dst: “报告在这里，我的女元首。”“好，我看看。嗯，这个不错。那个也没问题。那步调动我能接受。党卫军德洛丽丝·索特女将军，她到底为什么不把党卫军第14师调回这里，她仍然暴露在那些苏军面前。”“我的女元首，她的报告说，重炮无法移动，她手里那点摩托化运输工具越用越坏，马匹又在这场糟糕的天气里全都冻死了。”“是啊，没人能预料到这种天气。它拖慢了我们的行动，而苏联人的数量会让我们为此付出代价。只要空中掩护少出纰漏，我们应能撑住。可这么再拖2、3个月，我们会损失大量装备和‘女士’。这是我们必须忍受的‘必需之举’。我们别无选择，只能放弃一些土地。我们不能为了守阵地而丢掉整师。除了第14师，其他都还算有序。给索特发讯息，让她舍弃重炮，撤往克先斯克。我们会派些轻型机动炮兵连去与她会合。”于是，挡不住党卫军“女士”们的苏联人，有了一个能挡住她们的盟友——俄国严冬。

We will be overrun"." Come with Me Renveldt".A trip to the Rail Station." There Renveldt,there's Your Armor".Stu IIIG's had arrived.
dst: “基吉，上面情况怎么样。”“苏联人把他们所有东西都砸上来了。党卫军第36师原来驻守的空档正遭到持续进攻。我们在突破口把他们炸得够呛，可现在所有‘斯图卡’都领了新任务，去打击后方的补给区。我们所有人都知道那意味着什么——成吨的高射炮，想把我们打下来。‘费诺姆’的重型‘秃鹰’大队本该在我们之前进入支援，可这种协同以前从没成功过，所以明天我可能就不能和格罗特一起飞这架‘斯图卡’了，我们俩能活到明天都算走运。”基吉的“斯图卡”和许多其他飞机一样被击落。“费诺姆”的“秃鹰”出击3次，也损失不小。最后党卫军航空军又放出另外5个“秃鹰”大队和一个 Ju-88 大队，苏联后方被摧毁。苏军装甲又进攻了2天，但因燃料短缺不得不缩减行动，随后在大部分苏联坦克后撤时，被党卫军第34装甲师和“维尔”的党卫军装甲群在“斯图卡”支援下歼灭。女元首飞抵前线会见党卫军伦费尔特将军。“伊尔泽，我早跟你说了，看看我们损失的数字。没错，这次我们守住了。可你要是不往这儿调装甲部队，我们就有麻烦了。冬天一到，航空军就一文不值。我们会被打垮的。”“跟我来，伦费尔特。”一趟去火车站的行程。“看，伦费尔特，你的装甲部队到了。”三号突击炮 G 型已经运达。

dst: “你对这事担心吗，伊尔泽？”党卫军／海军蒂娜女海军上将问道。“它让我做噩梦。英国人在海上一直更强，这是事实。日德兰，我们又要回到日德兰了吗？当然，他们也一直有数量优势。我知道军舰、尤其是战列舰的时代，已经随着飞机和航母的进步而进入倒计时。很快它们就会成为累赘，甚至不值得建造。‘女士俾斯麦’号和‘女士提尔皮茨’号，如果我们能把它们投入海上，我们骚扰船队的处境会好得多，但那还得等几个月。我不认为‘皮卡尔·沃尔’号或‘女士埃尼’号能在这场战斗中幸存——要是能，那就是奇迹。我只希望舰上的光学和测距仪比英国人高出一档。不过‘胡德’号也参与了，它是一艘巨舰。英国人到底给它加装更多装甲了没有？我知道按计划是要升级的。只要几发炮弹打中要害，也许我们就能迫使英国人撤退，或者运气让我们‘横切T字阵’。要是不能，那么‘沃尔’号上的伊兹·泽拉女海军上将和‘埃尼’号上的普蒂·塞格尔女海军上将就要带着我们许多姑娘去游一场冰冷的水了。然后那个无用孤岛上的肥猪首相就会得意忘形，直到我们入侵、敲响他家门的时候。也许我们的航空军这次能救我们？”

src: As this great cloud of green gray gas was forming in front of us, we suddenly heard the French yelling. In less than a minute they started with the most rifle and machine gun fire that I had ever heard. Every field artillery gun, every machine gun, every rifle that the French had, must have been firing. I had never heard such a noise. The hail of bullets going over our heads was unbelievable, but it was not stopping the gas. The wind kept moving the gas towards the French lines. We heard the cows bawling, and the horses screaming. The French kept on shooting. They couldn't possibly see what they were shooting at. In about 15 minutes the gun fire started to quit. After half an hour, only occasional shots. Then everything was quiet again.
dst: 「当这片巨大的灰绿色毒气云在我们面前形成时，我们突然听到法国人在喊叫。不到一分钟，他们便开始了密集的步枪和机枪射击，那是我从未听过的。法国人所有的野战炮、每一挺机枪、每一支步枪，想必都在开火。我从未听过这样的喧闹。子弹从我们头顶呼啸而过，令人难以置信，但这并没有阻止毒气。风继续把毒气吹向法军阵地。我们听到牛在哞叫，马在嘶鸣。法国人不停地射击，他们根本看不清自己在朝什么打。大约15分钟后，枪声开始平息。半小时后，只剩零星的枪声。然后一切又归于寂静。」

dst: “天哪，伙计，她现在在哪儿。”那架“喷火”正在疾驰。“霍勒斯，在你左边，不，右边，见鬼，她又绕到你后面了。”“妈的，这些娘们是从哪儿弄来这种经验，能一直咬住我。老天作证，我在天上打过20多场遭遇战，就是甩不掉缠在我尾巴上的这个。”“把她引到我前面，霍勒斯，我替你把她点着。”“好，伯特，向左。来了。”那架“喷火”动了，党卫军跟上来，伯特切入。结果是：党卫军JG/52联队的“莉萨”·哈特曼女士的机翼和机身中了几发炮弹；霍勒斯和他的“喷火”拖着火坠下；一架 FW-106 一个桶滚，让伯顿的“飓风”也逃了起来。几分钟后，党卫军哈特曼又去寻找下一个对手，而伯特正缓缓坠向大地母亲，眼看着自己的飞机翻滚着走向毁灭。落到地面后，伯特被几个看空战的农民围住。“上面谁在赢？”一个老人问，更多人聚过来看。“不是我们。这些该死的纳粹丫头正把我们揍得够呛。”伯特回答。后来一位少校看见了伯顿·格诺姆斯——皇家空军第6中队——用他的车把他接走，送回一处机场。伯特本想再开一架战斗机，但这个基地只有在地面上被击毁的飞机，其余都后撤到巴黎方向了。于是党卫军/BdM 在这一带取得了控制权，而岛上的英国人为了“亲爱的老英格兰”把战斗机攥在手里不放。

src: But Sir,the SS has a new tank."Look Commander,what options have We got.The fuel trucks are burning from that 'Stuka attack.The bridge behind us has been blown by the Enemy.We got enough in Our fuel tanks for what,another 20 or 25 kilometers?What do You want to do,jump out of the tanks and have a picnik with these SS Girls?You want to sit there as they reach for the knife to butter your roll?They'll stick that Dam knife in Your eye then cut Your throat with it.I know some Guys have cut out figuring the War is lost and maybe it is,I don't know.But I know when those Guys get back to the Life as what they knew before it is going to be gone and replaced by suffering,misery and depression.Our Country is destroyed,People have been displaced in horrendous numbers.You saw it in Paris the thousands begging for nothing but a chunk of bread.And anytime the People heard a plane the terror in their eyes whether Ours or the SS/BdM's cos odds were it was the later.And No I don't blame the Brits  for holding onto their 'Spits but I believe they have made a grave mistake.With them here in large numbers We might have stood up to these 'Frau Whores but with Us folding the Brits will soon be getting all the Nazi's attention.We had the Finest Armee in the World.The Brits do not compare to Us.Bad decisions from the Top has destroyed Us,not this Incessant SS/BdM but now I would say They,the 'Fraus are the Finest Armee.Especially with that Air Korps.
dst: “可是长官，党卫军有了新坦克。”“听着，指挥官，我们还有什么选择。燃料车被那次‘斯图卡’空袭击中起火了。我们身后的桥被敌人炸了。油箱里剩下的油够跑多少，20还是25公里？你想怎么办，跳下坦克跟这些党卫军姑娘野餐去？你想坐在这儿，等她们伸手去拿涂黄油的面包刀？她们会把那该死的刀捅进你眼睛，再用它割断你的喉咙。我知道有些弟兄已经开小差，认定这仗输了，也许确实输了，我不知道。但我知道，等这些人回到他们熟悉的生活里，那生活已经没了，只剩下苦难、悲惨和压抑。我们的国家被毁了，民众流离失所的数量骇人听闻。你在巴黎看到了，成千上万人只求一块面包。任何时候人们听到飞机声，眼里都是恐惧——不管是我们还是党卫军/BdM 的，因为多半是后者。不，我不怪英国人攥着他们的‘喷火’不放，但我相信他们犯了大错。如果他们大批支援过来，我们或许还能顶住这些‘女士’们的攻势；可我们一垮，英国人很快就会成为所有纳粹注意力的目标。我们曾拥有世界上最精锐的军队。英国人根本不能跟我们比。是高层糟糕的决定毁了我们，不是这没完没了的党卫军/BdM——可如今我得说，她们，那些‘女士’们，才是最好的军队。尤其是配上那支航空军。”

src: Commander Isddorr,what should We do now the Fraus out of ammunition asked."Get Your pretty asses up,and take off.You don't want the Slav's slobbering all over them.I've got 8 Stick Grenades,I'll wait here for those Bastard Red Horse soldiers and do what I can,give them a Good Frauland welcome.Now get the Hell out of here".The Fraus cut out leaving behind everything but their uniforms and SS/BdM daggars.Hellbumahr Isddorr lit a cigarette and enjoyed a puff or two.She reached in the bag laying the grenades in front of Her,kept counting them as if by a miracle the next count there would be more.Didn't matter,8,10 a 100.Ivan's Horse soldiers were coming in mass and Poor Little Isddorr as the Fraus who just took out like lightning would not see tomorrow's Sun rise.So this was the End,nothing Special about it.Maybe a Prayer could do something?Rubbish. God or whatever had got Hellbumahr to here while Others had fell many times before.A lot of them prayed on their knees til they bled,still did not save them.Oh to be back in the Frauland Hellbumahr thought.Noise of approaching horses heard,Hundreds if not a thousand."Well My time has come,hope Your happy My Fuhress" Hellbumahr told Herself.The horses came over the hill.Hellbumahr stood up and tossed a Grenade.Later She woke up.Alone She looked around.Not an Ivan in sight.Puzzled She just stayed put for a few days.Panzers arrived. Isddorr survived,those who ran cut to pieces.
dst: “伊斯多尔指挥官，我们现在怎么办？”没弹药的“女士”们问。“把你们漂亮的屁股从地上挪起来，撤。你们不会想让那些斯拉夫人对着它们流口水吧。我还有8枚柄式手榴弹，我留在这儿等那些该死的红军骑兵，能干多少干多少，好好‘招待’他们一番。现在赶紧滚开这儿。”除了制服和党卫军/BdM 匕首，“女士”们丢下了一切，飞快撤离。赫尔布马赫尔·伊斯多尔点了一支烟，惬意地抽了两口。她把手伸进袋子，把手榴弹一枚枚摆在面前，不停地数着，仿佛下一次再数就会奇迹般地多出几枚。无所谓，8枚、10枚、100枚都一样。伊万的骑兵正成群杀来，可怜的小伊斯多尔——以及那些像闪电一样刚撤走的“女士”们——看不到明天的太阳了。那就这样结束吧，也没什么特别的。祈祷能管用吗？废话。上帝也好、什么也好，把赫尔布马赫尔带到了这里，而别人早已倒下许多次。他们中不少人跪着祈祷直到流血，也没能救下自己。啊，要是能回到“女性之国”该多好，赫尔布马赫尔想。听见马蹄声逼近，成百，也许上千。“好吧，我的时辰到了，希望您满意，我的女元首。”赫尔布马赫尔对自己说。马群翻过山冈。赫尔布马赫尔站起身，扔出一枚手榴弹。后来她醒了过来。孤身一人，环顾四周，一个伊万都看不见。她困惑地原地待了几天。装甲部队到了。伊斯多尔活了下来，那些逃走的人却被切成了碎片。

src: Commander Karlle,look."Yes I see Tarra,the same look on that bunch.We got replacements coming.These Girls got to be gotten out of the lines for a while or We are going to have them all go Mad.You go over there and tell them the Replacements will be here soon and I will watch their reaction".So Frau Sargent Tarra went over to the line of Zombies and gave them the Good News.Most showed no signs of interest at all,they had heard it before but it came to nothing.One Frau finally spoke up."Sargent,get the Hell out of My face before I take My Daggar out.Go on back over there with that Bitch Officer.You and Her have a Good Time while all of us here wait til Ivan shows up again.We've had enough,We won't survive any more against the numbers.We're numb now from dealing with the Soviet Bastards.Let them take Us,Rape Us,Torture Us and Kill Us.We don't give a Shit no more.They'll be in Berlin before it is over Raping and Killing there.Tell the Fuhress She and You and all the Rest of the SS Commanders have lost the Dam War and were Insane to think You could have ever beat Stalin.We should have quit after beating the French and British.We can not beat these Numbers,there's no way in Hell and that's where were all headed for.And all of Us here,We welcome it,it cannot be no worst then this Dam land of the Russians".
dst: “卡尔勒指挥官，你看。”“是啊，我看到了，塔拉，那帮人也是这副表情。我们有补充兵要来。这些姑娘得撤下前线一阵子，不然全都会发疯。你过去告诉她们补充兵很快就到，我看看她们什么反应。”于是塔拉女中士走到那排像行尸走肉一样的人面前，宣布了这个好消息。大多数人毫无反应，她们以前就听过，可什么都没兑现。终于有一个“女士”开口了。“中士，滚出我的视线，不然我就把匕首掏出来。滚回那个贱人军官那儿去。你和她乐呵去吧，我们在这儿等着伊万再来。我们受够了，再拼也拼不过他们的数量。被那些苏联混蛋折腾到这地步，我们已经麻木了。让他们抓我们、强暴我们、折磨我们、杀我们吧。我们他妈的不在乎了。到最后他们会打到柏林，在那里强暴、杀戮。去告诉女元首，她、你，还有所有其余的党卫军指挥官，全都输掉了这场该死的战争，还妄想能打赢斯大林，简直是疯了。我们打败法国人和英国人之后就该收手。我们拼不过这些数量，绝无可能，而我们所有人正朝那儿去。我们这里所有人，都欢迎它——再糟也糟不过俄国这片该死的土地。”

src: Commander what if We surrender? "Are You insane Frau? In France You fought an Enemy who had a little touch of morality.You surrender to the Bolsheviks and You will suffer a fate worst than Death.Imagine 20,40,100 of these Dirty Stinking Animals taking advantage of Your Gender before that Death.No We take Our SS daggars since were out of ammo and fight to the Death.Did You not take an oath to the Fuhress after arriving from Amerika.On that You swore Your Life to defend the Frauland from all enemies who would stand in it's way to acheive the Greatness the Fuhress is leading Us to". Commander Roche of the 1st SS/BdM 'Ilse' took Her SS daggar out and stabbed the Amerikan Frau in the throat several times."There You Stupid Bitch, We are here to fight until Our last breath and if You are too chicken or want to surrender and not follow orders of Your superiors then Your last breath comes by My hand".So an Amerikan Frau died,the platoon followed Endora Roche and all were killed though some who were injured and immobilized after Hours of being taken advantage of by the 'Animals' in Soviet uniforms.
dst: “指挥官，要是我们投降呢？”“你疯了吗，女士？在法国你面对的敌人还多少讲点道德。你要是向布尔什维克投降，会遭遇比死更惨的命运。想象一下，在这场死亡之前，20个、40个、100个这些肮脏发臭的畜生糟蹋你的身体。不行，既然没弹药了，我们就用党卫军匕首，战到死为止。你从美国来之后不是向女元首宣誓了吗。你誓言用生命保卫‘女性之国’，抵御一切阻挡它实现女元首带领我们走向的伟大的敌人。”“是的，可我没想到要跟俄国人打，一个8人小队对200人能做什么？女元首和她的‘伟大’在柏林，又安全又舒服，而我们在没弹药、只有8个人的这里。也许你对那边指挥苏军的人判断错了，也许他们还算正派。”“那就这么办吧，美国女士。”党卫军/BdM 第1“伊尔泽”师指挥官罗歇抽出党卫军匕首，在“美国女士”的喉咙上连捅数刀。“看你这蠢货。我们来这里就是要战到最后一口气，要是你太胆怯、想投降、不服从上级命令，那你的最后一口气就由我来断。”于是这名美国女士死了；全排跟随恩多拉·罗歇，最终全部阵亡——其中一些人在被那些穿苏联制服“畜生”糟蹋数小时、伤重无法动弹后被杀。

src: Commo,pluck that officer out of the water.The Italian crew pulled the officer aboard the launch."Captain Sentra,this officer is a Admiral"."Well salute Him and bring Him here".British Admiral Vian was brought to the Captain."This Day has not favored You,has it Admiral.You no longer have a Royal Navy and We the Italians now own the Sand and the Sea.The Glory of Rome is once again shining for all the World to admire.What do You say to that Admiral"? "I cannot deny We Brits have failed.And today is as sorry a day as I will ever see thanks to Your Navy.As far as the World admiring Rome I feel You are wrong on that count.I believe the 'Frau's of the SS is what the World is seeing shine and also alarmed about and their Insane Evil Leader in Berlin.You Italians are playing second Fiddle and I imagine as soon as Russia falls Fraulien Koch will turn Her attention towards You and 'Il Duce and do what She has done to all the other Males She has encountered,walk all over them in Her High Heels and grind them into the dirt". dst: 准将，把那个军官从水里捞上来。意大利船员把那名军官拉上小艇。"森特拉舰长，这位军官是位海军上将。""那就向他敬礼，带他过来。"英国海军上将维安被带到舰长面前。"今天对你可不友好，是吧，上将。你再没有皇家海军了，而我们意大利人如今拥有了沙地与海洋。罗马的荣光再次照耀，供全世界景仰。对此你有什么话说，上将？""我无法否认我们英国人失败了。多亏了你们的舰队，今天是我此生所见最不堪的一天。至于世界景仰罗马——我觉得你这一点说错了。我相信世界看到在闪耀、并且为之惊恐的，是党卫军那些'女士'，以及她们在柏林那个疯狂邪恶的领袖。你们意大利人不过是配角；我想一旦俄国陷落，弗劳莱因·科赫就会把注意力转向你和'领袖'，像对待她遇到的所有其他男性那样，用高跟鞋踩过去，把他们碾进泥土里。""别说蠢话了，上将，女人统治世界。我们意大利人应付得了女人，哪怕是党卫军里的。""是啊，舰长，你就继续这么想吧。我们也曾这么想。法国人也这么想。斯大林现在正在学。别忘了'领袖'的朋友希特勒。我相信你们意大利人能在别人都做不到的时候挡住党卫军'女士'们。唯一还有一线希望挡住'女士'们的，是美国——但以所罗门群岛发生的那些事，他们的时间也不多了。"

Serov out".
dst: “米斯卡同志，你在吗。你突过去了没有？”“没有，谢罗夫元帅，我们的坦克全没了。‘女士’们有了一种新型坦克歼击车，把我们切成了碎片。”“空中呢，空中情况怎么样？”“还是这场该死战争里的老样子，他们那种双发战斗机照例把我们的飞机清出了天空。谢罗夫，我们输了，莫斯科很快就要挨炮了。我现在正在收拾东西，去找我的家人，我们要跑。”“谢谢你，同志。我们从一开始就注定完蛋。斯大林的命令，加上他从头就对军官团的杀戮，让太多指挥官在关键时刻无法果断行动。不过还是难以相信，这些‘女士’竟然打败了我们的数量。可惜我们失去了那么多同志。我见不到我的家人了，所以我要回克里姆林宫去见斯大林，把这个好消息告诉他：战争就要结束了——但不是‘老板’设想的那种。在他下令枪毙我之前，他脸上的表情想必很精彩。不过他会得到报应的。要么‘女士’们收拾他，要么我们自己的同胞。斯大林在这场讨伐党卫军的十字军中牺牲了多少俄罗斯儿女，这笔账一定会讨回来，我毫不怀疑。内务人民委员部保不了‘老板’一辈子。祝你好运，米斯卡，告诉你妻子，我会想念她做的饭。谢罗夫通话完毕。”

dst: “迪安娜，过来。”迪安娜·特雷耶尔爬上山丘，看蒂切要她看什么。“看那儿。”“这儿到底发生了什么事，蒂切？周围有多少该死的伊万？”“我数了那边11个，那边还有3个，看，还有2辆红军坦克。而她身边我只看到那支 MP 40 和那支反坦克枪，没有‘铁拳’爆炸的痕迹，也没有别的支援。”“她一定是个了不起的‘女士’，比你我强多了，这一点可以肯定。”“是的，我同意。可惜这么出色的一位‘女士’，要为女元首付出生命这样沉重的代价。”慢慢地，更多“女士”爬上山丘来看这一幕。几分钟后，赫斯勒女少尉出现了：“这儿怎么回事？”“妈的，赫斯勒，睁开你的眼睛。”蒂切回道，“你看不出有人为了阻止这里的布尔什维克，把命都搭上了，让我们所有人汗颜吗。把你那些拍马屁换来的勋章摘一枚下来，钉在她的尸体上。这辈子你就做一件对的事吧，赫斯勒，这儿所有人都知道你的勋章是怎么来的。”“蒂切，你总有一天会过分到让我把你关起来。”“空头支票。要是能让我离开你的小队，我求之不得。”党卫军“女士”埃莉兹·蒙哥马利因独自一人的防御、并为掩护他人撤退而献出生命，被追授铁十字勋章。她的指挥官把这事大肆宣扬，但真相是：那位指挥官为了保命，把这位“女士”和另外几人丢给了伊万。真相永远不会被人知道。

dst: “昆德丽女士，我要的补给呢？”“魏因施特劳斯少校，它们暂时被卡住了。我们有个严重问题，这场讨伐布尔什维克的伟大远征中没人注意到它。”“我不管什么严重不严重的破事，我需要装甲部队的燃料，现在就要。非得我掏鲁格手枪吗？”“别冲我发火，少校，开枪对你也没好处。要是有人事先查过我们用的铁轨轨距和这些布尔什维克混蛋的轨距不一样，你的燃料现在就在这儿，而不是在格奥格诺波利斯那儿往卡车上倒。你大概还得等4个小时。”“四个小时。你疯了吗。我把苏联人打跑了，要是追不上，他们就会和其他部队会合，我们还得再击溃他们一次，损失更多姑娘和坦克。”“抱歉，少校，我无能为力。”“唉，把那该死的电话给我。格温，你在吗。去机场，告诉埃尔克尔女士派几架运输机去普雷迪，有一批燃料车正往你那边开。拦住它们，把燃料给我弄这儿来。唉，我不知道，要是它们不停车就毙了那些司机。只要把燃料给我弄来，我的装甲部队都趴着呢，车组没事干只能修指甲，我可不高兴。是啊好吧，嘿，我说毙司机是开玩笑的。瞧，女士，这不就用不了4小时了。你还有多少弹药？”“我猜你最好还是去掏鲁格手枪吧，少校，再让那些飞机飞去特列姆科斯诺夫——我说了，4小时，或者更久。”

Georgi K. Zhukov's way of fighting a battle, (and it may have been a way dictated as much by necessity as by design), was to let the enemy extend himself; to wait until the last moment  of enemy offensive momentum, and then to grind them down in terrible bloody exchanges as they moved in for their objective. Meanwhile, despite fearful Soviet losses and dangerous enemy penetration, Zhukov cautiously, carefully, and painstakingly massed reserve armies which he refused to commit to action, no matter what the peril at the front. Then, at the moment when German strength was spent, he would unleash the counterblow with dramatic rapidity-often within 48 hours of a German pause, and before the Nazis were able to estabilish a reliable defence."
dst: 「格奥尔基·K·朱可夫打战役的方式（这可能是必然与设计各占一半的产物）是：先让敌人把力量铺开；一直等到敌军进攻势头将尽的最后一刻，然后在他们扑向目标的途中，以可怕的流血对耗把他们磨垮。与此同时，尽管苏军损失惨重、敌军突入危险，朱可夫仍谨慎、细致、耐心地集结着预备队集团军，无论前线处境多么危急，他都拒绝将其投入战斗。而后，在德军力量耗尽的那一刻，他便以惊人的速度发动反击——常常在德军停顿后的48小时之内，在纳粹还来不及建立可靠防御之前。」

dst: “是女元首吗，您听得见我吗？我几乎听不见您。是的，我是萨凡纳。我们终于拿下了。不过代价很大。是的，航空军也付出了沉重代价，我们这一带到处散落着飞机。不，该死的苏联重炮还在开火，所以我才几乎听不见。我们在布置自己的炮，还调了几门突击炮来打过伏尔加河。我派了几艘小艇载着突击‘女士’过河。我们还在架桥，好把几辆‘虎’式送过去——等着看那些炮到时候还有什么办法，等我们的大家伙压到那些苏联混蛋头顶上。它们会被打哑，但代价还是少不了。航空军正在猛轰那些企图合围我们的部队，他们终于在这一带掌握了制空权。那些该死的‘Hexxens’一到就把地面夷平了，我怀疑没有它们参战我们赢不了这一仗。施特格哈斯曼女士，弄一支这种飞机的机队来，这场战争会结束得快得多。为什么，它们能赢下这场战争。您是说霍顿姐妹那些疯子设计的东西更好？这我倒要看看。好了，我暂时要把司令部后移，安全第一。我想过几天清剿小队就到了，他们这儿可有的忙了。周围肯定有20万平民，我们还抓了约9万士兵俘虏。我们正把他们往城外赶，好把秩序理出来。是的我知道，我的女元首，这是我们时代的一个伟大时刻。他们现在在我们手里了。”

src: It takes guts to throw the kind of forces they did at us in my last engagement.  Maybe that's why the brass have sent us to the coast.   They're calling it a 'reprisal' operation; I guess they think taking some villages will help lower enemy morale.
dst: 「上次交火时，他们敢把那种规模的兵力砸到我们头上，够有胆量的。也许这就是上头把我们派到沿海来的原因。他们管这叫『报复』行动；我猜他们觉得夺取几个村庄能打击敌军士气。」

src: It's been a while, I guess...

It's over, gentlemen. Since I've got the news of my promotion, I knew that we're in serious trouble. But now it's official. Nevermind. We were in a wish-wash times before and we may still save the brigade. But it will cost many lives; not everyone makes it to the safety. I want you to immediatelly start with organization of the withdrawal. We must hold the bridges as long as possible, lest they all will be trapped.	“结束了，先生们。自从我得知晋升的消息，我就知道我们有大麻烦了。但现在它正式确定了。没关系。我们以前也经历过混乱的时候，我们也许还能救下这个旅。但这要付出许多生命的代价；不是每个人都能安全脱身。我要你们立即着手组织撤退。我们必须尽可能久地守住这些桥，否则他们全都会被围住。	prose	1
It's time to strike a blow and reclaim hope.   One attack, near enough to the Arm bases to cause dismay and in a large enough city to mobilize the populace."
dst: 「是时候打出一击、重拾希望了。一次进攻，要打得离阿尔姆基地够近以致其惊惶，也要选一座够大的城市以动员民众。」

src: It's time to take the fight to the men in charge.  I trust the men and they trust me.  We'll get the job done.
dst: 「是时候把仗打到那些掌权者头上了。我信任这些人，他们也信任我。我们会把活干完。」

src: Ja, Herr General, I was just told that the city is captured and the Dutchmen routed. But we've had great losses. Looks like some scouts reported very badly and many of our troops fell into some sort of trap. And in the chaos that reigned there, our pilots even bombed several of our units. Yes, yes, I know, very frustrating, but this just happens. Nein, mein Herr, I won't tell this to the survivors... Pardon? Oh, the name of the officer that saved the situation? I really don't know, but I'll do my best to find him out!
dst: “是，将军先生，我刚得到消息，城市已攻占，荷兰人被击溃了。但我们损失惨重。看来有些侦察兵报告得很糟，我们许多部队落入了某种陷阱。而在随之而来的混乱中，我们的飞行员甚至轰炸了自己的几支部队。是，是，我知道，非常令人沮丧，但这种事就是会发生。不，先生，我不会把这事告诉幸存者……什么？哦，那个挽救局面的军官的名字？我真的不知道，但我会尽力查出他是谁！”

src: Karla turn the turret to the left there's one trying to get around behind Mikka.The turret on the Panzer turned,2 shots into the Brit Maltilda and no effect."Dam those are hard Bastards to destroy".Next moment the Brit tank took one in the rear stopping it cold."Zena,ah You beautriful darling saved Our asses again"."Look Sebba,Zena's here just in the nick of time".Zena Warburgen,tank destroyer supreme for the SS/BdM.The crews number of kills was approaching 30.Zena's tank moved off.The battle raged for hours with both sides paying a terrible price.Then the Air Korps arrived and in the end few Brit tanks escaped while another gruppen of SS Panzers showed up on the scene.Moving towards Arras Zena's tank was spotted smoke pouring out of the turret and the left tread knocked off.In the woods a destroyed Brit anti-tank gun which got Zena but later was attacked by infantry."Shit Karla they got Zena,what a shame"."Yeh Sebba she's going to be missed by one and all.Sure was a Hell of a Girl.How many times She save Us,about a 100? dst: “卡拉，把炮塔转向左边，有一辆想绕到米卡背后。”坦克的炮塔转了过去，两发炮弹命中那辆英国“玛蒂尔达”，却毫无效果。“该死，这些家伙皮糙肉厚，打不烂。”下一刻，那辆英国坦克后部中了一弹，立刻瘫住不动了。“泽娜，啊，你这漂亮宝贝又救了我们的命。”“瞧，塞巴，泽娜来得正是时候。”泽娜·瓦布根，党卫军/BdM 最顶尖的坦克杀手，她的车组击毁数已接近30。泽娜的坦克开走了。战斗持续了数小时，双方都付出了惨重代价。随后航空军赶到，最终没几辆英国坦克逃脱，而另一群党卫军装甲部队也出现在战场上。在向阿拉斯移动时，泽娜的坦克被发现——炮塔冒着烟，左侧履带被打断。树林里有一门被摧毁的英国反坦克炮，正是它击中了泽娜，但随后遭步兵攻击。“妈的，卡拉，他们干掉了泽娜，太可惜了。”“是啊，塞巴，大家都会想念她。她可真是个了不起的姑娘。她救过我们多少次，大概一百次吧？基奇女少校可不会喜欢给瓦布根家写信报丧，他们从十来岁起就在一起了。”“卡拉，这里发生的事，对‘女性之国’的许多家庭来说都不是好消息。以后应该会轻松些——英国人耗光了他们的装甲，加上本月早些时候航空军的战果，形势已转向对我们有利。一切都取决于他们从这里起会逼得我们多紧。”
马克斯·阿尔佩特的《营长》。

src: Let's get to the Volga first

Look at that Annka, must be 40 soldiers around it.Stalin has to be there."Sargent Terra, move Your troops over to there, we'll wait for the Tiger to show up then move".The Frau Commanders wanted Him alive but Ilse had told Frau Major Gilda she would rather He died and just get it over with.With Stalin dead the Soviet Forces East of the Don would fall apart as the Soviet Generals would fight for control and try to make some Peace with the Frauland.The Fuhress wasn't going to have it, Eradication East of the Don was already taking place and the SS/BdM had control of the Air and bombed at will, anything and everything.Tiger 206 of the 1st SS arrived.It moved down the street.The attack commenced. First the mobile Sig batteries opened up a barrage.The Soviet troops scattered, running every which way, "to Hell with Stalin" they must of said.Some ran into Sargent Terra's machine-gun support and were mowed down.Some tried to surrender and were shot with their hands in the air, the SS was not taking Prisoners any more.The Tiger moved up to get a clear shot.A anti-tank gun, light version fired from a window inside the building on the main floor.A few richochets off the Tiger.Tiger 206 cut loose firing into the main floor, it rocked the whole area.Three more shots from the 88 and the 3 story building collasped.The SS infantry then worked into the rubble, a few shots to kill those injured and Joseph Stalin was found, crushed to death.It was over, Russia was in the hands of the SS.
dst: “看那儿，安卡，周围肯定有40个士兵。斯大林一定在里面。”“特拉中士，把你的人调过去，我们等‘虎’式到了再动。”党卫军指挥官们想活捉他，但伊尔泽告诉吉尔达女少校，她宁愿他死了、赶紧了结。斯大林一死，顿河以东的苏军就会分崩离析，因为苏军将领们会争夺控制权，并试图与“女性之国”谈和。女元首不会答应——顿河以东的清剿已经在进行，党卫军/BdM 掌握着制空权，想炸什么就炸什么。党卫军第1师的206号“虎”式到了。它沿街推进。进攻开始。先是机动“西格”火箭炮连齐射。苏军四散奔逃，想必是说着“让斯大林见鬼去吧”。有些人撞上特拉中士的机枪火力网，被扫倒。有些人试图投降，举着手就被打死——党卫军已不再收俘虏。“虎”式上前，准备清射。一门轻型反坦克炮从那栋楼底层的一扇窗里开火，在“虎”式上打出几处跳弹。206号“虎”式猛烈还击，向底层倾泻火力，震动了整片区域。88炮又打了三发，那栋三层楼轰然倒塌。党卫军步兵随后钻进瓦砾，补几枪打死伤者，并找到了约瑟夫·斯大林——已被压死。结束了，俄国落入党卫军之手。

src: Look at that Cawells,isn't She beautiful.A shame to send Her to the bottom.I must say those Broads in Germany have as fine a looking battleship as I have ever seen.Commander Cawells looked through the periscope.The Polish sub 'Orzel had a SS/KM battleship in it's sight.A Torpedo spread was fired."Their true to center Lispke,this should be some fireworks and We can at least speak of Victory from under the sea".The countdown was made,only 1 Explosion."Faulty weapons again,Lispke.Raise the periscope let's see the damage.Dam another vessel got in the way,small fry not worth registering in the log but do it anyway.Let's get out of here".The 'Orzel moved out into deeper waters and made a run for Dennmark.The SS Air Korps hounded it for 40 minutes finally giving up,too much allotment of forces for a single Polish fish when there was better targets on the land.From Dennmark to England the 'Orzel traveled but with a faulty radio it could not communicate with the Brits.Finally putting some Men ashore they made contact just in time to see a Brit Coastal bomber drop bombs damaging the 'Orzel.The 'Orzel would not get back into action for 8 months and of course by that time Poland would be no more.Later exploits of the 'Orzel would be Legend and of course it's end would too.It being one of a number of subs struck by it's own Torpedo when the sound guidance would error sending the wayward fish back in the waters off Casablanca to destroy the sub.
dst: “看那儿，考威尔斯，她多美啊。把她送到海底真是可惜。我得说，德国那些娘们建造的战列舰，是我见过最好看的。”考威尔斯指挥官透过潜望镜望去。波兰潜艇“苍鹰”号的瞄准镜里有一艘党卫军／海军的战列舰。一组鱼雷齐射。“他们正对中心，利斯普克，这下该有一场好戏了，我们至少能从水下报个胜绩。”倒计时数完，只有1声爆炸。“武器又出故障了，利斯普克。升起潜望镜，看看损伤。妈的，另一艘船挡在了中间，不值一提的小船，不值得记入航海日志，但还是记一笔吧。我们撤。”“苍鹰”号驶向更深的水域，向丹麦方向逃去。党卫军航空军追击了40分钟，最终放弃——为一条波兰鱼花费太多兵力，而陆上还有更好的目标。从丹麦到英格兰，“苍鹰”号一路航行，但电台故障，无法与英国人联络。最后派了几个人上岸，刚接上头，就眼看着一架英国海岸轰炸机投下炸弹，击伤了“苍鹰”号。“苍鹰”号此后8个月都无法再参战，而到那时波兰已经不复存在了。后来“苍鹰”号的战绩成为传奇，它的结局同样如此——它是若干艘被自己的鱼雷击中的潜艇之一，当时声制导系统出错，把失控的鱼雷送回了卡萨布兰卡外海，摧毁了潜艇本身。

src: Look there Kartrina,all those frozen bodies."That could have been Us Gann,the Poor Devils.Must be 200.No place to go to get out of the Cold and just unlucky to wander in an area where the Ivans were before they retreated with Ivan destroying everything through their Scorched Earth Policy". "Gann,Kartrina come over here"."Oh Hell, Corporal Tammie is going to give Us Burial Detail".A lot of Frau's were buried on the Eastern Front from the Winter of '41.The Soviets took back some area so in early '42 land that the SS/BdM had payed for in Blood before would cost more.With offensive actions curtailed Stalins Armies were back up to strength as far as numbers.The advantage of course was in the experience and the SS had that in 'Spades.So when offensive actions began again the Frau's would once again move forward with the Soviets throwing horrendous numbers to try and prevent it.A place called Rostav now appeared on the Map.The SS needed it to set up Airbases to attack the Oilfields in the Caucasus.And of course Junkers 'Frau-Z finally appeared on the scene giving the Air Korps complete dominance in the Dogfighting over the Russian terroritory below.Even with the 'Frau-Z the Russians still had planes that appeared in the Skies and SS/BdM Forces both in the Sky and on the Ground kept saying to themselves "will this ever End".In Berlin the Fuhress looked out the window thinking the same.
dst: “看那儿，卡特丽娜，那么多冻僵的尸体。”“那本来也可能是我们，甘，这些可怜的家伙。肯定有200具。没地方躲寒，又倒霉地晃荡到伊万撤退前待过的地带——伊万按焦土政策把一切都毁了。”“甘，卡特丽娜，过来这边。”“哦，见鬼，塔米下士要派我们去收尸了。”41年冬天，东线埋葬了许多“女士”。苏联人夺回了一些地区，所以42年初，党卫军/BdM 此前用鲜血换来的土地要再付一次代价。攻势缩减后，斯大林的军队在数量上恢复到了满编。优势自然在经验上，而党卫军在这方面富得流油。因此当攻势重启时，“女士”们再次向前推进，苏联人则投入骇人的数量试图阻止。地图上如今出现了一个叫罗斯托夫的地方。党卫军需要它来修建机场，以便攻击高加索的油田。当然，容克公司的“Frau-Z”终于登场，使航空军在下方俄国领土上空的空战中取得完全统治地位。即便有了“Frau-Z”，俄国人仍不断有飞机出现在天上，党卫军/BdM 不论空中还是地面，都在不停自问：“这一切到底有没有尽头。”在柏林，女元首望着窗外，想的也是同样的问题。

src: Lori,You go after that one I'll get rid of this Pest.Pilot Shanna Sullivan,from Amerika and now a SS/BdM Pilot with over 40 kills.Flying the Frau-Z and as most Pilots in it having a feeling of invincibility.The Soviet Pilot flying the best the Soviets had the Yak Seven/B.On a chase over Mother Russia the Planes went after each other.Down on the Deck,Steep dives,Barrel Rolls,incredible turns that made both Pilots Black out for a few seconds.Places were traded,one leading the Chase then the Other.Both took hits but no Critical Damage up to this point.Finally Shanna got a hit and smoke was trailing from the Russian Bird.The Russian Pilot was in trouble and knew it.She once again went down on the Deck after making a long turn.Shanna followed,both racing over the landscape.One last Blast from the 20mm and the Russian plane crashed into a street."Got You,didn't I.You were Good Ivan,but not quite Good enough".Another kill for the SS,for Shanna.A few seconds later Her Plane blew apart.A large AA gun not even firing at Shanna hit the Frau-Z.Shanna got Hers this day too.The Russian Pilot had led Shanna towards a massive amount of AA guns congregated to the East of the town.The SS Pilots had been warned of the site but Shanna in Her little battle with the Yak had let it consume Her,and So it did.SS Pilot Lori Langemarck survived and waited for Her friend on the Airfield to return,She never did.
dst: “洛丽，你去追那架，我来收拾这个讨厌鬼。”飞行员珊娜·沙利文，来自美国，如今是击落超过40架的党卫军/BdM 飞行员。她驾驶“Frau-Z”，和大多数驾驶这种飞机的飞行员一样，有一种不可战胜的感觉。那名苏联飞行员驾驶着苏军最好的雅克-7B。在“母亲俄罗斯”上空的一场追逐中，两架飞机互相追杀。贴地飞行、陡直俯冲、桶滚、令人难以置信的急转，让两名飞行员都短暂黑视。位置不断交换，一会儿这个领追，一会儿那个领追。双方都中了弹，但到此刻都还没有致命损伤。终于，珊娜打中一发，俄国飞机拖起了烟。那名苏联飞行员陷入困境，心里也清楚。她做了一个长转弯后再次贴地。珊娜紧跟，两架飞机掠过大地竞逐。20毫米炮最后一次齐射，俄国飞机撞进了街道。“我逮到你了，对吧。你干得不错，伊万，但还差那么一点。”这是党卫军、是珊娜的又一个战果。几秒钟后，她的飞机炸成了碎片。一门根本没朝珊娜射击的大型高射炮击中了“Frau-Z”。这一天珊娜也轮到了自己。那名苏联飞行员把珊娜引向了城镇以东集结的大量高炮。党卫军飞行员们本已被警告过那个阵地的存在，但珊娜在与雅克的那场小缠斗中让胜负欲吞没了自己，结果就真的被吞没了。党卫军飞行员洛丽·朗格马克幸存下来，在机场等着她的朋友返航，她再也没回来。

src: Well there's nothing to do,we'll have to bail,inform the crew Freida.SS/BdM Bomber # 221 on it's return trip had been shot up too bad by flak.Engine 2 and 4 had done gave out and 3 was starting to lose pressure.The Fraus jumped from the Damaged Kondor.All landed safely but Nerra,Her chute caught in a tree and slammed Her body against it killing Her.Commander Close would have liked to have got Her down but knew it would take too much of an effort with Her up so high.And of course all the Girls knew this far behind the lines and them being in the Air Korps that just layed waste to the Armor factories they were as good as dead too. dst: “没办法了，我们得跳伞，通知机组，弗蕾达。”党卫军/BdM 221号轰炸机在返航途中被高射炮打得千疮百孔。2号和4号发动机已经报废，3号也开始掉压。“女士”们从受损的“秃鹰”上跳下。所有人都安全着陆，只有内拉——她的伞挂在树上，身体狠狠撞上树干，当场身亡。克洛斯指挥官本想把她弄下来，但知道她挂得那么高，太费劲了。当然，所有姑娘都清楚，在这么深的敌后，而她们又属于刚刚摧毁了装甲工厂的航空军，自己也等于死人了。她们撤离，藏进一片树林。对大多数人来说，睡眠自然是不可能的。“她怎么做到的，这种处境还能睡着。”“唉，让她睡吧，丹卡，明天她就会和我们一样永久地睡了。我们没法躲，这一带人太多，迟早会被发现。”第二天，“女士”们果然被发现了。苏军的规定要求把所有飞行员交给秘密警察审讯，若审讯中的拷打没弄死囚犯，就随后处决。这些“女士”被农民抓到，带到一个集体农庄，遭到殴打和强暴，然后被活活烧死。作为航空军的一员，她们投下燃烧弹烧毁了农民储存在谷仓里的粮食——这是她们的罪。而当苏军出现索要粮食时，这些农民已经用自己几个孩子的性命付了代价。

dst: “那是什么鬼口径的火炮，卡西？”“我不知道，但我从没见过‘虎’式那样被炸飞。那个车组连撒泡尿的时间都没有。”俄国人在该地区调来了一些重型机动炮兵连，正在猛烈开火。“听听那鬼东西。你说他们不会把战列舰弄到陆上来了吧，泽娜？”“俄国人是挺疯的，卡西，但我觉得还没疯到那份上。不过你知道，再过几分钟尼托尔上尉就要找志愿者去定位那门苏联炮了；她恨你老是顶撞她，等她一来我可不想站你旁边。”“泽娜，你话说早了，贱人尼托尔这就来了。”“泽娜、卡西，把你们那可怜的两条腿挪过来。听着，你们俩，我需要你们出去找到那门炮的位置，这样我才能叫来空中支援把它摧毁——否则空军指挥官不会为搜索任务派飞机，至少不会为我们派。”于是泽娜和卡西只得闯进“无女士”地带，只能指望自己运气好，不至于待在炮弹落点上。她们运气不好。后来俄国人把那门炮后撤了，但被一辆侦察车发现，随后派出2架“FrauWind-Z”把它摧毁了。泽娜和卡西又是两个从此不存在的灵魂——那发大口径炮弹只留下了昔日党卫军“女士”们的碎片。

src: (Book II,1.) While Caesar was in winter quarters in Hither Gaul, as we have shown above, frequent reports were brought to him, and he was also informed by letters from Labienus, that all the Belgae, who we have said are a third part of Gaul, were entering into a confederacy against the Roman people, and giving hostages to one another; that the reasons of the confederacy were these-first, because they feared that, after all [Celtic] Gaul was subdued, our army would be led against them; secondly, because they were instigated by several of the Gauls; some of whom as [on the one hand] they had been unwilling that the Germans should remain any longer in Gaul, so [on the other] they were dissatisfied that the army of the Roman people should pass the winter in it, and settle there; and others of them, from a natural instability and fickleness of disposition, were anxious for a revolution; [the Belgae were instigated] by several, also, because the government in Gaul was generally seized upon by the more powerful persons and by those who had the means of hiring troops, and they could less easily effect this object under our dominion.
dst: （卷二、1）如前所述，凯撒在内高卢过冬期间，不断有消息报来，拉比埃努斯的书信也告 知他：所有比尔吉人——我们说过他们占高卢的三分之一——正在结成对抗罗马人民的同盟，并互派 人质；结盟的理由是：第一，他们担心〔凯尔特〕高卢全境被征服之后，我军会转而进攻他们；第二， 他们受到若干高卢人的煽动；这些人一方面不愿日耳曼人再留在高卢，另一方面又不满意罗马人民的军 队在 此过冬并定居下来；还有些人则天性反复无常、喜好变乱；〔比尔吉人〕受多方煽动，也因为在高卢，政 权通常被有权势者、以及有财力雇兵的人把持，而在我们的统治之下，他们较难达成这一目标。

src: (BookII/21) Caesar, having given the necessary orders, hastened to and fro into whatever quarter fortune carried him, to animate the troops, and came to the tenth legion. Having encouraged the soldiers with no further speech than that “they should keep up the remembrance of their wonted valor, and not be confused in mind, but valiantly sustain the assault of the enemy;” as the latter were not further from them than the distance to which a dart could be cast, he gave the signal for commencing battle. And having gone to another quarter for the purpose of encouraging [the soldiers], he finds them fighting. Such was the shortness of the time, and so determined was the mind of the enemy on fighting, that time was wanting not only for affixing the military insignia, but even for putting on the helmets and drawing off the covers from the shields. To whatever part any one by chance came from the works (in which he had been employed), and whatever standards he saw first, at these he stood, lest in seeking his own company he should lose the time for fighting....
dst: （卷二/21）凯撒下达必要命令后，便往来奔走于命运把他带到的各处，去激励部队，最后来到第10军团。他只以一句话鼓励士兵：「要记住你们一贯的勇武，不要心慌，要勇敢地承受敌人的进攻。」——此时敌人距他们已不到一投矛之遥——随即发出会战信号。等他再到别处去鼓励〔士兵〕时，发现他们已在厮杀。时间如此紧迫，敌人作战之意又如此坚决，以至于不仅来不及安上军旗标志，连戴头盔、揭下盾套都来不及。不管谁从（他原先干活的）工事那边碰巧赶到哪一处，也不管他先看见哪些旗号，就在那里站定，唯恐去找自己的队而误了厮杀……

src: (BookIII/1) When Caesar was setting out for Italy, he sent Servius Galba with the twelfth legion and part of the cavalry, against the Nantuates, the Veragri, and Seduni, who extend from the territories of the Allobroges, and the lake of Geneva, and the River Rhone to the top of the Alps. The reason for sending him was, that he desired that the pass along the Alps, through which [the Roman] merchants had been accustomed to travel with great danger, and under great imposts, should be opened. He permitted him, if he thought it necessary, to station the legion in these places, for the purpose of wintering. Galba having fought some successful battles and stormed several of their forts, upon embassadors being sent to him from all parts and hostages given and a peace concluded, determined to station two cohorts among the Nantuates, and to winter in person with the other cohorts of that legion in a village of the Veragri, which is called Octodurus; and this village being situated in a valley, with a small plain annexed to it, is bounded on all sides by very high mountains.
dst: （卷三/1）凯撒启程前往意大利时，派塞尔维乌斯加尔巴率第12军团和一部分骑兵，去对付南图阿特人、韦拉格里人与塞杜尼人——他们的地界自阿洛布罗格斯人领地、日内瓦湖与罗讷河一直延伸到阿尔卑斯山顶。派他前去的理由是：凯撒希望打开沿阿尔卑斯山的那条通道——〔罗马〕商队一向冒着极大危险、缴纳重税经此往来。他准许加尔巴，若认为必要，就把军团驻在这些地方过冬。加尔巴打了几场胜仗、攻下数座堡垒之后，各方派来使者、交出人质、缔结和约，于是他决定在南图阿特人中驻留两个步兵队，亲自率该军团其余步兵队在韦拉格里人的一个村落过冬，那村子叫奥克托杜鲁斯；此村坐落于一条山谷之中，附带一小片平地，四面为极高的山峦所环抱。

src: (BookIV/16) The German war being finished, Caesar thought it expedient for him to cross the Rhine, for many reasons; of which this was the most weighty, that, since he saw the Germans were so easily urged to go into Gaul, he desired they should have their fears for their own territories, when they discovered that the army of the Roman people both could and dared pass the Rhine.
dst: （卷四/16）日耳曼战事既毕，凯撒认为渡莱茵河于他有利，理由甚多；其中最有力的一条是：他既然看出日耳曼人如此容易被鼓动进入高卢，便希望他们在得知罗马人民的军队既能、也敢渡过莱茵河之后，为自己的领土担惊受怕。

src: (BookIV/20) During the short part of summer which remained, Caesar, although in these countries, as all Gaul lies toward the north, the winters are early, nevertheless resolved to proceed into Britain, because he discovered that in almost all the wars with the Gauls succors had been furnished to our enemy from that country; and even if the time of year should be insufficient for carrying on the war, yet he thought it would be of great service to him if he only entered the island, and saw into the character of the people, and got knowledge of their localities, harbors, and landing-places, all which were for the most part unknown to the Gauls
dst: （卷四/20）在夏天剩下的不多时间里，凯撒虽然身处这些地区——由于整个高卢偏北，冬季来得早——仍决意进军不列颠，因为他发现，几乎所有对高卢的战争中，敌方都从那里得到援助；即便时令已不足以支撑一场战争，他也认为只要登上该岛、看看当地人的性情、弄清他们的地理、港湾与登陆点，就已大有用处——而这一切高卢人大多并不知道

src: (BookV/8) When these things were done [and] Labienus left on the continent with three legions and 2,000 horse, to defend the harbors and provide corn, and discover what was going on in Gaul, and take measures according to the occasion and according to the circumstance; he himself, with five legions and a number of horse, equal to that which he was leaving on the continent, set sail at sun-set, and [though for a time] borne forward by a gentle south-west wind, he did not maintain his course, in consequence of the wind dying away about midnight, and being carried on too far by the tide, when the sun rose, espied Britain passed on his left. Then, again, following the change of tide, he urged on with the oars that he might make that part of the island in which he had discovered the preceding summer, that there was the best landing-place, and in this affair the spirit of our soldiers was very much to be extolled; for they with the transports and heavy ships, the labor of rowing not being [for a moment] discontinued, equaled the speed of the ships of war. All the ships reached Britain nearly at mid-day; nor was there seen a [single] enemy in that place, but, as Caesar afterward found from some prisoners, though large bodies of troops had assembled there, yet being alarmed by the great number of our ships, more than eight hundred of which, including the ships of the preceding year, and those private vessels which each had built for his own convenience, had appeared at one time, they had quitted the coast and concealed themselves among the higher points....
dst: （卷五/8）这些事办妥之后〔，〕拉比埃努斯带着三个军团和2,000骑兵留在大陆，守卫港口、筹办粮食、探察高卢的动向，并相机行事；凯撒本人则率五个军团和与留在陆上数量相等的骑兵，于日落时起航。〔虽然〕一度被柔和的西南风推送前进，但不到半夜风就停了，他又被潮水带得过远，因此未能保持航向；日出时，他望见不列颠从自己左侧掠过。于是他再顺潮流变化，督促划桨前进，以便抵达他去年夏天发现的那处最好的登陆点——在这件事上，我方士兵的士气极堪称赞：他们驾着运输船和笨重的船只，划桨一刻不停，竟赶上了战舰的速度。所有船只几乎都在正午抵达不列颠；那处地方不见一个敌人，但正如凯撒后来从一些俘虏口中得知的，虽然当地曾集结大批部队，可是他们被我们船只的数量吓住了——连同上一年的船以及各人为自己方便而造的私船，一次出现的竟有八百多艘——于是离开海岸，躲进了较高的地势……

src: (BookVI/7) While these things are being performed by Caesar, the Treviri, having drawn together large forces of infantry and cavalry, were preparing to attack Labienus and the legion which was wintering in their territories, and were already not further distant from him than a journey of two days, when they learn that two legions had arrived by the order of Caesar. Having pitched their camp fifteen miles off, they resolve to await the support of the Germans. Labienus, having learned the design of the enemy, hoping that through their rashness there would be some opportunity of engaging, after leaving a guard of five cohorts for the baggage, advances against the enemy with twenty-five cohorts and a large body of cavalry, and, leaving the space of a mile between them, fortifies his camp.
dst: （卷六/7）当凯撒在做这些事时，特雷维里人已集结起大量步兵与骑兵，准备进攻拉比埃努斯以及在他们地界过冬的那个军团，距他不过两日行程；这时他们得知凯撒已下令调来两个军团。他们把营寨扎在十五里外，决定等待日耳曼人的支援。拉比埃努斯探知敌人的打算，希望趁其鲁莽觅得战机，便留下五个步兵队守卫辎重，率二十五个步兵队和大量骑兵向敌人推进，与之相距一里扎下营寨加以设防。

src: (BookVI/9) Caesar, after he came from the territories of the Menapii into those of the Treviri, resolved for two reasons to cross the Rhine; one of which was, because they had sent assistance to the Treviri against him; the other, that Ambiorix might not have a retreat among them. Having determined on these matters, he began to build a bridge a little above that place where he had before conveyed over his army. The plan having been known and laid down, the work is accomplished in a few days by the great exertion of the soldiers. Having left a strong guard at the bridge on the side of the Treviri, lest any commotion should suddenly arise among them, he leads over the rest of the forces and the cavalry....
dst: （卷六/9）凯撒从梅纳皮人地界进入特雷维里人地界后，因两条理由决意渡过莱茵河：其一，他们曾派兵援助特雷维里人对抗他；其二，不能让安比奥里克斯在他们那里有藏身之处。计议既定，他便在他先前渡军之处稍上游的地方动手架桥。方案既定，全赖士兵们奋力，工程数日而成。他在靠特雷维里人一侧的桥头留下重兵，以防他们突然生变，然后率其余部队与骑兵过河……

src: (BookVII/16) Vercingetorix follows closely upon Caesar by shorter marches, and selects for his camp a place defended by woods and marshes, at the distance of fifteen miles from Avaricum. There he received intelligence by trusty scouts, every hour in the day, of what was going on at Avaricum, and ordered whatever he wished to be done; he closely watched all our expeditions for corn and forage, and whenever they were compelled to go to a greater distance, he attacked them when dispersed, and inflicted severe loss upon them; although the evil was remedied by our men, as far as precautions could be taken, by going forth at irregular times’ and by different ways.
dst: （卷七/16）维钦托利以较短的行军日程紧随凯撒，择一处有林木与沼泽掩护之地扎营，距阿瓦里库姆十五里。他在那里每日随时由可靠斥候获得阿瓦里库姆城中的消息，并下令要办的各事；他严密监视我军所有征粮征草的队伍，每当他们被迫走得更远，他便趁其分散时袭击，使我军损失惨重；我军虽以不定时出发、多路并进等法尽力防范，也只能稍减其害。

src: (BookVII/36) Caesar, in five days’ march, went from that place to Gergovia, and after engaging in a slight cavalry skirmish that day, on viewing the situation of the city, which, being built on a very high mountain, was very difficult of access, he despaired of taking it by storm, and determined to take no measures with regard to besieging it before he should secure a supply of provisions. But Vercingetorix, having pitched his camp on the mountain near the town, placed the forces of each state separately and at small intervals around himself, and having occupied all the hills of that range as far as they commanded a view [of the Roman encampment], he presented a formidable appearance....
dst: （卷七/36）凯撒自该地经五日行军抵达热尔戈维亚，当日与敌骑兵小战一场后，观察该城形势——城建于极高的山上，极难接近——便放弃了强攻之念，决定在筹足粮秣之前不对其采取围困之策。然而维钦托利把营寨扎在城旁的山上，把各邦的部队彼此相隔不远地分置于自己四周，并占据了那道山岭上所有能俯瞰〔罗马营寨〕的高地，显得声势逼人……

src: (BookVII/57) While these things are being done by Caesar, Labienus, leaving at Agendicum the recruits who had lately arrived from Italy, to guard the baggage, marches with four legions to Lutetia (which is a town of the Parisii, situated on an island on the river Seine ), whose arrival being discovered by the enemy, numerous forces arrived from the neighboring states. The supreme command is intrusted to Camalugenus one of the Aulerci, who, although almost worn out with age, was called to that honor on account of his extraordinary knowledge of military tactics. He, when he observed that there was a large marsh which communicated with the Seine, and rendered all that country impassable, encamped there, and determined to prevent our troops from passing it.....
dst: （卷七/57）当凯撒在做这些事时，拉比埃努斯把新近从意大利赶来的新兵留在阿格恩迪库姆守卫辎重，率四个军团向卢泰西亚（巴黎西人的城镇，位于塞纳河中的岛上）进军。敌军探知他到来，邻近各邦纷纷来援。最高指挥权交给了奥勒尔奇人中的卡马卢根努斯；此人虽已年迈力衰，却因精通兵法而被推上此位。他见有一大片沼泽与塞纳河相通、使整个地区无法通行，便在那里扎营，决意阻止我军通过……

src: (BookVII/69) The town itself was situated on the top of a hill, in a very lofty position, so that it did not appear likely to be taken, except by a regular siege. Two rivers, on two different sides, washed the foot of the hill. Before the town lay a plain of about three miles in length; on every other side hills at a moderate distance, and of an equal degree of height, surrounded the town. The army of the Gauls had filled all the space under the wall, comprising a part of the hill which looked to the rising sun, and had drawn in front a trench and a stone wall six feet high. The circuit of that fortification, which was commenced by the Romans, comprised eleven miles. The camp was pitched in a strong position, and twenty-three redoubts were raised in it, in which sentinels were placed by day, lest any sally should be made suddenly; and by night the same were occupied by watches and strong guards.....
dst: （卷七/69）城本身建在一座极高的山顶上，看来除非正规围攻，否则难以攻取。两条河分从两侧冲刷山脚。城前是一片约三里长的平原；其余各面则是距离不远、高度相若的丘陵环绕着城。高卢人的军队填满了城墙下的所有空地，包括朝向日出的那部分山坡，并在前面挖了一道壕沟、修起一道六尺高的石墙。罗马人开始构筑的那道工事周长十一里。营寨扎在坚固的阵地上，营中筑起二十三座堡垒，白天在其中布置哨兵，以防突然出击；夜间也由值班哨与强兵据守……

Smith-Dorrien's decision to make a stand at Le Cateau however grew a serious rift between himself and his commander, Sir John French, head of the BEF.

dst: - 20:30 面对顽强的抵抗，德军撤退。

src: - 23:00 8th Brigade is ordered to fall back further.
- 2nd half April & May: After a brief pauze the British resumed their attacks. All failed against the German elastic defense. Also the Nivelle offensive failed.
dst: - 4月下半月和5月：短暂停顿后，英军恢复了进攻。所有进攻都在德军的弹性防御面前失败了。尼韦勒攻势也失败了。

src: - 4:30 1st Cavalry Brigade and L battery at Nery, who are bivouacking between the widely separated 4th and 5th Divisions is ordered to resume their march, but zero visibility because of fog made this impossible.
dst: - 4:30 驻扎在相距很远的第四师和第五师之间、位于内里的第一骑兵旅和L炮兵连奉命继续行军，但由于大雾导致能见度为零，这已无法实现。

src: - 5:30 A 11th Hussars patrol runs into units from the 4th Kavallerie Division. The German artillery starts shelling and machine gunning Nery.
dst: - 5:30 第十一骠骑兵团的一支巡逻队与第四骑兵师的部队遭遇。德军炮兵开始炮击内里并用机枪扫射。

src: - 5th Panzer Armee in Tunisia/Algeria is holding out against renewed Allied attacks.
dst: - 突尼斯／阿尔及利亚的第5装甲集团军正顶住盟军新一轮进攻。

src: - 6.Reserve Division thought that the Belgian exit was in full swing to their East rather than the expected West. They turned North West to cut off the Belgians from their fortresses. This brought them in range of the guns of Fort Liezele and Fort Willebroek. Losses were heavy (600-800 men killed). The Germans reported to be lucky that the Belgian Army did not pursue their disorganized division.
dst: - 第六预备师以为比利时人的突围正在他们东面全面展开，而不是预期的西面。他们转向西北，试图切断比利时人与要塞的联系。这使他们进入了利泽勒要塞和维勒布鲁克要塞的火炮射程。损失惨重（600-800人阵亡）。德军报告称，比利时军队没有追击他们已陷混乱的那个师，实属侥幸。

src: - 6:30 IV Korps troops start entering Le Cateau. II Kavallerie Korps digs in in front of the 3rd and 4th Divisions while IV Korps infantry supported by artillery fire keeps on attacking the BEF's 5th Division - and the 19th Brigade that supports it - despite heavy losses caused by the BEF's artillery and accurate riffle fire.
dst: - 6:30 第四军部队开始进入勒卡托。第二骑兵军在第三、第四师面前构筑阵地，同时第四军步兵在炮火支援下继续攻击英国远征军第五师——以及支援它的第十九旅——尽管英国远征军的炮火和精准步枪射击造成了惨重损失。

src: - 7:00 The BEF's 4th Cavalry Brigade with I battery came to the rescue of the 1st Brigade. Soon after that the first units of the 10th Brigade/4th Division and the 19th independent Brigade arrived on the scene as well.
dst: - 7:00 英国远征军第四骑兵旅带着I炮兵连前来援救第一旅。不久之后，第十旅/第四师和第十九独立旅的首批部队也赶到了现场。

src: - 8:00 I battery silenced the German artillery and the German 4th Kavallerie Division began to draw off, leaving all artillery behind. Its three Brigades got separated, each of them hiding in the woods around Nery for the rest of the day.
dst: - 8:00 I炮兵连压制了德军炮兵，德军第四骑兵师开始撤离，丢弃了全部火炮。它的三个旅被打散，当天其余时间各自躲在内里周围的树林里。

src: - 8:00 first Kuerassiers arrive at Halen and are repulsed by the Cyclistes.
dst: - 8:00 首批胸甲骑兵抵达哈伦，被自行车兵击退。

src: - 9:00 Belgian 4 Brigade Mixte of the 4th Infantry Division is sent as reinforcement.
dst: - 9:00 比利时第4步兵师的第4混合旅作为援军被派出。

src: - 9:00 more German cavalry arrives at the scene, supported by artillery, and the Cyclistes have to pull back behind the railroad.
dst: - 9:00 更多德军骑兵在炮兵支援下抵达现场，自行车兵不得不退到铁路后方。

dst: - 法国陷落后，“日耳曼尼亚”团从党卫军第5师分出，构成党卫军“日耳曼尼亚”师（后称“维京”师）的骨干。党卫军第11团（原属“骷髅”师）被编入党卫军第5师。

dst: - 下午：第18骑兵旅（骠骑兵）投入战斗。

dst: - 由艾克指挥的盟军部队执行“火炬”行动——在维希法国摩洛哥和阿尔及利亚实施两栖登陆——从而开辟了针对我们非洲军的第二战场。
- 盟军每回合获得 100pp；轴心国每回合获得 60pp。

dst: - 除坦克外，双方军队在数量、各兵种单位数、单位类型和指挥官方面势均力敌。

src: - Apr 10 1918: Sixth Army tried to push West from Estaires, but was contained. Armentières in the North was taken by the Germans (end of the battle of Estaires, but not of the Fourth Ypres/Battle of the Lys/Third Battle of Flanders/Operation Georgette). The Germans attacked North of Armentières and pushed through Allied lines for 3km because British reserves were committed South of Armentières.
dst: - 1918年4月10日：第六集团军试图从埃斯泰尔向西推进，但被遏制。北面的阿尔芒蒂耶尔被德军占领（埃斯泰尔之战结束，但第四次伊普尔战役/利斯河战役/第三次佛兰德战役/乔治特行动尚未结束）。德军进攻阿尔芒蒂耶尔以北，推进穿过协约国战线3公里，因为英军预备队被投入到了阿尔芒蒂耶尔以南。

src: - Apr 11 1918: The British situation was desperate.
- Apr 12 1918: Sixth Army renewed its attack in the South and captured Merville.
dst: - 1918年4月12日：第六集团军在南面再次发起进攻并攻占了梅维尔。

src: - Apr 13-15 1918: The Germans reached a point 12km West of Armentières. The British forces gave up ground in front of Ypres to shorten the line so that troops could be made available to stop the German offensive. Later in the month also French troops would be sent in to take over from exhausted British Divisions
dst: - 1918年4月13-15日：德军抵达阿尔芒蒂耶尔以西12公里处。英军放弃了伊普尔前方的阵地以缩短战线，从而腾出部队来阻止德军的攻势。本月晚些时候，法军也会被派来接替疲惫不堪的英军各师。

src: - Apr 17-29 1918: Multiple German attacks resulted in the capture of the Kemmel and Scherpenberg (Hills) but they made no progress toward a new break in the Allied lines and the Allied offensive was called off.
dst: - 1918年4月17-29日：德军的多次进攻攻占了凯默尔和斯赫彭贝赫（高地），但在突破协约国战线新缺口方面毫无进展，协约国的攻势被取消。

src: - Apr 29th 1916: British forces surrounded in Kut (Messopotamia), surrender to the Turks.
dst: - 1916年4月29日：被围困在库特（美索不达米亚）的英军向土耳其人投降。

src: - Apr 7 evening - Apr 9 dawn: German bombardment against the Allied line between Armentières and Festubert.
dst: - 4月7日傍晚至4月9日拂晓：德军对阿尔芒蒂耶尔与费斯蒂贝尔之间的协约国战线进行炮击。

src: - Apr 9 1918: Sixth Army attacked with eight divisions against the Portuguese 2nd Division. The division was overrun and withdrew. The British 55th Division to the South (off-map) pulled back its Northern Brigade and held ground for the rest of the battle. The British 40th Division to the North collapsed and fell back to the North. The Germans broke through 15 kilometers of front and advanced up to 8 km, reaching Estaires on the Lys (Leie). There they were finally halted by British reserve divisions.
dst: - 1918年4月9日：第六集团军以八个师进攻葡萄牙第二师。该师被击溃并撤退。南面的英军第五十五师（地图外）撤回其北面的旅，并在战斗剩余时间里守住了阵地。北面的英军第四十师崩溃并向北退却。德军突破了15公里的战线，推进了多达8公里，抵达利斯河（莱厄河）畔的埃斯泰尔。在那里他们最终被英军预备师阻止。

src: - April 10: The attack at Bullecourt was repulsed by the Germans.
dst: - 4月10日：对布勒库尔的进攻被德军击退。

src: - April 10th 1915: Von Marwitz and his Besiden Korps, who were sent to the aid of the Austro-Hungarians, have stopped the Russian advance.
dst: - 1915年4月10日：被派去支援奥匈军队的冯·马维茨及其贝斯基德军已阻止了俄军的推进。

src: - April 22nd: The gas was released. Many French troops ran from the gas cloud and the Germans moved forward. The attack was an unexpected success.
dst: - 4月22日：毒气被释放。许多法军士兵逃离毒气云，德军向前推进。这次进攻取得了出人意料的成功。

src: - April 24th: The Germans released another cloud of chlorine gas. The Canadian lines West of St-Julien broke.The Germans were concerned about what the gas would do to them and did not advance in great numbers which allowed Canadian and British troops to retake the position. Fighting continued for 2 weeks and the Entente positions were driven back.
dst: - 4月24日：德军又释放了一团氯气。圣于连以西的加拿大军防线被突破。德军担心毒气会波及自身，没有大举推进，这让加军和英军得以夺回阵地。战斗持续了两周，协约国阵地被逼退。

src: - April 4: Bombardment on rest of the Arras sector starts.
dst: - 4月4日：对阿拉斯地段其余部分的炮击开始。

src: - April 6, 1917: US Congres declared war on Imperial Germany.
dst: - 1917年4月6日：美国国会对德意志帝国宣战。

src: - April 9: Attacks East of Arras and at Vimy Ridge were successful, with spectacular gains.
dst: - 4月9日：阿拉斯以东和维米岭的进攻获得成功，取得了惊人的战果。

src: - April: A new German offensive on both sides of the Meuse with attacks and counterattacks continuing into May.
dst: - 4月：德军在默兹河两岸发动新的攻势，攻防战一直持续到5月。

src: - August 4: German forces cross the border

- August 6th 1915: Second landing at Gallipoli. After all attempts to move inland have been defeated, a new British landing is made at Suvla Bay, linked to an assault on the hills beyond the Australian and New Zealand position. The operations fail.
dst: - 1915年8月6日：加利波利第二次登陆。在所有向内陆推进的尝试均告失败后，英军在苏夫拉湾进行了新的登陆，并配合对澳新军队阵地后方山丘的突击。这些行动均告失败。

src: - August 7: The Belgian 3rd Division is withdrawn to the West.
- August: Falkenhayn was dismissed by the Kaiser and was dispatched to the Transylvanian front to command 9th Army.
dst: - 8月：法尔肯海因被德皇解职，被派往特兰西瓦尼亚前线指挥第九集团军。

src: - Be careful with the Soviet attacks against your starting position.
dst: - 小心苏维埃对您起始阵地的进攻。

src: - Be careful with the possible partisan activity on your rear.
dst: - 小心您后方可能出现的游击活动。

src: - Belgian losses are heavy: half of the second Brigade Mixte is killed or wounded.
dst: - 比利时损失惨重：第2混合旅一半官兵阵亡或负伤。

src: - Beware of the muddy terrain and the enemy attacks behind your lines.
dst: - 当心泥泞的地形以及敌人对您战线后方的袭击。
- 双方都会获得宝贵的增援。

- 夺取贝尔格莱德胜利格

dst: - 夺取南部三个英军旗帜格子以获得额外奖励。

dst: - 夺取西部三个英军旗帜格子和东部那一个，以获得额外威望。

dst: - 若您想在巴尔干与意大利战线同塞尔维亚和意大利作战（直到1917年秋），请点击意大利旗帜。

dst: - 若您想在东线与俄国和罗马尼亚作战（直到1917年秋），请点击俄国旗帜。

src: - Contain the enemy forces! You can win a BV by taking all VH the first 8 turns, V or TV by holding a second line and retaking a VH after the first 8 turns.
dst: - 牵制敌军！在前8回合夺取全部胜利格可赢得辉煌胜利；守住第二道防线并在前8回合之后夺回一个胜利格，则可取得胜利或战术胜利。

src: - Core ships can be used in most scenarios, but not all!
dst: - 核心舰船可在大多数场景中使用，但并非全部！

src: - Core units can be deployed after capturing the supply hex.
dst: - 夺取补给格后可部署核心单位。

src: - De Wet's troops are known for their sneak attacks behind the enemy lines.
dst: - 德韦特的部队以深入敌后的偷袭而闻名。

src: - Dec 15-18: The French captured 11,000 prisoners and 115 heavy guns, ending the battle.
dst: - 12月15-18日：法军俘获1.1万名俘虏和115门重炮，结束了这场战役。

src: - Dec 3 1917: Snowfall and lack of further progress made the Germans put an end to the offensive. Both British and German casualties totaled 40,000 to 50,000 men.
dst: - 1917年12月3日：降雪和无法继续推进使德军终止了攻势。英德双方的伤亡总数达4万至5万人。

src: - December 13th: Our Austro-Hungarian allies stopped Russian hopes of a further advance in Galicia in the Battle of Limanowa.
dst: - 12月13日：我们的奥匈盟国在利马诺瓦战役中粉碎了俄国人在加利西亚继续推进的希望。

src: - December 2nd, but lost again on December 15th after which the whole army had to retreat back into Austro-Hungarian territory. The Serbian Army suffered 170,000 casualties and our allies 215,000. On the Serbian side, a deadly typhus epidemic killed hundreds of thousands of Serb civilians during the winter.
dst: - 12月2日（攻占贝尔格莱德），但在12月15日又失守，此后全军不得不撤回奥匈帝国境内。塞尔维亚军队伤亡17万人，我方盟友伤亡21.5万人。在塞尔维亚一侧，一场致命的斑疹伤寒疫情在那个冬天夺去了数十万塞尔维亚平民的生命。

src: - December 6th 1914: Also a second attempt to take Warsaw in appaling winter conditions failed at the Battle of Lodz. Another 160,000 of our troops lost against 120,000 Russian losses.
dst: - 1914年12月6日：在恶劣的冬季条件下第二次夺取华沙的企图也在罗兹战役中失败。我方又损失16万人，俄军损失12万人。

src: - Deploy five units and exit them at the North of the map.
dst: - 部署五个单位，并让它们从地图北面撤出。

src: - Destroy 10 of the 12 British units (all of them are MSUs).
dst: - 摧毁12个英军单位中的10个（它们全部是主力单位）。
- 消灭16个英军主力单位中的10个。

dst: - 歼灭13个苏军装甲单位中的10个即可赢得本场景。
- 摧毁22个英军主力单位中的15个。

src: - Destroy 50 British Must-Survive units to win.
dst: - 消灭50个英军主力单位即可获胜。
- 摧毁全部3个保加利亚「必须存活」单位（主力单位）。
- 摧毁全部4辆英军辎重车（主力单位）

src: - Destroy all French ground units. Air and sea units do not have to be destroyed to win.
dst: - 歼灭所有法国地面单位。空军和海军单位无需歼灭即可获胜。

src: - Destroy all the 6 Mexican units before any of them reaches the EH at (26,19)
dst: - 在任何一个墨西哥单位抵达(26,19)处的撤退格之前，消灭全部6个墨西哥单位。

src: - Do NOT allow the French to capture the Moerdijk bridge.
dst: - 绝不能让法国人夺取莫尔代克桥。

src: - Do not at any time let the Italians take all three victory hexes.
dst: - 任何时候都不要让意大利人夺取全部三个胜利格。

src: - Do not let the Soviets take the victory hex.
dst: - 不要让苏军夺取胜利格。

src: - Do not let the resistance capture all three victory hexes.
dst: - 不要让抵抗组织夺取全部三个胜利格。

src: - Do not let them kill your command unit - Enver Bey.
dst: - 不要让他们杀死您的指挥单位——恩维尔贝伊。

src: - Don't forget that you can buy trucks for your light units.
dst: - 别忘了您可以为您的轻型部队购买卡车。

src: - Don't lose any of your 6 MSUs. You can embark them, if you wish.
dst: - 不要损失您的6个主力单位中的任何一个。如果您愿意，可以让他们登船。

src: - Due to the even armies, maybe neither side can win. Have fun anyway!
dst: - 由于兵力相当，也许双方都无法获胜。无论如何，玩得开心！
- 埃及警察和部队人员纷纷消失。

src: - Embassies of any nation that can offer an escape from Egypt are besieged.
dst: - 任何能提供逃离埃及途径的国家的大使馆都被人围堵。

src: - Evacuate 4 civilian units through the EH at (38,32).
dst: - 通过(38,32)处的撤离格撤走4个平民单位。

src: - Exit 5 units via the escape hex in the North to win.
dst: - 让5个单位经北面的逃生格撤出即可获胜。

src: - Extra prestige can be gained by controlling the complete coast (most coastal towns give prestige when captured).
dst: - 控制整条海岸线可获得额外声望（夺取大多数沿海城镇都会给予声望）。

src: - Feb 22: German troops had advanced 5km but were held up 2 days at he Bois the Caures by two Chasseurs battalions of Colonel Driant (leadered Chasseur unit in the scenario). The French started to realize the seriousness of the attack.
dst: - 2月22日：德军推进了5公里，但在科雷斯树林被德里昂上校的两个猎兵营迟滞了2天（德里昂是场景中的精英猎兵单位）。法国人开始意识到这次进攻的严重性。

src: - Feb 23: A French counterattack s repulsed.
dst: - 2月23日：法军的一次反击被击退。

src: - Feb 24: The French second line of defence is captured. The French XX Corps arrives to strengthen the defenders.
dst: - 2月24日：法军第二道防线被攻克。法军第二十军抵达以加强守军。

src: - Feb 25: The Germans captured Fort Douaumont.
- Feb 26: A French counterattack on Fort Douaumont failed. Total French losses so far: 24,000 men, German losses 25,000 men.
dst: - 2月26日：法军对杜奥蒙堡的反击失败。法军迄今总损失：2.4万人，德军损失2.5万人。

src: - Februari 19th 1915: British and French ships have bombarded the fortresses at the entrance of the Dardanelles. Ottoman troops are now preparing to repulse a possible landing by sending reinforcements to threatened beach areas and by laying mines in the Dardanelles.
dst: - 1915年2月19日：英法军舰炮击了达达尼尔海峡入口处的要塞。奥斯曼军队正在向受威胁的滩头地区增派援军，并在达达尼尔海峡布设水雷，准备击退可能的登陆。

src: - Februari 4th 1915: The Ottoman attempt to take the Suez Canal from the British failed.
dst: - 1915年2月4日：奥斯曼帝国从英国人手中夺取苏伊士运河的企图失败。

src: - Februari 5th 1915: The Russian armies have counterattacked after Conrad's offensive had failed to relieve Przemyl. 800,000 Austro-Hungarians troops have been lost and the Russians advance is threathening Boedapest and Vienna, where panick has broken out.
dst: - 1915年2月5日：在康拉德的攻势未能解普热梅希尔之围后，俄军发起了反攻。奥匈军队损失了80万人，俄军的推进正威胁布达佩斯和维也纳，那里已陷入恐慌。

src: - Februari 7-22nd 1915: Our 8th Army launched a surprise attack on the Russians in a snow storm (Second Battle of the Masurian Lakes), inflicted 56,0000 casualties and took 100,000 prisoners at the cost of 16,200 lost, before a Russian counterattack checked our advance.
dst: - 1915年2月7-22日：我方第八集团军在暴风雪中向俄军发动突袭（第二次马祖里湖战役），造成56000人伤亡并俘虏10万人，自身损失16200人，随后俄军的反攻遏制了我们的推进。

src: - Forenoon and early afternoon: German III Corps brings more Field Batteries forward but still cannot break through.
dst: - 上午及午后早些时候：德军第3军把更多野战炮连调上前线，但仍无法突破。

src: - Four camps in your hands at the end of the scenario will give you a BV, three a V, two a TV and one or zero will result in a loss.
dst: - 场景结束时手中握有4处营地得辉煌胜利，3处得胜利，2处得战术胜利，1处或0处则告失败。

src: - French units are fighting on your side, but are controlled by the AI, not by you.
dst: - 法军部队与你并肩作战，但由 AI 指挥，不由你控制。

dst: - 从现在起，您购买的新单位将以120威望开局。

dst: - 从现在起，您新购买的装备将以99点经验起步。

dst: - 从现在起，您新购买的所有部队都将以99点经验开局。

dst: - 从现在起，您可以在每个场景中从哥萨克军购买装备。

dst: - 从现在起，您的新单位将以99经验值开局。

src: - General Giulio Martinat, chief-of-staff of our Alpini Corps in Russia was killed while personally leading a successful attack to break through Russian blocking positions at Nikolajevka, an attack which opened a path for our encircled troops, Germans and Hungarians to escape and regain Axis lines. A victory against all odds, with no artillery and no air support and on foot.
dst: - 我们在俄国的阿尔卑斯山地军参谋长朱利奥·马蒂纳特将军阵亡，当时他亲自率领一次成功突击，突破了俄军在尼古拉耶夫卡的封锁阵地，为被围的我军、德军和匈牙利军打通了逃回轴心国战线的道路。这是一场在毫无炮兵、没有空中支援、且只能徒步的情况下以寡敌众取得的胜利。

src: - German agents in Spain report massive Allied naval and air concentrations in Gibraltar.
dst: - 德国在西班牙的特工报告，盟军在直布罗陀有大规模海空集结。

src: - German troops are in the center of Stalingrad but seem to fail to capture the last parts of the city.
dst: - 德军已进入斯大林格勒市中心，但似乎未能拿下该城最后的部分。

src: - German troops drive a wedge in Sevastopol's defenses.
dst: - 德军在塞瓦斯托波尔的防御中打入一个楔子。

src: - Germany extracts its specialist officers from Stalingrad. They get priority over wounded men on flights out.
dst: - 德国把专业军官从斯大林格勒空运出来。他们在撤出的航班上比伤员优先。

src: - Go to Irkutsk, free Kolchak and take him to the EH at Bolshoye Goloustnoye (40,19).
dst: - 前往伊尔库茨克，解救高尔察克，并带他到大戈洛乌斯特诺耶(40,19)的撤离格。

src: - Heavy rains on October 9th have taken all our forward air bases out of operation. Continuous Western Desert Airforce attacks since that date have prevented us from recovering.
dst: - 10月9日的大雨使我们所有前沿机场无法使用。此后西部沙漠空军的持续空袭又使我们无法恢复。

src: - Hitler declares Stalingrad defeated but Zhukov launches Operation Uranus and encircles 250,000 German troops of the 6th Army in Stalingrad.
dst: - 希特勒宣布斯大林格勒已被攻克，但朱可夫发起“天王星”行动，把德军第6集团军的25万人围困在斯大林格勒。

src: - Hold 5 Victory hexes at the end of the scenario for a Brilliant Victory. Hold 4 for a Victory and 3 for a Tactical Victory.
dst: - 场景结束时守住5个胜利格得辉煌胜利。守住4个得胜利，3个得战术胜利。

src: - Hold at least 5 Victory hexes for a BV, 4 for a V and 3 for a TV.
dst: - 守住至少5个胜利格得辉煌胜利，4个得胜利，3个得战术胜利。

src: - Hold your own victory hex and capture the Russian one.
dst: - 守住你的胜利格，并夺取俄国人的胜利格。

src: - III.Btn/35.Res.Inf.Rgt. that was supposed to destroy the bridges ran into troops of the 3rd Chasseur a Pied Rgt. that was guarding the locks at the canal to allow the Belgians to inundate more territory around Antwerp.
dst: - 本应摧毁桥梁的第三十五预备步兵团第三营，与守卫运河水闸的第三徒步猎兵团部队遭遇，该团守闸是为了让比利时人能淹没安特卫普周围更多地区。

src: - If a single enemy unit manages to reach the EH at (2,14), you will lose.
dst: - 只要有任何一个敌方单位抵达位于（2,14）的撤离格，您就会失败。

dst: - 若按“帝国”师的历史核心编制，购买6个党卫军步兵单位。你可以部署所有单位。

src: - If not arranged otherwise players should refrain from laying minefields.
dst: - 若无另行约定，玩家应避免布设雷区。

dst: - 若使用限制规则：你可部署以下核心单位：1高射炮＋4炮兵（其中1自行）＋6步兵＋1工兵＋1摩托化步兵＋1侦察＋1牵引反坦克炮＋1自行反坦克炮＋2装甲。

dst: - 如果红军撤走其10个主力单位，您将失败。

dst: - 若苏军夺取你的两个胜利格，他们即获胜。

dst: - 如果您选择与塞尔维亚和黑山作战，请点击塞尔维亚旗帜。

dst: - 如果您选择在塞尔维亚作战，请点击塞尔维亚旗帜。

dst: - 若您与德军并肩对西方盟军作战，则禁止将苏联部队升级为德军部队。只允许购买德军部队（基础兵力为 5，但已有 499 点经验值）。

dst: -如果您选择惠灵顿营房，您将获得两个步兵单位。

dst: - 在下一个场景中您将失去您的核心。

dst: - 在第2、第3、第4回合，您将获得81个援军单位，帮助您对抗德军。

dst: - 在此场景中，「跳过首个玩家回合」选项已启用。

src: - It is strictly forbidden to sell not deployed auxiliary troops.
dst: - 严禁出售未部署的辅助部队。

src: - It seems that the Soviets are preparing a counterattack in the north, where the 2nd Division is staying.
dst: - 看来苏维埃正在北方准备反攻，第2师正驻扎在那里。

src: - It's an Austro-Hungarian campaign, don't expect an "all BVs" record :)
dst: - 这是奥匈帝国战役，别指望「全大捷」战绩 :)

src: - Januari 17th 1915: A month-long Ottoman attempt to retake territory lost to the Russian Empire in the Russo-Turkish war of 1877 failed. Turkish losses amounted 60,000. Russia lost 30,000.
dst: - 1915年1月17日：奥斯曼帝国试图夺回在1877年俄土战争中输给俄罗斯帝国的领土，这场持续一个月的努力失败了。土耳其损失6万人，俄国损失3万人。

src: - Januari 23rd 1915: Conrad has started a major offensive in Galicia with the aim of eliminating the Russian threat to Hungary and to relieve the fortress of Przemyl.
dst: - 1915年1月23日：康拉德在加利西亚发动大规模攻势，目的是消除俄国对匈牙利的威胁并解普热梅希尔要塞之围。

src: - Januari 31st 1915: Our 9th Army attacked the Russian 2nd Army near Bolimow with xylyl bromide gas. The gas blew back into our lines but failed to cause casualties because it froze. A Russian counterattack was halted at the cost of 20,000 of our men. The Russians lost 40,000.
dst: - 1915年1月31日：我第9集团军在博利莫夫附近用二甲苯溴毒气攻击俄军第2集团军。毒气被风吹回我方阵地，但因冻结而未造成伤亡。俄军的一次反攻被阻止，我方损失2万人，俄军损失4万人。

src: - Japan starts construction of the Railway of Death to supply its forces in Burma.
dst: - 日本开始修筑“死亡铁路”，以补给其在缅甸的部队。

src: - July 11th: The British secure the first line of German trenches. German troops are transferred from the Verdun sector, doubling the number of men available.
dst: - 7月11日：英军拿下了德军第一道战壕线。德军从凡尔登地段调来部队，可用兵力增加了一倍。

src: - July 13th 1915: Germans and Austro-Hungarians launch a major offensive against the Russians
dst: - 1915年7月13日：德军和奥匈军队对俄国人发动大规模攻势。

src: - July 14th: The attack on the second Germen line of defense starts after a short hurricane-like bombardment. It is relatively successful, but is not followed up due to communication failures, casualties and disorganization. Attacks late July and August did not generate much gains.
dst: - 7月14日：在短暂的飓风式炮击之后，对德军第二道防线的进攻开始。这次进攻相对成功，但由于通信故障、伤亡和混乱，未能继续扩大战果。7月末和8月的进攻没有取得多少进展。

src: - July 18th 1915: Second Battle of the Isonzo. Second in a series of eleven battles launched along the Isonzo river in north-eastern Italy. Fighting on the Isonzo continues until October 1917.
dst: - 1915年7月18日：第二次伊松佐河战役。这是在意大利东北部伊松佐河沿线发动的一系列十一次战役中的第二次。伊松佐河的战斗一直持续到1917年10月。

src: - July 1st: The Somme offensive starts with 750,000 men after a week-long bombardment in the British sector. The British loose 58,000 troops on day one. The French conduct a short surprise bombardment only and do much better: small advancing groups of men reach all day-1 targets without suffering heavy losses.
dst: - 7月1日：英军地段进行了一周的炮击后，索姆河攻势以75万人开始。英军第一天就损失了5.8万人。法军只进行了短暂的突袭炮击，表现得更好：小股推进部队在没有遭受重大损失的情况下达成了第一天的所有目标。

src: - July 9th 1915: German South-West Africa surrenders to South African forces led by General Louis Botha
dst: - 1915年7月9日：德属西南非洲向路易·博塔将军率领的南非军队投降。

src: - July and August 1918: After two more mainly unsuccessful German offensives, the initiative moved to the Entente again. Their 100 day offensive would end the war on November 11, 1918.
dst: - 1918年7月和8月：在德军又两次基本失败的攻势之后，主动权再次转到协约国手中。他们的百日攻势将在1918年11月11日结束这场战争。

src: - July: The offensive on the Somme scheduled for August 1st is brought forward by one month to relieve pressure on the French. Fifteen German divisions had to be moved to the Eastern front.
dst: - 7月：原定8月1日的索姆河攻势提前一个月，以减轻法军的压力。德军不得不把十五个师调往东线。

src: - June 1 1918: German forces captured Vaux and Château-Thierry and moved into Belleau Wood. American forces were moved up to check the German advance. Throughout the next weeks, Belleau Wood would change hands multiple times.
dst: - 1918年6月1日：德军攻占了沃堡和蒂耶里堡，并进入贝洛森林。美军被调上来遏制德军的推进。在接下来的几周里，贝洛森林多次易手。

src: - June 22nd 1915: Austro-Hungarian forces recapture the city of Lemberg (Lvov) from the Russians
dst: - 1915年6月22日：奥匈军队从俄国人手中夺回伦贝格（利沃夫）城。

src: - June 23rd 1915: First Battle of the Isonzo. Italian troops attack Austro-Hungarians in north-eastern Italy, aiming to reach Trieste. Disappointing results but operations continue until 7 July.
dst: - 1915年6月23日：第一次伊松佐河战役。意军在意大利东北部进攻奥匈军队，目标是抵达的里雅斯特。结果令人失望，但作战一直持续到7月7日。

src: - June 3 1918: Victory seemed near with Paris only about 50km away.
dst: - 1918年6月3日：巴黎距此仅约50公里，胜利似乎近在咫尺。

src: - June 4th 1916: The Russians start the Brusilov Offensive against Austro-Hungarian forces, in support of the Somme Offensive. The offensive would last until September when the Russians had to come to the aid of their new ally Romenia. The offensive broke the back of the Austro-Hungarian forces and forced the Germans to keep troops scheduled to go West on the Eastern front.
dst: - 1916年6月4日：为策应索姆河攻势，俄国人对奥匈军队发动了布鲁西洛夫攻势。这场攻势一直持续到9月，当时俄国人不得不去援助他们的新盟友罗马尼亚。攻势打断了奥匈军队的脊梁，并迫使德国人把本拟调往西线的部队留在了东线。

src: - June 6 1918: After many Entente counterattacks and beset by supply shortages, fatigue, lack of reserves and many casualties the offensive had to be halted.
dst: - 1918年6月6日：在协约国的多次反击以及补给短缺、疲惫、缺乏预备队和大量伤亡的困扰下，攻势不得不停止。

src: - Keep at least one of your VHs.
dst: - 至少守住您的一个胜利点。

src: - Keep at least three of the eight trapped LSSAH and Lehr units alive.
dst: - 让被困的警卫旗队和教导师8个单位中至少3个存活。

src: - Keep control of 5 out of the 6 victory hexes at the end of the scenario for brilliant victory, 2 for victory and 1 for tactical victory.
dst: - 场景结束时控制6个胜利格中的5个得辉煌胜利，2个得胜利，1个得战术胜利。

src: - Keep control of all 7 victory hexes at the end of the scenario for brilliant victory, 5 for victory and 4 for tactical victory.
dst: - 场景结束时控制全部7个胜利格得辉煌胜利，5个得胜利，4个得战术胜利。

src: - Keeping command of the 4th Kavalerie Division in von der Marwitz's [IIHKK], covering the flank of 1st Armee. Move [IIHKK] South to capture Mons in turn two, three or four.
dst: - 继续指挥冯·德·马尔维茨的[IIHKK]中的第4骑兵师，掩护第1集团军侧翼。令[IIHKK]向南，在第二、第三或第四回合夺取蒙斯。

src: - Kesselring orders the 5th FsJgr Rgt and Wehrmacht units to Tunesia - Vichy agrees. French troops withdraw West, towards Algeria and the Allied forces.
dst: - 凯塞林下令第5伞兵（FsJgr）团和国防军部队开赴突尼斯——维希方面同意。法军向西撤退，往阿尔及利亚和盟军方向。

src: - Land your troops and take the Amiens victory hex.
dst: - 让你的部队登陆并夺取亚眠胜利格。

src: - Late June/early July: The Germans almost break through the French lines.
dst: - 6月末/7月初：德军几乎突破了法军防线。

src: - Late morning: 17 Dragoner Regiment moves on Zelk (NW)
dst: - 上午晚些时候：第17龙骑兵团向泽尔克（西北）推进

src: - Later that day: The Belgian King Albert orders the retreat to Antwerp.
dst: - 当天晚些时候：比利时国王阿尔贝下令撤退到安特卫普。

src: - Losses will not be automatically replaced at the end of the scenario.
dst: - 场景结束时，损失不会自动补充。

src: - March 10 1:00pm: All goals of the first phaze reached. Germans concentrate on a few strong points and bring in reinforcements.
dst: - 3月10日下午1:00：第一阶段的所有目标均已达成。德军集中防守几个强点并调来增援。

src: - March 10 3:30pm: Artillery bombardment that starts 2nd phase hits own troops and disorganized attacks fail to reach goals.
dst: - 3月10日下午3:30：开启第二阶段的炮击击中了己方部队，陷入混乱的进攻未能达到目标。

src: - March 10 8:15am: First German trench line occupied
dst: - 3月10日上午8:15：占领德军第一道战壕线。

src: - March 10 8:50am: Second wave troops follow up the attack and occupy next trench line that turns out to be undefended. Because of a scheduled - but useless - British bombardment on that trench line, the troops have to retreat, after which they could re-occupy the trench. Permission to continue attacking was refused.
dst: - 3月10日上午8:50：第二波部队跟进进攻并占领了下一道战壕线，结果发现那里无人防守。由于英军对那道战壕线进行了预定但毫无用处的炮击，部队不得不后撤，之后又重新占领了战壕。继续进攻的请求被拒绝。

src: - March 12 evening: German reinforcements (6th Bavarian Reserve Division and elements 13th and 14th Infanterie divisions) stabilize front.
dst: - 3月12日傍晚：德军增援部队（第六巴伐利亚预备师以及第十三、十四步兵师的部分部队）稳定了前线。

src: - March 13: Two more British attacks fail after a failed artillery barrage.
dst: - 3月13日：在炮火准备失败之后，英军又有两次进攻受挫。

src: - March 14 sunrise: German counterattack failed - mainly because of insufficient artillery support.
dst: - 3月14日日出时分：德军反击失败——主要是由于炮兵支援不足。

src: - March 20: Bombardment of Vimy Ridge starts.
- March: Brutal attacks and counterattacks on the left (West) bank of the Meuse from where the German troops on the right bank are shelled. Le Mort-Homme, Cote 304, ...
dst: - 3月：在默兹河左（西）岸发生残酷的攻防战，德军从那里炮击右岸的部队。死人岭、304高地……

src: - May 10th: SS Regiment Deutschland reaches Wageningen in front of the Grebbelinie.
dst: - 5月10日：党卫军“德意志”团抵达格勒贝防线前的瓦赫宁恩。

src: - May 11th: The Regiment captures all outposts.
dst: - 5月11日：该团夺取所有前哨阵地。

src: - May 12th: The Regiment penetrates the main Ducth defensive line.
dst: - 5月12日：该团突入荷兰人的主要防御线。

src: - May 13th: A major Dutch counterattack fails and with the help of one infantry regiment of the 207th ID, victory is achieved. The Dutch evacuate the complete Grebbelinie.
dst: - 5月13日：荷军一次大规模反击失败，在第207步兵师一个步兵团的支援下，胜利达成。荷兰人全线撤出格勒贝防线。

src: - May 15th 1915: Battle of Festubert. British troops undertake another attack in French Flanders only a short distance from Aubers Ridge. Battle carries on until 25 May.
dst: - 1915年5月15日：费斯蒂贝尔之战。英军在距奥贝尔岭不远的法属佛兰德再次发动进攻。战斗持续到5月25日。

src: - May 19th 1915: Defence of Anzac. At Gallipoli, Australian and New Zealand troops fight off a very heavy Turkish attack. After weeks of effort on both sides, it is clear stalemate has been reached.
dst: - 1915年5月19日：澳新军团防御战。在加利波利，澳大利亚和新西兰军队击退了土耳其人一次极为猛烈的进攻。经过双方数周的努力，很明显已陷入僵局。

src: - May 23th 1915: Italy declares war on Austria-Hungary and moves to secure strategically important points along their shared border
dst: - 1915年5月23日：意大利对奥匈帝国宣战，并着手夺取两国共同边界沿线具有战略意义的要点。

src: - May 24th: The Germans released another gas attack at Bellewaarde (just South of Frezenberg).
dst: - 5月24日：德军在贝勒瓦尔德（弗雷岑贝格以南）再次发动毒气攻击。

src: - May 25th 1915:  Coalition government formed by the British Prime Minister Herbert Asquith as tensions rise over his handling of the war. David Lloyd George, the former Chancellor of the Exchequer, appointed Minister of Munitions to increase the production of weapons and ammunition.
dst: - 1915年5月25日：由于对其战争处理方式的不满日益加剧，英国首相赫伯特·阿斯奎斯组建了联合政府。前财政大臣戴维·劳合·乔治被任命为军需大臣，以增加武器弹药的产量。

src: - May 25th: After an initial successful defense, the British troops were pushed back 1000 yards, after which the Germans gave up. The British hardly had any ammo left for their guns,  but the Germans had no more reserves. If only a few less divisions were sent to the Eastern front ...
dst: - 5月25日：在最初成功防御之后，英军被击退了1000码，此后德军停止了进攻。英军的火炮几乎没有弹药了，但德军也没有后备队了。要是少派几个师到东线就好了……

src: - May 27 1918: Operation Blücher-Yorck (Third battle of the Aisne) starts with an attack between Soisson and Reims. The strategic goal is to split French and British forces and gain victory before more American forces reach the battlefield. The French defenses were not developed in depth and the front quickly collapsed.
dst: - 1918年5月27日：布吕歇尔-约克行动（第三次埃纳河战役）以在苏瓦松与兰斯之间的进攻开始。战略目标是分割法军和英军，并在更多美军抵达战场之前赢得胜利。法军防御纵深不足，战线迅速崩溃。

src: - May 29: The Germans secured Mort-Home hill.
dst: - 5月29日：德军攻占了死人岭高地。

src: - May 2nd 1915: Battle of Gorlice Tarnow. German and Austro-Hungarian armies defeat the Russians in the centre of their line and begin to drive them back. After weeks of retreat, the Russians lose most of their territory in Poland.
dst: - 1915年5月2日：戈尔利采-塔尔努夫战役。德军和奥匈军队在俄军战线中央将其击败，并开始将其击退。经过数周的撤退，俄国人失去了在波兰的大部分领土。

src: - May 31st 1915: First German airship raid on London. 7 people are killed and 35 injured.
dst: - 1915年5月31日：德国飞艇首次空袭伦敦。7人死亡，35人受伤。

src: - May 31st 1916: The battle of Jutland, fought between the Royal Navy's Grand Fleet and the Imperial German Navy's High Seas Fleet ends inconclusive. The British keep on dominating the North Sea.
dst: - 1916年5月31日：英国皇家海军大舰队与德意志帝国海军公海舰队之间的日德兰海战以不分胜负告终。英国继续主导北海。

src: - May 7th 1915: German submarine U-20 sinks the luxury passenger liner Lusitania off the west coast of Ireland. 1198 people are killed, including 128 US citizens.
dst: - 1915年5月7日：德国潜艇U-20在爱尔兰西海岸外击沉了豪华客轮卢西塔尼亚号。1198人遇难，其中包括128名美国公民。

src: - May 8th: A German attack on the Eastern part of the Ypres salient at Frezenberg met with initial success, but counterattacks and British reinforcements drove them back after five days of fighting.
dst: - 5月8日：德军对伊普尔突出部东侧弗雷岑贝格发动进攻，初战告捷，但经过五天的战斗后，法军反击和英军增援将其击退。

src: - May 9th May 1915: Second Battle of Artois. French launch attack for limited gains. Battle lasts until 18 June.  Battle of Aubers Ridge. To support French operations in Artois, British troops attack in FrenchFlanders but achieve no real gains. Battle continues until 10 May.   First units of Kitchener's New Armies, forming the 9th (Scottish) Division, leave Britain for overseas service
dst: - 1915年5月9日：第二次阿图瓦战役。法军发动进攻，战果有限。战役持续到6月18日。奥贝尔岭之战。为支援法军在阿图瓦的作战，英军在法属佛兰德发起进攻，但未取得实际战果。战斗持续到5月10日。基钦纳新军的第一批部队组成了第九（苏格兰）师，离开英国前往海外服役。

src: - Mussolini has shipped his white 'victory parade horse' to North Africa.
dst: - 墨索里尼已把他的白色“胜利游行马”运往北非。

src: - New units can be acquired at HQ at the start of the next scenario.
dst: - 新单位可在下一场景开始时于总部获取。

src: - New units can be purchased before and during during the scenario.
dst: - 新单位可在场景开始前和进行中购买。

dst: - 若取得胜利或辉煌胜利，下一场景开始时不能在司令部获得新单位。

src: - New units cannot be acquired at HQ at the start of the next scenario.
dst: - 新单位无法在下一场景开始时于总部获取。

src: - No Luftwaffe units have orders to provide air support to your troops, but fighter units supporting air landings around The Hague and Rotterdam might come to your assistence as they pass through the area.
dst: - 没有德国空军单位受命为你的部队提供空中支援，但支援海牙和鹿特丹附近空降作战的战斗机单位在途经该地区时可能会来协助你。

src: - No more than six ground units can be deployed in this scenario.
dst: - 本场景最多只能部署六个地面单位。

src: - No more than three ground units can be deployed in this scenario: the Ariete battle group.
dst: - 本场景最多只能部署三个地面单位：“公羊”战斗群。

src: - No new units can be purchased before or during during the scenario.
dst: - 场景开始前和进行中都不能购买新单位。

src: - No new units can be purchased during the scenario.
dst: - 场景进行中不能购买新单位。

src: - Noon: 18 Dragoner Regiment moves on Yzerwinning farm but are repulsed by Lancers and Cyclistes. 3rd Kavallerie Brigade moves on Velpen and Yzerwinning where it also gets stopped.
dst: - 中午：第18龙骑兵团向伊泽尔温宁农场推进，但被枪骑兵和自行车兵击退。第3骑兵旅向费尔彭和伊泽尔温宁推进，同样受阻。

src: - Nov 02: The French recapture Fort Vaux.

- Nov 20 1917: British forces supported by substantial numbers of tanks and airplanes broke through strong German defenses at Cambrai. The Germans quickly sent in reinforcements. The British did not realize the extent of the blow they dealt the Germans and did not immediately sent the Cavalry Divisions through the gaps in the German line.
dst: - 1917年11月20日：在大量坦克和飞机的支援下，英军突破了德军在康布雷的坚固防御。德军迅速派来增援。英军没有意识到自己给德军造成的打击有多大，也没有立即让骑兵师穿过德军战线的缺口。

src: - Nov 21 1917: The pace of the British advance was greatly slowed.
dst: - 1917年11月21日：英军推进的速度大大减缓。

src: - Nov 22-27 1917: Most British attacks failed to gain much ground and the attack was halted.
dst: - 1917年11月22-27日：英军的大部分进攻未能取得多少进展，进攻遂告停止。

src: - Nov 30 1917: The Germans launched a counterattack making use of a massive artillery bombardment, gas shells, CL type planes and Stosstruppen tactics. German forces gained up to 13 km before they were halted by British counterattacks and newly arrived tanks.
dst: - 1917年11月30日：德军利用大规模炮击、毒气弹、CL型飞机和突击队战术发起反击。德军推进了多达13公里，随后被英军的反击和新到的坦克所阻止。

src: - Nov17: Falkenhayn decided to cut his losses and stopped the offensive. In 6 weeks of fighting, about 60,000 BEF (and more Belgian and French) troops were lost. This meant the end of the old British Army as it was sent accross the channel in August. German losses were  about 250,000: Der Kindermord bei Ypern.
dst: - 11月17日：法尔肯海因决定止损并停止了攻势。在6周的战斗中，英国远征军损失了约6万人（比利时和法国军队损失更多）。这意味着8月被派过海峡的那支老英军已经终结。德军损失约25万人：伊普尔的幼童屠杀。

src: - November 5th: After weakening the Serbian Army in a month and a half of trench warfare, the Austro-Hungarian Army launched another massive attack. Belgrade was captured on - December 2nd, but lost again on December 15th after which the whole army had to retreat back into Austro-Hungarian territory. The Serbian Army suffered 170,000 casualties and our allies 215,000. On the Serbian side, a deadly typhus epidemic killed hundreds of thousands of Serb civilians during the winter.
dst: - 11月5日：在一个半月的堑壕战中削弱塞尔维亚陆军后，奥匈军队发动了又一次大规模进攻。贝尔格莱德于12月2日被攻占，但12月15日再度失守，此后整支部队不得不撤回奥匈境内。塞尔维亚陆军伤亡17万人，我方盟友伤亡21.5万人。在塞尔维亚一方，一场致命的斑疹伤寒疫情在那个冬天夺走了数十万塞尔维亚平民的生命。

src: - Oct 24: The French recapture Fort Douaumont.
- Oct 2nd: The fortresses of Wallem, Lier and Koningshooikt are out of order and are evacuated.
dst: - 10月2日：瓦莱姆、利尔和科宁斯霍伊克特要塞已失效并被弃守。

src: - Oct 3rd: Schans Duffel was given up and all Belgian troops retreated behind the river Nete.
dst: - 10月3日：迪费尔堡被放弃，所有比利时军队退到内特河之后。

src: - Oct 4th: A Brigade of British Marines takes position around the city of Lier.
dst: - 10月4日：英国海军陆战队的一个旅在利尔城周围就位。

src: - Oct 5th: Fortress Kessel is destroyed and occupied by the 26th Landwehr Brigade. German troops cross the river Nete. The Belgian Army begins evacuating Antwerp.
dst: - 10月5日：凯瑟尔要塞被摧毁并被第二十六国土旅占领。德军渡过内特河。比利时军队开始撤离安特卫普。

src: - Oct 6th: The British 7th Inf Div and 3rd Cav Div arrive in the port of Oostende which gives the Belgian Army new hope. The Belgian government relocates from Antwerp to Ostend. All guns of fortress Broechem are hit and the fortress is abandoned.
dst: - 10月6日：英国第七步兵师和第三骑兵师抵达奥斯坦德港，给比利时军队带来了新的希望。比利时政府从安特卫普迁至奥斯坦德。布鲁赫姆要塞的所有火炮都被击中，要塞被放弃。

src: - Oct 7th: The inner ring of old fortresses is penetrated.
- Oct 8th: The British rear guard retreats across the river Schelde, abandoning Antwerp.
dst: - 10月8日：英国后卫部队渡过斯海尔德河撤退，放弃了安特卫普。

src: - Oct19: The British were convinced that their attack with now 7 Infantry and 3 Cavalry Divisions - and an Indian Corps on the way - would brake the German lines and reach through Belgium all the way to the German border.
dst: - 10月19日：英国人确信，他们以现有7个步兵师和3个骑兵师——以及一个正在赶来的印度军——发动的进攻，将突破德军防线，穿越比利时直达德国边境。

src: - Oct20: The British attack was stopped by the vast number of German Divisions gathered for their own offensive.
dst: - 10月20日：英军的进攻被德军为自身攻势而集结的大量师所阻挡。

src: - Oct21-22: The British Cavalry Divisions have no problem stopping the German attack - certainly when the 3rd Cav is moved in and the 4th Inf Div's 12th Br takes over Ploegsteert Wood.
dst: - 10月21-22日：英军骑兵师毫不费力地挡住了德军的进攻——尤其是在第三骑兵师投入、第四步兵师第十二旅接管普卢赫斯泰尔特森林之后。

src: - Oct22-23: French troops take over the front N of Ypres.
dst: - 10月22-23日：法军接管了伊普尔以北的前线。

src: - Oct27-Nov11: German attacks on the Ypres front continue and the final assault on Ypres by the finest of the German troops nearly lead to a breakthrough.
dst: - 10月27日-11月11日：德军对伊普尔前线的进攻持续不断，德军最精锐部队对伊普尔的最后突击几乎实现了突破。

src: - Oct27: Armee Gruppe Fabeck is formed and the Kavallerie is taken out of the line. Fabeck will take Messine ridge which is kept until 1917.
dst: - 10月27日：法贝克集团军群组建，骑兵被撤出战线。法贝克将夺取梅森山脊，该山脊一直坚守到1917年。

src: - October 13th 1915 (not part of the scenario): An attack on the Redount by the 46th North Midland Division failed misserably.
dst: - 1915年10月13日（不属于本场景）：第四十六北米德兰师对棱堡发起的进攻惨遭失败。

src: - October 28th 1914: Turkey formally entered the war on our side with the bombing of Russian Black Sea ports.
dst: - 1914年10月28日：土耳其以轰炸俄国黑海港口的方式正式加入我方参战。

src: - October 2nd 1915: A German counterattack from both sides of the Hohenzollern Redoubt, brought the fortification back in German hands.
dst: - 1915年10月2日：德军从霍亨索伦棱堡两侧发起反击，夺回了这座工事。

src: - October 31st 1914: An attempt to take Warsaw from the Russians with the help of the newly arrived 9th Army failed at the Battle of the Vistula River. We lost 140,000 men. The Russians 65,000.
dst: - 1914年10月31日：在新到的第九集团军的协助下，从俄国人手中夺取华沙的企图在维斯瓦河战役中失败。我方损失14万人，俄军损失6.5万人。

src: - On August 7th, Churchill accepted the proposal to elevate General Gott, of 13 Corps, to the command of the army. Next day however we intercepted and shot down his Bombay transport.  Gott was amongst those killed.
dst: - 8月7日，丘吉尔接受了把第13军的戈特将军提升为集团军司令的建议。然而第二天，我们拦截并击落了他的“孟买”运输机。戈特也在死者之列。

src: - On turn 12 the Prussian II Army, with four Army Corps, will come from the north.
dst: - 第12回合，拥有四个军的普鲁士第2军团将从北面到来。

dst: - 一条线性战役路线，包含79个场景和1个奖励场景。

dst: - “火星”行动——朱可夫试图消除勒热夫突出部并合围莫斯科附近的德军第9集团军——以俄军彻底失败告终。

dst: - 原场景：Panzerlige Efile；1942 Amona's Tunis 42 -- WM -- [OG]

src: - Our Arditi Regiment, in teams of nine to ten men, were parachuted in various places in Algeria, Libya and Tunisia for covert warfare duties. Although not as successful as they had hoped to be, they managed to destroy or damage the bridges in Bonira, Beni Mansour and Uadi Bouduvaou.
dst: - 我们的“突击队”团以九到十人一组，在阿尔及利亚、利比亚和突尼斯多处跳伞执行秘密作战任务。虽然不如他们期望的那样成功，他们还是摧毁或破坏了博尼拉、贝尼曼苏尔和瓦迪布杜瓦乌的桥梁。

src: - Our Japanese Allies lose most of the forces that were to finish the conquest of New Guinea at the battle of the Bismarck sea when their transports were sunk by US and RAAF bombers.
dst: - 我们日本盟友原定用以完成征服新几内亚的部队，在俾斯麦海之战中被美军和澳大利亚皇家空军的轰炸机击沉运输船，损失大半。

src: - Our scouts have informed us that there is a river ford south of the first Italian defence line.
dst: - 我们的侦察兵报告，意大利第一道防线以南有一处河滩浅渡点。

src: - Our spies in Baghdad report Russian mountain divisions of the Central Asia Military District moving towards TransJordan.
dst: - 我们在巴格达的间谍报告，中亚军区的俄国山地师正朝外约旦移动。

src: - Our troops that landed in Tunisia to oppose the Allied invasion of Morocco, Algeria and Tunisia have been pushed back by French, US and British forces.
dst: - 我们为抗击盟军入侵摩洛哥、阿尔及利亚和突尼斯而在突尼斯登陆的部队，已被法军、美军和英军击退。

src: - Paratroopers may be needed in some scenarios to get a BV, but are not mandatory.
dst: - 某些场景中可能需要伞兵才能取得BV，但并非强制要求。
