dst: - 玩家须在7个胜利点中守住6/5/4个，以获得辉煌胜利/胜利/战术胜利。

src: - Please do not deploy tank, armoured artillery or armoured recon units - Centauro is commited elsewhere.
dst: - 请不要部署坦克、装甲炮兵或装甲侦察单位——“半人马”师已被派往别处。

src: - Please do not reassign (sell) the defensive units that you get. Deploy them on the map.
dst: - 请不要重新调配（出售）你获得的防御部队。把它们部署到地图上。

dst: - 请注意。除了补给格外，最南端还有一个单独的部署格。

dst: - 请仔细阅读场景简报与回合信息。它们会提供关于规则、设定与即将发生事件的提示和有用信息。

src: - Polish forces in the area are believed to be two infantry divisions and possibly a few cavalry brigades.
dst: - 该地区的波军据信为两个步兵师，可能还有几个骑兵旅。

src: - Prevent any enemy unit (MSUs or not) from reaching the EH at (21,4).
dst: - 阻止任何敌军单位（无论是否主力单位）到达（21，4）处的撤离点。

dst: - 本场景中无法购买单位。

src: - Radio Berlin announces the discovery by Wehrmacht of mass graves of Poles killed by Soviets in the Katyn massacre.
dst: - 柏林电台宣布，国防军发现了在卡廷惨案中被苏联人杀害的波兰人的万人坑。

src: - Ramcke's German paratrooper brigade and our Folgore paratrooper division have reached the front.
dst: - 拉姆克的德国伞兵旅和我们的“闪电”伞兵师已抵达前线。

src: - Read the scenario description and turn messages carefuly.
dst: - 请仔细阅读场景说明和回合提示信息。

src: - Roads and railways out of Cairo and Alexandria are chocked.
dst: - 离开开罗和亚历山大的公路与铁路严重拥堵。

src: - Roosevelt and Churchill are discussing the problems of the second front and the atomic bomb. The are considering action in North Africa.
dst: - 罗斯福和丘吉尔正在讨论第二战场和原子弹的问题。他们正考虑在北非采取行动。

src: - Roosevelt orders a Sqn of B25's to Egypt instead of China, as well as 40 Hurricanes on route to Russia and 10 B24's stationed in India. He also sends 100 howitzers and 300 tanks.
dst: - 罗斯福下令把一个中队的 B-25 调往埃及而非中国，另有40架“飓风”在运往俄国途中、10架 B-24 驻印度。他还送去100门榴弹炮和300辆坦克。

src: - SS Panzer-Grenadier Divisions LSSAH, Das Reich and Totenkopf - forming the SS Panzer Corps - were sent to the Eastern front to stop the Russians advancing after their victory at Stalingrad.
dst: - 党卫军装甲掷弹兵师（警卫旗队、“帝国”和“骷髅”）组成党卫军装甲军，被派往东线，以阻止俄国人在斯大林格勒胜利后的推进。

src: - Scenario is balanced for human vs human play.
dst: - 场景按人对人（human vs human）对战平衡设计。

src: - Sep 28th: The shelling of the Belgian fortresses by 30,5 cm and 42cm batteries started.
dst: - 9月28日：30.5厘米和42厘米炮兵连开始炮击比利时要塞。

src: - Sep 29th: The fortress of Sint-Katelijne-Waver was destroyed and evacuated when the ammo supply was hit.
dst: - 9月29日：弹药供应被击中后，圣卡特莱娜-瓦弗尔要塞被摧毁并弃守。

src: - September 15th: The third and final general offensive - that saw tanks deployed in small numbers - lasted until mid November. It achieved considerable tactical gains, but did not achieve a breakthrough.
dst: - 9月15日：第三次也是最后一次总攻——这次动用了少量坦克——一直持续到11月中旬。它取得了相当大的战术进展，但没有实现突破。

src: - September 25th 1915: The British used gas for the first time. On the left flank of the 9th Scottish Division the wind blew the gas back towards their own lines. The attack of 28th Brigade went bad. In the center, 26th Brigade made good progress, capturing the Hohenzollern Redoubt, Fosse 8 and the Dump. In the evening, 26th Brigade was reinforced with 27th Brigade. At night they were joined by 73rd Brigade of the 24th Infantry Division.
dst: - 1915年9月25日：英军首次使用毒气。在第九苏格兰师左翼，风把毒气吹回了己方阵地。第二十八旅的进攻受挫。在中央，第二十六旅进展顺利，攻占了霍亨索伦棱堡、8号矿井和堆场。傍晚，第二十六旅得到第二十七旅的增援。夜间，第二十四步兵师的第七十三旅也加入进来。

src: - September 26th 1915: A rapidly formed German ad-hoc fighting force under command of OberstLeutnant Anton Staubwasser started counterattacks at the Quarries first, and later at The Dump.
dst: - 1915年9月26日：一支由中校安东·施陶布瓦瑟指挥、仓促组建的德军临时战斗部队，先在采石场、随后在堆场发起反击。

src: - September 28th 1915: At dawn, a German counterattack pushed the exhausted British forces from Fosse 8 and The Dump. Hohenzollern Redoubt stayed in British hands.
dst: - 1915年9月28日：拂晓时分，德军的一次反击把疲惫的英军从8号矿井和堆场赶了出来。霍亨索伦棱堡仍留在英军手中。

src: - Sevastopol surrenders. Von Manstein is promoted to Field Marshal.
dst: - 塞瓦斯托波尔投降。冯·曼施泰因晋升为元帅。

dst: - 经验增长缓慢（每格经验条衰减15%）。

dst: - 少量捷克和南斯拉夫保王派部队。

dst: - 有人看到一些布尔什维克部队正试图翻越山区。别忘了保护您的后方。

src: - Some Soviet partisan units have been spotted on your rear guard. Watch out!
dst: - 在您的后卫处发现了一些苏维埃游击队单位。当心！

dst: - 有时您必须修建机场、桥梁或港口。

dst: - 核心单位损失的兵力将不会在下一场景开始时于总部自动补充。

src: - Submarine launched aircraft of our Japanese allies have bombed Oregon (US) forests with incindiary bombs.
dst: - 我们日本盟友的潜艇载机用燃烧弹轰炸了（美国）俄勒冈的森林。

src: - Take all the VHs or destroy all the enemy MSUs (there are 10 in total).
dst: - 夺取所有胜利点，或消灭所有敌方主力单位（共10个）。

dst: - 夺取所有胜利格，并阻止法军越过法瑞边境。

dst: - 夺取并/或守住所有胜利点。

dst: - 指挥冯·贝泽勒的第2预备军中的第6预备师。令[IIR]在第一回合向安特卫普推进。

dst: - 第11步兵师将在战斗开始两天（4回合）后接替第61步兵师。

src: - The 1st US Rangers Bn - AI controlled.
dst: - 美军第1游骑兵营——由AI指挥。

src: - The Arab Legion - possibly the best trained Arab army unit.
dst: - 阿拉伯军团——可能是训练最好的阿拉伯军队单位。

src: - The Armored Train Artillery is the jewel of the Hungarian Red Army. You must keep this unit alive during the whole campaign!
dst: - 装甲列车炮兵是匈牙利红军的瑰宝。您必须在整个战役期间让这个单位存活！

src: - The British cavalry is heading to Baberspan and outnumbers you, so use the terrain wisely.
dst: - 英军骑兵正朝巴伯斯潘开进，兵力超过您，所以要善用地形。

src: - The Dutch airforce is substantially smaller than our Luftflotte 2 that is covering the Netherlands and Belgium.

src: 1884-AUG-05 French forces disabled the Keelung harbor defences and put a small landing force ashore that occupied Keelung and the Pei-tao coal mines.
dst: 1884年8月5日 法军瘫痪了基隆港的防御工事，并派一支小规模登陆部队上岸，占领了基隆和北头煤矿。

src: 1884-AUG-06 French forces had to re-embark after the arrival of a large body of Chinese troops.
dst: 1884年8月6日 在一大批清军抵达后，法军不得不重新登船撤离。

src: 1884-AUG-23 Admiral Amédée Courbet's Far East Squadron virtually destroyed the Fujian Fleet - one of China's four regional fleets - in the Battle of Fuzhou.
dst: 1884年8月23日 阿梅代·库尔贝海军上将的远东分舰队在福州海战中几乎全歼了福建水师——中国四大区域舰队之一。

src: 1884-NOV/DEC French constructed forts around the city and repulsed multiple Chinese attacks.
dst: 1884年11月/12月 法军在城周围修筑了堡垒，并击退了清军的多次进攻。

src: 1884-OCT-01 The corps expéditionnaire de Formose captured positions in and around Keelung, but Pei-tao coal mines remained in Chinese hands.
dst: 1884年10月1日 法国远征军占领了基隆及周边阵地，但北头煤矿仍在清军手中。

src: 1885-FEB-13. French forces take Lang Son, after a march of 10 days and several engagements against Chinese forces.
dst: 1885年2月13日 法军在行军10天、与清军多次交战后占领了谅山。

src: 1885-FEB-23. The French defeat the Qing army at Dong Dang, forcing it to retreat towards the Chinese border.
dst: 1885年2月23日 法军在同登击败清军，迫使其向中国边境撤退。

src: 1885-FEB-25. The French take the Zhennan Pass, but most of the army goes back to Lang Son, leaving just a small force on the mountain passes.
dst: 1885年2月25日 法军攻占镇南关，但主力又退回谅山，只在山隘留下少量兵力。

src: 1885-JAN-20 Two additional French battalions are sent to Keelung.
dst: 1885年1月20日 又两个法国营被派往基隆。

src: 1885-JUN-09. France and China sign the Treaty of Tientsin. China recognises the French protectorate over Annam and Tonkin, but at least doesn't have to pay any war reparations. From the Chinese point of view the war had been fought to a stalemate, and that had an outstanding effect on the rebirth of China's national pride.
dst: 1885年6月9日 法国与中国签订《天津条约》。中国承认法国对安南和东京（北圻）的保护权，但至少不必支付任何战争赔款。从中国人的角度看，这场战争打成了平局，而这对中国民族自豪感的重生产生了深远的影响。

src: 1885-MAR-24. The Qing army defeats the French troops that were defending the Zhennan Pass (battle of Bang Bo).
dst: 1885年3月24日 清军击败了防守镇南关的法军（邦波之战）。

src: 1885-MAR-25/29 A battalion of marines was detached from the Keelung garrison to capture the Pescadores Islands. An important strategic victory, which would have prevented the Chinese from further reinforcing their army in Formosa, but it came too late to affect the outcome of the war.
dst: 1885年3月25日/29日 一个海军陆战营从基隆守备队中抽调出来，去攻占澎湖列岛。这是一次重要的战略胜利，本可以阻止清军继续增援台湾的军队，但为时已晚，未能影响战争结局。

src: 1885-MAR-28. Fearing a Chinese counterattack, the French evacuate Lang Son.
dst: 1885年3月28日 因担心清军反击，法军撤离了谅山。

src: 1885-MAR-30. When the news of the French retreats reached Paris, there were riots in the streets. The laicist-colonialist government of Jules Ferry fell, and his successor promptly ordered to sign a peace treaty with China.
dst: 1885年3月30日 法军撤退的消息传到巴黎，街头爆发了骚乱。儒勒·费里的世俗殖民主义政府倒台，其继任者立即下令与中国签订和平条约。

src: 1885-MAR-4/7 French attacks broke the Chinese encirclement of Keelung and pushed the Chinese back behind the Keelung River.
dst: 1885年3月4日/7日 法军的进攻打破了清军对基隆的包围，并把清军逼退到基隆河之后。

src: 1895-AUG-13: The last Hova defense line at Andriba is being attacked by the French, who initially fail to break the lines of the Malagasy defenders. After an intense artillery bombardment, the frightened and demoralized Hova troops retreat to Antananarivo.
dst: 1895年8月13日：法军进攻霍瓦人在安德里巴的最后一道防线，起初未能突破马达加斯加守军的阵线。经过猛烈炮击后，惊恐而士气低落的霍瓦军队撤退到塔那那利佛。

src: 1895-JUN-29: The attack of the Hova army - 5,000 men attacking in human waves - on the French outpost at Tsarasoatra is repulsed.
dst: 1895年6月29日：霍瓦军队以5000人的人海冲锋进攻法国在察拉萨奥特拉的前哨阵地，被击退。

src: 1895-Oct-01: General Duchesne enters the city, and Queen Ranavalona III signs a treaty that makes Madagascar a full Protectorate of the French government.
dst: 1895年10月1日：迪谢纳将军进入该城，拉纳瓦洛娜三世女王签署条约，使马达加斯加成为法国政府的完全保护国。

src: 1895-SEPT-30: A flying column of the French expditionary forces reaches the Malagasy capital and storms the city. Queen Ranavalona III surrenders.
dst: 1895年9月30日：法国远征军一支快速纵队抵达马达加斯加首都并攻入城中。拉纳瓦洛娜三世女王投降。

src: 1914-AUG-20. The Germans counterattack in Lorraine and defeat the French, opening a gap in their lines and forcing them to retreat.
dst: 1914年8月20日 德军在洛林发动反击并击败法军，在其防线撕开一道缺口，迫使其撤退。

src: 1914-AUG-21. The French close the gap, so their First and Second Armies regain contact, keeping in touch despite new German attacks.
dst: 1914年8月21日 法军封闭了缺口，其第1、第2集团军重新取得联系，在德军新的进攻下仍保持联络。

src: 1914-AUG-26. The German assault on Nancy fails, and the French gradually recover the lost ground.
dst: 1914年8月26日 德军对南锡的进攻失败，法军逐步收复失地。

src: 1914-SEP-04. As General von Kluck's 1st Army, the German right wing, is turning away from Paris and marching south, General Galieni, the Military Governor of the French capital, decides to take advantage of the exposed position of the German 1st Army and attack its flank. General Joffre almost simultaneously comes to the same conclusion and orders a general counter-attack at the Marne.
dst: 1914年9月4日。当冯·克卢克将军的第一集团军——德军的右翼——正掉头离开巴黎向南进军时，法国首都的军事总督加利埃尼将军决定利用德军第一集团军暴露的位置，攻击其侧翼。霞飞将军几乎同时得出了同样的结论，并下令在马恩河发起总反击。

src: 1914-SEP-04. As the German right wing, General von Kluck's 1st Army, is turning away from Paris and marching south, General Galieni, the Military Governor of the French capital, decides to take advantage of the exposed position of the German 1st Army and attack its flank. General Joffre almost simultaneously comes to the same conclusion and orders a general counter-attack along the Marne.
dst: 1914年9月4日。当德国右翼——冯·克卢克将军的第1集团军——从巴黎掉头南进时，法国首都的军事总督加利埃尼将军决定利用德国第1集团军暴露的侧翼，攻击其侧翼。霞飞将军几乎同时得出相同结论，下令沿马恩河发起全面反攻。

src: 1914-SEP-05. General Manoury's 6th Army attacks at the River Ourcq, but is initiallly checked by the German IV Reserve Corps.
dst: 1914年9月5日。莫努里将军的第6集团军在乌尔克河发起进攻，但起初被德国第4预备军阻止。

src: 1914-SEP-05. Manoury's 6th Army attack at the River Ourcq, but is checked by the German IV Reserve Corps.
dst: 1914年9月5日。马努里的第六集团军在乌尔克河发起进攻，但被德军第四预备军所阻止。

src: 1914-SEP-06-08. General von Kluck hurries reinforcements from his centre to the River Ourcq, leading to a general withdrawal of the 1st Army, which opens a wide gap between von Kluck's Army and the 2nd German Army under von Bülow.
dst: 1914年9月6日至8日 冯·克卢克将军急忙从中路调集援军前往乌尔克河，导致第1集团军全面后撤，在冯·克卢克的集团军与冯·比洛指挥的德军第2集团军之间撕开了一道宽大的缺口。

src: 1914-SEP-06. The BEF cautiously advances into the gap between the two German armies. Von Bülow, heavily engaged against the French 5th Army, withdraws his troops to prevent being outflanked by the British.
dst: 1914年9月6日 英国远征军谨慎地推进到两支德军之间的缺口。冯·比洛正与法军第5集团军激烈交战，为免遭英军迂回侧翼，他撤回了部队。

src: 1914-SEP-08-09. After Lieutenant-Colonel Hentsch, an officer of the General Staff, being sent out by Moltke to visit to all army commands along the front, considers the situation of the German 1st, 2nd and 3rd Army to be "untenable", the Germans break off the battle and retreat along the whole frontline. The French and British troops push back the Germans to River Aisne.
dst: 1914年9月8日至9日 毛奇派总参谋部军官亨奇中校到前线视察各集团军指挥部，亨奇认为德军第1、第2、第3集团军的处境「难以为继」，于是德军中止战斗，沿整条战线后撤。法英军队将德军逼退到埃纳河。

src: 1914-SEP-10. The front line is stabilized again, aproximately as it was before the start of the battle of Lorraine.
dst: 1914年9月10日 战线再次稳定下来，大致回到洛林战役开始前的态势。

src: 1915-DEC-22. The Bulgarians defeat the French and British armies at Kosturino, forcing the Entente troops to retreat from Serbia completely, and enabling the Central Powers to build the Berlin to Constantinople rail line. However, the French and the British build a strong defence line in Macedonia, and despite some fierce battles the front line will change very little until 1918.
dst: 1915年12月22日 保加利亚人在科斯图里诺击败了法英军队，迫使协约国部队完全撤出塞尔维亚，并使同盟国得以修建柏林至君士坦丁堡的铁路线。然而，法英两国在马其顿构筑了坚固防线，尽管发生了一些激烈战斗，战线直到1918年都很少变动。

src: 1915-NOV-22. After a last Serbian offensive in Macedonia is defeated by the Bulgarians, the French evacuate the region.
dst: 1915年11月22日 塞尔维亚在马其顿的最后一次攻势被保加利亚人击败后，法军撤离了该地区。

src: 1916   Rückzug in den Busch -- Retreat into the Bush
dst: 1916年 撤退到灌木丛--撤入灌木丛

src: 1916-DEC-01. French shelling of German positions is resumed.
dst: 1916年12月1日 法军恢复对德军阵地的炮击。

src: 1916-DEC-13-15. The creeping barrage moves forwards. The French capture Bezonvaux, the Bois de Hassoule, the Bois de Chauffour and Louvemont with heavy losses.
dst: 1916年12月13日至15日 徐进弹幕向前推进。法军以惨重伤亡攻占了贝宗沃、阿苏勒森林、绍富尔森林和卢沃蒙。

src: 1916-DEC-19. German high command admits defeat. The German army is back where it started Feb 21st.
dst: 1916年12月19日 德军最高统帅部承认失败。德军回到了2月21日出发的地方。

src: 1916-FEB-21. "Unternehmen Gericht" (Operation Judgement), the German attack on Verdun, begins with a 10-hour artillery bombardment of nearly 1,000 guns of all calibres, followed by the advance of the three infantry coprs, spearheaded by new 'stormtrooper' and flamethrower units. While most of the French 1st line is either destroyed by artillery fire or overrun by infantry, Colonel Emile Driant and his two battalions of Chasseurs delay the German advance in the Bois des Caures for nearly 2 days, before he and most of his men are killed.
dst: 1916年2月21日 「裁决行动」（即对凡尔登的进攻）开始，近1000门各口径火炮进行了长达10小时的炮击，随后三个步兵军发起推进，打头阵的是新组建的「暴风突击队」和喷火部队。虽然法军第一线大部分不是被炮火摧毁就是被步兵冲垮，但埃米尔·德里昂上校率领他的两个猎兵营在科雷森林中迟滞了德军的推进近两天，直到他和手下大部分人阵亡。

src: 1916-FEB-25. Fort Douaumont, the largest and highest fort of the Verdun defences, is entered and occupied without a fight, by a small German raiding party.
dst: 1916年2月25日 杜奥蒙堡——凡尔登防御体系中最大、最高的堡垒——被一支德军小规模突击队兵不血刃地攻入并占领。

src: 1916-FEB-27-29. The German advance slows down due to exhaustion, high casualties, and
dst: 1916年2月27日至29日 由于疲惫和惨重伤亡，德军的推进放缓下来，而且

src: 1916-JAN-9. The last Entente units in Gallipolli reembark, leaving the area.
dst: 1916年1月9日 加里波利的最后一支协约国部队重新登船，离开了该地区。

src: 1916-JUL-1. The British offensive at the Somme starts. Troops, artillery and aeroplanes are transferred from the Verdun front to the Somme front. However, bitter fighting still continues over Fleury.
dst: 1916年7月1日 英军在索姆河的攻势开始。部队、火炮和飞机从凡尔登战线调往索姆河战线。然而，弗勒里周围的激战仍在继续。

src: 1916-JUL-12. At the Verdun front, a German attack against Fort Souville fails. General Nivelle gives a moving order of the day, in which the French troops are praised for their perseverance and their persistency. He concludes with the famous sentence:  "Ils ne passeront pas!".
dst: 1916年7月12日 在凡尔登战线，德军对苏维尔堡的进攻失败。尼韦勒将军发布了一道动人的当日命令，赞扬法军官兵的坚毅与顽强。他以那句名言作结：「他们绝不可通过！」

src: 1916-JUL/AUG. The German and French attacks continue, with huge losses on both sides and without any significative results. Gradually, the old front line is restored once again and the front becomes quiet.
dst: 1916年7月/8月 德法双方的进攻仍在继续，双方损失巨大，却毫无显著战果。旧战线逐渐再次恢复，前线归于沉寂。

src: 1916-JUN-21-23. A new German attack manages to take Fleury. The French defence nearly collapses, and even Pétain and Nivelle consider to vacate the right riverbank of the Meuse. However, the Germans are not able to force a breakthrough.
dst: 1916年6月21日至23日 德军新一轮进攻攻占了弗勒里。法军防线几乎崩溃，连贝当和尼韦勒都考虑放弃默兹河右岸。然而，德军未能实现突破。

src: 1916-JUN-25. Knowing that a British offensive in the Somme is imminent, the German Vth army receives the request to be more economical with men, materials and ammunition. The French counterattack at the Verdun front, and the German preparations for the planned attack have to be postponed. The chance for a German breakthrough is gone.
dst: 1916年6月25日 得知英军即将在索姆河发起攻势，德军第5集团军接到命令，要在人员、物资和弹药上更加节约。法军在凡尔登战线发起反击，德军原定进攻的准备工作不得不推迟。德军突破的机会就此丧失。

src: 1916-JUN-4. While the Germans attack Fort Vaux, the Russians launch the Brusilov offensive.
dst: 1916年6月4日 当德军进攻沃堡时，俄军发动了布鲁西洛夫攻势。

src: 1916-JUN-7. Fort Vaux surrenders, after one week of heroic resistance. The German losses are so high that they must stop their offensive for a few days. The offensive continues on June 12, but with little success.
dst: 1916年6月7日 沃堡在英勇抵抗一周后投降。德军损失惨重，不得不暂停攻势数日。攻势于6月12日继续，但收效甚微。

src: 1916-NOV-02. The French capture the fortress of Vaux and the Verdun front returns to relative inactivity.
dst: 1916年11月2日 法军攻克沃堡，凡尔登战线重新归于相对平静。

src: 1916-OCT-21. French artillery starts shelling German positions on a 7km front.
dst: 1916年10月21日 法军炮兵开始在7公里宽的正面炮击德军阵地。

src: 1916-OCT-22. French artillery stops shelling the German positions. German artillery fires to disrupt the French attack. French counter-battery fire takes out 70 of 158 German batteries.
dst: 1916年10月22日 法军炮兵停止炮击德军阵地。德军炮兵开火以打乱法军进攻。法军的反炮兵火力摧毁了158个德军炮连中的70个。

src: 1916-OCT-24. French infantry attacks behind a creeping barrage. The Fortress of Douamont is captured. Resistance of the German left flank between the fortress of Vaux and the Bois de Fumin is heavy and French progress limited.
dst: 1916年10月24日 法军步兵在徐进弹幕掩护下发起进攻。杜奥蒙堡被攻克。德军在沃堡与富曼森林之间左翼的抵抗十分激烈，法军进展有限。
1917-20 捷克军团 - 西伯利亚远征

src: 1917-AUG. During the wettest summer in 30 years, the British continue their slow progress, taking Westhoek and Langemarck.
dst: 1917年8月 在30年来最潮湿的夏季里，英军继续缓慢推进，攻占了韦斯特胡克和朗厄马克。

src: 1917-JUL-31. Believing that they finally can open a gap in the German defences at the Ypres salient, the British launch an attack against Pilkem. Although initially successful, the heavy rains soon bogs the offensive down.
dst: 1917年7月31日 英军相信终于能在伊普尔突出部的德军防线上撕开缺口，便对皮尔克姆发动了进攻。虽然起初进展顺利，但连日的暴雨很快使攻势陷入泥沼。

src: 1917-OCT-12. The Entente forces attack Passchendaele. Heavy rain and mud again make the British advance terribly difficult, and the assault must stop.
dst: 1917年10月12日 协约国军队进攻帕斯尚代尔。大雨和泥泞再次使英军的推进变得异常艰难，进攻不得不停止。

src: 1917-OCT-26- NOV-10. The British finally capture Passchendaele, but the fierce German resistance makes a break through impossible. The trench warfare still goes on.
dst: 1917年10月26日至11月10日 英军最终攻占了帕斯尚代尔，但德军的顽强抵抗使突破成为不可能。堑壕战仍在继续。

src: 1917-OCT-9. The British and the French attack Poelcappelle and its surrounding areas. Although the operation is initially successfull, most of the taken ground is later lost to German counter-attacks.
dst: 1917年10月9日 英法军队进攻普尔卡佩勒及其周边地区。虽然行动起初获得成功，但大部分占领的地区后来又在德军反击中丧失。

src: 1917-SEP-20- OCT-4. The British take Menin Road, Polygon Wood and Broodseinde. The Germans start to think that a general withdrawal is unavoidable.
dst: 1917年9月20日至10月4日 英军攻占了梅嫩路、波利贡森林和布罗德塞因德。德军开始认为全面后撤不可避免。

src: 1918 Der lange Marsch nach Norden  -  The long march northwards

1918-APR-11. The Germans manage to break through the British, Belgian and Portuguese lines, making the deepest advances by either side since 1914. However, their casualties are very high, so after a few days their attacks start to lose momentum.
dst: 1918年4月11日 德军突破了英军、比利时军和葡萄牙军的防线，取得了自1914年以来任何一方最深的推进。然而，他们伤亡惨重，几天后攻势开始失去势头。

src: 1918-APR-17. The Germans launch a first assault against the Kemmelberg position, but the British repulse it. Just a few hours later, French units must relieve the decimated British divisions in that area.
dst: 1918年4月17日 德军对凯默尔贝格阵地发动了第一次突击，但被英军击退。仅仅几小时后，法军部队就不得不接防该地区被打残的英军师。

src: 1918-APR-25. The Germans attack Kemmelberg again, and this time they capture the position. Exhausted, and without the possibility of receiving any reinforces to make up for their losses, they can't exploit their success. In the meantime, the French send more divisions to the combat zone.
dst: 1918年4月25日 德军再次进攻凯默尔贝格，这一次攻占了该阵地。由于疲惫不堪，又得不到任何援军来弥补损失，他们无法扩大战果。与此同时，法军向战区增派了更多师。

src: 1918-APR-29. Unable to progres any further, the Germans cancel Operation Georgette. All the German attacks during the Spring Offensive will suffer the same fate.
dst: 1918年4月29日 由于无法再取得进展，德军取消了乔治特行动。春季攻势中德军的历次进攻都将遭受同样的命运。

src: 1918-APR-7. One of those attacks (Operation Georgette) starts with the aim of taking Ypres, forcing the British forces back to the channel ports. Most of the fighting will take place near the Lys river.
dst: 1918年4月7日 其中一次进攻（乔治特行动）开始，目标是攻占伊普尔，把英军逼回海峡各港口。大部分战斗将发生在利斯河附近。

src: 1918-JUNE-10. The Germans launch "Operation Gneisenau" with 21 divisions attacking along the Matz River. Despite fierce resistance, they are able to advance up to 14km.
dst: 1918年6月10日 德军发动「格奈泽瑙行动」，以21个师沿马茨河进攻。尽管遭遇顽强抵抗，他们还是推进了多达14公里。

src: 1918-JUNE-11. General Mangin counterattacks west of Compiegne with 4 divisions and 150 tanks. The Germans are completely caught by surprise because Mangin didn't use any preliminary bombardment.
dst: 1918年6月11日 曼让将军以4个师和150辆坦克在贡比涅以西发起反击。曼让没有进行任何预先炮击，德军被完全打了个措手不及。

src: 1918-JUNE-12. "Operation Gneisenau" is called off by the German High Command. Losses are 35,000 Allied and 30,000 German soldiers.
dst: 1918年6月12日 「格奈泽瑙行动」被德国最高统帅部取消。协约国损失35000人，德军损失30000人。

src: 1918-MARCH-23. The Germans start their Spring Offensive, in the hope that they could defeat the Entente before the American Army could deploy its forces entirely. The offensive was, actually, a series of coordinated attacks in Northern France and Flanders.
dst: 1918年3月23日 德军发动春季攻势，希望在美军能全部部署之前击败协约国。这次攻势实际上是法国北部和佛兰德斯一系列协调进攻的组合。

1935年决定的骑兵军（“Corps de Cavalerie”）摩托化如今已接近完成。这支机动部队将配合我们的主要筑垒阵地和防线，在需要之处提供支援。
1936年，比利时开始推行“武装独立”政策，这一政策得到大多数比利时民众的支持。由于德国重新占领莱茵兰时法国和英国无力作出反应，以及法国拒绝将马奇诺防线延伸至比利时-法国边界（这无异于邀请德国取道比利时进攻法国），比利时终止了共同防御条约，决定依靠自身武装力量来保障独立。因此，战争爆发时比利时拥有其历史上准备最充分的军队，年度国家预算的25%用于军事。
1937年9月25日，中国北方大同附近的平型关。

src: 1939,  Austria, Czech and Moravia have been occupied. Now we test our Wermacht forces agianst the massive Polish military.
dst: 1939年，奥地利、捷克和摩拉维亚已被占领。现在我们要用国防军的力量去对付庞大的波兰军队。
1939年，法国和英国单方面保证比利时的独立。尽管双方没有官方的军事计划协调，但仍保持着秘密接触。一旦德国发动进攻，法国和英国将开进比利时并在戴尔河一线占领阵地（D计划）。因此比利时人把这条河作为主要防线，尽管这意味着放弃半个国家。

1940年1月10日，一架德国飞机坠毁后德军军事计划被缴获，比利时国王利奥波德三世准备在一定条件下接受盟军部队进入本国（比利时参与和平谈判、保证比利时及其殖民地的完整、以及战后重建比利时的财政支持）。然而，这些条件对英国和法国来说无法接受，他们的部队直到德国发动进攻才进入比利时。
1941年，意大利军队在非洲无力对抗英军。经历了一年的惨败之后，他们向德国盟友求援。德国抽不出多少资源在非洲与英军作战，于是在 1941年2月12日把隆美尔将军以及第一批德国装备和人员派往的黎波里。
1941年决定性会战的时刻已经到来。苏军已集结兵力保卫莫斯科，此地是俄国经济与政治的关键所在。现在，该由你把部队投向莫斯科了。你必须突破他们的防御，在冬季天气与西伯利亚增援夺走先手之前拿下莫斯科。若能在这个冬季攻占并守住莫斯科，苏联无疑将会投降。

src: 1942 has been a bad year for our campaign. Clearly the Russians have suffered greater losses than we did, but we did not achieve the strategic victory we need. Where it not for you and your brave men however, we would have suffered a strategic defeat.
dst: 1942年对我们的战局而言是糟糕的一年。俄军的损失显然比我军更大，但我们并未取得所需的战略性胜利。然而若不是您和您勇敢的部下，我们早已遭受一场战略失败。
1942年11月是战争的转折点。德军犯下了一些严重的战略错误。在本战役中，国防军最高统帅部决定把原本要派给保卢斯的三个师改派去加强斯大林格勒以北罗马尼亚战线的一段。
1942年对我们的战局而言是糟糕的一年。俄军的损失显然比我军更大，但我们并未取得所需的战略性胜利。然而若不是您和您勇敢的部下，我们早已遭受一场战略失败。
1942年未能给俄国以致命一击，本已令我们失望，而西方盟军逐步将我们逐出北非，更使这种失望有增无减。已不再需要你的效力。

src: 2 When several days had elapsed in winter quarters, and he had ordered corn to be brought in he was suddenly informed by his scouts that all the people had gone off in the night from that part of the town which he had given up to the Gauls, and that the mountains which hung over it were occupied by a very large force of the Seduni and Veragri. It had happened for several reasons that the Gauls suddenly formed the design of renewing the war and cutting off that legion. First, because they despised a single legion, on account of its small number, and that not quite full (two cohorts having been detached, and several individuals being absent, who had been dispatched for the purpose of seeking provision); then, likewise, because they thought that on account of the disadvantageous character of the situation, even their first attack could not be sustained [by us] when they would rush from the mountains into the valley, and discharge their weapons upon us. To this was added, that they were indignant that their children were torn from them under the title of hostages, and they were persuaded that the Romans designed to seize upon the summits of the Alps, and unite those parts to the neighboring province [of Gaul], not only to secure the passes, but also a constant possession.
dst: 2 在冬营中过了数日、他已下令征粮时，斥候忽然来报：所有居民都在夜里从划给高卢人的那片城区撤走，俯瞰该处的山上已被塞杜尼人与韦拉格里的重兵占据。高卢人忽然打定主意重开战事、歼灭该军团，原因有几条。第一，他们看不起这一个军团，因其兵数不多，而且并不满编（已分出两个步兵队，另有一些人被派出去筹粮而缺席）；其次，他们认为凭地形之不利，即便我军〔第一次〕冲击也撑不住——那时他们会从山上冲入谷中，向我军投掷武器。此外，他们还愤恨自己的孩子以人质之名被夺走，并且相信罗马人图谋夺取阿尔卑斯山各隘口、把这一带并入邻近的〔高卢〕行省，既不只为控制通道，还要长久占有。

src: 23 These matters being arranged, finding the weather favorable for his voyage, he set sail about the third watch, and ordered the horse to march forward to the further port, and there embark and follow him. As this was performed rather tardily by them, he himself reached Britain with the first squadron of ships, about the fourth hour of the day, and there saw the forces of the enemy drawn up in arms on all the hills. The nature of the place was this: the sea was confined by mountains so close to it that a dart could be thrown from their summit upon the shore. Considering this by no means a fit place for disembarking, he remained at anchor till the ninth hour, for the other ships to arrive there. Having in the mean time assembled the lieutenants and military tribunes, he told them both what he had learned from Volusenus, and what he wished to be done; and enjoined them (as the principle of military matters, and especially as maritime affairs, which have a precipitate and uncertain action, required) that all things should be performed by them at a nod and at the instant. Having dismissed them, meeting both with wind and tide favorable at the same time, the signal being given and the anchor weighed, he advanced about seven miles from that place, and stationed his fleet over against an open and level shore.
dst: 23 这些事安排妥当后，他见风向宜于航行，便于第三更时分起航，并命令骑兵先行前往较远的港口，在那里登船随后跟上。由于他们动作稍迟，凯撒本人已随第一支分舰队抵达不列颠，时约白昼第四时，见到敌人武装的部队在各处山丘上列阵。当地的地形是这样的：海被山峦逼得极近，从山顶可以投矛直抵岸边。他认定这里绝非合适的登陆之处，便停泊待锚，等到第九时其余船只到达。其间他召集副将与军团长官，把他们从沃卢塞努斯处得知的情报、以及他希望办理的事项一一告知；并告诫他们（正如军务、尤其是海上行动那种仓促而不确定的情形所要求的）：一切都要凭一个示意、在刹那间完成。遣散他们之后，恰逢风与潮同时顺遂，信号一发、起锚开航，他前进约七里，把舰队停在一片开阔平缓的海岸对面。

src: 3. Mobile forces will take Gaivoron from where we will launch the final push south.
dst: 3. 机动部队将夺取盖沃龙，我们将从那里发起最后的南下进攻。

src: 3. Once KG East has formed a secure bridgehead it will be reinforced while the main KG heads south to take Stonne then west towards Rethel.

src: 3. Once all objectives are secured the ring must be held and all enemy forces within it destroyed.
dst: 3. 所有目标到手后，必须守住包围圈并歼灭圈内全部敌军。

src: 3. Protect the Fuhrer's bodygaurds at all costs.
dst: 3. 不惜一切代价保护元首的警卫部队。

src: 3. Soviet Armies caught between the thrusts must be destroyed.
dst: 3. 被夹在各路突击之间的苏军集团军必须予以歼灭。

src: 3. Spare units from 1st and 2nd Panzer Division will come together to take Picquigny and it's airfield.
dst: 3. 第1和第2装甲师的余部将合兵夺取皮基尼及其机场。

src: 3. The capture of the now besieged city of Antwerp.
dst: 3. 攻占如今已被围困的安特卫普城。

5月11日，情况进一步恶化。德军主力部队，尤其是第3和第4装甲师的抵达，对比利时第7师来说过于沉重。德军扩大了桥头堡，把比利时军队击退。
5月12日至13日，德军步兵在哈伦、海特贝茨和胡岑霍芬对盖特河临时防线发起猛攻。所有进攻（共十一次）均被击退，比利时骑兵师直到发现左翼的法军已经后撤时才撤退。这次防御也使英国远征军得以在未遭德军攻击的情况下进入“KW 防线”（迪尔河防线）阵地。
5月18日至19日夜间，比利时军队撤往根特-泰尔讷曾运河后方新阵地的行动由各骑兵师和第1“阿登猎兵”师掩护。当德军利用安特卫普地区一条未被彻底炸毁的隧道渡过斯海尔德河时，德军第208步兵师与比利时骑兵部队在兹韦恩德雷赫特周边爆发激战。由于比利时坦克和装甲车辆（T13）的攻击，德军步兵未能继续推进。当日结束时，比利时部队奉命撤往根特-泰尔讷曾运河后方。
5月20日，德军三个师在泽尔扎特、夸特雷赫特和津海姆转入进攻。在取得初步胜利后，比利时人立即发起数次反击，夺回了先前失去的大部分土地。德军在比利时战线上的所有进攻均被击退，未能在斯海尔德河和泰尔讷曾运河上建立桥头堡。比利时指挥部相信，德军能够在斯海尔德河被挡住。
5月27日莱厄河/利斯河一线被突破后，新的撤退命令下达，比利时部队撤出了芬克特。虽然一些部队成功撤到新阵地，但局势十分严峻：德军处处突破、伤亡不断增加、补给匮乏、与部分部队失去联系……很明显比利时军队正在瓦解。与1914年不同，撤向艾泽尔河/伊瑟河已不可能。

src: 8 Scarcely had the rear advanced beyond the fortifications when the Gauls, encouraging one another “not to cast from their hands the anticipated booty, that it was a tedious thing, while the Romans were panic-stricken, to be waiting for the aid of the Germans, and that their dignity did not suffer them to fear to attack with such great forces so small a band, particularly when retreating and encumbered,do not hesitate to cross the river and give battle in a disadvantageous position. Labienus suspecting that these things would happen, was proceeding quietly, and using the same pretense of a march, in order that he might entice them across the river. Then, having sent forward the baggage some short distance and placed it on a certain eminence, he says, "Soldiers, you have the opportunity you have sought: you hold the enemy in an encumbered and disadvantageous position: display to us, your leaders, the same valor you have ofttimes displayed to your general: imagine that he is present and actually sees these exploits."

src: <A QUEEN MOTHER IS TRAPPED IN THE HEART OF THE PESTILENCE'S LARGEST NEST IN THIS AREA.  SHE MUST BE PROTECTED!>
dst: <一位蚁后母被困在此地瘟疫最大巢穴的核心。她必须受到保护！>

src: <BIPED FORCES HAVE SEEN US COMING AND BLOCKED OFF THE MAJOR ARTERIAL INTO THIS REGION WITH AN AVALANCHE OF BOULDERS AND AN EXCELLENT DEFENSIVE POSITION.  THE PATH TO THE EAST MUST BE SECURED FROM THIS ANGLE IN ORDER TO BRING IN THE MAIN WARRIOR GROUP.>
dst: <双足军队已察觉我们的到来，用崩落的巨石堵住了通往此区域的主要通道，并占据了绝佳的防御阵地。东面的道路必须先从这一角度夺取，才能把主力战士集群开进来。>

src: <DESTRUCTION OF THIS HIVE CLUSTER WILL ASSURE OUR FINAL VICTORY, BUT THERE ARE SEVERAL OBSTACLES IN OUR WAY.>
dst: <摧毁这一蜂巢群，即可确保我们的最终胜利，但前路尚有数道障碍。>

src: <FOR THE FIRST TIME, WE REACH THE BOUNDARY OF THE GREAT WATER.  BUT THIS IS NO REAL BOUNDARY.  A THOUSAND QUEENS AWAIT THEIR MAIDEN FLIGHT.>
dst: <我们首次抵达大水域的边界。但这并非真正的边界。千百个蚁后正等待它们处女航。>

src: <Good, now that I have you and your men here, we can carry out the last part of your mission.>
dst: <很好，现在你和你的人都在这里了，我们可以执行你任务的最后一部分。>

src: <I am Pegasus, tool of the divine, parter of the heavens.  Free at last.  Free at last.>
dst: <我是珀伽索斯，神明的工具，天界的开拓者。终于自由了。终于自由了。>

src: <I am coordinating the larger and more significant task of destroying the apes in blue uniforms but even I cannot do everything at once in my damaged state.  You must take the minority of troops that have scattered near the other group of apes and shatter their command structure so that I have time to repair the machine and depart.  I don't want to be stuck with these idiots any more than you do.>
dst: <我正在统筹那项更重大、更紧要的任务——消灭穿蓝制服的猿猴，但即便是我，在受损状态下也无法同时兼顾一切。你必须带着散落在另一群猿猴附近的那支少数部队，击碎他们的指挥结构，好让我有时间修好机器并离开。我和你一样，不想跟这些白痴困在一起。>

src: <I have completely repaired the Transporter and it is time to depart.  Say goodbye and good riddance to your ugly past.>
dst: <我已把传送器完全修好，该出发了。跟你不堪的过去道个别，滚得越远越好。>

src: <If you want to live you will follow my orders.>

<Let me break down to you the reality of your situation.  You have been catapulted roughly one hundred years into the past as a result of your primitive rock slinging.  I am a synthetic intelligence that is bonded with the transporter you handled so imprecisely with your greasy-ape hands.  I am the key to your escape and your salvation.>
dst: <让我向你剖析一下你处境的现实。由于你们那原始的投石之举，你被猛地抛回了大约一百年前。我是一个合成智能，与你那双油腻的猿手如此笨拙地摆弄过的传送器绑缚在一起。我是你逃脱与获救的关键。>

src: <PROTECT THE QUEEN MOTHER.  PROTECT THE LIFE GIVER.  ANNIHILATE EVERY LAST TRACE THAT THE BIPED CREATURES WERE EVER HERE.>
dst: <保护蚁后母。保护生命给予者。将双足生物曾经存在过的一切痕迹彻底抹除。>

src: <THE BITTER COLD ALSO WEAKENS THE WARRIORS THAT REMAIN UNDER OUR COMMAND IN THE IMMEDIATE AREA.  IF ACTION IS NOT TAKEN QUICKLY, UNIT COHESIVENESS WILL QUICKLY COLLAPSE TO WEATHER CONDITIONS.>
dst: <严寒也削弱了我们目前在该区域指挥下的战士。若不迅速行动，部队的凝聚力将因天气而迅速崩溃。>

src: <THE LAST BASTION OF BIPED RESISTANEC HAS BEEN ELIMINATED.>
dst: <双足抵抗的最后一处堡垒已被肃清。>

src: <THE PESTILENCE HAS NEARLY BEEN WIPED OFF OF OUR WORLD.   BUT THE TWO STRONGEST SPECIES HAVE PUT THEIR DIFFERENCES ASIDE AND HAVE GATHERED IN THE COLD WASTELAND OF THE NORTH, WHERE THEY EVEN NOW WORK WITH THEIR PECULIAR ADAPTABILITY ON A WAY TO STOP US.>
dst: <瘟疫几乎已从我们的世界被抹除。但两个最强物种已搁置分歧，集结于北方酷寒的荒原——此刻它们正凭借其奇特的适应力，设法阻止我们。>

src: <THE PESTILENCE IS LIMITED TO TRAVEL ALONG CERTAIN MAJOR ARTERIALS.  CONTROL OF THESE ARTERIALS WILL PREVENT THE REINFORCEMENT OF THEIR HIVE FROM ELSEWHERE.>
dst: <瘟疫的行军局限于特定的主要通道。控制这些通道，就能阻止它们从别处增援蜂巢。>

src: <THE PESTILENCE WILL SOON BE BUT A DISTANT MEMORY.  WE CRAWL ENDLESSLY ACROSS THE PLAINS OF THE EARTH.  OUR EARTH.>
dst: <瘟疫不久将只余遥远的记忆。我们无休无止地爬行在大地平原上。我们的大地。>

src: <THEIR YOUNG PROVIDE US SUSTENANCE.  WE EXPAND.  WE GROW.  WE THRIVE.>
dst: <它们的幼体供给我们养分。我们扩张。我们成长。我们繁盛。>

src: <The apes here would pose no threat to me, nor even you, were it not for the fact that the Temporal Transporter is critically damaged.  I can repair it easily, but this will take some time, and we are currently positioned between two hostile armies of overwhelming size, if inferior quality.>
dst: <这里的猿猴本不会对我、甚至对你构成威胁，只是因为这台时空传送器受了致命损伤。我能轻易修好它，但这需要一些时间，而我们目前正处在大得压倒性、质量却低劣的两支敌对军队之间。>

src: <The power's flowing back to me.  I am, we are close to our escape.  Report back to the Transporter and we will plot the final step.>
dst: <电力正回流到我这里。我，我们即将逃脱。回到传送器报到，我们将谋划最后一步。>

src: <WE HAVE CLAIMED THIS REGION AS OUR OWN.  WE WILL BEGIN SETTLEMENT HERE IMMEDIATELY.>
dst: <我们已将这片区域据为己有。我们将立即在此建立据点。>

src: <Well done.  It must have been extremely difficult for you to quash an army of muskets and swords with 105mm smoothbore cannons and fully automatic machine-guns.>
dst: <干得好。用 105 毫米滑膛炮和全自动机枪去碾碎一支只有滑膛枪和刀剑的军队，对你来说想必极其艰难。>

src: <You must make do with the raw materials you have at this time, though I am working on a solution.  Your minions have been scattered to the edge of the area and must be reunited.>
dst: <你必须将就着用你现在手头的原材料，不过我正设法解决。你的手下已被打散到这片区域的边缘，必须重新集结。>

src: <Your primitive ape form amuses me.  Does it amuse you?>
dst: <你们原始猿猴的形态让我觉得有趣。你觉得有趣吗？>

src: A  good performance, to be sure. The Bolshevik armies are cut off without hope of relief.  And, even now,  communication between Moscow and Leningrad has been severed.  Leningrad should now fall easily; Moscow will be more problematic.
dst: 确实是不错的表现。布尔什维克军队已被切断，毫无解围希望。而且，即便此刻，莫斯科与列宁格勒之间的交通已被切断。列宁格勒如今应可轻易拿下；莫斯科会更棘手些。

dst: 一辆英国 M4 谢尔曼坦克与一头大象聚在一起。

src: A British reporter, embedded in a unit of the Kavkaz Army, has prepared the text of his report for your review:  "The road to the West was open to the Turks, and those who could escape fled along it, quickly pursued by the Russian cavalry. The first report that reached Europe was that 100,000 men and 1,000 guns had been captured. This was an exaggeration. According to the official statement, the Russians captured 235 officers and 12,753 uninjured men, besides sick and wounded; 323 guns, nine standards, a vast supply of stores, and a very considerable quantity of ammunition."
dst: 一名随高加索集团军某部队采访的英国记者，已草拟好他的报道请您过目：「通往西方的道路向土耳其人敞开，能够逃脱的人沿路逃窜，很快被俄国骑兵追击。传到欧洲的第一份报道称有10万人和1000门火炮被俘。这有所夸大。据官方声明，俄军俘虏了235名军官和12753名未受伤者，另有病员和伤员；缴获323门火炮、9面军旗、大量物资储备和数量相当可观的弹药。」

src: A Frau-Z dashing behind the lines on a Recon flight.Soviet aa firing from woods.Pilot Tikka Grenfield "What the Hell".A few pings off the fuselage of Junkers dominant Warbird.A circle made to come back and check the area.Tons of armor spotted in the woods with more aa cutting loose."Better get My Ass out of here,Hey Ivan"? At Lenningrad Airfield 9 the Frau-Z touching down then the landing gear giving way.The plane sliding across the runway turning into a fireball.The Plane almost to a stop and Tikka jumps out rolling away from the burning bird,get's up to Her feet and casually strolls by the Fire units and ambulance.The sight of the armor is reported,the message sent to Frau General Pedderson.Berlin is contacted."Yes this is the Fuhress.I see General.I know they seem to have an endless supply.Yes sure the Girls there have had their fill.I'll see who I can move to aid.It has to stop sometime Pedderson. When it does I imagine Your Panzers will be able to roll up the area.Yes I know,Good Luck". General Pedderson met with Her Panzer Commanders breaking the news.She could see the looks on their faces knowing they seemed to be taking the Burden of the whole Soviet Army."It has to break sometime" She told them."Sure" PZ commander Stowe said, "When they roll into Berlin".
dst: 一架“Frau-Z”在敌后执行侦察飞行。苏军高射炮从树林里开火。飞行员蒂卡·格伦菲尔德：“他妈的。”几发弹片擦过这架容克王牌战机的机身。她绕了一圈回来查看该地区。树林里发现成吨的装甲，还有更多高射炮开火。“我还是赶紧撤吧，伊万？”在列宁格勒9号机场，“Frau-Z”触地时起落架折断。飞机滑过跑道，变成一团火球。飞机快停下时，蒂卡跳出机舱、翻滚着离开燃烧的飞机，站起身，若无其事地从消防车和救护车旁走过。装甲部队的行踪被报告上去，讯息发给了佩德森女将军。柏林也接到了联络。“是，我是女元首。我明白了，将军。我知道他们似乎有源源不断的补充。是啊，当然，那边的姑娘们已经受够了。我看看能调谁去支援。总得停下来，佩德森。等它停下来，我想你的装甲部队就能横扫那一带了。是的，我知道。祝好运。”佩德森将军召见她的装甲指挥官们通报这个消息。她看得出他们脸上的神色——他们像是背负着整个苏军的重担。“总会有崩断的时候。”她对他们说。“当然。”装甲指挥官斯托说，“等他们开进柏林的时候。”

src: A German attack through the Ardennes forest, while initially achieving some success against the thinly held American lines, has now effectively been halted.  The Germans have outrun their supply lines, and are thus experiencing huge shortages of fuel, ammunition and other vital supplies.  It is at this juncture that we will go onto the attack.  You will cross the bridge at Dinant and assist the U.S. 2nd Armoured Division in reducing the German bulge.
dst: 德军穿过阿登森林的进攻，起初在美军单薄的防线上取得了一些战果，如今已被有效遏止。德军已超出其补给线，正面临燃料、弹药和其他关键物资的严重短缺。正是在此关头，我们要转入进攻。你将渡过迪南的桥梁，协助美军第2装甲师削平德军的突出部。

src: A German observation balloon is directing deadly artillery fire on our lines. Luckily, we found adjutant Willy Coppens with his Hanriot plane willing to attempt to shoot it down. I have a feeling that this won't be the last balloon that will be added to this young man's list of aerial victories.
dst: 一个德军观测气球正引导致命的炮火轰击我们的阵地。幸运的是，我们找到了副官威利·科彭斯，他愿意驾驶他的昂里奥飞机尝试把它打下来。我有种预感，这不会是最后一个被记入这位年轻人空战胜利清单的气球。

Now they are advancing toward Debrecen and Nyíregyháza and try to cut off completely the 8th German and 2nd Hungarian Armies. Bolsheviks don't expect any serious counterattack and left their flanks relatively lightly defended. General Fretter-Pico ordered the German 1st and 13th Panzer Division to encircle advancing Red troops. Go and help them, General!
dst: 9月，伊萨·普利耶夫指挥的一支苏军机械化集群击败了尚未经战阵的匈牙利第3集团军。如今他们正朝德布勒森和尼赖吉哈佐推进，力图彻底切断德国第8集团军和匈牙利第2集团军。布尔什维克料不到会有任何像样的反击，因而两翼防守相对薄弱。弗雷特-皮科将军已命令德国第1和第13装甲师合围推进中的红军部队。去支援他们吧，将军！

src: A barely acceptable performance, Herr General.  Only the brilliant maneuvers of Fieldmarschall Rommel saved the situation.  He will now continue with the conquest of Egypt and the Suez Kanal. You and your men are to be transferred back to the Russian front, where things have not gone well. Fieldmarschall Paulus has been unable to break out of Stalingrad.  Worse, intelligence indicates that the Bolsheviks are planning a great offensive in the Kursk region.  The General Staff hopes that your failure at El Alamein was but a temporary departure from your previous excellent conduct and thus is giving you one more chance to prove yourself.
dst: 勉强可以接受的表现，将军阁下。全靠隆美尔元帅的卓越机动才挽回了局势。他将继续征服埃及和苏伊士运河。您和您的部下将被调回俄国前线，那里的情况不太顺利。保卢斯元帅未能从斯大林格勒突围。更糟的是，情报显示布尔什维克正计划在库尔斯克地区发动一场大规模攻势。总参谋部希望您在阿拉曼的失利只是暂时偏离了您以往出色的表现，因此再给您一次证明自己的机会。

src: A battle-hardened German soldier in Stalingrad, 27 November 1942.
dst: 斯大林格勒一名久经沙场的德国士兵，1942年11月27日。

src: A beached French coastal patrol craft at low tide at Dunkirk.
dst: 低潮时搁浅在敦刻尔克的一艘法国海岸巡逻艇。

src: A big thank you to Dragdasan for the magnificant map that he made for this scenario.
dst: 特别感谢 Dragdasan 为本场景制作的精美地图。

src: A big thanks also goes to jccalvin who provides scans of eastern front situation maps and allowed me to use map sections for scenario intros. Visit jccalvin's blog: https://wwii-microfilm.blogspot.com/
dst: 还要衷心感谢 jccalvin，他提供了东线态势图的扫描件，并允许我将地图片段用于场景简介。欢迎访问 jccalvin 的博客：https://wwii-microfilm.blogspot.com/

src: A bold and aggressive attack by our air forces followed by a sweep by our ground forces should capture the island in a matter of days.
dst: 以我方空军大胆而猛烈的进攻为先导，随后地面部队扫荡，应能在数日内攻占该岛。

src: A brilliant maneuver. This victory will allow us to gain some time. Unfortunately for us, Romania and the Ottoman Empire are going to side with Greece and Serbia, so our situation is starting to become desperate.
dst: 一次漂亮的机动。这场胜利将为我们争取到一些时间。对我们不幸的是，罗马尼亚和奥斯曼帝国将站在希腊和塞尔维亚一边，因此我们的处境开始变得绝望。

src: A brilliant maneuver. You have nearly destroyed an entire Serbian division. But I'm afraid that I have bad news for you. The Greeks have routed our Second Army at Kukush, south of here, and Serbian reinforcements are coming from the north. You must retreat to your original lines, or you will be the one in danger of being outflanked.
dst: 一次漂亮的机动。您几乎全歼了一个塞尔维亚师。但恐怕我有坏消息要告诉您。希腊人在南边的库库什击溃了我们的第2集团军，而塞尔维亚援军正从北面赶来。您必须撤回原来的战线，否则被迂回包抄的危险就将落到您头上。

src: A brilliant victory will give you the opportunity to end the war in the early 1942 by encircling the Heeresgruppe Mitte at Krasny Bor.
dst: 辉煌胜利将让你有机会在1942年初通过围歼克拉斯内博尔附近的中部集团军群，提前结束战争。

src: A brilliant victory, a normal victory and a tactical victory will lead to different scenarios. There will be no choice scenario. You should make a save game, if you want to play all scenarios.
dst: 辉煌胜利、普通胜利与战术胜利将导向不同的场景。本战役没有选择场景。如果你想体验所有场景，应当保存一个存档。

src: A brilliant victory, a normal victory and a tactical victory will lead you into different paths.
dst: 辉煌胜利、普通胜利与战术胜利将把你引向不同的路线。

src: A campaign tracing the military career, (1939-45), of arguably one of the most towering military figures to emerge from WW2, and  also one of the Soviet Union's greatest generals; Georgi K. Zhukov. 2 paths, longest path is 14 scenarios. Enjoy :)
dst: 一场战役，追踪格奥尔基·K·朱可夫的军旅生涯（1939—1945）——他堪称二战中最巍峨的军事人物之一，也是苏联最伟大的将领之一。两条路线，最长的一条为14个场景。祝玩得开心 :)

src: A captured machine gun unit has been added to your core.
dst: 一个缴获的机枪单位已加入您的核心部队。

src: A catastrophe has happened near the Don River! The Bosheviks are attacking everywhere!
dst: 顿河一带发生了灾难！布尔什维克正在四处进攻！

src: A cavalry unit will speed up the chase. Our supply lines are long, so prestige will be given only if the outcome will not be brilliant.
dst: 一支骑兵部队将加快追击速度。我们的补给线很长，所以只有在战果不理想时才会给予声望。

src: A chain of unfortunate incidents with the Soviets along the Chinese - Soviet border has opened the way for the outbreak of full scale military operations.  As you know, the relationship with our former Soviet allies has badly deteriorated.  Moscow doesn't like our own interpretation of Marxism and wants to take us back to the ''correct'' communist system.  To punish us, they have launched an invasion across the Amur River, the natural border between the PRC and the USSR.  They have captured a many square kilometers of Chinese territory, including some villages.
dst: 中苏边境沿线一连串不幸事件，为全面军事行动的爆发打开了道路。如你所知，我们与从前的苏联盟友的关系已严重恶化。莫斯科不喜欢我们对马克思主义自己的解释，想让我们回到"正确"的共产主义制度。为了惩罚我们，他们越过黑龙江——中华人民共和国与苏联之间的天然边界——发动了入侵。他们已夺取了许多平方公里的中国领土，包括一些村庄。

src: A classic strategie would be to march on slowly with your heavy Infantery backed by archers. Secure your flanks by cavalry and Lilia fields .... fight enemy spies with your spies and scouts ...
dst: 一种经典的战术是：让你的重装步兵在弓箭手支援下缓慢推进。用骑兵与百合场护住两翼 .... 用你的间谍和斥候去对付敌方间谍 ...

src: A commom Housewife or SS Frau?
dst: 普通家庭主妇，还是党卫军“女士”？

src: A communist force is about to land along the east coast of Mallorca. Our local forces are outnumbered! Try to hold as many objectives as possible until our forces from the west of the island arrive in the battle zone. Take care, powerful enemy battleships have been reported in the area!
dst: 一支共产军正要在马略卡岛东海岸登陆。我方当地兵力处于劣势！请尽可能多地守住目标，直到我岛西部部队抵达战区。小心，据报该海域有敌方强大战列舰出没！

src: A communist force is about to land along the east coast of Mallorca. Our local forces are outnumbered! Try to hold as many objectives as possible until you forces from the west of the island arrive in the battle zone. Take care, powerful enemy battleships have been reported in the waters off Mallorca!
dst: 一支共产主义部队即将在马略卡岛东海岸登陆。我方当地兵力处于劣势！请尽可能守住更多目标点，直到来自岛屿西部的部队抵达战区。当心，有报告称马略卡岛近海出现了强大的敌方战列舰！

src: A complete failure! To our south, US divisions moving north have relieved the surrounded
dst: 彻底失败！在我们以南，北上的美军各师已给被围的

src: A complete failure. You lost Kharkov and Russian advances North and South of the city force us to retreat to the Dnepr. Most of your forces are sent to France for rest and refit. Only a Kampfgruppe will remain on the Eastern front until the spring of 1944.
dst: 彻底失败。你丢掉了哈尔科夫，俄军在该城南北两侧的推进迫使我们退往第聂伯河。你的大部分部队被派往法国休整和重新装备。只有一个战斗群会留在东线直到1944年春天。

src: A costly victory Herr General. Continue your advance towards Moscow.
dst: 一场代价高昂的胜利，将军阁下。继续向莫斯科推进。

src: A crushing Soviet offensive destroyed the whole Armeegruppe Mitte and now's perhaps will roll over us...
dst: 一场摧枯拉朽的苏军攻势摧毁了整个中央集团军群，如今或许将碾压我们……

src: A decisive victory here will be the end of the rebel's menacing threat to Madrid, at least for the moment.
dst: 这里的一场决定性胜利将终结叛军对马德里的威胁，至少目前如此。

src: A destroyer and a Schnellboot will join your core navy. Be careful, these ships with a base strength of 12 can not be replaced in case they get sunk!
dst: 一艘驱逐舰和一艘快艇将加入你的核心海军。请注意，这些基础强度为12的舰艇一旦被击沉便无法补充！

src: A direct attack seems to be suicide but maybe we should remember Franz Sigel's favorite tactic and send the Cavalry far away to one of the flanks!
dst: 正面进攻无异于自杀，但也许我们应该记起弗朗茨·西格尔的拿手战术，把骑兵远远派往某一侧翼！

src: A division size force consisting of:
dst: 一个师级规模的部队，编成如下：

src: A experience trigger can be found somewhere on the map!
dst: 地图上某处可以找到一处经验触发点！

src: A few days after the battle against the  Russian Navy, some British warships shelled the Ottoman Forts in the Dardanelles, without even a declaration of war. Then they announced that Misir (Egypt) was a part of their Empire. The Ottoman Army had no choice but to respond, and sent an expedition to cross the Suez Canal and liberate Misir.
dst: 与俄国海军交战几天后，一些英国军舰甚至未宣战就炮击了达达尼尔海峡的奥斯曼要塞。随后他们宣布埃及是其帝国的一部分。奥斯曼军队别无选择，只能作出回应，于是派出一支远征军去横渡苏伊士运河、解放埃及。

src: A few days ago, a division-strong enemy force crossing the Sinai desert has been spotted by a French hydroplane. Obviously, the Turks are planning a major assault on the Suez Canal.
dst: 几天前，一架法国水上飞机发现了一支师级规模的敌军部队正穿越西奈沙漠。显然，土耳其人正在策划对苏伊士运河的大规模进攻。

src: A few days later my Colonel ordered me to meet him at his tent. He was impressed by my performance against the enemy, and that he knew that I had repeatedly asked for my transfer to the Grenadier Guards. He told me that, although he regretted losing such a promising young officer, he knew that I would have a brighter destiny in that unit, so he would recommend my transfer as a reward for my behaviour in battle.
dst: 几天后，我的上校命我到他的帐篷里会面。他对我迎敌的表现印象深刻，也知道我曾多次申请调往掷弹兵近卫团。他告诉我，虽然他为失去这样一位前途无量的年轻军官感到惋惜，但他知道我在那支部队会有更光明的前途，因此他将推荐我调任，作为对我战斗表现的奖赏。

src: A few days later we received excellent news from southern Russia. Denikin's forces had finally been able to advance into the lower Volga, and had taken Tsaritsyn. That meant that our two armies were separated by less than 150 Russian miles. If we managed to liberate Samara and Saratov, the two main clusters of anti-Bolshevik resistance would finally be united. Kolchak knew the importance of that goal, so he ordered us to plan a summer offensive against Samara.
dst: 几天后，我们从俄国南部收到了极好的消息。邓尼金的部队终于得以推进到伏尔加河下游，并夺取了察里津。这意味着我们两支军队之间相隔已不到150俄里。如果我们能解放萨马拉和萨拉托夫，两大反布尔什维克抵抗力量的核心就终于能合为一体。高尔察克深知这一目标的重要性，于是他命令我们筹划一场针对萨马拉的夏季攻势。

src: A few months later a conflict erupted in Tonkin between France and China. The French had tried for some time to stablish a protectorate over that region, which traditionally had been a tributary of China. The growing tension led to a full scale war, so in September of 1884 my patron entered Tonkin and sent his militias to the Luc Nam valley where, along with some Black Flag mercenaries, he would try to stop the French advance towards Lang Son. It was a difficult task, since our troops were far from ready and the French units were better trained and equipped. Numerical superiority was our only advantage, but I doubted that it would be enough.
dst: 几个月后，法国与中国之间在北圻爆发了冲突。法国人一段时间以来一直试图在该地区建立保护国，而该地区历来是中国的藩属。日益加剧的紧张局势演变成了一场全面战争，于是1884年9月，我的东家进入北圻，把他的团练派往陆南河谷，与一些黑旗军雇佣兵一起，试图阻止法军向谅山推进。这是一项艰巨的任务，因为我们的部队远未做好准备，而法军训练更佳、装备更好。兵力优势是我们唯一的优势，但我怀疑这还远远不够。

src: A few weeks later I was promoted to captain. Upon my return to England I could finally ask Colonel Worthington for the hand of Evelyn, and we married in Norwich on May 13th, 1883. She was determined to accompany me to Egypt when I rejoined my regiment and, knowing that nothing that I could say would make her change her mind, I didn't make any objections. Ten months after our wedding, Michael, our first son, was born in Alexandria. I was happier than ever before in my life, but at the same time the news about the Dervish rebellion in Sudan grew increasingly worrysome.
dst: 几周后，我晋升为上尉。回到英国后，我终于得以向沃辛顿上校请求娶他的女儿伊芙琳，我们于1883年5月13日在诺里奇成婚。当我重新归队时，她执意要随我前往埃及，而我知道无论我说什么都无法改变她的主意，也就没有提出异议。婚后十个月，我们的第一个儿子迈克尔在亚历山大出生。我一生中从未如此幸福，但与此同时，关于苏丹德尔维希人叛乱的消息却日益令人担忧。

src: A fine piece of Generalship if you don't mind me saying, sir.  With the port captured, we have essentially nullified the threat posed by the Japanese Navy.  Now, we must press onwards to take the rest of the island.
dst: 这是一次漂亮的用兵，长官。港口既已夺取，我们实质上就化解了日本海军的威胁。现在，我们必须继续推进，夺取该岛其余部分。

src: A fine victory, General. The Russians won't dare to threaten our sector for a long time. The winter will be cold, but at least it will be calm, too.
dst: 漂亮的胜利，将军。俄国人在很长时间内都不敢再来威胁我们的防区了。这个冬天会很冷，但至少也会很平静。

src: A free SPAT will be added to your core army.
dst: 一支免费的 SPAT 将加入你的核心部队。

src: A free paratrooper unit with a base strength of 12 is added to your core.
dst: 一支基础兵力为 12 的免费伞兵部队加入您的核心部队。

src: A french ad hoc formation with the size of an infantry division will arrive near Strasbourg soon.
dst: 一支规模相当于一个步兵师的法国临时编队即将抵达斯特拉斯堡附近。

src: A german fleet will arrive soon! Caution, the enemy has some powerful ships anchored in the ports of Gibraltar. Keep your precious units out of range of the enemy battleships until it is save.
dst: 一支德国舰队很快将抵达！小心，敌人有一些强大的军舰停泊在直布罗陀的港口中。在安全之前，让你宝贵的单位保持在敌方战列舰射程之外。

src: A glorious victory, Herr Feldmarschall!  The Bolsheviks have surrendered unconditionally!  We will require the independence of Bylorussia and the Ukraine under German protection, which will stabilize our Eastern borders.  We are about to sign a peace treaty with the English and Americans which will involve our withdrawal from England and France (we keep Alsace-Lorraine).  Now we will have the peace necessary to develop the Fatherland to its full potential.
dst: 一场辉煌的胜利，元帅阁下！布尔什维克已无条件投降！我们将要求白俄罗斯和乌克兰在德国保护下独立，这将稳定我们的东部边界。我们即将与英国人和美国人签署和约，条约将涉及我们从英国和法国撤出（我们保留阿尔萨斯-洛林）。现在我们将获得必要的和平，以充分发挥祖国的潜力。

src: A glorious victory, Herr General! Stalingrad is ours and the Bolsheviks have been driven out if the city. They are dazed and reeling from the blows you and your brave men have delivered. The vital railroad between Astrachan and Moscow has been cut.  You now must continue our offensive into the Caucasus.
dst: 光荣的胜利，将军阁下！斯大林格勒属于我们，布尔什维克已被逐出该城。他们被您和您勇敢的部下所给予的打击打得晕头转向、踉跄后退。阿斯特拉罕与莫斯科之间的重要铁路已被切断。您现在必须继续向高加索进攻。

src: A good general tries to get a complete view of the battlefield!...for this you have scouts and spies...by the way, spies can be transported and refreshed in large battleships...
dst: 好统帅会设法把整个战场尽收眼底！……为此你有斥候和间谍……顺带说，间谍可以搭乘大型战舰运输与补充……

src: A good performance Herr General .  The capture of Savannah will be remembered as a great German victory....
dst: 表现不俗，将军阁下。夺取萨凡纳将被铭记为德国的一场伟大胜利……

src: A good piece of Generalship if you don't mind me saying, sir.  With the port captured, we have essentially nullified the threat posed by the Japanese Navy.  Now, we must press onwards to take the rest of the island.
dst: 这是一次不错的用兵，长官。港口既已夺取，我们实质上就化解了日本海军的威胁。现在，我们必须继续推进，夺取该岛其余部分。

src: A great victory! Turkish forces were no match for our infantry divisions. Now we must advance deeper into Thrace. The town of Lule Burgas is our next objective.
dst: 一场大胜！土耳其军队根本不是我们步兵师的对手。现在我们必须向色雷斯纵深推进。卢莱布尔加斯镇是我们的下一个目标。
一场艰苦的战斗，将军阁下！

src: A healer unit will support you and there is also an AT unit that guards our backs.
dst: 一支医疗部队会支援你，还有一支反坦克部队为我们守后路。

src: A healer units that heals 3 sp will assist you
dst: 一个可治疗3点兵力的医疗单位将协助你

src: A healer units that heals 3 sp will assist you.
dst: 一个能治疗3点生命值的医疗单位将协助你。

src: A historical campaign tracing Finland's involvement through 2 wars with the Soviet Union, and a war with Germany. 12 scenarios long, a linear path, and lots of fun! Happy Blasting!
dst: 一场史实战役，追溯芬兰在与苏联的两次战争以及与德国的一场战争中的经历。共12个场景，单线推进，乐趣无穷！祝炸得开心！

src: A horrible massacre... this time the high command has decided to avoid your sepukku, since your services have been requested from Tokyo...
dst: 一场惨烈的屠杀……这一次高层决定免您切腹，因为东京方面已要求调用您的部队……

src: A hospital ship will join your core! This healer unit can heal 4 strength points/turn. Be careful, this unit can not be replaced when it gets destroyed.
dst: 一艘医院船将加入您的核心部队！这支部队每回合可治疗 4 点兵力。请注意，该部队被摧毁后无法补充。

src: A immense pocket is closed - to the trapped enemy troops will remain only the surrender. But we leave the elimination of the pocket to our infantry. Advance west of the Appalachian Mountains further north on Knoxville!
dst: 一个巨大的包围圈已经合拢——被困的敌军唯有投降一途。不过，清剿包围圈的任务我们交给步兵。从阿巴拉契亚山脉以西继续向北推进，直取诺克斯维尔！

src: A knocked out German Panzer II in Libya, circa 1941.
dst: 利比亚一辆被击毁的德国二号坦克，约1941年。

src: A large part of the 2nd Brigade reached the Ukrainian positions. Some were captured and judged by KuK court martial but eventually paroled by the Kaiser Karl. Those who reached the Ukrianian lines fought for the Polish cause all around the world.
dst: 第2旅的大部分人抵达了乌克兰阵地。一些人被俘，受到奥匈帝国军事法庭审判，但最终被卡尔皇帝赦免释放。那些抵达乌克兰防线的人，在世界各地为波兰的事业而战。

src: A little help for the AI

A lot of armoured units have been spotted in our forward positions. Surely, the enemy is trying to stop our assault on Tobruk, which is completely besiged now. Unfortunately we must halt the attack on Tobruk, to stop the British attack!. On the other hand, beware the enemy units from Tobruk, if you don't take care, they will be able to attack us from behind.
dst: 我军前沿阵地发现大量装甲部队。敌人肯定是在设法阻止我们对托布鲁克的进攻，而托布鲁克现在已被彻底包围。遗憾的是，我们必须停止对托布鲁克的攻击，以阻止英军的进攻！另一方面，要提防托布鲁克的敌军部队，一不留神，他们就会从背后袭击我们。

src: A magnificent but costly victory Herr General. Continue your advance towards Moscow.
dst: 一场辉煌但代价高昂的胜利，将军阁下。继续向莫斯科推进。

src: A major battle is imminent - your troops facing one of the ultimate objectives of the Eastern campaign! 4-5 Soviet divisions are encircled in Baku, Russia's oilfield, the largest city on the Caspian Sea and of the Caucasus region, and expect our attack. Unfortunately most oil production facilities have been destroyed by the Russians and the rebuild will take a long time, but primarily the supply of the enemy war industry with oil comes to stop. 70-80% of the Soviet demand was covered by Baku and is no longer available now. A blow that hopefully will be crucial for the further course of the war.
dst: 一场大战迫在眉睫——你的部队面对着东线战役的终极目标之一！4到5个苏军师被围困在巴库，这里是俄国的油田、里海和高加索地区最大的城市，正等着我们的进攻。遗憾的是，大部分石油生产设施已被俄国人破坏，重建将需很长时间，但首要的是，敌人战争工业的石油供应就此中断。苏联需求的70-80%由巴库提供，如今已不再可得。这一击，但愿将对战争的后续进程起到决定性作用。

src: A major problem was the rough terrain, but you have established excellent positions near the Nalon river.  The Reds quarters at both Simancas and Zapadores have fallen and we are now at the gates of Oviedo.  We must press on to save our brave fellows from the Red onslaught and show the world that we are not going to surrender without a fight.
dst: 崎岖地形曾是个大问题，但您已在纳隆河附近建立了极佳的阵地。赤色分子在锡曼卡斯和萨帕多雷斯的营地均已陷落，我们现在已兵临奥维耶多城下。我们必须继续推进，把勇敢的弟兄们从赤色分子的猛攻中解救出来，并向世界表明我们不会不战而降。

src: A masterful performance. The Chinese are fleeing Tonkin, running for their lives, and leaving their best equipment behind. They might recover their courage once they cross the border, but it doesn't really matter. One way or another, Tonkin will become a French protectorate, just like Annam, and it'll join our other territories in Indochina.
dst: 一场大师级的表现。中国人正逃离东京，仓皇逃命，把他们最好的装备都丢弃了。他们越过边境后或许会重拾勇气，但那已无关紧要。无论如何，东京都将像安南一样成为法国的保护国，并入我们在印度支那的其他领地。

src: A mobile auxiliary field hospital will assist you in this scenario.
dst: 本场景中一支机动辅助野战医院将协助你。

src: A month ago we broke through fascist lines at the Perekop peninsula, the sole connection of the Crimean peninsula with the Ukrainian mainland. The enemy has retreated from all over the Crimea to Sevastopol which has been turned into a fortress once again. And this time we will be attacker - and we will gain victory!
dst: 一个月前，我们在佩列科普半岛——克里米亚半岛与乌克兰大陆的唯一连接处——突破了法西斯的战线。敌人已从克里米亚各地撤往塞瓦斯托波尔，那里再次被改造成一座要塞。而这一次，我们将是进攻方——我们将赢得胜利！

src: A most valiant effort Herr General! We must now retreat to the Mius river, it is the right course of action considering the overall situation.....
dst: 无比英勇的奋战，将军阁下！我们现在必须退守米乌斯河，就整体局势而言这是正确的抉择.....

src: A never-ending supply of Soviet equipment is exhausting our limited resources.
dst: 源源不断的苏联装备正耗尽我们有限的资源。

src: A new assignment is waiting for you.

A new chlorine gas attack will be released on the Canadian First Division on your left flank to remove the threat on your advancing troops. Your tasks are to consolidate the gains made the last two days and to support the attack of 2.Reserve Ersatz Brigade, 38.Ldw. Brigade and Brigade Schmieden (a composite brigade of 53.Reserve Division batallions) on the Canadians.
dst: 您左翼的加拿大第1师将遭受一次新的氯气攻击，以消除对您推进中部队的威胁。您的任务是巩固过去两天取得的战果，并支援第2预备补充旅、第38国土防卫旅和施米登旅（由第53预备师各营混编而成的旅）对加拿大人的进攻。

src: A new core Flak is attached to your army. Although the Germans do not have many bombers at this stage of the war, the Flak could still be useful in the future.
dst: 一支新的核心高射炮部队已配属给你的军队。尽管在战争的这一阶段德军轰炸机并不多，但高射炮在将来仍可能派上用场。

src: A new mission is waiting for you.
A new mission is waiting for you. Go to the canteen and let's hope you are able to cook "Hennepot".
dst: 新的任务正等着您。到食堂去吧，希望您能做好一锅“鸡肉砂锅”。

src: A new mission is waiting for you. Go to the canteen and let's hope you are able to cook a good "Carbonnade flamande".
dst: 新的任务正等着您。到食堂去吧，希望您能做好一道“弗拉芒啤酒炖牛肉”。

src: A new mission is waiting for you. Go to the canteen and let's hope you are able to cook a good "Filet américain".
dst: 新的任务在等着你。去食堂吧，但愿你能做出一份好吃的“Filet américain”。

dst: 新的任务正等着您。到食堂去吧，希望您能做好一道“焗菊苣”。

src: A new mission is waiting for you. Go to the canteen and let's hope you are able to cook a good "Lapin à la gueuze".
dst: 新的任务正等着您。到食堂去吧，希望您能做好一道“啤酒炖兔肉”。

dst: 新的任务在等着你。去食堂吧，但愿你能做出一份好吃的“Moules frites”。

src: A new mission is waiting for you. Go to the canteen and let's hope you are able to cook a good "Stoemp".
dst: 新的任务正等着您。到食堂去吧，希望您能做好一道“土豆泥”。

src: A new mission is waiting for you. Go to the canteen and let's hope you are able to cook a good "Waterzooi".
dst: 新的任务正等着您。到食堂去吧，希望您能做好一道“瓦特佐伊炖菜”。

src: A new source of tension emerged after 1868, when a liberal coup dethroned Queen Isabel II of Spain. The Spanish provisional government started to search for a new king among different European noble families, and one of the candidates was the Prussian prince Leopold von Hohenzollern. Napoleon III strongly opposed this, fearing a German-Spanish alliance that would isolate France, so Leopold's candidacy was finally retired.
dst: 1868年之后，出现了一个新的紧张源，当时一场自由派政变废黜了西班牙女王伊莎贝尔二世。西班牙临时政府开始在欧洲各贵族家族中物色新国王，候选人之一便是普鲁士亲王利奥波德·冯·霍亨索伦。拿破仑三世强烈反对此事，担心德西联盟会使法国陷入孤立，于是利奥波德的候选资格最终被撤回。

src: A nice but costly victory Herr General. Continue your advance towards Moscow.
dst: 一场漂亮但代价高昂的胜利，将军阁下。继续向莫斯科推进。

src: A nice day, isn't it? Finally, we have a great opportunity to expel the Spaniards from Cuba. Over the past 50 years, we tried to buy the island many times, but they always rejected our offers. The three hopeless wars against the Cuban independentists, the thousands of Spanish soldiers that have died, and all the money that they've spent don't seem to matter. Spain has refused to leave Cuba and let us be in charge.
dst: 天气不错，不是吗？我们终于有了一个把西班牙人赶出古巴的大好机会。过去50年里，我们多次试图买下这座岛屿，但他们总是拒绝我们的提议。对古巴独立派的三场无望之战、数千名阵亡的西班牙士兵，以及他们花掉的所有金钱，似乎都无关紧要。西班牙拒绝离开古巴，也不让我们接手。

src: A normal victory will lead you to the normal progression of the campaign.
dst: 普通胜利将让你沿战役的正常进程推进。

src: A notable victory indeed! With the Soviet Western Army in disarray, we'll advance further east to stronger positions. This winter we'll be safe from enemy attacks. There are chances that an independent Bialorus will rise!
dst: 这的确是一场了不起的胜利！苏俄西方集团军既已陷入混乱，我们将继续向东推进，占领更坚固的阵地。这个冬天我们将免受敌军进攻。独立的「白俄罗斯」有望崛起！

src: A number of Trigger Hexes on map (see listed below)
dst: 地图上设有若干触发格（详见下文）

src: A panoramic view of the city of Nijmegen, Holland, and the Nijmegen Bridge over the Waal (Rhine) River in the background, 09/28/1944.
dst: 1944年9月28日，荷兰奈梅亨城的全景，背景是横跨瓦尔河（莱茵河）的奈梅亨大桥。

src: A paratroopers battalion holds this airfield and the enemy tries to dislodge them for several days. We must not lose the airfield, as it is our last base for air operations in region. This village blocks the road towards the capital. You'll secure the village and when I say 'secure', I mean 'secure'; not a single English soldier gets behind this line!
dst: 一个伞兵营守着这座机场，敌军试图把他们赶走已经好几天了。我们不能丢掉机场，因为它是我们在该地区进行空中行动的最后基地。这座村庄挡住了通往首都的道路。你要确保这座村庄，我说“确保”，就是“确保”；一个英国兵都不能越过这条线！

src: A part of me can't help but pity the Socialist- Revolutionaries that stayed in Irkutsk. Their destiny was terrible. They didn't like us, but they soon learnt that the Bolsheviks were much worse than us.
dst: 我内心深处不禁同情那些留在伊尔库茨克的社会革命党人。他们的命运很悲惨。他们不喜欢我们，但他们很快就明白，布尔什维克比我们糟糕得多。

src: A pesar de la aplastante superioridad aérea y artillera de los rebeldes, ¿conseguirán las fuerzas gubernamentales lograr su objetivo, salvar Valencia y cambiar el rumbo de la guerra?
dst: 尽管叛军拥有压倒性的空中与炮兵优势，政府军能否实现其目标、拯救巴伦西亚并扭转战局？

src: A pesar de los esfuerzos realizados, las operaciones de los meses pasados no alcanzaron sus objetivos primarios, el frente Norte ha caido, y la ofensiva rebelde sobre el Levante se acerca cada vez mas a Valencia (capital de la Republica provisionalmente). Para ayudarse en su avance hacia el Mediterraneo, el enemigo cuenta con la estrategica posicion de Teruel, que capturo tiempo atras. Esta posicion constituye un enorme peligro para Levante, por lo que no podemos permitir que continue en manos rebeldes.
dst: 尽管我们付出了努力，过去几个月的行动仍未能达成其主要目标，北方战线已经陷落，而叛军对莱万特的攻势正日益逼近巴伦西亚（共和国临时首都）。为了协助其向地中海推进，敌人掌握着特鲁埃尔这一战略要地，那是他们先前夺取的。这个据点对莱万特构成巨大危险，因此我们不能容许它继续留在叛军手中。

src: A primeras horas nuestros asesores sovieticos (Rodimtsev y Goriev) nos han informado de una gran concentracion de tropas en la linea Brihuega-Torija, y que se oyen a lo lejos raras canciones italianas, lo que hace indicar que el nucleo de esas tropas es el CTV italiano que capturo Malaga en fechas pasadas.
dst: 清晨时分，我们的苏联顾问（罗季姆采夫和戈里耶夫）向我们通报，布里韦加—托里哈一线出现了大规模部队集结，远处还传来奇怪的意大利歌曲，这表明这些部队的核心正是前些日子攻占马拉加的意大利志愿军团。

src: A promotional success for you, that troops under your command could as first reach a goal of the A-A line. Well, reaching the Arkhangelsk-Astrakhan line was originally planned for the year '41, but it will still attract attention when your troops have taken Astrakhan. According to latest information, for the end of '42 as the strategic objective the meeting of the Japanese and German forces at the Yenisei River near the 70th meridian east is planned. Well, perhaps the general staff should first make sure that Moscow is taken!
dst: 这为你带来一次升迁的功绩：你麾下的部队得以率先达成“A-A 线”的目标。诚然，抵达阿尔汉格尔斯克-阿斯特拉罕一线原定于41年就应实现，但当你的部队拿下阿斯特拉罕时，仍会引起关注。据最新情报，作为42年底的战略目标，已计划让日军与德军在东经70度子午线附近的叶尼塞河会师。嗯，也许总参谋部首先该确保拿下莫斯科！

src: A quick strike back northward they Brits won´t expect....
dst: 英国人料想不到我们会迅速挥师北进……

src: A random player of average skill who does not know the campaign and plays it without a single reload may think that the campaign is easy or medium or hard to play.
dst: 一名不了解该战役、且全程不读档重来的普通水平随机玩家，可能会认为该战役玩起来是简单、中等或困难。

src: A relief column has been spotted moving to break our ring around Tobruk, and our Navy can only hope to keep the RN busy, we will not see any naval support.
dst: 已发现一支解围纵队正开进，试图打破我们对托布鲁克的包围圈，我们的海军只能指望牵制住皇家海军，我们不会得到任何海上支援。

src: A relief column of 500 infantrymen sent from Manila to reinforce General Peña was stopped at Zapote River after suffering heavy losses.
dst: 从马尼拉派来增援佩尼亚将军的一支500人步兵救援纵队在萨波特河被阻截，伤亡惨重。

src: A sailor on watch next to a quadruple anti-aircraft mounting of Vickers .5-inch machine gun, 1942.
dst: 一名水兵在四联装维克斯0.5英寸机枪防空枪架旁值更，1942年。

src: A satisfactory performance, Herr General. Kovel has been successfully evacuated. Now your division will move to Modlin, on the Vistula River line near Warsaw...
dst: 一次合格的表现，将军阁下。科韦利已成功撤离。现在你的师将移驻华沙附近维斯瓦河一线的莫德林……

src: A seabourne invasion was planned to
dst: 于是计划发动一次两栖登陆，

src: A series of battles in area of Rzhev were fought since the start of the year. While the initiative is mostly on the Soviet side, their every gain is followed by a fierce German counterattack.
dst: 自年初以来，勒热夫地区爆发了一连串战斗。主动权虽多半在苏军一方，但他们每得一寸，都会遭到德军的猛烈反击。

src: A serious mistake as it turned out - The Germans overran the normal battle array of the Romans ...
dst: 事实证明这是个严重错误——日耳曼人冲垮了罗马人惯常的战斗队形 ...

src: A small part of the Legion will take part in the action to put down this revolt. Support will come from Cossacks which are grazing in the countryside.
dst: 军团的一小部分将参与镇压这场叛乱的行动。支援将来自在乡间放牧的哥萨克。

src: A soldier from the New Zealand Division overlooking a group of German POW's during the Second Battle of El Alamein, November 1942.
dst: 第二次阿拉曼战役期间，一名新西兰师的士兵俯瞰一群德军战俘，1942年11月。

src: A special Typ 166 Schwimmwagen will assist you as healer (4 sp) and supply unit.
dst: 一辆特殊的 Typ 166 水陆两用车将作为医疗（4点兵力）和补给单位协助你。

src: A special healer unit with 4 sp per turn will assist you.
dst: 一支每回合治疗4点sp的特殊医疗单位将协助你。

src: A statement by French HQ.Winston all safe over there in England while the French just lost Pari and then while on the run got to look back and see the Effiel Tower coming down.So the French sent a message to Winston and got a reply.The Reply "Even though I know the situation is horrible there in Your Beloved France Parliment will not allow a mass of Spitfires for Your aid.I have been allowed to send some more Armor,Men and AA.I will do My utmost to convince them that it is in Our best interest to gain control over the Skies of France so they will allow Our fine fighter to be deployed there in great numbers.The Main objective of course is 'Liverpools Percy Wadsworth Harrlaman who has always been a pawn for the Oil Industry. With Our Convoys under attack in the Atlantic by the Germans and the Mediterranean by the Italians His point of stressing "We need Our Fuel to defend England not to have Pilots flying over French soil.We can help the French or Save Our island,We cannot do both" has My hands tied.It is impossible to get the votes to secure Spits for You at this time.I will work dilligently to correct the matter.All I need is 'Time".For the French 'Time was running out.
dst: 法军总部的一则声明。温斯顿在英格兰那边安然无恙，而法国人刚丢了巴黎，接着在逃亡途中还回头看见埃菲尔铁塔倒塌。于是法国人给温斯顿发去讯息，得到了回复。回复中说：“虽然我知道你们深爱的法国局势可怕，但议会不允许调大批‘喷火’来支援你们。我获准再送去一些装甲部队、人员和防空炮。我会竭尽全力说服他们：控制法国上空符合我们的最大利益，好让他们允许我们优秀的战斗机大批部署到那里。主要障碍当然是利物浦的珀西·沃兹沃思·哈拉曼，他一直充当石油业的走卒。我们的船队在大西洋遭德国人攻击、在地中海遭意大利人攻击，他那一套说辞——‘我们需要燃料保卫英格兰，而不是让飞行员在法国土地上飞行。我们要么帮法国人，要么保住我们的岛，两者不能兼得’——把我捆住了手脚。眼下不可能凑够票数为你争取到‘喷火’。我会勤勉地纠正此事。我只需‘时间’。”对法国人来说，时间正在耗尽。

src: A superb piece of Generalship if you don't mind me saying, sir.  With the port captured, we have essentially nullified the threat posed by the Japanese Navy.  Now, we must press onwards to take the rest of the island.
dst: 恕我直言，长官，这是一次堪称卓越的用兵。港口既已夺取，我们实质上就化解了日本海军的威胁。现在，我们必须继续推进，夺取该岛其余部分。

src: A thousand thanks to Luis, who made all this possible!
dst: 万分感谢 Luis，是他让这一切成为可能！

src: A unit of Arabian Legion Fallschirmjagers with a base strength of 12 will join your core!
dst: 一队基础战力为 12 的阿拉伯军团伞兵将加入你的核心部队！

src: A victory here would allow us further advances. If we are defeated here ... No, failure is too terrible to contemplate.
dst: 在此取胜将使我军得以继续推进。若我们在此战败……不，失败的后果太可怕，不敢去想。

src: A weakness in the British 7 Armored Division's signals security informed us of an enemy attack 9 hours ago. The British attack is performed by elements of the 4th Indian division and the rebuild 7th Armored Division. Our sea and air forces were able to sink a ship with 57 tanks of the Tiger convoy, but the rest slipped though with 238 tanks and 43 Hurricanes. These are now used against us - without any doubt with the goal to reach Tobruk and possible to even push us back further than that point.
dst: 英国第7装甲师通信保密上的一个漏洞，在9小时前把敌军进攻的情报泄露给了我们。英军此次进攻由印度第4师的部分兵力和重建后的第7装甲师实施。我们的海空军击沉了“老虎”船队中一艘载有57辆坦克的运输船，但其余船只带着238辆坦克和43架“飓风”溜了过来。这些装备如今正用来对付我们——毫无疑问，目的是抵达托布鲁克，甚至可能把我们逼退到更远的地方。

src: A week ago, Yugoslavia was close to signing the Dreimaechtepakt - and become one of our allies, and yesterday they actually signed the agreement. However, rumour has it that there has been a coup d'etat by the military, who are against this agreement. Therefore we must use the current confusion to invade the country. We cannot have an army one million strong in our rear! Move swiftly the enemy forces grow stronger by the day!
dst: 一周前，南斯拉夫还接近签署三国同盟条约、成为我们的盟友之一，昨天他们甚至真的签了。然而有传言称，军方发动了反对该协议的政变。因此我们必须利用当前混乱入侵该国。我们绝不能在后方留着一支百万大军！迅速行动，敌军日益强大！

src: A week of attacks on our positions with heavy losses on both sides was followed by three days of relative rest. Our counterattacks in the North against the 9th Australian Division have failed. The enemy seems to have reorganized and has resumed the offensive. Our reserves are most of what is left of 21Pz, the armored units of 15Pz and Ariete - which is still positioned well South of 8th Army's main attack.
dst: 对我们阵地一周的进攻使双方都付出了惨重代价，随后是三天相对平静。我们在北面对澳大利亚第9师的反击失败了。敌人似乎已完成重整并恢复进攻。我们的预备队是第21装甲师残部的大部、第15装甲师的装甲单位，以及“公羊”师——后者仍远在第8集团军主攻方向的南面。

src: Abbeville was under the Gun.The SS/BdM poised to remove the defenders there. Overhead roamed the Air Korps and any Civilians trying to get to Paris were strafted.The roads were clogged so French replacements wasted time trying to get to where they needed to be.And 'Le Grande Armee also was leary of using the roads.The Civilians had had faith but that was erroding second by second.French soldiers were slandered,spit at and even attacked by the thousands dis-placed by the War.Where was there to go to?Sure head for Paris figuring that was more protected than other areas but already the City was over-burdened with People,short on Food and was becoming a place of the Starving and Dead.The French Goverment was not able to cope with the War from a Military or Civilian angle.So slowly there rose a Resistance.At First it was anti-Nazi,then Against the People crowding the area taking Food and stealing but now it decided the Goverment was of little value so attack local officials.France was falling apart.So the SS after Abbeville would send a few Panzers to the Coast,the Girls could take a dip in the water.ILse wanted a Picture of that Glorious Event.She would make a copy and send it to dear Winston and entitled it 'We will dip in the Thames too'.
dst: 阿布维尔已陷入炮火之下。党卫军/BdM 蓄势待发，要清除那里的守军。头顶上航空军来回巡弋，任何想逃往巴黎的平民都遭扫射。道路被堵死，法国补充兵在赶往目的地的路上白白浪费时间。“大军团”也对走公路心怀忌惮。平民曾抱有信心，但那信心正一秒一秒地消蚀。法国士兵遭到诋毁、唾骂，甚至被因战争而流离失所的成千上万人攻击。他们又能去哪儿？当然，都奔着巴黎去，以为那里比其他地方更有保障，可这座城市早已被人潮压得不堪重负，食物短缺，正变成饥饿与死亡的所在。法国政府无论从军事还是民生角度，都无力应付这场战争。于是抵抗力量慢慢兴起。起初是反纳粹，后来转为反对涌入该地区、抢夺食物和偷窃的人，而如今它认定政府已无价值，便去袭击地方官员。法国正在分崩离析。于是党卫军在拿下阿布维尔后，会派几辆坦克到海边，姑娘们可以在水里泡一泡。伊尔泽想要一张记录这一光荣时刻的照片。她要复印一张寄给她亲爱的温斯顿，题名“我们也将在泰晤士河里泡一泡”。
阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼·努朱米

src: Accepting Kalm's plan, you will have neither the time nor the HQ support to outfit your troops properly for the attack:  only 9 battalions (including a maximum of 4 Soomusrong units) can participate.  Furthermore, this is a hunt-and-destroy mission.  You must eliminate all Soviet forces in the region.
dst: 若接受卡尔姆的计划，您将既没有时间也没有指挥部支持来为部队妥善装备进攻：只有9个营（含至多4个装甲列车单位）可以参战。此外，这是一次搜歼任务。您必须消灭该地区所有的苏俄军队。

src: Accomplish this task and promotion is assured.

According Seeboehm, Brigadier WHE 'Strafer' Gott is very likely to launch an attack at our positions at Halfaya and Fort Capuzzo and maybe even as far as Sidi Azeiz or Tobruk, in order to improve the starting positions of the coming British offensive.
dst: 据泽博姆称，WHE“疾行者”戈特准将很可能会进攻我们在哈勒法亚和卡普佐堡的阵地，甚至可能推进到西迪阿泽兹或托布鲁克，以改善英军即将发动的攻势的出发阵地。

src: According to Cuban and American sources, the Spanish met with a terrible defeat since they were not able to hold the ground and suffered serious losses. In addition, apparently Maceo was not there.
dst: 根据古巴和美国方面的说法，西班牙人遭遇了可怕的失败，因为他们没能守住阵地，还损失惨重。此外，显然马塞奥当时并不在场。

src: According to Intelligence a sharp attack of German infantry around the locality of Halen is expected. The 4th Panzerdivision has moved further south towards Gembloux (Gembloers) where it would meet the French Cavalry units of Prioux. So luckily it seems you will not have to fight the German tanks again.
dst: 据情报判断，德军步兵将在哈伦附近发起猛烈进攻。第4装甲师已南调至让布卢（Gembloers），将在那里迎战普里乌指挥的法军骑兵部队。因此幸运的是，您这次似乎不必再与德军坦克交手。

src: According to Kappel's plan, the People's Army and the Czechs would advance along both shores of the Volga and would attack the Bolsheviks from several directions, trapping them in the town or forcing them to flee. The communists outnumbered us three to one, so the greater mobility of our troops would be decisive. We'd use all the river boats that we had been able to find in order to advance along the Volga faster.
dst: 按照卡佩尔的计划，人民军和捷克人将沿伏尔加河两岸推进，从几个方向攻击布尔什维克，把他们困在城里或迫使他们逃跑。共产党人在兵力上以三比一超过我们，因此我军更高的机动性将起到决定性作用。我们将动用能找到的所有内河船只，以便更快地沿伏尔加河推进。

src: According to Plutarch, they had more than 30,000 seafarers on 1000 ships, conquered 400 cities and were well organized.
dst: 据普鲁塔克记载，他们有1000艘船、3万多名水手，攻占过400座城市，而且组织严密。

src: According to ancient forefathers traditions, Caesar's skull will decorate Vercingetorix's royal hall from now on....!
dst: 依照先民古俗，从今往后凯撒的头骨将装点维钦托利的王厅....！

src: According to international law, they could not conscript subjects of the Tsar. Only volunteers could be asked to fight against the Tsar and Russia. And all volunteers have been in Polish Legions already. So to get the Polish coscripts, Emperors had to grant the independence for the Kingdom of Poland. But once the independence was granted, there was no need for the Poles to fight on the side of the Central Powers anymore.
dst: 根据国际法，他们不能征召沙皇的臣民入伍。只能要求志愿者去与沙皇和俄国作战。而所有的志愿者都已加入了波兰军团。因此，为了得到波兰的应征士兵，两位皇帝不得不赐予波兰王国独立。但独立一旦赐予，波兰人便再无必要站在同盟国一方作战了。

src: According to the Red commander, the Nazis apparently have some kind of rocket research facility in the core of the jungle.  They know we're coming, and they're preparing to sabotage the entire facility.  We NEED to have those rockets intact, Commander.  They could provide a huge benefit to our space program and our missile capabilities, especially if we get some scientists out of the deal.
dst: 据那位红军指挥官说，纳粹在丛林深处似乎有一处火箭研究设施。他们知道我们来了，正准备把整座设施炸毁。我们需要那些火箭完好无损，指挥官。它们对我们的太空计划和导弹能力有极大的助益，尤其是如果我们还能顺带弄出几个科学家的话。

src: According to the Sailors' revolt in Kiel, the revolution spreads to Frankfurt
dst: 随着基尔水兵起义，革命蔓延到了法兰克福。

src: According to the intelligence service, you will have to fight against several panzerdivisions from the XIX Panzerkorps of Guderain, so be prepared!  We have also been informed that paratroopers may land behind our lines, probably close to Neufchâteau (20,25).
dst: 据情报部门称，你将面对古德里安第19装甲军的数个装甲师，做好准备！我们还获悉，伞兵可能会降落在我们战线后方，很可能在讷沙托(20,25)附近。

src: Acknowledging my past victories with relatively few losses, Haig decided that my Army Corps would lead our first attack, crossing the Ypres Canal at the dawn of July 31st. Our objectives  were the very same places where we had fought in 1914, now devastated after years of war. In front of us there were three German divisions and several lines of fortifications.
dst: 鉴于我以往以相对较少的损失取得的胜利，黑格决定让我的军率领我们发起首次进攻，于7月31日黎明渡过伊普尔运河。我们的目标正是1914年我们曾经战斗过的那些地方，如今在数年战火之后已成焦土。我们面前有三个德国师和数道防御工事。

src: Acknowledging the importance of a victory against Russia in the Eastern Front, we sent some of our best troops to that theatre of war, so far away from the boundaries of the Empire. In the summer of 1916 the XV Army Corps, with two divisions, was sent to Galicia. The XX Army Corps, with two divisions, and the 177th Infantry Regiment, went to Macedonia.  And finally, your VI Army Corps, with three divisions, went to Romania.
dst: 认识到在东线击败俄国的重要性，我们把自己一些最精锐的部队派往了那个远离帝国边界的战区。1916年夏天，第十五军携两个师被派往加利西亚。第二十军携两个师及第177步兵团前往马其顿。最后，您的第六军携三个师前往罗马尼亚。

src: Act as quick as possible, the Japanese are going to use all available means to defeat any try to stop their penetration into China.
dst: 行动要尽可能迅速，日军将动用一切可用手段来挫败任何阻止其深入中国的企图。

src: Actions of the Alpenkorps in the Balkans consisted of constant fighting retreats. These less epic actions are not depicted in this campaign. So this is the end... my friend... Thank you for playing this campaign that the four of us made between September 2018 and December 2021. You are very welcome to post feedback on the Open General Forums (Designer's Corner section).
dst: 阿尔卑斯军在巴尔干的作战是一连串且战且退的行动。这些不够壮烈的行动并未在本战役中呈现。所以，到此结束了……我的朋友……感谢您游玩这个由我们四人于2018年9月至2021年12月间制作的战役。非常欢迎您在 Open General 论坛（设计者角版块）发布反馈。

src: Actually, I couldn't blame them. Even the local Siberian politicians, most of them Socialist- Revolutionaries, were eager to get rid of us and make a deal with their new Bolshevik masters. The fools believed that Lenin and his minions would have mercy on them.
dst: 事实上，我不能责怪他们。就连本地的西伯利亚政客——其中大多数是社会革命党人——也急于甩掉我们，去和他们新的布尔什维克主子做交易。这些蠢货竟相信列宁及其爪牙会怜悯他们。

dst: Adler 对本场景和下一场景（须赢得塞得港才能玩到）的剧情与战斗序列贡献很大。

src: Admirably handled, sir.  Those Italians certainly put up a stiff patch of resistance, but our forces prevailed in the end, no doubt due to your sheer stubbornness.  Elsewhere things are going well, and victory is well within our sights here in East Africa.
dst: 处理得令人钦佩，长官。那些意大利人确实进行了一番顽抗，但我们最终取胜了，无疑要归功于你百折不挠的坚持。其他方向进展顺利，东非这里的胜利已近在眼前。
海军上将 Kolchak/ Siberian 集团军
海军上将 Kolchak/ 西部集团军
海军上将 Seymour/ Seymour's Relief Force

src: Admiral Spruance watched as the last of His carrier planes came in.The carrier 'Lexington had 2 wings up protecting the area as Spruance's planes aboard His carrier 'Ticondaroga re-fueled and re-armed.Things had not gone as Good as the Americans would have liked but they were in their favor and one more round would get the job done and the Air would be American and the Jap Fleet would be destroyed from the Air as well as from the sea.Midway would then be in American hands.Spurance rushing the servicing of His planes was brought a message 'planes were on the horizon closing fast'.The Wildcats defending were sent off to slow them down.The Enemy planes turned out to be the SS/BdM 'Frau-Z's instead of the expected 'Zero's.The Frau's cut through the American Wildcats then flew through a hail of AA fire.Spurance's carrier was loaded with planes all over the deck.It didn't take bombs but just One Frau-Z getting over the carrier deck and strafting it with it's 20mm auto-cannon before being shot down and the 'Ticondaroga was done for.That quick the 'Tide turned at Midway.The SS/BdM aided the Japanese Imperial Air Force and the Americans lost their last fleet,another set-back.Now Rumours on the West Coast were Rampant of Japanese Invasion.Other Rumours were being spread too,the SS had flown their 'Super-bombers into Cuba,Mexico and a massive SS Fleet was coming from England.
dst: 斯普鲁恩斯上将望着他航母上最后一批舰载机返航。“列克星敦”号航母有2个中队在空掩护该区域，斯普鲁恩斯所在“提康德罗加”号上的飞机正在加油挂弹。事情不像美国人希望的那样顺利，但形势对他们有利，再一轮就能了结，天空将属于美国，日本舰队将从空中和海上被消灭。中途岛随后就会落入美国手中。斯普鲁恩斯催促为他的飞机加紧整备，这时传来一条讯息：“有飞机出现在地平线，正在快速逼近。”负责防御的“野猫”被派出去迟滞它们。来的敌机不是预期的“零”式，而是党卫军/BdM 的“Frau-Z”。“女士”们切穿了美国“野猫”，然后穿过一阵高射炮火雨。斯普鲁恩斯的航母甲板上挤满了飞机。不需要炸弹——只要一架“Frau-Z”冲过航母甲板、用它的20毫米机炮扫射一番（随后被击落），“提康德罗加”号就完了。中途岛的“局势”就这样瞬息逆转。党卫军/BdM 协助日本帝国航空队，美国人失去了他们最后一支舰队，又一次挫败。如今西海岸盛传日本人即将入侵。还有别的流言在传播：党卫军已把他们的“超级轰炸机”飞进了古巴和墨西哥，一支庞大的党卫军舰队正从英格兰开来。

src: Admiral, you have been ordered to break through the Dardanelles Strait and Bosporus and sail your fleet into the Black Sea to assist our offensive against the Soviet Union.
dst: 海军上将，你已奉命突破达达尼尔海峡与博斯普鲁斯海峡，率舰队驶入黑海，以支援我们对苏联的攻势。

src: Adolf Hitler sent troops, aircraft, tanks, and other weapons to support Franco.
dst: 阿道夫·希特勒派出军队、飞机、坦克及其他武器支援佛朗哥。
向耶路撒冷进军，1917年11月19日

src: Advance through Slovakia proceeded until 1th February 1945 when Czechoslovaks reached the gates of Liptovsky Svaty Mikulas.
dst: 穿越斯洛伐克的进军持续到1945年2月1日，捷克斯洛伐克人抵达利普托夫斯基米库拉什城下。

src: Advance through the first defensive line.  Optionally , try to make use of the Port at (4,35) to cross the lake . Take of VHs (victory hexes ).
dst: 突破第一道防线。亦可尝试利用（4,35）处的港口渡湖。夺取胜利点（VH）。

src: Advance through the main defensive lines and take Odessa. Take all VHs.
