dst: 突破主要防线并夺取敖德萨。夺取全部胜利点（VH）。

src: Aerial reconnaissance has confirmed that there is a large camouflauged shipping operation off the coast of the Yucatan where the Germans are shipping in arms and supplies from the rest of Latin America.
dst: 空中侦察已确认，尤卡坦沿岸存在一处规模庞大、伪装巧妙的航运作业，德国人正从拉丁美洲其他地区向这里运送武器和补给。
阿沙达机场 (拉日什机场)
卡塔尼亚-丰塔纳罗萨机场
巴勒莫-蓬塔拉伊西机场

src: Afortunadamente hemos conseguido hacer una retirada ordenada y la mayor parte del Ejercito Popular ha cruzado en direccion contraria el rio Ebro.
dst: 所幸我军完成了一次有序撤退，人民军的大部分已朝相反方向渡过了埃布罗河。

src: After 1866 the relations between France and Prussia deteriorated very quickly. Emperor Napoleon III was an obstacle to the final unification of Germany, and Bismarck was searching for a new war in order to advance his political agenda.
dst: 1866年后，法国与普鲁士的关系迅速恶化。拿破仑三世皇帝是德国最终统一的障碍，而俾斯麦正在寻找一场新的战争以推进他的政治议程。

src: After 19 days of indecisiveness - known as the 19 day interregnum, Hitler has decided you and the rest of Guderian's 2nd Pz Gruppe need turn South to assist Von Rundstedt's less successful Armee Gruppe Sud in the encirclement of Kiev - Ukrain - 350 km South of here. You are to make contact with von Kleist's 1 Pz Gruppe South of Konotop to complete the encirclement. The capture of Moscow will have to wait. Opposing your forces is the newly created Russian 40th Army assisted by the 2nd Air-landing Corps and the 10th Tank Division.
dst: 经过19天的举棋不定——史称“19天空位期”，希特勒决定让你和古德里安第2装甲集群的其余部队转向南方，协助冯·伦德施泰特那不太顺利的南方集团军群合围基辅——此地以南350公里的乌克兰。你要在科诺托普以南与冯·克莱斯特的第1装甲集群建立联系，以完成合围。夺取莫斯科只能推迟。与你对峙的是新组建的俄军第40集团军，并有第2空降军和第10坦克师协助。

src: After 2 years of training at Fort Knox, your division is ready for action. Elements of the division will participate in Operation Torch, the Allied landing in French North Africa at a time when Monty is pushing back the Germans and Italians at El Alamein in Egypt. When the Axis forces are kicked out of North-Africa, your division will land in Italy.
dst: 在诺克斯堡训练两年后，你的师已准备就绪。本师部分部队将参加火炬行动——盟军登陆法属北非，此时蒙哥马利正在埃及阿拉曼击退德意军。当轴心国军队被逐出北非后，你的师将登陆意大利。

src: After 4 days of artillery preparation, 19 of the mines detonated - killing 10,000 German soldiers instantly.  The explosion was the loudest man-made disturbance in history and was audible in Dublin.
dst: 经过4天的炮火准备后，19处地雷被引爆，瞬间炸死10000名德军士兵。这次爆炸是人类历史上最响亮的人为巨响，远在都柏林都能听见。

src: After 4 days of fighting, Goering decided to force the Dutch in Rotterdam to surrender by bombing the city. When Generalleutnant Schmidt (9th PzDiv) reached an agreement on the terms of surrender of Rotterdam with it's Dutch commander, it was too late to recall all bombers and Rotterdam city center got hit very hard. The same day, Dutch General Winkelman decided to have all equipment destroyed in preparation for the overall Dutch surrender.
dst: 经过4天战斗，戈林决定以轰炸城市的方式迫使鹿特丹的荷兰人投降。当施密特中将（第9装甲师）与鹿特丹的荷军指挥官就投降条款达成一致时，已来不及召回所有轰炸机，鹿特丹市中心遭到重创。同一天，荷兰温克尔曼将军决定销毁所有装备，为荷兰全军投降做准备。

src: After 8th Army's defeat at Mersa Matruh, its remnants have fallen back to the last defendable position before the Nile Delta: El Alamein. With the Qattara Depression in the South, there is no way around their defences. But once again they have dug themsleves in in far apart brigade size boxes. You are still in command of all mobile Italian forces that are  in pursuit of 8th Army. Your task is to roll up 8th Army's boxes and move to Cairo and Alexandria as soon as possible.
dst: 第8集团军在梅尔萨马特鲁战败后，残部退守到尼罗河三角洲之前最后一处可守阵地：阿拉曼。南面有盖塔拉洼地，无法绕过他们的防线。但他们又一次以彼此相距很远的旅级支撑点挖壕据守。你仍指挥追击第8集团军的全部意军机动部队。你的任务是逐次卷击第8集团军的各个支撑点，并尽快向开罗和亚历山大推进。

src: After Cacarajicara, Weyler began an aggressive campaign to put an end to Maceo's invasion of Western Cuba and force his troops back across the "trocha" (fortified line) and into Eastern provinces. After some months of harsh combats, Maceo became convinced that he would have to leave Pinar del Río province behind and return to the East, where the insurrection had also fallen on hard times. When he was going to meet Cuban Chief Commander Máximo Gómez to plan the ulterior course of war, on December 7 he was killed in a skirmish with a Spanish column.
dst: 卡卡拉希卡拉之战后，韦勒发动了一场咄咄逼人的战役，以终结马塞奥对古巴西部的入侵，并迫使其部队越过「特罗查」（设防防线）退回东部各省。经过数月的艰苦战斗，马塞奥确信他必须放弃比那尔德里奥省，返回东部——那里的起义也已陷入困境。当他要去会见古巴总司令马克西莫·戈麦斯、筹划下一步作战方略时，他于12月7日与一支西班牙纵队的小规模交火中阵亡。

src: After El Obeid the Egyptian government and our British advisors agreed to evacuate the remaining Egyptian troops from Sudan. General Charles 'Chinese' Gordon was sent to supervise the withdrawal, but he soon found himself besieged at Khartoum. Fearing for Gordon's life, our government ordered Major-General Wolseley to organise a relief expedition. Naturally, I promptly volunteered myself to be a member of that army, and we left Alexandria at the end of October, 1884.
dst: 奥贝德之战后，埃及政府和我们的英国顾问同意将剩余的埃及军队撤出苏丹。查尔斯·「中国」戈登将军被派去监督撤退，但他很快就发现自己被围困在喀土穆。出于对戈登生命的担忧，我国政府命令沃尔斯利少将组织一次救援远征。自然地，我立即自告奋勇加入那支军队，我们于1884年10月底离开亚历山大。

src: After El Obeid, the British started to worry. Egypt was a British protectorate since 1882, and the Mahdist War was a problem you didn't expect. Many Egyptian forces were trapped in forts of small towns and, if they didn't receive any relief, the Mahdist would eventually exterminate them. The British didn't have the resources to evacuate all of those garrisons, so they asked Emperor Yohannes for help.
dst: 欧拜伊德一役之后，英国人开始担忧起来。埃及自1882年起就是英国的保护国，而马赫迪战争是个谁也没料到的麻烦。许多埃及军队被困在小镇的堡垒里，如果得不到任何援救，马赫迪分子最终会把他们全部消灭。英国没有资源撤出所有那些驻军，于是他们向约翰内斯皇帝求助。

src: After General Murray was relieved of his command in April, our new commander-in-chief, General Sir Edmund Allenby - a tall, heavy cavalryman nicknamed "The Bull" due to his physics and his explosive temper - has filled our army with new enthusiasm and developed a new plan to finally overcome the Gaza Line.
dst: 默里将军4月被解除指挥权后，我们的新总司令埃德蒙·艾伦比爵士将军——一位因体格和暴躁脾气而得绰号「公牛」的高大重骑兵——为我们的军队注入了新的热情，并制定了一个最终攻克加沙防线的新计划。

src: After Jan Smuts took command of the British forces in East Africa he started his large scale offensive against Von Lettow at the region of Taveta. This town is located on the British side of the border near Mount Kilimanjaro.  It had been occupied by the Germans in order to have a base for their raids against the Uganda Railway.
dst: 在扬·斯马茨接掌英属东非英军指挥权之后，他开始了针对冯·莱托的大规模攻势，地点在塔韦塔地区。该镇位于边境英方一侧，靠近乞力马扎罗山。德军曾占领此地，作为其袭扰乌干达铁路的基地。

src: After Kiel, the naval base of Wilhelmshaven is now rebelling. Under the leadership of Bernhard Kuhnt, you are now the one representative for the Council of the 21, whom the revolution now badly needs
dst: 继基尔之后，威廉港海军基地如今也起义了。在伯恩哈德·孔特的领导下，您现在成了二十一人委员会的代表，革命正迫切需要您。

src: After Spartacus had defeated Varinius lieutenant Furius, he encountered the troops of Varinius' legat Cossinius. He carefree had a bath, while Spartacus blasted his troops at Heraclea Salinae.
dst: 在斯巴达克斯击败瓦里尼乌斯的副将富里乌斯之后，他遇到了瓦里尼乌斯的副将科西尼乌斯的部队。科西尼乌斯正悠闲地洗着澡，斯巴达克斯却在赫拉克利亚盐场把他的部队打得粉碎。

src: After Velestino, the Greeks retreated to the mountains located south of Pharsala, near the village of Domokos. The position was easy to defend, and was the first of several mountain passes that the Turks would have to take on their way to Athens. The Greeks hoped to resist long enough, until the mediation of the Great Powers forced the Ottoman Empire to accept an armistice.
dst: 韦莱斯蒂诺之后，希腊人撤退到法尔萨拉以南、多莫科斯村附近的山地。这个阵地易于防守，是土耳其人进军雅典途中必须夺取的几处山口中的第一处。希腊人希望能抵抗足够长的时间，直到列强的调停迫使奥斯曼帝国接受停战。

src: After Wladiwostok was reached, it took months to get home. Partly because there still had be ships to arrive to take them on board, partly because of a huge journey from the Pacific Ocean to European ports, and from there over land to the new republic of Czechoslovakia: HOME!
dst: 抵达符拉迪沃斯托克后，用了好几个月才回到家乡。部分原因是还需要有船来接他们上船，部分原因是旅途漫长——从太平洋到欧洲各港口，再从那里经陆路抵达新的捷克斯洛伐克共和国：家！

src: After Ysterspruit the British have renewed their attempts to capture us. One of the British forces that is taking part in this operation is commanded by none other than Lord Mehuen, the general that we faced at the Moddeer River and Magersfontein.
dst: 在艾斯特斯普雷特之后，英军再次加紧了对我们的围捕。参加这次行动的一支英军部队，其指挥官不是别人，正是梅休因勋爵——我们在莫德河和马赫斯方丹交过手的那位将军。

src: After a cautious advance by night - avoiding vigilant observation by German Fokker planes - we have reached the Gaza area. Hopefully, we will be able to take the garrison by surprise in the morning.
dst: 经过夜间小心翼翼的推进——躲避着德国福克飞机的警惕侦察——我们已抵达加沙地区。希望我们能在清晨出其不意地拿下守军。

src: After a complete failure of your offensive at Valga, Red Latvian units went on the counter-offensive and overran your HQ.  You have been captured and executed next to an armored train the Red Latvians were re-equipping to use against your countrymen...
dst: 您在瓦尔加的攻势彻底失败后，拉脱维亚红军部队转入反攻，攻占了您的指挥部。您被俘获，并在一列拉脱维亚红军正重新装备、准备用来对付您同胞的装甲列车旁被处决……

src: After a couple of hours of travel, we have reached the Norvegian coast. Oslo is in front of us and it's our firts objetive. Your mission is take Oslo and the nearby airports. Fallschimjaegers will help you in the take of Fornebu airport. Good Luck.
dst: 经过数小时的航程，我们抵达了挪威海岸。奥斯陆就在我们前方，这是我们的首要目标。您的任务是夺取奥斯陆及其附近的机场。伞兵将协助您夺取福内布机场。祝您好运。

src: After a fierce fighting Gondar was saved, and the Sudanese retreated to Gallabat. Wisely, Emperor Yohannes thought that they would attack again as soon as they could, so he ordered King Menelik to send his army to Gojjam and Gondar, in order to reinforce those areas. However, unbeknownst to Yohannes, Menelik and Tekle Haymanot saw this as an opportunity to forge an alliance.
dst: 经过一场激战，贡德尔保住了，苏丹人撤回加拉巴特。约翰内斯皇帝明智地判断，他们定会尽快再度来犯，于是他命令孟尼利克国王派兵前往戈贾姆和贡德尔，以加强那些地区的防务。然而，约翰内斯并不知道，孟尼利克和特克莱·海马诺特却把这看作结盟的机会。

src: After a fierce fighting, we were defeated. Northwestern Ethiopia was open to the Mahdists, who followed up their victory by entering, sacking, and burning Gondar. Thousands of Christians were captured, enslaved, and marched off to Gallabat.
dst: 经过一场激战，我们战败了。埃塞俄比亚西北部向马赫迪分子敞开了大门，他们乘胜攻入贡德尔，大肆洗劫并纵火焚烧。成千上万的基督徒被俘、沦为奴隶，并被押往加拉巴特。

src: After a final heavy bombardment from the air and the sea, the island’s garrison was twice invited to surrender. There was no reply, so the British troops were landed, and the italian commander Pavesi then capitulated, having been authorised to do so in the course of the preceding night.
dst: 在来自空中和海上的最后一轮猛烈炮击之后，守岛部队曾两次被劝降。对方没有回应，于是英军部队登陆，意大利指挥官帕韦西随后投降——此前一夜他已获授权这么做。

src: After a hard and bitter fight our troops stormed Hill 60. Unfortunately, the strategic significance of this assault is rather limited. But at least it has been a boost of morale for our troops after all the letdowns.
dst: 经过一场艰苦而惨烈的战斗，我军猛攻下了60高地。可惜这次进攻的战略意义相当有限。但在经历了那么多挫折之后，它至少提振了我军的士气。

src: After a hard and bitter fight we finally secured the Medean Pass, but we were unable to defeat the Senussi decisively. We missed the great chance to eliminate the threat to Egypt and the Suez Canal from the Turkish supported attacks from the west. It has to be said that your performance as commanding officer of this operation has been less than satisfactory. It remains to be seen how you will perform when you encounter a more formidable enemy...
dst: 经过一场艰苦惨烈的战斗，我们终于确保了米迪安隘口，却未能决定性击败塞努西。我们错过了消除土耳其从西面支持的对埃及和苏伊士运河威胁的大好机会。不得不说，您作为本次行动指挥官的表现差强人意。当您遭遇更强大的敌人时，表现如何，还有待观察……

src: After a hard winter in Russia, your division is rested and re-equipped. The division is re-designated as SS Panzer-Grenadier Division Das Reich. As a reaction to the Allied landings in North-Africa, Hitler ordered Operation Anton - the occupation of Vichy France to protect it against the Allies. The French were allowed to hold the port of Toulon, to defend it against an Allied invasion. Now Hitler has changed his mind and wants Operation Lila executed. We are to move into Toulon and capture the Vichy French fleet that Hitler has promised to Mussolini. You will have to move fast because the French are expected to scuttle their fleet, rather than hand it over to us. French GMR and SOL forces are thought to be more favorable to our cause than the rest of the Vichy French troops.
dst: 在俄国经历一个严酷的冬天后，你的师得到休整和重新装备，并改称党卫军装甲掷弹兵“帝国”师。为回应盟军在北非登陆，希特勒下令执行“安东”行动——占领维希法国，以防其落入盟军之手。法国人获准保留土伦港，以抵御盟军入侵。如今希特勒改变了主意，要执行“百合”行动。我们要开进土伦，夺取希特勒许诺给墨索里尼的维希法国舰队。你必须行动迅速，因为预计法国人会凿沉舰队，而不是交给我们。据信，法国的 GMR 和 SOL 部队比维希法国其他部队更倾向于我方。

src: After a long and successful raid against allied merchant ships "Admiral Graf Spee" fought with allied light cruisers "Exeter", "Ajax" and "Achilles" off Montevideo on 13 December 1939 . After the battle the germans decided to put into Montevideo for repairs while the allied ships took position in the Rio de la Plata estuary. With fake radio messages they conviced the germans that a large allied force will reach the scene soon. Hans Langsdorff, the commander of "Admiral Graf Spee" decided to scuttle the ship and save the lives of his crew. In the evening of 18 December 1939 the ship was destroyed by several explosions and burned for days in the shallow waters off Montevideo. Langsdorff commited suicide 2 days after and his crew got interned in Argentina until the war was over.
dst: 在对盟军商船进行了一次漫长而成功的破袭之后，“施佩伯爵海军上将”号于1939年12月13日在蒙得维的亚外海与盟军轻巡洋舰“埃克塞特”号、“阿贾克斯”号和“阿喀琉斯”号交战。战后，德方决定驶入蒙得维的亚修理，而盟军战舰则在拉普拉塔河河口就位。他们用假无线电讯息让德方相信，一支庞大的盟军舰队即将赶到现场。“施佩伯爵海军上将”号舰长汉斯·朗斯多夫决定自沉军舰，以保全舰员性命。1939年12月18日傍晚，该舰在数次爆炸中被毁，在蒙得维的亚外海的浅水中燃烧了数日。朗斯多夫两天后自杀，其舰员在阿根廷被扣留，直到战争结束。

src: After a long rule of Etruscan kings, the last of them, Tarquinius Suberbus, was driven out by the Romans and the Republic is set up.
dst: 经过伊特鲁里亚诸王长期的统治，末代之王塔克文苏佩布斯被罗马人驱逐，共和国建立。

src: After a quiet winter we are preparing for a Invasion of Canada. Unfortunately some Highlanders in the region of Caithness carry out guerilla attacks against the railways. We need those railroads and ports as supply bases for the Kriegsmarine base at Scapa Flow. You and your men have to find and take out every enemy guerilla unit!
dst: 在度过一个平静的冬天之后，我们正准备入侵加拿大。遗憾的是，凯斯内斯地区的一些高地人正对铁路发动游击袭击。我们需要那些铁路和港口，作为斯卡帕湾海军基地的补给站。你和你的部下必须找到并消灭每一个敌军游击单位！

src: After a ten day bombardement, the French attacked the German positions at the Chemin des Dames. But the Chemin des Dames Ridge had been quarried for centuries, leaving a warren of caves and tunnels which were used as shelters by the German troops to escape the bombardment. The offensive met massed German machine-gun and artillery fire, which inflicted many casualties and repulsed the French infantry at many points. Finally, the offensive just advanced the front line by 6,7 Km.
dst: 经过十天的炮击，法军进攻了贵妇小径上的德军阵地。但贵妇小径山脊经过数百年开采，形成了一个布满洞穴和坑道的迷宫，德军部队利用这些洞穴作为掩体躲避炮击。进攻遭遇了密集的德军机枪和炮火，造成大量伤亡，并在许多地段击退了法军步兵。最终，这次进攻只把战线向前推进了6.7公里。

src: After all the drawbacks here a unique chance is offered to us.
dst: 在经历了这里所有的挫折之后，一个独一无二的机会呈现在我们面前。

src: After all the hard and challenging times my brave men and I had to go through during the Gallipoli and the Balkans campaigns, the last weeks here in Verdun, a rather quiet part of the Western front, almost felt like a holiday. Breathing the fresh French air again is such a pleasure, especially when you can enjoy the days without being constantly harassed by enemy fire. But now dark clouds have appeared on the horizon.
dst: 在加里波利和巴尔干战役中，我和我英勇的士兵经历了种种艰难困苦的考验，而在凡尔登——西线相当平静的一段——度过的这几周，几乎像在度假一样。再次呼吸清新的法国空气真是种享受，尤其是当您不再时刻被敌火骚扰、能够享受日子的时候。但如今，地平线上已经出现了乌云。

src: After all these days of marching in the jungle, our next goal is right there. The town of Nyangwe has been, for a long time, one of the main Arab outposts in this region. Occupying it is vital for our interests in this part of the world.
dst: 在丛林中行军了这么多天之后，我们的下一个目标就在眼前。尼扬圭镇长期以来一直是阿拉伯人在这一地区的主要据点之一。占领它对我们在这个地区的利益至关重要。

src: After an intense bombardment, the first line of defense is penetrated by the enemy, who's rolling deep into your territory. Your battalion is stationed right behind the front with a company of new Panther tanks. This is your first action as a freshly named battalion commander, and you are immediatelly rushed into the battle with a simple yet grave orders: destroy the enemy armoured spearheads, eliminate any further Soviet threat, and then retake the lost ground.
dst: 在猛烈炮击之后，敌军突破了第一道防线，正向你的防区纵深滚滚而来。你的营带着一个连的新黑豹坦克就驻防在前线正后方。这是你新官上任营长后的首战，你被立即投入战斗，接到的命令简单而严峻：摧毁敌军装甲矛头，扫除一切后续苏军威胁，然后夺回失地。

src: After an undeniable victory at Gumbinnen, Rennekampf became reluctant to pursue the Germans and convert the victory into a rout.  The 1st Army - with its massive presence of 5 cavalry divisions - deployed its bulk too far to the north and was unable to use its mobile arm in pursuit.  Rennekampf's hesitation at this stage in the August Campaign would become the subject of analysis, controversy, and suspicion.
dst: 在贡比嫩取得无可置疑的胜利之后，连宁坎普夫却不愿追击德军，把胜利扩大为一场溃败。第1集团军虽拥有多达5个骑兵师，却把主力部署得过于靠北，无法使用其机动部队展开追击。连宁坎普夫在八月战役这一阶段的犹豫不决，日后成为分析、争论与猜疑的话题。

src: After beating Lentullus, Spartacus also defeated his pursuer Consul L. Gellius Poplicola.
dst: 打败伦图卢斯之后，斯巴达克斯又击败了他的追击者、执政官卢基乌斯盖利乌斯波普利科拉。

src: After being forced to retreat from Pyongyang the Chinese started to build a new defence line at the Yalu river, the border between Korea and the Qing Empire, in the hope of stopping the advance of the First Japanese Army. The end of October was close, and we knew that  we would have to fight again very soon.
dst: 被迫从平壤撤退后，中国军队开始在鸭绿江——朝鲜与清帝国的边界——构筑一条新的防线，希望阻止日军第1军团的推进。10月已近尾声，我们知道很快又将不得不投入战斗。

src: After breaking with the Soviet authorities, the Czech Legion started to take over city after city along the railroads towards Wladiwostok. As it was still dispersed from east of the Urals in the east to almost the  Volga River in the west. Before long the Legion held power over a huge stretch of territory and was seen as one of the most dangerous enemies by the Soviet leaders in Moscow. In an attempt to secure itself the Czech Legion carried out attacks on Soviet cities. Tsjeljabinsk and Ufa had already been taken. Samara on the Volga River would be next.
dst: 与苏维埃当局决裂后，捷克军团开始沿着通往符拉迪沃斯托克的铁路逐城夺取。由于它仍然分散在东起乌拉尔以东、西至伏尔加河附近的广大地域，不久军团便控制了大片领土，并被莫斯科的苏维埃领导人视为最危险的敌人之一。为求自保，捷克军团对苏维埃城市发动了进攻。车里雅宾斯克和乌法已被攻下。伏尔加河畔的萨马拉将是下一个目标。

src: After crossing the Apennine mountains and clearing the coast your next task will be the liberation of the cities of Bologne and Modena. When both cities are in our hands and the surrounding area is secure you will push further northwards into the Po river valley. Reaching the Po river will be our final objective as well as the destruction of the last remnants of the german forces. Victory is close and it will be ours! Good luck, commander!
dst: 越过亚平宁山脉、肃清沿海之后，您的下一项任务是解放博洛尼亚和摩德纳两座城市。当两城落入我们手中、周边地区也安全之后，您将继续北进，深入波河流域。抵达波河将是我们的最终目标，同时还要消灭德军最后残部。胜利就在眼前，而且必将属于我们！祝您好运，指挥官！

src: After crossing the Ebro our army has just found token resistance on its way to Madrid. We believe that the Republicans are concentrating most of their troops in the capital, where they plan to defeat us thanks to their superior numbers and equipment.
dst: 渡过埃布罗河后，我军在通往马德里的路上只遇到了象征性的抵抗。我们相信共和派正把大部分兵力集中在首都，企图凭借人数和装备优势在那里击败我们。

src: After days of heavy fighting we finally managed to stop the French offensive. Our enemies were surprised by the tenacity of the Chinese forces, and decided to hold their ground while they waited for reinforcements. Some weeks later, after learning of the immediate arrival of more French troops, the Chinese left Kep and Chu and retreated unmolested towards Lang Son, in the north.
dst: 经过数日的激战，我们终于设法阻止了法军的攻势。敌人对中国军队的顽强感到惊讶，决定在等待援军的同时固守阵地。几周后，在得知更多法军即将抵达后，中国军队撤出盖普和朱，不受干扰地向北撤往谅山。

src: After defeating the Bolsheviks, the German Baltische Landeswehr (Baltic Territorial Army) Freikorps is now turning against us in order to establish puppet governments in the baltic states. You are ordered to take command of the united Estonian and Latvian forces in this descisive battle for freedom!
dst: 击败布尔什维克之后，德国波罗的海地方防卫军（波罗的海领土军）自由军团如今调转枪口对付我们，企图在波罗的海国家建立傀儡政府。你奉命在这场决定自由的关键战役中指挥爱沙尼亚与拉脱维亚联军！

src: After defeating the Turks at Romani, the next objective for the Egyptian Expeditionary Force was El Arish. When the EEF advanced along the Sinai coast in December, reconnaissance advised that the enemy had apparently abandoned the village. So the town was captured without a fight on 20th December. A few captured prisoners told our interrogators that the garrison was heading inland along the Wadi el Arish.
dst: 在罗马尼击败土耳其人后，埃及远征军的下一目标是阿里什。12月，当EEF沿西奈海岸推进时，侦察情报称敌人显然已放弃该村。于是该镇于12月20日不战而下。几名被俘的俘虏告诉我们的审讯官，守军正沿瓦迪阿里什向内陆撤退。

src: After delivering this speech, he dismissed the assembly; and, besides those statements, many circumstances induced him to think that this affair ought to be considered and taken up by him; especially as he saw that the Aedui, styled [as they had been] repeatedly by the senate "brethren" and "kinsmen," were held in the thraldom and dominion
dst: 讲完这番话后，他就解散了聚会；除这些陈述之外，还有许多情形促使凯撒认为此事应当由他考虑并接手；尤其因为他看到，曾被元老院一再称为「兄弟」「亲族」的埃杜伊人，如今却处在日耳曼人的奴役与统治之下，

src: After driving the Boer off Belmont and Graspan we followed our advance north along the Western Cape Railway, in order to relieve Kimberley.
dst: 将布尔人从贝尔蒙特和格拉斯潘击退之后，我们沿西开普铁路继续向北推进，以解金伯利之围。

src: After escaping from Capua they settled at the foot of Vesuvius, and hold up transports to get to food. So they also came to weapons. In the course of time, more and more slaves and outlaws joined the group, as their leader Spartacus was chosen. His lieutenants were the Celts Crixus and Oinominos.
dst: 从卡普阿逃出后，他们在维苏威山脚下落脚，并劫掠运输队以获取食物。武器也就这样到手了。随着时间推移，越来越多的奴隶与亡命者加入这支队伍，斯巴达克斯被推举为首领。他的副将是凯尔特人克里克索斯与奥伊诺米诺斯。

src: After expressing my condolences for your loss, let me remind you that a possible resignation of your command of the fleet would seem very suspicious at such a critical juncture of the war. On the other hand, you know that the next few months will be very difficult. I am not at all optimistic about the battle at Stalingrad and also now that the Italian fleet is not that strong, I fear an allied counter attack along with the Americans now.
dst: 在对你痛失亲人表示慰问之后，请容我提醒你，在战争如此关键的关头辞去舰队指挥职务，会显得非常可疑。另一方面，你也知道接下来几个月会非常艰难。我对斯大林格勒之战完全不抱乐观，而且如今意大利舰队已不那么强大，我现在担心的是盟军会同美国人一道发起反攻。

src: After giving up the Cyrenaica to the Brits in the aftermath of Crusader last year December, our German allies launched a couteroffensive in January. That offensive brought us back to Gazala where all parties have been preparing for a new offensive.
dst: 去年12月“十字军”之后把昔兰尼加让给英国人后，我们的德国盟友在1月发起了反攻。那次反攻把我们带回加扎拉，各方都在那里为一场新的攻势做准备。

src: After having enclosed the legions of Antonius at Actium, Octavian, and above all, his most capable leader Marcus Agrippa,  Antonius is in a desperate situation because the queen, Cleopatra VII, is with him there....
dst: 在把安东尼乌斯的军团围困于亚克兴之后，屋大维——尤其是他最能干的统帅马尔库斯阿格里帕——使安东尼乌斯陷入绝境，因为女王克利奥帕特拉七世就在他身边....

src: After he perceived that all the forces of the Belgae, which had been collected in one place, were approaching toward him, and learned from the scouts whom he had sent out, and [also] from the Remi, that they were then not far distant, he hastened to lead his army over the Aisne , which is on the borders of the Remi, and there pitched his camp. This position fortified one side of his camp by the banks of the river, rendered the country which lay in his rear secure from the enemy, and furthermore insured that provisions might without danger be brought to him by the Remi and the rest of the states. Over that river was a bridge: there he places a guard; and on the other side of the river he leaves Q. Titurius Sabinus, his lieutenant.
dst: 他察觉到比尔吉人集结于一处的全部兵力正朝他逼近，又从他派出的斥候以及雷米人口中得知他们已 经不远，便赶紧率军渡过位于雷米人边界的埃纳河，在那里扎营。这一位置以河岸为营寨的一侧提供了防 护，使他后方的地带免遭敌人威胁，此外还确保雷米人及其余各邦可以安全地把粮秣送给他。河上有 一座桥：他在那里设了守卫；河的另一侧，他留下副将昆图斯提图里乌斯萨比努斯。

src: After initial success, the British offensive at Cambrai has stalled. We are ready for a counterattack. The primary goal is to surround and destroy multiple British divisions. The secondary goal is to take command of the lost positions of the Siegfriedstellung.
dst: 在最初的成功之后，英军在康布雷的攻势已陷入停滞。我们已准备好反攻。首要目标是包围并歼灭多个英军师。次要目标是夺回齐格飞防线失守的阵地。

src: After last year's disastrous Summer on the Eastern Front, you were able to stabilize the situation in Eastern Prussian and Central Poland. But failed to stop the advance of the Soviet 3rd Ukrainian Front. Budapest is in Soviet hands, Hungary has capitulated and Soviet forces have reached Vienna.
dst: 在东线去年灾难性的夏季之后，你稳住了东普鲁士和波兰中部的局势。但未能阻止苏军乌克兰第3方面军的推进。布达佩斯已在苏军手中，匈牙利已投降，苏军已抵达维也纳。

src: After leaving Syria, Allenby has retreated with his remaining divisions into the fortified area of Jerusalem, where he hopes to stop our offensive.
dst: 离开叙利亚之后，艾伦比率领他剩余的师退入了耶路撒冷的设防地区，希望在那里阻止我们的攻势。

src: After losing the Spanish-American War in 1898 Spain sought to recover some of its lost prestige and glory by expanding its influence in Northern Morocco. However, some of the local Berber tribes were determined not to live under Spain's rule and started a ferocious and bloody war that would last for almost two decades.
dst: 1898年美西战争战败之后，西班牙试图通过扩大其在北摩洛哥的影响力，来挽回一些失去的威望与荣光。然而，一些当地柏柏尔部族下定决心不生活在西班牙的统治之下，于是发动了一场持续近二十年的惨烈而血腥的战争。

src: After many quite months the British und US forces launched a invasion on Sicily. They already captured Pantelleria and Lampedusa and now use the little islands to launch their planes.
dst: 在经历了许多平静的月份之后，英军与美军对西西里发动了入侵。他们已占领潘泰莱里亚岛与兰佩杜萨岛，现在正利用这些小岛起飞飞机。

src: After months of preparations, we have invaded Rumania. The biggest ally of the German cowards that invaded our country. Like our offensives in the Baltic and Byelorussia, we have made promising advances. From our bridgehead over the Prut River at Jassy and at a number of other places, we have broken fascist lines and are driving deep into their rear. If we could join two of our pincers near Falciu, at the Prut River, then we can cut of a considarable number of fascist troops.
dst: 经过数月的准备，我们入侵了罗马尼亚——那些入侵我们国家的德国懦夫最大的帮凶。如同我们在波罗的海和白俄罗斯的攻势一样，我们取得了可喜的进展。从雅西的普鲁特河桥头堡以及其他多处地点，我们突破了法西斯的战线，正深入他们的后方。如果我们能在普鲁特河上的法尔丘附近会合两路钳形攻势，就能切断相当数量的法西斯部队。

src: After months of war we all know how tough and brave the Filipinos are, but anyway there's no excuse for this. It's a shame that you've allowed an army of peasants armed with knives and some old rifles to defeat you.
dst: 打了几个月的仗，我们都清楚菲律宾人多么顽强勇敢，但这无论如何都不能成为借口。您竟让一支手持刀子和几支老式步枪的农民军打败了您，这真是耻辱。

src: After more then three months of continuous combat your forces need some weeks of well deserved rest. Use the time to bring your units back to full fighting strength!
dst: 经过三个多月连续不断的战斗，你的部队需要几个星期的休整，这是应得的。利用这段时间让你的部队恢复到满编战斗力！

src: After much bitter fighting, General Allenby entered Jerusalem through the Damascus Gate. The Turks have left the city without great resistance, so the sights of Holy City remain unharmed by this bloody war. Now it's time to relax a few days, before we are planning our next steps.
dst: 经过一番苦战后，艾伦比将军经大马士革门进入耶路撒冷。土耳其人未做激烈抵抗便弃城而去，因此圣城的景象在这场血腥战争中未遭破坏。现在，在我们筹划下一步行动之前，该休整几天了。

src: After much ebb and flow, the African front has stabilized at Gazala. It is time for you to seize the initiative and drive the British out of Libya and Egypt. Your goal is to seize Cairo and all other objectives by September 30th. However, given the entry of the Americans in the war, it may be necessary to complete the conquest of Egypt earlier to prevent an American invasion of Northwest Africa.
dst: 经过反复拉锯，非洲前线已在加扎拉稳定下来。现在该由你夺取先手，将英军逐出利比亚和埃及。你的目标是在9月30日前夺取开罗及所有其他目标。但鉴于美国已参战，为阻止美军入侵西北非，可能有必要提前完成对埃及的征服。

src: After my victory at Orel it was easy to reach Plavsk, 20 miles from Moscow. But the Bolsheviks have shown a remarkable ability for military logistics. Somehow they have managed to build a defence line south of Tula, and they have sent six fresh divisions from the Voronezh and Tsaritsyn fronts. I'll need all my skill in order to defeat the Reds and continue my march on Moscow.
dst: 在奥廖尔取胜后，我们顺利抵达距莫斯科20英里的普拉夫斯克。但布尔什维克展现了非凡的军事后勤能力。他们设法在图拉以南构筑了一条防线，并从沃罗涅日和察里津战线调来六个新锐师。我需要使出浑身解数，才能击败红军，继续向莫斯科进军。

src: After nearly a month of withdrawal, the Red Army is trying to build a solid defensive line by the river Niemen, near the town of Grodno. We must break that line quickly so that we can continue our offensive before the Russian defenses are completed. Besides, the League of Nations is increasing the pressure to force a cease fire so we have only a few weeks to continue our offensive before they impose an armistice on us.
dst: 在撤退了近一个月之后，红军正试图在格罗德诺城附近的涅曼河边构筑一条坚固的防线。我们必须迅速突破这条防线，好赶在俄军工事完工之前继续进攻。此外，国联正在加大压力以促成停火，因此在他们强行让我们停战之前，我们只有几周时间继续进攻。

src: After negotiations between Germany and Poland broke down, Pz Division Kempf units crossed the border into Poland on August 26th 06h00. At the last minute the order to attack was postponed and it wasn't until 09h00 that all the units had been recalled to their assembly points.
dst: 德波谈判破裂后，肯普夫装甲师的部队于8月26日6时越过边境进入波兰。最后一刻进攻命令被推迟，直到9时所有部队才被召回集结点。

src: After negotiations between Germany and Poland broke down, Pz Division Kempf units crossed the border into Poland.
dst: 德波谈判破裂后，肯普夫装甲师的部队越过边境，进入波兰。

src: After our assault on the Philippines in December of the past year, the enemy forces have been defeated, and these islands are clearly into our hands, however, there are still some pockets of enemy resistance. The most of the enemy troops are entretched on the Bataan peninsula, where they are desperately trying to resist our assaults...
dst: 在去年12月我们对菲律宾发起进攻之后，敌军已被击败，这些岛屿显然已落入我们手中，不过仍有若干敌军抵抗的孤立据点。敌军大部分部队据守巴丹半岛，拼命抵抗我们的进攻……

src: After our decisive victories at London, Manchester and Glasgow, the remnants of the British Army retreated to North Ireland and the Orkneys. The large bay of Scapa Flow with its naval base will be our main objective, but we also need to secure the other islands of the archipelago.
dst: 在我们于伦敦、曼彻斯特与格拉斯哥取得决定性胜利后，英军残余部队撤退到了北爱尔兰与奥克尼群岛。拥有海军基地的斯卡帕湾广阔海湾将是我们的主要目标，但我们也需要夺取该群岛的其他岛屿。

src: After our offensive failed we had to retire to our strongholds in Navarra. The republican General Concha has directed his troops there, determined to take our capital, Estella, and defeat us definitely. But this time we are prepared. Gather your army, reject the liberals and recover the local villages.
dst: 攻势失败后，我们不得不退回纳瓦拉的要塞。共和派将军孔查已率部前往那里，决意夺取我们的首府埃斯特利亚，将我们彻底击败。但这一次我们已有准备。集结您的军队，击退自由派，收复当地的村庄。

src: After our offensive in the winter there is still the German salient at Rzhew. We have decided to start a great attack on the salient with the target of destroying the defendsing German troops. Your troops should attack in the north at Rzhew, in the south at Sychewka and in the middle of the salient, break through the lines and destroy or capture the most forces.
dst: 我们冬季攻势之后，德军在勒热夫的突出部依然存在。我们已决定对其实施一场大规模进攻，目标是歼灭防守的德军部队。你的部队应在北面的勒热夫、南面的瑟乔夫卡以及突出部中央发起攻击，突破敌军防线，尽可能多地歼灭或俘获敌军。

src: After our splendid victories in Great Britain and the Orkneys some British troops escaped to Northern Ireland. Therefore we have to launch "Operation Green" and seize the whole of Ireland.
dst: 我们在英国和奥克尼群岛取得辉煌胜利后，一些英军部队逃往北爱尔兰。因此我们必须发动“绿色行动”，夺取整个爱尔兰。

src: After our success at Kiev, the entire front in the Ukraine is moving west.  And still is! The Polish armies are far from defeated but they lack the power to stop our people's army for once and for all.  While our strategic goal will be Lwow, or Lemberg as the old imperialists from Germany would name it.  However the Poles seem to everything to stop them from liberating the people they are oppressing!
dst: 在基辅大捷之后，乌克兰的整条战线都在西移。而且仍在西移！波兰军队远未被击败，但他们缺乏一劳永逸地阻止我们人民军队的力量。而我们的战略目标将是利沃夫，或者像德国的老帝国主义者所称的伦贝格。然而波兰人似乎想尽一切办法，阻止我们解放他们正在压迫的人民！

src: After our success in Karelia we now want to free the Baltic states. Your tank army have the mission to attack the Germans in Riga and throw them out of the city.
dst: 在卡累利阿取得胜利后，我们现在要解放波罗的海诸国。你的坦克集团军受命进攻里加的德军，把他们赶出该城。

src: After our success in the retaking of Mersa el Brega and Agedabia, the counteroffensive must continue. The British are now trying to regroup some units in the Beda Fomm - Bengazhi - Mechilli area. These units are surely the remnants of the enemy 1st Armored Division, and the 4th Indian division, which intelligence reports indicate is deployed around Bengazhi.
dst: 在成功夺回布赖加港和阿杰达比亚之后，反攻必须继续下去。英军目前正试图在贝达富姆——班加西——梅基利一带重整部分部队。这些部队肯定是敌军第1装甲师和第4印度师的残部，情报显示后者部署在班加西周边。

src: After our successes in the winter the Germans seems to have their troops reinforced. With their Hungarian allies they are starting a big offensive with the target Voronezh. Slow down the advance of the Germans, so we have enough time to prepare new positions.
dst: 经过我们在冬季取得的战果，德军似乎已增援了其部队。他们正与匈牙利盟军一同发起一场以沃罗涅日为目标的大规模攻势。延缓德军的推进，好让我们有足够时间构筑新的阵地。

src: After our victory against the troops near to Kongsvinger, we have arrived to the next step on the norvegian inland. Gjoevik is an importante point before reach Lillehammer. Your mission is defeat the norvegian troops here, and continue with the drive to the north. Good Luck.
dst: 在战胜了康斯温厄尔附近的敌军之后，我们进入了挪威内陆的下一阶段。约维克是抵达利勒哈默尔之前的重要据点。您的任务是击败这里的挪威军队，并继续向北推进。祝您好运。

src: After out landing in the Anzio area the germans might rush troops to fight our beachhead, but that will weaken ther positions at the Gustav Line. In the first phase of the landings we don't expect much resistance. But reports indicate strong Luftwaffe forces and even submarines in this area.
dst: 在我军于安齐奥地区登陆后，德军可能会急调部队来攻击我们的登陆场，但这将削弱他们在古斯塔夫防线上的阵地。在登陆的第一阶段，我们预计不会遇到太多抵抗。但有报告显示该地区有强大的德国空军部队，甚至还有潜艇。

src: After pushing the Belgian Army back to Antwerp, the German First Armee turns south. Only the British Expeditionary Force (BEF), a 'contemptible little army' comprising 75,000 men stands between them and Paris.
dst: 在将比利时军队逼退到安特卫普之后，德军第1集团军转向南方。唯有英国远征军（BEF）这支「微不足道的小军队」——共75000人——横亘在他们与巴黎之间。

src: After receiving new Panzer IIIs, you moved to the vicinity of Rzhev in preparation for a small-scale attack. Unfortunately, things don't go well. Our artillery blasted off the important railway bridge by inadvertently discharging Soviet mines, so you need to cross the river elsewhere. In the west, Grossdeutschland's engineers put into the operation a ferry. In the east, there is an attempt to cross the river by neighboring infantry battalion. Join those units, break through the enemy resistance, and penetrate deep into the Soviet territory.
dst: 接收新三号坦克后，你移师勒热夫附近，准备发起一次小规模进攻。不幸的是，事与愿违。我们的炮兵不慎引爆苏军地雷，炸毁了重要的铁路桥，所以你只能另寻渡河之处。西面，大德意志师的工兵投入了一艘渡船。东面，友邻步兵营正尝试渡河。与这些部队会合，突破敌军抵抗，向苏联腹地纵深突进。

src: After receiving the news of the Allied invasion of Sicily, as well as reports of impeding Soviet attacks on the Mius River and at Izyum, Hitler decided to cancel Operation Zitadelle.
dst: 接到盟军入侵西西里的消息，以及苏军即将在米乌斯河和伊久姆发起进攻的报告后，希特勒决定取消“堡垒”行动。

src: After receiving the news of the Allied invasion of Sicily, as well as reports of impeding Soviet attacks on the Mius River and at Izyum, Hitler decided to cancel Operation Zitadelle. Unfortunately, we will not be able to completely finish of the Russian armor with the 3 Panzer divisions we kept in reserve.
dst: 接到盟军入侵西西里的消息，以及苏军即将在米乌斯河和伊久姆发起进攻的报告后，希特勒决定取消“堡垒”行动。遗憾的是，我们无法用留在预备队的3个装甲师将俄军装甲部队彻底歼灭。

src: After receiving the news of the Allied invasion of Sicily, as well as reports of impeding Soviet attacks on the Mius River and at Izyum, Hitler has decided to cancel Operation Zitadelle.
dst: 接到盟军入侵西西里的消息，以及苏军即将在米乌斯河和伊久姆发起进攻的报告后，希特勒决定取消“堡垒”行动。

src: After recovering Ufa, Kolchak's staff started to plan our Spring Offensive. For better or worse, it would start in March. Our supply lines were still a mess, and many of our soldiers didn't have a decent training, but we couldn't wait any longer.
dst: 收复乌法后，高尔察克的参谋人员开始筹划我们的春季攻势。无论好坏，它将在3月发动。我们的补给线仍一团糟，许多士兵也没有像样的训练，但我们不能再等了。

src: After resisting the numerically superior Germans for as long as they could, the French retreated to the west, towards Bitche and Saverne. The German Third Army did not pursue them and remained in Alsace, attacking and destroying the French garrisons that they could find.
dst: 在尽其所能抵抗兵力占优的德军之后，法军向西撤退，朝比奇和萨韦尔讷方向而去。德意志第3军团没有追击，而是留在阿尔萨斯，进攻并摧毁他们所能找到的法军守备部队。

src: After retreating from Morogoro, von Lettow took positions to the east and west of the Uluguru Mountains at Kisaki and Dutumi. Van Deventer divided his forces with the idea of attacking simultaneously the Germans on both sides of the mountains.
dst: 从莫罗戈罗撤退之后，冯·莱托在乌卢古鲁山东西两侧的基萨基和杜图米占据阵地。范德文特将其部队分开，打算同时进攻山两侧的德军。

src: After retreating from the Crusader battlefield, we have taken positions at the Gazala line. Until more reinforcements arrive at the front, the British 8th Army is still stronger than we are. Not unless there are signals that your troops are surrounded, you can retreat further West.
dst: 从“十字军”战场撤退后，我们在加扎拉防线占领了阵地。在更多增援抵达前线之前，英国第8集团军仍强于我们。除非出现你的部队被包围的迹象，你可以继续向西撤退。

src: After sailing thru the Suez Canal they
dst: 穿过苏伊士运河后，他们

src: After securing Kazan, Simbirsk and Samara were our next obvious steps. I was confident that both cities would fall with relative ease. Unlike Kazan, their defenders had not built strong fortifications that could stop our assaults. We also knew that many Bolshevik regiments had fled to Saratov, and Kolchak had sent one cossack division to reinforce us. So I believed that nothing could stop our men.
dst: 在确保喀山之后，辛比尔斯克和萨马拉显然是我们接下来的目标。我相信这两座城市都会相对轻松地陷落。与喀山不同，它们的守军没有修筑能够阻止我们进攻的坚固工事。我们还知道，许多布尔什维克团已逃往萨拉托夫，而高尔察克已派一个哥萨克师来增援我们。所以我相信，没有什么能阻挡我们。

src: After seeing your performance I think that it would be better to keep you on a secondary front until the end of the war. However, the OHL has decided that you and your men will be transferred to the Belgian border. I can't understand why, maybe they think that there you're most likely to be killed in action. Anyway, I wish you good luck, General, you'll need it on your new destination.
dst: 看过您的表现后，我认为最好把您留在一个次要战线上直到战争结束。然而，最高陆军指挥部已决定把您和您的部下调往比利时边境。我不明白为什么，也许他们认为您在那里更可能阵亡。无论如何，祝您走运，将军，您在新驻地会需要运气的。

src: After seizing New York City we secured the greater NYC metropolitan area and now have to push further to the west and south. Harpers Ferry is a important transport hub and river crossing northwest of Washington DC. Once the area is under control, the enemy capital will be cut of from most of its supplies. But the US Army is far from being beaten and we expect some enemy counterattacks at any time, so stay alert!
dst: 夺取纽约市后，我们已控制了整个纽约大都会区，现在必须继续向西和向南推进。哈珀斯费里是华盛顿特区西北一处重要的运输枢纽与渡河点。一旦该地区落入掌控，敌军首都的大部分补给线将被切断。但美军远未被击垮，我们预计敌人随时可能发起反攻，所以保持警惕！

src: After several clashes with Ataman Semenov, Semenov left the Czechs for what they were and concentrated on the Soviet forces which were approaching. The Czech Legion was steaming full speed on Wladiwostok!
dst: 与阿塔曼·谢苗诺夫的几次冲突之后，谢苗诺夫不再理会捷克人，转而集中兵力对付逼近的苏军。捷克军团正全速驶向符拉迪沃斯托克！

src: After smoke has cleared around the corps headquarters, you have found yourself surrounded by the German GardeKorps.  Insolent and proud of their accomplishment, they escort you and your staff to be questioned by General von Plettenberg.  As a prisoner of war, your career in the service of Russia has come to an end.
dst: 硝烟在军指挥部周围散去后，您发现自己已被德国近卫军包围。他们骄横自得，押送您和您的参谋去见冯·普莱滕贝格将军受审。作为战俘，您为俄国效力的军旅生涯就此终结。

src: After so many battles, fatigue had affected my mind and my body. I suffered a breakdown at the worst possible time, and I had to be relieved from command. Victory was finally ours, but to this day I still regret not having been able to participate in this heroic deed until te end. My family always tries to cheer me up when they see that I'm in a sad mood, but I can't help thinking that, somehow, at the moment of truth Glory avoided me and I failed my country.
dst: 经过这么多场战斗，疲惫侵蚀了我的身心。我在最糟糕的时刻崩溃了，不得不被解除指挥权。胜利最终属于我们，但直到今天，我仍为自己未能将这一英雄壮举坚持到底而遗憾。我的家人看到我情绪低落时总会设法逗我开心，但我忍不住去想，在关键时刻，荣耀躲开了我，我辜负了我的祖国。

src: After so many defeats the war is growing increasingly unpopular in the United Kingdom. Some liberal MPs led by Mr. Lloyd George are asking openly for a negotiated peace, and they have a real chance of winning the next elections. The Marquess of Salisbury still refuses to negotiate, but if you and the other generals keep on winning battles against the British, he won't be able to mantain his intransigent position for a long time.
dst: 在接连惨败之后，这场战争在英国越来越不得人心。以劳合·乔治先生为首的一些自由党议员公开要求通过谈判实现和平，而且他们确有赢得下次选举的机会。索尔兹伯里侯爵仍拒绝谈判，但如果您和其他将军继续在对英作战中取胜，他就不可能长久维持这种强硬的立场。

src: After some initial British successes, Ariete supported by elements of the 15th Panzer and 5th Leichte Division swept the Brits off the battlefield.
dst: 在英军取得一些初步战果后，“公羊”师在第15装甲师和第5轻装师部分兵力的支援下，把英国人扫出了战场。

src: After some losses the Teutons decided to avoid the camp an go straight towards the Mediterranean and Italy ...
dst: 损失了一些人之后，条顿人决定绕开营地，径直向地中海和意大利进发 ...

src: After some months of small skirmishes, we can say that Manila is safe. The Filipino rebels don't dare to approach the capital. Now it's time to send some troops to the south and clear the area between Manila and Cavite of enemies.
dst: 经过数月的小规模交火，我们可以说马尼拉已经安全了。菲律宾叛军不敢靠近首都。现在是时候派兵南下，肃清马尼拉与甲米地之间地区的敌人了。

src: After some planning the general stuff has decided that we will attack the allied lines at Dessau. The allies have numerous troops at this front line, so, if we can break through their lines, the allies must withdraw their other troops.
dst: 经过一番筹划，总参谋部已决定对德绍的盟军防线发起进攻。盟军在这条前沿防线上兵力众多，因此如果我们能突破他们的防线，盟军就必须撤回其他部队。

src: After stuborn resistance Axis forces have capitulated. It were however the British forces that accomplished this result, not you.
dst: 轴心国军队顽抗之后终于投降。然而取得这一战果的是英军，不是你。

src: After taking Adi Quala, many other villages and towns fell, too. Gura, Barentu and Agordat were the most important ones. My father had fought many battles in that area, either against the Egyptians or against the Dervishes. Knowing that I was following his steps, I was ecstatic.
dst: 攻占阿迪夸拉之后，许多其他村镇也相继陷落，其中以古拉、巴伦图和阿科达特最为重要。我父亲曾在那片地区打过许多仗，不是打埃及人，就是打德尔维希人。得知自己正追随他的足迹，我欣喜若狂。

src: After taking Chistopol we spent a few days resting and resupplying, but we continued our offensive as soon as we could. We were anxious to reach the shores of the Volga before the Red Army could recover. It would be our best chance to recover Kazan and its neighbouring area  once and for all.
dst: 拿下奇斯托波尔后，我们休整补充了几天，随即尽快继续进攻。我们急于在红军恢复之前抵达伏尔加河沿岸。这将是我们一劳永逸收复喀山及其周边地区的最好机会。

src: After taking part in the attacks on Ypres, you are back in command of [VII] Korps. It's troops are still occupying the same sector of the front (13th Infantry Division around Neuve Chapelle, 14th Infantry Division South of it and the 6th Bavarian Reserve Division in reserve).
dst: 参加完对伊普尔的进攻后，您重新接管了[VII]军的指挥权。该军的部队仍驻守在前线的同一地段（第13步兵师驻新沙佩勒附近，第14步兵师在其南面，第6巴伐利亚预备役师作为预备队）。

src: After the Anglo-American's disembark on the African coasts they'll surround us. Due to our lack of forces we be unable to resist in battle.
dst: 英美在非洲海岸登陆后将包围我们。由于兵力不足，我们将无力在战斗中抵抗。

src: After the Battle of Salaita, Col. von Lettow-Vorbeck reorganized the German defenses. The Salaita positions were abandoned and German forces moved to the Latema-Reata Hills.  These stood on the way to Kahe. Major Kraut was once again in command of the German defenders.  The British attack on Latema began on March 11.
dst: 萨拉伊塔战役之后，冯·莱托-福尔贝克上校重组了德军防务。萨拉伊塔阵地被放弃，德军部队转移到拉特马-雷亚塔丘陵。这些丘陵位于通往卡赫的路上。克劳特少校再次担任德军守军指挥官。英军于3月11日开始进攻拉特马。

src: After the Battle of Wizna the XIX Corps brings up it's reserves, makes repairs and continues it's advance towards Brest, largely destroying the Polish 18th Infantry Division as it goes. At Wysokie-Masowieki, Polish troops attack the Corps headquarters while Guderian is inspecting the leading elements and debriefing the forward observers. A detatchment from the 3rd Panzer Division is sent back to deal with the Poles but finds the situation already resolved by members of headquaters staff. Little resistance is encountered at Bialystok and apart from a brief skirmish at Chiechanowiec the adavance procedes rapidly.
dst: 维兹纳之战后，第19军调上预备队、进行修理，继续向布列斯特推进，沿途基本歼灭了波兰第18步兵师。在维索基马佐维茨基，波军袭击了军司令部，当时古德里安正在视察先头部队并向前沿观察员听取汇报。第3装甲师派出一个分遣队回身对付波兰人，却发现情况已被司令部参谋人员解决。在比亚韦斯托克几乎未遇抵抗，除了在切哈诺维茨一场短暂的小规模交火外，推进十分迅速。

src: After the Battle of Wizna the XIX Corps brings up it's reserves, makes repairs and continues it's advance towards Brest, largely destroying the Polish 18th Infantry Division as it goes. At Wysokie-Masowieki, Polish troops attack the Corps headquarters while Guderian is inspecting the leading elements and debriefing the forward observers. A detatchment from the 3rd Panzer Division is sent back to deal with the Poles but finds the situation already resolved by members of headquaters staff. Little resistance is encountered at Bialystok and apart from a brief skirmish at Chiechanowiec, the adavance procedes rapidly.
dst: 维兹纳之战后，第19军调上预备队、进行修理，继续向布列斯特推进，沿途基本歼灭了波兰第18步兵师。在维索基马佐维茨基，波军袭击了军司令部，当时古德里安正在视察先头部队并向前沿观察员听取汇报。第3装甲师派出一个分遣队回身对付波兰人，却发现情况已被司令部参谋人员解决。在比亚韦斯托克几乎未遇抵抗，除了在切哈诺维茨一场短暂的小规模交火外，推进十分迅速。

src: After the Chinese defeats at Pyongyang and, especially, the naval disaster of the Yalu river two days later, defending Korea became impossible. Our forces abandoned the country and retreated to the northern bank of the Yalu river, where they would try to stop the advancing Japanese divisions.
dst: 在平壤战败，尤其是两天后鸭绿江的海战惨败之后，守卫朝鲜已无可能。我们的部队放弃了该国，撤退到鸭绿江北岸，试图在那里阻止推进中的日军师团。

src: After the Faschists your great attacks have left the Japanese out of the war, too. The war is finally over. You and your men will achieve the justified honor. Come back to Moscow and join the celebration of the soviet population.
dst: 继法西斯分子之后，你的出色进攻也让日本人退出了战争。战争终于结束了。你和你的部下将获得应有的荣誉。回莫斯科来，加入苏联人民的庆祝吧。

src: After the Great War, Poland became an independent republic again. But rebuilding of the state was halted by the Soviet attack last winter. Instead of the roads and towns that needed to be built, the army had to be sent in to stop the Bolsheviks. A few weeks ago the Russians crushed Polish positions near Wilno and took the city. Then they occupied other Polish territories. Now it's time to stop the bolsheviks and take Wilno back.
dst: 一战结束后，波兰再次成为一个独立的共和国。但国家的重建被去年冬天苏联的进攻打断了。本应修建的道路和城镇，如今却不得不派出军队去阻止布尔什维克。几周前，俄军摧毁了维尔诺附近的波兰阵地并占领了该城。随后他们又占领了其他波兰领土。现在是时候阻止布尔什维克并夺回维尔诺了。

src: After the Medean Pass had been secured, we crossed the Libyan border and defeated the Senussi at Bir Asiso. We captured no less than forty enemy guns and machine guns, took three Turkish officers and hundreds of Senussi prisoners. Now let the Duke's armoured cars round up the enemy stragglers.
dst: 在确保米迪安隘口之后，我们越过了利比亚边境，在比尔阿西索击败了塞努西。我们缴获了不下四十门敌方火炮和机枪，俘获了三名土耳其军官和数百名塞努西俘虏。现在让公爵的装甲车去清剿溃散的敌军吧。

src: After the Melilla campaign in 1909, the area patrolled by the Spanish army reached the eastern bank of the river Kert, although due to the rough terrain and to the lack of resources the Spanish couldn´t build permanent positions.
dst: 1909年梅利利亚战役之后，西班牙军队巡逻的区域抵达了凯尔特河东岸，但由于地形崎岖、资源匮乏，西班牙人无法修建永久性阵地。

src: After the Russian 39rd Army, 29th Army and the 11th Cavalry Corps, now also some troops of the 33rd Army are encircled. Altough we expected more from you in this battle, you have stopped the Russian Winter offensive. Congratulations.
dst: 继俄军第39集团军、第29集团军和第11骑兵军之后，如今第33集团军的一些部队也被合围。虽然我们本以为你在这场战斗里能有更好的表现，但你毕竟遏止了俄军的冬季攻势。恭喜。

src: After the Russian 39rd Army, 29th Army and the 11th Cavalry Corps, now also the 33rd Army is encircled. You have stopped the Russian Winter offensive. Congratulations.
dst: 继俄军第39集团军、第29集团军和第11骑兵军之后，如今第33集团军也被合围。你遏止了俄军的冬季攻势。恭喜。

src: After the Russian Revolution of 1917 the Bolshevik government concluded the separate Treaty of Brest-Litovsk and it was agreed between the Bolsheviks and the corps to evacuate the Czechs and Slovaks to France to join the Czechoslovak corps and continue fighting there. Because the European front was blocked by German and Austrian armies, the evacuation was to be done by a detour via Siberia, the Pacific port of Vladivostok and the USA.
dst: 1917年俄国革命后，布尔什维克政府缔结了单独的《布列斯特-立托夫斯克条约》，布尔什维克与军团商定，将捷克人和斯洛伐克人撤往法国，加入捷克斯洛伐克军团并在那里继续作战。由于欧洲战线被德军和奥军封锁，撤退须绕道西伯利亚、太平洋港口符拉迪沃斯托克和美国。

src: After the Salerno Landings the Germans were retreating. It seems they set up various defence lines between Naples and Rome. Now the first one, the Volturno Line, lies ahead of us. While the British 8th Army is approaching the defence lines along the Adriatic Sea, you and your men while approach the Volturno Line near the Volturno river mouth at the Tyrrhenian Sea. We expect a strong system of defences that will slow down our approach.
dst: 萨莱诺登陆之后，德军一直在撤退。看来他们在那不勒斯与罗马之间设置了多道防线。现在，第一道“沃尔图诺防线”就在我们前方。英国第8集团军正沿亚得里亚海方向逼近防线，而您和您的部下则将从第勒尼安海一侧的沃尔图诺河口附近逼近沃尔图诺防线。我们预计会遇到一套坚固的防御体系，拖慢我们的推进。

src: After the Suez Canal opened in 1869, Egypt sought to take control of the Red Sea coast. As part of his plan, in 1872 Khedive Ismail ordered the occupation of Bogos, a region that Yohannes IV regarded as part of Ethiopia. The Emperor tried to solve the crisis peaceably, and sent John Kirkham, a Scottish adventurer at the service of Ethiopia, to different European countries, looking for some kind of diplomatic support. However, everything was in vain. Nobody took the Ethiopian emissary seriously.
dst: 1869年苏伊士运河通航之后，埃及力图控制红海沿岸。作为其计划的一部分，1872年赫迪夫伊斯梅尔下令占领博戈斯，一个被约翰内斯四世视为埃塞俄比亚一部分的地区。皇帝试图和平解决这场危机，派遣为埃塞俄比亚效力的苏格兰冒险家约翰·柯卡姆前往欧洲各国寻求某种外交支持。然而，一切都是徒劳。没人把这位埃塞俄比亚特使当回事。

src: After the U.S. entered the war in December, they undertook several attempts to bring reinforcements to Iceland, which could be more or less averted. But now it is time to eliminate this isolated outpost!
dst: 美国12月参战后，多次试图向冰岛运送增援，这些行动或多或少被我们挫败。但现在，是时候拔除这个孤立的据点了！

src: After the Western front destruction, you are facing your most difficult duty:- in battle once more against Monty's 8th Army. This is a very difficult mission, but if you are successful you will have stopped the threat of our expulsion from Africa.
dst: 在西线被摧毁之后，您面临最艰难的任务：再次与蒙蒂的第8集团军交战。这是一项非常艰难的任务，但如果您成功，就能阻止我们被逐出非洲的威胁。

src: After the annihilation of the 2nd Army, only a few occupation troops remained in Russia. The German offensive failed at Kursk, we should retreat to the area of the Pripyaty marshes, the border between Ukraine and Belorussia. We have to face strong partisan activity here. The Polish partisans are arch enemies of the Germans, but we have an unofficial cease-fire with them. Moreover, they hate Bolsheviks more than us, and inform us of any Red activity they detect. Your task is to secure Kovel, which is an important junction on the rail line running from Kiev to Warsaw.
dst: 第2集团军被歼灭之后，俄国境内只剩少数占领部队。德军在库尔斯克的攻势归于失败，我们应退往乌克兰与白俄罗斯交界处的普里皮亚季沼泽地区。我们在此必须面对活跃的游击活动。波兰游击队是德国人的死敌，但我们与他们之间有一份非正式的停火默契。不仅如此，他们仇恨布尔什维克更甚于仇恨我们，一旦察觉红军有任何活动便会通报我们。你的任务是确保科韦利的安全，它是基辅通往华沙的铁路线上的重要枢纽。

src: After the assassination of Caesar, his adopted son Octavian and his longtime follower Marcus Antonius formed together with Lepidus a triumvirate.
dst: 凯撒遇刺后，他的养子屋大维与多年的追随者马尔库斯安东尼乌斯，联合雷必达结成了三头同盟。

src: After the assault, the Russian brigade participated in solidifying the French line and was withdrawn to the 5th Army's rear.  In brief, the French Nivelle Offensive failed with serious consequences:  demoralized, many French soldiers refused to obey their officers' orders, and a crisis hung over the entire French Army.  The Russian brigades were not spared the effects of revolution and disenchantment:  soldiers from both brigades mutineed in June of 1917.  The participation of Russian soldiers in the war on the Western Front did not end in June of 1917, however.  By April 1918 the Russian Legion was formed from volunteers and grew to a battalion-sized assault unit during the remainder of the war.  The Russian Legion earned the admiration of French commanders and served with the Moroccan Division.
dst: 突击之后，俄国旅参与巩固法军战线，随后被撤回第5集团军后方。简言之，法军尼韦勒攻势以严重后果告终：士气低落，许多法国士兵拒绝服从军官的命令，一场危机笼罩着整个法军。俄军各旅也未能幸免于革命和幻灭的影响：两个旅的士兵于1917年6月发动兵变。然而，俄国士兵在西线的参战并未止于1917年6月。到1918年4月，俄国军团由志愿者组建而成，在战争余下时间里发展成为营级规模的突击部队。俄国军团赢得了法军指挥官的钦佩，并随摩洛哥师服役。

src: After the attack at Messines - South of Ypres - six weeks ago, British forces are switching their attention to the sector North and East of Ypres. Your task is to counter all attacks and push the Brits back to their starting positions. Unfortunately 4th Army has positioned your (core) Eingreif divisions quite far from the front line. This keeps them safe from enemy artillery fire, but it also means that they cannot counterattack as quickly as you might like.
dst: 六周前伊普尔以南的梅森进攻之后，英军正把注意力转向伊普尔以北和以东的地段。您的任务是反击所有进攻，并把英军打回他们的出发阵地。不幸的是第4集团军把您的（核心）反击师部署在离前线相当远的地方。这能让他们避开敌军炮火，但也意味着他们无法像您希望的那样迅速发起反攻。

src: After the battle of Annual the political turmoil in Spain became so huge that King Alfonso XIII autorized the suspension of the parliamentary system and the dictatorship of General Primo de Rivera.
dst: 安瓦尔战役之后，西班牙政局动荡至极，以致国王阿方索十三世批准中止议会制，并实行普里莫·德里维拉将军的独裁统治。

src: After the battle of Annual, the Berber rebels of the Rif region, commanded by Abd-el-Krim el Jatabbi, felt strong enough to invade the Djebala region in the western part of the Spanish protectorate in Morocco. In the beginning of 1925 they even dared to attack the Uarga Valley, in the southern French protectorate.
dst: 安瓦尔战役之后，里夫地区的柏柏尔叛军在其首领阿卜杜·克里姆·哈塔比的指挥下，自认为已强大到足以入侵摩洛哥西班牙保护地西部的杰巴拉地区。1925年初，他们甚至敢于进攻法属保护地南部的瓦尔加河谷。

src: After the battle of Gorlice, all was quiet on the eastern front. For almost the entire year the war was conducted in the Balkans, Alpes, and Turkish Straits... But in 1916 the Germans decided to start the war of attrition and attacked at Verdun. France was on the edge of disaster so they asked the allies to attack on other fronts to relieve them. The Brits attacked at Somme, Italians at Isonzo, and the Russians began the Brusilov's offensive which pushed the KuK army back.
dst: 戈利采战役后，东线一片平静。在几乎整整一年里，战争在巴尔干、阿尔卑斯山区和土耳其海峡进行……但1916年，德国人决定开启消耗战，在凡尔登发动进攻。法国濒临灾难，于是请求盟友在其他战线进攻以减轻其压力。英国人在索姆河进攻，意大利人在伊松佐河进攻，俄国人则发动了布鲁西洛夫攻势，把奥匈帝国军队击退。

src: After the battle of Kahe, Van Deventer 2nd Division reached Kondoa Irangi and after light German resistance took the town. During its advance, his forces had lost more than 2,000 horses to the Tsetse fly and so its mobility was very restricted. He was ordered to entrench in Kondoa and await reinforcements. When the rainy season began Van Deventer's forces had severe supply problems and were cut off from the rest of British units. Meanwhile, von Lettow-Vorbeck reinforced his units around the town and planned to recapture it.
dst: 卡赫战役之后，范德文特的第2师抵达了孔多阿伊兰吉，并在德军轻微抵抗之后占领了该镇。在推进过程中，他的部队因舌蝇损失了2000多匹马，因此其机动性受到极大限制。他奉命在孔多阿掘壕据守，等待增援。雨季开始时，范德文特的部队面临严重的补给问题，并与其余英军部队断绝了联系。与此同时，冯·莱托-福尔贝克在镇周围增援了他的部队，并计划将其重新夺回。

src: After the battle of Le Cateau, Von Marwitz - commander of II Kavallerie Korps - sends his three cavalry divisions in pursuit of the retreating BEF. On the morning of September 1st, when the fog clears, the 4th Kavallerie Division finds itself eye to eye with the BEF's 1st Cavalry Brigade and the order to attack is given. The 1st Brigade has spent the night in and around Nery far away from other BEF or French forces and finds itself heavily outnumbered against the attacking Germans.
dst: 勒卡托之战后，第2骑兵军军长冯·马尔维茨派出他的三个骑兵师追击撤退中的英国远征军。9月1日清晨，雾气散去，第4骑兵师发现自己与英国远征军第1骑兵旅正面相对，进攻命令随即下达。第1旅在远离英国远征军其他部队和法军的内里及其周边度过了一夜，面对进攻的德军，人数处于绝对劣势。

src: After the battle of Mahiwa, Von Lettow realized that he couldn't afford another battle like that.  This was due to the unsustainable losses of ammunition. His forces were so short of modern ammo that they had to revert to the old Model 71 rifles. These of course used rounds that produced a lot of smoke. To solve this problem Lettow decided to invade Portuguese East Africa.  Here he would capture Portuguese supply dumps.
dst: 马希瓦战役之后，冯·莱托意识到自己再也经受不起一场这样的战斗了。这是因为弹药的损失已难以为继。他的部队十分缺乏现代化弹药，不得不重新使用老式的71式步枪。这些枪当然使用会产生大量烟雾的子弹。为了解决这个问题，莱托决定入侵葡属东非。在那里，他可以缴获葡萄牙人的补给仓库。

src: After the battle of Manila Bay with the Americans, the situation is now becoming complicated with the Filipino insurgents. Emilio Aguinaldo, the leader of the Filipino rebels, has broken the pact of Biak na Bato and used the money we paid him in exchange of peace to buy arms. He has arrived to the Philippines from Hong Kong and, with the support of the U.S., he is raising a newly armed Philippine Revolutionary Army in the province of Cavite.
dst: 在与美国人的马尼拉湾海战之后，局势因菲律宾起义者而变得复杂。菲律宾叛军领袖埃米利奥·阿奎纳多已撕毁比亚克纳巴托协定，并用我们为换取和平而支付给他的钱购买武器。他已从香港抵达菲律宾，并在美国支持下，于甲米地省组建一支新武装的菲律宾革命军。

src: After the battle of Pilkem Ridge, British commander Haigh kept on launching more attacks North and East of Ypres throughout August, looking for a breakthrough. The results were small gains of terrain at higher and higher costs. All until the British got completely stuck after capturing Passchendaele in a final attack early November. All reserves of the British army were spent.
dst: 皮尔肯岭战役之后，英军指挥官黑格在整个8月里继续在伊普尔以北和以东发动更多进攻，寻求突破。结果是付出的代价越来越高，却只换来一点点地盘。直到11月初，英军在一次最后的进攻中攻下帕斯尚代尔后彻底陷于停滞。英军的所有预备队都已耗尽。

src: After the battle of Sokolovo the battalion was extended into the 1st Czechoslovak Independent Brigade which numbered roughly 3500 men and women. Czechoslovaks got new weapons, including field, antiaircraft and antitank artillery, machine guns, armoured cars and even twenty tanks.
dst: 索科洛沃战役之后，该营扩编为捷克斯洛伐克第1独立旅，兵力约3500名男女。捷克斯洛伐克人获得了新武器，包括野战炮、高射炮和反坦克炮、机枪、装甲车，甚至二十辆坦克。

src: After the battle of Stalingrad our units were broken.
dst: 斯大林格勒之战后，我部已元气大伤。

src: After the battle of the Aisne both armies tried to outflank the other in a series of engagements near the French-Belgian border. It was especially important to us, as we could not afford losing the Channel ports of Calais and Boulogne. To achieve that goal, it was imperative to stop the Germans at the Belgian town of Ypres.
dst: 埃纳河战役之后，双方军队都在法比边境附近的一系列交战中试图包抄对方。这对我们尤为重要，因为我们承受不起失去加来和布洛涅这两个海峡港口的代价。要实现这一目标，就必须在比利时城镇伊普尔挡住德军。

src: After the battle, the Egyptians retreated to their bases in the Red Sea coast, leaving much of their equipment behind. That allowed us to acquire hundreds of rifles, as well as a handful of cannons, which would be very useful in the future. However, our enemies had vowed to return with a larger force as soon as they could, and avenge their defeat at Gundet.
dst: 战后，埃及人撤回红海沿岸的基地，留下大量装备。这使我们得以缴获数百支步枪，以及少量火炮，将来会非常有用。然而，我们的敌人发誓要尽快带领更庞大的军队卷土重来，为他们在贡代特的失败报仇。

src: After the battle, the Egyptians went back to their bases in the Red Sea coast, leaving much of their equipment behind. That allowed us to acquire hundreds of rifles, as well as a handful of cannons, which would be very useful in the future. However, our enemies had vowed to return with a larger force as soon as they could, and avenge their defeat at Gundet.
dst: 战后，埃及人撤回红海沿岸的基地，留下了大量装备。这使我们得以缴获数百支步枪，以及少量火炮，将来会非常有用。然而，我们的敌人发誓要尽快带领更庞大的军队卷土重来，为他们在贡代特的失败报仇。

src: After the battles of Tanga and Jassin Von Lettow-Vorbeck turned his attention to the Kilimanjaro area.  Here the proximity of his troops to the Uganda Railway allowed him to mount continuous raids against it.
dst: 在坦噶和贾辛两场战役之后，冯·莱托-福尔贝克将注意力转向了乞力马扎罗地区。在这里，他的部队靠近乌干达铁路，使他得以对其发动连续不断的袭扰。

src: After the big Maroc uprising, we have secured the city of Casablanca and the whole coast, but in Southern Maroc still resist some rebels, holding the important city of Marrakech.
dst: 在摩洛哥大起义之后，我们已确保卡萨布兰卡城和整条海岸，但摩洛哥南部仍有一些叛军据守，占据着重要城市马拉喀什。

src: After the bombing of the Monte Cassio Abby on 15th February German Paratroopers are using the ruins of the Abby as fortress.
dst: 2月15日蒙特卡西诺修道院被轰炸后，德军伞兵正把修道院的废墟当作堡垒使用。

src: After the break trough Crassus siege Spartacus again invaded the interior of Italy as far as the Province of Lukania. Here the Celts under the command of Gannius and Castus devided from Spartacus. Spartacus encamped nearby the Celts to support them in case of an emergency. That was what happened. Crassus redeployed his troops undetected from the main camp to a smaller camp and attacked the Celts at the morning with his entire force. He annihilated them. Spartacus arrived too late, to support them sustainably. As he notified the hopeless Situation of the Celts, he pulled back. The second Commander Quästor Tremellius attacked Spartacus. But Spartacus was able to defeat the Quästor and fled to Lukania.
dst: 突破克拉苏斯的封锁之后，斯巴达克斯再次攻入意大利内陆，直抵卢卡尼亚行省。在这里，由甘尼乌斯与卡斯图斯指挥的凯尔特人脱离斯巴达克斯而去。斯巴达克斯在凯尔特人附近扎营，以便必要时支援他们。事情果然发生了。克拉苏斯神不知鬼不觉地把部队从主营调往一处较小的营地，清晨以全部兵力进攻凯尔特人。他把他们全歼了。斯巴达克斯赶到时已太迟，无法给予有效支援。察觉凯尔特人已陷绝境后，他撤了回来。第二指挥官、财务官特雷梅利乌斯进攻斯巴达克斯。但斯巴达克斯击败了这位财务官，逃入卢卡尼亚。

src: After the break-out of the civil war they choose the side of freedom and because of their military experience in 1848 they are willingly recruited as officers by the Union.
dst: 内战爆发后，他们选择了自由的一方，由于他们在1848年积累的军事经验，联邦军乐于招募他们担任军官。

src: After the capture of Faroe islands, it is time to attack the British naval bases.
dst: 夺取法罗群岛之后，该轮到攻击英国海军基地了。

src: After the capture of Trinidad by our troops a few months ago and the loss of the U.S. airfields there, the Americans probably try to get back a foothold in the southern Caribbean. Our intelligence has received information about a forthcoming operation - obviously the Americans are planning the seizure of French Martinique and other islands. In order not to lose our position here and to ensure the official neutrality of the English and French possessions, this enemy attempt must be stopped.
dst: 几个月前我军夺取特立尼达后，美国人失去了那里的空军基地，他们很可能正试图在南加勒比重新取得立足点。我方情报已获知一场即将到来的行动——显然美国人正计划夺取法属马提尼克等岛屿。为了不丢掉我们在这里的阵地、并确保英法属地的官方中立，必须阻止敌人的这一企图。

src: After the civil war finished, I left the Army and I established myself in Ekaterinburg. I started to work as a teacher, I married and I raised a family. We've been working hard, trying to improve our country and make it thrive. I'm optimistic, and I'm sure that Trans-Ural has a bright future. May God help us to make that dream come true.
dst: 内战结束后，我离开了军队，在叶卡捷琳堡定居。我开始当教师，结婚成家，养育子女。我们一直努力工作，努力改善我们的国家，使它繁荣昌盛。我很乐观，确信外乌拉尔拥有光明的未来。愿上帝帮助我们实现这个梦想。

src: After the collapse of the pro-German regime in Yugoslavia, Wehrmacht launched the invasion of the country on April 7, 1941. The independent state of Croatia was proclaimed on April 10, and under the pretext of protecting the Hungarian minority, the Governor ordered your troops to cross the borders and retake Bácska (Voivodina). Some German divisions will help you.
dst: 在亲德政权于南斯拉夫垮台之后，国防军于1941年4月7日发动了对该国的入侵。克罗地亚独立国于4月10日宣告成立，摄政以保护匈牙利少数民族为借口，命令你的部队越过边界收复巴奇卡（伏伊伏丁那）。会有一些德国师协助你。

src: After the conquest of Kristiansand, your troops have reached the nearby areas to the important city port of Stavanger. Your mission is to defeat the norvegian troops here, and conquest Stavanger and the Sola airport. Troops coming from the sea may help you, and fallskimjaegers will arrive for take the Sola airport. Good Luck.
dst: 在征服克里斯蒂安桑之后，您的部队已抵达重要港口城市斯塔万格附近地区。您的任务是击败这里的挪威军队，并占领斯塔万格和索拉机场。来自海上的部队可以协助您，伞兵也将抵达以夺取索拉机场。祝您好运。

src: After the costly setbacks during the initial landings, the allied advance on Krithia was stopped by the Turks on April 28th, and in some places the British and French were even driven back to their starting positions. Another 3,000 allied troops lost their lives on a devastating day that left the infantry men exhausted, demoralized and virtually leaderless due to an appaling breakdown of command. The high hopes for a swift and crushing victory at Gallipoli vanished and the whole campaign turned into trench warfare.
dst: 在初期登陆遭受惨重挫折之后，协约国对克里希亚的推进于4月28日被土耳其军阻止，在一些地方英法军队甚至被赶回出发点。在这灾难性的一天里，又有3000名协约国官兵丧生，指挥体系的严重失灵使步兵精疲力竭、士气低落，几乎群龙无首。对加里波利速战速决的厚望化为泡影，整个战役变成了堑壕战。

src: After the crossing of the Canal Albert by German troops, the Belgian army has received the order to retreat to the "Ligne KW" (Dyle Position). In order to protect the retreat and give time to take the new positions, you will support the "2e Division de Cavalerie" (2 DC) to establish a temporary defensive line in the Gete river, between Diest and Tienen (Tirlemont).
dst: 德军渡过阿尔贝特运河后，比利时军队已奉命撤往“KW 防线”（迪尔河阵地）。为掩护撤退并争取时间进入新阵地，您将支援“第2骑兵师”（2 DC），在迪斯特与蒂嫩（蒂尔勒蒙）之间的盖特河建立一道临时防线。

src: After the crushing blow that we dealt to the Western Allies in the Ardennes, our troops have been slowly pushed back behind the Rhein.
dst: 在我们在阿登给西方盟国以毁灭性打击之后，我军已被缓慢逼退到莱茵河之后。

src: After the defeat at Tobruk, Rommel had pressured the High Command to plan to take Malta, because for the intended advance to Egypt, they needed to have a secured route of supplies.
dst: 托布鲁克战败之后，隆美尔向最高统帅部施压，要求策划夺取马耳他，因为要按计划向埃及推进，就必须拥有一条安全的补给路线。

src: After the defeat of his lieutenants, Varinius was finally having a larger troop contingent to the site and surrounded the slave army at the camp of Heraclea. Spartacus recognized the weakness of his position, where he and his men would soon be cut off from supply. Nevertheless, he let his troops continue to strengthen the fortifications, so that Varinius happy believed that the Thracian prepared to a long siege. At night, Spartacus let bodies set up as guardians and left quietly position. He successfully led his men under the protection of the night, passing the too careless Romans. Varinius only became suspicious when he no longer heard the usual background noise from the slave camp. He conquered the empty camp and would have torn his hair when realizing how he had been led around by the nose.
dst: 在部将相继被击败后，瓦里尼乌斯终于带着更大的一支部队赶到，把奴隶军围困在赫拉克利亚营地。斯巴达克斯意识到自己处境不利，很快就会与补给断绝。但他仍让部队继续加固工事，使瓦里尼乌斯满心以为这位色雷斯人准备长期坚守。夜里，斯巴达克斯命人立起尸体充当哨兵，悄然撤离。他成功带领部下借夜色掩护，从过于松懈的罗马人身边通过。直到再也听不到奴隶营地惯常的嘈杂声，瓦里尼乌斯才起疑。他攻下空营，若有所悟自己是被牵着鼻子绕了一圈，怕是要把头发都揪下来。

src: After the end of the Gallipoli campaign the gallantry of the troops became a legend which compared favourably with the Trojan Wars, the site of which was so near to the Gallipoli battlefront. About 87,000 Turks, 25,000 British, almost 10,000 French, 7,300 Australians, 2,400 New Zealanders and 1,700 Indians had lost their lives in what was, in the final reckoning, a campaign ruined by catastrophic incompetence, over which not even the heroism displayed at every turn could emerge victorious.
dst: 加里波利战役结束后，将士们的英勇成为一段传奇，堪与特洛伊战争相媲美——而特洛伊古战场就在加里波利战场附近。最终清点下来，约有87000名土耳其人、25000名英国人、近10000名法国人、7300名澳大利亚人、2400名新西兰人和1700名印度人在这场被灾难性的无能所葬送的战役中丧生，纵使处处展现的英雄气概也无法换来胜利。

src: After the failed San Offensive, we have had to retreat toward Kraków. The Germans can't send the promised troops to help you as they have launched a new offensive to take Lódz. We hold the fortified area of Kraków, but there is a 200 km wide gap between the 3rd and 4th KuK Armies. The 3rd Russian Army is expected to attack here. The High Command chose your division to fill the gap at Limanowa and hold the lines until reinforcements relieve your men. General, you must stop the Russian steamroller here and now and prevent their break into Silesia and Hungary.
dst: 桑河攻势失败后，我们不得不向克拉科夫撤退。德国人因发动了夺取罗兹的新攻势，无法派出承诺的部队来帮您。我们守着克拉科夫的要塞区，但奥匈第3、第4集团军之间存在一个宽达200公里的缺口。俄国第3集团军预计将在此发起进攻。最高统帅部选中您的师去填补利马诺瓦的缺口，并守住防线直到援军接替您的部队。将军，您必须在此刻此地阻止俄国这台蒸汽压路机，防止他们突入西里西亚与匈牙利。

src: After the failed attempt to fortify Subic Bay, where our new naval base is being built, Rear Admiral Patricio Montojo has ordered his squadron back to Manila. He has placed it opposite to the Cavite Arsenal, in order to spare Manila from bombardment. So the decisive battle will be fought in Manila Bay's waters.
dst: 在试图加强正在建设的新海军基地苏比克湾防御的努力失败后，帕特里西奥·蒙托霍少将已命令其分舰队返回马尼拉。他将其部署在甲米地兵工厂对面，以免马尼拉遭到炮击。因此，决战将在马尼拉湾水域打响。

src: After the failure of Zitadelle, Soviets started to push hard against the Axis.Germans tried to stop the onslaught by building Ostwall, an immense defensive line, with Smolensk being one of the key centres of defense.
dst: “堡垒”行动失败后，苏军开始猛攻轴心国。德军试图修建“东方壁垒”——一道庞大的防线——以阻止攻势，斯摩棱斯克正是防御的关键中心之一。

src: After the failure of the relieving counterattacks (Operation Konrad I-III) and desperate breakout attempts, the remaining defenders finally surrendered on February 13, 1945. German and Hungarian military losses were high with entire divisions wiped out. The Germans lost all or most of the 13th Panzer Division, the 60th Panzergrenadier Division, the 8th SS Cavalry Division Florian Geyer and the 22nd SS Volunteer Cavalry Division Maria Theresa. The Hungarian 1st Corps was virtually annihilated. Budapest lay in ruins, with more than 80 percent of its buildings destroyed or damaged, with historical buildings like the Hungarian Parliament Building and the Royal Castle among them. All five bridges spanning the Danube were destroyed.
dst: 在解围反击（「康拉德」一号至三号行动）失败和绝望的突围尝试之后，残存的守军终于在1945年2月13日投降。德军和匈军的损失极为惨重，整建制师被全歼。德军损失了第13装甲师、第60装甲掷弹兵师、党卫军第8骑兵师「弗洛里安·盖尔」和党卫军第22志愿骑兵师「玛丽亚·特蕾西亚」的全部或大部。匈牙利第1军几乎被全歼。布达佩斯化为废墟，八成以上的建筑物被摧毁或受损，匈牙利国会大厦和王宫等历史建筑也在其中。横跨多瑙河的五座桥梁全部被毁。

src: After the fall of Alexandria and Cairo, British and American forces lead by Ike opened a second front in North Africa - Operation Torch. It took von Arnim many months to stabilize that front in Algeria and Tunisia using mainly German forces.
dst: 亚历山大和开罗陷落后，由艾克率领的英美军队在北非开辟了第二战场——“火炬”行动。冯·阿尼姆用了好几个月，主要靠德军才稳定住阿尔及利亚和突尼斯的那条战线。

src: After the fall of Antwerp that resulted in 35,000 Belgian fortress troops captured and the 1st British Naval Brigade interned in the Netherlands, our III Reserve Corps has pursued the retreating Belgian Army for more than a week. The Belgian Army has stopped its retreat and has taken position behind the river Yzer between Dixmude and Nieuport, holding on to the last small piece of unoccupied Belgium. By doing this, they are completing a continuous frontline that runs from the Swiss border in the South-East all the way to the North Sea in the North-West.
dst: 安特卫普陷落，35000名比利时要塞部队被俘，英国第1海军旅在荷兰被扣留。此后，我方第3预备军追击撤退中的比利时陆军已有一个多星期。比利时陆军已停止撤退，在迪克斯迈德与尼乌波特之间的伊泽尔河后方占据阵地，据守着比利时最后一片未被占领的土地。这样一来，他们便补全了一条从东南方瑞士边境一直延伸到西北方北海的绵亘战线。

src: After the fall of Baghdad, we will never again suffer from the lack of fuel. Only Persia, one of the places with the most petrol reserves in the World, is still not under our control. Please give me a moment to explain to you the Persian situation:-
dst: 在巴格达陷落之后，我们再也不会饱受燃料匮乏之苦。只有波斯——世界上石油储量最多的地方之一——仍不在我们控制之下。请给我一点时间向您说明波斯的局势：

src: After the fall of Basra, the last Commonwealth troops in Iraq withdrew on the Faw Peninsula and wait for their evacuation. Due to the loss of the port in Basra, only a small harbor at Al Qushlah remains for embarkation. If we act quickly it should possible to capture most of these troops. Air support for your attack is ensured - Iran has allowed the use of their airfield at Abadan by our Luftwaffe.
dst: 巴士拉陷落后，伊拉克最后的英联邦部队撤到了法奥半岛，等待撤离。由于巴士拉港失守，只剩下库什拉的一个小港可供登船。如果我们行动迅速，应该能俘获这些部队的大部分。你进攻的空中支援已有保障——伊朗已允许我们的德国空军使用他们在阿巴丹的机场。

src: After the fall of Burma, the British will be busy for a long time! hahaha.  The Burma Road will no longer be the life line for our old Chinese enemies.  The Chinese supplies are running out quickly and now it's time to begin the end for the Chinese campaign at once.  We should take advantage of this opportunity!  Your mission is to capture Kunming, one of the latest supply depots the Chinese still hold.  This won't be easy because the mountain terrain will allow the dirty Chinese to ambush us every step of the way, but we count on you once again to complete this mission.
dst: 缅甸陷落之后，英国人将有很长时间忙不过来！哈哈哈。滇缅公路将不再是我们这些中国老对手的生命线。中国的补给正迅速耗尽，现在是立刻着手结束中国战役的时候了。我们应当利用这个机会！您的任务是夺取昆明，那是中国仍然掌握的最后几个补给基地之一。这不会容易，因为山地地形会让卑鄙的中国人一路伏击我们，但我们再次指望您来完成这项任务。

src: After the fall of Dieppe and the evacuation of the British forces, taking Rouen was extremely easy. At this stage the French Navy and a great part of the French Army are in open mutiny and the radicalism amongst the working class soldiery is rising. We've opened a second front  in the south, where our troops stationed in Italy are marching towards Marseille. At last we can say that France is doomed.
dst: 在迪耶普陷落、英军撤离之后，攻克鲁昂变得极为容易。到了这个阶段，法国海军和大部分法国陆军已公开哗变，工农士兵中的激进情绪日益高涨。我们已在南方开辟了第二战线，驻扎在意大利的我军正向马赛挺进。我们终于可以说，法国注定败亡了。

src: After the fall of El Cairo and Port Said, the last point of British resistance in Egypt is the Suez Canal. The enemy have regrouped some units around Suez as a last chance to stop us. Intelligence reports say that the Americans are preparing an invasion of Nort Africa soon so you must finish with the British as soon as possible, to control the Suez Canal for a possible meeting with the Americans in the coming months.
dst: 在开罗和塞得港陷落之后，英国在埃及抵抗的最后一个据点是苏伊士运河。敌人已在苏伊士周边重整了一些部队，作为阻止我们的最后机会。情报报告称美国人正筹备不久后入侵北非，所以您必须尽快解决英国人，控制苏伊士运河，以便在今后几个月可能与美国人会师。

src: After the fall of Gaza, the EEF advanced along the Maritime Plain and then performed a right turn into the Judean Hills in order to march on Jerusalem.
dst: 加沙陷落后，埃及远征军沿海岸平原推进，随后右转进入朱迪亚丘陵，以便向耶路撒冷进军。

src: After the fall of Jerusalem, we were able to stop the British forces in the Valley of the Jordan. The German generals decided to dig us in, in a "Western Front" style, with big trench-systems, MG-nests and entrenchend artillery. Theorically, that would force the British to attack on free ground against our defence system, suffering heavy losses.
dst: 耶路撒冷陷落后，我们在约旦河谷挡住了英军。德国将军们决定让我们构筑「西线」式的工事，包括庞大的战壕体系、机枪巢和隐蔽炮兵阵地。理论上，这将迫使英军在开阔地带进攻我方防御体系，从而遭受惨重损失。

src: After the fall of London the British government has resigned and the new prime minister, Lord Halifax, has asked for an armistice. However, some members of the former government fled to Canada and have called for further resistance by the british dominions and colonies.
dst: 伦敦陷落后，英国政府辞职，新首相哈利法克斯勋爵请求停战。然而，前政府的一些成员逃往加拿大，并号召英国各自治领和殖民地继续抵抗。

src: After the fall of New York, the city will now be transformed into a fortified stronghold under German control.
dst: 在纽约陷落之后，这座城市如今将被改造为德军控制下的设防要塞。

src: After the fall of the capital, the first voices in American politics and public are heard, which advocating for an end to the war. A good sign! After this hard but important battle your troops need some rest and will return to their winter camp!
dst: 首都陷落后，美国政界和公众中传出了第一批主张结束战争的声音。好兆头！经过这场艰苦而重要的战斗，你的部队需要一些休整，将返回冬季营地！

src: After the first success against the British (and against the orders of Hitler), the situation is turning positive for us. The British are withdrawing thier troops, Mersa el Brega has fallen into our hands, and now we must continue the offensive on towards Benghazi, then later to Mechilli. In this way, Cyrenaica will be secured, and the front lines restored for the moment.
dst: 在对英军取得首次胜利之后（此举也违背了希特勒的命令），形势正朝着有利于我们的方向转变。英军正在撤走其部队，梅尔萨布赖加已落入我们手中，现在我们必须继续向班加西、随后向梅基利进攻。这样，昔兰尼加就能得到确保，战线也可暂时恢复。

src: After the great German storms in the fifth century, all the Roman legions were withdrawn and the Roman rule ends there forever....at this time, the famous Arthurian legend, begun...
dst: 五世纪日耳曼大风暴之后，罗马军团全部撤离，罗马的统治在那里永远终结……也就在此时，著名的亚瑟王传说开始了……

src: After the heavy defeat at Tehran the Soviets withdraw from Iran. The retreat runs relatively orderly but slow. If we act quickly, it might be possible to cut off some Soviet divisions at Tabriz. Attack with your forces and interrupt the Tabriz - Jolfa rail link.
dst: 在德黑兰遭遇惨败后，苏军正撤出伊朗。撤退相对有序但缓慢。如果我们行动迅速，或许能在大不里士切断一些苏军师。率你的部队进攻，切断大不里士-焦勒法铁路线。

src: After the late founding of the German Empire in 1871 (It was the second; the first, called 'Holy Roman Empire of the German Nation'  ended in 1806 when Napoleon defeated it.), Germany forced into the rank of the great colonial powers. Germany also requires a 'place in the sun'...
dst: 在1871年德意志帝国姗姗来迟地建立之后（这是第二个帝国；第一个被称为「德意志民族神圣罗马帝国」，1806年被拿破仑击败后终结），德国强行跻身于殖民列强之列。德国同样需要一片「阳光下的土地」……

src: After the liberation of Kiev, the parts of the 1st Czechoslovak Independent Brigade moved to the area of Vasilkiv, where they underwent several missions during early days of November. Then at the very end of the year the whole brigade once again fought united. It took part in liberation of Ruda and Czechoslovaks lead the assault of Bila Cerkva.
dst: 解放基辅之后，捷克斯洛伐克第1独立旅的各部移师瓦西里基夫地区，在11月初执行了多次任务。到年底，全旅再次统一作战。它参加了鲁达的解放，捷克斯洛伐克人还领头突击了白采尔克瓦。

src: After the murder of the Royal Family our determination to destroy the Bolshevik scum is stronger than ever. Despite all our suffering and all our losses, Providence is guiding us. Just four months ago we had to retire from the Kuban, defeated, without a leader and virtually without hope. Now, in a matter of days, we'll liberate all this region.
dst: 皇室被杀害之后，我们消灭布尔什维克渣滓的决心比以往更加坚定。尽管我们历经苦难和损失，上苍仍在指引着我们。就在四个月前，我们还不得不兵败撤离库班，群龙无首，几乎毫无希望。如今，用不了几天，我们就将解放整个地区。

src: After the past victories in our disembarks, the High Command want you to lead the assault on Trondheim. A part from our army is southwards of the coast, however, by the momment we can not send reinforcements to that area, you and your troops must avoid the allies could destroy our positions in that zone, and take Trondheim too.
dst: 在我们登陆作战取得一系列胜利之后，最高统帅部希望您领导对特隆赫姆的进攻。我军一部位于海岸以南，然而眼下我们无法向该地区派出增援，您和您的部队必须防止盟军摧毁我们在那一带的阵地，同时也要拿下特隆赫姆。

src: After the raid in Portuguese East Africa, Lettow decided to go to Northern Rodhesia to continue distracting Entente forces from the war in Europe. After a long march they arrived at Kasama and Chambesi, where notice of the Armistice arrived. Subsequently Lettow surrendered his forces at Abercorn in Nov 25 1918.
dst: 在葡属东非的袭扰之后，莱托决定前往北罗得西亚，继续牵制协约国在欧洲战场上的兵力。经过长途行军，他们抵达了卡萨马和尚贝西，在那里传来了停战的消息。随后，莱托于1918年11月25日在阿伯康交出了他的部队。

src: After the retreat from Salaita and Latema, von Lettow-Vorbeck forces regrouped at Kahe.  Here they planed to stop the British long enough for the start of the rainy season.  This would make any British pursuit nearly impossible.
dst: 从萨拉伊塔和拉特马撤退之后，冯·莱托-福尔贝克的部队在卡赫重新集结。他们计划在这里挡住英军足够长的时间，以撑到雨季开始。这将使英军的任何追击都几乎不可能实现。

src: After the succes at Iceland, your fleet moves to Calais. Your marines landed to Scotland. Another strike at British ground will be not only a message to the British, but will also create a chaos to the local goverment of Scotland.
dst: 继冰岛告捷之后，你的舰队驶往加来。你的海军陆战队已在苏格兰登陆。对英国本土的又一次打击不仅是对英国人的一个信号，也将在苏格兰地方政府中制造混乱。

src: After the successful Allied campaign in Sicily, followed by the British 8th Army crossing the Strait of Messina and the US 5th Army landing in Salerno, the Italians surrendered and the Germans were driven out of muchg of Southern Italy.
dst: 盟军西西里战役告捷之后，英军第8集团军渡过墨西拿海峡、美军第5集团军在萨莱诺登陆，意军投降，德军被逐出南意大利大部。

src: After the successful breakout you will advance with your troops to the southwest. Your goal is to reach the Gulf of Mexico east of Tallahasee and cut off the enemy troops standing in Florida.
dst: 突围成功后，你将率部队向西南推进。你的目标是抵达塔拉哈西以东的墨西哥湾，切断驻扎在佛罗里达的敌军。

src: After the surrender of Finland Romania now have sued for peace too. Thereby the Germans have lost their important oilfields in Romania. Soon the Germans will be as immobile as a 90 year old rollator-grandma. So, the victory over the Faschist will be a waltz.
dst: 在芬兰投降之后，罗马尼亚现在也请求和平了。这样一来，德国人就失去了他们在罗马尼亚的重要油田。很快德国人就会像一位90岁、推着助行架的老奶奶一样动弹不得。所以，战胜法西斯将如同一支华尔兹。

src: After the turn to the south, Spartacus met the newly organized Roman legions, probably under the joint command of Lentulus, Gellius and Arrius. They again experienced a setback.
dst: 转向南方之后，斯巴达克斯与重新整编的罗马军团遭遇，大概由伦图卢斯、盖利乌斯与阿里乌斯共同指挥。他们再次遭遇挫败。

src: After the victory in Lillehammer, the south of Norway is mostly over control. Your troops have reached the coast after accomplish all their objetives on the inland. Your mission now is to take Trondheim and all the nearby bases. OKH and OKW have reports that confirm the allied presence in the area. Troops and Kriegsmarine ships will help you from the sea, good luck.
dst: 在利勒哈默尔取得胜利之后，挪威南部已基本处于我方控制之下。您的部队在完成内陆的所有目标后已抵达海岸。您现在的任务是夺取特隆赫姆及其附近的所有基地。陆军总司令部（OKH）和国防军最高统帅部（OKW）收到的报告证实该地区有盟军存在。陆军部队和德国海军舰船将从海上支援您，祝您好运。

src: After the war against the Soviet Union was won we ended up with a large stockpile of USSR tanks. You will receive a free IS-2 tank unit.
dst: 在对苏联的战争获胜后，我们缴获了大量苏联坦克库存。你将获得一个免费的 IS-2 坦克单位。

src: After their failure at Núi Bop the French considered retreating from the Luc Nam valley, although they finally rejected the idea. They couldn't afford being humiliated by the "yellow savages", so they sent even more reinforcements to the area, determined to take Lang Son once and for all.
dst: 在努伊博普受挫后，法军一度考虑从陆南河谷撤退，但最终还是否决了这一想法。他们承受不起被「黄种野蛮人」羞辱的后果，于是向该地区派出了更多援军，决心一举拿下谅山。

src: After these 7 long years of war, our long awaited objective is now near; the complete conquest of China, and the unconditional surrender of all the Chinese forces.  Although we eliminated their supply lines some time ago, their new capital, Chongqing is still resisting our assaults.  Your mission is simply to take the enemy capital, without taking into account the losses; we must defeat the Chinese at all costs!
dst: 经过这漫长的七年战争，我们期盼已久的目标如今近在眼前：彻底征服中国，迫使中国所有军队无条件投降。虽然我们此前已切断了他们的补给线，但其新首都重庆仍在抵抗我们的进攻。您的任务很简单，就是拿下敌军首都，不必计较损失；我们必须不惜一切代价打败中国人！

src: After these initial victories, from its headquartes in Samara the Komuch decided that our next step should be to capture Saratov, in the south. If Saratov and Tsaritsyn fell in our hands, we'd have a chance to link with the Don cossacks and the Volunteer Army, who were fighting the Bolsheviks in Southern Russia.
