However, Kappel believed that Kazan, in the north, was a more important target, where we could get decent equipment, ammunition, and new volunteers.
dst: 取得这些初步胜利后，科穆奇在萨马拉的总部决定，我们的下一步应夺取南方的萨拉托夫。如果萨拉托夫和察里津落入我们手中，我们就有机会与正在俄国南部同布尔什维克作战的顿河哥萨克和志愿军会合。然而，卡佩尔认为北方的喀山才是更重要的目标，在那里我们可以获得像样的装备、弹药和新志愿兵。

src: After this battle the Eastern campaign for you and your troops is over. Russia is not yet pacified, but new tasks wait in the west. Your troops will be moved to the winter camp to England.
dst: 此战之后，对你和你的部队而言，东线战役就此结束。俄国尚未平定，但西面有新的任务在等着你们。你的部队将移往英格兰的冬季营地。

src: After this battle you will be remembered as one of the finest generals of modern times. You have routed the British Army and saved Cronjé and de Wet! But there is no time to lose, you must chase Roberts's soldiers before they have time to regroup.
dst: 这场战斗之后，您将被铭记为近代最杰出的将军之一。您击溃了英军，并救出了克罗涅和德韦特！但机不可失，您必须趁罗伯茨的士兵还没时间重新集结就去追击他们。

src: After this defeat Von Lettow has run out of ammunition and it is imposible for him to obtain supplies. The German army must surrender. Your campaign is over.
dst: 经过这场失败，冯·莱托的弹药已经耗尽，他也无法获得补给。德军必须投降。您的战役结束了。

src: After this defeat any roman plans of expansion into the right Rhine area have been cancelled and the Rhine border has been enforced. While in the german Southwest people could enjoy the advantages of roman civilisation and pax romana ( Trevorum Augusta= Trier has been the largest city north of the alpes and capital and emperors seat) the barbars in the east never had these...:-)
dst: 此败之后，罗马向莱茵河右岸扩张的一切计划都被取消，莱茵边界得到加强。当西南日耳曼地区的人们得以享受罗马文明与「罗马和平」的种种好处时（特雷维罗鲁姆·奥古斯塔＝特里尔曾是阿尔卑斯山以北最大的城市、也是首府与皇帝驻地），东边的蛮族却从未拥有这些...:-)

src: After this defeat we'll have to stop our offensive in Thrace and start peace negotiations with the Ottomans. We really expected more from you, General. Soon you will be relieved of command.
dst: 这次战败之后，我们不得不停止在色雷斯的攻势，并开始与奥斯曼人进行和平谈判。将军，我们原本对您期望更高。您很快就会被解除指挥权。

src: After this fiasco, you should better hurry to shoot yourself. Adieu.
dst: 出了这么大的洋相，您最好赶紧举枪自尽吧。再会。

src: After this poor performance, we won't need your service anymore. You'd better resign.
dst: 经过这次糟糕的表现，我们不再需要您效力了。您最好辞职吧。

src: After this second victory, the whole world looks impressed at Bulgaria. Our offensive in Thrace seems unstoppable, and if we continue our advance, our dream of conquering Tsarigrad might soon become true.
dst: 取得这第二次胜利之后，全世界都对保加利亚刮目相看。我们在色雷斯的攻势似乎势不可挡，如果我们继续推进，我们征服察里格勒的梦想也许很快就会成真。

src: After three days of fighting we finally reached the left shore of the Nile River, where we could send a ship to rescue General Gordon. But all our efforts were in vain, the Dervishes had murdered Gordon and his remaining troops just two days before our steamer arrived in Khartoum. With great sadness in our hearts we returned to Korti and some days later we were back in Egypt. For the next thirteen years the Dervishes were the true masters of Sudan.
dst: 经过三天的战斗，我们终于抵达了尼罗河左岸，在那里我们可以派船去营救戈登将军。但我们的一切努力都付诸东流，德尔维希人就在我们的轮船抵达喀土穆前两天杀害了戈登及其残余部队。我们怀着无比沉痛的心情返回科尔蒂，数日后回到埃及。此后十三年里，德尔维希人一直是苏丹真正的主宰。

src: After three days of fighting, during which I was badly wounded by a Dervish spear and nearly died, we finally reached the left shore of the Nile River, where we could send a ship to rescue General Gordon. But all our efforts were in vain, the Dervishes had murdered Gordon and his remaining troops just two days before our steamer arrived in Khartoum. With great sadness in our hearts we returned to Korti and some days later we were back in Egypt, where I could recover from my wound. For the next thirteen years the Dervishes were the true masters of Sudan.
dst: 经过三天的战斗——其间我被德尔维希人的长矛重伤，险些丧命——我们终于抵达了尼罗河左岸，在那里我们可以派船去营救戈登将军。但我们的一切努力都付诸东流，德尔维希人就在我们的轮船抵达喀土穆前两天杀害了戈登及其残余部队。我们怀着无比沉痛的心情返回科尔蒂，数日后回到埃及，在那里我可以养伤。此后十三年里，德尔维希人一直是苏丹真正的主宰。

src: After three months of ferocious fighting, and with the help of more than 100,000 reinforcement troops, the French colonial army was finally able to repel the Berber offensive. But in the meantime 48 out of 66 French frontier posts were destroyed by the rebels, some 3,000 French soldiers died, and Abd el-Krim´s army was on the brink of taking the cities of Fez and Taza.
dst: 经过三个月的激战，并得到超过10万增援部队的支援，法国殖民军终于击退了柏柏尔人的攻势。但在此期间，66个法国边境哨所中有48个被叛军摧毁，约3000名法国士兵阵亡，阿卜杜·克里姆的军队一度濒临攻克菲斯和塔扎两城。

src: After three weeks of fighting, badly beaten, and incapable of to continuing the battle due to the many casualties, the remnants of the French "division de Cilicie" had been forced to retreat.
dst: 经过三周的战斗，法军「奇里乞亚师」残部伤亡惨重，无力再战，被迫撤退。

src: After three weeks of fighting, the French "division de Cilicie" has retreated from Marash.
dst: 经过三周的战斗，法军「奇里乞亚师」已从马拉什撤退。

src: After three weeks of fighting, the remnants of the French "division de Cilicie" had been forced to retreat.
dst: 经过三周的战斗，法军「奇里乞亚师」残部被迫撤退。

src: After three years of fighting in several fronts against some of the most powerful countries in the world, Turkey couldn't resist any longer. The war ended on 30 October 1918, when the Armistice of Mudros was signed. The peace conditions were extremely harsh: Istambul and Eastern Thrace were occupied, and the Empire partitioned. The Ottomans lost all their remaining possessions and political rights in Northern Africa, Arabia and Mesopotamia. Even worse, during 1919 British, Italian, French and Greek forces occupied most of the Anatolian coastal regions.
dst: 在多个战线上与世界上一些最强大的国家作战三年之后，土耳其再也无法支撑。战争于1918年10月30日结束，穆兹罗斯停战协定签署。和平条件极为苛刻：伊斯坦布尔和东色雷斯被占领，帝国被瓜分。奥斯曼人丧失了他们在北非、阿拉伯和美索不达米亚所有剩余的领地和政治权利。更糟的是，1919年间，英国、意大利、法国和希腊军队占领了安纳托利亚大部分沿海地区。

src: After two days of hard fighting the 1st Czechoslovak Independent Field Battalion still held the village. But as the German ring around Kharkov was closing, nothing could be done to prevent the withdrawal. Czechoslovaks left the positions in good order, but leaving no less than one hundred fallen and many others wounded. But the Germans also payed the price, they've lost three to four hundred of men and more than twenty armoured vehicles from some fourty to sixty deployed.
dst: 经过两天激战，捷克斯洛伐克第1独立野战营仍坚守着村庄。但随着德军对哈尔科夫的包围圈逐渐合拢，撤离已无可避免。捷克斯洛伐克人有条不紊地撤出阵地，却留下了不下百名阵亡者和众多伤员。但德军也付出了代价——他们损失了三四百人，以及投入的四五十辆装甲车辆中的二十多辆。

src: After two months of fighting, and after the situation on battlefield swinged back and forth for several times, the Germans were finally able to conquer Narvik. The port became important for future plans and campaigns.
dst: 经过两个月作战，战场态势几经反复，德军终夺纳尔维克。该港口对日后的计划与战役意义重大。

src: After two years of struggle getting through Russia, the Czech Legion had finally reached Wladiwostok and all what was left was waiting on ships to take them home, as initially there were not sufficient ships to take all back home at once.
dst: 在俄国历经两年艰苦跋涉后，捷克军团终于抵达符拉迪沃斯托克，剩下的只有等待船只载他们回家，因为起初没有足够的船只一次性把所有人送回国。

src: After we made peace with Finland, we want to urge Romania out of the war, because with the loss of the Romanian oilfield the Germans will not be able to perform big resistance. You have to break through the Axis lines at Jassy.
dst: 在与芬兰缔结和平后，我们想迫使罗马尼亚退出战争，因为一旦失去罗马尼亚油田，德国人将无法进行大规模抵抗。你必须突破雅西的轴心国防线。

src: After we won the war I had to spend some time in Ceuta, recovering from my wound. My career in the Spanish army was over, and I realised that, with my sick leg, it would be very difficult to go back home and work as a farmer. At least I still knew how to fight with my fists, so eventually I became a bodyguard for many European businessmen who wished to invest in Northern Africa, but were too scared of the natives.
dst: 战争胜利之后，我不得不在休达待了一段时间养伤。我在西班牙军队的生涯就此结束，我也意识到，凭这条残腿，很难再回家务农了。至少我还会用拳头打架，于是最终我成了许多欧洲商人的保镖，这些人想在北非投资，却又害怕当地土著。

src: After weeks of fierce fighting and ruthless weather we've crossed the white hell and reached the Kuban, just to see that Ekaterinodar has also fallen into the hands of the Bolsheviks. Despite all our efforts, our fate seems to be sealed.
dst: 经过数周激烈战斗和恶劣天气，我们穿越了白色的地狱，抵达库班，却只看到叶卡捷琳诺达尔也落入了布尔什维克之手。尽管我们竭尽全力，命运似乎已经注定。

src: After weeks of fierce fighting and ruthless weather, and after losing  many brave soldiers and  civilians that counted on our protection, we've crossed the white hell and reached the Kuban, just to see that Ekaterinodar has also fallen into the hands of the Bolsheviks. Despite all our efforts, our fate seems to be sealed.
dst: 经过数周激烈战斗和恶劣天气，在失去许多勇敢的士兵和依赖我们保护的平民之后，我们穿越了白色的地狱，抵达库班，却只看到叶卡捷琳诺达尔也落入了布尔什维克之手。尽管我们竭尽全力，命运似乎已经注定。

src: After you defeated Gellius and Arrius, the path to freedom over the Alps, where many of your followers have their home, lays clear. But is the way really free?
dst: 在你击败盖利乌斯与阿里乌斯之后，翻越阿尔卑斯山通往自由的路已经畅通——那里是你们许多人的故乡。但这条路真的自由吗？

src: After you've beaten Lentullus, you hear of the defeat that Crixus had suffered against Gellius and Arrius. You couldn´t put up with this accusation.
dst: 在你打败伦图卢斯之后，你听说克里克索斯败在盖利乌斯与阿里乌斯手下。你无法容忍这样的指责。

src: After you've destroyed the Anglo-American forces in Bone and stop the advance of the 8th army, we are going to chase the survivors of Bone toward Algiers to destroy the second front and take our revenge against the French traitors.
dst: 在您摧毁博讷的英美军队并阻止第8集团军推进之后，我们将把博讷的残部追向阿尔及尔，以摧毁第二战场，并向法国叛徒复仇。

src: After your first successful actions with the People's Army, and with our new Soviet equipment, received in the past few days, we are in a good position to launch our first big offensive of the war.
dst: 您随共和军取得最初的几场成功行动之后，加上最近几天收到的苏联新装备，我们已处于有利地位，可以发动这场战争中的第一次大规模攻势。

src: After your forces have now reached the Lake Erie, turn your forces to southwest and start the attack on Cleveland. Cleveland is one of the largest cities in the United States and several enemy divisions are ready to defend the city. Southeast of Cleveland is a large ammunition depot of the U.S. Army, the Ravenna Arsenal. Also this object is one of your attack targets!
dst: 你的部队现已抵达伊利湖，把部队转向西南，发起对克利夫兰的进攻。克利夫兰是美国最大的城市之一，已有数个敌军师准备防守该城。克利夫兰东南方是美国陆军的一处大型弹药库——拉文纳兵工厂。这个目标也是你的进攻目标之一！

src: After your good start we need to press our advantage and increase our beach-head before the Turks have a chance to regroup. Take your objectives and we may yet get to those Coastal Guns!!
dst: 在您良好的开局之后，我们必须趁土耳其人来不及重整之机扩大优势、扩大我们的滩头阵地。拿下您的目标，我们或许还能逼近那些海岸炮！！

src: After your great success at Hong Kong and Macao, the high command wants you to assault the Malayan peninsula.  The last British stronghold in Asia is just at the end of the Malayan peninsula, Singapore!  That city-fortress is still an important base for the Royal Navy, and a menace to our shipping along Asia.  The British have deployed Malayan, Indian and Australian troops to defend their positions; however, thanks to the ''collaboration'' of the king of Thailand... we will attack from our Thai bases striking the peninsula from the North.  We will then expect the surrender from the British Commander hahaha!
dst: 在您于香港和澳门取得重大胜利之后，高层希望您进攻马来半岛。英国在亚洲的最后据点就在马来半岛的尽头——新加坡！那座城塞至今仍是皇家海军的重要基地，也是我们亚洲航线的一大威胁。英国人已部署马来亚、印度与澳大利亚部队守卫阵地；不过，多亏了泰国国王的「合作」……我们将从我们的泰国基地出击，自北面打击该半岛。之后我们就等着英国指挥官投降吧，哈哈哈！

src: After your past battles against Lord Methuen it's surprising that General Cronjé has sent you to a secondary front like this. I guess that he doesn't want to share the glory of conquering Kimberley with anyone else, but I hope that he knows what he's doing. General Roberts is marching north with two British divisions, and he's determined to relieve Kimberley and destroy our commandoes.
dst: 在您过去与梅休因勋爵作战之后，克罗涅将军把您派到这样一个次要战线实在令人惊讶。我猜他是不想与任何人分享攻克金伯利的荣耀，但我希望他知道自己在做什么。罗伯茨将军正率两个英军师向北开进，他决意要解金伯利之围并消灭我们的突击队。

src: After your past victories we have had some months without any big military operation. However, the morale of our soldiers is starting to be alarmingly low. Their bravery and patriotism is out of question, but life in the trenches is always hard, and flux and malaria make it still worse. Right now it's impossible for them to foresee when this war will end.
dst: 在您过去的胜利之后，我们已经过了几个月没有任何大规模军事行动的日子。然而，我军士兵的士气开始低落到令人担忧的地步。他们的勇敢和爱国毋庸置疑，但战壕里的生活总是艰苦的，而痢疾和疟疾更使它雪上加霜。眼下，他们根本看不到这场战争何时结束。

src: After your past victories, you are clearly the right man to lead our resistance. You will have to defeat the inminent Bulgarian attack and, if possible, make a quick counterattack to retake some strategical positions. If the Bulgarian Army suffers enough casualties, they will be forced to negotiate the terms of peace, and Serbia and Greece won't have the strength to continue this war on their own.
dst: 在您过去的胜利之后，您显然是领导我们抵抗的最佳人选。您将必须击败迫在眉睫的保加利亚进攻，如有可能，还要发动快速反击，夺回一些战略要地。如果保加利亚军队伤亡足够惨重，他们就将被迫谈判和平条件，而塞尔维亚和希腊也将没有力量独自把战争继续下去。

src: After your stunning successes in the East, your division is getting some rest. It is broken up in Kampfgruppen and forms the mobile reserve of II FschJgr Korps that has taken position on the Eastern bank of the river Rhein. Monty's troops are on the other side of the river.
dst: 你在东线取得惊人战功之后，你的师得到一些休整。它被拆分成若干战斗群，构成已在莱茵河东岸占领阵地的第2伞兵军的机动预备队。蒙蒂的部队就在河对岸。

src: After your stunning victory in the Ardennes offensive, which has rendered Antwerpen inoperable as a port for quite some time, destroyed a large part of the tactical air force of the allies in northern France and destroyed several American divisions and shattered others, the SS Panzerkorps have been redeployed to East Prussia to face the ongoing Soviet offensive towards Königsberg.
dst: 你在阿登攻势中取得惊人胜利——使安特卫普港在相当长时间内无法使用，摧毁了盟军在法国北部的大部分战术空军，歼灭数个美军师、打残其他若干——之后，党卫军装甲军被调往东普鲁士，以应对苏军向柯尼斯堡的持续进攻。

src: After your success and short rest at Baghdad, you will perform a attack towards Khanaqin into northeastern direction at the Iranian border. There are together with Mosul the largest oil fields of Iraq and Indian troops preparing the destruction of the production facilities. This must be prevented at all costs, act fast!
dst: 在巴格达取得成功并短暂休整后，你将向东北方向的伊朗边境发起进攻，直指哈纳金。那里和摩苏尔一起是伊拉克最大的油田，印度军队正准备破坏生产设施。必须不惜一切代价阻止这一切，动作要快！

src: After your success at Iwo Jima we hope you can also stop the enemies here, in Okinawa. The High Command have planned the defence of the island in this way; our most important facilities are positioned in the South corner of the island, including some airstrips and the important Naha naval base. The main objective is to protect that part, focusing your efforts in holding the lines agaisnt the enemy strikes and landings using the hills and cities present there.
dst: 在硫磺岛取得成功之后，我们希望您也能在此地，在冲绳，挡住敌人。高层对岛屿防御作了如下部署：我们最重要的设施都位于该岛南部，包括几条简易机场跑道以及重要的那霸海军基地。主要目标是保护该地区，集中力量守住防线，抵御敌军的突击与登陆，利用当地的山丘与城镇。

src: After your success at Jasin the Germans will be able to intensify their attacks against the Uganda railway and to send more troops to the Bukoba radio station. These will be your next missions.
dst: 在您于贾辛取得成功之后，德军将能够加强对乌干达铁路的进攻，并向布科巴无线电台派遣更多部队。这些将是您接下来的任务。

src: After your success at Tula we could also break through the German lines north of Moscow. You are now in the near of Smolensk. The Germans had not tried to escape. I believe they have the order to stay in the pocket. Your troops should now deploy northeast and southeast of the city and attacking the last German troops which hold the last position, in which German troops could escape. Close the pocket! Hold in any case the connection to the troops east of you (both victory hexes), so the Germans could not escape. Otherwise there is a risk that your troops will be encircled.
dst: 继你在图拉取得胜利之后，我们也得以突破莫斯科以北的德军防线。你目前已逼近斯摩棱斯克。德军并未试图突围。我相信他们接到了留在包围圈内的命令。你的部队现在应部署在该市东北和东南方向，并攻击据守最后一处阵地的德军残部——那是德军尚可突围的最后据点。收紧包围圈！无论如何都要守住与你东侧部队的联络（两个胜利点），这样德军就无法逃脱。否则，你的部队将有被反包围的危险。

src: After your success in Melilla more than two years ago the area patrolled by our army has reached the eastern bank of the Kert river.  Due to the rough terrain and the lack of resources we could not build permanent positions.
dst: 两年多前您在梅利利亚取得成功之后，我们军队巡逻的区域已经推进到了克特河东岸。由于地势崎岖、资源匮乏，我们无法修筑永久性阵地。

src: After your success in the Jarama Valley, our aim now, is to accomplish a grand victory over the overconfident Italian troops.
dst: 您在哈拉马谷地取得胜利之后，我们现在的目标是对过于自信的意大利军队取得一场大胜。

src: After your success in the Xingkai lake, the Kwantung army wants you to manage the retreat from the Karafuto island, the bolsheviks have invaded that island with strong units, and for the moment we can't mantain our positions there while our fleets are fighting the americans on the Pacific.
dst: 在兴凯湖取得成功之后，关东军希望您来负责库页岛的撤退事宜，布尔什维克已派出强大部队入侵该岛，而眼下我们的舰队正在太平洋上与美国人对峙，我们无法在那里维持阵地。

src: After your troops have reached the Gulf of Mexico at Apalachee Bay, you will turn to the north and advance to Columbus, Georgia. We leave the blockade of Florida and the destruction of the enemy troops standing there to our infantry. Meanwhile strong enemy forces from Alabama and West-Georgia advance east to the Atlantic Coast. Our plan is to trap, encirclement and destroy these forces!
dst: 你的部队抵达阿巴拉契湾的墨西哥湾后，将转向北方，向佐治亚州的哥伦布推进。围困佛罗里达、歼灭驻扎在那里的敌军，就交给我们的步兵。与此同时，来自亚拉巴马和佐治亚西部的强大敌军正向东推进，直逼大西洋海岸。我们的计划是诱捕、包围并歼灭这股敌军！

src: After your victory at Verona, we believed that taking Florenz would be an easy mission for you. Obviously, we were wrong. It's a good thing that, at least, the Germans took the valley of the Po, putting Venedig under siege. The Germans have announced that the Italian government will unconditionally surrender to them. With most of their army pinned in Venedig, and France and Britain bleeding themselves to death in Belgium, the Italians understand that they won't receive any help before we conquer Rom. Any further resistance on their part will just worsen their situation.
dst: 在您取得维罗纳的胜利之后，我们原本以为攻占佛罗伦萨对您来说会是件轻而易举的任务。显然，我们错了。好在德国人至少夺取了波河河谷，把威尼斯包围了起来。德国人已经宣布，意大利政府将向他们无条件投降。他们的大部分军队被牵制在威尼斯，而法国和英国又在比利时流尽鲜血，意大利人明白，在我们攻下罗马之前，他们得不到任何援助。他们再作任何抵抗，都只会让自己的处境更加恶化。

src: After your victory over the Boii you will reach areas of a nation unknown to you.... the northern outpost of the Romans ...
dst: 在战胜波伊人之后，你将进入一个你所不知的民族的地界.... 罗马人的北方前哨 ...

src: Aftermath: After a hard fight, the germans stopped the british attack and forced them to reembark leaving more than 800 casualties, against about 50 dead in the german side. Also many war supplies were abandoned: enough english rifles to equip three askari companies, 600.000 rounds and 16 machineguns. Besides, the native soldiers learned that they could defeat an european army. The defeat cost Major-General Aitken his command.
dst: 战后：经过一番苦战，德国人阻止了英军的进攻，迫使他们重新登船撤离，留下800余人伤亡，而德军一方仅阵亡约50人。此外还遗弃了大量军用物资：足以装备三个阿斯卡里连的英制步枪、60万发子弹和16挺机枪。而且，土著士兵认识到他们能够击败一支欧洲军队。这次失败使艾特肯少将丢掉了指挥权。

src: Afyon redif div./ III Provisional Reserve Corps/ 莂talca Army
dst: Afyon 预备役师/ 第3暂编预备役军/ Catalca 集团军
Afyon 预备役师/ 暂编部队
Afyonkarahisar 预备役师/ 第3集团军

src: Afyonkarahisar redif div./ III Army Corps/ Eastern Army
dst: Afyonkarahisar 预备役师/ 第3集团军军/ 东部集团军

src: Again French troops will assist your forces, but they will not take orders from you.
dst: 法军部队仍将协助你的部队，但不受你指挥。

src: Again our forces gained ground against the unprotected Canadian troops. Our losses are however mounting fast and the novelty of gas warfare is wearing off. Other divisions will have to continue the attack towards Ypres.
dst: 我军再次对缺乏掩护的加拿大军队取得进展。然而我方损失正在迅速增加，毒气战的新奇感正在消退。其他师将不得不继续向伊普尔方向进攻。

src: Again the Thracian and his slave army won. Surprisingly, Spartacus chose to lead his army of slaves back into Italy.
dst: 这位色雷斯人和他的奴隶大军再次获胜。出人意料的是，斯巴达克斯选择把奴隶大军带回意大利。

src: Again time is of the essence.

Again we will attack in three colums: 36 Brigade Group in the North, Blade Force in the center and 11th Brigade Group in the South. A commando naval landing and paratrooper air drop are planned. The enemy has air superiority, but more of our fighters will be stationed closer to the front line soon and a heavy bomber raid should help you to break enemy lines. The remainder of your (core) CCB 1st Armored Division is on its way to Tunisia and will arrive in 3 to 4 days (7 game turns).
dst: 我们仍将兵分三路进攻：北路第36旅集群，中路“刀锋”部队，南路第11旅集群。计划实施突击队海上登陆与伞兵空降。敌军握有制空权，但我军更多战斗机即将进驻前线附近，重型轰炸机的空袭应能助你撕开敌阵。你（核心）第1装甲师CCB的其余部队正开赴突尼斯，将于3至4天（7个游戏回合）内抵达。

src: Again you have forced the BEF to retreat, but more valuable time has been lost. II Kavallerie Korps is ordered to keep on hitting the enemy as they retreat.
dst: 您再次迫使英国远征军撤退，但损失了更多宝贵的时间。第2骑兵军奉命在敌军撤退之际持续攻击。

src: Again you have struck a severe blow to the BEF. II Kavallerie Korps is ordered to keep on hitting the enemy as they retreat.
dst: 您再一次重创了英国远征军。第2骑兵军奉命在敌军撤退时继续追击打击。

src: Again, a splendid victory. And I'm glad to inform you that the Romanians have also surrendered at the Tutrakan fortress. All of Southern Dobruzha will be free in a few days! Now you should spend some time reinforcing and regrouping your units before resuming your offensive. Your next goal will be the port city of Konstantia.
dst: 又是一场辉煌的胜利。我很高兴地通知您，罗马尼亚人也已在图特拉坎要塞投降。整个南多布罗加数日内就将获得解放！现在您应当花些时间补充和整编您的部队，然后再继续进攻。您的下一个目标将是港口城市康斯坦察。

src: Again, comrade, do not watch your back. Only go for Rostov and do not let your troops be stopped by road blocks or anything else important. It is vital that we capture Rostov before the capitalist swines have the time to reinforce the city!
dst: 再说一遍，同志，不要瞻前顾后。只管朝罗斯托夫推进，别让您的部队被路障或任何其他要事耽搁。我们必须在资本主义猪猡们来得及增援该城之前拿下罗斯托夫，这一点至关重要！

src: Again, the central committee of the ChCP has agreed to launch another guerrilla assault on the Japanese rearguard in co-operation with our Kuomingtan ''allies''.  Comrade Mao dislikes this attack, but China is calling for Chinese action against the invaders, and that's what we are going to carry out.  The main objectives must be the capture of enemy resources present in your area: the coal mines and factories.  Your battle plan includes some cities and don't forget to cut all enemy lines of communication.
dst: 中共中央再次同意与我们的国民党"盟友"配合，对日军后方发动一次游击突击。毛泽东同志不喜欢这次进攻，但中国在呼吁中国人对侵略者采取行动，我们要做的就是这个。主要目标必须是夺取你所在区域内的敌方资源：煤矿和工厂。你的作战计划包括一些城市，别忘了切断敌人所有的交通线。

src: Again, you will nearly have your own troops to deal with your mission.
dst: 这一次，你几乎只能依靠自己的部队来完成任务。

src: Again, your smashing attack has left the enemy forces on the ground isolated.  This is the situation at Hungnam.  The UN forces are surrounded from the North and South by us while the North Korean units will attack from the East.  However, the Hungnam port continues to be their main lifeline, supported by their overwhelming naval power.
dst: 又一次，你的猛烈进攻使敌军地面部队陷入孤立。兴南的局势就是这样。联合国军被我们从北面和南面包围，而朝鲜人民军部队将从东面发起进攻。不过，兴南港仍是他们的主要生命线，并得到其压倒性海军力量的支持。

src: Against Bismarck's wishes, the Prussian Army decided not to shell the city of Paris immediately, in order to avoid civilian casualties and undesirable diplomatic pressure from other European powers. Instead, they would take their time to gradually conquer the strong fortifications that defended Paris. Even if that failed, Prussia was sure that, when the large civilian population of Paris started to suffer the consequences of being deprived of food and other basic supplies for a long period of time, the French would have to surrender.
dst: 普鲁士军队不顾俾斯麦的意愿，决定不立即炮击巴黎城，以避免平民伤亡以及来自其他欧洲列强的不必要外交压力。相反，他们将从容地逐步攻克守卫巴黎的坚固工事。即便此举失败，普鲁士也确信，当巴黎庞大的平民人口开始遭受长期缺乏食物和其他基本物资的后果时，法国人就不得不投降。

src: Against all odds, you have destroyed or captured most of the American ships. Your determination and courage has leaded to a victory that no one thought possible.
dst: 在极其不利的情况下，您摧毁或俘获了大部分美国军舰。您的决心和勇气带来了一场没有人认为可能实现的胜利。

src: Against the odds your ANZACs have secured these most valuable objectives. The Turks have withdrawn and we are now in a position to destroy those coastal guns!! Very good work commander!!
dst: 在极为不利的情况下，您的澳新军团还是拿下了这些极具价值的目标。土耳其人已经撤退，我们现在得以摧毁那些海岸炮！！干得非常出色，指挥官！！

src: Agentes infiltrados informan de que el puesto de mando enemigo se encuentra en la localidad de Fraga, que constituye uno de los objetivos de la mision.
dst: 渗透进来的特工报告，敌军指挥部位于弗拉加镇，该镇是本次任务的目标之一。

src: Agosto de 1936. El capitán Bayo dirige el asalto a la isla de Mallorca. ¿Será capaz de arrebatar la isla de manos nacionales?
dst: 1936年8月。巴约上尉指挥对马略卡岛的突击。他能否从国民军手中夺取该岛？

src: Aguinaldo has presented surrender terms to Spanish Governor General Basilio Augustín but not surprisingly he has refused them.
dst: 阿奎纳多向西班牙总督巴西利奥·奥古斯丁提出了投降条件，但不出所料，后者予以拒绝。

src: Ah Herr General, today is the day you enter the history books! You will hit the heavily defended beachs of Turkey at Gallipoli and do what the ANZAC's could not do in WW1. You must smash the Turks swiftly because your troops are needed in Russia to relieve our trapped troops there. Move quickly General, many lives depend on you!
dst: 啊，将军阁下，今天是你载入史册的日子！你将在加里波利强攻土耳其重兵把守的海滩，做到一战时澳新军团没能做到的事。你必须迅速击垮土耳其人，因为你的部队还需赶赴俄国解救我困在那里的部队。快，将军，无数性命系于你身！

src: Ah!, buenos dias ''general''!, el GCG estara contento de saber que hemos dado otro paso adelante en la liberacion de este pais capturando a uno de sus comandantes mas famosos. En adelante se pudrira usted en una de nuestras carceles!.
dst: 啊，早上好，「将军」！最高统帅部要是知道我们又向解放这个国家迈进了一步，俘获了你们最著名的指挥官之一，一定会很高兴。从今往后，您就在我们的某座监狱里烂掉吧！

src: Ah!, un general fascista!. El alto mando del Ejercito Popular estara extremadamente feliz de saber que en nuestra operacion a traves del rio Segre hemos tomado a un prisionero tan ilustre como usted. Un peloton de ejecucion le esta esperando en Barcelona! jajajajaja.
dst: 哈！一个法西斯将军！共和军最高统帅部得知我们在横渡塞格雷河的作战中抓到了像您这样显赫的俘虏，一定会极其高兴。一个行刑队在巴塞罗那等着您呢！哈哈哈哈哈。

src: Ah!, un general fascista!. El alto mando del Ejercito Popular estara extremadamente feliz de saber que nuestra operacion de cruce del Ebro va bien y que ademas hemos capturado a un prisionero tan ilustre como usted!, un peloton de ejecucion le espera en Barcelona! jajajajajaja.
dst: 啊哈！一位法西斯将军！共和军最高统帅部得知我们的埃布罗河渡河行动进展顺利，而且我们还俘获了像您这样声名显赫的俘虏，一定会极其高兴！巴塞罗那有一个行刑队正等着您呢！哈哈哈哈哈哈。

src: Ah!, un general fascista!. The high command of the PEOPLES ARMY will be extremely pleased knowing that our operation across the Ebro river is going well, and that we have captured a enemy general so famous like you!. An execution platoon is waiting for you in Barcelona! HAHAHAHA!.
dst: 啊哈！一位法西斯将军！共和军最高统帅部得知我们的埃布罗河渡河行动进展顺利，而且我们还俘获了像您这样声名显赫的敌军将军，一定会极其高兴！巴塞罗那有一个行刑队正等着您呢！哈哈哈哈！

src: Ah!, un general fascista!. The high command of the PEOPLES ARMY will be extremely pleased knowing that our operation across the Segre river is going well, and that we have captured a enemy general so famous like you!. An execution platoon is waiting for you in Barcelona! HAHAHAHA!.
dst: 哈！一个法西斯将军！共和军最高统帅部得知我们横渡塞格雷河的作战进展顺利，而且我们俘虏了像您这样出名的敌军将军，一定会极其高兴。一个行刑队在巴塞罗那等着您！哈哈哈哈哈！

src: Ah!, un general republicano!, el alto mando del generalisimo estara encantado de saber que ademas de haber destruido todo su sucio ''ejercito del Ebro'' hemos capturado a un general rojo. Trataremos de sacar partido con su captura y si no nos sirve le fusilaremos por traicion a la patria!.
dst: 啊哈！一名共和军将军！大元帅的最高指挥部会很乐意得知，我们不仅摧毁了你们那支肮脏的「埃布罗军团」，还俘获了一名共和军将军。我们会设法从您的被俘中捞取好处，要是您对我们没用，我们就以叛国罪枪毙您！

src: Ah, General. There are rumors that you have requested your resignation. It isn't necessary, if you ask me. It is traditional for KuK commanders who lose a battle to get a medal for it!
dst: 啊，将军。有传言说您已请求辞职。依我看，大可不必。奥匈指挥官打了败仗还能得一枚勋章，这向来是传统！

src: Ah, Good day, Herr General!  Please sit down  and allow me to explain the present situation.  The Spanish Nationalists have requested the help of Germany to wrest control of Spain from their enemies. In leading this expedition, you will have the opportunity to sharpen your skills in the art of war. You will test the General Staff's new ideas regarding tank use, concentration of force, and combined arms operations.
dst: 啊，日安，将军阁下！请坐，容我说明当前形势。西班牙民族主义者请求德国帮助，从他们的敌人手中夺取对西班牙的控制权。率领这支远征军，你将有机会磨砺战争艺术。你将检验总参谋部关于坦克运用、兵力集中和诸兵种协同作战的新理念。

src: Ah, Good day, Herr General!  Please sit down  and allow me to explain the present situation.  The Spanish Nationalists have requested the help of Germany to wrest control of Spain from their enemies. In leading this expedition, you will have the opportunity to sharpen your skills in the art of war. You will test the General Staff's new ideas regarding tank use, concentration of force, and combined arms operations.  Your expertise can then be put to work towards the real objective:  the return of Germany to its proper place,  the leader of Europe.
dst: 啊，你好，将军阁下！请坐，容我说明当前局势。西班牙国民军已请求德国出手，帮助他们从敌人手中夺回西班牙的控制权。率领这支远征军，你将有机会磨炼自己的战争技艺。你将检验总参谋部关于坦克运用、集中兵力和合成兵种作战的新构想。此后，你的专长便可投入到真正的目标上：让德国恢复其应有的地位，成为欧洲的领袖。

src: Ah, Good day, Herr General!  Please sit down and allow me to explain the present situation. As part of this campaign you are directed to cross the Dnieper.
dst: 啊，日安，将军阁下！请坐，容我说明当前局势。如你所知，我们占领莫斯科为时甚短，因为来自西伯利亚的新锐布尔什维克部队迫使我方疲惫的部队撤离了该城。今年春天，我们决定采取南方战略，攻占斯大林格勒作为基地，以便进一步向莫斯科或巴库油田推进。作为此次战役的一部分，你奉命强渡第聂伯河。

src: Ah, Good day, Herr General! Please sit down and allow me to explain the present situation. The Spanish Nationalists have requested the help of Germany to wrest control of Spain from their enemies. In leading this expedition, you will have the opportunity to sharpen your skills in the art of war. You will test the General Staff's new ideas regarding tank use, concentration of force, and combined arms operations. Your expertise can then be put to work towards the real objective: the return of Germany to its proper place, the leader of Europe.
dst: 啊，您好，将军阁下！请坐，容我说明当前局势。西班牙国民军已请求德国援助，以从敌人手中夺取西班牙的控制权。在率领这支远征军的过程中，你将有机会磨砺你的战争艺术。你将检验总参谋部关于坦克运用、兵力集中与合成兵种作战的新构想。随后你的专长便可投入到真正的目标上：让德国重返它应有的位置——欧洲的领导者。

src: Ah, Good day, Herr General! Please sit down and allow me to explain the present situation. We have decided for you to pursue a Southern strategy, capturing Dnipropetrovsk, Voroshilovgrad and Rostov to serve as a base to strike towards either Moscow or the Baku oil fields. As part of this campaign you are directed to cross the Dnepr at Kanev and Cherkasy.
dst: 啊，日安，将军阁下！请坐，允许我说明一下当前的形势。我们已决定让你采取南方战略，夺取第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克、伏罗希洛夫格勒和罗斯托夫，作为向莫斯科或巴库油田任一方向出击的基地。作为这次战役的一部分，你受命在卡涅夫和切尔卡瑟渡过第聂伯河。

src: Ah, Herr General, I hope you have enjoyed your leave.  As you know, British and Commonwealth  troops are attempting to evacuate as many troops as possible from Greece. Your job is to prevent this.
dst: 啊，将军阁下，希望你享受了休假。如你所知，英国和英联邦部队正试图从希腊撤出尽可能多的部队。你的任务就是阻止这一切。

src: Ah, Herr General, I hope you have enjoyed your leave.  As you know, British and Commonwealth  troops have occupied the historic pass at Thermopylae.  You must secure this pass and prevent the escape of the enemy.  The terrain is rugged and difficult for maneuver.   You must act decisively.
dst: 啊，将军阁下，希望你享受了休假。如你所知，英国和英联邦部队已占领历史性的温泉关。你必须夺取这个隘口，阻止敌人逃脱。地形崎岖，难以机动。你必须果断行动。

src: Ah, Herr General, I hope you have enjoyed your leave.  As you know, British and Commonwealth  troops have occupied the historic pass at Thermopylae.  You must secure this pass and prevent the escape of the enemy.  The terrain is rugged and difficult for maneuver.   You must act decisively. These troops were bypassed in our initial Grecian campaign, but now is the time to eliminate this threat to our control of the area.
dst: 啊，将军阁下，希望您休假愉快。如您所知，英国和英联邦军队已占领了温泉关这一历史名隘。您必须夺取该隘口，阻止敌人逃脱。当地地形崎岖，难以机动。您必须果断行动。这些部队在我军最初的希腊战役中被绕过了，现在是消除他们对本地区控制权威胁的时候了。

src: Ah, Herr General, I hope you have enjoyed your leave.  As you know, the British fortress of Gibraltar is a serious threat to our operations in the Mediterranean region.  With the conquest of France, and your victory in Norway, now is the time to eliminate this threat to our control of the Mediterranean.  We have persuaded Spain to join us and our ally Italy in our attack on Gibraltar.
dst: 啊，将军阁下，希望您休假愉快。如您所知，英国人的直布罗陀要塞对我们在地中海地区的作战构成严重威胁。随着法国被征服，加上您在挪威的胜利，现在是消除这一对我们地中海控制权威胁的时候了。我们已说服西班牙加入我们和我们的盟友意大利，共同进攻直布罗陀。

src: Ah, Herr General, I hope you have enjoyed your leave. As you know, British and Commonwealth troops have occupied the historic pass at Thermopylae. You must secure this pass and prevent the escape of the enemy. The terrain is rugged and difficult for maneuver. You must act decisively.
dst: 啊，将军阁下，希望你的休假过得愉快。如你所知，英国与英联邦部队已占领了温泉关的历史关隘。你必须夺取这道关隘，阻止敌人逃脱。地形崎岖，难以机动。你必须果断行动。

src: Ah, Herr General, excuse me, Herr Feldmarschall! As you know, our campaign in the north continues to go well.  You have been chosen to lead our invasion in the south.  After your beachhead is secure,  it is imperative for you to seize the port city of Savannah. Once this is accomplished, our drive inland will cut the United States in half.  It is believed that the Americans are ignorant of our plans.
dst: 啊，将军阁下，恕我失礼，是陆军元帅阁下！如你所知，我们在北方的战役进展顺利。你被选中领导我们在南方的入侵。滩头稳固之后，你必须夺取港口城市萨凡纳。一旦得手，我们向内陆的推进将把美国一分为二。据信美国人对我们的计划一无所知。

src: Ah, Herr General, excuse me, Herr Feldmarschall! As you know, our campaign in the north continues to go well.  You have been chosen to lead our invasion in the south.  After your beachhead is secure,  it is imperative for you to seize the port city of Savannah. Once this is accomplished, our drive inland will cut the United States in half.  It is believed that the Americans are ignorant of our plans.  But be aware that the people of this region will fight us to their last breath.
dst: 啊，将军阁下，恕我失礼，元帅阁下！如你所知，我们在北方的战役进展顺利。你被选中指挥我方在南方的入侵。滩头堡巩固之后，你必须夺取港口城市萨凡纳。一旦达成，我们向内陆的推进将把美国一分为二。据信美国人对我们的计划毫不知情。但要注意，该地区的人民会与我们战斗到最后一息。

src: Ah, Herr General.  Excuse me, Herr Feldmarschall.  A bold stroke to invade England is necessary.  We must force the Allies to the bargaining table so that we may have the peace needed to develop the Fatherland to its full glory.  You have been given command of the initial phase of the invasion.
dst: 啊，将军阁下。失敬，是元帅阁下。对英格兰发动一次大胆入侵势在必行。我们必须迫使盟军回到谈判桌前，以便获得让祖国充分发展其全部荣光所需的和平。您已被授予此次入侵第一阶段行动的指挥权。

src: Ah, Herr General.  Excuse me, Herr Feldmarschall.  A bold stroke to invade England is necessary.  We must force the Allies to the bargaining table so we may have the peace needed to develop the Fatherland to its full glory.  You have been given command of one section of the invasion.
dst: 啊，将军阁下。失敬，是元帅阁下。对英格兰发动一次大胆入侵势在必行。我们必须迫使盟军回到谈判桌前，以便获得让祖国充分发展其全部荣光所需的和平。您已被授予此次入侵一个方向上的指挥权。

src: Ah, Herr General. Excuse me, Herr Feldmarschall. A bold stroke to invade England is necessary. We have waited with this mission for much to long now. We must force the Allies to the bargaining table so we may have the peace needed to develop the Fatherland to its full power and glory. You have been given command of the most eastern sector of the invasion around Dover and Folkestone while a Italian Army is about to land around Portsmouth and Southampton.
dst: 啊，将军阁下。恕我冒昧，元帅阁下。入侵英格兰的大胆行动势在必行。我们为这次任务已经等待太久了。我们必须迫使盟国坐到谈判桌前，这样才能获得所需的和平，将祖国发展至其全部实力与荣耀。你已被授予多佛尔和福克斯通附近入侵地段最东翼的指挥权，而一支意大利集团军即将在朴茨茅斯和南安普顿一带登陆。

src: Ah, but I must bid farewell, my 163rd is to continue north while you clean up the small pockets of resistance here that still hang on.
dst: 啊，但我得道别了，我的第163师要继续北上，而你负责清剿这里仍在顽抗的小股抵抗。

src: Ah, dear Comrade Commisar, have you got the dedicated copy of Lenin's The State and Revolution? Comrade Szamuely has just arrived from Moscow with the warmest greetings and this special present for you. Our international revolution is going well, our Slovakian comrades will declare their Soviet Republic within days. Unfortunately these pesky Czech marauders simply can't accept their defeat, and they launched a strong counterattack in the area of Nyitra (Nitra) - Vág (Váh) - Garam (Hron) rivers. Give these imperialist lapdogs a bloody nose again!
dst: 啊，亲爱的政委同志，您拿到列宁《国家与革命》的签名本了吗？绍穆埃利同志刚从莫斯科回来，带来了最热情的问候以及这份送给您的特殊礼物。我们的国际革命进展顺利，我们的斯洛伐克同志们几天之内就将宣布成立他们的苏维埃共和国。不幸的是，这些讨厌的捷克掠夺者就是不肯接受失败，他们在尼特拉-瓦赫河-赫龙河一带发动了猛烈的反攻。再给这些帝国主义的走狗们一记迎头痛击吧！

src: Ah, one more thing... as you surely already know it's minus 28 degrees (-18 Fahrenheit) and the snow will be another enemy to face for El Ejercito Popular...
dst: 啊，还有一件事……您肯定已经知道了，气温是零下28度（零下18华氏度），而大雪将是共和军需要面对的又一个敌人……

src: Ah, there you are. Welcome to Galicia and welcome to the corps of Autos-Canons-Mitrailleuses (ACM). Major Colon is on his way home after he lost the last bit of trust he had with the general staff. Traveling to Russia in a luxury train with wife and son while the rest of the corps was on the way to Archangelsk on the cargo ship Wray Castle in the October cold, did not make him very popular. When he promoted himself to Colonel, the general staff had enough and called him back home.
dst: 啊，您来了。欢迎来到加利西亚，欢迎加入装甲车-火炮-机枪军团（ACM）。科隆少校在失去总参谋部对他最后的一丝信任后，正在归国途中。当军团其余成员在十月严寒中搭乘货船「雷城堡」号前往阿尔汉格尔斯克时，他却带着妻儿乘坐豪华列车前往俄国，这让他很不受欢迎。当他把自己晋升为上校时，总参谋部终于忍无可忍，把他召回了国。

src: Ahead of us lies Lemberg, one of the most important strategic points in Poland. You see, the battle for Poland is by no means decided yet. If they withdraw to the Narew-Weichsel-San line, they will hold us off until the British and French intervene and we are forced to detach some of our forces from the east. If you manage to cross the San and take Lemberg, you will have turned their flank and basically won the Polish campaign.
dst: 我们面前是伦贝格——波兰最重要的战略要点之一。要知道，波兰战役远未定局。若他们退到纳雷夫河—维斯瓦河—桑河一线，就能拖住我们，直到英法介入，逼我们从东线分兵。你若能渡过桑河、攻下伦贝格，就能包抄其侧翼，基本打赢波兰战役。

src: Ahead of us lies the new Russian capital - Khabarovsk. There is not much I can tell you because it has been snowing for the past few days and this has screened all movement. I hope you can take the city with your forces.
dst: 我们面前就是俄国新首都——哈巴罗夫斯克。我能告诉你的不多，因为过去数日一直下雪，遮蔽了一切动向。希望你能率部拿下此城。

src: Ahh, comrade Commander!  Do you like Khabarovsk?  It's a pretty city, isn't it?   I know you are the greatest hero of the PRC and the KRC and I have a mission for you from the Kremlin.  I have to give you a letter from Moscow but... well anyway this is a good situation to do it.  Err... yes, but first, let's negotiate the surrender of my forces in this sector.
dst: 啊，指挥员同志！你喜欢哈巴罗夫斯克吗？这是座漂亮的城市，不是吗？我知道你是中华人民共和国和朝鲜人民共和国最伟大的英雄，克里姆林宫交给你一项任务。我得转交给你一封莫斯科的来信，不过...好吧，反正现在正是转交的好时机。呃...对，不过首先，让我们商谈一下我这个地段部队的投降事宜。

src: Alarmed by these tidings and letters, Caesar levied two new legions in Hither Gaul, and, at the beginning of summer, sent Q. Pedius, his lieutenant, to conduct them further into Gaul. He, himself, as soon as there began to be plenty of forage, came to the army. He gives a commission to the Senones and the other Gauls who were neighbors of the Belgae, to learn what is going on among them [i.e. the Belgae], and inform him of these matters. These all uniformly reported that troops were being raised, and that an army was being collected in one place. Then, indeed, he thought that he ought not to hesitate about proceeding toward them, and having provided supplies, moves his camp, and in about fifteen days arrives at the territories of the Belgae.
dst: 凯撒为此消息与书信所惊动，在内高卢征募了两个新军团，并在夏初派他的副将昆图斯佩迪乌斯把它们 带往高卢腹地。他自己一俟草料充足便来到军中。他委派塞农人以及其他与比尔吉人为邻的高卢人去探 明〔比尔吉人〕的动向并向他报告。这些人众口一词地报告说正在征兵，并在某一处集结军队。于是凯撒 认为不应对是否前去犹豫，筹办粮秣之后便拔营前进，约十五日抵达比尔吉人地界。
