src: Alea iacta est !  ("The die is cast")

Alea iacta est. We tried to remain neutral in the middle of the turmoil that threatens Europe, and we firmly refused to allow the German army  passage through our country. But we knew it would be useless. The German invasion of France can only take place if the troops of the Kaiser cross Belgian territories.
dst: 木已成舟。在这场威胁欧洲的动荡之中，我们试图保持中立，并坚决拒绝德军借道我国。但我们知道这无济于事。德军对法国的入侵，只有让皇帝的军队穿越比利时领土才能进行。
库亚维地区亚历山德鲁夫
阿列克谢！给我们来点伏特加！”
阿列克谢耶沃-图兹洛夫卡

src: Alexandria has for ages been the goal of the Italians and Rommel, who are still distant in Libya. Now it appears that you will be the one to take the city! Strike quickly, but beware! City fighting can be very costly in blood, and Cairo in the south is not yet contained - expect a relief force!
dst: 亚历山大历来是意大利人和隆美尔的目标，他们至今仍远在利比亚。如今看来，攻取此城者将是你！速速进攻，但要当心！巷战可能付出惨重鲜血代价，而南面的开罗尚未被牵制——当心敌援军！

src: Alexandria turned out to be too heavily defended and the Allied air force too strong to continue. The subsequent Allied counterattack does not seem to lose steam. We will try to stop the Allies at Mersa Brega.
dst: 亚历山大防御过于严密，盟军空军又太强，无法继续推进。随后的盟军反攻似乎势头不减。我们将设法在梅尔萨布雷加挡住盟军。

src: Alexandria! Herr General, we are close to our main objective of our African adventures, the city of Alexandria. Your orders are to capture the city and the surrounding area. Alexandria is also the biggest base of the British Mediterranean Fleet. With Alexandria in our hands we will be able to march on Cairo and Suez!
dst: 亚历山大！将军阁下，我们已接近我们非洲冒险的主要目标，亚历山大城。您的命令是夺取该城及周边地区。亚历山大也是英国地中海舰队最大的基地。亚历山大在我们手中，我们便能向开罗和苏伊士进军！
亚历山德罗斯·帕夫罗杰尼托斯
阿尔及利亚民族主义者

src: Algiers is a tough task but the General Staff is optimistic that you will be the right commander for this job. Your troops are backed by our Kriegsmarine and specially equipped  marine Kommando units.
dst: 阿尔及尔是个艰巨的任务，但总参谋部乐观地认为，你是担当此任的合适指挥官。你的部队由我方海军和装备特殊的海军突击队提供支援。
阿尔冈昆团/第10/第4加拿大集团军 [加拿大第2军]

src: Algunos de nuestros valerosos guerrilleros operan ya sobre el terreno, nos han remitido informes que muestran que el enemigo cuenta con fuerzas de las que se retiraron de la Peninsula, y que ha organizado en dos divisiones, compuestas por banderas de la Legion; la division ''Ceuta'' y la division ''Tetuan'', asi como otros elementos de la ya famosa 13 Division. Los rebeldes siguen recibiendo cierta ayuda italiana, lo que complicara las cosas.
dst: 我们一些英勇的游击队员已在当地活动，他们发回的报告显示，敌军拥有从半岛撤出的部队，并已将其编成两个师，由外籍军团旗队组成；「休达」师和「得土安」师，以及那支已经声名远扬的第13师的其他部队。叛军仍在接受意大利方面的某些援助，这会使事情变得更加复杂。

src: Algunos miembros del gobierno republicano ya han establecido contactos con nosotros para poner punto y final a la guerra. Por la situación internacional actual, creo que tal vez en fechas venideras se desate una nueva Cruzada...
dst: 共和政府的一些成员已经与我们建立联系，打算结束这场战争。就目前的国际形势而言，我认为也许在不久的将来会爆发一场新的十字军东征……

src: Ali Insan Pasa / XIII Corps / 6th Army
dst: Ali Insan Pasa / 第13军 / 第6集团军

src: All German Kavallerie Divisions have been put under command of 6th Armee. Their first mission is to occupy the ridge to the South-East of Ypres. The ridge is defended by the British Cavalry Corps. All cavalry will fight dismounted because of the terrain. That gives the British an advantage - they are trained in infantry tactics.
dst: 所有德国骑兵师都已划归第6集团军指挥。它们的首要任务是占领伊普尔东南方的山脊。该山脊由英国骑兵军防守。由于地形原因，所有骑兵都将下马作战。这给了英国人一个优势——他们受过步兵战术训练。

src: All German attacks have been repelled and you have retreated the forces under your command in an ordered manner. Your defence has enabled our army to safely take positions on the "Ligne KW" (Dyle line).
dst: 德军的进攻全部被击退，您以有序的方式撤出了麾下部队。您的防御使我军得以安全进入“KW 防线”（迪尔河防线）阵地。

src: All airfields got destoyed. You have to build one.
dst: 所有机场都已被摧毁。你必须建造一座。

src: All airfields have been destroyed in the previous battles and need repairs!
dst: 所有机场已在此前的战斗中被摧毁，需要修复！

src: All axis nations auxiliaries are under your command.
dst: 所有轴心国的辅助部队都归你指挥。

src: All enemy units must be destroyed
dst: 必须消灭所有敌军单位

src: All in All, the First Battle of Artois was a very bloody engagement, and one first taste of Verdun.
dst: 总而言之，第一次阿图瓦战役是一场极其血腥的战斗，也是凡尔登的一次预演。

src: All in-scenario turns prestige is received at the very first turn of each scenario. This has three consequences that you should keep in mind. First of all, it's not necessary to play until the last turn to receive all the prestige; you'll get it immediatelly on the very first turn. Second important thing to never forget is that you can actually use this prestige on the very first turn to acquire a new unit; just don't close the deploy screen until you are done with purchases. Last thing to consider: the prestige flow is lowest at the start and the end of campaign, while it's at its peek during the mid-stages; use this knowledge to your advantage.
dst: 每个场景的全部回合声望都在该场景第一个回合一次性获得。这带来三点你需牢记的后果。其一，不必玩到最后一回合才能拿全声望——你第一个回合就能立刻拿到。其二，务必牢记：你可以在第一个回合就用这笔声望征募新单位，只要在完成购买前别关闭部署界面即可。最后一点：声望流量在战役初期和末期最低，中期最高；善用这一规律。

src: All in-scenario turns prestige is received at the very first turn of each scenario. This has three consequences that you should keep in mind. First of all, it's not necessary to play until the last turn to receive all the prestige; you'll get it immediatelly on the very first turn. Second important thing to never forget is that you can actually use this prestige on the very first turn to acquire a new unit; just don't close the deploy screen until you are done with purchases. Last thing to consider: the prestige flow is mostly stable and you'll get a fixed amount of post-scenario prestige (depending on the outcome of the battle, of course), so it should be easy to overstrength your units or replace any permanent losses.
dst: 每个场景的全部回合声望都在该场景第一个回合一次性获得。这带来三点你需牢记的后果。其一，不必玩到最后一回合才能拿全声望——你第一个回合就能立刻拿到。其二，务必牢记：你可以在第一个回合就用这笔声望征募新单位，只要在完成购买前别关闭部署界面即可。最后一点：声望流量大体稳定，战役结束后你会获得一笔固定的声望（当然取决于战果），因此给部队超编或补充永久性损失都应当不难。

src: All of the German units must survive.
dst: 所有德军单位都必须存活。

src: All of those factors meant that, although the most powerful German states (Bavaria, Saxony, Hanover, Baden or Württemberg) supported Austria and went to war against Prussia, and that Austria and her allies had numerical superiority over their enemies, they were forced to fight in several fronts, allowing Prussia to defeat them in detail. To make things even worse for Austria and her allies, they lacked an unified command, and some of their generals didn't have the initiative and the wits that the situation required.
dst: 所有这些因素意味着，尽管最强大的德意志各邦（巴伐利亚、萨克森、汉诺威、巴登或符腾堡）支持奥地利并对普鲁士开战，尽管奥地利及其盟友在兵力上占优，他们却被迫在多个战线作战，使普鲁士得以将其各个击破。对奥地利及其盟友更为不利的是，他们缺乏统一的指挥，一些将领也不具备形势所需的主动性和才智。

src: All other colonies were lost in the first month of the war, but here in German East Africa, we fight for the last twe years and retain a much larger enemy force. The Kaiser gives his regards to you!
dst: 战争的头一个月，所有其他殖民地都沦陷了，但在这里，在德属东非，我们已奋战了最后两年，并牵制住了一支远为庞大的敌军。德皇向您致意！

src: All our Men, who's not killed or captured, flown to the Swiss and the most of us want to emigrate to the USA... there, we can live in freedom...
dst: 我们所有未被杀死或俘虏的人，都逃往了瑞士，我们大多数人想移民美国……在那里，我们能自由地生活……

src: All our efforts during the summer of 1919 had allowed us to retreat in order to the relative protection of the river Ishim. However, we knew that if we didn't launch a counteroffensive, the Red Army would destroy us completely before the next year. In fact, the Soviets acted as if they had already defeated us. Having learnt nothing from their setbacks at Ekaterinburg and Chelyabinsk, their quick advances in Siberia had convinced them that we were a bunch of corrupt incompetents, and they even had started to retire some units from the front, in order to send them against Denikin's Armed Forces of Southern Russia, or even further to the west, against the Polish Army.
dst: 1919年夏天我们所有的努力，使我们得以有秩序地撤到伊希姆河相对安全的屏障之后。然而我们知道，如果不发动反攻，红军就会在来年之前将我们彻底消灭。事实上，苏维埃的表现就好像他们已经打败了我们。他们没有从叶卡捷琳堡和车里雅宾斯克的挫折中吸取任何教训，在西伯利亚的快速推进让他们确信我们只是一帮腐败无能的家伙，他们甚至已经开始从前线撤走一些部队，以便调去对付邓尼金的南俄武装力量，甚至进一步向西去对付波兰军队。

src: All our efforts were in vain. The Bolsheviks were too strong and numerous, and nothing seemed to work against them.
dst: 我们所有的努力都付诸东流。布尔什维克太强大、人数太多了，似乎什么都对付不了他们。

src: All our men are dead or scattered to the four winds...
dst: 我们的部下或死或四散 ......

src: All our men, who have not been killed or captured, flew to Switzerland and most of us want to emigrate to the USA... there, we can live in liberty...
dst: 我们所有未被杀死或俘虏的人，都逃往了瑞士，我们大多数人想移民美国……在那里，我们能自由地生活……

src: All our men, who have not been killed or captured, flew to Switzerland and most of us want to emigrate to the USA... there, we can live in liberty....
dst: 我们所有未被击毙或俘获的人都逃到了瑞士，而且大多数人想移民美国……在那里，我们可以自由地生活……

src: All pictures have been taken from Wikipedia/Wikimedia
All ports are destroyed. You have to repair them in order to deploy your fleet and naval transports.
dst: 所有港口均已被摧毁。你必须修复它们才能部署你的舰队与海上运输船。

src: All scenarios are playable as standalone.
dst: 所有场景均可作为独立场景游玩。

src: All that stands between us and victory in the west is a quick knock-out blow against the disorganized allied armies in France. Your mission is to break the French 'will to resist' by taking Paris and all other objectives by no later than July 30th. However, due to the difficulties involved in preparing for an invasion of England, it is essential that you end this campaign much sooner if at all possible. Otherwise, the opportunity to invade England this summer will be lost. The upcoming battle for France is the most important campaign you have yet to participate in.
dst: 挡在我们与西线胜利之间的，只有一件事：迅速给法国境内混乱的盟军部队一记致命打击。你的任务是在7月30日之前夺取巴黎及所有其他目标，从而摧毁法国人的抵抗意志。但鉴于入侵英国的战备工作困难重重，你务必尽可能大幅提前结束本战役。否则，今夏入侵英国的机会将会丧失。即将开始的法国战役，是你迄今参与过的最重要的战役。

src: All the airfields have been destroyed so it is important that you capture the last remaining airfield so your Luftwaffe can operate. I think the natives will crumble when faced with your seasoned troops!
dst: 所有机场都已被摧毁，所以你必须夺取最后一座机场，好让你的空军得以作战。我想面对你久经沙场的部队，土著们会土崩瓦解！

src: All the army leaders have appeared to the great state parliament in Alesia ..... this has not happened for generations .....
dst: 所有军队首领都到阿莱西亚参加了这场部族大会 ..... 这种事已有几代人未曾发生 .....

src: All the foreign goverments are absolutely amazed by the striking change of the war! To complete the victory over the rebel troops we have planned an attack along the Segre river, southwards from Lerida, where the rebels are trying to advance to halt our attacks. Your mission is to face the rebel attack on the Segre river.
dst: 所有外国政府都对战争惊人的转变深感震惊！为彻底战胜叛军，我们策划了一场沿塞格雷河的进攻，从莱里达向南推进，叛军正试图在那里推进以阻止我军进攻。您的任务是迎击叛军在塞格雷河上的进攻。

src: All the goals have been achieved. However, due to the enemy air superiority and the quality of their troops, we must retreat our troops from Brunete to Northern positions.
dst: 所有目标均已达成。然而，由于敌人的空中优势及其部队的素质，我们必须把部队从布鲁内特撤往北面的阵地。

src: All the main ports of the Mediterranean Sea are now under our control! Only the Suez Canal remains under British domination... We shall see how many time they can use the Canal!
dst: 地中海所有主要港口现在都在我们控制之下！只有苏伊士运河仍在英国统治下……我们倒要看看他们还能使用运河多久！

src: Allied (Soviet) reinforcements will arrive in the South-West. The enemy troops had time to entrench and are experienced .
dst: 盟军（苏军）增援将从西南方向抵达。敌军已有时间设防，且经验丰富。

src: Allied Aircraft Cross the Rhine, Kevelaer, Germany, 24 March 1945.
dst: 1945年3月24日，盟军飞机飞越德国凯沃拉尔上空的莱茵河。
托莱多的阿尔莫纳西德

src: Almost at the same time, the Germans were launching their final offensives in the Balkans and in Italy. The Italians surrendered in July, leaving the British Empire as our only enemy left. We were nearly exhausted after two years of war, so we sent a message to General Allenby assuring him that, if his troops stayed in Sudan, we'd remain peacefully on our side of the border. The British never answered to our proposal, but the ceased their attacks. For a few months, it seemed that the war was over for us.
dst: 几乎在同一时间，德国人正在巴尔干和意大利发动最后的攻势。意大利于七月投降，大英帝国成了我们仅剩的敌人。经过两年战争，我们几乎筋疲力尽，于是我们给艾伦比将军捎去口信，向他保证，只要他的部队留在苏丹，我们就会安分地待在自己这边的边境。英国从未答复我们的提议，但他们停止了进攻。有那么几个月，似乎战争对我们来说已经结束了。

src: Almost at the same time, the Siberian Army took Nizhni Novgorod and the AFSR defeated the Soviet Army in Tula. The war was almost won, so we started to think about what would come next. In a conference that took place in Tsarytsin, it was decided that a Military Directory would govern Russia until the revolution was completeley defeated. Naturally, Admiral Kolchak was chosen as its President. The first decision of the Directory was to order a final, coordinated assault on Moscow.
dst: 几乎在同一时间，西伯利亚集团军攻占了下诺夫哥罗德，南俄武装力量在图拉击败了苏俄军队。战争几乎已经打赢，于是我们开始考虑接下来会发生什么。在一次于察里津举行的会议上，决定由一个军事督政府治理俄国，直到革命被彻底击败。海军上将高尔察克自然被选为其主席。督政府的第一个决定，就是下令对莫斯科发动一次最终的、协调一致的进攻。

src: Along the railroad many troubles took place. Skirmishes with retreating Hungarian POWs lead to a rise against the Bolsheviks. Subsequently the Czech Legion took possession of huge parts of Siberia and even reaching the Volga River in the west.
dst: 铁路沿线发生了许多麻烦。与撤退中的匈牙利战俘的交火引发了反抗布尔什维克的起义。随后，捷克军团占领了西伯利亚的大片地区，甚至西抵伏尔加河。
阿尔卑斯架桥步兵 (未使用)

src: Alpini/ 43 Div./ IV Corp. d'Arm./ 2 Arm.
dst: 山地兵/ 第43师/ 第4军 d'Arm./ 第2集团军

src: Alpini/ 50 Div./ IV Corp. d'Arm./ 2 Arm.
dst: 山地兵/ 第50师/ 第4军 d'Arm./ 第2集团军

src: Als Grund gibt er an, die Gallier würden aus Britannien militärische Hilfe erhalten... und tatsächlich befinden sich auf beiden Seiten des Ärmelkanals identische Stämme: beispielsweise die Parisi -auf die der Name der Stadt Paris zurückgeht- sie Siedelten um das heutige Paris und in Südostengland...
dst: 他给出的理由是，高卢人会从不列颠获得军援……而事实上，英吉利海峡两岸确实分布着相同的部族：例如巴黎西人——巴黎城之名即源于他们——就既定居在今天的巴黎一带，也定居在英格兰东南部……

src: Alsen was the last major battle of the war. Between June and July the Germans occupied all of Jutland (continental Denmark), and the Danes had to surrender. On 1 August 1864 the King of Denmark renounced all his rights in the duchies in favour of the Emperor of Austria and the King of Prussia. The peace treaty was finally signed in Vienna on 30 October 1864.
dst: 阿尔森是这场战争最后一场大战。六月到七月间，德军占领了整个日德兰半岛（丹麦本土），丹麦人不得不投降。1864年8月1日，丹麦国王放弃了自己在公国中的一切权利，把它们让给了奥地利皇帝和普鲁士国王。和约最终于1864年10月30日在维也纳签署。
此外，还必须有10支比利时部队存活。

src: Also General Staff promotes you to Kommodore. Congratulations!
dst: 另外，总参谋部将你晋升为海军准将。恭喜！

src: Also a lot of enemy ships with marines and partroopers are moving from Scapa Flow to fight you. General Staff sends a Light Radar Cruiser from east .
dst: 此外，大批载有海军陆战队与伞兵的敌舰正从斯卡帕湾出动，前来与你交战。总参谋部从东面派来一艘轻型雷达巡洋舰。

src: Also a sort of advice, since some things I won't be able to pass on to you anymore because the Gestapo has me on their list too. Add Graf Zeppelin Carrier but don't abandon Friesenland. Also add Scharnhorst or Deutschland and 1 Destroyer and as many marine units you can, I am afraid that will be a long time until you can get reinforcements. Air units can easily be transferred to your core if needed.
dst: 另外还有一点建议，因为有些事我再也无法转达给你了，因为盖世太保也把我列入了名单。增购 Graf Zeppelin 号航母，但不要放弃 Friesenland。还要增购 Scharnhorst 号或 Deutschland 号以及1艘驱逐舰，并尽可能多地增购海军陆战队单位，恐怕要过很久你才能得到增援。如有需要，空军单位可以很容易地转入你的核心部队。

src: Also units of the Polska Si³a Zbrojna mutineed against the Central Powers.
dst: 波兰武装力量的部队也发动了针对同盟国的哗变。

src: Also we got our peace-offer: the 1937 borders, public in the US press, and announced that, as a sign of good will, we will immediately retreat from Belgium and France. We might still have a chance to split the coalition apart....
dst: 而且我们的和平提议：1937年的边界，已刊登在美国报端，我们还宣布，作为善意的表示，我们将立即从比利时和法国撤退。我们或许仍有机会拆散这个联盟……

src: Also while you were busy, a revolt has broken out in Warschau. Clearly the goal is to establish an independent state before the Soviets enter Warschau. We will see what the English think of it.
dst: 另外，就在您忙于作战之时，华沙爆发了起义。其目标显然是在苏军进入华沙之前建立一个独立国家。我们就看英国人对此作何想法。

src: Also, I assume you know what to do with the Ukrainian prisoners of war?  They are traitors of their own people.  They allied themselves with the very power that invaded their country and they deserve nothing but the final penalty.
dst: 另外，我想您知道该如何处置乌克兰战俘吧？他们是自己人民的叛徒。他们与入侵自己国家的势力勾结，只配得到最终的惩罚。

src: Also, tell your men that there is talk that the Allies are entertaining an Allied Italian corps to fight the Germans up north..............
dst: 另外，告诉你的部下，有传言说盟军正在考虑组建一个同盟国意大利军，去北面对付德国人……
奥尔绍梅尼奥迪林（森林）
下特尔梅什(蒂米舒德若斯)

src: Although Antwerpen/Anvers fell on the 18/19 May, the Belgian Army is now taking position in the Gent/Gand bridgehead, behind the Dender/Dendre and Escaut/Scheldt rivers.
dst: 虽然安特卫普已于5月18日至19日陷落，比利时军队现在正进入根特桥头堡，位于登德尔河和斯海尔德河后方。

src: Although Greece still had more soldiers on the field, their morale was decreasing quickly. Maybe, if they had settled for Smyrna, the Greeks could have kept that region for themselves, but they had been too ambitious, and now they were going to pay for their folly.
dst: 虽然希腊在战场上仍有更多士兵，但他们的士气正在迅速低落。也许，如果当初满足于士麦那，希腊人本可以为自己保住那个地区，但他们过于贪心，现在他们要为这份愚蠢付出代价。

src: Although Merritt was for an immediate assault, Dewey wanted to negotiate a deal with General Fermin Jaudenes, the new Spanish Governor replacing Augustin due to his pessimism. On 10 August a deal was made. Jaudenes agreed to surrender after a fake battle to satisfy Spanish honour, provided the insurgents were kept out.
dst: 虽然梅里特主张立即进攻，杜威却想与费尔明·豪德内斯将军达成协议。豪德内斯是因奥古斯丁的悲观而接替他的西班牙新总督。8月10日，双方达成协议。豪德内斯同意在一场假仗之后投降，以顾全西班牙的荣誉，条件是起义者不得入城。

src: Although Ras Alula and the other Ethiopian chieftains tried to hide Yohannes's death from the Mahdists and from our own warriors, it was in vain. As soon as our men knew that their emperor had died, most of them panicked and fled the battlefield. The Sudanese counter-attacked, and a battle that was going extremely well turned into a terrible defeat for us.
dst: 尽管拉斯·阿卢拉和其他埃塞俄比亚酋长竭力向马赫迪分子以及我们自己的战士隐瞒约翰内斯的死讯，但都是徒劳。我们的士兵一得知皇帝驾崩，大部分便惊慌失措，逃离了战场。苏丹人发起反击，一场本来进展极好的战斗，就这样变成了我们的惨败。

src: Although Shire was a tactical victory for the Italians, they suffered a strategic defeat. Their casualties had been very high, and they couldn't go on with their offensive. And so it was how the Italian invaders were expelled from Ethiopia a second time, twenty years after Adwa. All the enemy survivors retreated to the safety of the Eritrean Highlands.
dst: 尽管希雷对意大利人来说是一场战术胜利，但他们却遭受了战略上的失败。他们伤亡惨重，无法继续攻势。就这样，在阿杜瓦战役二十年之后，意大利入侵者第二次被逐出了埃塞俄比亚。所有幸存的敌人都退入了厄立特里亚高地这个安全之地。

src: Although all the surviving Chinese warships were fleeing to Weihawei, my father in law somehow convinced the Beiyang Fleet to turn back and defend Liushun. We knew that the Japanese Navy was approaching, but after the Yalu river naval battle they were overconfident. They were sending a powerful, but small, advanced flotilla without any proper gunboat escort, and they didn't expect any Chinese warships in the area, so maybe they could be caught by surprise.
dst: 尽管所有幸存的中国战舰都在逃往威海卫，我的岳父还是设法说服北洋水师掉头回来保卫旅顺。我们知道日本海军正在逼近，但鸭绿江海战之后，他们变得过于自信。他们派出的是一支虽强大却规模很小的先遣分舰队，没有任何像样的炮舰护航，而且他们没料到该地区会有中国战舰，所以也许他们可以被打个措手不及。

src: Although almost all of the Danish army succeeded in completing the evacuation, the Danes had lo leave many artillery pieces behind, and lost their best defence positions without any serious fighting. Seeing the evacuation as a failure, de Meza was relieved of his command.
dst: 尽管丹麦军队几乎全部成功完成了撤退，但丹麦人不得不丢下许多火炮，并在没有进行任何激烈战斗的情况下失去了他们最好的防御阵地。由于认为这次撤退是一场失败，德梅扎被解除了指挥职务。

src: Although an attack to the Spanish forces in the Philippines had long been a part of the U.S. Navy's strategic plans in the event of a conflict with Spain, the objective of the offensive operation was not to conquer all or part of the Spanish colony, but divert Spanish ships and give the United States' a stronger bargaining position at the peace settlement. The magnitude of Dewey's victory changed these plans and prompted the United States to send the troops necessary to capture Manila from the Spanish.
dst: 尽管对菲律宾西班牙军队的进攻早已是美国海军在美西冲突情况下战略计划的一部分，但此次进攻行动的目标并非征服西班牙殖民地的全部或一部，而是牵制西班牙舰船，使美国在和平谈判中获得更强有力的筹码。杜威胜利的规模改变了这些计划，促使美国派出攻占马尼拉所需的军队。

src: Although an attack to the Spanish forces in the Philippines had long been a part of the U.S. Navy's strategic plans in the event of a conflict with Spain, the objective of the offensive operation was not to conquer all or part of the Spanish colony, but divert Spanish ships and give the United States' a stronger bargaining position at the peace settlement. The magnitude of Dewey's victory prompted the United States to send the troops necessary to capture Manila from the Spanish.
dst: 尽管在与西班牙发生冲突时进攻驻菲律宾的西军早就是美国海军战略计划的一部分，但这次进攻行动的目标并不是征服西班牙殖民地的全部或一部分，而是牵制西班牙军舰，并使美国在和平谈判中处于更有利的地位。杜威胜利的巨大影响促使美国派遣必要兵力，从西班牙人手中夺取马尼拉。

src: Although badly outnumbered, my troops have behaved at the battlefield much better than the Bolsheviks. Now the railroad is clear of enemies, we have taken lots of supplies, and many prisoners have joined our ranks. Tikhoretskaya will fall pretty soon, and then the way to Ekaterinodar will be open.
dst: 尽管兵力处于严重劣势，我的部队在战场上的表现却远胜布尔什维克。如今铁路线上已无敌军，我们缴获了大量补给，许多俘虏加入了我们的队伍。季霍列茨卡亚很快就会陷落，通往叶卡捷琳诺达尔的道路也将随之打开。

src: Although battered and bruised, the Bulgarians have kept on their advance until the Çatalca line, only 25 miles away from Istambul. Beyond our Çatalca defences, only Edirne and a handful of villages still resist the allied offensive. So Çatalca is, right now, our last line of defence against the enemy hordes.
dst: 尽管伤痕累累、狼狈不堪，保加利亚人仍一路推进到了恰塔尔贾防线——距伊斯坦布尔仅25英里。在我们的恰塔尔贾防线之外，只有埃迪尔内和少数几个村庄仍在抵抗联军攻势。所以，恰塔尔贾眼下是我们抵御敌军洪流的最后一道防线。

src: Although defeating the British forces under these circumstances was a truly heroic deed, there are simply too few of us to chase and destroy the fleeing enemies.They'll regroup and will attack again in a few days and, since we don't have enough replacements for our casualties, we'll have to retreat and live to fight another day.
dst: 尽管在这种情形下击败英军堪称真正的英雄壮举，但我们的人数实在太少，无力追击并消灭溃逃的敌人。他们会在几天内重新集结并再次进攻，而由于我们没有足够的兵员补充伤亡，我们只得撤退，以待来日再战。

src: Although deployment is not limited you may find it difficult to bring all units into battle due to the rough arctic terrain.
dst: 尽管部署不受限制，但由于北极地形崎岖，你可能会发现难以把所有部队都投入战斗。

src: Although everything was lost for them, the Germans kept on fighting until the Armistice was signed on November 11th. It was a total defeat for them, and a cruel and bitter victory for the British Empire, badly weakened as a result of the war, and has never fully recovered.
dst: 尽管对他们来说一切尽失，德军仍继续作战，直到11月11日停战协定签署。对他们而言这是一场彻底的失败，而对大英帝国而言则是一场残酷而苦涩的胜利，帝国因这场战争而元气大伤，且从未完全恢复。

src: Although everything was lost for them, the Germans kept on fighting until the Armistice was signed on November 11th. It was a total defeat for them, and a cruel and bitter victory for the British Empire, badly weakened as a result of the war, and that has never fully recovered.
dst: 尽管对他们来说一切尽失，德军仍继续作战，直到11月11日停战协定签署。对他们而言这是一场彻底的失败，而对大英帝国而言则是一场残酷而苦涩的胜利，帝国因这场战争而元气大伤，且从未完全恢复。

src: Although initially the British were reluctant to employ non-white units in this war, now they're desperate. While you were fighting in Port Elizabeth an expeditionary corps was formed in India, and they disembarked in Durban some weeks ago. They tried to go to  Buller's aid in Colenso, but due to their lack of knowledge of the terrain and their defective maps they didn't arrive in time.
dst: 尽管英军起初不愿在这场战争中使用非白人部队，如今他们却已走投无路。当您在伊丽莎白港作战时，一支远征军已在印度组建，并于几周前在德班登陆。他们试图前往科伦索援助布勒，但由于不熟悉地形且地图残缺，未能及时赶到。

src: Although it is said that the catastrophe at Liptovsky Svaty Mikulas happened mainly due to the low morale of Soviet soldiers, who immediatelly pillaged the local distillery, it is hard to argue about the fact that Germans put up a heavy resistence.
dst: 尽管有人说利普托夫斯基米库拉什的灾难主要源于苏军士兵士气低落——他们立刻洗劫了当地的酒厂——但德军进行了顽强抵抗这一事实是难以否认的。

src: Although my troops did their best, only with the arrival of our cossack reserves could we overcome the Bolsheviks. At least the railroad is clear of enemies now, we have taken lots of supplies, and many prisoners have joined our ranks. Tikhoretskaya will fall pretty soon, and then the way to Ekaterinodar will be open.
dst: 尽管我的部队尽了全力，但直到我们的哥萨克预备队赶到，我们才得以击败布尔什维克。至少现在铁路线上已无敌军，我们缴获了大量补给，许多俘虏加入了我们的队伍。季霍列茨卡亚很快就会陷落，通往叶卡捷琳诺达尔的道路也将随之打开。

src: Although not in a very brilliant way, your task here has finished. The Turks, and some of our second line divisions, will be able to secure the new front line. They could even occupy the Sinai and threaten the Sueskanal. It will depend on the result of the upcoming German offensive in France. And that's precisely the reason why you must go back to Europe. We count on you for the final attack against the French. Are you ready?
dst: 尽管方式不算辉煌，但您在这里的任务已经完成。土耳其人和我们的一些二线师将能够守住新的战线。他们甚至可能占领西奈半岛并威胁苏伊士运河。这要取决于即将到来的德国在法国攻势的结果。而这也正是您必须返回欧洲的原因。我们指望您对法国人发起最后一击。您准备好了吗？

src: Although not without problems, you have beaten off the Russian relieve attempt. Send your troops back North for the final assault on Moscow. And don't give me any excuses, I know the rasputitsa - the dreaded Fall rains - have set in. This will disrupt mobility but we do need to reach Moscow before the winter.
dst: 虽然并非毫无波折，你毕竟击退了俄国人的解围企图。把你的部队调回北方，准备对莫斯科的最后突击。别给我找任何借口，我知道“泥泞季”——那可怕的秋雨——已经来了。这会影响机动，但我们必须在入冬前抵达莫斯科。

src: Although our maps were not good and our scouts could not approach the Boer lines due to the amazing marksmanship of our enemies, we believed that most of the Boer defenders were entrenched on Magersfontein Ridge. Lord Methuen ordered us to make a night march towards Magersfontein, and then launch a frontal assault on the Boer at dawn, the following day.
dst: 尽管我们的地图不佳，而且由于敌人惊人的枪法，我们的侦察兵无法接近布尔人的战线，但我们相信大多数布尔守军都据守在马格斯方丹山脊上。梅休因勋爵命令我们向马格斯方丹作夜行军，然后在次日黎明对布尔人发起正面突击。

src: Although our plan was good, it was poorly executed. The Soviets resisted and we couldn't encircle them. In the end we were forced to retire. The troops of the Red Army finally occupied the whole of the Urals and were given the opportunity to attack Siberia and Turkestan.
dst: 尽管计划很好，但执行得很糟。苏维埃顶住了，我们没能合围他们。最终我们被迫撤退。红军部队最终占领了整个乌拉尔，并获得了进攻西伯利亚和土耳其斯坦的机会。

src: Although severely weakened, the German Army was still a magnificent war machine and a terrible enemy. Between the end of the campaign of the Somme and the summer of 1917 the Germans managed to conquer Romania, to bring Russia to a revolution and to the verge of surrender, and to defeat the French at the Aisne. Some French units actually mutinied, and for some days it seemed that the front could collapse. Our own offensive at Messines had only a limited success, and our enemies had been able to take reinforcements to the Italian front. In fact, the only real good news was that, finally, the United States declared war on Germany.
dst: 尽管已遭到严重削弱，德军仍是一台出色的战争机器和一个可怕的敌人。从索姆河战役结束到1917年夏天之间，德军征服了罗马尼亚，使俄国陷入革命并濒临投降，还在埃纳河击败了法军。一些法军部队实际上发生了兵变，有几天战线似乎可能崩溃。我们在梅西讷的攻势只取得了有限的成功，而我们的敌人则得以把增援调往意大利战线。事实上，唯一真正的好消息是，美国终于对德国宣战了。

src: Although some Belgian soldiers were indeed evacuated it was not the result of an organized operation but of casual or individual circumstances.
dst: 虽然确实有一些比利时士兵被撤离，但这并非有组织行动的结果，而是偶然或个别情况所致。

src: Although some of my fellow officers are ecstatic with those news, I'm skeptical about them. In a few years' time the Red Army will have grown stronger, so the Bolsheviks will probably attack us again. Then the British, who have already betrayed us once, will surely forsake us one more time.
dst: 尽管我的一些同僚军官对这些消息欣喜若狂，我却心存疑虑。再过几年，红军将变得更加强大，布尔什维克很可能会再次进攻我们。到那时，已经背叛过我们一次的英国人，定会再次抛弃我们。

src: Although somewhat outdated, the Çatalca line is still a formidable fortress. Behind its fortifications and trenches, the Ottomans have gathered all their remaining forces in Europe, they have brought their artillery together for centralized operations, and besides they are expecting some reserve divisions from Anatolia. There aren't any obvious weak points in the line, so by no means should you underestimate the enemy.
dst: 虽然略显过时，恰塔勒贾防线仍是一座令人生畏的要塞。在其防御工事和战壕后方，奥斯曼人集结了他们在欧洲的全部剩余兵力，把炮兵集中起来用于统一指挥的作战，此外还在等候来自安纳托利亚的一些预备师。这条防线没有任何明显的弱点，所以您绝不可低估敌人。

src: Although the Belgians succeeded in containing the bridgehead no sufficient reserves were available for a large-scale counterattack. On the contrary the Germans were constantly dropping new paratroopers at the bridges and the fortress of Eben-Emael.
dst: 尽管比利时人成功遏制了桥头堡，却没有足够的预备队发动大规模反击。相反，德军不断向桥头和埃本-埃马尔要塞空投新的伞兵。

src: Although the French had a tactical victory at Gravelotte, they couldn't exploit their success. Unable to keep its positions, the Army of the Rhine retreated to Metz the next morning, and the Germans besieged the city almost immediately. In a matter of weeks most of Bazaine's units had been destroyed or had been trapped in Metz where, unless they received some kind of help, would eventually have to surrender.
dst: 尽管法军在格拉沃洛特取得了一场战术上的胜利，他们却无法利用这一战果。莱茵军团无力守住阵地，次日清晨便撤回梅斯，德军几乎立即包围了该城。数周之内，巴赞的大部分部队要么被歼灭，要么被困在梅斯，除非得到某种援助，否则最终都将不得不投降。

src: Although the German forces routed the Soviet advance, we fear for the worst when the Germans leave...  With the rank of Kolonelleitnant, You will be stationed by Lake Peipus to continue the effort to train and recruit the Estonian Army.
dst: 尽管德军击溃了苏军的推进，但我们担心德军离开后情况会恶化……您将以中校军衔驻守在佩普西湖畔，继续训练和招募爱沙尼亚军队。

src: Although the German victory at Tanga had thwarted the British plans for a quick victory over German East Africa, Indian and K.A.R. troops managed to control some strategic positions on the German East African side of the border with British East Africa.  One of these positions was the Jasin plantation.  Von Lettow-Vorbeck knew that Jasin was weakly defended and decided to attack on 18 January 1915 in order to prevent further danger to Tanga.
dst: 尽管德军在坦噶的胜利挫败了英国迅速战胜德属东非的计划，印度部队和国王非洲步枪团（K.A.R.）还是设法控制了与英属东非接壤的德属东非一侧的一些战略要地。其中之一就是贾辛种植园。冯·莱托-福尔贝克知道贾辛防守薄弱，遂决定于1915年1月18日发动进攻，以防坦噶遭到进一步威胁。

src: Although the Italian Army has tried to react, they've been too slow, and most of our enemies are still on the Piave river. So, once you emerge victorious, most of the Italian Army will be trapped between the Piave and the Po, and our divisions will be free to race southwards down the country.
dst: 尽管意大利军队试图作出反应，但他们的动作太慢了，我们的大部分敌人仍在皮亚韦河一线。因此，一旦您胜出，意大利陆军的大部分就会被困在皮亚韦河与波河之间，我们的各师便可放手沿这个国家向南长驱直入。

src: Although the Prussians suffered terrible losses at Mars-la-Tour, the French Army had to stop and retreated to the east. When the next day the bulk of the German First and Second Armies arrived to the area, they prepared themselves to destroy the Army of the Rhine once and for all.
dst: 尽管普鲁士人在马尔斯拉图尔遭受了惨重损失，法军还是不得不停下脚步，向东撤退。次日，当德意志第1和第2军团的主力抵达该地区时，他们便着手准备彻底歼灭莱茵军团。

src: Although the Prussians suffered terrible losses at Mars-la-Tour, they achieved their goal. The French Army had to stop and retreated to the east. When the next day the bulk of the German First and Second Armies arrived to the area, they prepared themselves to destroy the Army of the Rhine once and for all.
dst: 尽管普鲁士人在马尔斯拉图尔遭受了惨重损失，他们还是达成了目标。法军不得不停下脚步，向东撤退。次日，当德意志第1和第2军团的主力抵达该地区时，他们便着手准备彻底歼灭莱茵军团。

src: Although the Roman generals understood the cunning ruse,they could not hold back their legionaries in  lineup, after someone had claimed the enemies trying to escape.
dst: 罗马将领虽看破了这条诡计，却在有人喊出敌人要逃跑之后，再也拦不住列阵中的军团兵。

src: Although the Roman generals understood the cunning ruse,they could not hold back their legionaries in their lineup, after someone had claimed the enemies trying to escape.
dst: 罗马将领虽看破了这条诡计，却在有人喊出敌人要逃跑之后，再也拦不住列阵中的军团兵。

src: Although the Turk army is composed mainly of infantry units, we know that thay have at least one cavalry division in the area. Besides, our intelligenge reports confirm that a large number of Turkish fresh troops are on their way to Bunar Hissar, and they'll arrive to the battle front in a couple of days at most.
dst: 虽然土耳其军队主要由步兵单位组成，但我们知道他们在该地区至少有一个骑兵师。此外，我们的情报报告证实，大批土耳其生力军正赶往布纳尔希萨尔，最多几天之内就会抵达前线。

src: Although the Turkish couldn't overcome the French defences, and the battle stilll didn't have a clear winner, on February 11 general Quérette and his troops retreated from Marash. Most of the Armenian civilians in the town were then massacred by the Muslim militias, or froze to death during the evacuation.
dst: 虽然土耳其人未能突破法军防线，战斗也没有明确胜负，但2月11日，凯雷特将军和他的部队从马拉什撤退了。镇上的大多数亚美尼亚平民随后被穆斯林民兵屠杀，或在撤退途中冻死。

src: Although the Zulus fought valiantly, they were no match for our experienced and well equipped soldiers.
dst: 尽管祖鲁人作战英勇，他们仍不是我们经验丰富、装备精良的士兵的对手。

src: Although the enemy had a minor success at Zborow, Kerenski's plan has ended in a disaster. Russian soldiers refuse to fight anymore and they are simply deserting or, even worse, joining the revolutionaries. I wouldn't be surprised if the Bolsheviks took power before the end of the year. I can almost feel pity for this former great country and its cruel ending, but it's a war after all. It was them or us.
dst: 尽管敌军在兹博罗夫取得了些许战果，克伦斯基的计划仍以灾难收场。俄军士兵拒绝再战，他们要么干脆开小差，要么更糟——投奔革命者。如果布尔什维克在年底前夺取政权，我一点也不会惊讶。对这个曾经伟大的国家及其残酷的结局，我几乎感到一丝怜悯，但这毕竟是战争。不是他们死，就是我们亡。

src: Although the fascists have had a hard time, they are still able to resist. It is unsure if the enemy decides to defend Odessa. Nonetheless, we demand you take this port as soon as possible, and drive west, if possible up to the Rumanian border. Watch out for experienced elements of elite divisions. The past weeks these have been the prime source of resistance to our advance in the Ukraine. Good luck, comrade.
dst: 尽管法西斯日子难过，他们仍能抵抗。敌人是否决定防守敖德萨，尚不确定。尽管如此，我们要求你尽快夺取这个港口，并尽可能向西推进，直抵罗马尼亚边境。当心精锐师的经验丰富的部队。过去几周，他们是我们向乌克兰推进的主要抵抗来源。祝你好运，同志。

src: Although the first and second Transjordan operations were a distinct tactical defeat, the British losses were not too heavy; about 500 in the mounted divisions and 1,100 in the infantry.  Nearly 1,000 prisoners were captured.
dst: 虽然第一次和第二次外约旦行动在战术上明显失败，但英军损失并不太重：骑兵师约500人，步兵约1100人。还俘虏了近1000名敌军。

src: Although the initial plan was to break into Slovakia in five days, now it is clearly visible that such a thing is completely impossible. The enemy defence is extremely firm and we must fear the worst - we may be stuck in the Pass and forced into the positional warfare that favors the German defenders. Try to break through, so that we'll get into the open landscape before weather worsens. The deeper you'll get, the better chance for a complete German collapse...
dst: 尽管原计划五天内突入斯洛伐克，如今已清楚可见，这完全不可能。敌军防御极其坚固，我们必须做最坏的打算——我们可能会被困在山口里，被迫进行有利于德军守军的阵地战。设法突破吧，好赶在天气恶化前进入开阔地。你推进得越深，德军全面崩溃的机会就越大……

src: Although the main battles are taking place in the west, you know that the situation in Elsass isn't exactly calm. Right now the front is stabilized on the Vogesen mountains, but the French have occupied the strategic peak called Hartmannsweilerkopf. There they have an excellent advanced position for observating our movements on the plains of Elsass, or for launching a new offensive against Mülhausen. Your mission will be driving the French out of the mountains as fast as you can.
dst: 尽管主要战斗都发生在西面，但您知道阿尔萨斯的局势并不太平。眼下战线稳定在孚日山脉上，但法军已占领了被称为哈特曼斯维勒科普夫的战略山峰。在那里他们占据着极好的前进阵地，既能观察我们在阿尔萨斯平原上的动向，又能对米卢斯发动新的攻势。您的任务将是尽快把法军赶出山区。

src: Although the main justification for American intervention was the situation in Cuba, the war extended to all Spanish possessions in both the Caribbean and the Pacific. In fact the first main battle was at Manila Bay where, on May 1, the U.S. Navy's Asiatic Squadron defeated the Spanish squadron in the Philippines.
dst: 尽管美国干预的主要理由是古巴局势，但战争扩展到了西班牙在加勒比和太平洋的所有属地。事实上，首场主要战斗发生在马尼拉湾，5月1日，美国海军亚洲分舰队在菲律宾击败了西班牙分舰队。

src: Although the third battle of Ypres was not the success that Haig had hoped for, it had proved that our Army, by using the new methods in combined arms, could pierce even the deepest German defence line. However, our enemies possessed an outstanding ability for mobilizing their reserves and counterattacking in a matter of hours, so they had been able to stop all our former offensives before we had had any real chance to inflict on them a decisive defeat. But if we could launch a surprise attack on the Germans, so that they could not know when or where it would take place, even the Hindenburg Line might fall.
dst: 尽管第三次伊普尔战役并未取得黑格所期望的成功，但它证明了我们的军队通过运用诸兵种协同的新方法，能够突破甚至是最纵深的德军防线。然而，我们的敌人拥有在数小时内调动预备队并实施反击的出色能力，因此他们得以在我们真正有机会对其造成决定性失败之前，就阻止了我们此前所有的攻势。但如果我们能对德军发动一场突袭，使他们无法得知其时间和地点，那么即便是兴登堡防线也可能陷落。

src: Although they stopped our first attack, the Italians retired as soon as they learnt that our reinforcements were on the way. They finally feared and respected the Ethiopian army!
dst: 尽管他们挡住了我们的第一次进攻，但一得知我们的援军正在赶来，意大利人便撤退了。他们终于畏惧并敬重起埃塞俄比亚军队来了！

src: Although this caused some panic amoungst our troops you were able to ward it off, well done.
dst: 虽然这在我军引起了一些惊慌，你还是把它挡了回去，干得好。

src: Although we completed our mission by taking all the marked objectives, the Germans mobilized their reserves faster than we did, and, deprived of any proper support, we had to go back to the left bank of the Aisne. It was then when I was informed that my son Michael had been wounded in a skirmish soon after his division had crossed the Marne. However, I was relieved to know that it was nothing too serious, and that he would recover in just a few weeks.
dst: 尽管我们攻占了所有标定的目标、完成了任务，德军调动预备队的速度仍比我们快，由于得不到任何像样的支援，我们不得不退回埃纳河左岸。就在这时，我得知我的儿子迈克尔在他的师渡过马恩河后不久，在一场小规模交火中负伤了。不过，得知伤情并不太重，而且几周内就能痊愈，我松了一口气。

src: Although we couldn't stop the French from relieving Tuyen Quang, when the news of the French retreat from Lang Son reached Paris there were riots in the streets. The laicist-colonialist government of Jules Ferry fell on 30 March, and his successor promptly signed a peace treaty with China. According to the Treaty of Tientsin China recognised the French protectorate over Annam and Tonkin, but at least didn't have to pay any war reparations. From the Chinese point of view the war had been fought to a stalemate, and that had an outstanding effect on the rebirth of China's national pride.
dst: 尽管我们没能阻止法军解宣光之围，但当法军从谅山撤退的消息传到巴黎时，街头发生了骚乱。茹费里的世俗殖民主义政府于3月30日倒台，他的继任者随即与中国签署了和约。根据《天津条约》，中国承认法国对安南和北圻的保护权，但至少无需支付任何战争赔款。从中国人的角度看，这场战争打成了平局，这对中国民族自豪感的重生产生了深远的影响。

src: Although we defended ourselves quite well at Landrecies and Grand Fayt, our retreat was too hasty. We left the II Corp's right flank exposed, so they nearly got trapped by the enemy at Le Cateau. We could do nothing but follow our march  to the South: fortunately the enemy dared not to pursue us for a few days.
dst: 尽管我们在朗德勒西和格朗费防守得相当不错，但我们的撤退太过仓促。我们使第二军的右翼暴露出来，以致他们险些在勒卡托被敌人围困。我们别无他法，只能继续向南行进：幸运的是，敌人有几天不敢追击我们。

src: Although we have been defeated, the liberal army withdrew. They lost General Concha, who was killed by one of our shots. Although an enemy, he was a capable and courageous man. We will pray for him.
dst: 尽管我们战败了，自由派军队却撤退了。他们失去了孔查将军，他被我方一枪击毙。虽然是敌人，他却是一位能干而勇敢的人。我们会为他祈祷。

src: Although we have succeeded in defeating the Soviets in our sector we have been isolated from other units around us.  The Soviets are launching counter-attacks all along the front.  We have no choice but to pull back and try and contain them to give time for the other armies to retreat to the 'eastern wall'.
dst: 尽管我们已在本地段击败苏军，却与周围其他部队失去了联系。苏军正沿全线发起反攻。我们别无选择，只能后撤并设法遏制他们，好为其他集团军撤往“东方壁垒”争取时间。

src: Although we have taken Rostov - it is a short lived victory.  Timoshenko's counter-attack has forced us into a quick retreat despite Hitlers insistance that we stand our ground.  We will be fighting containing actions against limited Soviet actions for the rest of the winter.
dst: 尽管我们已夺取罗斯托夫，这却是一场短暂的胜利。铁木辛哥的反攻迫使我们迅速撤退，尽管希特勒坚持要我们死守阵地。整个冬季余下的时间里，我们都将进行遏制作战，对付苏军有限的行动。

src: Although we held Caen we can not continue to hold these current positions.  The Americans have broken through the 'bocage' terrain and are advancing rapidly.  We are in danger of being encirlced and we must pull back before it is too late.
dst: 尽管我们守住了卡昂，却无法继续守住眼下的阵地。美军已突破“灌木树篱”地带，正迅速推进。我们有被合围的危险，必须趁早后撤。

src: Although we made progress, still, after all those months, there is no break through. Our troops were ready. You failed. Our glorious leader has requested your presence...
dst: 尽管我们取得了进展，但这么多个月过去，依然没有突破。我们的部队已经准备就绪。你失败了。我们伟大领袖召见你……

src: Although we succeeded in capturing our initial objectives the rest of the divisions taking part in the offensive have failed to penetrate far enough.  Also, the Americans and the British are beginning counter-attacks.  Germany is now moving to the defensive in the west while we and rest of 6th SS Panzer Army are transferred east.
dst: 尽管我们成功夺取了初始目标，但参加攻势的其他师未能推进得足够远。而且美英正开始反攻。如今德国在西线转入防御，而我们和党卫军第6装甲集团军其余部队则调往东线。

src: Although we tried to make an agreement with the British Empire about the rights of the uitlanders, the negotiations have failed. President Paul Kruger has declared war on the British.
dst: 尽管我们曾试图就外侨的权利与大英帝国达成协议，但谈判失败了。保罗·克鲁格总统已向英国宣战。

src: Although we were about to ask for a ceasefire, after three weeks of fighting the French "division de Cilicie" has retreated from Marash.
dst: 尽管我们正打算请求停火，但经过三周的战斗，法军「奇里乞亚师」已从马拉什撤退。

src: Although you couldn't defeat Kitchener's forces he has died in battle, and when news of this  arrived in Kaapstad a rebellion started among the Afrikaner population of the city. Governor Milner panicked and he has left the country.
dst: 尽管您未能击败基钦纳的部队，但他已战死沙场，而当这一消息传到开普敦时，该城的阿非利卡人居民中爆发了起义。米尔纳总督惊慌失措，已经逃离了该国。

src: Although you did a great job at Malka Nidzhe, the enemy offensive against Bitolya goes on, harder than ever. We haven't got enough soldiers to overcome the French pressure, so we'll evacuate Bitolya and build a strong defence line north of that town. However, that will take some time.
dst: 虽然您在马尔卡尼哲干得很出色，但敌人对比托利亚的攻势仍在继续，而且比以往更猛烈。我们没有足够的兵力顶住法国的压力，因此我们将撤出比托利亚，在该镇以北构筑一道坚固的防线。不过，这需要一些时间。

src: Although you did manage to advance almost halfway to Stalingrad, Unfortunately, in this case, that is not good enough! Dismissed!
dst: 尽管你确实推进到了距斯大林格勒近一半的路程，遗憾的是，这一次这还不够好！你被解职了！

src: Although you did your best, this time victory was impossible. Our army is exhausted, and we can't fight any longer. We'll have to ask for an armistice.
dst: 虽然您尽了全力，但这次胜利已无可能。我军已精疲力竭，再也无力作战。我们只能请求停战。

src: Although you did your best, this time victory was impossible. The British and Greek armies are marching through all of Macedonia, and soon they'll be able to take Sofiya. We'll have to ask for an armistice.
dst: 虽然您尽了全力，但这次胜利已无可能。英军和希腊军队正横扫整个马其顿，很快就能拿下索非亚。我们只能请求停战。

src: Although you did your best, this time victory was impossible. The French and Serbian armies are marching through all of Macedonia, and soon they'll be able to take Sofiya. We'll have to ask for an armistice.
dst: 虽然您尽了全力，但这次胜利已无可能。法军和塞尔维亚军队正横扫整个马其顿，很快就能拿下索非亚。我们只能请求停战。

src: Although you fought with courage the enemy was too numerous. However, your heroism has allowed our troops to withdraw in order, so that the combat capability of our army is still intact. Unfortunately from now on the liberals take the initiative in the war, which will surely be confined to the northern provinces.
dst: 尽管您英勇奋战，敌人还是太多了。不过，您的英勇让我们的部队得以有序撤退，我军战斗力仍然完好。遗憾的是，从今往后，自由派掌握了战争的主动权，而战争必将局限于北方各省。

src: Although you have defeated the British, French has been able to send reinforcements to Roberts. And, sadly, I have bad news from Kimberley. Roberts has forced Cronjé to leave his positions at Magersfontein, and has trapped him at Paardeberg. In a matter of days Cronjé will be forced to surrender. You must go back to the Transvaal inmediately and try to save our country from the foreign invasion.
dst: 尽管您击败了英军，弗伦奇还是得以向罗伯茨派出增援。而且遗憾的是，我从金伯利带来了坏消息。罗伯茨已迫使克罗涅放弃马赫斯方丹的阵地，并将他围困在帕尔德山。不出几天克罗涅就将被迫投降。您必须立即返回德兰士瓦，尽力把我们的国家从外国入侵中拯救出来。

src: Although you have defeated the French and Serbian armies, the British and the Greeks still threaten our left flank at the Doiran Lake. In fact, we know that five enemy divisions are about to make a general assault against our defences. If they overcome us, your recent victory at Dobro Pole will have been in vain, because we'll have to cancel  our advance into Solun and adopt, one more time, a defensive strategy. For God's sake, don't let that happen. Destroy the Brithish Salonika army and lead Bulgaria to victoy!
dst: 虽然您击败了法军和塞尔维亚军队，但英军和希腊军队仍威胁着我们在多伊兰湖的左翼。事实上，我们得知五个敌军师即将对我军防线发动总攻。如果他们得逞，您最近在多布罗波列的胜利将付诸东流，因为我们将不得不取消向萨洛尼卡的推进，再一次转入防御。看在上帝份上，别让这种事发生。摧毁驻萨洛尼卡的英军，带领保加利亚走向胜利！

src: Although you have failed to capture Riga, the German forces have been severely weakened by your actions at Cesis.  A diplomatic solution was reached with British and French aid.
dst: 尽管您未能攻克里加，德国军队已因您在采西斯的行动而遭到严重削弱。在英法两国的帮助下，达成了外交解决方案。

src: Although you managed to break the Ottoman line, I regret to inform you that a cholera epidemic has erupted among our troops. Our soldiers are being decimated by illness, so we are forced to stop our offensive. A ceasefire will be declared soon, and our diplomats will start peace negotiations with the Turks.
dst: 虽然您设法突破了奥斯曼人的防线，但我遗憾地通知您，我军中爆发了霍乱疫情。疾病正在使我们的士兵大批倒下，因此我们被迫停止攻势。停火很快就会被宣布，我们的外交官将与土耳其人开始和平谈判。

src: Although you stopped the enemy offensive, once again we can't take advantage of your victory. Our army is exhausted and we can't go on with this war any longer. We'll have to ask for an armistice.
dst: 尽管您阻止了敌人的攻势，但我们再一次无法利用您的胜利。我军已精疲力竭，再也无法继续这场战争。我们将不得不请求停战。

src: Although you struggled, you made it.
dst: 尽管你打得很吃力，但还是挺过来了。

src: Although you struggled, you made it. Malta is ours, but I fear it was a Pyrrhic victory. The Italians suffered heavy losses and probably won't be able to maintain our dominance in the Mediterranean for a long time. Our fleet after regrouping must start for the Black Sea.....
dst: 尽管过程艰辛，你还是成功了。马耳他已是我们的了，但我担心这是一场惨胜。意大利人损失惨重，恐怕在很长时间内都无法维持我们在东地中海的优势。我们的舰队在重新编组后必须启程前往黑海……

src: Although you struggled, you made it. Move fast to Gibraltar, we have no time.
dst: 虽然你打得很艰难，但你做到了。快速驶向直布罗陀，我们没时间了。

src: Although you struggled, you made it. Next mission is to secure Krasnodar and then Black Sea is ours.
dst: 虽然你打得艰难，但你做到了。下一个任务是确保克拉斯诺达尔安全，然后黑海就归我们了。

src: Although you struggled, you made it. Once again you have defeated the English.
dst: 尽管过程艰难，你还是做到了。你又一次击败了英国人。

src: Although you struggled, you made it. Our fleet can resupply.
dst: 虽然你打得很艰难，但你做到了。我们的舰队可以补给了。

src: Although you struggled, you made it. You stop the Americans.
dst: 尽管过程艰难，你还是做到了。你挡住了美国人。

src: Although you succeeded at breaking the enemy defences, I regret to inform you that our attack at the Eastern sector has beed repelled. You can't follow your advance with your right fank exposed. It's time to go back to your starting positions. It doesn't matter. We'll use the next weeks to reorganize our army and then we'll try again. The Rasova-Kobadin-Tuzla line will fall before the end of the year, be sure of that.
dst: 虽然您成功突破了敌军防线，但我遗憾地通知您，我军在东段的进攻已被击退。您的右翼暴露，无法继续推进。是时候撤回您的出发阵地了。这没什么。我们将利用接下来几周重整军队，然后再试一次。拉索瓦—科巴丁—图兹拉防线必将在年底前崩溃，请放心。

src: Although you were able to capture Stalingrad, the Soviet winter offensives have forced us back along the entire front.
dst: 尽管你得以攻克斯大林格勒，但苏联人的冬季攻势已迫使我们在整条战线上后退。

src: Although you were able to take all of your objectives, and successfully fight off the Russian counterattack, unfortunately we lost the initiative on the eastern front, and must prepare to fight off the inevitable Soviet offensives that are coming.
dst: 尽管你成功夺取了全部目标，并击退了苏军的反攻，但遗憾的是，我们在东线失去了先手，必须准备迎击即将到来、不可避免的苏军攻势。

src: Although you were successful in taking Cairo, we must now move some of our assets in order to strengthen our hold on Northwest Africa.
dst: 尽管你成功夺取了开罗，我们现在仍必须抽调部分兵力，以加强我们对西北非的控制。

src: Although you were unable to expel the invaders, your defense of Germany was sufficiently resolute to persuade the allies to grant us an armistice, similar to the unpopular one signed in 1918.
dst: 虽然你未能将入侵者逐出，但你对德国的防御足够坚决，使盟军同意给予我们停战，其性质类似 1918年签订的那份不受欢迎的停战协定。

src: Although you were unable to take all of your objectives, you did successfully fight off the Russian counterattack. Unfortunately we lost the initiative on the eastern front, and another year of senseless fighting in Russia has come and gone.
dst: 尽管你未能夺取全部目标，但你成功击退了苏军的反攻。遗憾的是，我们在东线失去了先手，俄国战场上又一年无谓的厮杀就此过去。

src: Although you were unable to take all of your objectives, you did successfully fight off the Russian counterattack. Unfortunately we lost the initiative on the eastern front, and must now prepare to fight off the inevitable Soviet offensives that are coming.
dst: 尽管你未能夺取全部目标，但你成功击退了苏军的反攻。遗憾的是，我们在东线失去了先手，现在必须准备迎击即将到来、不可避免的苏军攻势。

src: Although you've been stopped at the gates of Athen we've been very lucky this time. The pro-German officers of the Greek Army have staged a coup d'etat, and they've managed to control the capital. King Alexander has forced the resignation of the government and the exile of the pro-British Prime Minister Venizelos. He's also assured us that Greece will accept our peace terms.
dst: 尽管您在雅典城门前受阻，我们这次却非常走运。希腊陆军中的亲德军官发动了一场政变，并成功控制了首都。国王亚历山大已迫使政府辞职，并放逐了亲英的首相韦尼泽洛斯。他还向我们保证，希腊将接受我们的和谈条件。

src: Although you've failed, the Germans have destroyed the Italian army in the north, taking thousands of prisoners. The Italians have fled to the outskirts of Venedig and won't dare to attack us for some time. For the first time in two years, the Empire is safe.
dst: 尽管您失败了，德国人还是在北面摧毁了意大利军队，俘虏了数千人。意大利人已经逃到威尼斯的郊外，一段时间内不敢再来进攻我们了。两年来，帝国第一次真正安全了。

src: Although your objectives were taken, RAF squadrons that arrived on Malta during the last half of June have prevented an advance on Cairo.
dst: 尽管各项目标均已夺取，但6月下半月抵达马耳他的皇家空军中队阻止了我军向开罗推进。

src: Although your performance was Excellent, Herr General, the Soviets have managed to sabotage the Oilfields...
dst: 尽管你的表现优异，将军阁下，苏军还是设法破坏了油田……

src: Although your performance was Good, Herr General, the Soviets have managed to sabotage the Oilfields...
dst: 尽管你的表现良好，将军阁下，苏军还是设法破坏了油田……

src: Although your performance was excellent, Herr General, and 13th Panzer Division has successfully disengaged and withdrawn from Ordzhonikidze, the encirclement of the 6th Armee at Stalingrad means that the Caucasus is now a secondary theatre and offensive operations here have been halted. Therefore you are now ordered to fall back to the Ukraine south of Kharkov and await further orders....
dst: 尽管你的表现优异，将军阁下，第13装甲师也已成功脱离并自奥尔忠尼启则撤出，但第六集团军在斯大林格勒被合围意味着高加索现在已是次要战区，此处的进攻行动已经停止。因此，你现奉命退往哈尔科夫以南的乌克兰地区，听候进一步命令……

src: Although your performance was excellent, Herr General, we have still been unable to breakthrough to Grozny...
dst: 尽管你的表现优异，将军阁下，我们仍未能突破至格罗兹尼……

dst: 尽管你的表现良好，将军阁下，我们仍未能突破至格罗兹尼……

src: Although your performance was satisfactory, Herr General, Soviet forces have stopped our drive at Bicske, just 18 miles from Budapest! Unfortunately, after our breakthrough at Pilisgebirge, we could not capitalize, and our beseiged forces defending Budapest have surrendered. You will now move west to Lake Balaton, where SS-Obergruppenfuhrer Sepp Dietrich's 6th SS-Panzerarmee is preparing for another offensive...
dst: 尽管你的表现差强人意，将军阁下，苏军还是在距布达佩斯仅18英里的比奇凯挡住了我们的推进！不幸的是，我们在皮利什山区突破之后未能扩大战果，而保卫布达佩斯的被围部队已经投降。你现在将西调至巴拉顿湖，党卫队上级集团领袖泽普·迪特里希的党卫军第6装甲集团军正在那里准备另一次攻势...

Unfortunately, after our breakthrough at the Pilis Hills, we could not advance farther, and our besieged forces defending Budapest have surrendered. You will now move to Lake Balaton, where the 6th SS Panzerarmee is preparing for another offensive...
dst: 尽管你的表现差强人意，红军还是在马尔通瓦沙尔挡住了我们的推进。不幸的是，我们在皮利什山区突破之后无法再向前推进，而保卫布达佩斯的被围部队已经投降。你现在将移驻巴拉顿湖，党卫军第6装甲集团军正在那里准备另一次攻势...

src: Although your troops finally retired from the battlefield, the Greeks have lost many men and equipment, so they have been forced to stop their offensive. That will give us the time we need to strengthen our army.
dst: 尽管您的部队最终撤出了战场，但希腊人损失了许多人员和装备，因此被迫停止了进攻。这将为我们赢得强化军队所需的时间。

src: Although your troops have fought bravely the Allied High Command has decided to evacuate the beach-head here at Gallipoli!! Your troops shall be restaioned in France to help in our planned offensive there. The Australian Light Horse Brigade will remain in Egypt to continue our war against the Turks. Thank you for your efforts here!!
dst: 尽管您的部队英勇作战，协约国最高统帅部还是决定撤离加利波利这里的滩头阵地！！您的部队将被重新部署到法国，以协助我们在那里的计划攻势。澳大利亚轻骑兵旅将留在埃及继续我们对土耳其人的战争。感谢您在这里的努力！！

src: Although, once again, our army was saved, the main result of the Bolshevik military operations against Ekaterinburg was the occupation of the main cities and factories of the Urals, the most important industrial region of Russia. If the Red Army kept on sending its reserves against us, we'd soon be facing a bleak future.
dst: 尽管我们的军队再次获救，但布尔什维克针对叶卡捷琳堡的军事行动的主要结果是占领了乌拉尔的主要城市和工厂——俄国最重要的工业区。如果红军继续把预备队投入对付我们，我们很快就会面临黯淡的前景。

src: Althought we have made valiant efforts to change the tactical and strategic situation, recent operations have not achieved the High Command's goals. The Northern front has fallen, and the rebel offensive over the Levante is approaching the Republic's provisional capital in Valencia. Now, the enemy has an important base to aid his advance on the Mediterranean Sea, Teruel. The enemy base at Teruel is a great danger for the whole Levante area. We cannot allow the enemy to continue holding Teruel, if we are to save the Republic!
dst: 尽管我们为改变战术和战略态势做出了英勇的努力，近期的行动仍未能达成最高统帅部的目标。北方战线已经陷落，叛军对莱万特的攻势正逼近共和国位于巴伦西亚的临时首都。如今，敌人拥有特鲁埃尔这个重要基地来协助其向地中海推进。特鲁埃尔的敌军基地对整个莱万特地区构成巨大危险。我们要想拯救共和国，就不能容许敌人继续占据特鲁埃尔！
美国宾夕法尼亚州阿尔图纳
阿尔弗林厄姆 (阿尔弗林厄姆)

src: Amassing artillery, the Germans have destroyed railways and our trench lines.  As you retreat into the fortress of Novogeorgievsk, you should gather the rail-transported supplies and use them to increase the fighting capabilities of your troops.  As soon as you receive the evacuation order, you can begin the retreat with your troops in rear-guard, but you must hold the Novogeorgievsk fortress in its entirety!
dst: 德军集结炮兵，摧毁了铁路和我方的堑壕线。当您撤入新格奥尔吉耶夫斯克要塞时，应当收集由铁路运来的补给，用它们提升部队的战斗力。一旦接到撤退命令，您便可率部作为后卫开始撤退，但您必须完整地守住新格奥尔吉耶夫斯克要塞！

src: Amasya redif div./ II Provisional Reserve Corps/ 莂talca Army
dst: Amasya 预备役师/ 第2暂编预备役军/ Catalca 集团军

src: Amasya redif div./ III Army Corps/ 2nd Eastern Army
dst: Amasya 预备役师/ 第3集团军军/ 第2东部集团军

src: Amazing work, General! Though we can't win this war, the Bolsheviks are astounded by the success of your offensive against their over-extended forces, and Red Army lost initiative in this region. British will liberate Transdanubia and Hungary will be a democratic country in the future.
dst: 令人惊叹的表现，将军！尽管我们赢不了这场战争，布尔什维克却对你针对其过度展开的部队所发动的攻势之成功感到震惊，红军在这一地区丧失了主动权。英国人将解放外多瑙地区，匈牙利未来会成为一个民主国家。

src: Amazing work, comrade! You not only destroyed many fascist forces but also got the front moving again, back to the north-west. Although a considerable number of Germans managed to get to their own lines, we are preparing to liberate the region in our upcoming winter offensive!
dst: 干得漂亮，同志！你不仅消灭了许多法西斯军队，还让战线重新向西北推进。尽管相当数量的德军还是撤回了己方战线，我们正在为即将到来的冬季攻势准备解放该地区！

src: Amazing! This counterattack will be remembered as one of the finest military feats in Poland's history! The Red Army has been crushed and now its surviving units are fleeing to avoid being surrounded and destroyed by our troops!
dst: 太惊人了！这次反攻将作为波兰历史上最杰出的军事功绩之一被世人铭记！红军已被粉碎，其残存部队正在溃逃，以免被我军包围歼灭！

src: Amazing! You break trough the enemy Lines- now the Way to the North is open!
dst: 太棒了！您突破了敌军防线——现在通往北方的道路敞开了！

src: Amazing, Oberstleutnant. Fort Vaux is under our control and the French are desperately trying to rebuild their defence lines near Fleury. With more victories like yours, I'm sure that they'll have to surrender before the end of the summer. That is, if Britain and Russia don't lauch any offensives of their own in support of their French allies. That would be lethal for our plans.
dst: 太惊人了，中校。沃堡已在我们控制之下，法国人正拼命试图在弗勒里附近重建防线。有更多像您这样的胜利，我相信他们夏天结束之前就不得不投降。当然，前提是英国和俄国不发起各自的攻势来支援其法国盟友。那对我们的计划将是致命的。

src: America will leave this war as one of the victors and one of the greatest military powers in the world. Maybe the greatest, since France and Britain have suffered terrible losses. Risking very little, we've won a lot of power. From now on, nothing will be done in the world without hearing our opinion first.
dst: 美国将作为战胜国之一、作为世界最强大军事力量之一离开这场战争。也许是最强大的，因为法国和英国都已元气大伤。我们以极小的风险，赢得了巨大的权力。从此以后，凡天下大事，必先听取我们的意见。

src: American and British paratroopers attempt to capture the last Italian supply base, the fortress of Pantelleria. While our ships and planes try to stop the massive attack in the Strait of Gibraltar, the marines managed to reach Pantelleria.
dst: 美英伞兵试图夺取意大利最后一处补给基地——潘泰莱里亚要塞。当我们的舰船和飞机试图在直布罗陀海峡阻止这场大规模进攻时，海军陆战队成功抵达了潘泰莱里亚。

src: American and Soviet troops in the German village of Griebo, Saxony, after the the end of World War II in Europe, May 1945.
dst: 1945年5月，欧洲第二次世界大战结束后，位于萨克森州格里博（Griebo）村的美国与苏联士兵。

src: American forces are moving fast through the gap that you failed to close near Avranches. The US VII and XV corps are moving East to the South of us, threatening to surround us now that the Brits have broken through North-East of us near Caen. Retreat East towards Falaise to save your troops.
dst: 美军正快速从你未能在阿夫朗什附近封住的缺口涌过。美军第7军和第15军正从我们南面向东推进，而英军已在我们东北的卡昂附近突破，我们面临被包围的危险。向东撤退，往法莱斯方向，以保全你的部队。

src: Among all our enemies, the Bulgaria Army is the largest and the most disciplined. They'll attack us in Eastern Thrace, between Edirne and Kirk Kilisse, and they'll try to break our line of defence. They know they have numerical superiority and that, right now, we won't be able to receive any reinforcements, but we can use their overconfidence in our favor.
dst: 在我们所有敌人中，保加利亚军队规模最大、纪律最严。他们将在东色雷斯、在埃迪尔内与基尔克利塞之间进攻我们，并试图突破我们的防线。他们知道自己有数量优势，也知道眼下我们得不到任何增援，但我们可以利用他们的过分自信。

src: Among the many secrets societies that appeared in China in the XIX century, one of the strongest, and certainly the most infamous, was the Yihetuan, that is, the "Fists of Patriotic Union", called the "Boxers" outside China for the proficiency that many of its members showed in the combat without weapons. It was a group of violent, anti-foreigner and anti-christian fanatics that started their criminal activities in 1897. Although the Qing Army defeated them in some battles, they earned the sympathy of many powerful Imperial officials and many common people, tired of the constant meddling of the Western countries in the Chinese internal affairs. So the Yihetuan quickly gained new members, and their attacks became more frequent and more lethal.
dst: 在19世纪中国出现的众多秘密会社中，实力最强、也无疑最臭名昭著的当属义和团，意即「爱国联合会之拳」，在中国境外又因其许多成员徒手搏斗的娴熟本领而被称为「义和拳」。这是一个暴力的、排外反基督的狂热组织，于1897年开始其犯罪活动。尽管清军在一些战斗中击败了他们，但他们赢得了许多有权势的帝国官员以及许多普通百姓的同情——这些人厌倦了西方国家对中国内政的不断干涉。于是义和团迅速招纳了新成员，其袭击也变得更加频繁、更加致命。

src: Among the ones who tried to resist some died in battle, others were taken prisoners, and only a handful of them escaped to Zululand. Buller was with them, but right now this isn't a problem. Now we must exploit this victory and take Durban.
dst: 在试图抵抗的人当中，有的战死沙场，有的被俘，只有一小撮逃往祖鲁兰。布勒就在其中，但眼下这已不是问题。现在我们必须利用这场胜利，夺取德班。
阿穆阿特吉第35营/6 Bda./第2师

src: Amur Cossack Reg./ Southern Manchuria Column
dst: Amur 哥萨克团/ 南部 Manchuria 纵队

src: An Excellent performance, Herr General! Kovel has been successfully evacuated. Now your division will move to Modlin, on the Vistula River line near Warsaw...
dst: 一次优异的表现，将军阁下！科韦利已成功撤离。现在你的师将移驻华沙附近维斯瓦河一线的莫德林……

src: An Italian and a German soldier with the Parthenon in the background, Athens, Greece, May 1941.
dst: 一名意大利士兵和一名德国士兵，背景是帕特农神庙，希腊雅典，1941年5月。

src: An Ottoman breakthrough at Alashkert would be an unthinkable tragedy for the Kavkaz Front, Gospodin General!
dst: 奥斯曼在阿拉什凯尔特突破，对高加索方面军将是不可想象的悲剧，中将阁下！

src: An agreement has been made between the Bolshevik authorities in Moscow and the Czech Legion. The Legion is allowed to get out of Russia using the Trans-Siberian railway. So the Legion was scattered over the railway between Penza and the Urals in May 1918.
dst: 莫斯科的布尔什维克当局与捷克军团达成了协议。军团获准利用西伯利亚大铁路离开俄国。于是，1918年5月，军团分散在奔萨与乌拉尔之间的铁路沿线。

src: An ambulance that heals 4 sp will assist your marines.
dst: 一辆每回合治疗4点sp的救护车将协助你的海军陆战队。

src: An army of around 30 units will suffice to carry you through this campaign
dst: 一支约 30 个单位的部队就足以带你打完全程。

src: An army will support your attack. A unit of Josef Stalin tanks will assist you, too.
dst: 一支集团军将支援你的进攻。一队约瑟夫·斯大林坦克也将协助你。

src: An artillery unit has been added to your core.
dst: 一个炮兵单位已加入您的核心部队。

src: An attack on French North Africa was proposed instead, which would clear the Axis powers from North Africa, improve naval control of the Mediterranean Sea, and prepare for an invasion of Southern Europe in 1943. American President Franklin D. Roosevelt suspected the African operation would rule out an invasion of Europe in 1943 but agreed to support British Prime Minister Winston Churchill.
dst: 取而代之的是进攻法属北非的提议——此举可肃清北非的轴心国势力、加强地中海的制海权，并为1943年进攻南欧做准备。美国总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福怀疑非洲行动会挤掉1943年进攻欧洲的可能，但仍同意支持英国首相温斯顿·丘吉尔。

src: An early thaw has caused severe flooding in the area, producing swamp-like conditions. On my way to your HQ, I saw 15 King Tigers that had sank into the mud up to their turrets. What is Hitler thinking having 4SS Panzer Divisions attack on this terrain?
dst: 早来的解冻在这一带造成严重洪涝，地面如同沼泽。在来你司令部的路上，我看到15辆“虎王”坦克陷进泥里，泥都没过了炮塔。希特勒到底在想什么，竟让4个党卫军装甲师在这种地形上进攻？

src: An earthen colossus will break up...
dst: 一个泥足的巨人终将崩塌……
一个更简单的「嘿亚远征」战役

src: An exceptional victory at Stalingrad, but unfortunately, the Soviet winter offensives have forced us back along the entire front, putting us in an extremely difficult position. We must now plan accordingly.
dst: 斯大林格勒一役取得了非凡的胜利，但遗憾的是，苏联人的冬季攻势已迫使我们在整条战线上后退，使我方陷入极为困难的境地。我们现在必须据此重新筹划。

src: An exceptional victory in the Caucasus, but unfortunately, the Soviet winter offensives have forced us back along the entire front, putting us in an extremely difficult position. We must now plan accordingly.
dst: 高加索之战是一次非凡的胜利，但不幸的是，苏军的冬季攻势已迫使我们在全线后退，使我们陷入极其困难的处境。我们现在必须相应调整计划。

src: An honour guard of the Royal Albanian Army around 1939.
dst: 约1939年阿尔巴尼亚皇家陆军的一支仪仗队。

src: An immense attack of combined British and New Zealand divisions forced us to leave the first line of defense. We're holding the second line but there's nothing but sand dunes behind our back. We must hold the enemy assault and retake the lost ground, if we're to survive.
dst: 英军与新西兰师联军的庞大攻势，迫使我们放弃了第一道防线。我们据守第二道防线，但身后除了沙丘别无所有。若要活命，就必须顶住敌军冲击，夺回失地。

src: An important problem for the defenders of Crimea were the large partisan formations in the Yaila Mountains, which in November 1943 were estimated to be about 7-8,000 men strong. After the Red Army had reached the Perekop Isthmus, they intensified their actions, which until then had been pretty rare and involved small groups. They became so troublesome that the Romanian Mountain Corps was ordered to clear the main partisan group, 20 km east of Simferopol. The operation took place between 29 December and 4 January.
dst: 对克里米亚守军而言，雅伊拉山区庞大的游击队是一大难题——1943年11月其兵力估计约7,000—8,000人。红军抵达彼列科普地峡后，游击队活动加剧，此前其行动稀少且多为小股。其猖獗程度致使罗马尼亚山地军奉命清剿辛菲罗波尔以东20公里处的主要游击群。行动于12月29日至1月4日进行。

src: An impressive performance, Oberstleutnant. You’ve opened a gap in the Romanian lines, and now our fresh troops are marching through Moldavia. Nobody can stop them! Our enemies won’t be able to recover from this huge blow. Very soon we’ll occupy the whole country, and the Romanian government will be forced to surrender. The Russians will return to their fatherland, which is quickly descending into chaos. They are demoralized, and won’t resist for much longer. Finally, after so many sacrifices, the victory in the Eastern front will be a reality.
dst: 出色的表现，中校。您已在罗马尼亚防线上撕开了一个缺口，现在我们的生力军正穿过摩尔达维亚挺进。没有人能阻挡他们！敌人将无法从这次沉重打击中恢复过来。很快我们就会占领整个国家，罗马尼亚政府将被迫投降。俄国人将返回他们正迅速陷入混乱的祖国。他们士气低落，撑不了多久了。最终，在付出了如此多的牺牲之后，东线的胜利将成为现实。

src: An inquiry into the quality of reinforcements arriving to the front on both sides illustrates a tragic horror of the war:  throwing large nubmers of Landwehr and Reserve divisions into the offensive, the German army was beginning to exhibit the death toll it has suffered since August on both fronts.  Likewise on the Russian side, the 2nd and 3rd line (Opolchenie) divisions spoke to the horrific losses in Galicia and Poland.
dst: 对双方抵达前线援军质量的调查，揭示了这场战争可悲的恐怖：德军把大量后备军和预备师投入攻势，开始显现出自八月以来在两个战线上所承受的死亡代价。俄军方面亦然，二线、三线（民兵）师诉说着在加利西亚和波兰的可怕损失。

src: An interesting development - in secret negotiations we managed to pull the Egyptians on our site. Now an Egyptian Brigade at Mersa Matruh blocked the harbor and depots and denied supplies for the Commonwealth troops. This bad news forces the Commonwealth's to withdrew from the Egyptian/Libyan border - they rely on the supplies at Mersa Matruh and will try to get this harbor back. Take advantage of the situation and advance to Mersa Matruh, as long as the Egyptians will be able to hold out!
dst: 一个有趣的进展——通过秘密谈判，我们成功地把埃及人拉到了我们这边。如今在梅尔萨马特鲁的一支埃及旅封锁了港口和仓库，拒绝向英联邦部队提供补给。这个坏消息迫使英联邦从埃及/利比亚边境撤军——他们依赖梅尔萨马特鲁的补给，会试图夺回这个港口。趁着埃及人还能支撑，利用这一局面向梅尔萨马特鲁推进！

src: An orderly retreat...: one of the most difficult manuveurs...
dst: 有序撤退……：最困难的机动之一……
阿纳斯塔西耶夫斯卡亚

src: Anatoly has become a full-grown man. He's been promoted to captain, and his audacity, cunning and bravery is starting to be acknowledged and feared by our enemies. Looking at him now I can't help but remember that frail baby who gave us so many worries. I'm amazed at how much he has changed. I'm so proud of him...and I know you'll be proud when you see him, too.
dst: 阿纳托利已经长成一个男子汉了。他晋升为上尉，他的胆识、机敏和勇敢开始被我们的敌人所承认，也为他们所畏惧。看着现在的他，我不禁想起当年那个让我们操碎了心的孱弱婴儿。我惊叹于他的变化之大。我为他感到无比自豪……而且我知道，您见到他时也会感到自豪。

src: Anatoly! What are you doing? Go away and save your men if you can...the Reds will be here in a matter of minutes, you have no time to lose!
dst: 阿纳托利！您在干什么？快走，能救您的士兵就快去救……红军几分钟内就会赶到这里，您没有时间可浪费了！

src: And I am still here. After all these years, death hasn't come for me yet. I can't say that I've been truly happy, but at least I've got used to my new life in the Legion and, although I don't know what the future holds for me, I am hopeful that things will get better.
dst: 而我仍在这里。这么多年过去了，死神还没找上我。我不能说自己真正快乐过，但至少我已习惯了在军团里的新生活，而且，虽然我不知道未来会怎样，但我满怀希望，相信一切会好起来。

src: And before you attack Freiburg, you must gather your troops !
dst: 而且在您进攻弗赖堡之前，必须先集结部队！

src: And even worse than this, our intelligence reports warn us of a huge Red counteroffensive that will start in the next few weeks or possibly in a few days! We are very far from our bases and the Soviet reinforcements will be composed mainly of veteran troops so we could be in serious trouble.
dst: 而更糟糕的是，我们的情报报告警告说，一场大规模的红色反攻将在未来几周内、甚至可能在几天内开始！我们远离基地，而苏联增援部队将主要由老兵组成，因此我们可能会陷入严重的麻烦。

src: And in the future, who knows? Despite all our suffering, there are still more Afrikaners than British in South Africa. Our families are bigger than theirs. We could be a majority in South African politics. Maybe some day the British will wake up and discover that they took our lands, but on doing so they also allowed us to control the whole country.
dst: 而未来，谁知道呢？尽管我们遭受了种种苦难，南非的阿非利卡人仍比英国人多。我们的家庭比他们的大。我们可能成为南非政治中的多数。也许有一天，英国人醒来会发现，他们夺走了我们的土地，但这样做时，他们也让我们得以掌控整个国家。

src: And it seems, there are no enemies in the West...
dst: 而且看来，西面没有敌人……

src: And not only has the Italian front collapsed, but also the Austro-Hungarian Monarchy has ceased to exist. All across the former empire, the various territories are declaring their independence. Protesters have gained control of Budapest, and King Charles IV has accepted the independence of Hungary. It's time to return to our homeland. I know your troops are demoralized, exhausted and eager for peace, but I'm afraid that Serbian, Romanian and Czech territorial demands have no limits, and we will face a new war sooner than we think...
dst: 而且不仅意军战线已经崩溃，奥匈君主国也已不复存在。在整个昔日帝国的各地，各个地区纷纷宣布独立。抗议者已控制了布达佩斯，国王查理四世接受了匈牙利独立。是时候返回祖国了。我知道您的部队士气低落、疲惫不堪、渴望和平，但我担心塞尔维亚、罗马尼亚与捷克的领土要求永无止境，我们将比想象中更快地面临一场新战争……

src: And now forward! This time it is about the homeland!
dst: 现在出发吧！这一次，是为了家园！

src: And now that we have the USS Iowa, it can help us in the siege.
dst: 而且既然我们现在有了「艾奥瓦」号，它能在围攻中帮上忙。

src: And now, the Bolshevik reserves await your attack. Defeat them and this war will end soon!
dst: 而现在，布尔什维克的预备队正等着你的进攻。击败他们，这场战争很快就会结束！

src: And please accept my heartfelt condolences for the death of your son Adriaan. His sacrifice won't be forgotten.
dst: 对于您儿子阿德里安的牺牲，请接受我由衷的哀悼。他的献身不会被遗忘。

src: And so it was how the Italian invaders were destroyed a second time, twenty years after Adwa. All the enemy survivors retreated to the safety of the Eritrean Highlands.
dst: 就这样，在阿杜瓦战役二十年之后，意大利入侵者第二次被消灭了。所有幸存的敌人都退入了厄立特里亚高地这个安全之地。

src: And so it was. Ethiopia became the only country from black Africa that resisted the European colonialists. The Italians lost more than 6,000 men at Adwa, and nearly 3,000 were captured. The survivors retreated to Eritrea, and never returned. We didn't pursue them. Our men were exhausted, and we couldn't demand more from them.
dst: 事实正是如此。埃塞俄比亚成了黑非洲唯一顶住了欧洲殖民者的国家。意大利人在阿杜瓦损失了六千多人，还有近三千人被俘。幸存者撤回厄立特里亚，再也没有回来。我们没有追击他们。我们的士兵已经筋疲力尽，不能再向他们要求更多了。

src: And so it wasn't until June 2026, just a few days before the 85th anniversary of the attack on the Soviet Union, that the campaign was finally complete. I hope you enjoyed it as much as I did while creating it.
dst: 就这样，直到2026年6月——进攻苏联85周年前几天——这部战役才终于完成。希望你在游玩时，能像我创作时一样乐在其中。

src: And that was how the Red Army was crushed by Diterikhs and his Tobol offensive. Thousands of Bolshevik soldiers died or were captured, along with tons of equipment. In the following weeks we retook Siberia almost without a fight: Tobolsk, Tiumen, Chelyabinsk, Ekaterinburg and many other cities and towns fell very easily. The communist panicked every time that they heard that we were approaching, and ran to the west as fast as they could.
dst: 红军就是这样被季捷里赫斯及其托博尔攻势击垮的。数千名布尔什维克士兵阵亡或被俘，还损失了成吨的装备。此后几周，我们几乎兵不血刃地收复了西伯利亚：托博尔斯克、秋明、车里雅宾斯克、叶卡捷琳堡以及许多其他城镇都轻而易举地陷落了。共产党人每次听说我们逼近就惊慌失措，拼命向西逃窜。

src: And that was how, in April 1920, Poland invaded Ukraine. Naturally, that act of aggression against us was condemned by the League of Nations, whose delegates made us know that if Russia used an armed force against the Polish Army, only for defensive purposes, the League would support us. That was all that Kolchak wanted, and he immediately sent an army to Volinia, in western Ukraine, in order to stop the Polish invasion.
dst: 就这样，1920年4月，波兰入侵了乌克兰。自然，这一针对我们的侵略行径遭到国际联盟的谴责，联盟代表让我们知道，如果俄国仅出于防御目的对波兰军队动用武力，联盟将支持我们。这正是高尔察克想要的，他立即派一支军队前往乌克兰西部的沃里尼亚，以阻止波兰的入侵。

src: And that was the end of the Komuch. The Red Army regrouped and received reinforces, while all our attempts to mobilize a bigger army failed. The passivity of the Socialist-Revolutionaries led them to disaster. The Bolsheviks were a buch of fanatics, criminals and murderers, but their determination was simply enviable. They would stop at nothing in order to obtain power, and that gave them an advantage over all of us. Just one month after we occupied Kazan, a massive Soviet counterattack forced us to retreat down the Volga, towards Samara, with our enemies on our heels.
dst: 那就是科穆奇的终结。红军重新集结并得到了增援，而我们所有动员更大军队的努力都失败了。社会革命党人的消极无为把他们引向了灾难。布尔什维克是一帮狂热分子、罪犯和杀人犯，但他们的决心实在令人羡慕。为夺取政权他们会不择手段，这使他们对我们所有人占据了优势。就在我们占领喀山一个月后，一场大规模的苏维埃反攻迫使我们沿伏尔加河向萨马拉方向撤退，敌人紧追不舍。

src: And that's how it began. A strange mixture of unreliable Czech veterans, a few hundreds of socialist volunteers and a handful of army officers joined in Samara and decided to fight the Bolsheviks. We'd start taking strategically important towns located along the railways, or on the shores of the Volga.
dst: 事情就这样开始了。一批靠不住的捷克老兵、几百名社会党志愿兵和一小撮军官在萨马拉会合，决定与布尔什维克作战。我们将从夺取铁路沿线或伏尔加河沿岸那些具有战略意义的城镇开始。

src: And that's how, on 3 June 1884, the United Kingdon and Ethiopia signed the Treaty of Adwa, and our war with Egypt officially ended. We would help to evacuate the Egyptian garrisons from Keren to Kassala and Gallabat, something that Yohannes had demanded for almost ten years. In return, Ethiopia would finally recover Bogos and, even more important, we could use the port of Massawa, even for importing arms.
dst: 就这样，1884年6月3日，联合王国与埃塞俄比亚签订了《阿杜瓦条约》，我们与埃及的战争正式结束。我们将协助撤出从克伦到卡萨拉和加拉巴特的埃及驻军，这是约翰内斯要求了将近十年的事情。作为交换，埃塞俄比亚终于收回博戈斯，更重要的是，我们可以使用马萨瓦港，甚至可以用它进口武器。

src: And the Bolsheviks aren't the only threat to Russia. First of all, we have to dedide what kind of country we'll live in. The most obvious option is the return of the monarchy, but most of the Royal Family was murdered by the Reds, so it might be difficult to find an optimal candidate. I think that Grand Duke Cyril is the legitimate heir, but in the past he has behaved as a person unworthy of the title of Tsar.
dst: 而布尔什维克并非俄国的唯一威胁。首先，我们必须决定将生活在一个什么样的国家里。最显而易见的选择是恢复君主制，但皇室大部分成员都被红军杀害了，因此可能很难找到合适的人选。我认为西里尔大公是合法继承人，但他过去的所作所为配不上沙皇的称号。

src: And the English are thinking a lot: The fact the we agreed that Romania may break our alliance, but that the Soviets refuse peace with Romania and insist on the occupation of Romania has brought Soviet-allied relations to the point of rupture. We have allready noticed a big decline in English bombers over Germany.
dst: 而英国人确实想了很多：我们同意罗马尼亚可以退出我们的同盟，但苏军拒绝与罗马尼亚媾和并坚持占领罗马尼亚，这一事实已使苏联与盟国的关系濒临破裂。我们已注意到英格兰轰炸机飞临德国的数量大幅下降。

src: And then, all of a sudden... this. We didn't see it coming. They're storming our lines. We must do something to delay the Russian offensive, and give our men enough time to retreat in order. We couldn't endure another Premissel. The Empire would collapse. Save us, General, hold our lines against the assaults of the Russian 8th Army!
dst: 然而，突然之间……就变成这样。我们毫无防备。他们正在强攻我们的防线。我们必须设法迟滞俄国的攻势，给我们的士兵留出有序撤退的时间。我们再也承受不起又一个普热梅希尔了。帝国会崩溃的。救救我们，将军，守住我们的防线，抵御俄国第8集团军的进攻！

src: And then, on December 7th, at the worst possible moment, there was an uprising of our 2nd Barabinsk Regiment in the city. Under the influence of the Socialist-Revolutionaries, those traitors wanted to expel us from Novonikolayevsk and hand it over to the communists. We couldn't let it happen, we had to resist and stop the Bolsheviks at the Obi.
dst: 随后，12月7日，在最糟糕的时刻，城里的第2巴拉宾斯克团发动了兵变。在社会革命党人的影响下，这些叛徒想把我们赶出新尼古拉耶夫斯克，把它交给共产党人。我们不能让这发生，必须坚守，在鄂毕河挡住布尔什维克。

src: And there comes the answer of our dear comrades from "Down Under", a beautiful song as well, I must say. I have been told it is called "Waltzing Matilda". Oh well, Général, let the boys celebrate tonight. Tomorrow they will learn that all of our courage, all of our sacrifice has been in vain, since the British landing at Suvla Bay has been an utter failure. It is a disgrace, and I doubt it will raise the reputation of our ally among our men.
dst: 接着，从「澳洲」传来了我们亲爱的战友的回应，那也是一首优美的歌，我不得不说。有人告诉我，那首歌叫《华尔兹玛蒂尔达》。哎，将军，今晚就让小伙子们尽情庆祝吧。明天他们就会知道，我们所有的勇气、所有的牺牲都付诸东流，因为英军在苏夫拉湾的登陆彻底失败了。这真是耻辱，我怀疑这能否提升我们盟友在士兵心中的声望。

src: And there comes the sung answer of our dear comrades from "Down Under", a beautiful song as well, I must say. I have been told it is called "Waltzing Matilda". Oh well, Général, let the boys celebrate tonight. Tomorrow they will learn that all of our courage, all of our sacrifice has been in vain, since the British landing at Suvla Bay has been an utter failure. It is a disgrace, and I doubt it will raise the reputation of our ally among our men.
dst: 而那边又传来我们来自「南方大陆」亲爱的战友们唱答的歌声，我也得说，同样是一首动听的歌。我听说它叫「与玛蒂尔达共舞」。哦，好吧，将军，让小伙子们今晚好好庆祝吧。明天他们就会明白，我们所有的勇气、所有的牺牲都白费了，因为英国人在苏夫拉湾的登陆彻底失败了。这真是一种耻辱，我怀疑这不会提高我们盟友在士兵中的声誉。

src: And this is where my story ends. On January 10th, when our column had almost reached Kansk, a partisan sniper shot me in the chest. A few hours later Kappel fell in a frozen river. They took us to a village where they could take care of our wounds, but they were too serious. There was nothing that the doctors could do for us.  Lord Jesus Christ, Son of God, have mercy on me, a sinner.
dst: 我的故事就在这里结束。1月10日，当我们这支纵队几乎抵达坎斯克时，一名游击队狙击手射中了我的胸口。几小时后，卡佩尔跌进了一条结冰的河。他们把我们送到一个村庄，好照料我们的伤口，但伤势太重了。医生也无能为力。主耶稣基督，上帝之子，怜悯我这个罪人吧。

src: And thus July 1st, the first day of the Somme, came. My Army Corps started again on the reserve, so we were spared the horror of this initial push. A few hours later I was informed that my son William had died in one of the first assaults, just like near 20,000 British soldiers did before the end of that day. For some time I could barely speak, eat or sleep. I thought about retiring and giving way to younger officers, but I finally decided to stay. My divisions had been among the ones with the least losses when they fought on the first line, so although I could not save my own son, if I kept on fighting maybe I could save the sons of others.
dst: 于是，7月1日，索姆河战役的第一天到来了。我的军又处于预备队位置，因而躲过了这场最初攻势的惨状。数小时后，我得知我的儿子威廉在最初几次进攻中的一次里阵亡了，正如那一天结束前近两万名英国士兵的遭遇一样。有一段时间，我几乎说不出话、吃不下饭、睡不着觉。我想过退役，给更年轻的军官让路，但最终我决定留下。我的各师在一线作战时，属于损失最小的那一批，所以尽管我救不了自己的儿子，但只要我继续战斗，也许就能救下别人的儿子。

src: And we should apply Alexander's strategy:
dst: 而且我们应当采用亚历山大的策略：

src: And whatever made You think You could change Providence.Now You,those You Love will meet a fate with many Horrors.It will be slow and painful.We can make it last weeks.We know the 'Breaking Point' and will push You near the limit.Time and time again You will wish,even pray for this End to Your miserable Life.All will be recorded on film so the Fuehrer can enjoy.And Your family will be right beside You.First though the other 'Traitors to the Reich' will meet the same Fate and You and Your family will get to listen to their screams and begging for Mercy.None will be shown for them or You.All who challenge the Fuehrer and His Genius will learn.
dst: 是什么让你以为可以改变天意。如今你，还有你所爱的人，将遭遇充满无数恐怖的命运。它会缓慢而痛苦。我们可以让它持续数周。我们清楚“崩溃点”在哪里，会把你逼到极限边缘。一次又一次，你会盼着——甚至祈祷着——你这条可悲性命的终结。这一切都会被拍摄下来，好让元首欣赏。而你的家人就在你身边。不过首先，其他“帝国的叛徒”会遭遇同样的命运，你和你的家人将听到他们的惨叫和求饶。对他们和你，都不会有丝毫怜悯。所有胆敢挑战元首及其天才的人都会学到这一课。

src: And while our men were hesitating [whether they should advance to the shore], chiefly on account of the depth of the sea, he who carried the eagle of the tenth legion, after supplicating the gods that the matter might turn out favorably to the legion, exclaimed, "Leap, fellow soldiers, unless you wish to betray your eagle to the enemy. I, for my part, will perform my duty to the commonwealth and my general."
dst: 当我方士兵犹豫〔是否该向岸边推进〕——主要是因为水太深——时，扛着第10军团鹰旗的那人先向众神祈求此事对军团有利，随即喊道：「跳下去，弟兄们，除非你们想把鹰旗交给敌人。至于我，我会对共和国和我的统帅尽到我的本分。」

src: And you will also need to purchase a cheap recon bomber which is very important!
dst: 此外，您还需要购买一架廉价的侦察轰炸机，这非常重要！

src: And, despite all our problems and all our fears, we had to persist. We had to delay the Bolsheviks for as long as we could. If they wasted enough time, we could evacuate the civilians, the wounded, our equipment, and most of our troops. We could make an orderly retreat and, beyond the Urals, we would have more chances to stop the red wave.
dst: 尽管困难重重、恐惧万分，我们仍必须坚持下去。我们必须尽可能久地拖住布尔什维克。只要他们浪费足够的时间，我们就能疏散平民、伤员、装备和大部分部队。我们就能有序地撤退，在乌拉尔山以东，我们将有更多机会挡住红色浪潮。
安德烈·马尔蒂/第48旅/第12/第4
安德烈耶沃-梅连季耶夫斯基
安德罗尼科斯·孔托斯特法诺斯

src: Anglo-American forces have disembarked in French territory, moving at full speed toward Tunisia. After your recent victory in Alexandria, we cannot affort a counterattack from behind. Due to your inexperienced rivals, their positions are very weak, but they are greater in number and better supplied.
