src: Another great problem is that Alekseyev is very ill. He's been trying to hide it, but we know he's suffering from cancer and heart disease. I wonder how long he'll be able to endure the unhealthy conditions we're living in.
dst: 另一个大问题是，阿列克谢耶夫病得很重。他一直在试图掩饰，但我们知道他正饱受癌症和心脏病的折磨。我不知道他还能在我们所处的这种恶劣环境中撑多久。

src: Another great victory!  The German troops have rid themselves of most of their pursuers.  Now they will be able to invade Portuguese East Africa with little opposition.
dst: 又一场伟大的胜利！德军已摆脱了大部分追兵。现在他们将能够以很小的阻力入侵葡属东非。

src: Another large scale attack was planned by the Ivans on Leningrad.SS/BdM Frau General Viga Nostitz decided to move first. "Rhonda,the Trupps ready". "Javolt,General.Supplied and deployed as instructed". "How's the morale of the Commom Frau"? "Good overall General but pockets of dissatisfaction are starting to show.That has to be expected with the numbers We are losing or being maimed.And of course the Soviet heavy batteries shelling 'No-Fraus' land is taking it's toll"."I told Ilse way back Her indocrination was going to really be put to the test once We moved East.You can talk all You want about Duty,Glory and Honor to the Frauland but once You are in Combat and that is sustained as the levels here in the East a lot of Fraus are gonna crack.You cannot watch those around You fall and not pay a price.Maybe after this We will get a little break,I know the Fraus need one.Hell I do too but don't imagine I myself will have that Luxury.Of course the horrendous numbers the Soviets have lost it is hard to Fathom how any of their soldiers could have any moral at all.Hopefully they 'break' soon as the Fuhress has stated.Those Commisars for Stalin cannot be Miracle Workers but I give them Credit they've worked some up to this moment. Maybe Our routing of the Soviets here will put a cease to that".
dst: 伊万们又计划对列宁格勒发动一次大规模进攻。党卫军/BdM 的维加·诺斯蒂茨女将军决定先发制人。“朗达，部队准备好了吗？”“是（Javolt），将军。已按指示完成补给和部署。”“普通‘女士’们士气怎么样？”“总体上不错，将军，但已经开始出现小范围的不满。以我们伤亡和致残的数量来说，这是难免的。当然，苏军重炮轰击‘无女士’地带也在不断消耗着。”“我早就跟伊尔泽说，等我们东进，她那一套思想灌输会真正受到考验。你可以大谈对‘女性之国’的责任、光荣与荣誉，可一旦真上了战场、而且像东线这里这样持续不断，很多‘女士’都会崩溃。你不能眼看着身边的人倒下却毫无代价。也许这仗打完我们能喘口气，我知道‘女士’们需要。我也需要，但别指望我自己能享受这种奢侈。当然，苏联人损失的数目骇人，难以想象他们的士兵怎么还能有任何士气。但愿他们像女元首说的那样很快‘垮掉’。斯大林的那些政委不是变戏法的，但我得承认，到目前为止他们还算有点本事。也许我们在这里击溃苏联人，能让这一切停下来。”

src: Anyhow we can not allow this provocation to go unheeded - enter Sweden with your troops and show those so-called Vikings that us Germans aren't to be trifled with!
dst: 无论如何，我们不能对这种挑衅置之不理——率军进入瑞典，让那些所谓的维京人知道，我们德国人可不是好惹的！

src: Anywat, tomorrow there will be a great parade at the Red Square. Our army will march along the main streets of Moscow, that has finally awaken from this nightmare that has lasted two years.
dst: 无论如何，明天红场将举行盛大的阅兵式。我们的军队将行进在莫斯科的主要街道上，这座城终于从持续了两年的噩梦中苏醒。

src: Anyway, Astrakhan is not strong fortified and estimated only 3 divisions defends the Volga river delta. But we are informed that reinforcements downstream the Volga river and will arrive soon. So act immediately and fast! You get several construction battalions at hand to overcome the numerous waterways.
dst: 无论如何，阿斯特拉罕防御并不坚固，估计只有3个师防守伏尔加河三角洲。但我们获悉，增援正沿伏尔加河顺流而下，很快就会抵达。所以立即行动，动作要快！你手上有几个工兵营可供调遣，用来克服众多的水道。

src: Anyway, I've heard that Aguinaldo and his ministers might be too civilized for their own good. If we capture them, they'd probably agree to negotiate. In the future, we could grant the Philippines some kind of self-government if they accept a permanent presence of American troops and civil officials. At least, that's what I hope.
dst: 不过，我听说阿奎纳多和他的部长们可能过于「文明」而对自己不利。如果我们抓住他们，他们或许会同意谈判。将来，只要他们接受美国军队和文职官员的常驻，我们就可以给予菲律宾某种自治。至少，这是我期望的。

src: Anyway, President Wilson decided to support the liberal Carranza, and that's the official American policy right now. Other revolutionaries, more radical than Carranza, are fighting against him. One of the most dangerous is the former bandit Pancho Villa, well known for his cunning and audacity.
dst: 总之，威尔逊总统决定支持自由派的卡兰萨，这就是美国当前的官方政策。其他比卡兰萨更激进的革命者正在与他作对。其中最危险的一个，便是昔日的匪徒潘乔·比利亚，他以狡诈和大胆著称。

src: Anyway, it was a wrong move that cost the Germans the war, because to the Southwest there was a whole French Army waiting for Von Kluck, and his imprudent decision had exposed his right flank to our French allies.
dst: 无论如何，正是这个错误的调动让德国人输掉了战争，因为在西南方，正有一整支法国集团军在等待冯·克卢克，而他轻率的决定已将自己的右翼暴露给了我们的法国盟友。

src: Anyway, it's time to do something with the Anyera "kabila". The Anyera are ferocious and independent people, who obey neither Spain nor the Sultan of Morocco. Their territory is very close to the Spanish town of Ceuta, and the control of the area is vital for securing the roads to Tangier and Tetuán, so we must end the rebellion there.
dst: 不管怎样，是时候对安耶拉「卡比拉」采取行动了。安耶拉人是凶猛而独立的族群，既不服从西班牙，也不服从摩洛哥苏丹。他们的领地紧邻西班牙城市休达，而控制该地区对于保障通往丹吉尔和得土安的道路至关重要，所以我们必须平息那里的叛乱。

src: Anyway, parts of the Home Fleet set sail towards Canada and some British divisions have fled to Ireland. It is expected that soon a operation against Ireland will be considered. Prepare your troops!
dst: 无论如何，本土舰队的一部分启航驶向加拿大，一些英国师则逃往爱尔兰。预计很快会考虑对爱尔兰采取行动。让你的部队做好准备！

src: Anyway, the Russian attaché captain Prezjbjano - the one that spotted our armoured cars back home and used his influence to get us here - was right. We are of much more use here than in the trenches of the Western Front.
dst: 不管怎样，俄国武官普雷兹比亚诺上尉——就是那位在国内发现我们的装甲车、并运用自己的影响力把我们弄到这里来的人——是对的。我们在这里比在西线的战壕里有用得多。

src: Anyway, this battle has made France realise how serious Abd el-Krim's menace really is, so from now on the French will cooperate with us even closer. They will expand the counteroffensive at the Ouergha Valley in order to destroy the Berber strongholds at the mountains, and they will give logistical support to our most ambitious operation: A disembark at Alhucemas Bay, the very heart of the Berber lands.
dst: 不管怎样，这场战斗让法国认识到，阿卜杜·克里姆的威胁究竟有多么严重，所以从现在起，法国将与我们更紧密地合作。他们将在乌埃尔加河谷扩大反攻，以摧毁山区的柏柏尔人据点，并将为我们最雄心勃勃的行动提供后勤支援：在柏柏尔人腹地深处的阿尔胡塞马斯湾实施登陆。

src: Anyway, we expect an improvement of your skills in the near future.
dst: 不管怎样，我们期待您在不久的将来提升您的本领。

src: Anyway, we'll use our reserves and we'll eventually overcome the Montenegrins. Their army is small, and they won't receive any reinforcements. They can't resist much longer.
dst: 不管怎样，我们会动用预备队，最终战胜黑山人。他们的军队规模很小，又得不到任何援军，撑不了太久了。

src: Anyway, when our reinforcements arrive the uprising will be crushed and the survivors will have to flee to the jungle and the mountains.
dst: 不管怎样，等我们的援军一到，起义就会被镇压，幸存者将不得不逃进丛林和山区。

src: Anyway, you have my congratulations, General. I will recommend that you have the Laureate Cross of San Fernando awarded for your heroic behaviour.
dst: 无论如何，将军，请接受我的祝贺。我将推荐授予您圣费尔南多桂冠十字勋章，以表彰您的英勇行为。

src: Apart from this setback, your actions during these weeks of war have been effective and you've showed competence commanding large ammounts of troops. You've earned your promotion to General.
dst: 除了这次挫折之外，这几周战争期间您的行动卓有成效，您在指挥大量部队时表现出了卓越的能力。您赢得了晋升将军的资格。

dst: Ardense Jagers”小股部队的顽强抵抗，造成了严重延误。德军十分惊讶，因为这些小部队销毁了所有文件，使他们的上级无法查明发生了什么，从而耽误了如此多的时间。古德里安和隆美尔后来都称赞比利时军队实施的破坏和迟滞战术十分有效，并称他们为“灰狼”。

src: Arverni and the Sequani. That about 15,000 of them [_i.e._ of the Germans] had at first crossed the Rhine: but after that these wild and savage men had become enamoured of the lands and the refinement and the abundance of the Gauls, more were brought over, that there were now as many as 120,000 of them in Gaul.
dst: 最初渡过莱茵河的日耳曼人约15,000人：但此后这些粗野凶悍之人爱上了高卢的土地、文雅与富足，于是又有更多人被带过来，如今在高卢的已达12万人。

src: As I said before, with Roberts and Kitchener came massive British reinforcements. Outnumbered four to one, the Boer had to retire from virtually all the towns and the other relevant positions, most of the time without a fight. By March 1900 they had been forced to fight a guerrilla warfare, with sporadic attacks on our supply lines.
dst: 正如我之前所说，随着罗伯茨和基钦纳的到来，大批英国增援部队也抵达了。布尔人在兵力上以一对四处于劣势，不得不从几乎所有城镇和其他重要阵地撤退，而且大多数时候是不战而退。到1900年3月，他们已被迫开展游击战，对我们的补给线进行零星的袭击。

src: As I'm sure you're well aware, the Italians have decided to join the war on the German side.  That was a month ago.  The Italian forces here in East Africa have been fairly docile, as they percieve themselves to be in a relatively weak position.  However, it appears now that Mussolini's gaze has fixed itself to British Somaliland.  Italian forces have advanced into the territory, on three lines of advance.  A western column is advancing towards the coast at Zeila; a central column is advancing along the main road to Berbera; and an eastern column is protecting the central column's flank.  It has been decided, in light of our limited resources, to concentrate our forces in the centre, and you have thus been given the task of defending the main road into Berbera.  To accompolish this, your men will occupy a series of hills overlooking this road.  You are to hold the enemy up for as long as possible.
dst: 相信你很清楚，意大利人已决定站到德国一边参战。那是一个月前的事了。东非这里的意军一直相当安分，因为他们自认为处于相对弱势的地位。然而，墨索里尼的目光如今似乎盯上了英属索马里兰。意军已分三路推进进入该地区：西路由泽拉向海岸推进；中路沿通往伯贝拉的主干道推进；东路掩护中路侧翼。鉴于我们资源有限，已决定将兵力集中在中路，因此你受命防守通往伯贝拉的主干道。为此，你的部队将占领俯瞰这条公路的一系列山丘。你要尽可能久地拖住敌人。

src: As I'm writing these memoirs, I'm hearing Kappel in the other room. He's had his legs amputated, but the infection hasn't stopped. He'll die in a few days, but he's still giving instructions. He's saying something about assaulting Irkutsk and freeing Kolchak. I don't know what he means. I'm feeling very sick, and I know that I only have a few hours left. All I want is to finish this story before the end comes. People must know what happened. I won't be able to tell anyone, but at least there will be a way to read it.
dst: 当我写下这些回忆录时，我听见卡佩尔在隔壁房间。他的双腿被截肢，但感染仍未停止。他几天内就会死去，却还在下达指令。他说着什么进攻伊尔库茨克、解救高尔察克。我不知道他是什么意思。我感觉病得很重，知道自己只剩下几个小时。我只想在生命终结前写完这个故事。人们必须知道发生了什么。我无法再亲口告诉任何人了，但至少会有一种方式让人读到它。

src: As I've said, in the end we arrived in Chita. Kolchak and Kappel thought about continue the fighting in Trans- Baikal, but it was obvious that we didn't have an army anymore. We could convince them that the war was lost, and our only option was to cross the Chinese border and go into exile. The cossacks helped us to do it, and in April we finished the evacuation.
dst: 如我所说，最终我们抵达了赤塔。高尔察克和卡佩尔曾考虑在外贝加尔继续作战，但很明显我们已不再是一支军队。我们说服了他们，战争已经失败，我们唯一的选择就是越过中国边境去流亡。哥萨克帮助我们做到了这一点，4月里我们完成了撤离。

src: As I've said, it won't be easy, but we can't let the Rooineks retake the initiative. Get your troops, storm the enemy defences, and take control of the coast. That could be the last blow for the British.
dst: 如我所说，这不会容易，但我们不能让英国佬重新夺回主动权。带上您的部队，猛攻敌军防御，控制海岸。这或许能给英军最后一击。

src: As Operation Fruhlingserwachen ran out of steam, the Soviets launched a massive counter offensive, the Vienna Operation, on March 15 1945. By March 20, the Wiking were almost completely encircled. The men of the Wiking division were saved by the sacrifice of the 9th SS Hohenstaufen, who managed, despite being bled white, to hold open a small corridor that allowed Wiking to escape. On March 24, another Soviet attack pushed the exhausted Wiking back towards Vienna. Any semblance of an organised line of defence was gone. The 5th SS Wiking then executed a fighting withdrawal into Czechoslovakia, and by early May, they were within reach of the American forces, to whom the division officially surrendered near Furstenfeld, Austria on May 9 1945....
dst: 随着「春季觉醒」行动后劲耗尽，苏军于1945年3月15日发动了大规模反攻——维也纳攻势。到3月20日，「维京」师几乎被完全合围。「维京」师的官兵得以幸存，靠的是党卫军第9「霍恩施陶芬」师的牺牲：该师虽已血流殆尽，仍设法撑开一条狭窄走廊，使「维京」得以脱身。3月24日，苏军的又一次进攻把疲惫的「维京」师压回维也纳方向。任何像样的有组织防线都已不复存在。党卫军第5「维京」师随后且战且退撤入捷克斯洛伐克，到5月初已抵达美军可及之处，并于1945年5月9日在奥地利菲尔斯滕费尔德附近正式向美军投降……

src: As World War I broke out, ethnic Czechs and Slovaks living in the Russian Empire petitioned Emperor Nicholas II of Russia to let them set up a national force to fight against Austria-Hungary. The Tsar finally gave his assent. The force was composed of many prisoners and deserters from the army of the Austro-Hungarian Empire which were from the territories of Bohemia, Moravia and Slovakia. It rose in size and its first independant action was during the Russian Kerensky Offensive in between of the two Russian revolutions in the summer of 1917.
dst: 第一次世界大战爆发后，居住在俄罗斯帝国的捷克族和斯洛伐克族人向俄国沙皇尼古拉二世请愿，请求准许他们组建一支民族武装，与奥匈帝国作战。沙皇最终应允。这支部队由许多来自奥匈帝国军队的战俘和逃兵组成，他们来自波希米亚、摩拉维亚和斯洛伐克地区。部队规模不断扩大，其首次独立行动是在1917年夏两次俄国革命之间的俄国克伦斯基攻势期间。

src: As a Bulgarian commander, you'll have to fight the main battles of those turbulent times, first for the glory of your country, then for her survival.
dst: 作为保加利亚指挥官，您将亲历那段动荡岁月中的主要战役，起初是为了祖国的荣耀，而后则是为了她的存亡。

src: As a consequence of the peace talks that are taking place in Riga, it seems that a ceasefire is imminent. In a few days Poland and Soviet Russia will sign an armistice and the military operations will end.
dst: 由于正在里加举行的和平谈判，停火似乎已迫在眉睫。再过几天，波兰和苏维埃俄国就将签署停战协定，军事行动也将结束。

src: As a member of the 2nd battalion of the Grenadier Guards, I was one of the officers of that army. Aside from patriotism and sense of duty, at that moment in my life I had strong personal reasons for searching the glory of battle; I had finally found the courage to propose to my dear Evelyn, but I still feared that Colonel Worthington wouldn't approve the marriage of his only daughter to a mere Lieutenant with little combat experience.
dst: 作为掷弹兵近卫团第2营的一员，我是那支军队中的军官之一。除了爱国心与责任感之外，在那一刻，我的人生还有着强烈的个人动机去追寻战斗的荣耀；我终于鼓起勇气向我亲爱的伊芙琳求婚，但我仍担心沃辛顿上校不会同意把他唯一的女儿嫁给一个缺乏实战经验的区区中尉。

src: As a part of the 48th Panzer Corps, your battalion is tasked to support a sweeping attack with a goal of encircling and destroying the enemy north of Zhitomir.
dst: 作为第48装甲军的一部分，你的营奉命支援一场扫荡式进攻，目标是合围并消灭日托米尔以北的敌军。

src: As a provisional government was formed a Land-governing-body, to what, among others, the Rüstringer Member of Parliament Paul Hug and Kuhnt belonged.
dst: 作为临时政府，成立了一个邦治理机构，其成员包括吕斯特林根的国会议员保罗·胡格和孔特等人。

src: As a result of the German breakthrough at Sedan, General Billote, French commander of the Groupe d'Armées n° 1 and coordinator of the Northern front, has decided to retreat from the fortified "Ligne KW" (Dyle position). towards the Escaut/Scheldt river and the Terneuzen-Gent canal.
dst: 由于德军在色当突破，法军第1集团军群司令、北方战线协调人比约特将军决定从筑垒的“KW 防线”（迪尔河阵地）撤往斯海尔德河和泰尔讷曾-根特运河。

src: As a result of the Soviet summer offensives, the Germans have been pushed back to their pre-war borders, and now the Red Army is preparing to enter East Prussia. It is here, near Gumbinnen, that you face a concentrated attack by the 11th Guards Army.
dst: 由于苏军夏季攻势，德军已被压回战前边界，如今红军正准备进入东普鲁士。正是在这里，贡宾嫩附近，你将面对第11近卫集团军的集中进攻。

src: As a result of the treaty, Central Europe changed completely. The German Confederation was dissolved, Prussia annexed many of Austria’s allies, and Austria herself was excluded from German affairs. Prussia created the North German Confederation, with all the German states except Austria, Bavaria, Baden, Württemberg and part of the Grand Duchy of Hesse. Austria lost the province of Venetia and, in order to survive, transformed into Austria-Hungary in 1867.
dst: 由于这项条约，中欧彻底改变了。德意志邦联被解散，普鲁士吞并了奥地利的许多盟友，而奥地利自身也被排除在德意志事务之外。普鲁士建立了北德意志邦联，成员包括除奥地利、巴伐利亚、巴登、符腾堡以及黑森大公国一部分之外的所有德意志邦国。奥地利失去了威尼斯省，为了生存，于1867年改组为奥匈帝国。

src: As a result of your superb  performance, Herr General, Boleshevik resistance is crumbling, and it will surely not be long before they utterly collapse!
dst: 由于你卓越的表现，将军阁下，布尔什维克的抵抗正在瓦解，他们的彻底崩溃想必为期不远了！

src: As a result, during 1918 the whole of the Ottoman 4th Army was employed in monitoring and harassing the occupation of the Jordan Valley by the Egyptian Expeditionary Force, leaving the extreme right of their line comparatively weak and giving Allenby an opportunity to attack on the coast of the Mediterranean in mid-September 1918. That British final offensive ended with a total Ottoman defeat, and forced the Turks to ask for an armistice on October 1918.
dst: 结果，1918年全年，奥斯曼第4集团军全部兵力都被用于监视和袭扰埃及远征军对约旦河谷的占领，使其战线最右端相对薄弱，给了阿伦比1918年9月中旬在地中海岸进攻的机会。英军那次最后攻势以奥斯曼的彻底失败告终，迫使土耳其人在1918年10月求和。

src: As a result, we have eliminated the threat to Egypt and the Suez Canal from the Turkish supported attacks from the west.
dst: 结果，我们消除了来自西面的、由土耳其支持的对埃及和苏伊士运河的威胁。

src: As a reward for your brave efforts at ANZAC Cove you can now decide where you would like to fight next!! If you want to lead the ANZAC Infantry in France then you must take the Victory Hex for a Tactical Victory. If you want to lead the ANZAC Mounted Corp in the Middle East take the Victory Hex for a Victory. Whatever your decision Commander the Allied High Command wishes you the best of luck!!
dst: 作为对您在澳新军团湾英勇奋战的奖赏，您现在可以决定接下来去哪里作战！！如果您想在法国率领澳新军团步兵，就必须夺取胜利点以获得战术胜利。如果您想在中东率领澳新军团骑兵军，就夺取胜利点以获得小捷。无论您作何决定，指挥官，协约国最高统帅部都祝您一切顺利！！

src: As anticipated the tanks of the French moved to attack the 11th SS 'Granna on the flanks.How could the French sit idle while the SS was trying to get around behind the Maginot line or cut loose and run thru French soil.Belgium Forces joined the French.The French 12th wing Fighters and Bombers were also ordered to attack.So far the women pilots of the SS had surprised not only the French but the Brits as well.In London Air Marshal Downing believed this to be a 'Fluke' so He anticipated the results in the skies over Namur to be lop-sided in favor of the French Air Force.In Berlin the Fuhress got info to Commander Pfil Kohler at Her Command post in the 'Rewand Forest on the movement of the 2nd and Her reply was "Good let them come,the Girls are ready.This will be one less Armee the French will have and the Girls do need more experience if they are to tangle later with the Bolshevik Menace.Also thanks for releasing Your Fighter Wing from Munich".The French 'Le Grande Armee was thought to be the finest in the World and still was in the minds of many.Panzers of the SS had caught them offguard,time would reticfy that and send the 'Dear Frau's back running to the Frauland.
dst: 正如预料，法军的坦克开始进攻党卫军第11“格兰纳”师的侧翼。党卫军正试图绕到马奇诺防线后方，或放手冲过法国土地，法国人怎能坐视不理。比利时军队加入了法军。法国第12航空队的战斗机和轰炸机也奉命出击。到目前为止，党卫军的女性飞行员不仅让法国人吃惊，也让英国人吃惊。在伦敦，空军元帅唐宁认为这不过是“侥幸”，因此他预计纳尔附近上空的战果会一边倒地有利于法国空军。在柏林，女元首把法国第2集团军的动向通报给设在“雷万德森林”指挥所的普菲尔·科勒指挥官，她的回复是：“好啊，让他们来，姑娘们准备好了。法军将因此少一个集团军，而且姑娘们若日后要与布尔什维克的祸患较量，正需要更多经验。另外，谢谢你从慕尼黑调出你的战斗机联队。”法国“大军团”被认为是世界上最精锐的军队，在许多人心中依然如此。党卫军的装甲部队打了他们一个措手不及；时间会纠正这一点，把那些“亲爱的女士”们赶回“女性之国”。

src: As described, a Group of Celts under the command of Sparatcus Friend and Subleader "Krixos" indeed seperated to keep going to attack the Romans in their own Country. Spartacus still followed his target to cross the Alps from Italy.
dst: 如前所述，一支由斯巴达克斯的朋友兼副将「克里克索斯」指挥的凯尔特人确实分了兵，要继续去罗马本土进攻罗马人。斯巴达克斯仍坚持从意大利翻越阿尔卑斯山的目标。

src: As diplomatic talks with the Ottoman Empire stalled during the fall of 1914, preparations for a military campaign in the Kavkaz Mountains have begun.  The plans call for an offensive across the mountains into Turkey's Anatolia province.  Turkey's defenses hinge on the fortress of Erzerum, while ours on the fortress of Sarykamysh.
dst: 随着1914年秋与奥斯曼帝国的外交谈判陷入僵局，在高加索山脉展开军事行动的准备工作已经开始。计划要求越过山脉向土耳其的安纳托利亚省发起攻势。土耳其的防御依托埃尔祖鲁姆要塞，而我们的防御则依托萨雷卡梅什要塞。

src: As expected, the new British government is not recognized in the British dominions and in most British colonies. In Canada, a counter-government of the so-called free-Britain has established and intends to continue the war. Also the British troops in Ireland refuse to capitulate and the RAF still flying attacks against us from this island.
dst: 如所预料，新的英国政府未被英国各自治领和大多数英国殖民地承认。在加拿大，一个所谓的“自由不列颠”反政府已经建立，并打算继续战争。爱尔兰的英军也拒绝投降，皇家空军仍从这座岛上对我们发动空袭。

src: As for our brigade, since February we followed Roberts's advance to Kimberley, and then to Bloemfontein and Johannesburg, but for the next four months our division had a secondary role and we were not engaged in any important battle.
dst: 至于我们旅，自2月起我们跟随罗伯茨向金伯利推进，继而前往布隆方丹和约翰内斯堡，但在随后的四个月里，我们师只承担次要任务，未参与任何重大战斗。

src: As for the Mahdists, they never invaded Ethiopia again. Many of their best soldiers had died in the battle, seriously weakening their military strength. In the following years, they just dared to make some small-scale raids near the border. At the same time, Britain and Italy increased their military pressure against Sudan, and that would lead to the final defeat of the Mahdists at Omdurman in 1898. But don't forget that Ethiopia played a very important role in the Mahdist War. Without our little known efforts and sacrifices, it would have been extremely difficult for Britain and Egypt to ever recover Sudan.
dst: 至于马赫迪信徒，他们此后再未入侵埃塞俄比亚。他们许多最精锐的士兵都死在了那场战役中，军事力量被严重削弱。在随后的岁月里，他们只敢在边境附近进行一些小规模的袭扰。与此同时，英国和意大利加大了对苏丹的军事压力，这最终导致马赫迪信徒于1898年在恩图曼彻底覆灭。但不要忘记，埃塞俄比亚在马赫迪战争中发挥了非常重要的作用。没有我们鲜为人知的努力与牺牲，英国和埃及想要收复苏丹将极其困难。

src: As for the first battle, the plan is for a general advance on a broad front across the peninsula with the French on the right of the line, and our British and Commonwealth troops in the centre and on the left.
dst: 与第一次战斗一样，计划是沿横贯半岛的宽大正面发动全面进攻，法军在战线右翼，我们的英军及英联邦部队在中路和左翼。

src: As for the units who have mutinied, their leaders will be condemned to death at a court-martiall. And about "La Chanson de Craonne", we must find his author. It has damaded the morale of the troops terribly.
dst: 至于那些发生兵变的部队，其带头人将在军事法庭上被判处死刑。至于「克拉翁之歌」，我们必须找出它的作者。它严重损害了部队的士气。

src: As for you, General, your next destination will be the town of Melilla. Your former superior, General Fernández Silvestre, is going to launch an offensive for pacifying the Rif mountains, and has personally asked for your presence there. Good luck!
dst: 至于您，将军，您的下一站将是梅利利亚城。您昔日的上司费尔南德斯·西尔维斯特雷将军即将发动一场旨在平定里夫山区的攻势，并亲自请求您到场。祝您好运！

src: As late as April 30th and May 1st, the Nazi leaders were still playing for time, opening talks for a cease-fire in Berlin and calling on Admiral Donitz's newly proclaimed government to negotiate Germany's surrender. The Soviets held fast to the demand that Germany unconditionally surrender to all the Allies before military activities would be halted. The last ditch German attempt to sow disunity between the Allies had failed. The Soviet forces were then given the order to finish off the enemy. On May 1st 1945 at 6:30pm, the final assault on the center of Berlin began. By 3:00pm May 2nd, it was all over, and from the Reichstag waved the Hammer & Sickle. The fall of Berlin and the link up between the Soviet armies and the Allied troops led to the final collapse of Nazi Germany. The disorganized German army was no longer capable of resistance. Everywhere in Italy and Western Europe, German troops began to capitulate. On May 8th representatives of the German command signed the Act of Unconditional Surrender, thus acknowledging their total defeat...
dst: 直到4月30日和5月1日，纳粹领导人仍在争取时间：他们在柏林开启停火谈判，并呼吁海军元帅邓尼茨新宣布组建的政府去谈判德国的投降。苏联坚持要求德国先向所有盟国无条件投降，然后才停止军事行动。德国为在盟国之间制造分裂所作的最后努力失败了。苏军随即受命彻底消灭敌人。1945年5月1日下午6时30分，对柏林市中心的最后突击开始。到5月2日下午3时，一切结束，锤子与镰刀的旗帜在国会大厦上飘扬。柏林的陷落以及苏军与盟军部队的会师，导致纳粹德国的最终崩溃。已陷入混乱的德军再无力抵抗。在意大利和西欧各地，德军开始投降。5月8日，德军指挥部的代表签署了无条件投降书，从而承认了自己的彻底失败……

src: As long as the Germans are in a close formation a wild counterattack might inflict heavy losses to your army. As soon as they will split to cross the Dives you might take the chance to roll up the Germans from behind.
dst: 只要德军保持密集队形，一次猛烈的反击就可能给你的军队造成重大损失。一旦他们分散渡河，你或许可以抓住机会从背后卷击德军。

src: As once our great ancestor Brennus, we will take Rome, and this time there will be no geese on the Capitol detaining us.....
dst: 如同我们伟大的先祖布伦努斯那样，我们将拿下罗马，而这一次，卡比托利欧山上不会再有鹅来阻挡我们.....

src: As other German forces head far north To Narvick, we shall continue the drive from Oslo to Lillehammer.
dst: 趁其他德军部队北上纳尔维克之际，我们将继续从奥斯陆向利勒哈默尔推进。

src: As our forces recover from the serious fighting, let us discuss how this fight was different from your Spanish experiences.
dst: 趁我们的部队从激战中恢复，让我们聊聊这场战斗与你的西班牙经历有何不同。

src: As part of our general offensive I have to reach Kursk and then march on Moscow. The first step will be to crush the enemy defences at Oboyan. Once I have succeeded the road to Kursk will be open and Moscow will be much closer.
dst: 作为我们总攻势的一部分，我必须抵达库尔斯克，然后向莫斯科进军。第一步将是粉碎敌人在奥博扬的防御。一旦成功，通往库尔斯克的道路就将打开，莫斯科也就近在咫尺了。

src: As planned, the offensive got under way on March 6, 1945. It was spearheaded by the German 6th SS Panzer Army. Despite the muddy ground conditions, the Germans managed to attack effectively and take the Soviets by surprise. Impressive gains were made for an offensive launched at such a late date in World War II, with some groups penetrating as far as 40 km (25 miles) from the start point.
dst: 按计划，攻势于1945年3月6日发起，由德国党卫军第6装甲集团军充当先锋。尽管地面泥泞，德军仍有效地发起进攻，打了苏军一个措手不及。对于在第二次世界大战如此后期发动的攻势而言，战果相当可观，有些部队自出发点突入了远达40公里（25英里）的纵深。

src: As soon as Gojjam and Gondar were safe, Menelik returned to Shewa. Some weeks later, in September, a weak Sudanese force invaded western Gojjam. Emperor Yohannes quickly sent his army in order to repel this new threat and, amazingly, Tekle Haymanot refused to help the Emperor. Now that he believed that Menelik had grown stronger, Tekle Haymanot would rather see his own kingdom destroyed than risk his alliance with the Shewans.
dst: 戈贾姆和贡德尔一安全，孟尼利克就返回了绍阿。几周后，即9月，一支弱小的苏丹军队入侵了西戈贾姆。约翰尼斯皇帝迅速派出军队去击退这一新威胁，而令人惊讶的是，特克勒·海马诺特竟拒绝援助皇帝。既然他认为孟尼利克已变得更强，特克勒·海马诺特宁愿眼睁睁看着自己的王国被毁，也不愿冒险破坏与绍阿人的联盟。

src: As soon as the Qing Army controlled Tientsin my father in law sent most of our troops to the coast, to harass the foreign soldiers and prevent them from launching a new offensive against Peking. In the meantime a small, but experienced and extremely loyal group of veterans marched on the capital, and there they gave the Yihetuan forces the same treatment that their comrades had received in Tientsin. In a few days the Yihetuan uprising was under control, the order was restored and the foreign legations were freed by our own Chinese forces.
dst: 清军一控制天津，我的岳父便派出我们的大部分部队前往海岸，袭扰外国军队，阻止他们对北京发动新的攻势。与此同时，一小队经验丰富、极其忠诚的老兵向京城进发，在那里，他们让义和团武装尝到了与天津同伙相同的下场。数日之内，义和团起义便被控制住，秩序得以恢复，各国使馆也由我们自己的中国军队解救了。

src: As soon as we cancelled our unfortunate winter operation against Ufa, Kolchak's staff started to plan our Spring Offensive. For better or worse, it would start in March. Our supply lines were still a mess, and many of our soldiers didn't have a decent training, but we couldn't wait any longer.
dst: 我们一取消对乌法那场不幸的冬季作战，高尔察克的参谋人员就开始筹划春季攻势。无论好坏，它将在3月发动。我们的补给线仍一团糟，许多士兵也没有像样的训练，但我们不能再等了。

src: As soon as we took Simbirsk, Kappel started to plan an offensive to capture Kazan, against the orders of the Komuch, that still wanted an attack on Saratov.
dst: 我们一拿下辛比尔斯克，卡佩尔就开始筹划进攻喀山，这违背了科穆奇的命令，因为他们仍想攻打萨拉托夫。

src: As special recognition the newly launched USS Moose is detached to your army corps...!
dst: 作为特别的表彰，新近下水的美国军舰「麋鹿号」被配属给您的军团……！

src: As the Battle of Verdun rages on the Western Front, the French military liason office has urgently requested a Russian offensive to begin with the hope of preventing the transfer of divisions from the German Eastern Front to the west.  Our 2nd Army (Ragoza) had begun preparing an offensive aimed at recapturing Wilna and Panevezys.  Here at Lake Narotch you will lead the V and XXXVI Corps (Baluyev Group).  All artillery assets (divisional, corps, and army) have been combined into three artillery groups to facilitate a breakthrough.
dst: 当凡尔登战役在西线激烈进行之际，法国军事联络处紧急请求俄军发起攻势，以期阻止德军把师从德国东线调往西线。我们的第2集团军（拉戈扎）已开始准备一次旨在夺回维尔纳和帕涅韦日斯的攻势。在纳罗奇湖这里，您将统率第5和第36军（巴卢耶夫集群）。所有炮兵（师属、军属和集团军属）已合并为三个炮兵群，以便利突破。

src: As the Cimbri were tired of wandering and fighting, Boiorix made a proposition to the Romans to serve as mercenaries and were therefore allowed to stay here and settle.
dst: 由于辛布里人厌倦了漂泊与征战，博伊奥里克斯向罗马人提议：愿作雇佣兵，因此获准留在此地定居。

src: As the Cimbri were tired of wandering and fighting, Boiorix made the proposition to serve as mercenaries for the Romans and get therefor permission to settle here.
dst: 由于辛布里人厌倦了漂泊与征战，博伊奥里克斯向罗马人提议：愿作雇佣兵，以换取在此定居的许可。

src: As the Great War continues to rage on the Eastern Front, Russia has begun assembling indigenous regiments of her non-Russian subjects.  Estonian politicians have poured all effort into keeping Estonian units on Estonian soil.
dst: 随着大战继续在东线肆虐，俄国开始组建由非俄裔臣民组成的本土团。爱沙尼亚政界人士倾尽全力让爱沙尼亚部队留在爱沙尼亚国土上。

src: As the Kavkaz Army prepares the logistics necessary for an attack against Erzerum (planned for the winter of 1916), you will join the III Kavkaz Corps, which is en route to Galicia.  In May the Austrian and German forces have broken through our front and threaten to envelop our armies in Poland.  Your forces will participate in the Wieprz Operation of the South-Western Front in Galicia.
dst: 当高加索集团军为进攻埃尔祖鲁姆（计划于1916年冬实施）准备后勤之际，您将加入正开赴加利西亚的第3高加索军。五月，奥德联军已突破我方战线，并威胁要合围我们在波兰的集团军。您的部队将参加西南方面军在加利西亚的维普日河战役。

src: As the famous panzer commander you must race your forces to take your objectives. Encircle and wipe out the Poles then move West to destroy the French before taking on the might of the Russian Bear.
dst: 作为那位著名的装甲指挥官，你必须率部疾进夺取目标。围歼波兰人，然后西进消灭法国人，再去对抗俄国熊的威力。

src: As the front on the Leie
As the german commander you have to take the  belt of fortesses around Verdun and the city itself. These are to hold under all circumstances by the french commander.
dst: 作为德军指挥官，您必须夺取凡尔登周围的要塞带和城市本身。而法军指挥官则要誓死坚守这些目标。

src: As the main enemy forces hold the capitol, you outnumber the defenders, but the Polish infantry is well entrenched, and has some MG and artillery support. Be careful of armoured counterattacks and cavalry raids. Always escort your bombers and be ready for dogfights.
dst: 鉴于敌军主力据守首都，你虽在兵力上占优，但波兰步兵工事坚固，且配有部分机枪与炮兵支援。当心装甲反击与骑兵突袭。务必为轰炸机护航，并随时准备空战。

src: As the smoke cleared over the battlefields around Kop, a gruesome picture of heroism and death comes to light:  with your HQ overrun by a massive Turkish counter-attack, you realize how quickly fortune can turn in war.
dst: 当硝烟在科普周围的战场上空散去，一幅英勇与死亡交织的惨烈图景浮现出来：您的指挥部被土耳其的大规模反攻攻占，您这才意识到命运在战争中会变得何等之快。

src: As the two masses will inevitably clash, maneuver will characterize this battle.
dst: 两大集群势必碰撞，机动将是这场战斗的特点。

src: As there are only 2 deploy hex at sea and 1 to the ground, it is recommended to deploy your flagship to clear the mines, 1 more ship and your marrinestosstrupp to capture the VH.
dst: 由于海上只有2个部署格、陆地上只有1个，建议部署你的旗舰来清除水雷，再加1艘舰船和你的海军陆战队突击队来夺取胜利点。

src: As though nothing could fall: Klin
dst: 仿佛一切都不会陷落:克林

src: As we cross the Dnipr, your troops will support the main thrust by screening the flanks of my XXIX PzKorps.  The left flank should require little attention, however the Russians are approaching us from the South in strength, do not underestimate this threat!
dst: 渡第聂伯河时，你的部队将通过掩护我第29装甲军的两翼来支援主攻。左翼应无需太多关注，但俄军正从南面大举逼近我们，切勿低估这一威胁！

src: As we expected, the Russians are becoming better at defending their country.
dst: 如我们所料，俄国人正越来越善于保卫他们的国家。

src: As we feared, the Americans had some of those "nukes" ready to use.
dst: 如我们所担心的那样，美国人已备好了几枚那种“核弹”可供使用。

src: As we have won Missouri for us I think our meanwhile well established cavallery will free Arkansas quickly too...
dst: 既然我们已为联邦赢得了密苏里州，我想我们如今已颇具实力的骑兵也能很快解放阿肯色州……

src: As we paraded in front of the Kazan Kremlin, I realised that the spring of 1919 would probably be the happiest of my life. We were recovering our homeland step by step. Siberia and the Urals were safe, and now it was time to consolidate our positions on the Volga.
dst: 当我们在喀山克里姆林宫前阅兵时，我意识到1919年的春天很可能是我一生中最幸福的时光。我们正在一步步收复祖国。西伯利亚和乌拉尔安全了，现在是时候巩固我们在伏尔加河的阵地了。

src: As we speak the Czech Legion has partly reached Kiev and parts of the Legion  will take up defensive positions at the bridges over the Dnjepr River, so that the bulk of Czech Legion can retreat even deeper into the Ukraine and stay out of German hands. You will have to hold out for at least five days.
dst: 就在我们说话之际，捷克军团已部分抵达基辅，军团的各部将在第聂伯河上的桥梁处布防，以便捷克军团主力能够撤入乌克兰更深处，避开德军的魔掌。您必须至少坚守五天。

src: As you advance into Tabriz, you will make contact with the volunteer Armenian units.  Large stockpiles of supplies had been left behind in December by our army:  upon capture of the city, you will be able to resupply your army and deploy in full.
dst: 当您向大不里士推进时，将与亚美尼亚志愿部队取得联系。我军12月在那里遗留了大量补给：夺取该城后，您就能为您的部队补给并全面展开部署。

src: As you and your men are most experienced in amphibious maneuvers, we once again have to ask you to carry out this important amphibious maneuver....
dst: 由于您和您的部下在两栖机动方面经验最为丰富，我们不得不再次请您执行这次重要的两栖行动……

src: As you are aware, the Allied forces have been destroyed in their attempt to invade "Fortress Europe".
dst: 如你所知，盟军入侵“欧洲堡垒”的企图已被粉碎。

src: As you are the commander of our elite paratroopers, we need to inform you that our Italian allies sent alarming reports from Rhodes. Greek forces are about to attack Lindos. Italian intelligence alse reports guerilla attacks on Kamiros and the Katavia airfield.
dst: 由于你是我们精锐伞兵的指挥官，我们必须通知你：我们的意大利盟友从罗得岛发来了令人警觉的报告。希腊部队即将进攻林多斯。意大利情报部门还报告了针对卡米罗斯和卡塔维亚机场的游击袭击。

src: As you can imagine, the Centre was as useless and weak as the old Komuch. After just a few days they surrendered to the Bolsheviks, who were the ones who had Kolchak at the end of January. They would kill them if we couldn't rescue him first. Then we'd have to flee to the Baikal. If we managed to cross it, we'd be relatively safe.
dst: 您可以想象，这个中心就像从前的科穆奇一样无用而软弱。仅仅几天后，他们就向布尔什维克投降了，而布尔什维克才是在1月底掌控高尔察克的人。如果我们不能先把他救出来，他们就会杀了他。然后我们就得逃向贝加尔湖。如果我们能渡过它，就会相对安全。

src: As you flee the battlefield of Lodz, passing entire regiments consumed by panic, you come to realize that your cowardice during this fight has greater strategic implications than you have imagined.  Unfortunately for your career, this conclusion has coincided with Stavka's assessment of the situation.
dst: 当您逃离罗兹战场，从被恐慌吞没的整团整团士兵身旁经过时，您逐渐意识到，这场战斗中的怯懦所带来的战略影响远比您想像的更为重大。不幸的是，对您的前程而言，这一结论与大本营对局势的评估不谋而合。

src: As you know our original push for Falaise, Operation Totalize, met with fanatical German resistance and, consequently, has become bogged down. Therefore we are planning a new offensive, Operation Tractable. Your mission is to capture Falaise, and then push south-eastwards for Trun and Chambois, keeping the Normandy bottle securely corked...
dst: 如你所知，我们最初向法莱斯推进的「总计」行动遭到了德军的疯狂抵抗，因而陷入停滞。因此我们正在计划一次新的攻势——「驯服」行动。你的任务是夺取法莱斯，然后向东南推进至特兰和香布瓦，把诺曼底这只瓶子的瓶塞牢牢塞住...

src: As you know, Rear Admiral Cámara's relief squadron has been ordered to return to Spain to face possible U.S. Navy operations against Spain itself. Therefore, do not expect any help from the Metropolis.
dst: 如您所知，卡马拉海军少将的救援分舰队已奉命返回西班牙，以应对美国海军可能对西班牙本土采取的行动。因此，不要指望来自本土的任何支援。

src: As you know, a group of dissidents in eastern Cuba have started an armed uprising against the Spanish authority. They are strong in the province of Oriente, where their guerrilla strategy is restricting troops' movements and making difficult to supply garrisons.
dst: 如您所知，古巴东部的一群异见者发动了反抗西班牙当局的武装起义。他们在奥连特省势力强大，其游击战术限制了部队调动，使守军补给十分困难。

src: As you know, after taking Wilno, Polish authorities issued a Proclamation to the inhabitants of the former Grand Duchy of Lithuania. Poles hoped that liberating Wilno from the hands of the Russians would give them a chance to recreate the historical state.
dst: 如您所知，占领维尔诺后，波兰当局向原立陶宛大公国的居民发布了一份宣言。波兰人希望，将维尔诺从俄国人手中解放出来，能给他们一个重建这个历史国家的机会。

src: As you know, following the sinking of the US ship "Maine" in Havana harbour our relations with the United States are fragile and precarious and war is about to break out.
dst: 如您所知，美国军舰「缅因号」在哈瓦那港沉没之后，我们与美国的关系变得脆弱而危险，战争一触即发。

src: As you know, our campaign in the north continues to go well.  You have been chosen to lead our invasion in the south.  After your beachhead is secure,  it is imperative for you to seize the port city of Savannah. Once this is accomplished, our drive inland will cut the United States in half.  It is believed that the Americans are ignorant of our plans.  But be aware that the people of this region will fight us to their last breath.
dst: 如你所知，我们在北方的战役进展顺利。你被选中领导我们在南方的入侵。滩头稳固之后，你必须夺取港口城市萨凡纳。一旦得手，我们向内陆的推进将把美国一分为二。据信美国人对我们的计划一无所知。但要当心，这一带的人会与我们拼到最后一口气。

src: As you know, our current situation in this war is grim: The Germans are steamrolling across Russia, the British 8th army has been pushed back into Egypt, and the enemy is sitting just across the Channel. Since the time is not yet ripe for a full scale invasion of the continent, we have decided to mount a raid on the French port of Dieppe. It is designed to foster German fears of a major attack in the west and compel them to strengthen their Channel defences at the expense of other areas of operations. This will be a good opportunity for us to gain experience in amphibious landings and test new techniques and equipment...Good Luck General...
dst: 如你所知，我们在这场战争中的处境十分严峻：德国人正横扫俄国，英国第八集团军被打回埃及，敌人就盘踞在海峡对岸。既然大举入侵欧洲大陆的时机尚未成熟，我们决定对法国港口迪耶普实施一次突袭。此举旨在加剧德国对西线大规模进攻的恐惧，迫使他们以牺牲其他战场为代价来加强海峡防线。这也是我们积累两栖登陆经验、检验新技术与新装备的好机会……祝你好运，将军……

src: As you know, since June several contingents of American land forces have arrived to the Philippines. By now, some 12,000 U.S. troops under Major General Wesley Merritt have landed and are moving towards Manila to assault and occupy the city.
dst: 如您所知，自6月起，数支美国地面部队已抵达菲律宾。如今，韦斯利·梅里特少将麾下约12000名美军已登陆，正向马尼拉进发，准备攻占该城。

src: As you know, since you have some experience against the soviets in 1938, they will be a rough enemy.  Their use of heavy artillery units will again be a major problem.
dst: 如您所知，由于您在 1938 年就有过与苏军交战的经验，他们将会是一个棘手的敌人。他们对重型炮兵部队的运用，将再次成为一大难题。

src: As you know, the Chinese refuse to support our claims on Tonkin [Northern Vietnam] and Negotiations to settle the matter peacefully have failed....
dst: 如您所知，中国人拒绝支持我们对东京（越南北部）的主权要求，和平解决此事的谈判已经失败……

src: As you know, the Soviet Union has attacked us all along our front, but you managed to delay the Soviet attack in this sector just enough to allow us to begin the set up our defensive positions behind the Mannerheim line. Do not worry about the puppet government installed by Stalin in Terijoki, it does not and will not have the support of our people! Anyway, You and your men will now move North towards Tolvajarvi, where a counter offensive is being planned....
dst: 如你所知，苏联在我国全线发动了进攻，但你成功地把苏军在这一地段的进攻拖延了足够长的时间，使我们得以开始在曼纳海姆防线后方构筑防御阵地。不必担心斯大林在泰里约基扶植的那个傀儡政府，它得不到、也永远不会得到我国人民的支持！总之，你和你的部下现在将北上调往托尔瓦亚尔维，那里正在策划一次反击....

src: As you know, the Soviet victory agaisnt the Japanese in Manchuria the past year has opened the gate of the regular support of hardware and weapons to us. Now, the ChCP troops are better equipped and trained. The Soviets have given us some Japanese captured equipment from Manchuria, like tanks and artillery and the Japanese prisoners are training our brave men. They had no choice: work in Siberia or work with us!.
dst: 如你所知，去年苏联在满洲对日本的胜利为我们打开了获得硬件和武器正规支援的大门。现在，中共部队装备和训练都更好了。苏联人把从满洲缴获的一些日军装备给了我们，比如坦克和大炮，日军战俘正在训练我们的勇士。他们别无选择：要么去西伯利亚干活，要么跟我们干！

src: As you know, the campaign against Russia began last week on June 22. We have order to bring the fighting in Iraq as quickly as possible to an end, to establish a threat on the Russian southern flank in Caucasus. Negotiations with the Iranian and Turkish leaders are in progress to allow the transit of our troops.
dst: 如你所知，对俄国的战役上周6月22日打响了。我们奉命尽快结束伊拉克的战斗，以便在高加索的俄军南翼建立威胁。与伊朗和土耳其领导人的谈判正在进行，以允许我军过境。

src: As you know, the fortifications surrounding Melilla (one of our cities in North Africa) are being expanded and new redoubts are being erected. Unfortunately a holy place has been demolished and Moroccans across the province (known as Rifians) have rushed to arms against Spain and called for a jihad.
dst: 如您所知，围绕梅利利亚（我们在北非的城市之一）的防御工事正在扩建，新的棱堡也在修建中。不幸的是，一处圣地被拆毁，全省的摩洛哥人（称为里夫山民）纷纷拿起武器反抗西班牙，并号召圣战。

src: As you know, the reds have launched another strike, this time they are trying to capture Teruel, which is completely besieged now. The colonel Rey d'Haucourt is resisting with the garrison of Teruel, however we think he have not means to face the assault for a long time.
dst: 如您所知，共和军又发动了一次打击，这一次他们企图夺取特鲁埃尔，该城现已被彻底包围。雷伊·多库尔上校正率特鲁埃尔守备部队抵抗，不过我们认为他没有能力长期抵御这次进攻。

src: As you know, there weren't any important battles in the Gondar campaign. Both sides had good reasons for avoiding pitched battles, and for taking little risks. We chose a strategy of permanent guerrilla attacks, trying to harass the invaders as much as possible, to cut their supply lines, to slow their advances, and to lower their morale. Although we couldn't retake the lost territory, this new system seemed to work, as our enemies finally stopped their offensive.
dst: 如您所知，贡德尔战役中并没有什么重要的会战。双方都有充分的理由避免正面决战，也都尽量少冒风险。我们选择了不断进行游击袭扰的战略，尽可能骚扰入侵者，切断他们的补给线，迟滞他们的推进，并瓦解他们的士气。尽管我们无法收复失地，但这套新战法似乎奏效了，因为敌人最终停止了攻势。

src: As you know, we have pursued the Germans back to the Adriatic coast, to their last major defensive line seperating us from the Po valley and the Lombardy plain in Northern Italy. Since many factories producing supplies vital to the German effort are located in the North, we expect the Germans to fight hard tp prevent our breakthrough. Your mission is to breach the "Gothic" line and drive North, capturing all key cities along the way to the main objective of Rimini. Victory in the coming battles means the beginning of the end for the German armies in Italy...Good luck General...
dst: 如你所知，我们已把德军追到亚得里亚海沿岸，追到那道把我们与意大利北部的波河河谷和伦巴第平原隔开的主要防线。由于许多为德国战争机器生产重要物资的工厂都位于北方，我们预计德军会拼死阻止我们突破。你的任务是突破「哥特」防线并北上，夺取沿途所有关键城市，直至主要目标里米尼。在即将到来的战斗中取胜，意味着意大利境内的德军开始走向末日……祝你好运，将军……

src: As you know, we have signed an alliance with our former enemies, the nationalists.  Now, the enemy is the foreign imperialist invader, it's time to forget our quarrel with the KMT for a while.  We are united with them against a common enemy: the Japanese Empire.  While the KMT troops are dealing with the Japanese armies in other parts of China, our guerrillas have been surrounded by the enemy advance in Manchuria and other many places in Northern China, and you (yes, you), a veteran ChCP commander will show the dirty invaders a bit of the people's revolution power.  We must harass the Japanese rearguard as much as possible without taking too many losses.  I'm sure the current KMT-ChCP alliance will not long too much longer.
dst: 如你所知，我们已同从前的敌人国民政府结盟。如今敌人是外国帝国主义侵略者，是时候暂时放下与国民党的争执了。我们与他们联合起来对抗共同的敌人：日本帝国。当国民党军队在中国其他地区对付日军时，我们的游击队在满洲和中国北方许多地方已被敌人推进所包围，而你（对，就是你），一位老练的中共指挥员，要让肮脏的侵略者见识一下人民革命的力量。我们必须尽可能袭扰日军后方，同时不要遭受太大损失。我相信目前的国共联盟不会维持太久。

src: As you may know, a part of the British Home Fleet which is loyal to the new King is temporarily interned in French Le Havre. This morning we received reports that some of the ship crews rebelled, instigated by a local mob! They have overwhelmed our harbor guards and since the harbor is completely mined and they can't sail, they have begun to sink their ships. You have order to interrupt your transfer to Spain - move your forces immediately to Le Havre and stop these madmen before serious damage is done!
dst: 如你所知，忠于新国王的英国本土舰队的一部分，暂时扣留在法国的勒阿弗尔。今天早上我们收到报告，一些船员在当地暴民的煽动下哗变了！他们制服了我们的港口卫兵，而由于港口已完全布雷、无法出航，他们开始凿沉自己的军舰。你奉命中断向西班牙的转移——立即把部队开往勒阿弗尔，在这些疯子造成严重破坏之前制止他们！

src: As you well know - you of all people certainly! - the Soviets are running for their lives. However, since most people in the old leadership are either dead or captured, it is uncertain who is in charge of the Soviet forces. We must therefore chase them and capture as many Soviet soldiers as possible. Capture Gorki and we will have secured the Moscow-Gorki area, the largest industrial area in Russia.
dst: 你比谁都清楚——苏联人正在逃命。然而，由于旧领导层大多或死或被俘，如今谁在统率苏军已不得而知。因此我们必须追击，尽量多俘虏苏军士兵。拿下高尔基，我们就将确保莫斯科—高尔基地区——俄国最大的工业区。

src: As your landing party has been repulsed we have decided to launch an invasion force to land on the southwest side of the peninsula and travel overland and destroy these coastal guns.
dst: 由于您的登陆部队被击退，我们决定派出一支登陆部队在半岛西南侧登陆，经陆路行军摧毁这些海岸炮台。

src: As your marines fight to liberate the islands, the French fleet is in danger of being destroyed. Admiral Robert overestimated the capabilities of his ships and is in danger of losing not only the sovereignty he had but all his ships. So you have to save the French ships but at the same time prevent the landing of the American marines who are coming to occupy the islands. Try to destroy as many enemy units as possible, the blow to the Americans will be huge, since we will delay a possible involvement of them in Europe.
dst: 正当您的海军陆战队为解放这些岛屿而战时，法国舰队却面临被歼灭的危险。罗贝尔上将高估了自己舰船的能力，如今不仅可能失去他原有的制海权，还可能葬送全部舰船。因此，您必须保住法国舰船，同时阻止前来占领群岛的美国海军陆战队登陆。尽量多摧毁敌军单位，这将给美国人以沉重打击，因为我们将借此推迟他们可能介入欧洲的进程。
阿森西奥·卡瓦尼利亚斯

src: Ashamed for my failure, I left the army and went back to Samara, where I found a job as a teacher. Luckily, people soon forgot about me. After all, I'm not the first Russian officer who fails at a very critical moment. At least I can proudly say that we defeated the Bolsheviks and that, although the empire has been lost, Russia still has a future thanks to people like me. I did my best to serve my country. I wish I had done it better, but I couldn't. Over time, I have learnt to live with that.
dst: 为自己的失败而羞愧，我离开了军队，回到萨马拉，谋得了一份教师的工作。幸运的是，人们很快就把我淡忘了。毕竟，我不是第一个在极关键时刻失手的俄国军官。至少我可以自豪地说，我们击败了布尔什维克，而且，尽管帝国已经失去，俄国依然因为像我这样的人而拥有未来。我尽了全力报效祖国。我多么希望自己能做得更好，但我做不到。随着时间推移，我学会了与这一切共处。
Ashburner's 轻型马/ Methuen's 纵队
阿什福德 (巴利马卡哈拉)
美国俄亥俄州阿什塔比拉

src: Asomese a la ventana, lo ve?, las columnas enemigas estan apareciendo por el paseo de la Castellana triunfalmente. No nos queda escapatoria alguna, gracias a su ineptitud la guerra ha terminado para nosotros y seguro que pronto nos fusilaran.
dst: 您往窗外看看，看见了吗？敌军纵队正耀武扬威地出现在卡斯特利亚纳大道上。我们已无路可逃，多亏您的无能，这场战争对我们而言已经结束了，想必他们很快就会枪毙我们。
阿斯普拉斯皮蒂亚 (帕拉利亚迪斯托穆)

src: Assassins - against soft and spy-class units.
dst: 刺客 - 对付软目标与间谍类单位。

src: Assault and capture the important city of Tula.
dst: 进攻并夺取重要城市图拉。

src: Astor Bty. / 1st Bde. / 2nd Div. / VIII Corps
dst: Astor 炮兵连 / 第1旅 / 第2师 / 第8军

src: Asturias, 1936. La Guerra Civil está inundando de sangre España. El ejército planea evitar otro Octubre Rojo en Asturias. El Frente Popular ha sido eliminado del oeste de Asturias, pero los republicanos todavía tienen el poder suficiente para asaltar Oviedo, donde el coronel Aranda resiste desde Julio. Si los republicanos logran tomar Oviedo, serán capaces de enviar tropas al oeste y sur de Asturias, y la rebelión contra el gobierno se vería seriamente perjudicada. Evítelo tomando Oviedo.
dst: 阿斯图里亚斯，1936年。内战正让西班牙血流成河。军方计划避免在阿斯图里亚斯再度上演「红色十月」。人民阵线已被逐出阿斯图里亚斯西部，但共和军仍拥有足够力量进攻奥维耶多，阿兰达上校自七月起便在那里坚守。如果共和军成功攻占奥维耶多，他们就能从阿斯图里亚斯向西面和南面派遣部队，反抗政府的起义也将遭受重创。请您夺取奥维耶多，以阻止这一切。

src: Asturias, 1936. The Civil War is flooding Spain with blood. The Army plans to avoid another Red October in Asturias has worked in part. The People's Front has been eliminated from Western Asturias, but the republicans still have enough power to assault Oviedo, where the colonel Aranda is resisting since July. If the republicans achieve to take Oviedo, they will be able to send troops to the West and the South from Asturias, and the rebellion agaisnt the government would be seriously damaged. Avoid that by saving Oviedo.
dst: 阿斯图里亚斯，1936年。内战正让西班牙血流成河。军方避免在阿斯图里亚斯再度上演「红色十月」的计划已部分奏效。人民阵线已被逐出阿斯图里亚斯西部，但共和军仍拥有足够力量进攻奥维耶多，阿兰达上校自七月起便在那里坚守。如果共和军攻占奥维耶多，他们就能从阿斯图里亚斯向西面和南面派遣部队，反抗政府的起义也将遭受重创。请您保住奥维耶多，以阻止这一切。

src: At 07:20 (Moscow time) on 19 November Soviet forces on the northern flank of the Axis forces at Stalingrad began their offensive; forces in the south began on 20 November. Although Romanian units were able to repel the first attacks, by the end of 20 November the Third and Fourth Romanian armies were in headlong retreat.
dst: 11月19日07:20（莫斯科时间），位于斯大林格勒轴心军北翼的苏军发起进攻；南翼部队则于11月20日行动。尽管罗马尼亚部队击退了首轮攻击，但至11月20日末，罗马尼亚第3、第4集团军已溃退。

src: At 08:30 on 12 July 1943, Pavel Rotmistrov, commanding officer of the 5th Guards Tank Army, radioed his tankers: "Steel, Steel, Steel!", the order to commence the attack on the German forces of the II SS-Panzer Corps in the vincinity of Prokhorovka.
dst: 1943年7月12日8时30分，近卫第5坦克集团军司令帕维尔·罗特米斯特罗夫向他的坦克手们发出无线电呼叫：「钢铁，钢铁，钢铁！」——这是向普罗霍罗夫卡附近党卫军第2装甲军德军部队发起进攻的命令。

src: At 3:10 a.m. 19 mines - placed by British tunellers - were detonated under our positions on Messines Ridge. The explosions could be heard hundreds of kilometers away. British troops have gone over the top and are  attacking the ridge. You are in charge of the Eingreif Divisions and your task is to counterattack and regain our positions.
dst: 凌晨3点10分，英国工兵埋设的19枚地雷在梅森岭我方阵地下方引爆。爆炸声在数百公里外都能听见。英军已跃出战壕，正向山岭发起进攻。您负责指挥反击师，您的任务是反攻并夺回我方阵地。

src: At 5pm on the 18th of September the supply column of the 3rd Panzer Division arrived to refuel the vehicles and they set off towards Chelm. They advanced slowly due to bad and blocked roads and destroyed bridges. Only isolated pockets of resistance are ecountered but the division suffers it's highest losses of the campaign so far this day. The lead units enter the outskirts of Chelm and OKW reports suggest a meeting between Heers Groups Nord and Sud here, but this was never substantiated.
dst: 9月18日下午5点，第3装甲师的补给纵队抵达，为车辆加油，随后他们出发前往海乌姆。由于道路糟糕、被堵塞以及桥梁被毁，他们推进缓慢。只遇到孤立的抵抗据点，但该师当天遭受了本战役迄今最惨重的损失。先头部队进入海乌姆郊区，OKW 的报告称北方与南方两个集团军群在此会师，但此事从未得到证实。

src: At 5pm on the 18th of september the supply column of the 3rd Panzer Division arrived to refuel the vehicles and they set off towards Chelm. They advanced slowly due to bad and blocked roads and destroyed bridges. Only isolated pockets of resistance are ecountered but the division suffers it's highest losses of the campaign so far this day. The lead units enter the outskirts of Chelm and OKW reports suggest a meeting between Heers Groups Nord and Sud here, but this was never substantiated.
dst: 9月18日下午5点，第3装甲师的补给纵队抵达，为车辆加油，随后他们出发前往海乌姆。由于道路糟糕、被堵塞以及桥梁被毁，他们推进缓慢。只遇到孤立的抵抗据点，但该师当天遭受了本战役迄今最惨重的损失。先头部队进入海乌姆郊区，OKW 的报告称北方与南方两个集团军群在此会师，但此事从未得到证实。

src: At Bachmatsj the Czech Legion, in cooperation with Soviet Red Army units, stopped the advance of the German Army and could march its way east, out of the German occupied regions of Russia.
dst: 在巴赫马奇，捷克军团与苏联红军部队协同，阻止了德军的推进，得以向东行军，走出了被德军占领的俄国地区。

src: At Brakfontein Drift near the Elandsrivier there is a British supply dump which is being guarded by a garrison of 500 Australian and Rhodesian soldiers. General Kitchener is almost two weeks away from them. Thus, their only real chance of relief is a small column of Australians that will come from the west in a few days. We can deal with them, so we should have enough time for defeating the Australians and for taking their supplies.
dst: 在埃兰兹河附近的布拉克方丹渡口，有一个英军补给堆放点，由一支500人的澳大利亚和罗得西亚士兵守备队把守。基钦纳将军离他们还有将近两周的路程。因此，他们唯一现实的解围希望，就是几天后将从西面赶来的一支澳大利亚小纵队。我们能对付他们，所以应该会有足够的时间击败澳大利亚人并夺取他们的补给。

src: At Cork don't expect much resistance. There are 5 forts near Cork (2 next to Whitegate, 2 next to Crosshaven and 1 next to Kinsale), the units that capture these forts will gain experience.
dst: 在科克不要指望会遇到多少抵抗。科克附近有5座要塞（2座在 Whitegate 附近，2座在 Crosshaven 附近，1座在 Kinsale 附近），攻占这些要塞的单位将获得经验。

src: At Esus! About this victory songs will be sung even in a thousand years! The Romans were completely extinguished ....! ....
dst: 埃苏斯在上！这场胜利的颂歌千年之后仍会被唱起！罗马人被彻底消灭了 ....! ....

src: At HQ you're not allowed to upgrade any units or buy new ones, seeing that this scenario takes place only a couple of days after the last one
dst: 在司令部，你不得升级任何部队或购买新部队，因为本场景发生在上一个场景之后仅仅数日

src: At Krasnoyarsk we found some wagons and other vehicles that we used to advance faster without having to split our forces. We wanted to reach Irkutsk, where Kolchak was supposedly waiting for us. Then we could cross the Baikal and build a new line of defense.
dst: 在克拉斯诺亚尔斯克，我们找到了一些马车和其他车辆，使我们不必分兵就能更快地前进。我们想抵达伊尔库茨克，据说高尔察克正在那里等我们。然后我们就能渡过贝加尔湖，构筑新的防线。

src: At Landrecies and Grand Fayt we taught the Germans what a fighting retreat means. We inflicted on them great losses, and we also secured the II Corp's right flank, giving them a great advantage at Le Cateau. Once we accomplished our goals, we marched to the South. The enemy dared not to pursue us for a few days.
dst: 在朗德勒西和格朗费，我们让德国人领教了什么叫且战且退。我们给他们造成了重大损失，还保住了第二军的右翼，使他们在勒卡托占据了很大的优势。一旦达成目标，我们便向南行进。敌人有几天不敢追击我们。
新沙佩勒之战 - 1915年3月12日 - 大捷
新沙佩勒之战 - 1915年3月12日 - 失败
新沙佩勒 - 1915年3月12日 - 小捷

src: At Peralejo Cubans used for the first time its tactic of cavalry charging at the beginning to force Spanish troops to close up ranks. This allowed Cuban infantry to move into position and to fire into massed squares of Spanish troops. Despite the myth of the "machete" (heavy knife) as Cuban's favourite weapon, in Peralejo, as in many other the battles, the rifle, and not the "machete", was the main weapon.
dst: 在佩拉莱霍，古巴人第一次使用了先以骑兵冲锋迫使西班牙军队收拢队形的战术。这使古巴步兵得以进入阵地，向密集列队的西班牙方阵开火。尽管流传着「大砍刀」（重刀）是古巴人最喜爱武器的神话，但在佩拉莱霍，如同在其他许多战役中一样，步枪而非「大砍刀」才是主要武器。

src: At Saint Quentin the French lost their last organized army, and once the battle was over nothing could stop the new German nation from achieving a total victory. Alsace and Lorraine would become German territories, among other harsh peace conditions.
dst: 在圣康坦，法国人失去了他们最后一支有组织的军队，战斗一结束，便再没有什么能阻止这个新生的德意志国家取得彻底的胜利。阿尔萨斯和洛林将成为德国领土，此外还有其他苛刻的和平条件。

src: At Sandeveg there is a hospital thal heals ground units.
dst: 在 Sandeveg 有一所医院，可为地面单位治疗。

src: At Valga you faced the elite Red Latvian formations of the Red Army and succeeded in defeating them during a battle characterized by its violent intensity.  Strategically, this battle carried major consequences for the Red Army:  our success at Valga split the Red Latvian Army and forced them to abandom the successful offensive against Libau, giving time to the Baltische Landeswehr in Latvia to regroup and gain the initiative against the Red Latvians.
dst: 在瓦尔加，您面对的是红军的精锐拉脱维亚红色部队，并在一场异常激烈的战斗中成功将其击败。从战略上讲，这场战斗对红军产生了重大影响：我们在瓦尔加的胜利分割了红色拉脱维亚军队，迫使他们放弃了对利包的成功攻势，从而为拉脱维亚的波罗的海防卫军争取到了重新集结并对红色拉脱维亚人夺取主动权的时间。

src: At Zborow, the site of all too familiar to our cavalry since 1914 and to the Czech Legion since 1916, the VI Corps of the 11th Army has been tasked with breaking through toward Zloczow.  You will receive the French Air detachment and the Belgian Armored Car Corps as reinforcements.  You will face experienced German divisions, as they have taken over supreme command of the Galician Front.  Our air recoinnasance has reported few strategic reinforcements available to the enemy, so a breakthrough here will open the road to Lemberg.  May God grant you speed in this battle!
dst: 在兹博罗夫——这个自1914年以来我骑兵、自1916年以来捷克军团都再熟悉不过的地方——第11集团军第6军受命向兹沃切夫方向突破。您将得到法国航空支队和比利时装甲车军作为增援。您将面对经验丰富的德军师，因为他们已接管了加利西亚战线的最高指挥权。我们的空中侦察报告，敌军可用的战略预备队很少，因此在这里突破将打开通往伦贝格的道路。愿上帝赐您在这一战中行动神速！

src: At all the very factual style of the book is intended by him....
dst: 全书那种极其实事求是的文风，正是他有意为之……

src: At first I couldn't understand the reasons why Denikin sent me here, to the left flank of our battle front, in order to help May-Mayevsky, who had recently asked for reinforcements, because he knows that I dislike that man. I consider him a competent general, but a disgusting kind of person. Even worse, he's allowed his soldiers to behave almost as common criminals, bandits and looters, not very different from the Bolsheviks that are destroying Russia.
dst: 起初我无法理解邓尼金为何派我来这里，到我们战线左翼援助最近请求增援的迈-马耶夫斯基，因为他明知我不喜欢那个人。我认为他是一位称职的将军，但人品令人作呕。更糟的是，他纵容自己的士兵几乎像普通罪犯、强盗和掠夺者一样行事，与正在毁灭俄国的布尔什维克并无多大区别。

src: At first we thought the invasion of Crete was a goal in itself. Only meant to secure mediterrenean shipping, and to establish an airbase for bombarding Ploesti. Clearly this was not the case: it seems the western allies feel they are not strong enough yet to invade France and have therefore choosen first to gain a foothold in the Balkans that will tie up some of our forces and secure their influence there.
dst: 起初我们以为入侵克里特岛本身就是目的，只是为确保地中海航运安全，并为轰炸普洛耶什蒂建立一个空军基地。显然并非如此：看来西方盟国觉得自身还不够强大，尚不足以入侵法国，因此选择先在巴尔干取得立足点，以牵制我们部分兵力并确保其在那里的影响力。

src: At first you will have to clear a strong mines and obstacle field before your troops can penetrate the fortress. The success of this operation will depend on the smooth cooperation between our navy and your ground troops! The Spanish military have supplied some naval units also.
dst: 首先，你必须清除大片雷区和障碍物，你的部队才能突入要塞。此役的成败，取决于我方海军与你的地面部队之间的顺畅协同！西班牙军方也提供了一些海军舰艇。

src: At first, there wasn't enough equipment and weaponry for the Czechoslovaks. Soldiers wore civilian clothes and trained with wooden rifles and make-believe artillery for a very long time and it was only in the end of November 1942, when the final cargo of necessary stuff reached Buzuluk.
dst: 起初，捷克斯洛伐克人既缺装备也缺武器。士兵们穿着平民衣服，用木枪和假想的火炮训练了很久，直到1942年11月底，最后一批必需物资才运抵布祖鲁克。

src: At last we are at the gates of Moscow - despite continuous interference in our operations from above. We have heard that Stalin himself is still in the city - take it quickly in order to prevent him to escape!
dst: 我们终于兵临莫斯科城下——尽管上头不断干涉我们的行动。我们听说斯大林本人仍在城中——速速夺城，别让他跑了！

src: At last, the British conquered the important ports of Jaffa and Gaza. After these fights, in which both sides suffered heavy losses, the Turkish army has gathered in Jerusalem.
dst: 最终，英军攻占了雅法和加沙这两个重要港口。在这些双方均损失惨重的战斗之后，土耳其军队集结于耶路撒冷。

src: At last. We've finally reached our destination, lieutenant. Now it's time to show your value as an officer of the Force Publique of the Free State of the Congo.
dst: 终于到了。中尉，我们终于抵达了目的地。现在，是时候展现您作为刚果自由邦「公共力量」军官的价值了。

src: At least our enemies' initial plan had gone astray and they were far from Paris, but they still constituted a formidable threat. Now it was clear for both sides that the last hope for a quick victory lay in lauching a successful flanking maneuver in Artois or Flanders.
dst: 至少敌人的初步计划已经落空，他们已远离巴黎，但他们仍构成巨大的威胁。如今双方都明白，速胜的最后希望在于在阿图瓦或佛兰德斯发动一次成功的侧翼机动。

src: At least our enemies' initial plan had gone astray and they were far from Paris, but they still constituted a formidable threat. Now it was clear to both sides that the last hope for a quick victory lay in lauching a successful flanking maneuver in Artois or Flanders.
dst: 至少敌人的初步计划已经落空，他们已远离巴黎，但他们仍构成巨大的威胁。如今双方都明白，速胜的最后希望在于在阿图瓦或佛兰德斯发动一次成功的侧翼机动。

src: At least the Bolsheviks have taken many losses, so they won't pursue us. And in the north, since the Don Cossacks have risen against the Reds and the German Army is getting close to Rostov, the power of the communists has been severely weakened. They won't be able to bother us, so we'll rest for some weeks and start a new offensive as soon as we can.
dst: 至少布尔什维克已遭受了很大损失，所以他们不会追击我们。而在北方，由于顿河哥萨克人起而反抗红军，德军也在逼近罗斯托夫，共产党的力量已严重削弱。他们无法再来骚扰我们，所以我们将休整几周，然后尽快发起新的攻势。

src: At least the Germans broke the enemy line and are about to take Konstantia, but you haven't been able to offer them any real support. In the eyes of our allies we have become an unreliable army, capable of great deeds, but also of great failures. It's not all your fault, but you have a measure of responsability for it. You'd better ask for your transfer to a secondary front.
dst: 至少德军突破了敌军防线，即将攻占康斯坦察，而您却未能给他们提供任何真正的支援。在盟友眼中，我们已成了一支不可靠的军队——既能创造伟业，也会铸成大错。这不全是您的错，但您对此负有一定责任。您最好主动请求调往次要战线。

src: At least the battle wasn't a complete loss.
dst: 至少这场战斗没有彻底失败。

src: At least we've taken thousands of prisoners. The Italians won't dare to attack us for some time. For the first time in two years, the Empire is safe.
dst: 至少我们俘虏了数千人。意大利人一段时间内不敢再来进攻我们了。两年来，帝国第一次真正安全了。

src: At least, that’s what I hope. Maybe when the spring ends we’ll be able to be together again. Forever.
dst: 至少，这是我所希望的。也许春天结束时，我们就能再次相聚了。永远在一起。

src: At the Aisne: The first trenches
dst: At the Aisne: The first 战壕

src: At the Bald Eagle Forest a crisis is looming! North of the Juniata River the enemy has silently pulled together strong armored forces and attacks our weak northern flank. Our forces advancing on Lake Erie threaten to be cut off. Turn your forces immediately and catch the enemy attack! Prevent a disaster and don't let the enemy break through to the town of Blain! More forces were ordered to this scene and will arrive later.
dst: 秃鹰森林一带危机逼近！在朱尼亚塔河以北，敌人已悄悄集结起强大的装甲部队，攻击我们薄弱的北翼。我们正向伊利湖推进的部队有被切断的危险。立即调转你的部队，迎击敌人的进攻！防止一场灾难，绝不能让敌人突破到布莱恩镇！更多部队已奉命开赴这一战场，稍后抵达。

src: At the Teutates! The Etruscans joined us!
dst: 图塔蒂斯在上！伊特鲁里亚人加入我们了！

src: At the beginning of 1945 Romanian 1st Army received the mission of eliminating the German forces resisting in the Javorie mountains, Slovak Republic.
dst: 1945年初，罗马尼亚第1集团军受命消灭斯洛伐克共和国境内亚沃里耶山区顽抗的德军。

src: At the beginning of May 1945 a revolutionary wave ran through the Czech lands, similar to the one that ran through other European countries that were approached by the Allied armies. Yet the situation in Protectorate was a bit different due to the pre-war situation. There were very little weapons amongst the people, instead there were some one million German soldiers spread through the land. But once the fire was ignited, it couldn't be quenched easily. During the first days of May a nationwide uprising started. There's a one last mission before you. Liberate the Czech capital and finish your road from Buzuluk to Prague.
dst: 1945年5月初，一股革命浪潮席卷捷克大地，与盟军逼近的其他欧洲国家如出一辙。然而，由于战前的局势，保护国的情况略有不同。民间武器极少，取而代之的，是散布全国的约一百万德军士兵。但火一旦点燃，就难以扑灭。5月的头几天，全国性的起义爆发了。你面前还有最后一个任务。解放捷克首都，走完你从布祖鲁克到布拉格的征程。

src: At the beginning of November 1943, the brigade took a part in the Battle of Kiev...
dst: 1943年11月初，该旅参加了基辅战役……

src: At the beginning of November they had already routed us. We had lost nearly half of our men, most of our best equipment, and desertions were common. Petropavlovsk fell with little resistance, as well as Omsk, the capital of our government. The United Kingdom and all the other friendly countries were discreetly retiring their support, and were "recommending" us to accept our defeat and leave Russia forever.
dst: 到11月初，他们已将我们击溃。我们损失了近一半的兵力、大部分最好的装备，逃兵屡见不鲜。彼得罗巴甫洛夫斯克几乎没有抵抗就陷落了，我们政府的首都鄂木斯克亦然。英国和其他所有友好国家都在悄悄撤回对我们的支持，并「建议」我们接受失败、永远离开俄国。

src: At the end of 1914 British troops, mainly from the British Indian Army, were sent to occupy the city of Basra and protect the oil refineries. Due to the Ottoman offensives in the Caucasus and in the Sinai, Mesopotamia was poorly defended and the British could easily advance up the Tigris river with the goal of capturing Baghdad if possible.
dst: 1914年底，主要由英印军组成的英军部队被派去占领巴士拉城并保护炼油厂。由于奥斯曼在高加索和西奈的攻势，美索不达米亚防守薄弱，英军得以沿底格里斯河轻松推进，目标是如有可能则夺取巴格达。

src: At the end of October 1944 a narrow valley north of Slovak city Svidnik became a place of heavy fights that last for three days. This encounter was a part of Carpatho-Dukla operation; the dale became lately famous as a Valley of Death...
dst: 1944年10月底，斯洛伐克城市斯维德尼克以北的一条狭窄山谷爆发了持续三天的激战。这次交锋是喀尔巴阡-杜克拉行动的一部分；这条山谷后来以“死亡谷”闻名……

src: At the end of the 12th turn hold the required number of Victory Hexes to claim the corresponding victory.
dst: 在第12回合结束时守住所需数量的胜利格，以取得相应的胜利。

src: At the end of the 16th turn hold the required number of Victory Hexes to claim the corresponding victory.
dst: 第16回合结束时，守住所需数量的胜利点，以取得相应的胜利。

src: At the end of the GT 10  victory will be awarded according to the number of VHs you hold.
dst: 在第10回合结束时，将根据你占据的胜利点数量判定胜利。

src: At the end of the day, the British - with the exception of their left flank - had retreated to a second line of defense in an orderly fashion after having suffered about 1600 killed, wounded or missing -  practically half of these in 2 battalions of 8th Brigade. German casualties were three times higher and the Germans lost another day in their race to Paris.
dst: 当天结束时，英军——除左翼外——在遭受约1600人阵亡、负伤或失踪后，已有序撤退到第二道防线，其中几乎一半损失来自第8旅的两个营。德军伤亡是英军的三倍，德军在向巴黎的赛跑中又损失了一天。

src: At the end of the first day of fighting, our battalion was nearly wiped out in the intense fighting, Not even the mighty Tigers were able to breach open the enemy lines, and when our battalion commander was mortally wounded, we surrendered to the Soviets. Now a grim future awaits us.
dst: 首日战斗结束时，我们营在激战中几乎全军覆没。连强大的虎式也未能撕开敌阵，营长身负重伤之际，我们向苏军投降。如今等待我们的是黯淡的前途。

src: At the end of the first day of fighting, your battalion managed to halt the Soviet assault, launch a counterattack, and break through the enemy lines. After intense fighting, you widened the breach, created an evacuation corridor, and enabled not only your comrades but also thousands of civilians to escape the Soviets.
dst: 首日战斗结束时，你的营成功挡住苏军突击、发起反击并突破敌阵。经过激战，你扩大了缺口，开辟出一条撤离走廊，不仅让战友、也让成千上万平民得以逃脱苏军。

src: At the end of the first day of fighting, your battalion managed to halt the Soviet assault, launch a counterattack, and break through the enemy lines. After intense fighting, you widened the breach, created an evacuation corridor, and enabled your comrades to escape the Soviets.
dst: 首日战斗结束时，你的营成功挡住苏军突击、发起反击并突破敌阵。经过激战，你扩大了缺口，开辟出一条撤离走廊，让战友得以逃脱苏军。

src: At the end of the first day of fighting, your battalion was nearly wiped out in the intense fighting, Not even the mighty Tigers were able to breach open the enemy lines, and later that evening the few remaining men fell into Soviet captivity. Now a grim future awaits you.
dst: 首日战斗结束时，你的营在激战中几乎全军覆没。连强大的虎式也未能撕开敌阵，当晚仅存的少数人落入了苏军俘虏。如今等待你的是黯淡的前途。

src: At the end of the scenario own 9 VH for a Decsive Victory, or 8 VH for a Victory, or 6 VH for a Marginal Victory.
dst: 场景结束时占据9个胜利点为决定性胜利，8个胜利点为胜利，6个胜利点为险胜。

src: At the end of the scenario, holding 4 victory hexes gives you a brilliant victory. Hold 3 for victory and 2 for a tactical victory.
dst: 场景结束时，守住4个胜利格可得大捷。守住3个可得胜利，2个可得战术胜利。

src: At the end of the scenario, holding 5 victory hexes gives you a brilliant victory. Hold 4 for victory and 3 for a tactical victory.
dst: 在场景结束时，守住5个胜利点将让您获得大捷。守住4个为胜利，守住3个为小捷。

src: At the end of turn 7, hold 4 VH for BV, 2 or 3 for V and 1 for TV. Zero hexes will result in a loss.
dst: 第7回合结束时，守住4个胜利点得辉煌胜利，2至3个得胜利，1个得战术胜利。一个不占则告失败。

src: At the gates of Europe: Ufa
At the height of their power the Cilician pirates were no longer a simple group of buccaneers:
dst: 奇里乞亚海盗在其势力鼎盛时已不再是一伙简单的掠掠之徒：

src: At the last Battle we captured this Bottle Scotch-Whiskey... Prost, Herr General!
dst: 在上一场战斗中，我们缴获了这瓶苏格兰威士忌……干杯，将军先生！

src: At the moment, the British are under very serious pressure. Rommel is coming from the west and you are here in the east. They are desperately trying to embark their troops at Sollum and Bardia but it is not so easy because we have managed to persuade Mussolini to send us his battleships. The British are blocked in from several sides - now is the time to crush them!
dst: 眼下英军压力极大。隆美尔从西面而来，你在东面。他们正拼命在索卢姆和巴尔迪亚让部队登船，但谈何容易——我们已设法说服墨索里尼把战列舰派给我们。英军已被从多个方向堵住——现在正是击溃他们的时候！

src: At the moment, the Canal is only defended by some battalions of the Indian Army. You are ordered to build a capable defence force from the British and ANZAC troops that are undergoing training in the Nile Delta.
dst: 眼下，运河仅由印度陆军的一些营防守。您奉命从正在尼罗河三角洲受训的英军和澳新军团部队中组建一支有力的防御力量。
At the 山地 of Cer

src: At the outbreak of WW1, Australia and New
dst: 一战爆发时，澳大利亚和新西兰

src: At the same time he orders the troops to face about toward the enemy and form in line of battle, and, dispatching a few troops of cavalry as a guard for the baggage, he places the rest of the horse on the wings...
dst: 同时他下令部队转向敌人、列成战斗队形，并派出几队骑兵护卫辎重，把其余骑兵布置在两翼……

src: At the same time that our air force is attacking the airfields in Malta the marines must attack and take Gozo.
dst: 在我方空军空袭马耳他机场的同时，海军陆战队必须进攻并夺取戈佐岛。

src: At the same time the Allies are establishing a foothold near Salerno, German forces are trying to push the Allied invasion back out to sea.
dst: 当盟军在萨莱诺附近建立立足点时，德军正试图把盟军的入侵赶回海里。

src: At the same time these messages were received on the radio:
dst: 与此同时，电台收到了这些消息：

src: At the same time, you'll cross the Apennin and take Florenz. We think that the fighting will be tough. The region is being defended by the Italian 7th Army, a bunch of veterans who know that they're the last obstacles that you'll have to face before conquering central Italy. When Florenz falls, we'll control the main roads and railroads that lead to Rom, and Italy will be doomed. Our enemies know that, and they'll do everything they can in order to stop you. Be careful, General, and good luck!
dst: 与此同时，您将翻越亚平宁山脉并攻占佛罗伦萨。我们认为战斗将会十分艰苦。该地区由意大利第7集团军防守，这是一群老兵，他们深知在您征服意大利中部之前，他们将是您必须面对的最后一道障碍。一旦佛罗伦萨陷落，我们将控制通往罗马的主要公路和铁路，意大利就注定完蛋了。我们的敌人深知这一点，他们会不惜一切代价阻止您。小心行事，将军，祝您好运！

src: At this moment only a miracle could save our republics. The British outnumber us nearly four to one. Bloemfontein and Johannesburg have fallen, and six days ago so did Pretoria.
dst: 此刻只有奇迹才能拯救我们的共和国。英军兵力几乎是我们的四倍。布隆方丹和约翰内斯堡已经陷落，六天前比勒陀利亚也失守了。

src: At this moment our vanguard has met Breckinridge´s men so I must hurry into our forward line...
dst: 此刻我们的前卫部队已与布雷肯里奇的部队遭遇，所以我必须赶紧赶往前沿……

src: At this point, finding a problem caused by the Soviets would be a relief.
dst: 到了这一步，要是发现问题是苏联人搞出来的，反倒会让人松一口气。

src: At this stage of Operation Husky you should not try to capture the northeastern part of Sicily. We have to secure the western part of the island first.

src: Atencion!, los rojos han lanzado un ataque en direccion a Zaragoza!. Las guarniciones de todos los puestos colindantes tienen ordenes de resistir hasta que lleguen los refuerzos. Debe usted detener este ataque a toda costa, de otro modo Zaragoza puede caer y con ello se desestabilizaria toda la zona. Por el momento los republicanos han establecido una cabeza de puente en Belchite, y se acercan por el Noreste de la capital aragonesa con un par de divisiones que seguramente trataran de poner en peligro la capital desde el Norte.
dst: 注意！共和军已向萨拉戈萨方向发动进攻！所有相邻据点的守备部队都接到命令，要坚守到增援抵达。您必须不惜一切代价阻止这次进攻，否则萨拉戈萨就可能陷落，整个地区也将随之动荡。目前共和军已在贝尔奇特建立了一处桥头堡，并正以大约两个师从阿拉贡首府的东北方向逼近，他们多半会试图从北面威胁这座首府。

src: Atencion!, the red forces have launched another powerful strike, this time on to Zaragoza!. We must stop this attack at any costs!!!. The reds have damaged our lines Southwards to Zaragoza, along the Ebro river, and now our troops are desperately resisting at the village of Belchite. Belchite must not fall!, and the Republicans must not achieve the victory here, otherwise Zaragoza will be in a bad position to be defended...
dst: 注意！共和军又发动了一次强大的打击，这一次的目标是萨拉戈萨！我们必须不惜一切代价阻止这次进攻！！！共和军沿埃布罗河破坏了我们通往萨拉戈萨的南方防线，如今我军正在贝尔奇特村拼死抵抗。贝尔奇特绝不能陷落！绝不能让共和军在此取胜，否则萨拉戈萨将陷于难以防守的境地……

src: Athen is being defended by half of the Greek Army. They've also managed to fortify the city, and they'll count with the help of a couple of French divisions that have avoided encirclement. Even more important, the Royal Navy will give support to the defenders of Athen. We've sent you some submarines and torpedo bombers from the Pola flotilla, so you won't be helpless against them, but remember to be careful anyway.

src: Attacked fom no less than four different points at the same time, the Soviets finally retreated from Moscow. Victory was ours! Sadly, we didn't have been able to encircle the city completely, so many enemies escaped to the northwest. The Directory ordered us to pursue them and destroy them before they could reach Petrograd.
dst: 苏维埃同时遭到不少于四个方向的进攻，最终从莫斯科撤退。胜利属于我们！遗憾的是，我们没能彻底合围这座城市，因此许多敌人逃向了西北。督政府命令我们追击他们，务必在他们抵达彼得格勒之前将其消灭。

src: Attacking armies had great losses and were unable to breach German firm defense. On 22nd April 1945 Opava was captured and this helped to develop the forces. Final assault of Ostrava started just a few days later.

src: Attrition. That's the ultimate goal of our new operation. We can't break through the Entente lines, nor can we defend ourselves forever. So we'll set a trap for the French Army. We'll launch an offensive against Verdun and its ring of forts. Naturally, taking the town would be very important, but what the OHL really wants is forcing the French to counterattack in order to retake the lost terrain. Then we'll be able to annihilate them with our artillery fire, standing on safe positions.
dst: 消耗。这就是我们这次新行动的终极目标。我们既无法突破协约国的战线，也无法永远自守。所以我们要给法军设下陷阱。我们将对凡尔登及其环城要塞群发动攻势。当然，夺取这座城市非常重要，但最高陆军指挥部真正想要的，是迫使法军为了夺回失地而发动反攻。到那时，我们就能安然据守阵地，用炮火将他们歼灭。

src: Aware of this, Napoleon III and Marshall MacMahon raised the new Army of Châlons in order to march towards Metz and rescue Bazaine. With Napoleon III personally leading it, the Emperor and MacMahon guided the Army of Châlons to the northeast. The plan was to surprise the Germans, sneak behind their right flank, near the frontier with Belgium, and then turn to the south and liberate Metz.
dst: 意识到这一点，拿破仑三世和麦克马洪元帅组建了新的沙隆军团，以便向梅斯进军并解救巴赞。在拿破仑三世亲自率领下，皇帝与麦克马洪率领沙隆军团向东北方向进发。计划是突袭德军，绕过他们的右翼，在靠近比利时边境处包抄到其后方，然后转而向南，解梅斯之围。

src: Axdir is ours! Our glorious army controls the territory of the Beni Urriaguel "kabila". Abd el-Krim and some of his men escaped at the last minute, but it doesn't matter. We have won this war, after so many years!
dst: 阿克迪尔是我们的了！我们光荣的军队控制了贝尼乌里亚格勒「卡比拉」部落的领地。阿卜杜勒·克里姆和他的一些手下在最后一刻逃脱了，但那已无关紧要。经过了这么多年，我们终于赢得了这场战争！

src: Axis forces are closing in on Nikolaev, with German infantry divisions west of the Southern Bug river, the Italian auto-transportable division Pasubio and Hungarian motorized brigades in the north and the German 16. Panzer-Division in the northeast.
dst: 轴心国军队正在逼近尼古拉耶夫，德国步兵师位于南布格河以西，意大利可自动运输师Pasubio和匈牙利摩托化旅在北面，德国第16装甲师在东北面。

src: Axis forces could only capture the eastern part of the city at the end of July 14. When Voronezh was occupied, the 4th Panzer Army moved down the Western bank of the Don towards Stalingrad as part of Fall Blau. The Soviets lost the battle, but detained for 4-5 days offensive of German troops to Stalingrad.
dst: 轴心国军队在7月14日结束时只夺取了城市的东部。沃罗涅日失守后，第4装甲集团军作为「蓝色」行动的一部分，沿顿河西岸南下扑向斯大林格勒。苏军输掉了这一战，却将德军向斯大林格勒的攻势迟滞了四到五天。

src: Axis forces have retreated into Northern Tunisia and US II Corps has been shifted to the far North of the Allied line. The role of II Corps in the final campaign to kick the Axis out of Northern Africa is to capture Mateur and Bizerte.
dst: 轴心国军队已退入突尼斯北部，美军第2军被调往盟军战线最北端。在这场将轴心国逐出北非的收官之战中，第2军的任务是夺取马特尔与比塞大。

src: Battle of Dukla Pass went on for several weeks and it was the most cruel battle of the 1st Czechoslovak Army Corps since its very beginning. On the 9th September 1944 a miscommunication and poor reconnaisance lead the 1st and 3rd brigades right into the enemy positions. src: Battle of Dukla wasn't the only operation in which the 1st Czechoslovak Army Corps took part. Battle of the Kerch Peninsula (German: Unternehmen Trappenjagd) was a World War II offensive by German and Romanian armies against the Soviet Crimean Front forces defending the Kerch Peninsula, in the eastern part of the Crimea. It was launched on May 8, 1942 and concluded around May 18, 1942 with the near complete destruction of the Soviet defending forces. The Red Army lost over 170,000 men killed [1] or taken prisoner, and three armies (44th, 47th, and 51st) with twenty-one divisions.[2] The operation was one of the battles immediately preceding the German summer offensive (Operation Blau), and its successful conclusion made it possible for the Axis to launch a successful assault on Sevastopol in the following months.
dst: 刻赤半岛战役（德文：Unternehmen Trappenjagd）是二战中德、罗军队对守卫刻赤半岛（克里米亚东部）的苏军克里米亚方面军发起的攻势。行动于1942年5月8日展开，至5月18日前后以苏军守军近乎全军覆没而告终。红军阵亡[1]或被俘逾170,000人，并损失第44、第47、第51集团军及二十一个师[2]。此役是德军夏季攻势（“蓝色”行动）前夕的战斗之一，其成功使轴心国得以在随后数月对塞瓦斯托波尔发起有效进攻。

src: Because of SS Armor units chewing up the Soviet armor Joseph Stalin had shifted His production more towards the Air and AA,especially Fighters.The SS/BdM was now in a Fight for their Lives.The Soviets though maimed and bruised were not down for the Final Count in the Skies west or north of Moscow.Soviet Pilots who had escaped after being shot down many times now were as experienced as the SS.Though the Female Pilots of the Air Korps had incredible kill numbers the Soviets with still their number advantage were starting to make the Air War a contest in every area except one.That was when the Soviets tangled with Junker's Frau-Z.The Frau-Z was a cut above.It could outrun the Soviets if it had to by using a Special additive ( Blitztrycessaran) increasing the Horsepower for a short time and the 'Musik' guns which pointed up tricked many a inexperienced Soviet Pilot who had no ideal they could level off and fire to the rear.Every third shell firing from the 20mm Auto-cannons also had the effect of a Shot-gun shell which played havoc with the Enemies planes also exploding too soon at times bringing down a few Frau-Z's by blowing off the Tail.Defensively the Junkers Warbird had redundant fuel and contol systems.And of course the best Frau Pilots flew the Frau-Z.So with Moscow soon to be under the Gun Stalin was playing His Cards that He hoped could 'Trump the Frau-Z's, Numbers.On the Ground He had failed,could He Win in the Air.
dst: 由于党卫军装甲部队不断碾碎苏军装甲，约瑟夫·斯大林把生产更多转向空军和防空，尤其是战斗机。党卫军/BdM 如今已是在为活命而战。苏联人虽然伤痕累累，却还没有在莫斯科以西或以北的天空中认下最后一局。那些多次被击落后逃生的苏联飞行员，如今经验已不输党卫军。尽管航空军的女性飞行员战绩惊人，但苏联人凭借数量优势，正让空战在除一处之外的所有领域都变成势均力敌的较量。那一处，就是苏联人撞上容克公司的“Frau-Z”的时候。“Frau-Z”高出一筹。必要时它能靠一种特殊添加剂（Blitztrycessaran）短暂提升马力，甩开苏联人；而朝上安装的“音乐”机炮，骗过了许多没经验的苏联飞行员——他们根本没想到对方可以改平后朝后射击。20毫米机炮每三发中就有一发具有霰弹效果，把敌机打得千疮百孔，但有时也会过早爆炸，炸掉几架“Frau-Z”的尾翼。防御方面，容克的这款战机有冗余的燃料和操纵系统。当然，最优秀的“女士”飞行员都飞“Frau-Z”。因此，莫斯科即将遭受攻击，斯大林正打出他希望用来“压过‘Frau-Z’”的那张牌——数量。在地面上他失败了，在空中他能赢吗？

src: Before heading south and taking Madrid it is imperative that we control the communications between Santander and Bilbao. All republican attempts to break our siege, by land and sea, came from the Montaña. If we go south without caution the enemy might try again, attacking our rear and breaking our lines of supply.Our army would be in the middle of Castilla isolated, doomed to failure!
dst: 在挥师南下攻取马德里之前，我们必须控制桑坦德与毕尔巴鄂之间的交通线。共和派解围的一切企图，无论从陆上还是海上，都来自蒙塔尼亚。倘若我们贸然南下，敌人或许会再次尝试，攻击我们的后方、切断我们的补给线。我军将孤悬于卡斯蒂利亚腹地，注定败亡！

The High Command has decided that you, along with some German and Bulgarian troops, will lead the attack on the Western sector, from Rasova to Kobadin.
