src: Before the autumn rains set in, the South-Western Front must deploy for a second push toward Kowel.  Our Front is receiving additional resources from Stavka, and Brusilov is forming the Osobaya (Special) Army for this push.
dst: 在秋雨来临之前，西南方面军必须为向科韦利发起第二次突击而展开部署。我们的方面军正从大本营获得额外资源，布鲁西洛夫正在为此组建特别集团军。

src: Before the end of 1915 the United Kingdom and our allies had decided to launch a series of coordinated offensives against Germany in 1916. However, our enemies attacked first at Verdun, in February, and all our strategy had to be redesigned. Our offensive would take place at the River Somme, as initially planned, but with little support from the French, who had been forced to send reinforcements to the Verdun front.
dst: 1915年结束之前，联合王国及其盟友已决定在1916年对德国发动一系列协调一致的攻势。然而，我们的敌人于2月先在凡尔登发动了进攻，我们所有的战略都不得不重新设计。我们的攻势将按原计划在索姆河进行，但得到的法军支援寥寥无几，因为法军被迫向凡尔登前线派出了增援。

src: Before the end of May, we had crushed the Soviet counterattack and we had a new chance to reach the Volga. But then we learnt thar our enemies were regrouping near Chistopol, on the left shore of the Kama. If the communists consolidated that position our chances to recover Kazan would be gone. Since we had already dealt with a similar situation in Belebei, Kolchak sent us to liberate Chistopol.
dst: 5月底之前，我们粉碎了苏维埃的反攻，重新获得了抵达伏尔加河的机会。但随后我们得知，敌人正在卡马河左岸的奇斯托波尔附近重新集结。如果共产党人巩固了那个阵地，我们收复喀山的机会就会化为乌有。由于我们已在别列别伊处理过类似局面，高尔察克派我们去解放奇斯托波尔。

src: Before the war started, we all knew that our army needed some important reforms, better funding, modern equipment and proper training and leadership, but nobody could foresee this disaster. We thought that what we had was enough to beat Serbia and, at the very least, to hold the Russians for some months.
dst: 战争开始前，我们所有人都知道，我们的军队需要一些重要的改革、更好的经费、现代化的装备以及适当的训练和指挥，但没有人能预见到这场灾难。我们原以为，我们所拥有的一切足以击败塞尔维亚，至少也能挡住俄国人几个月。

src: Before the war the area of the village of Wizna was prepared as a fortified line of defence. It was to shield the Polish positions further to the south and guard the crossing of Narew and Biebrza rivers.The spot was chosen carefully: most of the concrete bunkers were built on hills overlooking a swampy Narew River valley.On September 8 Guderian was ordered to advance through Wizna towards Brest.Early the next morning his units reached the Wizna area and were joined with 10th Panzer Division already present in the area. His forces numbered some 1200 officers and 41000 soldiers and NCOs, equipped with over 350 tanks,108 howitzers,58 artillery pieces,195 anti-tank guns,108 mortars,188 grenade launchers,288 heavy machine guns and 689 machine guns. Altogether, his forces were some 60 times stronger than the Polish defenders, initially the losses among German infantry were high,several assaults were repelled during the night and in the early morning of September 10.German engineers with the help of tanks and artillery finally managed to destroy all but two Polish bunkers which continued to resist.It is alleged Guderian, in an attempt to end the Polish resistance, threatened the Polish commander that he would shoot the POWs if the remaining forces did not surrender and for this the Poles wanted him tried for War Crimes in 1945, however it was concluded this was a bluff and no prisoners were shot.
dst: 战前，维兹纳村一带被构筑成一条筑垒防线，用以掩护更南面的波军阵地，并守卫纳雷夫河与别布扎河的渡口。地点是精心选定的：大部分混凝土碉堡建在俯瞰纳雷夫河沼泽谷地的山丘上。9月8日，古德里安奉命经维兹纳向布列斯特推进。次日清晨，他的部队抵达维兹纳地区，与已在该地区的第10装甲师会合。他的部队约有1200名军官和41000名士兵及军士，装备350多辆坦克、108门榴弹炮、58门火炮、195门反坦克炮、108门迫击炮、188具掷弹筒、288挺重机枪和689挺机枪。总体而言，他的兵力约为波兰守军的60倍。起初德军步兵伤亡惨重，数次冲击在夜间及9月10日清晨被击退。德军工兵在坦克和炮兵的协助下，最终摧毁了除两座仍在抵抗的波兰碉堡之外的所有碉堡。据称古德里安为结束波兰人的抵抗，曾威胁波军指挥官，若残余部队不投降就枪杀战俘；为此波兰人曾在1945年要求以战争罪审判他，但最终认定这不过是虚张声势，没有战俘被枪杀。

src: Before we advance on Sicily we still need to take these small Italian Islands in the Mediterranean Sea. Your orders are to conquer the island of Lampedusa and fight down its little garrison.
dst: 在我们向西西里推进之前，我们仍需夺取地中海上这些意大利小岛。你的命令是征服兰佩杜萨岛并击溃其微弱的守军。

src: Before we can invade the Soviet Union we must secure our southern flank - Yugoslavia and Greece.  Your brigade will advance from Kustendil in Bulgaria towards the city of Skopje, you will be supported by the 9th Panzer Division.  Enemy strength is estimated as at least two divisions in the area.
dst: 在入侵苏联之前，我们必须确保南翼——南斯拉夫和希腊。你的旅将从保加利亚的丘斯滕迪尔向斯科普里城推进，第9装甲师将支援你。估计该地区敌军至少有两个师的兵力。

src: Before we invade Great Britain we need to get air superiority. To weaken the allies you have to destroy 15 enemy fighters and/or important facilities such as fuel depots, factories and radar stations. Take care, the RAF gets help from experienced polish pilots!
dst: 在入侵大不列颠之前，我们需要夺取制空权。为削弱盟军，你必须摧毁15架敌战斗机，和/或燃料库、工厂、雷达站等重要设施。当心，皇家空军得到了经验丰富的波兰飞行员的助战！
贝格里亚库姆的警备队

src: Behind us, on the battlefield, lay the bodies of nearly 10,000 enemies. They were the fortunate ones. A similar number of wounded Dervishes remained there, too. Most of them were left to die on the sand.
dst: 在我们身后的战场上，横陈着近万名敌人的尸体。他们是幸运的。同样数量的德尔维希伤兵也留在了那里。他们中的大多数人被留在沙地上等死。

src: Being unable to resist US superior force (a heavily armed vessel and several transports loaded with troops), the Spanish Governor of Guam surrendered the island.
dst: 由于无力抵抗占绝对优势的美军（一艘重武装军舰和数艘满载部队的运输船），关岛的西班牙总督投降了该岛。
别列耶夫卡 (别利亚耶夫卡)
凯撒将军的比利时战役
比利时与荷兰已败下阵来。
别尔戈涅特 斯纳亚
别利亚耶夫斯基佩尔维
本博/第1海军旅/皇家海军师
柏柏尔炮兵 (operated by European mercenaries)
柏柏尔炮兵 (operated by european mercenaries)
贝尔德丘夫(别尔季切夫)

src: Beriev is especially known for its seaplanes. Once Taganrog is in our hands, the door to Rostov will be wide open.
dst: 别里耶夫尤以水上飞机闻名。一旦塔甘罗格落入我们手中，通往罗斯托夫的大门就将完全敞开。

src: Berlin is captured by our troops. Now we want to destroy the remaining German armies in Czechia and in Slovakia and free Prague. You have to broke through the German lines at Nagysallo and move north.
dst: 柏林已被我军攻占。现在我们想歼灭捷克与斯洛伐克境内残存的德军集团军，并解放布拉格。你必须在纳吉萨洛突破德军防线，然后向北推进。

src: Berlin, Three Volkssturm soldiers with anti-tank weapons stand guard during the construction of a roadblock at a railway underpass on 10 March 1945.
dst: 柏林，1945年3月10日，三名国民突击队士兵手持反坦克武器，在一处铁路地下通道旁的路障施工中站岗警戒。

src: Besides in the front of Ladysmith, and after three failed attempts, General Buller finally managed to defeat our troops, commanded by General Botha, and a few days ago he lifted the siege of the town. Soon the British will launch new attacks, and I'm afraid that we won't have the strength to repel their invasion.
dst: 此外在莱迪史密斯前线，经过三次失败后，布勒将军终于击败了由博塔将军指挥的我军，并在几天前解了该城之围。英军很快会发动新的进攻，我担心我们将无力击退他们的入侵。

src: Besides your tank army a little army will support you. This troops could be useful for the conquer of Emden.
dst: 除你的坦克集团军外，一支小规模部队也将支援你。这支部队对攻克埃姆登可能有用。

src: Besides your tank army one army will support your attack. They are deployed west of your troops.
dst: 除你的坦克集团军之外，还将有一个集团军支援你的进攻。他们部署在你部队的西面。

src: Besides your tank army several divisions will support your troops. Relating to your request we have given you more Flak units for this battle.
dst: 除你的坦克集团军外，还有数个师将支援你的部队。针对你的请求，我们为这场战斗给你增派了更多高射炮单位。

src: Besides, a quick victory over the Serbians will have a positive strategical effect. Although Greece is, theoretically, a neutral country, there are already thousands of British and French troops there, who use Greece as a safe base for their operations in Gallipolli and the Balkans. The Greek goverment can't, or doesn't want to, do nothing against them.
dst: 此外，迅速战胜塞尔维亚人将产生积极的战略影响。虽然希腊理论上是个中立国，但那里已有数千名英法军队，他们把希腊当作在加里波利和巴尔干作战的安全基地。希腊政府无力、或不愿对他们采取任何行动。

src: Besides, glory may have followed you to Colesberg. This is a small town, but with a great strategic importance. It's located on the main road from Kaapstad to Johannesburg, so now that the Rooineks have decided to invade our land, all their main supply lines will cross this area. If you manage to disrupt them, sending reinforcements to Roberts will be very difficult for our enemies.
dst: 此外，荣耀也许一直跟随着您来到了科尔斯堡。这是一座小城，却具有重大的战略意义。它位于从开普敦通往约翰内斯堡的主干道上，所以既然英国佬已决定入侵我们的土地，他们所有的主要补给线都将经过这一地区。如果您能切断它们，敌人向罗伯茨输送增援就会变得非常困难。

src: Besides, he decided that we'd make the main attack, from the northeast, at the confluence of the Salmysh and Sakmara rivers. The cossacks would support us from the east and southeast, but our staff believed that sending the cossack light cavalry against the Soviet trenches and machine gun nests was suicidal. Thus, the responsibility for taking Orenburg would be ours.
dst: 此外，他决定由我们从东北方向、在萨尔梅什河与萨克马拉河交汇处发起主攻。哥萨克将从东面和东南面支援我们，但我们的参谋认为，派哥萨克轻骑兵去冲击苏维埃的战壕和机枪火力点是自杀行为。因此，攻取奥伦堡的重任就落在了我们肩上。

src: Besides, in the south, the cossacks, outnumbered, without adequate equipment, and isolated from the rest of our army, hadn't been able to take Orenburg. From that stronghold the Soviets now threatened our left flank. Unable to advance, we realized that our enemies would counterattack very soon. We knew that we'd have to resist, or we'd be forced to retreat to Siberia, this time permanently.
dst: 此外，在南方，哥萨克人兵力处于劣势、缺乏足够的装备，又与我军其余部队隔绝，因而没能拿下奥伦堡。苏军现在正是从这个据点威胁着我们的左翼。由于无法推进，我们意识到敌人很快就会反攻。我们知道必须顶住，否则就将被迫退往西伯利亚，而这一次将是永久性的撤退。

src: Besides, in the south, the cossacks, outnumbered, without adequate equipment, and isolated from the rest of our army, hadn't been able to take Orenburg. From that stronghold the Soviets now threatened our left flank. Unable to advance, we relized that our enemies would counterattack very soon. We knew that we'd have to resist, or we'd be forced to retreat to Siberia, this time permanently.
dst: 此外，在南方，哥萨克兵力处于劣势、缺乏足够的装备，又与主力隔绝，未能攻下奥伦堡。如今苏维埃从这个据点威胁着我们的左翼。无法推进的我们意识到，敌人很快就会反攻。我们知道必须顶住，否则就不得不撤退到西伯利亚，而这一次将是永久性的。

src: Besides, on December 10th the constituents of the North German Confederation agreed to become a German Empire, giving the title of German Emperor to Wilhelm I, the Kaiser of Prussia. Naturally, the priority of the new emperor was winning the war at all costs.
dst: 此外，12月10日，北德意志邦联的成员同意组成一个德意志帝国，把德意志皇帝的称号授予普鲁士国王威廉一世。理所当然地，新皇帝的当务之急是不惜一切代价打赢这场战争。

src: Besides, since the Tewahedo Church and much of the aristocracy disliked Iyasu's policies, we deposed him on 27 September 1916 in favour of his aunt, Empress Zauditu, Menelik's eldest daughter. We had the cooperation from the British ambassador, and it seemed that our neutrality was assured.
dst: 此外，由于特瓦赫多教会和大部分贵族都反感伊雅苏的政策，我们于1916年9月27日废黜了他，改立他的姑母、孟尼利克的长女佐迪图女皇。我们得到了英国大使的配合，看起来我们的中立已有了保障。

src: Besides, the League of Nations let us know that they wouldn't tolerate any Russian action against the sovereignty of Finland, Poland or the Baltic republics. We had no choice but to accept those demands.
dst: 此外，国际联盟让我们知道，他们不会容忍俄国对芬兰、波兰或波罗的海各共和国的主权采取任何行动。我们别无选择，只能接受这些要求。

src: Besides, the truth is that I've spoken with Jean-Pierre, and he doesn't want any special treatment just because he's my grandon, so he went to our first line. I can understand it: In these times we all must do our duty. Ils ne passeront pas!
dst: 再说，事实是我已经和让-皮埃尔谈过，他不愿仅仅因为是我的外孙就受到特殊照顾，所以他去了我们的一线。我能理解：在这种时候，我们所有人都必须履行自己的职责。他们绝不能通过！

src: Besides, they have ordered back their most experienced legions from all parts of their empire...
dst: 此外，他们还从帝国各处召回了最有经验的军团...

src: Besides, this battle has made France realise how serious Abd el-Krim's menace really is, so from now on the French will cooperate with us even closer. They will expand the counteroffensive at the Ouergha Valley in order to destroy the Berber strongholds at the mountains, and they will give logistical support to our most ambitious operation: A disembark at Alhucemas Bay, the very heart of the Berber lands.
dst: 此外，这场战斗让法国认识到阿卜杜勒·克里姆的威胁究竟有多严重，所以从现在起，法国人将与我们更紧密地合作。他们将扩大韦尔加河谷的反攻，以摧毁柏柏尔人在山区的据点，并将为我们最雄心勃勃的行动提供后勤支援：在柏柏尔人腹地的胡塞马湾实施登陆。

src: Besides, we knew that among the best Soviet units there were some foreign fighters, especially Serbians, that were discontent with their communist masters and would rebel against them if they had the chance. Not all the non-Russians would do the same. Most of the Latvians, the Tatars and the Hungarians seemed to be loyal to the Bolsheviks, and they were all veteran soldiers. We knew that the battle would be tough, but we were confident after our past victories in Samara and Simbirsk.
dst: 此外，我们知道，在苏俄精锐部队中有一些外国战士，尤其是塞尔维亚人，他们对共产主义主子心怀不满，一有机会就会起义反对他们。并非所有非俄罗斯人都会这么做。大多数拉脱维亚人、鞑靼人和匈牙利人似乎都忠于布尔什维克，而且他们都是久经沙场的老兵。我们知道这场战斗会很艰苦，但有了先前在萨马拉和辛比尔斯克的胜利，我们充满信心。

src: Better late than never....  You've pushed the Hun over to the other side of the Mass river and given vital flank protection to our Canadian brethren.  Montgomery has granted your unit some much needed rest as a show of appreciation.  Your men will have the chance to enjoy Christmas away from the front!
dst: 迟到总比不到好……你已把德国佬赶到马斯河对岸，为我们加拿大兄弟提供了至关重要的侧翼掩护。蒙哥马利已准你的部队急需的休整，以表嘉许。你的部下将有机会在远离前线的地方过圣诞节！

src: Better luck in your next mission........Major, enjoy Russia.
dst: 祝你的下一个任务好运……少校，去享受俄国吧。

src: Better luck next time, Herr Leutnant. As a new battalion commander, you'll really need it.
dst: 祝下次好运，少尉阁下。作为新营长，你确实需要它。

src: Better luck to you in the future, yet take my thanks for victory.
dst: 祝你未来好运，不过请接受我对胜利的感谢。

src: Better to burn out: The Tobol offensive (II)
dst: Better to burn out: The Tobol 攻势 (II)

src: Between 1848 and 1852 there was a war between Denmark and the German states that supported the claims of the Germans who lived under the rule of the personal union. In the end the Danes managed to keep the integrity of the Danish federation, and the duchies remained as independent entities. However, the peace didn't last long. Frederik VII died in 1863, just when the Danish government was working on a new constitution for Denmark and Schleswig, that would create a joint parliament to govern the common affairs of both territories. Christian IX of Glücksburg, the new king, signed the constitution on November 18.
dst: 1848年至1852年间，丹麦与支持君合国统治下德意志人诉求的德意志各邦之间爆发了一场战争。最终丹麦人得以保住丹麦联邦的完整，各公国仍保持独立实体地位。然而，和平没有维持多久。弗雷德里克七世于1863年去世，恰逢丹麦政府正在为丹麦和石勒苏益格制定一部新宪法，该宪法将设立一个联合议会来管理两地共同事务。新国王格吕克斯堡的克里斯蒂安九世于11月18日签署了这部宪法。

src: Between May and July, the French and British slowly advanced up the peninsula while the ANZACs clung to their small perimeter. In August, another ambitious offensive was planned by the Allies. The assault would be conducted in three parts. The first involved two columns from ANZAC Cove making their way through a relatively undefended route to attack the key position, Chunuk Bair, in the Sari Bair mountains. The second involved the 1st Australian Division attacking the supposedly impregnable Lone Pine position and the third would be the amphibious operation with IX Corps, under General Stopford, at Suvla Bay.
dst: 5月至7月间，法军和英军沿半岛缓慢推进，而澳新军团则固守着自己狭小的防御圈。8月，协约国又筹划了一次雄心勃勃的攻势。此次进攻将分三部分进行。第一部分是两支纵队从澳新军团湾出发，沿一条相对无人防守的路线前进，去进攻萨里拜尔山脉中的关键阵地楚努克拜尔。第二部分是澳大利亚第1师进攻被认为坚不可摧的独松阵地，第三部分则是由斯托普福德将军指挥的第9军在苏夫拉湾进行两栖登陆。

src: Between the German pressure and the extremely cold weather, the Army of the Loire was forced to retreat, although it had had the victory at hand. Most of the survivors went to the east and tried to lift the siege of Belfort, but two French Army Corps escaped to Le Mans, in the west. The Prussians soon chased them.
dst: 在德军的压力与极寒天气的双重作用下，卢瓦尔军团被迫撤退，尽管胜利一度近在咫尺。大部分幸存者向东而去，试图解除贝尔福之围，但有两个法军军逃往了西面的勒芒。普鲁士人很快便追击而去。
缴获装甲连/基尔战斗群

src: Beware of the man with the laurel wreath ....!
dst: 当心那个戴着月桂花冠的人 ....!

src: Beware: If the enemy takes Dar Accoba on the 7 first turns, you will lose.
dst: 注意：如果敌人在前7回合内夺取达尔阿科巴，您就会失败。
别兹博罗德科韦 (亚历山德罗夫卡)

src: Bialostocki pulk/ I Bryg./ 1st Dyw. Litewsko-Bialoruska
dst: Bialostocki 团/ 第1旅/ 第1师 Litewsko-Bialoruska

src: Bien comandante, le pondre al corriente de la situacion presente; 4 meses despues del golpe de Julio la situacion es caotica, algunos sectores de la Peninsula y la totalidad del protectorado de Marruecos se han unido a la sublevacion. Columnas rebeldes provenientes del Norte y el Sur han alcanzado Madrid. Mientras que las columnas del general Mola se han visto detenidas en las sierras del Norte de la capital, el ejercito de Africa al mando del general Franco ha alcanzado los barrios del Sur y del Oeste de la ciudad y constituye una gravisima amenaza, no deben cruzar el rio Manzanares!. Ademas se teme que elementos quintacolumnistas aparezcan dentro de la ciudad segun se vayan acercando las columnas rebeldes.
dst: 好的，指挥官，我来向您介绍一下当前形势：七月政变四个月后，局势一片混乱，半岛的一些地区和整个摩洛哥保护地都加入了叛乱。来自北部和南部的叛军纵队已经抵达马德里。莫拉将军的纵队在首都以北的山脉中被挡住，而佛朗哥将军指挥的非洲军已抵达该城的南部和西部街区，构成极其严重的威胁，他们绝不能渡过曼萨纳雷斯河！此外，人们担心随着叛军纵队逼近，城内会出现第五纵队分子。

src: Bien hecho!!. Los italianos han conseguido expulsar de la zona a los republicanos, sin embargo debemos volver nuestra atencion a asuntos mas importantes...
dst: 干得好！！意大利人成功把共和军逐出了这一地区，不过我们必须把注意力转回更重要的事务上……

src: Bien, despues de la liberacion del Alcazar su mision es basicamente abrir el camino hacia Madrid desde la zona de Toledo. Esto nos permitiria continuar facilmente hacia la capital. Las fuerzas enemigas, se componen de milicianos que escaparon de Toledo y puede que tambien algunos refuerzos que les envien desde Madrid.
dst: 好，在解放托莱多城堡之后，您的任务基本上是从托莱多地区打通通往马德里的道路。这将使我们能够轻易地向首都继续推进。敌军由从托莱多逃出的民兵组成，可能还包括马德里派来的一些增援。

src: Bienvenido al Frente Norte!, nuestras operaciones aqui en Euzkadi, siguen marchando bien para nosotros. Sin embargo esperamos una dura resistencia en la capital, Bilbao, en torno a la cual los vascos han construido una cadena de defensas estaticas denominadas ''Cinturon de Hierro''. Afortunadamente el ingeniero que ideo las fortificaciones se ha pasado a nuestro bando, suministrandonos informacion extremadamente importante a cerca de las defensas enemigas.
dst: 欢迎来到北方战线！我们在巴斯克的行动依然进展顺利。不过，我们预计在首府毕尔巴鄂会遭遇顽强抵抗，巴斯克人在那里周边修建了一连串被称作「铁环防线」的静态防御工事。所幸设计了这些工事的那名工程师已投奔我方，向我们提供了关于敌军防御的极为重要的情报。

src: Bienvenido al Frente Norte!. Our operations here, in Euzkadi are marching good for us. However, we expect a harder resistance in the capital, Bilbao, where the enemy have build up defensive fortificacions, called ''Cinturon de Hierro''. Fortunately, the Republican engineer who designed the defensive line has reciently joined our side, and he has provided us with extremely useful information about the line. The Cinturon de Hierro is not still finished in it's left shore, however it has a couple of good artillery positions. The Legion Condor have intensively bombed the Republican defensive line, making the things a bit easier for you.
dst: 欢迎来到北方战线！我们在巴斯克的行动进展顺利。不过，我们预计在首府毕尔巴鄂会遭遇更顽强的抵抗，敌军在那里修筑了被称为「铁环防线」的防御工事。所幸设计了这条防线的共和军工程师最近已投奔我方，并向我们提供了关于这条防线极为有用的情报。铁环防线在其左岸仍未完工，不过它有几处不错的炮兵阵地。秃鹰军团已对共和军防线进行了猛烈轰炸，使您的任务稍微轻松了一些。

src: Bienvenido al frente de Aragon, general. Los objetivos alcanzados en el sector de Brunete no correspondieron finalmente con nuestras aspiraciones, pero la ofensiva franquista sobre el Frente Norte se ha visto afectada.
dst: 欢迎来到阿拉贡战线，将军。布鲁内特地段所取得的战果最终未能达到我们的期望，但佛朗哥军队对北方战线的攻势已受到影响。

src: Bilbao ha caido!, el gobierno vasco esta completamente derrotado y ahora gran parte de las industrias de guerra en Vascongadas estan en nuestras manos, excelente trabajo.
dst: 毕尔巴鄂陷落了！巴斯克政府已被彻底击败，如今巴斯克地区的很大一部分军工产业已落入我方之手，干得漂亮。

src: Bilbao has fallen!, the basque goverment is defeated, and now a good part of the main Republican industries are in our hands. Excellent work.
dst: 毕尔巴鄂陷落了！巴斯克政府已被击败，如今共和国主要军工产业的很大一部分已落入我方之手。干得漂亮。

src: Brave soldiers under my command!  The so-called ''united front'' with the Kuomingtan is over.  Today we will join the revolution against the ancient oppressors of the Chinese people and against the likes of Chiang-Kai-Shek.  Some of our comrades in other army units will also join us in our glorious uprising against the enemies of the people.  They are just now coming here to help us in the assault on the old city of Nanchang!  The end of the oppression, the capitalism, and the humiliations begins here on the West bank of the Gan River!  We are surrounded by the local warlords KMT troops, but our comrades will attack them from different directions, and the victory will be ours!
dst: 我指挥下的英勇士兵们！与国民党的所谓"统一战线"已经结束。今天我们投身革命，反抗压迫中国人民的古老压迫者，反抗蒋介石之流。我们在其他部队的一些同志也将加入我们这场反抗人民之敌的光荣起义。他们此刻正赶来协助我们攻打南昌老城！压迫、资本主义与屈辱的终结，就从赣江西岸开始！我们被地方军阀的国民党军队包围，但我们的同志将从不同方向进攻他们，胜利必将属于我们！

src: Bravo Herr General, the Poles are routed and a demarkation line has been established between Germany and Russia. Take time now to repair and refit your division which I'm sure is battered after your astounding drive across Poland.
dst: 干得漂亮，将军阁下，波兰人已被击溃，德俄之间已划定分界线。现在花点时间修理和整备你的师吧——我相信它在横贯波兰的惊人奔袭之后已伤痕累累。

src: Bravo to you and your men!
Bravo!  Mussilini's confidence in you has resulted in your assignment to lead our forces in the great Axis attack on communist Russia!
dst: 好样的！墨索里尼对你的信任，使你得任指挥我军参加轴心国对共产主义俄国的大进攻！

src: Bravo, General! Your troops overran the Turkish lines and stormed Scimitar Hill. Unfortunately, we have lost far too many men to carry on with the attack. Again, the final breakthrough has not been achieved.
dst: 好样的，将军！您的部队冲垮了土耳其人的防线并猛攻弯刀山。不幸的是，我们损失了太多兵力，无法继续进攻。最终的突破仍未实现。

src: Break through the British lines and force the B.E.F. to surrender. Beware of British counterattacks. Their armoured brigade has already brought Rommel's 7thPz division and the Totenkopf into problems a few days ago near Arras.
dst: 突破英军防线，迫使英国远征军投降。当心英军反扑。他们的装甲旅几天前已在阿拉斯附近给隆美尔的第7装甲师和“骷髅”师制造了麻烦。

dst: 突破敌军防线，进攻彼列科普地峡以及克里米亚北部，并在 16/20/26 回合内夺取全部胜利点，以获得辉煌胜利/胜利/战术胜利。

src: Brigaadikindral, Kolonel Kalm of the Finnish Pohjan Poikain regiment has presented the following plan to you in confidence:  he wishes to continue to pursue the retreating Soviet forces into Latvia proper.  With the political sitation still unstable in Latvia (there had been an official announcement of the formation of a Bolshevik Latvian government), you are certain that such a move will not be approved by the Estonian military command.  However, such a daring move will deal a severe tactical and strategic blow to the Red Army in this region.
dst: 准将，芬兰波赫扬·波伊凯宁团的卡尔姆上校私下向您提出了如下计划：他希望继续追击撤退的苏俄军队，直入拉脱维亚腹地。鉴于拉脱维亚政局仍不稳定（已有官方公告称布尔什维克拉脱维亚政府成立），您确信此举不会得到爱沙尼亚军事指挥部的批准。然而，这样的大胆行动将对这一地区的红军造成沉重的战术与战略打击。

src: Brigaadikindral, following your brilliant performance on the Southern Estonian Front, you are joining the operations of the Estonian naval and marine forces.  Starting from the battles of Tallinn, our (and our allies') forces have performed naval assault operations.  Here, we hope to combine the speed of your Soomusrong with the skill of our marines to continue the advance along the coast of the Gulf of Finland.
dst: 准将，鉴于您在爱沙尼亚南部战线上的出色表现，您将加入爱沙尼亚海军与陆战部队的行动。自塔林战役起，我们（以及我们盟友）的部队就一直在实施两栖突击作战。在这里，我们希望将您的装甲列车的速度与我们陆战队的技能结合起来，继续沿芬兰湾海岸推进。

src: Brigaadikindral, victory at Narva has brought stability to the whole eastern frontier... for the moment.  Using a rapidly-growing railroad capability, we have been able to transfer your battle-hardened troops to the southern sector of fighting.  The situation here has been difficult for the 2nd and 3rd regiments, the Kuperjanow Brigade, and the Pohjan Poikain Finnish regiment.  With rapid Bolshevik political and military gains in neighboring Latvia, the Red Army has found an ally among many of them:  enough for a full standing division and another in formation!  Defensively, Valga is an important railroad hub, and its capture will tear a large gap in the Soviet Latvian Army's northern flank.
dst: 准将，纳尔瓦的胜利为整个东部边境带来了稳定……暂时如此。借助迅速增长的铁路运力，我们得以把您久经沙场的部队调往南部战区。这里的局势对第2、第3团、库珀亚诺夫旅以及波赫扬·波伊凯宁芬兰团来说一直很艰难。随着布尔什维克在邻国拉脱维亚取得迅速的政治与军事进展，红军在他们中间找到了许多盟友：足以组成一个满编师，还有一个师正在组建！就防御而言，瓦尔加是重要的铁路枢纽，夺取它将使苏俄拉脱维亚集团军的北翼被撕开一个大口子。

src: Brigaadikindral, we have returned to Narva once again.  The strategic importance of this city is immesureable.  The scale of this battle will test your skill and bravery.
dst: 准将，我们再次回到了纳尔瓦。这座城市的战略重要性不可估量。这场战斗的规模将考验您的技巧与勇气。

src: Brigaadikindral, your attack failed to destoy significant amounts of Soviet equipment, but their forces have been expelled from the area by your troups.  All that lies in the way of Estonian liberation is the Bolshevik garrison at Narva!
dst: 准将，您的进攻未能摧毁大量苏军装备，但他们的部队已被您的部队逐出该地区。如今挡在爱沙尼亚解放之路上的，只剩纳尔瓦的布尔什维克守军了！

src: Brigaadikindral, your promotion places you in command of the northern wing of our counter-offensive against the Red Army.  You must capture two important cities along the Tallinn-Narva railroad (Rakvere and Sami) and eliminate the Russian garrison at the port of Letipea.  In this operation you will combine breakthrough maneuver on land and railroad and an amphibious operation.
dst: 准将，您的晋升使您得以指挥我们对红军反攻的北翼。您必须沿塔林-纳尔瓦铁路占领两座重要城市（拉克韦雷和萨米），并消灭莱蒂佩亚港的俄国守军。在此次行动中，您将把陆地和铁路上的突破机动与一场两栖作战结合起来。

src: Brigade fought also on the next day, together with the soldiers of Soviet 169th Rifle Regiment. German resistance in Bila Cerkva was ferocious again, and Czechoslovaks losses numbered over four hundred men, with 66 of them killed in action. Czechoslovaks destroyed fifteen enemy tanks, four self-propelled guns and many other equipment; they killed at least fifty enemy men. Brigade was moved to reserve on the 2nd January 1944, and therefore it didn't take a part in final liberation of Bila Cerkva.
dst: 该旅第二天继续作战，与苏军第169步兵团并肩。白采尔克瓦的德军抵抗再次十分凶猛，捷克斯洛伐克人伤亡超过四百人，其中66人阵亡。捷克斯洛伐克人摧毁了敌军十五辆坦克、四辆自行火炮和大量其他装备，至少歼敌五十人。1944年1月2日，该旅转入预备队，因此未参加白采尔克瓦的最终解放。

src: Brigade participated in fighting since 17th January, when tanks and motorized infantry charged and destroyed a small German bridgehead near Ostrozhany, until 26th January, when Luftwaffe inadvertently destroyed the bridge at village, severely crippling any chance of German escape. Brigade was moved to its new postions on the very same day.
dst: 该旅自1月17日起参战——当时坦克和摩托化步兵冲击并摧毁了奥斯特罗扎内附近的一个德军小桥头堡——一直打到1月26日，德国空军误炸了村里的桥梁，严重削弱了德军逃脱的任何可能。该旅当天即转往新阵地。

src: Brigade size Combat team 26, organized around Infantry Regiment 26 of the 1st US Infantry Division. The AI (computer) controls these forces.
dst: 旅级第26战斗队，以美军第1步兵师第26步兵团为骨干组建。这些部队由 AI（计算机）指挥。

src: Brilliant Victory: Should you choose a Brilliant Victory in this choice scenario, you will command your corps on the North-Western Front.  Stavka has begun drafting plans for a winter offensive from the Polish Salient into Eastern Prussia.
dst: 大捷：若您在此选择场景中达成大捷，您将指挥您的军前往西北战线。大本营已开始拟订从波兰突出部向东普鲁士发动冬季攻势的计划。

src: Brilliant victory is achieved by taking all eight Victory Hexes in the next 12 days (24 turns) or by exiting a Brigade size force (6 units) East of the Nieuport-Dixmude rail road. Not exiting a brigade but taking seven Victory Hexes will give you a victory, six Victory hexes a tactical victory.
dst: 在未来12天（24回合）内夺取全部八个胜利点，或让一支旅级部队（6个单位）从尼乌波特-迪克斯迈德铁路以东离开地图，即可获得大捷。不让旅级部队离开地图但夺取七个胜利点，可获胜利；夺取六个胜利点则获小捷。

src: Brilliant work. You have fulfilled the General Staff's hopes!  Your drive to Avranches has forced the last of the American and British forces from Europe.  Now we can concentrate on building up our forces to invade England next year.  You and your men will rest and refit for a key role in our invasion.  I am happy to inform you that you are promoted to Feldmarschall!
dst: 漂亮的工作。您实现了总参谋部的期望！您向阿夫朗什的推进迫使最后的美军和英军部队撤离欧洲。现在我们可以集中力量积蓄部队，准备明年入侵英格兰。您和您的部下将休整并补充装备，在我们的入侵行动中承担关键角色。我很高兴地通知您，您已被晋升为元帅！

src: Brilliant, Comrade. You have shown that it is a mistake to think the Red Army is an easy prey! You are ordered to dig in, because the situation on other sections of the front causes us to send all reinforcements elsewhere.
dst: 出色，同志。你已证明，认为红军是易于捕食的猎物是个错误！你奉命就地固守，因为前线其他地段的局势要求我们抽调所有增援前往别处。

src: Brilliant, comrade. Simply brilliant! You have chased those fascists dogs in front of you. Large parts of the Caucasus region have been liberated. And the fascists in Stalingrad should be close to surrender. We have destroyed many Rumanian, Hungarian and Italian units in battles near the Don River. Our winter offensive is already a triumph. Simply keep advancing until you receive new orders, comrade!
dst: 漂亮，同志。太漂亮了！你把这些法西斯走狗追得四散奔逃。高加索的大部分地区已经解放。而斯大林格勒的法西斯应该也快投降了。我们在顿河附近的战斗中消灭了许多罗马尼亚、匈牙利和意大利部队。我们的冬季攻势已经是一场胜利。继续推进，直到接到新命令，同志！

src: Brilliant, comrade. The Red Army has encircled many fascist formations. We expect to have encircled over 20 German divisions at least. And our advance into Rumania is going quick, victory should be near. In the Baltic and Byelorussia we have advanced over hundreds of kilometers. Our nation is close to being completely liberated from the fascist supression!
dst: 漂亮，同志。红军已经包围了许多法西斯兵团。我们预计至少已包围了20个以上的德军师。我们向罗马尼亚的推进进展迅速，胜利应该就在眼前。在波罗的海和白俄罗斯，我们已推进了数百公里。我们的祖国即将从法西斯的压迫下完全解放！

src: Brilliant, comrade. We have most of the Perekop peninsula back under control. However it seems the fascists are assembling new forces to storm our lines again.
dst: 漂亮，同志。我们已夺回了佩列科普半岛的大部分。然而，看来法西斯正在集结新的力量，准备再次冲击我们的防线。

src: Brilliant, comrade. You have taken Feodosiya and repulsed all fascist counterattacks! The landing near Kerch has been an equal success. The enemy was quick enough to retreat and build a new defensive line, but we are in possession of the Kerch peninsula from Kerch to Feodisya and have drained away enemy forces that could otherwise attack Sevastopol.
dst: 漂亮，同志。你夺取了费奥多西亚，并击退了法西斯的所有反扑！刻赤附近的登陆同样成功。敌人撤得够快，构筑了一条新防线，但我们已占据了从刻赤到费奥多西亚的刻赤半岛，并牵制了本可进攻塞瓦斯托波尔的敌军力量。

src: Brilliant, comrade. You have taken Kerch and repulsed all fascist counterattacks! The landing near Feodosiya has been an equal success. The enemy was quick enough to retreat and build a new defensive line, but we are in possession of the Kerch peninsula from Kerch to Feodisya and have drained away enemy forces that could otherwise attack Sevastopol.
dst: 漂亮，同志。你夺取了刻赤，并击退了法西斯的所有反扑！费奥多西亚附近的登陆同样成功。敌人撤得够快，构筑了一条新防线，但我们已占据了从刻赤到费奥多西亚的刻赤半岛，并牵制了本可进攻塞瓦斯托波尔的敌军力量。

src: Bring beer and wine! Let us celebrate this big victory. . . . !
dst: 拿啤酒和葡萄酒来！让我们庆祝这场大胜. . . . ！

src: Bring your forces north of Philadelphia in position. The General Staff is planning a raid on Lake Erie to cut off the States north of Pennsylvania from the rest of the country. Your units will take part in this operation.
dst: 把你的部队调往费城以北进入阵地。总参谋部正计划对伊利湖发起一次突袭，以切断宾夕法尼亚以北各州与全国其余部分的联系。你的部队将参加这次行动。
布里斯班防线防御阵地
英国富兰克林将军/参谋部

src: British 8th Army broke through the enemy lines before you did. Looks like is them who will get all the honours.
dst: 英军第8集团军抢在你之前突破了敌军防线。看来所有荣誉都将归于他们。

src: British Reinforcements are expected to arrive soon.
dst: 预计英国增援很快就会抵达。
英国 South 非洲警察

src: British and French troops are trapped in the south of the Gallipolli peninsula. Their original plans have failed and it will be very difficult for therm to advance any further. Good job!
dst: 英法军队被困在加里波利半岛南部。他们的原定计划已经失败，再向前推进将极为困难。干得好！

src: British losses are 122 killed, 588 wounded and 259 men missing, 27 Cruiser tanks, 45 Crusaders, 64 Matilda's and 36 planes. Our losses are limited to 93 killed, 353 wounded and 253 missing, 10 aircraft and 25 tanks.
dst: 英军损失：阵亡122人、负伤588人、失踪259人，巡洋坦克27辆、“十字军”45辆、“玛蒂尔达”64辆、飞机36架。我方损失仅限于阵亡93人、负伤353人、失踪253人，飞机10架、坦克25辆。

src: British troops in your sector have just started their expected autumn offensive. The attacks seem to be concentrated around the main defensive position: the Hohenzollern Redoubt. Contain the British gains and use reinforcements to counterattack. 'The Dump', the slag heap near Fosse 8 (Mine Pit 8), offers excellent views on the enemy positions.
dst: 您防区内的英军刚刚发动了他们预料之中的秋季攻势。进攻似乎集中在主要防御阵地——霍亨索伦堡垒一带。要遏制英军的进展，并利用增援部队发起反攻。「废料堆」——8号竖井（8号矿坑）旁的矿渣堆——可以极好地俯瞰敌军阵地。
英国志愿兵/ 皇家空军
布罗尼斯拉夫·济涅维奇

dst: Brooklyn Museum Archives, Goodyear Archival Collection (S03_06_01_018 image 2380)。

dst: Bruno Sutkus是第68步兵师的一名立陶宛裔德国狙击手。

布鲁西洛夫攻势：卢茨克战役

src: Brusilov's meticulous preparation has proven successful:  the Austrians failed to rush reserves to locations of our breakthrough, and garrison after garrison was surrounded and neutralized.
dst: 布鲁西洛夫细致入微的准备证明是成功的：奥地利人未能把预备队及时调到我们的突破地点，一个又一个守军被包围并解除武装。

src: Brusilov's plan hinged on two key parameters: absolute secrecy in preparation and a simultaneous front-wide offensive at the appointed time.  Throughout the spring months, artillery positions were prepared and Austrian targets were identified.  The use of air recoinassance missions aided these efforts.  The Front's artillery barrage was the largest yet employed by the Russian army, lasting 2 entire days.  The entire length of the front was covered, giving the Austrians no clues about the intended breakthrough.  The first assault has commenced, and your units must complete the breakthrough by capturing Lutsk and Berestechno.  You will also envelop the Austrian fortified line, eliminating any resistance in the cauldron.
dst: 布鲁西洛夫的计划取决于两个关键因素：准备工作的绝对保密和在指定时间全线同时进攻。整个春季，炮兵阵地被构筑起来，奥地利目标被一一查明。空中侦察任务的运用助力了这些努力。方面军的炮火准备是俄军迄今规模最大的一次，持续了整整两天。战线全线都被覆盖，没有给奥地利人任何关于突破点的线索。首次突击已经开始，您的部队必须通过夺取卢茨克和别列斯捷奇科完成突破。您还要合围奥军设防线，消灭包围圈内的一切抵抗。

src: Buen trabajo!, con la caida de Gijon, la totalidad del Frente Norte y su tejido industrial esta ahora en nuestro poder, de este golpe no se recuperara el enemigo facilmente.
dst: 干得好！随着希洪的陷落，整个北方战线及其工业体系现在都落入我方手中，敌人很难从这次打击中恢复过来。

src: Buen trabajo!, the whole North Front is destroyed and the important industrial areas placed here will support us in advance.
dst: 干得好！整个北方战线已被摧毁，位于此地的重要工业区将为我方今后的行动提供支援。

src: Buen trabajo!. Hemos aplastado las lineas enemigas, sin embargo los objetivos marcados no estan al alcance de momento, la resistencia enemiga es mas fuerte de lo que pensabamos.
dst: 干得好！我们粉碎了敌军防线，然而目前既定目标还无法达成，敌军的抵抗比我们预想的更强。

src: Buen trabajo!. We have destroyed the enemy lines, however we can't finally achieve all the goals of our attack... the enemy resistance is harder than we thought.
dst: 干得好！我们粉碎了敌军防线，然而我们最终无法达成此次进攻的全部目标……敌军的抵抗比我们预想的更强。

src: Buen trabajo. Las milicias republicanas no son suficiente para detener a nuestras tropas de elite. Basicamente salen corriendo tan pronto como los legionarios aparecen en el horizonte!.
dst: 干得好。共和国民兵不足以挡住我们的精锐部队。基本上，外籍军团士兵一出现在地平线上，他们就会撒腿逃跑！

src: Buen trabajo. The enemy militias are not enough to stop your elite african troops. They basically leaves their positions as soon as your legionarios appear in front of then! hahahaha!
dst: 干得好。敌人民兵不足以挡住您的非洲精锐部队。基本上，您的外籍军团士兵一出现在他们面前，他们就会弃阵而逃！哈哈哈！

src: Buena suerte!  If we can achieve a complete victory, this operation will open the way to Zaragoza again!
dst: 祝您好运！如果我们能取得全胜，此次行动将再次打开通往萨拉戈萨的道路！

src: Buena suerte!, si logramos la victoria total en esta operacion la puerta hacia la capital de Aragon quedara abierta.
dst: 祝您好运！如果我们在此次行动中取得全胜，通往阿拉贡首府的大门就将敞开。

src: Buena suerte, esta vez la necesitara.
dst: 祝您好运，这一次您会需要它的。

src: Buenos dias General.  It is my pleasure to put you in command of the offensive at Bilbao. The newly created Brigadas Navarras are now under your direct command as well as the 2nd Italian Division that was deployed in Spain to defeat the Marxists.  A large number of artillery pieces and air recourses will support your storming the enemy lines.  I suggest you use the close support tactics of the Germans to eliminate the Republican battalions.
dst: 早上好，将军。我很高兴任命您指挥毕尔巴鄂攻势。新组建的纳瓦拉旅以及为击败马克思主义者而部署到西班牙的第2意大利师，现在都由您直接指挥。大量火炮和航空资源将支援您强击敌军防线。我建议您采用德国人的近距支援战术来消灭共和派各营。

src: Buenos dias General. Es un placer tenerle al mando de la ofensiva sobre Bilbao. Como ya sabe, las recien creadas Brigadas Navarras, así como la 2º División Italiana están bajo su mando. Un buen número de baterías de artillería y unidades aéreas apoyaran la ofensiva machacando las líneas enemigas. Le sugiero que empleé esas tácticas de apoyo cercano de los alemanes para eliminar a los batallones republicanos.
dst: 早上好，将军。由您来指挥对毕尔巴鄂的攻势，我深感荣幸。如您所知，新组建的纳瓦拉旅以及第2意大利师都归您指挥。大量炮兵连和航空部队将支援此次攻势，压制敌军防线。我建议您采用德国人那套近距支援战术，以消灭共和军各营。

src: Buenos dias Sr.General!  Our glorious patriotic movement to save Spain is progressing well.  However, we need to do some operations in the northern provinces.  Our attack on Asturias, Santander, Vizcaya and Guipuzcoa (where our garrison has been defeated) have failed miserably.  That ridiculous northern strip of land it's still loyal to the Madrid government!  We can't tolerate this.  While our brave men are battling the enemy at the republic's capital, you will take command of some units and attack at Guipuzcoa.  Some reinforcements will arrive following the southwest axis of Urnieta - Hernani - San Sebastian.  Also some naval units are sailing up from the El Ferrol naval base to support your offensive with their heavy fire power.
dst: 早上好，将军！我们为拯救西班牙而进行的这场光荣的爱国运动进展顺利。然而，我们在北部各省仍需执行一些作战。我们对阿斯图里亚斯、桑坦德、比斯开和吉普斯夸（我方守备部队已在那里被击败）发动的进攻惨遭失败。那条可笑的北部狭长地带竟仍效忠于马德里政府！这是我们绝不能容忍的。当我们英勇的士兵正在共和国首都与敌人作战时，您须统率若干部队进攻吉普斯夸。西南方向会有一些增援部队抵达，他们应沿乌尔涅塔-埃尔纳尼-圣塞瓦斯蒂安轴线发起进攻。此外，还有一些海军部队正从埃尔费罗尔海军基地出航，将以重炮火力支援您的攻势。

src: Buenos dias general!, tengo el placer de informarle, que finalmente usted tomara parte en el asalto a Madrid, tras nuestra larga marcha desde Africa y despues de la liberacion del Alcazar. Su mision es tomar los puentes sobre el rio Manzanares, y despues continuar el avance siguiendo el eje Ciudad Universitaria - Hospital Clinico, despues fije su objetivo en el centro de Madrid...
dst: 早上好，将军！我很荣幸地通知您，经过我们从非洲出发的漫长行军以及解放托莱多城堡之后，您最终将参与对马德里的进攻。您的任务是夺取曼萨纳雷斯河上的桥梁，随后沿大学城 - 临床医院一线继续推进，然后以马德里市中心为目标……

src: Buenos dias general!. I have the pleasure to notice you finally the assault on Madrid will start. Your mission is to take all the bridges over the Manzanares river, and to advance following the axis Ciudad Universitaria - Hospital Clinico, and then, on to the center of Madrid...
dst: 早上好，将军！我很荣幸地通知您，对马德里的进攻终于要开始了。您的任务是夺取曼萨纳雷斯河上的所有桥梁，并沿大学城－临床医院轴线推进，然后向马德里市中心前进……

src: Buenos dias general!. I have the pleasure to notice you that finally the assault on Madrid will start, after our long march from Africa and after the liberation of El Alcazar de Toledo. Your mission is to take all the bridges over the Manzanares river, and to advance following the axis Ciudad Universitaria - Hospital Clinico, and then, on to the center of Madrid...
dst: 早上好，将军！我很荣幸地通知您，经过我们从非洲出发的漫长行军以及托莱多城堡的解放之后，对马德里的进攻最终就要开始了。您的任务是夺取曼萨纳雷斯河上的所有桥梁，并沿大学城 - 临床医院一线推进，然后继续向马德里市中心挺进……

src: Buenos dias general!. Nuestra marcha victoriosa desde el Protectorado, hacia la capital continua. Las hordas rojas aun campan a sus anchas por Madrid, pero seguro que por poco tiempo. A pesar de ello, las ordenes son que cambie la direccion de su columna; el general Mola ha enviado ordenes de que debe liberar el Alcazar de Toledo, donde la guarnicion que se ha sublevado con nosotros, al mando del coronel Moscardo esta resistiendo desesperadamente los asaltos de los milicianos enemigos.
dst: 早上好，将军！我们从保护地一路向首都的胜利进军仍在继续。共和军仍在马德里肆意横行，但肯定为时不长。尽管如此，命令是让您改变纵队的进军方向；莫拉将军已下令，要您去解放托莱多城堡，那里随我们一同起事的守军，在莫斯卡多上校的指挥下，正绝望地抵御着敌方民兵的进攻。

src: Buenos dias general!. Our victorious march from the Spanish Morocco to Madrid continues. The red hordes are still ruling Madrid... but surely for a few time. In spite of this fact, you should change the direction of your troops; the general Mola have ordered you to save the Alcazar de Toledo, (an infantry school is located there) where the garrison is desperately resisting the attacks of the reds since July, receiving heavy assaults from the CNT militias which are besieging the Alcazar.
dst: 早上好，将军！我们从西属摩洛哥向马德里的胜利进军仍在继续。共和军仍统治着马德里……但想必为时不长。尽管如此，您应当改变部队的进军方向；莫拉将军已下令要您去解救托莱多城堡（那里设有一所步兵学校），那里的守军自 7 月以来一直绝望地抵抗着共和军的进攻，并承受着围困城堡的 CNT 民兵的猛烈攻击。

src: Buenos dias general. The Italians are preparing an assault themselves on to Madrid... The CTV generals are believing they will be able to hit hard to the Republicans, but, we shall see what the Italians will do!. You are going to take part in the offensive with a couple of your best units...
dst: 早上好，将军。意大利人自己也在准备进攻马德里……CTV 的将军们相信他们能狠狠打击共和军，但是，我们且看意大利人会怎么做！您将率领几支最精锐的部队参加这次攻势……

src: Buenos dias, I have left you the situation map of the war on your desk. General Franco have changed the strategy, now we must end with the Republican resistance in the North Front, then the Republicans will lose their main industrial areas. However spies are reporting about a big concentration of forces Westwards to Madrid... You can join the assault on the North of Spain, or stay in the West of Madrid, awaiting a possible enemy powerful strike...
dst: 早上好，我已把战争态势图放在您桌上。佛朗哥将军改变了战略，现在我们必须终结北部战线上共和军的抵抗，这样共和军就会失去其主要工业区。不过间谍报告说，马德里以西正在大规模集结兵力……您可以参加对西班牙北部的进攻，也可以留在马德里以西，等待敌军可能发动的猛烈打击……

src: Buenos dias, le he dejado el mapa de situacion sobre su mesa. El general Franco ha cambiado la estrategia. Ahora el Frente Norte va a cobrar mayor actividad, ya que revisten una gran importancia las industrias leales al enemigo alli estacionadas. Por otro lado, algunos de nuestros informadores, reportan de que una gran concentracion de fuerzas enemigas se esta formando en los alrrededores de la zona occidental de Madrid, lo que indica un posible ataque a gran escala en los proximos dias en el frente de Navalcarnero.
dst: 早上好，我已把态势图放在您桌上。佛朗哥将军改变了战略。现在北部战线将变得更加活跃，因为驻扎在那里的忠于敌方的工业具有重大价值。另一方面，我们的一些情报人员报告说，敌军正在马德里西部地带周边大规模集结，这表明未来几天在纳瓦尔卡内罗战线可能发生一场大规模进攻。

src: Buenos dias. Como usted sabe, los rojos han lanzado otro ataque desesperado, no le parece ridiculo?, esta vez tratan de capturar Teruel... Ciertamente han conseguido rodear por completo la ciudad, donde el coronel Rey d'Haucourt esta resistiendo con toda su guarnicion, sin embargo creemos que no podra hacerlo por mucho tiempo mas.
dst: 早上好。如您所知，共和军又发动了一次绝望的进攻，您不觉得可笑吗？这一次他们企图夺取特鲁埃尔……他们的确已将该城彻底包围，雷伊·多库尔上校正率其全部守备部队在那里抵抗，不过我们认为他撑不了多久了。

src: Build a combined core of approx 30 units. There are no special rules or tricks in the campaign, just lots of combat.
dst: 组建一支约30个单位的联合核心部队。本战役没有特殊规则或窍门，只有大量战斗。

src: Build your army, and cross the Yalu River to help the North Koreans and strike the UN forces.  Liberate Pyongyang to allow further advances to the 38 parallel and beyond.  We will have help from the air from our recently created People's Liberation Army Air Force. Remember all the principles of the People's War doctrine on your way.
dst: 建立你的部队，跨过鸭绿江去援助朝鲜人，打击联合国军。解放平壤，以便进一步向三八线及其以南推进。我们将得到我们新近组建的中国人民解放军空军的空中支援。一路上牢记人民战争学说的全部原则。

src: Bulgaria has switched sides and the Bulgarian Army, as the Rumanian Army, is fighting alongside us against the German fascists. You have done a worthy job.
dst: 保加利亚已倒戈，保加利亚军队与罗马尼亚军队一样，正与我们并肩作战，打击德国法西斯。你完成了一项可敬的任务。

src: Bulgaria's Army isn't big enough to fully recover from their losses, and the Germans can't send more soldiers to the area, so the Balkan Front will stabilize pretty soon. However, I'm afraid that we'll have to retreat from the Dardanelles. Russia won't receive any help by sea. I hope they'll be able to take care of themselves.
dst: 保加利亚军队规模不够大，无法从其损失中完全恢复，德国人又无法向该地区增派更多士兵，因此巴尔干战线很快就会稳定下来。然而，我担心我们不得不从达达尼尔海峡撤退。俄国将无法通过海路得到任何援助。我希望他们能照顾好自己。
保加利亚共产党游击队
保加利亚 air 防御
保加利亚 recon 飞机

src: Buller's plan is crossing the Drakensberge and invading the Orange Free State, forcing us to fight in our own territory. He receives supplies from the port of Durban regularly, so he's by no means isolated. But Botha is resisting him fiercely, so most of the British soldiers and resources have been sent to the mountains. In fact, the British defences on the Tugela Valley are weaker now than they were when the year started.
dst: 布勒的计划是翻越德拉肯斯山脉并入侵奥兰治自由邦，迫使我们不得不在自己的国土上作战。他定期从德班港获得补给，所以他绝非孤立无援。但博塔正顽强地抵抗他，因此大部分英军士兵和资源都被派往了山区。事实上，英军在图盖拉河谷的防御如今比年初时更为薄弱。
