src: But Bismarck edited the official report of the incident, making it appear as a harsh argument between the king and the ambassador. Bismarck`s version was sent to the foreign embassies and the press, and in France it was seen as an insult by both the government and the people. On 19 July 1870 France declared war on Prussia, the southern German states supported Prussia, and Bismarck was delighted.
dst: 但俾斯麦篡改了关于此事的官方报告，使之看起来像是国王与大使之间的一场激烈争吵。俾斯麦的版本被送往各国使馆和新闻界，在法国，政府和民众都视之为侮辱。1870年7月19日，法国对普鲁士宣战，德意志南部各邦支持普鲁士，俾斯麦喜出望外。

src: But Bismarck wasn't satisfied yet. He wished to incorporate Bavaria and the other remaining independent German states into an unified German Empire. France wouldn't tolerate that, but that wasn't a problem for the Prussian chancellor. He was ready for war, if necessary, and once again he started to look for excuses that would lead to it.
dst: 但俾斯麦仍不满足。他希望把巴伐利亚和其他尚保持独立的德意志邦国并入一个统一的德意志帝国。法国不会容忍这一点，但对这位普鲁士宰相来说那并不是问题。如果必要，他已做好了开战准备，并且再次开始寻找能够引发战争的借口。

src: But Commander, I have to say that after everything we've been through together, the last thing I expected was for us to fight our own countrymen.
dst: 但指挥官，我不得不说，在共同经历了这一切之后，我最没料到的竟是要和自己的同胞作战。

src: But Greece is a different matter. The Greeks consider themselves the true heirs of the Byzantine Empire, and they want to annex as much Anadolu land as they can. The Treaty of Sèvres granted Greece a protectorate over Izmir, but that is simply not enough for them.
dst: 但希腊是另一回事。希腊人自视为拜占庭帝国的真正继承者，他们想尽可能多地吞并安纳托利亚的土地。《色佛尔条约》授予希腊对伊兹密尔的保护权，但这对他们来说远远不够。

src: But I am afraid that even this might not save Tripoli.
dst: 但我担心，即便如此也救不了黎波里。

src: But I could not enjoy my victory. When the battle was almost over, German artillery shelled the house where I was spending the night, shrapnel injured my chest, and I had to be taken to a campaign hospital. It could have been worse. A few days later my friend Samuel Lomax, who commanded the 1st division, was mortally wounded, again due to German artillery fire, and the first battle of Ypres also claimed the life of old Lord Roberts, the man who had created the concentration camps at South Africa. Indeed, all they that live by the sword shall perish by the sword.
dst: 但我却无法享受胜利。战斗即将结束时，德军炮火轰击了我过夜的那栋房子，弹片击伤了我的胸口，我不得不被送往野战医院。情况本可能更糟。几天后，指挥第1师的朋友塞缪尔·洛马克斯再次因德军炮火而受了致命伤，第一次伊普尔战役还夺去了老罗伯茨勋爵的生命，正是此人创建了南非的集中营。确实，凡动刀剑者，必死于刀剑之下。

src: But I have no doubt that, regardless of what our destiny will be, you will go down in history as one of the greatest European military officers of this century.
dst: 但我毫不怀疑，无论我们的命运如何，您都将作为本世纪欧洲最伟大的军事家之一载入史册。

src: But I know I won't do it. My oath still binds me, and it will always do. When we learnt that generals Alekseyev and Kornilov had gathered some men ready to fight the Bolsheviks, Anatoly and I were among the first members of the Volunteer Army. Alas, the revolutionary madness is very powerful and we are too few. We could hardly arrive in Rostov, and now we know that the Red Army is coming. We must retreat further South, through the open field and the snow, far from the railway lines. If we manage to survive the Reds, the cold and the ice and get to the Kuban we could have a chance to perform a counterattack.
dst: 但我知道我不会那样做。我的誓言仍束缚着我，而且将永远如此。当我们得知阿列克谢耶夫将军和科尔尼洛夫将军已聚集起一些人准备与布尔什维克作战时，阿纳托利和我便成了志愿军最早的一批成员。唉，革命的疯狂极为强大，而我们人太少。我们勉强抵达罗斯托夫，如今又得知红军正在逼近。我们必须继续向南撤退，穿过开阔地和积雪，远离铁路线。如果我们能挺过红军、严寒和冰雪，抵达库班，也许还有机会发起反攻。

src: But I must be clear about this: in 1920 we didn't want a war with Poland. Kolchak was resigned to accept the demands of the League of Nations and to leave the Poles alone. It was them who, blinded by their victories against the Bolsheviks, believed that they could force us to leave Belarus and Ukraine, where they would support the establishment of independent republics that (of course!) would be allies of Poland and enemies of Russia.
dst: 但我必须说清楚：1920年我们并不想与波兰开战。高尔察克已忍痛接受国际联盟的要求，不再招惹波兰人。是他们，被自己对布尔什维克的胜利冲昏了头脑，以为能迫使我们放弃白俄罗斯和乌克兰，在那里支持建立独立共和国，而这些共和国（当然！）将成为波兰的盟友、俄国的敌人。

src: But I'm afraid that the war will soon be over. Our commando could still fight for some time, but most of the other commandoes are exhausted and without any proper equipment. We've fought until the bitter end, but now we must stop, before we lose everything we have left.
dst: 但我担心战争很快就要结束。我们的突击队或许还能再坚持一段时间，但其他大多数突击队已经精疲力竭，而且缺乏像样的装备。我们已经血战到了最后，但现在必须停下来，以免失去所剩的一切。

src: But I'm not calling you for that reason. The French authorities have reported some enemy movements near their borders in the Ouergha Valley. I don't think that Abd el-Krim is so imprudent as to attack the French Protectorate, but since your troops are already in the region and the French have scarce units at the Ouergha; I want you to help our allies in case any enemy aggression takes place.  You need to hold until they can mobilize enough reinforcements.
dst: 但我打电话给您并非为此。法国当局报告说，在乌埃尔加河谷靠近他们边境的地方发现了一些敌军动向。我不认为阿卜杜·克里姆会如此鲁莽，竟去进攻法属保护地，但既然您的部队已经在该地区，而法国在乌埃尔加河谷的部队又很少，我希望您在发生任何敌方侵犯时支援我们的盟友。您需要坚守，直到他们能调动起足够的援军。

src: But I've learnt that revolution is like a hydra. No matter if we cut its heads, if we don't destroy them, soon many more will grow. So I must hurry and take Petrograd before they have time to  react. The fewer that can escape, the better.
dst: 但我已懂得，革命就像九头蛇。无论我们砍掉它多少头颅，若不将其彻底毁灭，很快就会长出更多。所以我必须抓紧时间，在他们还来不及反应之前拿下彼得格勒。能逃掉的人越少越好。

src: But Providence had not have forsaken us, and Von Kluck had already made a terrible mistake. Believing that there were not any significant enemy forces in the Southwest, ahead of him, on August 31st he had ordered a change of direction, to the Southeast. Maybe he wanted to envelope us. Maybe he believed that it would be a shorter way to Paris. Maybe it was just that his troops were exhausted.
dst: 但上苍并未抛弃我们，而冯·克卢克已经犯下了一个可怕的错误。他以为西南方、也就是他的正前方没有什么重要的敌军，便于8月31日下令改变方向，转向东南。也许他想包抄我们；也许他以为那是通往巴黎的捷径；也许仅仅是因为他的部队已经疲惫不堪。

src: But also at the invasion front decide successes were achieved. After the collapse of the important GHQ defense line further resistance is actually hopeless, but the Brits do not want to give up and retreated behind the so-called A-Stop-Line on the outskirts of London. The General Staff has decided to break this defense line at Windsor. There is the weakest point and there is our gateway to London. Heavy artillery is already assembled at this point and also our Luftwaffe is ready. Your battle group will form the spearhead of the attack. Repair at last one bridge to make the way free for the following divisions.
dst: 但入侵战线也取得了决定性胜利。在重要的GHQ防线崩溃后，进一步的抵抗实际上已无望，但英国人仍不愿放弃，退到了伦敦郊外所谓的A-止线之后。总参谋部决定在温莎突破这条防线。那里是最薄弱处，也是我们通往伦敦的门户。重炮已经在该点集结，我们的德国空军也已就绪。你的战斗群将担任进攻的矛头。至少修复一座桥梁，为后续各师扫清道路。

src: But also our Spring Offensive in South Russia and the Caucasus makes good progress - a Soviet tank corps is threatened with encirclement near Grozny. The enemy, however, has recognized the danger and tried to break away in northeast direction to escape destruction. Your order is to cut off the path of the enemy forces, prevent their escape and crush the trapped divisions together with the forces moving up from the West!
dst: 我们在南俄和高加索的春季攻势也进展顺利——一个苏军坦克军在格罗兹尼附近面临被围的危险。然而，敌人已经察觉到危险，试图向东北方向突围以免被歼。你的命令是切断敌军的退路，阻止他们逃脱，并与从西面赶上来的部队一起粉碎被困的各师！

src: But at least our country will survive, and we'll learn from our mistakes. When the next war starts, we'll be prepared. We'll find allies that will help us. Next time, we won't be alone. Some German officials claim that their country is willing to help...
dst: 但至少我们的国家会生存下去，我们会从错误中吸取教训。当下一次战争开始时，我们会做好准备。我们会找到愿意帮助我们的盟友。下次，我们不会再孤军奋战。一些德国官员声称他们的国家愿意提供帮助……

src: But at that time the Anti-Bolshevik resistance lacked an unified command, and our plans weren't always properly coordinated. Denikin believed that he had a good opportunity to take Moscow, so he ordered most of his units to leave the Volga region, go to the north and take Kursk and Orel. His reserve went even further, to Ukraine, to protect his left flank from the attacks of Makhno's anarchists. As usual, we were on our own.
dst: 但在那时，反布尔什维克抵抗力量缺乏统一的指挥，我们的计划也并非总能协调一致。邓尼金认为他有一个攻取莫斯科的好机会，于是命令大部分部队离开伏尔加地区，向北进军并夺取库尔斯克和奥廖尔。他的预备队则走得更远，去了乌克兰，以保护左翼免受马赫诺无政府主义者的攻击。和往常一样，我们只能靠自己。

src: But be careful. Bulgarians are on the offensive west and north of you, so you could clash with them if you advance too quickly.
dst: 但要小心。保加利亚人正在您的西面和北面进攻，所以如果您推进过快，可能会与他们遭遇。

src: But before that happens, it is our duty to keep on pinning down as many German regiments as we can, and inflicting them as many casualties as possible. Right now, our goal is deny our invaders an easy, quick victory. We must weaken them, delay them, exhaust them, and make their plans fail. That will benefit us in the long term. Germany isn't strong enough to fight a long war against most of Europe. If they don't defeat France by the end of the year, they never will. We'll make sure that they waste their precious time on us.
dst: 但在那之前，我们的职责是继续尽可能多地牵制德军各团，并尽可能多地给他们造成伤亡。眼下，我们的目标是让侵略者无法轻易、快速地取胜。我们必须削弱他们、迟滞他们、拖垮他们，让他们的计划落空。从长远看，这对我们有利。德国并没有强大到能与大半个欧洲打一场持久战。如果他们到年底还打不垮法国，他们就永远也打不垮了。我们要确保他们把宝贵的时间浪费在我们身上。

src: But despite that, for some reason, I have not been forgotten. For some, I am the living legend, Bruce "The African", the hero from better times. For others, I am an old fossil that should be on display at the British Museum, next to the Egyptian mummies.
dst: 但尽管如此，出于某种原因，我并未被遗忘。对一些人来说，我是活着的传奇，是「非洲佬」布鲁斯，是来自更美好时代的英雄。对另一些人来说，我是个应该陈列在大英博物馆埃及木乃伊旁边的老古董。

src: But don't expect any cooperation. In the summer of 1919, they invited Denikin's troops to the town and the White Russians betrayed their trust and made a bloodbath there. Now they don't trust foreigners at all.
dst: 但别指望有任何合作。1919年夏天，他们邀请邓尼金的部队进城，白俄却背叛了他们的信任，在那里制造了一场大屠杀。如今他们完全不信任外国人。

src: But don't think about it now. You must heal from those wounds first. It will take just a few months. Before you can notice, you'll be back on the front line.
dst: 但现在别想这些了。您必须先把伤养好。只需要几个月。不知不觉，您就会重返前线。

src: But even in the Heart of Rome, our enslaved tribe brothers have taken up arms....!
dst: 但即便在罗马的心脏，我们被奴役的部族兄弟也已拿起武器....！

src: But even then I believed that not everything was lost. If, somehow, we managed to stop the communist swarm, a counterattack would be possible. I had to cling to that last hope.
dst: 但即便那时，我仍相信并非一切都已失去。如果我们能以某种方式挡住共产主义的洪流，反攻仍有可能。我必须紧紧抓住这最后的希望。

src: But even though the enemy is falling back to his main position across the Sinai desert, having suffered more than 5,000 casualties, the exhaustion of our troops and horses leaves us with no means to exploit this splendid victory.
dst: 但尽管敌人正撤往西奈沙漠彼端的主阵地、且已伤亡超过5000人，我们部队和马匹的疲惫仍使我们无力扩大这场辉煌的胜利。

src: But finally the tension exploded. In June 1894, the Qing government sent troops to Korea, in order to supress a rebellion against King Gojong. Infuriated, the Japanese sent troops to Korea, too, and they acted extremely quickly. Before the end of the month they captured King Gojong, occupied the Royal Palace in Seoul and imposed a  pro-Japanese government. The Qing Empire declared that the new Korean government was illegitimate and on 1 August declared war on Japan.
dst: 但紧张局势最终还是爆发了。1894年6月，清政府向朝鲜派兵，以镇压一场反对高宗国王的叛乱。日本人被激怒，也向朝鲜派兵，而且行动极为迅速。当月月底之前，他们便俘获了高宗国王，占领了汉城的王宫，并扶植了一个亲日政府。大清帝国宣布新的朝鲜政府为非法，并于8月1日对日宣战。

src: But here are the areas of the Celts and Romans.
dst: 但这里是凯尔特人与罗马人的地界。

src: But if we have overcome the Reds, all the other difficulties can be overcome, too. The sky is still grey, but the storm is passing over. And I am confident that soon the sun will shine over my beloved Russia.
dst: 但是，既然我们已战胜红军，其他一切困难也都能克服。天空依然灰暗，但风暴正在过去。我深信，太阳很快就会照耀在我亲爱的俄国上空。

src: But in the Saratov pocket several Soviet armies were destroyed and hundreds of thousands of prisoners were made. Army Group Center and South started now the attack on Moscow and most of the troops on the Volga River are swung westward to encircle Moscow.
dst: 但在萨拉托夫包围圈中，数个苏军集团军被歼灭，数十万人被俘。中央集团军群和南方集团军群现已发起对莫斯科的进攻，伏尔加河上的大部分部队正调往西面，以合围莫斯科。

src: But instead of celebrating, Christmas will be a time for fighting this year for us here in Romania. Just a few minutes ago, I was informed that the new offensive is about to begin. Since our victory at the Roterturmpass we have chased the enemy across the mountains and valleys. Now we have reached the south-eastern slopes of the Carpathians, and the resistance has stiffened again. The Romanians have received reinforcements by their Russian ally. A few days ago, while on patrol, I watched some mounted cossacks in the distance. But I am pretty sure, we will deal with them as well.
dst: 但今年，在罗马尼亚的我们，圣诞节将是一个作战的日子，而不是欢庆的日子。就在几分钟前，我接到通知，新的攻势即将开始。自从我们在红塔山口获胜以来，我们一路翻山越谷地追击敌人。如今我们已抵达喀尔巴阡山东南坡，抵抗再次变得顽强起来。罗马尼亚人得到了其俄国盟友的增援。几天前，我在巡逻时远远望见一些骑马的哥萨克。但我相当确信，我们同样能对付他们。

src: But it all changed when the Czech Legion, intending to leave Russia, revolted against the Bolsheviks, who had denied the Legion safe passage along the Trans-Siberian Railway  towards Vladivostok.
dst: 但一切都变了，因为捷克军团原本打算离开俄国，却因布尔什维克拒绝让他们沿西伯利亚大铁路安全前往符拉迪沃斯托克而发动了叛乱。

src: But it is not supposed to be. Rumour is that we will be relieved before the end of the month and will be sent back to where it all started for us: the Balkans.
dst: 但事与愿违。有传言说，我们将在月底前被换防，并被送回我们一切开始的地方：巴尔干。

src: But it seems that is a story for another to write...
dst: 但看来，那是一个留给他人书写的故事……

src: But let's not worry about the possibility until it presents itself. Now rest for a few days. We'll call you if we need your services again at the front of Verdun. When this battle is finally over, there will be a new mission waiting for you.
dst: 但在这种可能性出现之前，我们先不必担心。现在休息几天吧。如果我们再需要您到凡尔登前线效力，我们会叫您。等这场战役最终结束后，还会有新的任务等着您。

src: But let's not worry about the possibility until it presents itself. Now rest for a few days. We'll call you when we need your services again at the front of Verdun. And, once this battle is finally over, there will be a new mission waiting for you.
dst: 但在这种可能性出现之前，我们先不必担心。现在休息几天吧。等我们再需要您到凡尔登前线效力时，我们会叫您。而一旦这场战役最终结束，还会有新的任务等着您。

src: But maybe I'm wrong, its just a feeling, after all.... and first I must solve the problems here.
dst: 但也许我错了，说到底这只是种感觉……而且我得先解决这里的问题。

src: But most of the remaining US Forces and Navy were evacuated to the Hawaii archipelago. Your orders are to attack the island of Oahu and seize Pearl Habor, sink the US fleet and gain control about the various cities and airfields.
dst: 但余下的美军和海军大多已撤往夏威夷群岛。你的命令是进攻瓦胡岛并夺取珍珠港，击沉美国舰队并控制各座城市和机场。

src: But my patron was a resolute man. He ordered our best troops to make a last stand at Cut and Pho Vy, blocking the two main roads that the French were using in their offensive on Lang Son, and to retake Deo Quao at all costs.
dst: 但我的东家是个意志坚定的人。他命令我们最精锐的部队在库特和富维做最后的坚守，封锁法军进攻谅山所用的两条主要道路，并不惜一切代价夺回德奥夸。

src: But nevertheless, HQ has granted my request to put General Sigel in command of my cavalry... if its is about flanking, there is no one better than Franz....
dst: 不过，司令部还是批准了我的请求，让西格尔将军指挥我的骑兵……论侧翼包抄，没人比弗朗茨更在行……

src: But now Lee has sent General Breckinridge against us with all men he could collect...
dst: 但现在李派了布雷肯里奇将军率领他能集结的全部人马前来对付我们……

src: But now it is better for us to withdraw in the bushland on our southern border ...
dst: 但现在，我们最好撤入南部边境的灌木丛地带……

src: But now the Volga front is secured with only weak forces. Therefore your troops remain as mobile reserve on the western bank of the Volga to respond any enemy attacks if necessary.
dst: 但现在伏尔加河战线只有少量兵力驻守，已确保安全。因此你的部队继续作为机动预备队，留在伏尔加河西岸，以备必要时应对任何敌军进攻。

src: But now we have to advance to Missouri as fast as possible!
dst: 但现在我们必须尽快向密苏里推进！

src: But now you have to liberate Wilno!
dst: 但现在您必须解放维尔诺！

src: But on 13 July 1870 Count Benedetti, the French ambassador to Prussia, approached King Wilhelm I at the spa of Ems, and demanded guarantees that Prussia wouldn't permit the candidacy of another Hohenzollern prince to the Spanish throne. The king politely refused, and under normal circumstances the issue should have ended there.
dst: 但1870年7月13日，法国驻普鲁士大使贝内代蒂伯爵在埃姆斯温泉找到国王威廉一世，要求普鲁士保证不再允许另一位霍亨索伦亲王角逐西班牙王位。国王礼貌地拒绝了，在正常情况下此事本应就此了结。

src: But once the independence was granted, there was no need for the Poles to fight on the side of the Central Powers anymore.
dst: 但独立一旦赐予，波兰人便再无必要站在同盟国一方作战了。

src: But our next concern is 8th Army, which stands in front of the Mareth line in Southern Tunisia. If 8th Army brakes through there is a risk that they make contact with Allied troops in Northern and Central Tunisia. That would be the beginning of the end of our presence in Africa.
dst: 但我们下一个担忧是第8集团军，它正列阵于突尼斯南部的马雷斯防线之前。如果第8集团军在此突破，就有可能与突尼斯北部和中部的盟军会师。那将是我们非洲存在的终结之始。

src: But right now we're running short of ammunition and other supplies, so we need to be more aggresive. A large British convoy is heading to Klerksdorp escorted by a force of 700 soldiers. It's imperative that we defeat the enemy and capture that convoy.
dst: 但现在我们的弹药和其他补给快耗尽了，所以我们必须更主动一些。一支庞大的英军运输队正由700名士兵护送，前往克莱克斯多普。我们必须击败敌军并夺取那支运输队。

src: But something strange happened during the signature of the treaty. The text of the article 17 wasn't the same in the Italian and the Ahmaric versions. The text that Menelik signed just said that Ethiopia could conduct its foreign affairs through the Italians. According to the version that the Italian delegate signed, Ethiopia had the obligation to do so. In practice, that second version of the treaty established an Italian protectorate over Ethiopia.
dst: 但在条约签订过程中发生了一件怪事。第17条的文本在意大利文版和阿姆哈拉文版中并不相同。孟尼利克签署的文本只说，埃塞俄比亚可以通过意大利人处理其外交事务。而根据意大利代表签署的版本，埃塞俄比亚则有义务这样做。实际上，那第二个版本确立了意大利对埃塞俄比亚的保护关系。

src: But still we are not enough men, so we have to flee from here. At Rhine and Neckar we will surely find a lot of supporters...
dst: 但我们人手依然不足，所以必须从这里撤离。在莱茵河和内卡河一带，我们一定能找到许多支持者……

src: But that can wait a little longer. Now it's time for you to take some deserved rest. You and your courageous men must recover well.
dst: 不过那可以稍后再办。现在该是您好好休息的时候了。您和您的英勇部下必须好好休整。

src: But that isn't our worst problem. That one, paradoxically, has been caused by our own artillery. The bombardment has been so heavy that the terrain has become impracticable. Our troops can hardly move on the conquered ground, and they won't be able to take all the relevant defensive points before the French reinforcements arrive. So when the enemy deploys its reserves, our own soldiers will be exposed to artillery fire, too. They won't be safe and we'll suffer many casualties.
dst: 但这还不是我们最糟的问题。最糟的那个，说来矛盾，恰恰是我们自己的炮兵造成的。炮击如此猛烈，以致地形变得无法通行。我们的部队在占领的土地上几乎寸步难行，无法在法军增援到达之前夺取所有关键防御要点。因此，当敌人部署其预备队时，我们自己的士兵也将暴露在炮火之下。他们将不再安全，我们会遭受大量伤亡。

src: But that strategy was very dangerous. The German advance had been so fast that they didn't have been able to secure their flanks. As a consequence, their supply lines had become scarce and overstretched, that is say, vulnerable and easy to disrupt. Still worse, north, west and south of the positions that the German attackers were holding there were still large areas under enemy control, where the French were quickly raising new armies. Finally, many Prussian regiments were still stuck at Metz, unable to help in Paris.
dst: 但这一战略非常危险。德军的推进太快，以至于没能确保两翼的安全。结果，他们的补给线变得匮乏而过度拉伸，也就是说，脆弱且易于被切断。更糟的是，在德军进攻部队所据阵地的北、西、南三面，仍有大片地区处于敌人控制之下，法国人正在那里迅速组建新的军队。最后，许多普鲁士团仍被困于梅斯，无法支援巴黎。

src: But that was soon going to change. General Roberts was appointed as overall Commander-in-Chief in South Africa. He came with General Kitchener as Chief of Staff, and with tens of thousands of reinforcement troops from all parts of the Empire. The days of Boer independence were numbered.
dst: 但这一切很快就要改变。罗伯茨将军被任命为南非全军总司令。他与担任参谋长的基钦纳将军一同前来，还带来了来自帝国各地的数万名增援部队。布尔人独立的日子屈指可数了。

src: But the Belgians won’t resign to their fate, either. If they are forced to fight in a war that they can’t avoid, so it will be. Very soon, their small army will gain the respect of friends and foes. Many years ago, they didn’t stop until they expelled the Arabs from the Congo and the Mahdists from Lado. Now they’ll stop at nothing until the German invaders leave their homeland.
dst: 但比利时人也不会向命运屈服。如果他们被迫卷入一场无法避免的战争，那就让它来吧。很快，他们这支小小的军队将赢得朋友和敌人的尊重。多年前，他们不达目的誓不罢休，把阿拉伯人赶出了刚果，把马赫迪派赶出了拉多。如今，他们将不择手段，直到德国侵略者离开他们的家园。

src: But the Berbers from the Rif din´t want to live under the rule of the Spanish protectorate. Lead by the Cadi, Abd el-Krim al Jatabbi, a former employee of the colonial administration in the Office of Indigenous Affairs in Melilla who had been educated in Spain, and leader of the Beni Urriaguel tribe.
dst: 但里夫的柏柏尔人不愿生活在西班牙保护地的统治之下。领导他们的是卡迪阿卜杜·克里姆·哈塔比，他曾是梅利利亚殖民地当局土著事务局的一名职员，在西班牙接受过教育，也是贝尼乌里亚格勒部落的首领。

src: But the Ireland-campaign is successfully completed and your forces will relocated to France. After a deserved rest, prepare your troops for an operation in Spain, Gibraltar is still held by so-called free-British forces. This operation is scheduled early next year.
dst: 但爱尔兰战役已经胜利结束，你的部队将调往法国。经过应得的休整后，为在西班牙的行动做好准备——直布罗陀仍被所谓的自由不列颠部队占据。这次行动定于明年初进行。

src: But the Prussians were much faster. In the last week of June, three Prussians armies entered Bohemia from the north and the west, and defeated the Austrians in a series of skirmishes. The Austrian I Corps and the Saxonian Army, in danger of being attacked from different sides, retreated from the line of the Iser and tried to establish a defensive position in the hills north and west of Gitschin, where they hoped that they could resist the Prussians long enough, giving the main Austrian forces (the bulk of the Nord Armee) time to join them.
dst: 但普鲁士人要快得多。6月的最后一周，三支普鲁士军队从北面和西面进入波希米亚，在一系列遭遇战中击败了奥地利人。奥地利第1军和萨克森军队面临着腹背受敌的危险，于是从伊泽尔河一线撤退，试图在吉钦以北和以西的山丘上建立防御阵地，希望能在那里拖住普鲁士人足够长的时间，让奥地利主力部队（北方军团的主力）有时间前来会合。

src: But the aggressive neighbours tried to exploit the perceived Polish weaknesses and took over the territory.
dst: 但好斗的邻国们却企图利用它们眼中波兰的软弱，侵占了其领土。

src: But the biggest danger were the communists who already killed millions of Russians and wanted to export communism to Europe, over the dead body of Poland.
dst: 但最大的危险是共产主义者，他们已经杀害了数百万俄国人，还想跨过波兰的尸体把共产主义输出到欧洲。

src: But the conquest of Baku will be no easy - the entrenched Russians have a strong air defense and will fight to the last breath!
dst: 但征服巴库绝非易事——据守的俄国人拥有强大的防空力量，将战斗到最后一刻！

src: But the danger is not yet averted...
But the decision is already made, General. Now you must choose if you'll fight against Serbia and Montenegro or against Greece.
dst: 但决定已经作出，将军。现在您必须选择是与塞尔维亚和黑山作战，还是与希腊作战。

src: But the enemy will come again. The republican army outnumbers us. We can only hope for a miracle and that the political situation in Spain changes favorably to our interests.
dst: 但敌人还会再来。共和军在人数上超过我们。我们只能指望奇迹，指望西班牙的政治局势朝有利于我们的方向转变。

src: But the hope of Gaul has a name:
dst: 但高卢的希望有一个名字：

src: But the main German spring offensive still has to start. I however expect that not we, but the French and British armies will be at the receiving end of it. Let's hope that they will hold out until enough American forces reach France to win this war.
dst: 但德军春季攻势的主攻尚未开始。不过我预计，承受它的不是我们，而是法军和英军。让我们期望他们能坚持到足够的美国部队抵达法国，从而打赢这场战争。

src: But the point is that Denikin is well aware of May-Mayevsky's behaviour and thinks that things can't go on like that, so he decided to send an officer who would demand the highest standards of discipline. And he chose me.
dst: 但关键在于，邓尼金深知迈-马耶夫斯基的行径，认为事情不能再这样下去，于是决定派一位会要求最严明纪律的军官前往。而他选择了我。

src: But the war doesn't end here. The Berber rebellion still goes on, and now that they have a brilliant commander I'm afraid that things are going to become difficult.
dst: 但战争并未就此结束。柏柏尔人的叛乱仍在继续，而如今他们有了一个杰出的指挥官，恐怕局势将变得艰难起来。

src: But the war doesn't end here. The Berber rebellion still goes on, and now that they have a competent commander I'm afraid that things are going to become difficult.
dst: 但战争并未就此结束。柏柏尔人的叛乱仍在继续，而如今他们有了一个能干的指挥官，恐怕局势将变得艰难起来。

src: But the war is far from over.The enemy will sent massive reinforcements very soon, so you must be ready for even harder battles. Colesberg will be your next destination.
dst: 但战争远未结束。敌人很快就会派出大批增援，所以您必须准备好迎接更加艰苦的战斗。科尔斯堡将是您的下一站。

src: But the worst consequence of war will be the social unrest. Our people are hungry, and post-war will be terrible for them. I fear that communist revolutionaries will take advantage of this and will try to seize power.
dst: 但战争最糟糕的后果将是社会动荡。我们的人民在挨饿，战后他们的日子会非常艰难。我担心共产主义革命者会利用这一点，企图夺取政权。

src: But the worst consequence of war will be the social unrest. Our people are hungry, and post-war will be terrible for them. I fear that communist revolutionaries will take advantage of this and will try to seize power. People like you will be indispensable in saving our country from chaos in the near future.
dst: 但战争最严重的后果将是社会动荡。我们的人民饥肠辘辘，战后岁月对他们而言将十分艰难。我担心共产主义革命者会利用这一点，企图夺取政权。在不久的将来，像您这样的人将在拯救国家免于混乱的斗争中不可或缺。

src: But then, when we were very close to our destination, we learnt that there had been another Socialist-Revolutionary uprising in Irkutsk. The Czechs, pretending to be looking for a peaceful solution, had captured Kolchak and they were determined to hand him over to anyone who could grant them a safe passage to Vladivostok. Our garrisons and the cossack volunteers had been defeated by the Socialists or had switched sides. We were Kolchak's last and only hope. Kappel ordered us to go faster. We had to arrive in Irkutsk before it was too late.
dst: 但后来，就在我们离目的地很近时，我们得知伊尔库茨克又爆发了一场社会革命党人的起义。捷克人假装寻求和平解决，却扣押了高尔察克，并决意把他交给任何能保证他们安全前往符拉迪沃斯托克的人。我们的守备部队和哥萨克志愿兵要么被社会党人击败，要么倒戈。我们是高尔察克最后也是唯一的希望。卡佩尔命令我们加快速度。我们必须赶在一切太迟之前抵达伊尔库茨克。

src: But there are always TWO consuls .... I think the Romans will again use one of their favorite strategies: as we turn to the consular army in the plane, there will surely be a second in our back .....!
dst: 但执政官总有两个 .... 我想罗马人又会用他们最爱的那套：当我们转身对付平原上的执政官军团时，我们背后一定还会冒出第二个 .....！

src: But there was a last effort that we had to do. Most of the Second Red Army had gathered in Chistopol, and it had launched a new, desperate counteroffensive against us. I trusted my men, but I knew that the attack of our enemies was dangerous. If we didn't stop the communists Bugulma would fall, Ufa would be in danger, and all our front could fall apart. That could not happen. Not then. Not when the Volga was so near. We had to prevail.
dst: 但我们还须做最后一次努力。第二红军的大部分兵力已集结在奇斯托波尔，并向我们发动了一场新的、孤注一掷的反攻。我信任我的士兵，但我知道敌人的进攻很危险。如果我们不能阻止共产党人，布古利马就会失守，乌法就会陷入危险，整条战线都可能崩溃。那绝不能发生。不能是现在。不能是在伏尔加河近在咫尺的时候。我们必须获胜。

src: But there was very little that a single man could do. Many christians, mostly Chinese natives, were murdered. Arson, looting and all kinds of depravity were so common that the foreign diplomats, fearing for their lives, requested the presence of Western soldiers in the Peking legations. The petition was granted, and the deployment of the defence forces started in June. But it was too late for peace. On June 11, after some Germans executed a member of the Yihetuan, thousands of rioters, as well as the Kansu Braves, an elite unit of muslim Qing soldiers, stormed Peking burning, looting and murdering. Soon the foreign diplomats, along with some Chinese servants, local christians and a handful of soldiers, were surrounded in the legations by thousands of violent enemies.
dst: 但一个人能做的实在有限。许多基督徒——大多是本地中国人——遭到杀害。纵火、抢劫以及种种暴行如此普遍，以至于各国公使因担心生命安全而要求西方士兵进驻北京的使馆区。请求得到了准许，防御部队于6月开始部署。但为时已晚，和平已无望。6月11日，在一些德国人处决了一名义和团成员之后，数千名暴乱者以及甘军——一支由清军穆斯林组成的精锐部队——冲入北京，纵火、抢劫、杀人。很快，各国公使连同一些中国仆人、本地基督徒和少量士兵，被成千上万凶暴的敌人包围在使馆区内。

src: But there's very good news, too ! The People of Baden and their whole army, except the High Command, has joined again our side!
dst: 但也有非常好的消息！巴登人民及其整个军队——除最高统帅部外——已重新站到我们这一边！

src: But this may not concern you anymore. ..
dst: 但这或许已与您无关了……

src: But this time, again, we have built a defense line at the Marne. My men and I have arrived just in time.
dst: 但这一次，我们又在马恩河建立了防线。我和我的士兵们刚好及时赶到。

src: But those weren't the reasons. I stayed because, in Tonkin, I had the impression that I was living the beginning of a great change in history. China had been a powerful country, a mighty dragon, but for many years that dragon had been postrated, as if it was the victim of a magical sleep. In Tonkin I convinced myself that the dragon was awakening, and that soon we'll see its power again. I didn't know how that adventure would end, but I wanted to be there when it happened.
dst: 但那些并不是原因。我留下来，是因为在北圻，我有一种感觉：我正亲身经历一场伟大历史变革的开端。中国曾是一个强大的国家，一条巨龙，但许多年来，那条龙一直倒伏在地，仿佛中了魔法的沉睡。在北圻，我说服了自己：那条龙正在苏醒，不久我们就会再次看到它的威力。我不知道那场冒险会如何收场，但我希望当它发生时，我能在场。

src: But to your fortune, the enemy has withdrawn and there are no enemy forces between Alexandria and our troops anymore - the depots in Mersa Matruh are full! Supply you troops, refuel the vehicle and make your way to Alexandria!
dst: 但让你走运的是，敌人已经撤退，亚历山大与我军之间已无敌军——梅尔萨马特鲁的仓库满满当当！补给你的部队，给车辆加满油，向亚历山大进发！

src: But we are in a good strategical position, and the Baden Army has joined our side...
dst: 但我们占据了有利的战略位置，而且巴登军队已经加入我们这边……

src: But we are not defeated yet!  While the White armies of Denikin march north, their front becomes wider and wider.  Our Eight Army has just now lost the city of Voronezh at the Don River.  However the army is still intact and resumes fighting.  Reinforcements from Moscow are on their way as we speak!  Your newly formed command of the First Cavalry Army has been ordered to move out and attack Voronezh from the west.  Indeed comrade, you will be cutting through their flank like a knife through butter!
dst: 但我们还没有被打败！当邓尼金的白卫军向北推进时，他们的战线越拉越宽。我第八集团军刚刚丢失了顿河畔的沃罗涅日城。不过部队建制仍然完整，正在继续作战。莫斯科的增援此刻正在赶来！您新组建的第一骑兵集团军指挥部已奉命出动，从西面进攻沃罗涅日。的确，同志，您将如快刀切黄油般撕裂他们的侧翼！

src: But we can't stop now! We must continue our counteroffensive and recover all of the territories lost to the Russians in the last months. Your next destination will be the Niemen River.
dst: 但我们现在不能停下！我们必须继续反攻，收复过去几个月里被俄国人夺走的所有领土。您的下一个目的地将是涅曼河。

src: But we haven't spent this time just sitting on our hands. We have built an impressive line of trenches at Magersfontein, which will help you on your mission. Now use your skills and hold the line. The Kakies must not pass.The Kakies will not pass.
dst: 但这段日子我们也没闲着。我们已在马赫斯方丹构筑了一条了不起的战壕防线，它将助您完成任务。现在施展您的本领，守住防线。英国佬绝不能通过。英国佬不会通过。

src: But we will not fall into their trap. While the bulk of the Northern Army occupies strategic positions on the outskirts of Madrid, we have ordered you to be diverted east to Guadalajara, where you will link with the Carlist units from Cataluña and Levante that the Infante Alfonso, the younger brother of Carlos VII, leads.
dst: 但我们不会落入他们的圈套。在北方集团军主力占领马德里郊外战略要地的同时，我们已命令您向东转进至瓜达拉哈拉，在那里与卡洛斯七世的弟弟阿方索王子率领的加泰罗尼亚和莱万特卡洛斯党部队会合。

src: But what's even worse is that the Turks will take a lot of motivation out of their victory and their determination to defend the Gaza-Beersheba line will be much greater now than it has been before.
dst: 但更糟的是，土耳其人将从这次胜利中汲取极大的士气，他们保卫加沙-贝尔谢巴防线的决心将比以往更坚定。

src: But while you were driving the Allies into the sea, the Bolsheviks treacherously broke our peace treaty and invaded our allied territories in Eastern Europe. With the bulk of our forces involved on the Western Front and in Afrika they have been able to pollute the sacred soil of the Fatherland and penetrate almost to Berlin! You MUST stop them immediately.
dst: 但就在你把盟军赶下海的同时，布尔什维克背信弃义地撕毁了我们的和平条约，入侵了我们在东欧的盟国领土。趁我军主力深陷西线与非洲战场，他们得以践踏祖国神圣的国土，并已推进到几乎抵达柏林！你必须立即阻止他们。

src: But wisdom was a virtue that I lacked at a younger age. I wanted to enjoy all the pleasures that destiny seeemed to offer me, wether they were expensive drinks, gambling, or the company of beautiful women. I guess that I was what you could call a rake. My way of living led to one scandal after the other, each of them more difficult to hide than the previous one. Eventually my problems became really serious. One of my indiscretions could well have taken me to prison. At the very least, it could have meant my dishonourable discharge from the army, and a source of perpetual shame for my family. Before anything of that could happen, I managed to make a last time agreement: I would resign from the army and I'd board the first ship to the colonies, where I'd spend some years until everything was forgotten and I could return.
dst: 但在我年轻的时候，智慧是我所缺乏的一种美德。我想享受命运似乎要赐予我的一切欢愉，无论是昂贵的酒水、赌博，还是漂亮女人的陪伴。我想，我就是人们所说的那种浪荡子。我的生活方式引发了一桩接一桩的丑闻，每一桩都比前一桩更难遮掩。最终，我的麻烦变得十分严重。我的一次失检之举本可能把我送进监狱。至少，那可能意味着我被军队开除军籍，并成为我家族永远蒙羞的根源。在这一切发生之前，我设法达成了一个最后的约定：我将辞去军职，登上第一班开往殖民地的船，在那里待上几年，直到一切被遗忘，我再回来。

src: But you will have little time for celebration, you are to report to Sicily for your next asignment in two days.
dst: 但你没什么时间庆祝，你将在两天后到西西里报到，接受下一个任务。

src: But, after all, we didn't enter the war to conquer more land. We just wanted to preserve the Empire and destroy our enemies, and we have achieved both goals. We have survived. That's what we wanted, isn't it?
dst: 但归根结底，我们参战并不是为了征服更多的土地。我们只是想保住帝国、消灭敌人，而这两个目标我们都已实现。我们活了下来。这正是我们想要的，不是吗？

src: But, although it's somewhat annoying, I won't be able to enjoy my victory. Not all the news from Ukraine are good. Nestor Makhno and his army of anarchist peasants want to help the Reds now, and they have invaded Western Ukraine. We just have a handful of soldiers in that area, and our supply lines are too long and very vulnerable, so Makhno could make us a lot of damage, even threatening our offensive on Moscow. I must go to Uman and put an end to this menace.
dst: 但是，尽管有些令人不快，我却无暇享受胜利。来自乌克兰的消息并不都好。涅斯托尔·马赫诺和他那支无政府主义农民军队如今想帮助红军，他们已经入侵了乌克兰西部。我们在那一带只有少数士兵，补给线过长且极易受攻击，因此马赫诺可能给我们造成巨大损失，甚至威胁到我们对莫斯科的攻势。我必须前往乌曼，消除这一威胁。

src: But, before sending the bulk of the American Expeditionary Forces to the front, the French want to make sure that we're capable of beating the Germans. So we must make a test and prove our ability. Your mission is to retake the village of Cantigny. That's where the Krauts stopped their first spring drive, and reducing the salient will be a blow for their morale. Go ahead and teach the Germans a lesson. The French will provide aerial and artillery coverage.
dst: 但是，在把美国远征军的主力派往前线之前，法国人想先确认我们有能力打败德国人。所以我们必须接受一次考验，证明我们的实力。您的任务是夺回康蒂尼村。那里正是德国佬第一次春季攻势受阻的地方，削弱这个突出部将沉重打击他们的士气。去吧，给德国人一个教训。法国人会提供空中掩护和炮火支援。

src: But, confidentially, I must tell you that the situation is far worse than we expected. Although Symon Petliura thought that there would be a Ukrainian patriotic uprising against the Russians, most of the population is indifferent at best. We won't have any strong support from the locals.
dst: 不过，我得私下告诉您，局势远比我们预想的糟糕。尽管西蒙·彼得留拉以为会爆发反对俄国人的乌克兰爱国起义，但大多数民众充其量只是漠不关心。我们将得不到当地人的有力支持。

src: But, do we want to run away forever and be eaten away by diseases in the cold of the northern countrys ?
dst: 可是，我们要永远逃亡下去，在北方寒冷的国度里被疾病侵蚀吗？

src: But, of course, there is a great problem with defensive victories: Sooner or later they'll end in our final defeat. Eventually the enemy will find the way to surprise us. We must act before that happens, but what can we do? We have numerical inferiority and the front line is too long. For us, attempting a breakthrough is out of the question. The OHL is thinking about a possible solution, and maybe next year we'll know their decision.
dst: 但防御性的胜利当然有个大问题：它们迟早会以我们的最终失败告终。敌人终会找到出奇制胜的办法。我们必须在那之前采取行动，可我们又能做什么呢？我们兵力处于劣势，战线又太长。对我们来说，尝试突破根本无从谈起。最高陆军指挥部正在考虑一个可能的解决方案，也许明年我们就会知道他们的决定。

src: But, right now, we need to talk, General. The future of the Empire is at stake. We need commanders who don't make serious mistakes. Your performance at Marasesti has been far from optimal. Given your service record, you'll be assigned to a prestigious position in Wien. Well paid, but far from the front line. I'm afraid that those days are over for you.
dst: 但是，眼下我们需要谈谈，将军。帝国的前途危在旦夕。我们需要不会犯严重错误的指挥官。您在马勒什蒂的表现远非最佳。鉴于您的服役记录，您将获得一个派驻维也纳的显赫职位。薪水优厚，但远离前线。恐怕那些日子对您而言已经结束了。

src: But, south of Perm, the 5th Army continued its advance, and on December 31st we had to evacuate Ufa. Knowing the strategical importance of that city, a few days later Kolchak ordered us to counterattack.
dst: 但在彼尔姆以南，第五集团军继续推进，12月31日我们不得不撤离乌法。深知该城的战略意义，几天后高尔察克命令我们发动反攻。

src: But, things won't be easy general. The enemy troops deployed here are not a big problem, but as soon as we reach Kokoda, we are sure the Australians will send reinforcements to avoid the fall of his main forward base at New Guinea. Another problem is the jungle with the tropical diseases, and the poor supplies you will receive... anyway we count on you to defeat the enemy one time more, here.
dst: 但是将军，事情不会一帆风顺。部署在这里的敌军部队不是什么大麻烦，但一旦我们抵达科科达，我们确信澳大利亚人一定会派出援军，以防他们新几内亚的主要前进基地陷落。另一个难题是丛林中的热带疾病，以及您将获得的匮乏补给……无论如何，我们指望您在这里再一次击败敌人。

src: But, this mutiny has given us a welcome pretext to take over the British naval units in Le Havre into our Kriegsmarine. The damaged ships can obviously be repaired and after some time be ready for use again. Your troops are now transferred to Spain to carry out the planned operation against Gibraltar.
dst: 不过，这次哗变给了我们一个受欢迎的借口，把勒阿弗尔的英国海军舰艇收编进我们的德国海军。受损的军舰显然可以修复，一段时间后就能重新投入使用。你的部队现在调往西班牙，执行进攻直布罗陀的计划。

src: But, what choice do we have?  We must hit them with everything we can muster!  Go!  Prepare your men, YOU attack across the entire sector tomorrow!
dst: 但是，我们还有什么选择？我们必须倾尽所能打击他们！去吧！准备你的部队，明天你在整个地段发起进攻！
购买一个带运输工具的机枪部队。

src: Buy a cavalry. You can name it as "1. pu³k u³anów legionowych", or "1. pu".
dst: 购买一个骑兵部队。您可以将它命名为「军团第1枪骑兵团」，或简称「第1枪骑兵团」。

src: Buy a second infantry. You can name it as "5. pu³k piechoty legionów", or "5. pp".
dst: 购买第二个步兵部队。您可以将它命名为「军团第5步兵团」，或简称「第5步兵团」。
布祖卢克捷克斯洛伐克营地

src: By 1917 the once mighty Kavkaz Army was reduced to a series of garrisons, totaling several tens of thousands of men:  the European fronts of the war continued to devour our troops.  In the summer of 1917 Turkey resumed the offensive:  only to be halted by an emerging Armenian army in 1919.
dst: 到1917年，昔日强大的高加索集团军已缩减为一系列守备部队，总兵力仅剩数万人：欧洲战场持续吞噬着我们的部队。1917年夏，土耳其再度发动攻势，结果在1919年被一支新生的亚美尼亚军队所阻挡。

src: By 7 January , the British troops had already been reduced to 19,000. The Turks were well aware of the forthcoming evacuation and mounted a last attack by their XIV Corps under cover of the heaviest bombardment of the campaign. The attack failed almost before it had begun. Many Turks simply refused to advance, as if, after months of heroism, their will had finally given out.
dst: 到1月7日，英军已减员至19000人。土耳其人很清楚撤退即将进行，遂以其第14军发动了最后一次进攻，并以整场战役中最猛烈的炮击作掩护。这次进攻几乎还没开始就失败了。许多土耳其士兵干脆拒绝前进，仿佛在经历了数月的英勇奋战之后，他们的意志终于崩溃了。

src: By Chief Photographer's Mate (CPHoM) Robert F. Sargent.
dst: 摄影：首席摄影师助理（CPHoM）罗伯特·F·萨金特。

src: By December 1, the fighting for Jerusalem was almost over.
dst: 到12月1日，争夺耶路撒冷的战斗已接近尾声。

src: By Jove! A great victory! Caesar called us one of his best generals!
dst: 朱庇特在上！一场大胜！凯撒称我们是他的最佳将领之一！

dst: 摄影：马林丁 E G（上尉），第5陆军电影与摄影分队。

src: By September 18, the Soviet 53th Army and the 18th Tank Corps arrived in the area and routed the desperate Hungarian divisions within two days. The last Hungarian troops retreated from Arad on September 21. The following day the Red Army crossed the border and Hungary became a battlefield for months.
dst: 到9月18日，苏军第53集团军和第18坦克军抵达该地，两天内击溃了拼死抵抗的匈牙利各师。最后一批匈牙利部队于9月21日从阿拉德撤退。次日红军越过边境，匈牙利在接下来的数月里沦为战场。
摄影：威廉·斯潘格尔中士。

src: By getting a BV you will fight on the battles of Brunete and Belchite. Otherwise, get a V if you want to go to defeat the Republican resistance in the North, in this case you will fight in Euzkadi and Asturias.
dst: 取得 BV 后，您将在布鲁内特和贝尔奇特作战。否则，若想前往北部击溃共和军的抵抗，则取得 V，这样您将在巴斯克和阿斯图里亚斯作战。

src: By god, Commander, we did it!  We've restored the future!
dst: 老天啊，指挥官，我们做到了！我们恢复了未来！

src: By late 1914, the Western Front had effectively become fixed. Trench-lines ran from Flanders to the Swiss border, and already it was obvious that a rapid decisive victory was unlikely. A new front was desperately needed. Turkey had joined the Central Powers in October and, by controlling the Dardanelles, blocked Russia's main supply route through the Mediterranean Sea. When the Tsar appealed for help after serious defeats on the Eastern Front, the Entente powers agreed that a combined British and French operation against the Dardanelles should relieve the pressure on their Eastern ally. However, the naval attacks in March 1915 failed, and it became clear that ground troops were necessary to gain control over the Dardanelles.
dst: 到1914年末，西线实际上已陷入僵局。堑壕线从佛兰德斯一直延伸到瑞士边境，人们已经明显看出，迅速取得决定性胜利已不可能。急需开辟一条新战线。土耳其于10月加入同盟国，并通过控制达达尼尔海峡，切断了俄国经地中海的主要补给线。当沙皇在东线遭受惨败后请求援助时，协约国同意对达达尼尔海峡发动一次英法联合行动，以缓解其东方盟友的压力。然而，1915年3月的海上进攻失败了，事实表明，必须动用地面部队才能控制达达尼尔海峡。

src: By pure chance the first ship that I found was about to sail to Hong Kong, where I arrived before the end of 1883. Just a few weeks after my arrival I befriended an important Chinese official in one of the many dens of iniquity of Hong Kong. He was in charge of some of the local militias in Southern China and, learning about my past as a British officer, he offered me a job as his personal assistant. He was really eager to transform his ill-equipped bunch of indisciplined peasants into a modern, well trained army, and I happened to be the kind of person that he was looking for. Since I didn't have any other means of living I accepted his offer, and that's how I started to serve the Qing Empire.
dst: 纯属偶然，我找到的第一班船正要驶往香港，我在1883年年底之前抵达了那里。到达仅仅几周后，我就在香港众多藏污纳垢的场所之一里结识了一位重要的中国官员。他负责中国南方的几支地方团练，在得知我曾是英国军官后，便聘我当他的私人助理。他一心要把自己那支装备简陋、纪律涣散的农民队伍改造成一支训练有素的现代化军队，而我恰好就是他所需要的那种人。由于我没有其他谋生手段，便接受了他的提议，就这样，我开始为大清帝国效力。

src: By reaching the Gulf of Riga, Soviet summer offensive cut off the lines between Army Group North and Army Group Centre. This is a major disaster, and the connection must be renewed immediatelly. That's the goal of the hastily planned offensive and you'll take a part in it.
dst: 苏军夏季攻势推进到里加湾，切断了北方集团军群与中央集团军群之间的联系。这是场大灾难，必须立即恢复连接。这就是这场仓促策划的攻势之目标，你将参与其中。

src: By that time, an armistice had been concluded. Had Spanish Governor Jaudenes been kept better informed, he could have longer preserved the city under Spanish control, thus rendering it a useful card in subsequent peace negotiations.
dst: 到那时，停战协定已经缔结。如果西班牙总督豪德内斯能更及时地获得情报，他本可以更久地守住马尼拉，从而使其成为后续和平谈判中一张有用的牌。

src: By the end of 1916 the British had occupied the coastal towns of Lindi and Kilwa in German East Africa. From there they advanced into the mountain areas of Kibata and Narungombe. The Germans feared that from their positions at Kibata the British could take Liwale thus cutting the German escape route.  This caused Von Lettow-Vorbeck to order an assault against Kibata at the beginning of December.  It was strongly defended by veteran British colonial troops like the Gold Coast Regiment.
dst: 到1916年底，英军已占领德属东非沿海城镇林迪和基尔瓦。他们从那里推进到基巴塔和纳伦贡贝的山区。德军担心，英军从其在基巴塔的阵地出发可以攻占利瓦莱，从而切断德军的退路。这使得冯·莱托-福尔贝克于12月初下令对基巴塔发动突击。该地由黄金海岸团等久经沙场的英国殖民部队严密防守。

src: By the end of 1919 the White armies in Siberia, western Russia and the Ukraine had been contained and defeated by the victorious Red Army.  Although isolated troops and bands continued to roam around, the only organized resistance was put up by General Wrangel on the Crimea.  However, with peace so close by for the Bolshevik government, the tide seemed to turn again and not for the better...
dst: 到1919年底，西伯利亚、俄西部和乌克兰的白卫军已被胜利的红军牵制和击败。尽管仍有零星的部队和匪帮四处流窜，唯一有组织的抵抗只有弗兰格尔将军在克里米亚的部队。然而，就在布尔什维克政权的和平近在咫尺之际，局势似乎又起了波折，而且不是向好的方向……

src: By the end of 1919, General Smigly-Rydz decided to conduct a limited operation in the most distant northeastern front against the Red Army which occupied Dyneburg, the town that the Latvians called Daugavpils. Their goals were to link with the Latvians, secure their young independence, and to break the communication between the Bolsheviks and the Lithunian government in Kowno.
dst: 到1919年底，希米格维-雷兹将军决定在最偏远的东北战线发动一次有限行动，打击占领了德文斯克的红军——这座城市拉脱维亚人称之为陶格夫匹尔斯。他们的目标是与拉脱维亚人会合，巩固其年轻的独立，并切断布尔什维克与考纳斯立陶宛政府之间的联系。

src: By the end of the 19th century most of Spanish former possessions had been lost, mainly when its territories in the Americas got their independence. However, in 1898 Spain still had important possessions in the Caribbean (Cuba and Puerto Rico) and the Pacific (the Philippines, Guam and many other Pacific islands), the former considered as part of Spain itself with the status of provinces.
dst: 到19世纪末，西班牙昔日的大部分属地已丧失，主要是在其美洲领土获得独立之时。然而，1898年西班牙在加勒比地区（古巴和波多黎各）以及太平洋地区（菲律宾、关岛和许多其他太平洋岛屿）仍拥有重要领地，其中前者被视为西班牙本土的一部分，享有行省地位。

src: By the middle of April, our offensive was progressing very well. After recovering Sterlitamak, Meleuz and Belebei, Bugulma and Buguruslan were the next important towns that were taken on our way to the Volga. But our advance had some vulnerable points, and Orenburg, on our left flank, was the most critical one.
dst: 到4月中旬，我们的攻势进展顺利。在收复斯捷尔利塔马克、梅列乌兹和别列别伊之后，布古利马和布古鲁斯兰是我们通往伏尔加河路上要夺取的下一批重镇。但我们的推进存在一些薄弱环节，而左翼的奥伦堡是最关键的一处。

src: By the summer of 1918, the Germans had failed to conquer France. In autumn, the Entente army under General Frenchet d'Esperey overran the Balkans. This took Bulgaria, Turkey, Hungary and Austria out of the war. Also, the Germans had to sign a ceasefire agreement. The Great War was over.
dst: 到1918年夏，德国人已未能征服法国。秋天，弗朗谢·德斯佩雷将军麾下的协约国军队席卷了巴尔干。这使保加利亚、土耳其、匈牙利和奥地利退出了战争。此外，德国人也不得不签署停战协议。大战结束了。

src: By the way as commander he knows the strengths and weaknesses of the roman army very well...
dst: 顺带说，作为指挥官，他对罗马军队的强弱点知道得非常清楚...

src: By the way, I heard rumors that General Murray is going to be relieved from his post after these two disastrous battles. Hopefully, our next commander in chief will do better.
dst: 顺便说一句，我听说有传言说，穆雷将军在这两次惨败之后将被解除职务。希望我们的下一任总司令能做得更好。

src: By the way, I've met a interesting young american officer. I think that his name was Patton. He has real interesting ideas about tank warfare.
dst: 顺便说一句，我遇到了一位有趣的年轻美国军官。我想他的名字叫巴顿。他对坦克战有一些真正有趣的想法。

src: By the way, did you know that our old enemy El Raisuli has been taken prisoner by Abd el-Krim? It seems that he hates Abd el-Krim and in the end he wanted to make a deal with us, but he came too late. El Raisuli's health is poor so I don't think he will survive for long in prison.
dst: 顺便说一句，您知道吗，我们的老对手赖苏利已被阿卜杜勒·克里姆俘虏了？看来他痛恨阿卜杜勒·克里姆，最后还想与我们达成交易，但他来得太迟了。赖苏利健康状况很差，所以我想他在狱中撑不了多久。

src: By the way, von Lettow-Vorbeck is the only German general of both wars, who is buried in the Federal Republic of Germany with military honors.
dst: 顺便一提，冯·莱托-福贝克是两次大战中唯一一位以军礼安葬于德意志联邦共和国的德国将军。

src: Caesar knew this would be his last stand as they had run out of supplies and with no lines of retreat they would be at Pompey's mercy and likely slaughtered if they lost the battle. This "nothing to lose" mentality was played up by Caesar to his men as he explained that defeat meant nothing less than death. Caesar also deployed in three lines but could only set them to six men deep if he was to match the length of Pompey's line. Like Pompey he was protected by the river on his left allowing him to position all his cavalry to the right as a counter. As was typical of Caesar he gambled and began discreetly thinning his already depleted ranks of men then repositioned them as a fourth line to support his cavalry against the inevitable assault by the much larger Pompeian cavalry. Caesar himself commanded the cavalry, he posted the notorious tenth legion on his right under Sulla, with the undermanned eighth and possibly the ninth on his left under Antonius. In the center he designated Domitius as the commanding officer. According to his accounts, he had 80 cohorts on the battlefield, about 22,000 men.
dst: 凯撒明白这将是他的背水一战，因为他们已耗尽补给，又无退路，一旦战败就只能任凭庞培宰割、多半会被屠戮。凯撒向部下渲染这种「无所可失」的心态，说明战败无异于死亡。凯撒同样排成三线，但若要抵上庞培战线的长度，只能把纵深压到六人。与庞培一样，他的左翼受河流掩护，使他能把全部骑兵摆在右翼作为反制。凯撒故技重施，先暗中抽稀本已单薄的队列，再把他们改列为第四线，用来支援骑兵抵挡人数远占优势的庞培骑兵必然发动的冲击。凯撒亲自指挥骑兵，把声名赫赫的第10军团置于右翼交由苏拉统领，左翼则由安东尼乌斯率领缺编的第八军团，可能还有第九军团。中路他指定多米提乌斯为指挥官。据他自己的记述，他在战场上共有80个步兵队，约22,000人。

src: Caesar lands twice in Britain : first in 55 BC, and the second time one year later in 54 BC ...
dst: 凯撒两次在不列颠登陆：第一次在公元前55年，一年后的公元前54年又第二次……

src: Caesar often crossed the Rhine and landed twice in Britain, whitch was a completely unexplored area for former romans,and militarily insignificant, but enormously prestigious for Caesar.
dst: 凯撒屡次渡过莱茵河，并两次在不列颠登陆；对从前的罗马人而言，那是完全未经探查的地区，军事上无足轻重，却能为凯撒带来巨大的声望。

src: Caesar thinks, that by doing so, we will cut off their last supply
dst: 凯撒认为，这样一来我们就能切断他们通往高卢的最后补给

src: Comandante, Blackshirts of the 1st CC.NN. Division "23 Marzo" are about to launch an attack on Fort Capuzzo. Once the Fort is ours, your forces should proceed along the coastal road further to the east and deeper into Egypt. Our main objective for this operation is Sidi Barrani.

src: Comandante, most of the Mediterranean Sea is under our control. The British have only few isolated bases in the east. Your next mission will be a raid on Alexandria. Our human torpedos of Decima Flottiglia MAS will attack and sink the powerful enemy battleships that are anchored in the ports of Alexandria in an heroic attack that will cause havoc amongst the British units. Your men then will make landfall and destroy enemy facilities and capture important objectives.
dst: 指挥官，地中海的大部分已处于我们控制之下。英国人在东部仅剩少数孤立基地。你的下一个任务将是对亚历山大的突袭。我们“第10轻型水面舰艇支队”的人操鱼雷将发起一次英勇的攻击，击沉锚泊在亚历山大港的强大敌舰，给英国部队造成一片混乱。随后你的部下将登陆，摧毁敌军设施并夺取重要目标。

src: Comandante, our great victory at Alexandria enables us to proceed further east and gives us the chance to capture the northern end of the Suez Canal at Port Said. We also need to secure important Canal port and city of Ismailia, deep in the desert. After most of the enemies units got crushed at Alexandria, we expect only local resistance.
dst: 指挥官，我们在亚历山大的伟大胜利使我们得以继续向东推进，并给了我们夺取苏伊士运河北端塞得港的机会。我们还必须控制沙漠深处的重要运河港口城市伊斯梅利亚。敌军大部分单位已在亚历山大被击溃，我们预计只会遇到局部抵抗。

src: Comandante, the Germans are about to launch a major sea- and airborne attack on Crete in the next days. You and your special forces will asisst our ally in this important operation. But before we attack Crete, we have an delicate mission for you and your men. The British have installed heavy coastal batteries on the island of Navarone. Our convoys have to pass the island and its guns on their way to Crete. Your orders are to infiltrate Navarone and destroy the heavily fortified guns and facilities on the island, as well as the Greek and British garrison.
dst: 指挥官，德军将在近日对克里特岛发动一场大规模海空进攻。你和你的特种部队将协助我们的盟友完成这一重要行动。但在我们进攻克里特之前，有一项微妙的任务要交给你和你的部下。英国人在纳瓦罗内岛上架设了重型海岸炮。我们的船队前往克里特途中必须经过该岛及其炮台。你的命令是潜入纳瓦罗内，摧毁岛上重兵设防的炮台与设施，以及希腊与英国守军。

src: Comandante, we are making good progress with our greek campaign. But before we proceed further down south we need to gain control of the Corinth Isthmus, a narrow land bridge which connects the Peloponnese peninsula with the rest of the mainland of Greece.
dst: 指挥官，我们的希腊战役进展顺利。但在我们继续南下之前，我们需要控制科林斯地峡，这是一条连接伯罗奔尼撒半岛与希腊大陆其余部分的狭窄陆桥。

src: Comandante, we got an radio transmition from our garrison at Siwa. They report that they are attacked by enemy forces! Comandante, your forces are the only italian forces in Egypt that are combat ready. Leave now, there is no time... Help our brothers!
dst: 指挥官，我们收到来自锡瓦守军的无线电通讯。他们报告正遭到敌军进攻！指挥官，你的部队是埃及境内唯一处于战备状态的意大利部队。现在就出发，没有时间了……救救我们的兄弟！

src: Comandante, you are ordered to command a small legion of combined arms, which is already on its way to Libya.
dst: 指挥官，你奉命指挥一支正在开赴利比亚的合成兵种小军团。

src: Comandante, you have been selected to take command of a small force of combined armes and ships to carry out special missions, naval battles and sea- and airborne landing operations on the islands and shores of the Mediterranean Sea in this semi-fictional campaign. dst: 指挥官，你已被选中统率一支由合成兵种与舰艇组成的小型部队，在这场半虚构战役中，于地中海诸岛与沿岸执行特种任务、海战以及海空登陆作战。请阅读下面的规则与设定。

dst: 扎什基夫周边的战斗发生在一片遍布地雷、铁丝网和机枪巢的泥泞地带。旅在戈尔内季基奇河畔和布济夫卡周围据守阵地。捷克斯洛伐克人奉命阻止德军对扎什基夫的任何进攻，从而堵住他们从苏军合围中逃脱的去路。

src: Combat operations in Lesser Fatra were not only bloody, but also extremely demanding when it comes to soldiers' physical and mental powers. The success of Mala Fatra operation says much about Czechoslovaks' capabilities.
dst: 小法特拉山的作战不仅血腥，对士兵的身心也是极大的考验。士兵们在海拔高达1000米的恶劣天气中，与顽强的敌人作战。小法特拉行动的成功充分说明了捷克斯洛伐克人的能力。

src: Commander Flecce Vygerr,1st SS 'Ilse,tank # 101 popped Her head out of the turret.Infantry was going by,the battle won."You there,You got a cigarette"."Sure Commander,here take the pack.You saved Our hides today.How many tanks You shoot up anyway"? Flecce hollered down into the Tiger "Beth,how many tanks We get today.5 destroyed and 2 immobilized,1 immobilized.I guess We knocked 6 out of action Frau.We are going to roll up this Front,Stalin can't stop Us now.Still going to take some time to get to Moscow but late summer or early fall We'll be at the Gates of Moscow.Of course You infantry will have to protect Us in the City street fighting from the Bolshevik infantry.I'm pretty sure Command won't be Stupid and send tanks in alone, even Tigers.I would think We would shell the Hell out of the Soviets and the Planes would drop Tons of Bombs before We go in anyway.The more Destruction I think makes the Fuhress happier.Shame they waited so long to get the Tigers here,We could've been half-way to Tosno by now and had fewer casulties.I imagine when the reports on what's happened here gets back to Stalin the Soviet Leader will be packing His suitcase just in case.Well,thanks for the cigarettes Frau,You better catch up with Your Squad and We better get back to the rear and get some Fuel and Ammo.Hopefully we'll meet in Moscow in a few months".
dst: 党卫军第1“伊尔泽”师指挥官弗莱切·维格尔，101号坦克的车长从炮塔里探出头来。步兵正从旁边经过，战斗已打赢。“你，有烟吗。”“当然，指挥官，这包拿着。你今天救了我们的命。你到底打掉了多少辆坦克？”弗莱切朝“虎”式里喊道：“贝丝，我们今天干掉几辆了。5辆击毁，2辆瘫痪，还有1辆瘫痪。我估计我们干掉了6辆，女士。我们要把这整条战线卷垮，斯大林现在挡不住我们了。到莫斯科还要些时间，但夏末或初秋我们就会到莫斯科城下。当然，巷战时你们步兵得保护我们，防着布尔什维克步兵。我确信司令部不会蠢到让坦克单独进城，就算是‘虎’式也一样。我想我们进城前会先把苏联人轰个半死，飞机也会投下成吨的炸弹。破坏得越多，我想女元首越高兴。可惜他们拖了这么久才把‘虎’式送到，不然我们现在可能已经到托斯诺半路了，伤亡也会少些。我想等这里的战况报告传到斯大林那儿，这位苏联领导人就该收拾行李箱以防万一了。好了，谢谢你的烟，女士，你快跟上班里吧，我们也得回后方加油补弹了。但愿几个月后能在莫斯科见。”

src: Commander wise Decision.The SS showing No Mercy to those in Warsaw will benefit Us.We have no Food to give to Civilians and cannot let them have stores of It while Our Armies are doing without.All Mankind is at risk here of the Bolsheviks taking over the World and only the SS aligned with the Whermacht can save It.Yes it is tough having to kill those who just want to live and be left alone but if You are not with Our Just Cause then You are against Us.If the Bolsheviks defeat Us the World is Theirs.Without Our Brave Troops battling them Who would,Amerika?Those in the United States are too Proud of themselves and too busy living the 'Good Life'.Our great German Scientist 'Heisenberg,Von'Braun and the Horten's are working to Seal the Amerikans Fate after We settle this Issue of who is 'Master in Europe'.Amerika has nothing but Fools running it and Our request for an Alliance was only answered by the threat We must not interfere with the Humanitarian Aid being sent to England.Amerika cannot stop the starving and dying on that miserable Brit isle.Amerika is pretending, sending Crums to the starving while gorging and becoming lazy and fat.Maybe a Year Amerika or two the fat will come to be Slaughtered as here in Warsaw.If You are not with Us,Yavolt?
dst: 指挥官，明智的决定。党卫军对华沙城内那些人毫不留情，对我们有利。我们没有食物可分给平民，也不能让他们囤着，而我军却在挨饿。全人类如今都面临布尔什维克统治世界的危险，只有与国防军联手的党卫军能拯救它。没错，杀掉那些只想活命、不想被打扰的人确实很残酷，但如果你不站在我们正义的事业一边，就是站在我们的对立面。如果布尔什维克打败了我们，世界就是他们的。没有我们英勇的部队与之作战，还能有谁，美国？美国那些人太自傲，又忙着过他们的“好日子”。等我们解决了谁“主宰欧洲”这个问题，我们伟大的德国科学家——海森堡、冯·布劳恩和霍顿姐妹——正在努力封死美国人的命运。美国掌权的只有一群蠢货，我们请求结盟，得到的答复只是威胁说我们不得干预运往英格兰的人道援助。美国阻止不了那个可怜的不列颠岛上的饥荒和死亡。美国在装样子，一边给饥饿者送去面包屑，一边自己大快朵颐、变得又懒又肥。也许再过一两年，这些肥肉也会像华沙这里一样被宰掉。你到底站在不站在我们这边？

src: Commander your couragous assault on Damascus has convinced the Turkish government into an unconditional surrender!!! The Anzac Mounted Division will return home as we believe the war in France is nearing an Armistace!! Thank you for your efforts here and enjoy your retirement!
dst: 指挥官，您对大马士革的英勇突击已促使土耳其政府无条件投降！！！澳新骑兵师将返回家乡，因为我们相信法国的战争已临近停战！！感谢您在这里的努力，好好享受退役生活吧！

src: Commander your objective is Polygon Wood, it is strongly held and is strategically important for an attack on Broodseinde Ridge. If you can take the outskirts of Zonnebeke this will be a bonus!!
dst: 指挥官，您的目标是波利贡森林，那里守备严密，对进攻布罗德赛恩德山脊具有重要战略意义。如果您能拿下佐内贝克的近郊，那就是意外之喜！！

src: Commander your objective is the city of Gaza, we need this vital communications and supply link for our upcoming offensive against the Turks in Jerusalem.
dst: 指挥官，您的目标是加沙城，我们需要这条关键的通讯与补给通道，以支撑我们即将对耶路撒冷土耳其人发起的攻势。

src: Commander, I'm sorry for keeping you in the dark.  My wounds from Aberdeen weren't lethal, but they incapacitated me long enough to keep me from attracting the attention of that deranged computer.  Once I realized what was going on I figured it would be better to lay low and find the right moment to strike.
dst: 指挥官，很抱歉一直瞒着你。我在阿伯丁受的伤并不致命，但它让我失能了足够长的时间，使我无法引起那台疯狂计算机的注意。一旦我弄明白发生了什么，我就觉得最好是潜伏下来，寻找合适的时机动手。

src: Commander, it is my duty to inform you that you have been dismissed from your position, as requested by the Corps commander, the Army commander, the Theatre commander and the Chiefs of Staff. The dismissal is due to your, and I quote, "complete and utter ineptitude and incompetence". It was nice working with you sir. Here are your transfer papers to the Women's Auxiliary Balloon Corps.
dst: 指挥官，我有责任通知你，你已被解除职务，这是军长、集团军司令、战区司令和参谋长联席会议共同提出的要求。解除职务的原因，我引用原话，是你“彻头彻尾的无能与不称职”。与你共事很愉快，长官。这是你调往女子辅助气球部队的调令。

src: Commander, it's been damn fine working with you.  And hey, what do you know, we haven't spontaneously erased ourself from history.   That's always good.  Have a cigar on me.
dst: 指挥官，跟你共事真是痛快。而且，你看怎么着，我们并没有从历史上自发抹掉自己。这总是好事。来根雪茄，算我的。

src: Commander, most of Sicily is under allied contrill. Axis forces are withdrawing to the northeastern tip of Sicily arround the city of Messina. Some had already crossed the Messina Strait in the previous nights and took position around Regio di Calabria. Your orders are to free the messina area and cross the Messina Strait in order to conquer Regio. Your forces will belong to the first allied units to put a foot onto the mainland of Italy.
dst: 指挥官，西西里大部已在盟军控制之下。轴心国部队正向西西里东北端的墨西拿城周边撤退。部分部队已在此前几夜渡过墨西拿海峡，并在雷焦迪卡拉布里亚周边占据阵地。您的命令是解放墨西拿地区并渡过墨西拿海峡，以攻占雷焦。您的部队将成为首批踏上意大利本土的盟军部队之一。

src: Commander, something very unusual has happened.  All forms of communication with Holloman Air Force Base have been down for almost twenty four hours, and the higher ups have no idea why.  We dispatched an infantry company to Holloman several hours ago to ascertain the nature of the problem, but they never reported back to us either, and a huge sandstorm is preventing the operation of aircraft within the region.
dst: 指挥官，发生了非常不寻常的事。与霍洛曼空军基地的一切通讯已中断将近二十四个小时，上头完全不知道原因。几小时前我们派出一个步兵连前往霍洛曼查明情况，但他们同样再没回报，而且一场巨大的沙暴正妨碍该地区内的飞机行动。

src: Commander, this is Carter.  You're not going to believe this.
dst: 指挥官，我是卡特。你不会相信的。

src: Commander, we have received information that enemy aircraft are ready to attack your fleet. Make sure you cross the Dardanelles unscathed and show once again that you are just as capable in aerial combat.
dst: 指挥官，我们收到情报，敌方飞机已准备好攻击你的舰队。务必让舰队毫发无伤地穿越达达尼尔海峡，并再次证明你在空战中同样出色。

src: Commander, we have stormed ashore on the northern side of the Vichy French held island of Madgascar in order to prevent the Japanese from using the islands ports.  With a submarine base in Madagascar the Japanese navy would be able to threaten our supply route to the 8th Army, our merchant shipping and the Eastern Fleet.
dst: 指挥官，我们已在维希法国控制的马达加斯加岛北岸强行登陆，以防止日本人利用该岛的港口。若日军在马达加斯加建立潜艇基地，其海军就能威胁我们通往第8集团军的补给线、商船队和东方舰队。

src: Commander, we still have no idea what this device is or what it can do.  It must be protected at all costs.
dst: 指挥官，我们仍不知道这个装置是什么、能做什么。必须不惜一切代价保护它。

src: Commander, we've got something on our hands the likes of which has never been seen before.  Obviously whoever made this thing and the sentry craft protecting it has technology way beyond that of our own.  Thank god they've never heard of the idea of armor on a combat vehicle.
dst: 指挥官，我们手上摊上了一种前所未见的东西。显然，制造这玩意儿的人、以及保护它的哨兵飞行器，其技术远远超过我们自己。谢天谢地，他们从没听说过给战斗车辆加装甲这个主意。

src: Commander, what started as a simple riot has escalated into a true life or death situation for the Union.   The rebs have obviously infilitrated the protests with their own provocateurs, and their troops have moved in to occupy the majority of Brooklyn.
dst: 指挥官，一场起初只是简单骚乱的事件，已升级为合众国生死攸关的局面。叛军显然安插了自己的煽动者混入抗议人群，他们的部队已经开进并占领了布鲁克林的大部分地区。

src: Commander, you have been assigned to the first wave of landings in Normandy, occupied France.  You and your men will land at 'Sword Beach', secure our bridgehead and then move out towards Caen.  Note that a quick link up with the 6th Para Division will be needed as they hold positions east of the River Orne, and will be expected to face a heavy German counter-attack.  Also, keep in mind that the 21st Panzer Division is in this area, and although we may have given them a good licking in Africa, they will still be formidable opponents.
dst: 指挥官，你已被编入诺曼底（被占领的法国）登陆的第一波。你和你的人将在“剑滩”登陆，巩固滩头，然后向卡昂推进。注意，需尽快与第6伞兵师会合——他们据守奥恩河以东阵地，预计将面对德军的猛烈反攻。还要记住，第21装甲师就在这一地区，虽然我们在非洲曾痛揍过他们，但他们仍是强劲的对手。

src: Commander, you know how important this base is, and you know we can't let Ivan have it.  It'll jeopardize everything we've worked for.  Take your men and push west towards your objectives; we've got a couple pieces of armor stationed near Thule that should help you gain the initiative, so you should have a fairly easy time of it.  Drive Ivan off our island.
dst: 指挥官，你知道这座基地有多重要，也知道我们不能让伊万得手。那会危及我们为之奋斗的一切。带你的部下向西推进，直取目标；我们在图勒附近部署了几辆装甲车，应能帮你夺取主动权，所以你行动应该相当轻松。把伊万赶出我们的岛。

src: Commander, you will arrive with your elite airborn units in turn 3. You (airborn recon) are a Must-Survive-Unit (MSU).
dst: 指挥官，你将在第3回合率精锐空降部队抵达。你（空降侦察单位）是一个必须存活单位（MSU）。

src: Commander, you will be taking part in the Allied 3rd Ypres Offensive.  The opening phases of this action include capturing the dominating heights with which the Germans have held the Ypres salient.  In preparation for this battle, 8000m of tunnels were dug under the german lines, and 21 mines were laid.  They will be detonated after the preliminary artillery barrage.
dst: 指挥官，您将参加协约国的第三次伊普尔攻势。此次行动的开局阶段包括夺取德国人赖以控制伊普尔突出部的制高点。为准备这场战斗，德军战线下方挖掘了8000米隧道，并布设了21处地雷。它们将在炮火准备之后引爆。

src: Como usted ya sabe, tras partir el territorio republicano en dos, los rojos se han embarcado en una ofensiva suicida a través del río Ebro en Agosto. Sus ordenes son desplegar a sus hombres de inmediato para participar en el contraataque que estamos preparando, y aniquilar por completo la bolsa de tropas republicanas en el Ebro.
dst: 如您所知，在把共和军领土一分为二之后，共和军于8月发起了一场渡过埃布罗河的自杀式攻势。尽管他们起初取得了一定的突然性，也给我们造成了一些麻烦，但英勇的国民军已坚决反击，并将他们挡在了甘德萨城外。您的命令是立即部署您的部队，参加我们正在筹备的反攻，彻底歼灭埃布罗的共和军部队包围圈。
