src: Complete failure, General! The Bolsheviks have broken through the Attila-line and are advancing rapidly. Nothing is going to stop them from taking Budapest.
dst: 彻底失败，将军！布尔什维克已突破阿提拉防线，正快速推进。没有什么能阻止他们夺取布达佩斯了。

src: Compromise was sought by Spain, but the United States sent an ultimatum demanding Spanish withdrawal from Cuba. Spain declared war on April 23. On April 25, Congress declared that a state of war between the U.S. and Spain had existed since April 21, the day the blockade of Cuba had begun.
dst: 西班牙寻求妥协，但美国发出最后通牒，要求西班牙撤出古巴。西班牙于4月23日宣战。4月25日，国会宣布美西之间自4月21日——即封锁古巴开始之日——起即已处于战争状态。

src: Comrade Commander! Come quickly, we must act swiftly.  Let me introduce you. I am the political commissar attached to your command.  The capitalist swine's are close to crushing our glorious revolution!  The Great War is over but the war for communism is still in its early phase.  We have overthrown the Tsar but that has not stopped the capitalists, monarchists and other enemies of the people to unite, raise forces and march on our people's republic!  Petrograd lies under attack and Siberia is under enemy control.   Now from the Ukraine a certain traitor named Denikin is directing his army towards our capital of Moscow!
dst: 指挥官同志！快来，我们必须迅速行动。让我介绍一下，我是配属您指挥部的政委。资本主义猪猡们就要扑灭我们光荣的革命了！世界大战已经结束，但共产主义的战争仍处于早期阶段。我们推翻了沙皇，但这并没能阻止资本家、君主主义者及其他人民的敌人联合起来、纠集军队、向人民共和国进军！彼得格勒正遭受攻击，西伯利亚已落入敌手。如今，从乌克兰来了一个名叫邓尼金的叛徒，正率军直扑我们的首都莫斯科！

src: Comrade Commisar, our offensive is going well, and our soldiers are eager to take a revenge for previous losses, another shiny victory would boost their morale. More importantly, there is a good opportunity to deliver a severe blow
dst: to the Czech marauders. Comrade, your job is to liberate Kassa with its important steel industry and railways junctions.

src: Comrade Commisar, our troops weren't able to stop the overwhelmind Romanian attacks. We executed a few ex-KuK officers but it didn't help too much. We should retreat behind the Tisza River. You'd better hurry, two Romanian pincers are closing around Nyíregyháza.
dst: 政委同志，我们的部队没能挡住罗马尼亚人排山倒海的进攻。我们处决了几名前奥匈帝国军官，但收效甚微。我们应该撤到蒂萨河对岸去。您最好抓紧，两支罗马尼亚钳形部队正朝尼赖吉哈佐合拢。

src: Comrade Commisar, tens of thousands proletars joined the Hungarian Red Army. These factory workers are eager to fight against the capitalist marauders and their mercenaries. Though our new red soldiers aren't trained well enough to defeat the Romanians, we are ready to push back the Czechs, who are famous for their low commitment to fight. Comrade, let's liberate Miskolc!
dst: 政委同志，成千上万的无产者加入了匈牙利红军。这些工厂工人渴望与资本主义掠夺者及其雇佣兵作战。尽管我们新入伍的红军战士训练得还不够好、不足以击败罗马尼亚人，但我们已准备好击退捷克人——他们素以战斗意志低落而闻名。同志，让我们解放米什科尔茨吧！

src: Comrade Commisar, the Czech capitalists are in disarray, they didn't expect how strong the Red Army of workers and peasants could be when they get a proper training about the dialectical materialism. Now we have a unique chance to cut off the Czech defense lines and separate the Romanian and Czech invaders once and for all. Let the Iron Fist of the factory workers smash these imperialist bandits! Your order is to liberate Bártfa near the Polish border.
dst: 政委同志，捷克资本家已陷入混乱，他们没料到工农红军在接受过关于辩证唯物主义的适当训练后，会变得如此强大。现在我们有一个独一无二的机会，可以切断捷克人的防线，一劳永逸地把罗马尼亚和捷克侵略者分隔开来。让工厂工人的铁拳砸烂这些帝国主义匪徒吧！您的命令是解放波兰边境附近的巴尔托法。

src: Comrade Commisar, the Romanians have reached the Tisza, and a smaller vanguard has crossed the river at Szolnok. The retreat must end here and now, if the main troops of the reactionists can cross the Tisza, our proletarian state will collapse. Your job is to secure the western bank of the river and form a bridgehead on the eastern bank, if possible. But be cautious, more and more Romanian divisions are on their way.
dst: 政委同志，罗马尼亚人已经抵达蒂萨河，一支较小的先头部队已在索尔诺克渡河。撤退必须就此打住，如果反动分子的主力能够渡过蒂萨河，我们的无产阶级国家就会崩溃。您的任务是守住河西岸，并尽可能在东岸建立一个桥头堡。但要当心，越来越多的罗马尼亚师正在赶来。

src: Comrade Commisar, the situation is critical. Though we have managed to cross Tisza at three locations, and we have gained a large bridgehead east of Szolnok, our offensive has stalled. Our soldiers are exhausted, we have serious difficulties to resupply them, while more and more fresh Romanian troops are arriving at the battlefields. We suspects some of the former KuK officiers in our rank have betrayed our Soviet Republic and delivered important intels to the imperialists. Comrade, a strong and overwhelming capitalist counterattack is imminent! Save our revolution and do not let them cross the Tisza!
dst: 政委同志，局势十分危急。尽管我们已在三处渡过蒂萨河，并在索尔诺克以东建立了一个大型桥头堡，但我们的攻势已经停滞。我们的士兵疲惫不堪，补给极为困难，而越来越多的罗马尼亚生力军正源源不断地赶到战场。我们怀疑，我军中一些前奥匈帝国（KuK）军官已背叛我们的苏维埃共和国，向帝国主义者泄露了重要情报。同志，一场强大而压倒性的资本主义反攻迫在眉睫！挽救我们的革命，绝不能让它们渡过蒂萨河！

src: Comrade Commisar, the situation is dangerous. After our new, revolutionary government refused to retreat behind the new demarcation lines, the imperialist hyenas insited their capitalist lapdogs, the Romanian and the so called "Czechoslovakian" reactionists. They mobilized their armies and attacked our weak, inexperienced troops. Your job is securing the railway station at NagykÃ¡roly as long as possible to cover our retreat.
dst: 政委同志，局势十分危险。在我们的新革命政府拒绝撤到新分界线之后，帝国主义豺狼便怂恿他们的资本主义走狗——罗马尼亚和所谓的「捷克斯洛伐克」反动分子。他们动员军队，进攻我们弱小而无经验的部队。您的任务是尽可能久地守住大卡罗伊的火车站，以掩护我们的撤退。

src: Comrade Commisar, while your troops defended Szolnok, the Czech henchmen of the capitalist warlords took Miskolc, the biggest industrial center in North-East Hungary. Now they are surrounding Salgótarján, the last city with steal factory and strong organized working class outside of Budapest. You should relieve Salgótarján immediately!
dst: 政委同志，当您的部队保卫索尔诺克时，资本主义军阀的捷克走狗们占领了匈牙利东北部最大的工业中心米什科尔茨。现在他们正在包围绍尔戈陶尔扬——那是布达佩斯以外最后一座拥有钢铁厂和强大而有组织的工人阶级的城市。您应该立即解绍尔戈陶尔扬之围！

src: Comrade Commisar, you did what you could. Unfortunately, the Romanians crossed the Tisza at Tokaj, the Revolutionary Governing Council has resigned, most leaders are fleeing to Vienna. Our Soviet Republic has collapsed. However, we don't stop dreaming about a better future. Save your life and join your comrades fighting for a perfect, communist society all around the world!
dst: 政委同志，您已尽了力。不幸的是，罗马尼亚人在托考伊渡过了蒂萨河，革命执政委员会已辞职，大多数领导人正逃往维也纳。我们的苏维埃共和国已经垮台。然而，我们不会停止对美好未来的梦想。保住性命，去和同志们一道，为在全世界建立完美的共产主义社会而战斗吧！

src: Comrade General,  despite your being halted by the fascist counter attack, STAVKA has confirmed that the gains of Operation Uranus have now been consolidated, and there is no chance of a German counter-attack in the Stalingrad sector...
dst: 将军同志，尽管你被法西斯的反击所阻滞，最高统帅部已确认「天王星」行动的战果现已巩固，斯大林格勒地段不可能再有德军的反击……

src: Comrade General, I have an easy mission for you. Since our offensive in the winter we could encircle the X. Army Corps near of Demyansk. Now we know that the Kampfgruppe Seydlitz is on her way to save the troops in the pocket. Stop the attack of Kampfgruppe Seydlitz and hold the pocket closen.
dst: 将军同志，我为你准备了一个轻松的任务。自冬季攻势以来，我们已能将第10军围困在杰米扬斯克附近。现在我们知道，塞德利茨战斗群（Kampfgruppe Seydlitz）正在前来解救包围圈中的部队。阻止塞德利茨战斗群的进攻，并守住包围圈的封锁。

src: Comrade General, STAVKA applauds your decision in rejecting a  defensive posture in favor of a more active stance. As a result, the German offensive has been brought to a halt here in the Yelnya sector. Stalin now requests that You and General Rokossovsky turn the tables on the Germans by retaking Yelnya and securing the remainder of the area....
dst: 将军同志，最高统帅部对你拒绝采取守势、转而选择更积极姿态的决定表示赞赏。结果，德军的攻势已在叶利尼亚地段被遏止。斯大林现在要求你和罗科索夫斯基将军反守为攻，夺回叶利尼亚并控制该地区的其余部分....

src: Comrade General, as you are now commander of the Kiev Special Military District, we have a special assignment for you to organize! As you know, the Romanians have consented to give us back the territory taken from us during the civil war, but, in disregard of the agreement, they are also attempting to take with them railroad rolling stock, factory equipment, and other supplies as they evacuate the area! To help halt this blatant violation of the agreement, you must secure the Chisinau vicinity by occupying as many cities as possible and by cutting off their routes of exit over the Prut river. We are still trying to determine exactly where they plan on crossing the Prut river, but as soon as we know, you will know...
dst: 将军同志，既然你现在是基辅特别军区的司令员，我们有一项特殊任务要你去组织！如你所知，罗马尼亚人已同意归还他们在内战期间从我们手中夺走的领土，但他们无视协定，在撤离该地区时还企图把铁路机车车辆、工厂设备和其他物资一并带走！为制止这种对协定的公然违反，你必须通过尽可能多地占领城市、并切断他们越过普鲁特河的退路，来控制基希讷乌一带。我们仍在查明他们究竟打算在哪里渡过普鲁特河，一旦查明，你也会立刻得知……

src: Comrade General, how could you have let the Romanians get away with it? Because you are still rather new to the post of the Kiev Special Military District, Stalin has reluctantly agreed to give you one more chance.....Do not fail us again!
dst: 将军同志，你怎么能让罗马尼亚人就这般逃脱？考虑到你担任基辅特别军区司令一职时日尚浅，斯大林勉强同意再给你一次机会.....别再让我们失望了！

src: Comrade General, the lead German forces now stand less than 30 kilometers away from the Kremlin! Stalin has finally approved the counter offensive proposed by You and General Vasilevsky. You will commence it immediately!
dst: 将军同志，德军的先头部队现在距克里姆林宫已不足30公里！斯大林终于批准了由你和华西列夫斯基将军提出的反攻。你要立即发起！

src: Comrade General, we are now in the position to attack the Isthmus of Perekop and northern Crimea, where Wrangel's White Army has entrenched themselves. Prepare for long and hard fighting! You will also command Makhno's Black Army in this operation.
dst: 将军同志，我们现在有能力进攻彼列科普地峡和克里米亚北部，弗兰格尔的白军已在那里构筑工事。准备迎接长期而艰苦的战斗！在此次行动中你还将指挥马赫诺的黑军。

src: Comrade General, you surely know that the Germans have assaulted our country. Now, the situation is really delicate. While we are speaking, every moment German troops can fulfill the closing of the Minsker pocket. The Panzergruppe 2 and 3 have bypassed Minsk in the northern and southern and every moment they can team up near of Borissow to close the pocket. You have the permission to evacuate the pocket in need. But you should try to hold Minsk, the Minsker Airfield and Borissow as long as possible.
dst: 将军同志，您想必知道德军已进攻我国。如今局势十分微妙。就在我们谈话之际，德军随时可能完成明斯克口袋的合围。第2和第3装甲集群已从南北两翼绕过明斯克，随时可能在鲍里索夫附近会合以封闭口袋。您获准在必要时撤出口袋。但您应尽可能长久地守住明斯克、明斯克机场和鲍里索夫。

src: Comrade General, you will lead a Soviet panzer army in the second World War. With Finland, Japan, Germany, Rumania, Hungary, Great Britain, USA and France you'll fight eight rigid opponents. Most battles are against the Germans. At the beginning you will have to defend terrain in most of the scenarios. Later you will only have attack missions.
dst: 将军同志，您将在第二次世界大战中率领一支苏联装甲集团军。您将同芬兰、日本、德国、罗马尼亚、匈牙利、英国、美国和法国这八个顽强的对手作战。多数战斗是与德军交手。在大部分场景中，起初您都必须防守地形。此后您将只执行进攻任务。

src: Comrade Generall, I have heard rumours that comrade Stalin is relieving you of your command. Don't worry, I think he appreciates all that you have done, but maybe he feels that you need a rest. Perhaps he has lined up a nice easy desk job for you at headquarters in Moscow?
dst: 将军同志，我听到风声，说斯大林同志要解除你的指挥权。别担心，我想他对你所做的一切是赏识的，只是觉得你或许需要休息一下。说不定他已经在莫斯科的总部为你安排了一份轻松的案头工作？

src: Comrade Hauptmann, I'll be pleased to keep a guard of honor during your tomorrow leave. But before then, lets violate the regulations a bit! After all, I'm of higher rank, hahaha!
dst: 上尉同志，我很乐意在你明天的休假中安排一支仪仗队。不过在那之前，让我们稍微违反一下规定！毕竟，我官阶更高，哈哈哈！

src: Comrade Mao has established a "Soviet Commune'' here in the Jinggangshan Mountains.  It is well protected and hidden from our enemies by a heavy wilderness and bamboo trees.  All the access points to our base are under continuous servalance and our Soviet GRU spies report that the Kuomingtan enemies and the Warlords are planning to eradicate us at once.  They are supported by German advisors who think the best way to eliminate us from here is the so-called strategy ''ferocious walls''.  They are blocking our exits by constructing blockhouses.  We will resist their attacks as long as possible.  Mao thinks we will leave here soon and go North which is much closer to the Soviet border.
dst: 毛泽东同志已在井冈山建立了一个"苏维埃公社"。这里被茂密的荒野和竹林掩护，很好地保护着我们，不被敌人发现。我们基地的所有通道都在持续监视之下，我们苏维埃的格鲁乌间谍报告说，国民党敌人和军阀正打算一举消灭我们。他们有德国顾问支持，这些顾问认为把我们赶出这里最好的办法就是所谓的"铁壁"战略。他们正修筑碉堡封锁我们的出路。我们将尽可能长久地抵抗他们的进攻。毛泽东认为我们很快就会离开这里北上，那里离苏联边境近得多。

src: Comrade Marshal, I have heard rumours that comrade Stalin is relieving you of your command. Don't worry, I think he appreciates all that you have done, but maybe he feels that you need a rest. Perhaps he has lined up a nice easy desk job for you at headquarters in Moscow?
dst: 元帅同志，我听到风声，说斯大林同志要解除你的指挥权。别担心，我想他对你所做的一切是赏识的，只是觉得你或许需要休息一下。说不定他已经在莫斯科的总部为你安排了一份轻松的案头工作？

src: Comrade Marshal, STAVKA has directed that you be informed that you have now been assigned to direct command of the 1st Belorussian front, while Marshal Rossokovsky has been appointed commander of 2nd Belorussian front, effective immediately...
dst: 元帅同志，最高统帅部已指示我通知您：您现在被任命为白俄罗斯第1方面军的直接指挥官，同时罗科索夫斯基元帅被任命为白俄罗斯第2方面军司令，即刻生效……

src: Comrade Marshal, STAVKA has directed that you now be informed of your assignment to direct command of the 1st Belorussian front, while Marshal Rossokovsky has been appointed commander of 2nd Belorussian front, effective immediately...
dst: 元帅同志，最高统帅部指示我通知您：您已被委派直接指挥白俄罗斯第1方面军，同时罗科索夫斯基元帅被任命为白俄罗斯第2方面军司令，即刻生效……

src: Comrade Marshal, as you know, two bridgeheads over the Vistula have already been secured in preparation for the drive into Warsaw, and now that You and  Rokossovsky are finished preparing, Stalin has given the go ahead for the last remaining key German bridgehead on the east bank to be taken, thus eliminating a dangerous bulge in the Vistula Front, which Stalin would like to have straightened out before starting any large scale operations. But, just between You and Me comrade, I think Stalin also sees this operation as an opportunity to appear to the world as finally addressing the situation in Warsaw...
dst: 元帅同志，如你所知，为进军华沙，维斯瓦河上的两个桥头堡已经巩固；既然你和罗科索夫斯基已完成准备，斯大林已下令夺取东岸上德军仅存的那个关键桥头堡，从而消除维斯瓦河正面上一个危险的突出部——斯大林希望在任何大规模行动开始之前把它拉直。不过，只在你我之间说说，同志，我认为斯大林也把这次行动看作一个机会，好向世界显示他终于在处理华沙的局势了……

src: Comrade Marshal, due to the staggering success of the Belorussian operations thus far, Stalin has decided to implement the plan for the expansion of the offensive to the Northern and Southern flanks. You will now "suggest" to Rokossovsky that he deploy the left wing of the 1st Belorussian front to the south of the Pripet  Marshes. From there, see to it that  Brest-Litovsk is taken...
dst: 元帅同志，鉴于白俄罗斯各战役迄今取得的惊人成功，斯大林已决定实施把攻势向南北两翼扩展的计划。你现在要向罗科索夫斯基「建议」，把白俄罗斯第1方面军的左翼部署到普里皮亚季沼泽以南。从那里，务必拿下布列斯特-立托夫斯克……

src: Comrade Marshal, in view of the existing military and political situation, STAVKA has decided that the Berlin operation should be launched no later than April 16th, so here we are! Reviewing the plan once more: The main thrust toward Berlin and the capture of the city are entrusted to You and the 1st Belorussian front. Marshal Konev's 1st Ukrainian front is to strike from the Neisse river against enemy forces south of Berlin and cut off the main force of Army Group Center, thus securing your operations from the south. Konev should then be in a position to strike at Berlin from the south if necessary. Since Rossokovsky's 2nd Belorussian front will not be able to cross the Oder river before April 20th, you will have to advance with an uncovered right flank for the first crucial days of the operation, but, we have faith in your abilities!
dst: 元帅同志，鉴于当前的军事与政治形势，最高统帅部决定柏林战役最迟不晚于4月16日发起——于是我们来了！再把计划过一遍：向柏林的主要突击以及攻占该城的任务，交给你和白俄罗斯第1方面军。科涅夫元帅的乌克兰第1方面军将自尼斯河出击，打击柏林以南的敌军，切断中央集团军群的主力，从而从南面保障你的行动。必要时，科涅夫随后应能自南面突击柏林。由于罗科索夫斯基的白俄罗斯第2方面军在4月20日之前无法渡过奥得河，在战役最初的关键几天里，你将不得不在右翼暴露的情况下推进，不过，我们相信你的能力！

src: Comrade Marshal, latest intelligence and recon reports show that the Germans have made extensive defensive preparations around Bobruisk, and have declared it a fortified area, nonetheless, we will proceed as planned. As you already know, the goal of this operation is twofold: breakthrough the defensive positions and take Bobruisk, and exploit any gaps that are opened, with the objective of forcing open a southern route towards Minsk...
dst: 元帅同志，最新情报与侦察报告显示，德军已在博布鲁伊斯克周围做了大量防御准备，并宣布该地区为筑垒地域；尽管如此，我们仍将按计划推进。如你已知，此次行动的目标有两个：突破防御阵地并夺取博布鲁伊斯克，以及利用打开的任何缺口，以打通一条通往明斯克的南路……

src: Comrade Marshal, now that the trapped German 4th Armee has, for the most part, been reduced in the pocket east of Minsk, STAVKA has issued  new objectives for You and general Zakharov; secure the Novogrudok area, capture the key points of enemy resistance, especially Grodno and Volkovysk, and advance in the direction of Bialystok. To aid you in this task, STAVKA has subordinated the 3rd army from the 1st Belorussian front to be under your command, and has ordered elements of the 3rd Belorussian front to provide support for the duration of this operation...
dst: 元帅同志，既然被围的德国第4集团军已在明斯克以东的包围圈中大部被歼，最高统帅部已为你和扎哈罗夫将军下达了新的任务：控制新格鲁多克地区，夺取敌军抵抗的关键要点，特别是格罗德诺和沃尔科维斯克，并向比亚韦斯托克方向推进。为协助你完成此项任务，最高统帅部已把白俄罗斯第1方面军的第3集团军转隶你指挥，并命令白俄罗斯第3方面军各部队在本次行动期间提供支援……

src: Comrade Marshal, now that you have successfully taken Grodno and Bialystok, STAVKA has issued new objectives for the 2nd Belorussian front; capture the fortress of Osowiec whilst securing the area and moving in the direction of Lomza, enlarging the bridgeheads in preparation for a further advance into East Prussia...
dst: 元帅同志，既然你已成功夺取格罗德诺和比亚韦斯托克，最高统帅部已为白俄罗斯第2方面军下达了新的任务：夺取奥索维茨要塞，同时控制该地区并向沃姆扎方向推进，扩大桥头堡，为进一步进军东普鲁士做准备……

src: Comrade Marshal, seeing as the German counter attack has been blunted here in the Arnswalde sector with the result that the Germans are slowly falling back to their staging areas, Stalin suggests that you take the initiative and drive as far west as you can! This will assist Rossokovsky and the 2nd Belorussian front in clearing the enemy from all of Eastern Pomerania between Danzig and Stettin...
dst: 元帅同志，鉴于德军的反击已在阿恩斯瓦尔德地段受挫、德军正缓慢退回其集结地域，斯大林建议你主动出击，尽可能向西推进！这将有助于罗科索夫斯基和白俄罗斯第2方面军肃清但泽与斯德丁之间整个东波美拉尼亚的敌军……

src: Comrade Marshal, the joint attack by your 1st Ukrainian Front and Marshal Konev's 2nd Ukrainian Front has been approved by Stalin! The 2nd Ukrainian Front will move against Uman tommorrow, and then with any luck, we will end up encircling  the 1st Panzer Armee in the Kamenets-Podolsk region...
dst: 元帅同志，你的乌克兰第1方面军与科涅夫元帅的乌克兰第2方面军的联合进攻已获斯大林批准！乌克兰第2方面军将于明日进军乌曼，随后若一切顺利，我们将把德国第1装甲集团军合围于卡缅涅茨-波多利斯克地区……

src: Comrade Zhukov, I am sure that Stalin has already briefed you on the importance of this operation to our starving people trapped in Leningrad. They are depending for their lives on your leadership of the Leningrad and Volkov fronts!
dst: 朱可夫同志，我相信斯大林已向你说明此次行动对被困在列宁格勒、忍饥挨饿的人民有多重要。他们的生命就寄托在你对列宁格勒方面军和沃尔霍夫方面军的指挥上！

src: Comrade Zhukov, STAVKA has confirmed that the gains of Operation Uranus have now been consolidated, and there is no chance of a German counter-attack in the Stalingrad sector. Stalin sends his regards...
dst: 朱可夫同志，最高统帅部已确认「天王星」行动的战果现已巩固，斯大林格勒地段不可能再有德军的反击。斯大林向你致意……

src: Comrade Zhukov, the desired effect of compelling the Germans to bring up four additional panzer divisions and one motorized division to deal with your attack, (thus effectively depriving their Stalingrad sector of the reinforcements they needed to deal with the Uranus operation), appears to have been accomplished. Therefore, Stalin has now authorized  your order for  the remnants of the 6th Tank Corps and three Cavalry divisions to break the encirclement...
dst: 朱可夫同志，你所期望的效果——迫使德国调来四个额外的装甲师和一个摩托化师来应对你的进攻，从而实际剥夺了他们应对「天王星」行动所需的斯大林格勒地段增援——看来已经达成。因此，斯大林现已批准你的命令：由第6坦克军残部和三个骑兵师突围……

src: Comrade Zhukov, your prediction made back in April has come to pass! The Germans have launched a massive attack towards Kursk. But as you have also foreseen, the German onslaught has more or less stalled in front of our defensive preparations. As per your orders, General Popov's Bryansk front, and General Sokolovsky's Western front,  have a few days ago initiated their attacks in the direction of Orel. As STAVKA  advisor to General Rokossovsky's Central front, Stalin has given the OK for you to now order the Central front to stage a counter-attack in the general direction of the Orel sector, thus unfolding a powerful three-front offensive on the Orel region...
dst: 朱可夫同志，你在4月间所作的预言应验了！德军已向库尔斯克发动了大规模进攻。但正如你同样预见到的，德军的猛攻在我方防御准备面前或多或少停滞了下来。按照你的命令，波波夫将军的布良斯克方面军和索科洛夫斯基将军的西方面军几天前已在奥廖尔方向发起进攻。作为斯大林派驻罗科索夫斯基将军中央方面军的最高统帅部代表，斯大林已批准你现在命令中央方面军在奥廖尔方向发动反击，从而展开一场针对奥廖尔地区的强大的三方面军攻势……

src: Comrade have I ever told you why I joined the Bolshevik party?  No, but you are right. There is no time for such tales.  I have noticed it, comrade.  Morale is low among the ranks.  The sudden change in the course of the war has left its traces.  This is a serious set back.  But it is merely a set back!
dst: 同志，我有没有告诉过您我为什么加入布尔什维克党？没有，但您说得对。现在没时间讲这些往事。同志，我已经注意到了。部队士气低落。战局的骤变留下了它的痕迹。这是一次严重的挫折。但这仅仅是一次挫折！

src: Comrade there lays the old city of Lwow.  It was the goal of the Tsar in 1914, Brusilov in 1916 and our goal in 1920.  The goal of the Revolution!
dst: 同志，那座古城利沃夫就在眼前。它是1914年沙皇的目标、1916年布鲁西洛夫的目标，也是我们1920年的目标。革命的目标！

src: Comrade! Kiev is liberated!  Imagine the headline of tomorrow's newspaper!  "The Ukrainian capital has been liberated!"   The people of the Ukraine are now free from the capitalists who have ruled them for the past few weeks.
dst: 同志！基辅解放了！想想明天报纸的头条吧！「乌克兰的首都已获解放！」乌克兰人民现在摆脱了过去几周统治他们的资本家的魔爪。

src: Comrade! The Germans have broken through our lines and are advancing with high speed. However, to their south, the Rumanians have still not managed a breakthrough thanks to your men. However if you do not retreat immediately you will be cut off and this would be a disaster!
dst: 同志！德军已突破我们的防线，正高速推进。然而，在他们的南面，多亏了你的士兵，罗马尼亚人仍未能实现突破。不过，如果你不立即撤退，就会被切断，那将是一场灾难！

src: Comrade, although Odessa is still in our hands, the enemy rushes further east. At Kiev we have suffered enormous defeats with the losses of hundreds of thousands of soldiers. But we will continue to resist the invaders nonetheless!
dst: 同志，尽管敖德萨仍在我们手中，敌人却继续东进。在基辅，我们遭受了惨重失败，损失了数十万士兵。但无论如何，我们都将继续抵抗侵略者！

src: Comrade, althought the fascist invaders cannot do anything about the stunning successes of our winter campaign, they have regained their spirit, again, even after a second winter. In the Ukraine near Kharkov huge battles are being fought and we are not in a position to win easy. We are happy to hold down the Germans. More south, the enemy is still holding the Kuban region, of which the Taman peninsula is only a few miles away from the Kerch peninsula of the Crimea. It offers a safe route of withdrawal for the enemy.
dst: 同志，尽管法西斯侵略者对我军冬季战役的惊人胜利无能为力，但他们又一次重振了士气——即便已是第二个冬天之后。在乌克兰的哈尔科夫附近，大规模战斗正在进行，我们无法轻易取胜。我们能牵制住德军已经很满意了。更南面，敌人仍占据着库班地区，其塔曼半岛距克里米亚的刻赤半岛只有几英里。那里为敌人提供了一条安全的撤退路线。

src: Comrade, comrade. What were you thinking? Never underestimate the will to resist of fascists...
dst: 同志，同志。你在想什么？永远不要低估法西斯的抵抗意志……

src: Comrade, comrade... You failed to stop the enemy advance on the coastal road. If you are lucky you are getting another chance, as regular soldier in the 62nd Army in the hell of Stalingrad.
dst: 同志，同志……你没能挡住敌军在滨海公路上的推进。如果你运气好，还有机会——作为第62集团军的一名普通士兵，到斯大林格勒的地狱里去。

src: Comrade, cross the Dnjepr River near Kakhovka and quickly penetrate through the enemy lines.  Their force must not reach the Perekop isthmus before we do if we are to gain an easy victory!  The proletariat has suffered enough during the last years!
dst: 同志，在卡霍夫卡附近强渡第聂伯河，迅速突破敌军防线。若要轻松取胜，绝不能让敌军先于我们抵达彼列科普地峡！无产阶级在过去几年里已经受够了苦难！

src: Comrade, despite our initial successes in our Winter offensive, it has failed to defeat the fascist invaders. With the start of spring they have regained their iniative and at the moment are preparing a final assault on the fortress city of Sevastopol which is being cut off from our lines since last year. The Black Sea Fleet will transport your forces to Sevastopol where you will reinforce the defenses. The fascist attack is expected to start as we speak!
dst: 同志，尽管我们的冬季攻势初期取得了成功，但未能击败法西斯侵略者。随着春天来临，他们重新夺回了主动权，眼下正筹备对要塞城市塞瓦斯托波尔的最后总攻——这座城市自去年起就被切断了与我方的联系。黑海舰队将把你的部队运往塞瓦斯托波尔，增援那里的防御。预计法西斯的进攻此刻已经开始！

src: Comrade, finally all of your command has arrived at the new front in the west.  The front against the Poles!  The newly emerged Polish state has invaded our sacred territory both in the Belarus as here in the Ukraine.  Kiev has fallen into Polish hands already but again the enemy is widespread and this offers chances to turn the tide!
dst: 同志，您的全部部队终于抵达了西面的新战线。与波兰人作战的战线！新生的波兰国家侵入了我们神圣的领土，无论是在白俄罗斯还是这里乌克兰。基辅已落入波兰人之手，但敌人再次兵力分散，这为我们扭转战局提供了机会！

src: Comrade, it is a glorious day! You have effectively halted the fascist advance on Ordzhonikidze by not only stopping them in the city suburbs but even more by encircling them from behind! Do not waste time, go and destroy them, comrade!
dst: 同志，这是光荣的一天！你有效地遏止了法西斯向奥尔忠尼启则的推进——不仅把他们挡在了城郊，更从背后包围了他们！别浪费时间，去消灭他们，同志！

src: Comrade, let me quote something for the French socialist newspaper "L'Humanite" from early August.  "Not a man, not a soul, not a shell for reactionary and capitalist Poland. Long live the Russian Revolution!  Long live the Workmen's International!"  As you can see our struggle against the capitalists is not going unnoticed.  The eyes of the socialists all over the world are upon us!
dst: 同志，让我引用一下8月初法国社会主义报纸「人道报」上的一段话。「不出一兵一卒、不出一份灵魂、不出一颗炮弹，去支援反动而资本主义的波兰。俄国革命万岁！工人国际万岁！」如您所见，我们反对资本家的斗争并非无人知晓。全世界社会主义者的目光都注视着我们！

src: Comrade, the operation near Volodarka has not been a success. The Polish troops had cowardly tactics and hid themselves in the villages where our horses have little effect! However the fighting with the Polish cavalry showed that the people's Cavalry Army is a superior army!
dst: 同志，沃洛达尔卡附近的行动并未成功。波兰军队采用了怯懦的战术，躲进村庄里，我们的马匹在那里难以发挥威力！不过与波兰骑兵的交战表明，人民骑兵集团军是一支更优秀的军队！

src: Comrade, the situation at the fronts is critical. We only possess a number of single buildings in Stalingrad. And in the Caucasus Army the German First Panzer Army has  refueled its offensive over the Terek River towards Grozny, and Baku where the oilfields are. After 48 hours of continuous airbombardment, the fascists are storming at the key town of Ordzhonikidze which is a very important communications center. We must deny the enemy control of this town at all costs!
dst: 同志，各战线的局势十分危急。在斯大林格勒，我们只剩几栋孤零零的楼房。而在高加索，德军第1装甲集团军已经重新加油，越过捷列克河向格罗兹尼和盛产石油的巴库推进。经过48小时不间断的空袭，法西斯正在猛攻重镇奥尔忠尼启则——一个非常重要的交通枢纽。我们必须不惜一切代价阻止敌人控制这个城镇！

src: Comrade, the situation is getting worse and worse. The Fascists are near Leningrad  and Smolensk in the north and Kiev in the south. Here, near the Black Sea coast, the Rumanian fascists with help of their German allies have advanced to the port of  Odessa which is an important base for our Black Sea Fleet. However we are encircled and cut off from land supplylines because the Germans are driving further and leaving the Rumanians to behind to capture Odessa. We will hold it as long as possible. Any supplies and reinforcements will be brought be sea from the Crimea.
dst: 同志，局势越来越糟。法西斯在北面逼近列宁格勒和斯摩棱斯克，在南面逼近基辅。这里，黑海沿岸，罗马尼亚法西斯在德国盟友的帮助下，已推进到敖德萨港——这是我们黑海舰队的重要基地。然而我们已被包围，陆上补给线被切断，因为德军继续向前推进，把夺取敖德萨的任务留给了后面的罗马尼亚人。我们将尽可能久地守住它。任何补给和增援都将从克里米亚经海路运来。

src: Comrade, this is one of the finest bottles of vodka!  Something that Wrangel wanted to take with him in his escape.  Though Wrangel has escaped, something historical has happened, comrade.  The Revolution of the proletariat in Russia has succeeded!  For the first time in history, the socialists of the people will rule themselves!  No more tyranny, no more social classes!  We will all be equal!  A dream has come alive, comrade!
dst: 同志，这是上好的伏特加之一！是弗兰格尔逃跑时想带走的东西。虽然弗兰格尔逃了，但同志，一件具有历史意义的事发生了。俄国无产阶级革命成功了！有史以来第一次，人民中的社会主义者将主宰自己的命运！不再有暴政，不再有社会阶级！我们将人人平等！同志，一个梦想成真了！

src: Comrade, what can I say!  Moscow expected a long campaign against Wrangel. However your horses have proven them wrong!  The enemy is shattered.  Our people's armies are closing in on them.  Now quickly!  To the Perekop isthmus!!!
dst: 同志，我还能说什么呢！莫斯科原以为对付弗兰格尔会是一场漫长的战役。然而您的骑兵证明他们错了！敌人已被打垮。我们的人民军队正逼近他们。现在，快！冲向彼列科普地峡！！！

src: Comrade, you failed our revolution, the workers and peasants of our Soviet Republic. You are going to face the firing squad.
dst: 同志，您辜负了我们的革命，辜负了苏维埃共和国的工人和农民。您将面对行刑队。

src: Comrade, you have failed. The fascists are still in the Sofia vicinity...
dst: 同志，你失败了。法西斯仍盘踞在索菲亚周边……

src: Conclusion: The German army lost valuable time in their race to Paris.
dst: 结论：德军在向巴黎的赛跑中损失了宝贵的时间。
邦联 States 佐阿夫兵

src: Confidentially, I inform you that the Kaiser wishes that the war came to an end. He'd be willing to sign a separate peace with the Entente powers if they agreed to respect the statu quo ante bellum.  Your victory in Albania could give us some leverage in case the peace negotiations ever start. However, I don't think that will happen. Our enemies won't accept anything but the total partition of the Empire, and I doubt that Germany allowed us to retire peacefully from this war. On the other hand, if our allies discovered the intentions of our Kaiser, maybe that would finally convince the Germans that something needs to be done at the Isonzo front. If they really want us to remain in the war, they'll have to help us.
dst: 我私下告诉您，皇帝希望这场战争早日结束。只要协约国列强同意尊重战前原状，他愿意与他们单独媾和。您在阿尔巴尼亚的胜利，可以在和平谈判一旦启动时为我们增添一些筹码。不过，我不认为这会发生。我们的敌人不会接受任何东西，除非彻底瓜分帝国，而我也不认为德国会允许我们和平退出这场战争。另一方面，如果我们的盟友发现了皇帝的真实意图，也许最终能说服德国人，伊松佐战线必须有所行动。如果他们真想让我们继续留在战争中，就必须帮助我们。

src: Congradulations on a brilliant victory!  The portuguese camp was taken and we have found lots of needed supplies. We can now continue with the war.
dst: 祝贺您取得辉煌胜利！葡萄牙人的营地被占领了，我们找到了大量急需的补给。我们现在可以继续作战了。

src: Congradulations on a brilliant victory. Your troops can rest and reorganize as the rainy season has stopped the British. You can now choose your next destination.
dst: 祝贺您取得辉煌胜利。由于雨季阻住了英军，您的部队可以休整并重新整编。现在您可以选择您的下一个目的地。

src: Congradulations on a tactical victory!  The portuguese camp was taken and we have found lots of needed supplies. We can now continue with the war.
dst: 祝贺您取得战术胜利！葡萄牙人的营地被占领了，我们找到了大量急需的补给。我们现在可以继续作战了。

dst: 祝贺您取得战术胜利。由于雨季阻住了英军，您的部队可以休整并重新整编。现在您可以选择您的下一个目的地。

dst: 祝贺您取得胜利！葡萄牙人的营地被占领了，我们找到了大量急需的补给。我们现在可以继续作战了。

src: Congradulations on your victory. Your troops can rest and reorganize as the rainy season has stopped the British. You can now choose your next destination.
dst: 祝贺您取得胜利。由于雨季阻住了英军，您的部队可以休整并重新整编。现在您可以选择您的下一个目的地。

src: Congradulations you will join the Axis attack to subdue the Balkans.
dst: 恭喜，你将参加轴心国制服巴尔干的进攻。

src: Congradulations you will lead the Romanian attack to secure Bessarabia.
dst: 恭喜，你将率领罗马尼亚的进攻，去确保比萨拉比亚。

src: Congratulation Herr General, you survived to the end of the campaign and to the end of the war.No matter if you made it to the British lines, or if you held the corridor open for others to reach the safety, your deeds will not be forgotten.
dst: 恭喜你，将军阁下，你熬到了战役结束，也熬到了战争结束。无论你是抵达了英军战线，还是为他人守住了通往安全之地的走廊，你的功绩都不会被遗忘。

src: Congratulation, General! A last minute victory! When news arrived that a Turkish relief force was approaching from the east, it was decided to call off the attack and retreat back towards El Arish. However, as evening approached and orders were being issued to disengage, your troops mounted a final and successful charge against the Turkish redoubts.
dst: 祝贺您，将军！一场最后时刻的胜利！当传来一支土耳其援军正从东面逼近的消息时，本来已决定取消进攻并撤回阿里什。然而，随着夜幕降临、正在下达脱离接触的命令时，您的部队对土耳其人的多面堡发起了最后一次成功的冲锋。

src: Congratulations Commander you have withstood the Turk onslaught and have inflicted heavy casulties on them!! Your troops must now dig in, it's going to be a long battle!!
dst: 恭喜您，指挥官，您顶住了土耳其人的猛攻，并给他们造成了惨重伤亡！！您的部队现在必须挖壕固守，这将是一场漫长的战斗！！

src: Congratulations General! The war is won. Germany has surrendered.
dst: 恭喜你，将军！战争胜利了。德国已经投降。

src: Congratulations General! … or should I say Admiral?
dst: 恭喜您，将军！……或者我该说海军上将？

src: Congratulations General.  The enemy commander, Percival is now at the negotiation table but the only choice he has is "unconditional surrender!"
dst: 恭喜您，将军。敌军指挥官帕西瓦尔如今坐到了谈判桌前，但他唯一的选择就是“无条件投降！”

src: Congratulations General. After last year's disastrous Summer on the Eastern Front, you have stabilized the situation in the Winter, bringing  the Soviet steamroller to a standstill. Your division will be transported to the Western front to protect the Ruhr area from British and US forces that have reached the Rhein.
dst: 恭喜，将军。在东线去年灾难性的夏季之后，你在冬季稳住了局势，让苏联的压路机停了下来。你的师将被调往西线，保护鲁尔区免遭已抵达莱茵河的英美部队进攻。

src: Congratulations General. After stuborn resistance Axis forces have capitulated.
dst: 祝贺您，将军。轴心国军队顽抗之后终于投降。

src: Congratulations General. By capturing all of the Reinhardt line and pushing the Germans back to the Gustav line, all of your objectives were met.
dst: 祝贺您，将军。通过夺取整条莱因哈德防线并将德军逐回古斯塔夫防线，你达成了全部目标。

src: Congratulations General. By capturing most of the Reinhard line and pushing the Germans back to the Gustav line, most of your objectives were met.
dst: 祝贺您，将军。通过夺取莱因哈德防线大部并将德军逐回古斯塔夫防线，你达成了大部分目标。

src: Congratulations General. Even though our attack got bogged down in the end, the British lost many troops and a lot of the Siegfriedstellung has been recaptured.
dst: 祝贺您，将军。尽管我们的进攻最终陷入僵局，但英军损失了大量部队，西格弗里德防线的很大一部分也已被夺回。

src: Congratulations General. It seems like the Western Allies did not really recover from the blow that you have dealt them five months ago. After the defeat that they suffered here, we can move all mobile forces East to counter the expected great last Soviet offensive.
dst: 恭喜，将军。看来西方盟国至今仍未从五个月前你给他们的那一击中缓过劲来。在他们在这次遭受失败之后，我们可以把所有机动兵力调往东线，以应对预料中苏军最后的大攻势。

src: Congratulations General. Our beach heads in the northern islands of the Philippines are secured, and the Rising Sun flag will rise in Manila soon. Those Philippinos and Americans are no match for our brave soldiers.
dst: 恭喜您，将军。我们在菲律宾北部诸岛的滩头阵地已稳固，旭日旗很快将升上马尼拉。那些菲律宾人和美国人根本不是我们勇敢士兵的对手。

src: Congratulations General. The British attack has been contained with quite some losses on British side.
dst: 祝贺您，将军。英军的进攻已被遏制，英方损失不小。

src: Congratulations General. The British attack has been pushed back with great losses on British side.
dst: 祝贺您，将军。英军的进攻已被击退，英方损失惨重。

src: Congratulations General. The German collapse in Northern Tunisia occured more quickly than anticipated.
dst: 祝贺您，将军。突尼斯北部的德军崩溃得比预期快得多。

src: Congratulations General. The German collapse in Northern Tunisia occured much more quickly than anticipated.
dst: 祝贺您，将军。突尼斯北部的德军崩溃得比预期快得多。

src: Congratulations General. The SS panzer divisions, transported to the Eastern front after achieving great successes on the Western front, were able to stop the attack on Königsberg.
dst: 恭喜，将军。在西线取得巨大成功后调往东线的党卫军各装甲师，成功遏止了对柯尼斯堡的进攻。

src: Congratulations General. The SS panzer divisions, transported to the Eastern front after achieving great successes on the Western front, were able to stop the attack on Königsberg. Contact with Heeresgruppe Kurland is restored. Casualties amongst the attacking Soviet armies are enormous.
dst: 恭喜，将军。在西线取得巨大成功后调往东线的党卫军各装甲师，成功遏止了对柯尼斯堡的进攻。与库尔兰集团军群的联系已恢复。进攻的苏军各集团军伤亡惨重。

src: Congratulations General. The enemy attack has been stopped and your forces have recaptured most of the positions lost earlier. Well done.
dst: 祝贺您，将军。敌军进攻已被阻止，你的部队已夺回先前失去的大部分阵地。干得好。

src: Congratulations General. The enemy attack has been stopped and your forces have recaptured some of the positions lost earlier. Well done.
dst: 祝贺您，将军。敌军进攻已被阻止，你的部队已夺回先前失去的部分阵地。干得好。

src: Congratulations General. The enemy officers hidden in the Malinta tunnel in Corregidor have been taken as prisoners, and the American presence on the Philippines will no longer be a threat.
dst: 恭喜您，将军。藏身于科雷希多马林塔隧道中的敌军军官已被俘，美国在菲律宾的存在将不再是威胁。

src: Congratulations General. You have performed well. But because of the flooding of the complete area around the Yzer, it is impossible to bring more men and supplies forward to exploit this victory. Also the attacks of 6th Army have failed to achieve a breakthrough.
dst: 祝贺您，将军。您表现出色。但由于伊泽尔河周边整片地区被洪水淹没，无法再向前运送更多兵员和补给来扩大这次胜利。此外，第6集团军的进攻也未能实现突破。

src: Congratulations General. You have taken Messines Ridge. Your Kavallerie Division is taken out of the line and is sent to the Eastern Front. The 2nd Bavarian Corps of the new Armee Groupe Fabeck will take over your sector of the front.
dst: 恭喜您，将军。您已夺取梅森山脊。您的骑兵师被撤出战线并调往东线。新组建的法贝克集团军群的第二巴伐利亚军将接管您所在的前线地段。

src: Congratulations General. You successfully countered the German attack. Unfortunately our losses force us to retreat to Sbeitla.
dst: 祝贺您，将军。你成功击退了德军的进攻。遗憾的是，我军的损失迫使我们撤往斯贝特拉。

src: Congratulations General. Your actions forced the Germans to give up the Gustav line in order to avoid being cut-off. It is only a matter of days before Rome is in our hands.
dst: 祝贺您，将军。您的行动迫使德军为免被切断而放弃了古斯塔夫防线。罗马落入我军之手只是数日之内的事。

src: Congratulations General. Your attack exceeded all expectations. American reinforcements were pushed aside and the road to Paris is wide open. We might win this great war after all.
dst: 祝贺您，将军。您的进攻超出了所有预期。美军增援被击退，通往巴黎的道路完全敞开。我们或许终究能赢得这场大战。

src: Congratulations General. Your attack initially took the Italians and Germans by surprise. But then their counterattack proved too strong. Luckilly Monty is having more success and the Axis forces are retreating North.
dst: 祝贺您，将军。你的进攻起初令意德军队措手不及，但随后他们的反攻过于猛烈。所幸蒙哥马利进展更顺，轴心国军队正北撤。

src: Congratulations General. Your attack took the Italians and Germans by surprise. All objectives were in your hands before the enemy could launch a counterattack. Well done.
dst: 祝贺您，将军。你的进攻令意德军队措手不及。敌军尚未及发起反攻，所有目标已尽入你手。干得好。

src: Congratulations General. Your attack took the Italians and Germans by surprise. All objectives were in your hands before the enemy could send strong forces through the pass. Well done.
dst: 祝贺您，将军。你的进攻令意德军队措手不及。敌军尚未及派重兵穿过山口，所有目标已尽入你手。干得好。

src: Congratulations General. Your attack took the Italians and Germans by surprise. They eventually did launch a counterattack. But that was skillfully stopped by your forces. Well done.
dst: 祝贺您，将军。你的进攻令意德军队措手不及。他们最终还是发起了反攻，但被你部巧妙阻止。干得好。

src: Congratulations General. Your counterattack was more or less successful. Unfortunately our losses force us to retreat to Sbeitla.
dst: 祝贺您，将军。你的反击大体成功。遗憾的是，我军的损失迫使我们撤往斯贝特拉。

src: Congratulations Generale. You broke through the English roadblock and brought your troops safely into Tripolitania.
dst: 恭喜，将军。你冲破了英军的路障，把你的部队安全带入的黎波里塔尼亚。

src: Congratulations Herr Feldmarshal!!, High Command have prommoted you due to your good actions in the past. Now, the next aim should be the Mersa Matruh area. The enemy is trying to build up another defensive line in this place. The reports are indicating that this time the enemy lines are weaker than in Gazala. On the other hand, the enemy forces are bigger, and surely will outnumber our troops again. The mission objetive is to make a fast assault from the South, like at Gazala, surprising the enemy with our fastest units, and finally assaulting the fortified point of Mersa Matruh.
dst: 祝贺您，元帅！鉴于您过去的出色表现，最高统帅部已提升您的军衔。现在，下一个目标应当是马特鲁港地区。敌人正试图在此地再建一道防线。报告显示，这次敌军防线比加扎拉要薄弱。另一方面，敌军兵力更多，肯定又会超过我军。任务目标是从南面发起快速突击，如同在加扎拉那样，用我们最快的部队打敌人一个措手不及，最后突击马特鲁港要塞。

src: Congratulations Herr General, Dnipropetrovsk is in our hands! You have broken through the Russian defenses and have crushed several Soviet divisions. Prepare to move your army to the Sea of Azov.
dst: 恭喜你，将军阁下，第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克已在我们手中！你突破了俄军防线，并击溃了数个苏联师。准备把你的军队开往亚速海。

src: Congratulations Herr General. The American beachhead has been annihilated. Unfortunately the British and Canadians have broken through our lines near Caen. This has forced us to retreat in order to escape from getting surrounded. Our retreat allowed US forces that remained in the Cherbourg area to outflank us in the Coutance area. Your mission is to push West to the shore in order to restore the front line and cut off the US divisions that have broken through.
dst: 恭喜，将军阁下。美军滩头阵地已被肃清。遗憾的是，英军和加军在卡昂附近突破了我军防线，迫使我们后撤以免被合围。我军的后撤又让留在瑟堡地区的美军得以在库唐斯一带迂回到我们侧后。你的任务是向西推进到海岸，以恢复战线并切断已突破的美军各师。

src: Congratulations Herr General. With Yelnya captured, the next stop is Moscow!
dst: 恭喜，将军阁下。叶利尼亚既已拿下，下一站就是莫斯科！

src: Congratulations Herr General. You have broken through the Russian defenses and have ran into and beaten the lead elements of the 5th Guards Tank Army. Next stop on the way to Kursk is the village of Prochorovka.
dst: 恭喜，将军阁下。你突破了俄军防御，并撞上并击败了近卫第5坦克集团军的先头部队。通往库尔斯克路上的下一站是普罗霍罗夫卡村。

src: Congratulations Herr General. You have broken through the Russian defenses and have ran into and crushed the lead elements of the 5th Guards Tank Army. Next stop on the way to Kursk is the village of Prochorovka.
dst: 恭喜，将军阁下。你突破了俄军防御，并撞上并击溃了近卫第5坦克集团军的先头部队。通往库尔斯克路上的下一站是普罗霍罗夫卡村。

src: Congratulations Herr General. You have broken through the first Russian defensive lines. This has however taken far more time than expected.
dst: 恭喜，将军阁下。你突破了俄军的第一道防线。但这花的时间远超预期。

src: Congratulations Sir, we received a message from President Lincoln and the Army Headquaters and you will be promoted to Major General! Due to the reorganisation of the Army of the Potamac, you will command our new formed corps. Four regiments of colored soldiers will be attached to your core units.
dst: 恭喜您，先生，我们收到了林肯总统和陆军司令部的消息，您将被晋升为少将！由于波托马克军团重组，您将指挥我们新组建的军。四个有色人士兵团将配属给您的核心单位。

src: Congratulations commander on another fine performance.  Although the Germans were dazed and on the run they still managed to put up a stiff and competent resistance.  Now with the Reds closing in on Berlin and our successes here in the west, the war's outcome is in little doubt.  For you, the war is most definitely over, and you are to return to the UK to await your post-war assignment.
dst: 恭喜，指挥官，又一次出色的表现。尽管德军已晕头转向、节节败退，他们仍进行了顽强而老练的抵抗。如今红军逼近柏林，加之我们在西线的胜利，战争的结局已无多少悬念。对你而言，战争确已结束，你将返回英国，等候战后的任命。

src: Congratulations commander on another great performance.  Although the Germans were dazed and on the run they still managed to put up a stiff and competent resistance.  Now with the Reds closing in on Berlin and our successes here in the west, the war's outcome is in little doubt.  For you, the war is most definitely over, and you are to return to the UK to await your post-war assignment.
dst: 恭喜，指挥官，又一次绝佳的表现。尽管德军已晕头转向、节节败退，他们仍进行了顽强而老练的抵抗。如今红军逼近柏林，加之我们在西线的胜利，战争的结局已无多少悬念。对你而言，战争确已结束，你将返回英国，等候战后的任命。

src: Congratulations comrade!  Korea is now entirely unified under the communist flag, and Kim-Il-Sung has been proclaimed chairman of the People's Republic of Korea at Seoul. This is an enormous victory for the communist world, there have also been celebrations at other communist capitals like Moscow, East-Berlin, and of course Beijing.
dst: 祝贺你，同志！朝鲜现在已完全统一在共产主义旗帜之下，金日成已在汉城宣告就任朝鲜人民共和国主席。这是共产主义世界的巨大胜利，莫斯科、东柏林，当然还有北京等其他共产主义国家首都也举行了庆祝活动。

src: Congratulations comrade!  You are the new Premier of the People's Republic of China. Mao has disappeared and we know he won't be back, hahaha!  I hope your understanding of the communist doctrine will be the correct one.  That would be the best for the communist world.
dst: 祝贺你，同志！你是中华人民共和国的新总理。毛已经消失，我们知道他不会再回来了，哈哈哈！我希望你对共产主义学说的理解会是正确的那一种。那对共产主义世界来说是最好的。

src: Congratulations for the outstanding way in which you conducted the counterattacks that threw the British back to their starting positions.
dst: 祝贺您以出色的方式指挥了反攻，将英军打回了他们的出发阵地。

src: Congratulations for the way in which you conducted the counterattacks that retook most of the territory gained by the British.
dst: 祝贺您指挥反攻，夺回了英军占领的大部分领土。

src: Congratulations for your success. Serbia will fall completely in a matter of days. It's time to leave the front line and take a well deserved rest.
dst: 祝贺您取得成功。塞尔维亚将在几天内彻底沦陷。是时候离开前线，好好休息一下了。

src: Congratulations on a brilliant victory and taking all of your objectives. However, we must abandon Kondoa and retreat further south as we are in danger of being surrounded in the town.
dst: 祝贺您取得辉煌胜利并达成了您所有的目标。然而，我们必须放弃孔多阿，继续向南撤退，因为我们有在该镇被包围的危险。

src: Congratulations on a brilliant victory. However we must retreat further south as the enemy is strengthening his forces.
dst: 祝贺您取得辉煌胜利。然而，由于敌人正在加强兵力，我们必须继续向南撤退。

src: Congratulations on a brilliant victory. The bridge was destroyed thus disrupting the British supply for some days.
dst: 祝贺您取得辉煌胜利。桥梁被摧毁，从而中断了英军数日的补给。

src: Congratulations on becoming a Commissioned Officer!
Congratulations on completing your mission satisfactorily.
dst: 祝贺你令人满意地完成了任务。

src: Congratulations on completing your most recent campaign on schedule.
dst: 祝贺你按期完成了最近这次战役。

src: Congratulations on meeting your objectives in Norway.
dst: 祝贺你完成了在挪威的各项目标。

src: Congratulations on your crushing victory over the Soviets, a triumph most impressive. Russia has surrendered! Now, America must be dealt with.
dst: 祝贺你对苏军取得的压倒性胜利，这是一场极为辉煌的胜利。俄国已经投降！现在必须对付美国。

src: Congratulations on your early success in Italy. Unfortunately, the Allies have been able to fight their way onto the Italian mainland.
dst: 祝贺你在意大利取得的初期战果。遗憾的是，盟军还是杀上了意大利本土。

src: Congratulations on your excellent defense of the Italian mainland. To date, you have done a good job defending Southern Italy. Unfortunately, the Allies have been able to fight their way onto the Italian mainland.
dst: 祝贺你对意大利本土的出色防御。迄今为止，你对意大利南部的防守做得很好。遗憾的是，盟军还是杀上了意大利本土。

src: Congratulations on your outstanding victory in France. Our humiliation of 1918 is avenged.
dst: 祝贺你在法国取得的卓越胜利。1918年的屈辱已然洗雪。

src: Congratulations on your promotion general! After the big success in the Ebro Offensive the enemy has retreated many troops from the Mediterranean areas. The French government has opened the border and we have received more Soviet weapons. This is the hour to start the exploiting of the present situation! Again, the plan is to attack Zaragoza, taking into account the past experiences in the Aragon front. Capturing Zaragoza will clear the path to Burgos; the Fascist capital!. A major victory here surely will change all our fortunes, and the Northern areas would rise up against the Fascists also.
dst: 祝贺您晋升，将军！在埃布罗攻势取得巨大成功后，敌人已从地中海沿岸地区撤走了大量部队。法国政府已经开放边境，我们又收到了更多苏联武器。现在是开始扩大当前局势优势的时候了！计划依然是进攻萨拉戈萨，并考虑阿拉贡战线以往的经验。夺取萨拉戈萨将打通通往法西斯首府布尔戈斯的道路！在此取得一场大胜必定会改变我们全部的命运，北方地区也会奋起反抗法西斯分子。

src: Congratulations on your promotion to commander of our reciently created People's Liberation Army!. Your actions were enough to support your upgrade decided in the ChCP council... Mao Zedong it's also pleased with you as PLA's general.
dst: 祝贺你晋升为我们新近组建的中国人民解放军指挥员！你的表现足以支撑中共中央委员会决定给你这次提拔...毛泽东对作为解放军将领的你也很满意。

src: Congratulations on your stunning success in the Ukraine. Many Soviet troops have been destroyed or have surrendered.
dst: 祝贺你在乌克兰取得的惊人胜利。大量苏军被歼灭或投降。

src: Congratulations on your stunning victory. England has surrendered and the war in the west is now over. Now, the war in the east will begin. While you and your army rested, we conquered Yugoslavia and Greece. You should now be ready to play a key role in Barbarossa, the assault on Russia.
dst: 祝贺你取得这场辉煌的胜利。英国已经投降，西线战事至此结束。现在，东线的战争即将开始。在你和你的部队休整期间，我们已征服南斯拉夫与希腊。你现在应当准备好，在进攻俄国的巴巴罗萨行动中发挥关键作用。

src: Congratulations on your successful destruction of the Bolshevik supply lines in Estonia, Brigaadikindral.  All that lies in the way of Estonian liberation is their garrison at Narva!
dst: 恭喜您成功摧毁了布尔什维克在爱沙尼亚的补给线，准将。如今挡在爱沙尼亚解放之路上的，只剩他们在纳尔瓦的守军了！

src: Congratulations on your successful escape from Finland, Herr General.  Rapid developments over the past few months have caused the General Staff to forget your failure there.  You are given one last chance - to play an important role in our invasion of France.  Their army is said to be the world's finest.  We shall see!  Now, we believe the Allies plan to push into Belgium in response to our offensive.  Your task is to lead your forces through the Ardennes and emerge behind the enemy.  Our victory at Sedan in 1870 made Germany a Great Power.  Your victory at Sedan will return us to that status.
dst: 恭喜你从芬兰成功脱身，将军阁下。过去数月形势的迅速发展，使总参谋部淡忘了你在那里的失败。你得到了最后一次机会——在我们入侵法国中扮演重要角色。据说他们的军队是世界上最精锐的。走着瞧吧！现在，我们认为盟军计划推进到比利时，以回应我们的攻势。你的任务是率部穿过阿登，出现在敌军后方。我们1870年在色当的胜利使德国跻身列强。你在色当的胜利将使我们重返这一地位。

src: Congratulations on your superb performance!  It appears the strength of your troops was underestimated:  your actions have helped the Russians evacuate the majority of their own division unharmed.  You are to report to Narva for garrison duty.
dst: 祝贺您表现出色！看来您部队的实力被低估了：您的行动帮助俄军使其本师大部分人安然撤离。您要前往纳尔瓦报到，执行驻防任务。

src: Congratulations on your victory in France. Our humiliation of 1918 is avenged.
dst: 祝贺你在法国取得的胜利。1918年的屈辱已然洗雪。

src: Congratulations on your victory over the British!
Congratulations on your victory over the forces of General Von der Goltz.  It was a hard-won battle, but it will remain a symbol.
dst: 祝贺您战胜了冯·德·戈尔茨将军的部队。这是一场来之不易的胜利，但它将永远成为象征。

src: Congratulations on your victory over the forces of General Von der Goltz.  Their equipment, training, and organizations are excellent, but are no match for your cunning.
dst: 祝贺您战胜了冯·德·戈尔茨将军的部队。他们的装备、训练与组织都堪称一流，却敌不过您的机智。

src: Congratulations on your victory.   Myself, together with Mao and our Komintern advisor Li-De (Otto Braun) are planning the evacuation of Jinggangshan.  We will do it quickly while the KMT troops are busy dealing with the Japanese in Manchuria.
dst: 祝贺你的胜利。我本人将同毛以及我们的共产国际顾问李德（奥托·布劳恩）一起筹划井冈山的撤离。我们会在国民党军队忙于在满洲对付日本人时迅速行动。

src: Congratulations to you and your Anzacs!! The High Command is pleased with how you have adapted to the different conditions here!!
dst: 祝贺您和您的澳新军团！！最高统帅部对您在此适应不同环境的能力感到满意！！

src: Congratulations with a stunning victory. The lack of anti-tank guns in Tobruk's garrison, the abscence of the RAF and the fact that the inexperienced South African General Klopper clearly expected an attack from the West lead to an easy push through the perimeter's defences.
dst: 恭喜取得一场惊人胜利。托布鲁克守军缺乏反坦克炮、皇家空军又不见踪影，加上缺乏经验的南非将军克洛珀显然以为进攻会来自西面，这些让我们轻松突破了外围防线。

src: Congratulations with your victory. The lack of anti-tank guns in Tobruk's garrison, the abscence of the RAF and the fact that the inexperienced South African General Klopper clearly expected an attack from the West lead to an easy push through the perimeter's defences.
dst: 恭喜你取得胜利。托布鲁克守军缺乏反坦克炮、皇家空军又不见踪影，加上缺乏经验的南非将军克洛珀显然以为进攻会来自西面，这些让我们轻松突破了外围防线。

src: Congratulations!  Brilliant performance, Herr General.  The Finns have reclaimed their lost territory and will assist us in the future capture of Leningrad.
dst: 祝贺！表现出色，将军阁下。芬兰人已经收复了失去的领土，并将在将来攻取列宁格勒时协助我们。

src: Congratulations!  Brilliant performance, Herr General.  The Finns have reclaimed their lost territory.  More importantly, they will be able to assist us in the future capture of Leningrad.
dst: 祝贺！表现出色，将军阁下。芬兰人已经收复了失去的领土。更重要的是，他们将能在将来攻取列宁格勒时协助我们。

src: Congratulations!  Brilliant performance.  The capture of Savannah will be remembered as a great German victory.  There is talk of renaming the city in your honor.
dst: 恭喜！表现精彩。萨凡纳的攻占将被铭记为德国的一场伟大胜利。已有传言说要把这座城市以你的名字更名。

src: Congratulations!  Brilliant performance.  The capture of Savannah will rank with Tannenberg and Koniggratz as great German victories.  There is talk of renaming the city in your honor.
dst: 恭喜！表现精彩。萨凡纳的攻占，将与坦能堡和克尼格雷茨并列为德国的伟大胜利。已有传言说要把这座城市以你的名字更名。

src: Congratulations!  The General Staff is pleased by your performance.  Egypt and the Middle East lie at our feet. Herr General, you have exceeded all expectations. Your mastery of the art of war continues to dismay our enemies.
dst: 恭喜！总参谋部对你的表现十分满意。埃及和中东已匍匐在我们脚下。将军阁下，你超出了所有的预期。你对战争艺术的掌握持续令我们的敌人沮丧。

src: Congratulations!  The high command is really pleased with your overwhelming victory over the Chinese elite troops in Shanghai.  Chiang and his troops are no longer a threat, at least for the moment.
dst: 恭喜！最高统帅部对您在上海击败中国精锐部队所取得的压倒性胜利深感满意。蒋和他的部队已不再是威胁，至少眼下如此。

src: Congratulations!  Your performance is even better than the historical result of the battle.
dst: 祝贺您！您的表现甚至比这场战斗的历史实际结果还要好。

src: Congratulations! Brilliant performance once again, Herr Feldmarschall! The capture of Savannah and Brunswick will rank with Tannenberg and Koniggratz as great German victories. There is talk of renaming one of the cities in your honor.
dst: 恭喜！又一次出色的表现，元帅阁下！夺取萨凡纳和布伦瑞克将与坦嫩贝格和柯尼希格雷茨并列，成为德国的伟大胜利。有人提议以你的名字重新命名其中一座城市。

src: Congratulations! Brilliant performance, Herr General. The Finns have reclaimed their lost territory. And more important, they will be able to assist us in the future capture of Leningrad.
dst: 恭喜！表现辉煌，将军阁下。芬兰人已收复失地。更重要的是，他们将能在未来协助我们夺取列宁格勒。

src: Congratulations! Brilliant performance, Herr General. The Finns have reclaimed their lost territory. More importantly, they will be able to assist us in the future capture of Leningrad.
dst: 恭喜！辉煌的表现，将军阁下。芬兰人已夺回他们失去的领土。更重要的是，他们将来能够协助我们夺取列宁格勒。

src: Congratulations! British and French troops are trapped in small areas without any possibility of further advance. They will be forced to re-imbark sooner or later. You have done a very good job!
dst: 恭喜！英法军队被困在狭小区域内，再无任何推进的可能。他们迟早会被迫重新登船。您干得非常出色！

src: Congratulations! British and French troops are trapped in the beaches and will be forced to re-imbark. You have done an excellent job!
dst: 恭喜！英法军队被困在海滩上，将被迫重新登船。您干得非常出色！

src: Congratulations! It was the Waffen SS that captured Belgrade and not Heer troops. One of your SS patrols entered the city center and has hoisted the Nazi flag atop the German legation. About two hours later the mayor of Belgrade officially handed over the city to Obersturmfuehrer Klingenberg who was accompanied by a representative of the German Foreign Ministry, previously interned by the Yugoslavs.
dst: 恭喜！拿下贝尔格莱德的是武装党卫军，而非陆军部队。你的一个党卫军巡逻队进入市中心，在德国公使馆顶上升起了纳粹旗。约两小时后，贝尔格莱德市长把城市正式移交给了党卫军上级突击队领袖克林根贝格，陪同他的是一位此前被南斯拉夫人扣留的德国外交部代表。

src: Congratulations! One of your SS patrols entered the city center and has hoisted the Nazi flag atop the German legation. About two hours later the mayor of Belgrade officially handed over the city to Obersturmfuehrer Klingenberg who was accompanied by a representative of the German Foreign Ministry, previously interned by the Yugoslavs.
dst: 恭喜！你的一个党卫军巡逻队进入市中心，在德国公使馆顶上升起了纳粹旗。约两小时后，贝尔格莱德市长把城市正式移交给了党卫军上级突击队领袖克林根贝格，陪同他的是一位此前被南斯拉夫人扣留的德国外交部代表。

src: Congratulations! Thanks to your defence and your counterattack the German attack has been stopped and most of the terrain previously lost has been regained.
dst: 祝贺！由于您的防御和反击，德军的进攻已被阻止，先前失去的大部分土地均已夺回。

src: Congratulations! Thanks to your defence the German attack has been stopped and they have only be able to create some small bridgeheads not suitable for any further immediate action.
dst: 祝贺！由于您的防御，德军的进攻已被阻止，他们只建立了几个小桥头堡，不足以立即采取进一步行动。

src: Congratulations! Thanks to your stubborn defence and your brave counterattack the German attack has been repelled and all terrain previously lost has been regained.
dst: 祝贺！由于您的顽强防御和英勇反击，德军的进攻已被击退，先前失去的全部土地均已夺回。

src: Congratulations! The city of Melilla is saved!
dst: 恭喜您！梅利利亚城保住了！

src: Congratulations! The manoeuvres have been a complete success. You have proved the value of motorized forces.
dst: 祝贺！演习取得了圆满成功。你证明了摩托化部队的价值。

src: Congratulations! The manoeuvres have been a success. You have proved the value of motorized forces.
dst: 祝贺！演习取得了成功。你证明了摩托化部队的价值。

src: Congratulations! We knew that the British were not ready for us. Now that we have cut off an entire army in North Africa we can sieze the rest of Arabia and Iraq at leisure! You, general, are ordered West to crush the British in the desert!
dst: 恭喜！我们早知英国人没准备好对付我们。如今我们在北非已切断一整支军队，大可从容夺取阿拉伯和伊拉克的其余地区！将军，你奉命向西，去沙漠中击溃英军！

src: Congratulations! You have showed the proper skills to be a good commander for the People's Army. The Rebel offensive has been stopped for the moment, and the fascists have already seen the valor of our troops.
dst: 恭喜！您已展现出成为一位出色共和军指挥官应有的才能。叛军的攻势目前已被阻止，法西斯分子已经见识到我们部队的英勇。

src: Congratulations! You have taken Kut and forced the Anglo-Indian troops to retreat to Basra.
dst: 恭喜！您夺取了库特，并迫使英印军队撤退到巴士拉。

src: Congratulations! You have taken Kut,  almost 10,000 prisioners, caused more than 20,000 casualties, forced the Anglo-Indian troops to retreat to Basra and ....you have humiliated the British army!!!
dst: 恭喜！您夺取了库特，俘敌近万人，造成两万余人的伤亡，迫使英印军队撤退到巴士拉，而且……您羞辱了英国军队！！！

src: Congratulations! You have taken Kut, almost 10,000 prisioners, caused more than 20,000 casualties, and forced the Anglo-Indian troops to retreat to Basra.
dst: 恭喜！您夺取了库特，俘敌近万人，造成两万余人的伤亡，并迫使英印军队撤退到巴士拉。

src: Congratulations! Your lightning attack on Tobruk was successful! The General Staff is pleased by your performance. Egypt and the Middle East lie at our feet. Herr General, you have exceeded all expectations. Your mastery of the art of war continues to dismay our enemies.
dst: 恭喜！你对托布鲁克的闪电进攻取得了成功！总参谋部对你的表现十分满意。埃及和中东已在我们脚下。将军阁下，你已超越了所有期望。你精湛的战争艺术继续令我们的敌人沮丧。

src: Congratulations!! You have forced the Greeks to retreat. Now it's time to chase them, so they can't recover.
dst: 恭喜您！！您已迫使希腊人撤退。现在是追击他们的时候了，别让他们恢复元气。

src: Congratulations!, Changchun, Jilin and Siping have been captured. This will be a big problem for the Nationalists, since their communications by train or by road from Manchuria to Beijing are now stopped.
dst: 祝贺！长春、吉林和四平已被攻占。这对国民政府将是个大麻烦，因为他们从满洲到北平的铁路和公路交通现在已被切断。

src: Congratulations, 600,000 Bolsjeviks are trapped in the Kiev pocket!
dst: 祝贺你，60万布尔什维克被困在基辅包围圈里！

src: Congratulations, General! Our troops gradually clawed their way forward to Katia, throwing back desperate counter-attacks as they hurled the enemy from one position after another.
dst: 恭喜您，将军！我们的部队一步步艰难推进到卡提亚，击退了敌人绝望的反击，把他们从一个阵地又一个阵地地赶了出去。

src: Congratulations, General! Our whole Agagia operation has been a 'model of desert warfare', leading to the destruction of the Senussi force, the capture of its leader Jaafer Pasha and his staff, and the relief of Sidi Barrani. The remnants of the enemy have retreated 50 miles west, to Sollum. We are ordered to follow up and strike again, quickly...
dst: 祝贺您，将军！我们整个阿加吉亚行动堪称「沙漠战的典范」，它摧毁了塞努西军队，俘虏了其首领贾法尔帕夏及其幕僚，并解了西迪巴拉尼之围。敌军残部已向西撤退50英里，退至索勒姆。我们奉命追击并迅速再次出击……

src: Congratulations, General! Russia is defeated, only a few pockets in Yakutsk and northern Siberia still offer resistance. But we expect that problem to be resolved very soon. You and your troops have been granted a holiday - you will be stationed on the Indian coast! Have fun, but mind the sharks!
dst: 恭喜，将军！俄国已被击败，只有雅库茨克和西伯利亚北部的少数孤立地区仍在抵抗。但我们预计这个问题很快就能解决。你和你的部队获准休假——你们将驻扎在印度海岸！玩得开心，但要当心鲨鱼！

src: Congratulations, General! The Turkish plan to disrupt the Canal traffic has failed due to your good leadership. The few Turks that were able to reach the western shore have either been killed or captured. Your counter-attack drove them back into the desert, and they have started a withdrawal across the Sinai to Beersheba. At the moment we don't have the means to pursue them, but after this heavy defeat I am sure the Turks will not dare to attack again in the near future.
dst: 祝贺您，将军！由于您的出色指挥，土耳其人扰乱运河交通的计划失败了。少数得以抵达西岸的土耳其人要么被击毙，要么被俘。您的反攻将他们赶回了沙漠，他们已开始经西奈半岛向贝尔谢巴撤退。眼下我们无力追击他们，但经过这次惨败，我确信土耳其人在近期内不敢再进攻了。

src: Congratulations, General! Unfortunatelly, our plan to disrupt the Canal traffic and to liberate Misir has failed due to the enemy superiority. British counterattacks drove us back into the desert, and we have had to start a withdrawal across the Sinai to Beersheba. At the moment we don't have the means to repet the counterattack, so we have to focus on other goals.
dst: 恭喜，将军！不幸的是，我们扰乱运河航运、解放埃及的计划因敌人的优势而失败了。英军的反攻把我们赶回了沙漠，我们不得不开始经西奈向贝尔谢巴撤退。眼下我们没有能力击退这次反攻，所以只能把精力转向其他目标。

src: Congratulations, General! You have secured the Polish-Hungarian border and the railway to Poland! Your fast advance surprised both the Slovaks and the Germans! We signed a peace treaty with Slovakia on April 4 and we annected another 1600 km2 of territory.
dst: 恭喜，将军！你已确保了波兰-匈牙利边界以及通往波兰的铁路！你的快速推进让斯洛伐克人和德国人都措手不及！我们于4月4日与斯洛伐克签署了和约，并又兼并了1,600平方公里的领土。

src: Congratulations, General! You held the enemy at bay and defeated his counter-attacks, while our men stormed the Turkish  positions before Jerusalem.
dst: 恭喜您，将军！您牵制住了敌人并击退了他们的反击，与此同时，我们的士兵向耶路撒冷前的土耳其阵地发起猛攻。

src: Congratulations, General, you've beaten the Germans one more time. They won't be able to re-establish a stable front line again, and their last chances of a negotiated peace are gone. In a matter of days they'll have to surrender unconditionally. If they refuse to do it, we'll invade their country. One way or another, the war will be over. We've won!
dst: 恭喜您，将军，您又一次击败了德军。他们将无法再重建稳固的战线，其通过谈判求和最后的机会也已化为乌有。不日之内，他们就不得不无条件投降。若他们拒绝，我们就会入侵他们的国家。不管怎样，战争都会结束。我们赢了！

src: Congratulations, Herr Feldmarschall! Pearl Harbor is ours! The USA are defeated!
dst: 祝贺你，元帅阁下！珍珠港是我们的了！美国已被击败！

src: Congratulations, Herr Feldmarschall, another brilliant demonstration of your superb tactical skills!  London is ours!
dst: 恭喜你，元帅阁下，又一次出色地展现了你高超的战术才能！伦敦归我们了！

src: Congratulations, Herr Feldmarschall, another brilliant demonstration of your superb tactical skills!  London is ours!  Now it only remains to conquer the central region of England and the English will have no choice but to sue for peace.
dst: 恭喜，元帅阁下，这又是对你高超战术素养的一次精彩展示！伦敦是我们的了！现在只需征服英格兰中部地区，英国人就将别无选择，只能求和。

src: Congratulations, Herr Feldmarschall, another brilliant demonstration of your superb tactical skills! London is ours!
dst: 恭喜，元帅阁下，又一次出色地展示了你卓越的战术才能！伦敦是我们的了！

src: Congratulations, Herr Feldmarschall, another brilliant demonstration of your superb tactical skills! London is ours! Now it only remains to conquer the central and northern regions of the United Kingdom and the English will have no choice but to sue for peace. I can assure you that your name shall be remembered alongside the greatest heroes of our nation. I salute you, Herr Feldmarschall!
dst: 恭喜，元帅阁下，这是你高超战术才能的又一次辉煌展示！伦敦归我们了！现在只剩下征服英国的中部和北部地区，英国人将别无选择，只能求和。我可以向你保证，你的名字将与我国最伟大的英雄们一同被铭记。我向你致敬，元帅阁下！

src: Congratulations, Herr Feldmarschall, the Royal Navy ceased to exist! Only few of their ships, stationed in the colonies, are still in service but they will never be a threat to our Kriegsmarine again.
dst: 祝贺你，元帅阁下，英国皇家海军已不复存在！只有少数驻守殖民地的舰船仍在服役，但它们再也不会对我们的海军构成威胁了。

src: Congratulations, Herr Feldmarschall.  London is ours!  Now it only remains to conquer the central region of England and the English will have no choice but to sue for peace.
dst: 祝贺你，陆军元帅阁下。伦敦已归我们所有！现在只剩下征服英格兰中部地区，英国人就别无选择，只能求和。

src: Congratulations, Herr General!  You are going to Tobruk in the desert.
dst: 恭喜，将军阁下！你将前往沙漠中的托布鲁克。

src: Congratulations, Herr General!  You have accomplished what has not been done for centuries, the conquest of England.  Now, the English have no choice but to sue for peace.  I can assure you that your name shall be remembered alongside the greatest heroes of our nation.
dst: 恭喜，将军阁下！你完成了数个世纪以来无人做到的事——征服英格兰。现在，英国人别无选择，只能求和。我可以向你保证，你的名字将与我们民族最伟大的英雄一道被铭记。

src: Congratulations, Herr General!  You have accomplished what has not been done for centuries, the conquest of England.  Now, the English have no choice but to sue for peace.  I can assure you that your name shall be remembered alongside the greatest heroes of our nation.  I salute you, Herr General!
dst: 恭喜，将军阁下！你完成了数个世纪以来无人做到的事——征服英格兰。现在，英国人别无选择，只能求和。我可以向你保证，你的名字将与我们民族最伟大的英雄一道被铭记。我向你致敬，将军阁下！

src: Congratulations, Herr General!  You have chosen to go to Belgium!
dst: 恭喜，将军阁下！你已选择前往比利时！

src: Congratulations, Herr General! Thanks to your rapid advance across the Mius and Sambek rivers, the enemy defensive lines are breached on a broad front and the Soviets are in complete disarray. You have demonstrated the superiority of our tactics once again. Rostov is finaly ours and we were able to cross the Don river!
dst: 恭喜你，将军阁下！多亏你迅速推进越过米乌斯河与桑别克河，敌军防线已在广阔正面上被突破，苏军陷入一片混乱。你再次证明了我们战术的优越性。罗斯托夫终于归我们所有，我们还得以渡过顿河！

src: Congratulations, Herr General! Your aggressive leadership has shattered the British forces and our landing in North Africa was a complete success. Now, we must pursue the enemy and capture the port of Tobruk, before the English can prepare an effective defense.
dst: 恭喜你，将军阁下！你富有进攻性的指挥粉碎了英军，我们在北非的登陆取得了圆满成功。现在，我们必须追击敌人，在英军组织起有效防御之前夺取托布鲁克港。

src: Congratulations, Herr General! Your leadership has completely shattered the British forces. Now, we must capture the port of Tobruk before the English can prepare an effective defense...
dst: 恭喜，将军阁下！你的指挥已彻底击溃了英军。现在，我们必须在英国人组织起有效防御之前夺取托卜鲁克港……

src: Congratulations, Herr General!! Your magnificent victory will go into history as one of the most decisive of all times! You have surrounded three Soviet armies around Bryansk.
dst: 恭喜，将军阁下！！你这场辉煌的胜利将作为史上最具决定性的胜利之一载入史册！你在布良斯克周围合围了苏联的三个集团军。

src: Congratulations, Herr General, an excellent performance. Our Finnish allies want to retake their lost territory from the Bolsheviks.  Because of your brilliant performance helping them as a 'volunteer' in 1939, they have asked for you to lead their attack.  We have decided to grant their request, so Feldmarschall Paulus's forces will now take over and capture Stalingrad.
dst: 祝贺你，将军阁下，表现卓越。我们的芬兰盟友想从布尔什维克手中夺回失去的领土。由于你在1939年以“志愿者”身份帮助他们时的出色表现，他们请求由你来领导他们的进攻。我们决定批准他们的请求，因此保卢斯陆军元帅的部队将接手攻取斯大林格勒。

src: Congratulations, Herr General, an outstanding performance. Our Finnish allies want to retake their lost territory from the Bolsheviks. src: Congratulations, Herr General.  Your aggressive leadership has shattered the British forces. Now, we must capture the port of Tobruk, before the English can prepare an effective defense.
dst: 祝贺你，将军阁下。你果断的领导已经击溃了英军。现在，我们必须赶在英国人做好有效防御之前，攻占托布鲁克港。

src: Congratulations, Herr General.  Your troops have successfully cleared a corridor to our comrades in Sixth Army. We will be able to continue to send reinforcements and supplies to our brave men.  Bravo.
dst: 恭喜，将军阁下。你的部队成功打通了通往第6集团军战友们的走廊。我们将能够继续向勇敢的士兵们输送增援和补给。干得漂亮。

src: Congratulations, Herr General.  Your troops have successfully cleared a corridor to our comrades in Sixth Army. We will be able to continue to send reinforcements and supplies to our brave men.  However we have a new and urgent assignment for you. Intelligence indicate that the Western Allies are planning a landing in Northwest Afrika.  The General Staff has decided to send significant reinforcements to the Afrika Corps, so you and your men are to transfer to Afrika after a thorough rest and refitting.
dst: 恭喜，将军阁下。你的部队已成功为第六集团军的同志们打通一条走廊。我们将能继续向这些勇士输送援军和补给。不过，我们有一项新的紧急任务交给你。情报显示，西方盟国正计划在西北非登陆。总参谋部已决定向非洲军派出大量增援，因此你和你的部下在充分休整改编之后将调往非洲。

src: Congratulations, Herr General.  Your troops have successfully estabilished a base close enough to our comrades trapped in Stalingrad so as to enable the reinforcement and supply of our brave men.  Bravo.
dst: 恭喜，将军阁下。你的部队已成功建立一处足够靠近被困在斯大林格勒的同志们的前进基地，使我们能够为其补充兵力与补给。好样的。

src: Congratulations, Herr General. Our Finnish allies have retaken their lost territory in the North! The road to Mursmank and the Land and Lease aid is closed.
dst: 恭喜，将军阁下！我们的芬兰盟友已在北方收复失地！通往摩尔曼斯克的通道和租借法案援助就此被切断。

src: Congratulations, Herr General. Our Finnish allies want to retake their lost territory in the North. Because of your brilliant performance, they have asked for you to lead their attack. We have decided to grant their request, so move to their side of the border.
dst: 恭喜您，将军阁下。我们的芬兰盟友希望收复北方失地。鉴于您此前的卓越表现，他们请求由您指挥这次进攻。我们已决定准其所请，请即刻挥师北上，越过边境。

src: Congratulations, Herr General. Your troops have stopped the enemy attack in the north and successfully cleared a corridor to our comrades in Sixth Army. We will be able to continue to send reinforcements and supplies to our brave men. Bravo!
dst: 恭喜你，将军阁下。你的部队阻止了北面的敌军进攻，并成功打通了一条通往第六集团军战友的走廊。我们将得以继续向英勇的将士们输送增援与补给。好样的！

src: Congratulations, Herr General. Your troops have successfully cleared a corridor to our comrades in Sixth Army. We will be able to continue to send reinforcements and supplies to our brave men. Bravo.
dst: 祝贺你，将军阁下。你的部队已成功为第六集团军的同志们打开一条走廊。我们将能继续向这些勇士输送援军和补给。好样的。

src: Congratulations, Herr Leutnant! You are promoted to the battalion command! Lead your panzers to more brilliant victories!
dst: 恭喜，少尉阁下！你被提升为营长！率领你的装甲部队去夺取更多辉煌胜利吧！

src: Congratulations, Herr Leutnant, you are promoted to the battalion command.
dst: 恭喜，少尉阁下，你被提升为营长。

src: Congratulations, the way to the South is open.  The North Americans have received a stinging lesson on the power of the People's War.
dst: 祝贺你，南下的大门已经打开。北美人在人民战争的力量面前受到了惨痛的教训。

src: Congratulations, you have broken through the last line of 8th Army's defence before the Nile Delta. Our mobile forces have captured more petrol and are moving on Cairo and Alexandria as we speak.
dst: 恭喜，你突破了第8集团军在尼罗河三角洲之前的最后一道防线。我方机动部队已缴获更多汽油，此刻正朝开罗和亚历山大推进。

src: Congratulations, you have completed the campaign!
dst: 恭喜，你已打完整个战役！

src: Congratulations, you have successfully completed the campaign!
dst: 恭喜，你已成功完成整个战役！

src: Congratulations, you have successfully crossed the Dnepr and have penetrated the Russian defenses. Gather your forces for the drive on Smolensk.
dst: 恭喜，你成功渡过第聂伯河并突破俄军防御。集结你的部队，准备向斯摩棱斯克推进。

src: Congratulations, you have successfully crossed the Dnepr. Gather your forces for the drive on Smolensk.
dst: 恭喜，你成功渡过了第聂伯河。集结你的部队，准备向斯摩棱斯克推进。

src: Congratulations, you stopped the attack of XXX Corps, spearheaded by the 50th (Northumbrian) Division, dead in its tracks. Operation Pugilist is a complete failure and the victory is ours, even with most of our tanks operating against the US II Corps at El Guetar.
dst: 恭喜，你让第30军由第50（诺森伯兰）师打头的进攻彻底停滞。“拳击手”行动完全失败，胜利属于我们——尽管我们大部分坦克都在盖塔尔对付美军第2军。

src: Congratulations, you stopped the attack of XXX Corps, spearheaded by the 50th (Northumbrian) Division. Operation Pugilist is a failure and the victory is ours, even with most of our tanks operating against the US II Corps at El Guetar.
dst: 恭喜，你挡住了第30军由第50（诺森伯兰）师打头的进攻。“拳击手”行动失败，胜利属于我们——尽管我们大部分坦克都在盖塔尔对付美军第2军。

src: Congratulations, you stopped the attack of XXX Corps, spearheaded by the 50th (Northumbrian) Division. Operation Pugilist is a failure, even with most of our tanks operating against the US II Corps at El Guetar.

src: Congratulations. Alexandria is ours and Eight Army is fleeing into the Sinai. Keep up the pressure and move your XX NE along the Mediterranean coast. DAK will follow a parallel course  through the desert.
dst: 恭喜。亚历山大是我们的了，第8集团军正逃入西奈。继续保持压力，让你第20军沿地中海海岸向东北推进。非洲军将在沙漠中平行跟进。

src: Congratulations. Although the Italian Navy makes it impossible for us to hold on to our gains, we gave the Italians a bloody nose and took away their hopes of an easy conquest of Trablusgarp. Our victory has reached foreign newspapers. Now it is up to the diplomats to make an end to this war.
dst: 恭喜。尽管意大利海军使我们无法守住战果，但我们让意大利人鼻青脸肿，并打消了他们轻松征服的黎波里塔尼亚的幻想。我们的胜利已登上了外国报纸。现在就看外交官们如何结束这场战争了。

src: Congratulations. Although the Italian Navy makes it impossible for us to hold on to the city, we gave the Italians a bloody nose and took away their hopes of an easy conquest of Trablusgarp. Our victory has reached foreign newspapers. Now it is up to the diplomats to make an end to this war.
dst: 恭喜。尽管意大利海军使我们无法守住这座城市，但我们让意大利人碰了一鼻子血，打消了他们轻易征服的黎波里塔尼亚的幻想。我们的胜利已经登上了外国报纸。现在，结束这场战争就要看外交官们的了。

src: Congratulations. It took many brave soldier's lives, but the Soviet steamroller has been stopped.
dst: 恭喜。这付出了许多勇敢士兵的生命，但苏联的压路机终于被挡住了。

src: Congratulations. Most troops were able to get out of the Falaise pocket. Retreat east to form a new line of defense.
dst: 恭喜。大部分部队得以逃出法莱斯包围圈。向东撤退，建立新防线。

src: Congratulations. The Axis forces failed to take posession of most of these important passes in the Eastern Dorsal.
dst: 恭喜。轴心国军队未能夺取东部多塞勒的大多数重要山口。

src: Congratulations. The Axis forces failed to take posession of these important passes in the Eastern Dorsal.
dst: 恭喜。轴心国军队未能夺取东部多塞勒的这些重要山口。

src: Congratulations. The Belgian army has started to evacuate Antwerp. Their 2nd Division supported by the three British Brigades are covering the retreat.
dst: 祝贺您。比利时军队已开始撤离安特卫普。他们的第2师在三个英国旅的支援下掩护撤退。

src: Congratulations. The Belgian king has capitulated and the British forces are retreating towards the port of Dunkirk. The Luftwaffe can take further care of destroying the encircled troops. Refit your troops and move your forces east to wrap up Maginot line garrisons.
dst: 恭喜。比利时国王已投降，英军正朝敦刻尔克港撤退。德国空军可以接手继续消灭被围部队。让你的部队重新装备，然后东调，去收拾马奇诺防线的守军。

src: Congratulations. The Italian attack was a complete failure. The remnants of their forces are fleeing back towards Trablus.
dst: 恭喜。意大利人的进攻彻底失败。其残部正逃向的黎波里。

src: Congratulations. The Italian attack was a failure. The remnants of their forces are fleeing back towards Trablus.
dst: 恭喜。意大利人的进攻失败了。其残部正逃向的黎波里。

src: Congratulations. The Italian attack was a failure. Their forces are retreating to Trablus.
dst: 恭喜。意大利人的进攻失败了。其部队正在向的黎波里撤退。

src: Congratulations. The Soviet steamroller has been stopped dead in its tracks.
dst: 恭喜。苏联的压路机已被彻底遏止，动弹不得。

src: Congratulations. With Malta out of the way, supplies are reaching the front-line troops in the desert again. You will soon be able to start an offensive against Eight Army's positions at El Alamein.
dst: 恭喜。马耳他既已解决，补给又能送到沙漠前线部队手中。你很快就能对第8集团军在阿拉曼的阵地发起攻势。

src: Congratulations. With Von Kluck moving more and more divisions of the First Armee back to the NW, the attack of the French Sixth Army was pushed back.
dst: 恭喜您。随着冯·克卢克把第一集团军越来越多的师调回西北方向，法军第六集团军的进攻被击退了。

src: Congratulations. You have captured Faid pass and secured Sened and Maknassy. This gives us solid defensive positions in Central Tunisia and a base for big follow-up attacks on Sbeitla and Kasserine towards Tebessa and maybe even Bone, splitting or even surrounding large Allied forces in Tunisia and Algeria.
dst: 恭喜。你夺取了法伊德山口，并控制了塞内德和马克纳西。这使我们在突尼斯中部获得了稳固的防御阵地，以及一个基业，可随后对斯贝特拉和卡塞林发起大规模进攻，直指泰贝萨甚至波尼，把突尼斯和阿尔及利亚的大批盟军分割甚至包围。

src: Congratulations. You have stopped the German counterattack and pushed them back way behind their starting positions. Unfortunately the enemy defensive line in front of Bizerte and Tunis is too strong for your exhausted forces to penetrate. Dig in and wait for reinforcements.
dst: 恭喜。你阻止了德军的反攻，并将其击退到远在出发阵地之后。遗憾的是，比塞大与突尼斯城前方的敌军防线过于坚固，你疲惫的部队难以突破。就地固守，等待增援。

src: Congratulations. You have stopped the German counterattack. Dig in and wait for reinforcements.
dst: 恭喜。你阻止了德军的反攻。就地固守，等待增援。

src: Congratulations. You have succeeded against all odds. Mateur and Tebourba are in our hands.
dst: 祝贺你。你已逆势成功。马特尔和泰布尔巴已落入我们手中。

src: Congratulations. You have whiped out the 1st Cavalry Brigade, linked up with the 2nd Kavallerie Division and pushed the rest of the BEF further South.
dst: 祝贺您。您已全歼第1骑兵旅，与第2骑兵师会合，并将英国远征军其余部队进一步向南逼退。

src: Congratulations. You have wiped out the 1st Cavalry Brigade, linked up with the 2nd Kavallerie Division and pushed the rest of the BEF further South.
dst: 祝贺您。您已全歼第1骑兵旅，与第2骑兵师会合，并将英国远征军其余部队进一步向南逼退。

src: Congratulations. Your troops and the hotchpotch of German troops that arrived in 1st Division's (Superga) sector were able to take all assigned targets from the French Maroccan and French Algerian Divisions.
dst: 恭喜。你的部队连同抵达第1师（苏佩尔加）地段的杂牌德军，从法国摩洛哥师和法国阿尔及利亚师手中夺取了全部预定目标。

src: Congratulations. Your troops delayed 8th Army's advance and were able to break through the disorganized New Zealand troops that were close to cutting off most of the DAK and your Ariete Battle Group.
dst: 恭喜。你的部队迟滞了第8集团军的推进，并突破了那支混乱的新西兰部队——他们当时已接近切断非洲军大部和你的“公羊”战斗群。

src: Congratulations. Your troops delayed 8th Army's advance and were able to retreat West in good order.
dst: 恭喜。你的部队迟滞了第8集团军的推进，并得以井然有序地向西撤退。

src: Congratuliatons General, advance into Burma with all speed!!
dst: 恭喜将军，请全速进军缅甸！！

src: Congratuliatons General, the entire 17th Indian Division was practically destroyed.  The road to Rangoon is clear!.
dst: 恭喜将军，英印第17师几乎全军覆没。通往仰光的道路已畅通无阻！

src: Conquer the north, Aurich, Emden and especially the reservists garrison Oldenburg!!!
dst: 攻克北方，奥里希、埃姆登，尤其是预备役部队驻防的奥尔登堡！！！

src: Conquest of Nola (Die Eroberung von Nola)
dst: 攻占诺拉（Die Eroberung von Nola）

src: Consider this battle as a warning. Eventually the enemy will find the way to surprise us. We must act before that happens, but what can we do? We have numerical inferiority and the front line is too long. For us, attempting a breakthrough is out of the question. The OHL is thinking about a possible solution, and maybe next year we'll know their decision. Whatever that decision is, when the moment comes you'll have to behave as a true German officer. Mediocrity won't be tolerated.
dst: 把这场战斗当作一个警告吧。敌人终会找到出奇制胜的办法。我们必须在那之前采取行动，可我们又能做什么呢？我们兵力处于劣势，战线又太长。对我们来说，尝试突破根本无从谈起。最高陆军指挥部正在考虑一个可能的解决方案，也许明年我们就会知道他们的决定。无论那是什么决定，到了关键时刻，您都必须表现得像个真正的德国军官。平庸将不被容忍。

src: Considering the distinguished service to your country you will be recommended for promotion to "Coronel".
dst: 鉴于您对祖国的杰出贡献，您将被推荐晋升为「上校」。

src: Considering the situation, you did well Herr General in escaping a complete encirclement!  Now I must now inform you that the Sturmbrigade Wallonien and the Panzergrenadier-Battalion Narwa are being withdrawn from your division. Wallonien will be sent back to Wildflecken to be reformed, and Narwa will be integrated into the 20th Estonian SS-Freiwilligen-Divison at Debrecia....
dst: 考虑到局势，将军阁下，你能避免被彻底合围已属干得不错！现在我必须通知你：瓦隆突击旅和纳尔瓦装甲掷弹兵营将从你的师中抽走。瓦隆旅将被送回维尔德弗莱肯整编，纳尔瓦营则编入德布雷岑的党卫军第20爱沙尼亚志愿师....
君士坦丁堡，从而迫使土耳其

执政官卢基乌斯盖利乌斯波普利科拉

src: Continue your advance along the border between Alabama and Georgia to the north. Pass Atlanta in the West and unite in the area around Rome with our troops coming from the east advancing via Augusta-Athens.
dst: 继续沿亚拉巴马与佐治亚的边界向北推进。从西面绕过亚特兰大，在罗马一带与我方从东面经奥古斯塔-阿森斯推进的部队会合。

src: Continue your drive south with the aim of meeting I Panzergruppe at Lokhvitsa and closing the ring of steel around Kiev.
dst: 继续南下，目标是在洛赫维察与第1装甲集群会师，合拢对基辅的钢铁之环。

src: Continue your drive south with the aim of meeting I Panzergruppe coming from the Kremenchug area and closing the ring of steel around Kiev.
dst: 继续南下，目标是与从克列缅丘格地区赶来的第1装甲集群会师，合拢对基辅的钢铁之环。

src: Continue your transfer to Leningrad, hopefully without further incident, you and your troops will be expected there already!
dst: 继续你向列宁格勒的转移，希望不再出什么岔子，你和你的部队在那里已经被翘首以盼了！

src: Continuing the initiative of the Gorlice-Tarnow breakthrough, the German 11th Army (Mackensen) lead elements are approaching Lublin and Kholm from the south.  A strike by the German 8th (von Below) and 12th (Gallwitz) Armies from the north at Warsaw could spell disaster for three of our armies.
dst: 德军第11集团军（马肯森）先头部队延续戈尔利采—塔尔努夫突破之势，正从南面逼近卢布林和海乌姆。德国第8集团军（冯·贝洛）和第12集团军（加尔维茨）从北面对华沙的打击，可能给我三个集团军带来灭顶之灾。

src: Contrary to our initial plans, Généralissime Gamelin has placed Leuven/Louvain in the area of the II British Corps and its 3 Infantry Division has already taken positions in this city, forcing to move northwards our 5th "Division d'Infanterie". I am afraid we will have to coordinate with its commander, General Montgomery, in order to defend Leuven/Louvain and avoid the Germans to cross the Dijle/Dyle River. The "Ligne KW" has strong fortifications so I am confident you will improve our allies' esteem of the Belgian army.

src: Dateline Berlin - August 15, 1945. The war is over. A peace agreement between the United States and Germany is signed. Our armed forces failure to capture Washington, D.C., and the use by the United States on August 6th of an atomic bomb are the reasons cited for the peace accord. We are pleased peace has come but are sorry to report that the commander of the invasion forces is confirmed killed alongside his troops in the atomic explosion. He will long be remembered as one of history's greatest military minds in the hearts of our people for his contribution to peace.
dst: 柏林电——1945年8月15日。战争结束了。美国与德国签署和平协定。据称，和约的达成，缘于我军未能攻占华盛顿特区，以及美国于8月6日使用了原子弹。和平降临，我们感到欣慰，但遗憾地报告：入侵部队司令已确认与他的部队一同殒命于原子爆炸之中。为了他对和平的贡献，我们的民众将长久铭记他是历史上最伟大的军事英才之一。

Until it officially dissolved on November 9th, the Siberian Government refused to comply with the orders of the Directory. The British attachés acted as the real rulers of the land, and the peasants and workers didn't show any real support.
