src: Dear Comrade. Today fascist forces from Germany have attacked our borders, from the Baltic to the Ukraine. To make things worse, Rumania has declared war upon us. The situation looks grim but we are prepared. Our Red Army is the biggest army in the world and we have more tanks and aircraft than any other country. Victory will be ours.
dst: 亲爱的同志。今天，来自德国的法西斯军队已从波罗的海至乌克兰一线进攻我国边境。更糟的是，罗马尼亚已对我们宣战。局势看似严峻，但我们已做好准备。我们的红军是世界上最庞大的军队，拥有的坦克与飞机数量超过任何其他国家。胜利终将属于我们。

src: Dear Friend, this night we reached the city of Fredericksburg. The confederates had destroyed all bridges across Rappahannock River. Our sappers were busy building ponton bridges instead. We have been ordered to cross the river and attack the confederate positions on the heights west of Fredericksburg and the railway.
dst: 亲爱的朋友，今夜我们抵达了弗雷德里克斯堡城。南方军已摧毁拉帕汉诺克河上的所有桥梁。我们的工兵正忙着架设浮桥。我们奉命渡河，进攻弗雷德里克斯堡以西高地和铁路沿线的南方军阵地。

src: Dear Friend, we are sitting in the middle of nowhere, waiting for the enemy. They are somewhere in the woods. This region is called "The Wilderness", and that's how it looks here: Deep forests and small creeks....
dst: 亲爱的朋友，我们正坐在荒郊野外，等待敌人。他们就在树林里的某处。这一带被称为「荒野」，而它的样子正如其名：密林深谷、小溪潺潺……

src: Dear Friend, we have been ordered to Harpers Ferry. It's such a beautiful place! A little town and important railroad crossing, were the Shenandoah and Potamac Rivers meet, surrounded by mountains...
dst: 亲爱的朋友，我们奉命前往哈珀斯费里。那真是个美丽的地方！一座小镇，重要的铁路交汇处，谢南多厄河与波托马克河在此汇合，四周群山环绕……

src: Dec 5th 1917: Armistice between Germany and Russia signed.
dst: 1917年12月5日：德国与俄国签署停战协定。

src: Dec 9th 1917: British forces forces capture Jerusalem from the Turks.
dst: 1917年12月9日：英军从土耳其人手中攻占耶路撒冷。

src: Decent work, General.  We've made a deep penetration into the enemy's rear....ahem.  Now two fresh armoured divisions of Poles and Canadians are to take over for a new offensive to capture Falaise, while your brave men get some much needed rest.  Oh and if you bump into any Poles on your way, don't broach the subject of Latin American politics - for some reason the subject really winds them up!
dst: 干得不错，将军。我们已向敌后纵深插入……咳咳。现在两个新锐的波兰和加拿大装甲师将接手，发起夺取法莱斯的新攻势，而你勇敢的部下则得到急需的休整。哦对了，若你路上遇到波兰人，千万别提拉丁美洲政治这个话题——不知为何，这话题真能把他们惹毛！

src: Decide for yourself if you wish to make one very influential friend, or rather several of them, but less influential. Check the VHs names for... another hint, of course.
dst: 你自己决定是想结交一位极有影响力的朋友，还是结交好几位影响力稍逊的。查看胜利格的名字……当然，这是又一个提示。

src: Decided to crush that growing menace, Prussia sent reinforcements to the area. On December 3, four German Army Corps, plus some attached divisions, were ready to counterattack and divide the Army of the Loire in two. The French outnumbered the Germans almost three to one, but the Prussian generals believed that their more experienced troops would eventually overcome their enemies.
dst: 普鲁士决心粉碎这一日益增长的威胁，于是向该地区派出增援。12月3日，四个德军军外加一些配属师，已准备好发起反攻并将卢瓦尔军团一分为二。法军兵力几乎是德军的三倍，但普鲁士将领们相信，他们经验更丰富的部队最终会战胜敌人。
德基穆斯·布鲁图斯的辅助队
德基穆斯·布鲁图斯的秘密情报处

src: Defeat the Dutch quickly and decisively, we have more important tasks for you.
dst: 迅速而果断地击败荷兰人，我们还有更重要的任务交给你。

src: Defeat the forces of proconsul Quintus Servilius Caepio and consul Gnaeus Mallius Maximus.
dst: 击败前执政官昆图斯塞尔维利乌斯凯皮奥与执政官格奈乌斯马利乌斯马克西穆斯的军队。

src: Defeat them at the sea, and stop their counterattack, we will then celebrate our victory at the negotiation tables of San Francisco!
dst: 在海上击败他们，阻止他们的反攻，然后我们就能在旧金山的谈判桌上庆祝胜利了！

src: Defeated, unable to follow their retreat towards Bavaria, and with enemy reinforcements approaching from the north and the south, the Hanoverians had to surrender just two days after the battle.
dst: 战败的汉诺威人无法继续向巴伐利亚方向撤退，而敌军援军又从南北两面逼近，他们不得不在战斗仅两天后投降。
塞瓦斯托波尔防御战 — 1944年4月26日

src: Defence of the Suez Canal, 3rd February 1915
dst: 苏伊士运河防御战，1915年2月3日

src: Defend the Sevastopol area until the evacuation transports arrive.
dst: 防守塞瓦斯托波尔地区，直至撤离运输船抵达。

src: Defend your starting position. Don't let the Germans cut you off.
dst: 守住您的出发阵地。不要让德军切断您。
保卫新扎姆基（诺韦扎姆基）

src: Dehra Dun Brig./ 7th Meerut Div./ Indian Corps
dst: Dehra Dun 旅/ 第7 Meerut 师/ 印度军

src: Delivery included PzKpfw IV F, G, H anf J models. Some of these tanks were already worn as they were conveyed from 23rd Panzer Division. Thirty T-4 tanks serviced in the Mixed Armored Group "Cantemir", formed on 24 February 1944, that actioned on Moldavian front until April. Thirty-two pieces serviced in the Fast Armored Detachment, a training and intervention unit formed on March 28 1944, which also actioned on Moldavian front. Forty-eight T-4 tanks endowed 1st Regiment of 1st Armored Division. During the fights between 19 and 23 August 1944 in Moldavia, 1st Armored Division suffered heavy losses.
dst: 交付型号包括PzKpfw IV F、G、H及J型。部分坦克由第23装甲师调拨，已显老旧。30辆T-4服役于1944年2月24日组建的“坎泰米尔”混成装甲群，在摩尔达维亚前线作战至4月。32辆服役于1944年3月28日组建的“快速装甲支队”（训练与干预部队），同样在摩尔达维亚前线作战。48辆T-4装备第1装甲师第1团。在1944年8月19日至23日摩尔达维亚的战斗中，第1装甲师遭受重大损失。
代米尔卡皮亚 (代米尔卡普)

src: Denikin won't come with us. He believes that his staff has lost confidence in him, so he has resigned from his position. He'll go into exile, and Wrangel will be our new commander.
dst: 邓尼金不会与我们同行。他认为他的参谋班子已对他失去信心，于是辞去了职务。他将流亡海外，弗兰格尔将成为我们的新指挥官。

src: Denizli detachment/ III Army Corps/ 莂talca Army
dst: Denizli 支队/ 第3集团军军/ Catalca 集团军

src: Denmark is now another of Germanys conquests.
dst: 丹麦如今成了德国的又一征服地。

src: Dennis Felling - Narvik 1 from his Marinenkorps campaign. slightly modified by Jan Hedstrom.
dst: Dennis Felling——纳尔维克1，出自他的《海军陆战军》战役，由 Jan Hedstrom 略作修改。
Dennison's 侦察兵/ Methuen's 纵队

src: Deploy your Carrier and some ships but don't try to attack with ships, keep them away. Enemy has many subs, radars, mines and coastal Canons. Also use your fighters to support your Branderburgers.
dst: 部署你的航母和一些舰船，但不要试图用舰船进攻，让它们保持距离。敌军有许多潜艇、雷达、水雷和海岸炮。还要用你的战斗机支援你的勃兰登堡部队。

src: Deploy your forces and begin the attack.  One more thing my General, In the near future I'm planning a personal meeting with General Franco.  We will discuss my role in the new government, so I will be gone for a couple of days.  Oh, one last thing.  Thanks to our Italian friends you can add some Italian units to your army.
dst: 部署您的部队并开始进攻。还有一件事，我的将军，不久的将来我打算与佛朗哥将军私下会晤。我们将讨论我在新政府中的角色，所以我会离开几天。哦，最后一件事。多亏我们的意大利朋友，您可以给您的军队增添一些意大利部队。

src: Deploy your mountain units to the hills. Units that have the Landwasserschlepper transport can move at sea, coastal canons can't attack them.
dst: 把山地部队部署到丘陵地带。装备Landwasserschlepper运输车的部队可以在海上移动，海岸炮打不到它们。

src: Deploy your troops around our lines in the North of Bataan, and kick out the enemy from this part of the Philippines. The annihilation of the allied troops here, means the end of the campaign in the Philippines. Also, our information reveals that the enemy officers are hidden in the Malinta Tunnel, located on the Corregidor Island. Take that island on the South.
dst: 在巴丹北面我们防线周围部署您的部队，把敌人从菲律宾的这一部分赶出去。歼灭此地的盟军部队，就意味着菲律宾战役的结束。此外，我们的情报显示，敌军军官藏匿在科雷希多岛上的马林塔隧道中。夺取南面的那座岛。

src: Deployment Speed:   Limited to deploying only 1 ground unit from each Supply Hex owned per turn. Air units have unlimited deployment per turn from Airfields as per normal.
dst: 部署速度：   每回合每座己方补给格仅可部署 1 个地面单位。空中单位照常可从机场无限次部署。

src: Deployment is limited in this scenario!
Deployment is limited in this scenario.
dst: 本场景中部署受到限制。

src: Deployment is restricted. You will have to capture the deployment hex in the south in order to deploy your main core.
dst: 部署受限。你必须夺取南面的部署格，才能投入你的骨干部队主力。
黑克尔远征（黑克尔起义）* 大捷
黑克尔远征（黑克尔起义）* 失败
黑克尔远征（黑克尔起义）* 小捷
黑克尔远征（黑克尔起义）* 胜利
德尔纳、马尔图巴机场西北方向
沙漠巡逻队/阿拉伯军团

src: Despite German attacks you have succeeded in retreating the forces under your command but at the cost of suffering heavy losses.
dst: 尽管德军不断进攻，您仍成功撤出了麾下部队，但代价是遭受了重大损失。

src: Despite acheiving a satisfactory outcome in the Caucasus, the Soviet winter offensives have forced us back along the entire front, putting us in an extremely difficult position. We must now plan accordingly.
dst: 尽管在高加索取得了令人满意的战果，苏军的冬季攻势仍迫使我们全线后退，使我们陷入极其困难的处境。我们现在必须相应调整计划。

src: Despite all the years that have passed, I still remember it as if it was yesterday; our scouts had spotted a small enemy impi (armed force) raiding a fertile valley. My battalion was sent to put an end to that menace and destroy the Zulu camp.
dst: 尽管许多年过去了，我仍记忆犹新，仿佛就在昨天；我们的侦察兵发现了一支小股敌军（祖鲁语中称「因皮」的武装力量）正在袭扰一处肥沃的山谷。我的营奉命去消除这一威胁并摧毁祖鲁营地。

src: Despite an initial French success, the Prussian reserves finally repelled the attack. The defenders of Paris eventually resigned themselves to adopt a passive strategy, while they waited for help from the outside.
dst: 尽管法军起初取得了一些战果，普鲁士预备队最终还是击退了进攻。巴黎守军最终只好采取消极防御的战略，同时等待外部的援助。

src: Despite being a very hazardous manoeuvre, the credit of conducting this succesfull retreat is only yours. The troops from Cavite will make our position stronger in Manila. However, wars are not won by retreats.
dst: 尽管这是一次非常危险的机动，但成功实施这次撤退的功劳完全属于您。来自甲米地的部队将使我们在马尼拉的地位更加稳固。然而，战争不是靠撤退赢得的。

src: Despite facing fierce enemy resistance, you have cleared the area between the rivers, and have decimated the Soviet 62nd Army! Now you will make the final drive for Stalingrad!
dst: 尽管遭遇敌军的顽强抵抗，你已肃清两河之间的地区，并重创了苏联第62集团军！现在你将向斯大林格勒发起最后的一击！

src: Despite facing fierce enemy resistance, you have done well. Unfortunately though, the Soviets are still hanging on in a few places on the banks of the Volga, especially in the houses and factories...
dst: 尽管遭遇敌军的顽强抵抗，你干得不错。遗憾的是，苏军仍在伏尔加河沿岸的几处据守，尤其是在那些房屋和工厂里……

src: Despite facing fierce enemy resistance, you have succeeded and have neutralized the threat to 4th Panzer armee's left flank, and thus as a result, 4th Panzer armee is now on the move, and should arrive very shortly at Kotelnikovo...
dst: 尽管遭遇敌军的顽强抵抗，你已成功消除了对第4装甲集团军左翼的威胁；因此，第4装甲集团军现已出动，不久即应抵达科捷利尼科沃……

src: Despite facing fierce enemy resistance, you have succeeded in aquiring the resources of the Donets Basin. About General Halder: His talk with the Fuhrer has had some success! The Fuhrer has promised to keep a close watch on your 6th Armee's progress, and to strengthen your exposed position on the steppe, he has ordered the 4th Panzer Armee to turn around and rejoin the Drive to the Volga!
dst: 尽管遭遇敌军的顽强抵抗，你已成功夺得了顿巴斯的资源。关于哈尔德将军：他与元首的谈话取得了一些成效！元首已承诺密切关注你第六集团军的进展；为加强你在草原上暴露的阵地，他已命令第4装甲集团军掉头回来，重新加入进军伏尔加河的行列！

src: Despite facing fierce enemy resistance, you have succeeded in opening the road to Voronezh...
dst: 尽管遭遇敌军的顽强抵抗，你已成功打通了通往沃罗涅日的道路……

src: Despite failing to re-capture Yelnya, You and Rokossovsky have shown the Germans that we will not give up. Stalin has now ordered the Reserve front onto the defensive, and has summoned you to the Kremlin. I have a feeling that he would like you to take over the defence of Leningrad from Marshal Voroshilov, whose performance has been deemed as so incompetent, that now there is a real threat that our Northern capital will fall!
dst: 尽管未能收复叶利尼亚，你和罗科索夫斯基已向德国人表明我们不会放弃。斯大林现已命令预备队方面军转入防御，并召你前往克里姆林宫。我有一种感觉：他大概想让你从伏罗希洛夫元帅手中接管列宁格勒的防务——后者的表现被认为极其无能，以致我们北方的都城现在真的有陷落的危险！

src: Despite fierce Soviet counter attacks,  your troops have managed to successfully estabilish a base close enough to our comrades trapped in Stalingrad,  enabling the reinforcement and supply of our brave men....
dst: 尽管苏军反击凶猛，你的部队仍成功建立了一处足够靠近被困在斯大林格勒的同志们的基地，使我们能够为其补充兵力与补给....

src: Despite fierce Soviet resistance,  the encirclement has been broken and you have managed to save some of the Sixth Armee's men. These brave men are now safely on our side of the Mishkova. We mourn the heroic ones that died during the attempt, and those who were forced to surrender...
dst: 尽管苏军抵抗顽强，包围圈已被打破，你成功救出了第六集团军的一部分人。这些勇士现在已安全抵达我们这一侧的米什科瓦河。我们为在突围中阵亡的英雄、以及被迫投降的人们哀悼……

src: Despite fierce Soviet resistance, you managed to reach Orsha, rally the scattered units, and break through the encirclement. However, the retreat to the west was chaotic; most of the heavy equipment was lost, and many men were killed.
dst: 尽管苏军抵抗猛烈，你仍成功抵达奥尔沙、收拢溃散部队并突出合围。然而向西的撤退一片混乱，大部分重装备损失，许多官兵阵亡。

src: Despite fierce Soviet resistance, you managed to reach Orsha, rally the scattered units, and break through the encirclement. The retreat to the west was carried out in an orderly manner, and although some of the heavy equipment was lost, the majority of the troops were saved.
dst: 尽管苏军抵抗猛烈，你仍成功抵达奥尔沙、收拢溃散部队并突出合围。向西的撤退井然有序，虽然损失了部分重装备，但大部分部队得以保全。

src: Despite fierce enemy opposition, you have brilliantly delivered supplies to Bayamo. You will be promoted to "Comandante".
dst: 尽管敌人顽强抵抗，您仍出色地将补给运抵巴亚莫。您将被晋升为「少校」。

src: Despite fierce enemy opposition, you have managed to deliver supplies to Bayamo. You will be promoted to "Comandante".
dst: 尽管敌人顽强抵抗，您仍成功将补给运抵巴亚莫。您将被晋升为「少校」。

src: Despite fierce enemy opposition, you have successfully delivered supplies to Bayamo. You will be promoted to "Comandante".
dst: 尽管敌人顽强抵抗，您仍顺利将补给运抵巴亚莫。您将被晋升为「少校」。

src: Despite fierce enemy resistance, and a few setbacks, the Soviet attack has been repelled. After a well deserved night's rest, you and your men will immediately set out to rejoin our forces at the Svir river. Judging by the latest recon reports, it appears the Soviets might be up to something there...
dst: 尽管敌军抵抗顽强，也尽管有过几次挫折，苏军的进攻已被击退。经过一夜应得的休息之后，你和你的部下将立刻出发，前往斯维尔河与我军主力会合。根据最新的侦察报告，苏军似乎在那里有所图谋……

src: Despite fierce enemy resistance, we are close to re-conquering the Karelian Isthmus. Soon we will push into East Karelia, towards Leningrad, which should result in giving us a comfortable buffer zone against any Soviet attempts at re-entering Finnish territory...
dst: 尽管敌军抵抗顽强，我们已接近重新征服卡累利阿地峡。很快我们将推进至东卡累利阿，直指列宁格勒，这将给我们带来一片舒适的缓冲地带，足以应对苏军任何重新进入芬兰领土的尝试……

src: Despite fierce enemy resistance, we have been able to set up a strong line of defence on the Soviet side of the Svir river! We are now going to continue to press north from Petrozavodsk, towards Medvezhegorsk. Your forces will enjoy some well earned R&R manning the line of defence here....
dst: 尽管敌军抵抗顽强，我们已在斯维尔河的苏方一侧建立起一道坚固防线！现在我们将继续自彼得罗扎沃茨克向北推进，指向梅德韦日耶戈尔斯克。你的部队将在此驻守防线，享受一段应得的休整....

src: Despite fierce enemy resistance, you have managed to acheive enough of a success to allow the continuation of our drive into the Caucasus..
dst: 尽管敌军抵抗顽强，你已取得足够的成功，使我们得以继续进军高加索..

src: Despite fierce enemy resistance, you have managed to advance almost halfway to Stalingrad! Unfortunately though, we had to call off the relief effort  when the Soviets countered by attacking the flank position defended by the 8th Italian Army, compelling us to decide to quickly order the transfer of the 6th Panzer division, as well as your men, there to prevent the cutting off our entire southern wing in Russia!
dst: 尽管敌军抵抗顽强，你仍推进到距斯大林格勒近一半的路程！然而不幸的是，当苏军反击由意大利第8集团军防守的侧翼阵地时，我们不得不中止解围行动，并被迫迅速决定把第6装甲师连同你的人马调往那里，以免我们在俄国的整个南翼被切断！

src: Despite fierce enemy resistance, you have managed to secure the city of Voronezh. Your performance has consolidated the flanks of our attack towards the Caucasus...
dst: 尽管敌军抵抗顽强，你已成功确保了沃罗涅日城。你的表现巩固了我们向高加索进攻的两翼……

src: Despite fierce enemy resistance, you have managed to secure the city of Voronezh. Your victory has consolidated the flanks of Fall Blau.
dst: 尽管敌军抵抗顽强，你已成功确保了沃罗涅日城。你的胜利巩固了「蓝色」行动的两翼。

src: Despite fierce enemy resistance, you have still managed to open the door for a direct attack on the city of Stalingrad!
dst: 尽管敌军抵抗顽强，你仍成功为直接进攻斯大林格勒城打开了大门！

src: Despite fierce enemy resistance, you have succeeded! This is our first "big" victory against the Invaders. The importance of this Victory as a morale booster cannot be under estimated! The threat of a Soviet division getting behind our lines has been neutralized, and the 139th division has been hit very hard. Now your skills are again needed, even further North, where we are planning to retake Suomussalmi.....
dst: 尽管敌军抵抗顽强，你成功了！这是我们抗击入侵者的首次「重大」胜利。这场胜利在鼓舞士气方面的意义再怎么高估也不为过！苏军一个师迂回到我军后方的威胁已被消除，第139师遭到重创。如今你的才能在更北面的地方又被需要了——我们正计划在那里收复苏穆萨尔米.....

src: Despite fierce resistance, Bobruisk is ours again, and a southern route into Minsk has been opened. But not only that! 5 divisions of 9th Armee's XXXV Korps have been trapped, along with elements of the XXXXI Panzer Korps that were not able to break out...
dst: 尽管抵抗顽强，博布鲁伊斯克又回到我们手中，通往明斯克的南路也已打开。不仅如此！第9集团军第35军的5个师被围，未能突围的第41装甲军各部队也在其中……

src: Despite fierce resistance, Brest-Litovsk is ours again. Stalin is also pleased that You and Rokossovsky were able to exploit the success, and as a result, continue the drive west towards the Vistula river...
dst: 尽管抵抗顽强，布列斯特-立托夫斯克又回到我们手中。斯大林也很满意你和罗科索夫斯基能够扩大战果，因而继续西进，直逼维斯瓦河……

src: Despite fierce resistance, Mogilev is ours again and 4th Armee has been pushed back to Minsk preventing them from disengaging in time to reinforce Vitebsk and Bobruisk, resulting in roughly 30,000 German troops being surrounded at Vitebsk, and the encirclement of 5 divisions in the Bobruisk sector!
dst: 尽管抵抗顽强，莫吉廖夫又回到我们手中，第4集团军被打退回明斯克，未能及时脱身去增援维捷布斯克和博布鲁伊斯克，结果约3万名德军在维捷布斯克被包围，博布鲁伊斯克地段则有5个师被合围！

src: Despite fierce resistance, Yelnya is again ours. Your's and Rokossovsky's success at Yelnya has been the only bright spot against the German invasion of our country thus far. I know that you would probably like to continue your westward drive from Yelnya, but Stalin has ordered the Reserve front onto the defensive, and has summoned you to the Kremlin. I have a feeling that he would like you to take over the defence of Leningrad from Marshal Voroshilov, whose performance has been deemed as so incompetent, that now there is a real threat that our Northern capital will fall!
dst: 尽管抵抗顽强，叶利尼亚又回到我们手中。迄今在德国入侵我国的战争中，你和罗科索夫斯基在叶利尼亚取得的战果是唯一的亮点。我知道你大概想从叶利尼亚继续西进，但斯大林已命令预备队方面军转入防御，并召你前往克里姆林宫。我有一种感觉：他大概想让你从伏罗希洛夫元帅手中接管列宁格勒的防务——后者的表现被认为极其无能，以致我们北方的都城现在真的有陷落的危险！

src: Despite fierce resistance, You and Zakharov have acheived in 5 days what STAVKA had allotted 8-11 days to complete! Well done!
dst: 尽管抵抗顽强，你和扎哈罗夫用5天时间完成了最高统帅部预计8至11天完成的任务！干得漂亮！

src: Despite fierce resistance, Your's and Rokossovsky's joint handling of the situation has sent the Germans reeling back under the weight of the Central front's advance, forcing  the German command to acknowledge the failure of Operation Citadel. As a result, the Germans have decided to pull von Manstein's forces back to their starting line in order to save it's troops from complete defeat...
dst: 尽管抵抗顽强，你和罗科索夫斯基对局势的联手处置，使德军在中央方面军推进的重压下节节败退，迫使德军指挥部承认「堡垒」行动失败。结果，德军已决定把冯·曼施泰因的部队撤回出发线，以免其部队彻底覆灭……

src: Despite fierce resistance, and the fact that remnants of the encircled Soviet divisions managed to escape destruction by fleeing into the forests, we managed to capture most of their heavy equipment! All fronts are now stabilized and......Excuse me a moment.....Colonel!, I have just now been informed that Stalin will accept Marshal Mannerheim's proposal for an armistice if we cut all diplomatic ties with Germany, and German troops are given a deadline of September 15 to withdraw from Finnish soil or be interned and handed over to the Soviet Union as POWs. This war of continuation is as good as over!
dst: 尽管抵抗顽强，而且被围苏军各师的残部逃入森林得以免于被歼，我们仍缴获了他们的大部分重型装备！各战线现已稳定，而且……失陪一下……上校！我刚刚得知：如果我们与德国断绝一切外交关系，并给德军规定9月15日为撤出芬兰领土的最后期限，否则即予以拘押并作为战俘移交苏联，斯大林将接受曼纳海姆元帅的停战提议。这场继续战争差不多已经结束了！

src: Despite fierce resistance, and the remaining intact of the German line of defence on the Narew River in the Lomza area, Stalin has noted the capture of the fortress of Osowiec and sends congratulations to the units and commanders involved!
dst: 尽管抵抗顽强，且德军在沃姆扎地区纳雷夫河上的防线仍然完整，斯大林已注意到奥索维茨要塞的攻克，并向参战部队和指挥员表示祝贺！

src: Despite fierce resistance, the Germans have been driven away from Moscow, but the front lines are still relatively close, and more importantly, the Rzhev salient of Army Group Center remains intact. Thus Stalin still considers Moscow as threatened...
dst: 尽管抵抗顽强，德军已被逐离莫斯科，但战线仍然相对接近，更重要的是，中央集团军群的勒热夫突出部依旧完好。因此斯大林仍认为莫斯科受到威胁……

src: Despite fierce resistance, the Germans have been forced back over to the west bank of the Vistula, but unfortunately, they managed to destroy the bridgehead, thus making it much harder now to relieve the uprising...
dst: 尽管抵抗顽强，德军已被逼回维斯瓦河西岸，但不幸的是，他们成功摧毁了桥头堡，这使驰援起义变得更加困难……

src: Despite fierce resistance, the Soviet attack has been stopped, and they are now transferring their best troops to Estonia, to fight the Germans there. It appears the Soviets are coming to the conclusion that conquering Finland will be extremely difficult, and not worth the cost. We have received word from our Swedish friends that Stalin is now willing to discuss peace terms with us. Nevertheless, we now need you to begin immediately making your way further north, towards Ilomantsi, where, based on the latest recon reports, an as yet indeterminant number of Soviet troops appear to be moving in an aggressive fashion towards us...Oh yes, I nearly forgot, you have been promoted to Colonel!
dst: 尽管抵抗顽强，苏军的进攻已被阻止，他们正把最精锐的部队调往爱沙尼亚，在那里与德军作战。看来苏军正在得出这样的结论：征服芬兰将极其困难，且不值得付出那样的代价。我们从瑞典朋友处得到消息，斯大林现在愿意与我们商讨和平条件。尽管如此，我们现在需要你立刻启程继续北上，前往伊洛曼齐——根据最新的侦察报告，数量尚不确定的苏军部队似乎正以进攻姿态朝我们逼近……哦对了，我差点忘了，你已晋升为上校！

src: Despite fierce resistance, the Soviet attackers have been repelled, and the partisan spies destroyed. Thanx to your help, our airbase at Tiiksjarvi should continue to be a thorn in the side of the Soviet juggernaut for some time yet. Now, back to business. After a well deserved night's rest, you and your men will immediately set out to rejoin our forces at the Svir river. Judging by the latest recon reports, it appears the Soviets might be up to something there...
dst: 尽管抵抗顽强，苏军的进攻已被击退，游击队的密探也被消灭。多亏你的帮助，我们在蒂克夏尔维的空军基地在未来一段时间内仍将是苏联那台战争机器侧翼的一根刺。现在言归正传。经过一夜应得的休息之后，你和你的部下将立刻出发，前往斯维尔河与我军主力会合。根据最新的侦察报告，苏军似乎在那里有所图谋……

src: Despite fierce resistance, the Soviet attempt to drive us out of the Svir sector has been repulsed, and they have suffered heavy casualties as a result. I have a feeling that they will think twice before attacking us in this area again. Now, I should pass this interesting information on to you: Since Marshal Mannerheim is not so sure anymore that Germany will be able to win the war, he is contemplating how to make peace with the Allies, and he may soon start by not ordering anymore offensive operations. If this happens, take care that your men's morale stays high, just in case....
dst: 尽管抵抗顽强，苏军把我们逐出斯维尔地段的企图已被挫败，他们为此付出了惨重伤亡。我有一种感觉：他们下次在这一地区进攻我们之前会三思而行。现在，我应该把这则有趣的消息转告给你：由于曼纳海姆元帅已不再那么确信德国能赢得这场战争，他正在考虑如何与盟国媾和，而且可能很快就会从不再下令发动任何进攻行动开始。如果真到了那一步，请务必让你的部下保持高昂的士气，以防万一……

src: Despite fierce resistance, we have managed to encircle the 1st Panzer Armee and capture Kamenets-Podolsk. But unfortunately, the Germans have counter-attacked, cutting off our forces, thus their breakout attempt continues. You have been re-assigned as STAVKA coordinator to both General Rokossovsky's 1st Belorussian Front, and General Zakharov's 2nd Belorussian Front...
dst: 尽管抵抗顽强，我们已成功合围德国第1装甲集团军并夺取卡缅涅茨-波多利斯克。但不幸的是，德军发起反击，切断了我军，因此他们的突围企图仍在继续。你已被重新指派为最高统帅部驻罗科索夫斯基将军白俄罗斯第1方面军和扎哈罗夫将军白俄罗斯第2方面军的协调员……

src: Despite fierce resistance, you did manage to halt the Soviet attack and route parts of the 54th division. Furthermore, the remainder of the 54th division, after losing their forward bases, are now encircled in a great "Motti" near the Soviet-Finnish border. Now you will make your way back to the Karelian Isthmus, where some dark clouds are gathering...
dst: 尽管抵抗顽强，你确实挡住了苏军的进攻并击溃了第54师的一部。此外，第54师的余部在失去前进基地之后，现已在苏芬边境附近被合围于一个巨大的「莫蒂」包围圈中。现在你将返回卡累利阿地峡，那里正聚集着一些乌云……

src: Despite fierce resistance, you have helped to acheive yet another victory against the Invaders! 2 Soviet divisions have been nearly wiped out, and the remainder are on the run, and we have collected quite a war booty! Now, your men, along with the 9th division, will move back south towards Kuhmo....
dst: 尽管抵抗顽强，你又帮我们取得了一场抗击入侵者的胜利！苏军两个师几乎被全歼，余部正四处逃散，我们也缴获了可观的战利品！现在，你的部下将连同第9师南下，朝库赫莫推进....

src: Despite fierce resistance, you have managed to secure the Arsnwalde area and breakthrough past Stargard towards Altdamm and Stettin. Now the 2nd Belorussian front will take it from here while most of the elements of your 1st Belorussian front return to the bridgehead at Kustrin in preparation for the final push towards Berlin...
dst: 尽管抵抗顽强，你已成功控制阿恩斯瓦尔德地区，并突破什塔加德，直指阿尔特达姆和斯德丁。现在白俄罗斯第2方面军将接手这里，而你的白俄罗斯第1方面军大部则返回屈斯特林桥头堡，为向柏林的最后推进做准备……

src: Despite fierce resistance, you have managed to wipe out most of the Japanese forces, the remainder being either caught behind our lines of advance or pushed back into Manchukuo. Now the Japanese have asked for an armistice, and they agree to abide by the existing border! Congratulations, you have been awarded the title of "Hero of the Soviet Union", promoted to General of the Army, and have been given command of the Kiev Special Military District!
dst: 尽管抵抗顽强，你已成功歼灭了日军大部，余部要么被切断在我军推进线之后，要么被赶回满洲国。现在日方已请求停战，并同意遵守现有边界！恭喜你，你被授予「苏联英雄」称号，晋升为大将，并受命指挥基辅特别军区！

src: Despite of German armament and military officers the combat strength and courage of Askari troops should not be underestimated .*
dst: 尽管有德国的武器装备和军官，阿斯卡里部队的战斗力与勇气也不应被低估。*

src: Despite of their high losses, the Western Desert Air Force still holds air superiority. The B25's diverted from China to Egypt by Roosevelt have been spotted by our troops.
dst: 尽管损失很大，西部沙漠空军仍掌握着制空权。我们的部队已发现了罗斯福从中国调往埃及的那些 B-25。

src: Despite our victories in Russia the Austro-Hungarian Army is on the verge of collapse. If we don't help them quickly, I'm afraid that the Italians will force them to surrender in a matter of weeks. So you'll have to go to the rescue of our allies again.
dst: 尽管我们在俄国节节胜利，奥匈军队却已濒临崩溃。如果我们不迅速施以援手，恐怕意大利人不出几周就会迫使他们投降。所以您又得去救援我们的盟友了。

src: Despite our victories, our advance was hard and slow. The Boer had had time to fortify themselves on the hills located along the railway line to Kimberley, south of the town. They knew that it was their last line of defense. If we managed to defeat them, we would force them to lift the siege, and Kimberley would be free at last. In order to reach that objective, we had recently been reinforced by the Highland Brigade.
dst: 尽管我们屡屡获胜，我们的推进仍然艰难而缓慢。布尔人已利用时间在通往金伯利的铁路沿线、该镇以南的山丘上构筑了工事。他们知道这是他们的最后一道防线。如果我们能打败他们，就能迫使他们解除围困，金伯利终将获得自由。为了达成这一目标，我们最近得到了高地旅的增援。

src: Despite several attacks the German troops could not take the town of Vinkt. Both in Meigem and Vinkt the Germans suffered heavy casualties. German frustration was that high that 140 civilians were killed in the space of just a few days.
dst: 尽管发动了多次进攻，德军仍未能攻占芬克特镇。在梅海姆和芬克特，德军都付出了惨重伤亡。德军的挫败感如此之强，以至于在短短几天内就有140名平民被杀害。

src: Despite some resistance, you have managed to put a stop to the mischief. Now the Romanians are protesting that we violated the agreement by using airborne troops and airborne tanks to disperse their army! They were so panic stricken that they actually assumed that the tanks had been transported by air as well! Stalin sends his regards...
dst: 尽管遭遇一些抵抗，你已成功制止了这场闹剧。现在罗马尼亚人抗议我们使用空降部队和空降坦克驱散他们的军队，违反了协定！他们惊恐万状，竟真的以为那些坦克也是由空运投送的！斯大林向你致意……

src: Despite tenacious Filipino resistance, Lachambre's troops recaptured Silang without major difficulties, forcing the rebels to retreat to Perez Dasmariñas in disorganized manner.
dst: 尽管菲律宾人顽强抵抗，拉尚布尔的部队还是没费太大力气就收复了西朗，迫使起义军狼狈地撤退到佩雷斯·达斯马里尼亚斯。

src: Despite the armistice, the Belgian army continued to fight in different scenarios … but that is another story.
dst: 尽管签订了停战协定，比利时军队仍在不同的战场上继续战斗……但那是另一个故事了。

src: Despite the efforts of the Army of the North and the defenders of Paris, the main threat for the Prussian plans was, without any doubt, the southern Army of the Loire. Commanded by General d'Aurelle de Paladines, on November 9 it had managed to surprise and defeat a Bavarian contingent at Coulmiers. That had been the greatest victory of any French army during the war, and it had allowed them to retake Orléans and to give hope to the Parisians.
dst: 尽管北方军团和巴黎守军做出了种种努力，对普鲁士计划构成最大威胁的，毫无疑问还是南面的卢瓦尔军团。该军团由多雷勒·德·帕拉丁将军指挥，于11月9日在库尔米耶成功奇袭并击败了一支巴伐利亚部队。这是这场战争中任何一支法军取得的最大胜利，使他们得以收复奥尔良，并给巴黎人带来了希望。

src: Despite the lack of substantial artillery support we have repulsed the Turkish counter-attack that could have easily pushed us back all the way down to ANZAC cove. Even though the breakout has not been a total success we have at least achieved some territorial gains and could establish new positions at Sari Bair ridge.
dst: 尽管缺乏强大的炮兵支援，我们仍击退了土耳其人的反攻——这次反攻本可能轻易将我们一路推回澳新军团湾。虽然突围并非完全成功，但我们至少取得了一些领土进展，并得以在萨里拜尔山脊建立新阵地。

src: Despite the late acquisition of colonies, Germany was able to secure large territories, especially in Africa. At that time Germany was one of the most modern and most powerful industrialized nations...
dst: 尽管获取殖民地较晚，德国还是成功占据了广大的领土，尤其是在非洲。当时德国是世界上最现代化、最强大的工业国之一……

src: Despite the many drawbacks and misadventures, the Austro-Saxon Army of the North could finally regroup near the town of Königgrätz. They had allowed the Prussians to take the initiative in the campaign, and now they were paying the price: three Prussian armies were converging on the Elbe Valley, and would soon reach the Austrian positions.
dst: 尽管经历了诸多挫折与磨难，奥萨北方军团最终还是得以在柯尼希格雷茨城附近重新集结。他们此前让普鲁士人在战役中掌握了主动权，如今正为此付出代价：三支普鲁士军队正向易北河谷汇集，很快将抵达奥地利人的阵地。

src: Despite the meticulous preparation, your troops failed to maintain a pace adequate to keep up with the creeping barrage.  Suffering horrid casualties, you have not achieved your objectives.
dst: 尽管准备周密，您的部队还是没能以足够的速度跟上徐进弹幕。在遭受可怕的伤亡之后，您未能达成目标。

src: Despite the stout resistance of the enemy, your troops have established a bridgehead at the tip of the Gallipoli peninsula. Turkish resistance has been much heavier than expected, but in the end the dash and bravery of your superb 29th Division prevailed.
dst: 尽管敌人顽强抵抗，您的部队还是在加里波利半岛顶端建立了桥头堡。土耳其人的抵抗比预期猛烈得多，但最终，您卓越的第29师凭借勇猛与无畏占了上风。

src: Despite the stunning German success, many things could have gone wrong.   The French might have succeeded and the German advance to the sea slowed enough to allow the Allied mobile forces to escape from the encirclement at Dunkirk.
dst: 尽管德军取得了令人震惊的成功，但许多事情本可能出错。法国人本可能成功，使德军向海边的推进慢到足以让盟军机动部队从敦刻尔克的包围中逃脱。

src: Despite the success of the operation, all the heavy equipment and vehicles had to be abandoned, and several thousand French troops were captured in the Dunkirk pocket. Six British and three French destroyers were sunk, along with nine large boats. In addition, 19 destroyers were damaged. Over 200 of the Allied sea craft were sunk, with an equal number damaged. The Royal Navy claimed the destruction of 35 Luftwaffe aircraft from ship's gunfire during the period and damage to another 21 aircraft. Between 26 May and 4 June the RAF flew a total of 4,822 sorties over Dunkirk, losing just over 100 aircraft in the fighting.
dst: 尽管行动成功，所有重型装备和车辆都不得不丢弃，数千名法国士兵在敦刻尔克包围圈中被俘。6艘英国和3艘法国驱逐舰被击沉，另有9艘大船沉没。此外还有19艘驱逐舰受损。盟军有200多艘船只被击沉，另有同等数量受损。皇家海军声称在此期间以舰炮击落35架德国空军飞机，另击伤21架。5月26日至6月4日，皇家空军在敦刻尔克上空共出动4822架次，战斗中仅损失100余架飞机。

src: Despite the superiority of soviet forces the battle for Taman Peninsula was fought on German's OKH terms which decided the moments of withdrawal on defensive lines and also the time for the evacuation.  The decision to evacuate was not a result of defeats in Taman but because of unfavorable unfolding operations to the north of Azov Sea .
dst: 尽管苏军占有优势，塔曼半岛之战却按德军OKH（陆军总参谋部）的节奏进行——其决定了逐次退守防线及撤离的时机。撤离的决定并非源于塔曼的失败，而是因亚速海以北战事发展不利。

src: Despite the victorious outcome, battle of Sokolovo could easily end the other way around. It is rather known fact that the supporting tanks were ordered into the thawing river Mzha, where the first one of them drowned. Also the connection with the 1st company was lost and this cost many lives. After all those years it is too hard to judge what exactly happened and where the mistakes were done...
dst: 尽管取得了胜利，索科洛沃之战本也可能以另一种结局收场。众所周知，支援坦克奉命开进正在解冻的姆扎河，结果第一辆就淹没了。此外，与第1连的联系一度中断，这付出了许多生命的代价。时隔多年，已很难判断究竟发生了什么、错在哪里……

src: Despite their defeat at Lozengrad, the Ottomans hae been able to reorganize their troops very quickly. Right now, they are building a defence line between Lule Burgas and Bunar Hissar. You must attack inmediately, before they can finish their trenches and bunkers.
dst: 尽管在洛泽格勒战败，奥斯曼人还是很快重整了部队。眼下，他们正在卢莱布尔加斯与布纳尔希萨尔之间构筑防线。您必须立即进攻，趁他们挖完战壕和掩体之前。

src: Despite their enormous numerical superiority, you have stopped the Greek offensive. That will give us the time we need to strengthen our army.
dst: 尽管希腊人在兵力上占有巨大优势，您还是阻止了他们的进攻。这将为我们争取到加强军队所需的时间。

src: Despite their heroic deeds the British soldiers, without any hope of receiving reinforcements, had to retire, and went back to the East Africa Protectorate. So, finally, we secured our southern border. Eritrea was safe for the moment, and the Mad Mullah, unwittingly, was helping us in Somalia, blocking all the Entente columns in the desert. So I was finally free to help in Gondar.
dst: 尽管英军士兵英勇作战，但由于毫无得到增援的希望，他们不得不撤退，返回了东非保护国。就这样，我们终于保住了南部边境。厄立特里亚暂时安全了，而在索马里，疯狂毛拉无意中帮了我们，把所有协约国纵队都困在了沙漠里。所以我终于腾出手来援助贡德尔了。

src: Despite violent counter-attacks, your troops have routed the German defenders all along the ridge and have attained all of their objectives.
dst: 尽管遭到猛烈反击，您的部队还是沿着山脊全线击溃了德军守军，并达成了所有目标。

src: Despite your brilliant command you have not managed to evacuate the germ of a new Belgian army to continue the fight to restore the independence and freedom of Belgium.
dst: 尽管你出色地指挥，你仍未能撤出新比利时军队的种子，以继续战斗、恢复比利时的独立与自由。

src: Despite your excellent job the 3rd and 4th Panzerdivisionen have finally broken through towards the city of Tongres. This has forced our Army to abandon the "Position de Couverture" of the Canal Albert sooner than planned and as a consequence it has undermined the deployment of the 1re armée française in the "Ligne KW" (Dyle position).
dst: 尽管你表现出色，第3和第4装甲师最终还是突破了防线，向通厄伦城推进。这迫使我军比计划更早地放弃阿尔贝运河的“Position de Couverture”，结果也破坏了法国第1集团军在“Ligne KW”（戴尔河阵地）的部署。

src: Despite your incompetence Riga is ours, and the infiltration tactics have allowed us to achieve our goals without destroying most of the city. Apart from some units including the Latvian riflemen, who have fought valiantly, most of the Russian 12th Army has fled the battlefield. After so many years of war the Russian soldiers have lost their combative spirit and they refuse to fight against us. Soon Kerenski will have to accept our peace terms and, if he doesn't, he'll be ousted from power. In any case the war with Russia will soon be over.
dst: 尽管您指挥无能，里加还是归我们了，渗透战术也使我们得以在不摧毁大部分城区的情况下达成目标。除了一些包括拉脱维亚步兵在内的英勇作战的部队，俄军第12集团军大部分已逃离战场。经过这么多年的战争，俄军士兵已丧失斗志，拒绝与我们作战。克伦斯基很快就得接受我们的和谈条件，否则就会被赶下台。无论如何，对俄战争很快就会结束。

src: Despite your stunning success the free people of the world never lose their will to fight.  Cross Atlantic supply lines and stubborn resistance eventually slow your advance, stop it, then reverse it.  Several South American nations declare themselves as your allies after your initial victories on U.S. soil, but even the support they offer is not enough to turn the tide in your favour.  And across the Atlantic, in Europe, and the Soviet Union, resistance grows.  You may yet lose the war, and if you win the war, you may lose the peace that follows.
dst: 尽管你取得了惊人的成功，世上自由的人民却从未丧失战斗意志。跨大西洋的补给线和顽强的抵抗，最终会迟滞你的推进、令其停止，继而将其逆转。你在美国本土取得初步胜利后，数个南美国家宣布成为你的盟友，但即便他们提供的支持也不足以让战局向你有利的方向扭转。而在大西洋彼岸，在欧洲、在苏联，抵抗日益壮大。你或许终究会输掉这场战争；而即便赢了战争，也可能输掉随之而来的和平。

src: Despite your successful maneuvers, by now it's obvious that we are going to lose this war. We counted on a quick, decisive victory against Serbia while holding out the Greek Army before our other neighbours could react. But nothing of that happened. Still weakened after the war against the Ottomans, we had to go on the defensive in all fronts, and Romania and Turkey mobilized their troops sooner than we expected. In fact, the Turks have just retook Odrin, and the Romanians are at the gates of Sofia.
dst: 尽管您机动成功，但事到如今，我们显然要输掉这场战争了。我们原指望趁其他邻国还来不及反应，迅速取得对塞尔维亚的决定性胜利，同时挡住希腊军队。但这些都没有发生。在对奥斯曼的战争之后，我们依然虚弱，不得不在各条战线转入守势，而罗马尼亚和土耳其动员军队的速度比我们预想的更快。事实上，土耳其人刚刚重新夺回了奥德林，罗马尼亚人也已兵临索非亚城下。

src: Despite your successful maneuvers, by now it's obvious that we are going to lose this war. We counted on a quick, decisive victory against Serbia while holding out the Greek Army before our other neighbours could react. But nothing of that happened. Still weakened after the war against the Ottomans, we had to go on the defensive in all fronts, and Romania and Turkey mobilized their troops sooner than we expected. With nothing to oppose them, the Turks will soon retake Odrin, and the Romanians will march to the gates of Sofia.
dst: 尽管您机动成功，但事到如今，我们显然要输掉这场战争了。我们原指望趁其他邻国还来不及反应，迅速取得对塞尔维亚的决定性胜利，同时挡住希腊军队。但这些都没有发生。在对奥斯曼的战争之后，我们依然虚弱，不得不在各条战线转入守势，而罗马尼亚和土耳其动员军队的速度比我们预想的更快。由于无人抵挡，土耳其人很快就会重新夺取奥德林，罗马尼亚人也将兵临索非亚城下。

src: Despite your tenacious resistance the 3rd and 4th Panzerdivisionen have finally broken through towards Tongres. This has forced our Army to abandon the "Position de Couverture" of the Canal Albert sooner than foreseen and as a consequence has undermined the deployment of the 1re armée française in the "Ligne KW" (Dyle position).
dst: 尽管你顽强抵抗，第3和第4装甲师最终还是突破了防线，向通厄伦推进。这迫使我军比预想更早地放弃阿尔贝运河的“Position de Couverture”，结果也削弱了法国第1集团军在“Ligne KW”（戴尔河阵地）的部署。

src: Despite your troops engaged several German divisions, you have managed to offer considerable resistance, to delay the German forces and to withdraw from Antwerpen/Anvers in an ordered manner.
dst: 尽管您的部队与德军数个师交战，您仍成功进行了相当顽强的抵抗，迟滞了德军，并有秩序地从安特卫普撤出。

src: Despite your troops engaged several German divisions, you have managed to offer some resistance, to difficult the German forces advance and to withdraw from Antwerpen/Anvers without panic.
dst: 尽管您的部队与德军数个师交战，您仍成功进行了抵抗，迟滞了德军推进，并从安特卫普从容撤出。

src: Despite your troops engaged several German divisions, you have managed to withdraw from Antwerpen/Anvers without suffering heavy losses.
dst: 尽管您的部队与德军数个师交战，您仍成功从安特卫普撤出，且未遭受重大损失。

src: Despite your valiant effort in slowing the breakout from Normandy, the Allies continue to race across the countryside.
dst: 尽管你为迟滞诺曼底方向的突破英勇作战，盟军仍在乡野间长驱直入。

src: Despite your victory at Saint-Mihiel, the siege of Verdun and the fall of Nancy, the French have recovered incredibly quickly. Many enemy divisions have rushed to the front and somehow they've managed to slow our advance along the Marne. If we don't react, another stalemate seems likely. We'll have to improvise, try something different.
dst: 尽管您在圣米耶勒取得了胜利，凡尔登被围、南锡陷落，法军却以惊人的速度恢复了过来。许多敌军师匆匆赶往前线，并设法迟滞了我们在马恩河沿岸的推进。如果我们不采取行动，似乎很可能再度陷入僵局。我们必须随机应变，尝试一些不同的打法。

src: Despliegue sus fuerzas y comience el ataque. Ah, una cosa más, mi general. En el futuro próximo estoy planeando una entrevista con el general Franco. Vamos a discutir sobre mi papel en el nuevo gobierno, así que estaré ausente por unos días.
dst: 展开您的部队，开始进攻。啊，还有一件事，我的将军。不久的将来，我计划与佛朗哥将军会面。我们要讨论我在新政府中的角色，因此我将离开几天。

dst: 摧毁 1 个雷达单位、4 个防空单位与 15 架战斗机。

dst: 歼灭该部，占领拉昂及通往圣康坦的桥梁。

src: Diamond Hill was one of the last true battles of the war. Our division remained in the area surrounding Pretoria for nearly a month, and later we were again given secondary tasks, pursuing small Boer commandos.
dst: 钻石山是这场战争最后几场真正的大战之一。我们的师在比勒陀利亚周边地区驻扎了近一个月，之后我们又被分派次要任务，追击小股布尔突击队。

src: Diamond Hill was one of the last true battles of the war. Our división remained in the area surrounding Pretoria for nearly a month, and later we were again given secondary tasks, pursuing small Boer commandos.
dst: 钻石山是这场战争最后几场真正的大战之一。我们的师在比勒陀利亚周边地区驻扎了近一个月，之后我们又被分派次要任务，追击小股布尔突击队。

src: Did you really think we were sailing to Pearl Harbor?  Allow me to explain the true plans for your troops.  While the other troop formation that we were sailing with is going to Pearl Harbor, your command will simultaneously disembark on a night attack against the Monterey beaches, southwards from San Francisco.  This double attack will completely surprise the Americans as they are only awaiting an attack on Pearl Harbor or Alaska, but not an attack on the US mainland!  They have started building fortification works on the beaches, but they haven't enough troops to stop our night assault.  They only have a couple of recently formed divisions and the ''National Guard'' of California.
dst: 您真的以为我们是要驶向珍珠港吗？请允许我说明您的部队真正的计划。与我们同行的另一支编队正前往珍珠港，而您所部将同时在夜间对旧金山以南的蒙特雷海滩发起登陆突袭。这场双重打击将让美国人完全措手不及，因为他们只提防着对珍珠港或阿拉斯加的进攻，却绝没想到会遭到对美国本土的进攻！他们已开始在海滩上构筑工事，但兵力不足以阻止我们的夜间突击。他们只有两个新近组建的师以及加利福尼亚的「国民警卫队」。

src: Die Maji-Maji haben von ihrem Führer "Bokero" ein Zauberwasser erhalten, dass unsere Kugeln bei einem Treffer in Wasser verwandeln soll - kann man sich so etwas vorstellen? Da sie glauben dass sie unverwundbar sind, ziehen ihre Krieger brandschatzend in Richtung unserer wertvollen Baumwollplantagen.
dst: 马吉-马吉人从他们的首领「博克罗」那里得到了一种神奇的水，据说能使我们的子弹在击中时化为水——您能想象这种事吗？他们相信自己刀枪不入，于是他们的战士一路烧杀抢掠，直扑我们宝贵的棉花种植园。

src: Die Römer bleiben etwa 400 Jahre im heutigen England; der Norden, das heutige Schottland, und der äusserste Westen, das heutige Wales werden nie von ihnen unterworfen. Nach den grossen Germanenstürmen im fünften Jahrhundert werden alle römischen Legionen aus Britannien zurückgezogen und die römische Herrschaft endet dort für immer.... um diese Zeit rankt sich die bekannte Artus-Legende...
dst: 罗马人在今天的英格兰逗留了约400年；北方，即今天的苏格兰，以及最西边，即今天的威尔士，从未被他们征服。五世纪日耳曼人大风暴之后，罗马军团全部从不列颠撤走，罗马的统治在那里永远终结……也就在那个时期，著名的亚瑟王传说开始流传……

src: Dieppe is in our hands and you've taken thousands of British prisoners. However, despite your victory, that stubborn country still refuses to surrender. Do you understand it? They've been expelled out of France, but they still want to fight! They want to keep their naval blockade on our coast, while they hope for an American intervention. What else do we have to do before they acknowledge their defeat?
dst: 迪耶普已在我们手中，您还俘获了数千名英军战俘。然而，尽管您取得了胜利，那个顽固的国家仍拒绝投降。您能理解吗？他们已被赶出法国，却还想继续打！他们想继续对我们的海岸实行海上封锁，同时指望美国介入。在他们承认战败之前，我们还得再做些什么？

src: Dieser gibt nicht freiwillig sein Land auf. Es gilt also das Land der Boier zu erobern. Auf auf Krieger !!! Macht uns alle Ehre !!!
dst: 波伊人不会自愿放弃土地。因此必须征服波伊人的土地。冲啊，战士们！！！为我们所有人争光！！！

src: Dietrich's Leibstandarte has launched an attack towards the Wattenberg heights to destroy Allied artillery there. OKW is far from pleased but has ordered you to move 2nd Panzer Division up in support of this reckless action.
dst: 迪特里希的警卫旗队已向瓦滕贝格高地发起进攻，以摧毁那里的盟军炮兵。最高统帅部（OKW）对此极不满意，却仍命令你调第2装甲师上前，支援这次鲁莽的行动。

src: Difficult terrain , weather conditions and German's tenacious defense determined a slow progress for Romanian troops...
dst: 艰险地形、恶劣天气与德军的顽强防御，致使罗马尼亚军队推进迟缓……
迪尔曼—乌尔米耶，1915年5月15日

src: Disaster - Eight Army has broken through and enemy recon and armored formations are causing havoc behind our lines. Rommel has ordered all units to retreat. This could lead us all the way back to El Agheila.
dst: 灾难——第8集团军已突破，敌军的侦察和装甲部队正在我们战线后方大肆破坏。隆美尔已下令所有部队撤退。这可能使我们一路退回阿格海拉。

src: Disaster - after Bardia also Tobruk has fallen into English hands and XXII Corps has surrendered.
dst: 灾难——继巴迪亚之后，托布鲁克也落入英军之手，第22军已投降。

src: Disaster! Eight Army was succesful in surrounding and capturing the remnants of the DAK and your Ariete Battlegroup. Prepare for a long stay in captivity.
dst: 灾难！第8集团军成功包围并俘获了非洲军残部和你的“公羊”战斗群。准备在战俘营里长住了。

src: Disaster! The Soviet barbarians have reached Berlin. This is the end of the Third Reich and the end of civilization..
dst: 灾难！苏联人已抵达柏林。这是第三帝国的终结，也是文明的终结……

src: Disaster! The enemy has broken through our lines. The complete Tunisian front is completely distabalized. You are fired!
dst: 灾难！敌军已突破我军防线。整个突尼斯战线彻底动摇。你被撤职了！

src: Disaster! You failed to stop the attack of XXX Corps, spearheaded by the 50th (Northumbrian) Division. There is nothing left for us but to hastily retreat to the Akarit line.
dst: 灾难！你未能挡住第30军由第50（诺森伯兰）师打头的进攻。我们别无出路，只能仓促撤往阿卡里特防线。

src: Disaster. German forces have broken through and are causing havoc behind the front line. We have to retreat into Algeria. Your services are no longer required.
dst: 灾难。德军已突破防线，正在战线后方肆虐。我军不得不撤回阿尔及利亚。你的服务不再需要了。

src: Disaster. There is nothing that stands between the Allies and Tripoli now. North Africa is lost.
dst: 灾难。如今盟军与黎波里之间已无兵可挡。北非丢掉了。

src: Disaster. We lost thousands of men and the Italians vastly extended their area of control around Trablus.
dst: 灾难。我们损失了数千人，意大利人在的黎波里周围的控制区大幅扩大。

src: Disaster. Your brigades had to flee into the woods and your division has ceased to be an effective fighting force.
dst: 一场灾难。您的各旅不得不逃入树林，您的师已不再是有效的作战力量。

src: Disembarking in Siboney was extremely easy. Now we're supposed to flank the other brigade of our division, but you know what? We've spotted some Spanish troops in Las Guásimas, guarding the road to Santiago. Wouldn't it be good to have some action after that terrible journey by sea?
dst: 在西博内登陆异常顺利。如今我们本该去包抄我们师里的另一个旅，但您知道吗？我们在拉斯瓜西马斯发现了一些西班牙部队，正把守着通往圣地亚哥的道路。在经历了那段可怕的海上航行之后，来点战斗岂不正好？

src: Diterikhs had to come to my rescue. Moscow is in our hands, but not due to my merits. I have a personal sense of defeat.
dst: 季捷里赫斯不得不赶来救我。莫斯科虽已在我们手中，却并非我的功劳。我个人有一种挫败感。

src: Do not allow any enemy unit to slip through your lines!
dst: 绝不允许任何敌军单位从你的防线上溜走！

src: Do not apologize, comrade.  Although you were held up near Rovno, the advance is still under way.  Not even the people's army can win every skirmish.  But the war, comrade, the war is still going on, and it is going in our favor!
dst: 不必道歉，同志。虽然您在罗夫诺附近受阻，但攻势仍在继续。即使是人民的军队也不可能赢得每一场小仗。但战争，同志，战争仍在继续，而且正朝着有利于我们的方向发展！

src: Do not attempt an attack on the southern coast! Our reports indicate that it is heavily defended. We suggest your airborne troops take an airbase for your planes to operate from.
dst: 切勿尝试进攻南部海岸！报告显示那里守备森严。我们建议让你的空降部队夺取一座航空基地，供你的飞机起降作战。

src: Do not choose any scenario you have already played as this will take you back in time.
dst: 不要选择任何你已玩过的场景，否则会把你带回过去的时间点。

src: Do not desesperate General. You were close to victory!
dst: 不要绝望，将军。您离胜利只差一步！

src: Do not fail us again or the end of your command will come swiftly for you.
dst: 别再让我们失望，否则你的指挥生涯将很快结束。

src: Do not fear nuclear retaliation, Herr General; the Japanese will never subject themselves to the shame that would result from the use of such a "cowardly" weapon.
dst: 不必担心核报复，将军阁下；日本人绝不会让自己蒙受使用如此『懦夫』武器所带来的耻辱。

src: Do not hesitate to use all of the tools at your disposal.  The Luftwaffe has come up with some new toys that may make this assault easier than anything you ever had to deal with in the previous war.
dst: 不要犹豫，尽管动用你掌握的一切手段。空军研制出了一些新玩具，或许能让这次进攻比你上一场战争中经历过的任何事都更容易。

src: Do not plan on receiving many reinforcements for this battle:  Kuropatkin has refused to commit all of his troops, fearing a sudden break-through by the Japanese against one of his flanks.
dst: 别指望这场战斗能得到多少增援：库罗帕特金担心日军会对其某个侧翼发动突然突破，因此拒绝投入全部兵力。

src: Do not sell free core naval vessels. You'll need them!
dst: 不要卖掉免费的核心海军舰艇。你会用得着的！

src: Do not sell your core ships, you need them in some scenarios.
dst: 不要卖掉你的核心舰船，有些场景里你需要它们。

src: Do not stop for nothing.  Go for your objectives.  Make terror your weapon!  Liberate the peasants of Voronezh!
dst: 不要为任何事停下。直扑您的目标。让恐怖成为您的武器！解放沃罗涅日的农民！

src: Do not underestimate the Germans! Although they have not many armoured vehicles, they know the terrain well and especially in the north you will need units with a good defense and good attack against entrechened infantry.
dst: 不要低估德军！尽管他们没有多少装甲车辆，但他们熟悉地形，尤其是在北面，你需要防御力好、对据守步兵攻击力强的单位。

src: Do the Russians stick to or abandon their grand offensive?.
dst: 俄军究竟会坚持还是放弃其宏大攻势？

src: Do you have any doubts about this? Well, it's a bit too late for that, don't you think? And let me tell you something: no matter what you may have heard about atrocities committed by the Force Publique, the Arab slavers are a hundred times worse than us. Believe it or not, we're the good guys here. We're liberating this country.
dst: 您对此还有什么疑虑吗？嗯，现在有点太迟了，您不觉得吗？让我告诉您一件事：无论您可能听说了「公共力量」犯下怎样的暴行，阿拉伯奴隶贩子都比我们恶劣一百倍。信不信由您，在这里我们才是好人。我们正在解放这个国家。

src: Do you remember M. Robert Esnault-Pelterie, one of the founders of the Paris Air Show? We met him back in 1912 at the show when Europe was enjoying more peaceful times. Six of his airplanes commanded by Capitaine Maurice Précardin are now joining my division to better direct the fire of our artillery.
dst: 您还记得罗贝尔·埃斯诺-佩尔特里先生吗？巴黎航展的创始人之一。我们是在1912年的航展上认识他的，那时欧洲正享受较为和平的时光。他麾下的六架飞机由莫里斯·普雷卡丹上尉指挥，如今正加入我的师，以便更好地引导我方炮兵的火力。

src: Do you want to spend 300 prestige to secure Gibralter and the help of the Italian Navy?
dst: 你是否愿意花费 300 点声望以确保夺取直布罗陀并获得意大利海军的协助？
多布里夫卡 (多布罗夫卡)
多布罗梅罗斯·赫里索斯

src: Doing this, we also have encircled the rebel capital Richmond.
dst: 这样一来，我们也就包围了叛军首府里士满。
多林斯克 (塔拉姆斯基耶)
多莫科斯 - 战术胜利

src: Don't disappoint us any further, especially now when your unit will receive several pieces of a brand new heavy tank.
dst: 别再让我们失望了，尤其是眼下你的部队即将接收数辆崭新的重型坦克。

src: Don't entertain any illusions about this campaign. We're here for just two reasons: the riches of the Congo and the glory of the King of the Belgians. Sadly, the Arabs from the Sultanate of Zanzibar make good money in Eastern Congo, too, and they won't give up their ivory and their slave routes, so I guess that a fight for this territory was unavoidable.
dst: 对这场战役不要抱任何幻想。我们来这里只为两个原因：刚果的财富，以及比利时国王的荣耀。遗憾的是，桑给巴尔苏丹国的阿拉伯人也在刚果东部赚得盆满钵满，他们不会放弃象牙和贩奴路线，所以我想，为这片领土而战是不可避免的。

src: Don't expect any reinforcements. The battle is at its high and both sides already moved in the reserves...
dst: 别指望任何增援。战斗正值高潮，双方都已投入了预备队……

src: Don't expect further reinforcements! And if you delay your attack too much, you may have to fight off more bolsheviks!
dst: 不要再指望进一步的增援！如果您过于拖延进攻，可能就不得不与更多的布尔什维克作战了！

src: Don't expect ground reinforcements during the battle.
dst: 战斗中不要指望地面增援。

src: Don't feel frustrated. The Germans have been forced to commit more troops in Alsace and Lorraine than they had expected, so they haven't been able to reinforce their main offensive in Belgique as much as they needed. This will give us more chances of defeating them there.
dst: 不必沮丧。德军被迫在阿尔萨斯和洛林投入了比预期更多的部队，因此无法按需要充分增援他们在比利时的主攻。这将给我们更多机会在那里击败他们。

src: Don't underestimate the enemy. They may be weaker now, but their defences stand still, and some of their soldiers are veterans.
dst: 不要低估敌人。他们现在也许更弱了，但他们的防御工事依然矗立，而且他们中有些士兵是老兵。

src: Don't waste units on garrison duties. Move forwards as fast as possible, knocking out the Soviets one by one by your local superiority in numbers.
dst: 别把部队浪费在守备任务上。尽快向前推进，凭借局部兵力优势逐个击破苏军。

src: Don't worry about me. We arrived here one month after the offensive began, and in that time our army, along with our Austrian and Bulgarian allies, have already defeated the Serbians. All we have to do now is to march as quickly as we can and destroy the remnants of the Serbian Army before they can flee to any of the neighbouring countries. Believe me, it won't be too hard.
dst: 别为我担心。我们在攻势开始一个月后才抵达这里，而在这段时间里，我们的军队已会同奥地利和保加利亚盟友击败了塞尔维亚人。现在我们要做的，就是尽可能快速地行军，赶在塞尔维亚军队残部逃往任何邻国之前将其歼灭。相信我，这不会太难。

src: Don't worry too much, Commander; the eggheads also think that our time machine is "ripple-proof" or some such bullshit.  I guess what that means is that we're not going to spontaneously erase ourselves or the machine from the timeline by wiping out Pegasus before we ever got the machine to begin with.
dst: 别太担心，指挥官；书呆子们还认为我们的时间机器「抗涟漪干扰」之类的鬼话。我猜那意思是，我们在当初得到机器之前就抹掉珀伽索斯，不会让我们自己或机器从时间线上自发消失。

src: Don't you believe it? I find it hard to believe it myself, even after reading all those damned reports. We were doing it right, General. After the battle of Cer, we all agreed to take as few risks as possible. Our advance into Serbia was slow, methodical and, apparently, successful. We took thousands of prisoners and tons of equipment. Only two days ago, Belgrad fell without a fight. Yesterday we had a victory parade through the streets of the capital. We all believed that Serbia was doomed.
dst: 您不信吗？即便读完了那些该死的报告，我自己也难以相信。我们本来做得没错，将军。采尔战役之后，我们一致同意尽量少冒险。我们向塞尔维亚的推进缓慢、有条不紊，表面上也很成功。我们俘虏了数千人，缴获成吨装备。仅仅两天前，贝尔格莱德不战而降。昨天我们还在首都街头举行了胜利游行。我们都以为塞尔维亚气数已尽。

src: Dont forget to equip your men with modern weapons....
dst: 别忘了给您的士兵配备现代武器……

src: Dont forget: we must hold ALL VH's !
dst: 别忘了：我们必须守住所有胜利点！

src: Don´t let the two Confederate army groups get into contact with each other !
dst: 绝不能让这两支邦联军部队会合！

src: Don’t worry about your next command. In the following months you just have to rest and recover. Go back home, and spend your time with your wife. Didn’t you want that? Who knows, maybe when you’re ready for service again, the war will have already finished...
dst: 不必担心您下一次的指挥职务。接下来的几个月，您只需休养恢复。回家去吧，陪陪您的妻子。这不正是您想要的吗？谁知道呢，也许等您重新能够服役时，战争已经结束了……

src: Dort siedelt der keltische Stamm der Iceni, der später mit seiner Königin Boudicca noch zu trauriger Berühmtheit gelangen soll....
dst: 那里定居着凯尔特部族伊塞尼人，他们后来因女王布狄卡而落得可悲的名声……

src: Doshita no?, nani?... excuse me General, we are in an unexpected situation now!, the Soviets are launching a full scale offensive against Manchukuo. Some border units together with Manchukoan army units are already trying to stop the bolshevik onslaught!. Although the Kwantung Army is strong enough... could you help us with your troops?, you can drive them quickly to the Xingkai lake to help the Kwantung and Manchukoan units...
dst: 怎么了？什么？……抱歉，将军，我们现在处于意想不到的局面之中！苏联正对满洲国发动全面进攻。一些边境部队连同满洲国军部队已经在努力阻止布尔什维克的猛攻！尽管关东军足够强大……您能否率领您的部队帮助我们？您可以迅速把他们开赴兴凯湖，去支援关东军和满洲国部队……
Dover Monitor 中队  (RAdm Horace Hood)

src: Dublin and Belfast are taken by our troops and the British have started the evacuation of their remaining troops to Canada. We have order to prevent the evacuation via Londenderry and Coleraine in the north of the island. Your troops will advance on Coleraine in the northeast and stop these activities. Hurry up, it should not escape too many troops!
dst: 都柏林和贝尔法斯特已被我军夺取，英军已开始把残余部队撤往加拿大。我们奉命阻止他们经由岛北部的伦敦德里和科尔雷恩撤离。你的部队将向东北方向的科尔雷恩推进，制止这些行动。快点，不能让他们逃掉太多部队！
杜布罗夫卡 (萨马克拉热)

src: Due to my past defeat, in the following weeks Denikin only assigned secondary tasks to me. I can't blame him for that. My failure has prevented us from taking Moscow and, possibly, has cost us the war. Our army has been unable to stop the Soviet counterattacks, and it has been forced to retreat from most of the towns that it had taken during the summer. In fact, many of our divisions are on the verge of destruction.
dst: 由于我过去的失败，此后数周邓尼金只派给我次要任务。我不能为此责怪他。我的失败使我们未能攻下莫斯科，甚至可能使我们输掉了战争。我军一直无法抵挡苏维埃的反攻，被迫从夏季占领的大部分城镇撤退。事实上，我们的许多师都濒临覆灭。

src: Due to our actions at Przasnyz, the German plans for a coordinated spring offensive against the North-Western Front have been denied.  Having spent the strength of their divisions on the fighting, the German northern group of armies cannot undertake a strategic offensive without reinforcements from the West.  In the meanwhile, the German navy has assisted the German I Cavalry Corps in a raid against the Lithuanian port of Libau (Liepaja).  The port commander has over-reacted and ordered a full retreat in haste.
dst: 由于我们在普扎斯内什的作战，德军对西北方面军发动协同春季攻势的计划已告破产。在战斗中耗尽了各师的兵力后，德国北方集团军群无法在得不到西线增援的情况下发起战略进攻。与此同时，德国海军协助德国第1骑兵军对波罗的海港口利包（利耶帕亚）实施了一次突袭。港口司令反应过度，仓促下令全面撤退。

src: Due to the adverse weather conditions and supply problems, OKH has re-evaluated your drive on Moscow to more modest objectives for now.
dst: 由于恶劣天气和补给问题，陆军总司令部已重新评估了你向莫斯科的推进，目前改为较有限的目标。

src: Due to the deadlock in the Western front, with the trenchwarfare, and the difficut situation on the Eastern front, where the Russians are close to collapse, the Entente has planned to attack the Dardanelles. The aim is to help Russia distracting Turkish ressources, allow a passage to the Black Sea and invite the Balkan countries to abandon their neutrality and join a coalition against Turkey.
dst: 由于西线在堑壕战中陷入僵局，而东线局势艰难、俄国人濒临崩溃，协约国计划进攻达达尼尔海峡。其目的是通过牵制土耳其资源来帮助俄国，打开通往黑海的航道，并促使巴尔干国家放弃中立、加入反土耳其联盟。

src: Due to the extra distance that would be travelled by Guderians force, his attack began 2 days earlier than the other assaults to the north. The Russians had spent two months building field fortifications and over 800,000 men faced the Germans  however they were mostly raw replacements with little training and poor leadership. The defences along the River Desna were arranged in two echelons with no reserves of any strength in the rear. Guderian's Panzers broke the line in the Sevsk area and rushed north-east to Orel. After the war, Guderian noted in his book 'Panzer Leader' "Our seizure of the town took the enemy so completely by surprise, that the electric trams were still running as our tanks drove in." To the north the 1st Cavalry Division found the going hard and barely penetrated the Russian defences, they were withdrawn to Gomel and the next month dismounted and became the 24th Panzer division. Further north II Army was making slow progress so Guderian swung the 17th Panzer and 29th Mot Infantry Divisions to the west to attack Bryansk from the more weakly defended eastern side, the city fell on October 6th. The first snows fell on October 7th, it melted quickly, but was followed by heavy rains. "The roads rapidly became nothing but canals of bottomless mud," Guderian wrote, "along which our vehicles could only advance at a snail's pace and with great wear to the engines."
dst: 由于古德里安的部队要多走一段路，他的进攻比北面的其他攻势提前两天开始。俄国人花了两个月修筑野战工事，有80多万人面对德军，但他们大多是训练很少、指挥糟糕的新兵补充兵。杰斯纳河沿线的防御分两个梯队配置，后方没有任何有实力的预备队。古德里安的装甲部队在谢夫斯克地区突破防线，向东北直扑奥廖尔。战后，古德里安在《装甲指挥官》一书中写道：“我们夺取该城完全出乎敌人意料，我们的坦克开进去时，有轨电车还在运行。”在北面，第1骑兵师进展艰难，勉强突入俄军防御，他们被撤回戈梅利，次月下马改编为第24装甲师。再往北，第2集团军进展缓慢，于是古德里安把第17装甲师和第29摩托化步兵师调往西面，从防御较弱的东侧进攻布良斯克，该城于10月6日陷落。10月7日下了第一场雪，很快融化，随后是连绵大雨。古德里安写道：“道路很快变成一条条深不见底的泥河，我们的车辆只能以蜗牛般的速度前进，发动机磨损严重。”

src: Due to the heavy losses to your squadron we have decided to launch an invasion force to land on the southwest side of the peninsula and travel overland and destroy these coastal guns.
dst: 由于您的舰队损失惨重，我们决定派出一支登陆部队在半岛西南侧登陆，经陆路行军摧毁这些海岸炮台。

src: Due to the heavy resistance of the 9th Independent Army (initially) and the rapidly formed Separate Coastal Army, which was formed from the Coastal Group of the 9th Army[1]), and the Black Sea Fleet forces in Odessa, it took the Romanian army 73 days of siege and four attempts to take the city, during which they suffered 93,000 casualties.
dst: 由于第9独立集团军（起初）及由第9集团军海岸集群改编而成的独立海岸集团军的顽强抵抗，加之黑海舰队驻敖德萨部队，罗马尼亚军队历时73天、四次进攻才攻占该城，期间伤亡93,000人。

src: Due to the hostile pressure, we are forced to withdraw further and further into the south of German East Africa.
dst: 由于敌人的压力，我们被迫不断向德属东非的南部撤退。

src: Due to the inexperience of your rivals, their positions are badly defended, but they outnumber you easily and have more supplies.
dst: 由于你们对手缺乏经验，他们的阵地防御很差，但他们在人数上轻松压过你们，并且补给更充足。

src: Due to the invasion of west allied troops in France the Germans have withdrawn many troops. Your next operation will be the attack in Karelia. Move forward and capture Viipuri.
dst: 由于西方盟军部队入侵法国，德军已撤走许多部队。你的下一次行动将是进攻卡累利阿。向前推进并夺取维普里。

src: Due to your brilliant victory at Colesberg, now you may decide the course of the campaign. You can go to Paardeberg in order to save Cronjé's army, or you can stay at Colesberg.
dst: 由于您在科尔斯堡的辉煌胜利，现在您可以决定战役的走向了。您可以前往帕尔德山去拯救克罗涅的军队，也可以留在科尔斯堡。

src: Due to your delay, the Allies were able to evacuate their oil reserves from Tebessa.
dst: 由于您的拖延，盟军得以将他们的石油储备从泰贝萨撤走。

src: Due to your excellent performance and leadership on the field of battle, you will be reccomended for promotion to captain.
dst: 由于您在战场上的卓越表现和指挥才能，您将被推荐晋升为上尉。

src: Due to your good performance and leadership on the field of battle, you will be reccomended for promotion to captain.
dst: 由于您在战场上的良好表现和指挥才能，您将被推荐晋升为上尉。

src: Due to your great victories against the Bolsheviks, you are now in a position to change history. The Whites could win the Russian civil war and crush the Soviet revolutionaries.
dst: 由于您对布尔什维克取得的巨大胜利，您现在能够改变历史。白军可能赢得俄国内战，并粉碎苏维埃革命者。

src: Due to your incompetence you've spoiled more than a year of hard work. Your attack has been a disaster, but we can't afford retreating. If we do, the war will be lost. We'll keep pushing forward until we reach the Marne, but that'll be a task for a new, more gifted commander. Consider yourself relieved of all your duties. Go back home and try to enjoy your retirement.
dst: 由于您的无能，您毁掉了一年多的艰苦努力。您的进攻是一场灾难，但我们不能撤退。一旦撤退，战争就输定了。我们将继续向前推进，直到抵达马恩河，但那将交给一位新的、更有天赋的指挥官去完成。您已被解除全部职务。回家去吧，好好享受您的退役生活。

src: Due to your incompetence, rebel commander Maceo is stronger than ever.
dst: 由于您的无能，叛军指挥官马塞奥比以往更加强大。

src: Due to your incompetence, the Yankees have taken control over the island of Guam, a small but vital part of our glorious Empire.
dst: 由于您的无能，洋基人已经控制了关岛——我们这个光荣帝国虽小却至关重要的一部分。

src: Due to your incompetence, the city of Bayamo is lost.
dst: 由于您的无能，巴亚莫城失守了。

src: Due to your incompetence, the city of Melilla is lost.
dst: 由于您的无能，梅利利亚城失守了。

src: Due to your incompetence, the insurgents have destroyed our forces in Cavite and part of the relief column. The rebellion has spread across the country and our situation in Manila is hopeless.
dst: 由于您的无能，起义者消灭了我们在甲米地的部队以及援军纵队的一部分。叛乱已蔓延全国，我们在马尼拉的处境已毫无希望。

src: Due to your incompetence, the rebels have inflicted a serious defeat on us. They are stronger than ever and the reconquer of Cavite province will take us longer and with heavier losses.
dst: 由于您的无能，叛军使我们遭受惨败。他们比以往更加强大，收复甲米地省将耗费更长时间并付出更惨重代价。

src: Due to your incompetence, we have lost control over Manila's only source of reliable fresh water. All resistance is futile.
dst: 由于您的无能，我们失去了对马尼拉唯一可靠淡水水源的控制。一切抵抗都徒劳无益。

src: Due to your incompetence, you have failed to take the village of Silang. This disaster has raised morale among the rebels and no the reconquer of Cavite province will take us longer and with heavier losses.
dst: 由于您的无能，您未能攻占锡朗村。这场灾难提升了叛军的士气，如今收复甲米地省将耗费更长时间并付出更惨重代价。

src: Due to your ineptitude the Germans have managed to create several bridgeheads over the Escaut and the Terneuzen Canal and are ready to penetrate our defensive line.
dst: 由于您的无能，德军得以在斯海尔德河和泰尔讷曾运河上建立数处桥头堡，并随时可以突入我军防线。

src: Due to your outstanding performance and leadership on the field of battle, you will be recommended for promotion to "Capitán".
dst: 由于您在战场上的出色表现和指挥才能，您将被推荐晋升为「上尉」。

src: Due to your pathetic speed, they have escaped and we cannot chase them because our reports say that Monty is preparing a big offensive in the sector of Mareth Line.
dst: 由于您那可怜的速度，他们逃脱了，而我们无法追击，因为报告称蒙蒂正在马雷斯防线一带准备一场大规模攻势。

src: Due to your utterly disgusting performance at Erzerum, your command will be transferred to a desk.
dst: 由于您在埃尔祖鲁姆极其糟糕的表现，您的指挥权将被调去坐办公室。

src: Dug in tank turrets of broken Panzers
dst: 破损坦克的掘入式炮塔
杜克尔斯基山口（杜克拉山口）

src: Dukla Pass holds tremendous value to us as a gateway toward a strategic solution to the conflict with Austria-Hungary:  you must make haste in the face of stubborn enemy resistance and our own ammunition supply problems.
dst: 杜克拉山口对我们具有巨大价值，是通往与奥匈帝国冲突的战略解决之道的门户：面对敌人顽强的抵抗和我方自身的弹药补给困难，您必须加快行动。
杜克拉山口 (杜克尔斯基山口)

src: Dumlupinar was a disater for the Greeks. Tens of thousands were killed, wounded, captured, or simply deserted. In just two weeks, the Turkish army managed to re-capture all the territories which the Hellenes had taken since 1919. Izmir was the last city reconquered by the Turks, on 9 September 1922. It was the last military action of the Turkish Independence War.
dst: 杜姆卢珀纳尔对希腊人是一场灾难。成千上万人阵亡、受伤、被俘或干脆当了逃兵。仅仅两周内，土耳其军队就夺回了希腊人自1919年以来占领的全部领土。伊兹密尔是土耳其人最后收复的城市，时间为1922年9月9日。这是土耳其独立战争的最后一次军事行动。

dst: Dunavski 炮兵团/ II Dunavska 师/ 塞尔维亚第2集团军

src: Durante la batalla por Santander también se produce la rendición de la mayor parte de los batallones vascos en el conocido como "Pacto de Santoña", aunque realmente se firmó en Guriezo, localidad próxima.
dst: 在桑坦德战役期间，大部分巴斯克营还在所谓的「桑托尼亚协定」中投降，不过该协定实际上是在附近的古列索签署的。

src: During 1919 Poland was a formidable foe for the Red Army, that tried in vain to expand to the west only to be defeated by the brave Poles. I am convinced that, were it not for Poland, the Bolsheviks would have reached the borders of Germany, Hungary and other countries, where they would have instigated successful communist revolutions. Most people in Europe don't realise how much they owe to Poland, that acted as a barrier to the Soviet expansion. Personally, I respect and appreciate what the Poles did.
dst: 1919年间，波兰是红军一个令人生畏的对手，红军徒劳地试图向西扩张，却被英勇的波兰人击败。我深信，如果没有波兰，布尔什维克本会抵达德国、匈牙利等国的边境，并在那里煽动起成功的共产主义革命。欧洲大多数人并没有意识到他们欠波兰多少——波兰充当了阻止苏维埃扩张的屏障。就我个人而言，我敬重并赞赏波兰人的所作所为。

src: During an eerie lull in the bombardment of your HQ positions by German 150mm howitzers, you had an opportunity to glance around your trench:  masses of German GardeInfanterie were assaulting your positions to the north and south.  The River Sereth glistened behind your back, and you could just make out German engineers building a pontoon bridge, sealing your fate on the western bank.
dst: 在德军150毫米榴弹炮对您指挥部阵地轰击的一次诡异间歇中，您得以环顾自己的堑壕：大批德国近卫步兵正从南北两面突击您的阵地。塞雷特河在您背后闪着波光，您勉强能辨认出德国工兵正在架设浮桥，注定您在西岸的命运。

src: During that time, we experienced several world-shaking events, and I also wrote a book myself. I didn't have much time for PG2/OG, even less for test runs, and absolutely none for writing briefings. It wasn't until my book was published that I finally found the motivation to open OG Suite again.
dst: 那期间，我们经历了几桩震撼世界的大事，我自己也写了一本书。我没多少时间投入 PG2/OG，试玩更少，写简报则完全没时间。直到我的书出版，我才终于找回打开 Open Suite 的动力。

src: During the 12th and 13th of May the temporary line at the Gete River was heavily attacked by the German infantry at Halen, Geetbets and Goetsenhoeven. All attacks (in total eleven) were repelled and the Belgian cavalry divisions only retreated when they discovered that the French on their left had already retreated. This defence enabled also the BEF to take positions on the "Ligne KW" (Dyle line) without being attacked by the Germans
dst: 5月12日至13日，德军步兵在哈伦、海特贝茨和胡岑霍芬对盖特河临时防线发起猛攻。所有进攻（共十一次）均被击退，比利时骑兵师直到发现左翼的法军已经后撤时才撤退。这次防御也使英国远征军得以在未遭德军攻击的情况下进入“KW 防线”（迪尔河防线）阵地。

src: During the Battle of Debrecen, Armeegruppe Fretter-Pico (with elements of Hungarian 2nd and 3th Armies) achieved a major success against the Red Army. While avoiding encirclement, Axis troops managed to encircle and destroy three Soviet tank corps. At the beginning of the battle, the situation on the ground was greatly confused, with neither the Soviets nor the Germans knowing who was surrounding whom. Then the German 23rd and 1st Panzer Divisions (led by Tiger II panzers) arrived from Budapest and completed the encirclement of Pliyev's group. On October 26, the 23rd Panzer Division recaptured Nyíregyháza. Meanwhile, the German 8th Army began moving out through the escape route created through Nyíregyháza.
dst: 在德布勒森之战中，弗雷特-皮科集团军级集群（下辖匈牙利第2和第3集团军各部）对红军取得了一次重大胜利。轴心国部队在避免被合围的同时，成功合围并歼灭了苏军三个坦克军。战役之初，地面态势极为混乱，苏德双方都不清楚究竟是谁在包围谁。随后，德国第23装甲师和第1装甲师（由虎II坦克领头）自布达佩斯赶到，完成了对普利耶夫集团的合围。10月26日，第23装甲师夺回尼赖吉哈佐。与此同时，德国第8集团军开始经由尼赖吉哈佐打开的通道撤出。

src: During the Gallipoli campaign in 1915 neither the Turks nor we had anything to spare for greater efforts in Sinai. So things here have been relatively quiet for some months. Our main concern at the moment are the Arab and Berber tribes of the Western Desert. The Senussi, a hostile religious fraternity led by Said Idris Ahmed, have declared "jihad" on us and our Italian allies, who have been occupying Libya since 1911. The Turks have delivered artillery and machine guns to the Senussi by German submarines, and equipped a force of about 5,000 bedouins with which Jaafar Pasha, a Turkish officer, intends to capture the small ports at the Libyan and Egyptian coast.
dst: 1915年加里波利战役期间，土耳其人和我们都无力在西奈投入更多兵力。因此这里数月来相对平静。我们目前的主要心患是西部沙漠的阿拉伯和柏柏尔部落。塞努西教团——一个由赛义德·伊德里斯·艾哈迈德领导的敌对宗教兄弟会——向我们和我们的意大利盟友宣战（圣战），而意大利人自1911年以来一直占领着利比亚。土耳其人用德国潜艇向塞努西运去了火炮和机枪，并装备了一支约5000人的贝都因部队，土耳其军官贾法尔帕夏打算率这支队伍夺取利比亚和埃及海岸的一些小港口。

src: During the Lee's second invasion of the Union states, the Conferedacy got some major victories which fueled the hopes of Richmond to kick out the US Goverment from prosecuting the war. The Lee's astounding victory at Chancelorsville and later the succesful campaign at the Shenandoah valley, drove the CSA armies to a deep advance into the North, even into Pennsylvania. President Lincoln sent the maj. gen. J. Hooker to pursuit the Confederate advance, just to replace him by the maj. gen. G.G. Meade three days before the battle. In July the 1st of 1863, both armies began to clash at a town of Pennsylvania: Gettysburg, thus, begining the biggest battle on the North American soil of the whole known history up to now.
dst: 在李将军第二次入侵北方联邦各州期间，邦联取得了一些重大胜利，这些胜利助长了里士满迫使美国政府停止战争的希望。李在钱瑟勒斯维尔取得的惊人胜利，以及随后在谢南多厄河谷的成功战役，驱使南方邦联军队深入北方，甚至攻入宾夕法尼亚。林肯总统派少将J·胡克追击邦联的推进，却在开战前三天将他换成了少将G·G·米德。1863年7月1日，两军在宾夕法尼亚的一个小镇葛底斯堡开始交战，由此拉开了迄今所知北美洲大陆上规模最大的一场战役的序幕。

src: During the Second World War the island was frequently bombed by the Luftwaffe. Close to France, the island hosted observation stations and transmitters, as well as the RAF radar station at Ventnor. It was the starting-point for one of the earlier Operation Pluto pipelines to feed fuel to Europe after the Normandy landings.
dst: 二战期间，该岛频繁遭到德国空军轰炸。该岛靠近法国，设有观察站和发射台，以及文特诺的皇家空军雷达站。它还是诺曼底登陆后向欧洲输送燃料的“冥王行动”早期输油管之一的一个起点。

src: During the armistice the Ottomans gathered several regiments at the Gallipolli peninsula. Our intelligence reports suggest that they are preparing a counterattack at the neck of the peninsula, near the village of Bulair. They will combine that assault with an amphibious operation at the coastal town of Sarköy. You must stop them as soon as possible. If they succeed, they could attack our defensive positions on the Çatalca line from the rear, or even relief the siege of Odrin. But you can only count on your local troops. Don't expect any reinforcements.
dst: 停战期间，奥斯曼人在加里波利半岛集结了好几个团。我们的情报报告显示，他们正准备在半岛的颈部、布莱尔村附近发动反击。他们将把那次进攻与在沿海城镇沙尔柯伊的一次两栖行动结合起来。您必须尽快阻止他们。如果他们得手，就能从后方攻击我们在恰塔勒贾防线上的防御阵地，甚至解除对奥德林的围困。但您只能依靠您的当地部队，别指望任何增援。

src: During the course of battle, you had lost the advantage in initiative we held over the Red Army.  This war will become costly for our nation, but it is also costing you your career.
dst: 战斗过程中，您失去了我们此前对红军所持有的主动权优势。这场战争将令我们的国家付出沉重代价，同时也在葬送您的职业生涯。

src: During the final stages of war the 1st Czechoslovak Army Corps had some sixty thousand men and women. Road from Buzuluk to Prague is lined with graves of four thousands Czechoslovaks of all nationalities: Czechs, Slovaks, Jews, Rusyns...
dst: 战争最后阶段，捷克斯洛伐克第1军约有六万名男女。从布祖鲁克到布拉格的道路两旁，长眠着四千名各族捷克斯洛伐克人：捷克人、斯洛伐克人、犹太人、鲁塞尼亚人……

src: During the last two days my troops conducted a landing operation on the Asian side of the Dardanelles as a diversion from the main landings of our British and ANZAC brothers in arms, who tried to gain a foothold on the Gallipoli peninsula. Our action at Kum Kale nearly ended as a disaster with about 800 of my brave men dying at the hands of the ferociously fighting Turks. Only the guns of our navy rescued us and we were safely evacuated.
dst: 过去两天，我的部队在达达尼尔海峡亚洲一侧实施了一次登陆作战，作为我们英国和澳新军团战友主力登陆的牵制，他们试图在加里波利半岛站稳脚跟。我们在库姆卡莱的行动几乎以灾难告终，约800名我英勇的士兵死于凶猛作战的土耳其人之手。只有我们海军的炮火救了我们，我们才得以安全撤离。

src: During the last year we haven't taken many risks. There were some big battles like Vlakfontein or Moedwil, but most of the time our actions consisted of blowing railway lines and bridges or attacking small British columns.
dst: 过去一年里我们没有冒太多风险。有过像弗拉克方丹或莫德维尔这样的大仗，但大多数时候我们的行动就是炸铁路线和桥梁，或者袭击小股英军纵队。

src: During the month-long progress through Slovakia, the 1st Czechoslovak Army Corps liberated many great cities, but then they were stopped at Liptovsky Svaty Mikulas, where there were many casualties both on Czechoslovak and on Soviet side.
dst: 在历时一个月的穿越斯洛伐克的进军中，捷克斯洛伐克第1军解放了许多大城市，但随后在利普托夫斯基米库拉什受阻，捷克斯洛伐克和苏军双方都伤亡惨重。

src: During the night the 8th Panzer Division drove into Belgrade, occupied the center of the city, and hoisted the Swastika flag.
dst: 夜间，第8装甲师驶入贝尔格莱德，占领市中心，并升起了卐字旗。

src: During the operation the 2nd Brigade of the Russian Expedionary Corps suffered 1,400 casualties.  Although offensive operations will continue for the Russian brigades on the Salonika Front, your command is required in France, where the other two Russian Brigades have joined the French order of battle.
dst: 在这次作战中，俄国远征军第2旅伤亡1400人。尽管萨洛尼卡战线上的俄军各旅还将继续进攻作战，但法国需要您的指挥，另外两个俄国旅已加入法军的战斗序列。

src: During the rest of the winter we won't participate in any large scale military actions. But in spring we'll launch an offensive in Ukraine. If we help Symon Petliura's nationalists to create an anti-Bolshevist Ukrainian republic allied with Poland our eastern frontier will be much safer.
dst: 冬季剩余的时间里，我们将不参与任何大规模军事行动。但到了春天，我们将在乌克兰发起攻势。如果我们帮助西蒙·彼得留拉的民族主义者建立一个与波兰结盟的反布尔什维克乌克兰共和国，我们的东部边疆就会安全得多。

src: During the second Balkan war, the Ottoman Empire recovered Eastern Thrace with little effort, taking advantage of Bulgaria being attacked by Serbia, Greece and Romania.
dst: 在第二次巴尔干战争中，奥斯曼帝国利用保加利亚遭到塞尔维亚、希腊和罗马尼亚进攻的机会，几乎不费吹灰之力就收复了东色雷斯。

src: During the second world war Portsmouth and its port were bombed by the Luftwaffe 67 times between July 1940 and May 1944. Portsmouth was an important embarkation point for the D-Day landings and the allied headquarters was just outside the city.
dst: 二战期间，从1940年7月到1944年5月，朴次茅斯及其港口被德国空军轰炸了67次。朴次茅斯是 D 日登陆的重要上船点，盟军总部就在城外。

src: During the war, the Russian Empire has raised several native divisions:  Finnish divisions have been fighting with the Army since 1915.  The Czech Legion, raised out of Austro-Hungarian army's POWs, has been active since 1916.  The Estonian division is in training at Revel.  Finally, the Latvian division had been employed during the failed Mitau Offensive in January of 1919; they have deployed at Ropazhi.  The bulk of our regular army has become but a shadow of its might:  political instability has thrown the army into a state of disobedience at best and criminal desertion at its worst.  Whole regiments refuse to go into line.  So-called "soldier committees" have assumed command of entire divisions, stripping their officers of their rank or summarily executing them.
dst: 战争期间，俄罗斯帝国组建了若干本土师：芬兰各师自1915年起一直随军作战。捷克军团由奥匈军队战俘组建，自1916年起活跃。爱沙尼亚师正在雷瓦尔训练。最后，拉脱维亚师曾投入1919年1月那场失败的米塔乌攻势；他们已部署在罗帕日。我正规军主力已沦为昔日雄风的影子：政治动荡使军队最好的情况下陷入不服从，最坏的情况下则出现犯罪的逃亡。整个整个的团拒绝进入战线。所谓「士兵委员会」已接管整师整师的部队，剥夺其军官的军衔，或不经审判就地枪决。

src: During the year 1915 our allies in the west met stalemate. Our own North-Western Front has retreated but held the German offensive. Our South-Western Front in Galicia met a devastating Germano-Austrian blow and retreated deep into our territory. In the Middle East two fronts, in Egypt and Mesopotamia, have pitted British and Ottoman forces. In the Kavkaz mountains a Turkish offensive had shattered against our army.
dst: 在1915年，我们在西方的盟友陷入僵局。我们的西北方面军虽然后退，却顶住了德军的攻势。我们在加利西亚的西南方面军遭受德奥联军毁灭性的打击，深深退入我方领土。在中东，埃及和美索不达米亚两条战线让英军与奥斯曼军对垒。在高加索山脉，土耳其的一次攻势在我军面前撞得粉碎。

src: During the year 1915 the Ottoman Empire stand firm against many enemies. The western boundaries of the empire were safe, but in the begining of 1916 danger came from the east: the British Army attacked in Mesopotamia, and at the same time the Russian Army attacked through the Kafkasya (Caucasus) mountains.
dst: 1915年间，奥斯曼帝国顶住了众多敌人。帝国的西部边界是安全的，但1916年初，危险来自东方：英军进攻美索不达米亚，与此同时俄军穿过高加索山脉发起进攻。

src: During their "Operation Marneschutz-Reims" the Germans overran our frontline at the Aisne and they are standing now at the Marne, just like they did in 1914.
dst: 在德军的「马恩河-兰斯防卫行动」期间，德军攻破了我们在埃纳河的前线，如今他们正像1914年那样抵达了马恩河畔。

src: During their winter retreat, the Austrians have begun forming ad-hoc army groups to guard key passes over the Carpathians.  The Pflanzer-Baltin Army Group (Korps Czibulka, XIII, and the Polish Legion) had succeeded in crossing the Dniester River themselves in February and had captured the city of Stanislau.  The Austrian bulge into our positions must first be eliminated to enable any further offensive operations.
dst: 在冬季撤退期间，奥地利人已开始组建临时集团军群以扼守喀尔巴阡山脉的要隘。普弗兰策—巴尔廷集团军群（齐布尔卡军、第13军和波兰军团）已于二月自行渡过德涅斯特河，并占领了斯坦尼斯拉夫城。必须先消除奥地利人楔入我方阵地的突出部，才能进行任何进一步的进攻作战。

src: Eager of liberating Metz, the French had neglected their both flanks during their advance. The Germans took advantage of this almost immediately. Outmaneuvering the French, they forced a first engagement at Beaumont on 30 August. The Army of Châlons had to withdraw to Sedan to regroup and resupply, but the Germans followed them and encircled them. On September 1, the rescue operation that the French intended had turned into a trap.
dst: 急于解救梅斯的法军在推进中忽视了两翼。德国人几乎立刻抓住了这一点。他们以机动胜过法军，于8月30日在博蒙迫使其进行了第一场交战。沙隆军团不得不撤往色当进行整编和补给，但德军紧随其后并将其包围。9月1日，法军原本设想的救援行动已变成一场圈套。
伊克尔/米切尔空军侦察

src: Earlier this year, 50 Divisions were moved to the Western Front after the collapse of the Russian surrender and the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk. Our first major offensive in a long time - Operation Michael - pushed the Entente forces up to 64km back, but failed to reach a breakthrough.
dst: 今年早些时候，在俄国崩溃投降并签订《布列斯特-立托夫斯克条约》之后，50个师被调往西线。我们长久以来的第一次大规模攻势——米夏埃尔行动——将协约国军队击退了多达64公里，但未能实现突破。

src: Early 1920, the Legion was close to reaching Wladiwostok. At Irkutsk the Czech Legion traded the Imperial Gold Reserve and Koltsjak to the Soviets for a free passage further east. Being already east of Lake Baikal, it was thought no more fighting would take place. However these regions, east of Lake Baikal, were never under control by Koltsjak and a Cossack ruler, Ataman Semenov, ruled here. Semenov was supported by Japan and was initially hostile towards the Legion.
dst: 1920年初，军团已接近抵达符拉迪沃斯托克。在伊尔库茨克，捷克军团以帝国黄金储备和高尔察克为代价，向苏维埃换取继续东进的自由通行权。既已身处贝加尔湖以东，本以为不会再发生战斗。然而，贝加尔湖以东的这些地区从未处于高尔察克的控制之下，统治这里的是哥萨克首领、阿塔曼谢苗诺夫。谢苗诺夫得到日本的支持，起初对军团怀有敌意。
早期自行反坦克炮 (未使用)

src: Early this morning, our Soviet advisors (Rodimtsev and Goriev) informed us of a large concentration of troops spotted along the Brihuega-Torija line. Our advanced recon units have heard strange Italian songs. There is no doubt the Italian CTV which captured Malaga the past days is on the way to strike again, here in Guadalajara.
dst: 今天清晨，我们的苏联顾问（罗季姆采夫和戈里耶夫）向我们通报，在布里韦加—托里哈一线发现大规模部队集结。我方前出侦察部队听到了奇怪的意大利歌曲。毫无疑问，前些日子攻占马拉加的意大利志愿军团正再度出动，目标就是这里——瓜达拉哈拉。

src: Eastern Prussia and Central Poland are secure. It is now time to break the siege of Budapest and keep our Hungarian allies in the war. Your second SS Panzer Corps - 2SS Das Reich, 9SS Hohenstaufen and 44. Reichsgrenadier Division Hoch und Durchmeister - will spearhead the attack. Supporting attacks will be made from the S/W by the 16SS Pz.Gren.Div. Reichsfuhrer-SS and from the South by elements of 11. Luftwaffe Field Division and the 1. Kosakenkavalleriedivision.
dst: 东普鲁士和波兰中部已确保安全。现在是时候打破布达佩斯之围，让我们的匈牙利盟友留在战争中了。你的党卫军第2装甲军——党卫军第2“帝国”师、党卫军第9“霍恩施陶芬”师和第44帝国掷弹兵师“高地与德意志骑士团”——将作为进攻的矛头。支援进攻将由党卫军第16装甲掷弹兵师“党卫军全国领袖”从西南发起，并由第11空军野战师和哥萨克第1骑兵师的部分兵力从南面发起。

dst: 南俄罗斯萨拉托夫东北，伏尔加河东岸
埃布隆人的秘密情报处

src: Edirne fortress surrendered to the Bulgarians four months ago, after a siege that lasted the whole winter. Our troops there fought bravely, but starving and sick, they finally were forced to give up. Now your mission is to retake the position.
dst: 埃迪尔内要塞四个月前在持续了整整一个冬天的围困后向保加利亚人投降。我们那里的部队英勇作战，但饥病交加，最终被迫放弃。现在您的任务是夺回这个阵地。

src: Egypt and the Middle East lie at our feet.  Your ability on the battlefield continues to confound our enemies.
dst: 埃及和中东已匍匐在我们脚下。你在战场上的能力持续令敌人困惑。

src: Egypt is already in our hands, now, the Mediterraneans's coasts need to be secured, go quickly!
dst: 埃及已在我们手中，现在需要确保地中海沿岸的安全，快速行动！
