src: Egyptian Expeditionary Force (EEF) infantry brigades succeeded in completely overrunning our trenches. Your forces are on the run. Southern Palestine is lost.
dst: 埃及远征军（EEF）的步兵旅成功彻底突破了我方战壕。您的部队正在溃逃。南巴勒斯坦已失守。

src: Egyptian Expeditionary Force (EEF) infantry brigades succeeded in entering our trenches at multiple points, but we were able to repulse them with heavy losses on both sides. Well done General.
dst: 埃及远征军（EEF）的步兵旅成功在数处进入我方战壕，但我们击退了他们，双方均损失惨重。干得好，将军。

src: Egyptian Expeditionary Force (EEF) infantry brigades succeeded in entering our trenches at multiple points. You were unable to repulse them, so we had to retreat to the next line of defense.
dst: 埃及远征军（EEF）的步兵旅成功在数处进入我方战壕。您未能击退他们，因此我们不得不撤退到下一道防线。

src: Egyptian Expeditionary Force (EEF) infantry brigades succeeded in entering our trenches at several points, but they were too weakened by our fierce defense to retain their gains during our counterattacks. British losses are about 6,000 men, three times as high as ours. Moral in our Army is high!
dst: 埃及远征军（EEF）的步兵旅成功在数处进入我方战壕，但在我方的猛烈防守下，他们已过于虚弱，无法在我方反攻时守住战果。英军伤亡约6000人，是我方的三倍。我方军队士气高昂！
埃及 machine guns/ 埃及师

src: Eight Army started its expected offensive. Reports of enemy attacks are coming in from the Northern and the Southern sectors.
dst: 第8集团军如期发起了攻势。北面和南面都在传来敌军进攻的报告。
法雷尔-弗里德里希费尔德前进机场

src: Eisenhower was in favor of the Eastern Option(s), but the Combined Chiefs of Staff were in favor of the less risky option. So Morocco, Oran and Algiers it is.
dst: 艾森豪威尔倾向东部方案，但美英联合参谋长会议倾向风险较小的方案。于是敲定摩洛哥、奥兰和阿尔及尔。
艾森施塔特尔 (热莱兹尼采)

src: Either capture all Victory Hexes or destroy all enemy units marked as "Must Survive" to claim the victory!
dst: 夺取全部胜利点，或消灭所有标为“必须存活”的敌军单位，即可赢得胜利！

src: Either you fly with me to Germany or you leave for the Black Sea. You have 1-2 hours to think about it.
dst: 要么你随我飞往德国，要么你前往黑海。你有1到2小时可以考虑。

El Adem Airfield to the W
El Alcazar se ha convertido en todo un simbolo para la Espana Nacional, asi que su deber es liberar el Alcazar lo antes posible, ademas su guarnicion esta al borde de la derrota.
dst: 托莱多城堡已成为国民西班牙的象征，所以您的职责就是尽快解放托莱多城堡，何况它的守军已濒临失败。

src: El CTV se despliega al sur del Puerto del Escudo para tratar de forzar las lineas gubernamentales y conseguir la victoria que Mussolini les exige.
dst: 意大利志愿军团在埃斯库多山口以南展开，试图突破政府军的防线，赢得墨索里尼所要求的胜利。

src: El Cairo has been cleared. Now, the next aim is to complete the conquest of the Suez Canal.
dst: 开罗已被肃清。下一个目标是完成对苏伊士运河的征服。

src: El Cairo is in front of us, after more than one year of battles in Africa we are starting the final assault on the British stronghold of Egypt.
dst: 开罗就在我们面前，在非洲一年多的战斗之后，我们正开始对英国在埃及的据点发起最后突击。
略布雷加特河畔埃尔普拉特
谢赫祖韦德，埃及/巴勒斯坦边境

src: El alzamiento contra el Frente Popular ha comenzado!. Usted, un general africanista, es el lider de una de las columnas compuestas por marroquies y legionarios que se dirigen a Madrid. Se cree que la marcha hacia la capital terminara con el gobierno frente populista... pero si falla, estamos seguros que nuestros aliados alemanes e italianos no nos dejaran solos para enfrentarnos a los rojos.
dst: 反抗人民阵线的起义已经开始！您，一位非洲派将领，是一支由摩洛哥人和外籍军团士兵组成的纵队的指挥官，这些纵队正开往马德里。据信，向首都的进军将终结人民阵线政府……但如果失败，我们确信我们的德国和意大利盟友不会让我们独自面对共和军。

src: El coronel rebelde, Rey d'Haucourt rindió sus fuerzas en Teruel, y la ciudad fue recuperada, pero la posterior contraofensiva rebelde convirtió la batalla en un pequeño Stalingrado español...
dst: 叛军上校雷伊·德·阿尔库尔在特鲁埃尔率部投降，该城被收复，但随后叛军的反攻使这场战役变成了一场小型的西班牙斯大林格勒……

src: El ejercito de Africa ha sido frenado en seco!, es el primer exito importante de nuestras valerosas tropas. Gran trabajo, general. Madrid ha sido defendido con exito y ahora se convertira en el ejemplo a seguir por todos los pueblos de este pais, que estan tratando de resistir a la amenaza fascista.
dst: 非洲军被彻底遏制住了！这是我们英勇部队取得的第一个重大胜利。干得好，将军。马德里已成功守住，如今它将成为全国各城镇效仿的榜样，这些城镇正努力抵抗法西斯的威胁。

src: El enemigo ha alcanzado el mar Mediterraneo y las cosas no pueden ir peor, tal vez esta sea nuestra ultima oportunidad de encauzar la situacion, general. Se ha concebido un nuevo plan de batalla, esta ocasion es el mas ambicioso de todo cuanto hemos hecho hasta ahora. Nuestro Ejercito Popular ha tomado sigilosamente posiciones en torno al rio Ebro, cerca de Amposta, en Tarragona, con la mision de cruzarlo y romper asi el frente por una zona por la que el enemigo no se lo espera.
dst: 敌军已抵达地中海，局势再糟不过了，将军，这也许是我们扭转局面的最后机会。我们构想了一项新的作战计划，这一次是我们迄今采取的所有行动中最具雄心的。我人民军已悄然在塔拉戈纳阿姆波斯塔附近的埃布罗河沿岸占领阵地，任务是强渡该河，从敌军料想不到的地段突破其防线。

src: El frente catalan esta severamente debilitado por nuestro avance, hemos tomado multitud de ciudades de camino a Barcelona... sin embargo, los republicanos han lanzado una ofensiva local en el sector de Fraga, a traves del rio Segre. Creemos que tratan de recapturar la zona al Sur de Lerida con sus dos importantes plantas electricas, tratando de reestablecer la situacion despues de la batalla del Ebro.
dst: 由于我军的推进，加泰罗尼亚战线已被严重削弱，我们在向巴塞罗那进军的途中攻占了众多城镇……然而，共和军在弗拉加地段渡过塞格雷河发动了一场局部攻势。我们认为，他们企图夺回莱里达以南、拥有两座重要发电厂的地区，试图在埃布罗河战役之后重整局势。

src: El gobierno de la Republica ha dado la orden de la formacion de un ejercito popular del que comienzan a formarse las primeras brigadas mixtas. Ademas, contamos con la valerosa aportacion de los voluntarios extranjeros, que hemos agrupado en algunas ''Brigadas Internacionales''. Su mision consistira en dirigir esas unidades de nueva creacion y algunas milicias para defender Madrid. Si Madrid cae, de por sentado que habremos perdido la guerra.
dst: 共和国政府已下令组建一支共和军，首批混成旅正开始编成。此外，我们还有外国志愿者英勇的支援，我们已把他们编入若干「国际纵队」。您的任务是率领这些新组建的部队以及一些民兵保卫马德里。如果马德里陷落，那就意味着我们已经输掉了这场战争。

src: El mapa estrategico de Espana esta sobre la mesa de su puesto de mando...
dst: 西班牙的战略地图就摆在您指挥所的桌上……

src: El objetivo primario es cruzar el rio y establecer una fuerte cabeza de puente alcanzando la capital de la comarca; Gandesa. Una posible victoria en esta operacion nos permitiria futuros avances que tal vez pudiesen re-equilibrar la situacion.
dst: 首要目标是渡河并建立稳固的桥头堡，进而攻取该地区首府甘德萨。此次行动若能取胜，将使我军得以继续推进，或许能重新平衡局势。

src: El plan consiste en un ataque desde el Norte y el Este en el sector de Brunete para embolsar a las fuerzas rebeldes aqui presentes. La mayor parte del V y el XVIII cuerpos atacaran desde el Norte en direccion a Brunete y Villafranca del Castillo, mientras que desde Madrid llegara el II cuerpo por el Este en direccion a Villaviciosa de Odon. Tambien llegara la 14 Division posteriormente como refuerzo, ademas de una buena cantidad de aparatos de las FARE.
dst: 计划是从北面和东面对布鲁内特地段发起进攻，包围此处的叛军部队。第V军和第XVIII军的大部分将从北面进攻，直指布鲁内特和卡斯蒂略的比利亚弗兰卡；而第II军则从马德里由东面开来，直指奥东的比利亚维西奥萨。第14师随后也将作为增援抵达，此外还有大量 FARE 的飞机。

src: El plan principal ha fracasado... el contraataque enemigo frustro nuestro ataque sobre Zaragoza, sin embargo los servicios de propaganda explotaran esta victoria secundaria en Belchite de la mejor manera posible.
dst: 主要计划失败了……敌人的反攻挫败了我们对萨拉戈萨的进攻，不过宣传部门会尽可能利用贝尔奇特的这次次要胜利。

src: El principal objetivo es tomar Barcelona, la última ciudad capital de la República, ya que su gobierno esta de hecho emplazado allí. Tomando Barcelona y Cataluña entera, seremos capaces de poner fin a esta sangrienta guerra. Los republicanos están actualmente tratando de construir varias líneas fortificadas en todo el territorio catalán, así que necesitaremos de nuevo poner en práctica las tácticas germanas de concentración de tropas y apoyo táctico para aplastárles con rapidez.
dst: 主要目标是攻占巴塞罗那——共和国最后的都城，因为其政府实际上就设在那里。攻下巴塞罗那和整个加泰罗尼亚，我们就能终结这场血腥的战争。共和军目前正试图在整个加泰罗尼亚地区构筑多道防御工事，因此我们需要再次运用德式的兵力集中与战术支援战术，将他们迅速击垮。

src: El principal problema era el accidentado terreno, pero usted ha conseguido establecer unas posiciones inmejorables cerca del río Nalón. Los rojos han logrado hacerse con el control de los cuarteles de Simancas y Zapadores en Gijón, pero debemos continuar adelante, hacia Oviedo, y presionar para salvar a nuestros valientes camaradas que siguen resistiendo allí el asedio de los rojos. ¡Debemos demostrar al mundo que nosotros no nos rendimos sin luchar!.
dst: 主要问题是崎岖的地形，但您已在纳隆河附近建立起极佳的阵地。共和军已夺取希洪的锡曼卡斯兵营和萨帕多雷斯兵营的控制权，但我们必须继续前进，向奥维耶多推进，并向那里施加压力，以解救仍在抵抗共和军围攻的英勇战友。我们必须向全世界证明，我们绝不会不战而降！

src: El rotundo fracaso en el Ebro ha propiciado a los rebeldes lanzar una gran ofensiva sobre Catalunya. El alto mando tiene intencion de al menos detener esa ofensiva y se ha planeado una operacion en el sector de Lerida, destinada a corregir el frente y recuperar dos importantes centrales electricas al otro lado del rio.
dst: 埃布罗的惨败促使叛军对加泰罗尼亚发动了一场大规模攻势。最高指挥部打算至少遏止这场攻势，并已在莱里达地区策划了一次行动，旨在修正战线，并夺回河对岸的两座重要发电厂。

src: El tiempo es extremadamente frio, cerca de -20 grados, esto hara la operacion aun mas complicada, nuestra fuerza aerea no podra prestarnos facilmente sus servicios. Contamos con usted y sus tropas de elite para dirigir el asalto a las posiciones enemigas...
dst: 天气极其寒冷，接近零下20度，这会让作战更加艰难，我们的空军也难以提供支援。我们指望您和您的精锐部队来指挥对敌军阵地的突击……

src: Embark your units in Tianjing and reach the Taiwanese coast as soon as possible.  Beijing is sure the UN will take part in operations like in Korea, this time supporting the KMT in Taiwan.  Your highest priority is the conquest of Taipei.  With this city we will complete the unification of all the Chinese territories.
dst: 把你的部队从天津登船，尽快抵达台湾海岸。北京确信联合国会像在朝鲜那样介入行动，这次是支持台湾的国民党。你的最高优先目标是攻占台北。有了这座城市，我们就能完成所有中国领土的统一。

src: Emile now must know how Cassandra felt when her fellow Trojans wouldn't believe her warnings. He has returned to his battalions in the Bois des Caures north of Verdun and tries the best he can to prepare for the worst. And so do I, since I believe this man, because...
dst: 埃米尔现在一定体会到了卡珊德拉当年特洛伊同胞不信她警告时的感受。他已回到凡尔登以北科雷树林中的各营，尽其所能做最坏的打算。我也是如此，因为我相信这个人，因为……

src: En el helado invierno de 1937, los nacionales tenían un importante punto desde donde continuar su ofensiva: la ciudad de Teruel, como "un arma apuntando al corazón del levante español". El Ejército Popular no podía permitir esto, y una ofensiva para retomar Teruel fue planeada y puesta en marcha bajo temperaturas de alrededor de -28 grados...
dst: 在1937年寒冷的冬天，国民军拥有一个继续进攻的重要据点：特鲁埃尔城，它犹如「一件直指西班牙莱万特心脏的武器」。共和军不能允许这种情况，于是一项夺回特鲁埃尔的攻势被制定并付诸实施，气温约为零下28度……

src: En el plan de Mola el objetivo principal era la captura de Madrid. El Norte de España era un mero problema secundario al inicio del levantamiento. Pronto, resultó evidente que Madrid no iba a caer con un simple asalto frontal, y que la guerra iba a ser larga. El General Mola te ha elegido a ti como uno de sus oficiales de confianza para comandar el ataque principal a las provincias del Frente Norte. Después, ¿quién sabe?.
dst: 在莫拉的计划中，主要目标是攻占马德里。起义之初，西班牙北部只是一个次要问题。很快人们便看清，马德里不会因一次简单的正面强攻而陷落，这场战争将旷日持久。莫拉将军已选定您为他最信任的军官之一，去指挥对北方战线各省份的主攻。此后的事，谁知道呢？

src: Encircle all soviet units near Minsk city and destroy them. You must be as swift as an arrow, because our units must quickly go on to Smolensk, Viazma and Moscow...
dst: 合围明斯克城附近所有苏军部队并予以歼灭。您必须迅捷如箭，因我部须迅速向斯摩棱斯克、维亚济马与莫斯科推进……

src: Encoded 'Eni' Message to Berlin from Amerika --(Uncoded] --  Their Stupidity here amazes Me.They still walk with a Swagger as everything is in hand.These set-backs to the Nips affect nothing.They think at anytime the Armaments Production can be increased enough to beat the Nips and Us.There is some major improvements in manufacturing of Naval beginning on both coast.A enormous Aircraft industry is going up at a place called 'Willow Run'.A few Top Secret Projects have started in Oak Ridge.Our network here My Fuhress is still not detected.As ordered We are sacrificing a few to keep them busy thinking their little women are dedicated to the Amerikan Way and followers of the 'BdM' are nothing but a sideshow for Radicals.The 'Loop' here is as secure as it has always been.Our subservant Males filtered into the American Press System have all blinded here thinking America can 'Get it done at anytime'.That includes those in the Capitial moved to Chicago.As far as Our nearing the End in Russia the Amerikans believe We have bled Ourselves dry and will want no more Combat when We are done there.We are 'Europe's Problem' You know.I have a long list of places the 'Batts can visit when they are let out of the Cave.Sascha's brilliance in having them send out Radar signals for a signature at the moment will be a surprise here when they don't.The Frau's wait,I will enjoy a Soda at the Corner shop.Meine Fuhress,tell Us 'When'.
dst: 自美国发往柏林的“埃尼”密电——（已解码）——  这里的人的愚蠢令我惊讶。他们依然昂首阔步，仿佛一切尽在掌握。日本人的这些挫折对他们毫无影响。他们以为随时都能把军备生产提高到足以击败日本人和我们的程度。两海岸的海军制造已开始有一些重大改进。一个叫“柳树溪”的地方正建起一座庞大的飞机工业。橡树岭启动了若干绝密项目。我的女元首，我们在这里的网络仍未被侦破。按您的命令，我们牺牲了几个人，好让他们忙于相信：他们那些小女人不过是在忠于“美国方式”，而“BdM”的追随者不过是激进分子的余兴节目。这里的“循环”一如既往地安全。我们安插进美国报界的那些顺从的男性，全都在这边蒙着眼睛，以为美国“随时都能搞定”。包括迁到芝加哥的那些首都人士。至于我们在俄国即将收尾，美国人相信我们已经把自己耗干，等我们在那边打完，就不会再想打仗了。你知道的，我们“是欧洲的问题”。我有一长串地方，等“Batt 们被放出洞穴后可以去造访。萨莎的聪明之处在于让它们此刻发出雷达信号、形成一个假回波——等信号不再出现时，这里会大吃一惊。“女士”们等着，我会去街角小店喝一杯苏打水。我的女元首，告诉我们“何时”。

src: Enemy advance lost the momentum and the Soviets entrenched themselves in a firm line copying the major rivers, with the main centres in nearby cities and ports. They have numerous artillery pieces, including the heaviest anti-tank cannons, and their air support has overwhelming numerical superiority that the few tired and thinly-spread Luftwaffe newbies cannot contest.
dst: 敌军攻势失去势头，苏军沿主要河流掘壕固守，形成一道坚固防线，以附近城市和港口为主要据点。他们拥有大量火炮，包括最重的反坦克炮，其空中支援在数量上占压倒优势，少数疲惫且分散的空军新兵根本无法抗衡。

src: Enemy air activity is also very severe! Russians have sent anything possible and our pilots had very difficult times.
dst: 敌军空袭也极其猛烈！俄国人把能派出的都派出来了，我们的飞行员苦不堪言。

src: Enemy fighters and bombers continue to plague our forces. Your offensive has failed. A superior enemy that applied better tactics than before stopped your attack. There is nothing left but to dig in and await 8th Army's inevitable major offensive.
dst: 敌方战斗机和轰炸机仍在不断袭扰我军。你的攻势失败了。一个占有优势、且战术比以往更高明的敌人挡住了你的进攻。除了挖壕据守、等待第8集团军不可避免的大攻势，已别无他法。

src: Enemy forces consist of approximately twenty battalions of tanks, assault guns, and self-propelled anti-tank artillery followed by many supporting units. The Soviets also have virtually complete air superiority, and only our heavy flak is preventing them from launching air raids on Gumbinnen.
dst: 敌军由约二十个坦克、突击炮和自行反坦克炮营组成，后随众多支援部队。苏军还几乎握有完全制空权，只有我们的重型高炮在阻止他们空袭贡宾嫩。

src: Enemy moves to Southeast, you don't have too much time.
dst: 敌人正向东南方移动，你的时间不多。

src: Enemy reinforcement, the II. confederate Corps, will arrive from the west....
dst: 敌军援军、南方军第二军，将从西面赶到……

src: Enemy still has a lot of air support but no big ships are at the moment at the islands. You must repair the airfield if you want to fly your Branderburgers. Don't forget the 70 Km range radar at Kirkwell.
dst: 敌人仍拥有大量空中支援，但目前岛上没有大型舰船。如果你想放飞你的 Branderburger，就必须修复机场。别忘了柯克沃尔的 70 公里雷达。

src: England now lies open to invasion, ensuring total victory on the western front. The invasion is planned to occur on September 1st, but a debate at the highest level of government is in progress. Some believe that we should invade Spain in order to take Gibraltar and thus free the Italian Navy to assist us against the powerful British Navy. Others believe this to be unnecessary and they are winning the argument. Your opinion could influence the outcome of this key decision. The assistance of the Italian Fleet could be the difference in the upcoming invasion, but it may come at the cost of some of your prestige.
dst: 英格兰现已门户洞开，可实施入侵，从而确保西线的全面胜利。入侵计划于 9月1日发起，但政府最高层正就此展开争论。一些人认为我们应入侵西班牙，夺取直布罗陀，从而使意大利海军腾出手来协助我们对强大的英国海军作战。另一些人认为此举没有必要，而且他们的意见正占上风。你的看法可能影响这一关键决策的结果。意大利舰队的协助可能成为即将到来的入侵中的决定性因素，但也许会以你的一部分声望为代价。

src: Enough is enough. A despicable terrorist has murdered our heir to the throne, and Serbia is to blame. They will pay for that. Those who sow the wind shall reap the whirlwind. It doesn't matter if Russia supports Serbia. We have powerful allies, too. If Serbia doesn't comply with all our demands, there will be war. If the world thinks that the Austro-Hungarian Empire is a weak, moribund kingdom, then we'll show them how wrong they are.
dst: 够了，忍无可忍。一个卑鄙的恐怖分子杀害了我们的王位继承人，而塞尔维亚难辞其咎。他们将为此付出代价。种下风者，必收暴风。俄国是否支持塞尔维亚都无关紧要，我们也有强大的盟友。如果塞尔维亚不满足我们的全部要求，就会爆发战争。如果世人以为奥匈帝国是个虚弱、垂死的王国，那我们就让他们看看自己错得有多离谱。

src: Enough. It's time to go back before the German reinforcements arrive. We've already got what we wanted.

src: Entraining von Francois' I Corps and transferring it to strike at Samsonov's south-western flank and turning the I Reserve and XVII Corps to face the advancing 2nd Army, Hindenburg set the trap.  Fully aware of the danger of leaving the 8th Army's flank exposed to Rennekampf, Hindenburg made a gamble with extremely high stakes on his intercepted intelligence.  Meanwhile, Rennekampf's cavalry failed to discover the German intentions.  Observing the rapid retreat of the I Corps, elated with his victory at Gumbinnen, and concerned about the lengthened and strained supply lines, Rennekampf did not hurry the advance of his army, choosing instead to allow the retreating Germans to stumble onto the advancing 2nd Army.  Similarly lacking good field intelligence, Samsonov was not aware of the German reorganization and issued orders in preparation for chasing the enemy to the Vistula.
dst: 兴登堡让冯·弗朗索瓦的第1军登车并调其去打击萨姆索诺夫的西南翼，同时调第1预备军和第17军迎击推进中的第2集团军，就此设下陷阱。兴登堡深知将第8集团军侧翼暴露给连宁坎普夫的危险，仍凭借截获的情报进行了一场赌注极高的豪赌。与此同时，连宁坎普夫的骑兵未能发现德军的意图。连宁坎普夫看到第1军迅速撤退，又陶醉于贡比嫩之胜，还担心补给线拉得过长、压力过大，因而并未催促部队前进，而是听任撤退中的德军撞上正推进的第2集团军。萨姆索诺夫同样缺乏良好的战场情报，对德军的重新部署一无所知，只顾下令准备将敌人追至维斯瓦河。

src: Erroneous recurrent versions attribute the Spanish defeat to their old wooden vessels. However, only one ship of the Spanish naval force was made of wood, the other six being relatively recent iron or steel ships, even if unprotected and quite battered due to their intense use against Filipino rebels. Although Dewey's squadron heavily outweighed and outgunned the Spanish naval squadron in the Philippines, Dewey's victory is better explained by other factors such as American better preparation for action; serious Spanish mistakes as regards planning (dispersion of the scarce and mostly obsolete coastal artillery, delay in defensive works, decision to give battle to the Americans in Manila Bay); and the sense of defeatism with which the Spanish high officers were seize. British logistic support to Dewey's squadron, which made possible the attack from Hong Kong, cannot be underestimated either.
dst: 一些反复流传的错误说法将西班牙的失败归咎于其老旧的木制舰船。然而，西班牙海军舰队中只有一艘是木制的，其余六艘都是较新的铁制或钢制舰船，尽管它们没有装甲，且因频繁用于镇压菲律宾叛军而相当破旧。虽然杜威的分舰队在吨位和火力上都远胜西班牙在菲律宾的海军分舰队，但杜威的胜利更应归因于其他因素，例如美国为作战做了更充分的准备；西班牙在筹划上犯了严重错误（分散了本就稀少且大多过时的岸炮、拖延防御工事、决定在马尼拉湾与美国交战）；以及西班牙高级军官弥漫的失败主义情绪。英国对杜威分舰队的后勤支持使从香港出击成为可能，这一点同样不容低估。

Now, you are responsible for the refugees and their lives on your sector, all of them must survive since the High Command would not accept to lost any of the refugee groups. Due to the refugees matter, all the room on the evacuation fleet it's full. Don't loose any of the transports, or the High Command will relief you.
dst: 构筑防御阵地，在其他地区完成撤退时挡住苏联人，然后把您的部队开往撤离点。还有一件事，指挥官。北面许多居民因害怕苏联入侵已舍弃了家园。如今，您要对您辖区内难民及其生命负责，他们所有人都必须存活，因为高层不会接受损失任何一个难民群体。由于难民问题，撤离舰队的所有舱位都已满员。不要损失任何一艘运输船，否则高层将解除您的职务。

src: Estamos sacando reservas de otros frentes menos importantes, contamos con usted para detener a los rojos y hacer que crucen de nuevo el rio Ebro en direccion opuesta.
dst: 我们正从其他不太重要的战线抽调预备队，我们指望您来遏止共和军，迫使他们重新渡回埃布罗河对岸。

src: Esto es un autentico desastre!, los republicanos nos han derrotado y Teruel continua en sus manos, nuestra marcha hacia el Mediterraneo ha sido detenida!!!, retirese de mi vista donde no pueda verlo o le fusilo yo mismo!!!!
dst: 这是一场不折不扣的灾难！共和军打败了我们，特鲁埃尔仍在他们手中，我们向地中海的进军已被遏止！！！从我眼前消失，别让我看到您，否则我亲手枪毙您！！！！

src: Esto es un desastre!  Your attack has best crushed and our units destroyed. The enemy has consolidated their positions around Teruel and now we have suspended our attack on the Mediterranean.
dst: 这是一场灾难！您的进攻被粉碎，我们的部队被歼灭。敌军已在特鲁埃尔周边巩固阵地，现在我们已中止向地中海的进攻。

src: Esto es un desastre!!!!, esos ineptos milicianos han conseguido desbaratar nuestra ofensiva hacia la capital!!!, le vamos a formar un consejo de guerra por semejante derrota!.
dst: 这是一场灾难！！！！那些无能的民兵竟然打乱了我们对首都的攻势！！！因为这样的失败，我们要为您组建军事法庭！

src: Esto es un desastre!!!, el enemigo ha tomado el Alcazar y ahora se estan retirando a Madrid con el coronel Moscardo y sus camaradas como prisioneros. No le necesitaremos nunca mas.

dst: 这是一场灾难！萨拉戈萨正被共和军围困，很可能在接下来几周内陷落！最高统帅只有拿到您的项上人头作为交代才会满意！

src: Esto es un desastre!, los rojos han roto completamente nuestras lineas de frente y el sector entero ha caido en manos de los rojos... Esta usted relevado del mando.
dst: 这是一场灾难！共和军彻底突破了我军前线，整个地段都落入了共和军手中……您已被解除指挥权。

src: Esto es un desastre!, the reds have completely broken the front lines, and now this sector lost into the enemy hands... You are dimised.

src: Esto es un desastre!. Our attack has been crushed and our units destroyed.  The enemies have consolidated their positions around San Sebastian and now the north is a dangerous knife aiming at Navarra and Castilla, the backbone of our advance on to Madrid...
dst: 这是一场灾难！我们的进攻被粉碎，部队被歼灭。敌军已在圣塞瓦斯蒂安周边巩固阵地，如今北方成了一把危险的尖刀，直指纳瓦拉和卡斯蒂利亚——我们向马德里推进的支柱……

src: Esto es urgente!  The Reds have defeated the 4th Brigade deployed at Teruel. Many prisoners were captured including the garrison commander Colonel Rey D'Harcourt.  The extreme cold and snow prevents us from deploying our air power to help smash the enemy advance.  This will be maybe problematic, but the Generalisimo's staff thinks your troops can retake Teruel.  This would allow us to continue our march to the Mediterranean.
dst: 此事紧急！赤色分子击败了部署在特鲁埃尔的第4旅。许多人员被俘，其中包括守备司令雷·迪亚尔库尔上校。严寒和大雪使我们无法动用航空兵力协助粉碎敌军攻势。这或许会有些麻烦，但大元帅的参谋部认为您的部队能够夺回特鲁埃尔。这将使我们得以继续向地中海进军。
