src: Europe is now united under German leadership. You have achieved the success that Napoleon only dreamed of. Now it is time for you to end the war. The Americans have long thought themselves secure because of the vastness of the oceans washing their shores. But, your initial landings in Delaware and Maryland have shaken popular confidence. They have mustered their forces to defend their capital and you must crush the defenders and seize all your objectives in and around Washington, D.C. by August 15th at the latest. Confidentially, we have reports that the US is constructing a super weapon that could totally reverse the course of this war. This weapon may be available as early as mid-July so it is imperative that you force an American surrender as early as possible.
dst: 欧洲现已在德国领导下统一。你取得了拿破仑当年只能梦想的成就。现在，该由你来结束这场战争了。美国人一向自恃两洋浩瀚、海水环抱其海岸而高枕无忧。但是，你在特拉华和马里兰的初期登陆已经动摇了民众的信心。他们已集结兵力保卫首都，你必须击溃守军，至迟于8月15日夺取华盛顿特区城内及周边的全部目标。据机密报告，美国正在研制一种可能彻底扭转战局的超级武器。这种武器最早可能在7月中旬投入使用，因此你必须尽早迫使美国投降。

src: Europeans tend to overlook the importance of the Ethiopian contribution to the war effort of the Central Powers. It's a mistake. We were relevant, not only in the African Front. Italy had to send four infantry brigades from Albania to Eritrea. That's nearly half of the Italian troops that had been deployed there. Do you see? Our sacrifice weakened the Entente in the Balkans, and that became extremely important just a few months later, when the Germans launched the Operation Teutoburg in June. We were absolutely relevant!
dst: 欧洲人往往忽视埃塞俄比亚对同盟国战争努力所做贡献的重要性。这是错误的。我们举足轻重，而且不仅限于非洲战线。意大利不得不从阿尔巴尼亚抽调四个步兵旅派往厄立特里亚。那几乎是其部署在阿尔巴尼亚的意大利军队的一半。您明白了吗？我们的牺牲削弱了协约国在巴尔干的力量，而这一点在短短几个月后、当德国人于6月发动条顿堡行动时变得至关重要。我们绝对举足轻重！

src: Even after the fall of Nottingham and the reach of the Line Liverpool-Leeds-Hull, the British are not willing to surrender. Therefore, the General Staff has ordered the attack on London. Your battle group will invade the city from the northwest. Roughly 3 to 4 divisions defend the city - advance downtown and break any resistance!
dst: 即使在诺丁汉陷落、并抵达利物浦-利兹-赫尔一线之后，英国人仍不愿投降。因此，总参谋部下令进攻伦敦。你的战斗群将从西北方向攻入城市。约有3到4个师防守该城——向市中心推进，粉碎一切抵抗！
更多土耳其总参谋部增援

src: Even more it has been raining for weeks and all rivers are impassable... my men are already joking that they will have to carry out their next land battle from canon boats.
dst: 更糟的是，雨已经下了好几个星期，所有河流都无法通行……我的士兵已经在开玩笑说，他们下一次陆战得在炮艇上打了。

src: Even the titanic efforts by our Axis corps sent to save our IT 8th army were not enough to stem the Russian hordes - the Russians have just entered Kharhov!
dst: 即便我轴心国军为解救我意大利第8集团军付出了巨大努力，仍不足以挡住俄国的人海——俄军刚刚进入了哈尔科夫！

src: Even though 8th Army is larger than our mobile forces, it was clear from the start that the British position could not be held. Their X Corps was positioned North of the Northern Escarpment and the XIII Corps was positioned South of the Southern escarpment with only a few weak demoralized troops positioned in the center. Both Corps were unable to support each other. Too bad most of the 2nd New Zealand Division broke through the encirclement and escaped to El Alamein.
dst: 尽管第8集团军兵力超过我们的机动部队，但英军阵地守不住从一开始就显而易见。他们的第10军部署在北面陡崖以北，第13军部署在南面陡崖以南，中间只摆了少数士气低落的弱旅。两个军无法相互支援。可惜的是，新西兰第2师的大部分突破了包围，逃往阿拉曼。

src: Even though Comando Supremo wants to cut off Tobruk again with our remaining forces, Rommel has started retreating his divisions to the Gazala line. That leaves us no choice but to do the same.
dst: 尽管最高统帅部想以我们剩余的兵力再次切断托布鲁克，但隆美尔已开始把他的各师撤往加扎拉防线。这让我们别无选择，只能照做。

src: Even though our initial invasion of Norway was largely successful, the Norwegians are attempting to stop us at Hamar and Lillehammer so that we can't enter the Gudbrandsdal further north to capture Trondheim. This is just the job for your Kampfgruppe, isn't it?
dst: 尽管我们最初对挪威的入侵大体成功，挪威人仍试图在哈马尔和利勒哈默尔阻击我们，以免我们进入更北的居德布兰河谷去攻取特隆赫姆。这不正是你战斗群的拿手好戏吗？

src: Even though the British threw in many divisions - supported by some new metal monsters - you held most of the third line of defence long enough for new troops to seal of a breakthrough. Well done General. Fresh troops will take over this sector of the front.
dst: 尽管英军投入了许多师——还得到一些新型钢铁怪物的支援——您仍守住了第三道防线的大部分，为生力军封堵突破赢得了足够的时间。干得好，将军。新部队将接管这一前线地段。

src: Even though the British threw in many divisions - supported by some new metal monsters - you held most of the third line of defence. Well done General. Fresh troops will take over this sector of the front.
dst: 尽管英军投入了许多师——还得到一些新型钢铁怪物的支援——您仍守住了第三道防线的大部分。干得好，将军。新部队将接管这一前线地段。

src: Even though the British threw in many divisions - supported by some new metal monsters - you held the third line of defence. Well done General. Fresh troops will take over this sector of the front.
dst: 尽管英军投入了许多师——还得到一些新型钢铁怪物的支援——您仍守住了第三道防线。干得好，将军。新部队将接管这一前线地段。

src: Even though the War was winding down Sevastapol had to be taken.The Air Korps had flown numerous bombing raids to try and reduce it to Rubble but the amount of aa around the area had took it's toll and Crews of the Bombers just prayed when the Curtains were drawn at the Today's Mission breifings' it was not Moscow or Sevastapol for the odds of returning intact were about 50-50 from either location.Of course both places were going to be in SS hands before it was over but at how high a cost.So a 'Showdown on the Sea and in the Air as an amphibious attack by the 8th SS 'Alma was ordered.Frau General Alma Rommel Knauf knew She would be in a Good Fight here with all the Entrenchments and Big Guns plus She was not one of those much on Amphibious assaults knowing how vunerable naval transports were.Soviet Commander Cherevichenko would have his forces fight to the Death here.A lot of Generals in the SS told the Fuhress it could be bypassed and left to wither on the vine but intelligence had informed Ilse that the Soviets were thinking of sending their Fleet to join up with the Amerikans so Ilse gave the usual statement on Her decision to attack "It is a Necessity,to remove the Ships of the Soviet Black Sea Fleet and protect the 12th SS 'Ursha on the Flank".
dst: 尽管战争已接近尾声，塞瓦斯托波尔仍必须拿下。航空军已执行了无数次轰炸，试图把它炸成瓦砾，但该地区密集的高射炮造成了沉重损失，轰炸机机组在每日任务简令拉开帷幕时只能祈祷目标不是莫斯科或塞瓦斯托波尔——从这两处返回的完好率都只有五成左右。当然，最终这两个地方都会落入党卫军之手，只是代价高得可怕。于是一场"海上与空中的对决"展开：党卫军第8"阿尔玛"师奉命实施两栖进攻。阿尔玛·隆美尔·克瑙夫女将军知道，面对重重工事和重炮，她将陷入一场恶战；而且她并不擅长两栖突击，深知海军运输船有多脆弱。苏军指挥官切列维琴科将在此战斗到最后一人。党卫军中有不少将军对女元首说，这里可以绕过去、任其自生自灭；但情报告知伊尔泽，苏联人正考虑派舰队去与美国会合，于是伊尔泽对这次进攻的决定照例只说了一句"这是必需之举——拔除苏联黑海舰队的舰船，并保护侧翼的党卫军第12'乌尔莎'师"。

src: Even though the main combats are taking place near the city of Tetuán, the friendly "kabilas" have reported that a large number of hostile Berbers have been seen near Alcazarquivir, a town located near the border with the French protectorate and the Atlantic coast. Move your troops there and repel any attack in case  the enemy tries to surprise us.
dst: 尽管主要战斗发生在得土安市附近，但与我们友好的「卡比拉」报告说，在阿尔卡萨基维尔附近发现了大量敌对的柏柏尔人。该镇靠近法属保护地边境和大西洋海岸。把您的部队调到那里，一旦敌人试图突袭我们，就击退任何进攻。

src: Even though we are still dominating the battlefield, our loses are steadily increasing and new British tanks and troops keep on entering the theatre.
dst: 尽管我们仍主宰着战场，但我方损失在持续增加，而英国的新坦克和新部队仍源源涌入战区。

src: Even though we had an initial success, the Boer fought brilliantly, we suffered many losses, and we finally had to regroup at our initial positions on the Modder River. That very same week the Boer defeated other British forces at Stormberg and Colenso. After nearly three months of war our Army had been unable to make any significant progress.
dst: 尽管我们起初取得了成功，布尔人仍打得十分出色，我们损失惨重，最终不得不在莫德河上我们最初的阵地重新集结。就在同一周，布尔人又在斯托姆贝格和科伦索击败了其他英军。开战近三个月后，我们的军队仍未能取得任何重大进展。

src: Even though you did not reach your objectives, the Germans have signed an armistice! The war is over!
dst: 尽管您没有达成您的目标，但德军已经签署了停战协定！战争结束了！

src: Even though your corps was key in our success, your cooperation with General Guderian was somtimes strained, our two country's forces must learn to work more closely together.
dst: 尽管你的军是我们成功的关键，但你与古德里安将军的配合有时不太融洽，我们两国的军队必须学会更紧密地协同。

src: Even with a lot of the French on the run, it was hard to reach our objectives. HQ has ordered to stop further attacks and to go back on the defensive.
dst: 尽管大量法军正在溃逃，要达到我方目标仍十分艰难。指挥部已下令停止进一步进攻，转回防御。

src: Even with a lot of the French on the run, you were unable to reach your objectives. HQ has ordered to stop further attacks and to go back on the defensive.
dst: 尽管大量法军正在溃逃，您仍未能达成目标。指挥部已下令停止进一步进攻，转回防御。

src: Even with limited forces you achieved great success. The frontline opposite the American troops has been restored.
dst: 即便兵力有限，你仍取得了巨大成功。面对美军的战线已经恢复。

src: Even with limited forces you achieved your objectives. The frontline opposite the American troops has been restored.
dst: 即便兵力有限，你仍达成了目标。面对美军的战线已经恢复。

src: Events at Osel unfolded just as HQ has feared:  you were sent to the slaughter.  Thankfully, arrangement for your evacuation were made in a timely manner.  Your experience is valuable to the young Estonian army.  You are to report to Narva for garrison duty.
dst: 厄塞尔岛的事态正如司令部所担心的那样发展：您被送上了屠宰场。值得庆幸的是，您的撤离安排已及时作出。您的经验对年轻的爱沙尼亚军队十分宝贵。您要前往纳尔瓦报到，执行驻防任务。

src: Eventually all who survived came back to Poland.
dst: 最终，所有幸存者都回到了波兰。

src: Eventually we should shorten our frontline and draw back; but on the other side our positions in the mountains are very valuable... so you have to act with care..
dst: 最终我们也许应该缩短战线并后撤；但另一方面，我们在山中的阵地又极其宝贵……所以您必须谨慎行事……

src: Eventually, your troops broke through the Turkish lines. Unfortunately, we had to stop our offensive after the appearance of two new Turkish divisions. Now we have to dig in.
dst: 最终，您的部队突破了土耳其人的防线。不幸的是，在土耳其两个新师出现后，我们不得不停止攻势。现在我们只能挖壕据守。

src: Every minute counts now:  the II Corps' task is making contact with Samsonov with utmost urgency.
dst: 现在分秒必争：第2军的任务是以最紧急的方式与萨姆索诺夫取得联系。

src: Everyday I wake up thinking that this time, with one final push, our enemies will be routed, the way to Paris will be open, and this war will end at last. I can almost feel it. We are so close... one last, bold effort and all our sacrifices will have a reward. We just have to try a little harder, a little longer, and we’ll make it.
dst: 每天醒来，我都在想，这一次，只要最后再推一把，敌人就会溃败，通往巴黎的道路就会打开，这场战争也终将结束。我几乎能感觉到它了。我们是如此接近……最后再作一次大胆的努力，我们所有的牺牲都将得到回报。我们只需再拼一点、再坚持久一点，就一定能成功。

src: Everyone still remembers how the Great War started. In June 1914 the heir to the Austro-Hungarian throne was murdered by a fanatic who had Serbian support. Austro-Hungary threatened Serbia with war, and Russia threatened Austro-Hungary. And then Germany, making the greatest misjudgement of any country in contemporay history, declared war on Russia, France and Belgium, forcing us to intervene. The Germans actually believed that they could have an easy victory over France, just like in 1870, that we would soon lose interest in a war in the Continent, and that before the end of the year they would have free rein to fight Russia with the help of Austria-Hungary.
dst: 人人都还记得那场大战是如何爆发的。1914年6月，奥匈帝国皇位继承人在得到塞尔维亚支持的一名狂热分子手中遇刺身亡。奥匈帝国以战争威胁塞尔维亚，俄国则以战争威胁奥匈帝国。随后，德国犯下了近代史上任何一个国家都未曾犯过的最大误判，向俄国、法国和比利时宣战，迫使我们介入。德国人竟真的以为，他们可以像1870年那样轻松战胜法国，以为我们很快就会对欧洲大陆的战争失去兴趣，以为在年底之前他们就能在奥匈帝国的帮助下放手与俄国作战。

src: Everything has gone as planned. Most of out civilian sympathizers and our soldiers have been evacuated to Crimea. The Reds have suffered many casualties and won't be able to harass us.
dst: 一切都按计划进行。我们大多数平民支持者和士兵都已撤往克里米亚。红军伤亡惨重，已无力袭扰我们。

src: Everything has gone as planned. Now, while the Austrians and Bulgarians pin down the allied forces at Thessaloniki you'll attack Athen, closing the pincer on our enemies.
dst: 一切都按计划进行。如今，趁奥地利人和保加利亚人在塞萨洛尼基牵制住协约国军队之际，您将进攻雅典，对我们的敌人形成钳形合围。

src: Everything has gone as planned. We're marching along the streets of Tsaritsyn while many peope cheer us. I wonder if they cheered the Bolsheviks before, too.
dst: 一切都按计划进行。我们行进在察里津的街道上，许多人向我们欢呼。我不禁想，他们之前是否也曾这样为布尔什维克欢呼。

src: Everything has gone well. Now the port of Köstence will fall easily, and we'll capture the railway between that city and Bogazköy. Romania will be defeated before the end of this year.
dst: 一切都很顺利。现在康斯坦察港将轻松陷落，我们还将夺取该城与博阿兹柯伊之间的铁路。罗马尼亚将在今年年底之前被击败。

src: Everything is going as planned. Now you can advance towards Podgorica. The capital will fall without a fight, since the Montenegrin army has nothing left to fight with.
dst: 一切都在按计划进行。现在您可以向波德戈里察推进了。黑山军队已无力再战，首都将不战而降。

src: Everything is lost. Our army has been destroyed and the Russians have conquered our beloved capital. We can offer no further resistance and we have no other option but surrender. Poland will become a dominion of Soviet Russia. Or at best, if we are lucky and the League of Nations puts pressure on Russia, we'll be allowed to keep a tiny Polish state around Kraków.
dst: 一切都完了。我们的军队已被消灭，俄国人攻占了我们心爱的首都。我们无力再抵抗，除了投降别无选择。波兰将成为苏维埃俄国的一块属地。至多，如果我们运气好，国联向俄国施压，我们才可能被允许在克拉科夫周围保留一个微小的波兰国家。

src: Everything seemed to change at the end of December, when our troops defeated the Red Army in Perm. Pepelyayev and his Siberians recovered the city on December 24th, after routing the communist 3rd Army. That victory gave us hope.
dst: 12月底，似乎一切都变了：我们的部队在彼尔姆击败了红军。佩佩利亚耶夫和他的西伯利亚军在击溃共产党第三集团军后，于12月24日收复了这座城市。这场胜利给了我们希望。

src: Everything was in vain. Kolchak was killed and we were forced to cross the frozen Baikal. I won't make it. I was wounded during the combats, and blood loss and cold will kill me very soon. Sadly, I won't be the only one. Thousands of people, including women and children, are dying as I write these last notes. We haven't got time, strength or resources to bury them, so we leave them where they fall. Actually, sometimes they don't fall. They freeze to death while they're standing, and they'll remain there, as ice statues on the snow, until the spring comes and the waters of the lake swallow them.
dst: 一切都付诸东流。高尔察克被杀害，我们被迫渡过结冰的贝加尔湖。我走不到了。我在战斗中负伤，失血和严寒很快就会夺去我的生命。遗憾的是，我不是唯一一个。当我写下这些最后的文字时，成千上万的人——包括妇女和儿童——正在死去。我们没有时间、力气或资源埋葬他们，所以就把他们留在倒下的地方。实际上，有时他们并没有倒下。他们站着就被冻死了，就这样留在那里，像雪地上的冰雕，直到春天来临，湖水将他们吞没。

src: Ex comrade general, Comrade Beria of the NKVD would like to have coffee with you, but not here, because now our Capital will very soon be overrrun by the Fascist invaders!
dst: 前将军同志，内务人民委员部的贝利亚同志想和你喝杯咖啡，但不是在这里，因为我们祖国的首都很快就会被法西斯入侵者占领！

src: Exact Prestige Available per Turn (listed at 100%):
dst: 每回合可获得的确切声望（按 100% 列出）：

src: Exactly three years after the start of the Eastern Campaign, the Red Army launched one of the largest offensives in history - Operation Bagration. Our battalion arrived at the frontline on the eve of the enemy's attack and immediately after unloading from the train became embroiled in heavy fighting.
dst: 东线战役开始整三年后，红军发动了史上规模最大的攻势之一——巴格拉季昂行动。我们营在敌军进攻前夜抵达前线，刚下火车便卷入激战。

src: Excelent work, Herr general, the way to the next objetive is cleared after this victory. The reinforcements that allies sent were good, but they could'nt stop us.
dst: 出色的表现，将军先生，经过这场胜利，通往下一个目标的道路已经打通。盟军派来的援军虽然精锐，却无法阻止我们。

src: Excelente! Excelente!  All of  north Spain is now into our hands. We can now turn our attention to the center front.  Your next destination will be Aragon.   We are formulating a special operation to reach the Mediterranean and take Valencia, the new Republican capital.
dst: 好极了！好极了！整个西班牙北方现在都在我们手中。我们现在可以把注意力转向中部前线。您的下一个目标是阿拉贡。我们正在制订一项特别行动，以进抵地中海并夺取共和派的新首都巴伦西亚。

src: Excelente, excelente!  The enemy offensive was ill conceived and the Republicans have been stopped.    This forced them to discontinue their ''advance'' on Vitoria.  General, we will soon initiate future operations in the North.
dst: 好极了，好极了！敌人的攻势考虑不周，共和派已被挡住。这迫使他们中止了对维多利亚的「推进」。将军，我们很快将在北方发起新的作战。

src: Excellent ! The campaign has reached its end!
Excellent !!! Arrius is defeated - now L. Gellius Poplicola is waiting ...
dst: 太好了！！！阿里乌斯已被击败——现在等着我们的是卢基乌斯盖利乌斯波普利科拉 ...

src: Excellent !!! Cossinius is beaten. Now praetor Publius Varinius number is up !!!!
dst: 太好了！！！科西尼乌斯被打败了。接下来就轮到法官普布利乌斯瓦里尼乌斯了！！！！

src: Excellent !!! Furius is beaten. Who is next?
dst: 太好了！！！富里乌斯被打败了。下一个是谁？

src: Excellent !!! Gellius is defeated - now it is time to move again with Spatacus ...
dst: 太好了！！！盖利乌斯已被击败——现在是时候与斯巴达克斯再次行动了 ...

src: Excellent !!! Gellius is defeated, now is the time for Crixus obsequies and then go further north to freedom ...
dst: 太好了！！！盖利乌斯已被击败，现在是时候为克里克索斯举行葬礼，然后继续北上奔向自由 ...

src: Excellent !!! Lentus is defeated - now we turn south, heading to Poplicola and Arrius ...
dst: 太好了！！！伦图卢斯已被击败——现在我们转向南方，直取波普利科拉与阿里乌斯 ...

src: Excellent !!! Manlius and Longinus are defeated, Excellent !!! Manlius and Longinus are defeated, now we can cross over the Alps !
dst: 太好了！！！曼利乌斯与隆吉努斯已被击败，太好了！！！曼利乌斯与隆吉努斯已被击败，现在我们可以翻越阿尔卑斯山了！

src: Excellent !!! Nola burns and ye escape in time ...
dst: 太好了！！！诺拉燃起大火，你们及时脱身 ...

src: Excellent !!! Now we are supplied with weapons and some food. Come on into the inaccessible terrain of Mount Vesuvius ...
dst: 太好了！！！现在我们有了武器补给和一些食物。开进维苏威山那难以接近的地形吧 ...

src: Excellent !!! Nuceria is conquered and a part of Varinius Troops are destroyed.
dst: 太好了！！！努凯里亚被攻下，瓦里尼乌斯的一部分部队被歼灭。

src: Excellent !!! Picentia is conquered and Varinius Troops have been nearly exterminated.
dst: 太好了！！！皮琴蒂亚被攻下，瓦里尼乌斯的部队几乎被全歼。

src: Excellent !!! The first battle is over. Now it's time for a counterstrike ...
dst: 太好了！！！第一战结束了。现在该反击了 ...

src: Excellent !!! The road to the south is now free. Let's go for The Boot of the world ...
dst: 太好了！！！南下之路已经畅通。让我们去拿下那个世界的「靴子」 ...

src: Excellent !!! The way into the interior of the country is open now. On to the farms with the fattened Pigs...
dst: 太好了！！！通向内陆的道路已经打开。向那些养着肥猪的农庄进军...

src: Excellent !!! The way to freedom lies ahead ...
dst: 太好了！！！通往自由之路就在前方 ...

src: Excellent !!! You have rescued the Celts. But now there is staying a new strong opponent in front of you. Pompeius is back in the Country. Get armed !!!
dst: 太好了！！！你救出了凯尔特人。但如今眼前还挡着一个强敌。庞培回到了国内。拿起武器吧！！！

src: Excellent Herr General, Alexandria is ours! Now Cairo and the Suez Canal will be our next targets. But we have other plans for you. You are ordered back to Berlin for a victory parade.
dst: 太好了，将军阁下，亚历山大是我们的了！接下来开罗和苏伊士运河将是我们的目标。但我们为您另有安排。您奉命返回柏林参加胜利阅兵。

src: Excellent Herr General, Alexandria will be in our hands soon!
dst: 好极了，将军阁下，亚历山大港很快将落入我们手中！

src: Excellent Herr General, now take Sedan while the French are in disarray!!!
dst: 好极了，将军阁下，趁法国人一片混乱，现在夺取色当！！！

src: Excellent comrade!!! This is one of first big victories of this war. You have driven some elite forces of the fascists armies out of Rostov and saved the Caucasus from an attack! However many of the almost entrapped Germans managed to retreat and built up a defensive winter line at the Mius River, still tens of kilometers west of Rostov!
dst: 干得漂亮，同志！！！这是这场战争最初的大捷之一。你把法西斯的几支精锐部队赶出了罗斯托夫，使高加索免遭进攻！然而，许多险些被围的德军还是撤了出去，在米乌斯河——罗斯托夫以西几十公里处——构筑起一条冬季防线！

src: Excellent display, General.  With the annihilation of the German Afrika Korps we can now begin the long, arduous task of liberating Europe from the tyranny of leather shorts, sausages and foul-smelling cabbage.  Oh and we'll give the pasta munchers a bloody good seeing too while we're at it.  Pip pip!
dst: 表现精彩，将军。随着德国非洲军团的覆灭，我们现在可以开始解放欧洲这项漫长而艰巨的任务了——把欧洲从皮短裤、香肠和臭烘烘的卷心菜的暴政下解放出来。哦，顺手我们还要把那些吃意面的家伙也好好收拾一顿。再见！

src: Excellent job, General! Our enemies' losses have been staggering, and their hopes on a quick occupation of Elsass are gone. However, due to the immediate arrival of a large contingent of French reinforcements, it'll be wiser to retreat behind the Rhein while we try to outflank them with a counterattack in Lothringen.
dst: 干得漂亮，将军！敌人的损失大得惊人，他们迅速占领阿尔萨斯的希望已化为泡影。然而，由于大批法军增援即将赶到，明智的做法是撤到莱茵河后方，同时我们设法在洛林发起反攻来包抄他们。

src: Excellent job. Again 100,000s of Russians are trapped in pockets behind our lines. The Bolsheviks made the mistake of committing all their troops to the first line of defense. Once you broke through, they had no reserve forces to stop you. Now it's time to move East. Moscow is the target.
dst: 干得极好。又有数十万俄国人被困在我们战线后方的各个包围圈中。布尔什维克犯了把全部兵力投入第一道防线的错误。你一旦突破，他们就没有预备队可以阻挡你了。现在是时候向东推进了。目标是莫斯科。

src: Excellent news from the fronts are arriving to our glorious leader. The fascist forces at Stalingrad have finally been forced to surrender. We have liberated Rostov again and the Caucasus has been liberated entirely but for the Kuban region. The danger for the oilfields is gone and our winter offensive has been a great success!
dst: 前线的好消息不断传到我们伟大领袖耳中。斯大林格勒的法西斯军队终于被迫投降了。我们再次解放了罗斯托夫，高加索除库班地区外也已全部解放。油田的威胁解除了，我们的冬季攻势取得了巨大成功！

src: Excellent performance, Herr General! After 2 and a half years of fighting Leningrad is finally ours! The enemy fought valiantly, but this did not stop you. And now, the last Bolshevik reserves await your attack. We must strike quickly towards Moscow while we have the initiative over the Bolsheviks.
dst: 表现出色，将军阁下！经过两年半的战斗，列宁格勒终于归我们所有！敌人作战英勇，但这未能阻止你。而现在，布尔什维克最后的预备队正等着挨你的打。我们必须趁掌握主动之际迅速向莫斯科挺进。

src: Excellent performance, Herr General! Since the Bolsheviks have begun a great offensive in the Kursk region, the General Staff has decided that you and your men are to be transferred back to the Russian front where you have performed so well in the past.
dst: 表现出色，将军阁下！由于布尔什维克已在库尔斯克地区发起大规模攻势，总参谋部已决定将你和你的部下调回俄罗斯前线，你在那里过去表现出色。

src: Excellent performance, Herr General.  Leningrad is ours!  Now that our conquests in the East have been consolidated, you are needed ellsewhere. Your troops are to be transferred to France where our intelligence reports that the Allies will be attempting to land in the summer.
dst: 表现优异，将军阁下。列宁格勒是我们的了！既然我们在东方的征服已经巩固，别处需要你。你的部队将调往法国，据我方情报报告，盟军将在夏季尝试在那里登陆。

src: Excellent performance, Herr General.  Leningrad is ours!  Now we must strike quickly towards Moscow while we have the initiative over the Bolsheviks.
dst: 出色的表现，将军阁下。列宁格勒属于我们了！现在我们必须趁掌握对布尔什维克的先手之机，迅速向莫斯科发起进攻。

src: Excellent performance, Herr General.  The conquest of Cairo and the Suez Kanal should now be easy, especially for Feldmarschall Rommel.  Since the Bolsheviks have begun a great offensive in the Kursk region, while Feldmarschall Paulus is still unable to break out of Stalingrad, the General Staff has decided that you and your men are to be transferred back to the Russian front where you have performed so well in the past.
dst: 出色的表现，将军阁下。现在征服开罗和苏伊士运河应当轻而易举，尤其是对隆美尔元帅而言。由于布尔什维克已在库尔斯克地区发起大规模攻势，而保卢斯元帅仍未能从斯大林格勒突围，总参谋部已决定将您和您的部下调回俄国前线——您过去在那里表现出色。

src: Excellent performance, Herr General.  The conquest of Cairo and the Suez Kanal should now be easy, especially for Feldmarschall Rommel.  Since we're expecting the Bolsheviks to launch a great offensive in the Kursk region, while Feldmarschall Paulus is still unable to break out of Stalingrad, the General Staff has decided that you and your men are to be transferred back to the Russian front where you have performed so well in the past.
dst: 表现优异，将军阁下。攻占开罗和苏伊士运河现在应当易如反掌，对隆美尔元帅而言尤其如此。由于我们预计布尔什维克会在库尔斯克地区发动一场大规模攻势，而保卢斯元帅仍无法突围出斯大林格勒，总参谋部已决定把你和你的部下调回俄战线——你过去在那里表现出色。

src: Excellent performance, sir.  With Syracuse in our hands we have secured an excellent supply hub for our advance to Messina.  We have also gained valuable lessons in amphibious landings which will help us plan for the return to France.
dst: 表现出色，长官。锡拉库萨既已入手，我们就为向墨西拿推进取得了一个极佳的补给枢纽。我们还从两栖登陆中汲取了宝贵经验，这将有助于我们谋划重返法国。

src: Excellent showing, sir!  Despite the rather madcap nature of Montgomery's cunning plan, you still somehow managed to achieve your objectives - and in good time!  Unfortunately, due to the heavy casualties suffered by our airborne chaps, the lack of supplies and the German counter-attacks bearing down on our flanks, we have little chance of exploiting this breakthrough.  The war won't be over by Christmas it now appears.
dst: 表现得精彩，长官！尽管蒙哥马利那个狡猾的计划相当疯狂，你竟还是设法达成了目标——而且及时！遗憾的是，由于我空降部队伤亡惨重、补给匮乏，加之德军反攻压向两翼，我们几乎没有机会扩大这一突破。看来战争不会在圣诞节前结束了。

src: Excellent sir! The Herero issue is resolved, the revolt ended and our settlers could return to their farms.
dst: 好极了，先生！赫雷罗人的问题已经解决，叛乱平息，我们的定居者可以重返他们的农场了。

src: Excellent work Colonel! Even though the remnants of the encircled Soviet divisions managed to escape destruction by fleeing into the forests, we managed to capture most of their heavy equipment! All fronts are now stabilized and......Excuse me a moment......Colonel!, I have just now been informed that Stalin will accept Marshal Mannerheim's proposal for an armistice if we cut all diplomatic ties with Germany, and German troops are given a deadline of September 15 to withdraw from Finnish soil or be interned and handed over to the Soviet Union as POWs. This war of continuation is as good as over!
dst: 干得漂亮，上校！尽管被围苏军各师的残部逃入森林得以免于被歼，我们仍缴获了他们的大部分重型装备！各战线现已稳定，而且……失陪一下……上校！我刚刚得知：如果我们与德国断绝一切外交关系，并给德军规定9月15日为撤出芬兰领土的最后期限，否则即予以拘押并作为战俘移交苏联，斯大林将接受曼纳海姆元帅的停战提议。这场继续战争差不多已经结束了！

src: Excellent work Commander I knew you would not let us down!! Your victory has seriously damaged enemy morale. Well done.
dst: 干得漂亮，指挥官，我就知道您不会让我们失望！！您的胜利严重打击了敌军士气。做得好。

src: Excellent work Comrade General! Now the Romanians are protesting that we violated the agreement by using airborne troops and airborne tanks to disperse their army! They were so panic stricken that they actually assumed that the tanks had been transported by air as well! Stalin sends his regards. Well done...
dst: 干得漂亮，将军同志！现在罗马尼亚人抗议我们使用空降部队和空降坦克驱散他们的军队，违反了协定！他们惊恐万状，竟真的以为那些坦克也是由空运投送的！斯大林向你致意。干得好...

src: Excellent work Comrade General! Your's and Rokossovsky's success at Yelnya has been the only bright spot against the German invasion of our country thus far. I know that you would probably like to continue your westward drive from Yelnya, but Stalin has ordered the Reserve front onto the defensive, and has summoned you to the Kremlin. I have a feeling that he would like you to take over the defence of Leningrad from Marshal Voroshilov, whose performance has been deemed as so incompetent, that now there is a real threat that our Northern capital will fall!
dst: 干得漂亮，将军同志！迄今在德国入侵我国的战争中，你和罗科索夫斯基在叶利尼亚取得的战果是唯一的亮点。我知道你大概想从叶利尼亚继续西进，但斯大林已命令预备队方面军转入防御，并召你前往克里姆林宫。我有一种感觉：他大概想让你从伏罗希洛夫元帅手中接管列宁格勒的防务——后者的表现被认为极其无能，以致我们北方的都城现在真的有陷落的危险！

src: Excellent work General! Now we will pursue the Germans back to the Adriatic coast..
dst: 干得漂亮，将军！现在我们要把德军一路追回亚得里亚海沿岸..

src: Excellent work Herr General!  As a result, 4th Panzer armee is now on the move, and should arrive very shortly at Kotelnikovo...
dst: 干得漂亮，将军阁下！结果，第4装甲集团军现已出动，不久即应抵达科捷利尼科沃……

src: Excellent work Herr General!  The encirclement has been broken and the remanents of the Sixth Armee evacuated safely! We will think about resuming the offensive once von Manstein is finished discussions with the Fuhrer, and the serviceable remaining units from Sixth Armee receive some much needed regrouping and refitting...
dst: 干得漂亮，将军阁下！包围圈已被打破，第六集团军的残部已安全撤出！待冯·曼施泰因与元首的讨论结束、第六集团军尚堪使用的剩余部队得到急需的重新编组与整补之后，我们再考虑恢复攻势……

src: Excellent work Herr General! Due to your brilliant leadership, the resources of the Donets Basin are now ours. About General Halder: His talk with the Fuhrer has had some success! The Fuhrer has promised to keep a close watch on your 6th Armee's progress, and to strengthen your exposed position on the steppe, he has ordered the 4th Panzer Armee to turn around and rejoin the Drive to the Volga!
dst: 干得漂亮，将军阁下！由于你卓越的指挥，顿巴斯的资源现在归我们所有。关于哈尔德将军：他与元首的谈话取得了一些成效！元首已承诺密切关注你第六集团军的进展；为加强你在草原上暴露的阵地，他已命令第4装甲集团军掉头回来，重新加入进军伏尔加河的行列！

src: Excellent work Herr General! Unfortunately though, the Soviets are still hanging on in a few places on the banks of the Volga, especially in the houses and factories...
dst: 干得漂亮，将军阁下！遗憾的是，苏军仍在伏尔加河沿岸的几处据守，尤其是在那些房屋和工厂里……

src: Excellent work Herr General! You have achieved a Great victory and have secured the city of Voronezh. Your victory has consolidated the flanks of our attack towards the Caucasus...
dst: 干得漂亮，将军阁下！你取得了一场伟大的胜利，并夺取了沃罗涅日城。你的胜利巩固了我们向高加索进攻的两翼……

src: Excellent work Herr General! You have achieved a Great victory for the Fatherland! The city of Stalingrad is finally and completely ours at last! The Fuhrer is beside himself with joy! We should refit and await with confidence the events that the new year will bring!
dst: 干得漂亮，将军阁下！你为祖国赢得了一场伟大的胜利！斯大林格勒城终于完全属于我们了！元首欣喜若狂！我们应当休整改编，满怀信心地等待新的一年将带来的事态发展！

src: Excellent work Herr General! You have cleared the area between the rivers, and have decimated the Soviet 62nd Army! Now you will make the final drive for Stalingrad!
dst: 干得漂亮，将军阁下！你已肃清两河之间的地区，并重创了苏联第62集团军！现在你将向斯大林格勒发起最后的一击！

src: Excellent work Herr General!! Due to your battlefield instincts, the road to Voronezh is now open!
dst: 干得漂亮，将军阁下！！多亏你在战场上的直觉，通往沃罗涅日的道路现在已经打开！

src: Excellent work Herr General!, the Uman pocket has been sealed...
dst: 干得漂亮，将军阁下！乌曼包围圈已经合拢……

src: Excellent work Herr General!, the bridgeheads have been secured...
dst: 干得漂亮，将军阁下！桥头堡已经巩固……

src: Excellent work Herr General!, we are now driving deep into the Caucasus!
dst: 干得漂亮，将军阁下！我们正在向高加索纵深推进！

src: Excellent work Major! Although you were unable to completely destroy the Soviet 54th division, you did manage to halt their attack and route parts of the division. Furthermore, the remainder of the 54th division, after losing their forward bases, are now encircled in a great "Motti" near the Soviet-Finnish border. Now you will make your way back to the Karelian Isthmus, where some dark clouds are gathering...
dst: 干得漂亮，少校！尽管你未能彻底消灭苏联第54师，但你确实挡住了他们的进攻并击溃了该师的一部。此外，第54师的余部在失去前进基地之后，现已在苏芬边境附近被合围于一个巨大的「莫蒂」包围圈中。现在你将返回卡累利阿地峡，那里正聚集着一些乌云……

src: Excellent work Major! As you know, the Soviet Union has attacked us all along our front, but you managed to delay the Soviet attack in this sector just enough to allow us to begin the set up our defensive positions behind the Mannerheim line. Do not worry about the puppet government installed by Stalin in Terijoki, it does not and will not have the support of our people! Anyway, You and your men will now move North towards Tolvajarvi, where a counter offensive is being planned....
dst: 干得漂亮，少校！如你所知，苏联在我国全线发动了进攻，但你成功地把苏军在这一地段的进攻拖延了足够长的时间，使我们得以开始在曼纳海姆防线后方构筑防御阵地。不必担心斯大林在泰里约基扶植的那个傀儡政府，它得不到、也永远不会得到我国人民的支持！总之，你和你的部下现在将北上调往托尔瓦亚尔维，那里正在策划一次反击....

src: Excellent work Major! Thanx to your militairy prowess, we have been able to set up a strong line of defence on the Soviet side of the Svir river! We are now going to continue to press north from Petrozavodsk, towards Medvezhegorsk. Your forces will enjoy some well earned R&R manning the line of defence here....
dst: 干得漂亮，少校！多亏你的军事才干，我们已在斯维尔河的苏方一侧建立起一道坚固防线！现在我们将继续自彼得罗扎沃茨克向北推进，指向梅德韦日耶戈尔斯克。你的部队将在此驻守防线，享受一段应得的休整....

src: Excellent work Major! The Soviet attackers have been repelled, and the partisan spies destroyed. Thanx to your help, our airbase at Tiiksjarvi should continue to be a thorn in the side of the Soviet juggernaut for some time yet. Now, back to business. After a well deserved night's rest, you and your men will immediately set out to rejoin our forces at the Svir river. Judging by the latest recon reports, it appears the Soviets might be up to something there....
dst: 干得漂亮，少校！苏军的进攻已被击退，游击队的密探也被消灭。多亏你的帮助，我们在蒂克夏尔维的空军基地在未来一段时间内仍将是苏联那台战争机器侧翼的一根刺。现在言归正传。经过一夜应得的休息之后，你和你的部下将立刻出发，前往斯维尔河与我军主力会合。根据最新的侦察报告，苏军似乎在那里有所图谋....

src: Excellent work Major! The Soviet attempt to drive us out of the Svir sector has been repulsed, and they have suffered heavy casualties as a result. I have a feeling that they will think twice before attacking us in this area again. Now, I should pass this interesting information on to you: Since Marshal Mannerheim is not so sure anymore that Germany will be able to win the war, he is contemplating how to make peace with the Allies, and he may soon start by not ordering anymore offensive operations. If this happens, take care that your men's morale stays high, just in case....
dst: 干得漂亮，少校！苏军把我们逐出斯维尔地段的企图已被挫败，他们为此付出了惨重伤亡。我有一种感觉：他们下次在这一地区进攻我们之前会三思而行。现在，我应该把这则有趣的消息转告给你：由于曼纳海姆元帅已不再那么确信德国能赢得这场战争，他正在考虑如何与盟国媾和，而且可能很快就会从不再下令发动任何进攻行动开始。如果真到了那一步，请务必让你的部下保持高昂的士气，以防万一....

src: Excellent work Major! This is our first "big" victory against the Invaders. The importance of this Victory as a morale booster cannot be under estimated! The threat of a Soviet division getting behind our lines has been neutralized, and the 139th division has been hit very hard. Now your skills are again needed, even further North, where we are planning to retake Suomussalmi....
dst: 干得漂亮，少校！这是我们抗击入侵者的首次「重大」胜利。这场胜利在鼓舞士气方面的意义再怎么高估也不为过！苏军一个师迂回到我军后方的威胁已被消除，第139师遭到重创。如今你的才能在更北面的地方又被需要了——我们正计划在那里收复苏穆萨尔米....

src: Excellent work Major! We are close to re-conquering the Karelian Isthmus. Soon we will push into East Karelia, towards Leningrad, which should result in giving us a comfortable buffer zone against any Soviet attempts at re-entering Finnish territory...
dst: 干得漂亮，少校！我们已接近重新征服卡累利阿地峡。很快我们将推进至东卡累利阿，直指列宁格勒，这将给我们带来一片舒适的缓冲地带，足以应对苏军任何重新进入芬兰领土的尝试……

src: Excellent work Major! You have helped to acheive yet another victory against the Invaders! 2 Soviet divisions have been nearly wiped out, and the remainder are on the run, and we have collected quite a war booty! Now, your men, along with the 9th division, will move back south towards Kuhmo....
dst: 干得漂亮，少校！你又帮我们取得了一场抗击入侵者的胜利！苏军两个师几乎被全歼，余部正四处逃散，我们也缴获了可观的战利品！现在，你的部下将连同第9师南下，朝库赫莫推进....

src: Excellent work Major, excuse me, I mean Colonel! The Soviet attack has been defeated, and they are now transferring their best troops to Estonia, to fight the Germans there. It appears the Soviets are coming to the conclusion that conquering Finland will be extremely difficult, and not worth the cost. We have received word from our Swedish friends that Stalin is now willing to discuss peace terms with us. Nevertheless, we now need you to begin immediately making your way further north, towards Ilomantsi, where, based on the latest recon reports, an as yet indeterminant number of Soviet troops appear to be moving in an aggressive fashion towards us...
dst: 干得漂亮，少校，恕我失言，我是说上校！苏军的进攻已被击败，他们正把最精锐的部队调往爱沙尼亚，在那里与德军作战。看来苏军正在得出这样的结论：征服芬兰将极其困难，且不值得付出那样的代价。我们从瑞典朋友处得到消息，斯大林现在愿意与我们商讨和平条件。尽管如此，我们现在需要你立刻启程继续北上，前往伊洛曼齐——根据最新的侦察报告，数量尚不确定的苏军部队似乎正以进攻姿态朝我们逼近……

src: Excellent work by you and your troops!! We can now attack Constantinople.
dst: 您和您的部队干得非常出色！！我们现在可以进攻君士坦丁堡了。

src: Excellent work comrade General! The Germans have been driven away from Moscow, but the front lines are still relatively close, and more importantly, the Rzhev salient of Army Group Center remains intact. Thus Stalin still considers Moscow as threatened...
dst: 干得漂亮，将军同志！德军已被逐离莫斯科，但战线仍然相对接近，更重要的是，中央集团军群的勒热夫突出部依旧完好。因此斯大林仍认为莫斯科受到威胁……

src: Excellent work comrade Lieutenant-General!  Most of the Japanese forces have been wiped out, the remainder being either caught behind our lines of advance or pushed back into Manchukuo. Now the Japanese have asked for an armistice, and they agree to abide by the existing border! Congratulations, you have been awarded the title of "Hero of the Soviet Union", promoted to General of the Army, and have been given command of the Kiev Special Military District!
dst: 干得漂亮，中将同志！日军大部已被歼灭，余部要么被切断在我军推进线之后，要么被赶回满洲国。现在日方已请求停战，并同意遵守现有边界！恭喜你，你被授予「苏联英雄」称号，晋升为大将，并受命指挥基辅特别军区！

src: Excellent work comrade Marshal! Although the German defence line on the Narew River remains intact in the Lomza area, Stalin has noted the capture of the fortress of Osowiec and sends congratulations to the units and commanders involved!
dst: 干得漂亮，元帅同志！尽管德军在沃姆扎地区纳雷夫河上的防线仍然完整，斯大林已注意到奥索维茨要塞的攻克，并向参战部队和指挥员表示祝贺！

src: Excellent work comrade Marshal! Bobruisk is ours again, and a southern route into Minsk has been opened. But not only that! 5 divisions of 9th Armee's XXXV Korps have been trapped, along with elements of the XXXXI Panzer Korps that were not able to break out...
dst: 干得漂亮，元帅同志！博布鲁伊斯克又回到我们手中，通往明斯克的南路也已打开。不仅如此！第9集团军第35军的5个师被围，未能突围的第41装甲军各部队也在其中……

src: Excellent work comrade Marshal! Brest-Litovsk is ours again. Stalin is also pleased that You and Rokossovsky were able to exploit the success, and as a result, continue the drive west towards the Vistula river...
dst: 干得漂亮，元帅同志！布列斯特-立托夫斯克又回到我们手中。斯大林也很满意你和罗科索夫斯基能够扩大战果，因而继续西进，直逼维斯瓦河……

src: Excellent work comrade Marshal! The Germans have been forced back over to the west bank of the Vistula, but unfortunately, they managed to destroy the bridgehead, thus making it much harder now to relieve the uprising...
dst: 干得漂亮，元帅同志！德军已被逼回维斯瓦河西岸，但不幸的是，他们成功摧毁了桥头堡，这使驰援起义变得更加困难……

src: Excellent work comrade Marshal! You have managed to secure the Arsnwalde area and breakthrough past Stargard towards Altdamm and Stettin. Now the 2nd Belorussian front will take it from here while most of the elements of your 1st Belorussian front return to the bridgehead at Kustrin in preparation for the final push towards Berlin...
dst: 干得漂亮，元帅同志！你已成功控制阿恩斯瓦尔德地区，并突破什塔加德，直指阿尔特达姆和斯德丁。现在白俄罗斯第2方面军将接手这里，而你的白俄罗斯第1方面军大部则返回屈斯特林桥头堡，为向柏林的最后推进做准备……

src: Excellent work comrade Marshal!, Mogilev is ours again and 4th Armee has been pushed back to Minsk preventing them from disengaging in time to reinforce Vitebsk and Bobruisk, resulting in roughly 30,000 German troops being surrounded at Vitebsk, and the encirclement of 5 divisions in the Bobruisk sector!
dst: 干得漂亮，元帅同志！莫吉廖夫又回到我们手中，第4集团军被打退回明斯克，未能及时脱身去增援维捷布斯克和博布鲁伊斯克，结果约3万名德军在维捷布斯克被包围，博布鲁伊斯克地段则有5个师被合围！

src: Excellent work comrade Marshal!, You and Zakharov have acheived in 5 days what STAVKA had allotted 8-11 days to complete! Stalin sends his regards!
dst: 干得漂亮，元帅同志！你和扎哈罗夫用5天时间完成了最高统帅部预计8至11天完成的任务！斯大林向你致意！

src: Excellent work comrade Zhukov!  Although the Germans still hold the Sinyavino heights, under your leadership and guidance, the fronts have met, and thus a land corridor has been opened into Leningrad! The city is still partially under siege, but emergency supply trucks are entering Leningrad as we speak, carrying much needed food and supplies. Once this second " Road of Life" is finished being constructed within the liberated corridor, Leningrad should be able to be supplied with all necessities until the Siege can be completely lifted. Congratulations, you have been promoted to Marshal of the Soviet Union!
dst: 干得漂亮，朱可夫同志！尽管德军仍据守锡尼亚维诺高地，但在你的领导和指挥之下，两个方面军已经会师，从而打通了一条通往列宁格勒的陆上走廊！该城仍处于部分围困之中，但就在我们说话的当口，载着急需粮食和物资的应急卡车正驶入列宁格勒。一旦这条第二条「生命之路」在解放出来的走廊内修筑完成，列宁格勒就应能获得一切必需品的补给，直至围困被彻底解除。恭喜你，你已晋升为苏联元帅！

src: Excellent work comrade Zhukov!, but unfortunately, even though we managed to encircle the 1st Panzer Armee and capture Kamenets-Podolsk, the Germans have counter-attacked, cutting off our forces, thus their breakout attempt continues. You have been re-assigned as STAVKA coordinator to both General Rokossovsky's 1st Belorussian Front, and General Zakharov's 2nd Belorussian Front...
dst: 干得漂亮，朱可夫同志！但不幸的是，尽管我们成功合围了德国第1装甲集团军并夺取了卡缅涅茨-波多利斯克，德军已发起反击，切断了我军，因此他们的突围企图仍在继续。你已被重新指派为最高统帅部驻罗科索夫斯基将军白俄罗斯第1方面军和扎哈罗夫将军白俄罗斯第2方面军的协调员……

src: Excellent work comrade! Your's and Rokossovsky's joint handling of the situation has sent the Germans reeling back under the weight of the Central front's advance, forcing  the German command to acknowledge the failure of Operation Citadel. As a result, the Germans have decided to pull von Manstein's forces back to their starting line in order to save it's troops from complete defeat...
dst: 干得漂亮，同志！你和罗科索夫斯基对局势的联手处置，使德军在中央方面军推进的重压下节节败退，迫使德军指挥部承认「堡垒」行动失败。结果，德军已决定把冯·曼施泰因的部队撤回出发线，以免其部队彻底覆灭……

src: Excellent work, General! You crushed the Bolshevik lines at Tarnopol. Hitler is sending his compliments to a job well done.
dst: 干得漂亮，将军！你在捷尔诺波尔粉碎了布尔什维克的防线。希特勒对这项出色的战绩表示赞赏。

src: Excellent work, General.  We've made a deep penetration into the enemy's rear....ahem.  Now two fresh armoured divisions of Poles and Canadians are to take over for a new offensive to capture Falaise, while your brave men get some much needed rest.  Oh and if you bump into any Poles on your way, don't broach the subject of Latin American politics - for some reason the subject really winds them up!
dst: 干得漂亮，将军。我们已向敌后纵深插入……咳咳。现在两个新锐的波兰和加拿大装甲师将接手，发起夺取法莱斯的新攻势，而你勇敢的部下则得到急需的休整。哦对了，若你路上遇到波兰人，千万别提拉丁美洲政治这个话题——不知为何，这话题真能把他们惹毛！

src: Excellent work, Herr Feldmarschall.  Low on supplies and cut off from the rest of the Empire, the Japanese troops have had little choice but to surrender or face annihilation.  Most of them have chosen to fight to the last.
dst: 干得漂亮，元帅阁下。日军补给匮乏、又被切断了与帝国其余部分的联系，除了投降就只有坐以待毙。他们大多数人选择了战至最后一人。

src: Excellent work, Herr Feldmarschall.  The American resistance has been eliminated and we have secured the area sufficiently to allow the arrival of reinforcements.  Our nuclear research proceeds apace.
dst: 干得漂亮，元帅阁下。美国抵抗力量已被消灭，我们已充分控制该地区，足以让增援部队抵达。我们的核研究正稳步推进。

src: Excellent work, Herr Feldmarschall.  You have stopped the Bolsheviks and forced them back
dst: 表现出色，陆军元帅阁下。你阻止了布尔什维克，并把他们逼退

src: Excellent work, Herr Feldmarschall.  You have stopped the Bolsheviks and forced them back across the Nemnuas river. Feldmarschall Manstein will now take command and continue our drive to free all of the Fatherland from the Bolsheviks.  Your superb tactical skills are needed in Hungary where the situation is critical.  The Bolsheviks have besieged Budapest,and we believe that if it falls our Hungarian allies will sue for peace.  You must relieve Budapest.
dst: 干得漂亮，元帅阁下。你挡住了布尔什维克并把他们逼回涅姆纳斯河对岸。曼施泰因元帅现在将接掌指挥，继续推进，把祖国的全部领土从布尔什维克手中解放出来。你的高超战术素养在匈牙利是必需的，那里的局势已到了危急关头。布尔什维克已围困布达佩斯，我们相信该城一旦陷落，我们的匈牙利盟友就会求和。你必须为布达佩斯解围。

src: Excellent work, Herr Feldmarschall. You have stopped the Bolsheviks and forced them back across the Seelow Heights.
dst: 干得漂亮，元帅阁下。您已阻止布尔什维克，并迫使他们退回泽洛高地。

src: Excellent work, Herr Feldmarschall. You have stopped the Bolsheviks and forced them back across the Seelow Heights. Feldmarschall Manstein will now take command and continue our drive to free all of the Fatherland from the Bolsheviks. Your superb tactical skills are needed in Hungary where the situation is critical. The Bolsheviks have besieged Budapest, and we believe that if it falls our Hungarian allies will sue for peace. You must relieve Budapest.
dst: 干得漂亮，元帅阁下。你阻止了布尔什维克，迫使他们退过泽洛高地。曼施坦因元帅现在将接手指挥，继续我们的推进，把整个祖国从布尔什维克手中解放出来。你卓越的战术才能为匈牙利所需，那里的局势十分危急。布尔什维克已围困布达佩斯，我们相信一旦该城陷落，我们的匈牙利盟友就会求和。你必须解救布达佩斯。

src: Excellent work, Herr Feldmarshall!  Unfortunately though, after receiving the news of the Allied invasion of Sicily, as well as reports of an impending Soviet attack on our positions on the Mius river, the Fuhrer has decided to cancel Operation Zitadelle...
dst: 干得漂亮，元帅阁下！遗憾的是，在接到盟军入侵西西里的消息，以及苏军即将进攻我们在米乌斯河阵地的报告之后，元首已决定取消「堡垒」行动……

src: Excellent work, Herr General!  Crete is ours, except for a few scattered units which may be left to our Italian allies.  You and your men will rest and refit in preparation for our 1942 Russian campaign.
dst: 干得漂亮，将军阁下！克里特岛是我们的了，只剩下几支零星部队，可以留给我们的意大利盟友去收拾。你和你的部下将休整改编，为1942年的俄国战役做准备。

src: Excellent work, Herr General! Crete is ours, except for a few scattered units which may be left to our Italian allies.
dst: 干得漂亮，将军阁下！克里特岛已是我们的了，只剩少数散兵游勇，可以留给我们的意大利盟友。

src: Excellent work, Herr General, the road to Grozny has been cleared, and preparations are now underway for the final assault...
dst: 干得漂亮，将军阁下，通往格罗兹尼的道路已经打通，最后突击的准备工作正在进行……

src: Excellent work, Herr General.  With Rostov in our hands we can finally advance into the Caucasus in order to secure the Soviet oil fields. Well done Herr General!
dst: 干得漂亮，将军阁下。罗斯托夫既已在我手中，我们终于可以推进至高加索，夺取苏联的油田。干得好，将军阁下！

src: Excellent work, Herr General.  With Sevastopol in our hands our advances on Stalingrad and the Caucaus can proceed.  Your success here has led the General Staff to give you the critical assignment of taking Stalingrad, while Feldmarschall Manstein will conquer the Caucaus.
dst: 干得漂亮，将军阁下。塞瓦斯托波尔已在我们手中，我们向斯大林格勒和高加索的推进可以继续了。您在此处的成功使总参谋部决定，把夺取斯大林格勒这一关键任务交给您，而曼施坦因元帅将征服高加索。

src: Excellent work, Herr General.  With Sevastopol in our hands our advances on Stalingrad and the Caucaus can proceed.  Your success here has led the General Staff to give you the critical assignment of taking Stalingrad.
dst: 干得漂亮，将军阁下。塞瓦斯托波尔既已在我手中，我们向斯大林格勒和高加索的推进便可展开。你在此地的成功使总参谋部把夺取斯大林格勒这一关键任务交给了你。

src: Excellent work, Herr General.  With the oil fields in our hands we can turn our panzers north again. Well done Herr General!
dst: 干得漂亮，将军阁下。油田既已在我手中，我们可以让装甲部队再度转向北方。干得好，将军阁下！

src: Excellent! After all your victories against the Ottomans, I think you are the right man for putting the siege of Odrin to an end.
dst: 出色！在您对奥斯曼人取得这一系列胜利之后，我认为您是结束奥德林围城战的合适人选。

src: Excellent! After this great victory, the 8th army won't be able to make a quick reorganization, this is our chance to take the initiative, we will chase the Allies towards the west.
dst: 出色！经过这场大胜，第8集团军无法迅速重整，这是我们的机会——夺取先手，我们将把盟军向西追击。

src: Excellent! Despite the fact the enemy have managed to force their way inland at other points, you have swept all before you. And because of this blow you have dealt them, the Allies will not be able to take advantage of their successes elsewhere. It is unfortunate that we do not have more like you, Herr General.
dst: 干得漂亮！尽管敌军在别处设法突入内陆，你却一路扫荡了面前的一切。正由于你给予他们的这一记重击，盟军将无法利用他们在其他地段取得的战果。遗憾的是，像你这样的人我们不多，将军阁下。

src: Excellent! Despite the fact the enemy have managed to force their way inland at other points, you have swept all before you. And because of this blow you have dealt them, the Allies will not be able to take advantage of their successes elsewhere. It is unfortunate that we do not have more men like you, Herr General.
dst: 太出色了！尽管敌人在其他地点设法强行突入内陆，您已将其全部荡平。正因为您给予他们的这一打击，盟军将无法利用他们在别处的战果。遗憾的是，我们没有更多像您这样的人，将军阁下。

src: Excellent! Now Serbia is cut off from the rest of the world, and in a few weeks they will have no other option but surrender. Congratulations!
dst: 出色！现在塞尔维亚已与外界隔绝，几周之内他们将别无选择，只能投降。祝贺您！

src: Excellent! The Bolshevik armies are cut off without hope of relief and communication between Moscow and Leningrad has been severed.
dst: 太好了！布尔什维克各集团军已被切断，救援无望，莫斯科与列宁格勒之间的联系也已被切断。

src: Excellent! The important transportation hub of Harpers Ferry is in our hands! Washington is now cut of from vital supplies from the northwest. Your great victory serves as a pivotal moment in our war against the USA! Congratulations, Herr Feldmarschall!
dst: 太棒了！重要的交通枢纽哈珀斯费里已在我们手中！华盛顿如今被切断了来自西北的关键补给。您的伟大胜利是我们对美战争的关键时刻！祝贺您，元帅阁下！

src: Excellent! The renmants of the Serbian Army are fleeing to Kosovo, where they'll try to resist until reinforcements come. Now you'll have to chase them and destroy them there.
dst: 出色！塞尔维亚军队的残部正向科索沃逃窜，他们将在那里试图抵抗，直到援军到来。现在您必须追击他们，并在那里将其消灭。

src: Excellent! With actions like this, the Germans will have to learn to respect us. Sadly, we must cancel the operation. Our allies have informed us that Joffre has ordered a general retreat. We won't receive any help fom them in the near future, so it's absurd to keep on taking risks. It's time to disengage and to go back behind the ring of fortifications surrounding Antwerp.
dst: 好极了！有了这样的行动，德国人就不得不学会尊重我们。遗憾的是，我们必须取消这次行动。我们的盟友已通知我们，霞飞下令全面撤退。近期我们不会得到他们的任何帮助，所以继续冒险是荒谬的。是时候脱离接触，撤回安特卫普周围的堡垒环后方了。

src: Excellent! You have completely routed the Entente forces in Macedonia. Now we must advance to Solun before they have time to recover. This will be our only chance to have a peace with honor.
dst: 太棒了！您已彻底击溃了马其顿的协约国军队。现在我们必须趁他们喘息之前向萨洛尼卡推进。这将是我们赢得体面和平的唯一机会。

src: Excellent! You have rendered the Bulgarian 3rd Army nearly useless. However, the center of our line and our left flank haven't been so successful. We'll have to retreat to the safety of the Çatalca line, but at least we'll make it orderly and with low casualties. The Bulgarians won't dare to chase us for some time.
dst: 太棒了！您已使保加利亚第三集团军几乎丧失了战斗力。然而，我军战线的中央和左翼就没有那么成功了。我们将不得不撤退到恰塔尔贾防线的安全地带，但至少撤退会井然有序、伤亡不大。保加利亚人有一段时间不敢追击我们。

src: Excellent! You've overcome all odds, and now the Serbians are fleeing to Belgrad. Their capital will fall pretty soon.
dst: 干得漂亮！您克服了重重困难，如今塞尔维亚人正向贝尔格莱德溃逃。他们的首都很快就会陷落。

src: Excellent!! you've captured the oil reserves found in Tebessa!
dst: 好极了！！您夺取了泰贝萨发现的石油储量！

src: Excellent!!!. Again a horrible massacre, but we have won the battle, anyway we expect another assault soon. Your services have been requested from Tokyo...
dst: 太棒了！！！又是一场惨烈的屠杀，但无论如何我们赢得了这场战斗，我们预计敌人很快会再次发起进攻。东京方面已要求调用您的部队……

src: Excellent!, thanks to your determination, the Burma front remains in a stable condition.
dst: 好极了！多亏您的坚定决心，缅甸战线仍保持着稳定的态势。

src: Excellent!, thanks to your determination, the Burma front remains in a stable situation.
dst: 好极了！多亏您的坚定决心，缅甸战线仍保持着稳定的局面。

src: Excellent!, the Gulf of Bengala is safe now thanks to us holding all those airstrips on Akyab.
dst: 好极了！多亏我们守住了阿恰布的所有机场，孟加拉湾如今已安全了。

src: Excellent!, we have defeated the Americans!. They couldn't afford the bloodbath they have suffered in the battle. Now, we can negotiate a good peace treaty for us. Congratulations for your work!.
dst: 太棒了，我们打败了美国人！他们承受不起在这场战斗中遭受的血腥屠杀。现在，我们可以为我们谈成一项有利的和平条约了。祝贺您的工作！

src: Excellent, Comrade. You have shown that it is a mistake to think the Red Army is an easy prey! You are ordered to dig in, because the situation on other sections of the front causes us to send all reinforcements elsewhere.
dst: 太棒了，同志。你已证明，认为红军是易于捕食的猎物是个错误！你奉命就地固守，因为前线其他地段的局势要求我们抽调所有增援前往别处。

src: Excellent, General! Our brave men overran the Turkish lines, stormed the hills and finally took the summits in desperate hand-to-hand combat. But casualties have been heavy, and the Turks have delayed our advance long enough to bring strong reinforcements to the Sair Bair mountains.
dst: 出色，将军！我们英勇的将士冲垮了土耳其人的防线，猛攻各座山丘，最终在殊死的白刃战中夺取了山顶。但伤亡惨重，而且土耳其人拖延我们的推进够久，得以向萨里拜尔山脉调来强大的增援。

src: Excellent, General! The partisans have been destroyed. Thanks to your help, the vital railway junction at Kovel is safe and Axis supply lines are secured.
dst: 干得漂亮，将军！游击队已被消灭。多亏你的帮助，科韦利这个至关重要的铁路枢纽安然无恙，轴心国的补给线得以保障。

src: Excellent, General! You have shown what grim determination is able to achieve. We have made substantial territorial gains.
dst: 出色，将军！您展现了坚定的决心所能成就的事业。我们取得了可观的领土进展。

src: Excellent, General! Your assault on Hill 60 has been a stunning success. Unfortunately, it's strategic significance is rather limited. But at least it has been a boost of morale for our troops after all those letdowns.
dst: 出色，将军！您对60高地的进攻取得了惊人的成功。可惜其战略意义相当有限。但在经历了那么多挫折之后，它至少提振了我军的士气。

src: Excellent, General! Your troops shattered the Turkish lines. Unfortunately, we had to stop our offensive after the appearance of two new Turkish divisions. Now we have to dig in.
dst: 太出色了，将军！您的部队粉碎了土耳其防线。遗憾的是，在两支新的土耳其师出现后，我们不得不停止进攻。现在我们必须转入掘壕固守。

src: Excellent, General. You have wiped out the rebel "kabilas" (local tribes) that menaced Melilla and many civilian lives have been saved.  The Spanish flag is waving on the top of Mount Gurugú and soon we'll be able to expand our area of influence in the region.  Even His Majesty King Alfonso XIII has sent you his congratulations!
dst: 出色，将军。您消灭了威胁梅利利亚的叛乱「卡比拉」（当地部族），许多平民的生命得以挽救。西班牙国旗正在古鲁古山顶飘扬，很快我们就能扩大在该地区的影响范围。就连国王阿方索十三世陛下也向您发来了祝贺！

src: Excellent, Herr General! The Bolshevik armies are cut off without hope of relief. And, even now, communication between Moscow and Leningrad has been severed. Leningrad should now fall easily; Moscow will be more problematic.
dst: 出色，将军阁下！布尔什维克的集团军已被切断，毫无获救希望。而且即便现在，莫斯科与列宁格勒之间的通信也已被切断。列宁格勒现在应当容易攻下；莫斯科则会麻烦得多。

src: Excellent, Herr General! The Soviet armies were defeated in a tremendous struggle, and the last major obstacle in the Crimea has been removed.
dst: 干得漂亮，将军阁下！苏军各集团军在一场惊天动地的搏斗中被击败，克里米亚的最后一道主要障碍已被清除。

src: Excellent, Major Bauernschmitt! Serbia will fall completely in a matter of days. It's time to leave the front line and take a well deserved rest.
dst: 出色，鲍恩施密特少校！塞尔维亚将在几天之内彻底陷落。是时候离开前线，好好休息一下了。

src: Excellent, althougth the mission was really hard, your warriors have succeeded. The Allies will take a while to reorganize their lines again.
dst: 好极了，尽管任务确实艰巨，您的将士们仍取得了成功。盟军要花上一段时间才能重新组织起他们的防线。

src: Excellent, comrade, excellent! You cannot imagine how happy our glorious leader is with this victory. Finally we have broken through and have liberated Novorossiysk! The enemy is retreating towards the Taman peninsula, and will either make a stand there or get ready to be evactuated to the Crimea. Follow the fascists, let nothing stop you!
dst: 干得漂亮，同志，漂亮！你无法想象我们伟大领袖对这场胜利有多高兴。我们终于突破并解放了新罗西斯克！敌军正朝塔曼半岛撤退，他们要么在那里顽抗，要么准备撤往克里米亚。追击法西斯，别让任何东西阻挡你！

src: Excellent, comrade. The fascist advance on Suchumi has been stopped. It seems the front, from the Don and Stalingrad in the north, to the Caucasus mountains is turning into a stalemate all along the front.
dst: 干得漂亮，同志。法西斯向苏呼米的推进已被遏止。看来，从北面的顿河与斯大林格勒，到高加索山脉，整条战线正在全线陷入僵持。

src: Excellent, comrade. There were serious fights happening in the streets of Bucharest until you arrived and restored law and order. Proletarian law and order! The fascists are almost as good as driven out of Rumania and now the Rumanian Army is fighting alongside us against the Germans and Hungarians.
dst: 干得漂亮，同志。布加勒斯特的街头曾发生激烈战斗，直到你赶到并恢复了法律与秩序。无产阶级的法律与秩序！法西斯几乎已被赶出罗马尼亚，如今罗马尼亚军队正与我们并肩作战，打击德国人和匈牙利人。

src: Excellent, comrade. We have most of the Perekop peninsula back under control. However it seems the fascists are assembling new forces to storm our lines again.
dst: 干得漂亮，同志。我们已夺回了佩列科普半岛的大部分。然而，看来法西斯正在集结新的力量，准备再次冲击我们的防线。

src: Excellent, comrade. You have stopped the Rumanian fascists! Furious fights have shown the tenacity of the Red Army in war! However the bridgehead cannot be held. As you have noticed the enemy is close to cutting us off from the rear. You have orders to pull back to our side of the Prut River and await new orders.
dst: 干得漂亮，同志。你挡住了罗马尼亚法西斯！激烈的战斗展示了红军在战争中的坚韧！然而桥头堡守不住了。正如你所注意到的，敌人已逼近要切断我们的后路。你奉命撤回我方一侧的普鲁特河，等待新命令。

src: Excellent, sir.  Jerry sure made a bit of a ruckus in this sector, but we soon put a stop to that - thanks to your magnificent generalship, of course.  The commander of the U.S. 2nd Armoured Division sends his gratitude for your help, in the form of the largest collection of Charlie Chaplin films ever gathered.  Its all piled up outside your HQ.  Shall I use petrol to make it burn quicker, sir?
dst: 太棒了，长官。德国佬确实在这一地段闹腾了一阵，但我们很快就让他们消停了——当然，全靠你卓越的统兵才能。美军第2装甲师的指挥官为表谢意，送来了有史以来最全的查理·卓别林影片合集。全堆在你的指挥部外面了。要我浇上汽油让它烧得更快些吗，长官？

src: Excellent, you've captured the oil reserves found in Tebessa.
dst: 好极了，你已夺取泰贝萨的石油储备。

src: Excellent. The Bolshevik armies are cut off without hope of relief.  And, even now,  communication between Moscow and Leningrad has been severed.  Leningrad should now fall easily; Moscow will be more problematic.
dst: 出色。布尔什维克军队已被切断，毫无解围希望。而且，即便此刻，莫斯科与列宁格勒之间的交通已被切断。列宁格勒如今应可轻易拿下；莫斯科会更棘手些。

src: Excellent. The Bolshevik armies are cut off without hope of relief. And, even now, communication between Moscow and Leningrad has been severed. Leningrad should now fall easily.
dst: 干得漂亮。布尔什维克的军队已被切断，解围无望。而且，即便在此刻，莫斯科与列宁格勒之间的联系也已被切断。列宁格勒现在应当能轻易拿下。

src: Excuse me, General.  I was talking with the commander from our garrison in Shouzhou.  He was calling for help.  By the looks of it, the communist Chinese guerrillas have begun a coordinated offensive in the North of China.  It is against some important industrial centers, communication lines, and of course, against the coal mines present on this sector.  Your mission is to advance to Shouzhou and save the garrison.  Unfortunately, the garrison at Datong, an important crossroads and railroad center in the North, has lost control of that town.  It is now being controlled by the guerrillas.  Retake Datong and you will be able to use the train to deploy more troops.  Then clear the area of enemy guerrillas.  The intelligence reports indicate that the enemy troops are mainly the units from the communist ''8th Route Army'', from Mao and his boys.
dst: 失礼了，将军。我刚才在和我们朔州守备队的指挥官通话。他在求援。看来中国共产党游击队已在中国北方发起一场协同攻势。其目标是一些重要的工业中心、交通线，当然还有本地区的煤矿。您的任务是向朔州推进，救出守备队。遗憾的是，北方一处重要交通枢纽和铁路中心大同的守备队已失去对该城的控制。该城现由游击队控制。夺回大同，您就能利用铁路投送更多部队。然后肃清该地区的敌军游击队。情报报告显示，敌军部队主要是来自毛及其部下的中国共产党"八路军"。

src: Exit 8 units at one of the three red retreat hexes along the Eastern map edge..
dst: 让8支部队从地图东缘三个红色撤退格中的任一处退出..

src: Exit a total of five units through any of the exit hexes on the North of the map.
dst: 让总共五个单位从地图北部的任一撤离格撤离。

src: Expect lots of medium and heavy armour, and be mindful of enemy planes.
dst: 预计会遇到大量中型和重型装甲，并提防敌机。

src: Expect most 2,3 & 4 engined bombers and forts to blow hexes when destroyed so be careful.
dst: 要当心，大多数双发、三发和四发轰炸机以及要塞被摧毁时都会炸毁所在格。

src: Expect mostly static stronghold positions and mines .
dst: 预计敌军多为静态据点与地雷。

src: Expect multiple Squadrons and multiple US and British battalions as reinforcements.
dst: 预计将有多个中队以及多个美英营作为增援。

src: Expect no reinforcements except for the 2/509 Parachute Infantry Bn that is flown in from the UK in turn 2. The French Oran Division is in charge of the defense of the area.
dst: 除第509伞降步兵团第2营于第2回合从英国空运而来外，预计无其他增援。该地区的防御由法军奥兰师负责。

src: Expect no reinforcements. Three units can be deployed West of Sened. The rest at the Supply Hex.
dst: 预计无增援。三个单位可部署在塞内德以西，其余部署在补给点。

src: Expect no reinforcements. Three units can be deployed close to the front line. The rest at the Supply Hex further behind the front.
dst: 预计无增援。三个单位可部署在战线附近，其余部署在战线后方较远处的补给点。

src: Expect some air unit reinforcements if the weather clears. Three units can be deployed close to the front line. The rest at the Supply Hex further behind the front.
dst: 若天气转好，预计会有一些空中单位增援。三个单位可部署在战线附近，其余部署在战线后方较远处的补给点。

src: Expect strong and entrenched enemy positions.
dst: 预计敌军阵地坚固且纵深设防。

src: Expect strong and entrenched enemy positions. There are reports of Soviet reinforcements trying to land North-East of Odessa, on the coast.
dst: 预计敌军阵地坚固且纵深设防。有报告称苏军正试图在敖德萨东北海岸登陆增援。

src: Expect strong coastal artillery and many anti-aircraft batteries on both sides of the Messina Strait.
dst: 预料墨西拿海峡两岸将有强大的海岸炮和众多高射炮连。

src: Expect strong opposition along the railway .
dst: 预计铁路沿线敌军抵抗强烈。

src: Expect the enemy forces to be heavily entrenched. Allied reinforcements will arrive in the North-East.
dst: 预计敌军深沟高垒。盟军增援将从东北方向抵达。

src: Expect the main Soviet attack to be dirrected towards Krymsk. There are reports of very strong enemy air presence.
dst: 预计苏军主攻将指向克雷姆斯卡亚。有报告称敌军空中力量极为强大。

src: Expect very strong Soviet forces attacking . Try using engineer type units to enhance defenses with mines and fortifications.
dst: 预计苏军将发起极为猛烈的进攻。建议使用工程兵单位，以地雷和工事加强防御。

src: Expect very strong Soviet forces attacking . Try using engineer type units to enhance defenses with mines and fortifications.  The enemy has air superiority.
dst: 预计苏军将发起极为猛烈的进攻。建议使用工程兵单位，以地雷和工事加强防御。敌军掌握制空权。

src: Experience and superior firepower soon led the french to victory. Marrakech fall into French hands again, after a few hours of battle.
dst: 经验和优势火力很快使法国人取得了胜利。经过几小时的战斗，马拉喀什再次落入法国人手中。

src: Experience the development of a modern army, as you participate in the early conflict with Japan.  As the Russian army reorganizes, you will march to war against Germany, Austria-Hungary, and Turkey in a series of yearly paths you may choose as you progress through the campaign.
dst: 在您参与早期对日冲突的过程中，体验一支现代化军队的成长。随着俄军重整，您将在一系列可按您意愿选择的年度路线中，向德国、奥匈帝国和土耳其开战。

src: Experienced Hungarian and German forces have set a defensive line between Carei and Satu Mare . Expect heavier resistance around Carei.
dst: 经验丰富的匈牙利与德国军队已在卡雷伊与萨图马雷之间布设防线。预计卡雷伊周围抵抗更为猛烈。

src: Experienced Sappers in addition are able to build a bridge immediately after entering a river Hex.
dst: 有经验的工兵还能在进入河流格之后立刻架好一座桥。

src: Expierience and superior Firepower led the french to Victory soon. Marrakesh fall into french hands again, after a few hours after the battle.
dst: 经验和优势火力很快为法国人带来了胜利。战斗结束后数小时，马拉喀什再次落入法国人之手。

src: Extensive reconnaisance has shown a lot of Belgian activity along the Mechelen-Dendermonde railroad. Our spies near the Belgian coast have reported that more and more English troops are entering Belgium. These and other signs indicate that the Belgians and the English are plugging the gap between Antwerp and the North of France. We expect that the Belgium Army will conduct another sortie from Antwerp to support these plans.
dst: 大规模侦察显示，梅赫伦-登德尔蒙德铁路沿线有大量比利时人活动。我方在比利时海岸附近的间谍报告称，越来越多的英军正进入比利时。这些以及其他迹象表明，比利时人和英国人正在堵住安特卫普与法国北部之间的缺口。我们预计比利时陆军将再次从安特卫普出击，以配合这些计划。

In America there had never been nothing like it. And from all over America thousands of common housewives who that morning had kissed their Husbands goodbye as the Men went off to work in the Armament factories and then sent the Kids off to school went into Their bedrooms. Moments later reappearing dressed in Black,BdM Armband and a 'Deathheads cap'.American Women had been kept in the Home,the Bedroom,Kitchen and out of the Factories.The Fuhress offered them more than Enslavement to the Male Race,a Place of standing,to give an input in the World situation,not just a piece of 'Eye-Candy'. dst: 罗斯福在国会面前向全国发表讲话。美国在中途岛失利，罗斯福正在找借口，同时指出很快将有14艘战列舰下水。就在罗斯福向全国讲话时，霍顿姐妹的‘Batt 从古巴和墨西哥升空。它们将沿东海岸、西海岸以及墨西哥湾发动攻击。‘Batt 的毁灭区域包括炼油厂、船厂、机场、军火生产设施，以及包括洛杉矶和纽约在内的主要城市。美国从未经历过这样的事。而从全美各地，成千上万的普通家庭主妇——那天早上她们吻别了去军工厂上班的丈夫、送孩子去了学校——走进了自己的卧室。片刻后，她们重新出现，身着黑衣，佩戴 BdM 袖标和“骷髅”帽徽。美国女性一直被关在家里、卧室里、厨房里，被排除在工厂之外。女元首给了她们比“被男性种族奴役”更多的东西：一个地位，一个参与世界事务的发言权，而不只是一件“花瓶”。配合航空军的攻击，这些破坏行动已足够。政府和军方无法控制这铺天盖地的混乱。党卫军和日本地面部队随后发起进攻；4个月后的今天，“欧洲的问题”已经到了芝加哥城外——“权力中心”。而‘Batt 仍在四处巡弋。

src: Fabulous work by your XIX corps Herr General, now push on to your new objectives.
dst: 你的第19军干得非常出色，将军阁下，现在向你的新目标推进。

src: Fabulous work by your XIX corps Herr General, you are now ordered to cross East Prussia and form up for our attack south-east.
dst: 你的第19军干得非常出色，将军阁下，现在你奉命穿过东普鲁士集结，准备向东南发起进攻。

src: Fabulous!   Your lightning strike on the other side of the river has avoided any quick soviet counterattack.  Now the hills and other strategic locations are in our hands.  Maybe in the future Vladivostok could be the next target in this area.  Congratulations for your promotion to General of the Imperial Army!
dst: 太出色了！您对河对岸的闪电突击使苏联人来不及迅速发起反击。如今各高地及其他战略要点都在我们手中。也许今后这一地区的下一个目标就是符拉迪沃斯托克。祝贺您晋升为帝国陆军将军！

src: Facing arrest and military tribunal, you have been removed from command and arrested.  Your failure at Przemysl cost Russia dearly:  the utter collapse of the South-Western Front precipitated a panic-stricken rout of entire armies across Galicia.
dst: 面临逮捕和军事法庭审判，您已被解职并逮捕。您在普热梅希尔的失败使俄国付出了沉重代价：西南方面军的彻底崩溃，引发了整个集团军群惊慌失措地溃退，横穿加利西亚。

src: Faid stays in French hands and offers the French XIX Corps and US II Corps and excellent starting point to attack East, reach the sea and split Axis troops in Africa. Panzer Armee Afrika cannot keep up the fight without supplies. This is the end of Mussolini's Afrika Corps!
dst: 法伊德仍留在法国人手中，为法国第19军和美军第2军提供了向东进攻、打到海边并分割非洲轴心国部队的绝佳出发阵地。没有补给，非洲装甲集团军无法继续作战。墨索里尼的非洲军到此为止了！

src: Failure! French batteries and ground troops took a heavy toll on the invasion force. Whatever is left of it, is brought back on board the ships. Your services are no longer required.
dst: 失败！法军炮台与地面部队给登陆部队造成重大伤亡。残部被撤回舰上。你的服务不再需要了。

src: Failure! Most of the tanks of the 5th Pz.Rgt. were able to make it back to our lines, but many soldiers of the 8th Mg.Btn. have been captured.
dst: 失败！第5装甲团的大部分坦克得以撤回我方战线，但第8机枪营的许多士兵被俘。

src: Failure! Vimy Ridge is in enemy hands.
dst: 失败了！维米岭已落入敌手。

src: Failure! You did not succeed in dealing a serious blow the British forces.
dst: 失败了！您未能给英军以沉重打击。

src: Failure! You did not succeed in keeping all the German divisions engaged. Let alone take the Reinhard line and push the Germans back to the Gustav line.
dst: 失败！你未能牵制住全部德军师，更遑论夺取莱因哈德防线并将德军逐回古斯塔夫防线。

src: Failure! You were unable to push back the Belgian 1st Cavalry Division. Enemy artillery fire is forcing us to move back to Halen and wait for the 1st Armee infantry divisions - tied up at Liege - to arrive at the front to resume the offensive.
dst: 失败！您未能击退比利时第1骑兵师。敌军炮火迫使我们退回哈伦，等待被牵制在列日的第1集团军步兵师抵达前线，以恢复攻势。

dst: 伞兵装甲掷弹兵第2师“赫尔曼·戈林”带着其3个装备88炮的营，正在推进中的近卫第5坦克集团军的必经之路上占据阵地。你的部队就是那把铁锤，将在反坦克炮屏这道铁砧上把近卫第5坦克集团军的坦克砸碎。

src: Fantastic Commander you have not let us down!!! Promotion is surely headed your way!
dst: 出色的指挥官，您没有让我们失望！！！晋升肯定离您不远了！

src: Fantastic breakthrough Commander!!! You were lucky that the Germans were relieving their seasoned troops in this sector and you faced fresh reserves!! After beating off a determined counterattack the inititive is with us now!
dst: 精彩的突破，指挥官！！！您很走运，德国人正在这一地段轮换他们的久经沙场的老兵，而您面对的是新预备队！！在击退一次坚决的反攻后，主动权现在掌握在我们手中！

src: Fantastic breakthrough Commander!!! You were lucky that the Germans were relieving their seasoned troops in this sector and you faced fresh reserves!! The inititive is with us now!
dst: 惊人的突破，指挥官！！！您很幸运，德国人正在这一地段轮换其久经沙场的部队，而您面对的是新来的预备队！！主动权现在在我们手里了！

src: Fantastic work, sir.  In spite of an initial wobble when the Germans launched a co-ordinated counter-attack, we were able to hold our beachhead thanks to determined and steadfast  British courage.  The Germans have now halted their attacks and are adopting a defensive posture.  While the rest of X Corps breaks out to the north, your men will rest and recuperate after a testing battle.
dst: 干得精彩绝伦，长官。尽管德军发起协同反攻时我们起初有些动摇，但凭着英国人坚定不屈的勇气，我们守住了滩头。德军现已停止进攻，转入防守态势。趁第10军其余部队向北突破之际，你的部队将在这场艰苦战斗之后休整恢复。

src: Fantastic work, sir.  The Jerries have been thoroughly and comprehensively trounced - that's what Montogomery told Eisenhower when he lied to him this afternoon.  We have achieved some measure of success though, Caen has been taken, along with Bourgebus ridge, and now with the U.S. breakout to the west, a chance for encirclement looks enticing.  You, sir, have been afforded a few days rest.
dst: 干得精彩绝伦，长官。德国佬已被彻底而全面地痛揍——那是蒙哥马利今天下午对艾森豪威尔撒谎时说的话。不过我们确实取得了某种程度的成功：卡昂连同布尔格比斯山脊都已拿下，如今随着美军在西面突破，一个合围的机会正显得诱人。您，长官，获准休整几天。

src: Fantastic!  The Australians have been defeated, and now, our Co-prosperity Sphere will cover all the islands of the South Pacific!  Oh, excuse me.  This is my friend, Kenosuke Sato, the new governor of Australia.  I know he is the ruler the Australians need... [malefic laugh again]
dst: 太棒了！澳大利亚人已被打败，如今我们的大东亚共荣圈将覆盖整个南太平洋的岛屿！哦，失礼了。这位是我的朋友佐藤健之助，新任澳大利亚总督。我知道他正是澳大利亚人所需要的统治者……[再次发出恶毒的笑声]

src: Fantastic! But there is no time to waste. As soon as you've resupplied, you must resume your march to the south, before the Italians can regroup.
dst: 太棒了！但没时间可浪费了。一旦补充完毕，您必须立即继续向南挺进，赶在意大利人重新集结之前。

src: Fantastic! The British have left Palestine and have retreated into the Sinai. You should be proud of yourself.
dst: 太棒了！英国人已经离开巴勒斯坦，退入了西奈半岛。您应当为自己感到自豪。

src: Fantastico!, los rebeldes se baten en retirada, nuestro ataque por sorpresa cruzando el Ebro ha sido todo un exito gracias a su pericia. Ahora todo el sector de Levante que los fascistas habian alcanzado esta comprometido y deberan retirarse de ahi si no quieren verse rodeados. Esta victoria elevara la moral de toda la zona leal al gobierno.
dst: 太棒了！叛军正在溃退，多亏您的指挥才能，我军强渡埃布罗河的突袭大获成功。如今法西斯分子所到达的整个莱万特地区都岌岌可危，他们若不想被包围，就必须从那里撤退。这场胜利将鼓舞所有效忠政府地区的士气。

dst: 不必害怕，因为胜利将属于我们。不必害怕，因为上帝站在我们这一边。不必害怕，因为我们已变得不可战胜。我的孩子们，我的兄弟们，你们准备好迎接这场雪崩了吗？

src: Fearful of the imminent arrival of Prussian reinforcements, the Austrians and Saxons left the battlefield as soon as they received new orders from Benedek, telling them to join the Nord Armee in the east. Finally, all the Austrian forces in Bohemia gathered near Königgrätz, where the decisive battle would take place.
dst: 由于担心普鲁士援军即将到来，奥地利人和萨克森人一接到贝内德克的新命令——命令他们去东面与北方军团会合——便离开了战场。最终，波希米亚境内的所有奥地利军队都集结在柯尼希格雷茨附近，决定性的战役即将在那里打响。

src: Feldmarschall Schorner has an immense number of units under his command and he's willing to drown the city in blood. A 2nd SS Panzer Division is coming from the north and these are experienced and well-equipped men, although their morale is a bit shaken. A 44th SS Panzer-Grenadier Division is closing form the south, they are moving through the Zbraslav and Radotin valleys of rivers Vltava and Berounka. In the east there are some smaller Kampfgruppen made of the SS PzJager school and the remnants of the 1st Flak Korps. Prague's garrison is very strong, of course. Finally there are some smaller enemy units that move towards the city.
dst: 舍尔纳元帅麾下有数量庞大的部队，他决意血洗这座城市。党卫军第2装甲师正从北面开来，这些都是经验丰富、装备精良的老兵，尽管士气略有动摇。党卫军第44装甲掷弹兵师正从南面逼近，他们正沿伏尔塔瓦河与贝龙卡河的兹布拉斯拉夫谷和拉多廷谷行进。东面还有一些较小的战斗群，由党卫军装甲歼击学校和第1高炮军的残部组成。当然，布拉格的守军非常强大。最后还有一些较小的敌军部队正向该城移动。

src: Felicidades por su ascenso general!, tras el rotundo exito en la ofensiva del Ebro el enemigo se ha visto obligado a retirarse de las zonas contiguas al Mediterraneo que habia ocupado, sumado a nuestra victoria, los franceses han levantado el cierre de la frontera y las armas sovieticas que esperabamos han logrado pasar la frontera. Gracias a todo esto, es la hora de explotar nuestro exito!, ademas los aliados de los rebeldes estan perdiendo la paciencia con ellos.
dst: 祝贺您晋升，将军！在埃布罗攻势取得决定性胜利之后，敌人被迫从其所占领的地中海沿岸地区撤退；加上我们的胜利，法国人已经解除了边境封锁，我们期盼的苏联武器也成功越过了边境。多亏这一切，现在是扩大我们战果的时候了！此外，叛军的盟友们正渐渐对他们失去耐心。

src: Felicidades!, after a really long battle, the Ebro pocket is finally cleared!. El Generalisimo is really pleased with your work. The war is decided with the final overcome of this battle!.
dst: 恭喜！经过一场十分漫长的战役，埃布罗河包围圈终于被肃清了！最高统帅对您的工作十分满意。这场战役的最终胜利已决定了战争的走向！

src: Felicidades!, despues de una larga y sangrientisima batalla, la bolsa del Ebro ha sido finalmente aplastada. El Generalisimo esta realmente contento con sus acciones. Posiblemente la guerra se ha decidido con el resultado final de esta batalla.
dst: 恭喜！经过一场漫长而血腥的战役，埃布罗河包围圈终于被粉碎了。最高统帅对您的行动十分满意。这场战役的最终结果很可能已决定了战争的走向。

src: Felicidades!, el Alcazar ha sido liberado, y sus defensores son ahora libres. Debe usted continuar con su marcha hacia Madrid.
dst: 恭喜！托莱多城堡已经解放，它的守军如今自由了。您必须继续向马德里进军。

src: Felicidades!, ha demostrado usted ser un buen mando para el Ejercito Popular. La ofensiva rebelde en el valle del Jarama se ha detenido por el momento y hemos conseguido demostrarles a los rebeldes que nuestras fuerzas deben ser tenidas en cuenta.
dst: 恭喜！您已证明自己是一位出色的共和军指挥官。叛军在哈拉马谷地的攻势目前已被阻止，我们已成功让叛军明白，我们的力量不容小觑。

src: Felicidades!, los republicanos huyen despaboridos! y Teruel ha regresado a nuestras manos.
dst: 恭喜！共和军惊慌逃窜！特鲁埃尔已重新回到我们手中。

src: Felicidades!, the Alcazar has been liberated, and it's defenders are now free. You must continue with the march on to Madrid.
dst: 恭喜！托莱多城堡已经解放，它的守军如今自由了。您必须继续向马德里进军。

src: Felicidades!, the Republican bridgehead has been destroyed. Barcelona is now in sight, and nobody can stop us now in our way to the Catalonian capital...
dst: 恭喜！共和军的桥头堡已被摧毁。巴塞罗那现已进入视野，再也没有人能阻挡我们前往加泰罗尼亚首府的道路……

src: Felicidades!, the Republicans are on their feets to escape from us, and Teruel has back into our hands.
dst: 恭喜！共和军仓皇逃离我们，特鲁埃尔已重新回到我们手中。

src: Fiat Aeronautics plant in Turin goes on strike. This is the first strike since Mussolini entered office in 1922. Mussolini calls on our Fascists troops to stop the strike, but they refuse to make the workers stop protesting. Other strikes erupt, grounding our war making capabilities.
dst: 都灵的菲亚特航空工厂罢工。这是墨索里尼1922年上台以来的第一次罢工。墨索里尼要求我们的法西斯部队制止罢工，但他们拒绝强迫工人停止抗议。其他罢工相继爆发，使我们的战争生产能力陷于停顿。

src: Fictional German campaign starting 1940 with the invasion of Great Britain and Ireland. Securing the Mediterranean and the oil fields in the Middle East and the struggle up to beyond the Ural Mountains and the Atlantic Ocean!
dst: 虚构的德国战役，始于1940年入侵大不列颠和爱尔兰。确保地中海和中东油田的安全，并一路征战，越过乌拉尔山脉和大西洋！

src: Fielding an armed forces composed mainly of volunteers, the Canadians went on to prove that for the defeat of the Axis powers, no price was too high...
dst: 加拿大以一支主要由志愿兵组成的武装力量出征，进而证明：为了击败轴心国，任何代价都不算太高……

src: Fifth Guards Tank Army has broken through! Eastern Prussia is cut off from the fatherland. The Eastern front lies in shambles. Your services are no longer required.
dst: 近卫第5坦克集团军突破了！东普鲁士与本土被切断。东线已是一片狼藉。不再需要你效力了。

src: Fifth Guards Tank Army yet again is crippled from the blow your troops have dealth. Central Poland is secure. But there is more work to be done South of here.
dst: 近卫第5坦克集团军再度被你部的打击重创。波兰中部已确保安全。但在此以南还有更多活儿要干。
战斗轰炸水上飞机 (未使用)

src: Fighters of the land, the sea and the air, Blackshirts of the revolution and of the legions, men and women of Italy, of the Empire and of the Kingdom of Albania, listen! An hour marked by destiny is ringing in the sky of our country; the hour of irrevocable decisions.
dst: 陆海空的战士们，革命与军团的黑衫军们，意大利、帝国以及阿尔巴尼亚王国的男女同胞们，听着！一个被命运标记的时刻正在我们祖国的天空敲响；这是做出不可更改的决定的时刻。

dst: 局势严重到什么程度，您看——佛朗哥将军已经把纳瓦拉旅从北方战线调了过来。

src: Filipino surrounding troops initially amounted to 800 men but these increased during the siege, including some captured artillery. After some failed attempts to take the position, Filipinos opted to surround the church with trenches. Filipinos also suffered serious casualties.
dst: 菲律宾围城部队起初有800人，但围困期间不断增加，还包括一些缴获的火炮。在几次攻占尝试失败后，菲律宾人选择用战壕包围教堂。菲律宾人也伤亡惨重。
