src: Final attack on Moscow. The Winter war in Soviet union is very hard
dst: 对莫斯科的最后一击。苏联境内的冬季作战异常艰难。

src: Finally Caesar wins and proclaims himself "Dictator for life", de facto the first Emperor. For sincere Roman Republicans unacceptable - his end is known.
dst: 最终凯撒获胜，并自封「终身独裁官」——事实上成了第一位皇帝。对真诚的罗马共和派而言，这是无法接受的——他的结局众所周知。

src: Finally the British pressure was too intense for the German army.  They retreated from the area of Kilwa and Lindi into the upper Lukuledi and the road between Liwale and Masasi. Von Lettow's last hope was to escape from the British and invade Portuguese East Africa.  He hoped to fine the much needed supplies for his men.
dst: 最终，英军的压力对德军来说过于强大。他们从基尔瓦和林迪地区撤退到卢库莱迪河上游以及利瓦莱与马萨西之间的道路上。冯·莱托最后的希望是摆脱英军，入侵葡属东非。他希望为他的士兵们找到急需的补给。

src: Finally the day has arrived, the start of Operation Fall Weiss our conquest of Poland.
dst: 这一天终于到了——“白色方案”行动开始，我们对波兰的征服就此展开。

src: Finally we have entered in Xauen, the town that the Berbers thought would never be conquered! El Raisuli has fled to Tazarut, on the last mountanious region that he still holds. He can't recieve reinforcements or supplies, so he won't be able to resist there for a long time. His only option is surrender and accept the rule of the Sultan of Morocco and the Spanish Protectorate. Sooner or later he'll realise that.
dst: 我们终于进入了舍夫沙万，这座柏柏尔人以为永远不会被攻克的城镇！赖苏利已逃往塔扎鲁特，那是他仍掌控的最后一片山区。他得不到增援或补给，因此在那里撑不了多久。他唯一的选择就是投降，接受摩洛哥苏丹和西班牙保护国的统治。他迟早会明白这一点。

src: Finally we have reached Lillehammer, this point of Norway is crucial, it's in the middle of Norway, and by conquest it we could make a great step to finnish fast with the norvegian resistance. Our troops are in troubles in Lillehammer, the allies and the norvegians are stoping they for the momment... Good Luck.
dst: 我们终于抵达了利勒哈默尔，挪威的这一地点至关重要，它位于挪威中部，征服它之后我们就能向迅速结束挪威人的抵抗迈出一大步。我们的部队在利勒哈默尔陷入困境，盟军和挪威人目前正在阻止他们……祝您好运。

src: Finally you were able to embark the remnants of your troops during the night... I hope that your warriors have not suffered too much. The japanese navy High Command wants you to defend the island of Guam in the same way you did in Tinian.
dst: 您终于得以在夜间让您部队的残部登船……我希望您的勇士们没有遭受太多苦难。日本海军最高统帅部希望您以在提尼安岛同样的方式保卫关岛。

src: Finally, a huge offensive was prepared in March 1912. If all went well, el Mizzian´s defeat would be definitive.
dst: 最终，1912年3月筹划了一场大规模攻势。如果一切顺利，米齐安的失败将是决定性的。

src: Finally, after a really touh attle, Lang Son has fallen. However, the Chinese army has retreated in order, and their troops still threaten our positions. I don'k know how long we'll be able to keep Lang Son. It doesn't really matter. One way or another, Tonkin will become a French protectorate, just like Annam, and it'll join our other territories in Indochina.
dst: 终于，在一场真正艰苦的战斗之后，谅山陷落了。然而，中国军队已有序撤退，其部队仍威胁着我们的阵地。我不知道我们还能守住谅山多久。其实这无关紧要。无论如何，东京都将成为法国保护国，就像安南一样，并将并入我们在印度支那的其他领地。

src: Finally, after so many months of endless fighting, we've expelled the Communists from the Kuban. Although I must confess that I wouldn't have been able to take Stavropol without Wrangel's timely help.
dst: 终于，经过数月无休止的战斗，我们已把共产党人赶出了库班。尽管我必须承认，若不是弗兰格尔及时相助，我本无法攻下斯塔夫罗波尔。

src: Finally, after so many months of endless fighting, we've expelled the Communists from the Kuban. The remnants of the 11th Army have escaped to the Terek, but their defeat has been so absolute that I doubt they'll recover from it. Surely they'll merge with the 12th Army, that is currently dealing with a cossack rebellion against the Reds. Soon they'll have to deal with us, too. The Terek is our next objective.
dst: 终于，经过数月无休止的战斗，我们已把共产党人赶出了库班。第11集团军的残部已逃往捷列克，但他们的失败如此彻底，我怀疑他们能否恢复元气。他们肯定将与目前正忙于镇压反红军哥萨克起义的第12集团军会合。很快，他们也将不得不应付我们。捷列克是我们的下一个目标。

src: Finally, after the complete defeat of the main British army at El Alamein, we can assault the strongly important port of Alexandria. Unfortunately, some enemy units have escaped from the El Alamein area, and now they are trying to set up defences in and around Alexandria. Air Recon reports show that the Royal Navy has come to protect the port, our Italian friends will send the Regia Marina to help us in the assault, and to face the Royal Navy.
dst: 终于，在阿拉曼彻底击败英国主力军队之后，我们可以突击极为重要的亚历山大港了。遗憾的是，一些敌军部队已从阿拉曼地区逃脱，现在他们正试图在亚历山大城内及周边构筑防御。空中侦察报告显示皇家海军已前来保护该港，我们的意大利盟友将派出皇家海军前来协助我们突击，并对抗英国皇家海军。

src: Finally, in August 1922 the Turks started a counteroffensive, with the aim of driving the Greek army out of Anatolia.
dst: 最后，1922年8月，土耳其人发动反攻，目的是把希腊军队赶出安纳托利亚。

src: Finally, in December 1894 the Italians invaded the Ethiopian region of Tigray. Putting all our past differences aside, Ras Alula, Tekle Haymanot, Ras Mengesha and myself, along with many other noblemen, assured Menelik that we would fight for his side.
dst: 最终，1894年12月，意大利人入侵了埃塞俄比亚的提格雷地区。拉斯·阿卢拉、特克莱·海马诺特、拉斯·门格沙和我，以及许多其他贵族，抛开我们过去的一切分歧，向孟尼利克保证，我们将为他的阵营而战。

src: Finally, it's time to turn the tables on the Italians. Our artillery bombardment has finished, the poison gas has gone away, and now you must storm the Italian positions between Görz and Udine. At the same time, the Germans will strike near the town of Karfreit, north of here. The High Command believes that this joint offensive will be able to break through the Italian lines. If we do it fast enough, we'll trap two enemy armies at the Isonzo.
dst: 终于，是时候向意大利人反戈一击了。我们的炮火轰击已经结束，毒气也已散去，现在您必须向戈里齐亚与乌迪内之间的意大利阵地发起猛攻。与此同时，德国人将在北面的卡波雷托镇附近发动进攻。最高统帅部认为，这次联合攻势将能够突破意大利的防线。如果我们动作足够迅速，就能在伊松佐河围困两支敌军集团军。

src: Finally, our joint chief of staff has come to the conclusion that only a major offensive will be able to break the stalemate. British reinforcements, numbering five divisions, are on their way, and it has been decided that they will be landed a few miles north of Anzac Cove, where our Australian and New Zealand brothers in arms are holding a small bridgehead.
dst: 终于，我们联军的参谋长得出结论，只有一场大规模攻势才能打破僵局。五个师的英国增援部队正在途中，并已决定让他们在澳新军团湾以北几英里处登陆，我们的澳大利亚和新西兰战友正在那里坚守着一个小小的桥头堡。

src: Finally, the British withdrew to their original lines on the night of the 16th August.  Over 4,000 troops and similar numbers of Turkish soldiers fell during the 2 days of fighting, yet no tactical or territorial gains were made whatsoever.
dst: 最终，英军于8月16日夜间撤回原防线。两天战斗中，超过4000名官兵阵亡，土耳其军也有相当数量的损失，然而双方都没有取得任何战术或领土上的进展。

src: Finally, the battle of la Malmaison (October 1917) led to the capture of the fort and the town of Malmaison and the full control of the Chemin des Dames by the French.
dst: 最终，马尔迈松之战（1917年10月）使法军攻占了马尔迈松堡和马尔迈松镇，并完全控制了贵妇小径。

src: Finally, the end of the war was near. Just five days after the taking of Le Mans, on January 17th, the French Army of the East was defeated at the Lisaine River when they were trying to relieve Belfort. Paris couldn't resist longer than a few weeks without any help from the outside. Only the Army of the North remained as an able, although small, fighting force. Despite the loss of Amiens, Péronne and other strongholds, the French units, led by General Faidherbe, were still trying to save Paris. Eager to end the war once and for all, the Prussians sent their VIII Army Corps against them. Pretty soon, they found the French army near the town of Saint Quentin.
dst: 终于，战争的结束临近了。攻克勒芒仅仅五天后，1月17日，法军东方军团在试图解救贝尔福时于利萨讷河畔被击败。没有外部的任何援助，巴黎撑不过几个星期。只有北方军团仍是一支尚有战斗力、尽管规模很小的作战力量。尽管失去了亚眠、佩罗讷和其他据点，费德尔布将军率领的法军部队仍在试图拯救巴黎。普鲁士人急于彻底结束战争，便派他们的第8军去对付他们。很快，他们就在圣康坦城附近找到了法军。

src: Finally, the time has come for the decisive offensive against Serbia. One month ago, Bulgaria joined our side, and now they are ready to fight, just like the Germans and ourselves. To make things better, the French and the British have been too slow, and their troops are still in Greece. They won't arrive in time to save their ally.
dst: 终于，对塞尔维亚发动决定性攻势的时刻到了。一个月前，保加利亚加入我方阵营，如今他们已准备好作战，正如德国人和我们自己一样。更妙的是，法国人和英国人动作太慢，他们的军队仍滞留在希腊。他们将无法及时赶到拯救自己的盟友。

src: Finally, those officers from Tokyo will be happy knowing we are going to strike the Soviets in Far East Siberia.  Your command, as well as some troops from Manchukuo, will take part in the Vladivostok operation.  The plan is to cut the Trans-Siberian Railway and any surrounding communications to isolate the port city of Vladivostok.  Then your units will drive to the South towards Vladivostok.
dst: 终于，东京的那些军官会很高兴得知我们将要在远东西伯利亚打击苏联人了。您的部队，以及一些来自满洲国的部队，将参加符拉迪沃斯托克作战。计划是切断西伯利亚大铁路及周边一切通信，以孤立港口城市符拉迪沃斯托克。随后您的部队将向南推进，直取符拉迪沃斯托克。

src: Finally, we defeated the Senussi, but the fight was much harder than expected. We have been able to relieve Sidi Barrani, but we failed to destroy the Senussi force completely. Their remnants have retreated 50 miles west, to Sollum. We are ordered to follow up and strike again, quickly...
dst: 我们终于击败了塞努西，但战斗远比预期艰难。我们得以解除西迪巴拉尼之围，却未能彻底消灭塞努西的部队。其残部已向西撤退50英里，退往塞卢姆。我们奉命跟进，迅速再次出击……

src: Finally, we have managed to break through the Russian lines. We've destroyed the Russian 3rd Army, and in the following weeks nobody will be able to stop our advance. Soon, we'll liberate Premissel, Lemberg and all of Galizien. Besides, if they want to rebuild their lines, the Russians will have to retreat from the Warschau salient, too. When the front line stabilizes, we'll be fighting inside the Russian Empire. Congratulations, General!
dst: 终于，我们成功突破了俄军防线。我们歼灭了俄国第3集团军，接下来的几周，没人能阻挡我们的推进。很快，我们将解放普热梅希尔、伦贝格以及整个加利西亚。此外，俄国人若要重建防线，还不得不从华沙突出部撤退。当战线稳定下来时，我们将在俄国境内作战。恭喜您，将军！

src: Finally, we secured our southern border. Eritrea was safe for the moment, and the Mad Mullah, unwittingly, was helping us in Somalia, blocking all the Entente columns in the desert. So I was finally free to help in Gondar.
dst: 我们终于保住了南部边境。厄立特里亚暂时安全了，而在索马里，疯狂毛拉无意中帮了我们，把所有协约国纵队都困在了沙漠里。所以我终于腾出手来援助贡德尔了。

src: Finally, we took Lesboeufs and Morval. The breakthrough was very close this time, when the Germans did a last, desperate effort, and it slipped out of our hands.
dst: 我们终于攻占了莱斯伯夫和莫瓦尔。这一次突破近在咫尺，可就在此时，德军作了一次最后的、绝望的努力，机会便从我们手中溜走了。

src: Finaly! Let's hope we don't have to enter this forest ever again. Now our next objective will be Rhine river. Good job soldier!
dst: 终于！但愿我们再也不用进入这片森林了。现在我们的下一个目标是莱茵河。干得好，士兵！

src: Find and eliminate the key partisan units.
dst: 搜寻并消灭关键的游击分队。

src: Find the way across the river and clear the area - capture as many VHs as possible - so that the bulk of our army does not lose time in the traffic jams and may use the secured passages.
dst: 找到渡河的路径并肃清该区域——尽可能多地夺取胜利格——好让主力部队不至于在交通堵塞中浪费时间，能使用这些安全的通道。

src: Fine display, General.  With the annihilation of the German Afrika Korps we can now begin the long, arduous task of liberating Europe from the tyranny of leather shorts, sausages and foul-smelling cabbage.  Oh and we'll give the pasta munchers a bloody good seeing too while we're at it.  Pip pip!
dst: 表现漂亮，将军。随着德国非洲军团的覆灭，我们现在可以开始解放欧洲这项漫长而艰巨的任务了——把欧洲从皮短裤、香肠和臭烘烘的卷心菜的暴政下解放出来。哦，顺手我们还要把那些吃意面的家伙也好好收拾一顿。再见！

src: Fine job, sir.  We've pushed the Germans back somewhat to the west of Caen, allowing Montgomery the pleasure of moving his drinks cabinet six inches closer to Berlin.  Unfortunately those German reinforcements that showed up have stalled our advance, and we need a new plan to wrest Caen from the Bosch.  I fear the words "I have a cunning plan" are rapidly marching from Montgomery's mouth with ill-deserved confidence.  Cup of tea, sir?
dst: 干得好，长官。我们已把德军向西压退到卡昂以西一段，让蒙哥马利得以乐滋滋地把他的酒柜向柏林挪近了六英寸。遗憾的是，那些出现的德军援军迟滞了我们的推进，我们需要一个新计划来从德国佬手中夺下卡昂。我担心“我有个狡猾的计划”这句话正从蒙哥马利口中以莫须有的自信鱼贯而出。来杯茶吗，长官？

src: Fine performance General.  We've secured the bridge at Primasole and the port of Catania has fallen to us - though not after a tough fight against a crack German Parachute Division.  The advance will continue on up the coast to Messina, however your unit has been withdrawn and placed in reserve for future operations.
dst: 表现不错，将军。我们已拿下普里马索莱桥，卡塔尼亚港也已落入我手——尽管这之前与一支精锐德国伞兵师打了一场硬仗。推进将继续沿海岸北上墨西拿，不过你的部队已被撤下，编入预备队以备后用。

src: Fine performance, sir.  With Syracuse in our hands we have secured an excellent supply hub for our advance to Messina.  We have also gained valuable lessons in amphibious landings which will help us plan for the return to France.
dst: 表现不错，长官。锡拉库萨既已入手，我们就为向墨西拿推进取得了一个极佳的补给枢纽。我们还从两栖登陆中汲取了宝贵经验，这将有助于我们谋划重返法国。

src: Fine showing, sir.  Despite the rather madcap nature of Montgomery's cunning plan, you still somehow managed to achieve your objectives - and in good time!  Unfortunately, due to the heavy casualties suffered by our airborne chaps, the lack of supplies and the German counter-attacks bearing down on our flanks, we have little chance of exploiting this breakthrough.  The war won't be over by Christmas it now appears.
dst: 表现不错，长官。尽管蒙哥马利那个狡猾的计划相当疯狂，你竟还是设法达成了目标——而且及时！遗憾的是，由于我空降部队伤亡惨重、补给匮乏，加之德军反攻压向两翼，我们几乎没有机会扩大这一突破。看来战争不会在圣诞节前结束了。

src: Fine work, sir.  In spite of an initial wobble when the Germans launched a co-ordinated counter-attack, we were able to hold our beachhead thanks to determined and steadfast  British courage.  The Germans have now halted their attacks and are adopting a defensive posture.  While the rest of X Corps breaks out to the north, your men will rest and recuperate after a testing battle.
dst: 干得好，长官。尽管德军发起协同反攻时我们起初有些动摇，但凭着英国人坚定不屈的勇气，我们守住了滩头。德军现已停止进攻，转入防守态势。趁第10军其余部队向北突破之际，你的部队将在这场艰苦战斗之后休整恢复。

src: Fine work, sir.  Our crossing of the Rhine has been successful, and now all that stands in our way to Berlin is a few Hitler Youth and old men.
dst: 干得好，长官。我们渡过莱茵河已告成功，如今挡在我们通往柏林之路上的，只剩几个希特勒青年团员和一些老头子了。

src: Fine work, sir.  The Jerries have been thoroughly and comprehensively trounced - that's what Montogomery told Eisenhower when he lied to him this afternoon.  We have achieved some measure of success though, Caen has been taken, along with Bourgebus ridge, and now with the U.S. breakout to the west, a chance for encirclement looks enticing.  You, sir, have been afforded a few days rest.
dst: 干得好，长官。德国佬已被彻底而全面地痛揍——那是蒙哥马利今天下午对艾森豪威尔撒谎时说的话。不过我们确实取得了某种程度的成功：卡昂连同布尔格比斯山脊都已拿下，如今随着美军在西面突破，一个合围的机会正显得诱人。您，长官，获准休整几天。

src: Fine work, sir.  We've landed and successfully consolidated our beachhead.  Now, we must move to capture Caen at the earliest possible convenience.  I'm sure Montgomery is hatching a cunning plan as we speak...
dst: 干得好，长官。我们已经登陆并成功巩固了滩头。现在，我们必须尽早夺取卡昂。我敢肯定，此刻蒙哥马利正在酝酿一个狡猾的计划……

src: Finely done, sir.  We've finally taken the city of Caen, our major objective since we landed here in Normandy.  Montgomery is delighted, and is taking all of the credit of course.  He said we'd take the city on day one, but now claims having us get bogged down was all part of his subtle plan.  I don't think he'd recognize a subtle plan if it painted itself purple and danced naked on a harpsichord singing 'subtle plans are here again' quite frankly.
dst: 干得漂亮，长官。我们终于攻下了卡昂城——自我们在诺曼底登陆以来的首要目标。蒙哥马利欣喜若狂，当然把功劳全揽了去。他曾说我们第一天就能拿下此城，如今却宣称让我们陷入胶着全是他那精妙计划的一部分。说实在的，就算一个精妙计划把自己涂成紫色、裸着身子在羽管键琴上跳舞、唱着“精妙计划又来了”，我看他也未必认得出来。

src: First of all, let them know that, no matter what you may have heard, when the Great War started Ethiopia's only wish was to remain neutral. The strife in Europe had nothing to do with us. Certainly, Lij Iyasu V had a soft spot for the Ottoman Empire and Islamic religion, but he would never have entered the war on the side of the Central Powers.
dst: 首先，请让他们知道，无论您可能听到了什么，一战爆发时埃塞俄比亚唯一的愿望就是保持中立。欧洲的纷争与我们毫无关系。诚然，利杰·伊雅苏五世对奥斯曼帝国和伊斯兰教颇有好感，但他绝不会站在同盟国一边参战。

src: First of all, we must stop the Serbian attack here, at Kalimanci, in the upper Bregalnica Valley. This is a mountain region, good for defensive operations. If you overcome the Serbians soon enough, we'll be able to send reinforcements to our 2nd Army, which is fighting against the Greek Army in the Struma Valley, and we'll defeat our enemies separately.
dst: 首先，我们必须在这里、在布雷加尔尼察河上游谷地的卡利曼齐挡住塞尔维亚人的进攻。这里是山区，适合防御作战。如果您能尽快击败塞尔维亚人，我们就能向正在斯特鲁马河谷与希腊军队作战的第2集团军派出增援，从而把敌人各个击破。

src: Five days ago I assured you that the Reds were on the verge of panic. You could see with your own eyes how the survivors of their 13th Army ran for their lives when we took Orel. They know that their time is running out, but they also know that they won't find mercy in us. They'll be forced to fight until their bitter end.
dst: 五天前，我向你们保证红军已濒于恐慌。你们亲眼看到，当我们攻下奥廖尔时，他们第13集团军的幸存者是如何拼命逃窜的。他们知道自己的时间不多了，但他们也知道，从我们这里得不到怜悯。他们将被迫战斗到痛苦的结局。

src: Follow the Boer general Koos de la Rey in his campaign against the British Empire and become a hero. Fight your enemies until the bitter end and, who knows?, maybe you'll get a chance to earn your happy ending.
dst: 跟随布尔将军库斯·德拉雷伊征战大英帝国，成为一名英雄。与敌人血战到底，而谁知道呢？也许您会得到赢来圆满结局的机会。

src: Follow the Qing Army in its struggle against France, Japan and the Eight Nation Alliance during the last years of the XIX century. Fight for the traditions and the independence of the Empire and build a brighter future for China.
dst: 跟随清军，在19世纪最后几年与法国、日本和八国联军作战。为帝国的传统与独立而战，为中国开创更光明的未来。

src: Follow these links, if you wish to take a quick look:
dst: 若想快速一览，请访问以下链接：

src: Following an extended preliminary bombardment, but yet again advancing in broad daylight,  the Allies mades some progress, but a spirited Turkish counter-attack drove the French from the trenches they had gained. The Royal Naval Division was caught in enfilade fire from the right where the French advance had failed and was forced to retreat, causing the whole attack to crumble. By the end of the battle the new front line was a mere 200 to 250 yards in front of the start line, passing through a patch of vines that earned the area the name of 'The Vineyard'. The British alone lost 4,000 casualties in this costly failure.
dst: 在长时间的前期炮击之后，协约国军队又一次在大白天推进，取得了一些进展，但土耳其军一次勇猛的反击把法军从他们夺得的战壕里赶了出去。皇家海军师遭到来自右侧的侧射火力——那里法军的进攻已经失败——被迫撤退，导致整个进攻土崩瓦解。战斗结束时，新的前线仅仅在出发线前方200到250码处，穿过一片葡萄藤，这片地因此得名「葡萄园」。仅英军就在这次代价高昂的失败中伤亡4000人。

src: Following an unsuccessfull naval attack to force the Dardanelles, an amphibious landing is expected in the Gallipoli peninsula.
dst: 在试图强行突破达达尼尔海峡的海上进攻失败后，预计敌军将在加利波利半岛进行两栖登陆。

src: Following the Fall of France, the Germans hoped the British government would seek a peace agreement and reluctantly considered invasion only as a last resort if all other options failed. As a precondition, they specified the achievement of both air and naval superiority over the English Channel and the proposed landing sites from around Ramsgate to beyond the Isle of Wight, but the German forces did not achieve both at any point during the war. The invasion was postponed indefinitely on 17 September 1940 and it was never put into action.
dst: 法国陷落之后，德国人希望英国政府会寻求和平协议，只是在万不得已时才勉强考虑入侵。作为先决条件，他们要求在英吉利海峡以及从拉姆斯盖特一带到怀特岛以远的拟定登陆地点上空和海面都取得优势，但德军在战争期间从未同时取得这两者。入侵于1940年9月17日被无限期推迟，从未付诸实施。

src: Following the Soviet offensive near Stalingrad in November 1942, the supply lines of the Axis forces in the Caucasus were threatened. Thus a general retreat was ordered. The 1st Panzer Army pulled back towards Rostov, while the 17th Army, to which the bulk of the Romanian forces were assigned, towards the Taman Peninsula.
dst: 继1942年11月斯大林格勒附近的苏军攻势后，轴心国在高加索的供应线受到威胁，遂下令总退却。第1装甲集团军撤向罗斯托夫，而罗马尼亚主力所配属的第17集团军则撤向塔曼半岛。

src: Following the defeat of Admiral Cervera's Squadron in Santiago de Cuba, it is unlikely that reinforcements will be sent to us. Do not expect any help from the Metropolis.
dst: 塞尔维拉海军上将的分舰队在古巴圣地亚哥战败之后，援军不太可能再派给我们了。不要指望来自本土的任何援助。

src: Following the end of WWI, an independent Polish state was established in territories that had previously been part of the Austro-Hungarian, German, and Russian Empires. These territories had existed since the partitions of Poland in the 18th century.
dst: 一战结束后，一个独立的波兰国家在先前属于奥匈、德意志和俄罗斯帝国的领土上建立起来。这些领土自18世纪瓜分波兰以来便已存在。

src: Following the rebels' victory over our forces in Maltiempo (Central Cuba) last December, the way for the invasion of the rich provinces of the west has been opened. Maceo has crossed our fortified lines ("trocha") and joined other insurgents' forces in western provinces (Havana and Pinar del Río). In the first months of 1896 the mambises have destroyed farms, sugar mills and cane fields and have prevented the production of sugar.
dst: 去年12月，叛军在马尔蒂恩波（古巴中部）击败我方部队后，入侵西部富庶省份的道路便已打开。马塞奥越过我们的筑垒防线（「特罗查」），与西部各省（哈瓦那和比那尔德里奥）的其他起义军会合。1896年头几个月里，曼比塞斯摧毁了农场、糖厂和甘蔗田，使甘蔗生产陷入停顿。

src: Following the success of Rennekampf's 1st Army to the north, General Samsonov's 2nd Army began its maneuver with the aim of cutting off the German path of retreat toward the Vistula River.  Under the impression, given by Rennekampf's reconnaisance, that the German 8th Army was in full retreat, Samsonov plunged his army into Eastern Prussia.
dst: 继北面连宁坎普夫第1集团军得胜之后，萨姆索诺夫将军的第2集团军开始机动，目标是切断德军向维斯瓦河撤退的通路。根据连宁坎普夫侦察所得、以为德军第8集团军正在全面撤退的印象，萨姆索诺夫率军深入东普鲁士。

src: Following the uprising of Filipino rebels, Manila is now under siege. Since June 1898, the city has been completely surrounded by Aguinaldo's Filipino rebel ground forces. Some 30,000 Filipino troops had dug fourteen miles of trenches around Manila.
dst: 菲律宾叛军起义后，马尼拉如今已遭围困。自1898年6月起，该城便已被阿奎纳多的菲律宾叛军地面部队完全包围。约30000名菲律宾士兵在马尼拉周围挖了14英里的战壕。

src: Following their initial success, Republican forces occupy the hills and mountains in a river bent, but after weeks in isolation, they are outnumbered and effectively trapped in a pocket. They mostly consist of entrenched infantry battalions with some MG support. Their artillery, armoured, and aircraft units are weak and of lower quality.
dst: 初战得手后，共和军占据河湾处的丘陵山地；但数周孤立无援之后，他们兵力处于劣势，实际上已被困于口袋之中。其主力为构筑工事的步兵营，配属少量机枪支援。炮兵、装甲与航空兵单位薄弱且素质不高。

src: Following your utter failure at the great offensive's key direction, Brusilov has personally stripped you of your command.  A dossier has been prepared for an investigation of your subversive activities, and you have been transported to Petrograd to await your fate.
dst: 继您在这次大攻势关键方向上彻底失败之后，布鲁西洛夫亲自解除了您的指挥权。为调查您的破坏活动而准备了一份卷宗，您已被押往彼得格勒听候发落。

src: For a few days the Bolsheviks were in shock, unable to react. Kappel tried to convince the Komuch that, if we took advantage of the situation and advanced to Moscow through Nizhny Novgorod, the war would be over before the end of the summer. And maybe he was right. But the Komuch was afraid of leaving Samara, Simbirsk and Kazan undefended, and the Czechs didn't really wish to fight a Russian war, so they didn't agree with Kappel. Maybe if he had been older, with a higher rank, they would have listened to him. But they didn't. We went on the defensive, and we let our enemies retake the initiative.
dst: 一连几天，布尔什维克都震惊得无法作出反应。卡佩尔试图说服科穆奇，如果我们利用这一形势，经下诺夫哥罗德向莫斯科推进，战争将在夏天结束前结束。也许他是对的。但科穆奇害怕让萨马拉、辛比尔斯克和喀山无人防守，而捷克人实在不愿打一场俄国内战，所以他们不同意卡佩尔的意见。也许他再年长一些、军衔再高一些，他们就会听他的了。但他们没有。我们转入防御，让敌人重新掌握了主动权。

src: For a long Time I have not thought about War and Battles.... but now our new freedom is threatened again.
dst: 很长时间以来，我都没有再想过战争与战斗……但现在我们新获得的自由再次受到威胁。

src: For a long time all historical sources are quiet until he appears to the stage of World History in 58 BC in the age of 42, when he is appointed as governor of Roman Gaul, a small province at the northwest border of the former Roman Republic. Under his direct command are three  Legions, and he immediately begins the conscription of two others.
dst: 此后很长一段时间，所有史料都归于沉寂，直到公元前58年他42岁登上世界史的舞台——被任命为罗马高卢总督，那是前罗马共和国西北边境上的一个小行省。他直接统辖三个军团，并立刻着手征募另外两个。

src: For a moment we succeeded in stopping the Soviets here, at the Lodz line. However, the Soviets have broken through north and south of you.
dst: 我们曾一度在这里，即罗兹一线挡住了苏军。然而，苏军已在您南北两翼突破。

src: For far too long, the English based on Malta have interrupted our flow of supplies to North Africa.  You have been selected to lead an elite assault force and subdue this enemy stronghold.  You must secure all the island's harbors and airfields so that our hold on the Mediterranean is secure.
dst: 太久以来，盘踞马耳他的英军一直切断我们对北非的补给流。你被选中率领一支精锐突击队，去制服这座敌军堡垒。你必须确保该岛所有港口和机场，好让我方对地中海的掌控牢不可破。

src: For far too long, the English based on Malta have interrupted our flow of supplies to North Africa.  You have been selected to lead an elite assault force and subdue this enemy stronghold.  You must secure all the island's harbors and airfields so that our hold on the Mediterranean is secure...
dst: 长期以来，以马耳他为基地的英国人一直在阻断我们通往北非的补给线。你被选中率领一支精锐突击部队，去制服敌人的这个据点。你必须夺取岛上所有的港口和机场，以确保我们对地中海的控制……

src: For far too long, the English based on Malta have interrupted our flow of supplies to North Africa. You have been selected to lead an elite assault force and subdue this enemy stronghold. You must secure all the island's harbors and airfields so that our hold on the Mediterranean is secure.
dst: 盘踞马耳他的英国人切断我们通往北非的补给线已经太久了。您已被选中率领一支精锐突击部队攻占这一敌军据点。您必须夺取岛上所有港口和机场，以确保我们对地中海的控制。

src: For far too long, the English based on Malta have interrupted our flow of supplies to North Africa. You have been selected to lead an elite assault force and subdue this enemy stronghold. You must secure all the island's harbors and airfields so that our hold on the Mediterranean is secure. Malta will be our unsinkable aircraft carrier!
dst: 长期以来，驻马耳他的英国人一直在切断我们通往北非的补给线。你已被选中率领一支精锐突击部队去征服这座敌军堡垒。你必须夺取岛上所有的港口与机场，以确保我们对地中海的掌控。马耳他将成为我们永不沉没的航空母舰！

src: For me, those years were peaceful and happy. I didn't fight in the Ashanti Wars, and I dedicated myself to my family life. I became an avid reader, mainly of military books, but also of British authors, from Stevenson or Conan Doyle to Lord Tennyson or the Cardinal Newman.
dst: 对我而言，那些年是平静而幸福的。我没有参加阿散蒂战争，而是专注于家庭生活。我成了一个如饥似渴的读者，主要读军事书籍，也读英国作家的作品，从史蒂文森、柯南·道尔到丁尼生勋爵、纽曼枢机主教。

src: For more than a year our duty in the Macedonian front has consisted in repelling fierce offensives from the Entente armies. The Bulgarian divisions have fought bravely, but we have been unable to counterattack. Our enemies are too strong for that, at least for the moment.
dst: 一年多来，我们在马其顿战线的职责一直是击退协约国军队的凶猛攻势。保加利亚各师英勇作战，但我们一直无法发起反攻。我们的敌人太强大了，至少目前如此。

src: For more than three months the Ottoman garrison at Odrin has refused to surrender. Before the war the Turks built a formidable fortress around the town, with nearly inexpugnable lines of fortifications and trenches. But now, after weeks of artillery fire, and with the help of two Serbian divisions, our Second Army has weakened the Turkish defences enough to make a final assault.
dst: 三个多月来，奥德林的奥斯曼守军一直拒绝投降。战前，土耳其人在城镇周围修建了坚固的要塞，拥有几乎攻不破的防御工事和战壕。但如今，经过数周的炮击，并在两个塞尔维亚师的协助下，我们的第2集团军已把土耳其人的防御削弱到足以发起最后进攻的程度。

src: For nearly five months our troops have besieged Kimberley to no avail. I have to admit that the British commander, Lt Col Kekewich, is an excellent officer. In fact I feel sorry for him. Every day he has to direct the defence of this mining town, and still worse, he has to suffer Cecil Rhodes' presence.That must be like living in Hell.
dst: 将近五个月来，我军一直围攻金伯利却毫无结果。我不得不承认，英军指挥官基克维奇中校是一位出色的军官。事实上我有点同情他。他每天都得指挥这座矿业小镇的防御，更糟的是，他还得忍受塞西尔·罗兹的存在。那简直就像活在地狱里。

src: For now you will be transfered to base in East Prussia, where you will receive new Panzer IVs, some of them long-barelled. Your men will undergo an intensive training: there's a grand offensive planned for the next year's spring, and you will participate in it.
dst: 眼下你将调往东普鲁士的基地，在那里接收新的四号坦克，部分是长管炮型。你的部下将接受强化训练：明年春季计划发动一场大规模攻势，你将参与其中。

src: For our own fleet support will arrive in a few hours.
dst: 我方舰队的支援将在几小时后抵达。

src: For our part, this victory didn't alleviate our supply problems, and knowing that the final battle for Lang Son was imminent we left Núi Bop and marched to the north, where the roads were better. It was a risky decision, but it was our only alternative.
dst: 就我们而言，这场胜利并没有缓解我们的补给问题，而且知道谅山的最后决战迫在眉睫，我们便离开了努伊博普，向北行军，那里的道路状况更好。这是一个冒险的决定，但也是我们唯一的选择。

src: For our strategic summer offensive Army Group South has been split and you and your men will spearhead Army Group A's attack on Rostov while Army Group B will march on Stalingrad. Your orders are to launch a surprise attack from our defensive positions at the Mius river. Once the first Soviet lines have been breached you'll advance towards Rostov and cross the Don river. Good luck, Herr General!
dst: 为实施我们的战略夏季攻势，南方集团军群已被拆分，您和您的部下将作为 A 集团军群的先锋进攻罗斯托夫，而 B 集团军群将向斯大林格勒进军。您的命令是从我们在米乌斯河的防御阵地发起突然袭击。一旦突破苏军第一道防线，您便向罗斯托夫推进并渡过顿河。祝好运，将军阁下！

src: For security reasons, I can't tell you exactly where I am. I've been given the command of a division somewhere in Lorraine, and I guess that soon we'll attack the German positions.  Although, given my experience, I doubt that the'll just stay there waiting for us.
dst: 出于安全考虑，我不能告诉您我的确切位置。我奉命在洛林某处指挥一个师，我猜我们很快就会进攻德军阵地。不过，以我的经验，我怀疑他们不会就那么待在那里等我们。

src: For some time the local "kabilas" acted peacefully, but last year a new rebellion started.  This time headed by Mohamed el-Mizzian.  The first attack was against a topographic surveying unit in August.  Now the Berber rebels have started repeatedly crossing the river Kert in order to harass both our military patrols and our allied "kabilas".  Since October we have launched different military operations in the area, but we haven't been able to stop the rebels.  This can't go on.  Finally our Government has approved a major offensive against the enemy "kabilas" and we need you to once again command your troops in battle. If all goes well el-Mizzian's defeat will be permanent!
dst: 一段时间以来，当地「卡比拉」部族相安无事，但去年一场新的叛乱爆发了。这一次由穆罕默德·米齐安领头。第一次袭击发生在八月，目标是我们的一个地形测绘队。如今，柏柏尔叛军开始反复渡过克特河，骚扰我们的军事巡逻队和与我们结盟的「卡比拉」。自十月以来，我们在该地区发起了多次军事行动，但都没能阻止叛军。这样下去可不行。最终，我国政府批准了对敌对「卡比拉」发动一场大规模攻势，我们需要您再次在战场上指挥部队。如果一切顺利，米齐安的失败将是永久性的！

src: For that reason I decided to retreat all of the Spanish garrisons on the western zone to strong defensive lines near the main towns: Ceuta, Larache and Tetuán.  Now the retreat is almost finished, but we still have to take the last step of the operation, and the most dangerous one: the retreat from Xauen to Tetuán. I count on you for this task. Don't fail us, General!
dst: 因此，我决定把西部地区所有西班牙驻军撤到主要城镇附近的坚固防线：休达、拉拉什和得土安。如今撤退已接近完成，但我们还必须执行这次行动的最后一步，也是最危险的一步：从沙温撤往得土安。这项任务我就指望您了。别让我们失望，将军！

src: For the Fifth Battle of Courland, Soviets gathered hundreds of tanks, self-propelled artillery, heavy tank hunters, and an overwhelming mass of infantry. Their air support is formidable.
dst: 至第五次库尔兰战役，苏军集结了数百辆坦克、自行火炮、重型坦克歼击车，以及铺天盖地的步兵。其空中支援声势浩大。

src: For the first time in History such an action will be taken with the combination of land troops and heavy air and naval support. If all goes well, Abd el-Krim's army will be destroyed and he will have to surrender.
dst: 历史上第一次，将以陆军与强大的海空支援相结合的方式来展开这样的行动。如果一切顺利，阿卜杜勒-克里姆的军队将被消灭，他将不得不投降。

src: For the first time, Spanish troops wielded the formidable 7 mm Mauser Model 1893's.
dst: 西班牙军队第一次用上了威力强大的7毫米毛瑟1893型步枪。

src: For the late summer, the encirclement and destruction of the Soviet armies between Don and Volga River is planned. Your troops will form the top of the eastern pincer and push forward along the eastern bank of the Volga River to the north to Kuybyshev. A second pincer will proceed from the Voronezh area in northeastern direction and join your troops at Kuybyshev.
dst: 计划在夏末围歼顿河与伏尔加河之间的苏军各集团军。你的部队将构成东侧钳形攻势的矛头，沿伏尔加河东岸向北推进至古比雪夫。第二支钳形部队将从沃罗涅日地区向东北方向推进，在古比雪夫与你的部队会合。

src: For the moment, however, your first concern is that your ships can enter the Mediterranean and ensure that your marines make it through the strait unscared. Good luck.
dst: 不过目前，你的首要任务是让舰船进入地中海，并确保你的陆战队毫发无伤地通过海峡。祝你好运。

src: For the next scenario, two scenarios can be played. You can choose which one it will be: Kerch of Feodosiya. Both are similar scenarios, both having an amphibious invasion and followed by ground fighting. No matter what your choice will be, after you played the chosen scenario, you will play all scenarios. Your choice won't affect the further continuation of the campaign, nor the scenarios you will play.
dst: 下一个场景，有两个场景可玩。你可以选择是刻赤还是费奥多西亚。两者都是相似的场景，都包含两栖登陆以及随后的地面战斗。无论你选择什么，玩过所选场景后，你会玩到所有场景。你的选择不会影响战役的后续推进，也不会影响你将玩到的场景。

src: For the sake of simplicity the Sultanate of Zanzibar is displayed as Tanganyika as well.
dst: 为简便起见，桑给巴尔苏丹国也一并标注为坦噶尼喀。

src: For their part, the Japanese had had enough fighting. Peace negotiations started in December, and on 17 January 1895 both countries signed the Treaty of Shimonoseki. China had to accept a Japanese protectorate over Southern Korea, with capital in Seoul, while Pyongyang would be the capital of the Kingdom of Northern Korea, under Chinese influence.
dst: 就日本人而言，他们已经打够了。和平谈判于12月开始，1895年1月17日，两国签署了《马关条约》。中国不得不接受日本对南部朝鲜的保护权，以汉城为首都，而平壤则将作为受中国影响的北朝鲜王国的首都。

src: For these Divitiacus the Aeduan spoke and told him:-- "That there were two parties in the whole of Gaul: that the Aedui stood at the head of one of these, the Arverni of the other. After these had been violently struggling with one another for the superiority for many years, it came to pass that the Germans were called in for hire by the
dst: 埃杜伊人迪维提亚库斯代他们发言，向他说：——「整个高卢分为两派：埃杜伊人是一派之首，阿维尔尼人是另一派之首。这两派为争雄长已激烈争斗多年，结果阿维尔尼人与塞夸尼人把日耳曼人雇了进来。

src: For this attack you will only have your tank army. We own no airfield in this area. So, you should have a can build unit for this mission in your troops.
dst: 此次进攻你只有你的坦克集团军。我们在该地区没有机场。因此，你的部队中应有一支可建造单位用于此次任务。

src: For this easy mission you will nearly only have your tank army. The deploy-hexes around the pocket are limited.
dst: 为了这个轻松的任务，你几乎只会拥有你的坦克集团军。包围圈周边的部署格十分有限。

src: For this year, you have done your job! Other units will continue our offensive. For the ongoing operation your troops will give for a few more days flank protection and will then gradually removed from the front line. Your winter camp is located in North Carolina. There you will adapt your forces for winter warfare, so that in early '44 your forces are again operational. And one more word - you have done an excellent job in '43, respect!
dst: 今年你已经完成了任务！其他部队将继续我们的攻势。为当前行动，你的部队还要再提供几天侧翼掩护，随后逐步撤出前线。你的冬季营地在北卡罗来纳。在那里，你要让部队适应冬季作战，以便44年初你的部队能再度参战。还有一句话——你在43年干得非常出色，致敬！

src: For those reasons, as soon as the new Prussian Krupp siege guns arrived in Paris, the bombardment of the city began. Initially, only the defence forts were shelled, but after some days some of the Parisian quarters were attacked, too. Hundreds of civilians were killed or wounded.
dst: 出于这些原因，新的普鲁士克虏伯攻城炮刚运抵巴黎，对这座城市的炮击就开始了。起初，只有防御堡垒遭到轰击，但几天之后，巴黎的一些街区也遭到了袭击。数百名平民伤亡。

src: For three days blood was shed and both sides have suffered massive casualties.  Lwow is still in reactionary hands.  You have done well despite the results, comrade.  But reports I am getting show a very, very grave situation is on our hands...
dst: 三天来血流成河，双方都伤亡惨重。利沃夫仍在反动派手中。尽管结果如此，您已经做得很好了，同志。但我收到的报告显示，一个非常非常严峻的局面正摆在我们面前……

src: For weeks our troops have been stopped by Russian forces near Kiev. It is time for you to encircle and destroy their positions. You are hereby ordered to strike south toward Kiev and Lokhvitsa. Army Group South units, temporarily under your command, are to drive north and meet your forces, thus encircling the Russian armies. All of the objectives in your sector must be taken by September 19th in order for us to redeploy your troops in time for an attack on Moscow this year. An earlier completion of this battle can only enhance your prestige, and give you a better chance to obtain the resources you will need to capture Moscow.
dst: 数周以来，我军在基辅附近一直受阻于苏军。现在该由你将其阵地合围并歼灭。兹命令你向南进攻，直取基辅和洛赫维察。暂归你指挥的南方集团军群部队将向北推进，与你部会合，从而对苏军形成合围。你战区内的所有目标必须在9月19日前夺取，以便我们及时重新部署你的部队，用于今年对莫斯科的进攻。提前结束此战只会提升你的声望，并让你更有机会获得攻取莫斯科所需的资源。

src: For weeks the Rumanians have preparing their offensive. They will first elimenate our bridgehead over the Prut River at Falciu. Comrade, you have orders not to step back and hold your lines at all costs! If possible we will arrange reinforcements. However the burden of the Rumanian counterattack will fall upon your troops. Good luck, Comrade!
dst: 几个星期以来，罗马尼亚人一直在准备他们的攻势。他们将首先清除我们在法尔丘的普鲁特河桥头堡。同志，你接到命令：不许后退一步，不惜一切代价守住你的防线！如有可能，我们会安排增援。然而，罗马尼亚人反攻的重担将落在你的部队身上。祝你好运，同志！

src: For your excellent leadership, you have been appointed as the commander of our combined land, naval, and air assault on Norway, code named Operation Weserubung. Your goal is to capture all objectives in southern and central Norway by May 3rd. Your forces must be free to redeploy for the upcoming campaign in France which is slated to begin May 10th. You should complete your mission as early as you can. This will allow us a greater chance to rest, refit and upgrade your troops prior to the invasion of France.
dst: 鉴于你出色的领导才能，你已被任命为对挪威陆海空联合突击的指挥官，此次行动代号威悉演习行动。你的目标是在5月3日前夺取挪威南部与中部的所有目标。你的部队必须能够自由重新部署，以参加定于5月10日开始的法国战役。你应尽早完成任务。这将使我们有更大机会在入侵法国之前让部队休整、整补与升级。

src: For your outstanding victories that are unmatched in history you will be awarded the Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross with golden Oak Leaves, Swords and Diamonds.
dst: 鉴于您立下的史无前例的卓越战功，您将被授予带金橡叶、剑与钻石的铁十字骑士勋章。

src: For your outstanding victories that are unmatched in history you will be promoted to Generalissimo and awarded the Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross with golden Oak Leaves, Swords and Diamonds.

src: Fortunaly your troops could withstand the German pricer grip. Now we have finally taken over the initiative. I will plead for better reconnaissance for further operations. You can make holidays at the black sea. We will report when our next big offensives are pending.
dst: 幸运的是，你的部队顶住了德军的钳形攻势。现在我们终于夺回了主动权。我会为后续作战请求更好的侦察支援。你可以去黑海边休假了。等我们下一次大规模攻势临近时，会再通知你。

src: Fortunately Fregattenkapitan, things finaly was not so bad. We hope next time to be more careful!
dst: 幸运的是，海军中校，情况最终并不太糟。我们希望下次能更谨慎些！

src: Fortunately Herr Kapitanleutnant, things finaly was not so bad. We hope next time to be more careful!
dst: 幸运的是，海军上尉阁下，情况最终没那么糟。我们希望下次更加小心！

src: Fortunately Herr Korvettenkapitan, things finaly was not so bad. We hope next time to be more careful!
dst: 幸运的是，海军少校阁下，事情最终没有那么糟。我们希望下次能更加小心！

src: Fortunately Herr Leutnant, things finaly was not so bad. We hope next time to be more careful!
dst: 幸运的是，少尉阁下，结果最终没那么糟。我们希望下次更加谨慎！

src: Fortunately Herr Oberleutnant, things finaly was not so bad. We hope next time to be more careful!
dst: 幸运的是，中尉阁下，最终情况并没有那么糟。希望我们下次能更谨慎些！

src: Fortunately Korvettenkapitan, things finaly was not so bad. We hope next time to be more careful!
dst: 幸运的是，海军少校，事情最终还不算太糟。希望下次我们能更谨慎些！

src: Fortunately for us, an attack from the Entente forces against Eritrea was highly unlikely. One month after the battle of Keren, the Germans crushed the Italian army in Caporetto, and Italy was on the verge of surrender. In just a few weeks, Ethiopia had become the least of Italy's problems, so they wouldn't bother us.
dst: 对我们而言幸运的是，协约国军队进攻厄立特里亚的可能性微乎其微。克伦之战一个月后，德国人在卡波雷托击溃了意大利军队，意大利濒临投降。短短几周内，埃塞俄比亚就成了意大利最不操心的问题，所以他们不会再来找我们的麻烦。

src: Fortunately the British offensive has been stopped. However we must withdraw our units to safer positions.
dst: 幸运的是，英军的攻势已被阻止。不过我们必须把部队撤到更安全的位置。

src: Fortunately we early recognized the importance of railways and are therfore able to move troops for hundreds of miles very fast.
dst: 幸运的是，我们很早就认识到了铁路的重要性，因此能够快速调动部队行军数百英里。

src: Fortunately your failure here did not influence the outcome of this campaign. France surrenders! We accomplished in 6 weeks what could not be done in 4 years 25 years earlier. German troops will parade on the Champs Elysees.
dst: 所幸你在此处的失利没有影响本战役的结局。法国投降了！我们在6周内完成了25年前4年都没能做到的事。德军将在香榭丽舍大道上阅兵。

src: Fortunately, eveything was fine. Ireland will now stop (even secretly) supporting the British with volunteers.
dst: 幸运的是，一切都很顺利。爱尔兰现在将（哪怕是秘密地）停止以志愿者支援英国。

src: Fortunately, in the east the Czech Legion had conquered all the important outposts along the Trans-Siberian Railway, from Samara to Irkutsk. So we joined them on their evacuation, and before the end of the summer we had arrived safely in Ufa.
dst: 幸运的是，在东部，捷克军团已攻占了西伯利亚大铁路沿线从萨马拉到伊尔库茨克的所有重要据点。于是我们加入了他们的撤退队伍，在夏天结束前安全抵达乌法。

src: Fortunately, our enemy, the Hova army of Queen Ranavalona, has not tried to stop our advance so far. We spotted two columns of their infantry a few days ago, but they retreated into the jungle, as soon as we lifted our rifles against them. I think...
dst: 幸运的是，我们的敌人——拉纳瓦洛纳女王的霍瓦军队——迄今没有试图阻止我们的推进。几天前我们发现了他们两路步兵纵队，但我们一举起步枪，他们就退回了丛林。我想……
幸运的是，我们的海军陆战队安然无恙。

src: Fortunately, the enemy has been hit hard enough to make him retreat and not exploit our failure. The Senussi seem to gather forces again  50 miles west, at Sollum. We are ordered to follow up and strike again, quickly...
dst: 所幸，敌人已遭到足够沉重的打击，不得不撤退，无法乘胜扩大战果。塞努西似乎又在西面50英里外的塞卢姆重新集结兵力。我们奉命跟进，迅速再次出击……

src: Fortunately, things finaly was not so bad. We hope next time to be more careful!
dst: 幸运的是，情况最终并不太糟。我们希望下次能更谨慎些！

src: Fortunately, things finaly was not so bad. We hope next time to be more careful! But anyway, you gave to British another good lesson.
dst: 幸运的是，结果最终没那么糟。我们希望下次更加谨慎！但无论如何，你又给英国人上了一课。

src: Fortunately, things finaly was not so bad. We hope next time to be more careful! You have to return to Germany.
dst: 幸运的是，情况最终没那么糟。我们希望下次更加小心！你必须返回德国。

src: Fortunately, things finaly was was good!
dst: 幸好，结果最终还是好的！

src: Fortunately, we also have the support of the German ''Legion Condor'' and the Italian ''Corpo di Truppe Volontaire'' to aid us in our advance.
dst: 所幸，我们还有德国「秃鹰军团」和「意大利志愿军团」的支援，来协助我们推进。

src: Fortunately, you have been successful. Boiorix you are a tactican and at the end of your journey. Settle here and liveth long. Long live the people of the Cimbri!
dst: 幸而你取得了成功。博伊奥里克斯，你是位战术家，你的旅程也已走到尽头。在此定居，长命百岁。辛布里民族万岁！

src: Fortunately, you have managed to make a careful retreat to the other bank of the river, and most of the People's Army is now safe for the moment.  Unfortunately, careful retreats and saving what is left of our army will not defeat the Falangists.
dst: 所幸您成功地谨慎撤退到了河对岸，人民军的大部分眼下暂时安全了。遗憾的是，谨慎的撤退和保存我们残存的军队并不能击败长枪党分子。

src: Fortunatly Panzergruppe III was able to clean up your mess. Continue on towards Smolensk.
dst: 幸好第3装甲集群收拾了你的烂摊子。继续向斯摩棱斯克推进。

src: Four Air Transports are available in this scenario.
dst: 本场景中可用的空运队为四支。

src: Four days ago we discovered that the French and the British are sending troops through a gap between our First and Second Armee at the Marne. [IXReserve] corps and your 6.Reserve Division were sent away from our positions in front of Antwerp to the Marne to plug the hole in our lines there.
dst: 四天前我们发现，法军和英军正从马恩河我方第1与第2集团军之间的一个缺口运送部队。[IXReserve]军和您的第6预备师被调离安特卫普前方的阵地，前往马恩河去堵住那里的防线缺口。

src: Four long years we have held on to a tiny sliver of our kingdom behind the river IJzer, not giving up but also not being able to advance through the drowned no man's land.

dst: 法国投降了！我们用6周完成了25年前4年都没做到的事。德军将在香榭丽舍大街上阅兵。

src: Frankly, I'm tired after so many months far from home, fighting in this primitive lands. I miss you very much. Sometimes I wish I could retire, and stay with you forever. But then I realize that it would be a selfish act. The future of the French people, of our children and grandchildren, is at stake. And that includes the fighting in the Balkans. I hope I'll return to France soon, but in the meantime I must stay here. However foolish it may sound, thoughts of you are a great relief for my old soul right now. Everyday I remember how we met, how young we were, and all the great times that we've lived together since then.
dst: 坦率地说，在远离家乡这么多个月、在这片原始土地上作战之后，我已经累了。我非常想念您。有时我真希望能退役，与您长相厮守。但随即我意识到，那会是一种自私的行为。法国人民的未来、我们子孙后代的未来危在旦夕。这也包括在巴尔干的战斗。我希望我很快能回到法国，但与此同时我必须留在这里。尽管这听起来也许很傻，但对您的思念此刻对我苍老的灵魂是极大的慰藉。每天我都会想起我们如何相遇、我们当时多么年轻，以及自那以后我们一起度过的所有美好时光。

src: Frau Admiral Zera was stunned.What had just happened?The Brits and their Royal Navy,the Pride of that Navy the 'Hood not a match for the Girls aboard the SS/KM Fleet.The shells from the Big guns had been on target enough to ravage the Royal Navies battlewagons. Zera watched as the Flyers of the Air Korps went over to chase the small boats running back to 'Winstons arms.The 'Wohr moved slowly through the carnage of Brit ships still afloat.The 'Hood was listing to starboard and would soon be going under.Brit Admiral Holland was boarding a lifeboat and stood at attention ordering the others to do the same and gave the 'Wohr a salute."That's Big of Him,isn't it Zera" Frau Captain Missy Warner stated."Yes I must admit,in all the World the Brits show class no matter what the situation.I admire them for that.As soon as the 2 'Fuhress Class Battleships are put to sea they should get a lot more chances to show it in defeat.This Day will go down as one of the most monumental in the annals of naval history.Now let's get back to Our Duty,We must get to port and repair Our damage and give Respect for the Dead".In Berlin the Fuhress on hearing the result of the battle stated "a 'Miracle has been delivered into My hands,this will have to affect the Enemies moral".In London Churchill retired to His Library to gulp down some Spirits and cuss the 'Fraus who were only worthy of Cooking,Cleaning and Bearing Bastard SS Children.
dst: 泽拉女海军上将惊呆了。刚才发生了什么？英国人——以及他们引以为傲的皇家海军、那支海军的骄傲“胡德”号——竟不是党卫军／海军舰队上这些姑娘的对手。巨炮射出的炮弹精准命中，重创了皇家海军的战列舰。泽拉看着航空军的飞行员们飞过去追击那些逃回“温斯顿怀抱”的小船。“沃尔”号缓缓驶过仍在漂浮的英国舰船的残骸。“胡德”号向右舷倾斜，很快就要沉没。英国海军上将霍兰德正登上一艘救生艇，立正站好，命令其他人也照做，并向“沃尔”号敬了个礼。“他这份气度真了不起，是吧，泽拉。”米西·沃纳女上尉说。“是的，我得承认，全世界就属英国人无论什么处境都保持着风度。我为此敬佩他们。等两艘‘女元首’级战列舰出海，他们还会有更多机会在失败中展示这一点。这一天将被载入海军史上最重大的日子之一。现在回到我们的职责——我们必须回港修理损伤，并向死者致敬。”在柏林，女元首得知此战结果后说：“一个‘奇迹’被交到了我手里，这必然会影响敌人的士气。”在伦敦，丘吉尔退入书房，灌了几口烈酒，咒骂那些“只配做饭、打扫和生党卫军野种”的“女士”们。

src: Frau Bauernschmitt, I regret to inform you that your husband was captured last week by the enemy while his trench near Epéhy was overrun during a French counterattack. According to our information, he’s alive and well, but he has been transferred to a prisoner camp, where he’s likely to remain until the end of the war. Please accept my condolences.
dst: 鲍恩施密特夫人，我很遗憾地通知您，您的丈夫上周在法军的一次反攻中，其埃佩伊附近的战壕被攻占时，被敌人俘获了。据我们所知，他还活着，安然无恙，但已被转移到一个战俘营，很可能要在那里待到战争结束。请接受我的慰问。

src: Frau Bauernschmitt, I regret to inform you that your husband was captured last week by the enemy, during a French counterattack in Flandern. According to our information, he’s alive and well, but he has been transferred to a prisoner camp, where he’s likely to remain until the end of the war. Please accept my condolences.
dst: 鲍恩施密特夫人，我很遗憾地通知您，您的丈夫上周在佛兰德的一次法军反攻中被敌人俘获。据我们所知，他还活着，安然无恙，但已被转移到一个战俘营，很可能要在那里待到战争结束。请接受我的慰问。

src: Frau Commander 'Piask stepping out of Her Command tent.The Soviets were cutting loose with another barrage of Big Guns.The SS was held up at the moment waiting for the Air Korps to arrive.Moments later it did.Piask thought She had seen something but She was even in for a Bigger show.The Sky started to have the Black specks of aa fire show up and it increased til it was not specks but the whole Skyline."Dam they must have a Thousand Guns there" Piask commented.The SS Planes now came flying out of the area with most trailing smoke or fire.Some crashed a few kilometers away.To the Pilots they had seen flak before but nothing on this level.The Air Korps liasion officer came over to Piask."They've shot down so many Air Korps Command has cancelled further aid for the moment" Major 'Ion reported."I'll  contact Berlin about that,guess for the moment the Panzers will have to work through the area.Going to be a lot less available for further duties after this Shit without aid from above.Those are some Big Guns.Don't imagine the accompanying infantries going to enjoy this either.We got to have this area though.And to think I knew the Girls hated Me for My pushing them,after this I will be lucky I'm not shot by Our own side.Sure wish We was back in France. Russia's going to Bleed Us to Death".
dst: 皮亚斯克女指挥官走出她的指挥帐篷。苏联人又开始了新一轮重炮齐射。党卫军此刻被挡住了，等待航空军到来。片刻后航空军到了。皮亚斯克以为自己看到了什么，但等着她的场面更大。天空中开始出现高射炮火的黑色斑点，而且越来越多，直到不再是斑点，而是整条天际线。"妈的，他们那儿肯定有一千门炮。"皮亚斯克评论道。党卫军的飞机随即从该地区飞出，大多拖着烟或火。有几架坠毁在几公里外。对飞行员们来说，他们见过高射炮火，但从没见过这种级别的。航空军联络官走到皮亚斯克身边。"他们击落太多了，航空军司令部已暂时取消后续支援。"'伊昂少校报告。"我会就此事联系柏林。看来眼下只能靠装甲部队啃过这一带了。这一仗打完，能用于后续任务的兵力会少很多。那些可是大家伙。我想随行的步兵也不会喜欢这种场面。可我们必须拿下这一带。想想吧，我知道姑娘们因为我的逼迫而恨我；这一仗之后，我没被自己人打死就算走运了。真希望我们还在法国。俄国会把我们活活吸干的。"

src: Frau General Cupps stepped out of the building."What a Dam mess,the Air Korps letting the Soviets sneak Bombers in here.Ah shit the Top floors gone,all My Dam papers.If this aint a sorry state of affairs.Runner come here,get to the Command at Gertz and tell them I need the K4 papers dealing with 'Enfromm.And don't let no grass grow under Your feet.Hell, Hell,Hell.Look at that,Sydignee's car on it's side.Frau any occupants in it,Just the Driver.Where's the Major,over to the Airbase.For What? To shoot Schellem.Get Your Ass over there and stop Her.If She shoots Schellem the SS flyers will bomb Us".Cupps had officers all around Her asking to do this and that while She surveyed more damage."Sargent You've been pestering Me for 10 minutes,can't You see I'm kinda busy.What the Hell do You want"? "Herr General,the 9th SS stopped the Soviets but they only got 6 Panzers left"."How the Hell the Soviets shoot up that many,never mind.Go over to Gertz and tell the 23rd SS to get here on the Double,the Code word is 'Nietsche.Then get to Plenbosvull and tell the 16th to do the same.How could this day get any worst".At that moment a grenade flew out of a window and landed near Cupps.The Frau Sargent kicked it under a truck.It blew,the Truck filled with ammunition blew.Cupps, the Sargent and the others tossed around like Ragdolls from the blast.Frau General Cupps got up, brushed off Her uniform, "guess I better get My Silly Ass out of view".
dst: 库普斯女将军走出大楼。“真是一团糟，航空军竟让苏联人把轰炸机偷偷放进来。妈的，顶层没了，我所有该死的文件都没了。这局面可真够呛。传令兵，过来，去格茨的司令部，告诉他们我要关于‘恩弗罗姆’的 K4 文件。别磨磨蹭蹭的。要命、要命、要命。瞧那个，西迪尼的车翻在一边了。女士，里面有人吗，只有司机。少校在哪儿，去机场了。去干什么？去枪毙谢勒姆。你赶紧过去拦住她。要是她毙了谢勒姆，党卫军的飞行员会来炸我们。”库普斯查看更多损毁时，周围围满了请示这请示那的军官。“中士，你已经烦了我10分钟了，没看见我正忙着吗。你到底要干什么？”“将军阁下，党卫军第9师挡住了苏联人，可他们只剩6辆坦克了。”“苏联人他妈的怎么打掉那么多，算了。去格茨，告诉党卫军第23师火速赶到这里，暗语是‘尼采’。然后去普伦博斯维尔，让第16师也照办。这一天还能再糟到哪儿去。”就在那一刻，一枚手榴弹从窗户飞出，落在库普斯附近。那名女中士把它踢到一辆卡车底下。它炸了，装满弹药的卡车也炸了。库普斯、中士和其他人像布娃娃一样被冲击波抛来抛去。库普斯女将军爬起来，掸了掸制服，“我想我最好还是把我这蠢屁股挪开视线”。

src: Frau General Glorrus Nekker sitting in Her staff car.A Russian Female sniper being searched for after killing Nekker's driver and of course it could have as easily been Nekker.Snipers on the Fronts were making an impact on both sides but the Russians with their advantage in numbers were taking out a lot of SS officers with some Snipers racking up as many as 70 kills.So the protection was stepped Up after a call to the Fuhress and any Sniper caught was tortured for a long time before put to Death.So Nekker as other High-ranking officers would be moved back from the Front lines and protected better.The SS was on the move and the Leningrad Front was heading to meet the Moscow Front to work in coordination.Joseph Stalin had gave up on stopping those coming from Leningrad and would work on slowing them down and destroying the Moscow and Stalingrad Fronts.So His numbers started to be sent to those areas.The Frau's on the Front lines coming from the North could not tell that though they did see the Armor was not as overwhelming as in the past.Again they thanked the 'Tigers for that.
dst: 格洛鲁斯·内克尔女将军坐在她的座车里。一名俄罗斯女狙击手在击毙内克尔的司机后正被搜捕——被击中的当然也完全可能是内克尔本人。前线的狙击手对双方都造成影响，但俄国人凭数量优势干掉了大量党卫军军官，有些狙击手战绩高达70人。于是在一通打给女元首的通话后，防护被加强，任何被抓获的狙击手都要先受长时间折磨再处死。于是内克尔和其他高级军官一样，将从一线后撤，获得更好的保护。党卫军正在推进，列宁格勒战线准备与莫斯科战线会合、协同作战。约瑟夫·斯大林已放弃阻止从列宁格勒方向来的部队，转而设法拖慢他们，并击破莫斯科和斯大林格勒战线。于是他的兵力开始被调往那些地区。从北面前来的前线“女士”们察觉不到这一点，但她们确实发现敌方装甲不再像过去那样势不可挡。她们又一次把这归功于“虎”式。

src: Frau General Ortrun Knapp was attacking the City of Leningrad by sea.The SS/BdM Air Korps blitz all across the Soviet frontiers had took it's toll.For 2 weeks now the Soviets with more aircraft than the World combined had been decimated by the 'Frau's.Over 2,000 planes had been destroyed allowing the Nazi's pilots Air-superiority and experience that could not be rivaled in the Dogfights over Mother Russia.The fortunes of the Soviets had gone sour and now the Dreaded Stuka's could roam at will destroying supply units behind the Frontier.And Leningrad was beseiged,the Soviet Forces in the Baltics running for their lives and the 'Kondors were ready to start missions far behind the Frontier.Joseph Stalin was in Shock from the attacks destroying His forces on the Fronts.Time and time again He had called Commanders to the Kremlin and after chewing them out then having the NKVD put them in front of firing squads.Four heads of the Red Air Force had met a similar fate.On hearing the SS was attacking Leningrad by sea Stalin retired to His Quarters,a bottle in hand and a few female clerks telling His Chief of staff to " let Him be until the Nazi's showed up at the Front Gates for He had no more answers for Himself or anyone else".So there It was,Stalin drunk and the 'Cradle of Bolshevik Revolution" under attack.
dst: 女将军奥特伦·克纳普正从海上进攻列宁格勒。党卫军/BdM 航空军横扫苏联边境的闪击已见成效。两周来，拥有比全世界加起来还多飞机的苏军，一直被“女士”们屠戮。2000多架飞机被摧毁，使纳粹飞行员在“母亲俄罗斯”上空的空战中取得了无可匹敌的制空权和经验。苏军的运势急转直下，如今可怕的“斯图卡”可以肆意巡弋，摧毁边境后方的补给部队。列宁格勒被围，波罗的海沿岸的苏军夺路而逃，“秃鹰”轰炸机也准备开始执行深入边境后方的任务。约瑟夫·斯大林被这些摧毁其前线部队的攻击震住了。他一次又一次把指挥官召到克里姆林宫，训斥一通后让内务人民委员部把他们送去枪决。红军空军已有四任首脑遭遇同样下场。听说党卫军正从海上进攻列宁格勒，斯大林退回自己的居所，手里抓着酒瓶；几位女文书告诉他的总参谋长：“别去打扰他，等纳粹出现在大门前再说吧，他对自己、对别人都没有答案了。”就这样，斯大林喝得烂醉，而“布尔什维克革命的摇篮”正遭受进攻。

src: Frau Major Magla came into the Command building, "General Cupps,Russian armor is pouring through the ranks,100's of tanks and not those small ones but those KV's we've been having trouble with"."You didn't believe that garbage from Berlin did You?The 'Russian Bear' running back to Moscow for some of Stalins Tit.I wish the Reich Propaganda Ministry under Frau Teufel would stay out of the War.I see Fraus running around with too many smiles on their faces.The Soviets are not going to Fold cause We captured the land on the Frontiers and their Grand city of Leningrad.I Myself believe the Fuhress has bit off more than We All can chew and We will be lucky to win this War and keep Russian boots out of Berlin.Last weeks downpour stifling all movement of the Heavy stuff should wake everyone up but I see those redeployment Orders from Berlin are still pouring in".Moments later the Air-raid sirens went off and the officers moved to the basement.The building rocked from the bombs."Magla when We go back up You get over to the airfield and chew out Commander Schellem,that Silly Bitch boasting how We got control of the Skies as far as the Eye can see.Runner come here.Go tell Frau 'Lungerhausen to move the 9th SS to the East of grid 31 and prepare for Heavies".
dst: 玛格拉女少校走进司令部大楼：“库普斯将军，俄国装甲正成群涌来，数百辆坦克，而且不是那些小个头的，是我们一直很头疼的 KV。”“你当初不信柏林那套鬼话，是吧？说‘俄国熊’正在逃回莫斯科去讨斯大林的奶吃。我倒希望托伊费尔女士管的帝国宣传部别插手这场战争。我看见‘女士’们一个个笑得太多。我们占了边境的土地和他们那座大城列宁格勒，苏联人可不会就此垮掉。我个人认为，女元首这一口咬得太大，我们所有人都咽不下去；能打赢这场仗、不让俄国人的靴子踏进柏林，就算走运了。上周那场让重装备寸步难行的暴雨本该让所有人清醒过来，可我看柏林那些重新部署的命令还在不断涌来。”片刻后防空警报响起，军官们撤进地下室。大楼被炸弹震得摇晃。“玛格拉，等我们上去，你去机场把谢勒姆指挥官骂一顿，那个蠢娘们还吹嘘我们控制着目之所及的天空。传令兵，过来。去告诉‘伦格豪森女士，把党卫军第9师调到31网格以东，准备迎击重型坦克。”

src: French Major Suett Dever Charles commanding the 17th and 20th Armee's statement to the French Command in Paris.The French HQ wanted everything destroyed in and around Rouen so the SS couldn't use it or shelter in it but the Major refused.He had seen enough hardships in the War already to be the one to cast what Civilians remained out in the cold and snow.Besides the SS/BdM had come prepared,they were dressed in fine Winter garb while the French overcoats and overshoes were wore out.The French soldier was more worried on getting something to eat this day as slowly the rations had been cut back to not enough to sustain the 17th or 20th,HQ in Pari was hoarding everything.You add displaced Persons begging for food and the matters got worst.Soldiers were starting to desert and Charles as the Command in Paris knew soon the numbers would be in the thousands.Morale non-existent, Air-superiority held by the Enemy and French Commanders giving orders,then retracting orders only to come back and give more ludicrious orders than the ones before.The French soldier looked for someone to step-up.There was no-one in the face of the SS 'Fraus assault.
dst: 指挥第17和第20集团军的法国少校苏尔特·德弗·夏尔对巴黎法军司令部的陈述。法军总部想摧毁鲁昂城内及周边的一切，好让党卫军无法利用或据守，但这位少校拒绝了。他在战争中已见够了苦难，不愿做那个把残余平民赶到寒冷与风雪中的人。何况党卫军/BdM 是有备而来，穿着精良的冬装，而法军的大衣和套鞋都已磨破。这一天，法国士兵更操心的是弄点吃的——配给量已渐渐削减到不足以维持第17或第20集团军，巴黎的总部却囤积一切。再加上流离失所者乞讨食物，情况更糟。士兵开始开小差，而夏尔作为巴黎指挥官知道，人数很快就会上千。士气荡然无存，制空权在敌人手里，法军指挥官下了命令又收回，回来再下比之前更荒唐的命令。法国士兵盼着有人能站出来。面对党卫军“女士”们的猛攻，却无人挺身而出。

src: From 1908 the troubled riffian cabilas of the Spanish Morocco were in revolt. They began the attacks on the spanish settlements by attacking the Spanish workers on the area, then, they could built up their irregular army by purchasing foreing weapons. Some tribal leaders claim for the holy war agaisnt Spain, and the riffian harkas (the moroccan irregular forces) put Melilla into real danger.
dst: 从1908年起，西属摩洛哥动乱不安的里夫卡比拉便起兵反叛。他们先是袭击该地区的西班牙工人，进而攻击西班牙定居点，然后通过购买外国武器组建起非正规军。一些部落首领号召对西班牙发动圣战，里夫哈尔卡（摩洛哥非正规军）使梅利利亚陷入真正的危险之中。

src: From China I traveled to many different countries, until in 1922 I established myself in Argentina, where I still live. I can't complain about the life that I've lived in these last 30 years, but the truth is that I miss Russia very much. I wish that I could have done more, and that we could have won the war. I know that I should have gotten rid of all these feelings of failure and shame, but I've never been able to do that. It's true, I did my best, but now that the Soviet Union seems more powerful than ever, despair and grief take hold of my mind. I guess that it's the penance I have to pay for my sins, and I must accept it.
dst: 离开中国后，我游历了许多国家，直到1922年在阿根廷定居，至今仍生活在那里。对这最近30年的生活，我没什么可抱怨的，但说实话，我非常想念俄国。我希望自己本可以做得更多，希望我们本可以赢得战争。我知道我本该摆脱所有这些失败与羞耻感，但我一直没能做到。的确，我已尽了全力，但如今苏联似乎比以往任何时候都强大，绝望和悲痛攫住了我的心。我想，这是我必须为自己的罪孽付出的忏悔，我必须接受它。

It's true, I did my best, but now that the Soviet Union seems more powerful than ever, despair and grief take hold of my mind. I guess that it's the penance I have to pay for my sins, and I must accept it.
dst: 离开中国后，我游历了许多国家，直到1922年在新西兰定居，至今仍生活在那里。对这最近30年的生活，我没什么可抱怨的，但说实话，我非常想念俄国。我希望自己本可以做得更多，希望我们本可以赢得战争。我知道我本该摆脱所有这些失败与羞耻感，但我一直没能做到。的确，我已尽了全力，但如今苏联似乎比以往任何时候都强大，绝望和悲痛攫住了我的心。我想，这是我必须为自己的罪孽付出的忏悔，我必须接受它。

src: From July 1, 1898 to June 2, 1899, Filipino revolutionaries sieged the fifty-man garrison of the small town of Baler, who had fortified themselves in the stone church. Although the Spanish-American war ended in December 1898 with Spain's surrender and annexation of the Philippines to the United States, cut off from communications with their own government and military, the Spanish forces in Baler continued their defence against overwhelming superior Filipino forces for 11 months.
dst: 从1898年7月1日到1899年6月2日，菲律宾革命者围困了小城巴莱尔的五十人守备队，这队人已固守在一座石头教堂里。虽然美西战争于1898年12月以西班牙投降、菲律宾被割让给美国而告终，但与本国政府和军队通讯中断的巴莱尔西班牙部队，仍继续抵抗占据压倒优势的菲律宾军队长达11个月。

src: From Landrecies we should go to Étreux and then further south to Laon and Soissons. But we couldn't retreat too fast, lest we leave the II Corp's right flank unprotected. Besides, some French units were using the same roads for their own retreat, so an excessive haste on our part could have disatrous consequences. I decided that holding the pursuing Germans for a few hours was the best option.
dst: 我们本应从朗德勒西前往埃特勒，再向南至拉昂和苏瓦松。但我们不能撤得太快，以免使第2军的右翼失去掩护。况且，一些法国部队也在使用同样的道路撤退，所以我们若过于仓促，后果将不堪设想。我认定，阻击追兵几个小时是最佳选择。

src: From Landrecies we should go to Étreux and then further south to Laon and Soissons. But we couldn't retreat too fast, lest we left the II Corp's right flank unprotected. Besides, some French units were using the same roads for their own retreat, so an excessive haste on our part could have disatrous consequences. I decided that holding the pursuing Germans for a few hours was the best option.
dst: 从朗德勒西出发，我们本应前往埃特勒，然后继续南下到拉昂和苏瓦松。但我们不能撤退得太快，以免使第二军的右翼失去掩护。此外，一些法国部队正沿着同样的道路撤退，因此我们若过于仓促，可能会造成灾难性的后果。我认定，拖住追击的德军几个小时是最佳选择。

src: From May through August Russia lost 1,798 officers + 114,627 soldiers killed, 8,819 officers + 663,560 soldiers wounded, and 475 officers + 95,750 soldiers missing.  Austria-Hungary lost 959 officers + 29,286 soldiers killed, 3,669 officers + 149,944 wounded, and 5,348 officers + 322,040 soldiers captured.  Germany lost 59,000 killed and 26,000 missing.
dst: 从五月到八月，俄军阵亡1798名军官加114627名士兵，负伤8819名军官加663560名士兵，失踪475名军官加95750名士兵。奥匈帝国阵亡959名军官加29286名士兵，负伤3669名军官加149944名士兵，被俘5348名军官加322040名士兵。德国阵亡59000人，失踪26000人。

src: From Samara, south of Kazan, you will once again use the railroad system to quickly reach Kazan and clear it of Bolsheviks. The Imperial Gold Reserve is also one of your goals. If we capture it, we have a very good negitiation position - with anyone.
dst: 从喀山以南的萨马拉出发，您将再次利用铁路系统迅速抵达喀山，清除那里的布尔什维克。帝国黄金储备也是您的目标之一。如果我们夺下它，就能拥有与任何人谈判的极佳筹码。

src: From his HQ at Annual, spanish general Manuel Fernández Silvestre saw how the number of enemies grew day by day. On July 16th it was clear that a huge Berber counteroffensive was inminent. Could Silvestre´s troops, unexperienced and demoralized, defend their positions in the mountains of the Rif?
dst: 在安瓦尔的指挥部里，西班牙将军曼努埃尔·费尔南德斯·西尔韦斯特看到敌人一天天增多。到7月16日，一场大规模柏柏尔反攻已迫在眉睫。西尔韦斯特那支缺乏经验、士气低落的部队，能否守住他们在里夫山区的阵地呢？

src: From my HQ at Annual I can see how the number of enemies grows day by day. It's obvious that a huge Berber counteroffensive is imminent, and the Spanish soldiers that defend Annual are inexperienced and demoralized. We must retreat from the mountains of the Rif. Before your arrival I thought that it would be immposible, and I was about to lose my sanity. Now I can see a glimpse of hope.
dst: 从我在安瓦勒的司令部，我能看到敌人的数量与日俱增。显然，一场柏柏尔人的大规模反攻迫在眉睫，而防守安瓦勒的西班牙士兵既缺乏经验又士气低落。我们必须撤出里夫山区。在您到来之前，我本以为这不可能，我几乎要失去理智了。现在我看到了一线希望。

src: From now on we'll adopt guerrilla tactics. We won't confront the Rooineks on the open field. We'll attack small columns, destroy telegraph and railway lines, assault British positions by surprise and, in general, do our best to harass them. We'll make them pay a great price for having occupied our lands. So high that maybe, eventually, they'll go away and leave us alone.
dst: 从现在起我们将采取游击战术。我们不会在开阔地上与英国佬正面对抗。我们将袭击小股纵队，破坏电报和铁路线，突袭英军阵地，总之尽我们所能去骚扰他们。我们要让他们为占领我们的土地付出沉重的代价。代价高到也许最终他们就会离开，不再打扰我们。

src: From now on, you will be on the defensive.
dst: 从现在起，您将转入防御。

src: From that moment, Manila's water supply depended on rainwater catched and stored in cisterns.
dst: 从那一刻起，马尼拉的供水便依赖于收集并储存在蓄水池中的雨水。

src: From the Boxer Rebellion of 1900, when Kaiser Wilhelm commited troops to China with the infamous 'Hun Speech' (because of that the English call us Germans 'Huns'. Call note of the author) through various uprisings in the colonies up to the courageous defense of German East Africa by von Lettow-Vorbeck in 1918, this mini-campaign includes all the relevant sites of the German colonial history.
dst: 从1900年的义和团之乱（当时德皇威廉以臭名昭著的「匈奴演说」向中国派兵——正因如此英国人称我们德国人为「匈奴人」。作者注），到殖民地此起彼伏的起义，再到1918年冯·莱托-福贝克对德属东非的英勇防守，本迷您战役囊括了德国殖民史上所有相关的地点。

src: From the Volga to Vladivostok, many anti-Bolshevik forces roam the turbulent Eastern regions of Russia in 1918. Separated by strong ideological and ethnic differences, and without a centralized command, they are too weak to threaten the Red power. But, united, they could become a formidable force. Maybe strong enough to change the course of the civil war.
dst: 从伏尔加河到符拉迪沃斯托克，1918年，许多反布尔什维克力量在俄国动荡的东部地区活动。它们因强烈的意识形态和民族差异而彼此分离，又没有统一的指挥，因此过于弱小，无法威胁到红色政权。但是，一旦联合起来，它们就能成为一股强大的力量。也许强大到足以改变内战的进程。

src: From the beginning their were a lot of doubts about operation Zitadelle. At first we delayed it for a few weeks in order to solve some of the mechanical problems our new tanks suffered. Then we heard of the great success of our forces in Sicily and decided to call the operation off, and decided to send some of the Panzer divisions against the offensive the Russians started in the south on July 17.
dst: 从一开始，人们对"堡垒"行动就疑虑重重。起初我们为排除新式坦克的某些机械故障而将其推迟了数周。随后我们得知我军在西西里大获成功，于是决定取消该行动，并决定抽调部分装甲师去对付俄军7月17日在南线发起的攻势。

src: From the high command of the Imperial Army.

From the island of Cuba to the exotic China, from the Philippine jungles to Mexico and the devastated French battlefields of the WWI, lead the American Army in this quest towards glory. Thanks to your effort, one day your country will be the most powerful in the world.

src: General Aranda is besieged in Oviedo since the past year, only supported by a narrow corridor, and some Republican divisions are surrounding the city. Moreover, the enemy is trying to create a defensive line along the Sella river to stop our forces, and, unfortunately for us, the extremely rainy Asturian weather will support them with heavy rains.
dst: 阿兰达将军被困在奥维耶多已有一年，仅靠一条狭窄的走廊维持，而共和派的几个师正包围着这座城市。此外，敌军正试图沿塞利亚河构筑防线以阻止我军，而且对我们不幸的是，阿斯图里亚斯多雨的气候将用瓢泼大雨助他们一臂之力。

src: General Bistroff, this is the turning point in the whole Russian campaign, and I hope you already understand this. We are on the brink of total collapse and the Soviets know this.
dst: 比斯特罗夫将军，这是整个俄国战役的转折点，我希望你已经明白这一点。我们正处在全面崩溃的边缘，而苏联人对此心知肚明。

src: General Botha says that the British will give us lots of money for reconstruction and they have promised that, although our republics have been annexed, they will eventually grant us limited self-government. It's still a cruel destiny for our people, but we'll be forced to accept it.
dst: 博塔将军说，英国人将给我们一大笔重建资金，他们还承诺，尽管我们的共和国已被吞并，他们最终会给予我们有限的自治。这对我们的人民来说仍是残酷的命运，但我们不得不接受。

src: General Charles De Gaulle had long believed that Tanks should be used in groups to smash the enemy not as Infantry support which was French military doctrine at the time. After the breakthrough at Sedan he was finally  given command of a hastily formed armoured division called the 4th DCR and allowed free reign. He decided to counter-attack the German panzer corridor at Laon in an attempt to cut the German advance. De Gaulle's first attack on the 17th and second on the 19th were both smashed thanks largely to the 10th Panzer Division which had just arrived after fighting at Stonne.
dst: 夏尔·戴高乐将军长期以来一直认为，坦克应当集中成集群用来打击敌人，而不是像当时法国军事学说所主张的那样充当步兵支援。色当突破之后，他终于获得了一支仓促组建的装甲师——第4装甲师（4th DCR）——的指挥权，并获准自主行动。他决定在拉昂反击德军装甲走廊，企图切断德军的推进。戴高乐17日的第一次进攻和19日的第二次进攻均被粉碎，主要归功于刚在斯托讷战斗后赶到的第10装甲师。

src: General Denikin, who after Alekseyev's passing has become our sole leader, has ordered me to attempt a third, and hopefully final, assault on Stavropol, while Wrangel's men storm Armavir, in the west. Fortunately my health problems seem to be over, so I can employ all my energies in destroying the 11th Army.
dst: 阿列克谢耶夫去世后成为我们唯一领袖的邓尼金将军，已命令我对斯塔夫罗波尔发起第三次、但愿也是最后一次进攻，与此同时，弗兰格尔的部队在西面向阿尔马维尔猛攻。幸运的是，我的健康问题似乎已经过去，因此我可以全力投入消灭第11集团军的战斗。

src: General Epanchin's III Corps, of the 1st Russian Army (Rennekampf) reached the city of Stalluponen and engaged General von Francois' I Corps of the 8th Army (von Prittwitz).
dst: 俄国第1集团军（连宁坎普夫）叶潘钦将军的第3军抵达斯托卢波嫩城，与第8集团军（冯·普里特维茨）冯·弗朗索瓦将军的第1军交战。

src: General Falkenhayn has the German troops carrying out an enveloping movement in the area of Minsk, while the Austro-Hungarian troops have been ordered to take Równe, an important transportation hub south of the Pripyat Marshes. However, the Russians are suspected to have built strong defense lines after their great retreat. Your job is to explore the eastern bank of Stokhid River.
dst: 法尔肯海因将军正指挥德军在明斯克地区实施包抄机动，而奥匈军队则奉命夺取罗夫诺——普里皮亚季沼泽以南的重要交通枢纽。不过，据怀疑俄国人在大撤退之后构筑了坚固的防线。您的任务是侦察斯托霍德河东岸。

src: General Foch has declared this day "Tout le monde a la bataille"- "Everyone into the Battle" Your Anzacs are to join in this offensive with the objective of breaking through the Hindenburg Line and seizing several key enemy positions. Success here could force the Germans into signing an Armistace.
dst: 福煦将军宣布今日为「Tout le monde a la bataille」——「人人投入战斗」。您的澳新军团将加入这次攻势，目标是突破兴登堡防线并夺取敌军若干关键阵地。此处的胜利可能迫使德国人签署停战协定。

src: General Foch has ordered us to attack on the whole northern front. So here are your orders: As you can see, the Heights of the Chappelle de Notre Dame de Loretto, in the west of Lens, are a very important strategical place: We must take them back!
dst: 福煦将军已命令我们在整个北部战线发起进攻。所以这是您的命令：如您所见，朗斯以西的洛雷托圣母教堂高地是一处非常重要的战略要地：我们必须把它们夺回来！

src: General Franco have called the Navarra brigades from the North Front  to stop the enemy attack, so you will receive good reinforcements, also from our German and Italian allies.
dst: 佛朗哥将军已从北部战线调来纳瓦拉旅以阻止敌军进攻，因此您将得到强有力的增援，还有我们德国和意大利盟友的增援。

src: General Franco have called the Navarra brigades from the North Front  to stop the enemy attack, we expect German and Italian air reinforcements.
dst: 佛朗哥将军已从北方战线调来纳瓦拉旅，以阻止敌军进攻，我们预计会得到德国和意大利的空中增援。

src: General Gallieni - gouverneur militaire de Paris - recognizes the unique opportunity to seriously disrupt our advance and moves General Manoury's complete Sixth Armee out of Paris to strike our flank. The North of the French counterattack does not meet any resistance, but your scouts have spotted the advance units of General Lamaze's V Group de Divisions de Reserve which is about to clash with IV Reserve Korps. The battle of the Marne is about to start here along the river l'Ourq at Monthyon.
dst: 加列尼将军——巴黎军事总督——认识到这是严重打乱我方推进的绝佳机会，遂将马努里将军的整个第6集团军调出巴黎，袭击我方侧翼。法军反攻的北段未遇任何抵抗，但您的侦察兵已发现拉马兹将军第5预备师群的先头部队，该部即将与第4预备军交锋。马恩河之战即将在此地、蒙蒂永的乌尔克河沿岸打响。

src: General Graziani told Mussolini that we lack trucks, fuel, ammo, tanks and just about everything else needed to conquer Egypt, but to no avail. We shall put an end to these English raids into Libya and liberate Egypt.
dst: 格拉齐亚尼将军告诉墨索里尼，我们缺少卡车、燃料、弹药、坦克，几乎所有征服埃及所需的东西都缺，但无济于事。我们将终结英军对利比亚的袭扰，并解放埃及。

src: General Hunter-Weston asked too much of his 29th Divison when he attacked at Krithia on April 28th. The Allied artillery barrage was meagre, and the troops were still exhausted from the landings. Nevertheless, some British troops actually reached the slopes of Achi Baba, but a strong Turkish counter-attack, that was only stopped by the guns of HMS Queen Elizabeth, pushed them back. The difficult terrain and the failure to co-ordinate the attack prevented success. The Allies withdrew, having sustained 3,000 casualties form the 14,000 engaged.
dst: 亨特-韦斯顿将军在4月28日进攻克里希亚时，对他的第29师要求过高。协约国的炮火准备很薄弱，部队在登陆后也仍精疲力尽。尽管如此，一些英军部队确实推进到了阿奇巴巴的山坡，但土耳其军一次强有力的反击——仅被「伊丽莎白女王」号战列舰的舰炮所阻止——把他们逼退了回去。崎岖的地形和进攻协调的失败使胜利无从谈起。协约国军队撤了下来，在参战的14000人中伤亡了3000人。

src: General Kornilov/ Armed Forces of Southern Russia
dst: General Kornilov/ 武装部队 of 南部俄罗斯

src: General Kuropatkin is very pleased with the results and has begun preparations for an offensive toward Port Arthur.
dst: 库罗帕特金将军对结果非常满意，已开始准备向旅顺口发起攻势。

src: General Lachambre idea is to take the village with a frontal assault combined with two flank manoeuvres. On the left, some troops under the command of Lachambre's son will clean the Gatludá hills on the other side of the San Agustín River and threaten rebels' positions in the main way. Teniente Coronel Villalón will protect the right flank and take the village of Paliparang. There he will join the column of Coronel Arizón to manoeuvre on the rear of the enemy, thus preventing Filipino rebels to escape. Unfortunately, it has been a while since we have not heard from Coronel Arizón and we are not sure when he will arrive.
dst: 拉尚布尔将军的构想是：以正面进攻配合两翼迂回来夺取该村。左翼，拉尚布尔之子指挥的一些部队将肃清圣奥古斯丁河对岸的加特卢达丘陵，威胁叛军在主道上的阵地。比利亚隆中校将掩护右翼并攻占帕利帕朗村。他将在那里与阿里松上校的纵队会合，向敌后机动，从而阻止菲律宾叛军逃脱。不幸的是，我们已有段时间没有阿里松上校的消息，也不确定他何时抵达。

src: General Lachambre, who has been assigned to combat the new insurgency in the Philippines, has asked you to go with him. Good luck!
dst: 被派去镇压菲律宾新起叛乱的拉尚布尔将军已请求您随他前往。祝您好运！

src: General Lee and President Davis flew to Richmond, capital of the CSA and their last stronghold.
dst: 李将军和戴维斯总统逃回了里士满——南方邦联的首都，也是他们最后的堡垒。

src: General Lee fought his way trough all our armies and stands now close to Washington....but more bad news: the enemy uses our famous strategy and flanks us.... we must draw back to better positions....
dst: 李将军一路击穿了我们所有的军队，现已逼近华盛顿……但还有更坏的消息：敌人运用了我们那套著名的策略，从侧翼包抄我们……我们必须后撤到更好的阵地……

src: General Leopoldo Garcia Peña, the Spanish military commander of Cavite Province, had 2,800 men loosely scattered in various small detachments across Cavite. Hard-pressed by around 12,000 enemy troops, he was not able to concentrate his forces. By May 31, Binakayan, Polvorin, Bacoor and Cavite Viejo had surrendered after they ran out of ammunition. In a few days, the entire province of Cavite was under the control of the revolutionaries (in reality, during the operation no US naval or land forces were involved). General Peña himself and his surviving troops were made prisoners.
dst: 甲米地省西班牙军事指挥官莱奥波尔多·加西亚·佩尼亚将军把2800人松散地分散在甲米地各处的小型分遣队中。面对约12000名敌军，他无力集中兵力。到5月31日，比纳卡扬、波尔沃林、巴科尔和老甲米地在弹药用尽后相继投降。短短几天内，整个甲米地省都处于革命者控制之下（实际上，这次行动中美方没有投入任何海陆军力量）。佩尼亚将军本人及其幸存部队被俘。

src: General Nivelle was superseded by General Philippe Pétain, who adopted a strategy of "healing and defence". Thus, the battle of the Chemin des Dames would be the last pure French offensive in the First World War. The French Supreme Command decided to wait for the American reinforces, since The United States had declared war on Germany on April 6, 1917, a few days before the Nivelle offensive.
dst: 尼韦勒将军被菲利普·贝当将军取代，贝当采取了「休整与防御」的战略。于是，贵妇小径之战成为第一次世界大战中最后一次纯粹由法国发动的攻势。法国最高统帅部决定等待美国援军，因为美国已于1917年4月6日——尼韦勒攻势前几天——对德宣战。

src: General Rennekampf believes that the German 8th Army has begun its retreat following this defeat.  He has resolved to screen the fortress of Koenigsberg with the XX and III Corps to the north.  The IV and II Corps have the task of pursuing the enemy.  However, Rennekampf has ordered a cautious advance because of strained supply lines.
dst: 伦嫩坎普夫将军认为，德军第8集团军在此次战败后已开始撤退。他决心以第20军和第3军在北面掩护柯尼斯堡要塞。第4军和第2军负责追击敌军。然而，由于补给线吃紧，伦嫩坎普夫下令谨慎推进。

src: General Sigel proposed to use one of our most successful strategies of the 48 revolution: General Lyon should occupy the enemy troops frontally and General Sigel and we will sneak into its back...
dst: 西格尔将军提议采用我们1848年革命中最成功的策略之一：由莱昂将军正面牵制敌军，而西格尔将军和我们则绕到其背后……

src: General Sigel's Men, Forward ! Attack them in their Back !
dst: 西格尔将军的士兵们，前进！从背后攻击他们！

src: General Staff orders you to return to Germany.
dst: 总参谋部命令你返回德国。

src: General Staff orders you to stop the British attack and destroy them.
dst: 总参谋部命令您阻止英军进攻并将其歼灭。

src: General Student and his Falshirmjager must occupy the island.
dst: 施图登特将军及其空降猎兵必须占领该岛。
维克托·贝拉尔米诺将军

src: General Weyler has started an active persecution of insurgent leader Maceo. Informants have told us that Maceo is hiding in the Cacarajicara Mountains, in Pinar del Río province, southwest of Havana. A strong column under Suarez Inclán will attack Cacarajicara from Bahía Honda.
dst: 韦勒将军已开始积极追剿起义军领袖马塞奥。线人告诉我们，马塞奥藏身于哈瓦那西南、比那尔德里奥省的卡卡拉希卡拉山区。苏亚雷斯·因克兰率领的一支强大纵队将从巴伊亚翁达进攻卡卡拉希卡拉。

src: General Yudenich has announced his goals for a most ambitious operation:  the capture of Petrograd.  You will begin this stage of the campaign in operations along the coast of the Gulf of Finland.
dst: 尤登尼奇将军已宣布了他那极为宏大的作战目标：攻占彼得格勒。您将沿芬兰湾海岸展开作战，开始战役的这一阶段。

src: General de Brigada Garc韆 Pe馻
General staff already ordered battleship Admiral Hipper to assist you. His crew knows the fjord well .
dst: 总参谋部已命令战列舰Admiral Hipper前来协助你。它的舰员对这片峡湾了如指掌。

src: General staff orders you to lead a special mission. Destroy the British Radar Factory. You will lead the attack only with ground units.
dst: 总参谋部命令你执行一项特殊任务：摧毁英国雷达工厂。你只能率领地面部队发起进攻。

src: General strike in Berlin. The newspaper district in the street "Kochstraße" is occupied and roadblocks are erected. Negotiations between the government Ebert and the USDP fail - Communist Party under the leadership of Liebknecht calls for armed insurrection. This is the scenario in which you find yourself.
dst: 柏林爆发总罢工。街道「科赫街」上的报馆区被占领，并筑起了路障。艾伯特政府与独立社会民主党之间的谈判破裂——以李卜克内西为首的共产党号召武装起义。您正身处这一局面之中。

src: General von Falkenhayn has however ordered us to attack at Ypres to test the first use of poisonous gas by our army and to divert attention away from his proposed offensive on the Eastern Front. Attacks south of Ypres have been delayed time and time again due to the wind blowing in the wrong direction. That is why your troops North of Ypres have gotten the order to dig in gas cylinders between the German and Entente front lines and to open them as soon as the wind blows strong enough in a favourable direction.
dst: 不过，冯·法尔肯海因将军命令我们在伊普尔发起进攻，以试验我军首次使用毒气，并把注意力从他拟议的东线攻势上引开。由于风向不对，伊普尔以南的进攻一再推迟。正因如此，您在伊普尔以北的部队接到命令，在德军与协约国战线之间埋设毒气钢瓶，一旦风向有利且风力足够，就立即打开。

src: General von Kressenstein, the German director of last year's vain Turco-German attack on the Suez Canal, has prepared a more formidable movement of invasion across the Sinai Desert. Instead of attempting a surprise attack across the centre of the Sinai wastes, the German commander has made a well-heralded movement along the ancient caravan track by the Mediterranean shore.
dst: 冯·克雷森施泰因将军——去年土德联军进攻苏伊士运河徒劳无功行动的德国主谋——已策划了一场更为可怕的穿越西奈沙漠的入侵。这位德军指挥官没有试图穿越西奈荒原中部发动奇袭，而是沿地中海沿岸那条古老的商队路线大张旗鼓地推进。

src: General you have the privilege of launching Operation Barbarossa against the Red Menace. Surprise is on our side. Destroy the Russian airforce on the ground and smash thru their weak defences. We have much ground to cover so a rapid advance would be favorable to us. First you must capture an airfield to resupply.
dst: 将军，你有幸对“红色威胁”发动巴巴罗萨行动。突然性在我们一边。在地面摧毁俄国空军，粉碎他们薄弱的防御。我们要推进的地域很广，所以神速推进对我们有利。首先你必须夺取一座机场以补充补给。

src: General!  We heard that you had died in a RAF attack!  I'm glad you are OK.
dst: 将军！我们听说你死于皇家空军的空袭！很高兴你没事。

src: General! As the Brits think that our harbor is mined, they are landing strong Indian reserve Troops on beaches around Tanga!
dst: 将军！由于英国人以为我们的港口布满了水雷，他们正让强大的印度预备役部队在坦噶周围的海滩登陆！

src: General! The Bolsheviks held Tarnopol! Your attack achieved little at great cost. You will have to explain yourself to Governor Horthy personally. You are relieved of command.
dst: 将军！布尔什维克守住了捷尔诺波尔！你的进攻代价高昂却收效甚微。你必须亲自向霍尔蒂摄政作出解释。你被解除指挥权。

src: General!? Do you realise what your bonehead attack has caused? We are far behind the schedule! You had better not do something like this again. Thanks to the Germans Tarnopol has been fallen into our hands at last.
dst: 将军！？你可知道你那愚蠢的进攻造成了什么后果？我们的进度已大大落后！你最好别再干这种事。多亏德国人，捷尔诺波尔终于落到了我们手中。

src: General, 90,000 German and Hungarian soldiers are cut off and surrounded in the Hungarian capital of Budapest. The first two attempts (codenamed Operation Konrad) to relieve the besieged Budapest have failed, and the encircled troops are exhausted, they are close to surrender. Your troops must force their way into the city immediately.
dst: 将军，9万名德国和匈牙利士兵在匈牙利首都布达佩斯被切断并合围。前两次代号「康拉德」的解围行动均告失败，被围部队已筋疲力尽，濒临投降。你的部队必须立刻强行突入该城。

src: General, Excuse me.............. Marshall! Please sit down.
dst: 将军，恕我失礼……是元帅！请坐。

src: General, Governor Horthy is afraid that negotiations would make no sense and Germany will guarantee current lines as Slovakia's borders. So you must act quickly! Attack the unprepared Slovaks, push the frontier back to a safe distance beyond the western watershed of the Ung Valley and protect Ungvár and the key railway to Poland.
dst: 将军，霍尔蒂摄政担心谈判毫无意义，而德国将保证以现有战线作为斯洛伐克的边界。所以你必须迅速行动！进攻毫无准备的斯洛伐克人，把边界推回至乌日河谷西面分水岭以外的安全距离，并保护乌日哥罗德和通往波兰的关键铁路。

src: General, Hitler insists that we push even harder to encircle Moscow!  How?  All our German formations are mere skeletons of what they should be!  This crazy cold winter is no excuse he says!  He is convinced the Russians are about to fall apart, I don't know what to think.
dst: 将军，希特勒坚持要我们更加拼命地合围莫斯科！怎么合围？我们所有的德军编队都只剩该有规模的空架子了！他说这个疯狂的寒冬不是借口！他坚信俄国人就要垮了，我真不知道该作何想。

src: General, I am sure that you and your men have given your best, but the Turkish resistance has just been too heavy. Our troops have suffered badly, and we had to call off this ill-fated offensive.
dst: 将军，我相信您和您的部下已尽了全力，但土耳其人的抵抗实在过于顽强。我军伤亡惨重，我们不得不取消这次注定多舛的攻势。

src: General, I appologise for calling you reckless - perhaps recklessness what just what we needed here!
dst: 将军，我为叫你鲁莽而道歉——也许鲁莽正是我们这里所需要的！

src: General, I appologise for calling you reckless, you seemed almost timid at times...........
dst: 将军，我为叫你鲁莽而道歉，你有时似乎又近乎怯懦……

src: General, I know your division has suffered severe losses against the Russians and that we sent you to Bukovina to be refitted, but the situation has changed. Romania declared war on us and is ready to launch a full scale invasion. Dorna-Watra, near the Hungarian border, is a small but important city. If it falls, our troops in Bukovina will be easily encircled by the Russian and Romanian forces. The Germans are busy on the Western front, and we have deployed our last reserves to halt Brusilov on the Eastern front, so don't expect much in the way of reinforcements. You must hold on at all costs!
dst: 将军，我知道您的师在对俄作战中损失惨重，也知道我们把您调到布科维纳是为了整补，但形势已经改变。罗马尼亚向我们宣战，并准备发动全面入侵。多尔纳-瓦特拉靠近匈牙利边境，是一座虽小却重要的城市。若它失守，我们在布科维纳的部队将轻易被俄军与罗马尼亚军队包围。德国人在西线忙得不可开交，而我们已把最后的预备队部署到东线去阻挡布鲁西洛夫，所以别指望能有多少援军。您必须不惜一切代价坚守！
