src: General, I was right for calling you reckless, and you get to explain yourself to Mussilini personally...........
dst: 将军，我叫你鲁莽果然没错，你就亲自去向墨索里尼解释吧……

src: General, Operation Market Garden has been started! British and US Paratroopers have already arrived in their drop zones close to their objectives. Your army is ordered to take the way into the north and clean the corridor from enemy units. Some units of the XXX. Corps will assist you. In a few days General Sosabowski and his Polish paratroopers will arrive near Arnhem. Be aware that the Germans have air superiority!
dst: 将军，市场花园行动已经开始了！英军与美军伞兵已抵达各自目标附近的空降场。你的部队奉命向北推进，肃清走廊中的敌军部队。第XXX军的部分部队将协助你。几天后索萨博夫斯基将军及其波兰伞兵将抵达阿纳姆附近。请注意，德国人拥有制空权！
将军，长官，干得漂亮，长官！

src: General, Sir, while most of our troops are already approaching the border between France and Belgium, your units are ordered to capture Dunkerque. The Germans declared the city a fortress and are well prepared and dug in. In the surrounding area we expect only little resistance of remnants of several German infantry divisions. The Germans still control several airfields in this area and you should expect some strong Luftwaffe fighter and bomber units as well.
dst: 将军阁下，虽然我军大部已在向法国与比利时边境推进，但你的部队奉命攻占敦刻尔克。德军宣布该城为要塞，准备充分并已构筑工事。在周边地区，我们预计只会遭到若干德军步兵师残部的轻微抵抗。德军仍控制着该地区的数座机场，你也应提防其部分强大的德国空军战斗机与轰炸机部队。

src: General, Sir, your next objective is to liberate the city of Caen and clear its vicinity from german units. You will field a powerful allied army, which is comming from our beachheads. Most of the germans are not at full strength but be aware that we received intelligence reports which mention strong enemy Panzer forces comming from the south and southwest. Be cautious!
dst: 将军，长官，你的下一个目标是解放卡昂城并肃清其周边的德军部队。你将率领一支强大的盟军部队，他们正从我们的登陆场开来。大多数德军兵力并不满员，但请注意，我们收到的情报报告提到有强大的敌军装甲部队正从南面与西南面开来。务必谨慎！

src: General, The Germans spearheads once again race across the step....leaving large pockets of Soviet forces behind for us to reduce.  Barenkovo has two soviet armies inside will attempt to breakout east.  Your corps must prevent this.
dst: 将军，德军的矛头再次横扫草原……身后留下大片苏军口袋交给我们去解决。巴伦科沃内有苏军的两个集团军，他们企图向东突围。你的军必须阻止这一点。

src: General, Welcome back to China and congratulations on your new promotion.  Your first task as a General of the Imperial Army will be to undertake an assault on to the key city of Nanchang an important crossroads.  It is also a major industrial city and the main port on the Gan River.  It is an enormous river which you will have to cross to assault the Chinese positions in the city.  The Chinese forces have been threatening our communications, troop movements, and our shipping by the Yangtze River with their air units deployed at Nanchang.  Our supply lines in China must not suffer from this menace - otherwise our troops won't receive enough supplies to continue with the advance over China.
dst: 将军，欢迎回到中国，并祝贺您晋升。作为帝国陆军将军，您的第一项任务是向关键城市南昌发起进攻——那是重要的交通枢纽。它也是一座重要的工业城市，是赣江上的主要港口。赣江是一条大河，您必须渡过它才能进攻城中的中国阵地。中国军队部署在南昌的空中单位，一直在威胁我们的通讯、部队调动以及长江航运。我们在中国的补给线绝不容受此威胁——否则我们的部队将得不到足够的补给，无法继续向中国纵深推进。

src: General, a quite impressive performance if I may say so. Thanks to your victory we have secured Spain and made it impossible for the Americans or British to land there. It appears that they were planning to do so during the next month. However, we can't leave Portugal as it is since the Allies might choose to invade from there.
dst: 将军，恕我直言，这表现相当出色。多亏你的胜利，我们确保了西班牙，使美英无法在此登陆。看来他们本打算下月登陆。不过，我们不能对葡萄牙听之任之，因为盟军可能从那里入侵。

src: General, a very capable performance. But Hitler is really furious! He has ordered an immediate cease-fire and we must leave Nagyszeben and respect the fact that Romania is our ally from now.
dst: 将军，这是一次相当出色的表现。但希特勒真的勃然大怒！他已下令立即停火，我们必须撤出纳吉塞本，并从今以后尊重罗马尼亚是我国盟友这一事实。

src: General, after having secured the beachheads our next objective will be the heights of Achi Baba, possession of which would allow our artillery to range over the entire peninsula. The Turks have established new lines in front of Krithia, a small town at the slope of Achi Baba. Your task is to break through the Turkish line of defence and reach the heights.
dst: 将军，在确保滩头阵地之后，我们的下一个目标将是阿奇巴巴高地，一旦拿下它，我们的炮兵就能俯瞰整个半岛。土耳其人已在克里希亚——阿奇巴巴山坡上的一座小镇——前方建立了新防线。您的任务是突破土耳其人的防线并抵达高地。

src: General, after our attempt to take the hills of the Sari Bair range has failed, we at least want to consolidate our meagre territorial gains. Hill 60, in the north of our sector, is the last obstacle between us and our troops at Suvla Bay. If you are able to take this hill - thus connecting our troops at ANZAC and Suvla - this would facilitate possible future operations.
dst: 将军，在我们夺取萨里拜尔山岭诸山丘的尝试失败之后，我们至少想巩固我们微薄的领土进展。位于我地段北面的60高地，是我们与苏夫拉湾部队之间最后的障碍。如果您能拿下这座山丘——从而把我们在澳新军团和苏夫拉的部队连接起来——这将为将来可能的行动提供便利。

src: General, after stopping the enemy on the coast, we have a new plan; the objective is the Indian city of Imphal, where the allied HQ is deployed. A victory attacking Imphal is strongly desired to delay the enemy advance on Burma.
dst: 将军，在沿海挡住敌军之后，我们有了新计划：目标是印度城市英帕尔，盟军指挥部就设在那里。我们迫切希望通过进攻英帕尔取胜，以迟滞敌军向缅甸的推进。

src: General, after the demanding and exhausting fight for the Hürtgen Forest your Army will be send back to Belgium for refreshes. Allied forces are about to launch Operation Pheasant, the liberation of Northern Brabant, Netherlands. After all your forces have reached combat readiness again, you are then ordered to join forces with the 1st Polish Armoured Division and liberate the cities of Breda, 's-Hertogenbosch, Tilbur, Bergen Op Zoom, Roosendaal, Dordrecht and their vicinity as part of Operation Pheasant.
dst: 将军，在许特根森林那场艰苦卓绝、令人疲惫的战斗之后，你的集团军将被调回比利时休整。盟军即将发起“雉鸡”行动，即解放荷兰北布拉班特北部。待你部所有部队重新达到战备状态后，你受命与波兰第1装甲师会合，作为“雉鸡”行动的一部分，解放布雷达、斯海尔托亨博斯、蒂尔堡、贝亨奥普佐姆、罗森达尔、多德雷赫特及其周边地区。

src: General, after your past victories near Melilla I really did expect more of you and your men. You have lost a very important town. No matter if we recover Alcazarquivir in a few weeks, our military prestige is seriously damaged. Now more and more men will join El Raisuli's harkas and our task here has become more difficult.
dst: 将军，在您于梅利利亚附近取得那些胜利之后，我原本确实对您和您的部下寄予了更高的期望。您丢掉了一座非常重要的城镇。即便我们几周内就收复阿尔卡萨基维尔，我们的军事威望也已严重受损。如今，越来越多的人将加入赖苏利的哈尔卡，我们在这里的任务变得更加艰难了。

src: General, air recon discoverd that the bridge over Sittang River was blown prematurely, this is your chance to destroy the 17th Indian Division.
dst: 将军，空中侦察发现锡当河上的大桥已被过早炸毁，这是您歼灭英印第17师的机会。

src: General, an enemy army, coming from the South !.... If we hold the actual positions, our Army, Washington and maybe the whole war is lost !....we must draw back and build a defense line on better positions...
dst: 将军，一支敌军正从南方而来！……如果我们固守现有阵地，我们的军队、华盛顿乃至整场战争可能都会输掉！……我们必须后撤，在更有利的阵地上构筑防线……

src: General, as you know the Kursk Salient poses a serious threat to us. To reduce this salient and restore the integrity of our line, we will attack from the north and south, pocket, and then crush the enemy trapped inside. You and your command will lead the southern thrust of our offensive. You must penetrate as far as the town of Prokhorovka. Good Luck.
dst: 将军，如您所知，库尔斯克突出部对我们构成严重威胁。为削平这一突出部并恢复我方战线的完整，我们将从南北两翼发起进攻，合围并歼灭被困其中的敌人。您和您的司令部将率领我军攻势的南翼突击。您必须突入至普罗霍罗夫卡镇。祝您好运。

src: General, as you know, Wehrmacht launched Operation Barbarossa, a large scale attack against the Soviet Union. You are commanding the Carpathian Group (consisting of the mechanized "Rapid Corps") as an attachment of Heeresgruppe Süd. After crossing the Dniester we have reached the defense lines of the Soviet 12th Army at the gates of Tarnopol. Instead of a frontal assault against the dug-in bolsheviks, try to surround them. You will attack in the South while elements of the German 17th Army will form the northern pincer. Good luck, General!
dst: 将军，如你所知，国防军已发动「巴巴罗萨」行动，即对苏联的大规模进攻。你指挥着喀尔巴阡集群（由机械化「快速军」编成），隶属南方集团军群。渡过德涅斯特河之后，我们已进抵捷尔诺波尔城下苏军第12集团军的防线。与其对掘壕据守的布尔什维克正面强攻，不如设法包围他们。你将在南面进攻，而德国第17集团军的部队将构成北面的钳臂。祝你好运，将军！

src: General, as you know, we regained some of the territories that we had lost by the Treaty of Trianon after the Great War. The First Vienna Award (one of the consequences of the Munich Agreement) separated 12.000 km2 territories from Czechoslovakia and awarded them to Hungary on November 2, 1938. On March 14, 1939 the Slovak people proclaimed their independence from Czecho-Slovakia. The very next day Wehrmacht invaded Bohemia and Moravia, and Hitler gave us permission to occupy the rest of Subcarpathia (10.000 km2), north up to the Polish border. This mission has just been complished. In our interpretation, the eastern Slovak boundary was only an internal Czechoslovak administrative line, not an internationally recognized boundary, and therefore in need of defining now that Subcarpathia has passed into our hands.
dst: 将军，如你所知，我们已经收复了大战之后因《特里亚农条约》而丧失的部分领土。第一次维也纳仲裁（慕尼黑协定的后果之一）于1938年11月2日从捷克斯洛伐克划出1.2万平方公里的领土并授予匈牙利。1939年3月14日，斯洛伐克人宣布脱离捷克斯洛伐克而独立。就在次日，国防军入侵波希米亚和摩拉维亚，希特勒也准许我们占领外喀尔巴阡的其余部分（1万平方公里），北抵波兰边界。这项任务刚刚完成。按我们的理解，斯洛伐克东部边界原本只是捷克斯洛伐克内部的一条行政线，并非国际公认的边界，因此在外喀尔巴阡已落入我们手中之后，现在有必要加以界定。

src: General, as you well know Rommel has been fighting in Africa for about a year now, and has managed to stop the British at El Agheila. Now he is surging forward and is approaching Tobruk. However we consider it very unlikely that he will take it because British opposition is simply much too strong. Our solution is to form a giant Kessel by taking Egypt from the north. On our way through Lebanon and Syria we have been able to liberate the interned French forces which will help us in Egypt.
dst: 将军，你很清楚，隆美尔已在非洲作战约一年，并在艾季达比耶阻止了英军。如今他正向前猛攻，逼近托布鲁克。但我们认为他不大可能拿下它，因为英军抵抗实在太强。我们的解决办法是：从北面夺取埃及，形成一个巨大的合围圈。在途经黎巴嫩和叙利亚时，我们得以解救被拘留的法军部队，他们将助我们征战埃及。

src: General, deploy your forces along the front lines we have reached in the past months. Be careful, the lines are not safe; althought we are near to Jilin, Changchun and Siping, the KMT forces still keep a strong attack axis near to our base at Linjiang. The mission will be a complete success if you can besiege Changchun and Jilin, and stop the KMT's assault on Linjiang, GRU spies reports our enemies will also try to recapture the section of the Beijing-Changchun railroad, which is also now our main supply line, protect it at any costs!
dst: 将军，把你的部队部署在我们过去几个月抵达的前线上。小心，这些战线并不安全；尽管我们已接近吉林、长春和四平，国民党军队仍在我们的临江基地附近保持着一条强大的进攻轴线。如果你能围困长春和吉林，并阻止国民党对临江的进攻，这次任务就会完全成功，格鲁乌间谍报告说，我们的敌人还会试图夺回北平-长春铁路的路段，那现在也是我们的主要补给线，不惜一切代价保住它！

src: General, despite your heroic efforts in these rearguard actions, the KuK troops are retreating without any order, complete regiments are deserting.
dst: 将军，尽管您在这些后卫战中英勇奋战，奥匈军队仍毫无秩序地撤退，整团整团的士兵在逃亡。

src: General, due to your incompetence the operation has been a total disaster! Take this gun. You are a man of honor so you will know what to do with it.
dst: 将军，由于您的无能，这次行动已是一场彻头彻尾的灾难！拿着这把枪。您是讲荣誉的人，该知道拿它做什么。

src: General, during the last days we had to endure a number of Turkish counter-attacks. Fortunately, we have been able to fight them off. Similar counter-attacks were repulsed at ANZAC Cove, so that General William Birdwood, commander of the Australian and New Zealand Army Corps, has deemed his front sufficiently secure to enable two brigades to be moved to Helles for our next assault on Krithia. The Australian 2nd Infantry Brigade and the New Zealand Infantry Brigade will join you during the forthcoming operation. Other British reinforcements include a Brigade from the Royal Naval Division and the 125th Brigade from the 42nd (East Lancashire) Division. Nevertheless, the men of your 29th Division will once again be at the forefront of the attack.
dst: 将军，最近几天我们不得不承受土耳其人的多次反攻。所幸我们都将其击退了。澳新军团湾也击退了类似的反攻，因此澳大利亚和新西兰军团指挥官威廉·伯德伍德将军认为他的战线已经足够稳固，可以调两个旅到海勒斯，参加我们对克里希亚的下一次进攻。澳大利亚第2步兵旅和新西兰步兵旅将在即将展开的行动中加入您。其他英军增援包括皇家海军师的一个旅，以及第42（东兰开夏）师的第125旅。尽管如此，您第29师的官兵仍将再次冲在进攻的最前面。

src: General, during the last weeks the British contingent on the Helles front has been expanded to three division and a brigade. However, the situation at Helles remains perilous. We are short of guns and ammunition. Furthermore, after HMS Triumph and HMS Majestic have been torpedoed by the enemy in May, the situation has even worsened as our naval gunfire support was reduced. Fortunately, our French ally has been able to lend us some of his fine 75s batteries that now have been deployed in our sector of the Helles front.
dst: 将军，过去几周里，海勒斯战线上的英军部队已扩充到三个师加一个旅。然而，海勒斯的局势依然险恶。我们缺少火炮和弹药。此外，5月间「凯旋」号和「威严」号相继被敌人用鱼雷击沉后，随着我军舰炮支援的减少，形势更是雪上加霜。所幸我们的法国盟友借给了我们一些他们精良的75毫米炮连，如今已部署在海勒斯战线我们这一地段。

src: General, even the Admiral was happy with your performance, he said it was quite remarkable how few of your men were sea-sick on the way across. On the other hand, what amazed me most of all was how you managed to fend of the American counter-attack! A very considerable part of the American army was trying to recapture Washington but they didn't manage it!
dst: 将军，连那位海军上将都对你的表现赞不绝口，他说渡海途中你的部下晕船的竟如此之少，实在难得。而最令我惊叹的是，你竟击退了美军的反攻！美军相当大一部分兵力试图夺回华盛顿，但没能得逞！

src: General, even though you did not manage it all as quickly as we thought you would, you managed to hold off the Czech tank corps long enough for other motorised divisions to cut their supply lines. You were heavily outnumbered but you prevailed - I think there will be an honour for you and your troops.
dst: 将军，尽管你未能如我们所愿那般迅速，但你还是拖住捷克坦克军足够久，让其他摩托化师得以切断其补给线。你兵力悬殊却最终取胜——我想你和你的部队将会获得嘉奖。

src: General, first of all, don't ask me why your unit has been assigned to this task, but I think you'll be transferred further north later on. The objective of the day is to secure Denmark. The Danish army is a joke with only two divisions, and only one of them is posted along the border. Crush them and take them prisoners. Secure all objectives in one day.
dst: 将军，首先别问我为何你的部队被派了这任务，但我估计你之后会被调往更北。今日目标是确保丹麦。丹麦军队只有两个师，是个笑话，且其中仅一个师驻守边境。击溃他们并俘虏他们。一天之内拿下所有目标。

src: General, for the first time we will fight on German soil. Your units have reached the Westwall fortifications. It is time to move into enemy homeland and capture the first major city.
dst: 将军，我们将首次在德国本土作战。你的部队已抵达齐格菲防线工事。是时候向敌方腹地推进，夺取第一座主要城市了。

src: General, get ready. Soon! I wish that this was just a bad dream, but if the reports are true, the entire Serbian front is in danger.
dst: 将军，做好准备。快了！我真希望这只是一场噩梦，但若报告属实，整条塞尔维亚战线都岌岌可危。

src: General, if Vicksburg is taken, only Port Hudson is left as last resort on the Mississipi for the rebels...
dst: 将军，如果拿下维克斯堡，叛军在密西西比河上就只剩下哈德逊港这最后一块立足之地了……

src: General, it is good fortune that you have been near. Strengthen immediately the front of Gettysburg with your men !
dst: 将军，您就在附近，真是幸运。请立即用您的部队加强葛底斯堡的正面防线！

src: General, it is my duty to inform you that you are under arrest. In consideration of your rank, General Cadorna will allow you to keep your sabre and your pistol while you are under the custody of the Italian army. Although I think that you won't be our prisoner for too long. It would surprise me that the Austro- Hungarian Empire didn't surrender in less than two months.
dst: 将军，我有责任通知您，您已被逮捕。考虑到您的军衔，卡多尔纳将军将允许您在意大利军队看押期间保留您的军刀与手枪。不过，我想您当俘虏的时间不会太久。若说奥匈帝国在不到两个月内还不投降，那才会让我吃惊。

src: General, let's talk frankly! Due to your poor leadership during this battle the situation for our troops here at Cape Helles has deteriorated. We still are far from reaching the heights of Achi Baba and are facing an enemy who's getting stronger and stronger every day.
dst: 将军，让我们坦率地说！由于您在这场战斗中的拙劣指挥，我们在海勒斯角部队的处境已经恶化。我们仍远未到达阿奇巴巴高地，而面对的敌人却一天比一天强大。

src: General, looking at our forces, I still feel that it is impossible to take Petersburg frontally; but with the support of your army corps we are able to lay siege to Petersburg and cut it off from all connections...
dst: 将军，看看我们的兵力，我仍觉得正面夺取彼得斯堡是不可能的；但有了您这个军的支援，我们就能包围彼得斯堡，切断它的一切联系……

src: General, los ojos del Duce y de toda Italia están puestos en usted, debemos demostrar a Europa entera como se conduce una guerra moderna. Debe usted ejecutar  una ofensiva relámpago contra Málaga, que servirá de base a Italia para sus operaciones futuras en todas direcciones.
dst: 将军，领袖和整个意大利的目光都注视着您，我们必须向全欧洲展示如何进行一场现代战争。您必须对马拉加发动一场闪电攻势，它将成为意大利日后向各个方向作战的基地。

src: General, nos encontramos ante un momento clave en esta guerra. Las órdenes de Roma son claras: Madrid debe caer y debe ser gracias a nuestro esfuerzo.  Deberá ser capaz de presionar y cumplir sus objetivos para poder trasladar nuestra presión a Madrid rodeando al enemigo.
dst: 将军，我们正处在这场战争的关键时刻。罗马的命令很明确：马德里必须陷落，而且必须归功于我们的努力。您必须能够施压并达成目标，从而通过包围敌人将我们的压力转移到马德里。

src: General, not bad for the most decorated soldier in the Wehrmacht. We've driven the Soviets across the Oka and onto the Volga. Now all that remains is to push them across Volga as well and we will have forced them out of Europe for ever!
dst: 将军，对国防军中获得勋章最多的军人来说，这表现不赖。我们已把苏军赶过奥卡河、逼至伏尔加河。如今只剩下把他们也赶过伏尔加河，我们就能把他们永远逐出欧洲了！

src: General, now that your old troops have left for the Eastern Front, you have gotten command of [VII] Korps which is part of Crown Prince Ruprecht's 6th Army. Divisions under your command are the 13th and 14th Infanterie Divisions and the Bavarian 6th Reserve Infanterie Division with a young Corporal that is to make history some day.
dst: 将军，您的老部队已开赴东线，如今您受命指挥[VII]军，该军隶属鲁普雷希特王储的第6集团军。归您指挥的师有第13和第14步兵师，以及巴伐利亚第6预备步兵师，后者营中有一位日后将名垂青史的年轻下士。

src: General, once again admirable! We knew that the Soviets were in the area helping the Republicans, but you beat them easily. Slightly ironic, isn't it, that the Republicans had more advanced equipment than the Russians!? Anyway, now we can start the assault of Madrid.
dst: 将军，又一次令人钦佩！我们早知苏军在该地区支援共和派，但你轻松击败了他们。说来有点讽刺——共和派的装备竟比俄国人的还先进！？总之，现在我们可开始进攻马德里了。

src: General, our breakout has run into difficulties! We are still holding the summit of Chunuk Bair, but we had to relieve the Wellington battalion which has suffered heavy casualties while defending Chunuk Bair, and replace those brave New Zealanders by two inexperienced New Army battalions. At Hill Q, the Gurkhas have been driven off the hill and are waiting for reinforcements at the slopes. Your troops are ordered to retake Hill Q by a determined assault as well as hold our positions at Chunuk Bair. The enemy is sending further regiments to the front line, and will have plenty of artillery available. We will try to give you as much fire support as possible, but don't expect too much.
dst: 将军，我们的突围陷入了困境！我们仍坚守着楚努克拜尔的山顶，但不得不把在防守楚努克拜尔时伤亡惨重的惠灵顿营撤下来，用两个缺乏经验的新军营替换那些英勇的新西兰人。在Q高地，廓尔喀人已被赶下山，正在山坡上等待增援。您的部队奉命以坚决的进攻重新夺取Q高地，同时守住我们在楚努克拜尔的阵地。敌人正把更多的团派往前线，并拥有充足的炮兵。我们会尽力给您尽可能多的火力支援，但不要期望过高。

src: General, our failure in this battle has broken the fighting spirit of our brave men. There are hardly enough troops left to hold our positions, let alone for another attack. The government is considering an evacuation. There are a lot of people back home who would like to see you court-martialed for this unique example of military incompetence. You are relieved of your command, Sir!
dst: 将军，我们在这场战斗中的失败摧毁了英勇将士的斗志。剩下的兵力连守住阵地都几乎不够，更不用说再次进攻了。政府正在考虑撤退。国内有许多人都想看到您因这个军事无能的反面典型而被送上军事法庭。您已被解除指挥权，先生！

src: General, our next main objective will be the Rhine river. But before we can get closer to the Rhine, we have to keep our flanks save. You and your men are ordered to replace the 9th and 28th Infantry Divisions which entered the Hürtgen Forest, but gained little ground only. Now they are worn down and entrenched in their positions.
dst: 将军，我们的下一个主要目标将是莱茵河。但在我们能更接近莱茵河之前，我们必须保证两翼安全。你和你的部下奉命接替进入许特根森林（Hürtgen Forest）的第9与第28步兵师，但他们只夺取了很少的地盘。如今他们已疲惫不堪，只能据守在阵地上。

src: General, regarding your previous performance, Governor Horthy chose you to lead the 3rd Corps of the 2nd Army. You will join the Heeresgruppe Süd and will participate in the new major German offensive codenamed Fall Blau. Push back the Bolsheviks behind the Don River and take Voronezh and all key cities in the area. You will be supported by the German 4th Panzer Army.
dst: 将军，鉴于你此前的表现，霍尔蒂摄政选中你统领第2集团军的第3军。你将加入南方集团军群，参与代号「蓝色」行动的德军新一轮大规模攻势。把布尔什维克压回顿河彼岸，夺取沃罗涅日及该地区的所有关键城市。德国第4装甲集团军将为你提供支援。

src: General, since our failed August offensive, there have been discussions going on about breaking off this whole ill-fated campaign. Recently, Bulgaria has joined the Central Powers, so that Germany now can supply the Turks with heavy artillery and ammunition by rail to Istanbul which makes our situation even more precarious. Furthermore, troops are needed to support Serbia and Greece against the Central Powers' combined offensive in the Balkans.  In November, Lord Kitchener visited the peninsula to get a clear picture of the situation here at the Dardanelles Front and finally accepted the need for evacuation. In December, the evacuation of our troops at Suvla and ANZAC was completed successfully.
dst: 将军，自我们8月攻势失败以来，关于中止这场注定多舛战役的讨论就一直在进行。最近，保加利亚加入了同盟国，德国如今可以通过铁路向伊斯坦布尔运送重炮和弹药，这使我们的处境更加岌岌可危。此外，还需要部队去支援塞尔维亚和希腊，抵御同盟国在巴尔干的联合攻势。11月，基钦纳勋爵视察了半岛，以摸清达达尼尔战线这里的实际情况，最终接受了必须撤退的结论。12月，我们在苏夫拉和澳新军团的部队完成了成功的撤退。

src: General, since the naval defeat of our fleet by Commodore Dewey's U.S Asiatic Squadron in the waters of Cavite (Manila Bay) on 1 May 1898, Manila has been surrounded both by US vessels and by Aguinaldo's Filipino rebel ground forces. The U.S Army under General Merril has now disembarked and it is moving towards Manila to assault and occupy the city.
dst: 将军，自1898年5月1日我舰队在甲米地（马尼拉湾）水域被杜威准将的美国亚洲分舰队击败以来，马尼拉就一直被美国舰船和阿吉纳尔多的菲律宾起义地面部队所包围。由梅里尔将军率领的美国陆军现已登陆，正向马尼拉推进，以攻占该城。

src: General, some enemy harkas led by El Raisuli have been seen near the village of Kesiva near the coastal town of Arcila. Apparently he has ventured near our lines in order to get supplies for his men. We must stop him immediately so he can't take control of the road which goes from Larache to Tangier. Prepare your troops and drive El Raisuli back to his mountains!
dst: 将军，有人看到一些由赖苏利率领的敌方哈尔卡出现在沿海城镇阿尔西拉附近的凯西瓦村一带。显然，他冒险逼近我方战线，是为了给部下筹措补给。我们必须立即阻止他，免得他控制从拉拉什通往丹吉尔的道路。准备好您的部队，把赖苏利赶回他的山里去！

src: General, starting in 1908 some Riffian "kabilas" near Melilla have been revolting.  They have built up their irregular army by purchasing foreign weapons, and now they have attacked the Spanish workers in the area.  Some tribal leaders are claiming a holy war against Spain and the Riffian harkas (the Moroccan irregular forces) have put Melilla in great danger.
dst: 将军，从1908年起，梅利利亚附近的一些里夫「卡比拉」部族就一直作乱。他们通过购买外国武器组建起自己的非正规军，如今又袭击了该地区的西班牙工人。一些部族首领叫嚣要对西班牙发动圣战，里夫的哈尔卡（摩洛哥非正规武装）已将梅利利亚置于极大的危险之中。

src: General, such a victory! But Hitler is really furious! He ordered an immediate cease-fire and we must leave Nagyszeben and respect the fact that Romania is our ally from now.
dst: 将军，何等的胜利！但希特勒真的勃然大怒！他已下令立即停火，我们必须撤出纳吉塞本，并从今以后尊重罗马尼亚是我国盟友这一事实。

src: General, take your men and clear the whole Peninsula, then attack Cherbourg. Intelligence reports that there are two defence lines. The outer defence line is located few miles out of the city, while Cherbourg itself is heavily fortified. More german units are dispersed across the peninsula. You should not wait for naval support. The waters are heavily mined and High Command is unwilling to risk precious capital ships. Good luck!
dst: 将军，带上你的人肃清整个半岛，然后进攻瑟堡。情报显示有两道防线。外围防线位于城外数英里处，而瑟堡本身防御工事极为坚固。半岛各处还散布着更多德军部队。你不应等待海军支援。这片水域布设了大量水雷，最高统帅部不愿拿宝贵的capital ships冒险。祝你好运！

src: General, thank God you are here! Our advance into the Rif mountains, west of Melilla,  has met much more resistance than we had expected. The "kabilas" from the Rif are commanded by the Cadi, Abd el-Krim al Jatabbi, a former employee of the colonial administration in the Office of Indigenous Affairs in Melilla who has been educated in Spain, and now is the leader of the Beni Urriaguel tribe. Abd el-Krim has declared jihad against the Spanish invaders, and in June our offensive halted when the Berbers retook the position at Abarrán.
dst: 将军，谢天谢地您来了！我们向梅利利亚以西的里夫山区推进，遇到的抵抗远超出我们的预期。里夫的「卡比拉」由卡迪阿卜杜·克里姆·哈塔比指挥，他曾在梅利利亚殖民地行政当局的土著事务处任职，在西班牙接受过教育，如今是本尼乌里亚格勒部族的首领。阿卜杜·克里姆已对西班牙入侵者宣布圣战，六月，当柏柏尔人重新夺回阿瓦兰阵地时，我们的攻势停滞了下来。

src: General, thanks to your stunning blow to the Americans in the north, we now have the opportunity to encircle the American army in the East. Make a thrust to Savannah and cut the rest of the country off from their army!
dst: 将军，多亏你在北方对美军的一记重击，我们现在有机会合围东部的美军了。向萨凡纳突击，把这个国家的其余地区与他们的军队切断！

src: General, that final victory lead to the total collapse of the Soviet armed forces. The new government established in Khabarovsk has signed its surrender of all land, air and sea forces west of the Volga and Kama. There are fireworks in Berlin, Rome, Paris, Bukarest and Helsinki to celebrate this final victory over communism. It will never again be a threat to Europe!!
dst: 将军，那最后的胜利导致了苏联武装力量的总崩溃。在哈巴罗夫斯克成立的新政府已签署投降书，交出伏尔加河与卡马河以西的全部陆海空兵力。柏林、罗马、巴黎、布加勒斯特和赫尔辛基燃放烟花，庆祝这场对共产主义的最终胜利。它再也无法威胁欧洲了！！

src: General, that was the greatest fiasco I have seen since the charge of the Kuirassiers into French machine gun positions in 1914! What do you think you are doing? You deliberately disobeyed the order to advance quickly - prepare yourself for a court martial!
dst: 将军，这是自1914年胸甲骑兵冲击法军机枪阵地以来我所见过最惨的败仗！你究竟在干什么？你故意违抗了快速推进的命令——准备上军事法庭吧！

src: General, the British forces are hurt badly. You should rest before the next battle.
dst: 将军，英军已遭重创。你应在下一场战斗前休整。

src: General, the enemy fought valiantly, but this did not stop you. And now the last Bolshevist reserves await your attack. Defeat them! And end this war!
dst: 将军，敌人英勇作战，但这并未挡住你。现在布尔什维克最后的预备队正等着你进攻。击败他们！结束这场战争！

src: General, the eyes of the Duce and of all of Italy are upon you; we must show all of Europe how to conduct a modern war. You must start a lightning attack against Malaga, so it will be our center for future operations.
dst: 将军，领袖和整个意大利的目光都注视着您；我们必须向全欧洲展示如何进行一场现代战争。您必须对马拉加发动一场闪电攻势，从而使其成为我们日后作战的基地。

src: General, the orders for the final assault on Jerusalem have been given!
dst: 将军，对耶路撒冷发动最后突击的命令已经下达！

src: General, the russians are launching a massive attack on our front. You must create a defensive line and hold them back. Their reinforcements are limted in this area so once they have smashed themselves on your defences you must launch a counterattack and take this sector.
dst: 将军，俄军正对我军前线发动大规模进攻。你必须建立防线并挡住他们。他们在此地区的增援有限，所以一旦他们在你的防线上撞得头破血流，你就必须发起反攻并拿下这一地段。

src: General, the situation is critical.  The Soviets have encircled 6 divisions at Korsun-Shevchenkovsky.  Hitler has refused to allow the trapped men to break out.  So, Manstein has gathered the bulk of his tank strength to save the two corps.  We must drive forward at once, before they are destroyed!
dst: 将军，局势危急。苏军已在科尔孙-舍甫琴科夫斯基合围了6个师。希特勒拒绝让被困部队突围。于是曼施泰因集结了大部分坦克兵力去解救这两个军。我们必须立即向前推进，趁他们尚未被歼灭！

src: General, there are alarming news coming from South East Asia. Evidently a certain Colonel S. Brown are leading a revolt against us. Rumour as it that Mr. Brown is a specialist in jungle warfare and stacked fortifications, so cut his forces off
dst: 将军，东南亚传来令人担忧的消息。显然，某位 S. 布朗上校正在领导一场针对我们的叛乱。有传言说布朗先生擅长丛林战和堆叠工事，所以要切断他的部队。

src: General, this has been a day when survival must be regarded as a victory! The tenacity of the enemy has been extraordinary. But despite the stout resistance of the Turks, your troops have established a bridgehead at the tip of the Gallipoli peninsula. However, your advance has been slower than we expected.
dst: 将军，今天能活下来就必须算作一场胜利！敌人的顽强非同寻常。但尽管土耳其人抵抗坚决，您的部队还是在加里波利半岛顶端建立了桥头堡。不过，您的推进速度比我们预期的要慢。

src: General, this is Admiral von Schneider. He will brief you for this next mission.
dst: 将军，这位是冯·施耐德海军上将。他将为你的下一项任务作简报。

src: General, this is a glorious day for Germany! We have taken Moscow and Stalin is our prisoner! The enemy is in desperate flight for the Urals! The decapitation has left him in chaos! Leningrad will fall in two days at the latest and nobody can believe we will be defeated anymore! You, General, will get the Grosskreuz des Eisernen Kreuzes - the highest decoration for an officer to date! And here is the voice of Stalin himself, now a prisoner of the Reich! [Stalin speaking]
dst: 将军，今天是德国的光荣之日！我们攻占了莫斯科，斯大林成了我们的俘虏！敌人正仓皇逃向乌拉尔！群龙无首使他们陷入混乱！列宁格勒最迟两日内陷落，再无人相信我们会失败了！将军，你将获颁大铁十字勋章——迄今军官所能获得的最高勋章！而现在，是斯大林本人的声音——他已是德意志帝国的阶下囚！[斯大林讲话]

src: General, this is a glorious day for Germany! We have taken Moscow and the enemy is in desperate flight for the Urals!
dst: 将军，这是德国的光荣之日！我们已经攻占莫斯科，敌军正仓皇逃向乌拉尔！

src: General, this is a very urgent matter - Italy is no longer our ally! There has been a coup against Mussolini! Our troops in Italy are completely surrounded and have absolutely no chance to retreat, there are clusters everywhere. Mussolini is besieged in a fortress. You must get Mussolini out, you must relieve our own troops and you must get Mussolini back into power.
dst: 将军，这是十万火急之事——意大利已不再是我们的盟友！有人发动了针对墨索里尼的政变！我们在意大利的部队被完全包围，毫无退路，处处都是围困。墨索里尼被困在一座要塞里。你必须救出墨索里尼，必须解救我军的围困，还必须让墨索里尼重掌大权。

src: General, this is not what I would like to call good. Or even sufficient. I don't think I have to point out your mistakes to you... you have a new post, your division will find better care under a more capable officer. You are the new head of the War Graves Commission.
dst: 将军，这可称不上好，甚至连合格都谈不上。我想不必向你点明你的错误了……你有了新任命，你的师将由一位更称职的军官统率。你如今是阵亡将士墓地委员会的新主任。

src: General, this is tragic. Moscow remains Russian. The Russians managed to get in reinforcements - there is no hope to take Moscow this year. We will be lucky if we can hold even just our positions around Moscow! Like Napoleon we have been defeated at Moscow.
dst: 将军，这真是悲剧。莫斯科仍在俄国人手中。俄国人设法调来了援军——今年拿下莫斯科已无希望。我们能守住莫斯科周边的阵地就算走运了！我们像拿破仑一样，在莫斯科城下折戟。

src: General, this offensive is our last hope. Hitler has grouped 1st and 2nd SS Panzer Corps West of Székesfehérvár in an attempt to retake the Transdanube area from the Bolsheviks, thereby destroying the Bolsheviks in the area between the Drava, the Danube and the Balaton. You must go to help them. If you could throw the Bolsheviks back to the Danube, they lost their initiative and we would stand until Allies would reach our western borders. Save your country from the Communist occupation!
dst: 将军，这次攻势是我们最后的希望。希特勒已把党卫军第1和第2装甲军集结在塞克什白堡以西，力图从布尔什维克手中夺回外多瑙地区，从而歼灭德拉瓦河、多瑙河与巴拉顿湖之间地域内的布尔什维克。你必须前去支援他们。若你能把布尔什维克打回多瑙河，他们就会丧失主动权，我们便能支撑到盟军抵达我国西部边界。把你的国家从共产党的占领下拯救出来！

src: General, this was a disaster! You have been defeated by an irregular army composed mainly of shepherds and farmers!  Now even Melilla is in danger after more than four centuries under Spanish rule.  We'll have to beg France for help and that means that we'll lose all of our territorial concessions in northern Morocco. It is obvious that you are incapable of commanding an army on a real battlefield. If there is a spark of honor in you, you will resign and ask for your retirement immediately.
dst: 将军，这真是一场灾难！您竟然被一支主要由牧羊人和农夫组成的非正规军打败了！如今，就连在西班牙统治下长达四个多世纪的梅利利亚都岌岌可危。我们将不得不低声下气地乞求法国相助，而那就意味着我们将失去在北摩洛哥的全部领土租让地。显然，您没有能力在真正的战场上指挥军队。如果您心中还有一丝荣誉感，就请立即辞职，申请退休吧。

src: General, this was nothing less than a disaster! The Turkish machine-guns mowed down our men. Whole Battalions have been wiped out. This failure has broken the fighting spirit of our brave men. There are hardly enough men left to hold our positions, let alone for another attack. The government is considering an evacuation. There are a lot of people back home who would like to see you court-martialed for this unique example of military incompetence. You are relieved of your command!
dst: 将军，这简直就是一场灾难！土耳其人的机枪扫倒了我军士兵。整营整营的部队被歼灭。这次失败摧毁了我们英勇将士的斗志。剩下的兵力连守住阵地都几乎不够，更不用说再次进攻了。政府正在考虑撤退。国内有许多人都想看到您因这个军事无能的反面典型而被送上军事法庭。您已被解除指挥权！

src: General, this was nothing less than a disaster! The Turkish machine-guns mowed down our men. Whole Battalions have been wiped out. This failure has broken the fighting spirit of our brave men. There are hardly enough men left to hold our positions, let alone for another attack. The government is considering an evacuation. There are a lot of people back home who would like to see you court-martialed for this unique example of military incompetence. You are relieved of your command, Sir!
dst: 将军，这简直就是一场灾难！土耳其人的机枪扫倒了我军士兵。整营整营的部队被歼灭。这次失败摧毁了我们英勇将士的斗志。剩下的兵力连守住阵地都几乎不够，更不用说再次进攻了。政府正在考虑撤退。国内有许多人都想看到您因这个军事无能的反面典型而被送上军事法庭。您已被解除指挥权，先生！

src: General, we are about to invade Britain. Your two Corps will head the assault. Your task here is relatively simple - take Southampton.
dst: 将军，我们即将入侵不列颠。你的两个军将担当突击先锋。你在这里的任务相对简单——拿下南安普敦。

src: General, we are going to renew our offensive here at Suvla Bay. For this purpose, we have been reinforced by dismounted Yeomanry of the 2nd Mounted Divsion, which will be our reserve for this attack. Your 29th Division and 11th Division have been given the order to storm Scimitar Hill and the heights of Ismail Oglu Tepe, also called the "W Hills". The enemy on these hills is heavily entrenched and has used the last quiet days on this part of the front to build a formidable defence position that will be a hard nut to crack. Nevertheless, we have to take these heights if any real progress is to be made.
dst: 将军，我们即将在苏夫拉湾恢复攻势。为此，我们得到了第2骑兵师徒步义勇骑兵的增援，他们将成为这次进攻的预备队。您的第29师和第11师已接到命令，向弯刀山和伊斯梅尔奥卢泰佩高地——又称「W高地」——发起猛攻。这些山丘上的敌人深挖壕沟据守，并利用战线这一地段最近平静的日子构筑了坚固的防御阵地，这将是块难啃的硬骨头。尽管如此，要想取得任何真正的进展，我们就必须拿下这些高地。

src: General, we are in a complex situation. The Allies have launched a powerful offensive against our positions at Mandalay, which is our main base in this sector. Your mission is to hold the line at any cost!
dst: 将军，我们处境复杂。盟军已对我军在本地区的主要基地曼德勒的阵地发起强大攻势。您的任务是不惜一切代价守住防线！

src: General, we are in a key moment in this war. Rome's orders are clear: Madrid should fall and it must be by to our troops. You must attack and reach your objectives to encircle Madrid.
dst: 将军，我们正处在这场战争的关键时刻。罗马的命令很明确：马德里应当陷落，而且必须由我军来完成。您必须发起进攻并达成目标，以包围马德里。

src: General, we cannot afford any more lackluster performances from you. You are relieved of your duties.
dst: 将军，我们再也承受不起你这样平庸的表现了。你被解除职务。

src: General, we have established a bridgehead at Suvla Bay, but the Turks are still in control of the heights. Right now the enemy might not yet be strong enough for a decisive counter-attack, but our situation is quite uncomfortable, and we should act, until Johnny Turk is able to throw us back into the sea. A first assault on the Kiretch Tepe Ridge has failed three days ago. Not a single soldier of the 1/5th Norfolks battalion has returned from this attack. Now GHQ has decided to mount a final major attack along the same ridge.
dst: 将军，我们已在苏夫拉湾建立了桥头堡，但高地仍掌握在土耳其人手中。眼下敌人或许还没有强大到足以发动决定性反攻，但我们的处境相当难受，我们应当趁土耳其佬还能把我们赶回大海之前采取行动。三天前对基雷奇泰佩山脊的第一次进攻失败了。诺福克团第1/5营没有一个士兵从这次进攻中回来。现在总司令部已决定沿同一条山脊发起最后一次大规模进攻。

src: General, we have to take these important navy bases under all circumstances ... best land your troops on the peninsula north of Fort Fisher but keep some landing units for landing in th outmost west, after the sea has been cleared from enemies.
dst: 将军，我们无论如何都必须拿下这些重要的海军基地……最好让部队在费舍尔堡以北的半岛登陆，但要保留一些登陆部队，待海上敌人被肃清后，用于在最西端登陆。

src: General, we send you a ship to support your troops. hurry up ! we need boonville fast !
dst: 将军，我们派一艘船去支援您的部队。抓紧时间！我们需要尽快拿下布恩维尔！

src: General, we took Gaza and should claim a splendid victory - but our Higher Command decided to call off the attack and retreat, delivering victory to the Turks. What a disgrace!
dst: 将军，我们攻下了加沙，本应宣称一场辉煌的胜利——但我们的最高统帅部却决定取消进攻并撤退，把胜利拱手让给了土耳其人。真是奇耻大辱！

src: General, welcome back to Morocco. You haven't missed much action these past two years. Spain is determined to remain neutral in the Great War that is devastating Europe, and among other things that means that we must keep the local "status quo" in Morocco at all costs. If we started huge military campaigns that would undoubtedly affect the French interests in Morocco. We wish to avoid that, so things have been quite calm here.
dst: 将军，欢迎回到摩洛哥。过去这两年，您没有错过多少战事。西班牙决心在这场蹂躏欧洲的大战中保持中立，这尤其意味着我们必须不惜一切代价维持摩洛哥本地的「现状」。如果我们发动大规模军事行动，无疑会损害法国在摩洛哥的利益。我们希望避免那种情况，所以这里一直相当平静。

src: General, welcome to Djebala, the western region of our protectorate in Morocco. Not long ago, the situation here was relatively calm. We  tried to forge an alliance with the most powerful local leader: Mulay Mohamed El Raisuli, "The Sultan of the mountains", a combination of feudal lord and bandit who is both admired and feared by the Berber tribesmen. At first, El Raisuli accepted the alliance. He saw our army as powerful enough to be helpful, but powerless enough not to be a menace.
dst: 将军，欢迎来到杰巴拉，我们在摩洛哥保护国的西部地区。不久之前，这里的局势还相对平静。我们曾试图与当地最有权势的首领结盟：穆莱·穆罕默德·赖苏利，「群山苏丹」，一个集封建领主与土匪于一身的人物，柏柏尔部族对他既敬且畏。起初，赖苏利接受了联盟。他认为我们的军队足够强大、能帮上忙，却又不够强大、构不成威胁。

src: General, welcome to the East. Let me brief you. The government in Berlin has finally decided that it is time to destroy our sworn enemies - the Bolsheviks. Your attack here at Brest-Litowsk will be the opening hour of Operation Barbarossa. Along a front line 3000km long, guns will open fire. The enemy should be completely surprised and you'll be able to cross the Bug river with almost no resistance. Good luck all the same!
dst: 将军，欢迎来到东方。我来为您做简报。柏林政府终于决定，是时候消灭我们誓不两立的敌人——布尔什维克了。您在此地对布列斯特-立托夫斯克的进攻，将是巴巴罗萨行动的开场时刻。在长达3000公里的战线上，火炮将同时开火。敌人应当会完全措手不及，您将几乎不会遇到抵抗就能渡过布格河。还是祝您好运！

src: General, well done. The British have panicked and retreated to the area around Bardia and Sollum, where they are trying to pull off the same thing they tried at Dunkirk.
dst: 将军，干得好。英国人慌了神，退到巴尔迪亚和索卢姆周边，想在那里重演他们在敦刻尔克玩过的那一套。

src: General, what happened to you? After all of your excellent past performances, it seems that you've reached your limit. Our offensive has been a failure, the Germans have retreated in good order, and we've suffered tens of thousands of casualties. It's time for you to retire. We need a younger commander who fully understands the new weapons and the warfare strategies of the future.
dst: 将军，您怎么了？在以往所有的出色表现之后，看来您已经到了极限。我们的攻势失败了，德军秩序井然地撤退，而我们伤亡数万。是您该退役的时候了。我们需要一位更年轻、更充分理解新式武器和未来战争策略的指挥官。

src: General, when we gave you this mission, we firmly believed that it wouldn't be hard for you to beat our enemies. Obviously, we were wrong. A handful of starving Germans managed to stop you somehow.
dst: 将军，当我们把这项任务交给您时，我们坚信您击败敌人并非难事。显然，我们错了。一小撮饥肠辘辘的德国人竟然设法挡住了您。

src: General, you and your brave men must destroy the invaders.... Close the gap and throw them back again to the other shore of the Jordan.
dst: 将军，您和您英勇的部下必须消灭入侵者……封住缺口，把他们赶回约旦河对岸。

src: General, you are a disgrace to the German Wehrmacht!! The newspapers are full of jokes about our incompetence, a comedy will be shown in the cinemas portraying your conduct, and the High Command is furious! Get out of my office at once!
dst: 将军，你是德国国防军的耻辱！！报纸上满是嘲讽我们无能的段子，影院还将上映一出描绘你所作所为的喜剧，最高统帅部怒不可遏！立刻滚出我的办公室！

src: General, you are ordered to launch the final assault on the french stronghold Dien Bien Phu. The french army is trapped in the valley and short of equipment, but still consits of some of their best Forreign Legion units and they even field some tanks, but that won't be enough to stop us!
dst: 将军，你奉命对法军据点奠边府发起最后突击。法军被困在谷地中，装备短缺，但其编成中仍有一些他们最精锐的外籍军团部队，他们甚至投入了一些坦克，但这不足以阻挡我们！

src: General, you certainly showed that Adlerfellow the superiority of fascism over socialism! Hehe.. This is the final victory - the second World War is at an end! The High Command and all of Germany are extremely grateful to you!
dst: 将军，你确确实实向那个阿德勒家伙展示了法西斯主义对社会主义的优越性！嘿嘿……这是最后的胜利——第二次世界大战结束了！最高统帅部和整个德国都对你感激不尽！

src: General, you did it. But Hitler is really furious! He has ordered an immediate cease-fire and we must leave Nagyszeben and respect the fact that Romania is our ally from now.
dst: 将军，你做到了。但希特勒真的勃然大怒！他已下令立即停火，我们必须撤出纳吉塞本，并从今以后尊重罗马尼亚是我国盟友这一事实。

src: General, you failed to push back French and British forces that are now in an excellent position to launch follow-up attacks. Luckily we have more prepared defensive lines to fall back to.
dst: 将军，您未能击退法军和英军，他们现在正处在发动后续进攻的绝佳位置。幸运的是我们还有更多构筑好的防线可以退守。

src: General, you have achieved our highest goal; the unconditional surrender of Chiang-Kai-Shek!   Seven years of bloody battles have come at an enormous price.  All the resources and other supplies from China will be now included in the Co-Prosperity Sphere!  Omedetogozaimasu!
dst: 将军，您实现了我们的最高目标：蒋介石无条件投降！七年血战付出了极其惨重的代价。中国的全部资源与其他物资如今都将纳入共荣圈！恭喜！

src: General, you have been condecorated with the Iron cross with swords and oak leaves about his great actions. Good work, now we must finalize the Norway invasion.
dst: 将军，鉴于您卓著的战功，您被授予佩剑橡叶铁十字勋章。干得好，现在我们必须完成对挪威的入侵。

src: General, you have been given command over the whole landing operation at Suvla Bay, five miles north of ANZAC cove. This area is known to be only lightly defended, so after you have dealt with the Turkish defences at the landing sites, you should advance inland as swiftly as possible and take the hills that overlook the plain - Kiretch Tepe to the north and Tekke Tepe to the east. You also should occupy the smaller hills east of the salt lake. A successful landing at Suvla could achieve in one determined advance what several months of campaigning have failed to accomplish: the Turkish right could be turned and help our comrades at ANZAC to break out and occupy the Sari Bair ridge, the key to the entire campaign.
dst: 将军，您受命指挥整个苏夫拉湾登陆行动，地点在澳新军团湾以北五英里。据了解，这一地区防守薄弱，因此在您解决登陆点的土耳其守军之后，应尽快向内地推进，夺取俯瞰平原的山丘——北面的基雷奇泰佩和东面的泰克泰佩。您还应占领盐湖以东那些较小的山丘。苏夫拉一次成功的登陆，或许能靠一次坚决的推进，做到数月苦战都未能实现的事：迂回土耳其军的右翼，并帮助我们在澳新军团的战友突围、占领整个战役的关键——萨里拜尔山脊。

src: General, you have been promoted to C-I-C of the defense of Tokyo, it's an enormous honor to protect the Imperial capital... isn't it?. Let me inform you about the reports we have about the enemy movements. We know they are going to disembark in two main fronts, one southwards from Tokyo, and another one in the East. According to our sources, the Americans have assembled a huge mass of Assault ships, supported by carriers and many warships.
dst: 将军，您已被晋升为东京防御总司令，保卫帝国首都是一项无上荣耀……不是吗？请允许我向您通报我们掌握的敌军动向情报。我们知道他们将主要在两条战线上登陆，一条在东京以南，另一条在东面。据我们的情报来源，美国人已集结了庞大的登陆舰群，并有航母与众多战舰支援。

src: General, you have done it! Your victory allows the withdrawal of our encircled troops from Transylvania.
dst: 将军，你做到了！你的胜利使我们得以把被围部队从特兰西瓦尼亚撤出。

src: General, you have done your best, but our troops are still too novice to try to defeat the enemy. At least you have managed to stand up to the liberals, and soon we will have more opportunities to beat them.
dst: 将军，您已尽了全力，但我们的部队仍过于稚嫩，还无法击败敌人。至少您已能与自由派分庭抗礼，很快我们就会有更多机会击败他们。

src: General, you have lost the battle and your army suffered heavy casualties.
dst: 将军，你输掉了这场战斗，你的集团军伤亡惨重。

src: General, you have lost the battle but saved your army.
dst: 将军，你输掉了这场战斗，但保住了你的集团军。

src: General, you must be ashamed of yourself!
dst: 将军，您应当为自己感到羞耻！

src: General, you must destroy the British forces before they can evacuate at Dunkirk. You have submarines under your command to attack any British ships in the area.
dst: 将军，你必须在英军从敦刻尔克撤离之前将其消灭。你麾下有潜艇，可攻击该地区的任何英国舰船。

src: General, you must move quickly & smash the weak Norwegians.  They have had time to prepare their defences but you must not let them slow you down.
dst: 将军，你必须迅速行动，击垮孱弱的挪威人。他们有时间为防御做了准备，但你绝不能让他们拖慢你的步伐。

src: General, you superceded our expectations - Trondheim is firmly in our hands and advanced detachments are already probing the defences of Narvik. The British have lost their first battle in this war - it was not very clever of them to intervene!
dst: 将军，你超出了我们的预期——特隆赫姆已牢牢在我军手中，先遣支队已在试探纳尔维克的防御。英军输掉了这场战争中的第一仗——他们出手干预实在不算明智！

src: General, you're responsible for one of the worst disasters in our great country's military history. The Turks have pushed us back into the sea, and the blood of our boys has turned the beaches red. There are a lot of people back home who would like to see you court-martialed for this unique example of military incompetence.
dst: 将军，您要为我们伟大国家军事史上最惨重的灾难之一负责。土耳其人已把我们赶回大海，我们小伙子们的鲜血染红了海滩。国内有许多人都想看到您因这个军事无能的反面典型而被送上军事法庭。

src: General, your actions have been decisive!  A huge number of enemy units have been trapped, and the enemy resistance is being defeated in all sectors.  Our surprise and surgical strikes have given the Chinese what they deserved, Defeat!
dst: 将军，您的行动起到了决定性作用！大量敌军部队陷入重围，敌军在各处的抵抗正被逐一粉碎。我们的奇袭与精准打击让中国人得到了他们应得的东西——失败！

src: General, your determined assault brought the Turks resistance close to breaking, but our men are totally exhausted and our casualties have been ghastly. So we can't resume the attack. It looks like we're getting into a stalemate position here at Cape Helles. I suggest, we should rethink our strategy...
dst: 将军，您坚决的进攻已使土耳其人的抵抗濒临崩溃，但我军官兵已精疲力尽，伤亡惨重。因此我们无法再恢复进攻。看来我们在海勒斯角陷入了僵局。我建议我们重新考虑战略……

src: General, your handling of the Suvla Bay landing has been one of the worst fiascos in the history of the British army. Even though the Turks were totally outnumbered, they have been able to delay your advance until reinforcements arrived. Their fresh forces pushed us back into the sea. You are instantly relieved of your command and will be send to India for garrison duties on the Afghan border...
dst: 将军，您对苏夫拉湾登陆的指挥是英国陆军历史上最惨痛的惨败之一。尽管土耳其人兵力处于绝对劣势，他们还是设法拖延您的推进，直到援军赶到。他们的生力军把我们赶回了大海。您被立即解除指挥权，并将被派往印度，去阿富汗边境执行驻防任务……

src: General, your mountain corps did very well, but not better than any others on the front. After all, we managed to achieve surprise. And what is more, the Polish troops are in disorder because they were still hoping for a chance to invade Germany and steal more land! The way is now open to decisively defeat the Polish armed forces. By the way, they are not the only ones to be impressed. Listen to this... [Chamberlain speaking]
dst: 将军，你的山地军打得很好，但前线各军都打得不错。毕竟我们达成了突然性。而且，波军已陷入混乱，因为他们竟还指望找机会入侵德国、抢占地盘！现在通向决定性击败波兰武装力量的道路已经敞开。顺便说，被打动的可不止他们。听听这个……[张伯伦讲话]

src: General, your performance was excellent. You managed to stun the Czechs and paralyze them. While they were still trying to cope with the situation, you overran them. I'm glad we pulled it off - it could so easily have gone wrong!
dst: 将军，你的表现极为出色。你成功震慑并瘫痪了捷克人。趁他们尚未反应过来，你就已将他们击溃。我很高兴我们成功了——这原本很容易失手！

src: General, your resounding success here at Lemberg allows us to shift our Schwerpunkt from the Ukraine to Moscow. The panzer units remaining with Heeresgruppe Sued will suffice to take the Ukraine.
dst: 将军，你在伦贝格的辉煌胜利，使我们得以把主攻方向从乌克兰转向莫斯科。留在南方集团军群的装甲部队足以拿下乌克兰。

src: General, your task in the East is finished! Singapore has surrendered to us and is now German. That obnoxious Colonel Brown is in solitary confinement where he isn't allowed to communicate with the outside world! I can't imagine a more cruel punishment for him.
dst: 将军，你在东方的任务结束了！新加坡已向我们投降，如今已归德国。那个讨厌的布朗上校被单独监禁，不得与外界联系！我实在想不出对他更残酷的惩罚了。

src: General, your troops are to advance across the bridges at Zutphen, and push as quickly and as far as possible, as to support the paradrop on Rotterdam.  We have been attached to the 227th Infantry Division.  We should expect to link up with 9th Panzer Division for the assault on Rotterdam.
dst: 将军，你的部队要穿过聚特芬的桥梁推进，尽可能快、尽可能远，以支援鹿特丹的空降。我们已配属第227步兵师。预计将与第9装甲师会合，共同突击鹿特丹。

src: General, your troops must quickly defeat our enemies!
dst: 将军，您的部队必须迅速击败我们的敌人！

src: General, your victory is admirable. You managed to restore the situation and kept up the morale. All Bolshevik attempted breakouts have been stopped. You have sealed the gap between Nordukraine and Südukraine army groups.
dst: 将军，你的胜利令人钦佩。你成功扭转了局势并维系了士气。布尔什维克所有的突围尝试均被挫败。你已弥合了北乌克兰集团军群与南乌克兰集团军群之间的缺口。

src: General, your victory was sorely needed. Although your performance was satisfactory and your troops have reached the outskirts of the Hungarian capital, our besieged forces defending Budapest can no longer hold their positions. We must evacuate our forces immediately. You will now move to Lake Balaton, where the 6th SS Panzerarmee is preparing for another offensive...
dst: 将军，我们亟需这场胜利。尽管你的表现差强人意、你的部队也已抵达匈牙利首都的郊外，但我们保卫布达佩斯的被围部队已无法再守住阵地。我们必须立刻把部队撤离。你现在将移驻巴拉顿湖，党卫军第6装甲集团军正在那里准备另一次攻势……

src: General-Major, the lack of initiative on your part has delayed the III Corps, and General Rennenkampf has relieved you of your command.  Perhaps a clerical job in the Far East would be better suited to your skill.
dst: 少将，您的缺乏主动延误了第3军，伦嫩坎普夫将军已经解除了您的指挥权。也许远东的一份文书工作更适合您的才能。

src: General. All is lost. The Allies are pouring into the fatherland, occupying key industrial sites in the Ruhr area. Your services are no longer required.
dst: 将军。大势已去。盟军正涌入本土，占领鲁尔区的关键工业区。不再需要你效力了。

src: General. Even the SS panzer divisions, transported to the Eastern front after achieving great successes on the Western front, were not able to stop the red steamroller. Eastern Prussia is lost.
dst: 将军。即便是那些在西线取得巨大成功后调往东线的党卫军装甲师，也未能挡住红色的压路机。东普鲁士失守了。

src: General. You and your men fought bravely, but the Bolsheviks stopped our attack. Our tanks have increasing problems in dealing with the Red heavy armor. Unfortunately, Governor Horthy is disappointed and your performance has become an embarrassment to him politically. You are relieved of your command and stripped of your awards. I am sorry, comrade.
dst: 将军。你和你的部下打得英勇，但布尔什维克挡住了我们的进攻。我方坦克在应对红军重型装甲时愈发吃力。遗憾的是，霍尔蒂摄政深感失望，你的表现已成为他在政治上的尴尬。你被解除指挥权并剥夺勋章。我很遗憾，同志。

src: General. You have disappointed Falkenhayn. The British attack was a success and it remains a mystery why the enemy did not exploit this victory .
dst: 将军，您让法尔肯海因失望了。英军的进攻取得了成功，而敌军为何没有利用这场胜利，至今仍是个谜。
少将 奥托·比斯特罗夫。”

src: Generals, this PBEM battle is about to commence! November 1942. Allies are advancing on Tunis! Hastily assembled German and Italian forces try to stop them. Fictitiously, the German 10th Panzer Div. is deployed completely here to make the scenario more balanced.
dst: 各位将军，这场 PBEM 对战即将开始！1942年11月。盟军正向突尼斯推进！仓促集结的德军和意军试图阻止他们。为使场景更加平衡，这里虚构性地将德国第10装甲师完整部署于此。

src: Generals, this PBEM battle is about to commence! The Germans are about to launch an attack out of their positions around Belgorod towards Prokhorovka while the Soviets need to stand their ground and might launch their own counterattack later on. Tankers, start your engines!
dst: 各位将军，这场PBEM对战即将开始！德军即将从别尔哥罗德周边的阵地向普罗霍罗夫卡发起进攻，而苏军需要坚守阵地，并可能在之后发动自己的反击。坦克手们，发动引擎！

src: Generalstab Gen. Geyer / IX AK / AOK 18
dst: 总参谋部 盖尔将军 / 第9军 / 第18集团军

src: Generalstab Gen. Hansen / X AK / AOK 18
dst: 总参谋部 汉森将军 / 第10军 / 第18集团军
沃德里希将军总参谋部

src: Generalstab Gen. Wodrig / XXVI AK / AOK 18
dst: 总参谋部 沃德里希将军 / 第26军 / 第18集团军

src: Genial!, herr general, the OKH and OKW send you their congratulations for this fast conquest of this port and the nearby points. Very good work.
dst: 太棒了！将军阁下，陆军总司令部（OKH）和国防军最高统帅部（OKW）对您迅速攻克该港口及附近据点向您表示祝贺。干得非常出色。
根特-布鲁日-奥斯坦德运河
热尔戈维亚的间谍洞穴

src: German Luftwaffe machine operators using an anti-aircraft MG-15.
dst: 德国空军机枪手正在使用一挺 MG-15 防空机枪。

src: German Messerschmitt Me 109E fighters from I/Jagdgeschwader 27 (1st Group, 27th Fighter Wing) in flight over North Africa, circa 1941.
dst: 来自第27战斗机联队第1大队（I/Jagdgeschwader 27）的德国梅塞施密特 Me 109E 战斗机飞越北非上空，约1941年。

src: German Spring Offensives - Prelude at the Reigersvliet
dst: 德国 Spring Offensives - Prelude at the Reigersvliet

src: German Spring Offensives - Prelude at the Reigersvliet - March, 1918
dst: 德国春季攻势——雷格斯弗利特的前奏——1918年3月

src: German and Axis Campaign 1937-1941 maybe further sometime in the future.
dst: 德国及轴心国战役 1937-1941，将来也许会更远。

src: German and Italian forces are following up their attack on the Barrage de l'Oued Kebir, the Karachoum Gap and the Kairouan Pass (previous scenario) with an attack on the more Southernly Faid pass.
dst: 德意军在进攻瓦迪凯比尔拦河坝、卡拉舒姆缺口与凯鲁万山口（上一战役）之后，正乘势向更南面的法伊德山口发起进攻。

src: German and Romanian forces are closing in on the remnants of the Soviet 9th & 18th Armies that are located in a small pocket north of the city of Berdyansk. Several Soviet divisions got destroyed and more than 100.000 men were captured. Meanwhile the 1st Panzer Army is already pushing westwards towards Mariupol, Taganrog and Rostov.
dst: 德军与罗马尼亚部队正逼近被围困在别尔江斯克城北一个小口袋中的苏联第9集团军与第18集团军残部。苏军数个师被歼灭，超过10万人被俘。与此同时，第1装甲集团军已在向西推进，直指马里乌波尔、塔甘罗格和罗斯托夫。

src: German and Romanian troops are occupying the Ukraine.  Soon, you will be needed at Army Group North. I am sure that you will do very well.
dst: 德罗部队正在占领乌克兰。不久你将需前往北方集团军群。我相信你定会表现优异。

src: German and Romanian troops on the attack across the river Pruth. Axis units would move from their positions around Iasi towards Balti in the north. Once Balti was captured most of the Axis forces would continue to push to the north and northeast while the German LIV corps and the Romanian III corps and reserves would move towards Kishinev (Chisinau) in the southeast. On 16 July, Kishinev, the Bessarabian capital was captured by Romanian forces of the 1st Romanian Armored Division.
dst: 德军和罗马尼亚军队渡过普鲁特河发起进攻。轴心国部队将从雅西周边的阵地向北面的巴尔蒂推进。巴尔蒂被攻占后，大部分轴心国部队将继续向北和东北推进，而德军第54军、罗马尼亚第3军及预备队将向东南的基什尼奥夫（基希讷乌）推进。7月16日，比萨拉比亚首府基什尼奥夫被罗马尼亚第1装甲师的部队攻占。

src: German attacks have been repelled and you have succeeded in retreating the forces under your command. Your defence has enabled our army to safely take positions on the "Ligne KW" (Dyle line).
dst: 德军的进攻已被击退，您也成功撤出了麾下部队。您的防御使我军得以安全进入“KW 防线”（迪尔河防线）阵地。

src: German audacity had caused our plan to fail again, but at least Cambrai proved that a surprise artillery-infantry attack supported by new methods and weapons could destroy even the strongest German line of defense. Our victory was closer than ever, and our enemies knew it. The Hindenburg Line would not resist our attacks much longer.
dst: 德国人的胆大妄为使我们的计划再次受挫，但至少康布雷战役证明，一场得到新战术和新武器支援的炮步协同奇袭，能够摧毁哪怕最坚固的德军防线。我们的胜利比以往任何时候都更近了，而敌人也知道这一点。兴登堡防线撑不住我们的进攻太久了。

src: German campaign during the First World War
dst: 第一次世界大战期间的德国战役

src: German cavalry has occupied Kovno on the heels of our retreating troops, and the I Landwehr Corps has crossed the Niemen in the region of Alytus.  You must destabilize the German offensive here by striking at your objectives quickly.  We cannot hold the attackers along the Niemen, but we can distrupt the German plan of an assault on Wilna by forcing the deployment of their second echelon against us here at Kovno.
dst: 德国骑兵紧跟我方撤退部队之后占领了科夫诺，第1后备军已在阿利图斯地区渡过涅曼河。您必须迅速打击目标，以打乱德军在这里的攻势。我们无法沿涅曼河挡住进攻之敌，但我们可以通过在科夫诺这里迫使德军投入其第二梯队，从而打乱他们进攻维尔纳的计划。

src: German fast attack crafts (Schnellboote) attacked Soviet shipping operations and sunk 19 ships.
dst: 德军快速攻击艇（Schnellboote）袭击了苏联的航运行动，击沉19艘船只。

src: German field commanders are not allowed to fail.  I have nothing more to say to you.
dst: 德军战地指挥官不允许失败。我对你无话可说了。

src: German fighters are invading our airspace over the Netherlands and Belgium and launch their Operation Bodenplatte (Baseplate). Our airfields and planes on the ground in this area seem to be their targets.
dst: 德军战斗机正侵入我们在荷兰与比利时上空的空域，并发动了他们的「底板行动」。我们在该地区的机场与停在地面的飞机似乎就是他们的目标。

src: German forces are following up their attack at Sidi Bou Zid with an attack on Sbeitla. You are advised to evacuate Feriana and Thelepte and reatreat to positions that can be defended better. Do not let the enemy break through to Tebessa or Thala. Such a breakthrough would destabilize the complete front.
dst: 德军在西迪布济德得手后，正乘势进攻斯贝特拉。建议你撤出费里亚纳与泰莱普特，退往更利于防守的阵地。切勿让敌军突破到泰贝萨或塔拉——那样的突破将动摇整条战线。

src: German forces clearly went beyond their orders to tie down our brigade and suffered heavy losses when staying in range of our artillery far too long. But still they managed to hold on to the advanced positions by the railway embankment. If they bring up heavy artillery, we will not be able to hold fortress Antwerp.
dst: 德军显然超越了他们的命令范围来牵制我们的旅，并在我们火炮射程内停留过久，遭受了惨重损失。但他们仍守住了铁路路堤旁的前沿阵地。如果他们调来重炮，我们将无法守住安特卫普要塞。

src: German forces clearly went beyond their orders to tie down our brigade and suffered heavy losses when staying in range of our artillery far too long. Good job recapturing our advanced positions by the railway embankment.
dst: 德军显然超越了他们的命令范围来牵制我们的旅，并在我们火炮射程内停留过久，遭受了惨重损失。干得好，您夺回了我们铁路路堤旁的前沿阵地。

src: German forces have launched a large-scale attack to the West of us to prevent us from forming a continuous front with the British Army behind the river Scheldt. Get your brigade ready to attack them in the flank.
dst: 德军已在我们西面发动大规模进攻，以阻止我们与斯海尔德河后方的英军形成连续的战线。让您的旅做好准备，从侧翼攻击他们。

src: German forces pushed back all of our columns marching East. Luckily more of our troops are reaching Tunisia every day. Time for a new attack.
dst: 德军击退了我军所有东进的纵队。所幸我们的部队每天都在源源抵达突尼斯。是时候发起新的进攻了。

src: German forces surrendering in Saint-Lambert-sur-Dive, 21 August 1944.
dst: 德军部队在圣朗贝尔叙迪沃投降，1944年8月21日。

src: German forces were massive, but the Soviet were no less: general Ludvik Svoboda mentions some fifty artillery barrels per kilometer, excluding the small-caliber guns, katyushas and mortars! There was a day when 240 German bombers attacked Czechoslovak positions. Czechoslovak scouts, who spoke perfectly German, intercepted the enemy radio transmission. On one occassion they unraveled preparations for a great enemy attack, so on 22th January a joint Soviet and Czechoslovak artillery raid was conducted against the enemy. This raid was so immense, that even the official Soviet documents describe it as a "hell on earth"; more than seventy German tanks were destroyed and countless men perished. Then on the 26th January the scouts persuaded German pilots to bomb the bridge across Horny Tikich; once the bridge was ruined, Germans couldn't win the battle anymore...
dst: 德军兵力庞大，但苏军也不遑多让：卢德维克·斯沃博达将军提到，每公里有约五十门火炮，还不包括小口径炮、喀秋莎和迫击炮！曾有一天，240架德军轰炸机袭击捷克斯洛伐克阵地。会说一口流利德语的捷克斯洛伐克侦察兵截获了敌军无线电通讯。有一次，他们查明了敌军一场大规模进攻的准备工作，于是1月22日，苏捷联合对敌实施了炮击。这次炮击规模之大，连苏联官方文件都称之为“人间地狱”；七十多辆德军坦克被毁，无数人丧生。随后1月26日，侦察兵又诱使德军飞行员轰炸了横跨戈尔内季基奇河的桥梁；桥一毁，德军就再也无法赢得这场战斗了……

src: German gun crew practice drill wearing gas masks
dst: 戴着防毒面具进行操练的德军炮组

src: German industry started to churn out new tanks with an amazing pace, and hopefully there will be enough Panthers for your third company, now that half of the battalion's strength is composed of them. But the Soviet Union factories spew even more tanks, guns, and ariplanes, with the latter being increasingly dangerous...
dst: 德国工业开始以惊人的速度量产新坦克，既然营里一半兵力已是黑豹，但愿能有足够的黑豹装备你的第三个连。但苏联工厂吐出的坦克、火炮和飞机更多，而飞机正日益危险……

src: German jet fighters, type Me 262 have been reported in this area too! Be cautious! We expect heavy Luftwaffe attacks in the next weeks.
dst: 该地区也报告出现了Me 262型德军喷气式战斗机！务必小心！预计未来数周德国空军将发动猛烈空袭。

src: German land forces could have easily destroyed the British Expeditionary Force and for years, it was assumed that Adolf Hitler ordered the German Army to stop the attack, favouring bombardment by the Luftwaffe. However, according to the Official War Diary of Army Group A, Feldmarshall Gerd von Rundstedt, the Chief of the General Staff, ordered the halt, Hitler merely validated the order several hours after the fact. Several high-ranking German commanders including Generals Erich von Manstein and Heinz Guderian, as well as Admiral Karl Dönitz, considered the failure of the German High Command to order a timely assault on Dunkirk to eliminate the British Expeditionary Force to be one of the major mistakes the Germans had made on the Western Front.
dst: 德国地面部队本可轻松歼灭英国远征军，多年来人们一直以为，是阿道夫·希特勒下令德国陆军停止进攻、转而倚重德国空军的轰炸。然而，根据A集团军群的官方战地日记，下令停止的是总参谋长格特·冯·伦德施泰特元帅，希特勒不过是在事隔数小时后追认了这道命令。包括埃里希·冯·曼施泰因和古德里安两位将军以及海军上将卡尔·邓尼茨在内的多位德国高级指挥官，都认为德国最高统帅部未能及时下令进攻敦刻尔克以歼灭英国远征军，是德军在西线的重大失误之一。

src: German officer from the Condor Legion instructing Nationalist infantry soldiers, Ávila, January 1939.
dst: 来自秃鹰军团的德国军官正在指导国民军步兵士兵，西班牙阿维拉，1939年1月。

src: German positions were quickly destroyed and the city was captured on the second day. Mobile units chased the enemy, but they were recalled in the evening.
dst: 德军阵地迅速被摧毁，该城第二天即被攻克。机动部队追击敌军，但傍晚即被召回。

src: German raider Emden across the Indian Ocean.
dst: 埃姆登号在印度洋上玩起了「猫捉老鼠」。

src: German soldiers and German custom officials reenact the removal of the Polish border crossing in Sopot (near Gdansk) on September 1, 1939
dst: 1939年9月1日，德国士兵与德国海关官员在索波特（Sopot，格但斯克附近）重演拆除波兰边境检查站的情形

src: German soldiers by a knocked out French Char B1bis tank, number 205 'Indochine', France, June 1940.
dst: 德军士兵站在一辆被击毁的法国Char B1bis坦克旁，编号205“Indochine”，法国，1940年6月。
在法国的德国士兵，1940年6月。

src: German soldiers of the 24th Panzer Division in action during the fighting for the southern station of Stalingrad, 15 September 1942.
dst: 第24装甲师的德国士兵在斯大林格勒南站战斗期间投入作战，1942年9月15日。

src: German soldiers taking a group photo after a day on the shooting range.
dst: 德军士兵在靶场训练一天后拍摄合影。

src: German soldiers with 3,7cm anti tank gun, May 1940.
dst: 1940年5月，携带3,7厘米反坦克炮的德军士兵。

src: German soldiers with an MG 34 machine gun in Russia.
dst: 在俄国使用 MG 34 机枪的德国士兵。

src: German troops advances along a cliffside during the invasion of Norway, 1940.
dst: 德军部队在入侵挪威期间沿崖边推进，1940年。

src: German troops have captured Rostov and the 73. and 125. Infanterie-Division as well as the Slovak Brigade crossed the Don south of the city.
dst: 德军已夺取罗斯托夫，第73与第125步兵师以及斯洛伐克旅在这座城市以南渡过了顿河。

src: German troops started a major counterattack. They are in front of the Tebourba gap and are attacking Combat Command B troops on the East bank of the river Medjerda. Stop the enemy advance so that we are not pushed back into Algeria.
dst: 德军发动了大规模反攻。他们已兵临泰布尔拜缺口，正向迈杰尔达河东岸的战斗指挥部B部队发起进攻。阻止敌军推进，以免我军被赶回阿尔及利亚。

src: German troops were clearly too numerous to hold your positions at the Gete. It unfortunate that you missed King Albert's early afternoon order to retreat in the face of a much bigger German force. Retreating would have saved a lot of our brave troops that now remain on the battlefield.
dst: 德军显然兵力过于庞大，您无法在赫特河守住阵地。遗憾的是，您错过了阿尔贝国王当天下午早些时候下达的、面对规模大得多的德军时撤退的命令。撤退本可以拯救许多如今仍躺在战场上的英勇士兵。

src: Germans Production: Limited to only 1 of the same type of any German unit on the map at any one time except for unlimited normal Regular Infantry.(Automatically added Reinforcements dont count).
dst: 德军生产：地图上同一时间，任意型号的德军单位最多只能有 1 个，普通正规步兵不受此限。（自动加入的增援不计入）。

src: Germans were particularly harsh during the Uprising and committed many atrocities, including murders of helpless civilians. Death toll of five days of fightings were some 1700 Czech insurgents, 700 insurgents of other nationalities, 300 men of ROA, 700 men of the Red Army and four thousand slain civilians. Germans lost one thousand men.
dst: 起义期间德军尤为残暴，犯下许多暴行，包括杀害手无寸铁的平民。五天战斗的死亡人数约为：1700名捷克起义者、700名其他民族起义者、300名 ROA 士兵、700名红军士兵，以及四千名被杀平民。德军损失一千人。

src: Germans: Destroy all enemies especially the Consul and/or conquer all Victory Hexes!
dst: 日耳曼方：消灭所有敌人，尤其是那位执政官，并/或夺取所有胜利格！

src: Germany has responded to Austria's plea for help and began transferring divisions from the west to stop us.  You must carry the momentum forward and dash the Prussians' hopes of aiding their ally.
dst: 德国已响应奥地利的求援，开始从西线调遣师来阻止我们。您必须乘势向前推进，粉碎普鲁士人援助其盟友的企图。

src: Germany has sent three fresh divisions, commanded by General Falkenhayn, to stop the Romanian offensive. They are attacking toward Nagyszeben and Brassó (Southern-Transylvania). In the meanwhile your division is ordered to liberate and secure the valleys of the Eastern Carpathians.
dst: 德国已派出三个新锐师，由法尔肯海因将军指挥，去阻止罗马尼亚人的攻势。他们正向纳吉塞本与布拉索夫（特兰西瓦尼亚南部）进攻。与此同时，您的师奉命解放并确保东喀尔巴阡山的河谷安全。

src: Germany is the main country but other Axis nations are support countries and the campaign could be played using any of these countries.
dst: 德国是主国家，但其他轴心国是支援国家，本战役可以用其中任何一个国家来玩。

src: Germany is the main country but other Axis nations are support countries.
dst: 德国是主国家，但其他轴心国是支援国家。

src: Germany used many of its heaviest artillery systems so shell the extensive fortifications of Sevastopol. The 80cm Schwerer Gustav railroad artillery, the 60cm self-propelled siege mortar Karl, the 42cm Gamma mortar and the 35,5cm siege howitzer M1, 28cm railroad artillery amongst other heavy artillery got deployed to the Sevastopol front.
dst: 德国动用了许多最重型火炮系统来轰击塞瓦斯托波尔庞大的防御工事。80厘米"重型古斯塔夫"铁道炮、60厘米"卡尔"自行攻城臼炮、42厘米"伽马"臼炮和35.5厘米 M1 攻城榴弹炮、28厘米铁道炮以及其他重型火炮都被部署到塞瓦斯托波尔前线。

src: Get better next time, Herr Oberleutnant!!
dst: 下次可要争气些，中尉阁下！！

src: Get out there and get the job done, commander.  Wipe Pegasus, his machine and his factories off the face of the planet.
dst: 出去把活干完，指挥官。把珀伽索斯、他的机器和他的工厂从这颗行星表面抹掉。

src: Get ready for a fierce battle.
Get ready, quick! Shots have been fired near Santa Mesa. I don't know the details, but apparently that the Filipinos have rebelled against us.
dst: 快，做好准备！圣梅萨附近已经响起了枪声。我不知道细节，但显然菲律宾人已经起来反抗我们了。

src: Getting frustrated that they were not able to bring a quick end to the war in Libya, the Italians sought and got permission from the great powers to attack Turkish possessions in the Aegean Sea. These developments forced Turkey to sign the First Treaty of Lozanne that gave Italy control over Libya.
dst: 由于无法迅速结束利比亚战争而感到沮丧，意大利人寻求并获得列强的许可，去攻击土耳其人在爱琴海的属地。这些事态发展迫使土耳其签署了《第一次洛桑条约》，把利比亚的控制权让给了意大利。
古拉姆·穆罕默德·塔尔齐

src: Giant ANTS?  Are you fucking kidding me?  Was this in the job description when you signed up?
dst: 巨型蚂蚁？你他妈的在逗我？你报名的时候招募令上写了这条吗？

src: Gibraltar has been taken and the Italian Fleet has sailed toward England. Your mission is to take London and the Industrial Heart of England before our limited shipping and storms in the English Channel force us to withdraw our invasion. High command has given you until September 30th to complete your mission, but we fear that you must succeed sooner or we will see the invasion falter before the British surrender. Operation Sealion is about to begin. Good Luck!
dst: 直布罗陀已被攻占，意大利舰队已驶向英格兰。你的任务是夺取伦敦以及英格兰的工业心脏地带，必须在我们有限的航运能力与英吉利海峡的风暴迫使我们撤出入侵部队之前完成。统帅部给你完成任务的期限是9月30日，但我们担心你必须更早取胜，否则入侵将在英国人投降之前便告夭折。海狮行动即将开始。祝好运！

src: Gibraltar is impossible to occupy, or so they say. We'll see about that. We were originally going to make this an operation starting from the Spanish mainland but we have found that the soil over there is too soft for our artillery. So you must land by sea. Our Kriegsmarine and the Italian Navy will support you, as well as some of the Fallschirmjaeger which you saved on Crete. They think they owe you this one!
dst: 都说直布罗陀不可能被占领，我们走着瞧。我们本打算从西班牙本土发起此次行动，但发现那边的土质太软，架不住我们的火炮。所以你必须从海上登陆。我国海军和意大利海军将支援你，还有你在克里特救下的部分空降猎兵——他们觉得欠你这个人情！

src: Gibraltar is ours, thanks mainly to the skill of Feldmarschall Kesselring in breaking through the defenses on the Spanish side.  Of course, our ally Spain will be given nominal soverignty over Gibraltar, but it will serve us as our base.  Herr General, you did not handle this difficult assignment with the skill you have shown in previous battles.  However, you will be given another chance.  After some rest and recuperation you and your men will probably be called upon to play a role in our 1941 spring campaign.
dst: 直布罗陀属于我们了，这主要归功于凯塞林元帅突破西班牙一侧防御的技艺。当然，我们的盟友西班牙将被授予对直布罗陀的名义主权，但它将作为我们的基地供我们使用。将军阁下，您并未以在以往战役中展现的技艺来完成这项艰巨任务。不过，我们会再给您一次机会。经过一段休整之后，您和您的部下很可能会被召去在我们1941年春季攻势中发挥作用。
Gibson's 农庄 and 磨坊
乔瓦尼·德尔莱·班德·内雷号

src: Give up your offensive and retreat back east to avoid being surrounded.
dst: 放弃攻势，向东撤退，以免被合围。

src: Give your troops a few days rest and check your equipment. You will receive new orders soon,  most likely we need your troops for an southern push towards Basra.
dst: 让你的部队休整几天，检查一下装备。你很快就会接到新命令，很可能我们需要你的部队向南进攻巴士拉。

src: Given that Baler is reachable only by ship (the town is surrounded by mountains and the jungle trails are nearly impassable), you will disembark in the mouth of the Baler River and enter into insurgent-held territory to reach our countrymen. You will have the support of an American gunboat.
dst: 鉴于巴莱尔只能乘船抵达（该镇四周环山，丛林小径几乎无法通行），您将在巴莱尔河口登陆，进入起义者控制的地区，去与我们的同胞会合。您将得到一艘美国炮艇的支援。

src: Given that the 17 DI, which is defending the area, is withdrawing to their new positions, you have to help the "2 Division de Cavalerie" to re-establish the situation.
dst: 鉴于防守该地区的第17步兵师正在撤往新阵地，您必须协助“第2骑兵师”恢复局势。

src: Given the circumstances, the end of the war didn't have been too bad for the Qing Empire, but the loss of part of Korea was a terrible blow for the Chinese pride. Sorrow and resentment against foreigners, especially Westerners and Japanese, spread incredibly fast in all the country. Millions of voices cried for revenge, for the expulsion of the "white devils" and for the end of the foreign concessions. The Chinese government, which secretly supported those claims, did nothing to control the protesters, and as the century came to and end it was obvious that a new war would start soon. All that we could do was to go on with the modernization of the Chinese Army, and pray for being ready when the Empire needed us.
dst: 考虑到当时的处境，战争的结局对大清帝国而言还不算太糟，但失去部分朝鲜领土对中国人的自尊心是一个沉重的打击。对外国人，尤其是对西方人和日本人的悲愤与怨恨，以惊人的速度传遍全国。无数人呐喊要复仇，要驱逐「白鬼」，要终结外国租界。暗中支持这些诉求的清政府没有采取任何措施去控制抗议者，而随着世纪行将结束，一场新的战争显然很快就会爆发。我们所能做的，就是继续推进中国军队的现代化，并祈祷当帝国需要我们时我们已经准备就绪。

src: Giving up those lands, for which Yohannes IV and so many Ethiopians had fought and died in the recent past, was a clever political move of Menelik. Yohannes had belonged to the Tigrayan tribe, as well as Ras Alula and many of his most trusted counselors. Under the clauses of the Treaty of Wuchale, the majority of the Tigrayans would remain under the rule of Italy in the colony of Eritrea, beyond the new borders of Ethiopia. The Ethiopian Tigrayans would be very few, not numerous enough to be a serious threat for Menelik. Thus, the new emperor was making sure that he would reign over a united, cohesive empire. The time of the aristocratic conspiracies and rebellions would be over.
dst: 放弃那些约翰内斯四世和众多埃塞俄比亚人在不久前为之战斗、为之献身的土地，是孟尼利克的一步精明政治棋。约翰内斯属于提格雷部族，拉斯·阿卢拉以及许多他最信任的谋臣也是如此。根据《武恰莱条约》的条款，大多数提格雷人将留在厄立特里亚殖民地，接受意大利的统治，处在埃塞俄比亚的新边界之外。埃塞俄比亚境内的提格雷人将少之又少，不足以对孟尼利克构成严重威胁。就这样，新皇帝确保了自己将统治一个统一而团结的帝国。贵族阴谋与叛乱的时代将就此终结。
格约莱河（卢米格约莱斯）

src: Glad to have your men with us General, make sure they know the great demands to maintain speed.........and General, be sure to carry your own SMG, there are Russian stragglers everywhere!
dst: 很高兴你的部队与我们同行，将军，务必让他们知道保持速度的严苛要求……还有，将军，务必随身带好自己的冲锋枪，到处都是掉队的俄军散兵！

src: Glorious Victory Herr General! You have earned the admiration of your country! The Furher is very pleased with your performance! Your victory has made Soviet defeat a certainty! Congratulations!
dst: 辉煌的胜利，将军阁下！你赢得了祖国的敬仰！元首对你的表现极为满意！你的胜利已使苏联的败局成为定局！恭喜！
格奈乌斯·多米提乌斯·科尔布洛
格奈乌斯·伊卢利乌斯·阿格里科拉
格奈乌斯帕皮里乌斯卡尔波
格奈乌斯·庞培·马格努斯

src: Go back to England you are expected there already to train your troops in major amphibious landing maneuvers.
dst: 返回英格兰，那里已经有人在等着你，要把你的部队训练成大规模两栖登陆的行家。

src: Go into Battle with them, they persecute you anyway ...
dst: 与他们开战吧，反正他们也在追杀你 ...

src: Go on to the north-west and take Bay City on Lake Huron and ensure that the escape route via Detroit to Canada is also be cut off.
dst: 继续向西北推进，夺取休伦湖畔的贝城，并确保经底特律逃往加拿大的路线也被切断。
戈班尼提奥的秘密情报处

src: Gobannitio, an ally of the Romans and Uncle of the Vercingetorix, also claimed the royal dignity... He gathers all his followers in Gergovia around himself, and it will probably come to the fight. . . .
dst: 戈班尼提奥，罗马人的盟友、维钦托利的叔父，也自称拥有王位尊号... 他把所有追随者聚集在热尔戈维亚，看来难免一战。. . . .

src: God bless and long live liberty !
God bless you, you have saved Italy from the destruction that Germany is soon to suffer.
dst: 愿上帝保佑你，你使意大利免于德国即将遭受的毁灭。
愿上帝保佑我们所有人……

src: God is with us! The advance of the British Home Fleet into the English Channel was rejected by our Luftwaffe. After heavy losses the Royal Navy retreated to Scapa Flow and probably prepares a new attempt to disturbing our supplies.
dst: 上帝与我们同在！英国本土舰队向英吉利海峡的推进被我们的德国空军击退。在遭受惨重损失后，皇家海军撤回斯卡帕湾，很可能在准备新的尝试来扰乱我们的补给。

src: God's speed in your next mission!
dst: 祝你下一个任务一路顺风！
祝你好运，指挥官。卡特 完毕。

src: Golpe de Gracia: Aniquilando el Ejército del Ebro
dst: 致命一击：歼灭埃布罗军团
戈雷卡拉梅什 - 巴尔策
大恰穆尔利 (斯莫尔尼察)
Gondar, Tigray and Shewa 部队

src: Good  performance, Herr General! Unfortunately though, despite your success,  the Bolsheviks still defy us!...
dst: 表现良好，将军阁下！遗憾的是，尽管你取得了成功，布尔什维克仍在抗拒我们！……

src: Good Luck, this time you'll need it.
dst: 祝你好运，这次你确实需要运气。

src: Good Morning Colonel. As you probably know, a few days after the failed German attempt to seize Suursaari island, we signed an interm peace agreement with the Soviet Union. Ever since then, they have been demanding a more active war from us against the Germans. The Allied control commission in Helsinki, responsible for supervising the truce, is also pressing us to start forcefully removing the German troops from the Lapland. Therefore, we have no choice, we must now pro-actively confront our former ally.....
dst: 早上好，上校。你大概知道，在德军夺取苏尔萨里岛的尝试失败数日之后，我们与苏联签署了一份临时和平协定。自那时起，他们一直要求我们对德采取更积极的作战行动。驻赫尔辛基、负责监督停战的盟国管制委员会也在催促我们开始动用武力把德军逐出拉普兰。因此，我们别无选择，必须现在就主动与我们昔日的盟友对抗.....

src: Good Morning Colonel. Despite the peace feelers sent out by Stalin earlier this month, and the withdrawl of some of his troops, two Soviet divisions, the 176th and 289th, have been steadily advancing towards us here in the Ilomantsi area. Marshal Mannerheim has decided to give a last lesson to the Soviet leadership about the futility of continuing this war. We have therefore organized an attack with the goal of encircling and destroying these divisions. Give them no quarter!....
dst: 早上好，上校。尽管斯大林本月早些时候放出了和平试探，也撤走了他的部分部队，苏军第176和第289两个师仍在稳步朝我们推进，就在伊洛曼齐一带。曼纳海姆元帅决定给苏联领导层上最后一课，让他们明白继续这场战争是徒劳的。因此我们组织了一次进攻，目标是合围并歼灭这两个师。不要给他们任何活路！....

src: Good Morning Commander! Your orders are to weaken the garrison of Pantelleria by aerial bombing and naval bombardment. A Landing force will arrive later and will take the island.
dst: 早上好，指挥官！你的命令是通过空袭和舰炮轰击削弱潘泰莱里亚的守军。一支登陆部队稍后将抵达并夺取该岛。

src: Good Morning Comrade Marshal. Since you are now Stavka coordinator for both the 1st and 2nd Belorussian fronts, and we know how you like to be close to the front lines with your troops, Stalin has given you the option to decide at which front you would like to be...
dst: 早上好，元帅同志。既然你现在是最高统帅部驻白俄罗斯第1和第2方面军的协调员，而我们也知道你喜欢和部队一起靠近前线，斯大林给了你选择权，由你决定想去哪个方面军……

src: Good Morning General! The liberation of Bialorus was the last Polish operation against the Reds in 1919. The second half of the year was all quiet. Meanwhile, the new Soviet Russians of Lenin fought against the White Russians of Denikin. But General Denikin not only refused to recognize the Polish state, but he also asked France (former Russian ally and current Polish ally) to stop supporting the Poles as well! Because of this, Polish authorities decided not to support Denikin’s forces and stopped all aggressive operations against the Red Army. This allowed the Bolsheviks to concentrate all available forces against the Whites and they were able to repel them.
dst: 早上好，将军！解放白俄罗斯是1919年波兰对红军发动的最后一次行动。下半年一切平静。与此同时，列宁领导的新苏维埃俄国与邓尼金的白军作战。但邓尼金将军不仅拒绝承认波兰国家，还要求法国（前俄国的盟友、现波兰的盟友）也停止支持波兰人！正因如此，波兰当局决定不支持邓尼金的部队，并停止了对红军的一切进攻行动。这使得布尔什维克得以集中所有可用力量对付白军，并成功击退了他们。

src: Good Morning General. HQ has directed me to inform you that some of your forces are being transferred to Malta to participate in the defence of the island. Latest intelligence indicates that the Axis air attacks are, to some extent, covertly being coordinated from the ground. The murderous aerial seige of Malta continues, but so does our will to defend this most strategically important island. Malta must not fall to the Axis forces.
dst: 早上好，将军。司令部指示我通知你：你的部分部队正调往马耳他参加该岛的防御。最新情报显示，轴心国的空袭在一定程度上是由地面秘密协调的。对马耳他杀气腾腾的空中围困仍在继续，但我们保卫这座战略上至关重要的岛屿的意志同样不减。马耳他绝不能落入轴心国手中。

src: Good Morning Major, here is the situation at Suomussalmi: On December 20, a strong Soviet counter attack prevented our advance towards the village center, and  forced the withdrawl of our attacking forces after we sustained heavy casualties. Then, on December 24, preceded by a 3 hour preliminary bombardment, the Soviets launched a powerful attack, but with hard efforts, Soviet gains were limited to some forward strongpoints. Now, after repulsing yet another Soviet attack, we are going onto the offensive again...
dst: 早上好，少校，以下是苏穆萨尔米的局势：12月20日，苏军一次强有力的反击阻止了我们向村庄中心的推进，并在我方遭受重大伤亡之后迫使我进攻部队后撤。随后在12月24日，苏军以3小时的预备炮击为先导发动了一次猛攻，但经过艰苦奋战，苏军的所得仅限于若干前沿支撑点。如今，在又击退一次苏军进攻之后，我们重新转入进攻……

src: Good Morning Major. As you have probably guessed, the Soviet build up here in the Svir sector was no feint. A large scale attack has been launched against us, and the Soviets have had some success in pushing us from the Svir river line. You must contain the attack, and then drive them back...
dst: 早上好，少校。你大概已经猜到，苏军在斯维尔地段的集结并非佯动。一场大规模进攻已向我们发起，而苏军在把我们逐离斯维尔河一线方面取得了一些进展。你必须遏制这次进攻，然后把他们赶回去……

src: Good Morning Major. How things have changed! Hitler has attacked the Soviet Union, and the arms deliveries from Germany, stopped during the Winter war, have now resumed. But, on June 25, the Soviet Union unleashed a major air offensive against 18 of our cities, causing serious damage to our civilian infrastructure. The Soviet Union tried to justify the attack as being directed against German targets in Finland, but the heaviest damage was done in the south where there were no Germans. So much for peace! We are once again at war with the Soviet Union, but we also have a chance to reverse our losses under the Moscow Peace treaty!
dst: 早上好，少校。世事变化多大啊！希特勒进攻了苏联，冬季战争期间中断的德国军火交付如今已经恢复。但在6月25日，苏联对我国18座城市发动了一次大规模空中攻势，严重破坏了我们的民用设施。苏联试图为这次袭击辩解，称其针对的是芬兰境内的德国目标，然而损失最惨重的却是南方根本没有德国人的地区。所谓的和平不过如此！我们再一次与苏联处于战争状态，但我们也有机会扭转在《莫斯科和约》下的损失！

src: Good Morning Major. Latest intelligence suggests that the Soviets are about to renew their drive on Kuhmo. So your men, along with the 9th division, have been moved here in order to destroy the Soviet 54th division before their attack gathers momentum. Good luck Major...
dst: 早上好，少校。最新情报显示，苏军即将重启对库赫莫的推进。因此你的部下连同第9师已调驻此地，以便在苏联第54师的进攻形成势头之前将其歼灭。祝你好运，少校……

src: Good Morning Major. Many things have happened in the two years since we last spoke, but what concerns us most is this: As you have no doubt heard, on June 10th, the Soviets unleashed a vicious full scale attack on the Karelian Isthmus, forcing our retreat in several sectors. Then on June 20th, they captured Viipuri, but we did manage to halt their further advances in this area. We then contacted the Soviet Union, via Sweden, to ask for peace terms, but Stalin replied that only unconditional surrender would be acceptable, but of course, that was unacceptable to us. Then, they proceeded to attack us in the Tali sector, forcing our retreat north towards Ihantala. That brings us to the present situation. The Soviets are now resuming their offensive against us.  You must repulse the Soviet onslaught, and hold the Ihantala sector. Failure is not an option, Major....
dst: 早上好，少校。自我们上次交谈以来的两年间发生了许多事，但最令我们关切的是这一件：你无疑已经听说，6月10日苏军在卡累利阿地峡发动了一场凶猛的全面进攻，迫使我们在数个地段后撤。随后在6月20日，他们攻占了维堡，但我们确实设法阻止了他们在这一地区的进一步推进。之后我们经瑞典与苏联接触，询问和平条件，但斯大林答复说只有无条件投降才可接受——而这当然是我们不能接受的。接着，他们又在塔利地段向我们进攻，迫使我们北撤至伊汉塔拉。这便把我们带到了当前的局势。苏军现在正重新对我们发起攻势。你必须击退苏军的猛攻，守住伊汉塔拉地段。失败不在选项之内，少校....

src: Good Morning Major. Now that the Soviets are reeling, and we have finally regained what was lost in the Winter war, it is time to push ahead into Soviet territory. As well as acting as a buffer zone, whatever we are able to gain and hold should improve our leverage in any possible future peace negotiations with Stalin...
dst: 早上好，少校。既然苏军正摇摇欲坠，而我们终于收复了冬季战争中的失地，现在是推进到苏联领土上的时候了。除了充当缓冲地带，我们能够夺取并守住的一切，都应能改善我们在未来与斯大林的任何和平谈判中的筹码……

src: Good Morning Major. Sorry to interrupt your "vacation", but we have a special assignment for you and some of your men! Your fighter wing is being temporarily transferred north to the LLv.24 air base at Tiiksjarvi. There have been too many Soviet recon attempts around here lately, and the enemy is likely being informed about take-offs and landings by the Partisans hiding in the forests around the base. This leads us to believe an attack is probably imminent. Your mission is to root out the Partisans and repel any possible attacks. Good luck, Major...
dst: 早上好，少校。很抱歉打断你的「假期」，但我们给你和你的部分部下安排了一项特殊任务！你的战斗机大队将暂时北调至蒂克夏尔维的LLv.24空军基地。近来苏军的侦察尝试过于频繁，而躲在基地周围森林里的游击队很可能在向敌人通报我机的起降情况。这使我们相信，进攻很可能迫在眉睫。你的任务是肃清游击队并击退任何可能的进攻。祝你好运，少校...

src: Good Morning Major. The situation here around Tolvajarvi has been somewhat stabilized, but is still critical. We have decided to boost dwindling morale and gain the initiative by launching a counter attack aimed at encircling and destroying as many units of the Soviet 139th division as possible. Show them what Finnish resolve can acheive!
dst: 早上好，少校。托尔瓦亚尔维一带的局势已稍有稳定，但仍然危急。我们决定发动一次反击，以提振日渐低落的士气并夺回主动权，目标是尽可能多地合围并歼灭苏联第139师的部队。让他们见识一下芬兰人的决心能成就什么！

src: Good Morning Major. The situation with the Soviet Union has rapidly deteriorated. As you know, they have been demanding 2700 square kilometers of our territory in the Karelian Isthmus, as well as some of our islands in the Gulf of Finland and the town of Hanko in the south coast. Stalin has offered in exchange the Porajarvi and Repola districts in East Karelia. After the last negotiations on Nov 13, Molotov was overheard to say, "Since we civilians can't achieve anything, the matter has to be left to the militairy personnel".
