Then, on Nov 26, after falsely accusing us of shelling their militairy base at Mainila, Stalin has demanded that we should apologize for the incident and  move our forces 20-25 kilometers from the border! The Soviet Union is looking for any little reason to attack us, and we will not give in to their demands, so Major, be on your guard!
dst: 早上好，少校。与苏联的局势已迅速恶化。如你所知，他们一直索要我卡累利阿地峡2,700平方公里的领土，以及我在芬兰湾中的一些岛屿和南海岸的汉科镇。斯大林提出以东卡累利阿的波拉耶尔维和雷波拉地区作为交换。11月13日最后一轮谈判之后，有人听到莫洛托夫说：「既然我们这些文职人员办不成什么事，这事就只能交给军人去办了。」随后在11月26日，在诬告我们炮击其迈尼拉军事基地之后，斯大林要求我们为这一事件道歉，并把部队从边界后撤20至25公里！苏联正在找任何一点微小的借口来攻击我们，而我们决不会屈从于他们的要求，所以少校，务必保持警惕！

src: Good Work!, the disemnark has been succesfully. The OKH and OKV send you their congratulations from Berlin.
dst: 干得好！登陆行动已经顺利完成。陆军总司令部与国防军最高统帅部从柏林向您发来祝贺。

src: Good Work. I wish El Ejercito Popular had more commanders of your quality and initiative.
dst: 干得好。我真希望共和军能有更多像您这样有才干、有主动精神的指挥官。
好选择: 前方有有趣的战役!

src: Good day Herr Fregattenkapitan, you know that your major succes at Shetland was even for me a surprise. But we don't have time to celebrate.
dst: 你好，海军中校阁下，你知道你在设得兰群岛的重大胜利即便对我来说也是个惊喜。但我们没时间庆祝。

src: Good day Herr General. We will now take Denmark and complete this stage of our Blitzkrieg. The Danes are tough fighters but will be no match for your battle hardened troops.
dst: 日安，将军阁下。我们现在将拿下丹麦，完成闪电战的这一阶段。丹麦人是顽强的战士，但绝非你久经沙场部队的对手。

src: Good day Herr Oberleutnant, yes following my suggestion, General Staff promoted you! Also you take command of the "Wolfgang Zenker" Flotilla leader ship.
dst: 你好，中尉阁下，是的，遵照我的建议，总参谋部已晋升了你！同时你接管“沃尔夫冈·岑克尔号”（Wolfgang Zenker）驱逐领舰的指挥。

src: Good day Kapitanleutnant, one more time British surprised us. In a few hours Narvik will fall after the attack of paratroopers and some enemy ships.
dst: 您好，海军上尉阁下，英国人又一次打了我们措手不及。几小时之后，纳尔维克就将在伞兵和若干敌舰的攻击下陷落。

src: Good day Korvettenkapitan, it is time to end the British attacks at Norway. First you have an important mission, to capture Faroe Islands. Enemy has many ships, a lot of ground units and some airplanes. Our intelligence reports that there also is a radar unit at Vagar airport.
dst: 您好，海军少校，是时候终结英军在挪威的进攻了。首先你有一项重要任务：攻占法罗群岛。敌军拥有许多舰艇、大量地面部队以及一些飞机。我方情报显示，瓦加尔机场还驻有一个雷达单位。

src: Good evening Herr General. As you are aware, our Fuhrer likes to attack neutral coutries that do not support us. The Yugoslavians have been leaning towards the Allies & need to be taught a lesson. A swift invasion from the Adriatic Sea will be that lesson. They will not be expecting a sea invasion. Our Bulgarian allies will be supporting you Herr General.
dst: 晚上好，将军阁下。如你所知，我们的元首喜欢进攻那些不支持我们的中立国。南斯拉夫人一直倒向盟国，需要被教训一番。从亚得里亚海发起的迅速入侵就是那堂课。他们料不到海上入侵。我们的保加利亚盟友将支援你，将军阁下。

src: Good evening Herr Kapitanleutnant, yes you get promoted again. As you know you have to sail to Norway to assist our fleet in their important mission to rescue battleship Bismarck which has to move to the naval base of Henningsvaer for repairs, so it can get back to action soon. As you know British bombed all the other Ports and the nearest airfields. So for the moment only some weak fighters will be at your force.
dst: 晚上好，海军上尉阁下，是的，你又晋升了。如你所知，你必须驶往挪威，协助我们的舰队执行解救"俾斯麦"号战列舰的重要任务，该舰必须转移到亨宁斯韦尔海军基地进行修理，以便它能尽快重返战场。如你所知，英国人轰炸了所有其他港口和最近的机场。因此目前你的部队中只有一些弱小的战斗机。

src: Good evening Korvettenkapitan. British attack our forces at Trondheim with many ships, marines and the support of RAF.
dst: 晚上好，海军少校。英军以众多舰船、海军陆战队和英国皇家空军的支援进攻我们在特隆赫姆的部队。

src: Good evening, General! Welcome to our last meeting before the start of our operation - the greatest amphibious landing ever attempted!
dst: 晚上好，将军！欢迎参加我们在行动开始前的最后一次会议——这将是有史以来规模最大的一次两栖登陆！

src: Good friends of mine have word that you are favored to lead the assault on Tobruk.  Congratulations to you General, and good luck in your next mission!
dst: 我的一些好友得到消息，说你有望领导对托布鲁克的突击。恭喜你，将军，祝你的下一个任务好运！

src: Good friends of mine have word that you are to lead the final assault on Greece.  Enjoy the mediteranian air during your next mission.
dst: 我的一些好友得到消息，说你要领导对希腊的最后突击。在你的下一个任务中，尽情享受地中海的气息吧。

src: Good job !!! Arrius is defeated - now L. Gellius Poplicola is waiting ...
dst: 干得好！！！阿里乌斯已被击败——现在等着我们的是卢基乌斯盖利乌斯波普利科拉 ...

src: Good job !!! Cossinius is beaten. Now praetor Publius Varinius number is up !!!!
dst: 干得好！！！科西尼乌斯被打败了。接下来就轮到法官普布利乌斯瓦里尼乌斯了！！！！

src: Good job !!! Gellisu is defeated - now it is time to move again with Spatacus ...
dst: 干得好！！！盖利乌斯已被击败——现在是时候与斯巴达克斯再次行动了 ...

src: Good job !!! Lentus is defeated - now we turn south, heading to Poplicola and Arrius ...
dst: 干得好！！！伦图卢斯已被击败——现在我们转向南方，直取波普利科拉与阿里乌斯 ...

src: Good job !!! Manlius and Longinus are defeated, Excellent !!! Manlius and Longinus are defeated, now we can cross over the Alps !
dst: 干得好！！！曼利乌斯与隆吉努斯已被击败，太好了！！！曼利乌斯与隆吉努斯已被击败，现在我们可以翻越阿尔卑斯山了！

src: Good job !!! Nola burns and ye escape in time ...
dst: 干得好！！！诺拉燃起大火，你们及时脱身 ...

src: Good job !!! Now we are supplied with weapons and some food. Come on into the inaccessible terrain of Mount Vesuvius ...
dst: 干得好！！！现在我们有了武器补给和一些食物。开进维苏威山那难以接近的地形吧 ...

src: Good job !!! Nuceria is conquered and a part of Varinius Troops are destroyed.
dst: 干得好！！！努凯里亚被攻下，瓦里尼乌斯的一部分部队被歼灭。

src: Good job !!! Picentia ist conquered and Varinius Troops have been nearly exterminated.
dst: 干得好！！！皮琴蒂亚被攻下，瓦里尼乌斯的部队几乎被全歼。

src: Good job !!! The first battle is over. Now it's time for a counterstrike ...
dst: 干得好！！！第一战结束了。现在该反击了 ...

src: Good job !!! The road to the south is now free. Let's go for The Boot of the world ...
dst: 干得好！！！南下之路已经畅通。让我们去拿下那个世界的「靴子」 ...

src: Good job !!! The way into the interior of the country is open now. On to the farms with the fattened Pigs...
dst: 干得好！！！通向内陆的道路已经打开。向那些养着肥猪的农庄进军...

src: Good job !!! You have rescued the Celts. But now there is staying a new strong opponent in front of you. Pompeius is back in the Country. Get armed !!!
dst: 干得好！！！你救出了凯尔特人。但如今眼前还挡着一个强敌。庞培回到了国内。拿起武器吧！！！

src: Good job !!! Your flight was successful !!!
Good job General. Messines Ridge is back in our hands.
dst: 干得好，将军。梅西讷山脊重新回到我们手中。

src: Good job General. The attack of British and French forces towards Pilkem Ridge has been stopped and most of the ground lost recaptured. Our troops are in good shape to counter the follow-up attacks that can be expected soon.
dst: 干得好，将军。英法军队向皮尔凯姆岭的进攻已被阻止，大部分丢失的阵地也已夺回。我们的部队状态良好，足以反击很快便可预期的后续进攻。

src: Good job General. The attack of British and French forces towards Pilkem Ridge has been stopped and most of the ground lost recaptured. Our troops are in pretty good shape to counter the follow-up attacks that can be expected soon.
dst: 干得好，将军。英法军队向皮尔肯姆岭的进攻已被遏止，失去的阵地大部分也已夺回。我军状态相当不错，足以迎击预料中即将到来的后续进攻。

src: Good job Herr General! Your victory has opened the door for an attack on the city of Stalin before the Soviets have even consolidated their defenses!
dst: 干得好，将军阁下！你的胜利为在苏军尚未巩固其防御之前进攻斯大林城打开了大门！

src: Good job! The German offensive has been stopped, and it's obvious that they're running out of reserves and supplies. If things go on like this, soon they'll have nothing left to fight with. However, let's not underestimate the Krauts. Their first assault on the Marne may have failed, but I doubt they've given up so easily. I'm sure they'll try again.
dst: 干得好！德军的攻势被遏制住了，而且很明显，他们的预备队和补给正日渐枯竭。照这样下去，他们很快就会弹尽粮绝、无力再战。不过，我们可不能低估德国佬。他们第一次对马恩河的进攻也许失败了，但我怀疑他们不会如此轻易罢休。我敢肯定他们会卷土重来。

src: Good job! The Soviet armies were defeated and Rostov is in our hands. Now we can plan the invasion of the Caucasus! The Fuhrer is already thinking about reaching the Middle East.
dst: 干得好！苏军各集团军已被击败，罗斯托夫在我手中。现在我们可以筹划入侵高加索了！元首已经在考虑推进到中东。

src: Good job, General. We are expecting the Yugoslavian government to surrender at any minute. We can extend our territory with another 11600 km2. Now we are sending you back to the mainland to reinforce your troops. We'll need you and your men for the big push on the Soviet Union. I hope you are up to the challenge.
dst: 干得好，将军。我们预计南斯拉夫政府随时会投降。我国领土又能再扩大1.16万平方公里。现在我们把你派回本土去加强你的部队。向苏联的大举推进需要你和你的部下。我希望你能胜任这一挑战。

src: Good job, General. You have secured the Polish-Hungarian border and the railway to Poland! We signed a peace treaty with Slovakia on April 4 and we annected another 1600 km2 of territory.
dst: 干得好，将军。你已确保了波兰-匈牙利边界以及通往波兰的铁路！我们于4月4日与斯洛伐克签署了和约，并又兼并了1,600平方公里的领土。

src: Good job, Herr General! You were able to hold off the Soviet attack! Unfortunately this horrible weather is forcing us to abandond our positions in the Volga and in Klin!
dst: 干得好，将军阁下！你顶住了苏军的进攻！遗憾的是，这恶劣的天气正迫使我们在伏尔加河和克林放弃阵地！

src: Good job, Herr General. Despite the Soviets threwing everything at you, you were able to succeed! Now we can hold the city until next campaigning season will begin.
dst: 干得好，将军阁下。尽管苏军把一切都朝你砸来，你还是成功了！现在我们可以守住该城，直到下一个作战季节开始。

src: Good job, Herr General. You have defeated the enemy and our front is finally seccured. Now we can complete our preparations for our final  objective, Mosvow.
dst: 干得好，将军阁下。你击败了敌人，我们的正面终于稳固。现在我们可以为最终目标莫斯科完成各项准备。

src: Good job, sir.  We've pushed the Germans back somewhat to the west of Caen, allowing Montgomery the pleasure of moving his drinks cabinet six inches closer to Berlin.  Unfortunately those German reinforcements that showed up have stalled our advance, and we need a new plan to wrest Caen from the Bosch.  I fear the words "I have a cunning plan" are rapidly marching from Montgomery's mouth with ill-deserved confidence.  Cup of tea, sir?
dst: 干得不错，长官。我们已把德军向西压退到卡昂以西一段，让蒙哥马利得以乐滋滋地把他的酒柜向柏林挪近了六英寸。遗憾的是，那些出现的德军援军迟滞了我们的推进，我们需要一个新计划来从德国佬手中夺下卡昂。我担心“我有个狡猾的计划”这句话正从蒙哥马利口中以莫须有的自信鱼贯而出。来杯茶吗，长官？

src: Good job. Again 100,000s of Russians are trapped in pockets behind our lines. The Bolsheviks made the mistake of committing all their troops to the first line of defense. Once you broke through, they had no reserve forces to stop you. Now it's time to move East. Moscow is the target.
dst: 干得好。又有数十万俄国人被困在我们战线后方的各个包围圈中。布尔什维克犯了把全部兵力投入第一道防线的错误。你一旦突破，他们就没有预备队可以阻挡你了。现在是时候向东推进了。目标是莫斯科。

src: Good job. The Germans were driven back several hundereds miles. The Leningrader population is no longer a hostage for the faschists.
dst: 干得好。德国人被击退了数百英里。列宁格勒的民众不再是法西斯的人质。

src: Good job. The attack of the axis crashed on your lines. Now we have enough time to prepare Kiew for the defense.
dst: 干得好。轴心国的进攻在你们防线上撞得粉碎。现在我们有了足够的时间把基辅准备成防御阵地。

src: Good job. We could attack along a wide front. However, the Germans brought up reinforcements. So, a further attack is impossible in the moment.
dst: 干得好。我们得以在宽广的战线上推进。然而，德军在此期间已得到增援。暂时无法再考虑进一步推进了。

src: Good job. You could achieve most of our goals despite the german tanks.
dst: 干得好。尽管有德国坦克的阻挠，你还是达成了我们的大部分目标。

src: Good job. You could held most of the region of Kiev.
dst: 干得好。你守住了基辅地区的大部分。

src: Good job. You could nearly hold your line.
dst: 干得好。你几乎守住了你的防线。

src: Good job. You hold nearly everything.
dst: 干得好。你几乎守住了一切。

src: Good luck Kapitanleutnant. If you succeed and complete the mission you will become the youngest Korvettenkapitan of the Kriegsmarine.
dst: 祝您好运，海军上尉阁下。如果您成功完成任务，您将成为德国海军最年轻的海军少校。

src: Good luck and God's speed General.
dst: 祝你好运，一路顺风，将军。

src: Good luck in your next mission, I must depart to catch up to the drive to the channel.
dst: 祝你的下一个任务好运，我得走了，去赶上向海峡的推进。

src: Good luck next time, Herr Oberleutnant.
Good luck reporting to Mussilini, I must depart to answer to the Fuhrer for our failure.
dst: 祝你向墨索里尼汇报好运，我得走了，去向元首为我们的失败作交代。

src: Good luck, General! God save the King!
dst: 祝您好运，将军！上帝保佑国王！

src: Good luck, General! You will need it.
dst: 祝您好运，将军！您会需要运气的。

src: Good luck. I am sure that you will not disappoint me.
dst: 祝好运。我相信您不会让我失望。

src: Good morning Capitano. Welcome to the Libyan desert. You have been put in command of the Ridotta Capuzo garrison. These local garrison troops are part of the 38th Group Frontier Guards.
dst: 早上好，上尉。欢迎来到利比亚沙漠。你已被任命为卡普佐据点守备队的指挥官。这些当地守备部队隶属第38边防警戒集群。

src: Good morning General, I hope you thaw from the trip most quickly.
dst: 早上好，将军，希望你尽快从旅途的严寒中缓过来。

src: Good morning General, what do you think of today's surprise attack on Pearl Harbor?  The Yankees were completely surprised and there fleet was severely damaged!   We will receive the war declaration from the USA in the next few hours...
dst: 早上好，将军，您对今天偷袭珍珠港有何看法？美国佬完全被打了个措手不及，他们的舰队遭受重创！接下来几小时内我们就会收到美国的宣战……

src: Good morning commander! Winston Churchill observes a maneuver near Holkham. He'll reside at Holkham Hall. If we could take him as a hostage, the war could be won soon.
dst: 早上好，指挥官！温斯顿·丘吉尔正在霍尔克姆附近视察一场演习。他将下榻霍尔克姆庄园。若能把他抓为人质，战争很快就能获胜。

src: Good morning commander.  Have you enjoyed the past months here in Korea?  Well I'm going to explain your new orders from Tokyo... yes, the vacation is over.  You and your men will go to the Russo-Korean border... yes you have guessed it, the plans are to make a little ''attack'' on the strategic ''Zaozernaya'' and ''Bogomolnaya'' hills located on the East side of the border, not far from the Khasan lake.  These hills are claimed by Tokyo, and of course they should be ours!  The borders are only protected by some poorly equipped border guards, but surely the Soviet Far East command will react quickly by sending troops to halt our assault.  If we can resist the soviet counterattack, the hills and other strategic positions will remain under the Rising Sun flag.
dst: 早上好，指挥官。过去几个月您在朝鲜过得愉快吗？好吧，我来向您说明东京下达的新命令……没错，假期结束了。您和您的部下将前往苏朝边境……是的，您猜到了，计划是对位于边境东侧、离哈桑湖不远的战略要地「扎奥焦尔纳亚」高地和「博戈莫利纳亚」高地发起一次小小的「进攻」。这些高地是东京声称拥有主权的，当然它们应该属于我们！边境只有一些装备简陋的边防军守卫，但可以肯定，苏联远东司令部会迅速做出反应，派兵阻止我们的突击。如果我们能顶住苏联的反击，这些高地和其他战略要地就将继续飘扬在旭日旗下。

src: Good morning comrade Lieutenant-General. STAVKA has decided it is time for you to break the stalemate at Khalkin Gol. The Japanese have been pouring reinforcements into the area, but, as you know, so have we, and we continue to do so. Therefore you will expel the invaders and push them back to where they came from!
dst: 早上好，中将同志。最高统帅部决定，现在是你在哈拉哈河打破僵局的时候了。日军一直在向该地区倾注增援，但如你所知，我们也一样，而且仍在继续。因此你要把入侵者赶出去，把他们打回他们来的地方！

src: Good morning general, Hainan Island is good base for air raids into south China.
dst: 早上好，将军，海南岛是对中国南方发动空袭的优良基地。

src: Good morning general.  The enemy National Guard and those rookie soldiers weren't a problem for your elite warriors.  But now, we should take care, the Americans will send a lot of units to this sector with the aim of erasing us from US soil, we shall see.  Your mission is to capture San Francisco from the ground, and also seize San Jose.  We expect a direct attack on our beach head at Monterey and the arrival of the US navy, which will surely try to set a blockade... it, will be funny when the world biggest warship, our glorious battleship Yamato, arrives to deal with their vessels.
dst: 早上好，将军。 敌方的国民警卫队和那些新兵蛋子根本不是你们这些精锐武士的对手。 但现在我们得当心了，美国人会向这一地区投入大量部队，企图把我们彻底从美国本土上抹掉，走着瞧吧。 您的任务是从陆上夺取旧金山，同时占领圣何塞。 我们预计敌人会直接进攻我们在蒙特雷的滩头阵地，美国海军也会到来，他们肯定会试图实施封锁……等到世界上最大的战舰、我们光荣的大和号战列舰前来收拾他们的舰船时，那可就有意思了。

src: Good morning, Colonel. After the Great War, Poland became an independent republic again. But rebuilding of the state was halted by the Soviet attack last winter. Instead of the roads and towns that needed to be built, the army had to be sent in to stop the Bolsheviks. A few weeks ago the Russians crushed Polish positions near Wilno and took the city. Then they occupied other Polish territories. Now it's time to stop the bolsheviks and take Wilno back.
dst: 早上好，上校。第一次世界大战结束后，波兰再次成为一个独立的共和国。但国家的重建被去年冬天苏军的进攻打断了。军队不得不被派去阻止布尔什维克，而不是修建那些本该修建的公路和城镇。几周前，俄国人摧毁了维尔诺附近的波军阵地，占领了该城。随后他们又占领了波兰的其他领土。现在是时候阻止布尔什维克、夺回维尔诺了。

src: Good morning, General. First of all, my congratulations. As part of our cooperation agreement with the Government of France accepted your elite column to be trained along with French units near the city of Fez. I didn't expect your troops to perform so well. You have earned the respect of Maréchal Lyautey himself and that will undoubtedly increase the prestige of our army among our neighbors.
dst: 早上好，将军。首先，请接受我的祝贺。作为我们与法国政府合作协议的一部分，法国政府同意您的精锐纵队在非斯市附近与法军部队一同训练。我没想到您的部队表现得如此出色。您赢得了利奥泰元帅本人的尊重，这无疑将提高我军在邻国当中的威望。

src: Good morning, General. It seems that our alliance with the Serbs and the Greeks will make our old dream of liberating all the Bulgarian people that are still under the Turkish yoke come true. Our advance on Thrace has been so quick that we have caught the Turks off-guard. So far, they have only a few weak divisions in the area, and their reinforcements haven't been able to arrive in time.
dst: 早上好，将军。看来我们与塞尔维亚人和希腊人的联盟，将使解放所有仍处于土耳其奴役之下的保加利亚同胞这一夙愿得以实现。我们向色雷斯的推进如此神速，打得土耳其人措手不及。迄今，他们在该地区只有几个兵力薄弱的师，援军也未能及时赶到。

src: Good morning, General. Just as you expected, the French have mobilized their troops in a matter of hours, and they are ready to invade Elsass and Lothringen. Since most of our divisions are in Belgium executing the Schlieffen Plan, that means that our enemies have numerical superiority in this region. It's essential that you hold Mülhausen long enough, slowing the French advance and forcing them to send reinforcements to Elsass, weakening their defences in the west.
dst: 早上好，将军。正如您所料，法军数小时内就完成了动员，并准备入侵阿尔萨斯和洛林。由于我们的大部分师正在比利时执行冯·施里芬计划，这意味着敌军在这一地区拥有数量优势。关键的是您必须守住米卢斯足够长的时间，迟滞法军推进，迫使他们向阿尔萨斯派出增援，从而削弱其在西面的防御。

src: Good morning, General. Sit down. There is something important that I want to tell you.
dst: 早上好，将军。请坐。有件重要的事情我想告诉您。

src: Good morning, Herr Feldmarschall! We have to proceed further down the coast towards Florida in order to completely cut off the US Army from the sea. Your next objectives are to capture the city of Savannah and the port town of Brunswick, Georgia.
dst: 早上好，元帅阁下！我们必须继续沿海岸向佛罗里达方向推进，以彻底切断美军与海洋的联系。您的下一个目标是夺取萨凡纳市和佐治亚州港口城镇布伦瑞克。

src: Good news, General! We have recieved a squadron of Stukas from Germany. They will come in handy when you advance on Madrid. This is your next task. Having cut them off from the rest of the country, taking the capital should be rather easy.
dst: 好消息，将军！我们从德国接收了一个中队的斯图卡俯冲轰炸机。你向马德里推进时它们会派上用场。这是你的下一项任务。既然已把他们与全国其他地区隔绝，攻占首都应该相当容易。

src: Good news, comrade!  The capitalists in Warsaw realize that further struggles with the People's Republic will inevitably will lead their defeat!  Though not all of our claims have been recognized in the cease fire, we now have peace at our western borders!  That means we finally have a border instead of a front!
dst: 好消息，同志！华沙的资本家们认识到，与人民共和国继续斗争必将导致他们的失败！尽管停火中我们并非所有要求都得到了承认，但我们现在在西线边境已迎来和平！这意味着我们终于有了一条边界，而不是一条战线！

src: Good performance, Herr General. The Bolshevik armies are cut off without hope of relief. And, even now, communication between the Baltic states and Leningrad has been severed. Leningrad should now fall easily.
dst: 表现良好，将军阁下。布尔什维克的军队已被切断，解围无望。而且，即便在此刻，波罗的海沿岸各国与列宁格勒之间的联系也已被切断。列宁格勒现在应当能轻易拿下。

src: Good show, sir.  Despite the desperate attempts by the Italians and their Colonial allies, the advance is going swimmingly.  Further challenges await however, as the vice tightens around the Italians and their East African forces.
dst: 干得漂亮，长官。尽管意大利人和他们的殖民盟友拼命挣扎，推进依然顺风顺水。然而，随着包围圈在意大利人及其东非部队周围越收越紧，更多挑战还在前方。

src: Good showing, sir!  Despite the rather madcap nature of Montgomery's cunning plan, you still somehow managed to achieve your objectives - and in good time!  Unfortunately, due to the heavy casualties suffered by our airborne chaps, the lack of supplies and the German counter-attacks bearing down on our flanks, we have little chance of exploiting this breakthrough.  The war won't be over by Christmas it now appears.
dst: 表现出色，长官！尽管蒙哥马利那个狡猾的计划相当疯狂，你竟还是设法达成了目标——而且及时！遗憾的是，由于我空降部队伤亡惨重、补给匮乏，加之德军反攻压向两翼，我们几乎没有机会扩大这一突破。看来战争不会在圣诞节前结束了。

src: Good to see you again General!
Good to see you again so soon General!
dst: 这么快又见到你，真好，将军！

src: Good work Colonel. Even though the remnants of the encircled Soviet divisions managed to escape destruction by fleeing into the forests, we managed to capture most of their heavy equipment! All fronts are now stabilized and......Excuse me a moment......Colonel!, I have just now been informed that Stalin will accept Marshal Mannerheim's proposal for an armistice if we cut all diplomatic ties with Germany, and German troops are given a deadline of September 15 to withdraw from Finnish soil or be interned and handed over to the Soviet Union as POWs. This war of continuation is as good as over!
dst: 干得好，上校。尽管被围苏军各师的残部逃入森林得以免于被歼，我们仍缴获了他们的大部分重型装备！各战线现已稳定，而且……失陪一下……上校！我刚刚得知：如果我们与德国断绝一切外交关系，并给德军规定9月15日为撤出芬兰领土的最后期限，否则即予以拘押并作为战俘移交苏联，斯大林将接受曼纳海姆元帅的停战提议。这场继续战争差不多已经结束了！

src: Good work Commander!! We were taken by surprise at the strength of the enemy and your invasion force landed off target but you have prevailed!!!
dst: 干得好，指挥官！！我们被敌人的强大兵力打了个措手不及，您的登陆部队也偏离了目标地点，但您仍然获胜了！！！

src: Good work Comrade General! Now the Romanians are protesting that we violated the agreement by using airborne troops and airborne tanks to disperse their army! They were so panic stricken that they actually assumed that the tanks had been transported by air as well! Stalin sends his regards. Well done...
dst: 干得好，将军同志！现在罗马尼亚人抗议我们使用空降部队和空降坦克驱散他们的军队，违反了协定！他们惊恐万状，竟真的以为那些坦克也是由空运投送的！斯大林向你致意。干得好...

src: Good work Comrade General. Your's and Rokossovsky's success at Yelnya has been the only bright spot against the German invasion of our country thus far. I know that you would probably like to continue your westward drive from Yelnya, but Stalin has ordered the Reserve front onto the defensive, and has summoned you to the Kremlin. I have a feeling that he would like you to take over the defence of Leningrad from Marshal Voroshilov, whose performance has been deemed as so incompetent, that now there is a real threat that our Northern capital will fall!
dst: 干得好，将军同志。迄今在德国入侵我国的战争中，你和罗科索夫斯基在叶利尼亚取得的战果是唯一的亮点。我知道你大概想从叶利尼亚继续西进，但斯大林已命令预备队方面军转入防御，并召你前往克里姆林宫。我有一种感觉：他大概想让你从伏罗希洛夫元帅手中接管列宁格勒的防务——后者的表现被认为极其无能，以致我们北方的都城现在真的有陷落的危险！

src: Good work General. Now we will pursue the Germans back to the Adriatic coast..
dst: 干得好，将军。现在我们要把德军一路追回亚得里亚海沿岸..

src: Good work Herr General  The encirclement has been broken and you have managed to some of the Sixth Armee's men. These brave men are now safely on our side of the Mishkova. We mourn the heroic ones that died during the attempt, and those who were forced to surrender...
dst: 干得好，将军阁下  包围圈已被打破，你成功救出了第六集团军的一部分人。这些勇士现在已安全抵达我们这一侧的米什科瓦河。我们为在突围中阵亡的英雄、以及被迫投降的人们哀悼……

src: Good work Herr General  Unfortunately though, the Soviets are still hanging on in a few places on the banks of the Volga, especially in the houses and factories...
dst: 干得好，将军阁下  遗憾的是，苏军仍在伏尔加河沿岸的几处据守，尤其是在那些房屋和工厂里……

src: Good work Herr General!  Due to your battlefield savvy, the road to Voronezh is now open!
dst: 干得好，将军阁下！多亏你在战场上的敏锐，通往沃罗涅日的道路现在已经打开！

src: Good work Herr General! Due to your resourceful leadership, the resources of the Donets Basin are now ours. About General Halder: His talk with the Fuhrer has had some success! The Fuhrer has promised to keep a close watch on your 6th Armee's progress, and to strengthen your exposed position on the steppe, he has ordered the 4th Panzer Armee to turn around and rejoin the Drive to the Volga!
dst: 干得好，将军阁下！由于你足智多谋的指挥，顿巴斯的资源现在归我们所有。关于哈尔德将军：他与元首的谈话取得了一些成效！元首已承诺密切关注你第六集团军的进展；为加强你在草原上暴露的阵地，他已命令第4装甲集团军掉头回来，重新加入进军伏尔加河的行列！

src: Good work Herr General! You have achieved a Great victory for the Fatherland! The city of Stalingrad is finally and completely ours at last! The Fuhrer is beside himself with joy! We should refit and await with confidence the events that the new year will bring!
dst: 干得好，将军阁下！你为祖国赢得了一场伟大的胜利！斯大林格勒城终于完全属于我们了！元首欣喜若狂！我们应当休整改编，满怀信心地等待新的一年将带来的事态发展！

src: Good work Herr General! You have cleared the area between the rivers, and have decimated the Soviet 62nd Army! Now you will make the final drive for Stalingrad!
dst: 干得好，将军阁下！你已肃清两河之间的地区，并重创了苏联第62集团军！现在你将向斯大林格勒发起最后的一击！

src: Good work Herr General, huge numbers of prisoners have been taken and 2 Soviet Armies destroyed. Continue on towards Smolensk.
dst: 干得好，将军阁下，俘获了大量战俘，歼灭了2个苏联集团军。继续向斯摩棱斯克推进。

src: Good work Herr General, thankfully you were able to retreat before your entire force was lost!!
dst: 干得好，将军阁下，幸好你赶在全部兵力被歼之前撤退了！！

src: Good work Herr General, the Bryansk Front has been smashed by your Panzers and Orel taken.
dst: 干得好，将军阁下，你们的装甲部队已粉碎布良斯克方面军，并夺取了奥廖尔。

src: Good work Herr General, the Uman pocket has been sealed...
dst: 干得好，将军阁下，乌曼包围圈已经合拢……

src: Good work Herr General, the bridgeheads have been secured...
dst: 干得好，将军阁下，桥头堡已经巩固……

src: Good work Herr General, time to press our advantage.
dst: 干得好，将军阁下，是时候扩大我们的优势了。

src: Good work Herr General, we are now driving deep into the Caucasus!
dst: 干得好，将军阁下，我们正在向高加索纵深推进！

src: Good work Herr General, you have managed to open the road to Grozny. Preparations are now underway for the final assault...
dst: 干得好，将军阁下，你已成功打开通往格罗兹尼的道路。最后突击的准备工作正在进行……

src: Good work Herr General. As a result, 4th Panzer armee is now on the move, and should arrive very shortly at Kotelnikovo..
dst: 干得好，将军阁下。结果，第4装甲集团军现已出动，不久即应抵达科捷利尼科沃..

src: Good work Herr General. Now that you have established a base on Canadian soil we can push into the U.S.A.
dst: 干得好，将军阁下。既然你已在加拿大土地建立了基地，我们就能推进到美国了。

src: Good work Herr General. We have reached the shores of Lake Ladoga! Now we can encircle Leningrad from the east.
dst: 干得好，将军阁下。我们已抵达拉多加湖畔！现在我们可以从东面合围列宁格勒。

src: Good work Herr General. You have achieved a great victory and have secured the city of Voronezh. Your victory has consolidated the flanks of our attack towards the Caucasus...
dst: 干得好，将军阁下。你取得了一场伟大的胜利，并夺取了沃罗涅日城。你的胜利巩固了我们向高加索进攻的两翼……

src: Good work Herr General. Your Wiking division acquitted itself well, and von Rundstedt sends his congratulations on a succesful outcome to your first action on the Eastern front...
dst: 干得好，将军阁下。你的「维京」师表现不俗，冯·伦德施泰特对你踏上东线后首次行动的圆满结果表示祝贺……

src: Good work Major! As you know, the Soviet Union has attacked us all along our front, but you managed to delay the Soviet attack in this sector just enough to allow us to begin the set up our defensive positions behind the Mannerheim line. Do not worry about the puppet government installed by Stalin in Terijoki, it does not and will not have the support of our people! Anyway, You and your men will now move North towards Tolvajarvi, where a counter offensive is being planned...
dst: 干得好，少校！如你所知，苏联在我国全线发动了进攻，但你成功地把苏军在这一地段的进攻拖延了足够长的时间，使我们得以开始在曼纳海姆防线后方构筑防御阵地。不必担心斯大林在泰里约基扶植的那个傀儡政府，它得不到、也永远不会得到我国人民的支持！总之，你和你的部下现在将北上调往托尔瓦亚尔维，那里正在策划一次反击...

src: Good work Major! As you know, the Soviet Union has attacked us all along our front, but you managed to delay the Soviet attack in this sector just enough to allow us to begin the set up our defensive positions behind the Mannerheim line. Do not worry about the puppet government installed by Stalin in Terijoki, it does not and will not have the support of our people! Anyway, You and your men will now move North towards Tolvajarvi, where a counter offensive is being planned....
dst: 干得好，少校！如你所知，苏联在我国全线发动了进攻，但你成功地把苏军在这一地段的进攻拖延了足够长的时间，使我们得以开始在曼纳海姆防线后方构筑防御阵地。不必担心斯大林在泰里约基扶植的那个傀儡政府，它得不到、也永远不会得到我国人民的支持！总之，你和你的部下现在将北上调往托尔瓦亚尔维，那里正在策划一次反击....

src: Good work Major, excuse me, I mean Colonel! The Soviet attack has been defeated, and they are now transferring their best troops to Estonia, to fight the Germans there. It appears the Soviets are coming to the conclusion that conquering Finland will be extremely difficult, and not worth the cost. We have received word from our Swedish friends that Stalin is now willing to discuss peace terms with us. Nevertheless, we now need you to begin immediately making your way further north, towards Ilomantsi, where, based on the latest recon reports, an as yet indeterminant number of Soviet troops appear to be moving in an aggressive fashion towards us...
dst: 干得好，少校，恕我失言，我是说上校！苏军的进攻已被击败，他们正把最精锐的部队调往爱沙尼亚，在那里与德军作战。看来苏军正在得出这样的结论：征服芬兰将极其困难，且不值得付出那样的代价。我们从瑞典朋友处得到消息，斯大林现在愿意与我们商讨和平条件。尽管如此，我们现在需要你立刻启程继续北上，前往伊洛曼齐——根据最新的侦察报告，数量尚不确定的苏军部队似乎正以进攻姿态朝我们逼近……

src: Good work Major. Thanx to your militairy prowess, we have been able to set up a strong line of defence on the Soviet side of the Svir river! We are now going to continue to press north from Petrozavodsk, towards Medvezhegorsk. Your forces will enjoy some well earned R&R manning the line of defence here....
dst: 干得好，少校。多亏你的军事才干，我们已在斯维尔河的苏方一侧建立起一道坚固防线！现在我们将继续自彼得罗扎沃茨克向北推进，指向梅德韦日耶戈尔斯克。你的部队将在此驻守防线，享受一段应得的休整....

src: Good work Major. The Soviet attackers have been repelled, and the partisan spies destroyed. Thanx to your help, our airbase at Tiiksjarvi should continue to be a thorn in the side of the Soviet juggernaut for some time yet. Now, back to business. After a well deserved night's rest, you and your men will immediately set out to rejoin our forces at the Svir river. Judging by the latest recon reports, it appears the Soviets might be up to something there...
dst: 干得好，少校。苏军的进攻已被击退，游击队的密探也被消灭。多亏你的帮助，我们在蒂克夏尔维的空军基地在未来一段时间内仍将是苏联那台战争机器侧翼的一根刺。现在言归正传。经过一夜应得的休息之后，你和你的部下将立刻出发，前往斯维尔河与我军主力会合。根据最新的侦察报告，苏军似乎在那里有所图谋...

src: Good work Major. The Soviet attempt to drive us out of the Svir sector has been repulsed, and they have suffered heavy casualties as a result. I have a feeling that they will think twice before attacking us in this area again. Now, I should pass this interesting information on to you: Since Marshal Mannerheim is not so sure anymore that Germany will be able to win the war, he is contemplating how to make peace with the Allies, and he may soon start by not ordering anymore offensive operations. If this happens, take care that your men's morale stays high, just in case....
dst: 干得好，少校。苏军把我们逐出斯维尔地段的企图已被挫败，他们为此付出了惨重伤亡。我有一种感觉：他们下次在这一地区进攻我们之前会三思而行。现在，我应该把这则有趣的消息转告给你：由于曼纳海姆元帅已不再那么确信德国能赢得这场战争，他正在考虑如何与盟国媾和，而且可能很快就会从不再下令发动任何进攻行动开始。如果真到了那一步，请务必让你的部下保持高昂的士气，以防万一....

src: Good work Major. This is our first "big" victory against the Invaders. The importance of this Victory as a morale booster cannot be under estimated! The threat of a Soviet division getting behind our lines has been neutralized, and the 139th division has been hit very hard. Now your skills are again needed, even further North, where we are planning to retake Suomussalmi....
dst: 干得好，少校！这是我们抗击入侵者的首次「重大」胜利。这场胜利在鼓舞士气方面的意义再怎么高估也不为过！苏军一个师迂回到我军后方的威胁已被消除，第139师遭到重创。如今你的才能在更北面的地方又被需要了——我们正计划在那里收复苏穆萨尔米....

src: Good work Major. We are close to re-conquering the Karelian Isthmus. Soon we will push into East Karelia, towards Leningrad, which should result in giving us a comfortable buffer zone against any Soviet attempts at re-entering Finnish territory...
dst: 干得好，少校。我们已接近重新征服卡累利阿地峡。很快我们将推进至东卡累利阿，直指列宁格勒，这将给我们带来一片舒适的缓冲地带，足以应对苏军任何重新进入芬兰领土的尝试……

src: Good work Major. You have helped to acheive yet another victory against the Invaders! 2 Soviet divisions have been nearly wiped out, and the remainder are on the run, and we have collected quite a war booty! Now, your men, along with the 9th division, will move back south towards Kuhmo....
dst: 干得好，少校。你又帮我们取得了一场抗击入侵者的胜利！苏军两个师几乎被全歼，余部正四处逃散，我们也缴获了可观的战利品！现在，你的部下将连同第9师南下，朝库赫莫推进....

src: Good work comrade General. The Germans have been driven away from Moscow, but the front lines are still relatively close, and more importantly, the Rzhev salient of Army Group Center remains intact. Thus Stalin still considers Moscow as threatened...
dst: 干得好，将军同志。德军已被逐离莫斯科，但战线仍然相对接近，更重要的是，中央集团军群的勒热夫突出部依旧完好。因此斯大林仍认为莫斯科受到威胁……

src: Good work comrade Lieutenant-General. Most of the Japanese forces have been wiped out, the remainder being either caught behind our lines of advance or pushed back into Manchukuo. Now the Japanese have asked for an armistice, and they agree to abide by the existing border! Congratulations, you have been awarded the title of "Hero of the Soviet Union", promoted to General of the Army, and have been given command of the Kiev Special Military District!
dst: 干得好，中将同志。日军大部已被歼灭，余部要么被切断在我军推进线之后，要么被赶回满洲国。现在日方已请求停战，并同意遵守现有边界！恭喜你，你被授予「苏联英雄」称号，晋升为大将，并受命指挥基辅特别军区！

src: Good work comrade Marshal! Bobruisk is ours again, and a southern route into Minsk has been opened. But not only that! 5 divisions of 9th Armee's XXXV Korps have been trapped, along with elements of the XXXXI Panzer Korps that were not able to break out...
dst: 干得好，元帅同志！博布鲁伊斯克又回到我们手中，通往明斯克的南路也已打开。不仅如此！第9集团军第35军的5个师被围，未能突围的第41装甲军各部队也在其中……

src: Good work comrade Marshal! Brest-Litovsk is ours again. Stalin is also pleased that You and Rokossovsky were able to exploit the success, and as a result, continue the drive west towards the Vistula river...
dst: 干得好，元帅同志！布列斯特-立托夫斯克又回到我们手中。斯大林也很满意你和罗科索夫斯基能够扩大战果，因而继续西进，直逼维斯瓦河……

src: Good work comrade Marshal! The Germans have been forced back over to the west bank of the Vistula, but unfortunately, they managed to destroy the bridgehead, thus making it much harder now to relieve the uprising...
dst: 干得好，元帅同志！德军已被逼回维斯瓦河西岸，但不幸的是，他们成功摧毁了桥头堡，这使驰援起义变得更加困难……

src: Good work comrade Marshal! You have managed to secure the Arsnwalde area and breakthrough past Stargard towards Altdamm and Stettin. Now the 2nd Belorussian front will take it from here while most of the elements of your 1st Belorussian front return to the bridgehead at Kustrin in preparation for the final push towards Berlin...
dst: 干得好，元帅同志！你已成功控制阿恩斯瓦尔德地区，并突破什塔加德，直指阿尔特达姆和斯德丁。现在白俄罗斯第2方面军将接手这里，而你的白俄罗斯第1方面军大部则返回屈斯特林桥头堡，为向柏林的最后推进做准备……

src: Good work comrade Marshal, Mogilev is ours again and 4th Armee has been pushed back to Minsk preventing them from disengaging in time to reinforce Vitebsk and Bobruisk, resulting in roughly 30,000 German troops being surrounded at Vitebsk, and the encirclement of 5 divisions in the Bobruisk sector!
dst: 干得好，元帅同志，莫吉廖夫又回到我们手中，第4集团军被打退回明斯克，未能及时脱身去增援维捷布斯克和博布鲁伊斯克，结果约3万名德军在维捷布斯克被包围，博布鲁伊斯克地段则有5个师被合围！

src: Good work comrade Marshal, You and Zakharov have acheived in 5 days what STAVKA had allotted 8-11 days to complete! Stalin sends his regards!
dst: 干得好，元帅同志，你和扎哈罗夫用5天时间完成了最高统帅部预计8至11天完成的任务！斯大林向你致意！

src: Good work comrade Marshal. Although the German defence line on the Narew River remains intact in the Lomza area, Stalin has noted the capture of the fortress of Osowiec and sends congratulations to the units and commanders involved!
dst: 干得好，元帅同志。尽管德军在沃姆扎地区纳雷夫河上的防线仍然完整，斯大林已注意到奥索维茨要塞的攻克，并向参战部队和指挥员表示祝贺！

src: Good work comrade Zhukov! Although the Germans still hold the Sinyavino heights, under your leadership and guidance, the fronts have met, and thus a land corridor has been opened into Leningrad! The city is still partially under siege, but emergency supply trucks are entering Leningrad as we speak, carrying much needed food and supplies. Once this second " Road of Life" is finished being constructed within the liberated corridor, Leningrad should be able to be supplied with all necessities until the Siege can be completely lifted. Congratulations, you have been promoted to Marshal of the Soviet Union!
dst: 干得好，朱可夫同志！尽管德军仍据守锡尼亚维诺高地，但在你的领导和指挥之下，两个方面军已经会师，从而打通了一条通往列宁格勒的陆上走廊！该城仍处于部分围困之中，但就在我们说话的当口，载着急需粮食和物资的应急卡车正驶入列宁格勒。一旦这条第二条「生命之路」在解放出来的走廊内修筑完成，列宁格勒就应能获得一切必需品的补给，直至围困被彻底解除。恭喜你，你已晋升为苏联元帅！

src: Good work comrade Zhukov. But unfortunately, even though we managed to encircle the 1st Panzer Armee and capture Kamenets-Podolsk, the Germans have counter-attacked, cutting off our forces, thus their breakout attempt continues. You have been re-assigned as STAVKA coordinator to both General Rokossovsky's 1st Belorussian Front, and General Zakharov's 2nd Belorussian Front...
dst: 干得好，朱可夫同志。但不幸的是，尽管我们成功合围了德国第1装甲集团军并夺取了卡缅涅茨-波多利斯克，德军已发起反击，切断了我军，因此他们的突围企图仍在继续。你已被重新指派为最高统帅部驻罗科索夫斯基将军白俄罗斯第1方面军和扎哈罗夫将军白俄罗斯第2方面军的协调员……

src: Good work comrade. Your's and Rokossovsky's joint handling of the situation has sent the Germans reeling back under the weight of the Central front's advance, forcing  the German command to acknowledge the failure of Operation Citadel. As a result, the Germans have decided to pull von Manstein's forces back to their starting line in order to save it's troops from complete defeat...
dst: 干得好，同志。你和罗科索夫斯基对局势的联手处置，使德军在中央方面军推进的重压下节节败退，迫使德军指挥部承认「堡垒」行动失败。结果，德军已决定把冯·曼施泰因的部队撤回出发线，以免其部队彻底覆灭……

src: Good work!  Mussilini's has decided your next assignment is to lead our forces in the great Axis attack on communist Russia!
dst: 干得好！墨索里尼已决定，你的下一个任务是率领我军参加轴心国对共产主义俄国的大进攻！

src: Good work!  We have stopped the Greek assualt, but more importantly we have forced the Greek Army to capitulate.
dst: 干得好！我们挡住了希腊的进攻，但更重要的是，我们迫使希腊军队投降了。

src: Good work! The surviving Arabs have fled, and Nyangwe is in our hands. Now we'll continue our advance into the heart of Eastern Congo. A few more actions like this, and the Arabs will be doomed. Soon, all this land will belong to our beloved king.
dst: 干得好！幸存的阿拉伯人已经逃走，尼扬圭落入我们手中。现在，我们将继续向刚果东部腹地推进。再这样来上几次，阿拉伯人就完蛋了。很快，这片土地将全部属于我们敬爱的国王。

src: Good work, General! After the Medean Pass had been secured, we crossed the Libyan border and defeated the Senussi at Bir Asiso. We captured no less than forty enemy guns and machine guns, took three Turkish officers and hundreds of Senussi prisoners. Now let the Duke's armoured cars round up the enemy stragglers.
dst: 干得好，将军！在确保梅代安山口后，我们越过利比亚边境，在比尔阿西索击败了塞努西军队。我们缴获了不下四十门敌军火炮和机枪，俘虏了三名土耳其军官和数百名塞努西战俘。现在让公爵的装甲车去围捕敌军的散兵游勇吧。

src: Good work, General! Governor Horthy is very satisfied. We are expecting the Yugoslavian government to surrender at any minute. We can extend our territory with another 11600 km2. Now we are sending you back to the mainland to reinforce your troops. We'll need you and your men for the big push on the Soviet Union. I hope you are up to the challenge.
dst: 干得好，将军！霍尔蒂摄政非常满意。我们预计南斯拉夫政府随时会投降。我国领土又能再扩大1.16万平方公里。现在我们把你派回本土去加强你的部队。向苏联的大举推进需要你和你的部下。我希望你能胜任这一挑战。

src: Good work, General! It is quite clear Bolsheviks had hoped to have Budapest by a frontal assault, but your bold actions have prevented that.
dst: 干得好，将军！很明显，布尔什维克本指望以正面突击拿下布达佩斯，但你果断的行动阻止了这一点。

src: Good work, General! Uman has fallen and our advance is going well. The Bolshevik armies in the heart of Ukraine are destroyed. Kiev will soon be encircled by Wehrmacht.
dst: 干得好，将军！乌曼已经陷落，我们的推进进展顺利。乌克兰腹地的布尔什维克军队已被歼灭。基辅很快将被国防军合围。

src: Good work, General! You have shown what grim determination is able to achieve. We have made substantial territorial gains.
dst: 干得好，将军！您展现了顽强的意志能取得怎样的成就。我们取得了可观的领土进展。

src: Good work, General! You overcame the Bolshevik lines at Tarnopol and our advance into Ukraine is going as planned.
dst: 干得好，将军！你在捷尔诺波尔突破了布尔什维克的防线，我们向乌克兰的推进正按计划进行。

src: Good work, General! Your troops overran the Turkish lines and stormed Scimitar Hill. Unfortunately, we have lost far too many men to carry on with the attack. Again, the final breakthrough has not been achieved.
dst: 干得好，将军！您的部队冲垮了土耳其防线并猛攻弯刀山。遗憾的是，我们损失了太多兵力，无法继续进攻。最终的突破再次未能实现。

src: Good work, General. We already have a much improved access to the Aermelkanal [English Channel] and this might tip the scales if our advance into France proves to be indecisive - and the current plan is VERY indecisive despite Von Manstein's changes! Would you believe a plan consisting of "stop at the Meuse"?
dst: 干得好，将军。我们通往英吉利海峡的通道已大为改善，若我们向法国的推进显得迟疑不决，这或许能扭转局势——而眼下的计划即便经冯·曼施泰因修改，仍是非常迟疑不决！你能相信有“止步于默兹河”这种计划吗？

src: Good work, General. You have achieved a great victory and have secured the city of Voronezh. Your victory has consolidated the flanks of Fall Blau.
dst: 干得好，将军。你取得了一场伟大的胜利，并夺取了沃罗涅日城。你的胜利巩固了「蓝色」行动的两翼。

src: Good work, General. You have wiped out the rebel "kabilas" (local tribes) that menaced Melilla. The Spanish flag is waving on the top of Mount Gurugú and soon we´ll be able to expand our area of influence in the region.
dst: 干得好，将军。您消灭了威胁梅利利亚的叛乱「卡比拉」（当地部族）。西班牙国旗正在古鲁古山顶飘扬，很快我们就能扩大在该地区的影响范围。

src: Good work, General. Your assault on Hill 60 has been a stunning success. Unfortunately, it's strategic significance is rather limited. But at least it has been a boost of morale for our troops after all the letdowns.
dst: 干得好，将军。您对60高地的进攻取得了惊人的成功。可惜其战略意义相当有限。但在经历了那么多挫折之后，它至少提振了我军的士气。

src: Good work, Herr Feldmarshall. Unfortunately though, after receiving the news of the Allied invasion of Sicily, as well as reports of an impending Soviet attack on our positions on the Mius river, the Fuhrer has decided to cancel Operation Zitadelle...
dst: 干得好，元帅阁下。遗憾的是，在接到盟军入侵西西里的消息，以及苏军即将进攻我们在米乌斯河阵地的报告之后，元首已决定取消「堡垒」行动……

src: Good work, Herr General.  With Stalingrad in our hands we can now choose our next move.  Intelligence indicates that the Western Allies are planning a landing in Northwest Afrika.  The General Staff has decided to send significant reinforcements to the Afrika Corps, so you and your men are to transfer to Afrika after a thorough rest and refitting.  Meanwhile Feldmarschall von Paulus's Sixth Army will take your place in Stalingrad.
dst: 干得好，将军阁下。斯大林格勒已在我们手中，现在我们能选择下一步行动了。情报显示，西方盟军正计划在西北非登陆。总参谋部已决定向非洲军派出大量增援，因此您和您的部下将在充分休整和补充装备后调往非洲。与此同时，冯·保卢斯元帅的第6集团军将接替您在斯大林格勒的防务。

src: Good work, Herr General.  With Stalingrad in our hands we can now turn south and capture the Caucasian oil fields before the winter sets in.
dst: 干得好，将军阁下。斯大林格勒既已在我手中，我们现在可以转向南方，赶在冬季来临之前夺取高加索的油田。

src: Good work, Herr General.  Your troops have successfully estabilished a base close enough to our comrades trapped in Stalingrad so as to enable the reinforcement and supply of our brave men.  Bravo.
dst: 干得好，将军阁下。你的部队已成功建立一处足够靠近被困在斯大林格勒的同志们的前进基地，使我们能够为其补充兵力与补给。好样的。

src: Good work, Herr General. With Stalingrad in our hands we can now choose our next move. Intelligence indicates that the Western Allies are planning a landing in Northwest Afrika. The General Staff has decided to send significant reinforcements to the Afrika Corps, so you and your men are to transfer to Afrika after a thorough rest and refitting. Meanwhile Feldmarschall von Paulus's Sixth Army will take your place in Stalingrad.
dst: 干得好，将军阁下。斯大林格勒已在我们手中，现在我们可以选择下一步行动了。情报显示，西方盟军正计划在西北非登陆。总参谋部已决定向非洲军团派遣大批增援，因此你和你的部下将在充分休整与补充整备之后调往非洲。与此同时，冯·保卢斯元帅的第6集团军将接替你在斯大林格勒的位置。

src: Good work, in fact we doesn't expect less than a great victory here!.
dst: 干得好，事实上，我们在这里期待的绝不亚于一场大胜！

src: Good work, now we must continue with our drive to the north. Lillehammer is our next objetive.
dst: 干得好，现在我们必须继续向北推进。利勒哈默尔是我们的下一个目标。

src: Good work, sir.  In spite of an initial wobble when the Germans launched a co-ordinated counter-attack, we were able to hold our beachhead thanks to determined and steadfast  British courage.  The Germans have now halted their attacks and are adopting a defensive posture.  While the rest of X Corps breaks out to the north, your men will rest and recuperate after a testing battle.
dst: 干得不错，长官。尽管德军发起协同反攻时我们起初有些动摇，但凭着英国人坚定不屈的勇气，我们守住了滩头。德军现已停止进攻，转入防守态势。趁第10军其余部队向北突破之际，你的部队将在这场艰苦战斗之后休整恢复。

src: Good work, sir.  The Jerries have been thoroughly and comprehensively trounced - that's what Montogomery told Eisenhower when he lied to him this afternoon.  We have achieved some measure of success though, Caen has been taken, along with Bourgebus ridge, and now with the U.S. breakout to the west, a chance for encirclement looks enticing.  You, sir, have been afforded a few days rest.
dst: 干得不错，长官。德国佬已被彻底而全面地痛揍——那是蒙哥马利今天下午对艾森豪威尔撒谎时说的话。不过我们确实取得了某种程度的成功：卡昂连同布尔格比斯山脊都已拿下，如今随着美军在西面突破，一个合围的机会正显得诱人。您，长官，获准休整几天。

src: Good work, sir.  We've landed and successfully consolidated our beachhead.  Now, we must move to capture Caen at the earliest possible convenience.  I'm sure Montgomery is hatching a cunning plan as we speak...
dst: 干得不错，长官。我们已经登陆并成功巩固了滩头。现在，我们必须尽早夺取卡昂。我敢肯定，此刻蒙哥马利正在酝酿一个狡猾的计划……

src: Good work. You have fulfilled the General Staff's hopes!  Your attack has weakened enemy resistance.  And now, the war with Norway will soon be over.
dst: 干得好。你实现了总参谋部的期望！你的进攻削弱了敌军抵抗。如今，对挪威的战争很快就要结束了。

src: Good workMajor. Although you were unable to completely destroy the Soviet 54th division, you did manage to halt their attack and route parts of the division. Furthermore, the remainder of the 54th division, after losing their forward bases, are now encircled in a great "Motti" near the Soviet-Finnish border. Now you will make your way back to the Karelian Isthmus, where some dark clouds are gathering...
dst: 干得好，少校。尽管你未能彻底消灭苏联第54师，但你确实挡住了他们的进攻并击溃了该师的一部。此外，第54师的余部在失去前进基地之后，现已在苏芬边境附近被合围于一个巨大的「莫蒂」包围圈中。现在你将返回卡累利阿地峡，那里正聚集着一些乌云……

src: Good, sir.  Jerry sure made a bit of a ruckus in this sector, but we soon put a stop to that - thanks to your magnificent generalship, of course.  The commander of the U.S. 2nd Armoured Division sends his gratitude for your help, in the form of the largest collection of Charlie Chaplin films ever gathered.  Its all piled up outside your HQ.  Shall I use petrol to make it burn quicker, sir?
dst: 不错，长官。德国佬确实在这一地段闹腾了一阵，但我们很快就让他们消停了——当然，全靠你卓越的统兵才能。美军第2装甲师的指挥官为表谢意，送来了有史以来最全的查理·卓别林影片合集。全堆在你的指挥部外面了。要我浇上汽油让它烧得更快些吗，长官？

src: Good, sir.  Our crossing of the Rhine has been successful, and now all that stands in our way to Berlin is a few Hitler Youth and old men.
dst: 不错，长官。我们渡过莱茵河已告成功，如今挡在我们通往柏林之路上的，只剩几个希特勒青年团员和一些老头子了。

src: Goodbye dearest Katya, my first and only love...Believe me ever to be your devoted and loving husband,
dst: 再见了，最亲爱的卡佳，我最初也是唯一的挚爱……请永远相信，我是您忠诚而深情的丈夫，

src: Goodbye, dearest Katya, my first and only love...Believe me ever to be your devoted and loving husband,
dst: 再见了，最亲爱的卡佳，我最初也是唯一的挚爱……请永远相信，我是您忠诚而深情的丈夫，
戈帕尔·古鲁纳特·贝沃尔
戈尔代乔拉第16号/第2纵队
戈尔部队/第26集团军/第6集团军
戈尔利采—塔尔努夫，1915年5月2日
戈里亚切伊斯托奇诺耶

src: Gospodin General, Florina has been secured, and your troops have marched through Seres!  The operation has been a success.  Our allies had hoped that a Russian presence on this front would persuade the Bulgarian soldiers to desert, but this has proven to be false.
dst: 将军阁下，弗洛里纳已经确保，您的部队已穿过塞雷斯挺进！此次作战取得了成功。我们的盟友曾希望俄军出现在这条战线能说服保加利亚士兵倒戈，但事实证明并非如此。

src: Gospodin General, heavy rains hamper our communications, and the advancing front's support is not able to keep up.  Brusilov has gathered the remaining forces assaulting Kowel into an ad-hoc Osobaya (Special) Army.
dst: 将军阁下，暴雨阻碍了我们的交通，推进中的方面军后勤跟不上。布鲁西洛夫已把进攻科韦利的剩余部队集结为一支临时编成的特别集团军。

src: Gospodin General, in April 1916 the Tsar authorized the formation of a Russian Expeditionary Corps.  4 brigades were to be raised:  the 1st and 3rd destined for France and 2nd and 4th for Salonika.  The 2nd Brigade (Diterikhs) reached Salonika on 30 July, 1916 and went in line alongside the 57th and 156th French divisions.  The 4th Brigade (Leontiev) reached Salonika in October.  For both the Entente and the Central Powers, the Salonika Front is a multi-national effort.  You will deploy alongside the Serbian Morava division with the British 22nd in reserve.  On the other side of the line, Bulgarian 6th and 8th divisions alongside the German 101st hold their line.
dst: 将军阁下，1916年4月，沙皇批准组建俄国远征军。将编成4个旅：第1和第3旅开赴法国，第2和第4旅开赴萨洛尼卡。第2旅（季捷里赫斯）于1916年7月30日抵达萨洛尼卡，与法军第57和第156师并肩进入战线。第4旅（列昂季耶夫）于十月抵达萨洛尼卡。对协约国和同盟国双方来说，萨洛尼卡战线都是一场多国努力。您将与塞尔维亚摩拉瓦师并肩部署，英军第22师作为预备队。战线另一侧，保加利亚第6和第8师与德国第101师据守其战线。

src: Gospodin General, the Kerensky offensive has failed dramatically.  Along the entire Galician front:  from Lutsk to Marasti our valiant attacks pushed the enemy back from their first lines but failed to break them.  The devastating blow that came on July 14th was carried out by the German XXIII Reserve Corps (1st Guard, 2nd Guard, 6th German divisions, and the 33rd Austro-Hungarian division) in the viscinity of Zloczow.  The German divisions in the XXIII Reserve Corps were transferred from the Western Front specifically for this operation.
dst: 将军阁下，克伦斯基攻势已经惨败。沿整个加利西亚战线：从卢茨克到马拉什蒂，我们英勇的进攻把敌人从其第一道防线击退，却未能将其击破。7月14日那毁灭性的一击，由德国第23预备军（第1近卫师、第2近卫师、第6德国师和第33奥匈师）在兹沃切夫附近实施。第23预备军中的德军师是专门为这次作战从西线调来的。

src: Gospodin General, the Marasesti Operation has been a success due to the excellent communication between you and our Romanian allies.  If in the fall of 1916, when our 4th and 11th Armies were transferred to the Romanian Front to stop the Germano-Bulgarian offensive, only 74 out of 609 front-line battalions were Romanian, then today the reorganized Romanian army (15 infantry and 2 cavalry divisions) has once again assumed command of their national front.
dst: 将军阁下，由于您与罗马尼亚盟友之间的出色沟通，马勒谢什蒂战役取得了成功。如果说1916年秋，当我第4和第11集团军被调到罗马尼亚方面军以阻止德保联军攻势时，609个一线营中只有74个是罗马尼亚营，那么今天，重组后的罗马尼亚军队（15个步兵师和2个骑兵师）已再次接管了他们的国家战线。

src: Gospodin General, the results of the offensive have thus far been stunning!  By June 10th, in addition to your capture of Lutsk, Czernowitz has fallen.  Over 4,000 Austrian officers and 200,000 soldiers have been captured.  After having refused to attack along his Western Front, General Ewarth transferred control of his southern-most 3rd Army to Brusilov's command.
dst: 将军阁下，攻势迄今战果辉煌！到6月10日，除您攻占卢茨克外，切尔诺维茨也已陷落。超过4000名奥地利军官和20万名士兵被俘。在拒绝沿其西方方面军进攻之后，埃瓦特将军把他最南端的第3集团军转交布鲁西洛夫指挥。

src: Gospodin General, we are witnessing the disentigration of the 12th Army (Klembovsky)!  At dawn on September 1st, the entire German 8th Army (Hutier) has gone on the offensive with the aim of surrounding our 12th Army at Riga.  Klembovsky, expecting a direct assault on the city, concentrated his best troops (the II and VI Siberian Corps) in fortifications around the city.  Hutier, however, deployed the bulk of his army at Friedrichstadt with the aim of crossing the Dvina River and breaking through toward Hiazenburg and assaulting Riga from behind.  The Germans have formed elite stormtrooper detachments for their breakthrough divisions.  In fact, entire divisions appear to have trained in advanced assault and infiltration tactics.
dst: 将军阁下，我们正在目睹第12集团军（克列姆博夫斯基）的瓦解！9月1日拂晓，整个德国第8集团军（胡蒂尔）发起攻势，企图在里加包围我第12集团军。克列姆博夫斯基预料德军会直接攻城，便将其精锐部队（第2和第6西伯利亚军）集中在城周工事中。然而，胡蒂尔却将其集团军主力部署在弗里德里希施塔特，企图强渡德维纳河，向希亚岑堡突破，并从背后进攻里加。德军为其突破师组建了精锐的突击队分遣队。事实上，整师整师的部队似乎都受过高级突击和渗透战术的训练。

src: Gospodin General, welcome to the Western Front.  The 1st Brigade (Lokhvitsky) of the Russian Expeditionary Corps is in line north of Rheims with the VII (Baselere) Corps.  The brigade has performed several trench raids successfully, earning itself a feared reputation among the Germans.
dst: 将军阁下，欢迎来到西线。俄国远征军第1旅（洛赫维茨基）与第7军（巴塞莱尔）在兰斯以北进入战线。该旅已成功实施数次堑壕突袭，为自己在德国人中赢得了令人畏惧的名声。

src: Gospodin General, your successful capture of this objective has not been a long posession of our troops:  it appears the German command has transferred enough troops from the west to counter our offensive.  With the line stabilized, the offensive's human cost can be reflected upon...
dst: 将军阁下，您成功夺取这一目标并未被我军长久占据：看来德国指挥部已从西线调来足够部队反击我们的攻势。随着战线稳定下来，可以反思这场攻势的人命代价了……

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, Mackensen's spearhead - the GardeKorps - engaged our Leib-Guards in this battle.
dst: 中将阁下，马肯森的矛头——近卫军——在此役中与我禁卫军交战。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, SW Front (Ivanonv) has commanded we go on the offensive in the Carpathian mountains.  Simultaneously with the NW Front's offensive in North Poland, we will launch the offensive campaign of 1915.  Our strategic goals are to crest the Carpathian mountains and to break out into the Hungarian plains.
dst: 中将阁下，西南方面军（伊万诺夫）已命令我们在喀尔巴阡山脉发起进攻。与西北方面军在波兰北部的攻势同时，我们将发起1915年的进攻战役。我们的战略目标是翻越喀尔巴阡山脉，突入匈牙利平原。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, Sharpantier's cavalry has overrun the numerically superior Kurdish forces in the region:  remnants of the Halil-Bei Corps are in full retreat along the entire front.  Again, our forces were not able to reach Urmia in time to assist the revolting Armenians.  The civillian population has suffered tremendously:  47,000 Armenian and Assyro-Chaldeans have been murdered as the revolt was put down by the Ottoman Jandarma forces.
dst: 中将阁下，沙尔庞捷的骑兵击溃了该地区数量占优的库尔德部队：哈利勒贝军的残部正沿全线全面溃退。我们的部队又一次未能及时抵达乌尔米耶援助起义的亚美尼亚人。平民蒙受了巨大苦难：起义被奥斯曼宪兵部队镇压，47000名亚美尼亚人和亚述—迦勒底人被杀害。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, abandoning the great fortress of Novogeorgievsk - the symbol of Russian presence in Poland - has dealt a severe blow to the troops' morale.  The effects of the German offensive have been shattering, but your rear-guard action has saved our army valuable time in retreating from Warsaw.  You will continue to delay the German advance in Northern Poland.
dst: 中将阁下，放弃新格奥尔吉耶夫斯克这座大要塞——俄国在波兰存在的象征——已对部队士气造成沉重打击。德军攻势的后果是毁灭性的，但您的后卫作战为我军撤离华沙赢得了宝贵时间。您将继续在波兰北部迟滞德军的推进。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, after securing the Galician front during the Wieprz Operation, you have returned to the Kavkaz Front for an assignment of acute dimplomatic and strategic importance.  You will participate in the Persian Pacification campaign.
dst: 中将阁下，在维普日河战役中稳固加利西亚战线之后，您已返回高加索方面军，接受一项具有重大外交和战略意义的任务。您将参加波斯绥靖战役。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, as the South-Western Front retreated before a determined Germano-Austrian offensive, General Brusilov's 8th Army (XII, VIII, XVII, VII) on the left flank of the front found itself in a precarious position:  with the majority of forces still engaged in the Carpathian Mountain passes, the army needed much more time to withdraw.  Risking envelopment from the north, the 8th Army executed a fighting retreat to the pre-war Galician border.
dst: 中将阁下，当西南方面军在德奥联军坚决的攻势面前撤退时，位于方面军左翼的布鲁西洛夫将军第8集团军（第12、第8、第17、第7军）发现自己处境危险：由于大部分兵力仍困在喀尔巴阡山各山口，该集团军需要更多时间撤出。冒着被来自北面的合围风险，第8集团军边打边撤到战前的加利西亚边界。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, despite your dismal performance on the battlefield, the Austrian 2nd Army spent considerable time pursuing your disorganized forces.  This has bought enough time for our 8th Army to disengage from the Carpathian Mountains.  Joining the rest of the South-Western front, the 8th made a fighting retreat back across Galicia through the still fresh battlefields of the Autumn of 1914.
dst: 中将阁下，尽管您在战场上表现糟糕，奥地利第2集团军却花了不少时间追击您溃散的部队。这为我们的第8集团军从喀尔巴阡山脉脱离接触赢得了足够时间。第8集团军与西南方面军其余部队会合后，边打边撤，横穿加利西亚，穿过1914年秋季那仍然清晰的战场。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, despite your failure at Khamadan, you have performed admirably during the 1915 campaign with the Kavkaz Front.  Strategically, the Russian army has defeated any Turkish attempts at offensive operations.  With the Erzerum Operation planned for the winter of 1916, the Kavkaz Front is poised to remove Turkey's last defensive position in the Kavkaz Mountains.
dst: 中将阁下，尽管您在哈马丹失利，但您在1915年高加索方面军的战役中表现出色。在战略上，俄军已挫败土耳其任何进攻作战的企图。随着埃尔祖鲁姆战役计划于1916年冬实施，高加索方面军已蓄势待发，准备拔除土耳其在高加索山脉的最后一处防御阵地。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, do not allow another Tannenberg to be repeated!
dst: 中将阁下，绝不能让坦能堡的悲剧重演！

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, expending the last possible reserves, you have pushed your men to achieve their objectives in the face of stubborn Austrian resistance - and even offensive action.  The tactical successes of the South-Western Front's Carpathian offensives during the winter and spring of 1915 have not approached the strategic goals set by Stavka.  Plagued by severe ammunition shortage, manpower attrition, and a chronic disarray of the armies' supply structure, the Russian offensive came to a grinding halt.
dst: 中将阁下，您耗尽了最后的预备队，推动部下在奥地利人顽强的抵抗——乃至进攻——面前达成了目标。西南方面军1915年冬春喀尔巴阡攻势的战术胜利，并未接近大本营设定的战略目标。由于严重弹药短缺、兵员损耗和各集团军补给体制的长期混乱，俄军的攻势戛然而止。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, facing entrenchments up to 9 layers deep, Linsingen's German regiments filled the outermost trenches to the brim with their dead, achieving little gain in the face of our murderous artillery.  Hofmann's second echelon -- the 1st Infantry Division (veterans of the Tannenberg campaign) -- were forced to deploy early, denying the Austro-German offensive any promise of a strategic success in this battle.  As the 4th Rifle Brigade fell upon the enemy's ranks, some retribution for our losses in far-away Prussia was exacted.
dst: 中将阁下，面对深达9层的堑壕，林辛根的德国各团用其尸体填满了最外层的堑壕，在我方致命的炮火面前几乎毫无进展。霍夫曼的第二梯队——第1步兵师（坦能堡战役的老兵）——被迫提前投入，使奥德攻势在此役中丧失了取得战略成功的任何可能。当第4步兵旅扑向敌军阵线时，我们在遥远普鲁士的损失终于得到了一些报复。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, fighting along the entire North-Western Front has solidified along deep scars in the ground, called trenches.  Our spring offensive, having been launched following the German failure at Przasnysz, has gained little ground in the area.  Your corps has been called in to capture both German lines of trenches in the vicinity of the town of Jednorozec, just NE of Przasnysz.
dst: 中将阁下，沿整个西北方面军的战斗已固化成地面上深深的壕沟，即所谓堑壕。我们的春季攻势是在德军于普扎斯内什失利之后发起的，但在该地区收效甚微。您的军奉命前来夺取普扎斯内什东北方向耶德诺罗热茨镇附近的两道德军堑壕线。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, following the Augustow offensive, the Germans continue to press our positions along the North-Western Front.  Stavka has begun forming a new 12th Army (Pleve), which will now be employed defensively by the front.  The 1st Army (Litvinov) is in the midst of launching a supporting local offensive to relieve the situation around Warsaw on his left flank.
dst: 中将阁下，继奥古斯图夫攻势之后，德国人继续沿西北方面军全线向我方阵地施压。大本营已开始组建新的第12集团军（普列韦），该集团军现在将由方面军用于防御。第1集团军（利特维诺夫）正在其左翼发起一次支援性的局部攻势，以缓解华沙周围的局势。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, following the redeployment of the IV Kavkaz Corps toward its objective of flanking the Erzerum fortress from the south, the groups under your command (Voropanov and Mudry) must break the Turkish line along the Kop-Dag Ridge.  Two additional groups, Isarlov and Abatsiev, have sent their cavalry detachments along the Eastern Euphrates to capture Sheikh Bridge:  contact with them is expected within days.  General Sharpantier-who is covering your flank along the northern shores of Lake Van-will also be reinforcing your assault with several Cossack sotni within days.
dst: 中将阁下，继第4高加索军重新部署、以从南面包抄埃尔祖鲁姆要塞为目标之后，您指挥的集群（沃罗帕诺夫和穆德雷）必须突破土军沿科普—达格山脊的战线。另外两个集群，伊萨尔洛夫和阿巴齐耶夫，已沿东幼发拉底河派出其骑兵分遣队去夺取谢赫桥：预计数日内与他们取得联系。沙尔庞捷将军——正在凡湖北岸掩护您的侧翼——也将在数日内以若干哥萨克百人队增援您的突击。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, following the unexpected rout of the Turkish 3rd Army at Sarykamysh, the Kavkaz Front command has tasked the IV Kavkaz Corps (Organovsky) with restoring the territorial integrity of the left (southern) flank.  In an effort to maintain control of troops traversing rugged terrain, groups (Otriady) have been formed at roughly brigade level.  You will take command of the Azerbaijansky Otriad (Chernozubov) and retake the city of Tabriz, which was hastily abandoned in December of 1914.
dst: 中将阁下，继土耳其第3集团军在萨雷卡梅什意外溃败之后，高加索方面军指挥部已责成第4高加索军（奥尔加诺夫斯基）恢复左（南）翼的领土完整。为保持对穿越崎岖地形的部队的控制，已组建了大致旅级规模的集群（奥特里亚德）。您将统率阿塞拜疆集群（切尔诺祖博夫），夺回1914年12月仓促放弃的大不里士城。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, having penetrated deep into our territory the enemy can finally be stopped.  After capturing Wilna, the German VI (Brecht) and III (von Frommel) Cavalry Corps launched into the widening gap between the 10th (Radkevich) and 5th (Pleve) Armies.  However, with the length of our front shortening, the 2nd Army (Smirnov) maneuvered behind the 10th to counter the German advance east of Lake Narotch.  In an effort to coordinate the efforts of cavalry from both 5th and 10th Armies, a single cavalry army was formed during the battle under General Kozakov, which included the I and Svodny Cavalry corps, several cavalry divisions, and the elite Guard Cavalry division.
dst: 中将阁下，敌人深入我方领土之后，终于可以被阻止了。占领维尔纳后，德国第6（布雷希特）和第3（冯·弗罗梅尔）骑兵军冲入第10（拉德克维奇）和第5（普列韦）集团军之间不断扩大的缺口。然而，随着我方战线缩短，第2集团军（斯米尔诺夫）机动到第10集团军背后，以反击纳罗奇湖以东的德军推进。为协调第5、第10集团军骑兵的作战，战斗中组建了一支由科扎科夫将军统率的联合骑兵集团军，下辖第1骑兵军和混成骑兵军、若干骑兵师以及精锐的近卫骑兵师。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, having received reinforcements from the West, the German northern group of armies have joined the massive offensive against us.  The German summer offensive in Poland has focused on trapping our forces in the Polish cauldron:  the heaviest blow has fallen on the Przasnysz-Novogeorgievsk front.  You must take control of the situation and delay the German advance so that our supply and communication lines can retreat from Warsaw!
dst: 中将阁下，在得到西线增援后，德国北方集团军群已加入对我们的全面攻势。德军在波兰的夏季攻势旨在将我方部队围困在波兰包围圈中：最沉重的打击落在了普扎斯内什—新格奥尔吉耶夫斯克一线。您必须掌控局势，迟滞德军推进，以便我们的补给和交通线能够撤出华沙！

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, news of an Armenian revolt in the city of Van has reached Front Command.  The Front intends to use the opportunity to exploit this section of the Turkish front with a mobile force, link up with the Armenians at Van, and disrupt the Turkish rear communications.  The two cities of Van and Tabriz will serve as powerful springboards for a potential offensive against the Ottoman Empire's Persian lands.
dst: 中将阁下，凡城发生亚美尼亚人起义的消息已传到方面军指挥部。方面军打算利用这一机会，以一支机动部队利用土军战线的这一地段，在凡城与亚美尼亚人会合，并打乱土耳其的后方交通。凡城和大不里士两城将成为对奥斯曼帝国波斯属地发动潜在攻势的强大跳板。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, overrunning Van Jandarma and 2nd Cavalry Divisions, Sharpantier's cavalry rushed to outflank the enemy.  While Turkish columns of infantry crested the mountain passes to Alashkert, their supply communications were overrun.  The Turkish offensive turned into a cauldron trap for an entire army.  You have successfully stopped the Ottoman offensive and launched a counter-offensive of your own, Gospodin General!
dst: 中将阁下，沙尔庞捷的骑兵击溃了凡城宪兵和第2骑兵师，急行军包抄敌军。正当土耳其步兵纵队翻越山隘向阿拉什凯尔特进发时，其补给交通被切断。土耳其的攻势对整整一个集团军变成了包围圈陷阱。您已成功阻止奥斯曼的攻势，并发动了属于您自己的反攻，中将阁下！

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, please accept the congratulations on your promotion.  Your command has increased to an Army Corps:  you should receive sufficient resources to requisition troops once operations for 1915 commense.
dst: 中将先生，请接受对您晋升的祝贺。您的指挥权已扩至一个军：一旦1915年的行动开始，您应能获得足够的资源征调部队。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, so ends the year of 1915 on our North-Western Front.  The Front has failed to accomplish any strategic offensive plans and has stablized along a line deep within our territory.  The massive Germano-Austrian offensive during the second half of the year has shattered morale but failed to rout us.  Your participation in the action in North Poland during our retreat has played a major role in delaying the German advance:  from Novogeorgievsk to Narotch you stood between German staff expectations and reality.  The massive cavalry engagement at Narotch may well be the last we have seen in this war.  The elan of our Guard Cavalry Division will resonate through German divisional histories, but at a heavy price..
dst: 中将先生，1915年就这样在我西北战线结束了。这条战线未能完成任何战略进攻计划，只能在我方领土纵深一线稳定下来。下半年德奥联军的大规模攻势虽已击垮士气，却未能将我们击溃。您在我军撤退期间参与北波兰战斗，对迟滞德军推进发挥了重要作用：从新格奥尔吉耶夫斯克到纳罗奇湖，您始终横亘在德军参谋部的期望与现实之间。纳罗奇湖的大规模骑兵交战或许是我们在这场战争中见到的最后一场骑兵大战。我军近卫骑兵师的锐气将永远回响在德国各师的战史之中，但代价十分沉重……

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, the 9th Army (Lechitsky) has prepared the XXX Corps (Zaikonchovsky) to strike at the Austrian flank on the Prut' River near the town of Nadvodnaya.  Units of the Austrian 2nd Army (Pflanzer-Baltin) - XI (von Korda) and XIII (von Rhemen) Corps - must be eliminated on the southern bank of the river.  Having had sufficient time for preparations, Zaikonchovsky has deployed his forces in full.  You will lead the corps in this counterattack.
dst: 中将阁下，第9集团军（莱奇茨基）已令第30军（扎伊翁奇科夫斯基）准备在纳德沃德纳亚镇附近的普鲁特河上打击奥军侧翼。必须歼灭河南岸的奥地利第2集团军（普弗兰策—巴尔廷）第11军（冯·科尔达）和第13军（冯·雷门）。由于有充足时间准备，扎伊翁奇科夫斯基已将其部队全部展开。您将在这次反击中统率该军。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, the German 11th (Mackensen), Austrian 2nd (Bohm-Ermolli), and Austrian 4th (Linsingen) Armies - have shattered our front in the viscinity of the towns of Gorlice and Tarnow.  Radko-Dmitriev's 3rd Army is not capable of withstanding the numerical superiority of the attacking force, having depleted his divisions in the winter Carpathian campaign.  The X (Protopopov), III Kavkazky (Irmanov), and XXIV (Trurikov) Corps lie in the immediate path of the advancing enemy.  You must delay the Germano-Austrian advance by recapturing key defensive positions.
dst: 中将阁下，德国第11集团军（马肯森）、奥地利第2集团军（伯姆—埃尔莫利）和奥地利第4集团军（林辛根）——已在戈尔利采和塔尔努夫两镇附近击溃我方战线。拉德科—德米特里耶夫的第3集团军已在冬季喀尔巴阡战役中耗尽了各师的兵力，无力抵挡进攻部队的数量优势。第10军（普罗托波波夫）、第3高加索军（伊尔马诺夫）和第24军（特鲁里科夫）正处在敌军推进的正前方。您必须通过夺回关键防御阵地来迟滞德奥联军的推进。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, the German Niemen Offensive against the northern wing of NW Front (5th and 10th Armies) has attained rapid success, and our positions at Kovno are threatened from the flanks.  Front command has chosen to abandon the city and to retreat to Wilna, where the Germans must be stopped.
dst: 中将阁下，德军对西北方面军北翼（第5和第10集团军）发动的涅曼攻势进展神速，我们在科夫诺的阵地受到两翼的威胁。方面军指挥部已决定放弃该城，向维尔纳撤退，必须在维尔纳阻止德军。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, the German VI Cavalry and XXI Army Corps have poured into a breach between our 10th and 5th Armies to the north of Wilna and are threatening to envelop the bulk of the 10th Army!  You must stop this maneuver and hold Wilna.  The forces under your command include the elite Guard Corps and the I Cavalry Corps.  General Smirnov (2nd Army) has sent the XXXVI Corps to your aid as well.
dst: 中将阁下，德国第6骑兵军和第21军已涌入维尔纳以北我第10和第5集团军之间的缺口，并威胁要合围第10集团军主力！您必须阻止这一机动并守住维尔纳。您指挥的部队包括精锐的近卫军和第1骑兵军。斯米尔诺夫将军（第2集团军）也已派第36军前来增援。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, the Tukish 3rd Army (XI, Hamdi, IX, and Halil Corps) has escalated its offensive against our I and IV Kavkaz Corps.  With the IV Kavkaz Corps stretched from Alashkert to Tabriz, only the 2nd Kavkaz Cavalry (Abatsiev) and 66th divisions stand in the way of the Turkish onslaught toward Sarykamysh.  Sharpantier's cavalry group, having endured the forced march from Lake Urmia, has concentrated north of Lake Van.  Use the group's mobility to outflank the Turkish assault group.  You will also receive parts of Sharpantier's infantry arriving from the city of Van in barge transports a few days into the operation.
dst: 中将阁下，土耳其第3集团军（第11、哈姆迪、第9和哈利勒军）已加大对我国第1和第4高加索军的攻势。由于第4高加索军从阿拉什凯尔特一直拉伸到大不里士，只有第2高加索骑兵师（阿巴齐耶夫）和第66师挡在土军向萨雷卡梅什猛攻的路上。沙尔庞捷的骑兵集群在经受从乌尔米耶湖出发的强行军之后，已集结于凡湖北面。利用该集群的机动性包抄土耳其突击集群。您还将在战役开始几天后收到沙尔庞捷的部分步兵，他们从凡城乘驳船运输抵达。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, the Turkish 3rd Army dispatched over 110,000 men against our garrison of 65,000.  The initial advance of the enemy caused widespread panic in the rear of the Kavkaz Army, prompting the front command to evacuate the regions of Alashkert and Tabriz along the southern border (our left flank).
dst: 中将阁下，土耳其第3集团军派出超过11万人进攻我方6.5万守军。敌军最初的推进在高加索集团军后方引起大范围恐慌，促使方面军指挥部撤离南部边境（我左翼）的阿拉什凯尔特和大不里士地区。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, the Turkish positions - up to 5 layers deep around the town of Kop - have been breached by your brave troops!  In the face of devastating counter-attacks you have held the captured ground.  Unfortunately, the Ottomans have carefully prepared a counter-offensive of their own.  Our entire Meliazgert Operation has stalled:  your troops have been ordered to pull back toward the city of Alashkert.  Scouts report the Turks have fielded several fresh corps to break through at Alashkert.  Their objective remains Sarykamysh.
dst: 中将阁下，土军阵地——在科普镇周围深达5层——已被您英勇的部队突破！在毁灭性的反击面前，您守住了夺占的阵地。不幸的是，奥斯曼人已精心准备了自己的反攻。我们整个梅利亚兹盖尔特战役已经停滞：您的部队奉命向阿拉什凯尔特城后撤。侦察兵报告，土耳其人已投入若干新锐军试图在阿拉什凯尔特突破。他们的目标仍是萨雷卡梅什。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, the fighting in the Carpathian mountains has reached its crescendo of violence.  The Austrian 3rd (von Bojna) and German Sudost (von Linsingen) Armies have launched a desperate push to reach the besieged Przemysl.  Mobilizing their last reserves, the Austrians are forming ad-hoc divisions and brigades out of reserve MarchBatalionen, pouring inexperienced troops to fill the depleted ranks of standing divisions.  At Uszok Pass, the left wing of Linsingen's army -- Hofmann Corps -- are assaulting the heavily fortified positions of the 34th division in Kaledin's Svodny Corps (part of Brusilov's 8th Army).
dst: 中将阁下，喀尔巴阡山脉的战斗已到达暴力顶点。奥地利第3集团军（冯·博伊纳）和德国南东集团军（冯·林辛根）发动了拼死推进，以解被围的普热梅希尔之围。奥地利人动员了最后的预备队，用预备补充营组建临时师和临时旅，把缺乏经验的部队塞入正规师已空虚的序列。在乌索克山口，林辛根集团军左翼——霍夫曼军——正在猛攻卡列金混成军（属布鲁西洛夫第8集团军）中第34师重兵设防的阵地。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, the focus of this war has shifted to the Eastern Front.  On May 1st, Germano-Austrian forces have broken through at Gorlice and Tarnow, dismantling our line of denfese within days and breaching the front.  The South-Western Front is desperately trying to stop the offensive by vicious counter-attacks against the Central Powers' spearhead.
dst: 中将阁下，这场战争的重心已转向东线。5月1日，德奥联军在戈尔利采和塔尔努夫突破，数日内便摧毁了我方防线并撕开了正面。西南方面军正以对同盟国突击矛头的猛烈反击，拼命试图阻止这次攻势。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, the situation on the North-Western Front is becoming critical!  It appears that Stavka's offensive plans may be abandoned:  following the defeat of our 2nd Army at Tannenberg, the German 8th and the newly formed 10th Armies have begun the campaign to recapture lost territory in Prussia and Masuria.
dst: 中将阁下，西北方面军的局势正变得危急！看来大本营的进攻计划可能被放弃：继我们的第2集团军在坦能堡被击败之后，德国第8集团军和新组建的第10集团军已展开战役，旨在夺回普鲁士和马祖里失地。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, the war has once again returned to Przemysl.  After the Austrian garrison within the fortress capitulated in March of 1915, we have had barely two months to re-fortify the positions.  The breakthrough at Gorlice-Tarnow has forced the 3rd Army - while taking massive casualties - to retreat behind the San River.  The depleted III Kavkazky, XXIV, and XXI corps (numbering on average 1000 men per division) must fight this rear-guard action after 10 days of continuous fighting and German artillery bombardment.
dst: 中将阁下，战争再次回到普热梅希尔。1915年3月要塞内的奥地利守军投降后，我们只有不到两个月的时间重新巩固阵地。戈尔利采—塔尔努夫的突破迫使第3集团军在付出惨重伤亡的同时撤到桑河之后。元气大伤的第3高加索军、第24军和第21军（平均每师约1000人）必须在连续十天战斗和德军炮火轰击之后执行这次后卫作战。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, trench warfare is a new way of waging war, and you have shown your skills in this.  New weapons and tactics are necessary to break through the enemy's front lines, and retaining the units' cohesion following the breakthrough is necessary to withstand the inevitable counter-attacks.
dst: 中将阁下，堑壕战是一种新的作战方式，而您在其中已经展现了您的本领。突破敌军前线需要新式武器和新战术，而在突破之后保持部队的凝聚力，则是抵御不可避免的反击所必需的。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, trench warfare is a new way of waging war, and you have yet much to learn of these methods.  New weapons and tactics are necessary to break through the enemy's front lines, and retaining the units' cohesion following the breakthrough is necessary to withstand the inevitable counter-attacks.
dst: 中将阁下，堑壕战是一种新的作战方式，这些战法您还有许多要学。突破敌军前线需要新式武器和新战术，而在突破之后保持部队的凝聚力，则是抵御不可避免的反击所必需的。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, welcome to the Kavkaz.  Diplomatic talks with the Ottoman Empire have broken down.  The Germano-Turkish fleet, headed by the cruisers Goeben and Breslau (renamed Sultan Selim and Midillu, flying the Turkish flag), bombarded our Black Sea ports of Odessa, Sevastopol, Novorossisk, and Feodosia on 29th October.  On 1st November Russia declared war on Turkey.
dst: 中将阁下，欢迎来到高加索。与奥斯曼帝国的外交谈判已经破裂。以格本号和布雷斯劳号巡洋舰（改名苏丹塞利姆号和米迪利号，悬挂土耳其旗）为首的德土舰队，于10月29日炮击了我们的黑海港口敖德萨、塞瓦斯托波尔、新罗西斯克和费奥多西亚。11月1日，俄国对土耳其宣战。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, with all hopes of retaining Poland disappearing, the North-Western Front is fighting rear-guard action as the armies retreat eastward.  Here at Panevezys we must delay the German attack while our forces take positions in the Kowno and Wilna fortresses.
dst: 中将阁下，随着守住波兰的一切希望化为泡影，西北方面军正边打边撤，各集团军向东退却。在帕涅韦日斯这里，我们必须迟滞德军的进攻，同时让我们的部队在科夫诺和维尔纳要塞就位。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, with our offensives against German forces in Northern Poland failing, Stavka has ordered the South-Western Front to achieve strategic gains with its Carpathian offensive.  Forming the Dniester Group on the basis of Gen. Lechitsky's 9th Army (XI, XVII, XXX, and XXXIII) and reinforcing it with two additional cavalry corps (II and III), the Front was tasked with crossing the Dniester River and breaking through over the eastern slopes of the Carpathian Mountains.  The Dneister offensive would be followed by the advance of our troops over the Dukla and Uszok Passes.
dst: 中将阁下，随着我们对波兰北部德军的攻势失利，大本营已命令西南方面军以其喀尔巴阡攻势取得战略成果。方面军以莱奇茨基将军的第9集团军（第11、第17、第30、第33军）为基础组建德涅斯特集群，并增配两个骑兵军（第2和第3军），任务为强渡德涅斯特河并越过喀尔巴阡山脉东坡突破。德涅斯特攻势之后，我方部队将越过杜克拉山口和乌索克山口推进。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, you have broken the Austrian offensive through Dukla Pass and solidified our hold on this valuable strategic position.  The overall situation for our entire front in January, however, began assuming an aspect of precariousness.  The SW Front command (Ivanov) continued to build up reserves at the expense of the NW Front -- which was selected by Stavka as the instrument for the major 1915 offensive effort against German forces in North Poland.  The fact that our losses -- and, particularly, the ammunition problem -- could hardly support one offensive did not discourage Ivanov from pushing for a parallel offensive effort.
dst: 中将阁下，您打破了奥地利经杜克拉山口的攻势，巩固了我们对该战略要地的控制。然而，我整个方面军一月的总体局势开始趋于不稳。西南方面军指挥部（伊万诺夫）继续以牺牲西北方面军为代价集结预备队——大本营已选定西北方面军作为1915年对波兰北部德军实施大规模攻势的主力。事实上，我们的损失——尤其是弹药问题——几乎无力支撑一场攻势，但伊万诺夫并未因此放弃推动一场平行攻势的努力。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, you have chosen to participate in the 1915 Galician campaign.  Stavka plans a winter Carpathian offensive here, followed by operations within Hungary proper.  God willing, we shall defeat the Habsburgs in this new year!
dst: 中将阁下，您已选择参加1915年加利西亚战役。大本营计划先在这里发起冬季喀尔巴阡攻势，随后深入匈牙利本土作战。若上帝眷顾，我们将在新的一年里击败哈布斯堡王朝！

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, you have failed in your mission and must now retreat with the 5th Army to our new positions along the Neman (Niemen) River.
dst: 中将阁下，您的任务失败了，现在必须随第5集团军撤往我们在涅曼河沿线的新阵地。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, you have failed to hold the German advance effectively at Novogeorgievsk.  As you abandoned the fortress in haste - and without regard to your comrades still in the trenches - your retreat resembled the fate of the Austrian armies in the fall of 1914 at Przemysl.  With the situation reaching critical levels, your unsatisfactory command must be retained in the service of the Tsar.  Do not fail Russia again!
dst: 中将阁下，您未能在新格奥尔吉耶夫斯克有效地阻滞德军的推进。当您仓促放弃要塞——全然不顾仍在堑壕中的战友——您的撤退堪比1914年秋普热梅希尔奥地利军队的命运。随着局势趋于危急，您令人不满的指挥仍须为沙皇陛下效力。不要再让俄国失望了！

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, you have held the Gnila Lipa line long enough to allow the 8th Army to disengage from the Carpathian Mountains.  Joining the rest of the South-Western front, the 8th made a fighting retreat back across Galicia through the still fresh battlefields of the Autumn of 1914.
dst: 中将阁下，您守住了格尼拉利帕一线足够长的时间，使第8集团军得以从喀尔巴阡山脉脱离接触。第8集团军与西南方面军其余部队会合后，边打边撤，横穿加利西亚，穿过1914年秋季那仍然清晰的战场。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, you have once again displayed inspirational skill on the battlefield.  Holding the enemy at the San, you have provided cover for the entire South-Western Front to realign its supply structure and to redeploy the northern wing behind the San River line.  This time has also been valuable in the preparation of counter-offensive actions on the tactical level to delay the enemy advance further:  at the Prut' River the XXX Corps has been making preparations for such action.
dst: 中将阁下，您再次在战场上展现了鼓舞人心的本领。您在桑河阻住敌人，为整个西南方面军重新调整补给体系、并把北翼重新部署到桑河一线提供了掩护。这段时间对于在战术层面准备反攻行动以进一步迟滞敌军也极为宝贵：在普鲁特河，第30军一直在为此类行动做准备。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, you have succeeded in slipping into Libau right under the Germans' noses!  After successfully destroying the supplies, you have denied the Germans valuable ammunition stocks.  You must now retreat with the 5th Army to our new positions along the Neman (Niemen) River.
dst: 中将阁下，您成功地在德国人眼皮底下潜入利包！在成功摧毁补给物资后，您使德国人失去了宝贵的弹药储备。您现在必须随第5集团军撤往我们在涅曼河沿线的新阵地。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, you have successfully completed the 1915 campaign with the Kavkaz Front.  Strategically, the Russian army has defeated any Turkish attempts at offensive operations.  With the Erzerum Operation planned for the winter of 1916, the Kavkaz Front is poised to remove Turkey's last defensive position in the Kavkaz Mountains.
dst: 中将阁下，您已圆满完成1915年高加索方面军的战役。在战略上，俄军已挫败土耳其任何进攻作战的企图。随着埃尔祖鲁姆战役计划于1916年冬实施，高加索方面军已蓄势待发，准备拔除土耳其在高加索山脉的最后一处防御阵地。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, you have successfully retaken Tabriz.  Your action has prepared the entire Front for offensive operations planned for spring.  Recruitement of the local Armenian population has begun, and their Druzhiny become integrated into the Russian Army.  However, rumors of Turkish retribution against civilians abound...
dst: 中将阁下，您已成功夺回大不里士。您的行动已为整个方面军筹划中的春季攻势作战做好了准备。当地亚美尼亚人的招募已经开始，他们的义勇队被编入俄军。然而，土耳其人对平民实施报复的传言四起……

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, you must push forward with your cavalry to capture the western bank of Lake Urmia.  You command Sharpandier's cavalry and the Azerbaijansky Otriad (Chernozubov).  The Ottoman Halil-Bei Corps by now has suffered the retreat from the Meliazgert-Tabriz line, followed by its rout at Van.
dst: 中将阁下，您必须率骑兵向前推进，夺取乌尔米耶湖西岸。您统率沙尔庞捷的骑兵和阿塞拜疆集群（切尔诺祖博夫）。奥斯曼哈利勒贝军此时已经历从梅利亚兹盖尔特—大不里士一线的撤退，随后在凡城溃败。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, your daring raid across the Niemen River has been a stunning success!  Throwing the German Landwehr units back into the waters, you have forced the enemy to commit his reserves to push toward Wilna.  Your action has bought valuable time for our defenders, as they prepare for the German assault.
dst: 中将阁下，您横渡涅曼河的大胆突击取得了惊人成功！您把德国后备军部队赶回河中，迫使敌军投入预备队向维尔纳推进。您的行动为我方守军赢得了宝贵时间，使他们得以准备抗击德军的进攻。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, your feeble resistance against the Austrian offensive failed miserably, allowing the enemy to capture this key strategic position.  With the overall situation for our entire front in January assuming an aspect of precariousness, your failure may have devastating consequences for our entire Carpathian position.  General Brusilov has relieved you of your command and has ordered your replacement to recapture the lost positions immediately.
dst: 中将阁下，您对奥地利攻势的软弱抵抗惨遭失败，让敌人夺取了这一关键战略要地。由于我整个方面军一月的总体局势趋于不稳，您的失败可能对我方整个喀尔巴阡阵地造成灾难性后果。布鲁西洛夫将军已解除您的指挥权，并命令您的继任者立即夺回失地。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, your feeble resistance against the enemy's offensive failed miserably, allowing the capture of this key strategic position.  Only the shortage of officers with experience will allow you to retain your command.
dst: 中将阁下，您对敌军攻势的软弱抵抗惨遭失败，让敌人夺取了这一关键战略要地。只是由于有经验的军官短缺，您才得以保留指挥权。

src: Gospodin General-Leitenant, your skillful execution of the defense of Panevezys has earned your much respect among your troops.  Stavka relies on you to continue to provide rearguard security, as the North-Western Front retreats to the Niemen River.
dst: 中将阁下，您对帕涅韦日斯防御的娴熟指挥，为您赢得了部队的极大尊敬。随着西北方面军向涅曼河撤退，大本营依靠您继续提供后卫掩护。

src: Gospodin General-Major, August of 1914 brings the nations of Europe into a great conflict.  You must choose which campaign you would like to take part in for the duration of 1914.
dst: 少将先生，1914年8月把欧洲各国卷入一场大战。您必须选择在1914年余下时间里参加哪场战役。

src: Gospodin General-Major, after a period of rest, your troops are once again ready to fight on the Austro-Hungarian front.  Following the unsuccessful October-November offensives by the Germans (Lodz) and the Austrians (to relieve Przemysl), our South-Western Front resumed its offensive with the goal of capturing Krakau and launching an offensive into Silesia.
dst: 少将先生，经过一段休整，您的部队再次准备好在奥匈战线上作战。继10月至11月德军（罗兹）和奥军（解围普热梅希尔）的攻势相继失利后，我西南战线恢复了攻势，目标是攻占克拉科夫并向西里西亚发起进攻。

src: Gospodin General-Major, as the Galician battle of maneuver unfolded, the Austrian 4th Army found itself in a corner.  With our 5th Army (V,XVII, and XII Corps) marching through Tomashov, the threat concentrated to the north.  Our 3rd Army (XI, IX, and X) began preparations for an attack from the east against the town of Rava Russka.
dst: 少将先生，随着加利西亚运动战展开，奥军第4集团军发现自己陷入绝境。我第5集团军（第5、第17和第12军）正穿过托马绍夫挺进，威胁集中在北面。我第3集团军（第11、第9和第10军）则开始准备从东面向拉瓦鲁斯卡镇发起进攻。

src: Gospodin General-Major, following our swift action at Rava Russka, the Austro-Hungarian armies in Galicia face utter collapse.  Pursued by our cavalry, Austrian forces abandoned one of their key fortifications at Lemberg.  The retreat has turned into a rout.  Now the Austrians hope to hold their right wing at the great fortress of Przemysl.  With its ring of modernized fortifications and fielding the mighty 305mm Skoda howitzers, the fortress presents a formidable defensive position.
dst: 少将先生，继我们在拉瓦鲁斯卡的迅速行动之后，加利西亚的奥匈军队面临全面崩溃。在我军骑兵的追击下，奥军放弃了他们在伦贝格的一处关键要塞。撤退已演变成溃逃。如今奥军指望在这座普热梅希尔大要塞守住其右翼。这座要塞拥有现代化的防御圈，并配备强大的305毫米斯柯达榴弹炮，构成了令人望而生畏的防御阵地。

src: Gospodin General-Major, following the defeat of the 2nd Army in Eastern Prussia, Stavka has reorganized our forces on the North-Western front.  A new 2nd Army has been formed from Siberian rifle divisions with the aim of invading German Silesia, using the giant Polish Salient as the springboard for the offensive.  However, the Germans have transferred divisions from the Western Front and have formed a new 9th Army, which in concert with the 8th, is attempting to outflank our 2nd Army through Northern Poland.
dst: 少将先生，第2集团军在东普鲁士战败后，大本营重整了西北战线的部队。一支由西伯利亚步枪师组成的新第2集团军已经组建，目的是入侵德属西里西亚，以巨大的波兰突出部作为进攻跳板。然而，德军已从西线调来几个师，组建了新的第9集团军，正与第8集团军协同，企图经波兰北部包抄我第2集团军。

src: Gospodin General-Major, following the unsuccessful attempt to encircle our 2nd Army at Lodz, the line stabilized to the north of the city.  The Germans are now attempting to reduce the salient to the west and south-west of Lodz.  Receiving Austrian Carpathian forces (from the 2nd Austrian Army), the German 9th Army redeployed to take the city directly from the west.
