dst: 少将先生，在罗兹合围我第2集团军的企图失败后，战线在该城以北稳定下来。德军如今正试图压缩罗兹以西和西南的突出部。德军第9集团军在得到奥地利喀尔巴阡部队（来自奥地利第2集团军）的增援后，重新部署，从正西方向直接攻城。

src: Gospodin General-Major, having made contact with Japanese forces, the bulk of our army continues south toward the town of Lyaoyan.
dst: 少将先生，在与日军接触后，我军主力继续向南朝辽阳进发。

src: Gospodin General-Major, our reconnaisance battalion has come across wayward troops from XV and XIII Corps of the 2nd Army: both of these corps have been erased from existence.
dst: 少将先生，我们的侦察营遇到了第2集团军第15军和第13军流散的部队：这两个军都已被消灭殆尽。

src: Gospodin General-Major, the Austrian 4th Army - in the center of the enemy's advance into Galicia - has captured the town of Komarov and is threatening to break through toward Kowel, a vital railroad junction.  Having eliminated the Austrian threat on our southern flank, Brusilov (8th Army) is pushing toward the Carpathian mountains.  This development places the Austrians here at Komarov in a vulnerable position:  their flanks are nearly exposed.
dst: 少将先生，奥军第4集团军——位于敌人进军加利西亚的中路——已攻占科马罗夫镇，正威胁着要突破至重要铁路枢纽科韦利。布鲁西洛夫（第8集团军）已消除我军南翼的奥军威胁，正朝喀尔巴阡山推进。这一态势使科马罗夫这里的奥军处于易受攻击的位置：其两翼几乎暴露。

src: Gospodin General-Major, the German right wing (III Cavalry and Posen Corps) were pushed back by our Galician veterans, the XIX Corps.  The XXV Reserve Corps was stopped with heavy losses by our V and sundry forces from the Lodz garrison (the baker company of the 3rd Leib-Guard Division participated in the counter-attack).
dst: 少将先生，德军的右翼（第3骑兵军和波森军）被我们的加利西亚老兵——第19军击退。第25预备军被我们的第5军和罗兹守备部队的各路兵力以沉重损失阻止（近卫第3师的面包连参加了反攻）。

src: Gospodin General-Major, the Japanese 3rd Army has begun its siege of Port Arthur.  The first assault, launched between 6 (19) - 11 (24) of August 1904 cost the Japanese attackers 16,700 men: a quadrouple of our losses.  A second assault is imminent, and our swift advance through Korea is necessary to lift the siege.  You have opened the campaign to relieve Port Arthur poorly with your indecision in the field of battle.  You must gain the initiative!
dst: 少将先生，日本第3军已开始围困旅顺口。第一次进攻于1904年8月6日（19日）至11日（24日）之间发起，令日军付出16700人的代价：是我方损失的四倍。第二次进攻迫在眉睫，我们必须迅速穿越朝鲜以解除围困。您在战场上的犹豫不决，使这场解围旅顺口的战役开局不利。您必须夺取主动权！

src: Gospodin General-Major, the Japanese 3rd Army has begun its siege of Port Arthur.  The first assault, launched between 6 (19) - 11 (24) of August 1904 cost the Japanese attackers 16,700 men: a quadrouple of our losses.  A second assault is imminent, and our swift advance through Korea is necessary to lift the siege.  You have opened the campaign to relieve Port Arthur successfully with your action on the Shakhe River:  you must maintain the initiative!
dst: 少将先生，日本第3军已开始围困旅顺口。第一次进攻于1904年8月6日（19日）至11日（24日）之间发起，令日军付出16700人的代价：是我方损失的四倍。第二次进攻迫在眉睫，我们必须迅速穿越朝鲜以解除围困。您在沙河上的行动使这场解围旅顺口的战役开局顺利：您必须保持主动权！

src: Gospodin General-Major, the dramatic clash of our armies with those of Austria-Hungary has begun in Galicia.  Unprecendented numbers of troops have engaged in maneuver never before attempted in war.
dst: 少将先生，我军与奥匈军队在加利西亚的戏剧性碰撞已经开始。空前数量的部队投入了战争史上从未尝试过的机动作战。

src: Gospodin General-Major, the objective of the 1st Army - III (Epanchin), XX (Smirnov), and IV (Aliev) Corps - is to besiege the Prussian city of Koenigsberg.  In front of us, the Germans have fortified at Gumbinnen and hope to hold our advance there.  Meanwhile, the 2nd Army (Samsonov) is advancing northward out of Russian Poland, and an envelopment of the entire German force with both our armies is now a possibility.
dst: 少将先生，第1集团军——第3（叶潘钦）、第20（斯米尔诺夫）和第4（阿利耶夫）军——的目标是围攻普鲁士城市柯尼斯堡。在我们面前，德军已在贡比嫩设防，企图阻止我们前进。与此同时，第2集团军（萨姆索诺夫）正从俄国波兰向北推进，用我们两个集团军合围整个德军已有可能。

src: Gospodin General-Major, we have received an urgent message from Samsonov:  both of his flanks have collapsed; the enemy is on the verge of breaking through and surrounding his center corps (the XIII, XV, and XXIII).
dst: 少将先生，我们收到萨姆索诺夫的紧急消息：他的两翼均已崩溃；敌人即将突破并包围他的中央各军（第13、第15和第23军）。

src: Gospodin General-Major, with the battle intencifying in the center and our attempt to outflank the Japanese with Samsonov's and Rennekampf's cavalry stopped by the Japanese 2nd Cavalry brigade (Kanin), the initiative has firmly passed into enemy hands.
dst: 少将先生，随着中路战斗加剧，我军以萨姆索诺夫和伦嫩坎普夫的骑兵包抄日军的企图，被日本第2骑兵旅（卡宁）所阻，主动权已牢牢落入敌手。

src: Gospodin General-Major, you have achieved an unprecedented victory in this war!  The most powerful fortresses of Lemberg and Przemysl - Austria's pride of fortress engineering - have ceased to protect her borders within two months of commencement of hostilities.  After a prolonged siege that lasted until May 1915 over 150,000 Austrian defenders of the fortress surrendered.  Your action in the siege itself has warranted your troops rest, and you will be redeployed to the front for the Campaign of 1915.
dst: 少将先生，您在这场战争中取得了前所未有的胜利！伦贝格和普热梅希尔这两座最强大的要塞——奥地利要塞工程的骄傲——在开战仅两个月内就已无法再守护其边境。经过持续到1915年5月的长期围困，超过15万名奥军要塞守军投降。您在围城战中的表现为您的部队赢得了休整，您将被重新部署到前线，参加1915年战役。

src: Gospodin General-Major, you have achieved an unprecedented victory in this war!  The most powerful fortresses of Lemberg and Przemysl - Austria's pride of fortress engineering - have ceased to protect her borders within two months of commencement of hostilities.  The garrison of Przemysl - over 150,000 men - has been securely trapped within a siege ring of your making.  Austria-Hungary's last line of defense - the natural barrier of the Carpathian Mountains stands in the way of the empire's conquest by your forces!
dst: 少将先生，您在这场战争中取得了前所未有的胜利！伦贝格和普热梅希尔这两座最强大的要塞——奥地利要塞工程的骄傲——在开战仅两个月内就已无法再守护其边境。普热梅希尔的守军——超过15万人——已被牢牢困在您构筑的包围圈内。奥匈帝国的最后一道防线——喀尔巴阡山脉这道天然屏障——正横亘在您征服该帝国的道路上！

src: Gospodin General-Major, you have chosen to participate in the East Prussia 1914 campaign of WWI.  Your command is transferred to the North-Western Front, consisting of 1st (Rennekampf) and 2rd (Samsonov) first-line Armies.  Second-line and Siberian units will begin mobilization with declaration of war.  You will face the German Empire as your enemy.
dst: 少将先生，您已选择参加一战1914年东普鲁士战役。您的指挥权将转至西北战线，该战线由第1（伦嫩坎普夫）和第2（萨姆索诺夫）两个一线集团军组成。二线部队和西伯利亚部队将在宣战后开始动员。您的敌人将是德意志帝国。

src: Gospodin General-Major, you have chosen to participate in the Galicia 1914 campaign of WWI.  Your command is transferred to the South-Western Front, consisting of 5th (Pleve), 3rd (Ruzsky), and 8th (Brusilov) first-line Armies.  Second-line and Siberian units will begin mobilization with declaration of war.  You will face the Austro-Hungarian Empire as your enemy.
dst: 少将先生，您已选择参加一战1914年加利西亚战役。您的指挥权将转至西南战线，该战线由第5（普列韦）、第3（鲁兹斯基）和第8（布鲁西洛夫）三个一线集团军组成。二线部队和西伯利亚部队将在宣战后开始动员。您的敌人将是奥匈帝国。

src: Gospodin General-Major, you have failed as a divisional commander in this critical battle!  With the danger of envelopment for our front-line armies looming, you will be relieved of command by someone with more vigor.
dst: 少将先生，在这关键一战中，您作为师长是失败的！随着我一线集团军面临被合围的危险，您将被一位更有干劲的人解除指挥权。

src: Gospodin General-Major, you have forced the Austrian 3rd Army (Brudermann) to go into full retreat, exposing the fortress of Lemberg before us.  Strategically, this creates a critical opportunity for a counter-stroke.  The Austrian 4th Army (von Auffenberg) has pushed into Galicia and lost contact with the 3rd on its right.
dst: 少将先生，您已迫使奥军第3集团军（布鲁德曼）全面撤退，把伦贝格要塞暴露在我们面前。从战略上讲，这创造了一个反击的关键机会。奥军第4集团军（冯·奥芬贝格）已深入加利西亚，与其右翼的第3集团军失去联系。

src: Gospodin General-Major, you will take part in General Kuropatkin's attempt to break the siege of Port Arthur.  Fresh troops are arriving by rail through Siberia.
dst: 少将先生，您将参加库罗帕特金将军解除旅顺口之围的行动。新锐部队正经西伯利亚铁路源源而来。

src: Gospodin General-Major, your actions on the Shakhe River have cut down the Japanese attempt to regain the initiative.  Overrunning the Japanese 2nd Cavalry Brigade, Rennekampf's and Samsonov's cossacks engulfed the enemy positions from behind and decimated all plans of a Japanese advance any further.
dst: 少将先生，您在沙河上的行动粉碎了日军重夺主动权的企图。伦嫩坎普夫和萨姆索诺夫的哥萨克部队冲垮了日本第2骑兵旅，从背后吞没了敌军阵地，彻底粉碎了日军继续推进的一切图谋。

src: Gospodin General-Major, your division has captured the objective.  We now push to Gumbinen, expanding the conquest of Prussia in this war.
dst: 少将先生，您的师已夺取目标。我们现在向贡比嫩推进，扩大这场战争中对普鲁士的占领。

src: Gospodin General-Major, your division is now part of General Epanchin's III Corps, of the 1st Army (Rennenkampf).  With great speed, we have mobilized and concentrated our front-line divisions for an attack against Germany - surpassing the enemy's estimate by 4 weeks.  The opening engagement of the war is at Stalluponen, a town just inside German Eastern Prussia.
dst: 少将先生，您的师如今隶属于第1集团军（伦嫩坎普夫）叶潘钦将军的第3军。我们以极快的速度动员并集中了前线各师，向德国发起进攻——比敌人的估计早了4周。这场战争的首场交火发生在斯托卢波嫩，一个位于德国东普鲁士境内的小镇。

src: Gospodin General-Major, your division is now part of the VIII Corps, 8th Army (Brusilov).  The opening engagement of the war with Austria-Hungary had occured at the Zlota Lipa river, where the Austrian 3rd Army (Brudermann) has been repulsed.  The Austrian armies have launched an offensive along the entire frontier, and their center 4th Army has gained some ground.  Generals Ruzsky (3rd) and Brusilov (8th) hope to collapse the Austrian right flank and threaten their center.
dst: 少将先生，您的师如今隶属于第8集团军（布鲁西洛夫）的第8军。与奥匈帝国的首场交火发生在兹沃塔利帕河，奥军第3集团军（布鲁德曼）在那里被击退。奥军沿整条边境发动了攻势，其中路的第4集团军取得了一些进展。鲁兹斯基（第3）和布鲁西洛夫（第8）两位将军希望击垮奥军右翼，威胁其中路。

src: Gospodin General-Major, your division performed admirably, and you have captured your objective in a timely manner.  We now push to Gumbinen, expanding the conquest of Prussia in this war.
dst: 少将先生，您的师表现出色，已及时夺取目标。我们现在向贡比嫩推进，扩大这场战争中对普鲁士的占领。

src: Gospodin General-Major, your performance at Gumbinnen has amounted to inexcuseable failure.  You have been relieved of command.
dst: 少将先生，您在贡比嫩的表现堪称不可原谅的失败。您已被解除指挥权。

src: Gospodin General-Major, your performance at Gumbinnen has not been a stunning success, but the Germans have been defeated decisively nonetheless.
dst: 少将先生，您在贡比嫩的表现算不上辉煌胜利，但德军终究被决定性地击败了。

src: Gospodin General-Major, your valiant defense of Lodz has allowed our 2nd and 5th armies to retreat toward Warsaw, maintaining the integritiy of their supply lines intact.  Thus ends the 1914 campaign for the North-Western Front:  having failed to achieve the strategic objectives of the Wistula River and Koenigsberg, the Front line has been drawn across Prussian lands southwest to the Polish salient and then along the Carpathian Mountains, deep into Austro-Hungarian territory.
dst: 少将先生，您对罗兹的英勇防御，使我第2、第5集团军得以向华沙撤退，补给线保持完好。1914年西北战线的战役就此结束：由于未能实现维斯瓦河和柯尼斯堡的战略目标，战线横贯普鲁士土地，向西南延伸至波兰突出部，再沿喀尔巴阡山脉深入奥匈帝国领土。

src: Gospodin General-Major, your victory at Gumbinnen has been a stunning success!  The German I Corps has paid dearly for their daring initiative:  meeting our troops head-on, thousands of Germans have died as our field artillery fired in close support.
dst: 少将先生，您在贡比嫩的胜利堪称辉煌！德军第1军为他们的冒进付出了惨重代价：与我军正面交锋，数千德军在野战炮的近距离支援火力下丧命。

src: Gospodin Polkovnik, After crossing the Yalu, the Japanese are unloading two more armies from their transports:  each army landing successively closer to Port Arthur.
dst: 上校先生，渡过鸭绿江后，日本人正从运输船上卸下另外两个军：每个军登陆的位置都逐次更靠近旅顺口。

src: Gospodin Polkovnik, the whithering machine-gun fire from your defensive positions has dazed the attacking Japanese hordes, but it has not stopped them.  Climbing over their dead comrades, the enemy relentlessly pushes forward.
dst: 上校先生，您防御阵地倾泻而出的猛烈机枪火力打得进攻的日军尸横遍野、晕头转向，却未能阻止他们。敌人踩着阵亡战友的尸体，毫不留情地向前推进。

src: Gospodin Polkovnik, welcome to Korea.  Following the breakdown of negotiations, the Japanese Empire has declared war and has begun preparations for landing her army in Korea.  The Russian Empire's sphere of influence in the region rests on Port Arthur:  a fortress on the western coast of northern Korea.  It will be the aim of Japan's army to capture this fortress and expell our presence from the region.
dst: 上校先生，欢迎来到朝鲜。谈判破裂后，日本帝国已经宣战，并开始为其军队在朝鲜登陆做准备。俄罗斯帝国在该地区的势力范围依托旅顺口——一座位于朝鲜北岸西部的要塞。日本军队的目标将是夺取这座要塞，将我们的势力逐出该地区。

src: Gospodin Polkovnik, you have achieved victory in the face of superior enemy forces!  You have held the position long enough for our engineers to make the last preparations at Port Arthur.  Begin your retreat toward the city:  we have prepared another line of skirmish behind you.
dst: 上校先生，您在敌军优势兵力面前取得了胜利！您坚守阵地足够之久，让我们的工兵得以在旅顺口完成最后的准备。开始向该城撤退吧：我们已在您身后准备了另一道散兵线。

src: Gospodin Polkovnik, your forces have been overrun by superior numbers of the enemy!  You must disengage your troops and begin your retreat toward Port Arthur:  we have prepared another line of skirmish behind you.
dst: 上校先生，您的部队已被优势敌军击溃！您必须让部队脱离接触，开始向旅顺口撤退：我们已在您身后准备了另一道散兵线。

src: Gospodin Polkovnik, your tactical prowess has frustrated the Japanese commanders yet again.  The whithering machine-gun fire from your defensive positions has stopped the initial attacking waves in a bloody heap, but the Japanese have pulled up massive reinforcements and are about to overwhelm your positions.
dst: 上校先生，您的战术才能再次挫败了日军指挥官。您防御阵地倾泻而出的猛烈机枪火力，把最初几波进攻打得血流成河、寸步难行，但日军已调来大规模增援，即将压垮您的阵地。

src: Graziani wanted to give up the Cirenaica, but Comando Supremo ordered him to be more optimistic. He split 10th Army in 3 defensive groups: your division and the rest of XXIII Corps in Bardia, XXII Corps in Tobruk and XX Corps holding the Mechili-Derna line.
dst: 格拉齐亚尼本想放弃昔兰尼加，但最高统帅部命令他乐观一些。他把第10集团军分成3个防御集群：你的师和第23军其余部队在巴迪亚，第22军在托布鲁克，第20军守梅基利-德尔纳一线。

src: Great Work!, the capital has fallen, and the countrie will go to the caos for the moment. The King of Norwat, Hakkon, has escaped us, but our agents will pursuit him.
dst: 干得好！首都已经陷落，眼下这个国家将陷入混乱。挪威国王哈康从我们手中逃脱了，但我们的特工将会追捕他。

src: Great display, General.  With the annihilation of the German Afrika Korps we can now begin the long, arduous task of liberating Europe from the tyranny of leather shorts, sausages and foul-smelling cabbage.  Oh and we'll give the pasta munchers a bloody good seeing too while we're at it.  Pip pip!
dst: 表现出色，将军。随着德国非洲军团的覆灭，我们现在可以开始解放欧洲这项漫长而艰巨的任务了——把欧洲从皮短裤、香肠和臭烘烘的卷心菜的暴政下解放出来。哦，顺手我们还要把那些吃意面的家伙也好好收拾一顿。再见！

src: Great job Herr Fregattenkapitan. We are absolutely delighted!!!
dst: 干得好，海军中校阁下。我们非常高兴！！！

src: Great job Herr General!  Your victory has opened the door for an attack on the city of Stalin before the Soviets have even consolidated their defenses!
dst: 干得漂亮，将军阁下！你的胜利为在苏军尚未巩固其防御之前进攻斯大林城打开了大门！

src: Great job Herr Kapitanleutnant. We are absolutely delighted!!!
dst: 干得漂亮，海军上尉阁下。我们非常高兴！！！

src: Great job Herr Korvettenkapitan. We are absolutely delighted!!!
dst: 干得漂亮，海军上校阁下。我们无比欣喜！！！

src: Great job Herr Leutnant. We are absolutely delighted!!!
dst: 干得好，少尉阁下。我们非常高兴！！！

src: Great job Herr Oberleutnant. We are absolutely delighted!!!
dst: 干得好，中尉阁下。我们非常高兴！！！

src: Great job Kapitan!!!. We are absolutely delighted!!!
dst: 干得好，上尉！！！我们非常高兴！！！

src: Great job Kapitan!!!. We are absolutely delighted!!! You gave to British another good lesson.
dst: 干得好，上尉！！！我们非常高兴！！！你又给英国人上了很好的一课。
干得漂亮，海军准将阁下！！！

src: Great job Kommodore!!! Malta is ours, but I fear it was a Pyrrhic victory. The Italians suffered heavy losses and probably won't be able to maintain our dominance in the Mediterranean for a long time. Our fleet after regrouping must start for the Black Sea.....
dst: 干得漂亮，海军准将！！！马耳他是我们的了，但我担心这是一场惨胜。意大利人损失惨重，恐怕无法长期维持我们在地中海的优势。我们的舰队重新集结后必须开赴黑海……

src: Great job Kommodore!!! Move fast to Gibraltar, we have no time.
dst: 干得漂亮，海军准将！！！迅速前往直布罗陀，我们没时间了。

src: Great job Kommodore!!! Next mission is to secure Krasnodar and then Black Sea is ours.
dst: 干得好，海军准将！！！下一个任务是夺取克拉斯诺达尔，那时黑海就是我们的了。

src: Great job Kommodore!!! Once again you have defeated the English.
dst: 干得漂亮，海军准将！！！你再次击败了英国人。

src: Great job Kommodore!!! Our fleet can resupply.
dst: 干得漂亮，海军准将！！！我们的舰队可以补给。

src: Great job Kommodore!!! We are absolutely delighted!!! You have to return to Germany.
dst: 干得漂亮，海军准将！！！我们欣喜万分！！！您必须返回德国。

src: Great job Kommodore!!! You stop the Americans.
dst: 干得漂亮，海军准将！！！你挡住了美国人。

src: Great job Kommodore!!!. Ireland will now stop (even secretly) supporting the British with volunteers.
dst: 干得好，海军准将！！！爱尔兰现在将停止（哪怕是秘密地）以志愿者支援英国。

src: Great job Kommodore!!!. Our marines are safe.
dst: 干得好，海军准将！！！我们的海军陆战队安全了。

src: Great job Kommodore!!!. We are absolutely delighted!!!
dst: 干得太棒了，海军准将！！！我们欣喜若狂！！！

src: Great job commander. A lot of Vichy French ships fell into our hands. Hitler and Mussolini will be pleased.
dst: 干得好，指挥官。许多维希法国舰船落入我们手中。希特勒和墨索里尼会很高兴。

src: Great job general. The French have retreated back to Belgium. Continue the pursuit and do not give them any rest.
dst: 干得好，将军。法国人已撤回比利时。继续追击，别给他们喘息之机。

src: Great job, General! Now we are in a perfect situation for our assault on the last Turkish line blocking our way to the Holy City.
dst: 干得好，将军！现在我们正处于绝佳态势，可以对阻挡我们通往圣城之路的最后一道土耳其防线发起突击。

src: Great job, sir.  We've finally taken the city of Caen, our major objective since we landed here in Normandy.  Montgomery is delighted, and is taking all of the credit of course.  He said we'd take the city on day one, but now claims having us get bogged down was all part of his subtle plan.  I don't think he'd recognize a subtle plan if it painted itself purple and danced naked on a harpsichord singing 'subtle plans are here again' quite frankly.
dst: 干得真棒，长官。我们终于攻下了卡昂城——自我们在诺曼底登陆以来的首要目标。蒙哥马利欣喜若狂，当然把功劳全揽了去。他曾说我们第一天就能拿下此城，如今却宣称让我们陷入胶着全是他那精妙计划的一部分。说实在的，就算一个精妙计划把自己涂成紫色、裸着身子在羽管键琴上跳舞、唱着“精妙计划又来了”，我看他也未必认得出来。

src: Great job. The Germans got a bloody nose. They have wasted all of their reserves and it seems that they have no capabilities to lead a further big attack. After your success our troops in the north of the Kursker salient could break to the German lines. Because of this they stopped all attacks on the Kursker salient. It gives me pleasure to told you that the USA and Great Britain has landed on Sicily.
dst: 干得好。德国人碰了一鼻子灰。他们已耗尽全部预备队，看来他们已无力再发动大规模进攻。在你的胜利之后，我们在库尔斯克突出部北面的部队本可以突破德军防线。正因如此，他们停止了对库尔斯克突出部的所有进攻。我很高兴地告诉你，美国和英国已在西西里登陆。

src: Great news from some days ago: the Rumanians have surrendered to the mighty Soviet Union and are now fighting against the Germans. The German fascists are in disarray and lack leadership. Many of their forces find themselves trapped in Rumania. However there are still Rumanian fascists in the Rumanian Army that refuse to surrender and remain loyal to their fascists leaders and the Germans. Your force is closest to the Rumanian capital of Bucharest. You must rush into the city and clear it of any enemy. Moskva does not care who gets shot. Just make sure we are in possession of Bucharest as soon as possible. Watch out for still retreating Germans in the countryside. Also the Germans might plan to send reinforcements to the city by air. You will be supported by Rumanian units that have switched sides. It is a confusing time, but you must succeed.
dst: 几天前传来大好消息：罗马尼亚人已向强大的苏联投降，如今正与德国人作战。德国法西斯陷入混乱，指挥失灵。他们的许多部队被困在了罗马尼亚。然而罗马尼亚军队中仍有拒绝投降的罗马尼亚法西斯，他们忠于自己的法西斯头目和德国人。你的部队离罗马尼亚首都布加勒斯特最近。你必须冲进城市，肃清一切敌人。莫斯科不在乎谁被击毙。只要确保我们尽快占领布加勒斯特。当心乡间仍在撤退的德军。德军也可能计划空运增援进城。倒戈的罗马尼亚部队会支援你。这是个混乱的时期，但你必须成功。

src: Great performance General.  We've secured the bridge at Primasole and the port of Catania has fallen to us - though not after a tough fight against a crack German Parachute Division.  The advance will continue on up the coast to Messina, however your unit has been withdrawn and placed in reserve for future operations.
dst: 表现出色，将军。我们已拿下普里马索莱桥，卡塔尼亚港也已落入我手——尽管这之前与一支精锐德国伞兵师打了一场硬仗。推进将继续沿海岸北上墨西拿，不过你的部队已被撤下，编入预备队以备后用。

src: Great victory, Herr General! Your forces secured our positions on the road to Smolensk!
dst: 伟大的胜利，将军阁下！你的部队巩固了我们在通往斯摩棱斯克道路上的阵地！

src: Great work Commander, Constantinople is in our hands and the Turks have signed an unconditional surrender!!!
dst: 干得漂亮，指挥官，君士坦丁堡已落入我们手中，土耳其人签署了无条件投降！！！

src: Great work by your XIX corps Herr General, now push on to your new objectives.
dst: 你的第19军干得好，将军阁下，现在向你的新目标推进。

src: Great work by your XIX corps Herr General, you are now ordered to cross East Prussia and form up for our attack south-east.
dst: 你的第19军干得好，将军阁下，现在你奉命穿过东普鲁士集结，准备向东南发起进攻。

src: Great work out there Commander!  Martial law has been declared and the National Guard is rounding up the rest of the surviving rioters as we speak.
dst: 干得漂亮，指挥官！戒严令已经颁布，国民警卫队此刻正在围捕余下的幸存骚乱者。

src: Great work, General.  We've made a deep penetration into the enemy's rear....ahem.  Now two fresh armoured divisions of Poles and Canadians are to take over for a new offensive to capture Falaise, while your brave men get some much needed rest.  Oh and if you bump into any Poles on your way, don't broach the subject of Latin American politics - for some reason the subject really winds them up!
dst: 干得好，将军。我们已向敌后纵深插入……咳咳。现在两个新锐的波兰和加拿大装甲师将接手，发起夺取法莱斯的新攻势，而你勇敢的部下则得到急需的休整。哦对了，若你路上遇到波兰人，千万别提拉丁美洲政治这个话题——不知为何，这话题真能把他们惹毛！

src: Great work.  The Chinese will no longer be a threat to our shipping routes on the Yangtze and the Gan rivers.  They have suffered a major defeat by losing the industrial center of Nanchang.  We can now continue our advance on the Chinese mainland.
dst: 干得漂亮。中国军队将不再威胁我们在长江和赣江上的航运。他们失去了工业中心南昌，遭受了一场重大失败。我们现在可以继续在中国大陆推进了。

src: Great!  Hong Kong and Macao are in our hands and the chinese armies deployed around our base of Canton have been defeated.  The chinese and their allies will no longer be a problem to our continued advance into Asia.
dst: 太好了！香港和澳门已落入我们手中，部署在我们广州基地周围的中国军队也已被击败。中国及其盟国将不再是我们继续向亚洲推进的障碍。

src: Great! The Anyera rebellion is over and our army controls the area completely. Indeed, it has been a brilliant performance, General. Your victory will make easier for us to plan more ambitious operations in the future.
dst: 好极了！安耶拉叛乱已经结束，我军完全控制了该地区。将军，这确实是一次出色的表现。您的胜利将使我们未来更易于筹划更具雄心的行动。

src: Great! The Italians are running to the hills instead of trying to hold their front lines. This victory will stop the rebel menace at Madrid, at least for the moment, and allow us to think about further operations in the coming weeks.
dst: 太好了！意大利人逃往山里，而不是设法守住自己的前线。这场胜利将阻止叛军对马德里的威胁，至少目前如此，并让我们得以考虑在接下来几周里展开进一步行动。

src: Great! The Spanish defences have fallen, Vara del Rey is dead, and Linares has been wounded. Now the siege of Santiago can begin. Nothing, and nobody, will be able to get out of the town, either by land or by sea. In a few days the Spaniards will realise that there is no hope for them, and they'll surrender.
dst: 太棒了！西班牙防线已经崩溃，巴拉德尔雷阵亡，利纳雷斯负伤。现在圣地亚哥之围可以开始了。届时无论从陆路还是海路，任何人和任何东西都无法离开这座城镇。不出数日，西班牙人就会意识到他们已毫无希望，并选择投降。

src: Great!. The allies have been fully defeated at the gates of Rangoon. Now, we can send some units to protect other more important fronts.
dst: 太好了！盟军在仰光城下被彻底击败。现在，我们可以抽调一些部队去保护其他更重要的战线了。

src: Ground Frau Commanders had come to expect it.How could all the SS Forces along the vast Russian Conflict Zones have Air-cover.Slowly the Fighters showing in the Skies were the weak 'Kris models as the Frau-Z's and others needed maintenance.So far nothing dramatic had happened.Was this the incident that was going to cause a little more Caution to the Frau's movement.In Moscow Joseph Stalin hoped so.So the 10th Guards of 'Helmonchek had been reinforced with some Armor of the Brits and French plus even a Group of Americans had arrived.The Frau's wore out as they was had made a Dash to not let the 10th Guards separate them from other SS forces.SS/BdM Air units had intervenned but not in the numbers the situation called for so the 10th Guards moved in to cut off 'Elfi's Gruppe.Russian Commander Borisko Lutt Helmonchek expected some aid from stragglers of the 51st Shock but most who had fought and escaped were useless,they didn't want to tangle with the Nazi Bitches again.Even shooting them to motivate them did no good.So Helmonchek would have to do it on His own with a few Allies there to Spy on the Red Army so He would make plans for His 'Friends to be used as 'Panzer Fodder' while attempting not to have His Forces become another 51st.
dst: 地面部队的“女士”指挥官们早已料到这一点。在辽阔的俄国战区，党卫军各部队怎么可能都有空中掩护。渐渐出现在天空的战斗机，都是孱弱的“克里斯”型号，因为“Frau-Z”和其他机型都需要维护。到目前为止还没出什么大事。会不会就是这一回，让“女士”们的行动多几分谨慎？在莫斯科，约瑟夫·斯大林但愿如此。于是“赫尔蒙切克”的近卫第10集团军得到了英法的一些装甲部队加强，甚至还有一批美国人抵达。疲惫不堪的“女士”们奋力冲击，不让近卫第10集团军把她们与其他党卫军部队隔开。党卫军/BdM 的空中单位介入了，但投入的数量达不到形势所需，于是近卫第10集团军插了进来，试图切断“埃尔菲”的集群。俄军指挥官鲍里斯科·卢特·赫尔蒙切克本指望第51突击集团军的散兵游勇前来支援，但那些打过仗又逃出来的人大多派不上用场——他们不想再跟这些纳粹娘们纠缠。连枪毙他们以激励士气都没用。于是赫尔蒙切克只能靠自己，身边还有几个“盟友”——那些人其实是来监视红军的；他于是打算让这些“朋友”充当“装甲饲料”，同时尽量别让自己的部队变成第二个第51集团军。

src: Guderian, travelling with 3rd Panzer Division at the head of II Panzergruppe, met Kleist's tanks near the school at Lokhvitsa on September 15. Four Soviet Armies (5th, 21st, 26th and 37th) were trapped. South-west front was falling apart and communications in such a state of chaos that Timoshenko the next day ordered his forces east of the German cordon to hold open the corridor unaware that there was no corridor left. On the night of the 17th Kirponos ordered all his Armies to fight their way out of the cauldron while the 2nd Cavalry Corps forced an opening at Romny. But the breakout was doomed from the start, 37th Army defending Kiev didn't receive the order and fought for 2 more days before surrendering. Scattered groups of 50 here and 100 there made their way to the east but the Russians had lost 665,000 men, 3718 guns and 884 tanks captured. It was the biggest catastrophe in Russian history, maybe in all history though it's strategic consequences were not to prove as fatal as those of many a smaller battle.
dst: 9月15日，古德里安随第2装甲集群先头的第3装甲师行动，在洛赫维察的学校附近与克莱斯特的坦克会师。四个苏军集团军（第5、第21、第26和第37集团军）陷入重围。西南方面军正在瓦解，通信混乱到如此地步，以至于铁木辛哥次日竟命令德军封锁线以东的部队守住走廊——却不知走廊已不复存在。17日夜里，基尔波诺斯命令所有各集团军杀出重围，同时第2骑兵军在罗姆内打开了一个缺口。但突围从一开始就注定失败：防守基辅的第37集团军没有接到命令，又打了两天才投降。零散的队伍这里50人、那里100人向东突围，但俄军损失了66.5万人，被缴获3718门火炮和884辆坦克。这是俄国历史上最大的灾难，也许是人类历史上最大的灾难，尽管其战略后果并不像许多规模较小的战役那样致命。

src: Général, I guess this offensive has been doomed right from the start. Nothing went as planned, and our losses have been outrageous. All we can do now is cling to the few miles of soil that we could conquer and wait what HQ wil make out of this mess. I just received a message about the British landing at Suvla Bay. It has be an utter failure as well. What a disgrace! I can only hope that our military leaders are still sane enough to end this operation once and for all and evacuate us from this godforsaken shore.
dst: 将军，我猜这次攻势从一开始就注定失败。没有一件事按计划进行，我们的损失惨重得令人发指。我们现在能做的，就是守住我们能夺取的这几英里土地，等待指挥部如何收拾这个烂摊子。我刚收到关于英国人在苏夫拉湾登陆的消息。那也彻底失败了。真是一种耻辱！我只能希望我们的军事领导人还足够清醒，能一劳永逸地结束这次行动，把我们从这被上帝遗弃的海岸撤离。

src: Général, Verdun has fallen. France will fight on, but it will take our nation a lot to recover from this loss. The press is blaming some generals for this debacle. Be sure that it will not be Joffre who has to take the responsibility. You are an old and well-respected soldier, my friend, therefore you will not have to fear court-martial. But it's time for you to resign and make way for younger, more capable commanders. Adieu!
dst: 将军，凡尔登陷落了。法国将继续战斗，但我们国家要从这一损失中恢复过来，还需付出很多。新闻界正把这场溃败归咎于某些将军。请放心，不必负责的不会是霞飞。您是一位年长且备受尊敬的军人，我的朋友，因此您不必担心军事法庭。但该是您辞职、为更年轻、更有能力的指挥官让路的时候了。再见！

src: Général, Verdun has fallen. France will fight on, but it's uncertain if we'll recover from this loss. The press is blaming some generals for this debacle. Be sure that it will not be Joffre who has to take the responsibility. You are an old and well-respected soldier, my friend, therefore you will not have to fear court-martial. But it's time for you to resign and make way for younger, more capable commanders. Adieu!
dst: 将军，凡尔登陷落了。法国将继续战斗，但我们能否从这一损失中恢复，尚未可知。新闻界正把这场溃败归咎于某些将军。请放心，不必负责的不会是霞飞。您是一位年长且备受尊敬的军人，我的朋友，因此您不必担心军事法庭。但该是您辞职、为更年轻、更有能力的指挥官让路的时候了。再见！

src: Général, although you and your your men achieved your goals, overall our offensive has been a total disaster! We've only taken the western part of the Chemin des Dames, and even that has been at the price of staggering casualties.
dst: 将军，尽管您和您的部下达成了目标，但整体而言，我们的攻势完全是一场灾难！我们只夺取了贵妇小径的西部，而即便是这一点，也付出了惊人的伤亡代价。

src: Général, bot bad. But your advance hasn't been as deep as we had planned.The Loretto Heights are still in German hands. Now we must gather our troops and reinforce our frontline, before planning new attacks
dst: 将军，不算差。但您的推进没有我们计划的那么深入。洛雷托高地仍在德国人手中。现在我们必须集结部队、加强前线，然后再筹划新的进攻。

src: Général, do you hear the voices of our men - singing "La Madelon" - reverberating from the hills?
dst: 将军，您听见我们士兵的歌声了吗——唱的是「拉马德隆」，在山丘间回荡？

src: Général, do you hear the voices of our men singing "La Madelon" reverberating from the hills?
dst: 将军，您听见我们的士兵在群山间回荡的《玛德隆》歌声了吗？

src: Général, failure! You were not able to prevent the Germans from capturing La Bassée. Luckily further British reinforcements were able to stop the German advance. So the Race to the Sea continues. But it is pretty clear that the ports of Calais and Dunkerque will stay out of German hands.
dst: 将军，失败了！您未能阻止德国人夺取拉巴塞。幸好更多的英国增援部队得以阻止了德军的推进。于是「奔向大海」继续进行。但很明显，加来和敦刻尔克两港不会落入德国人之手。

src: Général, it looks like we gave you a mission impossible. Reserve divisions will have to take the remaining German positions.
dst: 将军，看来我们给了您一个不可能完成的任务。预备师将不得不去夺取德军剩余的阵地。

src: Général, just as has happened in the rest of Lorraine, your offensive has stalled. The Boche will counterattack soon, so you must cancel your battle plans and cover our retreat. For the moment, our priority in Lorraine will be the defence of Nancy.
dst: 将军，正如洛林其余地区发生的情况一样，您的攻势停滞了。德国佬很快就会反击，因此您必须取消作战计划，掩护我方撤退。眼下，我们在洛林的首要任务是保卫南锡。

src: Général, la France is very grateful. The fortresses are back in our hands. The battle of Verdun is over. The Germans have admitted defeat.
dst: 将军，法兰西万分感激。要塞重归我们手中。凡尔登战役结束了。德国人已经承认失败。

src: Général, our offensive has been a total disaster! We've captured nothing, and due to our heavy casualties, our front is wide open right now...we could even lose the war!
dst: 将军，我们的攻势彻底失败了！我们什么都没能占领，由于伤亡惨重，我们的战线现在门户大开……我们甚至可能输掉这场战争！

src: Général, we have returned to the Aisne. Our counterattack has broken Germany's neck.
dst: 将军，我们已经回到了埃纳河。我们的反击已经打断了德国的脊梁。

src: Général, well done. But your advance hasn't been as deep as we had planned.The Loretto Heights are still in German hands. Now we must gather our troops and reinforce our frontline, before planning new attacks
dst: 将军，干得好。但您的推进没有我们计划的那么深远。洛雷托高地仍在德军手中。现在我们必须集结部队、加强前线，然后再筹划新的进攻。

src: Général, what a shame. Our counterattack has failed.
dst: 将军，真遗憾。我们的反击失败了。

src: Général, when all seemed lost and whole divisions vanished in panic and chaos, your calm, but determined leadership saved the day once again. Joffre and every Frenchman praises your great service to our nation. The Germans seem to be even more exhausted and worn out than our brave troops. They will continue their attack soon, there's no doubt about it. But right now, let'st take a deep breath and raise our glasses in honour of our comrades who made the greatest sacrifice and perished in the inferno, fighting until the end. Adieu, Colonel Emile Driant!
dst: 将军，当一切似乎都已失去、整师整师的部队在恐慌和混乱中溃散时，是您冷静而坚定的指挥再次挽救了局面。霞飞和每一个法国人都赞颂您为祖国做出的伟大贡献。德军似乎比我们英勇的部队更加疲惫不堪。他们很快就会继续进攻，这一点毋庸置疑。但现在，让我们深吸一口气，举杯向那些做出了最大牺牲、在地狱中战斗到最后一刻而牺牲的战友们致敬。永别了，埃米尔·德里昂上校！

src: Général, you and your men have fought bravely, nobody can deny that! Even those snobbish British generals have to admit that it has been the French Army that has set an example of adorable valour here at Gallipoli. But finally we had to accept that the Turkish reinforcements were just too much for our depleted forces. We had to call off the offensive, before we could reach Krithia. Now we have to dig in and hold our position for the time being.
dst: 将军，您和您的士兵作战英勇，这一点无人能否认！即便是那些傲慢的英国将军也不得不承认，正是在加里波利，法国军队树立了令人敬佩的英勇典范。但最终我们不得不接受，土耳其增援对我们这支筋疲力尽的部队来说实在太强了。我们不得不取消进攻，未能到达克里希亚。现在我们必须掘壕固守，暂时守住阵地。

src: Général, you have been magnificient! Even those snobbish British generals had to admit that it has been the French Army that has defeated the Turks and taken Krithia. It is a pity that we can't continue our advance to Constantinople and you could enter the Hagia Sophia as a modern-day Napoleon. But the Turkish reinforcements are just too much for our depleted forces. We have to dig in and hold our position for the time being.
dst: 将军，您表现得精彩绝伦！即便是那些目空一切的英国将军也不得不承认，是法军击败了土耳其人、夺取了克里提亚。可惜我们无法继续向君士坦丁堡推进，您也不能以现代拿破仑的身份踏入圣索菲亚大教堂。但土耳其的增援部队对我方已经疲惫的部队来说实在太多了。我们不得不暂时挖壕据守。

src: Général, you have failed! We've not been able to recover even just one meter of terrain. It's a shame for the whole French army.
dst: 将军，您失败了！我们连一米土地都没能夺回。这对整个法军都是耻辱。

src: Général, you have prevented the Germans from enveloping our forces. The Race to the Sea continues, but it is clear that the ports of Calais and Dunkerque will stay out of German hands.
dst: 将军，您已阻止了德军对我军的包抄。「奔向大海」仍在继续，但很明显，加来和敦刻尔克两港将不会落入德国人之手。

src: Général, you've done it again! The main German attack has been stopped. No matter how many times they try to break our front, we always manage to repel their assaults. This nightmare won't go on for much longer. The Boches will have to back down very soon.  Now let's hope that our allies do their part, and attack the Germans as they have promised.
dst: 将军，您又做到了！德军的主要进攻已被阻止。无论他们多少次试图突破我们的防线，我们总能击退他们的猛攻。这场噩梦不会持续太久了。德国佬很快就会不得不退却。现在让我们希望盟友尽到他们的责任，按承诺进攻德军。

src: Général, you've done it again! The main German attack has been stopped. No matter how many times they try to break our front, we always manage to repel their assaults. This nightmare won't go on for much longer. The Boches will have to back down very soon. Now let's hope that our allies do their part, and attack the Germans as they have promised.
dst: 将军，您又做到了！德军的主攻被阻止了。无论他们多少次试图突破我方战线，我们总能击退他们的突击。这场噩梦不会持续太久了。德国佬很快就得退却。现在让我们希望我们的盟友尽他们的本分，如约进攻德国人。

src: Général, you've managed to stop the Bulgarian attacks for a while. Unfortunately, the Serbian Army has been nearly destroyed, so there is no need to keep on fighting in Macedonia at the moment. You may evacuate your forces south of the Greek border, while the British embark the surviving Serbian troops to the island of Corfou.
dst: 将军，您已暂时阻止了保加利亚人的进攻。不幸的是，塞尔维亚军队已几近覆灭，所以目前没有必要继续在马其顿作战。您可以把部队撤到希腊边境以南，而英国人则把幸存的塞尔维亚军队装上船送往科孚岛。

src: Général, your conduct of this battle has been appaling, and only your good reputation and the fact that the British performance has been even worse has saved you from being relieved from your command. We can call ourselves lucky that the Turks are equally exhausted, otherwise they would haven driven us into the sea. We had to call off the offensive, before we could even reach Krithia. Now we have to dig in and hold our position for the time being.
dst: 将军，您对这场战斗的指挥糟糕透顶，只是因为您的好名声、加上英军的表现更糟，才使您免于被解除指挥权。我们能说自己幸运，是因为土耳其人同样疲惫，否则他们早就把我们赶进海里了。我们还没能到达克里提亚，就不得不取消攻势。现在我们必须暂时挖壕据守。

src: Général, your troops have beaten the Germans badly, but in the rest of Lorraine our offensive has stalled. The Boche will counterattack soon, so you must cancel your battle plans and cover our retreat. For the moment, our priority in Lorraine will be the defence of Nancy.
dst: 将军，您的部队重创了德军，但在洛林其余地区，我们的进攻陷入了停滞。德国佬很快会反攻，因此您必须取消作战计划，掩护我军撤退。眼下，我们在洛林的首要任务是防守南锡。

src: Général, your troops have reached their objectives with a great effort, but in the rest of Lorraine our offensive has stalled. The Boche will counterattack soon, so you must cancel your battle plans and cover our retreat. For the moment, our priority in Lorraine will be the defence of Nancy.
dst: 将军，您的部队付出了巨大努力才达成目标，但在洛林其余地区，我们的攻势停滞了。德国佬很快就会反击，因此您必须取消作战计划，掩护我方撤退。眼下，我们在洛林的首要任务是保卫南锡。

src: Général, your troops have taken quite a beating by the Germany, but be assured, it has not been in vain. Your sacrifices made the enemy withdraw his troops from other parts of the front, leading to a general retreat. Everyone is speaking about "le miracle de la Marne", and so let us raise a glass of wine to celebrate this first great victory in this war, even though other generals will receive the fame for it.
dst: 将军，您的部队被德军打得够呛，但请放心，这并非徒劳。你们的牺牲迫使敌人从战线其他地段撤军，从而引发了全面撤退。人人都在谈论「马恩河奇迹」，那就让我们举杯，庆祝这场战争中的第一次伟大胜利吧，尽管这份荣耀将归于其他将军。

src: Général, your troops have written history by stopping the enemy's advance. Everyone is speaking about "le miracle de la Marne", but your men created it. Your determined counter-attack at the River Ourcq was the he first domino that intiated the withdrawal of the whole German Army. Le Grand Nation can't thank you enough.
dst: 将军，您的部队阻止了敌人的推进，从而书写了历史。人人都在谈论「马恩河奇迹」，但创造它的正是您的部下。您在乌尔克河上坚定的反击，是引发整个德军撤退的第一张多米诺骨牌。伟大的法兰西民族对您感激不尽。

src: H.Q. has decided it is time for your men to sharpen their skills, and regain some confidence. You and your men have been slated to take part in a training exercise code named "Operation Spartan". This exercise will involve ground forces only. A large area  west of London has been cleared to provide the "Battlefield". Your men, along with the Free French forces, will be known as "Force Z" and will attempt to secure a bridgehead at Egham and capture Camberly, forcing, and clearing the way for, a breakout. Opposing you will be the British and U.S. forces, to be known as "Force X". This is a "live" ammo exercise, so be careful!

dst: 您已达成此次进攻的全部目标。尽管如此，敌军正在首都的街巷中表现出难以置信的顽强抵抗……我们必须改变最初的计划，现在我们打算设法包围马德里，从而切断它与其余共和区之间的交通联络。

src: Ha! The British assault has failed, and it will take them many months to be able to make another try. The area of the Doiran Lake will be quiet for some time.
dst: 哈！英军的进攻失败了，他们要想再尝试一次，得等上好几个月。多伊兰湖地区将会平静一段时间。

src: Ha, it's great to finally meet you! My late father liked it when you interviewed him in 1906. Until the day he died, he considered one of his friends.
dst: 哈，终于见到您了，真是太好了！1906年您采访先父时，他非常高兴。直到去世那天，他都把您当作朋友之一。

src: Haig had ordered that the objectives were to relieve pressure on the French at Verdun and inflict loss on the enemy. I objected that our own losses would also be very high, since the logistical mistakes that we had made at Loos were far from solved. He told me that he understood my concerns, but that the offensive of the Somme was a strategic necessity. The French Army was in serious risk of collapsing at Verdun and, if we did not intervene, they could actually be forced to surrender before the end of the year. He told me that, as long as I accomplished my objectives, I was free to try any measure that could save the lives of the men under my command, especially my small-scale tactics.
dst: 黑格已下令，目标是缓解法军在凡尔登的压力，并给敌人造成损失。我提出异议说，我们自己的损失也会非常惨重，因为我们在洛斯犯下的后勤错误远未解决。他告诉我，他理解我的顾虑，但索姆河攻势是战略上的必需。法军正面临在凡尔登崩溃的严重危险，如果我们不干预，他们真的可能在年底前被迫投降。他告诉我，只要我完成了我的目标，我就可以自由尝试任何能够挽救我麾下士兵生命的办法，尤其是我的小规模战术。

dst: 干得漂亮，将军！我们对补给的担忧已成过去。如今只剩下一项大任务，将军——征服这个国家！

src: Hang on Herr Korvettenkapitan, we just received a message that enemy marines with the support of RAF and many ships are trying to attack Faroe islands. Your marines should defend the ground targets against the attack of enemy paratroopers. Use your airplanes to assist them. I am afraid your ships can't support them because they have to move south to block enemy naval attack with many ships and marines. 1 Light Radar Cruiser at east will assist to spot enemy ships.
dst: 挺住，海军少校阁下，我们刚收到消息：敌军海军陆战队在 RAF 和多艘舰船的支援下正试图进攻法罗群岛。您的海军陆战队应守住地面目标，抵御敌军伞兵的攻击。用您的飞机协助他们。恐怕您的舰船无法支援他们，因为它们必须南下，以拦截敌军由众多舰船和海军陆战队发起的海上进攻。东部将有1艘轻型雷达巡洋舰协助侦测敌舰。

dst: 豪塞尔的党卫军第2装甲军执行“安东”行动，入侵法国南部。党卫军第2装甲师“帝国”在“百合”行动中夺取土伦港，但大部分法国舰船被舰员凿沉。我军占领法国里维埃拉和科西嘉。

src: Having failed to capture the town of Krasnostav head-on, the GardeKorps lost an opportunity to force the XIV and III Kavkazky Corps to remain on the western bank of the Wieprz, resulting in a significantly blunted overall attack.
dst: 由于未能正面攻下克拉斯诺斯塔夫，近卫军错失了迫使第14军和第3高加索军留在维普日河西岸的机会，结果整个进攻的势头大大受挫。

src: Having failed to reach your objectives, you have also wasted the lives of countless men under your command.  Without a doubt, your tactical blunders will cost the Front stretegically, as the enemy prepares for offensive action in your sector.  You have been relieved of your command.
dst: 由于未能达成目标，您还白白葬送了麾下无数将士的生命。毫无疑问，您的战术失误将在战略上令方面军付出代价，因为敌人正准备在您这个地段发起进攻。您已被解除指挥权。

src: He gave as his reason that the Gauls would receive military aid from Britain...and indeed, on both sides of the Channel are located identical tribes: for example, the Parisi - from whom the now called city of Paris gets its name - they settled around present-day Paris and in South East England ...
dst: 他给出的理由是，高卢人会从不列颠获得军援……而事实上，海峡两岸确实分布着相同的部族：例如巴黎西人——今巴黎城之名即源于他们——就既定居在今天的巴黎一带，也定居在英格兰东南部……

src: He gave the supreme command for the revenge campaign ......... you!

src: He is threatening Washington D.C. as well as Baltimore and Philadelphia, and in addition he is tying useful troops of us up here...
dst: 他正威胁着华盛顿特区、巴尔的摩和费城，此外他还把我们有用的部队牵制在了这里……

src: He seconded guides for the negotiating team in order to lead it back to its camp in a roundabout way and took with his Legion  the quickest way to ambush the clueless Germans in their camp.
dst: 他给谈判使团派了向导，好把他们绕远路带回营地，自己则率军团走最近的路，去偷袭毫无防备的日耳曼人营地。

src: Heavy rains turned the Tunisian battlefield into a sea of mud and combat actions came to an abrupt halt mid December last year. We received reports that British, French and US forces are preparing for an offensive with the aim of reaching the sea, cutting our forces in half and cutting the supply route to our forces opposing 8th Army. Our plan is to spoil those attacks by capturing all passes leading through the Eastern Endorsal, starting with the pass at Barrage de l'Oued Kebir, the Karachoum Gap and the Kairouan Pass: Operation Eilbote I (this scenario). We will follow up these actions by capturing the Faid and Maknassy passes (next).
dst: 大雨把突尼斯战场变成一片泥海，去年12月中旬战斗骤然停止。我们收到报告，英、法、美军队正为一场攻势做准备，目标是打到海边，把我军拦腰截断，并切断我军的补给线以支援正在对抗第8集团军的那部分部队。我们的计划是破坏这些进攻：夺取东部山脊的所有隘口，从瓦迪凯比尔水坝隘口、卡拉舒姆隘口和凯鲁万隘口入手：“信使”行动 I（本场景）。之后我们将继续夺取法伊德和马克纳西两处隘口（下一场景）。
赫柏号、斯皮迪号、海斯号与拉伊号

src: Heeresgruppe Kurland and 4th Army are holding East Prussia fairly well now. But the Soviets have advanced in central Poland and are turning North to cut off East Prussia. The attack was spearheaded by their 70th Army, but now the 5th Guards Tank Army is taking over the advance.
dst: 库尔兰集团军群和第4集团军如今把东普鲁士守得相当不错。但苏军已在波兰中部推进，并正掉头北上，企图切断东普鲁士。进攻最初由他们的第70集团军打头，如今近卫第5坦克集团军接过了推进任务。

src: Heeresgruppe Mitte must break russian defence and beat back the attack.
dst: 中央集团军群必须突破苏军防线，并击退其进攻。
