src: Hello Otto! How are you? Listen, kamerad, I've got a big news for you! Come and join me tonight in the Offizie... what? Why, what's happening? Oh, it's today? Nevermind, even better than that, we'll talk about it after dinner. At least we'll speak at rest and without too many ears listening... No, no... everything's fine. I'm glad that I have called, otherwise I'd forget about Pauline. I'm going to a florist's right away. Should I buy roses, carnations, or... Pardon? No, it's not the reason why I phoned. Otto, the machine is somehow noisy, seems like they're repairing the line, if you understand me. We'll talk later. If I hadn't forgotten about the annual party, I wouldn't have phoned at all. See you in the evening! Bye now... Ja, ja... Ja, tschuss!"
dst: 你好，奥托！你怎么样？听着，老伙计，我有个大消息要告诉你！今晚来军官……什么？为什么，发生什么了？哦，是今天？没关系，那更好，我们晚饭后再谈。至少我们可以安心地谈，没有太多耳朵听着……不，不……一切都好。我很高兴我打了这通电话，不然我会忘了宝琳的事。我这就去花店。我该买玫瑰、康乃馨，还是……什么？不，这不是我打电话的原因。奥托，这机器有点吵，好像他们在修线路，你明白我的意思吧。我们回头再谈。要不是我忘了那个年度聚会，我根本不会打电话。晚上见！再见……是，是……好，回见！”

src: Hemos conseguido alcanzar una victoria estrategica, pero el enemigo ha sabido encajar el golpe y la ofensiva no va a tener los efectos planeados... ahora se espera un fuerte contraataque enemigo. Prepare las trincheras.
dst: 我军已取得一场战略性的胜利，但敌人稳住了阵脚，此次攻势不会产生预期的效果……现在预计敌军将发动猛烈反击。请构筑好战壕。

src: Hemos conseguido hacer una retirada medianamente ordenada, sin embargo algunas unidades han quedado atras y han sido capturadas por el enemigo.
dst: 我军完成了一次还算有序的撤退，但仍有部分部队落在后面，被敌军俘获。

src: Hemos infiltrado algunos grupos de guerrilleros tras las lineas enemigas, que seguro le seran de utilidad. De paso, estos guerrilleros nos informan que los rebeldes han desplegado aqui el CTV al completo, y es probable que la 13 Division vuelva a presentar batalla...
dst: 我们已向敌后渗透了几支游击队，他们肯定会对您派上用场。这些游击队员还告知我们，叛军已在此部署了完整的 CTV，而且第13师很可能再次投入战斗……

src: Her General, while you were leading your force with compentence and professionalism there has been a coup.  Der Fuehrer has been placed under arrest and is under heavy guard at Krankenaus  der Judischen Gemeinde in Berlin.  Peace negotiations are under way with the Russians, the Americans and the British.  In spite of your victories we still have no choice but to surrender, but perhaps we can trade that cursed man for a just peace.  Perhaps now this madness can end.
dst: 将军阁下，就在你以干练和专业的姿态指挥部队之际，一场政变发生了。元首已被逮捕，现被严密看押在柏林的犹太人社区医院。与俄国人、美国人和英国人的和平谈判正在进行。尽管你取得了胜利，我们仍别无选择，只能投降，但或许我们可以用那个该死的人换来公正的和平。也许现在这场疯狂可以结束了。

src: Her Kapitan, General Staff is pleased with your succes at England. We just receive a message that the American built 2 big fuel depots at North Iceland. In next summer they will try to control the North Atlantic. You have to move fast and destroy the bases and capture the airport. Also you must capture the English Airport at center and the ports in the west of the island.
dst: 长官，总参谋部对你在英格兰取得的成功感到满意。我们刚收到消息，美国人在北冰岛建造了两座大型燃料库。明年夏天他们将试图控制北大西洋。你必须迅速行动，摧毁这些基地并夺取机场。此外，你还必须夺取岛屿中部英格兰人的机场以及岛屿西部的港口。

src: Here at Mogilev we will again carry out a pincer movement to encircle the strongly held city.
dst: 在莫吉廖夫，我们将再次实施钳形攻势，合围这座防守坚固的城市。

src: Here is a portion of the wreckage in St. Vith, Belgium, after units of the 7th Armored Division, took the town, 24 January 1945.
dst: 这是比利时圣维特的一处残骸，在美军第7装甲师部队占领该镇之后，1945年1月24日。

src: Here is the situation. You have to attack with your ships the Liberty ships that approach from USA. We believe that the British fleet will come to support them, while our marines and branderburgers will destroy the enemy coastal batteries at Shetland islands.
dst: 情况如下。你必须用你的军舰攻击从美国驶来的自由轮。我们相信英国舰队会前来支援它们，而我们的海军陆战队和勃兰登堡部队将摧毁设得兰群岛的敌军岸防炮台。

src: Here on the ground, the naval bombardment of the Trablus fortresses was so heavy that we quickly had to retreat from the city. The Italians have brought more troops on land and five Italian Regiments have established a defensive perimeter around the city.
dst: 在陆地上，海军对黎波里要塞的炮击如此猛烈，我们不得不迅速撤出该城。意大利人已将更多部队运上岸，五个意大利团已在城周围建立了防御圈。

src: Here they were cornered by two Roman armies.
dst: 他们在此被两支罗马军队逼入绝境。

src: Here we are, at the gates of Egypt. Just one year ago the Ottoman Empire nearly collapsed, after losing all of Arabia, Mesopotamia, Palestine and Syria under the British pressure. But then, when everything seemed lost to them, our offensives in Greece and Italy forced the British to retire most of their troops in the Middle East. They achieved nothing, but that decision allowed the Turkish to counterattack and, with the help of some Austrian and German units, they managed to recover most of the lost ground, including the Sinai.
dst: 我们到了，就在埃及的大门口。就在一年前，奥斯曼帝国在英国的压力下丢失了阿拉伯、美索不达米亚、巴勒斯坦和叙利亚的全部土地，几乎崩溃。但后来，正当他们看似大势已去之际，我们在希腊和意大利的攻势迫使英国撤走了其在中东的大部分部队。英国虽一无所获，但这一决定却让土耳其人得以反攻，并在一些奥军和德军部队的协助下，收复了大部分失地，包括西奈半岛。

src: Here we are, at the gates of the Red fortress of Tsaritsyn. The cossacks tried to take it three times in the last months, and every time they had to retire with heavy losses. The Soviets have many of their best units in this town on the shores of the Volga, including infantry, trench defences, armoured trains, heavy artillery and even some war boats.
dst: 我们来到了红军要塞察里津的城下。过去几个月，哥萨克三次试图攻下它，每次都不堪重创而退。苏维埃在伏尔加河畔这座城镇驻有其许多最精锐的部队，包括步兵、战壕工事、装甲列车、重炮，甚至还有一些武装船只。

src: Here we are, only 25 miles away from Tsarigrad. Behind our lines, the Ottomans still resist at Odrin, but they are being beseiged by our Second Army and some Serbian divisions. Thus, only the defences of the Çatalca line prevent us from entering in the old capital of the Bizantine Empire.
dst: 我们就在这里，距察里格勒仅25英里。在我们的战线后方，奥斯曼人仍在奥德林顽抗，但他们正被我们的第2集团军和一些塞尔维亚师围攻。因此，只有恰塔勒贾防线的防御工事在阻止我们进入这个拜占庭帝国的旧都。

src: Here we are, ready for our final blow against Solun. If we take the city, it's very likely that France and Britain will grant us acceptable peace terms. Of course, they could send wave after wave of reinforcements until they destroyed us, but the point is that they think that Bulgaria and the Balkans aren't really worth the effort. In a few weeks they'll achieve a total victory in the west against Germany, and they won't be willing to lose more men and resources in what they see as a remote region of Europe. If we press them hard enough, they'll force Serbia and Greece to accept a reasonable armistice.
dst: 我们已就位，准备对萨洛尼卡发起最后一击。如果我们拿下这座城市，法国和英国就很可能给我们开出可接受的和平条件。当然，他们可以一波接一波地派来增援，直到把我们消灭，但关键在于，他们认为保加利亚和巴尔干根本不值得如此大费周章。几周之内，他们将在西线对德国取得全胜，不会愿意在他们眼中的欧洲偏远地区再折损兵力和资源。只要我们逼得足够狠，他们就会迫使塞尔维亚和希腊接受一个合理的停战协定。

src: Here we are, ready for what could be the last offensive of the war. The Germans have opened a gap in the French defences at Saint Mihiel, and right now they're trying to reach the Marne. But we all know that France is a powerful country with many resources. They'll do anything to stop the German advance, and everybody is aware of that. So, naturally, Germany asked us to launch a secondary offensive in the French Mediterranean coast. Our enemies will find difficult to fight on two fronts at the same time.
dst: 我们来了，准备好了迎接可能是这场战争的最后一次攻势。德国人已经在圣米耶勒的法军防线上撕开了一个缺口，眼下他们正试图抵达马恩河。但我们都知道，法国是一个资源雄厚的强国。他们会不惜一切代价阻止德军的推进，这一点人尽皆知。因此，德国很自然地要求我们在法国地中海沿岸发起一场辅助攻势。我们的敌人会发现，同时在两条战线作战是件困难的事。

src: Here we are, south of Trient. Our aim is to break through the Italian lines while the Entente armies are still fighting in Greece, before they can react effectively.
dst: 我们到了，就在特伦托以南。我们的目标是在协约国军队仍在希腊作战、尚未来得及作出有效反应之前，突破意大利的防线。

src: Here's an extra canteen, MAJOR, you will need it.
dst: 这里有个多余的水壶，少校，你会用得上的。

src: Here, in Tientsin, things were pretty bad, too. A couple of days ago the Chinese nearly took the foreign settlements of the city. Even with the combined effort of American, European and Japanese soldiers, we could hardly resist. But now we've decided to counterattack. We're planning an assault inside the walled city of Tientsin. Once we defeat the Chinese army there, the road to Peking will be open.
dst: 在天津这里，情况也相当糟糕。几天前，中国人差一点就攻下了城里的外国租界。即便有美国、欧洲和日本士兵的联合抵抗，我们仍然险些支撑不住。但现在我们决定反攻。我们正计划强攻天津城墙内的城区。一旦击败那里的清军，通往北京的道路就会打开。

src: Here, quickly, comrade!  A squadron of our loyal Cossacks have made a corridor through which we can escape!  Though not mauled, we have suffered a moral defeat from the Polish cavalry.  Worst of all, we have been denied access to the north and our entire front in Poland is rapidly collapsing...
dst: 这边，快，同志！一队我们忠诚的哥萨克已经打开了一条可让我们突围的通道！虽然未被重创，但我们在波兰骑兵面前遭到了一场士气上的失败。最糟糕的是，我们被切断了通往北面的去路，而我们在波兰的整条战线正迅速崩溃……
赫雷尼乌斯·伊特鲁斯库斯
特兰西瓦尼亚，赫尔曼施塔特——1916年9月25日

src: Herr Feldmarschall, I have just received information of the most critical importance.  Intelligence reports indicate that the Americans are building a weapon of terrifying explosive power, which  will be finished by August 1!  It is imperative that we act decisively and conquer England before this weapon is ready.  With England in our hands we can negotiate a reasonable peace with the Americans.
dst: 元帅阁下，我刚刚收到一份极其重要的情报。情报显示，美国人正在制造一种具有可怕爆炸威力的武器，它将在8月1日前完成！我们必须果断行动，在这一武器准备就绪之前征服英格兰。只要英格兰落入我们手中，我们就能与美国人体面地议和。

src: Herr Feldmarschall, I know that you and your men have not had time even to catch a breath, but the situation here is critical. Budapest is besieged by the Bolsheviks. Your troops must force their way into the city. It is doubtful that our Hungarian allies will continue to fight if Budapest falls. If you can drive the Reds into the Danube, we may stop the Russian Bear from consuming us.
dst: 元帅阁下，我知道你和你的部下连喘口气的时间都没有，但此地的局势十分危急。布达佩斯正被布尔什维克围困。你的部队必须强行突入城中。如果布达佩斯陷落，我们的匈牙利盟友是否还会继续作战就值得怀疑了。如果你能把红军赶进多瑙河，我们或许能阻止那头俄罗斯熊吞掉我们。

src: Herr Feldmarschall, although you overran the Oak Ridge facility, the Americans had time to dismantle and move the most critical material. This Atomic Bomb may still a threat to us. We have no choice but to negotiate with the Americans.
dst: 陆军元帅阁下，尽管你攻占了橡树岭设施，美国人却有时间拆走并转移了最关键的材料。这枚原子弹可能仍是我们的威胁。我们别无选择，只能与美国人谈判。

src: Herr Feldmarschall, although you overran the Oak Ridge facility, the Americans had time to dismantle and move the most critical material. This Atomic Bomb may still be a threat to us. We have no choice but to negotiate with the Americans.
dst: 元帅阁下，尽管你攻占了橡树岭设施，美国人仍有时间拆解并运走了最关键的物资。这枚原子弹对我们可能仍是威胁。我们别无选择，只能与美国人谈判。

src: Herr Feldmarschall, as you know, the Boksheviks have refused our peace offers, so as part of our response to their treacherous attack you have been chosen to play a key role in our drive into southern Russia. Our Romanian Allies have rejoined us and will help you to liberate their lost province of Moldavia. The key cities in this province are Kishinev and Iasi. These cities will be your primary objectives.
dst: 元帅阁下，如你所知，布尔什维克已拒绝我们的和平提议，因此作为对其背信弃义进攻的回应之一，你被选中在我们向南俄的进军中扮演关键角色。我们的罗马尼亚盟友已重新加入我们，并将协助你解放他们失去的摩尔达维亚省。该省的关键城市是基什尼奥夫和雅西。这些城市将是你的主要目标。

src: Herr Feldmarschall, due to your unprecedented advance, we will soon see the triumphant finish of our English campaign.  Feldmarschall von Manstein's Army Group North is within 100 kilometers of Glasgow, and .....  excuse me, Herr Feldmarschall .....
dst: 元帅阁下，由于您前所未有的推进，我们即将迎来英格兰战役的胜利终局。曼施坦因元帅的北方集团军群距格拉斯哥已不足100公里，而且……请原谅，元帅阁下……

src: Herr Feldmarschall, due to your unprecedented advance, we will soon see the triumphant finish of our Southern campaign.  Feldmarschall von Manstein's Army Group North is within 100 kilometers of Knoxville, and .....  excuse me, Herr Feldmarschall .....           Herr Feldmarschall, I have just received information of the most critical importance. Less than 20 kilometers north of us, here, is a large facility. Intelligence reports indicate that the Americans are building a weapon of terrifying explosive power there. It is imperative that we act decisively and destroy this facility.
dst: 元帅阁下，由于你前所未有的推进，我们很快将看到南方战役的胜利收官。冯·曼施泰因元帅的北方集团军群已推进至距诺克斯维尔100公里处，而且……恕我打断一下，元帅阁下……元帅阁下，我刚刚收到一份至关重要的情报。就在我们这里以北不到20公里处，有一处大型设施。情报报告显示，美国人正在那里建造一种具有可怕爆炸威力的武器。当务之急是我们必须果断行动，摧毁这处设施。

src: Herr Feldmarschall, due to your unprecedented advance, we will soon see the triumphant finish of our Southern campaign.  Feldmarschall von Manstein's Army Group North is within 100 kilometers of Knoxville, and .....  excuse me, Herr Feldmarschall .....           Herr Feldmarschall, I have just received information of the most critical importance. Less than 20 kilometers north of us, here, is a large facility. Intelligence reports indicate that the Americans have more weapons of terrifying explosive power there. It is imperative that we act decisively and destroy this facility.
dst: 陆军元帅阁下，由于您史无前例的推进，我们南方战役即将迎来凯旋的终章。冯·曼施泰因元帅的北方集团军群已推进到距诺克斯维尔不足100公里处，而……请原谅，元帅阁下……元帅阁下，我刚收到一份至关紧要的情报。就在我们以北不到20公里处，有一座大型设施。情报显示，美国人在那里存有更多威力骇人的爆炸性武器。我们必须果断行动，摧毁这座设施。

src: Herr Feldmarschall, it's been one year after your victory against the United Kingdom. Now it is the time to execute our invasion of North America.
dst: 元帅阁下，距离你战胜英国已过去一年。现在是执行我们入侵北美计划的时候了。

src: Herr Feldmarschall, thank God you are here.  Our situation is critical. Buda-Pest is besieged by the Bolsheviks. Your troops must force their way into the city. It is doubtful that our Hungarian allies will continue to fight if Buda-Pest falls. If you can drive the Reds into the Danube, we may stop the Russian Bear from consuming us.
dst: 元帅阁下，谢天谢地您来了。我们的形势十分危急。布达佩斯已被布尔什维克围困。您的部队必须强行突入城中。布达佩斯一旦陷落，我们的匈牙利盟友是否还会继续作战就很难说了。如果您能把红军赶进多瑙河，我们或许能阻止俄国熊吞掉我们。

src: Herr Feldmarschall, the Americans have successfully evacuated their research site.  This is your failure.  This Atomic Bomb is still a threat to us, and now we are forced to make peace with the Americans on their terms.  You have disgraced the German nation.
dst: 元帅阁下，美国人已成功撤离了他们的研究场址。这是你的过失。这枚原子弹对我们仍是威胁，而现在我们被迫按美国人的条件与他们媾和。你让德意志民族蒙羞。

src: Herr Feldmarschall, the Battle of Berlin was won, The Harz pocket has been annihilated! The Reds retreated eastwards ever since and the enemie's last reserves have been caught in a pocket around Danzig and Hel just like in 1939.
dst: 元帅阁下，柏林战役已经打赢，哈茨包围圈已被全歼！红军此后不断向东撤退，敌人最后的预备队被困在但泽和赫尔周边的包围圈中，就像1939年一样。

src: Herr Feldmarschall, the Bosheviks are retreating everywhere! Feldmarschall Guderian has retaken the Baku oil fields, while Feldmarschall Manstein has surrounded Moscow.  As part of our campaign to keep the Bolsheviks on the run, you are to cross the Don river.
dst: 元帅阁下，布尔什维克正在全线退却！古德里安元帅已夺回巴库油田，曼施坦因元帅则包围了莫斯科。作为我们让布尔什维克持续溃逃的作战的一部分，您要渡过顿河。

src: Herr Feldmarschall, the enemy is making a final attempt to break out of the encirclement in Normandy around the key city of Avranches. Your orders are to move swiftly and prevent this outbreak and force the Allies out of Europe. With Fortress Europe secure, and the Luftwaffe's success in dealing with Allied bombing raids, we will be able to build up our forces to invade England next year.
dst: 元帅阁下，敌人正做最后一次尝试，试图突围出诺曼底以阿夫朗什这座关键城市为中心的包围圈。你的命令是迅速行动，阻止这次突围，并把盟军赶出欧洲。只要欧洲堡垒得以稳固，加上德国空军在应对盟军轰炸空袭方面的成功，我们就能扩充兵力，在明年入侵英国。

src: Herr Feldmarschall, the rear units just came in contact with the enemy chasing group! They nailed Soviets to the ground east from the city, but can't repel them! It looks that we're surrounded from three sides and only the western road remains open!
dst: 陆军元帅先生，后卫部队刚刚与追击的敌军部队接上了火！他们把苏联人钉在了城东，却无法击退他们！看来我们已从三面被围，只有西面的道路还开着！

src: Herr Feldmarschall, the time has come to fight the final battle against the Japanese army. The Japanese will desperately throw their last reserves into battle.
dst: 元帅阁下，与日本军队进行最后决战的时刻到了。日本人将不顾一切地把他们最后的预备队投入战斗。

src: Herr Feldmarschall, this triumph is a fitting end to our Atlantic campaign. Once again your skillful leadership has brought us the victory. The passage into the Pacific Ocean is clear and your troops are about to pass the Panama Canal en route to Hawai'i.
dst: 元帅阁下，这场胜利为我们的“大西洋”战役画上了圆满句号。你再次凭借高超的指挥为我们赢得了胜利。通往太平洋的航道已畅通，你的部队即将经巴拿马运河前往夏威夷。

src: Herr Feldmarschall, this triumph is a fitting end to our British campaign! Once again your brilliant skill has led to victory, and more importantly, you have prevented the Americans from using their "Atomic Bomb" in Europe. With England and Europe in our grasp, we are able to negotiate a peace to our terms. Now we will have the peace necessary to develop the Fatherland to its full potential.
dst: 元帅阁下，这场胜利是我们英国战役的圆满结局！你的卓越才能再次带来了胜利，更重要的是，你阻止了美国人在欧洲使用他们的"原子弹"。英格兰与欧洲已在我们掌控之中，我们得以按自己的条件谈判和平。现在我们终于有了必要的和平，来把祖国发展到其全部潜力。

src: Herr Feldmarschall, this triumph is a fitting end to our English campaign.  Once again your brilliant skill has led to victory, and more importantly, you have prevented the Americans from using their "Atomic Bomb."  With England and Europe in our grasp, we are able to negotiate a peace that will give us the Lebensraum we need in Eastern Europe, while withdrawing from England and France.
dst: 陆军元帅阁下，这场胜利为我们的英格兰战役画上了圆满的句号。你卓越的才能再次带来了胜利，更重要的是，你阻止了美国人使用他们的“原子弹”。随着英格兰和欧洲落入我们手中，我们得以谈判达成一项和平，它将给我们带来在东欧所需的生存空间，同时从英格兰和法国撤军。

src: Herr Feldmarschall, this triumph is a fitting end to our English campaign.  Once again your skill has led to victory, and more importantly, you have prevented the Americans from using their "Atomic Bomb."  With England and Europe in our grasp, we should be able to negotiate a peace that will give us the Lebensraum we need in Eastern Europe, while withdrawing from England and France.
dst: 陆军元帅阁下，这场胜利为我们的英格兰战役画上了圆满的句号。你的才能再次带来了胜利，更重要的是，你阻止了美国人使用他们的“原子弹”。随着英格兰和欧洲落入我们手中，我们应该能够谈判达成一项和平，它将给我们带来在东欧所需的生存空间，同时从英格兰和法国撤军。

src: Herr Feldmarschall, this triumph is a fitting end to our Southern campaign.  Once again your skill has led to victory, and more importantly, you have prevented the Americans from using their "Atomic Bomb."  Their research facility is a gutted ruin.  It is most extraordinary that you were able to capture Knoxville despite this distraction.  We must hope that only one such facility exists.
dst: 元帅阁下，这场大捷为我们的南方战役画上了恰如其分的句号。你的才华再一次带来了胜利，更重要的是，你阻止了美国人使用他们的「原子弹」。他们的研究设施已成一片焦土废墟。即便有这等牵制，你仍能攻占诺克斯维尔，实属非凡。我们只能寄望于这样的设施只有一处。

src: Herr Feldmarschall, this victory is worthy of great praise. The southern front is now secure, and, more importantly, the Ukraine with its rich resources is ours. It is my pleasure to inform you that the Bolshevik's have sued for peace! The independence of Bylorussia and the Ukraine under German protection will stabilize our Eastern borders. Now it only remains to force the Western Allies to the peace table.
dst: 元帅阁下，这场胜利值得高度赞扬。南线现已稳固，更重要的是，拥有丰富资源的乌克兰已归我们所有。我很荣幸地通知你，布尔什维克已经求和！白俄罗斯与乌克兰在德国保护下的独立将稳定我们的东部边界。现在只剩下迫使西方盟国坐到和谈桌前。

src: Herr Feldmarschall, we have a delicate mission for you and your men. You have to gather your navy and paratroopers and send them down to the Lesser Antilles. The UK and France still are in posession of some colonies on the islands. We also expect some enemy naval forces still operating in the area. While the main body of your army is heading towards Panama and the Pacific Ocean you have to overcome any enemy threat in our Caribbean backyard.
dst: 元帅阁下，我们有一项棘手的任务交给您和您的部下。您须集结您的海军和伞兵，派往小安的列斯群岛。英国和法国仍占据着该群岛上的若干殖民地。我们还预计该地区仍有部分敌军海军力量活动。当您的主力部队向巴拿马和太平洋挺进之时，您须扫清我们加勒比后院的任何敌军威胁。

src: Herr Feldmarschall, we met some stiff resistance in the vicinity of Petersburg, Virginia. It seems the US general staff sends their strategic reserves into a decisive battle. Our own reserves will arrive soon. Until then you are on your own. Make your way into the hinterland, secure Petersburg and the bridges, capture the villages in the vicinity of the town and withstand all enemy attacks!
dst: 元帅阁下，我们在弗吉尼亚州彼得斯堡附近遭遇了一些顽强的抵抗。看来美国总参谋部把他们的战略预备队投入了一场决战。我们自己的预备队很快就会到达。在此之前你要靠自己。向内地推进，固守彼得斯堡和那些桥梁，夺取该镇附近的村庄，并抵挡住所有敌军进攻！

src: Herr Feldmarschall, we were victorious in the Battle of Berlin! Unfortunately parts of the southern pincer of the Soviet Army penetrated our defenses south of Berlin and quickly moved deep into central Germany. They are now trapped between the cities of Magdeburg, Braunschweig and Erfurt.
dst: 元帅阁下，我们在柏林战役中取得了胜利！遗憾的是，苏军南翼钳形攻势的部分部队突破了我们柏林以南的防线，并迅速深入德国中部。他们现在被困在马格德堡、布伦瑞克和埃尔福特三座城市之间。

src: Herr Feldmarschall, while our army prepares for an invasion of the USA, we need to seize the Azores Islands. These islands are of strategic importance, especially the island of Terceira with its airfield. This Lajes Air Base has the longest runway in the world and is used by our enemies for trans-atlantic flight and anti submarine operations. The desperate UK persuaded Portugal, citing the Anglo-Portuguese Treaty of 1373, to allow the allies to use the airfield.
dst: 元帅阁下，趁我军准备入侵美国之际，我们需要夺取亚速尔群岛。这些岛屿具有重要的战略意义，尤其是拥有机场的特塞拉岛。这座拉日什空军基地拥有世界上最长的跑道，被我们的敌人用于跨大西洋飞行和反潜作战。走投无路的英国援引1373年的英葡条约，说服葡萄牙允许盟军使用该机场。

src: Herr Feldmarschall, while the situation in central Europe is under control the Soviets are also threatening our ally, Finland. Once again the Reds are attacking Viipuri. The Finnish managed to stop the Bolsheviks at the villages of Tali and Ihantala but the situation is critical!
dst: 元帅阁下，虽然中欧的局势已在掌控之中，但苏联人也在威胁我们的盟国芬兰。赤色分子又一次进攻维普里。芬兰人成功在塔利与伊汉塔拉等村庄挡住了布尔什维克，但局势十分危急！

src: Herr Feldmarschall.  We have obtained an armistice with England and the United States.  Bravo!  But while we were conquering England the Bolsheviks treacherously broke our armistice with them and invaded our allied territories in Eastern Europe.  With the bulk of our forces in England and Afrika the situation is critical. Your forces are the only units standing between them and Berlin. You MUST stop them.
dst: 元帅阁下。我们已与英国和美国达成停战。太好了！但就在我们征服英格兰之际，布尔什维克背信弃义地撕毁与我们之间的停战协定，入侵了我们在东欧的盟国领土。由于我军主力都在英格兰和非洲，形势十分危急。您的部队是挡在他们与柏林之间的唯一力量。您必须阻止他们。

src: Herr Feldmarschall.  We have obtained an armistice with England and the United States.  Bravo!  But while we were conquering England the Bolsheviks treacherously broke our armistice with them and invaded our allied territories in Eastern Europe.  With the bulk of our forces in England and Afrika they have been able to pollute the sacred soil of the Fatherland and penetrate almost to Berlin!  You MUST stop them.
dst: 陆军元帅阁下。我们已与英美达成停战。好样的！但就在我们征服英格兰的同时，布尔什维克背信弃义地撕毁了与我们的停战协定，入侵了我们在东欧的盟友领土。由于我方主力都在英格兰和非洲，他们得以玷污祖国神圣的国土，几乎推进到了柏林城下！你必须阻止他们。

src: Herr Feldmarshall, I am at a loss for words.  Your failure is...  incomprehensible. This debacle will be remembered as one of the worst military disasters of our nation.  It is better for you that you will never return to the fatherland.  Much better.
dst: 元帅阁下，我已无言以对。您的失败……令人无法理解。这场溃败将被记为我国最惨重的军事灾难之一。对您来说，最好永远不要回到祖国。最好如此。

src: Herr Feldmarshall, I am at a loss for words.  Your failure is...  incomprehensible. You have left us no choice but to come to terms with the Americans. This debacle will be remembered as one of the worst military disasters of our nation.  It is better for you that you will never return to the fatherland.  Much better.
dst: 元帅阁下，我无言以对。你的失败是……不可理喻的。你让我们别无选择，只能与美国人达成协议。这场溃败将被铭记为我们民族最惨重的军事灾难之一。对你而言，永远不再回到祖国会更好。好得多。

src: Herr Feldmarshall, I am at a loss for words.  Your failure is... incomprehensible. This debacle will be remembered as one of the worst military disasters of our nation.  It is better for you that you will never return to the Fatherland.  Much better.
dst: 元帅阁下，我无言以对。你的失败是……不可理喻的。这场溃败将被铭记为我们民族最惨重的军事灾难之一。对你而言，永远不再回到祖国会更好。好得多。

src: Herr Feldmarshall, as you know the Kursk Salient poses a serious threat to us. To reduce this salient and restore the integrity of our line, we will attack from the north and south, pocket, and then crush the enemy trapped inside. You and your command will lead the northern thrust of our offensive. You must penetrate as far towards the town of Prokhorovka as possible. Good Luck.
dst: 元帅阁下，如你所知，库尔斯克突出部对我们构成了严重威胁。为消除这一突出部并恢复我战线的完整，我们将自南北两翼进攻，合围，然后粉碎被困之敌。你和你的部队将领导我方攻势的北路突击。你必须尽可能深入，直抵普罗霍罗夫卡镇。祝你好运。

src: Herr Feldmarshall, though your performance has been.....competent, the decision has been made to ... relieve you of command.  The General Staff feels it is best that a more.... seasoned officer replace you.  The great Erich von Manstein will assume your duties.
dst: 陆军元帅阁下，尽管你的表现……还算称职，但已作出决定……解除你的指挥权。总参谋部认为最好由一位更……老练的军官接替你。伟大的埃里希·冯·曼施泰因将接手你的职责。

src: Herr Feldmarshall, we have an excellent opportunity to deliver a crushing blow to the enemy, here, north of Strasbourg. As you can see, the advance of the American Third Army has left this sector of
dst: 元帅阁下，我们有一个绝佳的机会重创敌军，就在斯特拉斯堡以北。如你所见，美国第三集团军的推进使其正面的

src: Herr Feldmarshall, you already know that the enemy has launched an amphibious operation south of Naples, near Salerno. The terrain in this part of Italy is hilly and rugged, and we have been able to contain the enemy beachhead thus far. It is of critical importance that the Americans and British are not allowed to gain a foothold on the continent. We are relying on you and your crack troops to throw the enemy into the sea. Failure here is not an option.
dst: 元帅阁下，你已知道，敌人在那不勒斯以南、萨莱诺附近发动了两栖登陆。意大利这一带地形多山崎岖，而我们至今已能遏制敌人的滩头堡。至关重要的是，决不能让美国人和英国人在欧洲大陆站稳脚跟。我们指望你和你的精锐部队把敌人赶下海。此处失败不在选项之内。
海军中校阁下，你有2个选择。

src: Herr Fregattenkapitan, you know that we have no time at all. We must complete our mission to destroy enemy facilities at Scapa Flow. But General Staff also orders you to destroy the facilities at Wick (north Scotland).
dst: 海军中校阁下，你知道我们完全没有时间。我们必须完成摧毁斯卡帕湾敌方设施的任务。但总参谋部还命令你摧毁威克（苏格兰北部）的设施。

src: Herr General - very strong enemy position - inf. and aty fortresses - you must use the artillery and Flak 88 units and fight through  over hill and enemy bunkers.
dst: 将军阁下——敌军阵地极为坚固，步兵与炮兵要塞——您必须动用炮兵与88毫米高射炮部队，翻越山丘、突破敌军地堡。

src: Herr General OKW have expressed doubts about your abilities in the new type of warfare. Make haste to your next mission!
dst: 将军阁下，最高统帅部对你在这类新型战争中的能力表示怀疑。赶快去执行你的下一个任务！

src: Herr General You have captured most of the area, but the Soviets still hold the oil fields and the mountain passes. The General Staff is not pleased about your lackluster performance! You should take some rest and report to the Fourth Panzer Army headquarters at Kotelnikov!
dst: 将军阁下，你已攻占了大部地区，但苏军仍据守着油田和山口。总参谋部对你平庸的表现感到不满！你应当稍事休息，然后前往科捷利尼科夫的第四装甲集团军司令部报到！

src: Herr General You have captured most of the area, but the Soviets still hold the oil fields and the mountain passes. The General Staff is not pleased with your lackluster performance! You should take some rest and then report to the Fourth Panzer Armee headquarters at Kotelnikov!
dst: 将军阁下，你已攻占了大部地区，但苏军仍据守着油田和山口。总参谋部对你平庸的表现很不满意！你应当稍事休息，然后前往科捷利尼科夫的第四装甲集团军司令部报到！

src: Herr General You have captured most of the area, but the Soviets still hold the oil fields and the mountain passes. You should take some rest and then report to the Fourth Panzer Armee headquarters at Kotelnikov!
dst: 将军阁下，你已攻占了大部地区，但苏军仍据守着油田和山口。你应当稍事休息，然后前往科捷利尼科夫的第四装甲集团军司令部报到！

src: Herr General it is imperative that you secure crossing points on the Chir, Liska, and Don Rivers before the Soviets can bring up their reserves and block our advance. If this can be acheived, then there will be nothing stopping us from extending this drive to include Stalingrad iteslf!
dst: 将军阁下，当务之急是在苏军调来预备队阻滞我们推进之前，夺取奇尔河、利斯卡河和顿河上的渡口。若能达成，便没有什么能阻止我们把这次突击扩大到直取斯大林格勒本身！

src: Herr General von Rundstedt, Admiral Donitz and fieldmarschal Goring,Disembark on English coast and occupy Dover and airport. Weather is good and if to us succeed occupy coast, we can Christmas celebrate in London...
dst: 伦德施泰特将军、邓尼茨海军上将及戈林元帅：在英格兰海岸登陆，占领多佛与机场。天气晴好，若我军成功占据海岸，我们便能在伦敦欢庆圣诞……

src: Herr General we have the opportunity to end victoriously our offensive into the Caucasus. We need to take the city of Grozny and the surrounding oil fields. After that we can pass the winter without serious problems.  The General Staff and General Von Paulus have faith in your leadership!
dst: 将军阁下，我们有机会以胜利结束向高加索的攻势。我们需要夺取格罗兹尼城及其周围的油田。此后我们便能安然过冬，不致遇上严重问题。总参谋部和冯·保卢斯将军都对你的指挥抱有信心！

src: Herr General we must be fast as lightning if we are to smash the French and the BEF.
dst: 将军阁下，要粉碎法国人和英国远征军，我们必须快如闪电。

src: Herr General you have captured most of the city and thrown the Soviet to the Volga in several places, but total victory has eluded you! We cannot afford to give the Soviets the opportunity to recover!
dst: 将军阁下，你已攻占该城大部，并在数处把苏军逼至伏尔加河畔，但彻底的胜利仍与你擦肩而过！我们承受不起给苏军喘息之机的代价！

src: Herr General you have selected the alternative line involving a direct attack by the Sixth and Fourth Panzer armies on the Volga River and Stalingrad.
dst: 将军阁下，你选择了备选路线：由第六集团军和第四装甲集团军直取伏尔加河与斯大林格勒。

src: Herr General you have selected the historic line
dst: 将军阁下，你选择了史实路线

src: Herr General you have the choice of continuing a historic line or moving into an alternative series of three scenarios that can lead to immediate victory. If you want to follow the alternative line go East to Puk'yantsy. If you want to continue with the historic line move South to Svechenko...
dst: 将军阁下，你可以在继续史实路线与转入一条可通向即刻胜利的三场景备选路线之间作出选择。若想走备选路线，就向东前往普基扬齐。若想继续史实路线，就向南前往斯韦琴科……

src: Herr General!  Good work!  The crisis is over, and the Polish Army has collapsed.  Once you led us past the river, nothing could stop our panzers.  Congratulations.
dst: 将军阁下！干得好！危机已经解除，波兰军队已经崩溃。你率我们渡河之后，就再没有什么能阻挡我们的装甲部队了。祝贺你。

src: Herr General!  Very good work!  The crisis is over, and the Polish Army has collapsed.  Once you led us past the river, nothing could stop our panzers.  Congratulations.
dst: 将军阁下！干得非常好！危机已过，波兰军队已经崩溃。你一带我们渡河，就再没什么能挡住我们的装甲部队。恭喜。

src: Herr General! Da die Briten denken das unser Hafen vermint ist, versuchen sie mit starken indischen Reserve-Einheiten auf unseren Stränden rings um Tanga  anzulanden!
dst: 将军先生！由于英国人以为我们的港口布满了水雷，他们正试图用强大的印度预备役部队在坦噶周围的海滩登陆！

src: Herr General! Gerade noch rechtzeitig konnten Sie als Entsatz hierher verschifft werden. Beschützen Sie unsere Siedler und sorgen sie in Deutsch-Ost-Afrika wieder für Ruhe und Ordnung!
dst: 将军阁下！您总算作为援军被及时运到了这里。请保护我们的定居者，让德属东非重新恢复平静与秩序！

src: Herr General! Good work! The Grebbelinie turned out to be defended by ill equiped and badly motivated Dutch troops that were no match for your skills. Utrecht is ready for the capture by 207th ID and SS Regiment Deutschland.
dst: 将军阁下！干得好！事实证明，防守格勒贝防线的是装备低劣、士气低落的荷兰部队，根本不是你的对手。乌得勒支已等着第207步兵师和党卫军“德意志”团来夺取。

src: Herr General! Herr General, the Soviets launched an powerful surprise attack against our troops and our Romanian allies in the Melitopol area. Fast enemy cavalry and tank forces broke through the center of the front and our troops in this sector are in complete shock! The Bolsheviks clearly attempt to cause chaos in the hinterland of the front and will try to cut our supply lines. You and your men must stop the Soviet attack at any cost and punish this bold and desperate move!
dst: 将军阁下！将军阁下，苏联人对我们在梅利托波尔地区的部队和我们罗马尼亚盟友发动了强大的突然袭击。敌军快速骑兵和坦克部队突破了战线中央，我方在该地段的部队陷入全面混乱！布尔什维克显然企图在战线后方制造混乱，并将试图切断我们的补给线。您和您的部下必须不惜一切代价阻止苏军进攻，并惩罚这一大胆而绝望的举动！

src: Herr General! Luckily you came here as our relief. Protect our settlers and ensure again peace and order in German East Africa!
dst: 将军阁下！幸好您作为我们的援军赶到了这里。请保护我们的定居者，让德属东非重新恢复平静与秩序！

src: Herr General,  We start our northern campaign by assaulting the Baltic states. It should be easy to defeat their troops. We have received some strange reports about giant Soviet tanks. Be careful, there may be something after all...
dst: 将军阁下，我们以进攻波罗的海沿岸各国开启北方战役。击败他们的部队应当不难。我们收到了一些关于苏联巨型坦克的离奇报告。务必小心，也许那些传闻并非空穴来风……

src: Herr General,  it is your privilege to lead our attack here, south of Novgorod, in the Russian heartland.  A successful offensive here will sever communications between Moscow and Leningrad and trap several Soviet armies. It is, of course, imperative to take your objectives quickly.
dst: 将军阁下，你荣幸地领导我们在俄国腹地、诺夫哥罗德以南的进攻。此处攻势的成功将切断莫斯科与列宁格勒之间的交通，并困住数个苏军集团军。当然，务必迅速夺取你的目标。

src: Herr General,  it is your privilege to lead our attack here, south of Novgorod, in the Russian heartland.  A successful offensive here will sever communications between Moscow and Leningrad and trap several Soviet armies. It is, of course, imperative to take your objectives quickly.  Our thoughts are with you.
dst: 将军阁下，能在俄国腹地的诺夫哥罗德以南率领此次进攻，是您的殊荣。此处攻势若成，将切断莫斯科与列宁格勒之间的交通，并围困数个苏军集团军。当然，迅速夺取目标势在必行。我们挂念着您。

src: Herr General,  you narrowly accomplished what was expected of you.  Unfortunately, the Soviets held the Volokolamsk Highway long enough for more troops to arrive.  In addition, heavy snows are now falling.  Our offensive cannot continue under these conditions. Herr General, you are not suited to command at this level.  You will report to the officer training school at Metz. There is an opening for a panzer maintenance instructor.
dst: 将军阁下，你只是勉强完成了对你的期望。遗憾的是，苏军守住沃洛科拉姆斯克公路足够久，让更多部队得以抵达。此外，现在正下着大雪。在这种条件下，我们的攻势无法继续。将军阁下，你不适合这一层级的指挥。你将去梅斯的军官学校报到。那里有个装甲维护教官的空缺。

src: Herr General, 80,000 of our troops are cut off and surrounded in the Hungarian capital of Budapest, now 35 miles behind the Soviet front lines! Your division, as well as the Totenkopf and elements of the 23rd and 26th Hungarian divisions, will join Balck's 6th Armee in mounting for a relief effort, codenamed Operation Konrad...
dst: 将军阁下，我军8万人在匈牙利首都布达佩斯被切断并合围，该地现在位于苏军战线后方35英里处！你的师，连同「骷髅」师以及匈牙利第23和第26师的各部队，将加入巴尔克的第六集团军，发起代号「康拉德」的解围行动……

src: Herr General, Armeegruppe Sud is attacking Warsaw. You must occupy the roads and railroads south Warsaw.
dst: 将军阁下，南方集团军群正在进攻华沙。您必须占领华沙以南的公路与铁路。

src: Herr General, Army Command ordered you to execute a raid on Taganrog. The Soviets are still in disarray and with a fast maneuver we will take the enemy by surprise and capture the vital industrial center of Taganrog with ease. Taganrog is also home to the Beriev aircraft works and capturing the Beriev facilities will be a major blow to Soviet aviation.
dst: 将军阁下，集团军司令部命令您对塔甘罗格实施突袭。苏军仍一片混乱，我们只要快速机动就能出其不意，轻松夺取塔甘罗格这一重要的工业中心。塔甘罗格也是别里耶夫飞机厂的所在地，夺取别里耶夫的设施将是对苏联航空业的重大打击。

src: Herr General, Athens is ours! We now have to gain control over all of Attica and the Greek islands. Caution, Italian intelligence reports a strong enemy naval presence in this area!
dst: 将军阁下，雅典已是我们的了！我们现在必须控制整个阿提卡以及希腊诸岛。注意，意大利情报部门报告该地区有强大的敌方海军存在！

src: Herr General, Excellent work!  Von Rundtsedt is most impressed with your Wiking division!
dst: 将军阁下，干得漂亮！冯·伦德施泰特对你的「维京」师印象极佳！

src: Herr General, German field commanders are not allowed to fail. Do you understand?  I have nothing more to say to you.
dst: 将军阁下，德军战地指挥官不允许失败。你明白吗？我对你无话可说了。

src: Herr General, German field commanders are not allowed to fail. Do you understand? I have nothing more to say to you.
dst: 将军阁下，德军战地指挥官不允许失败。你明白吗？我对你无话可说了。
将军阁下，中央集团军群

src: Herr General, Herr General...the situation is critical! Our previous efforts were highly successful and we were able to capture Narvik and the surrounding area. But now Norwegian and French troops are closing in from the north, while Polish forces are about to attack us from the west and south. The British must have landed somehwere too.
dst: 将军阁下，将军阁下……形势危急！我们此前的行动非常成功，夺取了纳尔维克及其周边地区。但如今挪威和法国军队正从北面逼近，波兰军队即将从西面和南面向我们发起进攻。英国人想必也在某处登陆了。

src: Herr General, I am sorry that the sacrifice of your fine troops have been in vain.  You have been ordered to Berlin.  I do not envy your reception there.
dst: 将军阁下，我很遗憾，你精锐部队的牺牲都白费了。你已被命令前往柏林。你在那里将受到的接待，我可一点也不羡慕。

src: Herr General, I am sorry that the sacrifices of your fine troops have been in vain. Italy has  capitulated to the Allies, and we must fall back quickly or face annihilation. You have been ordered to Berlin. I do not envy your reception there.
dst: 将军阁下，我很遗憾，你精锐部队的牺牲都白费了。意大利已向盟军投降，我们必须迅速后撤，否则将面临被歼灭。你已被命令前往柏林。你在那里将受到的接待，我可一点也不羡慕。

src: Herr General, I know that you and your men have not had time even to catch a breath, but the situation here is critical. Buda-Pest is besieged by the Bolsheviks. Your troops must force their way into the city. It is doubtful that our Hungarian allies will continue to fight if Buda-Pest falls. If you can drive the Reds into the Danube, we may stop the Russian Bear from consuming us.
dst: 将军阁下，我知道你和你的部下连喘口气的时间都没有，但此地局势十分危急。布达佩斯正被布尔什维克围困。你的部队必须强行突入城内。如果布达佩斯陷落，我们的匈牙利盟友是否还会继续作战就很值得怀疑了。如果你能把赤色分子赶进多瑙河，我们或许还能阻止那头俄国熊把我们吞掉。

src: Herr General, I know that you and your men have not had time even to catch a breath, but the situation here is critical. Buda-Pest is besieged by the Bolsheviks. Your troops must force their way into the outer defences of the city and reinforce them sufficiently to prevent the fall of Buda-Pest. It is doubtful that our Hungarian allies will continue to fight if we lose Buda-Pest to the Russain Bear.
dst: 将军阁下，我知道你和你的部下连喘口气的时间都没有，但此地的局势已到危急关头。布达佩斯被布尔什维克围困。你的部队必须强行突入该城的外围防御，并予以充分加强，以阻止布达佩斯陷落。如果我们把布达佩斯丢给俄国熊，我们的匈牙利盟友是否会继续作战，就很值得怀疑了。

src: Herr General, I must congratulate you on this brilliant success. Gibraltar is ours.  Of course, our ally Spain will be given nominal soverignty over Gibraltar, but it will serve us as our base.  You handled this difficult assignment well.  After some well-earned rest and recuperation you and your men will undoubtedly be called upon to play a key role in our 1941 spring campaign.
dst: 将军阁下，我必须祝贺您取得这一辉煌成功。直布罗陀属于我们了。当然，我们的盟友西班牙将被授予对直布罗陀的名义主权，但它将作为我们的基地供我们使用。您出色地完成了这项艰巨任务。经过一段应得的休整之后，您和您的部下无疑将被召去在我们1941年春季攻势中发挥关键作用。

src: Herr General, I must congratulate you on this resounding success.  British and Commonwealth forces have surrendered, and Greek resistance has collapsed.  You handled this difficult assignment with great skill and intelligence.  You will be, no doubt, honored when you return to the fatherland.
dst: 将军阁下，我必须为这次响彻四方的成功向你祝贺。英军和英联邦部队已经投降，希腊的抵抗也已瓦解。你以高超的技艺和智慧完成了这项艰巨的任务。当你回到祖国时，无疑将受到表彰。

src: Herr General, Kishinev is secure. German and Romanian troops are occupying the Ukraine.  This victory is worthy of great praise.  Soon, you will be needed at Army Group North. I am sure that you will do very well.
dst: 将军阁下，基希讷乌已确保。德罗部队正在占领乌克兰。这场胜利值得大力褒奖。不久你将需前往北方集团军群。我相信你定会表现优异。

src: Herr General, Kishinev is secure. German and Romanian troops are occupying the Ukraine.  This victory is worthy of great praise.  The Bolshevik's have sued for peace!  The independence of Bylorussian and the Ukraine under German protection will stabilize our Eastern borders.  Now it only remains to force the Western Allies to the peace table.
dst: 将军阁下，基希讷乌已告稳固。德国和罗马尼亚军队正在占领乌克兰。这场胜利值得高度赞扬。布尔什维克已经求和！白俄罗斯和乌克兰在德国保护下的独立将稳固我方东部边境。现在只剩下迫使西方盟国坐到谈判桌前。

src: Herr General, Kishinev is secure. German and Romanian troops are occupying the Ukraine.  This victory is worthy of great praise. Soon, you will be needed at Army Group North.
dst: 将军阁下，基希讷乌已确保。德罗部队正在占领乌克兰。这场胜利值得大力褒奖。不久你将需前往北方集团军群。

src: Herr General, Kishinev is secure. German and Romanian troops are occupying the Ukraine. This victory is worthy of great praise. Soon, you will be needed elsewhere.
dst: 将军阁下，基希讷乌已经稳固。德军和罗马尼亚部队正在占领乌克兰。这场胜利值得大加赞扬。很快，别处就需要你了。

src: Herr General, Operation Citadel has been successful so far. Our spearheads are now past Prokhorovka and continue our speedy advance trough the endless Russian Steppe.
dst: 将军阁下，迄今为止"堡垒行动"进展顺利。我们的先头部队现已越过普罗霍罗夫卡，继续在无边无际的俄罗斯草原上快速推进。

src: Herr General, Our situation in Hungary is rapidly becoming critical!: Operation Fruhlingserwachen has stalled, Soviet efforts at outflanking our advanced forces have intensified, and the latest intelligence indicates the Soviets are planning a massive counter-offensive! So, Herr General, in this situation, the only orders are: Use your best battlefield judgement!
dst: 将军阁下，我们在匈牙利的局势正迅速变得危急！：「春季觉醒」行动已经停滞，苏军包抄我方前出部队的努力正在加强，最新情报显示苏军正在策划一场大规模反攻！所以，将军阁下，在此局面下唯一的命令就是：运用你在战场上最佳的判断力！

src: Herr General, The 50st Red army is defending the Bryansk area.You must attack the  Bryansk and Orel city area and break down the resistance of the soviet army - especially tank brigades and strong artillery batteries.
dst: 将军阁下，第50集团军（红军）正防守布良斯克地域。您必须进攻布良斯克与奥廖尔城区，粉碎苏军抵抗——尤其是坦克旅与重炮兵连。

src: Herr General, Volpino is part of Leningrad. There are also many industrial factories working for the war effort. Take it and the city will fall!
dst: 将军阁下，沃尔皮诺是列宁格勒的一部分，此地亦有众多军工工厂。拿下它，列宁格勒便指日可下！

src: Herr General, You defeated the Tank Armies that formed the last Russian reserves in this sector. If it wasn't for Hitler, we could drive on to Kursk and accomplish all of our goals.
dst: 将军阁下，你击败了构成俄国人在此段最后预备队的各坦克集团军。若不是希特勒，我们本可继续向库尔斯克推进，完成所有目标。

src: Herr General, You failed to defeat the Tank Armies that formed the last Russian reserves in this sector.
dst: 将军阁下，你未能击败构成俄国人在此段最后预备队的各坦克集团军。

src: Herr General, Zviagel is secure. German and Romanian troops are occupying the Stalin line. This victory is worthy of great praise. Soon, you will be needed further South.
dst: 将军阁下，兹维亚格尔已经稳固。德军和罗马尼亚部队正在占领斯大林防线。这场胜利值得大加赞扬。很快，更南面的地方就需要你了。

src: Herr General, after capturing Kishinev all of Bessarabia, Northern Bukovina and Hertza are liberated from the Soviets. Your troops are now ordered to close in on Odessa. The soviet 9th army is retreating further east and the units who are ordered to defend Odessa now are under command of the so called Separate Coastal Army.
dst: 将军阁下，攻占基什尼奥夫之后，整个比萨拉比亚、北布科维纳与赫尔察地区都已从苏联人手中解放。你的部队现在奉命逼近敖德萨。苏联第9集团军正向东进一步撤退，而奉命防守敖德萨的部队现由所谓的独立滨海集团军指挥。

src: Herr General, after our recent success in Tunisia, we are now able to proceed eastwards along the coast and conquer the terrain we had lost. This time the enemy won't be able to stop us! Alexandria is the main objective in this operation. Our first step en route to Alexandria is the fortress of Tobruk! Leave now, start the engines!
dst: 将军阁下，在突尼斯取得近期胜利之后，我们现在能够沿海岸向东推进，并征服我们曾失去的地域。这一次敌人无法阻止我们！亚历山大是这次行动的主要目标。我们通往亚历山大的第一步就是托布鲁克要塞！立刻出发，发动引擎！

src: Herr General, after our success at Stalingrad it is time to launch our attack on the Caucasus. We need to seize the oil fields of Maikop, Grozny and Baku to supply our industry. In the first phase of our offensive you will capture the entire Taman Peninsula and the ports of Anapa and Novorossiysk. Codename: Operation Blücher.
dst: 将军阁下，继斯大林格勒的胜利之后，是时候发起我们对高加索的进攻了。我们需要夺取迈科普、格罗兹尼和巴库的油田，以供给我们的工业。在攻势的第一阶段，你将夺取整个塔曼半岛以及阿纳帕和新罗西斯克两港。代号：“布吕歇尔”行动。

src: Herr General, after our successful campaign in Poland your troops are being transfered to their garrisons. Please sit down and take a look at these documents and photos. The Army HQ wants you to choose one of these units for your core army. These units are made up of captured Polish equipment, that otherwise would not be available to your forces.
dst: 将军阁下，我们在波兰的战役取得成功之后，你的部队正被调回各自的驻地。请坐下看看这些文件与照片。陆军总司令部希望你为你的核心部队从中挑选一支部队。这些部队由缴获的波兰装备编成，否则这些装备是不会配属给你部队的。

src: Herr General, after the Kerch Peninsula is in our hands you have to turn against Sevastopol now. You will field the worlds biggest artillery piece against the worlds biggest fortress! The time has come to tear down the bunkers and fortifications of Sevastopol and capture the city.
dst: 将军阁下，刻赤半岛已落入我们手中，现在你必须转而进攻塞瓦斯托波尔。你将用世界上最大的火炮对抗世界上最大的要塞！时候到了，拆毁塞瓦斯托波尔的碉堡与工事，夺取这座城市。

src: Herr General, after your splendid success in North Africa, your units are transfered back to the eastern front and, after some holidays in the "Heimat", are ordered to the Kursk front as army reserve.
dst: 将军阁下，您在北非取得辉煌胜利之后，您的部队被调回东线，在“祖国”休假一段时间后，奉命开赴库尔斯克前线担任集团军预备队。

src: Herr General, although your performance was Excellent, and the Soviets have been driven back from the Valki sector, unfortunately they have made progress in other areas and have wrestled back Kharkov from us. Your men are again being pulled back out of the line, this time to be restructured as a panzer division!  Also, the 5th SS-Freiwilligen-Sturmbrigade Wallonien is being attached to your division to further bolster your strength..
dst: 将军阁下，尽管你的表现优异，苏军也被逐离瓦尔基地段，但遗憾的是他们在其他地区取得了进展，并从我们手中夺回了哈尔科夫。你的人马再度被撤出战线，这一次是要改编为一个装甲师！此外，党卫军第5「瓦隆」志愿突击旅将配属给你的师，以进一步增强你的实力..

src: Herr General, although your performance was Good, and the Soviets have been driven back from the Valki sector, unfortunately they have made progress in other areas and have wrestled back Kharkov from us. Your men are again being pulled back out of the line, this time to be restructured as a panzer division!  Also, the 5th SS-Freiwilligen-Sturmbrigade Wallonien is being attached to your division to further bolster your strength..
dst: 将军阁下，尽管你的表现良好，苏军也被逐离瓦尔基地段，但遗憾的是他们在其他地区取得了进展，并从我们手中夺回了哈尔科夫。你的人马再度被撤出战线，这一次是要改编为一个装甲师！此外，党卫军第5「瓦隆」志愿突击旅将配属给你的师，以进一步增强你的实力..

src: Herr General, although your performance was satisfactory, and the Soviets have been driven back from the Valki sector, unfortunately they have made progress in other areas and have wrestled back Kharkov from us. Your men are again being pulled back out of the line, this time to be restructured as a panzer division! Also, the 5th SS-Freiwilligen-Sturmbrigade Wallonien is being attached to your division to further bolster your strength...
dst: 将军阁下，尽管你的表现差强人意，苏军也被逐离瓦尔基地段，但遗憾的是他们在其他地区取得了进展，并从我们手中夺回了哈尔科夫。你的人马再度被撤出战线，这一次是要改编为一个装甲师！此外，党卫军第5「瓦隆」志愿突击旅将配属给你的师，以进一步增强你的实力...

src: Herr General, another pincer movement has been a fantastic success.
dst: 将军阁下，又一次钳形攻势取得了辉煌的成功。

src: Herr General, as you are aware the USA troops are attacking Berlin. Their massive bombing raids are making it difficult to defend the city. They must not take all the bridges into Berlin. The only troops we have defending the city are old men. You must attack their troops and push them clear of the city. If you can do this we may be able to negotiate a ceasefire.
dst: 将军阁下，如你所知，美军正在进攻柏林。他们的大规模轰炸使守城越发艰难。绝不能让他们夺取通往柏林的全部桥梁。我们守城的部队只剩老人。你必须进攻敌军，把他们逐出城市。若能如此，我们或许能谈判停火。

src: Herr General, as you know the Allies landed in Northwest Africa in November and have been been driving east ever since. It is imperative not only that their drive be stopped, but that they be thrown out of Tunesia! We thought to assign this task to Feldmarschall Rommel, but Feldmarschalls Kesselring and Manstein have argued that he is needed to continue the drive on Egypt. We have therefore given you this critical assigment. Herr General, do not disappoint.
dst: 将军阁下，如你所知，盟军于11月在西北非登陆，此后便一路向东推进。不仅必须阻止他们的推进，还必须把他们赶出突尼斯！我们本想将此项任务交给隆美尔元帅，但凯塞林元帅和曼施坦因元帅认为他需要继续指挥向埃及的推进。因此我们将这一关键任务交给了你。将军阁下，请不要让我们失望。

It is imperative not only that their drive be stopped, but that they be thrown out of Tunesia!  We thought to assign this task to Feldmarschall Rommel, but Feldmarschalls Kesselring and Manstein have argued that he is needed to continue the drive on the Suez Kanel.  We have therefore given you this critical assigment.  Herr General, do not disappoint.

src: Herr General, as you know the Americans landed in Northwest Afrika in November.  While Feldmarschall Rommell executed a fighting withdrawal against the British, though outnumbered 10 to 1, the American drive from the west has had little resistance.  It is imperative that the Allied drives be stopped. You must help Feldmarschall Rommel defeat the Allies.
dst: 将军阁下，如你所知，美军于十一月在北非登陆。隆美尔陆军元帅虽以1比10的劣势兵力对英军实施了且战且退，但美军自西面的推进却几乎未遇抵抗。当务之急是阻止盟军的推进。你必须协助隆美尔陆军元帅击败盟军。

src: Herr General, as you know the Americans landed in Northwest Afrika in November.  While Feldmarschall Rommell executed a fighting withdrawal against the British, though outnumbered 10 to 1, the American drive from the west has met with little resistance.  It is imperative that the Allied drive be stopped. You must help Feldmarschall Rommel defeat the Allies. In addition iyou have to take full responsibility for the survival of the Freldmarschall.
dst: 将军阁下，如你所知，美国人于11月在西北非登陆。隆美尔元帅虽以1比10的劣势兵力对英军实施且战且退，美军自西面的推进却几乎未遇抵抗。当务之急是挡住盟军的推进。你必须协助隆美尔元帅击败盟军。此外，你必须对元帅的人身安全负全责。

src: Herr General, as you know the Kursk Salient poses a serious threat to us. The enemy is counterattacking and our only hope to seal the break in the lines is your Kampfgruppe. You must stop the Soviet counterattack immediately. Good Luck.
dst: 将军阁下，如您所知，库尔斯克突出部对我们构成严重威胁。敌人正在反攻，我们堵住战线缺口的唯一希望就是您的战斗群。您必须立即阻止苏军反攻。祝好运。

src: Herr General, as you know the Kursk Salient poses a serious threat to us. To reduce this salient and restore the integrity of our line, we will attack from the north and south, pocket, and then crush the enemy trapped inside. You and your command will lead the northern thrust of our offensive.
dst: 将军阁下，如你所知，库尔斯克突出部对我构成严重威胁。为削平该突出部、恢复战线完整，我们将从南北两面进攻，形成合围，然后粉碎被困其中的敌军。你和你的指挥部将领导我军攻势的北面突击。

src: Herr General, as you know the Kursk Salient poses a serious threat to us. To reduce this salient and restore the integrity of our line, we will attack from the north and south, pocket, and then crush the enemy trapped inside. You and your command will lead the northern thrust of our offensive. You must penetrate as far as the town of Prokhorovka. Good Luck.
dst: 将军阁下，如你所知，库尔斯克突出部对我们构成严重威胁。为削平这个突出部、恢复我军战线的完整，我们将从南北两翼进攻，合围，然后歼灭被困之敌。你和你的指挥部将领导我军攻势的北翼。你必须推进到普罗霍罗夫卡镇。祝你好运。

src: Herr General, as you know, Germany has declared war on the Soviet Union.  You have been chosen to play a key role in our drive into southern Russia. You will assist our Romanian Allies in their attempt to reclaim their lost province of Moldavia. The key city in this province is Kishinev, and it is also your primary objective.  Not only is this assignment strategically important, it is politically critical.  The world is watching, Herr General, do not disappoint.
dst: 将军阁下，如你所知，德国已对苏联宣战。你被选中在我们向俄国南部的进军中发挥关键作用。你将协助我们的罗马尼亚盟友，设法收复他们失去的摩尔达维亚省。这个省的关键城市是基什尼奥夫，它也是你的首要目标。这项任务不仅在战略上重要，在政治上同样至关重要。全世界都在注视，将军阁下，不要让我们失望。
