src: Herr General, as you know, the Allies are pushing inland from St. Lo in an attempt to break out from their beachhead in Normandy.  Your assignment is to stop this assault, then counterattack and force them back on Cherbourgh.  Success here is critical, as an Allied breakout could threaten the Reich!
dst: 将军阁下，如您所知，盟军正从圣洛向内陆推进，试图从他们在诺曼底的登陆场突围。您的任务是阻止这次进攻，然后实施反击，把他们压回瑟堡。此处的成功至关重要，因为盟军一旦突围，就可能威胁到帝国！

src: Herr General, as you know, the Allies are pushing inland from St. Lo in an attempt to break out from their beachhead in Normandy. Your assignment is to stop this assault, then counterattack and force them back on Cherbourgh. Success here is critical, as an Allied breakout could threaten the Reich!
dst: 将军阁下，如你所知，盟军正从圣洛向内陆推进，试图从诺曼底登陆场突围。你的任务是阻止这次攻势，随后反击并将他们逼回瑟堡。此战的成败至关重要，因为盟军一旦突围，就可能威胁到帝国！

src: Herr General, as you know, the Boksheviks have refused our peace offers, so as part of our
dst: 将军阁下，如你所知，布尔什维克拒绝了我方的和平提议，因此作为我们

src: Herr General, as you know, we were unable to fight our way past Malgobek to the main prize of Grozny, and instead, we switched the direction of our advance to come at it from the south. Now, on the outskirts of Ordzhonikidze, our spearhead has been snipped off. Your task is to make secure the area around the city of Gizel, while reinforcing the Corridor , thus temporarily preserving a path to allow 13th Panzer division to disengage its units and withdraw before they are completely encircled. Good luck, Herr General....
dst: 将军阁下，如你所知，我们未能经由马尔戈别克打到主要目标格罗兹尼，于是改换了推进方向，改从南面逼近。如今在奥尔忠尼启则郊外，我们的前锋已被切断。你的任务是确保吉泽尔城周围的地区，同时加强那条走廊，从而暂时保住一条通路，让第13装甲师得以脱离其部队并在被彻底合围之前撤出。祝你好运，将军阁下....

src: Herr General, because of your performance, we  now have to withdraw before the whole southern front is encircled. It is the end for our comrades in the Sixth Armee, and also for your career in the Wehrmacht! Dismissed
dst: 将军阁下，由于你的表现，我们现在不得不在整个南翼被合围之前撤退。这对我们在第六集团军的同志们是末日，对你国防军的生涯也是末日！你被解职了

src: Herr General, before we launch our 1942 spring offensive on Stalingrad, Moscow and the Caucasian oil fields, we need to capture whole Crimea, where the Kerch Peninsula and Sevastopol are still Red Army strongholds. Your first operation will focus on Kerch where the Soviets have entrenched at the neck of the peninsula. You have to break through the enemy defensive line, proceed eastwards and drive the enemy back into the sea. Once the peninsula is in our hands we will be able to operate on Sevastopol with all our forces.
dst: 将军阁下，在我们发起1942年针对斯大林格勒、莫斯科和高加索油田的春季攻势之前，我们需要夺取整个克里米亚，那里的刻赤半岛和塞瓦斯托波尔仍是红军据点。你的首次行动将聚焦于刻赤，苏军已在该半岛颈部构筑工事。你必须突破敌军防线，向东推进，把敌军赶入大海。一旦半岛落入我们手中，我们就能以全部兵力进攻塞瓦斯托波尔。

src: Herr General, cross river Somma, occupy Amiens and push back the BEF.
dst: 将军阁下，渡过索姆河，占领亚眠，击退英国远征军（BEF）。

src: Herr General, despite fierce enemy resistance, you have managed to open the road to Grozny. Preparations are now underway for the final assault...
dst: 将军阁下，尽管敌军抵抗顽强，你已成功打开通往格罗兹尼的道路。最后突击的准备工作正在进行……

src: Herr General, despite your success in the Serafimovich area the Soviet were able to launch successful attacks from their Don bridgehead at Kremenskaya northwest of Stalingrad and in the southeast of Stalingrad.
dst: 将军阁下，尽管你在谢拉菲莫维奇地区取得了胜利，苏军仍得以从斯大林格勒西北的克列缅斯卡亚顿河桥头堡以及斯大林格勒东南方向发起成功的进攻。

src: Herr General, diplomatic representatives of Germany and the Soviet Union are meeting even as we speak... Your string of victories here, and in the west, are unparalleled.... You are to return home to a grateful nation.
dst: 将军阁下，德国与苏联的外交代表此刻正在会谈……你在此地以及在西线取得的一连串胜利都是前所未有的......你将返回祖国，接受一个感恩的国家的欢迎。

src: Herr General, diplomatic representatives of Germany and the Soviet Union are meeting even as we speak..., although our bargaining position is not as strong as it could have been, nevertheless,  our defensive positions around Buda-Pest have been reinforced sufficiently to stave off a disaster.
dst: 将军阁下，德国与苏联的外交代表此刻正在会谈……，尽管我们的谈判筹码不如本来可以有的那么强，但我们围绕布达佩斯的防御阵地已得到充分加强，足以避免一场灾难。

src: Herr General, following our defeat at Stalingrad, the Soviets have also taken Kharkov from us! This cannot stand. Feldmarschall von Manstein, our  new commander of Army Group South, has ordered your move to take part in his attempt at recapturing Kharkov. Show Ivan that we are far from finished!
dst: 将军阁下，继我们在斯大林格勒战败之后，苏军又从我们手中夺走了哈尔科夫！这不能容忍。我们南方集团军群的新任司令冯·曼施泰因元帅已下令调你参加他收复哈尔科夫的尝试。让伊万看看我们远未完蛋！

src: Herr General, free all the Main Cities around the Neckar and take you radvance to the important City of Freiburg.
dst: 将军阁下，解放内卡河周边的所有主要城市，然后向重镇弗赖堡推进。

src: Herr General, it appears you are brilliant!  You have established a base in Canada for our armies. I hope you did not suffer to many casualties on your fine troops?
dst: 将军阁下，看来你真是才华横溢！你已为我们的军队在加拿大建立了基地。希望你的精锐部队没有遭受太多伤亡？

src: Herr General, it does not look good. Your forces were unable to establish a base for our troops to land. I hope your losses were not to great to continue? Were the naval guns and radar to effective?
dst: 将军阁下，情况不妙。你的部队未能为我军登陆建立基地。希望你的损失不至于大到无法继续？是舰炮和雷达太厉害了吗？

src: Herr General, it is time for the last battle. Your troops have taken positions along the Oder. In this scenario you have several missions.
dst: 将军阁下，最后一战的时候到了。你的部队已在奥得河一线占领阵地。本次场景中你有若干项任务。

src: Herr General, it is time to take the German East Africa territories back, which we lost to the Brits in the Great War!
dst: 将军阁下，是时候夺回我们在大战中失去的德属东非领地了！

src: Herr General, it is your privilege to lead our attack here, on the Dnepr River, in the Ukranian heartland. A successful offensive here will sever communications between Kiev and Rostov and trap several Soviet armies. It is, of course, imperative to take your objectives quickly. Our thoughts are with you.
dst: 将军阁下，能由您在此地——乌克兰腹地的第聂伯河一线——指挥进攻，是您的荣耀。此役若成，将切断基辅与罗斯托夫之间的联系，并围歼苏军数个集团军。当然，您必须迅速夺取目标。我们与您同在。

src: Herr General, it is your privilege to lead our attack here, south of Novgorod, in the Russian heartland. A successful offensive here will sever communications between Moscow and Leningrad and trap several Soviet armies. It is, of course, imperative to take your objectives quickly. Our thoughts are with you.
dst: 将军阁下，你有幸在此地——俄罗斯腹地的诺夫哥罗德以南——指挥我们的进攻。在此地成功发起攻势将切断莫斯科与列宁格勒之间的交通，并困住数个苏联集团军。当然，迅速夺取目标至关重要。我们与你同在。

src: Herr General, it may have been to your advantage to have remained in captivity. This failure was completely unexpected from an officer of your caliber and experience. Your services will no longer be required!
dst: 将军阁下，也许一直待在战俘营对你更有利。以你的才干和资历，这次失败完全出乎意料。我们不再需要你的效劳了！

src: Herr General, many enemies in every direction.....
dst: 将军先生，四面八方都是敌人……

src: Herr General, maybe we'll see in France the next time...
dst: 将军先生，也许下次我们会在法国相见……

src: Herr General, meanwhile our armies have arrived Poland. You should take Krakow, west of you which is hold by the 4th Tank Army.
dst: 将军阁下，与此同时我军已抵达波兰。你应夺取位于你西面的克拉科夫，该城由第4坦克集团军据守。

src: Herr General, meteorologists say that the snowfall won't cease not even after the New Year.
dst: 将军先生，气象学家说，这场雪恐怕到新年后都不会停。

src: Herr General, most of Belgium and northern France is in our hands. The enemy still holds a small corridor along the sea. Before we can advance deeper into France we need to clear the enemy resistance at the coast.
dst: 将军阁下，比利时大部分地区和法国北部已在我们手中。敌人仍沿海岸占据一条狭长走廊。在我们向法国纵深推进之前，需要肃清海岸的敌军抵抗。

src: Herr General, not bad for the most decorated soldier in the Wehrmacht. We've driven the Soviets across Perekop and into the Crimea. Now we have to exploit your accomplishments!
dst: 将军阁下，对国防军中勋章最多的军人来说，这成绩不算差。我们已把苏军赶过彼列科普，逼入克里米亚。现在我们要扩大你的战果！

src: Herr General, once again you and your courageous men have kept us from the brink of disaster. Italy remains firmly in our camp, and the invaders have been forced out of Salerno. The Fatherland owes you a great debt.
dst: 将军阁下，你和你的勇士们再一次使我们免于坠入灾难的边缘。意大利仍牢牢留在我们阵营，入侵者已被逐出萨莱诺。祖国欠你一份厚重的恩情。

src: Herr General, once again you and your courageous men have kept us from the brink of disaster. The invaders have been forced out of Salerno. The Fatherland owes you a great debt.
dst: 将军阁下，你和你英勇的部队再一次把我们从灾难边缘拉了回来。入侵者已被赶出萨莱诺。祖国欠你一份大恩。

src: Herr General, or better ex-General: You have disappointed us! Your failure is incomprehensible! You have dishonored our flag! Prepare to take your new post as a frontline soldier!
dst: 将军阁下，或者更确切地说，前将军：你让我们失望了！你的失败不可理喻！你玷污了我们的旗帜！准备去赴任你的新岗位吧——一名前线士兵！

src: Herr General, our Finnish allies wish to reclaim the territory they lost to the Bolsheviks in 1940. You and your brave men will assist them in this, thus preparing the way for the seizure of Leningrad.
dst: 将军阁下，我们的芬兰盟友希望收复他们1940年被布尔什维克夺去的领土。你和你的勇士们将协助他们，从而为夺取列宁格勒铺平道路。

src: Herr General, our Panzers broke through the enemy lines and are already northeast of Nikolaev. The Soviets destroyed all bridges and a large force gathered in the city.
dst: 将军阁下，我们的装甲部队突破了敌军防线，目前已在尼古拉耶夫东北方。苏联人炸毁了所有桥梁，大批部队集结于城中。

src: Herr General, our advance towards Kiev must continue! But first, we must clear the area around Zhitomir. Push on and capture all objectives...
dst: 将军阁下，我们向基辅的推进必须继续！但首先，我们必须肃清日托米尔周围地区。继续推进，夺取所有目标……

src: Herr General, our drive into the south-east continues! You are now charged with establishing bridgeheads at  Kremencuk and  Dniepropetrovsk on the Dniepr river....
dst: 将军阁下，我们向东南的推进仍在继续！现在的任务是在第聂伯河上的克列缅丘格和第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克建立桥头堡....

src: Herr General, our drive on Moscow has been quite successful, but enemy resistance continues to stiffen.  You must break through along the Volokolamsk Highway.   There is no doubt; the enemy will commit his toughest units to defend the capital, but we will persevere.
dst: 将军阁下，我们对莫斯科的推进相当顺利，但敌军抵抗日益顽强。您必须沿沃洛科拉姆斯克公路实施突破。毫无疑问，敌人必将投入其最精锐的部队保卫首都，但我们定能坚持到底。

src: Herr General, our drive on Moscow has been quite successful, but enemy resistance continues to stiffen. You must break through along the highway in the Viazma area. There is no doubt; the enemy will commit his toughest units to defend the capital, but we will persevere.
dst: 将军阁下，我们向莫斯科的进军相当成功，但敌人的抵抗仍在不断加强。你必须在维亚济马地区沿公路突破。毫无疑问，敌人会投入其最顽强的部队来保卫首都，但我们将坚持到底。

src: Herr General, our drive to Moscow has been quite successful, but enemy resistance continues to stiffen. You have been assigned with the task to capture the important river crossings along the Dniepr close to Smolensk. In doing so we might be able to surround and defeat a number of Soviet armies. However, our intelligence report that most of the bridges have been destroyed by the Soviets, and there are also troop movements that indicate that the enemy is trying to escape the encirclement by attacking our forces around Tolochin. Good luck, Herr General.
dst: 将军阁下，我们向莫斯科的推进相当成功，但敌人的抵抗正持续加强。你受领的任务是夺取斯摩棱斯克附近第聂伯河上的重要渡口。如此，我们或许能够合围并击败苏联的若干集团军。然而，我方情报报告，大部分桥梁已被苏军炸毁，同时有部队调动显示，敌人正试图通过进攻我们在托洛钦周围的部队来突围。祝你好运，将军阁下。

src: Herr General, our drive to Moscow has been quite successful, but enemy resistance continues to stiffen. You must break through towards Smolensk. There is no doubt that the enemy will commit his best units to defend the capital, but we will persevere.
dst: 将军阁下，我们向莫斯科的推进相当成功，但敌人的抵抗正持续加强。你必须向斯摩棱斯克方向突破。毫无疑问，敌人会投入其最精锐的部队来保卫首都，但我们会坚持到底。

src: Herr General, our goal is to seize Stalingrad as a base which will allow us to turn either north towards Moscow or south towards the Caucasian oil fields. With Stalingrad in our hands we will be able to massively cut down enemy supplies via rail and river. You have been chosen to lead our initial drive towards Stalingrad.
dst: 将军阁下，我们的目标是夺取斯大林格勒作为基地，这将使我们能够向北转向莫斯科，或向南转向高加索油田。斯大林格勒一旦到手，我们就能通过铁路和水路大幅削减敌军补给。你已被选中率领我们向斯大林格勒的初期推进。

src: Herr General, our situation is even worse than we expected. The oasis is occupied by the Commonwealth forces. Oberst says that there are at least two or three infatry battalions spread across the whole area, road and pathways are blocked with static defense and MGs, deeper in the camp there are artillery batteries under cover of autocannons.
dst: 将军先生，我们的处境比预想的还要糟。绿洲被英联邦部队占据。上校说，至少有二到三个步兵营散布在整个地区，道路和小径被静态防御和机枪封锁，营地深处还有炮兵连，并有高射炮掩护。

src: Herr General, our troops are approaching the Polish capital, Warsaw, from northern, western and southern directions. The enemy will soon be encircled. Prepare for heavy street fighting.
dst: 将军阁下，我方部队正从北面、西面和南面逼近波兰首都华沙。敌人很快将被包围。为激烈的巷战做好准备。

src: Herr General, out intelligence report that the enemy are massing troops in the Leningrad area. The General Staff suspect that they soon will be trying to breakout. Your kampfgruppe is our only hope to stop this attack. Please make haste.
dst: 将军阁下，我方情报报告，敌人正在列宁格勒地区集结部队。总参谋部怀疑他们很快就会尝试突围。你的战斗群是我们阻止这次进攻的唯一希望。请尽快行动。

src: Herr General, please sit down and take a look at these documents and photos. The Army HQ wants you to choose one of these units for your core army. These units are made up of Italian and Romanian prototypes, that otherwise would not be available to your forces.
dst: 将军阁下，请坐下看看这些文件和照片。陆军总部希望您为您的核心部队从这些部队中挑选一支。这些部队由意大利和罗马尼亚的原型装备组建而成，否则您的部队无法获得它们。

src: Herr General, sit down please. We are giving your troops a very special mission.  We have convinced the Furher that they must capture the factories the French have on the coast before they can be destroyed.
dst: 将军阁下，请坐。我们要交给你部队一项非常特殊的任务。我们已说服元首，必须赶在法国人被摧毁之前夺取他们在沿海的工厂。

src: Herr General, thanks to your efforts we've achieved a vital breakthrough and it is my pleasure to inform you that your request for leave has been granted. Enjoy your leave!
dst: 将军阁下，多亏您的努力，我们实现了至关重要的突破，我很荣幸地通知您，您的休假申请已获批准。祝您休假愉快！

src: Herr General, the  Soviets are trying to regroup in the old fortifications of the Stalin Line. You should break through and capture the city of Zviagel. Some Romanian troops will support you.
dst: 将军阁下，苏军正试图在斯大林防线的旧工事地带重整旗鼓。您须突破其防线并夺取兹维亚格尔城；将有部分罗马尼亚部队策应您。

src: Herr General, the 21st and 40th Armies are in ruin and full retreat, no time to pause continue south the close the ring of steel.
dst: 将军阁下，第21和第40集团军已溃不成军、全线撤退，没有时间停顿，继续南下合拢钢铁之环。

src: Herr General, the British on Crete have been a hindrance to our operations in the eastern Mediteranian.  The General staff has decided to eliminate this annoyance.  Since your troops are already in Greece, and our 1942 Russian campaign will wait for good spring weather, you have been chosen to lead this operation.
dst: 将军阁下，克里特岛上的英军一直妨碍我们在东地中海的行动。总参谋部决定拔除这个麻烦。既然你的部队已在希腊，而我方1942年俄国战役也要等春季好天气，你便被选中领导这次行动。

src: Herr General, the Caucasus Mountains have been cleared of Soviet forces and we almost reached Baku! The Baku oil fields will boost our war economics.
dst: 将军阁下，高加索山脉的苏军已被肃清，我们几乎抵达巴库！巴库油田将提振我们的战时经济。

src: Herr General, the Fuhrer has had a sudden change of mind! You are to now abandon the drive for Kiev and instead move south east towards Bila Cerkva, a strong point on the Stalin Line. Capture all objectives and the encirclement  of two Soviet armies and part of a third in the Uman area will  soon be complete!
dst: 将军阁下，元首突然改变了主意！你现在要放弃进军基辅，转而向东南方向移动，前往斯大林防线上的支撑点白采尔科维。夺取所有目标，对苏军两个集团军及第三个集团军一部在乌曼地区的合围很快就会完成！

src: Herr General, the Hermann Goering and 19th Panzer Divisions have struck the overextended Soviet tank corps northeast of Warsaw. So far, the Soviets have withstood our counterattacks. Now your division, along with the Totenkopf, will join the fight. We must render the Soviets incapable of renewing their drive on Warsaw! Good luck Herr General...
dst: 将军阁下，赫尔曼·戈林师和第19装甲师已对华沙东北方过度展开的苏军坦克军发起打击。迄今为止，苏军顶住了我们的反击。现在你的师将连同「骷髅」师一起投入战斗。我们必须使苏军无力再对华沙发起推进！祝你好运，将军阁下……

src: Herr General, the High Command of the Army orders you and your men to embark naval transports and sail to Africa! Stop the enemy advance, start your counterattack together with our Italian allies and reclaim lost territory. Codename: Operation Sonnenblume (sunflower).
dst: 将军阁下，陆军最高统帅部命令您和您的部下登上海上运输船，航渡非洲！阻止敌军推进，与我方意大利盟友一道发起反攻，收复失地。代号：向日葵行动。

src: Herr General, the Poles have pushed us back from Caen and are still on the offensive. The SS troops must hold until we can get your troops to reinforce them . This will take 5 days.
dst: 将军阁下，波兰人已把我军从卡昂击退，且仍在进攻。党卫军部队必须坚守，直到我们能让你的部队去增援他们。这需要5天。

src: Herr General, the Soviet 18th and 9th armies are in complete disarray and are in a unorganized retreat to the east. Our motorized units and panzers are comming down from the northeast and we hope to cut off and encircle the enemy around Berdyansk.
dst: 将军阁下，苏军第18与第9集团军已完全陷入混乱，正毫无组织地向东撤退。我们的摩托化部队与装甲部队正从东北方向南下，我们希望能将敌军在别尔江斯克一带切断并合围。

src: Herr General, the Soviet offensive has broken our lines south of the Bogodukhov sector! Your men, along with the Totenkopf and Das Reich divisions will launch a counter attack in the area around Valki and bring a halt to the Soviet advance...
dst: 将军阁下，苏军的攻势已在博戈杜霍夫地段以南突破我军防线！你的人马将连同「骷髅」师和「帝国」师在瓦尔基一带发动反击，阻止苏军的推进……

src: Herr General, the Soviets are attacking in great force our troops defending the city of Rostov. Three Soviet Armies are attacking from North and South. The Fuhrer has ordered the city to be deffended until the last man. You should help them before is too late!
dst: 将军阁下，苏军正以重兵猛攻我方据守罗斯托夫的部队，三个苏联集团军自南北两翼夹击。元首已下令死守该城至最后一兵一卒。请即刻驰援，切勿贻误战机！

src: Herr General, the Soviets counter-attack from the west and the east.Be careful, Soviet tank units will attack your position. Look toward the brunt of the battle being in the south-east and east.The second attack will come in the northwest.
dst: 将军阁下，苏军自西、东两面发动反攻。当心，苏军坦克部队将冲击您的阵地。主战场在东南与东部。第二波攻势将来自西北。

src: Herr General, the Soviets have landed troops on the Kerch area behind our positions. The area is defended only by the 84th infantry division and some Romanian troops. You should hurry to help them!
dst: 将军阁下，苏军已在我军阵地后方的刻赤地区登陆。该地仅有第84步兵师及部分罗马尼亚部队防守。请火速前往增援！

src: Herr General, the Soviets have trapped a number of our units in the city of Kovel. You and your men will make up part of a relief force and fight your way through the Soviet encirclement, opening a corridor to Kovel, thus allowing the withdrawal of our encircled troops. Good luck Herr General....
dst: 将军阁下，苏军把我们的若干部队困在科韦利城中。你和你的部下将组成解围部队的一部，一路杀穿苏军的合围，打通一条通往科韦利的走廊，从而使我被围部队得以撤出。祝你好运，将军阁下....

src: Herr General, the Soviets launched an desperate attack against Army Group Centre in order to bring our advance on Moscow to a halt. While mechanized units attack from the east, Soviet paratroopers and partizans are operating in our rear. To top it all, the weather is deteriorating and the ground is becoming muddy - Rasputitsa, the mud season, has started!
dst: 将军阁下，苏联人对我中央集团军群发动了一次绝望的进攻，以阻止我们向莫斯科推进。机械化部队从东面发起进攻的同时，苏联伞兵与游击队在后方活动。更糟的是，天气正在恶化，地面变得泥泞——拉斯普季察，泥泞季节开始了！

src: Herr General, the Soviets were pushing us out of Stalingrad and they are constantly bringing in newly raised regiments from the trans-Ural regions of Siberia and the Far East.
dst: 将军阁下，苏军正把我们挤出斯大林格勒，他们不断从西伯利亚的外乌拉尔地区和远东调来新组建的团。

src: Herr General, the battle is not over yet! The Brits are bringing in troops from Uganda and Rhodesia. South African troops have been reported to be on the march too! Prepare the defense of our forces along the coast and on Zanzibar.
dst: 将军阁下，战斗尚未结束！英国人正从乌干达和罗得西亚调来部队。据报道南非部队也在开进！准备好在沿海和桑给巴尔我方部队的防御。

src: Herr General, the beachhead on the Dnepr is secure. German and Romanian troops are occupying the estern bank. This victory is worth of great praise. Soon, you will be able to drive your panzers at the rear of the Soviet troops in Kiev. I am sure that you will do it very well.
dst: 将军阁下，第聂伯河上的桥头堡已经稳固。德军和罗马尼亚部队正在占领东岸。这场胜利值得大加赞扬。很快，你就能把装甲部队打到基辅苏军的后方。我相信你会干得非常出色。

src: Herr General, the enemy fought valiantly, but this did not stop you.  And now, the last Bolshevik reserves await your attack.  Defeat them and end this war.
dst: 将军阁下，敌军英勇作战，但这没能阻止你。如今，布尔什维克最后的预备队正等着你的进攻。击败他们，结束这场战争。

src: Herr General, the enemy fought valiantly, but this did not stop you. We are already inside Leningrad! And now, the last Bolshevik reserves in the North await your attack. Defeat them and the end will be at hand!
dst: 将军阁下，敌人打得英勇，但这没能挡住你。我们已经进入列宁格勒！而现在，北方最后的布尔什维克预备队正等着你的进攻。击败他们，结局就在眼前！

src: Herr General, the enemy is making a final attempt to break out of the encirclement in Normandy around the key city of Avranches. Your orders are to move swiftly and prevent this outbreak and force the Allies out of Europe. With Fortress Europe secure, and the Luftwaffe's success in dealing with Allied bombing raids, we will be able to build up our forces to invade England next year.
dst: 将军阁下，敌人正做最后努力，试图从诺曼底包围圈中、围绕重镇阿夫朗什突围。您的命令是迅速行动，阻止这次突围，并把盟军赶出欧洲。欧洲堡垒一旦稳固，加上德国空军在应对盟军轰炸行动中取得的成功，我们就能积蓄力量，于明年入侵英格兰。

src: Herr General, the enemy is making an attempt to break out of the encirclement in Normandy around the key city of Avranches. Your orders are to move swiftly and prevent this outbreak.
dst: 将军阁下，敌军正试图在诺曼底从阿夫朗什这座关键城市附近的包围圈中突围。您的命令是迅速行动，阻止这次突围。

src: Herr General, the situation is critical. 2 days after we captured Rostov the Bolsheviks launched a massive counterattack on Rostov from southern, eastern and northeastern directions. Your orders are to hold your positions, no matter what! Only in the most critical situation you are free to withdrew your troops to better positions in the west. Taganrog and positions on the western shore of the Mius river will be our last stand. Leave now, there is no time!
dst: 将军阁下，情况危急。我们夺取罗斯托夫两天后，布尔什维克从南面、东面和东北方向对罗斯托夫发动了大规模反攻。你的命令是不惜一切代价守住阵地！只有在最危急的情况下，你才可以自由地把部队撤往西面更有利的阵地。塔甘罗格以及米乌斯河两岸的阵地将是我们最后的防线。马上出发，没时间了！

src: Herr General, the situation is critical. Few days after we captured Rostov the Bolsheviks launched a massive counterattack on Rostov from southern, eastern and northeastern directions. Your orders are to hold your positions, no matter what! Only in the most critical situation you are free to withdrew your troops to better positions in the west. Taganrog and positions on the western shore of the Mius river will be our last stand. Leave now, there is no time!
dst: 将军阁下，局势危急。我们攻占罗斯托夫数日后，布尔什维克从南面、东面和东北方向对罗斯托夫发动了大规模反击。您的命令是守住阵地，不惜一切代价！只有在最危急的情况下，您才可以自由地将部队撤往西面更有利的阵地。塔甘罗格和米乌斯河西岸的阵地将是我们的最后防线。立刻出发，没有时间了！

src: Herr General, the situation is critical. The enemy is about to launch an attack on our positions soon. Prepare your troops for a fierce battle and hold the lines, no matter the costs!
dst: 将军阁下，形势危急。敌人即将对我军阵地发动进攻。让你的部队做好迎接激战的准备，并不惜一切代价守住防线！

src: Herr General, the situation is very awkward. Your troops are threatened by encirclement. Western of Kiev, the 6. Army is attacking your positions. From the north the Panzergruppe 2 will show up every moment in the back of your positions and they will join with the advance guard of the 17. Army. Hold Kiev and the surrounding regions as long as possible, so that we have the possibility to bind German troops.
dst: 将军阁下，局势十分棘手。您的部队面临被合围的危险。在基辅以西，德军第6集团军正在进攻您的阵地。北面的德军第2装甲集群随时会出现在您阵地后方，并与第17集团军的先遣部队会合。请尽可能长久地守住基辅及其周边地区，以便我们有机会牵制德军兵力。

src: Herr General, the victory is within one`s reach, or maybe not. The Germans have evacuated the area of Charkow and withdraw their troops. Your army should push forward into the empty area and follow the escaping Germans. Many of our generals believe that the Germans are already beaten and the war will soon be over. But I am not so optimistic. So, be careful.
dst: 将军阁下，胜利近在咫尺，也许并非如此。德军已撤离哈尔科夫地区并后撤其部队。你的军队应推进到这片空虚地带，追击逃窜的德军。我们的许多将军认为德军已被击败，战争很快就会结束。但我没那么乐观。所以，务必小心。

src: Herr General, the way to Lillehammer it won't be easy. Altough we're on Spring, the inland an North of Norway is covered by the snow, the mountains make it more hard too, the enemy will use that mountains for defensive things. You may take an important comunications center in the mountains too. We expect allied presence in the area.
dst: 将军阁下，通往利勒哈默尔的道路不会轻松。尽管时值春季，挪威内陆和北部仍被积雪覆盖，群山也使行军更加艰难，敌人将利用那些山脉进行防御。您还可能需要夺取山中的一个重要通信中心。我们预计该地区会有盟军存在。

src: Herr General, there's not much that OKH can offer us, but we all know that your brigade was seriously depleted during the previous campaigns, but we believe that your skills and experience will compensate for the lack of men and equipment.
dst: 将军先生，陆军总司令部能给我们的不多，但我们都知道你的旅在历次战役中严重减员，不过我们相信，你的技艺和经验能弥补兵员和装备的不足。

src: Herr General, this becomes a hard battle, we have to defend the revolution against the famous Prussian army....
dst: 将军阁下，这将是一场恶战，我们必须为捍卫革命而对抗赫赫有名的普鲁士军队……

src: Herr General, this complete victory is worthy of great praise. The southern front is now secure, and, more importantly, the Ukraine with its rich resources is almost ours!
dst: 将军阁下，这场彻底的胜利值得大大嘉奖。南线现已安全，更重要的是，拥有丰富资源的乌克兰几乎已归我们所有！

src: Herr General, this is a disaster! Sixth Army is entirely lost to us.  Though this situation is not totally of your making, your career is obviously finished. You are dismissed.
dst: 将军阁下，这是一场灾难！第六集团军已彻底损失。尽管这一局面并不完全由你造成，你的仕途显然已经结束。你被解职。

src: Herr General, this is very good work. The Allies's attempted breakout has been stopped and now the only part of France they still hold is the area around Cherbourgh.  Unfortunately, while we were fighting the Allies the Bolsheviks stabbed us in the back!  They broke our peace treaty and with most of our troops tied up in Western Europe and Afrika have been able to rampage across Eastern Europe. You must quickly move on Cherbourgh and force the Allies from Europe, so that we may transfer troops to the East.
dst: 将军阁下，干得非常出色。盟军试图突围的行动已被遏止，如今他们在法国仍占据的仅有瑟堡周边地区。不幸的是，就在我们与盟军作战时，布尔什维克从背后捅了我们一刀！他们撕毁了我们的和约，趁我方大部分部队被牵制在西欧与非洲之机，得以在东欧肆意横行。你必须迅速向瑟堡进军，把盟军逐出欧洲，这样我们才能把部队调往东线。

src: Herr General, this is very good work. The Allies's attempted breakout has been stopped and now the only part of France they still hold is the area around Cherbourgh. Unfortunately, while we were fighting the Allies the Bolsheviks stabbed us in the back! They broke our peace treaty and with most of our troops tied up in Western Europe and Afrika have been able to rampage across Eastern Europe. You must quickly move on Cherbourgh and force the Allies from Europe, so that we may transfer troops to the East.
dst: 将军阁下，这活儿干得非常漂亮。盟军企图突围的行动已被阻止，如今他们在法国仅存的据点就是瑟堡周边地区。遗憾的是，就在我们与盟军作战时，布尔什维克在背后捅了我们一刀！他们撕毁和平条约，趁我们大部分部队被牵制在西欧和非洲之际，得以在东欧大肆横行。你必须迅速推进到瑟堡，把盟军逐出欧洲，这样我们才能把部队调往东线。

src: Herr General, this victory is worthy of great praise. The Allies's attempted breakout has been stopped and now the only part of France they still hold is the area around Cherbourgh.  Unfortunately, while we were fighting the Allies the Bolsheviks stabbed us in the back!  They broke our peace treaty and with most of our troops tied up in Western Europe and Afrika have been able to rampage across Eastern Europe. You must quickly move on Cherbourgh and force the Allies from Europe, so that we may transfer troops to the East.
dst: 将军阁下，这场胜利值得高度赞扬。盟军企图突围的行动已被阻止，如今他们仍占据的法国领土只剩下瑟堡周边地区。不幸的是，就在我们与盟军作战时，布尔什维克从背后捅了我们一刀！他们撕毁了我们的和约，由于我军大部分兵力被牵制在西欧与非洲，他们得以在东欧肆意横行。你必须迅速向瑟堡推进，把盟军逐出欧洲，以便我们将部队调往东线。

src: Herr General, this victory is worthy of great praise. The Allies's attempted breakout has been stopped and now the only part of France they still hold is the area around Cherbourgh. Unfortunately, while we were fighting the Allies the Bolsheviks stabbed us in the back! They broke our peace treaty and with most of our troops tied up in Western Europe and Afrika have been able to rampage across Eastern Europe. You must quickly move on Cherbourgh and force the Allies from Europe, so that we may transfer troops to the East.
dst: 将军阁下，这场胜利值得高度赞扬。盟军的突围企图已被阻止，如今他们仍占据的法国领土只剩下瑟堡周边地区。不幸的是，就在我们与盟军作战时，布尔什维克在我们背后捅了一刀！他们撕毁了我们的和平条约，趁我军大部被牵制在西欧与非洲之机，得以在东欧横行肆虐。你必须迅速向瑟堡推进，把盟军逐出欧洲，以便我们能抽调部队到东线。

src: Herr General, this victory is worthy of great praise. The Allies's attempted breakout has been stopped and now the only part of France they still hold is the area north of Avranches.  We must now take Avranches and expel the Allies from Europe!
dst: 将军阁下，这场胜利值得高度赞扬。盟军试图突围的行动已被阻止，如今他们在法国仅剩的占领区就是阿夫朗什以北地区。现在我们必须夺取阿夫朗什，把盟军赶出欧洲！

src: Herr General, this victory is worthy of great praise. The southern front is now secure, and, more importantly, the Ukraine with its rich resources is ours.  It is my pleasure to inform you that the Bolshevik's have sued for peace!  The independence of Bylorussia and the Ukraine under German protection will stabilize our Eastern borders.  Now it only remains to force the Western Allies to the peace table.  It is my further pleasure to inform you that you have been promoted to Feldmarschall.
dst: 将军阁下，这场胜利值得高度赞扬。南方战线现已稳固，更重要的是，拥有丰富资源的乌克兰已归我们所有。我很荣幸地通知你，布尔什维克已经求和！白俄罗斯和乌克兰在德国保护下的独立将稳固我方东部边境。现在只剩下迫使西方盟国坐到谈判桌前。我更有幸通知你，你已被晋升为陆军元帅。

src: Herr General, this victory is worthy of great praise. The southern front is now secure, and, more importantly, the Ukraine with its rich resources is ours.  It is my pleasure to inform you that your request for leave has been granted.  Berlin is beautiful in the summer.  Enjoy yourself.
dst: 将军阁下，这场胜利值得大力褒奖。南方战线现已稳固，更重要的是，拥有丰富资源的乌克兰已归我们所有。我很高兴通知你，你的休假申请已获批准。夏日的柏林很美。尽情享受吧。

src: Herr General, this was a dilettante performance. Dismiss!
dst: 将军阁下，这是一次业余水平的拙劣表现。滚吧！

src: Herr General, though able to achieve some limited success, you did not show the initiative demanded of German field commanders.  You were expected to do more than merely follow orders. The Bolsheviks still defy us.
dst: 将军阁下，你虽取得了一些有限的成功，却没有展现出对德军战地指挥官所要求的主动性。你被期望做到的，不止是服从命令。布尔什维克仍在抗拒我们。

src: Herr General, though able to achieve some success, you did not show the initiative demanded of German field commanders.  You were expected to do more than merely follow orders. The Bolsheviks still defy us and we need to regroup our forces.
dst: 将军阁下，您虽然取得了一些战果，却没有展现出德国野战指挥官应有的主动精神。人们对您的期望不止是循规蹈矩地执行命令。布尔什维克仍在顽抗，我们需要重新集结部队。

src: Herr General, though you shamed the Wehrmacht with your miserable performance against the Poles, other recent victories have put the General Staff in a forgiving mood.  You have been granted another chance to lead an attack against our old enemy, France.  Their army is said to be the world's finest.  We shall see!  Now, we believe the Allies plan to push into Belgium in response to our offensive.  Your task is to lead your forces through the Ardennes and emerge behind the enemy.  Our victory at Sedan in 1870 made Germany a Great Power.  Your victory at Sedan will return us to that status.
dst: 将军阁下，尽管你对付波兰人时的糟糕表现让国防军蒙羞，但近来的其他胜利让总参谋部心情宽宥。你获准再有一次机会，领导对我们宿敌法国的进攻。据说他们的军队是世界上最精锐的。走着瞧吧！现在，我们认为盟军计划推进到比利时，以回应我们的攻势。你的任务是率部穿过阿登，出现在敌军后方。我们1870年在色当的胜利使德国跻身列强。你在色当的胜利将使我们重返这一地位。

src: Herr General, though you were able to achieve some limited success, you did not show the initiative demanded of German field commanders.  You were expected to do more than merely follow orders. Dismissed.
dst: 将军阁下，尽管你取得了一些有限的战果，你却没有表现出德国野战指挥官所要求的主动性。我们对你的期望，不止是仅仅照命令行事。你被解职。

src: Herr General, very good work! You have taken the bridges, and the Soviet resistance has collapsed. Once you led us past the river, nothing could stop our panzers. Congratulations!
dst: 将军阁下，干得非常出色！你夺下了桥梁，苏军的抵抗已经崩溃。一旦你率部渡河，就没有什么能阻挡我们的装甲部队了。恭喜！

src: Herr General, von Rundtsedt sends his regards on a succesful outcome to your first action on the Eastern front....
dst: 将军阁下，冯·伦德施泰特对你踏上东线后首次行动的圆满结果表示祝贺....

src: Herr General, we are now in a position to begin an assault towards the vital city of Grozny . Your men, along with the 13th and 1st Panzer-Divisions, will cross the Terek and Kurp Rivers, capturing all objectives, and  breaching the Soviet defences, opening a road to Grozny, and thus, to the Caspian Sea Oil reserves. Good luck Herr General...
dst: 将军阁下，我们现在已能对至关重要的格罗兹尼城发起突击。你的人马将连同第13和第1装甲师渡过捷列克河和库尔普河，夺取所有目标，突破苏军的防御，打开通往格罗兹尼的道路，进而通往里海的石油储备。祝你好运，将军阁下...

src: Herr General, we are now in a position to begin an assault towards the vital city of Grozny . Your men, along with the 13th and 1st Panzer-Divisions, will cross the Terek and Kurp Rivers, capturing all objectives, and  breaching the Soviet defences, opening a road to Grozny, and thus, to the Caspian Sea. Good luck Herr General...
dst: 将军阁下，我们现在已能对至关重要的格罗兹尼城发起突击。你的人马将连同第13和第1装甲师渡过捷列克河和库尔普河，夺取所有目标，突破苏军的防御，打开通往格罗兹尼的道路，进而通往里海。祝你好运，将军阁下...

src: Herr General, we cannot afford anymore lackluster performances from you, and since you are already at the Eastern front, you are relieved of your duties...
dst: 将军阁下，我们再也承受不起你平庸的表现了；既然你已经在东线，你被解除职务……

src: Herr General, we cannot leave Sevastopol on our flank while we advance on Stalingrad and the Caucaus, therefore it must be taken. Sevastopol is the most heavily fortified area in the world, stronger than the Maginot line or even Gibraltar!  This will not be an easy task, Herr General, but the General Staff has confidence in your leadership and resourcefulness.
dst: 将军阁下，我们在向斯大林格勒和高加索推进时，不能把塞瓦斯托波尔留在我们的侧翼，因此必须拿下它。塞瓦斯托波尔是世界上工事最坚固的地区，比马奇诺防线甚至直布罗陀还要坚固！这不会是一项轻松的任务，将军阁下，但总参谋部对你的指挥和应变能力抱有信心。

src: Herr General, we get alarming radio transmissions from the Italian garrison on the Island of Rhodes. It seems Greek partizans are attacking the islands cities and airfields. All airfields have been destroyed and need to be repaired!
dst: 将军阁下，我们收到来自罗得岛意大利守军的紧急无线电通讯。看来希腊游击队员正在进攻岛上的城市和机场。所有机场都已被摧毁，需要修复！

src: Herr General, we have a very important mission for you and your men. We need to capture the city of Narvik, the ice-free port in the very north of Norway. Narvik is connected to the Swedish iron ore mines around Kiruna via rail. Iron ore which is vital for our industry. Now your orders are to seize Narvik and secure the surrounding area.
dst: 将军阁下，我们有一项非常重要的任务交给你和你的部下。我们需要夺取纳尔维克城——挪威最北端的不冻港。纳尔维克通过铁路与基律纳周边的瑞典铁矿相连。那里的铁矿石对我们的工业至关重要。现在你的命令是夺取纳尔维克并确保周边地区安全。

src: Herr General, we have an excellent opportunity to deliver a crushing blow to the enemy, here, north of Strasbourg. As you can see, the advance of the American Third Army has left this sector of their front inadequately defended. If you can knife through to Strasbourg, the Americans and British will be forced to halt their drive on the Fatherland.
dst: 将军阁下，在斯特拉斯堡以北，我们有个绝佳机会给敌人致命一击。如你所见，美军第3集团军的推进使他们的这一段战线防守空虚。你若能直插斯特拉斯堡，美英军队就不得不停止向祖国推进。

src: Herr General, we have an excellent opportunity to deliver a crushing blow to the enemy, here, north of Strasbourg. As you can see, the advance of the American Third Army has left this sector of their front inadequately defended. If you can knife through to Strasbourg, the Americans and British will be forced to halt their drive on the Fatherland. Good luck.
dst: 将军阁下，我们有一个绝佳机会，可在此地、斯特拉斯堡以北予敌以致命一击。如你所见，美国第3集团军的推进已使其战线这一地段守备空虚。若你能直插斯特拉斯堡，美英将被迫停止向祖国的推进。祝你好运。

src: Herr General, we have been asked to pass on this urgent communique from Feldmarschall von Manstein to you: 3rd Panzerkorps can advance no further. You must perform breakthrough towards Lysjanka by your own efforts, there link up with 3rd Panzerkorps....
dst: 将军阁下，我们受命把冯·曼施泰因元帅的这份紧急通报转交给你：第3装甲军已无法再向前推进。你必须靠自己的力量向雷相卡方向突破，在那里与第3装甲军会师....

src: Herr General, we have broken our teeth on the enemy defenses. The Bolsheviks are counterattacking all along our front. Army Group South has been shaken and must give ground. General Hoth will be assuming your duties. That is all.
dst: 将军阁下，我们在敌军防线上碰得头破血流。布尔什维克正沿我全线反扑。南方集团军群已经动摇，不得不后撤。霍特将军将接替你的职务。就这样吧。

src: Herr General, we have crossed the Don and are now just 45km away from Stalingrad, the city that is named after Stalin, the communist leader. You should speed through the Steppe and close the distance to the city fast, then launch your attacks on the various landmarks, strongpoints and factories.
dst: 将军阁下，我们已渡过顿河，如今距斯大林格勒——那座以共产党领袖斯大林命名的城市——仅有45公里。你应迅速穿越草原，快速接近该城，随后对各处地标、据点和工厂发起进攻。

src: Herr General, we have discovered Ivan's supply dumps and they are lightly protected. Attack immediately using your repair crews to destroy them.
dst: 将军阁下，我们发现了“伊万”的补给仓库，且守备薄弱。立即进攻，用你的修理分队将其摧毁。

src: Herr General, we have made a grave error. The situation on Crete has become hopeless. It was a mistake to send your troops there. You must evacuate the island. To do this, you must hold the port on the island and the mainland. The port city is the only position on the island that you must keep control of. You must ferry your troops to the mainland and repair and occupy the Italian positions. The Italians will hold as long as possible.
dst: 将军阁下，我们犯了个大错。克里特的局势已无可救药。把部队派去那里是个错误。你必须撤离该岛。为此，你必须守住岛上的港口和大陆。港口城市是你在岛上唯一必须保持控制的据点。你必须把部队渡运到大陆，修复并占领意军阵地。意军会尽可能久地坚守。

src: Herr General, we have no chance in the open field, stay in the hills and let them come....
dst: 将军阁下，在开阔地上我们毫无胜算，据守山丘，等他们来攻……

src: Herr General, we have to keep the momentum going after our splendid victories in the opening days of our offensive. Now we have to push deeper into the heartland of France.
dst: 将军阁下，在攻势开局阶段取得辉煌胜利之后，我们必须保持势头。现在我们必须向法国腹地纵深推进。

src: Herr General, we have underestimated the Bolsheviks' powers of resistance. They have crossed the Don and completely encircled Sixth Army! You must drive towards Gromoslavka and enter it with sufficient force, securing a base from which we can re-establish contact with von Paulus's trapped forces. We will never, never surrender to the Red Army, but in order for us to hold our position in Stalingrad, you must prevail. Good Luck.
dst: 将军阁下，我们低估了布尔什维克的抵抗能力。他们已渡过顿河，把第六集团军彻底合围！你必须向格罗莫斯拉夫卡推进，并以足够的兵力进入该地，夺取一处基地，以便我们重新与冯·保卢斯被困的部队取得联系。我们绝不、绝不向红军投降，但为了让我们守住斯大林格勒的阵地，你必须取胜。祝你好运。

src: Herr General, we have underestimated the Bolsheviks' powers of resistance. They have crossed the Don and completely encircled Sixth Army. You must drive on Kletskaya and Serafimov to reestablish contact. We will never, never surrender to the Red Army, but in order for us to hold our position, you must prevail. Good Luck.
dst: 将军阁下，我们低估了布尔什维克的抵抗能力。他们已渡过顿河，彻底包围了第六集团军。你必须向克列茨卡亚和谢拉菲莫维奇推进，以恢复联系。我们绝不会，绝不会向红军投降，但为了守住阵地，你必须取胜。祝好运。

src: Herr General, we have underestimated the Bolsheviks' powers of resistance. They have crossed the Don and completely encircled Sixth Army. You must stop their counteroffensive before the entire Eastern Front crumbles completely. Good luck, Herr General
dst: 将军阁下，我们低估了布尔什维克的抗击之力。他们已渡过顿河，将第六集团军完全合围。您必须在整条东线彻底崩溃之前挡住他们的反攻。祝您好运，将军阁下。

src: Herr General, we have underestimated the Bolsheviks' powers of resistance. They have crossed the Don and completely encircled Sixth Army. You must support our Romanian ally, stop the Soviets and drive on Kletskaya and Serafimov to reestablish contact. We will never, never surrender to the Red Army, but in order for us to hold our position, you must prevail. Good Luck!
dst: 将军阁下，我们低估了布尔什维克的抵抗能力。他们已渡过顿河并完全包围了第6集团军。您必须支援我们的罗马尼亚盟友，阻止苏军并向克列茨卡亚和谢拉菲莫维奇推进，以重建联系。我们绝不会，绝不会向红军投降，但为了让我们守住阵地，您必须取胜。祝好运！

src: Herr General, we have underestimated the Bolsheviks' powers of resistance. They have crossed the Don and completely encircled Sixth Army. You must support our Romanian ally, stop the Soviets and drive on Kletskaya and Serafimov to reestablish contact. We will never, never surrender to the Red Army, but in order for us to hold our position, you must prevail. Good Luck.
dst: 将军阁下，我们低估了布尔什维克的抵抗力量。他们已渡过顿河，完全包围了第6集团军。你必须支援我们的罗马尼亚盟军，阻止苏联人，并向克列茨卡亚与谢拉菲莫维奇推进，以重建联系。我们绝不、绝不向红军投降，但为了守住阵地，你必须取胜。祝你好运。

src: Herr General, we know most of your men are enganged in Egypt, but you have to send your naval and paratrooper forces as well as some fast troop transports to relief the Rhodes garrison.
dst: 将军阁下，我们知道你麾下大部分兵力正深陷埃及，但你必须派出你的海军和伞兵部队，以及一些快速运兵船，去解救罗得岛守军。

src: Herr General, we made it into the Netherlands and now it is time to attack the so called Fortress Holland around Rotterdam and The Hague (Den Haag). Besides these two cities, your other main objectives will be Amsterdam in the north and Middelburg in the west.
dst: 将军阁下，我们已攻入荷兰，现在是时候进攻鹿特丹和海牙（Den Haag）周边的所谓“荷兰要塞”了。除这两座城市外，你的其他主要目标将是北部的阿姆斯特丹和西部的米德尔堡。

src: Herr General, we must have those Oilfields intact! Cross the Kuban river, capture all centres of enemy resistance, and then quickly take the Oilfields before Ivan can set them ablaze. We are counting on you Herr General!....
dst: 将军阁下，我们必须完好无损地拿到那些油田！渡过库班河，夺取敌军所有抵抗中心，然后在伊万把它们付之一炬之前迅速拿下油田。我们全指望你了，将军阁下！....

src: Herr General, we must have those Oilfields! Cross the Kuban river, capture all centres of enemy resistance. We are counting on you Herr General!....
dst: 将军阁下，我们必须拿到那些油田！渡过库班河，夺取敌军所有抵抗中心。我们全指望你了，将军阁下！....

src: Herr General, we must hurry up: speed is the key; but dont forget our back.....
dst: 将军阁下，我们必须抓紧：速度是关键；但别忘了我们的后方……

src: Herr General, we need to capture Denmark and Norway before the British will land their troops in Scandinavia and cut us off from the vital Swedish iron ore. Your first objective will be the city of Copenhagen, the capital of Denmark and stepping stone en route to Norway. Our second goal will be the Værløse Airfield, home to the entire Danish Army Air Service. Then you'll march further to the north.
dst: 将军阁下，我们必须在英军登陆斯堪的纳维亚并切断我们至关重要的瑞典铁矿石供应之前，夺取丹麦和挪威。你的首个目标是哥本哈根市——丹麦首都，也是通往挪威的踏脚石。我们的第二个目标是沃勒瑟机场，那是丹麦陆军航空兵全部力量的驻地。随后你将向北继续推进。

src: Herr General, we need to keep the momentum going and strike a final blow against the Greek and Commonwealth forces in Greece. Athens, Pireas and Corinth will be our main objectives but you also have to capture the Islands in the Saronic Gulf, Argos in the southwest and Calcis in the northeast.
dst: 将军阁下，我们需要保持势头，对希腊境内的希腊和英联邦部队施以致命一击。雅典、比雷埃夫斯和科林斯将是我们的主要目标，但您还必须夺取萨罗尼克湾中的岛屿、西南的阿戈斯和东北的哈尔基斯。

src: Herr General, we now stand before the gate of Rostov! Your men, along with elements of the Leibstandarte and 13th Pz. Divisions, will capture and occupy Rostov and the surrounding cities, thus providing us with a point of entry into the Caucasus region and it's valuable treasure; the Oilfields!
dst: 将军阁下，我们现在已站在罗斯托夫的门前！你的人马将连同「警卫旗队」师和第13装甲师的各部队夺取并占领罗斯托夫及其周围城市，从而为我们提供进入高加索地区的入口，以及那里宝贵的财富——油田！

src: Herr General, we receive alarming messages from North Africa. The Italiens got pushed back from the Egyptian border and had to retreat westward ever since. They lost Tobruk, Derna and Benghazi and are now retreating along the coast of the Gulf of Sidra towards Sirte.
dst: 将军阁下，我们收到来自北非的告急消息。意大利军被逐出埃及边境，此后不得不向西撤退。他们丢掉了托布鲁克、德尔纳和班加西，目前正沿锡德拉湾海岸向苏尔特撤退。

src: Herr General, we receive alarming radio transmitions from a Italian armored patrol that captured the Siwa Oasis. Siwa is one of the last places of civilization before the endless great sand sea. It seems, the Italians got ambushed! Select your best men and relief the Italian patrol.
dst: 将军阁下，我们收到一支占领了锡瓦绿洲的意大利装甲巡逻队发来的紧急无线电通报。锡瓦是茫茫大沙海之前最后几处文明之地之一。看来意大利人中了埋伏！挑选你最好的兵员，去解救这支意大利巡逻队。

src: Herr General, we received alarming reports radio transmissions from Army Group B! The situation at the Don is deteriorating and it is necessary for our troops to be transfered back to the Stalingrad front...
dst: 将军阁下，我们收到了来自B集团军群的令人警醒的无线电报告！顿河方向的局势正在恶化，我军必须调回斯大林格勒前线……

src: Herr General, we should not stop now! The Suez Canal is near and with the canal in our hands we will gain control of the whole Mediterranean Sea from Gibraltar in the west to Port Said in the east. The Suez Canal will also open the door to East Africa and Arabia!
dst: 将军阁下，我们现在不应停下！苏伊士运河就在眼前，运河一旦落入我们手中，我们就将控制从西面的直布罗陀到东面的塞得港之间的整个地中海。苏伊士运河还将为我们打开通往东非与阿拉伯的大门！

src: Herr General, welcome to Demyansk,... again. The situation did not change much since your last visit in this region, although the Soviets managed to capture Staraya Russa.
dst: 将军阁下，欢迎再次来到杰米扬斯克……。自您上次造访该地区以来，局势变化不大，只是苏军成功夺取了旧鲁萨。

src: Herr General, welcome to Estonia. Our advance got stuck in the rough terrain and we had to pull back our units for reinforcements and to replace our losses. The high command called you and your experienced men to this section of the northern front.
dst: 将军阁下，欢迎来到爱沙尼亚。我们的推进在崎岖地形中受阻，不得不把部队撤回以进行增援并补充损失。最高统帅部把你和你那些经验丰富的部下召到了北线这一段。

src: Herr General, welcome to Finland! We need to secure our northern and arctic fronts while Finnland wants to recapture territory they lost in the Winter War.
dst: 将军阁下，欢迎来到芬兰！我们需要稳固我们北部和北极方向的战线，而芬兰想要夺回他们在冬季战争中失去的领土。

src: Herr General, welcome to Italy! While your troops stay here for the winter, doing training and getting replenishment .....Oh wait..... Herr General, Herr General! We received a radio transmission from Spain. Our spies in Gibraltar reported a British and Free French force leaving for the Balearic Islands. It is expected they are about to launch an attack on Mallorca soon! Herr General, your troops are the only combat-ready force in the area. You have to relief our Spanish friends on Mallorca. Board the ships!
dst: 将军阁下，欢迎来到意大利！趁你的部队在此过冬、进行训练并补充兵员……哦等等……将军阁下，将军阁下！我们收到来自西班牙的无线电讯息。我们在直布罗陀的间谍报告，一支英国与自由法国部队正启程前往巴利阿里群岛。预计他们不久将对马略卡岛发动进攻！将军阁下，你的部队是该地区唯一处于战备状态的部队。你必须去增援我们在马略卡岛的西班牙盟友。登船！

src: Herr General, welcome to Novgorod,... again. The situation did not change much since your last visit in this region, although the Soviets managed to capture Staraya Russa.
dst: 将军阁下，欢迎来到诺夫哥罗德……又来了。自你上次造访该地区以来，形势没有太大变化，尽管苏联人设法夺取了旧鲁萨。

src: Herr General, what a surprise that the French managed to scrape together some tanks and even be brave enough to launch a counter-attack!!
dst: 将军阁下，真没想到法国人竟能凑出一些坦克，还大胆到发动反击！！

src: Herr General, what a surprise that the Poles managed to scrape together some tanks to defend Brest!! The "Kitchen Corps" defended bravely but we are able to overcome them eventually and now we are in a great position to stike South to Chelm.
dst: 将军阁下，真没想到波兰人竟能凑出一些坦克来防守布列斯特！！“厨房部队”守得很勇敢，但我们最终把他们打垮了，如今我们处于向南直取海乌姆的有利位置。

src: Herr General, while your troops are being transfered to East Africa we should allocate a experienced force for the cause of the legitimate leaders of Iraq and thus strengthen the friendship between Arabs and Germans.
dst: 将军阁下，趁您的部队正被调往东非之际，我们应当抽调一支经验丰富的部队来支持伊拉克的合法领导人，从而增进阿拉伯人与德国人之间的友谊。

src: Herr General, you achieved a great victory! German and Romanian troops have surrounded two Soviet armies. This victory is worthy of great praise. Soon, we will occupy all the Ukraine. I am sure that you will not let us down.
dst: 将军阁下，你取得了一场伟大的胜利！德军和罗马尼亚部队已合围了苏联的两个集团军。这场胜利值得大加赞扬。很快，我们将占领整个乌克兰。我相信你不会让我们失望。

src: Herr General, you already know that the enemy has launched an amphibious operation south of Naples, near Salerno. The terrain in this part of Italy is hilly and rugged, and we have been able to contain the enemy beachhead thus far. It is of critical importance that the Americans and British are not allowed to gain a foothold on the continent. We are relying on you and your crack troops to throw the enemy into the sea. Failure here is not an option.
dst: 将军阁下，你已得知敌军在那不勒斯以南、萨莱诺附近发动了两栖行动。意大利这一带地形丘陵起伏、崎岖不平，我们迄今尚能遏制敌军滩头。绝不能让美英在欧洲大陆取得立足点，这一点至关重要。我们仰仗你和你的精锐部队把敌军赶进大海。此处不容有失。

src: Herr General, you and your troops are sailing to Narvik in this Kriegsmarine ships. There some signs about that the British are on this seas too... If the allies appeared, the ships will be involved in a naval battle. Sail by the area, in order to find the British fleet. Good luck.
dst: 将军阁下，您和您的部队正乘这些德国海军的舰船驶向纳尔维克。有迹象表明英国人也在这片海域……如果盟军出现，舰船将卷入一场海战。在这片海域航行，以找到英国舰队。祝您好运。

src: Herr General, you are to assist the Spanish Nationalists take control of their country. This will give your men training and experience in the new warfare of Blitzkrieg.
dst: 将军阁下，你要协助西班牙民族主义者夺取他们国家的控制权。这将让你的部队在闪电战这种新式战争中得到训练和历练。

src: Herr General, you have decided to start our campaign in Russia.
dst: 将军阁下，你已决定在俄国开始我们的战役。

src: Herr General, you have disgraced the Wehrmacht with your conduct of this battle!  Many here demand your return to Berlin to face a court-martial.  Your services will no longer required.
dst: 将军阁下，你在这场战斗中的表现让国防军蒙羞！这里许多人要求你返回柏林接受军事法庭审判。你的效劳不再需要了。

src: Herr General, you have disgraced the Wehrmacht with your conduct of this battle!  Many here demand your return to Berlin to face a court-martial. Your services will no longer be required.
dst: 将军阁下，你在这场战斗中的指挥使国防军蒙羞！这里许多人要求把你送回柏林接受军事法庭审判。你的效力将不再被需要。

src: Herr General, you have done Germany proud. Your use of fast moving forces to secure objectives far behind enemy lines is a triumph. Don't stop now, onward, onward!
dst: 将军阁下，你为德国赢得了荣誉。你运用快速部队夺取敌后深远目标，堪称杰作。现在不要停下，前进，前进！

src: Herr General, you have done Germany proud. Your use of fast moving forces to secure objectives far behind enemy lines is a triumph. Don't stop now, onward, onward!!
dst: 将军阁下，你为德国赢得了荣誉。你运用快速部队夺取敌后深远目标，堪称杰作。现在不要停下，前进，前进！！

src: Herr General, you have done Germany proud. Your use of fast moving forces to secure objectives far behind enemy lines is a triumph. Don't stop now, onward, onward!!!
dst: 将军阁下，你为德国赢得了荣誉。你运用快速部队夺取敌后深远目标，堪称杰作。现在不要停下，前进，前进！！！

src: Herr General, you have done well and gained us a foothold on British soil. You must now expand that area and move towards London.
dst: 将军阁下，你干得很好，为我们取得了在英国土地的立足点。现在你必须扩展该地区，向伦敦推进。

src: Herr General, you have exceeded our expectations.  The enemy fought valiantly, but this did not stop you.  And now launch a final offensive in order to capture Leningrad before the Soviets manage to regroup. Good luck Herr General!
dst: 将军阁下，你超出了我们的预期。敌人打得英勇，但这没能挡住你。现在发动最后攻势，在苏军得以重新集结之前夺取列宁格勒。祝你好运，将军阁下！

src: Herr General, you have exceeded our expectations.  The enemy fought valiantly, but this did not stop you.  And now, the last Bolshevik reserves await your attack.  Defeat them and end this war.
dst: 将军阁下，你超出了我们的期望。敌军英勇作战，但这没能阻止你。如今，布尔什维克最后的预备队正等着你的进攻。击败他们，结束这场战争。

src: Herr General, you have exceeded our expectations.  The enemy fought valiantly, but this did not stop you.  And now, the last Bolshevik reserves standing between us and Moscow await your attack!
dst: 将军阁下，你超出了我们的预期。敌人打得英勇，但这没能挡住你。而现在，横在我们与莫斯科之间的最后一批布尔什维克预备队正等着你的进攻！

src: Herr General, you have exceeded our expectations. The enemy fought valiantly, but this did not stop you. Novgorod is in our hands. Leningrad is next.
dst: 将军阁下，你超出了我们的预期。敌人打得英勇，但这没能挡住你。诺夫哥罗德已在我手中。下一个就是列宁格勒。

src: Herr General, you have exceeded our expectations. The enemy fought valiantly, but this did not stop you. The important shipyards of Nikolaev are in our hands now. This is a major blow the Soviet shipbuilding capacities.
dst: 将军阁下，你超出了我们的期望。敌人作战英勇，但这并未阻止你。尼古拉耶夫重要的造船厂现在已在我们手中。这是对苏联造船能力的重大打击。

src: Herr General, you have failed.  The British have successfully withdrawn.  We expected more from you.  Dismissed.
dst: 将军阁下，你失败了。英军成功撤离了。我们对你的期望更高。解职。

src: Herr General, you have managed to take Tobruk after a hard fight, but the English were still able to withdraw and strengthen their forces in Egypt. Unfortunately, the war in North Africa will continue to drag on, since we lack the resources to sustain a major effort in the desert just yet.
dst: 将军阁下，你经过苦战夺取了托布鲁克，但英军仍得以撤退并加强了他们在埃及的兵力。遗憾的是，北非战争还将继续拖延下去，因为我们目前缺乏在沙漠中维持大规模作战的资源。

src: Herr General, you have narrowly achieved your objectives.  Unfortunately, the Soviet armies have been able to withdraw in good order and regroup behind new defensive lines.  You are obviously suffering from combat stress and will be reassigned to oversee the construction of beach defenses in Norway.  Dismissed.
dst: 将军阁下，你勉强达成了目标。遗憾的是，苏联各集团军得以有序后撤，并在新的防线之后重新集结。你显然患有战斗疲劳症，将被调去监督挪威滩头防御工事的构筑。你被解职。

src: Herr General, you have not performed as well as we had hoped. Your troops need more training in Blitzkrieg tactics. You should make use of your specialist troops, like the repair crews and mineclearers.
dst: 将军阁下，你的表现未如我们所望。你的部队需要更多闪电战战术训练。你应善用专业部队，如修理分队和扫雷兵。

src: Herr General, you have successfully held the Mius line over the winter; now it is finally time to retake Rostov and advance into the Caucasus towards the Oilfields! This attack,  code named  Operation Maus, is part of Army Group South's offensive Case Blue. Kick open the gate, Herr General!
dst: 将军阁下，你已成功守住米乌斯防线度过整个冬天；现在终于到了收复罗斯托夫、向高加索油田推进的时候！这次进攻代号「鼠」行动，是南方集团军群「蓝色方案」攻势的一部分。把大门踹开，将军阁下！

src: Herr General, you have to advance southwards and capture the whole northwestern Caucasus from Krasnodar and Maykop to the Black Sea port of Tuapse and the oil fields in the center. Leave now, start your engines, time is limited. Good luck!
dst: 将军阁下，您必须向南推进，夺取整个高加索西北部，从克拉斯诺达尔和迈科普直到黑海港口图阿普谢以及中部的油田。即刻出发，发动引擎，时间有限。祝您好运！

src: Herr General, you just arrived in Libya, North Africa, and will take command over the 5th Light Division in order to stabilize the front, stop the enemy and support our Italian allies. Codename: Operation Sonnenblume (sunflower). Hurry up, start your engines!
dst: 将军阁下，你刚刚抵达北非利比亚，将接管第5轻装师，以稳定战线、阻止敌军并支援我们的意大利盟友。代号：向日葵行动（Sonnenblume）。快，发动你的引擎！

src: Herr General, you made the Russians pay dearly for attempting a counter-attack.
dst: 将军阁下，你让俄国人为试图反击付出了惨重代价。

src: Herr General, you must break through and encircle the enemy along the Polish frontier, exploiting their lack of mobility.  Speed is essential; a successful advance here will allow us to threaten Warsaw from the north and east simultaneously.  In addition, we can welcome our Soviet friends to the key city of Brest-Litovsk on the new German-Soviet border.  The General Staff will not be pleased if it is the Soviets who welcome us instead.
dst: 将军阁下，你必须突破并合围波兰边境的敌军，利用其机动性之不足。速度至关重要；此处的顺利推进将使我们能从北、东两翼同时威胁华沙。此外，我们还能在新德苏边境的要城布列斯特-立托夫斯克欢迎我们的苏联朋友。若反过来是苏联人来欢迎我们，总参谋部可不会高兴。

src: Herr General, you must break through and encircle the enemy along the Polish frontier, exploiting their lack of mobility.  We will send pre-emptive strikes to destroy the Polish air force, therefore no aircraft will impede your advance.  Speed is essential; a successful advance here will allow us to threaten Warsaw from the north and east simultaneously.  In addition, we can welcome our Soviet friends to the key city of Brest-Litovsk on the new German-Soviet border.  The General Staff will not be pleased if it is the Soviets who welcome us instead.
dst: 将军阁下，您必须沿波兰边境实施突破并包围敌军，充分利用其机动性不足的弱点。我们将发动先发制人的打击摧毁波兰空军，因此不会有敌机阻碍您的推进。速度至关重要；此处的成功推进将使我们得以从北面和东面同时威胁华沙。此外，我们还能够在德苏新边界上的重镇布列斯特-立托夫斯克迎接我们的苏联友军。倘若反过来是苏联人迎接我们，总参谋部绝不会高兴。

src: Herr General, you must break through and encircle the enemy along the Polish frontier, exploiting their lack of mobility. We will send pre-emptive strikes to destroy the Polish air force, therefore no aircraft will impede your advance. Speed is essential; a successful advance here will allow us to threaten Warsaw from the north and east simultaneously. In addition, we can welcome our Soviet friends to the key city of Brest-Litovsk on the new German-Soviet border. The General Staff will not be pleased if it is the Soviets who welcome us instead.
dst: 将军阁下，你必须突破并围歼波兰边境沿线的敌军，利用其机动力的不足。我们将发动先发制人的打击摧毁波兰空军，因此不会有任何飞机阻碍你的推进。速度至关重要；在此处成功推进，将使我们得以同时从北面与东面威胁华沙。此外，我们还能在新的德苏边界上的重镇布列斯特-立托夫斯克迎接我们的苏联朋友。如果反倒是苏联人来迎接我们，总参谋部是不会满意的。

src: Herr General, you must bypass the Australian garrison at Tobruk and drive on towards the Suez Canal before the Allies manage to regroup their forces. Our Italian Allies will deal with the Australians while your mission is to capture the airfield at Sidi Rezegh and crush the Allied resistance east of Tobruk..
dst: 将军阁下，你必须绕过托卜鲁克的澳大利亚守军，在盟军重新集结兵力之前直取苏伊士运河。我们的意大利盟友将应付澳大利亚人，而你的任务是夺取西迪雷泽格的机场，并粉碎托卜鲁克以东的盟军抵抗..

src: Herr General, you must cross the river and drive straight through the Polish frontier, exploiting their lack of mobility.  We will send pre-emptive strikes to destroy the Polish air force, therefore no aircraft will impede your advance.  Speed is essential; a successful advance here will allow us to threaten Warsaw from the north and east simultaneously.  In addition, we can welcome our Soviet friends to the key city of Brest-Litovsk on the new German-Soviet border.  The General Staff will not be pleased if it is the Soviets who welcome us instead.
dst: 将军阁下，你必须渡河，直插波兰边境，利用其机动性之不足。我们将发动先发制人的打击摧毁波兰空军，因此不会有飞机阻碍你推进。速度至关重要；此处的顺利推进将使我们能从北、东两翼同时威胁华沙。此外，我们还能在新德苏边境的要城布列斯特-立托夫斯克欢迎我们的苏联朋友。若反过来是苏联人来欢迎我们，总参谋部可不会高兴。

src: Herr General, you must hold all positions.
dst: 将军阁下，您必须守住所有阵地。

src: Herr General, you must hold the Allied troops long enough for reinforcments to arrive. There level bombers are causing massive destruction on our troops & cities. I think we are going to lose some good units Herr General, I hope you are good at writing requiems.
dst: 将军阁下，你必须挡住盟军足够久，好等增援抵达。他们的水平轰炸机正给我军部队和城市造成巨大破坏。我想我们会损失一些优秀部队，将军阁下，但愿你会写安魂曲。

src: Herr General, you must occupy the bridge across the Vistula river.
dst: 将军阁下，您必须占领维斯瓦河上的桥梁。

src: Herr General, you must occupy the bridge over Olesznica river and Pyszna river and defend the area.
dst: 将军阁下，您必须占领奥莱斯尼察河与皮什纳河上的桥梁，并防守该地区。

src: Herr General, you must quickly crush the defenses of Tobruk and finish what our Italian allies have so successfully begun. If Tobruk falls into our hands, the British will never recover. Now is our chance to drive them into the sea and secure Libya.
dst: 将军阁下，你必须迅速粉碎托布鲁克的防御，完成我们意大利盟友如此成功地开启的事业。如果托布鲁克落入我们手中，英国人将永远无法恢复元气。现在是我们把他们赶入大海、确保利比亚安全的机会。

src: Herr General, you must quickly crush the defenses of Tobruk and finish what you have so successfully begun.  If Tobruk falls into our hands, the British will never recover.  Now is our chance to drive them into the sea.
dst: 将军阁下，你必须迅速粉碎托布鲁克的防御，把你如此成功地开始的事业进行到底。如果托布鲁克落入我们手中，英国人将永远无法恢复。现在正是我们把他们赶下海的机会。

src: Herr General, you must quickly crush the defenses of Tobruk and finish what you have so successfully begun.  If Tobruk falls into our hands, the British will never recover.  Now is our chance to drive them into the sea. The Italians are hard pressed to find good troops but they have supplied you with what they have.
dst: 将军阁下，你必须迅速击垮托布鲁克的防御，完成你如此成功开创的事业。若托布鲁克落入我手，英军将永难恢复。现在正是把他们赶进大海的机会。意大利人费尽心力才凑出好部队，但已把他们能拿出的都供你调遣。

src: Herr General, you should not stop now! Proceed as fast as possible along the coast and cross the border into Egypt.
dst: 将军阁下，你现在不应该停下！尽可能快速沿海岸推进，越过边界进入埃及。

src: Herr General, you take command of our naval, ground and air forces and fight battles from the civil war in Spain to North Africa, from the western and eastern fronts of World War II - and beyond!
dst: 将军阁下，您将统率我们的海军、陆军与空军，从西班牙内战到北非，从第二次世界大战的西线与东线——直至更远的战场，一路征战！

src: Herr General, you will assist our Romanian allies in their attempt to reclaim their lost province of Moldavia. The key city in this province is Kishinev, and it is also your primary objective. Not only is this assignment strategically important, it is politically critical. The world is watching, Herr General, do not disappoint.
dst: 将军阁下，您将协助我们的罗马尼亚盟友收复其失陷的摩尔多瓦地区。该地重镇基什尼奥夫即为您的首要目标。此项任务不仅有重大的战略意义，更有关键的政治影响。举世瞩目，将军阁下，切勿有负所托。

src: Herr General, your attack breached the defensive line on the Luga River. We established several bridgeheads on the East bank of the River. The road to Leningrad is open.
dst: 将军阁下，你的进攻突破了卢加河上的防线。我们已在河东岸建立了数个桥头堡。通往列宁格勒的道路已经打开。

src: Herr General, your bold and energetic tactics have allowed us a complete victory.  And now the Finnish people have been given the will to face the Soviets with us in future campaigns.  Well done!
dst: 将军阁下，你果敢而充满活力的战术为我们赢得了完胜。如今，芬兰人民已被赋予与我们并肩面对苏联的意志，将在未来的战役中与我们同行。干得好！

src: Herr General, your bold and energetic tactics have allowed us a complete victory.  Finland is still a nation and now a valuable ally.  Good work, Herr General!
dst: 将军阁下，你果敢而充满活力的战术为我们赢得了完胜。芬兰仍是一个国家，如今更是一位宝贵的盟友。干得好，将军阁下！

src: Herr General, your bold stroke through the city of Schuss'elsburg have closed the ring on Leningrad! The city of Lenin will surely be ours!
dst: 将军阁下，你经由施吕瑟尔堡城的果敢一击，已经合拢了对列宁格勒的包围圈！列宁之城必定归我们所有！

src: Herr General, your brilliant leadership has brought us once again to Moscow. This time we must capture the enemy capital and principal city and force the Bolsheviks to make peace on our terms. The General Staff has given you this critical task. You should not fail!
dst: 将军阁下，你卓越的指挥再次把我们带到了莫斯科。这一次我们必须夺取敌军首都和首要城市，迫使布尔什维克按我们的条件求和。总参谋部把这一关键任务交给了你。你不应该失败！

src: Herr General, your forces are smashed and your HQ captured, for you the war is over.
dst: 将军阁下，你的部队已被击溃，司令部被占领，对你而言战争已经结束了。

src: Herr General, your men have fought bravely but you could not stop the Soviets!  We have to withdraw now before the whole southern front is encircled. It is the end for our comrades in the Sixth Armee!
dst: 将军阁下，你的部下打得英勇，但你没能挡住苏军！我们现在必须撤退，以免整个南翼被合围。这对我们在第六集团军的同志们就是末日了！

src: Herr General, your narrow victory has shown that already you have gained some experience in this new type of warfare.  In addition, the new pro-German government in Spain may prove to be a useful ally in the coming years.
dst: 将军阁下，你的险胜表明，你已在这种新型战争中积累了一些经验。此外，西班牙新成立的亲德政府或许会在未来岁月中成为有用的盟友。

src: Herr General, your thrust to Strasbourg will be used as a textbook example of offensive maneuver. This lightning blow has changed the course of the war in the west.  Outstanding.
dst: 将军阁下，你向斯特拉斯堡的突击将被用作进攻机动的教科书范例。这一闪电般的打击改变了西线的战争进程。卓越。

src: Herr General, your thrust to Strasbourg will be used as a textbook example of offensive maneuver. This lightning blow, you have changed the course of the war in the west. Outstanding.
dst: 将军阁下，你向斯特拉斯堡的突击将被用作进攻机动的教科书范例。这一闪电般的打击，你改变了西线的战争进程。卓越。

src: Herr General, your thrust to Strasbourg will be used as a textbook example of offensive maneuver. With this lightning blow, you have changed the course of the war in the west. Outstanding.
dst: 将军阁下，你向斯特拉斯堡的突击将被用作进攻机动的教科书范例。凭这一闪电般的打击，你改变了西线的战争进程。卓越。

src: Herr General, your troops are being transfered across the Crimean Pensinsula from Kerch to Sevastopol. Please sit down and take a look at these documents and photos. The Army HQ of Heeresgruppe Süd wants you to chose one unit of the four presented in the documents. They are all formidable units that otherwise would not be available to your forces.
dst: 将军阁下，你的部队正从刻赤穿越克里米亚半岛调往塞瓦斯托波尔。请坐下看看这些文件和照片。南方集团军群陆军总部要你从文件中展示的四个单位中挑选一个。它们都是强大的单位，否则你的部队无法获得。

src: Herr General, your troops are experimented now in anfibious assaults after the lasts attacks you did. You will make the next disembark with your troops. The mission is to take Bergen, an important norvegian port. The Kriegsmarine will arrive for help you in your attack, and elements from the 69 infanterie division. Im sure, the allies will send troops and maybe, the Royal Navy will come too.
dst: 将军阁下，在您最近发起的数次进攻之后，您的部队如今已精通两栖突击。您将率领您的部队进行下一次登陆。任务是夺取卑尔根，一个重要的挪威港口。德国海军将赶来支援您的进攻，还有第69步兵师的部队。我确信，盟军会派遣部队，也许英国皇家海军也会到来。

src: Herr General, your troops are gaining valuable experience fighting with the Spaniards. This battle should be the last in Spain, we have plans for your troops!
dst: 将军阁下，你的部队在与西班牙人并肩作战中获得了宝贵经验。这场战斗应该是西班牙的最后一战，我们对你的部队另有安排！

src: Herr General, your troops have gained valuable experience during this battle. We have more tasks for you now.
dst: 将军阁下，你的部队在此役中积累了宝贵的经验。现在我们还有更多任务交给你。

src: Herr General, your victory at Lillehammer allows us an opportunity to crush our old enemy, France.  Their army is said to be the world's finest.  We shall see!  Now, we believe the Allies plan to push into Belgium in response to our offensive.  Your task is to lead your forces through the Ardennes and emerge behind the enemy.  Our victory at Sedan in 1870 made Germany a Great Power.  Your victory at Sedan will return us to that status.
dst: 将军阁下，你在利勒哈默尔的胜利使我们有机会粉碎我们的宿敌法国。他们的军队号称是世界上最精锐的。我们走着瞧！现在，我们相信盟军会以进军比利时来回应我们的攻势。你的任务是率领你的部队穿过阿登地区，出现在敌人后方。我们1870年在色当的胜利使德国成为强国。你在色当的胜利将使德国重获那一地位。

Now, we believe the Allies plan to push into Belgium in response to our offensive.  Your task is to lead your forces through the Ardennes and emerge behind the enemy.  Our victory at Sedan in 1870 made Germany a Great Power.  Your victory at Sedan will return us to that status.
dst: 将军阁下，您在纳尔维克取得的胜利为我们创造了粉碎宿敌法国的机会。据说他们的陆军是世界上最优秀的。我们走着瞧！如今我们认为，盟军计划针对我们的攻势向比利时推进。您的任务是率领部队穿越阿登，出现在敌军背后。1870年我们在色当的胜利使德国成为列强。您在色当的胜利将让我们重返那一地位。

Now, we believe the Allies plan to push into Belgium in response to our offensive.  Your task is to lead your forces through the Ardennes and emerge behind the enemy.  Our victory at Sedan in 1870 made Germany a Great Power.  Your victory at Sedan will return us to that status.
dst: 将军阁下，你在纳尔维克的胜利使我们有机会粉碎我们的宿敌法国。他们的军队号称是世界上最精锐的。我们走着瞧！现在，我们相信盟军会以进军比利时来回应我们的攻势。你的任务是率领你的部队穿过阿登地区，出现在敌人后方。我们1870年在色当的胜利使德国成为强国。你在色当的胜利将使德国重获那一地位。
