Now, we believe the Allies plan to push into Belgium in response to our offensive. Your task is to lead your forces through the Ardennes and emerge behind the enemy. Our victory at Sedan in 1870 made Germany a Great Power. Your victory at Sedan will return us to that status.
dst: 将军阁下，你在挪威的胜利为我们创造了粉碎宿敌法国的机会。据说他们的陆军是世界最强的。走着瞧吧！目前我们认为，盟军计划针对我们的攻势向比利时推进。你的任务是率领部队穿越阿登，出现在敌军后方。1870年我们在色当的胜利使德国跻身列强。你在色当的胜利将让我们重返那个地位。

src: Herr General,Paris is near and you must destroy French and British land, air and naval forces.
dst: 将军阁下，巴黎已近在眼前，您必须歼灭英法陆、空、海军兵力。

src: Herr General,after a hard battle you have taken Mstensk,now our goal in within reach.
dst: 将军阁下，经过一场苦战你已拿下姆岑斯克，我们的目标如今近在咫尺。

src: Herr General,few objectives have been won,press on!!
dst: 将军阁下，已夺下少数目标，继续推进！！
将军阁下，我们的运势已然逆转，

src: Herr General,you must clear the banks of the Somme river and Authie river of enemy soldiers. Near the Authie river location are strong enemy positions.
dst: 将军阁下，您必须肃清索姆河与欧蒂河沿岸的敌军。欧蒂河附近敌军工事坚固。

src: Herr General.  Now that Leningrad has fallen it only remains to capture Moscow and force the Bolsheviks to make peace on our terms.  You have been chosen to lead this critical attack.
dst: 将军阁下。既然列宁格勒已经陷落，剩下的只是攻取莫斯科，迫使布尔什维克按我们的条件媾和。您被选中率领这次关键进攻。

src: Herr General.  Our Finnish allies wish to reclaim the territory they lost to the Bolsheviks in 1940.  You and your brave men will assist them in driving the Russians from Finnish soil.
dst: 将军阁下。我们的芬兰盟友希望收复1940年他们败给布尔什维克而失去的领土。你和你的勇士们将协助他们把俄国人逐出芬兰国土。

src: Herr General.  Our Finnish allies wish to reclaim the territory they lost to the Bolsheviks in 1940.  You and your brave men will assist them in this, thus preparing the way for the seizure of Leningrad.
dst: 将军阁下。我们的芬兰盟友希望收复他们在1940年输给布尔什维克的领土。你和你英勇的部队将协助他们，从而为攻取列宁格勒铺平道路。

src: Herr General.  Our Finnish allies wish to reclaim the territory they lost to the Bolsheviks in 1940.  You and your brave men will assist them in this, thus preparing the way for the seizure of Leningrad.  Your offensive here will also divert some of the Bolshevik's attention from Feldmarschall Manstein's Army Group Center.
dst: 将军阁下。我们的芬兰盟友希望收复 1940 年割让给布尔什维克的领土。您与麾下勇士将助其达成此愿，进而为夺取列宁格勒铺平道路。您在此地的攻势也将分散布尔什维克对曼施泰因元帅中央集团军群的注意力。

src: Herr General.  Our goal is to seize Rostov as a base which will allow us to turn either north towards Moscow or south towards the Caucasian oil fields.  You have been chosen to lead our initial drive.
dst: 将军阁下。我们的目标是夺取罗斯托夫，以此作为基地，进而或北取莫斯科，或南下高加索油田。您已被选定为此次首轮攻势的先锋。

src: Herr General.  Our goal is to seize Stalingrad as a base which will allow us to turn either north towards Moscow or south towards the Caucasian oil fields.  You have been chosen to lead our initial drive towards Stalingrad.
dst: 将军阁下。我们的目标是夺取斯大林格勒作为基地，以便此后或北上莫斯科，或南下高加索油田。您被选中率领我们向斯大林格勒发起的最初攻势。

src: Herr General.  The victory is near. The Bolsheviks are retreating in disorder. Your mission is to occupy the Grozny oilfields before the Bolsheviks destroy them. Good luck.
dst: 将军阁下。胜利在望，布尔什维克正仓皇溃退。您的任务是在敌人将其摧毁之前占领格罗兹尼油田。祝您好运。

src: Herr General.  Your brilliant leadership has brought us once again to Moscow.  This time we must capture the enemy capital and principal city and force the Bolsheviks to make peace on our terms and end this war for good.  The General Staff has given you this critical task, do not fail!
dst: 将军阁下。在您的卓越指挥下，我军再度兵临莫斯科。这一次我们必须攻占敌国的首都与首要都市，迫使布尔什维克按我方条件媾和，彻底终结这场战争。总参谋部将这一关键重任交付于您，切勿失败！

src: Herr General.  Your brilliant leadership has brought us once again to Moscow.  This time we must capture the enemy capital and principal city and force the Bolsheviks to make peace on our terms.  The General Staff has given you this critical task, do not fail!
dst: 将军阁下。您卓越的指挥再次把我们带到了莫斯科城下。这一次我们必须夺取敌国首都和首要城市，迫使布尔什维克按我们的条件媾和。总参谋部把这一关键任务交给了您，切勿失败！

src: Herr General.  Your capture of Moscow once again showed your mastery of tactics.  The Bolsheviks still refuse to surrender but have offered us an armistice.  Our intelligence indicates that the Allies are planning an invasion of Europe early this summer.  Therefore the High Command signed the armistice with the Bolsheviks so we can prepare for the pending invasion.  You are to be transferred to the Western Front, where you will help defend Fortress Europe against an Allied invasion.
dst: 将军阁下。您攻占莫斯科再次展现了您的战术造诣。布尔什维克仍拒绝投降，但已向我们提出停战。我们的情报显示，盟军正计划在今年初夏入侵欧洲。因此最高统帅部与布尔什维克签署了停战协定，以便为即将到来的入侵做准备。您将被调往西线，协助保卫欧洲堡垒，抵御盟军入侵。

src: Herr General. Even now, enemy troops are advancing on our position.  Arm yourself with a rifle and seek redemption on the front lines. You may leave at once.
dst: 将军阁下。即便此刻，敌军正在向我阵地推进。拿起一支步枪，到前线去寻求救赎吧。你可以立即离开了。

src: Herr General. The 21st Red army defends the bridges, you must occupy all the bridges and hold them.
dst: 将军阁下，第21集团军（红军）防守各座桥梁，您必须占领全部桥梁并固守。

src: Herr General. The crisis is over, and the Polish Army has collapsed.   Unfortunately, some of the enemy has retreated into Romania.  No doubt, we will encounter these tough and vengeful troops again.  There are other repercussions as well.  The British and French have now declared war on Germany.
dst: 将军阁下。危机已过，波兰军队已经崩溃。遗憾的是，部分敌人已撤入罗马尼亚。毫无疑问，我们还会再遇上这些顽强而复仇心切的部队。还有别的后果：英法现已对德宣战。

src: Herr General. you have failed us. Even though the Grebbelinie turned out to be defended by ill equiped and badly motivated Dutch troops, the line could not be penetrated. Luckily Student's troops and the ground troops coming to their assistence in the South were more successful reaching the main Dutch cities and forcing the Dutch to capitulate.
dst: 将军阁下，你让我们失望了。尽管事实证明防守格勒贝防线的是装备低劣、士气低落的荷兰部队，这条防线却未能被突破。所幸施图登特的部队以及南下支援他们的地面部队更为成功，抵达了荷兰各主要城市，迫使荷兰人投降。

src: Herr General:  You have been ordered to link up with Feld Marschall von Manstein's forces in the launching of this relief effort. Time is of the essence!
dst: 将军阁下：你已受命与冯·曼施泰因元帅的部队会师，共同发起这次解围行动。时间至关重要！

src: Herr General:  finally General von Paulus has agreed to take an active role in this operation! Feld-Marschall von Manstein has given precise orders for the conduct of Operation Thunderclap: General von Paulus will gather up what fuel and ammo he can, and then attempt to break out of the encirclement and reach safety, sector by sector, at the same time as you are trying to break in. Our Romanian friends are expected to arrive in the next few days to lend what assistance they can to this operation. It is true we defy the Fuhrer's orders in pursuing this, but our higher duty is to the Fatherland!
dst: 将军阁下：冯·保卢斯将军终于同意在这次行动中发挥积极作用了！冯·曼施泰因元帅已就「霹雳」行动的实施下达了明确命令：冯·保卢斯将军将尽可能收集燃料和弹药，然后设法逐地段突围，抵达安全地带，与此同时你则设法突入。我们的罗马尼亚朋友预计将在未来数日内抵达，为这次行动提供力所能及的援助。我们这样做确实违抗了元首的命令，但我们更高的职责在于祖国！

src: Herr General: After our conquest of Smolensk the Soviet troops have been attacking our line centered on the city of Yelnia. Our troops cannot hold them off for long. If Yelnia is lost Smolensk will follow. You should use your Panzer corps to restore our front.
dst: 将军阁下：在我们攻占斯摩棱斯克之后，苏军一直在攻击我们以叶利尼亚城为中心的防线。我军难以长期抵挡。叶利尼亚一失，斯摩棱斯克也将不保。你应当动用你的装甲军来恢复我们的正面。

src: Herr General: After the victory at Klin we have to defeat the troops covering the North East  flank of Moscow. You should reach the Istra reservoir! Good luck, Herr General!
dst: 将军阁下：在克林取胜之后，我们必须击败掩护莫斯科东北翼的部队。你应当进抵伊斯特拉水库！祝你好运，将军阁下！

src: Herr General: After your brilliant advance we can link with Army Group South. Soviet troops are resisting at Konotop trying to block your path. You should defeat them and close a huge pocket!
dst: 将军阁下：在你这番出色的推进之后，我们可以与南方集团军群会师。苏军正在科诺托普抵抗，试图阻挡你的去路。你应当击败他们，合拢一个巨大的包围圈！

src: Herr General: Ahead of us lies Lemberg, one of the most important strategic points in Soviet occupied Poland. You have to trap their forces. If they withdraw to the Narew-Weichsel-San line, they will hold us off for long time. If you manage to cross the San and take Lemberg, you will have turned their flank and basically won the border campaign.
dst: 将军阁下：前方即为伦贝格，是苏占波兰最具战略意义的要地之一。您必须围歼其部队。若他们退守纳雷夫河—维斯瓦河—桑河一线，便能将我军长期牵制。您若能渡过桑河并夺取伦贝格，即已迂回其侧翼，边境战役基本上胜券在握。

src: Herr General: As you know, the Fuhrer has decided to divide our forces. Armee Group A and the 4th Panzer Armee are now rushing towards the Caucasus, leaving Armee Group B, (containing only your 6th Armee), to drive on towards the Volga river. General Halder is speaking to the Fuhrer about this; he has concerns that a grave strategical blunder has been made! Nevertheless, you will continue on towards the Volga river, and on the way, attempt to secure the resources of the Donets basin...
dst: 将军阁下：如你所知，元首已决定把我们的兵力分开。A集团军群和第4装甲集团军正扑向高加索，而B集团军群（只辖你的第六集团军）则向伏尔加河推进。哈尔德将军正就此事与元首交谈；他担心犯下了一个严重的战略错误！尽管如此，你仍将继续向伏尔加河推进，并在途中设法夺取顿巴斯的资源……

src: Herr General: Feld-Marschall von Manstein, the new Army Group Commander, has designed a  counter-attack in response to Operation Uranus. He has asked General von Paulus for your leadership in conducting this operation. You will take command of the 14th Panzer Korps immediately!
dst: 将军阁下：冯·曼施泰因元帅，新的集团军群司令，已针对「天王星」行动设计了一次反击。他已向冯·保卢斯将军请求，由你来指挥这次行动。你将立即接管第14装甲军的指挥权！

src: Herr General: Finally we face the battle for Moscow! The city is surrounded, but still the Communists will figth to the end! You should take the Soviet Capital and defeat the Soviets once and for all!. Expect very strong opposition.
dst: 将军阁下：我们终于迎来了莫斯科之战！该城已被包围，但共产党人仍将战斗到最后！你应当拿下苏联首都，一劳永逸地击败苏军！预计会遭遇极为顽强的抵抗。

src: Herr General: It appears that the Soviets still have control of the western industrial district of Stalingrad, where they have established strongholds in the houses and factories. It is imperative that they are dislodged. Take the area and throw them into the Volga!
dst: 将军阁下：看来苏军仍控制着斯大林格勒西部的工业区，他们在那里的房屋和工厂中构筑了据点。当务之急是把他们赶走。夺取该地区，把他们赶进伏尔加河！

src: Herr General: It is time to start the final offensive of the war in Russia. You should attack from the Northwest and by-pass the Soviet Armies in the region. You should close a pocket around the city of Viazma!
dst: 将军阁下：是时候发起这场俄国战争中的最后攻势了。你应当自西北方向进攻，并绕过该地区的苏联各集团军。你应当在维亚济马城周围合拢一个包围圈！

src: Herr General: Novgorod the ancient city of Russia is in front of you. You should take it for the first time in a milenium!
dst: 将军阁下：俄罗斯的古城诺夫哥罗德就在眼前。您当将它攻下——这是千年来首次！

src: Herr General: Originally, the Fuhrer planned to bypass Voronezh in the hopes of trapping the Soviet armies on the open steppe. But when our panzers easily penetrated the outskirts and the Kommandanten radioed for permission to seize the remainder of the area, the Fuhrer allowed the decision to be made by Feldmarschall von Bock!, who chose to press on. Therefore you will now join in with the  4th Panzer Armee in taking Voronezh and all key cities in the area...
dst: 将军阁下：起初，元首计划绕过沃罗涅日，以便在开阔的草原上围歼苏联各集团军。但当我们的装甲部队轻易突入郊区、城防司令用无线电请求准许夺取该地区其余部分时，元首把这个决定交给了冯·博克元帅，而他选择了继续推进。因此你现在将与第4装甲集团军一道，夺取沃罗涅日及该地区的所有关键城市……

src: Herr General: Our Finnish allies are trying to recover their ancient city of Viipuri. You should support their efforts with an expeditionary corps. A victory will open the northern door to Leningrad!
dst: 将军阁下：我们的芬兰盟友正力图收复其古城维普里。您应以一支远征军助其成事。此役获胜，通往列宁格勒的北门便将敞开！

src: Herr General: Preparations are complete! As you already know, von Manstein practically gave a guarantee to the Fuhrer that we would succeed in finally taking Stalingrad, therefore, failure or partial victory is not an option! One last thing Herr General, latest recon reports have confirmed that parts of the Volga river are sufficiently frozen over to allow a crossing, particularly in the Krasnoarmeysk and Svetlyy Tars vicinities..
dst: 将军阁下：准备工作已经就绪！如你所知，冯·曼施泰因实际上已向元首作出保证，我们最终会拿下斯大林格勒，因此失败或部分的胜利都不在选项之内！还有最后一件事，将军阁下：最新的侦察报告已经证实，伏尔加河有若干河段已充分封冻，可以通行，在红军城和斯韦特雷塔尔斯一带尤其如此..

src: Herr General: Stavka has surprised us completely by attacking our flanks in great force! Our Romanian allies cannot resist for long. The situation is desperate. You, and some of your men, have been ordered here to the Chir River to lend any assistance you can to our faltering allies...
dst: 将军阁下：最高统帅部以重兵突击我们的两翼，令我们完全措手不及！我们的罗马尼亚盟友支撑不了多久。局势万分危急。你和你的部分部下已奉命来到奇尔河，尽你所能去援助我们那些动摇的盟友……

src: Herr General: The 4th Panzer Armee has made amazing progress since rejoining our drive to the Volga river. They are now just 73 miles southwest of Stalingrad! Your performance in the Donets Basin has also helped to throw the Soviets off balance, and now you will follow-up by taking the area between the Don and the Volga rivers, while continuing on to eventually link up with the 4th Panzer Armee which is swinging north east to join in the assault on Stalingrad...
dst: 将军阁下：第4装甲集团军在重新加入我们向伏尔加河的推进之后取得了惊人的进展。他们现在距斯大林格勒西南仅73英里！你在顿巴斯的表现也有助于打乱苏军的步调，现在你要乘胜追击，夺取顿河与伏尔加河之间的地区，同时继续推进，最终与正转向东北、加入对斯大林格勒突击的第4装甲集团军会师……

src: Herr General: The Fuhrer has decided to conquer the Ukraine before moving towards Moscow. You should move in a Southeast direction. Your first task is to cross the Desna River. You should use the capabilities of your engineers.
dst: 将军阁下：元首已决定在进军莫斯科之前先征服乌克兰。你应当朝东南方向推进。你的首要任务是渡过杰斯纳河。你应当发挥你工兵的能力。

src: Herr General: The Fuhrer has ordered the invasion of the Soviet Union to start on June 22 at 4 am! You will have an opportunity to meet again our 'friends' at Brest-Litovsk. You will direct a Panzer Corps. Camouflaged bridges have alredy been prepared at the side of the city. Good luck! We need to achieve a complete surprise!
dst: 将军阁下：元首已下令于6月22日凌晨4时发起对苏联的入侵！你将有机会在布列斯特-立托夫斯克再次见到我们的「朋友们」。你将指挥一个装甲军。伪装好的桥梁已在城边准备就绪。祝你好运！我们必须达成完全的突然性！

src: Herr General: The General Staff has decided that you should lead the attack against the British in North Africa.  Their will to fight has by no means been broken.  If we can push the English out of North Africa, we will gain access to the Suez Canal and the oil-rich Middle East.
dst: 将军阁下：总参谋部已决定由你领导对北非英军的进攻。他们的战斗意志绝未瓦解。如果我们能把英国人赶出北非，我们就能获得苏伊士运河和富产石油的中东。

src: Herr General: The General Staff wants you to take the city of Pskov. If we are successful we can trap the Soviet troops retreating from the Baltic countries. We will open the door to the Baltic and Leningrad too!
dst: 将军阁下：总参谋部要您夺取普斯科夫城。此役若成，我们便可围歼自波罗的海三国撤退的苏军，同时也将打开通往波罗的海与列宁格勒的大门！

src: Herr General: The Soviets have disrupted our planned relief of Stalingrad! They have forced their way across the Chir river and have taken Sovkhoz 79, and Sysokin, threatening to roll up our entire line, and thus preventing Hoth's 4th Panzer Armee from moving into position at Kotelnikovo. You must stabilize the situation here in order to allow our relief attempt to begin!
dst: 将军阁下：苏军打乱了我们解救斯大林格勒的计划！他们强行渡过奇尔河，夺取了第79国营农场和瑟索金，威胁要从侧翼卷击我们的整条防线，从而阻止霍特的第4装甲集团军进入科捷利尼科沃的阵地。你必须稳定此地的局势，以便我们的解围行动得以展开！

src: Herr General: The Soviets have reacted with great speed in their attempt at dealing with our efforts in breaking through to Stalingrad! Not only are they trying to complete the isolation of  6th Armee from Army Group Don, but they also threaten to destroy the Italian 8th Army, and then push towards Rostov, cutting the lines of communication between Army Group A fighting in the Caucasus, and the 4th Panzer Armee, which is still engaged in holding onto our gains won in the ongoing Operation Wintergewitter...
dst: 将军阁下：苏军对我们突入斯大林格勒的努力作出了极为迅速的反应！他们不仅在设法彻底切断第六集团军与顿河集团军群的联系，还威胁要歼灭意大利第8集团军，然后直扑罗斯托夫，切断在高加索作战的A集团军群与仍在执行「冬季风暴」行动、固守既有战果的第4装甲集团军之间的交通线……

src: Herr General: The city  of Orel has fallen! Your lateral movements had the enemy completely baffled about your intentions! The General Staff is pleased!
dst: 将军阁下：奥廖尔城已经陷落！你的横向机动让敌人对你的意图完全摸不着头脑！总参谋部很满意！

src: Herr General: The last obstacle to your advance is the city of Tula. This city is considered to be part of Moscow. You should take it and flank the Soviet Capital from the South!
dst: 将军阁下：你推进的最后一道障碍是图拉城。该城被视为莫斯科的一部分。你应当夺取它，并从南面包抄苏联首都！

src: Herr General: There are 2 ways we can plan to react to the Soviet breakthrough: we can try the mounting of a Relief effort in order to free the now encircled 6th Armee in Stalingrad...or ...we can  commence a direct attack on the Soviet armored spearheads moving towards Kalach from the Chir river. To choose the Relief effort, report northwest to Popoff. To choose the direct attack, head north to Katschalinsky. Good luck Herr General...
dst: 将军阁下：对苏军的这次突破，我们可以有两种应对方案：我们可以尝试发起一次解围行动，以解救如今被围在斯大林格勒的第六集团军……或者……我们可以对自奇尔河向卡拉奇推进的苏军装甲前锋发起直接攻击。若选择解围行动，就向西北前往波波夫报到。若选择直接攻击，就向北前往卡恰林斯基。祝你好运，将军阁下……

src: Herr General: There is a big concentration of Soviet troops on the Southeast around Roslavl. You should eliminate those troops before we can continue our advance towards Moscow.
dst: 将军阁下：东南方向罗斯拉夫尔一带有苏军大部队集结。在我们继续向莫斯科推进之前，你应当消灭这支部队。

src: Herr General: We have the opportunity of establishing a bridge-head at Bobryusk on the Dnepr River.  You should drive immediately there and surprise the defenders before a determined defense is established!
dst: 将军阁下：我们有机会在第聂伯河上的博布鲁伊斯克建立一个桥头堡。你应当立刻向那里推进，在守军组织起坚决的防御之前打他们一个措手不及！

src: Herr General: We have to defeat the troops covering the North East flank of Moscow before the winter sets in. Your orders are to reach the Istra reservoir! Good luck, Herr General!
dst: 将军阁下：我们必须在冬季来临之前击败掩护莫斯科东北翼的部队。你的命令是进抵伊斯特拉水库！祝你好运，将军阁下！

src: Herr General: We need to surround the Soviet troops in and around Minsk, the capital of Belorussia. You will drive a Panzer Corps and try to make contact with our forces north of the city. We expect much from you. Do not disappoint us!
dst: 将军阁下：我们需要把明斯克城内及周围的苏军合围，该城是白俄罗斯的首府。你将指挥一个装甲军，并设法与该城以北的我军部队取得联系。我们对你的期望很高。不要让我们失望！

src: Herr General: We should continue our drive for Leningrad. We should reach the shores of Lake Ladoga to encircle the city from the east.
dst: 将军阁下：我们应继续向列宁格勒推进，直抵拉多加湖畔，自东面完成对该城的合围。

src: Herr General: With our positions completely  overrun, the Soviet advance on Kalach continues. If Kalach falls, so does our one and only life-line into Stalingrad! But nevertheless, we must now decide on a course of action to deal with this most grave threat!...
dst: 将军阁下：由于我们的阵地被完全攻占，苏军向卡拉奇的推进仍在继续。卡拉奇一旦陷落，我们通往斯大林格勒的唯一生命线也就断了！尽管如此，我们现在必须就如何应对这一最为严重的威胁作出决断！……

src: Herr General: With your troops now poised just in front of Stalingrad, and Hoth's 4th Panzer Armee ready to storm the southern outskirts, it is time! The Soviets have fortified the city using everything they have, but you must prevail! The Fuhrer demands it!
dst: 将军阁下：你的部队如今已摆在斯大林格勒城前，霍特的第4装甲集团军也已准备好猛攻南部郊区，是时候了！苏军用他们所拥有的一切把这座城市要塞化了，但你必须取胜！元首要求如此！

src: Herr General: You came nowhere near to breaking through the Soviet encirclement and helping the Sixth Armee! It is the end of our relief attempts, Sixth Armee is now doomed, and so is your career as an officer in the Wermacht!
dst: 将军阁下：你远远未能突破苏军的合围去救援第六集团军！我们的解围尝试就此告终，第六集团军现在注定要完蛋，你在国防军的军官生涯也一样！

src: Herr General: You came nowhere near to breaking through to take Stalingrad. As a result, the Soviets have reinforced the city and have put an end to the Fuhrer's dream for now, and also your career as an officer in the Wermacht! Dismissed..
dst: 将军阁下：你远远未能突入并夺取斯大林格勒。结果，苏军加强了该城的兵力，并就此终结了元首的梦想，也终结了你在国防军的军官生涯！你被解职..

src: Herr General: You came nowhere near to stabilizing the Lower Chir river area, thus the relief attempt has been postponed indefinitely, and therefore, so has your career in the Wermacht! Dismissed...
dst: 将军阁下：你远远未能稳定下奇尔河地区，因此解围行动已被无限期推迟，你在国防军的生涯也同样如此！你被解职...

src: Herr General: You can choose which path to play. If you want to play the path of Army Group North go to Leningrad. If you want to play the path of Army Group Center go to Moscow. If you want to play the path of Army Group South go to Rostov.
dst: 将军阁下：你可以选择走哪条路线。若想走北方集团军群的路线，就前往列宁格勒。若想走中央集团军群的路线，就前往莫斯科。若想走南方集团军群的路线，就前往罗斯托夫。

src: Herr General: You destroyed completely the Soviet forces! You achieved a great victory! Minsk will soon be on our hands! Now move fast on the road to the Dnepr River.
dst: 将军阁下：你彻底歼灭了苏军！你取得了一场伟大的胜利！明斯克很快将落入我们手中！现在沿通往第聂伯河的道路快速推进。

src: Herr General: You have achieved a great victory! You have won the race for Brest-Litovsk! This is a big lesson for the Soviets. They are not worth much. They will be easy to beat when time comes.
dst: 将军阁下：你取得了一场伟大的胜利！你赢得了争夺布列斯特-立托夫斯克的赛跑！这对苏联人是一大教训。他们不值一提。到时候打败他们会很容易。

src: Herr General: You have achieved a very narrow victory! Finally the sacrifice of your soldiers have won the day. We can continue our retreat until we reach a solid line.
dst: 将军阁下：你取得了一场极为险峻的胜利！最终是你士兵们的牺牲赢得了这一天。我们可以继续撤退，直到抵达一条稳固的防线。

src: Herr General: You have achieved a very narrow victory! Finally, the sacrifice of your soldiers have won the day. We can continue our retreat until we reach a solid line.
dst: 将军阁下：你取得了一场极为险峻的胜利！最终，是你士兵们的牺牲赢得了这一天。我们可以继续撤退，直到抵达一条稳固的防线。

src: Herr General: You have been assigned to command the troops that will capture the Crimea. You have to break through the isthmus at Perekop first. The Soviets have strongly fortified the only access to the peninsula.
dst: 将军阁下：您已受命指挥攻取克里米亚的部队。您须先突破彼列科普地峡——那是通往该半岛的唯一通路，苏军已在此重兵设防。

src: Herr General: You have been designated by OKW as Chief of Operations for the Sixth Armee in our upcoming southern campaign, Operation Blue. The ultimate goal of this undertaking is to cut the Volga river lifeline and capture the oilfields of the Caucasus, thus delivering a powerful blow from which the Soviets will never recover. The 4th Panzer Armee has already begun their drive towards Voronezh. Your job is to follow suit and cover the flank while destroying any Soviet troops in your line of march...
dst: 将军阁下：你已被国防军最高统帅部指定为第六集团军在即将到来的南方战役「蓝色」行动中的作战处长。此次行动的最终目标是切断伏尔加河的生命线并夺取高加索的油田，从而给予苏联一记永难恢复的沉重打击。第4装甲集团军已开始向沃罗涅日推进。你的任务是依样跟进并掩护侧翼，同时消灭行军路线上遇到的任何苏军……

src: Herr General: You have chosen to play the campaign of Army Group Center.
dst: 将军阁下：你已选择进行中央集团军群的战役。

src: Herr General: You have chosen to play the campaign of Army Group North.
dst: 将军阁下：你已选择进行北方集团军群的战役。

src: Herr General: You have chosen to play the campaign of Army Group South.
dst: 将军阁下：你已选择进行南方集团军群的战役。

src: Herr General: You have disappointed us! Despite the sacrifice of your soldiers your failure is incomprehensible. You should take a training course and go into reserve!
dst: 将军阁下：你让我们失望了！尽管你的士兵作出了牺牲，你的失败仍不可理喻。你应当去参加一个训练课程，然后转入预备役！

src: Herr General: You have failed miserably! You have lost the race for Brest-Litovsk! Maybe the Soviets are better that we thought. We may need to keep their friendship.
dst: 将军阁下：你失败得惨不忍睹！你输掉了争夺布列斯特-立托夫斯克的赛跑！也许苏联人比我们想的要强。我们也许需要维持与他们的友谊。

src: Herr General: You have failed miserably! You have shown no aptitude whatsoever for commanding a schlachtgruppe! You will now report to the 44th Infanterie division where an  infanterie zug might be in need of some leadership!
dst: 将军阁下：你失败得惨不忍睹！你在指挥一个战斗群方面毫无才干可言！你现在到第44步兵师报到，那里某个步兵排也许正需要有人来带领！

src: Herr General: You have failed miserably! You have shown no aptitude whatsoever for commanding a schlachtgruppe! You will now report to the 44th Infanterie division where an  infanterie zug might be in need of some leadership.
dst: 将军阁下：你失败得惨不忍睹！你在指挥一个战斗群方面毫无才干可言！你现在到第44步兵师报到，那里某个步兵排也许正需要有人来带领。

src: Herr General: You have failed miserably! You have shown no aptitude whatsoever for commanding a schlachtgruppe, but nevertheless, you have been given one last chance, do not disappoint us!
dst: 将军阁下：你失败得惨不忍睹！你在指挥一个战斗群方面毫无才干可言，尽管如此，你还是得到了最后一次机会，别让我们失望！

src: Herr General: You have succeeded! Bobryusk is in our hands and the Dnepr River line is broken! We can start operations on the way to Smolensk.
dst: 将军阁下：你成功了！博布鲁伊斯克已在我手中，第聂伯河防线已被突破！我们可以开始向斯摩棱斯克方向的行动了。

src: Herr General: You have to defeat the remnants of the Polish army and take the city of Brest-Litovsk. The Soviets are also on the way. You have to be there to guide our 'Allies'.
dst: 将军阁下：你必须击败波兰军队的残部，并夺取布列斯特-立托夫斯克城。苏联人也在赶来。你必须在场，好给我们的「盟友」带路。

src: Herr General: You should close the pincer around the city of Bryansk. We can trap 5 Soviet armies in a huge pocket. Do not fail us Herr General!
dst: 将军阁下：你应当在布良斯克城周围合拢钳形攻势。我们可以把苏联的5个集团军困在一个巨大的口袋里。别让我们失望，将军阁下！

src: Herr General: You should direct our southern pincer to surround Moscow. Your first task is to defeat the Soviet troops around Orel. After the fall of the town the road to Tula will be open.
dst: 将军阁下：你应当指挥我们的南路钳臂去合围莫斯科。你的首要任务是击败奥廖尔周围的苏军。该城陷落之后，通往图拉的道路就将打开。

src: Herr General: You surprised completly the Soviets! You achieved a great victory! Brest-Litovsk is on our hands! Now drive fast inside Russian territory.
dst: 将军阁下：你让苏联人完全措手不及！你取得了一场伟大的胜利！布列斯特-立托夫斯克已在我手中！现在快速推进，深入俄国的领土。

src: Herr General: Your great victory opens the way to Moscow! Now full speed ahead, before the start of the mud season!
dst: 将军阁下：你这场伟大的胜利为通往莫斯科打开了道路！现在全速前进，赶在泥泞季节开始之前！

src: Herr General: despite the harsh weather conditions you achieved victory!. You have kept Tikhvin and the siege will be maintained! Leningrad will have to surrender!
dst: 将军阁下：尽管天气条件恶劣，你还是取得了胜利！你守住了季赫温，围困将得以维持！列宁格勒将不得不投降！

src: Herr General: due to the harsh weather conditions we could not reach the Svir and close the circle around Leningrad. The Soviets are counterattacking to recover Tikhvin and destroy our troops. Keep Tikhvin and the siege will be maintained!
dst: 将军阁下：由于恶劣的天气条件，我们未能抵达斯维尔河、合拢对列宁格勒的包围圈。苏军正在反击，力图夺回季赫温并歼灭我军。守住季赫温，围困就能维持下去！

src: Herr General: it is your privilege to lead our attack here, south of Novgorod, in the Russian heartland.  A successful offensive here will sever communications between Moscow and Leningrad and trap several Soviet armies. It is, of course, imperative to take your objectives quickly. Our thoughts are with you.
dst: 将军阁下：能由您在此地——诺夫哥罗德以南的俄罗斯腹地——指挥进攻，是您的荣耀。此役若成，将切断莫斯科与列宁格勒之间的联系，并围歼苏军数个集团军。当然，您必须迅速夺取目标。我们与您同在。

src: Herr General: our trip through the Baltic states is going well. In order to maintain our momentum we have to take the bridges on the Daugava River at Daugavpils. Do not fail us!
dst: 将军阁下：我们穿越波罗的海三国的进军进展顺利。为保持势头，我们必须夺取陶格夫匹尔斯附近道加瓦河上的桥梁。切勿有负所望！

src: Herr General: the Duderhoff Hills are in front of you. The old Tzars parading ground is the last obstacle in our drive for Leningrad. Take it and the city will be in our grasp!
dst: 将军阁下：杜德霍夫高地就在眼前。这片旧沙皇阅兵场是我们进军列宁格勒的最后障碍。拿下它，该城便尽在掌握！

src: Herr General: the Fuhrer has decided not to assault Leningrad. We will surround it instead, and force its surrender. You should drive to the Svir River and close the circle. Take Tikhvin and the city will be encircled!
dst: 将军阁下：元首已决定不强攻列宁格勒，改以合围迫其投降。您应推进至斯维里河，合拢包围圈。拿下提赫文，该城便被彻底围死！

src: Herr General: the Soviet troops are trying to outflank Army Group Center in front of Moscow. A strong group is attacking in the direction of the city of Rzhev. If the city falls they will cut our communications with the rear areas. You should counterattack and hold them off! We expect much from you. Do not disappoint us!
dst: 将军阁下：苏军正试图迂回莫斯科正面的中央集团军群。一支强大的集群正向勒热夫城方向突击。该城若失，我军与后方的联系将被切断。您应发起反击并顶住他们！我们对您寄望甚厚，切勿有负所托！

src: Herr General: the Soviets are attacking our troops North of Moscow. The weather is horrible and we do not have enough supplies, but we need to hold our positions!
dst: 将军阁下：苏军正在莫斯科以北向我军发起进攻。天气恶劣，补给亦不充足，但我们必须守住阵地！

src: Herr General: the Soviets are counterattacking the troops of LVI Panzer Corps. Manstein is under a lot of pressure. You should attack to relieve our troops.
dst: 将军阁下：苏军正对第56装甲军所部发起反攻，曼施泰因承受着巨大压力。您应出击以解我军之围。

src: Herr General: the Soviets are trying to create a defensive line on the Luga River. We cannot allow this! You should tale the city of Narva and establish a bridgehed on the Luga River. After that we can head for Leningrad.
dst: 将军阁下：苏军正试图在卢加河沿岸构筑防线，我们绝不能容许！您应夺取纳尔瓦城，并在卢加河上建立桥头堡。此后便可直取列宁格勒。

src: Herr General: the Soviets are trying to relieve the siege of Tula. Strong Siberian formations supported by T-34 tanks are trying to break our line. The Fuhrer relies on you to restore our line!
dst: 将军阁下：苏军正试图解图拉之围。由 T-34 坦克支援的强大西伯利亚部队正试图突破我军防线。元首倚仗您来重整防线！

src: Herr General: you have completely surprised the Soviets and secured a beachhead on the east bank of the Desna River. We can continue our move South.
dst: 将军阁下：你们完全打了苏军一个措手不及，并在杰斯纳河东岸建立了登陆场。我们可以继续向南推进了。

src: Herr Generalmajor! We all hope and believe that this will be the one last lightning strike that ends the war. Don't disappoint us!
dst: 少将先生！我们都希望并相信，这将是结束战争的最后一记闪电。别让我们失望！

src: Herr Generalmajor, it seems like the Brits knew of your coming and they've prepared a pretty hot welcome for you. For weeks they're improving their positions, they're moving more and more men and resources and it is obvious that a big offensive is about to start in coming days.
dst: 少将先生，看来英国人早就知道你要来，为你准备了一场相当热烈的欢迎。几个星期以来，他们一直在加固阵地，调集越来越多的兵员和资源，很明显，一场大规模攻势将在未来几天内打响。

src: Herr Generalmajor, seems like the Soviets already knew what's happening and there are signs that they prepared a local offensive action to disrupt our concentration. The elements of 512th infantry division hold the base of your entrance area. You'll move into the postions at midnight and we hope that you'll spend the whole day in cover, preparing for the attack. But if the Soviets really try to disturb your line... well, you know what to do."
dst: 少将先生，看来苏联人已经知道发生了什么，有迹象表明他们准备了一场局部攻势来扰乱我们的集结。第512步兵师的部队扼守着你入口区域的前沿。你将在午夜进入阵地，我们希望你能在掩蔽下待一整天，为进攻做准备。但如果苏联人真的试图扰乱你的战线……嗯，你知道该怎么做。”

src: Herr Hauptmann, the situation is dire. While your battalion wa able to break through the enemy defense, elsewhere the line barely moved forward. I'm afraid the offensive isn't going the way we planned.
dst: 上尉阁下，形势严峻。虽然你的营得以突破敌军防御，但其他地段战线几乎寸步难行。恐怕攻势并未如我们计划的那样展开。
海军上尉阁下，你有2个选择。

src: Herr Kommodore, we just heard that your mother passed away. The General Staff gives you permission if you wish to return to Germany for the funeral on the condition that you resign command of the fleet.
dst: 海军准将阁下，我们刚刚得知令堂已去世。若你希望返回德国参加葬礼，总参谋部可以批准，但条件是你必须辞去舰队指挥职务。
海军准将阁下，你有2个选择。
海军少校先生，你有两个选择。

src: Herr Korvettenkapitan, you have a special mission. You must destroy the radar, the submarine base and the fuel depot at the north island of Shetland.
dst: 海军少校阁下，你有一项特殊任务。你必须摧毁设得兰群岛北岛上的雷达、潜艇基地和燃料库。

src: Herr Leutnant, General Staff orders you to take command of the Destroyer "Wolfgang Zenker" after the death of your Kapitan, who has been killed in in action. Now you have to continue his mission to destroy enemy transport ships and take revenge for his death by sinking the sub that attacked your ship.
dst: 少尉阁下，总参谋部命令你在舰长阵亡后接管驱逐舰"Wolfgang Zenker"号。他的舰长已在战斗中阵亡。现在你必须继续他的任务，摧毁敌方运输船，并通过击沉袭击你军舰的潜艇来为他的死报仇。

src: Herr Major, I couldn't pass over your lack of resolve and tactical flexibility during the last mission. Commanding an elite panzerabteilung is both an honour and obligation!
dst: 少校阁下，我不能对你上次任务中缺乏决断力和战术灵活性视而不见。指挥一支精锐装甲营，既是荣誉，也是职责！

src: Herr Major, at least the war is over for you.
dst: 少校阁下，至少对你而言，战争结束了。

src: Herr Major, if you no longer feel up to field duty, I can speak with our superiors, and I'm sure we can find you a position in the supply depot, where you can join the retired officers of the Great War. Counting caps, buttons, and canteens will surely suit you better than commanding an elite tank battalion.
dst: 少校阁下，若你已不再胜任野战职责，我可以向上级说说，相信能给你在补给站谋个职位，与一战退役军官们为伍。数数军帽、纽扣和水壶，想必比指挥一支精锐坦克营更适合你。

src: Herr Major, the defense of Gumbinnen was a textbook example of modern tank warfare. Let us hope that we can hold the positions you have captured and launch a massive counterattack as soon as possible.
dst: 少校阁下，贡宾嫩防御战是现代坦克战的教科书范例。但愿我们能守住你夺取的阵地，尽快发起大规模反攻。

src: Herr Major, the fact that the Soviets threw an entire tank corps at your positions does not change anything about your failure to defend a critical section of the front. Surely I need not remind you that our Königstigers are designed precisely for this kind of combat!
dst: 少校阁下，苏军把整个坦克军投向你的阵地这一事实，丝毫不能改变你未能守住关键战线的过失。想必无需我提醒你——我们的虎王坦克正是为这种战斗而设计的！

src: Herr Major, the war is over for you.
dst: 少校阁下，对你而言，战争结束了。

src: Herr Major, this is really disappointing. It's understandable that heavy tanks are unfit for operation in swampy region, but by now you should have enough experiences to find a way.
dst: 少校阁下，这实在令人失望。重型坦克不适合在沼泽地带作战情有可原，但到如今你早该有足够经验找到办法了。

src: Herr Major, this was a hard-fought victory.
dst: 少校阁下，这是一场来之不易的胜利。

src: Herr Major, we will never forget you.
dst: 少校阁下，我们永远不会忘记你。

src: Herr Major, we've reached the brink of disaster.
dst: 少校阁下，我们已濒临灾难边缘。
中尉阁下，你有两个选择。

src: Herr Oberst! The Luftwaffe has just blown the bloody place!
dst: 上校先生！德国空军刚把那个该死的地方炸平了！

src: Herr Oberst, I regret to tell you that the offensive has been cancelled. Our armies are too tired and our casualties are too high. Besides, we know that some British and French divisions will arrive very soon to the Piave and will reinforce the Italians.
dst: 上校先生，我很遗憾地告诉您，攻势已经取消。我们的军队过于疲惫，伤亡也太惨重。此外，我们知道一些英军和法军的师很快就会抵达皮亚韦河，增援意大利人。

src: Herr Oberst, as usual your troops have done a fantastic job, but I regret to tell you that the offensive has been cancelled. Our armies are too tired and our casualties are too high. Besides, we know that some British and French divisions will arrive very soon to the Piave and will reinforce the Italians.
dst: 上校先生，您的部队一如既往表现出色，但我遗憾地通知您，进攻已被取消。我军过于疲惫，伤亡也过于惨重。此外，我们知道一些英国师和法国师很快就会抵达皮亚韦河，增援意大利人。

src: Herr Oberst, please keep laid down. The doctor has said that, if you do unnecessary efforts, your wound will take longer to heal.
dst: 上校先生，请继续躺着。医生说了，如果您作不必要的活动，伤口愈合的时间会更长。

src: Herr Oberst, we're stuck here and we just can't move any further. The river banks are occupied by the enemy, with the infantry heavily entrenched and supported by guns and MGs. But that's not the worst of it. The enemy has a strong tank force just beyond the river! Every time we tried to move across the meadow, they counterattacked. And we cannot bypass the meadow, because of the infantry I mentioned. What types of panzers? Well, every type imaginable. They have Chars, Somuas, Cruisers and Matildas.
dst: 上校先生，我们被困在这里，实在无法再推进了。河岸被敌军占据，步兵深沟高垒，还有火炮和机枪支援。但这还不是最糟的。河对岸有敌军强大的坦克力量！每次我们试图越过草地，他们就反扑。而因为我说过的那些步兵，我们又无法绕过草地。什么型号的坦克？嗯，你能想到的都有。他们有夏尔、索玛、巡洋坦克和玛蒂尔达。

src: Herr general, after we have conquested Oslo, the capital of Norway, you can select the next destination of for your troops. If you select Kristiansand (to the west) your troops will go by the seaside, and they'll take part in anfibious assaults towards the norvegian coast. If you select go to Konstinger, your troops will go by the mainland, taking all the important areas. OKH and OKW lend the decission in your hands.
dst: 将军阁下，在我们征服了挪威首都奥斯陆之后，您可以为您的部队选择下一个目的地。如果您选择克里斯蒂安桑（向西），您的部队将沿海岸推进，并参与对挪威海岸的两栖突击。如果您选择前往康斯温厄尔，您的部队将走陆路，夺取所有重要地区。陆军总司令部（OKH）和国防军最高统帅部（OKW）把决定权交到您手中。

src: Herr, General,you must defend Le Cateau city and where upon you must attack at Beamont city  the French supply depot and occupy it.
dst: 将军阁下，您必须防守勒卡托城，继而进攻博蒙城的法军补给站并予以占领。

src: Herramienta de Testeo de la AI
Hess. Inf. Reg. Nr. 1/ 49 Brig./ 25 Div. / IX Preus. Korps/ II Armee
dst: 黑森步兵第1团/ 第49旅/ 第25师 / 第9普鲁士军/ 第2集团军

src: Hess. Inf. Reg. Nr. 2/ 49 Brig./ 25 Div. / IX Preus. Korps/ II Armee
dst: 黑森步兵第2团/ 第49旅/ 第25师 / 第9普鲁士军/ 第2集团军

src: Hess. Inf. Reg. Nr. 3/ 50 Brig./ 25 Div. / IX Preus. Korps/ II Armee
dst: 黑森步兵第3团/ 第50旅/ 第25师 / 第9普鲁士军/ 第2集团军

src: Hess. Inf. Reg. Nr. 4/ 50 Brig./ 25 Div. / IX Preus. Korps/ II Armee
dst: 黑森步兵第4团/ 第50旅/ 第25师 / 第9普鲁士军/ 第2集团军

src: Hess. J鋑er Bat. Nr.1/ 49 Brig./ 25 Div. / IX Preus. Korps/ II Armee
dst: 黑森猎兵第1营/ 第49旅/ 第25师 / 第9普鲁士军/ 第2集团军
海特 第1/第3伞兵团/拉姆克
海特/第拉姆克旅/[非洲军]

src: Hi, General, welcome back! It must be tiring to cross most of France in just a few days, but I hope that you're ready for more action.
dst: 嗨，将军，欢迎回来！短短几天内横穿大半个法国想必十分疲惫，但我希望您已准备好迎接更多行动。

src: High Command has decided now is the time to defeat England. You and your elite troops have been chosen to lead the invasion of the British Isles.
dst: 最高统帅部已决定，现在是击败英格兰的时候。你和你的精锐部队被选中领导对不列颠群岛的入侵。

src: High Command sends you a prototype unit, the A39 Tortoise heavy assault tank, for testing and evaluation.
dst: 最高统帅部拨给你一支原型单位——A39 陆龟重型突击坦克，供测试与评估之用。

src: High Command wants us to capture this airfield and either capture or destroy the radio station before they can alert the local defense.
dst: 最高统帅部要我们夺取这座机场，并在敌人能向当地守军报警之前，夺取或摧毁那座无线电台。

src: High Command would like to see us expand our base and release some of the enemy pressure. This is not impossible, but only a cunning and a courageous leader may succeed against all odds.
dst: 最高统帅部希望我们扩大基地、为敌军减压。这并非不可能，但唯有狡黠而勇毅的指挥官，方能逆势成功。

src: High command send congratulations -stop- Emperor Hiro-Hito is deeply happy with this victory -stop- Headquarters expects to keep the beach head with the first hours of the morning - stop- The invasion of Pearl Harbor has also been a success -stop- The Yamato with a warship group is sailing to San Francisco - stop- Kitto-Kattsu - end of transmission-.
dst: 最高统帅部发来贺电——停——裕仁天皇对此次胜利深感欣慰——停——大本营希望在清晨头几个小时内守住滩头阵地——停——对珍珠港的入侵亦已成功——停——大和号正率一支战舰编队驶向旧金山——停——必胜！——电文完——。
Hindenburg / 港口警戒部队 Ostende-Ost

src: Hindenburg and Ludendorff have decided on a defensive strategy on the Western Front for 1917 and have pulled our troops back on the easier to defend Hindenburg Linie. The British and French public opinion is not pleased with the bloodshed at Verdun, Gallipoli and the Somme that did not result in any type of victory. British and French forces keep on searching for ways to brake the stalemate by trying to force a breakthrough. Their latest attempt is a simultaneous British attack near Arras and French attack on the Aisne.
dst: 兴登堡和鲁登道夫决定1917年西线采取防御战略，并将我们的部队撤回到更易防守的兴登堡防线。英法舆论对凡尔登、加利波利和索姆河那些未换来任何胜利的流血伤亡深感不满。英法军队一直在寻找打破僵局的办法，试图强行突破。他们最近的尝试是英军进攻阿拉斯附近、法军进攻埃纳河的同步行动。
美国佐治亚州海恩斯维尔

src: Hint 2: Watch out for any unusual circumstances and use them to your advantage! There are roaming enemy fast units (mostly the cavalry and light tanks) securing the enemy rear, don't run into them.
dst: 提示2：警惕任何异常情况，并善加利用！有敌军快速部队（多为骑兵和轻型坦克）在敌军后方游弋，别撞上他们。

src: Hint: After initial success, the German armies more and more flounder in the extremely strong and deep Soviet defense. One line after another falls down, just to be followed by yet another one... Every time the Germans get through, they lose men, machines, time, patience and morale...
dst: 提示：在初期的成功之后，德军越来越深地陷入苏军极其坚固、纵深的防御而无法自拔。一道又一道防线被突破，紧随其后的却是又一道……德军每突破一次，就损失兵员、装备、时间、耐心和士气……

src: Hint: After we've broken through the initial defensive line, we must secure the area and hold the counterattack. Capture and hold the VHs... and then we may finally rush south towards Moscow.
dst: 提示：突破最初的防线后，我们必须肃清该区域并顶住反攻。夺取并守住胜利格……然后我们才能最终南进，直指莫斯科。

src: Hint: As you have realized during the Western campaign, Allied tanks are very powerful, same as their planes.
dst: 提示：正如你在西线战役中意识到的那样，盟军的坦克非常强大，他们的飞机也一样。

src: Hint: Be very careful with your advance. The terrain is confusing and the morning fog does not help with a proper reconnaisance. Don't lead your men into some trap...
dst: 提示：推进时要格外小心。地形错综复杂，晨雾也不利于正常侦察。别把部下带进陷阱……

src: Hint: Czechoslovaks captured Hitler's own "befehl" that orders an extreme discipline to the German units. Be ready for a really rugged defense...
dst: 提示：捷克斯洛伐克人缴获了希特勒本人那份要求德军部队极端纪律的“命令”。准备好迎接一场极其顽强的防御吧……

src: Hint: Defenders airforce is annihilated and his air defense is close to none. Your planes may roam free without any fear of interception.
dst: 提示：守军的空军已被全歼，防空也几乎为零。你的飞机可以自由翱翔，无需担心截击。

src: Hint: Don't forget that you may use the city's SH as your own.
dst: 提示：别忘了你可以把城里的 SH 当作己方据点使用。

src: Hint: Enemy units are placed mainly in the cities. However, speed of your advance will be hindered by harsh terrain and ground conditions. Garrison of Liptovsky Sv. Mikulas is quite strong!
dst: 提示：敌军主要部署在城里。不过，崎岖的地形和地面状况会阻碍你的推进速度。利普托夫斯基米库拉什的守军相当强大！

src: Hint: Hold a compact formation, isolated men will be an easy target to pick. Germans seem to not know of your presence and they march southwards from the hamlet without much caution. If you could deal them a strong enough blow, they'll run away before they realize how small your forces are.
dst: 提示：保持队形紧凑，落单的人很容易被盯上。德军似乎不知道你的存在，他们正从村庄向南行进，毫无戒备。若能给他们足够沉重的一击，他们就会在你兵力如此之少被察觉之前逃之夭夭。

src: Hint: Hold tight formation and proceed slowly. Roads and cities are devastated from previous fights, so you won't be able to do some fast maneuvres no matter what. Since the last combat actions ended in this sector, our engineers were able to remove most of the mines. But once it was obvious that the Zitadelle operation failed, there was no reason to continue clearing, so don't ride into the old minefields. To make things even worse - don't forget that Soviets layed these mines, so they knew how to avoid them...
dst: 提示：保持紧密队形，缓慢推进。道路和城市已被此前的战斗破坏，所以无论如何你都做不了快速机动。自从这一防区的最后一次战斗结束后，我方工兵已清除了大部分地雷。但一旦“堡垒”行动失败已成定局，就没有理由继续排雷了，所以别驶进旧的雷场。更糟的是——别忘了这些雷是苏联人埋的，他们知道怎么避开……

src: Hint: Let the Germans crack on your defense. Don't proceed alone. Be careful of enemy reserves.
dst: 提示：让德军在你的防线上撞个头破血流。别单独行动。提防敌军预备队。

src: Hint: Luftwaffe have sent most of its planes into even more endangered sectors. We're not going to get any air support.
dst: 提示：德国空军已把大部分飞机派往更危急的防区。我们得不到任何空中支援。

src: Hint: Luftwaffe is seriously depleted, but Soviet pilots have different tasks. Your airplanes will rule the skies...
dst: 提示：德国空军已严重损耗，但苏军飞行员另有任务。你的飞机将主宰天空……

src: Hint: Once you capture Ostrava, you may use the city as a base for further operations...
dst: 提示：一旦你攻下俄斯特拉发，就可以把该城作为进一步行动的基地……

src: Hint: Our lines copy the terrain and are quite solid, but the lack of personnel makes them very vulnerable to concentrated attack of armoured units. Russian command knowing of this fact have sent the whole tank division to break the line and mar the preparations for our upcomimg operation. They are concentrated in the NW. You must not only stop the Soviets, but drive them away totally.
dst: 提示：我们的防线依地形布设，相当坚固，但兵员不足使它们极易被装甲部队的集中突击所突破。俄军指挥部深知这一点，派出了整个坦克师来突破防线、破坏我们即将展开的行动的准备。他们集中在西北方向。你不仅要挡住苏联人，还要把他们彻底赶走。

src: Hint: Poles have withdrawn across the river, leaving the whole clearway unoccupied, thus making their defense very strong.
dst: 提示：波兰人已撤过河对岸，整条通路空无一人，因而他们的防御非常坚固。

src: Hint: Some reinforcements (naval, air and ground) are on their way from SE, but due to bad weather they'll come in several hours or even later. Rush to the VH, so that the enemy does not escape before our reinforcements join the battle.
dst: 提示：一些增援（海军、空军和地面部队）正从东南方向赶来，但由于天气恶劣，他们要几个小时甚至更晚才能到。冲向胜利格，别让敌人在我方增援参战之前逃掉。

src: Hint: The German morale is inconsistent. Third Reich has lost the war and the armistice is a matter of hours or days. But although the greenhorn and second grade units may crumble easily, and it is expected that they will lay down arms once the truce comes into effect, the experienced soldiers, and those that fear their fate in Soviet hands will fight to the last breath. And the men of SS, guilty of many war crimes, will never surrender.
dst: 提示：德军士气参差不齐。第三帝国已输掉战争，停战只是几小时或几天的事。虽然新兵和二流部队可能轻易崩溃——预计停战一生效他们就会放下武器——但老兵和那些惧怕落入苏军之手的人会战斗到最后一口气。而犯下众多战争罪行的党卫军，绝不会投降。

src: Hint: The Soviets have overwhelming superiority. You can't do more than hold the lines for the time ordered. Soviet units are strong, experienced and omnipresent.
dst: 提示：苏军拥有压倒性优势。你所能做的，就是按命令时限守住防线。苏军单位强大、经验丰富、无处不在。

src: Hint: There are mobile forces moving towards our base. Be careful, precise and cunning.
dst: 提示：有快速部队正朝我方基地移动。要小心、精准、机敏。

src: Hint: This is once again a smaller scenario, yet it is quite crowded. Although there were mainly artillery forces at Jaslo, you may wish to place mostly the tanks.
dst: 提示：这又是一个较小的场景，但相当拥挤。虽然亚斯沃主要是炮兵部队，你或许还是想多部署坦克。

src: Hint: This scenario uses limited deployment, use the "View the Strategic Map" feature first!
dst: 提示：本场景使用受限部署，请先使用“查看战略地图”功能！

src: Hint: Use terrain to your advantage... or at least don't let the enemy use it to his advantage.
dst: 提示：善用地形……至少别让敌人利用地形占便宜。

src: Hint: We have a huge air dominance over the region, as the enemy airplanes must fly from a distant airfields. Americans once again launched an amphibious operation and there were even the gliders spotted above the sea, but most of their units comes from the west, where they broke through our lines. Their British and French allies are in the southwest and their advance guards already crossed the rivette.
dst: 提示：我们对该地区拥有巨大的空中优势，因为敌机必须从遥远的机场起飞。美国人再次发动了两栖行动，甚至在海面上空发现了滑翔机，但他们大部分部队来自西面，正是他们突破了我们的防线。他们的英法盟友在西南方向，其先头部队已经渡过了那条小河。

src: Hint: You are lost deep in the desert. There's a wellspring in the oasis (represented by the Retreat Hex), so just let your men quench their thirst there... right after you defeat or evict the defenders.
dst: 提示：你在沙漠深处迷路了。绿洲里有一眼泉（以撤退格表示），所以让你的士兵在那儿解渴吧……不过得先击败或赶走守军。

src: Hint: You may find a long-barelled AT gun very useful. Take care of terrain, try to not get stuck in a deep snow.
dst: 提示：你可能会发现长管反坦克炮非常有用。注意地形，尽量别陷进深雪里。

src: Hint: You'll be given orders through turn messages, so don't miss them. Once you'll tame the German assault, you should try to reach their SH so that you'll get some additional prestige.
dst: 提示：你会通过回合消息接到命令，所以别错过。一旦你制服了德军攻势，应设法抵达他们的 SH，以获取额外声望。

src: Hint: You'll notice that there are no enemy flags. We're far from the Soviet-German front, and the Soviet comrades are exactly that - comrades, not enemies.
dst: 提示：你会注意到这里没有敌方旗帜。我们远离苏德前线，苏联同志们就是同志，不是敌人。
希尔西夫卡 (吉尔索夫卡)

src: His bones still lie anywhere under the hot sun of Africa.
dst: 他的遗骨仍躺在非洲炎炎烈日下的某个地方。

src: His dead face haunted me on the long railway trip to Transylvania. I am almost relieved that we are now going into action again, and there is no time anymore for those dark thoughts. Soon the fighting will start again, as we are supposed to repulse the Romanians who have crossed the Carpathians and swiftly advanced as far as Hermannstadt, deep into Transylvania, after they had declared war on Austria-Hungary in August.
dst: 在前往特兰西瓦尼亚的漫长火车旅途中，他死去的面容一直萦绕着我。如今我们又要投入战斗，我反而几乎松了口气，再也没有时间去想那些阴暗的念头。战斗很快会再度打响，因为我们奉命击退罗马尼亚人——他们在8月向奥匈帝国宣战后，已越过喀尔巴阡山脉，迅速推进到赫尔曼施塔特，深入特兰西瓦尼亚腹地。

src: His plan for next year is to take complete Control of Southeast Gaul...
dst: 他明年的计划是完全掌控高卢东南部......

src: His troops have theur camp at Salinae Hercalea. Prepare your wild bunch for it !!!
dst: 他的部队在赫拉克利亚盐场扎营。把你的乌合之众准备好！！！

src: Historcial Note: The invasion of Sicily was the logical continuation of the North African campaign, since capturing the island meant regaining almost complete control over the Mediterranean. The Allies also had a secondary goal: force Germany to pull land and air forces away from the Eastern front in order to defend it's Southern side, thereby easing the pressure on Russia. On July 4th and 5th, while enroute to Sicily, the Canadian assault convoy was attacked by U-boats off the coast of Algeria, losing 3 supply ships and over 500 vehicles, but none the less, Operation Husky was the campaign in which the Canadians started to come together as an effective fighting force...
dst: 历史注记：入侵西西里是北非战役合乎逻辑的延续，因为夺取该岛意味着几乎完全重掌地中海。盟军还有一个次要目标：迫使德国从东线抽调陆空军力来防守其南翼，从而减轻俄国的压力。7月4日和5日，加拿大突击船队在驶往西西里途中于阿尔及利亚海岸外遭到U艇攻击，损失3艘补给船和500余台车辆。尽管如此，「哈士奇」行动仍是加拿大人开始凝聚为一支善战之师的战役……

src: Historians estimate that several million Gauls were killed during the fighting. Caesar himself says in "De Bello Gallico" tersely " .... the remaining several tens of thousands were killed ..... "
dst: 史家估计，战事期间有数百万高卢人被杀。凯撒本人在《高卢战记》里只简略地说：「……余下的数万人被杀……」

src: Historic aftermath: After a hard fight, the Germans stopped the British attack and forced them to reembark, leaving more than 800 casualties, against about 50 dead on the German side. Also many war supplies were abandoned, among them enough English rifles to equip three Askari companies, 600.000 rounds and 16 machine guns. Besides, the native soldiers learned that they could defeat an European army. This defeat cost Major-General Aitken his command.
dst: 历史结局：经过一番苦战，德军阻止了英军的进攻，并迫使他们重新登船撤退，英军留下了800多人的伤亡，而德军方面仅阵亡约50人。此外，大量军用物资被遗弃，其中包括足以装备三个阿斯卡里连的英式步枪、60万发子弹和16挺机枪。而且，当地士兵认识到他们能够击败一支欧洲军队。这场败仗使艾特肯少将失去了指挥权。

src: Historic aftermath: British troops landed in a swamp where they were stopped by fire from the German troops. The raid lasted two days and then the German troops evacuated the town. Casualties for both sides were light. After the retreat of the German troops, the British destroyed the fort and the wireless station. Some units were granted permission to loot the town, but this soon got out of hand.  There was much burning, robbing and destruction.  Due to this incident the British changed commanders and appointed General Smuts as head of their forces.
dst: 历史结局：英军在一片沼泽地登陆，被德军火力所阻。这次袭击持续了两天，随后德军撤离了该镇。双方伤亡都很轻微。德军撤退后，英军摧毁了堡垒和无线电台。一些部队获准劫掠该镇，但很快就失控了。烧杀抢掠、破坏横行。由于这一事件，英军更换了指挥官，任命斯马茨将军为部队统帅。

src: Historic aftermath: During the advance coordination between the sudafrican brigades was lost and the attack was launched on different days.  This allowed von Lettow to defeat each in turn.
dst: 历史结局：在推进过程中，南非各旅之间失去了协调，进攻在不同日子发起。这使冯·莱托得以逐个击破。

src: Historic aftermath: The British tried to outflank the Germans so they would be surrounded and defeated. Van Deventer's Mounted Brigade was the unit chosen to try the flanking movement. As the Germans were strongly entrenched, Van Deventer lacked the force to push further and once again the German troops escaped.
dst: 历史结局：英军试图迂回包抄德军，使其陷入包围并被歼灭。范德文特骑马旅被选作执行这次迂回行动的部队。由于德军构筑了坚固的工事，范德文特无力继续推进，德军部队又一次逃脱。

src: Historic aftermath: The German assault began on May 7, with the German forces advancing and Van Deventer withdrawing to the town itself. Further German assaults meet with a determined defense and were stopped cold. The German forces dug into their positions to the south and held for two more months.  They switched to a tactic of raids on supply columns and artillery barrages on Kondoa
dst: 历史结局：德军于5月7日开始突击，德军部队向前推进，范德文特撤退到镇内。德军的后续突击遭遇了坚决的防御，被硬生生挡下。德军部队在南面挖掘工事据守，又坚持了两个多月。他们转而采取袭击补给纵队和对孔多阿实施炮击的战术。
历史上的爱沙尼亚独立斗争战役

src: Historical Note: Although some Wehrmacht and Finnish army officers tried to organize a relatively peaceful withdrawal, the fighting became real when the Finns sought to comply with the Soviet demand that all German troops be expelled from Finland. The Finns' task was complicated by the Soviet demand that the major part of Finnish armed forces must be demobilized at the same time, even during the campaign against the Germans. The Finns struck first at Tornio, and in October-November 1944, drove them out of the greater part of northern Finland. The German forces retaliated by using scorched earth tactics, devastating large areas of northern Finland. More than a third of the dwellings in this area were destroyed, and the provincial capital of Rovaniemi was burned to the ground. The last German troops were expelled from Finland in April 1945.
dst: 历史注记：尽管国防军和芬兰军的一些军官曾试图组织相对和平的撤军，但当芬兰人为满足苏联关于驱逐全部德军出境的要求而采取行动时，战斗便真正打响了。芬兰人的任务因苏联同时要求芬兰武装力量主力复员而更趋复杂，即便这一要求是在对德作战期间提出的。芬兰人首先在托尔尼奥发难，并于1944年10月至11月将德军逐出芬兰北部的大部地区。德军以焦土战术报复，摧毁了芬兰北部的大片区域。该地区三分之一以上的住宅被毁，省会罗瓦涅米被烧成平地。最后一批德军于1945年4月被逐出芬兰。

src: Historical Note: In early October 1944, the Allies controlled the harbours north of the Seine but the supply issue was not yet solved: Dieppe, Le Treport and Ostende had been opened but could not handle the high volumes that Allied troops in Europe required. Le Havre, Boulogne and Calais were not serviceable having suffered major destruction. Further north, Antwerp had been liberated by the Allies on September 3rd, but the city was located on the Scheldt River, 80 kilometres from the open sea and the river's mouth was still under German control. The only way to make sure that the supplies required by the campaign in Europe could enter the continent was to capture the Scheldt...
dst: 历史注记：1944年10月初，盟军已控制塞纳河以北的各港口，但补给问题仍未解决：迪耶普、勒特雷波尔和奥斯坦德虽已启用，却无力吞吐欧洲盟军所需的巨大运量。勒阿弗尔、布洛涅和加来因遭受严重破坏而无法使用。再往北，安特卫普已于9月3日被盟军解放，但该城位于斯海尔德河畔，距出海口的80公里河道仍控制在德军手中。要确保欧洲战役所需的补给运进大陆，唯一的办法就是夺取斯海尔德河……

src: Historical Note: Malta was one of the most heavily bombed areas of the entire war. The intensity with which Hitler pounded Malta attested to the importance of the island to the Mediterranean theatre of war, but in the spring of 1942, when Spitfires and Hurricanes flown from the deck of the carrier HMS Eagle arrived at the battered island, the battle over Malta took a new turn. At last, though still heavily outnumbered, the volunteer pilots from Britain, Australia, America, Canada, and New Zealand were able to put up a meaningful defense. Never again would the Axis raids be met only with token resistance, and gradually the Allied fighters began to dominate the sky above the beleaguered island. They had arrived in the nick of time...
dst: 历史注记：马耳他是整场战争中遭受轰炸最猛烈的地区之一。希特勒倾泻在马耳他身上的火力之烈，正说明了该岛对地中海战区的重要意义。然而1942年春，当从「鹰」号航空母舰甲板上起飞的喷火式和飓风式战斗机抵达这座饱受摧残的岛屿时，马耳他上空的空战出现了转机。来自英国、澳大利亚、美国、加拿大和新西兰的志愿飞行员虽然依旧在数量上处于绝对劣势，却终于能够组织起有效的防御。轴心国的空袭再也不会只遭到象征性的抵抗，盟军战斗机逐渐开始主宰这座被困岛屿的天空。他们来得正是时候……

src: Historical Note: On August 14, the 2nd Canadian Infantry Division set out again to take Falaise. It's ruins finally fell on August 17. Meanwhile, the 4th Canadian and the 1st Polish Armoured Divisions hurried to block the German line of retreat just east of the town. As American and Free French forces sped from the south toward Argentan and Chambois, the 4th Canadian Armoured occupied Trun from the north. While the division prepared a line of defence along the Falaise-Trun-Chambois highway to bar the Germans from breaking out of the pocket, most of the 1st Polish Armoured took up position further east to head off the imminent enemy attempt to break in and extricate their comrades. The rest of it drove on to Chambois and there joined forces with American troops. The Falaise Gap was as good as closed at last..
dst: 历史注记：8月14日，加拿大第2步兵师再次出发夺取法莱斯。该城的废墟终于在8月17日陷落。与此同时，加拿大第4装甲师和波兰第1装甲师赶往城镇以东封堵德军的退路。当美军和自由法国部队自南面疾趋阿尔让唐和香布瓦时，加拿大第4装甲师自北面占领了特兰。在该师沿法莱斯—特兰—香布瓦公路布设防线以阻止德军突围的同时，波兰第1装甲师主力在更东面展开，迎击敌军即将发起的突入接应。其残部直趋香布瓦，与美军会师。法莱斯缺口至此终于基本合拢..

src: Historical Note: On July 4th, 1944, in preparation for the move on Caen, the Canadians moved against the village of Carpiquet. Concealed in concrete pillboxes and bunkers that defended the city, the Germans fired relentlessly at the approaching Canadian troops. The city, and later, the airfield, were finally captured after intense combat. Also In preparation for the assault on Caen, the Allies had ordered massive air strikes. The Germans started to fall back under the pressure. The city was liberated, but only in part: the enemy still held the southern sector on the other side of the Orne River. On July 18th, an air raid that dropped 7,700 tonnes of bombs, synchronized with counter-battery fire from 33 artillery regiments, preceded the crossing of the Orne River by the British and the Canadians....
dst: 历史注记：1944年7月4日，为进攻卡昂作准备，加拿大人向卡尔皮凯村发起攻击。德军隐蔽在保卫该城的混凝土碉堡和掩体里，向逼近的加拿大部队不停射击。经过激战，该城、随后是机场终于被攻占。同样是为进攻卡昂作准备，盟军还下令实施了大规模空袭。德军在压力下开始后撤。该城获得解放，但只是部分解放：敌军仍据守奥恩河对岸的南部地区。7月18日，一场投下7,700吨炸弹的空袭，配合33个炮兵团的压制射击，为英军和加拿大人强渡奥恩河拉开了序幕....

src: Historical Note: Operation Jubilee was the lowest point of the war for the Canadians. It was their first major ground action of WW2, and it was a disaster. The Germans had advance warning when in the early hours of Aug 19th, the eastern sector invasion force encountered a small German convoy. The noise of the ensuing Naval battle alerted the coastal defences. That, combined with an ill-conceived plan, doomed the operation before it had even started. Although the operation was a failure, the lessons learned about fire support, pre-invasion bombing and other tactics, helped reduce the casualties of D-Day to an unexpected minimum...
dst: 历史注记：「庆典」行动是加拿大人在战争中的最低点。这是他们在二战中的首次重大地面行动，却是一场灾难。8月19日凌晨，东路登陆编队遭遇一支德国小型船队，德军因此提前获得警报。随后的海战惊动了岸防部队。这一点，加上一个构想拙劣的计划，使这次行动在尚未开始之时就已注定失败。尽管行动失败了，但从火力支援、登陆前轰炸和其他战术中汲取的教训，却帮助把D日的伤亡降到出人意料的最低限度...

src: Historical Note: Operation Overlord, of which the landing at Juno Beach was a part, was only one step of a global strategic plan for the complete defeat of Nazi Germany. The Normandy landings were designed to establish  bridgeheads from which two armies, the First US Army on the west flank and the Second British Army to the east could be supplied by sea. With the bridgeheads firmly secured, the armies were to move on to liberate France and the neighbouring countries. Germany, attacked on three separate fronts, in Northwest Europe, in Russia, and in the Mediterranean, would soon be exhausted and defeated. As D-Day drew to an end, the Canadians had managed to advance quite deeply towards Creully, Colomby-sur-Thaon and Anisy, short of their assigned target of Carpiquet Airfield, but far enough to make the operation a definite success....
dst: 历史注记：朱诺海滩登陆所隶属的「霸王」行动，只是彻底击败纳粹德国这一全球战略计划中的一步。诺曼底登陆旨在建立滩头堡，以便西翼的美国第一集团军和东翼的英国第二集团军能够经由海路获得补给。滩头堡一旦巩固，两支集团军便将进而解放法国及其邻国。德国在西北欧、俄国和地中海三条战线上同时遭到攻击，很快就会精疲力竭并被击败。随着D日临近尾声，加拿大人已深深推进到克勒利、科隆比叙托和阿尼西一线，虽未达成夺取卡尔皮凯机场的指定目标，但足以使这次行动取得确定无疑的成功....

src: Historical Note: Operation Veritable, which began on 8 Feb 45, and later, Operation Blockbuster, 25 Feb 45, were designed to overcome the three defensive German lines built within the 30 km gap between the Maas and Rhine Rivers east of Nijmegen. Also known as the Siegfried Lines, these German positions consisted of trenches, anti-tank traps and wire belts which ran between towns and farmhouses. Behind the lines was German territory, including the cities of Cleve, Goch, Calcar, Geldern and Xanten. The plan was to clear the area west of the Rhine river, then link up with American forces pushing up from the south, (Operation Grenade 23 Feb 45). During this month of fighting, the First Canadian Army lost 15,634 killed, wounded or missing, including 5,304 Canadians, but they had gained the banks of the Rhine which marked the last major line of German defence.
dst: 历史注记：2月8日发起的「真实」行动，以及随后2月25日的「巨磅」行动，旨在突破奈梅亨以东、马斯河与莱茵河之间30公里缺口内构筑的三道德军防线。这些阵地又称齐格菲防线，由堑壕、反坦克陷阱和铁丝网带组成，在城镇与农舍之间延伸。防线之后便是德国本土，包括克莱沃、戈赫、卡尔卡、盖尔登和克桑滕等城市。计划是先肃清莱茵河以西地区，再与自南面推进的美军会师（2月23日的「手榴弹」行动）。在这一个月的战斗中，加拿大第一集团军伤亡失踪达15,634人，其中加拿大人5,304名，但他们夺得了莱茵河沿岸——德军最后一道主要防线。

src: Historical Note: The Canadian Army's role in these final days of the war was to open up the supply route to the north through Arnhem, and then to clear the northeast and western Netherlands. Near Zutphen, Canadian soldiers liberated Stalag VI C, a camp for Russian POWs captured on the Eastern front. After occupying Zwolle, the Canadians then pressed on further north, but by then, the might of the Wehrmacht had been broken. Liberation Day, (Dutch: Bevrijdingsdag), is celebrated each year on May 5 in the Netherlands to mark the end of the German occupation during the Second World War. The nation was liberated largely by Canadian troops and to thank them each year, thousands of Tulip bulbs are sent to Ottawa where the annual May Tulip Festival is held.
dst: 历史注记：在这场战争的最后日子里，加拿大军队的任务是打通经阿纳姆向北的补给线，随后肃清荷兰东北部与西部。在聚特芬附近，加拿大士兵解放了Stalag VI C——一座关押东线被俘苏军战俘的战俘营。占领兹沃勒之后，加拿大人继续向北推进，但到那时，德国国防军的威力早已被摧毁。荷兰每年5月5日庆祝解放日（荷兰语：Bevrijdingsdag），以纪念第二次世界大战期间德国占领的结束。这个国家主要是由加拿大军队解放的；为了感谢他们，每年都有数千颗郁金香球茎被送往渥太华，并在那里举办一年一度的五月郁金香节。

src: Historical aftermath: After playing cat and mouse with the Entente colonial armies for more than four years during which he never suffered a decisive defeat.  This in spite of being desperately outnumbered.  Von Lettow-Vorbeck surrendered in Abercorn on 23 November 1918 after learning of the armistice that had been signed in France 12 days before.  His remaining army then consisted of 30 German officers, 125 German non-commissioned officers and other enlisted ranks, 1,168 Askaris and some 3,500 porters.
dst: 历史结局：在与协约国殖民军队周旋四年多、从未遭受决定性失败之后——尽管他处于极度劣势的兵力对比——冯·莱托-福尔贝克在得知法国12天前签订的停战协定后，于1918年11月23日在阿伯康投降。他剩余的军队当时包括30名德国军官、125名德国士官及其他士兵、1168名阿斯卡里士兵和约3500名挑夫。

src: Historical aftermath: After three frontal assaults and hundreds of casualties, the 5th South African Regiment managed to take both hills. By then the night had already fallen and the British commander Brigadier General Tighe not knowing the location of his different units and fearing a counterattack ordered a withdrawal.  However, in the confusion of the night the Germans didn't notice this and by the time they discovered that the hills were clear it was too late to mount a counterattack, since most companies were already on their way to Kahe.  Thus, Von Lettow had to leave the region of Taveta and retreat to the Kahe railway station.
dst: 历史结局：在三次正面突击和数百人的伤亡之后，南非第5团终于攻占了两座山头。此时夜幕已经降临，英军指挥官泰赫准将不知道各部队的位置，又担心反击，便下令撤退。然而，在黑夜的混乱中德军并未察觉，等他们发现山头已空时，已来不及发动反击，因为大部分连队已经在前往卡赫的路上了。于是，冯·莱托不得不离开塔韦塔地区，撤退到卡赫火车站。

src: Historical aftermath: Although numerically superior, the British discovered that Salaita was much more heavily defended than they had thought. German troops, under local commander Maj. Kraut, inflicted heavy losses on the enemy and managed to make an orderly retreat.
dst: 历史结局：尽管在数量上占优，英军却发现萨拉伊塔的防守比他们想象的要强得多。德军部队在当地指挥官克劳特少校的带领下，给敌人造成了重大损失，并得以有序撤退。

src: Historical aftermath: Although the Germans viciously attacked the Kibata Hills, the British colonial troops strongly resisted.  This allowed them to kept some strategic positions. However, fearing a new German offensive, the British High Command decided not to reinforce Lindi and canceled their offensive for taking Liwale.
dst: 历史结局：尽管德军凶猛地进攻基巴塔丘陵，英国殖民地军队进行了顽强抵抗。这使他们得以保住一些战略阵地。然而，由于担心德军新的攻势，英军最高统帅部决定不增援林迪，并取消了攻取利瓦莱的攻势。

src: Historical aftermath: Following Von Lettow's own words, Mahiwa was a "brilliant victory" for his army. It was the bloodiest African battle of WWI for the British army.  It suffered more than 2,500 casualties. However, the German losses were also high and few German soldiers managed to cross the Rovuma river into Portuguese East Africa.
dst: 历史结局：用冯·莱托自己的话说，马希瓦是他军队的一场「辉煌胜利」。对英军而言，这是第一次世界大战中非洲最血腥的一仗。英军伤亡超过2500人。然而，德军损失也很高，只有少数德军士兵渡过鲁伍马河进入葡属东非。

src: Historical aftermath: For some months the Germans mounted a series of raids in the Uganda railway aimed at disrupting the British supplies. These raids tried to blow bridges and plant mines in the railway. The British countered with patrols and painting the railway bed white to show removed earth. Consequently the Germans started bringing their own paint and started using delayed fuses.  This countered the British use of a flatbed car before the locomotive.
dst: 历史结局：几个月里，德军对乌干达铁路发动了一系列袭击，目的是破坏英军补给。这些袭击试图炸毁桥梁、在铁路上埋设地雷。英军以巡逻队和在路基上刷白漆来显示翻动过的泥土作为应对。于是德军也开始自带油漆，并开始使用延时引信。这破解了英军把平板车置于机车之前的做法。

src: Historical aftermath: In September the Belgians entered into the town of  Tabora thus fulfilling all of their initial objectives.  However the German resistance decimated the Belgian troops and many of Wahle´s men were able to escape Tabora.  For many months Wahle continued to fight the Allied forces.
dst: 历史结局：9月，比利时人进入塔波拉镇，从而实现了他们的全部初始目标。然而，德军的抵抗使比利时军队损失惨重，瓦勒手下的许多人得以逃离塔波拉。此后数月，瓦勒继续与协约国军队作战。

src: Historical aftermath: Led by the former commander of the cruiser "Könisberg" Captain Max Looff, the German garrison counterattacked fiercely and defeated the Portuguese.  They promptly crossed back over the Rovuma on November 28th.
dst: 历史结局：由「柯尼斯堡」号巡洋舰前舰长马克斯·洛夫上校率领，德军守备队凶猛地反击并击败了葡萄牙人。他们随即于11月28日越过鲁伍马河撤回。

src: Historical aftermath: Narungombe was a defensive victory for the Germans. The British advance was  once again halted and Von Lettow was free to move his army to the south.
dst: 历史结局：纳龙贡贝之战是德军的一场防御性胜利。英军的推进再次被阻止，冯·莱托得以自由地把军队调往南方。

src: Historical aftermath: The British resistance was very hard and although they finally surrendered, they inflicted heavy casualties on the Germans. Aware that he could not replace his losses, Lettow-Vorbeck decided to avoid any more large scale battles and start a guerrilla warfare.  This would come against the Uganda Railway.
dst: 历史后续：英军的抵抗非常顽强，尽管他们最终投降了，但给德军造成了惨重伤亡。莱托-福尔贝克意识到自己无法弥补损失，遂决定避免再打任何大规模战役，转而开展游击战。而这将针对乌干达铁路展开。

src: Historical aftermath: The British resistance was very strong and although they finally surrendered, they inflicted heavy casualties on the Germans. Aware that he could not replace his losses Lettow-Vorbeck decided to avoid any more large scale battles and start guerrilla warfare. His first attack was against the Uganda Railway.
dst: 历史结局：英军的抵抗非常顽强，尽管他们最终投降了，但仍给德军造成了惨重伤亡。莱托-福尔贝克意识到自己无法弥补损失，于是决定避免任何大规模战斗，转而开展游击战。他的第一次袭击针对的是乌干达铁路。

src: Historical aftermath: The battle of Namacurra was a complete success for the Germans.  They got all the supplies they needed for a prolonged resistance.
dst: 历史结局：纳马库拉之战对德军而言是一次完全的成功。他们得到了长期抵抗所需的所有补给。

src: Historical aftermath: The portuguese army was completetly defeated.  They suffered more than 200 casualties and about 700 prisioners. Teixeira Pinto and part of his staff were killed early in the battle. Even after firing more than 30,000 rounds, they only inflicted 1 german and a few askaris dead. Lettow captured a huge quantity of ammunition and enough portuguese rifles to arm his troops.  Now they could discard the old ones. The german Askaris shouted "This is the day of the old rifles!", refering to their victory with older weapons.
dst: 历史结局：葡萄牙军队被彻底击败。他们伤亡200多人，约700人被俘。特谢拉·平托及其部分参谋在战斗初期阵亡。尽管发射了3万多发子弹，他们只打死了1名德国人和几名阿斯卡里土著兵。莱托缴获了大量弹药和足够武装其部队的葡萄牙步枪。现在他们可以淘汰旧枪了。德军阿斯卡里士兵高呼「今天是老枪之日！」，意指他们用更旧的武器取得了胜利。

src: Historical note--- The war finally end in April of 1939 with the rebel victory after the fall of Catalunya and the surrender of Madrid to rebels.
dst: 历史注记---战争最终于1939年4月以叛军的胜利告终，此前加泰罗尼亚陷落，马德里向叛军投降。

src: Historical note--- The war finally ended in April, 1939 with the rebel victory after the fall of Catalunya and the surrender of Madrid to rebels.  The prelude to WWII was over, and September 1, 1939 was quickly approaching.
dst: 历史注记---战争最终于1939年4月以叛军的胜利告终，此前加泰罗尼亚陷落，马德里向叛军投降。第二次世界大战的序幕至此落幕，1939年9月1日正迅速临近。

src: Historical note:  In the last week of August 1944, the entire Canadian Corps began its attack on the Gothic Line with the objective of capturing Rimini. Six rivers lay across the path of the advance. On August 25, the Canadians crossed the Metauro River but the next, the Foglia was more formidable. Here the Germans had concentrated their defences, and it required days of bitter fighting and softening of the line by Allied air forces to reach it. On August 30, the Canadians crossed the Foglia River and fought their way to the Conca River, where the forward troops came under fire from the German 1st Parachute Division, while to the west heavy fighting was developing on the Coriano Ridge. By hard fighting the Canadians captured the ridge and it appeared that the Gothic Line was finally about to collapse, but this was not to be. For three more weeks the Canadians battled to take the hill position of San Fortunato which blocked the approach to the Po Valley. On September 21, the Allies entered a deserted Rimini. The Canadian Corps was now withdrawn into Army reserve where they could recuperate from the ten weeks of continuous fighting and train for the battles which lay ahead. The Italian campaign continued into the spring of 1945, but the Canadians did not participate in the final victory. In February 1945 the 1st Canadian Corps was re-united with the First Canadian Army in Northwest Europe. There they would join in the drive into Germany and Holland...
dst: 历史注记：1944年8月的最后一周，整个加拿大军开始进攻哥特防线，目标是夺取里米尼。前进的道路上横亘着六条河流。8月25日，加拿大人渡过梅陶罗河，但下一条福利亚河更为险恶。德军在此集中了防御，盟军空军经过数日苦战并软化其防线之后才得以抵达。8月30日，加拿大人渡过福利亚河，一路打到孔卡河，前锋部队在此遭到德国第1伞兵师的火力压制，而西面的科里亚诺岭上激战正酣。加拿大人经苦战夺取了该岭，哥特防线看来终于即将崩溃，但事实并非如此。此后三周，加拿大人为夺取封锁通往波河河谷道路的圣福尔图纳托高地而苦战。9月21日，盟军进入空无一人的里米尼。加拿大军随后被撤入集团军预备队，得以从连续十周的战斗中恢复，并为未来的战斗进行训练。意大利战役一直持续到1945年春，但加拿大人并未参与最后的胜利。1945年2月，加拿大第1军与西北欧的加拿大第一集团军重新会合。他们将在那里加入推进德国和荷兰的作战...

src: Historical note:  Ten years after this battle, the date Feb. 23 was proclaimed to be the official birthday of the Soviet Armed forces.  Dybenko's stunning defeat was masked by the Communist propagandists.
dst: 历史注释：此战十年之后，2月23日被宣布为苏联武装力量的官方诞生日。德边科令人震惊的失败被共产党宣传机器掩盖了。

src: Historical note: As the first snow of winter began to fall, the Eighth Army struck hard at the German line along the Sangro River on the Adriatic Coast. The aim was to break the stalemate that had developed and to relieve the pressure on the Fifth Army in the drive to take Rome. The task was not easy for the Adriatic shoreline was cut by a series of deep river valleys. As the British and Canadians succeeded in driving the Germans from the Sangro, they were faced with the same task a few miles further north. Here, along the line of the Moro River, occurred some of the bitterest fighting of the war. The Germans counter-attacked repeatedly as the Canadians edged forward to Ortona on the coast. At Ortona, during several days of vicious street fighting, the Canadians smashed their way through walls and buildings - "mouseholing" they called it. This was Christmas 1943. Meanwhile, a subsidiary attack had been launched to the northwest, and the Germans, in danger of being cut off, withdrew from Ortona. The city officially fell on December 28....
dst: 历史注记：入冬的第一场雪开始飘落时，第八集团军在亚得里亚海沿岸的桑格罗河一线对德军防线发起猛攻。目的是打破已经形成的僵局，并缓解第五集团军在进军罗马时承受的压力。任务并不轻松，因为亚得里亚海岸被一连串深邃的河谷切割。当英军和加拿大人成功将德军逐出桑格罗河后，往北几英里又面临同样的任务。在莫罗河一线，发生了整场战争中最惨烈的战斗之一。德军反复反击，加拿大人则沿着海岸一寸寸地移向奥托纳。在奥托纳，经过数日激烈的巷战，加拿大人凿穿墙壁和建筑物向前推进——他们称之为「打鼠洞」。此时正值1943年圣诞节。与此同时，西北方向发起的辅助进攻使德军面临被切断的危险，于是他们撤出了奥托纳。该城于12月28日正式陷落....

src: Historical note: During April and May 1944, the British Eighth Army, including the 1st Canadian Corps, was secretly moved across Italy to join the Fifth U.S. Army in the struggle for Rome. Here under the dominating peak of Cassino, the Allied armies hurled themselves against the enemy position. Tanks of the 1st Canadian Armoured Brigade (formerly 1st Canadian Army Tank Brigade) supported the Allied attack. After four days of hard fighting, the German defenses were broken from Cassino to the Tyrrhenian Sea and the enemy moved back to his second line of defence. On May 18 Polish troops took the Cassino position and the battered monastery at the summit. Early on May 23 the attack on the Hitler Line went in. Under heavy enemy mortar and machine-gun fire, the Canadians breached the defences and the tanks of the 5th Armoured Division poured through toward the next obstacle, the Melfa River. Desperate fighting took place in the forming of a bridgehead across the Melfa. However, once the Canadians were over the river, the major fighting for the Liri valley was over...
dst: 历史注记：1944年4月至5月，包括加拿大第1军在内的英国第八集团军被秘密调往意大利各地，与美军第五集团军会合，共同争夺罗马。在卡西诺居高临下的山峰之下，盟军向敌军阵地发起猛攻。加拿大第1装甲旅（前身为加拿大第1集团军坦克旅）的坦克支援了盟军的进攻。经过四天苦战，从卡西诺到第勒尼安海的德军防线被突破，敌军退守第二道防线。5月18日，波兰部队攻占了卡西诺阵地和山顶上弹痕累累的修道院。5月23日凌晨，对希特勒防线的进攻发起。在敌军猛烈的迫击炮和机枪火力下，加拿大人撕开了防线，第5装甲师的坦克涌向下一道障碍——梅尔法河。为在梅尔法河对岸建立桥头堡，双方展开了殊死搏斗。然而加拿大人一渡过河，利里河谷的主要战斗便告结束...

src: Historical note: Operation Baytown was the pre-invasion invasion, the main invasion took place on Sept 9 1943 near Taranto and Salerno. The Italian surrender was "officially" announced on Sept 8th 1943. But unfortunately, the Germans had foreseen this, and were very well prepared to defend without Italian assistance...
dst: 历史注记：「贝敦」行动是登陆前的预演式进攻，真正的登陆于1943年9月9日在塔兰托和萨莱诺附近展开。意大利的投降于1943年9月8日「正式」宣布。但不幸的是，德国人早有预见，在没有意大利协助的情况下也做好了充分的防御准备...

src: Historical note: Operation Gauntlet was one of the first  Allied ground missions in which the Canadians took an active part. After the evacuation, and the demolition of the radio, meteorological, and coal mining facilities on Spitzbergen, the Allied team then carried out a successful ploy to deter the Germans from flying over the island; they began transmitting fake weather reports indicating low cloud cover and fog shrouding the area. The Germans didn't discover what had happened on Spitzbergen until Sept 5...
dst: 历史注记：「铁手套」行动是加拿大人首次积极参与的盟军地面任务之一。在撤离并摧毁斯匹次卑尔根岛上的无线电、气象和采煤设施之后，盟军小队又成功施计阻止德国人飞越该岛：他们开始播发虚假气象报告，声称当地云层低垂、大雾笼罩。直到9月5日，德国人才发现斯匹次卑尔根岛上发生的一切……

src: Historical note: Operation Spartan was the first large scale training  exercise involving the "Jedburghs", an elite special forces unit comprising teams of 3 men, whose mission was: to be dropped into occupied Europe to stir up the resistance, harass enemy movements and tie down as many German divisions as possible. After the liberation of Europe, the Jedburghs then served in the Pacific theatre. Canada, Britain, France and the USA all were involved in Jedburgh operations from 1943 until the end of the war...
dst: 历史注记：「斯巴达」行动是首次涉及「杰德堡」小组的大规模演习。「杰德堡」是一支精锐特种部队，由三人小组编成，其任务是：空降至被占领的欧洲，煽动抵抗运动、袭扰敌军调动，并尽可能牵制德军的师团。欧洲解放之后，「杰德堡」小组又转赴太平洋战区。加拿大、英国、法国和美国自1943年起都参与了「杰德堡」行动，直至战争结束...

src: Historical outcome: After the initial landings, not much advantage was taken of the situation and most troops stayed on the beaches. The Turks had time to bring up reinforcements. The subsequent failure of the Entente's offensives, the persistent lack of progress, and the entry of Bulgaria into the war on the side of the Central Powers opening a second Mediterranean front at Salonika, made the Entente's position untenable and forced the evacuation of the peninsula.
dst: 历史结局：最初的登陆之后，并没有充分利用当时的局面，大多数部队都滞留在海滩上。土耳其人得以从容调来增援。随后协约国攻势的失败、持续缺乏进展，以及保加利亚加入同盟国一方参战、在萨洛尼卡开辟了第二条地中海战线，使协约国的处境无法维持，被迫撤离了该半岛。

src: Historical outcome: With no further hope of relief - a final attempt by the paddle steamer Julnar to reach the town with supplies having failed - Townshend requested and received an armistice pending surrender talks on 26 April.
dst: 历史结局：解围已无希望——明轮汽船朱尔纳号最后一次试图把补给送进城里的努力失败后——汤森德请求并获准停火，等待4月26日进行投降谈判。

src: Historically, after a hard fight, the germans stopped the british attack and forced them to reembark leaving more than 800 casualties, against about 50 dead in the german side. Also many war supplies were abandoned: enough english rifles to equip three askari companies, 600.000 rounds and 16 machineguns. Besides, the native soldiers learned that they could defeat an european army. The defeat cost Major-General Aitken his command.
dst: 历史上，经过一场艰苦的战斗，德军阻止了英军的进攻，迫使他们重新登船，留下了800多人的伤亡，而德军一方仅阵亡约50人。此外还有大量军用物资被遗弃：足够装备三个阿斯卡里连的英式步枪、60万发子弹和16挺机枪。而且，当地土著士兵由此认识到，他们能够打败一支欧洲军队。这场败仗使艾特肯少将失去了指挥权。

src: Historically, at this time the DAK was composed of the 15th Panzer Division, the 21st Panzer Division (formerly 5 Leichte Division, 5 LD) plus 6 Italian Divisions (many of them with outdated equipment). Operation Crusader was finally a stalemate, but the DAK withdrew from its positions, and on December the 24th, Benghazi fell again into the Allies hands.
dst: 从历史上看，此时非洲军由第15装甲师、第21装甲师（原第5轻装师，5 LD）以及6个意大利师（其中许多装备陈旧）组成。十字军行动最终打成僵局，但非洲军撤出了阵地，12月24日，班加西再次落入盟军之手。

src: Historically, the British had decoded the German ''Enigma'' codes and knew all the German plans, Montgomery was able to make special plans to force out the Germans from El Alamein. Marshall Rommel didn't follow the order to fight at any cost and in November the 12th, he started the retreat of the DAK.
dst: 从历史上看，英军已破译了德军的“恩尼格玛”密码，掌握了德军的所有计划，蒙哥马利因而得以制订特别方案，把德军逐出阿拉曼。隆美尔元帅没有执行战斗到底的命令，11月12日，他开始了非洲军的撤退。

src: Historically, the French didn't join the ANZAC troops at Chunuk Bair. They remained at Cape Helles and took part in a diversionary attack on Krithia that can be at best be described as "insignificant". Meanwhile, wave after wave of ANZAC soldiers branded against the Turkish defences along the Sari Bair range. Some Australian battalions were almost annihilated at Lone Pine and The Nek, as was the Wellington Battalion of the New Zealand Brigade, which conquered the heights of Chunuk Bair. When Mustafa Kemal launched his counter-attack on August 10th, the allied troops finally were overwhelmed, and even the brave and stubborn Gurkhas that were the last to hold out on the upper ridge, were forced to retreat.
dst: 历史上，法军并未在楚努克拜尔加入澳新军团部队。他们留在海勒斯角，参加了一次对克里希亚的佯攻，这次佯攻充其量只能说是「微不足道」。与此同时，一波又一波的澳新军团士兵向萨里拜尔山脊沿线的土耳其军防线猛冲。一些澳大利亚营在孤松和「内克」几乎全军覆没，新西兰旅的威灵顿营也是如此，该营曾攻克楚努克拜尔高地。当穆斯塔法·凯末尔于8月10日发起反击时，协约国军队最终被压倒，即便是最后坚守在上山脊的英勇而顽强的廓尔喀人也被迫撤退。

src: Hitler and Mussolini decided it was time to occupy Gibraltar. The loss of Malta is not considered significant, as the English fleet has suffered heavy casualties. Already, Italian paratroopers are attempting the rock while a landing by marines is also being prepared. On Hitler's orders, German troops stationed in Italy will also help. Move quickly to help take Gibraltar.
dst: 希特勒与墨索里尼断定，是时候占领直布罗陀了。马耳他的失守被认为无关紧要，因为英国舰队已遭受惨重损失。意大利伞兵已在尝试攀登该岩山，同时海军陆战队的登陆也在准备之中。奉希特勒之命，驻意大利的德军也将提供协助。快速行动，协助夺取直布罗陀。

src: Hitler decided to attack Malta. In the first phase, your ships must neutralize the enemy fleet located northwest of Gozo.
dst: 希特勒决定进攻马耳他。在第一阶段，你的舰船必须消灭位于戈佐岛西北的敌方舰队。

src: Hitler has decided IISS Panzer Corps is needed to deal with the anticipated Soviet diversionary attacks south of the Belgorod-Kharkov sector.
dst: 希特勒已决定，需要党卫军第2装甲军来应对预料中苏军会在别尔哥罗德-哈尔科夫段以南发动的牵制性进攻。

src: Hitler has decided to invade Yugoslavia after the coup that has recently transpired.
dst: 在最近发生的政变之后，希特勒已决定入侵南斯拉夫。

src: Hitler has decided you and the rest of Guderian's 2nd Pz Gruppe need turn South to assist Von Rundstedt's less successful Armee Gruppe Sud in the encirclement of Kiev - Ukraine.
dst: 希特勒已决定，你和古德里安第2装甲集群的其余部队需要转向南方，协助冯·伦德施泰特进展不顺的南方集团军群合围乌克兰的基辅。

src: Hitler has grouped Ist and IInd SS Panzer Corps West of Budapest in an attempt to retake the city from the Russians, thereby destroying the Bolsheviks in the area between the Drava, the Danube and the Plattensee. Your forces are positioned on the left flank of the offensive.
dst: 希特勒把党卫军第1和第2装甲军集结在布达佩斯以西，试图从俄国人手中夺回该城，并借此歼灭德拉瓦河、多瑙河与巴拉顿湖之间的布尔什维克。你的部队位于此次攻势的左翼。

src: Hitler has released us to complete the destruction of the forces trapped north of us.  We must act quickly to sieze the ports and Roads to the coast to prevent the Allies escape to Britain.
dst: 希特勒已批准我们彻底歼灭被困于我们北面的部队。我们必须迅速夺取港口和通往海岸的道路，阻止盟军逃往英国。

src: Hitler himself ordered all non-German forces to withdraw from front line duty...leaving the front in more chaos then ever.
dst: 希特勒亲自下令所有非德军部队撤出一线战斗……使前线陷入比以往更严重的混乱。

src: Hitler initially wanted to call off Zitadelle after Prokhorovka, but luckily Von Manstein was able to convince him to commit the last mobile reserves so that the captured ground could be held and 5 Guards Tank Army fully destroyed. 2SS Panzer Armee is exploiting the gap in Russian lines.
dst: 希特勒起初想在普罗霍罗夫卡之后叫停“堡垒”，但幸亏冯·曼施泰因说服他投入最后的机动预备队，以便守住已夺取的阵地并彻底歼灭近卫第5坦克集团军。党卫军第2装甲集团军正在利用俄军防线上的缺口。

src: Hitler on a retreat with His Top Commanders aboard a Cruise Liner among the Kreigsmarines Captial ships.Hitler admiring the newly launched Capital ship the 'Pikar Wohr."Rohm,Kietel,did You hear that,all those gun shots,wonder what the Hell is going on over there"? dst: 希特勒正与他的高层指挥官们乘一艘游轮在海军主力舰之间休整。希特勒欣赏着刚下水的主力舰“皮卡尔·沃尔”号。“罗姆、凯特尔，你们听见了吗，那些枪声，真想知道那边到底在搞什么鬼？”“看，我的元首，有几艘小艇载着‘女士’们过去了，我猜她们是在那边开派对庆祝吧。”“啊，那个愚蠢的女元首，她开始失控了。那些传言一定是真的，听着，罗姆，她要把我们全换掉。”“当然，我的元首，等她有更多‘女士’穿上那种黑制服的时候。我想我那500万冲锋队追随者不会乐意让一个女人来带领他们，何况她、冲锋队和国防军都宣誓效忠于您，我的元首。”“好吧，等我开完这些会回到柏林，我就去收拾我们那位‘小可爱’女元首和她的党卫军。”于是希特勒和其他人进去用餐，稍后又出来在甲板上交谈。“现在又在搞什么鬼？”希特勒说道——只见“皮卡尔·沃尔”号把德国战旗降下，升起了党卫军／海军旗，主炮塔转向他和随从们所在的游轮。
