src: However I must inform you that, from now on, we'll decrease our level of engagement in the Romanian front. Apart from giving Southern Dobrudzha back to us, Germany and Austria-Hungary don't want to grant us any significative territorial compensations in the area, so why should we fight for nothing? Yes, we'll still launch minor operations at the Dunav Delta, and we'll flank the Germans on their final assault on Bukurest, but we won't take part in any major battles.
dst: 不过我必须通知您，从今往后，我们将降低在罗马尼亚战线的投入程度。除了把南多布罗加归还我们之外，德国和奥匈帝国不愿在该地区给我们任何有实质意义的领土补偿，那我们又为何要为毫无回报之事流血？是的，我们仍会在多瑙河三角洲发动小规模行动，也会在德军对布加勒斯特的最后突击中掩护其侧翼，但我们不会再参与任何大规模会战。

src: However our intelligence report that the Soviets are trying to break the encirclement, so expect Soviet counterattacks both from the south and the northeast.
dst: 但我方情报显示，苏军正试图突围，因此请务必提防他们自南面与东北两翼发起的反攻。

src: However the price has been high. We have lost many brave Spanish soldiers, including General Pintos. We can't afford such heavy casualties, or else our beloved fatherland could suffer another anarchist uprising like the recent one in Barcelona. From now on you will have to command your troops more carefully.
dst: 然而代价是高昂的。我们失去了许多英勇的西班牙士兵，包括平托斯将军在内。我们承受不起如此惨重的伤亡，否则我们亲爱的祖国可能会再遭受一次像巴塞罗那那样不久前的无政府主义者起义。从现在起，您必须更谨慎地指挥部队。

src: However the situation is different in the west, in the vicinity of Ceuta and Larache. The High Command has transferred you and your troops to that region, where I'm sure that you will be extremely useful.
dst: 然而西部的情况不同，在休达和拉腊什附近。最高统帅部已把您和您的部队调到那一地区，我相信您在那里会大有作为。

src: However, Benedek's Nord Armee had been forced to stop its march, and would never reach Gitschin. The Austro-Saxonian forces still had numerical superiority and a good defensive position, but it was doubtful how they would react when they learnt that they wouldn't receive any reinforcements.
dst: 然而，贝内德克的北方军团被迫停止行军，永远也到不了吉钦。奥萨联军仍拥有兵力优势和良好的防御阵地，但一旦得知不会得到任何增援，他们将作何反应，尚未可知。

src: However, Cambrai has proved that a surprise artillery-infantry attack supported by new methods and weapons can destroy even the strongest of our lines of defense. The Siegfriedstellung will not resist much longer. We must take the time to devise counter-measures for the tanks and to strengthen and widen our defence lines if we want to have a chance at the Western front.
dst: 然而，康布雷已经证明，一场在新战法、新武器支援下的炮步协同突袭，甚至能摧毁我们最坚固的防线。齐格菲阵地撑不了多久了。如果我们还想在西线有一线生机，就必须抓紧时间想出对付坦克的对策，并加强、加宽我们的防线。

src: However, Denikin won't come with us. He believes that his staff has lost confidence in him, so he has resigned from his position. He'll go into exile, and Wrangel will be our new commander.
dst: 然而，邓尼金不会与我们同行。他认为他的参谋班子已对他失去信心，于是辞去了职务。他将流亡海外，弗兰格尔将成为我们的新指挥官。

src: However, France wasn't going to surrender so easily. As soon as they knew that the Emperor had been captured, some French politicians led by Léon Gambetta dethroned Napoleon III Napoleon III and established a Government of National Defence on 4 September 1870. General Louis-Jules Trochu was the first president of the provisional government. The French, ready to continue the war, ordered the recruitment of new regiments in order to fight the Germans.
dst: 然而，法国不会如此轻易地投降。一得知皇帝被俘，以莱昂·甘必大为首的一些法国政治家便废黜了拿破仑三世，并于1870年9月4日成立了国防政府。路易-儒勒·特罗许将军是临时政府的首任总统。决心继续作战的法国人下令征募新团，以抗击德军。

src: However, France wasn't going to surrender so easily. As soon as they knew that the Emperor had been captured, some French politicians led by Léon Gambetta dethroned Napoleon III and established a Government of National Defence on 4 September 1870. General Louis-Jules Trochu was the first president of the provisional government. The French, ready to continue the war, ordered the recruitment of new regiments in order to fight the Germans.
dst: 然而，法国不会如此轻易地投降。一得知皇帝被俘，以莱昂·甘必大为首的一些法国政治家便废黜了拿破仑三世，并于1870年9月4日成立了国防政府。路易-儒勒·特罗许将军是临时政府的首任总统。决心继续作战的法国人下令征募新团，以抗击德军。

src: However, I admit that, for now, living in a free Crimea is better that going into exile. And if we choose the right policies, our new country could thrive. Then we could afford a modern Army, capable of deterring our enemies. At the moment that's just a castle in the air but if we all work hard in the same direction, who knows? Maybe we could make it real.
dst: 然而，我承认，就目前而言，生活在一个自由的克里米亚总比流亡要好。如果我们选择正确的政策，我们新的国家就能繁荣发展。到那时，我们就能养得起一支足以威慑敌人的现代化军队。眼下那还只是空中楼阁，但如果我们都朝着同一方向努力，谁知道呢？也许我们能让它成为现实。

src: However, I'm afraid that such conditions will be quite hard. We'll have to leave Solun and Vardar Macedonia, but at least we'll keep Southern Dobrudzha, Western Thrace and part of Aegean Macedonia, including the town of Ser. It may seem a small reward after so many sacrifices, but our fate will be much better than that of our allies.
dst: 不过，恐怕这样的条件会相当苛刻。我们将不得不放弃萨洛尼卡和瓦尔达尔马其顿，但至少我们保住了南多布罗加、西色雷斯和爱琴马其顿的一部分，包括塞尔镇。经历了如此多的牺牲，这样的回报或许显得微不足道，但我们的命运将远好于我们的盟友。

src: However, I'm afraid that the Italians won't give up. They will try again, and they have more men than us. We won't be able to hold them forever, especially if we keep on fighting on three fronts at the same time.
dst: 然而，恐怕意大利人不会罢休。他们还会再试，而且他们兵员比我们多。我们无法永远挡住他们，尤其是在我们同时三线作战的情况下。

src: However, King Leopold III has agreed that our best troops must retreat to Dunkerque to be shipped and continue the battle in the South France.
dst: 然而，国王利奥波德三世同意，我们最精锐的部队必须撤往敦刻尔克登船，在法国南部继续战斗。

src: However, Loring understood that the Egyptians couldn't remain in the forts forever. If they did, we'd eventually cut their supply lines, and they'd be forced to surrender or, at the very least, to cancel the offensive and retreat to the coast. So in the first days of March he forced Mohammed Ratib Pasha to leave the safety of Fort Gura and try to search and destroy our forces.
dst: 然而，洛林明白，埃及人不可能永远龟缩在堡垒里。如果他们真这样做，我们最终会切断他们的补给线，他们就将被迫投降，或者至少取消攻势、撤回海岸。因此，在三月的头几天，他迫使穆罕默德·拉提卜帕夏离开古拉堡的庇护，去搜索并消灭我们的部队。

src: However, Sokolovo became a symbol of Czechoslovak will to fight. Many soldiers were awarded Soviet orders, most notably the second lieutenant Otakar Jaros, who was (as a first foreigner ever) awarded the Gold Star of "Hero of Soviet Union" medal in memoriam.
dst: 然而，索科洛沃成了捷克斯洛伐克人抗战意志的象征。许多士兵获颁苏联勋章，最著名的是少尉奥塔卡尔·雅罗什——他（作为有史以来第一个外国人）被追授“苏联英雄”金星奖章。

src: However, We have been called to direct our attacks back, our flanks have collapsed!.....The Russians don't know it yet, but they have cut us off.
dst: 然而，我们已被召回，要把攻势调回头——我们的两翼已经崩溃了！……俄国人还不知道，但他们已经切断了我们的联系。

src: However, as a complete surprise, on 16th May the BEF started to leave their positions at the Dijle/Dyle river. Soon orders came for the Belgian army to retreat. The Germans had broken trough at Sedan and were racing towards the coast threatening to cut of the Armies in Belgium from the main body of the French army.
dst: 然而，完全出乎意料的是，5月16日英国远征军开始撤离其在迪尔河的阵地。不久后，比利时军队也接到了撤退命令。德军已在色当突破，正向海岸疾进，威胁要把在比利时的各集团军与法军主力割裂开来。

src: However, because of your experience in colonial warfare, the QG has new plans for you and your men.
dst: 然而，鉴于您在殖民战争中的经验，指挥部为您和您的部下安排了新的计划。

src: However, by March 14, Operation Spring Awakening was in serious trouble. The advance of the 6th SS Panzer Army was well short of its ambitious goals. The German 2nd Panzer Army did not do so well south of Lake Balaton as the 6th SS Panzer Army did, north of Lake Balaton. Army Group E met fierce resistance from the Bulgarian 1st Army and ultimately failed to reach its objective of Mohács.
dst: 然而到了3月14日，「春季觉醒」行动陷入严重困境。党卫军第6装甲集团军的推进与其雄心勃勃的目标相去甚远。德国第2装甲集团军在巴拉顿湖以南的表现，不如党卫军第6装甲集团军在巴拉顿湖以北的表现。E集团军群遭到保加利亚第1集团军的顽强抵抗，最终未能达成夺取莫哈奇的目标。

src: However, commandante, you must understand that tactical victories do not balance strategic failures.
dst: 不过，指挥官，您必须明白，战术上的胜利抵不过战略上的失败。

src: However, despite your determination and courage you are not an Admiral and the outcome of the battle could hardly be in doubt. We have lost a battle but not the war. The fight will continue in land. I am confident you will defeat the U.S. Army if they dare to attack Manila.
dst: 然而，尽管您决心坚定、勇气可嘉，但您毕竟不是海军上将，这场战斗的结局几乎毫无悬念。我们输掉了一场战斗，但并未输掉战争。战斗将在陆地上继续。我有信心，若美军胆敢进攻马尼拉，您定能击败他们。

src: However, despite your success in battle, I'm afraid that they'll be very hard on us. Vardar Macedonia will remain in Serbia, and we'll lose Agean Macedonia to Greece, Eastern Thrace to the Ottoman Empire, and Dobrudzha to Romania.
dst: 然而，尽管您在战场上取得了成功，恐怕他们会对我们非常苛刻。瓦尔达尔马其顿将留在塞尔维亚，我们将把爱琴马其顿割给希腊、东色雷斯割给奥斯曼帝国、多布罗加割给罗马尼亚。

src: However, enemy artillery fire is forcing us to move back to Halen and wait for the 1st Armee  infantry divisions - tied up at Liege - to arrive at the front to resume the offensive.
dst: 然而，敌军炮火迫使我们退回哈伦，等待被牵制在列日的第1集团军步兵师抵达前线，以恢复攻势。

src: However, enemy artillery fire is forcing us to move back to Halen and wait for the 1st Armee infantry divisions - tied up at Liege - to arrive at the front to resume the offensive.
dst: 然而，敌军炮火迫使我们退回哈伦，等待被牵制在列日的第1集团军步兵师抵达前线，以恢复攻势。

src: However, his sacrifice hasn't been forgotten, and today his relatives have joined here, in Samara, to pay tribute to this true Russian hero. Uncle, you have made our lives possible. We owe you everything, and we want you to be sure that we'll remember you until the day we die. Za pobedu, hura!!!
dst: 然而，他的牺牲没有被遗忘。今天，他的亲人们齐聚萨马拉，向这位真正的俄国英雄致敬。叔父，是您成就了我们今天的生活。我们的一切都归功于您，我们想让您知道，我们会铭记您，直到我们离世的那一天。为胜利，乌拉！！！

src: However, in the end we succeeded. By mid October all our supply lines were safe, from Vladivostok to the Volga, and we finally started to plan our new offensives. Then, just a few days later, the first snows came, at the worst possible moment. That forced Kolchak to study our different options carefully.
dst: 然而，我们最终成功了。到10月中旬，从符拉迪沃斯托克到伏尔加河，我们所有的补给线都安全了，我们终于开始筹划新的攻势。可是，仅仅几天后，第一场雪在最糟糕的时刻降临了。这迫使高尔察克仔细研究我们的各种选择。

src: However, in the south, the cossacks, outnumbered, without adequate equipment, and isolated from the rest of our army, hadn't been able to take Orenburg. If the Reds kept that city they would threaten our left flank, and it would be very dangerous to continue our race to the Volga, so Kolchak ordered us to go south and help the cossacks to occupy Orenburg at all costs.
dst: 然而，在南方，哥萨克人兵力处于劣势、缺乏足够的装备，又与我军其余部队隔绝，因而没能拿下奥伦堡。如果红军保住那座城市，他们就会威胁我们的左翼，而继续向伏尔加河推进将会非常危险，因此高尔察克命令我们南下，不惜一切代价帮助哥萨克人占领奥伦堡。

src: However, it won't be easy. This area is being defended by the Taman Army Group, one of the best units of the Red Army of the Northern Caucasus. They'll try to stop our advance or, at the very least, retreat unharmed to the south, where they'd reinforce Sorokin's units. But I'm here to stop them. The victory will be mine.
dst: 然而，这不会容易。这一地区由塔曼集团军群防守，它是北高加索红军最精锐的部队之一。他们将试图阻止我们推进，或者至少安然撤往南方，去加强索罗金的部队。但我在这里就是为了阻止他们。胜利必将属于我。

src: However, it's quite obvious that if we keep on fighting in several fronts, we'll be doomed. Due to the Russian attacks, we've been forced to cancel our offensive against the treacherous Italians in the Alpen. Yes, we may have defeated Serbia, but that's not enough. And now things can get even worse. It seems that the Romanians, encouraged by the Russian offensive, are about to declare war on the Empire. Soon, we'll have a new enemy.
dst: 然而，很明显，如果我们继续在多条战线作战，我们就注定要完蛋。由于俄军的进攻，我们被迫取消了在阿尔卑斯山区对背信弃义的意大利人的攻势。是的，我们或许击败了塞尔维亚，但那还不够。而现在情况可能变得更糟。看来，在俄国攻势的鼓舞下，罗马尼亚人即将向帝国宣战。很快，我们就会多出一个新的敌人。

src: However, it's still soon to enjoy our new training and equipment... the bad news?, well the mission of the US general George Marshall to pacificate China and reach an agreement between us and the KMT is a clear failure. The Kuomingtan have taken advantage of the time just to rearm their units, and now they are clearly taking positions around our areas, probably to anihilate us like in the 30's. In case of the outbreak of the war... your mission is to drive your units in Wuhan to the West, to join the central ChCP units in Central China.
dst: 不过，现在享受我们的新训练和新装备还为时过早...坏消息呢？美国将军乔治·马歇尔促成中国和平、让我们与国民党达成协议的使命已明显失败。国民党利用这段时间重整了他们的部队，现在他们显然正在我们的区域周围占据阵地，很可能想像30年代那样消灭我们。一旦战争爆发...你的任务是把你在武汉的部队向西开进，去与华中的中共中央部队会合。

src: However, just 20 Km west of Metz, at Mars-la-Tour, two Prussian Army Corps were blocking the French line of retreat. As soon as they discovered the enemy, and despite being numerically inferior, the Prussians decided to attack and prevent the French from escaping.
dst: 然而，就在梅斯以西仅20公里处的马尔斯拉图尔，两个普鲁士军正封锁着法军的退路。普鲁士人一发现敌人，尽管兵力处于劣势，仍决定发起进攻，阻止法军逃脱。

src: However, knowing that everything was lost, the French Government of National Defence started to negotiate an armistice on 24 January. The negotiations were quick, and President Favre signed the armistice at Versailles three days later. It came into effect at midnight, on 28 January 1871. Gambetta didn't surrender the French provintial armies until February 6th, but that didn't make a difference.
dst: 然而，明知大势已去，法国国防政府于1月24日开始谈判停战。谈判进行得很快，三天后，法夫尔总统在凡尔赛签署了停战协定。协定于1871年1月28日午夜生效。甘必大直到2月6日才交出法国各省军队，但这已无济于事。

src: However, most of the Taman Army Group has managed to escape and has joined the Red Army of the Northern Caucasus. Now they are heading south, to Armavir and Stavropol.
dst: 然而，塔曼集团军群的大部分还是设法逃脱，并加入了北高加索红军。如今他们正向南进发，前往阿尔马维尔和斯塔夫罗波尔。

src: However, my South African experiences had affected me deeply. They were the start of a spiritual journey that would end with my conversion in 1904, following the path that Evelyn had taken ten years before. Some friends said that it would be the end of my career, but they were wrong. The Relief Act was already old when I was born, and in the XX century these kind of decisions were not scandals any more. In 1909 I was finally appointed as a Major-General.
dst: 然而，南非的经历深深地影响了我。那是我一段心灵之旅的开端，最终以我在1904年皈依告终，走的是伊芙琳十年前走过的路。一些朋友说这会断送我的前程，但他们错了。《救济法案》在我出生时便早已陈旧，到了20世纪，这类决定也不再是什么丑闻。1909年，我终于被任命为少将。

src: However, on May 28, while still distributing firearms in Alapan (Imus), the Spanish sent a column of some 270 troops for the purpose of seizing the reported consignment of arms. Filipinos attacked the Spanish column that, after several hours of intense fighting, ran out of ammunition and surrendered. After his first military victory, Aguinaldo unfurled the Filipino flag for the first time in Cavite Nuevo.
dst: 然而，5月28日，正当阿吉纳尔多还在阿拉潘（伊穆斯）分发枪械时，西班牙派出一支约270人的纵队，目的是夺取据报的那批军火。菲律宾人进攻了这支西班牙纵队，经过数小时的激战，西班牙人弹药用尽，被迫投降。取得第一场军事胜利后，阿吉纳尔多在新甲米地第一次升起了菲律宾国旗。

src: However, one unexpected fact could change everything. We know that, blinded by what they perceive as a stunning Russian victory, Romania will enter the war very soon, siding with the Entente. The Romanian Army, although antiquated and poorly equipped, is very large, and it could alter the balance of power in the Balkans. You'll have to go there and make sure it doesn't happen.
dst: 然而，一个意想不到的事实可能会改变一切。我们知道，罗马尼亚被他们眼中俄军的惊人胜利冲昏了头脑，很快就会加入协约国参战。罗马尼亚军队虽然装备陈旧简陋，但规模庞大，足以改变巴尔干的实力对比。您必须前往那里，确保这种事不会发生。

src: However, one unexpected fact could change everything. We know that, blinded by what they perceive as a stunning Russian victory, Romania will enter the war very soon, siding with the Entente. The Romanian Army, although antiquated and poorly equipped, is very large, and it could alter the balance of power in the Balkans. You'll have to go there and make sure it doesn't happen. The Russians are too much for you, but al least you can overcome the Romanians, can't you?
dst: 然而，一个意想不到的事实可能会改变一切。我们知道，罗马尼亚被他们眼中俄军的惊人胜利冲昏了头脑，很快就会加入协约国参战。罗马尼亚军队虽然装备陈旧简陋，但规模庞大，足以改变巴尔干的实力对比。您必须前往那里，确保这种事不会发生。俄国人您对付不了，但至少您能制服罗马尼亚人，对吧？

src: However, our advance was too cautious for fear of being ambushed, and that gave the enemy time to build strong defensive positions on the Northern shore of the Aisne River. The High Command believed that, if we pressed them hard enough, we could break the German lines and force them out of France and, hopefully, the war. I was not so optimistic about the chances of success of a frontal assault, but the night of September 13th the fog was extremely dense, so with God on our side maybe we would surprise the Germans.
dst: 然而，由于害怕遭到伏击，我们的推进过于谨慎，这给了敌人时间在埃纳河北岸构筑坚固的防御阵地。最高统帅部认为，如果我们对敌军施加足够的压力，就能突破德军防线，把他们赶出法国，甚至有望结束战争。我对正面突击成功的可能性并不那么乐观，但9月13日夜雾浓得厉害，所以有上帝站在我们这一边，也许我们能出其不意地打击德军。

src: However, our intelligence reports suggest that the enemy could try an enveloping manouver here, at our Third Army's left flank. Your mission is to crush any counterattack from the Turks and follow our advance to the town of Lozengrad.
dst: 然而，我们的情报报告显示，敌人可能试图在这里、在我第3集团军左翼发动一次迂回包抄。您的任务是粉碎土耳其人的任何反击，并随我们的推进直取洛泽格勒镇。

src: However, peace conditions were very hard on the Ottoman Empire: They lost all their remaining territories in Europe, except the tiny strip of land located east of the line between Enos and Midia, which included Istambul. Tensions beween the allies started almost inmediately, since Bulgaria asked for more formerly Ottoman lands than Serbia and Greece were willingl to cede, and on 29th June 1913 the Second Balkan War started when Bulgaria attacked her former allies.
dst: 然而，和平条件对奥斯曼帝国非常苛刻：他们失去了在欧洲剩下的全部领土，只除了埃诺斯至米迪亚一线以东的一小块土地，该地区包括伊斯坦布尔。盟国之间的紧张关系几乎立刻出现，因为保加利亚要求得到的原奥斯曼领土比塞尔维亚和希腊愿意割让的要多；1913年6月29日，保加利亚进攻她的前盟友，第二次巴尔干战争爆发。

src: However, personally I think the fate of the Republica is sealed, my friend.  If you fail, there is no one to help you.
dst: 不过，我个人认为共和国的命运已经注定，我的朋友。如果您失败了，没有人能帮您。

src: However, remaining here idly woul be a great mistake. We must harass the Germans, hit them as hard as we can. I f we force them to spend time and resources on us, their main attack against France will be weaker and slower. That should give our allies an opportunity to stop the Huns and finish this war before the end of the summer.
dst: 然而，在这里无所事事地待着将是一个大错。我们必须骚扰德国人，尽可能猛烈地打击他们。如果我们迫使他们把时间和资源花在我们身上，他们对法国的主攻就会更弱、更慢。这应当能给我们的盟友一个机会，去阻止匈奴人，并在夏天结束前结束这场战争。

src: However, some remained in Egypt and built the nucleus of the army that was to fight all its way across the desert into the heart of the Holy Land - The Egyptian Expeditionary Force (EEF), as it was officially named in March 1916.
dst: 不过，一些人留在了埃及，组建了一支军队的核心，这支军队后来一路穿过沙漠，打进圣地的腹地——即1916年3月正式命名的埃及远征军（EEF）。

src: However, that oath was impossible to fulfill. Ras Mengesha was just 21 years old. He was too young to hold the title of Emperor. He lacked the experience, or the strength, to govern the different Ethiopian kingdoms, or to subdue all the Ethiopian nobles. Without unity, it would be impossible to defend the country from the depredations of the Sudanese, the Italians, or the British. No, Ras Mengesha couldn't be our emperor.
dst: 然而，那份誓言是无法兑现的。拉斯·门格沙年仅21岁。他太年轻，无法承当皇帝的头衔。他既缺乏经验，也缺乏力量，去治理各个埃塞俄比亚王国，或降服所有埃塞俄比亚贵族。没有团结，就不可能保卫国家免受苏丹人、意大利人或英国人的蹂躏。不，拉斯·门格沙无法成为我们的皇帝。

src: However, the British had been much more cunning. As it turned out to be, the Gondar campaign was just a bait, as it had been the southern invasion by the African Rifles. The British were using expendable colonial troops in order to keep us busy and exhaust all our reserves of men and supplies, while they prepared their real attack. They called it Operation Solomon, and took us completely by surprise.
dst: 然而，英国人却狡猾得多。事实证明，贡德尔战役只是个诱饵，非洲步枪团的南部入侵也是如此。英国人一直在利用可牺牲的殖民部队拖住我们，耗尽我们所有的人力和物资储备，同时准备他们真正的进攻。他们把这称作「所罗门行动」，让我们完全措手不及。

src: However, the Danish soldiers heroically resisted the Prussian attacks for more than one month. It was only on April 18 when the Prussian High Command decided that it was time for the final assault.
dst: 然而，丹麦士兵英勇地抵抗普鲁士人的进攻长达一个多月。直到4月18日，普鲁士最高统帅部才决定是时候发动最后总攻了。

src: However, the French were convinced that, if Bazaine had resisted in Metz just another week, they would have had time to complete the creation of the new National Defence armies, they could have defeated the weak Prussian forces at the Loire region, and they could have lifted the siege of Paris. That was a really unlikely sequence of events, but the French really believed it could have happened. After the fall of Metz it had become just an impossible dream.
dst: 然而，法国人坚信，倘若巴赞在梅斯再多坚守一周，他们就有时间完成新国防军的组建，就能在卢瓦尔地区击败兵力薄弱的普鲁士军队，也就能解除巴黎之围。这真是一连串极不可能发生的事，但法国人却真心相信它本可能发生。梅斯陷落之后，这便成了一个不可能实现的梦。

src: However, the Germans have managed to quickly cross the Ardennes in spite of the French troops sent to delay this movement.
dst: 然而，尽管法国部队被派去迟滞德军，德军仍然迅速穿过了阿登。

src: However, the Kaiser and Bismarck weren't satisfied. The war was becoming too long and expensive. Even worse, many German soldiers were falling victims to tuberculosis and other contagious diseases, and some European powers were starting to see Prussia in a very unfavourable light. They had to force France to surrender in just a few weeks, or else Prussia and her allies would face a most unpredictable future.
dst: 然而，皇帝和俾斯麦并不满足。战争正变得过于漫长且代价高昂。更糟的是，许多德国士兵正染上肺结核和其他传染病，而一些欧洲强国也开始以十分不利的眼光看待普鲁士。他们必须在短短几周内迫使法国投降，否则普鲁士及其盟友将面临一个最难以预料的未来。

src: However, the battle has just started.

However, the campaign in German East Africa (a colony which comprised most of present day Tanzania, Rwanda and Burundi) was very different from what was expected. The German commander, Col. Paul Von Lettow-Vorbeck proved to be one of the most skilled officers of the WWI, and maybe of the 20th century. Displaying a great mobility, an excellent knowledge of the terrain and an exceptional gift for guerrilla warfare, Von Lettow led his "Feldkompanien" for more than four years, forcing the Entente powers to send 250,000 soldiers in search of less than 20,000 German troops.
dst: 然而，德属东非（一个包括今天坦桑尼亚、卢旺达和布隆迪大部分地区的殖民地）的战局却与预期大不相同。德军指挥官保罗·冯·莱托-福尔贝克上校被证明是一战、乃至20世纪最出色的军官之一。他展现出极强的机动性、对地形的卓越了解以及非凡的游击战天赋，率领他的「野战连」坚持了四年多，迫使协约国列强派出25万名士兵去搜寻不到2万人的德军。

src: However, the journey was long, so when we arrived our troops had already retaken the initiative. I couldn't take part in any of the big battles of this peculiar war, but at least I had my first real combat experience.
dst: 然而，旅途漫长，所以当我们抵达时，我们的部队已经重新掌握了主动权。我没能参加这场奇特战争的任何一场大战役，但至少我有了第一次真正的实战经历。

src: However, the reinforcements that had engaged our defensive screen of light horsemen had already been repulsed with relative ease when the order to retreat was given. How could we give away victory so easily?
dst: 然而，与我们轻骑兵掩护部队交战的援军，在撤退命令下达时其实已被较为轻松地击退了。我们怎能如此轻易地拱手让出胜利？

src: However, the respect that we had for the Polish army, and the fact that the Bolsheviks were our common enemies for many months, couldn't hide the mutual enmity that existed between us. We knew that, once the Red Army was finally destroyed, Poland would become our new main enemy, at least in the short term.
dst: 然而，我们对波兰军队的敬重，以及布尔什维克曾数月作为我们共同敌人这一事实，都无法掩盖我们之间存在的相互敌意。我们知道，一旦红军被最终消灭，波兰就将成为我们新的主要敌人，至少短期内如此。

src: However, the retreat of the Belgian army to his main line of defence at the Dyle River succeeded, so nothing was lost yet.
dst: 然而，比利时军队撤退到戴尔河主防线的行动取得了成功，所以一切都还没有失去。

src: However, the situation deteriorated with time. The legitimacy of our protectorate is based on the stabilization and the development of the country, in favor of the interests of the Sultan of Morocco. El Raisuli sees the growing influence of the Sultan's agents as a danger for his own power, and some months ago he rebelled against our administration.
dst: 然而，局势随着时间推移而恶化。我们保护国的合法性，建立在对这个国家的稳定与发展之上，这符合摩洛哥苏丹的利益。赖苏利却把苏丹代理人日益增长的影响力视为对自身权力的威胁，几个月前他起兵反抗我们的行政当局。

src: However, the war against Sudan was going to be a long one, and it would consume Yohannes in the last years of his reign. He would receive very little help from Menelik of Shewa who, thanks to his deals with the Italians in Harar, had a permanent supply of modern arms and was expanding his kingdom to Ogaden, in the east, and to the lands south of the Blue Nile. As long as the Mahdists weren't a direct menace for his Shewan kingdom, he wouldn't get involved in the war.
dst: 然而，对苏丹的战争注定漫长，它将在约翰尼斯统治的最后岁月里耗尽他的心力。他能从绍阿的孟尼利克那里得到的帮助少之又少——孟尼利克靠着与哈拉尔的意大利人交易，拥有源源不断的现代武器供应，并正把他的王国向东扩张到奥加登、向南扩张到青尼罗河以南的土地。只要马赫迪信徒对他的绍阿王国不构成直接威胁，他就不会卷入战争。

src: However, there is yet one goal to achieve: we must prevent being captured and stuck in internment camps, as an independent Hungary would be attacked by Serbs, Romanians and Czechs. Only the old, the young, the injured and inexperienced reservists are stationed in Hungary.
dst: 然而，仍有一个目标要去实现：我们必须避免被俘并困于拘留营，因为独立的匈牙利将遭到塞尔维亚人、罗马尼亚人与捷克人的进攻。匈牙利境内只剩下老人、青年、伤员与缺乏经验的预备役士兵。

src: However, they didn't say anything about Belarus or Ukraine, and we were determined to keep those lands under Russian control.
dst: 然而，他们对白俄罗斯或乌克兰只字未提，而我们决心将这些土地保持在俄国控制之下。

src: However, this time the Prussian III and X Corps weren't going to engage in battle. They were still very exhausted from the previous fight at Mars-la-Tour, and they needed time to recover. That gave the French a small chance of success, despite their numerical inferiority.
dst: 然而，这一次普鲁士第3军和第10军没有投入战斗。他们仍在为马尔斯拉图尔的前一场战斗而疲惫不堪，需要时间恢复。这给了法军一线取胜的机会，尽管他们兵力处于劣势。

src: However, try to control your troops. We've heard that soldiers from other countries are murdering innocent Chinamen, or stealing everything they can from the local population. We must not allow that.
dst: 不过，务必管好您的部队。我们听说其他国家的士兵在杀害无辜的中国人，或从当地居民那里抢夺一切能抢的东西。我们绝不容许那样做。

src: However, we may not celebrate yet.  The German troops have broken through the Latvians' southern flank and are retreating toward Riga.  You must knock them out of the town at all costs.
dst: 然而，我们还不能庆祝。德军已突破拉脱维亚人的南翼，正朝里加撤退。您必须不惜一切代价把他们从城里赶出去。

src: However, we still have a weak point at the Perekop Isthmus. Should it fall, all of Crimea would be in danger. Denikin has ordered me to go there and command its defence, and I'll arrive as soon as possible. It's more that just my duty: my family's safety depends on it. Katya, the children and Olga, Anatoly's wife, who is expecting her first child, have been evacuated to Simferopol, so I must do my best in order to prevent the Reds from taking Crimea.
dst: 然而，我们在彼列科普地峡仍有一个薄弱环节。一旦失守，整个克里米亚都将陷入危险。邓尼金已命令我前往那里指挥防御，我将尽快赶到。这不仅是我的职责：我家人的安危也系于此。卡佳、孩子们以及阿纳托利那正怀着第一个孩子的妻子奥尔加，都已撤往辛菲罗波尔，所以我必须竭尽全力阻止红军夺取克里米亚。

src: However, we were lucky. If the Boer had followed de la Rey's plan to the letter they would have waited for us to come closer before opening fire, surprising us completely. Our whole division could have been in great danger, but fortunately for us they used their rifles too soon.
dst: 然而，我们是幸运的。如果布尔人原原本本地执行德拉雷的计划，他们本会等我们靠近后再开火，把我们打得措手不及。我们整个师本可能陷入巨大危险，但对我们而言幸运的是，他们过早地开了枪。

src: However, when the Germans shifted its attention towards the British in the south they created in the sector of the 44th Infantry division a bridgehead o over the Schelde/ Escaut, which could be used as a base for future actions.
dst: 然而，当德军把注意力转向南面的英军时，他们在第44步兵师的地段建立了斯海尔德河上的一处桥头堡，可作为日后行动的基地。

src: However, you will not lead us in the invasion of Egypt, Mussilini has a different assignment for you, Malta!
dst: 然而，你不会领导我们对埃及的入侵，墨索里尼另有任务给你——马耳他！

src: However, you won't be here watching the Entente fail. The OHL has decided that for our final offensive we need even more men, and they can only come from the secondary fronts of Macedonia and Italy. We'll have to destroy the Entente forces there, just like we did in Russia. So the Balkans await you, General.
dst: 然而，您不会留在这里看着协约国走向失败。最高陆军统帅部已经决定，我们的最后攻势需要更多的人手，而这些人手只能来自马其顿和意大利这两条次要战线。我们必须像在俄国所做的那样，摧毁那里的协约国部队。所以，将军，巴尔干在等着您。

src: However, you'll have to make one last effort before we can completely encircle Paris. There are still some strong enemy units west of the city, blocking the way to Chartres and Orléans. Defeat them and those two towns will fall, too. Then Paris will be surrounded and the French government will have no option but to surrender unconditionally. But be careful, our enemies are desperate and that makes them unpredictable.
dst: 不过，在我们能彻底包围巴黎之前，您还得再作最后一次努力。城市西面仍有一些强悍的敌军部队，挡住了通往沙特尔和奥尔良的道路。击败他们，那两座城镇也将陷落。届时巴黎将被包围，法国政府除了无条件投降将别无选择。但要小心，我们的敌人已陷入绝望，这让他们变得难以捉摸。

src: However, your victory has called the attention of the OHL, and it's been decided that you and your men will be transferred to the Belgian border. Good luck, General, you'll need it on your new destination.
dst: 然而，您的胜利引起了最高陆军指挥部的注意，他们已决定把您和您的部下调往比利时边境。祝您好运，将军，您在新驻地会需要运气的。
