src: I admit that now that they're wounded and desperate they've become extremely dangerous, as any other cornered wild beast. But if we have patience and don't lose our minds, we'll overcome this last German offensive. Once that it is over, everything will be better. Have faith, Fabienne, the worst months of the war have already passed by. Verdun and Chemin des Dames were the hardest times. Now I'm starting to see the light at the end of the tunnel. We just have to resist a little longer.
dst: 我承认，如今他们受了伤又绝望，已经变得极其危险，就像任何一头被逼入绝境的野兽一样。但只要我们保持耐心、不失去理智，我们就能挺过这最后一场德军攻势。一旦它结束，一切都会好起来。要有信心，法比安，战争最艰难的月份已经过去了。凡尔登和贵妇小径才是最艰苦的时刻。现在我正开始看到隧道尽头的光明。我们只需再坚持久一点。

src: I am afraid this is the end of your career in the military. Maybe you should try the cooking businees.
dst: 恐怕你在军中的生涯到此为止了。也许你该试试餐饮业。

src: I am at a loss for words. Your failure is... incomprehensible. This debacle will be remembered as one of the worst military disasters of our nation. You were fortunate to have escaped capture after the this fiasco. You are reliefed of your command and are ordered back to Berlin.
dst: 我无言以对。您的失败……令人难以理解。这场溃败将被记为我们国家最惨重的军事灾难之一。在这场惨败之后您能逃脱被俘，算是幸运。您被解除指挥权，并被命令返回柏林。

src: I am aware that conditions have been harsh, but you have done poorly!  The only positive result is that you and your troops have gained some experience in this new type of armored warfare.   But, the new Spanish government and our other allies have not yet learned to respect our military capabilities which we require!   Herr General, do not disappoint us again.
dst: 我知道条件一直很艰苦，但你们打得并不好！唯一的好消息是你和你的部队在这种新型装甲战中积累了一些经验。但是，新的西班牙政府以及我们的其他盟国，还没有学会尊重我们所需的军事能力！将军阁下，不要再让我们失望了。

src: I am confident you are eager to play a major role in the future operations of our Army. That’s why your new mission will be to prepare our forces in Congo to be ready to fight.
dst: 我相信你渴望在我们军队未来的行动中发挥重要作用。因此你的新任务将是整备我们在刚果的部队，使其做好战斗准备。

src: I am considering proposing you for a promotion! You have managed to completely stop the German advance and eliminate the created bridgehead in a well-executed counterattack. The German 56th Division has suffered heavy casualties.
dst: 我正在考虑提议为您晋升！您以一次执行出色的反击彻底阻止了德军前进，并消除了其建立的桥头堡。德军第56师伤亡惨重。

src: I am delighted being able to write that our brave troops have broken through the German Hindenburg line! The Hun is in full retreat.
dst: 我很高兴能够写道，我们英勇的部队已经突破了德军的兴登堡防线！德军正在全线溃退。

src: I am determined to put an end to El Raisuli's insurgence. The time has come to take the Berber strongholds on the Djebala and Gomara mountains. You will command our troops in the field.
dst: 我决心结束赖苏利的叛乱。攻取杰巴拉山和戈马拉山上柏柏尔人据点的时机已经到来。您将亲临战场指挥我们的部队。

src: I am glad to hear that you have reshuffeled your positions in order to close the gap in our front. It now runs along an imaginairy line from Serafimovitch to Nizhne Chirskaya and so far, it looks alright with remains of the 1st Roumanian Pz supporting Axis troops holding the southern part.
dst: 很高兴得知你已调整了阵地，封住了我们正面的缺口。这条战线现在沿着从谢拉菲莫维奇到下奇尔斯卡亚的一条假想线延伸，目前看来还不错，罗马尼亚第1装甲师残部协同轴心国部队守住了南段。

src: I am glad to see that you made it to Trablusgarp (Lybia) to lead us into battle. It must have been a difficult journey from Istanbul disguised as a reporter.
dst: 我很高兴看到您抵达的黎波里塔尼亚（利比亚）来领导我们作战。您乔装成记者从伊斯坦布尔前来，这一路想必十分艰难。

src: I am grateful of your promises to send reinforcements, the few men that managed to retire with my Finns are such heroes as they long for revenge!  We Shall overcome this setback!
dst: 我感激你们承诺派遣援军，随我芬兰人一起撤下来的那少数士兵都是渴望复仇的英雄！我们定会战胜这次挫折！

src: I am not sure if you believe my predictions anymore. The big German offensive in March that I declared as their last effort, was followed by another one, and another one.... and anolther one. I have no clue where they found the means and men to mount their attacks. Probably they come marching right out of hell. It is true, none of their offensives since the "Kaiserschlacht" in March has been a great success, but they are able to postpone the inevitable end of the war week by week, and month by month. And so many brave men still perish in the merciless storms of steel. Mon Dieu, when will this war ever end?
dst: 我不确定您是否还相信我的预测了。我在3月宣称那是德军最后一次努力的那场大规模攻势，之后接着又是一场，又一场……又一场。我完全不知道他们从哪里找来发动进攻的兵员和手段。也许他们径直从地狱里列队而来。确实，自从3月的「皇帝会战」以来，他们的攻势没有一场取得重大成功，但他们却能够一周又一周、一月又一月地把战争的必然结局往后拖延。而仍有那么多勇敢的人在无情的钢铁风暴中丧生。天啊，这场战争究竟何时才会结束？

src: I am proposing you for a promotion! You have managed to completely stop the German advance and eliminate the created bridgehead in a brilliant counterattack. The German 56th Division has suffered heavy casualties.
dst: 我提议为您晋升！您以一次出色的反击彻底阻止了德军前进，并消除了其建立的桥头堡。德军第56师伤亡惨重。

src: I am sorry, General. We had to break off the attack. Since we have been unable to take Magdhaba and her precious wells in time, a retreat to El Arish is the only option. Or do you rather want to die of thirst?
dst: 抱歉，将军。我们不得不中止进攻。由于未能及时拿下马格达巴及其宝贵的水井，撤回阿里什是唯一的选择。难道您更愿意渴死吗？

src: I am sorry, but we cannot grant a rest to you and your men... you are moved further by rail - our situation in the south is difficult...
dst: 很抱歉，但我们无法让您和您的部下休整……你们将被用火车继续调往别处——我们在南方的局势很困难……

src: I am still alive, but I am afraid that's more or less the only good news I can tell you from this ill-fated operation. You know how furious I was when I got to know that my brave men and I would be sent to the Dardanelles as support to our British friends in their attempt to break through the Dardanelles and take Constantinople. I wanted to fight the Boches on our own soil, and not engage in an operation that appears to have been planned by a bunch of lunatic British aristocrats without the slightest knowledge of how to conduct amphibious landings of such a scale. You can't delude an old warhorse like me! I felt it in my guts right from the start. And unfortunately, I have been proven right.
dst: 我还活着，但我恐怕这几乎是我能从这次倒霉的行动中告诉您的唯一好消息。您知道当我知道我和我英勇的士兵将被派往达达尼尔海峡、支援我们的英国朋友突破达达尼尔海峡并夺取君士坦丁堡的企图时，我有多么愤怒。我想在自家国土上打德国佬，而不是参与一场似乎是由一群对如此规模两栖登陆毫无概念、疯狂的英国贵族策划的行动。您可骗不了我这样的老战马！我从一开始就凭直觉感到不对劲。不幸的是，事实证明我是对的。

src: I am talking as an eccentric old man, and maybe that is all that is left of me. I retired from the Army before the end of 1918, and Evelyn and I could move (at last!) to our country house in Norwich. Since then, I have spent most of the time with my family, in the church, in my library, or in my garden. I have seldom moved more than 20 miles away from home in 18 years. My wife says that, obviously, my true vocation was being a hermit.
dst: 我说话的样子就像一个古怪的老头，也许这正是如今我仅存的模样。1918年结束前，我退伍了，伊芙琳和我终于得以搬回诺里奇的乡间住宅。自那以后，我大部分时间都与家人在一起，或在教堂、或在书房、或在花园里。十八年来，我很少离家超过20英里。我妻子说，很明显，我真正的天职是当一名隐士。

src: I am to be transferred to Graffenwoehr for assignment in a training support unit, and I have written orders here for you to return to your home as well..............it would seem our days of command are over.
dst: 我将被调到格拉芬沃尔，去一个训练支援单位任职，我这里还有书面命令让你也回家……看来我们统兵的日子到头了。

src: I am to report to OKW for assignment in Norway, and you General?  I here that Marshall Graziani will get you out of Hitlers attention by sending you to the Balkans.
dst: 我要去最高统帅部报到，接受挪威的任命，你呢，将军？我听说格拉齐亚尼元帅会把你派往巴尔干，让你离开希特勒的视线。

src: I am truly amazed, Herr Major! Your ability to command Tigers in an impassable terrain is matched only by the courage of your tanksmen. I've heard that you've been nominated for the Ritterkreuz!
dst: 我真是惊叹不已，少校阁下！你在无法通行的地形上指挥虎式的能力，唯有你坦克兵的勇气可与之比肩。我听说你已被提名骑士十字勋章！

src: I am truly amazed, Herr Major! Your ability to command Tigers in an impassable terrain is matched only by the courage of your tanksmen. Well done!
dst: 我真是惊叹不已，少校阁下！你在无法通行的地形上指挥虎式的能力，唯有你坦克兵的勇气可与之比肩。干得好！

src: I am very glad that my grandparents are together. They don't have anyone else than me, so once I'll merry, they won't be alone."
dst: 我很高兴爷爷奶奶又在一起了。他们除了我，没有别人，所以等我出嫁了，他们也不会孤单。”

src: I began designing it in June 2021, just a few days before the 80th anniversary of the attack on the Soviet Union. I thought it would be freely available that summer as a lighthearted vacation diversion. However, I was deeply mistaken; these eight short scenarios took me five years to complete.
dst: 我于2021年6月开始设计它，正值进攻苏联80周年前几天。我原以为那年夏天就能把它作为轻松的度假消遣免费发布。然而我大错特错；这八个短场景竟花了我五年才完成。

src: I bring good news from Moscow, comrade!  The leaders are very happy with your progress.  The fear of a successful army full of horse warriors is excellent propaganda material.  Yet it is not only propaganda!  Your army has not been defeated and is close to dealing another crucial blow to the capitalist's cause in southern Russia!
dst: 同志，我从莫斯科带来了好消息！领袖们对您的进展非常满意。一支战无不胜、骑士如云的军队所带来的威慑，是绝佳的宣传素材。但这也不只是宣传！您的军队未尝败绩，正接近在俄南部对资本家的事业再施一记重击！

src: I can't believe that I've been defeated by an army of farmers and peasants. The Makhnovists roam freely in Ukraine, destroying our garrisons and disrupting our supply lines. I haven't been able to stop them, and now I'm afraid that our offensive on Moscow will fail.
dst: 我简直无法相信自己竟被一支由农夫和农民组成的军队打败。马赫诺分子在乌克兰自由驰骋，摧毁我们的守军，破坏我们的补给线。我没能阻止他们，如今我担心我们对莫斯科的攻势将会失败。

src: I can't believe that the Serbians have defeated us again. Thank God that the Germans and the Bulgarians have taken care of the situation. Some foreigners have had to solve the problems that you caused. What a shame. What will our allies think about us if we can't get anything done? It's obvious that you need to retire. We'll find more capable officers that can replace you.
dst: 我真不敢相信塞尔维亚人又击败了我们。谢天谢地，德国人和保加利亚人已经收拾了局面。居然要由外国人来解决您惹出的麻烦。真是耻辱。我们的盟友会怎么看我们，如果我们一事无成？显然您需要退役了。我们会找到更能干的军官来接替您。

src: I can't believe that those pesky little Filipinos, with their poor training and even poorer equipment, have actually resisted our assaults and made us ask for reinforcements. They are astonishingly brave, that's for sure. We won't underestimate them again.
dst: 我真不敢相信，那些讨厌的小菲律宾人，训练差、装备更差，居然真的顶住了我们的进攻，还逼得我们请求增援。他们勇敢得惊人，这点毋庸置疑。我们不会再低估他们了。

src: I can't believe that you allowed yourself to be defeated by the Greeks. Now everything is lost!
dst: 我无法相信，您竟然让自己败给了希腊人。现在一切都完了！

src: I can't blame Buller for this poor planning. After all, he couldn't expect that you would be here so soon. But if you take Colenso and Ladysmith before he can react, you'll cut his supply lines, his army will be trapped in Northern Natal and his situation will become hopeless. Our final victory will be one step closer.
dst: 我不能怪布勒谋划不周。毕竟，他不可能料到您会这么快来到这里。但如果您在他反应过来之前拿下科伦索和莱迪史密斯，就能切断他的补给线，他的军队将被困在纳塔尔北部，处境将变得无望。我们的最终胜利也就更近了一步。

src: I can't continue writing. It's time for our attack...
dst: 我无法继续写下去了。到了我们进攻的时候了……

src: I can't understand what happened to us. We tried everything, but nothing worked. The Reds resisted. We threw everything that we had at them, and they were still capable of fighting back. Our offensive was a complete failure.
dst: 我无法理解我们到底怎么了。我们尝试了一切，却都不起作用。红军顶住了。我们倾尽全力扑向他们，他们却仍能反击。我们的攻势彻底失败了。

src: I can't understand your failure commander.  It seems our estimation of your skills were wrong... the central ChCP commission has demoted you to a private for the remainder of the fighting.  This should erase any capitalist bad manners that you have acquired.
dst: 我无法理解你的失败，指挥官。看来我们对你的能力评估错了...中共中央委员会已把你降为列兵，直到战斗结束。这应当能洗掉你沾染上的资本主义坏习气。

src: I can't understand your failure commander.  It seems our estimation of your skills were wrong... the central ChCP commission has demoted you to a private for the remainder of the fighting.  This should erase any capitalist bad manners that you may have acquired.
dst: 我无法理解你的失败，指挥官。看来我们对你的能力评估错了...中共中央委员会已把你降为列兵，直到战斗结束。这应当能洗掉你可能沾染上的资本主义坏习气。

src: I close this letter and will go to my men... it is dawning and the last attack is coming....
dst: 我合上这封信，就要到我的士兵们中间去了……天快亮了，最后的进攻即将到来……

src: I couldn't repel the first wave of Italian invaders, but with the help of reinforcements from Shewa and Harar we could finally stop the enemy offensive, at least for a while.
dst: 我没能击退第一波意大利入侵者，但在绍阿和哈拉尔援军的帮助下，我们终于阻止了敌人的攻势，至少暂时是这样。

src: I couldn't retake Velikoknyazheskaya, but at least the offensive of the 10th Army has stopped. The Bolsheviks have understood that staying on this bank of the Manych is becoming dangerous for them, so they have retreated. Now our right flank is secured and we can finally help the Don cossacks at Tsaritsyn.
dst: 我没能夺回韦利科克尼亚热斯卡亚，但至少第10集团军的攻势已经停止。布尔什维克已明白，留在马内奇河这一岸对他们日益危险，于是他们撤退了。如今我们的右翼得以巩固，终于可以去支援察里津的顿河哥萨克了。

src: I created this campaign using scenarios from other designers campaigns. I used scenarios that I liked and modified them to suit the campaign flow and OG features.
dst: 我用其他设计者战役中的场景制作了本战役。我挑选了自己喜欢的场景，并加以修改以适应战役流程和 OG 特性。

src: I did my best to recover my country, but in the end we were defeated. Now I suppose that I'll settle in Sweden with my family. Except for Anatoly, of course. His wife, his newborn baby and himself will go to Spain, where he hopes to join its colonial army. The idea of a new adventure sounds tempting, but I think that I'm too old for that. I wish my son the best, but for me the military life has finished.
dst: 我尽了全力去收复我的国家，但最终我们还是失败了。如今我想我会与家人在瑞典定居。当然，阿纳托利除外。他、他的妻子和他们刚出生的孩子将前往西班牙，他希望在那里加入西班牙的殖民地军队。新冒险的念头听起来很诱人，但我想自己已经太老了。我祝愿我的儿子一切顺利，但对我而言，军旅生涯已经结束。

src: I did not care about these opinions. I have never spoken in public about my war memories. Even my family wonders why. The reason is simple. I always thought that those memories were private, and belonged to me alone.
dst: 我并不在乎这些看法。我从未在公开场合谈论过我的战争回忆。连我的家人都不明白为什么。原因很简单。我一直认为，那些回忆是私人的，只属于我一个人。

src: I didn't expect such ineptitude from the Alpenkorps. Thank God that, even without your help, Serbia is doomed. We'll control the country in a matter of days. Now leave immediately and start to train your troops properly. If you don't, I doubt that any of you will survive the next battles.
dst: 我没想到阿尔卑斯军竟如此无能。谢天谢地，即便没有您的帮助，塞尔维亚也注定要完蛋。我们几天之内就能控制这个国家。现在立刻离开，开始好好训练您的部队。否则，我怀疑你们谁也活不过接下来的战斗。

src: I didn't expect you to be back so early from your meeting at Hong Kong. It's much better this way. You'll take command of the American troops at Tientsin.
dst: 我没想到您这么快就从香港的会晤中回来了。这样好得多。您将接掌驻天津美军的指挥权。
第1师/ 集团军 of Thessaly

src: I do not believe that we, until we put foot on Roman ground, on enemy's contact have to calculate. . .
dst: 我认为，在我们踏上罗马人的土地之前，不必考虑与敌接触. . .

src: I do not expect you will like your next assignment......in Corsica.
dst: 我料想你不会喜欢你的下一个任务……在科西嘉。

src: I do not know how this will end, but I feel this is the end of the war.. one way or the other..this is the final decision...
dst: 我不知道这一切会如何收场，但我感觉这就是战争的终结……无论以何种方式……这就是最后的决战……

src: I do not think it wise to return with your troops..........
dst: 我不认为带着你的部队回去是明智之举……

src: I don't believe it! You haven't been able to end this campaign on time! I will send reinforcements to reach the last objectives, but you will be relieved of command. It's obvious that you are an unreliable officer. You'd better return to Spain and sit at a desk for the rest of your career.
dst: 我真不敢相信！您竟然没能按时结束这场战役！我会派出援军去攻占最后的目标，但您将被解除指挥权。显然，您是个靠不住的军官。您最好返回西班牙，在办公桌后度过余下的职业生涯。

src: I don't forget your past services to our fatherland, but you must leave Morocco immediately. The war is over for you. I'll make sure that you are sent to a bureaucratic position in some Spanish province.
dst: 我不会忘记您过去对祖国的贡献，但您必须立即离开摩洛哥。对您来说，这场战争已经结束了。我会确保您被安排到某个西班牙省份担任一个文书职位。

src: I don't know how the hell they managed to get out this far without being detected, but that was a nice job you did mopping up the Soviet recon picket, Commander.  Can't be all of them though.  Sit tight.  I'll patch you through when we've got more information.
dst: 我不知道他们究竟是怎么神不知鬼不觉地摸到这么远的，但你清剿那支苏联侦察前哨干得漂亮，指挥官。不过不可能只有他们。先按兵不动。等有更多情报我再接通你。

src: I don't know what will happen next. I doubt that the Russians will recover from this failure. We'll stay here for a while, doing our best to help them, but maybe we would be more useful if we just returned home.
dst: 我不知道接下来会发生什么。我怀疑俄国人能否从这次失败中恢复过来。我们会在这里待上一阵子，尽力帮助他们，但也许我们直接回国反而更有用。

src: I don't like to remember the weeks that we spent repairing our railroads and fighting against the partisans. There was nothing noble in that. Only ruthless, bloody skirmishes. That summer war showed us its ugliest face.
dst: 我不愿回想我们修复铁路、同游击队作战的那几周。那其中没有什么高尚可言，只有残酷血腥的小规模冲突。那场夏季战争向我们展现了它最丑陋的一面。

src: I don't regret what I did, though. The Bolshevik menace is over. We have recovered our country. I have a home. Certainly, my life is hard, I can't do certain jobs, and my wounds hurt occasionally. But when the spring comes and I can go strolling on the shores of the Volga in Samara, I realise how lucky I am for being able to live in my beloved Russia, and I thank God for that. Our sacrifice has been worthwhile.
dst: 不过，我并不后悔自己的所作所为。布尔什维克的威胁已经解除。我们收复了祖国。我有了家。诚然，我的生活很艰难，我做不了某些工作，伤口也时常疼痛。但当春天来临，我能漫步在萨马拉的伏尔加河畔时，我意识到自己还能生活在我心爱的俄国，是何等幸运，为此我感谢上帝。我们的牺牲是值得的。

src: I don't think that I will ever get used to life in the trenches. We lost Herbert yesterday. Earlier this week part of his cheek got eaten by a rat while he was sleeping. We put a bandage on it and he went to the doctor first thing in the morning. But it was too late. The rat's poison turned his face and neck all black and he died two days later. If only the time would come when I could see you again and take you in my arms, if only this misery would have an end.
dst: 我想我永远也无法习惯战壕里的生活。昨天，我们失去了赫伯特。这周早些时候，他睡觉时脸颊被老鼠啃掉了一块。我们给他包扎了一下，他一大早就去看了医生。但已经太迟了。鼠毒让他的脸和脖子全都变黑了，两天后他便死了。要是能再见到您、把您拥入怀中的那一刻能到来该多好，要是这场苦难能有个尽头该多好。

src: I don't think the snow and the bad weather conditions of the Manchurian Winter will be a major problem for you.
dst: 我认为满洲冬季的大雪和恶劣天气不会成为你的主要问题。

src: I envied Denikin and his men. At least they were battling against real armies. They had crushed the Makhnovists in Ukraine and the Bolsheviks in Oboyan, and had kept advancing towards Orel. Meanwhile, we had been chasing murderous ghosts.
dst: 我羡慕邓尼金和他的部下。至少他们是在与真正的军队作战。他们粉碎了乌克兰的马赫诺分子和奥博扬的布尔什维克，并继续向奥廖尔推进。而我们却一直在追剿杀人不眨眼的幽灵。

src: I eventually recovered my strength, but the High Command decided that the war was over for me. I was sent back to England, where we arrived in July 1900. Miss Hobhouse had already sent the Government her well-known report on the concentration camps in South Africa, the British public was well aware of the situation, and the Fawcett Commision was being created to investigate Hobhouse's claims. So I decided to remain silent about what I knew. Nothing that I could have said would have provided any additional help to those poor people, and it would have contributed to sully the reputation of my beloved Army.
dst: 我最终恢复了体力，但最高统帅部认为战争对我来说已经结束。我被送回英国，于1900年7月抵达。霍布豪斯小姐早已向政府提交了她那篇关于南非集中营的著名报告，英国公众对局势十分清楚，福塞特委员会也正组建起来调查霍布豪斯的指控。于是我决定对我所知之事保持沉默。我无论说什么都无法给那些可怜的人带来任何额外帮助，反而只会损害我心爱的军队的名誉。

src: I fear that if we're divided the Reds will have an advantage on us. We'll have to take more risks and, if anything goes wrong, we could pay a very high price.
dst: 我担心，如果我们分散开来，红军就会占我们的上风。我们将不得不冒更大的风险，而一旦出了差错，我们可能会付出非常高昂的代价。

src: I felt great happiness when the Reds surrendered and the cossacks entered Orenburg. With the liberation of the city we could finally control the railways that we needed to communicate all our battle front from north to south, so as long as the Czechs did their jobs we could send supplies and reinforcements very quickly to any sector that could need it.
dst: 当红军投降、哥萨克进入奥伦堡时，我感到无比欣喜。随着该城的解放，我们终于掌控了贯通南北整条战线所需的铁路，只要捷克人尽职尽责，我们就能迅速向任何需要的战区运送补给和增援。

src: I got command for our attack on Virginia...!
dst: 我获得了进攻弗吉尼亚的指挥权……！

src: I guess that most of you have seen copies of that historical photograph of Kappel and Wrangel shaking their hands when they finally met in Saratov. In my living room I have a framed one, signed by both of them. Having contributed to the union of the two main anti-Bolshevik forces is one of the greatest things that I've ever done. I'm proud of having fought in Saratov.
dst: 我想你们大多数人都见过那张历史照片的复制品，照片上卡佩尔和弗兰格尔最终在萨拉托夫会面时握手。我的客厅里就挂着一幅装裱好的，上面有他们两人的签名。促成两大反布尔什维克力量联合，是我做过的最了不起的事情之一。我为自己在萨拉托夫作过战而自豪。

src: I guess that you would hardly recognize me now. In the last weeks my nerves have betrayed me. I can barely eat, and I just sleep three or fours hours every day, at best. Even then, my dreams are plagued with nightmares. I can't tell this to anyone, only to you. Somehow, being able to write this letter and tell you what I'm experiencing is a relief.
dst: 我猜您现在大概认不出我了。最近几周，我的神经背叛了我。我几乎吃不下东西，每天最多只能睡三四个小时。即便入睡，梦境也被噩梦纠缠。这件事我不能对任何人讲，只能对您说。不知怎的，能写下这封信、告诉您我正经历的一切，是一种解脱。

src: I had decided that I would leave the Army in 1916, when I turned sixty, but until then I was determined to serve my country with all my strength. And at that moment that meant studying as hard as when I was a cadet. Those were turbulent times in Europe: Germany was following an aggressive and expansionist foreign policy, and it was only a matter of time before they clashed with Russia or France. When that happened, Britain coud be forced to intervene, with unpredictable consequences.
dst: 我已决定在1916年、年满六十岁时离开军队，但在此之前，我决心竭尽全力为国效力。而在那一刻，这就意味着要像我当年当军校学员时一样刻苦学习。那是欧洲的动荡岁月：德国奉行着侵略性和扩张性的外交政策，他们与俄国或法国发生冲突只是时间问题。一旦发生，英国可能被迫介入，其后果难以预料。

src: I had hopes that the new airplanes could be useful at spotting the enemy troops, and maybe neutralizing their rear guard. Artillery was also an obvious choice against trenches and fortified positions, but in order to be effective, guns had to follow the advance of the infantry and provide cover fire at any given time, and that was only possible with highly experienced crews. And of course specialized infantry, like our Royal Engineers, could have an essential role in trench warfare. In fact there were too many theories and little experience in real battles, so despite all my efforts I was far from finding a definitive answer.
dst: 我曾希望新型飞机能有助于侦察敌军部队，也许还能压制他们的后卫。炮兵也是对付堑壕和筑垒阵地的显而易见之选，但要发挥效力，火炮必须跟上步兵的推进，并随时提供掩护火力，而这只有经验极其丰富的炮手才能做到。当然，像我们的皇家工兵这样的专业步兵，也能在堑壕战中发挥重要作用。事实上，理论太多而实战经验太少，因此尽管我竭尽全力，仍远未找到确定的答案。

src: I had to suffer his tantrums about giving the Yugoslavs advanced notice of the invasion and then his tirades about Italia's pathetic troops that can't seem to deal with the miserable token resistance that the Yugoslavs produced.
dst: 我不得不忍受他关于“提前通知了南斯拉夫人入侵”的暴怒，以及他对意大利那支可怜部队的长篇怒骂——他们似乎连南斯拉夫人那点微不足道的象征性抵抗都应付不了。

src: I hate this all. I hope that it will be over soon, but I fear that the Soviets are inexhaustible and that we won't be able to finish the operation with a satisfactory result.
dst: 我恨这一切。我希望它快点结束，但我担心苏联人取之不尽，我们无法以令人满意的结果结束这次行动。

src: I have decided your next assignment is to lead a newly formed CCNN battalion.
dst: 我已决定，你的下一个任务是率领一个新组建的黑衫军营。

src: I have great news General! Mussolini has been overthrown!, and, we are currently in secret negotiations with the new Italian government. They want to surrender! But, it has not been officially announced yet. Nevertheless, we will continue with the invasion of Italy; hopefully this will "hasten" their decision, and thus trap the Germans into fighting in a hostile country. Good luck General....
dst: 我有重大消息，将军！墨索里尼已被推翻！而且，我们目前正在与新的意大利政府进行秘密谈判。他们想投降！不过，此事尚未正式公布。尽管如此，我们仍将继续入侵意大利；但愿这能"促使"他们下定决心，从而把德国人困在一个充满敌意的国家里作战。祝你好运，将军……

src: I have just had the most humiliating meeting with Hitler!
dst: 我刚和希特勒开了一场最令人难堪的会！

src: I have only few minutes because we can hear some battle noise from far ahead of us. Will it be a minor skirmish again?
dst: 我只有几分钟时间，因为我们能听到远处前方传来的战斗声。这会不会又是一场小规模遭遇战？

src: I have only time for a short letter.... The recent days saw only minor skirmishes. We don't know what is going on, and it seems our maneuvers were unsuccessful...
dst: 我只有时间写封短信……最近几天只有零星的小规模战斗。我们不知道局势如何，而我们的机动似乎并不成功……

src: I have received more good news.  Comrade Tukhachevsky has started a grand offensive in Belarus and is also moving west!  Capitalist Poland will suffer dearly for their attack on the people of Russia!
dst: 我还收到了更多好消息。图哈切夫斯基同志已在白俄罗斯发动大规模攻势，同样在向西推进！资本主义的波兰将为其对俄国人民的进攻付出惨痛代价！

src: I have some bad news, comrade.  A few days ago while you were busy trying to capture Lwow; the Polish imperialists started a counteroffensive pushing through the center of the line between Lwow and Warsaw.  After their breakthrough they turned north and now the entire northern command is retreating in order not to be encircled!  Our dreams of capturing Warsaw have to be shelved!
dst: 同志，我有一些坏消息。几天前，当您忙于攻打利沃夫之际，波兰帝国主义者发动了反攻，从利沃夫与华沙之间的战线中部突破。突破之后他们转而向北，如今整个北线指挥部为避免被包围而节节后撤！我们攻占华沙的美梦只得暂时搁置！

src: I have taken your proposal of an attack by your Anzac's on Mont-St-Quentin to HQ and you have been given approval!! We admire your daring and wish you the best of luck. It's all or nothing Commander!!
dst: 我已将您提出的由澳新军团进攻蒙圣康坦的提议呈报总部，您已获得批准！！我们钦佩您的大胆，并祝您一切顺利。指挥官，成败在此一举！！

src: I have visited the Philippines in the past, and I can say the Lingayen Gulf offers good beachs to disembark your troops, select carefully where you are going to deploy your men, and the victory will be easy and swift. Also, I should say the high command has decided to land some of your troops nothwards from here, so, some of your command will come from the North.
dst: 我过去曾访问过菲律宾，我可以说林加延湾提供了良好的海滩供您的部队登陆，请谨慎选择部署您部下的地点，胜利就会轻松而迅速。另外，我应当说明，高层已决定让您的部分部队在此以北登陆，因此，您的一部分部队将从北方赶来。

src: I hear that you barely managed to escape the Soviet butchers.  Towns burn as the Chekists have free reign on the borders.  These Red Army raids are seen as very serious threats to the security of Estonia in Tallinn:  they may be precursors to an invasion by the Soviet Union.
dst: 我听说您险些没能逃出苏联屠夫的魔掌。城镇在燃烧，而契卡在边境上恣意妄为。这些红军的袭扰被视为对塔林的爱沙尼亚安全的严重威胁：它们可能是苏联入侵的前兆。

src: I hope that Anatoly is ready for this battle. He's a major now, so his responsabilities are greater. But now that Katya has told him that we approve it, it seems that his mind is only set on his engagement with that nurse of the Kornilov regiment. He shouldn't forget that this is a war, and that any distraction can have a terrible cost. I have confidence in his sense of duty, but maybe I should have a conversation with him about the matter.
dst: 我希望阿纳托利已为这场战斗做好准备。他如今已是少校，责任更重了。但自从卡佳告诉他我们同意后，他的心思似乎只放在与科尔尼洛夫团那位护士的婚约上了。他不该忘记这是一场战争，任何分心都可能付出惨痛代价。我对他的责任感有信心，但也许我该就此事和他谈谈。

src: I hope that in spite of the African heat we are suffering this Summer, the People's Army will be able to achieve all the scheduled goals.
dst: 我希望尽管今夏我们正忍受着非洲般的酷热，共和军仍能达成所有预定的目标。

src: I hope that the QG will authorize the permission that I've asked for, so I'll be at home for Christmas. I really wish so. I miss you very much,
dst: 我希望司令部能批准我所请求的休假，这样我就能回家过圣诞节了。我真的非常希望如此。我非常想念您，

src: I hope that you have had a good rest in Madrid after the last campaign and you are now full of energy for a new assignment.
dst: 希望上一场战役之后，您在马德里得到了充分休息，如今精力充沛地迎接新的任务。

src: I hope that your defences are ready, because the Germans are already here, on the bank of the Marne.  Our mission is clear: we must halt their advance. Defeat isn't an option. If they cross the river, all the Western Front could fall. But it won't happen. They won't break through our lines.
dst: 我希望您的防御已经就绪，因为德军已经逼近，就在马恩河畔。我们的任务很明确：必须阻止他们推进。失败绝不可接受。如果他们渡过此河，整条西线都可能崩溃。但这种情况不会发生。他们无法突破我们的防线。

src: I hope that, when you returned home after visiting Denise and saw that I wasn't at home, you didn't worry too much. I wish I could have written a real farewell letter, and not the quick note that I had to leave for you, but the orders from the QG were clear: I had to go back to active duty immediately, in a matter of hours, in fact. The war with Germany is so important for our army, that everything else had to be put aside. I'm so sorry for you, but there was nothing that I could do about that.
dst: 我希望您拜访丹妮丝后回到家、发现我不在时，没有太过担心。我真希望能写一封真正的告别信，而不是我不得不留给您的那张便条，但指挥部的命令很明确：我必须立即恢复现役，事实上只有几个小时的时间。对德战争对我军如此重要，其他一切都得靠边。我很抱歉，但我对此无能为力。

src: I hope to see you soon my son.
dst: 我希望能很快见到你，我的儿子。

src: I hope you and your men make it to the port, but now we really need to drive the enemy away."
dst: 我希望你和你的士兵能赶到港口，但现在我们真的需要把敌人赶走。”

src: I hope you don't suffer badly in the hands of the Arabs!! Farewell!
dst: 希望您在阿拉伯人手里不会吃太多苦头！！再见！

src: I hope you had enough rest from your participation on the Korean War.  As one of the heroes of the PRC the High Command of the PLA has a new mission for you.  The new North American government has retired the fleet that was guarding the Taiwan Strait.  This is the opportunity we have been waiting for; the assault on the rebel province of Taiwan.  You must end the existence of the KMT and its leader, Chiang-Kai-Shek.
dst: 希望你参加朝鲜战争之后已经休息够了。作为中华人民共和国的英雄之一，解放军最高统帅部给你一项新任务。新的北美政府已撤走守卫台湾海峡的舰队。这正是我们一直在等待的机会；进攻叛乱省份台湾。你必须终结国民党的存在及其领袖蒋介石。

src: I hope you have killed enought enemies in Tinian, because I think the battle for Guam will be even worse!. I haven't received many orders from Tokyo, the only I can suggest you is to take as much advantage as possible from the terrain, select carefuly where you are going to mount your lines... and kitto-katsu.
dst: 我希望您在提尼安岛已经消灭了足够多的敌人，因为我想关岛之战会更加惨烈！我没有从东京收到多少命令，我唯一能建议您的是尽可能利用地形，仔细选择您要部署防线的位置……并且，必胜。

src: I hope you will do better in in your next mission.
dst: 希望您在下一个任务中表现更好。

src: I hope you will find as much fun in playing as i did in designing.
dst: 希望你在玩的时候，能像我设计时一样得到那么多乐趣。

src: I hope, you recovered from your flu.
dst: 我希望您的流感已经痊愈。

src: I joined Friedrich Hecker who is negotiating at the moment with prussian general Friedrich von Gagen.
dst: 我加入了弗里德里希·黑克尔的队伍，此刻他正与普鲁士将军弗里德里希·冯·加根谈判。

src: I knew it. Ludendorff, that old fox, is making one last effort to cross the Marne. This time it's just a few miles east of Château-Thierry. He's trying a pincer movement around Reims.
dst: 我早就料到了。鲁登道夫那只老狐狸，正做最后一次努力强渡马恩河。这次地点在蒂耶里堡以东仅几英里处。他正企图对兰斯实施钳形攻势。

src: I knew that if panic spread all our front could be in serious danger, I ordered my men to keep calm, to stand firm at Gouzeaucourt, and to defend our lines at all costs.
dst: 我知道一旦恐慌蔓延开来，我们的整个战线都可能陷入严重危险，于是我命令我的士兵保持冷静，在古佐库尔站稳脚跟，不惜一切代价守住我们的防线。

src: I knew that it would happen sooner or later. When we arrived at the Philippines I really believed that the only thing that the local population wished was to get rid of the Spaniards and that, once they were gone, the Filipinos wouldn't object to an American occupation. But I was wrong. They want to become an independent republic, and they want it now. Some weeks ago their so-called president, Aguinaldo, threatened us with war if we persisted with our policy of benevolent assimilation.
dst: 我早就知道这事迟早会发生。刚到菲律宾时，我真的以为当地民众唯一的愿望就是赶走西班牙人，而且西班牙人一走，菲律宾人就不会反对美国的占领。但我错了。他们想成为一个独立的共和国，而且现在就要。几周前，他们那个所谓的总统阿奎纳多以战争相威胁，要我们放弃「善意同化」政策。

src: I know it's taken longer than expected to get you up here, but it took the Air Force a full six months to get everything ready, even with the assistance of the German scientists we "liberated" from that rocket base.  You've got a dedicated team of specialists and equipment up there now that are fully trained and itching for their first round of extraterrestrial combat. Took some words to get you in command of the outfit, but you know, I do my best.
dst: 我知道把你送上来的时间比预期长了些，但空军花了整整六个月才把所有东西准备妥当，即便有我们从那座火箭基地「解放」来的德国科学家帮忙。你现在在那边有一支专职的专家团队和装备，他们训练有素，正跃跃欲试地等待第一轮地外作战。为让你执掌这支部队费了些口舌，但你知道的，我总是尽力而为。

src: I know that I left home too soon, but la France needs me. Our haut-commandement is determined to beat back the Germans at Verdun once and for all. This attack has been prepared very carefully. A lot of guns and ammunition have been moved up to Verdun. Inlcuding two 400mm Creusot-Schneider railway guns. Reconnaisance airplanes have located many German guns. That will give our artillery something to shoot at. Fresh and well-trained troops will move forward behind a creeping barrage. My division will spearhead the attack to regain control of the fortresses of Vaux and Douamont. It will be a glorious day for France when the tricolore flies above those fortresses again.
dst: 我知道我离开家太早了，但法兰西需要我。我们的最高统帅部决心在凡尔登一劳永逸地击退德国人。这次进攻经过了非常周密的准备。大量火炮和弹药已运到凡尔登，包括两门400毫米克勒索—施耐德列车炮。侦察机已定位许多德军火炮。这将给我方炮兵提供射击目标。新锐且训练有素的部队将在徐进弹幕的掩护下向前推进。我的师将充当先锋，夺回沃堡和杜奥蒙堡的控制权。当三色旗再次飘扬在那些堡垒上空时，那将是法兰西光荣的一天。

src: I know that I won't live for much longer. The guards will kill me if disease doesn't do it first. I've told you everything that I remember about these months of war, hoping that, someday, one of you will be able to leave this country. When that moment comes, tell the world what really happened. Please, I beg you, don't let all of this be forgotten.
dst: 我知道自己活不了多久了。就算疾病不先夺去我的命，看守也会杀了我。我已把关于这几个月的战争所能记得的一切都告诉了您，只盼着有一天，你们当中有人能离开这个国家。到那时，请告诉世人这里真正发生过什么。求您了，我恳求您，别让这一切被遗忘。

src: I know that you are upset and you feel that you've been betrayed by the High Command, but the Afrika Korps will rise again.
dst: 我知道您很沮丧，觉得自己被最高统帅部出卖了，但非洲军终将再度崛起。

src: I know that you haven't had enough time to plan a decent strategy, but the situation right now is desperate. Your troops are the only reinforces available in all the Middle East. If you don't intervene, Turkey will surrender before the end of the month, since they can't resist any longer. You must counterattack immediately and retake Beirut. That should halt the British offensive, because the risk that they might be outflanked would become too high. Then we could think on our next move.
dst: 我知道您还没有足够的时间来制定一套像样的战略，但眼下的局势已经万分危急。您的部队是整个中东唯一可用的援军。如果您不出手，土耳其就会在本月底之前投降，因为他们已经支撑不下去了。您必须立即反攻并夺回贝鲁特。那样应当能阻止英军的攻势，因为他们被包抄的风险将变得过高。之后我们再考虑下一步行动。

src: I know that your troops are exhausted, but you must make the most of the time that we have left. Continue your march to the east, towards the city of Minsk. Your objective isn't the city itself, but the roads, the railway lines, and the strategic towns surrounding Minsk. That will help us to get more concessions from the Reds at the negotiation table.
dst: 我知道您的部队已疲惫不堪，但您必须充分利用我们剩下的时间。继续向东进军，朝着明斯克城前进。您的目标不是城市本身，而是明斯克周边的公路、铁路线和战略城镇。那将有助于我们在谈判桌上从红军那里争取到更多让步。

src: I know the Germans have given you a hard stroke but you have received as reinforcements our elite troops and you should have performed much better. I am afraid you should look for new challenges.
dst: 我知道德军给了您沉重一击，但您得到了我们的精锐部队作为增援，本应表现得更好。恐怕您该去找新的挑战了。

src: I know the situation is dramatic and our troops are exhausted but I was expecting much more from you as commander.
dst: 我知道局势十分严峻，我们的部队已经精疲力竭，但作为指挥官我对你的期望要高得多。

src: I know this decision is difficult to understand since its means losing both Antwerpen/Anvers and Bruxelles/Brussel and leaving our strong positions at the "KW line" (Dyle position), but we have to be confident in our allies. The retreat will start in the night of the 17th/18th of May. You must ensure the IV and V Corps retreat to the new positions behind the Escaut/Scheldt river and stop the Germans over it to give time for the redeployment. Our army depots have also to be moved.
dst: 我知道这一决定难以理解，因为它意味着既要放弃安特卫普和布鲁塞尔，又要放弃我们在“KW 防线”（迪尔河阵地）的坚固阵地，但我们必须信任盟友。撤退将于5月17日至18日夜间开始。您必须确保第4军和第5军撤往斯海尔德河后方的新阵地，并把德军阻止在河对岸，以便争取重新部署的时间。我军仓库也必须转移。

src: I know this means abandoning Brussels and Leuven but I am confident we will check the German advance there.
dst: 我知道这意味着放弃布鲁塞尔和鲁汶，但我相信我们能在那里阻止德军前进。

src: I know this means abandoning Brussels and Leuven but I am confident we will fight until our last round there.
dst: 我知道这意味着放弃布鲁塞尔和鲁汶，但我相信我们会在那里战斗到最后一弹。

src: I know you're saddened by the death of your old friend Col. Emerson Liscum, but there is no time to lose. We must exploit this splendid victory and advance into Peking as soon as possible. The foreign legations must be relieved, no matter the cost.
dst: 我知道您为老友埃默森·利斯科姆上校的死而悲痛，但现在没有时间耽搁。我们必须利用这场辉煌的胜利，尽快向北京推进。不惜一切代价，也要解救各国外交使团。

src: I know you've tried, General, but you have to admit that the war is affecting you. A couple of years ago you'd have had no problems in defeating the Italians in Albania. Now, you've been incapable of winning this battle. It's time for you to retire. Take this not as an order, but as an advice from an old friend. You've done great things for the Empire. Now it's time for you to help in the reserve.
dst: 我知道您已经尽力了，将军，但您得承认战争正在影响您。要是几年前，您在阿尔巴尼亚击败意大利人根本不成问题。如今，您却无法赢得这场战斗。是您该退役的时候了。请把这话当作一位老友的忠告，而非命令。您为帝国立下了汗马功劳。现在，是时候去预备役效力了。

src: I know your troops are stiff from the cold and their long travel to get here, but we must launch our attack to destory these forces immediately.  The heat of battle will warm our blood!
dst: 我知道你的部队长途跋涉而来、被冻得僵硬，但我们必须立即发起进攻，消灭这些敌军。战斗的热度会让我们热血沸腾！

src: I meet with Marshall Graziani, your replacement tomorrow.  I expect you will be professional enough to brief him fully on his new command before you return to Italy.
dst: 我明天会见接替你的格拉齐亚尼元帅。希望你能足够专业，在返回意大利之前向他充分汇报他的新指挥权。

src: I missed my old days in the army and, let's admit it, I was overcome by greed. So I accepted the King's offer, and that's how I became an Abyssinian general. Now hear the rest of my story.
dst: 我怀念过去在军队里的日子，而且，坦率地说，我也被贪欲冲昏了头脑。于是我接受了国王的提议，就这样成为了一名阿比西尼亚将军。现在请听我讲完剩下的故事。

src: I moved all the dates 2 years into the future and reduced this campaign from 50 scenarios to 27.
dst: 我把所有日期往后推了2年，并把这个战役从50个场景缩减到27个。

src: I must commend your forces, your drive up the right was fantastic in this rugged country.  I was happy to report directly to the Furher himself of our success, and he said he would call Mussilini to send his personal gratitude.
dst: 我必须嘉奖你的部队，在这片崎岖之地，你右路的推进精彩绝伦。我很高兴直接向元首本人汇报了我们的成功，他说他会打电话给墨索里尼，转达他个人的谢意。

src: I must commend your forces, your drive up the right was on time despite this rugged country.  I was happy to report directly to the Furher himself of our success, he sends you his gratitude.
dst: 我必须嘉奖你的部队，尽管这片地区崎岖，你右路的推进仍如期完成。我很高兴直接向元首本人汇报了我们的成功，他向你转达谢意。

src: I must hurry, ma chère. Pray for me, pray for Emile who is probably in the middle of the inferno right now.
dst: 我得抓紧了，亲爱的。为我祈祷，为埃米尔祈祷，此刻他大概正身处炼狱之中。

src: I must inform you that you have been instantly relieved of your command. You are called back to London to give a full report of this operation. Lord Kitchener has called you an "example of unbearable military incompetence", so don't expect to see further action in this war...
dst: 我必须通知您，您已被立即解除指挥权。您被召回伦敦，就这次行动作全面汇报。基钦纳勋爵称您为「不可容忍的军事无能之典范」，所以别指望在这场战争中还有仗可打了……

src: I must inform you that you have been instantly relieved of your command. You are called back to London to give a full report of this operation. The Prime Minister has called you an "example of unbearable military incompetence", so don't expect to see further action in this war...
dst: 我必须通知您，您已被立即解除指挥权。您被召回伦敦，就这次行动作全面汇报。首相称您为「不可容忍的军事无能之典范」，所以别指望在这场战争中还有仗可打了……

src: I must stop writing now. Je t'embrasse,
dst: 我现在必须停笔了。吻您，

src: I never thought that they'd think about me for an active position in the first line of battle. Too old for that, I said. But some of my comrades, that are currently in the Ministry, think otherwise. They believe that, right now, we need level headed commanders, whose wishes for revenge don't cloud their judgements.
dst: 我从没想过他们会考虑让我担任第一线战斗的现役职务。我说过，我太老了。但我的一些目前在陆军部的战友却不这么想。他们认为，眼下我们需要头脑冷静的指挥官，对复仇的渴望不应蒙蔽他们的判断。

src: I pray for your success. This one could be the last battle of this war.
dst: 我为您的成功而祈祷。这一战可能是这场战争的最后一仗。

src: I promise that I will come home for good soon.
dst: 我保证，我很快就会永远回家。

src: I regret to inform you that our admired General found a glorious death in the field of battle. His sacrifice allowed us to gain enough time to fortify and defend Melilla, that could finally be saved with the help of the French Army. From now on all of Morocco will be under the influence of France, and only the cities of Ceuta and Melilla will remain under the sovereignty of Spain.
dst: 我很遗憾地告知您，我们敬仰的将军在战场上光荣捐躯了。他的牺牲为我们赢得了足够的时间来加固并保卫梅利利亚，最终这座城在法国陆军的帮助下得救了。从今往后，整个摩洛哥都将处于法国的影响之下，只有休达和梅利利亚两座城市仍归西班牙主权所有。

src: I repeat, move fast!!! Luftwaffe will support your mission. Unfortunately the elite Mountain Mortar units are delayed due to bad weather.
dst: 我再重复一遍，迅速行动！！！德国空军将支援你的任务。遗憾的是，精锐山地迫击炮部队因恶劣天气而延误。

src: I resolved, therefore, stop fighting. If success has not crowned our efforts for now, this does not diminish the greatness of our task, nor clouds the heroic deeds that you have undertaken to carry it out. You have been soldiers worthy of a Cause like mine, and your deeds will place you at a great height. In our  immortal history  the names of your victories will be inscribed with dazzling letters. My Spaniard pride grows with the show of your courage, and my heart of King will keep eternal gratitude to your dedication and your sacrifice.
dst: 因此，我决定停止战斗。即使成功暂时未能眷顾我们的努力，这也不会减损我们事业的伟大，更不会遮蔽你们为践行它而完成的英勇壮举。你们是配得上我这般事业的士兵，你们的功绩将使你们名垂高位。在我们不朽的历史中，你们胜利的名字将以耀眼的文字铭刻。你们展现的勇气让我的西班牙自豪感油然而生，我的国王之心将永远感激你们的奉献与牺牲。

src: I see that the eighty-eights are deadly weapons. We've discovered Matildas that were torn to pieces of scrap metal after a single hit! Your advice will be taken seriously from now on!"
dst: 看来八八炮是致命的武器。我们发现了一些玛蒂尔达坦克，被一发命中就撕成了废铁！你的建议从今往后会被认真对待！”

src: I set my headquarters in Dogali, where my father had fought in the past. In Massawa, the Italian ascaris had long deserted. The garrison of Massawa was composed of some terrified policemen and sailors who didn't have been evacuated when Italy surrendered. A group of British sailors were trying to help them, although their morale was equally low. However, the fortifications of the city were still solid, so taking Massawa wouldn't be a walk on the park.
dst: 我把司令部设在多加利，先父曾在那里作战。在马萨瓦，意大利的阿斯卡里士兵早已逃散。马萨瓦的守军由一些惊慌失措的警察和意大利投降时未及撤走的水兵组成。一队英国水兵正试图帮助他们，尽管这些人的士气同样低落。然而，这座城市的防御工事仍然坚固，所以夺取马萨瓦绝非易事。

src: I shall be glad to honor my promise to support Italy with my Spanish Legions in future campaigns.
dst: 我将乐于兑现承诺，用我的西班牙军团在未来的战役中支持意大利。

src: I should send you to take care of the Royal Stables, but I can't afford losing any officers. So get out of my sight for a few weeks, and I'll call you again when there is another chance to redeem yourself against the Serbians.
dst: 我本该派您去照看皇家马厩，可我损失不起任何军官。所以这几周先别让我看见您，等再有向塞尔维亚人雪耻的机会时，我会再叫您。

src: I should warn you that you are close to the Bulgarian border. We are not in war with Bulgaria though the country is allied to Germany. You have orders not to cross the Danube and leave the Bulgarians for what they are. On later date Moskva will decide what we will do with Bulgaria.  Good luck, comrade.
dst: 我要提醒你，你已接近保加利亚边境。尽管保加利亚是德国的盟国，我们并未与保加利亚开战。你奉命不得渡过多瑙河，对保加利亚人暂且不予理会。日后莫斯科会决定我们如何处置保加利亚。祝你好运，同志。

src: I soon developed a great deal of respect for the simple, but highly efficient tactics of those Dutch farmers. When they had to defend themselves, they dug trenches or took the nearby hills, and fired on our troops with remarkable accuracy. When we came too close to their positions, they retreated to secondary lines of defence, where they could keep on resisting our advance. If they had to attack, they were masters of the fire-and-movement technique. Excellent riders and shooters, they could move at great speed on the South African terrain, which they knew perfectly and used to their advantage. The lessons that I learnt in South Africa would be very useful to me during the Great War.
dst: 我很快对那些荷兰农民简单却极为高效的战术产生了深深的敬意。当他们需要防御时，便挖掘战壕或占领附近的山丘，以惊人的准度向我军射击。当我们逼近其阵地时，他们便撤至二线防御阵地，继续抵抗我军的推进。若需进攻，他们则是「火力与运动」战术的大师。作为出色的骑手和射手，他们能在那片他们了如指掌并善加利用的南非土地上高速机动。我在南非学到的经验，在后来那场大战中对我极为有用。

src: I still don't understand what has happened to you. Was it simply bad luck, or something else? Did the idea of fighting the Russians make you feel uneasy? I'm afraid that, for the next months, you'll be under investigation and you won't command any troops.
dst: 我仍然不明白您究竟怎么了。是单纯的运气不佳，还是另有隐情？与俄国人作战的念头让您心神不宁了吗？恐怕在接下来的几个月里，您将接受调查，不再指挥任何部队。

src: I still have nightmares when I remember Ekaterinburg. The Soviets struck from our rear, cutting our retreat lines. Many soldiers, civilians and equipment were trapped in the city, and despite all our efforts we couldn't evacuate them. Others died or were captured when they were trying to reach Tobolsk.
dst: 一想起叶卡捷琳堡，我至今仍会做噩梦。苏维埃从我们后方发动突袭，切断了我们的退路。许多士兵、平民和装备被困在城里，尽管我们竭尽全力，仍无法将他们撤出。另一些人在试图赶往托博尔斯克的途中死亡或被俘。

src: I suggest Generalmajor Otto Bistroff for promotion."
dst: 我建议晋升少将奥托·比斯特罗夫。”

src: I think I owe you a slight apology, General, we did not know the Russians were so strong again. It appears they have been planning an attack on us all along. Unfortunately, many other sections of the front have been harder hit and need reinforcement desperately.
dst: 我想我得向你略表歉意，将军，我们不知道俄国人竟又如此强大。看来他们一直在策划进攻我们。遗憾的是，战线其他许多地段遭受的打击更重，急需增援。

src: I think it would be good to place an article in the FAZ stating that the general of the XXII Pz division died while commanding his tanks in the front line.
dst: 我认为最好在《法兰克福汇报》上刊登一篇文章，称第22装甲师师长在前线指挥坦克作战时阵亡。

src: I think it would be good to place an article in the Volkischer Beobachter stating that the general of the XXII Pz division died while commanding his tanks in the front line.
dst: 我认为最好在《人民观察家报》上刊登一篇文章，称第22装甲师师长在前线指挥坦克作战时阵亡。

src: I think she will be quite useful for us in the future...
dst: 我想它在将来会对我们大有用处……

src: I think that we could have a bigger fish to catch pretty soon. If Wilson is re-elected this year and the Germans keep on acting as irrational barbarians, America will enter the Great War. The British and the French are praying for the day when we'll fight among them, that's for sure, and I believe that day is near. You'd better get ready, for your next destination could be the trenches of France.
dst: 我想我们很快就会有一条更大的鱼要抓。如果威尔逊今年成功连任，而德国人继续表现得像不讲理的野蛮人，美国就会参战加入这场大战。英国人和法国人肯定都在祈祷我们与他们并肩作战的那一天到来，而我相信那一天已经不远了。您最好做好准备，因为您的下一站可能就是法国的战壕。

src: I think you already know the outline of the plan - all you need to do is take Duenkirchen and you will have cut off the British and French from resupply and cut their only escape route. The importance of this victory cannot be estimated too highly - all of France might fall if this works!
dst: 我想你已知晓计划梗概——你要做的就是拿下敦刻尔克，这样就能切断英法的补给，并截断其唯一退路。此役之重要无论怎么估量都不为过——若成功，整个法国都可能陷落！

src: I think you deserve a rest, General. A leave would do you good and I'm sure that we won't have much enemy activity for some time. We'll talk again once you are back. I will be glad to have you by my side in future operations.
dst: 我认为您该休息了，将军。休个假对您有好处，而且我确信一段时间内敌人不会有什么大动作。等您回来我们再谈。未来作战中有您在身边，我会很高兴。

src: I think you know this area - it is Lemberg again, or Lvov as the Russians call it. Take it back - they don't expect you and won't be ready. Because of your heroic actions in Western and Southern Europe you've been chosen to lead the assault!
dst: 我想你熟悉这片地区——又是伦贝格，也就是俄国人口中的利沃夫。把它夺回来——他们料不到你来，不会有所防备。鉴于你在西欧和南欧的英勇表现，你被选中率队突击！

src: I think you should take a rest, General. A leave would do you good and I'm sure that we won't have much enemy activity for some time.
dst: 我认为您该休息了，将军。休个假对您有好处，而且我确信一段时间内敌人不会有什么大动作。

src: I thought I'd never say this, but I'm almost glad to be back on the battle. I know that it may sound strange coming from a member of the Military Directory that will govern Russia until the revolution is completeley defeated, but I simply can't get used to political affairs. In my opinion, those pointless discussions were mostly responsible for the fall of the Tsar and the coming of the Bolsheviks.
dst: 我本以为我永远不会说出这种话，但我几乎为重返战场而感到高兴。我知道，这话出自一个将执掌俄国直至革命被彻底粉碎的军事委员会成员之口，或许显得有些奇怪，但我实在无法适应政治事务。在我看来，那些毫无意义的争论在很大程度上导致了沙皇的垮台和布尔什维克的上台。

src: I took my family to Spain. At first, it was very hard for them, but we've finally found happiness here. Life isn't easy, but at least we're free. Well, I guess that now my sons and daughters must find their place in life. I found mine, in a country that I could never have imagined, but now all that's left for me to do is living my final years happily and peacefully, surrounded by my loved ones.
dst: 我带着家人去了西班牙。起初，他们过得很艰难，但我们最终在这里找到了幸福。生活并不容易，但至少我们是自由的。嗯，我想如今我的儿女们必须找到自己在生活中的位置。我找到了我的位置，在一个我做梦也想不到的国家，而现在我唯一要做的，就是在挚爱亲人的围绕下，安详而平静地度过余生。

src: I understand that you will conduct anti-partisan duty, a distasteful yet necessary task.
dst: 我明白你将执行反游击任务，这是一项令人不快却必要的任务。

src: I understand your doubts in Hitler's demand to send more troops and Marshall Graziani......but perhaps Adolf will now listen to our demands for joint tank development as a price?
dst: 我理解你对希特勒增兵要求的疑虑，还有格拉齐亚尼元帅……但也许阿道夫现在会听我们的，把联合研制坦克作为代价来谈？

src: I used the "no prototype" settings, moreover the purchase pool is limited to simulate the reality of warfare in Russia, the overall German military production, but mainly the fact that you command just a tank battalion. For the "Blitzkrieg!" minicampaign, you are recommended to increase your tank force with a new unit each scenario, while giving your older companies at least somewhat up to date vehicles. For the "Defending The Reich" minicampaign, you should increase the number of your secondary units, and especially try to improve the anti-aircraft capabilities of your force, as the deteriorating situation will leave you with lesser and lesser Luftwaffe support.
dst: 我采用了“无原型”设定，且购买池有限，以模拟俄国战场的现实、德国军工总产量，以及最重要的——你只指挥一个坦克营这一事实。在“闪电战！”迷你战役中，建议你每个场景都为坦克部队添置一个新单位，同时给老连队换装至少较为新式的车辆。在“保卫德意志”迷你战役中，则应增加辅助单位的数量，尤其要设法提升部队的防空能力，因为日益恶化的战局将使你得到的空军支援越来越少。

src: I used the "no prototype" settings, moreover the purchase pool is limited to simulate the reality of warfare in Russia, the overall German military production, but mainly the fact that you command just a tank battalion. For the "Tiger I" minicampaign, you are simply recommended to upgrade your starting tanks. For the "Tiger II" minicampaign, you should increase the number of your secondary units, and especially try to improve the anti-aircraft capabilities of your force, as the deteriorating situation will leave you with lesser and lesser Luftwaffe support.
dst: 我采用了“无原型”设定，且购买池有限，以模拟俄国战场的现实、德国军工总产量，以及最重要的——你只指挥一个坦克营这一事实。在“虎式I型”迷你战役中，建议你直接升级初始坦克。在“虎式II型”迷你战役中，则应增加辅助单位数量，尤其要设法提升部队防空能力，因为日益恶化的战局将使你得到的空军支援越来越少。

src: I used to love this area for boating in the summer, there are a few lovely canals and lakes here... well, it's a pity we don't have time for mere sightseeing right now. Holland must fall in two days if we are successfully to sieze Belgium before the French and the British can march in. Already well-known for your courageous dashes, your Kampfgruppe has been chosen for this task. Expect only the slightest resistance.
dst: 我从前很喜欢夏天来这里划船，这儿有几条可爱的运河和湖泊……唉，可惜眼下我们没工夫游山玩水。荷兰必须在两天内陷落，我们才能抢在法英军队开进之前拿下比利时。你的战斗群素以勇猛突进闻名，故被选中执行此任务。预计只会遇到极轻微的抵抗。

src: I was able to write and send this letter just before we left New Orleans for the Gulf of Mexico. They say we will sail westwards. So Florida is not our destination! It must be Alabama or Texas.
dst: 就在我们离开新奥尔良驶向墨西哥湾之前，我得以写下并寄出这封信。他们说我们将向西航行。所以佛罗里达不是我们的目的地！一定是阿拉巴马或得克萨斯。

src: I was amazed by the stubbornness and determination of the German assaults, so similar to those made by the Dervishes at Omdurman. In both cases waves of soldiers, some of whom were very young and lacked any proper training, charged to their deaths without any sign of hesitation or fear. In the end their sacrifice was futile, as even their hearts had to know.
dst: 德军进攻的顽强与坚决令我震惊，这与德尔维希人在恩图曼发动的冲锋何其相似。在这两场战役中，一波波士兵——其中有些人非常年轻且缺乏任何正规训练——毫不犹豫、毫无惧色地冲向死亡。最终，他们的牺牲徒劳无功，这一点就连他们的内心也必然明白。

src: I was completely wrong about you and maybe also with your friend Zhou, hmmm or maybe not.  I think China deserves a return to the true Revolution to avoid the capitalist deformation that you have suffered.
dst: 我看错你了，也许也看错了你的朋友周，嗯，也许没有。我认为中国应当回归真正的革命，以避免你所沾染上的资本主义蜕变。

src: I was extremely happy. We were recovering our homeland step by step. Siberia and the Urals were safe, and now it was time to consolidate our positions on the Volga.
dst: 我欣喜若狂。我们正在一步步收复祖国。西伯利亚和乌拉尔安全了，现在是时候巩固我们在伏尔加河的阵地了。

src: I was ordered to go to Gojjam as soon as possible. The Empress sent her Imperial Guard as a reinforcement, and I could use the local guerrillas to harass the advancing British, but I knew that the upcoming battle was going to be very tough, maybe the toughest that I had ever fought.
dst: 我奉命尽快赶往戈贾姆。女皇派她的帝国卫队前来增援，我还可以利用当地游击队骚扰推进中的英军，但我知道，即将到来的战斗将异常艰苦，或许是我经历过的最艰苦的一仗。

src: I was pleasantly surprised by the personality of the Emperor. I was expecting a murderous, ignorant savage. What I found was a clever, devout and resolute man, deeply concerned by the future of his kingdom and his subjects. He was well aware that, surrounded by Muslim kingdoms and with a growing European interest in the lands of the Horn of Africa, Ethiopia could only survive by abandoning the old medieval ways and becoming a modern state. Yohannes knew that the Ethiopians couldn't achieve that goal without the help of European advisors.
dst: 皇帝的性格让我又惊又喜。我原本以为会遇到一个嗜杀成性、愚昧无知的野蛮人。结果我却见到了一位聪慧、虔诚而果断的人，他深深关切着自己王国和臣民的未来。他清楚地意识到，四周环绕着穆斯林王国，欧洲对非洲之角这片土地的关注又日益增长，埃塞俄比亚唯有抛弃陈旧的封建体制、成为一个现代国家，才能生存下去。约翰内斯知道，没有欧洲顾问的帮助，埃塞俄比亚人无法实现这一目标。

src: I was saddened when I saw how many Tigrayans were serving in the Italian colonial army. One of Menelik's aims had always been to limit the political and military power of Tigray, so that their inhabitants could never be a challenge for his authority.
dst: 当我看到有那么多提格雷人在意大利殖民军中服役时，我感到十分痛心。孟尼利克的一个目标，一直都是限制提格雷的政治和军事力量，好让那里的居民永远无法对他的权威构成挑战。

src: I will always remember this first battle; the screaming, the confusion, the thought that the world was coming to an end. The initial fear and the anger that came after it. I experienced those sensations every time that I entered combat, but they were never as intense as against the Zulus. Somehow, that South African valley will stay with me for the rest of my life.
dst: 我将永远铭记这第一场战斗：呐喊声、混乱，以及世界末日将至的感觉。最初的恐惧，以及随之而来的愤怒。每次投入战斗，我都会体验到这些感受，但它们从未像面对祖鲁人时那样强烈。不知怎的，那个南非山谷将伴随我的余生。

src: I will have a chance to redeem myself for my failure at Oboyan. Not all the news from Ukraine are good. Nestor Makhno and his army of anarchist peasants want to help the Reds now, and they have invaded Western Ukraine. We just have a handful of soldiers in that area, and our supply lines are too long and very vulnerable, so Makhno could make us a lot of damage, even threatening our offensive on Moscow. I must go to Uman and put an end to this menace.
dst: 我将有机会为奥博扬的失败将功补过。来自乌克兰的消息并不都好。涅斯托尔·马赫诺和他那支无政府主义农民军队如今想帮助红军，他们已经入侵了乌克兰西部。我们在那一带只有少数士兵，补给线过长且极易受攻击，因此马赫诺可能给我们造成巨大损失，甚至威胁到我们对莫斯科的攻势。我必须前往乌曼，消除这一威胁。

src: I will never admit that a Man will be another Man´s Slave!
dst: 我绝不承认一个人会成为另一个人的奴隶！

src: I wish that this was the end of the war, but it won't be so easy. The Filipinos will surely avoid any kind of pitched battles in the future, and they'll employ tactics of guerrilla warfare. It will be a long and frustrating war. No matter how hard we hit them, they'll hit back the next day. It's the kind of war that I loathe. As long as there is a living Filipino, we won't be able to take peace for granted.
dst: 我真希望战争就此结束，但事情不会那么简单。菲律宾人今后肯定会避免任何形式的阵地战，转而采用游击战术。这将是一场漫长而令人沮丧的战争。无论我们打击得多狠，他们第二天都会还击。这正是我厌恶的那类战争。只要还有一个活着的菲律宾人，我们就无法把和平视为理所当然。

src: I wish that you retired and lived as a civilian for the rest of your life, but there are different orders for you. You must go with a small contingent of troops to China, where the anti-western movement has grown increasingly violent. We must send some soldiers to protect the Americans who live there, as well as their possessions. You'll have another chance and  I'll get rid of you, so we both win.
dst: 我本希望您就此退役，余生做个平民，但对您另有安排。您必须带领一支小分队前往中国，那里的排外运动日益暴力。我们必须派些士兵去保护那里的美国侨民及其财产。您将得到另一次机会，而我也会摆脱您，这样我们俩都如愿。

src: I wish that you were here with me. It's so long since I have seen you for the last time. I really miss you.
dst: 我多希望此刻你在我身边。我已经很久没见到你了。我真的很想你。

src: I wish we could have remained in Romania for some time, to witness our final victory at the Eastern Front. Instead, the High Command sent us elsewhere. They say we’ve become one of the best German units, and now they need our skills in the Alps, where it all began.
dst: 我多希望我们能在罗马尼亚再待一段时间，好亲眼见证我们在东线的最后胜利。然而，最高统帅部却把我们派往了别处。他们说，我们已成为德国最精锐的部队之一，如今需要我们的本领回到阿尔卑斯山——这一切开始的地方。

src: I wish you could remain with us to lead the invasion of Egypt, but it seems Mussilini has a bigger assignment for you, Malta!
dst: 我本希望你留下来领导对埃及的入侵，但看来墨索里尼有个更大的任务给你——马耳他！

src: I wish you never experience that ominous state of mind of perpetual sadness, when all your efforts seem pointless, and everything that you love and cherish seems about to die. That terrible disease of the soul during which even breathing causes an immense pain, until you end up envying the stray dogs on the streets, hungry and full of ticks, but free of worries.
dst: 我希望您永远不要体会那种不祥的、无休止悲伤的心境：您所有的努力似乎都毫无意义，您所爱所珍视的一切似乎都将死去。那种灵魂的可怕病症，其间连呼吸都会带来巨大的痛苦，直到您最终羡慕起街上的流浪狗——饥肠辘辘、满身跳蚤，却无忧无虑。

src: I won't lie to you. The entire front could collapse if you can't buy us some time to retreat in order, so we can save as many soldiers and supplies as possible. We know that there are Russian regiments north, south and east of Rawa Ruska, so this won't be an easy mission. If you aren't careful, you could end up trapped, surrounded by enemy units. Don't hold your ground for a minute longer than necessary.
dst: 我不会骗您。如果您不能为我们争取到一些时间，让我们有序撤退、尽可能多地保全士兵与补给，整条战线就可能崩溃。我们知道，拉瓦鲁斯卡的北、南、东三面都有俄军团队，所以这不是一个轻松的任务。若不小心，您可能会身陷重围，被敌军包围。没有必要，就一刻也不要多守。

src: I would have wished you could have welcomed the Germans instead - but meeting them shall have to do eh?
dst: 我本希望你能去迎接德国人——不过与他们碰头也就将就了，对吧？

src: I would say that we should encircle and conquer Rome as soon as possible ....instead of fighting a protracted, energy-consuming war like Hannibal .....
dst: 我以为我们应当尽快包围并攻下罗马 ....而不是像汉尼拔那样打一场旷日持久、耗尽元气的战争 .....
第1&第2&第3/第10/第10装甲掷弹兵师
第1&第2/第41/第10装甲掷弹兵师

src: I'd like to say that they'll pay for that, but the truth is that they outnumber us 2-to-1. Stopping them isn't going to be easy. At least we have some good defensive positions on the mountains. That should help.
dst: 我很想说他们会为此付出代价，但事实是他们在兵力上以二比一超过我们。要挡住他们并不容易。至少我们在山上有一些不错的防御阵地。那应该会有所帮助。

src: I'll be glad to go with you to Wilno to offer our victory to Our Lady of Gate of Dawn. May our Lord give you a long and prosperous life.
dst: 我很乐意与您一同前往维尔诺，将我们的胜利敬献给黎明之门圣母。愿上帝赐予您长寿而富足的一生。

src: I'll join them very soon. I'll give my notebook to one of my friends, and I hope that some day he'll be able to publish it. People need to know what happened. That will be my legacy when I'm gone. Lord Jesus Christ, Son of God, have mercy on me, a sinner.
dst: 我很快也会加入他们。我会把笔记本交给一位朋友，希望有一天他能把它出版。人们需要知道发生了什么。这将是我离去后留下的遗产。主耶稣基督，上帝之子，怜悯我这个罪人吧。

src: I'll see to it that you assume full responsibility and be expelled from the Army.
dst: 我会让您承担全部责任，并被逐出军队。

src: I'll see you again very soon. I promise you that. I'll retire fron the Army and we'll spend the last years of our lives together, in the countryside, receiving the visits of our grandchildren. I pray for long, happy and peaceful years by your side. And now I know that they'll come soon.
dst: 我很快就能再见到您了。我向您保证。我会从军队退役，我们将在乡下共度余生的岁月，接受儿孙们的探望。我祈求能与您相伴度过漫长、幸福而安宁的岁月。而现在我知道，这样的日子很快就会到来。

src: I'll try my best. But don't expect miracles..."
dst: 我会尽力。但别指望奇迹……”

src: I'm afraid that peace conditions will be very hard. We'll lose Macedonia and Southern Dobrudzha again, and Greece will probably take Western Thrace from us, too. We'll have to accommodate thousands of Bulgarian refugees from our lost territories, and pay huge war reparations to Serbia, Romania and Greece. Finally, Tsar Ferdinand I will have to abdicate in favour of his son Boris.
dst: 恐怕和平条件会非常苛刻。我们将再次失去马其顿和南多布罗加，希腊可能还会从我们手中夺走西色雷斯。我们将不得不收容成千上万来自失地的保加利亚难民，并向塞尔维亚、罗马尼亚和希腊支付巨额战争赔款。最后，沙皇斐迪南一世将不得不让位于其子鲍里斯。

src: I'm afraid that we'll finally have to accept the Curzon Line as the boundary between Poland and Red Russia. But after your poor performance at the battle of the Niemen River it's the best we can get.
dst: 我担心我们最终不得不接受寇松线作为波兰与红色俄国的边界。但在您于尼曼河之战中的糟糕表现之后，这已经是我们能得到的最好结果了。

src: I'm afraid that you have been too slow. Serbia has managed to receive reinforcements from France and the British Empire, and all the Serbian front is in danger. From this moment, you are relieved from command.
dst: 恐怕您行动得太慢了。塞尔维亚已设法从法国和不列颠帝国得到了增援，整个塞尔维亚战线都处于危险之中。从此刻起，您被解除指挥权。

src: I'm completely sure that, very soon, Moscow will fall. Denikin has chosen me for leading the final assault.
dst: 我完全确信，莫斯科很快就会陷落。邓尼金已选定我领导最后的突击。

src: I'm exultant. These past two years have been the hardest in my life, but in the end the Dragon was destroyed. My family and I will be free. Thank God!
dst: 我欣喜若狂。过去这两年是我一生中最艰难的岁月，但最终巨龙被摧毁了。我和我的家人将获得自由。感谢上帝！

src: I'm glad that you managed to escape alive, General. It's a pity that so many of our brave men can't say the same. The Russians are taking tens of thousands of prisoners, and are finding tons of equipment that we had to leave behind. Don't feel bad for it, it's not your fault. Obviously, we had underestimated our enemies. Or, maybe, we had overestimated our own strength.
dst: 我很高兴您活着逃了出来，将军。可惜我们许多勇敢的战士不能这样说了。俄国人正在俘虏数以万计的战俘，并缴获成吨我们不得不丢弃的装备。别为此自责，这不是您的错。显然，我们低估了敌人。或者，也许是我们高估了自己的实力。

src: I'm glad to see you and your refreshment troops, indeed. This new war hasn't started well for us: Our divisions haven't recovered from the losses that they suffered fighting against the Turks, so right now the Greeks have numerical superiority. They stopped our offensive rather easily, and now they are about to launch a massive counterattack against our lines.
dst: 我很高兴见到您和您的生力军。这场新战争对我们开局不利：我们的各师尚未从对土耳其作战的损失中恢复，因此眼下希腊人拥有数量优势。他们相当轻松地阻止了我们的攻势，现在正准备对我军战线发动大规模反攻。

src: I'm glad to see you and your refreshment troops, indeed. This new war hasn't started well for us: Our divisions haven't recovered from the losses that they suffered fighting against the Turks, so right now the Serbians have numerical superiority. They stopped our offensive rather easily, and now they are about to launch a massive counterattack against our lines.
dst: 我很高兴见到您和您的生力军。这场新战争对我们开局不利：我们的各师尚未从对土耳其作战的损失中恢复，因此眼下塞尔维亚人拥有数量优势。他们相当轻松地阻止了我们的攻势，现在正准备对我军战线发动大规模反攻。

src: I'm not feeling well since we took Ekaterinodar. The pain is terrible, but that won't stop me. My next mission is too important to care for my health.
dst: 自从攻下叶卡捷琳诺达尔，我一直感觉不适。疼痛难忍，但这不会阻止我。我的下一个任务太重要了，顾不上自己的身体。

src: I'm not positive, but the scenery looks familiar; I'd be willing to bet we're just a little ways outside D.C.
dst: 我不确定，但这景色看着眼熟；我敢打赌我们离华盛顿特区不远。

src: I'm not surprised. The Italians know that, with most of their remaining armies pinned in Venedig, they can do nothing against us and any further resistance will only be a source of unnecessary suffering to them. Naturally, the Royal Navy could evacuate the trapped Italian units, but not before they complete the rescue of their own soldiers in Thessaloniki. And the French could send enough reinforcements by land, but they won't risk weakening their defences at the Western front after the failure of their Spring Offensive. The Italians understand that, before they can receive any real help, we'll be already marching along the streets of Rom.
dst: 我并不惊讶。意大利人明白，他们剩下的大部分军队被牵制在威尼斯，已经无力与我们抗衡，任何进一步的抵抗只会给他们带来不必要的痛苦。自然，皇家海军本可以撤离被困的意军部队，但他们得先完成对塞萨洛尼基己方士兵的救援。而法国人本可以经陆路派来足够的增援，但在春季攻势失败之后，他们不敢冒险削弱西线的防御。意大利人明白，在他们得到任何真正援助之前，我们早已沿着罗马的街道行进了。

The Italians know that, with most of their remaining armies pinned in Venedig, they can do nothing against us and any further resistance will only be a source of unnecessary suffering to them. Naturally, the Royal Navy could evacuate the trapped Italian units, but not before they complete the rescue of their own soldiers in Thessaloniki. And the French could send enough reinforcements by land, but they won't risk weakening their defences at the Western front after the failure of their Spring Offensive. The Italians understand that, before they can receive any real help, we'll be already marching through the streers of Rom.
dst: 我并不惊讶。意大利人明白，他们剩下的大部分军队被牵制在威尼斯，已经无力与我们抗衡，任何进一步的抵抗只会给他们带来不必要的痛苦。自然，皇家海军本可以撤离被困的意军部队，但他们得先完成对塞萨洛尼基己方士兵的救援。而法国人本可以经陆路派来足够的增援，但在春季攻势失败之后，他们不敢冒险削弱西线的防御。意大利人明白，在他们得到任何真正援助之前，我们早已行进在罗马的街道上了。

src: I'm really puzzled. I simply can't understand why you haven't been able to achieve your objectives in time. The Australians have been forced to clean up your mess, and the British are very disappointed with the performance of the American soldiers. They're thinking about replacing us, and I can't really blame them. Let's face it, General, you've been one of our finest commanders, but now you must take responsibility for this failure. You'll be reassigned to the staff of General Pershing, but you won't command any units on the front line again. Your warrior days are over.
dst: 我实在困惑不解。我就是无法理解，您为什么没能及时完成任务。澳大利亚人被迫替您收拾残局，英国人对美军士兵的表现非常失望。他们正考虑换掉我们，我实在无法责怪他们。面对现实吧，将军，您曾是我们最优秀的指挥官之一，但现在您必须为这次失败负责。您将被改派到潘兴将军的参谋部，但再也不能在前线指挥任何部队了。您的军旅生涯结束了。

src: I'm shocked and saddened to realize that I must be the first to unravel the true depths of the tragedy that affected your family. I can't understand why everybody (Karl-Hans, dr. Braunheld to name few...) hid the verity before your eyes, so it will be me to have the dubious honour of being the messenger of bad news.
dst: 我震惊而悲伤地意识到，我竟必须第一个揭穿降临你家庭的那场悲剧的真正深度。我不明白为什么所有人（卡尔-汉斯、布劳恩赫尔德博士，仅举几例……）都在你眼前隐瞒了真相，以至于由我来担起这个令人难堪的报丧人的角色。

src: I'm sitting here at our first line, too; staring at the horizon. It's indescribably: right now I'm seeing an ocean of flames, and there is so much noise that I can't speak to my men. Our artillery has been firing at the German lines for ten days, in preparation for our grand offensive, which will start at any time.
dst: 我也坐在这里的一线，凝视着地平线。这难以形容：此刻我眼前是一片火海，噪声震耳欲聋，我根本无法跟我的士兵们说话。我们的炮兵已经向德军阵地轰击了十天，为我们的宏大攻势做准备，攻势随时都会开始。

src: I'm sorry to inform you that you won't have any time to rest. You must keep on fighting until the battle is over. After that, there will be a new mission waiting for you.
dst: 很遗憾地通知您，您将没有任何休息时间。您必须继续战斗，直到战役结束。之后，还会有新的任务等着您。

src: I'm sorry, General, but there is too much at stake. We can't tolerate this kind of failures. You've served the Empire well, but the modern warfare needs new commanders with different ideas. It's time for your honourable retirement.
dst: 对不起，将军，但事关重大。我们无法容忍这类失败。您为帝国效力多年，但现代战争需要观念不同的新指挥官。是您光荣退役的时候了。

src: I'm speechless.  Not only did you hold Caen against Montgomery's attacks, but you practically destroyed his army!   We have thrown the British back into the sea, and the Leibstandarte has once again proved itself worthy of the 'elite' status given to it.  We can not expand on the success though.  The Americans have broken out of the bocage terrain and we must pull back before we are encircled.
dst: 我无言以对。你不仅顶住了蒙哥马利对卡昂的进攻，简直把他的军队打垮了！我们把英国人赶回了大海，警卫旗队再次证明了它无愧于“精英”称号。但我们无法扩大战果了。美军已突破灌木树篱地带，我们必须在被合围之前后撤。

src: I'm sure that they'll keep on fighting there. Winning this war will take some time, but we'll prevail. I'm starting to think that the Spaniards had so many problems with the Filipinos because they were too soft with them, but that won't happen to us. Most of the American generals that have come to this archipelago are veterans of the Indian wars. They know how to deal with stubborn native rebels that refuse to accept defeat.
dst: 我敢肯定他们会在那里继续战斗。打赢这场战争需要一些时间，但我们终将获胜。我开始觉得，西班牙人之所以在菲律宾人身上遇到那么多麻烦，是因为他们对菲律宾人太软弱，但我们不会重蹈覆辙。来到这片群岛的大多数美国将领都是印第安战争的老兵。他们知道如何对付那些拒绝认输的顽固土著叛乱者。

src: I'm sure that, if the British had known the outcome of the battle of Caporetto in advance, they'd never had declared war on Ethiopia. They already had enough problems with the Ottomans in Palestine, the Mad Mullah in Somalia, and the German colonial army in East Africa. Besides, they had supposed that they'd just be giving support to a larger Italian offensive. However, after Caporetto, Italy had stopped all its military actions in Africa. So, in the end, the British found themselves in the middle of a fight that they never had wished, just for the sake of an unreliable ally.
dst: 我敢肯定，如果英国人提前知道卡波雷托战役的结果，他们就绝不会对埃塞俄比亚宣战了。他们在巴勒斯坦要对付奥斯曼人，在索马里要对付疯狂毛拉，在东非还要对付德国殖民军，麻烦已经够多了。此外，他们原本以为，自己只是在一场更大规模的意大利攻势中提供支援。然而，卡波雷托之战后，意大利停止了在非洲的所有军事行动。所以到头来，英国人发现自己卷入了一场他们从不愿打的仗，仅仅是为了一个靠不住的盟友。

src: I'm surprised that the Bulgarians forced you to retreat, but at least you could delay their advance for a while. To make things worse, the Serbian Army has been nearly destroyed, so there is no need to keep on fighting in Macedonia at the moment. You must evacuate your forces south of the Greek border, while the British embark the surviving Serbian troops to the island of Corfou.
dst: 保加利亚人逼您撤退，这让我很惊讶，但您至少迟滞了他们的推进一段时间。更糟的是，塞尔维亚军队已几近覆灭，所以眼下没有必要继续在马其顿作战。您必须把部队撤到希腊边境以南，同时英国人把幸存的塞尔维亚部队装上船运往科孚岛。

src: I'm surprised that the defenders of Las Guásimas didn't receive any reinforcements from Santiago. We could have run into serious trouble if General Linares, the Spanish commander, had decided to help General Rubín, but it seems that Linares is too prudent, and he's afraid of a Cuban attack against Santiago if he sends any troops out of the town. Much better for us. After we take all the hills surrounding Santiago Linares will be trapped there, unable to defend himself, and he'll regret not having been bolder when he had the chance.
dst: 我很惊讶，拉斯瓜西马斯的守军竟未从圣地亚哥获得任何援军。如果西班牙指挥官利纳雷斯将军当初决定援助鲁宾将军，我们本可能陷入大麻烦，但看来利纳雷斯过于谨慎，他担心一旦从城内派兵，古巴人就会进攻圣地亚哥。这对我们好得多。待我们拿下圣地亚哥周围所有高地后，利纳雷斯将被困在那里，无力自保，到那时他会后悔当初有机会时没有更大胆一些。

src: I'm very sorry, Nonnie. Your heroic husband died four days ago, during the  battle of Donkerhoek. We had found very strong British resistance and he decided to lead a group of men to outflank the enemy and capture his cannons. He ultimately succeeded, but the shrapnel from one of the last British shots hit him, killing him instantly. We have lost one of our most capable generals, and the blow to the morale of the troops is immense. Now we must find the strength to recover from his loss.
dst: 我非常难过，诺妮。您那英勇的丈夫四天前在东克胡克之战中牺牲了。当时我们遭遇了英军极其顽强的抵抗，他决定带领一队人马去包抄敌军并夺取他们的火炮。他最终成功了，但英军最后几发炮弹中的一发榴霰弹击中了他，当场夺去了他的生命。我们失去了一位最能干的将军，这对部队士气的打击是巨大的。现在我们必须在悲痛中重拾力量，走出失去他的阴影。

src: I'm very sorry, Nonnie. Your heroic husband died four days ago, during the second battle of Colenso. We had found very strong British resistance and he decided to lead a group of men to outflank the enemy and capture his cannons. He ultimately succeeded, but the shrapnel from one of the last British shots hit him, killing him instantly. We have lost one of our most capable generals, and the blow to the morale of the troops is immense. Now we must find the strength to recover from his loss.
dst: 我非常难过，诺妮。您那英勇的丈夫四天前在第二次科伦索之战中牺牲了。当时我们遭遇了英军极其顽强的抵抗，他决定带领一队人马去包抄敌军并夺取他们的火炮。他最终成功了，但英军最后几发炮弹中的一发榴霰弹击中了他，当场夺去了他的生命。我们失去了一位最能干的将军，这对部队士气的打击是巨大的。现在我们必须在悲痛中重拾力量，走出失去他的阴影。

src: I'm very sorry, Nonnie. Your heroic husband died four days ago, fighting in Natal. We had found very strong enemy resistance and he decided to lead a group of men to outflank them and capture his cannons. He ultimately succeeded, but the shrapnel from one of the last enemy shots hit him, killing him instantly. We have lost one of our most capable generals, and the blow to the morale of the troops is immense. Now we must find the strength to recover from his loss.
dst: 我非常难过，诺妮。您那英勇的丈夫四天前在纳塔尔作战时牺牲了。当时我们遭遇了敌军极其顽强的抵抗，他决定带领一队人马去包抄他们并夺取他们的火炮。他最终成功了，但敌军最后几发炮弹中的一发榴霰弹击中了他，当场夺去了他的生命。我们失去了一位最能干的将军，这对部队士气的打击是巨大的。现在我们必须在悲痛中重拾力量，走出失去他的阴影。

src: I've got strange rumours from the French front. On one hand, it looks like the Frenchmen are on the very bottom and now when most of the Brits have left the mainland, our positions are better. On the other  hand, we've got more and more news about the new French tactic; one that gives our schnelle Truppen much trouble. They've heavily entrenched themselves in every town and village and we can't do much more than sneak through their lines... only to be immediately attacked by reserves. Many times those are armoured. It's really annoying, because the tanks can't waste their time with nests of resistance, but once they get into the 'open', they are constricted between the French 'hedgehogs' and as they now can't out-maneuver the slower enemy tanks, the results of such encounters are very painful. Many experienced men were lost.
dst: 我从法国前线听到些奇怪的传闻。一方面，看来法国人已到了谷底，如今大多数英军已撤离大陆，我们的形势更好了。另一方面，关于法军新战术的消息越来越多；那是一种让我们的快速部队大为头疼的战术。他们在每一座城镇、每一个村庄都深挖工事，我们只能从他们的防线之间穿插……结果立刻遭到预备队反击。许多时候那些还是装甲部队。这实在恼人，因为坦克不能把时间浪费在抵抗巢穴上，可一旦进入“开阔地”，它们又会被夹在法军的“刺猬”之间，而此刻它们已无法机动绕过那些较慢的敌军坦克，这种遭遇的结果非常惨痛。许多经验丰富的老兵牺牲了。

src: I've heard that you've missed the enemy tanks most of the time up there in north. Others weren't that lucky. We've done some tests with captured equipment and we've been very surprised; no need to mention that the surprise was rather unwelcome... This way, please...
dst: 我听说你在北方大部分时间都错过了敌人的坦克。其他人可没那么走运。我们用缴获的装备做了些测试，结果让我们非常吃惊；不用说，这吃惊相当不受欢迎……这边请……

src: I've joined the "Heckerzug" and fight for a free, democratic Republic for all Germans.....
dst: 我已加入「黑克尔远征」，为全体德意志人的自由民主共和国而战……

src: I've just read your last letter. It has saddened me deeply how much the news that you read in the papers have affected you. Calm down, I beg you. I can assure that we have motives to be optimistic, despite what the journalists say.
dst: 我刚读了您最近的信。您在报纸上读到的那些消息竟让您如此忧心，令我深感难过。我求您冷静下来。我可以向您保证，无论记者们怎么说，我们都有理由保持乐观。

src: I've needed the help of our fresh troops, but the Terek is in our hands. Some Soviet units have fled to the steppes of Astrakhan, where they'll hardly get any supplies, so they won't be able to bother us there.
dst: 我不得不借助我们生力军的帮助，但捷列克已落入我们手中。一些苏维埃部队逃往阿斯特拉罕草原，在那里他们几乎得不到任何补给，因此无法再给我们添麻烦。

src: I've thought many times about the British treason, and now I believe that they never had the intention of allowing Ethiopia access to the sea. I doubt that Egypt would have dared to invade Bogos in 1875 without the knowledge, and the tacit permission, of some powerful English officials. After the opening of the Suez Canal, you needed an allied country in charge of the main ports of the route. It had to be a weak nation, too, or else France and Germany would have opposed you. Egypt was perfect for that task, but the British Empire didn't expect that two savage nations would defeat them. What other options did you have? Give Massawa to the Ethiopians? You consider them a bunch of savages. Too weak and unreliable. So, as soon as the Italians showed some interest, you invited them to occupy part of the coast of the Red Sea. That was always the plan. You played with the people who adopted me, you used tem and, later, you betrayed them and forsook them. I'll never forgive that.
dst: 我多次思考过英国人的背叛，如今我相信，他们从未打算让埃塞俄比亚获得出海口。我怀疑，如果没有某些权势显赫的英国官员的知情和默许，埃及绝不敢在1875年入侵博戈斯。苏伊士运河开通后，您需要一个掌控这条航线主要港口的盟国。而且它还必须是个弱国，否则法国和德国会反对您。埃及正是执行这一任务的完美之选，但大英帝国没料到，两个野蛮国家竟会打败他们。您还有什么别的选择？把马萨瓦交给埃塞俄比亚人？您把他们看作一群野蛮人，太弱小、太不可靠。于是，意大利人一表现出兴趣，您就邀请他们占领红海沿岸的一部分。这从一开始就是计划好的。您玩弄了收养我的那些人，您利用了他们，后来又背叛并抛弃了他们。我永远不会原谅这一切。

src: I've visited your husband again. Unfortunately I don't have much spare time, but I'm trying to see him at least twice per week. He's strong man and the wound is not dangerous. We all hope that he'll be in shape for a transport soon, but now it's out of question, he must stay in a hospital for another week or two. I'm sorry I can't give you better news. I understand that right now you need him the most...
dst: 我又去探望了你的丈夫。很遗憾我空闲时间不多，但我尽量每周至少去看他两次。他是条硬汉，伤口并不危险。我们都希望他很快能康复转运，但眼下还不行，他得在医院再待一两周。很抱歉我不能给你更好的消息。我理解，此刻你最需要他……

src: ILse looked out the window.A beautiful day.A clear Sky over Berlin.Below the Civilians going about the daily chores.She thought of how the Hell must be on the civilians near the Fronts in France,on those in the cities the SS Air Korps was visiting and dropping bombs on.She thought about Children and Babies being killed.'It was a necessity to a Better World' She told Herself.If She was destined to change the 'Rule of Order' and to 'bring Germinia about' there would be sacrifices.Her feelings had to be 'Numbed' in order to do what must be done.She walked to Her desk and took out a letter opener.She called a few People into the room and requested Her Medical Fraus as well.They watched as She spoke and then slowly She pushed the letter opener through Her hand.She grimaced in pain,some in the room wept and try'd to stop Her thinking for the umpteenth time the Fuhress had finally broke from sanity."No don't intervene" the Fuhress stated "this is nothing, I must learn to control all Emotions to lead Us, the SS/BdM.If We as I have seen in My Dreams are to save the World then We must become as hard as the steel Frau 'Krupp is producing Our weapons out of.Our Girls in the Field who see Death must view those Kamrad's dying with not sorrow or pity but with Gratitude for what they had attempted to do.Make the World a Better Place for All".ILse went back to the Window after having Her hand bandaged.She looked to the West "Winston England will Fall"!
dst: 伊尔泽望着窗外。美好的一天。柏林上空晴空万里。下面，民众正操持着日常生计。她想着法国前线附近平民的地狱处境，想着党卫军航空军造访并投弹的那些城市里的平民。她想着被杀害的儿童和婴儿。“这是通往更好世界的必需之举。”她对自己说。如果她注定要改变“秩序规则”、“让日耳曼尼亚降临”，那就必然有牺牲。她的情感必须“麻木”，才能做成必须做的事。她走到桌前，取出一把拆信刀。她叫了几个人进屋，也召来了她的医务“女士”们。她们看着她说话，然后她缓缓把拆信刀刺穿了自己的手。她痛得龇牙，屋里有人哭了起来，试图阻止她——她们第无数次以为女元首终于精神失常了。“不，别干预。”女元首说，“这不算什么。我必须学会控制一切情感，才能领导我们，领导党卫军/BdM。如果我们——如我在梦中所见——要拯救世界，我们就必须变得像克虏伯女士为我们的武器所炼的钢一样坚硬。我们在前线的姑娘们见到死亡时，必须看着战友死去而不带悲伤或怜悯，而是怀着感激——感激她们曾试图做的事：让世界对所有人来说变得更好。”手包扎好后，伊尔泽回到窗前。她望向西方：“温斯顿，英格兰会陷落！”

src: If anyone in Germany had suspected that the performance of the Austro-Hungarian Army would be so poor, it's likely that the WWI would have never started. In just a few months, after a series of crushing defeats against Russia and Serbia, the k.u.k Army nearlly collapsed, and was incapable of launching any new offensive operations in the Eastern Front without the help of its allies. The German counterattacks and, since Bulgaria joined the Central Powers in October of 1915, the victories in Serbia and Macedonia, alleviated the situation, but it was obvious that Germany would need all the help that she could receive.
dst: 如果德国有人曾料到奥匈帝国军队的表现会如此糟糕，那么第一次世界大战很可能根本不会爆发。短短几个月，在对俄国和塞尔维亚的一系列惨败之后，奥匈帝国军队（k.u.k）几乎崩溃，没有盟友的帮助，就无法在东线发动任何新的攻势。德国的反攻，以及保加利亚1915年10月加入同盟国后在塞尔维亚和马其顿的胜利，缓解了局势，但显而易见，德国需要她能获得的一切帮助。

src: If we accepted that, for fear of the British reaction, we would become a puppet of the Italians. dst: 伊尔泽决定等“秃鹰”轰炸机生产试飞几批之后再进攻俄国，这让党卫军有了一些时间放松、享受“女士”们击败法国、并在不列颠群岛驻有安全部队的成果。试飞员丧生暴露出的若干设计缺陷，把东进的时间进一步推后，女元首如今把进攻定在41年5月。于是女元首和那490万身穿黑制服、佩戴“BdM”袖标的党卫军/BdM 姑娘们要把目标转向巴西——她们在那里有不错的追随者。这一点正受到考验：美洲各国正为美国出力施压，而多管闲事的罗斯福和温斯顿·丘吉尔始终在谋划把美国拖入“战时状态”。巴西必须纳入伊尔泽的控制体系，将来发射“Batts 还需要古巴和墨西哥。霍顿姐妹的问题远比“秃鹰”的缺陷更突出：她们的项目过于超前，帝国采购部门已建议伊尔泽取消其经费。伊尔泽打算再给姑娘们一点时间，但确实起草了一份备忘录，向霍顿姐妹说明必须有实质进展，而且要快。女元首也在觊觎直布罗陀，尽管西班牙的佛朗哥对她把男性压低几个档次、却把女性捧上神坛心存疑虑。

src: Immediately after the start of hostilities in Europe were cut off all our supply lines. Almost all of our colonies were taken by surprise - but here in German East Africa, we will beat them back!
dst: 欧洲战事一开始，我们所有的补给线就被切断了。几乎我们所有的殖民地都被打了个措手不及——但在德属东非，我们将把他们打回去！

src: Immediately the Romans begin to subdue the surrounding countryside, but for further expansion the League of Twelve Etruscan Cities stood in their way...after long preparation, years of struggle and truces Rome is ready for the decisive blow: Veii.
dst: 罗马人随即着手征服周边乡野，但要进一步扩张，伊特鲁里亚十二城同盟挡在面前...经过长期准备、多年争斗与休战，罗马终于准备好给出决定性的一击：维爱。
