dst: Imperial 俄罗斯海军/ Seymour's Relief Force

src: Important center on the Morava river, Kromeriz was part of a strong defensive area organized by 182nd and 271st german infantry divisions. Romanian 1st Army had the mission to advance north on the Morava river and eliminate all german resistance.
dst: 克罗梅日什是摩拉瓦河上的重要中心，属由德军第182、第271步兵师组织的坚固防御地域之一部。罗马尼亚第1集团军的任务是沿摩拉瓦河向北推进，肃清所有德军抵抗。

src: Impressive commander!  Despite the odds being stacked against you, you managed to hold the Italians off.  However, due to the very serious danger of encirclement posed by other Italian units on our flanks, the order to evacuate Somaliland has been given.  We'll regroup, drink some tea, and then come back later to give the fascists a bloody good licking!
dst: 了不起，指挥官！尽管形势对你不利，你还是设法挡住了意大利人。然而，由于两翼其他意军部队构成了严重的合围威胁，撤出索马里兰的命令已经下达。我们会重整旗鼓、喝点茶，然后再回来把法西斯分子狠狠教训一顿！
出色的防御！干得漂亮，将军先生！

src: In 1848 the ("2nd") german empire is a patchwork of more than 350 kingdoms, counties etc....
dst: 1848年，这个（「第二」）德意志帝国是由350多个王国、伯爵领地等拼凑而成的。

src: In 1865 Austria and Prussia signed the Gastein Convention, according to which the idea of a condominium was rejected, Prussia would control Schleswig and Lauenburg, and Austria would govern over Holstein. The treaty was very good for the Prussian interests, but it didn't solve the concerns of the Austrians who, on 1 June 1866, asked the German Diet for a resolution on the status of Holstein.
dst: 1865年，奥地利与普鲁士签署了《加斯泰因协定》，据此，共管的构想被否决，普鲁士将控制石勒苏益格和劳恩堡，奥地利则管辖荷尔斯泰因。该条约对普鲁士的利益极为有利，却未能解决奥地利人的忧虑，他们于1866年6月1日要求德意志邦联议会就荷尔斯泰因的地位做出决议。

src: In 1866 the Austrians finally gave Bismarck an excuse for war. Both countries disagreed about the way that Schleswig and Holstein should be administered after the war against Denmark. Prussia wanted to annex the duchies or, at the very least, Schleswig, while Austria wished either a condominium or the creation of a new independent country with Duke Friedrich VIII as head of state.
dst: 1866年，奥地利人终于给了俾斯麦一个开战的借口。两国就对丹麦战争后石勒苏益格和荷尔斯泰因应如何治理一事存在分歧。普鲁士想要吞并这两个公国，或者至少吞并石勒苏益格，而奥地利则希望要么共管，要么建立一个以弗里德里希八世公爵为国家元首的新独立国家。

src: In 1878 a group of Egyptian officers led by Colonel Urabi had rebelled against the Khedive, and a couple of years later they virtually controlled that country. Our government feared that Urabi's policies could damage the investments of British companies in Egypt and our interests in the Suez Canal, so it gave support to the Khedive and in 1882, after our fleet bombarded Alexandria, a British expeditionary force disembarked in Egypt.
dst: 1878年，一群由奥拉比上校领导的埃及军官发动了反抗赫迪夫的起义，几年之后，他们实际上控制了那个国家。我国政府担心奥拉比的政策会损害英国公司在埃及的投资以及我们在苏伊士运河的利益，于是支持赫迪夫，并于1882年，在我们的舰队炮轰亚历山大之后，一支英国远征军在埃及登陆。

src: In 1878 the Ottoman Empire promised to give Crete wide autonomy, but never fullfilled the agreement. Clashes between Muslims and Christians in Crete became increasingly frequent, and in 1897 the violence led to a Greek intervention on the island. On 7 February the Greek expeditionary force in Crete defeated an Ottoman force at the Battle of Livadeia.
dst: 1878年，奥斯曼帝国许诺给予克里特岛广泛的自治权，却从未履行协议。克里特岛上穆斯林与基督徒之间的冲突日益频繁，1897年，暴力冲突导致希腊在该岛进行干预。2月7日，希腊远征军在克里特岛于利瓦迪亚之战中击败了一支奥斯曼军队。

src: In 1878, not long after my 22nd birthday, I was finally commissioned as second lieutenant. Less than a month after I had joined my regiment we were ordered to travel to Southern Africa, where a war had erupted against the local Zulu tribes. Amazingly, those native warriors had managed to defeat two of our battalions at Isandlwana in January 1879, and Lord Chelmsford, the British commander, had been forced to ask for reinforcements.
dst: 1878年，就在我22岁生日后不久，我终于被委任为少尉。加入我的团后不到一个月，我们就奉命前往南部非洲，那里爆发了一场针对当地祖鲁部族的战争。令人惊讶的是，那些土著战士竟于1879年1月在伊桑德尔瓦纳击败了我们的两个营，英军指挥官切姆斯福德勋爵不得不请求增援。

src: In 1898 everything was ready to give the enemy the final blow and take Omdurman, the Mahdist capital, located very near Khartoum. Kitchener needed reinforcements for that action, so the 1st Battalion of the Grenadier Guards, which I commanded at that moment, was ordered to join the Anglo-Egyptian forces. In July, 1898, we left Gibraltar and sailed to Egypt. Before the end of the summer we had joined Kitchener's Army.
dst: 1898年，一切都已就绪，准备给敌人以致命一击并攻占恩图曼——马赫迪派的首都，它离喀土穆很近。基钦纳需要为这一行动增援，因此，我当时指挥的掷弹兵近卫团第1营奉命加入英埃联军。1898年7月，我们离开直布罗陀，驶往埃及。夏季结束之前，我们已加入基钦纳的军队。

src: In 1900 the riots transformed into a full-scale uprising which wanted to "revive the Qing and destroy the foreigners". The government ceased to pursue the members of the Yihetuan and started to defend them. I didn't like those measures and, for my part, I gave safe-conduct passes to as many threatened families as I could, so that they could travel to Russia or Korea, where they would be safe. Others took refuge in my Peking mansion, where Meiying was bearing our seventh, and last, child. She was having some health problems at that time, so I feared that taking so many strangers in  could worsen her condition, but amazingly it had quite the opposite effect.
dst: 1900年，骚乱演变成了一场全面起义，其口号是「扶清灭洋」。政府停止追捕义和团成员，转而开始袒护他们。我不喜欢这些举措，就我个人而言，我尽可能多地为受到威胁的家庭开具了通行证，好让他们前往俄国或朝鲜，在那里得以安身。另一些人则躲进我在北京的宅邸，当时美英正怀着我们的第七个、也是最后一个孩子。她那时身体有些不适，所以我担心收留这么多陌生人会加重她的病情，但出人意料的是，结果恰恰相反。

src: In 1911 a new rebellion against the Spanish started, this time headed by Mohamed el-Mizzian. After a first attack against a topographic surveying unit in the month of August, the Berber rebels started crossing the river Kert repeatedly in order to harass both the Spanish patrols and their allied cabilas (tribes).
dst: 1911年，一场新的反西班牙起义爆发，这次由穆罕默德·米齐安领导。8月，反叛者首先袭击了一支地形测绘队，随后柏柏尔叛军开始反复渡过凯尔特河，袭扰西班牙巡逻队及其盟友卡比拉（部落）。

src: In 1912 I started making plans for my retirement. Evelyn and I had bought a beautiful house in the country, not far from Norwich, where we intended to spend our last years after all our sons and daughters had left our old home; Michael, Christine and Margaret were married and they had already given us seven grandchildren, Thomas had been ordained a priest at the diocese of East Anglia, and William was studying in Cambridge.
dst: 1912年，我开始筹划退休。伊芙琳和我在乡间买了一栋漂亮的房子，离诺里奇不远，我们打算在所有的儿女都离开老家之后，在那里度过晚年；迈克尔、克里斯蒂娜和玛格丽特已经成婚，并已为我们生下了七个孙辈，托马斯已在东盎格利亚教区受任为神父，威廉则在剑桥读书。

src: In 1916 a Belgian army, supported by some British units, invaded German East Africa as part of the Allied operations which sought to conquer the last of German territories in Africa. However the German defenses were cleverly organized by General Wahle and put up a ferocious resistance.
dst: 1916年，一支得到若干英军部队支援的比利时军队入侵德属东非，作为协约国旨在征服非洲最后几块德国领土的作战行动的一部分。然而，德军防务由瓦勒将军巧妙组织，并进行了顽强抵抗。

src: In 1916 the Entente Alliance plans to bring this war to a conclusive end:  a French offensive at Verdun has been planned for February. The success of our Kavkaz Front has enabled a strategic push against Turkey's presence in the Kavkaz Mountains: a line that stretches from the coast of the Black Sea to the mighty fortress of Erzerum. The offensive's first action will be a diversionary attack against the Arkhave-Vize section of the Turkish line on the shore of the Black Sea. You will command the Primorsky Otriad (Liakhov).
dst: 1916年，协约国联盟计划结束这场战争：定于二月在凡尔登发动法军攻势。我们高加索方面军的成功，使得对土耳其在高加索山脉的势力发起战略打击成为可能：一条从黑海海岸延伸到巍峨的埃尔祖鲁姆要塞的战线。此次攻势的首次行动，将是对黑海沿岸土军阿尔哈韦—维泽地段的一次牵制性进攻。您将统率滨海集群（利亚霍夫）。

src: In 1916 the Spanish army, with the help of friendly "cabilas" (Berber tribes) attacked the rebel cabila of the Anyera. For Spain it was extremely important to control the Anyera territoy in order to secure the roads from Ceuta to Tangier and Tetuán.
dst: 1916年，西班牙军队在友好的「卡比拉」（柏柏尔部落）帮助下，进攻了安耶拉的反叛卡比拉。对西班牙而言，控制安耶拉地区极为重要，这样才能保障从休达到丹吉尔和得土安的道路。

src: In 1917, the  Russian Empire collapsed and divided. Civil war had begun and in the winter of 1918 the Central Powers signed a peace treaty with Russia and with the newly created Ukraine. It was called the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk.
dst: 1917年，俄罗斯帝国崩溃并四分五裂。内战爆发，而1918年冬，同盟国与俄国以及新成立的乌克兰签订了一项和平条约，即《布列斯特-立托夫斯克条约》。

src: In 1919 the Germans finally breached the Entente defences in France and Belgium. Knowing that the war was lost, the British left Ethiopia in April, and we immediately took coastal Eritrea. When the Great War ended, we were counted among Germany's friends. It was a bittersweet ending. We were on the winner's side, but I'm still sorry about my defeat at Bure. I wish I had been able to win that battle. It's a thorn that will rip my flesh until the day I die.
dst: 1919年，德国人终于突破了协约国在法国和比利时的防线。英国知道战局已败，便于四月撤离埃塞俄比亚，我们随即占领了厄立特里亚沿海地区。一战结束时，我们被算作德国的友邦。这是一个苦乐参半的结局。我们站在了胜利者一边，但我仍为布雷之败而抱憾。我真希望自己能打赢那一仗。那是一根刺，将一直撕裂我的皮肉，直到我死的那一天。

src: In 1920 Budyonny's Cavalry Army took part in the invasion of Poland during the Polish-Bolshevik War and at first had remarkable success.  The Cavalry Army pushed Polish forces out of the Ukraine and broke through Polish southern frontlines, but later was bogged down at Lwow.  This in turn led to the heavy defeat of the rest of the Bolsheviks forces in the Battle of Warsaw.  When the Cavalry Army finally joined the battle it was also soundly defeated in the Battle of Komarow, known as the last great cavalry battle in history.  At this point, the Cavalry Army's morale and discipline were at a low point and robbery and violence became commonplace against the civilian population.
dst: 1920年，布琼尼的骑兵集团军参加了波苏战争中对波兰的入侵，起初战果辉煌。骑兵集团军把波兰军队赶出乌克兰，突破了波兰的南部前线，但随后在利沃夫陷入胶着。这反过来导致布尔什维克其余部队在华沙战役中惨败。当骑兵集团军最终投入战斗时，又在科马罗夫战役中被彻底击败——那场战役被称为历史上最后一次大规模骑兵会战。至此，骑兵集团军的士气和纪律跌入低谷，对平民百姓的劫掠和暴力成了家常便饭。

src: In 1921, after thirteen long years, the war that Spain was fighting in northeastern Morocco seemed close to an end. The Spanish army had launched a major offensive in order to subjugate the last hostile Berber tribes in the Rif region.
dst: 1921年，经过漫长的十三年，西班牙在摩洛哥东北部进行的战争似乎接近尾声。西班牙军队发动了一场大规模攻势，以征服里夫地区最后一批敌对柏柏尔部落。

src: In 1932 Adolph Hitler turned to Ernst Rohm "This is what I need"."Yes I see,We should be able to fill that void with some Frau's Meine Fuhrer since We must have all our males armed and at our call to serve the Fatherland in it's quest to conquer Europe".And so the SS/BdM was formed.An Organization of clerks,concentration camp guards and drivers to replace the Males who would be busy conquering the World for the 3rd Reich.Promoted to SS Fuhress was ILse Koch to lead the Fraus.Slowly Ilse got Hitler to allow the Frau's into more areas including ferrying planes and even creating a few Armee Gruppes.All a joke to the Whermacht Generals and Top Elite of the SA.In '35 Frau's got more assignments and started to be assigned into the Kreigsmarine.In early '36 ILse had under Her command 2 million of the Little Darlings dressed in Black with 'BdM' Armbands,Deathheads Caps,Black boots and Lugers on their side.Slowly rumours started that the Fuhress wanted to replace the Fuhrer which of course She and the Top SS Frau's denied.Hitler and Rohm of course had fun with this the Fuhrer stating "Stupid women in charge,replacing Me and You Ernst,what a sad Fatherland that would make".So a War Cabinet meeting,the Fuhrer,Rohm and Top Brass of the Whermacht planning the conquest of Europe.From Ilse's HQ Berlin a message is sent to all SS officers with three words 'Pandora Frau's Mobil'.And meanwhile---
dst: 1932年，阿道夫·希特勒对恩斯特·罗姆说：“这正是我需要的。”“是啊，我明白了。既然我们必须让所有男性都武装起来、随时听候召唤，为祖国征服欧洲的大业效力，那我们应当用一些‘女士’来填补这个空缺，我的元首。”于是党卫军/BdM 就此成立。这是一个由文书、集中营看守和司机组成的组织，用来替代那些将忙于为第三帝国征服世界的男性。伊尔泽·科赫被提升为党卫军女元首，领导这些“女士”。伊尔泽慢慢说服希特勒允许“女士”进入更多领域，包括运送飞机，甚至组建几个集团军群。这在国防军将领和冲锋队高层精英看来全是笑话。1935年，“女士”们获得了更多任务，并开始被分配到海军。1936年初，伊尔泽麾下已有200万“小可爱”，身穿黑衣、佩戴“BdM”袖标和骷髅帽徽，脚蹬黑靴，腰挎鲁格手枪。渐渐地，开始有传言说这位女元首想取代元首——她和党卫军高层的“女士”们自然予以否认。希特勒和罗姆当然拿这事取乐，元首说：“让愚蠢的女人掌权，取代我和你，恩斯特，那会是个多么可悲的祖国啊。”于是一次战时内阁会议召开，元首、罗姆和国防军高层筹划征服欧洲。从伊尔泽的柏林总部，一条发给所有党卫军军官的讯息只用了三个词：“潘多拉·女士总动员”。与此同时——

src: In 1934, Kemal, now Kemal Ataturk, president of the new Turkish Republic, wrote this tribute in remembrance of the soldiers buried at Gallipoli:
dst: 1934年，凯末尔——此时已是新土耳其共和国总统凯末尔·阿塔图尔克——为纪念埋葬在加里波利的士兵写下了这段悼词：

src: In 1936 Belgium started its policy of "Armed Independence", a policy supported by the majority of the Belgian people. As a consequence of the inability of France and Britain to react when Germany re-occupied the Rhine-land and the French refusal to extend the Maginot Line at the Belgian-French border (thus inviting the Germans to attack France through Belgium), Belgium put an end to the mutual defence pacts and decided to rely on its own armed forces to guarantee its independence. As a result at the outbreak of war Belgium had the best prepared army in its history, having spent 25% of the annual national budget on the military.
dst: 1936年，比利时开始推行“武装独立”政策，这一政策得到大多数比利时民众的支持。由于德国重新占领莱茵兰时法国和英国无力作出反应，以及法国拒绝将马奇诺防线延伸至比利时-法国边界（这无异于邀请德国取道比利时进攻法国），比利时终止了共同防御条约，决定依靠自身武装力量来保障独立。因此，战争爆发时比利时拥有其历史上准备最充分的军队，年度国家预算的25%用于军事。

src: In 1939, France and Britain unilaterally guaranteed Belgium independence. Although there was no official coordination of military plans secret contacts were held. France and Britain would march into Belgium and take positions on the Dyle River (plan D) in case of a German attack. Therefore the Belgians had made this river their main defence line although it meant giving up half of their country.
dst: 1939年，法国和英国单方面保证比利时的独立。尽管双方没有官方的军事计划协调，但仍保持着秘密接触。一旦德国发动进攻，法国和英国将开进比利时并在戴尔河一线占领阵地（D计划）。因此比利时人把这条河作为主要防线，尽管这意味着放弃半个国家。

src: In 1941 German and Rumanian Armies invade the Soviet Union. Along the Black Sea coasts battles were fought from the beginning in 1941 until far into 1944. Odessa, Sevastopol, Kerch, Feodosiya, Rostov, Novorossiysk, Ordzhonikidze, Maikop. All important battles, fought close to the Black Sea. The enemy will drive you back during 1941 and 1942, but in the winter of 1942/1943 the tide turns, and during 1943 and 1944 you will advance west. Finally you reach the positions you had in 1941, and invade Rumania and Bulgaria. Then the coasts of the Black Sea are once again pacified.
dst: 1941年，德国与罗马尼亚军队入侵苏联。黑海沿岸的战斗自1941年初一直打到1944年后期。敖德萨、塞瓦斯托波尔、刻赤、费奥多西亚、罗斯托夫、新罗西斯克、奥尔忠尼启则、迈科普——所有重要战役都发生在黑海附近。1941至1942年间敌人将把你逼退，但在1942/1943年之交的冬季形势逆转，1943与1944年间你将向西推进。最终你回到1941年时的阵地，并攻入罗马尼亚和保加利亚。此后黑海沿岸重归平静。

src: In 1941 the Italian Army was unable to face up to the British in Africa. After a year of disasters, they called for help from their German allies. Germany couldn't spare many resources to fight the British in Africa, so on February 12th 1941 they sent General Rommel plus the first German equipment and men to Tripoli.
dst: 1941年，意大利军队在非洲无力对抗英军。经历了一年的惨败之后，他们向德国盟友求援。德国抽不出多少资源在非洲与英军作战，于是在 1941年2月12日把隆美尔将军以及第一批德国装备和人员派往的黎波里。

src: In 1953 he visited East Africa again on his way to South Africa. The day he arrived in Dares Salaam among the crowd was a small group of native old men waiting for him. When the old general passed they broke the security line and reached Von Lettow.  They knelt in front of  him before standing up again. They were surviving Askari who could join their old commander again. They started to sing their old hymn, "Heia Safari". Von Lettow hugged them and then they marched by the pier, singing "Heia Safari all the time. Those men were his guard of honor for the duration of the visit.
dst: 1953年，他在前往南非途中再次访问了东非。他抵达达累斯萨拉姆那天，人群中有一小群土著老人正等着他。当这位老将军走过时，他们冲破了警戒线，来到冯·莱托面前。他们跪在他面前，然后又站了起来。他们是幸存下来的阿斯卡里士兵，得以再次见到他们的老指挥官。他们开始唱起他们那首老军歌《海亚萨法里》。冯·莱托拥抱了他们，然后他们沿着码头行进，一路唱着《海亚萨法里》。这些人在整个访问期间都是他的仪仗队。

src: In 48 BC Caesar is prompted by the Roman Senate to give back the command of his legions and return to Rome. Caesar sees this as a personal insult (even this may say something about his character...) and returns in forced marches with only 5000 of his legionnaires and exceeds by saying "Alea Jacta est" the Rubicon, the ancient border of the city of Rome, that shall be never exceeded  by a commander with troops. His enemies believe that he has appeared with all the Legions and flee...
dst: 公元前48年，罗马元老院要求凯撒交还军团指挥权并返回罗马。凯撒视之为对个人的侮辱（这或许也能说明他的性格……），便仅带5,000名军团兵强行军回师，并在越过卢比孔河——罗马城的古边界，统帅不得带兵越过——时说出「Alea Jacta est」。他的敌人以为他是带着全部军团来的，纷纷逃散……

src: In 73 BC, Spartacus was among a group of gladiators plotting an escape.
dst: 公元前73年，斯巴达克斯是密谋逃亡的一群角斗士之一。

src: In December 1940, the first truly international division of the Waffen-SS was born. SS-Division (mot) Germania, (whose name was soon changed to SS-Division (mot) Wiking), was created around three motorised infantry regiments: Germania, formed mostly from ethnic Germans; Westland, consisting mainly of Dutch and Flemish volunteers; and Nordland, comprised mostly of Danes, Swedes and Norwegians. Command of the newly formed division was given to SS-Obergruppenfuhrer Felix Steiner, the brilliant former commander of the SS-VT's Deutschland Regiment. After its formation was complete, Wiking was sent to Truppen-Ubungsplatz Heuberg in Germany for training. By April 1941, Wiking was deemed combat-ready...
dst: 1940年12月，武装党卫队第一支真正意义上的国际性师诞生了。党卫军"日耳曼尼亚"（摩托化）师（其名称很快改为党卫军"维京"（摩托化）师）是以三个摩托化步兵团为核心组建的：日耳曼尼亚团，主要由德意志族裔构成；韦斯特兰团，主要由荷兰与佛兰德志愿者组成；诺德兰团，大多由丹麦人、瑞典人和挪威人组成。新组建的师由党卫队全国总指挥费利克斯·施泰纳指挥，他是党卫队特别机动部队"德意志"团出色的前任团长。编制完成后，维京师被派往德国霍伊贝格练兵场接受训练。到1941年4月，维京师已具备作战能力……

src: In England the Marquess of Salisbury has been forced to resign as Prime Minister and his successor, Arthur Balfour, has agreed to start peace negotiations. They're willing to acknowledge the full independence of our republics and to state that they will stop messing in our internal affairs, including th eissue with the uitlanders. President Kruger would be satisfied with that, but most of your generals believe that we should ask for more. Many claim for the annexation of Natal, and Louis Botha even dreams of a South African Union under Afrikaner control and free from any influence of the British Empire. Which side will you support? You're one of the greatest heroes of this country, and your opinion will be greatly valued. Maybe your next destination will be politics.
dst: 在英国，索尔兹伯里侯爵被迫辞去首相职务，他的继任者阿瑟·贝尔福已同意开始和谈。他们愿意承认我们各共和国的完全独立，并声明不再插手我们的内部事务，包括外侨问题。克鲁格总统对此会感到满意，但您手下的大多数将军认为我们应当要求更多。许多人要求兼并纳塔尔，路易斯·博塔甚至梦想建立一个由阿非利卡人控制、不受大英帝国任何影响的南非联邦。您会支持哪一方？您是这个国家最伟大的英雄之一，您的意见将备受重视。也许您的下一站会是政坛。

src: In England the Marquess of Salisbury has been forced to resign as Prime Minister and his successor, Arthur Balfour, has agreed to start peace negotiations. They're willing to acknowledge the full independence of our republics and to state that they will stop messing in our internal affairs, including the issue with the uitlanders. President Kruger would be satisfied with that, but most of our generals believe that we should ask for more. Many claim for the annexation of Natal, and Louis Botha even dreams of a South African Union under Afrikaner control and free from any influence of the British Empire. Which side will you support? You're one of the greatest heroes of this country, and your opinion will be greatly valued. Maybe your next destination will be politics.
dst: 在英国，索尔兹伯里侯爵被迫辞去首相职务，他的继任者阿瑟·贝尔福已同意开始和谈。他们愿意承认我们各共和国的完全独立，并声明不再插手我们的内部事务，包括外侨问题。克鲁格总统对此会感到满意，但您手下的大多数将军认为我们应当要求更多。许多人要求兼并纳塔尔，路易斯·博塔甚至梦想建立一个由阿非利卡人控制、不受大英帝国任何影响的南非联邦。您会支持哪一方？您是这个国家最伟大的英雄之一，您的意见将备受重视。也许您的下一站会是政坛。

src: In February and March the Prussians and Austrians took most of Schleswig, and they even invaded Denmark. In the meantime, many Danish troops had taken defensive positions at the forts of Düppel.
dst: 2月和3月，普鲁士人和奥地利人占领了石勒苏益格的大部分地区，甚至入侵了丹麦本土。与此同时，许多丹麦军队已在迪伯尔堡垒进入防御阵地。

src: In January 1915 I returned to active service and was assigned to Haig's staff, but although I found it a remarkable experience, I still longed for a divisional command. I asked for it repeatedly, until in August they offered me command of the newly formed Guards Division, composed of battalions taken from the different Guards regiments. I have no words to express my joy for having been granted the privilege of leading these most extraordinary men to battle.
dst: 1915年1月，我重返现役，被分配到黑格的参谋部任职，尽管我认为这是一段了不起的经历，我仍然渴望执掌一个师。我反复请求，直到8月，他们任命我指挥新组建的近卫师，该师由从各近卫团抽调的各营组成。被授予率领这些最非凡的人上战场的殊荣，我心中的喜悦无以言表。

src: In January 1942, German troops in Kholm were surrounded by Soviets. They held the city until saved from the pocket months later by a third and final relief attempt.
dst: 1942年1月，驻霍尔姆的德军被苏军包围。他们坚守该城，直到数月后第三次也是最后一次解围尝试才把他们从包围圈中救出。

src: In January, the invaders arrived in the plains of Gura, where they quickly built two forts. They also bribed Ras Wolde Mikael into betraying Emperor Yohannes. Sadly, Ethiopia seemed to be still in Medieval times, when many different nobles challenged the authority of their king as soon as they perceived that on doing so they could gather more power for themselves. In fact, the main threat for Yohannes's crown wasn't, at that time, the Egyptian army, but King Menelik of Shewa, who still aspired to become Emperor, and was always defiant to the authority of Yohannes.
dst: 一月，入侵者抵达古拉平原，并在那里迅速修筑了两座堡垒。他们还收买拉斯·沃尔德·米卡埃尔背叛约翰内斯皇帝。可悲的是，埃塞俄比亚似乎仍停留在中世纪，许多不同的贵族一发觉抗命能为自己聚敛更多权力，便去挑战国王的权威。事实上，当时对约翰内斯王位的最大威胁并不是埃及军队，而是绍阿的国王孟尼利克，他仍渴望成为皇帝，并且总是公然藐视约翰内斯的权威。

src: In July 1939, the OKH decided to create a unique unit in preparation for the assault on Poland. This unit was officially designated as Panzer-Verbaende Ostpreussen, better known as Panzer Division Kempf. The division was composed of both Heer and Waffen SS units.
dst: 1939年7月，陆军总司令部决定组建一支独特的部队，为进攻波兰做准备。这支部队被正式命名为“东普鲁士装甲部队”，更广为人知的名字是肯普夫装甲师。该师由陆军和武装党卫军两部分单位编成。

src: In July, Polish soldiers had to pledge their allegiance to the Emperors. Jozef Pilsudski  asked his soldiers not to do this?
dst: 7月，波兰士兵不得不向两位皇帝宣誓效忠。约瑟夫·毕苏斯基请求他的士兵们不要这样做？

src: In July, Polish soldiers had to pledge their allegiance to the Emperors. Józef Pi³sudski asked his soldiers not to do this.
dst: 7月，波兰士兵不得不向两位皇帝宣誓效忠。约瑟夫·毕苏斯基请求他的士兵们不要这样做。

src: In Lorraine the war wasn't going well for the French, either. Just like it had happened to the Austrians four years earlier, the troops of Napoleon III had been completely surprised by the amazing mobility of the Prussians. Before the Army of the Rhine could react, the northeast of France had been invaded and many French divisions had been trapped in strong positions, unable to stop the Germans or to retreat to secondary defence lines.
dst: 在洛林，法军的战况同样不妙。正如四年前奥地利人遭遇的那样，拿破仑三世的军队被普鲁士人惊人的机动性打了个措手不及。莱茵军团还没来得及反应，法国东北部便已被入侵，许多法军师被围困在坚固阵地中，既无法阻挡德军，也无法撤退到第二道防线。

src: In May 1898, with the outbreak of the Spanish-American War, Aguinaldo sought help from the U.S. Commodore Dewey agreed to transport Aguinaldo from Hong Kong to the Philippines and to provide him with arms. Aguinaldo arrived in Cavite on May 19, resumed command of Filipino rebel forces and scheduled a general uprising for May 31 in Cavite province, where Aguinaldo had most of his followers.
dst: 1898年5月，随着美西战争的爆发，阿吉纳尔多向美国寻求帮助。杜威准将同意把阿吉纳尔多从香港送到菲律宾，并向他提供武器。阿吉纳尔多于5月19日抵达甲米地，重新掌握菲律宾起义军的指挥权，并计划于5月31日在甲米地省——阿吉纳尔多拥有最多追随者的地方——发动总起义。

src: In May 1940, the British had occupied Iceland with a handful of marines, but after the British defeat in October, the garrison refused to surrender. At this time, the General Staff did not have enough capacity to expel the British and in July '41, the British garrison was shipped to Canada and handed over control to the U.S. to prevent a German occupation of Iceland.
dst: 1940年5月，英国人以少量海军陆战队占领了冰岛，但在10月英国战败后，守军拒绝投降。当时，总参谋部没有足够兵力驱逐英军；1941年7月，英国守军被海运到加拿大，并把控制权移交给了美国，以防德国占领冰岛。

src: In May, a peace conference started in London. Considering that the Danish Army had nearlly collapsed, the German allies offered Denmark quite generous conditions, which guaranteed that Northern Schleswig would remain under Danish control. However, the Danes didn't accept those terms, and in June the negotiations failed.
dst: 5月，和平会议在伦敦开幕。考虑到丹麦军队已几近崩溃，德意志盟友们向丹麦提出了相当宽厚的条件，保证北石勒苏益格将继续处于丹麦控制之下。然而，丹麦人没有接受这些条款，6月谈判破裂。

src: In May, two British divisions, composed exclusively of European and Indian troops, and with aerial and tank support, attacked Gojjam, and quickly overran the local defences. After a few days, they had already taken Bure, and it seemed that they'd reach Debre Markos soon. If that town fell, nothing would stop them until Addis Abeba, and the war would be lost.
dst: 五月，两个完全由欧洲和印度部队组成、并得到空中和坦克支援的英国师进攻戈贾姆，迅速击溃了当地守军。几天之后，他们便已占领布雷，而且看来很快就要推进到德布雷马科斯。一旦那座城镇陷落，就再没有什么能阻止他们直逼亚的斯亚贝巴，战争也就输定了。

src: In Mola's plan the main goal  was the capture of Madrid.  The North of Spain was a secondary problem at the beginning of the subdivision.  It was soon obvious that Madrid would not fall by a frontal assault. General Mola has selected you as his most trusted officer to spearhead the attacks on the non-loyal northern  provinces of the rebellion.  Then, who knows?
dst: 在莫拉的方案中，首要目标是夺取马德里。在作战划分之初，西班牙北部只是次要问题。但很快就清楚，马德里不会因正面强攻而陷落。莫拉将军已选定您为他最信任的军官，去带头攻击那些不忠于叛军的北方省份。此后会怎样，谁知道呢？

src: In Morocco a coup d'état of pro-Allied General Antoine Béthouart failed, but French troops surrendered on November 10th after heavy fighting on the beaches and a Naval battle at Cassablanca.
dst: 在摩洛哥，亲盟军的安托万·贝图阿尔将军发动的政变失败了，但法军在滩头激战及卡萨布兰卡海战后，于11月10日投降。

src: In November 1918 many things have changed but the old Polish enemy - Russia - hasn't changed. And Poles had to defend their independence. And - as it occured later - for independence and freedom of all the Europeans, because if Russians had won the war against Poland, they would have turned the greater part of Europe into oppressive, communist union.
dst: 1918年11月，许多事情都变了，但波兰的老敌人——俄国——却没有变。波兰人不得不捍卫自己的独立。而且——正如后来所发生的那样——他们也是为了全体欧洲人的独立与自由而战，因为倘若俄国人在对波兰的战争中获胜，他们就会把欧洲的大部分变成压迫性的共产主义联盟。

src: In October 1875 the Egyptian forces invaded Hamasien, a tributary of the Ethiopian Empire. The Egyptian army was well equipped, and possessed some artillery pieces. Besides, it was commanded by a Danish officer, Soren Arendrup.
dst: 1875年10月，埃及军队入侵了哈马西恩，一个向埃塞俄比亚帝国纳贡的地区。埃及军队装备精良，还拥有一些火炮。此外，它由丹麦军官索伦·阿伦德鲁普指挥。

src: In Poland, which was mentioned in the treaty because part of the Polish territories were ceded to the Ukraine as well, its signing caused riots and protests. It meant an end to any support for the Central Powers.
dst: 在波兰——由于部分波兰领土也被割让给了乌克兰，波兰在条约中被提及——条约的签订引发了骚乱和抗议。这意味着对同盟国的任何支持都走到了尽头。

src: In Romania , Soviet occupation following World War II facilitated the rise of the Communist Party as the main political force, leading ultimately to the abdication of the King and the establishment of a single-party people's republic in 1947.
dst: 在罗马尼亚，二战后的苏联占领助长了共产党作为主导政治力量的崛起，最终导致国王退位，并于1947年建立一党制的人民共和国。

src: In September 1916 a poorly equipped and trained Portuguese expeditionary force crossed the Rovuma river and invaded German East Africa.  This was part of the continuing Allied plan to end the German resistance in that region.
dst: 1916年9月，一支装备和训练都很差的葡萄牙远征军渡过鲁伍马河，入侵德属东非。这是协约国旨在终结该地区德军抵抗的持续计划的一部分。

src: In September I discovered the inhuman conditions that the Boer civilians had to endure in our concentration camps, where they were dying of starvation and disease by the hundreds. I tried to talk to General Kitchener about the matter, but he wouldn't listen to me. His refusal to deal with this terrible problem was the final blow to my poor health, and some days later I fell victim to typhoid fever. I was sent to a hospital in Cape Town, where I spent ten days between life and death. Although I survived, my convalescence was long, but at least I received the best of surprises when Evelyn and Christine came by my side to take care of me.
dst: 9月，我发现了布尔平民在我们集中营里所忍受的非人境况——他们成百上千地死于饥饿和疾病。我试图就此事与基钦纳将军谈谈，但他不愿听。他拒绝处理这个可怕的问题，成了压垮我糟糕健康的最后一根稻草，几天后我染上了伤寒。我被送往开普敦的一家医院，在那里度过生死一线的十天。虽然我活了下来，康复期却很漫长，但至少我得到了最大的惊喜：伊芙琳和克里斯汀来到我身边照顾我。

src: In Serbia, things are only slightly better. Despite our many efforts, we've been incapable of defeating that tiny kingdom. Our neighbours are starting to believe that we're just a "paper tiger", weak and easy to destroy. We fear what Italy could do under these circumstances. They're supposed to be our allies, but they've never hidden their intention of annexing our Tirol and Triest, either.They could join our enemies if they believe that they can get away with it.
dst: 在塞尔维亚，情况也好不到哪去。尽管我们多方努力，却始终无法击败那个弹丸小国。我们的邻国开始认为我们不过是一只「纸老虎」，软弱可欺、不堪一击。我们担心意大利在这种情况下会做出什么事。他们本应是我们的盟友，却从不掩饰吞并我们蒂罗尔与的里雅斯特的意图。一旦他们觉得自己能得逞，就很可能倒向我们的敌人。

src: In Wilhelmshaven-Rüstringen was founded on 6th November 1918, after a mass demonstration of over 20,000 naval and shipyard workers and other civilians a workers and Soldiers Council, with its executive organ, the so-called Council or the 21.
dst: 1918年11月6日，在威廉港-吕斯特林根，两万多名海军和船厂工人及其他平民举行大规模示威之后，成立了一个工人士兵委员会，其执行机关即所谓的「二十一人委员会」。

src: In a classic pincer maneuver, the XL Reserve Corps from the German 8th Army was sent along the Bobr River to meet the forward elements of the 10th with the goal of trapping the majority of the our 10th (III, XX, and III Siberian Corps) in a cauldron.  While the XX Corps desperately tried to hold the German onlaught in the Augustow Forest, the fortress of Osowiec was the hinge of the Russian left flank.
dst: 在一次经典的钳形攻势中，德军第8集团军的第40预备军奉命沿博布尔河推进，迎击第10集团军的前锋部队，企图将我第10集团军主力（第3军、第20军和第3西伯利亚军）困入一口大锅。当第20军在奥古斯图夫森林拼命抵挡德军猛攻时，奥索维茨要塞成了俄军左翼的轴心。

src: In a few months Spain will stablish a protectorate over northern Morocco, similar to the southern French protectorate. I don't think there will be much action near Melilla for a long time.
dst: 再过几个月，西班牙将在摩洛哥北部建立保护国，类似于法国在南部的保护国。我想在很长一段时间里，梅利利亚附近不会有多少战事了。

src: In a matter of weeks Aguinaldo's forces surrounded Manila and kept the Spanish soldiers bottled up inside the city until American troops could arrive. However, in late May, Dewey was ordered to distance himself from Aguinaldo. It was already evident that the US interests were not fully aligned with Filipino ones.
dst: 短短数周内，阿吉纳尔多的部队包围了马尼拉，把西班牙士兵困在城内，直到美军抵达。然而，5月下旬，杜威奉命与阿吉纳尔多保持距离。美国利益与菲律宾利益并不完全一致，这一点已很明显。

src: In addition you have to ensure that the auxiliary FM Rommel unit survives the scenario.
dst: 此外，你还必须确保辅助的FM隆美尔单位在本剧本中存活下来。

src: In addition, if you lose Bastogne (29,16) before the turn 5 or Neufchâteau (20,25) AND Champion (17,9) before the turn 10 Germans win.
dst: 此外，如果你在第5回合前丢失巴斯托涅(29,16)，或在第10回合前丢失讷沙托(20,25)和香皮翁(17,9)，德军将获胜。

src: In addition, supply has become extremely difficult due to the supremacy of the German Luftwaffe.
dst: 此外，由于德国空军掌握制空权，补给已变得极其困难。

src: In addition, the cowardly Romans, have stirred up almost all the Teutons from the right side of the Rhine by using much roman gold, and hurriedly gathered together as many auxiliar troops as they could....
dst: 此外，怯懦的罗马人用大量罗马黄金，几乎把莱茵河右岸的条顿人全都挑动起来，还匆忙纠集了尽可能多的辅助部队....

src: In an attempt to keep you on the West bank of the Dnepr, STAVKA has landed several airborne units in your rear.
dst: 为把你拖在第聂伯河西岸，苏联最高统帅部在你的后方空投了若干空降部队。

src: In an ensuing chaos you reached British forces and surrendered to captivity.
dst: 在随后的混乱中，你抵达英军处，投降当了俘虏。

src: In any case, going into exile would be the best thing for you to do General. After this defeat you will be better off in Paris or London than in Poland.
dst: 无论如何，将军，流亡国外对您来说是最好的选择。这场失败之后，您待在巴黎或伦敦，会比待在波兰更安稳。

src: In any case, we must force the British off the mainland to secure our hold on the Balkans, this should not be difficult with our new Axis partners of Hungary and Romania.
dst: 无论如何，我们必须把英国人赶出大陆，以巩固我们对巴尔干的掌控；有了匈牙利和罗马尼亚这些新的轴心国伙伴，这应当不难。

src: In august 1920 the Russian Red Army was ready for its final assault on Warsaw. As the Russian troops crossed the Wkra River and advanced towards Modlin Fortress, the Polish defeat seemed inminent. The Russians wanted to break the Polish defences north of Warsaw, allowing them to strike from behind the city.
dst: 1920年8月，俄国红军准备对华沙发动最后进攻。当俄军渡过弗克拉河、向莫德林要塞推进时，波兰的失败似乎已不可避免。俄军想突破华沙以北的波军防线，以便从城市后方发起打击。

src: In case the English do decide to cross the 271km frontier wire - Graziani's wall - between Libya and Egypt, your orders are to hold on to your positions and harass their supply columns (Hint). That should force them to retreat back into Egypt. There is no need to rush into Egypt with your garrison forces. Our counterintelligence units report that the English have excellent recon information of your positions.
dst: 万一英国人真决定越过利比亚与埃及之间那道271公里的边界铁丝网——格拉齐亚尼之墙，你的命令是坚守阵地并袭扰他们的补给纵队（提示）。这应能迫使他们退回埃及。你的守备部队无需急于攻入埃及。我们的反间谍单位报告，英国人对你的阵地有极精确的侦察情报。

src: In defence of the historical perspective, this scenario follows a scenario in which the allies have been defeated in their attempt to gain a bridgehead on the Italian penninsula.  In that context the force compositions make a great deal more historical sense.
dst: 从历史角度作辩护的话，本场景接续的是一个盟军试图在意大利半岛取得桥头堡但被击败的场景。在这个背景下，这样的兵力编成就合理得多。

src: In diesem Buschland, zum Teil weit entfernt von Deutsch-Ostafrika, ist es uns immer wieder gelungen den Feind auszumanövrieren und ihm schwere Verluste zuzufügen! Jetzt haben wir genügend Vorräte und Munition erbeutet um sie erneut auszutricksen.
dst: 在这片灌木丛生的土地上，有些地方远离德属东非，我们一次又一次地成功机动、甩开敌人，并给他们造成惨重损失！如今我们缴获了足够的补给和弹药，可以再次戏耍他们。

src: In early 1943, Romanian Ministry of Army Endowment and War Production placed an order of 150 T-3 and T-4 tanks and 56 self-propelled guns, quantities that had to be delivered by Germany within two years. The delivery was slow and by August 1944 only a total of 110 T-4 tanks had been received.
dst: 1943年初，罗马尼亚陆军装备与军工生产部订购150辆T-3与T-4坦克及56门自行火炮，须由德国在两年内交付。交付缓慢，至1944年8月仅收到110辆T-4坦克。

src: In fact nearly 25 % of the Uniontroops have german origin and for the moral of these troops it is favorable to have "political" generals like Franz Sigel.
dst: 事实上，近25%的联邦军士兵是德意志裔，而拥有像弗朗茨·西格尔这样的「政治」将领，对这些部队的士气十分有利。

src: In fact the new Polish Army had to be organized from scratch. But there was no enemy for the Poles to fight. Russia ceased to exist and neither the French, nor British were an enemy for the Poles.
dst: 事实上，这支新的波兰军队必须从零开始组建。但波兰人已没有敌人可打。俄国已不复存在，法国人和英国人也都不是波兰人的敌人。

src: In fact, Bismarck had been preparing the war with Austria for years. He had already secured an alliance with Italy and the neutrality of Britain, Russia and France. Besides, the Prussian army had better weapons and better organisation, and more access to railroads, which meant that it could be mobilized faster than the Austrian forces.
dst: 事实上，俾斯麦为与奥地利的战争已经准备多年。他早已确保与意大利结盟，并取得了英国、俄国和法国的中立。此外，普鲁士军队拥有更好的武器和更好的组织，也更便于利用铁路，这意味着它能比奥地利军队更快地完成动员。

src: In fact, it was even worse than that. Some days later, a group of Mahdists ambushed and defeated, at the Atbara River, the small Ethiopian detachment that was carrying the corpse of Yohannes. The Mahdists captured the body of the dead Emperor, whose head they cut off and sent back to Omdurman as a trophy.
dst: 事实上，情况比那还要糟糕。几天之后，一伙马赫迪分子在阿特巴拉河伏击并击溃了护送约翰内斯遗体的那支埃塞俄比亚小分队。马赫迪分子夺走了已故皇帝的尸体，砍下他的头颅，作为战利品送回乌姆杜尔曼。

src: In fact, there was only one realistic option. With Yohannes dead, only one Ethiopian noble had the power, and the prestige, to lead the country. It was no other than Menelik, the old rival of Yohannes. Menelik II was soon and unanimously recognized as the new Negusa Negest.
dst: 事实上，只有一个现实的选择。约翰尼斯一死，只有一位埃塞俄比亚贵族拥有统领国家的实力与威望。那不是别人，正是约翰尼斯的老对手孟尼利克。孟尼利克二世很快就被一致拥立为新的万王之王。

src: In front of you lies consul Cornelius Lentullus Clodianus with two legions. Behind you, Gellius and Arrius are moving up with two legions.
dst: 在你面前的是执政官科尔内利乌斯伦图卢斯克洛迪亚努斯，带着两个军团。你身后，盖利乌斯与阿里乌斯正带两个军团逼近。

src: In front of you stand massively built defensive positions, full of anti-tank, air defense and field artillery, with mines, bunkers, and entrenched infantry. Soviets have solid air support, and some T-34s are in reserves.
dst: 你面前是构筑庞大的防御阵地，遍布反坦克炮、防空炮和野战炮，还有地雷、碉堡和堑壕步兵。苏军拥有稳固的空中支援，另有部分 T-34 留作预备队。

src: In his way towards Adwa and Mekele, the Egyptians had taken Adi Quala, in the highlands above the Mareb River. On November 14th Alula and his men crossed the river, quickly outflanking the Egyptians. We didn't attack immediately, but took positions on the mountains and waited for our enemies to fall into our trap.
dst: 在前往阿杜瓦和默克莱的途中，埃及人占领了马雷布河上方高地上的阿迪夸拉。11月14日，阿卢拉和他的部下渡过该河，迅速包抄了埃及人。我们没有立即进攻，而是在山上占据了阵地，等待敌人落入我们的陷阱。

src: In its advance through the Ardennes German II and XIX Panzercorps had to face fierce resistance from small Belgian detachments of "Chasseusr Ardennaises
dst: 在穿越阿登的推进中，德军第2和第19装甲军在许多地方（马特朗日、博当日、斯特兰尚、沙布雷埃）遭到比利时“Chasseusr Ardennaises

src: In just a couple of days we had cleaned the Chinese lines from undesirable elements and we were ready to face the counteroffensive of the foreign army. Their overconfidence gave us a good opportunity to defeat them before they could send even more fresh troops from the coast. If we managed to take total control of Tientsin, the coalition forces would be deprived of their most important base in mainland China, and they'd probably agree to negotiate with the Empire.
dst: 仅仅几天之内，我们便清除了中国军队战线中的不良分子，并准备好迎击外国军队的反攻。他们的过度自信给了我们一个好机会，可以在他们从海岸调来更多生力军之前击败他们。如果我们能完全控制天津，联军就将失去其在中国本土最重要的基地，他们大概也会同意与帝国进行谈判。

src: In just one month the British have lost all the terrain that they had gained in the past year. Now that they have received the support of a tank brigade, as well as some reinforces from India and Australia, they're desperately trying to stabilize the front near Gaza. Don't stop now, General. Keep pushing the British and drive them off the Middle East.
dst: 仅仅一个月内，英国人就把过去一年所夺取的地盘全部丢光了。如今他们得到了一个坦克旅的支援，以及来自印度和澳大利亚的一些援军，正拼命试图在加沙附近稳住战线。现在不要停，将军。继续向英国人施压，把他们赶出中东。

src: In late October begun the offensive for liberation of last major cities of  the territory of Northern Transylvania : Carei and Satu Mare
dst: 10月下旬，解放北特兰西瓦尼亚最后两座主要城市——卡雷伊与萨图马雷——的攻势开始。

src: In less than a month you've finished the war in the Balkans. King Alexander has forced the resignation of the government and the exile of the pro-British Prime Minister Venizelos. He's also assured us that Greece will accept our peace terms.
dst: 不到一个月，您就结束了巴尔干的战争。国王亚历山大已迫使政府辞职，并放逐了亲英的首相韦尼泽洛斯。他还向我们保证，希腊将接受我们的和谈条件。

src: In less than an hour Sorendrup and most of his men were dead on the battlefield. Those were the lucky ones. The Ethiopians celebrated the victory murdering and mutilating most of the prisoners. It was impossible not to be moved by the sight of those poor Egyptians castrated, burned, stoned, clubbed, pierced with lances, stripped and violated with the most hideous indignities.
dst: 不到一个小时，索伦德鲁普和他手下大部分人便已阵亡在战场上。那些人算是幸运的。埃塞俄比亚人屠杀并残害了大部分俘虏，以此庆祝胜利。看到那些可怜的埃及人被阉割、焚烧、石击、棍打、长矛刺穿、剥光衣物，并遭受最骇人的凌辱，实在令人不能不为之动容。

src: In many scenarios will be limited deploy, maybe no purchase or upgrade units, in 1-2 maybe not even replacements. Sometimes enemy may have better units, so attachments maybe better than purchase more and more units.
dst: 在许多场景中部署会受限，也许不能购买或升级单位，有1-2个场景甚至可能无法补充兵力。有时敌人可能拥有更好的单位，所以附属装备或许比不停购买更多单位更划算。

src: In many scenarios you'll start without an airfield. You'll have to build one.
dst: 在许多场景中，你开局时没有机场，得自己修建。

src: In most cases the retreat of the Belgian army towards the Dyle River succeeded without too much difficulty but for some divisions it was a very hazardous undertaking (e.g. the evacuation of the 3rd and 2nd division from Liege (Luik) or the encirclement of the 14th division at Lummen).
dst: 大多数情况下，比利时军队向迪尔河的撤退都相当顺利，但对某些师而言却极为凶险（例如第3师和第2师从列日撤出，或第14师在吕门被围）。

src: In order to achieve that goal, you and your veteran troops will have to confront and delay the Greek first wave here, between the villages of Kukush and Lahna. The terrain is good for defence and small counterattacks, so you could inflict the enemy heavy casualties. If you do that, we'll be able to retreat undisturbed to the mountains.
dst: 为了实现这一目标，您和您的老兵部队必须在这里、在库库什与拉赫纳两村之间迎击并迟滞希腊人的第一波进攻。这一带地形利于防御和小规模反攻，因此您可以给敌人造成重大伤亡。如果您做到了，我们就能不受干扰地撤往山区。

src: In order to attempt the start of the anti-Russian uprising in Poland, we need to cross the border and take the city of Kielce.
dst: 为了设法在波兰发动反俄起义，我们需要越过边境，夺取凯尔采城。

src: In order to be able to fully deply your forces, you must repair the Damaged Airfield..
dst: 为了能够完整展开你的部队，你必须修复受损的机场。

src: In order to command complete control of the whole eastern frontier of Estonia proper, both Narva and Slantsy must be captured.  The Narva Lake divides the battlefield into two regions.  To the north, your Soomusrongide Kolon will lead the frontal breakthrough.  They will face the battered 6th Soviet rifle division.  In addition, the Finnish 1st regiment has made a successful landing at Hungerburg.  It appears that the Soviets have pulled up the 19th rifle division to Narva, because their regiments are facing the Finns.
dst: 为完全控制爱沙尼亚本土的整个东部边境，纳尔瓦与斯兰齐都必须拿下。纳尔瓦湖将战场一分为二。在北面，您的装甲列车纵队将引领正面突破。他们将迎战被打残的苏俄第6步兵师。此外，芬兰第1团已在洪格堡成功登陆。看来苏俄人已把第19步兵师调至纳尔瓦，因为他们的各团正面向芬兰人。

src: In order to prevent this, and with the help of the liberal Vevizelist Greeks, we have basically invaded that country. Now we are in Macedonia, ready to confront the Bulgarians and stop their offensive before it's too late.
dst: 为防止这种情况，并在自由派韦尼泽洛斯党希腊人的帮助下，我们实际上入侵了那个国家。现在我们在马其顿，准备迎战保加利亚人，在为时已晚之前阻止他们的攻势。

src: In order to relieve Tuyen Quang the French had to cross the Yu Oc gorge, near the village of Hoa Moc. That position was easy to defend, with hills on one flank and the Lo river on the other, so our enemies would be forced to make a frontal attack. If the Chinese fought like they had done in the past battles, I was confident that the French brigade would be destroyed.
dst: 为了解救宣光，法军必须穿过华木村附近的裕澳峡谷。该阵地易于防守，一侧是丘陵，另一侧是泸江，因此敌人将被迫发起正面进攻。如果中国人像先前几场战斗那样作战，我确信法军旅将被歼灭。

src: In order to remain master of the situation,

In order to reverse the situation you must make a flanking assault against the Serbian Third Army here, in Krivolak. If you manage to cross the Vardar River and take solid positions on the opposite shore, the rest of our units could follow you and we might neutralize the Serbian right flank.
dst: 为了扭转局势，您必须在这里、在克里沃拉克对塞尔维亚第3集团军发动侧翼突击。如果您能渡过瓦尔达尔河并在对岸占据牢固阵地，我们其余部队就能跟进，我们或许就能瓦解塞尔维亚军的右翼。

src: In our country we had already formed a British Expeditionary Force under the command of Sir John French. I was to lead the 2nd Division of Douglas Haig's I Corps. Mi sons Michael and William were sent to Smith-Dorrien's II Corps. On August 9th we proceeded to France, the stations full of flags and "Rule Britannia". After a fast march through northern France, on August 22nd we reached Mons, in Belgium. The next day the II Corps was heavily engaged against the advancing German Army. Our soldiers fought like true British lions, but the German attack was too strong and we had to retreat to new defensive lines. We retreated to Landrecies and the II Corps to Le Cateau, on our left flank.
dst: 在我国，我们已经组建了一支由约翰·弗伦奇爵士指挥的英国远征军。我受命指挥道格拉斯·黑格第一军的第二师。我的儿子迈克尔和威廉被派往史密斯-多里恩的第二军。8月9日，我们启程前往法国，车站里满是旗帜和《不列颠万岁》的歌声。穿过法国北部急行军后，我们于8月22日抵达比利时的蒙斯。次日，第二军与推进中的德军激烈交战。我们的士兵像真正的英国雄狮一样战斗，但德军的进攻太过强大，我们不得不撤退到新的防线。我们撤往朗德勒西，第二军则撤往我们左翼的勒卡托。

src: In parallel with the conversion of captured tanks, research started in December 1942 for development of a Romanian tank-destroyer. The solution of Marshal Ion Antonescu was the construction of a light, highly mobile and powerful armed vehicle that Romanian industry could handle alone.
dst: 在改装缴获坦克的同时，1942年12月启动了研制罗马尼亚坦克歼击车的研究。扬·安东内斯库元帅的方案，是建造一种轻便、高度机动且火力强劲、可由罗马尼亚工业独立完成的车辆。

src: In past weeks your battalion has been reinforced and is at full strength in terms of both personnel and equipment; one company has even been re-equipped with the feared Jagdtiger heavy tank destroyers. You are outnumbered, but still formidable. Together with your comrades from the schwere Panzerjäger-Abteilung you need to open an escape route toward Schweinemünde and Stralsund.
dst: 过去几周，你的营得到了加强，人员和装备均满员；一个连甚至换装了令人畏惧的“猎虎”重型坦克歼击车。你兵力处于劣势，但依然强悍。你需与重型坦克歼击营的战友一道，打开一条通往施韦因明德和施特拉尔松德的逃生路线。

src: In past years, Persia was a pro-German country, however in the first days of 1943 the Soviets, aided by some remaining British units who escaped from other fronts, (mainly of the 8th Army), have invaded the country. The King of Persia, Reza Shah (forced by the invaders) has abdicated. Fortunately for us, some Persian army officers, still loyal to Reza Shah, have contacted us offering their help to kick out the Soviets and the British from Persia. Intelligence reports that the Armed Persian Police, and the weak Persian Air Force will remain under the enemy control, also, a good number of Soviet tanks have been spotted. There is only an airstrip near to Tehran, so you must take it to allow our airforce to be deployed there. Also, Japanese forces have disembarked in Iraq, and have sent us reinforcements.
dst: 过去这些年，波斯是一个亲德国家，然而在 1943年的最初几天，苏联人在一些从其他战线逃脱的英军残部（主要是第8集团军的）协助下入侵了这个国家。波斯国王礼萨汗（在入侵者胁迫下）已经退位。对我们来说幸运的是，一些仍忠于礼萨汗的波斯军官已与我们接触，提出帮助我们赶走波斯的苏联人和英国人。情报显示，武装警察和弱小的波斯空军仍将处于敌人控制之下，此外还发现了数量可观的苏联坦克。德黑兰附近只有一条简易机场跑道，所以您必须夺取它，以便我们的空军能在那里部署。此外，日军已在伊拉克登陆，并向我们派来了增援。

src: In preparation for the offensive, you received anxiously awaited Panzer IVs. These are older tanks, but at least they are reliable and there are sufficient numbers of them available. The upgunned, long-barrelled version is a formidable foe for every Soviet armoured vehicle.
dst: 为准备攻势，你收到了翘首以盼的四号坦克。这些坦克虽较老旧，但至少可靠，且数量充足。其中换装长管炮的型号，是每辆苏军装甲车的劲敌。

src: In principle Antique-General works in the same way as in the other parts of Open General and Panzer General.
dst: 原则上，Antique-General 的运作方式与 Open General、Panzer General 的其他部分相同。

src: In reaction Case Green, the occupation of Ireland, was ordered. We intend to land simultaneously on the island at several points. You will land with your battle group on the south coast, west of Waterford. The total strength of the Irish armed forces on the island is equivalent with two divisions and is not really worth to mentioning. If these forces resist, smash it! After landing your goal is to destroy a large RAF aerodrome with the code name "Rathduff". Our intelligence says it is near the town of Clonmel. Find and destroy this base!
dst: 作为回应，“绿色方案”——占领爱尔兰——被下令实施。我们打算同时在岛上多处登陆。你将在南海岸、沃特福德以西登陆。岛上爱尔兰武装力量的总兵力相当于两个师，实在不值一提。如果这些部队抵抗，就粉碎他们！登陆后，你的目标是摧毁一座代号“拉斯达夫”的大型皇家空军机场。我们的情报说它位于克朗梅尔镇附近。找到并摧毁这个基地！

src: In reality, and contrary to other German bridgeheads (e.g. Ronsele), Belgians were not able to recover the lost ground and could only temporary stop the German Army. Other attacks were repelled in the area and indeed heavy losses were inflicted to the Germans.
dst: 实际上，与德军在其他地方（例如龙瑟勒）的桥头堡不同，比利时人未能夺回失去的土地，只能暂时阻止德军。该地区的其他进攻均被击退，德军确实付出了惨重伤亡。

src: In reality, contrary to other German bridgeheads (e.g. Ronsele), Belgians were not able to recover the lost ground and could only temporary stop the German Army. Other attacks were repelled in the area and indeed heavy losses were inflicted to the Germans.
dst: 实际上，与德军在其他地方（例如龙瑟勒）的桥头堡不同，比利时人未能夺回失去的土地，只能暂时阻止德军。该地区的其他进攻均被击退，德军确实付出了惨重伤亡。

src: In reality, everything went bloodless. After the revolt in Kiel, Wilhelmshaven and other towns the USPD planned in Berlin mass demonstrations and a general strike for the 9th November 1918 . This was heard by the competing SPD under leadership of its chairman, Friedrich Ebert.
dst: 实际上，一切都进行得兵不血刃。基尔、威廉港等地起义之后，独立社会民主党（USPD）计划于1918年11月9日在柏林发动大规模示威和总罢工。此事被与之竞争的、由主席弗里德里希·艾伯特领导的社会民主党（SPD）获悉。

src: In recent weeks we have enough forces gathered to dare the breakout from our bridgehead at Savannah. In the south at the Altamaha River the defense is obvious the weakest and a frontal attack on the strong enemy positions in the West would be too costly. Therefore our plan is to attacks south and outflank the strong defense in the west. However, your troops need to cross the Altamaha River two times to reach the enemy's rear - a maneuver that require determination and experience. Once the enemy is forced to retreat by your maneuver, chase and destroy him!
dst: 近几周我们已集结了足够的兵力，敢从萨凡纳的桥头堡突围了。南面的阿尔塔马哈河一带防御明显最薄弱，而正面强攻西面的坚固敌阵地代价太大。因此我们的计划是向南进攻，迂回包抄西面的坚固防线。不过，你的部队需要两次渡过阿尔塔马哈河才能抵达敌人后方——这是一次需要决心与经验的机动。一旦你的机动迫使敌人退却，就追击并歼灭他们！

src: In response to the actual development, your battalion increased its air defense capabilities. And the fourth company will soon receive the last batch of Panthers.
dst: 针对实际态势，你的营加强了防空能力。第四连很快将接收最后一批黑豹。

src: In response to this development, your battalion increased its air defense capabilities. And the fourth company will soon receive the last batch of Panthers.
dst: 针对这一态势，你的营加强了防空能力。第四连很快将接收最后一批黑豹。

src: In retaliation, the Mahdists invaded Ethiopia a few months later and, in June, they sacked Gondar, which had been the Imperial capital until 1855. In January 1888 they made a second attack against the same town, but this time Tekle Haymanot was ready to give battle. Yohannes had sent my army to reinforce him, so we were the last hope for the inhabitants of Gondar.
dst: 作为报复，几个月后马赫迪分子入侵了埃塞俄比亚，并于六月洗劫了贡德尔——那里在1855年之前一直是帝国首都。1888年1月，他们对同一座城镇发动了第二次进攻，但这一次特克莱·海马诺特已做好迎战准备。约翰内斯派我的军队前去增援他，所以我们成了贡德尔居民最后的希望。

src: In short, one successful attack was all that the French needed to turn the siege of Paris into a trap for the Germans. The hunters could easily become the prey. Under those circumstances, it was a relief when, on 28 September 1870, the allies of Prussia finally took Strasbourg, forcing the French into Belfort and the Vosgues.
dst: 简而言之，法军只需一次成功的进攻，就能把对巴黎的围攻变成德国人的陷阱。猎人很容易变成猎物。在这种情况下，1870年9月28日，普鲁士的盟友们终于攻克了斯特拉斯堡，把法军逼入贝尔福和孚日山区，这才让人松了一口气。

src: In some scenarios there are some rules (eg don't sell attachments) but that is something for a player who likes the rules. Everyone can play as he (she) likes.
dst: 在某些场景中存在一些规则（例如不要出售附属装备），但那是为喜欢规则的玩家准备的。每个人都可以按自己（她）喜欢的方式游玩。

src: In spite of the delays, Germans reached the Maas river faster than the French 9th and 2nd Army. Therefore the bridges over the river had to be destroyed by Belgian troops.
dst: 尽管有这些延误，德军还是比法国第9和第2集团军更快地抵达马斯河。因此河上的桥梁不得不由比利时部队炸毁。

src: In spring 1918 Ludendorff launched a series of great offensives supported by a massive artillery bombardment, in an attempt to get the final breakthrough.The Matz battle should end the Aisne offensive (the 3rd German drive) victoriously, by taking Compiegne and then opening the road on Paris. In the beginning, the entrenched French 3rd Army is totally overwhelmed by the numerical superiority and the surprise effect, but soon a counterattack force is formed under General Mangin's command to regain the lost territory.
dst: 1918年春，鲁登道夫在大规模炮火轰击的支援下发动了一系列大规模攻势，试图取得最终突破。马茨河战役本应胜利地结束埃纳河攻势（德军第三次进攻），先夺取贡比涅，再打通通往巴黎的道路。起初，据壕坚守的法军第3集团军被兵力优势和突袭效果完全压制，但很快便在芒然将军的指挥下组建起一支反攻部队，以收复失地。

src: In the 1910s Bulgaria struggled to become the main power in the Balkans. Pursuing that goal, the Bulgarians fought all of their neighbouring countries, in two Balkan wars and later siding with the Central powers during the Great War.
dst: 20世纪10年代，保加利亚奋力崛起，欲成为巴尔干头号强国。为达此目的，保加利亚人与所有邻国作战，经历了两次巴尔干战争，之后又在第一次世界大战中站在同盟国一方。

src: In the Antwerpen/Anvers sector all Belgian divisions (12th, 13th and 15th infantry divisions) were attacked during their retreat by the German Army, in some cases suffering serious casualties, but eventually managed to retreat over the Escaut/Scheldt River.
dst: 在安特卫普地段，比利时各师（第12、第13和第15步兵师）在撤退途中都遭到德军攻击，有些部队伤亡惨重，但最终都成功撤过了斯海尔德河。

src: In the Balkans things have gone badly, too. The Serbians overcame us, and forced us to retreat to the Drina. After six months of fighting, a tiny kingdom has defeated us.
dst: 在巴尔干，战局也很糟糕。塞尔维亚人击溃了我们，迫使我们退到德里纳河。激战六个月后，一个弹丸小国击败了我们。

src: In the Kuban steppes the enemy is stronger than expected. After a month of ferious attacks we have not breached the fascist front. We have only advanced several miles, and the cities of Novorossiysk and Krasnodar are still in enemy hands.  However we must maintain pressure and eventually the German and Rumanian positions must crack.
dst: 在库班草原，敌人比预想的更强大。经过一个月的猛烈进攻，我们仍未突破法西斯的战线。我们只推进了几英里，新罗西斯克和克拉斯诺达尔两城仍在敌人手中。然而我们必须保持压力，德国和罗马尼亚的阵地终究会崩溃。

src: In the Saratov pocket several Soviet armies were destroyed and hundreds of thousands of prisoners were made. Army Group Center and South started now the attack on Moscow and most of the troops on the Volga River are swung westward to encircle Moscow.
dst: 在萨拉托夫包围圈中，数个苏军集团军被歼灭，数十万人被俘。中央集团军群和南方集团军群现已发起对莫斯科的进攻，伏尔加河上的大部分部队正调往西面，以合围莫斯科。

src: In the XIX Century it was undeniable that the once powerful Ottoman Empire was enduring a long period of decadence, and many European nations took advantage of it.  Algeria and Tunisia were lost to the French, Egypt to the British, and in Europe most of the Turkish Balcanic possessions had to be handed over to new countries like Greece, Romania and Bulgaria. Decade after decade, the agony of the Ottomans didn't seem to end.
dst: 在19世纪，曾经强盛的奥斯曼帝国正经历漫长的衰落，这一点无可否认，许多欧洲国家趁机渔利。阿尔及利亚和突尼斯落入法国之手，埃及落入英国之手，在欧洲，土耳其大部分巴尔干属地也不得不割让给希腊、罗马尼亚和保加利亚等新兴国家。年复一年，奥斯曼人的痛苦似乎没有尽头。

src: In the aftermath of the Soviet winter offensives, the enemy captured Kharkov. We need to stop the Russian assault and retake the city.
dst: 苏军冬季攻势过后，敌人攻占了哈尔科夫。我们必须阻止俄军突击，夺回该城。

src: In the afternoon of August 21, the first assault was made. With no effective artillery support, under fire from Hill 60 and neighbouring Hill 100, the infantry were decimated. The undergrowth caught fire, burning to death many of the wounded. Nevertheless, by nightfall the Indian Brigade had managed a foothold at the base of the hill.
dst: 8月21日下午，第一次突击发起。由于没有有效的炮火支援，又身处60号高地和邻近100号高地的火力之下，步兵遭到重创。灌木丛燃起大火，许多伤员被活活烧死。尽管如此，到夜幕降临时，印度旅还是在山脚夺下了一个立足点。

src: In the autumn of 1915 the French and British Armies carried out a second large-scale, two-pronged offensive against the German positions, which were by this time well-consolidated and proving increasingly more difficult to break into. The Second Champagne Offensive (25th September - 6th November 1915), had the objective of forcing the German Third and Fifth Armies in the Argonne sector to withdraw along the Meuse river towards Belgium. A simultaneous attack by French and British forces from Vimy Ridge to La Bassée, called the Artois-Loos Offensive or the Third Battle of Artois (25th September - 15th October 1915), aimed to break through the German Front in Artois. This would compel the German Second and Seventh Armies caught between the two attacks to pull back to the Belgian border in order to protect their road and rail routes in their Lines of Communication on the Douai plain.
dst: 1915年秋，法军和英军对德军阵地发动了第二次大规模、双箭头的攻势，而此时的德军阵地已经构筑得十分坚固，越来越难以突破。第二次香槟攻势（1915年9月25日-11月6日）的目标，是迫使阿戈讷地区的德国第三、第五集团军沿默兹河向比利时方向撤退。与此同时，法英军队从维米岭到拉巴塞发动了一次进攻，称为阿图瓦-洛斯攻势或第三次阿图瓦战役（1915年9月25日-10月15日），旨在突破德军在阿图瓦的前线。这将迫使被夹在两次进攻之间的德国第二、第七集团军后撤到比利时边境，以保护他们在杜埃平原交通线上的公路和铁路补给通道。

src: In the battle of Zborow the Czech Legion captured 62 officers, 3150 soldiers, 15 canons and lots of machine guns. The losses were only 185 killed and 800 wounded. Though in general, the Kerensky offensive was a failure, the Czechs proved their worth and spirit in battle.
dst: 在兹博罗夫战役中，捷克军团俘获了62名军官、3150名士兵、15门大炮和大量机枪。己方仅阵亡185人、受伤800人。尽管总体而言克伦斯基攻势以失败告终，捷克人却在战斗中证明了自己的价值与斗志。

src: In the beginning, move forward with care and stay connected.
dst: 开始时，谨慎推进，并保持彼此联络。

src: In the chaos after the fall of Bardia some of your troops - accompanied by General Bergonzoli, commander of XXIII Corps - were able to find their way through the English lines and escaped captivity.
dst: 巴迪亚陷落后的混乱中，你的一部分部队——在第23军军长贝尔贡佐利将军的带领下——找到了穿过英军防线的路，逃脱了被俘的命运。

src: In the east things have gone badly, too. The Russians overcame us. Lemberg has fallen, Przemysl is under siege, and our enemies almost invaded the Hungarian plains. Only their own mistakes, the weather and the Germans prevented it.
dst: 在东线，情况也很糟糕。俄国人压倒了我们。伦贝格已经陷落，普热梅希尔正遭围困，敌人几乎打进了匈牙利平原。只是他们自己的失误、天气以及德国人才阻止了这一切。

src: In the eastern Mediterranean a power vacuum arised by reason of the demise of the Seleucid Empire in the 2nd Century BC, what was the reason that a well-organized piracy could establish and operate from ports in Cilicia.
dst: 公元前2世纪塞琉古帝国覆亡，使东地中海出现权力真空，这正是组织良好的海盗得以在奇里乞亚各港口立足并活动的缘由。

src: In the end, God denied us the victory. It was the Germans who occupied coastal Eritrea and the Italian Somalia in September. However, they counted us among their friends, and they soon ceded those territories to us.
dst: 最终，上帝没有把胜利赐予我们。九月，是德国人占领了厄立特里亚沿海地区和意属索马里。不过，他们把我们算作友邦，不久便把那些领土让给了我们。

src: In the end, God denied us the victory. The British took Addis Abeba ten days later, and Empress Zauditu surrendered.
dst: 最终，上帝没有把胜利赐予我们。十天后，英国人攻占了亚的斯亚贝巴，佐迪图女皇投降了。

src: In the end, God gave us the victory. One of the greatest victories in the history of this country. The British couldn't believe what had happened, and returned to Sudan. In the north, they left Gondar, too. When August came, there weren't any British soldiers in Ethiopian soil.
dst: 最终，上帝把胜利赐给了我们。这是这个国家历史上最伟大的胜利之一。英国人不敢相信所发生的一切，撤回了苏丹。在北面，他们也撤出了贡德尔。到了八月，埃塞俄比亚的土地上已没有一个英国士兵。

src: In the end, Kappel convinced the Komuch, and during the summer we headed to Kazan.
dst: 最终，卡佩尔说服了科穆奇，那年夏天我们向喀山进发。

src: In the end, coordinating our efforts with our German, Bulgarian and Turkish allies, we managed to stop the Russian Brussilow Offensive and to defeat the Romanians, but our enemies at the Eastern front are still very strong. We can't afford retiring any divisions from there.
dst: 最终，通过与我们的德国、保加利亚和土耳其盟友协同作战，我们成功阻止了俄国的布鲁西洛夫攻势并击败了罗马尼亚人，但我们在东线的敌人仍十分强大。我们承受不起从那边撤走任何师。

src: In the end, this has been a very good year. At last we've avenged the Archduke and restored the honour of the Empire. In the east the Russians are retreating, ad so far we're resisting the Italian assaults in the west. Let's hope that 1916 is even better.
dst: 总而言之，这是非常好的一年。我们终于为皇储报了仇，恢复了帝国的荣誉。在东线，俄国人正在撤退，而在西线我们迄今仍顶住了意大利人的进攻。但愿1916年会更好。

src: In the first hours of our offensive I already knew what would happen, so I decided to adopt small-scale tactics. Since a breakthrough was impossible, I would be content with taking valuable positions located near the front line. After that, my men would dig in and resist the predictable German counterattacks, so we could wear our enemies down with relatively little losses.
dst: 在我们攻势的最初几个小时里，我就已经知道会发生什么，于是我决定采用小规模战术。既然突破已不可能，我便满足于夺取靠近前线的有价值阵地。之后，我的士兵将掘壕据守，抵御可以预见的德军反击，这样我们就能以相对较小的损失消耗敌人。

src: In the first hours of the battle we captured a substantial ammount of ground and we inflicted a large number of casualties on the Germans. Although they again proved their resilience and combative spirit, I am convinced that this time only the terrible weather and the muddy terrain prevented us from obtaining the breakthrough that we had been trying to gain for so long. But in the end, when my first line units had already been replaced, the enemy rebuilt its lines, and the third battle of Ypres became one of the bloodiest in the war. After three months of fighting, and just like it had happened at the Somme, our advances were minimal, and the Germans were severely weakened, but not destroyed.
dst: 在战斗的最初几个小时里，我们占领了大片土地，并给德军造成了大量伤亡。尽管他们再次证明了他们的韧性和战斗精神，我仍然深信，这一次只有恶劣的天气和泥泞的地形，才使我们未能取得长期以来一直试图实现的突破。但最终，当我一线的部队已被替换下去时，敌人重建了其战线，第三次伊普尔战役成为整场战争中最血腥的战役之一。经过三个月的战斗，正如索姆河发生过的那样，我们的进展微乎其微，德军遭到严重削弱，但并未被歼灭。

src: In the first scenarios there will be a "recommended" army, with upgrades, purchases etc, but that is only by my test.
dst: 在最初的几个场景中会有一个"推荐"军队配置，包括升级、购买等，但那只出自我的测试。

src: In the first weeks of the war our men engaged the Qing army in several battles on the Luc Nam valley, expelling them from Kep, Núi Bop and other important positions. Now that I've joined them, it's time to advance into northern Tonkin, until we reach the Chinese border and force them to surrender. Our next goal is the capture of Lang Son. Should the town fall, nothing will stand between our army and the Zhennan mountain pass, the Gate of China.
dst: 战争的头几周，我军在陆南河谷与清军进行了数场战斗，把他们从盖普、努伊博普和其他重要阵地驱逐出去。如今我已加入他们，是时候向东京北部推进了，直到抵达中国边境并迫使他们投降。我们的下一个目标是夺取谅山。一旦谅山陷落，我军团与镇南关——中国之门——之间就再无任何阻碍。

src: In the following nine years things improved greatly. It was a extremely difficult task, though, because each and every tiny reform had to overcome the indolence, corruption and fear of innovation that, unfortunately, were too common among the Chinese bureaucracy. But in the end we could create some excellent infantry units, equipped with modern rifles and supported by good artillery pieces.
dst: 在接下来的九年里，情况大为改观。不过这是一项极其艰难的任务，因为每一项细小的改革都不得不克服中国官僚中普遍存在的怠惰、腐败和对革新的恐惧。但最终，我们得以创建了一些优秀的步兵部队，装备着现代步枪，并得到精良火炮的支援。

src: In the following scenarios you will not be able to purchase new units.
dst: 在接下来的场景中你将无法采购新单位。

src: In the following years Emperor Yohannes didn't forget about Bogos, but the Egyptians refused to negotiate a peace treaty for nearly a decade. The war didn't end officially until 1884, when a new enemy emerged in Sudan, and Egypt and the British Empire had to ask Ethiopia for help.
dst: 在接下来的岁月里，约翰尼斯皇帝并未忘记博戈斯，但埃及人将近十年都拒绝谈判和平条约。战争直到1884年才正式结束，当时苏丹出现了一个新的敌人，埃及和大英帝国不得不向埃塞俄比亚求助。

src: In the front of Ladysmith, and after three failed attempts, General Buller finally managed to defeat our troops, commanded by General Botha, and a few days ago he lifted the siege of the town. But you have made the British victory useless. Botha will stop Buller in the Drakensberge passes, and while the British divisions waste their time in Natal you will be able to attack Kimberley without any interference. However, this time you won't have Cronjé and de Wet by your side. Their troops must go north and destroy the last British pockets of resistance there, in Mafikeng and Gaberones.
dst: 在莱迪史密斯前线，经过三次失败后，布勒将军终于击败了由博塔将军指挥的我军，并在几天前解了该城之围。但您已让英国的这场胜利变得毫无意义。博塔将在德拉肯斯山脉的各隘口挡住布勒，而当英军各师在纳塔尔虚耗时日之际，您将能够不受任何干扰地进攻金伯利。然而，这一次克罗涅和德韦特不会在您身边了。他们的部队必须北上，消灭那里——马菲肯和加贝罗内斯——最后的英军抵抗据点。

src: In the frozen Winter of 1937, the Spanish Nationalist had an important point to continue his offensive: the city of Teruel, as a 'gun aiming to the hearth of the Spanish Levante'. The Spanish Popular Army could not allow this, and an offensive to retake Teruel was planed and launched under temperatures around -28 degrees...
dst: 在1937年寒冷的冬天，国民军拥有一个继续进攻的重要据点：特鲁埃尔城，它犹如「一件直指西班牙莱万特心脏的武器」。共和军不能允许这种情况，于是一项夺回特鲁埃尔的攻势被制定并付诸实施，气温约为零下28度……

src: In the future I, Spain!  Shall be glad to support Italy with my Spanish Legions in future campaigns!
dst: 今后，我西班牙！将乐于用我的西班牙军团在未来的战役中支持意大利！

src: In the last 3 days, the British 7th Armoured Division and the Indian 4th Division have captured all but our Sofafi and Rabia camps. We have lost the 2 Libica Divisions, the Maletti Group, the fourth Camicie Nere Division and the 64th Catanzaro division.
dst: 过去3天里，英国第7装甲师和印度第4师夺取了除索法菲和拉比亚两处营地之外的所有阵地。我们损失了2个利比亚师、马莱蒂集群、第4黑衫师和第64卡坦扎罗师。

src: In the last days of 1916 we retook Adwa and Adigrat, but then we had to stop our advance for some weeks, while we completed the much needed reform of our army. However, when we finally entered Eritrea, nothing could stop my men.
dst: 1916年的最后几天，我们收复了阿杜瓦和阿迪格拉特，但随后不得不暂停推进数周，以完成军队迫切需要的改革。然而，当我们最终进入厄立特里亚时，再也没有什么能阻挡我的士兵了。

src: In the last days the tension between our soldiers and the armed Filipinos that control much of the outskirts of Manila has grown enormously. It was just a matter of time before we had an actual battle, and now the time has come. We must restore order in Manila. Gather your troops and take care of this rebellion.
dst: 近日来，我们的士兵与控制马尼拉大部分郊区的武装菲律宾人之间的紧张关系急剧升级。一场真正的战斗只是时间问题，如今它已经到来。我们必须恢复马尼拉的秩序。集结您的部队，去平息这场叛乱。

src: In the last year we have occupied the small Sable Island situated 300 km southeast of Halifax, Nova Scotia and build up there a weather and radar station as well as a Naval Air Base and an airstrip for emergency landings. Since then, the base has become an important source of information. Recently, increased enemy activity were registered, which indicate that the enemy plans to attack and destroy this base. We want to deploy some additional forces on the island and increase our air force on Newfoundland to be prepared for an enemy attack. Arrange all necessary things!
dst: 去年我们占领了位于新斯科舍省哈利法克斯东南300公里处的小岛塞布尔岛，并在那里建起了气象与雷达站，以及一座海军航空基地和一条供紧急降落的简易跑道。此后，这座基地成为重要的情报来源。近来侦察到敌军活动增多，表明敌人正计划进攻并摧毁这座基地。我们想在该岛增派一些兵力，并加强我们在纽芬兰的空军，以防敌人来袭。把所有必要的事都安排妥当！

src: In the meantime, Alula Engida was granted the title of Ras (you could translate it as Duke), and I became a Balambaras (a commander of elite forces). Besides, Yohannes personally convinced me to marry one of the youngest daughters of one important Imperial official, thus sealing my destiny forever. I would never return to Spain. After nearly three years, I had got used to the relative luxury of the court, and staying here for the rest of my life didn't sound that bad. Besides, have you noticed how beautiful Ethiopian women are? Well, let's just say that Yohannes offered me the hand of one of the best girls in the kingdom. It didn't take long to persuade me.
dst: 与此同时，阿卢拉·恩吉达被授予拉斯（您可以把它译作公爵）的头衔，而我成了一名巴兰巴拉斯（精锐部队的指挥官）。此外，约翰尼斯亲自说服我娶了一位帝国要员最年轻的女儿之一，从而永远锁定了我的命运。我再也回不去西班牙了。将近三年过去，我已习惯了宫廷相对奢华的生活，在这里度过余生听起来也没那么糟。再说，您注意到埃塞俄比亚女子有多美了吗？这么说吧，约翰尼斯把王国里最好的姑娘之一许配给了我。没用多久他就说服了我。

src: In the meantime, Czechoslovaks were ordered to send most of their artillery plus two tank platoons to support the Jaslo operation....
dst: 与此同时，捷克斯洛伐克人奉命派遣大部分炮兵外加两个坦克排，去支援亚斯沃行动……

src: In the meantime, the defenders of Paris didn't remain idle. On September 30 one French Army Corps made a sortie from the city, against the Prussian positions of Chevilly, trying to open a gap in the German lines.
dst: 与此同时，巴黎的守军也没有闲着。9月30日，一个法国军从城中出击，扑向普鲁士人在舍维伊的阵地，试图在德军战线上打开一个缺口。

src: In the middle of July 1941, General Kleist's 1st Panzergruppe drove a wedge between Kiev and Vinnytsia. The German 17th and 11th Field Armies advanced to south of Uman. Stavka mistakenly assumed that the Germans were striving to reach the crossing of the Dnieper between Kiev and Cherkasy for a further offensive toward Donbass, and underestimated the danger of encirclement for their 6th and 12th Armies. On August 3, the encirclement was closed when the 1st Panzergruppe met with the German 17th Field Army and the Hungarian Mechanized Corps (Gyorshadtest). By August 8, the Soviet resistance had generally stopped. As the pocket was eliminated, the 1st Panzergruppe turned north on the orders to assist General Guderian's 2nd Panzergruppe in closing another encirclement around Kiev. Except the most rapid elements of the Gyorshadtest, Hungarian troops didn't participate in further battles in this year and returned to Hungary in October.
dst: 1941年7月中旬，克莱斯特将军的第1装甲集群在基辅和文尼察之间打入一个楔子。德国第17和第11集团军推进至乌曼以南。最高统帅部误判德军力图夺取基辅与切尔卡瑟之间的第聂伯河渡口，以便进一步向顿巴斯进攻，因而低估了第6和第12集团军被合围的危险。8月3日，第1装甲集群与德国第17集团军及匈牙利机械化军（快速军）会师，合围圈就此合拢。到8月8日，苏军的抵抗大体停止。包围圈被肃清后，第1装甲集群奉命北上，协助古德里安将军的第2装甲集群完成对基辅的另一个合围。除快速军中推进最快的部队外，匈牙利部队当年未再参加其他战斗，并于10月返回匈牙利。

src: In the morning of february 16 th 1916 the 5th german army with 500 000 men and more than 1200 guns started to attack the fortress of Verdun.
dst: 1916年2月16日清晨，德军第5集团军以50万人和1200余门火炮开始进攻凡尔登要塞。

src: In the morning, General Stopford refused to advance without substantial artillery support - giving the Turks enough time to bring two divisions from Bulair to Suvla. General Hamilton, dismayed by the lack of progress and the absence of any drive from Stopford, intervened on 8 August. But precious time had already been lost, and when 32nd Brigade approached the summit of Tekke Tepe on 9 August, they met with strong Turkish reinforcements that virtually annihilated the brigade in a matter of minutes by a bayonet charge.
dst: 清晨，斯托普福德将军拒绝在没有强大炮火支援的情况下推进——这给了土耳其人足够的时间从布莱尔调来两个师到苏夫拉。汉密尔顿将军对进展的缺乏和斯托普福德的毫无进取感到沮丧，于8月8日出手干预。但宝贵的时间已经流逝，当第32旅于8月9日逼近泰克泰佩山山顶时，他们遇到了强大的土耳其援军，土军一次刺刀冲锋几乎在几分钟内就全歼了该旅。

src: In the name of all our gods, let us swear a holy oath:
dst: 以我们所有神明的名义，让我们立下神圣的誓言：

src: In the next days, Germany will start with the preparation of the final offensive against France and Britain. And you'll have to travel very far, to the Middle East. While you were beating all the enemies of the Empire in Europe, the Ottomans, our forgotten allies, were in deep trouble in Mesopotamia and Palestine. I'm afraid that, if we don't help them, Turkey will have to surrender in just a few weeks. That front can't fall. Not now. Go there and save our Turkish friends.
dst: 接下来几天，德国将开始准备对法国和英国的最后攻势。而您将远赴中东。当您在欧洲击败帝国的所有敌人时，我们被遗忘的盟友奥斯曼人却已在美索不达米亚和巴勒斯坦陷入深重困境。我担心，如果我们不帮助他们，土耳其再过几周就不得不投降。那条战线不能崩溃。现在尤其不能。去那里，拯救我们的土耳其朋友吧。

src: In the next years the administrative, economic and military reforms continued, especially after Empress Dowager Cixi's death in 1908. Although China is still far from being a wealthy country, the results of the reforms have been positive. Besides, China benefited greatly from the World War. With a masterly use of diplomacy and threat of force the Chinese managed to recover most of the territorial concesions that they had been forced to cede in the XIX century. Later, Chinese intervention was crucial to defeat the Bolshevik revolution in Russia.
dst: 此后数年，行政、经济和军事改革继续进行，尤其是在1908年慈禧太后去世之后。尽管中国仍远称不上富庶之国，改革的成果却是积极的。此外，中国从世界大战中获益良多。凭借对外交和武力威慑的高超运用，中国人得以收回19世纪被迫割让的大部分领土租界。后来，中国的干预对粉碎俄国的布尔什维克革命起到了关键作用。

src: In the next years we'll have to put our efforts in recovering from these terrible six years of war. And we'll have an eye on our neighbours, too. Greece and Turkey still have an unfinished feud, and Serbia may find out that controlling the Croats and Macedonians isn't as easy as they had thought. If they ever get into trouble, we'll be there to take advantage of the situation. We'll learn to patient but, some day, they'll give us all that's rightfully ours.
dst: 在未来几年里，我们必须努力从这可怕的六年战争中恢复元气。同时我们也会盯着邻国。希腊和土耳其之间仍有一桩未了的宿怨，而塞尔维亚或许会发现，控制克罗地亚人和马其顿人并不像他们想得那么容易。一旦他们陷入麻烦，我们就会在那里坐收渔利。我们将学会忍耐，但终有一天，他们会把本该属于我们的一切都交还给我们。

src: In the north the Communists are very busy dealing with the German menace and with the uprising of Krasnov's Don cossacks, so the Red Army of the Northern Caucasus is receiving very little support from their comrades. That has allowed us to retake the initiative.
dst: 在北方，共产党人正忙于应对德国的威胁和克拉斯诺夫的顿河哥萨克起义，因此北高加索红军几乎得不到战友们的支援。这使我们得以重新夺回主动权。

src: In the north you have to face several tank and tank-destroyer units. It seems that we are to weak to stop the germans with a offensive. Maybe you should await the germans behind rivers.
dst: 在北面您必须面对若干坦克和坦克歼击车部队。看来我们太弱，无法以进攻阻止德军。也许您应当守在河流后方等待德军。

src: In the north, our Siberian units would advance from Perm to Vyatka and Vologda, trying to connect with Yudenich and the British near Petrograd. In the south, Dutov's cossacks would attack Orenburg. In the centre, our final mission was to liberate Kazan, Simbirsk and Samara. But first we'd have to defeat the five Red divisions that were deployed between Belebei and Ufa. The good news was that, a few days before they ordered me to attack Ufa, some of our units had crossed the Belaya and had taken positions west of that city, so we had a great opportunity to outflank the Reds and storm their rear.
dst: 在北方，我们的西伯利亚部队将从彼尔姆向维亚特卡和沃洛格达推进，试图与彼得格勒附近的尤登尼奇和英军会合。在南方，杜托夫的哥萨克将进攻奥伦堡。在中路，我们最终的使命是解放喀山、辛比尔斯克和萨马拉。但首先，我们必须击败部署在别列别伊和乌法之间的五个红军师。好消息是，就在他们命令我进攻乌法的几天前，我军一些部队已渡过别拉亚河，在该城以西占据了阵地，因此我们有了绝佳机会包抄红军并突袭其后方。

src: In the north, our Siberian units would advance from Perm to Vyatka and Vologda, trying to connect with Yudenich and the British near Petrograd. In the south, Dutov's cossacks would attack Orenburg. In the centre, our final mission was to liberate Kazan, Simbirsk and Samara. But first we'd have to defeat the five Red divisions that were deployed east of Belebei.
dst: 在北方，我们的西伯利亚部队将从彼尔姆向维亚特卡和沃洛格达推进，试图与彼得格勒附近的尤登尼奇和英军会合。在南方，杜托夫的哥萨克将进攻奥伦堡。在中路，我们最终的使命是解放喀山、辛比尔斯克和萨马拉。但首先，我们必须击败部署在别列别伊以东的五个红军师。

src: In the plain, a Roman army is waiting for us ... in fact, it is a consular army: it is personally led by one of the consuls!
dst: 平原上有一支罗马军队在等着我们 ... 事实上那是一个执政官军团：由其中一位执政官亲自统率！

src: In the process of securing its own fate, the Czech Legion was capturing various cities. Within weeks the Volga River was reached and the city of Samara was taken. Next would be Kazan, famous for holding the Imperial Gold Reserve. A fact not lost for the Czech Legion.
dst: 在确保自身命运的过程中，捷克军团攻占了一座又一座城市。数周之内，军团便抵达伏尔加河，攻下了萨马拉。下一个目标是喀山，那里以存放帝国黄金储备而闻名。捷克军团对此心知肚明。

src: In the southwest and in the northeast we can count on strengthening of our warriors from the more distant villages. . . .
dst: 在西南和东北，我们都能指望更远村庄里赶来增援的战士。. . . .

src: In the southwest the 4. Panzerarmee under command of Hermann Hoth is your opponent. In the north the 3. Romanian Army defends the front line. In the southeast Italian and Hungary troops hold the lines. The Romanian, Italian und Hungarian troops have under strength and are bad equipped. They have only a lit bit of ammunition. Although these troops are numerous, they should be no real opponent for your troops. The situation in the southwest looks different. The 4. Panzerarmee still has some tank divisions. There is also a tank troop equipped with the new very dangerous Tiger tank.
dst: 在西南面，由赫尔曼·霍特（Hermann Hoth）指挥的第4装甲集团军是你的对手。在北面，罗马尼亚第3集团军防守着战线。在东南面，意大利与匈牙利部队据守着防线。罗马尼亚、意大利与匈牙利部队兵力不足且装备低劣，他们只有很少的弹药。尽管这些部队数量众多，对你的部队来说应该算不上真正的对手。西南面的情况则不同。第4装甲集团军仍有若干装甲师。还有一支装备了新的、极其危险的虎式坦克的装甲部队。

src: In the southwest the enemy seems to be weaker. . . . . We should try to break through there, to attack the enemy in the north-east in his back. . . . .
dst: 西南方向敌人似乎较弱。. . . . 我们应当试着从那里突破，从背后袭击东北的敌人。. . . .

src: In the summer of 1918 Austria-Hungary was defeated and the new state of Czechoslovakia was a fact. The Legion had a home to go to. It withdrew from the conflicts of the Russian Civil War as best as it could from then on. Eventually the Legion was evacuated via Vladivostok - three years after their first battle action.
dst: 1918年夏，奥匈帝国战败，新的国家捷克斯洛伐克成为既成事实。军团有了可以奔赴的祖国。此后，军团尽其所能退出了俄国内战的纷争。最终，军团经符拉迪沃斯托克撤离——距其首次作战行动已过去三年。

src: In the upcoming battle I'd serve under the orders of Alula Engida, a brash and extremely cunning chieftain, who was a close friend of Yohannes since their childhood years, despite the fact that Alula had been born in a peasant family.
dst: 在即将到来的战斗中，我将在阿卢拉·恩吉达的麾下效力。他是一位鲁莽而又极其狡黠的酋长，尽管阿卢拉出身农家，却自幼就是约翰内斯的挚友。

src: In the west, in Ukraine, we've also taken Kharkov. We've found tons of weapons, guns and ammunition, and the number of our soldiers is greater than ever. Now we're truly the Armed Forces of Southern Russia.
dst: 在西面，在乌克兰，我们还攻占了哈尔科夫。我们找到了成吨的武器、枪炮和弹药，我们士兵的数量也比以往任何时候都多。现在，我们真正成了南俄武装力量。

src: In the years that followed the Nile Expedition, only the Abyssinians and the Italians (who, on the other hand, were sworn enemies themselves) did actually fight against the Dervishes, in Southeastern Sudan. We concentrated our efforts on rebuilding Egypt, waiting for the right time to make those madmen pay for having killed Gordon.
dst: 在尼罗河远征之后的岁月里，只有阿比西尼亚人和意大利人（而这两者彼此又是死敌）真正在苏丹东南部与德尔维希人作战。我们把精力集中在重建埃及上，等待合适的时机，让那些疯子为杀害戈登付出代价。

src: In this Bushlands far away from German East-Africa, we managed it again and again to outmanoeuvre our enemies and caused them heavy losses! Now we have captured enough supplies and ammunition to outsmart them again.
dst: 在这片远离德属东非的灌木丛中，我们一次又一次地成功机动、甩开敌人，并给他们造成惨重损失！如今我们缴获了足够的补给和弹药，可以再次戏耍他们。

src: In this campaign you will play the role of Bruce W. Dickinson, a fictional British officer, since the time he joined the Army in 1879 until he retired as a Lieutenant General in 1918, after the end of the Great War.
dst: 在本战役中，您将扮演布鲁斯·W·迪金森——一位虚构的英国军官——从1879年参军起，直到1918年一战结束后他以中将身份退役。

src: In this scenario, the option "Skip first player's turn" is activated.
dst: 在本场景中，已启用「跳过第一名玩家的回合」选项。

src: In view of your outstanding service you have been selected for promotion to "Teniente Coronel".
dst: 鉴于您卓越的服役表现，您被选中晋升为「中校」。

src: In what the Germans failed once we now want to success. In the Ardennes the allied have build the last defensive line. If we can manage a breakthrough the way to Antwerpen will be free and the allied troops can no longer use the harbor of Antwerpen for reinforcements.
dst: 德国人曾在此失败，如今我们要取得成功。在阿登，盟军已构筑了最后一道防线。如果我们能实现突破，通往安特卫普的道路就将畅通，盟军部队便无法再利用安特卫普港获得增援。

src: In your last letter you seemed worried about my destiny here, in Romania. But believe me, there is no reason to feel any anxiety. Your mind should get rid of those ominous thoughts. Pay no attention to gossips and rumours. They are useless, and they contribute to demoralize the civilians as much as the troops.
dst: 您在上一封信里似乎很担心我在这里——罗马尼亚——的命运。但相信我，没有任何理由感到焦虑。您应当摆脱那些不祥的念头。别去理会闲言碎语和谣言。它们毫无用处，而且既会消磨平民的士气，也会消磨部队的士气。

src: Including 9301 soldiers and officers, the Russian brigades are larger in size than most French divisions in 1917.  Along with the raiding reputation, the Russian brigades are considered by the French to be formidable assault units.
dst: 俄军各旅共有9301名官兵，规模超过1917年大多数法军师。加上突袭的名声，俄军各旅被法国人视为令人生畏的突击部队。

src: Incredible! You managed to destroy most of the Greek Army! It's a real pity that Romania and the Ottoman Empire entered the war so soon, because we might have actually defeated Serbia and Greece if they hadn't received aditional help.
dst: 难以置信！您几乎摧毁了希腊军队的大部分！真可惜罗马尼亚和奥斯曼帝国这么快就参战了，因为如果他们没有得到额外的帮助，我们本可能真的击败塞尔维亚和希腊。

src: Incredible! You managed to stop the Serbian Army and their Montenegrin allies! It's a real pity that Romania and the Ottoman Empire entered the war so soon, because we might have actually defeated Serbia and Greece if they hadn't received aditional help.
dst: 难以置信！您成功挡住了塞尔维亚军队及其黑山盟友！真可惜罗马尼亚和奥斯曼帝国这么快就参战了，因为如果他们没有得到额外的帮助，我们本可能真的击败塞尔维亚和希腊。

src: Indeed, the King was right but the victory had to wait five years...
dst: 确实，国王说得没错，但胜利还要再等五年……
独立骑兵师/ 第1东部集团军
土著警察 (阿尔卡萨尔塔博尔)
雅基印第安人/ 比利亚派

src: Inepto!, los rebeldes han conseguido cercar la capital y ahora la guerra esta sentenciada, no nos queda escapatoria alguna,  la guerra ha terminado para nosotros y seguro que pronto nos fusilaran.
dst: 无能的家伙！叛军已经成功包围了首都，如今这场战争已成定局，我们已无路可逃，这场战争对我们而言已经结束了，想必他们很快就会枪毙我们。

src: Inepto!, los rebeldes han conseguido detener la ofensiva por completo y ahora se preparan a lanzar un contraataque que seguro rompera el frente, lo que les permitira cercar la capital.
