src: Initially the Poles did not intend to defend the old fortress of Brest as it was located far from front lines, however Guderian's bold rush to outflank Warsaw ensured it became a pivotal position and it's defence could prevent German forces from attacking further south. It's garrison consisted of the march battalions of the 82nd and 35th Infantry Regiments, newly arrived reservists, several batteries of artillery and some old FT-17 tanks used for training. Guderian tried to capture the town on the run with 77 tanks from the 10th Panzer Division but was repelled by Infantry after destroying all the Polish tanks. The next attack was stopped by 2 Polish tanks sealing the main gate. Finally artillery was brought up within range and the fortress subjected to intense bombardment, followed by heavy street fighting which resulted in 40% Polish casualties and their evacuation on the 17th of September.
dst: 起初波兰人并不打算防守布列斯特的旧要塞，因为它远离前线；然而古德里安大胆奔袭包抄华沙，使这里成为关键要地，其防御可阻止德军进一步南进。守军由第82和第35步兵团的行军营、新到的预备役人员、几个炮兵连和一些用于训练的旧FT-17坦克组成。古德里安试图以第10装甲师的77辆坦克乘行夺取该镇，但在其波兰坦克全被击毁后被步兵击退。第二次进攻被两辆封堵城门的波兰坦克挡住。最后，炮兵被推进到射程内，要塞遭到猛烈轰击，随后是激烈的巷战，波军伤亡达40%，并于9月17日撤离。

src: Initially we marched without any relevant incidents, but as we approached the wells at Abu Klea on January 17th, we found disturbing evidence of the presence of a large Dervish Army in the area. They outnumbered us 10 to 1, so we knew that if we broke our formation, we would be lost.
dst: 起初我们行军一路平安无事，但当我们于1月17日接近阿布克莱亚的水井时，我们发现了令人不安的迹象，表明该地区存在一支庞大的德尔维希军队。他们在兵力上以十比一超过我们，所以我们知道，一旦我们的队形被冲散，我们就完蛋了。

src: Initially, I thought about giving battle on the shore of the Uri River, but I soon rejected the idea. My forces could easily get trapped between the river and the three Italian columns that I knew that were approaching from the west, the north and the east. Instead, I ordered my troops to deploy near Shire, where they surely would have more mobility.
dst: 起初，我考虑在乌里河岸边与敌交战，但很快便打消了这个念头。我的部队很容易被夹在河流和那三支正从西、北、东三个方向逼近的意大利纵队之间。相反，我命令部队在希雷附近展开，那里肯定会有更大的机动空间。

src: Initially, I was optimistic about the outcome of the battle. Yohannes had mobilized an army of more than 100,000 infantrymen and nearly 20,000 horse riders. Most of them were levies with little combat experience, but not all of them. My own troops, for example, could be compared favourably to any colonial unit of that time, due to years of training and hard discipline.
dst: 起初，我对战局颇为乐观。约翰内斯动员了一支超过十万步兵、近两万骑兵的军队。其中大多数是缺乏实战经验的征募兵，但并非全部如此。以我自己的部队为例，由于多年的训练和严格的纪律，他们足以与当时任何一支殖民部队相媲美。

src: Initially, things didn't go well for us. Ras Mengesha was defeated at Coatit in January 1895. The Italians followed their advance, and Menelik had to raise a massive army of nearly 200,000 men.
dst: 起初，局势对我们不利。1895年1月，拉斯·门格沙在科阿蒂特战败。意大利人乘胜追击，孟尼利克不得不征召起一支近二十万人的庞大军队。
战斗机航空兵总监(第1 VH)

src: Instead of sending your divisions to Paulus we have decided to send you to this part of the Roumanian sector. Though the Roumanians are tough fighters they do not have any Anti tank capability. You are to secure their positions by integrating your panzerjaeger regiments into their defensive positions.
dst: 我们没有把你的师派往保卢斯那里，而是决定把你派到罗马尼亚防区的这一地段。罗马尼亚人虽然作战顽强，却毫无反坦克能力。你要把你的反坦克歼击团编入他们的防御阵地，以稳固其阵地。

src: Instead of waging another fruitless frontal assault on Gaza, there will be only a feint attack on the city. The main thrust will take place on the extreme left flank of the enemy, at Beersheba. With this town in our hands, we should have an open flank against which to operate, and full use could be made of our superiority in mounted troops. Moreover, a success here offered prospects of pursuing our advantage, and forcing the enemy to abandon the rest of his fortified positions.
dst: 不再对加沙发动又一次徒劳的正面突击，而只是对该城佯攻。主攻将落在敌军最左翼的贝尔谢巴。一旦拿下该镇，我们就有了一个可以施展的暴露侧翼，并能充分发挥我们在骑乘部队上的优势。此外，这里的成功还提供了乘胜追击、迫使敌人放弃其余筑垒阵地的前景。

src: Instead, I decided to volunteer. I hated the idea of serving a socialist government and fighting under a red flag, but it was better than waiting at home for the Bolsheviks to shoot me. At least I'd have a last chance to die with my boots on.
dst: 而我却决定志愿参军。我憎恨为社会主义政府效力、在红旗之下作战的念头，但这总好过在家里坐等布尔什维克来枪毙我。至少我还有最后一次机会能穿着军靴战死。

src: Instead, Kolchak didn't want to make a deal with the socialists, and that's how most of the soldiers of the Komuch People's Army deserted, or even joined our enemies. As 1918 ended, where would we find the strength, the volunteers, and the supplies to overcome the terrible Red Army? Only time would tell.
dst: 然而，高尔察克不愿与社会主义者达成交易，结果立宪会议人民军的大部分士兵开小差，甚至投向了我们的敌人。随着1918年结束，我们要到哪里去寻找力量、志愿者和补给，来战胜可怕的红军呢？只有时间才能给出答案。

src: Instead, the Prussians were free to send tens of thousands of veteran soldiers from Metz to the west, reinforcing the German positions and allowing them to retake the initiative. Almost immediately, they planned new offensives against the French armies.
dst: 相反，普鲁士人得以自由地将数万名老兵从梅斯调往西面，增援德军阵地，使他们重新掌握了主动权。几乎立刻，他们就策划了对法军的新攻势。

src: Instead, we'll take advantage of the enemy's fear to lose its capital. While they hurry to Kaapstad they have neglected the defences of Port Elizabeth and Oos-Londen. They still have numerical superiority and more guns, but if we use our troops wisely we can win, cutting all the communication by land  between Milner in Kaapstad and Buller in Natal. I know that you're the right man for this mission.
dst: 相反，我们要利用敌人害怕失去首都的心理。当他们急奔开普敦之时，他们已疏于伊丽莎白港和东伦敦的防御。他们仍拥有数量优势且火炮更多，但如果我们善用部队，就能获胜，切断开普敦的米尔纳与纳塔尔的布勒之间所有陆路联系。我知道您是这项任务的合适人选。

src: Instrucciones: Para ganar el escenario debe retirar sus tropas hacia la orilla derecha del Ebro y despues tomar las dos banderas nacionalistas nombradas en el mapa como ''EXIT''. Atencion, obteniendo una BV PIERDE EL ESCENARIO, obtener una V se considera como una TV y una TV se considera como BV y da prestigio.
dst: 说明：要赢得本场景，您必须将部队撤往埃布罗河右岸，然后夺取地图上标为「EXIT」的两面国民军旗帜。注意，取得决定性胜利即会输掉本场景，取得胜利被视为战术胜利，而取得战术胜利则被视为决定性胜利，并获得威望。

src: Intel reports that Churchill is very disappointed with the failure of Battleaxe and replaced General Wavell with General Sir Claude Auchinleck.
dst: 情报报告，丘吉尔对“战斧”行动的失败极为失望，已由克劳德·奥金莱克爵士将军接替韦维尔将军。

src: Inteligence report: the Turkish HQ promised a few mobile units as reinforcements. Also, the Germans promised to send their best men to stop the Russians. Bad weather can help in holding the defensive lines.
dst: 情报报告：土耳其司令部许诺派几个机动单位作为增援。此外，德国人许诺派他们最优秀的士兵来阻止俄国人。恶劣天气有助于守住防线。

src: Intelligence and reconnaisance: 320th and 545th Volksgrenadier Divisions and units of XI. SS Army Corps are entrenched on the approaches to the city. They are supported by few artillery batteries and several StuGs and rocket launchers.
dst: 情报与侦察：第320和第545国民掷弹兵师以及党卫军第11军的一些部队在通往该城的要道上掘壕据守。他们得到数个炮兵连和若干突击炮及火箭炮的支援。

src: Intelligence and reconnaisance: Although their forces are mainly infantry battalions, Germans are heavily entrenched and the mountaineous terrain gives them a solid advantage. They have quite strong artillery support and they've build many bunkers, both concrete and improvised.
dst: 情报与侦察：尽管德军主要是步兵营，但他们掘壕据守得很深，山地地形给了他们坚实的优势。他们拥有相当强的炮兵支援，还修筑了许多碉堡——有混凝土的，也有简易的。

src: Intelligence and reconnaisance: German defenders turned the valley into a deadly trap. Try to get through the vale, but know that you face four infantry divisions supported by several artillery batteries and more then a dozen of armoured vehicles.
dst: 情报与侦察：德军守军把这条山谷变成了死亡陷阱。设法穿过山谷，但要明白，你面对的是四个步兵师，配以数个炮兵连和十几辆装甲车辆的支援。

src: Intelligence and reconnaisance: Germans are firmly entrenched in the city and they have AA guns, artillery support and air-cover. On their left flank, just behind the antitank ditch, the 7th Tank Division is placed. Its force is depleted and many tanks fight in other sectors, but you still face some twenty armoured vehicles.
dst: 情报与侦察：德军在城中固守，拥有高射炮、炮兵支援和空中掩护。在其左翼、反坦克壕沟正后方，部署着第7坦克师。该师兵力已损耗，许多坦克在别的地段作战，但你仍要面对约二十辆装甲车辆。

src: Intelligence and reconnaisance: Germans have tens of armoured vehicles supported by two battalions of infantry. These are experienced men. Our forces consists of three infantry companies, nine light mortars and a dozen of HMGs. We have also some antitank guns, Soviet command gave us some artillery and engineers support. But our greatest strength is the village itself. Digged in the village, you will withstand the initial attack of German tanks. In the open... not so. Once you'll cripple the German forces, you may go into the offensive. Try to liberate the men surrounded in Taranivka... or at least unravel truth of their fate.
dst: 情报与侦察：德军拥有数十辆装甲车辆，配以两个营的步兵支援。这些都是经验丰富的老兵。我方兵力由三个步兵连、九门轻型迫击炮和十几挺重机枪组成。我们还有一些反坦克炮，苏军指挥部给了我们一些炮兵和工兵支援。但我们最大的优势是村庄本身。在村里掘壕据守，你就能顶住德军坦克的首轮进攻。在开阔地……就未必了。一旦你重创德军，就可以转入进攻。设法解救被困在塔拉尼夫卡的战友……或者至少查清他们的命运。

src: Intelligence and reconnaisance: In an attempt to breaktrough from the encirclement, Germans amassed a giant force. Their 16th and 17th tank divisions lead the attack, but there are plenty of other tanks, assault guns, infantrymen and cannons in reserve. The enemy has no less than one hundred tanks of many different types, including the fearful Tigers and Panthers. German airforce is also more than impressive.
dst: 情报与侦察：为从合围中突围，德军集结了庞大的兵力。他们的第16、第17坦克师担任主攻，但预备队里还有大量其他坦克、突击炮、步兵和火炮。敌军拥有不下百辆各式坦克，包括令人生畏的虎式和黑豹。德国空军也颇为可观。

src: Intelligence and reconnaisance: Krosno is heavily fortified and it looks like that unless for our siege artillery, it won't fall anytime soon. What lies deeper in the Pass, no one can tell, but even the initial defense is a hard nut to crack. Air reconnaisance confirms that German mobile reserves consisting of two tank divisions are moving in from the south. These, together with armoured units of the 1st Hungarian Royal Army, may prove very dangerous.
dst: 情报与侦察：克罗斯诺设防森严，看来除非动用我们的攻城炮兵，否则它一时半会儿拿不下来。山口更深处有什么，无人能知，但即便是最初这道防线也是一块难啃的硬骨头。空中侦察确认，由两个坦克师组成的德军机动预备队正从南面开来。这些部队与匈牙利皇家第1集团军的装甲部队一起，可能十分危险。

src: Intelligence and reconnaisance: Ostrava is the last greater German industry centrum. Her coal mines and ironworks are very important, the city itself is a gate to Moravia and then further to Bohemia. Hitler's soldiers are ordered to never surrrender, never withdraw and they will fight till death.
dst: 情报与侦察：俄斯特拉发是德军最后的大型工业中心。她的煤矿和钢铁厂极其重要，城市本身是通往摩拉维亚、进而通往波希米亚的门户。希特勒的士兵奉命永不投降、永不撤退，他们将战斗到死。

src: Intelligence and reconnaisance: Prague is a great intersection and any German that wishes to run away from the Soviets must move through the city no matter what. The Uprising hampered German situation in an extreme way, because they cannot cross the Vltava river anywhere else then via the bridges of Prague.
dst: 情报与侦察：布拉格是一个大枢纽，任何想逃离苏军的德军都无论如何必须穿过这座城市。起义极大地破坏了德军的态势，因为他们除了布拉格的桥梁外，无法在任何地方渡过伏尔塔瓦河。

src: Intelligence and reconnaisance: Ruda is occupied by elements of 2nd SS Tank Division. Scouts noticed two infantry battalions, an antitank battery, several Tiger tanks and a dozen of self-propelled howitzers and guns. We were unable to reach Bila Cerkva, therefore we can only guess the real power of city's defense. But as the garrison is subordinated to the German 4th Tank Army, it'll be to no surprise if the enemy brings some armour. Germans have also a total air supremacy.
dst: 情报与侦察：鲁达由党卫军第2坦克师一部占领。侦察兵发现了两个步兵营、一个反坦克炮连、数辆虎式坦克和十几辆自行榴弹炮及火炮。我们无法抵达白采尔克瓦，因此只能猜测该城防御的真实力量。但既然守军隶属德国第4装甲集团军，敌军带些装甲来也不足为奇。德军还拥有完全制空权。

src: Intelligence and reconnaisance: Units of XXIX Army Corps hold the Slovak cities on road to the west. The 320th Infantry Division is entrenched in Liptovsky Sv. Mikulas and on the approaches to the city. Enemy units are mostly infantry, but they still have several armoured vehicles at their dispostion and lots of artillery.
dst: 情报与侦察：第29军的一些部队扼守着通往西面的斯洛伐克城市。第320步兵师在利普托夫斯基米库拉什及通往该城的要道上掘壕据守。敌军多为步兵，但仍有数辆装甲车辆和大量火炮可用。

src: Intelligence and reconnaisance: While on its way through the mountains, our ad hoc group of soldiers and insurgents lead by some parachutists of the 2nd brigade realized that an enemy column moves on the same mountain trail. This is a perfect chance to set a trap. These Germans are part of the infamous anti-partisan forces, a cause of many misery in surrounding villages. Now they will pay for their cruelty...
dst: 情报与侦察：在穿山途中，我们这支由士兵和起义者临时组成的队伍（由第2旅的一些伞兵带领）发现一支敌军纵队正沿同一条山道行进。这是设伏的绝佳机会。这些德军是臭名昭著的反游击部队的一员，是周围村庄许多苦难的根源。现在他们要为自己的残暴付出代价……

src: Intelligence report: A German assault is imminent. Don't go to the offensive too soon.
dst: 情报报告：德军突击迫在眉睫。不要过早转入进攻。

src: Intelligence report: According to our sources, the Serbian attack will be specially hard near Grljani. While the surrounding mountains are good for defensive purposes, defending the village itself could be impossible, at least until you gather enough troops to launch a counterattack.
dst: 情报报告：据我方消息来源，塞尔维亚人在格尔利亚尼附近的进攻将尤为猛烈。虽然周围山区利于防御，但防守村庄本身几乎不可能，至少要等到您集结起足够的部队发动反攻为止。

src: Intelligence report: After their defeat at the Niemen River, the Russians have few units left. Most of them are regrouping in the main towns, where they hope to offer a fierce resistance until the ceasefire comes.
dst: 情报报告：在涅曼河战败之后，俄国人剩下的部队已经不多。他们大多正在主要城镇重新集结，希望在那里顽强抵抗，直到停火到来。

src: Intelligence report: Although our High Command has made desperate efforts to bring you fresh reinforcement troops from Anatolia, I regret to inform you that they won't arrive in time. You will have to deal with the Bulgarians with the forces that are currently available.
dst: 情报报告：尽管最高统帅部竭尽全力想从安纳托利亚为您调来生力军，但我遗憾地告知您，他们无法及时赶到。您将只能依靠现有的兵力来对付保加利亚人。

src: Intelligence report: Beseler's ship scuttled somwhere on the islands of the Vistula River. The plane will speed up the action. As the plane's fuel and ammo is limited, build an airfield with the pioneers for resupplying it.
dst: 情报报告：贝泽勒的船在维斯瓦河的某处岛屿上凿沉了。飞机将加速行动。由于飞机的燃油和弹药有限，请用工兵修建机场为其补给。

src: Intelligence report: Beseler's ship scuttled somwhere on the islands of the Vistula River. The plane will speed up the action. As the plane's fuel and ammo is limited, build an airfield with the pioneers for resupplying it. The plane bought for this scenario has an experience bonus!
dst: 情报报告：贝泽勒的船在维斯瓦河的某处岛屿上凿沉了。飞机将加速行动。由于飞机的燃油和弹药有限，请用工兵修建机场为其补给。为本场景购买的飞机拥有经验加成！

src: Intelligence report: Beware of the enemy air force and mine fields.
dst: 情报报告：当心敌人的空军和雷区。

src: Intelligence report: Beware of the enemy air force.
dst: 情报报告：当心敌人的空军。

src: Intelligence report: British troops are expected to arrive along the Tigris river. You will have to count on your own resources since no reinforcements are availabe and only some supplies will be delivered to you.
dst: 情报报告：预计英军将沿底格里斯河而来。您将只能依靠自己的资源，因为没有任何增援，只有少量补给会送达。

src: Intelligence report: Cossacks are everywhere and supported by weak infantry and defectors from the  KuK 26 IR. Enemy artillery is likely to arrive later. KuK airplanes can spot the enemy but their efficiency will be doubled if sappers can build an airfield. The most distant VH is a really hard nut to crack and only soft and weak reinforcements are expected so it will be a tough fight.
dst: 情报报告：哥萨克人遍地都是，并得到薄弱步兵和奥匈帝国第26步兵团的叛逃者的支援。敌军炮兵很可能稍后抵达。奥匈帝国的飞机可以发现敌人，但若工兵能修建机场，其效率将翻倍。最远的胜利点是一块极难啃的硬骨头，而且预计只会出现软弱无力的增援，因此这将是一场苦战。

src: Intelligence report: Enemy units are weak and shattered but remnants of the destroyed units can attack from the woods.
dst: 情报报告：敌军部队薄弱且溃散，但被歼灭部队的残部可能会从树林中发起攻击。

src: Intelligence report: In the north and south, your forces will be flanked by our cavalry units. Our 4th and 13th infantry divisions are also on their way to reinforce your flanks but it will still take some time for them to join the battle.
dst: 情报报告：在北面和南面，您的部队两侧将由我们的骑兵单位掩护。我们的第4和第13步兵师也在赶来增援您的两翼，但他们还需要一些时间才能投入战斗。

src: Intelligence report: Main Entete's effort is expected in the south of the peninsula, but do not exclude landings in the other parts also. If needed, reinforcements will be sent to you.
dst: 情报报告：预计协约国的主力攻势在半岛南部，但也不要排除在其他地方登陆的可能。如有需要，将向您派遣增援。

src: Intelligence report: Most of the Soviet units are believed to be gathering near the Rastavitsa River and the forests by the eastern shore of the Teterev. You should build solid lines of defence as fast as possible using the terrain features wisely. Your engineer troops can be very useful in delaying the Russian advance.
dst: 情报报告：据信大部分苏军部队正在拉斯塔维察河附近以及捷捷列夫河东岸的森林地带集结。您应当尽可能快地构筑坚固防线，并巧妙地利用地形。您的工兵部队在迟滞俄军推进方面会非常有用。

src: Intelligence report: On turn 3 you will receive reinforcements coming from the west.
dst: 情报报告：第3回合，您将得到来自西面的援军。

src: Intelligence report: On turn 7 you will receive reinforcements coming from the west. But beware of Russian reinforcements.
dst: 情报报告：第7回合，您将得到来自西面的援军。但要提防俄军的增援。

src: Intelligence report: Only light cossack units are have been spotted. Our resources are limited, so there will be no additional funds. Volunteers can approach from the south and there is plenty of ammo.
dst: 情报报告：只发现了轻装哥萨克部队。我方资源有限，因此不会有额外资金。志愿兵可从南面接近，弹药十分充足。

src: Intelligence report: Only light cossack units have been spotted. Our resources are limited, so there will be no additional funds. Volunteers can approach from the south and there is plenty of ammo.
dst: 情报报告：只发现了轻装哥萨克部队。我方资源有限，因此不会有额外资金。志愿兵可从南面接近，弹药十分充足。

src: Intelligence report: Our cavalry was hidden on the left flank of the enemy, but has been spotted by Italian air ships.
dst: 情报报告：我们的骑兵曾隐蔽在敌军左翼，但已被意大利飞艇发现。

src: Intelligence report: Russians are coming from the North, East and South.
dst: 情报报告：俄国人正从北、东、南三面逼近。

src: Intelligence report: The Bolsheviks are fleeing. A few units will try to slow you down. You can also expect some blockroads but HQ is sure that there will be no counterattacks. The 6th Ukrainian Division will attack south of you but don't expect any cooperation from them.
dst: 情报报告：布尔什维克正在逃跑。少数部队会试图拖慢您的脚步。您还可能会遇到一些路障，但司令部确信不会有反击。乌克兰第6师将在您的南面进攻，但别指望他们提供任何配合。

src: Intelligence report: The Italians will not be able to ship many new troops to Trablus the next few days. The Italian Navy still has a strong presence in the area.
dst: 情报报告：未来几天，意大利人将无法向的黎波里运送多少新部队。意大利海军在该地区仍有强大存在。

src: Intelligence report: The enemy air force is significantly stronger than in previous battles, so be careful.
dst: 情报报告：敌军空军的实力明显强于以往的战斗，务必小心。

src: Intelligence report: The roads here have been devastated by the battles of the Great War and Soviet occupation. You can expect fortifications here so prepare your forces for difficult warfare. Don't expect further reinforcements. White Armies started to attack in the south so the Red Army should not be reinforced in our area.
dst: 情报报告：这里的道路已被大战的战役和苏军占领所毁坏。您可以料想这里会有防御工事，所以要让您的部队为艰苦作战做好准备。不要指望有进一步的增援。白军已开始在南方进攻，因此红军在我方地区应该得不到增援。

src: Intelligence report: The weather is terrible: temperatures of -25 ºC (-13 ºF) and thick snow makes any air-support nearly impossible. The Soviet 15th Army is rather weak but hidden in strong fortifications. Be prepared because they use a lot of mines! If you move your infantry cautiously onto the minefield they will be able to possibly remove the mines!
dst: 情报报告：天气糟透了——气温零下25摄氏度（零下13华氏度），厚厚的积雪使任何空中支援几乎都不可能。苏军第15集团军相当虚弱，但隐藏在坚固的工事里。要有所准备，因为他们埋了大量地雷！如果您的步兵小心翼翼地进入雷区，他们或许能把地雷排除掉！

src: Intelligence report: There are more enemy regiments in the area.
dst: 情报报告：该地区有更多的敌军团。

src: Intelligence report: There are more enemy regiments in the area. There is not only the Western Division, allegedly Polish,  but also a division from Pskow. Wilno is heavilly garrisoned by remnants of the previously beaten enemy that can also be found outside the town. There is a possibility that Polish citizens of Wilno will stand against the Communists. Don't expect further reinforcements.
dst: 情报报告：该地区还有更多的敌军团队。不仅有据称是波兰的西师，还有一支来自普斯科夫的师。维尔诺由先前被击败之敌的残部重兵驻守，城外也能发现这些残部。维尔诺的波兰公民有可能起来反抗共产主义者。不要指望有进一步的增援。

src: Intelligence report: There are more enemy regiments in the area. There is not only the Western Division, allegedly Polish, but also a division from Pskow. Wilno is heavilly garrisoned and remnants of the previously beaten enemy can also be found outside of the town. There is the possibility that the Polish citizens of Wilno will stand against the Communists. Do not expect further reinforcements.
dst: 情报报告：该地区有更多的敌军团。那里不仅有据称是波兰人的西方师，还有一支来自普斯科夫的师。维尔诺守备森严，此前被击败的敌人残部也会在城外出现。维尔诺的波兰公民有可能起来反抗共产党人。不要再指望进一步的增援。

src: Intelligence report: Two roads leads north. The western road is guarded by German units while the eastern is guarded by Austrian units. Choose one.
dst: 情报报告：有两条路通往北方。西边的路由德军把守，东边的路由奥军把守。任选其一。

src: Intelligence report: We know that the Romanians have blown up most of the bridges and laid minefields along your way in order to delay you. You'll have to find he way to remove those obstacles.
dst: 情报报告：我们知道罗马尼亚人已炸毁沿途大部分桥梁并布设了雷场，以迟滞您。您必须想办法清除这些障碍。

src: Intelligence report: We know there are a few weak Red Army units in the vicinity. Some of these units consist of Poles so you either can expect a tough resistance or maybe even desertions. They are our compatriots after all.  Don't expect further reinforcements! And if you delay your attack too much, you may have to fight off more bolsheviks!
dst: 情报报告：我们知道附近有几支弱小的红军部队。其中一些部队由波兰人组成，因此您既可以预期遇到顽强的抵抗，也可能出现倒戈。毕竟他们是我们的同胞。不要再指望进一步的增援！如果您过于拖延进攻，可能就不得不与更多的布尔什维克作战了！

src: Intelligence report: We know there are a few weak Red Army units in the vicinity. Some of these units consist of Poles so you either can expect a tough resistance or maybe even desertions. They are our compatriots after all.  Some of them alreade deserted and brought a train full of planes, so we can equip a unit of fighters. The planes are obsolete, but can be useful.
dst: 情报报告：我们知道附近有几支弱小的红军部队。其中一些部队由波兰人组成，因此您既可以预期遇到顽强的抵抗，也可能出现倒戈。毕竟他们是我们的同胞。其中一些人已经倒戈，带来了一整列火车的飞机，因此我们可以装备一支战斗机部队。这些飞机已经过时，但仍能派上用场。

src: Intelligence report: Whatever will be the choice, infantry should be modernized to match the German Army standards.
dst: 情报报告：无论做出何种选择，步兵都应进行现代化，以达到德军标准。

src: Intelligence report: Whatever will be the choice, infantry should be modernized to match the German Army standards..
dst: 情报报告：无论做出何种选择，步兵都应进行现代化，以达到德军标准。

src: Intelligence report: the Canal can be crossed only from ports (already existing or newly built by sappeurs). Reinforcements can be expected just before the BV limit expires.
dst: 情报报告：运河只能从港口（已存在的或工兵新建的）渡过。增援可望在大捷时限即将到期前到达。

src: Intelligence reports tell us that Zabinka and Kobryn are defended by elements of the improvised 60th Infantry Division while we believe Brest has only March Battalions or the "Kitchen Corps" garrisoning the fortress.
dst: 情报报告称，扎宾卡和科布林由临时编成的第60步兵师部分兵力防守，而我们相信布列斯特只有行军营或“厨房部队”在守备要塞。

src: Intelligence reports that a force of gargantuan proportions is being assembled for the assault.  Unfortunately, your regiment is slated to join the defenders.  The Estonian HQ believes that sending your regiment to Osel is a hopeless task.  Care has been taken to ensure sufficient transport remains on Osel to evacuate your regiment.  Your orders for this mission are as follows:
dst: 情报报告称，一支规模庞大的部队正在为进攻而集结。不幸的是，您的团被指定加入守军。爱沙尼亚司令部认为，把您的团派往厄塞尔岛是一项毫无希望的任务。他们已注意确保厄塞尔岛上留有足够的运输工具，以便将您的团撤离。您此次任务所受的命令如下：

src: Intelligence reports that the 10th Rifle Division has fortified at Pskov and will not be dislodged easily.  An armored train has also been spotted on the railway between Pskov and Novgorod.
dst: 情报显示，第10步兵师已在普斯科夫设防固守，不易击退。此外，普斯科夫与诺夫哥罗德之间的铁路上也发现了一列装甲列车。

src: Intelligence reports that the 4th Indian division has been redrawn from the front lines and the 6th 'Diggers' Australian division has taken its place.
dst: 情报报告，印度第4师已从前线撤下，澳大利亚第6“挖土工”师接替了它的位置。

src: Intelligence reports that the South African 2nd Division has been joined by the 201 Gds Brigade, the 11th Indian Brigade and the 32 Army Tank Brigade before our troops completed the encirclement of Tobruk. The 20th Indian Brigade that tried to break out of the encirclement ran into the German 5th Pz Rgt and was captured almost to the last man.
dst: 情报报告，在我军完成对托布鲁克的合围之前，南非第2师已得到近卫第201旅、印度第11旅和第32集团军坦克旅的增援。试图突围的印度第20旅撞上德国第5装甲团，几乎全军被俘。

src: Intelligence reports that the enemy command point is located in the village of Fraga, and obviously that is one of the main goals of your mission.
dst: 情报显示，敌军指挥所位于弗拉加村，这显然也是您此次任务的主要目标之一。

src: Intelligence reports that the enemy troops consist mainly of the red V corps under the general Modesto.
dst: 情报报告称，敌军主要由莫德斯托将军麾下的共和军第5军组成。

src: Intelligence reports the rebel forces are mainly composed by the elements from the 13th Division, and some Legion Banderas, which have been included into two newly formed divisions; the division Tetuan and the division Ceuta, which will surely be extremely hard. Also, Italian units will make harder the things.
dst: 情报显示，叛军主要由第13师的部队和一些外籍军团旗队组成，它们已被编入两个新组建的师：得土安师和休达师，这两个师毫无疑问将极难对付。此外，意大利部队也会让事情更加棘手。

src: Intelligence tells us that the Turks are about to launch a massive offensive with the aim of driving us back into the sea!! It is imperitive that you hold all your positions!! Good Luck. (There is only 2 possible outcomes:- Brilliant Victory for holding your 3 Vic Hexs OR Loss for not holding them)
dst: 情报显示，土耳其人即将发动大规模攻势，意图把我们赶回海里！！您必须守住所有阵地！！祝您好运。（只有两种可能的结果：守住3个胜利点获大捷，或者守不住而失败）

src: Intending to stop this, the Turkish authorities tried to modernize and strengthen their armies since the decade of 1890. In the following years they had to fight wars in Greece, in Lybia,  in Macedonia and, finally, in the terrible Great War. Although they fought bravely, the Ottomans were eventually defeated, and the new Turkish Republic had to fight for its very survival until 1923, when the foreign invaders were finally expelled from the country.
dst: 为阻止这种局面，土耳其当局自19世纪90年代起试图对其军队进行现代化和强化。此后数年，他们不得不在希腊、利比亚、马其顿作战，最终卷入了可怕的大战。尽管他们英勇作战，奥斯曼人最终仍战败，新生的土耳其共和国不得不为生存而战，直到1923年外国入侵者终于被逐出国门。

src: Into the Jaws of Death - U.S. Troops wading through water and Nazi gunfire, 6. Juni 1944, 08:30.
dst: 《进入死神之口》——美军士兵涉水穿过海水与纳粹炮火，1944年6月6日，08:30。

src: Into the bunker quickly, the RAF are everywhere is seems.
dst: 快进掩体，皇家空军似乎无处不在。

src: Irashaimase!  Our Empire is secure in the Pacific.  Now, the Americans will pay for the years of humiliations against our glorious imperial nation... the high command has special plans for them...
dst: 欢迎光临！我们的帝国在太平洋已安然无虞。现在，美国人将为他们多年来对我们光荣帝国的羞辱付出代价……高层对他们另有特别的安排……

src: Irasshaimase to New Guinea General. Your troops should be deployed as special detachtment to the South part of this island, to take part in our operations at New Guinea. Our intentions are to cut the supply trails of the enemy from their main base in the South; Port Moresby, which eventually could be further goal, if the enemy is damaged enough.
dst: 欢迎来到新几内亚，将军。您的部队应作为特别支队部署到本岛南部，参与我们在新几内亚的作战。我们的意图是切断敌军来自其南方主基地莫尔兹比港的补给线；如果敌军受损足够严重，那最终还可能成为下一步目标。
Irene / 港口警戒部队 Ostende-Ost

src: Irkutsk is almost on the shores of the Baikalsee and lies in territory excellently suited for the defender. We think that the Russians don't have any troops in place yet, but it is important to act quickly!
dst: 伊尔库茨克几乎就在贝加尔湖畔，地处极利于防守的地形。我们估计俄国人尚未在此部署部队，但必须火速行动！

src: Ironically, Omdurman was a source of great honours for me. I was mentioned in Kitchener's despatches for my resolution in battle, and a few months later I was promoted to Colonel. So there is no doubt that I owe much to Lord Horatio Kitchener. For my sins, that would not be the last time that I would serve under his direct command and witness his ruthless methods.
dst: 讽刺的是，恩图曼成了我莫大荣誉的来源。我因在战斗中的果决而在基钦纳的战报中受到表彰，几个月后晋升为上校。因此毫无疑问，我欠霍雷肖·基钦纳勋爵很多。作为我的报应，那并非我最后一次在他直接指挥下服役、目睹他的冷酷手段。

src: Ironically, the real winner of this battle between Germany and Russia is...France. Due to the Brussilow offensive and the British operation at the Somme we've been forced to retire too many troops from Verdun, and our plan there has failed. The French Army is shaken, but not broken, and our losses in the west have been so high that we'll have to retire to a safer defence line as soon as we can build it.
dst: 颇具讽刺的是，这场德俄之战的真正赢家是……法国。由于布鲁西洛夫攻势和英军在索姆河的行动，我们被迫从凡尔登撤走了太多部队，我们在那里的计划已经失败。法军虽受重创，但未被打垮，而我们在西面的损失如此之大，以致不得不尽快修筑一条更安全的防线并撤守过去。
伊尔塔什弗尔德克（丘陵）
伊伦——封闭西班牙-法国边境

src: Irun - Closing the Spanish - French border
dst: 伊伦——封闭西班牙-法国边境

src: Is important to destroy the enemy ships before your marines move to Corsica. Also watch out for the enemy air force, they may have the upper hand. The most important thing is to protect your ships and your marines as well as to constantly scan the sea.
dst: 在你的海军陆战队开赴科西嘉之前，摧毁敌舰很重要。同时也要提防敌军空军，他们可能占据上风。最重要的是保护你的军舰和海军陆战队，并不断扫描海面。

src: Is it already enough for us?
dst: 这对我们来说已经够了吗？

src: Is not expected a hard enemy resistance.
dst: 预计敌军不会进行顽强抵抗。

src: Is this what you call Blitzkrieg, Herr General? Your troops are put in reserve. You would better hope they can take part in a successful action before France capitulates or this might be the end of the Waffen SS.
dst: 这也叫闪电战吗，将军阁下？你的部队被编入预备队。你最好祈祷他们能在法国投降前参加一次成功的行动，否则武装党卫军也许就此走到头了。

src: Islanders defend their homes. You must destroy airfields, other city defenses, RAF and many land and navy units.
dst: 岛民誓死守土。您必须摧毁机场、城市防御工事、皇家空军及众多陆军与海军部队。

src: It all does not matter anymore, comrade.  Strategy?  We want victory!  The Tsarist monarchists know their fate.  Their dream of a Russia full of slaves they can control is gone!  The people have stood up against this injustice and united itself to drive out the capitalist oppressors!
dst: 这一切都已不再重要，同志。战略？我们要的是胜利！沙皇君主主义者自知他们的命运。他们那个坐拥一群可随心所欲奴役的奴隶的俄国的迷梦，已经破灭！人民挺身反抗这种不公，并团结起来驱逐资本主义压迫者！

src: It appears our initial estimate regarding the German retreat has been wrong:  using the slow advance of the 1st Army to their advantage, the Germans have regrouped the bulk of the 8th Army against Samsonov and have struck at his flanks.
dst: 看来我们最初对德军撤退的判断是错误的：德军利用第1集团军推进缓慢之机，重新集结了第8集团军主力对付萨姆索诺夫，并打击其两翼。

src: It appears that the Austrians are cut off from their neighbors with only a line of communication to the rear.  They are attempting to concentrate their forces against one flank and then the other.  You must press on with exhausted troops to foil the Austrian maneuver.  Expect the arrival of the 3rd Army to assault Rava Russka within days.
dst: 看来奥军与友邻已被切断，只剩一条通往后方的交通线。他们正试图把兵力先集中对付一个侧翼，再对付另一个。您必须以疲惫不堪的部队继续推进，挫败奥军的机动。预计第3集团军将在数日内到达，向拉瓦鲁斯卡发起突击。

src: It appears that the XL Reserve Corps from the 8th Army was sent along the Bobr River to meet the forward elements of the 10th with the goal of trapping the majority of the 10th (III, XX, and III Siberian Corps) in a cauldron.  You will be deployed as the XX Corps, charged with the task of holding the German onlaught in the Augustow Forest.  The fortress of Osowiec will serve as the hinge of your left flank.
dst: 看来第8集团军的第40预备军已沿博布尔河派出，前去与第10集团军的前锋会合，目的是将第10集团军主力（第3、第20和第3西伯利亚军）围困在包围圈中。您将作为第20军部署，任务是在奥古斯图夫森林阻击德军的猛攻。奥索维茨要塞将成为您左翼的支点。

src: It appears the Dutch are no longer in this war.
dst: 看来荷兰人已退出这场战争。

src: It could have been a great agreement but, as you know, for all its wealth and power, your country has always been a land of bandits and pirates, and always will be. If you betrayed your God just to follow the whim of a lecherous king, could anyone expect that you honoured the promises that you made to Emperor Yohannes? As soon as the Egyptians were successfully evacuated, and just four months after the signature of the treaty, your government broke it, and encouraged Italy to take Massawa.
dst: 这本可以是一份很棒的协议，但如您所知，尽管你们国家富庶强大，却始终是一片强盗与海盗的土地，而且永远都是。既然你们为追随一个好色国王的一时兴起而背叛了自己的上帝，又怎能指望别人相信你们会信守对约翰内斯皇帝许下的承诺呢？埃及人刚刚顺利撤出，距离条约签订仅仅四个月，你们的政府就撕毁了它，还怂恿意大利夺取马萨瓦。

src: It could have been worse. A few days later my friend Samuel Lomax, who commanded the 1st division, was mortally wounded, again due to German artillery fire, and the first battle of Ypres also claimed the life of old Lord Roberts, the man who had created the concentration camps at South Africa. Indeed, all they that live by the sword shall perish by the sword.
dst: 情况本可能更糟。几天后，指挥第1师的朋友塞缪尔·洛马克斯再次因德军炮火而受了致命伤，第一次伊普尔战役还夺去了老罗伯茨勋爵的生命，正是此人创建了南非的集中营。确实，凡动刀剑者，必死于刀剑之下。

src: It doesn't matter. We've taken thousands of prisoners, and Austria-Hungary is safe for the moment. The Italians won't dare to attack them for some time.
dst: 这无妨。我们俘获了数千名战俘，奥匈帝国暂时安全了。意大利人一段时间内不敢再进攻他们。

src: It goes without saying that it is a question of honour to relieve the surrounded detachment. You will be in charge of the rescue mission to Baler.
dst: 不用说，解救被围困的分遣队关乎荣誉。您将负责前往巴莱尔的营救任务。

src: It had been 3 years since the Fuhress had took control.Germany had become the 'Beacon of the World' for the Female gender.Women were still pouring in to join the SS.With these Women came the money and Germany had 'more than enough'.No country in History had seen the developement of it's infrastructure and industry ascend to the limit of the Frauland in such a short time and everything was structured for 'Total War'.In Berlin ILse had one thing on Her mind and that was to enslave those not of the SS/BdM of value and the rest Exterminate.Behind the 'Frau Armies sat truckloads of 'Death-heads' Eradication squads."A Necessity" ILse termed it.In the History of the World it would be termed the 'SS Plague".If Amerika had joined the Allies cause with more than supplies or Joseph Stalin had moved during '38 the World might have averted the 'Plague' but now it was too late and Stalin had his hands full to the East with the Japanese.So War was coming and France and England were about to face those their Diplomats thought could be controlled with a Good Meal,a bottle of wine,a little music and a few Roses.The message went out to the Panzers sneaking through the Ardennes,to the Flyers of the SS Air Korps sitting on the airfields and to the SS/KM. Three words, 'War' and 'Stuka's aloft.
dst: 女元首掌权至今已3年。德国成了女性性别的“世界灯塔”。女性仍在涌入，加入党卫军。随着这些女性而来的是金钱，德国的钱“多得用不完”。历史上没有任何国家的基础设施和工业，能在如此短的时间内发展到“女性之国”这样的高度，一切都按“总体战”来构建。在柏林，伊尔泽心里只有一件事：把党卫军/BdM 之外有价值的人变成奴隶，其余的全部消灭。在“女士”军队后面，是满载“骷髅”清剿小队的卡车。伊尔泽称之为“必需之举”。在世界史上，它将被称作“党卫军瘟疫”。如果美国当初不只是提供物资、而是加入了盟国事业，或者约瑟夫·斯大林在38年就动手，世界或许能避免这场“瘟疫”——但如今为时已晚，而斯大林在东边正被日本人缠得脱不开身。于是战争将至，法国和英格兰即将面对的，是他们的外交官以为靠一顿美餐、一瓶好酒、一点音乐和几枝玫瑰就能拿下的人。讯息发给了悄悄穿过阿登的装甲部队、发给了驻在机场上的党卫军航空军飞行员，也发给了党卫军／海军。三个词——“战争”——以及升空的“斯图卡”。

src: It has become apparent that the new leadership of the German 8th Army (von Hindenburg and Ludendorff) orchestrated the defeat of the 2nd Army by rapidly redeploying the I, I Reserve, and XVII Corps to face Samsonov and annihilate his force.
dst: 情况已明朗：德军第8集团军的新领导层（冯·兴登堡与鲁登道夫）通过迅速重新部署第1军、第1预备军和第17军去迎击萨姆索诺夫并歼灭其部队，一手策划了第2集团军的溃败。

src: It has become clear that our soldiers can fight on equal terms with the liberals. It's time to leave the mountains and villages and take the war to the great cities of the north. Bilbao will be your next target.
dst: 已经很明显，我们的士兵能与自由派军队势均力敌。是时候走出山区和村庄，把战火烧向北方的大城市了。毕尔巴鄂将是您的下一个目标。

src: It has been a difficult battle but in the end the Soviet army has been destroyed and we have forged an alliance with Latvia that will be very important in the future.
dst: 这是一场艰苦的战斗，但最终苏军被歼灭了，我们还与拉脱维亚缔结了联盟，这在将来会非常重要。

src: It has been a tough battle, General, but our victory is complete! El Mizzian was killed by our soldiers near Kaddur, and after that, the few remaining enemies have fled. Our control over the Kert Valley is complete, and without a powerful leader like El Mizzian, it will take years for the hostile Berbers tribes to recover from this defeat.
dst: 这是一场艰苦的战斗，将军，但我们的胜利是彻底的！埃尔米齐安在卡杜尔附近被我们的士兵击毙，此后，残余的少数敌人也逃走了。我们完全控制了凯尔特河谷，而没有了埃尔米齐安这样强有力的领袖，敌对的柏柏尔人部落要想从这次失败中恢复过来，得花上好几年。

src: It has been a tremendous battle but finally the Soviets have been defeated and they have taken heavy losses. The Bolshevik government has sent us a peace offer that we are considering right now.
dst: 这是一场规模宏大的战斗，但最终苏军被击败，并遭受了重大损失。布尔什维克政府向我们发出了和平提议，我们此刻正在考虑。

src: It has been a tremendous battle but our troops were exhausted and we couldn't take our objectives in time. The Red Army has taken heavy losses too so the Bolshevik government has sent us a peace offer that we are considering right now.
dst: 这是一场规模宏大的战斗，但我们的部队已精疲力竭，没能及时达成目标。红军也遭受了重大损失，因此布尔什维克政府向我们发出了和平提议，我们此刻正在考虑。

src: It has been decided to press our advance as rapidly as possible along the coast, and so by indirect pressure compel the Turks to retire from the Sinai highlands. As a preliminary step your troops will raid the Turkish force in position at El Magruntein Hill, close to the old Egyptian police post at Rafa.
dst: 已决定尽可能迅速地沿海岸推进，从而以间接压力迫使土耳其人撤出西奈高地。作为初步行动，您的部队将袭击拉法附近旧埃及警察哨所旁的埃尔马格伦廷山上的土耳其部队。

src: It has come to our attention that the Swedes are planning an uprising. The uprising is centered around the town of Oestersund, where a certain 'Generalleutenant' Von Adler is advocating his evil socialist ideas, when he isn't busy baking chocolate cakes....
dst: 我们注意到瑞典人正在策划一场起义。起义中心在厄斯特松德镇，那里有位“将军”冯·阿德勒，在忙于烤巧克力蛋糕之余，鼓吹他那邪恶的社会主义思想……

src: It has turned out that our previous suspicions were incorrect. The Russian government was pro-German, as we thought. But the KGB and the armed fores were not. Now they have overthrown the government in Khabarovsk and have started an all-out attack. Since we only had a few static divisions guarding the border we have been quickly over-run. Kazan has fallen - take it back!
dst: 事实证明我们先前的怀疑有误。俄国政府确如我们所想是亲德的，但克格勃和军队却不是。如今他们推翻了哈巴罗夫斯克的政府，发动了全面进攻。由于我们只有少数静态师守边，很快就被击溃。喀山已陷落——把它夺回来！

src: It hasn't passed one single day that I haven't thought that, if we had advanced a little faster, or if the Cossacks had been more disciplined, we could have actually encircled the Soviet Army. But we failed at the worst possible time. We were facing a bleak future, and things would get much worse before the war was over.
dst: 没有一天我不在回想：如果我们推进得再快一点，或者哥萨克再守纪律一些，我们本可以真正合围苏俄军队。但我们却在最糟糕的时刻失败了。我们正面临黯淡的前景，而战争结束之前，情况还会变得更糟。

src: It hasn't passed one single day that I haven't thought that, if we had advanced faster, or if the Cossacks had been more disciplined, we could have actually encircled the Soviet Army. But we failed at the worst possible time. We were facing a bleak future, and things would get much worse before the war was over.
dst: 没有一天我不在回想：如果我们推进得再快一些，或者哥萨克再守纪律一些，我们本可以真正合围苏俄军队。但我们却在最糟糕的时刻失败了。我们正面临黯淡的前景，而战争结束之前，情况还会变得更糟。

src: It is D-Day+12. We were able to establish beachheads alonge the whole coast from Utah beach in the west to Sword beach near Caen in the east. Paratroopers landed on the Cotentin pensinula and our ground units already reached the western coast and cut off the germans on the peninsula. Your objective is now to capture the city and port of Cherbourg. The germans declared Cherbourg a fortress and it seems that they are willing to fight and won't surrender.
dst: 现在是登陆日+12天。我们已在从西面的犹他海滩到东面卡昂附近剑海滩的整条海岸线上建立起滩头阵地。伞兵在科唐坦半岛着陆，我们的地面部队已经抵达西海岸，切断了半岛上的德军。你现在的目标是夺取瑟堡城及其港口。德军宣布瑟堡为要塞，看来他们打算顽抗，不会投降。

src: It is a pity we did not discuss your Spanish experiences.  Perhaps it could have helped to put them in todays perspective, but we will not get the chance.  Hitler himself has ordered that all non-German forces be withrawn from battle and sent home immediately.
dst: 可惜我们没能聊聊你的西班牙经历。或许那本有助于用今天的视角来看待它们，但我们没机会了。希特勒亲自下令，所有非德军部队撤出战斗，立即遣送回国。

src: It is dawning and I have to move to our positions....
dst: 天快亮了，我得赶去我们的阵地了……

src: It is difficult to consider Peralejo as a victory of any side. The number of casualties on either side was, as usual, in dispute but they were high for both sides, by the standards of the war in Cuba. Estimates of Spanish casualties are 28 killed and 98 wounded, including the death of General Santocildes. The Cubans suffered 118 casualties. However, the Spanish were force to withdraw from the field, something they rarely had to do.
dst: 很难把佩拉莱霍之战视为任何一方的胜利。和往常一样，双方的伤亡数字存在争议，但按古巴战争的标准，双方伤亡都很高。西班牙伤亡估计为28人阵亡、98人受伤，其中包括桑托西尔德斯将军的阵亡。古巴人伤亡118人。然而，西班牙人被迫撤离战场，这种事他们极少不得不做。

src: It is imperative that we regain the initiative by launching a counterattack to retake Kharkov, a city recently taken by advancing Soviet armies. If you are able to retake Kharkov and all other objectives by March 14th, we should be in a position to launch a major offensive aimed at Kursk in the summer. An early victory at Kharkov will make it easier for us to overwhelm the Soviets when the weather turns warm again.
dst: 我们必须发起反攻、夺回哈尔科夫，以重夺先手——该城不久前被推进中的苏军攻占。如果你能在3月14日前夺回哈尔科夫及所有其他目标，我们就能在夏季对库尔斯克发动一场大规模攻势。哈尔科夫的早日胜利，将使我军在天气再度转暖后更容易压倒苏军。

src: It is important for us to gain experience but we should withdraw to the east....!
dst: 对我们来说积累经验很重要，但我们应该向东撤退……！

src: It is inadmissible to loss during manouvres.
dst: 演习中出现损失是不可接受的。

src: It is my duty to report, that upon my arrival, that the situation is grave.
dst: 我有责任报告，抵达之后发现，局势十分严峻。

src: It is noteworthy that on 12 April, upon the request of the Spanish High Command, the Americans intervened when Lt. Commander James C. Gilmore with fourteen crews from the gunboat USS Yorktown attempted to relieve the Spanish. However, they were captured by the Filipino forces and held prisoner for eight months before they were simply abandoned by their Filipino captors in the midst of the jungle.
dst: 值得注意的是，4月12日，应西班牙最高统帅部的请求，美国人进行了干预：海军少校詹姆斯·C·吉尔摩率领炮艇「约克敦」号的14名船员试图解救西班牙人。然而，他们被菲律宾军队俘获，被关押了八个月，最后只是被他们的菲律宾俘获者遗弃在丛林深处。

src: It is now time to assault the Italian mainland.  While Montgomery's 8th Army advances across the straits of Messina, your force as part of the British X Corps will land near Salerno.  On your right flank will be the U.S. 36th Infantry Division.  After securing a beach head your men should move quickly to capture Salerno and the mountain passes north of the city.  Diversionary attacks have been made to the east in order to draw away the attention of German forces.  Please note that there will be no pre-landing air and naval bombardment.
dst: 现在是时候突击意大利本土了。趁蒙哥马利的第8集团军横渡墨西拿海峡之际，你作为英军第10军一部分的部队将在萨莱诺附近登陆。你的右翼是美军第36步兵师。巩固滩头后，你的部队应迅速夺取萨莱诺及城北的山口。东面已发起牵制性进攻，以引开德军的注意力。请注意，此次登陆前没有海空火力准备。

src: It is now time to repatriate our forces back to Spain.
dst: 现在是时候把我们的部队撤回西班牙了。

src: It is on the native divisions and on your formation, Gospodin General, that the North-Western Front depends in this hour.
dst: 在这一时刻，西北方面军所依靠的正是本土师和您的部队，将军阁下。

src: It is only possible to deploy Friedrich Hecker at hex (29,29).
dst: 弗里德里希·黑克尔只能部署在(29,29)格。

src: It is only through the direct intervention of Marshall Rommel that the fuehrer did not fire you straight away. He seems to have somehow convinced him that attacking the paratroopers and thus allowing the allies to gain a large bridgehead in the south was your only option. In this way we gained a small victory but lost the Peloponese.
dst: 全凭隆美尔元帅直接出面干预，元首才没有立即将您撤职。他似乎设法让元首相信，进攻伞兵从而让盟军得以在南部取得一个宽阔桥头堡，是您唯一的选择。如此我们赢得了一场小胜，却丢掉了伯罗奔尼撒半岛。

src: It is possible to deploy planes at the axis flagged hex. This hex simulates a flight path / approach corridor of planes taking off from airports in Scotland.
dst: 可以在轴心国旗帜的格子上部署飞机。该格模拟从苏格兰机场起飞的飞机的航路/进场走廊。

src: It is recommended to upgrade your mountain mortars to marine mortars with the marine transport. You will need this also in the future. Purchase 1 more marine inf and 2 Marine MG Flak, all with marine transport. Also it would be useful to add fast speed to ground units.
dst: 建议你将山地迫击炮升级为配备海上运输的海军迫击炮。你在日后也会需要它。再采购 1 个海军步兵和 2 个海军 MG FlaK，全部配备海上运输。此外，为地面单位增加快速移动能力也会很有用。

src: It is rumored that a group of liberal polititians and military officers intends to proclaim Alfonso,  Infanta Isabel's son, as King . There is no doubt that the People would more readily accept him that King Amadeo or the republic, so it is imperative to march on Madrid before the enemy can react.
dst: 有传言说，一群自由派政客和军官企图拥立伊莎贝尔公主之子阿方索为国王。毫无疑问，比起阿马德奥国王或共和国，人民会更乐于接受他，因此必须赶在敌人作出反应之前向马德里进军。

src: It is strongly recommended to buy a fighter.
dst: 强烈建议购买一架战斗机。

src: It is suggested that you pay careful attention to the Polish cavalry.  They are still among the best trained and equipped units of the Polish army.  They are acting as reconnaissance units, but are a force to be reckoned with in their own right.  There is also an extensive forested area near the town of Kryznowloga, intelligence reports that the Polish forces are using this to avoid the strength of our panzer units, and to launch flanking attacks.
dst: 建议你格外留意波兰骑兵。他们仍是波军训练最好、装备最精的部队之一。他们担任侦察任务，但本身就是一支不可小觑的力量。克雷日诺沃加镇附近还有大片林区，情报显示波军正利用这片林地避开我方装甲部队的锋芒，并发动侧翼进攻。

src: It is time for our Normandy landings, D-Day. Your troops are ordered to land at Omaha Beach, establish a beachhead and fight their way through the Atlantic Wall into the hinterland of the Normandy. This section of the Atlantic Wall is defended by the 352th Infantry division and the 439th Ost-Batallion as well as some other units. Maybe some armored troops will arrive at the battlefield in a few days.
dst: 该是我们在诺曼底登陆的时候了，D日。你的部队奉命在奥马哈海滩登陆，建立滩头阵地，并一路突破大西洋壁垒杀入诺曼底腹地。这一段大西洋壁垒由第352步兵师和第439东方营以及其他一些部队防守。也许几天后会有一些装甲部队抵达战场。

src: It is time for us to end British domination over the entire Middle East. If we succeed, we may be able to influence the war in Russia by opening a new invasion route through the Caucasus. Your many objectives in the Middle East must be taken before major British reinforcements are able to arrive this fall, or all gains may be lost. In any event, we expect you to take your objectives by November 15th at the latest.
dst: 现在是我们终结英国对整个中东统治的时候了。若能成功，我们或许可以通过开辟一条穿越高加索的新入侵路线来影响俄国战局。你必须在今年秋季英国大批增援抵达之前夺取中东的众多目标，否则一切战果都可能丧失。无论如何，我们期望你最迟于11月15日夺取各项目标。

src: It is time for you to teach the British a lesson in desert warfare. You are to take all of your objectives, including Tobruk and Mersah Matruh, and thus clear the road to Cairo by June 30th. Earlier success could prove decisive, as the British presence on Malta is likely to make our supply situation in North Africa increasingly precarious.
dst: 现在是你给英国人上一堂沙漠战课的时候了。你须夺取包括托布鲁克与马特鲁港在内的所有目标，从而在6月30日前打通通往开罗的道路。更早取得成功可能具有决定性意义，因为英军在马耳他的存在很可能使我军在北非的补给状况日益岌岌可危。

src: It is very dangerous situation. Wager on ony our military art.
dst: 形势极为凶险。把胜负寄托于我们的用兵之道吧。

src: It is very sad, but may be we can win the war without him..
dst: 这非常令人悲痛，但也许我们没有他也能赢得这场战争……

src: It is with a heavy heart that I report of your General's death and of great losses sustained by your nation's people.
dst: 我怀着沉重的心情报告，你们的将军阵亡了，贵国人民也蒙受了重大损失。

src: It is with great sadness that I must tell you the commander of the 22 nd Pz has died
dst: 我非常悲痛地必须告诉您，第22装甲师师长已经阵亡

src: It is your choice to either take this unique chance to reach the Suez now or improve your supply situation and make a better prepared dash to the Suez later this month.
dst: 你可以选择现在就抓住这一独特机会冲向苏伊士，或者改善补给状况，本月晚些时候更有准备地冲向苏伊士。

src: It might be that we have to give up Gettysburg for the moment and to reconquer it later....
dst: 我们可能不得不暂时放弃葛底斯堡，日后再将其夺回……

src: It seems Mussilini is privately dissappointed despite his public declarations of victory.
dst: 尽管墨索里尼公开宣布胜利，他私下似乎很失望。

src: It seems a pitched battle would take no good end. Will you succeed the outbreak and retreat over the mountains ???
dst: 看来一场阵地战不会有好结果。你能成功突围、翻山撤退吗？？？

src: It seems like Soviet thrown one or two tank divisions against our sector, with a support of self-propelled artillery and heavy tank destroyers. They are determined to break through and won't crack easily. Luftwaffe lost local air superiority and you will lack any significant support. At least Soviet reserves are weak, but this in fact means that everything they got is just steamrolling its way towards you.
dst: 苏军似乎向我防区投入了一两个坦克师，配以自行火炮和重型坦克歼击车支援。他们决意突破，不会轻易动摇。德国空军已失去局部制空权，你将缺乏任何有力支援。所幸苏军预备队薄弱，但这实际上意味着——他们所有的兵力正势不可挡地向你压来。

src: It seems that the Russians are as good as defeated! Moscow has fallen, the Japanese have occupied Krasnoyarsk and a continuous front line exists no more in large parts! The Soviet leadership fled to Arkhangelsk in the north - this event is a sign that the enemy sees the areas behind the Ural as already lost and that organized resistance does not exist there. 2000 km are currently between the Japanese troops and us. Our aim is now to overcome this distance quickly.
dst: 看来俄国人已几乎被打败！莫斯科已陷落，日本人已占领克拉斯诺亚尔斯克，大片地区已不存在连贯的战线！苏联领导层逃往北方的阿尔汉格尔斯克——这一事件表明，敌人已把乌拉尔以东的地区视为丧失，那里不再存在有组织的抵抗。目前日军与我军之间相距2000公里。我们现在的目标就是迅速跨越这段距离。

src: It seems that the heavy losses of the Italian fleet will cost us. Move immediately with your destroyers, Friesenland  and some marines to retake the island. You should act immediately. If you want to deploy all your planes you must repair the airfield.
dst: 看来意大利舰队的惨重损失要让我们付出代价了。立即率领你的驱逐舰、Friesenland和一些陆战队夺回该岛。你应当立即行动。如果你想部署所有飞机，就必须修复机场。

src: It seems that your Orient-Korps has arrived just in time! Just two weeks ago the British routed the Ottoman armies at Megiddo, and all the front line collapsed. Amman and Damaskus have fallen, as well as Beirut. Three days ago a French naval division disembarked in that town, and soon afterwards they linked with the British XXI Corps.
dst: 看来您的东方军团来得正是时候！就在两周前，英国人在米吉多击溃了奥斯曼军队，整条战线随之崩溃。安曼和大马士革已经陷落，贝鲁特也是如此。三天前，一个法国海军师在那座城市登陆，随后不久便与英国XXI军会合。

src: It seems the Germans have reached the North Sea at Abbeville cutting the Allied armies in two. We are now isolated from our supply lines. The battle of the North has started.
dst: 看来德军已抵达阿布维尔的北海之滨，把盟军一分为二。我们现在与补给线隔绝。北方之战已经开始。

src: It seems the royal family and the war cabinet left London and fleed to Liverpool. There are rumors about submarines load with gold and secret passangers.
dst: 看来王室和战时内阁已离开伦敦，逃到了利物浦。有传言说，有些潜艇满载黄金和秘密乘客。

src: It should be a walk, after our immense artillery preparation.
dst: 在我们如此猛烈的炮火准备之后，这应该易如反掌。

src: It shouldn't take too long to charge, so we should be back home soon, Commander.
dst: 充电应该花不了太久，所以我们很快就能回家了，指挥官。

src: It took half a century that an enemy,  the Visigoth Alaric,  again stood an enemy army before Rome.
dst: 此后过了半个世纪，才有敌人——西哥特人阿拉里克——再次把军队带到罗马城前。

src: It took quite some effort, but the bolshevik bidgehead has been crushed. Unfortunately Soviet forces have crossed the Mius at multiple other locations. Kharkov is now under severe Soviet pressure. Send your troops to the Kharkov area to safeguard the city.
dst: 费了不少力气，布尔什维克的桥头堡终于被粉碎。遗憾的是，苏军已在米乌斯河其他多处地点渡河。哈尔科夫如今承受着苏军的沉重压力。把你的部队派往哈尔科夫地区，保卫该城。

src: It took several more days before the division was combat ready again. And even then - contrary to the 2nd and 9th Kavallerie Divisions in the Korps - it was kept away from the front line.
dst: 又过了好几天，该师才重新具备战斗力。而且即使在那之后——与军中第二、第九骑兵师不同——它仍被安排远离前线。

src: It turned out that there was no second Belgian sortie from Antwerp. Our troops did however suffer heavy losses caused by shelling from a Belgian light armoured train and by the Belgian fortresses South of Antwerp that saw our troops move in range of their guns.
dst: 结果表明，比利时人并没有从安特卫普发动第二次出击。不过，我们的部队确实遭受了惨重的损失，这些损失来自一辆比利时轻型装甲列车的炮击，以及安特卫普以南那些看到我军进入其火炮射程的比利时要塞。

src: It turned out that there was no second Belgian sortie from Antwerp. Our troops did however suffer losses caused by shelling from a Belgian light armoured train and by the Belgian fortresses South of Antwerp that saw our troops move in range of their guns.
dst: 结果表明，比利时人并没有从安特卫普发动第二次出击。不过，我们的部队确实遭受了损失，这些损失来自一辆比利时轻型装甲列车的炮击，以及安特卫普以南那些看到我军进入其火炮射程的比利时要塞。

src: It was a bittersweet ending. We were on the winner's side, but I'm still sorry about my defeat at Massawa. I wish I had been able to win that battle. It's a thorn that will rip my flesh until the day I die.
dst: 这是一个苦乐参半的结局。我们站在了胜利者一边，但我仍为马萨瓦之败而抱憾。我真希望自己能打赢那一仗。那是一根刺，将一直撕裂我的皮肉，直到我死的那一天。

src: It was a close thing no?!  Mussilini has decided your next assignment is to lead our forces going to Russia.
dst: 真是险啊，不是吗？！墨索里尼已决定，你的下一个任务是率领我军前往俄国。

src: It was a daring plan, and it needed to be perfectly executed if we were to have any chances of success. As the beginning of the offensive came close, I was overwhelmed by anxiety. I knew that this would be our last chance. If we let the Soviets live to fight another day, they would attack again soon, stronger that ever. And if that moment came, we'd have nothing left to defend ourselves.
dst: 这是一个大胆的计划，要想有任何成功的希望，就必须执行得完美无缺。随着攻势临近，我忧心如焚。我知道这将是我们最后的机会。如果我们让苏维埃活下来改日再战，他们很快就会以更强大的姿态卷土重来。而一旦那一刻来临，我们就再无任何东西可以自卫了。

src: It was a hard battle, but in the end, the victory was ours. Many Mahdists were killed, and the rest fled for their lives to Kassala, in Sudanese territory. The invasion was over, and Ethiopia would be calm for a while.
dst: 这是一场艰苦的战斗，但最终胜利属于我们。许多马赫迪分子被击毙，其余的人逃命至苏丹境内的卡萨拉。入侵结束了，埃塞俄比亚将会安宁一段时间。

src: It was a regretful, although minor, incident, but Italy immediately saw it as a golden opportunity to avenge its defeat at Adwa and annex Ethiopia once and for all. The Italians thought that, since they were part of the Entente powers, the British would be forced to support them, tacitly at least. And they were right.
dst: 这虽然只是一起令人遗憾的小事件，但意大利立刻把它视为一雪阿杜瓦之耻、一劳永逸吞并埃塞俄比亚的天赐良机。意大利人认为，既然自己是协约国的一员，英国就不得不支持他们，至少也会默许。而他们想得没错。

src: It was accepted to convert the vehicle into a self-propelled gun by using the captured 76.2mm artillery pieces and armour plates of the captured T-26 and T-60 tanks.
dst: 最终决定将该车改装为自行火炮，采用缴获的76.2毫米火炮，并取材于缴获的T-26与T-60坦克的装甲板。

src: It was as we thought it would happen. After London was cut off and the Midlands occupied, the English government surrendered! Just listen to that swine Churchill proclaiming defeat! [Churchill speaking]
dst: 一切如我们所料。伦敦被切断、中部地区被占领后，英国政府投降了！听听那头猪丘吉尔如何宣告失败！[丘吉尔讲话]

src: It was bad enough that our offensive in the Dardanelles stalled, but when last week Bulgaria finally decided to side with the Central Powers, our position in the Eastern Mediterranean became really dangerous.
dst: 我们在达达尼尔海峡的攻势陷入僵局已经够糟了，而上周保加利亚最终决定倒向同盟国后，我们在地中海东部的处境变得真正危险起来。

src: It was clear from the start that breaking through the line at El Alamein was going to be near imposible. Our absolute last reserves and the first troops of the 164Le division arriving at the front where required to counter the arrival of the 9th Australian Division and its attacks out of the El Alamein box. If it wasn't for the 164Le, we'd be back in the Cyrenaica by now.
dst: 突破阿拉曼防线近乎不可能，这一点从一开始就很清楚。我们最后的一点预备队和第164轻装师的首批部队抵达前线，正是为了应对澳大利亚第9师的到来及其从阿拉曼支撑点发起的进攻。要不是第164轻装师，我们现在早就退回昔兰尼加了。

src: It was decied that the 1st Czechoslovak Brigade will be enhanced to the 1st Czechoslovak Army Corps. We'll meet again at the Dukla Pass...
dst: 决定将捷克斯洛伐克第1旅扩编为捷克斯洛伐克第1军。我们将在杜克拉山口再见……

src: It was definirly right to honor you with the soviet medal. The German divisions in the pocket have surrendered after fighting a few days. The war is over! Hitler has withdrawed the last German armys.
dst: 授予你苏联勋章肯定是正确的。口袋中的德国师在战斗数日后投降了。战争结束了！希特勒已撤走了最后几支德国集团军。

src: It was frustrating, and Kolchak was furious, but there was nothing that we could do. Denikin had refused to acknowledge Kolchak as the supreme leader of the anti-Bolsheviks, and he didn't accept his orders.
dst: 这令人沮丧，高尔察克也很愤怒，但我们无能为力。邓尼金拒绝承认高尔察克是反布尔什维克力量的最高领袖，也不接受他的命令。

src: It was hoped that you would once again snatch victory from defeat. But it was not to be. The Wehrmacht is a spent force, unable even to slow the Russian Bear.  I advise you to fight your way to the west, Herr General. The Reds are not known for their hospitality to guests
dst: 人们本以为你能再一次从失败中夺取胜利。但事与愿违。国防军已是一支精疲力竭的力量，甚至连拖慢那头俄国熊都做不到。我建议你向西杀出一条血路，将军阁下。红军对客人可没什么好客的名声

src: It was hoped that you would once again snatch victory from defeat. But it was not to be. The Wehrmacht is a spent force, unable even to slow the Russian Bear.  I advise you to fight your way to the west, Herr General. The Reds are not known for their hospitality to guests.
dst: 我们曾指望你再次从失败中夺回胜利。但事与愿违。国防军已成强弩之末，连迟滞俄国熊都做不到。我建议你且战且向西，将军阁下。赤俄向来对来客不甚好客。

src: It was impossible. The Germans had very good defensive positions, and they resisted all our attacks. To make things even worse, our intelligence reports confirm that fresh enemy troops will launch a counterattack in a few hours, and the Russians have already exhausted their reserves. We'll have to cancel the offensive and retreat in order to our trenches.
dst: 这是不可能的。德军拥有极好的防御阵地，他们顶住了我们所有的进攻。更糟的是，我们的情报报告证实，几小时后敌军生力部队将发起反攻，而俄军的预备队已经耗尽。我们只得取消攻势，撤退回我们的战壕。

src: It was incredible. We could rescue Kolchak and most of us crossed the Baikal and arrived safely in Chita. Unfortunately, not everyone did it. Thousands of people, including women and children, died along the way. We didn't have time, strength or resources to bury them, so we left them in the places where they fell. Actually, sometimes they didn't fall. They froze to death while they were standing, and they remained there, as ice statues on the snow, until the spring came and the waters of the lake swallowed them.
dst: 这真不可思议。我们救出了高尔察克，我们大多数人渡过了贝加尔湖，安全抵达赤塔。不幸的是，并非人人都做到了。成千上万的人——包括妇女和儿童——死在途中。我们没有时间、力气或资源埋葬他们，就把他们留在倒下的地方。实际上，有时他们并没有倒下。他们站着就被冻死了，就这样留在那里，像雪地上的冰雕，直到春天来临，湖水将他们吞没。

src: It was lucky for us that the Italian politicians were incompetent fools. They wanted a quick, big and nice military victory, so they rejected Baratieri's plan and forced him to advance towards Adwa, where Menelik was staying. It was just in time, because our army only had supplies for another three of four days, at best.
dst: 对我们而言幸运的是，意大利的政客们是一群无能的蠢货。他们想要一场迅速、宏大而又漂亮的军事胜利，于是否定了巴拉蒂耶里的计划，迫使他向孟尼利克所在的阿杜瓦挺进。这来得正是时候，因为我军的补给顶多只够再维持三四天了。

src: It was not of the Legion's wishes to mix itself into any Russian internal affairs but local Soviet authorities were sometimes acting on their own good. The relation between the Soviets and Czechs was tense. So on 14 May 1918 the units of the Legion arrived in Tsjeljabinsk, east of the Ural mountains, where a train with Hungarian prisoners of war which were returning to Austria-Hungary in accordance with the Brest-Litovsk treaty. At Tsjeljabinsk an incident between a number of Czechs and Hungarians took place after which the local Soviet authority imprisoned a number of Czechs. Trotsky ordered to disarm the Legion which was sufficient for the Legion's commanders to take their faith into their own hands.
dst: 军团本不愿卷入俄国的任何内部事务，但当地的苏维埃当局有时会自行其是。苏维埃与捷克人之间的关系很紧张。于是，1918年5月14日，军团各部抵达乌拉尔山脉以东的车里雅宾斯克，那里有一列载着匈牙利战俘的火车，这些战俘正依照《布列斯特-立托夫斯克条约》返回奥匈帝国。在车里雅宾斯克，一些捷克人与匈牙利人之间发生了冲突，此后当地苏维埃当局关押了一些捷克人。托洛茨基下令解除军团的武装，这足以让军团指挥官们把命运掌握在自己手中。

src: It was something Ilse had told Herself she would not do.The plans the War Cabinet had made would be followed to the letter.Joseph Stalin's attacks around Leningrad now meant Ilse would have to adapt." I have made a error in My judgement of the Russians capabilities" She informed the War Cabinet.SS Frau General Lotte Renveldt was ordered to relenquish the 36th SS Panzers,they would aid the Leningrad forces.Renveldt was pissed of course and filed a complaint to the Fuhress which stated "remember Your arrogance in the meeting at Munich.You said it would only take a few months and the Soviets would be running for their lives.Your overdue My Fuhress.My accomplishments which are Historical here in the Center have been because of the Panzers,the 34th and 36th.Take half of that away and the Center will be as Lenningrad except I cannot hold the immense terroritory I have captured. The Soviets will surely see the empty spaces and flood through.In time We will be chewed to pieces running around as 'Fire Brigades'.I feel You Meine Fuhress have made a grave Mistake.One last thing, enjoy the Soviet Hordes in Berlin for I will be long Dead".The reply from the Fuhress " You forget Our Trump Card Frau Renveldt,the Air Korps".
dst: 这是伊尔泽曾对自己说过不会做的事。战时内阁定下的计划本应被逐字执行。但约瑟夫·斯大林在列宁格勒周边的进攻，如今意味着伊尔泽必须变通。“我对俄国人能力的判断出了错。”她向战时内阁通报。党卫军洛特·伦费尔特女将军奉命交出党卫军第36装甲师，它将去支援列宁格勒的部队。伦费尔特自然恼怒，向女元首递交了一份申诉：“还记得您在慕尼黑会议上的傲慢吗。您说只要几个月，苏联人就会仓皇逃命。女元首，您逾期了。我在中部这里堪称历史性的战功，靠的是装甲部队——第34和第36师。拿走一半，中部就会变成另一个列宁格勒，只不过我守不住我已经夺取的这片辽阔领土。苏联人肯定会看到这些空虚地带，然后蜂拥而入。到时候我们会被当作‘消防队’四处奔波、被啃成碎片。我觉得您，我的女元首，犯了一个严重的错误。最后一件事：好好享受在柏林的苏联人潮吧，因为我早就死了。”女元首的回复：“你忘了我们的王牌，伦费尔特女士——航空军。”

src: It was the first time that the Romans subdued a foreign nation to gain forever ground beyond the old boundary of the Latin landscape, north of the Tiber.....
dst: 这是罗马人第一次征服一个外族，以求永远取得拉丁地区旧边界之外、台伯河以北的土地.....

src: It was then when we knew that, just the day before, a multi-national relief force, commanded by Admiral Seymour, was heading to Peking to liberate the foreign legations and crush the uprising of the Yihetuan. Although I understood the reasons behind that decision, that was an act of war against the country that I had been serving for more that 15 years, so I sent my troops to stop Seymour. As much as I despised the Yihetuan, my duty was to defend China against the foreign enemies.
dst: 那时我们才得知，就在前一天，一支由西摩海军上将指挥的多国救援部队正赶往北京，以解救各国使馆并镇压义和团起义。尽管我理解这一决定背后的原因，但这却是一个针对我为之效力了十五年之久的国家的战争行为，因此我派兵去阻止西摩。尽管我极其鄙视义和团，我的职责却是保卫中国、抵御外敌。

src: It was too much for the 'Le Grande Armee and eveyone knew it.The fall of Paris,the Sky owned by the SS/BdM Flyers and England calling all forces out of Western Europe.The Worlds finest Armee in most Eyes had been beaten by a bunch of 'Fraus.How could it be the French soldier asked himself.It was over as the SS put a chase on the last major forces running from Paris.And a massive pitiful sight it was.The soldiers were hungry,tired and knew the end was at hand.A few last stands would be made here and there for the sake of the Civilians trying to escape to embark to places around the World,anywhere the SS wasn't.And those Civilians who would arrive in Amerika would tell the stories of horror but would not be taken seriously. "No-one could be that Evil" would be the statements.And ILse was being  crowned the Top Female tactician of All Time for leading the SS to victory over the Worlds finest Armee which was now upstaged by the SS/BdM.And more Women would look towards the 'Frauland to fight for the Fuhress.And in Berlin with Western Europe in Her hands which way would the Fuhress gaze now,towards England which was drying up because of the Convoys being slaughtered or the vast land to the East,Russia?That was where the Largest Army in the World was wasn't it!
dst: 对“大军团”来说这太过沉重，所有人都心知肚明。巴黎陷落，天空归党卫军/BdM 的飞行员所有，英格兰召回了西欧的所有部队。在大多数人眼里世界上最精锐的军队，竟被一群“女士”打败了。法国士兵自问，这怎么可能。当党卫军开始追击从巴黎出逃的最后几支主力时，一切都结束了。那是一幅浩大而可悲的景象。士兵们又饿又累，知道末日已至。为了那些试图逃往世界各地——任何党卫军不在的地方——登船离去的平民，这里那里还会有人做最后的坚守。而那些抵达美国的平民会讲述那些恐怖的故事，却不会被人当真。人们会说：“没人能邪恶到那种地步。”而伊尔泽正被加冕为史上最杰出的女性战术家，因为她率领党卫军战胜了世界上最精锐的军队——如今这支军队已被党卫军/BdM 比了下去。会有更多女性投向“女性之国”，为女元首而战。而在柏林，西欧已在手中，这位女元首如今会望向何方——是船队被屠戮、正日渐枯竭的英格兰，还是东方那片辽阔的土地，俄国？那不就是世界上最庞大的军队所在的地方吗！

src: It wasn't just because we had lost the civil war. It was more than that. I had lost everything that I held dear: my country, my loved ones, my sovereign. In one word, my identity. I had lost my purpose in life.
dst: 这并不仅仅因为我们输掉了内战。远不止于此。我失去了我所珍视的一切：我的祖国、我的亲人、我的君主。一言以蔽之，我的身份。我失去了生活的目标。

src: It will be basically a naval campaign, with ships, marines and elite inf units at the begin. Some missions will be only naval battles, some maybe only with marines.
dst: 这基本上会是一场海战战役，开局时拥有军舰、海军陆战队和精锐步兵单位。有些任务只会有海战，有些则可能只有海军陆战队。

src: It will be our first offensive against the Germans since 1915. But, wait...Silence!
dst: 这将是我们自1915年以来首次对德军发起攻势。但是，等等……安静！

src: It will take some time for me to rebuild my Spanish Legions to honor my promise to support Italy in future campaigns.
dst: 我需要一些时间来重建我的西班牙军团，才能兑现我在未来战役中支持意大利的承诺。

src: It won't be easy, the nationalists still have good units with good equipment, but we count on your elite units to deal with the Kuomingtan troops. The planned Summer Offensive must be victorious.
dst: 这不会容易，国民政府仍拥有装备精良的精锐部队，但我们指望用你的精锐部队来对付国民党军队。计划中的夏季攻势必须获胜。

src: It won't be long until we can meet again. Hopefully, just a few months. I miss all of you very much, but I must still  be patient. Don't forget to tell Yuri and the girls that his father thinks about them every day. Tell them how we're fighting for our country, and for their future.
dst: 我们很快就能再见面了。但愿只需再等几个月。我非常想念你们所有人，但我还必须保持耐心。别忘了告诉尤里和女儿们，他们的父亲每天都在思念他们。告诉他们，我们如何为祖国、为他们的未来而战。

src: It worked! While your attack across the Oder sucked away Russian forces, several panzer corps have marched on Posen and encircled Zjoekov's White Russian front with half a million soldiers!
dst: 成功了！当您横渡奥得河的进攻吸走俄军兵力之时，数个装甲军已向波兹南进军，将朱可夫的白俄罗斯方面军连同五十万士兵一起包围了！

src: It would be best to retreat across the Seine, but the Fuehrer has ordered that we have to take a stand here as long as possible.
dst: 最好是退过塞纳河，但元首已下令我们必须在此地尽可能长久地坚守。

src: It would have been nice to see our new armoured vehicles fighting, but they didn’t arrive in time for the battle. They aren’t easy to deploy, and most of the time they don't see any action. Maybe they could be more useful in other parts of Europe. In fact, the Russians have showed some interest in them.
dst: 本来能看到我们新式装甲车参战会很好，但它们没能及时抵达战场。它们不容易部署，多数时候根本没参与任何战斗。也许它们在欧洲其他地方会更有用。事实上，俄国人已对它们表现出一些兴趣。

src: It wouldn't have happened without you. You've been our best commander, by far. You've played a large part in this victory. We all thank you for that. And now, it's time to rebuild the Empire. We'll need good statesmen for that. And, you know? You could teach them a couple of things. In fact, there is a rumour that, very soon, the Kaiser will ask you to do exactly that.
dst: 没有您，这一切就不可能发生。您是我们迄今最优秀的指挥官。在这场胜利中，您发挥了巨大的作用。我们都为此感谢您。而现在，是时候重建帝国了。这需要优秀的政治家。而且，您知道吗？您或许能教他们一两手。事实上，有传闻说，皇帝很快就要请您去做这件事了。

src: It's a pity that we couldn't convince Bulgaria to join our side. They have a big and experienced army, with good officers, although with outdated equipment. They would have been excellent allies, but Serbia's intransigency ruined all our negotiation attempts.
dst: 很遗憾我们没能说服保加利亚加入我们这边。他们有一支庞大而有经验的军队，军官优秀，尽管装备过时。他们本会是极好的盟友，但塞尔维亚的顽固不化毁了我们所有的谈判努力。

src: It's a pity that you got ill due to the unhealthy conditions of the trenches. Fortunately we were able to retreat to safer positions in the rear. As for you, you'll have an opportunity to overcome our enemies at the Crna Valley.
dst: 很遗憾，由于战壕恶劣的卫生条件，您病倒了。所幸我们得以撤退到后方更安全的阵地。至于您，您将有机会在茨尔纳河谷战胜我们的敌人。

src: It's a shame that not all of your divisions where send to Sicily straight away. Now fortifications are not as good as they could have been, but I hope they will help somewhat. Reports indicate a large invasion is taking place, in view of our supply situation you are to attack as soon as possible.
dst: 遗憾的是并非您所有师都立即被派往西西里。如今工事不如本可建成的那样坚固，但我希望它们多少能派上用场。报告显示一场大规模登陆正在进行，鉴于我方补给状况，您须尽快发起进攻。

src: It's amazing how fast the course of the war has improved for our country in just a few months. With Pétain  in charge, all the senseless operations have come to an end. He has agreed, in practice, to most of the demands of our troops, although at the same time he has punished some dangerous individuals who, under the proper circumstances, could have brought anarchy and chaos to France, just like it's happening in Russia.
dst: 短短几个月内，战局对我们国家就变得大为好转，实在令人惊叹。在贝当的主持下，所有毫无意义的行动都告一段落。他实际上同意了部队的大部分要求，尽管与此同时，他也惩处了一些危险分子，这些人在适当的条件下，本会给法国带来无政府状态和混乱，就像正在俄国发生的那样。

src: It's an honor to meet such a worthy adversary. However, it's time for you and your men to surrender to the Royal Greek Army. You must accept your defeat.
dst: 能遇到这样一位可敬的对手是我的荣幸。然而，是您和您的士兵向希腊王家军队投降的时候了。您必须接受失败。

src: It's an honor to meet such a worthy adversary. However, it's time for you and your men to surrender to the Royal Serbian Army. You must accept your defeat.
dst: 能遇到这样一位可敬的对手是我的荣幸。然而，是您和您的士兵向塞尔维亚王家军队投降的时候了。您必须接受失败。

src: It's been a long time since 1906, isn't it? Twenty years! Lots of things have happened in these turbulent times. Let me tell you that I'm sorry about all the troubles that have happened in England. The British Revolution was an absolute tragedy. Thank God that you managed to leave the country.
dst: 自1906年以来已经过了很久，不是吗？二十年了！在这动荡的岁月里发生了太多事情。请允许我说，我对英格兰发生的种种动乱深感遗憾。英国革命是一场彻头彻尾的悲剧。谢天谢地，您设法离开了那个国家。

src: It's been a nice victory, but now we know that Villa had just left Guerrero when we arrived there. Never mind. He has lost many men, including his friend Hernández. I don't know if we'll ever be so close to get him again, but at the very least we'll force him to run and hide. Carranza will consolidate his power knowing that Villa won't be an important threat anymore.
dst: 这是一场漂亮的胜利，但如今我们知道，我们抵达时比利亚刚刚离开格雷罗。没关系。他折损了许多手下，包括他的好友埃尔南德斯。我不知道我们是否还能如此接近地抓到他，但至少我们会逼得他东躲西藏。卡兰萨将巩固其权力，因为他知道比利亚不会再构成重大威胁。

src: It's been an honor serving with you Commander.
dst: 能与你共事是我的荣幸，指挥官。

src: It's been close, but you finally led your troops to victory! The surviving Greeks are leaving their positions, deserting and running for their lives, trying to get to Izmir and return to their country. Before this year ends, all the foreign invaders will be expelled from Turkey, and after four years we'll finally have, again, a nation of our own.
dst: 战局一度十分胶着，但您最终率领部队取得了胜利！幸存的希腊人正离开阵地，弃械逃命，试图逃往伊兹密尔并返回自己的国家。今年年底前，所有外国入侵者都将被逐出土耳其，四年之后，我们终将再次拥有一个属于自己的国家。

src: It's been decided that while the Bulgarians and the Austro-Hungarians attack the Greek-British forces at the Doiran Lake you'll lead the main attack against the Franco-Serbian sector in Bitola. If, employing our infiltration tactics, you manage to break through the enemy lines the road to Athen will be open for your troops.
dst: 已经决定，趁保加利亚人和奥匈军队在多伊兰湖进攻希英联军之际，您将在比托拉指挥对法塞防区的主攻。如果您运用我们的渗透战术突破敌军防线，通往雅典的道路就将为您的部队敞开。

src: It's been ten years since then. Now I'm an old man, adopted by the Ethiopian nobility. My sons and daughters are part of the Ethiopian aristocracy. Did you know that Daniel, my oldest son, fought at Adwa when he was only sixteen years old? Later, I sent him to the military academy of Toledo, in Spain. He was the first Ethiopian who graduated from a European officer school. Now he's part of the Ethiopian legation that is negotiating in Russia the acquisition of modern military equipment. Well, I guess that now he and his siblings must find their place in life. I've already found mine, in a country that I could never have imagined, but now all that's left for me to do is living my final years happily and peacefully, surrounded by my loved ones.
dst: 自那以后已经过去了十年。如今我已是个老人，被埃塞俄比亚贵族所接纳。我的儿女们已是埃塞俄比亚贵族的一员。您知道吗，我的长子丹尼尔十六岁就参加了阿杜瓦战役？后来，我把他送进了西班牙托莱多的军事学院。他是第一位从欧洲军官学校毕业的埃塞俄比亚人。现在他是埃塞俄比亚公使馆的一员，正在俄国谈判采购现代军事装备。嗯，我想如今他和他的兄弟姐妹们必须找到自己在生活中的位置。我已经找到了我的位置，在一个我做梦也想不到的国家，而现在我唯一要做的，就是在挚爱亲人的围绕下，安详而平静地度过余生。

src: It's difficult to describe the excitement that I felt when we approached the villages where my father had fought against the Egyptians, so many years ago. Adi Quala and Gura were within reach, and I promised myself that, this time, we would remain here forever.
dst: 当我们逼近那些多年前先父曾与埃及人交战的村庄时，我内心的激动难以言表。阿迪夸拉和古拉近在咫尺，我向自己发誓，这一次我们将永远留在这里。

src: It's imperative you take Bilbao as soon as possible.  I know if the Vizcayan capital falls the Basque nationalist battalions will surrender.  The Republicans think they are safe behind those bunkers around Bilbao, the ''Cinturon de Hierro'', but that's just a myth!  The engineer who designed the fortified line, Alejandro Goicoechea, is now on our side. Thanks to him, we have all the blueprints of the bunkers.  Only about 40 percent of the lines were completed and the most important thing is we know where the weak points are.
dst: 您必须尽快夺取毕尔巴鄂，这一点至关重要。我知道，一旦比斯开首府陷落，巴斯克民族主义各营就会投降。共和派以为他们躲在毕尔巴鄂周边那些掩体后面很安全，那道「铁环防线」，但那只是个神话！设计这条筑垒线的工程师亚历杭德罗·戈伊科埃切亚现在站在我们这边。多亏了他，我们掌握了这些掩体的全部图纸。整条防线只完成了约百分之四十，而最重要的是我们知道薄弱点在哪里。

src: It's incredible. They've attacked at the worst possible moment for us, and they're succeeding. Our 6th Army is on the brink of defeat, and I'm afraid that it will be on the retreat soon.
dst: 真是难以置信。他们在对我们最不利的时刻发动了进攻，而且正在得手。我们的第6集团军濒临失败，我担心它很快就会撤退。

src: It's obvious that we aren't going to get any help from France or Britain. In a few weeks the fortress will fall, and our army will be forced to retire.
dst: 很明显，我们不会从法国或英国得到任何帮助。几周之内，要塞就会陷落，我军将被迫撤退。

src: It's over, General! The war with Italy is over! The Germans have announced that the Italian government will unconditionally surrender to them. With most of their army pinned in Venedig, and France and Britain bleeding themselves to death in Belgium, the Italians understand that they won't receive any help before we conquer Rom. Any further resistance on their part will just worsen their situation.
dst: 结束了，将军！与意大利的战争结束了！德国人已经宣布，意大利政府将向他们无条件投降。他们的大部分军队被牵制在威尼斯，而法国和英国又在比利时流尽鲜血，意大利人明白，在我们攻下罗马之前，他们得不到任何援助。他们再作任何抵抗，都只会让自己的处境更加恶化。

src: It's pretty hot here in Spain. We've undertook our first mission yesterday, and now I finally have time, will and patience to write you a letter. It'll be very chaotic writing, but veterans advised us that it's much better to write it all right now, before our minds process their own pictures of what happened.
dst: 西班牙这边相当炎热。我们昨天执行了第一次任务，现在终于有时间、有意愿、也有耐心给你写封信了。这封信会写得很乱，但老兵们劝我们，最好现在就把它写下来，赶在我们的大脑自己处理出那些画面的样子之前。

src: It's sad to admit it, but we chose the losing side on this war. The Ottoman and Austro-Hungarian empires are disintegrating, and Germany will be forced to surrender in a matter of weeks. The morale of our soldiers and our citizens is at its lowest, and they become an easy prey for the bolshevik propaganda, specially after the reds took over Russia in 1917. And let's not forget that Greece finally declared war on us on June 1917.
dst: 虽然不愿承认，但我们在这场战争中站错了队。奥斯曼帝国和奥匈帝国正在土崩瓦解，德国也将在数周内被迫投降。我们的士兵和国民士气跌到了最低点，尤其是在红军1917年夺取俄国政权之后，他们极易沦为布尔什维克宣传的猎物。别忘了，希腊最终于1917年6月向我们宣战了。

src: It's time for you to intervene! Gather your troops, repel the British attack and inflict them as many casualties as you can.
dst: 轮到您出手了！集结您的部队，击退英军进攻，并尽可能多地杀伤他们。

src: It's time to go back to Seoul.  We have deployed a large number of PLA and KPA units Northwards toward Seoul and with your armies nothing will stop us in our drive.  The South Korean capital must be in our hands again.
dst: 是时候重返汉城了。我们已把大量解放军和朝鲜人民军部队向北部署，直指汉城，有你的部队，我们的推进将无可阻挡。韩国首都必须再次回到我们手中。

src: It's time to go back to our starting positions. It doesn't matter. We'll use the next weeks to reorganize our army and then we'll try again. The Rasova-Kobadin-Tuzla line will fall before the end of the year, be sure of that.
dst: 是时候撤回我们的出发阵地了。这没什么。我们将利用接下来几周重整军队，然后再试一次。拉索瓦—科巴丁—图兹拉防线必将在年底前崩溃，请放心。

src: It's time to organize our final offensive and march towards Madrid. But first it is essential to ensure our rear. Your next goal will be Santoña.
dst: 是时候组织我们的最后攻势，向马德里进军了。但首先必须确保我们的后方安全。您的下一个目标将是桑托尼亚。

src: It's time to recover our country. After the battle of Sakarya, the Grand National Assembly has made agreements with France, Italy, and the Soviet Union. Most of our enemies are tired of this war, and are willing to leave us alone. Only the British still support the Greek invaders, but they won't risk the lives of their own soldiers.
dst: 是时候收复我们的国家了。萨卡里亚战役之后，大国民议会已与法国、意大利和苏联达成协议。我们的敌人大多已厌倦这场战争，愿意不再干涉我们。只有英国仍支持希腊入侵者，但他们不愿拿自己士兵的性命冒险。

src: It's time to resume our offensive in Kobadin. This time Generalfeldmarschall Mackensen has decided that the German troops and our cavalry division, placed in the Eastern sector, will make the main attack and you, commanding the Western sector, will support them. Your mission is to attack the positions of the Russian 61st and 115th divisions, near Kobadin, and inflict them as many casualties as possible, so they can't send any reinforcements to the east. But be careful. The Russians are flanked by two Romanian divisions, and we know that the 3rd Siberian division, which has just arrived in Dodrudzha, is about to deploy in the area.
dst: 是时候在科巴丁恢复我们的攻势了。这一次，陆军元帅马肯森决定，部署在东段的德军和我们的骑兵师将担任主攻，而您指挥西段，负责支援他们。您的任务是进攻科巴丁附近俄军第61和第115师的阵地，尽可能多地杀伤他们，使他们无法向东线派出任何增援。但务必小心。俄军侧翼有两个罗马尼亚师掩护，而且我们得知，刚刚抵达多布罗加的第3西伯利亚师即将在该地区展开。

src: It's time! The training of the last months must pay off now. Our intelligence has done everything to make the enemy believe that our landing take place at Norfolk in the north. But even if this diversion bear fruit, it wait a difficult battle on you. The entire east coast of the United States from Maine to Florida was changed into a fortress. Your landing section is defended by two Infantry divisions, but many more are in the outback on standby. Let's hope that the enemy fails to bring these forces in time to the front.
dst: 时候到了！过去几个月的训练现在必须见效。我们的情报部门已竭尽所能，让敌人相信我们在北面的诺福克登陆。但即便这一欺敌奏效，等待着你的仍是一场硬仗。美国从缅因到佛罗里达的整条东海岸都被改造成了一座堡垒。你的登陆地段由两个步兵师防守，但还有更多部队在内陆待命。但愿敌人来不及把这些部队及时调到前线。

src: It's useless to go on with this. Go back before the German reinforcements arrive and wipe out what's left of your army.
dst: 继续下去毫无意义。在德军增援到达之前撤回去吧，免得您军队剩下的人被消灭。

src: Italia reportedly has a picture of everyone of them in the Rome catherdral, praying for their safety amid this winter, it seems their prayers were answered.
dst: 据说意大利在罗马大教堂里挂着他们每个人的照片，为他们在寒冬中的平安祈祷，看来祈祷应验了。
意大利阿尔卑斯山 - 1917年11月25日

src: Italian planes and German Ju 88s were constantely attacking the allies and destroyer USS Maddox got sunk on the first day of Operation Husky while the Liberty Ship 'Robert Rowan' blew up in an large explosing when her cargo of ammunition got hit one day later on 11th July.

src: Italy has many dark days yet to come.
dst: 意大利还有许多黑暗的日子要熬。

src: Italy invaded Greece late last year without informing us beforehand. The Italians only managed to penetrate about 20km into the country, and were then thrown back by the Greeks! For a while, Albania was in danger of falling. Now the English have landed and that has made things worse. The situation is intolerable. General, after securing Yugoslavia, you have been chosen to lead the attack through the Thermopylae Pass, where the Greeks and British have entrenched themselves.
dst: 意大利去年年底未事先知会我们就入侵了希腊。意军仅推进了约20公里就被希腊人赶了回来！一度阿尔巴尼亚都有陷落之危。如今英军又登陆了，雪上加霜。形势令人无法容忍。将军，在确保南斯拉夫之后，你被选中率军从温泉关隘口发起进攻——希腊人和英军已在那里掘壕据守。

src: Italy is about to invade Albania. Since your formidable cooperation in Spain, you will be assigned as Liason Officer and Chief of the German military mission. Of course you are only in the area to observe the Italian maneuvers....
dst: 意大利即将入侵阿尔巴尼亚。鉴于你在西班牙的出色合作，你将被任命为联络官兼德国军事代表团团长。当然，你到那里只是为观察意大利的军事行动……

src: Italy isn't the only country that covets parts of our Empire. Now our former vassals, Serbia, Greece and Bulgaria have made an alliance for seizing our remaining provinces in Europe.
dst: 意大利并不是唯一觊觎我们帝国领土的国家。如今我们昔日的附庸——塞尔维亚、希腊和保加利亚——已结成联盟，要夺取我们在欧洲剩下的省份。

src: Italy stands a little taller today General - thank you!
dst: 意大利今天挺直了些腰杆，将军——谢谢你！

dst: 是时候为最坏的情况做准备了。攻势必须取消。不过，我们必须战斗到底，防止德国遭到入侵。

src: Japan, in a total unjustified and unprovoked attack, hit the home base of our Pacific Fleet in Pearl Harbor and captured our possessions in East India. This stab in the back from our former ally will not go unpunished! Prepare your forces!
dst: 日本以完全无端且毫无理由的袭击，打击了我们太平洋舰队在珍珠港的母港，并夺取了我们在东印度的属地。我们前盟友的这一背刺绝不会不受惩罚！准备您的部队！

Your objectives are Jerusalem and it's airstrip, The city of Jaffa in the north with it's airstrip and the railway station at Lydda.
dst: 耶路撒冷被穆斯林统治已有数百年，最高统帅部强烈渴望「解放」它。这将极大地鼓舞我军及盟友的士气。您的目标是耶路撒冷及其简易机场、北面的雅法城及其简易机场，以及利达的火车站。

src: Jerusalem is not a goal of strategic importance, but have some symbolic value. Commonwealth troops entrenched there to secure the withdrawal of their comrades to Iraq. But without tanks and adequate air support, their defense is hopeless. Take the holy city, and gather your troops after our victory on the Trans-Jordanian border!
dst: 耶路撒冷不是一个具有战略重要性的目标，但有些象征意义。英联邦部队在那里据守，以确保他们的战友撤往伊拉克。但没有坦克和足够的空中支援，他们的防御是无望的。夺取这座圣城，胜利后在约旦边境集结你的部队！
