src: John Kirkham arrived too late in Gundet, so he didn't take part in the battle. Some weeks later Yohannes sent him again as an emissary to London, but this time he was captured by the Egyptians. Showing that they were no better that the Ethiopians, the Egyptians tortured him for months, until he finally died, broken and sick.
dst: 约翰·柯卡姆赶到贡德特时已太迟，因此没有参加战斗。几周后，约翰尼斯再次派他作为使者前往伦敦，但这一次他被埃及人抓获。埃及人证明自己并不比埃塞俄比亚人好到哪里去——他们折磨了他数月，直到他最终身心俱碎、病重而死。

src: Join the Deutsches Heer in its struggle against the Entente forces. Show your enemies that the German Empire has been underestimated, and that it has the will and the skill to become the main power in Europe...and the world.
dst: 加入德意志陆军，投身于对抗协约国军队的斗争。向您的敌人证明，德意志帝国被低估了，它拥有成为欧洲……乃至世界头号强国的意志与本领。

src: Join the Imperial Japanese Army from the early years of the first conflicts in WWII.  Begin in Asia with China and Manchuria up to the jungle battles in the Pacific islands or to Burma against the Allied forces.  Your destiny as a Japanese general is not still clear.  Will you end your days fighting to save the sacred Japanese main islands or will you help establish Japan as the preeminent power in Asia?
dst: 从二战初期冲突的早期年代起加入帝国陆军。从亚洲的中国和满洲开始，直到太平洋岛屿的丛林战，或是在缅甸与盟军作战。您作为一名日本将军的命运仍未明朗。您最终会为保卫神圣的日本本土诸岛战斗到生命尽头，还是会帮助日本确立其亚洲首屈一指强国的地位？

src: Jolly good show, sir.  Despite the desperate attempts by the Italians and their Colonial allies, the advance is going swimmingly.  Further challenges await however, as the vice tightens around the Italians and their East African forces.
dst: 干得棒极了，长官。尽管意大利人和他们的殖民盟友拼命挣扎，推进依然顺风顺水。然而，随着包围圈在意大利人及其东非部队周围越收越紧，更多挑战还在前方。
约尔丹-罗兹瓦多夫斯基

src: Joseph Stalin's Armies had not shown the World much up to this point.His victories had cost Him too much men and material especially against the Finns.The 'Boss now decided to step back and evaluate the Soviet Forces which of course let Britian and France breathe a little eaiser.With this would come more purging of the Officers including a few 'Marshals of the Soviet Union.His allie the Yugoslavians attacked the Czech nation quickly over-running the Country except for the Sudetenland while Stalin sat idle.The Brits and French sent troops in from Poland as Fuhress ILse finally had to play Her hand at War knowing Stalin could not be trusted with His word "Has nothing to do with Me".So War between the Frauland and the Soviet Union was tettering to begin.At the War Cabinet meeting in Berlin the question was "If We fight the allie of Stalin surely He will respond and declare War on Us.Are We ready"? The Fuhress answered "No,We are not.But We cannot allow Stalin on Our doorstep as the Poles have and invite Him on in to take Our Reich.Stalin will die by My orders same as Hitler,His only salvation at the moment is time.We'll have to see how it goes,I believe the Girls are ready and If the Enemy wants War we'll give it to Them".
dst: 到目前为止，约瑟夫·斯大林的军队并未向世界展示多少本事。他的胜利代价太大——人员和物资，尤其在对芬兰的战争中。这位“老板”如今决定退后一步，评估苏联的军力，这自然让不列颠和法国稍稍喘了口气。随之而来的是对军官的进一步清洗，包括几位“苏联元帅”。他的盟友南斯拉夫人迅速进攻捷克，几乎占领了该国全境，只有苏台德地区除外，而斯大林袖手旁观。英法从波兰调兵进入，女元首伊尔泽终于不得不在战争中出手——她知道斯大林的话“与我无关”不可信。于是“女性之国”与苏联之间的战争一触即发。在柏林的战时内阁会议上，问题是：“如果我们打击斯大林的盟友，他必定会回应并对我们宣战。我们准备好了吗？”女元首答道：“没有，我们没准备好。但我们不能让斯大林像波兰人那样堵在我们家门口，再把他请进来夺走我们的帝国。斯大林会像希特勒一样死于我的命令，眼下唯一能救他的只有时间。只能走着瞧了，我相信姑娘们已经准备好了——如果敌人要战争，我们就给他们。”

src: Joseph Stalins new plan was making progress.No where better was the message delivered to the SS then at Stalingrad.Here the 6th SS 'Savannah had worked into the city but street fighting with support of heavy Soviet batteries from behind the Volga was taking its toll.Even the Mighty Tigers in the streets were being destroyed the Soviets taking out the protecting infantry with small groups of soldiers or the large caliber shells coming from across the Volga making the Heavy Panzer vunerable to magnetic mines and explosives.SS Frau General Savannah Michelle Armstack sent a message to Berlin. Stalingrad was a 'Rat War' and She would not have enough Fraus to man a Mobile Kitchen if things kept going the way they was.The only thing positive was the Rats would be fed with the Dead from both sides.Also reports showed the Soviets had actually let Her work Panzers into the area as part of an encirclement operation which they were about to commence.The Air-war over Stalingrad was not a forgone conclusion either according to Savannah,the Soviets showed up in Good numbers no matter how the Commanders of the Air Korps kept stating 'The BdM has Superiority'.So a call to SS/BdM AirFuhress Inga Stercghassmann from the Fuhress. Stalingrad would be taken care of and those Guns across the Volga would cease to be as well as any large troop concentrations. Armstack was informed,She was not impressed.Would She be?
dst: 约瑟夫·斯大林的新计划正在奏效。没有哪里比斯大林格勒更能说明这一讯息对党卫军的含义。在这里，党卫军第6“萨凡纳”师已攻入城内，但在伏尔加河对岸苏军重炮支援下的巷战正不断消耗着他们。就连街巷中威力无比的“虎”式也在被摧毁——苏军用小队士兵干掉掩护步兵，或用从伏尔加河对岸射来的大口径炮弹使重型坦克暴露在磁性雷和炸药之下。党卫军萨凡纳·米歇尔·阿姆斯塔克女将军向柏林发出讯息。斯大林格勒是一场“老鼠战”，若照这样下去，她连开一辆流动厨房车的“女士”都凑不齐。唯一的好消息是，老鼠们会有双方的尸体可吃。报告还显示，苏联人实际上是故意让她的装甲部队进入该地区，作为他们即将发动的一次合围行动的一部分。据萨凡纳说，斯大林格勒上空的空战也并非已成定局——不管航空军的指挥官们怎么反复宣称“BdM 拥有优势”，苏联人总以可观的规模出现。于是女元首致电党卫军/BdM 空军女元首英加·施特格哈斯曼。斯大林格勒会被收拾掉，伏尔加河对岸的那些炮，以及任何大规模的兵力集结，都将不复存在。阿姆斯塔克收到了通报，她并不以为然。她会吗？

src: June 22, 1941. The largest military operation in history begins. More than 3 million axis soldiers attack the Soviet Union. The attack was directed in three directions, each assigned to an Army Group: North, Centre and South. The operation great successes, but failed to meet its final objectives. Now it's your time to try to succeed where the Axis armies failed.
dst: 1941年6月22日。史上规模最大的军事行动开始了。300多万轴心国士兵进攻苏联。攻势沿三个方向展开，每个方向交给一个集团军群：北方、中央与南方集团军群。这次行动取得了巨大成功，却未能达成其最终目标。现在轮到你来尝试在轴心国军队失败的地方取得成功。

src: June the 21st,1943  "Alright,alright I'll do it" The Fuhress stated.She climbed up on the SS Tiger II.Into Chicago Square She rode with the crew of SS Tiger II 206 of the 1st SS PZ Gp 'Ilse,4 other Tigers II's following.The crowd of Fraus went wild,their Fuhress had arrived.SS Eradication units were taking away the Goverment and Military Leaders including FDR.To the South in the Sky a gruppen of 'Klann Ein's did a flyby.A moment in History that would never again be repeated. One Country had the World under it's thumb,the Frauland. Japan was now getting the attention of the 'Batts and as others had no answer for them.The SS Plague across the World would reduce most areas to Food production including virtually all of Amerika.Those who could not work would be Eradicated unless having a Member Card of the SS/BdM,kins and 'Special cases which Ilse had the final say in that.For those not BdM also restrictions on breeding to not burden the Germania System.The 'Gestapa's presence across the Globe would be challenged now and then but SS Security Measures would insure 'SS Order'.For 50 years SS 'Germania would rule with no real resistance.Then in early 2000 a baby would be born in Savannah Georgia.One Jess Grant Lee,and the seed for 'Germania's fall would be planted.It would take 55 years to come full Circle.The Fuhress would not see it of course having passed away in '94.
dst: 1943年6月21日  “好吧，好吧，我去。”女元首说。她爬上党卫军“虎王”坦克。她乘车驶入芝加哥广场，随行的是党卫军第1装甲群“伊尔泽”206号“虎王”的车组，后面跟着另外4辆“虎王”。“女士”们的人群沸腾了——她们的女元首到了。党卫军清剿部队正把政府和军方领导人、包括罗斯福，押走。南面的天空中，一个“克兰一号”大队飞过。这是历史上再不会被重演的一刻。一个国家把世界攥在拇指之下——“女性之国”。日本如今正遭受‘Batt 的关注，而其他国家也拿这些飞机毫无办法。席卷全球的“党卫军瘟疫”将把大部分地区降格为粮食生产区，包括几乎整个美国。那些不能劳动的人将被清除，除非持有党卫军/BdM 的“会员卡”、亲属关系，或属于“特殊情况”——而这些由伊尔泽最终裁定。非 BdM 成员还将在生育上受到限制，以免给“日耳曼尼亚”体系增添负担。盖世太保在全球的存在会时不时受到挑战，但党卫军的安全措施将确保“党卫军秩序”。此后50年，“党卫军日耳曼尼亚”将在没有真正抵抗的情况下统治。然后在2000年初，佐治亚州萨凡纳将诞生一个婴儿——杰丝·格兰特·李，‘日耳曼尼亚’衰落的种子就此埋下。它要用55年才会画完一个圆。女元首自然看不到那一天——她已于94年去世。

src: Just a few months after the battle of Gundet, the Egyptians invaded Hamasien again, this time with a much larger army. Our enemies were commanded by Mohammed Ratib Pasha, and among his officers there were a few former Confederate veterans, including General Loring.
dst: 贡代特战役之后仅仅几个月，埃及人再次入侵哈马西恩，这一次率领的军队要庞大得多。我们的敌人由穆罕默德·拉提卜帕夏指挥，在他的军官中还有几位前邦联老兵，包括洛林将军在内。

src: Just a few quick lines to let you know that I’m well and safe. Our campaign in Italy proceeds extremely well. We’re very tired, our supply lines get longer everyday, and the Italians are quickly building new, stronger defence lines. But I’m confident. Each morning I wake up with the feeling that, with one more push, the Italians will surrender, just like the Romanians did. We’ll have time to rest later, when all this mess is over.
dst: 匆匆几行，只是想让您知道我平安无事。我们在意大利的战役进展得极为顺利。我们非常疲惫，补给线一天比一天长，意大利人也在迅速构筑新的、更坚固的防线。但我信心十足。每天早晨醒来，我都有一种感觉：只要再推一把，意大利人就会像罗马尼亚人那样投降。等这一切乱局结束之后，我们有的是时间休息。

src: Just a moment Herr General, the latest reports show the Canadians have installed hidden radar bases. This could cause major problems for your troops. Your paratroopers may be required to remove these.
dst: 稍等，将军阁下，最新报告显示加拿大人修建了隐蔽的雷达基地。这可能给你的部队带来大麻烦。你的伞兵或许需要去拔除这些。

src: Just as planned, the Germans have retired to the Hindenburg Line. They won't be safe there for too long, but before breaking through their strongest defence line we must eliminate a German salient that has disrupted the communications between Nancy and Verdun since 1914.
dst: 正如计划，德军已退到兴登堡防线。他们在那里也安稳不了多久，但在突破他们最坚固的防线之前，我们必须先拔掉一个自1914年以来就切断南锡与凡尔登之间交通的德军突出部。

src: Just as we feared, our Italian allies have betrayed us. Knowing that most of our army was deployed in two different fronts, they decided to stab us in the back.
dst: 正如我们所担心的，我们的意大利盟友背叛了我们。他们知道我军大部分部署在两条不同的战线，于是决定在背后捅我们一刀。

src: Just as we feared, the British have launched a massive autum offensive near Loos, with the intention of breaking through our defences and forcing us to fight in the open. They'll stop at nothing to succeed. They're even using poisonous gas, those barbaric islanders!
dst: 正如我们担心的那样，英军在卢斯附近发动了大规模秋季攻势，意图突破我们的防御，迫使我们打野战。为了取胜他们不择手段。他们甚至动用了毒气，这些野蛮的岛民！

src: Just as we feared, the Russians surpassed the defences of Premissel, trapping more than 150,000 imperial soldiers in the fortress, that is under siege right now. Brussilow's men are marching towards the Karpaten, and it seems that they won't stop until they take Krakau.
dst: 正如我们所担心的，俄国人突破了普热梅希尔的防御，将超过15万帝国士兵困在要塞中，此刻要塞正遭围困。布鲁西洛夫的部队正向喀尔巴阡山推进，看来不拿下克拉科夫他们不会罢休。

src: Just flawless execution!  Our main landing forces in the North can count on your secured airport.  Mission accomplished!
dst: 执行得毫无瑕疵！我们在北方的主力登陆部队可以依靠您夺取的机场了。任务完成！

src: Just got word that the convoys have made it safely to Holloman, Commander.  Let's hope we can get those people back to their homes.
dst: 刚收到消息，车队已安全抵达霍洛曼，指挥官。希望我们能让那些人重返家园。

src: Just like last year, the UN forces are again encircled on the ''Pusan Perimeter''.  Now, with the bulk of the North Korean forces are guarding the rear, we can assault the enemy positions without the fear of an assault on our back like last years landings at Inch'on.
dst: 就像去年一样，联合国军再次被围困在"釜山环形防御圈"中。现在，由于朝鲜人民军主力正守卫后方，我们可以进攻敌军阵地，而不必担心像去年仁川登陆那样背后遭到袭击。

src: Just like the British did at Doiran Lake some days ago, now the French are preparing a new assault against our positions on the Crna bend. Our scouts have reported enemy movements on the mountains between the river banks, east and south of our lines of trenches, so we think that the main attacks will come from there.
dst: 正如几天前英军在多伊兰湖所做的那样，现在法国人正准备对我们的茨尔纳河湾阵地发动新的进攻。我们的侦察兵报告了敌人在河两岸之间、我军战壕线以东和以南山区的调动，因此我们认为主攻将来自那里。

src: Just like the Prussians expected, the Army of the Loire was forced to retreat. Most of the survivors went to the east and tried to lift the siege of Belfort, but two French Army Corps escaped to Le Mans, in the west. The Prussians soon chased them.
dst: 正如普鲁士人所预料的那样，卢瓦尔军团被迫撤退。大部分幸存者向东而去，试图解除贝尔福之围，但有两个法军军逃往了西面的勒芒。普鲁士人很快便追击而去。

src: Just look what happened when he was replaced on May 1st. Let's just say that Nivelle's plan for counterattacking and retaking Fort Douaumont with frontal assaults didn't go as smoothly as he wished. Poor Mangin!
dst: 看看5月1日他被替换后发生了什么吧。只能说，尼韦勒以正面突击反攻并夺回杜奥蒙堡的计划，并不像他希望的那样顺利。可怜的芒然！

src: Just three days after the Prussian assault on Missunde the Danish Commander in Chief, General de Meza, withdrew all his forces from the Danevirke to the trenches at Düppel. Since the weather was terribly cold, the Schlei and the wetlands had frozen solid, and de Meza feared that, under those conditions, his army could be outflanked.
dst: 就在普鲁士人进攻米松德三天后，丹麦总司令德梅萨将军将其全部兵力从丹内维尔克撤至迪伯尔的战壕。由于天气极寒，施莱河和湿地都已封冻，德梅萨担心在这种情况下他的军队可能被包抄。

src: Kappel allowed everyone who wished to go home, or to surrender, to do so. Thus, we kept only the most reliable fighters. Then he planned to go to the Baikal, hoping that we could continue our resistance there. But first we'd have to reach Krasnoyarsk. We wouldn't find any friends there. A few days before the commander of our garrison in that town, General Zinevich, and the governor of the Yenisei province, had betrayed us and had started to negotiate an armistice with the Bolsheviks. One of our own generals! Can you imagine that?
dst: 卡佩尔允许所有想回家或想投降的人离开。这样，我们只留下最可靠的战士。然后他计划前往贝加尔湖，指望能在那里继续抵抗。但首先我们必须抵达克拉斯诺亚尔斯克。在那里我们找不到任何朋友。就在几天前，我们驻该城守备部队的指挥官济涅维奇将军和叶尼塞省省长已背叛了我们，开始与布尔什维克谈判停战。我们自己的将军！您能想象吗？

src: Kappel was an extremely competent officer, and after six weeks of fighting we had defeated all the communist forces between Simbirsk and Khvalynsk. Besides, in the east the Czech Legion had conquered all the important outposts along the Trans-Siberian Railway, from Samara to Irkutsk. Sadly, they didn't reach Ekaterinburg in time to save the Tsar and his family, who were cruelly murdered by the Bolsheviks a few days before the Czechs could control the area.
dst: 卡佩尔是一位极为出色的军官，经过六周的战斗，我们歼灭了辛比尔斯克与赫瓦伦斯克之间的所有共产主义武装。此外，在东部，捷克军团已攻占了西伯利亚大铁路沿线从萨马拉到伊尔库茨克的所有重要据点。遗憾的是，他们没能及时赶到叶卡捷琳堡去营救沙皇及其家人，就在捷克人能够控制该地区的几天前，沙皇一家已被布尔什维克残忍杀害。

src: Kappel was an extremely competent officer, but the Red Army was too powerful for us at that time. After six weeks of fighting we had been defeated, the Komuch was disbanded, and we were forced to leave Samara. To make things even worse, the Tsar and his family were cruelly murdered by the Bolsheviks in the month of July.
dst: 卡佩尔是一位极为出色的军官，但那时红军对我们来说太强大了。经过六周的战斗，我们战败了，科穆奇被解散，我们被迫撤离萨马拉。更糟的是，沙皇及其家人在7月被布尔什维克残忍杀害。

src: Kiev is important both strategically as well as politically, since it is considered to be the key to the Ukraine!  The Soviets have several large armies gathered near the city. You cannot hope to beat them frontally so we will encircle them. You have been given the southern wing - cut them off as fast as you can! You are not allowed to purchase any new units.
dst: 基辅无论在战略上还是政治上都至关重要——它被视为打开乌克兰的钥匙！苏军已在城郊集结数个大型集团军。正面强攻绝无胜算，因此我们将以合围取之。您受命指挥南翼——务必尽快切断其退路！您不得购入任何新部队。

src: Kimberley is finally ours, Rhodes is our prisoner, and in the north de Wet has overcome the British at Gaberones. Only Mafikeng still resists us, but sooner or later it will fall.
dst: 金伯利终于属于我们了，罗兹成了我们的阶下囚，而在北方，德韦特已在加贝罗内斯击败了英军。只有马菲肯仍在抵抗我们，但它迟早也会陷落。

src: Kimberley is finally ours, but it has been a pyrrhic victory. We have suffered so many losses that we won't be able to keep the town. Soon the British will launch new attacks, and I'm afraid that we won't have the strength to repel their invasion.
dst: 金伯利终于属于我们了，但这只是一场惨胜。我们遭受的损失如此惨重，以致无力守住这座城。英军很快会发动新的进攻，我担心我们将无力击退他们的入侵。

src: Kindralleitnant, stretched to its limits, our offensive is drowning in the blood of its soldiers.  Wave after wave of Bolshevik troops is thrown at our valiant warriors.  Not only Petrograd, even Gatchina seem to be beyond the limits of the Northwestern Army.
dst: 中将，我们的攻势已到极限，正淹没在士兵的血泊之中。一波又一波的布尔什维克军队扑向我们英勇的战士。不仅是彼得格勒，连加特契纳似乎也超出了西北集团军的能力范围。

src: Kindralleitnant, the time has come for our fall offensive against the Bolshevik forces.  The overall strategic situation looks very promising for us and our allies:  in the south Denikin's Volunteer Army has already begun their thrust north toward Moscow.  In the east, the Czech rebellion and Kolchak's forces are threatening to overrun the Bolsheviks.  Today presents the best opportunity for us to strike at the Bolshevik capital and to crush the regime.  Our alliance with Yudenich's White movement will serve as a powerful bargaining chip-should Imperial Russian forces emerge victorious in Russia's civil war.
dst: 中将，对布尔什维克军队发动秋季攻势的时刻到了。总体战略形势对我们和我们的盟友十分有利：在南面，邓尼金的志愿军已开始向北朝莫斯科推进。在东面，捷克军团起义与高尔察克的部队正威胁着要击溃布尔什维克。今天是我们打击布尔什维克首都、粉碎该政权的最佳时机。我们与尤登尼奇白军运动的联盟，将在俄国内战中帝国俄军最终取胜时，成为有力的谈判筹码。

src: Kindralleitnant, your nation calls upon her warriors to carry this war to our enemies and to guarantee peace and stability of our borders!
dst: 中将，您的国家召唤她的勇士们，把这场战争打到敌人那里去，保障我国边境的和平与稳定！

src: Kindralmajor, following your victory at Cesis, Von der Goltz' troops began their retreat to Riga.  This is our last chance to stabilize the situation in favor of Latvia and strengthen the Estonian-Latvian relations.  If you fail to destroy the German troops, then foreign intervention will be inevitable, which may not be an advisable option for young republics like ours.
dst: 少将，随着您在采西斯的胜利，冯·德·戈尔茨的部队开始向里加撤退。这是我们稳定局势、使之有利于拉脱维亚并加强爱拉关系的最后机会。若您未能消灭德国部队，外国的干涉将不可避免，而这对于像我们这样的年轻共和国来说未必是明智的选择。

src: Kindralmajor, the Soomusrongide Diviis has concentrated outside of Pskov.  The capture of this city and its viscinity will be the first major co-operative operation with General Yudenich's White Russian forces.
dst: 少将，装甲列车师已在普斯科夫外围集结。夺取这座城市及其周边地区，将是我们与尤登尼奇将军的白俄军队首次大规模协同作战。

src: Kindralmajor, there has been an urgent development on the Gulf of Finland.  As you may be aware, the Soviets have successfully salvaged the bulk of their Baltic Fleet from Helsinki last year.  They have since solidly fortified the southern shore of the gulf with anti-shipping bunkers and docked dreadnoughts.  The system of defensive installations culminates with the island-fortress of Kronshtadt, just a few kilometers west of Petrograd.
dst: 少将，芬兰湾出现了紧急事态。您或许已经知道，苏俄去年成功从赫尔辛基打捞并转移了波罗的海舰队的大部分舰只。此后，他们以反舰碉堡和停泊的无畏舰，牢牢加固了海湾南岸。这套防御体系以距离彼得格勒以西仅几公里的岛屿要塞喀琅施塔得为顶点。

src: Kindralmajor, there have been some disturbing developments in Latvia.  The Latvian Army had a slow start in organization in 1918, which resulted in the nationalist Latvian government's request for foreign intervention against the Red Army.  German volunteer troops-the "Baltishe Landeswehr" under the command of General Von der Goltz-have been waging a ruthless terror campaign against the Bolsheviks, which has spilled out against the local population.  Goltz, however, refuses to cooperate with the Latvian government and is now threatening to destabilize the country politically.  The Latvians have called upon us to help them at this time of need.
dst: 少将，拉脱维亚出现了一些令人不安的事态。拉脱维亚军队1918年的组建起步缓慢，导致民族主义的拉脱维亚政府请求外国干涉以对抗红军。德国志愿部队——冯·德·戈尔茨将军麾下的「波罗的海地方防卫军」——一直在对布尔什维克发动无情的恐怖战役，而这股暴力也波及了当地民众。然而，戈尔茨拒绝与拉脱维亚政府合作，如今甚至威胁要在政治上颠覆这个国家。拉脱维亚人已请求我们在这个危难时刻伸出援手。

src: Knowing that if they stayed at Domokos they would eventually be crushed, the Greeks retreated during the night. The road to Athens is open. Well done!
dst: 希腊人知道如果留在多莫科斯，最终必将被击垮，于是在夜间撤退了。通往雅典的道路已经敞开。干得好！

src: Knowing that, the High Command of the Egyptian Expeditionary Forces decided to try a different strategy. They concentrated the British attacks at one point: at the north of the Dead Sea. They were successful, and they managed to break trough our lines. Now, all their cavalry units, some infantry and the Imperial Camel Corps of the EEF stand deep behind our lines. They've just reached El Salt.
dst: 有鉴于此，埃及远征军最高指挥部决定尝试不同的战略。他们把英军的进攻集中在一个点上：死海以北。他们成功了，突破了我们的防线。现在，他们所有的骑兵部队、部分步兵以及埃及远征军的帝国骆驼军已深入我方防线后方。他们刚刚抵达萨勒特。

src: Knowing when to hold, retreat or advance will be your greatest ally.
dst: 懂得何时坚守、撤退或推进，将是你最大的盟友。

src: Kochira koso!  Your attack was outstanding; however, the enemy still has that damned airstrip!  We should launch another assault, to kick them from out Guadalcanal, and their so-called ''Henderson Field'' airstrip...
dst: 彼此彼此！您的进攻出色极了；然而敌军仍占据着那座该死的机场！我们应当再发起一次突击，把他们从瓜达尔卡纳尔岛、从他们那所谓的「亨德森机场」赶出去……

src: Kochira koso! Your attack was outstanding, and the enemies were completely defeated on the sea as well as on the soil of Guadalcanal... now we can begin to plan our attack on northern Australia.
dst: 彼此彼此！您的进攻非常出色，敌人在海上以及在瓜达尔卡纳尔岛的地面上都被彻底击败了……现在我们可以开始筹划对澳大利亚北部的进攻了。

src: Kochira koso!, the Australian supply lines have been cut, and now our brave men in the North of the island will have a much more easier job against the enemy. We have suffered some losses due to the jungle diseases. I hope you haven't got malaria or something like that...
dst: 彼此彼此！澳大利亚的补给线已被切断，现在我们在该岛北部的勇士们对敌作战将轻松得多。我们因丛林疾病而蒙受了一些损失。我希望您没有染上疟疾之类的病……

src: Kochira koso!, we now control the most important enemy bases. The Americans are trapped hopelessly in the Bataan peninsula, we need only to annihilate them!.
dst: 岂敢岂敢！如今我们已控制敌军最重要的基地。美国人绝望地被困在巴丹半岛，我们只需将他们歼灭！

src: Kochira koso!, your actions were outstanding, however, the enemies still have that damned airstrip!. We should launch another assault, to kick them out from Guadalcanal, and their so-called ''Henderson Field'' airstrip...
dst: 彼此彼此！您的行动非常出色，然而敌人仍占据着那条该死的机场跑道！我们应该再发动一次突击，把他们从瓜达尔卡纳尔岛以及他们所谓的「亨德森机场」跑道上赶出去……

src: Kochira-koso!!!, all the enemies were eliminated, the battle was a bloodbath, the sands of Iwo Jima are painted in dark red, but the Rising Sun flag it's still on the Mount Suribachi. Your next mission will be in Okinawa, we think the americans are planning to strike there.
dst: 岂敢岂敢！！！，敌人已被全部消灭，这场战斗是一场血战，硫磺岛的沙土被染成深红，但旭日旗依然飘扬在折钵山上。您的下一个任务将在冲绳，我们认为美国人正打算在那里发动进攻。
科克特贝尔 (普拉涅尔斯科耶)

src: Kolonel, Brigaadikindral Kubbo welcomes you to his staff of the 1st brigade.  You are already familiar with the area:  just last month you trained your troops nearby on the shores of Lake Peipus...
dst: 上校，准将库博欢迎您加入他第1旅的参谋部。您对这一地区已经很熟悉了：就在上个月，您还在附近的佩普西湖畔训练您的部队……

src: Kolonel, although you have inflicted heavy losses upon the Bolsheviks at Tapa, the bulk of their equipment and, most discouragingly, their heavy artillery have escaped your raid.  We must now rejoin the rest of the Estonian offensive.
dst: 上校，尽管您在塔帕给布尔什维克造成了惨重损失，但他们的大部分装备，以及最令人沮丧的是，他们的重炮都从您的突袭中逃脱了。我们现在必须重新汇入爱沙尼亚攻势的其余部分。

src: Kolonel, following a resounding victory over the Red Army at Tallinn, we are given the opportunity to pursue the retreating Bolsheviks.  The city of Tapa lies near the Tallinn-Narva railroad.  It appears elements of the 7th Army are retreating toward it.  You must capture Tapa and cut off the path of retreat for these forces.  Time is of essence in this mission.
dst: 上校，继在塔林对红军取得一场辉煌胜利之后，我们获得了追击撤退中的布尔什维克的机会。塔帕城位于塔林-纳尔瓦铁路附近。看来第7集团军的部分部队正在向那里撤退。您必须占领塔帕，切断这些部队的退路。此任务时间紧迫。

src: Kolonel, the Republic is indebted to your bravery.  The young Estonian army has claimed her first major victory in this war.
dst: 上校，共和国对您的英勇感激不尽。年轻的爱沙尼亚军队在这场战争中取得了她的第一次重大胜利。

src: Kolonel, the forces under your command are gaining valuable experience.  Now, without delay, we must press on!
dst: 上校，您麾下的部队正在积累宝贵的经验。现在，事不宜迟，我们必须继续前进！

src: Kolonel, the forces under your command have earned venerable recognition.  Now you must carry your initiative to further victories!
dst: 上校，您麾下的部队赢得了令人尊敬的赞誉。现在您必须将您的主动权延续到更大的胜利中去！

src: Kolonel, this has been a costly victory for the young Republic.  The countryside is envoloped in a sickening smoke, and whole sections of Tallinn lay in ruins.  Charred artillery barrels and twisted rails dot the landscape...
dst: 上校，这对年轻的共和国而言是一场代价高昂的胜利。乡野笼罩在令人作呕的硝烟之中，塔林整片整片的城区化为废墟。烧焦的炮管和扭曲的铁轨散落在各处……

src: Kolonel, under your exceedingly feeble leadership, the Estonian army has been nearly decimated.  With communications disrupted, the forces of our Nordic allies, the relief forces of the Kuperjanow Brigade, and the British Baltic fleet continue to resist the Red Army.
dst: 上校，在您极其软弱的指挥下，爱沙尼亚军队已几乎被打残。在通信中断的情况下，我们北欧盟友的部队、库佩亚诺夫旅的救援部队以及英国波罗的海舰队仍在继续抵抗红军。

src: Kolonel, under your leadership, the young Estonian army has claimed her first major victory in this war.
dst: 上校，在您的领导下，年轻的爱沙尼亚军队在这场战争中取得了她的第一次重大胜利。

src: Kolonel, you are charged with turning the tide of the Bolshevik offensive here at Tallinn.  With the Red Army troops just 30 km away from the Estonian capital, this battle is the pivotal engagement of the Estonian War of Independence.
dst: 上校，您受命在塔林这里扭转布尔什维克攻势的局势。红军部队距爱沙尼亚首都仅30公里，这场战斗是爱沙尼亚独立战争的关键一役。

src: Kolonelleitnant, it is good that your regiment has been training on the border.  The Red Army has launched an offensive against Estonia and our White Russian allies along two axes:  from the south-east with the aims of Pskov, Tartu and along the Baltic Sea with the aims of Narva, Rakvere, Tallinn.  It appears that the Reds have been held up at Pskov, so your regiment must relocate to Narva as quickly as possible.
dst: 中校，您的团一直在边境训练，这很好。红军已沿两条轴线对爱沙尼亚和我们的白俄盟友发动攻势：一条从东南方向、以普斯科夫和塔尔图为目标，另一条沿波罗的海、以纳尔瓦、拉克韦雷和塔林为目标。看来红军已在普斯科夫受阻，因此您的团必须尽快转移到纳尔瓦。

src: Kolonelleitnant, your expertise and the experience of your troops are needed at the training grounds of the 3rd regiment outside of Vyru on Lake Peipus.  There have been reports of violations of our borders by the Red Army.  Their raids have left many civilians dead, and it is up to you to protect them.  Battalions from the 4th Narva regiment and from the 2nd Tartu regiment will be ready to provide assistance if the Soviets violate the border.
dst: 中校，在佩普西湖畔沃鲁城外的第3团训练场上，需要您的专业知识和部队的经验。有报告称，红军侵犯了我们的边境。他们的袭扰造成许多平民死亡，保护他们的重任就落在您身上。如果苏军侵犯边境，第4纳尔瓦团和第2塔尔图团的各营将随时准备提供支援。
司令部/ III Caucasian 军/ 第7集团军
司令部/ Zapadno 集团军

src: Kommodore, we have a critical situation in the French Antilles. The Americans broke the peace with Admiral Robert. Already American paratroopers are ready to occupy the islands. The French fleet is already fighting and cannot help the few land units. While your fleet heads to the aid of the French fleet, your marines must retake the islands. Unfortunately your planes can't help since the Americans confiscated all the airfields.
dst: 海军准将，我们在法属安的列斯群岛遇到了危急情况。美国人破坏了与 Robert 海军上将的和平。美国伞兵已准备好占领这些岛屿。法国舰队已在交战，无法支援那少数地面部队。当你的舰队前往援助法国舰队时，你的海军陆战队必须夺回这些岛屿。不幸的是你的飞机帮不上忙，因为美国人没收了所有机场。

src: Komodore, as your fleet is already heading for the Black Sea, English marines have landed and ready to capture Lamperdusa. Apparently their purpose is to destroy the radar that controls the area.
dst: 海军准将，由于你的舰队已在开往黑海途中，英国海军陆战队已经登陆，准备夺取兰佩杜萨。显然他们的目的是摧毁控制该地区的雷达。
骑兵/ 贝尔格莱德军区
骑兵/-/第3多瑙河 第6集团军
骑兵/-/第49斯雷姆斯卡 第6集团军

src: Kongratulieren! Now the Suez Canal is under German control! This will be a great help also for our Japanese friends.
dst: 恭喜！现在苏伊士运河已在德国控制之下！这对我们的日本盟友也是极大的帮助。

src: Kongratulieren! Our elite paratroopers have showed their skills again. The entrance to the Canal is secured and the British won't be able to use it again to resupply their units in Egypt and the Middle East.
dst: 恭喜！我们的精锐伞兵再次展示了他们的本领。运河入口已安全，英国人再也无法利用它为其在埃及和中东的部队提供补给了。

src: Kongratulieren! The Soviets have been kicked out of Persia, and the British Armies will no longer disturb us here. The Middle East is under our command as well as the oil resources from these lands. In spite of the failure at Stalingrad, our presence in Persia will put pressure on  the Soviet southern borders. We hope the Kursk offensive will be a decisive victory for the Werhmacht, helped now by our big oil supplies...
dst: 恭喜！苏联人已被逐出波斯，英国军队再也不会在此地骚扰我们。中东以及这些土地上的石油资源都已在我们的掌控之下。尽管在斯大林格勒遭遇失败，我们在波斯的存在将对苏联南部边境施加压力。我们希望库尔斯克攻势将成为国防军的一次决定性胜利，如今有了我们大量的石油供应助力……

src: Kongratulieren!, the High Command is grateful for your actions. We hoped to preserve the front lines, however you have completed the conquest of Cyrenaica.
dst: 恭喜！最高统帅部对您的行动表示感谢。我们本只希望守住战线，而您却完成了对昔兰尼加的征服。

src: Kongratulieren!, the past year's frontlines have been restored here.
dst: 祝贺！去年的战线已在此地恢复。

src: Konichiwa General. I just want to wish you good luck for this new mission. The puny occidentals have held these islands for too long, and now we are going to clean another Asian place more from the foreign presence.
dst: 您好，将军。我只想祝您这项新任务好运。那些微不足道的西方人占据这些岛屿太久了，现在我们又要从一处亚洲土地上清除外国势力的存在。

src: Konichiwa. I have heard about your actions in the Pacific, but your task here will be completely different. As you know, Iwo Jima is our most important base in the Bonin Islands, and nowadays this volcanic island is currently threatened by the proximity of the enemy fleets. This time, you can't leave the island, the Emperor expects the best from you if finally the enemy disembarks here. Eliminate them, or, otherwise, die as the samurai you are, that's your mission. Think on our valiant kamikazes, their mission is to get a glorious death striking the enemy!.
dst: 您好。我已听闻您的太平洋战绩，但您在这里的任务将截然不同。如您所知，硫磺岛是我们在小笠原群岛最重要的基地，而如今这座火山岛正因敌军舰队的逼近而受到威胁。这一次，您不能离开该岛，如果敌人最终在此登陆，天皇对您寄予厚望。消灭他们，否则就像您身为武士那样战死，这就是您的任务。想想我们英勇的神风特攻队，他们的使命就是撞击敌舰、光荣牺牲！

src: Koninkijke Nederlandse Prinses Irene Brigade in Nederland, Tilburg, Noord-Brabant, November 1944.
dst: 荷兰皇家伊蕾娜公主旅在荷兰北布拉班特省蒂尔堡，1944年11月。

src: Konnichiwa general.  As you know, since the 7th of August, the Solomon Islands, Northwards to Australia, are under attack by the US Naval troops.  They have landed on the North side of the island of Guadalcanal, the main island, taking the airstrip, which they are using to support their air forces, and to receive supplies too.  The island of Florida and Tulagi are also now occupied by enemy forces.  Intelligence thinks that the US Navy will soon send reinforcements to their beach head around the village of Tenaru on North Guadalcanal.
dst: 您好，将军。如您所知，自8月7日以来，位于澳大利亚以北的所罗门群岛正遭到美国海军陆战队的进攻。他们已在主岛瓜达尔卡纳尔岛的北侧登陆，夺取了机场跑道，正利用它支援其空中力量，同时也用来接收补给。佛罗里达岛和图拉吉岛如今也被敌军占领。情报部门认为，美国海军很快会向其位于北瓜达尔卡纳尔岛泰纳鲁村附近的滩头阵地派遣增援。
君士坦丁·德拉加塞斯·帕列奥列格
执政官格奈乌斯马利乌斯马克西穆斯
执政官帕皮里乌斯卡尔波

src: Kornilov's death has been a terrible blow for us. Without his leadership many veteran warriors look lost now, like orphaned children without their father. The morale of our army has sunk. Alekseyev and Denikin have taken command and, knowing that it will take some time for our troops to recover, they have ordered us back to the Don River region.
dst: 科尔尼洛夫的死对我们是一个沉重的打击。失去了他的领导，许多老兵如今看上去茫然无措，就像失去父亲的孤儿。我们军队的士气一落千丈。阿列克谢耶夫和邓尼金接过了指挥权，他们知道部队需要一段时间才能恢复，于是命令我们撤回顿河地区。
科罗斯特舒夫(科罗斯蒂希夫)

src: La amenaza sobre Levante se ha disipado tras la captura de Teruel y la derrota del potente contraataque que lanzo el enemigo!. La batalla ha sido terrible, pero la victoria nos ha favorecido.
dst: 夺取特鲁埃尔并击溃敌军发动的强大反击后，莱万特面临的威胁已经解除！战斗十分惨烈，但胜利站在我们这边。

src: La batalla ha sido terrible... y mas aun lo esta siendo la retirada. Tras capturar Teruel los rebeldes nos han hecho trizas... Este golpe tal vez sea definitivo, a pesar de ello el alto mando seguira necesitando de sus servicios.
dst: 这场战斗太可怕了……而撤退更是如此。在夺取特鲁埃尔之后，叛军把我们打得粉碎……这一击也许会是决定性的，尽管如此，最高统帅部仍将需要您的效力。

src: La estrategia del mando nacionalista cambia de signo; en lugar del asalto directo a Madrid y sus zonas adyacentes, que demostró ser una empresa demasiado complicada, ahora el objetivo es terminar con la presencia republicana en zonas periféricas, que debiliten a los leales al gobierno y termine por derribar su resistencia. El destino de la nueva ofensiva será el Frente Norte, empezando por el País Vasco. Como general nacionalista, tu misión es emplear todos los recursos disponibles para capturar Bilbao, sede del gobierno de Euzkadi y asestar un duro golpe al Frente Norte, como general republicano, trata de defender Vizcaya y evitar su caida.
dst: 国民军统帅部的战略改变了方向；不再直接进攻马德里及其周边地区——事实证明那是一项过于艰巨的任务——如今的目标是清除共和军在周边地区的存在，以此削弱效忠政府者，并最终摧垮其抵抗。新一轮攻势的目标将是北方战线，从巴斯克地区开始。作为国民军将军，您的任务是动用一切可用资源夺取毕尔巴鄂——巴斯克政府所在地，并给予北方战线沉重一击；作为共和军将军，则要尽力保卫比斯开，阻止其陷落。

src: La marcha rebelde sobre Madrid esta completamente detenida por el momento. En las ultimas semanas los movimientos fascistas delatan que los planes del enemigo han cambiado y ahora en lugar del asalto directo a la capital se han decantado por rodearla, primero atacando nuestro sector Sur-Este en el rio Jarama para despues enlazar con las columnas que estan mas al norte.
dst: 目前叛军向马德里的进军已完全被阻止。近几周来，法西斯分子的调动表明敌军的计划已经改变，如今他们不再直接强攻首都，而是转而将其包围，先攻击我们在哈拉马河的东南地段，然后再与更北面的纵队会合。

src: La marcha rebelde sobre Madrid está completamente detenida por el momento. En las últimas semanas los movimientos fascistas delatan que los planes del enemigo han cambiado y ahora en lugar del asalto directo a la capital se han decantado por rodearla, primero atacando nuestro sector Sur-Este en el rio Jarama para despues enlazar con las columnas que estan mas al norte.
dst: 叛军向马德里的推进目前已被完全遏止。近几周，法西斯分子的动向表明敌军的计划已经改变：如今他们不再直接强攻首都，而是转而试图将其合围——首先在哈拉马河进攻我东南地段，随后再与更北面的纵队会合。

src: La mayoría de las unidades enemigas son batallones vascos, que no se cree que puedan llevar a cabo con éxito semejante objetivo. En realidad, esperabamos este ataque desde el Este, a través del Valle de Mondragón, así que los republicanos tienen cierta ventaja inicial. Desafortunadamente para nosotros, debido a esto tenemos que llevar a cabo una redistribución de unidades para detener su ofensiva cuanto antes.
dst: 敌军大部分部队是巴斯克营，据信他们无法成功完成这样的目标。事实上，我们原本预计这场进攻会从东面、经由蒙德拉贡谷地发起，因此共和军初期占有一定优势。对我们来说不幸的是，正因如此，我们不得不重新调配部队，以尽快阻止他们的攻势。

src: La ofensiva que lanzaremos consiste en otro ataque envolvente que acabara rapidamente con la guarnicion enemiga, pero de por sentado que recibiremos un duro contraataque seguidamente. Las condiciones climatologicas este invierno estan siendo especialmente duras... los -28 grados que hace ahi fuera seran un problema mas.
dst: 我们将发动的攻势是又一次包围进攻，它会迅速消灭敌军驻军，但您要料定我们随后会遭到猛烈的反攻。今年冬天的天气格外严酷……外面零下28度的严寒将是又一个难题。

src: La rebelion ha terminado en toda la Peninsula, la debilidad de retaguardia del enemigo ha sido clave para que el Norte se levantara contra los rebeldes, e incluso muchas unidades rebeldes se hayan cambiado de bando. Burgos, la capital enemiga ha caido, y las fuerzas insurgentes en el Sur han embarcado hacia el protectorado de Marruecos.
dst: 叛乱已在整个半岛终结，敌人后方的脆弱是北方奋起反抗叛军的关键，甚至许多叛军部队也已经倒戈。敌方首府布尔戈斯已经陷落，南方的叛乱武装已登船前往摩洛哥保护地。

dst: 由于缺乏任何补给线，我们被迫从当地村民那里征用了大量粮食和原料。不出所料，他们对我们的所作所为心怀怨恨，并开始把法国人视作潜在的救星。很快，他们就把我们的行踪透露给了敌人。

src: Lacking any kind of support, the days of the Directory were numbered. On November 17th a group of cossacks staged a coup d'etat. The next day the Directory was dissolved and the Minister of War, Admiral Alexandr Kolchak, became the Supreme Governor of All-Russia. Of course, I liked Kolchak's rule much better than the socialist governments that had tried to oppose the Bolsheviks until now, but I had learnt that, if we wanted to win the war, we were going to need allies. And that meant that we'd have to make concessions to the left-wing parties.
dst: 由于缺乏任何支持，执政内阁的日子屈指可数了。11月17日，一伙哥萨克发动了政变。第二天，执政内阁被解散，陆军大臣、海军上将亚历山大·高尔察克成为全俄最高执政。当然，比起迄今为止那些试图对抗布尔什维克的社会主义政府，我更喜欢高尔察克的统治，但我已经明白，要想赢得这场战争，我们就需要盟友。而这意味着我们必须向左翼政党作出让步。

src: Lacking artillery Rifians failed to take Melilla. Spanish reinforcements soon arrived. However, it took several months of fierce fight and heavy losses, including General Margallo, commander of the Spanish forces, to dislodge the Rifians sieging Melilla. They had expanded their trenches around the city and set up fortified camps, blocking off all communication between the city and the outlying forts.
dst: 由于缺乏火炮，里夫人未能攻下梅利利亚。西班牙援军很快抵达。然而，经过数月的激战和惨重损失——包括西班牙军队指挥官马尔加略将军的阵亡——才把围攻梅利利亚的里夫人击退。他们已经在城周围扩展了战壕并设立了设防营地，切断了城市与外围堡垒之间的一切联系。

src: Last January our troops landed at Anzio - 80km behind the Gustav line. Kesselring moved every spare unit to be found into a ring around our beachhead and stopped all breakout attempts. Four months later we are ready to try again: Operation Buffalo. Strike inland to cut the lines of communication of the German Tenth Army fighting at Monte Cassino and move North-West to capture Rome.

Your troops will have to drive into the Italian rear without even caring to secure their flanks. Remember that you must surround the enemy and control the lines of communications. That's the key to victory.
dst: 上个月，我们在伊松佐河谷、卡普雷托镇附近找到了一处可以实践渗透战术的地点。我们先用毒气笼罩了该地区，随后又用炮火轰击，直到第一线战壕被摧毁。如今轮到您出手了。您的部队必须突入意军后方，甚至不必费心去确保两翼安全。记住，您必须包围敌人并控制交通线。这才是制胜的关键。

src: Leading 1st Panzer's assault, Grossdeutschland crossed near Gaulier just after 3pm. Reaching the west bank, small groups of infantry pressed into the gaps between pillboxes, discovering few French interval troops. The more stubborn pillboxes were destroyed by Sturmpioneren attacking from the rear with explosives. The chaos in French lines and direct disobedience to orders only exacerbated the slowness of response of an army reacting at the speed of French warfare. The counterattack went in five-and-a-half hours late, with only half its allocated forces; the alarm it caused among the Germans suggests an earlier, stronger attack by the French could have had a dramatic effect. The French were slow to exploit an initial advantage and at 8:30 were struck by 1st Panzer, which destroyed half 7th Tank Battalion's obsolete tanks retaking Chemery. This failure meant the dissolution of 55th and 71st divisions, which by noon were panic-stricken mobs. Similarly Allied air forces made their efforts late - throughout May 14th, pilots fought with great courage to destroy the pontoon bridge at Gaulier. Their delay had allowed XIX Panzer Korps to erect 200 flak guns and the Luftwaffe was able to bring about 800 machines into the air. The Allies launched twenty-seven piecemeal attacks and lost ninety planes, but to no avail. The bridge remained intact. The battle of Sedan was, in effect, over.
dst: “大德意志”团作为第1装甲师的突击先锋，在下午3点刚过时分从戈利耶附近渡河。到达西岸后，小股步兵钻入各碉堡之间的空隙，发现法军的间隙部队很少。较顽固的碉堡由突击工兵从后方用炸药摧毁。法军战线上的混乱以及对命令的公然违抗，只会加剧一支以法军作战节奏反应的军队响应迟缓的程度。反攻迟了5个半小时才发起，且只投入了分配兵力的一半；它在德军中所引起的惊慌表明，若法军更早、更强地发起进攻，本可产生戏剧性效果。法军迟迟未能扩大初期的优势，8点30分时被第1装甲师击中，该师在夺回谢梅里的战斗中摧毁了第7坦克营半数过时的坦克。这次失败导致第55师和第71师解体，到中午时分它们已成了惊慌失措的乌合之众。盟军空军同样出手太晚——5月14日一整天，飞行员们以极大勇气试图摧毁戈利耶的浮桥。他们的迟延让第19装甲军得以架起200门高射炮，德国空军也得以让约800架飞机升空。盟军发动了27次零碎的进攻，损失90架飞机，却毫无结果。浮桥依然完好。色当之战事实上已经结束。

src: Leningrads capture was celebrated of course as a Big acheivement in the War being 1 of the 5 main focus points the others being Smolensk,Kharkov,Rostav and of course the prize,Moscow.The Soviet land so vast and the Forces so immense those Bolshevik units that were able to retreat or escape just moved into woods,re-organized and hounded the Nazi Invaders.Supply units of the SS/BdM could not do their job or could the Panzers roll forward until the Forest of Inndohr was cleared out.And Panzers could not dominate the battles in woods,it took the 'Fraus in great numbers which also meant great casulties.So unlike France the Dead and maimed were going to be in the 100's of thousands before the Crusade against the Bolsheviks was over.In the Reich a lot of Families would not celebrate the Greatness of the Fuhress attacking Russia as they had of the Fall of France and Englands demise.And the Fuhress repeating Her famous line 'It is a Necessity' would irk those who would lose their Daughters in Service of the Frauland far away on the Eastern Front.
dst: 列宁格勒的攻占自然被当作战争中的一大成就来庆祝——它是五大主要目标之一，其余是斯摩棱斯克、哈尔科夫、罗斯托夫，当然还有那个终极奖赏：莫斯科。苏联的土地如此辽阔，兵力如此庞大，那些得以撤退或逃脱的布尔什维克部队干脆钻进树林、重新整编，然后不断袭扰纳粹入侵者。在因多赫尔森林被肃清之前，党卫军/BdM 的补给部队无法履职，装甲部队也无法推进。而装甲部队无法在森林战中占据主导，只能靠“女士”们以大量兵力硬拼，这也就意味着惨重的伤亡。因此与法国不同，在这场讨伐布尔什维克的远征结束之前，死者和残废者将以数十万计。在帝国本土，许多家庭不会像庆祝法国陷落和英格兰灭亡那样，去庆祝女元首进攻俄国的“伟大”；而女元首反复念叨她那句名言“这是必需之举”，会让那些将在遥远的东线为“女性之国”服役而失去女儿的人更加愤懑。

src: Lentullus did not wait until they had encircled Spartacus and attacked to soon. That was was Spartacus chance, and he used it.
dst: 伦图卢斯没有等到合围完成就过早发起进攻。这成了斯巴达克斯的机会，而他抓住了它。

src: Leopold II made a deal with the British. They can use some help in the Sudan, fighting the Mahdists. He has been given the Lado Enclave in the South-West of the Sudan. That will give him access to a port on the Nile. In return the British got a piece of land in the East of the Congo that will allow them to build the Cape to Cairo railway.
dst: 利奥波德二世与英国人达成了交易。他们在苏丹与马赫迪派作战时用得着一些帮助。他得到了苏丹西南部的拉多飞地。这将使他在尼罗河上获得一个港口。作为回报，英国人得到了刚果东部的一块土地，以便修建从开普敦到开罗的铁路。

src: Less than four years ago life had granted me everything that I had wished. I was a well-respected officer in the Imperial Army, with a nice family. I couldn't dream on anything else.
dst: 不到四年前，生活还曾给予我想要的一切。我是帝国陆军中一位备受敬重的军官，家庭美满。我别无所求。

src: Less than two months after the battle of Metemma, Emperor Menelik II signed the Treaty of Wuchale with the Italians, their old allies. In exchange for the assistance of Italy in issues related to Ethiopian financial, military and foreign affairs, Ethiopia would cede the northern provinces of Bogos, Hamasien, Akkele Guzay, and Serae to Italy. Those territories were to becme part of the new colony of Eritrea.
dst: 梅特马战役之后不到两个月，孟尼利克二世皇帝便与他们的老盟友意大利人签订了《武恰莱条约》。作为意大利在埃塞俄比亚财政、军事和外交事务上提供援助的交换，埃塞俄比亚将把博戈斯、哈马西恩、阿克莱古扎伊和瑟拉伊等北部省份割让给意大利。这些领土将成为新殖民地厄立特里亚的一部分。

src: Let me be the first to congratulate you on your stunning victory over the British!
dst: 让我第一个祝贺你对英军的惊人胜利！

src: Let me explain the situation, General. Uman is the last strongly defended position before the Dnieper. If you can take the city and surround the remnants of the Soviet 6th and 12th Armies, we can advance toward Kiev from the South and meet Guderian's 2nd Panzer Army attacking from the North, and encircle Kiev, in which a million Bolsheviks would be trapped.
dst: 让我来说明一下形势，将军。乌曼是第聂伯河之前的最后一个坚固设防阵地。如果你能拿下这座城市并包围苏军第6和第12集团军的残部，我们就能从南面向基辅推进，与从北面进攻的古德里安第2装甲集团军会师，合围基辅，届时上百万布尔什维克将被困其中。

src: Let me welcome you to my cause to unite the Polish-Germans back to the Fatherland!
dst: 欢迎你加入我的事业——把波兰的德意志人重新团结回祖国！

src: Let the Carnix sound for the departure!
dst: 让卡尼克斯号角为出征而鸣！

src: Let us rest while we reform our legions, bury our dead and prepare for our future campaigns.  I salute you for your tenacity under these very hard circumstances.
dst: 让我们休整，重整军团、埋葬死者，并为未来的战役做准备。我为你在这般艰难处境下的坚韧向你致敬。

src: Let's be confident that our improvised positions behind the Escaut/Scheldt River can stop the German offensive.
dst: 让我们相信，我们在斯海尔德河后方临时构筑的阵地能够挡住德军的攻势。

src: Let's hope for the best! Good luck, General!
dst: 让我们寄望于最好的结果吧！祝您好运，将军！

src: Let's hope the lessons learned are well used in the future.
dst: 但愿这些经验教训将来能得到充分运用。

src: Let's pray that this will really, really be the last attack of our foe.
dst: 让我们祈祷，这真的、真的是敌人的最后一次进攻吧。

src: Lettow-Vorbeck agreed to a cease-fire at the spot now marked by the Von Lettow-Vorbeck Memorial in present-day Zambia. He was instructed by the British to march north to Abercorn (now Mbala) to surrender his undefeated army, which he did there on 23 November.  In 1915 the Survivors of the light Cruiser Königsberg, the Artillery of the Königsberg and the Crew of the auxiliary ship Somali joined his army. His remaining army then consisted of 30 German officers, 125 German non-commissioned officers and other enlisted ranks, 1,168 Askaris and some 3,500 porters.
dst: 莱托-福尔贝克同意在现处停火，此地如今就是位于今日赞比亚的冯·莱托-福尔贝克纪念碑所在地。英军指示他向北行军至阿伯康（今姆巴拉），在那里交出他那支从未战败的军队，他于11月23日在那里照办了。1915年，轻巡洋舰「柯尼斯堡」号的幸存者、「柯尼斯堡」号的炮兵以及辅助舰「索马里」号的船员加入了他的军队。他剩余的军队当时由30名德国军官、125名德国士官及其他士兵、1168名阿斯卡里士兵和约3500名挑夫组成。

src: Leutnant Alfred Seeboehm's signals intercept unit reports that the Tiger convoy with over 200 tanks and over 40 Hurricanes has arrived in Alexandria 3 days ago. Wavell will use that equipment in a major offensive soon.
dst: 阿尔弗雷德·泽博姆中尉的无线电侦听部队报告，载有200多辆坦克和40多架“飓风”的“老虎”运输船队已于3天前抵达亚历山大。韦维尔很快就会用这批装备发动一场大规模攻势。
利包突袭，1915年5月20日（旧历7日）

src: Liberating Vardar Macedonia is an old Bulgarian aspiration that now you, commanding our 2nd Army, can finally make true.
dst: 解放瓦尔达尔马其顿是保加利亚一个古老的夙愿，如今，指挥我们第2集团军的您终于可以将其实现了。

src: Liberation of Carei-Satu Mare area - 22 October 1944
dst: 卡雷伊-萨图马雷地区解放战 — 1944年10月22日
解放埃迪尔内 - 大捷
解放埃迪尔内 - 失败
解放埃迪尔内 - 胜利

src: Lidzki pulk/ I Bryg./ 1st Dyw. Litewsko-Bialoruska
dst: Lidzki 团/ 第1旅/ 第1师 Litewsko-Bialoruska

src: Liebe Dame, let me express my sincere condolences over the loss of your beloved son. Your husband was finally strong enough to speak and he assured me that Erich didn't suffer. I understand that this won't lessen your grieve too much, but I think you need to know that.
dst: 亲爱的夫人，请允许我对你痛失爱子致以诚挚的哀悼。你丈夫终于有力气开口了，他向我保证，埃里希没有受苦。我明白这并不能减轻你多少悲痛，但我想你应该知道这一点。
大利耶拉尤格拉河 (大亚格尔河)
利尔斯陶佩 (陶佩, 罗普)

src: Lieutenant Dhanis was supposed to join you with over 3,000 troops. But the Batetela in his column have rebelled and have killed most of their Belgian officers. Dhanis is one of the few men who was able to escape. Needless to say, the march up the Nile to Khartoum has been cancelled.
dst: 达尼斯中尉本应率领3000多人的部队与您会合。但他队伍中的巴特特拉人发动了叛乱，杀死了大部分比利时军官。达尼斯是少数得以逃脱的人之一。不用说，沿尼罗河北上喀土穆的行军已经取消。

src: Lieutenant, welcome to Dungu in the North-East of the Congo Free State. Seven riffle companies of Askaris and 500 spearmen of the Azande tribe are ready to start our march to the Nile.
dst: 中尉，欢迎来到刚果自由邦东北部的栋古。七个阿斯卡里步枪连和500名阿赞德族长矛手已准备就绪，即将开始我们向尼罗河的进军。

src: Lieutenant, you must be ashamed of yourself!
dst: 中尉，您应该为自己感到羞耻！

src: Lieutenant-Colonel Bertaux-Levillain, congratulations! It took longer than expected, but you have met all your goals. The Chinese have however not given up. It might take beating them in Tonkin to make them meet our demands.
dst: 贝尔托-勒维兰中校，恭喜！虽然耗时比预期更长，但您已达成全部目标。然而中国人并未放弃。可能还得在东京击败他们，才能迫使他们接受我们的要求。

src: Lieutenant-Colonel Bertaux-Levillain, congratulations! You have met all your goals. The Chinese have however not given up. It might take beating them in Tonkin to make them meet our demands.
dst: 贝尔托-勒维兰中校，祝贺您！您已实现了所有目标。然而中国人并未放弃。也许非得在东京击败他们，才能迫使他们满足我们的要求。

src: Lieutenant-Colonel Bertaux-Levillain, unfortunately you have not met all your goals. Now we have to beat the Chinese in Tonkin itself to make them meet our demands.
dst: 贝尔托-勒维兰中校，很遗憾您未能达成全部目标。现在我们必须在东京本土击败中国人，才能迫使他们接受我们的要求。

src: Lieutenant-Colonel Bertaux-Levillain, you are ordered to defeat the Chinese navy, land 1,800 marine infantry of the corps expéditionnaire de Formose in Keelung - northern Formosa, capture the Pei-tao coal mines and move inland. This should put enough pressure on the Chinese to give in to our demands.
dst: 贝尔托-勒维兰中校，您奉命击败中国海军，让台湾远征军的1800名海军步兵在台湾北部的基隆登陆，夺取北岛煤矿并向内陆推进。这应能对中国施加足够压力，使其接受我们的要求。

src: Light flak and tank in Russia, 21 June 1941.
dst: 俄罗斯的轻型高射炮与坦克，1941年6月21日。

src: Likely we'll get outflanked east and west from here, in Ser and Dojran Lake, so we'll have to make an orderly retreat to safer positions.
dst: 我们很可能在这里的东西两侧、在塞雷和多伊兰湖遭到迂回包抄，因此我们必须有条不紊地撤退到更安全的阵地。
林巴日 (莱姆斯劳, 莱姆萨尔)

src: Limited All Weather ability for advanced Planes and Radar AD
dst: 先进飞机与雷达防空单位具备有限的全天候能力

src: Limited choices of units when buying new equipment during game (No Buy used on Efile)
dst: 游戏中购买新装备时可选单位有限（Efile 上使用“不购买”）

src: Lines have stabilized after your retreat from Normandy. Hitler has gathered all available forces for a counterattack. Your division and the 9thSS Hohenstaufen form the 2SS Pz Corps. The original plan called for you to exploit the initial success of the 1SS Pz Corps attack on the northern shoulder of our attack through the Ardennes. The enemy however has stalled the LSSAH's attack. The goal of advancing as far west as Antwerp and cutting the Allied forces in half looks out of reach.
dst: 你们从诺曼底撤退后，战线已趋稳定。希特勒集结了所有可用兵力发动反击。你的师和党卫军第9“霍恩施陶芬”师组成党卫军第2装甲军。原计划要求你利用党卫军第1装甲军经阿登进攻我方攻势北肩所取得的初步战果。然而敌人已迟滞了警卫旗队的进攻。向西推进至安特卫普、把盟军拦腰切断的目标看来已难以企及。
利普托夫斯基圣米库拉什
利普托夫斯基赫拉多克

src: Listen, Commander, it was a real fine thing you did back there in D.C., but your work isn't done yet.  The rebs are closing in on New York and we need you there pronto.
dst: 听着，指挥官，你在华盛顿干得确实是件了不起的事，但你的活儿还没完。叛军正在逼近纽约，我们需要你立刻赶到那里。

src: Littorio and 15th Panzer are ready to close breakthroughs in the Northern sector and Ariete and 21st Panzer are ready to do the same in the South. Trieste and 90 Leichte Afrika division are in reserve near the coast.
dst: “利托里奥”师和第15装甲师已准备好在北面封闭突破口，“公羊”师和第21装甲师也准备在南面做同样的事。“的里雅斯特”师和第90轻装非洲师作为预备队驻于海岸附近。

src: Livy describes the scene with the Veientines holed up in their city, the main Roman force encamped outside and a second force set to attack from within via the tunnel. After this prayer from Camillus,
dst: 李维描写了那一幕：维爱人困守城中，罗马主力在城外扎营，另有一支部队准备经地道从城内进攻。在卡米卢斯做了这番祈祷之后，

src: Liège and Namur may have fallen, but the ring of fortifications around Antwerp is stronger. We'll be safe here for some time.
dst: 列日和那慕尔或许已经陷落，但安特卫普周围的堡垒环更为坚固。我们在这里将安全一段时间。
利亚诺·德·拉·恩科米恩达

src: Lloyd George has asked "The Bull" to present him Jerusalem for Christmas...
dst: 劳合·乔治已要求「公牛」在圣诞节前把耶路撒冷献给他……
洛博伊基夫卡 (洛博伊科夫卡)

src: Local weather conditions seem to be clear for the moment, so if you have any pilots itching to get their flying time in, now's as good as ever.  Don't expect any help from the other airbases though; their lungs are still filled with sand.
dst: 当地天气目前似乎晴朗，所以如果你有飞行员急于累积飞行时数，现在正是时候。不过别指望其他空军基地帮忙；他们的肺里还塞满沙子。
洛迪装甲和奥斯塔/-/因佩里亚利

src: Lodz is in our hands and Poland will soon fall.
dst: 罗兹已在我手，波兰很快将陷落。

src: Lodz is in our hands and Poland will soon fall.  More importantly for the LSSAH however, is that our efforts have been recognised.  We have been awarded a special standard in light of our heavy casualties in the Polish campaign.  We move now to Czechoslovakia for rest and relaxation.
dst: 罗兹已在我军手中，波兰即将陷落。然而对警卫旗队而言更重要的是，我们的努力得到了认可。鉴于我们在波兰战役中的惨重伤亡，我部获授一面特殊军旗。我们现在开赴捷克斯洛伐克休整。

src: Loehr wil now begin to regroup our forces and start a fighting retreat that will probably only end north of Thermopylae. We could off course try to keep the Corinth Canal,but that would expose us to naval gunfire, and be far to dangerous. It is rumoued that your troops, that are not needed in this strategy, will be transferred to France.
dst: 勒尔现在将着手重整我们的部队，开始一场且战且退的撤退，这场撤退大概只会在温泉关以北才告结束。我们当然可以试着守住科林斯运河，但那会使我们暴露在舰炮火力之下，实在太危险。有传言说，这场战略中并不需要的您的部队将被调往法国。
洛马德拉斯特林切拉斯
隆巴尔齐德 (隆巴尔兹德)
罗蒙诺索夫 (奥拉宁鲍姆)

src: London is almost surrounded and in the north our troops fighting their way further towards Nottingham. At time we will only besiege London and hope that the British will seek a cease-fire soon. A lossy struggle in the urban area should be the last option to bring the Brits to the negotiating table.
dst: 伦敦几乎被包围，在北面我们的部队正一路杀向诺丁汉。眼下我们只会围困伦敦，希望英国人很快寻求停火。在城区进行一场消耗战，应是把英国人拉上谈判桌的最后手段。

src: London is too heavily fortified to take, but we should be able to circumvent it and cut it off from the rest of the country. Take Windsor - it has strategic as well as political importance. It will have a great effect on the moral of the English if we are in control of the town where their King live!
dst: 伦敦设防太森严，难以攻克，但我们应能绕过它，把它与全国其他地区隔绝。夺取温莎——它兼具战略与政治意义。若能控制英王所居之城，必将极大打击英国人的士气！

src: London is within eyeshot, but England go on help their Allies - USA,
dst: 伦敦已遥遥在望，但英格兰仍在获得其盟友——美国的援助，

src: Long-standing followers like Titus Labienus have already deserted to the enemy! But Caesar can still count on loyal friends! In front of the whole army Caesar wants to praise the Legate of the Legio V !:
dst: 像提图斯拉比埃努斯这样的多年追随者已经投奔敌营！但凯撒仍可倚仗忠诚的朋友！凯撒要在全军面前褒奖第五军团的副将！：
最长路线：14 个场景（线性）

src: Look at one: We know them yet! In front of us are the contracted troops of Lentulus, Gellius and Arrius, or what's left of it them. It's time to destroy them finally …
dst: 看看吧：这些家伙我们认得！我们面前是伦图卢斯、盖利乌斯与阿里乌斯拼凑起来的部队，或者说他们的残部。是时候彻底消灭他们了……

src: Look who's here, after all those years! General, it's you! How long has it been since we last met? I had heard that you had retired and that you had moved to Idaho with your family. Thank God that it was just an absurd rumor.
dst: 瞧瞧，这么多年过去，是谁来了！将军，是您啊！我们上次见面到现在多久了？我听说您已经退役，和家人一起搬到了爱达荷州。谢天谢地，那只是个荒唐的谣言。

src: Look! Among the prisoners we have the Bulgarian commander himself! This is the icing on the cake of a great victory for Romania.
dst: 瞧！俘虏当中竟有保加利亚指挥官本人！这对罗马尼亚来说，是一场伟大胜利之上的锦上添花。

src: Looked like rough fighting out there, Commander, but you sure as hell did it.   Ivan won't be coming back to this god-forsaken iceberg anytime soon, and soon enough our bombers are going to have an express ticket to the Russian motherland.
dst: 那边打得挺艰难，指挥官，但你他娘的确实做到了。伊万短期内不会再回到这座鬼地方了，而用不了多久，我们的轰炸机就能拿到直飞俄罗斯本土的机票。
洛斯: 霍亨索伦堡垒

src: Lord Kitchener wanted to wait with a major British military offensive until his new volunteer army was ready - in 1916 or even 1917. By that time the Russians and French would be exhausted, it would be Britain that would gain the victory and could set conditions at the negotiating table, without having to take its allies into account. In the mean time, gains were to be had at Gallipoli (starting April 1915).
dst: 基钦纳勋爵想等到他的新志愿军在1916年甚至1917年准备就绪后，再发动大规模的英军攻势。到那时，俄国人和法国人已筋疲力尽，赢得胜利的将是英国，并且可以在谈判桌上设定条件，而无需考虑其盟友。与此同时，可以在加利波利取得战果（从1915年4月开始）。

src: Lord Methuen's British First Division is marching north, to lift the siege of Kimberley. We have taken positions at the kopjes near Belmont station, where we hope to slow the advance of the Kakies. That will give us enough time to build better defences at the Modder River. Confront the invaders while our other commandoes retreat to our second line. We know that Methuen's troops are the only ones that the British have sent this area, so while they're busy fighting you our other units will be able to march unmolested.
dst: 梅休因勋爵的英国第1师正向北开进，以解金伯利之围。我们已在贝尔蒙特车站附近的小山丘上占据阵地，希望在那里迟滞英国佬的推进。这将给我们足够的时间在莫德河构筑更坚固的防线。您要迎击入侵者，同时让我们的其他突击队撤向第二道防线。我们知道梅休因的部队是英军派往此地的唯一力量，所以趁他们忙于与您交战时，我们的其他部队就能不受干扰地行军。

src: Los fascistas han detenido en seco nuestra ofensiva, nos hemos quedado a las puertas de Gandesa y la aviacion Italoalemana nos hostiga continuamente. La ofensiva ha fracasado rotundamente, nuestra unica opcion ahora es retirar nuestras tropas para evitar mayores bajas.
dst: 法西斯分子彻底遏止了我军攻势，我们止步于甘德萨城下，意德空军不断袭扰我们。攻势已彻底失败，如今我们唯一的选择就是撤出部队，以避免更大的伤亡。

src: Los franceses han comenzado a enviar suministros a los republicanos, y además han desbloqueado las armas soviéticas. Gracias a su retraso en Barcelona, la guerra se alargará. dst: 法国人已开始向共和军运送补给，而且还放行了苏联武器。由于您在巴塞罗那的延误，战争将会拖长。共和军现在会竭力固守阵地，等待国际形势促成法国干预。

src: Los motivos de esta ofensiva son varios, por un lado el objetivo principal es embolsar al enemigo, pero tambien alejar a los fascistas definitivamente de Madrid y conseguir que estos retiren parte de sus tropas del frente Norte, para asi aliviar la presion ejercida sobre el mismo. Desde algunas instancias tambien se espera que esta ofensiva de lugar al final de la guerra, pero entre nosotros, creo que eso es algo complicado.
dst: 这次攻势的理由有好几个：一方面，主要目标是包围敌人，但同时也要把法西斯分子彻底赶离马德里，并促使他们从北方战线撤走部分兵力，从而减轻北方战线所承受的压力。有些部门还指望这次攻势能带来战争的结束，但咱们私下说，我觉得那有点难。

src: Luckily the muslim tribal sheikhs have chosen our side. We have armed the tribesmen with some of the 25,000 Mauser riffles that we shipped into Trablus on the Derna  - only days before Italy declared war on September 29. And now we are ready to retake ownership of Trablus. Most of the troops are positioned to the South-East of Trablus, between the gardens and palm trees where the Italian ships cannot provide accurate fire support.
dst: 幸运的是，穆斯林部落酋长们选择了站在我们这边。我们用从德尔纳号运进的25000支毛瑟步枪中的一部分武装了部落战士——那是在意大利于9月29日宣战的几天前。如今我们已准备好夺回的黎波里。大部分部队部署在的黎波里东南，位于花园和棕榈树之间，那里意大利军舰无法提供精确的炮火支援。

src: Luckily, we're still resisting the Italian attacks at the Isonzo front. To be sincere, I've already lost count of the times that they've tried to storm our positions. Nine? Ten? I can't tell. I know that we can't resist forever, though. We must send reinforcements to the Isonzo before the spring comes.
dst: 幸运的是，我们在伊松佐战线仍顶住了意大利人的进攻。说实话，我已经记不清他们试图强攻我们阵地的次数了。九次？十次？我说不清。不过我知道，我们不可能永远抵挡下去。我们必须在春天到来之前向伊松佐派出援军。

src: Magnificent performance General.  We've secured the bridge at Primasole and the port of Catania has fallen to us - though not after a tough fight against a crack German Parachute Division.  The advance will continue on up the coast to Messina, however your unit has been withdrawn and placed in reserve for future operations.
dst: 表现堪称卓越，将军。我们已拿下普里马索莱桥，卡塔尼亚港也已落入我手——尽管这之前与一支精锐德国伞兵师打了一场硬仗。推进将继续沿海岸北上墨西拿，不过你的部队已被撤下，编入预备队以备后用。

src: Magnificent! The enemy has surrendered and we have captured many prisoners and equipment. Eraúl will show the liberals that they will not beat us merely sending isolated columns through the mountains of Navarra.
dst: 太棒了！敌人已经投降，我们俘获了大量俘虏和装备。埃劳尔将向自由派证明，仅凭向纳瓦拉山区派出孤立的纵队，是打不败我们的。

src: Magnificent, General! Despite the lack of substantial artillery support we have repulsed the Turkish counter-attack that could have easily pushed us back all the way down to ANZAC cove. Even though the breakout has not been a total success we have at least achieved some territorial gains and could establish new positions at Sari Bair ridge.
dst: 了不起，将军！尽管缺乏有力的炮兵支援，我们仍击退了土耳其人的反攻——这次反攻本可能轻易将我们一路推回澳新军团湾。虽然突围并非完全成功，但我们至少取得了一些领土进展，并得以在萨里拜尔山脊建立新阵地。

src: Magnificent. The Germans have been forced to stop their assault after suffering extremely high losses. Soon their spring offensive will die out, as well as their last hopes of victory. But I must not anticipate events. Parts of the front are still in danger, and we'll need your skills there to thwart the plans of our enemies.
dst: 太出色了。德军在遭受极其惨重的损失后，被迫停止了进攻。很快，他们的春季攻势就会逐渐熄火，他们最后的胜利希望也将随之破灭。但我不该过早预言事态的发展。前线的部分地区仍处于危险之中，我们需要您在那里施展才能，挫败敌人的计划。

src: Magnifico!, los italianos huyen despaboridos mientras los rebeldes tratan de mantener las lineas de frente. Esta derrota despeja por completo el peligro sobre Madrid, al menos por el momento, y nos posibilitara empezar a pensar en acciones ofensivas en semanas posteriores.
dst: 太棒了！意大利人仓皇逃窜，而叛军则试图维持战线。这次失败彻底解除了马德里面临的危险，至少目前如此，也让我们得以开始考虑在接下来几周里采取攻势行动。

src: Mainland Greece is under control and the Guns of Navarone have been destroyed. Now the approaches to Crete are secure. Your experienced task force will carry out the initial landings on Crete, alongside our German ally.
dst: 希腊本土已在控制之下，纳瓦隆大炮也已被摧毁。如今通往克里特岛的道路已经安全。你这支经验丰富的特遣部队将与我们的德国盟友一道，在克里特岛实施最初的登陆。

src: Mainland Greece is under control, but the greek islands still need to be captured. Herr General, you and your men have been selected to invade the island of Crete by air and sea. Codename: Merkur (Mercury).
dst: 希腊本土已在我控制之下，但希腊的岛屿仍需夺取。将军阁下，你与你的部下已被选中，从空中与海上入侵克里特岛。代号：墨丘利（Merkur，水星）。

src: Mainland Greece is under control, but the greek islands still need to be captured. Herr General, you and your men have been selected to invade the island of Crete by air and sea. Experienced paratroopers and an italian fleet will assist you in this operation. Codename: Merkur.

src: Major, I have bad news for you. The front has collapsed; your battalion has been wiped out. Even if your injuries were to miraculously heal, you will never be entrusted with command again.
dst: 少校，我有坏消息要告诉你。战线已崩溃；你的营已全军覆没。即便你的伤势奇迹般痊愈，也再不会被委以指挥权了。

src: Major, The Russo-German front has collapsed.  In September, Riga fell to an unprecedented stormtrooper attack.  The Russians have retreated in disarray.  All that prevents the Germans from rolling toward Tallinn and Petrograd is the island-fortress of Osel (Saaremaa).
dst: 少校，俄德战线已经崩溃。9月，里加在一次史无前例的突击队进攻中陷落。俄军已混乱地撤退。唯一能阻止德军直扑塔林和彼得格勒的，就是厄塞尔岛（萨雷马岛）这一岛礁要塞。

src: Major, just recently Estonia has declared her independent status from the crumbling Russian Empire.  At this time, Germany has launched an offensive against Russia to force compliance with the Brest-Litovsk terms.  Germany has agreed to guarantee Estonian independence.
dst: 少校，就在最近，爱沙尼亚宣布脱离摇摇欲坠的俄罗斯帝国、取得独立地位。此时，德国已对俄国发动攻势，以迫使其履行布列斯特-立托夫斯克条款。德国已同意保证爱沙尼亚的独立。

src: Many of our divisions have been moved from the Verdun sector to the Somme, stopping the Entente attacks with heavy - specifically British - losses. But the Brits don't give up. After they captured our first line of defence, enemy activity has been noticed near Flers. Strengthen the defences and make sure the enemy does not break through our third line of defence.
dst: 我们的许多师已从凡尔登地段调往索姆河，以沉重的——尤其是英军的——伤亡遏制了协约国的进攻。但英国人并不放弃。他们攻占我们的第一道防线后，弗莱尔附近已发现敌军活动。加强防御，务必不让敌人突破我们的第三道防线。

src: Many officers want to attack our enemies in France immediately, before they can react, but that's too risky. If anything goes wrong we'll go nowhere, just like in 1914. No, if we want to have real chances of winning we have to plan our final offensive down to the last detail. And that needs time and patience. I don't think we'll be ready before next year.
dst: 许多军官想趁敌人还没反应过来，立即在法国发动进攻，但那太冒险了。一旦出了差错，我们就会像1914年那样一事无成。不，如果我们真想有获胜的把握，就必须把最后攻势的每个细节都谋划周全。而那需要时间和耐心。我看明年之前我们是准备不好的。

src: Many thanks to Craig Miller and all the other campaign designers for the various versions of the famous SSI Blitzkrieg campaign, a benchmark campaign and source of inspiration.
dst: 非常感谢 Craig Miller 以及所有其他战役设计者，他们创作了著名 SSI《闪电战》战役的各种版本，那是一座标杆，也是灵感之源。

src: Many things have changed in the last year. In Madrid Amadeo I abdicated, sick of the fact that even his top aides didn't pay the slightest attention to him. The foreign was suceeded by a republic, whose government is even more unpopular and weak.
dst: 过去一年发生了许多变化。在马德里，阿马德奥一世宣布退位，因为他已厌倦了连他最亲近的侍从都对他毫不理睬。这个外国人被一个共和国所取代，而共和国的政府则更加不得人心、更加软弱。

src: Marash and other similar engagements were a proof that the Turkish revolutionaries weren't going to fulfill any agreement that questioned the complete Turkish sovereignty over Anatolia, and that the Ottoman administration didn't have any control over the rebels. And they also proved that France, Italy and the British Empire weren't willing to lose more soldiers and resources in a new war in Turkey. They had already obtained what they wanted so, if pressed hard enough, they would eventually retire from Anatolia. They wouldn't fight and die defending the Greek or the Armenian interests.

src: Marius took up a strong position on a carefully selected hill and enticed the Teutones to attack him there using his cavalry and light infantry skirmishers (most of whom were allied Ligurians). The leading Teutone elements, the Ambrones, took the bait and attacked. They were soon foolishly followed by the rest of the horde. Meanwhile, Marius had hidden a small Roman force of 4,000 nearby. At the battle's height this force launched an ambush, attacking the Teutones from behind, and throwing them into confusion and rout. The Roman accounts claim that in the ensuing massacre 90,000 Teutones were slain and 20,000 including their King Teutobod, were captured. The only surviving reports are Roman, but certainly the complete annihilation of the Teutones and Ambrones speaks to the crushing nature of their defeat.
dst: 马略在一座精心选择的山丘上占据强固阵地，用骑兵与轻装散兵（其中大多是盟邦利古里亚人）诱使条顿人来攻。条顿人的前锋安布罗内斯人上了钩，发动进攻。其余部众也愚蠢地跟着冲了上去。与此同时，马略在附近埋伏了一支4,000人的罗马小部队。战至高潮，这支部队发起突袭，从背后攻击条顿人，使其陷入混乱与溃散。据罗马方面的记载，随后的屠杀中有90,000名条顿人被杀，20,000人被俘，其中包括他们的国王条顿博德。现存记载只有罗马一方的，但条顿人与安布罗内斯人被彻底歼灭，无疑说明了他们失败之惨烈。

src: Maybe I've found the solution to our problem. And I'm very interested about your opininon. I believe that the key is in the air. If we can break the French airforce and roam the skies free, than we must breakthrough at any place desired, 'hedgehogs' or not. What do you think?"
dst: 也许我找到了解决问题的办法。我很想听听你的意见。我认为关键在空中。如果我们能击垮法国空军，自由翱翔于天空，那么无论有没有“刺猬”，我们都必须在任何想要的地方突破。你觉得呢？”

src: Maybe the hot Italian summer has had a bad effect on you, but your performance has been truly disappointing. However, after your units were retired from the front the Austrians could finally reach the Adriatic and saved us from a humiliating defeat. Italy has announced that it'll unconditionally surrender to us, in the hopes of avoiding Austria’s harsh terms.
dst: 也许是炎热的意大利夏天对您产生了不良影响，但您的表现确实令人失望。不过，您的部队从前线撤下之后，奥地利人终于抵达了亚得里亚海，使我们免于一场耻辱的失败。意大利已宣布将无条件向我们投降，以期避开奥地利苛刻的条件。

src: Maybe we should send some additional men to the east while our main force advance on the western shore.
dst: 也许我们应该在主力沿西岸推进的同时，向东面增派一些人手。

src: Maykop was captured on 9 August while Krasnodar was captured on 11 August. The port towns of Anapa and Novorossiysk were captured on 31 August and 6 September respectively. But the Axis offensive slowed down and eventually stalled in the mountains. The goal to reach the port town of Tuapse was never achieved.
dst: 迈科普于8月9日被攻占，克拉斯诺达尔于8月11日被攻占。港口城镇阿纳帕和新罗西斯克分别于8月31日和9月6日被攻占。但轴心国的攻势放缓，最终在山区停滞。抵达港口城镇图阿普谢的目标始终未能实现。
马扎尤格拉河(凯特亚格尔)

src: Me alegra verle de nuevo, General. Bien, después de asegurar la victoria en Guipuzcoa, debemos de cambiar la atención hacia Asturias. Desde Julio, nuestros valientes camaradas han estado sufriendo el asedio de los rojos. En Gijón, los cuarteles del ejército han sido rodeados sin remisión, con lo que nuestros hombres permanecen allí atrapados, con cada vez menos municiones, suministros y la moral en descenso, con lo que están al borde del colapso. Probablemente, en el futuro solo recibiremos malas noticias de Gijón. En Oviedo, el coronel Aranda ha logrado asegurar la ciudad y ha establecido un perímetro defensivo mínimo, que le da algo de aire por el momento. Sin embargo, la capital asturiana está a punto de caer también.
dst: 很高兴再次见到您，将军。好，确保吉普斯夸的胜利之后，我们必须把注意力转向阿斯图里亚斯。自7月以来，我们英勇的战友一直在承受共和军的围攻。在希洪，军队的兵营已被彻底包围，我们的人被困在那里，弹药和补给日益减少，士气不断下降，已濒临崩溃。或许今后我们从希洪收到的只会是坏消息。在奥维耶多，阿兰达上校已成功守住该城，并建立起一道最低限度的防御圈，暂时让他得以喘息。然而，阿斯图里亚斯的首府也快要陷落了。

src: Me alegra verle de nuevo, Sr. General.  Well, after securing a victory at Guipuzcoa, we must turn our attention to Asturias.  Since July our brave comrades have been suffering under siege from the Reds.  In Gijon, our quarters have been surrounded and our men trapped.  They are rapidly running out of supplies and can barely continue resisting.   So in the future we can only anticipate more bad news from Gijon.  In Oviedo Colonel Aranda has secured the city.   However, the Asturian capital is also under siege and about to fall.
dst: 很高兴再次见到您，将军阁下。我们在吉普斯夸取得胜利之后，必须把注意力转向阿斯图里亚斯。自7月以来，我们勇敢的同志一直遭受赤色分子的围攻。在希洪，我们的营地被包围，弟兄们被困其中。他们的补给正迅速耗尽，几乎无法继续抵抗。因此今后我们只能预料从希洪传来更多坏消息。在奥维耶多，阿兰达上校已控制该城。然而，这座阿斯图里亚斯首府同样被围，即将陷落。

src: Me and my former Comrades have foundeed many gymnastics Clubs, Pubs, Factories... and Families...
dst: 我和昔日的战友们创办了许多体操俱乐部、酒馆、工厂……以及家庭……

src: Meanwhile French light troops intervened in the Neufchateau area but were forced to retreat behind the Maas River.
dst: 与此同时，法国轻装部队在讷沙托地区介入，但被迫撤退到马斯河之后。

src: Meanwhile in the bright waters of the south atlantic ocean our cruiser got trapped in the port of Montevideo. Your orders are: Break through the allied blockade and reach the open ocean. Take course back to Germany.
dst: 与此同时，在南大西洋明媚的海面上，我们的巡洋舰被困在了蒙得维的亚港。你的命令是：突破盟军封锁，抵达开阔海域，然后返航德国。

src: Meanwhile it has become quite clear that England is no longer a great power. They are bound hand and feet to the Americans, that still insist on an unconditional surrender.
dst: 与此同时，已经十分清楚的是，英国不再是一个大国。它已被美国人牢牢捆住手脚，而美国人仍坚持无条件投降。

src: Meanwhile the Germans are building defense lines in the Apennine Mountains...
dst: 与此同时，德国人正在亚平宁山脉修建防线……

src: Meanwhile the main Cimbri army  came up against Catulus. The Cimbri, who were more used to the cooler climate of the North had to fight with the heat of the southern countries. The Romans, however, were hardened by their years of training so the heat made them no problems.
dst: 与此同时，辛布里主力迎上了卡图卢斯。辛布里人更习惯北方较凉的气候，不得不忍受南方国度的酷热。而罗马人多年训练早已磨硬了筋骨，炎热对他们不成问题。

src: Meanwhile two German cruisers had made their way to Istanbul: the SMS Goeben and the SMS Breslau. Both ships were soon purchased by Ottoman Navy and, still manned by Germans, they improved the Turkish defences. Being on patrol, on October 29th, they spotted the Russian mine-layer Prut ready to lay mines near the Turkish coast. The mine-layer was sunk, the Ottoman cruisers devastated a few Russian ports as a retaliation and, as soon as the incident was known, on October 31st the Ottoman Empire declared war against Russia.
dst: 与此同时，两艘德国巡洋舰抵达了伊斯坦布尔：格本号和布雷斯劳号。两舰很快被奥斯曼海军买下，仍由德国人驾驶，增强了土耳其的防御。10月29日，正在巡逻的它们发现了俄国布雷舰普鲁特号，它正准备在土耳其海岸附近布雷。布雷舰被击沉，奥斯曼巡洋舰作为报复，摧毁了俄国几个港口，这一事件一经传出，10月31日奥斯曼帝国即向俄国宣战。

src: Meanwhile, General Stopford was dismissed by Hamilton on August 15th. Stopford was blamed for the failure of the Suvla operation, but responsibility ultimately lay with Lord Kitchener who, as Secretary of State for War, had appointed the elderly and inexperienced general to an active corps command.
dst: 与此同时，斯托普福德将军于8月15日被汉密尔顿解职。斯托普福德被归咎为苏夫拉行动失败的责任人，但最终责任在于基钦纳勋爵，他身为陆军大臣，把这位年迈而缺乏经验的将军任命到了现役军的指挥岗位上。

src: Meanwhile, Samsonov's 2nd Army has invaded from Russian Poland from the south.  We expect them to strike the retreating German army in the flank.  Your division will be part of Scheidman's II Corps and is tasked with making contact with Samsonov's forces...
dst: 与此同时，萨姆索诺夫的第2集团军已从南面、自俄国波兰境内入侵。我们期望他们侧击撤退中的德军。您的师将隶属于沙伊德曼的第2军，任务是设法与萨姆索诺夫的部队取得联系……

src: Meanwhile, following the Spanish naval defeat at Santiago de Cuba, on 7 July Spanish relief squadron under rear admiral Cámara had been ordered to return immediately to Spain to face possible U.S. Navy operations against Spain itself. Without reinforcements the ultimate fall of Manila was inevitable but Spanish Governor Augustin was ordered to continue resistance in order to get a better negotiation position in the peace talks already under way.
dst: 与此同时，在西班牙舰队于圣地亚哥-德古巴海战失利后，7月7日，卡马拉少将指挥的西班牙救援分舰队奉命立即返航西班牙，以应对美国海军可能对西班牙本土发动的行动。没有增援，马尼拉的最终陷落不可避免，但西班牙总督奥古斯丁奉命继续抵抗，以便在已经展开的和谈中争取更有利的谈判地位。

src: Meanwhile, in the German states the victories against France had started an unstoppable wave of patriotic fervour, which caused that Bavaria, Baden, Württemberg and Hesse joined the North German Confederation during November. The German unification was almost complete.
dst: 与此同时，在德意志各邦，对法国的胜利掀起了一股不可阻挡的爱国热潮，致使巴伐利亚、巴登、符腾堡和黑森在十一月加入了北德意志邦联。德意志的统一已基本完成。

src: Meanwhile, the Komuch delegates were meeting in Ufa with representatives of other anti-Bolshevik governments, organisations and political parties. The most important one was the Provisional Siberian Government (PSG), created in Omsk at the end of June. Just like the Komuch, the majority of the PSG were members of the Socialist-Revolutionary Party, but thanks to the British influence, the Tsarists, the conservatives and the military officers still retained much power.
dst: 与此同时，科穆奇代表正在乌法与来自其他反布尔什维克政府、组织和政党的代表会晤。其中最重要的是西伯利亚临时政府（PSG），它于6月底在鄂木斯克成立。与科穆奇一样，西伯利亚临时政府的大多数成员也是社会革命党人，但得益于英国的影响，沙皇派、保守派和军官仍握有相当大的权力。

src: Meanwhile, the XV Army Corps was deployed in Galicia, helping the Germans and Austro-Hungarians to cope with the new tactics that the Russians had developed during the Brusilov Offensive.The Ottoman divisions had initially been deployed on the west bank of the Zolota Lipa River. But just a few weeks later, on September 2nd, the Russians started an offensive against the  lines of the Central Powers on the Zolota Lipa Valley.
dst: 与此同时，第十五军被部署在加利西亚，帮助德军和奥匈军队应对俄国人在布鲁西洛夫攻势中发展出的新战术。奥斯曼各师最初部署在佐洛塔利帕河西岸。但仅仅几周后，9月2日，俄国人在佐洛塔利帕河谷对同盟国战线发动了进攻。

src: Meanwhile, you will have to face the main enemy blow at the bend of Crna River. There, two Serbian divisions and three French divisions are ready to cross the river and take positions on its left bank. You must stop them at all cost, thus giving us enough time to organize our defence strategy.
dst: 与此同时，您将必须迎击敌军在茨尔纳河河湾的主攻。在那里，两个塞尔维亚师和三个法国师正准备渡河，并在河左岸占据阵地。您必须不惜一切代价阻止他们，从而给我们足够的时间来组织防御策略。
梅迪奥马特里奇人的秘密情报处

src: Menelik rejected the treaty as soon as he discovered the scam, and then the Italians accused him of violating its clauses. They threatened Menelik with war, and sent troops to Eritrea. In the meantime, Russia was the only country that believed and supported Ethiopia, and sent us arms, ammunition and military advisors.
dst: 孟尼利克一发现这场骗局便拒绝承认该条约，随后意大利人反咬一口，指责他违反条约条款。他们以战争相威胁，并向厄立特里亚派兵。与此同时，俄国是唯一相信并支持埃塞俄比亚的国家，为我们送来了武器、弹药和军事顾问。

src: Menelik was going to be the next recipient of Yohannes's rage, but once again the clergy managed to calm him down. The Emperor was a devout Christian, so he understood that defeating the Sudanese was a priority. Besides, while we were campaigning in Gojjam, Menelik had finally engaged the Mahdists forces, achieving a fine victory in Gute Dili. The Sudanese had been foolish enough to invade the Southwest of the country, which was part of Menelik's territory. This time his own lands were at risk, so he had to take the initiative and, indirectly, help the cause of his Emperor.
dst: 孟尼利克本将成为约翰尼斯怒火的下一个发泄对象，但教士们又一次设法让他平静下来。皇帝是一位虔诚的基督徒，所以他明白击败苏丹人才是当务之急。此外，当我们在戈贾姆作战时，孟尼利克终于与马赫迪军队交战，并在古特迪利取得了一场漂亮的胜利。苏丹人愚蠢到入侵该国西南部，而那正是孟尼利克的领地。这一次他自己的土地危在旦夕，于是他不得不主动出击，从而间接地助了他皇帝一臂之力。

src: Mersa Matruh is taken!, now, we must continue our drive on to Egypt.
dst: 马特鲁港已被拿下！现在，我们必须继续向埃及推进。

src: Mersa Matruh is taken!, the High Command wants to tell you that Operation Hercules will be launched in the next few hours to take the island of Malta, as a reward for your outstanding actions.
dst: 马特鲁港已被拿下！最高统帅部要告诉您，作为对您杰出表现的奖赏，赫拉克勒斯行动将在未来数小时内发起，以夺取马耳他岛。

src: Mi general, debo de comunicarle que, los republicanos han comenzado a atacar nuestras posiciones en Álava. Al parecer, su objetivo es romper las líneas nacionales y llegar a Vitoria. De momento la situación parece controlada, pero las cosas pueden ponerse serias si no tomamos precauciones.
dst: 将军，我得向您报告，共和军已开始进攻我们在阿拉瓦的阵地。看来，他们的目标是突破国民军防线，抵达维多利亚。目前局势似乎仍在掌控之中，但如果我们不采取防范措施，情况可能会变得严峻。

src: Mi general, debo de comunicarle que.  The Republicans have begun attacking our positions at Alava and northwards to Vitoria.  Their main goal is to cut our lines and then attack Vitoria.  This will be very serious if don't take care of it now.
dst: 将军阁下，我必须向您报告。共和派已开始进攻我们在阿拉瓦的阵地，并向北进攻维多利亚。他们的主要目标是切断我们的交通线，然后进攻维多利亚。如果我们现在不处理，这将非常严重。

dst: 见鬼！意大利人的攻势彻底搞砸了！不过，为了在墨索里尼面前保住颜面，我们必须撤换掉几位将军，而您的名字就在其中……我们不再需要您了。

src: Mis felicitaciones General.  The best troops of the Red army have been destroyed at Ebro.  We do not expect any further offensive operations from the Reds and we can soon begin to think of a victorious end to this war.
dst: 向您祝贺，将军。红军最精锐的部队已在埃布罗河被消灭。我们预计赤色分子不会再有进一步的进攻行动，我们很快就可以开始考虑如何胜利结束这场战争了。

src: Mis felicitaciones general. Las mejoras tropas de los rojos han sido eliminadas en el Ebro. No esperamos que de aquí en adelante puedan volver a llevar a cabo operaciones ofensivas. Pronto podremos comenzar a vislumbrar el victorioso final de esta guerra.
dst: 恭喜您，将军。共和军最精锐的部队已在埃布罗被歼灭。我们不认为此后他们还能发动进攻行动。很快我们就能开始看到这场战争胜利的结局了。

src: Mission accomplished, Herr General! You have beaten the Soviet attack. Unfortunately the Soviets have broken our lines further South. We have to abandon the siege of Tula!
dst: 任务完成，将军阁下！你击退了苏军的进攻。遗憾的是，苏军已在更南面突破了我军防线。我们不得不放弃对图拉的围攻！

src: Mission accomplished, Herr General. You have taken Tikhvin, and we control the eastern side of Lake Ladoga. Unfortunately, the weather is horrible and the Finns have not linked with us.
dst: 任务完成，将军阁下。你已拿下季赫温，我们控制了拉多加湖东岸。遗憾的是，天气极其恶劣，芬兰人还没有与我们会合。

src: Mission accomplished, Kiev will fall. As I see, it was a waste of time - we could have encircled Moscow by now... and there is another railway much further to the north which we cannot reach anyway. Who does the Gefreiter [private] think he is directing us like this?
dst: 任务完成，基辅即将陷落。依我看，这是浪费时间——我们现在本可以合围莫斯科了……而且北面更远处还有一条铁路，我们反正也够不着。那个上等兵以为他是谁，竟这样指挥我们？

src: Mission accomplished, as I see. It was a waste of time - we could have taken Leningrad and encircled Moscow by now.. and there is another railway much further to the north which we cannot reach anyway. Who does the Gefreiter [private] think he is commanding us about like this?
dst: 依我看，任务完成了。纯属浪费时间——我们本可以拿下列宁格勒、合围莫斯科了……而且北边更远处还有一条我们根本够不到的铁路。那个列兵自以为是谁，敢这样对我们指手画脚？

src: Mission accomplished. You have relieved our surrounded troops, and threw the Soviets into the sea!
dst: 任务完成。你解救了被围的我军部队，并把苏军赶下了海！

src: Mission accomplished. You were able to surprise the enemy and break into the eastern part of the Crimea. The way to Kerch and the Caucasus is open!
dst: 任务完成。你成功奇袭了敌人，突入克里米亚东部。通往刻赤和高加索的道路已经打开！

src: Mission: The chosen plan is to use two companies of Brandenburger and a battalion of San Marco to infiltrate in the coast of Malta, meanwhile the Raemcke Brigade and Folgore division will fall on the coast, after that, two infantry divisions will arrive by sea.
dst: 任务：选定的方案是用两连勃兰登堡部队和一个圣马可营渗透马耳他海岸，同时拉姆克旅和福尔戈雷师将在海岸实施空降，此后两个步兵师将经海路抵达。

src: Montgomery has initiated Operation Market Garden, which aims to bypass the Sigfried Line, cross the Rhine with large-scale forces, and trap the German 15th Army between Arnhem and the shores of the IJsselmeer.  The plan actually consists of two operations: Market - the seizure of bridges and other vital points by the First Airborne Army, and Garden - the northward advance of the British 2nd Army.  You will be attached to the 2nd Army, as part of XXX Corps.
dst: 蒙哥马利发动了市场花园行动，旨在绕过齐格菲防线、以大规模部队渡过莱茵河，并把德国第15集团军困在阿纳姆与艾瑟尔湖岸之间。该计划实际由两个行动组成：市场——由第1空降集团军夺取桥梁和其他要害；花园——英军第2集团军向北推进。你将作为第30军的一部分配属第2集团军。

src: Montgomery started his attack on the Mareth Line. First Armoured is to support him with a limited attack, taking Sened followed by Maknassy and the mountain pass East of Maknassy. 60th Infantry Regiment of the 9th Infantry Division is attached to your division for this attack.
dst: 蒙哥马利开始进攻马雷斯防线。第1装甲师奉命以有限攻势策应他——先取塞内德，继取马克纳西及其以东的山口。第9步兵师第60步兵团为此次进攻配属给你师。

src: Montreal is the last stand of the british and canadian forces. Smash them an the war in the west will end!
dst: 蒙特利尔是英军和加军的最后据点。击垮他们，西线的战争就会结束！

src: Morale is shaky but for the moment should hold.  We've told the townspeople that this is a drill preparing them for the event of a nuclear war.  I don't know how many people believe that story but it's certainly more believable than the truth.
dst: 士气不稳，但目前尚能维持。我们已告诉镇民这是一次为核战争做的演习。我不知道有多少人相信这套说辞，但它肯定比真相更可信。

src: More and more of their excellent tanks show up every day. Here they concentrated some fifty of them, including the fearsome T-34s and KVs. This will be the first time our brigade encounters them.
dst: 他们精良的坦克一天比一天多。这里集中了大约五十辆，其中包括令人生畏的 T-34 和 KV。这将是我们旅第一次遭遇它们。

src: More gifted writers, like Mr. Churchill, have already published their impressions on the aftermath of Omdurman, so I will not say anything else about the matter. However, I must confess that even today, some of my nights are haunted by the screams of thousands of agonizing Sudanese. I know the madness of the Dervishes had to be stopped, but I wonder if everything that happened was really necessary.
dst: 更有才华的作家，如丘吉尔先生，已经发表过他们对恩图曼战后景象的感想，因此我不再多谈此事。然而我必须坦白，即使在今天，我的一些夜晚仍会被成千上万垂死的苏丹人的惨叫声所纠缠。我知道必须阻止德尔维希人的疯狂，但我怀疑当时发生的一切是否真的都属必要。

src: More importantly we have re-established our defenses on the Don, but 4th Panzer Army could not break through and Hitler refused to allow a withdrawl!  4th Panzer Army is withdrawling back across the Chir and Manstein has called a General Cousel to discuss Strategy.
dst: 更重要的是，我们已在顿河重建防御，但第4装甲集团军无法突破，希特勒又不允许撤退！第4装甲集团军正撤回奇尔河对岸，曼施泰因已召开军事会议讨论战略。

src: More than a year ago, we reclaimed parts of Germany then designated as "Czechoslovakia". Now it is time to undo one of the greatest injustices ever - the Polish Corridor. In the past week, as we all know, tensions between Poland and us have risen and after several failed attempts at negotiating, we are now forced to invade.
dst: 一年多前，我们收复了当时被划为“捷克斯洛伐克”的德国领土。现在是时候纠正史上最大的不公之一——波兰走廊了。众所周知，过去一周波兰与我国的关系趋于紧张，在数次谈判失败后，我们如今被迫入侵。

src: More then two years ago the Germans began with their blockade of Leningrad. The pitful population of the town had to feel the pinch of hunger. We want to stop the blockade and push the Germans back. In the south and in the central sovietunion the Germans are withdrawed. I am sure they will withdraw their troops, if we will be able to lauch a great attack on the 16th Army.
dst: 两年多前，德国人开始了对列宁格勒的封锁。城中可怜的民众不得不忍受饥饿之苦。我们要终止封锁并把德国人打回去。在苏联南部和中部，德国人正在撤退。我确信，如果我们能对第16集团军发动一场大规模进攻，他们就会撤走部队。
莫朗库尔, 拉乌苏瓦, 拜济厄(图外)

src: Morning, Commander.  I hope you're rested and ready because today the high and mighty are throwing your men right into the shit.
dst: 早上好，指挥官。我希望你已休整好、随时待命，因为今天那些高高在上的大人物就要把你的手下直接扔进火坑里。

src: Morocco? The Atlantic swells off Casablanca present considerablle risks to an amphibious landing and there is a chance that the Axis will capture Tunis before we do. But our lines of communication will be safe.
dst: 摩洛哥？卡萨布兰卡外的大西洋涌浪给两栖登陆带来相当大的风险，且轴心国可能抢在我们之前攻占突尼斯城。但我们的交通线将安然无恙。
