src: Most important is Belgrade is captured, but we hoped your SS forces would be able to accomplish this task on their own, without the help from 2 Panzer divisions.
dst: 最重要的是贝尔格莱德已被拿下，但我们本希望你的党卫军部队能独自完成此任务，无需两个装甲师帮忙。

src: Most of Great Britain is under controll. Now we push further north. Inverness is the key to the Highlands. You need to take the city and the surrounding area. Intel reports only few enemy units in this area. Our ships did not make it in time as the way around the northern tip of Great Britain is much to long.
dst: 大不列颠大部已在我掌控之下。现在我们继续北上。因弗内斯是通往高地的钥匙。你需要夺取该城及周边地区。情报显示该地区敌军单位很少。我们的舰船没能及时赶到，因为绕过大不列颠北端的航程实在太长。

src: Most of Novorossiysk was occupied by the German and Romanian Armies on September 10, 1942.
dst: 1942年9月10日，德军和罗马尼亚军队占领了新罗西斯克的大部分地区。

src: Most of northern Tonkin was now in Chinese hands, except for Tuyen Quang, where a French contingent had been besieged since November of 1884. Desperately in need for a victory that could make them recover their morale, the French decided to send a relief column to Tuyen Quang and rescue their defenders. Naturally, the Chinese would do their best to thwart the enemy's plans.
dst: 北圻北部大部分地区现已落入中国人之手，只有宣光除外，那里的一支法国分遣队自1884年11月以来一直遭到围困。法国人急需一场能让他们重振士气的胜利，于是决定派出一支救援纵队前往宣光，营救那里的守军。自然，中国人会尽一切努力挫败敌人的计划。

src: Most of our former defences are useless now, and the enemy has very little presence in the area, so time will be your worst enemy. You will have to take Edirne quickly, so that we can consolidate our advance before signing a new peace treaty. Quick cavalry units, or infantry with transports, could be useful for that acomplishment.
dst: 我们昔日的大部分防御工事如今已无用处，敌人在该地区的存在也很少，所以时间将是您最大的敌人。您必须迅速夺取埃迪尔内，以便在签署新和平条约前巩固我们的推进。快速的骑兵部队，或配有运输工具的步兵，或许有助于完成这一任务。

src: Most of the 2nd Armored division and the 3rd Motorized Indian Brigade were destroyed or surrendered. But a lot of the corps troops and the 9th Australian Division escaped. Reconnaisance reports indicate that some of these troops are at Tobruk and that others are fleeing further East.
dst: 第2装甲师和印度第3摩托化旅的大部分被歼或投降。但许多军属部队和澳大利亚第9师逃脱了。侦察报告显示，这些部队一部分在托布鲁克，另一部分正向东更远处逃窜。

src: Most of the UN forces have escaped and you have suffered heavy causalities.  You, commander, will meet a People's Court to determine if you are a capitalist sympathizer.
dst: 大部分联合国军部队已经逃走，而你遭受了惨重伤亡。指挥官，你将面对人民法庭，以判定你是否是资本主义同情者。

src: Most of the attacking units are composed of Basque battalions.  We expected this attack from the East via the Mondragon Valley.  Headquarters doesn't think the Basque troops will be able to hold the lines they have established.  Unfortunately at that location we are not prepared to stop their offensive.  So you are ordered to deploy your troops in Alava and stop the enemy offensive as soon as possible.  One more thing, we have numerical air superiority thanks to our German friends, but as you have seen the Republican flown soviet planes are superior to the German planes.  Use your air power carefully.
dst: 进攻部队大多由巴斯克营组成。我们预料到这次进攻会经蒙德拉贡谷地从东面而来。司令部认为巴斯克部队无力守住他们建立的战线。遗憾的是，在那一带我们并未做好阻止他们攻势的准备。因此，您受命在阿拉瓦部署部队，尽快阻止敌军攻势。还有一点，多亏我们的德国朋友，我们在航空兵力上占有数量优势，但如您所见，共和派驾驶的苏联飞机优于德国飞机。请谨慎使用您的空中力量。

src: Most of the city was liberated on 9th May 1945, but there were lots of German snipers on rooftops, and those still killed people. Many other Germans flled westwards where they wished to enter American captivity, and those fought even several days after armistice.
dst: 该城大部于1945年5月9日解放，但屋顶上仍有大量德军狙击手继续杀人。许多其他德军向西逃窜，希望落入美军战俘营，这些人甚至在停战后还打了好几天。

src: Most of the soldiers remaining on the Italian front are starving, aimless, without hope very close to deserting like almost all of the Slavic soldiers already did. Your division is one of the very last combat-ready formations. Your job is to cover our retreat before it becomes complete chaos. General, save the life of your comrades and the reputation of the Hungarian hussars.
dst: 留在意军战线的大多数士兵都在挨饿，漫无目的，毫无希望，几近于像几乎所有斯拉夫士兵那样临阵脱逃。您的师是最后少数仍有战斗力的部队之一。您的任务是在全面混乱爆发前掩护我军撤退。将军，挽救您战友的生命，保住匈牙利骠骑兵的声誉。

src: Most of the soldiers that sympathized with the Socialist Revolutionary Party had already deserted, or even changed sides. And, on top of all, the Bolsheviks kept on attacking us, taking one village after another.
dst: 大多数同情社会革命党的士兵已经开小差，甚至倒戈。而雪上加霜的是，布尔什维克不断向我们进攻，一个又一个村庄地蚕食。

src: Most of your units are still engaged on the mainland and you can deploy only few core units.
dst: 你的大部分单位仍在大陆作战，你只能部署少数核心单位。

src: Most officers and NCOs spend the rest of the war learning and teaching.
dst: 大多数军官和士官在战争剩余的时间里都在学习和授课。

src: Most scenarios refer to a real battle, except the second one (Nagyszeben / Sibiu) which was kept for a better timeline. Although it is a semi-fictional scenario, there was a real chance of a Hungarian-Romanian war before the Second Vienna Award.
dst: 大多数剧本都以真实战役为题材，只有第二个剧本（纳吉塞本／锡比乌）例外，它是为了更合理的时间线而保留的。尽管这是一个半虚构剧本，但在第二次维也纳仲裁之前，匈牙利与罗马尼亚之间确实有爆发战争的可能。
摩托化步兵营/第144坦克旅 [24]
摩托化步兵营/第148坦克旅 [43]
摩托化/-/-/比利时殖民地摩托化旅群 [XXX]
摩托化/-/-/比利时殖民地摩托化旅群[XXX]

src: Mountaineous terrain, awful weather and a well dug in enemy, all these factors radically changed the operation. What was planned as a swift penetration of German lines, immediatelly turned into a position warfare. The total Czechoslovak loss toll for the whole Carpatho-Dukla Operation was 935 dead, 4518 wounded and 756 missing...
dst: 山地地形、恶劣天气和掘壕固守的敌人——所有这些因素彻底改变了行动性质。原计划的快速突破德军防线，立刻变成了阵地战。整个喀尔巴阡-杜克拉行动中捷克斯洛伐克人的总损失为：阵亡935人、负伤4518人、失踪756人……

src: Mounted Infantry Camel reg./ Desert Column
dst: 骑乘步兵骆驼团/ 沙漠纵队
骑乘步兵/ East London 旅
骑乘步兵/ King's 非洲步枪兵

src: Move 8 ground units into Lysjanka to complete this scenario.
dst: 把8个地面单位移动进入利相卡即可完成本剧本。

src: Move eastwards along the coast and capture all VHs in 14/17/20 turns for a BV/V/TV.
dst: 沿海岸向东推进，并在 14/17/20 回合内夺取全部胜利点，以获得 BV/V/TV。

src: Move forward to the east, capture Barcelona and take all VHs in 11/14/18 turns for a BV/V/TV.
dst: 向东推进，夺取巴塞罗那，并在 11/14/18 回合内夺取所有胜利点以获得 BV/V/TV。

src: Move north to the designated rendevous cabin, but if things get hairy, move to secure the road to your north so that we can bring in your full A.O. unit.  You won't be able to handle a full strength enemy force with just your recon group.
dst: 向北推进到指定的会合小屋，但若情况变得棘手，就转去夺取你北面的道路，以便让我们把你的整支 A.O. 部队开进来。仅靠你的侦察小队，你应付不了一支满编的敌军。

src: Move to hex 4-37 to enable supply hex.
dst: 移动到4-37格以启用补给格

src: Move with your ships south east, fight the English fleet and then attack the Liberty ships arriving from west.
dst: 率领你的军舰向东南方向移动，与英国舰队交战，然后攻击从西面驶来的自由轮。

src: Move you mobile forces east. The Infantry divisions will launch another attack on the perimeter without your useless help.
dst: 把你的机动部队东调。步兵各师将不再需要你无用的帮助，自行对外围防线发起又一次进攻。

src: Move your troops back South to join the rest of the division at Tienen and Sint-Margriete Houtem. The Gete line must be held until substantial British and French forces come to our rescue.
dst: 把您的部队撤回南方，到蒂嫩和圣玛格丽特-胡特姆与师其余部队会合。赫特河防线必须坚守，直到大批英法军队前来救援我们。

src: Move your troops westward along the Missouri now. The moment we have broken the last resistance of rebels in Boonville our connection lines are secured
dst: 现在沿密苏里河向西调动您的部队。一旦我们粉碎布恩维尔叛军最后的抵抗，我们的交通线就有了保障。

src: Movement is hindered in this swampy area interwoven with rivers, and all bridges and major roads are heavily guarded with anti-tank cannons, MGs, and field artillery. The enemy forces are mostly static, and the Soviets lack armoured units. Unfortunately they are achieving strategical air superiority, and Luftwaffe is so much depleted that the Soviet long-range airplanes can attack nearly unopposed both directly on frontline and deep in our rear.
dst: 这片河网交织的沼泽地带行军受阻，所有桥梁和主要道路都有反坦克炮、机枪和野战炮重兵把守。敌军多为静态部队，苏军缺乏装甲单位。遗憾的是，他们正取得战略制空权，而德国空军损耗殆尽，苏军远程飞机几乎可在无阻截的情况下同时攻击前线和我军纵深后方。
骑马侦察兵/4 E.S.R. 师
骑马侦察兵/7 E.S.R. 师
迫击炮/掷弹兵/第1步兵师 [I]

src: Much better for us. We'll have time to recover before resuming our advance. After we take all the hills surrounding Santiago Linares will be trapped there, unable to defend himself, and he'll regret not having been bolder when he had the chance.
dst: 这对我们好得多。在恢复推进之前，我们会有时间休整。待我们拿下圣地亚哥周围所有高地后，利纳雷斯将被困在那里，无力自保，到那时他会后悔当初有机会时没有更大胆一些。

src: Much of this victory is owed to you, General. You will go down in history as the greatest legitimist officer, even above Zumalacárregui. The King will soon thank you with a nobility title, and I know that he is thinking of you for the post of Minister of War. You have a bright political future, General.
dst: 这场胜利很大程度上要归功于您，将军。您将作为最伟大的正统派将领名垂青史，甚至超越苏马拉卡雷吉。国王很快将以贵族头衔酬谢您，而且我知道他正考虑由您出任陆军大臣。您的政治前途一片光明，将军。

src: Muchas Gracias & special Greetings to Urica for wonderful Maps
dst: Muchas Gracias，并特别问候 Urica，感谢他出色的地图

src: Mucho nos tememos que a pesar de todo la guerra estara perdida pase lo que pase...
dst: 我们很担心，无论如何，这场战争终将失败……

src: Multiple Entente offensives in September 1918 retook the land in front of the Hindenburg line that was taking by the Germans earlier that year. In October the Hindenburg line was penetrated by attacks of Belgian, British and French forces.
dst: 1918年9月，协约国发动多次攻势，收复了当年早些时候被德军占领的兴登堡防线前方的土地。10月，比利时、英法军队突破了兴登堡防线。
穆纳托内斯第57营/第10旅/第3师

src: Muslim Communist Bat./ Eastern Army Group
dst: 穆斯林 Communist 营/ 东部集团军集群

src: Mussilini has convened a general's council.
dst: 墨索里尼召开了一次将领会议。

src: Mussilini has decided a different assignment is suited better for you, you will command in Russia..........fare you well on the Steppes.
dst: 墨索里尼已决定，另一个任务更适合你，你将去俄国指挥……愿你在草原上一路平安。

src: Mussilini has decided you will command the rear guard CCNN battalion while Marshall Graziani forms a new Army in Tripoli.
dst: 墨索里尼已决定，你指挥殿后的黑衫军营，而格拉齐亚尼元帅则在的黎波里组建新军。

src: Mussilini has managed to persuade Hitler to let us finish the Greeks, Hitler is apparently eager to do other things this Summer, interesting......
dst: 墨索里尼设法说服了希特勒，让我们去收拾希腊人；希特勒显然这个夏天急于干别的事，有意思……

src: Mussilini has promised me much, and I him......... should we be victorious.  Hurrah! You and your fresh troops are here to make us both honest men!
dst: 墨索里尼向我许了很多，我也向他许了……只要我们能取胜。好哇！你和你的生力军在这里，就是来让我们两个都言而有信的！

src: Mussilini has thankfully promised me more troops under General Graziani.  You, I understand, are to report immediately back to him...............and a lot of Italian mothers...
dst: 所幸墨索里尼已答应再派格拉齐亚尼将军麾下的更多部队给我。而你，我知道，要立即回去向他报到……还有向许多意大利母亲报到……

src: Mussilini must have forseen the future, General,  your recklessness what just what we needed!
dst: 墨索里尼必定预见了未来，将军，你的鲁莽正是我们所需要的！

src: Mussilini thinks you are the man for the job.  He told me he needed someone bold and aggressive....and General, I told him you were reckless.
dst: 墨索里尼认为你是干这活的合适人选。他告诉我说他需要一个果敢而富进取心的人……将军，而我告诉他，你很鲁莽。

src: Mussolinis CTV, Corpo Truppo Volontari, have gained strength in Spain and is now large enough to conduct independent operations. Mussolini has descided that it is time to end the Spanish Republic, thus the entire CTV, 4 divisions, supported by armour and artillery, as well as a the Nationalist Soria Division and air elements attack the thinly spread Republican 12th Division around Alamandrones. But the Republicans are detemined to stop the Fascists here and commit increasing reinforcements, among them Russian tanks and planes and the famous International Brigades.
dst: 墨索里尼的意大利志愿军团（CTV）已在西班牙壮大，如今实力足以独立作战。墨索里尼认定，是时候终结西班牙共和国了；于是整个意大利志愿军团——4个师——在装甲与炮兵、以及国民军索里亚师和航空部队的支援下，向散布在阿拉曼德罗内斯一带的共和军第12师发起进攻。但共和军决心在此阻止法西斯分子，不断投入增援，其中包括苏联坦克与飞机，以及著名的国际纵队。

src: Must I remind you that speed is all important, go now!!
dst: 还要我提醒你速度至关重要吗？现在就出发！！
穆斯塔法·凯末尔·阿塔图尔克

src: Mustafa Kemal has decided that we must launch a final attack on the Greek defensive line. They are overstretched, demoralized, and their line of communications with their headquarters at Izmir is inoperative. However, they still have a huge army on the field, so we only have one chance. We can't afford a defeat.
dst: 穆斯塔法·凯末尔已决定，我们必须对希腊防线发起最后进攻。他们战线过长、士气低落，且与其伊兹密尔总部之间的交通线已经瘫痪。然而，他们在战场上仍有一支庞大的军队，因此我们只有一次机会。我们输不起。

src: Muy bien... Los republicanos han sido expulsados de Teruel, y ahora están a la desbandada, tratando de establecer una línea defensiva en torno a su nueva capital, Valencia.
dst: 很好……共和军已被逐出特鲁埃尔，如今正溃不成军，试图在其新首都巴伦西亚周边建立一道防线。

src: Muy bien... The Republicans have been kicked out of Teruel and now they are in total retreat.   They are scrambling for good positions to protect their new capital, Valencia.
dst: 非常好……共和派已被逐出特鲁埃尔，现在他们全线撤退。他们正争相抢占有利阵地，以保卫他们的新首都巴伦西亚。

src: My Army Corps was not really engaged until the third week of July, when we fought with great determination at Delville Wood and later at Guillemont. Then September came, and with it, the time for the final assault against the last German line of defense, between Flers and Morval. The German fortifications were impressive, but this time we counted on a new, secret weapon, that supposedly would help us to advance through the oceans of mud and barberd wire. It was our last chance for a total breakthrough. If we could not break the German lines, all that would be left would be the battle of attrition.
dst: 我的军直到7月的第三周才真正投入战斗，我们在代尔维尔森林、随后在吉耶蒙进行了坚决的作战。接着9月来临，随之而来的是对弗莱尔与莫瓦尔之间德军最后一道防线发起总攻的时刻。德军的防御工事令人印象深刻，但这一次，我们拥有一种新的秘密武器，据说它将帮助我们穿过泥泞与铁丝网的汪洋。这是我们实现完全突破的最后机会。如果我们不能突破德军防线，剩下的就只有消耗战了。

src: My Finnish troops have cut supply to the Russians in Suomussalmi.  While you were traveling, fresh Soviet forces have started a drive to re-open their supply lines and save their comrades.
dst: 我的芬兰部队已切断苏奥穆斯萨尔米俄军的补给。在你赶路期间，新到的苏军已开始推进，试图重新打通补给线、解救其战友。

src: My God, how did I end like this?
dst: 天哪，我怎么会落到这般地步？

src: My Prince, now it is up to the courageous Treveri!
dst: 我的王子，如今就看英勇的特雷维里人了！

src: My admiration, General! The entire position has been captured within only a few hours, just before nightfall. Whereas our casualties have been very light, scarcely any Turks escaped from Magdhaba. Now it's time for our horses to have a drink in the wells before we return to El Arish...
dst: 钦佩之至，将军！整个阵地仅在几个小时之内、夜幕降临前就被攻占。我方伤亡极轻，几乎没有土耳其人从马格达巴逃脱。现在该让我们的马匹在井边饮个水，然后我们再返回阿里什……

src: My admiration, General! Your dashing cavalry charge has been the most spectacular one since the "Charge of the Light Brigade" during the Crimean War. Beersheba fell to your brave cavalry men, and with it the whole Turkish Gaza-Beersheba line started to crumble.
dst: 我由衷钦佩，将军！您英勇的骑兵冲锋是克里米亚战争「轻骑兵旅冲锋」以来最壮观的一次。贝尔谢巴落入您勇敢的骑兵手中，随之而来的是整个土耳其加沙-贝尔谢巴防线开始瓦解。

src: My army Corps originally was intended to support the South East but being near by chance we have to support our comrades in Gettysburg...
dst: 我的军原本是要去支援东南方向的，但碰巧就在附近，我们只得支援葛底斯堡的战友们……

src: My career also improved. In 1890 I was promoted to Major, and six years later to Lieutenant-Colonel. But more importantly, Evelyn and I created a loving and safe home as our family grew; Christine was born in 1886, Thomas in 1889, Margaret in 1890 and finally, ill-fated William in 1893.
dst: 我的仕途也一帆风顺。1890年我晋升为少校，六年后又升为中校。但更重要的是，随着家庭人丁兴旺，伊芙琳和我营造了一个充满爱意而安稳的家：克里斯汀生于1886年，托马斯生于1889年，玛格丽特生于1890年，最后是命运多舛的威廉，生于1893年。

src: My commendations, Herr Feldmarschall! Under harsh conditions, you have done very well! Your complete victory has opened the way deeper into China. You now have to head north, to Manchuria and Korea.
dst: 向你致意，元帅阁下！在艰苦的条件下，你表现出色！你的完全胜利为深入中国打开了道路。你现在必须北上，前往满洲和朝鲜。

src: My commendations, Herr General!  Under harsh conditions, you have done very well!  Your complete victory has shown that already you have gained valuable experience in this new type of warfare.  In addition, the new pro-German government in Spain will prove to be a useful ally in the coming years.
dst: 向你致敬，将军阁下！在严酷的条件下，你表现得非常出色！你的全胜表明，你已在这种新型战争中获得了宝贵的经验。此外，西班牙新成立的亲德政府将在未来数年里证明自己是个有用的盟友。

src: My commendations, Herr General!  Under harsh conditions, you have done very well.  A complete victory!
dst: 向你致敬，将军阁下！在严酷的条件下，你表现得非常出色。一场全胜！

src: My commendations, Herr General!  Under harsh conditions, you have done very well.  A complete victory!  As a necessary prelude to our drive towards the key communications and industrial center of Stalingrad you are to reduce the fortified port of Sevastopol.
dst: 我要嘉奖你，将军阁下！在艰苦的条件下，你表现得非常出色。一场彻底的胜利！作为我们向重要交通和工业中心斯大林格勒推进的必要前奏，你要去摧毁设防的塞瓦斯托波尔港。

src: My commendations, Herr General! Under harsh conditions, you have done very well! Your complete victory has opened the way across the Dniepr. You are to continue to drive towards the key communications and industrial centers of the eastern Ukraine.
dst: 我向你致意，将军阁下！在艰苦的条件下，你做得非常出色！你的完全胜利打开了横渡第聂伯河的道路。你要继续向乌克兰东部的关键交通与工业中心推进。

src: My commendations, Herr General! Under harsh conditions, you have done very well! Your complete victory has opened the way to Stalingrad. You are to continue to drive towards the key communications and industrial center of Stalingrad.
dst: 向你致敬，将军阁下！在艰苦的条件下，你干得非常出色！你的完胜打开了通往斯大林格勒的道路。你要继续向斯大林格勒这个关键的交通与工业中心推进。

src: My commendations, Herr General! Under harsh conditions, you have done very well. Mallorca is ours! Your complete victory has shown that already you have gained valuable experience in this new type of warfare. In addition, the new pro-German government in Spain will prove to be a useful ally in the coming years.
dst: 向你致贺，将军阁下！在艰苦的条件下，你做得非常出色。马略卡岛是我们的了！你的完全胜利表明，你已在这种新型战争中获得了宝贵的经验。此外，西班牙新的亲德政府将在未来数年里证明是一个有用的盟友。

src: My commendations, Herr Hauptmann! Your bold action on the first day of offensive not only secured your promotion, but also saved the momentum of our attack! Few more days and the Soviets will surely collapse.
dst: 我嘉奖你，上尉阁下！攻势首日你的果敢行动不仅为你赢得了晋升，还保住了我军进攻的势头！再过几日，苏军必将崩溃。

src: My congratulations, Oberstleutnant. Your determined attack in the Carpathians was of invaluable help for our offensive on Ramnicu Sarat. Romanian and Russian troops were tied down by your forces, and the enemy was not able to shift troops to the south, where they were desperately needed. Our breakthrough would not have been possible without you.
dst: 恭喜您，中校。您在喀尔巴阡山脉的果断进攻，对我们向拉姆尼库瑟拉特的攻势提供了不可估量的帮助。罗马尼亚和俄国军队被您的部队牵制，敌人无法向急需增援的南方调兵。没有您，我们的突破不可能实现。

src: My congratulations, general. You managed to succeed in your task. Yugoslavia has been struck down in less than two weeks, and you certainly had a major part in that! Now make haste and move further south - Greece awaits our onslaught!
dst: 恭喜你，将军。你成功完成了任务。南斯拉夫不到两周就被击溃，而你无疑居功至伟！现在抓紧时间继续南下——希腊正等着我们去冲击！

src: My current mood makes me miss Pétain even more. At least he understands what's happening. Some time ago, talking about our soldiers, he confided to me that "their expressions seemed frozen by a vision of terror; their gait and their postures betrayed a total dejection; they sagged beneath the weight of horrifying memories". He's a tough officer, but he hasn't lost his humanity yet. His defensive strategy, and his "Noria-relieve system", have allowed us to resist the German assaults so far. Without Pétain, I'm sure thar France would be on the verge of surrender right now.
dst: 我此刻的心情让我更加想念贝当。至少他明白正在发生什么。前些时候，谈到我们的士兵，他向我吐露：「他们的神情仿佛被恐怖的景象冻住了；他们的步态和姿态流露出彻底的沮丧；他们在可怕记忆的重压下弯下了腰」。他是个强硬的军官，但他还没有失去人性。他的防御战略，以及他的「诺里亚轮换制」，使我们迄今得以抵抗德军的突击。没有贝当，我确信法兰西此刻已濒临投降。

src: My defence of Kharkov could have given us a chance to recover, but France and the United Kingdom simply betrayed us. They've stopped their support to our cause and are preparing themselves to live in a world with communist governments. In the other fronts the news are equally bad. Kolchak and Yudenich have been defeated, so now the Bolsheviks can send all of their units against us. Believing that our end is imminent, many of our soldiers have deserted.
dst: 我对哈尔科夫的防御本可给我们一线恢复的机会，但法国和英国却背叛了我们。他们已停止对我们事业的支持，正做好准备与共产主义政府共处一个世界。其他战线的消息同样糟糕。高尔察克和尤登尼奇已被击败，所以现在布尔什维克可以调集全部兵力对付我们。许多人相信我们的末日将近，我们的许多士兵开小差了。

src: My last hopes were gone. We were doomed. Soon we'd have to choose between death, a life under the Bolshevik yoke, or leaving Russia forever.
dst: 我最后的希望破灭了。我们注定要完蛋。不久我们就得在死亡、在布尔什维克枷锁下生活、或永远离开俄国之间作出选择。

src: My life changed during one of my travels to Egypt, in 1872. I was accompanying a French gentleman who acquired ancient pieces of art, by not totally legal means, and sent them to several European museums and private collectors. A few months after our arrival, we were approached by a couple of men who worked for the Coptic Orthodox Church. They had been secretly gathering a large amount of rifles and ammunition for their Abyssinian brethren, and offered us a great sum of money if we managed to smuggle them into the ancient, hermit kingdom of Ethiopia. The offer was too tempting to reject it, but the mission was too dangerous, so I should personally carry it out. And that's how I arrived in Ethiopia or, as you call it, Abyssinia, in 1873.
dst: 我的人生在1872年的一次埃及之行中发生了改变。当时我陪同一位法国绅士，他用不算完全合法的途径收购古代艺术品，再把它们送到欧洲的几家博物馆和私人收藏家手中。我们抵达几个月后，有两名科普特正教会的人找上了我们。他们一直在暗中为他们的阿比西尼亚同胞筹集大量步枪和弹药，并表示如果我们能把这些武器偷运进那个古老而封闭的埃塞俄比亚王国，就给我们一大笔钱。这笔交易诱人得让人无法拒绝，但任务又太过危险，所以我必须亲自去完成。就这样，1873年，我来到了埃塞俄比亚，也就是您所说的阿比西尼亚。

src: My men and I needed some time to regroup and recover after the battles of the past months, so I didn't join the fighting against the British immediately. When my troops were ready, our enemies had already opened a second front, invading Southern Ethiopia with at least six battalions of the King's African Rifles. Due to our lack of troops in that area, the Rifles had entered nearly one hundred miles into Ethiopian territory without meeting any serious opposition, and they had become a very important problem, since they were heading towards Addis Abeba. The empress met me there and told me that, before going to the front of Gondar, I should stop the second invading force.
dst: 经过过去几个月的连番战斗，我和我的部下需要时间重新集结、休整恢复，因此我没有立即投入对英军的作战。等我的部队准备就绪时，敌人已经开辟了第二战线，以至少六个营的国王非洲步枪团兵力入侵了埃塞俄比亚南部。由于我们在该地区兵力匮乏，这些步枪团士兵深入埃塞俄比亚境内近一百英里，却没有遇到任何像样的抵抗，而且由于他们正直扑亚的斯亚贝巴，已经成了一个十分棘手的问题。女皇在那里会见了我，并告诉我，在前往贡德尔战线之前，我必须先挡住这第二支入侵部队。

src: My men fought valiantly, but they're exhausted and couldn't resist any longer. Our offensive simply can't continue. We'll have to retreat in order to avoid being encircled and destroyed.
dst: 我的部下作战英勇，但他们已筋疲力尽，再也支撑不住。我们的攻势实在无法继续。我们必须撤退，以免被包围歼灭。

src: My men think it has been only a small enemy rec unit, but I am sure General Lee will be here with the mass of his troops any moment...
dst: 我的士兵们认为那只是一支小股的敌军侦察部队，但我确信李将军随时都会带着他的大部队来到这里……

src: My men, I'm proud of you. The Soviet 13th Army has been virtually destroyed, Orel is in our hands and the road to Tula is open. But we must be cautious. The Reds have sent reinforcements from the Baltic, and they're about to attack our flank. We'll have to hold our positions and deal with this new threat before advancing any further.
dst: 我的弟兄们，我为你们感到骄傲。苏维埃第13集团军已被基本消灭，奥廖尔已在我们手中，通往图拉的道路已经打开。但我们必须谨慎。红军已从波罗的海调来增援，即将进攻我们的侧翼。在继续推进之前，我们必须守住阵地，应对这一新威胁。

src: My patron was acclaimed as the main architect of the good performance of the Chinese soldiers. He was ordered to move to Peking, where he was given the task of modernising the land forces in all of China. He was extremely happy with my services, so he offered me to become his permanent military advisor, as well as the hand of Meiying, his youngest illegitimate daughter. That was an immense honour, specially for a foreigner like me. But my father in law was a very clever man. He knew that if I accepted, I would stay in China forever. I could never return to Britain with an Asian wife. I would never see my country again.
dst: 我的东家被誉为中国士兵出色表现的主要缔造者。他奉命调往北京，被赋予在全中国推行陆军现代化的任务。他对我的服务极为满意，因此提议让我成为他的常任军事顾问，并把他的小女儿——他的私生女美英——许配给我。那是一项莫大的荣誉，尤其是对我这样一个外国人而言。但我的岳父是个非常精明的人。他知道，如果我接受，就将永远留在中国。我永远无法带着一个亚洲妻子返回英国。我将再也见不到我的祖国。

src: My patron was acclaimed as the main architect of the victory. He was ordered to move to Peking, where he was given the task of modernising the land forces in all of China. He was extremely happy with my services, so he offered me to become his permanent military advisor, as well as the hand of Meiying, his youngest illegitimate daughter. That was an immense honour, specially for a foreigner like me. But my father in law was a very clever man. He knew that if I accepted, I would stay in China forever. I could never return to Britain with an Asian wife. I would never see my country again.

src: My poor William! It's been sixteen years since he died at the Somme, and I still can't write his name without sensing my hands tremble and tears coming to my eyes. His death was the hardest blow that I had to endure as a soldier. But certainly not the first one. I still have nightmares about what happened in 1898, when we went back to Khartoum to crush the Dervishes once and for all.
dst: 我可怜的威廉！他死在索姆河已有十六年，而我至今仍无法写下他的名字而不感到双手颤抖、泪水盈眶。他的死是我作为一名军人所承受的最沉重的打击。但那绝不是第一次打击。我至今仍会做噩梦，梦见1898年我们重返喀土穆、一劳永逸地镇压德尔维希人的情景。

src: My prince! Since Alesia, Vercingetorix considers you the most capable of all warlords! That is why he has given you the supreme command, which is also the greatest honor given to a Celtic army commander since ...
dst: 我的王子！自阿莱西亚以来，维钦托利认为你是所有军阀中最能干的一个！因此他把最高指挥权交给了你——这也是自……以来授予一位凯尔特军队统帅的最高荣誉

src: My prince, I bow to you .....!
My prince, you, as a commander in chief, have to march of course the honour with your courageous men at the head. . .
dst: 我的王子，作为统帅，您自然要亲率麾下勇士走在全军最前面，这是荣誉. . .

src: My real name isn't important. Everybody forgot it a long time ago. In case you want to know, I was born in Wales not long after the end of the Second Opium War. My family was wealthy and well-respected, so I received a good education and, in time, I became a cavalry officer. I had a promising career in the British Army, so if I had been wiser I'm sure that I would have had a good life in Britain, the kind of life that my parents wished for me.
dst: 我的真名并不重要。很久以前，人人都已将它遗忘。假如您想知道，我出生在威尔士，那是在第二次鸦片战争结束后不久。我的家庭富有且受人尊敬，因此我受到了良好的教育，后来成为了一名骑兵军官。我在英国军队中前途无量，所以如果我当初更明智一些，我确信自己会在英国过上优裕的生活，那正是我父母所期望我过的那种生活。

src: My small-scale tactics did not work this time. At least, among all the British divisions that were heavily engaged there, mine was the one with the least casualties. In fact, on October 12th we were replaced by the 46th Division whose assault on German positions the next day ended in a dreadful bloodshed.
dst: 这一次，我的小规模战术没有奏效。至少，在所有于那里激烈作战的英军各师中，我师伤亡最少。事实上，10月12日，第46师接替了我们，次日该师对德军阵地的进攻以一场可怕的流血而告终。

src: My small-scale tactics worked again at the Hohenzollern Redoubt. Among all the British divisions that were heavily engaged there, mine was the one with the least casualties. In fact, on October 12th we were replaced by the 46th Division whose assault on German positions the next day ended in a dreadful slaughter.
dst: 我的小规模战术在霍亨索伦棱堡再次奏效。在所有于那里激烈作战的英军各师中，我师伤亡最少。事实上，10月12日，第46师接替了我们，次日该师对德军阵地的进攻以一场可怕的屠杀而告终。

src: My strategy failed. Tsaritsyn would have held, were it not for Wrangel, who took command and managed to conquer the town. Now we're marching along its streets while many peope cheer us. I wonder if they cheered the Bolsheviks before, too.
dst: 我的战略失败了。要不是弗兰格尔接掌指挥并设法攻克了该城，察里津本可以守住。如今我们行进在它的街道上，许多人向我们欢呼。我不禁想，他们之前是否也曾这样为布尔什维克欢呼。

src: My sympathies to his family, I shall try to attend his funeral.  Now, however I must put my focus on finishing off France.
dst: 我向他的家人致以慰问，我会尽量去参加他的葬礼。不过现在，我必须专注于彻底解决法国。

src: My troops must go there as soon as possible. We'll rest a couple of days in Novorossiysk and then we'll march to the Manych. The Soviets have launched a very dangerous counterattack there, that might split our forces in two.
dst: 我的部队必须尽快赶到那里。我们将先在新罗西斯克休整一两天，然后向马内奇河进军。苏军在那里发动了一次非常危险的反攻，可能会把我们一分为二。

src: My troops were too tired to advance fast enough, so when July came we didn't have taken all our objectives. The High Command had to send its reserves, and thanks to them the area of Kazan finally fell under our control.
dst: 我的部队太疲惫了，无法足够快地推进，所以到了7月，我们仍未达成所有目标。最高统帅部不得不派出其预备队，多亏了他们，喀山地区才最终落入我们控制。

src: My unit has arrived in the Dolomite mountains, ready to support our Austro-Hungarian allies against the Italians that have betrayed us by declaring war on the Austro-Hungarian Empire.
dst: 我的部队已抵达多洛米蒂山区，准备支援我们的奥匈盟友，对付那些背弃我们、向奥匈帝国宣战的意大利人。

src: My utmost admiration, Oberstleutnant, this has been example of moutain warfare that will probably be taught at military academies in the future. Your daring men took the mountain pass and ferociously defended it against an enemy that was superior in numbers, but lacked the skills and the morale of the Alpenkorps. You not only blocked any reinforcements coming over the Carpathians, but also trapped the retreating, or should  I rather say fleeing, Romanians, flooding back from Hermannstadt after our breakthrough. The enemy has been thoroughly defeated, and Transylvania has been liberated!
dst: 我深表钦佩，中校，这是一场山地战的典范，将来很可能会被写进军事院校的教材。您麾下勇敢的将士夺取了山口，并凶猛地抵御了人数占优、却缺乏阿尔卑斯军那般技能与士气的敌人。您不仅封锁了所有翻越喀尔巴阡山脉而来的援军，还困住了撤退的——或者我该说溃逃的——罗马尼亚人，他们在我军突破后从赫尔曼施塔特蜂拥逃回。敌人已被彻底击败，特兰西瓦尼亚已经解放！

src: My victory has been so absolute that the Bolsheviks have retreated from much of the Kuban and Denikin has changed his mind. We'll still retreat most of the civilians and some soldiers to Crimea, but we'll leave enough troops to defend the Taman and Novorossiysk. We'll build strong lines of trenches, fortifications, tunnels and bunkers, so when the communists decide to attack us again they'll be incapable of passing through them. This area will be safe for a long time.
dst: 我的胜利如此彻底，布尔什维克已从库班大部分地区撤退，邓尼金也改变了主意。我们仍将把大部分平民和部分士兵撤往克里米亚，但会留下足够部队防守塔曼和新罗西斯克。我们将构筑坚固的战壕防线、工事、地道和碉堡，这样，当共产党人决定再次进攻我们时，他们将无法通过这些防线。这一地区将长期安全。

src: My,My,My,Dear Friend.A mistake You have made.
dst: 哎呀呀，亲爱的朋友。你犯了个错误。

src: News: Our troops that landed in Tunisia to oppose the Allied invasion of Morocco, Algeria and Tunisia have been pushed back by French, US and British forces.
dst: 消息：我们为抗击盟军入侵摩洛哥、阿尔及利亚和突尼斯而在突尼斯登陆的部队，已被法军、美军和英军击退。

src: News: The German 6th Army is preparing for a major offensive on Stalingrad. British and Indian forces are on the retreat in Burma.
dst: 消息：德国第6集团军正为对斯大林格勒的大规模攻势做准备。英军和印军正在缅甸撤退。

src: News: The Germans have invaded the USSR! Rommel will never see all the reinforcements he was hoping to get.
dst: 消息：德军入侵了苏联！隆美尔盼着的那批增援，他再也等不到了。

src: News: The last German thrust towards Moscow has been beaten back and the Russians have started counter-attacks at Rostov in the South and at Tula near Moscow.
dst: 消息：德军向莫斯科的最后一次突击已被击退，俄国人已在南面的罗斯托夫和莫斯科附近的图拉发起反击。

src: Next deployment: 8 ground units, no air units.
dst: 下一轮部署：8个地面单位，无空中单位。

src: Next stop is Mersah Matruh - 80 miles East of your curent position.
dst: 下一站是梅尔萨马特鲁——在你当前位置以东80英里。

src: Next stop: Aghedabia, where the 90th Leichte Division is preparing strong defensive positions.
dst: 下一站：阿格达比亚，第90轻装师正在那里构筑坚固的防御阵地。

src: Next to the open debate about the continuation of the war in the House of Commons, the public debate in the American press about the need to continue the war has become very intense since the Italian press sighted Rommel and an American diplomat on lake Garda.
dst: 除了下议院关于是否继续战争的公开辩论之外，自从意大利报界在加尔达湖拍到隆美尔与一名美国外交官之后，美国报界关于是否有必要继续这场战争的公开辩论也变得十分激烈。

src: Next: camouflage your tank depot! We've had many cases of lost vehicles during last days, as the men are tired and demoralized and they slack... then they're surprised when enemy dumps the bombload right onto their head.
dst: 接下来：伪装你的坦克仓库！最近几天我们损失了许多车辆，因为士兵们疲惫、士气低落、松懈……等敌人把炸弹直接倒在他们头上时，他们才惊讶。
涅扎布迪内 (涅扎布季纳)

src: Nice job! The Rumanians have gotten a bloody nose. Unfortunally your troops are trapped. We will evacuate your troops with ships.
dst: 干得不错！罗马尼亚人碰了个头破血流。遗憾的是您的部队被困住了。我们将用舰船撤离您的部队。

src: Nice job. Tens of thousands of our troops are trapped in the Falaise pocket, but the best divisions got out. Retreat east to form a new line of defense.
dst: 干得好。我们数万部队被困在法莱斯包围圈中，但最精锐的几个师脱身了。向东撤退，建立新防线。

src: Nice to see you again commander. Your next mission is highly secret and will take you to the Sino-Korean border.  The dirty North American invaders and their South Korean allies have smashed the North Koreans.  Kim-Il-Sung was close to a total victory during the past summer, but he didn't protect his rearguard and as you know, the capitalist operation at Inch'on and Seoul has completely defeated the North Korean advance on Pusan.
dst: 很高兴再次见到你，指挥官。你的下一项任务高度机密，将把你带到中朝边境。肮脏的北美侵略者及其韩国盟友已击溃了朝鲜人。金日成在去年夏天曾接近全面胜利，但他没有保护好自己的后方，如你所知，资本主义者的仁川与汉城行动已彻底击溃了朝鲜人民军对釜山的进攻。

src: Nice to see you again... I hope the lessons you have reciently taken in the USSR about the modern warfare will be useful for us now. Well, please sit down, I have some information to bring you about the current situation.
dst: 很高兴再次见到你...我希望你最近在苏联学到的现代战争课程现在对我们有用。好，请坐，我有一些关于当前局势的情报要告诉你。

src: Nice, really nice general.  The communist troops have been completely defeated by your quick action.  I hope the problems with the guerrillas of the ChCP are finished for a long time.  Congratulations!  You have been awarded with the Order of the Golden Kite 3rd class, it is not a high decoration, but Congratulations anyway.
dst: 好，真的很好，将军。共军已被您的迅速行动彻底击败。我希望中国共产党游击队的麻烦在很长一段时间内已经了结。恭喜！您已被授予三等金鵄勋章，这不是很高的勋赏，但还是要恭喜您。

src: Nice, really nice general.  The communist troops have been completely defeated by your quick action.  I hope the problems with the guerrillas of the ChCP are finished for a long time.  Congratulations! You have been awarded with the Order of the Golden Kite 1st class.
dst: 好，真的很好，将军。共军已被您的迅速行动彻底击败。我希望中国共产党游击队的麻烦在很长一段时间内已经了结。恭喜！您已被授予一等金鵄勋章。

src: Nicely done, General. Another British Expeditionary Corps has been removed! Not many of them left, are there?
dst: 干得好，将军。又一支英国远征军被消灭了！剩下的不多了吧？

src: Nicely done, general. The British forces have been eliminated and we were also able to destroy one of the best French armies. As a consequence of our victories. France has fallen! The war from 1914-1940 has finally been ended justly! It's such a pity the English continue to resist, but we can't help that.
dst: 干得好，将军。英军已被消灭，我们还得以摧毁法军最精锐的部队之一。作为我们胜利的成果，法国陷落了！1914-1940年的战争终于得到公正的了结！可惜英国人仍继续顽抗，但我们也无可奈何。

src: Niemals werden wir uns den Römern unterwerfen, bei Teutates!
dst: 图塔蒂斯在上，我们绝不向罗马人屈服！
尼乌卡佩勒 (尼乌卡佩勒)
纽波特海滨 (尼乌波特海滨)
尼基弗鲁斯·布里恩尼乌斯
尼基弗鲁斯·洛戈塞特斯
尼古拉耶夫，港口，谷物升降机。
尼古拉耶沃-伊洛瓦伊斯基
尼科尔斯卡亚镇 (斯帕斯克)

src: Ninety miles. That was all the distance between our divisions and Denikin's army. With minimal effort, our forces could have joined before the end of August.
dst: 九十英里。这就是我们的各师与邓尼金军队之间仅剩的距离。只要稍作努力，我们的部队本可以在八月底之前会师。
尼努尔塔阿帕尔埃库尔
尼努尔塔图库尔提阿舒尔

src: No "official" word from the USSR, yet, though you may find this interesting.  Word from our spies in Moscow is that some sort of unidentified "device" recently teleported into the front courtyard of the Kremlin itself.   The occupants claimed to come from an alternate universe and to have discovered the world's first working time machine...
dst: 苏联方面还没有「官方」消息，不过你或许会觉得下面的事有意思。我们在莫斯科的间谍报告称，某种不明「装置」近日传送到了克里姆林宫正前方的庭院里。装置中的人声称来自另一个宇宙，并且发现了世界上第一台可用的时间机器……
No 第30中队 / 皇家飞行队
战术轰炸机默认不具反潜能力

src: No Air Transports are available in this scenario.
dst: 本场景中没有空中运输。

src: No Ammo Penalty used by all Air units and Super Heavy units
dst: “无弹药惩罚”属性用于所有空中单位与超重型单位

src: No Interception used extensively on low level AD's
dst: “无拦截”属性广泛用于低级别防空单位

src: No Leader used extensively (but some units marked at 100% chance in scenario)
dst: “无领袖”属性被广泛使用（但场景中有部分单位标记为 100% 触发几率）

src: No Station Needed not used - rail movement only via stations
dst: 未使用“无需车站” - 铁路移动只能经车站进行

src: No Surrender used extensively for the more resilient units
dst: 对较顽强的单位广泛使用“无投降”

src: No air or naval transports are available.
dst: 没有可用的空中或海上运输。

src: No breakthrough means no further combat missions for you. This is an easy calculation.
dst: 没有突破就意味着你不再有进一步的作战任务。这是一道很简单的算术。

src: No freedom for us, but the effort was worth it ...
dst: 我们没能得到自由，但这番努力是值得的 ...

src: No go spread the good word to your officers!
dst: 现在去把这个好消息传给你的军官们吧！

src: No has seleccionado destino, porfavor, selecciona un destino en el mapa estrategico.
dst: 您尚未选择目的地，请在战略地图上选择一个目的地。

src: No matter from which direction the wind is blowing -I can smell the confederats!
dst: 不管风从哪个方向吹来——我都能闻到南方军的气味！

src: No one still wants war, but the government does not get it. It sends the German fleet into the final battle against the Royal Navy. Your comrades defend themselves. This means mutiny. The ships turned back. The mutineers, however, were captured ...
dst: 已经没人还想打仗了，可政府就是不明白。它把德国舰队派去与英国皇家海军进行最后的决战。你们的同志们奋起反抗。这就是哗变。舰船掉头返航。然而，哗变者被逮捕了……

src: No se espera una fuerte oposicion del enemigo.
dst: 预计敌军不会进行顽强抵抗。

src: No siente usted verguenza?. The Republicans are still resisting at the Ebro pocket and are hoping to receive help from France.  We are sure they are going to get it.  Your future is dark, my General.
dst: 您难道不觉得羞耻吗？共和派仍在埃布罗河袋形阵地抵抗，并指望得到法国的援助。我们确信他们会得到援助。您的前途黯淡，我的将军。

src: No tiene usted calor, general?. Con este horrible calor no vuelan ni las moscas, pero que?, a los rojos solo se les ocurre lanzar una gran ofensiva a nuestras posiciones al Oeste de Madrid. El nuevo ''Ejercito Popular'' enemigo, esta poniendo en peligro nuestras posiciones en Brunete.
dst: 将军，您不觉得热吗？这么可怕的酷热，连苍蝇都不飞了，可您猜怎么着？共和军偏偏在这时候向我们马德里以西的阵地发动了一场大规模攻势。敌军新组建的「共和军」正威胁着我们在布鲁内特的阵地。

src: No tiene usted calor, general?. With this horrible heat, there are no any fly flying out of there, but, what?, the Republicans have launched a powerful attack agaisnt our positions Westwards to Madrid. The newly formed enemy ''People's Army'' is smashing our defenses on Brunete!.
dst: 将军，您不觉得热吗？这么可怕的酷热，连只苍蝇都飞不出来，可您猜怎么着？共和军向我们马德里以西的阵地发动了一场强大的攻势。新组建的敌军「共和军」正在猛攻我们在布鲁内特的防线！

src: No tiene usted calor, general?. With this horrible heat, there is no any fly flying out of there, but, what?, the Republicans have launched a powerful attack agaisnt our positions Westwards to Madrid. The newly formed enemy ''People's Army'' is smashing our defenses on Brunete!.
dst: 您不觉得热吗，将军？这么可怕的酷热，连苍蝇都不愿意从那里飞出来，可是，怎么着？共和军朝马德里以西我们的阵地发动了猛烈进攻。新组建的敌军「共和军」正在布鲁内特粉碎我们的防御！

src: No time is to be lost now:  with each new day the Austrian armies receive reinforcements from the Balkan 2nd Army.
dst: 现在一刻也不能耽误：每过一天，奥军都会从巴尔干第2集团军获得增援。

src: No time to esc--- the blast radius!

No time to rest for Marines. They must immediately attack and retake the island of Mallorca. Unfortunately, don't expect any help from the Spanish, all their attention is focused on Barcelona. You will only get help from Luftwaffe Recons.
dst: 海军陆战队无暇休整。他们必须立即进攻并夺回马略卡岛。遗憾的是，别指望西班牙人提供任何帮助，他们的全部注意力都集中在巴塞罗那。您将只得到德国空军侦察机的帮助。

src: No volverá usted a mandar tropas.
dst: 您再也不会统率部队了。

src: No words can sufficiently praise your superb 29th Division, General! Despite the stout resistance of the enemy, your troops have established a bridgehead at the tip of the Gallipoli peninsula. The GHQ is impressed by the way you conducted this operation.
dst: 将军，任何言语都不足以赞美您卓越的第29师！尽管敌人顽强抵抗，您的部队还是在加里波利半岛的顶端建立了桥头堡。总司令部对您指挥这次行动的方式印象深刻。

src: No! In the province of Gallia Cisalpina, strong Roman troops  under governor C. Cassius Longinus and praetor Cn. Manlius are awaiting you ...
dst: 不！在山南高卢行省，总督盖乌斯卡西乌斯隆吉努斯与法官格奈乌斯曼利乌斯麾下的大批罗马军队正等着你 ...

src: No, comrade, you do have to worry about your food supply.  Take anything from the country as you go.  The people will help you and if they do not it is because they are still terrified of repressions by the capitalist pigs.  Now let us go back to our plan of operations, comrade.
dst: 不，同志，您不必为粮草发愁。所到之处，从乡间取用即可。人民会帮助您，如果他们不帮，那是因为他们仍惧怕资本主义猪猡的迫害。现在让我们回到作战计划上来，同志。

src: No, let us rather draw south again. This will open up new opportuninies….
dst: 不，我们还是再次南下吧。这会带来新的机会…….

src: No, our only option was to attack, and conquer the mountain passes before they could react. We knew that the Italian government was making plans to send two or three infantry brigades from Albania to Eritrea. We needed to control the Eritrean Highland before that could happen.
dst: 不，我们唯一的选择就是进攻，趁他们来不及反应之前攻占各个山口。我们知道意大利政府正在计划从阿尔巴尼亚向厄立特里亚派遣两三个步兵旅。我们必须赶在那之前控制厄立特里亚高地。
第41(皇家海军陆战队)突击队

src: No...leave me. It's too late for me. My injury is too serious. There's nothing that you can do to save me. Even if you managed to take me to a hospital, I'd be dead before the end of the week. Leave me here...I'll try to delay our enemies for a while.
dst: 不……别管我。对我来说已经太迟了。我的伤太重了。您做什么都救不了我。即使您设法把我送到医院，我也活不过本周。把我留在这里……我会尽力拖住敌人一会儿。
No.第8中队皇家飞行队 (from 海军)
第804中队,舰队航空兵 及 第891中队,舰队航空兵

src: Nobody expected such a terrible attack. Even with the help of your troops, the French haven't been able to hold their positions at the Ouergha Valley. They will have to call thousands of fresh troops to recover their lost territories.
dst: 谁也没料到会遭到如此可怕的进攻。即便有您的部队相助，法国人也没能守住他们在乌埃尔加河谷的阵地。他们将不得不调来成千上万的生力军，以收复失地。
诺盖斯克 (普里莫尔斯克)

src: Nola you have left  in chaos behind you, but your pursuers are already within reach. Furius, sergeant of praetor Publius Varinius, stands with 3,000 men at Acerrea.
dst: 你把诺拉丢在身后，一片混乱，可追兵已近在咫尺。法官普布利乌斯瓦里尼乌斯的军士富里乌斯，正带着3,000人驻在阿切拉。

src: None of the above affects your victory conditions: just evacuate the given number of units.
dst: 以上都不影响你的胜利条件：只需撤离指定数量的单位。

src: None of this would have been possible without you. You'll be remembered as one of the greatest German heroes of all time. And I know that the Kaiser would be glad to appoint you as the next Chief of the General Staff. What do you think of that? Would you accept to serve your country for a little longer? Whaterver your answer is, let me say this: Feldmarschall, I salute you.
dst: 没有您，这一切都不可能实现。您将被铭记为有史以来最伟大的德国英雄之一。而且我知道，皇帝会很高兴任命您为下一任总参谋长。您意下如何？您愿意再为祖国效力一段时间吗？无论您的回答是什么，请允许我说一句：陆军元帅，我向您致敬。

src: None of this would have happened if you had led your army better, General. It's time for you to ask for your retirement.
dst: 将军，如果您的指挥更好一些，这一切都不会发生。现在是您申请退役的时候了。
北非，1942年，埃尔温·隆美尔手持望远镜。
诺德德比和克万讷松德
北格奥尔格斯费恩运河
北岸团/第8加拿大(配属)/第51高地师 [XXX]
冰岛雷克雅未克以北外海

src: North-Western Front (Ruszky) has directed the I and II Siberian Corps to attack the city from eastern and southern directions.  The front must hold, Gospodin General-Leitenant!
dst: 西北方面军（鲁斯基）已命令第1和第2西伯利亚军从东、南两个方向进攻该城。战线必须守住，中将阁下！

src: Northern Italy is already being occupied by Nazi troops, you must cooperate with my intelligence officer to help my Allied forces advance as far north as possible before making contact with the German Army.
dst: 意大利北部已被纳粹军队占领，你必须配合我的情报官，帮助我方盟军在与德军接触之前尽可能向北推进。
挪威叛军 松德洛上校
挪威叛军 松德洛上校
第1挪威自由空军战斗机大队
第2挪威自由空军战斗机大队
第6挪威自由空军战斗机大队

src: Norwegian units are small and few.
dst: 挪威部队规模小、数量少。

src: Not dead yet: The Tobol offensive (I)
dst: Not dead yet: The Tobol 攻势 (I)

src: Not much to go off, Commander, I know.  But I assume the brass trained you Anomalous Operations guys for a reason.  If you need anything, just ask for Carter.  I'll be around.
dst: 线索不多，指挥官，我知道。但我想上头训练你们异常行动的人总是有理由的。有什么需要，找卡特就行。我就在附近。

src: Not only did our enemies achieve surprise. Their usage of artillery and veteran infantry units, supported by a large number of tanks, has been extremely clever. Our trenches and fortifications have been useless against this new tactics. It's time for you to gather your troops and try to infiltrate behind the British lines. That could be our last chance.
dst: 我们的敌人不仅达成了奇袭。他们对炮兵和久经沙场的步兵部队的运用，加上大量坦克的支援，可谓极其高明。面对这种新战术，我们的战壕和工事毫无用处。现在到了您集结部队、设法渗透到英军战线后方的时候了。这或许是我们最后的机会。

src: Not only here, but also at multiple other locations, the Bolsheviks have crossed the Mius. Kharkov is now under severe Soviet pressure. Send your troops to the Kharkov area to safeguard the city.
dst: 布尔什维克不仅在渡这里，还在其他多处地点渡过了米乌斯河。哈尔科夫如今承受着苏军的沉重压力。把你的部队派往哈尔科夫地区，保卫该城。

src: Not only is our honour saved but the Americans have suffered a serious defeat. This battle may change the course of the war.
dst: 我们不仅保住了荣誉，而且让美国人遭受了一场惨重的失败。这场战斗或许会改变战争的进程。

src: Not only is our honour saved but the Americans have suffered a tremendous defeat. This battle may change the course of the war.
dst: 不仅我们的荣誉得以保全，美国人也遭受了一场惨败。这场战斗或许会改变战争的进程。

src: Not only is our honour saved but the Americans have suffered an important defeat. This battle may change the course of the war.
dst: 不仅我们的荣誉得以保全，美国人也遭受了一场重大失败。这场战斗或许会改变战争的进程。

src: Not only is this assignment strategically important, it is politically critical. With Feldmarschall Manstein leading Army Group North through the Baltic States, while Feldmarschall Guderian's Army Group Center is liberating the Bylorussian region, your victory here will help liberate the Ukraine and force the Bolsheviks to make peace on our terms.
dst: 这项任务不仅在战略上重要，在政治上同样至关重要。曼施坦因元帅正率领北方集团军群穿过波罗的海诸国，而古德里安元帅的中央集团军群正解放白俄罗斯地区，你在当地的胜利将有助于解放乌克兰，并迫使布尔什维克按我们的条件求和。

src: Not satisfied with that, Italy strengthened its alliance with King Menelik, sending even more arms, ammunition and other supplies to Shewa. The Italians thought that, as soon as he believed he was powerful enough, Menelik would try to claim Yohannes's throne. But that wasn't going to happen. Providence had arranged a different ending for Yohannes the Great.

src: Notes on the core managment and campaign design:

src: Notes:  The intent is to take the original classic SSI Blitzkrieg campaign and add as many of the new features of Open General as possible, as well as making it playable with the excellent high cost Open AK efile.  Hopefully some of the flavour of the original classic campaign has been preserved while making the game play more interesting, varied, and challenging.  I would love to have done a great deal of research and made the whole campaign more realistic in terms of unit choices and names, but I'm afraid that at this time I am not prepared to put that kind of effort forward.  Maybe for some future version I will do so.
dst: 说明：本战役的意图是取 SSI 经典原版“闪电战”战役，尽可能加入 Open General 的新特性，并使其能用出色的高成本 Open AK efile 游玩。希望原经典战役的一些风味得以保留，同时让玩法更有趣、更多样、更具挑战性。我很想多做研究，让整个战役在单位选择和名称方面更真实，但恐怕目前我还没有准备好投入那样的精力。也许未来某个版本我会这么做。

src: November 1918 was an extraordinary month. The Polish state was sovereign and united. Unification was great proof of Polish experience and high standards in politics. At the beginning of the month there were half a dozen governments and each one ruled different parts of Poland with different poltical programs. There was also a government in exile, in Paris as well. At the end of the month, there was only one Polish government. All those political changes were done voluntarily and without using armed forces.
dst: 1918年11月是非同寻常的一个月。波兰国家实现了主权与统一。统一是波兰政治经验和政治高水平的伟大证明。月初还有半打政府，各自以不同的政治纲领统治波兰的不同地区。此外在巴黎还有一个流亡政府。到月底，只剩下一个波兰政府。所有这些政治变革都是自愿完成的，没有动用武装力量。

src: November 1942 was a turning point in the war. The Germans made some grave strategic errors. In this campaign OKW decides to send three divisions originally meant to be send to Paulus to send instead to bolster part of the Romanian front line north of Stalingrad.
dst: 1942年11月是战争的转折点。德军犯下了一些严重的战略错误。在本战役中，国防军最高统帅部决定把原本要派给保卢斯的三个师改派去加强斯大林格勒以北罗马尼亚战线的一段。

src: November-December of 1936. After the coup d'etat of July, the Fascist columns have traveled from Africa and from the North of Spain to make a meeting in Madrid, overruning the capital. src: Novorossiysk is one of the most important ports in the Black Sea. If we take it, most of our supply problems will be solved. The Entente powers will be able to send us whatever we need, as long as they're willing to. But it's even more important than that. In Novorossiysk we'll be able to settle, at last, the capital of our provisional government. The rebirth of our nation will start. So failure is not an option.
dst: 新罗西斯克是黑海最重要的港口之一。如果我们拿下它，大部分补给问题都将迎刃而解。协约国列强将能够给我们送来所需的一切，只要他们愿意。但它比这更重要。在新罗西斯克，我们终于能够安顿我们的临时政府首都。我们国家的重生将从这里开始。所以，失败绝不容许。

src: Novorossiysk is ours. Soon the first ships with supplies and reinforcement troops will arrive. I've been told that General Wrangel will be among them.
dst: 新罗西斯克是我们的了。很快，载着补给和援军的第一批船只就会抵达。有人告诉我，弗兰格尔将军也在其中。

src: Now China has become one of the main powers in the Pacific. Naturally, the rivalry with Russia, Japan and even the United States still goes on, but my adopted country is respected all over the world. Definitely, the Qing Empire isn't the sleeping dragon that I met in 1883 anymore. And I'm not the same person, either. In the end  I've lived a good life in China, but I'll always wonder if it has been the kind of life that my parents wished for me.
dst: 如今，中国已成为太平洋地区的主要强国之一。当然，与俄国、日本甚至美国的竞争仍在继续，但我所寄居的祖国受到了全世界的尊重。毫无疑问，大清帝国已经不再是我1883年遇到的那条沉睡的巨龙了。而我也不再是从前的那个人了。最终，我在中国过上了优裕的生活，但我将永远思量：这究竟是不是我父母所期望我过的那种生活。

src: Now Filipino troops are trying to seize control of Manila's only pumping station in Santolán and cut off the water supply to the city.
dst: 现在，菲律宾部队正试图夺取马尼拉在桑托兰的唯一泵站，切断该城的供水。

src: Now I have to think about our next move. Spain is almost bankrupt and we lack the resources to continue this war without some support from France, so it's important to get along with the French authorities. Otherwise we will be forced into some kind of peace treaty with Abd el-Krim.
dst: 现在我得考虑我们的下一步行动了。西班牙几乎破产，没有法国的某种支持，我们就缺乏资源继续这场战争，所以与法国当局搞好关系很重要。否则我们就将被迫与阿卜杜勒·克里姆签订某种和平条约。

src: Now all of our past mistakes are more evident. And not only the military ones, the political ones too. We refused to make a deal with the Polish and Ukrainian independentists, and thus we lost some potential allies who could have been decisive. Denikin tried to develop a serious agrarian reform, but we didn't listen to him. We were very busy with the military issues, and thus we lost the support of the peasants. The Bolsheviks only offer them false promises, but even that is better than the lootings and harsh treatment that they've received from us. Soon they'll learn that the Reds are even worse masters, but for now they dream of their arrival.
dst: 现在我们过去的所有错误都更加明显了。不仅是军事上的，还有政治上的。我们拒绝与波兰和乌克兰独立派达成协议，因此失去了一些本可能起决定性作用的潜在盟友。邓尼金试图推行认真的土地改革，但我们没有听他的。我们忙于军务，因而失去了农民的支持。布尔什维克只给他们虚假的承诺，但即便如此，也比他们从我们这里遭受的掠夺和苛待要好。他们很快就会明白，红军是更糟糕的主人，但眼下他们正盼着红军到来。

src: Now all of the countries involved in this war want a peace. Right now, our diplomats are in Bucharest negotiating the final conditions. Despite your success in battle, I'm afraid that they'll be very hard on us. Vardar Macedonia will remain in Serbia, and we'll lose Agean Macedonia to Greece, Eastern Thrace to the Ottoman Empire, and Dobrudzha to Romania.
dst: 现在，卷入这场战争的所有国家都希望和平。此刻，我们的外交官正在布加勒斯特谈判最终条件。尽管您在战场上取得了成功，恐怕他们会对我们非常苛刻。瓦尔达尔马其顿将留在塞尔维亚，我们将把爱琴马其顿割给希腊、东色雷斯割给奥斯曼帝国、多布罗加割给罗马尼亚。

src: Now back to the battle situation, comrade!  There will be time for rejoicing after our victory is certain!  I know I have been saying this for days but Lwow is now really within our grasp.  We stand some 50 kilometers from Lwow and it appears that there is little between us and the city.  However we cannot take a city, always a very hostile terrain for cavalry, without infantry support and better supply.  Hence, it is vital that we capture the railroad junction of Zadworze.  What the capitalists can gather to resist, I cannot tell. What I can tell is that within days we will be marching into Lwow!
dst: 现在回到战况上来，同志！等胜利确定之后，有的是时间庆贺！我知道这话我已念叨了好几天，但利沃夫现在确实已近在咫尺。我们距利沃夫约50公里，看上去我们与城市之间几乎已无障碍。然而，若没有步兵支援和更好的补给，我们无法攻下一座对骑兵而言始终极为不利的城市。因此，夺取扎德沃日铁路枢纽至关重要。资本家能纠集多少兵力来抵抗，我无法断言。我能断言的是，数日之内我们就将开进利沃夫！

src: Now collect your troops, and give your men some rest.... for the last full moon before the summer solstice, Vercingetorix has invited to a large all-Gallic state parliament in Alesia; all the princes of war shall appear there with all their men....
dst: 现在收拢你的部队，让你的人休整一下...... 因为夏至前的最后一个满月，维钦托利已在阿莱西亚召集全高卢的部族大会；所有军阀都须带全部人马到场......

src: Now if you excuse me, I must mourn my own son's death as well.
dst: 现在恕我失陪，我也得去哀悼我儿子的死。

src: Now is the time to take possession of these lands once and for all! Tanks, start your engines!
dst: 现在是彻底占有这片土地的时候了！坦克，发动引擎！

src: Now is time to attack Dublin. At coast it will be easy with the support of your ships. At mainland there are some important ground targets. You must succeed so that the Irish government signs a capitulation. But first your Branderburgers must capture the port of Wicklow, so the rest of your units can deploy.
dst: 现在是进攻都柏林的时候了。在海岸边，有你的舰船支援会很容易。在内陆有一些重要的地面目标。你必须成功，以便爱尔兰政府签署投降书。但首先你的勃兰登堡部队必须夺取威克洛港，这样你的其余单位才能部署。

src: Now it is important to stabilize and expand the beachhead so that the supplies can flow. When we landed enough forces we will dare the breakout!
dst: 现在重要的是稳固并扩大滩头阵地，好让补给源源流入。等我们登陆了足够的兵力，就要放手突围！

src: Now it is the time to destroy all Shetland coastal batteries.
dst: 现在是摧毁所有设得兰沿岸炮台的时候了。

src: Now it is the time to do what Napoleon wasn't able to do! Now is the time to throw everything at the enemy we have.
dst: 现在是时候做拿破仑没能做到的事了！现在是时候把我们所拥有的一切都投向敌人了。

src: Now it is time for our big offensive. You will attack the German Heeresgruppe Mitte at Yelnya. The Germans are well prepared for our attack, but I am sure you will be able to break through their lines.
dst: 现在是我们大攻势的时候了。你将在叶利尼亚攻击德国中央集团军群。德军已为我们的进攻做好了充分准备，但我相信你能够突破他们的防线。

src: Now it is time to take the initiative. You are facing the 2. Panzerarmee, which will attack every moment your lines south of Tula. Hold Tula and try to realize a counterattack if possible.
dst: 现在是时候掌握主动了。你正面对德国第2装甲集团军，它随时会进攻图拉以南你们的防线。守住图拉，并尽可能实现一次反击。

src: Now it is time to try again, here South of Ypres. The objective is to capture Ypres, force the Brits back to the channel ports and out of the war. Your task is to take command of XIX Corps and carry out the initial attack against Portuguese forces occupying the line South of Armentières. Your forces will be relieved once they reach positions 5km North of Estaires. Secondary objectives (gain extra prestige) are Armentieres on your right flank and Merville on your left flank.
dst: 现在是时候再试一次了，就在伊普尔以南这里。目标是夺取伊普尔，把英军逼回海峡各港口，迫使其退出战争。您的任务是接管第19军，向占据阿尔芒蒂耶尔以南防线的葡萄牙军队发起首轮进攻。您的部队一旦到达埃斯泰尔以北5公里处，就会被替换。次要目标（可获得额外威望）是您右翼的阿尔芒蒂耶尔和左翼的梅维尔。

src: Now it is your choice to go either with Spartacus or Krixos.
dst: 现在由你选择：随斯巴达克斯，还是随克里克索斯。

src: Now it's time for thinking on our next move. Against Wranglel's objections, Denikin has decided that we won't try to join Kolchak's forces. Instead, he has ordered an offensive on Moscow. I don't fully agree with him. It's true that if we go in search of Kolchak we could lose the Donbass, the Kuban and the other cossack territories that we control right now. But united we would be stronger. We could defeat the Bolsheviks more easily, and even inflict them a definitive blow. Later, we could always recover the regions that we had to leave behind.
dst: 现在是时候考虑下一步行动了。不顾弗兰格尔的反对，邓尼金已经决定，我们不尝试与高尔察克的部队会合。相反，他下令向莫斯科发起进攻。我并不完全同意他的看法。诚然，如果我们去找高尔察克，我们可能会失去顿巴斯、库班以及我们现在控制的其他哥萨克地区。但联合起来我们会更强大。我们可以更容易地打败布尔什维克，甚至给他们一记决定性的打击。以后，我们总能收复那些不得不放弃的地区。

src: Now it's time to make your decision.
dst: 现在到了您做决定的时候。

src: Now it's time to turn the tables on them. Tomorrow we'll join the French troops of Général Mangin and will launch a counteroffensive. In a few weeks we'll retake Soissons and the front will be at the Aisne again. We'll need you there, so get ready.
dst: 现在是时候扭转局面了。明天我们将加入芒然将军的法国部队，发动反攻。几周之内，我们将夺回苏瓦松，战线将重新回到埃纳河。我们需要您在那里，做好准备吧。

src: Now its timeto invade the North American continent. Canada will be our next goal.
dst: 现在是时候入侵北美大陆了。加拿大将是我们的下一个目标。

src: Now let my Finnish troops show you some much deserved hospitality, the Russians will not return again this winter and rumor has it that Stalin is looking to talk!
dst: 现在让我的芬兰部队尽一尽你应得的地主之谊吧，这个冬天俄国人不会再来了，而且有传言说斯大林想谈判！

src: Now let my Finnish troops show you some much deserved hospitality, the Russians will not return for at least two weeks and rumor has it that the Soviets are looking to talk peace terms!
dst: 现在让我的芬兰部队尽一尽你应得的地主之谊吧，俄国人至少两周内不会再来，而且有传言说苏联人想谈和平条件！
现在，让我们看看未来吧。

src: Now move back your corps to Petersburg immediately and close the trap...!
dst: 现在立即把您的军调回彼得斯堡，合上包围圈……！

src: Now our bridgehead is established over the River Narew it is time to continue our push south towards the goal of Brest.
dst: 既然我们已在纳雷夫河上建立桥头堡，现在是继续向南推进、直取布列斯特的时候了。

src: Now our main force may come from the north whereas your corps will land from the south-east..
dst: 现在我们的主力可以从北面来，而您的军将从东南面登陆。

src: Now sir, warm yourself by the fire and let us discuss my plans for a spring offensive, should I get the chance, I am most interested in your critique........
dst: 现在，长官，到火边暖暖身子，让我们讨论我春季攻势的计划——若有这个荣幸，我很想听听你的批评……

src: Now sir, warm yourself by the fire and let us plan our forward defenses and rotating troops from the front to get some much needed rest.
dst: 现在，长官，到火边暖暖身子，让我们规划前沿防御，并轮换前线部队去休整一下。

src: Now sir, warm yourself by the fire and let us talk about my spring opperations, I am most interested in your thoughts about my plans........
dst: 现在，长官，到火边暖暖身子，让我们谈谈我春季的行动，我很想听听你对我计划的看法……

src: Now take some rest. We will need your leadership for a big 1917 spring offensive that will inflict a decisive defeat on the German armies in France.
dst: 现在去休整一下吧。我们需要您来指挥1917年春季的一场大战役，它将给在法国的德军以决定性打击。

src: Now that France is doomed the British just want to leave the Continent and go back to their island. Initially they planned to evacuate their soldiers through Dunkerque and Calais, but the same week that you took Reims our First Army stormed the part of the front defended by the Belgians, taking those two ports and forcing Belgium out of the war. So now the British plan is retreating in order to Dieppe and embarking there.
dst: 如今法国已注定败亡，英国人只想离开欧洲大陆，回到他们的岛上去。起初他们计划经敦刻尔克和加来撤走士兵，但就在您攻克兰斯的同一周，我第1集团军猛攻了由比利时人防守的那段战线，夺取了那两个港口，迫使比利时退出了战争。于是英军现在的计划是朝迪耶普方向撤退，并在那里登船。

src: Now that Russia, Romania, Serbia, Greece and Italy are out of the war, France and Britain should have the common sense to make a separate peace with us. Sadly, they're still too proud for that. So we'll have more war.
dst: 既然俄国、罗马尼亚、塞尔维亚、希腊和意大利都已退出战争，法国和英国本应有常识与我们单独媾和。可惜他们依然过于高傲。所以战争还将继续。

src: Now that Sevastopol has fallen our next objective is Stalingrad.  This is an important road and railroad nexus.  Also capture of a city named after the Bolshevik dictator will hurt their morale.  Our intelligence report that there are two tank enemy armies approaching Stalingrad from the north, expect them in our area in a couple of days and make your preparations. This is a critical assignment, Herr General, you must take Stalingrad quickly.
dst: 塞瓦斯托波尔既已陷落，我们的下一个目标便是斯大林格勒——那里是重要的公路与铁路枢纽。再者，攻下一座以布尔什维克独裁者命名的城市，将沉重打击其士气。我方情报显示，敌军有两个坦克集团军正自北面逼近斯大林格勒，数日内即将进入我战区，请早作准备。这是一项关键任务，将军阁下，您必须迅速拿下斯大林格勒。

src: Now that Sevastopol has fallen our next objective is Stalingrad.  This is an important road and railroad nexus.  Also capture of a city named after the Bolshevik dictator will hurt their morale.  This is a critical assignment, Herr General, you must take Stalingrad quickly.
dst: 既然塞瓦斯托波尔已经陷落，我们的下一个目标就是斯大林格勒。这是一处重要的公路与铁路枢纽。此外，夺取这座以布尔什维克独裁者命名的城市，将打击他们的士气。将军阁下，这是一项关键任务，您必须迅速拿下斯大林格勒。

src: Now that Tientsin is safe we must reach Peking as soon as possible. Every minute counts. The Chinese will try to delay us, but we must prevail. Those poor people at the foreign legations deserve to be rescued. Let's go!
dst: 如今天津已经安全，我们必须尽快赶到北京。分秒必争。中国人会设法拖延我们，但我们必须获胜。外交使馆区里那些可怜的人理应获救。出发！

src: Now that Verona and Vicenza are firmly under our control, we must start the second phase of our invasion of Italy. In the east the Germans are going to take the valley of the Po, isolating Venedig from the rest of the country, and trapping most of the Italian army between the rivers Piave and Po.
dst: 既然维罗纳和维琴察已牢牢掌握在我们手中，我们必须开始入侵意大利的第二阶段。在东面，德国人将夺取波河河谷，把威尼斯与该国其他地区隔离开来，并将大部分意大利军队围困在皮亚韦河与波河之间。

src: Now that all armies are available, we can begin the conquest of England! Berlin is very pleased indeed by your conduct here!
dst: 如今各集团军齐备，我们可以开始征服英格兰了！柏林对你的表现确实非常满意！

src: Now that our oldest grandson, Jean-Pierre, has joined our Army, I pray every evening for him and for you. I remember that you begged me to do something for him, and make sure that he would be at a safe position in our rear. But, ma chère Fabienne, I haven't so much influence in our Supreme Command.
dst: 如今我们最年长的外孙让-皮埃尔已经参军，我每晚都为他和您祈祷。我记得您曾恳求我为他做点什么，确保他能待在我们后方安全的位置上。但是，我亲爱的法比安，我在最高统帅部并没有那么大的影响力。

src: Now that the Americans are off-balance, you are to attack in Alsace, conquer Strassbourg and generally inflict heavy casualties on the Americans. The 17th SS has already moved from Metz and is also at your disposal.
dst: 既然美国人已乱了阵脚，您就要在阿尔萨斯发起进攻，攻占斯特拉斯堡，并大量杀伤美军。党卫军第17师已从梅斯调出，也归您指挥。

src: Now that the Americans have deployed their forces, the war is won. It may take some months, or even one year, and, sadly, many people will lose their lives before the end, but the fact is that there is nothing that the Germans can do to defeat us. No matter if they are magnificent soldiers. No matter that they've already defeated Russia. They lack the resources to win the war in the Western Front. Sooner than you think, they'll be suing for peace.
dst: 如今美军已经部署了兵力，这场战争我们已经赢了。也许还要几个月，甚至一年，而且遗憾的是，在结束之前还会有许多人丧生，但事实是，德军已经没有任何办法能打败我们了。不管他们是多么出色的军人，也不管他们已经打败了俄国，他们都缺乏在西线赢得战争的资源。他们会比您想象的更快求和。

src: Now that the Romanian assault has lost momentum, it's time for our counterattack near Marasesti. The Russian 4th Army and the Romanian 1st Army haven't had time to build a defence line, so you have a good chance to crush them. Do it, and our total victory in the east will be much closer.
dst: 如今罗马尼亚人的攻势已失去势头，是时候在马勒什蒂附近发动反攻了。俄国第4集团军与罗马尼亚第1集团军还没来得及构筑防线，所以您有个击溃他们的好机会。放手去做，我们在东线的全面胜利就会更近一步。

src: Now that the Slavs have been dealt with we must rest for our next mission.
dst: 既然斯拉夫人已解决，我们必须休整以备下一任务。

src: Now that the situation in the Balkans has improved, we can focus our efforts on getting rid of the Italians. So far, most of the fighting has taken place on the valley of the Isonzo River, and that means that one-half of the Italian army is currently deployed there. If we could take the mountains passes south of Trient and invade the plains of Vicenza and Verona, we'd cut their supply lines, the Italians would be trapped at the Isonzo, and we could force them to surrender. It could be the greatest victory in the history of the Empire.
dst: 如今巴尔干局势好转，我们可以集中精力收拾意大利人了。迄今为止，大部分战斗都发生在伊松佐河谷，也就是说意大利军队有一半目前部署在那里。如果我们能夺取特伦特以南的山口，入侵维琴察与维罗纳平原，就能切断他们的补给线，意军将被困在伊松佐，我们就可以迫使他们投降。这可能是帝国历史上最伟大的胜利。

src: Now that we control many of the hills on the west bank our task at Verdun will be much easier. It will take longer than we had thought, but we'll probably achieve all of our goals. The French Army will eventually collapse. Unless, of course, Britain or Russia launch relief offensives...
dst: 既然我们已控制西岸的许多高地，我们在凡尔登的任务就会容易得多。这会比预想的耗时更长，但我们很可能实现所有目标。法军终将崩溃。当然，除非英国或俄国发动救援性攻势……

src: Now that we crossed the Dnepr and broken the Russian lines, the 10th Pz Division will move on Yelnya while your troops are ordered to capture Roslavl. Yelnya will be the starting point for our final drive on Moscow and Roslavl controls the main roads in this area.
dst: 既然我们已渡过第聂伯河并突破俄军防线，第10装甲师将向叶利尼亚推进，而你的部队奉命夺取罗斯拉夫尔。叶利尼亚将是我们最后向莫斯科推进的起点，罗斯拉夫尔则控制着本地区的主要道路。

src: Now that we have captured Bardia our next objective is El Alamein as the gateway to  Egypt.  The British are present in great strength, but your past performance indicates that you should be able to overcome them.  Again, you must achieve your objectives quickly so we that may maintain our pressure on the British.  You are Feldmarschall Rommel's lead commander in this attack!
dst: 巴迪亚既已攻克，我们的下一个目标就是作为埃及门户的阿拉曼。英军兵力雄厚，但你以往的表现表明，你应当能够击败他们。同样，你必须迅速达成目标，好让我们能持续对英军施压。你是隆美尔陆军元帅在这场进攻中的先锋指挥官！

src: Now that we have captured Sidi Barrani our next objective is El Alamein as the gateway to  Egypt. The British are present in great strength, but your past performance indicates that you should be able to overcome them. Again, you must achieve your objectives quickly so we that may maintain our pressure on the British. You are Feldmarschall Rommel's lead commander in this attack!
dst: 既然我们已经夺取了西迪拜拉尼，我们的下一个目标就是作为埃及门户的阿拉曼。英军兵力强大，但你过去的战绩表明你应该能够战胜他们。同样，你必须迅速达成目标，以便我们能保持对英军的压力。你是隆美尔元帅在这次进攻中的前锋指挥官！

src: Now that we have stopped the Allied assault on Tunis, it's time for us to move eastwards. Our next objective is El Alamein - the gateway to Egypt. The British are present in great strength, but your past performance indicates that you should be able to overcome them. Again, you must achieve your objectives quickly so we that may maintain our pressure on the British. You are Feldmarschall Rommel's lead commander in this attack!
dst: 既然我们已经阻止了盟军对突尼斯的进攻，现在该向东推进了。我们的下一个目标是阿拉曼——通往埃及的门户。英军兵力强大，但你以往的表现表明你应该能够战胜他们。同样，你必须迅速达成目标，以便我们维持对英军的压力。在这次进攻中，你是隆美尔元帅麾下的主攻指挥官！

src: Now that we have stopped the Allied assault on Tunis, it's time for us to move westwards. Our next objective is El Alamein - the gateway to  Egypt. The British are present in great strength, but your past performance indicates that you should be able to overcome them.  Again, you must achieve your objectives quickly so we that may maintain our pressure on the British.  You are Feldmarschall Rommel's lead commander in this attack!
dst: 既然我们已经阻止了盟军对突尼斯的进攻，现在该向西行动了。我们的下一个目标是阿拉曼——通往埃及的门户。英军兵力雄厚，但您以往的表现表明您应当能够战胜他们。同样，您必须迅速达成目标，以便我们保持对英军的压力。您是隆美尔元帅此次进攻的先锋指挥官！

src: Now that we have taken Wilno, our left flank will be secure. Of course there will be Soviet counterattacks, but our new positions are strong and we'll be able to handle them.
dst: 既然我们已经夺取了维尔诺，我们的左翼就安全了。当然还会有苏军的反攻，但我们的新阵地十分坚固，足以应付。

src: Now that we have taken Wilno, our left flank will be secure. Of course, there will be Soviet counterattacks. But our new positions are strong and we'll be able to handle them.
dst: 既然我们已拿下维尔诺，我们的左翼就会安全了。当然，苏军会发动反攻。但我们的新阵地很坚固，我们能够应付。

src: Now that you control Saint-Dizier the French forces have been forced to retreat from Nancy, that will fall in the next hours. Verdun is surrounded, and the siege will begin very soon. For the first time in almost five years we've been able to advance dozens of miles into France. Congratulations, General, you've earned the Pour le Mérite award! Nobody deserves it more than you.
dst: 既然您已控制圣迪济耶，法军被迫撤出南锡，该城将在数小时内陷落。凡尔登已被包围，围城战很快就要开始。近五年来，我们头一次能够深入法国推进数十英里。恭喜您，将军，您赢得了蓝马克斯勋章！没人比您更配得上它。

src: Now that you have joined de Wet's remaining forces we could have a chance to slow, or even reject the Kakies before they take Bloemfontein. It may be difficult, but we must try as long as we have the strength.
dst: 如今您已加入德韦特的残部，我们或许有机会在英军攻占布隆方丹之前迟滞、甚至击退英国佬。这也许很艰难，但只要我们还有力气，就必须尽力一试。

src: Now the German general Erich von Falkenhayn has taken over the command of the Ottoman forces in Palestine, but it seems that we can't hold our lines for much longer....We must withdraw immediately, in order to spare our forces and to to continue the fighting in a new, more favorable strategical  position.
dst: 现在，德国将军埃里希·冯·法尔肯海因接管了巴勒斯坦奥斯曼部队的指挥权，但看来我们已无法坚守防线更久了……我们必须立即撤退，以保全部队，并在新的、更有利的战略位置上继续作战。

src: Now the Germans should realize, that we could do this any time we want to ...
dst: 现在日耳曼人该明白了，我们随时都能这么做 ......

src: Now the High Command believes that we'll have time to build a solid defence line around the fortress of Premissel.  After seeing how Lemberg fell, I'm not so optimistic. It'll be better to build a second line on the Karpaten. It'll be easier to stop the Russians there. I hope I'm wrong, but I think that we'll need it.
dst: 如今最高统帅部认为，我们会有时间在普热梅希尔要塞周围构筑一道坚固的防线。看到伦贝格是如何陷落的，我不那么乐观。最好在喀尔巴阡山再筑第二道防线。在那里阻挡俄国人会更容易。但愿是我错了，但我想我们会需要它的。

src: Now the High Command believes that we'll have time to build a solid defence line around the fortress of Premissel. After seeing how Lemberg fell, I'm not so optimistic. It'll be better to build a second line on the Karpaten. It'll be easier to stop the Russians there. I hope I'm wrong, but I think that we'll need it.
dst: 如今最高统帅部认为，我们会有时间在普热梅希尔要塞周围构筑一道坚固的防线。看到伦贝格是如何陷落的，我不那么乐观。最好在喀尔巴阡山再筑第二道防线。在那里阻挡俄国人会更容易。但愿是我错了，但我想我们会需要它的。

src: Now the Indian Corps is trying to go back to Durban, but we won't allow them to do so. They could be very dangerous fighting under the protection of trenches and forts, so you should take the opportunity to overcome them in the open. Attack them and destroy them while Botha, Smuts and De Wet outflank their lines and take Durban by surprise.
dst: 现在印度军正试图返回德班，但我们不会允许他们这么做。他们若依托战壕和堡垒的掩护作战会非常危险，所以您应当抓住机会在开阔地战胜他们。趁博塔、斯马茨和德韦特包抄他们的防线并突袭夺取德班之际，向他们发起进攻并歼灭他们。

src: Now the Russians have started a great offensive of their own to capture Belgorod. We are forced to commit our Panzers there. The Soviets also started a smaller offenisive to the east of Charkov. Your XXII Pz div is to stop this at all costs.
dst: 现在俄军已发起他们自己的大规模攻势，企图夺取别尔哥罗德。我们被迫把装甲部队投入那里。苏军还在哈尔科夫以东发动了一场规模较小的攻势。您的第22装甲师须不惜一切代价阻止它。

src: Now the Serbians are paying the price. In just a few days the German, Austrian and Bulgarian offensive has routed their army, and conquered most of their country. They are approaching the borders with Albania and Greece, and that could be a disaster. Many Greek Monarchists are pro-German, and they could convince King Konstantinos to join the Central Powers, too.
dst: 现在塞尔维亚人正在付出代价。仅仅几天时间，德国、奥地利和保加利亚的攻势就击溃了他们的军队，占领了他们国家的大部分地区。他们正向阿尔巴尼亚和希腊边境逼近，那可能是一场灾难。许多希腊保皇派亲德，他们可能说服康斯坦丁国王也加入同盟国。

src: Now the coasts are secured and we can go for the inner oil camps.
dst: 如今海岸已安全，我们可以向内陆的油田进发了。

src: Now the path of retreat from the Marne back to Paris is blocked, and the French forces are split. While a large portion of them is retreating southwards, the rest is falling back on Paris before we besiege the city. The only remaining entrenched zones are the British lines to the north.
dst: 如今从马恩河撤回巴黎的退路已被切断，法军也被一分为二。他们中的很大一部分正朝南撤退，其余则在我们将要围城之前退向巴黎。仅存的固守地带只有北面的英军防线了。

src: Now the time four our great offensives is come. Several armies will join the attack in Belorussia. Your troops should take Vitebsk.  Take the town and push forward to the west.
dst: 现在我们大举进攻的时刻到来了。数支集团军将加入在白俄罗斯的进攻。你的部队应当攻取维捷布斯克。拿下该城，然后向西推进。

src: Now the way to Berlin is free. When we have finished our operations in the north your troops will attack.
dst: 现在通往柏林的道路畅通无阻。当我们在北方的行动结束后，你的部队就将发起进攻。

src: Now the world finally knows what the American soldiers are capable of. However, while we were storming Cantigny, the Germans have launched a new offensive east of here, in Soissons. They've crossed the Aisne and they're approaching the Marne. If we don't stop them, Paris might fall and the war would be over.
dst: 如今全世界终于见识了美国士兵的本领。然而，就在我们强攻康蒂尼之际，德军又在东边的苏瓦松发动了新一轮攻势。他们已渡过埃纳河，正逼近马恩河。如果我们不拦住他们，巴黎可能陷落，战争也就结束了。

src: Now we are on our way to Manasas Junction and were marching all day long....
dst: 现在我们正前往马纳萨斯枢纽，整天都在行军……

src: Now we can continue easily towards the major oil reserves in the world, the rear is secure.
dst: 现在我们能轻松地向世界上最大的石油储区推进了，后方已经稳固。

src: Now we have an excellent position to assault Wilno. You will fight in the city so artillery and infantry will be handy.
dst: 现在我们已处于进攻维尔诺的绝佳位置。您将在城市中作战，因此炮兵和步兵会派上用场。

src: Now we have fastest carry on coast and destroy English force.
dst: 如今我军须以最快速度推进至海岸，歼灭英军。

src: Now we have to advance again....
dst: 现在我们又得重新推进了……

src: Now we must triumph where our allies failed. We'll storm Saint Mihiel with the help of our artillery, our tanks, and the greatest concentration of planes that the world has ever seen. Naturally, the French will send some ground units, too. They don't want to miss this party.
dst: 如今我们必须在盟友失败之处取得胜利。我们将凭借炮兵、坦克以及有史以来最大规模的机群强攻圣米耶勒。法国人自然也会派些地面部队。他们可不想错过这场好戏。

src: Now we need a quick peace treaty at all costs. With every passing day without a peace agreement, the conditions will be harder on us. We must convince our enemies that a cease fire is good for them, too.
dst: 现在我们必须不惜一切代价尽快签订和约。每过一天没有达成和平协议，条件对我们就会越苛刻。我们必须让敌人相信，停火对他们也有好处。

src: Now we need an inmediate peace treaty at all costs. With every passing day without a peace agreement, the conditions will be harder on us. We must convince our enemies that a cease fire is good for them, too.
dst: 现在我们必须不惜一切代价立即签订和约。每过一天没有达成和平协议，条件对我们就会越苛刻。我们必须让敌人相信，停火对他们也有好处。

src: Now we will pursue the Germans back to the Adriatic coast....
dst: 现在我们将追击德军，一直打回亚得里亚海沿岸……

src: Now we'll assault the French positions and, after we suceed and the battle is over, I'll write you again. That way you'll know that I'm still alive. I can't give you more details, for security reasons. Believe me, it's better that way.
dst: 现在我们将进攻法军阵地，等我们成功、战斗结束之后，我会再给您写信。那样您就知道我仍活着。出于安全原因，我不能告诉您更多细节。相信我，这样更好。

src: Now we'll occupy Peking. The Chinese government will pay for all the crimes that they've committed and for all the destruction that they've carried out. We'll demand the Empire to pay an indemnity to all the coalition countries, and besides they'll have to punish severely all the officials who supported the Boxers. We'll not allow this madness to happen again.
dst: 现在我们要占领北京。中国政府必须为他们犯下的一切罪行和他们造成的一切破坏付出代价。我们将要求这个帝国向所有联军国家支付赔款，此外他们还必须严惩所有支持义和团的官员。我们绝不允许这种疯狂再次发生。

src: Now we'll send reinforcements to our 2nd Army, and we'll deal with the Greeks. Very soon, all of the countries involved in this war will want a peace.
dst: 现在我们将向第2集团军派出增援，去对付希腊人。很快，卷入这场战争的所有国家都会希望和平。

src: Now we're crossing the Dardanelles to support our allies on the Gallipoli peninsula, and from the little information I have received from my British counterparts, we will jump out of the frying pan right into the fire. When only half of the rumours are true, their landings have been a bloodbath and their troops have hardly reached any of their objectives by now.
dst: 现在我们正横渡达达尼尔海峡，去支援我们在加里波利半岛的盟友，而从英国同僚那里得到的零星信息来看，我们将是跳出油锅又入火海。只要传闻有一半属实，他们的登陆就是一场大屠杀，他们的部队迄今几乎没有达成任何目标。

src: Now we're finally ready, and it's about time. A couple of months ago the Germans started a series of attacks along the Western Front, and although they've suffered heavy losses, this time it seems that they could finally break through the French or British lines at any time. That is, unless we intervene and give support to our allies.
dst: 如今我们终于准备就绪，也到了该动手的时候。几个月前，德军沿西线发动了一连串进攻，虽然他们损失惨重，但这一次看来他们随时可能突破法军或英军防线。除非我们出手干预、支援我们的盟友。

src: Now when you have lots of off-duty time, maybe it'll be wise to visit some of your rivals and change them into friends.
dst: 既然你现在有大量闲暇，也许去拜访你的一些对手、把他们变成朋友是明智之举。

src: Now you are a hero for the People's Republic of China and for all the workers around the world.
dst: 现在你是中华人民共和国和全世界工人的英雄。

src: Now you don't have much to fear from the British fleet, there are few ships left on the ocean. The rest of their fleet is fighting in the Mediterranean with our Italian allies.
dst: 如今你不必太担心英国舰队，海上所剩舰船寥寥无几。他们舰队余部正在地中海与我们的意大利盟友交战。

src: Now you must choose which path you will follow for the next two scenarios:
dst: 现在您必须选择在接下来的两个场景中要走哪条路线：

src: Now you must decide where you wish to fight. If you join our 1st Army, you'll take part on the invasion of Serbia. You'll have to conquer the Morava Valley and Kosovo. After that, you'll be sent to the border with Romania, just in case they decide to attack us from the rear.
dst: 现在您必须决定想去哪里作战。如果您加入我们的第1集团军，就将参加对塞尔维亚的入侵。您必须征服摩拉瓦河谷和科索沃。之后，您将被派往与罗马尼亚接壤的边境，以防他们决定从背后进攻我们。

src: Now you must go to Italy as fast as you can. Our offensive in Trient has broken the enemy lines, but we need your help to exploit the initial success.
dst: 现在您必须尽快前往意大利。我们在特伦特的攻势已经突破了敌军防线，但我们需要您的帮助来扩大初期的战果。

src: Now you must return to France. Both sides are preparing new offensives at the Western Front, and your experience will be needed there. Good luck!
dst: 现在您必须返回法国。双方都在西线准备新的攻势，您的经验在那里会派上用场。祝您好运！

src: Now your troops have enough supplies to fight for a year or more, but it's time to leave Portuguese East Africa and travel north.
dst: 现在您的部队拥有足够维持一年甚至更久的补给，但现在是离开葡属东非、向北进发的时候了。

src: Now, about those Spanish experiences, we never did get the chance to discuss them.  You MUST come to diner and tell us both of Spain as well as how you produced this recent stunning maneuver!
dst: 现在，关于你在西班牙的经历，我们一直没机会聊。你一定要来赴宴，给我们讲讲西班牙，也讲讲你最近是如何打出这场惊人机动的！

src: Now, do you see that bridge? We must cross it. I've heard that the last time the Poles were fast enough to blow it, but now we'll be faster than they. The road beyond it is blocked by some infantry and MGs. The village is also defended by some infantrymen. Problem is that the Poles know very well that we must finally turn back to north and that this road is our only path through the quagmire.
dst: 那么，看到那座桥了吗？我们必须渡过它。我听说上次波兰人手脚够快，把它炸了，但这次我们会比他们更快。桥后的道路被一些步兵和机枪封锁。那座村庄也有一些步兵防守。问题在于，波兰人很清楚我们最终必须折回北方，而这条路是我们穿过泥沼的唯一通道。

src: Now, go forward and hunt down the criminals of the people of Russia before they can get away!
dst: 现在，前进吧，在俄国人民的敌人逃脱之前追猎他们！

src: Now, ma chère Fabienne, our columns are standing close to Sidi Bou Othmane. The road is blocked by enemies and we have run out of water, but don't worry. I've been in worse situations before. I'll write you again, as soon as possible.
dst: 现在，我亲爱的法比安娜，我们的纵队已逼近西迪布奥斯曼。道路被敌人封锁，我们的水也已耗尽，但别担心。我以前经历过更糟的处境。我会尽快再给您写信。

src: Now, the defensive positions of the Turkish 3rd Army are stretched from the coast of the Karadeniz (Black Sea) to lake Van. The main goal for the Russian forces is the mighty fortress of Erzurum. The Turkish forces around the fortress are decimated after the battle of Koprukoy and the V Corps will be sent as a reinforcements from Gelibolu to Erzurum. Keeping the roads from the ports of the Karadeniz to Erzurum is vital.
dst: 如今，土耳其第三集团军的防御阵地从黑海海岸一直延伸到凡湖。俄军的主要目标是埃尔祖鲁姆这座坚固要塞。科普吕柯伊之战后，要塞周围的土耳其军队已损失殆尽，第五军将从加利波利派往埃尔祖鲁姆作为增援。保持从黑海各港口到埃尔祖鲁姆的道路畅通至关重要。

src: Now, their warriors, steeled in countless battles, encounter in the province of Noricum, the first Romans outposts.
dst: 如今，他们身经百战的战士们，在诺里库姆行省遇到了罗马人最早的前哨。

src: Now, we are completely sure the next goal of the enemies will be the Marianas. If the americans can capture this target, they will be able to launch air strikes agaisnt Japan from here. I want to be sincere, we haven't any chance of stop a powerful seaborne enemy attack, so kill as many american soldiers as you can, and maybe the US High Command will change its mind on the approach to the main japanese islands...
dst: 如今，我们完全可以肯定，敌人的下一个目标将是马里亚纳群岛。如果美国人能攻占这一目标，他们就能从这里对日本发动空袭。我想坦诚地说，我们没有任何机会阻止一场强大的海上敌军攻势，所以请尽可能多地消灭美国士兵，也许美国最高统帅部就会改变进攻日本本土诸岛的方略……

src: Now, we must retreat to Baden, and unite our armies....
dst: 现在，我们必须撤退到巴登，并把我们的军队会合起来……

src: Now, where are the supply and transportation systems still functioning so the Allied forces can move rapidly north.........
dst: 现在，哪些补给和运输系统还在运转，好让盟军能迅速北上……

src: Now, you and your refreshment troops from our First Army must follow our offensive and take the town of Nis, where two Serbian divisions will desperately try to delay your advance. All our other forces are busy in other fronts, so you'll have to deal with the problem without expecting any reinforcements, Good luck!
dst: 现在，您和来自第1集团军的生力军必须继续我们的攻势，拿下尼什镇，那里有两个塞尔维亚师将拼死迟滞您的推进。我们其余所有部队都在其他战线忙碌，所以您不必指望任何增援，只能靠自己解决这个问题，祝您好运！

src: Now... I understand that you don't want to leave your comrades and that the men of your unit feel the same, but honestly, I don't give a damn about your hurt feelings and even less of those of your tankists. OKH decided that they need you in France, so the rest of our Norway campaign will happen without you... Sit down! Frantsche, komm! Bring us tea! And rum!
dst: 现在……我理解你不想离开战友，你部队的士兵们也一样，但说真的，我一点儿也不在乎你那受伤的感情，更不在乎你那些坦克兵的。陆军总司令部决定，他们需要你去法国，所以我们挪威战役的其余部分就不劳你参与了……坐下！弗兰策，过来！给我们上茶！还有朗姆酒！
新亚历山德罗夫斯卡亚

src: Nuestros amigos italianos estan preparando un asalto en direccion a Guadalajara. Los generales del CTV opinan que sus tropas motorizadas pueden presionar desde este sector y pone en peligro la capital, logrando lo que nosotros no hemos conseguido en los pasados meses. Esto supone evidentemente un gran desprecio hacia nosotros, pero ya veremos a ver si todos esos camiones les sirven para acabar con los rojos. Nuestros soldados dicen de los italianos que hacen falta mas coj... y menos camiones.
dst: 我们的意大利盟友正在准备向瓜达拉哈拉方向发动突击。意大利志愿军团的将军们认为，他们的摩托化部队可以从这一地段施压，威胁首都，完成我们过去几个月未能达成的目标。这显然是对我们的极大蔑视，但我们倒要看看，那些卡车究竟能否帮他们消灭共和军。我们的士兵说，意大利人需要的是更多的胆量……和更少的卡车。

src: Nuestros camaradas esperan su ayuda, dese prisa.
dst: 我们的战友正等待您的援助，请抓紧时间。

src: Nuestros espias nos informan de que los republicanos han estado reorganizando sus tropas en divisiones regulares, se espera de nuevo, una fuerte resistencia. Por otro lado tambien sabemos que los rusos estan apoyando a la Republica, tenemos informes de que los republicanos cuentan con armamento proveniente de la URSS, asi que tendremos que andar con cuidado.
dst: 我们的间谍报告，共和军一直在把部队整编为正规师，预计又会遇到顽强抵抗。另一方面，我们也知道苏联人正在支援共和国，我们得到的报告称共和军拥有来自苏联的武器装备，所以我们必须小心行事。

src: Nuevamente el plan es atacar Zaragoza, aprendiendo de los errores del pasado. Zaragoza es la puerta hacia Burgos, la capital fascista. Una gran victoria aqui podria cambiar el curso de la guerra y desestabilizar toda la retaguardia enemiga, incluso incitando al levantamiento en las zonas del Norte contra los ocupantes rebeldes.
dst: 计划再次是进攻萨拉戈萨，并从过去的错误中吸取教训。萨拉戈萨是通往法西斯首府布尔戈斯的门户。在此取得一场大胜，可能改变战争的进程，动摇敌人的整个后方，甚至鼓动北方地区反抗叛军占领者。
