src: OIL!  That's what we need, and we can get it from the Dutch colonies.  Our supplies of oil are running out, and the high command thinks we desperately need that resource.  We must secure it at all costs to maintain our war against the western powers.
dst: 石油！这正是我们需要的，而我们可以从荷兰殖民地得到它。我们的石油储备即将耗尽，高层认为我们迫切需要这一资源。为了维持对西方列强的战争，我们必须不惜一切代价夺取它。

src: ORDERS:  Oberstleutnant Hugo Bauernschmitt, while our 187th Division and 76th Reserve Division join the 51st Hungarian Honved Division in a major offensive near Hermannstadt, the Alpenkorps has been given the task to cross the Cibin Moutains in the Southern Carpathians and take the Roterturmpass ("Red Tower Pass"). The Roterturmpass is the lifeline of the Romanian invading army. Any reinforcements and supplies to their troops around Hermannstadt must come over the mountains at this point, and in case of a general retreat this is the only route back for the Romanians. Therefore, expect strong counter-attacks by the enemy at any time. Hold this pass at any cost, and victory will be ours!
dst: 命令：中校胡戈·鲍恩施密特，当我们的第187师和第76预备师会同第51匈牙利洪韦德师在赫尔曼施塔特附近发起大规模攻势时，阿尔卑斯军受命翻越南喀尔巴阡山脉的奇宾山脉，夺取红塔山口。红塔山口是罗马尼亚入侵军队的生命线。凡是要运给赫尔曼施塔特附近罗马尼亚军队的增援与补给，都必须经此翻越群山，而一旦敌军全线撤退，这里也是罗马尼亚人唯一的退路。因此，随时提防敌人的强力反扑。不惜一切代价守住这个山口，胜利将属于我们！

src: ORDERS:  Oberstleutnant Hugo Bauernschmitt, you must assault the French positions at Fort Vaux, take them and hold them. The French are heavily entrenched, so your pionieres will be of great use to you. The 1st, the 50th and the 7th Reserve infantry divisions will be part of the attack, too.
dst: 命令：胡戈·鲍恩施密特中校，您必须进攻沃堡的法军阵地，夺取并守住它们。法军据守深固，因此您的工兵将对您大有用处。第1、第50和第7预备步兵师也将参加这次进攻。

src: ORDERS: Ahhh, Bonjour, Général Bertaux-Levillain, please take a seat. A Calvados or a Cognac?
dst: 命令：啊，您好，贝尔托-勒维兰将军，请坐。来杯卡尔瓦多斯还是干邑？

src: ORDERS: Colonel Bertaux-Levillain, you are ordered to relieve our outpost at Tsarasoatra, defeat the attacking Malagasi forces of the Hova army and advance along the jungle road in order to destroy and take the enemy´s field camp.
dst: 命令：贝尔托-勒维兰上校，您奉命解察拉索阿特拉前哨之围，击败来袭的霍瓦军队马达加斯加部队，并沿丛林道路推进，以摧毁并夺取敌军的野战营地。

src: ORDERS: Colonel Bertaux-Levillain, you are ordered to support Colonel Mangin. Break through the enemy lines to continue the march to Marrakech.
dst: 命令：贝尔托-勒维兰上校，您奉命支援芒然上校。突破敌军战线，继续向马拉喀什进军。

src: ORDERS: Général Bertaux-Levillain, I want to come clean with you. The situation at Gallipoli is grave. The British have landed their troops, but some of their battalions have suffered casualty rates of 70% on a single day. The Turkish resistance is much tougher than expected, and the Brits now wait for us to reinforce their right flank, so we can advance on the town of Krithia together. Bring your troops ashore as quick as possible and attack the Turkish positions.
dst: 命令：贝尔托-勒维兰将军，我想对您实话实说。加里波利的局势十分严峻。英军已经登陆，但他们的一些营在一天之内伤亡率高达70%。土耳其的抵抗远比预期顽强，英国人现在等着我们去加强他们的右翼，这样我们就能一起向克里提亚镇推进。尽快让您的部队上岸，攻击土耳其阵地。

src: ORDERS: Général Bertaux-Levillain, the brave men of the ANZAC welcome you. They have been fighting very hard over every inch of soil during the last months, as your men did at Cape Helles. Nevertheless, the Turks still hold the high ground, most importantly the heights of Chunuk Bair and a few other strategic points along the Sari Bair range, which give their artillery a perfect firing position. So taking the heights will be our main objective. If we succeed to take Chunuk Bair, and the landing at Suvla Bay is successful as well, we might be able to join forces north of Krithia, so that the Turks will have to give up their defensive line in the south and retreat towards Constantinople.
dst: 命令：贝尔托-勒维兰将军，澳新军团的勇士们欢迎您。过去几个月里，他们为每一寸土地浴血奋战，正如您的士兵在赫勒斯角所做的那样。然而，土耳其人仍占据着高地，最重要的是丘努克拜尔高地和萨里拜尔山脊沿线另外几个战略要点，这使他们的炮兵拥有绝佳的射击位置。因此夺取高地将是我们的主要目标。如果我们成功拿下丘努克拜尔，苏夫拉湾的登陆也取得成功，我们或许就能在克里提亚以北会师，这样土耳其人就不得不放弃南面的防线，向君士坦丁堡撤退。

src: ORDERS: Général Bertaux-Levillain, you are ordered again to delay the German offensive and hold as much ground as possible.
dst: 命令：贝尔托-勒维兰将军，您再次奉命迟滞德军攻势，并尽可能多地守住阵地。

src: ORDERS: Général Bertaux-Levillain, you are ordered to command our right flank on our assault on Sarrebourg. The 1st Bavarian Corps is near your positions, and our intelligence reports suggest that they might be preparing a counterattack.
dst: 命令：贝尔托-勒维兰将军，您奉命在我们进攻萨尔堡时指挥我方右翼。巴伐利亚第1军就在您的阵地附近，我们的情报报告显示，他们可能正准备反击。

src: ORDERS: Général Bertaux-Levillain, you are ordered to delay the German offensive and hold as much ground as possible.
dst: 命令：贝尔托-勒维兰将军，您奉命迟滞德军攻势，并尽可能多地守住阵地。

src: ORDERS: Général Bertaux-Levillain, you are ordered to regain control of the fortresses of Vaux and Douamont, with the 38th Division on your left and the 74th Division on your right.
dst: 命令：贝尔托-勒维兰将军，您奉命夺回沃堡和杜奥蒙堡的控制权，第38师在您左翼，第74师在您右翼。

src: ORDERS: Général Bertaux-Levillain, you are ordered to stop the attack of the 2nd Bulgarian Army in Macedonia.
dst: 命令：贝尔托-勒维兰将军，您奉命在马其顿阻止保加利亚第2集团军的进攻。

src: ORDERS: Général Bertaux-Levillain, you are ordered to take and hold La Bassée while the cavalry of générals de Mitry and Conneau outflanks the German positions. London busses are transporting British reinforcements to the front. Expect at least a brigade to arrive somewhere tomorrow.
dst: 命令：贝尔托-勒维兰将军，您奉命夺取并守住拉巴塞，同时德米特里将军和科诺将军的骑兵包抄德军阵地。伦敦的公共汽车正把英国增援部队运往前线。预计明天至少有一个旅抵达某地。

src: ORDERS: Général Bertaux-Levillain, you are ordered to take part in the attack of General Manoury's 6th Army against the German right flank at the River Ourcq. The 55th and parts of the 56th Reserve Divisions will support you and do their very best, but you may have no doubt that your experienced elite troops will have to be the heart of soul of our attack.
dst: 命令：贝尔托-勒维兰将军，您奉命参加莫努里将军第6集团军在乌尔克河对德军右翼的进攻。第55预备师和第56预备师的一部将支援您并全力以赴，但您不必怀疑，您经验丰富的精锐部队必须成为我们这次进攻的核心与灵魂。

src: ORDERS: Général Bertaux-Levillain, your orders are to secure the British flank, and make sure that their advance towards Passendale proceeds without any incidents.
dst: 命令：贝托-勒维兰将军，您的命令是保障英军的侧翼，并确保他们向帕森达勒的推进不出现任何意外。

src: ORDERS: Herr Oberst, your orders are clear: your men must assault the French defences at Kemmelberg and open a gap in the Entente lines, one that we can exploit to capture the Channel ports and encircle Paris. The outcome of this war may depend on you. Good luck!
dst: 命令：上校先生，您的命令很明确：您的部队必须进攻凯默尔山的法军防线，在协约国战线上撕开一个缺口，好让我们能够利用它夺取海峡港口并包围巴黎。这场战争的结局或许就系于您一身。祝您好运！

src: ORDERS: Major Hugo Bauernschmitt, The Austrians have not much more then a handfull of local StandSchütz militia and some Gendarmes to defend the mountain passes because most of their mountain units are in Galicia. The newly formed Alpenkorps is the right unit to support them.
dst: 命令：胡戈·鲍恩施密特少校，奥地利人用来防守山口的，除了一小撮当地的民防民兵和几名宪兵之外，几乎再无其他兵力，因为他们的大部分山地部队都在加利西亚。新组建的阿尔卑斯军正是支援他们的合适部队。

src: ORDERS: Major Hugo Bauernschmitt, you, along with some units of the XXII Reserve Korps and the Austrian 10th Mountain Brigade, will have to go to the south as quickly as you can and take control of the roads that lead to Albania and Montenegro. Should the Serbians resist you, do not hesitate to use force. It will be a good opportunity to test the usefulness of your new artillery battery.
dst: 命令：胡戈·鲍恩施密特少校，您将与第22预备军的一些部队以及奥地利第10山地旅一起，尽快向南推进，控制通往阿尔巴尼亚和黑山的道路。如果塞尔维亚人抵抗，不要犹豫，立刻使用武力。这将是检验您新炮兵连威力的好机会。

src: ORDERS: Oberst Bauernschmitt, our spring offensives have failed and we are back on the defence. The positions around Epéhy on the heights in front of the river Scheldt need to be held until the Hindenburg line behind us is in good enough shape to fall back to to resist Entente attacks.
dst: 命令：鲍恩施密特上校，我们的春季攻势已经失败，我们重新转入防御。位于斯海尔德河前方高地上、埃佩伊周围的阵地必须守住，直到我们身后兴登堡防线加固到足以撤回并抵御协约国进攻为止。

src: ORDERS: Oberst Bauernschmitt, the Italians are offering a ferocious resistance near the river Piave. They've gathered fresh troops and artillery, and they've filled the area with machine gun nests. Take your troops and, along with the Jäger Division, occupy Monte Tomba. From there, we could be able to overcome the last enemy defences.
dst: 命令：鲍恩施密特上校，意大利人正在皮亚韦河附近进行顽强的抵抗。他们集结了生力军和炮兵，并在该地区布满了机枪巢。率领您的部队，与猎兵师一起，占领托姆巴山。从那里，我们就有可能攻克敌人最后的防线。

src: ORDERS: Oberst Bauernschmitt, you, as well as three other divisions, will have to break the Italian lines at the Upper Isonzo and open a wide gap that our second line troops can use to advance deep into Italian territory. We'll use all kinds of weapons, including some of our new Sturmtruppen battalions. Don't stop until you reach the village of Cividale.
dst: 命令：鲍恩施密特上校，您以及其他三个师，必须在上伊松佐河突破意军防线，打开一个宽阔的缺口，让我们的第二线部队能够深入意大利境内。我们将动用各类武器，包括一些新的突击队营。不抵达奇维达莱村就不得停下。

src: ORDERS: Oberstleutnant Bauernschmitt, we will launch a new offensive further south against the city of Ramnicu Sarat, in order to finally break out of the moutain range and reach the plains. The Alpenkorps and the Austro-Hungarian 73rd Division are given the task to support this assault by attacking the last remaining enemy positions in the Carpathians. Be aware, that Russian reinforcements have arrived in the area and will probably try to counter-attack. As reinforcements for your troops, the Württemberg mountain battalion will be temporarily under your command during this battle.
dst: 命令：鲍恩施密特中校，我们将向更南面发动一次新的攻势，进攻勒姆尼库瑟拉特城，以便最终冲出山区、进入平原。阿尔卑斯军和奥匈帝国第73师的任务，是通过进攻喀尔巴阡山中敌军最后残余的阵地来支援这次突击。请注意，俄军增援部队已抵达该地区，并很可能试图反攻。作为对您部队的增援，符腾堡山地营将在本次战斗中暂时归您指挥。

src: ORDERS: Oberstleutnant Bauernschmitt, your goal will be to take and hold the villages of Panciu, Marasesti, and other locations in the region of Vrancea. You’ll have the help of three German and one Austro- Hungarian divisions. Although there is a strong enemy presence in the area, we believe that they haven’t had time to consolidate their positions, so their defence lines will be poorly built, and a bold counterattack is likely to succeed.
dst: 命令：鲍恩施密特中校，您的目标是夺取并守住潘丘、马拉塞什蒂等弗朗恰地区的村镇。您将得到三个德军师和一个奥匈师的协助。尽管该地区敌军兵力强大，但我们相信他们还没来得及巩固阵地，因此他们的防线会构筑得很差，一次大胆的反攻很可能成功。

src: ORDERS: Sir, now that we took Petersburg, the confederates are retreating to Richmond, their last stronghold and capital of the Confederate States of America. You and your Army have been ordered to proceed northwards and approach Richmond from the south. Only the Fortifications near the James River lie between us and Richmond.
dst: 命令：先生，既然我们拿下了彼得斯堡，南方军正向里士满——他们的最后堡垒、美利坚邦联的首都——撤退。您和您的集团军奉命向北推进，从南面逼近里士满。我们与里士满之间，只剩下詹姆斯河附近的防御工事。

src: ORDERS: Take all 5 victory hexes that the enemy currently controls.
dst: 命令：夺取敌人当前控制的全部5个胜利点。

src: ORDERS:(from General Nivelle:) General, your orders are clear and easy: break through the enemy Lines, recapture the Chemin des Dames and take your advance to the city of Laon.
dst: 命令：（来自尼维尔将军：）将军，您的命令明确而简单：突破敌军防线，重新夺回贵妇小径，并将您的攻势推进到拉昂城。

src: Obergefreiter with a Nebelhandgranate Stielhandgranate M-24.
dst: 手持 M-24 发烟柄式手榴弹的上等兵。

src: Oberstleutnant, your attacks in the Carpathians didn't bring the much needed relief for our troops in the south. The progress we made was in vain, and determined counter-attacks by fresh Russian divisions threw us back to our starting points. We will attack again, but right now our mauled army needs time for rest and consolidation.
dst: 中校，您在喀尔巴阡山脉的进攻并未给南线的我军带来急需的缓解。我们所取得的进展付诸东流，俄国生力军师的坚决反攻将我们赶回了出发地。我们还会再次进攻，但眼下我们这支饱受重创的军队需要时间休整和巩固。

src: Oberstleutnant, your men fought bravely and blocked any reinforcements coming over the Carpathians. We have not been able to defeat the enemy completely, though, and some units of the Romanian Army were able to retreat back over the Carpathians. Nevertheless, Transylvania has been liberated, and soon we will continue our offensive into Romania soon.
dst: 中校，您的士兵作战英勇，并切断了经喀尔巴阡山脉而来的所有增援。不过我们未能完全击败敌人，罗马尼亚军队的部分单位还是得以翻越喀尔巴阡山脉撤回。尽管如此，特兰西瓦尼亚已经解放，我们不久将很快继续向罗马尼亚腹地进攻。

src: Oberstleutnant, your men fought bravely, but the Romanians were able to push our troops aside and retreat over the Carpathians. We liberated Transylvania, but our victory has not been as complete as expected. Now that we will continue our offensive into Romania, I hope that this missed opportunity will not cost us dearly in the future.
dst: 中校，您的士兵作战英勇，但罗马尼亚人得以击退我军，翻越喀尔巴阡山脉撤退。我们解放了特兰西瓦尼亚，但胜利并不像预期的那样彻底。既然我们即将继续向罗马尼亚腹地进攻，我希望这次错失的良机将来不会让我们付出沉重代价。

src: Oberstleutnant, you’ve wasted a great amount of precious lives, resources and time in a useless attack. We simply can’t afford that. We’re fighting a desperate war against some of the greatest powers in the world. If we give them the slightest chance, they’ll destroy Germany without hesitation. We can’t allow performances like yours at Marasesti.
dst: 中校，您在一次毫无用处的进攻中浪费了大量宝贵的生命、资源和时间。我们根本承担不起。我们正在与世界上一些最强大的国家进行一场殊死的战争。只要给他们一丝机会，他们就会毫不犹豫地摧毁德国。我们绝不允许再出现像您在马拉塞什蒂那样的表现。

src: Objective: Destroy the 3 marked Soviet Fighters, and the Soviet Partisans
dst: 目标：摧毁3架被标记的苏军战斗机，以及苏军游击队

src: Objective: Destroy the 4  marked Soviet Fighters, and the Soviet Partisans
dst: 目标：摧毁4架被标记的苏军战斗机，以及苏军游击队

src: Objective: Hold as many VH as you can until the last turn...
dst: 目标：尽可能多地守住胜利点，直到最后一个回合……
观测/第1皇家炮兵/第1外籍军团/- [XXX]
观察哨 第65步兵师 [第1空降兵]

src: Observer Corps aircraft spotter on the roof of a building in London during the Battle of Britain, with St. Paul's Cathedral in the background.
dst: 不列颠空战期间，一名观察团飞机瞭望员站在伦敦一栋建筑的屋顶上，背景是圣保罗大教堂。
奥布希夫卡 (基洛夫斯科耶)

src: Obviously the defeated enemy withdraws behind the Egyptian border - at Sollum the Commonwealth troops will probably prepared their next defensive position. Follow the enemy with a small force and let your main troops rest a few days.
dst: 显然，被击败的敌人撤回了埃及边境之后——在塞卢姆，英联邦部队大概会准备他们的下一个防御阵地。派一支小部队追击敌人，让你的主力部队休整几天。

src: Obviously you have problems choosing which way to go..
dst: 看来您在选择前进方向上遇到了困难……

src: Obviously you need to take a rest. Another General will replace you now as C-in-C of the DAK. (You are dimised).
dst: 看来你需要休息一下了。另一位将军将接替你出任非洲军总司令。（你被解职了。）

src: Obviously, you did your best, but this time the enemy tide was unstoppable. The Entente has taken Prilep and marches through the Vardar Valley. If the Germans don't send any reinforcements inmediately, we'll have to ask for an armistice. This war has been too much for us.
dst: 显然，您已经尽了全力，但这一次敌人的潮水势不可挡。协约国已拿下普里莱普，正沿瓦尔达尔河谷挺进。如果德国人不立即派出援军，我们就不得不请求停战。这场战争对我们而言太过沉重了。
占领布列斯特与科布林。

src: Occupy Dubno and Rovno and ensure the northern wing of our attack on Kiev.
dst: 占领杜布诺与罗夫诺，并确保我军进攻基辅的北翼。

src: Occupy Gromoslavka by moving 6 ground units into it.
dst: 移动6个地面单位进入格罗莫斯拉夫卡，将其占领。

src: Occupy Ukraine and destroy Soviet armies.
dst: 占领乌克兰，并歼灭苏军。

src: Occupy and hold the bridges across the river Don River.
dst: 占领并守住顿河上的桥梁。
奥切列图瓦捷 (奥切列托瓦托耶)

src: Oct 24th - Nov 19th 1917: Italian forces at the Isonzo River were routed by Austro-Hungarian forces reinforced by German units employing Sturmtruppen tactics.
dst: 1917年10月24日-11月19日：伊松佐河沿岸的意大利军队被奥匈军队击溃，后者得到了采用突击队战术的德军部队的加强。

src: Octavian and Antonius alienated more and more after the "retirement" of Lepidus  (The Romans made Cleopatra responsible for this ) it Finally came to civil war between Octavian and Antonius...
dst: 雷必达「隐退」之后，屋大维与安东尼乌斯越发疏远（罗马人把此事归咎于克利奥帕特拉），两人最终爆发内战...
十月铁路 列宁格勒 - 莫斯科

src: Odessa ist lost. The only good thing is, that a traitor like you is fallen into the faschist clutches. I am sure they will arrive you every moment and thank you for your good work.
dst: 敖德萨失守了。唯一的好消息是，像你这样的叛徒落入了法西斯分子的魔掌。我相信他们随时都会赶到，并感谢你的出色工作。
奥多贝什蒂(奥多贝什蒂)

src: Of all sectors of the front, from Leningrad to Moscow and to Stalingrad, just here at Ordzhonikidze, we have the iniative, comrade. You have saved Ordzhonikidze from an immediately enemy invasion and cut off the supply lines for the fascist forces at Ordzhonikidze. However, as usual the enemy is persistant, we are sure the Germans have send reinforcements to restore the lines with the trapped Germans. It is likely that the encircled forces will participate in the breakout. If these forces join, then we are likely to lose Ordzhonikidze after all. You must make sure this does not happen by destroying the encircled enemy force and to drive west, away from Ordzhonikidze!
dst: 从列宁格勒到莫斯科再到斯大林格勒的所有战线中，只有奥尔忠尼启则这里，主动权在我们手中，同志。你使奥尔忠尼启则免遭敌人的直接入侵，并切断了奥尔忠尼启则法西斯部队的补给线。然而，敌人一如既往地顽强，我们确信德军已派出增援，试图与被围德军恢复联系。被围部队很可能会参与突围。如果这些部队会合，那我们终究可能失去奥尔忠尼启则。你必须确保这不会发生——消灭被围敌军，并向西推进，远离奥尔忠尼启则！

src: Of course the rebels are aware of this, and I bet they will try everything to break the siege. I feel this might become one of the heaviest fights of the war.
dst: 叛军当然也意识到了这一点，我敢打赌他们会不惜一切代价打破包围。我感觉这可能会成为这场战争中最惨烈的战斗之一。

src: Of course there are many things that have to be taken into consideration to determine the difficulty of a certain campaign and different players may experience the level of difficulty differently, so the stated level of difficulty should just be taken as a rough information whether a campaign is easy, medium or hard to play.
dst: 当然，判定某一战役的难度需要考虑许多因素，不同玩家的难度体验也可能不同，因此所列难度等级只应作为该战役玩起来是简单、中等还是困难的粗略参考信息。

src: Of course, I had heard the rumours about a surge of the partisan activity along the railroads, but to be honest, I had not paid much attention to them. After one year of war against the Red Army, the idea of worrying for a bunch of peasants with forks seemed hilarious to me.
dst: 当然，我也听说过铁路沿线游击活动激增的传闻，但老实说，我并没有太在意。在同红军打了一年仗之后，为一帮拿草叉的农民担忧，在我听来十分可笑。

src: Of course, it will take some months to pacify the country completely, but the indigenous police will be able to do that without our support. Abd el-Krim will be captured sooner or later, he doesn't have anywhere to hide any more.
dst: 当然，要完全平定这个国家还需要几个月，但当地警察在没有我们支援的情况下也能做到。阿卜杜勒·克里姆迟早会被抓住，他已无处可藏。

src: Of course, not everybody in Bulgaria will understand this decision. After all, we have become allies of the Ottoman Empire, and enemies of Russia, our traditional friend. But, didn't Serbia ally with the Turks in 1913, during the Interallied War? And where was Russia then, when we desperately needed her? No, this alliance with Germany will give Bulgaria what she deserves...the absolute hegemony on the Balkans!
dst: 当然，并不是每个保加利亚人都能理解这一决定。毕竟，我们成了奥斯曼帝国的盟友，成了我们传统朋友俄国的敌人。可是，1913年盟国间战争期间，塞尔维亚不也和土耳其人结盟了吗？而当我们迫切需要俄国的时候，俄国又在哪里？不，与德国的这个联盟将给予保加利亚她应得的东西……对巴尔干的绝对霸权！

src: Of course, that makes the Germans very dangerous now. They know that it's now or never for them. If they don't beat us soon, they'll lose their last chance. If they attack my sector, I just hope that I'll find the strength to do my duty one more time. I'm so tired that every day I think about the possibility of retiring. But, alas, I can't afford being weak right now.
dst: 当然，这让德国人现在变得非常危险。他们知道对他们来说现在是机不可失。如果他们不能很快击败我们，就会失去最后的机会。如果他们进攻我这个地段，我只希望我能找到力量，再尽一次我的职责。我太累了，每天都想着退役的可能。但是，唉，此刻我不能让自己软弱。

src: Of course, we both know that if I happen to be less obsessed with vengeance than other veterans of the war against Prussia, it's just because we first met, and we were engaged, during the siege of Belfort. So, despite the humiliation of the defeat, I can't help but remember that time as one of the happiest in my life.
dst: 当然，我们俩都知道，如果说我不像其他对普战争老兵那样执迷于复仇，那只是因为我们初次相遇并订婚，正是在贝尔福被围期间。因此，尽管战败令人屈辱，我却仍不禁把那段时光当作我一生中最幸福的时光之一。

src: Of the 57 men who entered the church of Baler, 37 survived the 337-day siege; 14 men died (12 from diseases and only two from wounds) and four deserted. Two men were executed for helping in the desertion of another on June 1, 1899, the day before the surrender.
dst: 进入巴莱尔教堂的57人中，37人在337天的围困中生还；14人死亡（12人死于疾病，只有2人死于战伤），4人开了小差。2人因在1899年6月1日——投降前一天——帮助另一人开小差而被处决。
图外 维尔赖克机场

src: Official TOP SECRET report to OKW.
dst: 呈最高统帅部的绝密正式报告。

src: Officially, French Martinique and the British Windward Islands are neutral and we have no troops there. Only the American facilities on Trinidad provided us the reason for the occupation of this island. Now we had to learn that British St. Lucia and St. Vincent make obviously common cause with the enemy and allow the Americans to use their airfields.
dst: 官方上，法属马提尼克和英属向风群岛是中立的，我们在那里没有驻军。只有特立尼达上的美国设施，为我们占领该岛提供了理由。如今我们得知，英属圣卢西亚和圣文森特显然与敌人沆瀣一气，允许美国人使用他们的机场。

src: Oficial Nacionalista- AH!, que tenemos aqui?, un general republicano!. El alto mando del Generalisimo estara encantado de saber que hemos capturado a un general rojo, esto es un paso mas para librar a este pais de canallas como usted!. Jajaja!, quiere usted unirse al bando que va a vencer?, no?, entonces se pudrira usted en la carcel!.
dst: 国民军军官——啊哈！我们这儿有什么？一位共和军将军！大元帅的最高指挥部要是知道我们抓到了一位共和军将军，一定会很高兴，这又是把您这样的无赖从我们国家清除出去的一步！哈哈哈！您想加入即将获胜的一方吗？不想？那您就在监狱里烂掉吧！

src: Ofitser/ Armed Forces of Southern Russia
dst: Ofitser/ 武装部队 of 南部俄罗斯

src: Oh thank God!, you have saved us General.  We ran out of ammunition and supplies.  Me and my staff were fearing the worst as the Reds were over running the city.  Now, we can continue to protect Oviedo.
dst: 哦，谢天谢地！您救了我们，将军。我们的弹药和补给都已耗尽。赤色分子占领全城时，我和我的参谋都料想最坏的结果。现在，我们可以继续保卫奥维耶多了。

src: Oh wait, the Germans have launched a counterattack. They will try to cut us off. Although the VII US Corps is trying to stop the attack we are not sure if it will be able to parry the attack. Keep a rear guard at your starting position!
dst: 哦等等，德军发动了反击。他们会试图切断我们。尽管美军第7军正设法阻止这次进攻，我们仍不确定它能否挡住。在您的出发阵地留一支后卫部队！

src: Oh yes, some anti-Bolshevik elements we found have joined us against the soviet government, and they are now part of your command.
dst: 哦，是的，我们找到的一些反布尔什维克分子已经加入了我们、共同对抗苏联政府，他们现在归您指挥。

src: Oh!, a fascist general as prisoner!, our Gudari units are making an outstanding defence of the Basque soil. Would you like to join us or maybe the execution platoon instead? hahaha!.
dst: 哦！一个法西斯将军成了俘虏！我们的巴斯克战士正在出色地保卫巴斯克土地。您愿意加入我们，还是加入行刑队？哈哈哈！

src: Oh!, un general fascista ha caido prisionero!, nuestros gudaris estan llevando una excelente defensa de Euzkadi. Le gustaria a usted unirse a nosotros o prefiere unirse al peloton de ejecucion? jajajajaja.
dst: 哦！一个法西斯将军成了俘虏！我们的巴斯克战士正在出色地保卫巴斯克。您愿意加入我们，还是更愿意加入行刑队？哈哈哈哈哈。

src: Oh, I have to stop here, my chère Fabienne. General Duchesne has just informed me that our outpost at Tsarasoatra is being attacked by Hova forces. Thousands of them seem to assault the positions of my dear friend Lt.-Colonel Lentonnet and his Algerian Regiment. I have to hurry forward with my men, if we want to save them. Thank God, I have a good horse that will carry me to where my weak feet will not be able to lead me...
dst: 哦，我得停笔了，我亲爱的法比安娜。迪谢纳将军刚刚通知我，我们在察拉索阿特拉的前哨正遭到霍瓦军队的攻击。成千上万的敌军似乎在猛攻我亲爱的朋友伦托内中校和他的阿尔及利亚团的阵地。我若想救他们，就得率部下火速前进。感谢上帝，我有一匹好马，能把我送到我虚弱的双脚无法引领我去的地方……

src: Oh, that's gotta hurt.  Their ships are on fire and their docks are in our hands, Commander.  Good work.
dst: 哎哟，那肯定很疼。他们的船在燃烧，码头已落入我们手中，指挥官。干得漂亮。
奥赫里米夫卡 (叶夫列莫夫卡)
奥克瑟维耶 (奥克斯赫夫特)
铁甲老兵——美军第1装甲师
亚历山德里夫卡 (第二亚历山德罗夫卡)
亚历山德里夫卡 (亚历山德罗夫卡)
亚历山德里夫卡 (亚历山德罗夫卡)
亚历山德罗皮尔 (亚历山德罗波尔)
奥莱尼夫卡 (尼古拉耶夫卡)
奥莱克西伊夫卡 (阿列克谢耶夫卡)

src: Omedetogozaimasu!  The enemy garrison was overrun by your glorious troops.  Now Darwin will be our beach head in this country.  Be ready to continue the penetration to the South.
dst: 恭喜！敌军守备部队已被您光荣的部队击溃。如今达尔文将成为我们在这个国家的滩头阵地。请做好准备，继续向南挺进。

src: Omedetogozaimasu!, althougth the mission was a hard one, you have achieved great success. The Allies will take time to reorganize themselves.
dst: 恭喜！尽管任务艰巨，您仍取得了巨大成功。盟军需要时间来重整旗鼓。

src: Omedetogozaimasu!, the operation has been a complete success, now you can embark your units...
dst: 恭喜！行动取得了圆满成功，现在您可以登船撤离部队了……

src: Omedetou General!!! Guadalcanal and the Solomon's are now safely in our hands!  Your actions secured our bases on these islands, which will be important for any further attacks in the South Pacific, and maybe on Australia.  You are awarded with the Order of the Golden Kite 2nd class, omedetou again.
dst: 恭喜，将军！！！瓜达尔卡纳尔岛和所罗门群岛现已牢牢掌握在我们手中！您的行动巩固了我们在这些岛屿上的基地，这些基地对今后在南太平洋乃至澳大利亚的任何进一步进攻都至关重要。您被授予金鵄勋章二等，再次恭喜您。
奥梅利亚诺维奇-帕夫连科
奥梅利亚尼夫卡 (叶梅利亚诺夫卡)

src: On 11th April 1945 the 1st Czechoslovak Army Corps captured Turciansky Svaty Martin. The next main city was Zilina, but as the road through the narrow Strecianske Valley was blocked by the Germans and moreover the bridges were flooded away, it was decided to move through the Mala Fatra mountains.
dst: 1945年4月11日，捷克斯洛伐克第1军攻克图尔钱斯基圣马丁。下一个主要城市是日利纳，但由于穿过狭窄的斯特雷奇诺山谷的道路被德军封锁，而且桥梁被洪水冲毁，遂决定改走小法特拉山区。

src: On 12 February 1944 the military officials decided that forty R-2 tanks to be converted in TACAMs. On July 22nd 1944 the High Command of Motomechanized Troops suspended the production of the last twenty TACAMs, resulting a total of twenty-one produced together with the prototype. In July 1944, the TACAM R-2s were distributed to the 1st Tank Regiment were they formed the 63th Tank-destroyer Company. They were used in the liberation of Romanian territory, by September 1944 only six serviceable TACAM R-2s remaining. After the 1st Tank Regiment was disbanded at Soviet order, the six TACAMs entered the composition of the 2nd Tank Regiment and took part in the operations in Austria and Moravia, at the end of the war only one surviving.
dst: 1944年2月12日，军方决定改装40辆R-2坦克为TACAM。1944年7月22日，摩托化机械化部队最高司令部叫停最后20辆TACAM的生产，最终连同原型车共生产21辆。1944年7月，TACAM R-2配属第1坦克团，编成第63坦克歼击车连。其用于罗马尼亚领土的解放，至1944年9月仅存6辆可动。第1坦克团奉苏军命令解散后，这6辆TACAM编入第2坦克团，参加奥地利与摩拉维亚方向的作战，战争结束时仅存1辆。

src: On 13 May, the German XIX Army Corps forced three crossings near Sedan, executed by the motorised infantry regiments of 1st, 2nd and 10th Panzerdivision, reinforced by the elite Grossdeutschland infantry regiment. Instead of slowly massing artillery as the French expected, the Germans concentrated most of their tactical bomber force to punch a hole in a narrow sector of the French lines by carpet bombing. Hermann Goring had promised Guderian that there would be an extraordinary heavy air support of a continual eight hour air attack, from 8am until dusk...
dst: 5月13日，德军第十九军在色当附近强渡，由第1、第2、第10装甲师的摩托化步兵团在精锐的大德意志步兵团加强下实施。德军没有像法军预料的那样缓慢集结炮兵，而是将大部战术轰炸机兵力集中，以地毯式轰炸在法军防线的一个窄段撕开缺口。赫尔曼·戈林曾向古德里安承诺，将从清晨8点至黄昏持续8小时，提供异常猛烈的空中支援……

src: On 13 November 1918, two days after the armistice in Europe, Lettow-Vorbeck now appointed as Major General, got a letter from a captured British motorcyclist
dst: 1918年11月13日，即欧洲停战两天之后，已被任命为少将的莱托-福尔贝克从一名被俘的英国摩托车手那里得到了一封信

src: On 14 October 1941, most of the remaining forces of the Red Army were evacuated.

On 15 February 1898 the armoured cruiser US Maine sank in Habana harbour after a sudden explosion, killing nearly three quarters of the crew. Sent to protect U.S. interests during the Cuban revolt against Spain, the cause and responsibility for the sinking remained unclear (most likely an undetected fire in one of the coal bunkers). Nevertheless, popular opinion in the U.S., fanned by the "Yellow Press" of William Randolph Hearst and Joseph Pulitzer, blamed Spain. While the sinking of the Maine was not a direct casus belli, the event, together with the perceived Spanish atrocities and loss of control in Cuba, created an atmosphere that virtually precluded a peaceful solution.
dst: 1898年2月15日，美国装甲巡洋舰缅因号在哈瓦那港因突发爆炸沉没，近四分之三的船员丧生。该舰本是为在古巴反西起义期间保护美国利益而来，其沉没的原因和责任至今不明（很可能是某一煤舱内未察觉的火灾所致）。然而，在威廉·伦道夫·赫斯特和约瑟夫·普利策的「黄色报刊」煽动下，美国民众舆论将罪责归于西班牙。虽然缅因号沉没并非直接的战争导火索，但这一事件，加上所感知的西班牙暴行及其在古巴失去控制，共同营造了一种实际上排除了和平解决的氛围。

src: On 17 October 1942, awared by the poor condition of their allies facing an increasing power of the Soviet armoured force, Germany agreed to deliver twenty-two of their medium-type tanks to the Romanian Army. These included eleven Panzerkampfwagen III Ausf N, the final version of the Pzkpfw III series, produced by Daimler-Benz during 1942-43.
dst: 1942年10月17日，鉴于其盟友面对苏军装甲力量日益增强而状况堪忧，德国同意向罗马尼亚陆军交付22辆中型坦克。其中包括11辆三号坦克N型（Pzkpfw III N）——由戴姆勒-奔驰于1942—43年生产的Pzkpfw III系列最终型号。

src: On 2 July, Filipino insurgent troops attacked and seized control of Manila's only pumping station, thus cutting off the water supply to the city. Heavily outnumbered, the Spanish garrison from the waterworks was forced to retreat and fight its way back to Manila. The Spanish lines began firing in the general direction of the Filipino trenches to support Santolán troops' retreat. However, the lack of forces and the distance to the main Spanish defensive line prevented Spanish to try to recapture the waterworks.
dst: 7月2日，菲律宾起义军进攻并夺取了马尼拉唯一的泵站，从而切断了城市供水。自来水厂的西班牙守备队因寡不敌众，被迫撤退，一路杀回马尼拉。西班牙战线开始朝菲律宾战壕的大致方向开火，以掩护桑托兰部队的撤退。然而，由于兵力不足且距离西班牙主防线太远，西班牙人无法尝试夺回自来水厂。

src: On 25th May, against Hitler's orders, Dietrich ordered an assault across the canal to eliminate the French artillery positions on the Wattenberg heights, which commanded the surrounding flatlands.  During the middle of the attack, General Guderian - to whose Panzer Corps the Leibstandarte was subordinate - appeared at Dietrich's HQ demanding to know why orders were being disobeyed.  Dietrich replied that the enemy on Mont Watten could 'look right down the throat' of anyone on the far bank of the canal.  Suitably appraised of the situation and encouraged by the early success of the advance, Guderian immediately approved the decision taken by Dietrich and ordered the 2nd Panzer Division to move up in support.
dst: 5月25日，迪特里希违抗希特勒的命令，下令越过运河发动进攻，以消灭瓦滕贝格高地上的法军炮兵阵地——那些阵地俯瞰着周围的平原。进攻进行到一半时，古德里安将军——警卫旗队所属装甲军的军长——出现在迪特里希的司令部，质问为何违抗命令。迪特里希回答说，蒙瓦滕的敌人能“直盯着”运河对岸任何人的喉咙。古德里安在恰当了解情况后，又受到推进初期成功的鼓舞，当即批准了迪特里希的决定，并命令第2装甲师前出支援。

src: On 28 September 1918 von Lettow again crossed the Rovuma and returned to German East Africa with the British still in pursuit. He then turned west and raided Northern Rhodesia, thus evading a trap the British had prepared for him in German East Africa.
dst: 1918年9月28日，冯·莱托再次渡过鲁伍马河，在英军仍紧追不舍的情况下返回德属东非。随后他转向西面，突袭了北罗得西亚，从而避开了英国人在德属东非为他设下的陷阱。

src: On 29 january the offensive started, the 7th and 4th Romanian army corps encountering forces of 8th German army.
dst: 1月29日攻势发起，罗马尼亚第7、第4军遭遇德国第8集团军部队。

src: On 3 March 1918 the Bolsheviks signed the peace treaty of Brest-Litovsk which made an end to official hostilities between Russia and the Central Powers. However sporadic fighting continued for days. Russia gave away huge territories including the Ukraine. At the time of the armistice the Czech Legion was east of Kiev.
dst: 1918年3月3日，布尔什维克签订了《布列斯特-立托夫斯克和约》，结束了俄国与同盟国之间的正式敌对状态。然而，零星战斗又持续了数日。俄国割让了包括乌克兰在内的大片领土。停战之时，捷克军团位于基辅以东。

src: On 3rd September the Allies launched Operation Baytown and the British XIII Corps crossed the Messina Strait from Sicily to Regio di Calabria. The Germans had pulled back their forces because the awaited the main force of the allies to make landfall somewhere in the north. Only one Regiment was left back to defent 17 miles of coast.
dst: 9月3日，盟军发起"贝城行动"，英国第13军从西西里横渡墨西拿海峡登陆卡拉布里亚的雷焦。德军此前已撤走部队，因为他们预料盟军主力将在北部某处登陆。只留下一个团防守17英里的海岸线。

src: On 4 November the governor of the naval base, Wilhelm Souchon, gave way and let the detained sailors free. However, foreign troops marched on to defeat the movement.
dst: 11月4日，海军基地司令威廉·苏雄作出让步，释放了被关押的水兵。然而，外地部队仍继续开进，企图镇压这场运动。

src: On 5th April Ruzomberok was captured, and not a week later Turciansky Svaty Martin also fell into Czechoslovak hands.
dst: 4月5日鲁容贝罗克被攻克，不到一周后图尔钱斯基圣马丁也落入捷克斯洛伐克人之手。

src: On 5th May 1945 Bohemian capitol Prague uprised, and before long, there are some thirty thousand men-at-arms fighting the occupants and about one hudred thousand men and women in auxiliary units who are building the barricades. Czech combatants are armed with anything from sticks and kitchen knives, through the pistols of Czech policemen and gendarms, many different kind of rifles that were hidden under a coal for the last six years, but also some MGs and panzerfausts captured from the Germans.
dst: 1945年5月5日，波希米亚首都布拉格爆发起义，不久就有约三万名武装人员与占领军作战，另有约十万男女在辅助部队中修筑街垒。捷克战斗人员的武器五花八门——从棍棒和菜刀，到捷克警察和宪兵的手枪，再到六年来藏在煤堆下的各式步枪，还有一些从德军手中缴获的机枪和“铁拳”。

src: On 9 October 1942, 1st Tank Regiment of 1st Romanian Armored Division received 11 T-3 (Pzkpfw III N) and 11 T-4 (Pzkpfw IV G) tanks, that formed two medium tank companies. During the battle of Don's Bend, 1st Tank Regiment lost 10 of the 11 T-4 tanks.
dst: 1942年10月9日，罗马尼亚第1装甲师第1坦克团接收11辆T-3（Pzkpfw III N）与11辆T-4（Pzkpfw IV G）坦克，编成两个中型坦克连。在顿河弯曲部战役中，第1坦克团损失了11辆T-4中的10辆。

src: On 9th April 1940 Germany launched a invasion of both, Denmark and Norway. Denmark had to surrender quickly, but Norway, with the help of British, French and Polish troops, was able to fight the Germans untill the Allies had to retreat and Norway capitulated to the Germans on 10th June 1940.
dst: 1940年4月9日，德国同时入侵丹麦和挪威。丹麦迅速投降，但挪威在英、法、波部队的帮助下顽强抵抗，直到盟军被迫撤退，挪威才于1940年6月10日向德军投降。

src: On April 8, 1915 Turkey announced a policy of deportation of hundreds of thousands of Armenian and Assyro-Chaldean populations from border regions in Anatolia.  Often escorted by Kurdish or police units, the Armenians were systematically starved and murdered.  April 24, 1915 witnessed the rejection of an appeal for help by the head of the Armenian Church to the American President Wilson.  The genocide against Armenians continued until 1917 and claimed over 1,000,000 lives.
dst: 1915年4月8日，土耳其宣布了一项政策，将安纳托利亚边境地区的数十万亚美尼亚人和亚述-迦勒底人驱逐出境。在库尔德人或警察部队的押送下，亚美尼亚人被系统地饿死和杀害。1915年4月24日，亚美尼亚教会领袖向美国总统威尔逊发出的求援呼吁遭到拒绝。针对亚美尼亚人的种族灭绝一直持续到1917年，夺走了超过100万条生命。

src: On August 22 the attack was reinforced by the Australian 18th Battalion which was part of the newly arrived Australian 2nd Division. The men were fresh and healthy, in stark contrast to the veteran troops, but were inexperienced and ill-equipped, even by Gallipoli standards. Attacking with bayonet only, they suffered 383 casualties in their first attack.
dst: 8月22日，进攻得到澳大利亚第18营的加强，该营隶属于新抵达的澳大利亚第2师。这些士兵精力充沛、身体健康，与老兵形成鲜明对比，但缺乏经验、装备简陋，即使以加里波利的标准衡量也是如此。仅凭刺刀进攻，他们在首次进攻中就伤亡了383人。

src: On August 24 1941, Stalin spoke to Yeremenko by telephone offering him 2 more tank brigades, several tank battalions, some Katyusha rockets batteries and several Air Force regiments comprising 464 planes "if you promise to beat that scoundrel Guderian" The offensive began on Aug 30th and made little impression before the 21st Army was pushed back onto the 40th, then cut off by Guderian coming from the north. On Sep 2nd Stalin wrote to Yeremenko "STAVKA is still not satisfied with your work, until Guderian and his group is smashed to pieces, all you say about successes is worthless. We are waiting for you to report that you have defeated Guderian's group."
dst: 1941年8月24日，斯大林在电话中对叶廖缅科说，如果再给他2个坦克旅、几个坦克营、一些“喀秋莎”火箭炮连和几个空军团（共464架飞机），“只要你能打败那个恶棍古德里安”。这次攻势于8月30日开始，没取得多少战果，第21集团军就被压向第40集团军，随后又被从北面赶来的古德里安切断。9月2日斯大林写信给叶廖缅科：“最高统帅部对你的工作仍不满意。只要古德里安和他的集群还没有被彻底粉碎，你所说的一切战绩都毫无价值。我们在等着你报告已击败古德里安的集群。”

src: On August 27th Romania declared war on the Central Powers and invaded Austria-Hungary. They thought that they would be able to defeat Austria before Germany and us could react. But they were wrong. On September 1st our Third Army, along with German and Ottoman units, attacked the Romanians in Southern Dobrudzha. This is a great opportunity for liberating this Bulgarian region, that Romania took away from us in 1913.
dst: 8月27日，罗马尼亚向同盟国宣战并入侵奥匈帝国。他们以为能在德国和我方作出反应之前击败奥地利。但他们错了。9月1日，我第三集团军会同德军和奥斯曼部队，在南多布罗加向罗马尼亚人发起进攻。这是解放这一保加利亚地区的绝佳机会——1913年罗马尼亚从我们手中夺走了它。

src: On December 20 Guderian visited Hitler requesting that the line be withdrawn to better positions.Hitler refused on the grounds that any retreat would lead to general panic.Guderian forced the issue,saying: 'Positional warfare in this unsuitable terrain will lead to battles of material as in WWI.We shall lose the flower of our officer and N.C.O. corps.We shall suffer huge losses without gaining any advantage and these losses will be irreplaceable,there seems no justification for sacrificing my soldiers lives.' Hitler replied: 'I know all about your personal effort and how you lead your troops from in front but for this reason you are in danger of seeing things too much at close quarters.You are hamstrung by too much compassion for your men.Things look clearer from a greater distance.In order to hold the front no sacrifice can be too great.For if we do not hold it then Army Group Center will be lost.' On December 24 von Kluge accused Guderian of evacuating Chern without authority,creating a dangerous gap of twenty-five miles.Hitler dismissed him from his command,already angered at the talk of withdrawal.Furious at Guderian's comments about him von Kluge challenged him to a duel which Hitler forbade. Guderian went on to become Inspector-General of the Armoured Troops and later Chief of Staff of the Army. After the war he spent 3 years in US custody and died in 1954 aged 65, his son Heinz became a prominent General in the post-war German Bundeswehr and NATO.
dst: 12月20日，古德里安拜访希特勒，请求把战线后撤到更好的阵地。希特勒以任何撤退都会引起全面慌乱为由拒绝。古德里安坚持己见，说：“在这种不适宜的地形上进行阵地战，将导致像一战那样的物资消耗战。我们将损失军官和军士中的精华。我们将蒙受巨大损失而毫无所得，这些损失无法弥补，我看不出有什么理由要牺牲我士兵的生命。”希特勒答道：“我完全了解你个人的努力以及你如何身先士卒地带领部队，但正因如此，你才有在近距离看得过于真切的危险。你对部下过于怜悯，这束缚了你的手脚。从更远的距离看，事情会更清楚。为了守住战线，任何牺牲都不为过。因为如果我们守不住，中央集团军群就会完蛋。”12月24日，冯·克卢格指责古德里安擅自撤出切尔恩，造成25英里的危险缺口。希特勒将他解职——他早已对撤退的言论恼怒。冯·克卢格对古德里安关于他的言论极为愤怒，向他提出决斗，希特勒禁止了。古德里安后来成为装甲兵总监，再后来任陆军总参谋长。战后他在美国看押下度过了3年，1954年去世，享年65岁；他的儿子海因茨成为战后德国联邦国防军和北约的著名将军。

src: On December 25th the Turkish 3rd Army launched the counter-offensive to capture Sarykamysh.  You must defeat the Turkish offensive and retain our position in preparation for our Erzerum offensive.
dst: 12月25日，土耳其第3集团军发动反攻，企图夺取萨雷卡梅什。您必须击败土耳其的攻势，并守住我方阵地，为我们的埃尔祖鲁姆攻势做准备。

src: On December 30th a Fuehrer order directed Totenkopf, Leibstandarte and Das Reich - the SS Panzer Corps - to return to Russia to strengthen Army Group South. Our trains were given absolute priority over all other railway traffic. As soon as they arrived on the front, our troops were used to try and stop the Bolsjevik advance. Thanks to our commander Hausser our troops could retreat out of Kharkov - against Fuehrer orders - and avoid certain destruction. This decision saved our SS Panzer Corps as a unit and allowed us to open the counterattack in N/E direction towards Kharkov.
dst: 12月30日，一道元首令命“骷髅”、“警卫旗队”和“帝国”各师——即党卫军装甲军——返回俄国，增援南方集团军群。我们的列车获得了高于所有其他铁路运输的绝对优先权。一到前线，我军就被投入阻止布尔什维克推进。多亏我们的指挥官豪塞尔，我军得以违抗元首令撤出哈尔科夫，避免了必定的覆灭。这一决定保全了党卫军装甲军作为一个建制单位，并使我们得以向哈尔科夫方向发起东北向的反击。

src: On January 1917 General Smuts was relieved of the British command. At the end of May General Van Deventer became the new commander-in-chief of the British troops. Just like Smuts had tried before, Van Deventer´s plan was to push westward from the coast both from Kilwa and from Lindi.  He will try to encircle the German forces.  In the month of July General Beves led three British columns into the mountain area of Narungombe.  Here they met a ferocious resistance from the German Askari.
dst: 1917年1月，斯马茨将军被解除英军指挥权。5月底，范德文特将军成为英军新任总司令。正如斯马茨先前所尝试的那样，范德文特的计划是从海岸线自基尔瓦和林迪两地向西推进。他将设法包围德军。7月，比夫斯将军率三支英军纵队进入纳伦贡贝山区。在这里，他们遭遇了德国阿斯卡里部队的顽强抵抗。

src: On July 1st, Army Group Centre began its advance towards Smolensk. The initial operation took place along a 600km wide front, between the Western Dvina and Dnepr Rivers. Remnants of the 4th Army were still forward of the Berezina River, also Cavalry units which had withdrawn from the battles around Minsk and Brest were hiding in the Pripit Marshes and continued to raid at the flank of the Panzergruppe causing an annoyance and inflicting damage to rear units. The Panzergruppe crossed the Berezina River and expanded its attack towards the important rail centre of Mogilev, forcing crossing points on the Dnepr River to the north and south. North of Mogilev a gap had opened in the Russian line, which was exploited by 10th Panzer and SS Das Reich. In the middle of July the STAVKA decided to go on the offensive in order to halt the German advance, they began counter attacks in the area on the 14th of July. On July 18th, the great armored pincers of the two German Panzer Armies came within 10 miles of closing, but the jaws would not finally snap shut for another 8 days. It would take the Germans another 10 days to liquidate the pocket. In the end, although 300,000 Soviet soldiers were captured, many would break out to stand between the Germans and Moscow. The failure of the Germans to quickly close the gap, thereby allowing 200,000 Soviets to escape, made Hitler give up on the concept of encirclement operations.
dst: 7月1日，中央集团军群开始向斯摩棱斯克推进。最初的行动沿一条600公里宽的正面上展开，介于西德维纳河与第聂伯河之间。第4集团军的残部仍在别列津纳河前方，而从明斯克和布列斯特周边战斗撤出的骑兵部队则隐蔽在普里皮亚季沼泽中，继续袭扰装甲集群的侧翼，给后方部队造成麻烦和损失。装甲集群渡过别列津纳河，向重要的铁路枢纽莫吉廖夫扩大进攻，并在第聂伯河上强行夺取了南北两处渡口。莫吉廖夫以北，俄军防线上出现一个缺口，被第10装甲师和党卫军“帝国”师加以利用。7月中旬，最高统帅部决定转入进攻以阻遏德军推进，于7月14日在该地区发起反击。7月18日，两个德国装甲集团军的大钳相距不到10英里，但钳口还要再过8天才最终合拢。德军还要再花10天才能肃清包围圈。最终虽有30万苏军士兵被俘，但许多人突围而出，挡在德军与莫斯科之间。德军未能迅速合拢缺口、让20万苏军逃脱，使希特勒放弃了合围作战的构想。

src: On July 24th the Reds entered Chelyabinsk. Our couteroffensive would start the next day. The northern group (under the command of the Czech Sergej Vojcechovsky) would cut the railway Chelyabinsk - Ekaterinburg and advance into the rear of the 5th Army. In the meantime, our southern group, commanded by Kappel, would destroy the Soviet 26th Division, closing the trap.
dst: 7月24日，红军进入车里雅宾斯克。我们的反攻将于次日开始。北集群（由捷克人谢尔盖·沃伊采霍夫斯基指挥）将切断车里雅宾斯克-叶卡捷琳堡铁路，并向第五集团军后方推进。与此同时，由卡佩尔指挥的南集群将消灭苏维埃第26师，合上包围圈。

src: On June 12 Aguinaldo declared independence in Cavite Viejo.
dst: 6月12日，阿吉纳尔多在老甲米地宣布独立。

src: On June 22, 1898, the USS Charleston and the transports left Guam to continue on their way to Manila.
dst: 1898年6月22日，「查尔斯顿」号及运输船队离开关岛，继续前往马尼拉。

src: On June 22, 1941, Germany launched Operation Barbarossa, attacking the Soviet Union on a wide front. Romania joined in the offensive, with Romanian troops crossing the River Prut.
dst: 1941年6月22日，德国发动“巴巴罗萨”行动，在广阔战线上进攻苏联。罗马尼亚加入攻势，罗马尼亚军队渡过普鲁特河。

src: On June 26 the ceasefire ended, and Prussia decided to occupy the island of Alsen, crossing the Alsensund by surprise. After the battle at Düppel the Danish forces had retreated to Alsen, and they had built a network of trenches and gun emplacements along the northern coast of the island. Nevertheless, those fortifications were much weaker than the ones at Missunde or Düppel, so the Prussians believed that they could overcome them without too many problems.
dst: 6月26日停火结束，普鲁士决定占领阿尔森岛，出其不意地渡过阿尔森海峡。迪伯尔之战后，丹麦军队已撤至阿尔森，并在该岛北岸修筑了由战壕和炮位组成的防御网。然而，这些工事远比米松德或迪伯尔的薄弱，因此普鲁士人相信他们无需太多周折就能攻克。

src: On March 15 the Prussian artillery started to fire at the Danish positions. The Danes were outnumbered, demoralized and lacked modern equipment and proper shelter. Their only advantage was the support of the Rolf Krake, a powerful Danish ironclad.
dst: 3月15日，普鲁士炮兵开始向丹麦阵地开火。丹麦人寡不敌众、士气低落，且缺乏现代装备和像样的掩体。他们唯一的优势是「罗尔夫·克拉凯」号——一艘强大的丹麦铁甲舰——的支援。

src: On March 16, the Red Army counterattacked in strength. Within 24 hours of the Soviet counterattack, the Axis troops were driven back to the positions they held before Operation Spring Awakening. On March 22, hopelessly out-numbered and with few armored vehicles remaining, the surviving Axis forces withdrew to prepared positions elsewhere in Hungary. The Soviet counteroffensive continued and these positions were soon overrun.
dst: 3月16日，红军大举反攻。在苏军反击后的24小时内，轴心国部队被打回到「春季觉醒」行动之前的阵地。3月22日，兵力悬殊、装甲车辆所剩无几的轴心国残余部队撤往匈牙利境内的其他既设阵地。苏军的反攻持续推进，这些阵地很快也被攻陷。

src: On May 22nd, the 20th Guards Brigade comprising Irish and Welsh Guards was taken to Boulogne, escorted by 3 destroyers. On May 24th the Germans carried out a head-on attack using siege ladders, and supported by artillery fire, flame throwers and fire from anti-aircraft guns. By the end of the day they had captured the citadel. While not as famous as the defence of Calais, the defence of Boulogne played a part in delaying the German advance. For years it was the practice of the officers of the 68 Company RPC to drink a toast to "The Defenders of Boulogne". When Boulogne fell to the Germans on May 25 Winston Churchill sent a wire to the commander at Calais, "Every hour you continue to exist is of the greatest help to the BEF. Government has therefore decided you must continue to fight. Have greatest possible admiration for your splendid stand. Evacuation will not (repeat not) take place, and craft required for above purpose are to return to Dover...." The 30th Brigade at Calais, was 2nd Battalion, King's Royal Rifle Corps (KRRC), 1st Battalion, The Rifle Brigade (RB), and 1st Battalion, Queen Victoria's Rifles (QVR). German tanks were held up for half an hour by 1st Searchlight Battery. The defense of Calais is a story of determination against enormous odds that contributed to the successful evacuation at Dunkirk.
dst: 5月22日，由爱尔兰和威尔士近卫团编成的第20近卫旅被送往布洛涅，由3艘驱逐舰护航。5月24日，德军以攻城梯、炮火、火焰喷射器和高射炮直射火力支援发动正面进攻。到当天结束时，他们已夺占卫城。布洛涅的防御虽不如加来保卫战有名，却也为迟滞德军推进出了一份力。多年来，第68皇家工兵连的军官们一直有举杯向“布洛涅的保卫者”致敬的惯例。5月25日布洛涅落入德军之手后，温斯顿·丘吉尔给加来的指挥官拍去电报：“你每多坚持一小时，都对英国远征军有极大的帮助。因此政府决定你必须继续战斗。对你的出色坚守，我极为钦佩。不会（重复：不会）进行撤退，用于此目的的船只将返回多佛……”加来的第30旅下辖国王皇家步枪队第2营、步枪旅第1营和维多利亚女王步枪队第1营。德军坦克被第1探照灯连阻滞了半小时。加来保卫战是一个以寡敌众、顽强死守的故事，为敦刻尔克的成功撤退作出了贡献。

src: On November 2, the 13th and 23rd Panzer Divisions finally reached the western outskirts of Vladikavkaz (Ordzhonikidze) and became embroiled in heavy fighting. A counterattack by the Soviet armed forces on November 5 finally brought the German offensive efforts to a halt. Vladikavkaz was the most southeastern point the German offensive reached in the war.
dst: 11月2日，第13和第23装甲师终于抵达弗拉季高加索（奥尔忠尼启则）西郊，并卷入了激烈的战斗。11月5日苏军的一次反攻最终使德军的进攻势头戛然而止。弗拉季高加索是德军在战争中所到达的最东南端。

src: On November 20th the Soviets started their offensive. They quickly took Tatarsk and Semipalatinsk, and then marched against Barnaul, Kolyvan and Novonikolayevsk, where we were waiting for them.
dst: 11月20日，苏维埃开始了进攻。他们迅速攻占鞑靼斯克和塞米巴拉金斯克，然后向巴尔瑙尔、科雷万和新尼古拉耶夫斯克进军，我们正在那里等着他们。

src: On November 30th 1939,the Soviet Union set into motion a series of events that would test Finnish national strength and resolve to the limits. On and off again, for a period of five years, the Soviet Union tried to realize it's dream of having the "hammer and sickle" fly permanently over Helsinki. Usually outnumbered, and having to partially rely on captured or donated equipment, the Finns proved to be one of the toughest and most resourceful soldiers of WW2...
dst: 1939年11月30日，苏联启动了一系列事件，将芬兰的民族力量与意志考验到了极限。在长达五年的时间里，苏联时断时续地试图实现自己的梦想：让"镰刀锤子"旗帜永久飘扬在赫尔辛基上空。芬兰人通常寡不敌众，还不得不部分依赖缴获或捐赠的装备，但他们证明了自己是二战中最顽强、最足智多谋的士兵之一……

src: On November 5th, 1916 the German and Austrian Emperors granted independence for the Kingdom of Poland.
dst: 1916年11月5日，德皇和奥皇赐予了波兰王国独立。

src: On October 15, 1944, the Hungarian governor, Admiral Miklós Horthy, announced that Hungary had accepted an armistice with the USSR. Reacting quickly, Hitler ordered Otto Skorzeny to launch Operation Panzerfaust. By October 16, 1944, Skorzeny and his SS paratroopers had averted disaster by blackmailing Horthy into resigning and giving control of the government to Ferenc Szálasi, a pro-German leader.
dst: 1944年10月15日，匈牙利摄政米克洛什·霍尔蒂海军上将宣布匈牙利已接受与苏联的停战协定。希特勒反应迅速，命令奥托·斯科尔策尼发动「铁拳」行动。到1944年10月16日，斯科尔策尼及其党卫军伞兵通过胁迫霍尔蒂辞职、把政府交给亲德领导人费伦茨·萨拉斯，化解了这场灾难。

src: On October 28th, with the Great War about to finish, the new state of Czechoslovakia was created. Naturally, the Czech Legion made clear that they didn't wish to be a part of our civil war, and that they would only follow the Directory as long as it served their own interests, that is, they'd be with us as long as they could return to their country as soon as possible. So our largest, and more experienced, military unit finally became a group of unpredictable mercenaries who, depending on the circumstances, could fight on our side or sell their own mothers for a train passage to Vladivostok.
dst: 10月28日，随着世界大战即将结束，新的国家捷克斯洛伐克成立了。很自然地，捷克军团明确表示，他们不希望卷入我们的内战，他们只会在符合自身利益的情况下听从执政内阁，也就是说，只要他们能尽快回国，他们才会站在我们这边。于是，我们这支规模最大、经验最丰富的军事单位，最终变成了一群捉摸不定的雇佣兵——视情况而定，他们既可以为我们作战，也可以为了弄到一张开往符拉迪沃斯托克的火车票而出卖自己的亲娘。

src: On October 29, 1944, the Red Army started its offensive against Budapest. The 2nd and 3rd Ukrainian Fronts and 7th Romanian Corps split into two operating maneuver groups, advanced. The plan was to cut Budapest off from the rest of the German and Hungarian forces. On November 7, Soviet and Romanian troops entered the eastern suburbs, 20 kilometers from the town. On December 26, a road linking Budapest to Vienna was seized by Soviet troops, thereby completing the encirclement. As a result of the Soviet link-up, nearly 90,000 German and Hungarian soldiers became trapped within the city. Refusing to authorize a withdrawal, Hitler had declared Budapest a fortress city, which had to be defended to the last man.
dst: 1944年10月29日，红军发起进攻布达佩斯的战役。乌克兰第2方面军和第3方面军以及罗马尼亚第7军分成两个机动集群向前推进。计划是把布达佩斯与德匈其他部队切断。11月7日，苏军和罗马尼亚部队进入东部郊区，距城20公里。12月26日，苏军夺取了连接布达佩斯与维也纳的公路，从而完成了合围。由于苏军会师，近9万名德国和匈牙利士兵被困城中。希特勒拒绝批准撤退，宣布布达佩斯为要塞城市，必须战斗到最后一人。

src: On September 10th 1939, well aware that the coming conflict would be long and demanding, Canada joined Britain and the other Commonwealth countries in declaring war on Germany. It would be some time before Canadian forces would fully be able to participate.The Canadian government's first priority was to build an army, navy, and airforce from practically nothing, and then prepare to fight for the righteous and just cause the young nation had committed to.
dst: 1939年9月10日，加拿大深知即将到来的冲突将旷日持久、艰难异常，于是与英国及其他英联邦国家一同对德宣战。加拿大军队要能全面参战尚需时日。加拿大政府的首要任务是几乎从零开始建立陆军、海军和空军，然后准备为这个年轻国家所承诺的正义事业而战。

src: On September 11, 1944, the 4th SS Division attacked the border posts south of Temesvár (Timisoara), the capital of the Bánát province. It had big strategic importance as a communications hub, and its capture would have allowed the Axis to establish a strong defensive position along the Southern Carpathians.
dst: 1944年9月11日，党卫军第4师进攻泰梅什堡（蒂米什瓦拉）以南的边境哨所，该城是巴纳特省的首府。它作为交通枢纽具有重要的战略意义，夺取它本可使轴心国沿南喀尔巴阡山脉建立一道坚固的防线。

src: On September 12, the Hungarian 4th Corps crossed the borders and advanced toward Arad, the Northern gate of the Bánát. The city was captured (liberated, by Hungarian terms) on September 14. On September 15-16, Axis troops tried to seize Temesvár from three sides, but all attacks were repulsed.
dst: 9月12日，匈牙利第4军越过边界，向巴纳特的北大门阿拉德推进。该城于9月14日被攻占（按匈牙利的说法是「解放」）。9月15日至16日，轴心国部队试图从三面夺取泰梅什堡，但所有进攻均被击退。

src: On September 27th we used those tactics at the Chalk Pit Wood sector with some success, so a few days later we were ordered to go to the North and replace the 28th Division facing the Hohenzollern Redoubt, a series of fortifications and trenches near Auchy-les-Mines where the Germans had gathered nearly three infantry divisions and dozens of artillery pieces. Our mission was to repell the German counterattacks and, if possible, recover some of the defensive perimeter.
dst: 9月27日，我们在白垩坑树林地段运用这些战术取得了一些成功，于是几天后，我们奉命北上，接替面对霍亨索伦棱堡的第28师。那是在奥希莱米讷附近的一系列防御工事和堑壕，德军在那里集结了近三个步兵师和数十门火炮。我们的任务是击退德军的反击，并尽可能收复部分防御圈。

src: On one hand food and fodder for the animals was consumed, on the other the people of that area were well-disposed towards Caesar, because in the past Caesar has often served them well....
dst: 一来，人畜的粮秣已经耗尽；二来，那一带的民众对凯撒抱有好感，因为过去凯撒常常善待他们....

src: On that May 14th 1940 General Student was hit in the head by a bullet from an SS sniper in Rotterdam. You and your SS friends are very lucky he survived.
dst: 1940年5月14日那天，施图登特将军在鹿特丹被一名党卫军狙击手的子弹击中头部。他和你们这些党卫军朋友非常走运，他活了下来。

src: On the 11th May things were getting worse. The arrival of the main German troops, and notably of the 3rd and the 4th Panzerdivision, was too much for the Belgian 7th division. The Germans expanded the bridgeheads and drove the Belgian troops back.
dst: 5月11日，情况进一步恶化。德军主力部队，尤其是第3和第4装甲师的抵达，对比利时第7师来说过于沉重。德军扩大了桥头堡，把比利时军队击退。

src: On the 20th of May three German divisions went over on the attack at Zelzate, Kwatrecht and Zingem. After some initial success, Belgians immediately started several counterattacks regaining most of the ground previously lost. All German attacks were repelled on the Belgian front and the Germans weren’t able to create bridgeheads over the Escaut and the Terneuzen Canal. Belgian command was confident that the Germans could be stopped at the Schelde/Escaut.
dst: 5月20日，德军三个师在泽尔扎特、夸特雷赫特和津海姆转入进攻。在取得初步胜利后，比利时人立即发起数次反击，夺回了先前失去的大部分土地。德军在比利时战线上的所有进攻均被击退，未能在斯海尔德河和泰尔讷曾运河上建立桥头堡。比利时指挥部相信，德军能够在斯海尔德河被挡住。

src: On the 2nd day in a place near Meziers city, our support units - Grossdeutschland and 10th Panzer division will begin their attack.
dst: 次日，在梅济耶尔城附近，我方支援部队——大德意志师与第10装甲师——将发起进攻。

src: On the Morava river : Kromeriz - Kojetin -  2 May 1945
dst: 摩拉瓦河畔：克罗梅日什 — 科热廷 — 1945年5月2日

src: On the afternoon of the 11 June General Mangin launched his counterattack.  5 divisions are under the order of Mangin Corps: 129DI (+ 2 groups of St Chamond tanks), 152DI (+ 4 groups of Schneider tanks), 165DI (+ 3 groups of Schneider), 48DI (+ 3 groups of Saint Chamond). The 133DI stays in reserve with one brigade of British armored cars. 2 regiments of corps artillery support the attack: 46RAC & 246RAC.
dst: 6月11日下午，芒然将军发动了反攻。5个师归芒然军指挥：第129步兵师（加2个圣沙蒙坦克群）、第152步兵师（加4个施耐德坦克群）、第165步兵师（加3个施耐德坦克群）、第48步兵师（加3个圣沙蒙坦克群）。第133步兵师与一个英国装甲车旅留作预备队。2个军属炮兵团支援进攻：第46炮兵团与第246炮兵团。

src: On the border between Alabama and Georgia, southwest of Columbus is Fort Benning, a major base of the U.S. Army. This base is your next target! We do not know exactly how many troops stay there at the time, but the Americans will defend this base determined. Unfavorably the enemy seems to have recognized our intentions - our intelligence reports that strong enemy armored units are approaching from the east. The General Staff, however, still has the opinion that your troops are strong enough for this task and we continue as planned. Occupy Columbus and Fort Benning and repel any enemy counterattack if necessary!
dst: 在亚拉巴马与佐治亚的边界上、哥伦布西南方，是本宁堡——美国陆军的一处重要基地。这座基地就是你的下一个目标！我们不确切知道当时那里驻扎着多少部队，但美国人必会坚决防守。不利的是，敌人似乎已识破我们的意图——我方情报报告，强大的敌军装甲部队正从东面逼近。不过，总参谋部仍认为你的部队足以胜任此任务，我们按计划继续。占领哥伦布和本宁堡，必要时击退敌人的任何反击！

src: On the central front, near Moskva, we have pushed the fasicsts armies almost hundred kilometers back, away from our capitol. Rostov is once again in Soviet hands. Sevastopol on the Crimea remains under our control but the remaining part of the Crimean peninsula is occupied by the Rumanian and German fascists. The enemy is attacking Sevastopol for days and without support it will fall. We must make sure this will not happen. Therefore we will invade the eastern Crimea at both Kerch and at Feodosiya.
dst: 在中央战线，莫斯科附近，我们已把法西斯军队击退了近一百公里，远离了我们的首都。罗斯托夫重归苏维埃之手。克里米亚的塞瓦斯托波尔仍在我们控制之下，但克里米亚半岛的其余部分被罗马尼亚和德国法西斯占领。敌军连日进攻塞瓦斯托波尔，没有支援它必将陷落。我们必须确保这不会发生。因此我们将在刻赤和费奥多西亚两处登陆，进攻克里米亚东部。

src: On the day of the Geman invasion, 10th May, King Leopold III said "Belges! pour la second fois en un quart de siècle, la Belgique, loyale et neutre, est attaqué par l'Empire allemande, [...] La lutte sera dure. Les sacrifices et les privations seront considérables, mais nul ne peut douter du succès final" ("Belgians! for the second time in a quarter century, Belgium, fair and neutral, is attacked by the German Empire [...] The fight will be tough. The sacrifices and hardships will be considerable, but no one can doubt the ultimate success".
dst: 在德军入侵当天，即5月10日，国王利奥波德三世说：“比利时人！四分之一世纪内第二次，忠诚而中立的比利时遭到德意志帝国的进攻，[...]战斗将是艰苦的。牺牲和匮乏将是巨大的，但没有人会怀疑最终的胜利”（“比利时人！四分之一世纪内第二次，忠诚而中立的比利时遭到德意志帝国的进攻[...]战斗将是艰苦的。牺牲和匮乏将是巨大的，但没有人会怀疑最终的胜利”。

src: On the evening of 4 November's Kiel was firmly in the hands of about 40,000 rebellious sailors, soldiers and workers.
dst: 11月4日晚，基尔已牢牢掌握在约四万名起义的水兵、士兵和工人手中。

src: On the evening of May 19th Guderian was given complete freedom of action and decided that he would take not only Amiens but Abbeville also the next day. They were to throw bridgeheads across the River Somme and await the enemy coming down from the north. By 9am 1st Panzer with Guderian at the front had captured Amiens. The Corps then pushed on along the north bank of the river, when 2nd Panzer arrived at Abbeville in the afternoon they were out of fuel and the tanks were left in front of the town while Riflemen, Sappers and Artillerymen took the objective. A British Artillery battery was captured on a parade ground armed only with blanks as no-one expected the Germans to arrive so quickly. An hour after the capture of Abbeville a battalion from 2nd Panzer commanded by Major Spitta reached the Channel coast at Noyelles and the great nation of France was severed in two.
dst: 5月19日傍晚，古德里安获得了完全的自主行动权，他决定次日不仅拿下亚眠，还要拿下阿布维尔。他们将在索姆河上建立桥头堡，等待敌人从北面南下。到上午9点，由古德里安随行的第1装甲师已夺取亚眠。军随后沿河北岸推进；下午第2装甲师抵达阿布维尔时燃料耗尽，坦克被留在了城外，由步枪手、工兵和炮兵夺占了目标。英军一个炮兵连在一个阅兵场被俘，当时他们只装了空包弹，因为没人料到德军会来得这么快。阿布维尔被夺取一小时之后，第2装甲师由施皮塔少校指挥的一个营抵达努瓦耶勒的英吉利海峡岸边，伟大的法国就此被拦腰斩断。

src: On the hill at Aquae Sextiae Gaius Marius has himselve entrenched.
dst: 在阿夸埃塞克斯提亚的山丘上，盖乌斯马略亲自筑垒据守。

src: On the island a reinforced Marine brigade is stationed and already weakened air forces. More problems will cause the U.S. warships, which recently managed to break our blockade and now anchor at Reykjavik. You get two battleships at hand to deal with this threat. Your goal is to destroy the air and naval forces of the enemy, to land your troops and take all key positions, the harbor, the airfields and the U.S. headquarter at Reykjavik!
dst: 岛上驻扎着一个加强的海军陆战旅，以及已经削弱的空军。更大的麻烦来自美国军舰——它们最近突破了我们的封锁，如今停泊在雷克雅未克。你有两艘战列舰在手来应对这一威胁。你的目标是摧毁敌人的空军和海军力量，登陆你的部队，夺取所有关键据点——雷克雅未克的港口、机场和美国总部！

src: On the last day of April 1945 Czechoslovaks entered Zilina. Now the time has come for the final liberation of Czech lands...
dst: 1945年4月的最后一天，捷克斯洛伐克人进入日利纳。如今，最终解放捷克土地的时刻到了……

src: On the morning of August 10th Kemal led an overwhelming Turkish counter-attack. His plan lacked subtlety, but was brutally effective - overrun the defenders by sheer weight of numbers. Kemal led his men from the front. During the fight he was struck in the chest by shrapnel, but was saved by his pocket watch which absorbed the blow.
dst: 8月10日清晨，凯末尔发动了一次压倒性的土耳其军反击。他的计划谈不上精妙，却粗暴有效——以绝对的兵力优势压垮守军。凯末尔身先士卒。战斗中，一块弹片击中了他的胸口，但他口袋里的怀表挡下了这一击，救了他一命。

src: On the night of 8/9 January the last troops withdrew along arranged routes, in complete silence. At dawn, when the ammunition-dumps blew up, there was no man left ashore, and not a casualty had been sustained. The evacuation of Gallipoli was a triumph, closing a campaign of incompetence.
dst: 1月8日至9日夜间，最后一批部队沿预定路线在完全静默中撤离。黎明时分，当弹药库爆炸时，岸上已无一人，而且未造成一例伤亡。加里波利的撤退是一次胜利，为这场无能的战役画上了句号。

src: On the night of the 18th/19th of May the retreat of the Belgian Army to its new positions behind the Gent-Terneuzen Canal was protected by the cavalry divisions and the 1st "Chausseurs Ardennaises"/"Ardense Jager" division. When the Germans crossed the Escaut/Scheldt River by using a tunnel not completely destroyed in the Antwerpen/Anvers region fierce battles occurred around Zwijndrecht between the German 208th infantry division and units of the Belgian cavalry. The German infantry was not able to advance further due to the attacks performed by Belgian tanks and AFV's (T13). At the end of the day the Belgian units retreated as ordered behind the Gent-Terneuzen Canal.
dst: 5月18日至19日夜间，比利时军队撤往根特-泰尔讷曾运河后方新阵地的行动由各骑兵师和第1“阿登猎兵”师掩护。当德军利用安特卫普地区一条未被彻底炸毁的隧道渡过斯海尔德河时，德军第208步兵师与比利时骑兵部队在兹韦恩德雷赫特周边爆发激战。由于比利时坦克和装甲车辆（T13）的攻击，德军步兵未能继续推进。当日结束时，比利时部队奉命撤往根特-泰尔讷曾运河后方。
