src: On the other hand, don't underestimate the American fleet.
dst: 另一方面，也不要低估美国舰队。

src: On the other hand, that's what really happened.
dst: 另一方面，这正是真实发生的历史。

src: On the other hand, the machine is clearly wearing out and this time our force was scattered on jump.  You need to get everyone back to the time machine so that we can leave without too much trouble.
dst: 另一方面，机器显然正在磨损，而这一次我们的部队在跳跃中被打散了。你需要把所有人带回时间机器，好让我们不至于太麻烦地离开。

src: On the other hand, the region is crawling with lots of enemy ground units including irregular troops with great knowledge of terrain.
dst: 另一方面，这一带到处是敌军地面部队，包括熟悉地形的非正规军。

src: On the other side, it was sarcastic that you had to encounter the treacherous Don Cossacks again that left our side at Volodarka.  If they had only known that the Revolution cannot be turned around.  We will make sure they know now.
dst: 另一方面，颇为讽刺的是，您不得不再度遭遇那支在沃洛达尔卡背弃我们的奸诈顿河哥萨克。如果他们早知道革命是不可逆转的就好了。我们现在定要让他们明白这一点。

src: On the political level, the Soviet Offensive on the Yassy-Kishinev line triggered King Michael's coup d'etat in Romania, and the switch of Romania from the Axis to the Allies. Almost immediately, a small border war between Romania and Germany's ally Hungary erupted over territory that Romania was forced to cede to Hungary in 1940, as a result of the Second Vienna Award.
dst: 在政治上，雅西-奇西瑙一线的苏军攻势引发了罗马尼亚国王米哈伊的政变，以及罗马尼亚由轴心国转向同盟国。几乎与此同时，罗马尼亚与德国盟友匈牙利之间，因罗马尼亚1940年依《第二次维也纳仲裁》被迫割让予匈牙利的领土，爆发了小规模边境战争。

src: On the political side this victory has stabilised Mussolini's regime a bit, but we are looking for a more competent replacement in the facsist movement. However, real power in Italy is in our hands now. In a few weeks we will take charge of militairy production and rearmement in Italy, meaning Italian industry will produce German arms. Paralel to the rearmement of the Italian army a few thousand advisors will retrain the army.
dst: 在政治层面上，这场胜利稍稍稳住了墨索里尼的政权，但我们正在法西斯运动中物色一个更能干的替代者。不过，意大利的实权如今已掌握在我们手中。数周之内我们将接管意大利的军事生产与重整军备，这意味着意大利工业将生产德国武器。在意大利军队重整军备的同时，数千名顾问将重新训练这支军队。

src: On the third day of battle, the Russians managed to capture Orsha. Our lines have been cut in two, and all units are rapidly moving along the Dnieper toward the city itself. You must blunt the Soviet advance, destroy their heavy tanks, and break out of the emerging encirclement in time.
dst: 战斗第三天，俄军攻占了奥尔沙。我军战线被一分为二，所有部队正沿第聂伯河向该城疾进。你必须挫钝苏军攻势、摧毁其重型坦克，并及时突出正在形成的合围。

src: On to Paris or Observation of Antwerp
dst: On to Paris or 观测 of Antwerp

src: On to Paris or Observation of Antwerp - August 1914 - BV
dst: 挺进巴黎还是监视安特卫普 - 1914年8月 - 大捷

src: On to Paris or Observation of Antwerp - August 1914 - L
dst: 挺进巴黎还是监视安特卫普 - 1914年8月 - 失败

src: On to Paris or Observation of Antwerp - August 1914 - TV
dst: 挺进巴黎还是监视安特卫普 - 1914年8月 - 小捷

src: On to Paris or Observation of Antwerp - August 1914 - V
dst: 挺进巴黎还是监视安特卫普 - 1914年8月 - 胜利

src: On to Paris or Observation of Antwerp - August 20th 1914
dst: 挺进巴黎还是监视安特卫普 - 1914年8月20日

src: On top of what is reported above, Ottoman forces received further reinforcements. The Weakened EEF dug in and stayed in the trenches opposite Ottoman forces for six months.
dst: 除上述报告外，奥斯曼部队还获得了更多增援。被削弱的埃及远征军构筑工事，在奥斯曼部队对面的战壕里驻守了六个月。

src: On your march route west of Knoxville should exist a secret town called Site X. According to our intelligence the Americans operate a nuclear research facility there. It would be desirable that this facility falls intact into our hands. Commando units were tasked to occupy this facility by surprise and to arrest the scientists and technicians. Once the facility is in our hand you must ensure that the enemy is not able to destroy the facility with artillery or his air force!
dst: 在你诺克斯维尔以西的行军路线上，应有一座名为“X 设施”的秘密城镇。据我方情报，美国人在那里运行着一座核研究设施。最好是能让这座设施完好无损地落入我们手中。突击队已受命突袭占领该设施，并逮捕科学家和技术人员。设施一旦到手，你必须确保敌人无法用炮兵或空军将其摧毁！

src: On your way back to the West there could be problems! In Kirov, an important railway junction, are Partisans on the loose! The 286th Security Division, responsible for this area, does not seem to be the master of the situation. Bridges and rails were blown up or mined. Prepare your troops for an uncomfortable passage, and if necessary take all measures to ensure a speedy advance of your forces!
dst: 你们西返途中可能遇到麻烦！在基洛夫这个重要的铁路枢纽，游击队正在活动！负责这一地区的第286警卫师似乎控制不住局面。桥梁和铁轨被炸毁或埋了雷。让你的部队做好艰苦行军的准备，必要时采取一切措施确保部队快速推进！

src: Once Baku is in our hands the coastal railroad and Caspian Sea shipping will be cut entirely and this will be a huge blow to Soviet supplies.
dst: 一旦巴库落入我们手中，沿海铁路和里海航运将被完全切断，这将是对苏联补给的巨大打击。

src: Once I swore to defend the Tsar and my country. Now the Tsar is a prisoner and I can hardly recognize my country. Sometimes I wonder if I'm still obliged by my oath. Katya is safe in Sweden with the girls and Yuri. Maybe Anatoly and I should leave the fight and join them.
dst: 我曾立誓捍卫沙皇和我的祖国。如今沙皇成了阶下囚，我几乎认不出自己的国家了。有时我会怀疑自己是否仍受誓言的约束。卡佳和女儿们以及尤里在瑞典安然无恙。也许阿纳托利和我该离开这场战斗，去与他们团聚。

src: Once Silang secured, Spanish forces marched into Pérez Dasmariñas, the main next village in the way to Aguinaldo’s capital, Imus. Following the only available route, a zigzag trail in the jungle, Spanish main advance was delayed by some Filipino trenches, some of them abandoned. Flank manoeuvres were also intercepted by trenches and skirmishes with the rebels.
dst: 西朗一旦稳固，西班牙军队便向佩雷斯·达斯马里尼亚斯——通往阿吉纳尔多首都伊穆斯途中的下一个主要村镇——进军。沿着唯一可行的路线——一条丛林中蜿蜒曲折的小径——西班牙主力的推进被一些菲律宾战壕所迟滞，其中一些已被弃守。迂回包抄行动也遭到战壕和与起义军小规模交火的拦截。

src: Once again my men fought with a remarkable proficiency, but we could not slow the German advance, which seemed unstoppable. Every day they got closer to Paris, and I started to believe that they could actually repeat their victory of 1870.
dst: 我的士兵们再次以出色的素养作战，但我们无法迟滞德军的推进，那推进似乎势不可挡。他们每天都更逼近巴黎，我开始相信他们真的可能重演1870年的胜利。

src: Once again my men fought with a remarkable proficiency, but we only managed to slow the German advance, which seemed unstoppable. Every day they got closer to Paris, and I started to believe that they could actually repeat their victory of 1870.
dst: 我的士兵们再次以出色的素养作战，但我们只是勉强迟滞了德军的推进，那推进似乎势不可挡。他们每天都更逼近巴黎，我开始相信他们真的可能重演1870年的胜利。

src: Once again our old friend Franz Sigel has taken command in our corps.... we have not met for a long time and the first night we talked an drank beer together...it has really been a long journey from the battlefields at the Rhine river up to here into Shenandoah valley....
dst: 我们的老朋友弗朗茨·西格尔又一次执掌了我们的军……我们许久未见，第一晚我们促膝长谈，一起喝啤酒……从莱茵河畔的战场一路走到这谢南多厄河谷，真是一段漫长的旅程……

src: Once again strong Roman troops under governor C. Cassius Longinus and praetor Cn. Manlius made a stand against him
dst: 总督盖乌斯卡西乌斯隆吉努斯与法官格奈乌斯曼利乌斯又一次率罗马重兵阻挡他

src: Once again the 23rd Infantry will be in Reserve and will follow you to hold taken objectives or capture bypassed ones. We expect that Pioneers will be able to build a temporary airfield for the Luftwaffe so they can keep up with your advance.
dst: 第23步兵师将再次担任预备队，跟随你守住已夺取的目标或攻取被绕过的目标。我们预计工兵能够为德国空军修建一座临时机场，好让他们跟得上你的推进。

src: Once again the Boer retreated in order after causing us some casualties. We had to spend some days recovering from this fight, giving our enemies enough time to finish their defence line at Magersfontein.
dst: 布尔人再次在给我们造成一些伤亡后井然有序地撤退。我们不得不花几天时间从这场战斗恢复，这给了敌人足够的时间去完成他们在马赫斯方丹的防线。

src: Once again we are in the Harper's Ferry vicinity.
dst: 我们又一次来到哈珀斯费里附近。

src: Once again we have routed the Soviet Army and now the way to Kijów is clear! My congratulations, General!
dst: 我们再次击溃了苏军，通往基辅的道路如今畅通无阻！将军，向您表示祝贺！

src: Once again you have proven to be the most brilliant general of the war. You have pushed the liberals back, although that will only delay them for a few months. Sooner or later they will launch their final offensive, and we will not have anything with which to cope with them.
dst: 您再次证明自己是这场战争中最杰出的将军。您击退了自由派，尽管那只能把他们拖住几个月。他们迟早会发动最后攻势，而我们届时将无力应对。

src: Once again your Panzergruppe let us down Herr General, thankfully the rest of our Army Group obliterated the pocket of Kiev and allowed the campaign to progress.
dst: 你的装甲集群又一次让我们失望了，将军阁下，幸好集团军群其余部队抹掉了基辅包围圈，使战役得以继续推进。

src: Once again your XIX Corps let us down Herr General, thankfully the 10th Armie's IV Corps was able to take Chelm and finish this campaign.
dst: 你的第19军又一次让我们失望了，将军阁下，幸好第10集团军的第4军得以夺取海乌姆，结束了这次战役。

src: Once again your XIX corps let us down Herr General,
dst: 你的第19军又一次让我们失望了，将军阁下，

src: Once again your XIX corps let us down Herr General, thankfully the rest of our Army Group took their objectives and allowed the campaign to progress. You are now ordered to contine north-west. Do not fail us again or the end of your command will come swiftly for you.
dst: 你的第19军又一次让我们失望了，将军阁下，幸好集团军群其余部队完成了他们的目标，使战役得以继续推进。现在你奉命继续向西北前进。别再让我们失望，否则你的指挥生涯将很快结束。

src: Once again your XIX corps let us down Herr General, you are now ordered to contine south. Do not fail us again or the end of your command will come swiftly for you.
dst: 你的第19军又一次让我们失望了，将军阁下，现在你奉命继续向南前进。别再让我们失望，否则你的指挥生涯将很快结束。

src: Once again your XIX corps let us down Herr General, you are now ordered to contine west. Do not fail us again or the end of your command will come swiftly for you.
dst: 你的第19军又一次让我们失望了，将军阁下，现在你奉命继续向西前进。别再让我们失望，否则你的指挥生涯将很快结束。

src: Once again your XIX corps let us down Herr General, you are now ordered to continue south. Do not fail us again or the end of your command will come swiftly for you.
dst: 你的第19军又一次让我们失望了，将军阁下，现在你奉命继续向南前进。别再让我们失望，否则你的指挥生涯将很快结束。

src: Once again your XIX corps let us down Herr General, you are relieved of your command!
dst: 你的第19军又一次让我们失望了，将军阁下，你被解除指挥权了！

src: Once again your XIX corps let us down Herr General, you have one last chance to attempt a crossing. Do not fail us again or the end of your command will come swiftly for you.
dst: 你的第19军又一次让我们失望了，将军阁下，你还有最后一次尝试渡河的机会。别再让我们失望，否则你的指挥生涯将很快结束。

src: Once again your resistance was historical, but there are too many British troops. You must retreat to a new line of defense in the area surrounding Kahe.
dst: 您的抵抗再次堪称历史性，但英军兵力太多了。您必须撤退到卡赫周边地区的一条新防线。

src: Once again your resistance was strong, but there are just too many British troops and they have managed to take some of your positions. You must retreat to a new line of defence in the area surrounding Kahe.
dst: 您的抵抗再次十分顽强，但英军实在太多，他们已经设法夺取了您的一些阵地。您必须撤退到卡赫周边地区的新防线。

src: Once again, the Entente will use a multinational army against us. This time the attack will be made by at least three French divisions, a Russian brigade and one Italian division. You will have to reinforce our Bulgarian and German garrisons and repel the enemy at all costs.
dst: 协约国将再次用一支多国部队来对付我们。这一次，发动进攻的将至少有三个法国师、一个俄国旅和一个意大利师。您将必须加强我们的保加利亚和德国守军，并不惜一切代价击退敌人。

src: Once again, the Italians didn't resist the pressure, and they retreated despite the casualties that they had inflicted on us. I guess that their morale was terribly low at that time.
dst: 意大利人又一次顶不住压力，尽管给我们造成了伤亡，他们还是撤退了。我想那时他们的士气低得可怕。

src: Once again, we ask you to repel an invasion, but this time Southern France is the allied target. Your job is to hold onto five objectives until after August 28th when we hope to move additional troops to support you. Failing this, you must hold at least two objectives until then.
dst: 我们再次要求你击退一次登陆入侵，但这次盟军的目标是法国南部。你的任务是在 8月28日之后仍守住五个目标，届时我们希望调派更多部队支援你。若无法做到，你至少须在此期限前守住两个目标。

src: Once in China, all of us went different ways. Most émigrés went to Eastern Europe, but we actually ended up all around the world: France, the United Kingdom, America, Asia.  All the countries in the world had its share of exiled Russians.
dst: 一到中国，我们便各奔东西。大多数流亡者去了东欧，但实际上我们最终散布到了全世界：法国、英国、美国、亚洲。世界上每个国家都有自己那一份流亡的俄国人。

src: Once more the German Blitzkrieg proved hard to beat. Luckily Tripoli has fallen in the hands of Montgomery. Time to continue building up II Corps and wait for the arrival of 8th Army in Tunisia.
dst: 德军的闪电战再一次证明难以战胜。所幸的黎波里已落入蒙哥马利之手。是时候继续扩充第2军，等待第8集团军抵达突尼斯。

src: Once more the attack will be done by infantrymen without armour support but do not underestimate the German artillery and the Luftwaffe.
dst: 这次进攻仍将由没有装甲支援的步兵发起，但不要低估德军炮兵和德国空军。

src: Once the Czechoslovaks replenished their losses, offensive actions of the 1st Czechoslovak Army Corps were renewed. On 19th January Czechoslovaks captured Bardejov and on the next day Kosice was in Soviet hands.
dst: 捷克斯洛伐克人补充损失之后，捷克斯洛伐克第1军的攻势重新展开。1月19日，捷克斯洛伐克人攻克巴尔代约夫，次日科希策落入苏军之手。

src: Once the Russians accept their defeat, Romania will fall too. Maybe sooner than we expect. A couple of weeks ago they launched an attack against the Austro- Hungarians, which had a limited success. I think the news of that battle were the ones that worried you. However, nothing serious happened, and now our enemies are vulnerable. They haven’t had time to build solid defences and I think that, if we counterattack soon, we’ll be able to surprise them and crush them once and for all. Then the end of the war will be one step closer. One step closer to peace, and to be back with you.
dst: 一旦俄国人接受失败，罗马尼亚也会随之陷落。也许比我们预想的还要快。几周前，他们向奥匈军发动了一次进攻，取得了有限的成功。我想，让您担心的正是那场战斗的消息。然而，并没有发生什么严重的事，如今我们的敌人十分脆弱。他们还没来得及构筑坚固的防线，我认为，如果我们很快反攻，就能打他们一个措手不及，把他们一劳永逸地击溃。那样，战争的结束就又近了一步——离和平，离回到您身边，都近了一步。

src: Once the reorganization was complete, Diterikhs prepared our armies for the counteroffensive, which would begin in September. All our units would participate, but the 3rd Army, along with the Separate Siberian Cossack Corps, would inflict the main blow along the Omsk-Petropavlovsk-Kurgan railroad line, on our left flank. While our other units pinned the enemy down near the Ishim, the Cossacks and the 3rd Army would penetrate deeply into the rear of the 5th Red Army, allowing the encirclement and destruction of the Bolshevik divisions that were deployed further to the north.
dst: 整编完成后，季捷里赫斯让我军为反攻做好了准备，反攻将在9月开始。我们所有部队都将参战，但第三集团军将连同独立西伯利亚哥萨克军，沿左翼的鄂木斯克-彼得罗巴甫洛夫斯克-库尔干铁路线实施主要打击。当其他部队在伊希姆河附近牵制住敌人时，哥萨克和第三集团军将深深插入第五红军的后方，从而得以包围并歼灭部署在更北面的布尔什维克各师。

src: Once this is achieved the 3rd Panzer Division along with the 2nd and 20th Infantry Divisions will join the 10th.
dst: 此目标达成后，第3装甲师连同第2和第20步兵师将与第10装甲师会合。

src: Once we captured the ports, the Soviets will be cut off from US supplies via the North Atlantic convoy routes.
dst: 一旦我们攻占这些港口，苏联人将被切断经由北大西洋护航运输线获得的美国补给。

src: Once we have taken the high ground we will be able to link with the landing at Suvla Bay.
dst: 一旦夺取高地，我们就能与苏夫拉湾的登陆部队会合。

src: Once we were here: The Ice March (II)
dst: 我们曾在此: 冰上行军 (II)

src: Once you broke through the enemy lines, you'll procced along the road towards Athens.
dst: 一旦突破敌军防线，你将沿公路向雅典推进。

src: Once you defeat our enemies, we'll cross the Karpaten easily, Ploesti will be ours in a matter of days, and we'll be able to execute a pincer maneuver against Bukarest. Meanwhile, our Bulgarian friends will attack the Romanian divisions in Dobrudscha and the lower Donau. With a bit of luck, most of the country will be ours before the beginning of the winter.
dst: 一旦您击败我们的敌人，我们就能轻松翻越喀尔巴阡山，普洛耶什蒂不日将落入我们手中，我们还能对布加勒斯特实施钳形攻势。与此同时，我们的保加利亚朋友将进攻多布罗加与多瑙河下游的罗马尼亚师。运气好的话，入冬前该国大部将归我们所有。

src: Once you'll capture Zilina, you may use it as a base of operation - the SH works for both sides.
dst: 一旦你攻下日利纳，就可以把它作为作战基地——SH 对双方都有效。

src: One Air Transport is available in this scenario.
dst: 本场景中有 1 架空中运输机可用。

src: One complicating factor that you must be aware of is that the Allies are attacking us with air units based in Sicily.  Unfortunately there is nothing we can do to attack these air bases.  The Luftwaffe will have to defeat the Allied air forces in Italian air space to gain air supremacy over the battlefield.
dst: 你必须知道的一个复杂因素是，盟军正用驻扎在西西里的航空部队攻击我们。遗憾的是，我们拿这些空军基地毫无办法。德国空军必须在意大利领空击败盟军航空部队，才能夺取战场制空权。

src: One complicating factor that you must be aware of is that the Allies are attacking us with air units based in the British Isles.  Unfortunately there is nothing we can do to attack these air bases at this time.  Our rockets are not accurate enough, yet.  The Luftwaffe will have to defeat the Allied air forces in French air space to gain air supremacy over the battlefield.
dst: 你必须知道的一个复杂因素是，盟军正用驻扎在不列颠群岛的航空部队攻击我们。遗憾的是，眼下我们拿这些空军基地毫无办法。我们的火箭还不够精确。德国空军必须在法国领空击败盟军航空部队，才能夺取战场制空权。

src: One last effort. That's all we need. When Petograd falls, all the Bolshevik power will have disappeared. Lenin, Trotsky, Stalin and most of their leaders have hidden here, waiting for a general mutiny among our forces, something that will never take place, or for the arrival of any ship that evacuates them to any country willing to accept them. And although I was reluctant to believe it, that might actually happen. The British and the French are so tired of war that they could allow them to stay in their countries. Well, if they want to hatch the eggs of vipers, I'm almost tempted to let them do so.
dst: 最后一次努力，这就是我们所需要的全部。当彼得格勒陷落，布尔什维克的一切权势都将烟消云散。列宁、托洛茨基、斯大林及其大多数领袖都藏在这里，等待我军发生一场永远不会出现的哗变，或等待任何一艘能把他们撤往某个愿意接纳他们的国家的船只到来。尽管我不愿相信，但这或许真会发生。英国人和法国人已厌倦战争，可能会允许他们留在自己的国家。也罢，如果他们想孵化毒蛇的卵，我倒几乎想随他们去了。

src: One last note: due to differences between German and Soviet organization, each side uses a slightly different unit scale. Units under your command represent companies, enemy units correspond to battalions.
dst: 最后一点说明：由于德苏编制不同，双方使用的单位比例尺略有差异。你麾下的单位代表连，敌方单位则对应营。

src: One last thing: You will have to resist many enemies charging against our lines, so it may be wise to gather some extra artillery.
dst: 最后一件事：您将不得不抵御许多敌人冲击我们的防线，所以多集结一些炮兵也许是明智的。

src: One moment Herr General...in this minute we receive alarming radio transmissions from our two destroyers which are guarding the entrance to the Ofotfjord. Enemy Battleship......end of transmission......
dst: 请稍等，将军阁下……就在此刻，我们收到守卫奥福特峡湾入口的两艘驱逐舰发来的紧急无线电通报。敌方战列舰……通报中断……

src: One month later, Greek irregulars crossed the border into Ottoman Macedonia. The Ottomans, numerically superior, reacted quickly, defeating the invaders and occupying the Greek province of Thessalia. Larissa fell on 27 April, while the Greek front was reorganized behind the strategic lines of Velestino, in Farsala. On 5 May a Turkish division under Hakki Pasha attacked the 9,000 Greeks under Colonel Smolenski, who were holding a strong position there.
dst: 一个月后，希腊非正规军越过边境，进入奥斯曼的马其顿。奥斯曼军在人数上占优，迅速作出反应，击退了入侵者并占领了希腊的色萨利省。拉里萨于4月27日陷落，而希腊战线则在法尔萨拉的韦莱斯蒂诺战略防线后方重新组织。5月5日，哈基帕夏麾下的一个土耳其师向斯莫伦斯基上校指挥的9000名希腊守军发起进攻，他们正据守着那里的坚固阵地。

src: One month later, on 11 October, the Grand National Assembly of Turkey, Italy, France and Britain, signed the Armistice of Mudanya. Greece was forced to sign it three days later.
dst: 一个月后，10月11日，土耳其大国民议会、意大利、法国和英国签署了《穆达尼亚停战协定》。希腊被迫在三天后签署。

src: One more thing, your mountain units (Branderburgers) with the assist of aux units must move through hills and the rivers and destroy the 2 fuel depots and the 2 trains with supplies.
dst: 还有一件事，你的山地部队（勃兰登堡部队）必须在辅助部队的协助下穿越丘陵与河流，摧毁2座燃料库和2列补给列车。

src: One of the Kakie units that are being used in those barbaric practices is Clements's brigade. We have been following them for a few days, and now we have a good chance for destroying it. They have camped in a place with water supply, but located at the foot of a mountain that they didn't care to explore. It's the perfect place for an ambush.
dst: 参与这些野蛮行径的英军部队之一就是克莱门茨旅。我们已经跟踪他们好几天了，现在有了歼灭它的好机会。他们在一处有水源的地方扎了营，但营地位于一座他们懒得去探查的山脚下。这正是伏击的绝佳地点。

src: One of the main reasons is that our long range artillery hasn't been able to neutralize theirs, so the French guns are constantly harassing our infantry, which has been exposed to enemy fire since the offensive began. The French don't really need to bleed themselves with useless counterattacks.
dst: 其中一个主要原因是，我们的远程炮兵一直没能压制住他们的炮兵，所以法军火炮不停地袭扰我们的步兵，而步兵自攻势开始以来就一直暴露在敌军火力之下。法军实在没必要用无谓的反攻去让自己流血。

src: One of the main targets of Scandinavian campaign was the Norwegian port of Narvik which became a scene for two naval battles and for a two months long land campaign.
dst: 斯堪的纳维亚战役的主要目标之一，是挪威港口纳尔维克；这里先后爆发了两场海战，以及一场历时两个月的陆战。

src: One of the reasons for the rapid German advance was the lack of cooperation between the Belgian and French troops. Both troops executed their plans without looking at what the other was doing, causing many disagreements and incidents.
dst: 德军推进迅速的原因之一是比利时与法国部队之间缺乏配合。两军各自执行自己的计划，不顾对方在做什么，造成许多分歧和事件。

src: One of the strongest fortresses in the north-east of Gaul, the Castrum Mogontiacum, lies directly in our territory; and prevents all troop movements from north to south and west .....
dst: 高卢东北最坚固的要塞之一——莫贡蒂亚库姆要塞，就横在我们的领地上；它阻断了所有从北向南、向西的部队调动 .....

src: One of those Prussian attacks was directed against the town of Amiens, where the small but potentially dangerous French Army of the North had established an advanced position. The Prussian goal was to drive their enemies out of the area of Amiens, so that they would cease to be a threat to the besiegers of Paris.
dst: 其中一次普鲁士进攻针对的是亚眠镇，规模虽小却颇具潜在威胁的法军北方军团在那里建立了前进阵地。普鲁士人的目标是把敌人赶出亚眠地区，使他们不再对巴黎的围城者构成威胁。

src: One of your brigades will advance on the extreme left, the other two brigades in the centre. The French are to act as a pivot on the right, and advance along the coast. We are expecting massive Turkish reinforcements arriving very soon, so there is no time to lose. I count on you, General!
dst: 您有一个旅将在最左翼推进，另外两个旅在中路。法军将在右翼担任枢轴，沿海岸推进。我们预计大批土耳其援军很快会赶到，所以刻不容缓。我全靠您了，将军！

src: One special, per turn, prestige producing hex, per side (Extra target incentive)
dst: 每方各有一座每回合产出声望的特殊格（额外的目标激励）

src: One special, per turn, prestige producing unit, per side (Another target incentive)
dst: 每方各有一个每回合产出声望的特殊单位（又一个目标激励）

src: One strong anti-tank gun is attached to your army.
dst: 一门威力强大的反坦克炮已配属您的部队。

src: One under the command of Proconsul Quintus Servilius Caepio and the other under Consul Gnaeus Mallius Maximus.
dst: 一支由前执政官昆图斯塞尔维利乌斯凯皮奥指挥，另一支由执政官格奈乌斯马利乌斯马克西穆斯指挥。
只有“轻型舰船”可以部署。

src: Only 14 core units can be deployed in this scenario.
dst: 本场景只能部署14个核心单位。

src: Only 5 core gound units and no air units can be deployed in the next scenario.
dst: 下一场景中只能部署5个核心地面单位，且不能部署任何空中单位。

src: Only 5 core gound units and no air units can be deployed in this scenario.
dst: 本场景中只能部署5个核心地面单位，不能部署空军单位。

src: Only Construction or Sapper units can repair a hex.
dst: 只有建筑或工兵部队能够修复格。

src: Only Level Bombers can cause long term suppression.
dst: 只有重型轰炸机才能造成长期压制。

src: Only Russia refused. During the uprising Siberian and Cossack units had occupied most of Manchuria, and they obviously wanted to annex that region. So the Qing Army woud have to fight one last campaign before China could have peace.
dst: 只有俄国拒绝。在起义期间，西伯利亚和哥萨克部队已经占领了满洲的大部分地区，他们显然想要吞并该地区。因此，在中国获得和平之前，清军还得再打最后一场战役。

src: Only Soviet inactivity after the capture of Tartu saved your brigade and spared your career, Kolonel.  You still posess a chance to redeem yourself in the defense of Tallin...
dst: 上校，只有苏军在占领塔尔图之后的按兵不动，才拯救了您的旅，也保全了您的军旅生涯。在塔林的防御战中，您仍有一次将功补过的机会……

src: Only a BV is possible in this scenario so take and hold the only VH.
dst: 本场景只能取得大捷，所以夺取并守住那唯一的胜利点。

src: Only a few things have been changed to adapt the game to the Ancient conditions.
dst: 只是改动了几处，让游戏适应古代的条件。

src: Only a thunderstorm prevented them from extermination.
dst: 只有一场雷雨才使他们免于全灭。

src: Only by withdrawing the First and Second Armee behind the Aisne, the German cavalry could close the gap and restore the frontline. The von Schlieffen plan had failed. The only option left to achieve a quick victory on the  Western Front was to outflank the enemy armies. Both sides tried to do this multiple times, leading to a 'Race to the Sea'.
dst: 只有将第1、第2集团军撤到埃纳河后方，德军骑兵才能封住缺口、恢复战线。冯·施里芬计划已告失败。要在西线取得速胜，剩下的唯一选择就是包抄敌军各集团军。双方多次尝试这一手，最终演变成一场「奔向大海」。

src: Only in the Austro-Hungarian Empire did Polish citizens have rights. They could develop their own organizations under the rule of the house of Habsburg. Not only could these organizations be scientifical and political, but they could also be paramilitary. In 1908 a refugee from the "Russian" part of Poland, Józef Pi³sudski,  took control over these paramilitary organizations and prepared  these people to fight against the Russian Empire in the coming war.
dst: 只有在奥匈帝国，波兰公民才享有权利。他们得以在哈布斯堡家族的统治下发展自己的组织。这些组织不仅可以是学术性和政治性的，还可以是准军事性的。1908年，一位来自波兰「俄占」部分的流亡者约瑟夫·毕苏斯基掌控了这些准军事组织，并训练这些人准备在即将到来的战争中与俄罗斯帝国作战。

src: Only one air and one naval transport are available.
dst: 仅有1个空中运输单位和1个海上运输单位可用。

src: Only the Polski Korpus Posi³kowy (Polish Auxiliary Corps - the 2nd Brigade of the Legiony under the "serious" name)  were sent to the eastern front, to Bukowina.
dst: 只有波兰辅助军团（即波兰军团第2旅冠以「正式」之名）被派往东线，前往布科维纳。

src: Only the arrival of more German divisions forced the Belgian Army to retreat to their starting positions around Antwerp. With hopes of a capture of Paris gone and your 6.Reserve Division reunited with 5.Reserve Division, it is time to deal with Antwerp.
dst: 直到更多德国师抵达，比利时陆军才被迫撤回他们在安特卫普周围的出发阵地。夺取巴黎的希望已化为泡影，您的第6预备师已与第5预备师会合，是时候解决安特卫普了。

src: Only the fall of Singapore - earlier this year February - is a bigger humilation for the Brits than the capitulation of Tobruk. Next to 35000 prisoners, we got our hands on much needed supplies.
dst: 对英国人来说，只有新加坡的陷落——今年2月——比托布鲁克的投降更让他们蒙羞。除了3.5万名战俘，我们还缴获了急需的补给。

src: Only three days later, a strong and extremely well-planned German counterattack began. On our right flank, near Gouzeaucourt, the break was swift. Two of our divisions seemed to evaporate, and the Guards, still recovering after the combats at Bourlon and Fontaine, were called as reinforcements to that area.
dst: 仅仅三天之后，一场强大且策划极为周密的德军反击开始了。在我们右翼、古佐库尔附近，突破来得非常迅速。我们的两个师似乎一下子消失了，而仍在布尔隆和方丹战斗后休整的近卫军被作为增援调往那一地区。

src: Operation "Uranus" was the codename of the Soviet strategic operation in World War II which led to the encirclement of the German Sixth Army, Third and Fourth Romanian armies, and portions of the German Fourth Panzer Army.
dst: “天王星”行动是二战中苏联战略行动的代号，该行动导致德国第6集团军、罗马尼亚第3、第4集团军以及德国第4装甲集团军一部被合围。

src: Operation "Wintergewitter" undertaken between 12 and 23 December 1942 aimed to create a link with the Axis troops in Stalingrad. The main blow was going to be delivered by the German 57th Panzer Corps (6th and 23rd Panzer Division - 230 tanks). On its left flank was the Romanian 6th Corps (2nd and 18th Infantry Divisions). On the right flank was the Romanian 7th Corps (1st and 4th Infantry Divisions) and the Cavalry Group "Gen. Popescu" (5th and 8th Cavalry Divisions). The German tanks advanced up to 50 km from Stalingrad, but were stopped.
dst: “冬季风暴”行动于1942年12月12日至23日实施，旨在与斯大林格勒的轴心国部队建立联系。主攻由德国第57装甲军（第6、第23装甲师，230辆坦克）担负。其左翼为罗马尼亚第6军（第2、第18步兵师）；右翼为罗马尼亚第7军（第1、第4步兵师）与“波佩斯库将军”骑兵集群（第5、第8骑兵师）。德军坦克推进至距斯大林格勒50公里处，但被阻停。

src: Operation Arctic Fox was a joint German-Finnish offensive in the Far North against the cities of Salla and Kandalaksha with an ultimate goal of blocking the railroad towards the Soviet harbour of Murmansk.
dst: “北极狐行动”是德芬联军在极北地区发起的攻势，矛头指向萨拉与坎达拉克沙两座城市，最终目标是切断通往苏联摩尔曼斯克港的铁路。

src: Operation Blücher-York brought us closer to Paris. But now our attack is checked by US and French forces. Your task is to get us moving again. Success here will bring us to Paris, or at least will draw British reserves away from Flanders. That will give us another chance at swinging around Ypres, reach the Channel Ports and force the British out of the war.
dst: 布吕歇尔-约克行动让我们离巴黎更近了。但现在我们的进攻遭到了美军和法军的阻击。您的任务是让我们重新推进起来。在这里获胜将把我们带到巴黎，至少也能把英军预备队从佛兰德引开。这将给我们再次包抄伊普尔、抵达海峡各港口并把英国赶出战争的机会。

src: Operation Brevity showed that our front line defences were quite easily breached. Anticipating this new British attack and using the lessons learned from our attacks on Tobruk, Rommel created a line of fortified positions from Halfaya to Sidi Azeiz.
dst: “短暂”行动表明，我们的前线防御很容易被突破。预见到英军这次新的进攻，并吸取我们进攻托布鲁克的经验教训，隆美尔构筑了一条从哈勒法亚到西迪阿泽兹的筑垒阵地线。

src: Operation Cobra is in a good progress and we are just a few miles away from Avranches. The defending German troops are weakened from our previous bombardements. The Panzer-Lehr-Division is the only enemy division in this area with considerable strength.
dst: “眼镜蛇”行动进展顺利，我们距阿夫朗什只有几英里。防守的德军部队已被我们此前的轰炸削弱。装甲教导师是该地区唯一一支实力可观的敌军师。

src: Operation Eilbote I brought the pass at Barrage de l'Oued Kebir, the Karachoum Gap and the Kairouan Pass in our hands. German forces - supported by our troops - will now follow up with an attack on the Faid pass. At the same time our troops are still involved in skirmishes with US II Corps forces around Sened and Maknassy.

src: Operation Marita, the plan to capture Greece has been complicated after a coup d'etat in Yugoslavia. This coup has ousted the government we signed a protocol with 2 days earlier - which is 2 weeks ago now - a protocol that brought Yugoslavia in the Tripartite Pact. The new government has canceled the protocol and Hitler thinks they will sooner or later join the Allies. He has ordered our troops to not only invade Greece as planned, but Yugoslavia as well. The task of your troops - your division is renamed SS-Division Das Reich - is to cross the border from Rumania into Yugoslavia and to capture Belgrade. The Heer does not want the Waffen SS to capture Belgrade and has added the GrossDeutschland Regiment to your troops. They have also ordered the 8th Panzer division to move on Belgrade from Hungary and has given similar orders to the 11th Panzer Division stationed in Bulgaria.
dst: “马里塔”行动——夺取希腊的计划在南斯拉夫发生政变后变得复杂起来。这场政变推翻了我们两天前（其实已是两周前）才与之签署议定书的政府，那份议定书把南斯拉夫拉进了三国同盟。新政府取消了议定书，希特勒认为他们早晚会加入盟国。他下令我军不仅按计划入侵希腊，也要入侵南斯拉夫。你的部队——你的师已改称党卫军“帝国”师——的任务是从罗马尼亚越过边境进入南斯拉夫，夺取贝尔格莱德。陆军不愿让武装党卫军拿下贝尔格莱德，于是把“大德意志”团编入你的部队。他们还下令第8装甲师从匈牙利向贝尔格莱德推进，并对驻保加利亚的第11装甲师下达了类似命令。

src: Operation Overlord will be the largest amphibious invasion ever seen by man, and you must stop it. You should strive to pin the Allies in Normandy by holding St. Lo, Caen, St. Mere Eglise, and Cherbourg until after July 5th when we hope reinforcements will arrive and throw the Allies back into the sea. At a minimum, hold at least one of these key towns.
dst: 「霸王」行动将是有史以来规模最大的两栖入侵，你必须阻止它。你应尽力把盟军钉在诺曼底，守住圣洛、卡昂、圣梅尔埃格利斯和瑟堡，直至 7月5日之后，届时我们希望增援到达，把盟军赶下海去。最低限度，也要守住其中至少一座要镇。

src: Operation Sea Lion the battle for Britain has begun! You have been provided the best equipment we have but sadly all your troops lack battle experience.
dst: 海狮行动——不列颠之战打响了！你获得了我们最精良的装备，但遗憾的是，你所有的部队都缺乏实战经验。

src: Operation Supercharge brought the German-Italian forces close to collapse and the inevitable followed soon. The Axis was extremely low on reserves, fuel, and morale, so the Allied breakthrough attempt started and succeeded on the very next day.
dst: “增压行动”使德意联军濒临崩溃，不可避免的结局接踵而至。轴心国后备兵力、燃油与士气都极度枯竭，盟军的突破尝试于次日发起并一举成功。

src: Operation Trappenjagd well underway. The Germans penetrated the Soviet front in the south and the swung north in order to try to encircle the Soviet 51. Army. src: Ostrava was liberated in the evening of 30th April 1945, when tanks crossed the bridge across Ostravice. This bridge was undermined, but a young man Emil (Milos) Sykora with his friend nicknamed "Olsak" warned the tankists of the explosives . Subsequently they cut the wires, but Sykora was mortally wounded by German machinegun fire from the opposite river bank. Olsak, wounded in a grenade explosion on the 1st May, died few days later in city's hospital.
