src: Otto, I know that this may sound like the usual Christian jargon and I really wish that it wasn't me who must undergo this all. But please, before you throw away the letter and before you refuse my requests, think about them just for a while.
dst: 奥托，我知道这可能听起来像老生常谈的基督徒套话，我也真希望不得不经历这一切的不是我。但请你，在扔掉这封信、拒绝我的请求之前，哪怕只是想上一会儿。

src: Otto, on the night of the air raid, the Brits were using incendiary bombs and one of them hit your house. The phosphorus adhered to Sophies hair and soiled her face, and... you know. Thank God that she didn't lost her sight. But she's still in a serious danger...
dst: 奥托，空袭那晚，英国人使用了燃烧弹，其中一枚击中了你的房子。白磷粘在了索菲的头发上，毁坏了她的面容，而……你知道的。谢天谢地她没有失明。但她仍处于严重的危险之中……

src: Otto, when you'll talk with Fuhrer, ask him something. Ask him if my daughter really had to die in pain. Ask him if my son had to die on some alien island. Ask him why parson Johann vanished in a KL. Ask him... or not. Maybe don't do anything, just return to me.
dst: 奥托，当你和元首谈话时，问他一件事。问他，我的女儿是否真的非要在痛苦中死去。问他，我的儿子是否非要死在某个陌生的岛上。问他，为什么约翰牧师消失在了集中营里。问他……或者不问。也许什么都别做，就回到我身边吧。

src: Ottoman forces were able to repulse the weakened EEF troops from the trenches that the EEF infantry brigades took in the initial assaults. British losses were about 6,000 men. Ottoman losses only a third of that. Moral in the Ottoman Fourth Army was high. The EEF dug in and stayed in the trenches opposite Ottoman forces for six months.
dst: 奥斯曼军队得以把遭到削弱的埃及远征军部队从那些战壕中击退，而那些战壕是埃及远征军的步兵旅在最初的突击中占领的。英军损失约6000人，奥斯曼方面的损失仅为其三分之一。奥斯曼第四集团军的士气高昂。埃及远征军转入防御，在奥斯曼军队对面的战壕里驻扎了六个月。
奥钱迪亚诺 第37/第2旅/第1师
旧斯蒂弗肯斯凯尔克教堂
维斯特雷阿姆防御工事
乌莱德艾哈迈德杰巴拉

src: Our 15th Panzer Division had already occupied the eastern Volga River bank opposite to Stalingrad and blocked the river passage. In the West, our troops have closed the ring around Stalingrad and will reach the city limits in a few days. Until then, you must prevent that enemy reinforcements reach Stalingrad! Divide your forces - with the stronger part reinforce the 15th Panzer Division and parry all attempts of the enemy to cross the river! Pass the Volga River with the other part (deploy this force at SH direct in naval transport) and support our incoming troops in the conquest of Stalingrad!
dst: 我们的第15装甲师已占领斯大林格勒对岸的伏尔加河东岸，封锁了河道。在西面，我军已合拢对斯大林格勒的包围圈，几天内就能抵达城郊。在那之前，你必须阻止敌军增援抵达斯大林格勒！把你的部队一分为二——以较强的一部增援第15装甲师，击退敌军一切渡河企图！以另一部渡过渡尔加河（将该部在 SH 处直接以海运方式部署），支援我方抵达的部队攻占斯大林格勒！

src: Our 2nd and 4th Kavallerie divisions are to cross the Gete at Halen and to move to Diest via Zelk. If this plan succeeds, the Belgian army will be forced to retreat to avoid getting cut off from its supply base at Antwerp.
dst: 我第2和第4骑兵师将在哈伦渡过赫特河，并经由泽尔克向迪斯特推进。如果此计划成功，比利时陆军将被迫撤退，以免与安特卫普的补给基地失去联系。

src: Our 3rd Army under Radko Dmitriev launched the offensive but was not able to break the front of the Austrian 4th Army (Archduke Josef Fredinand).  Stavka has resolved to pull the Carpathian Corps from Brusilov's 8th Army to achive a breakthrough at Limanowa.
dst: 拉德科·德米特里耶夫指挥的我第3集团军发动了攻势，却未能突破奥军第4集团军（约瑟夫·费迪南大公）的防线。大本营决定从布鲁西洛夫的第8集团军中抽调喀尔巴阡军，以在利马诺瓦实现突破。

src: Our 5th Army (Pleve), having regrouped after the inital setbacks, is ready to check the enemy advance.  You must recapture the lost ground and seize the initiative!  Your division will be deployed with the XXI Corps of the 5th Army.
dst: 我第5集团军（普列韦）在初期的挫折后已重新集结，准备遏制敌人的进攻。您必须夺回失地，夺取主动权！您的师将随第5集团军的第21军部署。

src: Our 6th Army is trapped in Stalingrad from another Soviet winter offensive.  Good news though, Manstein has already started an attack to open a corridor with 4th Panzer Army and our forces will attack here in a supporting effort.
dst: 我们的第6集团军又被苏军的一次冬季攻势困在斯大林格勒。不过好消息是，曼施泰因已开始进攻，与第4装甲集团军一起打通一条走廊，而我们的部队将在这里作为支援发起进攻。

src: Our Advance got stuck at the German Gustave Line. You and your men will carry out a seaborne landing near Anzio while the 5th Army will launch an attack in the Cassino area.
dst: 我方的推进在德军古斯塔夫防线上受阻。你与你的部下将在安齐奥附近实施一次海上登陆，同时第5集团军将在卡西诺地区发起进攻。

src: Our Axis corps was severely mauled trying to complete the destruction of two Soviet armies.  Apparently the soviets were much stronger than the Germans estimated and the INF corps that was eventually dispatched to help arrived too late to prevent the disaster.
dst: 我们的轴心国军在试图完成歼灭两个苏军集团军时遭重创。显然苏军比德国人估计的强得多，而最终派去支援的步兵军来得太晚，没能阻止这场灾难。

src: Our Chinese colony is lost! Here, a gun for you. Now I'll leave you alone...
dst: 我们的中国殖民地失守了！给您一把枪。现在我不管您了……

src: Our Command in Chief, General Murray, is quite optimistic about the prospects of our second attempt to take Gaza. The plan is for another frontal infantry assault on the Turkish positions at Gaza after two days of preliminary bombardment, while our cavalry will attack further east. Several new infantry divisions have arrived, and we have been sent a few tanks from the Western Front. French and British warships support us with all their firepower along the coast.
dst: 我们的总司令默里将军对第二次攻取加沙的前景相当乐观。计划是在两天的预备炮击后，由步兵对加沙的土耳其阵地再次发起正面突击，同时骑兵向东面更远处进攻。数个新步兵师已抵达，我们还从西线得到了几辆坦克。法国和英国的军舰沿海岸以全部火力支援我们。

src: Our Corps will land on the Formosan beaches in a few minutes, so I only have a brief moment to write you....
dst: 几分钟后我们的军团就要在台湾的海滩登陆了，所以我只有片刻时间给您写信……

src: Our Finnish allies are well experienced and highly motivated. We're in contact with advance elements of SS Division Nord, but we cannot rely on any significant help, as the bulk of the division is too far away.
dst: 我们的芬兰盟友经验丰富、士气高昂。我们与“北方”SS 师的前锋部队取得了联系，但无法指望其实质支援，因为该师主力远在后方。

src: Our First, Second and Third Armies must move through Belgium to reach Paris. The Belgian King Albert has rejected our ultimatum for free passage, so now the city of Liege, its fortresses and the Belgian 3rd Infantry Division - that is sent to bolster the Liege defences - are blocking our way West.
dst: 我们的第一、第二和第三集团军必须穿过比利时抵达巴黎。比利时国王阿尔贝拒绝了我们要其开放通道的最后通牒，于是如今，列日城、其要塞以及被派来加强列日防御的比利时第3步兵师，正挡住我们西进的道路。

src: Our First, Second and Third Armies must move through Belgium to reach Paris. The Belgian King Albert has rejected our ultimatum for free passage, so now the city of Liege, its fortresses and the Belgian 3rd Infantry Division that is sent to bolster the Liege defences are blocking our way West.
dst: 我第1、第2、第3集团军必须穿越比利时才能抵达巴黎。比利时国王阿尔贝已拒绝我们要求自由通行的最后通牒，因此，列日城、其要塞群，以及被派来加强列日防务的比利时第3步兵师，正阻挡着我们西进的道路。

src: Our Heeresgruppe attacks on the steppes have almost pulverized the Soviet army.
dst: 我军集团军群在草原上的攻势已近乎粉碎苏军。

src: Our High Command suggest that you should make a general frontal attack with our frontline divisions, but it might be wiser to focus our attacks at some specific points, in order to open breaches in the enemy defences. And don't hesitate to use our own reserve units.
dst: 我们的最高统帅部建议您以我前线各师发动全面正面进攻，但把进攻集中在若干特定地点、以便在敌军防线上撕开缺口，也许更为明智。并且不要犹豫使用我们自己的预备队。

src: Our I Corps reached Ypres on the night of October 20th. A few hours later we were advancing to the Northeast, covering the left flank of the IV Corps. Soon, we found that the German resistance was stronger than we had expected and that an enemy offensive was inminent, so we hastily built a precarious defensive line near the villlage of Langemarck. Only a few hours later, three German divisions started their assault. They were not first line units, but they clearly outnumbered us, and if they succeeded at penetrating our lines, the entire British front would be in danger.
dst: 我们的第一军于10月20日夜抵达伊普尔。数小时后，我们向东北推进，掩护第四军的左翼。很快，我们发现德军的抵抗比我们预想的更顽强，而且一场敌军攻势迫在眉睫，于是我们在朗厄马克村附近匆忙构筑了一道岌岌可危的防线。仅仅数小时后，三个德国师开始进攻。他们并非一线部队，但兵力明显多于我们，如果他们成功突破我们的防线，整个英军战线都将岌岌可危。

src: Our III/1st regiment and the Kuperjanow Brigade have taken defensive positions around the airfield near Vaidavas, while your Soomusrongide Diviis elements are to be deployed around Valmiera.  The Latvian garrisons in the area have been wiped out, but the Latvians are sending two understrengthened brigades, which will arrive within days from the south-west.  The Freikorps are expecting to destroy our forces in parts:  they have filled the gap between Vaidavas and Valmiera with an unknown number of troops...
dst: 我们的第1团第3营与库珀亚诺夫旅已在瓦伊达瓦斯附近的机场周围进入防御阵地，而您的装甲列车师各部则将部署在瓦尔米耶拉周围。该地区的拉脱维亚守军已被全歼，但拉脱维亚人正派出两个缺编旅，将在数日内从西南方向抵达。自由军团指望将我军各个击破：他们已用数量不明的部队填满了瓦伊达瓦斯与瓦尔米耶拉之间的缺口……

src: Our Italian allies are preparing an assault on the Guadalajara direction. The CTV generals are believing they will be able to do what we can not achieve in the past months, finishing with the enemy resistance. We shall see what the Italians are able to do!.
dst: 我们的意大利盟友正在准备向瓜达拉哈拉方向发动突击。意大利志愿军团的将军们相信，他们能够完成我们过去几个月未能达成的目标，消灭敌军抵抗。我们倒要看看意大利人能有什么作为！

src: Our Italian allies have undergone several defeats during last weeks and there's a danger of their complete failure. I think that I don't need to overly emphasize the importance of a secure southern flank for our upcoming campaign. Moreover, if the Brits gain total control of North Africa and Mediterranean basin, their supply lines will improve drastically.
dst: 我们的意大利盟友在过去的几周里遭遇了几场败仗，有彻底溃败的危险。我想我无需过分强调，一个稳固的南翼对我们即将到来的战役有多么重要。此外，如果英国人完全控制了北非和地中海盆地，他们的补给线将大大改善。

src: Our Marines already established a bridgehead at the western ferry station.
dst: 我们的海军陆战队已经在西面的渡口建立了桥头堡。

src: Our Mediterranean wolf packs have spent the weeks leading to this operation cutting off support for the British troops on Malta.  You will have command of them as well for the duration of this operation.  We must not let the British bring the strength of their navy to bear on our ground assault forces.
dst: 我们地中海的潜艇狼群在过去数周里一直切断马耳他英军的补给。本次行动期间，它们也归你指挥。我们绝不能让英国把其海军力量压到我们的地面突击部队头上。

src: Our Red Army is closing in on the city from the north and east.  Do I have to tell you about the instructions from Moscow?  They are expecting the Red Flag of the Revolution in Lwow as soon as possible!  Divisions of our Fourteenth Army are closely following your cavalry.  Polish resistance is unknown although interrogations have reported that the Poles bought time at Zadworze for defensive and offensive operations.  I believe these are capitalistic and criminal lies imprinted on the Polish soldiers.
dst: 我们的红军正从北面和东面逼近该城。还需要我告诉您莫斯科的指示吗？他们期待革命的红旗尽快飘扬在利沃夫！我第十四集团军的几个师正紧随您的骑兵。波兰人的抵抗情况不明，尽管审讯报告称，波兰人在扎德沃日赢得了时间，以便进行防御和进攻行动。我认为这些都是印刻在波兰士兵身上的资本主义谎言和罪恶。

src: Our Secret Service has reported that there are just bavarian Reserve Infantries defending them, but they are well entrenchend. At first you'll surround their position, and later you'll take the Loretto-Heights.
dst: 我们的情报部门报告，那里只有巴伐利亚预备步兵据守，但他们构筑了良好的工事。首先您要包围他们的阵地，然后夺取洛雷托高地。

src: Our Soviet advisors suggest that we let the enemy troops pass through the mountains and then annihilate them on a familiar battlefield.
dst: 我们的苏联顾问建议，让敌军穿过山区，然后在熟悉的战场上歼灭他们。

src: Our Tigers once again proved formidable, and they can stand against even the heaviest enemy tanks. Unfortunately, your battalion will receive only a few new tanks.
dst: 我们的虎式再次证明了自己的强悍，即便面对敌军最重的坦克也能一战。遗憾的是，你的营只能接收寥寥几辆新坦克。

src: Our Tigers once again proved formidable, and they can stand against even the heaviest enemy tanks. Your battalion will receive a batch of new tanks very soon.
dst: 我们的虎式再次证明了自己的强悍，即便面对敌军最重的坦克也能一战。你的营很快将接收一批新坦克。

src: Our actions in North Africa the last years have led to a international crisis with all the other powerful European states. Sometimes it seemed that it was really going to become an armed conflict. I must confess you that I have bad feelings about this. I really think that there will be a Great War in Europe soon, especially if those perfidious, damned Germans don't cease to provoke us. Three generations of French citizens haven't forgotten the shame of 1871.
dst: 过去几年我们在北非的行动，已引发与欧洲所有其他强国的国际危机。有时看起来真的要演变成武装冲突。我必须向您坦白，我对此有不好的预感。我真的认为欧洲很快就会有一场大战，尤其是那些背信弃义、该死的德国人不停止挑衅的话。三代法国人都没有忘记1871年的耻辱。

src: Our advantage is our Luftwaffe and that no one suspect a landing attempt at this season. The risks are great, but for the next few days unusually good weather is predicted.
dst: 我们的优势在于德国空军，而且没人会怀疑在这个季节有登陆企图。风险很大，但接下来几天的天气预计异常地好。

src: Our air recon confirmed a large concentrations of enemy armour, so we've arranged accordingly. But as the enemy air activity increases rapidly with every hour, it is more and more hard for us to gain new solid information.
dst: 我们的空中侦察确认了敌军装甲的大规模集结，所以我们已相应部署。但随着敌军空中活动每小时都在急剧增加，我们越来越难以获取新的可靠情报。

src: Our alliance with El Raisuli has deteriorated beyond recovery. His demands in order to keep his friendship have grown immensely and have become unacceptable.
dst: 我们与赖苏利的联盟已经恶化到无法挽回的地步。他为维持友谊而提出的要求已经膨胀得离谱，变得令人无法接受。

src: Our allies in Salonika have been planning an offensive during the entire summer, which resulted in a "spoiling" offensive by the Bulgarian 1st Army in August.  The Serbian Danube division has held to the last fortifications at Florina, but will not hold much longer.  Your offensive must restore our posession of Florina and break through the Bulgaro-German line by capturing the town of Seres.
dst: 我们在萨洛尼卡的盟友整个夏天都在筹划一次攻势，结果招致保加利亚第1集团军在八月发动了一次「先发制人」的攻势。塞尔维亚多瑙河师在弗洛里纳守到了最后的工事，但坚持不了多久了。您的攻势必须恢复我们对弗洛里纳的占据，并通过夺取塞雷斯镇突破保德联军战线。

src: Our anti-tank screen at the Rahman track collapsed and even the heroic performance of Ariete could not stop 8th Army. Your actions did allow some of the DAK remnants to retreat. Unfortunately we had to write off most of the non-motorized X (Brescia, Folgore, Pavia) and XXI (Trento, Bologna) Corps. The remnants of your XX Corps are renamed Battlegroup Ariete.
dst: 我们在拉赫曼小道的反坦克炮屏崩溃了，就连“公羊”师的英勇表现也没能挡住第8集团军。你的行动确实让非洲军的一些残部得以撤退。遗憾的是，我们不得不放弃大部分非摩托化的第10军（布雷西亚、闪电、帕维亚各师）和第21军（特伦托、博洛尼亚各师）。你第20军的残部被改称“公羊”战斗群。

src: Our anti-tank screen holding out at the Rahman track and the heroic performance of Ariete have allowed the DAK remnants to retreat. Unfortunately we had to write off most of the non-motorized X (Brescia, Folgore, Pavia) and XXI (Trento, Bologna) Corps. The remnants of your XX Corps are renamed Battlegroup Ariete.
dst: 我们在拉赫曼小道坚守的反坦克炮屏以及“公羊”师的英勇表现，让非洲军残部得以撤退。遗憾的是，我们不得不放弃大部分非摩托化的第10军（布雷西亚、闪电、帕维亚各师）和第21军（特伦托、博洛尼亚各师）。你第20军的残部被改称“公羊”战斗群。

src: Our armies are safe, comrade.  Thanks to your excellent rearguard duty slowing down the Polish army in the south long enough for us to retreat to better positions.  The front is stabilizing again locally.  Plus I have orders for our command to be pulled out of the frontline. That means rest and refitting for the first time in months!
dst: 同志，我们的军队安全了。多亏您出色的后卫作战，在南方拖住了波兰军队足够长的时间，让我们得以撤到更有利的阵地。战线正在局部重新稳定。此外，我还接到命令，让我们的指挥部从前线撤下。这意味着数月来头一次休整和换装！

src: Our armoured cars have been very effective neutralizing machine gun nests and artillery positions, so we'll help the Russians in this attack. Let's hope for the best.
dst: 我们的装甲车在摧毁机枪巢和炮兵阵地方面非常有效，所以我们将协助俄国人进行这次进攻。让我们期待最好的结果吧。

src: Our army did well! The German probing attacks against our lines have failed.
dst: 我们的军队表现得很好！德军对我方阵线的试探性进攻失败了。

src: Our army has come to a virtual standstill with most trucks broken down or without fuel. Alexandria is out of range and the only option is to walk back to Sidi Barrani where the Libyan Corps is preparing defensive positions.
dst: 我军几乎完全停滞，大部分卡车损坏或没有燃料。亚历山大已超出范围，唯一的选择是步行撤回西迪拜拉尼——利比亚军正在那里构筑防御阵地。

src: Our army is growing, and the city of Nola lies ahead. The local slaves will help us in conquering by opening the doors at night. A daring plan!
dst: 我们的军队正在壮大，而诺拉城就在前方。城中的奴隶会在夜里为我们打开城门，助我们攻城。好一个大胆的计划！

src: Our army lacked the strength to defeat the Russians in Manchuria. The Empire had to sign a peace treaty that ceded our enemies all that region.
dst: 我们的军队没有足够的力量在满洲击败俄国人。帝国不得不签署一项和约，把整个地区割让给敌人。

src: Our artillery is far superior to their archers, you have to take advantage of it!
dst: 我们的器械远胜他们的弓箭手，你必须善加利用！

src: Our assaults were unsuccessful. We had to bypass Krasnoyarsk and split our forces. There were several paths and railroads that crossed the taiga, but they weren't wide enough to allow us to march together. We made different groups, and all of them would have to reach Kansk, where we could regroup again.
dst: 我们的进攻没有成功。我们不得不绕过克拉斯诺亚尔斯克并分兵。有好几条穿过针叶林的小路和铁路，但它们不够宽，无法让我们整队行军。我们分成了若干队伍，所有队伍都必须抵达坎斯克，在那里重新会合。

src: Our attack on Amba Alagi wasn't successful, but it was followed by the taking of the fortress of Mekele the next month. Both actions showed the Italians that this war wouldn't be easy for them. They sent even more troops to Eritrea, planning a decisive battle that, ideally, would crush us forever.
dst: 我们对安巴阿拉吉的进攻未能得手，但紧接着下个月就攻占了默克莱要塞。这两次行动都让意大利人看到，这场战争对他们来说不会轻松。他们向厄立特里亚派出了更多部队，筹划着一场决战，理想情况下将一劳永逸地碾碎我们。

src: Our attack on Moscow is progressing well, the city is surrounded and another giant pocket has emerged. The Soviet counterattacks on the Volga River were stopped after short time or aborted by the enemy. The Russians now seem to have serious supply problems and fuel shortages, which greatly impairs the operational of their mobile forces and air force. Due to this development the further advance of your troops were ordered to northeast direction at Perm!
dst: 我们对莫斯科的进攻进展顺利，城市已被包围，又一个巨大的包围圈业已形成。伏尔加河上的苏军反攻在短时间内即被遏止，或被敌人自行放弃。俄国人现在似乎遭遇严重的补给困难和燃料短缺，这极大削弱了他们机动部队和空军的作战能力。鉴于这一态势，你的部队被命令改向东北方向的彼尔姆推进！

src: Our attack was well timed and resulted in complete surprise of the enemy. Excellent performance, Herr General! The conquest of Cairo and the Suez Kanal should now be easy.
dst: 我们的进攻时机恰到好处，完全出乎敌人意料。表现出色，将军阁下！如今攻克开罗和苏伊士运河应当易如反掌。

src: Our attacks destroyed both Soviet divisions and Finland is celebrating!
dst: 我们的进攻歼灭了两个苏军师，芬兰正在庆祝！

src: Our attempt to capture Hill 60 have failed. Losses have been heavy again. I fear our troops don't have the power nor the morale for another desperate attack. I don't see any positive prospect for this campaign anymore, General.
dst: 我们夺取60高地的尝试失败了。伤亡再次惨重。恐怕我军既无兵力也无士气再进行一次孤注一掷的进攻了。将军，我看不出这场战役还有任何积极的希望。

src: Our battle against the ancient landlords of oppression has been suddenly stopped... now we must again dress ourselves as peasants to avoid being captured by the enemy.
dst: 我们对古老压迫地主的战斗突然被制止了...现在我们只得再次装扮成农民，以免被敌人俘获。

src: Our battle-weary divisions have been withdrawn, and a crisis hangs over the entire Russian army.  Forced into the deadlock of static trench defenses, the soldiers have succumbed to revolutionary propaganda and have begun to organize meeting committees at the front.  In these conditions, our front may not hold another offensive by the Central Powers.
dst: 我方久战疲惫的各师已撤下，一场危机笼罩着整个俄军。士兵们被迫困于静态堑壕防御的僵局，受到革命宣传的影响，开始在前线组织会议委员会。在这种条件下，我们的战线恐怕无法再承受同盟国的又一次攻势。

src: Our battles against the African Rifles were a relief for General Von Lettow-Vorbeck and his men, who were fighting a guerrilla war in German East Africa. During some months, the number of enemies that were chasing him decreased significantly.
dst: 我们与非洲步枪团的战斗，对冯·莱托-福尔贝克将军及其部属来说是一种缓解——他们正在德属东非打游击战。在好几个月里，追击他们的敌军数量明显减少了。

src: Our beloved lands of Bohemia and Moravia have been under Habsburg control for centuries. Now, during the World War, the time has come to liberate ourselves and rule our own country ourselves!
dst: 我们亲爱的波希米亚和摩拉维亚土地，几个世纪以来一直处于哈布斯堡王朝的统治之下。如今，值此世界大战之际，解放自己、由我们自己统治自己国家的时刻已经到来！

src: Our brave men overran the Turkish lines, stormed the hills and finally took the summits in desperate hand-to-hand combat. But casualties have been heavy, and the Turks have delayed our advance long enough to bring strong reinforcements to the Sair Bair mountains.
dst: 我们英勇的士兵冲垮了土耳其防线，猛攻各座山丘，最终在殊死的白刃战中夺取了山顶。但伤亡惨重，土耳其人拖延我们的进攻够久，得以向萨里拜尔山脉调来强大的增援。

src: Our brave soldiers held this defensive line for more than 3 years. But not any longer. The Germans have penetrated our lines and are on their way to Dunkirk and Calais. The king is considering surrender. This and the fall of the channel ports will weaken the BEF to the point that they might not be able to withstand the upcoming big German offensive.
dst: 我们英勇的士兵守住了这条防线三年多。但现在再也守不住了。德军已经突破我们的防线，正向敦刻尔克和加来进发。国王正在考虑投降。再加上海峡各港口的陷落，英国远征军将被削弱到可能无法抵挡即将到来的德军大规模攻势的地步。

src: Our campaign in Tonkin is being successful, even though the Chinese resistance is harder than we had expected. My column will provide the reinforcements that our army needs.
dst: 我们在东京的战役进展顺利，尽管中国人的抵抗比我们预想的更顽强。我的纵队将为我军提供所需的增援。

src: Our campaign in the Kuban against the Red Army of the Northern Caucasus, now renamed 11th Army, still goes on. We hardly got time to mourn the death of General Alekseyev, who finally succumbed to his illness in September, before putting into practice the last step of our strategy.
dst: 我们在库班对现已更名为第11集团军的北高加索红军的战役仍在继续。我们几乎还没来得及哀悼阿列克谢耶夫将军的逝世——他最终于9月病故——便着手实施我们战略的最后一步。

src: Our cavallery scouts have spotted a  confederate reconnaissance unit near Gettysburg...expecting the mass of Lee´s army to be close our troops errected provisional defense positions around Gettysburg in the last moment..
dst: 我们的骑兵侦察兵在葛底斯堡附近发现了一支南方军侦察部队……预料到李的大军就在附近，我们的部队在最后关头于葛底斯堡周围构筑了临时防御阵地……

src: Our charge on Antwerpen was a totally disaster. The allied have reinforced their troops severely around the harbor. A new offensive is not possible at the moment. Your troops will be refreshed and will get a new commander.
dst: 我们对安特卫普的进攻彻底失败了。盟军已大幅加强了港口周边的部队。目前无法发动新的攻势。你的部队将被整补，并会得到一位新的指挥官。

src: Our commander, Crown Prince Wilhelm understands that you cannot give soldiers the order of threatening a city without attacking it. So our goals are much more concrete. Before your forces are relieved, you should capture the fortresses of Douaumont, Vaux and Souville on the right bank of the Meuse.
dst: 我们的指挥官威廉皇储明白，您不能只下令让士兵威胁一座城市而不去进攻它。所以我们的目标要具体得多。在您的部队被替换之前，您应当攻占默兹河右岸的杜奥蒙、沃克斯和苏维尔要塞。

src: Our commander, in a desperate attempt to get his forces to engage and destroy the Russian Heavy armor was killed and his tanks then lost heart and were routed.
dst: 我们的指挥官在孤注一掷地试图让部队接敌并摧毁俄军重装甲时阵亡，他的坦克随后士气尽失，被击溃了。

src: Our counter-attack failed to achieve its goal, and now the Soviet forces threaten our lines, in fact piercing them at several places.
dst: 我们的反击未能达成目标，如今苏军威胁着我军防线，实际上已在多处突破。

src: Our daring counter-attack thrown the enemy of balance and now it is time to consolidate our gains and secure the area. But this is a task for the intantry; your battalion will be relieved from combat.
dst: 我们果敢的反击打乱了敌人的阵脚，现在是巩固战果、确保该地区的时候了。但这是步兵的活；你的营将撤出战斗休整。

src: Our defeat left the Empire mortally wounded. The coalition forces occupied Tientsin and Peking before the end of the summer, and China had to accept humiliating conditions for peace. My family and I had to flee to the Chinese Turkestan, since the British troops wanted to hang me for high treason. We've lived as farmers since then, under the protection of some loyal army veterans.
dst: 我们的失败使帝国遭受了致命的创伤。联军在夏天结束之前占领了天津和北京，中国不得不接受屈辱的和平条件。我和我的家人不得不逃往新疆，因为英军想以叛国罪绞死我。从那以后，我们一直以务农为生，受到一些忠诚的退伍军人的保护。

src: Our defective maps could have cost us most of the Guards brigade, but my soldiers gave a perfect example of why the British Army is renowned for its determination and courage. Although with some casualties, we took our objectives. The Boer could retreat to Graspan, where they would still harass other units of our division two days later. However, they couldn't stop our advance to Kimberley.
dst: 我们错误百出的地图本可能让近卫旅付出惨重代价，但我的士兵完美地诠释了英国陆军何以以坚定和勇敢著称。尽管付出了一些伤亡，我们还是达成了目标。布尔人得以撤往格拉斯潘，两天后仍在那里袭扰我师的其他部队。然而，他们无法阻止我们向金伯利推进。

src: Our defence strategy didn't work. I guess that, no matter what we had tried, it wouldn't have been enough to delay the Soviets, much less to stop them. We were lucky to save our lives and to avoid capture, but we had to leave tons of equipment and ammunition behind. The victorious Bolsheviks found a great treasure in Ufa. Much more that they had expected.
dst: 我们的防御策略没有奏效。我想，无论我们尝试什么，都不足以拖住苏维埃，更不用说阻止他们了。我们能保住性命、避免被俘已是万幸，但我们不得不丢下成吨的装备和弹药。获胜的布尔什维克在乌法发现了一座巨大的宝库，远超他们的预期。

src: Our defensive actions at Ufa could not stop the Red Army for a long time, and when they received fresh units from the west they resumed their counteroffensive. Their next objectives were Perm and Ekaterinburg, where they had murdered the Tzar and his family in 1918. This time the High Command ordered us to stay there, acting as reserve troops.
dst: 我们在乌法的防御行动没能长时间挡住红军，当他们从西面获得生力军后，便恢复了反攻。他们的下一个目标是彼尔姆和叶卡捷琳堡——1918年他们就在那里杀害了沙皇及其家人。这一次，最高统帅部命令我们留在那里，充当预备队。

src: Our division (Ariete) and our Corps (XX) recon forces are stationed around Bir El Gubi to cover the planned attack on Tobruk. The rookie British 22th Armoured Brigade seems to be under the impression that they can whipe us from the battle field. It is your task to prove them wrong.
dst: 我们的师（“公羊”）和我们的军（第20军）的侦察部队驻扎在比尔埃尔古比周围，以为计划中对托布鲁克的进攻提供掩护。初出茅庐的英国第22装甲旅似乎以为他们能把我们从战场上抹掉。你的任务就是证明他们错了。

src: Our division has now been fully withdrawn from Russia to Montauban/Toulouse in France and is renamed to SS Panzer Division "Das Reich". Our main concern is the large number of fresh troops (9000) in Das Reich - we even had to accept conscripts to fill our ranks.
dst: 我们师现已全部从俄国撤出，调往法国的蒙托邦／图卢兹，并改称党卫军“帝国”装甲师。我们最担心的是“帝国”师里数量庞大的新兵（9000人）——我们甚至不得不接收征召兵来补足编制。

src: Our drive from Oslo to Lillehammer was completely stalled!  This along with the terrible Kriegsmarine losses at Narvick the Norwegians are sure to hang on another month or two.
dst: 我们从奥斯陆向利勒哈默尔的推进彻底停滞了！加上海军在纳尔维克的惨重损失，挪威人肯定还能再撑一两个月。

src: Our drive from Oslo to Lillehammer went as we expected, and soon the Norwegian Government should capitulate!
dst: 我们从奥斯陆向利勒哈默尔的推进正如预期，挪威政府很快应当投降！

src: Our drive from Oslo to Lillehammer went more quickly than expected, the Norwegians are already asking for terms!
dst: 我们从奥斯陆向利勒哈默尔的推进比预期更快，挪威人已经在求和了！

src: Our drive from Oslo to Lillehammer went much slower than expected, but with the success of the German forces at Narvick the Norwegians are sure to capitulate.
dst: 我们从奥斯陆向利勒哈默尔的推进比预期慢得多，但随着德军在纳尔维克的成功，挪威人必定投降。

src: Our efforts in Albania are too late to subdue Greeks before the Germans are sure to arrive.  However, what we loose in Greece we shall gain in Yugoslavia.
dst: 我们在阿尔巴尼亚的努力为时已晚，赶不上在德军必定抵达之前制服希腊人了。然而，我们在希腊失去的，将在南斯拉夫补回来。

src: Our encircled units in the Falaise pocket must raise the blockade and connect with the rest of our units.
dst: 我部在法莱斯口袋中被合围的部队必须突破封锁，与主力会合。

src: Our enemies are simply too powerful. There are too many of them. It was foolish to believe that we could fight against five military powers at the same time. It was madness. We did everything we could, we did our best, and we really were so close... we touched victory with our fingertips. But, at the last second, victory ran away from us.
dst: 我们的敌人实在太强大了。他们人数太多。以为我们能同时与五个军事强国作战，这太愚蠢了。那简直是疯狂。我们做了能做的一切，尽了全力，而且我们真的离胜利那么近……指尖都已触到了胜利。然而，就在最后一刻，胜利从我们手中溜走了。

src: Our enemies are simply too powerful. There are too many of them. It was foolish to believe that we could fight against five military powers at the same time. It was madness. We did everything we could, we did our best, and we really were so close... we touched victory with our fingertips. But, at the last second, victory ran away from us. We have thrown everything we had against the Entente lines, and they resisted. Now we have nothing left.
dst: 我们的敌人实在太强大了。他们数量太多了。相信我们能同时与五个军事强国作战，实在太愚蠢。那简直是疯狂。我们尽了全力，做到了最好，而且我们真的曾经如此接近……胜利几乎触手可及。但就在最后一刻，胜利从我们指缝间溜走了。我们把所拥有的一切都砸向了协约国战线，他们却挺住了。如今我们已一无所有。

src: Our enemies know all of this, and three French divisions, along with the Serbian Second Army, are preparing their final assault on Macedonia. They have gathered massive amounts of artillery and soon they will attack our defences. If they break them, it will be the end: they will force us to sue for peace.
dst: 我们的敌人对此一清二楚，三个法国师连同塞尔维亚第二集团军正在准备对马其顿发动最后突击。他们集结了海量火炮，很快就要进攻我们的防线。一旦防线被突破，一切都完了：他们将迫使我们求和。

src: Our enemies know this, and that's the reason why five veteran enemy divisions stand on our way to Moscow here, in Orel. Fear not. It's because they're afraid of us. They know that if they sent into battle their militias we'd be in Tula before the end of the week, and in Moscow before the end of the month. The Reds are on the verge of panic, so they've decided to throw their best units into us. This battle, and the next that will come, are going to be hard, but don't forget this: They're playing their last cards. Soon they'll be exhausted, and victory will be ours.
dst: 我们的敌人深知这一点，正因如此，五个经验丰富的敌军师在奥廖尔挡住了我们通往莫斯科的道路。不必害怕。那是因为他们怕我们。他们知道，若把自己的民兵投入战斗，我们本周结束前就能打到图拉，月底前就能抵达莫斯科。红军已濒于恐慌，所以他们决定把最精锐的部队投入对付我们。这场战斗以及随后的战斗都会很艰难，但别忘了这一点：他们正在打出最后的牌。很快他们就会筋疲力尽，胜利将属于我们。

src: Our enemies still have a strong and motivated army, but don't worry. In the next days many fresh divisions will join our forces, including a large number of tanks. Use them wisely.
dst: 我们的敌人仍拥有一支强大而士气高昂的军队，但别担心。未来几天，将有许多新锐师加入我们的部队，包括大量坦克。请善加运用。

src: Our enemies were still too strong, so we couldn't fully exploit our victory. We waited in Chelyabinsk until the Soviets came again, and then we withdrew our troops deeper into Siberia. We knew that they were suffering much more than us and that, if we kept on winning defensive battles and strategic counterattacks, sooner or later we'd have a chance for a decisive victory.
dst: 敌人仍然太强大，所以我们无法充分利用这场胜利。我们待在车里雅宾斯克，直到苏维埃再次来犯，随后把部队撤向西伯利亚腹地。我们知道，他们遭受的损失远大于我们，只要我们不断打赢防御战和战略反攻，迟早会迎来决定性胜利的机会。

src: Our enemy is beaten, Caesar very satisfied!
dst: 敌人已被击败，凯撒非常满意！

src: Our explorers confirm our worst fears. The defences of Ekaterinodar are strong and the communists outnumber us at least three to one. However, Kornilov is determined to attack. The Bolsheviks are growing stronger every day and if we leave they'll eventually find us and crush us. The general knows that a frontal attack would be suicidal, so he has ordered a flanking maneuver on Elizabetinskaya. That could surprise the Reds and, with the help of a handful of Cossacks that have joined us, might give us a chance.
dst: 我们的侦察兵证实了最坏的担忧。叶卡捷琳诺达尔的防御很坚固，共产党人的兵力至少是我们的三倍。然而，科尔尼洛夫决心进攻。布尔什维克一天天壮大，如果我们离开，他们最终会找到并消灭我们。将军知道正面进攻无异于自杀，因此他下令向叶利扎韦京斯卡亚实施侧翼机动。这或许能出其不意地打击红军，再加上加入我们的一小批哥萨克的帮助，也许会给我们一线机会。

src: Our first action in Russia has been a success.  We were able to come to the aid of 13th Panzer Division and defeat the Russian armoured counter-attacks.  We will now continue to advance in support of 13th Panzer Division towards Zhitomir.
dst: 我们在俄国的首次行动取得了成功。我们得以驰援第13装甲师，并击退了俄军的装甲反攻。现在我们将继续推进，配合第13装甲师向日托米尔进发。

src: Our first big offensive was a fail. Maybe because you are a fail. In the future we will work together with more talented generals.
dst: 我们的第一次大攻势失败了。也许是因为你是个失败者。今后我们将与更有才华的将军合作。

src: Our first opportunity to react came in December 1895, when we attacked one the forward Italian positions, at the mountain of Amba Alagi. Due to its isolated location, it would be difficult for our enemies to send any reinforcements, so if we were fast, we could overcome the Italian defenders.
dst: 我们的第一个反击机会出现在1895年12月，当时我们进攻了意大利人位于安巴阿拉吉山的一处前沿阵地。由于该地位置孤立，敌人很难派出任何援军，所以只要我们动作迅速，就能击败意大利守军。

src: Our fleet is approaching to attack Malta from the north and southwest, while the Italian fleet approach to attack too.
dst: 我方舰队正从北面和西南面逼近马耳他发起进攻，意大利舰队也同时逼近进攻。

src: Our foothold on English soil is still tenuous.
dst: 我们在英格兰土地的立足点仍岌岌可危。

src: Our forces are severely depleted, and thus our battalion doesn't fight as a cohesive unit. Instead our companies are spread across several sectors. Lead the attack, knock out the enemy heavy tanks, and try to unite the whole battalion once possible.
dst: 我军兵力损耗严重，因此我们营并非作为整体作战，而是各连分散在数个地段。率队进攻，击毁敌军重型坦克，并在可能时设法把全营重新集结起来。

src: Our forces in Sevastopol could not stop the fascist attack, despite you reinforcing them. The enemy has lead enormous numbers of men in their however. At the moment they are clearing the last streets of the city of Sevastopol. Luckily your core could make it on time out of the besieged city, to the ports where the Black Sea Fleet will transport you back to a Caucasus port.
dst: 尽管你增援了塞瓦斯托波尔，我们的部队还是没能挡住法西斯的进攻。敌人投入了数量庞大的兵力。此刻他们正在肃清塞瓦斯托波尔城最后的街道。幸运的是，你的核心部队及时撤出了被围的城市，抵达港口，黑海舰队将把你们运回高加索的某个港口。

src: Our forces in the Jassy bridgehead are problaby outnumbered and lack supplies and manpower at the moment. The Germans are depending on the worn out Rumanians to have sufficient manpower. They will try to eliminate our bridgehead as long as this situation continues. You are ordered to hold the bridgehead and repel any fascist counterattack. You are permitted to withdraw to a smaller perimeter but in the end we must have a position on the other side of the Prut River! Watch out for the enemy Panther and Tiger tanks. Good luck, comrade!
dst: 我们在雅西桥头堡的部队目前可能寡不敌众，且缺乏补给和人力。德军正依靠疲惫不堪的罗马尼亚人来凑足人力。只要这种局面持续，他们就会试图拔除我们的桥头堡。你奉命守住桥头堡，击退法西斯的任何反扑。允许你收缩到更小的外围，但最终我们必须在普鲁特河对岸保住一个阵地！当心敌人的黑豹和虎式坦克。祝你好运，同志！

src: Our forces might run of fuel and ammo before they reach Sevastopol, because of the distances traveled. Also non-motorized units are still on their way to the front. So expect them to arrive anytime. Moskva accepts no delay in taking the city, so you have orders to attack immediately. We are unsure if the enemy is trying to hold the city or to evactuate their forces. Because of the last option, you must attack quick and kill as many fascists as possible so the Crimea is once again free and liberated! Good luck, comrade.
dst: 由于长途行军，我们的部队可能在抵达塞瓦斯托波尔之前耗尽燃料和弹药。非摩托化部队也还在赶往前线的路上。所以随时可能抵达。莫斯科绝不容许夺取该城有任何延误，因此你奉命立即进攻。我们不确定敌人是想守住城市还是撤走部队。考虑到后一种可能，你必须快速进攻，尽可能多地消灭法西斯，让克里米亚重获自由和解放！祝你好运，同志。

src: Our forces were not able to reach Urmia in time to assist the revolting Armenians.  The civillian population has suffered tremendously:  47,000 Armenian and Assyro-Chaldeans have been murdered as the revolt was put down by the Ottoman Jandarma forces.
dst: 我们的部队未能及时抵达乌尔米耶援助起义的亚美尼亚人。平民蒙受了巨大苦难：起义被奥斯曼宪兵部队镇压，47000名亚美尼亚人和亚述—迦勒底人被杀害。

src: Our forces were rebuffed as the Germans withdrew taking thousands of Italian POW's with them.
dst: 我们的部队被击退了，德军撤退时还掳走了数千名意大利战俘。

src: Our forces were swamped by the Russians hordes from the south!
dst: 我们的部队被来自南面的俄国人海淹没了！

src: Our forces which should unite with your troops at Winston-Salem could not achieve its goals! Strong enemy forces threatened theirs northern flank. Most of the motorized units was removed from the attack to catch the enemy's move. The infantry was not strong enough to continue the attack alone and had to change into defense in unfavorable terrain.
dst: 本应在温斯顿-塞勒姆与你的部队会合的我军，未能达成目标！强大的敌军威胁着他们的北翼。大部分摩托化部队被从进攻中撤出，用以应对敌人的行动。步兵实力不足以单独继续进攻，只得在不利地形上转入防御。

src: Our garrisons, poorly equipped and scattered all over the Protectorate, are in extreme danger, since a general Berber attack would make them fall one by one, causing a massacre. The danger is specially critical in the western part of the Protectorate.
dst: 我们的驻军装备简陋，又分散在保护国各地，处境极其危险，因为柏柏尔人的总攻会让他们一个接一个地陷落，酿成一场屠杀。保护国西部的危险尤为严重。

src: Our glorious leader has not listened to your request for deployment in Yugoslavia to fight the fascists. You and your comrades have been fighting on the coasts of the Black Sea for over four years. They deserve rest and will not be called upon during this war again. And you, comrade, you will get a nice villa in the Crimea with view on your beloved Black Sea.
dst: 我们伟大领袖没有批准你前往南斯拉夫打击法西斯的请求。你和你的同志们已经在黑海沿岸战斗了四年多。他们理应休息，在这场战争中不会再被征召。而你，同志，你将在克里米亚得到一栋漂亮的别墅，可以眺望你心爱的黑海。

src: Our gods are stronger than theirs!
dst: 我们的神比他们的更强！

src: Our great success hung op at the  first line of the faschists. Many soldiers find a pointless death. For further operations amateurs like you are useless.
dst: 我们的大好战果就断送在法西斯分子的第一道防线上。许多士兵毫无意义地死去。执行后续作战任务，像你这样的外行毫无用处。

src: Our guerrila attacks have been extremely successful, but the British have found a way to force us to surrender: burning our farms, shooting our cattle and sending our women and children to concentration camps where they'll die of starvation. They want us to know that If we don't give up they'll destroy everything we love.
dst: 我们的游击战取得了极大成功，但英军找到了逼迫我们投降的办法：烧毁我们的农庄，枪杀我们的牲畜，并把我们的妇女儿童送进集中营，让他们活活饿死。他们想让我们明白，如果我们不放弃，他们就会摧毁我们所珍爱的一切。

src: Our hope to avoid a war with the USA or at least to delaying are shattered. The Japanese have opened hostilities against the U.S. in the Pacific. Despite our great successes, the year 1941 comes to an end with mixed feelings. In the east the Soviets, tattered but not defeated, and in the west the superpower USA. The task now is to use the winter to prepare for the spring offensive, which must bring the decision in the East!
dst: 我们避免与美国开战、或至少推迟的希望破灭了。日本人在太平洋对美国开战。尽管我们取得了巨大成功，1941年还是在复杂的心情中走到尽头。东面，苏联人被打得破破烂烂却未被打败；西面，是超级大国美国。眼下的任务是利用冬天为春季攻势做准备，这场攻势必须带来东线的决定性胜利！

src: Our industry is crumbling, we are desperately short on oil, our transport network is falling apart and our cities are in ruins. The war is lost. After you beat their previous attempt in April, the Western Allies have now crossed the Rhein and are on route to Berlin.
dst: 我们的工业正在崩溃，石油极度短缺，运输网络正在瓦解，城市一片废墟。这场战争已经输了。在你于4月粉碎了他们上一次企图之后，西方盟国如今已渡过莱茵河，正向柏林推进。

src: Our intelligence indicates that the Allies are planning an invasion of Europe early this summer. Therefore the High Command signed the peace with the Bolsheviks so we can prepare for the pending invasion. You are to be transferred to the Western Front, where you will help defend Fortress Europe against an Allied invasion.
dst: 我们的情报显示，盟军正计划在今年初夏入侵欧洲。因此最高统帅部与布尔什维克签订了和约，以便我们为即将到来的入侵做好准备。你将被调往西线，在那里协助保卫欧洲堡垒，抵御盟军的入侵。

src: Our intelligence report the possibility of Soviet Counterattacks so please be prepared for all eventualities
dst: 我方情报显示苏军有可能发动反击，请做好应对一切情况的准备。

src: Our intelligence reports that the Bolshevik leader Stalin has fled Moscow and is reportedly barricaded in the city of Kazan.  Most of the remaining high-grade Bolshevik troops are also in the Kazan region.  Meanwhile Bolshevik troops elsewhere are beginning to surrender.  Herr Feldmarschall, a quick victory here, especially if you capture Stalin, should lead to the Bolshevik's surrender and end this war!
dst: 我们的情报显示，布尔什维克领袖斯大林已逃离莫斯科，据报正困守喀山城。布尔什维克剩余的大部分精锐部队也都在喀山地区。与此同时，其他地方的布尔什维克部队开始投降。元帅阁下，此处的一场速胜——尤其是如果您能俘获斯大林——应当会促成布尔什维克投降，结束这场战争！

src: Our intelligence system has warned us that one of those attacks is going to take place very soon here, at Neuve-Chapelle. Four British divisions, including some of their colonial forces, are ready to storm your positions. You've repelled similar attacks in Elsass last year, so we count on you to stop the British. Good luck!
dst: 我们的情报系统已警告我们，其中一次这样的进攻很快就要发生在这里，就在新沙佩勒。四个英军师，包括他们的一些殖民部队，已准备好猛攻您的阵地。您去年在阿尔萨斯击退过类似的进攻，所以我们指望您来挡住英军。祝您好运！

src: Our invasion of Serbia has failed. Our men are retreating, and in a few hours all of them will have crossed the Drina again. At least we've been able to save most of our soldiers and of our equipment.
dst: 我们对塞尔维亚的入侵失败了。我们的士兵正在撤退，几小时后他们将全部再次渡过德里纳河。至少我们保住了大部分士兵与装备。

src: Our invasion of Serbia has failed. Our men are retreating, and in a few hours all of them will have crossed the Drina again. This has been one of the worst defeats in the history of Austria or Hungary.
dst: 我们对塞尔维亚的入侵失败了。我们的士兵正在撤退，几小时后他们将全部再次渡过德里纳河。这是奥地利或匈牙利历史上最惨重的失败之一。

src: Our job here is done. We must return to Verdun immediately, for the French are planning another offensive on the Meuse, and we'll play a very important role in it.
dst: 我们在这里的任务已经完成。我们必须立即返回凡尔登，因为法国人正策划在默兹河发动另一次攻势，而我们将在其中扮演非常重要的角色。

src: Our landing has been successful, General! The troops came ashore, overrun the surprised enemy and even reached the high ground of Tekke Tepe. Unfortunately, the Turks have responded quickly and we had to retreat from the heights when two new Turkish divisions appeared on the scene.
dst: 我们的登陆成功了，将军！部队登上海岸，击溃了措手不及的敌人，甚至攻上了特克山的制高点。遗憾的是，土耳其人反应迅速，当两个新的土耳其师出现时，我们不得不从高地撤退。

src: Our landings on the island have been successful so far, although the American sector had to fight off a fierce counter-attack by a German Panzer Division.  In our sector we have quickly taken the port of Syracuse and we have also taken Augusta.  We can therefore begin our advance to Messina, and you will be at the very head of our column.  For a rapid advance to Messina we need to secure the important Primasole bridge south of Catania, and the port of Catania itself.
dst: 我们在岛上的登陆迄今还算成功，虽然美军地段不得不击退一个德国装甲师的猛烈反攻。在我们地段，我们已迅速拿下锡拉库萨港，还夺取了奥古斯塔。因此我们可以开始向墨西拿推进，而你将处于纵队的最前列。为快速推进到墨西拿，我们需要夺取卡塔尼亚以南重要的普里马索莱桥，以及卡塔尼亚港本身。

src: Our last bastion remains in Crimea. Denikin has decided to evacuate as many people as possible there, in order to make a last stand. We've got enough ships, so the evacuation isn't a problem, but someone will have to defend the mountain passes, fighting the Bolsheviks and giving the others enough time to travel safely to Crimea. And that's what Denikin has ordered me to do.
dst: 我们最后的堡垒仍在克里米亚。邓尼金决定把尽可能多的人撤到那里，做最后一搏。我们有足够的船只，所以撤离不成问题，但总得有人防守山口，与布尔什维克作战，为其他人争取安全撤往克里米亚的时间。这正是邓尼金命令我去做的事。

src: Our latest information suggests that Gaza is held by only 4,000 troops under the command of Tala Bey, and  the enemy's closest support is at Hareira, ten miles to the south-east. Against this force we will be able to field about 22,000 rifles. With this advantage in numbers and mobility, the prospect of successfully rushing Gaza before Turkish reinforcements could arrive appears exceedingly good.
dst: 我们最新情报显示，加沙仅有4000名守军，由塔拉贝伊指挥，而敌军最近的援军在东南方十英里外的哈赖拉。面对这支敌军，我们将能投入约22000支步枪。凭借这样的人数和机动优势，在土耳其援军到来之前一举攻克加沙的前景显得极为乐观。

src: Our left flank - the 4th Ersatz Division, the 37th Landwehr Brigade and the 1st Bavarian Landwehr Brigade - is moving West and North on Dendermonde and Lokeren to prevent the Belgian Army retreating to Gent where Uhlanen have spotted French and British troops that have come to the aid of the Belgians.
dst: 我们的左翼——第四替补师、第三十七国土旅和第一巴伐利亚国土旅——正向西、向北朝登德尔蒙德和洛克伦推进，以防比利时军队撤往根特；在那里，枪骑兵已发现赶来援助比利时人的法国和英国军队。

src: Our lines have resisted. The British are going back to their starting positions. Loos will be remembered forever as a German defensive victory.
dst: 我们的防线顶住了。英军正退回他们的出发阵地。卢斯将永远作为德军的一场防御胜利而被铭记。

src: Our lines have resisted. The Italians haven't been able to occupy the Isonzo valley, and we'll be safe for a while. Congratulations, General.
dst: 我们的防线守住了。意大利人未能占领伊松佐河谷，我们能安稳一阵子了。恭喜您，将军。

src: Our losses are enormous, but you forced this contemptible little army to retreat south. Continue your advance!
dst: 我方的损失极其惨重，但您迫使这支可鄙的小军队向南撤退。继续前进！

src: Our losses are enourmous, but you forced this contemptible little army to retreat south. Continue your advance!
dst: 我方的损失极其惨重，但您迫使这支可鄙的小军队向南撤退。继续前进！

src: Our losses are more than considerable, but you forced this contemptible little army to retreat south. Continue your advance!
dst: 我方的损失相当惨重，但您迫使这支可鄙的小军队向南撤退。继续前进！

src: Our losses have been appaling, but due to your great resolution we finally overcame the Turkish redoubts. Nevertheless, this attack again ended as a great failure. The force at Gaza itself were much too strong to wage an assault against the city, and our forces have been weakened too much, so we can't hold our line against a possible Turkish counter-attack. So retreat to our starting positions is the reasonable choice.
dst: 我们的损失惨重，但凭着您的坚定决心，我们最终攻克了土耳其人的多面堡。然而，这次进攻再次以重大失败告终。加沙本身的守军过于强大，无法对这座城市发动突击，而我们的部队已被削弱得太厉害，因此无法守住战线以抵御土耳其人可能发动的反击。所以，撤退到出发阵地是明智的选择。

src: Our losses have been appaling. The Turkish redoubts proved to be too strong, and this attack again ended as a great failure.  Our forces have been weakened too much, so we can't hold our line against a possible Turkish counter-attack. So retreat to our starting positions is the reasonable choice.
dst: 我们的伤亡骇人听闻。土耳其人的多面堡过于坚固，这次进攻再次以惨败告终。我军已被削弱太多，无法抵挡土耳其人可能发动的反攻。因此，撤回出发阵地是明智的选择。

src: Our main objective will be the holy town of Xauen, a religious center for the Moroccan people. The taking of Xauen by the Spanish army will be a great blow for the morale of the rebels and for El Raisuli's prestige and our victory in Morocco will be much closer.
dst: 我们的主要目标将是圣城沙温，它是摩洛哥人民的一个宗教中心。西班牙军队攻占沙温，将对叛军的士气和赖苏利的威望构成沉重打击，我们在摩洛哥的胜利也将近在眼前。

src: Our main target in North Africa, the Suez Canal is in range! With this strategic point in our hands, Gibraltar too, Malta and Cyprus loyal to the new British king, our main objectives in the Mediterranean are achieved. However, you must act quickly, agents report that the enemy prepare the scuttling of merchant ships to make the canal for a long time impassable. It can be assumed that the Commonwealth troops will defend Port Said - a French Brigade and parts of a Indian Division staying in this area.
dst: 我们在北非的主要目标——苏伊士运河——已近在咫尺！这个战略要地一旦在手，再加上忠于新英王的直布罗陀、马耳他和塞浦路斯，我们在地中海的主要目标就都达成了。然而，你必须迅速行动，特工报告敌人正准备凿沉商船，使运河长期无法通航。可以想见，英联邦部队会防守塞得港——一个法国旅和印度师的一部分驻扎在这一带。

src: Our men are joyous and some are already celebrating victory. But I fear there is still some hard fighting in front of us. I don't have time for a long letter, they put us in railroad cars and some of us had to board ships in order to steam upriver. I hope, that the war will be over when you receive my next letter!
dst: 我们的士兵兴高采烈，有些人已经在庆祝胜利了。但我担心前面还有硬仗要打。我没时间写长信，他们把我们塞进了火车车厢，有些人还得上船溯流而上。我希望您收到我下一封信时，战争已经结束了！

src: Our men at first, while their strength was fresh, resisted bravely, nor did they cast any weapon ineffectually from their higher station. As soon as any part of the camp, being destitute of defenders, seemed to be hard pressed, thither they ran, and brought assistance.
dst: 我军起初体力尚新，英勇抵抗，从高处投出的武器没有一发落空。营中哪一处守兵不足、显得吃紧，他们就奔往那里增援。

src: Our men fought bravely, General! We have captured some of the Turkish trenches, but this ground could only be gained by ghastly sacrifice. It looks like we're getting into a stalemate position here at Cape Helles. I think there's no chance for us to break the Turkish lines at Krithia...
dst: 我们的将士打得很英勇，将军！我们夺取了土耳其人的一些战壕，但这些土地只有靠惨重的牺牲才能换来。看来我们在海勒斯角陷入了僵局。我认为我们没有机会在克里希亚突破土耳其人的防线了……

src: Our militaries will steamroll the Russkies.This field campaign will be  finished in six weeks.
dst: 我军将碾碎俄国人。这场战役将在六周内结束。

src: Our mobile reserves consist of 2 Panzer battalions. The German 5th Panzer Regiment has been reduced by the spring fighting and mechanical losses, the 8th Panzer Regiment due to mechanical and shipping losses. Rather than spreading the remaining vehicles thinly to keep all four German Panzer battalions operational, Rommel has chosen to keep two full strength battalions and disband the other two until repaired vehicles become available.
dst: 我们的机动预备队由2个装甲营组成。德国第5装甲团因春季作战和机械损耗而减员，第8装甲团则因机械和运输损失而减员。隆美尔没有把剩余车辆摊薄来维持德军4个装甲营都能作战，而是选择保留两个满编营，把另外两个解散，等有修复的车辆再说。

src: Our nation never accepted the Treaty of Trianon when we lost 2/3 of our territories and population. 3 million ethnic Hungarians live outside the borders. We claim all territories we lost in 1920 and hopefully we can regain a significant part of them with the support of our allied friend, Germany. When we will be strong enough, we can start a crusade against our arch enemy, the bolsheviks.
dst: 我们国家从未接受《特里亚农条约》，当时我们失去了三分之二的领土和人口。有300万匈牙利族人生活在边界之外。我们要求收回1920年失去的全部领土，并希望在我们的盟友德国的支持下夺回其中相当大的一部分。当我们足够强大时，就能对我们的宿敌布尔什维克发起一场讨伐。

src: Our native scouts have told us that the defences of Nyangwe are quite weak, since most of the Arabs have entrenched themselves on the other shore of the river. We can't let an enemy fortified position behind our backs, so you'll have to storm the Arab defences, too. Good luck!
dst: 我们的本地斥候告诉我们，尼扬圭的防御相当薄弱，因为大部分阿拉伯人都在河对岸构筑了工事。我们不能让一个设防的敌军阵地留在我们背后，所以您也必须强攻阿拉伯人的防线。祝您好运！

src: Our new Chief of the General Staff, Colonel-General Erich von Falkenhayn, has decided that the war can be won in Flanders. He has made a plan consisting of three operations to achieve victory:
dst: 我新任总参谋长、上将埃里希·冯·法尔肯海因断定，战争可以在佛兰德取胜。他制定了一个由三项行动组成的制胜计划：

src: Our new operation to break the Allied offensive by driving to Avranches and destroying their forces has started on time, but with fewer troops than expected. Both the 116 (PzLehr) and the 1SS (LSSAH) have problems reaching the front. The attack has started with the 2Pz in the North and our division reinforced with a KG of the 17SS (Goetz von Berlichingen) in the South. Opposite us is the US 30ID which is putting up a stubborn defense.
dst: 我们为粉碎盟军攻势而发起的新行动——向阿夫朗什突进并歼灭其兵力——已按时开始，但兵力比预期少。第116装甲师（装甲教导）和党卫军第1师（警卫旗队）都难以抵达前线。进攻由北面的第2装甲师和我方在南面、得到党卫军第17师（“格茨·冯·贝利欣根”）一个战斗群加强的师发起。与我们相对的是美军第30步兵师，正在顽强抵抗。

src: Our next destination is Korea and, Commander, your services are needed there.
dst: 我们的下一个目的地是朝鲜，指挥官，那里需要您效力。

src: Our next target will be the city of Minsk Litewski which is the capital of Bialorus. You will lead forces striking south and cutting off the Red Army units. These units should be destroyed by our forces from Wielkopolska and our Bialorussian allies from 1st Dywizja Litewsko-Bialoruska.
dst: 我们的下一个目标将是明斯克-立陶宛斯基城，即白俄罗斯的首都。您将率部队向南突击，切断红军各部。这些部队应由我们来自大波兰的部队和我们来自立陶宛-白俄罗斯第1师的白俄罗斯盟友加以歼灭。

src: Our objective is Alexandria, the great port of Egypt.  With Alexandria in our possession supply will cease to be a problem.  The British are present in great strength and strongly entrenched, but your past performance indicates that you should be able to overcome them.  They will be supported by the remnants of the British armor, and resupplied British aviation.  Our intelligence report that the Russians are planning a major offensive in the Kursk region so you must achieve your objectives quickly as we might need you elsewhere after we have dealt a final blow to the British.
dst: 我们的目标是埃及的大港亚历山大。一旦握有该港，补给便不再是问题。英军兵力雄厚且工事坚固，但依您此前的战绩，当能克敌制胜。他们将得到英军装甲部队残部的支援，以及补充完毕的英国航空兵。我方情报显示，俄军正筹划在库尔斯克地区发动大规模攻势，因此您必须迅速达成目标——在给英国人以致命一击后，我们可能还要调您转赴他处。

src: Our objective is Alexandria, the great port of Egypt.  With Alexandria in our possession supply will cease to be a problem.  The British are present in great strength and strongly entrenched, but your past performance indicates that you should be able to overcome them.  They will be supported by the remnants of the British armor, and resupplied British aviation.  The Russians have begun a major offensive in the Kursk region so you must achieve your objectives quickly.
dst: 我们的目标是亚历山大——埃及的大港。亚历山大一旦落入我们手中，补给将不再是问题。英军兵力雄厚且工事坚固，但您以往的表现表明您应当能够战胜他们。他们将得到英军残余装甲部队的支援，并得到重建补充的英国航空兵的补给。俄军已在库尔斯克地区发起大规模攻势，因此您必须迅速达成目标。

src: Our offensive brokes down in the same way like the German offensive once. Before the allied troops can force back our troops to the border of the German Reich we believe we have to appoint a new general.
dst: 我们的攻势像当年的德军攻势一样瓦解了。在盟军部队把我们的部队逼回德意志帝国边界之前，我们认为必须任命一位新的将军。

src: Our offensive has been a complete success with the Germans falling back all along the line and agreeing finally to sign an Armistace to end this slaughter!! well done Commander, Enjoy your retirement!!!
dst: 我们的攻势取得了彻底的成功，德军全线后撤，并最终同意签署停战协定以结束这场屠杀！！干得好，指挥官，好好享受退役生活吧！！！

src: Our offensive has failed with great loss of life and the Germans have counter-attacked and forced us to sign a cease fire!! You are relieved of your command!!
dst: 我们的攻势失败了，伤亡惨重，德国人发起反攻，迫使我们签订了停火协议！！您已被解除指挥权！！

src: Our offensive has stalled. Two Russian armies are approaching. Your division has been chosen to relieve the KuK 1st Armee
dst: 我军攻势已停滞。两支俄国集团军正在逼近。您的师被选中去解救奥匈第1集团军。

src: Our offensive started on June 23rd. After some heavy fighting our troops took Torgovaya, on the Tsaritsyn-Ekaterinodar railroad, cutting the enemy's communications with Northern Russia. Alas, we had to pay a heavy price for that victory. Many brave soldiers were injured or died, among them the General Markov. The survivors are exhausted and need a relief.
dst: 我们的攻势于6月23日开始。经过一番激战，我军占领了察里津—叶卡捷琳诺达尔铁路线上的托尔戈瓦亚，切断了敌人与俄国北方的联系。唉，我们为这场胜利付出了沉重代价。许多勇敢的士兵负伤或阵亡，其中包括马尔科夫将军。幸存者已筋疲力尽，需要休整。

src: Our offensive was a great success. We could not only free Belorussia, but push forward to the Vistula. Stalin has confer a decoration on you.
dst: 我们的攻势取得了巨大成功。我们不仅解放了白俄罗斯，还推进到了维斯瓦河。斯大林授予了你一枚勋章。

src: Our offensive was blighted. The war is over. We have to bear with the betrayal of the west allied.
dst: 我们的攻势受挫。战争结束了。我们必须承受西方盟军的背叛。

src: Our offensive will have two infiltration points. While the Bulgarians and the Germans attack the Franco-Serbian sector in Bitola, you'll lead the assault against the Greek-British forces at the Dojransee and open the road to Thessaloniki.
dst: 我们的攻势将有两个渗透点。当保加利亚人和德国人进攻比托拉的法国-塞尔维亚防区时，您将率领部队在杜伊兰湖向希腊-英国联军发起进攻，打开通往塞萨洛尼基的道路。

src: Our old enemies the Teutons once again invaded pillaging our tribal territory!
dst: 我们的宿敌条顿人又一次入侵，在我们的部族领地上烧杀掳掠！

src: Our old enemy, the best Roman general, Pompey Magnus, has managed to embark some Veteran legions from Spain .....
dst: 我们的宿敌、罗马最出色的将领庞培马格努斯，已设法从西班牙装船运走了一些老兵军团 .....

src: Our opening assault has been a great success.  We have crossed the River Prosna and can continue our advance towards Lodz.
dst: 我们的开局突击大获成功。我们已渡过普罗斯纳河，可继续向罗兹推进。

src: Our original orders were to defend our own railway connections and to destroy the enemy ones...
dst: 我们最初的命令是保卫我们自己的铁路交通线，并摧毁敌人的铁路线……

src: Our own intelligence has detected another major Soviet winter offensive directed at our own Italian 8th Army.  We must hold the line to allow Manstein's 4th Panzer Army to continue to push to link with the trapped 6th Army.
dst: 我方情报侦测到，苏军又一次针对我意大利第8集团军发动大规模冬季攻势。我们必须守住战线，好让曼施泰因的第4装甲集团军继续推进，与被困的第6集团军会合。

src: Our own support consists of scattered remains of several infantry garrisons, some Waffen-SS and Fallschirmjägers veterans and a completely outnumbered Luftwaffe pilots flying obsolete planes. Please note that there's a V1 instalment in our vicinity, so don't let this wonder weapon fall into the enemy hands.
dst: 我们自己的支援，仅有几处步兵守军的残部、一些武装党卫军与空降猎兵的老兵，以及数量完全处于劣势、驾驶老旧飞机的德国空军飞行员。请注意，我部附近有一处 V1 发射装置，切勿让这件神奇武器落入敌手。

src: Our plan consisted in attacking Saratov from three sides. We would come from the north, a small group of cossacks from the east, and part of Denikin's forces from the south. They were commanded by Baron Piotr Wrangel, one of the best generals of the AFSR. It was unlikely that the Soviets could stop us.
dst: 我们的计划是从三个方向进攻萨拉托夫。我们从北方进攻，一小队哥萨克从东方进攻，邓尼金的部分部队从南方进攻。他们由南俄武装力量最优秀的将领之一、皮奥特·弗兰格尔男爵指挥。苏维埃要阻止我们是不太可能的。

src: Our plan is simple, in fact: supported by our artillery, our troops will advance against the weakened German positions, opening gaps in their lines that we can widen when our reinforces relieve the first line units. Once we overcome the German defences, we'll be able to retake Gent and Ostende. But that will be the next step of our operation. Right now, your goal will be taking and holding Houthulst, Staden and Roeselare. When you do it, the German defences will be completely destroyed and nothing will be able to stop us.
dst: 其实我们的计划很简单：在我方炮火支援下，我们的部队将向被削弱的德军阵地推进，在他们的防线上撕开缺口，等我们的援军接替第一线部队后就能扩大这些缺口。一旦我们突破德军的防御，就能重新夺回根特和奥斯坦德。但那将是我们行动的下一步。眼下，您的目标将是攻取并守住豪特胡尔斯特、斯塔登和鲁瑟拉勒。当您做到这一点时，德军的防御将被彻底摧毁，什么也无法阻挡我们。

src: Our plan to disrupt the Canal traffic and to liberate Misir has failed due to the enemy superiority. British counterattacks drove us back into the desert, and we have had to start a withdrawal across the Sinai to Beersheba. At the moment we don't have the means to repet the counterattack, so we have to focus on other goals.
dst: 我们扰乱运河航运、解放埃及的计划因敌人的优势而失败了。英军的反攻把我们赶回了沙漠，我们不得不开始经西奈向贝尔谢巴撤退。眼下我们没有能力击退这次反攻，所以只能把精力转向其他目标。

src: Our plan was ambitious, but your execution was poor and unimaginative. Nothing has changed at the Alpine Front, and we’ve wasted lots of men, resources, and time. Soon, the Americans will be ready to fight in France, and we’ve achieved nothing in Italy. Nothing. We need some changes, herr Oberst. New commanders who can respond efficiently to these new challenges. Please resign and give way to them.
dst: 我们的计划雄心勃勃，但您的执行既拙劣又缺乏想象力。阿尔卑斯战线上一切照旧，我们白白浪费了大量人力、物力和时间。很快，美国人就将准备好到法国作战，而我们在意大利却一无所获。一无所获。我们需要作出一些改变，上校先生。我们需要能有效应对这些新挑战的新指挥官。请您辞职，把位置让给他们。

src: Our plan was too optimistic. Fortunally your troops could escape the pocket. Muster up your troops, because comrade Stalin has refused steadfastly to give you further reinforcements.
dst: 我们的计划过于乐观。所幸您的部队得以逃出口袋。重整您的部队吧，因为斯大林同志已坚决拒绝了给您进一步的增援。

src: Our position is strong, entrenched in hills behind the river. The Greek army had to decide between digging in and defending the gains, or advancing towards Ankara in order to destroy it, thus extending its lines of communication and supply in a hostile territory. After much deliberation they chose to attack.
dst: 我们的阵地很坚固，依托河后的山丘构筑工事。希腊军队不得不在就地固守、守住战果与向安卡拉推进并摧毁它之间做出抉择，而后者意味着在敌意领土上拉长其交通和补给线。经过反复权衡，他们选择了进攻。

src: Our problems grew with each passing day. Behind us, the Red Army was approaching. In front of us we had to deal with continuous mutinies, desertions and attacks from the partisans. We had lost our communications with the remnants of our First and Third armies. Tomsk and other towns had been lost. In fact, we only controlled the ground that we stepped on.
dst: 我们的困难与日俱增。身后，红军步步逼近；面前，我们得应付接连不断的哗变、逃兵和游击队的袭击。我们与第一、第三集团军残部的联系已中断。托木斯克等城镇已经失守。事实上，我们只控制着自己脚下踩着的那片土地。

src: Our pursuit of the retreating Bolshevik army has been quite successful so far. Now we have an opportunity to encircle and destroy the Russian's 1st cavalry Army, one of the best units in the Red Army.
dst: 到目前为止，我们对溃退的布尔什维克军队的追击相当成功。现在，我们有机会包围并歼灭俄军第1骑兵集团军——红军最精锐的部队之一。

src: Our quick success in North Africa has allowed us to expel the British from Egypt and secure the Suez Canal.
dst: 我们在北非的迅速胜利使我们得以将英国人逐出埃及，并确保苏伊士运河。

src: Our radio operators try to disturb and spy on the German transmission 24 hours a day. Hopefully their hard work will be of help.
dst: 我们的无线电操作员夜以继日地干扰和窃听德军通讯。但愿他们的辛勤工作能派上用场。

src: Our recons reported nearly no enemies in the area.
dst: 我们的侦察报告，该地区几乎没有敌人。

src: Our reinforcements are exected from the east and later on from the south.....
dst: 我们的援军预计从东面、随后从南面赶到……

src: Our remaining units were withdrawn to the Obi, and our armies were reorganized. Our next mission would be de defense of Novonikolayevsk, along with a couple of Siberian regiments and the 5th Polish Division, which was still loyal.
dst: 我们剩余的部队被撤到鄂毕河，全军重新整编。我们的下一个任务是防守新尼古拉耶夫斯克，配属几个西伯利亚团以及仍忠于我们的波兰第五师。

src: Our resistance was heroic, but useless. Nothing coud stop the Red Army, and we had to retreat further into the east.
dst: 我们的抵抗英勇却徒劳。什么都挡不住红军，我们不得不继续向东撤退。

src: Our resources are limited, so there will be no prestige for refitting.
dst: 我们的资源有限，所以不会有声望用于整补。

src: Our scouts have brought information that the Silkaatsnek Pass is being defended by a small British garrison. They're so overconfident that they haven't deployed any platoons on the higher ground.This may be a great opportunity for winning an easy victory and for gathering weapons to rearm our men.
dst: 我们的侦察兵带回情报说，锡尔卡茨内克山口由一支小小的英军守备队把守。他们狂妄自大到没有在高地上部署任何排。这可能是轻松取胜并为我们的战士重新武装而搜集武器的大好机会。

src: Our scouts have detected a large Filipino army at Bacoor and near the bridge over the river Zapote. Move your men there and expel our enemies from the coast. A flotilla of gunboats will help you. Good luck!
dst: 我们的侦察兵发现一支庞大的菲律宾军队驻扎在巴科尔以及萨波特河上的桥梁附近。把您的部队开到那里，把敌人赶出海岸。一支炮艇小舰队会支援您。祝您好运！

src: Our situation has reached a new depth. In the north the fascists have reached Leningrad and they are advancing on Moskva on the central front. In the south the fascists have captured Odessa, broken through into the Crimea, and days ago Rostov. Rostov is the gate to the Caucasus and its oilfields. We cannot allow the enemy to hold this position. An immediate counterattack has been ordered!
dst: 我们的处境跌到了新的谷底。北面，法西斯已抵达列宁格勒，并在中央战线向莫斯科推进。南面，法西斯已占领敖德萨，突破进入克里米亚，几天前又攻占了罗斯托夫。罗斯托夫是高加索及其油田的门户。我们不能让敌人守住这个阵地。已下令立即反击！

src: Our situation in northern Africa is critical. Allies destroy our supply fleet and have entire air superiority. We need to abandon Africa and take the fight back to Europe.
dst: 我们在北非的局势已十分危急。盟军摧毁了我们的补给船队，并掌握绝对制空权。我们须放弃非洲，将战斗带回欧洲。

src: Our situation in supply of crude oil is critical after losing the Romanian and Hungarian oil fields.
dst: 在失去罗马尼亚与匈牙利油田后，我们的原油补给已陷入危急。

src: Our situation is critical, and we can't continue to hold our front lines here. Our only choice is retreat, and wait for a miracle.
dst: 我们的处境十分危急，无法再在这里维持前线。我们唯一的选择是撤退，等待奇迹出现。

src: Our spies are reporting that the Republicans have re-organized their troops into regular divisions, so, again, it's expected a hard resistance. Also, we know the Republicans are supplied with Soviet equipment. In our operations in Madrid, Russian T-26 tanks have been reported, and it's undoubtely that the Republicans have received all those ''ratas'' fighters from the USSR. Be careful.
dst: 我们的间谍报告说，共和军已将部队重新整编为正规师，因此预料又会遇到顽强抵抗。此外，我们知道共和军装备着苏联提供的武器。在我们于马德里的作战中，据报出现了俄制 T-26 坦克，而且毫无疑问，共和军从苏联得到了那些「拉塔」战斗机。您要当心。

src: Our spies have reported that the puny Chiang-Kai-Shek has deployed here in Shanghai the best of his Kuomingtang troops, his German equiped divisions, but... they won't be a threat for our brave soldiers. Take Shanghai and establish a coastal position to allow further penetrations into the China mainland. Gather your division and land your command quickly!  The warship Idzumo and some air units will support your actions.
dst: 我们的间谍报告称，那个弱小的蒋介石已在上海部署了其国民党精锐部队——他那些德械师，但是……它们对我们英勇的士兵构不成威胁。夺取上海并建立沿海据点，以便进一步深入中国内陆。集结您的师团，迅速登陆并指挥行动！军舰出云号及一些空中单位将支援您的行动。

src: Our spies in Washington have informed that on June 4 the cruiser USS Charleston, in company with the steamers City of Peking, City of Sidney and Australia transporting troops, left Honolulu en route for the Philippines. Within the orders is the directive for the cruiser and transports to proceed to the Spanish Marianas Islands and take the island of Guam.
dst: 我们在华盛顿的间谍报告，6月4日，巡洋舰「查尔斯顿号」与运送部队的轮船「北京城号」「悉尼城号」和「澳大利亚号」一起离开檀香山，前往菲律宾。命令中包括指示该巡洋舰和运输船驶向西班牙所属的马里亚纳群岛并占领关岛。

src: Our spies report that a planned Allied invasion of Vichy French owned Morocco and Algeria has been delayed and that some of the forces that were planned to take part in it have been redirected to the Middle East.
dst: 我们的间谍报告，盟军原计划对维希法国所属摩洛哥和阿尔及利亚的入侵已被推迟，原定参加的一些部队已被改调中东。

src: Our standing in North Africa is Excellent, now finish the job and take Tobruk!
dst: 我们在北非的地位极佳，现在把活干完，拿下托布鲁克！

src: Our standing in North Africa is better, General Graziani has been chosen to take Tobruk, you have been chosen for a rather different operation.
dst: 我们在北非的地位好转，格拉齐亚尼将军被选中去夺取托布鲁克，而你被选中执行一项相当不同的任务。

src: Our standing in North Africa is good, now finish the job and take Tobruk!
dst: 我们在北非的地位不错，现在把活干完，拿下托布鲁克！

src: Our strike accross the Muese into France was horrendous, it seems the French were able to deter us everywhere we went.
dst: 我们跨过默兹河突入法国的这一击惨不忍睹，似乎我们走到哪里，法军都能挡住我们。

src: Our strike accross the Muese into France was most difficult, only through our sheer will did we prevail.
dst: 我们跨过默兹河突入法国的这一击极其艰难，我们全凭顽强的意志才取胜。

src: Our strike accross the Muese into France was true Blitzkrieg, we have met all expectations and now Guderian can continue the drive to the channel!
dst: 我们跨过默兹河突入法国的这一击是真正的闪电战，我们达到了所有预期，如今古德里安可以继续向海峡推进了！

src: Our strike accross the Muese into France will be taught in the Officer schools for decades to come as the definitive Blitzkrieg!
dst: 我们跨过默兹河突入法国的这一击，将在今后几十年的军官学校里被当作闪电战的典范来教授！

src: Our successful encirclement at Smolensk trapped many Russian Divisions!
dst: 我们在斯摩棱斯克成功的合围困住了许多俄军师！

src: Our successful encirclement at Smolensk trapped most of two armies!
dst: 我们在斯摩棱斯克成功的合围困住了两个集团军的大部！

src: Our successful encirclement at Smolensk trapped two full armies!
dst: 我们在斯摩棱斯克成功的合围困住了整整两个集团军！

src: Our task is not only to retake Sollum and secure the Medean Pass, but also to relieve our Italian allies, who are sieged by the Senussi at Bardia, and finally, to destroy the Senussi war camp at Bir Asiso. For this operation, a company of the Imperial Camel Corps and the Duke of Westminster's armoured car detachment will temporarily be under your command.
dst: 我们的任务不仅是夺回塞卢姆、确保米迪安隘口，还要为在巴迪亚被塞努西围困的意大利盟友解围，并最终摧毁塞努西在比尔阿西索的作战营地。此次行动中，帝国骆驼军团的一个连和威斯敏斯特公爵的装甲车分队将暂时归您指挥。

src: Our troops also attack on Paris. We expect, that after your success the French government will ask for a  cease-fire.
dst: 我军亦向巴黎发起进攻。我们预计，在你得手之后，法国政府将请求停火。

src: Our troops are exhausted after 4 long years of war. There is clearly not much more that we can do than to persue the Germans as they retreat. It is the major Entente powers that will force them to surrender in the coming days.
dst: 经过4年漫长的战争，我们的部队已经精疲力竭。我们显然没有太多可做的了，只能趁德军撤退时追击他们。在未来的日子里，迫使德军投降的将是协约国各大国。

src: Our troops are in bad shape.....I suggest we use this and the growing communist partisan activity in Yugoslavia as excuse to withdraw our troops from Russia.
dst: 我们的部队状况很糟……我建议利用这一点，以及南斯拉夫日益活跃的共产党游击活动作借口，把我们的部队撤出俄国。

src: Our troops are on the road to Basra in southern Iraq. Turn south and join our forces for the battle for Basra.
dst: 我们的部队正行进在通往伊拉克南部巴士拉的路上。转向南方，与我军会合，投入巴士拉之战。

src: Our troops are taking their new positions behind the Terneuzen canal and the Escaut/Scheldt River. The "Corps de Cavalerie" has to secure this movement.
dst: 我军正在进入泰尔讷曾运河和斯海尔德河后方的新阵地。“骑兵军”必须保障这一行动。

src: Our troops couldn't break the Egyptian lines but, knowing that they would eventually perish if they stayed at the open, the surviving Egyptians fled to the safety of their forts. Although in the following days we tried to assault them, it was in vain. Those positions were too strong. Finally, Yohannes agreed to a ceasefire. He allowed the remaining Egyptians to leave the forts and go back to their bases and, in return, we wouldn't pursue them. After some days, Hamasien, Akele and Guzay were again under Ethiopian control, but the Egyptians still held Bogos.
dst: 我们的部队没能突破埃及人的战线，但幸存的埃及人知道，如果继续暴露在野外，他们终将覆灭，于是逃回了堡垒的庇护之中。尽管在随后的几天里我们试图强攻，但都徒劳无功。那些阵地实在太坚固了。最终，约翰内斯同意停火。他允许剩余的埃及人离开堡垒返回基地，作为交换，我们不再追击他们。几天之后，哈马西恩、阿克莱和古扎伊重新归埃塞俄比亚控制，但埃及人仍然占据着博戈斯。

src: Our troops couldn't overcome the cold and the enemy. We still have a Soviet army menacing our left flank so we'll have to cancel our plans for a spring offensive.The Reds will have enough time to recover from their early defeats so maybe we'll have to agree to peace negotiations.
dst: 我们的部队既没能战胜严寒，也没能战胜敌人。仍有一支苏联集团军威胁着我们的左翼，因此我们不得不取消春季攻势的计划。红军将有足够的时间从先前的失败中恢复过来，所以也许我们不得不同意进行和平谈判。

src: Our troops couldn't overcome the cold and the enemy. We still have a Soviet army menacing our left flank, so we'll have to cancel our plans for a spring offensive.The Reds will have enough time to recover from their early defeats, so maybe we'll have to agree to peace negotiations.
dst: 我们的部队既没能战胜严寒，也没能战胜敌人。仍有一支苏联军队威胁着我们的左翼，因此我们不得不取消春季攻势的计划。红军将有足够的时间从早期的失败中恢复过来，所以我们或许不得不同意进行和谈。

src: Our troops have been training for this invasion for nearly a year now. XI Corps under command of Student will attack from the air with the Folgore paratrooper Division, 7th Flieger Division and La Spezia Air landing division (the air transportable units in your core). XXX and XVI Corps with most of the San Marco Regiment, a Camicie Nere Brigade, 10th Armoured Brigade and five infantry divisions will land from the sea.
dst: 我们的部队为这次入侵已训练了近一年。施图登特指挥的第11军将实施空降进攻，投入“闪电”伞兵师、第7航空师和“拉斯佩齐亚”空降师（你核心部队中可空运的单位）。第30军和第16军则携“圣马可”团大部、一个黑衫旅、第10装甲旅和五个步兵师从海上登陆。

src: Our troops have finally taken positions in the "Ligne KW" (Dyle Position) to confront the Germans. The defensive line is well prepared, our Army is ready and this is where we are going to give the decisive battle.
dst: 我军终于进入“KW 防线”（迪尔河阵地）与德军对峙。防线准备充分，我军已就绪，我们将在这里进行决定性会战。

src: Our troops left the Yalu river and arrived just in time in the fortified naval base of Liushun, called Port Arthur in Europe. Only a few days later the Second Japanese Army completed its disembark in Manchuria, and quickly marched towards Liushun, whose possession was vital for our enemies.
dst: 我们的部队离开鸭绿江，及时抵达了设防的海军基地旅顺，该地在欧洲被称为亚瑟港。仅仅几天后，日军第2军团完成了在满洲的登陆，并迅速向旅顺挺进，夺取旅顺对敌人而言至关重要。

src: Our troops, including the Imperial Camel Corps Brigade and 3rd Light Horse Brigade, have pursued the Turks to the tiny village of Magdhaba. The enemy position consists of a number of strong redoubts and a few connecting trenches, and is defended mainly by 80th Regiment, 27th (Arab) Division.
dst: 我们的部队，包括帝国骆驼军团旅和第3轻骑兵旅，已将土耳其人追至马格达巴小村。敌军阵地由若干坚固的多面堡和几条连接堑壕组成，主要由第27（阿拉伯）师的第80团防守。

src: Our victory at Amba Alagi, followed by our taking of the fortress of Mekele the next month, showed the Italians that this war wouldn't be easy for them. They sent even more troops to Eritrea, planning a decisive battle that, ideally, would crush us forever.
dst: 我们在安巴阿拉吉的胜利，以及下个月对默克莱要塞的攻占，让意大利人看到，这场战争对他们来说不会轻松。他们向厄立特里亚派出了更多部队，筹划着一场决战，理想情况下将一劳永逸地碾碎我们。

src: Our victory in the Kuban is almost complete. Ekaterinodar is ours at last, and our army is growing. I was wounded in the battle and I couldn't lead the main operations, but don't fear. It's nothing too serious, and in a couple of months I'll be fully recovered.
dst: 我们在库班的胜利已近完成。叶卡捷琳诺达尔终于归我们所有，我们的军队也在不断壮大。我在战斗中负了伤，没能指挥主要作战行动，但不必担心。伤得并不重，再过一两个月我就能完全康复。

src: Our victory in the Kuban is almost complete. Ekaterinodar is ours at last, and our army is growing. It won't be long until we can meet again. Hopefully, just a few months. I miss all of you very much, but I must still  be patient. Don't forget to tell Yuri and the girls that his father thinks about them every day. Tell them how we're fighting for our country, and for their future.
dst: 我们在库班的胜利已近完成。叶卡捷琳诺达尔终于归我们所有，我们的军队也在不断壮大。我们很快就能再见面了。但愿只需再等几个月。我非常想念你们所有人，但我还必须保持耐心。别忘了告诉尤里和女儿们，他们的父亲每天都在思念他们。告诉他们，我们如何为祖国、为他们的未来而战。

src: Our victory is complete! We have taken thousands of prisoners and  tons of Russian supplies. And in the east the enemy defences have been destroyed. In a few days we'll occupy Konstantia and all of Dobrudzha. Tsar Ferdinand is extremely pleased!
dst: 我们的胜利完满无缺！我们俘虏了数千人，缴获了成吨的俄国补给。而在东面，敌军防线已被摧毁。数日内我们就将占领康斯坦察和整个多布罗加。斐迪南沙皇欣喜若狂！

src: Our victory is complete. Now we can resupply our men and move quickly to our next destination.
dst: 我们取得了完胜。现在我们可以为战士们补充补给，并迅速赶赴下一个目的地。

src: Our victory was complete. The Polish were routed, and they retreated so fast that I think we could have reached Warsaw in a few weeks if we had wanted to. Instead, we contented ourselves with the liberation of most of Belarus and Ukraine and with reasonable war reparations. The Poles agreed to our conditions, and both sides signed a peace treaty in Minsk in June 1920.
dst: 我们的胜利是彻底的。波兰人被击溃，他们撤退得如此之快，我想，只要我们愿意，几周内就能打到华沙。但我们满足于解放白俄罗斯和乌克兰的大部分地区，以及合理的战争赔款。波兰人接受了我们的条件，双方于1920年6月在明斯克签署了和平条约。

src: Our western flank is secured by neutral, and the not especially friendly states of Germany and Lithuania. Do not tresspass their borders!
dst: 我们的西翼由德国和立陶宛这两个中立、且算不上特别友好的国家护卫着。切勿侵入它们的边境！

src: Our winter counter-offensive with waffen SS units against a Soviet armycorps must occupy Kharkov city, destroy many Red units and save time for our units.
dst: 我部在武装党卫军部队配合下发动冬季反攻，矛头直指苏军一个集团军级单位，必须攻占哈尔科夫城，歼灭大量红军部队，为我部争取时间。

src: Our winter offensive has brought us on the other side of the Dnjepr River and Kiev has been liberated. Enemy resistance is still present and the fascists are hurt but not dead. Every day resistance increases. We must make optimal use of the momentum, as long as lasts. We will attack near Perekop and force ourselves into the Crimea. Your force will march along the coast and liberate Odessa.
dst: 我们的冬季攻势已把我们带到了第聂伯河对岸，基辅已经解放。敌军的抵抗依然存在，法西斯受了伤，但还没死。每一天，抵抗都在增强。我们必须趁着势头尚在，善加利用。我们将在佩列科普附近进攻，强行突入克里米亚。你的部队将沿海岸行军，解放敖德萨。

src: Our worst expectations have become true. Serbia claims that, since the European great powers deny her the right to occupy Albania, she needs another compensation for the war against the Ottomans, so they won't leave Vardar Macedonia, which they conquered with virtually no Bulgarian support. And the Greeks have allied with them, since they long for Western Thrace.
dst: 我们最坏的预料成真了。塞尔维亚声称，既然欧洲列强不许她占领阿尔巴尼亚，她就需要为对奥斯曼的战争另寻补偿，因此他们不愿交出瓦尔达尔马其顿——这片土地他们几乎是在没有保加利亚支援的情况下征服的。而希腊人也与他们结盟，因为希腊渴望得到西色雷斯。

src: Out of desperation the Bolsheviks have raised a Shock Group composed mainly of Latvians and Estonians. They want to outflank us, forcing us to retreat or to risk encirclement. It's amusing how they still underestimate you. Hold the line, my brothers, and show them that all their efforts are useless!
dst: 绝望之下，布尔什维克组建了一个主要由拉脱维亚人和爱沙尼亚人组成的突击集群。他们想包抄我们，迫使我们撤退或冒被包围的风险。可笑的是，他们仍然低估了你们。守住防线，我的弟兄们，让他们看看，他们的一切努力都是徒劳的！
前哨/比利时殖民地摩托化旅群

src: Outstanding performance, Herr General! But things are not going well in Russia. Intelligence indicates that the Bolsheviks are planning a great offensive in the Kursk region in the summer. Therefore we must quickly take Alexandria so that Egypt and the Suez Canal can be conquered. You are given a key role in these operations. Once the British Empire is defeated in North Africa and Arabia we will be able to allocate more troops to the Eastern Front.
dst: 表现出色，将军阁下！但俄国那边的情况不妙。情报显示布尔什维克正计划在夏季于库尔斯克地区发动一场大规模攻势。因此我们必须迅速夺取亚历山大港，从而征服埃及与苏伊士运河。你将在这些行动中扮演关键角色。一旦大英帝国在北非与阿拉伯被击败，我们就能抽调更多部队到东线。

src: Outstanding performance, Herr General! But things are not going well in Russia. Intelligence indicates that the Bolsheviks are planning a great offensive in the Kursk region. Therefore we must quickly take Alexandria so that Egypt and the Suez Canal can be conquered. You are given a key role in these operations. Once the British Empire is defeated in North Africa and Arabia we will be able to allocate more troops to the Eastern Front.
dst: 出色表现，将军阁下！但俄国的情况并不顺利。情报表明布尔什维克正计划在库尔斯克地区发动一场大规模攻势。因此我们必须迅速夺取亚历山大港，以便征服埃及和苏伊士运河。你在这些行动中承担着关键角色。一旦大英帝国在北非和阿拉伯被击败，我们就能向东线调拨更多部队。

src: Outstanding performance, Herr General.  But things are not going well in Russia. Feldmarschall Paulus has been unable to break out of Stalingrad.  Worse, intelligence indicates that the Bolsheviks are planning a great offensive in the Kursk region.  Therefore we must quickly take Alexandria so that Egypt and the Suez Canal can be conquered.  You are given a key role in the capture of Alexandria.
dst: 干得非常出色，将军阁下。但俄国那边的形势不妙。保卢斯元帅未能从斯大林格勒突围。更糟的是，情报显示布尔什维克正计划在库尔斯克地区发动一场大规模攻势。因此我们必须迅速拿下亚历山大，以便征服埃及和苏伊士运河。在夺取亚历山大的行动中，你将扮演关键角色。

src: Overall info: (Somewhere in USSR.) After weeks of heavy fighting, the Germans penetrate deeper and deeper to the East, but the flow of fresh enemy units seems to be endless and once again, the Russians have stopped the brigade.
dst: 总体情报：（苏联某地。）经过数周激战，德军越来越深入东方，但敌军生力军似乎源源不断，俄国人又一次挡住了这个旅。

src: Overall, the February Przasnysz Operation strengthened the Russian position, while weakening the German.  Strategically, it relieved the pressure on the Russian Warsaw salient and frustrated German plans for a decisive action in the east during the month of February.
dst: 总体而言，二月的普扎斯内什战役巩固了俄军的地位，同时削弱了德军。在战略上，它缓解了俄军华沙突出部所承受的压力，并挫败了德军在二月份于东线展开决定性行动的图谋。

src: Overwhelmed by the numbers, you could not do more than repeat and multiply the admirable proofs of your courage. I can not, nor want to deal with the enemy. But I love you too much to let unnecessarily spill even a drop of your blood.
dst: 面对优势兵力，您所能做的只是不断展现您令人敬佩的勇气。我不能、也不愿与敌人交涉。但我太爱您，绝不忍心让您白白流一滴血。

src: PPS: I did as you wished and asked Hpt. Bistroff where is he from and where he served during the Weltkrieg. Seems like he's really your man, but he can't remember you. But well, it's too long since then."
dst: 再及：我照你的吩咐，问了比斯特罗夫上尉他是哪里人、世界大战时在哪儿服役。看起来他确实是你认识的那个人，但他记不起你了。不过话说回来，那都是太久以前的事了。”

src: PS: Father, just before the Reds fled, they set ablaze the nearby monastery. In previous weeks they've beaten and raped many sisters. War's so ugly. I've thought of it as a adventure, but now I see that you were right.
dst: 又及：父亲，就在红军逃走之前，他们放火烧了附近的那座修道院。前几个星期里，他们殴打并奸污了许多修女。战争真是丑陋。我过去把它当作一场冒险，但现在我明白了，你是对的。

src: PS: Otto, several times I've asked you for something, but you always forget. The picture you've sent me is awful and the photographer must have been totally inept, because you look like if you have your ear missing. Send me some better photo, please. Viele Küsse..."
dst: 又及：奥托，我几次求过你，可你总忘。你寄给我的那张照片糟透了，摄影师肯定笨得可以，因为你看起来像少了一只耳朵。请寄张更好的照片给我。许多吻……”

src: Para terminar la guerra debemos asaltar el protectorado. El plan consiste en atacar el puerto de Ceuta, y despues avanzar hacia Tetuan, donde se ha establecido el centro de mando de los rebeldes. Unidades navales han salido de la base de Cartagena, ademas el V cuerpo ha llegado a costas proximas a Ceuta desde Cadiz.
dst: 为结束战争，我们必须进攻摩洛哥保护地。计划是进攻休达港，随后向叛军指挥中枢所在地得土安推进。海军部队已从卡塔赫纳基地出发，此外第5军也已从加的斯抵达休达附近海岸。

src: Para tratar de nuevo de frenar completamente la tremenda presion que los rebeldes ejercen sobre Asturias y Cantabria, el alto mando ha creado esta nueva operacion sobre Aragon, consistente en un ataque concentrico que caera finalmente sobre Zaragoza. En su camino hacia la capital aragonesa encontrara multitud de guarniciones falangistas bien atrincheradas que trataran de resistir hasta la llegada de refuerzos, asi que actue con rapidez. Contara tambien con la ayuda de un grupo de guerrilleros cuya mision es capturar los puentes de Zaragoza...
dst: 为了设法再次彻底遏制叛军对阿斯图里亚斯和坎塔布里亚施压的可怕压力，最高统帅部策划了这次针对阿拉贡的新行动，即一场最终将落在萨拉戈萨的向心进攻。在您向阿拉贡首府推进的途中，会遇到众多工事坚固的长枪党驻军，他们会设法抵抗，直到援军抵达，因此您要迅速行动。您还将得到一支游击队的协助，其任务是夺取萨拉戈萨的桥梁……

src: Paradoxically, France and Russia could have switched their destinies. Due to the Brussilow offensive and the British operation at the Somme we've been forced to retire too many troops from Verdun, and our plan there has failed. The French Army is shaken, but not broken, and our losses in the west have been so high that we'll have to retire to a safer defence line as soon as we can build it.
dst: 说来矛盾，法国和俄国仿佛互换了命运。由于布鲁西洛夫攻势和英军在索姆河的行动，我们被迫从凡尔登撤走了太多部队，我们在那里的计划已经失败。法军虽受重创，但未被打垮，而我们在西面的损失如此之大，以致不得不尽快修筑一条更安全的防线并撤守过去。

src: Part of the Allied 3rd Ypres Offensive - aimed at destroying the German army group in Belgium - the battle for Messines Ridge was a meticulously crafted operation by the British Gen. Plumer.  Commanding high ground south of the Allied-held Ypres salient, the Messines Ridge was the primary obstacle of the offensive.  In preparation for the operation, 8000m of tunnels were dug by the British under the German positions, and 21 mines were laid.
dst: 作为协约国第三次伊普尔攻势的一部分——旨在摧毁德军在比利时的集团军群——梅辛岭之战是英军普卢默将军精心策划的一次行动。梅辛岭控制着协约国所据伊普尔突出部以南的高地，是此次攻势的主要障碍。为准备这次行动，英军在德军阵地下方挖掘了8000米隧道，并布设了21处地雷。

src: Part of the crew of SMS Thüringen and SMS Helgoland, two battle ships of the First Naval Battle Squadron, committed outright mutiny and sabotage. However, when a day later some torpedo boats directed their cannons onto these ships, the mutineers gave up and were led away without any resistance.
dst: 第一战列舰分舰队的两艘战列舰「图林根」号和「黑尔戈兰」号上的部分舰员公然哗变并实施了破坏。然而，一天之后，当一些鱼雷艇把炮口对准这两艘舰时，哗变者放弃了抵抗，未作任何反抗就被带走了。

src: Parts of the 2. Panzerarmee are under the required strength. There are not so much tanks and anti-tanks on the first front line, however the 2. Panzerarmee still have some tank divisions in reserve. Probably the Germans will march them off.
dst: 德国第2装甲集团军的部分部队兵力不足。一线并没有太多坦克与反坦克力量，不过第2装甲集团军仍保留着若干装甲师作为预备队。德军很可能会把它们调上来。

src: Parts of the 37. Army are subordinate to your authority. These troops are wet behind the ears and do not have much tanks, but some artillery with big caliber.
dst: 第37集团军的部分部队归您指挥。这些部队缺乏经验，坦克也不多，但有一些大口径火炮。

src: Parts of the 5th Alpini Division Pusteria have been flown in from Montenegro and are under your command. DAK will operate to the right of your forces (largely off-map).
dst: 第5阿尔卑斯山地师“普斯特里亚”的部分部队已从黑山空运而来，归你指挥。非洲军将在你部队的右翼行动（大部分在图外）。

src: Pasando al grano, Bilbao debe caer tan pronto como sea posible. Se de buena tinta que si tomamos la capital de Vizcaya, los batallones nacionalistas vascos no tardaran mucho en dejar de combatir. De momento los republicanos creen que están seguros detras de esos bunkers en torno a Bilbao, llamados ''Cinturón de Hierro'', pero eso es solo un nombre. El ingeniero que diseñó esa línea defensiva, Alejandro Goicoechea, se ha pasado a nuestro bando, y gracias a el tenemos los planos completos de la línea de bunkers. Ahora sabemos que solo el 40% de esas líneas están terminadas, y lo más importante: sabemos los puntos débiles donde atacar.
dst: 直说吧，毕尔巴鄂必须尽快陷落。我有可靠消息，如果我们拿下比斯开的首府，巴斯克民族主义营用不了多久就会停止作战。眼下共和军以为躲在毕尔巴鄂周边那些碉堡——所谓「铁环防线」——后面就安然无恙，但那不过是个名号。设计那道防御工事的工程师亚历杭德罗·戈伊科切亚已经投奔我方，多亏了他，我们掌握了整套碉堡防线的图纸。如今我们知道那些防线只完工了40%，而最重要的是：我们知道该在哪些薄弱点发起进攻。
