src: Pay attention this time Herr General!

Peace negotiations started in March, and on 17 April 1895 both countries signed the Treaty of Shimonoseki. The Qing Empire was forced to accept a Japanese protectorate over Korea, lost Taiwan, Penghu and the Manchurian Liaodong Peninsula, and had to pay war reparations to Japan. The peace terms were so harsh, in fact, that Russia, France and Germany, fearing that the Japanese could become too powerful, forced Japan to give up the Liaodong Peninsula, which eventually ended under Russian control.
dst: 和平谈判于3月开始，1895年4月17日，两国签署了《马关条约》。大清帝国被迫接受日本对朝鲜的保护权，丧失台湾、澎湖和满洲的辽东半岛，并不得不向日本支付战争赔款。事实上，和约条款如此苛刻，以至于俄国、法国和德国因担心日本变得过于强大，而强迫日本放弃辽东半岛，该半岛最终落入俄国控制之下。

src: Peace terms will be hard, but at least our Empire survives. And who knows? Our enemies have behaved as a pack of rabid wolves. Maybe soon they'll be fighting each other for their prey, and if that moment comes we'll take our opportunity.
dst: 和平条件将会很苛刻，但至少我们的帝国存活了下来。谁知道呢？我们的敌人表现得就像一群发疯的狼。也许很快他们就会为争夺猎物而自相残杀，到那时我们就抓住机会。
以实力求和平: 日托米尔

src: Peace will be as difficult as the war, if not more. Ending the anarchy that has been ravaging Spain since this sad century began will not be easy, but with God's help and supported in Tradition and the Fueros, we will succeed.
dst: 和平将与战争一样艰难，甚至更难。结束这个可悲世纪以来一直蹂躏西班牙的混乱局面并非易事，但凭借上帝的帮助，依托传统和权利宪章，我们定能成功。
Pee Dee, South Carolina, 炮兵

src: Peralejo was important for a number of reasons. It produced a flood of volunteers to the Cuban Liberation Army, forced Spanish to move in larger columns and allow the revolution to consolidate its hold on east Cuba.
dst: 佩拉莱霍之战之所以重要，有诸多原因。它为古巴解放军带来了大批志愿者，迫使西班牙人以更大的纵队行进，并使革命得以巩固对古巴东部的控制。
佩列亚斯拉夫-赫梅利尼茨基

src: Perez Dasmariñas was the bloodiest battle of the Cavite campaign. Katipunan revolutionaries, under the command of Aguinaldo himself, had built impressive trench works all around the village and fortified the village itself. After taking by assault the trenches, heavy and fierce combat took place inside the town, but finally Lachambre's forces squashed Filipino resistance.
dst: 佩雷斯·达斯马里尼亚斯之战是甲米地战役中最血腥的一仗。卡蒂普南革命者在阿吉纳尔多本人的指挥下，在村庄四周构筑了令人叹为观止的战壕工事，并把村庄本身也设了防。攻下战壕后，镇内发生了惨烈而残酷的巷战，但最终拉尚布尔的部队粉碎了菲律宾人的抵抗。
佩雷斯达斯马里尼亚斯

src: Perfect!  The North Korean flag again flies over the city of Seoul.  Kim-Il-Sung is really pleased with you.   You have become a hero for the Korean people.
dst: 完美！朝鲜的旗帜再次飘扬在汉城上空。金日成对你非常满意。你已成为朝鲜人民的英雄。

src: Perfect!  The North Korean flag again flies over the city of Seoul.  Kim-Il-Sung is really pleased with you.   You have become a hero for the Korean people.   Anyway we are shortly going to open the negotiations with the UN forces to terminate this conflict.
dst: 完美！朝鲜的旗帜再次飘扬在汉城上空。金日成对你非常满意。你已成为朝鲜人民的英雄。不管怎样，我们很快就会与联合国军开始谈判，以结束这场冲突。

src: Perfect! From Toulon we'll be able to take most of southern France. Our enemies aren't used to fighting on two fronts. We had to do it for a long time, while they laughed at our army, believing that we were useless bufoons. Well, now they'll know how difficult it is. Do you think they'll be able to manage the situation? I don't. I'm sure that, in a few weeks, France will surrender and the war will be finally over.
dst: 完美！从土伦出发，我们就能拿下法国南部的大部分地区。我们的敌人不习惯在两线作战。我们却长期不得不这样做，而他们却嘲笑我们的军队，认为我们是一群无用的蠢货。好了，现在他们该知道这有多难了。您觉得他们能应付得了这种局面吗？我看不能。我相信，用不了几周，法国就会投降，战争终于就要结束了。

src: Perfect! The Germans have fought valiantly, but they didn't have a chance. Now we can take a brief rest, and then we'll continue our advance. The liberation of our country is finally at hand. That's what we've fighting for all this time, and we must not make any mistakes. We'll succeed, no matter what.
dst: 太好了！德军作战英勇，但他们没有机会。现在我们可以稍作休整，然后继续推进。我们祖国的解放终于指日可待。这就是我们一直为之战斗的目标，我们绝不能犯任何错误。无论如何，我们都会成功。

src: Perfect! We have taken the weapons and ammunition. Now you must help the other commandoes that are besieging the town of Kimberley.
dst: 好极了！我们夺到了武器和弹药。现在您必须去支援正围攻金伯利城的其他突击队。

src: Perfect! we are now at the gates of the most important soviet Pacific port.   Also more enemies of the revolution have been enlisted to fight the Bolsheviks alongside us.
dst: 完美！我们现在已抵达苏联最重要的太平洋港口城下。此外，还有更多革命的敌人被征召来与我们并肩对抗布尔什维克。

src: Perfect, just as planned. We'll assault Bukarest before the enemy defences are ready. The Romanian army will have to surrender or, at most, their remnants will have to flee to Bessarabien, where they'll join the Russians. Either way, the crossing of the passes has been a magnificent victory for us.
dst: 完美，正如计划。我们将在敌军防御就绪之前强攻布加勒斯特。罗马尼亚军队将不得不投降，或者至多其残部逃往比萨拉比亚，去与俄国人会合。无论如何，翻越这些山口对我们来说都是一场辉煌的胜利。

src: Perfect. Dozens of German silver helmets lie on the battlefield as a shiny evidence of our victory. Our enemies have been stopped for a while, and our army will be able to regroup and retreat in order.
dst: 完美。数十顶德军银盔散落在战场上，成为我们胜利的闪亮见证。敌人被阻挡了一阵子，我军得以重新集结并有序撤退。

src: Perfect. Most of the Serbian army has been destroyed, and the survivors are fleeing to the south. They will try to reach the sea through Montenegro or Albania, but don't worry about that for now. Our reserves, as well as the winter weather, will take care of them. Now your troops must rest and recover until we need them again.
dst: 完美。塞尔维亚军队大部已被歼灭，幸存者正向南逃窜。他们会试图经黑山或阿尔巴尼亚抵达海边，但现在不必为此操心。我们的预备队以及冬季的严寒会收拾他们。眼下您的部队必须休整恢复，直到我们再次需要他们。

src: Perm fell rather easily, and on July 5 the operations against Ekaterinburg began. Initially, the  offensive of the Red Second Army was stopped by our shock regiments, but then the 28th Soviet Infantry Division outflanked their positions and attacked from the rear, surrounding and defeating our Siberian Army.
dst: 彼尔姆相当轻易地陷落了，7月5日，对叶卡捷琳堡的作战开始。起初，红军第二集团军的进攻被我军突击团挡住，但随后苏维埃第28步兵师包抄了他们的阵地，从后方发起进攻，包围并击溃了我们的西伯利亚集团军。

src: Pompey had every tactical advantage an army could hope for; he held the higher ground, had superiority of numbers, and was better supplied from his many allies in Greece. This caused the great general to be conservative, careful, and dangerously predictable. Pompey deployed his army in the traditional formation of three lines with a depth of ten men. Again according to convention he posted his most experienced legions on the flanks (the first and the third legion on his left with Pompey himself commanding, the Syrian legions in the center with Scipio, the Cilician legion and the Spanish cohorts on the right with Afranius), dispersing his new recruits along the center. In total, Caesar counted 110 complete cohorts in the Pompeiian army, about 45,000 men. Pompey's right was protected by the River Enipeus, therefore he amassed all his cavalry on Caesar's right. He had given command of the cavalry to Labienus, the former commander of Caesar's favourite X legion. He deployed the rest of the army on his left together with his auxiliary troops. Pompey's plan was to allow Caesar's infantry to advance, have his cavalry attack and push back the numerically inferior Julian horses, and then attack Caesar's infantry from behind.
dst: 庞培占尽一支军队所能指望的一切战术优势：他占据较高地势，兵力占优，还能从希腊的众多盟友那里得到更好的补给。这使这位名将变得保守、谨慎，也危险地易于预测。庞培按传统将部队排成三线、纵深十人。他又依照惯例把最有经验的军团布置在两翼（第一、第三军团在他本人指挥下的左翼，叙利亚军团由西皮阿率领居中，奇里乞亚军团与西班牙步兵队在阿夫拉尼乌斯率领下居右），把新兵分散在中路。据凯撒统计，庞培军中共有110个满编步兵队，约45,000人。庞培的右翼受埃尼佩乌斯河掩护，因此他把全部骑兵集中在凯撒的右翼方向。他把骑兵的指挥权交给了拉比埃努斯——凯撒最钟爱的第10军团的前任指挥官。他把其余部队与辅助部队一并布置在自己的左翼。庞培的计划是：让凯撒的步兵前进，用骑兵冲击并逼退人数处于劣势的凯撒骑兵，然后从背后攻击凯撒的步兵。

src: Quickly, the German states occupied Lauenburg and Holstein. On January 16, 1864, Austria and Prussia agreed to occupy Schleswig, too. dst: 德意志各邦迅速占领了劳恩堡和荷尔斯泰因。1864年1月16日，奥地利和普鲁士也同意占领石勒苏益格。然而，丹麦拒绝废除十一月宪法。最终，战争于1864年2月1日爆发，当时奥地利和普鲁士军队越过艾德河进入石勒苏益格。

src: Quickly, your troops must entrench themselves. Immediately! Although Fort Vaux is under our control, the French are regrouping and will launch a counterattack soon. If they surprise you, you'll be lost. We'll need to do it better if we want our enemies to surrender before the end of the summer. And even if we get them to that point, if Britain and Russia lauch any offensives of their own, in support of their French allies, we'll be in serious trouble.

src: Ras Alula and the other Ethiopian chieftains reacted quickly, and they hid Yohannes's death, not only from the Mahdists, but also from our own warriors. It was a wise move. I'm sure that most of our men would have panicked as soon as they knew that their emperor had died. They would have fled the battlefield, and a certain victory would have turned into a terrible defeat for us.
dst: 拉斯·阿卢拉和其他埃塞俄比亚酋长反应迅速，他们隐瞒了约翰内斯的死讯，不仅瞒着马赫迪分子，也瞒着我们自己的战士。这是明智之举。我相信，大多数士兵一得知皇帝驾崩就会惊慌失措。他们会逃离战场，一场本可稳操胜券的胜利就会变成我们的惨败。

src: Ras Alula chose the latter, and attacked the Italian fort of Saati, to no avail. Our warriors still lacked the equipment needed for an assault on fortified positions. But the defenders of Saati had nearly run out of ammunitions and other supplies, so they asked for a relief column to be sent from Massawa.
dst: 拉斯·阿卢拉选择了后者，进攻意大利人的萨蒂堡，但无济于事。我们的战士仍然缺乏强攻设防阵地所需的装备。不过，萨蒂堡的守军几乎耗尽了弹药和其他补给，因此他们请求从马萨瓦派出一支救援纵队。

src: Ras Alula's scouts spotted the Italian brigades soon after they started its march on February 29, so the Ethiopian forces were ready. The Tigrayans, led by Ras Mengesha, Ras Alula and myself, were on the left flank. On the centre, we had the warriors of Ras Mikael of Wollo, including the Oromo cavalry, and the Harar forces of Ras Makonnen. The righ flank was formed with soldiers from Gojjam, and their king Tekle Haymanot was at the front with them. Finally, on the reserve, there were the warriors from Shewa and the Semien, commanded by Emperor Menelik and Empress Taytu.
dst: 意大利旅于2月29日开始进军后不久，拉斯·阿卢拉的侦察兵便发现了他们，于是埃塞俄比亚军队做好了准备。由拉斯·门格沙、拉斯·阿卢拉和我率领的提格雷人在左翼。中路是沃洛的拉斯·米卡埃尔的战士，包括奥罗莫骑兵，以及拉斯·马孔嫩的哈拉尔部队。右翼由来自戈贾姆的士兵组成，他们的国王特克莱·海马诺特与士兵们一同冲在最前面。最后，作为预备队的是来自绍阿和塞米恩的战士，由孟尼利克皇帝和泰图皇后指挥。

src: Reality was very different, though. Well, now we know how weak we are. And our enemies know it, too. The following months will be terrible for the Empire. We must prepare ourselves for a long, ugly war. On the positive side, Russia has suffered greatly during this year, too, so I think that, working together with the Germans, we should be able to recover all the territories that we've lost.
dst: 不过，现实与预期大相径庭。唉，现在我们知道了自己有多虚弱。我们的敌人也知道了。接下来的几个月对帝国来说将十分难熬。我们必须为一场漫长而丑恶的战争做好准备。好的一面是，俄国今年也损失惨重，所以我想，与德国人携手，我们应该能收复所有失地。

src: Reality was very different, though. Well, now we know how weak we are. And our enemies know it, too. The following months will be terrible for the Empire. dst: 然而现实却大不相同。好了，现在我们知道自己有多虚弱了。我们的敌人也知道这一点。接下来的几个月对帝国来说将十分可怕。我们必须为一场漫长而丑陋的战争做好准备。好的一面是，塞尔维亚在这一年里也损失惨重，所以我想他们近期不会进攻我们。

src: Realizing little of the precariousness of the situation, Stavka continued to plan for dual offensives by the North-Western and South-Western fronts for the summer of 1915. src: Report to the Fuhress on the World condition (July '39)  Our SS numbers have now reached 3.2 million Fraus.The French still have a formidable force.To beat them may take the rest of the year.'IL Duce has agreed to step up operations in North Afrika to pull Allied reserves there.Canada ,Netherland will join the Allies cause soon We believe.Poland is leaning towards joining but Russian armor forces on the border have them indecisive as well as the SS forces of Armee 'Erfert in East Prussia.The 'War Cabinet' has made the request 'Erfert should move and take Danzig/Gdynia so no supplies can come ashore in the area.This will make the decision for the Poles a little simpler but We need them off Our flanks as We move more forces West.Japan is reluctant for the request of more attacks on Russia,it seems they are moving to create their Co-prosperity Sphere in the Pacific.We have stated again "The Russians are the Real War".Sooner or later the great Industrial Giant,the United States will have to get involved.At the moment Our Gestapa spys say they see no movement in American industry turning to War,they still have Cars and Refridgerators coming off the Assembly line.As far as Our industrial mite We are in better shape than ever but We cannot fight the whole World.We need to beat the French and Brits first.We can do that.Then the Soviets which with their vast areas to cross will be a greater task.Europe can be Ours but We must not get involved with Amerika before then.
dst: 关于世界形势呈女元首的报告（39年7月）  我们的党卫军人数现已达到320万“女士”。法国仍拥有可观的兵力，要打败他们也许还要花上今年余下的时间。“领袖”已同意加大在北非的行动，以吸引盟军预备队前往该地。我们相信加拿大、荷兰很快会加入盟国阵营。波兰倾向于加入，但边境上的俄国装甲部队让他们举棋不定，东普鲁士“埃尔弗特”集团军的党卫军部队也是如此。战时内阁已要求“埃尔弗特”出动，夺取但泽／格丁尼亚，使任何补给都无法在该地区上岸。这将让波兰人的抉择稍微简单些；而且随着我们把更多兵力调往西线，我们需要他们离开我们的侧翼。日本不愿再对俄国发动更多进攻，看来他们正打算在太平洋建立自己的“共荣圈”。我们已再次声明：“俄国人才是真正的战争。”这个伟大的工业巨人——美国——迟早会被卷进来。目前我们的盖世太保间谍说，他们看不到美国工业转向战时轨道的迹象，汽车和冰箱还在从流水线上下来。就我们自己的工业实力而言，我们比以往任何时候都好，但我们无法与世界为敌。我们得先打败法国人和英国人。这我们做得到。然后是苏联人——要跨越他们辽阔的国土，那将是更艰巨的任务。欧洲可以归我们所有，但在此之前，绝不能与美国纠缠。

src: Revolts against Spanish rule had occurred for some years in Cuba and more recently in the Philippines. In the late 1890s, the United States were increasingly critical to the Spanish administration of Cuba. However, neither President Cleveland nor McKinley was in favour of a military intervention. It was not until the sinking of the American battleship Maine in Havana harbour in February 1898 (probably due to a spontaneous combustion of coal in the bunker, next to magazine) that public opinion, agitated by the yellow press of William Randolph Hearst and Joseph Pulitzer blaming Spain, some politicians and certain businessmen pushed President McKinley into a war.
dst: 反西班牙统治的起义在古巴已持续数年，菲律宾则更晚些。19世纪90年代末，美国对西班牙在古巴的统治日益不满。然而，无论是克利夫兰总统还是麦金莱总统都不赞成军事干预。直到1898年2月美国战列舰缅因号在哈瓦那港沉没（很可能是由于煤舱中靠近弹药库的煤炭自燃），公众舆论被威廉·伦道夫·赫斯特和约瑟夫·普利策的黄色报刊所煽动，将罪责归于西班牙，一些政客和商人遂将麦金莱总统推向了战争。

src: Right now Austria-Hungary, the Ottoman Empire, Bulgaria, Russia, Italy and France can barely hold their own. They can still defend themselves, sure, but they lack the strength to launch any serious offensive operation. I hate to admit it, but that very same thing is happening to us here, at the Western Front. Only in the east do we have any chance to take the initiative.
dst: 眼下，奥匈帝国、奥斯曼帝国、保加利亚、俄国、意大利和法国都只能勉强自保。当然，它们仍能防守，但已无力发起任何像样的攻势。我很不愿意承认，但同样的情形也正发生在我们西线这里。只有在东线，我们才有机会夺取主动权。

src: Right now the remnants of the French, Serbian and Italian forces just care about embarking to Corfu, Kreta or Brindisi. And without the Greek support the British forces at Thessaloniki will have to choose between evacuation or surrender. It'll still take some weeks, maybe months, to fully clear Greece of enemies, but it's undeniable that this has been one of our finest victories in the war. Austria-Hungary and Bulgaria are safe now, and we'll be able to send thousands of soldiers to the Western front.  We can even afford transferring some battalions to the Middle East in order to help our Ottoman allies.
dst: 眼下，法军、塞尔维亚军和意军的残部只想着登船撤往科孚岛、克里特岛或布林迪西。而失去希腊的支持后，塞萨洛尼基的英军将不得不在撤退与投降之间做出选择。要把希腊的敌人彻底肃清，仍需数周、甚至数月的时间，但不可否认，这是我们在这场战争中最辉煌的胜利之一。奥匈帝国和保加利亚如今安全了，我们还能向西线派出成千上万的士兵。我们甚至负担得起向中东调派一些营去援助我们的奥斯曼盟友。

src: Right now there are other problems to worry about. We fear that the Romanians are preparing an offensive across the Dunav River, on our rear. You'll have to go there and reinforce the local garrisons.
dst: 眼下还有其他问题需要担忧。我们担心罗马尼亚人正准备跨越多瑙河发动进攻，直指我方后方。您必须赶赴那里，加强当地守备部队。

src: Right now, our troops are about to surrender the fortress of Tutrakan, and yesterday we entered Dobrich, the main town in the region. But we know that nearly four Russian and Romanian divisions are preparing a counterattack against our positions in Dobrich. Your mission is to reinforce them, repel the enemy attacks and secure the area.
dst: 眼下，图特拉坎要塞即将向我军投降，昨天我们又攻入了该地区的主要城镇多布里奇。但我们得知，近四个俄国师和罗马尼亚师正在准备对我军在多布里奇的阵地发起反攻。您的任务是增援他们、击退敌军进攻并巩固该地区。

src: Right now, the Serbians are manoeuvring to their right, trying to separate us from the remnants of the 6th Army. Our only hope is to regroup, resist their assaults, and try to damage the Serbian flank. That way we could give the 6th Army the time it needs for an orderly retreat, and we could mitigate this disaster.
dst: 此刻，塞尔维亚人正向其右翼机动，企图把我们从第6集团军的残部中分割出来。我们唯一的希望是重新集结、抵挡他们的进攻，并设法打击塞尔维亚人的侧翼。这样我们才能为第6集团军争取到有序撤退所需的时间，从而缓解这场灾难。

src: Right now, those British and French troops are preparing themselves for helping Serbia. If you take your objectives quickly, the Serbian supply lines will be destroyed, and Britain and France won't be able to send any reinforcements to them. In that case, Serbia will be defeated before Christmas.
dst: 眼下，那些英法军队正准备去支援塞尔维亚。如果您迅速拿下目标，塞尔维亚人的补给线就会被摧毁，英国和法国就无法向他们派遣任何增援。那样的话，塞尔维亚将在圣诞节前被打败。

src: Right now, we have gathered information from German POWs that the enemy will mount another attack in the Noyon-Montidier area, and has even sent some units of their monstrous A7V tanks to the front.. But knowing of their plans in advance has given us some valuable time to prepare for this assault. At this moment, General Mangin is building up a strong battle group for a counter-attack, including massive numbers of St. Chamond and Schneider tanks. I have received orders to support the local troops defending the area and wait for Mangin's force to join in a forceful counterattack.
dst: 眼下，我们从德军战俘那里收集到情报，敌人将在努瓦永-蒙蒂迪耶地区再次发动进攻，甚至已把他们那些庞然大物A7V坦克的部分单位派到了前线。不过，提前得知他们的计划，为我们准备应对这次突击赢得了宝贵的时间。此刻，曼让将军正在组建一支强大的反击战斗群，其中包括大量的圣沙蒙坦克和施奈德坦克。我已接到命令，支援当地防守该地区的部队，等待曼让的部队加入一场强有力的反击。

src: Roberts took command of the Kimberley front. He blamed Lord Methuen for not having defeated the Boer, quite unfairly in my opinion, and he ordered the 1st Division to stand by the Modder River for almost two months. In February 1900 Roberts stripped the Guards Brigade, to which I belonged, from the 1st Division to a new 11th Division under Pole-Carew, and he relegated Lord Methuen to cover his lines of communication. It was a sad destiny for such a knightly warrior, who only happened to have bad luck.
dst: 罗伯茨接管了金伯利战线的指挥权。他指责梅休因勋爵未能击败布尔人——在我看来这有失公允——并命令第1师在莫德河畔待命近两个月。1900年2月，罗伯茨把我所属的近卫旅从第1师抽调出来，编入波尔-卡鲁麾下的新第11师，并把梅休因勋爵降去掩护其交通线。对于这样一位只是运气不佳的骑士式军人来说，这真是个悲哀的结局。

src: Romania joined the German led invasion of the Soviet Union on June 22, 1941. Nearly 800,000 Romanian troops fought on the Eastern front. Areas that were annexed by the Soviets were reincorporated into Romania. By 1943, the tide began to turn and the Soviets pushed further west closer to Romania. Foreseeing the fall of Nazi Germany, Romania switched sides during King Michael's Coup on 23 August 1944. Romanian troops then fought alongside the Soviet Army until the end of war, reaching as far as Czechoslovakia and Austria.
dst: 罗马尼亚于1941年6月22日加入德国主导的对苏联的入侵。近80万罗马尼亚军队在东线作战。被苏联吞并的地区重新并入罗马尼亚。到1943年，形势开始逆转，苏军向西推进，逼近罗马尼亚。由于预见到纳粹德国的败亡，罗马尼亚在1944年8月23日国王米哈伊发动的政变中倒戈。此后罗马尼亚军队与苏军并肩作战直至战争结束，最远推进到捷克斯洛伐克和奥地利。

src: Romania, having declared her alliance with the Entente in the fall of 1916, had faced a devastating German offensive in Transylvania.  The Romanian armies had retreated across the Sereth River and formed the Romanian Front, our South-Western Front's southern neighbor.  The Romanian Front has been strengthened with our 4th Army and occupied the front along the Sereth River prior to the Kerensky Offensive.  In mid-July the Romanian Front also went on the offensive and moved the front line to the Putna River.  In the end, the Romanian offensive also stalled, and the line stabilized.
dst: 罗马尼亚于1916年秋宣布与协约国结盟后，在特兰西瓦尼亚遭到德军毁灭性的攻势。罗马尼亚各集团军已越过塞雷特河撤退，组成罗马尼亚方面军——我们西南方面军的南邻。罗马尼亚方面军得到我方第4集团军加强，并在克伦斯基攻势之前沿塞雷特河占领战线。七月中旬，罗马尼亚方面军也发起进攻，把战线推进到普鲁特纳河。最终，罗马尼亚的攻势同样停滞，战线趋于稳定。

src: SS Air Fuhress Inga Kohler Stercghassmann finally got Her chance to speak in the meeting of the War Cabinet." I told You all along Ilse that if You did not let Me build up the Bomber Fleets this would happen.Stalin has too many People and He will use every last one to save Russia.He still has Forces in Siberia He hasn't even tapped into yet.He's got Factories going up as I speak.Attrition is on His side,It will always be,We have to make sure it is not too lopsided in His favor.You can kill all You want on the Fronts but this War will be Won 100's of kilometers behind the Fronts.If We don't have 500 Heavy Bombers flying to cities obliterating eveything underneath them We cannot Win this War.And that has to start soon before Stalin goes underground,then even 500 bombers will not be enough.My sending 50 or a 100 is a joke.Yes We destroy stuff and the Soviets build it back over night.Yes We destroy a 100 tanks and the next day a 150 arrive to take their place.Only through total Destruction of Areas can We hope to acheive Victory.I need  400 Heavy bombers in 3 Months to get to those oilfields East of Stalingrad. I only have 286 at the moment and half are wore Out".Ilse was pissed,talked to in this tone.Everyone was thinking any second Her Luger would be pulled,Inga would be dead.Ilse stood up "Okay Frau Stercghassmann,You will have those Bombers".
dst: 党卫军空军女元首英加·科勒·施特格哈斯曼终于在战时内阁会议上得到了发言机会。“伊尔泽，我一直跟你说，不让我扩编轰炸机队，就会落到这步。斯大林人太多了，他会把最后一个人都用上保卫俄国。他在西伯利亚还有没动用的部队。就在我说话这会儿，他还在建工厂。消耗战对他有利，永远都会有利，我们必须确保它别太偏向他那一边。你在前线想杀多少都行，可这场战争将在前线后方几百公里处决出胜负。如果我们没有500架重型轰炸机飞抵各城市、把下面的一切夷平，我们就赢不了这场战争。而且必须尽快开始，趁斯大林还没转入地下——到那时候，500架都不够。我派50架、100架是个笑话。没错，我们炸掉东西，苏联人一夜之间又建起来。没错，我们击毁100辆坦克，第二天就有150辆补上来。只有对整片区域实施彻底摧毁，我们才有望取胜。我需要在3个月内拿到400架重型轰炸机，去打击斯大林格勒以东的油田。可我现在只有286架，其中一半已经报废。”伊尔泽被激怒了——竟有人用这种口气跟她说话。所有人都在想，下一秒她的鲁格手枪就会拔出来，英加会没命。伊尔泽站起身：“好，施特格哈斯曼女士，你会拿到那些轰炸机的。”

src: SS Frau Commander Genia Hahn Warlimont's response to the Frau's under Her command. There was finally light at the End of the Tunnel and Euphoria was starting to set in for the Common Frau who now thought there was a slim chance She would see the Frauland again.Genia knew the SS was going to win but also knew Stalin still had the Kalanin Front and Volga Front to fight through before Moscow would be under the Frau's Gun so a lot of Fraus were still going to perish in the struggle between Bolshevism and Nazism.Of course trying to calm the Girls down was virtually impossible.That relief soon if they lived through it would have nothing to compare to it.How can anything compare to War? How can anything compare to seeing those near You there one minute and the next to be torn asunder in a Blink of an eye?To see piles of Comrades dead or injured knowing it could have been You if not for the Grace of the Creator.Seeing the Dead,the smell of burning flesh,it would never leave Your mind how it reaked,You could taste it. And the Frau's were counting down,surely the War would be over before Christmas.Hopefully this Winter would be a little milder than the last when so many died from the elements and the Soviet Mass attacks while the Air Korps was grounded. Just a few more battles,let Me live through it the Common Frau prayed.
dst: 党卫军指挥官格尼亚·哈恩·瓦利蒙特对她麾下“女士”们的回应。隧道尽头终于有了光，普通“女士”们开始泛起一种亢奋——她们如今觉得，自己有一线希望能再见到“女性之国”了。格尼亚知道党卫军会赢，但也知道斯大林还有卡列宁方面军和伏尔加方面军要打，莫斯科才会落到“女士”们的炮口之下，因此在布尔什维主义与纳粹主义的这场搏斗中，还会有许多“女士”殒命。当然，想让姑娘们平静下来几乎不可能。那种解脱——如果她们能活着撑到——将无可比拟。什么能与战争相比？什么能与看着身边的人这一分钟还在、下一刻就在眨眼间被撕成碎片相比？看着成堆的战友死去或负伤，知道若不是造物主的恩典，那本可能是你。看着死者，闻着皮肉烧焦的气味，那味道永远留在你脑海里，你能尝到它。而“女士”们正在倒计时，战争一定会在圣诞节前结束。但愿这个冬天比去年温和些——去年那么多人死于严寒，死于苏军的大规模进攻，而当时航空军无法升空。再来几场仗就好，让我活过去吧，普通“女士”这样祈祷。

src: SS Frau Commander Stowe's Panzer III had been hit knocking a tread off.Still the Panzer fired on the 2 Soviet tanks destroying them."Good shooting Rall,let's get the Hell out of this coffin before some more Ivan's come over that hill".The crew made a run for it Soviet infantry firing at them.In some weeds,then a ravine and out of the shooting gallery.Now back with the rear units a few Mark IV's went by."Commander do You think we'll ever get one of those to fight in"? "I don't know Erika.Heard most were assigned to the Central Front because of Stalin protecting Moscow first"."Boy if it's worst there then in this area how are any of the Frau's even alive"."They got the majority of the 'Stuka's on call.Without them the Center would have done been rolled up".Back in Lennigrad Commander Stowe reported to Frau Major 'Trenrick at the Armor depot.All tanks had been assigned except for a few Mark I's which of course were Deathtraps against Ivan and mostly used for Recon though they were being pushed back into the fighting to fill the gaps."Stowe,Gwendoth Rall's in Your crew,Right.Be a shame to put Her talent in a PZ 1.Get over to the rail depot.Some Stu III's have arrived,let Rall get Her hands on a 75mm instead of these Pea Shooters she has been accustomed too".So Commander Stowe would trade the turning turret and smaller gun for a 75mm.
dst: 党卫军斯托女指挥官的3号坦克被击中，掉了一条履带。可坦克依然开火，击毁了那2辆苏军坦克。“打得好，拉尔，趁还没更多伊万翻过那座山，我们赶紧从这口棺材里撤出去。”车组弃车而逃，苏军步兵朝他们射击。他们钻进杂草丛，又下到一条沟壑，逃出了射击场。回到后方部队时，几辆四号坦克从旁边驶过。“指挥官，你觉得我们什么时候能开上那种坦克打仗？”“我不知道，埃里卡。听说大部分都拨给了中部战线，因为斯大林首先要保莫斯科。”“天哪，要是那边比这儿还糟，那些‘女士’怎么还活得下来。”“他们手里有大部分‘斯图卡’随时调用。没有那些飞机，中部早就被卷垮了。”回到列宁格勒，斯托指挥官向装甲仓库的特伦里克女少校报到。所有坦克都已分配，只剩几辆一号坦克——对付伊万它们当然就是死亡陷阱，平时多用于侦察，可如今也被推上前线填空缺。“斯托，格温多特·拉尔在你的车组里，对吧。把她的才能埋在一号坦克里太可惜了。去火车站，来了一些三号突击炮，让拉尔上手一门75毫米炮，别再摆弄她习惯的那些豌豆枪了。”于是斯托指挥官用可以旋转的炮塔和较小的火炮，换来了75毫米炮。

src: SS Frau General Ingrid Whallen talking to Frau Generals Pedderson and Gerwitzhaus. "Where Stalin gets these I don't know.We got piles laying all over the place.They stink enough when their alive but let the Bastards lay there in the Sun a few Days and the Stench will make You sick.I told the Fuhress to forget the Replacements just send Tons of Perfume.I know when the Wars over I aint living in this Land called Russia or whatever the Fuhress renames it,You'll never get the stench of the rotting Corpses out.But back to Business.They cut through the Lines and captured Luga destroying the Fuel.So now We got to move there and take it back.I got enough Fuel for that and the way I understand the Reports they had little armor,it was mostly infantry and horses.They did have those trucks with Rockets in good numbers.I know the Girls don't enjoy that sound or the aftermath,that's a Dam formidable weapon almost brings as much fear as the Flame-throwers.But we'll take it back it just 'burns Me to the Core' that once again something We payed for in Blood will cost more.I'm wondering if We will ever have a secure position here in this God-forsaken Land.So that's the situation,We move in an Hour".
dst: 党卫军英格丽德·沃伦女将军与佩德森、格维茨豪斯两位女将军交谈。“斯大林从哪儿弄来这些人，我不知道。我们这儿到处堆着尸体。他们活着的时候味道就够冲了，让这些混蛋在太阳底下躺几天，那臭气能熏得你恶心。我跟女元首说，别管补充兵了，直接送几吨香水来。我知道等战争结束，我不会住在这个叫俄国、或者女元首给它改叫别的什么名字的地方——那些腐烂尸体的臭味你永远除不掉。不过说正事。他们切穿了我们的防线，占领了卢加，还毁了燃料。所以现在我们必须过去把它夺回来。我的燃料够打这一仗；按我了解的报告，他们装甲很少，主要是步兵和马匹。他们确实有不少装火箭的卡车。我知道姑娘们不喜欢那种声音，也不喜欢事后那副景象——那是个可怕的武器，几乎和火焰喷射器一样让人恐惧。但我们会把它夺回来，只是一想到又一次要用鲜血换来的东西要再付一次代价，我就‘怒火中烧’。我在想，我们在这片被上帝遗弃的土地上，究竟能不能有一个安稳的立足点。情况就是这样，我们一小时后出发。”

src: SS Frau General Pedderson got up from the floor."For Gods sake,can't We get that Dam artillery spotted".A large caliber shell had landed near the Forward Command She was visiting the concussion knocking everyone to the ground and covering them with dust."Herr General, Frau Major Kenns of the forward Panzer Gruppe wants to speak to You".Pedderson took the Phone, "Yes relay Me.Panzer Commander Kenns We just got Our asses nearly blown off the face of the East here.Are You sight seeing or something?Get those Dam Soviet guns,what the Hells the hold-up.Why sure I would imagine they would be protected with infantry and anti-tank guns.The whole platoon.Don't tell Me You've lost all My Dam Panzers.Ahh Shit Kenns.Well get Your Ass back here,we'll move back.I'll get the mobile batteries of 'Beets to cover the withdrawal.Well hold back anymore attacks until the Air Korps makes a few runs.Yeh I'm sorry to hear that too.I see now this Zhukov is going to be a problem and We will have to not get sucked into His tank traps.After He gets a Good taste of the Flyers we'll send Him a few Heavy Mk Iv's,see what He can do with them.'Michele's Gruppe was over near Mga,think I can get them here some time tonight.We'll move tomorrow.You get Your Ass back to Dnask and take it easy for a while,You've done enough.Pedderson out".So Georgi Zhukov made an impression on Pedderson.The next few Days the Air Korps would make their own.
dst: 党卫军佩德森女将军从地上爬起来。“看在上帝份上，我们就不能把那些该死的大炮位置标出来吗。”一发大口径炮弹落在她正在视察的前方指挥所附近，冲击波把所有人掀倒在地，浑身是土。“将军阁下，前方装甲群的肯斯女少校想跟您通话。”佩德森接过电话：“好，接过来。肯斯装甲指挥官，我们这边刚差点被炸上天。你是在观光还是怎么着？把那该死的苏联炮给我端了，到底卡在哪儿了？当然，我料想它们会有步兵和反坦克炮掩护，整整一个排。别告诉我你把我那些该死的坦克全折损了。唉，妈的，肯斯。行了，你给我回来，我们后撤。我让‘贝茨’的机动炮兵连掩护撤退。在航空军出动几轮之前，先停止一切进攻。是啊，听到这个我也很难过。我现在明白了，这个朱可夫会是个麻烦，我们绝不能被他诱进坦克陷阱。等他尝够飞机的滋味，我们再送他几辆重型四号坦克，看他能怎么办。‘米凯莱’的集群在姆加附近，我想今晚某个时候能调过来。我们明天行动。你回德纳斯克，歇一阵子，你已经做得够多了。佩德森通话完毕。”于是格奥尔基·朱可夫给佩德森留下了印象。接下来几天，航空军也要给他们留个印象。

src: SS Frau General Petta Pedderson's remark of 'Zhukov opposing Her.Joseph Stalin had decided to move His General Zhukov up to the Northwest Front.This of course meant the Soviets Leaders already there were Dead Men along with their Families.Georgi had done the trick in the Center stabilizing the Front.The SS Fraus were still advancing but now it was at a Snails pace.On the South Front everything was being drawed into the Stalingrad area except a small Panzer Force north of Rostav.Stalin believed if He could destroy the Forces moving from Lennigrad and retake the City the Baltics could be rolled Up,the SS in the Center cut from it's supplies and in the works also was a Pincer operation to trap the Forces of the SS converging on Stalingrad.In Berlin the Fuhress saw in the War Cabinet meetings this same Scenario but had faith not only would Frau Pedderson's troops not be stopped by the a 'little bit above Average' Soviet Defensive General but when the Soviets had got their Forces in position for the Stalingrad counter the Air Korps would pummel them until the Panzers had nothing to engage but Bolshevik corpses.With Frau-Z recon flights behind the Soviet lines Stalin would have a Hard Time surprising the Fraus.He had the Numbers though.Would that be Enough.
dst: 这是党卫军佩塔·佩德森女将军对“朱可夫挡在她面前”的评论。约瑟夫·斯大林决定把他的朱可夫将军调往西北方面军。这自然意味着那里原有的苏联领导人及其家人都成了死人。格奥尔基在中部稳住了战线的确奏效。党卫军“女士”们仍在推进，但如今慢如蜗牛。在南线，除了罗斯托夫以北的一支小装甲部队外，一切都被吸引到斯大林格勒地区。斯大林相信，只要能歼灭从列宁格勒调来的部队并夺回该城，波罗的海地区就能被卷土收归，中部的党卫军就会被切断补给；同时还在筹划一次钳形行动，围住向斯大林格勒集中的党卫军部队。在柏林，女元首在战时内阁会议上看到的也是同样的局面，但她有信心：佩德森女士的部队不会被一个“略高于平庸”的苏军防御型将军挡住；而且一旦苏联人把兵力摆好准备斯大林格勒的反攻，航空军就会把他们轰到装甲部队只剩布尔什维克尸体可打。有“Frau-Z”在苏军后方侦察飞行，斯大林想给“女士”们一个惊喜会很困难。不过他有的是数量。数量够用吗？

src: SS Panzer Gruppe 'Rodtwher was ready to move.A Frau took a look up for a moment."Look Helga".In the Sky above a Parachute ascending slowly and landing among the girls. A SS/BdM crewmember took off Her flight helmet,brushed Her red hair and pulled out a cigarette "Hey somebody give Me a Light"."Sure,where did You come from Darling"?" Eh up there Silly,where do You think.You didn't take Me for an Angel did You"? "Nah that would be impossible,aint no Angels this Far East.Just Us trying to kill the Soviets and them trying to kill Us.A lot of Us destined to see Angels soon"."Aint that the Truth.Nah I'm originally from Strasburg.Our Bomber was 12,000 feet above to the East of here but developed some trouble.The other girls I had bail out about 6 kilometers from here and I stayed with the Bomber but then realized I couldn't save it so I pointed it East,auto-pilot on and got out.Should give the Soviets some more scrap of Ours to salvage"."How's the Bombing going up there anyway"?I think Our Heavies are doing alright on the cities,the troops in the Field I doubt if were even being a nusiance to with the numbers the Soviets got and of course trips to Moscow below 10,000 feet are suicide.Old Stalins protecting that as if it was all that matters.I really want to fly a 'Stuka but Commands assigned Me to the heavies, JU 88's at the moment and of course all of Us are assigned the Kondors as they arrive"."So We going to win this War"? "Ask the Fuhress".
dst: 党卫军“红翼”装甲群准备开拔。一名“女士”抬头看了一眼。“看，赫尔加。”头顶的天空中，一具降落伞缓缓上升，落在姑娘们中间。一名党卫军/BdM 机组人员摘下飞行头盔，理了理红发，掏出一支烟：“喂，谁给我个火。”“没问题。你是从哪儿来的，亲爱的？”“唉，上面呗，蠢货，你说呢。你不会把我当成天使了吧？”“不，那不可能，这么东边的地方没有天使。只有我们在杀苏联人，苏联人在杀我们。我们中很多人很快就注定要见到天使了。”“这倒是实话。不，我本来是斯特拉斯堡人。我们的轰炸机在往东这儿一万二千英尺高空，但出了点故障。我让其他姑娘在离这儿6公里处跳伞，我留在机上，后来发现救不了它，就把机头朝东、打开自动驾驶，然后跳了出来。该给苏联人留点我们的废铁去回收了。”“上面轰炸进行得怎么样？”“我想我们的重型轰炸机对城市还行，至于野外的部队——以苏联人那么大的数量，我怀疑我们连骚扰都算不上；而且飞到莫斯科低过一万英尺就是自杀。老斯大林把它保护得像命根子一样。我真想飞‘斯图卡’，可上头把我分到了重型机，眼下是 Ju 88；当然，‘秃鹰’一到货，我们所有人都得改飞它。”“那我们这仗能打赢吗？”“去问女元首吧。”

src: SS/BdM Air Fuhress Inga Stercghassmann had Her Bomber Fleets up and running now.The Kondor's of the Fleets were getting the Point across to Stalin that in time He would lose the War if He did not stop the Flying Fraus.With Frau-Z recons dashing across the Skies 100's of kilometers behind the Lines and reporting back for Inga to survey what She wanted obliterated Stalin knew the Nazi Fleets had to be stopped.The Russians still had plenty of planes and Pilots of course but Stalin made a request to His Allies to aid in the Skies over Mother Russia in better numbers.American and Soviet planners knew attrition should in the End get both the Sneaky Japs and the SS Bitches if the casulties weren't too outrageous which of course the Soviets were.In Berlin the War Cabinet knew Joseph Stalin's procedures of Fear and Death towards His own People that the Horrendous numbers lost at the Fronts meant if the Great Cities of the Soviet Union was in the hands of the SS Stalins grip on them and especially Soviet officers would be the Soviets End and the Country would revert into Civil War causing it's downfall. Leningrad was already in SS Hands,another few months and Moscow would be if the Soviet Armor showing up in the Center Front could be in lesser numbers.The Destruction of the Factories at Kolshaznol was part of the Answer.
dst: 党卫军/BdM 空军女元首英加·施特格哈斯曼的轰炸机队如今已投入运转。“秃鹰”机群正让斯大林明白：不及时遏制这些“飞行的女士”，他迟早会输掉战争。随着“Frau-Z”侦察机掠过战线后方数百公里的天空、把情报带回供英加挑选要夷平的目标，斯大林清楚地知道，纳粹机群必须被阻止。俄国人当然还有大量飞机和飞行员，但斯大林请求他的盟友以更大规模援助“母亲俄罗斯”上空的空战。美苏的谋划者都清楚，只要伤亡不过于离谱，消耗战最终会同时拖垮那些偷偷摸摸的日本人和党卫军娘们——而苏联人的伤亡自然离谱。在柏林，战时内阁明白，约瑟夫·斯大林对自己人民惯用恐惧和死亡的手段；前线骇人的损失意味着，一旦苏联的大城市落入党卫军之手，斯大林对这些城市、尤其是对苏军军官的掌控就将终结，国家会陷入内战而崩溃。列宁格勒已在党卫军手中，再几个月，如果中部战线出现的苏军装甲能减少的话，莫斯科也会到手。摧毁科尔沙兹诺尔的工厂，就是答案的一部分。

src: STAFF INTEL : Choose to get a VICTORY to lead the North African Campaign - OR - Choose a TACTICAL VICTORY to join the Balkan Campaign.
dst: 参谋情报：选择取得“胜利”以领导北非战役——或——选择取得“战术胜利”以参加巴尔干战役。

src: STAFF INTEL:  The British will show their usual resilience but slow to maneuver.  The RAF will be active.  The only Greek presence will be some partisan activity.
dst: 参谋情报：英军会展现其一贯的韧性，但机动迟缓。皇家空军会很活跃。希腊方面只有一些游击活动。

src: STAFF INTEL:  The Russians are defending in depth and have several large tank brigades to counterattack with.  We must defeat them in detail - AND move quickly in no less than divisional battle-groups.
dst: 参谋情报：俄军纵深防御，并握有几个大型坦克旅可用于反攻。我们必须逐个击破——并以不小于师级战斗群的规模快速行动。

src: STAFF INTEL:  The Russians will take at least 3-4 turns to break through the IT 8th Army.  We should first plug the holes. and then clear the west side of the Don of Russians.
dst: 参谋情报：俄军至少需要3-4个回合才能突破意大利第8集团军。我们应先堵住缺口，然后肃清顿河西岸的俄军。

src: STAFF INTEL: Choose to get a VICTORY to join 4th Panzer Army's attack to establish contact with 6th army - OR - Choose a TACTICAL VICTORY to reinforce our Italian 8th Army's defense of the Don.
dst: 参谋情报：选择取得“胜利”以加入第4装甲集团军的进攻、与第6集团军建立联系——或——选择取得“战术胜利”以加强我意大利第8集团军对顿河的防御。

src: STAFF INTEL: Choose to get a VICTORY to join Army Group Center - OR - Choose a TACTICAL VICTORY to join Army Group South.
dst: 参谋情报：选择取得“胜利”以加入中央集团军群——或——选择取得“战术胜利”以加入南方集团军群。

src: STAFF INTEL: Everything seems to favor the Russians, but 3 battle groups should be able to advance and achieve victory.  The Russians are defending in depth again - we must keep our units near full strength.
dst: 参谋情报：一切似乎都利于俄军，但3个战斗群应能推进并取胜。俄军再次纵深防御——我们必须让部队保持接近满员。

src: STAFF INTEL: SPEED is paramount - Reconnaisance will be critical because the Yugoslavs have roadbloacks and strong points in depth.
dst: 参谋情报：速度至关重要——侦察将是关键，因为南斯拉夫人纵深处设有路障和支撑点。

src: STAFF INTEL: Sir, we need to drive fast and hard with all our forces, the Republicans are projected to deploy strong reinforcements to this sector soon.
dst: 参谋情报：长官，我们需要倾全力快速猛攻，预计共和派很快会向这一地段部署强大的援军。

src: STAFF INTEL: The Allies are spread thin but we have a long way to go General, The Allies will fight harder the closer we get to the sea.  The Allies air-power could be some trouble also.
dst: 参谋情报：盟军兵力稀薄，但将军，我们还有很长的路要走。我们越接近大海，盟军就会拼得越凶。盟军的空中力量也可能带来一些麻烦。

src: STAFF INTEL: The Allies have ground, air and sea units to repel our counter-attack, we must focus on maneuver towards objectives to be successful.
dst: 参谋情报：盟军拥有陆、空、海部队可击退我们的反攻，我们必须专注于向目标机动方能取胜。

src: STAFF INTEL: The British line is thin but tough.  We can expect them to maneuver little and the distances are great thus our speed is essential.  When attacking, we'll need to have local mass to be successful.
dst: 参谋情报：英军防线虽薄却坚韧。我们可以预料他们机动不多，而距离遥远，因此我们的速度至关重要。进攻时，我们需要在局部形成兵力优势才能取胜。

src: STAFF INTEL: The French front lines troops are generally poor quality and their supposed readiness level is low, but, however several first class divisions are nearby, we must cross the rivers area quickly.
dst: 参谋情报：法军前线部队素质普遍较差，其所谓战备水平也低，不过附近有几个一流的师，我们必须迅速渡过河流地区。

src: STAFF INTEL: The Germans will have Mechanized reinforcements from the North and units comming from Crete via air from the south.  However, ELAS will mobilize to help scout our advance, and are ready for a sneak attack on the Southern Airfield.
dst: 参谋情报：德军将有来自北面的机械化援军，以及从克里特空运来的南面部队。不过，ELAS 将动员起来协助侦察我方推进，并准备对南部机场发动偷袭。

src: STAFF INTEL: The Luftwaffe is completely occupied up north, but our air forces will be sufficient - resistance should be mostly light and we should be able to complete the drive in just a few days.
dst: 参谋情报：德国空军在北面应接不暇，但我方空军已足够——抵抗应该大体轻微，我们应该能在短短几天内完成推进。

src: STAFF INTEL: The RAF and RN are the biggest threats.  The ground forces are heavy with anti-aircraft so our air forces are better off helping our own naval combat.
dst: 参谋情报：皇家空军和皇家海军是最大威胁。地面部队防空火力很强，所以我们的空军最好用于支援我们自己的海战。

src: STAFF INTEL: The Russian attack developing from the south is composed of two full Soviet armies, we are GREATLY concerned General.
dst: 参谋情报：从南面展开的俄军进攻由两个整编苏军集团军组成，我们深感忧虑，将军。

src: STAFF INTEL: The Russian front lines are thin but have good troops.  In addition several Tank and Mech formations are in close reserve posing a considerable threat.
dst: 参谋情报：俄军前线兵力单薄，但部队精锐。此外，数个坦克和机械化编队就在近处待命，构成相当大的威胁。

src: STAFF INTEL: The Russians are already heading east and have bridged the river-balkas, but they are spread out, we must not allow them to mass.
dst: 参谋情报：俄军已在向东移动，并架起了跨越河沟的桥，但他们兵力分散，我们绝不能让他们集结。

src: STAFF INTEL: The Russians are spread out but their Tanks and Artillery cab present a serious threat.   We must control the air quickly to perform the advance as planned.
dst: 参谋情报：俄军兵力分散，但其坦克和炮兵构成严重威胁。我们必须迅速夺取制空权，才能按计划推进。

src: STAFF INTEL: The poles should show stubborn resistance at fisrt, but once we break through the front lines we should be able to move quickly to our objectives.
dst: 参谋情报：波军起初会顽强抵抗，但一旦我们突破前线，就应能迅速向目标推进。

src: STAFF INTEL: This will be a hard fight General, the winter cold and the huge tanks the Russians have will make this a tough battle.  We should make sure to keep our units at near full strength for anything may happen in the snows.
dst: 参谋情报：将军，这将是一场硬仗，冬日的严寒和俄军的巨型坦克会让战斗十分艰难。我们务必让部队保持接近满员，因为雪地里什么情况都可能发生。

src: STAVKA agrees with you Comrade Marshal; the drive to capture Mogilev will be critical to the overall success of the Bagration operation. The German forces holding the Mogilev sector have a high proportion of very good units which cannot be allowed to reinforce either of the sectors to the north or south. Your's and general Zakarov's primary objectives are: capture Mogilev, thus taking control of the network of roads running from Mogilev to Minsk, and also to pin down the bulk of the German 4th Armee while the parallel offensives are taking place around Vitebsk and Bobruisk...
dst: STAVKA同意你的看法，元帅同志；夺取莫吉廖夫的行动对巴格拉季昂行动的整体成败至关重要。据守莫吉廖夫地段的德军编成中精锐单位比例很高，绝不能让它们去增援北面或南面的任何一个地段。你和扎哈罗夫将军的首要目标是：夺取莫吉廖夫，从而控制从莫吉廖夫通往明斯的道路网，同时在维捷布斯克和博布鲁伊斯克一带的平行攻势展开之际，牵制住德国第4集团军的主力……

src: STAVKA is apparantly under the impression their troops are still advancing and has marched 3rd Tank Army - a mighty force of 3 Inf divisions, 3 Tank brigades and a Guard Cav Corps in a gap which had openend between our division and the Leibstandarte. Your task is to trap these formations and capture Kharkov.
dst: 苏联最高统帅部显然还以为他们的部队仍在推进，竟把第3坦克集团军——一支由3个步兵师、3个坦克旅和一个近卫骑兵军组成的强大兵力——开进了我们师与警卫旗队之间出现的缺口。你的任务是围住这些部队并夺取哈尔科夫。
斯维尔德洛夫斯克——1942年9月19日
破坏者 - 对付硬目标。

dst: 萨克森卫队骑兵团/ 第23旅/ 第12骑兵师 / XII (萨克森) 军/ 第2集团军

src: Sadly General, you have chosen to exit the campaign.
dst: 遗憾的是，将军，你选择了退出战役。

src: Sadly sixth army and the Caucasus army were not able to hold on to the eastern Don bend. Mussolini will be glad that you saved his obsolete 8th army, but for the strategic situation this won't matter:
dst: 遗憾的是第六集团军与高加索集团军未能守住顿河河曲东部。墨索里尼会为您救下他过时的第八集团军而高兴，但对战略态势而言这无关紧要：

src: Sadly that is not true for the southern border...
dst: 遗憾的是，南部边境并非如此……

src: Sadly the British have retreated in perfect order. They're still a menacing army, and our troops are too tired to keep on attacking them. We'll have to lift the siege of Kimberley and go on the defensive.
dst: 遗憾的是，英军秩序井然地撤退了。他们仍是一支具有威胁的军队，而我们的部队已疲惫不堪，无法继续进攻。我们只得解除金伯利之围并转入防御。

src: Sadly you were not able to stop the bulk of the BEF from retreating back across the Channel. They are sure to be waiting eagerly when our Panzers arrive in England next summer.
dst: 遗憾的是，你未能阻止英国远征军大部撤回海峡对岸。明年夏天我们的装甲部队抵达英格兰时，他们必定会急切地等着我们。

src: Sadly, almost at the same time, in our northern border there was a quarrel between different clans of Ethiopian and Eritrean Tigrayans. The quarrel led to a riot, and there were some dead in both sides. Then the Italians sent a platoon of ascaris to restore order and, unfortunately, the Ethiopian rioters attacked them and killed some of them, too.
dst: 遗憾的是，几乎在同一时间，在我们的北部边境，埃塞俄比亚提格雷人与厄立特里亚提格雷人的不同氏族之间发生了争执。争执演变成骚乱，双方都有人死亡。随后意大利人派了一个排的阿斯卡里士兵前去恢复秩序，不幸的是，埃塞俄比亚的暴乱者袭击了他们，也杀死了其中一些人。

src: Sadly, our victory isn't complete. Our enemies still threaten the south eastern mountain passes that lead to the Hungarian Plains and, worst of all, in these past days we've been forced to use our last reserves. Our troops are exhausted and can't go on with the counteroffensive. That means that we won't be able to help the defenders of Premissel, at least for now.
dst: 遗憾的是，我们的胜利并不完整。我们的敌人仍威胁着通向匈牙利平原的东南山口，而最糟的是，这些天我们被迫动用了最后的预备队。我们的部队已精疲力竭，无法继续反攻。这意味着我们暂时无法解救普热梅希尔的守军了。

src: Sadly, we couldn't advance any further. The Japanese still had the resources to disembark more troops in mainland China and, if they attacked Manchuria again, or even Weihawei, our elite troops would have to move quickly to that area and overcome the new threat.That would be an impossible task if the Chinese soldiers were stationed in Korea.
dst: 遗憾的是，我们无法再向前推进。日本人仍有资源在中国本土登陆更多部队，如果他们再次进攻满洲，甚至进攻威海卫，我们的精锐部队就不得不迅速开赴该地区并化解新的威胁。倘若中国士兵驻扎在朝鲜，那将是一项不可能完成的任务。

src: Sadly, we had even bigger problems. In the north, our Siberian Army had liberated Glazov, but it seemed unable to follow its advance and take Vyatka. And the partisans had become a real problem They attacked the railroads everywhere, so our supply lines were in danger. In fact, we had to cancel our plans for new operations, and my men had to spend the rest of the summer pursuing bands of partisans between Samara and Belebei. After so many victories, wasting more than two months in minor operations was disheartening. It meant that the war would last until the next winter, at the very least.

src: Santander ha caido, la mayor parte de las tropas vascas se han rendido al CTV en la ciudad costera de Santona, abriendo las puertas de Asturias a nuestra ofensiva. La situacion de Asturias es ciertamente algo mas complicada; el general Aranda esta encerrado en Oviedo desde el comienzo de la guerra, abastecido unicamente por un estrecho corredor que los republicanos hostigan continuamente. Ademas, el enemigo esta tratando de crear una linea defensiva a lo largo del rio Sella, con la que pretenden detenernos.Teniendo en cuenta que el lluviosisimo clima asturiano estara de su parte y que la temporada invernal parece haberse adelantado las cosas pueden complicarse si no se tiene cuidado.
dst: 桑坦德已经陷落，大部分巴斯克部队已在沿海城市桑托尼亚向意大利志愿军团（CTV）投降，为我方的攻势打开了通往阿斯图里亚斯的大门。阿斯图里亚斯的局势确实要复杂一些；阿兰达将军自战争爆发起就被围困在奥维耶多，仅靠一条狭窄的走廊补给，而共和军不断袭扰。此外，敌军正试图沿塞利亚河建立一道防线，企图以此阻挡我们。考虑到多雨的阿斯图里亚斯气候将站在他们一边，而且冬季似乎已经提前到来，若不小心，局势可能会变得复杂。

dst: 桑坦德已经陷落。大部分巴斯克部队在海岸城镇桑托尼亚向我们投降，这为进军阿斯图里亚斯——北方共和派的最后堡垒——打开了大门。阿斯图里亚斯的局势有些复杂。

src: Santander has fallen. The most of the Basque troops have surrendered to us in the coast town of Santona, opening the door to Asturias, last redoubt of the Republicans in the North. The situation in Asturias is a bit complicated; the general Aranda is besieged in Oviedo since the past year, only supported by a narrow corridor, and some Republican divisions are surrounding the city. Moreover, the enemy is trying to create a defensive line along the Sella river to stop our forces, and, unfortunately for us, the extremely rainy Asturian weather will support them with heavy rains.
dst: 桑坦德已经陷落。大部分巴斯克部队已在沿海城市桑托尼亚向我们投降，打开了通往阿斯图里亚斯的大门——那是共和军在北方最后的据点。阿斯图里亚斯的局势有些复杂；阿兰达将军自去年起就被围困在奥维耶多，仅靠一条狭窄的走廊支撑，而一些共和军师正包围着该城。此外，敌军正试图沿塞利亚河建立一道防线以阻挡我军，而对我们不利的是，极为多雨的阿斯图里亚斯天气将以大雨助他们一臂之力。

dst: 萨莎·霍顿跑进大楼。“塔莎，塔莎，你到底在哪儿。”“在这儿，你这疯丫头，你要干嘛。”“看，这就是那个问题的答案。”图纸被抽出来，上面像小孩乱涂的无意义数字、字母和火柴棍式的线条都被看了一遍。“萨莎，你这疯狂的党卫军丫头，你做到了。我敢肯定这能行，现在去搞那些该死的资源和稀有材料。天哪我爱你，小妹，你救了我们的命，我们那该死的‘Batt 能飞了。”“是啊姐，有了它我们就能打赢对苏联、甚至对美国的战争，我们的‘Batt 太先进了。”“是啊，现在唯一能拦住我们的就是女元首掐断帝国马克了。”“别担心，我认识一个叫阿曼达的飞行员，她想飞我们的‘Batt。她从美国来，带了一群朋友，他们带来了一大堆帝国马克。她至少能凑到钱把第一架送上天。等女元首看到，她就会服气，前几天那封说项目资助可能在29号被终止的信也就成了废纸。”“萨莎，我们赶紧走，去庆祝，叫上大伙儿痛快几天。让女元首和她派来盯着我们和那些宝贝帝国马克的盖世太保走狗们干着急去吧。下周我们把一切都理顺。差一点项目就黄了，这压力实在太大了。我跟你说过我爱你吗，小妹？”

dst: 到9月，第8集团军巩固了塔尔诺波尔的南翼，守住了战线。在北面，第3集团军在德奥联军猛烈火力下继续撤退。穿过科马罗夫-托马舒夫和拉瓦鲁斯卡的战场，该集团军逼近了霍尔姆附近维普日河沿岸一线——那里曾是1914年俄军加利西亚攻势期间方面军司令部所在地。

dst: 眼见留在俄国毫无前途，捷克军团决定设法离开俄国。最终的计划是横穿西伯利亚，利用西伯利亚大铁路抵达符拉迪沃斯托克，再乘船前往法国。在巴赫马奇作战之后的几周里，军团分散在奔萨与乌拉尔山脉之间的铁路沿线。

src: Seeing that China was a tougher enemy than they had previously thought, that the legations crisis had been solved and that the Yihetuan had been outlawed, most foreign nations agreed to negotiate with the Qing Empire. China really wanted to stablish good relations with the United Kingdom, Germany, France and all the Western powers, but the Chinese demanded to be treated as equals. The time of the invasions, the ultimatums, the territorial concessions and the unequal treaties was over. China was a sovereign country and wouldn't tolerate any new foreign interference in its internal affairs. As a proof of its good intentions, the Chinese goverment would indemnify the victims of the Yihetuan and would grant the safety of the christians and their right to express their beliefs. After some weeks of tense negotiations, most countries agreed to those terms and retired their troops.
dst: 看到中国是一个比他们原先料想更难对付的敌人，看到使馆危机已经解决、义和团也已被取缔，大多数外国都同意与清帝国谈判。中国确实很想与英国、德国、法国以及所有西方列强建立良好关系，但中国人要求被平等对待。入侵、最后通牒、领土租界和不平等条约的时代已经结束。中国是一个主权国家，不会再容忍任何对其内政的新干涉。作为其良好意愿的证明，中国政府将赔偿义和团暴行的受害者，保证基督徒的安全及其表达信仰的权利。经过几周紧张的谈判，大多数国家接受了这些条款并撤走了军队。

src: Sevastopol, home of the Soviet Black Sea Fleet, must be taken so that we can begin our upcoming campaign in the Ukraine and the Caucasus without a major enemy fortress threatening our right flank. Sevastopol has been under siege and has been pounded by air and artillery for 5 straight days, but you should expect the entrenchments and forts you attack to be the toughest you have ever faced in the war. You must take Sevastopol and the surrounding objectives by no later than June 23rd or our offensive in the south will be compromised. An earlier completion of your mission will only make it easier to prevail over the Soviets later this year.
dst: 塞瓦斯托波尔是苏联黑海舰队的基地，必须将其攻占，我们才能在没有敌军大型要塞威胁右翼的情况下，展开即将在乌克兰和高加索进行的战役。塞瓦斯托波尔已被围困，并连续5天遭受空中与炮火的打击，但你应当预料到，你所攻击的工事与要塞将是这场战争中你面对过的最坚固的防御。你必须在6月23日之前夺取塞瓦斯托波尔及周边目标，否则我们在南方的攻势将受到牵制。任务越早完成，今年晚些时候压制苏联人就越容易。

src: Several 'New Army' brigades are eagerly waiting to be landed at Suvla, but I am afraid your veteran 29th Division will have to bear the brunt of the attack, since these brigades are totally unexperienced and have never fired a single shot in battle so far.
dst: 几个「新军」旅正急切地等待在苏夫拉登陆，但恐怕您那身经百战的第29师仍将承受进攻的主要压力，因为这些旅毫无经验，迄今在战斗中还从未放过一枪。

src: Several Brescia and Trento division troops are ready for a diversion West of the breach. Support those efforts and send troops to dislodge the German units.
dst: 布雷西亚师和特伦托师的一些部队已在突破口以西准备好进行佯攻。支援这些行动，并派部队接应德军的这两支部队脱身。

src: Several German divisions have taken position ahead of you. They might carry out small scale counterattacks to disrupt our advance.
dst: 已有数个德军师在你们前方占领阵地。他们可能实施小规模反击以扰乱我们的推进。

src: Several days of heavy fighting have taken place with both sides having lost thousands of men and hundreds of vehicles. But in the end the fascists couldn't drive us into the Prut River. We still have our bridgehead over the Prut River near Jassy. Preparations for the invasion of Rumania are taking place.
dst: 几天的激战过后，双方都损失了数千人和数百辆车辆。但最终，法西斯没能把我们赶进普鲁特河。我们仍在雅西附近拥有着普鲁特河上的桥头堡。入侵罗马尼亚的准备工作正在进行。

src: Several of our agents in Moscow were recently killed attempting to retrieve information on the diversion of key Soviet elite units to new theaters.  Luckily, in their final moments one of them was able to relay a message to the spooks working stateside.  Commander, as audacious as it sounds, the Soviets have been planning an invasion of the Eastern United States, and they're about to carry out their mission.
dst: 我们在莫斯科的几名特工近日在试图获取有关苏联精锐部队调往新战区的关键情报时被杀。所幸，其中一人在临终前成功把一条消息传给了本土的情报人员。指挥官，说来难以置信，苏联人一直在筹划入侵美国东部，而且他们即将付诸行动。

src: Several weeks later Aguinaldo and his forces began the arduous retreat march towards a mountainous area in central Philippines. The military weakness and internal divisions in the Katipunan forced Aguinaldo to later sign the Pact of Biak-na-Bato on December 15, 1897. Under the Pact Aguinaldo agreed to end hostilities and dissolve his government in exchange for amnesty and an indemnity. On 23 December, Aguinaldo and other insurgent officials departed for Hong Kong to enter voluntary exile.
dst: 几周后，阿吉纳尔多及其部队开始了向菲律宾中部山区的艰苦撤退行军。军事上的孱弱和卡蒂普南内部的分裂，迫使阿吉纳尔多后来于1897年12月15日签署《比阿克纳巴托协定》。根据该协定，阿吉纳尔多同意停止敌对行动、解散政府，以换取赦免和赔款。12月23日，阿吉纳尔多及其他起义官员启程前往香港，开始自愿流亡。
北德文斯克 (莫洛托夫斯克)
塞克斯图斯·科尔内利乌斯·雷彭提努斯
塞克斯图斯·昆提利乌斯·孔狄亚努斯

src: Seymour's relief force never reached Peking. Although they actually defeated the Chinese soldiers, they suffered many casualties and Seymour, knowing that many more Chinese units awaited him in Peking, decided to end this adventure two weeks after it started. The Westerner sailors retreated to Tientsin, where they hoped that they'd receive reinforcements very soon. We regrouped and chased them, but not before my father in law assured me that, after expelling the foreign army from China, we'd send our troops against the Yihetuan.
dst: 西摩的救援部队始终没能抵达北京。尽管他们确实击败了中国士兵，但他们伤亡惨重，而且西摩知道在北京还有更多中国部队在等着他，于是决定在这段冒险开始两周后将其终结。西方水兵们撤退到天津，希望很快能得到增援。我们重新集结并追击他们，但在此之前，我的岳父向我保证，把外国军队逐出中国之后，我们就会派兵去对付义和团。

src: Seymour's relief force never reached Peking. The foreign sailors fought bravely, but they weren't a serious menace for the Qing elite troops. The Westerner survivors retreated to Tientsin, where they hoped that they'd receive reinforcements very soon. We regrouped and chased them, but not before my father in law assured me that, after expelling the foreign army from China, we'd send our troops against the Yihetuan.
dst: 西摩的救援部队始终没能抵达北京。外国水兵们英勇作战，但对清军精锐部队并不构成真正的威胁。西方幸存者撤退到天津，希望很快能得到增援。我们重新集结并追击他们，但在此之前，我的岳父向我保证，把外国军队逐出中国之后，我们就会派兵去对付义和团。
210毫米迫击炮分队(配属)/-/-/-/卡梅拉纳 [CAS]

src: Shame on you. Even the lack of anti-tank guns in Tobruk's garrison, the abscence of the RAF and the fact that the inexperienced South African General Klopper clearly expected an attack from the West did not lead to the fall of Tobruk.
dst: 你真丢人。即便托布鲁克守军缺乏反坦克炮、皇家空军不见踪影、缺乏经验的南非将军克洛珀又显然以为进攻会来自西面，托布鲁克仍未被攻下。

src: Shame on you. You failed to defeat the BEF. Luckily the French 5th Army on the BEF's right flank is retreating and the BEF needs to do the same to avoid getting surrounded.
dst: 真丢人。您未能击败英国远征军。所幸英国远征军右翼的法军第5集团军正在撤退，英国远征军为免被包围也不得不照做。
阿拉伯河 [不可通行河流]

src: She will be of benefit for us till the end of war...
dst: 它会一直对我们有益，直到战争结束……

src: Ships of the Royal Navy will support your troops with all their firepower, so you should be able to thwart the Turkish plans to cross the Canal and defend our outposts on the eastern shore. We cannot allow the Turks to threaten our most important supply line. So cross the Canal with your troops as soon as possible and clear the whole area.
dst: 皇家海军的舰船将以全部火力支援您的部队，因此您应当能够挫败土耳其人渡河的图谋，并守住我们在东岸的前哨。我们绝不能让土耳其人威胁我们最重要的补给线。因此，尽快率部渡过运河，肃清整个地区。
突击团/ 志愿兵集团军

dst: 射击训练与空心装药课程

dst: 墨西哥，尤卡坦半岛海岸线

dst: 进攻开始不久，干燥的平原上扬起大片尘土，马略和他的部队一开始没找到辛布里人，四处游走了一阵，才意外从背后撞上敌人。

src: Shortly after the beginning of the attack a huge cloud of dust arose from the dry plains, so Marius first missed the Cimbris and wandered around for a while with his troops, until they met by chance on the enemy from behind.
dst: 进攻开始不久，干燥的平原上扬起大片尘土，马略一开始没找到辛布里人，带着部队四处游走了一阵，才意外从背后撞上敌人。

src: Shortly later the metropolis we know today, arose on the former marsh between the seven hills of loosely scattered villages
dst: 不久之后，我们今天所知的那座大都会，就在七座山之间、原本是沼泽的地方、由零散村落的基础上崛起

src: Sicily couldn't be held, and as such, it was evacuated after several weeks of battle. There was nothing else what could have been done, and it was thanks to an amazing planning and coordination that the retreat to Italian mainland was finished without heavy losses.
dst: 西西里守不住，于是经过数周战斗后被迫撤离。事已至此别无他法，幸亏周密的计划与协同，撤往意大利本土的行动才得以在无重大损失的情况下完成。

dst: 敖德萨围城战 第一部 1941年8月18日

dst: 敖德萨围城战 第二部 1941年9月20日

src: Sientese por favor, y atienda mis ordenes.  As you may know General the war is about to end.  We need  to inflict one more blow to the badly wounded enemy forces the so-called ''People's Army''.  The very best of the remaining enemy forces are located at Catalonia.   It is the last Republican stronghold in direct contact with a foreign border.  We know the French are debating on whether to intervene and send the Republicans some Soviet weapons that have been blocked at the French boarder.  This is unacceptable as it will allow them to prolong the war.  This would be disastrous for the National cause if a new World War finally exploded.
dst: 请坐，听取我的命令。将军，您大概知道，战争即将结束。我们需要再给重伤的敌军——所谓的「人民军」——一次打击。敌军残存部队中最精锐的部分位于加泰罗尼亚。那是共和派最后一个与外国边境直接接壤的据点。我们知道法国人正在辩论是否干预，把被阻在法国边境的苏联武器送给共和派。这是不可接受的，因为那会让他们把战争拖长。如果新的世界大战最终爆发，这对民族事业将是灾难性的。

src: Sientese porfavor, pasare a explicarle la situacion. La cosa se ha tornado exageradamente peligrosa en el sector de Gandesa, cerca de la gran curva del Ebro antes de Amposta. Un poderoso ataque a traves del Ebro con lo mejor que tienen los rojos ha pulverizado a nuestra 50 Division. Bien es cierto que eran tropas inexpertas, pero no podemos permitir que los republicanos prosigan mas alla de Gandesa .
dst: 请坐，我来向您说明局势。甘德萨一带的情况已变得极其危险，就在阿姆波斯塔之前埃布罗河大转弯附近。共和军倾其精锐强渡埃布罗河，一场猛烈的进攻将我们的第50师彻底击溃。诚然，他们是一支缺乏经验的部队，但我们绝不能容许共和军越过甘德萨继续推进。

src: Silang was the first victory of the Spanish campaign of 1897 to recapture the territories of Cavite province which had fallen into Filipino hands in the early phase of the revolution in 1896. It was an important stronghold in the way to Imus, the seat of Aguinaldo's revolutionary government and the first main objective of the Spanish offensive.
dst: 西朗是西班牙1897年战役中的第一场胜利，该战役旨在收复在1896年革命初期落入菲律宾人手中的甲米地省各地区。它是通往伊穆斯——阿吉纳尔多革命政府所在地、也是西班牙攻势的第一个主要目标——途中的一处重要据点。

src: Simply put, we can not fail here, the British are sending more troops to this region every day after their failure in France...but let us part with a positive note...See you in Tobruk!
dst: 简而言之，这里我们绝不能失败。英军在法国失败后，每天都在向该地区增兵……但让我们以积极的口吻道别……托布鲁克见！

src: Since 1885 the Mahdists had carried out sporadic border raids into Ethiopia. Tired of that, in January 1887 the King of Gojjam, Tekle Haymanot, who at that time was a loyal vassal of Yohannes, sacked the Sudanese border town of Gallabat.
dst: 自1885年以来，马赫迪分子不断对埃塞俄比亚进行零星的边境袭扰。对此忍无可忍的戈贾姆国王特克莱·海马诺特——他当时是约翰内斯忠实的封臣——于1887年1月洗劫了苏丹边境城镇加拉巴特。

src: Since 1915 the Bulgarians have fought in Macedonia against superior forces. Their performance has been excellent and they've achieved quite a good number of defensive victories, but they simply aren't strong enough to attack and pierce the enemy lines. Now that the Entente Spring Offensive in France has died down, it's time to help them and to win the war in the Balkans.
dst: 自1915年以来，保加利亚人一直在马其顿与优势敌军作战。他们的表现十分出色，取得过相当多的防御胜利，但他们就是不够强大，无力进攻并突破敌军防线。如今协约国在法国的春季攻势已逐渐平息，是时候去帮助他们、在巴尔干赢得战争了。

src: Since October 1920, the Greek army advanced further east into Anadolu, and nothing could stop them until three months later, when a Greek reconnaissance force was stopped here, at Inonu, by the army of the Grand National Assembly.
dst: 自1920年10月起，希腊军队进一步向东推进进入安纳托利亚，无人能挡，直到三个月后，一支希腊侦察部队在伊诺努被大国民议会军队拦住。

src: Since a few days ago a  republican column is chasing  throughout the region. At present it proceeds from Echávarri to Eraúl. But it has separated too much from the other  enemy columns, so we have a great opportunity to fight back and force them to surrender.
dst: 几天来，一支共和军纵队一直在该地区追击。眼下它正从埃查瓦里向埃劳尔推进。但它与其他敌军纵队脱离得太远，因此我们有了一个绝佳的机会进行反击，迫使他们投降。

src: Since a successful invasion of France has been deemed impossible this year, HQ has decided on an invasion of the island of Sicily. The goal is to remove Sicily as a base for Axis shipping and aircraft, thus allowing free passage to Allied ships in the Mediterranean sea. Although HQ doesn't fully agree on it yet, it could also act as a precursor to an invasion of Italy. You and your men will now embark immediately for Sicily, where you will be under the overall command of General Montgomery. Your planned landing zone is in the Southern tip area of Sicily, between Pachino and it's airfield. From there you will move Northwest along National Road 124, while the British 8th Army will take Siracusa, and then move North from there. Good luck General....
dst: 既然今年已断定无法成功入侵法国，总部决定改为入侵西西里岛。目标是使西西里不再成为轴心国海运与航空的基地，从而让盟军船只在地中海自由通行。尽管总部对此尚未完全认同，但这次行动也可以作为入侵意大利的前奏。你和你的部下现在立即登船前往西西里，在那里你将接受蒙哥马利将军的统一指挥。你们计划的登陆区位于西西里岛南端，在帕基诺及其机场之间。从那里你们将沿124号国道向西北推进，而英国第8集团军将攻取锡拉库萨，然后从那里向北推进。祝你好运，将军……

src: Since all their attempts to attack us in France or on the eastern front, the allies created a Anglo-Soviet force in their desperation. The remnants of the Soviet arctic fleet take part in this operation.
dst: 由于在法国或东线发起的进攻屡遭失败，盟军在绝望中组建了一支英苏联合部队。苏联北极舰队的残余舰艇也参与了此次行动。

src: Since last year a secret organization called Katipunan has started an armed revolt with the goal to get the independence of the Philippines from Spain. Although an attack on Manila in August failed, the revolt has spread to other provinces, especially Cavite province, the main centre of rebellion. In Cavite, our troops, often heavily outnumbered, have been repeatedly defeated and katipuneros, led by Emilio Aguinaldo, have gained control over almost the entire territory of the province.
dst: 自去年起，一个名为卡蒂普南的秘密组织发动了武装起义，旨在使菲律宾脱离西班牙而独立。尽管8月对马尼拉的进攻失败，起义仍蔓延到了其他省份，尤其是起义中心的甲米地省。在甲米地，我们的部队常常在兵力上处于严重劣势，屡遭败绩，由埃米利奥·阿奎纳多领导的卡蒂普南分子几乎控制了全省全境。

src: Since many months the Germans has the bridgehead at the black sea. We could push them back, but all tries to destroy the Germans and their allied failed. We have reliable information that the Germans plans to evacuate the bridgehead preventing a cut off. We want attack before they can escape. Force an attack and destroy the German forces.
dst: 德军占据黑海沿岸的桥头堡已有数月之久。我们曾将他们击退，但所有歼灭德军及其盟军的尝试都失败了。我们有可靠情报表明，德军计划在桥头堡撤离以避免被切断。我们要在他们逃走之前发起进攻。强行发起进攻，歼灭德军。

src: Since our forces here at Cape Helles are to remain largely on the defensive, we could need the help of your veteran troops both at Suvla Bay and at Ari Burnu. You may decide where your men will be more useful.
dst: 由于我们在海勒斯角的部队将大体保持守势，我们在苏夫拉湾和阿里伯努都可能需要您老兵部队的帮助。您可以决定您的士兵在哪里更有用。

src: Since our spring offensives we have a bridgehead into Rumania over the Prut River, near Jassy.  The fascists have taken blow after blow but somehow have regained their spirit. We are convinced the enemy has concentrated a huge force to eliminate our bridgehead. We must hold it. It is an ideal starting point for the invasion of Rumania which is plannend within some months.
dst: 自春季攻势以来，我们在普鲁特河上、雅西附近，拥有了一个进入罗马尼亚的桥头堡。法西斯接连挨打，却不知怎地又重振了士气。我们确信敌人集结了一支庞大的力量，企图拔除我们的桥头堡。我们必须守住它。它是计划数月后发动的罗马尼亚入侵的理想起点。

src: Since the Middle Ages the duchies of Schleswig and Holstein had been joined in personal union with the Crown of Denmark, as was the Duchy of Lauenburg after the Napoleonic wars.
dst: 自中世纪以来，石勒苏益格和荷尔斯泰因两个公国便以君合国形式与丹麦王室联合在一起，拿破仑战争之后的劳恩堡公国也是如此。

src: Since the Pretoria Convention was signed in 1881 the British Empire had guaranteed the self-government of the two Boer republics in South Africa. But, during the decade of 1890, new problems started, concerning the rights of the British citizens in the Transvaal. I am convinced that the differences between our country and the Boer could have been easily settled at a negotiation table, but for some gentlemen with strong influence in the mining industry and the Government, greed and profit were more important than a civilized agreement. The intransigent demands of our officials led the Boer to desperation, and eventually they declared war on Britain. I suppose that they thought that, after some months of fighting, our Government would decide that the campaign was too costly, and finally we would sign a treaty. But that was not going to happen. The gold mines in the Boer territory, to the eyes of Mr Rhodes and Mr Phillips, were well worth the resources of the Crown and the lives of thousands of good British soldiers.
dst: 自1881年签署比勒陀利亚公约以来，大英帝国一直保证南非两个布尔共和国的自治。但在19世纪90年代，新的问题开始出现，涉及德兰士瓦境内英国公民的权利。我确信，我们国家与布尔人之间的分歧本可以在谈判桌上轻松解决，但对于某些在采矿业和政府中具有强大影响力的先生们来说，贪婪和利润比一项文明的协议更重要。我们官员毫不妥协的要求把布尔人逼到了绝境，最终他们对英国宣战了。我猜想，他们认为经过几个月的战斗，我国政府会觉得这场战役代价过高，最终我们会签署一项条约。但那不会发生。在罗兹先生和菲利普斯先生眼中，布尔领地内的金矿完全值得动用王室的资源以及成千上万优秀英国士兵的生命。

src: Since the Russian 1st Army was days ahead of the 2nd, the solution of the German 8th Army was to deploy its forces against Rennekampf, check his advance, and then redeploy to stop Samsonov.  The German I (von Francois), XVII (von Mackensen), and I Reserve (von Below) Corps were to engage the 1st Army.  The I Corps led the effort.
dst: 由于俄国第1集团军比第2集团军提前数天，德军第8集团军的对策是：先调集部队对付连宁坎普夫，遏制他的推进，然后再重新部署以阻挡萨姆索诺夫。德军第1军（冯·弗朗索瓦）、第17军（冯·马肯森）和第1预备军（冯·贝洛）将投入对第1集团军的战斗，其中第1军打头阵。

src: Since the United States hasn't entered the war, the Germans think that they don't need any reinforcements in France and Belgium. That means that, if Russia finally surrenders, we'll be able to reinforce the secondary fronts, and destroy the Entente forces there. So prepare yourself, General. If Russia falls, our next goal will be winning the war at the Balkans.
dst: 由于美国尚未参战，德国人认为他们在法国和比利时不需要任何增援。这意味着，一旦俄国最终投降，我们就能增援次要战线，并摧毁那里的协约国部队。所以，做好准备吧，将军。如果俄国垮台，我们的下一个目标就是在巴尔干赢得战争。

src: Since the beginning of August my grandma was very nervous and she cried very often. She told me that my grandpa will return home. She showed me his photograph and many times I couldn't go out with other girls, because grandma wished to talk with me about grandpa and it was sometimes boring.
dst: 从八月初开始，奶奶就非常紧张，经常哭。她告诉我，爷爷要回家了。她给我看他的照片，有好多次我都没法跟别的女孩出去玩，因为奶奶想跟我聊爷爷，有时候挺无聊的。

src: Since the beginning of the XIX century, and the rise of nationalist ideologies, the different German states had made great efforts to achieve some kind of economic and political union. However, it wasn't until the 1860's when Prussia, one of the most powerful German kingdoms, could lead the other states to unification. Through a skilled use of diplomacy and military power, and after winning three wars against Denmark, Austria and France, Prussia made possible, in just seven years, the transformation of Germany from a loose confederation into a Empire composed of 26 constituent states.
dst: 自19世纪初民族主义意识形态兴起以来，德意志各邦便为实现某种形式的经济与政治联合付出了巨大努力。然而，直到19世纪60年代，作为最强大的德意志王国之一的普鲁士才得以引领其他各邦走向统一。通过娴熟地运用外交与军事力量，并在战胜丹麦、奥地利和法国三场战争之后，普鲁士仅用七年时间，就使德国从一个松散的邦联变成了一个由26个邦组成的帝国。

src: Since the beginning of year the Japanese could achieve grandiose successes against the Allies in Southeast Asia and Pacific. The Philippines, Dutch East Indies, Malaya, Burma and Singapore were conquered in recent months and the Japanese Kwantung Army in the Far East has opened the awaited second front against the Soviets.
dst: 自年初以来，日本人在东南亚和太平洋对盟军取得了辉煌战果。菲律宾、荷属东印度、马来亚、缅甸和新加坡在最近几个月被征服，远东的日本关东军开辟了对苏联的第二战线。

src: Since the days of Alexander such was not seen anywhere...!
dst: 自亚历山大大帝的时代以来，天下未曾见此盛况......！

src: Since the early weeks of this year, fierce battle is fought for Narva and in the town's surroundings. Soviets built several bridgeheads and they threaten to cut communications towards Tallin. They must not break through the Narva Isthmus, because this could mean a loss of Estonia and subsequent isolation of Finland.
dst: 自今年年初以来，纳尔瓦及其周边爆发了激战。苏军建立了数个桥头堡，威胁切断通往塔林的交通。他们绝不能突破纳尔瓦地峡，因为那将意味着爱沙尼亚的丢失和芬兰随后的孤立。

src: Since the failure of Von Schlieffen's Plan we've been forced to adopt a defensive strategy in France. The Entente forces have numerical superiority and they are well aware of that. Now they'll try once and again to break our lines with all the means at their disposal, and after that they'll send all their reserves into the gap, hoping to cut our supply lines and encircle our units.
dst: 自从冯·施里芬的计划失败后，我们被迫在法国采取防御战略。协约国军队拥有数量优势，而且他们对此心知肚明。现在他们会一次又一次地动用一切手段试图突破我们的防线，然后再把所有预备队投入缺口，妄图切断我们的补给线并包围我们的部队。

src: Since the following scenario takes place only a couple of days after this scenario, the following options are disabled at HQ after this scenario - autosupply, autorefit. upgrade, purchase . Thus all purchases/upgrades for both Tobruk scenarios has to be made at HQ in THIS scenario
dst: 由于下一场战役仅在本战役之后数日展开，因此本战役结束后总部将禁用以下选项——自动补给、自动整补、升级、购买。所以托布鲁克两场战役的所有购买/升级都必须在本次战役中于总部完成。

src: Since the position of Salinae Heraclea is not known, I made the better-known map of Herculaneum.
dst: 由于赫拉克利亚盐场的位置无从查考，我改用了更有名的赫库兰尼姆地图。

src: Since the war against the Boer I was aware that frontal infantry assaults against an entrenched enemy equipped with modern weapons would be costly and ultimately futile. So there I was, an old man studying, trying to find an alternative to the old methods.
dst: 自对布尔人的战争以来，我就明白，对装备现代化武器的掘壕固守之敌发动正面步兵突击，代价高昂且最终徒劳无功。于是，我这样一个老人仍在钻研，试图为这些老方法找到替代之策。

src: Since they were unable to agree on a joint approach
dst: 由于两人无法就联合作战达成一致

src: Since we had joined the 11th división in February, and as a part of Roberts's army, we had taken Bloemfontein, Johannesburg and, finally, Pretoria, without any serious fighting. But a week after the fall of Pretoria, the enemy still wandered the hills east of the town. After months of secondary and degrading tasks we were finally given the order of attacking and forcing the Boer to retreat.
dst: 自2月加入第11师、并作为罗伯茨军队的一部分以来，我们几乎未经历任何激烈战斗就攻占了布隆方丹、约翰内斯堡，最后是比勒陀利亚。但比勒陀利亚陷落一周后，敌人仍在城东的山丘上游荡。经过数月次要而屈辱的任务之后，我们终于接到了进攻并迫使布尔人撤退的命令。

src: Since we have mobilized before the 2nd Army, we must expect to meet the majority of the German 8th Army - I (von Francois), XVII (von Mackensen), and I Reserve (von Below) Corps - at Gumbinnen.
dst: 由于我们比第2集团军先完成动员，我们必须预料到将在贡比嫩遭遇德军第8集团军主力——第1（冯·弗朗索瓦）、第17（冯·马肯森）和第1预备（冯·贝洛）军。

src: Since you already know the area, you'll command the operations against Belgrad. The city is fortified, and their defences include some pieces of heavy artillery, but with the help of the German XXII Reserve Korps it will be easy to outflank and destroy our enemies. Go ahead, General, the victory will be ours!
dst: 既然您已熟悉这一带，就由您指挥进攻贝尔格莱德的行动。这座城市设防坚固，其防御设施包括若干重型火炮，但有了德国第22预备军团的协助，包抄并歼灭我们的敌人将易如反掌。去吧，将军，胜利必将属于我们！

src: Since you got stuck at the Dojransee, our victory in the Balkans will take longer and will be harder. At least the Germans have destroyed the Entente army in Bitola, and now they're marching towards Athen. Well, let's forget about this. You'll be sent to the Italian front again, and I hope you'll show there that you've learnt from your mistakes.
dst: 既然您在杜伊兰湖受阻，我们在巴尔干的胜利将需要更长的时间，也会更加艰难。至少德国人已经在比托拉摧毁了协约国军队，现在他们正向雅典进军。好了，这件事就到此为止吧。您将再次被派往意大利战线，我希望您能在那里证明自己已经从错误中吸取了教训。

src: Sir Douglas Haigh of the First British Army was able to convince sir John French to let him carry out the attack - and not sir Horace Smith-Dorrien - by promising a real break-through at Neuve Chapelle towards Lille and la Bassee. The commander of [IV] Corps Rawlinson had a more limited attack in mind with the goal of straightening the front line and capturing Neuve Chapelle - nothing more than that. Not the last of the differences of opinion between Haig and his generals. When the attack began, Rawlinson had not made any plans for exploiting a breakthrough. Simply because he was convinced that there would be none.
dst: 英国第一集团军的道格拉斯·黑格爵士承诺在新沙佩勒朝里尔和拉巴塞方向实现真正的突破，从而说服了约翰·弗伦奇爵士让他——而不是霍勒斯·史密斯-多里恩爵士——来执行这次进攻。[IV]军军长罗林森心里想的是一次更有限的进攻，目标是拉直战线并占领新沙佩勒——仅此而已。这并非黑格与其将领们之间意见分歧的最后一例。进攻开始时，罗林森并没有制定任何利用突破的计划，原因很简单：他确信不会有突破。

src: Sir General, Sir, we were able to push deep into Germany. You and your men are ordered to liberate the coastal region of Frisia in northwestern Germany and the Netherlands. The end of the war is near!
dst: 将军阁下，我们得以深入德国境内。您和您的部下奉命解放德国西北部的弗里斯兰沿海地区以及荷兰。战争即将结束！

src: Sir, I don't think we can hold all positions at the same time. It seems to be a better tactic to defend one stronghold and recapture the other objectives later.
dst: 长官，我认为我们无法同时守住所有阵地。更好的战术似乎是集中防守一处据点，稍后再夺回其他目标。

src: Sir, after we took the Remagen Bridge we now need to cross the Rhine in the north too. With bridgeheads in the north and south we will be able to encircle the Ruhr area, the industrial heart of Germany. Some of your units will cross the Rhine at Remagen and will stay in the south, so your armee won't be at full strength for this operation (Limited Deployment).
dst: 长官，在我们夺取雷马根大桥之后，我们现在还需要在北面渡过莱茵河。有了南北两处桥头堡，我们就能包围鲁尔区——德国的工业心脏。你的一部分部队将在雷马根渡河并留在南面，因此你的集团军在此次行动中将无法满编（有限部署）。

src: Sir, it seems it is not necessary to take all of the forts and batteries. Most of them are protected by immobile units. Sir, we also hear rumors about sea monsters!
dst: 先生，看来没有必要攻占所有的堡垒和炮台。它们大多由无法机动的单位守卫。先生，我们还听到了关于海怪的传闻！

src: Sir, may I suggest to stay near the railroad and keep the troops together?
dst: 先生，我建议靠近铁路，并让部队保持集结。

src: Sir, our next objective is the Ruhr area, the industrial heart of Germany. A large german force has gathered in the Ruhr area, but most of them are in bad condition.
dst: 长官，我们的下一个目标是鲁尔区，德国的工业心脏。大批德军已在鲁尔区集结，但他们大多状态不佳。

src: Sir, the Germans have attacked the left shore of the Rhine river as part of their Operation Nordwind (Northwind) and they managed to establish a bridgehead around Offendorf. Further, we expect strong German attacks (on the ground and in the air) from northern and eastern directions in the next hours. The situation is chaotic! Many of our units are not at full strength. Take your men an stablilize the front.
dst: 长官，德军作为其“北风”行动的一部分，已进攻莱茵河左岸，并成功在奥芬多夫一带建立了桥头堡。此外，我们预计未来数小时内德军将从北部和东部方向发起猛烈进攻（包括地面与空中）。局势一片混乱！我方许多单位都不满编。请率领您的部下稳住战线。

src: Sir, the good news is that our General is recovering and the majority of our troops were able to avoid encirclement, but perhaps it is time to leave Russia to the Germans.......
dst: 长官，好消息是我们的将军正在康复，大部分部队得以避免被合围，但也许是把俄国留给德国人的时候了……

src: Sir, this is the situiation at the moment and the allied command had already planned to carry out simultaneous operations Near Salerno and Taranto. The British 1st Airborne Division will head for Taranto while a large combined force is going to make landfall near Salerno. We hop to cut off German forces in southern Italy.
dst: 长官，这是目前的情况，盟军指挥部已计划在萨莱诺和塔兰托附近同时展开行动。英国第1空降师将开往塔兰托，而一支庞大的联合部队将在萨莱诺附近登陆。我们希望切断意大利南部的德军。

src: Sir, we are about to launch our spring offensive in the next days. But before you should pick your best men and carry out a commando operation. We need to secure our right flank at the Adriatic Sea. You and your men, alongside British Commandos, are ordered to capture the sandspit which is seperating the Comacchio Lagoon from the Sea. The germans have entrenched on the spit.
dst: 长官，我们即将在接下来几天发动春季攻势。但在那之前，你应当挑选最精锐的部下执行一次突击队行动。我们需要确保亚得里亚海一侧的右翼安全。你和你的部下将协同英国突击队，奉命夺取把科马基奥潟湖与大海隔开的那道沙嘴。德军已在沙嘴上构筑了工事。

src: Sir, we should cross the rivers up- or downstream. The riverside at Harper's Ferry seems to be well defended....
dst: 先生，我们应该从上游或下游渡河。哈珀斯费里一带的河岸似乎防守严密……

src: Sir, we should deploy the USS Moose near the front of our line of battle. You know, the good old Moose is not the fastest ship in the Navy...
dst: 先生，我们应该把「驼鹿」号部署在我们战线的前方。您知道的，这艘老「驼鹿」可不是海军里最快的船……

dst: Sirhind 旅/ 第3 Lahore 师/ 印度军

src: Sit down Herr General. The invasion of the Amerika's has started! The Italians have established a base in Canada but need our support. Your troops are to attack the northern coast and link up with the Italians and then drive inland.
dst: 请坐，将军阁下。对美洲的入侵已经开始了！意大利人已在加拿大建立了基地，但需要我们的支援。你的部队要进攻北部海岸，与意军会合，然后向内陆推进。

src: Sitting astride the sea lanes between Italy and Libya, the British-held island of Malta proved a major nuisance to Italian efforts to push supply convoys across the Mediterranean Sea.  The German plan (Operation Hercules) put its faith in airborne landings.  German and Italian paratroopers would secure the most important points, and reinforcements would then come over the beaches to finish off the island's garrison.
dst: 英属马耳他岛横亘在意大利与利比亚之间的航路上，对意大利运送补给船队横渡地中海的努力构成重大麻烦。德方的计划（“海格力斯”行动）把希望寄托在空降登陆上。德国和意大利伞兵将夺取最重要的要点，随后增援将从海滩上陆，肃清该岛守军。

src: Six strengthened infantry brigades are taken from the First, Second and Third Armies to form Armeegruppe Meuse and are instructed to take the city. They are accompanied by 3 cavalry divisions that are to sweep around Liege and cut it off from the main body of the Belgian Army.
dst: 六个加强步兵旅从第一、第二、第三集团军中抽调出来，组建默兹集团军群，并奉命夺取该城。他们配属了3个骑兵师，任务是横扫列日周围，切断其与比利时陆军主力的联系。

src: Siéntese por favor, y atienda mis ordenes.  Como usted probablemente ya conoce, general, la guerra está a punto de terminar. Sin embargo, necesitamos asestar un último golpe fatal al llamado ''Ejército Popular'' de los republicanos. Lo mejor de las tropas republicanas se encuentra aun en Cataluña, el último bastión del enemigo que cuenta con acceso a una frontera internacional. Sabemos que los franceses siguen debatiendo si intervenir a favor de la República y permitir el paso de armas soviéticas, que continúan retenidas en Francia, lo cual no podemos aceptar, ya que prolongaría la guerra de forma indefinida y es algo que hay que evitar. Piense que sería desastroso para nuestro movimiento si una guerra a nivel internacional estallase finalmente.
dst: 请坐，听我的命令。将军，您大概已经知道，这场战争即将结束。然而，我们需要对共和军所谓的「人民军」予以最后一记致命打击。共和军最精锐的部队仍在加泰罗尼亚，那是敌军最后一个拥有国际边境通道的堡垒。我们知道，法国人仍在争论是否援助共和国，并放行那些仍被扣在法国的苏联武器——这是我们无法接受的，因为那会使战争无限期延长，而这是必须避免的。您想想，如果最终爆发一场国际战争，对我们的运动将是灾难性的。
