src: So I actually prefer to be here, where I can serve my country by taking Moscow. The old capital that has been transformed into the Beast's lair. The horrific place where the Red godless demons lurk. Never before have I been so eager to fulfill my duty. This city must be saved from the communists.
dst: 所以我其实更愿意待在这里，通过夺取莫斯科来报效祖国。这座古都已沦为野兽的巢穴，这个可怕的地方潜伏着红色无神论的恶魔。我从未如此渴望履行自己的职责。必须把这城市从共产党人手中拯救出来。

src: So Spartacus stood shortly thereafterbefore Rome. He did not lay siege to the city and moved even further south.
dst: 于是斯巴达克斯不久后便兵临罗马城下。但他没有围攻该城，而是继续南下。

src: So be happy, my love. Although these days will be difficult for us, they won’t be the hardest ones that we’ve experienced. And I am confident that soon we’ll be together again.
dst: 所以，亲爱的，开心点。尽管这些日子对我们来说会很艰难，但它们不会是我们经历过的最难熬的时光。我深信，我们很快就会再次团聚。

src: So ends the campaign, thanks for playing.
dst: 战役到此结束，感谢游玩。

src: So far everything has gone well. Maybe too much. It's surprising how poorly defended the French forts were. Besides, there haven' been any serious counterattacks. Where are the French? Our intelligence suggests that most of them have been killed, but I agree with you. It's likely that they are regrouping and preparing themselves to defend as many strategic positions as they can.
dst: 到目前为止一切顺利。也许太顺利了。令人惊讶的是，法军要塞的防御竟是如此薄弱。此外，也没有出现任何像样的反攻。法军到底在哪里？我们的情报显示他们大多已被歼灭，但我同意您的看法。他们很可能正在重新集结，准备尽可能多地守住各个战略要点。

src: So far von Rundstedt has pushed the advance through what the Americans call the 'Manufacturing Belt' at a quite fast pace. However, resistance is getting tougher so you have been called onto the scene. Take Chicago - this will deprive the Americans of one of their last industrial centers and also cut off three American armies.
dst: 迄今为止，冯·伦德施泰特以相当快的速度推进，穿过了美国人所谓的“制造业带”。然而抵抗日益顽强，于是你被召上场。夺取芝加哥——这将夺走美国人仅剩的几个工业中心之一，并切断三支美军。

src: So far, our armies have been able to reject a dozen Italian assaults in the Isonzo Valley, but our casualties are too high. If we don't help them, sooner or later that entire front will collapse. Fortunately, it seems that the Germans want to help us in our struggle against Italy. That will be an excellent chance to get rid of the Italians, and you are the right man for the task.
dst: 到目前为止，我们的军队已经在伊松佐河谷击退了意大利人的十多次进攻，但我们的伤亡实在太大。如果我们不支援他们，那条战线迟早会全线崩溃。幸运的是，德国人似乎愿意帮助我们对付意大利。那将是一个摆脱意大利人的绝佳机会，而您正是执行这项任务的合适人选。

src: So he decides to pull back to Greece amd wait there for Cäsar.
dst: 于是他决定撤往希腊，在那里等待凯撒。

src: So here I am again back to the Mississipi valley where everything started for me...
dst: 于是我又回到了密西西比河谷，这里是我一切开始的地方……

src: So here's the situation:  the Germans have three command structures on the lunar surface.  You need to destroy all three of these structures and take control of the surrounding area.
dst: 那么情况是这样的：德国人在月球表面有三座指挥结构。你需要摧毁这三座结构，并控制周边区域。

src: So in the spring of 1918 Germany launched a most vicious attack. They used all the knowledge thay had acquired on trench warfare during these years, and I must confess that, initially, the execution of their plan was close to perfection. They advanced deeply behind our lines, disrupting our communications and menacing Arras and Amiens. Just as it had happened at Cambrai, some of our units were on the verge of panic, and if we did not stop the German advance inmediately, there was a real danger of being trapped between our enemies and the sea. Again, it was my duty to hold our lines and save my country from a most embarrasing defeat.
dst: 于是，1918年春天，德国发动了一次极其凶猛的进攻。他们用上了这些年来在堑壕战中积累的全部经验，我必须承认，起初，他们计划的执行近乎完美。他们深入我方战线后方推进，扰乱我们的通信，并威胁着阿拉斯和亚眠。正如康布雷发生的情况一样，我们的一些部队濒于恐慌，如果我们不立即阻止德军的推进，就真有被敌人和大海两面夹击的危险。又一次，守住我们的防线、使祖国免于一场最令人难堪的失败，成了我的职责。

src: So it is Caesar`s Will to cross the Rhine again and teach them their final lesson....
dst: 因此凯撒决意再次渡过莱茵河，给他们上最后一课......

src: So make a choice. Take a regular "Victory" by taking the first hex to play Kerch. Take a "Tactical Victory" by taking the second hex to play Feodosiya.
dst: 那么做个选择吧。夺取第一个胜利格取得常规“胜利”，即玩刻赤。夺取第二个胜利格取得“战术胜利”，即玩费奥多西亚。

src: So now it's my turn. While some of our units cover our flanks and rear, my men will continue the main offensive along the railroad. Our objectives are the towns of Belaya Glina and Novopokrovskaya. Once they fall the taking of Tikhoretskaya will be easy, and soon we'll be at the gates of Ekaterinodar once again.
dst: 所以现在轮到我了。在我方部分部队掩护两翼和后方的同时，我的部下将沿铁路继续主攻。我们的目标是别拉亚格利纳镇和新波克罗夫斯卡亚镇。一旦攻克这两地，夺取季霍列茨卡亚便易如反掌，我们很快将再次兵临叶卡捷琳诺达尔城下。

src: So now your new readers in Canada want to hear about me, Dejazmach Daniel Andarawus of Tigray. Well, we won't disappoint them, will we?
dst: 那么现在您在加拿大的新读者想听听我的故事，提格雷的德贾兹马奇·丹尼尔·安达拉乌斯。嗯，我们不会让他们失望的，对吧？

src: So now, at Zborow, the Russian 11th Army has been tasked with breaking through towards Zloczow. That could be a great opportunity for us. A Russian defeat would mean the failure of Kerenski and his government, and they'd be finally forced to sign a peace treaty with us in order to avoid the danger of a marxist revolution.
dst: 于是现在，在兹博罗夫，俄军第11集团军奉命向兹沃切夫方向突破。这对我们来说可能是绝佳的机会。俄军一旦战败，就意味着克伦斯基及其政府的失败，他们终将被迫与我们签订和约，以避免一场马克思主义革命的危险。

src: So the Army had to be sent to solve a problem that others had created. I sailed from Gibraltar with the 3rd battalion of the Grenadier Guards on 25th October 1899, and we arrived in Cape Town about three weeks later. I returned to the land where my life as a soldier had started, twenty years back. As our ship approached Table Bay, my mind was assaulted by many remembrances of my past battles, as well as by the impatience that I always feel when a new fight is imminent.
dst: 于是军队不得不被派去解决别人制造的问题。1899年10月25日，我随掷弹兵近卫团第3营从直布罗陀启航，大约三周后抵达开普敦。我又回到了二十年前我的军旅生涯起步的那片土地。当我们的船驶近桌湾时，我脑海中涌起了对过往战斗的种种回忆，以及每当一场新的战斗迫近时我总会感到的那种迫不及待。

src: So the French have finally decided to come home?
dst: 这么说法国人终于决定打回老家来了？

src: So this is the end... my friend... Thank you for playing this campaign that the four of us made between September 2018 and December 2021. You are very welcome to post feedback on the Open General Forums (Designer's Corner section).
dst: 那么，这就是结局了……我的朋友……感谢您游玩我们四人于2018年9月至2021年12月间制作的这场战役。非常欢迎您在 Open General 论坛（设计师角板块）上留言反馈。

src: So we can prevent a landing of the Roman veteran legions in our area and at the same time use the ports for our purposes .....
dst: 这样既能阻止罗马的老兵军团在我们这一带登陆，又能把港口为我们所用 .....

src: So we're sending you in.  We are completely uncertain as to the nature of the problem, Commander, but it's possible that the Soviets have decided for some reason to hit this airbase.  If this is true, we may be on the verge of a nuclear war.  Take your men in, secure Holloman, and if there is indeed a threat, hold your ground until heavier reinforcements can arrive.
dst: 所以我们要把你派进去。我们完全无法确定问题的性质，指挥官，但苏联人有可能出于某种原因决定袭击这座空军基地。若果真如此，我们或许正处在核战争的边缘。带你的人进去，控制霍洛曼，若确有威胁，就坚守阵地，直到更重的增援抵达。

src: So weit im Norden, werden Sie nicht mit uns rechnen!
dst: 在这遥远的北方，他们不会料到我们！

src: So you control CCB operating on both flanks + the suicide attack on Oran harbour. The AI controls the troops of 1st Infantry Division and the supporting air and naval assets.
dst: 因此，你指挥在两翼作战的CCB，外加对奥兰港的自杀式进攻。第1步兵师的部队以及配属的空中与海上力量由 AI 指挥。

src: So you've been wounded by enemy fire. I'm sorry to hear about that, General. Well, at least you're alive, and the doctors say that you'll recover after some months of rest. Don't worry about the war, now the priority is your health and your well-being. Replacing you won't be easy at all, but we'll find a way to get the job done. Don't think about it now, and just focus on your recovery.
dst: 原来您被敌军火力击伤了。听到这个消息我很难过，将军。好在至少您还活着，医生说经过几个月的休养您就能康复。别担心战事，现在最重要的是您的健康和身心安康。要找人接替您绝非易事，但我们会想办法把这件事办好的。现在别想这些了，专心养伤吧。

src: So, CLEAR this area of any Chinese soldiers and General, I'm starting to hate the Chinese!
dst: 所以，把这地区的中国士兵都肃清掉，将军，我开始讨厌中国人了！

src: So, Oberst says that the Reds' strength is vastly depleted, yet so is ours. Hence, both sides can't do much more than hold the nest defenses around the bridges. The situation is unsustainbale and must be solved before the enemy gets reinforces. We'll cross the bridges... hier und... ja, hier! It shouldn't be too hard, because the rebels seriously  lack men and their companies are mostly reduced to strengthened platoons at the very best. Our only concern are those annoying tanks of them. Scouts' reports are uncertain, but at least one three-vehicles platoon was spotted en route, while other machines were uncovered by the air support. Lets assume that the Reds may press six or seven tanks into service.
dst: 上校说，红军的兵力已大大消耗，但我们这边也一样。因此，双方都只能守住桥周围那些稳固的防御。局面难以为继，必须在敌人得到增援之前解决。我们将强渡这些桥……这儿……还有……对，这儿！这应该不会太难，因为叛军严重缺人，他们的连队充其量也大多缩减成了加强排。我们唯一担心的就是他们那些烦人的坦克。侦察报告含糊其辞，但至少有一支三辆车的排被发现在路上，而其他车辆则被空中支援发现。我们姑且假定红军能凑出六到七辆坦克投入战斗。

src: So, after capturing General Navarro we have taken another Spanish General prisoner! Allah be praised! You don't have to worry, we'll take you alive to Axdir. I know that your Government will pay a good ransom for you. You should feel lucky. Most of the Spanish soldiers will have the same fate as General Silvestre: They will rot under the sun or they will be eaten by the dogs. Now move!
dst: 这么说，在俘获纳瓦罗将军之后，我们又俘虏了另一位西班牙将军！赞美真主！您不必担心，我们会把您活着带到阿克斯迪尔。我知道你们的政府会为您支付一笔可观的赎金。您该感到庆幸。大多数西班牙士兵将落得和西尔维斯特雷将军一样的下场：要么在太阳下腐烂，要么被狗吃掉。现在，走吧！

src: So, although the Treaty of Sèvres, signed on 10 August 1920, established that Turkey had to cede parts of Anatolia to Greece and Armenia, and that there would be British, Italian and French zones of influence over most of the country, the Ottoman Government simply couldn't ratify it. The revolution was at its peak and, depending on the outcome of the clashes against the Greek Army, the Western Powers knew that they would have to negotiate again.
dst: 因此，尽管1920年8月10日签订的《塞夫尔条约》规定土耳其必须把安纳托利亚的部分地区割让给希腊和亚美尼亚，并规定英国、意大利和法国将在该国大部分地区设立势力范围，奥斯曼政府却根本无法批准它。革命正处于高潮，西方列强知道，取决于与希腊军队冲突的结果，他们将不得不再次谈判。

src: So, due to your betrayal, we were denied the access to the Red Sea, and we had two new powerful enemies. Furious with us for having helped the Egyptians, the Mahdist invaded our lands, forcing the people to choose between conversion to Islam or death. Acting again as a champion of Christianity, Yohannes raised a new army, and sent Ras Alula and me to repel the Sudanese invasion. After resting in Keren for ten days, and knowing that the Muslims were camped in Kufit, near Agordat, we headed there, ready to battle.
dst: 所以，由于你们的背叛，我们被剥夺了通往红海的出海口，还多了两个强大的新敌人。马赫迪分子因为我们帮助埃及人而勃然大怒，入侵了我们的土地，强迫百姓在皈依伊斯兰教与死亡之间作选择。约翰内斯再次以基督教捍卫者的姿态征召了一支新军，派拉斯·阿卢拉和我去击退苏丹人的入侵。在克伦休整了十天之后，得知穆斯林正扎营于阿戈尔达特附近的库菲特，我们便向那里进发，做好了战斗准备。

src: So, here's the map. We must move through enemy territory. Scouts say that there are lots of British and Greek units all around, many of them disorganized, but others are still in good shape. And the local people joined the battle, too! I can't understand how on earth those paratroopers could hold the airfield for nearly a week.
dst: 那么，这是地图。我们必须穿过敌方领土。侦察兵说，四周有大量英军和希腊部队，许多已经溃不成军，但另一些仍保持完整建制。而且当地民众也加入了战斗！我真不明白，那些伞兵究竟是怎么把机场坚守了将近一周的。

src: So, if we want peace, we must scare the British. We may not have the power to invade England, but we certainly could attack some strategical British bases in the Mittelmeer. It has been decided that the Germans will attack the Sueskanal and, at the same time, you'll disembark in Malta. If the British lose the Mediterranean route, they won't be able to control India and other important colonies. The British Empire would be in danger and, before it could fall, they'd choose to make peace with us.
dst: 所以，如果我们想要和平，就必须吓住英国人。我们或许没有入侵英格兰的实力，但我们当然可以攻击英国在地中海的一些战略基地。已经决定，德国人将进攻苏伊士运河，与此同时，您将在马耳他登陆。如果英国失去了地中海航线，他们就无法控制印度和其他重要殖民地。大英帝国将陷入危险，而在它可能崩溃之前，他们会选择与我们讲和。

src: So, in the end, Yohannes decided to forgive Menelik and give him one last chance. And, since the Sudanese were weakened, he decided to launch a final offensive against the Mus-lim menace. He was determined to liberate Ethiopia from the Mohammedan invaders, once and for all. When the year 1889 came, all of his officers were ready to march against Gallabat. That campaign would change the history of Ethiopia forever, but not the way that we expected.
dst: 于是，约翰尼斯最终决定宽恕孟尼利克，再给他最后一次机会。既然苏丹人已被削弱，他决定对穆斯林的威胁发动最后的攻势。他决心一劳永逸地把埃塞俄比亚从伊斯兰教入侵者手中解放出来。1889年到来时，他的所有军官都已准备就绪，随时向加拉巴特进军。那场战役将永远改变埃塞俄比亚的历史，但并非以我们所预期的方式。

src: So, in the end, we had to accept the conditions that the British presented at the Armistice of Helsinki. The partition of Russia came into effect: the Bolsheviks would rule in the west, and Kolchak in the new State of Trans-Ural Russia. Of course, Denikin and Wrangel obtained the recognition of their tiny Free Crimean State, too.
dst: 于是，最终我们不得不接受英国人在《赫尔辛基停战协定》中提出的条件。俄国的分治开始生效：布尔什维克统治西部，高尔察克统治新的外乌拉尔俄国。当然，邓尼金和弗兰格尔也使其小小的自由克里米亚国获得了承认。

src: So, instead, the High Command has decided to launch a small winter offensive against the Italians in southern Albania. We know that, recently, they've been forced to retire two brigades from the Balkans, in order to send them to Abyssinia. Last year, Italy was imprudent enough to invade that African country, trying to avenge their defeat at Adua in 1896, but the natives overcame their colonial troops again. Now they fear an invasion of Eritrea, so they've sent some European units to Massaua.
dst: 因此，最高统帅部决定改为对阿尔巴尼亚南部的意大利人发动一次小规模冬季攻势。我们知道，最近他们被迫从巴尔干撤走两个旅，派往阿比西尼亚。去年，意大利轻率地入侵了那个非洲国家，试图一雪1896年在阿杜瓦战败之耻，但当地人再次击败了他们的殖民军。如今他们担心厄立特里亚遭到入侵，便向马萨瓦派去了若干欧洲部队。

src: So, on October 20, the Italian government sent Empress Zauditu an insulting ultimatum, in unacceptable terms. What they really wanted was a pretext for a war, since they thought that this time they would win easily. Just a few days later, they invaded my land of Tigray. Their colonial forces quickly took Adwa and Adigrat, but I was waiting for them a few miles from there, near Mekele.
dst: 于是，10月20日，意大利政府向佐迪图女皇发出了措辞侮辱、令人无法接受的最后通牒。他们真正想要的是开战的借口，因为他们觉得这次自己能轻松取胜。仅仅几天之后，他们便入侵了我的家乡提格雷。他们的殖民部队迅速攻占了阿杜瓦和阿迪格拉特，但我正在几英里外的默克莱附近等着他们。

src: So, the decission is yours. Either you may take a rest and in the morning you'll board the plane that takes you home. Or, and now listen very carefully, I may throw you into jail for the rest of night and in the morning I'll send you by the very same plane back to Germany, but this time handcuffed. Choose wisely, Herr Bistroff."
dst: 那么，决定权在你。要么你可以休息一下，明早登机回家。要么——现在非常仔细地听着——我可以把你扔进牢房关到天亮，明早再用同一架飞机把你送回德国，只不过这次戴着手铐。明智地选择吧，比斯特罗夫先生。”

src: So, we very well know of your great experience. We hope that you and other experienced tankmen could find a way to counter the British and French tanks. Sit down, please, I see that we're the first. Good decision that we've gone so early in the morning. That wooden leg of mine is not the best thing that happened to me and I hate when everybody must wait for me to grovel."
dst: 那么，我们非常清楚你丰富的经验。我们希望你和其他经验丰富的坦克兵能找出对付英法坦克的办法。请坐，看来我们是第一批到的。我们一大早就来的决定很明智。我那条木腿可不是什么好事，我讨厌让所有人都等着我蹒跚而行。”

src: So, we will attack the important chinese Ports and some Villages around it, and must hold it until our reinforcements arrive ...
dst: 因此，我们将攻击重要的中国港口及其周围的一些村庄，并且必须坚守，直到我们的援军抵达……

src: So, what to do? Destroy the initial MSU around your starting positions, and once the Soviet "enemy" battalion shows up, approach its area and fight them like you'd fight any real enemy. Don't be afraid, this isn't live fire exercise, and all the fallen will rise after midnight...
dst: 那么，该怎么做？消灭你出发阵地周围的初始 MSU 单位，一旦苏联“敌军”营出现，就逼近其区域，像对付真正的敌人一样与他们作战。别怕，这不是实弹演习，所有倒下的人午夜后都会站起来……

src: So, when they told me that the Spanish Army was looking for foreign volunteers to fight in Morocco in their Legion, I didn't think it twice. I didn't want to be alive, so joining an elite unit whose nickname is "the grooms of death" seemed a perfect opportunity to leave this world doing what I was good at.
dst: 所以，当他们告诉我，西班牙军队正为其外籍军团招募去摩洛哥作战的外国志愿兵时，我毫不犹豫。我并不想活着，所以加入一个绰号为「死亡的新郎」的精锐部队，似乎是我离开这个世界、做我擅长之事的最佳机会。

src: So, your mission, the "Battle of Buzuluk" is over. Hopefully your result wasn't too dissapointing.
dst: 那么，你的任务——“布祖鲁克之战”已经结束。希望你的战果不至于太令人失望。

src: Sofort nach Beginn der Kampfhandlungen in Europa, wurden all unserere Versorgungslinien gekappt. Fast alle unsere Kolonien wurden im Handstreich genommen - aber hier in Deutsch-Ostafrika werden wir Sie zurückschlagen!
dst: 欧洲战事一开始，我们所有的补给线就被切断了。几乎我们所有的殖民地都被闪电般夺取——但在德属东非，我们将把你们打回去！
索科洛希尔内 (索科洛戈尔诺耶)

src: Soldat mit Maschinengewehr (MG 34) in ausgebauter Stellung, Siel- und Eierhandgranatenliegen griffbereit.
dst: 一名士兵在构筑好的阵地上持机枪（MG 34），身旁备有爆破筒与卵形手榴弹。

src: Soldier in foxholes at Toropets, Russia, 16 January 1943
dst: 在俄罗斯托罗佩茨的散兵坑中的士兵，1943年1月16日

src: Soldiers from the Indian Legion being inspected by Luftwaffe officers, Bordeaux, France, February 1944.
dst: 印度军团士兵正接受德国空军军官检阅，法国波尔多，1944年2月。

src: Soldiers of Polski Korpus Posilkowy, mainly veterans of 2nd Brigade of Legiony, decided to break through the frontline.
dst: 波兰辅助军团的士兵——主要是军团第2旅的老兵——决定突破前线。
索莱奇尼基(沙尔奇宁凯)
塞卢姆，埃及/利比亚边境

src: Some 25,000 Rifian warriors have descended from the mountains and attacked Melilla's garrison (about 3,000). The situation is critical. Troops are retreating to Melilla which may be soon under siege.
dst: 约25000名里夫战士从山上冲下，攻击梅利利亚的守军（约3000人）。局势危急。部队正撤往梅利利亚，而该城可能很快遭到围困。

src: Some 250 sailors met in the evening of 1 November in the Union House in Kiel and prevented the fleet from setting sail again.
dst: 11月1日晚，约250名水兵在基尔的工会会馆集会，阻止舰队再次出航。

src: Some Chechen and Ingush guerrillas still roam the mountains of the Caucasus, but they aren't very powerful. The local cossack garrisons will handle them. I wish there was a way to convince them to join our army, but I think it's unlikely to happen. Anyway, that isn't too important. Now I just have to think about reinforcing our Northern front.
dst: 一些车臣和印古什游击队仍在高加索山区游荡，但他们并不强大。当地的哥萨克驻军会对付他们。我希望能有办法说服他们加入我们的军队，但我想这不太可能发生。无论如何，这并不太重要。现在我只得考虑加强我们的北方战线。

src: Some U.S.C.T and our Marine Corps will support you...
dst: 一些美国有色人种部队和我们的海军陆战队将支援您……

src: Some UN forces have escaped from Hungnam, but at least we can now continue with our advance towards Seoul.
dst: 一些联合国军部队已从兴南逃走，但至少我们现在可以继续向汉城推进了。

src: Some days ago the Germans took the Rothenturm Pass, opening the way to Bukarest. But, in order to cross the mountains quickly, we must conquer other strategic points. Two of them are the Predeal and the Altschanz Passes, south of Kronstadt. Right now, the Romanian 2nd Army is defending them. You must take your troops and crush those Romanians that are blocking our way.
dst: 几天前，德国人夺取了罗滕图尔姆山口，打开了通往布加勒斯特的道路。但是，为了迅速翻越群山，我们必须再攻占其他战略要点。其中两处是位于克龙施塔特以南的普雷迪亚尔山口与阿尔茨尚茨山口。眼下，罗马尼亚第2集团军正在防守它们。您必须率部出击，粉碎那些挡住我们去路的罗马尼亚人。

src: Some days later, we met our enemies near Hudat and the Dawa River. I was determined not to let them advance any further.
dst: 几天之后，我们在胡达特和达瓦河附近与敌人遭遇。我下定决心，绝不再让他们前进半步。

src: Some enemy divisions are trapped at the southern tip of Cape May and refuse to surrender because they hope for their evacuation by sea. But they hope in vain! Despite our air and naval superiority our intelligence reports, that the desperate Americans have send a U.S. Navy formation, presumably to evaluate the chances of an evacuation and to support the besieged forces with naval artillery. You have order to chase off or destroy the U.S. Navy units with air and submarine forces while your ground units perform a frontal assault on Cape May and forcing the enemy to surrender!
dst: 一些敌军师被困在梅角南端，拒绝投降，因为他们盼着从海上撤离。但他们是痴心妄想！尽管我们握有制空权和制海权，我方情报仍报告说，绝望的美国人派出了一支美国海军编队，想必是为了评估撤离的可能性，并用舰炮支援被围部队。你奉命以空军和潜艇部队驱逐或歼灭这些美国海军舰艇，同时让你的地面部队对梅角发起正面强攻，迫使敌人投降！

src: Some fought north of the Arctic Circle against the Bolsheviks.
dst: 有些人在北极圈以北抗击布尔什维克。

src: Some fought on French soil, in the ranks of the Polish Army, commanded by General Józef Haller, against the Germans.
dst: 有些人在法国本土、在约瑟夫·哈勒将军指挥的波兰军队行列中抗击德国人。

src: Some guerrilla groups are beyond the enemy lines, and you can probably use them to our advantage. This guerrilla units have informed us that the enemy troops here are mainly composed of the complete Italian CTV and the famous rebel 13th Division.  Do not underestimate the enemy, General.
dst: 一些游击队正在敌后活动，您很可能可以利用他们为我方谋取优势。这些游击队告知我们，此地的敌军主要由完整的意大利 CTV 和著名的叛军第13师组成。将军，不要低估敌人。

src: Some members of the government expect to end the war in the next month and maybe we will have a new Crusade in the future.
dst: 政府中一些成员预计下个月就能结束战争，也许将来我们还会有一场新的十字军远征。

src: Some of Haig's enemies still claim that it was his faulty strategy, and not the weather, the reason why the Germans managed to survive, but those opinions are ill-conceived. Haig was known by his belief in careful and thorough planning, and his staff was probably the best in the Army. His main defect was, actually, the opposite: his hesitation to admit that, too often, reality can spoil even the best of plans, and it is no use keeping on trying. Third Ypres was one of the best exmples of that truth.
dst: 黑格的一些政敌至今仍声称，德军得以存活是他的战略失误、而非天气所致，但这些观点是欠考虑的。黑格素以相信周密而彻底的筹划著称，他的参谋班子或许是全军最优秀的。他主要的缺点其实恰恰相反：他不愿承认现实往往会毁掉哪怕最完美的计划，再坚持下去也无济于事。第三次伊普尔战役就是这一道理的最好例证之一。

src: Some of the Soviet gold reserves have been hastily evacuated across the Dnieper river. A bunker guards a prestige trigger!
dst: 苏联的部分黄金储备已被匆忙撤离到第聂伯河对岸。一座地堡守护着一个威望触发点！

src: Some of the Spartacans that fought 30 years later were their progenys ...
dst: 30年后参战的斯巴达克斯追随者中，有些就是他们的后代 ...

src: Some of the surviving captives are reported to have been among the rebelling Gladiators in the Third Servile War...
dst: 据说有些幸存的俘虏后来成了第三次奴隶战争中起义的角斗士...

src: Some of your Paratroopers have been equiped with captured british Bedford trucks.
dst: 你的一些伞兵已装备了缴获的英国 Bedford 卡车。

src: Some of your units will protect the retreat.
dst: 您的一些部队将负责掩护撤退。

src: Some people also believe that a major success for us here would finish the war... but personally I don't think so.
dst: 也有人认为，我们在这里取得一场大胜就能结束战争……但就我个人而言，我并不这么认为。

src: Some people are born lucky,while others simply aren't. Poor fellow, pierced by a spear in his first battle, and buried in the middle of the jungle. Well, I guess somebody will have to write to his mother and tell her the bad news...
dst: 有些人天生走运，而另一些人就是没有。可怜的家伙，第一场战斗就被长矛刺穿，葬身于丛林深处。唉，我想总得有人给他母亲写信，告诉她这个噩耗……

src: Some people are born lucky,while others simply don't. Poor fellow, pierced by a spear in his first battle, and buried in the middle of the jungle. Well, I guess somebody will have to write to his mother and tell her the bad news...
dst: 有些人天生走运，而另一些人就是没有。可怜的家伙，第一场战斗就被长矛刺穿，葬身于丛林深处。唉，我想总得有人给他母亲写信，告诉她这个噩耗……

src: Some prominent bolsheviks have died during the battle, but most of them have managed to escape, or have simply disappeared. Most of the communist survivors that we have located have fled to Petrograd, their last bastion. Once we take it, the revolution will be finally defeated and the war will be won. We'll recover our country.
dst: 一些显要的布尔什维克在战斗中丧生，但其中大多数人设法逃脱了，或者干脆消失了。我们查明的共产党幸存者大多逃往了彼得格勒——他们最后的堡垒。一旦我们攻克它，革命就将最终被击败，战争也将获胜。我们将收复我们的国家。

src: Some things you should know: gravity's obviously going to be lighter on the moon, so you're generally gonna get better bang for your buck in terms of effective firing range.  On the other hand, shrapnel weapons will be a lot less effective, and infantry are going to be more vulnerable generally.  But you already read all this in the briefing on the way up here, so that should be old news to you.
dst: 有几点你应该知道：月球上的重力显然更轻，所以一般来说，你的有效射程会带来更好的性价比。另一方面，破片武器会大打折扣，步兵总体上也会更加脆弱。但这些你在上来的路途中已经在简报里全读过了，所以对你来说应该都是旧闻了。

src: Some tribes are allied with the Romans, others are fighting them .... Like our old allies in the north, the courageous Eburones, under their battle-experienced chief Ambiorix .....
dst: 有些部族与罗马人结盟，有些则与他们作战 .... 比如我们北方的老盟友，英勇的埃布罗内斯人，以及他们身经百战的首领安比奥里克斯 .....

src: Some troops of the 1st Ukrainian Front will assist you by your mission.
dst: 乌克兰第1方面军的部分部队将协助您完成任务。

src: Some units of the "Corps de Cavalerie" must help the I Corps, and notably its 7th division, to defend the area of Eben-Emael and prevent the bridges over the Albert-canal in the Maastricht area to be taken by the Germans.
dst: “Corps de Cavalerie”的部分部队必须协助第1军，尤其是其第7师，防守埃本-埃马尔地区，并阻止德军夺取马斯特里赫特地区阿尔贝运河上的桥梁。

src: Some weeks ago the High Command considered the idea of joining Krasnov at Tsaritsyn, but it finally decided that it would be unwise to march to the north leaving a fully equipped enemy army, far greater than ours, on our rear. Before helping Krasnov we must neutralize the Red Army of the Northern Caucasus, that outnumbers us.
dst: 数周前，最高指挥部曾考虑在察里津与克拉斯诺夫会师，但最终认定，北上进发却把一支装备齐全、远强于我们的敌军留在后方是不明智的。在援助克拉斯诺夫之前，我们必须先消灭兵力多于我们的北高加索红军。

src: Some years ago, the campaign "Weltkrieg" gave the players of Open General the chance to win the First World War playing with the Imperial German Army. But, in the meantime, what were the Austro-Hungarians doing? This new campaign answers that question. You'll lead the K.u.K from Serbia to southern France, fighting against the enemies of the Central Powers. In the end, victory can be yours. The soldiers of the King Emperor deserve their fair share of glory, and they will have it. They will be heroes, too!
dst: 几年前，「世界战争」战役让《Open General》的玩家有机会率领德意志帝国陆军赢得第一次世界大战。但与此同时，奥匈帝国又在做什么呢？这个新战役回答了这个问题。您将率领皇家帝国军队从塞尔维亚打到法国南部，与同盟国的敌人作战。最终，胜利可能属于您。国王兼皇帝的士兵们理应得到他们应有的荣耀，他们必将如愿。他们也将成为英雄！

src: Some, in ranks of the Polish 6th Infantry Division, guarded the retreat of the Czechoslovakian Legion in Siberia.
dst: 有些人编入波兰第6步兵师，在西伯利亚掩护捷克斯洛伐克军团的撤退。

src: Somehow, a part of the British soul disappeared in the trenches of Ypres, the Somme and Cambrai. The glorious era that I knew when I was young is gone forever. Once, we were the light that illuminated the world. Now, we are incapable of responding to the challenges of our modern times.
dst: 不知怎的，英国灵魂的一部分消失在了伊普尔、索姆河和康布雷的堑壕之中。我年轻时熟知的那个辉煌时代一去不复返了。曾经，我们是照亮世界的光。如今，我们却无力应对这个现代时代的种种挑战。

src: Somehow, a part of the British soul disappeared in the trenches of Ypres, the Somme and, Cambrai. The glorious era that I knew when I was young is gone forever. Once, we were the light that illuminated the world. Now, we are incapable of responding to the challenges of our modern times.
dst: 不知怎的，英国灵魂的一部分消失在了伊普尔、索姆河和康布雷的堑壕之中。我年轻时熟知的那个辉煌时代一去不复返了。曾经，我们是照亮世界的光。如今，我们却无力应对这个现代时代的种种挑战。

src: Somehow, the Danes could defeat the Prussians one last time. But they suffered so many casualties, and the defences at Düppel were so seriously damaged, that just a few days later they had to escape towards Sonderburg.
dst: 不知何故，丹麦人最后一次击败了普鲁士人。但他们伤亡如此惨重，迪伯尔的防御工事也遭到严重破坏，以至于仅仅几天后他们便不得不向松德堡撤退。
Somerset 炮兵连/第3 RHA 旅

src: Something unusual is going on with America's friend along our southern border.  The jungles of the Yucatan Peninsula are notoriously difficult to navigate and are home to little more than the local natives.  Yet, recently there have been stories of men in gray uniforms and of modern combat tanks rolling through the jungle and taking control of the villages there.  Not exactly an accurate description of the Mexican Army, which we've infiltrated with numerous plants, so the question begged is: who's running around in the Yucatan?  The Soviets?
dst: 我们南边边境上的美国朋友出了件怪事。尤卡坦半岛的丛林素以难以通行为名，除了当地土著几乎荒无人烟。然而近来有传闻说，身穿灰色制服的人驾驶着现代战斗坦克穿过丛林，控制了那里的村庄。这可不是对墨西哥军队的准确描述——我们在其中安插了大量内线。于是问题就来了：到底是谁在尤卡坦半岛上四处活动？苏联人？

src: Sometimes I still wonder why I stayed. Of course, I've become a respected and rich man. Meiying is a precious woman who has never showed any discontent about my occasional lovers. In fact, she seems happy that my affairs are scarce and short-lived, and that I've never taken any permanent concubines or fathered  illegitimate children. She says that I'm a more considerate husband than most Chinese men.
dst: 有时我仍在想，我当初为什么要留下来。当然，我已经成了一个受人尊敬、家境富裕的人。美英是个可贵的女人，对我偶尔的情人从未流露过任何不满。事实上，她似乎很高兴我的风流韵事既稀少又短暂，而且我从未纳过固定的妾室，也没有私生子女。她说，我比大多数中国男人都更体贴。

src: Sometimes it is best to bypass the enemy instead of trying to destroy him.
dst: 有时最好的做法是绕过敌人，而不是试图歼灭他。

src: Somewhere in the south-eastern Carpathians - December 22nd, 1916
dst: 喀尔巴阡山脉东南某处 - 1916年12月22日
第288特别部队/90 LD/[非洲军]
第288特别部队/90 LD/[非洲军]

src: Soon Luftwaffe will send some fighters.
dst: 德国空军很快就会派出一些战斗机。

src: Soon after Dewey's victory at Manila Bay, Washington decided to send an expedition to reinforce him and capture Manila. Had Dewey supported Aguinaldo with naval gunfire he would probably have been able to seize the city earlier. However, by the end of May Dewey had received his first instructions not to have political alliances with the insurgents. Therefore, the capture of Manila had to wait three months.
dst: 杜威在马尼拉湾获胜后不久，华盛顿决定派遣一支远征军去增援他并攻占马尼拉。如果杜威当初用舰炮火力支援阿吉纳尔多，他或许能更早拿下这座城市。然而，到5月底，杜威接到了第一批指示，不得与起义者结成政治联盟。因此，攻占马尼拉不得不等待三个月。

src: Soon after Sakarya, France signed the Treaty of Ankara with the rebels, ending all hostilities between both sides, and the Soviets showed their disposition to have a peace agreement with Turkey, too. That allowed the rebels to concentrate more troops against the Greeks, while the Hellenes had already exhausted all their reserves.
dst: 萨卡里亚之战后不久，法国与起义军签订了《安卡拉条约》，结束双方之间的一切敌对行动，苏联也表现出与土耳其达成和平协议的意向。这使起义军得以集中更多兵力对付希腊人，而希腊人已经耗尽了全部后备力量。

src: Soon after acquiring fresh new Panzer II tanks, your battalion was ordered to attack the Soviet positions east of Kholm. Our men still hold the town, but they are in a desperate situation. Airdropped supplies are running low, as many of the JU 52 transport planes were shot down by the enemy. You need to act quickly, and completely dismantle the enemy. Destroy the Soviets east of the city, thus cutting off their frontline units in Kholm and its vicinity by severing their supply lines, then secure the eastern approaches so that a save evacuation is possible.
dst: 在接收崭新的二号坦克后不久，你的营奉命进攻霍尔姆以东的苏军阵地。我们的部队仍守着该城，但处境绝望。空投补给日渐告罄，因为许多 Ju 52 运输机被敌击落。你必须火速行动，彻底瓦解敌军。消灭城东的苏军，从而切断霍尔姆及其周边敌军前线部队的补给线，然后确保东部通道，以便安全撤离。

src: Soon afterwards, things got even worse. The whole country fell slowly under Soviet influence. In 1946 a communist party won the elections and the inevitable was just a question of time. In February 1948 communists overthrown the government and gained power for the next fourty years.
dst: 此后不久，情况变得更糟。整个国家慢慢落入苏联的影响之下。1946年共产党赢得选举，结局只是时间问题。1948年2月，共产党推翻政府，在此后四十年里掌权。

src: Soon the task became too hard, because troops from all over the British Empire flooded into the Nile Delta, while the Ottoman Empire could send there only a weak corps. The Ottomans retreated to safer positions in Gaza and Beersheba, although they manteined some advanced outposts on the Siani peninsula.
dst: 很快，这项任务变得过于艰巨，因为来自大英帝国各地的军队涌入了尼罗河三角洲，而奥斯曼帝国只能往那里派出一个弱小的军。奥斯曼人撤退到加沙和贝尔谢巴更安全的阵地，尽管他们仍在西奈半岛保留了一些前沿哨所。

src: Soon we will occupy Japan, Herr Feldmarschall, and through peaceful means.  German influence reigns unchallenged throughout the world.  You are to be commended for your many victories by Herr Hitler himself.
dst: 我们很快将占领日本，元帅阁下，而且是以和平手段。德国的影响力在全世界无可匹敌地君临。希特勒先生本人要对你的诸多胜利予以嘉奖。

src: Soon we'll occupy most of Albania. However, no matter how much we hurry, many Serbian soldiers will have enough time to embark on the coast, and they'll leave for Corfu or Greece. It doesn't matter. This has been our finest victory since the war started. Serbia has been destroyed, we control most of the Balkans, and the Bulgarians are strong enough to do most of the future fighting in this area. Now we can focus on the Eastern front, and on the war against Italy. Redeem yourself there.
dst: 很快我们将占领阿尔巴尼亚大部。然而，无论我们动作多快，许多塞尔维亚士兵都会有充足时间在海岸登船，前往科孚岛或希腊。这没关系。这是开战以来我们最辉煌的胜利。塞尔维亚已被摧毁，我们控制了巴尔干大部，保加利亚人也强大到足以承担该地区未来的大部分战事。现在我们可以把注意力转向东线，以及对意大利的战争。去那里将功赎罪吧。

src: Soon we'll occupy most of Albania. However, no matter how much we hurry, many Serbian soldiers will have enough time to embark on the coast, and they'll leave for Corfu or continental Greece. It doesn't matter. This has been our finest victory since the war started. Serbia has been destroyed, we control most of the Balkans, and the Bulgarians are strong enough to do most of the future fighting in this area. Now we can focus on the Eastern front, and on the war against Italy.
dst: 很快我们将占领阿尔巴尼亚大部。然而，无论我们动作多快，许多塞尔维亚士兵都会有充足时间在海岸登船，前往科孚岛或希腊本土。这没关系。这是开战以来我们最辉煌的胜利。塞尔维亚已被摧毁，我们控制了巴尔干大部，保加利亚人也强大到足以承担该地区未来的大部分战事。现在我们可以把注意力转向东线，以及对意大利的战争。

src: Soon you and your men will be deployed as reserves in Aragon and await further orders.
dst: 不久您和您的部下将被部署到阿拉贡作为预备队，等候进一步命令。

src: Soon you will have the support of a carrier and some ships from the north east. Also you have our Flakschiff under your command with the upgraded engines.
dst: 不久你将获得一艘航母以及来自东北方向的部分舰艇支援。此外，经过引擎升级的防空舰也归你指挥。

src: Soon, under the danger of becoming encircled, the Turkish force at Gaza city had to retreat.
dst: 很快，面临被合围的危险，加沙城的土耳其守军不得不撤退。

src: Sorendrup and his men defended themselves with remarkable proficiency, inflicting us a severe punishment. However, seeing that they were outnumbered, and knowing that soon we'd receive reinforcements, they finally left the battlefield, retreating in good order.
dst: 索伦德鲁普和他的部下以非凡的娴熟技艺进行自卫，使我们遭受了惨重损失。然而，看到自己寡不敌众，又知道我们很快会得到增援，他们最终离开了战场，井然有序地撤退了。

src: Sorry comrade, obviously you were not the right man for the task. Now go, comrade Beria is waiting to talk to you...
dst: 抱歉，同志，显然你不是完成这项任务的合适人选。现在去吧，贝利亚同志正等着跟你谈话……
索特龙迪奥 No.243/1 阿斯图里亚斯旅

src: Source: 'New evidence suggests that the Germans may have been closer to victory at Kursk than previously recognized' by George M. Nipe, Jr.
dst: 资料来源：George M. Nipe, Jr.《新证据表明，德军在库尔斯克距胜利可能比此前认为的更近》。

src: Sources claim that brigade knocked out many German bunkers and machine guns, destroyed several vehicles, including two Ferdinands. Czechoslovaks even shot down an airplane.
dst: 据记载，该旅摧毁了许多德军碉堡和机枪，毁掉数辆车辆，包括两辆“费迪南”。捷克斯洛伐克人甚至还击落了一架飞机。

src: South African Brig./ 9th Div./ II Corps/ II Army
dst: South 非洲旅/ 第9师/ 第2军/ 第2集团军
美国印第安纳州南本德
南俄罗斯阿斯特拉罕以南
南俄罗斯斯大林格勒东南
英国朴次茅斯东南外海
西伯利亚鄂木斯克西南
爱尔兰南海岸沃特福德西南外海

src: Soviet 28. and 38. army under command of marshal Timosenko attacks against of our 6. army.
dst: 铁木辛哥元帅麾下的苏军第 28 与第 38 集团军，向我军第 6 集团军发起进攻。

src: Soviet 2nd. guards army and 51. military attacks on Rostov on Don. If they occupy Rostov they will cut off our whole army group "A" , which draws off from Caucasus and that meets same fate, like 6th army in Stalingrad.
dst: 苏军近卫第 2 集团军与第 51 集团军进攻顿河上的罗斯托夫。若他们占领罗斯托夫，将切断我军整个『A』集团军群——该部正从高加索撤出，或将遭遇与斯大林格勒第 6 集团军相同的命运。

src: Soviet air force and tanks are busy in the north on the Kuban River, also no enemy ships are spotted, but watch for possible enemy cavalry reinforcements.
dst: 苏联空军和坦克正在北面库班河一带忙得不可开交，也未发现敌舰，但要提防敌军骑兵可能的增援。

src: Soviet armies break defence on river Dnieper and now they threaten Kiev with diretc attacks from the East and the North.
dst: 苏军突破第聂伯河防线，现从东、北两面向基辅发起直接进攻。

src: Soviet commissar, most likely to be Aleksei Gordeyevich Yeryomenko.
dst: 苏联政委，极可能是阿列克谢·戈尔杰耶维奇·叶廖缅科。

src: Soviet counter attack along the Volkhovskogo front.
dst: 苏军沿沃尔霍夫防线发起反攻。

src: Soviet forces are comprised mainly of lower-quality troops, untrained conscripts, and partisan fighters based in the nearby hamlets. Destroy the NKVD blocking units as this will facilitate a complete annihilation of Soviet resistance in the area.
dst: 苏军主要由素质低下的部队、未经训练的新兵和驻扎在附近村落的游击队员组成。消灭内务人民委员部（NKVD）的督战部队，这将有助于彻底肃清该地区的苏军抵抗。

src: Soviet forces consist of a dozen tank battalions supported by mechanized artillery and strong motorized rifle units. Tactical bombers operate from nearby airfields.
dst: 苏军由十来个坦克营组成，得到机械化炮兵和强大摩托化步兵部队的支援。战术轰炸机从附近机场起飞作战。

src: Soviet forces consist of two battlegroups. The main force holds the outer lines east of Kholm, and it is your task to destroy them and thus facilitate liberation of the cauldron. These are formed of infantry with some light artillery and AA support. The second, smaller group, is assaulting the town, and they are supported by light tanks and infantry guns. Destroy their rear before they overcome the defenders of Kholm.
dst: 苏军由两个战斗群组成。主力守住霍尔姆以东的外围防线，你的任务就是消灭他们，从而促成合围圈的解放。这些部队由步兵加上少量轻炮和高射炮支援组成。第二群规模较小，正进攻该城，得到轻坦克和步兵炮的支援。赶在他们压垮霍尔姆守军之前摧毁其后方。

src: Soviet forces consist of two battlegroups. The main force holds the outer lines east of Kholm, and it is your task to destroy them and thus facilitate liberation of the pocket. These are formed of infantry with some light artillery and AA support. The second, smaller group is assaulting the town, and they are supported by light tanks and infantry guns. Destroy their rear before they overcome the defenders of Kholm.
dst: 苏军由两个战斗群组成。主力守住霍尔姆以东的外围防线，你的任务就是消灭他们，从而促成包围圈的解放。这些部队由步兵加上少量轻炮和高射炮支援组成。第二群规模较小，正进攻该城，得到轻坦克和步兵炮的支援。赶在他们压垮霍尔姆守军之前摧毁其后方。

src: Soviet forces have already made it ashore via unknown methods and reports indicate they are heading this way.
dst: 苏军部队已经通过不明方式登陆，报告显示他们正朝这边推进。

src: Soviet forces launch an counterattack against Romanian and German troops west of Melitopol.
dst: 苏军对梅利托波尔以西的罗马尼亚和德国军队发动反攻。

src: Soviet forces, overwhelming in numbers and equipment, began an offensive on January 13, 1943. The Red Army was totally successful: they rapidly destroyed the Hungarian 2nd Army near Svoboda on the Don River. An attack on the German 2nd Army further north threatened to bring about an encirclement of that army as well, though it managed to withdraw and was forced to retreat.
dst: 1943年1月13日，兵力和装备均占压倒优势的苏军发起攻势。红军取得彻底成功：他们在顿河畔的斯沃博达附近迅速歼灭了匈牙利第2集团军。对更北面的德国第2集团军的攻击，也险些使该集团军陷入合围，不过它最终得以脱离，只是被迫后撤。

src: Soviet guard's rifle division is moving in from the south. Infatrymen advance cautiously to avoid ambush, with tanks and SPATs following in their wake. Sky is filled with Soviet airplanes, and there's not a single Luftwaffe machine to oppose them. Enemy rear is firmly held, and there's no other chance than to break through, escape the noose of the approaching Soviet troops, and reach the British lines to avoid Siberia or worse.
dst: 苏军近卫步兵师正从南面逼近。步兵谨慎推进以防伏击，坦克和自行反坦克炮紧随其后。天空中满是苏军飞机，却没有一架德国空军的战机出来迎击。敌军后方据守牢固，除了突围别无他路——摆脱步步逼近的苏军绞索，抵达英军战线，以免被送往西伯利亚或更糟的去处。

src: Soviet landings across the Kerch Strait and in the north-eastern sector of the Crimea near Sivash at the end of 1943, together with an attack at the Perekop Isthmus forced 17. Armee back towards Sevastopol from 10 April 1944. The OKW intended to hold Sevastopol as a fortress, as the Red Army had done during the first battle for the Crimea in 1941/42. The rapid movement of the Red Army together with inadequate preparation of the defenses of Sevastopol made this impossible, and on 9 May 1944, not even one month after the start of the battle, Sevastopol fell.
dst: 1943年底苏军在刻赤海峡及克里米亚东北部锡瓦什附近登陆，加之对彼列科普地峡的进攻，迫使第17集团军自1944年4月10日起退向塞瓦斯托波尔。OKW（最高统帅部）意图将塞瓦斯托波尔作为要塞固守，一如红军在1941/42年克里米亚首战中那样。但红军的迅速推进与塞瓦斯托波尔防御准备之不足，使此图谋落空——1944年5月9日，即战役开始后不到一个月，塞瓦斯托波尔陷落。

src: Soviet lines are held by mostly infantry. The enemy is not really active, but they have some air support from the nearby base. Some light tanks can come to their aid.
dst: 苏军战线主要由步兵把守。敌军并不十分活跃，但可从附近基地获得一些空中支援。部分轻型坦克也能前来助战。

src: Soviet militaries are certainly played out and Moscow will be destroyed.
dst: 苏军必然已精疲力竭，莫斯科将被攻陷。

src: Soviet soldiers holding PPSh-41 while defending the outskirts of Stalingrad, November 1942.
dst: 苏军士兵手持 PPSh-41 防守斯大林格勒近郊，1942年11月。

src: Soviet troops are highly mobile and well equipped. Don't leave any gaps in your formation for them to exploit.
dst: 苏军部队高度机动、装备精良。别在阵型中留下任何可被他们利用的空隙。

src: Soviets amassed a lot of armoured vehicles, and they got substantial air support. The approaches to the northeast are heavily guarded with entrenched infatnry, field, anti-tank and anti-aircraft artillery.
dst: 苏军集结了大量装甲车辆，并拥有可观的空中支援。通往东北的要道有堑壕步兵、野战炮、反坦克炮和高射炮重兵把守。

src: Soviets crossed the river and are fanning out to southeast. They got several tank battalions in the area and they firmly hold the river crossing.
dst: 苏军已渡河，正向东南方向散开。他们在该地区有数个坦克营，并牢牢扼守着渡口。

src: Soviets hold the river crossings with infantry, field and anti-aircraft artillery. Their air support is subpar to that of Germans. Air recon confirmed a light tanks battalion ready to contest your panzers. Soviet rear seems to be held by depleted forces.
dst: 苏军以步兵、野战炮和高射炮扼守渡口。他们的空中支援逊于德军。空中侦察确认有一个轻型坦克营准备与你的装甲部队一较高下。苏军后方似由残破部队把守。
苏维埃茨基 (穆沙伊俄斯基)

src: Sowjetunion. Unternehmen "Zitadelle". Panzerjäger Marder III Ausf. H (Sd. Kfz. 138). 21 June 1943.
dst: 苏联。“堡垒”行动。黄鼠狼 III 型 H 型坦克歼击车（Sd. Kfz. 138）。1943年6月21日。

src: Sowjetunion.- deutscher Infanterist in zerstörtem Gebäude (Demjansk?).
dst: 苏联——在被毁建筑中的德国步兵（杰米扬斯克？）。

src: Sowohl Cäsar, als auch Claudius landen mit ihren Truppen an der engsten stelle des Kanals, um die Gegend des damaligen Dubris, des heutigen Dover...
dst: 凯撒与克劳狄都把部队登上了海峡最窄处、当年的杜布里斯一带，也就是今天的多佛……

src: Spain had made no effort to reinforce this remote post of its empire. Spanish garrison on the island consisted only of 54 Spanish soldiers and 54 native "Chamorros". The rumors that there was a Spanish gunboat at Guam were not correct, it was only the Japanese vessel Minatogawa, trading in copra. The US determined afterwords that the fort were of no military value and that the old cast iron guns were even unsafe for saluting purposes.
dst: 西班牙从未费力去增援这个帝国偏远的哨站。岛上的西班牙守军只有54名西班牙士兵和54名土著「查莫罗人」。关于关岛有一艘西班牙炮艇的传闻并不属实，那只是日本商船港川号，来此做椰干贸易。美军事后断定该堡垒毫无军事价值，那些老旧的铸铁炮甚至用来鸣放礼炮都不安全。

src: Spain may have lost the war and its empire but Spanish soldiers have won the admiration of the world through their valour, determination and heroism. You do not merit being part of the same army to which these brave soldiers belong to. You are dismissed from the service.
dst: 西班牙或许输掉了战争和帝国，但西班牙士兵凭借其英勇、坚毅和英雄气概赢得了全世界的敬仰。您配不上与这些勇士同属一支军队。您被解除军职了。

src: Spain's alliance with El Raisuli proved to be weak. After the WWI there was a new period of unrest in northern Morocco. Determined to put an end to El Raisuli´s insurgence, general Berenguer decided to take the Berber strongholds on the Djebala and Gomara mountains. The main objective would be the holy town of Xauen, a religious center for the Moroccan people. The taking of Xauen by the Spanish army would be a great blow for the morale of the rebels and for El Raisuli's prestige, and the Spanish victory in Morocco would be much closer.
dst: 西班牙与赖苏利的联盟被证明是脆弱的。第一次世界大战之后，摩洛哥北部进入了新一轮动荡时期。贝伦格尔将军决心终结赖苏利的叛乱，于是决定夺取杰巴拉山和戈马拉山上的柏柏尔据点。主要目标将是圣城舍夫沙万——摩洛哥人的宗教中心。西班牙军队攻占舍夫沙万，将是对叛军士气和赖苏利威望的重大打击，西班牙在摩洛哥的胜利也将近在咫尺。

src: Spanish declined several invitations to surrender and only capitulated when they realized that the news that Spain had lost the war, which had been conveyed through different newspapers and emissaries, was not a ruse but reality. Recognizing their epic defence, Aguinaldo decreed that the survivors were to be considered "not as prisoners of war but as friends" and they were allowed to march to Manila to be repatriated to Spain, where they were lauded as heroes.
dst: 西班牙人多次拒绝了劝降，直到他们意识到，通过各种报纸和使者传达的西班牙战败的消息并非计谋而是事实，他们才投降。为了表彰他们的史诗般坚守，阿吉纳尔多下令，幸存者应被视为「不是战俘，而是朋友」，并允许他们行军前往马尼拉，再遣返西班牙；在西班牙，他们被誉为英雄。

src: Spartacus ! Now it's your turn to avert this threat. The first real battle is to win !
dst: 斯巴达克斯！现在轮到你化解这一威胁了。第一场真正的战斗必须打赢！

src: Spartacus - Months have passed and your followers entreched at Vesuvius. Gaius Claudius Glaber by now received the order to put down the rebellion.
dst: 斯巴达克斯——数月已过，你的追随者在维苏威扎下营寨。盖乌斯克劳狄乌斯格拉贝鲁斯此时已接到平定叛乱的命令。

src: Spartacus aligned obsequies for the fallen Crixus, where between 300 and 400 prisoned Romans had to fight against each other in a gladiatorial combat
dst: 斯巴达克斯为阵亡的克里克索斯举行了葬礼，其间300至400名被俘的罗马人被迫在角斗中互相厮杀

src: Spartacus encountered the strong forces of Crassus at Paestum. It is told, that he killed his own horse while saying, that if they would lose today, he wouldn`t need one anymore and, if they would win, he would have more Horses then he could ever need. He personally lead the attack on the roman Camp. The heroic, but because of the secession of the Celts weakened Slaves were defeated by the heavily superiority of Crassus. Only a few survived. Crassus gave order to crucify 6.000 captured Slaves along the Via Appia towards Rome. The fate of Spartacus is unknown, even the romans were not able to find his dead body or identify him underneath the captives. By this, the Trakian disappeared as shrouded in mystery as he had risen from it in the past, to shock the foundations of the triumphant Rome and to defeat several roman armys.
dst: 斯巴达克斯在佩斯图姆遭遇了克拉苏斯的大军。据说他亲手杀死了自己的战马，并说：若今日战败，他便再不需要战马；若今日获胜，他会有多到用不完的马。他亲自率军进攻罗马营地。英勇的奴隶们因凯尔特人的分裂而实力受损，最终被占据绝对优势的克拉苏斯击败。只有少数人活了下来。克拉苏斯下令把6,000名被俘奴隶钉死在通往罗马的阿皮亚大道两侧。斯巴达克斯的下落不明，连罗马人也未能找到他的尸体或在俘虏中认出他。这位色雷斯人就此消失，如同他当初从迷雾中崛起那般神秘——他撼动了凯旋的罗马的根基，并数次击败罗马军队。

src: Spartacus had spend the Winter at the bleak headland of South Italy. The escape overseas using the kilikian Pirates worked, despite a big advanced payment. That was how he had to break trough the siege of Crassus. At their first try about 12.000 Slaves died and it looked as if the fate of the Slave army was sealed. But the tide turned. At their second try the Slaves suddenly recovered their old strength, broke through the siege and invaded the interior of the Province Lukania.
dst: 斯巴达克斯在意大利南部荒凉的海岬度过了冬天。他企图借奇里乞亚海盗渡海出逃，尽管预付了大笔款项，计划仍告落空。于是他不得不突破克拉苏斯的封锁。第一次尝试中约有12,000名奴隶阵亡，奴隶大军的命运看似已被注定。但形势逆转了。第二次尝试时，奴隶们忽然恢复了旧日的战力，突破封锁，攻入卢卡尼亚行省内陆。

src: Spartacus now it`s getting tough. You march in the direction of Paestum. Certainly here are four Legions of Crassus - ready to fight. According to rumors Pompeius is also on the way to Paestum. This means now: Fight for your Life !!!
dst: 斯巴达克斯，现在要动真格了。你朝佩斯图姆方向进军。这里必有克拉苏斯的四个军团——准备开战。据传庞培也在赶往佩斯图姆的路上。这就是说：为你的性命而战！！！

src: Spartacus was born about 110 BC in the area around the middle course of the Strymon
dst: 斯巴达克斯约生于公元前110年，地在斯特里蒙河中游一带

src: Spartacus! The Celts that had seperated from you need your help! Crassus redeployed his troops undetected to the close Camp and is attacking our Friends Gannius and Castus. Come on there is no time to waste...
dst: 斯巴达克斯！先前与你分兵的凯尔特人需要你的帮助！克拉苏斯已神不知鬼不觉地调兵到近处的营地，正在进攻我们的朋友甘尼乌斯与卡斯图斯。快，时间不容耽搁……

src: Spartacus, after defeating two of Varinius subordinate leaders, you are now almost surrounded by Varinius´ main troops.
dst: 斯巴达克斯，在击败瓦里尼乌斯手下两名将领之后，你如今几乎被瓦里尼乌斯的主力包围了。

src: Spartacus, here you only have one option -> Defeat Lentullus and moves on to the north.
dst: 斯巴达克斯，你只有一条路可走 -> 击败伦图卢斯，继续北上。

src: Spartacus, now you have to prove yourself in the fight against Varius's legacy Cossinius.
dst: 斯巴达克斯，现在你要在与瓦里乌斯余部科西尼乌斯的战斗中证明自己。

src: Spartacus, we`ve spend the Winter at the Söuth and consolidated. But Crassus used the Time. He has build up a mighty siege. Could we break through and invade the interior of the country? It has to be done soon, because we are running out of supplys...
dst: 斯巴达克斯，我们在南方度过了冬天并巩固了力量。但克拉苏斯利用了这段时间。他已筑起一道强大的封锁线。我们能突围并打进内陆吗？必须尽快行动，因为补给快要耗尽了……
斯巴达克团起义 - 柏林
Spe. 旅/ Kon. 集团军

src: Speaking of that matter, I guess you understand that such an innovative operation must be led by a young commander, familiar with the characteristics of modern warfare. With all the respect that you and other veteran officers deserve, it´s time to reform the Spanish army. I think that you'd better ask for a honourable, well earned retirement.
dst: 说到这件事，我想您也明白，这样一场新颖的作战，必须由一位熟悉现代战争特点的年轻指挥官来领导。尽管您和其他资深军官都值得尊敬，但如今是改革西班牙军队的时候了。我想，您最好申请一份体面的、受之无愧的退休吧。

src: Speaking of the matter, I wish that we had actually signed a treaty with our allies. They may be trustworthy, but you never know when disagreements can arise...
dst: 说到这件事，我倒希望我们当初真的和盟友签了一份条约。他们或许值得信赖，但您永远不知道什么时候会生出分歧……

src: Spearheading the advance into Tunesia are 36 Brigade Group of the 78th Infantry Division in the North, airdropped 1st British Paratrooper battalion and Blade Force in the center, and 11th Brigade group of the 78th British Infantry Division in the South (off-map).
dst: 向突尼斯推进的先锋是：北路的第78步兵师第36旅集群，中路空投的英军第1伞兵营与“刀锋”部队，以及南路（地图外）的英军第78步兵师第11旅集群。

src: Specifically, our new mission would be the taking of Ryazan and Kolomna, southeast of Moscow.  I was determined to succeed, no matter the cost.
dst: 具体来说，我们的新任务是夺取莫斯科东南的梁赞和科洛姆纳。我下定决心要不惜一切代价取得成功。

src: Speed is vital, so take care of the auxiliary recon units.
dst: 速度至关重要，所以要保护好辅助侦察部队。

src: Spending most of his military career in the Grenadier Guards, Dickinson will fight in the most important British colonial wars in Africa, as well as in the Great War.
dst: 迪金森的大部分军旅生涯在掷弹兵近卫团度过，他将参加英国在非洲最重要的殖民战争，以及第一次世界大战。

src: Splendid job, General! You have inflicted serious tank losses on the Bolsheviks and you held on to Arad. However, Red advances east and south of the city force us to retreat behind the Tisza river.
dst: 干得漂亮，将军！你让布尔什维克损失了大量坦克，还守住了阿拉德。然而，红军在城市以东和以南的推进迫使我们退到蒂萨河之后。

src: Splendid job, sir.  We've pushed the Germans back somewhat to the west of Caen, allowing Montgomery the pleasure of moving his drinks cabinet six inches closer to Berlin.  Unfortunately those German reinforcements that showed up have stalled our advance, and we need a new plan to wrest Caen from the Bosch.  I fear the words "I have a cunning plan" are rapidly marching from Montgomery's mouth with ill-deserved confidence.  Cup of tea, sir?
dst: 干得漂亮，长官。我们已把德军向西压退到卡昂以西一段，让蒙哥马利得以乐滋滋地把他的酒柜向柏林挪近了六英寸。遗憾的是，那些出现的德军援军迟滞了我们的推进，我们需要一个新计划来从德国佬手中夺下卡昂。我担心“我有个狡猾的计划”这句话正从蒙哥马利口中以莫须有的自信鱼贯而出。来杯茶吗，长官？

src: Splendid performance General!. You were able to establish and secure a beachhead in time. Unfortunately the Germans are bringing in reinforcements. It will take a while to fight our way out of the beachhead.
dst: 表现出色，将军！你及时建立并巩固了一处滩头阵地。不幸的是，德军正在增调援兵。我们要从滩头阵地打出去还需要一段时间。

src: Splendid performance, Herr General! You repelled all Soviet attacks and the road to Moscow is ours! But first we have to take Leningrad!
dst: 表现极为出色，将军阁下！你击退了苏联人的所有进攻，通往莫斯科的道路已是我们的了！但首先我们必须拿下列宁格勒！

src: Splendid performance, sir.  With Syracuse in our hands we have secured an excellent supply hub for our advance to Messina.  We have also gained valuable lessons in amphibious landings which will help us plan for the return to France.
dst: 表现出色，长官。锡拉库萨既已入手，我们就为向墨西拿推进取得了一个极佳的补给枢纽。我们还从两栖登陆中汲取了宝贵经验，这将有助于我们谋划重返法国。

src: Splendid work Commander our defensive line is now complete to El Arish and we stand a good chance of defeating any Turkish attack towards Egypt!!
dst: 出色的工作，指挥官，我们的防线现已推进到阿里什，我们有很大把握击退任何朝埃及方向的土耳其进攻！！

src: Splendid work, sir.  We've landed and successfully consolidated our beachhead.  Now, we must move to capture Caen at the earliest possible convenience.  I'm sure Montgomery is hatching a cunning plan as we speak...
dst: 干得漂亮，长官。我们已经登陆并成功巩固了滩头。现在，我们必须尽早夺取卡昂。我敢肯定，此刻蒙哥马利正在酝酿一个狡猾的计划……

src: Splendid! We've almost reached the Greek border, and now Italy will have to spend many men and resources securing the new front line. The plan has worked.
dst: 好极了！我们几乎打到了希腊边境，如今意大利将不得不耗费大量兵力与资源去巩固新战线。计划奏效了。

src: Splendid, General! Thanks to the elegance with which you conducted the operation we are now in a position to take control of the entire Middle East!
dst: 精彩绝伦，将军！多亏你指挥行动时的巧妙，我们现在得以掌控整个中东！

src: Splendid, sir.  Jerry sure made a bit of a ruckus in this sector, but we soon put a stop to that - thanks to your magnificent generalship, of course.  The commander of the U.S. 2nd Armoured Division sends his gratitude for your help, in the form of the largest collection of Charlie Chaplin films ever gathered.  Its all piled up outside your HQ.  Shall I use petrol to make it burn quicker, sir?
dst: 漂亮，长官。德国佬确实在这一地段闹腾了一阵，但我们很快就让他们消停了——当然，全靠你卓越的统兵才能。美军第2装甲师的指挥官为表谢意，送来了有史以来最全的查理·卓别林影片合集。全堆在你的指挥部外面了。要我浇上汽油让它烧得更快些吗，长官？

src: Splendidly handled, sir.  Those Italians certainly put up a stiff patch of resistance, but our forces prevailed in the end, no doubt due to your great ability as a General.  Elsewhere things are going well, and victory is well within our sights here in East Africa.
dst: 处理得漂亮，长官。那些意大利人确实进行了一番顽抗，但我们最终取胜了，无疑要归功于你作为将军的非凡才能。其他方向进展顺利，东非这里的胜利已近在眼前。

src: Splendidly handled, sir.  Those Italians certainly put up a stiff patch of resistance, but our forces prevailed in the end, no doubt due to your unrivalled ability as a General.  Elsewhere things are going well, and victory is well within our sights here in East Africa.
dst: 处理得漂亮，长官。那些意大利人确实进行了一番顽抗，但我们最终取胜了，无疑要归功于你作为将军无与伦比的才能。其他方向进展顺利，东非这里的胜利已近在眼前。

src: Staraya Russa, south of Lake Ilmen, was occupied by the Germans between August 9, 1941 and February 18, 1944. In January and February the Soviets launched a powerful attack which trapped German units in the Demyansk Pocket southeast of Staraya Russa.
dst: 伊尔门湖以南的旧鲁萨在1941年8月9日至1944年2月18日期间被德国人占领。1月和2月，苏军发动了一场强大的进攻，将德军部队围困在旧鲁萨东南的德米扬斯克包围圈中。

src: Staraya Russa, south of Novgorod, was an important communications center between Leningrad and Moscow.  Though the Germans made some progress, the Soviets prevented a complete breakthrough, delaying the German push to Moscow until the cold winter snows had fallen.
dst: 旧鲁萨位于诺夫哥罗德以南，是列宁格勒与莫斯科之间的重要通信中心。虽然德军取得了一些进展，苏军却阻止了完全突破，把德军向莫斯科的推进拖到了寒冬大雪降临之后。

src: Starting as an infantry battalion, the Czechoslovak unit rose to the size of an army corps till the end of the war. The Czechoslovaks fought many engagements with the Germans, including several of the bloodiest battles in the history of WW2, most notably the Carpatho-Dukla Operation.
dst: 捷克斯洛伐克部队起初只是一个步兵营，到战争结束时已发展到军级规模。捷克斯洛伐克人与德军多次交战，其中包括二战史上最血腥的几场战役，最著名的当属喀尔巴阡-杜克拉行动。

src: Starting in the early days of October 1941, Unternehmen Taifun was a second stage of the German strategical offensive against Moscow.
dst: 始于1941年10月初的“台风”行动，是德军对莫斯科战略攻势的第二阶段。

src: Starting with the formation of Estonian regiments by the Russian Empire and ending with a bitter struggle against the Red Army for independence, you will lead Estonian troops into battle in this historical campaign.
dst: 从俄罗斯帝国组建爱沙尼亚各团开始，到与红军为独立而进行的艰苦斗争告终，您将在这个历史战役中率领爱沙尼亚部队投入战斗。

src: Stavka (Grand Duke Alexander) has ordered a fighting withdrawal in Southern Poland:  preparations were made to abandon established  fortress of Novogeorgievsk facing the northern wing of the German pincer.  Dispatching the Guard Corps (Bezobrazov) to Kholm, the 3rd Army was tasked with delaying the 11th Army on the banks of the Wieprz River, while the bulk of the 3rd Army retreated behind the Bug River.
dst: 大本营（亚历山大大公）已下令在波兰南部实施战斗撤退：已做好准备放弃新格奥尔吉耶夫斯克这座面对德军钳形攻势北翼的既设要塞。近卫军（别佐布拉佐夫）被派往海乌姆，第3集团军的任务是在维普日河沿岸迟滞第11集团军，同时第3集团军主力撤到布格河之后。

src: Stavka came upon the decision to evacuate Lodz and to consolidate the line at prepared positions west of Warsaw.  Our 2nd and 5th armies must fight heavy rearguard battles as the troops withdraw to a new position.
dst: 大本营决定撤离罗兹，在华沙以西的预设阵地巩固战线。我军第2、第5集团军必须在部队撤向新阵地时进行艰苦的后卫战斗。

src: Stavka is not pleased. Not pleased at all. I suggest you hold the honour to yourself...
dst: 统帅部很不高兴。非常不高兴。我建议你自己把荣誉留着吧……

src: Stay calm and defend this very important town! Surrender is not an option!
dst: 保持镇定，守住这座极其重要的城镇！投降绝不在考虑之列！

src: Stay focus to the target, don't spend your time to hunt enemies.
dst: 专注于目标，不要把时间花在追击敌人上。

src: Stop it from destroying us and we can trust in better peaceable conditions.

src: Stop the Americans as much as possible, and then, evacuate this island.

src: Stop the overconfident Italians in front of Guadalajara and crush them.
dst: 在瓜达拉哈拉城前阻止过分自信的意大利人，并将他们击溃。

src: Storm surges and food shortage caused by climatic changings in the second half of the 2nd Century BC, drove parts of the Cimbri and Teutons to leave their homes in northern Jutland and seek a new home in southern regions.
dst: 公元前2世纪后半叶因气候变化引发的风暴潮与粮食短缺，迫使辛布里人和条顿人的一部分离开日德兰北部的家园，去南方寻找新的居所。

src: Storyline:  It's been 6 months since your father's death. I'm sorry to have to tell you that a few days ago the Gestapo went to your parents house and they searched for hours. It's understandable that your mother would be upset. But I want to assure you that she is good.
dst: 剧情：  你父亲去世已6个月了。很抱歉不得不告诉你，几天前盖世太保去了你父母家，搜查了数小时。你母亲因此心烦意乱，这是可以理解的。但我想向你保证，她很好。

src: Storyline: From now on we will only talk through the messages I will send you through my trusted sailor. The situation here is complicated with the Gestapo watching my every move. Know that I fear more for your sister than for myself. Also know that your mother cannot be hurt. Finally, know that with your successes, you have made many fans but also many enemies. Fortunately, the naval staff has your back. That's why other marines who traveled in secret will be placed under your command. Their boat was sunk by the rebels but they caught up and disembarked.
dst: 剧情：从现在起，我们只能通过我信赖的水手传递的信息来联络。这里局势复杂，盖世太保监视着我的一举一动。要知道，我为你妹妹的担忧胜过为我自己。也要知道，你的母亲不会受到伤害。最后，要知道，随着你的成功，你赢得了许多拥趸，但也树敌众多。幸运的是，海军参谋部支持你。因此，其他秘密出航的海军陆战队员将归你指挥。他们的船被叛军击沉，但他们还是追了上来并登陆了。

src: Storyline: Herr Kommodore, I regret to inform you that the submarine in which your sister's husband served, has been sunk on 6 February 1942 north-east of the Azores by British warships. My sincere condolences!
dst: 剧情：海军准将阁下，我很遗憾地通知您，您姐夫服役的那艘潜艇已于1942年2月6日在亚速尔群岛东北海域被英国军舰击沉。谨致最诚挚的哀悼！

src: Storyline: I am happy to see you again. I chose to meet you here, where nobody can listen to us. I know you since you were a young boy and at the Academy you proved to everybody that you are one of the best. But the ideas of your father will follow you for the rest of your career. Sounds crazy, a raid to England, I know....I don't want to tell you more, you understand. Good luck!!! My regards to your mother.
dst: 剧情：很高兴再次见到你。我选择在这里与你会面，这里没人能偷听我们说话。我认识你还是个少年的时候，在军校时你向所有人证明了自己是最优秀的人之一。但你父亲的想法会伴随你余下的整个职业生涯。听起来很疯狂，一次对英格兰的突袭，我知道……我不想再多说，你明白的。祝你好运！！！代我向你母亲问好。

src: Storyline: I decided to fly all the way to Lampedusa because that's the only way I could talk to you.
dst: 剧情：我决定一路飞到兰佩杜萨岛，因为那是唯一能与你面谈的办法。

src: Storyline: I know you should have been close to your mother these days. I saw her at your father's memorial service, she is standing well.
dst: 剧情：我知道这些天你本该陪在你母亲身边。我在你父亲的追悼会上见过她，她身体还好。

src: Storyline: I'm afraid your decision to move your mother into your sister's house was not a good one. She is already on the Gestapo list, even though her husband is a member of the Nazi Party.
dst: 剧情：恐怕你把你母亲搬进你妹妹家的决定并不明智。她已经上了盖世太保的名单，尽管她的丈夫是纳粹党成员。

src: Storyline: My personal and sincere condolences for the loss of your Kapitan. Your father, was as you know my best friend and I feel remorse because I ordered him to undertake this mission.
dst: 剧情：对于你舰长的牺牲，我个人致以诚挚的哀悼。你的父亲，如你所知，是我最好的朋友，我为自己下令让他执行这项任务而感到自责。

src: Storyline: My son, a trusted sailor of mine will give you a folder to read when you are alone. Even now as we speak they are watching us.
dst: 故事线：我的孩子，我的一名亲信水兵会在你独处时给你一份文件夹阅读。即便此刻我们说话之时，他们也在监视我们。

src: Storyline: Your mother developed complications last night and was rushed to the hospital. I hope everything goes well.
dst: 剧情：你母亲昨夜出现并发症，被紧急送往医院。希望一切顺利。

src: Storyline: Your sister has been in the Gestapo offices for hours, there is no charge against her yet. Don't worry about your mother, I've sent a nurse to look after her. I know it's hard, but you have to stay focused on your task.
dst: 故事线：你的妹妹已在盖世太保的办公室里待了好几个小时，目前还没有对她提出任何指控。别担心你的母亲，我已派了一名护士去照顾她。我知道这很难，但你必须专注于你的任务。

src: Strachwitz offensive penetrated into the enemy territory and torn the Soviet lines apart. Panthers proved themselves worthy even in a boggy and woody terraine. The front was stabilized for the moment.
dst: 施特拉赫维茨的攻势突入敌境，撕开了苏军战线。即便在泥泞多林的地形里，黑豹也证明了自己不负所望。战线暂时稳定下来。

src: Strachwitz offensive penetrated into the enemy territory and torn the Soviet lines apart. Panthers proved themselves worthy even in a boggy and woody terraine. The front was stabilized for the moment. It's unfortunate that your own result was so weak...

src: Strange country, Mexico, isn't it? Since they ousted president Díaz in 1911 and the revolution started, many different factions have appeared. All of them want to rule the country, and everybody is fighting against everybody else. It's really difficult to differentiate between friends and enemies.
dst: 墨西哥真是个奇怪的国度，不是吗？自从1911年他们推翻迪亚斯总统、革命爆发以来，涌现出了许多不同的派系。他们都想统治这个国家，人人都跟别人打得不可开交。要想分清敌友，实在太难了。

src: Strategically, Stavka's plans for war in the north require a swift strike toward Koenigsberg in the first weeks of the war with the 1st and 2nd Armies.  With the army fully mobilized, it will deploy in Poland for a decisive strike against Germany.
dst: 从战略上讲，大本营在北方的作战计划要求在开战头几周，以第1、第2集团军向柯尼斯堡发动快速突击。待部队完全动员后，它将部署在波兰，对德国发动决定性打击。

src: Striving for a united, free, democratic Germany is becoming stronger and stronger and finally ends in a revolution in the southwest of the empire.
dst: 为一个统一、自由、民主的德意志而奋斗的呼声日益高涨，最终在帝国西南部爆发为一场革命。

src: Su incompetencia ha resultado funesta para la causa nacional!   The quarters at Gijon have fallen along with the whole city of Oviedo.   I have received reports that the execution of Colonel Aranda will be tomorrow.  Yours may soon follow.
dst: 您的无能给民族事业带来了灾难性后果！希洪的营地已经陷落，奥维耶多全城也随之失守。我收到报告说，阿兰达上校将于明天被处决。您的死期或许也不远了。

src: Su incompetencia ha resultado funesta para la causa nacional!  Bilbao is a new Madrid and it is rumored that the French are planning to re-open the frontier and send supplies to the Republicans.
dst: 您的无能给民族事业带来了灾难性后果！毕尔巴鄂成了新的马德里，而且有传言说法国人正打算重新开放边境，向共和派运送补给。

src: Su mision es clara, detenga el ataque republicano y reestablezca las lineas de frente. Para ello contara con generosos refuerzos aereos de la Legion Condor y el CTV. Tenga cuidado, parece ser que esa ''11 Division'' enemiga que se ha acercado a Brunete es bastante fuerte.
dst: 您的任务很明确：阻止共和军的进攻，恢复前线。为此，您将得到秃鹰军团和意大利志愿军团的大批空中增援。小心，逼近布鲁内特的那支敌军「第11师」似乎相当强悍。

src: Su mision es derrotar esta ofensiva lo antes posible, para que podamos continuar rapidamente la marcha hacia Barcelona.
dst: 您的任务是尽快击败这次攻势，以便我们能够迅速继续向巴塞罗那进军。

src: Su mision es evitar que los republicanos establezcan mas cabezas de puente y evitar que Belchite caiga completamente en manos enemigas. Inteligencia apunta a que de nuevo la ofensiva la esta llevando a cabo el V cuerpo republicano, al mando del general Modesto.
dst: 您的任务是阻止共和军建立更多桥头堡，并防止贝尔奇特完全落入敌手。情报显示，这次进攻仍由共和军第5军实施，由莫德斯托将军指挥。

src: Su mision es hacer una retirada ordenada hacia la otra orilla del rio Ebro, tratando de tener el menor numero posible de bajas.
dst: 您的任务是向埃布罗河对岸有序撤退，尽量把伤亡降到最低。

src: Su mision es romper el cerco de Oviedo, limpiar las zonas mineras del Sur, (foco de mas radical resistencia), y capturar Gijon, la ultima capital de la Republica en el Norte. El destructor Cervera y algunos bous armados, asi como la Legion Condor y el CTV le prestaran servicios de apoyo para acabar lo mas rapidamente posible con la resistencia asturiana.
dst: 您的任务是打破奥维耶多的包围，肃清南部的矿区（那里是最顽固抵抗的策源地），并夺取希洪——共和国在北方的最后一座首府。塞韦拉号驱逐舰和一些武装拖网渔船，以及秃鹰军团和意大利志愿军团，都将为您提供支援，以便尽可能迅速地终结阿斯图里亚斯的抵抗。

src: Su mision es terminar con la resistencia enemiga en Vizcaya y capturar la ciudad clave de Bilbao. De nuevo nuestros valientes quintacolumnistas apareceran de sus escondrijos tan pronto como se acerque a Bilbao.
dst: 您的任务是肃清比斯开境内的敌军抵抗，并夺取关键城市毕尔巴鄂。当我们靠近毕尔巴鄂时，我们英勇的第五纵队成员将再次从藏身处现身。

src: Su mision se localizara al Norte del dispositivo, justo al Sur de Lerida, cruce el rio y alcance la localidad de Fraga, donde segun informes de agentes infiltrados se encuentra la comandancia de las tropas enemigas en este sector.
dst: 您的任务区域位于我军部署的北部，就在莱里达以南，渡过该河，抵达弗拉加镇，据渗透特工的报告，敌军在此地区的指挥部就设在那里。

src: Su principal cometido será avanzar con sus tropas hacia el centro de Asturias para socorrer a nuestros hombres en Gijón y Oviedo, cuanto antes mejor.
dst: 您的主要任务是率部向阿斯图里亚斯中部推进，以驰援我们在希洪和奥维耶多的人员，越快越好。
第46潜艇支队/第4中队/潜艇舰队

src: Succeeding in capturing Przasnysz, the Germans were stopped with severe casualties from advancing further.  Litvinov, forced by a directive from his superior at the North-Western Front (Ruszky), redeployed the I Siberian Corps (Pleshkov) to attack Przasnysz from the south and turned the I Turkestan Corps toward the north.  Ruszky dispatched the II Siberian Corps (Sychevsky) from 12th Army to advance on Przasnysz from the east.  The three corps converged on their objective, defeating the German troops.  The German retreat, however, was not exploited by the Russians:  failing to deploy his cavalry forward, Litvinov missed the opportunity.  In addition, Ruszky failed to subordinate the I Siberian Corps to Litvinov, preventing the two Siberian corps from effective co-ordination.
dst: 在成功夺取普扎斯内什后，德国人因伤亡惨重而无力继续推进。利特维诺夫在其西北方面军上级（鲁斯基）的指令下，将第1西伯利亚军（普列什科夫）调往从南面进攻普扎斯内什，并令第1突厥斯坦军转向北面。鲁斯基从第12集团军派出第2西伯利亚军（瑟切夫斯基）从东面向普扎斯内什推进。三个军会攻其目标，击败了德军。然而，俄军并未利用德军的撤退：由于未能把骑兵派到前方，利特维诺夫错失了良机。此外，鲁斯基未能让第1西伯利亚军隶属于利特维诺夫指挥，致使两个西伯利亚军无法有效协同。

src: Superb  performance, Herr Feldmarschall! Our troops are safely ashore in England.  You have helped accomplish what Napoleon could not - the invasion of England! Your reputation in war is unparalleled.
dst: 出色的表现，陆军元帅阁下！我们的部队已在英格兰安全登陆。你帮助完成了拿破仑都没能做到的事——入侵英格兰！你在战争中的声名无人能及。

src: Superb  performance, Herr General! The Bolsheviks have fled to Siberia and sued for peace. You have helped accomplish what Napoleon could not -  the conquest of Russia!  Our panzers rumble through Red Square, and our troops sleep in the Kremlin!  Your reputation in war is unparalleled.
dst: 表现得极为出色，将军阁下！布尔什维克已逃往西伯利亚并求和。你助我们完成了拿破仑未能做到的事——征服俄国！我们的装甲部队隆隆驶过红场，我们的士兵睡在克里姆林宫！你在战争中的声望无与伦比。

src: Superb  performance, Herr General! The Bolsheviks have fled to Siberia and sued for peace. You have helped accomplish what Napoleon could not -  the conquest of Russia!  Our panzers rumble through Red Square, and our troops sleep in the Kremlin!  Your reputation in war is unparalleled.  But now we need you on the Western Front, where we must defend Fortress Europe against an Allied invasion.

src: Superb work Herr General! Your rapid invasion threw back the natives and the British were no help to them. The Italians are relieved and will continue to support us.
dst: 干得漂亮，将军阁下！你的迅速入侵击退了土著，英国人也帮不上他们的忙。意大利人如释重负，将继续支持我们。

src: Superb work Herr General. The Duderhoff Hills have been taken! The old Tzars parading ground is in our hands. Leningrad is next!
dst: 干得出色，将军阁下。杜德尔霍夫高地已被拿下！旧时沙皇的阅兵场已在我们手中。下一个就是列宁格勒！

src: Superb work, Herr General!  Thanks to your rapid advance across the Meuse, the Allies are in complete disarray.  You have demonstrated the superiority of our tactics over what was once called the world's best army.  We must now push rapidly to the shores of the English Channel and complete the defeat of our enemies.
dst: 干得漂亮，将军阁下！多亏你迅速渡过默兹河，盟军已彻底陷入混乱。你证明了我们的战术优于那支曾号称世界最强的军队。我们现在必须迅速推进到英吉利海峡岸边，完成对敌人的击败。

src: Superb work, Herr General! Thanks to your rapid advance across the Aisne and Marne rivers, the French are in complete disarray. You have demonstrated the superiority of our tactics over what was once called the world's best army. We must now push rapidly to the shores of the English Channel and complete the defeat of our enemies.
dst: 干得极为出色，将军阁下！多亏你迅速渡过埃纳河与马恩河，法国人已陷入彻底混乱。你证明了我们的战术胜过那支曾被称为世界最强的军队。我们现在必须迅速推进至英吉利海峡沿岸，彻底击败我们的敌人。

src: Superb! The Soviet armies were defeated in a 10-day Kesselschlacht and the last major stumbling block between us and the Soviet capital has been removed.

src: Superb! The Soviet armies were defeated in a 10-day Kesselschlacht, and the last major stumbling block between us and control of the Ukraine has been removed.
dst: 精彩！苏军在为期10天的合围战中被击溃，我们与控制乌克兰之间的最后一道重大障碍已被清除。

src: Superb! The Soviet armies were defeated in a 10-day Kesselschlacht, and the last major stumbling block between us and control of the Ukraine has been removed.  However your forces are needed further north as we are apporaching the gates of Moscow.
dst: 精彩！苏军在为期10天的合围战中被击溃，我们与控制乌克兰之间的最后一道重大障碍已被清除。但你的部队需要调往更北面，因为我们正逼近莫斯科的门户。

src: Superb, sir.  Our crossing of the Rhine has been successful, and now all that stands in our way to Berlin is a few Hitler Youth and old men.
dst: 太棒了，长官。我们渡过莱茵河已告成功，如今挡在我们通往柏林之路上的，只剩几个希特勒青年团员和一些老头子了。

src: Superbly done, sir.  We've finally taken the city of Caen, our major objective since we landed here in Normandy.  Montgomery is delighted, and is taking all of the credit of course.  He said we'd take the city on day one, but now claims having us get bogged down was all part of his subtle plan.  I don't think he'd recognize a subtle plan if it painted itself purple and danced naked on a harpsichord singing 'subtle plans are here again' quite frankly.
dst: 干得绝妙，长官。我们终于攻下了卡昂城——自我们在诺曼底登陆以来的首要目标。蒙哥马利欣喜若狂，当然把功劳全揽了去。他曾说我们第一天就能拿下此城，如今却宣称让我们陷入胶着全是他那精妙计划的一部分。说实在的，就算一个精妙计划把自己涂成紫色、裸着身子在羽管键琴上跳舞、唱着“精妙计划又来了”，我看他也未必认得出来。

src: Superbly done, sir.  You've pushed the Hun over to the other side of the Mass river and given vital flank protection to our Canadian brethren.  Montgomery has granted your unit some much needed rest as a show of appreciation.  Your men will have the chance to enjoy Christmas away from the front!
dst: 干得绝妙，长官。你已把德国佬赶到了马斯河对岸，为我们加拿大兄弟提供了至关重要的侧翼掩护。蒙哥马利已准你的部队急需的休整，以表嘉许。你的部下将有机会在远离前线的地方过圣诞节！

src: Tactical Victory: Galicia.  Preserving our Slavic bond with Serbia, our armies will defend the frontier against an Austro-Hungarian aggression on the South-Western Front.  With success, the way may be open to capture the Carpathian mountain passes into Vienna or, perhaps, for an invasion of German Silesia.
dst: 小捷：加利西亚。为维系我们与塞尔维亚的斯拉夫纽带，我军将在西南战线抵御奥匈帝国的侵略。若成功，通往喀尔巴阡山隘口直捣维也纳的道路或将洞开，甚至可能入侵德属西里西亚。

src: Tactical Victory: Tactical Victory in this scenario will transfer your troops to the Caucasus Front to join operations against Turkey.
dst: 小捷：本场景达成小捷后，您的部队将被调往高加索方面军，参与对土耳其的作战。

src: Tactically speaking, the Somme was another failure. Our advances were minimal, with hundreds of thousands casualties. But strategically, it was a great success. France was saved, and Germany was so weakened that, just a few months after the battle ended, its Army had to retire 40 miles, to the safety of the Hindenburg Line. I know that many orphans, widows and parents who lost their sons at the Somme will never find consolation in strategy, but for me it is important to acknowledge that, although we all paid a terrible price, our brave soldiers gave their lives for a reason and that their sacrifice was an unavoidable step towards our final victory.
dst: 从战术上说，索姆河战役是又一次失败。我们推进甚微，却付出了数十万人的伤亡。但从战略上说，它却是一次巨大的成功。法国得救了，德国被大大削弱，以至于战役结束仅几个月后，德军就不得不后撤40英里，退到兴登堡防线的安全地带。我知道许多在索姆河失去儿子的孤儿、寡妇和父母永远不会从战略中得到安慰，但对我而言，重要的是承认：尽管我们都付出了可怕的代价，我们英勇的士兵是为一个理由而献出生命，他们的牺牲是通向最终胜利的必经一步。

src: Tactically, this task is challenging.  Intelligence reports that the full 46th Soviet regiment has taken positions somewhere between Rakvere and the Baltic Sea.  In addition, their 1st cavalry regiment has stopped in the area en route to the front line.  Also, remnants of battered regiments are filtering through our lines to rejoin their comrades.  Beware of their sudden appearance on your flanks!
dst: 从战术上讲，这个任务极具挑战性。情报显示，苏俄第46团全军已在拉克韦雷与波罗的海之间某处占据阵地。此外，他们的第1骑兵团在赶往前线的途中停在了该地区。同时，被打残的各团残部正穿过我们的防线去与战友会合。当心他们突然出现在您的侧翼！

src: Take Kishinev (Chisinau) the capital of Bassarabia.

src: Take command of Ariete and Trieste in the upcoming attack on Tobruk. The Germans will throw the non-motorized elements of the 90Le and whatever is left of the 15th and 21Pz Division against the perimeter.
dst: 在即将到来的托布鲁克进攻中接管“公羊”师和“的里雅斯特”师。德国人将把第90轻装师的非摩托化部队和第15、第21装甲师残部投入对外围防线的进攻。

src: Take command of Gruppe Arras, attacking from the North-West. Gruppe Caudry will attack in the center and - the largely off-map - Gruppe Busigny from the South-West.
dst: 指挥阿拉斯集群，从西北方向发起进攻。科德里集群将在中路进攻，而——大部分位于地图外的——比西尼集群则从西南方向进攻。

src: Take command of the Ariete Division that - with the Gruppo Sirte - is all that stands between Campo Tripoli with its 4 weak infantry divisions and O'Connor's forces.
dst: 接管“公羊”师——它与苏尔特集群一起，是挡在拥有4个弱旅步兵师的黎波里营地与奥康纳部队之间仅有的兵力。

src: Take my binoculars... did you see them?, yes... it's the bolshevik naval base of Vladivostok. We didn't expect those naval forces of the Pacific Soviet fleet, it's seem they have escaped from their defeat at the battle in the Kuril Islands... Our infiltrated anti-bolshevik agents have reported us the soviets still have some important units in the encirclement of the besieged city, with orders from Moscow to resist until the last man. The NKVD police units will try to force that slogan on the population of Vladivostok, from which they have recruited two divisions.
dst: 拿上我的望远镜……您看到他们了吗？是的……那就是布尔什维克的符拉迪沃斯托克海军基地。我们没料到太平洋苏联舰队的那些海军力量，他们似乎是在千岛群岛战役中战败后逃出来的……我们渗透进去的反布尔什维克特工向我们报告，苏军在这座被围困之城的包围圈里仍保留着一些重要部队，他们奉莫斯科之命抵抗到最后一人。NKVD 警察部队将试图把这一口号强加给符拉迪沃斯托克民众，而他们已经从这些民众中征召了两个师。

src: Take our moon back, Commander!  I can't stand the thought of the Krauts being up there a moment longer.
dst: 夺回我们的月球，指挥官！我一刻也无法忍受那些德国佬还待在上面。

src: Take over the control of Teutobod and the Teutons or Boiorix and the Cimbris and become master of central Europe.
dst: 掌控条顿博德与条顿人，或博伊奥里克斯与辛布里人，成为中欧的主人。

src: Take part in the People's Revolution in China from the early days of uprisings against the warlords and nationalist troops, up to the Korea War.  If you get too popular... Mao probably would have never put the PLA armies under your command.
dst: 从反抗军阀和国民党军队的起义早期，直到朝鲜战争，参与中国革命。如果您变得太受欢迎……毛大概绝不会把人民解放军置于您的指挥之下。
夺取奥斯坦德的胜利点。

src: Take the city of Antwerp and advance South West. There is no time for sightseeing, this is Blitzkrieg warfare! Opposite you are the remnants of the Belgian Army and the retreating French 7th Army that was rushing into The Netherlands only a few days ago. The Belgian King has ordered 2 infantry divisions to prevent you from crossing the Schelde river. Rumor is that a cavalry division is reorganizing behind the front. The bulk of the French forces comes from the 9th Mechanized Division.
dst: 夺取安特卫普城，向西南推进。没时间观光了，这是闪电战！你面对的是比军残部和几天前还急冲入荷兰、如今正在撤退的法国第7集团军。比利时国王已下令两个步兵师阻止你渡过斯海尔德河。据传有一个骑兵师正在战线后方重整。法军主力来自第9机械化师。

src: Take the upcoming mission as a chance how to take a rest from the grandiose scenarios so far...
dst: 把接下来的任务当作一个机会，好从迄今那些宏大场景中喘口气……

src: Take you surviving troops further West to Bardia to strengthen the city parameter defences against an attack that will certainly come.
dst: 带你幸存的部队继续西去巴迪亚，加强该城周边防御，以迎击必定会到来的进攻。

src: Take your men and infiltrate the british coast, locate Churchill and take him prisoner. There are several british and polish infantry units around but they are unexperienced and wont be a threat to us. Mr. Devlin, a irish anarchist, will give us some help. He knows the area and will give us useful information. Leave now commander, time is limited!
dst: 带上你的人潜入英国海岸，找到丘吉尔并把他俘虏。周围有几个英国和波兰步兵单位，但他们缺乏经验，不会对我们构成威胁。爱尔兰无政府主义者德夫林先生会给我们一些帮助。他熟悉这一带，会给我们提供有用的情报。现在就出发吧，指挥官，时间有限！

src: Taking Kimberley is important for us strategically speaking, but its symbolic importance is even greater. This is the place where Rhodes, one of the worst enemies of our country, founded De Beers with the help of the Rothschilds. Capturing Rhodes and the mines would be an immense humiliation for the imperialists and their policies.
dst: 从战略上讲，攻占金伯利对我们很重要，但它的象征意义更为重大。这里是罗兹——我们国家最凶恶的敌人之一——在罗斯柴尔德家族的帮助下创办戴比尔斯的地方。俘获罗兹并夺取这些矿山，将是对帝国主义者及其政策的巨大羞辱。

dst: 考虑到本场景及后续场景艰难的沙漠地形，强烈建议您大量依赖骑乘单位（骑兵、马拉炮兵和骑马步兵）。

src: Tensions arose between the Vatican and the Allies after the bombing and destroction of the Abbazia di Montecassino. Only after the destruction of the Abbey, German Paratroopers began to use the abbey as a strongpoint and observation post. Following the war, the abbey was rebuild in the 1950s.

src: Teutobod - Leader of the Teutons - lead your people to the south and do us honor!
dst: 条顿博德——条顿人的首领——率领你的人民南下，为我们争光！

src: Teutobod, leader of the Teutons, chanced the camp of Gaius Marius - can he manage to annihilate the Romans,
dst: 条顿博德，条顿人的首领，撞上了盖乌斯马略的营地——他能歼灭罗马人吗，

src: Teutobod, now you got to know the Romans - make them feel fearful from now on!
dst: 条顿博德，如今你已认识了罗马人——从今往后就让他们心生畏惧！

src: Teutobod, your way has led you to Gaul where the Romans still rule.
dst: 条顿博德，你的路把你带到了高卢，罗马人仍在此地统治。

src: Teutons – residents of Jutland – heeded traders' reports concerning the fertile fields and pastures of the south, and moved there.
dst: 条顿人——日德兰的居民——听信了商人关于南方肥沃田地和牧场的说法，迁往那里。

src: Thank God that the French sent fresh divisions pretty quickly, because things were getting nearly nasty. Anyway, now the front is safe again, and that's what counts.
dst: 谢天谢地，法军很快就派来了生力师，因为局势已经变得十分凶险。不管怎样，现在战线又安全了，这才是最要紧的。

src: Thank God, our British and French allies accomplished what you could not: a complete breakthroug in the German lines. Despite your failure, we'll be able to go on with our offensive. We don't have time to choose a new commander, so we'll give you a second chance. You'll deliver the final blow to our enemies. Please don't disappoint us again.
dst: 谢天谢地，我们的英法盟友完成了您没能做到的事：在德军防线上实现了全面突破。尽管您失败了，我们的攻势仍能继续。我们没有时间另选指挥官，所以再给您一次机会。您将给敌人以致命一击。请不要再让我们失望了。

src: Thank You to Jorge Gabitto for allowing me to convert and openize his Stalingrad campaign in order to bring it up to modern standards...
dst: 感谢 Jorge Gabitto 允许我转换并 openize 他的斯大林格勒战役，使其达到现代标准……

src: Thank god you managed to restore the situation and kept up the morale.

dst: 谢谢你——我的儿子就在被解救的战俘之中！

dst: 谢谢你——我的儿子就在那些战俘中。虽然他的样子很糟，但他还活着。
