src: Thank you, General, you have saved us from a potential disaster. We'll make a strategic retreat to avoid being encircled, but that's not important. We've already got what we needed: the Russian offensive has lost momentum. When our reinforcements arrive, we'll be able to stop our enemies, and we'll recover our initial positions. The Russian offensive won't succeed.
dst: 谢谢您，将军，您把我们从一场潜在的灾难中拯救了出来。我们将进行战略撤退以避免被包围，但这并不重要。我们已得到了所需的东西：俄国的攻势已失去势头。等我们的援军抵达，就能挡住敌人，并收复最初的阵地。俄国的攻势不会得逞。

src: Thank you, General. Without all your efforts, our country would still be in danger. Now we have hope for a brighter future. The old Empire may be lost, but Turkey will survive and thrive. Our people will remember you forever.
dst: 谢谢您，将军。没有您的全部努力，我们的国家仍将处于危险之中。现在我们对更光明的未来有了希望。旧帝国或许已经失去，但土耳其将生存并繁荣下去。我们的人民将永远铭记您。

src: Thankfully I'm not one to cudgel my head, but I don't envy your situation. Moreover, because there's not much time for complete rearmament... Up the stairs, please. Go ahead, I'll come up after you.
dst: 幸好我不是那种爱钻牛角尖的人，但我也不羡慕你的处境。何况，也没有多少时间进行彻底的重新装备……上楼吧，请。你先走，我随后上来。

src: Thankfully we have re-established our defenses on the Don, but 4th Panzer Army could not break through and Hitler refused 6th Army to withdrawl!  4th Panzer Army is withdrawling back across the Chir and Manstein has called a General Cousel to discuss Strategy.
dst: 所幸我们已在顿河重建防御，但第4装甲集团军无法突破，希特勒又拒绝第6集团军撤退！第4装甲集团军正撤回奇尔河对岸，曼施泰因已召开军事会议讨论战略。

src: Thanks a lot for Translations to Uli :-)
dst: 特别感谢 Uli 提供的译文 :-)

src: Thanks for playing Defending the Reich playtest! Any feedback or comments, (good or bad), can be directed to Sdkfz173@gmail.com.
dst: 感谢试玩《保卫帝国》测试版！任何反馈或意见（无论褒贬）都可以发往 Sdkfz173@gmail.com。

src: Thanks for playing the 1939 campaign for Open Panzer General
dst: 感谢游玩 Open Panzer General 的 1939年战役

src: Thanks in large part to your past success in Africa, you now have an opportunity to deal the Russians a critical blow. You must complete the upcoming campaign by November 26th at the latest. The fate of the war in the east is in your hands.
dst: 很大程度上由于你此前在非洲的战绩，你现在有机会给苏军一次决定性打击。你最迟必须在 11月26日前完成即将展开的战役。东线战争的命运掌握在你手中。

src: Thanks to Maarten for letting me convert his campaign..
dst: 感谢 Maarten 允许我转换他的战役。

src: Thanks to Wonderdoctor for allowing me to use his scenario intro texts.
dst: 感谢 Wonderdoctor 允许我使用他的场景简介文本。

src: Thanks to hoza for playing and testing the campaign.
dst: 感谢 hoza 试玩并测试本战役。

src: Thanks to the use of glider infantry and elite-pioneer troops Germans succeeded in taking not only two bridges over the Canal Albert (Vroenhoven and Veldwezelt, which were not destroyed on time) but also destroying the strong fortress of Eben-Emael. The capture of Eben-Emael was extremely important as it dominated the whole region and protected all the bridges in this region.
dst: 借助滑翔机步兵和精锐工兵部队，德军不仅成功夺取了阿尔贝运河上的两座桥梁（弗鲁恩霍芬和费尔德韦泽尔特，这两座桥未能及时炸毁），还摧毁了坚固的埃本-埃马尔要塞。夺取埃本-埃马尔极为重要，因为它俯瞰整个地区，并保护该地区所有桥梁。

src: Thanks to victories in the Mediterranean Sea, the Western Desert, the Italian failure in Greece, and supply problems, the Italians have ceased their offensive operations.  They have now adopted a more defensive posture.  This gives us a golden opportunity to go on the attack here in East Africa.  Three forces will simultaneously strike into Ethiopia:  A northern front led by Lt. Gen. Platt which will advance from the Sudan through Eritrea, and down into Ethiopia.  A southern front led by Lt. Gen. Cunningham which will move north from Kenya, up into Italian Somaliland and then into Ethiopia.  In addition, a third group will make an amphibious assault in British Somaliland to retake the colony.  All groups are to meet in the Ethiopian capital, Addis Ababa.
dst: 得益于地中海的胜利、西部沙漠的战果、意大利在希腊的失败以及补给问题，意大利人已停止攻势作战，转而采取更加防守的态势。这给了我们在东非转入进攻的黄金机会。三路部队将同时攻入埃塞俄比亚：普拉特中将率领的北路将从苏丹经厄立特里亚南下，进入埃塞俄比亚；坎宁安中将率领的南路将从肯尼亚北上，经意属索马里兰进入埃塞俄比亚；此外，第三支部队将在英属索马里兰发起两栖突击，收复该殖民地。所有部队都将在埃塞俄比亚首都亚的斯亚贝巴会师。

src: Thanks to your advance across the Meuse, the Allies are in complete disarray.  You have demonstrated the superiority of our tactics over what was once called the world's best army.  We must now push rapidly to the shores of the English Channel and complete the defeat of our enemies.
dst: 多亏你渡过默兹河的推进，盟军已彻底陷入混乱。你证明了我们的战术优于那支曾号称世界最强的军队。我们现在必须迅速推进到英吉利海峡岸边，完成对敌人的击败。

src: Thanks to your brilliant attack Santolán pumping station is back in our hands and access to safe drinking water is guaranteed. This will help to prolong our resistance in Manila while waiting for the relief expedition.
dst: 多亏您出色的进攻，桑托兰泵站重新回到我们手中，安全饮用水供应得以保障。这将有助于延长我们在马尼拉的抵抗，等待援军到来。

src: Thanks to your brilliant command you have managed to evacuate the germ of a new Belgian army. The fight can now continue in France, in Congo or wherever is needed to restore the independence and freedom of Belgium.
dst: 由于你出色的指挥，你成功撤出了新比利时军队的种子。战斗如今可以在法国、在刚果，或任何需要的地方继续，以恢复比利时的独立与自由。

src: Thanks to your diversion attack and your aid to the German 5th Light Division, the 5th Pz.Rgt. and 8th Mg.Btn. were saved.
dst: 多亏你的佯攻和对德国第5轻装师的援助，第5装甲团和第8机枪营获救了。

src: Thanks to your feeble efforts, the war in North Africa will continue to drag on.  You will return immediately to Germany to face a court martial. Your replacement here will be Herr General Rommel.  You are dismissed.
dst: 由于你软弱无力的表现，北非的战事将继续拖延下去。你须立即返回德国接受军事法庭审判。你在此处的继任者是隆美尔将军阁下。你可以退下了。

src: Thanks to your good work, our base at Linjiang is now safe.  In addition, we are now in a good position to attack Changchun, Jilin and Siping during the next summer offensive.  We will wait for good weather to arrive in Manchuria.
dst: 多亏你出色的工作，我们的临江基地现在安全了。此外，我们现在处于有利地位，可以在下一次夏季攻势中进攻长春、吉林和四平。我们将等待满洲好天气的到来。

src: Thanks to your great performance in the 1938 manouvres, you have been assigned to command the "1ère Divison de Cavalerie" of our army. As you know, this an elite motorized division of the regular army that thanks to its greater mobility can help other units where needed, notably performing reconnaissance and providing protection. We are confident you will honour your tasks.
dst: 由于你在1938年演习中的出色表现，你被任命为我军第1骑兵师（“1ère Divison de Cavalerie”）的指挥官。如你所知，这是正规军中的一支精锐摩托化师，凭借其更强的机动能力可以在需要之处支援其他部队，尤其是执行侦察和提供掩护。我们相信你能够胜任这些任务。

src: Thanks to your great successes, we now have the possibility of surrounding the rookie armies going towards the Tunisian coast, more exactly, the city of Bone.
dst: 多亏你取得的巨大胜利，我们现在有机会合围正在向突尼斯海岸推进的新手部队，更确切地说，是博讷城。

src: Thanks to your heroic resistance we were able to reach Kalach. We have started a huge evacuation of Stalingrad and initiated the retreat of the Caucasus army.
dst: 多亏您的英勇抵抗，我们才得以抵达卡拉奇。我们已开始大规模撤离斯大林格勒，并着手让高加索集团军后撤。

src: Thanks to your rapid drive through Holland we are excellently positioned to take Belgium by coup de main as well. Even though the Belgian army is mobilised, you should be able to break through and make a thrust along the coast towards Ostend and France. Just like in the last war, we're aiming for the Channel ports!
dst: 多亏你迅速穿过荷兰，我们现在位置极佳，可同样以奇袭夺取比利时。尽管比利时军队已动员，你应该能够突破，并沿海岸向奥斯坦德和法国方向突击。一如上次大战，我们的目标是海峡各港口！

src: Thanks to your strong attack Santolán pumping station is back in our hands and access to safe drinking water is guaranteed. This will help to prolong our resistance in Manila while waiting for the relief expedition.
dst: 多亏您猛烈的进攻，桑托兰泵站重新回到我们手中，安全饮用水供应得以保障。这将有助于延长我们在马尼拉的抵抗，等待援军到来。

src: Thanks to your superb last success, we have the posibility of enclosing the rookie armies reaching to the Tunisian coast, particularly the city of Bone.
dst: 多亏您上一次的出色胜利，我们有机会围歼正在抵达突尼斯海岸的新兵部队，特别是博讷城。

src: Thanks to your tenacious attack Santolán pumping station is back in our hands and access to safe drinking water is guaranteed. This will help to prolong our resistance in Manila while waiting for the relief expedition.
dst: 多亏您顽强的进攻，桑托兰泵站重新回到我们手中，安全饮用水供应得以保障。这将有助于延长我们在马尼拉的抵抗，等待援军到来。

src: Thanks to your victory, the way to Vladivostok is open.  Our German allies are now very happy; these operations against the Bolsheviks have stopped the red offensive against the German positions in Eastern Europe.
dst: 多亏您的胜利，通往符拉迪沃斯托克的道路已经打通。我们的德国盟友现在非常高兴；这些针对布尔什维克的行动，已经阻止了红军在东欧对德军阵地的攻势。

src: Thanx for playing Stalingrad playtest! Any comments, suggestions, or feedback can be directed to me, MG43: Sdkfz173@gmail.com
dst: 感谢试玩《斯大林格勒》测试版！任何意见、建议或反馈都可以发给我，MG43：Sdkfz173@gmail.com

src: Thanx for playing! Hope you enjoyed Black Angels: The 5th SS Wiking playtest. Any feedback, comments, etc., can be directed to Sdkfz173@gmail.com...
dst: 感谢游玩！希望你喜欢《黑色天使：党卫军第5维京师》试玩版。任何反馈、意见等可发送至 Sdkfz173@gmail.com……

src: That changed some months ago, when I discovered the horrifying nonsense that my great-grandson Luke is being taught at school. I can not hide from the world, after all. If I do not tell Luke how I lived, he will have to learn the lies of others. So I started these memoirs as a last act of service that could help the young British understand their past. That way they will be able to avoid our mistakes, while feeling pride for our good decisions. I am tired, and I will not walk on this Earth for much longer but, with God's help, I hope that I have accomplished my last mission.
dst: 几个月前，这一切改变了。当时我发现，我的曾孙卢克在学校里正被灌输些骇人听闻的胡言乱语。我终究无法再躲避这个世界。如果我不告诉卢克我曾怎样生活，他就只能去学别人的谎言。于是我动笔写这部回忆录，作为最后一次服务，帮助英国的年轻人了解他们的过去。这样他们就能避免重蹈我们的覆辙，同时为我们的正确决定感到自豪。我累了，在这个世界上也活不了多久了，但靠着上帝的帮助，我希望自己已经完成了最后的使命。

src: That country joined the side of the Entente on August 14, 1916. The Romanian Army isn't very big, and its equipment and training is outdated, but that additional help was all that the Russians need to alter the course of the war.
dst: 那个国家于1916年8月14日加入了协约国一方。罗马尼亚军队规模不大，装备和训练也已过时，但这份额外的帮助正是俄国人所需要的，足以改变战争进程。

src: That didn't work out as planned...

That dinastic issue became a great problem when Christian VIII of Denmark died in 1848. His heir, Frederik VII, was childless, so after him the House of Oldenburg bould become extinct. According to the Danish laws, the crown would pass to Christian, a descendant of one of the daughters of Frederik V of Denmark, and also a member of the House of Glücksburg. Coming from a female family line, this was unacceptable for the Germans in Schleswig, Holstein and Lauenburg.
dst: 1848年丹麦国王克里斯蒂安八世去世后，这一王朝继承问题演变成了大麻烦。他的继承人弗雷德里克七世没有子嗣，因此在他之后奥尔登堡家族将绝嗣。根据丹麦法律，王位将传给克里斯蒂安——他是丹麦国王弗雷德里克五世某位女儿的后裔，同时也是格吕克斯堡家族的成员。由于来自女性家族支系，这对石勒苏益格、荷尔斯泰因和劳恩堡的德意志人来说是不可接受的。

src: That doesn't mean that all of Russia's problems are over. First of all, we have to dedide what kind of country we'll live in. The most obvious option is the return of the monarchy, but most of the Royal Family was murdered by the Reds, so it might be difficult to find an optimal candidate. I think that Grand Duke Cyril is the legitimate heir, but in the past he has behaved as a person unworthy of the title of Tsar.
dst: 这并不意味着俄国所有的问题都已解决。首先，我们必须决定将生活在一个什么样的国家里。最显而易见的选择是恢复君主制，但皇室大部分成员都被红军杀害了，因此可能很难找到合适的人选。我认为西里尔大公是合法继承人，但他过去的所作所为配不上沙皇的称号。

src: That doesn't mean that taking Solun will be easy. The Entente has gathered all the remaining troops it has in the area, and they'll have some support from the Royal Navy. On the other hand, your units will be flanked by our 4th Army. I wish you luck, the destiny of our nation depends on you.
dst: 这并不意味着攻占萨洛尼卡会很容易。协约国已集结了它在该地区仅存的所有部队，而且他们还会得到皇家海军的支援。另一方面，您的部队将得到我第4集团军的侧翼掩护。祝您好运，国家的命运就系于您一身。

src: That doesn't mean that the Bolsheviks are harmless madmen. A most bloody battle is taking place near Stavropol. Twice did we take this town, only to lose it again shortly afterwards under the pressure of fierce enemy counterattacks. Our casualties are really heavy, including General Drozdovsky, who was badly injured and might not survive.
dst: 这并不意味着布尔什维克是无害的疯子。斯塔夫罗波尔附近正进行着一场极其血腥的战斗。我们两次攻占该城，却都在敌人凶猛反攻的压力下很快得而复失。我们的伤亡非常惨重，其中包括德罗兹多夫斯基将军，他伤势严重，可能撑不过去了。

src: That doesn't mean that we've been sitting on our hands at the Western front. We have made our defences stronger and deeper, knowing that France and Britain need  to regain the initiative and will attack very soon, before we can complete the deployment of our "Russian" divisions. They'll try to replicate the tactics devised at Cambrai, but at a much larger scale. The problem for them is that it's impossible to keep such a huge offenssive a secret, so this time they won't achieve surprise. We know that one of the places that has been chosen for a combined British-Portuguese assault is the sector that you're defending. After years of bombs and mines the once fertile fields have become a barren wasteland, one of the most horrible places on Earth. Soon you'll have to fight there. Be strong, General, you'll still have to fight many more battles before the war is over.
dst: 这并不意味着我们在西线一直无所事事。我们已把防御加固、加深，因为我们知道法国和英国需要夺回主动权，很快就会在我们完成「俄国」各师部署之前发动进攻。他们将试图复刻康布雷那一套战术，但规模要大得多。问题在于，如此庞大的攻势不可能保密，所以这一次他们将无法达成奇袭。我们知道，被选为英葡联军进攻地点之一的地段，正是您所防守的。经过多年炮击和地雷，曾经肥沃的田野已变成一片荒芜的焦土，成为地球上最可怕的地方之一。很快您就要在那里作战了。坚强些，将军，在战争结束前您还要打更多的仗。

src: That gives us a great opportunity to attack the Sueskanal. If we block British ships from crossing the kanal, keeping control over India will become an impossible task and the Empire  will be lost. Before that happens the British will finally sign a peace treaty. So,  Feldmarschall, your mission will be to assault the Sueskanal and take Port Said and Damietta.
dst: 这给了我们进攻苏伊士运河的绝佳机会。如果我们阻止英国船只通过运河，控制印度就将成为不可能完成的任务，帝国也将不保。在那发生之前，英国终将签订和约。所以，陆军元帅，您的任务就是强攻苏伊士运河，夺取塞得港和达米埃塔。

src: That has certainly been an impressive counterattack! You have contributed decisively to crush the enemy attacks even before the French could deploy any reinforcements. Very well!
dst: 那的确是一次令人印象深刻的反攻！您甚至在法国人来得及部署任何增援之前，就对粉碎敌军进攻做出了决定性贡献。非常好！

src: That last action convinced both Spain and France that it was imperative to crush Abd-el-Krim´s rebellion against the colonial powers. Both nations decided to make a coordinated assault on the Berber positions.
dst: 最后这一行动让西班牙和法国都深信，必须粉碎阿卜杜·克里姆对殖民列强的反抗。两国决定对柏柏尔人的阵地发动协同进攻。

src: That may seem a very small prize after all that we've been through. Germany will become the main military power in the world. Even small Bulgaria will have a hegemonic position in the Balkanen. And what about us? Unlike our allies, we'll get very little.
dst: 历经这一切之后，这似乎是个很小的奖赏。德国将成为世界头号军事强国。连小小的保加利亚也将在巴尔干占据霸权地位。而我们呢？与我们的盟友不同，我们得到的将少得可怜。

src: That means it's up to us to kickstart the revolution and take back America.
dst: 这意味着，得靠我们来点燃革命、夺回美国。

src: That meant that, one more time, Yohannes would have to fight with his most loyal troops, who belonged to the tribes that dwelt in Tigray, Gondar, Gojjam and Wolo. That could be enough to deal with the Sudanese, or maybe with the Italians, but not with both of them at the same time.
dst: 这意味着，约翰尼斯不得不再次依靠他最忠实的部队作战，这些部队来自提格雷、贡德尔、戈贾姆和沃洛的部落。这或许足以对付苏丹人，或者对付意大利人，但无法同时对付两者。

src: That moment came in 1896. The Egyptian Army was now well trained, equipped and commanded, capable of launching a successful offensive in Sudan, especially if they fought alongside some British units. So an Anglo-Egyptian Army was built, and General Kitchener was appointed as its Commander-in-Chief. He soon won some important battles in Northern Sudan, and his Army, slowly but firmly, went into the heart of the Dervish territory.
dst: 那个时机在1896年到来了。埃及军队如今训练有素、装备精良、指挥得当，有能力在苏丹发动一场成功的攻势，尤其是与一些英国部队并肩作战时。于是组建了一支英埃联军，并任命基钦纳将军为其总司令。他很快就在苏丹北部赢得了一些重要战役，他的军队缓慢而坚定地深入德尔维希领地的腹心。

src: That my first clash with a modern army at Landrecies and Grand Fayt was a failure, I still regret. The Germans routed us and we left the II Corp's right flank exposed, so they nearly got trapped by the enemy at Le Cateau. We could do nothing but follow our march  to the South: fortunately the enemy did not pursue us for a few days.
dst: 我在朗德勒西和格朗费与一支现代化军队的首次交锋以失败告终，我至今仍感遗憾。德军击溃了我们，我们使第二军的右翼暴露出来，以致他们险些在勒卡托被敌人围困。我们别无他法，只能继续向南行进：幸运的是，敌人有几天没有追击我们。

src: That terrible treatment of the captured enemies was a savage, but widespread tradition in Ethiopia. It was tolerated by Yohannes, and Alula actually encouraged it. As an European, I was horrified by this demonstration of barbarism. If they wished to be regarded as modern soldiers, and not as a bunch of killers, no better than vermin, the Ethiopians would have to improve their morals in addition to their bodies and minds. In the following years I tried to eradicate those despicable practices in the units that I commanded, although I must admit that I only had a partial success. The mistreatment of prisoners became gradually uncommon, but it never disappeared completely.
dst: 对被俘敌人的残酷处置在埃塞俄比亚是一种野蛮却普遍的传统。约翰尼斯容忍了这种做法，阿卢拉实际上还加以鼓励。作为一个欧洲人，这种野蛮行径的展示令我震惊。如果埃塞俄比亚人希望被视为现代军人，而不是一群与害虫无异的刽子手，他们就不仅要在体魄和心智上、还要在道德上有所提升。在随后的岁月里，我努力在我指挥的部队中根除这些可鄙的行径，尽管我必须承认只取得了部分成功。虐待俘虏的情况逐渐变得少见，但从未完全消失。

src: That traitor Wrangel still operates like a wolf from the Crimea.  He stabbed the people's army in the back while we were occupied with the war against Poland.  Now that those reactionaries have seen that the Revolution in Russia cannot be stopped, we can muster all resources to bring peace to Russia!  Russia ruled by its people!
dst: 那个叛徒弗兰格尔仍像一头狼一样从克里米亚出动。在我们忙于对波战争之际，他从背后捅了人民军队一刀。既然那些反动派已经看到，俄国革命无法被阻止，我们就能调动一切资源，为俄国带来和平！由人民统治的俄国！

src: That was a tough battle! We must assume the Russians will fight like this for every inch of their country!
dst: 那是场硬仗！我们必须料到俄国人会为祖国的每一寸土地如此拼杀！

src: That was a very close battle, and costly!
dst: 那是一场非常胶着的战斗，而且代价高昂！

src: That was an awful performance. But unfortunally we do not have the replacement for you. So, you will have another chance to show your skill.
dst: 那是一次糟糕的表现。但不幸的是，我们没有可以接替你的人。所以，你将再有一次机会展示你的才能。

src: That was close !!! Now we are supplied with weapons and some food. Come on into the inaccessible terrain of Mount Vesuvius ...
dst: 好险！！！现在我们有了武器补给和一些食物。开进维苏威山那难以接近的地形吧 ...

src: That was close - but the road to freedom lies ahead ...
dst: 好险——但通往自由之路就在前方 ...

src: That was close Herr General. For a time there we thought you would not make it. Did you manage to save any Italian troops?
dst: 好险啊，将军阁下。有一阵我们以为你撑不过去了。你可设法救下了意军部队？

src: That was how, in May 1915, they joined several Bavarian and Prussian Jaeger and Guards battalions to create three mountain infantry regiments with their own artillery, machine guns, and even aviation. The Alpenkorps was born, and soon it became one of the best known and most feared German units of the Great War.
dst: 就这样，1915年5月，他们把几个巴伐利亚和普鲁士的猎兵营及近卫营合在一起，组建了三个山地步兵团，并配属了炮兵、机枪，甚至航空兵。阿尔卑斯军就此诞生，并很快成为大战中最著名、最令人畏惧的德国部队之一。

src: That was nearly an desaster. But you hold Minsk and Borissow long time.
dst: 这几乎是一场灾难。但您长久地守住了明斯克和鲍里索夫。

src: That was quick work Herr General. The Italians are grateful for our support and will continue to support us.
dst: 干得真快，将军阁下。意大利人感激我们的支援，将继续支持我们。

src: That was the end of the Komuch. The Bolsheviks were a buch of fanatics, criminals and murderers, but their determination was simply enviable. They would stop at nothing in order to obtain power, and that gave them an advantage over all of us. Just a few days later, a massive Soviet counterattack forced us to retreat down the Volga, towards Samara, with our enemies on our heels.
dst: 那就是科穆奇的终结。布尔什维克是一帮狂热分子、罪犯和杀人犯，但他们的决心实在令人羡慕。为夺取政权他们会不择手段，这使他们对我们所有人占据了优势。仅仅几天后，一场大规模的苏维埃反攻迫使我们沿伏尔加河向萨马拉方向撤退，敌人紧追不舍。

src: That was the last time that I was engaged in battle. I was relieved from command due to my failure, and Kolchak sent me to maintain order in Chita, near the border with China and Mongolia. That meant that, when our army was finally defeated a few months later, it was easy to gather as many sympathizers as I could find and lead them safely to China, where the Bolsheviks couldn't harm them. After Chelyabinsk, I had a chance to redeem myself.
dst: 那是我最后一次参战。由于失败，我被解除了指挥权，高尔察克派我去靠近中蒙边境的赤塔维持秩序。这意味着，几个月后我军最终战败时，我可以轻易地尽可能多召集同情者，把他们安全地带到中国，在那里布尔什维克无法伤害他们。车里雅宾斯克之后，我有了一个弥补自己的机会。

src: That was the last time that we acted as a coordinated army. After a bitter argument with Kolchak, Diterikhs resigned and emigrated to Harbin, in Manchuria. Kappel was appointed as the new Commander-in-Chief of the Eastern Front, but there was very little that he could actually do. Without most of our equipment, and without any means of transportation, planning coordinated actions between our remaining units was nearly impossible. Besides, we suffered a constant harassment by bands of partisans, and the foreign soldiers, especially the Czechs, were becoming increasingly hostile. All of us knew that the end was near.
dst: 那是我们最后一次像一支协调一致的军队那样行动。与高尔察克激烈争吵之后，季捷里赫斯辞职并移居满洲的哈尔滨。卡佩尔被任命为东线新的总司令，但他实际上能做的少之又少。失去了大部分装备，又没有运输工具，要在我们剩下的部队之间策划协同行动几乎是不可能的。此外，我们不断遭到游击队袭扰，而外国士兵——尤其是捷克人——也变得日益敌对。我们所有人都知道，末日临近了。

src: That was what we have expected from you. You could hold Kiev and the surrounding region.
dst: 这正是我们对你的期望。你守住了基辅及其周边地区。

src: That wasn't the first time that the Europeans had tried to deceive us. They had done the same to Yohannes IV with the Treaty of Adwa, and to Menelik II with the Treaty of Wuchale. This third time, we were ready to hit them first. The very same day that the Conference of Kasala ended, I launched a surprise attack against the Italian defences at the pass of Keren.
dst: 这已不是欧洲人第一次试图欺骗我们了。他们曾用《阿杜瓦条约》这样对待约翰内斯四世，又用《武恰莱条约》这样对待孟尼利克二世。这一次，我们已准备好先发制人。就在卡萨拉会议结束的当天，我便对克伦山口处的意大利防御阵地发动了突袭。

src: That went ok, sir.  Unfortunately, our rather limited advance has done little other than draw large swarms of angry Germans upon us.  Furthermore, the advance to our right, at Monte Cassino, has also been halted, and the Army within the Anzio beachhead refuses to move. This is not good.  We're in the stickiest situation since Sticky the Stick Insect got stuck on a sticky bun.  Thankfully however you needn't worry about all of this anymore - we've recieved orders to embark for home.  No, the war isn't over; we're needed for the liberation of France.
dst: 进展还行，长官。遗憾的是，我们相当有限的推进没别的用处，只招来了成群愤怒的德军。而且，我们右翼蒙特卡西诺的推进也已停滞，安齐奥滩头里的部队又拒绝动弹。这可不好。我们眼下所处的局面，比“黏虫虫黏在了黏面包上”还要黏糊。所幸这些您都不必再操心了——我们已接到命令登船回国。不，战争还没结束；解放法国还需要我们。

src: That went rather well, sir.  Unfortunately, our rather limited advance has done little other than draw large swarms of angry Germans upon us.  Furthermore, the advance to our right, at Monte Cassino, has also been halted, and the Army within the Anzio beachhead refuses to move. This is not good.  We're in the stickiest situation since Sticky the Stick Insect got stuck on a sticky bun.  Thankfully however you needn't worry about all of this anymore - we've recieved orders to embark for home.  No, the war isn't over; we're needed for the liberation of France.
dst: 进展还算不错，长官。遗憾的是，我们相当有限的推进没别的用处，只招来了成群愤怒的德军。而且，我们右翼蒙特卡西诺的推进也已停滞，安齐奥滩头里的部队又拒绝动弹。这可不好。我们眼下所处的局面，比“黏虫虫黏在了黏面包上”还要黏糊。所幸这些您都不必再操心了——我们已接到命令登船回国。不，战争还没结束；解放法国还需要我们。

src: That went well, sir.  Unfortunately, our rather limited advance has done little other than draw large swarms of angry Germans upon us.  Furthermore, the advance to our right, at Monte Cassino, has also been halted, and the Army within the Anzio beachhead refuses to move. This is not good.  We're in the stickiest situation since Sticky the Stick Insect got stuck on a sticky bun.  Thankfully however you needn't worry about all of this anymore - we've recieved orders to embark for home.  No, the war isn't over; we're needed for the liberation of France.
dst: 进展顺利，长官。遗憾的是，我们相当有限的推进没别的用处，只招来了成群愤怒的德军。而且，我们右翼蒙特卡西诺的推进也已停滞，安齐奥滩头里的部队又拒绝动弹。这可不好。我们眼下所处的局面，比“黏虫虫黏在了黏面包上”还要黏糊。所幸这些您都不必再操心了——我们已接到命令登船回国。不，战争还没结束；解放法国还需要我们。

src: That's how I was feeling when the failure of our Spring Offensive became clear. I really believed that we could destroy the Bolshevik revolution and win the war, and just two months later all that I could do was to wait impotently until the Reds, fully reinforced and resupplied, decided to recover their lost ground. I could hardly cope with that. I felt sick and weak, and finding the strength to carry on was harder every passing day.
dst: 当春季攻势的失败明朗化时，我就是这种感觉。我真的曾相信我们能够摧毁布尔什维克革命并赢得战争，而仅仅两个月后，我所能做的只是无能为力地等待，直到得到充分补充和补给的红军决定收复失地。我几乎无法承受这一切。我感到恶心和虚弱，而找到继续前进的力量，一天比一天艰难。

src: That's it. The German Spring Offensive is finally over. They haven't been able to achieve any of their goals, not only here, but all along the front.
dst: 就这样。德国春季攻势终于结束了。他们不仅在这里，而且在整条战线上都未能实现任何目标。

src: That's not what we were expecting. You've been ridiculed by a third class German division. We can still play a significant role in this war, but only if we choose competent commanders. Say goodbye to your former troops and return to America, immediately!
dst: 这可不是我们期望的结果。您被一个三流的德国师羞辱了。我们仍能在这场战争中发挥重要作用，但前提是选用称职的指挥官。跟您的旧部道别，立即返回美国！

src: That's the reason why we planned an attack against the Russian stronghold of Mukden. Thanks to the railway, it was the most important base of operations that our enemies had in southern Manchuria. The Russian presence there was a permanent threat to Peking, so recovering that town was vital for China. But first the Qing soldiers would have to fight the many Siberian regiments and Cossack squadrons that were defending Mukden and its neighbouring area.
dst: 这就是我们计划进攻俄国据点奉天的原因。多亏了这条铁路，奉天成了敌人在南满洲最重要的作战基地。俄国人在那里的存在是对北京的永久威胁，因此收复该城对中国至关重要。但首先，清军士兵必须与守卫奉天及其周边地区的众多西伯利亚团和哥萨克骑兵中队作战。

src: That's why the High Command decided that your elite troops should disembark in Toulon. Under normal circumstances it would be a suicide, but right now most of the French and British fleets are in the Ärmelkanal, supporting the Entente troops in northern France. If you make it, you'll save thousands of lives.
dst: 正因如此，最高统帅部决定，您的精锐部队应在土伦登陆。在正常情况下，这无异于自杀，但眼下法国和英国的大部分舰队都在英吉利海峡，支援着法国北部的协约国军队。如果您能成功，将挽救成千上万人的生命。

src: That's why the higher ups are getting a bit antsy, Commander.  We've lost contact with some of the smaller villages east of Thule, and the only intel we've got is a broken radio report of armed soldiers entering one of the town squares.  There's obviously some kind of paramilitary threat out there, and we need to put it down.
dst: 正因如此，上头的人开始坐立不安了，指挥官。我们与图勒以东的一些小村落失去了联系，唯一的线索是一份断断续续的无线电报告，说有武装士兵闯进了其中一座城镇的广场。显然外面存在着某种准军事威胁，我们必须将其扑灭。

src: The  Red army will to try raise a blockade to Leningrad and destroy our division.
dst: 红军将试图解除对列宁格勒的封锁，并歼灭我军师团。

src: The "1re Division de Chassesurs Ardennaises" has already been sent to the town of Vinkt to reinforce the front.
dst: “第1阿登猎兵师”已奉命前往芬克特镇增援前线。

src: The "Corps de Cavalerie" has to protect the north flank of the deployment replacing the French troops which are moving back to France.
dst: “骑兵军”必须掩护部署的北翼，接替正撤回法国的法军部队。

src: The "Corps de Cavalerie" is being reorganized behind the front line but you may be requested to provide some support if the situation requires so. We have been informed that the Germans will try to test our positions around the city of Leuven.
dst: “骑兵军”正在前线后方整编，但如形势需要，可能会要求您提供支援。我们已获悉德军将试探鲁汶城周边的我军阵地。

src: The "Legion I Germanica" is stationed in the Province of Noricum, where Consul Gnaeus Papirius Carbo enjoys a status of eminence.
dst: 「第1军团/日耳曼尼卡」驻在诺里库姆行省，执政官格奈乌斯帕皮里乌斯卡尔波在那里享有显赫地位。

src: The "Ligne KW" (Dyle line) has been broken in some places but I am confident that it will check the German advance. You just need to gather your troops and take again the bridgehead the Germans have made
dst: “KW 防线”（迪尔河防线）在若干地段被突破，但我相信它能阻止德军前进。您只需收拢部队，夺回德军建立的桥头堡。

src: The "Ligne KW" (Dyle line) has resisted as we thought. The Germans have suffered heavy losses and have not been able to break through our lines.
dst: “KW 防线”（迪尔河防线）果然如我们所料顶住了。德军损失惨重，未能突破我军防线。

src: The "Ligne KW" (Dyle line) has withstood German pressure well. The Germans have suffered important losses and have had a rough time to get some small bridgeheads. They will soon be cleaned up.
dst: “KW 防线”（迪尔河防线）很好地顶住了德军的压力。德军损失重大，费了很大力气才夺得几处小桥头堡。这些桥头堡很快就会被肃清。

src: The "Race to the Sea" is over and both Armies have started do dig in, from Switzerland to the Belgian Coast.
dst: 「奔向大海」已经结束，双方军队都开始从瑞士到比利时海岸挖壕据守。

src: The "enemy" forces are made of an infantry battalion supported by few obsolete light tanks. Those can't be used for anything else than an anti-tank training, but be careful still. Tankmen may overwatch you and we've had a mortal accident not long ago, when one Soviet recruit was trampled over by the speeding vehicle.
dst: “敌军”由得到一个营步兵、辅以少量老旧轻型坦克支援的部队组成。这些坦克除了用作反坦克训练外别无用处，但仍要当心。坦克手可能会警戒注视你们，而且不久前就出过一起致命事故——一名苏联新兵被疾驰的车辆碾过。

src: The "race" ended on the North Sea coast of Belgium around 19 October, when the last open area from Diksmuide to the North Sea was occupied by Belgian troops who had retreated after the Siege of Antwerp. The outflanking attempts had resulted in a number of encounter battles but neither side was able to gain a decisive victory.
dst: 这场「竞赛」大约于10月19日在比利时北海岸边结束，当时从迪克斯迈德到北海的最后一片开阔地带被安特卫普围城战后撤退下来的比利时军队占领。双方迂回包抄的企图导致了一系列遭遇战，但谁也无法取得决定性胜利。

src: The 'Frau's proved their Fuhress right and the Yugoslavian forces were destroyed with aid of the Brits and French.Now instead of Stalin having feet in Checkoslavakia it was the SS and they were there to stay,the "destruction of the Czech Army demanded It and the Sudetenland had to be protected" the Fuhress told England and France.Two Brits conversation after the battle. "Blimey Horace,did You see those girls take out that machine-gun.Hey give me another smoke will Ya? I would have never rushed a position like that.Hard to believe only 4 or 5 of them got hit"." Yeh Perky,they should have waited for that tank to arrive but when that Commander said Go those Krazy Girls acted as if someone had set a fire underneath their bumms.One thing is for sure once they got within distance to toss those stick grenades that was all She wrote.And that injured Guy begging for His life,what did that Broad shout before She cut His throat"?"It was something about not being 'SS/B/Fem/Im' I think,did You see that look on Her face while doing It,Evil I tell You Horace as if She enjoyed the sight of Blood.And afterwards them Girls talking about stuff as cooking and marrying and having a slew of kids as if nothing here had ever happened.I have heard of the Devil but always took that stuff to be a lot of rubbish by the clergy but these 'Fraus in those SS helmets may prove Me wrong"."Hey Perky You know something, we're not SS/B/Fem/Im".
dst: “女士”们证明了她们的元首没错，南斯拉夫军队在英法协助下被歼灭。如今在捷克斯洛伐克插足的已不是斯大林，而是党卫军，而且她们要长驻下去——女元首对英法说：“摧毁捷克军队是形势所需，苏台德地区必须受到保护。”战后两个英国人的对话。“天哪，霍勒斯，你看见那些姑娘端掉那挺机枪了吗。嘿，再给我支烟行吗？我可从不会那样冲一个阵地。真难相信她们只中了四五个人。”“是啊，珀基，她们本该等那辆坦克到的，可那位指挥官一喊‘上’，那些疯姑娘就像有人点着了她们的屁股一样。有一点可以肯定：等她们冲到能扔柄式手榴弹的距离，那就完了。还有那个受伤求饶的家伙，那娘们在割他喉咙前喊了句什么？”“我记得大概是说他不‘SS/B/Fem/Im’之类的话。你看见她动手时脸上的表情了吗？告诉你，霍勒斯，是邪恶，好像她享受看到血。之后那些姑娘还聊着做饭、结婚、生一大群孩子，好像这里什么都没发生过。我听说过魔鬼，一直当那是教士们的胡说八道，可这些戴着党卫军头盔的‘女士’们也许能证明我错了。”“嘿，珀基，你知道吗，我们可不是 SS/B/Fem/Im。”

src: The 10 Motorized Infantry Division is ordered to assist your attack from the North asap, followed soon by the 7th Panzer Division which will support your attack from the South.
dst: 第10摩托化步兵师奉命尽快从北面支援你的进攻，随后第7装甲师不久将从南面支援你的进攻。

src: The 10th Army has been completely routed. Our right flank is secured, and now we can finally help the Don cossacks at Tsaritsyn.
dst: 第10集团军已被彻底击溃。我们的右翼得以巩固，如今终于可以去支援察里津的顿河哥萨克了。

src: The 10th Panzer Division, which is ahead of your main battle group will drive south and capture the town of Lomza.
dst: 位于你主战斗群前方的第10装甲师将南下夺取沃姆扎镇。

src: The 12th Army has escaped the noose of encirclement by September 5th, leaving behind a trail of abandoned equipment, ammunition, and misery.  The Latvian division, having participated in the bloody Mitau Operation in January and in the rearguard actions in the direct path of the German army's main group, has been decimated:  of the 30,000 riflemen raised into the initially over-strengthened division, a third has falled.
dst: 到9月5日，第12集团军已逃出合围的绞索，身后留下一路被遗弃的装备、弹药和苦难。拉脱维亚师曾参加一月那场血腥的米塔乌战役，并在德军主力集群推进路线上的后卫作战中作战，已被打得元气大伤：起初超编组建的3万步枪手中，三分之一已经阵亡。

src: The 16th Army still have some strong troops, but the best of the Germans are fighting in the south and in the central. So the 16th Army has only a few tank divisions. Mostfull infantry divisions will be your opponent.
dst: 第16集团军仍有一些强大的部队，但德国人最精锐的部队正在南部和中部作战。因此第16集团军只有少数几个坦克师。你面对的大多是步兵师。

src: The 16th army and the 18th Army defends the city. There are some serious tank divisions outside of the city. In Riga fanatic infantry divisions are deployed. They have support fire from several artillery divisions.
dst: 第16集团军和第18集团军防守该城。城外有一些厉害的装甲师。里加城内则部署着狂热的步兵师。他们还有来自数个炮兵师的支援火力。

src: The 1905 plan developed by Count Alfred von Schlieffen, had the following key features:
dst: 1905年由阿尔弗雷德·冯·施利芬伯爵制定的计划具有以下关键特征：

src: The 1st Bavarian Reserve Infantry Division will arrive piecemeal over the next two days (during the first half of the scenario) in the sector of the Garde Kavallerie Division.
dst: 巴伐利亚第1预备步兵师将在未来两天内（场景前半段）分批抵达近卫骑兵师防区。

src: The 1st Czechoslovak Armoured Brigade and some Canadian units will be under your command for this operation.
dst: 第1捷克斯洛伐克装甲旅以及部分加拿大部队将在此次作战中归你指挥。

src: The 1st Czechoslovak Independent Brigade was then awarded the Order of Bogdan Khmelnitsky (1st grade).
dst: 捷克斯洛伐克第1独立旅随后获颁一级博格丹·赫梅利尼茨基勋章。

src: The 1st Czechoslovak Independent Field Battalion underwent its first action in March 1943 during the combats in Kharkov area. The battalion was ordered to hold the village of Sokolovo against the awaited German assault. This assault was delayed by a ferocious defense of the 78th Guards Rifle Regiment that held Taranivka. But once Taranivka fell, Germans quickly moved to the north. And on the afternoon of 8th March the first fourteen tanks started the armed reconnaisance of Sokolovo's outskirts...
dst: 1943年3月，捷克斯洛伐克第1独立野战营在哈尔科夫地区的战斗中接受了首次实战考验。该营奉命据守索科洛沃村，抵挡预料中的德军进攻。这次进攻因据守塔拉尼夫卡的第78近卫步兵团顽强防御而推迟。但塔拉尼夫卡一旦陷落，德军便迅速北上。3月8日下午，首批十四辆坦克开始了对索科洛沃郊外的武装侦察……

src: The 1st Czechoslovak Independent Field Battalion was officially found on 12th February 1942. It was made of Czechoslovak soldiers that fought during the Polish campaign in September 1939, and that fell into Soviet captivity. Although many of them left for France or Middle East, others had remained and they passed through several internmet camps; final one was in Buzuluk. Once the establishment of independent Czechoslovak army formation was approved by the Soviet officials, those men were joined by the former Czechoslovak citizens relased from Soviet prisons and concentration camps; together they formed the battalion. They were equipped and trained by the Soviets. This scenario is one of such training missions. You'll be guided by Soviet instructors as usual, but this time you'll also train with young Soviet recruits.
dst: 捷克斯洛伐克第1独立野战营于1942年2月12日正式成立。它由1939年9月波兰战役中作战、后落入苏军战俘营的捷克斯洛伐克士兵组成。虽然其中许多人去了法国或中东，但另一些人留了下来，辗转于多个拘留营，最后一个在布祖鲁克。一旦建立独立捷克斯洛伐克军队编成的提议获得苏联官方批准，这些人与从苏联监狱和集中营释放的前捷克斯洛伐克公民会合，共同组成了这个营。他们由苏军装备和训练。本场景就是这样的训练任务之一。你将一如既往地由苏联教官指导，但这次你还会和年轻的苏联新兵一起训练。

src: The 1st Polish Armor division has made contact with the US 90th Infantry Division near Chamboix causing multiple divisions of ours, between Falaise and Argentan, to be cut off during our retreat East. Your division got out in time. Counterattack and break through the Polish lines to get as much troops out of the Falaise pocket as possible.
dst: 波兰第1装甲师已在尚布瓦附近与美军第90步兵师会合，使我们在向东撤退途中、位于法莱斯与阿让唐之间的多个师被切断。你的师及时脱身。反击并突破波军防线，尽可能多地把我军救出法莱斯包围圈。

src: The 1st South African Brigade and an armoured car detachment of the Royal Navy Air Service (RNAS) will join your forces during this operation that should not only destroy the Senussi force, but also relieve Sidi Barrani.
dst: 南非第1旅和皇家海军航空队（RNAS）的一个装甲车分队将在本次行动中加入您的部队。此次行动不仅要摧毁塞努西的部队，还要为西迪巴拉尼解围。

src: The 1st brigade has been formed to combine all forces defending Tartu.  These include the 2nd and 3rd regiments and the Bulak-Bulakhovich brigade of the White Russian North Corps (which has been retreating from Pskov).  Due to a Bolshevik-orchestrated coup at Tartu, a batallion from the 2nd regiment has scattered, and Kubbo withdrew his forces toward Vortsjarv.
dst: 第1旅的组建，是为了整合所有防守塔尔图的部队。其中包括第2团和第3团，以及白俄北方军的布拉克-巴拉霍维奇旅（该旅一直在从普斯科夫撤退）。由于布尔什维克在塔尔图策划的一场政变，第2团的一个营已经溃散，库博将他的部队撤向沃尔茨湖。

src: The 2 Panzers of Gruppe 'Husmann parked by the Cafe.SS security was rounding up the French  hauling them off."Hey look Savannah,isn't that Betta Wohr"? "Looks like Her".The Girls had the Security bring Her over.She denied being Betta but didn't know who She was but She was not "the hated SS Witches".Savannah had the Security raise the Girls skirt and pull Her panties down a little telling them there should be a Heart tattoo on Her left Bun with the Word 'Dieter'.Sure enough there it was and then Savannah showed the same but with the name 'Franz."Betta don't You remember that Weekend in Slausenhamm,You know, 'Kitties House'?The bike ride,that Major about running over Our Asses and Dieter beating the crap out of Him.You have to remember that, if You hadn't told Dieter to stop He would have killed the Guy".But Betta Wohr could not remember.The Girls kept Betta with them prodding and questioning though Wohr kept telling them they was "both insane and just let Her go with the 'Decent' People and be interned for in the near future the SS was going to get their asses kicked by the Brits all the way back to Berlin".So Betta was prodded through the night and next day turned over to a Medical unit.6 months later convalessing at home She heard the name 'Triks for the 100th time and Her Mind let loose the Death of the Panzer crew being killed while She was spared by the hand of fate.Another 4 months and Betta would be a hated 'SS Witch' in a Panzer again.
dst: “胡斯曼”集群的2辆坦克停在咖啡馆旁。党卫军安全部队正在围捕法国人、把人带走。“嘿看，萨凡纳，那不是贝塔·沃尔吗？”“看着像她。”姑娘们让安全部队把她带过来。她否认自己是贝塔，也不知道自己是谁，但坚称自己不是“那些可恨的党卫军女巫”。萨凡纳让安全部队掀开那姑娘的裙子、把内裤往下拉一点，说她的左臀上应该有一个心形纹身，上面写着“迪特”。果然，就在那儿。然后萨凡纳也亮出自己同样的纹身，但上面的名字是“弗朗茨”。“贝塔，你不记得在斯劳森哈姆的那个周末吗，你知道的，‘小猫之家’？那次骑车，那个差点碾到我们俩的少校，还有迪特把他揍得够呛。你肯定记得——要不是你叫迪特住手，他会把那人打死的。”可贝塔·沃尔想不起来。姑娘们把贝塔留在身边，反复追问，而沃尔一直说她们“两个都疯了”，让她们放她和那些“体面人”一起去被拘留，因为不久的将来，党卫军会被英国人一路打回柏林。于是贝塔被盘问了一整夜，第二天被交给医疗单位。6个月后在家疗养时，她第100次听到“特里克”这个名字，她的记忆猛然松开了——车组阵亡，而她被命运之手留了下来。再过4个月，贝塔又会成为一名可恨的“党卫军女巫”，重新坐进坦克。

src: The 2nd Armoured Division is no match for our forces and has retreated East. The Cyrenaica lies at our feet. Rommel has ordered us to form 3 Kampfgruppes to advance along the coast on the Via Balbia, to Msus and to Mechili.
dst: 第2装甲师不是我们的对手，已向东撤退。昔兰尼加已在我们脚下。隆美尔已下令我们组建3个战斗群，分别沿海岸的巴尔比亚公路、向姆苏斯和向梅基利推进。

src: The 2nd Armoured Division is too strong for our untrained forces. Train your reinforcements and perform another attack on the British lines.
dst: 第2装甲师对我们的未训部队来说太强了。把你的增援训练好，再对英军防线发起一次进攻。

src: The 2nd Army's tragedy in Prussia has been offset by an Austro-Hungarian tragedy of greater porportions:  from the fortress of Przemysl to the slopes of the Carpathian Mountains, our troops have carried victory across the Galician plain.  Using the Polish salient as its springboard, the North-Western Front will prepare an offensive into German Silesia for the coming year of 1915.
dst: 第2集团军在普鲁士的悲剧，被一场规模更大的奥匈悲剧所抵消：从普热梅希尔要塞到喀尔巴阡山山坡，我军在加利西亚平原上节节胜利。西北战线将以波兰突出部为跳板，为即将到来的1915年准备一场进攻德属西里西亚的攻势。

src: The 2nd Belorussian Front will assist your attack in the south and in the north. In the north the 2nd Belorussian Front should take Schwedt and fight against the 4th Tank Army. Remember, this is the last battle. You can use the massive pp for refitting if you need it.
dst: 白俄罗斯第2方面军将在南面和北面协助你的进攻。在北面，白俄罗斯第2方面军应夺取施韦特并对抗第4坦克集团军。记住，这是最后一战。如有需要，你可以使用大量 pp 进行整补。

src: The 2nd Shock Army deployed two dozen armored battalions against our sector, armed with the heaviest equipment, including the dreaded IS-2 tanks and ISU-152 self-propelled guns.
dst: 第2突击集团军向我防区投入了二十多个装甲营，装备最重的武器，包括令人生畏的 IS-2 坦克和 ISU-152 自行火炮。

src: The 2nd Ukrainian Front will assist your attack on the German lines. Also, some Romanian, Czech and Polish troops will be under your command. Unfortunately, there is no airfield in this area. So, you have to build one, before your planes can start.
dst: 乌克兰第2方面军将协助你进攻德军防线。此外，还有一些罗马尼亚、捷克与波兰部队将归你指挥。遗憾的是，该地区没有机场。因此你必须先修建一座机场，你的飞机才能起飞。

src: The 2nd, 4th and 5th artillery regiments got lately a honorary degree "Jaslo's regiments".
dst: 第2、第4、第5炮兵团后来获授“亚斯沃团”的荣誉称号。

src: The 34th division has been ordered to hold its position behind an extensive entrenchment network.  While the 34th holds, you must use the now famous 4th "Zheleznaya" ("Iron") Rifle Brigade (Denikin) to punch through the Austrian lines, stabilize our grip on the pass, and remove the threat of a German breakthrough toward Przemysl.  To accomplish this task, your men must hold the supply line intact to the 34th, while striking westward to remove the threat of the Austrian flank there.  If the enemy is able to capture any of your starting positions, this operation will be lost.  Do not let your comrades down!
dst: 第34师奉命依托纵深堑壕网坚守。在第34师坚守的同时，您必须使用声名显赫的第4「热列兹纳亚」（「钢铁」）步兵旅（邓尼金）突破奥军战线，巩固我们对山口的控制，并消除德军向普热梅希尔突破的威胁。为完成此任务，您的部下必须保持通往第34师的补给线完好，同时向西突击以消除那里奥军侧翼的威胁。如果敌人能够夺取您的任何一处起始阵地，此次作战即告失败。不要让您的战友失望！

src: The 4th Panzer Division has been delayed at the town of Mtsensk by the stubborn resistence of the Soviet 1st Guards Rifle Corps. Now the flanks of your advance are secure all effort should be made to take these objectives.
dst: 第4装甲师在姆岑斯克镇被苏军近卫第1步兵军的顽强抵抗所阻。既然你推进的侧翼已经安全，就应全力夺取这些目标。

src: The 4th tank army has far under strength, but they have some serious Panther and Tiger II tanks. The strongest resistance should be in the Krakow city areal.
dst: 第4坦克集团军兵力远未满编，但他们拥有一些相当厉害的「黑豹」与「虎王」坦克。最强的抵抗应该会在克拉科夫城区一带。

src: The 5.Reserve Division of [IIReserve] Corps will guard the approach to Brussels from Mechelen - where the first Belgian exit took place.
dst: [IIReserve]军的第5预备师将扼守从梅赫伦——比利时人第一次出击的地点——通往布鲁塞尔的要道。

src: The 50. Army is reported to you. Altogether 50 troops will help you. They are still inexperienced, but they should be strong enough to slow the German advance a little bit.
dst: 第50集团军向你报到。总计有50支部队将协助你。它们仍然缺乏经验，但足以稍稍迟滞德军的推进。

src: The 58. Infanterie-Division closing in on Narva from the south. Fighting still took place several weeks in this area.
dst: 第58步兵师从南面逼近纳尔瓦。该地区仍有战斗持续了数周。

src: The 5th Army field hospital will supply your units and heal 4 strenth points in a turn.
dst: 第5集团军野战医院将为您的单位提供补给，每回合治疗4点兵力。

src: The 5th Leichte Division's 5th Pz.Rgt. and 8th Mg.Btn. have breached the Tobruk Perimeter this morning. Unfortunately the Panzers got separated from the infantry which got pinned down.
dst: 第5轻装师的第5装甲团和第8机枪营今晨突破了托布鲁克外围防线。遗憾的是，装甲部队与步兵失去联系，而步兵被压制住了。

src: The 6. Japanese army have only a few tanks and very few air support. The Japanese are worn out. They have no rail connection, so they are certainly not able to relieve their troops.
dst: 日本第6军只有少量坦克和极少的空中支援。日军已疲惫不堪。他们没有铁路连接，因此肯定无法增援其部队。

src: The 62nd Marmarican and 63rd Cyrene are the only divisions that have a reasonable number of trucks still running.
dst: 第62马尔马里卡师和第63昔兰尼师是仅有的、还有相当数量卡车可用的两个师。

src: The 9th Army, the 12th Army and the 4th Tank Army are high-experienced but worn out troops. They have some serious tank divisions with Tiger II and Panther tanks. In the areal of Berlin unexperienced Volkssturm and Landwehr troops are also common opponents. In Berlin rests of the 9th Army, police troops and Volkssturm troops defeats the city. They are supported by Waffen SS Battle Group Mohnke.
dst: 第9集团军、第12集团军与第4坦克集团军都是经验丰富但已疲惫不堪的部队。他们拥有一些配备虎II与黑豹坦克的精锐装甲师。在柏林地区，缺乏经验的国民突击队与地方防卫军部队也是常见的对手。在柏林，第9集团军的残部、警察部队与国民突击队部队在防守该城。他们由武装党卫军莫恩克战斗群（Waffen SS Battle Group Mohnke）支援。

src: The Affair at Nery - September 1914 - BV
dst: 内里之战 - 1914年9月 - 大捷

src: The Affair at Nery - September 1914 - L
dst: 内里之战 - 1914年9月 - 失败

src: The Affair at Nery - September 1914 - TV
dst: 内里之战 - 1914年9月 - 小捷

src: The Affair at Nery - September 1914 - V
dst: 内里之战 - 1914年9月 - 胜利

src: The African Army has been stopped! This is the first important successful action of our soldiers. Great work, Madrid has been successfully defended, and now it will be a resistance symbol for the people of this country fighting against the Fascist menace!
dst: 非洲军被挡住了！这是我们士兵取得的第一个重大胜利。干得好，马德里已成功守住，如今它将成为这个国家人民抵抗法西斯威胁的象征！

src: The Airfields in the ocean simulate flight path / approach corridors for planes taking off in France.
dst: 海上的机场模拟从法国起飞的飞机的航路/进场走廊。

src: The Akarit line formes a better defensive position than the Mareth line, but our troops arrived there in great disarray which meant that 24 hours after 8th Army's attack on the position it had to be evacuated. 8th Army has made contact with the Allied forces in North and Central Tunisia and Mussolini's Afrika Korps faith is doomed.
dst: 阿卡里特防线比马雷斯防线更宜防守，但我军抵达时已十分混乱，这意味着在第8集团军进攻该阵地24小时后，它就被迫放弃了。第8集团军如今已与突尼斯北部和中部的盟军会师，墨索里尼的非洲军命运已注定。

src: The Alcazar has become to be a symbol of our resistance to the enemy, so your task is;
dst: 托莱多城堡已成为我们抗敌的象征，所以您的任务是：

src: The Allied commander wants you to take your forces and establish a bridgehead over the Weser River in order to facilitate a push towards Hannover, although you needn't worry too much about enemy resistance.  Intelligence reports suggest that the German units within the area are a mix of various under strength replacement units and local militia, which should be no match for your crack troops.
dst: 盟军指挥官要你率部在威悉河上建立桥头堡，以利向汉诺威推进，不过你不必太担心敌军的抵抗。情报显示，该地区德军是各种缺编补充部队和地方民兵的混合，应当不是你精锐部队的对手。

src: The Allied forces have gained a foothold on Italian soil. You must remove them quickly Herr General before reinforcements arrive. Drop your seamines at sea to slow down the invasion fleet. The allies are constructing a radar base at a small town on the coast. Drop your paras and wait  until it is finished and then destroy it.
dst: 盟军已在意大利土地取得立足点。你必须在援军抵达前迅速将其清除，将军阁下。在海上布下水雷以迟滞入侵舰队。盟军正在海岸一座小镇修建雷达基地。投下你的伞兵，等它建成后再将其摧毁。

src: The Allied green forces proved too numerous and our advance has come to a standstill once more.
dst: 盟军的生瓜蛋子部队数量太多，我们的推进再次停滞。

src: The Allies are determined to create a Second Front in Europe.
dst: 盟军决意在欧洲开辟第二战场。

src: The Allies are insistant upon capturing our technology.
dst: 盟军执意要夺取我们的技术。

src: The Allies can be quite stubborn, they have stalled our attack so as to enable most of their forces to escape despite the heroic front line efforts of your previuos General.
dst: 盟军相当顽固，尽管你的前任将军在前线英勇奋战，他们还是拖住了我们的进攻，使大部分部队得以逃脱。

src: The Allies have been able to stop our advance! From now on we cannot carry out any more attacks, because our units are in bad shape. Now will be defending our positions!
dst: 盟军已能阻止我们的推进！从现在起我们无法再发动任何进攻，因为我们的部队状况不佳。现在将转入防御我们的阵地！

src: The Allies have been able to stop you, we couldn't acomplish the proposed goals. We realize that it was really very hard and you had very few units.
dst: 盟军已能阻止您，我们未能完成预定的目标。我们明白这确实非常艰难，而您手上的部队极少。

src: The Allies have been thrown off the continent. Bravo!
dst: 盟军已被赶出欧洲大陆。干得漂亮！

src: The Allies have been thrown off the continent. Bravo!  But while you were driving the Allies into the sea the Bolsheviks treacherously broke our peace treaty and invaded our allied territories in Eastern Europe.  With the bulk of our forces involved on the Western Front and in Afrika they have been able to pollute the sacred soil of the Fatherland and penetrate almost to Berlin!  You MUST stop them.
dst: 盟军已被赶出大陆。好样的！但就在你把盟军赶下海的同时，布尔什维克背信弃义地撕毁了我方的和平条约，入侵了我们在东欧的盟友领土。由于我方主力都投入了西线和非洲，他们得以玷污祖国神圣的国土，几乎推进到了柏林城下！你必须阻止他们。

src: The Allies have been thrown out of Tunesia and are reeling in disarray from the bold strokes you and your brave men have delivered.  Now you must continue this drive and force them to evacuate their bases in Morocco, thus removing this threat to Feldmarschall Rommel's campaign to capture Egypt and the Suez Kanal.
dst: 盟军已被逐出突尼斯，并在您和您勇敢部下的大胆打击下仓皇溃退。现在您必须继续推进，迫使他们撤出摩洛哥的基地，从而消除对隆美尔元帅夺取埃及和苏伊士运河作战的这一威胁。

src: The Allies have copied our invasion of Crete.
dst: 盟军照搬了我们对克里特的入侵。

src: The Allies have landed paratroops in the area and have Naval support. You must crush there beachheads before they can reinforce. This will be tough , Herr General. Good luck!
dst: 盟军已在该地区空降伞兵，并有海军支援。你必须在他们增援之前粉碎其滩头。这会很艰难，将军阁下。祝你好运！

src: The Allies have launched Operation Dragoon at us. They think this is our "soft underbelly" but you will teach them they are wrong.
dst: 盟军对我们发动了“龙骑兵”行动。他们以为这是我们的“柔软腹部”，但你会让他们明白他们错了。

src: The Allies have now built up their forces and are about to unleash Operation Cobra, their attempt to break out of the Norman hedgerows once and for all. Your mission is to keep the Allies from pushing far into France until after August 18th. To do this, you should hold Rouen, Evreux, Alencon, and Laval, but at a minimum you must maintain control of at least two of these cities.
dst: 盟军现已完成集结，即将发起「眼镜蛇」行动，企图一举突破诺曼底树篱地带。你的任务是阻止盟军在 8月18日之前深入法国腹地。为此，你应守住鲁昂、埃夫勒、阿朗松和拉瓦勒，但至少必须控制其中两座城市。

src: The Allies have pushed us out of North Africa, and have landed all over Sicily!  Marshall Graziani is leading our counterattack to the South, you and your men have must destroy the Allied forces that are to land at Salerno.  We can not expect, and do not want help from Germany, besides, they are busy being swallowed up by Russia.
dst: 盟军已把我们逐出北非，并在西西里岛到处登陆！格拉齐亚尼元帅正率领我们的反攻南下，你和你的部队必须消灭即将在萨莱诺登陆的盟军。我们不能指望、也不想要德国的帮助，况且他们正忙着被俄国吞噬。

src: The Allies have taken over the front to push through the Alps and into Germany.  YOUR Army is now going to be rested and refitted for a new operation.
dst: 盟军已接管战线，穿过阿尔卑斯山挺进德国。你的集团军现在将休整换装，准备执行新的行动。

src: The Allies landed in Normandy June 6 1944, 2 days ago. Yesterday preparations were made to come to march readiness. Today we are moving out. First stop is the Limoges-Tulle area. We will travel there in two columns. Be aware of partisan attacks. Resistance activity has increased considerably over the last few days throughout France.
dst: 两天前，也就是1944年6月6日，盟军在诺曼底登陆。昨天已做好行军准备。今天我们就要开拔。第一站是利摩日-图勒地区。我们将分两路纵队前往。提防游击队袭击。过去几天，全法国的抵抗活动已明显加剧。

src: The Alpenkorps is going to play a major role in the forthcoming operation, but I cannot tell you anything about it yet. Pray for me, mein Schatz!
dst: 阿尔卑斯军将在即将到来的行动中扮演重要角色，但我现在还不能告诉您任何详情。为我祈祷吧，我的宝贝！

src: The American Asiatic Squadron under Commodore George Dewey has entered the waters of Manila Bay to attack and destroy our forces in the Pacific. The batteries and mines in the entrance of Manila Bay have proved ineffective.
dst: 乔治·杜威准将率领的美国亚洲分舰队已进入马尼拉湾水域，前来攻击并消灭我们在太平洋的部队。马尼拉湾入口处的炮台和水雷已证明毫无作用。

src: The American commanders, General Merrit and Commodore Dewey, have dared to propose an outrageous agreement to surrender Manila after a "moke" battle consisting in a brief naval bombardment and infantry assault. It goes without saying that a Spanish officer and gentleman cannot accept such a humiliating offer. We count on your sharp fighting to defend the Spanish flag.
dst: 美军指挥官梅里特将军和杜威准将竟胆敢提出一项无耻的协议：在一场由短暂舰炮轰击和步兵突击组成的「假」战斗之后，让马尼拉投降。不言而喻，一名西班牙军官和绅士绝不能接受如此屈辱的条件。我们指望您英勇作战，捍卫西班牙国旗。

src: The American commanders, General Merritt and Commodore Dewey, have dared to suggest Governor Jáudenes, Augustín's replacement, an outrageous agreement to surrender Manila after a "mock" battle consisting in a brief naval bombardment and infantry assault. It goes without saying that a Spanish officer and gentleman cannot accept such a humiliating offer. We count on your sharp fighting to defend the Spanish flag.
dst: 美军指挥官梅里特将军和杜威准将竟敢向奥古斯丁的继任者豪德内斯总督提出一项无耻的协议：在一场由短暂舰炮轰击和步兵突击组成的「假」战斗后交出马尼拉。不言而喻，一名西班牙军官兼绅士绝不能接受如此屈辱的提议。我们指望您英勇奋战，捍卫西班牙国旗。

src: The American forces launched their own offensive, Operation Cobra. We must stop an immense wave of tanks, self-propelled artillery, infantry and parachute divisions, supported by the cream of the US Airforce: the sky is covered with hundreds of fighters and fighter-bombers.
dst: 美军发起了自己的攻势——“眼镜蛇行动”。我们必须挡住铺天盖地的坦克、自行火炮、步兵与空降师，其有美国空军精锐支援：天空被数百架战斗机与战斗轰炸机遮蔽。

src: The American forces reached Guam on the morning of June 20, 1898. The protected cruiser USS Charleston shelled fort Santa Cruz but there was no response. The fort did not reply not only because it had no powder but also because the Spanish government did not notify that Spain had been in war with the United States for nearly two months.
dst: 美军部队于1898年6月20日清晨抵达关岛。防护巡洋舰「查尔斯顿」号炮击了圣克鲁斯堡，但没有回应。该堡之所以没有回击，不仅是因为它没有火药，还因为西班牙政府没有通知说西班牙已与美国交战近两个月。

src: The American units are well equipped, however they lack any significant combat experiences. I order you to smash them into nothingness. After you make harmless the most immediate threat, you'll recapture Algeria in a series of fast operations with the final goal being a total control over North-West Africa. No other result is possible!"
dst: 美军装备精良，但严重缺乏实战经验。我命令你把他们碾成齑粉。在解除最直接的威胁之后，你将通过一系列快速行动夺回阿尔及利亚，最终目标是完全控制西北非。没有其他结果可言！”

src: The Americans and British have pushed us back across the Rhein. We no longer have the strength to halt them. All that is left for the fatherland is defeat and disgrace. But you have already experienced that. Haven't you, Herr General?
dst: 美军和英军已把我们赶回莱茵河对岸。我们再也没有力量阻止他们。留给祖国的只剩失败与耻辱。可你早已体会过这一切了，不是吗，将军阁下？

src: The Americans and British have pushed us back across the Rhine. We no longer have the strength to halt them. All that is left for the fatherland is defeat and disgrace. But you have already experienced that. Haven't you, Herr General?
dst: 美军和英军已把我们赶回莱茵河对岸。我们再也没有力量阻止他们。留给祖国的只剩失败与耻辱。可你早已体会过这一切了，不是吗，将军阁下？

src: The Americans are quite hard-headed; after their bloody nose at Nancy they are probably planning an assault on our fortress city of Metz. You are to stop them at all costs.
dst: 美国人相当顽固；在南锡碰得头破血流之后，他们大概正计划进攻我们的要塞城市梅斯。您须不惜一切代价阻止他们。

src: The Americans have been preparing to launch a new offensive aimed at taking Rome. You must hold a minimum of four objectives until at least the end of March. If possible, retake and hold Anzio while keeping the Allies from gaining any of the objectives you currently hold.
dst: 美军一直在准备发动一场旨在夺取罗马的新攻势。你至少须守到 3月底，期间保有四个目标。如有可能，夺回并守住安齐奥，同时不让盟军夺取你目前掌握的任何目标。

src: The Americans have launched a full scale offensive across the Vire. You will counterattack, restore the situation and make sure we keep St. Lo.
dst: 美国人已全线发起横渡维尔河的攻势。您将实施反突击，恢复态势，并确保我们守住圣洛。

src: The Anglo-American attempt to surprise us from behind was a total failure, from now on we can concentrate on thinking about our next offensive target.
dst: 英美军队从背后突袭我们的企图彻底失败，从现在起，我们可以专心考虑下一个进攻目标了。

src: The Anglo-American forces have disembarked in French territory, and set off at full speed following a route to Tunisia. After your defeat in Egypt, this is the only defendable sector of Africa that we have left.
dst: 英美军队已在法国领土登陆，并沿通往突尼斯的路线全速开进。在你们于埃及战败之后，这是我们在非洲仅剩的可守之地。

src: The Anglo-American's intent to surprise us from behind has failed, now we can concentrate on fighting against Monty at the Mareth Line.
dst: 英美从背后突袭我们的意图已经失败，现在我们可以集中力量在马雷斯防线对抗蒙蒂了。

src: The April uprising has been a disaster. Our troops, disorganized and inexperienced, have been completely defeated by the army of the foreign King Amadeo in Oroquieta. Now it is vital that the legitimate king crosses again the French border with all the possible troops. Liberals may have stopped us by now, but in France we will be able to reorganize and try again in the future.
dst: 四月起义是一场灾难。我们的部队杂乱无章、缺乏经验，已在奥罗基耶塔被外国国王阿马德奥的军队彻底击败。眼下，正当的国王带着所有可能的部队再次越过法国边境至关重要。自由派现在或许已挡住我们，但在法国，我们将能重整旗鼓，来日再战。

src: The Army Group Hoth is on the other side of the Myschkowa river. We calculate with further reinforcements in the next days. Although this troops will mostly be Italians, Romanians and Hungarians.
dst: 霍特集团军群位于梅什科瓦河对岸。我们预计在未来几天内还会有更多增援抵达。尽管这些部队大多是意大利人、罗马尼亚人与匈牙利人。

src: The Army has regrouped and re-equipped.  Our Prussian enemy has been cornered into a two-front war of attrition on a massive scale.  The year of 1916 will see a more co-ordinated effort by the Entente to bring this war to an end.
dst: 军队已重新编组并更换装备。我们的普鲁士敌人已被逼入一场规模庞大的两线消耗战。1916年将见证协约国为结束这场战争而进行的更加协调一致的努力。

src: The Army of the Loire fought bravely, and defeated the Prussians in some areas, but they eventually gave in. After two days of battle a third of the French soldiers had deserted, and other 29,000 men were killed, wounded or taken prisoner. The remnants of the army withdrew to the west, leaving a large part of their equipment behind. They wouldn't suppose a threat to the Prussians anymore. The reorganization of the Army of the Loire and the continuation of the war had become impossible tasks, and a relief of Paris was unthinkable. After Le Mans, there wouldn't be further major battles in the Loire region, and while the bombardment of Paris intensified, the Prussians were free to launch a final attack against the French forces in the north.
dst: 卢瓦尔军团英勇作战，并在一些地区击败了普鲁士人，但他们最终还是屈服了。经过两天的战斗，三分之一的法军士兵开了小差，另有2.9万人阵亡、负伤或被俘。军团残部向西撤退，丢弃了大部分装备。他们从此不再对普鲁士人构成威胁。重整卢瓦尔军团、继续作战都已成为不可能完成的任务，而解巴黎之围更是不可想象。勒芒之战后，卢瓦尔地区不再有大规模战斗，而随着对巴黎的炮击日益加剧，普鲁士人得以腾出手来，对北方的法军发起最后的进攻。

src: The Army of the Loire was completely beaten. After two days of battle a third of the French soldiers had deserted, and other 29,000 men were killed, wounded or taken prisoner. The remnants of the army withdrew to the west, leaving a large part of their equipment behind. They wouldn't suppose a threat to the Prussians anymore. The reorganization of the Army of the Loire and the continuation of the war had become impossible tasks, and a relief of Paris was unthinkable. After Le Mans, there wouldn't be further major battles in the Loire region, and while the bombardment of Paris intensified, the Prussians were free to launch a final attack against the French forces in the north.
dst: 卢瓦尔军团被彻底击溃。经过两天的战斗，三分之一的法军士兵开了小差，另有2.9万人阵亡、负伤或被俘。军团残部向西撤退，丢弃了大部分装备。他们从此不再对普鲁士人构成威胁。重整卢瓦尔军团、继续作战都已成为不可能完成的任务，而解巴黎之围更是不可想象。勒芒之战后，卢瓦尔地区不再有大规模战斗，而随着对巴黎的炮击日益加剧，普鲁士人得以腾出手来，对北方的法军发起最后的进攻。

src: The Artois-Loos offensive started well for the British forces, but bad management of reinforcements meant no breakthrough could be achieved and little of strategic value was gained. British losses totalled about 60,000 and French losses about 50,000. German losses were about 50,000.
dst: 阿图瓦-洛斯攻势对英军而言开局顺利，但对增援部队的糟糕调度意味着无法实现突破，取得的战果几乎没有战略价值。英军损失总计约6万，法军约5万，德军约5万。

src: The Aussies blew up the Causeway - and are hoping to be able to hold the island. Expect some hard resistance. Get your troops across and onto the island as fast as you can - that should be safest.
dst: 澳洲佬炸毁了堤道——指望能守住此岛。预计会遇到顽强抵抗。尽快让你的部队渡海登岛——这样最为稳妥。

src: The Australian 1st Brigade took Lone Pine after a desperate fight and held it against several Turkish counter-attacks, suffering 1,700 casualties out of 2,900. The 3rd Light Horse Brigade which was given the literally suicidal task to attack the Turkish lines at "The Nek" showed unimaginable heroism, but was nearly wiped out within 15 minutes. Not a single soldier reached the Turkish trenches.
dst: 澳大利亚第1旅在殊死战斗后夺取了孤松，并在土耳其军的多次反击下守住了它，2900人中伤亡1700人。第3轻骑旅被赋予了一项近乎自杀的任务——进攻「内克」地带的土耳其军防线——他们展现了难以想象的英勇，却在15分钟内几乎全军覆没。没有一个士兵抵达土耳其军战壕。

src: The Australian and New Zealand Army Corp!!!
dst: 澳大利亚和新西兰军团！！！

src: The Australian assault on Lone Pine succeeded due to careful and imaginative planning. The two columns advancing on Chunuk Bair came very close to succeeding in their missions, but were eventually thrown off Chunuk Bair by a near suicidal bayonet charge led by Kemal. The landings at Suvla were conducted successfully, but the British forces were slow to exploit this and after they had finally started moving, could not dislodge the Turkish forces defending the Suvla Plain. The great gamble had failed.
dst: 由于精心而富有想象力的筹划，澳大利亚军对独松的进攻取得了成功。向楚努克拜尔推进的两支纵队差一点就完成了任务，但最终还是被凯末尔率领的一次近乎自杀式的刺刀冲锋赶下了楚努克拜尔。苏夫拉的登陆进行得很成功，但英军未能及时利用这一有利形势，等他们终于开始行动时，已无法逐出防守苏夫拉平原的土耳其军队。这场豪赌失败了。

src: The Australian supply lines have been cut, and now our brave men in the North of the island will have a much more easier job against the enemy. We have suffered some losses due to the jungle diseases. I hope you haven't got malaria or something like that...
dst: 澳大利亚人的补给线已被切断，如今我们岛北的英勇将士对敌作战将会轻松得多。我们因丛林疾病遭受了一些损失。希望您没有染上疟疾之类的东西……

src: The Austrian 2nd Army (von Bohm-Ermolli) resolved to envelop the Russian 8th Army from the south, hoping to break through at Gnila Lipa with two corps (XVIII and XIX) and to link up with the bulk of the army (IV, V) at Tarnopol.  Overstrengthening Trollmann's XIX corps with massive artillery, the Austrians maneuvered to outflank Brusilov.
dst: 奥地利第2集团军（冯·伯姆—埃尔莫利）决意从南面合围俄国第8集团军，企图以两个军（第18和第19军）在格尼拉利帕突破，并与集团军主力（第4、第5军）在塔尔诺波尔会合。奥地利人以大量炮兵过度加强特罗尔曼的第19军，机动以包抄布鲁西洛夫。

src: The Austrian and German forces enjoyed a serious advantage in manpower:  mustering 357,400 men for the overall offensive (with 126,000 in the immediate viscinity of Gorlice and Tarnow), our 3rd Army could counter with 219,000 men (with 60,000 in the immediate viscinity of the towns).  Achieving a breakthrough of 16 km wide and 4 deep within three days of the attack, Falkenhayn had achieved the first breakthrough of a static front in WWI.  The German OHL had envisioned this breakthrough to be the opening to the Cannae pincer maneuver on a grand scale against our 3rd (Lesch), 4th (Evert), and the newly-formed 13th (Gorbatovsky) Armies deployed in Poland.
dst: 奥匈与德军在兵力上占有明显优势：为此次总攻集结了357400人（其中126000人就在戈利采和塔尔努夫附近），而我第3集团军只能以219000人应对（其中60000人在城镇附近）。法尔肯海因在进攻开始三天内实现了宽16公里、纵深4公里的突破，成为一战中静态战线上的第一次突破。德军最高统帅部设想这次突破将开启一场规模宏大的坎尼式钳形攻势，矛头直指部署在波兰的我第3（莱施）、第4（埃韦尔特）以及新组建的第13（戈尔巴托夫斯基）集团军。

src: The Austrian and German forces of the 11th Army have begun approaching Przemysl in three columns:  the Kneutzl Corps from the north-west, combined cavalry and infantry reserves from the west, and the Austrian X Corps in the south-west.  You must hold the fortress for as along as the South-Western Front command requires it.  You will be given clear orders to evacuate the battle field.
dst: 第11集团军的奥德部队已分三路逼近普热梅希尔：克诺伊茨尔军从西北，混成骑步兵预备队从西面，奥地利第10军从西南。您必须按西南方面军指挥部的要求，尽可能长久地守住要塞。您将得到明确的撤离战场命令。

src: The Austrian strategy for defeating Prussia consisted in an invasion of Silesia. With that goal in mind, Austrian and Saxonian troops started to concentrate in Bohemia, which had belonged to the Austrian Empire for centuries.
dst: 奥地利击败普鲁士的战略是入侵西里西亚。怀着这一目标，奥地利和萨克森军队开始在波希米亚集结，该地区数百年来一直属于奥地利帝国。

src: The Austrians, cut off from their neighbors with only a line of communication to the rear attempted to concentrate their forces against one flank and then the other to little effect.  With exposed flanks, outnumbered, and severely outgunned, the army wilted away in the carnage.
dst: 奥军与友邻被切断，只剩一条通往后方的交通线，他们试图把兵力先集中对付一个侧翼，再对付另一个，却收效甚微。由于侧翼暴露、人数劣势、火力严重不足，这支军队在屠戮中土崩瓦解。

src: The Austrians, on the other side, are desperately trying to break through toward Przemysl.  With over 150,000 troops still fighting inside the fortress, the 2nd, 3rd, and 4th Armies continue to mount ferocious attacks.  In command of our XII Corps (Lesh), you will face the Austrian III.Korps (von Geldern), which had retreated from Przemysl into the mountains during the fall of 1914.  Lesh's troops are already veterans of Carpathian fighting -- having briefly taken Dukla in November of 1914.  The Austrian Limanowa offensive, however, had forced his corps to leave Dukla and assist the bulk of the 8th Army to the north.
dst: 另一方面，奥地利人正拼命试图向普热梅希尔突破。要塞内仍有15万余人继续作战，第2、第3和第4集团军持续发起猛烈攻击。您统率第12军（莱什），将面对奥地利第3军（冯·格尔德恩），该军在1914年秋从普热梅希尔退入山区。莱什的部队已是喀尔巴阡作战的老兵——曾于1914年11月短暂攻占杜克拉。然而，奥地利的利马诺瓦攻势迫使他这个军离开杜克拉，北上支援第8集团军主力。

src: The Axis corps has been decimated by counterattacks as it reached the gates of Moscow.
dst: 轴心国军在抵达莫斯科城下时，已被反攻打得损失惨重。

src: The Axis counterattack pushed us way back. Time to dig in and wait for reinforcements.
dst: 轴心国的反攻把我军击退了很远。是时候就地固守，等待增援了。

src: The Axis forces under our General have been stopped cold.
dst: 我们将军麾下的轴心国部队被死死挡住了。

src: The Axis have started pouring troops and equipment into Vichy French owned Tunesia after the French allowed them to move in Luftwaffe and Wehrmacht units. Italian units were put under German command to not provoke the French. French generals on the ground passively resisted the Axis arrival and advance. But now things have changed. Three days ago, we have reached an agreement with the French for an immediate collaboration with Allied forces. That means all our troops can move East to Tunisia without having to worry about occupying Morocco and Algeria.
dst: 在法国准许德国空军与陆军部队进驻后，轴心国开始向维希法国所属的突尼斯源源投入兵员与装备。意军部队被置于德军指挥之下，以免刺激法国。当地法军将领对轴心国的到来与推进采取消极抵抗。但如今形势已变。三天前，我们与法军达成立即与盟军合作的协议。这意味着我军全部部队可东进突尼斯，无需再担心占领摩洛哥与阿尔及利亚。

src: The Axis losses totalled 56 Italian soldiers killed and another 116 wounded, and 11,621 Italians and 78 Germans taken prisoner. The sole British casualty was a man bitten by a mule.
dst: 轴心国方面总计损失：意大利士兵56人阵亡、116人负伤，11621名意大利人和78名德国人被俘。英军唯一的伤亡是一名被骡子咬伤的人员。

src: The Axis never found themselves in a position to assault Malta.
dst: 轴心国从未具备进攻马耳他的条件。

src: The BEF and some troops of the French 1st army have created a defensive perimeter around Dunkerque to ensure the evacuation of the greatest number of troops. Our 14 DI, which has been in Yser for some days to cover the rear of the army in case of a German advance from the west, has begun to build bridges to allow you to retreat.
dst: 英国远征军和法国第1集团军的部分部队已在敦刻尔克周围建立防御圈，以确保尽可能多的部队撤离。我们的第14步兵师已在伊瑟河一带驻守数日，以便在德军自西面推进时掩护军队后方，现在它已开始架桥，供你撤退。

src: The BEF's II Corps has taken position behind the Mons-Conde Canal in a terrain filled with ditches, half destroyed buildings, poor roads and high slag heaps that make it difficult to maneuver.
dst: 英国远征军第2军已在蒙斯-孔代运河后方占据阵地，这里地形遍布沟渠、半毁的房屋、破败的道路和高耸的矿渣堆，难以机动。

src: The BEF's L Battery won 3 VCs that morning but had to be sent back to England for rebuilding.
dst: 英国远征军的L炮兵连那天上午赢得了3枚维多利亚十字勋章，但不得不被送回英格兰进行重建。

src: The Battle of Britain took place between 10 July and 21 October 1940. It included large-scale air battles, actions against coastal-shipping and ports, bombing operations, both tactical and terror bombing. The german Luftwaffe, later asissted by Corpo Aereo Italiano tried to gain air superiority and to destroy the whole Royal Air Force. Once the Luftwaffe would have won air superiority, a invasion of the UK would follow - Operation Sealion. However, Luftwaffe failed to gain air superiority and lost nearly 2000 planes. Pilots from many countries served in the RAF or units under RAF command in the Battle of Britain. There were pilots from New Zealand, Canada, Czechoslovakia, Ireland, Australia, Belgium, South Africa, France, America, South Rhodesia and one each from Jamaica and Mandatory Palestine. The largest contingent of foreign pilotes came from Poland (145). While only 5% of all pilots who took part in the Battle of Britain for the RAF where polish, they claimed 13% of shot down german aircrafts.
dst: 不列颠之战发生于1940年7月10日至10月21日。它包括大规模空战、对近海航运和港口的行动、轰炸行动——既有战术轰炸也有恐怖轰炸。德国空军后来得到意大利空军军团的协助，试图夺取制空权并摧毁整个皇家空军。一旦德国空军赢得制空权，入侵英国就将随之而来——即海狮行动。然而，德国空军未能夺取制空权，损失了近2000架飞机。不列颠之战中，许多国家的飞行员在皇家空军或皇家空军指挥下的部队服役：来自新西兰、加拿大、捷克斯洛伐克、爱尔兰、澳大利亚、比利时、南非、法国、美国、南罗得西亚，以及各一名来自牙买加和委任统治巴勒斯坦的飞行员。外国飞行员中最大的群体来自波兰（145人）。虽然在不列颠之战中为皇家空军作战的波兰飞行员只占全部飞行员的5%，他们却声称击落了13%的德国飞机。

src: The Battle of Bullecourt has begun and your Anzacs have the task of capturing a length of the Hindenburg Line around the village of Biache St Vassst.
dst: 比勒库尔战役已经打响，您的澳新军团的任务是夺取比亚什圣瓦斯特村周围的一段兴登堡防线。
耶路撒冷战役 - 失败

dst: 耶路撒冷战役 - 大捷

src: The Battle of Mallorca took place in August 1936, but for technical reasons (to avoid early upgrades after just one scenario) it will now take place in August 1938.
dst: 马略卡岛战役发生于1936年8月，但出于技术原因（避免仅一场场景后就进行早期升级），现在它发生于1938年8月。

src: The Battle of Mokra took place on September 1, 1939 near the village of Mokra, 5 km north from Klobuck, 23 km north-west from Czestochowa, Poland. It was one of the first battles of the Invasion of Poland, of the Second World War and one of the few Polish victories of that campaign.
dst: 莫克拉之战发生于1939年9月1日，地点在莫克拉村附近，位于克沃布茨克以北5公里、波兰琴斯托霍瓦西北23公里处。这是波兰入侵（第二次世界大战）最初的战斗之一，也是那场战役中波兰人少有的胜利之一。

src: The Battle of Petrikowka took place between 27 and 30 September 1941. Fought between Italian and Soviet forces, it was the first significant engagement involving the Italian Expeditionary Corps in Russia.
dst: 彼得里科夫卡战役发生于1941年9月27日至30日之间。该战役在意大利军队与苏联军队之间进行，是意大利远征军团在俄国参与的首次重大交战。

src: The Battle of Petrikowka took place between 27 and 30 September 1941. Fought between Italian and Soviet forces, it was the first significant engagement involving the Italian Expeditionary Corps in Russia. About 10,000 Soviet prisoners were captured, along with a large amount of weapons and horses.
dst: 彼得里科夫卡战役发生于1941年9月27日至30日之间。这场意大利与苏联军队之间的战斗，是意大利远征军在俄国参与的第一次重大交战。约1万名苏军被俘，还有大量武器和马匹被缴获。

src: The Battle of Pharsalus was a decisive battle of Caesar's Civil War. On 9 August 48 BC at Pharsalus in central Greece, Gaius Julius Caesar and his allies formed up opposite the army of the republic under the command of Gnaeus Pompeius Magnus ("Pompey the Great"). Pompey had the backing of a majority of senators, of whom many were optimates, and his army significantly outnumbered the veteran Caesarian legions.
dst: 法萨卢斯之战是凯撒内战中的决定性一役。公元前48年8月9日，在希腊中部的法萨卢斯，盖乌斯尤利乌斯凯撒及其盟友列阵，对阵由格奈乌斯庞培马格努斯（「庞培大帝」）统率的共和国军队。庞培得到大多数元老的支持，其中许多是贵人派；他的军队在人数上明显超过凯撒那些身经百战的军团。
圣玛格丽特-豪特姆之战
圣玛赫里特-豪特姆战役
