src: The Battle of Stalingrad. The German and Romanian forces close in on the city while the Soviets launch counterattacks. The 16. Panzer-Division was the first German unit to reach the shores of the Volga river north of Stalingrad.
dst: 斯大林格勒战役。德军和罗马尼亚部队向该城逼近，而苏军发动反击。第16装甲师是第一支抵达斯大林格勒以北伏尔加河岸的德军部队。

src: The Battle of Voronezh started on June 28, 1942. The Axis assault was conducted by the element of the German 4th Panzer Army and the Hungarian 2nd Army. By July 3 the German 24th Panzer Division broke the defense line between the Soviet 13th and 40th Armies. On July 4, mechanized division Großdeutschland came to the Western side of the Don and created springboards south-west from Voronezh. The armored units of the 4th Panzer Army partly captured Voronezh on July 6 by occupying the Western river-bank suburbs; however, German troops were subjected to a Red Army counter-attack.
dst: 沃罗涅日之战于1942年6月28日爆发。轴心国的进攻由德国第4装甲集团军和匈牙利第2集团军的各部队实施。至7月3日，德国第24装甲师突破了苏军第13集团军与第40集团军之间的防线。7月4日，「大德意志」摩托化师进抵顿河西岸，并在沃罗涅日西南方向建立了前进基地。第4装甲集团军的装甲部队于7月6日占领西岸郊区，从而部分夺取了沃罗涅日；然而德军随即遭到红军的反击。

src: The Battle of Washington demonstrated very well that our supply lines are very unsafe at the moment. You will have to remedy that situation. Advance south as quickly as you can and take Norfolk. With one of the largest American naval bases in our hands it should not be too much of a problem to supply our invasion of America.
dst: 华盛顿之战充分表明，眼下我们的补给线极不安全。你必须扭转这一局面。尽快向南推进，夺取诺福克。一旦美国最大的海军基地之一落入我手，为入侵美国的部队补给便不成大问题了。

src: The Belgian Army has taken positions on the Terneuzen canal, Gent/Gand bridgehead and the Escaut/Scheldt River. Most of our divisions are under strength and have already lost 1/3 of their material after ten days of continuous fight and several retreats. Some units are close to collapse but the Army in general can still fight.
dst: 比利时军队已在泰尔讷曾运河、根特桥头堡和斯海尔德河上占领阵地。经过十天连续作战和数次撤退，我们大多数师都不满编，且已损失三分之一的装备。有些部队濒临崩溃，但全军总体上仍能战斗。

src: The Belgian Army succeeded in severing communications with our army at the Marne and drew substantial forces away from that army. Our advance on Paris has failed. The Allies won the battle of the Marne and our army had to retreat to the Aisne.
dst: 比利时陆军成功切断了我们马恩河部队的交通线，并从这支部队抽走了大量兵力。我们对巴黎的推进已告失败。协约国赢得了马恩河之战，我方部队不得不退至埃纳河。

src: The Belgian King has contacted us to discuss terms of surrender. Because of your slow advance, the French 7th Army has escaped South before it could be surrounded. Prepare to get orders to move to a different sector of the front.
dst: 比利时国王已与我们联系，商讨投降条款。由于你推进迟缓，法国第7集团军在尚未被包围前就南逃了。准备接受命令，开往战线的另一地段。

src: The Belgian King has contacted us to discuss terms of surrender. The French 7th Army has been surrounded and will give up soon. We are getting in orders to move to a different sector of the front.
dst: 比利时国王已与我们联系，商讨投降条款。法国第7集团军已被包围，很快会放弃。我们正接到命令，要开往战线的另一地段。

src: The Belgian attack on Impde was a faint. Luckily your reinforcements were able to push back the main attack East of the canal.
dst: 比利时人对因普德的进攻只是一次佯攻。幸运的是，您的援军得以击退运河以东的主攻。

src: The Belgian unconditional surrender came into effect at 04:00 on 28 May. Recriminations abounded with the British and French claiming the Belgians had betrayed the alliance. The reality was that since 25 May the Allies were aware of the critical Belgian situation. In spite of that, the Belgians extended their resistance for almost three days, frequently holding after British unexpected withdrawals, allowing the Allied armies to prepare their evacuation. On the contrary, when it was inquired if any Belgians were to be evacuated, the Chief of General Staff for the British Expeditionary Force replied "We don't care a bugger what happens to the Belgians".
dst: 比利时的无条件投降于5月28日04:00生效。英国和法国指责比利时背叛了联盟，怨言四起。事实是，自5月25日起盟国就已知道比利时的危急处境。尽管如此，比利时人仍把抵抗延长了近三天，常常在英军意外撤退后继续坚守，使盟军得以准备撤离。相反，当有人询问是否要撤出比利时人时，英国远征军总参谋长回答说“我们才不在乎比利时人怎么样”。

src: The Belgians have been defeated. It is only a matter of time and all Europe will be ours!
dst: 比利时人已被击败。整个欧洲归我所有只是时间问题！

src: The Berlin field hospital works as a supply and healer unit and restores ammo as well as 4 SP/turn.
dst: 柏林野战医院可作为补给与治疗单位运作，每回合恢复弹药以及 4 SP。

src: The Boer fought brilliantly a tough defensive battle. We suffered many losses, and we finally had to regroup at our initial positions on the Modder River. That very same week the Boer defeated other British forces at Stormberg and Colenso. After nearly three months of war our Army had been unable to make any significant progress.
dst: 布尔人打了一场出色的艰苦防御战。我们损失惨重，最终不得不在莫德河上我们最初的阵地重新集结。就在同一周，布尔人又在斯托姆贝格和科伦索击败了其他英军。开战近三个月后，我们的军队仍未能取得任何重大进展。

src: The Bolshevik advance was too fast for us to intervene. Knowing that the city was lost, we decided to organize the evacuation of Ekaterinburg. While we kept the railroads open, we would have to defend the positions that we didn't have lost yet.
dst: 布尔什维克的推进太快，我们来不及干预。知道该城已守不住，我们决定组织叶卡捷琳堡的疏散。在保持铁路畅通的同时，我们必须守住尚未丢失的阵地。

src: The Bolshevik revolution has ended, but most of their leaders, including Lenin, managed to flee to Finland. From the exile they'll still be a powerful threat.
dst: 布尔什维克革命已经结束，但他们的大多数领袖，包括列宁，都设法逃往了芬兰。在流亡中，他们仍将是一股强大的威胁。

src: The Bolshevik revolution has ended. They've been completely defeated and most of their leaders, including Lenin and Trotsky, have died or have been taken prisoners. Only Stalin and a handful of others have managed to flee to Finland, but they're too weak to be a problem anymore.
dst: 布尔什维克革命已经结束。他们已被彻底击败，包括列宁和托洛茨基在内的大多数领袖或已身亡，或已成俘虏。只有斯大林和少数几个人设法逃往芬兰，但他们已过于虚弱，再也构不成威胁。

src: The Bolshevik rule in Russia had resulted in a armistice with the Central Powers signed on 17 December 1917. At the moment peace talks are taking place in Brest-Litovsk. To force the Bolsheviks to sign, the Central Powers have resumed their offensive actions and because of the complete dissarray of the Russian Army, they are pushing deep into the Ukraine. At the time, the Czech Legion was retreating east to avoid capture by the German Army. The Czech Legion was now an independant force, obeying only to their own commander as nobody else could be trusted.
dst: 布尔什维克在俄国的统治导致与同盟国于1917年12月17日签订了停战协定。目前，和平谈判正在布列斯特-立托夫斯克进行。为了迫使布尔什维克签约，同盟国恢复了进攻行动，而由于俄军完全陷入混乱，他们正深入乌克兰腹地。当时，捷克军团正向东撤退，以免被德军俘获。捷克军团现在是一支独立的力量，只服从自己的指挥官，因为其他任何人都不可信任。

src: The Bolsheviks and their anarchist henchmen are detemined to throw us out of Crimea. It took them some months to find courage, but now it seems that the moment of truth has come.
dst: 布尔什维克和他们那些无政府主义帮凶铁了心要把我们赶出克里米亚。他们花了几个月才鼓起勇气，但如今决战的时刻似乎已经到来。

src: The Bolsheviks defended themselves like true heroes, not hesitating to sacrifice their lives if they could delay us for a few hours. They did that again and again, so when we finally reached the Tobol it was too late. The surviving communists had already crossed the river, had built strong defensive positions, and they simply had to wait until their reinforcements came. We had touched victory with the tips of our fingers, but we had let it go. Now it was all over.
dst: 布尔什维克像真正的英雄一样自卫，只要能拖延我们几个小时，他们不惜牺牲自己的生命。他们一次又一次地这样做，所以当我们终于抵达托博尔河时，已经太迟了。幸存的共产党人早已渡过河，构筑了坚固的防御阵地，只须等待增援到来。我们的指尖曾触到胜利，却让它溜走了。如今一切都完了。

src: The Bolsheviks had decided to make a last stand near Moscow, hoping to delay our advance. That way, they would gain enough time to finish a strong defensive line in Petrograd.
dst: 布尔什维克决定在莫斯科附近作最后一搏，指望拖延我们的推进。这样，他们就能赢得足够的时间，在彼得格勒构筑一条坚固的防线。

src: The Bolsheviks have been routed and are fleeing in panic. In a few days Kursk will be ours.
dst: 布尔什维克已被击溃，正在惊恐地逃窜。几天之内库尔斯克就将归我们所有。

src: The Bolsheviks have taken advantage from all of this, and in these past months they've driven us out from most of Ukraine, the Don region, and the Kuban. Even Ekaterinodar fell some days ago. At least thay've been forced to pay a very heavy price, with tens of thousands of dead and wounded.
dst: 布尔什维克充分利用了这一切，过去几个月里，他们已把我们赶出了乌克兰大部分地区、顿河地区和库班。连叶卡捷琳诺达尔也在几天前陷落了。至少他们被迫付出了极为惨重的代价，死伤数万人。

src: The Bolsheviks opposed a fierce resistance against our attacks. And here is where my story ends. During one of the assaults, I was badly wounded by an enemy grenade. The doctors could save my life, but I lost my left eye and part of my left leg. When I could leave the hospital, the war had already ended. The revolution was over and Russia had a new, bright future. But many people, including myself, had paid a terrible price for it.
dst: 布尔什维克对我们的进攻进行了顽强抵抗。而我的故事就在这里结束。在一次进攻中，我被敌人的手榴弹炸成重伤。医生保住了我的命，但我失去了左眼和部分左腿。等我能够出院时，战争已经结束。革命结束了，俄国有了一个崭新而光明的未来。但包括我在内的许多人，为此付出了可怕的代价。

src: The Bolsheviks were unstoppable. After just five days of fighting, we had to leave Belebei, retreat to Ufa and build a new line of defence there.
dst: 布尔什维克势不可挡。仅仅五天的战斗之后，我们不得不撤离别列别伊，退到乌法，并在那里构筑新的防线。

src: The Bolsheviks were unstoppable. After some days of fighting we had to leave Bugulma, retreat to Ufa and build a new line of defence there.
dst: 布尔什维克势不可挡。经过几天的战斗，我们不得不撤离布古利马，退到乌法，并在那里构筑新的防线。

src: The Bolsheviks, after their defeat, didn't dare to go after us. We could embark calmly in Sevastopol and here we are now, sailing the Black Sea on our way to the exile. Only a handful of our former soldiers decided to stay and try their luck living in a Red Russia.
dst: 布尔什维克战败之后，不敢再追击我们。我们得以在塞瓦斯托波尔从容登船，如今正航行在黑海上，前往流亡之地。只有少数我们昔日的士兵决定留下，在一个红色的俄国碰碰运气。
布恩维尔赛跑 * 大捷
布恩维尔赛跑 * 失败
布恩维尔赛跑 * 战术胜利
布恩维尔赛跑 * 小捷

src: The Borodino scenario and the map on which it is played are created by Hannes Gruber. Slight modifications were made: deployment hexes, a Russian armored train was added, the Russian air units were renamed, some owned hexes flags removed and some units were changed to make maximum use of the new e-file.
dst: 博罗季诺场景及其所用地图由 Hannes Gruber 制作。作了轻微修改：部署格、增列一列俄军装甲列车、更改俄军空中单位名称、移除一些己方所有格的旗帜，并改动一些单位以充分利用新的 efile。

src: The Brazilian Expeditionary Force fought in Italy from September 1944 to May 1945. The BEF fought at the Gothic Line and in the 1945 final offensive in northern Italy. Brazil was the only South American country to send ground troops to fight overseas. It depolyed none of its tanks, which stayed at the home front, but 48 pilots, equiped with P-47D Thunderbolts flew combat missions in Italy. Overall, more than 25.000 brazilian soldiers fought in Italy, while the navy and air force took part in the Battle of the Atlantic from 1942 onwards.
dst: 巴西远征军自1944年9月至1945年5月在意大利作战。巴西远征军参加了哥特防线战斗以及1945年意大利北部的最后攻势。巴西是唯一一个派遣地面部队到海外作战的南美国家。它没有部署任何坦克——这些坦克都留在了国内后方，但48名飞行员驾驶 P-47D 雷电战斗机在意大利执行了战斗任务。总体而言，超过25,000名巴西士兵在意大利作战，而海军和空军则从1942年起参加了大西洋海战。

src: The Bristish gained about 1km over a 2km front at the expense of 11,652 killed. German casualties were 8,600. Mainly because of Falkenhayn's insistence that all terrain lost had to be regained.
dst: 英军在2公里长的战线上推进了约1公里，代价是11652人阵亡。德军伤亡8600人。这主要是因为法尔肯海因坚持认为所有丢失的地盘都必须夺回。

src: The British 1st Division has ceased to exist as an able fighting force. Cecil Rhodes will have to wait in Kimberley a little longer before some gallant English knight goes to his rescue, ha, ha. And I'm glad to inform you that near Ladysmith General Botha has beaten a large British force, too. This has been an excellent week!
dst: 英国第1师已不再是一支有战斗力的部队。塞西尔·罗兹还得在金伯利多等上一阵子，才会有哪位英勇的英国骑士来救他，哈哈。而且我很高兴地告诉您，在莱迪史密斯附近，博塔将军也击败了一支庞大的英军。这真是出色的一周！

src: The British 8th army has finally taken the ridge overlooking the Sangro river valley. Now we  move. You will be supported by the 2nd New Zealander division arriving shortly from the south. Your mission is to capture Orsonga, San Leonardo, Casa Berardi, and ultimately Ortona. Good luck General...
dst: 英国第8集团军终于攻占了俯瞰桑格罗河谷的山脊。现在我们行动。新西兰第2师即将从南面赶来支援你。你的任务是夺取 Orsonga、圣莱昂纳多、贝拉尔迪农舍，并最终拿下奥尔托纳。祝你好运，将军……

src: The British Army completed the capture of the Sinai in February. In March they moved into Palestine and attempted to take Gaza but failed.
dst: 英军于2月完成了对西奈的占领。3月，他们进入巴勒斯坦并试图攻占加沙，但未成功。

src: The British Battleship HMS Howe Passing Through the Suez Canal, 14 July 1944
dst: 英国战列舰 HMS Howe 号通过苏伊士运河，1944年7月14日

src: The British Expeditionary Corps in France has been severely mauled and the French have suffered a tremendous defeat! Their morale is waning on the entire front, we should be able to win now!
dst: 驻法国的英国远征军已遭重创，法军也遭惨败！他们全线士气低落，我们现在应当能取胜了！

src: The British Expeditionary Force (BEF) is retreating South after the battle of Mons and Gen. Smith-Dorrien's II Corps gets separated from Gen. Haig's I Corps. When the exhausted II Corps is about to be overtaken by the German First Army, Smith-Dorrien decides to make a stand at Le Cateau. The German First Army is dispersed and only II Kavalerie Korps and IV Infantry Korps are in contact with II Corps of the BEF in the early morning of the 26th of August 1914.
dst: 蒙斯之战后，英国远征军（BEF）正向南撤退，史密斯-多里安将军的第2军与黑格将军的第1军分开了。当筋疲力尽的第2军即将被德国第1集团军追上时，史密斯-多里安决定在勒卡托决一死战。德国第1集团军兵力分散，1914年8月26日清晨，只有第2骑兵军和第4步兵军与英国远征军第2军接敌。

src: The British Expeditionary Force has been evacuated from the mainland at Dunkirk. The best divisions of the French Army have surrendered or are in disarray and on the run. Our Panzers are in pursuit heading South. Your forces are ordered to take part in mopping up the Maginot line - a complex of fortifications along the German-French border. You will attack the fortresses from the rear while 2 infantry divisions of the 7th Armee / Armee Gruppe C get the difficult task of attacking the fortresses head-on. Orders are to capture the command posts of the 2 big fortresses in the area. Das Oberkommando has asked you to prevent French troops from fleeing into Switzerland.
dst: 英国远征军已从大陆经敦刻尔克撤走。法军最精锐的几个师或已投降，或已溃乱奔逃。我们的装甲部队正向南追击。你部奉命参与扫荡马其诺防线——这是德法边境沿线的一整套要塞群。你将从后方攻击这些要塞，而第7集团军/C集团军群的2个步兵师则承担从正面强攻的艰巨任务。命令是夺取该地区两座大要塞的指挥部。最高统帅部要求你阻止法军逃入瑞士。

src: The British Expeditionary Force has been evacuated from the mainland at Dunkirk. The best divisions of the French Army have surrendered or are in disarray and on the run. Our Panzers are in pursuit heading South. Your forces are ordered to take part in mopping up the Maginot line - a complex of fortifications along the German-French border. You will attack the fortresses from the rear while 2 infantry divisions of the 7th Armee / Armee Gruppe C get the difficult task of attacking the fortresses head-on. Orders are to capture the command posts of the 2 big fortresses in the area. Das Oberkommando has asked you to prevent French troops from fleeing into Switzerland. Brandenburg Kommandos are on site to recon the area.
dst: 英国远征军已从敦刻尔克撤离大陆。法军最精锐的各师或已投降，或溃不成军、四处奔逃。我们的装甲部队正向南追击。你的部队奉命参加清剿马奇诺防线——德法边境上的一片筑垒体系。你将从后方攻击这些要塞，而第7集团军／C集团军群的两个步兵师则承担正面强攻要塞的艰巨任务。命令是夺取该地区两座大型要塞的指挥所。最高统帅部要求你阻止法军逃入瑞士。勃兰登堡突击队已到场侦察该地区。

src: The British MSUs have three escape routes: Jacobsdal, the Riet River and the road to Modder River Station.
dst: 英军主力单位有三条退路：雅各布斯达尔、里特河以及通往莫德河站的道路。

src: The British Matildas took a toll on attacking 15th Pz tanks, but their squadron commanders where heard crying on the radio: 'They are tearing my tanks apart' when they met the German 88's.
dst: 英军的“玛蒂尔达”坦克让进攻中的第15装甲师坦克损失不小，但当他们遇上德军的88炮时，其中队指挥官在无线电里哭喊：“他们正把我的坦克撕成碎片。”

src: The British Operation is a complete success. Gott has taken posession of Halfaya and Fort Capuzzo. The British forces are in an excellent starting position for an offensive towards Tobruk. Rommel has decided to retreat to Gazala.
dst: 英军这次行动完全成功。戈特已占据哈勒法亚和卡普佐堡。英军处于向托布鲁克进攻的绝佳出发阵地。隆美尔决定退往加扎拉。

src: The British Operation looked initially succesful, but the counterattack of our Panzer Regiments forced Gott to retreat to Halfaya. Gott seemed to have orders to hold Halfaya as a good starting point for the upcoming offensive, but abandoned the pass when our forces threathened to surround him.
dst: 英军这次行动起初看似成功，但我方装甲团的反击迫使戈特退往哈勒法亚。戈特似乎奉命守住哈勒法亚，作为即将到来的攻势的良好出发阵地，但当我军威胁要包围他时，他放弃了这处山口。

src: The British X.Corps will occupy the northern landing ground near Salerno and you, Sir, will take command about the forces that will head for the southern landing ground between Paestrum and the airfield near Battipaglia.
dst: 英国第10军将占领萨莱诺附近的北部登陆场，而长官您将指挥开往帕埃斯图姆与巴蒂帕利亚附近机场之间南部登陆场的部队。

src: The British advance into the mainland has been temporarily halted. Now the Germans have an open escape route to move south.
dst: 英军向内陆的推进已暂时停止。现在德军拥有一条畅通的南下退路。

src: The British and their colonial troops are completely disorganized following our victories all over Asia.  Intelligence sources have confirmed that they have belatedly started to reinforce Rangoon.  At this stage most of their formations are well below strength and lacking in support arms.
dst: 随着我们在亚洲各地取得胜利，英国及其殖民部队已完全陷入混乱。情报来源证实，他们迟迟才开始增援仰光。在这一阶段，他们的大多数编制兵力严重不足，并且缺乏支援武器。

src: The British are holding on to Tobruk and thus have only six third-rate ports left through which supplies can run. Because of its railway, El Alamein is one of the most important supply points. You have orders to capture it without delay.
dst: 英军死守托布鲁克，因此他们只剩下六个三流港口可供补给流通。阿拉曼因有铁路，是最重要的补给点之一。你奉命立即将其夺取。

src: The British are retreating to safer positions west of Jacobsdal, where they could regroup and wait for reinforcements. We can't afford to give them a single day of rest. If we don't go after them and defeat them completely, they will eventualy come back, even stronger than before.  You must stop them before they reach the railroad.
dst: 英军正撤往雅各布斯达尔以西更安全的阵地，在那里他们可以重新集结并等待增援。我们连一天的喘息时间都不能给他们。如果我们不追上去把他们彻底击败，他们终将卷土重来，而且比以前更强大。您必须在他们到达铁路之前拦住他们。

src: The British are running!  Your bold attack chased them all the way to Tobruk!
dst: 英军在逃窜！你果敢的进攻把他们一路追到了托布鲁克！

src: The British are too strong for us. We'll have to retreat and live to fight another day.
dst: 英军对我们来说太强大了。我们只得撤退，以待来日再战。

src: The British are truly mad. They have lost their armies in all parts of the world - even Asia where the Japanese have them on the run - but in London they say they will continue... like fanatics! It's not our problem really, they no longer have a chance to win. Here's what Rommel has to say about it! [Rommel speaking]
dst: 英国人真是疯了。他们在世界各地都丢掉了军队——甚至在被日军追着打的亚洲也是如此——但在伦敦，他们还说要坚持下去……就像狂热分子！这其实不关我们的事，他们已毫无胜算。听听隆美尔对此怎么说！[隆美尔讲话]

src: The British are withdrawing!  Your attack finally forced them back to Tobruk!
dst: 英军在撤退！你的进攻终于把他们逼回了托布鲁克！

src: The British are withdrawing!  Your bold attack forced them back to Tobruk!
dst: 英军在撤退！你果敢的进攻把他们逼回了托布鲁克！

src: The British attack was a complete success. This leaves us no option but to retreat West. We'll make a stand at Gazala.
dst: 英军的进攻完全成功。这让我们别无选择，只能向西撤退。我们将在加扎拉据守。

src: The British brigade has been destroyed. There are still lots of enemies in our country, but these ones will never hurt our families again.
dst: 那个英军旅已被歼灭。我们的国家里仍有大量敌人，但这一支再也无法伤害我们的家人了。

src: The British command decided to destroy the German wireless station at the town of Bukoba. The raid was launched as an amphibious assault since Bukoba was located on the shore of Lake Victoria.
dst: 英军指挥部决定摧毁布科巴镇的德军无线电台。由于布科巴位于维多利亚湖湖畔，这次突袭以两栖突击的方式进行。

src: The British couldn't enjoy their victory for a long time. While they were occupying our country, the Germans were launching their final offensives in the Balkans and in Italy. The Italians surrendered in July, and Salonika fell soon afterwards.
dst: 英国人的胜利没能享受多久。就在他们占领我们国家之际，德国人正在巴尔干和意大利发动最后的攻势。意大利于七月投降，塞萨洛尼基也很快陷落。

src: The British defences were stronger than we had thought, but at least they haven't followed us during our retreat. Now we must move quickly to our next destination.
dst: 英军的防御比我们预想的更强，但至少他们在我们撤退时没有追击。现在我们必须迅速赶赴下一个目的地。

src: The British defences were too strong for you and your men. I guess that we underestimated the Kakies. Fortunately we could send fresh troops from the North in time, and after relieving you they could finally overcome our enemies, who were already quite weakened. Those were our last reserves, so the next time you can't expect a rescue.
dst: 英军的防御对您和您的部下来说太坚固了。我猜是我们低估了英国佬。幸运的是我们能及时从北方派出生力军，他们在替换您之后，终于战胜了那些已经相当疲弱的敌人。那是我们最后的预备队，所以下次您就别指望有人来救了。

src: The British flanking attack was unexpected!
dst: 英军的侧翼进攻出人意料！

src: The British forces are retreating towards the port of Dunkirk. The Luftwaffe can take further care of destroying the encircled troops.
dst: 英军正朝敦刻尔克港撤退。德国空军可以继续负责歼灭被围之敌。

src: The British have been taken by strategic surprise by Hungary and Romania's declaration to the Axis!  We have an opportunity to strike them here with a bold attack and chase them all the way to Tobruk.... then Egypt!
dst: 匈牙利和罗马尼亚宣布加入轴心国，让英军遭受了战略性的突袭！我们有机会在此以果敢的进攻打击他们，并一路追到托布鲁克……然后到埃及！

src: The British have lost the initiative and we must make sure that things won't change. Between the Modder River and Kaapstad there are only a handful of Rooineks, and we must take advantage of that. Your next destination will be Port Elizabeth. They won't expect us there.
dst: 英军已失去主动权，我们必须确保局面不会改变。在莫德河与开普敦之间只有寥寥几个英国佬，我们必须利用这一点。您的下一站将是伊丽莎白港。他们不会料到我们会出现在那里。

src: The British have spent almost two weeks recovering from the losses they suffered while crossing the Modder River. They have received reinforcements, too: a Scottish brigade, more artillery, and some extra cavalry.
dst: 英军花了将近两周时间，才从渡莫德河时遭受的损失中恢复过来。他们还得到了增援：一个苏格兰旅、更多的炮兵以及一些额外的骑兵。

src: The British have suffered heavy losses, and we have been able to retreat unharmed to the Modder River. Good work!
dst: 英军伤亡惨重，而我们得以安然撤到莫德河。干得好！

src: The British held!  Your attack achieved little at great cost!
dst: 英军顶住了！你的进攻代价惨重，却收效甚微！

src: The British however seem more and more inclined to peace after their defeat at Arnhem.......
dst: 不过英国人在阿纳姆战败之后，似乎越来越倾向于和平……

src: The British invasion of Mesopotamia has therefore failed and Anglo-Indian troops have retreated back to the city of Kut al Amara, where they are now under siege.
dst: 因此，英国对美索不达米亚的入侵失败了，英印军队已退回到库特阿马拉城，如今他们在那里被围困。

src: The British offensive has been well planned, but it seems that they're being too slow executing it. That could give us the precious time we need to send our reserves to the open gaps and contain the enemy swarm. Right now one of the most dangerous zones is our observation position at the Hohenzollern Redoute, a series of fortifications and trenches near Auchy-les-Mines. The British know that it's one of our strong defence points, so they've sent some of their best troops to conquer it. We count on you to defend the redoubt at all costs and to defeat our enemies.
dst: 英军的攻势策划得不错，但他们的执行似乎太慢了。这或许能给我们争取到宝贵的时间，把预备队派往那些敞开的缺口，遏制蜂拥而至的敌军。眼下最危险的地带之一，就是我们在霍亨索伦堡垒的观察阵地——欧希莱米讷附近的一系列工事和战壕。英军知道那是我们的坚固防御要点之一，所以他们派出了一些精锐部队来攻克它。我们指望您不惜一切代价守住这座堡垒并击败敌人。

src: The British overestimated their capabilities. They clashed against our defensive lines but our men stood their ground. Now it is time to launch an counterattack on the whole front. El Alamain will be our stepping stone to Alexandria. Our army lost some strength points in the recent battle, but the British got hit badly. Hurry up now, start the enginees!
dst: 英国人高估了自己的能力。他们与我军防线相撞，但我军将士坚守住了阵地。现在是时候在全线发动反击了。阿拉曼将成为我们通往亚历山大的跳板。我们的军队在最近的战斗中损失了一些兵力值，但英国人遭到了重创。现在抓紧时间，发动引擎！

src: The British press says that right now you're marching towards Kaapstad. I guess that they think you're stupid. Attacking Kaaptstad at this moment would be suicidal. The defences of the city are much stronger than Kimberley's, and they have the support of the Royal Navy. There is nothing that we could do there, apart from sending thousands of our brave soldiers to a certain death.
dst: 英国报纸说，此刻您正朝开普敦进军。我猜他们以为您很愚蠢。此刻攻打开普敦无异于自杀。这座城市的防御比金伯利强得多，而且还有皇家海军的支援。我们在那里什么也做不了，除了把成千上万勇敢的士兵送上必死的绝路。

src: The British retreated to buy time and reinforcements. After 4 days and 60 miles inside Egypt, Graziani stops his attack due to supply logistics. To risk going any farther, Graziani said, would risk being defeated until supplies were available.
dst: 英军后撤以争取时间和增援。在深入埃及4天、推进60英里后，格拉齐亚尼因补给后勤问题停止进攻。格拉齐亚尼说，再冒险深入，就有在补给到位前被击败的危险。

src: The British retreated to buy time and reinforcements. After 4 days and 60 miles inside Egypt, Graziani stops his attack due to supply logistics. To risk going any farther, Graziani said, would risk being defeated until supplies were available. Promised reinforcements were diverted to Greece and Graziani was forced to change his attack plan and could not penetrate deeper than Sidi Barrani.
dst: 英军后撤以争取时间和增援。在深入埃及4天、推进60英里后，格拉齐亚尼因补给后勤问题停止进攻。格拉齐亚尼说，再冒险深入，就有在补给到位前被击败的危险。许诺的增援被转调希腊，格拉齐亚尼被迫改变进攻计划，未能深入西迪拜拉尼以外。

src: The British sent the 4th Armoured Brigade to encircle your positions, but your were able to escape West. All of this not before giving the New Zealanders a bloody nose and crippling the 4th Indian Division at Alem Hamza.
dst: 英军派第4装甲旅来包围你的阵地，但你得以向西脱身。这一切发生之前，你已给新西兰人一记重创，并在阿莱姆哈姆扎打残了印度第4师。

src: The British sent the 4th Armoured Brigade to encircle your positions. Many of your troops did not make it to Aghedabia, where the 90th Leichte Division is preparing strong defensive positions.
dst: 英军派第4装甲旅来包围你的阵地。你的许多部队没能撤到阿格达比亚——第90轻装师正在那里构筑坚固的防御阵地。

src: The British threw in many divisions - supported by some new metal monsters - and captured the third line of defence that you were supposed to hold. Luckily fresh troops were able to contain the British breakthrough.
dst: 英军投入了许多师——还得到一些新型钢铁怪物的支援——并攻占了本该由您守住的第三道防线。幸运的是新部队得以遏制了英军的突破。

src: The British troops have fallen back on Mersa Matruh where they are joined by fresh Indian troops and the 2nd NZ Div. You are now in command of Ariete, Trieste, the inexperienced Littorio armoured division and the few mobile troops of X and XXI Corps that have crossed the Lybia-Egypt border. Ariete and Trieste and 15 Pz are positioned on the right flank to keep the 1 Arm Div busy while the rest of DAK assisted by Littorio and the Infantry Divisions cut off the 8th Army forces.
dst: 英军已退守梅尔萨马特鲁，在那里得到新到的印度部队和新西兰第2师的会合。你现在指挥“公羊”师、“的里雅斯特”师、缺乏经验的“利托里奥”装甲师，以及第10军和第21军已越过利埃边境的少量机动部队。“公羊”师、“的里雅斯特”师和第15装甲师部署在右翼，缠住第1装甲师，而非洲军的其余部队在“利托里奥”师和步兵各师协助下，切断第8集团军。

src: The British troops in North Ireland unexpected quick responded our operation. Mountain troops, landed at Limerick on the west coast of Ireland, are attacked by strong forces and are in serious danger! Move your troops in direction of Limerick and relieve our troops!
dst: 北爱尔兰的英军出乎意料地迅速回应了我们的行动。在爱尔兰西海岸利默里克登陆的山地部队遭到强大兵力的攻击，处境十分危险！把你的部队调往利默里克方向，解救我们的部队！

src: The British used Yagodnik Island airfield for bombing missions against our ships in Norwegian  Fjords. This makes the airfield one of your objectives too.
dst: 英国人曾利用亚戈德尼克岛机场对我们停泊在挪威峡湾的舰艇执行轰炸任务。这也使该机场成为你的目标之一。

src: The British were sure that German East Africa would fall with just a single decisive blow. They decided to make a coordinated assault that included an amphibious landing at the German port of Tanga. The force was assembled in India and transported by ship to its destination. Upon arrival negotiations were started with the German governor of Tanga while the transports waited at sea. The seasick Indian troops were landed that afternoon on a beach some miles east of the city, believing that the port was mined. They waited on the beach without advancing further.
dst: 英国人确信，只需一次决定性的打击就能让德属东非陷落。他们决定发动一场协同突击，其中包括在德国港口坦噶进行两栖登陆。这支兵力在印度集结，并由船运往目的地。抵达后，他们开始与坦噶的德国总督谈判，而运输船队则在海上等待。那些晕船的印度部队于当天下午在城市以东数英里的一处海滩登陆，他们相信港口已布设水雷。他们就在海滩上等待，没有进一步推进。

src: The British will surely counter your forces with every available asset, including Alexandria.  YOU can count on support from Africa.
dst: 英军必然会动用一切可用力量反击你，包括来自亚历山大方向的。你可以指望非洲方面的支援。

src: The British, on the other hand, are in pretty good shape. Even after their terrible losses in Flandern and the Somme they still have many reserves, so in the following months I guess that the greatest danger for our soldiers will come from the British sector. However, a British attack isn't the worst thing that could happen to us. The worst-case scenario, by far, would be the United States entering the war. That would be the end of us.
dst: 另一方面，英国人状态相当好。即便在佛兰德和索姆河遭受了惨重损失之后，他们仍有许多后备力量，所以我想，接下来几个月里，对我们士兵最大的危险将来自英国防区。不过，英军的进攻还不是可能降临到我们头上的最糟之事。最糟的局面，毫无疑问，是美国参战。那将是我们的末日。

src: The British, who until them had made calls to the cessation of hostilities, suddenly warned us that, if we dared to cross the border in order to pursue the Italians, they'd consider it an act of aggression, and would declare war on us, too.
dst: 在此之前一直呼吁停止敌对行动的英国人，突然警告我们说，如果我们胆敢越过边境追击意大利人，他们就会视之为侵略行为，也会向我们宣战。

src: The Brjansker region is lost too early. You will get another chance but you have to deliever in the future.
dst: 布良斯克地区失守得太早了。你会得到另一次机会，但今后你必须交出成绩。

src: The Brusilov offensive - advance in Galicia
dst: The Brusilov 攻势 - advance in Galicia

src: The Brusilov offensive - advance in Galicia - June 1916
dst: 布鲁西洛夫攻势——加利西亚的推进——1916年6月
The Brusilov 攻势 - swan song

src: The Brusilov offensive - swan song - September 1916
dst: 布鲁西洛夫攻势——绝唱——1916年9月

src: The Bulgarian Army isn't big enough to fully recover from their losses, and the Germans can't send more soldiers to the area, so the Balkan Front will stabilize pretty soon. However, I'm afraid that we'll have to retreat from the Dardanelles. Russia won't receive any help by sea. I hope they'll be able to take care of themselves.
dst: 保加利亚军队规模不够大，无法从损失中完全恢复，而德国人又无法向该地区增派士兵，所以巴尔干战线很快就会稳定下来。不过，恐怕我们不得不从达达尼尔海峡撤退。俄国将无法从海上得到任何援助。我希望他们能够自己照顾自己。

src: The Bulgarians are fleeing and Eastern Thrace is ours again. We'll learn from these experiences, and when the next war comes, we'll make sure that we have powerful allies on our side. Then the time for retribution will come.
dst: 保加利亚人正在溃逃，东色雷斯再次归我们所有。我们将从这些经历中吸取教训，等到下一场战争到来时，我们一定会确保自己身边有强大的盟友。那时，清算的时刻就会到来。

src: The Bulgarians have been fighting here in Macedonia practically alone since 1915. They have repelled British, French, Serbian and Greek attacks once and again. They're very skilled and brave but, sadly, they aren't strong enough to break through the enemy lines.
dst: 自1915年以来，保加利亚人几乎一直独自在马其顿这里作战。他们一次又一次地击退了英国、法国、塞尔维亚和希腊的进攻。他们非常善战且勇敢，但遗憾的是，他们的力量还不足以突破敌军防线。

src: The Calais field hospital works as a supply and healer unit and restores ammo as well as 4 SP/turn.
dst: 加来野战医院可作为补给和医疗单位使用，既补给弹药，也每回合恢复4点SP。

src: The Canadians are currently engaged in bitter fighting to clear both banks of the Scheldt estuary, which would allow us the use of the port of Antwerp.  In order to protect the Canadian Army from counter-attacks on its flank, Montgomery has ordered you to clear the southbank of the Mass river.
dst: 加拿大军目前正苦战清除斯海尔德河口两岸，以使我们能使用安特卫普港。为保护加军侧翼免遭反攻，蒙哥马利已命令你肃清马斯河南岸。

src: The Capital of Baden, Karlsruhe, we must take later.
dst: 巴登的首府卡尔斯鲁厄，我们之后必须拿下。

src: The Catalonian front is heavily damaged by our advance, taking many towns in the way to Barcelona. However, the Republicans are launching a local offensiva on the Segre river sector, we think they want to cross the Segre and then, try to re-capture two important electric plants Northwards from here, and also to re-equilibrate the situation back after the battle of the Ebro.
dst: 由于我军的推进，加泰罗尼亚战线已遭到严重削弱，我们在向巴塞罗那进军的途中攻占了众多城镇。然而，共和军正在塞格雷河地段发动一场局部攻势，我们认为他们想要渡过塞格雷河，进而试图夺回此地向北的两座重要发电厂，并在埃布罗河战役之后重新平衡局势。

src: The Caucasus lies ahead! Just 400 km to Baku, this important goal must be reached before the winter comes.
dst: 高加索就在眼前！距巴库只有400公里，这个重要目标必须在入冬前拿下。

src: The Cavalry Army, led by Semyon Budionny, is now near the town of Zamosc. But since it's heavily defended by our infantry units, he has decided to move to Komarów, some 12 miles to the east. If we attack there with our cavalry units, we could trap the Soviets between Zamosc and Niewirków. We count on you for this mission, General.
dst: 由谢苗·布琼尼率领的骑兵集团军，现在扎莫希奇城附近。但由于该城被我军步兵严密防守，他决定转移到科马鲁夫——大约向东12英里处。如果我们用骑兵部队在那里发起进攻，就能把苏军围困在扎莫希奇和涅维尔库夫之间。将军，这项任务就指望您了。

src: The Central Powers have reacted quickly. German and Austro-Hungarian forces are counterattacking in the Carpathians. Meanwhile, in the Danube, Bulgarian, German and Turkish units joined in the Heeresgruppe Mackensen. In the first days of September the Heeresgruppe liberated Southern Dobruca and afterwards it has followed its advance, parallel to the coast of the Karadeniz.
dst: 同盟国反应迅速。德军和奥匈军队正在喀尔巴阡山发起反攻。与此同时，在多瑙河，保加利亚、德国和土耳其部队汇入了马肯森集团军群。9月头几天，该集团军群解放了南多布罗加，此后又沿海岸线继续推进，与黑海海岸平行。

src: The Central Task Force will land at 4 locations in and around Oran:
dst: 中央特遣队将在奥兰城内及周边的4个地点登陆：

src: The Champagne offensive gained a few miles of ground and captured some 25,000 German prisoners, but with German reinforcements brought into the sector from the Eastern Front, the French could not withstand repeated German counter-attacks. French losses were over 145,000 casualties by the time the Champagne offensive drew to a close.
dst: 香槟攻势推进了几英里并俘虏了约2.5万名德军战俘，但随着德军从东线调来增援，法军无法抵挡德军一次次的反击。到香槟攻势结束时，法军伤亡已超过14.5万人。

src: The Chinese Empire has vowed to leave behind decades of decadence, rebellions and humiliations at the hands of the Western powers. It's time to build a modern, competent army, capable of defending this once glorious country from the predations of the foreign devils.
dst: 中华帝国已经立誓要告别数十年来在西列强手中遭受的衰败、叛乱和屈辱。是时候建立一支现代化、有战斗力的军队，使这个曾经辉煌的国家能够抵御洋鬼子的掠夺。

src: The Chinese counterattacks were useless. The French conquered Lang Son four days later, and for some time they even fought against the Chinese at the Zhennan Pass. Luckily, they were suffering from tropical diseases, hunger and lack of ammunition, so they finally had to stop their offensive and, fearing that we could harass them and outflank them, they left Lang Son and returned to Hanoi.
dst: 中国军队的反攻毫无用处。四天后，法军攻占了谅山，甚至一度在镇南关与中国军队交战。所幸他们饱受热带疾病、饥饿和弹药匮乏之苦，最终不得不停止攻势，并因担心我们会袭扰和包抄他们，而撤离谅山，返回河内。

src: The Chinese didn't retreat too far. Keeping some advanced positions in the Luc Nam valley was indispensable for the safety of Lang Son. In December the Guangxi Army occupied the hill of Núi Bop, east of Chu, where we started to build a fortified camp.
dst: 中国人没有撤得太远。守住陆南河谷的一些前进阵地对谅山的安全不可或缺。12月，广西军占领了朱以东的努伊博普高地，我们在那里开始修筑设防营地。

src: The Chinese victory at Pyongyang could have been the start of a counteroffensive and the end of the Japanese expansion, but only two days later the Chinese Beiyang Fleet suffered a crushing defeat at the naval disaster of the Yalu river. After that tragedy defending Korea became impossible, so our forces abandoned the country and retreated to the northern bank of the Yalu river, where they would try to stop the advancing Japanese divisions.
dst: 中国军队在平壤的胜利本可能成为反攻的开端和日本扩张的终结，但仅仅两天后，中国北洋水师便在鸭绿江海战中遭到惨败。那场悲剧之后，守卫朝鲜已无可能，因此我们的部队放弃了该国，撤退到鸭绿江北岸，试图在那里阻止推进中的日军师团。
辛布里人与条顿人的迁徙

src: The Cimbri lost. The fugitives were driven into camps... 60,000 captives were sold into slavery.
dst: 辛布里人败了。逃散者被赶进营地……60,000名俘虏被卖为奴隶。

src: The Cimbri lost. The fugitives were driven into camps... 60,000 prisoners were sold into slavery.
dst: 辛布里人败了。逃散者被赶进营地……60,000名俘虏被卖为奴隶。

src: The Cimbrian horsemen attacked the Romans frontal, but swung to the right to bring the Romans little by between themselves and their infantry, which stood on the left side.
dst: 辛布里骑兵正面冲击罗马人，却向右迂回，把罗马人一点点挤到自己与左翼步兵之间。

src: The Cimbrian horsemen attacked the Romans frontal, but swung to the right to bring the Romans little by little between themselves and their infantry, which stood on the left side.
dst: 辛布里骑兵正面冲击罗马人，却向右迂回，把罗马人一点点挤到自己与左翼步兵之间。

src: The City that Hitler never planned to capture, and that Stalin never intended to defend, lay sweltering under the summer sun. From the west, from the far off Ukraine, came giant pillars of dust. The whirling clouds advanced fitfully across the steppe, slowing only for short periods before moving on toward the east and the Don River barrier. From a distance they resembled tornadoes. But these spiraling clouds hid the German Sixth Armee, an elite legion dispatched by Hitler to destroy the Communist state led by Stalin. It's men were supremely confidant; during 3 years of warfare, they had never tasted defeat, and had come to the conclusion that "Russland ist kaputt". With the unleashing in late June 1942 of Operation Blue, the intended knockout blow, Adolf Hitler had promised his soldiers an end to the war....
dst: 那座希特勒从未打算夺取、斯大林也从未打算防守的城市，在夏日骄阳下闷热地摊开着。从西面、从遥远的乌克兰，升起一根根巨大的尘柱。翻滚的云团断断续续地越过草原，只作短暂停歇，便继续向东朝顿河屏障推进。远远望去，它们宛如龙卷风。但这些盘旋的尘云掩盖着德国第6集团军——一支由希特勒派出、旨在摧毁斯大林领导的共产主义国家的精锐军团。其官兵自信至极；在3年的征战中，他们从未尝过败绩，并已得出结论："Russland ist kaputt"（俄国完蛋了）。随着1942年6月下旬"蓝色行动"的发起——那记意在击倒对手的重拳——阿道夫·希特勒曾向他的士兵许诺战争的终结……

src: The Commander of British forces in France, sir John French however wanted to prove his superiors that the BEF was capable of forcing a decisive breakthrough and that the Gallipoli campaign was a waste of resources. He also wanted to demonstrate the fighting force of the BEF to his French colleagues. The French at that point did not think highly of the BEF that only held 40km of the 750km front line.
dst: 然而，驻法英军司令约翰·弗伦奇爵士想向他的上司证明，英国远征军有能力取得决定性的突破，而加利波利战役是浪费资源。他还想向法国同僚展示英国远征军的战斗力。当时法国人对英国远征军评价不高，因为后者只守住了750公里战线中的40公里。

src: The Commonwealth forces in Egypt are as good as defeated, the evacuation of Alexandria is in progress and according to information of our intelligence, the Mediterranean fleet has already set sail and fled via Suez Canal toward the Indian Ocean. However, some units of the French fleet are interned in Alexandria - and these units should be located still there. It is clear that the enemy is not willing to let these ships fall into our hands. Occupy Alexandria and try your best to prevent the scuttling of the French ships!
dst: 埃及的英联邦部队几乎已被击败，亚历山大的撤离正在进行，据我方情报，地中海舰队已启航，经苏伊士运河逃往印度洋。然而，法国舰队的一些舰艇仍扣留在亚历山大——这些舰艇应该还在那里。很明显，敌人不愿让这些军舰落入我们手中。占领亚历山大，尽力阻止法国军舰被凿沉！

src: The Confederates are attacking the II corps but it seems they are not aware your corps is close behind. Repell the attack and continue your way to Manassas Junction. Reports from our scouts suggest that the enemy will attack from the north only.
dst: 南方军正在进攻第二军，但他们似乎没意识到您的军就在近旁。击退这次进攻，继续向马纳萨斯枢纽前进。我方侦察兵的报告表明，敌人只会从北面进攻。

src: The Conference of Kasala was a trap from the very beginning. Italy didn't want to negotiate anything, and just repeated a series of absurd demands: the complete demilitarization of Ethiopian Tigray, and the cessation of all our plans for modernizing our army and establishing permanent military agreements with other countries.
dst: 卡萨拉会议从一开始就是个陷阱。意大利根本不想谈判，只是一味重复一系列荒谬的要求：埃塞俄比亚提格雷地区完全非军事化，以及停止我们为实现军队现代化和与他国建立永久性军事协议而制定的一切计划。

src: The Conference of Ufa had a bittersweet outcome, too. After many debates and discussions, on September 23rd the majority of the delegates agreed to establish a five-man Directory as the basis of a new government for all Russia. But the Mensheviks and some Socialist-Revolutionaries rejected the agreement, and left the conference.
dst: 乌法会议的结果也苦乐参半。经过多次辩论和讨论，9月23日，大多数代表同意成立一个五人督政府，作为全俄新政府的基础。但孟什维克和部分社会革命党人拒绝了这个协议，并退出了会议。

But the Mensheviks and some Socialist-Revolutionaries rejected the agreement, and left the conference.

src: The Congo -  Arab war. Taking of Nyangwe
dst: The Congo -  阿拉伯 war. Taking of Nyangwe

src: The Crimean Offensive (8 April 1944 - 12 May 1944) was a series of offensives by the Red Army in the effort to liberate Crimea from the German Wehrmacht occupation. The Red Army's 4th Ukrainian Front engaged German 17. Armee of Army Group South, which consisted of German and Romanian formations, in an operation to liberate the Crimean peninsula.
dst: 克里米亚攻势（1944年4月8日—5月12日）是红军为将克里米亚从德国国防军占领下解放而发起的一系列进攻。红军乌克兰第4方面军与南乌克兰集团军群所属、由德、罗部队组成的德国第17集团军交战，以解放克里米亚半岛。

src: The Czech Legion had withdrawn itself from the Russian Civil War and was only sparsely involved when 1918 ended. However, still elements of the Legion were scattered as far west as Ufa, near the Ural mountains, when the White Russian forces of Koltsjak were on the retreat under pressure of a huge Soviet offensive aimed at destroying the White Russians in Siberia.
dst: 捷克军团已退出俄国内战，到1918年底时只零星卷入。然而，军团仍有部分人员分散在远至乌拉尔山脉附近乌法的西部，当时高尔察克的白俄军队在一场旨在消灭西伯利亚白俄的大规模苏维埃攻势压力下节节败退。

src: The Czech Legion is deployed in between the Finnish 6th and 4th divisions. The Austro-Hungarian forces consist of the K.u.K. 19th infantry division which consists roughly of half of Czechs... Success is vital!
dst: 捷克军团被部署在芬兰第6师与第4师之间。奥匈军队由奥匈帝国皇家第19步兵师组成，该师大约有一半是捷克人……胜利至关重要！

src: The Czech Legion was also retreating east to stay out of German hands. The Legion's 2nd Regiment took up positions at the bridges over the Dnjepr River at Kiev and held these for five days, until 3 March 1918, so that the bulk of the Czech Legion could retreat east. The 2nd regiment then broke off contact and joined the Legion again. Kiev was now in German hands but the Czech Legion had escaped!
dst: 捷克军团也在向东撤退，以免落入德军之手。军团第2团在基辅第聂伯河上的桥梁处占据阵地，并坚守了五天，直到1918年3月3日，好让军团主力能够向东撤退。第2团随后脱离接触，重新归队。基辅现已落入德军之手，但捷克军团成功逃脱了！

src: The Czech Legion was only sparsely involved in the battles between the Red Army and the White Russian Siberian Army. The White Russians lead defeat after defeat and near the end of 1919 the Red Army had captured Siberia all the way to Omsk. By then, the Czech Legion was already in eastern Siberia...
dst: 捷克军团仅很少地卷入了红军与白俄西伯利亚军队之间的战斗。白俄连连败退，到1919年底，红军已一路攻占西伯利亚直至鄂木斯克。那时，捷克军团已在西伯利亚东部……

src: The Czech Legion will take part in the Kerensky Offensive, lead by the 1916 hero Brusilov. The goal is to capture Lemberg and Kowel. The Czech Legion receives orders to capture the village of Pluhiv after breaking through the Austro-Hungarian trenches.
dst: 捷克军团将参加由1916年的英雄布鲁西洛夫领导的克伦斯基攻势。目标是夺取伦贝格和科韦尔。捷克军团接到命令，在突破奥匈军队战壕后攻占普鲁希夫村。

src: The Czech action at Zborow was a huge success for the Czech Legion. The Russian Army was weary of three years of defeat after defeat and were deeply demoralized. So were the Austro-Hungarian forces at the other side. Two of the Austrian regiments had more than 50% of Czechs filling the ranks.
dst: 捷克军团在兹博罗夫的作战取得了巨大成功。俄军因三年屡战屡败而疲惫不堪、士气涣散。对面奥匈军队亦是如此。奥地利有两个团的官兵中捷克人占了50%以上。

src: The Czech victory was kept silent in the Habsburg Empire but was made public in almost all other countries, including Germany. Kerensky allowed the Legion to expand and conduct an independant offensive which had minimum success. The front kept quiet the coming months when another revolution, the Bolshevik revolution, took place in Russia broke out...
dst: 捷克人的胜利在哈布斯堡帝国内被秘而不宣，却在包括德国在内的几乎所有其他国家被公开报道。克伦斯基允许军团扩编并进行一次独立的进攻，但这次进攻收效甚微。随后几个月前线归于平静，此时另一场革命——布尔什维克革命——在俄国爆发了……

src: The Czechs soon took several towns along the railway, and during the first days of June they occupied Samara. Almost immediately, the anti-Bolshevik leaders in the town formed a provisional government, the Komuch, contolled by members of the Socialist-Revolutionary Party, and called for the mobilization of a People's Army.
dst: 捷克人很快攻占了铁路沿线的多座城镇，并在6月的头几天占领了萨马拉。几乎与此同时，城里的反布尔什维克领袖组建了一个临时政府——科穆奇，它由社会革命党成员掌控，并号召动员组建人民军。

src: The DAK and our XX Corps with Ariete and Trieste started moving South last evening, swinging around the most Southern point of the Allied defensive line: Bir Hacheim. Your Ariete division and Trieste are tasked with taking out the defensive positions at Bir Hacheim. The DAK's objectives are to engage and take out the enemy armor and reach Tobruk - the goal of our offensive. Our X and XXI Corps assisted by the German 15th Schutzen Brigade will launch faint attacks against the Gazala line (N of this map - not covered by this scenario).
dst: 非洲军和我们的第20军带着“公羊”师和“的里雅斯特”师，昨晚开始南进，绕过盟军防线最南端的比尔哈凯姆。你的“公羊”师和“的里雅斯特”师负责拔除比尔哈凯姆的防御阵地。非洲军的目标是缠住并消灭敌方装甲，并抵达托布鲁克——我们此次攻势的终点。我们的第10军和第21军将在德国第15步兵旅协助下，对加扎拉防线发起牵制性进攻（在此地图以北，本场景不涉及）。

src: The DAS REICH campaign puts you in control of the SS units known as SS-Division Verfuegungstruppe, SS-Division Das Reich, SS-Panzergrenadier-Division Das Reich and 2SS Panzer Division Das Reich. The division was one of the classic SS divisions that quickly earned a reputation for courage and bravery.
dst: 本“帝国”师战役让你指挥党卫军部队——党卫军“武装”师（SS-Verfuegungstruppe）、党卫军“帝国”师（SS-Division Das Reich）、党卫军装甲掷弹兵“帝国”师（SS-Panzergrenadier-Division Das Reich）和第2党卫军装甲师“帝国”师。该师是经典的党卫军师之一，很快以勇敢无畏赢得了声誉。

src: The Dervishes stopped us for a while, but eventually they were overpowered by our superior tactics, training and equipment. In the end, their army ceased to exist, Omdurman was conquered, and in just a few months we would control all of Sudan.
dst: 德尔维希人一度挡住了我们，但最终他们还是被我们更优越的战术、训练和装备所压倒。最后，他们的军队不复存在，恩图曼被攻克，短短几个月内我们就将控制整个苏丹。

src: The Dukla pass is one of the few roads into Slowakia. You are to defend it at all costs.
dst: 杜克拉山口是通往斯洛伐克的少数几条道路之一。您须不惜一切代价守住它。

src: The Dunkirk evacuation, code-named Operation Dynamo took place between 26 May and the early hours of 3 June 1940. In a speech to the House of Commons, Winston Churchill called the events in France "a colossal military disaster", saying that "the whole root and core and brain of the British Army" had been stranded at Dunkirk and seemed about to perish or be captured. On the first day, only 7,011 men were evacuated, but by the ninth day, a total of 338,226 soldiers (198,229 British and 139,997 French) had been rescued by the hastily assembled fleet of 850 boats. Many of the troops were able to embark from the harbour's protective mole onto 42 British destroyers and other large ships, while others had to wade from the beaches toward the ships, waiting for hours to board, shoulder-deep in water. Others were ferried from the beaches to the larger ships, and thousands were carried back to Britain by the famous "little ships of Dunkirk", a flotilla of around 700 merchant marine boats, fishing boats, pleasure craft and Royal National Lifeboat Institution lifeboats. Two French divisions remained behind to protect the evacuation, though they halted the German advance, they were soon captured.
dst: 敦刻尔克大撤退，代号“发电机”行动，发生于1940年5月26日至6月3日凌晨之间。在下议院的一次演说中，温斯顿·丘吉尔把法国发生的事称为“一场巨大的军事灾难”，说“英国陆军的整个根基、核心与大脑”都被困在敦刻尔克，似乎即将覆灭或被俘。第一天只撤出7011人，但到第九天，一支仓促集结起来的850艘船只组成的船队已救出338226名士兵（198229名英国人和139997名法国人）。许多部队得以从港口防护堤登上42艘英国驱逐舰和其他大船，另一些人则不得不从海滩涉水上船，在水中齐肩深处等上几个小时。还有人从海滩被摆渡到较大的船上，数千人由著名的“敦刻尔克小船队”运回英国——那是由约700艘商船、渔船、游艇和皇家全国救生艇协会救生艇组成的船队。两个法国师留守掩护撤退，虽然他们迟滞了德军推进，但很快就被俘。

src: The Dutch forces have suffered a stinging defeat.  This means the outcome is a technical victory in this campaign.  The enemy is still holding some critical positions in other sectors, we must clear them.
dst: 荷兰军队遭受了惨重失败。这意味着本次战役的结局已可算作技术性胜利。敌军仍在其他地区死守一些关键阵地，我们必须将其肃清。

src: The Dutch forces have suffered a total defeat, Java is free!!!
dst: 荷兰军队彻底失败，爪哇自由了！！！

src: The Dutch government and Queen Wilhelmina managed to escape to England, but the Dutch capitulated after a few days of fighting. Congratulations.
dst: 荷兰政府和威廉明娜女王成功逃往英格兰，但荷兰人在几天战斗后即告投降。恭喜。

src: The Dutch have resisted in this jungle area since January General.  Bogor and other nearby places are the last bases which the enemy still holds on this island. Your command will be split in two groups; your task is to clear the jungle of enemy elements and to seize all other objectives.  Select carefully the jungle paths for your troops.  I think the jungle will be our worst enemy here.
dst: 将军，自1月以来荷兰人一直在这片丛林地区顽抗。茂物及附近其他地点是敌军仍在该岛据守的最后基地。您的部队将分为两路；您的任务是肃清丛林中的敌军，并夺取所有其他目标。请为部队谨慎选择穿越丛林的路线。我想丛林将是我们在这里最大的敌人。

src: The Dutch resistance network reports that the german defences mostly consist of several infantry divisions. Only one heavy self-propelled anti-tank (schwere Panzer-Jagt-Abteilung) formation is reported in the area.
dst: 荷兰抵抗组织网络报告称，德军防御主要由若干步兵师构成。该地区仅报告有一支重型自行反坦克部队（重装甲歼击营）。

src: The EEF was an "imperial" force in its true sense. Indian Ghurkas fought alongside Scotsmen, Australian Lighthorsemen beside New Zealand Mounted Rifles and the Imperial Camel Corps. This is their story...
dst: EEF是一支名副其实的「帝国」军队。印度廓尔喀人与苏格兰人并肩作战，澳大利亚轻骑兵与新西兰骑马步枪队和帝国骆驼军团并肩作战。这就是他们的故事……

src: The EEF's campaign from October to December of 1917 resulted in a military defeat of the Central Powers, which led to a substantial loss of enemy territory. In particular, the fighting from October 31 to November 7 against the Ottoman Gaza- Sheria- Beersheba line resulted in the first defeat of the entrenched, experienced and, up until then, successful Ottoman armies, which were supported by artillery, machine guns and aircraft. During these attacks the Ottoman defenders were well established in trenches, redoubts and other fortifications, requiring a "Western Front"-style of battle, as the attackers were forced to approach across open ground.
dst: 埃及远征军1917年10月至12月的战役使同盟国遭受军事失败，导致敌方领土大量丧失。特别是10月31日至11月7日对奥斯曼加沙-谢里亚-贝尔谢巴防线的战斗，使这些固守堑壕、经验丰富且此前所向披靡、并有火炮、机枪和飞机支援的奥斯曼军队首次遭到失败。在这些进攻中，奥斯曼守军凭借堑壕、棱堡及其他工事严密设防，攻方被迫穿越开阔地带，打成了一场「西线」式的战斗。

src: The East Coast of the USA has been cleared and the remnants of the US forces haven been driven across the country into the central regions and the so called Rocky Mountains Fortress. The Japanese captured the West Coast and are pushing into the hinterlad as well.
dst: 美国东海岸已被肃清，美军残余部队已被驱赶穿越全国，退入中部地区和所谓的"落基山脉要塞"。日本人占领了西海岸，并且也在向内地推进。

src: The Egyptians send us some experienced local scouts - they should help to reconnaissance the defensive line.
dst: 埃及人给我们派来了一些经验丰富的当地向导——他们应该能帮助侦察这条防线。

src: The Egyptians were really scared. They would have skipped the battle if they had had the chance, but they couldn't do that. On the other hand, our morale was quite low, too. Knowing this, Emperor Yohannes pierced our waterskins and said: "My children, if you don't want to die of thirst, you'll have to take the water from your enemies". Then all of us knew that the die was cast. We charged against our enemies. Only victory or death would await us. As soon as the Egyptians saw us, they quickly set up a defensive position on the shore of a dry riverbed, and we tried to storm it.
dst: 埃及人确实吓坏了。如果有机会，他们真想避开这场战斗，但他们做不到。另一方面，我们的士气也相当低落。约翰内斯皇帝深知这一点，于是他刺破了我们的水袋，说道：「我的孩子们，如果你们不想渴死，就得从敌人那里夺取水喝」。于是我们所有人都知道，木已成舟。我们向敌人发起冲锋。等待我们的只有胜利或死亡。埃及人一看见我们，就迅速在一条干涸河床的岸边布下防御阵地，我们则试图强攻它。

src: The Emperor Hiro-Hito sends his best and most sincere congratulations to you.
dst: 裕仁天皇向您致以最诚挚的祝贺。

src: The Emperor called us to war again, a Holy War between Christians and Muslims, and we quickly sent our troops to the battle. It wouldn't be as easy as in Gundet, though. This time the Egyptians were very prudent. They refused to leave the protection of their forts. Alula Engida tried to assault them, but he had to retreat after losing thousands of warriors in the attacks. Our army simply didn't have the means to take strong fortified positions.
dst: 皇帝再次召唤我们投入战争，一场基督徒与穆斯林之间的圣战，我们迅速派兵参战。不过，这一次不会像在贡代特那样轻松了。这回埃及人非常谨慎，拒绝离开堡垒的庇护。阿卢拉·恩吉达试图强攻，但在进攻中损失了数千名战士之后不得不撤退。我们的军队根本没有攻取坚固设防阵地的手段。

src: The English have dug in and are using tactics from WW1 to try and slow us down. They are also using second rate troops.
dst: 英国人已掘壕固守，正用一战战术试图拖慢我们。他们还用上了二流部队。

src: The English have surrendered, and Greek resistance has collapsed.  This was primarily due to the brilliant tactics of General Cundarian.  Your performance was mediocre, far below your past record. You will be given another chance.  After some rest and recuperation you and your men will be returned to the Russian front to play a key role in our 1942 spring campaign.
dst: 英国人已经投降，希腊抵抗也已崩溃。这主要归功于昆达里安将军的卓越战术。您的表现平平，远低于您以往的水准。我们会再给您一次机会。经过一段休整之后，您和您的部下将被调回俄国前线，在我们1942年春季攻势中扮演关键角色。

src: The English have surrendered, and Greek resistance has collapsed.  Your performance has been excellent, and we will continue to rely on your expertise.  Well done!  After some well-earned rest and recuperation you and your men will be returned to the Russian front to play a key role in our 1942 spring campaign.
dst: 英国人已经投降，希腊抵抗也已崩溃。您的表现极为出色，我们将继续倚重您的专长。干得好！经过一段应得的休整之后，您和您的部下将被调回俄国前线，在我们1942年春季攻势中扮演关键角色。

src: The English have surrendered, and Greek resistance has collapsed. Your performance has been excellent, and we will continue to rely on your expertise. Well done! There is only a little problem.... The island of Crete is still under Greek and British control!
dst: 英国人已经投降，希腊的抵抗也已崩溃。你的表现十分出色，我们将继续依赖你的专业才能。干得好！只有一个小问题……克里特岛仍在希腊和英国的控制之下！

src: The English have withdrawn, and Greek resistance has collapsed.   We hope you did not let to many enemy troops escape?
dst: 英军已撤离，希腊抵抗已崩溃。希望你没能让太多敌军逃脱？

src: The English have withdrawn, and Greek resistance has collapsed.   Your performance has been adequate.  Thank you, Herr General.
dst: 英军已撤离，希腊抵抗已崩溃。你的表现尚可。谢谢，将军阁下。

src: The English have withdrawn, and Greek resistance has collapsed.  Your performance has been excellent, and we will continue to rely on your expertise.  Well done!
dst: 英军已撤离，希腊抵抗已崩溃。你的表现出色，我们将继续仰仗你的专长。干得好！

src: The English took us completely by surprise by sending the 4th Indian and 7th Armored divisions in the gap between Camp Nibeiwa and Camp Rabia. Our fortresses turned out to be too far apart to support each other.
dst: 英军把印度第4师和第7装甲师投入尼贝瓦营地与拉比亚营地之间的缺口，完全打了我们一个措手不及。我们的各要塞彼此相距太远，无法相互支援。

src: The Ethiopians celebrated the Egyptian retreat murdering and mutilating most of the prisoners that they could take. It was impossible not to be moved by the sight of those poor Egyptians castrated, burned, stoned, clubbed, pierced with lances, stripped and violated with the most hideous indignities.
dst: 埃塞俄比亚人屠杀并残害了他们俘获的大部分俘虏，以此庆祝埃及人的撤退。看到那些可怜的埃及人被阉割、焚烧、石击、棍打、长矛刺穿、剥光衣物，并遭受最骇人的凌辱，实在令人不能不为之动容。

src: The Etruscan metropolis, located very close in the north-west of Rome is a member of the League of the Twelve Etruscan Cities and seals off all further expansion efforts of Rome....if Rome wants to grow, Veii first and foremost has to fall...!
dst: 这座伊特鲁里亚大城位于罗马西北极近之处，是伊特鲁里亚十二城同盟的成员，封死了罗马一切进一步扩张的努力....罗马若要壮大，首先必须攻下维爱...！

src: The Etruscans are known since ancient times as excellent technicians and teachers of the Romans: In front of Rome we will need a lot of modern siege equipment .....
dst: 伊特鲁里亚人自古就以精良的工匠和罗马人的老师著称：在罗马城前，我们会需要大量新式攻城器械 .....

src: The Etruscans taught the Romans how to build streets, drains, aqueducts and temples.
dst: 伊特鲁里亚人教会了罗马人如何修筑街道、排水渠、引水道与神庙。

法莱斯缺口 1944年8月 失败

法莱斯缺口 1944年8月 胜利

src: The Fatherland is indebted to you, Herr Major.
dst: 祖国亏欠你良多，少校阁下。

src: The Federal offensive over the Virginia Peninsula reachs it's highest peak with the attack onwards to Richmond. Save the Confederacy by defeating the US' attack. The confederate high command at Virginia consideres that you must hold 5 victory locations until the end to get a Brilliant Victory, 4 victory locations to get a single Victory, and 3 to get a Tactical Victory.
dst: 联邦军队对弗吉尼亚半岛的攻势在向里士满的进攻中达到最高峰。击败美军的进攻，拯救邦联。弗吉尼亚的邦联最高统帅部认为，您必须坚守5个胜利点直到最后以取得大捷，坚守4个胜利点取得胜利，坚守3个取得小捷。

src: The Feodosiya operation has failed. As we speak our brave forces are driven back into the sea. Because of the failure of the Feodosiya operation, the succesful Kerch operation has become irrelevant...
dst: 费奥多西亚行动失败了。此刻我们英勇的部队正被赶回大海。由于费奥多西亚行动的失败，成功的刻赤行动也变得无关紧要了……

src: The Fifth Battle of Courland ended disastrously for the Soviets, who lost 70 thousand dead and wounded, hundreds of tanks and planes for no real gain. The tide of war couldn't be turned back, though. The Axis forces remained trapped in Courland, where they capitulated on 9th May 1945.
dst: 第五次库尔兰战役以苏军的惨败告终——他们损失了 7 万死伤、数百辆坦克与飞机，却毫无实质收获。然而战局已无法逆转。轴心国军队仍被困于库尔兰，直至 1945 年 5 月 9 日投降。

src: The Filipinos are astonishingly brave, but obviously they have poor training and even poorer equipment. The uprising has been crushed and the survivors have fled to the jungle and the mountains. They intend to keep on fighting there.
dst: 菲律宾人勇敢得惊人，但显然训练差、装备更差。起义已被镇压，幸存者逃进了丛林和山区。他们打算在那里继续战斗。

src: The Finish have only a few troops. Mainly infantry troops are awaiting you on your way to Suomussalmi.
dst: 芬军兵力不多。在您通往苏奥穆斯萨尔米的路上等待您的主要是步兵部队。

src: The Finns have sabotaged and mined the rail line and road to delay the Russkie transports. Destroy any convoy you find, it will reduce the quantity of material reaching the front.
dst: 芬兰人已破坏并布雷于铁路和公路，以迟滞俄军运输。摧毁你发现的任何车队，这将减少抵达前线的物资数量。

src: The First and the Elbe Prussian armies arrived first, from the west, on July 2, and decided to attack the next day. Although the Austrians outnumbered them nearly two to one, they wouldn't wait for the arrival of the Prussian Second Army, which was marching from the north. Thus, on July 3rd, 1866, the fate of Germany was to be decided.
dst: 普鲁士第1军团和易北军团于7月2日率先从西面抵达，并决定次日发动进攻。尽管奥地利人的兵力几乎是他们的两倍，但他们不愿等待正从北面开来的普鲁士第2军团的到来。于是，1866年7月3日，德意志的命运即将被决定。

src: The Franco- American offensive on the Meuse and the Argonne region started while you were away, more than a week ago. I must say that it's been a complete success. The German lines of defence have been destroyed and our enemies are retreating in good order to the north, towards Sedan.
dst: 法美联军对默兹河与阿尔贡地区的攻势，是在您离开期间、也就是一周多以前发动的。我得说，那是一次彻底的胜利。德军的防线已被摧毁，我们的敌人正秩序井然地向北撤退，朝色当方向退去。

src: The Free State of Oldenburg was therefore declared in the territory of the Grand Duchy of Oldenburg.
dst: 于是，奥尔登堡自由邦在奥尔登堡大公国的领土上宣告成立。

src: The French 7th Army has crossed the Belgian-Dutch border. Their 1st Light Mechanized Division is rushing to Moerdijk. If they capture the Moerdijk bridge, your forces are trapped North of the rivers. Hurry your SS forces and the 9th Pz Division South to push the frogs back into Belgium.
dst: 法国第7集团军已越过比荷边境。他们的第1轻机械化师正扑向莫尔代克。若他们夺取莫尔代克桥，你的部队就会被困在诸河以北。赶紧让你的党卫军部队和第9装甲师南下，把法国人赶回比利时。

src: The French Army has been pushed asside, but it looks like the whole BEF - including a new 4th Corps - has been bussed in from the Aisne and is plugging the holes in the front.
dst: 法军已被击退，但看起来整个英国远征军——包括一个新编第四军——已从埃纳河用汽车运来，正在填补前线的缺口。

src: The French General Nivelle thinks that he's found a way to break through our defences on the Aisne, using a combined attack by infantry, artillery, planes and even tanks. It seems that the hardest assaults will take place at the Chemin des Dames ridge. You'll have to defend yourself at all costs and counterattack as soon as you can, ir order to outflank the French and force them to stop their offensive.
dst: 法军将领尼韦勒认为他找到了突破我们在埃纳河防御的办法，即动用步兵、炮兵、飞机乃至坦克实施联合作战。看来最猛烈的进攻将发生在贵妇小径山脊。您必须不惜一切代价坚守，并尽快反攻，以包抄法军并迫使他们停止攻势。

src: The French General Staff considered the hilly and densely forested Ardennes region as "impassable" so it only lightly defended. This proved no hindrance to the German tracked vehicles with many road blocks undefended while the French had refused block the forest trails by felling thousands of trees because it would impede the advance of their cavalry! By evening on May 10th the French 2nd Light cavalry came up against the 10th Panzer Division and was thrown back. The following day the remainder of the cavalry screen was attacked by German armour and scattered into the woods where they were sprayed with machine gun fire. On May the 12th Guderian's forces captured Bouillon, emerged from the Ardennes and crossed the French frontier just north of Sedan. The French delaying action had lasted just two days- instead of the nine or ten that Gamelin thought he would have in hand to move up the slow moving French forces.
dst: 法国总参谋部认为丘陵密林的阿登地区“无法通过”，因此只作了轻微防御。事实证明这对德军履带式车辆毫无妨碍，许多路障无人防守，而法国人还拒绝伐倒数千棵树木来堵塞林间小径，因为这会影响他们骑兵的前进！到5月10日傍晚，法国第2轻骑兵撞上第10装甲师并被击退。次日，骑兵屏的剩余部分遭到德军装甲攻击，被打散进树林，在那里遭到机枪扫射。5月12日，古德里安的部队夺取布永，从阿登穿出，在色当以北不远处越过法国边境。法军的迟滞行动只持续了两天——而不是加梅林以为他手上会有的九天或十天，用以来调动行动迟缓的法军部队。

This proved no hindrance to the German tracked vehicles with many road blocks undefended while the French had refused block the forest trails by felling thousands of trees because it would impede the advance of their cavalry! By evening on May 10th the French 2nd Light cavalry came up against the 10th Panzer Division and was thrown back. src: The French National Assembly puts the blame for the initial Verdun disaster on Joffre. He is replaced by Robert Nivelle.
dst: 法国国民议会把凡尔登初期灾难的责任归咎于霞飞。他被罗贝尔·尼韦勒取代。

src: The French are determined to retake all the land between Soissons and Reims that the Germans took during their failed Spring Offensive. Naturally, we're ready to help them. This will be the first of the many blows that we'll land on the Germans until they recover their senses and decide to surrender.
dst: 法国人决心夺回苏瓦松与兰斯之间德军在其失败的春季攻势中所占领的全部土地。我们自然乐意相助。这将是我们对德军挥出的众多重拳中的第一击，直到他们恢复理智、决定投降为止。

src: The French are resupplying the Republicans with weapons and ammunition. Thanks to your delay in taking Barcelona, the war will be prolonged.  The Republicans will now resist at the Franco-Spanish border and who knows if Paris will finally launch their army to support the government of Madrid.
dst: 法国人正在向共和派补给武器和弹药。由于您迟迟未能夺取巴塞罗那，战争将被延长。共和派现在将在法西边境抵抗，谁知道巴黎最终会不会出动他们的军队来支持马德里政府。

src: The French army is not defeated, there is a stalemate on the Western front and we need to sent more troops to the Eastern front rapidly to take pressure off our Austro-Hungarian allies that have lost Galicia to the Imperial Russian army. The von Schlieffen plan has failed.
dst: 法军并未战败，西线陷入僵局，我们需要迅速向东线增派更多部队，以减轻奥匈盟国的压力，因为帝国俄国军队已从他们手中夺取了加利西亚。施里芬计划已经失败。

src: The French have defeated you. Now their counterattack is imminent, but at least our starting positions are solidly defended. The fighting in Hartmannsweilerkopf isn't over. There will be many skirmishes in the following months until the front stabilizes again.
dst: 法军击败了您。如今他们的反攻已迫在眉睫，但至少我们的出发阵地防守稳固。哈特曼斯维勒科普夫的战斗还没有结束。此后数月还会有许多小规模交火，直到战线重新稳定下来。

src: The French invasion has failed miserably. Now our borders are safe and we just have to wait until the Schlieffen Plan ends with our total victory. The war will be over before Christmas.
dst: 法军的入侵以惨败告终。如今我们的边境安然无恙，只需等待冯·施里芬计划以我们的全胜收场。战争将在圣诞节前结束。

src: The French lines are routed, and right now all the Ypres salient is in danger. I guess that the Germans will try to assault our positions, too. But even if they don’t, we should try to stop their advance until the French reinforcements arrive. Just like we did last summer. It seems that it’s our destiny in this war.
dst: 法军阵线已经溃散，此刻整个伊普尔突出部都岌岌可危。我猜想德军也会试图进攻我们的阵地。但即便他们不这么做，我们也应该设法阻止他们推进，直到法军援军赶到。就像我们去年夏天做的那样。看来这就是我们在这场战争中的宿命。

src: The French lost 550,000 men at Verdun, the Germans 434,000, half of them fatalities.
dst: 法军在凡尔登损失了55万人，德军损失43.4万人，其中一半阵亡。

src: The French lost most of the strategic advantage that they had gradually obtained when the defenders of Metz finally surrendered on October 27. Marshall Bazaine, who had refused to recognize the new republican government, was seen as a traitor, but after a siege of more than two months he actually didn't have many options left.
dst: 当梅斯守军最终于10月27日投降时，法国人失去了他们此前逐渐取得的大部分战略优势。拒绝承认新共和政府的巴赞元帅被视为叛徒，但在被围困两个多月之后，他实际上已经没有多少选择了。

src: The French offensive has been suspended due to the heavy casualties that they were suffering. There are even rumours of mutinies among many French divisions, and a certain risk of collapse of the French Army. Nivelle's folly may have given us what we were trying to achieve at Verdun: an exhausted and demoralized France.
dst: 法军的攻势因伤亡惨重而暂停。甚至还有传言说，许多法军师中发生了兵变，法国陆军有崩溃之虞。尼韦勒的愚蠢或许让我们实现了在凡尔登一直想达到的目标：一个精疲力竭、士气低落的法国。

src: The French plan could have succeeded under other circumstances, but once again the Germans were much faster. As soon as they learnt of the march of the Army of Châlons, the Germans sent theirThird Army and their new Army of the Meuse against them. In the meantime, the Prussian First and Second Armies would remain at the siege of Metz and other secondary units, including most of the troops from Baden and Württemberg, would besiege Strasbourg.
dst: 在别的情况下，法军的计划本可能成功，但德国人又一次快得多。一得知沙隆军团的动向，德国人便派他们的第3军团和新组建的默兹军团去对付它。与此同时，普鲁士第1和第2军团将继续围攻梅斯，而其他次要部队，包括大部分来自巴登和符腾堡的军队，将围攻斯特拉斯堡。

src: The French quickly launched an offensive against Núi Bop. But instead of making a frontal assault from Chu, they decided to outflank the Chinese lines. Their plan consisted in marching along the southern bank of the Luc Nam river and then fording it, near the Chinese left. It was a daring move, that actually managed to surprise us. Our only hope was to resist the initial charges and counterattack as soon as possible.
dst: 法军迅速对努伊博普发动了进攻。但他们没有从朱发起正面突击，而是决定包抄中国军队的战线。他们的计划是沿陆南河南岸行军，然后在中国军队左翼附近涉水渡河。这是一个大胆的举动，确实令我们措手不及。我们唯一的希望就是顶住最初的几次冲击，并尽快发动反攻。

src: The French resisted the first German assaults but, exhausted and unable to receive any kind of help, they had to surrender a couple of days later. Thus Sedan became the most outstanding Prussian victory of the war: in just a few days the Germans had captured the entire Army of Châlons, including Emperor Napoleon III. After less than a month of battles, the best French units were prisoners of the Germans or were trapped at Metz.
dst: 法军顶住了德军最初的几次进攻，但因精疲力竭且无法得到任何援助，几天后不得不投降。于是，色当成为这场战争中普鲁士最辉煌的胜利：仅仅数日之内，德军便俘获了整个沙隆军团，包括拿破仑三世皇帝在内。经过不到一个月的战斗，法军最精锐的部队要么沦为德军的俘虏，要么被困于梅斯。

src: The French surprise was complete and the Chinese could do nothing but leaving Núi Bop and fleeing towards Lang Son. Then the French gathered their forces and prepared themselves for the final battle.
dst: 法军的突袭十分彻底，中国军队除了放弃努伊博普并向谅山逃去之外别无他法。随后法军集结兵力，为最后决战做准备。

src: The French were forced to retreat to Arras, in the north, in order to avoid the complete destruction of their army.
dst: 法军被迫向北撤退至阿拉斯，以免全军覆没。

src: The Fuehress entered the room along with some subordinates.In front of her the Leaders still alive and some followers all gagged and bound in a circle.Many had been beat near death.The entire floor was the image of the SS flag.Ilse pulled out Her SS daggar. "Let's see,who shall be first among You.Should I cut the throat of those who lead or those who follow.I really hate to get blood all over Our sacred flag but the cleaners do need something to do and I pay them very well so I don't think a smidgen of Blood should bother them much".Ilse toyed with the men putting the knife to their throats then pulling it away.This went on for a few minutes then a knock on the door."I have a surprise for You all,Your children and wives have come to wish a last farewell".Families of the Men were brought in.Ilse started on the children and did not stop until all those brought in were lying dead in the middle of the room.23 people at Ilse's feet,her covered in Blood.She kicked and cursed the Corpses in a Mad rage even scaring Her subordinates.She then calmed down,ran Her bloody hand through Her hair and took a deep breath." My goodness what an eventful day this has been,I hope You enjoyed the entertainment".Ilse left the room.Days later rats were released into the room.The dead and those still alive were torn to shreds.After that the area fumagated and cleaned.Two weeks later a Party held there with Big shots from German industry and even some Foreign diplomats.
dst: 女元首带着几名下属走进房间。在她面前，还活着的领导人以及一些追随者被堵住嘴、捆成一圈。许多人已被打得半死。整个地板都是党卫军旗帜的图案。伊尔泽抽出她的党卫军匕首。“让我看看，你们当中谁该第一个。我该割开那些首领的喉咙，还是那些追随者的。我真不愿把血溅到我们神圣的旗帜上，但清洁工总得有点事做，而我付他们很高的工钱，所以我想一点点血应该不怎么碍事。”伊尔泽把玩着那些男人，把刀贴上他们的喉咙又移开。这样持续了几分钟，然后传来敲门声。“我给大家准备了一个惊喜——你们的妻儿来作最后的告别了。”那些男人的家属被带了进来。伊尔泽先对孩子下手，一直没有停，直到所有被带进来的人都倒在房间中央。23个人躺在伊尔泽脚下，她浑身是血。她疯狂地踢踹、咒骂尸体，连她的下属都被吓到了。随后她平静下来，用血手捋了捋头发，深吸一口气。“天哪，今天可真是多事，希望你们喜欢这场表演。”伊尔泽离开了房间。几天后，老鼠被放进那个房间。死者和还活着的都被撕成碎片。之后该处被熏蒸清洁。两周后，那里举办了一场派对，来客是德国工业界的大人物，甚至还有一些外国外交官。

src: The Fuehress was happy.Things were falling into place as She had prophasized to those in her 'Black Circle'.Joseph Stalin was moving now.Finland was under his massive armies attack,Hungary and Romania.Britian and France were threatening War and trying to sway the Poles to join in.The Royal and French Navy had asked permission to station Fleets in Dennmark and the Denns agreed.France sent Emmisaries to Berlin but the Fuehress said the Frauland was staying out of any conflict unless attacked.Add important Women across the Globe,even the USA clammoring to join the SS/BdM bringing in money and prominence filling up the SS ranks so ILse was very happy.A knock on the door,trouble brewing in the City."Yes I know" the Fuehress responded to the group, "It was bound to happen.We have many a Day of struggle ahead before We put the males in their place,under our Boots and High Heels.I knew them chasing the Skirts around wouldn't last long.And of course the War that Stalin is bringing to our doorstep we will need those males in the factories to watch over the Slaves of Europe.Stalin's a Madman as Dear Old Adolph was but His fate will be the same in the end. We need a little time to produce the Weapons to Conquer those not of the SS/BdM.I hope the Finns and Others can hold Stalin off a while but if not then We will do what must be done".
dst: 女元首很满意。一切正按她向“黑色圈子”里那些人预言的那样发展。约瑟夫·斯大林现在动手了。芬兰正遭到他庞大军队的进攻，还有匈牙利和罗马尼亚。不列颠和法国在威胁开战，并试图拉拢波兰加入。皇家海军和法国海军已请求在丹麦驻泊舰队，丹麦人同意了。法国派使者到柏林，但女元首说“女性之国”不会卷入任何冲突，除非遭到进攻。再加上全球各地的要人女性——甚至美国——都争相加入党卫军/BdM，带来金钱和名望，充实着党卫军的队伍，所以伊尔泽非常满意。一阵敲门声，城里正在酝酿麻烦。“是的，我知道。”女元首对那群人说，“这是必然的。在我们把男性放到他们该待的位置——我们的靴子和高跟鞋之下——之前，还有很多天的斗争。我早知道他们追着裙子跑的日子不会长久。当然，斯大林给我们门口带来的这场战争，需要那些男人在工厂里看守欧洲的奴隶。斯大林像亲爱的老阿道夫一样是个疯子，但最终他的下场也会一样。我们需要一点时间来生产武器，去征服那些不属于党卫军/BdM 的人。我希望芬兰人和其他人能把斯大林拖住一阵；要是拖不住，我们就做必须做的事。”

src: The Fuehress was inspecting some new recruits.Some of the girls were from Amerika.As she walked the line She was impressed,fine specimens to change the 'Rule of Order' to the stronger sex.ILse and Her entourage stopped."What is that" She questioned.An Amerikan had a little stars and stripes pin on.The girl gave an explanation but after a few words the Fuehress told her to " Shut-up, there will be no deviations on uniforms of the SS.Make up Your mind 'Frau.You have come to the Frauland to be One of Us,have You not?Either You play our game or the game of those We will conquer.All ties before the SS must be Cut.You are either Our sister in the 'BdM' or Our enemy.Now take that off this instance,disgusting.Frau Klein (Ilse's secretary) take a note I never want to see anything disgracing the uniforms again".The pin was removed.ILse continued the inspection.ILse then inspected the Panzers.A MkIV prototype was shown among the Mark III's."Frau Klien how is the progress going on the IV's"? "Miene Fuehress,We still have some problems to solve pushing the beast that is a lot of weight,the Armor and Gun and the transmissions are really taxed.With the influx of Minds now joining Our ranks they will be solved before the 'Great Conflict' against Stalin".So ILse had Panzers that would dominate the battles on the ground and 'Frau Heyfeld of Junkers Aircraft had assured Her the Birds would be there to control the Skies.
dst: 女元首正在检阅一批新兵。有些姑娘来自美国。她沿着队列走过，颇为满意——这些都是改变“秩序规则”、让更强性别掌权的优良样本。伊尔泽和随行人员停下了脚步。“那是什么？”她问道。一名美国姑娘佩戴着一枚小小的星条旗徽章。那姑娘作了解释，可才说了几句，女元首就打断她：“闭嘴。党卫军的制服上不允许有任何偏差。想清楚，‘女士’。你到‘女性之国’来，是要成为我们中的一员，不是吗？要么你玩我们的游戏，要么玩我们将要征服的那些人的游戏。在党卫军面前，一切旧有纽带都必须斩断。你要么是‘BdM’里的姐妹，要么是我们的敌人。现在立刻把它摘下来，恶心。克莱因女士（伊尔泽的秘书），记一笔，我再也不想看到任何玷污制服的东西。”徽章被摘下了。伊尔泽继续检阅。随后她检阅装甲部队。在众多三号坦克中，展示了一辆四号坦克原型车。“克莱因女士，四号的进展如何？”“我的女元首，我们还有些问题要解决——推动这头沉重的巨兽，装甲、火炮和传动系统都承受着极大压力。随着新的人才不断加入我们的行列，这些问题会在对斯大林的‘大冲突’之前解决。”于是伊尔泽拥有了将主宰地面战斗的装甲部队；而容克飞机公司的海费尔德女士也向她保证，将有飞机来控制天空。

src: The Fuhress "this will be a little different"
dst: 女元首：“这会有点不一样”

src: The Fuhress from Berlin.Things were going as planned for the War against Russia. Production was at an all-time high.The Armee's of the SS/BdM prepared for the Crusade which would give them control over Europe and as far as the Fuhress was concerned the World.In South Africa of course there was this rather portly Gentlemen who liked His eggs overlight,a lot of butter on His roll and His coffee with just a taint of rum in it.He also was rather coarse about Dear England being occupied by SS/BdM forces."Never in the History of Mankind has such a She-devil cast Her Shadow upon the Good God fearing People of the World.She is determined in Her Madness to take the whole World down into the Pits of Hell.To Western Europe and England She has already succeeded,the Misery upon those places is ghastly.I do not understand the 'Yanks,they cannot be this Blind to what is happening and the Evil that is afoot.I know it is not 'Their Problem'.In time It will be for the Madness in Berlin cannot be contained.As a 'Good Soul' I must with all My might oppose that 'Vixen' in Berlin.That is My 'Duty'.I ask nothing less of those around Me.With Blood,sweat and toil We must succeed.Otherwise Hell awaits Us All" Churchill stated.So an attack through Sweden on Norway to try and slow down materials heading for the Reich.
dst: 女元首发自柏林。对俄战争一切按计划进行。生产处于历史最高水平。党卫军/BdM 的各集团军为这场十字军远征做着准备，它将使她们控制欧洲——而在女元首看来，是控制世界。在南非，当然有这么一位颇为肥胖的绅士，他喜欢两面煎的鸡蛋、面包卷上抹厚厚的黄油，咖啡里只加一点点朗姆酒。他对亲爱的英格兰被党卫军/BdM 部队占领一事也颇有微词。“人类历史上从未有过这样一个女魔头，把她的阴影投向世界上敬畏上帝的善良民众。她发了疯似的，执意要把整个世界拖进地狱深渊。对西欧和英格兰，她已经得手，那里的苦难触目惊心。我不理解那些美国佬，他们不可能对正在发生的事和眼前的邪恶瞎到这个地步。我知道‘那不是他们的问题’。但迟早会成为他们的问题，因为柏林的疯狂无法被遏制。作为一个‘善良的灵魂’，我必须竭尽全力对抗柏林那个‘妖妇’。这是我的‘职责’。我对我身边人的要求也是如此。我们必须以鲜血、汗水和辛劳取胜。否则地狱就在等着我们所有人。”丘吉尔如是说。于是经由瑞典对挪威发动一次进攻，试图拖慢运往帝国的物资。

src: The Fuhress made the statement to Lennigrad Commander SS Frau General Elfi Hostenferrgloss.Elfi knew She was in Stalins bullseye,He was determined to have Leningrad back in Soviet hands.Meetings in the War Cabinet would most likely include Lennigrad being mentioned,troops to be reinforced in the area and the immense supplies allocated for them.Ground in the area was gained very slow moving to Moscow compared to the Center and South Fronts and don't think the Frau Commanders in charge did not stress that point to the Fuhress.Of course the War Cabinet realized 'Elfi's Front sooner or later had to 'Break one way or the other.Recruits heading to the Conflicts now hearing the word Lennigrad just hoped that wasn't their assigned destination.These Reports started to get back to Berlin.So Lennigrad would have to start to get the biggest majority of the Fraulands new equipment to counter the morale problems that were rising.New Panzers formed SS Panzer Gruppe 'Elfi and an attack on the 51st Shock Army 47 kilometers east of Lennigrad would be made at a unmapped town know as Gorznoki before the Soviets moved first.On the flank of the 51st was 'Helmonchek's 10th Guards.Hopefully the Air Korps could keep them stifled to not intercede trapping PZ Gp 'Elfi.
dst: 女元首对列宁格勒指挥官、党卫军埃尔菲·霍斯滕费尔格洛斯女将军说了这句话。埃尔菲知道自己正处在斯大林的靶心位置，他决心把列宁格勒夺回苏联手中。战时内阁的会议上很可能会提到列宁格勒，提到要向该地区增援，以及为它们拨出的巨额补给。与中部和南部战线相比，向莫斯科方向的推进在这里极为缓慢，别以为负责的“女士”指挥官们没向女元首强调这一点。当然，战时内阁明白，埃尔菲的战线迟早得“以一种或另一种方式崩断”。如今开赴战场的补充兵一听到“列宁格勒”这个词，就只盼那不是分配给自己的目的地。这类报告开始传回柏林。于是列宁格勒必须开始优先获得“女性之国”新装备的大部分，以应对日益上升的士气问题。新组建的党卫军“埃尔菲”装甲群将在苏联人动手之前，对列宁格勒以东47公里一座地图上没有标出、名叫戈尔兹诺基的城镇发动进攻，目标是苏军第51突击集团军。第51集团军侧翼是“赫尔蒙切克”的近卫第10集团军。但愿航空军能压制住他们，使其无法插手，把党卫军“埃尔菲”装甲群困住。

src: The Fuhress walked into the room."There's too many Dam smiles in here Fraus,control Your emotions.Yes I know this is a Great Triumph over the Males,Hitlers death and Rohm's fat Ass on the run"."But Fuhress,Your Greatness has finally surfaced.Those who thought the Fuhrer was a Messiah for all His accomplishments will now surely see the Messiah to save Us all wears a skirt and High Heels and Her name is Ilse".At the statement Ilse cracked a little smile."We have a lot to do My SS,no celebrations yet.We've got to send the message to Frau General 'Kloss in Berlin,the SS Guards have to capture the Radio stations,neutralize the Home Armee and see which Generals of the Armee are going to be a problem.We have to Broadcast a message to the People to contol the Fear that will come with the Goverment being overthrown.We have to send Skirts and High Heels with Lugers into the Industry officies to seize them.The Embassies of the Foreign Countries have to be protected and believe that all is well.We do not need the French or Brits interfering with this movement.And of course We have to conjure up some statements to back Our actions up that all of this was a Necessity to save the 'Frauland'.We have made Our move,now We must face Our Destiny.However Time records Our Actions is for the Future.I know at least One Male has been put in 'His Place'.Many more will follow"! The meeting over Ilse gazed out the window,a little smile on Her face.
dst: 女元首走进房间。“这里的‘女士’们笑得太多了，控制你们的情绪。没错，我知道这是对男性的伟大胜利——希特勒死了，罗姆那肥屁股在逃。”“可是女元首，您的伟大终于显现了。那些曾以为元首凭其种种成就便是救世主的人，如今必将看到，拯救我们所有人的救世主穿着裙子、踩着高跟鞋，她的名字叫伊尔泽。”听到这话，伊尔泽微微一笑。“我们还有很多事要做，我的党卫军，现在还不到庆祝的时候。我们得给柏林的克洛斯女将军发讯息，党卫军卫队必须夺取广播电台，瘫痪本土集团军，并查明集团军里哪些将军会成为麻烦。我们必须向民众播发讯息，控制政府被推翻所带来的恐慌。我们必须把穿裙子、踩高跟鞋、挎着鲁格手枪的人派进工业部门办公室，把它们接管过来。各外国大使馆必须受到保护，并让他们相信一切安好。我们不需要法国人或英国人插手这场运动。当然，我们还得编出一套说辞来支撑我们的行动，说这一切都是为了拯救‘女性之国’的必需之举。我们已经出手，现在必须面对自己的命运。不过，时间如何记录我们的行动，是留给未来的事。我知道至少有一个男性已被‘放到他该待的位置’。还会有更多。”会议结束，伊尔泽望向窗外，脸上浮现一丝微笑。

src: The Furher has decided it is vital we take Sweden and have complete control of all the Nordic states. The Finns have found the best route for a fast drive staight to the port of Stockholm. If we capture this port and the airfields rapidly we will be able to force the Swedish government to capitulate.
dst: 元首已决定，夺取瑞典、完全掌控所有北欧国家至关重要。芬兰人找到了一条直插斯德哥尔摩港的最佳快速推进路线。若能迅速夺取该港和机场，我们就能迫使瑞典政府投降。

src: The General Staff commends you for your outstanding achievements in Norway.
dst: 总参谋部对你在挪威的卓越成就予以嘉奖。

src: The General Staff gave the order to transform your force into a fully-motorized unit.
dst: 总参谋部下令将你的部队改编为全摩托化单位。

src: The General Staff has decided that you should lead the attack against the British in North Africa.  Their will to fight has by no means been broken.  If we can push the English out of North Africa, we will gain access to the Suez Canal and the oil-rich Middle East.
dst: 总参谋部已决定由你领导对北非英军的进攻。他们的战斗意志丝毫没有瓦解。如果我们能把英国人赶出北非，就能打开通往苏伊士运河和石油资源丰富的中东的道路。

src: The General Staff has decided that you should lead the attack against the British in North Africa.  Their will to fight has by no means been broken.  If we can push the English out of North Africa, we will gain access to the Suez Canal and the oil-rich Middle East. The Italians have given you their best troops to assist you.
dst: 总参谋部已决定由你率队进攻北非的英军。他们的战斗意志远未被摧毁。若能把英国人逐出北非，我们就能通往苏伊士运河和富产石油的中东。意大利人已把他们最精锐的部队交给你助战。

src: The General Staff is already dreaming of a landing on the American mainland and I suspect that the Generals really think about it. Go back to England you are expected there already to train your troops in major amphibious landing maneuvers.
dst: 总参谋部已经在梦想登上美洲大陆了，我猜那些将军们是真的在认真考虑。返回英格兰，那里已经有人在等着你，要把你的部队训练成大规模两栖登陆的行家。

src: The General Staff is not pleased with your lackluster performance! You should take some rest and then report to the Fourth Panzer Armee headquarters at Kotelnikov!
dst: 总参谋部对你平庸的表现很不满意！你应当稍作休整，然后前往科捷利尼科沃的第4装甲集团军司令部报到！

src: The General Staff is pleased by your success in Poland.
dst: 总参谋部对你的波兰战果感到满意。

src: The General Staff is pleased with your manoeuvre. You have protected the retreat of the "17 Division d'Infanterie" and stopped the German advance. You must now join the rest of the Army for continuing the battle.
dst: 总参谋部对您的机动感到满意。您掩护了“第17步兵师”的撤退，并阻止了德军前进。现在您必须与主力会合，继续作战。

src: The General Staff is proud of your commendable manouvre. You have not only protected the retreat of the "17 Division d'Infanterie" but you have reconquered Zwijndrecht and stopped the German advance, forcing them to cross the Escaut river back. You must now join the rest of the Army for continuing the battle.
dst: 总参谋部为您值得称赞的机动感到自豪。您不仅掩护了“第17步兵师”的撤退，还夺回了兹韦恩德雷赫特，阻止了德军前进，迫使他们退回斯海尔德河对岸。现在您必须与主力会合，继续作战。

src: The General Staff is satisfied with your manoeuvre. You have protected the retreat of the "17 Division d'Infanterie" but the Germans have not stopped and are already putting pressure on our new positions. You must quickly join the rest of the Army for continuing the battle.
dst: 总参谋部对您的机动感到满意。您掩护了“第17步兵师”的撤退，但德军并未停下，已经在向我军新阵地施压。您必须迅速与主力会合，继续作战。

src: The General Staff looking for an experienced commander for a special mission. For this operation, only a selected part of your troops is needed (limited deployment). If you want to volunteer for this adventure, please travel to Berlin to receive further orders. If you want to have your well-deserved rest, please remain in your winter camp and enjoy your vacation.
dst: 总参谋部正在为一项特殊任务寻找经验丰富的指挥官。这次行动只需要你部队中经过挑选的一部分（受限部署）。如果你想志愿参加这次冒险，请前往柏林接受进一步命令。如果你想享受应得的休息，请留在你的冬季营地，好好度假。

src: The General Staff looking for an experienced commander for a special mission. For this operation, only a selected part of your troops is needed (limited deployment). If you want to volunteer for this adventure, please travel to Georgetown, British Guiana to receive further orders. If you want to have your well-deserved rest, please remain in your winter camp and enjoy your vacation.
dst: 总参谋部正在为一项特殊任务寻找经验丰富的指挥官。这次行动只需要你部队中经过挑选的一部分（受限部署）。如果你想志愿参加这次冒险，请前往英属圭亚那的乔治敦接受进一步命令。如果你想享受应得的休息，请留在你的冬季营地，好好度假。

src: The General Staff looking for an experienced commander for a special mission. For this operation, only a selected part of your troops is needed (limited deployment). If you want to volunteer for this adventure, please travel to St.John's, Newfoundland to receive further orders. If you want to have your well-deserved rest, please remain in your winter camp and enjoy your vacation.
dst: 总参谋部正在为一项特殊任务寻找经验丰富的指挥官。这次行动只需要你部队中经过挑选的一部分（受限部署）。如果你想志愿参加这次冒险，请前往纽芬兰的圣约翰斯接受进一步命令。如果你想享受应得的休息，请留在你的冬季营地，好好度假。
