src: The General Staff suspected already an Anglo-Soviet operation against the pro-German Iran. Since the 25th of August the presumption is now reality - but it's become now a Soviet solo through the resignation of India from the war, which makes the things not really easier. Three Soviet armies have crossed the border in the north and progress rapidly into the Iranian interior. The Iranian army is unable to stop this onslaught and Reza Shah Pahlavi asked us for help. For a defense of Tehran, it is now too late - try to stop the soviet advance together with the Iranians at Isfahan! You've to run about 400 km until Isfahan - order your troops in motion immediately!
dst: 总参谋部早已怀疑英苏会对亲德的伊朗采取行动。自8月25日起，这一猜测已成现实——但由于印度退出战争，如今变成了苏联单独行动，这让事情并不轻松多少。三个苏军集团军已在北面越过边境，迅速深入伊朗腹地。伊朗军队无法阻止这场猛攻，礼萨·沙阿·巴列维向我们求援。如今防守德黑兰为时已晚——试着在伊斯法罕与伊朗人一起阻止苏军推进！你须狂奔约400公里赶到伊斯法罕——立即命令部队开拔！

src: The General Staff suspected already an Anglo-Soviet operation against the pro-German Iran. Since the 25th of August the presumption is now reality.
dst: 总参谋部早已怀疑英苏会对亲德的伊朗采取行动。自8月25日起，这一猜测已成现实。

src: The General Staff thinks it is neccessary to surround the troops that have been opposing us effectively since the beginning of the invasion. You should outflank them North of Uman while the infantry armies march on their southern flank.
dst: 总参谋部认为，有必要合围自入侵之初便与我军顽强对抗的这股敌军。您应在乌曼以北迂回其侧翼，同时由步兵集团军沿其南翼推进。

src: The German 10th and 21st Panzer Divisions proved too strong for CCA. Retreat to Sbeitla.
dst: 德军第10、第21装甲师对CCA而言过于强大。撤往斯贝特拉。

src: The German 18th Army is tempting to cross our lines in several places. Your mission is to hold the line and avoid the Germans creating any bridgehead.
dst: 德军第18集团军正试图在多处突破我军防线。您的任务是守住防线，不让德军建立任何桥头堡。

src: The German 2nd and 4th Kavalerie divisions have gotten the task to cross the Gete at Halen - defended by the Belgian cavalry division - and move to Diest via Zelk. If this plan succeeds, the Belgian army will be forced to retreat to avoid getting encircled.
dst: 德军第2和第4骑兵师的任务是在哈伦渡过赫特河——该处由比利时骑兵师防守——并经泽尔克向迪斯特推进。如果这一计划成功，比利时军队将被迫撤退以避免被合围。

src: The German 406th regiment - a landwehr formation - is tasked with capturing Slantsy.  Intelligence reports that the Bolsheviks have retained control of elements of the experienced 6th Siberian division.  In addition, the Bolsheviks are amassing loyal sailors for a counterstrike from Narva.
dst: 德军第406团——一支后备军部队——的任务是占领斯兰齐。情报报告称，布尔什维克仍控制着经验丰富的西伯利亚第6师的部分部队。此外，布尔什维克正在集结忠诚的水兵，准备从纳尔瓦发起反攻。

src: The German 4th Panzer Division was forced back to its initial positions in Opatów and Wilkowiecko, and only the 12th Schützen Regiment managed to reach the rail road crossing at Izbiska. However, upon learning that the German 1st Panzer Division had managed to take Klobuck, the Polish forces were withdrawn overnight south-eastwards, to the village of Lobodno located north-east of Klobuck, and then to the second line of defence, some 12 km to the east.
dst: 德国第4装甲师被逼回其在奥帕图夫和维尔科维茨科的初始阵地，只有第12步枪团抵达了伊兹比斯卡的铁路道口。然而，在得知德国第1装甲师已夺取克沃布茨克后，波军当夜向东南撤退至克沃布茨克东北的沃博德诺村，随后又撤到以东约12公里的第二道防线。

src: The German 56th Infantry Division has crossed the Canal de Dérivation defended by the 4 "Division d'Infaterie" and has established a bridgehead around the village of Meigem.
dst: 德军第56步兵师已渡过由第4“步兵师”防守的分洪运河，并在梅海姆村周围建立了桥头堡。

src: The German 6th Army is cut off and encircled in the Stalingrad pocket. On 2 February 1943, the 6th Army, having exhausted their ammunition and food, finally capitulated after several months of battle.
dst: 德国第6集团军在斯大林格勒包围圈中被切断并合围。1943年2月2日，第6集团军在耗尽弹药与粮食后，经过数月战斗最终投降。

src: The German 76. and 295. Infanterie-Division forced the river Don with the help of pioneers, bridging pioneers and leichtes Sturmboot-Kommando 912, creating a bridgehead on the eastern shore near the villages of Vertyachii and Peskovatka. The 16. Panzer-Division and the 3. Infanterie-Division (mot.) followed once the bridgehead was secured.
dst: 德国第76和第295步兵师在工兵、架桥工兵以及第912轻型突击艇指挥部的帮助下强渡顿河，在韦尔佳奇和佩斯科瓦特卡两村附近的东岸建立了桥头堡。桥头堡稳固后，第16装甲师和第3步兵师（摩托化）随即跟进。

src: The German 7th Army and the 5th Panzer Army are on a retreat. The 1st Canadian Army soon will have contact with the enemy in the northwest. In the east the 1st Polish Armoured Division took position across the hills north of Mont Orme. In the south a French Armoured Division will arrive at the battlefield soon. Certainly the Germans will try to break the pocket from the outside and relief their trapped units. Our troops on the eastern shore of the Dives River have to expect attacks in their backyard, too.
dst: 德国第7集团军与第5装甲集团军正在撤退。加拿大第1集团军不久将在西北方向与敌接触。在东面，波兰第1装甲师已占领蒙特奥尔姆以北各高地一带的阵地。在南面，一支法国装甲师很快将抵达战场。德军必定会试图从包围圈外突围，以解救其被困部队。我军位于迪沃河（Dives）东岸的部队也必须防备其后方遭到攻击。

src: The German 8th Army had undergone a crisis in August:  following the Russian victories at Stalluponen and Gumbinnen, General von Prittwitz prepared the army for retreat behind the Vistula and was ready to abandon the fortress of Königsberg to a Russian siege.  Unsatisfied with Prittwitz's unwillingness to engage the enemy on German soil, the German Supreme Command replaced him with the retired General von Hindenburg, while tranferring the conqueror of Liege - Ludendorff - to serve as his Chief of Staff.  While en route by rail, Ludendorff and Hindenburg devised a parrying maneuver for the 8th Army:  while screening Rennekampf's advance with cavalry and Landwehr forces, to strike Samsonov's flanks with the maximum force, defeat the 2nd Army, and then bring the 8th Army to face Rennekampf's advance.
dst: 德军第8集团军在8月经历了一场危机：在俄军于斯托卢波嫩和贡比嫩取胜之后，冯·普里特维茨将军准备让部队撤至维斯瓦河后方，并打算将柯尼斯堡要塞弃之于俄军围攻。德国最高统帅部对普里特维茨不愿在本土与敌交战感到不满，便以退役的冯·兴登堡将军取而代之，同时调来列日的征服者鲁登道夫担任其参谋长。在乘火车途中，鲁登道夫和兴登堡为第8集团军谋划了一招化解之策：以骑兵和兰德韦尔部队迟滞连宁坎普夫的推进，同时以最大兵力打击萨姆索诺夫的两翼，歼灭第2集团军，然后再调第8集团军迎击连宁坎普夫的推进。

src: The German Army Group Gallwitz has attacked Litvinov's right flank at Przasnysz and have defeated the 63rd division, while pushing back the right flank of the I Turkestan Corps (Scheideman).  Without throwing the Germans back to their positions at Mlawa, we have no hope of maintaining this flank of the whole Polish Salient.
dst: 德国加尔维茨集团军群已在普扎斯内什攻击利特维诺夫的右翼，击败了第63师，同时击退了第1突厥斯坦军（沙伊德曼）的右翼。如果不把德国人赶回他们在姆瓦瓦的阵地，我们就别想守住整个波兰突出部的这一翼。

src: The German Command has kept its promise to protect Estonia's sovereignty, and your troops received very necessary combat training.  With the rank of Kolonelleitnant, You will be stationed by Lake Peipus to continue the effort to train and recruit the Estonian Army.
dst: 德军统帅部信守了保护爱沙尼亚主权的承诺，您的部队也接受了非常必要的战斗训练。以中校军衔，您将驻扎在佩普西湖畔，继续训练和招募爱沙尼亚军队。

src: The German Command has kept its promise to protect Estonia's sovereignty, and your troops received very necessary combat training.  You will be stationed by Lake Peipus to continue the effort to train and recruit the Estonian Army.
dst: 德军统帅部信守了保护爱沙尼亚主权的承诺，您的部队也接受了非常必要的战斗训练。您将驻扎在佩普西湖畔，继续训练和招募爱沙尼亚军队。

src: The German Governor, General von Beseler, escaped on a river boat. You should stop him.
dst: 德国总督冯·贝泽勒将军乘一艘内河船逃走了。您应该拦住他。

src: The German High Command has asked the Monarchy to launch a full scale attack on the Italian front. We have concentrated all available divisions (including yours) here, but the Italians outnumber our troops. They not only have more soldiers, but also more heavy artillery, planes, ammunitions, and food. Moreover, a few well experienced British and French divisions have joined them. Our plan is basically a frontal assault on Monte Grappa and across the Piave River, though -- to be honest -- it doesn't hold much hope for us. If we fail here and now, the war will be lost for sure. This means we must win at all costs! Your job is to create a bridgehead around Montello Hill.
dst: 德国最高统帅部请求君主国在意军战线发动全面进攻。我们已把包括您的师在内的所有可用师集中于此，但意军在人数上超过我们。他们不仅兵员更多，还拥有更多的重炮、飞机、弹药与粮食。此外，几个久经沙场的英法师也加入了他们。我们的计划基本是对格拉帕山及皮亚韦河对岸发起正面突击——不过，说实话，这计划对我们没抱多大希望。倘若我们此时此地失败，这场战争必败无疑。这意味着我们必须不惜一切代价取胜！您的任务是在蒙泰洛山附近建立一个桥头堡。

src: The German Operation Sonnenblume is bringing the 5th Light Division over to North Africa. It's first elements should reach the front a few days from now.
dst: 德国的“向日葵”行动正把第5轻装师运往北非。其首批部队应在几天后抵达前线。

src: The German Spring Offensive failed. We lived a horrifying nightmare for many weeks. Many times it seemed that we were doomed and that all our efforts had been in vain. And then, suddenly, it stopped. They used everything they had against our allies and us, and we resisted. Now they have very little left to keep on fighting, while thousands of fresh American troops arrive every day to help us. It's obvious that the tides of war have changed, and we must take advantage of it.
dst: 德军春季攻势失败了。我们度过了数周可怕的噩梦。很多次我们似乎注定要完蛋，一切努力都将付诸东流。然后，它突然停止了。他们倾其所有对付我们的盟友和我们，而我们顶住了。现在他们几乎没有多少东西可以继续作战了，而每天都有成千上万的美军生力部队赶来帮助我们。显然，战争的潮流已经转变，我们必须抓住这一良机。

src: The German aggressors invaded Belgium on August 4th. Despite our fierce resistance,  Liège is already under siege, and the fortress won't resist much longer.
dst: 德国侵略者于8月4日入侵比利时。尽管我们进行了顽强的抵抗，列日已经遭到围困，这座要塞撑不了多久了。

src: The German ambitions didn't stop there, though. Over the years, Germany developed strong rivalries with France and Russia, and the British Empire started to see the new country as a menace to her world hegemony. Sadly, those tensions would eventually lead to the Weltkrieg of 1914... But that's another story, that has also been told.
dst: 不过，德国的野心并未就此止步。多年来，德国与法国、俄国结下了深重的敌对，而大英帝国也开始把这个新兴国家视为对其世界霸权的威胁。可悲的是，这些紧张关系最终导致了1914年的世界大战……不过那是另一段故事，也已有人讲述。

src: The German and Austrian defenders have been completely destroyed by our combined attacks. The coordinated use of artillery, tanks, infantry and planes has been devastating, and I'm sure that's the way the wars of the future will be fought. We've taken almost 15,000 German prisoners, hundreds of guns and tons of ammunition. Even though the Krauts were already planning their retreat from the salient, our attack took them completely by surprise. What a fine victory!
dst: 德国与奥地利的守军已被我们的联合进攻彻底摧毁。炮兵、坦克、步兵与飞机的协同运用产生了毁灭性的效果，我确信未来的战争就将如此进行。我们俘虏了近15000名德军，缴获数百门火炮和成吨弹药。尽管德国佬本已在策划撤出该突出部，我们的进攻仍打得他们措手不及。真是一场漂亮的胜利！

src: The German army has launched a general offensive against our lines. Their main effort seems to be on the Leie/Lys river but our positions at the "Canal Dérivation de la Lys" are also being attacked simultaneously on several places.
dst: 德军已对我军防线发起总攻。其主攻方向似在利斯河，但我们在“利斯河分洪运河”上的阵地也在多处同时遭到攻击。

src: The German commander Von Kluck does not get permission to encircle the BEF from the West because he would run the risk of losing contact with the Second Armee to his left, so he has to attack the BEF head-on.
dst: 德军指挥官冯·克卢克未获准从西面包抄英国远征军，因为那样可能与其左翼的第2集团军失去联系，所以他只得正面强攻英国远征军。

src: The German counterattack treatened to cut off our troops west of the Sereth River.  On 21st July the Belgian Armored Car Corps was called in from Tarnopol to halt the enemy on the approaches to this key city on the Sereth.  The VI Corps made a fighting retreat with disordered communication lines.  At the Sereth the Belgians rallied our troops, and the German advance was halted.
dst: 德军的反击威胁要切断我们在塞雷特河以西的部队。7月21日，比利时装甲车军从塔尔诺波尔调来，在通往塞雷特河畔这座关键城市的要道上阻止敌人。第6军在通讯混乱的情况下边打边撤。在塞雷特河，比利时人重整了我军，德军的推进被阻止。

src: The German fascists are still in the vicinity of Bucharest. You have failed...
dst: 德国法西斯仍盘踞在布加勒斯特附近。你失败了……

src: The German fascists now turned their eyes on the Crimean peninsula with the mighty fortress of Sevastopol on it. The Crimea is only connected to the mainland, the Ukraine, with the Perekop peninsula. 24 Hours ago the enemy has surprisingly attacked and almost gained full control of the Perekop peninsula. We must retake Perekop before the fascists are able to pour their reserves into battle and break through. Good luck, comrade.
dst: 德国法西斯现在把目光投向了克里米亚半岛，以及其上坚固的塞瓦斯托波尔要塞。克里米亚只通过佩列科普半岛与大陆——乌克兰——相连。24小时前，敌人发动了突然袭击，几乎完全控制了佩列科普半岛。我们必须在法西斯能够把预备队投入战斗并实现突破之前，夺回佩列科普。祝你好运，同志。

src: The German forces attempt to cut the Eastern United States in half, while the Americans attempt to hold Knoxville.
dst: 德军试图把美国东部拦腰截断，而美军则试图守住诺克斯维尔。

src: The German general staff finally agreed to launch a major joint offensive with us against the Russian 3rd Army in Galicia, and they have sent the newly formed 11th Army to help us. General, only an imminent decisive victory can persuade Italy and Romania not to enter the war on the side of the Entente. Do not fail your country!
dst: 德国总参谋部终于同意与我们联手，对加利西亚的俄国第3集团军发动一次大规模联合攻势，并派来了新组建的第11集团军来协助我们。将军，只有一场迫在眉睫的决定性胜利才能说服意大利与罗马尼亚不加入协约国阵营参战。不要辜负您的祖国！

src: The German have deployed the 439th and 406th regiments of the 205th division.  The 439th regiment (raised from Baltic Germans in Wilna during 1917) is supported by an armored train (Panzerzug) and has the objective to capture Narva.  Use this as an opportunity to learn warfare on rails.  Apart from artillery and assault wagons, regular units may be embarked onto railroad cars for rapid transport (as is the case with the III/439 German battalion).  Armored trains are very powerful units on the battlefield, but they become severely vulnerable when encircled.
dst: 德军部署了第205师的第439团和第406团。第439团（1917年在维尔纳从波罗的海德意志人中组建）得到一列装甲列车（Panzerzug）的支援，其目标是占领纳尔瓦。请把这当作学习铁道作战的机会。除炮兵和突击车外，正规部队也可以登上铁路车厢以快速运输（正如德国第439团第三营的情况那样）。装甲列车在战场上是非常强大的单位，但一旦被包围就会变得极其脆弱。

src: The German invaders were crushed by your troops. Due to your success, we could push back the Germans by performing many counterattacks. Keep ready for further instructions.
dst: 德国入侵者被您的部队击溃。由于您的成功，我们得以通过多次反击将德军击退。保持待命，等待进一步指示。

src: The German juggernaut into the Ukraine was in general unstoppable because the Imperial Russian Army was no more. Only scattered troops were fleeing to safety. Chaos was complete. Kiev was evacuated by the Bolsheviks as soon as the Germans came near.
dst: 德国对乌克兰的碾压式进军总体上势不可挡，因为俄国皇家军队已不复存在。只有零散的部队在逃向安全地带。一片混乱。布尔什维克在德军逼近时立即撤离了基辅。

src: The German line (XXI and XXXVIII Res Corps) has been significantly fortified since our engagements here in the fall of 1915.  Expect several layers of entrenchments and concrete fieldworks.  Air reconnaissance has spotted the entire 9th Cavalry Division in reserve of this sector.
dst: 德军战线（第21和第38预备军）自我们1915年秋在此交战以来已大大加固。预计会有数层堑壕和混凝土野战工事。空中侦察已发现整个第9骑兵师作为该地段的预备队。

src: The German lines at Narungombe collapsed under heavy British pressure. Now the British advance will cut Von Lettow's route of escape and he will be forced to surrender.  Your campaign is over.
dst: 纳伦贡贝的德军防线在英军的重压之下崩溃了。现在，英军的推进将切断冯·莱托的退路，他将被迫投降。您的战役结束了。

src: The German panzercorps will form the right wing of the assault.  The Axis corps will form the left wing.  We expect the right to be able to penetrate quickly on the far right flank, and then race for the far objectives.
dst: 德国装甲军将构成突击的右翼，轴心国军构成左翼。我们预期右翼能在最右端迅速突破，然后疾驰夺取远处目标。

src: The German plan for the 1940 campaign in the west centered around a surprise strike through the dense Ardennes forest, emerging at Sedan to drive across France to the English Channel. This portion of the French line was considered the safest outside of Maginot, shielded as it was by the heavily forested Ardennes.
dst: 德军1940年西线战役的计划核心，是穿过茂密的阿登森林发动突然打击，在色当穿出，然后横贯法国直抵英吉利海峡。法军防线的这一段被认为是马奇诺防线之外最安全的地段，因为有森林密布的阿登作为屏障。

src: The German salient still exists and you have failed although best efforts of us. The Germans have progressed in the south, too. To stop the Faschists in the south we will need a more talented general then you.
dst: 德军的突出部依然存在，尽管我们竭尽全力，你还是失败了。德军在南面同样取得了进展。要在南面挡住法西斯分子，我们需要一个比你更有才华的将军。

src: The German troops have broken through the Latvians' southern flank and are retreating toward Riga.  You must knock them out of the town at all costs.
dst: 德国部队已突破拉脱维亚人的南翼，正向里加撤退。您必须不惜一切代价把他们赶出该城。

src: The German victories in East Africa in the first months of the war were astonishing, but the British would not give up so easily. Shortly after the battle of Jasin they prepared a raid against German positions at Bukoba. That will be your next destination.
dst: 战争头几个月里德国人在东非取得的胜利令人惊讶，但英国人不会轻易放弃。亚辛之战后不久，他们便筹划对布科巴的德军阵地发动一次袭击。那将是您的下一站。

src: The German-Italian force attempts to capture Tobruk in North Africa.
dst: 德意军队试图夺取北非的托布鲁克。

src: The Germano-Austrian counter-attack has devastated our 4th Army in viscinity of the town of Marasesti, and the Romanian 1st Army has taken positions behind our 4th to aid in their withdrawal.  You orders are to hold the front lines with our Romanian allies for as long as the Front command requires.  You will be given specific orders to withdraw.  Failure here will award the Germans a chance to envelop the southern wing of our South-Western Front.
dst: 德奥联军的反击在马勒谢什蒂镇附近重创我第4集团军，罗马尼亚第1集团军已在我第4集团军之后占领阵地，以助其撤退。您的命令是与我罗马尼亚盟友一同坚守战线，守到方面军指挥部要求的时间为止。您将得到明确的撤退命令。这里一旦失利，德军就将有机会合围我们西南方面军的南翼。

src: The Germans again proved their resilience and combative spirit and that, added to the terrible weather and the muddy terrain, prevented us from obtaining the breakthrough that we had been trying to gain for so long. The third battle of Ypres became one of the bloodiest in the war. After three months of fighting, and just like it had happened at the Somme, our advances were minimal, and the Germans were severely weakened, but not destroyed.
dst: 德军再次证明了他们的韧性和战斗精神，而这一点，再加上恶劣的天气和泥泞的地形，使我们未能取得长期以来一直试图实现的突破。第三次伊普尔战役成为整场战争中最血腥的战役之一。经过三个月的战斗，正如索姆河发生过的那样，我们的进展微乎其微，德军遭到严重削弱，但并未被歼灭。

src: The Germans and Romanians have several divisions in this area. More precisely you are fighting against the Heeresgruppe Südukraine which consists of the Army Group Wohler, the Army Group Dumitrescu and the 4th Romanian Army. The Germans have some heavy tanks and will be able to perform a hard counterattack if you are not able to perform a good first strike. The Romanians have suffered heavy losses in the war and their troops are quite under normal strength.
dst: 德国人与罗马尼亚人在此地区部署了若干师。更确切地说，你面对的是南乌克兰集团军群，它由沃勒集团军、杜米特雷斯库集团军以及罗马尼亚第4集团军组成。德国人拥有一些重型坦克，若你无法打出漂亮的首轮打击，他们将能够发动猛烈反击。罗马尼亚人在战争中损失惨重，其部队兵力相当不足。

src: The Germans and Romanians try to reopen the supply line to Stalingrad, while the Soviets dig in and await the attack.
dst: 德国人和罗马尼亚人试图重新打通通往斯大林格勒的补给线，而苏军则挖壕据守，等着他们进攻。

src: The Germans and their allies invade the USA near Savannah.
dst: 德国及其盟友在萨凡纳附近入侵美国。

src: The Germans and their allies, the Rumanians, attacking Bessarabia. Stop the advance of the axis troops.
dst: 德国人及其盟友罗马尼亚人正在进攻比萨拉比亚。阻止轴心国部队的推进。

src: The Germans are about to launch an attack on theBritish strogpoint Gibraltar. They have called for assistance and Il Duce decided to send his best men. Your men! Your experienced men will attack Gibraltar from the eastern shores. A Paratrooper brigade and a heavy artillery regiment have been secretly transfered to Spain. They will join your core forces, as will a heavy cruiser and a submarine.
dst: 德国人即将对英军据点直布罗陀发动进攻。他们已请求援助，Il Duce 决定派出他最好的部下。就是你的人！你这些身经百战的部下将从东岸进攻直布罗陀。一个伞兵旅和一个重炮团已秘密转移至西班牙。他们将加入你的核心部队，同时加入的还有一艘重巡洋舰和一艘潜艇。

src: The Germans are advancing northwards, with the Baltic Territorial Army in the center and eastern flank and the Iron Division in the west. Prepare for several attacks!
dst: 德军正向北推进，波罗的海领土军位于中央和东翼，铁师位于西面。做好应对多次进攻的准备！

src: The Germans are attacking our lines at Prokhorowka. Resist all Germans attacks and lead a conterattack against Belgorod.
dst: 德军正在进攻我们在普罗霍罗夫卡的防线。顶住德军的一切进攻，并对别尔哥罗德发起反击。

src: The Germans are expected to field more experienced troops and armor that they keep on shipping from Italy. This attack won't be a walk in the park.
dst: 预计德军将投入更有经验、并不断从意大利海运而来的部队与装甲。这场进攻绝非易事。

src: The Germans are holding the main battleline and are certain a swift strike from the NW around Dropov, plus an airborne landing with naval resupply in the NE around Rostoff and also a huge armour spearhead up the West flank, will cause the eventual collapse of the whole front.
dst: 德军正固守主战线，并确信：从西北方向德罗波夫一带发起的迅猛突击，加上东北方向罗斯托夫一带的伞降登陆与海上补给，以及西翼一支庞大的装甲矛头，终将导致整条战线全面崩溃。

src: The Germans are in disarray and in full retreat. They have clearly lost the war and are expected to surrender any day now.
dst: 德军已陷入混乱，正全面撤退。他们显然已经输掉了战争，预计随时都会投降。

src: The Germans are not numerous, but they have some serious tanks. Because of the near of the Germans to Zhitomir they may be able to lead a devastating attack onto your troops. So, be careful.
dst: 德军兵力并不算多，但他们有一些厉害的坦克。由于德军距日托米尔很近，他们可能对你的部队发动毁灭性打击。因此，务必小心。

src: The Germans are withdrawing towards the Rhine and the Low Countries, following our victories in Normandy.  Further advance however, on the 'broad front strategy' is becoming increasingly difficult, due to supply problems.  It is therefore impossible to continue to ensure all units are in a state of 'combat supply' and an attack across a narrow front is our only option at this stage.
dst: 诺曼底取胜之后，德军正向莱茵河和低地国家退却。然而，由于补给问题，“宽正面战略”下的进一步推进正日益困难。因此，继续确保所有部队都处于“战斗补给”状态已不可能，在这一阶段，跨越狭窄正面发动进攻是我们唯一的选择。

src: The Germans attack the American and French forces near Strassbourg.  Reinforcements for the Allies will arrive from the west in the vicinity of the villages Rehrbaon, Puberg and La-Petite-Pierre and the city of Saverne throughout the early stages of the battle.
dst: 德军进攻斯特拉斯堡附近的美法军队。战斗前期的各个阶段，盟军增援将从西面抵达雷尔博、普贝尔和拉佩蒂特皮埃尔各村以及萨韦尔讷城附近。

src: The Germans attempt to push through central Norway, hoping to destroy the Norwegian army before the British Expeditionary Force arrives.
dst: 德军试图穿过挪威中部，希望在英国远征军抵达之前歼灭挪威军队。

src: The Germans attempt to push through the Australian and New Zealand lines on the way to Athens, Greece.
dst: 德军试图在通往希腊雅典的路上突破澳大利亚和新西兰军队的防线。

src: The Germans didn't stop their operations, either. Just a few days after Sedan the Meuse Army and the Third Army went on to Paris. By 19 September the encirclement of the French capital was complete.
dst: 德军同样没有停止作战。色当战役之后仅几天，默兹集团军和第三集团军便继续向巴黎进军。到9月19日，对法国首都的包围已经完成。

src: The Germans drive on the road towards Moscow.
dst: 德军沿公路向莫斯科推进。

src: The Germans had to give up most of Northern France and a substantial part of Flanders, having to abandon increasingly large amounts of heavy equipment and supplies, further reducing their already low morale and capacity to resist.
dst: 德军不得不放弃法国北部大部分地区和佛兰德斯的相当一部分，被迫抛弃越来越多的大量重型装备和补给，进一步削弱了他们本已低落的士气和抵抗能力。

src: The Germans have been forced to retreat with heavy losses that they will not be able to replace. With his army decimated Von Lettow had no other option but to surrender.  Your campaign is over.
dst: 德军被迫撤退，蒙受了他们无法弥补的惨重损失。由于他的军队已被打残，冯·莱托别无选择，只能投降。您的战役结束了。

src: The Germans have blown most of the bridges over the Aisne River, but the one at Bourg seems to be still intact.
dst: 德军已炸毁埃纳河上的大部分桥梁，但布尔格的那座似乎仍完好无损。

src: The Germans have captured the initiative and have forced our 10th Army to slowly retreat through the Augustow Forest.  This has created a dangerous gap of 50 km on the north flank.  Von Hindenburg, sensing another opportunity to encircle large numbers of our forces, has rushed the XXXVIII and XXXIX Reserve Corps to exploit the gap.
dst: 德国人夺取了主动权，并迫使我们的第10集团军穿过奥古斯图夫森林缓缓撤退。这在北翼造成了一个50公里宽的危险缺口。冯·兴登堡察觉到又一次包围我方大部队的机会，已急调第38和第39预备军前来利用这一缺口。

src: The Germans have fled the area, and the Russians have taken hundreds of prisoners. However, our intelligence reports confirm that fresh enemy troops will launch a counterattack in a few hours, and the Russians have already exhausted their reserves. We won't be able to hold the positions that we've just taken, so we'll have to cancel the offensive and retreat in order to our trenches.
dst: 德军已经逃离了该地区，俄军俘获了数百名战俘。然而，我们的情报报告证实，几小时后敌军生力部队将发起反攻，而俄军的预备队已经耗尽。我们将无法守住刚刚夺取的阵地，因此只得取消攻势，撤退回我们的战壕。

src: The Germans have had a difficult time but despite your efforts our position is very weak and sooner than expected we will need to evacuate Vinkt.
dst: 德军打得很艰难，但尽管你努力了，我们的阵地仍非常虚弱，我们将比预期更早地需要撤出芬克特。

src: The Germans have just entered into Luxembourg and will soon cross the Belgian border and enter into the Belgian Ardennes. You must support the "1ére Division de Chasseurs Ardennais
dst: 德军刚刚进入卢森堡，很快就会越过比利时边界，进入比利时阿登地区。你必须支援“1ére Division de Chasseurs Ardennais

src: The Germans have launched a surprise followup to their failed attack on Villiers-Bretonneaux and have taken the village. You must withstand this onslaught and retake the village!!! (There is only 2 possible outcomes:- Brilliant Victory for holding your 4 Vic Hexs OR Loss for not holding them).
dst: 德国人对维莱布勒托讷失败的进攻发动了出人意料的后续攻势，并夺取了该村。您必须顶住这次猛攻并夺回村庄！！！（只有两种可能的结果：守住4个胜利点获大捷，或者守不住而失败）。

src: The Germans have launched an offensive against the French and British positions, just on our right flank, and have crossed the Ypres Canal at Steenstraat. Can you see that strange fog over there? Those animals are using some kind of poisonous gas against our allies!
dst: 德军对我们右翼正面的法军和英军阵地发起了进攻，并在斯滕斯特拉特渡过了伊普尔运河。您看见那边那团奇怪的雾气了吗？那些畜生正用某种毒气对付我们的盟友！

src: The Germans have left the city and have taken positions east of the town. The Germans in this area are really weak. However, the area of the bottleneck is surrounded with mine field and other blockings. We have reliable information that the Germans do big troop movements. They have removed troops from the Heeresgruppe Süd and Heeresgruppe Nord to relieve the pocket. Moreover, troops in the pocket try to meet these troops halfway. Be fast, because the enemy is outnumbered.
dst: 德军已放弃该城，并在城东占据了阵地。这一地区的德军确实很弱。不过，隘口地带布满了雷场和其他障碍物。我们有可靠情报表明德军正在进行大规模的部队调动。他们已从南方集团军群和北方集团军群抽调部队前来解围。此外，包围圈内的德军也试图与这些部队会合。要快，因为敌军兵力处于劣势。

src: The Germans have many tank divisions, infantry divisions and bomber squadrons. You should calculate with heavy attacks from the west and the south. The strongest German troops are deployed in the southwest.
dst: 德军拥有许多装甲师、步兵师和轰炸机中队。你应当预料到来自西面和南面的猛烈进攻。德军最强的部队部署在西南方向。

src: The Germans have received reinforcements (225th Infantry Division) and have now secured the bridgehead of Meigem. They are now attacking the positions near Vinkt. This is an important crossroads that has to be held at all costs.
dst: 德军得到了增援（第225步兵师），现在已经稳固控制了梅海姆桥头堡。他们正在进攻芬克特附近的阵地。这是一个重要的十字路口，必须不惜一切代价守住。

src: The Germans have routed your Anzacs and now the whole sector is in danger of collapse!! Maybe you will have better luck against the Turks in the Middle East!!
dst: 德国人击溃了您的澳新军团，如今整个地段都有崩溃的危险！！也许您在中东对付土耳其人会走运些！！

src: The Germans have taken Rostov with a number of motorized and armoured formations with lightening speed. However in the urban area of Rostov they have a huge disadvantage. Even more, the fascists advance has created a salient into our lines and this offers the possibility of encircling the fascists at Rostov. The winter has arrived and the plains are covered with snow. This is the time to attack again and drive them back west! Good luck, comrade.
dst: 德军以闪电般的速度，用若干摩托化和装甲兵团夺取了罗斯托夫。然而在罗斯托夫城区，他们处于巨大的劣势。更重要的是，法西斯的推进在我军战线中形成了一个突出部，这提供了在罗斯托夫包围法西斯的可能。冬天已经到来，平原上白雪皑皑。这是再次进攻、把他们赶回西面的时刻！祝你好运，同志。

src: The Germans knew that there wasn't any time to lose. They wanted to destroy the Army of the Rhine before the French could react. Just two days after Mars-la-Tour they attacked their enemies again, along the Gravelotte-Sankt Privat line, less than 10 Km west of Metz, where Bazaine's forces had built a defensive position.
dst: 德国人深知刻不容缓。他们想在法军反应过来之前歼灭莱茵军团。马尔斯拉图尔之战仅仅两天后，他们便再次进攻敌人，沿着格拉沃洛特-圣普里瓦一线，位于梅斯以西不到10公里处，巴赞的部队在那里构筑了防御阵地。

src: The Germans know that, if things go on like this, we won't be able to remain in this war for much longer, so they've decided to help us. Our spring offensive will be, in fact, a joint Austro-Hungarian-German operation against the Russian left flank, in the Görlitz- Tarnów front. If we succeed, the Russians will have to leave the mountain passes on the Karpaten, to avoid being trapped there. It can be an excellent opportunity to change the course of the war in the east.
dst: 德国人知道，如果这样下去，我们撑不了多久，于是决定帮助我们。我们的春季攻势实际上将是奥匈与德国联手对俄军左翼、对格尔利茨—塔尔努夫战线的一次行动。倘若成功，俄国人将不得不放弃喀尔巴阡山的山口，以免被困在那里。这可能是扭转东线战局的绝佳机会。

src: The Germans managed to give the Belgians a tactical defeat. The 7th division was almost completely destroyed and had to be sent to France for reorganisation. The Belgians could only stop the Germans for one day at the Albert canal instead of the three days initially planned. But worse, the loss of the Eben-Emael fortress was a serious psychological blow.
dst: 德军得以给比利时人一场战术失败。第7师几乎被全歼，不得不被送往法国整编。比利时人在阿尔贝运河只能阻挡德军一天，而不是原计划的三天。但更糟的是，失去埃本-埃马尔要塞是一次严重的心理打击。

src: The Germans mobilized their reserves faster than we did, and, deprived of any proper support, we had to go back to the left bank of the Aisne. It was then when I was informed that my son Michael had been wounded in a skirmish soon after his division had crossed the Marne. However, I was relieved to know that it was nothing too serious, and that he would recover in just a few weeks.
dst: 德军调动预备队的速度比我们快，由于得不到任何像样的支援，我们不得不退回埃纳河左岸。就在这时，我得知我的儿子迈克尔在他的师渡过马恩河后不久，在一场小规模交火中负伤了。不过，得知伤情并不太重，而且几周内就能痊愈，我松了一口气。

src: The Germans must inflict a severe enough defeat that the Allies begin evacuating the beaches.
dst: 德军必须给盟军以足够沉重的打击，迫使他们开始从海滩撤离。
德军始终未能抵达巴库。

src: The Germans numbers were just too big for our depleted army. Luckily Hendrik Geeraert - a skipper from Nieuwpoort - came up with a way to open the sluices of the Yzer at the right times to flood the complete area from Nieuwpoort to Diksmuide. That will prevent the Germans from ever mounting another big attack in our sector of the front.
dst: 德军的兵力对我们疲惫不堪的军队来说实在太多了。幸运的是，亨德里克·海拉尔特——一位来自尼乌波特的船长——想出了一个办法，在恰当的时机打开伊泽尔河的水闸，淹没从尼乌波特到迪克斯迈德的整个区域。这将使德军再也无法在我们这段战线发起大规模进攻。

src: The Germans proceed in the west with many tanks and infantry. The Panzergruppe 2 and the advance guard of the 17. Army are completely motorized and have mainly Panzer II and Panzer III tanks.
dst: 德军正以大量坦克和步兵在西面推进。德军第2装甲集群和第17集团军的先遣部队已完全摩托化，主要装备 II号坦克和 III号坦克。

src: The Germans responded to our requests for help and have sent over General Erwin Rommel with what should soon be 2 divisions. The German Fliegerkorps X was moved from Norway to Sicily December last year to patrol the sea lines between Italy and Libya.
dst: 德国人回应了我们的求援，派来了埃尔温·隆美尔将军，随行的部队不久将达两个师。德国第10航空军去年12月从挪威调往西西里，以巡弋意大利与利比亚之间的海上航线。

src: The Germans started their attempt to seize Rostov on 17 November and captured the city on 21 November. However, the German lines were over-extended and on 27 November the Soviets launched a counterattack. The Germns eventually had to retreat and took positions around Taganrog and behind the Mius river for the remainder of the winter 1941/1942 and spring 1942.
dst: 德军于11月17日开始尝试夺取罗斯托夫，并于11月21日占领该城。然而德军战线过度延伸，11月27日苏军发动反击。德军最终不得不撤退，在1941/1942年冬及1942年春余下的时间里在塔甘罗格周边和米乌斯河后方设防。

src: The Germans took Narvik quickly but later lost 10 destroyers (50% of their entire destroyer force) and were pushed eastwards by the allied forces. The Germans even had to consider reatreating into neutral Sweden and getting interned. However, the situation at the western front in France forced the Allies to retreat. On 8 June, General Dietl retook Narvik, and on 10 June the last Norwegian forces in Norway surrendered.
dst: 德军迅速夺取了纳尔维克，但后来损失了10艘驱逐舰（占其全部驱逐舰兵力的一半），并被盟军向东逼退。德军甚至不得不考虑撤入中立的瑞典、遭到扣留。然而，法国西线的局势迫使盟军撤退。6月8日，迪特尔将军重新夺回纳尔维克，6月10日，挪威最后的部队投降。

src: The Germans try to break through the Anglo-French lines and capture the French city of Dunkirk.
dst: 德军试图突破英法联军防线，夺取法国城市敦刻尔克。

src: The Germans try to open the gate to Moscow at Klin, while the Soviet forces attempt to slam it closed.
dst: 德军试图在克林打开通往莫斯科的大门，而苏军则试图把这扇门砰然关上。

src: The Germans were close to reaching their new borders on the border of Russia and the Ukraine. German forces made rapid advances using the railways. A collision between German troops and the Czech Legion is about to take place near the village of Bachmatsj, between Kiev and Konotop. To avoid capture it might be needed to fight a way east. Soviet Red Army troops are in the same position and are also trying to flee east. Cooperation with the Communists could be useful to our cause.
dst: 德军已接近他们在俄国与乌克兰边境上的新边界。德军利用铁路迅速推进。德军部队与捷克军团的遭遇战即将在基辅与科诺托普之间的巴赫马奇村附近爆发。为避免被俘，可能需要向东杀出一条血路。苏联红军部队处境相同，也在设法向东逃跑。与共产党人合作或许对我们的事业有益。

src: The Germans will most likely not stand back if we capture the first big German city. There is a high possibility of counterattacks. It is not advisable to use your armoured units like tanks in street fighting. So you should deploy your armoured forces in the south and try to flank Aachen to stop possible counterattacks northeast of the city.
dst: 如果我们夺取德国第一座大城市，德军多半不会袖手旁观。敌军发动反攻的可能性很高。让坦克一类的装甲单位参与巷战并不可取。因此你应在南面部署你的装甲部队，并设法迂回亚琛侧翼，以阻止该城东北方向可能出现的反攻。

src: The Germans will send us strong air support, but there will be many hostile airplanes, too.....
dst: 德国人将为我们提供强大的空中支援，但也会有许多敌机……

src: The Government has just named General Weyler governor with full powers to suppress the insurgency and restore political order and the sugar industry in Cuba..
dst: 政府刚刚任命韦勒将军为总督，授予其全权以镇压起义，恢复古巴的政治秩序和制糖业。

src: The Grand Army of All Tribes
The Grand Army of all Tribes
The Grand Army of the united Tribes

The Great powers of Europe feared that Athens could fall, so on May 20th they forced the Ottomans to accept an armistice. Greece had to cede minor areas on its northern border and pay heavy reparations (4 million Ottoman pounds). Since Greece was an insolvent country, it had to accept an International Financial Control commission, which in effect diverted the Greek state's main income sources  to the repayment of Greece's public loans. Crete however did become an autonomous state under international supervision, while remaining under the Sultan's suzerainty.
dst: 欧洲列强担心雅典可能陷落，于是在5月20日迫使奥斯曼接受停战。希腊不得不割让其北部边境的一些小块地区，并支付巨额赔款（400万奥斯曼镑）。由于希腊是一个破产国家，它不得不接受一个国际财政管制委员会，该委员会实际上把希腊国家的主要收入来源都转用于偿还希腊的公共贷款。不过，克里特岛确实成为一个国际监督下的自治邦，同时仍处于苏丹的宗主权之下。

src: The Greek Resistence have established a base on some outer islands and are being supplied by the Royal Navy. You must launch an amphibious assault on these islands. The Italians will attack the southern island. Your role is to attack the  2 smaller islands. Good luck General.
dst: 希腊抵抗运动在外围一些岛屿上建立了基地，正由皇家海军补给。你必须对这些岛屿发起两栖突击。意大利人将进攻南面的岛屿，你的任务是进攻那两座较小的岛。祝你好运，将军。

src: The Greek advance was halted at Inonu.  For some months there was a stalemate, as both sides had suffered great casualties and coudn't continue the military operations until they have recovered.
dst: 希腊人的推进在伊诺努被遏止。此后数月陷入僵局，因为双方都伤亡惨重，在恢复元气之前都无法继续军事行动。

src: The Greek advance was halted at Inonu. For some months there was a stalemate, as both sides had suffered great casualties and coudn't continue the military operations until they have recovered.
dst: 希腊军队的推进在伊诺努受阻。由于双方伤亡惨重，无法在恢复元气之前继续军事行动，战局僵持了数月。

src: The Greek army began its final offensive on July 16, 1921, overcoming our defenses and taking Eski Shehir on the 17th. Our troops retreated with heavy losses to a defence line behind the Sakarya River, just 50 miles from our capital, Ankara.
dst: 希腊军队于1921年7月16日发起最后攻势，突破了我们的防线，并于17日占领埃斯基谢希尔。我军损失惨重，撤退到萨卡里亚河后方的防线，那里距我们的首都安卡拉仅50英里。

src: The Greek army began its offensive on July 16, 1921, overcame the Turkish defense and took Eski Shehir the 17th. The Turks retreated with heavy losses to a position behind the Sakarya River, just 50 miles from Ankara, the Turkish capital.
dst: 希腊军队于1921年7月16日开始进攻，突破了土耳其人的防线，并于17日攻占埃斯基谢希尔。土耳其人损失惨重，撤退到萨卡里亚河后方的阵地，那里距土耳其首都安卡拉仅50英里。

src: The Greeks held their own throughout the day. After nightfall, however, with his line of retreat being threatened, Colonel Smolenski withdrew to Volo, where he embarked his troops on May 7th.
dst: 希腊人一整天都坚守不退。然而入夜后，由于撤退路线受到威胁，斯莫伦斯基上校撤往沃洛斯，并于5月7日在那里让部队登船。

src: The Greeks lost the initiative of the war after Sakarya. Although the battle ended in a stalemate, Greece missed her only chance to annex large parts of Anatolia. The Turkish rebels of the Grand National Assembly had become too strong, and the Western Powers started to see them as valid interlocutors.
dst: 希腊人在萨卡里亚之战后失去了战争主动权。虽然这场战役打成僵局，但希腊失去了吞并安纳托利亚大片地区的唯一机会。土耳其大国民议会的起义军已经变得过于强大，西方列强开始把他们视为有效的谈判对象。

src: The Greeks weren't affected by this minor setback, and soon prepared a much larger army. They are confident that this time they will overcome our defences at Inonu, and they don't seem to care about the fact that we have reinforced ourselves, too. As a result, a major battle will take place very soon.
dst: 希腊人并未受这次小挫折的影响，很快便组建了一支庞大得多的军队。他们确信这次能突破我们在伊诺努的防线，而且似乎毫不在意我们也已加强自身的事实。因此，一场大战很快就会打响。

src: The Habsburg K.u.K Army has suffered tremendous losses ever since 1914 and of the hundreds of thousands prisoners, a considerable number of Czech were part of that. Our political leaders, like Masaryk and Durich, have received permission from the Russian Tsar to form a Czech Legion. In 1916 two Czech regiments were formed. Early 1917 a revolution takes place in Russia which forces the Tsar to abdicate. Under the new government, lead by Kerensky, Russia continues the war against Austria-Hungary and the Germany. The Czech Legion is expanded to brigade size and is deployed at the southern front against the Austro-Hungarian K.u.K Army in the area of Zborow when Kerensky orders an offensive.
dst: 自1914年以来，哈布斯堡的奥匈帝国皇家军队蒙受了惨重损失，而在数十万战俘中，有相当数量是捷克人。我们的政治领袖，如马萨里克和杜里赫，已获得俄国沙皇的许可组建捷克军团。1916年，组建了两个捷克团。1917年初，俄国爆发革命，迫使沙皇退位。在克伦斯基领导的新政府治下，俄国继续对奥匈帝国和德国作战。当克伦斯基下令进攻时，捷克军团扩编到旅级规模，并被部署在南线，在兹博罗夫地区对抗奥匈帝国皇家军队。

src: The Harz Fortress is more a myth than reality. Although there was some fighting, the Allied forces were able to bypass the mountain range easily in the nort hand south on their way to the Elbe river.
dst: 哈茨要塞更多是传说而非现实。尽管那里有过一些战斗，但盟军在向易北河推进的途中，很容易就从南北两侧绕过了这条山脉。

src: The Heeresgruppe Mitte still have strong troops, but they have only few tanks. On the other side you have to calculate with strong fire of high-range artillery and the German Luftwaffe has strong bomber forces in this area. The areas behind the bridges are well prepared for your attack, but if you are breaken through the resistance will be smaller.
dst: 中央集团军群仍有强大兵力，但坦克很少。另一方面，你必须提防远程炮兵的强大火力，且德国空军在这一地区拥有强大的轰炸机力量。桥后区域已为你的进攻做好准备，但一旦你突破，抵抗将会减弱。

src: The Herero have overrun us! Many of our Settlers and brave Soldiers were killed! How could this happen? Here you have a Pistol, I will go...
dst: 赫雷罗人击溃了我们！我们的许多定居者和勇敢的士兵惨遭杀害！这怎么会发生？这里给您一把手枪，我先走了……

src: The High Command agreed reluctantly to your demand that all arrangements for the transportation of your troops to Tunesia be handled by direct courier, never by radio.  Our Enigma codes are unbreakable of course, but since Feldmarschall Rommel supported you in this we agreed. It is undoubtedly only coincidence that the convoy carrying you and your troops had no Allied interference.
dst: 最高统帅部勉强同意了你的要求：把你部队运往突尼斯的一切安排都由专人信使办理，绝不经无线电。我们的“恩尼格玛”密码当然是无法破译的，但既然隆美尔陆军元帅在这件事上支持你，我们也就同意了。运载你和你部队的船队未受盟军袭扰，这无疑只是巧合。

src: The High Command agreed reluctantly to your demand that all arrangements for the transportation of your troops to Tunisia be handled by direct courier, never by radio.  Our Enigma codes are unbreakable of course, but since Feldmarschall Rommel supported you in this we agreed. It is undoubtedly only a coincidence that the convoy carrying you and your troops had no Allied interference.
dst: 最高统帅部勉强同意了你的要求：你部运往突尼斯的全部安排须由专人信使处理，绝不使用无线电。我们的 Enigma 密码当然无法破译，但既然隆美尔元帅支持你，我们便同意了。运载你和你部队的船队未受盟军任何干扰，这无疑只是巧合。

src: The High Command once again noticed your capabilities. You retain the command of the brigade, and you are tasked with its reorganisation and expansion. Our air support will be increased to a Gruppe, probably with another batch of prototypes.
dst: 最高统帅部再次注意到你的才干。你留任该旅指挥，并受命对其进行重组与扩编。我们的空中支援将加强至一个大队（Gruppe），或许还会再拨一批原型机。

src: The High Command once again noticed your capabilities. You retain the command of the brigade, and you are tasked with its reorganisation and expansion. Our air support will be increased to a Gruppe.
dst: 最高统帅部再次注意到你的才干。你留任该旅指挥，并受命对其进行重组与扩编。我们的空中支援将加强至一个大队（Gruppe）。

src: The High Command reacted quickly. All ou army was reorganized, our units went to the Chelyabinsk area as a reinforcement, and as a part of our newly created 3rd Army we were told to deploy southeast of Chelyabinsk. The plan was to lure the Red units into the city, and then encircle them and defeat them.
dst: 最高统帅部反应迅速。全军重新整编，我们的部队作为增援前往车里雅宾斯克地区，作为新组建的第三集团军的一部分，我们奉命部署在车里雅宾斯克东南。计划是把红军部队诱入城中，然后包围并击败他们。

src: The High Command thinks it is neccessary to cut communications between Kiev and Moscow before both cities can be taken - an idiotic waste of time, but what can we do? You must make a thrust through Lubny east of Kiev and cut the Kiev to Moscow railway. There you will join hands with Guderian's panzers from Army Group Center.
dst: 最高统帅部认为，在攻取基辅与莫斯科之前，须先切断两城之间的联系——纯属浪费时间的蠢举，可我们又能如何？您须自基辅以东的卢布内实施突击，切断基辅通往莫斯科的铁路。在那里，您将与中央集团军群古德里安的装甲部队会师。

src: The High Command thinks it is neccessary to cut communications between Leningrad and Moscow before the cities can be taken - an idiotic waste of time, but what can we do? You must make a thrust through Staraya Russa south of Novgorod and cut the Leningrad to Moscow railway.
dst: 最高统帅部认为，在夺取两城之前必须先切断列宁格勒与莫斯科之间的交通——愚蠢的浪费时间之举，但我们又能怎样？你必须穿过诺夫哥罗德以南的旧鲁萨发动突击，切断列宁格勒至莫斯科的铁路。

src: The High Command wants to encircle the rebel troops, create a pocket, and then destroy it. This will allow us to push the rebel lines far away from Madrid. A success here would make the rebels withdraw troops from the Austrian Front in the North, which is under horrible pressure.
dst: 最高统帅部想要包围叛军，形成一个口袋，然后将其歼灭。这将使我们能够把叛军战线远远推离马德里。这里一旦成功，叛军就会从北面承受着可怕压力的奥地利战线撤走兵力。

src: The Hindenburg Line has fallen. Now the Australians and the British can keep on advancing. The Germans are doomed.
dst: 兴登堡防线已被突破。如今澳大利亚人和英国人可以继续推进。德国人气数已尽。

src: The Hungarian capital of Budapest is besieged by the Red Army.  The Germans must break through the Soviet lines to help their last remaining ally.
dst: 匈牙利首都布达佩斯被红军围困。德军必须突破苏军防线，去援助他们硕果仅存的盟友。

src: The Imperial Japanese Navy (IJN) Special Naval Landing Forces troops in gas masks prepare for an advance in the rubble of Shanghai, China, August 1937.
dst: 日本帝国海军（IJN）特别陆战队士兵戴着防毒面具，准备在中国上海的废墟中推进，1937年8月。

src: The Indian Corps has been slaughtered and Durban is in our hands. Natal is finally ours! However, the British haven't stayed in Kaapstad idly, doing nothing. Their remainining troops, commanded by General Kitchener, have attacked along the coastline and, with the help of the Royal Navy, have retaken Port Elizabeth.
dst: 印度军已被屠杀殆尽，德班也已落入我们手中。纳塔尔终于归我们了！然而，英军并没有在开普敦坐视不理。他们由基钦纳将军指挥的残余部队沿海岸线发起进攻，并在皇家海军的协助下重新夺回了伊丽莎白港。

src: The Indian and ANZAC battalions that will support your assault are severely under strength with many of the soldiers wracked by dysentery. So, your men will again bear the brunt of the attack. Break through the Turkish trench lines and storm the summit of Hill 60!
dst: 将支援您进攻的印度营和澳新军团营严重缺员，许多士兵还饱受痢疾折磨。因此，您的部队将再次承受进攻的主要压力。突破土耳其人的战壕线，猛攻60高地山顶！

src: The Ireland-campaign is successfully completed and your forces will relocated to France. After a deserved rest, prepare your troops for an operation in Spain, Gibraltar is still held by so-called free-British forces. This operation is scheduled early next year.
dst: 爱尔兰战役已经胜利结束，你的部队将调往法国。经过应得的休整后，为在西班牙的行动做好准备——直布罗陀仍被所谓的自由不列颠部队占据。这次行动定于明年初进行。

src: The Island of Pantelleria, in the Sicilian Narrows separating Sicily from Tunisia was strongly fortified and garrisoned from 1937 on. Benito Mussolini, the Italian dictator, saw in Pantelleria an Italian counterpart to the British bastion of Malta some 120 miles (195 km) to the Italian island’s south-east.
dst: 潘泰莱里亚岛位于分隔西西里与突尼斯的西西里海峡中，自1937年起便受到严密设防并驻有守军。意大利独裁者贝尼托·墨索里尼把潘泰莱里亚视为意大利对英国马耳他堡垒的对等存在，马耳他位于该意大利岛屿东南方约120英里（195公里）处。

src: The Isle of Wight is ours! Now we can set up our operations against the important ports of Portsmouth and Southampton. You have to take both cities. Expect british naval vessels in The Solent and Southampton Water.
dst: 怀特岛是我们的了！现在我们可以针对朴次茅斯和南安普敦这两座重要港口展开行动。你必须夺取这两座城市。预计索伦特海峡和南安普敦水域会有英国海军舰艇。

src: The Isonzo valley: a place to stay
dst: 伊松佐河谷: 落脚之地

src: The Italian column finally arrived in Saati. All that campaign was an useless effort for us. Besides, outraged by our attacks, Italy and Britain threatened Emperor Yohannes with heavy military reprisals. That was something that Ethiopia simply couldn't afford, so in the end we had to retire from all the coastal areas, and even from part of the Highlands, too.
dst: 意大利纵队最终还是抵达了萨蒂。对我们来说，整场战役都是徒劳。此外，意大利和英国对我们的进攻感到震怒，威胁要对约翰内斯皇帝进行严厉的军事报复。这是埃塞俄比亚根本承受不起的，所以最终我们不得不从所有沿海地区撤退，甚至包括高地的部分地区。

src: The Italian column never arrived in Saati. However, it was an useless effort for us. Outraged, Italy and Britain threatened Emperor Yohannes with heavy military reprisals. That was something that Ethiopia simply couldn't afford, so in the end we had to retire from all the coastal areas, and even from part of the Highlands, too.
dst: 意大利纵队始终没能抵达萨蒂。然而，这对我们来说也是徒劳。意大利和英国震怒之下，威胁要对约翰内斯皇帝进行严厉的军事报复。这是埃塞俄比亚根本承受不起的，所以最终我们不得不从所有沿海地区撤退，甚至包括高地的部分地区。

src: The Italian commander, General Baratieri, was a veteran and competent soldier. After the battles of Amba Alagi and Mekele, he had learnt that our army clearly outnumbered his, but that our main weakness was logistics. Supply lines were almost non-existent, and our soldiers had to eat and drink whatever they could find on the field. Just like in the Middle Ages. Ethiopia was trying hard to become a modern country, but many of our ways were really primitive.
dst: 意大利指挥官巴拉蒂耶里将军是一位经验丰富、能力出众的军人。经过安巴阿拉吉和默克莱两战，他认识到我军在人数上明显占优，但我们的主要弱点在于后勤。补给线几乎不存在，我们的士兵只能就地找什么吃什么、有什么喝什么，就像中世纪一样。埃塞俄比亚正努力成为一个现代化国家，但我们的许多做法确实还很原始。

src: The Italian defences have collapsed. We’ve captured thousands of prisoners and our divisions are marching unopposed to Udine. This is our greatest victory in the West since the war started! Now we must continue our advance before the Italians can react. If we are fast enough, we could force Italy to surrender. Yesterday, it was an impossible dream. Now, thanks to you, it’s a realistic goal.
dst: 意大利的防线已经崩溃。我们俘虏了数千名战俘，我们的各师正畅通无阻地向乌迪内挺进。这是开战以来我们在西线取得的最大胜利！现在我们必须趁意大利人来不及反应之前继续推进。如果我们动作够快，就能迫使意大利投降。昨天，这还只是个不可能实现的梦想。如今，多亏了您，它已成为一个现实的目标。

src: The Italians are gratefull for helping them recover their colonies.
dst: 意大利人感谢我们帮他们收复了殖民地。

src: The Italians are not impressed with the loss of there army!
dst: 意大利人对他们军队的损失深感不满！

src: The Italians attacked from the east and north as well as from the southwest. At the same time, many enemy ships and planes are approaching from the South.
dst: 意大利军从东面与北面以及西南面发起进攻。与此同时，大批敌舰与敌机正从南面逼近。

src: The Italians had divided their forces in three brigades, plus the reserve. Each column intended to advance parallel to the others, so at any time they could receive support from their comrades if they needed it. But they had to march during the night, over mountain terrain and with inaccurate maps, so at the next day's dawn the Italian units found themselves scattered across several miles. It was a perfect opportunity for defeating them in detail, and we got ready. The future of Ethiopia would be decided in the next hours.
dst: 意大利人把兵力分成了三个旅，外加预备队。每个纵队都打算与其他纵队平行推进，以便在需要时随时能得到友邻的支援。但他们不得不在夜间行军，翻越山地，又拿着不准确的地图，所以次日黎明时分，意大利各部队发现自己被分散在绵延数英里的区域。这是将他们各个击破的绝佳机会，我们做好了准备。埃塞俄比亚的未来将在接下来的几个小时里决定。

src: The Italians had had enough, too. In Rome, The Crispi Government fell. On 23 October 1896, Ethiopia and Italy signed the Treaty of Addis Ababa, and the war finally ended. The Treaty of Wuchale was abrogated, and Italy acknowledged Ethiopia as an independent country. A few months later, France and the British Empire did the same. However, we didn't obtain any territorial gains. It was obvious that Emperor Menelik didn't wish to fight for the sovereignty of Tigray.
dst: 意大利人也受够了。在罗马，克里斯皮政府倒台了。1896年10月23日，埃塞俄比亚与意大利签订了《亚的斯亚贝巴条约》，战争终于结束。《武恰莱条约》被废除，意大利承认埃塞俄比亚为独立国家。几个月后，法国和大英帝国也相继承认。然而，我们并没有获得任何领土。显然，孟尼利克皇帝并不愿为提格雷的主权而战。

src: The Italians have been completely routed, and have fled to the outskirts of Venedig. If we had more men and more supplies, we could keep striking our enemies until they had to surrender. But neither us, nor the Germans, thought that our victory would be so complete. Now we don't have enough reserves to keep on advancing, so we'll have to stop and dig in.
dst: 意大利人已被彻底击溃，逃到了威尼斯的郊外。如果我们拥有更多的人力和物资，就能继续打击敌人，直到他们不得不投降。但无论是我们还是德国人，都没有料到胜利会如此彻底。现在我们没有足够的预备队继续推进，只好停下来挖壕据守。

src: The Italians were dealt a crushing defeat by the more maneuverable Ottoman forces. The 11th Bersaglieri Regiment effectively seized as a fighting force and the Italians had to send many more troops to Tripoli. It took them many more weeks and troops to quell the civil unrest and to restore the perimeter around the city. Thousands of civilians got publicly executed or displaced. Houses were burned down and cattle was confiscated.
dst: 意大利人被机动性更强的奥斯曼军队打得大败。第11贝尔萨列里团实际上丧失了战斗力，意大利人不得不向的黎波里增派更多部队。他们又花了数周时间和大量兵力才平息内乱、恢复城防圈的秩序。数千平民被公开处决或流离失所。房屋被烧毁，牲畜被没收。

src: The Italians were really fast at colonizing the coast of the Red Sea and, as soon as they could, they advanced into the mainland, too. After a few months, the Ethiopians had to decide if they would retreat, or if they would fight.
dst: 意大利人殖民红海沿岸的速度确实很快，而且一有机会，他们便向内地推进。几个月之后，埃塞俄比亚人不得不作出抉择：要么撤退，要么战斗。

src: The Japanese 1st Army landed on the western coast of northern Korea with the aim of isolating and besieging Port Arthur.  The Yalu River is our first line of defense.   Your regiment will be part of General Zasulich's force of 6 Siberian regiments and a Cossack squadron.  Your task is to fight a delaying action.  You will be reinforced by units posessing a new weapon:  the machine gun.  Perhaps you can utilize this device to your advantage on the battlefield.
dst: 日本第1军已在朝鲜北岸西部登陆，目的是孤立并围困旅顺口。鸭绿江是我们的第一道防线。您的团将隶属于扎苏利奇将军的部队，该部队由6个西伯利亚团和1个哥萨克骑兵中队组成。您的任务是打一场迟滞战。您将得到装备新式武器——机枪——的部队的增援。也许您能在战场上善用这种装置。

src: The Japanese are attempting to regain the initiative and are advancing forward, intentsifying the battle in the center.  General Kuropatkin plans to outflank the advancing Japanese with the 1st Siberian Cossack Division (Samsonov) and the Zabaikal Cossack Division (Rennenkampf).  You are advised to maintain a defensive stance in the center, while strengthening your left (south-east) flank to assist Samsonov and Rennenkampf.
dst: 日军正试图夺回主动权，向前推进，加剧了中路的战斗。库罗帕特金将军计划以第1西伯利亚哥萨克师（萨姆索诺夫）和外贝加尔哥萨克师（伦嫩坎普夫）包抄推进中的日军。建议您在中路保持防御姿态，同时加强您的左翼（东南）以协助萨姆索诺夫和伦嫩坎普夫。

src: The Japanese continued to make fast moves, and in September they had already occupied most of Korea. Then our best troops converged on Pyongyang, ready to defend the city for as long as they could, waiting for the chance to counterattack. They were facing the Japanese First Army, composed of the 5th and the 3rd Divisions.
dst: 日本人继续快速行动，到9月已占领了朝鲜的大部分地区。于是我们最精锐的部队向平壤集结，准备尽可能久地坚守该城，等待反击的机会。他们面对的是由第5师和第3师组成的日军第1军团。

src: The Japanese divisions that had invaded Korea moved incredibly quickly, taking the Chinese by surprise. The panic spread, and many Qing units fled the battlefield leaving their equipment to their enemies.
dst: 入侵朝鲜的日军师团行动快得惊人，令中国军队措手不及。恐慌蔓延开来，许多清军部队逃离战场，把装备留给了敌人。

src: The Japanese divisions that had invaded Korea were utterly destroyed on the shores of the Yalu river, but the Chinese troops couldn't take advantage of their victory. Just when we were planning the liberation of Korea, our spies warned us of an imminent landing of the Japanese Second Army at Pitsewo, in Manchuria, inside the Empire and behind our own lines. So we had to go on forced marches towards the Chinese port of Liushun before the Japanese could take it. If our enemies succeeded, they could even threaten Peking.
dst: 入侵朝鲜的日军师团在鸭绿江畔被彻底歼灭，但中国军队却无法利用他们的胜利。正当我们筹划解放朝鲜之际，我们的间谍警告说，日军第2军团即将在满洲的貔子窝登陆，那里位于帝国内部，而且在我们自己战线的后方。因此，我们不得不强行军赶往中国港口旅顺，赶在日军占领它之前到达。倘若敌人得逞，他们甚至可能威胁北京。

src: The Japanese fleet is battered but intact, and shelters here as well.  Work closely with Admiral Raeder and make sure that the Japanese ships cannot hinder your landings here on Okinawa.  The mission is of the utmost importance.
dst: 日本舰队虽受重创但仍完整，也在这一带躲避。与雷德尔海军元帅密切协作，确保日本舰船无法妨碍你在此地冲绳的登陆。此任务至关重要。

src: The Japanese invasion of Manchuria and the loss of Liushun weren't the last disasters for China in this war. Weihawei, Penghu and Taiwan were terrible blows, too. Our troops fought as well as they could, but it wasn't enough. Chinese reforms had been too slow, and despite all our efforts the Qing Army simply wasn't ready for a modern war. Not yet.
dst: 日本入侵满洲和旅顺的失守，并非这场战争中中国最后的灾难。威海卫、澎湖和台湾同样遭受了沉重打击。我们的部队尽力作战，但这还不够。中国的改革太过缓慢，尽管我们付出了所有努力，清军终究还没准备好打一场现代战争。还没有。

src: The Japanese invasion of Manchuria was a disaster for them. Only a few hundred troops of the Land of the Rising Sun could be evacuated and returned safely to their country. Most of the members of the Second Japanese Army were either killed or taken prisoner, and soon the Chinese soldiers regained control of the right bank of the Yalu river.
dst: 日本对满洲的入侵对他们而言是一场灾难。只有几百名日出之国的士兵得以撤离并安全返回本国。日军第2军团的大部分成员要么阵亡，要么被俘，中国士兵很快重新控制了鸭绿江右岸。

src: The Japanese line is strong and entrenched; they are a paranoid lot and have been anticipating this action for some time.  If you can breach the line you will have little difficulty encircling and annihilating the other enemy forces in the area; by now I am sure you are familiar with the level of speed necessary to pull off a successful "Blitzkrieg" attack, Herr Feldmarschall.
dst: 日军的防线坚固而完备；他们是一群偏执的家伙，早已预判到这一行动。如果你能突破防线，就几乎不难包围并歼灭该地区的其他敌军；时至今日，我确信你已熟知发动一次成功『闪击战』所需的速度，元帅阁下。

src: The Japanese will lead a small attack from the northeast while most of your army will directly attack Peral Harbor from the south.
dst: 日军将从东北方向发动一次小规模进攻，而你的大部分军队将从南面直接进攻珍珠港。

src: The Jassy-Kishinev Operation, named after the two major cities (Iasi and Chisinau) that define its staging area, was a Soviet offensive against Axis forces, which took place in Eastern Romania during 20-29 August 1944. The 2nd and 3rd Ukrainian Fronts of the Red Army engaged Army Group South Ukraine, which consisted of combined German and Romanian formations, in an operation to reclaim the Moldavian SSR and destroy the Axis forces in the region, opening a way into Romania and the Balkans.
dst: 雅西-奇西瑙行动以界定其作战地域的两座主要城市（雅西与奇西瑙）命名，是苏军于1944年8月20—29日在罗马尼亚东部对轴心国军队发起的攻势。红军乌克兰第2、第3方面军与由德、罗部队组成的南乌克兰集团军群交战，旨在收复摩尔达维亚苏维埃社会主义共和国并消灭该地区轴心国军队，为进军罗马尼亚与巴尔干打开通道。

src: The KMT troops are badly wounded.  Our victories at Changchun and Siping have decimated their men, commander, and you must put an end to the nationalist resistance in Manchuria.  Your mission is to secure the communications between our base at Siping and our groups in the South, near to Shenyang.  Then you must take Shenyang.  It is the historical Manchurian capital and is both an important industrial and political center.  The capture of Shenyang will open the way to Beijing and Nanjing.
dst: 国民党军队已遭重创。我们在长春和四平的胜利使他们的兵力大减，指挥官，你必须终结国民政府军在满洲的抵抗。你的任务是确保我们四平基地与我们在南方沈阳附近各部队之间的交通线。然后你必须夺取沈阳。它是满洲的历史首府，既是重要的工业中心，也是政治中心。夺取沈阳将打开通往北平与南京的道路。

src: The Kaiser was this time at Spa, where the allied armistice terms had been previously negotiated. He then fled to his Dutch exile where he signed the abdication on 28.11.1919.
dst: 皇帝当时正在斯帕，协约国的停战条款此前就是在那里谈判的。随后他逃往荷兰流亡地，并于1919年11月28日在那里签署了退位诏书。

src: The Kakies know this, so Roberts has sent General French to this area, with one cavalry division and at least one infantry brigade. For the moment French has settled for small raids and skirmishes. It's pretty clear that he just wanted to divert as many Boer soldiers from Kimberley as he could. However in the last days he has extended his lines to the east and north, trying to outflank us before his final assault.
dst: 英国佬明白这一点，所以罗伯茨派弗伦奇将军率一个骑兵师和至少一个步兵旅来到这一地区。目前弗伦奇还只满足于小股袭扰和零星交火。很明显，他只是想尽可能多地把布尔士兵从金伯利引开。然而最近几天，他把战线向东面和北面延伸，试图在最后总攻之前包抄我们。

src: The Kakies think that we'll surrender in a matter of weeks, but obviously they don't know us at all. We've gathered the remmants of our army in the hills east of Pretoria and we're preparing a last line of defence there. Our enemies may win this war by the force of numbers, but they'll never break our spirits. 14,000 enemy soldiers will assault our positions very soon. Show them what we're made of! But beware of the British cavalry, they'll try to outflank you and attack from your rear.
dst: 英国佬以为我们几周内就会投降，但显然他们根本不了解我们。我们已把部队残部集结在比勒陀利亚以东的丘陵地带，正在那里准备最后一道防线。我们的敌人或许能靠数量优势赢得这场战争，但他们永远摧垮不了我们的意志。很快，1.4万名敌军士兵就会向我们的阵地发起进攻。让他们看看我们的本事！但要提防英军骑兵，他们会试图包抄您，从您的后方进攻。

src: The Kalkriese mountain near Osnabrück. Here many remains of roman legionary equipment have been found at a long line following the route of the  ancient street. Also from the coins found none has been dated later as the historically secured date of the battle ( late summer 9 AD).
dst: 奥斯纳布吕克附近的卡尔克里泽山。在这里沿古道路一线的一条长带上，发掘出大量罗马军团装备的遗存。且所发现的钱币中，没有一枚的年份晚于此役在史料上确定的日期（公元9年夏末）。

src: The Kavkaz Front has formed the Persian Expeditionary Force (Baratov), giving it mandate to exterminate the Mujahadeen brigades-many of which have organized under the leadreship of German, Austrian, and Swedish officers.  Baratov's force will split into three columns:  yours will capture Khamadan, another will enter Teheran, and the third will enter Qum.  The Russian Foreign Ministry has initiated talks with the British, who are currently advancing toward Baghdad, with the aim of coordinating campaigns in this theater of the war.
dst: 高加索方面军已组建波斯远征军（巴拉托夫），授权其剿灭圣战者旅——其中许多旅是在德国、奥地利和瑞典军官领导下组建的。巴拉托夫的部队将分三路进发：您的部队将夺取哈马丹，另一路进入德黑兰，第三路进入库姆。俄国外交部已与正向巴格达推进的英国人展开会谈，旨在协调这一战区的战役。

src: The Kavkaz Front has resolved to strike the Turkish 3rd Army at Erzerum.  The attack has been planned in extreme secrecy to take place during winter months - a move Turkish command does not expect.  The Kavkaz Army (II Turkestansky and I Kavkazky Corps) has achieved surprise over the enemy and has deployed in a semi-circle around Erzerum and its outlying forts.
dst: 高加索方面军已决意打击在埃尔祖鲁姆的土耳其第3集团军。这次进攻在极度保密中筹划，特意选在冬季实施——这是土耳其指挥部没有料到的举动。高加索集团军（第2突厥斯坦军和第1高加索军）已达成对敌突然性，并以半圆形态势部署在埃尔祖鲁姆及其外围堡垒周围。

src: The Kavkaz campaign of 1916 continued with two more major operations:  the capture of the port of Trapezond on the Black Sea coast in April and the defeat of a Turkish attempt to recapture Erzerum in August.  With the British Mesopotamian army surrendering at Kut, our operations in Persia and Mesopotamia ceased.
dst: 1916年的高加索战役继续以两次重大作战推进：四月夺取黑海沿岸的特拉布宗港，八月击退土耳其夺回埃尔祖鲁姆的企图。随着英国美索不达米亚集团军在库特投降，我们在波斯和美索不达米亚的作战停止了。

src: The Kavkaz campaign of 1916 continued with two more major operations:  the capture of the port of Trapezond on the Black Sea coast in April and the defeat of a Turkish attempt to recapture Erzerum in August.  With the British Mesopotamian army surrendering at Kut, our operations in Persia and Mesopotamia ceased.  Your command will transfer to the European theater.
dst: 1916年的高加索战役继续以两次重大作战推进：四月夺取黑海沿岸的特拉布宗港，八月击退土耳其夺回埃尔祖鲁姆的企图。随着英国美索不达米亚集团军在库特投降，我们在波斯和美索不达米亚的作战停止了。您的指挥权将调往欧洲战区。

src: The Kerch operation has failed. As we speak our brave forces are driven back into the sea. Because of the failure of the Kerch operation, the succesful Feodosiya operation has become irrelevant...
dst: 刻赤行动失败了。此刻我们英勇的部队正被赶回大海。由于刻赤行动的失败，成功的费奥多西亚行动也变得无关紧要了……

src: The Kharkov scenario and the map on which it is played are created by Hannes Gruber. Slight modifications were made: deployment hexes, supply hexes and prestige management.
dst: 哈尔科夫场景及其所用地图由 Hannes Gruber 制作。为使其适配本战役，仅作了轻微修改：部署格、补给格与声望管理。

src: The Kingdom of Poland was occupied by Russians for more than half a century. Polish citizens of Austro-Hungary could develop their own organizations, including paramilitary organizations. In 1908 a refugee from the "Russian" part of Poland, Józef Pi³sudski, took control over these paramilitary organizations and prepared these people to fight against the Russian Empire in the coming war. But war didn't break out in 1908 when Austria annexed Bosnia-Herzegowina. War also did not break out in 1911 when Germany tried to take over Morocco. Finally the Great War began in 1914.
dst: 波兰王国被俄国人占领了半个多世纪。奥匈帝国的波兰裔公民得以发展自己的组织，包括准军事组织。1908年，一位来自波兰「俄国占领区」的流亡者约瑟夫·毕苏斯基接管了这些准军事组织，并让这些人做好准备，在即将到来的战争中与俄罗斯帝国作战。但1908年奥地利吞并波斯尼亚-黑塞哥维那时，战争并未爆发；1911年德国试图夺取摩洛哥时，战争也没有爆发。最终，大战于1914年爆发。

src: The Konotop scenario and the map on which it is played are created by Hannes Gruber. No more than slight modifications were made to make it fit into this campaign.
dst: 科诺托普场景及其所用地图由 Hannes Gruber 制作。为使其适配本战役，仅作了轻微修改。

src: The Konotop scenario and the map on which it is played are made by Hannes Gruber.
dst: 科诺托普场景及其所用地图由 Hannes Gruber 制作。

src: The Kuban steppes and the Taman peninsula are liberated. Not one fascist still stands in its soil. Well done, comrade. Elsewhere our forces are having victories as well. In the Ukraine our offensive is steaming towards the Dnjepr River. And the winter has still to begin! However your forces will be drawn back, and receive some badly needed rest and refitting. But the enemy is far from defeated so you will face them again.
dst: 库班草原和塔曼半岛解放了。那片土地上再也没有一个法西斯立足。干得好，同志。其他方向，我军也在取胜。在乌克兰，我们的攻势正朝第聂伯河挺进。而冬天还没开始！不过你的部队将被调回，进行急需的休整和重新装备。但敌人远未被打败，你还会再面对他们。

src: The LSSAH will advance through the south-eastern area.
dst: 警卫旗队将从东南地区推进。

src: The Lang Son campaign started on February 3rd. A total of twelve French battalions left their camps at Chu and marched against Thanh Moy and Dong Song. Our Chinese troops faced twice as many enemies as they had previously fought at Kep and Núi Bop, so initially nothing could be done in order to stop them. In just six days they had already taken positions at Deo Quao and Pho Bu, and it seemed that the loss of Lang Son was inevitable.
dst: 谅山战役始于2月3日。总共十二个法军营离开他们在朱的营地，向清枚和东宋推进。我们的中国军队面临的敌人数量是先前在盖普和努伊博普所遇敌人的两倍，因此起初无法阻止他们。仅仅六天之内，他们便已占领德奥夸和富布的阵地，谅山的陷落似乎已不可避免。

src: The Legion succesfully occupied Samara and was threatening more Russian cities along the Volga. Through foreign and through White Russian eyes, the Legion was an ideal force for the counter-revolution and overthrow the Soviets. However the Czech Legion was fighting its own struggle and it only occasionally co-operated with White Russian authorities.
dst: 军团成功占领了萨马拉，并威胁到伏尔加河沿岸更多的俄国城市。在外人以及白俄人士眼中，军团是发动反革命、推翻苏维埃的理想力量。然而，捷克军团打的是自己的仗，只是偶尔与白俄当局合作。

src: The Libyan Corps will advance along the coastal road while our XXIII Corps - consisting of the 62nd Marmarican and 63rd Cyrene Divisions - will cross the border South of the Libyan Corps.
dst: 利比亚军将沿海岸公路推进，而我方第23军——由第62马尔马里卡师和第63昔兰尼师编成——将在利比亚军以南越过边境。

src: The Luftwaffe is to give us priority of support, but it is good to see your own planes in the sky too The RAF has been very active and could show up anywhere.
dst: 德国空军将优先支援我们，不过看到你自己的飞机也在天上真好。皇家空军非常活跃，可能在任何地方出现。

src: The Maginot Line is named after French Minister of Defense Andre Maginot, is a line of concrete fortifications, tank obstacles, artillery casemates, machine gun posts, and other defenses, which France has built along its borders with Germany and Italy, in the light of experience from World War I, and in the run-up to World War II. Generally the term describes either the entire system or just the defenses facing Germany, while the Alpine Line is used for the Franco-Italian defenses.
dst: 马其诺防线以法国国防部长安德烈·马其诺命名，是一系列钢筋混凝土工事、反坦克障碍、炮兵炮台、机枪阵地及其他防御设施，法国在第一次世界大战的经验与二战前夕沿德、意边境修建。通常该词指整套体系或仅指面向德国的防御，而“阿尔卑斯防线”用于法意之间的防御。

src: The Maginot Line.A line of Fortifications no one would ever dare to challenge,Shades of the First World Wars Entrenched Philosophy gone awry.The French people had suffered through the Years being taxed to Death after the 'War to End all Wars' so a wall could be put up and stop anymore Wars coming from the East and especially from the near East,Germany. SS units had done bypassed it and just wanted to let it sit there with all the troops inside doing nothing but twindling their thumbs while the SS took Paris, the Coast and the rest of France.Fuhress Ilse though wanted it to be destroyed stating "show the French how they have wasted their time building stupid fortifications, wasted their manpower and wasted their money, defense does not Win Wars.Show the French that the 'Great War' that was 20 years ago is nothing compared to this War we are bringing to them and the rest of this Man build decatant planet".So the SS would attack the 'Line with the main objective being the Airfields of 1st Armee de L' Air.Of course the Common Frau was impressed with the Concrete and Fortress Guns of the French but knew soon the French would be impressed with Soldierett's in Skirts and 'BdM' armbands attacking them.
dst: 马奇诺防线。一条谁也不敢挑战的要塞线，是第一次世界大战堑壕理念走向歧途的遗影。法国人民在“结束一切战争的战争”之后经历了多年被税到死的日子，只为筑起一堵墙，挡住来自东方、尤其是来自近东——德国——的任何战争。党卫军部队已经绕过了它，只想让它留在原地，里面的部队什么也干不了，只能干坐着捻手指，而党卫军夺取巴黎、海岸和法国其余地方。但女元首伊尔泽要把它摧毁，她说：“让法国人看看，他们浪费时间去修筑愚蠢的要塞、浪费人力、浪费金钱——防御赢不了战争。让法国人看看，20年前那场‘大战’，与我们带给他们的这场战争、与带给这个男性构建的堕落星球的这场战争相比，根本不算什么。”于是党卫军将进攻“防线”，主要目标是法国第1航空集团军的机场。当然，普通“女士”对法国人的混凝土和要塞炮印象深刻，但她们知道，法国人很快就会对穿着裙子、戴着“BdM”袖标冲上来的“女兵”印象深刻。

src: The Mahdist War - Securing the Lado Enclave.
dst: 马赫迪战争——夺取拉多飞地。

src: The Mahdist War - Securing the Lado Enclave. - Feb 1897
dst: 马赫迪战争——夺取拉多飞地。- 1897年2月

src: The Mahdists feared us, and they fortified themselves at Gallabat as soon as they knew that Yohannes's army was on the march. It would be hard to break into the town, but we were determined to overcome the Saracens forever. Destroying that stronghold was all we needed.
dst: 马赫迪分子畏惧我们，一得知约翰内斯的军队正在开进，他们便据守加拉巴特进行加固。要攻入该镇会很困难，但我们决心永远制服这些撒拉森人。摧毁那座要塞就是我们所需的一切。

src: The Maji Maji have received from their leader "Bokero" a war medicine that will transform our bullets when they hit, them into water - can you imagine such a thing? Because they believe they are invulnerable, their pillaging warriors move in the direction to our valuable cotton plantations.
dst: 马吉-马吉人从他们的首领「博克罗」那里得到了一种战争巫药，据说能使我们的子弹在击中时化为水——您能想象这种事吗？他们相信自己刀枪不入，于是他们的战士一路烧杀抢掠，直扑我们宝贵的棉花种植园。

src: The Maunsell naval forts were built in the Thames estuary and operated by the Royal Navy, to deter and report German air raids following the Thames as a landmark, and prevent attempts to lay mines by aircraft in this important shipping channel (Navy forts). Maunsell also designed forts for anti-aircraft defence (operated by the Army). During World War II, the Thames estuary forts shot down 22 aircraft and about 30 flying bombs (Army forts) and sunk one E-boat (Navy forts).
dst: 蒙塞尔海上堡垒建于泰晤士河河口，由皇家海军操作，用于威慑和报告沿泰晤士河这一地标而来的德军空袭，并阻止飞机在这一重要航道布雷的企图（海军堡垒）。蒙塞尔还设计了防空堡垒（由陆军操作）。二战期间，泰晤士河河口的堡垒击落了22架飞机和约30枚飞弹（陆军堡垒），并击沉一艘鱼雷艇（海军堡垒）。

src: The Michigan Lower Peninsula is cordoned and some caught enemy forces are now trying to escape westward over Lake Michigan. Occupy the ports along the coast and prevent the evacuation of this troops. Air landing units were dispatched to Benton Harbor and will support you.
dst: 密歇根下半岛已被封锁，一些被困的敌军正试图越过密歇根湖向西逃窜。占领沿岸各港口，阻止这些部队撤离。空降部队已派往本顿港，将支援你。

src: The Military Directory decided that Denikin's elite troops would lead the frontal attack against Moscow, while Wrangel and Diterikhs flanked them. Other units, including mine, would attack other points of the Bolshevik defensive perimeter, in order to weaken our enemies, prevent them from reinforcing the capital, and blocking as many Red escape routes as possible.
dst: 军事督政府决定，由邓尼金的精锐部队对莫斯科发起正面进攻，弗兰格尔和季捷里赫斯在两翼掩护。包括我在内的其他部队将进攻布尔什维克防御圈的其他要点，以削弱敌人、阻止他们增援首都，并尽可能封锁红军的逃跑路线。

src: The Ministry has deemed fit to offer you a promotion to Kindralleitnant and to place under your command the army slated to attack Petrograd.
dst: 陆军部认为应晋升您为中将，并将计划进攻彼得格勒的军队交由您指挥。

src: The Montenegrin army is blocking our march towards Albania, in the south, where the remnants of the Serbian army are staying. We must clear the way, and a classical pincer maneuver should work. While the XIX Korps attacks the coastal towns, you'll storm the enemy positions at the mountains. Once you've succeeded, both groups will converge in Podgorica and Montenegro will be ours.
dst: 黑山军队正阻挡我们向南挺进阿尔巴尼亚，塞尔维亚军队的残部就驻扎在那里。我们必须扫清道路，一次经典的钳形攻势应该能奏效。第19军进攻沿海城镇的同时，您将猛攻敌人在山中的阵地。一旦您成功，两路部队将在波德戈里察会合，黑山将归我们所有。

src: The Narotch debacle has shaken the will and morale of soldiers and officers of the Northern and Western Fronts: Stavka has been unable to form a coherent plan for their participation in the summer offensive, leaving Alexei Brusilov's South-Western Front (8th, 11th, 7th, and 9th Armies) to execute the action.  With ammunition and supply problems largely solved, the Army of 1916 has become a stronger and sharper instrument of war.  Regimental and divisional commanders of veteran divisions have earned their command.  The influx of freshly formed divisions, however, has brought large masses of untrained and unprepared recruits.
dst: 纳罗奇的惨败动摇了北方和西方两个方面军官兵的意志和士气：大本营始终无法为他们在夏季攻势中的参与制定出连贯的计划，只留下阿列克谢·布鲁西洛夫的西南方面军（第8、第11、第7和第9集团军）来执行这一行动。随着弹药和补给问题大体解决，1916年的这支军队已成为更加强大、更加锋利的战争工具。久经沙场各师的团、师长都是凭本事赢得指挥权的。然而，大批新编师的涌入，带来了大量未经训练、准备不足的新兵。

src: The National Army pushes into Catalonia after the Ebro's Battle to reach Barcelona, the most important republican city, this inflicting a smashing defeat to the Spanish Republic. Historical scenario.
dst: 埃布罗河战役后，国民军向加泰罗尼亚推进，以抵达共和派最重要的城市巴塞罗那，从而给西班牙共和国以毁灭性的打击。历史场景。

src: The Nationalist Colonel, Rey d'Haucourt surrendered his forces in Teruel, and the city was retaken, but the Rebel counteroffensive converted the battle in a little Spanish Stalingrad...
dst: 叛军上校雷伊·德·阿尔库尔在特鲁埃尔率部投降，该城被收复，但随后叛军的反攻使这场战役变成了一场小型的西班牙斯大林格勒……

src: The Nazis have been building a lunar command center as a way to ensure their survival should they be wiped out in Mexico.  Which, you've done a pretty good job of doing.
dst: 纳粹一直在建造一座月球指挥中心，以确保他们万一在墨西哥被消灭也能存续。而在墨西哥，你已经做得相当不错了。

src: The Normandy landings opened another front on European soil. An armoured counterattack around Saint-Lô is our last possible chance to drive the Allies back to the sea.
dst: 诺曼底登陆在欧洲大陆开辟了又一条战线。在圣洛一带发动装甲反击，是我们将盟军赶回大海的最后机会。

src: The Northern armies will have to retreat on their own to defensive positions while we prepare to strike again and then finally make the wishes of millions of proletarians come true!  In the south it has been quieter but it seems the imperialists in Warsaw have gathered enough men to continue the counteroffensive in the south as well.
dst: 北线各集团军将不得不自行撤退到防御阵地，而我们要准备再次出击，最终实现千百万无产者的夙愿！南线较为平静，但看来华沙的帝国主义者已集结了足够的兵力，准备在南线也继续反攻。

src: The Northwest road to Moscow has been opened by your victory! Now is time for the final effort.
dst: 你的胜利打开了通往莫斯科的西北道路！现在是最后奋力一搏的时候了。

src: The Norwegian Navy will not be much of a problem. However an British flotilla has been sighted and will likely engage your units, so speed is of highest importance.
dst: 挪威海军不会构成太大问题。不过已发现一支英国分舰队，很可能会与您的部队交战，因此速度至关重要。

src: The Norwegian Navy will not be much of a problem. However an British flotilla has been sighted and will likely engage your units, so speed is of the highest importance.
dst: 挪威海军不会构成太大问题。不过已发现一支英国分舰队，它很可能会与你的部队交战，因此速度至关重要。

src: The Norwegian forces are mostly infantrymen in firm positions, some field and antitank artillery, a few machine guns, and several coastal defense instalations and vessels, including the pair of sister ships Eidsvold and Norge. The Royal Navy destroyers are steaming towards the port, and the British planes augmented the tiny Norwegian airforce.
dst: 挪威军多为据守坚固阵地的步兵，配属部分野战与反坦克炮、少量机枪，以及若干海岸防御设施与舰只，包括“埃德斯沃尔德”号与“诺尔格”号两姊妹舰。皇家海军驱逐舰正全速驶向港口，英国飞机充实了那支小小的挪威空军。

src: The Norwegian forces are mostly infantrymen in firm positions, some field and antitank artillery, a few machine guns, and several coastal defense instalations and vessels, including the pair of sister ships Eidsvold and Norge. The Royal Navy destroyers are steaming towards the port, and the British planes augmented the tiny Norwegian airforce. We have slight numerical advantage over the enemy. Our destroyer group is an intimidating force.
dst: 挪威军多为据守坚固阵地的步兵，配属部分野战与反坦克炮、少量机枪，以及若干海岸防御设施与舰只，包括“埃德斯沃尔德”号与“诺尔格”号两艘姊妹舰。皇家海军驱逐舰正全速驶向港口，英国飞机充实了那支小小的挪威空军。我们对敌人略有数量优势。我们的驱逐舰群是一支令人忌惮的力量。

src: The Nyíregyháza counter-attack was the last time that German forces were to defeat a full-strength Red Army force on even terms. By pinching off the breakthrough exploitation group of the 2nd Ukrainian Front offensive, the Germans were able to re-establish a stable front line position, and thus prevent the 2nd Ukrainian Front's advance from becoming a catastrophe for the German 8th Army. The German success, was however short-lived as Nyíregyháza was captured by the Red Army on October 30.
dst: 尼赖吉哈佐反击战，是德军最后一次在势均力敌的条件下击败一支满编红军部队。通过掐断乌克兰第2方面军攻势中的突破发展集群，德军得以重建稳定的战线，从而阻止乌克兰第2方面军的推进演变成德国第8集团军的灾难。然而德军的胜利不过是昙花一现，10月30日尼赖吉哈佐即被红军攻占。

src: The OHL has decided that you'll launch a new attack on French positions near Reims. Last year, during the Great Western Offensive, we had to retire from Laon and most of the Aisne Valley in order to avoid unnecessary losses. The French had to pay a terrible price for their advances, and one year later they haven't been able to defend the new line properly. Their forces are too overstretched due to the heavy losses and the need to send reinforcements to the Marne, so we think that an attack of your elite troops is likely to succeed. The French won't be able to close a second gap on their lines.
dst: 最高陆军指挥部已决定，由您对兰斯附近的法军阵地发动新的进攻。去年西方大攻势期间，为避免不必要的损失，我们不得不撤出拉昂和埃纳河谷大部分地区。法军为他们的推进付出了惨重代价，一年后他们仍未能妥善守住这条新防线。由于伤亡惨重，又需向马恩河派兵增援，他们的兵力摊得过于分散，因此我们认为您的精锐部队发起进攻很可能会成功。法军将无力封堵他们战线上的第二个缺口。

src: The Old Ironsides campaign puts you in control of the 1st US Armored Division - the first US armored division that saw action in World War 2.
dst: “铁甲老兵”战役让你指挥美军第1装甲师——二战中首支参战的美国装甲师。

src: The Only Way To Be Sure
dst: 确保万无一失的唯一办法

src: The Operation Arctic Fox failed, it was far too complicated and the forces commited to the battle were unable to meet their goals. Although your initial progress was quick and satisfying, your units bogged down and it was painfully obvious that they are not exactly suited for the arctic warfare.
dst: “北极狐行动”失败了，行动过于复杂，投入作战的部队未能达成目标。尽管你初战进展迅速、令人满意，但部队随后陷入泥潭，显而易见他们并不真正适应北极作战。

src: The Ostrava offensive operation began in the early days of March, but it proceeded very slowly. Germans entrenched themselves heavily, sometimes using the old pre-war Czechoslovak fortificatons, although those were long ago outdated and stripped of the heavy guns.
dst: 俄斯特拉发攻势始于3月初，但进展极为缓慢。德军深沟高垒，有时还利用战前捷克斯洛伐克的旧工事，尽管那些早已过时、重炮也被拆走了。

src: The Ottoman Empire will last a little longer, I guess. The British have stopped their advance, and in fact they're retreating in certain areas. It seems that they've been informed that they won't receive any fresh troops from Europe or India any time soon because now the British priority is the defence of France, so Allenby has decided to dig in in Palestine. The Orient-Korps should take advantage of the current British vulnerability, don't you think? You should resume your counteroffensive as soon as you can.
dst: 我想，奥斯曼帝国还能再撑一段时间。英国已经停止了推进，事实上在某些地区他们正在撤退。看来他们已经得知，近期不会从欧洲或印度得到任何生力军，因为英国现在的当务之急是保卫法国，所以艾伦比决定在巴勒斯坦掘壕据守。东方军团应当利用英国当前的虚弱，您觉得呢？您应当尽快恢复反攻。

src: The Ottoman effort, sending so many divisions to help Germany, Austria and Bulgaria, was extremely generous and helped to achieve the final victory of the Central Powers in the Eastern Front, but overall it was a strategical mistake. Turkey deployed some of its best soldiers far from home, so they couldn't be used to protect the Empire when the British invasions of Mesopotamia and Palestine started, or when the Arab Revolt began. The Ottomans contributed to destroy the Russian Empire, but they left their borders undefended as a consequence. In 1917 many of those soldiers retuned, but it was too late. The British were already at the gates of Gaza.
dst: 奥斯曼派出如此多的师去帮助德国、奥地利和保加利亚，这份努力极其慷慨，并有助于同盟国在东线取得最终胜利，但总体上这是一个战略错误。土耳其把一些最精锐的士兵部署在远离本土的地方，因此当英军入侵美索不达米亚和巴勒斯坦、或阿拉伯大起义爆发时，他们无法用来保卫帝国。奥斯曼人帮助摧毁了俄国帝国，但代价是让自己的边境无人防守。1917年，许多士兵返回了，但为时已晚。英军已经兵临加沙城下。

src: The Ottoman forces had to withdraw to the west, not only from Erzurum, but also from the seaside regions. The situation was dire, but the V corps finally arrived, and the 3rd Army's leader gen. Mahmut Kamil was replaced with Vehip Pasha.
dst: 奥斯曼军队不得不向西撤退，不仅要撤出埃尔祖鲁姆，还要撤出沿海地区。局势十分严峻，但第5军终于抵达，第3集团军司令马哈茂德·卡米勒将军被韦希普帕夏取代。

src: The Ottoman garrison is starving and suffering from disease, but we can't afford waiting until they decide to surrender. Inactivity is making the morale of our troops go down, and they have suffered greatly during the cold winter. We need to end this war at once.
dst: 奥斯曼守军正忍受饥饿与疾病的折磨，但我们不能干等他们决定投降。无所事事正在使我军士气低落，而且他们在寒冷的冬天里受尽了苦。我们必须立刻结束这场战争。

src: The Ottoman government was unable to react, bound by the terms of the treaties, and soon some prominent military and political authorities started a revolution to guarantee the independence of Turkey. Since the beginning, one of the most active leaders of the new Turkish National Movement was Mustafa Kemal Pasha.
dst: 受条约条款约束，奥斯曼政府无力应对，很快一些显要的军事和政治人物便发起革命，以确保土耳其的独立。从一开始，新土耳其民族运动最活跃的领导人之一就是穆斯塔法·凯末尔帕夏。

src: The Ottomans and the Germans managed to hold their ground, although with heavy casualties, but the Austrian units were forced to retreat. Again, the poor Austrian performance in battle endangered her allies, who now were in risk of being encircled by the Russians. General Bothmer, the commander of the South Army, had no choice but to order a general retreat on September 5th. Most of the Turkish units went to the west, to Verkhnya Lypytsya and the surrounding villages. However, the Russians kept on trying to break the Ottoman lines, and they launched several assaults in the following days. The last one, and maybe the fiercest, took place on September 30th, when the 3rd Caucasian Corps attacked on the Turkish line.
dst: 奥斯曼人和德国人尽管伤亡惨重，却守住了阵地，但奥地利部队被迫撤退。奥地利军队的糟糕表现再次危及了其盟友，他们现在面临被俄国人包围的危险。南集团军司令博特默将军别无选择，只能于9月5日下令总撤退。大部分土耳其部队向西撤往上利皮察及周边村庄。然而，俄国人仍不断试图突破奥斯曼防线，并在随后几天发动了多次进攻。最后一次、也许是最猛烈的一次发生在9月30日，当时第三高加索军向土耳其防线发起进攻。
普法尔茨起义 * 大捷
普法尔茨起义 * 失败
普法尔茨起义 * 小捷
普法尔茨起义 * 胜利

src: The Panzer Division near of Braunschweig is fictional.
dst: 不伦瑞克附近的这个装甲师是虚构的。

src: The Panzers of Army Group Guderian were ordered to skirt the vital city of Konotop and speed south to close the ring around Kiev as fast as possible. OKH did not want a repeat of Smolensk where large amounts of Russian troops had been allowed to escape. By this stage most Panzer divisions had suffered large tank losses with many regiments down to 50% tank strength, with this in mind OKH ordered Panzer units to stay on the open Steppes where they could out manoeuvre the Russian armour rather than being wasted in street fighting. Starting on 5 September I.R. Grossdeutschland was tasked with road security operations along the Army group's axis of advance. By 8 September the Regiment went on the offensive, its objective was to establish bridgeheads across the Sejm River in the Putiwl region. The campaign entered a period of bitter fighting as Soviet resistance stiffened around the Sejm bridgeheads. As they approached Konotop, 14 September saw the Regiment prepare to assault Schilowka and cut the Kiev-Kursk-Moscow railway line. After completing this mission the Regiment turned to the west. The rifle companies advanced behind the assault guns and the enemy was finally thrown back after bitter fighting. On the 15th GD's attacks continued through Shilkova, ending up with the final objective, Konotop, being secured on the 16th.
dst: 古德里安集团军群的装甲部队奉命绕过重镇科诺托普，迅速南下，尽快合拢基辅的包围圈。陆军总司令部不想重演斯摩棱斯克的教训——那里让大批俄军逃脱了。到这时，大多数装甲师的坦克损失都很大，许多团只剩50%的坦克实力；有鉴于此，陆军总司令部命令装甲部队留在开阔的草原上，以便机动作战对付俄军装甲，而不是在巷战中被白白消耗。从9月5日起，“大德意志”步兵团受命沿集团军群的推进轴线执行道路警戒任务。到9月8日，该团转入进攻，目标是塞姆河畔普季夫利地区的桥头堡。随着苏军在塞姆河桥头堡周围抵抗加强，战役进入残酷战斗阶段。9月14日，该团在逼近科诺托普时准备进攻希洛夫卡，切断基辅-库尔斯克-莫斯科铁路线。完成此任务后，该团转向西面。步枪连跟在突击炮后推进，经过激战终于把敌人击退。15日“大德意志”团继续进攻，穿过希尔科瓦；16日拿下最终目标科诺托普。

src: The Persian Expeditionary Force has achieved its goals and established contact with local tribal leaders, negotiating their neutrality in this volatile border region.  Numerous German weapons convoys have been intercepted on their way to the Afghan border, denying the Central Powers this theater of operations.  With the British forces stalled in their Baghdad offensive, no military cooporation to secure this frontier can be expected from them.
dst: 波斯远征军已达成目标，并与当地部落首领建立了联系，通过谈判使他们在这一动荡的边境地区保持中立。许多德国武器运输队在前赴阿富汗边境途中被截获，使同盟国失去了这个战区。由于英军在其巴格达攻势中停滞不前，无法指望他们在保障此边疆方面提供任何军事合作。

src: The Persian Expeditionary Force has successfully achieved its goals and established contact with local tribal leaders, negotiating their neutrality in this volatile border region.  Numerous German weapons convoys have been intercepted on their way to the Afghan border, denying the Central Powers this theater of operations.
