With the British forces stalled in their Baghdad offensive, no military cooporation to secure this frontier can be expected from them.
dst: 波斯远征军已成功达成目标，并与当地部落首领建立了联系，通过谈判使他们在这一动荡的边境地区保持中立。许多德国武器运输队在前赴阿富汗边境途中被截获，使同盟国失去了这个战区。由于英军在其巴格达攻势中停滞不前，无法指望他们在保障此边疆方面提供任何军事合作。

src: The Petrogard offensive has drowned in a river of blood at Luga.  Estonia has withdrawn her troops from Yudenich's offensive and has pledged to provide material support to his army.  You have been recalled to Tallinn and will be asked to present a full report to the Ministry shortly upon your arrival.
dst: 彼得格勒攻势已在卢加的血河中淹没。爱沙尼亚已从尤登尼奇的攻势中撤出其部队，并承诺为他的军队提供物资支援。您已被召回塔林，抵达后不久将被要求向陆军部提交一份完整报告。

src: The Pincer is closed but your lack of speed still worries us.
dst: 钳形攻势已合拢，但你速度不足仍让我们担心。
巴拉顿湖攻势 1945年3月 辉煌胜利
巴拉顿湖攻势 1945年3月 失败
巴拉顿湖攻势 1945年3月 战术胜利
巴拉顿湖攻势 1945年3月 胜利

src: The Poles are routed and a demarkation line has been established between Germany and Russia. Take time now to repair and refit your division which I'm sure is battered after your astounding drive across Poland.
dst: 波兰人已被击溃，德俄之间已划定分界线。现在花点时间修理和整备你的师吧——我相信它在横贯波兰的惊人奔袭之后已伤痕累累。

src: The Poles have been able to form some kind of defensive line while you were pulling back from the Lwow operation.  However, this is no reason to be worried.  I am talking about the Cavalry Army!  It has not been defeated for months and just saying the name strikes terror into the enemy!  Strike north, and join up with our people's army in the north!!!
dst: 当您从利沃夫战役中撤出时，波兰人已设法构筑起某种防线。不过这没什么可担心的。我说的是骑兵集团军！它已数月未尝败绩，光提这个名字就能令敌人胆寒！向北突击，与北方的人民军队会合吧！！！

src: The Poles of the Western Divisions don't want to fight for bolshevism and deserts to us.
dst: 西方师中的波兰人不想为布尔什维克主义而战，纷纷倒戈到我们这边。

src: The Poles surprised us and defeated us, reaching Kiev a couple of weeks later. The risk of a new Bolshevik uprising was high, so we had to accept humiliating peace conditions, which included the acknowledgement of the independence of Poland, Belarus and Ukraine.
dst: 波兰人出其不意地击败了我们，几周后抵达基辅。新的布尔什维克起义风险很高，所以我们不得不接受屈辱的和平条件，其中包括承认波兰、白俄罗斯和乌克兰的独立。

src: The Polish government broke their bonds with Germany in October but were afraid that Polska Sila Zbrojna would be too weak to stop the bolshevik revolutions in the German Army stationed in Poland. On November 10th, Józef Pi³sudski returned from Germany, where he was imprisoned, and started another uprising with his veterans and the POW conspiracy. It was the most succesful uprisnig ever! No one was shot! Although a few Germans were scared to death. On November 11th Warsaw was free!
dst: 10月，波兰政府与德国断绝了关系，但又担心波兰武装力量过于弱小，无法阻止驻波兰德军中的布尔什维克革命。11月10日，约瑟夫·毕苏斯基从他被囚禁的德国返回，带领他的老兵和波兰军事组织的密谋者们再次发动起义。那是有史以来最成功的起义！没有一个人被枪杀！尽管有几个德国人吓得要死。11月11日，华沙自由了！

src: The Pope himself has declared a day of celebration!
dst: 教皇本人已宣布设立一个庆祝日！

src: The Portuguese, under the command of Teixeira Pinto, had established an encampment in the confluence of the Rovuma and Lujenda rivers.  Instead of fortifying his position Teixeira Pinto just waited.   He was convinced that the war was over.   Lettow had other ideas and after making a reconnaissance of the Portuguese encampment, he decided to attack. Part of his forces would cross the river upstream and attack the Portuguese in the rear while the German guns shelled the camp.
dst: 由特谢拉·平托指挥的葡萄牙人在鲁伍马河与卢任达河交汇处建立了一处营地。特谢拉·平托没有加固阵地，只是坐等。他确信战争已经结束。莱托另有打算，在对葡萄牙营地进行了侦察之后，他决定发起进攻。他的部分兵力将溯河而上渡河，从背后攻击葡萄牙人，同时德军火炮轰击营地。

src: The Prochorovka scenario is influenced by Jorge Gabitto's Kursk campaign.
dst: 普罗霍罗夫卡场景受 Jorge Gabitto 的库尔斯克战役启发。

src: The Prussian assault on Missunde was rejected, but just three days later the Danish Commander in Chief, General de Meza, withdrew all his forces from the Danevirke to the trenches at Düppel. Since the weather was terribly cold, the Schlei and the wetlands had frozen solid, and de Meza feared that, under those conditions, his army could be outflanked.
dst: 普鲁士人对米松德的进攻被击退，但仅仅三天后，丹麦总司令德梅萨将军就将其全部兵力从丹内维尔克撤至迪伯尔的战壕。由于天气极寒，施莱河和湿地都已封冻，德梅萨担心在这种情况下他的军队可能被包抄。

src: The Prussians have send some of their best troops, but in our hearts is still burning a hot flame of freedom....
dst: 普鲁士人派出了他们最精锐的一些部队，但自由的烈火仍在我们心中燃烧……

src: The Prussians quickly repelled the French attack. The defenders of Paris eventually resigned themselves to adopt a passive strategy, while they waited for help from the outside.
dst: 普鲁士人迅速击退了法军的进攻。巴黎守军最终只好采取消极防御的战略，同时等待外部的援助。

src: The Prussians stormed the Danish defences in a battle that lasted less than four hours. Most of the Danish troops were either killed, wounded or captured. Only a handful of them could escape towards Sonderburg.
dst: 普鲁士人在一场持续不到四小时的战斗中猛攻丹麦人的防线。大部分丹麦军队或阵亡、或负伤、或被俘。只有少数人得以逃往松德堡。

src: The Prussians suffered an unexpected defeat at Langensalza, but their lines didn't break. Unable to follow their retreat towards Bavaria, and with enemy reinforcements approaching from the north and the south, the Hanoverians had to surrender just two days after the battle.
dst: 普鲁士人在朗根萨尔察遭遇了一场意料之外的失败，但他们的阵线并未崩溃。汉诺威人无法继续向巴伐利亚方向撤退，而敌军援军又从南北两面逼近，他们不得不在战斗仅两天后投降。

src: The Pzkpfw III N was of little value against heavy armoured targets, nevertheless it was far more better armoured and armed than the obsolete R-2 tank that equipped the Romanian Armoured Division by the time. The eleven Pzkpfw III tanks, designated by Romanians "T-3" (T being the acronim of Tank in Romanian), formed up a medium tank company in the 1st Tank Regiment.
dst: Pzkpfw III N 型对重型装甲目标价值有限，但其装甲与火力远优于当时装备罗马尼亚装甲师的过时R-2坦克。这11辆Pzkpfw III被罗马尼亚人命名为“T-3”（T为罗马尼亚语Tank之缩写），编入第1坦克团的一个中型坦克连。

src: The QG appreciates my expierence in colonial warfare. As you know, after Indochine and Madagascar this is my third command in our colonies..... So here, in French Maroc, I've taken command over our second Column under the high command of Colonel Mangin.
dst: 指挥部很看重我在殖民战争中的经验。如您所知，继印度支那和马达加斯加之后，这是我在我们殖民地的第三次指挥……因此，在法属摩洛哥这里，我已接管了芒然上校最高指挥下的第二纵队。

src: The QG has ordered me and my brave men to the Area of Lens. There are rumours about a grand offensive.
dst: 指挥部已命令我和我英勇的士兵前往朗斯地区。有传言说将有一次大规模攻势。

src: The Qing army has showed us that we had underestimated them. They've stopped our advance at the gates of Lang Son. It doesn't really matter. We'll bribe some corrupt Mandarin officials at the Imperial court, if necessary. One way or another, Tonkin will become a French protectorate, just like Annam, and it'll join our other territories in Indochina.
dst: 清军让我们看到我们低估了他们。他们在谅山城门前阻止了我们的推进。其实这无关紧要。如有必要，我们会贿赂帝国朝廷一些腐败的满清官员。无论如何，东京都将成为法国保护国，就像安南一样，并将并入我们在印度支那的其他领地。

src: The Queen Regent wants herself to impose you the general's sash. You will take the next steamer back to Spain.
dst: 摄政女王想要亲自为您授予将军绶带。您将乘下一班汽船返回西班牙。

src: The Race to the Sea took place from about 17 September to 19 October 1914, after the German advance into France had been stopped at the First Battle of the Marne and the subsequent First Battle of the Aisne - a Franco-British counter-offensive.
dst: 「奔向大海」的竞赛大约发生在1914年9月17日至10月19日之间，此前德军向法国的推进已在第一次马恩河战役以及随后的第一次埃纳河战役——一次法英反击——中被阻止。

src: The Rafa defense line was not a serious barrier for your troops. Back up the coast and then head east with your troops on the Trans-Jordanian border.
dst: 拉法防线对你的部队来说不算真正的障碍。沿着海岸后撤，然后率你的部队向东，朝外约旦边境进发。

src: The Red Army didn't expect our reaction, and all its attempts to defend itself failed. When August came the 5th Army was nearly destroyed, and only the skills of their leader Tukhachevsky prevented the Bolshevik divisions from a complete destruction. The surviving communists retreated to the Miass river, where they waited until Lenin and Trotsky sent them more reinforcements.
dst: 红军没有料到我们的反应，其一切自卫企图都失败了。到了8月，第五集团军几乎被歼灭，全靠其统帅图哈切夫斯基的本事，布尔什维克各师才免于被彻底消灭。幸存的共产党人撤退到米阿斯河，在那里等待列宁和托洛茨基为他们派来更多增援。

src: The Red Army is ashamed of you. Report to HQ. It seems the fascists at Stalingrad are harder to defeat than imagined and we could use every extra man...
dst: 红军以你为耻。到司令部报到。看来斯大林格勒的法西斯比想象的更难对付，我们每一个多出来的人都有用……

src: The Red Army is still present in some areas of Estonia;  you must race south to Valga in an armored train collumn and neutralize the Soviet presence.
dst: 红军仍驻留在爱沙尼亚的一些地区；您必须乘装甲列车纵队急速南下瓦尔加，肃清苏联的存在。

src: The Red Army took advantage of the fact that German forces in the southern Soviet Union were overstretched, using weaker Romanian and Italian armies to guard their flanks; the offensives' starting points were established along the section of the front directly opposite Romanian forces.
dst: 红军利用驻南苏俄的德军兵力过度拉伸、以较弱的罗马尼亚与意大利军队守卫侧翼之弱点，将攻势发起地段设在正对罗马尼亚军队的正面地段。

src: The Red Army was virtually destroyed after Klin. Tukhachevsky led some surviving regiments to Petrograd, where they defended themselves for a couple of weeks until our army defeated them for good. In the end, all the Bolshevik leaders were killed or taken prisoner, or they had to flee to foreign lands.
dst: 克林一役后，红军实际上已被摧毁。图哈切夫斯基带领一些幸存的团退往彼得格勒，在那里他们坚守了几个星期，直到我军将他们彻底击败。最终，所有布尔什维克领导人都被击毙、被俘，或不得不逃往国外。

src: The Red Latvians have fortified within the city.  They are keeping 2 regiments in reserve, and intelligence warns of an unknown number of armored trains present.  On both sides of the Latvians are regular Soviet divisions.  The 85th regiment of the 10th, has partially deserted.  We have no way of knowing the full extent of the Latvians' reinforcements, so expect the worst after you capture Valga...
dst: 拉脱维亚红军已在城内构筑工事。他们保留了两个团作预备队，情报还警告说有数量不明的装甲列车在场。拉脱维亚人两侧是正规苏俄师。第10师第85团已部分逃亡。我们无法得知拉脱维亚人增援的全貌，所以在攻下瓦尔加后，请做好最坏的打算……

src: The Red army at Santander has been completely destroyed.  Only a few remnants have escaped to Asturias where they are now joined with the Asturian forces.  The enemy knows where to stop us in the mountains, but it's isolated.  The Republican government at Valencia can't send any kind of aid to the Asturians and it's just a matter of time until they are defeated.  However we must not allow the enemy to stage a heroic defense.  The winter in the mountains of Asturias is very hard and it will be the best ally for the Republicans.  Your task, mi General, is to get a quick and smashing victory.  Then, we will be able to turn our attention to the Aragon front.
dst: 桑坦德的红军已被彻底消灭。只有少数残部逃入阿斯图里亚斯，现在与阿斯图里亚斯部队会合。敌人知道在哪里能阻挡我们，但那是块与世隔绝的地方。巴伦西亚的共和派政府无法向阿斯图里亚斯人提供任何援助，他们被击败只是时间问题。然而我们绝不能容许敌人上演一场英雄式的防御。阿斯图里亚斯山区的冬天十分严酷，它将成为共和派最好的盟友。您的任务，将军阁下，是取得一场迅速而彻底的胜利。此后，我们就能把注意力转向阿拉贡前线。

src: The Red forces roam over most of Russia. All that you have learnt to love seems to be dying under the Bolshevik yoke. But you, along with a handful of fellow officers, are determined to make a last stand and save your beloved motherland. You won't leave without a fight. In the end, the Communist hordes will be defeated, or you'll die trying.
dst: 红军横行于俄国大部分地区。您所珍爱的一切似乎都在布尔什维克的枷锁下奄奄一息。但您，与少数同僚军官一起，决心做最后的抵抗，拯救您深爱的祖国。您不会不战而走。最终，要么共产主义群氓被击败，要么您在尝试中牺牲。

src: The Reds have defended themselves really well. I haven't been able to take Oboyan, but at least they're very weakened now. May-Mayevsky will relieve me and in a few days Kursk will be ours.
dst: 红军防守得确实很好。我没能攻下奥博扬，但至少他们现在已十分虚弱。迈-马耶夫斯基将来接替我，几天之内库尔斯克就将归我们所有。

src: The Reds resisted all our assaults. We tried everything, to no avail, and in the end we had to retire. The offensive against Orenburg was cancelled.
dst: 红军挡住了我们所有的猛攻。我们试尽一切办法，都无济于事，最终只得撤退。对奥伦堡的攻势被取消了。

src: The Reds. They've got good reasons to be worried. Most of the Taman Army Group has been destroyed or is trapped between the hills and the sea. In the next weeks we'll clean this area. The Bolsheviks will face surrender or extermination. It'll be a great blow for the Red Army of the Northern Caucasus. But not the last one. Denikin has informed me that the remaining Communist soldiers are heading south, to Armavir and Stavropol.
dst: 红军，他们有充分的理由担忧。塔曼集团军群的大部分已被消灭，或被围困在丘陵与大海之间。未来几周，我们将肃清这一地区。布尔什维克将面临投降或覆灭。这对北高加索红军将是一次沉重打击，但不会是最后一次。邓尼金已告知我，残余的共产党士兵正向南进发，前往阿尔马维尔和斯塔夫罗波尔。

src: The Regia Marina will assist you in this scenario. The British have some powerful battleships anchored in the ports of Alexandria and at sea.
dst: 意大利皇家海军将在本场景中协助你。英国人在亚历山大港和海上锚泊着一些强大的战列舰。

src: The Regio Aeronautica and the Luftwaffe have moved all available planes back from the desert to regain the necessary air superiority over Malta.
dst: 意大利皇家空军和德国空军已把所有可用飞机从沙漠调回，以重新取得马耳他上空必要的制空权。

src: The Reports were coming in from the Recon units.Soviet Tanks all over the place.A clerk ran into the Command Post of Frau General Elverfeldt "Yes General they are their too,We are completely surrounded.The Recon Commanders say they have never seen so many tanks"."How the Hell,ah it doesn't matter.I should have known this was never going to end til we're all dead.Ilse just had to get Me out of My nice cozy office in Berlin smack dab into a mess as this.I'll tell You She loses a few hands of cards and She gets so pissed and now who has the losing hand,Yours truly.Who the Hell do they think is commanding the Soviets here". "It is Kybiak Rubik,Frau General"." And I thought there wasn't an Officer in the East worthy to be called a Commander.My mistake and now it may be one of the last ones I get to make.Well get the Panzer Commanders in here and get on the phone,tell the Air Korps we've stirred up a Hornets Nest and could use all the aid We can get.We're You able to get a hold of 'Frann or 'Nerts Group"."The message got sent out but no reply as of yet"."If We get out of this I'm getting back on a Plane,getting My Ass back to Berlin and going to shove a High Heel up Ilse's butt.I need Combat Experience like I need a hole in My head".Commander Rubik contacted Stalin, "Let's see the SS Bitches solve this puzzle".
dst: 侦察部队的报告不断传来。苏军坦克到处都是。一名文书冲进埃尔弗费尔特女将军的指挥所：“是的，将军，那边也有，我们被彻底包围了。侦察指挥官们说，他们从没见过这么多坦克。”“怎么会，唉，无所谓了。我早该知道，这一切不到我们全死光不会结束。伊尔泽非要把我从柏林那间舒适的办公室拉出来，一头扎进这种烂摊子。告诉你，她打牌输几把就气得不行，现在谁手上有输光的牌？正是本人。他们以为这儿指挥苏联人的是谁。”“是基比亚克·鲁比克，女将军。”“我还以为东线没有一个军官配得上‘指挥官’这个称呼。我错了，而这可能是我犯的最后的几个错误之一。好了，把装甲指挥官们叫进来，再打电话告诉航空军，我们捅了马蜂窝，需要一切能得到的支援。你联系上‘弗兰’或‘内尔茨’集群了吗？”“讯息发出去了，但到目前为止没有回复。”“要是我们能活着出去，我就坐飞机回柏林，把一只高跟鞋塞进伊尔泽的屁股里。我需要实战经验，就像我脑袋上需要开个洞。”鲁比克指挥官联系了斯大林，“看党卫军那帮娘们怎么解开这道题。”

src: The Republican government has finally given the order to form a People's Army, some Mixed Brigades (Brigadas Mixtas, ''BM'') are now ready, and also other International Brigades (consisting mainly of foreign anti-fascist volunteers) should be ready for the battle!
dst: 共和政府终于下令组建一支共和军，一些混成旅（Brigadas Mixtas，「BM」）现已准备就绪，此外其他国际纵队（主要由外国反法西斯志愿者组成）也应做好战斗准备！

src: The Republicans have been kicked out of Teruel and now they are in total retreat.   They are scrambling for good positions to protect their new capital, Valencia.
dst: 共和派已被逐出特鲁埃尔，现在他们全线撤退。他们正争相抢占有利阵地，以保卫他们的新首都巴伦西亚。

src: The Revolution and your Life is Lost.
dst: 革命失败，您也丢掉了性命。

src: The Revolution is on its way to the West!  Comrade, a major offensive by our armies north and south of Kiev has pushed back the Polish bandits.  Even blind people can see that Kiev is about to fall.  Or better said, given back to the people of Kiev!
dst: 革命正向西进军！同志，我军在基辅南北发动的重大攻势已把波兰匪徒击退。即便是盲人也看得出，基辅即将陷落。或者更准确地说，即将交还给基辅人民！

src: The Revolution started from here with the sailor Karl Artelt and shipyard worker Lothar Popp (both USPD) as ringleaders.
dst: 革命就是从这里开始的，水兵卡尔·阿特尔特和船厂工人洛塔尔·波普（两人均为独立社会民主党成员）是带头人。

src: The Revolutionary Insurrectionary Army of Ukraine is not to be underestimated. They may lack a formal military formation, but they've showed great initiative and knowledge of the terrain. They appear out of nowhere, wipe out some of our garrisons, destroy or steal our supplies, disappear on the plains, regroup and attack some days later in a completely different location. They don't really want to hold the towns they take, their intention is to cause us as much damage as posssible, and they're good at it.
dst: 乌克兰革命起义军不容小觑。他们或许缺乏正规的军事编制，却表现出极强的主动性和对地形的熟悉。他们神出鬼没，消灭我们的一些守军，毁坏或劫走我们的补给，在平原上消失，数日后又在完全不同的地点重新集结并发动攻击。他们并不真想守住所占领的城镇，其意图是尽可能多地给我们造成破坏，而他们精于此道。

src: The Riukiu islands must not fall into the enemy hands!.
dst: 琉球群岛绝不能落入敌手！

src: The Roman legion seems to consist only of freshly recruited man with no appreciable combat experience .... The Norici traitors are a substantially serious opponent ...
dst: 这支罗马军团似乎全是由新征募、毫无实战经验的人组成 ...... 诺里库姆叛军才是真正棘手的对手 ...

src: The Romanian Army ended the war fighting against the Wehrmacht alongside the Soviets in Transylvania, Hungary, Yugoslavia, Austria and Czechoslovakia, from August 1944 until the end of the war in Europe. In May 1945, the Romanian First Army and the Romanian Fourth Army took part in the Prague Offensive. The Romanians incurred heavy casualties fighting Nazi Germany. Of some 538,000 Romanian soldiers who fought against the Axis in 1944-45, some 167,000 were casualties.
dst: 罗马尼亚军队于1944年8月至欧洲战事结束期间，在特兰西瓦尼亚、匈牙利、南斯拉夫、奥地利与捷克斯洛伐克，与苏军并肩对德军作战，以此结束了战争。1945年5月，罗马尼亚第1、第4集团军参加了布拉格攻势。罗马尼亚军对纳粹德国作战伤亡惨重——1944—45年抗击轴心国的约538,000名罗马尼亚士兵中，约167,000人伤亡。

src: The Romanian Troops showed signs of wavering and then completely faltered after this disaster.
dst: 罗马尼亚部队显露出动摇迹象，在这场灾难后彻底崩溃了。

src: The Romanian Troops showed signs of wavering but finally took heart by your tenacious example and finished off the Russian remnants.
dst: 罗马尼亚部队虽一度显露出动摇，但终因你坚韧的榜样而鼓起勇气，解决了俄军残部。

src: The Romanian army, with the help of its German ally, musters its strength to capture the Soviet controlled city of Kishinev.
dst: 罗马尼亚军队在德国盟友的帮助下集结兵力，准备夺取苏军控制的基希讷乌城。
The 罗马尼亚前线: Hermannstadt
The 罗马尼亚前线: Marasesti
The 罗马尼亚前线: Predeal 山口

src: The Romanian offensive was very well planned, but poorly executed due to a lack of coordination with the Russian commander at Dobrudzha. We could send you to Ryakhovo, and you succeeded at eliminating the Romanian bridgehead. Now, at last, we have free hands for our final assault to the Rasova- Kobadin- Tuzla line.
dst: 罗马尼亚的攻势谋划得十分周密，但由于与多布罗加的俄军指挥官缺乏协调而执行不力。我们得以把您派往里亚霍沃，您也成功拔除了罗马尼亚人的桥头堡。如今我们终于可以放手对拉索瓦—科巴丁—图兹拉防线发动最后突击了。

src: The Romanians are crazy, aren't they? Just as we feared, they attacked the Empire, thinking that the Brussilow- Offensive would succeed. They crossed the Karpaten and invaded Transsilvanien, defeating the local Hungarian garrisons.
dst: 罗马尼亚人真是疯了，对吧？正如我们所担心的，他们进攻了帝国，以为布鲁西洛夫攻势会成功。他们越过喀尔巴阡山，入侵特兰西瓦尼亚，击败了当地的匈牙利守备部队。

src: The Romanians are trapped and you will need to assist them also.
dst: 罗马尼亚人被困，你同样需要去援助他们。

src: The Romanians have been no match for your troops. Now nothing will stop us until we reach Bukarest. In the south the news are excellent, too. The Bulgarians have defeated the combined Romanian and Russian forces in Dobrudscha and now they're on their way to the port of Kreis Constanta. Caught between two fires, the remnants of the Romanian Army will soon be forced to surrender. This front will be quiet before Christmas. Yes, I know that you've heard that before, but this time I assure you that it's true.
dst: 罗马尼亚人根本不是您的部队的对手。如今，在我们抵达布加勒斯特之前，已经没有什么能阻挡我们了。南面的战报也同样出色。保加利亚人已在多布罗加击败罗马尼亚和俄国的联军，现在正向康斯坦察港挺进。腹背受敌之下，罗马尼亚军队的残部很快将被迫投降。这条战线将在圣诞节前安定下来。是的，我知道这话您以前听过，但这次我向您保证，这是真的。

src: The Romans are an enemy, as we have never met him before..... the Romans are not fighting for their fame and that of the gods; the Romans only know complete submission and enslavement ......!
dst: 罗马人是我们从未遇到过的敌人..... 罗马人不为声名与神明而战；罗马人只懂得彻底屈服与奴役 ......！

src: The Romans followed you, Teutobod. Your rearguard - a squad of Ambrones - have the Romans behind their backs... reach the secure storage with 15 men. But keep the strategically important parts of the hill and prepare for the decisive battle...
dst: 罗马人追上来了，条顿博德。你的后卫——一小队安布罗内斯人——背后就是罗马人... 带15人抵达安全的辎重处。但要守住山丘上具有战略意义的部分，并为决战做好准备...

src: The Romans found military support to the Latins and Hernicans, Whome the fall of the dreaded Etruscan neighbors promised as much benefit than the Romans themselves.
dst: 罗马人则得到了拉丁人与赫尔尼基人的军事支援；可憎的伊特鲁里亚邻邦若覆灭，这些人所得的好处并不亚于罗马人自己。

src: The Romans refused, and demonstrated Teutobod, King of the Teutons - the sister nation of the Cimbri - as a prisoner.
dst: 罗马人拒绝了，还把条顿人的国王、辛布里人的兄弟民族之君——条顿博德——当作囚徒示众。

src: The Romans remain in England for about 400 years: the north, todays Scotland, and the extreme west, today's Wales, were never subdued by them.
dst: 罗马人在英格兰逗留了约400年：北方，即今天的苏格兰，以及最西边，即今天的威尔士，从未被他们征服。

src: The Romans suffered one of the most devastanting defeats in their history...
dst: 罗马人遭到了他们历史上最具毁灭性的惨败之一...

src: The Romans under the legate Lucius Aurunculeius Cotta flee headlessly towards their next fortified camp ......
dst: 罗马人在副将卢基乌斯奥伦库莱乌斯科塔率领下，仓皇向他们的下一个设防营地逃去 ......

src: The Romans were defeated in Alesia, but they have built fortresses at strategic points, which are still manned with legions...
dst: 罗马人在阿莱西亚战败了，但他们在战略要地筑起了堡垒，那里仍驻有军团...

src: The Romny scenario and the map on which it is played are created by Hannes Gruber. No more than small modifications were made to make it fit into this campaign.
dst: 罗姆内场景及其所用地图由 Hannes Gruber 制作。为使其适配本战役，仅作了小幅修改。

src: The Royal Navy is weak but not destroyed so we must move across the channel rapidly.
dst: 皇家海军虽弱却未被摧毁，所以我们必须迅速渡过海峡。

src: The Rumanian 4. Army has launched its attack on Odessa in the last days. They succeeded in pushing our troops back. Your mission is to launch a counterattack and put the Rumanians back to their starting position.
dst: 罗马尼亚第4集团军近日对敖德萨发动了进攻。他们成功地把我们的部队击退。你的任务是发动反攻，把罗马尼亚人打回他们的出发阵地。

src: The Rumanian 4. Army is inexperienced. They have only a few tanks, but a lot of cavalry and infantry. We expect that some German troops will arrive in a few days to support the Rumanian attack.
dst: 罗马尼亚第4集团军缺乏经验。他们只有少量坦克，但有大量骑兵和步兵。我们预计几天后会有一些德军部队抵达，以支援罗马尼亚人的进攻。

src: The Rumanians proved to be too strong for you. Because you are incompetent to lead Red Army troops you will be stripped of your insignia and serve as a regular soldier from now on!
dst: 罗马尼亚人证明你无力应付。既然你无能指挥红军部队，你的军衔将被剥夺，从此以普通士兵身份服役！

src: The Russian 1st Army advanced into Eastern Prussia with the aim of besieging Koenigsberg and swinging south to meet the 2nd Army (Samsonov), which was advancing northward out of Russian Poland.  The city of Gumbinnen lay west of Satlluponen and formed the first line of German defense.
dst: 俄国第1集团军攻入东普鲁士，目标是围攻柯尼斯堡，然后挥师南下，与正从俄属波兰向北推进的第2集团军（萨姆索诺夫）会合。贡比嫩城位于斯托卢波嫩以西，构成了德军的第一道防线。

src: The Russian 33rd Army was able to relieve the 39rd Army, 29th Army and the 11th Cavalry Corps. Instead of Russian troops, lots of German divisions are now trapped behind enemy lines.
dst: 俄军第33集团军成功解救了第39集团军、第29集团军和第11骑兵军。如今被困在敌后的不是俄军，而是大批德军师。

src: The Russian 39rd Army followed by the 29th Army and the 11th Cavalry Corps have broken through our lines near Rzhev and are advancing South on Vyazma. Our Corps has just closed the lines behind these Bolshevik forces. Your orders are to hold Vyazma and stop the relief attempt by the Russian 33rd Army - that is advancing on Vyazma from the East - by capturing Maloyaroslavets and thus also cutting the 33rd Army off from their own lines.
dst: 俄军第39集团军，随后是第29集团军和第11骑兵军，已在勒热夫附近突破我军防线，正向南推进，直指维亚济马。我军已刚刚在这些布尔什维克部队身后封闭了战线。你的命令是守住维亚济马，并通过夺取小雅罗斯拉韦茨，阻止从东面向维亚济马推进的俄军第33集团军的解围企图——这样也就切断了第33集团军与其本方战线之间的联系。

src: The Russian 3rd Army exploited the gap between the KuK 3rd and 4th Armies. You are almost completely encircled; however, you are required to hold on and secure the railway lines until the majority of our troops can escape.
dst: 俄国第3集团军利用了奥匈第3、第4集团军之间的空隙。您几乎被完全包围；然而，您必须坚持并确保铁路线安全，直到我军主力能够撤离。

src: The Russian 50th Army defending Tula had been strongly reinforced and had turned the town into a fortress. Guderian pushed his Panzer Army east and then north around the town.Russian counter attacks in the area on November 17th halted him once more.He wrote to his wife:"the icy cold,the wretched accommodation,the insufficient clothing,the heavy losses of men and material and the meager supplies of fuel are making military operations a torture.I am getting increasingly depressed by the enormous weight of responsibility which,in spite of all the words,no-one can take off my shoulders."An attempt by 4th Army to renew its attack broke down. Over the next 14 days the offensive north and south also collapsed. Between the weather and Soviet spoiling attacks,only local advances occurred. T-34 tanks struck Guderian's right flank catching the 112th Infantry Division with no weapons that could stop them, and sending most of the division in panicked retreat.Members of a most-forward German patrol saw the towers of the Kremlin,as legend has it,perhaps not.Temperatures sank to minus 20 degrees Celsius,the German army was not able to cope with such cold,they lacked winter clothing and the number of frostbite cases rose to 228,000. Tanks,weapons,and radios failed.Bock doubted the value of pushing on,and asked OKH to suspend the operation but Brauchitsch,fearful of Hitler's anger, insisted the attacks must continue.
dst: 防守图拉的俄军第50集团军得到强力增援，把该镇变成了一座要塞。古德里安把他的装甲集团军向东推进，然后从该镇北面绕过。11月17日俄军在该地区的反击再次把他挡住。他给妻子写信说：“严寒、糟糕的住所、不足的衣物、人员和物资的重大损失以及燃料的匮乏，使军事行动变成一种折磨。巨大的责任压得我越来越抑郁，无论别人怎么说，这份责任没人能从我肩上卸下。”第4集团军重新发动进攻的尝试失败了。在接下来的14天里，南北两面的攻势也相继崩溃。由于天气和苏军的袭扰性进攻，只取得了一些局部进展。T-34坦克打击了古德里安的右翼，让第112步兵师毫无可用于阻止它们的武器，全师大部惊慌溃退。一个最前沿的德军巡逻队看到了克里姆林宫的塔楼——按传说如此，也许并非如此。气温降到零下20摄氏度，德军无法应付这样的严寒，缺少冬装，冻伤病例增至22.8万。坦克、武器和无线电台纷纷失灵。博克怀疑继续推进的价值，请求陆军总司令部暂停行动，但布劳希奇害怕希特勒发怒，坚持进攻必须继续。

src: The Russian Army captured Van too late.  Deploying General Sharpantier's cavalry forces, the IV Kavkaz Corps advanced its line rapidly between the lakes Van and Urmia against weakening Turkish second-line and Kurd resistance.
dst: 俄军夺取凡城为时已晚。第4高加索军部署沙尔庞捷将军的骑兵部队，在凡湖和乌尔米耶湖之间迅速推进战线，抗击日渐衰弱的土耳其二线部队和库尔德人抵抗。

src: The Russian Bear is getting tired, no?
dst: 俄国熊已疲态尽显，不是吗？

src: The Russian Empire's southern frontier, bordered by Persia and Afghanistan, is extremely porous.  This war leaves us no resources to establish a well-guarded frontier.  The Ottoman Empire has revived the specter of a Jihad against us, attempting to spread its influence upon numerous Turkik  and Islamic people under Russian Empire's rule.  The Ottomans and Germans-through their consulate missions in Persia-have actively encouraged, armed, and organized brigades of Mujahadeen with the aim of influencing the currently neutral lands to choose the sides in this war.
dst: 俄罗斯帝国南部边疆与波斯和阿富汗接壤，门户洞开。这场战争使我们无暇建立守备森严的边疆。奥斯曼帝国重新祭起对我们的圣战幽灵，企图将其影响力扩张到俄罗斯帝国统治下的众多突厥和伊斯兰民族身上。奥斯曼人和德国人——通过他们在波斯的领事使团——积极鼓动、武装并组建圣战者旅，旨在影响目前保持中立的这些土地在这场战争中选边站队。

src: The Russian armor is a surprise! It is much better then we thought and I hope there are not any more of those damned Siberians!
dst: 俄国的装甲令人吃惊！比我们预想的好得多，但愿别再冒出更多那些该死的西伯利亚人了！

src: The Russian attacks were finally repulsed, but the Ottomans paid a very high price for their victory.  In Galicia, during 1916 and 1917, the Turkish XV Army Corps suffered nearly 25,000 casualties, and the Russians took 10,000 Turkish prisoners of war. Finally, in 1917, between June and July, most of the XV Army Corps left Galicia and returned to Turkey.
dst: 俄军的进攻最终被击退，但奥斯曼为这场胜利付出了极其高昂的代价。在加利西亚，1916年和1917年间，土耳其第15军伤亡近25000人，俄军还俘虏了10000名土耳其战俘。最后，1917年6月至7月间，第15军大部分撤离加利西亚，返回土耳其。

src: The Russian cold winter still brings back memories of last year, does it not?
dst: 俄国的严冬仍让人想起去年，不是吗？

src: The Russian command resolved to prepare Port Arthur for a siege and to relieve the encirclement the following winter with an army being transported by railroad across Siberia.  You will participate in the last rearguard action before the ring closes around Port Arthur here at Nanshan.  Use flexible defensive tactics around the prepared defensive positions you have at your disposal.
dst: 俄军统帅部决定让旅顺口做好被围困的准备，并在来年冬天用一支经西伯利亚铁路运送的军队解除包围。您将参加在南山这里、包围圈在旅顺口四周合拢之前的最后一次后卫行动。利用您可支配的预设防御阵地，运用灵活的防御战术。

src: The Russian counter-offensive began on December 1st when 2 Panzer Army was attacked from all areas by what Guderian described as "hordes of Siberians". These troops from the 10th Army were indeed fresh reserves rushed from Siberia and released from the far east by the imminent entry of the USA into the war, Stalin's spy in Tokyo had informed him of a planned attack by Japan any day soon.The intention of the Soviet armies was to break through on the flanks of Army Group Center, surround as much of it as possible and cut it off. This catastrophic event completely changed the course of the war in 1941. It put the Wehrmacht into a state of panic. Here when they thought the enemy was beaten down, an entirely new fresh force, larger than theirs, was swooping in upon them. They seemed like ghosts in the blinding winter whiteness and came from everywhere. They were seemingly oblivious to the cold, disregarding death and with a vengeance as frigid as the air they were breathing.By the 2nd of December Guderian was forced to go over to the defensive and on the 6th, pressed by the Russian 10th and 50th Armies and the 1st Guards Cavalry Corps he began to withdraw towards the Shat and Don Rivers.
dst: 俄军的反攻始于12月1日，第2装甲集团军各处遭到古德里安所称“西伯利亚人群”的攻击。这些来自第10集团军的部队确实是刚从西伯利亚赶来的生力军，因美国即将参战而从远东调出——斯大林在东京的间谍已告知他日本即将发动进攻。苏军各集团军的意图是在中央集团军群的侧翼突破，尽可能多地包围并切断其部队。这一灾难性事件彻底改变了1941年的战争进程。它使国防军陷入惊慌。就在这里，当他们以为敌人已被打垮时，一支全新的、比他们更庞大的生力军却猛扑而来。他们仿佛炫目冬日雪原上的幽灵，从四面八方涌来。他们似乎对严寒浑然不觉，视死如归，带着如其所呼吸的空气一般冰冷的复仇之意。到12月2日，古德里安被迫转入防御；6日，在俄军第10和第50集团军以及近卫第1骑兵军的压迫下，他开始向沙季河与顿河撤退。

src: The Russian counterattack is a nightmare that has come true. They are trying to surround and crush our 3rd Army and we won't be able to resist their pressure until reinforcements arrive. We'll have to evacuate Kijów but we need some time to organize our troops and retreat in an orderly fashion towards our rear defence lines. You must resist the enemy attacks for as long as you can so that the rest of our troops have the time they need to retreat safely.
dst: 俄军的反攻是一场已经成真的噩梦。他们正试图包围并粉碎我们的第3集团军，在援军抵达之前，我们无法抵挡他们的压力。我们不得不撤离基辅，但我们需要时间把部队组织起来，有条不紊地向后方防线撤退。您必须尽可能久地抵挡敌人的进攻，好让其余部队有时间安全撤退。

src: The Russian forces detected massed against the Italian 8th Army are much lager than at first estimated!  Your assessment is correct - quicly get your corps in position to reinforce their lines along the Don.
dst: 侦测到集结对付意大利第8集团军的俄军，比最初估计的庞大得多！你的判断正确——迅速让你的军进入阵地，沿顿河加强他们的防线。

src: The Russian strategy in Manchuria relied completely on controlling the Chinese Eastern Railway. Although some parts of the line didn't have been built yet, it was a formidable piece of engineering that would soon communicate Chita and Vladivostok with Harbin and Liushun. Without that railway, the Russians wouldn't be able to remain in Chinese territory.
dst: 俄国在满洲的战略完全依赖于控制中东铁路。尽管这条线路的某些路段尚未建成，但它是一项了不起的工程，很快就能把赤塔和海参崴与哈尔滨和旅顺连接起来。没有这条铁路，俄国人就无法继续留在中国领土上。

src: The Russians appear to have a limitless suppy of troops to throw at us!
dst: 俄国人似乎有源源不断的部队向我们投来！

src: The Russians are about to unleash a massive attack aimed at the center of our line. It is up to you to fight against overwhelming odds and keep the Russians from taking Warsaw by August 29th. If possible, hold Warsaw and at least two other objectives until after then and we may yet have an opportunity to reverse the tide of this war.
dst: 苏军即将发起一场针对我战线中央的大规模进攻。你要以绝对劣势的兵力迎战，阻止苏军在 8月29日前夺取华沙。如有可能，在此之后仍守住华沙以及至少另外两个目标，我们或许还有机会扭转这场战争的局势。

src: The Russians are dazed and reeling from the blows you and your brave men have delivered! Not only did you succeed in relieving Buda-Pest, you drove the Reds back across the Danube. Herr General, diplomatic representatives of Germany and the Soviet Union are meeting even as we speak... Your string of victories here, and in the west, are unparalleled. You are to return home to a grateful nation.
dst: 俄国人被你和你英勇部队的重击打得晕头转向！你不仅成功解围了布达佩斯，还把红军赶回了多瑙河对岸。将军阁下，德国和苏联的外交代表此刻正在会晤……你在这里以及西线的一连串胜利无人能及。你将回到一个感恩的祖国。

src: The Russians are dazed and reeling from the blows you and your brave men have delivered! Not only did you succeed in relieving Buda-Pest, you drove the Reds back across the Danube. The General Staff is amazed at your performance, Herr Feldmarschall.  Now we must continue to pursue the Bolsheviks.  This time we will not settle for an armistice.
dst: 俄军被您和您勇敢部下的打击弄得晕头转向、溃不成军！您不仅成功为布达佩斯解围，还把红军赶回了多瑙河对岸。总参谋部对您的表现惊叹不已，元帅阁下。现在我们必须继续追击布尔什维克。这一次我们不会满足于停战了。

src: The Russians are dazed and reeling from the blows you and your brave men have delivered! Not only did you succeed in relieving Budapest, you drove the Reds back across the Danube. Herr Feldmarschall, diplomatic representatives of Germany and the Soviet Union are meeting even as we speak... Your string of victories here, and in the west, are unparalleled. You are to return home to a grateful nation.
dst: 俄国人被你和你勇敢的部下所给予的打击震得晕头转向、站立不稳！你不仅成功解了布达佩斯之围，还把红军赶回了多瑙河对岸。元帅阁下，就在我们说话的此刻，德国与苏联的外交代表正在会晤……你在这里以及在西方取得的一连串胜利无可比拟。你将返回祖国，接受一个心怀感激的国家的迎接。

src: The Russians are dazed and reeling from the blows you and your brave men have delivered! Not only did you succeed in relieving Budapest, you drove the Reds back across the Danube. Herr General, diplomatic representatives of Germany and the Soviet Union are meeting even as we speak... Your string of victories here, and in the west, are unparalleled. You are to return home to a grateful nation.
dst: 俄国人在你和你勇敢的部下所给予的打击下晕头转向、摇摇欲坠！你不仅成功解救了布达佩斯，还把红军赶回了多瑙河对岸。将军阁下，德国与苏联的外交代表此刻正在会晤……你在此地以及在西线的连番胜利是空前的。你将要回到家乡，迎接你的是一个心怀感激的国家。

src: The Russians are dazed and reeling from the blows you and your brave men have delivered! Not only did you succeed in relieving and reinforcing Buda-Pest defensive positions, you drove the Reds back across the Danube. Herr General, diplomatic representatives of Germany and the Soviet Union are meeting even as we speak... Your string of victories here, and in the west, are unparalleled. You are to return home to a grateful nation.
dst: 俄军被你和你的勇士们的一记记重击打得晕头转向！你不仅成功解了布达佩斯防御阵地之围并予以加强，还把赤俄驱回多瑙河对岸。将军阁下，德国与苏联的外交代表此刻正在会谈……你在此地以及在西线取得的一连串胜利都是前所未有的。你将返回祖国，接受一个感恩的国家的欢迎。

src: The Russians are determined to counter-attack on wide fronts.
dst: 俄军决意在广阔战线上发起反攻。

src: The Russians are everywhere! Our army is routed, and the Germans will have to send their reserves to prevent the collapse of the front. After making fools of ourselves like this, I guess that they'll send us back to Turkey, where at least we can help to fight the British.
dst: 俄国人无处不在！我军被击溃了，德军将不得不派出其预备队来防止战线崩溃。在这样丢人现眼之后，我想他们会把我们送回土耳其，在那里我们至少还能帮忙打英国人。

src: The Russians are expected to launch an offensive any minute; however, we don't know when and where they will attack. You must secure your sector. We will send reinforcements if your lines are in danger of being overwhelmed.
dst: 预计俄国人随时会发动攻势；但我们不知道他们将于何时何地进攻。您必须守住您的防区。若您的防线有被击溃的危险，我们会派出援军。

src: The Russians are now driving into the Balkans forcing a German withdrawl from Greece.....but they are taking the Italians POWs with them!  We must move quickly to rescue them and trap as many Germans south of Thermoplyae as possible.  We hope to negotiate a trade for POWs they already hold in Albania.
dst: 俄军正攻入巴尔干，迫使德军从希腊撤退……但他们把意大利战俘也一起带走了！我们必须迅速行动去解救他们，并尽可能多地把德军困在温泉关以南。我们希望通过谈判，换回他们已关押在阿尔巴尼亚的战俘。

src: The Russians are retreating everywhere; however, our troops are also exhausted. We reached the Bug again, and it's time to reap the rewards of this offensive: take Brest-Litovsk.
dst: 俄国人正在全线撤退；不过，我军也已疲惫不堪。我们再次抵达布格河，现在是收获这场攻势成果的时候了：夺取布列斯特-利托夫斯克。

src: The Russians are retreating, not only here in Limanowa, but in other sectors, too. That's good. They will never have another chance to take Krakau.
dst: 俄国人正在撤退，不只是在利马诺瓦，在其他防区也是如此。这很好。他们将再也没有机会夺取克拉科夫。

src: The Russians are strung out, now is opportune to defeat them in detail.  I know you and your men are still getting used to this area, but be thankful the winter is not so harsh this far south.
dst: 俄军兵力分散，现在正是逐个击破他们的时机。我知道你和你的人还在适应这个地区，但要庆幸这么靠南的地方冬天没那么严酷。

src: The Russians attempt to relieve their encircled forces at Kiev. You must respond with a counter attack.
dst: 俄国人试图解救他们在基辅被围的部队。你必须以反击回应。

src: The Russians had some very good defences prepared for us!
dst: 俄国人为我们准备了相当出色的防御！

src: The Russians have 2 Guard's Armies to conduct their offensive!  I know you and your men are just now disembarking but you must hurry,  our IT 8th Army is critically short anti-tank guns and your appearance in the days ahead will do wonders to their morale.
dst: 俄军以两个近卫集团军发动攻势！我知道你和你的人刚下船，但你必须抓紧，我意大利第8集团军反坦克炮严重短缺，你几天内的出现将极大提振他们的士气。

src: The Russians have achieved nothing. They've taken many territories, but they've lost so many soldiers and equipment that I doubt they'll be able to keep them for a long time. They've exhausted their last reserves, so from now on I think that they won't suppose a real threat to us. Paradoxically, France and Russia could have switched their destinies.
dst: 俄国人一无所获。他们占领了许多领土，却损失了如此多的士兵和装备，我怀疑他们很难长久守住。他们已经耗尽了最后的预备队，所以从今往后，我想他们不会再对我们构成真正的威胁了。说来矛盾，法国和俄国仿佛互换了命运。

src: The Russians have agreed to an armistice.
The Russians have almost completely encircled Vienna. Your division's task is too hold open the bridges over the Danube to let as many troops as possible escape to the west.
dst: 俄国人几乎完全包围了维也纳。你师的任务是守住多瑙河上的桥梁通道，让尽可能多的部队西撤。

src: The Russians have asked us for supplies and an attack on Turkey to relieve the pressure on their front line. We know that the Turks have formidible coastal guns guarding the Dardanelle Strait which is the supply line to southern Russia. You are to sail a squadron of Royal Navy and French warships up the strait and destroy these guns so the way is open for our fleet to attack Constantinople and force a Turkish surrender.
dst: 俄国人请求我们提供物资并对土耳其发动进攻，以缓解其前线的压力。我们知道，土耳其人以令人生畏的海岸炮扼守着达达尼尔海峡——这是通往俄国南部的补给线。您要率一支皇家海军与法国军舰组成的分舰队驶上海峡，摧毁这些火炮，从而为我们的舰队打开通路，以进攻君士坦丁堡并迫使土耳其投降。

src: The Russians have been stopped at Tartu.  You must hurry back to Tallinn to face the brunt of the Soviet offensive.
dst: 俄国人已在塔尔图被挡住。您必须火速赶回塔林，去迎击苏军攻势的主力。

src: The Russians have crossed the Dneiper river. You must push them back or we will be in full retreat.
dst: 俄军已渡过第聂伯河。你必须把他们推回去，否则我们就要全面撤退了。

src: The Russians have learned not to repeat their mistakes of '41. North of Saratov they try to escape encirclement and to save at least their mobile forces. Several pontoon bridges were built protected by strong air defense that allow their troops to escape across the Volga to the east. Your order is to destroy these bridges and close this loophole as fast as possible!
dst: 俄国人已经学会不重蹈41年的覆辙。在萨拉托夫以北，他们试图逃脱合围，至少要保住机动部队。他们架起了几座浮桥，并有强大的防空掩护，好让部队渡过渡尔加河向东逃窜。你的命令是摧毁这些桥梁，尽快堵上这个缺口！

src: The Russians have tasked us to help two infantry regiments and some Cossack cavalry to advance deep behind Austro-Hungarian lines as part of their huge Brusilov offensive. Our objective is the city of Sborov.
dst: 俄国人交给我们的任务是，协助两个步兵团和一些哥萨克骑兵，作为其庞大的布鲁西洛夫攻势的一部分，深入奥匈军队战线后方。我们的目标是斯博罗夫城。

src: The Russians mobilized their forces sooner than we expected. Stop their advance and hold the defense line beyond the Bug until the main Austro-Hungarian troops arrive.
dst: 俄国人比我们预期的更早动员了军队。阻止他们的推进，并在主力奥匈军队抵达前守住布格河对岸的防线。

src: The Russians must be crazy. After they dethroned Zar Nikolaus in March the country is in a state of anarchy. Many regiments refuse to keep on fighting and desertions are frequent. Under these circumstances Kerenski, the president of the new republican government, should have signed a peace treaty with us and then put his country in order, but he's decided to attack us instead. He thinks that France and the British Empire will grant him the help that he needs, but his allies won't give it for free. They've demanded Russia to give them some kind of military support in exchange for their future aid and, believe it or not, Kerenski has complied with those demands.
dst: 俄国人一定是疯了。他们在三月废黜了沙皇尼古拉之后，国家便陷入了无政府状态。许多团拒绝继续作战，开小差的事屡见不鲜。在这种情况下，新共和政府的首脑克伦斯基本应与我们签订和约，然后整顿自己的国家，可他偏偏决定向我们进攻。他以为法国和大英帝国会给他所需的帮助，但他的盟友不会白白相助。他们要求俄国以某种军事支持来换取将来的援助，而信不信由您，克伦斯基竟答应了这些要求。

src: The Russians plan an attack against the Arhavi-Findikli section of our defensive coastal line. Our forces are weak, outgunned and outranged. And the Russians dominate in the skies and the sea, too.
dst: 俄军计划进攻我们沿海防线的阿尔哈维-芬迪克利地段。我们的兵力薄弱，火力与射程都不如人。而俄国人在空中和海上也占据优势。

src: The Russians position can be characterised as a big wedge with Pommerania to the north of it, and Silesia south of it. You are to start a slow attack on the head of it. In the mean time we will transfer large formations of new panzers to Silesia and Pommerania. These wil then march on the besieged city of Posen, and trap the Whiterussian front.
dst: 俄军的态势可以形容为一个巨大的楔子，其北面是波美拉尼亚，南面是西里西亚。您要对这个楔子的头部发起缓慢进攻。与此同时，我们将把大批新式装甲部队调往西里西亚和波美拉尼亚。它们随后将向被围的波兹南城进军，并合围白俄罗斯方面军。

src: The Russians want to break our defences north of Warszawa so they would be able to strike from behind the city. Our last hope is the counterattack that commander Józef Pilsudski is preparing from the south. But in the meantime you and your troops, as well all the rest of the Polish 5th Army under General Wladyslaw Sikorski, will have to defend the northern area near the Modlin Fortress from an enemy that has superior numbers.
dst: 俄国人想突破我们在华沙以北的防线，这样他们就能从城市背后发动打击。我们最后的希望，是指挥官约瑟夫·毕苏斯基正在从南面准备的这次反攻。但与此同时，您和您的部队，以及瓦迪斯瓦夫·西科尔斯基将军麾下波兰第5集团军的其余所有部队，都必须防守莫德林要塞附近的北部地区，抵御兵力占优的敌人。

src: The Russians were hoping a massive push down the East Flank around Salem plus increasingly supplied partisan activity in the SW and also a new Navy beachhead in the SE around Oil Depot Alpha would finally bring the Germans to their knees.
dst: 俄军则期望：沿东翼萨勒姆一带大举推进，加上西南方向补给日益充足的游击队活动，以及东南方向“阿尔法油库”一带新的海军登陆场，能最终迫使德军屈服。

src: The Russians will respond swiftly with a counter-attack. Be ready.
dst: 俄军将迅速以反攻回应。做好准备。

src: The Russkies have new troops with limited experience but the quantity of troops and equipment is beyond belief!
dst: 俄军有新部队但经验有限，然而其兵员与装备数量之多令人难以置信！

src: The Russo-Japanese War was a highly embarassing conflict for Russia:  much more so for the Russian Navy.  After the Port Arthur squadron failed to escape and link up with the Vladivostok squadron (the Battle of the Yellow Sea, August 1904), Russia dispatched the Baltic Fleet around South Africa (to be coaled by German colliers en route!) to assault the Japanese fleet and to lift the blocade.  The Japanese, laying in ambush in the straits of Tsushima delivered a decisive blow to the fleet in May of 1905, dashing all hopes of relieving the besieged Port Arthur.  Signing the Treaty of Portsmouth in September of 1905, the Russian Empire relinquished its sphere of influence on the Korean peninsula and Manchuria.
dst: 日俄战争对俄国而言是一场极为难堪的冲突：对俄国海军来说更是如此。在旅顺口分舰队突围与海参崴分舰队会合的努力失败后（1904年8月的黄海海战），俄国派遣波罗的海舰队绕行南非（途中由德国运煤船供煤！）去攻击日本舰队并解除封锁。日本人埋伏在对马海峡，于1905年5月给了这支舰队决定性一击，使解除旅顺口之围的一切希望化为泡影。1905年9月，俄国签署《朴次茅斯和约》，放弃了在朝鲜半岛和满洲的势力范围。

src: The SS Panzer Crews rushed to the Rail station.Finally the time had come,the Mark VI Tigers had arrived.Just a few and of course the 1st SS would be assigned most,still now instead of being better than Ivan they had the Equipment to put them on a Plateau where no Tanker had been before.Soviet Armor would be shot to pieces with the massive 88 and the SS Crews would be protected better with all the Armor thickness.The Frau's could stop dying and being maimed in the numbers they were while tangling with the Soviet massed attacks. SS Armor ratio was 1 SS tank lost to between 4 and 5 of Ivan.With a Tiger and the 88 it was thought it could reach 1 to 10,maybe even 15. A Tiger of course had to trade mobility and range of movement for that Awesome Gun and the Armor.Command was surprised that just the few Tigers arriving shot the Frau's morale up a 100 percent.The Doom and Gloom was replaced with now 'We can do it as it was in the first months of the attack on Russia'.And the Morale swept through not only the Panzer Crews but the infantry as well.With a Tiger around the Frau's could concentrate on the Ivan foot soldiers for the Ivan Armor was as good as destroyed.So the Frau's in their Tigers moved out."How about that kill ratio Helga"?
dst: 党卫军装甲车组们涌向火车站。时机终于到了，六号“虎”式坦克运抵。数量不多，而且大部分自然拨给党卫军第1师；但如今她们不再只是比伊万强，而是有了能把她们带到此前任何坦克手都未曾到过的高度的装备。苏军装甲会被那门巨大的88炮打成碎片，党卫军车组也因厚重的装甲得到更好的保护。在与苏军集群攻击纠缠时，“女士”们不必再以那样高的数量伤亡和致残。党卫军装甲的交换比本是损失1辆换伊万4到5辆。有了“虎”式和88炮，人们认为可以达到1比10，甚至1比15。当然，“虎”式为了那门可怕的炮和厚重装甲，不得不在机动性和行程上做出牺牲。仅这少量“虎”式的到来就把“女士”们的士气抬高了100%，这让司令部感到意外。悲观沮丧被“我们做得到，就像进攻俄国最初几个月那样”取代。这股士气不仅席卷装甲车组，也传遍步兵。有“虎”式在旁，“女士”们可以专心对付伊万的步兵，因为伊万的装甲等于已被摧毁。于是驾着“虎”式的“女士”们出发了。“这交换比怎么样，赫尔加？”

src: The SS was ready to move on Paris.Bad weather through most of December had prevented the Air Korps of the SS/BdM from stopping the 3 French Armee's getting deployed.SS artillery had gotten close enough to do random shelling but it was more a nusiance than anything.The French could not let Paris fall so the fight here would be a 'Stand or Die'.Weather reports from 'Bucheford still had the Sky cloaked in clouds and freezing rain were now too optimistic.Commander Simone Hirkjohns in Paris had just got reports on the Weather plus the Brits getting some armor on the Coast near Dieppe giving Him a few more days respite.Stepping out of His Command Bunker He drove off to the Front of 12th Armee.Through Field Glasses He saw the SS on the move and knew this would be a murderous battle for both sides.Unfortunately for Hirkjohns He noticed the Sky getting lighter,a warmer breeze blowing and the Sun even trying to peek through the Heavy Clouds.And a message from the Brits,what should they do.The French Commander knew this SS/BdM Air Korps would have every plane they had involved in this fight including some new prototype.A 'Relief' Pari would not get, nor Hirkjohns,nor His 3 Armee Groups.Maybe the Brits could move on the SS flank?
dst: 党卫军已准备向巴黎推进。12月大半时间的恶劣天气使党卫军/BdM 的航空军无法阻止法军3个集团军完成部署。党卫军炮兵已逼近到可以随机炮击，但那更像骚扰。法国人不能让巴黎陷落，因此这里的战斗将是“要么守住，要么死战”。来自布赫福德的天气报告说天空仍被云层和冻雨笼罩——如今看来已过于乐观。巴黎的西蒙娜·希克约翰斯指挥官刚收到天气报告，加上英国人有一些装甲部队抵达迪耶普附近海岸，这又为他多争取了几天喘息。走出指挥部地堡，他驱车前往第12集团军前线。透过望远镜，他看见党卫军正在行动，心知这将是一场对双方都残酷血腥的战斗。对希克约翰斯不幸的是，他注意到天色渐亮、暖风轻拂，太阳甚至试图从厚重的云层中探出头来。还有英国人发来的讯息，问他们该怎么办。这位法军指挥官知道，党卫军/BdM 的航空军会把手上所有飞机——包括一些新原型机——都投入这场战斗。巴黎等不到“解围”，希克约翰斯等不到，他的3个集团军群也等不到。也许英国人能从党卫军侧翼发动攻击？

src: The SS-Division "Reich" and parts of the 10th Panzer Division were approaching the Borodino battlefield 100 km west of Moscow. Between them and the Russian Capital stood the reinforced 32nd Siberian Rifle Division, just arrived by train to man the partly completed Mozhaisk Defense Line. After five days of brutal fighting, the SS finally got through, but fresh units filled in behind the survivors.
dst: 党卫军“帝国”师和第10装甲师一部正逼近莫斯科以西100公里的博罗季诺战场。在他们与俄国首都之间，横着得到加强的第32西伯利亚步兵师——该师刚乘火车赶到，以守御尚未完工的莫扎伊斯克防线。经过五天残酷战斗，党卫军终于突破，但新鲜部队又填补到幸存者的背后。

src: The Second Battle of the Marne was an important victory. The Allies took 29,367 prisoners, 793 guns and 3,000 machine guns and inflicted 168,000 casualties on the Germans. For this success,  Ferdinand Foch received the baton of a Marshal of France.
dst: 第二次马恩河战役是一场重要胜利。协约国俘虏了29367人、缴获793门火炮和3000挺机枪，并使德军伤亡168000人。凭借这一胜利，费迪南·福煦获得了法国元帅的权杖。

src: The Second Vienna Award reassigned the territory of Northern Transylvania (43.000 km2) from Romania to Hungary on August 30, 1940. Our troops completed the reannexation process on September 13. Only a few Iron Guard (Garda de fier) squads provoked smaller skirmishes. Governor Horthy decided to treat them as casus belli and ordered you to invade Southern Transylvania. Your task is retake Nagyszeben (Sibiu) with its vital road and railway junctions. Do not fail us, General!
dst: 第二次维也纳裁决于1940年8月30日将北特兰西瓦尼亚（43000平方公里）的领土从罗马尼亚划归匈牙利。我军于9月13日完成了重新兼并的进程。只有少数铁卫团（Garda de fier）小队挑起了小规模冲突。霍尔蒂摄政决定将其视为宣战理由，命令你入侵南特兰西瓦尼亚。你的任务是夺回纳吉塞本（锡比乌）及其至关重要的公路与铁路枢纽。不要让我们失望，将军！

src: The Senate gave the command of their loyal Legions to Popmpeius, an experienced old "warhorse" who is already alowed to be named "magnus" (The Great).
dst: 元老院把他们忠诚军团的指挥权交给了庞培——一位经验丰富的老「战马」，此时已获准被称作「magnus」（大帝）。

src: The Senussi Order is not accepting our rule over the Libyan coast and our local forces met strong guerrilla resistance of Senussi tribal fighters lead by sheikh Omar Mukhtar. They frequently raid our coastal cities and supply lines. Our control over the area reaches barely 10 miles into the desert. The situation in the Derna area is critical.
dst: 赛努西教团不接受我们对利比亚海岸的统治，我们的当地部队遭遇了由谢赫奥马尔·穆赫塔尔率领的赛努西部落战士的顽强游击抵抗。他们频繁袭击我们的沿海城市和补给线。我们对这一地区的控制仅深入沙漠约10英里。德尔纳地区的局势十分危急。

src: The Senussi raids already forced us to evacuate Sollum and Sidi Barrani, and the frontier posts have been withdrawn to Mersa Matruh. Now that considerable forces have returned from Gallipoli, we should be able to defeat this insurgency. The main hostile force has been reported to be at Agagia, somewhere south east of Sidi Barrani.
dst: 塞努西的袭扰已迫使我们撤离塞卢姆和西迪巴拉尼，边境哨所也已撤回至梅尔萨马特鲁。既然相当规模的部队已从加里波利返回，我们应当能够击败这场叛乱。据报道，敌军主力位于西迪巴拉尼东南某处的阿加贾。

src: The Serbian Army has been defeated at all fronts, and now its remnants have retreated to Kosovo, where they hope to resist until help comes. But their fate will be surrender or destruction. Right now, we can attack them from all sides but the west: You will lead our First Army from the Morava Valley in the northeast. Some units of the German 11th Army will advance from the north and, after liberating Macedonia, some units of our Second Army will attack from the South. Very soon, Serbia will be doomed.
dst: 塞尔维亚军队在所有战线上都已战败，如今其残部已退入科索沃，寄望于在援军到来之前继续抵抗。但他们的命运不是投降就是覆灭。眼下，我们可以从西面以外的各个方向向他们发起进攻：您将从东北方的摩拉瓦河谷率领我第一集团军。德军第11集团军的部分部队将从北面推进，而在解放马其顿之后，我第二集团军的部分部队将从南面发起进攻。塞尔维亚的覆灭已是指日可待。

src: The Serbian Army has been nearly destroyed. Only a few units have managed to flee to Albania and join the British and the French.
dst: 塞尔维亚军队已几乎被摧毁。只有少数部队设法逃往阿尔巴尼亚，加入了英法军队。

src: The Siege of Budapest was a siege of the Hungarian capital city of Budapest, fought towards the end of World War II in Europe, during the Soviet Budapest Offensive.
dst: 布达佩斯围城战是二战欧洲战场末期、苏军布达佩斯攻势期间，对匈牙利首都布达佩斯展开的围城。

src: The Siege of Budapest was one of the bloodiest sieges of World War II and it ended when the city was unconditionally surrendered on 13 February 1945.
dst: 布达佩斯围城战是二战中最血腥的围城之一，于1945年2月13日该城无条件投降而告终。

src: The Siege of Sevastopol lasted 250 days, from 30 October 1941 to 4 July 1942, when the Axis finally captured the city.
dst: 塞瓦斯托波尔围城战持续了250天，从1941年10月30日到1942年7月4日，轴心国最终攻占了该城。

src: The Slovak National uprising is highly controversial theme and everything surrounding it became a reason for heated discussions in past years. As such, I didn't want to dabble in it. But I couldn't gloss over it just as well. So, this lead me to the creation of something special.
dst: 斯洛伐克民族起义是一个极具争议的话题，围绕它的一切在过去的岁月里引发了激烈争论。正因如此，我不想涉足其中。但我也无法避而不谈。于是，这促使我创作了一些特别的东西。

src: The Socialist States are reeling from the twin defeats you inflicted on them at New York and Washington D.C.  President Wallace himself announced a ceasefire today from Chicago.  It looks like the damn rebs may be finally giving up, Commander.
dst: 社会主义国家正因你在纽约和华盛顿给它们造成的双重失败而摇摇欲坠。华莱士总统本人今天在芝加哥宣布了停火。看来那些该死的叛军终于要投降了，指挥官。

src: The Somme was the debut of the Kitchener Army created by Lord Kitchener's call for recruits at the start of the war. They suffered heavy losses: 420,000. French losses were about 200,000 and German losses about 500,000. Germany, also at war against Russia, started to lose the war of attrition.
dst: 索姆河是基钦纳军队的首次亮相，这支军队是战争开始时基钦纳勋爵号召募兵组建的。他们损失惨重：42万人。法军损失约20万，德军损失约50万。同时还在与俄国交战的德国，开始输掉这场消耗战。
索姆河: 弗莱尔-库尔瑟莱特

src: The Soviet 5th Guards tank army that got badly mauled at Prokhorovka when meeting your forces in mid July has been rebuilt. It has rushed through the gap between our 4th Pz Army and Group Kempf and is now threatening Kharkov. A Kampfgruppe of the 3rd Pz Division, the 198ID and some corps troops are defending the city. They urgently need your help to stop the flood of T34 tanks.
dst: 7月中旬在普罗霍罗夫卡与我军遭遇时被痛击的苏军近卫第5坦克集团军已重建。它冲过我们第4装甲集团军与肯普夫集群之间的缺口，如今正威胁哈尔科夫。第3装甲师的一个战斗群、第198步兵师和一些军属部队正在防守该城。他们亟需你的帮助，以挡住T-34坦克的洪流。

src: The Soviet Baltic Fleet is a serious threat!
dst: 苏联波罗的海舰队是严重的威胁！

src: The Soviet Black Sea managed to evacuate 350,000 soldiers and civilians before the fall of the city. Nevertheless, this Romanian victory has to be considered to be amongst the greatest successes of the war by any minor Axis power. The Romanian success also had political implications: The Romanian army was partially demobilized and the British would eventually declare war on Romania in December.
dst: 苏联黑海舰队在城市陷落前成功撤离了35万名士兵和平民。尽管如此，这场罗马尼亚的胜利必须被视为轴心国中任何小国所取得的最伟大成功之一。罗马尼亚的胜利还带来了政治影响：罗马尼亚军队被部分复员，而英国最终在12月对罗马尼亚宣战。

src: The Soviet Union has invaded Finland, Herr General, and our Finnish friends have trapped a Soviet division in the town of Suomussalmi. Unfortunately, an even greater Soviet relief force is moving to aid their comrades, and the Finns are outnumbered. It is your task to destroy the isolated enemy and prevent the relief force from reaching him. Of course, due to our non-aggression pact with the Soviet Union, you and your troops will be considered volunteers.  If you are defeated, the General Staff will deny any knowledge of your participation, and you may expect the worst if captured.
dst: 苏联已入侵芬兰，将军阁下，我们的芬兰友军已将一支苏军师围困在苏奥穆萨尔米镇。不幸的是，一支规模更大的苏军救援部队正前去接应他们的同志，而芬兰人兵力处于劣势。您的任务是歼灭这支被孤立的敌军，并阻止救援部队与之会合。当然，鉴于我们与苏联签有互不侵犯条约，您和您的部队将被视为志愿者。倘若您战败，总参谋部将否认知悉您的参与，而您一旦被俘，就别指望有什么好下场。

src: The Soviet Union have pressed the United States and United Kingdom to start operations in Europe and open a second front to reduce the pressure of German forces on the Soviet troops. While the American commanders favored Operation Sledgehammer, landing in Occupied Europe as soon as possible, the British commanders believed that such a course would end in disaster.
dst: 苏联一直敦促美英在欧洲开辟第二战场，以减轻德军对苏军的压力。美军指挥官倾向于“大锤”行动，尽快在被占领的欧洲登陆；而英军指挥官则认为此路必以灾难收场。

src: The Soviet assembled their Fifth Army under General Tukhachevsky, which later lead the invasion of Poland and become victim of Stalin's purges. The Fifth Army had reached the Volga River and was now ready to recapture Kazan.
dst: 苏维埃在图哈切夫斯基将军麾下集结了第五集团军，这支部队后来领导了入侵波兰，又成为斯大林大清洗的牺牲品。第五集团军已抵达伏尔加河，现已准备夺回喀山。

src: The Soviet force took their half of the rocket base, packed up, and left.  No word on where they went, and a shame we only got half of the material, but at least we didn't have to try to fight them for the compound.
dst: 苏联部队拿走了火箭基地的一半，打包走人了。不知道他们去了哪里，可惜我们只拿到一半物资，但至少我们不必跟他们争夺这座园区。

src: The Soviet offensive broke through the German lines, and created a 200 km wide gap. The 1st Hungarian Army, defending the Carpathian mountains, was asked to help the German ally to fill the gap. Go ahead and halt the Bolshevik advance.
dst: 苏军攻势突破了德军防线，撕开了一道宽达200公里的缺口。正在喀尔巴阡山脉一线防守的匈牙利第1集团军奉命协助德国盟友填补这一缺口。去吧，阻止布尔什维克的推进。

src: The Soviet offensive has been too strong. Again and again we have been forced to retreat and now the Russian Red Army is ready for its final assault on Warszawa. As the Russian troops cross the Wkra River and advance towards Modlin Fortress, our defeat seems inminent. In a few days Poland could cease to exist as an independent state.
dst: 苏军的攻势过于强大。我们一次又一次被迫撤退，如今俄国红军已准备对华沙发动最后的进攻。随着俄军渡过弗克拉河并向莫德林要塞推进，我们的失败似乎已迫在眉睫。再过几天，波兰作为一个独立国家可能就不复存在了。

src: The Soviet offensive is stopped - counterattack with your troops immediately and advance on Tehran!
dst: 苏军的攻势已被遏止——立即率你的部队反击，向德黑兰推进！

src: The Soviet offensive is stopped and you have achieved all objectives, the mission was a complete success. Good work!
dst: 苏军的攻势已被遏止，你达成了全部目标，任务圆满完成。干得好！

src: The Soviets are completely defeated, Herr General! Your troops will link at any time with their comrades from Army Group South. It is a great victory! The Fuhrer is very pleased!
dst: 苏军已被彻底击败，将军阁下！你的部队随时都将与南方集团军群的战友会师。这是一场伟大的胜利！元首非常满意！

src: The Soviets are ready for their own attack on Berlin. They have brought in their Far Eastern Army, much of their forces from the Balkans and forces from East Prussia and Silesia for one HUGE three-pronged strike towards Berlin. Your forces are located on the West bank of the Oder at Seelower Höhen and will face the brunt of the Soviet forces. Do not expect reinforcements. They are required to hold the front North and South of Berlin.
dst: 苏军也已做好自己对柏林发起进攻的准备。他们调来了远东军团、巴尔干的大部分兵力，以及来自东普鲁士和西里西亚的部队，准备对柏林发起一次规模巨大的三路进攻。你的部队位于奥得河西岸的塞洛高地，将首当其冲面对苏军主力。不要指望增援。他们需要用来守住柏林南北两面的战线。

src: The Soviets aren't dumb, Commander; they know they have no hope of sustaining a massive invasion on such far-strung logistics.  We believe their force is more of a raiding party than anything else, with limited objectives; and we believe their target is the device you recently secured in Greenland, which we have moved to the Aberdeen Proving Ground in eastern Maryland for safekeeping and analysis, overseen by yours truly.
dst: 苏联人并不蠢，指挥官；他们知道自己靠着如此漫长的补给线，根本没有希望维持一场大规模入侵。我们相信他们的部队更像一支有限目标的突袭队；我们还相信他们的目标是你在格陵兰新近缴获的那个装置——我们已把它转移到马里兰州东部的阿伯丁试验场妥善保管并分析，由我本人监督。

src: The Soviets assembled at Mtsensk the 1st Guards Rifle Corps made up of the 4th and 11th Tank Brigades,36th Motorcycle Regiment,201th Air Brigade,6th Guards Rifle Division and cadets of the Tula artillery school.The Tank Brigades were re-equipped with brand new T-34 tanks and by this time "General Winter" was introducing himself to the German army.The 4th deployed itself in a series of open fields and took on the leading columns of German tanks.The advance of the 4th Pz Division was halted at Mtsensk and it was three days before the Division was able to resume its advance and enter the town. Colonel Katukov had the time to set up a careful defense,infantry was placed along the front line to catch the attention of the approaching Germans,behind them,tanks were carefully hidden at various points that offered a good field of fire. General Zhukov made mention of it in one of his reports, stating,"For the first time, our 4th and 11th Brigades hit the enemy vehicles from ambush." The 4th attacked again and this time the division was badly mauled. Guderian noted: "we have enjoyed tank superiority, but this is no longer the case!" He requested that a commission be sent to study the T-34 and incorporate its features into German designs and AT guns capable of destroying it be provided.For strong resistance and unprecedented actions 4th Tank Brigade was transformed into the 1st Guards Tank Brigade.
dst: 苏军在姆岑斯克集结了近卫第1步兵军，由第4和第11坦克旅、第36摩托团、第201航空旅、近卫第6步兵师和图拉炮兵学校的学员编成。两个坦克旅换装了崭新的T-34坦克，而此时“冬将军”正向德军打招呼。第4旅在一片开阔地上展开，迎面撞上德军的先头坦克纵队。第4装甲师的推进在姆岑斯克被挡住，过了三天该师才得以继续前进并进入该镇。卡图科夫上校有时间精心设防：步兵沿前线布置以吸引逼近的德军注意，在他们身后，坦克被小心地隐蔽在若干有良好射界的位置上。朱可夫将军在一份报告中提到此事，说：“我们的第4和第11旅第一次从设伏中打击敌军车辆。”第4旅再次进攻，这一次该师被打得大败。古德里安指出：“我们曾享有坦克优势，但如今已不复存在！”他请求派一个委员会来研究T-34，把其特点融入德国的设计，并提供能够击毁它的反坦克炮。由于顽强抵抗和前所未有的战法，第4坦克旅被改编为近卫第1坦克旅。

src: The Soviets blew all bridges! Find a way to cross the Prut river and launch your offensive. Good luck, Herr General!
dst: 苏联人炸毁了所有桥梁！找到渡过普鲁特河的办法，发起你的攻势。祝你好运，将军阁下！

src: The Soviets deployed a dozen of tank battalions supported by large numbers of infantry, assault guns, rocket artillery, and fighter-bombers.
dst: 苏军部署了十来个坦克营，辅以大量步兵、突击炮、火箭炮和战斗轰炸机。

src: The Soviets deployed some powerful capital ships to this area!
dst: 苏联人向该地区部署了一些强大的主力舰！

src: The Soviets eventually captured Kazan and the Czech Legion would retreat. News from Europe would weaken the wrath against the bolsheviks...
dst: 苏维埃最终攻占了喀山，捷克军团将撤退。来自欧洲的消息将削弱人们对布尔什维克的怒火……

src: The Soviets finaly managed to encircle our 6th Army and they are bringing in more and more reinforcements. You need to relief our comrades in Stalingrad now!
dst: 苏军最终包围了我们的第6集团军，并且正在不断投入更多增援。你现在必须去解救斯大林格勒的战友们！

src: The Soviets have found a weak spot in our defenses, where elements of the 18th Anti-Aircraft Division and the Fallschirm-Panzerdivision Hermann Göring meet. Thankfully the vanguard units of our 5th Panzer Division are already rushing in from the west. Support their attack, clear the area, then reoccupy the lost territory.
dst: 苏军在我军防线中找到一处薄弱点，正是第18防空师与“赫尔曼·戈林”伞降装甲师衔接之处。所幸第5装甲师的先头部队已从西面急驰而来。支援他们的进攻，肃清该地区，然后收复失地。

src: The Soviets have surprised us Herr General! They are attacking in great force from the mainland into the rear of your Eleventh Army. You need to hold up until the troops from First Panzer group can relieve you!
dst: 苏军打了我们一个措手不及，将军阁下！他们正以重兵自陆地方向突入您第十一集团军的后方。您必须顶住，直到第一装甲集群的部队前来解围！

src: The Soviets knew that their situation was desperate, so when May started they launched a massive counteroffensive. It was their last chance to prevent us from reaching the Volga, but they didn't have time to plan their attacks thoroughly and in most places it was easy to repel them. However, they succeeded in retaking Chistopol, on the left shore of the Kama. If the communists consolidated that position our chances to recover Kazan would be gone. Since we had already dealt with a similar situation in Orenburg, Kolchak sent us to liberate Chistopol.
dst: 苏维埃知道他们的处境已濒临绝境，所以5月一开始，他们就发动了大规模反攻。这是他们阻止我们抵达伏尔加河的最后机会，但他们没有时间周密筹划进攻，在大多数地方我们都能轻易击退他们。然而，他们成功夺回了卡马河左岸的奇斯托波尔。如果共产党人巩固了那个阵地，我们收复喀山的机会就会化为乌有。由于我们已在奥伦堡处理过类似局面，高尔察克派我们去解放奇斯托波尔。

src: The Soviets launched Operation Uranus on 19 November 1942. At 07:30 Moscow time Katyusha rocket-launchers and thousands of artillery guns started a heavy bombardment. The offensive against the Third Romanian Army in the Serafimovich sector of the offensive began 8:50. The Romanian defense to collapsed and Soviet forces broke through the lines. By late 22 November, the northern and southern Soviet forces linked up at the town of Kalach, encircling some 290,000 Axis personnel east of the Don River.
dst: 苏军于1942年11月19日发动了"天王星行动"。莫斯科时间07:30，喀秋莎火箭炮与数千门火炮开始了猛烈轰击。对谢拉菲莫维奇地段罗马尼亚第三集团军的进攻于8:50开始。罗马尼亚防线崩溃，苏军突破防线。至11月22日晚些时候，苏军南北两路部队在卡拉奇镇会师，包围了顿河以东约29万轴心国人员。

src: The Soviets now have serious suspisions that we are talking to the Americans. We therefore expect the Soviets to make an all out effort to capture terrain before we can make peace in the west.
dst: 苏联人现在严重怀疑我们正在与美国人谈判。因此我们预计，苏军将全力以赴，力求在我们与西方缔结和平之前夺取更多地盘。

src: The Soviets paid a heavy price for the conquest of Ufa. Thousands of communist troops lost their lives at the shores of the Belaya, trying in vain to stop our evacuation. When they finally entered the city, it had been a long time since we had left. We had survived to fight another day, and that made us feel happy.
dst: 苏维埃为攻占乌法付出了沉重代价。数千名共产党士兵在别拉亚河畔丧命，徒劳地试图阻止我们撤离。当他们终于进入该城时，我们早已离开多时。我们活下来改日再战，这让我们感到欣慰。

src: The Spanish Civil War was a major conflict in Spain that started after an attempted coup d etat by a group of Spanish Army generals against the government of the Second Spanish Republic. The Civil War devastated Spain from 17 July 1936 to 1 April 1939.
dst: 西班牙内战是西班牙的一场重大冲突，始于一批西班牙陆军将领对第二共和国政府发动的未遂政变。这场内战使西班牙满目疮痍，自1936年7月17日持续至1939年4月1日。

src: The Spanish Division Azul will assist you in this operation.
dst: 西班牙"蓝色师"将在这次行动中协助你。

src: The Spanish High Command decided to put and end to these attacks, and since october 1911 launched different military operations in the area, which could´t stop the rebellion.
dst: 西班牙最高统帅部决定结束这些袭击，自1911年10月起在该地区发动了多次军事行动，但都未能平息叛乱。

src: The Spanish garrisons, poorly equipped and scattered all over the Protectorate were in extreme danger, since a general Berber attack would make them fall one by one, causing a massacre. The danger was specially critical in the western part of the Protectorate.
dst: 西班牙守备部队装备简陋、分散在保护地各处，处境极为危险，因为柏柏尔人一旦发动总攻，他们便会一个个陷落，酿成一场屠杀。保护地西部的危险尤为严重。

src: The Spring Offensive ended with large territorial gains for the Germans, but they did not break us. German armies were exhausted and in exposed positions, without any chance of refitting their decimated units. Their best men, the feared stormtroopers, had been annihilated. They would not be able to attack us again, they simply lacked the resources. All they could do now was wait for our final offensives and for their inevitable defeat.
dst: 春季攻势以德国人获得大片领土告终，但他们没能击垮我们。德军已精疲力竭，处于暴露的阵地，根本无法重整他们那些被削弱的部队。他们最精锐的士兵——令人胆寒的突击队——已被消灭殆尽。他们再也无力进攻我们，因为他们根本没有资源了。他们现在所能做的，只有等待我们的最后攻势和他们不可避免的失败。

src: The Spy Class has three types of units:
The Spy units are rearmed in a spy-cave. (just the ancient counterpart to an airport)
dst: 间谍单位在间谍洞窟中补充弹药。（就是古代的机场）
圣路易斯兵工厂 * 大捷
圣路易斯兵工厂 * 失败
圣路易斯兵工厂 * 战术胜利
圣路易斯兵工厂 * 小捷

src: The Stettin-Rostock Operation was one of the last Soviet offensives. German defeat is inevitable; the sole purpose of the fighting is to enable the evacuation of as many civilians as possible and to avoid Soviet captivity.
dst: 斯德丁—罗斯托克行动是苏军最后的攻势之一。德国的失败已不可避免；战斗的唯一目的，是让尽可能多的平民撤离，并避免落入苏军俘虏。

src: The Sudanese fought like true fanatics and, in the end, we had to retire. However, their losses had been very high, too, and they had to finish their campaign and return to Kassala, in Sudanese territory. The invasion was over, and Ethiopia would be calm for a while.
dst: 苏丹人像真正的狂热信徒一样作战，最终我们不得不撤退。不过，他们的伤亡也非常惨重，不得不结束这场战役，撤回苏丹境内的卡萨拉。入侵结束了，埃塞俄比亚将会安宁一段时间。

src: The Suebi are tough opponents, but you, young war Chief, are the better warrior and the gods are really with You!
dst: 苏维汇人是顽强的对手，但你，年轻的军阀，是更出色的战士，众神真的与你同在！

src: The Suez Canal will probably be unusable for a long time, very annoying! You can take only a few days rest. We own information’s that the Commonwealth troops prepare a new line of defense at the Egyptian/Palestinian border at Rafa. Your troops are intended to cross the Sinai and drive the enemy out from Palestine.
dst: 苏伊士运河很可能将在很长一段时间内无法使用，真恼人！你只能休息几天。我们得到情报，英联邦部队正在埃及/巴勒斯坦边境的拉法准备一条新防线。你的部队将穿越西奈，把敌人赶出巴勒斯坦。

src: The Terek is in our hands. Some Soviet units have fled to the steppes of Astrakhan, where they'll hardly get any supplies, so they won't be able to bother us there.
dst: 捷列克已落入我们手中。一些苏维埃部队逃往阿斯特拉罕草原，在那里他们几乎得不到任何补给，因此无法再给我们添麻烦。

src: The Terek is the last redoubt of the Soviets in Southern Russia. Once we pacify this area our rearguard will be safe. There is no time to lose, because now that the Great War has finished and the Germans have retreated from Ukraine, the Red Army will be able to send reinforcements to the Donbass and Tsaritsyn. If we don't finish the Terek campaign soon we might find ourselves fighting in two fronts, something we can't afford.
dst: 捷列克是苏维埃在南俄的最后据点。一旦我们平定这一地区，我们的后方就将安全无虞。时间紧迫，因为大战已经结束，德国人已从乌克兰撤退，红军将能够向顿巴斯和察里津派遣增援。如果我们不尽快结束捷列克战役，就可能陷入两线作战，这是我们承受不起的。

src: The Teutons had crossed the Rhone in summer 102BC and moved downstream the left bank and came finally upon the Roman camp. For three days, the Teutons rushed again and again against the entrenchments, but failed due to the superiority of the Roman siege warfare.
dst: 条顿人在公元前102年夏天渡过罗讷河，沿左岸顺流而下，最终来到罗马营地前。连着三天，条顿人一次又一次冲向壕垒，却都因罗马人攻城术的绝对优势而失败。

src: The Thames River Mouth is the key to London. Control both sides of the River and your advance on the british capital will be unstopable. The british troops are in uncontrolled retreat. You should keep the momentum commander! Push forward and take the important airfields and roads to London.
dst: 泰晤士河河口是通往伦敦的钥匙。控制河的两岸，你对英国首都的推进就将势不可挡。英军正在溃退。你要保持势头，指挥官！向前推进，夺取通往伦敦的重要机场和道路。

src: The Tigers smelled blood and wouldn't let their prey slip from their claws! Herr Major, forgive me if I'm being a bit too poetic, but the way you led your men at Gumbinnen was comparable to the greatest warriors of German history!
dst: 虎式嗅到了血腥味，绝不让猎物从爪下溜走！少校阁下，恕我措辞过于诗意，但你在贡宾嫩统兵的方式，堪与德国史上最伟大的武士比肩！

src: The Treaty of Brest-Litowsk has finally been signed, ending the war with Russia. That will allow thousands of German troops to head west. Even better, the opening of Russian resources to Germany, particularly those from the Ukraine, will alleviate the worst effects of the British blockade. So we'll have the opportunity to plan our next move thoroughly.
dst: 《布列斯特-立托夫斯克条约》终于签订，结束了与俄国的战争。这将使成千上万的德军能够开赴西线。更妙的是，俄国资源向德国开放，尤其是乌克兰的资源，将缓解英国封锁带来的最坏影响。于是我们将有机会从容谋划下一步行动。

src: The Turkish 3rd Army, having begun the offensive against Sarykamysh with over 110,000 poorly prepared men have managed to seize control of the fortress from your incapable hands!  Some reports indicate that the Turkish army has left nearly 90,000 men dead on the frozen slopes of the Araks valley, yet your panic-striken dispatches led the Front to believe your defenders were overwhelmed.  An investigation into your subversive activities has been launched-the result of which you will await under arrest.
dst: 土耳其第3集团军以超过11万名准备不足的士兵向萨雷卡梅什发起进攻，竟从您无能的手中夺取了要塞！有报告称土军已在阿拉克斯河谷冰封的坡地上留下近9万具尸体，然而您惊慌失措的电报让方面军以为您的守军已被击溃。对您的破坏活动已展开调查——您将在被捕中等待结果。

src: The Turkish command has perceived the threat to Erzerum and redeployed the Halil-Bei Corps (3rd and 5th Mixed Divisions, various Kurdish detachments) in a defensive stance along the entire ridge.  Scouts report that the Halil-Bei Corps has been brought up to strength and is defending well-prepared positions.  Along the entire front Turkish resistance has stiffened:  we must maintain the initiative in our hands, Gospodin General-Leitenant!
dst: 土耳其指挥部已察觉到对埃尔祖鲁姆的威胁，将哈利勒贝军（第3和第5混成师及若干库尔德分遣队）沿整条山脊转入防御态势。侦察兵报告，哈利勒贝军已补充到满编，并据守精心准备的阵地。沿全线土军抵抗已经增强：我们必须把主动权掌握在手中，中将阁下！

src: The Turkish garrison in Gaza was on the verge of collapse when night fell. However, in a decision that dismayed most of their soldiers, the Higher Command decided to call off the attack and retreat, delivering victory to the Turks. The decision to withdraw was motivated by the failing light, mounting casualties amongst the infantry and reports that Turkish reinforcements, estimated in excess of 10,000 strong, were approaching from the north and east.
dst: 夜幕降临时，加沙的土耳其守军已濒临崩溃。然而，最高统帅部作出了一项令大多数士兵沮丧的决定——取消进攻并撤退，把胜利拱手让给了土耳其人。撤退的决定源于光线渐暗、步兵伤亡不断上升，以及有报告称土耳其援军正从北面和东面逼近，估计超过一万人。

src: The Turkish high command (Enver Pasha) resolved to open an offensive in the Kavkaz Mountains.  Hoping to trigger anti-Russian sentiment in this volatile region - the object of our pacification campaigns since the the rule of Catherine I - and to extend the Ottoman Empire over all Muslim and Turkik peoples of the region, Enver Pasha assembled a force of 150,000 soldiers in the 3rd Army (Hassan Izzet Pasha) against our 100,000 in the Kavkaz Army (Vorontzov-Dashkov) for the winter 1914-15 campaign.
dst: 土耳其最高统帅部（恩维尔帕夏）决意在高加索山脉发起攻势。恩维尔帕夏希望在这个动荡地区——自叶卡捷琳娜一世统治以来就是我们绥靖行动的对象——煽动反俄情绪，并把奥斯曼帝国的版图扩张到该地区所有穆斯林和突厥民族之上，为此他集结了15万士兵组建第3集团军（哈桑·伊泽特帕夏），对阵我们高加索集团军的10万人（沃龙佐夫—达什科夫），投入1914-15年冬季战役。

src: The Turkish plan to disrupt the Canal traffic has failed. The few Turks that were able to reach the western shore have either been killed or captured. Your counter-attack drove them back into the desert, and they have started a withdrawal across the Sinai to Beersheba. At the moment we don't have the means to pursue them, but after this heavy defeat I am sure the Turks will not dare to attack again in the near future.
dst: 土耳其人扰乱运河航运的计划已经失败。少数得以抵达西岸的土耳其人不是被击毙就是被俘。您的反攻把他们赶回了沙漠，他们已开始穿越西奈向贝尔谢巴撤退。眼下我们尚无追击的手段，但经过这次惨败，我相信土耳其人在不久的将来不敢再犯。

src: The Turks are making a final stand in Damascus!! If we can beat them here and capture Damascus, we may force a surrender and finish the war in the Middle East!!
dst: 土耳其人正在大马士革做最后的抵抗！！如果我们能在这里击败他们并夺取大马士革，或许就能迫使他们投降，结束中东的战事！！

src: The Turks at Magdhaba possess the only known water in the area. It is imperative that you capture the position quickly, so that our horses can be watered. If you don't take Magdhaba during the day, our troops would have to withdraw to our wells at El Arish.
dst: 马格达巴的土耳其人掌握着该地区已知唯一的水源。您必须迅速夺取该阵地，以便给我们的马匹饮水。如果白天拿不下马格达巴，我军将不得不撤回阿里什的水井。

src: The Turks didn't waste any time, and as soon as the battle of Domokos was won they advanced to Thermopylae, taking that pass, too.
dst: 土耳其人毫不耽搁，多莫科斯之战一获胜，就向温泉关推进，同样夺取了那个隘口。

src: The Turks, supported by the German "Pascha I" detachment and some Austrian mountain howitzer batteries, have brushed aside and scattered British cavalry and infantry formations that tried to bar their advance. The situation is getting serious, since Kressenstein's troops have already reached the oasis of Katia.
dst: 土耳其人在德国「帕夏一世」支队和一些奥地利山地榴弹炮连的支援下，击溃并驱散了试图阻挡其前进的英国骑兵和步兵编队。局势日益严峻，因为克雷森施泰因的部队已经抵达卡提亚绿洲。

src: The U.S sent to Spain an ultimatum on April 20 demanding Spanish withdrawal from Cuba and granting of complete Cuban independence. Following the Spanish refusal, on April 21 the U.S. Navy began a blockade of Cuba. Spain declared war on April 23. Two days later, on April 25, the U.S. declared war. Unlawfully, the U.S. considered that a state of war between the U.S. and Spain had existed since April 21, the day the blockade of Cuba had begun.
dst: 美国于4月20日向西班牙发出最后通牒，要求西班牙撤出古巴并给予古巴完全独立。西班牙拒绝后，美国海军于4月21日开始封锁古巴。西班牙于4月23日宣战。两天后，即4月25日，美国宣战。美国非法地认为，美西之间自4月21日——即封锁古巴开始之日——起即已处于战争状态。

src: The UN forces have massed their units to protect their silly so-called ''No-Named line''.  Anyway, this situation fits perfectly with our People's War doctrine.  Launch your armies and over run the dirty capitalist's invaders on your way to recapture Seoul.
dst: 联合国军已集结部队来保卫他们那愚蠢的所谓"无名线"。无论如何，这种局面完全符合我们的人民战争学说。发动你的部队，在重夺汉城的路上碾碎肮脏的资本主义侵略者。

src: The USA have already landed at Gela while the British landed at the eastern coast.
dst: 美军已在杰拉登陆，而英军则在东海岸登陆。

src: The United States of America.FDR knew sooner or later that Japanese aggression would spill over to attack America's holdings.He had guranteed it by cutting off their Oil over the Conflict with China.And here it was.So the trap had been layed,the Pacific Fleet moved near Wake and ready to pounce on the unsuspecting Jap fleet.On paper the U.S. a more formidable force,on the Sea and in the air.In reality though the Japanese were more fanatical and their ships though out-numbered were far superior with Sailors having experience gained from conflicts with the Russians,British and Chinese.In the Air was where the Japanese really had the advantage.Out-numbered again but the 'Zero was worth 2 American planes if not 5. And again the Pilots of the Imperial Japanese Air Force fighting over land in China had the Air in their hands there and had gained valuable experience in the art of 'Dog-fighting'.So Japan's attack would be all through the Pacific but their main Goal was to destroy the Pacific Fleet,con the West Coast Fleet into moving to protect Pearl and destroy It.Pearls capture or not was insignificant but would be a Trophy for Admiral Ionca Aku of the 5th Imperial Fleet.
dst: 美利坚合众国。罗斯福知道，日本的侵略迟早会蔓延到攻击美国的属地。他因中国问题切断对日石油供应，就把这一天提前锁定了。如今它来了。于是陷阱布下，太平洋舰队开赴威克岛附近，准备扑向毫无戒备的日本舰队。纸面上看，美国在海上和空中都是更强的力量。但现实中，日本人更为狂热，他们的军舰虽数量居劣，却远为精良，水兵还从与俄国、英国和中国的冲突中积累了经验。在空中，日本人才真正占据优势。数量同样居于劣势，但一架“零”式能顶2架、甚至5架美国飞机。而且日本帝国海军的飞行员在中国上空作战，掌握着那里的制空权，在空战技艺上积累了宝贵经验。于是日本的进攻将遍及整个太平洋，但主要目标是摧毁太平洋舰队，诱使西海岸舰队前来保护珍珠港并将其歼灭。珍珠港能否被攻占并不重要，但它将成为帝国第5舰队海军上将伊翁卡·阿库的战利品。

src: The Van uprising, which began on April 14, 1915, was violently put down by the Turkish army.  80,000 Armenians were murdered by Turkish authorities in the Van region.
dst: 始于1915年4月14日的凡城起义被土耳其军队血腥镇压。在凡城地区，8万名亚美尼亚人被土耳其当局杀害。

src: The Visit of the Prime Minister, Winston Churchill To Caen, Normandy, 22 July 1944.
dst: 1944年7月22日，首相温斯顿·丘吉尔视察诺曼底卡昂。

src: The WAR IS OVER! All the people are in the streets celebrating the victory of the Republic's victory over the fascist rebels! From now, and in the future, a new political system will try to modernize Spain without any kind of capitalist or traditionalist intervention. Excellent work general, obviously you are one of the new heroes of the Spanish Republic, and your name will be written for ever in the ancient Spanish history.
dst: 战争结束了！所有人都在街头庆祝共和国战胜法西斯叛军！从今往后，一个新的政治制度将努力在没有任何资本主义或传统主义干预的情况下实现西班牙的现代化。干得漂亮，将军，显然您是新西班牙共和国的英雄之一，您的名字将永远铭刻在古老的西班牙历史之中。

src: The Western Allies and the Soviet Union alike fell to the might of the German war machine during the Second World War, with even the United States subjugated by a German assault in the early months of 1945.  Seven years later, conflict stirs once again...
dst: 第二次世界大战期间，西方盟国与苏联同样都败在了德国战争机器的威力之下，就连美国也在 1945 年初被德军攻势所征服。七年后，冲突再起……

src: The Western Desert Force is on the run. It was clear soon to the Australians that it was impossible to hold Benghazi.
dst: 西部沙漠部队正在溃逃。澳大利亚人很快就明白，班加西守不住。

src: The Western borders of Romania were guarded by weaker "training divisions" against a possible Hungarian attack in the fall of 1944. When the Germans and Hungarians did attack in September 1944, these units performed way better than expected, and managed to delay the Axis troops until the arrival of the bulk of the Soviet forces.
dst: 1944年秋，罗马尼亚西部边境由较弱的「训练师」防守，以防备匈牙利可能的进攻。当德军和匈军于1944年9月真的发起进攻时，这些部队的表现远好于预期，并成功迟滞轴心国部队，直至苏军主力抵达。

src: The Westwall is a good opportunity to gain experience with your infantry units.
dst: 齐格菲防线是让你的步兵单位积累经验的好机会。

src: The White Army in the East during the Russian Civil War
dst: 俄国内战中的东方白军

src: The White Russian Siberian Army has suffered defeat after defeat and is retreating towards to Ural mountains where it hopes to stop the Soviet advance. The important city of Ufa has just now fallen in Soviet hands. Czech Legion units are near Ufa and are in immediately threat of being attacked.
dst: 白俄西伯利亚军队连吃败仗，正向乌拉尔山脉撤退，希望在那里阻止苏维埃的推进。重镇乌法刚刚落入苏维埃手中。捷克军团各部就在乌法附近，正面临被攻击的直接威胁。

src: The White forces during the Russian Civil War

The World Revolution has begun, the Hungarian working class joined the Russian, German and Finnish comrades in the last struggle to overthrow the capitalism. Though we are weak and exhausted after the Great War, we are also dauntless. "With the sacred faith in our endeavour, we are hurrying to the battle."
dst: 世界革命已经开始，匈牙利工人阶级与俄国、德国和芬兰的同志们一道，投入了推翻资本主义的最后斗争。尽管我们在大战之后虚弱而疲惫，我们同样无所畏惧。「怀着对我们事业的坚定信念，我们正奔赴战场。」

src: The X. Army corps has lost strength in the battles and have only a few divisions now. Kampfgruppe Seydlitz has an equal strength, but this troops are more dangerous. Do not miss to cut the Kampfgruppe Seydlitz off from the battlefield. They should arrive on our western flank in two days. Be aware of the German Luftwaffe. We have information that several bomber squadrons are in the combat area.
dst: 第10军已在历次战斗中损失了兵力，如今只剩下几个师。塞德利茨战斗群的兵力与之相当，但这支部队更为危险。务必切断塞德利茨战斗群与战场的联系。他们应在两天后抵达我军西翼。当心德国空军。我们有情报显示，若干轰炸机中队正位于作战区域内。

src: The XIX century is ending, and the United States of America has become one of the wealthiest countries in the world. This growing prosperity implies playing an increasingly important role in the international sphere. America has interests almost everywhere, and sometimes those interests can't be defended efficiently by peaceful means. When that happens, the small but highly motivated American Army must intervene. One way or another, the US will earn its rightful place among the greatest world powers.
dst: 十九世纪行将结束，美利坚合众国已成为世界上最富庶的国家之一。这种日益增长的繁荣，意味着在国际舞台上扮演日益重要的角色。美国的利益几乎遍及全球，而这些利益有时无法仅靠和平手段有效捍卫。每当此时，规模虽小却士气高昂的美国陆军就必须出手干预。无论以何种方式，美国都将赢得它在世界列强中应有的地位。

src: The XIX century wasn't a lucky one for Poles. Most of Poland was divided between the Austrian, German and Russian Empires. And, worst of all,  in 1831 Russia attacked the Kingdom of Poland and conquered the country. Only in the Austro-Hungarian Empire Polish citizens have rights. They could develop their own organizations under the rule of the house of Habsburg. Not only could these organizations be scientifical and political, but they could also be paramilitary. In 1908 a refugee from the "Russian" part of Poland, Józef Pi³sudski,  took control over these paramilitary organizations and prepared  these people to fight against the Russian Empire in the coming war.
dst: 19世纪对波兰人来说并不幸运。波兰的大部分地区被奥地利、德意志和俄罗斯三大帝国瓜分。而最糟糕的是，1831年俄罗斯进攻波兰王国并征服了该国。只有在奥匈帝国，波兰公民才享有权利。他们得以在哈布斯堡家族的统治下发展自己的组织。这些组织不仅可以是学术性和政治性的，还可以是准军事性的。1908年，一位来自波兰「俄占」部分的流亡者约瑟夫·毕苏斯基掌控了这些准军事组织，并训练这些人准备在即将到来的战争中与俄罗斯帝国作战。

src: The XIX century wasn't a lucky one for Poles. Poland was divided between the Austrian, German and Russian Empires. And, worst of all,  in 1831 Russia attacked the Kingdom of Poland and conquered the country.
dst: 19世纪对波兰人来说并不幸运。波兰被奥地利、德意志和俄罗斯三大帝国瓜分。而最糟糕的是，1831年俄罗斯进攻波兰王国并征服了该国。

src: The Yankees have been defeated and are now licking their wounds. They do not longer pose a threat to the Philippines. However, the situation in Cuba is dramatic and the Government has requested to start peace talks. The fate of the Philippines is now in the hands of our politicians.
dst: 洋基人已被击败，正在舔舐伤口。他们已不再对菲律宾构成威胁。然而，古巴局势严峻，政府已要求开始和谈。菲律宾的命运如今掌握在我们的政治家手中。

src: The Yankees have been seriously defeated and are now licking their wounds. They do not longer pose a threat to the Philippines. However, the situation in Cuba is dramatic and the Government has requested to start peace talks. The fate of the Philippines is now in the hands of our politicians.
dst: 洋基人已被重创，正在舔舐伤口。他们已不再对菲律宾构成威胁。然而，古巴局势严峻，政府已要求开始和谈。菲律宾的命运如今掌握在我们的政治家手中。
