src: The Yankees have been totally defeated and are now licking their wounds. They do not longer pose a threat to the Philippines. However, the situation in Cuba is dramatic and the Government has requested to start peace talks. The fate of the Philippines is now in the hands of our politicians.
dst: 洋基人已被彻底击败，正在舔舐伤口。他们已不再对菲律宾构成威胁。然而，古巴局势严峻，政府已要求开始和谈。菲律宾的命运如今掌握在我们的政治家手中。

src: The Zanzibar field hospital heals 4 strength points per turn.
dst: 桑给巴尔野战医院每回合治疗 4 点兵力。

src: The Zitadelle scenario is influenced by Jorge Gabitto's Kursk campaign.
dst: “堡垒”场景受 Jorge Gabitto 的库尔斯克战役启发。

src: The Zulus fought valiantly, and managed to retreat in good order despite the efforts of our experienced and well equipped soldiers. They were a threat for our patrols until the end of the war.
dst: 祖鲁人作战英勇，尽管我们经验丰富、装备精良的士兵奋力作战，他们仍得以井然有序地撤退。直到战争结束，他们始终对我们的巡逻队构成威胁。

src: The above mentioned level of difficulty is determind the following way:
dst: 上述难度等级按以下方式判定：

src: The action at Negomano got Von Lettow Vorbeck some of the supplies his army badly needed, but his troops still lacked the ammunitions and medicines that would be indispensable for a prolonged resistance. Thus, he advanced deeper into Portuguese East Africa and in June 1918 the German columns were near the main town of Quelimane. There they heard rumors about huge amounts of supplies stored at Namacurra.  It was a strategic village known for its railway and vital communications with the rest of Portuguese East Africa. Von Lettow knew this was the opportunity he was waiting for and on July 1st the German attack started.
dst: 内戈马诺的行动让冯·莱托-福尔贝克得到了他军队急需的一部分补给，但他的部队仍然缺乏长期抵抗所不可或缺的弹药和药品。因此，他继续向葡属东非腹地深入，1918年6月，德军纵队已逼近主要城镇克利马内。在那里，他们听说纳马库拉囤积着大量补给。那是一个战略要村，以铁路及其与葡属东非其余地区的重要交通而闻名。冯·莱托知道这就是他一直在等待的机会，7月1日，德军的进攻开始了。

src: The activity of the Soviet ChK has alarmed our intelligence:  these elite units seem capable of organizing strong resistance behind front lines.  With few military resources to spare across wide expanses of front line, you should take care to protect your supplies and HQ.
dst: 苏联契卡的活动使我们的情报部门警觉起来：这些精锐单位似乎有能力在前线后方组织起强大的抵抗。由于要在一片广阔的战线上分配本就不多的军事资源，您应当注意保护您的补给和司令部。

src: The advance of the Germans was blocked by the fortress Noreia and, furthermore, due to the Pontafel Pass being held by the Romans.
dst: 日耳曼人的推进被诺雷亚要塞挡住，此外蓬塔费尔山口也由罗马人把守。

src: The advance of the Prussian Second Army into Le Mans was delayed by the heavy rains, so the Germans weren't ready for their final assault until January 11th. That gave General Chanzy, the leader of the reformed Army of the Loire, time to prepare his troops for a final stand.
dst: 普鲁士第2军团向勒芒的推进因大雨而延误，因此德军直到1月11日才为最后总攻做好准备。这给了重整后的卢瓦尔军团指挥官尚齐将军时间来让他的部队做好最后决战的准备。

src: The advance went well initially but in November 1915 they arrived at Ctesiphon, some 40 km south of Baghdad, where the main Ottoman forces were waiting. After two days of battle, the Ottoman army was able not only to halt the British advance but also to force its retreat, after losing 1/3 of its strength.
dst: 推进起初很顺利，但1915年11月，他们抵达了巴格达以南约40公里的泰西封，奥斯曼主力正在那里等待。经过两天的战斗，奥斯曼军队不仅遏止了英军的推进，还在损失了三分之一兵力后迫使其撤退。

src: The advances of II SS-Panzer Corps are going well.  The same cannot be said about the armies on our flanks and the northern group.
dst: 党卫军第2装甲军的推进进展顺利。但我两翼的部队和北方集群则不然。

src: The air support is in the form of auxiliary units only. I used the "air missions" setting, so the planes work much differently than in original Panzer General II.
dst: 空中支援仅以辅助单位的形式出现。我采用了“空勤任务”设定，因此飞机的运作方式与《装甲元帅2》原版大不相同。

src: The alliance between Prussia and Austria didn't last long. Bismarck, the Prussian Chancellor, wanted an unified German State under Prussian hegemony. That meant excluding Austria, even if it had to be done by force. So just a few months after the victory against Denmark, Prussia was already looking for a pretext for declaring war on Austria.
dst: 普鲁士与奥地利的联盟没能维持多久。普鲁士宰相俾斯麦想要一个普鲁士霸权之下的统一的德意志国家。这意味着要把奥地利排除在外，哪怕必须动用武力。因此，在战胜丹麦仅仅几个月后，普鲁士就开始寻找向奥地利宣战的借口了。

src: The allied VH will also simulate airfields in Tunisia and will work as an regular airfield.
dst: 盟军的胜利点也将模拟突尼斯境内的机场，并会作为常规机场运作。

src: The allied advance on mainland Italy is already past the Island of Elba. We don't need a german stronghold in our back, just off the coast!
dst: 盟军向意大利本土的推进已越过厄尔巴岛。我们不需要一个就在海岸外的德军据点在背后掣肘！

src: The allied troops are still numerous. Beware of assaults in the woody terrain. I remind you, that Josef Stalin tanks only have a few ammunitions and they are vulnerable in this terrain.
dst: 盟军部队仍然数量众多。当心在林地地形中遭遇突袭。我提醒你，约瑟夫·斯大林坦克只有少量弹药，而且在这种地形中十分脆弱。

src: The allies have been barely stopped at the gates of Rangoon. Anyway, now, we can send some units to protect other more important fronts.
dst: 盟军在仰光城下勉强被挡住了。不管怎样，现在我们可以抽调一些部队去保护其他更重要的战线了。

src: The allies have been stopped at the gates of Rangoon. Now, we can send some units to protect other more important fronts.
dst: 盟军在仰光城下被挡住了。现在，我们可以抽调一些部队去保护其他更重要的战线了。

src: The allies launched an attack on our North Sea coast and islands. Your orders are to push the enemy back into the sea once and for all!
dst: 盟军对我北海沿岸及岛屿发动了进攻。你的命令是彻底把敌人赶回海里去！

src: The allies though that they could stop us sending his troops, but they were wrong!, now Stavanger is no more a port for the land of enemy troops.
dst: 盟军以为派兵就能阻止我们，但他们错了！如今斯塔万格不再是敌军登陆的港口。

src: The allies turned Terceira into an heavily fortified unsinkable aircraft carrier! We also expect a strong presence of enemy navy and air force. Expect fortifications and radar installations on the island.
dst: 盟军已将特塞拉岛变成一艘重兵设防、永不沉没的航空母舰！我们预计敌方海军与空军也将大量出现。岛上预计有防御工事与雷达设施。

src: The area around the nineteenth century Brest Fortress was the site of the 1939 Battle of Brzesc Litewski, when German forces captured it from Poland during the Polish September Campaign. However, according to the terms of the 1939 German-Soviet Nonaggression Pact the territory around Brest was assigned to the Soviet Union. Thus, in the summer of 1941, the Germans had to capture the fortress yet again - this time from the Soviets. The 3,500-strong defending force comprised regular soldiers, border guards and NKVD men. From the first minutes of the invasion, Brest and Brest Fortress were bombed and shelled by the Germans. Despite their surprise, the subsequent attempt by the Germans to quickly take the fortress with infantry stalled, and the Germans started a lengthy siege. Although they were initially surprised by the attack and heavily outnumbered, short of supplies and cut off from the outside world, the defenders fought and counter-attacked much harder and longer than the Germans expected. After two weeks of fierce combat the Germans had captured most of the fortress. The actual front had by then already moved far to the east.
dst: 19世纪布列斯特要塞周边地区，曾是1939年布列斯特立陶宛之战（Brzesc Litewski）的战场，当时德军在波兰九月战役中从波兰人手中夺取了它。然而，根据1939年德苏互不侵犯条约的条款，布列斯特周边地区被划归苏联。因此，1941年夏天，德军不得不再一次夺取该要塞——这一次是从苏联人手中。3500人的守备部队由正规军、边防军和内务人民委员部人员组成。从入侵的第一分钟起，布列斯特及布列斯特要塞就遭到德军的轰炸和炮击。尽管事出意外，德军随后以步兵迅速夺取要塞的企图却受阻，他们不得不开始漫长的围攻。守军虽然起初对袭击感到意外、兵力远逊、补给匮乏且与外界隔绝，却打得比德军预想的更顽强、更持久，并多次反击。经过两周激战，德军夺取了要塞的大部分。此时实际战线早已向东转移。

src: The armed clashes between the rebels and the occupation forces gradually increased in number and intensity. One of the worst incidents took place in Marash, a town in Cilicia, in southwestern Anatolia, in January 1920. Some weeks before, the Muslim militias had started a riot against the Christian population, mainly Armenians. The French, who had the responsability of securing the peace in Cilicia, quickly sent reinforcements to Marash, only to become themselves a target for the Turkish attackers.
dst: 叛军与占领军之间的武装冲突在数量和强度上逐渐升级。最严重的事件之一发生于1920年1月安纳托利亚西南部奇里乞亚的马拉什镇。数周前，穆斯林民兵开始对基督教民众（主要是亚美尼亚人）发动暴乱。负责保障奇里乞亚和平的法军迅速向马拉什派出增援，结果自己却成了土耳其袭击者的目标。

src: The armistice took effect at 11:00 on November 11, 1918.
dst: 停战协定于1918年11月11日11时生效。

src: The army confronting your forces is a decimated tired Belgian Army supplemented by some French forces that have come to its rescue. Break through their lines and the channel ports of Calais and Boulogne-sur-Mer are ours. This will make it a lot harder for the Brits to supply their BEF, which could have decisive strategic consequences.
dst: 与您部队对阵的是一支损失惨重、疲惫不堪的比利时陆军，外加一些前来救援的法军。突破他们的战线，加来和滨海布洛涅这两个海峡港口就是我们的了。这将使英国人补给其远征军难上加难，可能产生决定性的战略影响。

src: The army of Spartacus conquered the city of Nola, after slaves opened the town gates from the inside. The former slaves rage in the city, killing their former masters through no vault of Spartacus. He can only stop them when he announced that praetor Publius Varinius is with his troops on the march - In fact, he was on the way, but Spartacus could Nola leave on time.
dst: 斯巴达克斯的军队攻下了诺拉城——城内的奴隶从里面打开了城门。获释的奴隶在城中暴怒，杀戮旧主，这并非斯巴达克斯的意愿。他只能宣布法官普布利乌斯瓦里尼乌斯正率军进逼，才止住他们——事实上瓦里尼乌斯确实在赶来，但斯巴达克斯得以按时撤离诺拉。

src: The army of Vespasian under his commander Marcus Antonius Primus has five Legions, Auxilia from the Danube provinces, and Praetorian cohorts.
dst: 韦斯帕芗的军队由其统帅马尔库斯安东尼乌斯普里穆斯指挥，辖五个军团、多瑙河诸行省的辅助部队以及禁卫军步兵队。

src: The army will retreat into fortress Antwerp.
dst: 军队将撤入安特卫普要塞。

src: The arrival of my family in Novorossiysk was one of the happiest moments in my life. Finally, we're together again. I could spend just three days with them before returning to the battle front, but now I know that I'll return to them soon.
dst: 我的家人抵达新罗西斯克，是我一生中最幸福的时刻之一。我们终于又在一起了。返回前线之前，我只能和他们待三天，但如今我知道，自己很快就会回到他们身边。

src: The arrogance of the Bolsheviks gave us a chance to surprise them. As I've already written before, in July Kolchak had ordered the reorganization of the front and the unification of the Siberian Army and Western Army. General Diterikhs had been appointed as Commander in Chief of the Eastern Front. New armies and independent groups were created, mainly the 1st, the 2nd and the 3rd Armies. When the Tobol offensive began, I was serving in the latter.
dst: 布尔什维克的傲慢给了我们一个出其不意的机会。正如我此前写过的，7月里高尔察克下令重整战线，并将西伯利亚集团军与西方面军合并。季捷里赫斯将军被任命为东线总司令。新的集团军和独立集群被组建起来，主要是第一、第二和第三集团军。托博尔攻势开始时，我正在第三集团军服役。

src: The arrogant error of Glaudius Glaber, to dispense the usual fortification with wooden palisades, retaliated strongly. The frightened recruits fled and Glaber barely escaped. This sensational victory not only caused more slaves, but also impoverished farmers, farm workers and adventurers to join Spartacus.
dst: 格拉贝鲁斯自作聪明，省去了惯常的木栅防御工事，遭到了强烈的报应。惊恐的新兵溃逃，格拉贝鲁斯勉强逃脱。这场轰动性的胜利不仅吸引了更多奴隶，也让贫苦农民、雇农与冒险者纷纷投奔斯巴达克斯。

src: The artillery barrage and the initial assault against the German VII Reserve Corps (von Soden) caused serious casualties to the 21st and 43rd Reserve divisions.  Beremicourt and Brimont were captured, but a violent counter-attack by the German X Reserve Corps (Eberhardt) threw the French back from Beremicourt.
dst: 炮火准备和对德国第7预备军（冯·佐登）的最初突击，给第21和第43预备师造成了严重伤亡。贝雷米库尔和布里蒙被攻克，但德国第10预备军（埃伯哈特）的猛烈反击又把法军赶出了贝雷米库尔。

src: The assault of Kiev started on 5th November 1943, with the 1st Czechoslovak Independent Brigade leading the attack. Soviet artillery support was immense and the German positions couldn't withstand it.
dst: 对基辅的进攻始于1943年11月5日，捷克斯洛伐克第1独立旅担当先锋。苏军炮火支援极其猛烈，德军阵地无法抵挡。

src: The assault on Crete will be the largest airborne drop ever attempted. It is up to you to lead the airborne attack and capture airfields in Crete so that your main forces can aid the invasion by both sea and air to crush the Allies on the island. You must ultimately secure all of the objectives on Crete by June 1st at the latest. In order to ensure that our forces are optimally prepared for the upcoming invasion of Russia, a much earlier success is desirable.
dst: 对克里特的突击将是有史以来规模最大的空降行动。由你指挥这次空降进攻，夺取克里特的机场，以便我主力部队从海空两路支援入侵，粉碎岛上的盟军。你最迟必须在 6月1日前夺取克里特的全部目标。为确保我军能以最佳状态准备即将到来的入侵俄国之战，更早取胜则更为理想。

src: The atomic bomb tests of the post war era have gone on with great haste as both superpowers seek to gain a lethal edge over the other.   Little do they know that these very tests have produced the single greatest threat to mankind...
dst: 战后年代的原子弹试验以极大的紧迫持续推进，两个超级大国都力图取得对另一方的致命优势。它们几乎没有意识到，正是这些试验制造出了人类有史以来最大的威胁……

src: The attack at Scimitar Hill cost the British 5,300 casualties and was the last attempt to advance at Suvla. The front line remained between Green Hill and Scimitar Hill for the remainder of the campaign until the evacuation.
dst: 弯刀山之战使英军付出了5300人的伤亡，这也是苏夫拉的最后一次进攻尝试。在战役剩余的时期里，直到撤退，前线一直停留在绿山与弯刀山之间。

src: The attack in the South proved to be nothing more than a diversion and once Rommel returned to Egypt, our armored forces succeeded in containing the main attack in the North by throwing our last reserve units in the battle.
dst: 南面的进攻不过是佯攻，隆美尔一回到埃及，我们的装甲部队就把最后一点预备队投入战斗，成功牵制住了北面的主攻。

src: The attack in the South proved to be nothing more than a diversion and once Rommel returned to Egypt, our armored forces succeeded in containing the main attack in the North.
dst: 南面的进攻不过是佯攻，隆美尔一回到埃及，我们的装甲部队就成功牵制住了北面的主攻。

src: The attack in the South proved to be nothing more than a diversion and our armored forces succeeded in containing the main attack in the North even before Rommel returned on the 25th. Outstanding job, General!
dst: 南面的进攻不过是佯攻，我们的装甲部队甚至在隆美尔25日返回之前，就成功牵制住了北面的主攻。干得出色，将军！

src: The attack of the 10th Army on the Manych was a very serious threat to us. When they took Torgovaya they could split our lines in two, and even Ekaterinodar was at risk. Thank God that our campaign in the Terek ended soon, so we could send reinforcements just in time. Now the Bolshevik offensive has lost its initial momentum, and the initiative is ours again. We must send them back to the other side of the river, thus securing our right flank.
dst: 第10集团军对马内奇的进攻对我们构成了极为严重的威胁。他们攻占托尔戈瓦亚后，便可能把我方战线一分为二，连叶卡捷琳诺达尔都岌岌可危。感谢上帝，我们在捷列克的战役很快结束，我们得以及时派出增援。如今布尔什维克的攻势已失去最初的势头，主动权又回到了我们手中。我们必须把他们赶回河对岸，从而确保右翼安全。

src: The attack of the Germans was a great success. They could capture several armies in the Kursker pocket. Now it seems that we have los the war. The Germans are standing  at the gates of Moscow. We do not need cowards like you anymore.
dst: 德军的进攻大获成功。他们在库尔斯克包围圈中俘获了数个集团军。现在看来我们似乎已经输掉了这场战争。德军已兵临莫斯科城下。我们不再需要你这样的懦夫了。

src: The attack on Bardia is imminent, but our 4 divisions should be able to repulse the enemy.
dst: 对巴迪亚的进攻迫在眉睫，但我们的4个师应能击退敌人。

src: The attack on Danzig.SS Intelligence had been corrupted here.The Spys bought by the other side.One of the 'Slights' the Fuhress would have to deal with in the future but there was not time now.So tanks of the Poles if present were not accounted for.There was reports of plenty of Calvary though and recon flights over had spotted it for the most part.A sub of the SS/KM had spotted a Brit Carrier but could not be sure it had docked in the area because having to leave the area after numerous destroyers put a chase on the sub.SS 'Erfert units were coming in by sea and other units on the Border were ready to move.So Poland was about to be cut-off and then it's Goverment would declare War on Germany which all knew was in the Cards all along.And the Fuhress,Her opinion on the Poles joining into the fight "I could care less what happens to the Poles,Slaves they were meant to be as all the rest.That is if We can find some of value.If not,Well---".
dst: 对但泽的进攻。党卫军的情报在这里被搞坏了——间谍被对方收买。这是女元首日后必须处理的“疏漏”之一，但眼下没时间。所以，波兰的坦克即便存在，也没有被计入。倒是有大量骑兵的报告，侦察飞行也大多发现过他们。党卫军／海军的一艘潜艇发现了一艘英国航母，但无法确定它是否已在该地区靠港，因为众多驱逐舰追击，潜艇不得不离开。党卫军“埃尔弗特”的部队正从海上开来，边境上的其他部队也准备行动。于是波兰即将被切断，随后它的政府将对德国宣战——所有人都知道这是早就注定的事。至于女元首对波兰人参战的看法：“波兰人怎么样，我不在乎。他们本就注定是奴隶，和其他所有人一样。前提是我们能从中找到一些有价值的。要是没有，嗯——”

src: The attack on neutral Bulgaria proved a blessing for us: The Bulgarian government invited the English in and on the outskirts of Sofia these violently clashed with the Soviet troops. This was all the incident Churchill needed: the case of Bulgaria was blown up in the Anglo-American press, and thus came about the cease-fire with the western allies you undoubtedly heard of.
dst: 对中立国保加利亚的进攻结果反倒成了我们的幸事：保加利亚政府把英国人请了进来，在索菲亚近郊他们与苏军发生了激烈冲突。这正是丘吉尔所需要的事件：保加利亚事件在英美报界被大肆渲染，于是便有了您无疑已听说过的与西方盟国的停火。

src: The attack on nord and nord-east - line of operations on Zhukovka and Turgenevo city. If you can close any nearer to Tula, I can make an attack on Moscow this year.
dst: 向北方与东北方向的进攻——作战线指向茹科夫卡与图尔格涅沃城。若您能推进至离图拉更近处，我便可于年内对莫斯科发起进攻。

src: The attack resumed on August 27 and further progress was made up the slope, but the summit of the hill was still held by the Turks. Now the Australians from the 3rd Light Horse Brigade, who had fought at The Nek, were fed into the battle as reinforcements. On August 28 the Australians captured some of the Turkish trenches at the summit but the Turks clung to the vital northern face which overlooked Suvla. Attacking and counter-attacking continued until August 29 when the Allied offensive finally ceased.
dst: 进攻于8月27日恢复，沿山坡又取得了一些进展，但山顶仍由土耳其军控制。曾在「内克」作战的澳大利亚第3轻骑旅此时作为援军投入战斗。8月28日，澳大利亚人夺取了山顶的部分土耳其军战壕，但土耳其人仍死守着俯瞰苏夫拉湾的北面要地。攻防反复持续到8月29日，协约国的攻势才最终停止。

src: The attack was greater than we expected, but you defended Alcazarquivir brilliantly and the enemy hordes have fled the battlefield. Well done, General! With this sort of action we will force El Raisuli's men to take refuge in the mountains, far from the coastal road to Tangiers and from the fertile crop fields of the Lucus Valley. Anyway, this defeat won't stop El Raisuli. If I know this man, he will plan future actions agains us.
dst: 敌人的进攻比我们预想的更为猛烈，但您出色地守住了阿尔卡萨基维尔，敌军的乌合之众已经逃离战场。干得好，将军！这样的行动将迫使赖苏利的人退到山上避难，远离通往丹吉尔的海岸公路和卢库斯河谷肥沃的农田。不过，这次失败不会让赖苏利收手。以我对这个人的了解，他定会筹划针对我们的后续行动。

src: The attack was greater than we expected, but you defended Alcazarquivir brilliantly and the enemy hordes have fled the battlefield. Well done, General! With this sort of action we will force El Raisuli's men to take refuge on the mountains, far from the coastal road to Tangier and from the fertile crop fields of the Lucus Valley. Anyway, this defeat won't stop El Raisuli. If I know this man, he will plan future actions agains us.
dst: 敌人的进攻比我们预想的更为猛烈，但您出色地守住了阿尔卡萨基维尔，敌军的乌合之众已经逃离战场。干得好，将军！这样的行动将迫使赖苏利的人退到山上避难，远离通往丹吉尔的海岸公路和卢库斯河谷肥沃的农田。不过，这次失败不会让赖苏利收手。以我对这个人的了解，他定会筹划针对我们的后续行动。

src: The auto-transportable 9th Infantry Division "Pasubio" is crossing the Oril river and closing in on Petrikowka from the northwest while German and Italian forces are fighting north of Dnipropetrovsk.
dst: 可自动运输的第9步兵师“Pasubio”正渡过奥里尔河，从西北方向逼近彼得里科夫卡，而德国和意大利军队正在第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克以北激战。

src: The autumn of 1914 and the winter of 1915 were terrible for Austro-Hungary, but even worse for Russia. The Russian Army sustained enormous casualties, especially among the officers, and could not reach their goals. In the spring of 1915, the Austro-Hungarian Empire struck back. After the battle of Gorlice, Russian forces fled. They abandoned not only the Austro-Hungarian territory, but also the whole Kingdom of Poland.
dst: 1914年秋和1915年冬对奥匈帝国来说十分可怕，但对俄国来说更为糟糕。俄军伤亡惨重，尤其是军官损失巨大，且未能达成其目标。1915年春，奥匈帝国发动了反击。戈利采战役后，俄军溃逃。他们不仅放弃了奥匈帝国的领土，还放弃了整个波兰王国。

src: The autumn of 1918 brought good news to the Czech Legion. Austria-Hungary had surrendered and the new state of Czechoslovakia had declared its independance. In short, the Czechs and Slovaks of the Legion had a home to attend to. It would no longer be unneccasarily involve itself in the Russian Civil War anymore.
dst: 1918年秋天给捷克军团带来了好消息。奥匈帝国已经投降，新的国家捷克斯洛伐克宣布独立。简而言之，军团中的捷克人和斯洛伐克人有了可以奔赴的祖国。军团将不再无谓地卷入俄国内战。

src: The autumn offensive is imminent - it goes to the north! Our plan is to advance via Blackstone and Fort Pickett to Richmond and encircle and destroy the enemy forces in Eastern Virginia. Your task is to cross the Roanoke River and overcome the enemy defenses to create the conditions to push further on Blackstone! The Americans used the last weeks and have built a new defense line at the Roanoke River and expect our attack!
dst: 秋季攻势迫在眉睫——剑指北方！我们的计划是经布莱克斯通和皮克特堡向里士满推进，围歼弗吉尼亚东部的敌军。你的任务是渡过罗阿诺克河、突破敌军防御，为继续向布莱克斯通推进创造条件！美国人利用过去几周在罗阿诺克河构筑了一条新防线，正等着我们的进攻！

src: The auxiliary bombers have already expended most of their ammo before the battle begun. They need to go back to an airfield soon.
dst: 辅助轰炸机在战斗开始前就已耗尽了大部分弹药。它们需要尽快返回机场。

src: The axis of the operation, and center objective of our plans, is the village of Kokoda, and its airstrip. If you can take Kokoda, the communications between Port Moresby, and the allied troops on the North of the island would be cut. The airstrip would allow our planes to resupply here, bringing close support to your men. Planes from our base at Rabaul in the North of the island, will arrive to help you.
dst: 本次作战的轴线、我们计划的核心目标，是科科达村及其机场。如果您能拿下科科达，莫尔兹比港与岛北盟军之间的通讯将被切断。这座机场将使我方飞机得以在此补给，为您的部队提供近距支援。来自我们岛北拉包尔基地的飞机也将前来支援您。

src: The axis retreat across the Strait of Messina took place between 1st and 17th August and has to be considered a highly successful operation. The withdrawl of the axis forces was well ordered and so fast at times, that the allied forces couldn't keep up with the speed. Both sides of the Messina Strait were heavily defended by hundreds of anti-aircraft and coastal artillery guns, making it difficult for allied forces to attack.
dst: 轴心国横渡墨西拿海峡的撤退发生在8月1日至17日之间，必须被视为一次极为成功的行动。轴心国部队撤退井然有序，有时速度极快，盟军部队根本跟不上。墨西拿海峡两岸均由数百门高射炮与海岸炮严密防守，令盟军难以发起攻击。

src: The back cover of the Sekai Gaho ("The Pictorial World - Nisshi Dai Jihen Go No.4" Vol. 13 No. 12, Kokusai Joho Sha, 1937).
dst: 《世界画报》（"The Pictorial World - Nisshi Dai Jihen Go No.4" 第13卷第12号，Kokusai Joho Sha，1937年）的封底。

src: The baptism of fire of the Guards Division came at the battle of Loos, a new attempt to break the German lines that started in autum. As a part of the XI Corps we were at the Army reserve, so after our first line broke through the German defences in the morning of September 25th we should have followed it as fast as possible in order to widen the gap. But our communications system was so slow that when our orders finally came and we moved to the front line, the German reserves had been mobilized and the opportunity had been lost. Our divisions kept on attacking the German positions for three weeks, but without any significative result.
dst: 近卫师的战火洗礼发生在洛斯战役，这是秋季开始的一次突破德军防线的新尝试。作为第十一军的一部分，我们处于集团军预备队位置，因此在9月25日上午我们的一线部队突破德军防御之后，我们本应尽快跟进以扩大缺口。但我们的通信系统如此迟缓，以致于当我们最终接到命令、向前线开进时，德军预备队已经调动起来，战机已经丧失。我们的各师又连续进攻德军阵地三个星期，却没有任何显著战果。

src: The barbarians will attack head-on, resist their attacks...do your counter attack not before most of them lay dead to your ranks...
dst: 蛮族会正面猛冲，顶住他们的进攻……在大部分敌人死在你的阵前之前，不要发动反冲锋……

src: The battle at Neuve Chapelle served mostly political gains. Conquering the village had no military significance whatsoever.
dst: 新沙佩勒之战主要是为了政治上的收益。攻克这个村庄没有任何军事意义。

src: The battle for Saratov was finally coming. The Bolsheviks had fortified the city, knowing that its defences were all that stood between Denikin's Armed Forces of Southern Russia and us. However, they had been forced to retire many units from the Volga, in order to defend Moscow. In October, Denikin's generals had finally crushed the Red Army in Orel, and they were approaching Tula. Lenin and his henchmen had motives to reinforce the capital of Russia.
dst: 萨拉托夫之战终于来临。布尔什维克已将该城设防，因为他们知道，这座城的防御是横亘在邓尼金的南俄武装力量与我们之间的唯一屏障。然而，为了保卫莫斯科，他们被迫从伏尔加河调走了许多部队。10月，邓尼金的将领们终于在奥廖尔击溃了红军，他们正逼近图拉。列宁及其爪牙有理由加强俄国首都的防卫。

src: The battle had been won.Frau's were wore out,the Soviet numbers had nearly broke through the Strategic Points.SS machine-guns had blazed at such a pace that many were now useless.Mortars had fired all their ammunition and a lot of Squads had ran out too and had gone Hand to Hand in Combat.Two Frau's resting after the Battle."Dam this was a Hell of a battle wasn't it Leni"? "Your lucky I had Your back there Rike,I thought those hands around Your neck by that Dead Bastard there had You for a moment.Your going to the ground was a smart move,just enough time for Me to place My little cutting blade in His back"."Yeh You saved Me this time,next who knows.These numbers of them,I don't see how they can keep this up.Wave after wave coming.If they can We are Doomed.Look at all their dead out there,for everyone of Us must be 20,Hell maybe even 40.And still We hold this position"."Rike,Leni grab Your gear were moving Out"."Scarfrau Weems,aren't they going to give Us a Break"."Sure,Right after Your Funeral.You know the situation Rike,Commands giving You Regular 'Hedi's enough info to know We can be Flanked if We stay here.After a Days march they may let You rest 15 minutes"."You know Scarfrau Weems,We keep this Up were going to be Dead from exhaustion"."Leni,what's the Big Deal.You weren't Stupid enough to think Us 1st Line Frau's would ever see Berlin again were You"?
dst: 战斗打赢了。“女士”们精疲力竭，苏联人几乎冲破了要害据点。党卫军的机枪打得枪管发烫，许多已经报废。迫击炮打光了全部弹药，很多小队也弹尽，只能肉搏。战后两名“女士”在休息。“妈的，这真是一场恶战，是吧，莱妮？”“你运气好，我在后面护着你，里柯。我以为那个死混蛋掐住你脖子时你撑不住了。你往地上倒那一下很聪明，正好给了我时间把小刀插进他后背。”“是啊，这次你救了我，下次谁知道。就他们这数量，我看不出他们怎么撑得下去。一波接一波地来。要是他们能一直这么干，我们就完了。看外面他们那些尸体，我们每死一个，他们得死20个，甚至40个。可我们还是只能守住这个阵地。”“里柯，莱妮，收拾装备，我们要撤了。”“韦姆斯小队长，他们就不能让我们喘口气吗。”“当然，等你葬礼之后。你了解形势，里柯，上头给你的常规通报足够让你明白，留在这儿我们会遭侧翼包抄。走一天之后，也许能让你歇15分钟。”“韦姆斯小队长，你知道吗，这么下去我们会活活累死。”“莱妮，那又怎样。你总不至于蠢到以为我们这些一线‘女士’还能再见到柏林吧？”

src: The battle has been horrible... and more horrible has been the retreat. After the fall of Teruel, the rebels have overrun our troops. Maybe this strike against El Ejercito Popular has sealed our fate. In spite of your failure here, the high command, and the Republic, still need your services. For all our sakes, you must succeed next time.
dst: 这场战斗太可怕了……而撤退更加可怕。特鲁埃尔陷落之后，叛军击溃了我们的部队。也许这次对共和军的打击已经注定了我们的命运。尽管您在此役失利，最高统帅部和共和国仍然需要您的效力。为了我们大家，您下次必须成功。

src: The battle of Manila Bay was the first major engagement of the Spanish-American War and it was decisive for the fate of the Philippines in 1898. In few hours, Dewey's Squadron completely destroyed the Spanish Pacific Squadron under Admiral Patricio Montojo.
dst: 马尼拉湾海战是美西战争的第一次重大交战，它决定了1898年菲律宾的命运。短短数小时内，杜威的分舰队就彻底摧毁了帕特里西奥·蒙托霍海军上将指挥的西班牙太平洋分舰队。

src: The battle of Ouergha made France realise how serious Abd el-Krim´s menace really was, so the French decided to start a strong cooperation with Spain in order to defeat the Berber rebels of the Rif. The coordinated actions of both the French and the Spanish army reached its peak in september, when the dissembark at Alhucemas took place.
dst: 瓦尔加河之战让法国认识到阿卜杜·克里姆的威胁有多么严重，于是法国决定与西班牙展开密切合作，以击败里夫的柏柏尔叛军。法西两军的协同行动在9月达到顶峰，当时阿尔胡塞马斯登陆行动展开。

src: The battle of Savannah was probably one of the most decisive ones in the entire campaign. You not only managed to complete the largest encirclement the world has ever seen with over two million prisoners, but you also defeated the United States of America. That proud star-spangled banner flies no more!! Listen to Eisenhower declaring surrender.. [Eisenhower speaking]
dst: 萨凡纳之战可能是整场战役中最具决定性的战斗之一。你不仅完成了举世未见的最大合围、俘虏逾两百万人，还击败了美利坚合众国。那面骄傲的星条旗再也不会飘扬了！！听听艾森豪威尔宣布投降……[艾森豪威尔讲话]

src: The battle of Ypres ended in November without a clear winner. We managed to save the Channel ports, but neither side could outflank the other, and impenetrable lines of trenches were built all the way from the Northern Sea to the Swiss border. Maneuvering had become impossible, and waiting idly was not an option, lest we give Germany free rein to defeat Russia in the East. That left only one alternative, which I feared the most: we would fight the worst war of attrition that mankind had ever seen, launching frontal assault after frontal assault and suffering tens of thousands of casualties each time, until in the end one side could not resist any more and would be forced to surrender. I would have to put all of my efforts in finding a way to minimize the losses in the units under my direct command.
dst: 伊普尔会战于11月结束，没有明确的胜者。我们设法保住了海峡诸港，但双方都无法迂回对方，从北海一直到瑞士边境，一道无法穿越的堑壕线被修筑起来。机动作战已成不可能，而坐等也不是办法，否则就等于让德国放手在东线击败俄国。这样一来只剩一个我最害怕的选择：我们将打一场人类前所未见的最惨烈的消耗战，发起一次又一次正面强攻，每次伤亡数万人，直到最后有一方再也撑不住而被迫投降。我不得不倾尽全力，设法把直接隶属我指挥的部队的损失降到最低。

src: The battle of Zhashkiv happened in a back-and-forth style. Whenever an advantage was clearly on one side, this changed immediately and with dramatic circumstances.
dst: 扎什基夫之战呈拉锯态势。每当优势明显偏向一方时，形势便会戏剧性地急转直下。

src: The battle started the 23th of August, when Greek forces made contact with the Turksih defenses, and on August 26 they attacked all along the front.
dst: 战斗于8月23日开始，希腊军队与土耳其防线接触，8月26日，他们沿全线发起进攻。

src: The battle was a brilliant German victory:  Russia suffered 92,000 prisoners and over 30,000 casualties.  Ludendorff named the engagement after the village of Tannenberg in compensation for the defeat of Teutonic Knights by a Slavic alliance of Lithuanian, Polish, and Russian warriors in 1410 AD.
dst: 这场战役是德国一次辉煌的胜利：俄国损失了9.2万名战俘和超过3万名伤亡。鲁登道夫以坦能堡村为这场交战命名，以此补偿1410年条顿骑士团被立陶宛、波兰和俄国战士组成的斯拉夫联盟击败之耻。

src: The battle was a brilliant German victory:  Russia suffered 92,000 prisoners, over 30,000 casualties, and the XV and XIII Corps were erased from existence.  Ludendorff named the engagement after the village of Tannenberg in compensation for the defeat of Teutonic Knights by a Slavic alliance of Lithuanian, Polish, and Russian warriors in 1410 AD.
dst: 此役是德军的一场辉煌胜利：俄军有92000人被俘、30000余人伤亡，第15军和第13军被彻底抹去。鲁登道夫以坦能堡村为这场战斗命名，以补偿1410年条顿骑士团被立陶宛、波兰和俄罗斯战士组成的斯拉夫同盟所击败之辱。

src: The battle was tough but your masterful defence strategy was successful. You have inflicted heavy losses on the Reds and now, with a bit of luck, we'll be able to stop their counteroffensive at our winter headquarters near Zwiahel.
dst: 战斗虽然艰苦，但您高超的防御策略成功了。您给红军造成了重大损失，如今只要运气稍好，我们就能在兹维亚赫尔附近的冬季指挥部挡住他们的反攻。

src: The beachhead is secure and Operation Avalanche has to be considered a highly successfull operation. We should keep the momentum and push northwest towards Naples and Rome.
dst: 滩头阵地已稳固，“雪崩”行动堪称一次极为成功的行动。我们应保持势头，向西北方向的那不勒斯和罗马推进。

src: The bear against the red wolves: Chelyabinsk
dst: 熊与红狼的对决: 车里雅宾斯克

src: The beauty of your daughter's mortal body is possibly destroyed, but the beauty of her immortal soul is untouched. I'll pray for her and I'll try to help her as much as possible. Keep your faith and hope!
dst: 你女儿凡俗身体的美丽或许被毁，但她不朽灵魂的美丽完好无损。我会为她祈祷，并尽我所能帮助她。守住你的信念与希望！

src: The best of luck to you..........as you go to Malta!
The best of luck with your Malta operation!
dst: 祝你的马耳他行动好运！

src: The big time has arrived. With the conquest of Malta our sovereignty in the Mediterranean will be unquestionable.
dst: 重大时刻已经到来。夺取马耳他之后，我们在地中海的主权将无可争议。

src: The biggest tank battle of all time. Soviet tank armies, infantry, heavy artillery
dst: 史上规模最大的坦克会战。苏军坦克集团军、步兵、重炮

src: The biggest war operation has begun.
dst: 规模最大的作战行动已经打响。

src: The bloodless capture of the island of Guam gave the United States its first Spanish possession in the Pacific.
dst: 兵不血刃地攻占关岛，使美国获得了它在太平洋上的第一块西班牙属地。

src: The bloodletting of Narotch has stunned the Northern and Western fronts: over 100,000 Russian casualties accounted for no ground gained and roughly 20,000 German.  What looked like a 5:1 manpower advantage prior to the operation turned into a slaughter.  Having rushed the operation in response to a French plea for help, both fronts failed to prepare their artillery arms adequately: only 50% of alotted artillery pieces supported the attack, while the rest awaited deployment at railroad hubs and depots.  Wave after wave of our infantry were gunned down by murderous machine guns entrenched in casemates of concrete and steel.  Even after capturing an enemy trench, our troops perished in the counter-attacks that followed from the enemy's reserve.
dst: 纳罗奇的流血震撼了北方和西方两个方面军：超过10万俄军伤亡，没有换来一寸土地，而德军伤亡约2万。战前看似5比1的兵力优势变成了一场屠杀。由于响应法国的求援而仓促发起作战，两个方面军都未能充分准备炮兵：只有50%的配属火炮支援了进攻，其余仍在铁路枢纽和仓库等待部署。一波又一波的我方步兵被隐蔽在混凝土和钢铁碉堡中的凶残机枪射倒。即便夺取了敌军堑壕，我方部队也在随后来自敌军预备队的反击中丧生。

src: The bolshevik bidgehead has been crushed, but Soviet forces have crossed the Mius at multiple other locations. Kharkov is now under severe Soviet pressure. Send your troops to the Kharkov area to safeguard the city.
dst: 布尔什维克的桥头堡已被粉碎，但苏军已在米乌斯河多处地点渡河。哈尔科夫如今承受着苏军的沉重压力。把你的部队派往哈尔科夫地区，保卫该城。

src: The bolsheviks have crossed the Mius South of the Kursk salient near the village of Stepanovka in an effort to divert forces from the attack on Kursk. Throw them back to the other side of the river.
dst: 布尔什维克已在库尔斯克突出部以南、斯捷潘诺夫卡村附近的米乌斯河渡河，试图牵制用于进攻库尔斯克的兵力。把他们赶回河对岸。

src: The brave Warlord of the Treveri
dst: 特雷维里人的勇敢的军阀

src: The bravery of the Filipinos will go unrewarded. You've made them flee again after losing hundreds of soldiers. In less than six months the Filipino army has been nearly destroyed, and we control all the important towns and roads of the Philippines.
dst: 菲律宾人的英勇注定得不到回报。在损失了数百名士兵后，您再次让他们溃逃。不到六个月，菲律宾军队已几乎被摧毁，我们控制了菲律宾所有重要的城镇与道路。
突破——胡特胡尔斯特森林——1918年9月至10月

src: The bridgehead is lost as we speak. This makes our planned invasion of Rumania a lot more difficult. And we still need soldiers for the glorious Red Army. I suggest you join them if you want to get our of this situation alive.
dst: 桥头堡此刻正在丢失。这使我们计划中的罗马尼亚入侵变得更加困难。而我们光荣的红军还需要士兵。如果你还想活着离开这种处境，我建议你加入他们。

src: The brigade rode right into the enemy defense! The line is strengthened by machine guns and they have an artillery and tank support. I don't know if the Soviets are already in the area, but I can tell you for sure that it will be us, not them, who will welcome the others. Do you understand? I need your tankists to breach the Polish line immediatelly!
dst: 旅里一头撞进了敌军的防御！这条防线有机枪加强，还有炮兵和坦克支援。我不知道苏军是否已经进入这一地区，但我可以确定地告诉你，将是迎接对方的我们，而不是他们。明白吗？我需要你的坦克兵立刻突破波兰人的防线！

src: The british have taken Tanga. Your position is desperate and you must surrender your army.
dst: 英军已经占领了坦噶。您的处境已陷绝境，您必须率部投降。

src: The british were sure that German East Africa would fall with just one blow. They decided to make a coordinated assault that included an amphibious landing in the german port of Tanga. The force was assembled in India and transported by ship to his destination. Upon arrival, the seasick indian troops were landed at afternoon in a beach some miles east from the city, believing that the port was mined.
dst: 英国人确信，只需一击便能攻下德属东非。他们决定发动一次协同进攻，其中包括在德国港口坦加实施两栖登陆。部队在印度集结，由船运往目的地。抵达后，晕船的印度部队于下午在城市以东数英里的一处海滩登陆，他们以为港口布了雷。

src: The bulk of the Axis army is retreating towards Messina leaving the rest of Sicily only lightly defended. You should keep up the momentum and advance northwest as fast as possible in order to capture a large part of Sicily.
dst: 轴心国军队主力正向墨西拿撤退，西西里其余地区只留下轻微防御。你应保持势头，尽快向西北推进，以夺取西西里的大部分地区。

src: The bulk of the Soviet forces was evacuated out of the pocket via sea to Novorossiysk.
dst: 苏军主力已通过海路从包围圈撤往新罗西斯克。

src: The campaign has reached its end, your duty was superb and better than the historic one. Congratulations and I thank you for playing.
dst: 战役已到尽头，您的表现极为出色，比历史上的表现更好。恭喜，感谢您的游玩。

src: The campaign in Romania is far from over, since Russian reinforcements are pouring in day by day. But now it's time for you and your troops to take a well-deserved rest. You should celebrate New Year's eve and raise a toast to the New Year. Let's hope that 1917 will bring victory to our side and this was the last Christmas that we had to spend far from home!
dst: 罗马尼亚战役远未结束，因为俄国援军正日复一日地涌入。但现在，是时候让您和您的部队好好休整了。你们应该庆祝除夕，为新年举杯。让我们期盼1917年能把胜利带到我方，期盼这是我们在远离家乡的地方度过的最后一个圣诞节！

src: The campaign in Romania is far from over, since Russian reinforcements are pouring in day by day. Despite this huge setback, let's hope that 1917 will bring victory to our side and this was the last Christmas that we had to spend far from home!
dst: 罗马尼亚战役远未结束，因为俄国增援正日复一日地涌入。尽管遭受了这次巨大挫折，让我们仍寄望1917年能为我方带来胜利，让这成为我们在远离家乡处度过的最后一个圣诞节！

src: The campaign is over, I hope you have liked it. Thanks for playing!
dst: 战役到此结束，希望您喜欢。感谢游玩！

src: The campaign is over, but I think that you should replay the last scenario...
dst: 战役结束了，但我想您应当重玩最后一关……

src: The campaign is over, we hope you've liked it, and thanks for playing.
dst: 战役已结束，希望您喜欢它，感谢游玩。

src: The campaign is over. I hope that you have enjoyed it. Thanks for playing.
dst: 战役到此结束。希望您喜欢。感谢游玩。

dst: 战役结束了。我希望您喜欢它，感谢您的游玩！

dst: 战役结束了。我希望您喜欢它，感谢您的游玩。

dst: 战役已结束。希望您喜欢它，感谢游玩。

dst: 战役结束了。我们希望您喜欢它，感谢您的游玩！

dst: 战役结束了。我们希望您喜欢它，感谢您的游玩。

src: The campaign is over. We hope you have liked it, and thanks for playing.
dst: 战役已结束。希望您喜欢它，感谢游玩。

src: The campaign is set during the First World War and after it, during the Polish-Soviet War.
dst: 本战役设定于第一次世界大战期间及其后，即波苏战争期间。

src: The campaign presents the war in both the Caribbean and Pacific theatres. Due to the short duration of the war (three months and a half) and the long distances between the war theatres, the campaign is divided in two paths corresponding to the Caribbean and Pacific theatres. Before choosing path, some common scenarios present the situation of the Spanish possessions in the 1890s. Although most scenarios are land scenarios, there are also some naval combats.
dst: 本战役呈现了加勒比和太平洋两个战区的战争。由于战争持续时间短（三个半月），且两个战区之间距离遥远，战役分为与加勒比和太平洋战区对应的两条路线。在选择路线之前，一些共同场景会呈现19世纪90年代西班牙属地的状况。尽管大多数场景是陆战场景，但也包含一些海战。

src: The campaign represents operation "Fall Gelb" from the Belgian perspective. It reproduces some of the battles held during the 18 days the Belgian army fought against the Germans.
dst: 本次战役从比利时的视角再现了“黄色方案”行动。它重现了比利时军队与德军作战的18天中发生的一些战斗。

src: The capital has fallen, and the countrie will go to the caos for the moment. The King of Norwat, Hakkon, has escaped us, but our agents will pursuit him.
dst: 首都已经陷落，眼下这个国家将陷入混乱。挪威国王哈康从我们手中逃脱了，但我们的特工将会追捕他。

src: The capital has fallen, and the country will go to the caos for the moment. The King of Norwat, Hakkon, has escaped us, but our agents will pursuit him.
dst: 首都已经陷落，眼下这个国家将陷入混乱。挪威国王哈康从我们手中逃脱了，但我们的特工将会追捕他。

src: The catch was that they needed more Polish soldiers. But according to international law, they could not conscript subjects of the Tsar. Only volunteers could be asked to fight against the Tsar and Russia. And all volunteers have been in the Polish Legions already. So to get the Polish conscripts, the Emperors had to grant independence for the Kingdom of Poland.
dst: 其真正用意在于，他们需要更多的波兰士兵。但根据国际法，他们不能征召沙皇的臣民入伍。只能要求志愿者去与沙皇和俄国作战。而所有的志愿者都已加入了波兰军团。因此，为了得到波兰的应征士兵，两位皇帝不得不赐予波兰王国独立。

src: The center and left wing will have a harder going.  But it is eesential that the left and center press the Russians hard to not allow them to disengage and prevent the right panzercorps from conducting its exploitation.
dst: 中路和左翼将更艰难。但关键是左翼和中路要死死压住俄军，不让他们脱身，也不让他们妨碍右翼装甲军实施扩张战果。

src: The channel islands were under german occupation from 30 June 1940 until 9 May 1945. Prior to their occupation, the channel islands had been demilitarised and declared 'open towns' and thousands of civilians were evacuated. The channel islands were part of the german Atlantikwall and thousands of slave workers built fortifications and coastal artillery bunkers. On 9 May 1945, when the war was over, HMS Bulldog arrived at St Peter Port on Guernsey, greeted by a joyous but malnurished crowd singing patriotic songs.
dst: 海峡群岛自1940年6月30日至1945年5月9日处于德国占领之下。在被占领前，海峡群岛已非军事化并被宣布为“不设防城市”，数千平民被疏散。海峡群岛是德国大西洋壁垒的一部分，数千名苦工在此修筑工事和岸炮碉堡。1945年5月9日战争结束时，“斗牛犬”号军舰抵达根西岛的圣彼得港，受到一群欢欣却面黄肌瘦、高唱爱国歌曲的民众欢迎。

src: The city is surrounded by Romanian troops, who are approaching Odessa from all directions.
dst: 该城已被罗马尼亚部队包围，他们正从各个方向逼近敖德萨。

src: The civilians are captured and some of your units destroyed. Under these conditions you are unable to continue the war and must surrender your forces to the British.
dst: 平民被俘，您的部分单位被歼灭。在这种条件下，您无法继续战争，必须向英军投降。

src: The civilians are safe and your units are ready to fight another day. You must return to the Kilimanjaro area as the British troops are organizing an attack on our lines.
dst: 平民安然无恙，您的部队已准备好再战。您必须返回乞力马扎罗地区，因为英军正在组织对我方战线的进攻。

src: The civilians, and many of our soldiers, were on the verge of panic. Nobody thought about the Spring Offensive any more. The defeat of the Red Army, the liberation of Moscow... all of those ideas appeared like distant dreams, like something unreal that we had imagined decades ago. The present was completely different, far worse than anything that we could have imagined. Having thought about victory seemed foolish. There and then, survival was the only thing that mattered.
dst: 平民和我们许多士兵都濒临恐慌。再也没有人想着春季攻势了。击败红军、解放莫斯科……所有这些念头都像遥远的梦境，像我们几十年前想象出的、某种不真实的东西。眼前的现实截然不同，远比我们所能想象的要糟得多。曾想过胜利，似乎很愚蠢。此时此刻，生存才是唯一要紧的事。

src: The coast is secured! The landings was successful at all major sections, only in the area around Dover we suffered heavy losses. As long as our Luftwaffe and Kriegsmarine keeps the British Home Fleet away and our supply is secured, the continuation of the operation should succeed. Our next goal is to reach the line Gloucester-Oxford-London!
dst: 海岸已经确保！各主要地段登陆均告成功，只有在多佛一带我们遭受了惨重损失。只要我们的德国空军和德国海军能把英国本土舰队挡在外海、并确保我方补给安全，行动的继续就应该能成功。我们的下一个目标是抵达格洛斯特-牛津-伦敦一线！

src: The coast of Egypt is closed, Alexandria and Port Said are under our control, however the British have not accepted our offer of surrender. Now we must assault the city to end the British control over North Africa.
dst: 埃及海岸已被封锁，亚历山大和塞得港都在我们控制之下，然而英国人并未接受我们的投降提议。现在我们必须突入该城，以终结英国对北非的控制。

src: The code-name for this operation is: C3
The cold winter proves yet again he's best Russian General!  Sit down as look at the situation map.
dst: 这个寒冬再次证明了他才是俄国最好的将军！坐下看看态势图。

src: The colored infantry regiments which join your core did not take part at the historic Battle of Fredericksburg or were established later but have been implemented at this point of the campaign for a better core development.
dst: 加入您核心单位的有色人步兵部队并未参加历史上的弗雷德里克斯堡战役，或者是后来才组建的，但为了核心单位更好地发展，它们被安排在了战役的这一节点。

src: The combination of Belgian and South African troops was too much for you and your men. You have been captured by the enemy and are unable to receive any reincorcementes.  Von Lettow will soon have to surrender. The campaign is over.
dst: 比利时与南非部队的联合进攻对您和您的士兵来说过于强大。您已被敌人俘虏，无法得到任何增援。冯·莱托很快也将不得不投降。战役结束了。

src: The combined German and Italian army attempts to push back British forces in North Africa.
dst: 德意联军试图在北非击退英军。

src: The commander is missing, he was last seen rallying the a tank assault into the 4th SS Panzergrenadiere's sector to close the Thermoplyae road.
dst: 指挥官失踪了，他最后一次被人看见，是在集结一次坦克突击，冲入党卫军第4装甲掷弹兵师的地段，以封锁温泉关道路。

src: The communist troops have been completely defeated by your quick actions. The problems with the guerrillas of the ChCP are finished for a long time, I hope.  Congratulations! you have been awarded the Order of the Golden Kite 2nd class.
dst: 共军已被您的迅速行动彻底击败。我希望中国共产党游击队的麻烦在很长一段时间内已经了结。恭喜！您已被授予二等金鵄勋章。

src: The complete Totenkopf division will arrive - piecemeal - on your left later today.
dst: “骷髅”师全师将于今天晚些时候零散地抵达你的左翼。

src: The complete division reached Normandy around 20th June and was kept in reserve for more than a week.
dst: 全师于6月20日前后抵达诺曼底，并作为预备队待命了一周多。

src: The conditions out there are very difficult, an early thaw has left the ground water-logged making it impossible for our vehicles to operate off-road.
dst: 那里的条件极为艰难，过早解冻使地面泥泞不堪，我们的车辆无法越野行驶。

src: The conquest of France has begun! General, you must move quickly thru the Sedan area. A rapid advance in this sector will unbalance the French. Be warned General, while we may have surprise on our side the French have many troops & will reinforce quickly! Speed is important!
dst: 征服法国已经开始了！将军，你必须迅速穿过色当地区。此地段的神速推进会打乱法军的阵脚。提醒你，将军，我们虽有突然性之利，但法军兵力众多，会迅速增援！速度至关重要！

src: The conquest of Greece would not be complete without capturing the largest island, Crete. If we are to control the Mediterranean Sea - we have to dislodge the Allied forces that escaped from the mainland. You will be assisted by our Fallschirmjaegers that will make the largest airborne assault operation ever undertaken. Move as quickly as possible and don't let them down, as they can't hold their positions for long without your help. By the way - intelligence reports state there might be some enemy submarine activity north of the island, so you'd better get your troops ashore quickly.
dst: 不夺取最大岛屿克里特，征服希腊就不算完整。若要控制地中海，就必须逐走从大陆逃出的盟军。我们的空降猎兵将协助你，发动有史以来规模最大的空降突击。尽快行动，别让他们失望——没有你的支援，他们无法久守阵地。顺便说，情报报告称岛屿以北可能有敌方潜艇活动，所以你最好尽快让部队上岸。

src: The conquest of Serbia - November, 1915 - BV
dst: 征服塞尔维亚 - 1915年11月 - 大捷

src: The conquest of Serbia - November, 1915 - L
dst: 征服塞尔维亚 - 1915年11月 - 失败

src: The conquest of Serbia - November, 1915 - TV
dst: 征服塞尔维亚 - 1915年11月 - 小捷

src: The conquest of Serbia - November, 1915 - V
dst: 征服塞尔维亚 - 1915年11月 - 胜利

src: The conquest of the port would also be helpful as own supply may there be employed...
dst: 攻占港口也有帮助，因为那里可以作为我方的补给点...

src: The consequence of this great mistake was now clear: detached from the Ethiopian Empire, now the majority of the Eritrean Tigrayans viewed themselves as a different nation. If they ever got rid of the Italians, they would fight for an independent Eritrea, but they didn't wish to rejoin their Ethiopian brethren.
dst: 这个重大错误的后果如今已清晰可见：脱离了埃塞俄比亚帝国之后，如今大多数厄立特里亚提格雷人都把自己视为另一个民族。即便有朝一日摆脱了意大利人，他们也会为独立的厄立特里亚而战，而不愿重新加入他们的埃塞俄比亚同胞。

src: The consequence of this great mistake was now clear: detached from the Ethiopian Empire, now the majority of the EritreanTigrayans viewed themselves as a different nation. If they ever got rid of the Italians, they would fight for an independent Eritrea, but they didn't wish to rejoin their Ethiopian brethren.
dst: 这个重大错误的后果如今已清晰可见：脱离了埃塞俄比亚帝国之后，如今大多数厄立特里亚提格雷人都把自己视为另一个民族。即便有朝一日摆脱了意大利人，他们也会为独立的厄立特里亚而战，而不愿重新加入他们的埃塞俄比亚同胞。

src: The consequence would be, that in a few years they would all be driven from the territories of Gaul, and all the Germans would cross the Rhine; for neither must the land of Gaul be compared with the land of the Germans, nor must the habit of living of the latter be put on a level with that of the former. Moreover, [as for] Ariovistus, no sooner did he defeat the forces of the Gauls in a battle, which took place at Magetobria, than [he began] to lord it haughtily and cruelly, to demand as hostages the children of all the principal nobles, and wreak on them every kind of cruelty, if everything was not done at his nod or pleasure; that he was a savage, passionate, and reckless man, and that his commands could no longer be borne.
dst: 其后果将是：不出几年，他们就会被逐出高卢各地，所有日耳曼人都将渡过莱茵河；因为高卢的土地既不能与日耳曼的土地相比，后者的生活方式也不能与前者的相提并论。而且，阿里奥维斯图斯自从在马格托布里亚一战中击败高卢军队之后，就开始骄横残暴地作威作福，索要所有显贵子弟当人质，若有不顺其意者便施以种种酷刑；他是个野蛮、暴烈、不顾后果的人，他的命令再也不能忍受了。」

src: The convoy has been captured and our men are fully resupplied. Now we'll be able to keep on fighting for a very long time.
dst: 运输队已被缴获，我们的战士也补充了充足的补给。现在我们将能够继续战斗很长一段时间。

src: The counterattack stops the German advance but the gains for the 11 June are only 3-4 kilometers.  On 12th June the counterattack is relaunched but the advance is only of 2 kms.  On June 13th the battle is over. A lot of ground has been lost on French side but the German offensive on Compiegne has been stopped.
dst: 反攻阻止了德军的推进，但6月11日的战果仅有3至4公里。6月12日反攻重新发起，但推进仅2公里。6月13日，战役结束。法军一方丧失了大片土地，但德军对贡比涅的攻势已被遏制。

src: The courage and the quality of the Egyptian soldiers were beyond all doubt, and they were not surprised by our troops. However, with the arrival of our reserves we managed to overwhelm them. Urabi surrendered to our cavalry, and the next day Wolseley arrived in Cairo. The Khedive was reinstated, and we established a permanent British military garrison in Egypt for the protection of our nation's interests.
dst: 埃及士兵的勇气和素质毋庸置疑，他们也没有被我们的部队打得措手不及。然而，随着我们的预备队到达，我们终于将他们压倒。奥拉比向我们的骑兵投降，次日沃尔斯利抵达开罗。赫迪夫得以复位，我们在埃及设立了永久性的英国驻军，以保护我国的利益。

src: The crisis is over, and the Polish Army has collapsed.  Once you led us past the river, nothing could stop our panzers.
dst: 危机已过，波军已崩溃。一旦你率我们渡过了河，就再没什么能阻挡我们的装甲部队了。

src: The current plan for Normandy is for an American breakthrough in the west, to be made possible by an attritional battle here in the east, to draw away German reserves.  For this plan to work, we need to secure Bourgebus ridge to the south of Caen.  This will then draw in whatever German reserves remain into this battle, preventing them being used to counter the U.S. forces in the west.
dst: 当前诺曼底的计划是：由美军在西面实现突破，而这要靠东面这里的消耗战来引开德军预备队。为使该计划奏效，我们必须夺取卡昂以南的布尔格比斯山脊。这将把德军剩余的所有预备队都吸进这场战斗，使其无法用于对付西面的美军。

src: The current situation is bleak. In the east, Romania is going to enter the war, on Russia's side. Here, the only thing that we can do is to wait for the next Italian assault. Sooner or later, they'll find a way to breach our defence lines, especially if they choose a better commander.  I don't know what we're going to do. Well, I guess it could get better. In a war, things can change very suddenly.
dst: 当前局势十分黯淡。在东线，罗马尼亚即将站在俄国一边参战。在这里，我们唯一能做的就是等待意大利人的下一次进攻。他们迟早会找到办法突破我们的防线，尤其是如果他们换上一个更出色的指挥官。我不知道我们该怎么办。唉，我想情况也许会好转。战争中，局势可能骤然生变。

src: The day before the battle of Saint Quentin, Wilhelm I had been formally proclaimed German Emperor in the Hall of Mirrors at the Palace of Versailles. A new major power had been born in Europe.
dst: 圣康坦战役的前一天，威廉一世在凡尔赛宫的镜厅被正式宣告为德意志皇帝。欧洲诞生了一个新的强国。

src: The day that we were expecting finally arrived. We were told to follow our advance along the railroad, eliminating the Bolshevik resistance until we reached the river Tobol.
dst: 我们期待的那一天终于到来。我们奉命沿铁路继续推进，肃清布尔什维克的抵抗，直到抵达托博尔河。

src: The decision to withdraw was motivated by the failing light, mounting casualties amongst the infantry and reports that Turkish reinforcements, estimated in excess of 10,000 strong, were approaching from the north and east.  However, the reinforcements that had engaged our defensive screen of light horsemen had already been repulsed with relative ease when the order to retreat was given. How could we give away victory so easily?
dst: 做出撤退决定的理由是：天色渐暗、步兵伤亡不断增加，以及有报告称估计超过1万人的土耳其增援部队正从北面和东面逼近。然而，当撤退命令下达时，与我方轻骑兵警戒幕交战的增援部队其实已被相对轻松地击退。我们怎能如此轻易地放弃胜利？

src: The decisive Allied victory at the Second Battle of El Alamein was a turning point in the North African campaign.
dst: 盟军在第二次阿拉曼战役中的决定性胜利，是北非战役的转折点。

src: The decisive Battle at Waghäusel * BV
dst: 瓦格霍伊瑟尔决战 * 大捷

src: The decisive Battle at Waghäusel * L
dst: 瓦格豪塞尔决战 * 失败

src: The decisive Battle at Waghäusel * TV
dst: 瓦格豪塞尔决战 * 战术胜利

src: The decisive Battle at Waghäusel * V
dst: 瓦格豪塞尔决战 * 小捷

src: The deeds accomplished by Józef Pilsudski and his men created Poland.
dst: 约瑟夫·毕苏斯基及其手下所建立的功业造就了波兰。

src: The defeat in the Battle of Manila Bay on 1 May decided the Spanish government to organize a relief expedition. On June 16, Rear Admiral Cámara's Reserve Squadron (composed by Spain's most powerful warships, the battleship Pelayo and the brand-new armored cruiser Carlos V, together with some auxiliary cruisers and torpedo-boats) sailed for the Philippines to redress the situation there. Six more steamers carried 5.000 Spanish Army troops, coal and supplies to support the expedition and reinforce Spanish forces already in the Philippines.
dst: 5月1日马尼拉湾海战的失败促使西班牙政府决定组织一支救援远征队。6月16日，卡马拉少将的预备分舰队（由西班牙最强大的军舰——「佩拉约」号战列舰和全新的「卡洛斯五世」号装甲巡洋舰，以及一些辅助巡洋舰和鱼雷艇组成）驶往菲律宾，以扭转那里的局势。另有六艘轮船运送5000名西班牙陆军部队、煤和补给，以支援远征并加强已在菲律宾的西班牙军队。

src: The defeated 12th Army is now in no shape to offer resistance to a possible German advance on Petrograd.  The upheavals at the capital (Petrograd experienced riots in June and August and the Bolshevik revolution in October) have precipitated to all units on the front, transforming the army into a disillusioned, hungry, and vengeful mass.  The Bolsheviks will arrange a separate peace with Germany at Brest-Litovsk, ceding massive territory to the enemy.
dst: 如今，战败的第12集团军已无力抵抗德军可能向彼得格勒的推进。首都的动荡（彼得格勒在六月和八月经历骚乱，十月经历布尔什维克革命）已波及前线的所有部队，把军队变成一群幻灭、饥饿、满怀怨恨的乌合之众。布尔什维克将在布列斯特—立托夫斯克与德国单独媾和，把大片领土割让给敌人。

src: The defence by the Legiony was one of the factors which saved the Austro-Hungarian army from complete disaster. This outstanding accomplishment was so impressive, that on November 5th, 1916 the German and Austrian Emperors granted independence for the Kingdom of Poland.
dst: 军团进行的防御是使奥匈帝国军队免于彻底灾难的因素之一。这一杰出成就是如此令人瞩目，以至于1916年11月5日，德皇和奥皇赐予了波兰王国独立。

src: The defenders have abandoned the area south of Antwerpen and secured it with landmines and blockings. After this line the enemy front line is not so big. In the outback the allied still have some big tanks, like the Sherman Easy Eight type. In the harbor the allied unload unexperienced tank divisions at the moment.
dst: 守军已放弃安特卫普以南地区，并用反步兵地雷和障碍物加以封锁。此线之后，敌军前线并不宽大。在后方，盟军还有一些重型坦克，如“谢尔曼”Easy Eight型。在港口，盟军目前正在卸载缺乏经验的坦克师。

src: The defenders of Narva include the local 4th regiment and remnants of the German 405th.  It is unfortunate, but we must retreat from the city in the face of overwhelming Soviet forces.  Following a massive naval operation by the Soviets, a large contingent of enemy troops has captured territory to the west of Narva.  To make matters even worse, there are Estonian traitors fighting for the Reds to the south-west of the city.  Your objective is to provide for a secure evacuation of the Narva garrison.  To fulfill your mission, you must:
dst: 纳尔瓦的守军包括当地第4团和德军第405团的残部。很不幸，面对占压倒优势的苏军，我们必须撤出该城。苏军发动大规模海上行动之后，一支庞大的敌军部队已占领纳尔瓦以西的领土。更糟的是，在城西南，有爱沙尼亚叛徒在为红军作战。您的目标是确保纳尔瓦守军安全撤离。为完成使命，您必须：

src: The defenders of Tuyen Quang surrendered just three days after Giovanninelli's brigade was destroyed at Hoa Moc. Soon most of Tonkin was in Chinese hands. When the news of the French defeats reached Paris there were riots in the streets. The laicist-colonialist government of Jules Ferry fell on 30 March, and his successor promptly signed a peace treaty with China. According to the Treaty of Tientsin France recognised the Chinese protectorate over Tonkin, and reciprocally China acknowledged the Fench protectorate in Annam.
dst: 在乔瓦尼内利旅于华木被歼灭仅仅三天后，宣光的守军便投降了。很快，北圻的大部分地区落入中国手中。当法军战败的消息传到巴黎时，街头发生了骚乱。茹费里的世俗殖民主义政府于3月30日倒台，他的继任者随即与中国签署了和约。根据《天津条约》，法国承认中国对北圻的保护权，作为交换，中国承认法国对安南的保护权。

src: The defense of Nancy is very important right now. President Beck is desperately trying to make peace with the western allies. In order to attain this he has permitted the Italians, the Bulgarians and the Finns to get out of the war, and has withdrawn from Greece. At this moment secret negotiations are taking place in Spain: though Churchill is still insisting on an unconditional surrender he is the only one receiving our envoy.
dst: 当前保卫南锡至关重要。贝克总统正拼命设法与西方盟国媾和。为此他已允许意大利、保加利亚和芬兰退出战争，并已从希腊撤军。此刻在西班牙正在进行秘密谈判：尽管丘吉尔仍坚持无条件投降，但他是唯一接见我方使者的人。

src: The defenses at Lesboeufs and Morval were too strong for us. The breakthrough was impossible, and after two weeks of fighting we had no other choice but to retire to our starting positions.
dst: 莱斯伯夫和莫瓦尔的防御对我们来说过于坚固。突破已无可能，经过两周的战斗，我们别无选择，只能退回出发阵地。

src: The destruction of the Belgian Army - that sits in Antwerp and keeps on threatening the supply lines to our troops in France - has become a priority. Von Beseler has received more troops to reach this goal. On top of the III Reserve Corps with the 5th and 6th Reserve Divisions, also the Marine Division , the 4th Ersatz Division, the 26th, 37th, 38th and 41st Landwehr Brigaden and the 1st and 2nd Reserve Ersatz Brigaden are now under his command.
dst: 歼灭盘踞安特卫普、不断威胁我驻法部队补给线的比利时陆军，已成为当务之急。冯·贝泽勒为达成此目标得到了更多部队。除拥有第5、第6预备师的第3预备军外，海军陆战师、第4补充师、第26、37、38、41国土防卫旅以及第1、第2预备补充旅如今也归他指挥。

src: The determination and dedication of the anti-tank units will become history because of this battle!
dst: 反坦克部队的坚决与奉献，将因这场战斗而载入史册！

src: The determined frontal assault of your Soomusrongide Diviis in combination with amphibious operations behind enemy lines have routed the Bolshevik defenders in the area.  The distance to Petrograd has been shortened by a factor of 2, and you must now deploy to our southern flank to push the entire front line to within striking distance of the Bolshevik captial.
dst: 您的装甲列车师的坚决正面突击，加上深入敌后的两栖作战，已经击溃了该地区的布尔什维克守军。通往彼得格勒的距离缩短了一半，您现在必须部署到我们的南翼，把整条战线推进到布尔什维克首都的攻击距离之内。

src: The device is being shipped back to the States on the largest civilian boat we can find.  Meanwhile, you should plot your next move, Commander.  I'll let you know what happens with this as more developments come up.
dst: 这个装置正由我们能找到的最大一艘民用船运回美国。与此同时，你应当谋划下一步行动，指挥官。一有新进展我就告诉你。

src: The difficult terrain and weather conditions can make slower units unusable.  Partisan units have mountain training , do not surrender and can evade.
dst: 艰险地形与天气可使速度较慢的单位丧失效用。游击分队受过山地训练，绝不投降且善于规避。

src: The disaster in the Ebro operation has allow the rebels to launch a big offensive over Catalunya. The high command wants to (at least) stop that offensive, or delay it basically. The current operation consist of an attack in the Segre river sector, Southwards to Lerida, aimed to stabilize our front and to recapture two important electric plants in the other side of the river.
dst: 埃布罗行动的惨败让叛军得以对加泰罗尼亚发动一场大规模攻势。最高指挥部打算（至少）遏止这场攻势，或者大致上拖延它。当前的行动是在塞格雷河地区发起进攻，自莱里达向南推进，旨在稳定我军战线，并夺回河对岸的两座重要发电厂。

src: The diversion must reach as far as Fort Pilastrino and 8th Mg.Btn. must survive!
dst: 佯攻必须推进到皮拉斯特里诺堡，且第8机枪营必须存活！

src: The division's troops saw action in Poland, The Netherlands, Belgium, France, The Balkans, Russia, Normandy, The Ardennes, Hungary, Vienna and Prague. Expect a Blitzkrieg type of campaign with battalion size units.
dst: 该师部队转战波兰、荷兰、比利时、法国、巴尔干、俄国、诺曼底、阿登、匈牙利、维也纳和布拉格。这是一场营级规模的闪电战式战役。

src: The early years following the end of the war were bittersweet at best. Although the country was saved of the worst fate, Czechoslovakia still lost hundred thousands inhabitants, Subcarpathia was annexed by Soviet Union, industry was severely hampered.
dst: 战后的最初岁月，往好了说也是苦乐参半。尽管这个国家免于最坏的命运，捷克斯洛伐克仍失去了数十万居民，喀尔巴阡鲁塞尼亚被苏联吞并，工业受到重创。

src: The effect of the mines on the German defenders was devastating. Some 10,000 men were killed during the explosions alone. The British divisions took all objectives within three hours. German counterattacks were repelled. For the first time on the Western front, defensive casualties (25,000) exceeded attacking losses (17,000).
dst: 地雷对德军守军造成了毁灭性的打击。仅爆炸一项就造成约1万人死亡。英军各师在三小时内达成了所有目标。德军的反击被击退。在西线，防守方伤亡（25000人）首次超过了进攻方损失（17000人）。

src: The eggheads have figured out what the machine does.  It's sent us through time and space...and if they've discovered how to read the data correctly, we're about five years in the future.
dst: 书呆子们弄清了这台机器的作用。它把我们送穿越了时间和空间……如果他们读懂数据的方式没错，我们现在大约处在五年之后。

src: The eggheads have taken us back in time to the original location of the time machine, Commander.  Nobody knows exactly when (though the reader's glitched to 1955), but we know it's before the existence of the Roman Empire, so the odds are that you aren't going to run into anyone else out here.  Anyone human, anyway.
dst: 书呆子们把我们送回到了时间机器最初所在的地点，指挥官。没人确切知道是何时（虽然读数仪跳到了 1955 年），但我们知道这是在罗马帝国存在之前，所以十有八九你在外面不会遇到任何其他人。反正是不会遇到人。

src: The emperor again wants to give you the opportunity to select your next destination. By taking the Australian flag, you will go to New Guinea.  If you decide instead to take the British flag, your troops will be deployed in our coming campaign in Burma. Where will you go?
dst: 天皇再次希望给您选择下一个目的地的机会。夺取澳大利亚国旗，您将前往新几内亚。如果您改为夺取英国国旗，您的部队将被部署到我们即将展开的缅甸战役中。您要去哪里？

src: The encirclement of Atlanta is almost completed! Just north of Rome, 40 km east of your position, exists a loophole. You will close this gap immediately!
dst: 对亚特兰大的合围即将完成！就在罗马以北、你阵地以东40公里处，还有一个缺口。你要立即封住这个缺口！

src: The end of 1918 was very hard to us. At least,  Admiral Kolchak was our new Supreme Governor, and he was doing his best to win the war, but problems arose everywhere. We couldn't trust he Czechs, so most of them were retired from the front, and they were ordered to guard the Trans-Siberian Railway. It was the best possible decision, but it had a great flaw: thousands of armed foreigners were controlling our only supply line. Not surprisingly, they soon started to use the trains to secure their own evacuation, while our men in the front lacked proper equipment and reinforcements.
dst: 1918年年底对我们来说非常艰难。至少，高尔察克海军上将成了我们新的最高执政者，他正竭尽全力赢得战争，但问题无处不在。我们不能信任捷克人，所以他们中的大多数人从前线撤了下来，被派去守卫西伯利亚大铁路。这是当时最好的决定，但它有一个重大缺陷：数千名武装外国人控制着我们唯一的补给线。不出所料，他们很快就开始利用火车来确保自己的撤离，而我们在前线的士兵却缺乏像样的装备和增援。

src: The end of the war is near but until that moment comes our troops will have to go on advancing.
dst: 战争的结束已近在眼前，但那一刻到来之前，我们的部队仍须继续推进。

src: The enemies are not numerous. In the east of the Ruhr area the west allied have built a front which is saved by blockings, landmines and barbwire. More in the south the resistance seems to be not so hard.
dst: 敌军数量并不多。在鲁尔区东部，西方盟军构筑了一道由障碍物、地雷和铁丝网保护的防线。更靠南面的抵抗似乎没那么顽强。

src: The enemy air power is limited, but these are really experienced men flying modern planes. Be extremely careful in the air.
dst: 敌军空中力量有限，但这些都是驾驶现代化飞机、经验丰富的飞行员。在空中务必极其小心。

src: The enemy commander Stilwell and the British forces escaped to India and China.
dst: 敌军指挥官史迪威及英国部队逃往了印度和中国。

src: The enemy commander, Stilwell has been captured and  the British and China forces destroyed!.  The victory in Burma is complete!!
dst: 敌军指挥官史迪威已被俘，英军与中国军队均被歼灭！缅甸的战事已大获全胜！！

src: The enemy defense in North Caucasus has collapsed. On the way to Astrakhan, your next goal, we expect only sporadic resistance.
dst: 北高加索的敌军防线已经崩溃。在前往你的下一个目标阿斯特拉罕的路上，我们预计只会遇到零星抵抗。

src: The enemy expect our operation and the remains of the U.S. Atlantic Fleet was gathered in the area of Bermuda. Therefore, your landing troops are accompanied by strong naval and sea air forces. But make sure that none of the valuable heavy Naval units come to harm!
dst: 敌人料到了我们的行动，美国大西洋舰队的残余已集结在百慕大一带。因此，你的登陆部队由强大的海军和海军航空兵护航。但务必确保没有任何宝贵的大型海军舰艇受到损伤！

src: The enemy fleet has been destroyed, and now we must continue with the travel to Narvik.
dst: 敌方舰队已被摧毁，现在我们必须继续向纳尔维克进发。

src: The enemy forces are mainly militia men, but our spies reports that the communists are organizing regular units. Also some foreing volunteers and CNT forces have been reported on the East side of the city. Be careful, surely the enemy militias will offer a hard resistance on the south neighbourhoods, (mainly inhabited by workers) and we still don't know how good are the foreing volunteers of the goverment.
dst: 敌军主要由民兵组成，但我们的间谍报告说，共产党人正在组建正规部队。此外，据报在该城东侧出现了若干外国志愿者和 CNT 部队。要小心，敌军民兵肯定会在南部街区（主要为工人聚居区）进行顽强抵抗，而我们仍不清楚政府方面的外国志愿者战斗力如何。

src: The enemy forces are mainly militia men, but our spies reports that the communists are organizing regular units. Also some foreing volunteers and CNT forces have been reported on the East side of the city. Be careful, surely the enemy militias will offer a hard resistance on the south neighbourhoods, (mainly inhabited by workers) and we still don't know how good are the foreing volunteers of the goverment. We also expect the aparition of hidden supporters (the 5th Column) in Madrid as soon as we get closer to the city center.
dst: 敌军主要是民兵，但我们的间谍报告说，共产党人正在组建正规部队。此外，据报有若干外国志愿人员和 CNT 部队出现在城市东侧。您要当心，敌方民兵必定会在南部街区（主要由工人居住）进行顽强抵抗，而我们尚不清楚政府一方的外国志愿人员实力如何。我们还预计，一旦我们接近市中心，马德里城内就会出现隐藏的支持者（第5纵队）。

src: The enemy forces will use the Gan River as a big wall, but your artillery detachments should destroy that wall.  The Imperial Navy will send you some support reinforcements by the Gan River in the form of Imperial Navy air units and Special Navy Landing Forces.
dst: 敌军将把赣江当作一堵高墙，但您的炮兵部队应当摧毁这堵墙。帝国海军将通过赣江为您送来一些支援增援，形式为帝国海军空中单位与海军特别陆战队。

src: The enemy has been completely surprised and destroyed by your actions!, now the way to Egypt is clear. Your next mission is to assault the historical port of Alexandria.
dst: 在你的行动下，敌人被彻底打了个措手不及并被歼灭！通往埃及的道路已经打开。你的下一个任务是突击历史名城亚历山大港。

src: The enemy has been completely surprised and destroyed by your actions!, now, the way to Egypt is clear. Your next mission is to assault the historical port of Alexandria.
dst: 在你的行动下，敌人被彻底打了个措手不及并被歼灭！通往埃及的道路已经打开。你的下一个任务是突击历史名城亚历山大港。

src: The enemy has been surprised, however we could not get the complete victory, some units have escaped, and surely the British will launch a counteroffensive...
dst: 敌人被打了个措手不及，但我们未能取得全胜，部分敌军逃脱了，英军肯定会发动反攻……

src: The enemy has finally reached the Mediterranean sea, and things can't be worse. Maybe this will be our last chance to reverse the fortunes of war, commandante. A new plan has been designed. This offensive is our biggest gamble in the war up to now. People's Army units have silently taken positions along the river Ebro, nearly to the town of Amposta, in the province of Tarragona. The main mission is to cross the great Ebro river and break through the enemy lines here, in a place where an attack is not expected. Your mission is to cross the river, make a bridgehead to allow more troops to cross, and finally reach and conquer the town of Gandesa.
dst: 敌军终于抵达地中海，局势已经坏到不能再坏。指挥官，这或许是我们扭转战局的最后机会。一项新计划已经拟定。这次攻势是我们这场战争迄今最大的一场豪赌。人民军各部队已悄然在塔拉戈纳省阿姆波斯塔镇一带的埃布罗河沿岸占领阵地。主要任务是强渡这条伟大的埃布罗河，在此处——敌军料想不到会遇袭的地段——突破其防线。您的任务是渡河、建立桥头堡以便更多部队过河，最终抵达并攻占甘德萨镇。

src: The enemy has taken control of Kerch Straight . There are also enemy landings made on the Azov Sea coast and the Black Sea coast of Taman Peninsula.
dst: 敌军已控制刻赤海峡。敌军亦在亚速海沿岸及塔曼半岛黑海沿岸登陆。

src: The enemy have several tank divisions. In the air you have to calculate with high resistance, too. The USAF and RAF have several air fleets in the area of Dessau. Several level-bomber squadrons will support the ground troops.
dst: 敌军拥有若干坦克师。在空中你也必须预料到会遭遇顽强抵抗。美国空军与皇家空军在德绍地区拥有数支航空队。若干水平轰炸机中队将为地面部队提供支援。

src: The enemy have stopped our units. We must dig in and await the next British strikes, this won't be easy General...
dst: 敌人挡住了我军。我们必须构筑工事，等待英军的下一次打击，这不会轻松，将军……

src: The enemy holds a firm defense line along the river line. Although the Soviets are badly trained and lead, although their morale is low, their equipment is a quality one.
dst: 敌军沿河线据守着一条坚固的防线。尽管苏军训练和指挥都很差、士气低落，但他们的装备却是上乘的。

src: The enemy is determined to take Estella and put us to an end, and three army corps have been mobilized for this purpose. The second one has broken our line of defense, but it has lost touch with the other two, entering too much in our territory. That gives us an opportunity to counterattack, defeat them and tecover the lost teritory. Good Luck!
dst: 敌人决意夺取埃斯特利亚，置我们于死地，为此已动员了三个军。其中第二军突破了我军防线，但与其他两个军失去了联系，过于深入我领土。这给了我们反攻、击败他们并收复失地的机会。祝您好运！

src: The enemy is heavily entrenched. You have air supremacy but you don't own any airfields . Build or capture one.
dst: 敌军深沟高垒。我军掌握制空权，但无一处机场。须修筑或夺取一处。

src: The enemy is pushed back on a front multiple kilometers wide, but you failed to achieve a breakthrough.
dst: 敌军在数公里宽的战线上被击退了，但您未能实现突破。

src: The enemy is taking control of Suchumi and a section of the coastal road. This means we are no longer able to fully supply our units near Novorossiysk, only by the means of our Black Sea Fleet. The front is collapsing and soon our glorious Black Sea Fleet will run out of ports! Report to Moskva or take life into your own hands...
dst: 敌军正在控制苏呼米和一段滨海公路。这意味着我们再也无法充分补给新罗西斯克附近的部队，只能依靠黑海舰队。战线正在崩溃，我们光荣的黑海舰队很快就会失去所有港口！到莫斯科报到，或者自求生路吧……

src: The enemy knows that, so they won't be sitting down odly waiting for our troops. We think that they will try to delay your march, while their best troops try a final counterattack in the south, in the hope of opening a corridor in Macedonia that allows them to receive help from the French and British troops that have disembarked in Greece. But if you advance quickly enough, all of their efforts will be useless. Good luck!
dst: 敌人对此心知肚明，所以他们不会坐等我们的部队到来。我们认为他们会设法迟滞您的行军，同时以精锐部队在南部发动最后一次反攻，希望在马其顿打开一条走廊，以便获得已在希腊登陆的法英军队的支援。但只要您推进得足够迅速，他们的一切努力都将徒劳无功。祝您好运！

src: The enemy offensive has been completely defeated.  Seoul is now securely in our hands, Kim-Il-Sung is really happy with your actions.  Now, let's complete the communist victory in Korea.
dst: 敌人的进攻已被彻底击败。汉城现在牢牢掌握在我们手中，金日成对你的行动非常满意。现在，让我们完成朝鲜的共产主义胜利。

src: The enemy officers hidden in the Malinta tunnel in Corregidor have been taken as prisoners, and the American presence on the Philippines will no longer be a threat.
dst: 藏身于科雷希多马林塔隧道中的敌军军官已被俘，美国在菲律宾的存在将不再是威胁。

src: The enemy pressure was too much for you and your troops. The Bulgarian Army in Macedonia is routed, and we've been forced to order a general retreat. I don't know how all of this will end, but be sure that you'll be brought to a military court to respond for your actions.
dst: 敌人的压力对您和您的部队而言过于沉重。驻马其顿的保加利亚军队被击溃了，我们被迫下令全面撤退。我不知道这一切将如何收场，但可以肯定，您将被送上军事法庭，为您的行为负责。

src: The enemy thrown against us two infantry brigades and two armoured brigades. These are supported by powerful airforce. They got strong backup of light artillery, both field and anti-tank; thankfully the heavier weapons are either stuck in the desert or exhausted of ammunition.
dst: 敌军向我方投入了两个步兵旅与两个装甲旅，并有强大空军支援。其轻型火炮（野战与反坦克）后备充足；所幸重型武器要么陷在沙漠，要么弹尽援绝。

src: The enemy was much stronger than anticipated. This is however not an acceptable excuse for your performance. Report to HQ!
dst: 敌人比预想的强大得多。但这不能成为你表现的借口。到司令部报到！

src: The enemy was shaken by the galloping of the horsemen against the strong front of his
dst: 敌人被骑兵朝着其坚固正面的冲锋气势所震撼

src: The enemy will buy and deploy more units!
dst: 敌军将购买并部署更多单位！

src: The enemy's plan has failed. The Bolshevik divisions are routed and we've opened a large gap in their lines. Our only problem right now is that we can't advance too fast, because our own lines would be overstretched. That might give the Reds time to regroup.
dst: 敌人的计划失败了。布尔什维克各师已被击溃，我们在他们的战线上撕开了一个大缺口。眼下我们唯一的问题是不能推进得太快，因为我们自己的战线会拉得过长。那可能会给红军重新集结的时间。

src: The enemy, that outnumbers us, has just released their third offensive to relieve Bilbao. Unfortunately our High Command, convinced that the main assault would occur in Valmaseda further south, neglected the defenses in the rest of the line. Right now the front is broken and the liberals are about to lift the siege of the city. Your troops are the only reserves that we have. Prepare a counterattack and reject the liberal offensive. If possible, also arrange an assault to make Bilbao fall.
dst: 人数占优的敌人刚刚发动了第三次解围毕尔巴鄂的攻势。不幸的是，我们的最高统帅部认定主攻将发生在更南边的巴尔马塞达，因而忽视了防线其余地段的防御。眼下战线已被突破，自由派即将解除对该城的围困。您的部队是我们仅有的预备队。准备反攻，击退自由派的攻势。如有可能，同时安排一次突击，使毕尔巴鄂陷落。

src: The entire blame for the encicrlement of 6th army is on the general of the 22nd Pz division.
dst: 第6集团军被围的全部责任都在第22装甲师师长身上。

src: The entire eastern front is in disarray from what seems to be a general offensive by the Russians, however, seceral formations are standing fast and regrouping, the Axis corps amongst them.
dst: 整个东线因俄军似乎是全面进攻而陷入混乱，然而若干编队正坚守并重整，轴心国军便是其中之一。

src: The entire position has been captured just before nightfall. Whereas our casualties have been very light, scarcely any Turks escaped from Magdhaba. Now it's time for our horses to have a drink in the wells before we return to El Arish...
dst: 整个阵地恰在夜幕降临前被攻克。我方伤亡极轻，而几乎没有土耳其人从马格达巴逃脱。现在该让我们的马儿在回阿里什之前到井边喝口水了……

src: The evacuation of Helles will start in a couple of hours, and your 29th Division has been given the task to act as rearguard against a possible Turkish attack on our retreating troops.
dst: 海勒斯的撤退将在几小时后开始，您的第29师受命担任后卫，以防范土耳其人可能对我们撤退部队发动的进攻。

src: The evacuation operations, started in mid september, surprised at first the soviet forces which after 22 Sep managed to organize efforts to disrupt the retreat with landings in the rear of the defensive lines both on Black Sea and Azov Sea coastline.
dst: 9月中旬开始的撤离行动起初出乎苏军意料，但其在9月22日后得以组织力量，通过在黑海与亚速海沿岸防线后方登陆，扰乱退却。

src: The events following 23 August 1944 led to the cancellation of production on 29 August. However, it has been decided the resuming of trials with the M-05 and the finishing of the first series of ten vehicles. Invoking the terms of armistice, on 26 October the Soviets confiscated the prototypes, the first series that was almost completed and everything related to the Maresal.
dst: 1944年8月23日之后的事变，导致生产于8月29日取消。然而，仍决定恢复M-05的试验并完成首批10辆车。10月26日，苏方援引停战条款，没收了原型车、几近完成的首批车以及一切与“元帅”相关的资料。

src: The execution of the plan was perfect. When they learnt that we controlled the Tugela Valley, panic spread among Buller's forces. He tried to react and to retreat in order, but half of his men didn't care to listen to his orders and just ran for they lives. They became an easy prey for Botha and De Wet.
dst: 计划的执行堪称完美。当他们得知我们控制了图盖拉河谷后，恐慌在布勒的部队中蔓延开来。他试图应对并有序撤退，但他手下有一半人根本不理睬他的命令，只顾仓皇逃命。他们成了博塔和德韦特易得的猎物。

src: The expected German attack has started. Early in the morning the Germans have crossed the Dutch border and in few hours they will arrive at our delaying line ("Position de Couverture") situated behind the Canal Albert and the Maas river from Antwerp to Arlon. With the support of the strong fortress of Eben-Emael, you must contain the Germans in the "Position de couverture" for as long as possible in order to allow our troops, as well as that of our French and British allies, to occupy their positions in the "Ligne KW" (Dyle Position for our allies), the main defence line where is foreseen to fight the decisive battle.
dst: 预料中的德军进攻已经开始。清晨德军越过了荷兰边境，几小时内他们就会抵达我们位于阿尔贝运河与马斯河之后、从安特卫普到阿尔隆的迟滞线（“Position de Couverture”）。在坚固的埃本-埃马尔要塞支援下，你必须在“Position de couverture”尽可能久地遏制德军，以便我军以及法国和英国盟军的部队进入“Ligne KW”（我们的盟友称之为戴尔河阵地）的阵地，那是预计将进行决定性会战的主要防线。

src: The expected counterattack has begun - the Soviets try to cross the Volga River at various points of the eastern front line! Your troops are urgently needed near Kazan, the Hungarians in this front section have too few troops to fend off the attacks. Stop the enemy attack and if possible counterattack immediately! A Hungarian Panzer Division is placed under your command for this task.
dst: 预料中的反攻开始了——苏军试图在东线多处地点渡过渡尔加河！喀山附近急需你的部队，这一战区的匈牙利人兵力太少，无法击退进攻。阻止敌军进攻，如有可能立即反击！为此任务，一个匈牙利装甲师已划归你指挥。

src: The fact that your aux units start the scenario without ammo and fuel is probably annoying, but it is not a bug and is indeed intended]
dst: 你的辅助部队在剧本开始时没有弹药和燃料，这大概很让人恼火，但这不是程序错误，而是有意为之]

src: The failure at Loos marked the end of sir John French as commander of the British Expeditionary Force. He was replaced by Haig in December. Haig had a good opinion of me, and he recommended my promotion to Lieutenant General, which was finally approved in February 1916. I was very happy with this recognition, but that was overshadowed by the pride that I felt for my sons. Michael had been promoted to Major and assigned to Egypt, where he had been born, and William, following the steps of his older brother, was already a Lieutenant, at only 22 years old. I could not suspect at that time that the hardest blow that I would have to take in my life was getting very close.
dst: 洛斯战役的失败标志着约翰·弗伦奇爵士担任英国远征军总司令的终结。12月，他被黑格取代。黑格对我评价很高，并推荐我晋升中将，这一晋升最终于1916年2月获批。我为这份认可感到十分高兴，但那份喜悦却被我对儿子们的自豪所掩盖。迈克尔已晋升为少校，并被派往他出生的地方埃及；而威廉追随哥哥的脚步，年仅22岁就已是一名中尉。我那时还无法预料，我一生中将要承受的最沉重打击正日益逼近。

src: The failure had a traumatic effect on the morale of the French army and many divisions mutinied.... singing the Chanson de Craonne.
dst: 这次失败对法军士气造成了创伤性打击，许多师发生兵变……他们唱着《克拉奥讷之歌》。

src: The failure of Operation "Wintergewitter" sealed the fate of Axis troops inside Stalingrad.
dst: “冬季风暴”行动的失败，注定了斯大林格勒轴心国守军的命运。

src: The failure of the Nivelle strategy and the high number of French casualties led to mutinies and the dismissal of Nivelle, his replacement by Pétain and the adoption of a defensive strategy while the French army recuperated.
dst: 尼韦勒战略的失败和法军的大量伤亡导致了兵变，尼韦勒被解职，由贝当接替，并在法军休整期间采取了防御战略。

src: The fall of Tula is the last step to our attack on Moscow. Now we can close the pincer from the South and isolate the Soviet capital. The Fuhrer speaks very highly of you!
dst: 图拉的陷落是我们进攻莫斯科的最后一步。现在我们可以从南面合拢钳形攻势，孤立苏联首都。元首对你赞誉有加！

src: The fascist has started his summer offensive. We expected the fascists to strike against Moskva, our capitol, but they have attacked in the south. Within weeks they had reached the Don River and Stalingrad on the Volga River. Even more south, Rostov has once again switched hands, the oilfields of Maikop have fallen, and German and Rumanian forces poured into the steppes south of Rostov, leading to the Causasus mountains with the valuable oil. A week ago the enemy has taken the Black Sea port of Novorossiyk and if we fail to stop the enemy at the coastal road, other ports will soon be under enemy control as well.
dst: 法西斯发动了夏季攻势。我们原本预计法西斯会进攻我们的首都莫斯科，他们却在南面发动了进攻。几个星期内，他们就打到了顿河和伏尔加河上的斯大林格勒。更南面，罗斯托夫再次易手，迈科普油田失守，德军和罗马尼亚军队涌入罗斯托夫以南的草原，直逼蕴藏宝贵石油的高加索山脉。一周前，敌人夺取了黑海港口新罗西斯克，如果我们不能在滨海公路挡住敌人，其他港口很快也会落入敌手。

src: The fascist have have only been halted by days. Ordzhonikidze has been taken and  we are in serious trouble at Grozny. Report in Moskva!
dst: 法西斯只被迟滞了几天。奥尔忠尼启则失守了，我们在格罗兹尼陷入了严重困境。到莫斯科报到！

src: The fascists and their allied try to break up the pocket of Stalingrad. We could stop them at the Myschkowa. You should overrun the enemy troops and throw them back to their starting position.
dst: 法西斯分子及其盟友试图打破斯大林格勒的包围圈。我们得以在梅什科瓦河阻止他们。你应当击溃敌军，把他们赶回出发阵地。

src: The fascists have started a counterattack to destroy our bridgehead near Novorossiysk, that you helped to form a month ago, and although we are holding on, we are about to crack. To draw away reserves, and to break through the fascist front in the center, we will attack near Krymskaya. Be aware that the Germans have reserves and will use it. On the other hand, we will commit as much forces as we can in order to force a breakthrough. Good luck, comrade.
dst: 法西斯发动了一次反攻，企图摧毁一个月前你帮助建立的新罗西斯克附近桥头堡，尽管我们还在坚守，但快要撑不住了。为了牵走敌军预备队，并在中央突破法西斯战线，我们将在克雷姆斯卡亚附近进攻。要知道德军有预备队，而且会使用它们。另一方面，我们将投入尽可能多的兵力，力求突破。祝你好运，同志。

src: The faster you try to win the war in the air, the faster you'll... lose it. Allied airforce is very powerful.
dst: 你越想速胜空战，就败得越快。盟军空军非常强大。

src: The fate of Afrika is in your hands.
dst: 非洲的命运掌握在您手中。

src: The few regular 8th Army units left are reorganizing behind the front or are defending Cairo. Alexandria is most likely defended by a hotchpotch of Allied units present in the Middle East:
dst: 第8集团军仅剩的几支正规部队正在战线后方重整，或防守开罗。亚历山大的守军多半是中东现存的盟军杂牌部队：

src: The field hospital will heal 4 strength points/turn.
dst: 野战医院每回合将治疗4点兵力。

src: The fighting capability of the Russian Army has deterioriated since the February Revolution. Kerensky, the Russian Minister of War ordered General Brusilov to launch another major offensive in the hope that a new victory would provide a boost to morale. Luckily, after some initial success in the area of Lemberg, this offensive collapsed quickly. The German and Austro-Hungarian High Commands both agree that this is the right time to hit the Russian troops hard and force them out of the war once and for all. Unfortunately, the Romanians still show a strong commitment to the fight and their army doesn't look nearly as desperate as their Russian allies. It's your job to defeat the Romanian and Russian forces, and push them out of South-Bukovina.
dst: 自二月革命以来，俄军的战斗力已大为衰退。俄国陆军部长克伦斯基命令布鲁西洛夫将军再发动一次大规模攻势，指望一场新胜利能提振士气。幸运的是，这次攻势在伦贝格地区取得初步战果后便迅速崩溃。德、奥匈两国最高统帅部一致认为，这正是痛击俄军、将他们彻底逐出战争的最佳时机。可惜罗马尼亚人仍表现出强烈的战斗意志，其军队也远不像他们的俄国盟友那样绝望。您的任务是击败罗马尼亚与俄国军队，将他们逐出南布科维纳。

src: The file that has the tickets to Berlin or the bottle that is in your office.
dst: 拿到去柏林的车票，还是你办公室里那瓶酒。

src: The first American reinforcements to reach Dewey arrived on 30 June, after 36 days at sea. Additional convoys followed and by the end of July some 12,000 US Army troops under command of Major General Wesley Merritt had landed. After some skirmishes with the Spanish, beginning August Merritt considered he was ready for an assault on the city.
dst: 第一批抵达杜威处的美国增援部队于6月30日到达，在海上航行了36天。后续船队相继抵达，到7月底，由韦斯利·梅里特少将指挥的约12000名美军部队已经登陆。经过与西班牙人的几次小规模交火后，梅里特从8月开始认为自己已做好进攻该城的准备。

src: The first Soviet offensive against the Taman bridgehead took place between 25 February and 12 March 1943. The 17th Army generally managed to hold the line and repulse the assaults. The second Soviet offensive started on 25 March while the third from  the second half of April.
dst: 苏军对塔曼桥头堡的首次攻势发生于1943年2月25日至3月12日。第17集团军大体守住了防线并击退进攻。苏军第二次攻势始于3月25日，第三次则在4月下半月。

src: The first action of the Franco-Prussian War took place on 4 August 1870, when the forces of the German coalition took Wissembourg, in Alsace. Two days later, the German Third Army attacked again near Wörth, some 16 km west from Wissembourg. Although badly outnumbered, the French were ready for a fierce resistance.
dst: 普法战争的首次军事行动发生于1870年8月4日，当时德意志联军的部队攻占了阿尔萨斯的维桑堡。两天后，德意志第3军团又在维桑堡以西约16公里处的沃尔特附近发动进攻。尽管兵力处于严重劣势，法军仍做好了顽强抵抗的准备。

src: The first big Republican offensive operation. Strike the rebels under an smashing heat.
dst: 共和军的首次大规模攻势作战。在酷热之中打击叛军。

src: The first days of the battle of Cambrai were a splendid triumph. We took all our objectives quickly and with few casualties, and the Germans seemed broken. But we had lost most of our tanks, and the roads were nearly impassable due to mud and snow. On November 27th all units were ordered to consolidate.
dst: 康布雷战役的头几天是一场辉煌的胜利。我们迅速夺取了所有目标，伤亡很小，德军似乎已经崩溃。但我们损失了大部分坦克，道路因泥泞和积雪而几乎无法通行。11月27日，所有部队都被命令巩固阵地。
