src: The first days of the battle of Cambrai were one of my worst failures. With the roads nearly impassable due to mud and snow, and with heavy casualties, especially in the tank crews, on November 27th all units were ordered to consolidate, before we could take all our objectives.
dst: 康布雷战役的头几天是我最惨痛的失败之一。由于道路因泥泞和积雪而几乎无法通行，加上伤亡惨重——尤其是坦克乘员——11月27日，在我们能够夺取所有目标之前，所有部队都被命令巩固阵地。

src: The first military actions of Rome against the pirates remained without lasting success or failed.
dst: 罗马对海盗的最初几次军事行动都没有取得持久战果，或以失败告终。

src: The first month of the Great War was not lucky for Austro-Hungary or for the Polish cause. The Austro-Hungarian HQ sent a lot of divisions to screen the German homeland from the Russians while the German army focused on France - without success. The famous Tannenberg battle was a tiny battle in comparision to the battles of the Kaiserliche and Konigliche Armee. The price of Austro-Hungarian sacrifice was high and the Russians continued to push forward. In such conditions the Polish uprising was a failure. In fact there was no uprising at all.
dst: 大战的第一个月对奥匈帝国或波兰的事业来说并不走运。奥匈帝国统帅部派出大量师去掩护德国本土、抵御俄国人，而德军则专注于法国——却毫无成效。著名的坦能堡战役与帝国与王家军队的那些战役相比，不过是一场小规模战斗。奥匈帝国牺牲的代价是高昂的，而俄国人仍在继续向前推进。在这样的条件下，波兰起义失败了。事实上根本没有发生任何起义。

src: The first objective is to cut the railroad lines, thus encircling the Greek forces. If you succeed, all the enemy front will crumble.
dst: 首要目标是切断铁路线，从而包围希腊军队。若您成功，敌人的整个战线都将崩溃。

src: The first objective of the combined force is to secure the important railroad hub at Luga.  15th, 19th, and 11th divisions of the Soviet 15th Army have entrenched along the front.  Intelligence reports the 15th Army posseses 2 armored trains and a division in reserve.  You must capture your objectives as rapidly as possible:  every day the Bolsheviks conscript new masses into the Red Army.
dst: 联军的第一目标是确保卢加这个重要铁路枢纽。苏俄第15集团军的第15、第19、第11师已沿战线构筑了堑壕。情报显示，第15集团军拥有2列装甲列车和1个师的后备力量。您必须尽快夺取您的目标：布尔什维克每天都在把新的群众征召进红军。

src: The first phase of the Tobol offensive was a stunning victory for us. The 5th Army was routed and the survivors rushed to the river Tobol as fast as they could.
dst: 托博尔攻势的第一阶段对我们来说是一场惊人的胜利。第五集团军被击溃，幸存者以最快的速度逃向托博尔河。

src: The first phase of the operation will be the landing of a small marine force (4 marine units) on the shore of the gulf.  You must perform this quickly, because there are Soviet ships in the area.  In the viscinity of Korovkino and on the Tallinn-Petrograd railroad, you may deploy a small forward force.  These units must quickly reach Krakol'ye or Kamenka to allow the deployment of the remainder of your troops.
dst: 行动的第一阶段是在海湾沿岸登陆一支小规模陆战部队（4个陆战单位）。您必须迅速完成，因为该地区有苏俄舰艇出没。在科罗夫基诺附近以及塔林—彼得格勒铁路上，您可以部署一支小规模先遣部队。这些单位必须迅速抵达克拉科利耶或卡缅卡，以便其余部队展开部署。

src: The first set of cylinders will be opened in the sector opposite the French 87th Territorial Division and the in this sector newly arrived 45th Algerian Division. Your largely volunteer 46th Reserve, 53th Reserve and 54th Reserve Divisions are expected to advance South to the Gravenstafel Ridge. More attacks supported by gas might be launched here around Ypres if this attack is successful.
dst: 第一批钢瓶将在法军第87领土师以及新抵达本防区的第45阿尔及利亚师对面的地段打开。您那主要由志愿兵组成的第46预备师、第53预备师和第54预备师，预计将向南朝赫拉芬斯塔费尔山脊推进。如果这次进攻成功，伊普尔一带可能还会发动更多有毒气支援的进攻。

src: The first stage of our offensive on the Shakhe River will be a flank action by the Dembovsky recon group, followed by the engagement of the whole of the Western Group (Bilderling) against the Japanese 2nd Army (Oyama).
dst: 我们在沙河攻势的第一阶段，将由登博夫斯基侦察群发起侧翼行动，随后整个西集团（比尔德林）投入战斗，对阵日本第2军（大山）。

src: The first stage of our summer offensive was a complete success and it was decided to split our forces:
dst: 我们夏季攻势的第一阶段取得了完全成功，于是决定分兵：

src: The first unit that captures Dunkirk will raise a leader!
dst: 夺取敦刻尔克的第一个单位将晋升一名指挥官！

src: The first unit that captures the airfield south of Siwa will raise a leader.
dst: 第一支夺取锡瓦以南机场的部队将晋升一名指挥官。

src: The first wave of Italian invaders was quickly destroyed. I was saddened when I saw how many Tigrayans were serving in the Italian colonial army. One of Menelik's aims had always been to limit the political and military power of Tigray, so that their inhabitants could never be a challenge for his authority.
dst: 第一波意大利入侵者很快就被消灭了。当我看到有那么多提格雷人在意大利殖民军中服役时，我感到十分痛心。孟尼利克的一个目标，一直都是限制提格雷的政治和军事力量，好让那里的居民永远无法对他的权威构成挑战。

src: The flanking maneuver of the Ottoman cavalry was spotted by two Italian airships. These airships also carried out bombardments of the enemy troops. The Italians - dragging a few pieces of heavy artillery from Tripoli and towing light artillery with light Fiat trucks - were able to chase the Ottoman forces out of Janzour and from Abd Al Jalil hill. Italian casualties were 43 killed, 278 wounded. Ottomen casualties are estimated at around 2000.
dst: 奥斯曼骑兵的侧翼机动被两艘意大利飞艇发现。这些飞艇还对敌军部队实施了轰炸。意大利人——从的黎波里拖来几门重炮，并用轻型菲亚特卡车牵引轻炮——得以将奥斯曼军队赶出詹祖尔和阿卜杜勒·贾利勒山。意大利人阵亡43人、伤278人。奥斯曼人的伤亡估计约为2000人。

src: The flanking maneuver of the Ottoman cavalry was spotted by two Italian airships. These airships also carried out bombardments of the enemy troops. The Italians - draging a few pieces of heavy artillery from Tripoli and towing light artillery with light Fiat trucks - were able to chase the Ottoman forces out of Janzour and from Abd Al Jalil hill. Italian casualties were 43 killed, 278 wounded. Ottomen casualties are estimated at around 2000.
dst: 奥斯曼骑兵的侧翼机动被两艘意大利飞艇发现。这些飞艇还对敌军实施了轰炸。意大利人——从的黎波里拖来几门重炮，并用轻型菲亚特卡车牵引轻型火炮——得以把奥斯曼军队逐出扬祖尔和阿卜杜勒-贾利勒山。意大利方面伤亡为43人死亡、278人受伤。奥斯曼方面的伤亡估计在2000人左右。

src: The flanks are secured, thanks to the efforts of May-Mayevsky and Sidorin on my left, and Wrangel and Diterikhs on my right. The enemy's defences are strong. In fact, Moscow resembles a fortress now. But I won' let that stop me. Moscow will be free, even if it costs me my life.
dst: 两翼已经巩固，这要感谢我左翼的迈-马耶夫斯基和西多林，以及右翼的弗兰格尔和季捷里赫斯。敌人的防御很坚固。事实上，如今的莫斯科就像一座要塞。但我不会因此却步。莫斯科必将获得自由，哪怕付出我的生命。

src: The fleet again entered Kiel. 47 sailors were arrested and detained at the naval base 'Wilhelm Souchon'.
dst: 舰队再次驶入基尔。47名水兵被捕，关押在「威廉·苏雄」海军基地。

src: The fleet had been moved from Kiel to Wilhelmshaven to set from there sail to the last battle. Despite utmost secrecy the plans came through to the crews.
dst: 舰队已从基尔调往威廉港，准备从那里启航奔赴最后的决战。尽管严守机密，这一计划还是传到了舰员们的耳中。

src: The following battle will be fought over some of the worst terrain you have encountered to date.   We expect that the terrain will slow up your advance more than the enemies troops.  This is the last chance to stop us before the frontier of India and China.
dst: 即将展开的这场战斗将在您迄今遇到的最恶劣地形上进行。我们预计地形对您推进的阻滞作用将超过敌军。这是我们在印度和中国边境之前阻止我们的最后机会。

src: The following battles of the civil war take place in Spain, Greece and North Africa, and follow always the same pattern: a few experienced veterans of the Gallic war against many inexperienced Legionaires of the Senate.
dst: 此后内战的各次会战发生在西班牙、希腊与北非，模式始终如一：一小批高卢战争的老兵，对阵大批缺乏经验的元老院军团兵。

src: The following day the landing continued and when more soldiers were ready the advance to the city started.  It was believed that the Germans had abandoned the city.  The Germans hadn't and were reinforced thanks to careful railway planning and the nearly 48 hours wasted by the attacking forces.  When the British arrived in sight of the city they were greeted by devastating fire...
dst: 次日，登陆继续进行，当更多士兵准备就绪后，向城市的推进开始了。人们相信德军已经放弃了这座城市。但德军并没有，而且得益于周密的铁路调度以及进攻部队浪费的近48个小时，他们得到了增援。当英军进入城市视野时，迎接他们的是毁灭性的火力……

src: The following day the landing continued and, when more soldiers were ready, the advance to the city started, in the belief that the germans had fleed.
dst: 次日登陆继续进行，待更多士兵就绪后，部队开始向城市推进，他们相信德国人已经逃走。

src: The following week we continued our retreat into France, and even though Von Kluck's German First Army went after us, they did not dare to engage us in combat.
dst: 接下来的一周，我们继续向法国境内撤退，尽管冯·克卢克的德国第一集团军尾随而来，他们却不敢与我军交战。

src: The forces of the III. Armeekorps (mot.), the 13. and 14. Panzer-Division spearhead the German advance on Rostov while the Leibstandarte SS Adolf Hitler captures Taganrog.
dst: 第3摩托化军、第13和第14装甲师的部队充当德军向罗斯托夫推进的先锋，而“阿道夫·希特勒警卫旗队”攻占了塔甘罗格。

src: The fortress at Przemysl has been surrounded for months. The defenders are desperate and they are running out of ammo and food. I know, General, the winter in the Carpathians is harsh, but this is our last chance to relieve them. Open a path to the fortress!
dst: 普热梅希尔要塞已被围困数月。守军陷入绝望，弹药与粮食即将耗尽。我知道，将军，喀尔巴阡山的冬天十分严酷，但这是我们解救他们的最后机会。打开通往要塞的道路！

src: The fortresses of Liege  August 1914 BV
dst: 列日要塞 1914年8月 大捷

src: The fortresses of Liege  August 1914 L
dst: 列日要塞 1914年8月 失败

src: The fortresses of Liege  August 1914 TV
dst: 列日要塞 1914年8月 小捷

src: The fortresses of Liege  August 1914 V
dst: 列日要塞 1914年8月 胜利

src: The french division will not arrive at Chambois in time to prevent the Germans from crossing the Dives. Therefore it could be a good idea to build a hooker east of the Dives and trap the Germans with the Canadians in the north, the Polish units in the east and the French units in the south and the Dives in the west.
dst: 法国师无法及时抵达尚布瓦（Chambois）以阻止德军渡过迪沃河。因此，在迪沃河以东构筑一个钩形阵地，以北面的加拿大人、东面的波兰部队、南面的法国部队以及西面的迪沃河困住德军，或许是个好主意。

src: The fresh air from the channel is wonderful yah?
dst: 海峡吹来的新鲜空气真棒，不是吗？

src: The fresh air from the channel is wonderful yah?  It is good to finally look upon the water.
dst: 海峡吹来的新鲜空气真棒，不是吗？终于能望见大海，真好。

src: The front cover of the Sekai Gaho ("The Pictorial World - Nisshi Dai Jihen Go No.4" Vol. 13 No. 12, Kokusai Joho Sha, 1937).
dst: 《世界画报》（"The Pictorial World - Nisshi Dai Jihen Go No.4" 第13卷第12号，国际情报社，1937年）封面。

src: The front line here at Ypres has not changed much in the last 2 years. But that could change.
dst: 过去两年里，伊普尔这里的前线没有太大变化。但情况可能要变了。

src: The front runs along the Aisne River. You have to attack the French lines and move further south. Our main objective in this operation is to secure the bridges and southern shore of the river Marne.
dst: 前线沿埃纳河展开。你必须进攻法军防线并向南推进。本次行动的主要目标是确保马恩河的桥梁与南岸。

src: The front runs along the Dnieper River from the large Dnieper bend in the north to Cherkasy in the southeast. By this time German forces had already crossed the Dnieper north of Kiev and southeast of Cherkasy near Kremenchuk.
dst: 战线沿第聂伯河延伸，从北面的大第聂伯河弯曲部一直到东南面的切尔卡瑟。此时德军已经越过基辅以北以及切尔卡瑟东南靠近克列缅丘格的第聂伯河。

src: The fucking Commies are here too.  They've been wondering why we suddenly took such a huge interest in an insignificant little part of Mexico and they've dispatched their own equivalent of Anomalous Operations to the Yucatan.
dst: 该死的共匪也在这儿。他们一直纳闷我们为什么突然对墨西哥一个毫不起眼的小地方产生了如此浓厚的兴趣，于是也把他们自己的「异常行动」部队派到了尤卡坦。

src: The fuehrer is furious with you, I suggest you hide yourself
dst: 元首对您极为震怒，我建议您躲起来

src: The game is designed to be played with 250% Prestige on both sides and the manual House Rules below:-
dst: 本游戏设定为双方均以 250% 声望值进行，并遵循以下手工房规：

src: The game should be played back to back with the victory hexes held after each game added to the mirrored game to find the total victory hex score accumulated and hence the overall winner of the Grand Battle!!
dst: 双方应连续对局，将每局结束后所占据的胜利格计入镜像对局，以此求出累计的胜利格总分，从而决出大会战的最终胜者！！

src: The garrison of Sevastopol has months of artillery and air bombardments survived, and repulsed already two fascist attacks to capture the port. Our forces are exhausted and not many reinforcements can be send. Supplies are hard to deliver. You must hold out for at least 15 days. Then Stavka will decide what to do next. Good luck, comrade.
dst: 塞瓦斯托波尔的守军已经顶住了数月的炮击和空袭，并击退了法西斯夺取该港口的两次进攻。我们的部队精疲力竭，能派出的增援不多。补给难以送达。你必须坚守至少15天。之后统帅部将决定下一步行动。祝你好运，同志。

src: The gate to Palestine has been opened!
dst: 通往巴勒斯坦的大门已经打开！

src: The general offensive on the Prut River line for the recovery of Bassarabia and Bukovina , named Operation Munchen, was planned for 2 July. The experimented 11th German army and the Romanian 3rd and 4th armies faced the  9th and 18th soviet armies.The task of liberating Kishinev was assigned to Romanian 3rd corps and German 54th corps.
dst: 为收复比萨拉比亚和布科维纳而在普鲁特河一线发起的总攻代号“慕尼黑”行动，原计划于7月2日实施。久经战阵的德国第11集团军与罗马尼亚第3、第4集团军，面对苏军第9、第18集团军。解放基希讷乌的任务交由罗马尼亚第3军与德国第54军执行。

src: The general staff decided that the marines should leave Pantelleria and land in Messina. Your light ships from the northwest must quickly help disembark them.
dst: 总参谋部决定让海军陆战队撤出潘泰莱里亚岛，在墨西拿登陆。你从西北方出发的轻型舰艇必须迅速协助他们登陆。

src: The general staff sends you another fighter and you will also have the support of the Luftwaffe with some fighter and reconnaissance aircraft.
dst: 总参谋部又给您派来一架战斗机，您还将得到德国空军的支援，包括一些战斗机和侦察机。

src: The germans broke through our lines and they will recapture Antwerpen soon. It will be difficult for us to get supllies in the next months. Dismiss!
dst: 德国人突破了我们的防线，他们很快就会重新夺取安特卫普。未来几个月里我们获取补给将会很困难。解散！

src: The germans hadn't fleed, but were reinforced thanks to a carefull railway planning and the 48 hours that the attacking force had wasted, and when the british arrived in sight of the city they were greeted by a devastating fire...
dst: 德国人并未逃走，反而凭借周密的铁路调度，以及进攻部队白白浪费的那48小时，得到了增援。当英国人进入城市视野时，迎接他们的是毁灭性的火力……

src: The germans have launched a huge counteroffensive in the Ardennes. Several Panzer Divisions are attacking our troops in this moment. Their best units are deployed in the north, while their weaker forces are attacking in the south.
dst: 德军在阿登发动了大规模反攻。此刻数个装甲师正在进攻我方部队。他们最精锐的部队部署在北面，而较弱的部队在南面进攻。

src: The goal of the Ufa Conference was to unite the different anti-Bolshevik organisations of eastern Russia and approve a coordinated strategy to defeat the Soviet plague. If they came to an agreement, our efforts on the battlefield wouldn't be in vain.
dst: 乌法会议的目标是统一俄国东部各反布尔什维克组织，并批准一项协同战略，以击败苏维埃瘟疫。如果他们能达成协议，我们在战场上的努力就不会白费。

src: The gods are with you, young chief!
dst: 众神与你同在，年轻的军阀！

src: The good news are that, on one hand, an armistice with the Bolshevik Russians is imminent, and on the other hand, the United States are still a neutral country. Our decision to reject the unrestricted submarine warfare in order to starve out Britain has been a very hard one, but the resuts have been good.
dst: 好消息是，一方面，与布尔什维克俄国人的停战已迫在眉睫；另一方面，美国仍是一个中立国。我们放弃以无限制潜艇战来饿死英国的决定非常艰难，但结果很好。

src: The good news are that, trying to stop me, the Bolsheviks have weakened their left flank. Wrangel could take advantage of that and start an advance up the Volga. Then he could finally link with Kolchak's Siberian forces. So the Soviet's obsession with me could lead them to disaster, as long as I can take Tula.
dst: 好消息是，为了阻止我，布尔什维克削弱了自己的左翼。弗兰格尔可以借此机会沿伏尔加河发起推进。那样他最终就能与高尔察克的西伯利亚部队会师。因此，只要我能拿下图拉，苏维埃对我的执念就可能将他们引向灾难。

src: The good news is that Symon Petliura will be able to establish a Ukrainian government in Kijów. The bad news is that our ambush didn't work and the Red Army is fleeing. It seems that they decided not to defend Kijów and instead retreated to the eastern bank of the Dniepr river.
dst: 好消息是，西蒙·彼得留拉将能在基辅建立乌克兰政府。坏消息是，我们的伏击没有成功，红军正在逃跑。看来他们决定不守基辅，而是撤退到第聂伯河东岸。

src: The good news is that the Germans have pushed themselves to the limit. If you resist this last attack, they'll have to stop once and for all. Then we'll be free to start our own counteroffensive, and they'll have nothing left to defend themselves.
dst: 好消息是，德军已经把自己逼到了极限。如果您顶住这最后一次进攻，他们就不得不彻底停下。然后我们就能自由地发动我们自己的反攻，而他们将毫无还手之力。

src: The good thing is that Russia is falling apart. Who could have foreseen that a revolution would succeed in that once mighty empire? Nobody. Instead, here you have it: the Zar has been dethroned, and the country is run by a bunch of weak liberals. If they were true patriots, or at least if they had some common sense, they would seek to make peace with us, and try to rebuild their country. But they're just a pathetic band of British puppets, so they won't do anything of that.
dst: 好消息是，俄国正在分崩离析。谁能料到，一场革命会在那个曾经强盛的帝国中取得成功？没人能料到。可如今，您瞧：沙皇被废黜，国家由一帮软弱的自由派把持。如果他们是真正的爱国者，或者至少有些常识，就该设法与我们议和，并努力重建国家。但他们不过是一帮可悲的英国傀儡，所以什么都不会做。

src: The good thing is that the Germans are exhausted, too. I'm sure that they had expected us to launch pointless counterattacks once an again, so our casualties would have been even greater. Then we would have lost our reserves, and we'd have had to negotiate a peace treaty. Instead, Pétain adopted a defensive strategy, and now it's the Boches who are running out of reserves, and time. Very soon, Britain will launch supportive attacks against the Germans, just like the Russians are doing since March. The Germans will have to retire many troops from here, and we'll finally win this hellish battle of Verdun.
dst: 好消息是，德国人也疲惫不堪了。我确信他们原本指望我们一次又一次发动无谓的反击，那样我们的伤亡会更惨重。那样我们就会损失预备队，不得不谈判签订和约。相反，贝当采取了防御战略，如今轮到德国佬在耗尽预备队和时间了。很快，英国就会对德国人发起支援性进攻，就像俄国人自三月以来所做的那样。德国人将不得不从这里撤走许多部队，我们终将赢得这场地狱般的凡尔登之战。

src: The government did nothing against us. My father in law had proved that the Qing Army was all that the Empire needed against the foreign aggressions. Militias like the Yihetuan were unnecessary and, even worse, harmful to the Chinese interests. My father in law convinced Empress Dowager Cixi that the Yihetuan had to be forbidden, all of its leaders arrested or executed and its members punished.
dst: 政府没有对我们采取任何行动。我的岳父证明了，清军就是帝国抵御外国侵略所需的一切。像义和团这样的团练不仅多余，而且更有害于中国的利益。我的岳父说服了慈禧太后：必须取缔义和团，逮捕或处决其所有头目，并惩处其成员。

src: The governor of that province, General Peña, is trying to control the situation and prevent the distribution of arms (we have been informed that a new dispatch will take place in Alapan, a suburb of Imus). However, in view of the circumstances, he has been asked to abandon cavite, concentrate his troops and retreat to Manila.
dst: 该省省长佩尼亚将军正努力控制局势并阻止武器分发（我们已获悉，一次新的武器分发将在伊穆斯郊区阿拉潘进行）。然而，鉴于当前形势，他已被要求放弃甲米地，集结部队撤往马尼拉。

src: The harbor of Antwerpen is secured by several ships. You will have command over a part of our fleet. Some bombers will assist you in this fight, too. The allied hold the only airfield in this area. It could be a good idea to build a new airfield at the start of the battle.
dst: 安特卫普港由若干舰船守卫。你将指挥我方舰队的一部分。一些轰炸机也将在战斗中支援你。盟军控制着该地区唯一的机场。在战斗开始时新建一座机场可能是个好主意。

src: The harsh reality of a small nation's existence among giants has reared its ugly head today.  We must now rely on diplomacy to protect our sovereignty, but do we have friends around us?  The Ministry is forced to withdraw our troops from Latvia at this time of turmoil within the nation.  Your command on the Eastern Estonain Front has been given to a more capable general, and this is the end of your campaign.
dst: 小国身处列强夹缝中生存的残酷现实，今天再次露出了狰狞的面目。如今我们必须依靠外交来维护主权，但我们身边可有朋友？陆军部被迫在国家动荡之际从拉脱维亚撤回我们的部队。您在爱沙尼亚东部战线的指挥权已移交给一位更能干的将军，而您的战役就此结束。

src: The harsh weather and fierce Soviet defense stopped you on your approach to Kharkov, but Herr Kommandant, a serious question bogs your superiors: how come other units were much more successful? It seems like you miss the fighting spirit of a true German officer!
dst: 恶劣天气和苏军顽强防御挡住了你通往哈尔科夫之路，但指挥官阁下，你的上级心中萦绕着一个严肃的问题：别的部队为何比你成功得多？看来你缺乏一名真正德国军官的战斗精神！

src: The heart of the enemy ...... Rome!

The heavy fights during the end of the year 1944 and the related high losses forced Czechoslovaks to come into defense. Their numbers increased after conscriptions on liberated ground... but well, fate of Subcarpathian Ruthenia showed that "liberation" is too strong of a word...
dst: 1944年年底的激战和随之而来的惨重损失，迫使捷克斯洛伐克人转入防御。在解放区征兵后，他们的人数增加了……不过，喀尔巴阡鲁塞尼亚的命运表明，“解放”这个词分量太重了……

src: The heroic defence of the Bir Hacheim box by the Free French and the initial shock caused by the 100+ new enemy Grant tanks almost cost us the victory. But in the end we succeeded in beating the enemy armor, dislodging the enemy infantry brigades from their isolated boxes and reaching Tobruk.  Too bad that the 1st South African Division and the two remaining brigades of the 50th Division broke out and were able to retreat into Egypt.
dst: 自由法国对比尔哈凯姆支撑点的英勇防守，以及敌方100多辆新“格兰特”坦克造成的初冲击，几乎让我们输掉这场胜利。但最终我们成功击败了敌军装甲，把敌军步兵旅逐出他们孤立的支撑点，并抵达托布鲁克。可惜南非第1师和第50师剩下的两个旅突围成功，得以撤回埃及。

src: The heroic defence of the Bir Hacheim box by the Free French and the initial shock caused by the 100+ new enemy Grant tanks almost cost us the victory. But in the end we succeeded in beating the enemy armor, dislodging the enemy infantry brigades from their isolated boxes and reaching Tobruk. Too bad that the 1st South African Division and the two remaining brigades of the 50th Division broke out and were able to retreat into Egypt.
dst: 自由法国对比尔哈凯姆支撑点的英勇防守，以及敌方100多辆新“格兰特”坦克造成的初冲击，几乎让我们输掉这场胜利。但最终我们成功击败了敌军装甲，把敌军步兵旅逐出他们孤立的支撑点，并抵达托布鲁克。可惜南非第1师和第50师剩下的两个旅突围成功，得以撤回埃及。

src: The heroic defence of the Bir Hacheim box by the Free French and the shock caused by the 100+ new enemy Grant tanks has cost us the victory. The enemy counter offensive has thrown us hundreds of miles back - once again we had to give up the Cyrenaica.
dst: 自由法国对比尔哈凯姆支撑点的英勇防守，以及敌方100多辆新“格兰特”坦克造成的冲击，让我们输掉了这场胜利。敌人的反攻把我们打退了数百英里——我们不得不再次放弃昔兰尼加。

src: The high command is not pleased with your victory over the Chinese elite troops in Shanghai.  In the future we expect a marked improvement in your command skills.  Anyway, Chiang and his troops won't be a threat for the moment.
dst: 最高统帅部对您在上海击败中国精锐部队的战果并不满意。今后我们期望您的指挥能力有显著提升。无论如何，蒋和他的部队眼下不会构成威胁。

src: The high command is pleased with victory over the chinese elite troops in Shanghai.  Chiang and his troops won't be a threat for the moment.
dst: 最高统帅部对在上海击败中国精锐部队的胜利感到满意。蒋和他的部队眼下不会构成威胁。

src: The highly anticipated summer offensive is about to  commense. Both sides amassed immense numbers of personel, tanks, artillery, and planes for the battle that will decide the fate of the East Front.
dst: 万众期盼的夏季攻势即将开始。双方为这场决定东线命运的大战集结了庞大的人员、坦克、火炮和飞机。

src: The historical path of this campaign has finished. Now you must choose if you want to end it, or if you're ready to go on.
dst: 本战役的历史路线已经结束。现在您必须选择，是就此结束，还是准备继续下去。

src: The honour of Caesar can never admit this!
dst: 凯撒的尊严绝不容许此事！

src: The ice-free port of Narvik and its railroad connection to the ore mines of Kiruna and Gällivare is important for the german economic. You and your men, alongside Dietl's Gebirgsjäger have been selected to attack Narvik as part of Operation Weserübung. Your orders are to take Narvik and the military training facility at Elvegardsmoen.
dst: 纳尔维克的不冻港及其通往基律纳和耶利瓦勒铁矿的铁路，对德国经济至关重要。你和你的部下，与迪特尔的猎兵一道，被选中参加威瑟演习行动、进攻纳尔维克。你的命令是夺取纳尔维克和埃尔沃加兹莫恩的军事训练设施。

src: The idea that Allies could be driven back to the sea proved impossible. On the contrary, the Western Allies got themselves out of the Normandy bocage and by the end of August they reached Seine, while dealing another major blow to the Germans during the Battle of the Falaise Pocket.
dst: 将盟军赶回大海的想法被证明是痴人说梦。相反，西线盟军冲出了诺曼底的灌木篱墙，到八月底已抵达塞纳河，并在法莱斯口袋之战中再次重创德军。

src: The imperialists fooled us. They promised the Romanian troops would withdraw behind the demarcation line declared on March 20 in exchange for our withdrawal from the Fölvidék (Upper Hungary). But the enemies of our communist revolution broke their words, and their Romanian mercenaries are still staying behind the Tisza. It's time to teach these truce-breakers a hard lesson and liberate our proletarian sisters and brothers by force! Lead our troops to victory, Comrade Commisar!
dst: 帝国主义者欺骗了我们。他们许诺，作为我们从费尔维代克（上匈牙利）撤军的交换，罗马尼亚军队将退到3月20日宣布的分界线之后。但我们共产主义革命的敌人背弃了诺言，他们的罗马尼亚雇佣军仍滞留在蒂萨河之后。是时候给这些背信弃义者一个惨痛教训，用武力解放我们的无产阶级兄弟姐妹了！政委同志，率领我们的部队走向胜利吧！

src: The initial Danish strategy was to take positions at the Danevirke, a series of trenches and fortifications that protected Southern Jutland. One day after the war started, the Prussians tried to break through and outflank the eastern flank of the Danevirke at Missunde, where the Schlei was extemely narrow and it would be easy to cross.
dst: 丹麦最初的战略是在丹内维尔克布防，那是一系列保护南日德兰的战壕和工事。开战一天后，普鲁士人试图在米松德突破并包抄丹内维尔克的东翼，那里的施莱河极为狭窄，易于渡河。

src: The initial German attack toward the city of Lodz was highly successful:  the XXV Res and I Cavalry corps located a large gap between our 2nd and 1st armies and poured in to exploit the envelopment.  The 2nd Army has pulled back from its offensive stance in response.  We hope to use the XIX Corps - a triumphant veteran from Galician battles - to push the German right wing back, while we muster the 2nd Army's forces to repel the German envelopment attempt.  The 1st Army has dispatched an ad-hoc force (the Lovitch Group) to our aid from the North-East.
dst: 德军向罗兹城发动的初次进攻极为成功：第25预备军和第1骑兵军在我第2、第1集团军之间发现了一个巨大的缺口，涌入其中扩大包围。第2集团军随之放弃了进攻姿态，向后撤退。我们希望以第19军——一支来自加利西亚战役的凯旋老兵——把德军右翼顶回去，同时集结第2集团军的兵力击退德军的合围企图。第1集团军已从东北方向派出一个临时编队（洛维奇集群）前来增援。

src: The initial attack against the Rasova- Kobadin-Tuzla line failed. It wasn't until October 25th when the Central Powers could finally overcome the Russo-Romanian resistance and take Köstence (Constanta). However, in general, the Romanian campaign was a success. The menace against Hungary was quickly thwarted, and most of Romania was quickly occupied by Germany and her allies. Bucharest fell on December 6th, and the surviving Romanian units had to flee to Iasi, where they managed to reorganize themselves and continue the fighting. But eventually, with the final defeat and surrender of Russia in 1918, Romania had to ask for peace.
dst: 对拉索瓦-科巴丁-图兹拉防线的首次进攻失败了。直到10月25日，同盟国才最终突破俄罗联军（俄军与罗马尼亚军）的抵抗，攻占了克斯滕塞（康斯坦察）。不过，总体而言，罗马尼亚战役是成功的。对匈牙利的威胁很快被解除，罗马尼亚大部分地区很快被德国及其盟友占领。布加勒斯特于12月6日陷落，幸存的罗马尼亚部队不得不逃往雅西，在那里重新整编并继续战斗。但最终，随着俄国在1918年的彻底失败与投降，罗马尼亚不得不求和。

src: The initial landings that took Oslo by storm took the Allies completely by surprise!
dst: 以雷霆之势夺取奥斯陆的初步登陆，让盟军完全措手不及！

src: The initial moves in WW1 were dictated by plans drawn up in the years before the war. The plan with the most impact on the war in Western Europe was Germany's Schlieffen plan.
dst: 第一次世界大战初期的行动，是由战前数年制定的计划所决定的。对西欧战局影响最大的计划，是德国的施利芬计划。

src: The initial plan has foreseen some diversionary attacks to cover the landing operation at Suvla Bay: one by the ANZAC troops, breaking out of their bridgehead towards the heights of Chunuk Bair, and the other one by the Brits and us here at Cape Helles. But none of us French officers is willing to see our men conduct another suicidal frontal attack on Krithia. After a heated discussion, the British generals have finally agreed to redeploy our troops at Anzac Cove, so we will support the attack of the Australian and New Zealand Army Corps there, which has much better prospects of success.
dst: 最初的计划曾设想以一些牵制性进攻来掩护苏夫拉湾的登陆行动：一路由澳新军团部队从他们的桥头堡突破，冲向丘努克拜尔高地；另一路由英国人和我们在赫勒斯角实施。但我们法国军官没有一个人愿意看到自己的士兵对克里提亚发起又一次自杀式的正面进攻。经过激烈的讨论，英国将军们最终同意把我们的部队重新部署到澳新军团湾，这样我们就能支援那里的澳大利亚和新西兰军团进攻，其成功的前景要好得多。

src: The insurgency at Marash - brilliant victory
The insurgency at Marash - tactical victory
The invasion of Malta failed. The success of the upcoming offensive against Eight Army's positions at El Alamein is now uncertain.
dst: 马耳他入侵失败。即将对第8集团军在阿拉曼阵地发动的攻势能否成功，如今已成疑问。

src: The invasion of Poland is in its fourth day. While German panzer divisions are spearheading toward Warsaw, the German 8th Army has reached the river Warta. The Poles have set up a strong defensive Line and await the German assault.
dst: 入侵波兰已进入第四天。当德国装甲师正作为矛头直指华沙之际，德军第8集团军已抵达瓦尔塔河。波军已筑起一道坚固防线，等待德军进攻。

src: The invasion of Poland marked the start of World War II in Europe.
dst: 入侵波兰标志着第二次世界大战在欧洲爆发。

src: The invasion of Russia will be the largest military operation in history. Your army will spearhead Army Group Center's initial thrust into Russia. You must seize all of your objectives, including the main target of Smolensk, by August 6th. An earlier completion of your mission could allow us to begin the attack on Moscow before the onset of the autumn rain and the winter slows our advance. Rapid and decisive success will be the key to the entire War in the East.
dst: 对俄国的入侵将是有史以来规模最大的军事行动。你的集团军将作为中央集团军群首轮突入俄国的先锋。你必须在 8月6日前夺取全部目标，其中包括主要目标斯摩棱斯克。若能提前完成任务，我们就有可能在秋季降雨与冬季迟滞我军推进之前发起对莫斯科的进攻。迅速而决定性的胜利将是整个东线战事的关键。

src: The island of Okinawa is the key to our campaign in the Japanese home islands.  We need the airfields here to launch air raids against Tokyo and other major cities.  You are familiar with amphibious assault from your experiences at Savannah, but also skilled with combined arms warfare, so you have been prioritized above the officers of the Kriegsmarine for this operation.
dst: 冲绳岛是我们征战日本本土诸岛的关键。我们需要这里的机场来对东京及其他主要城市发动空袭。你从萨凡纳的经历中熟悉了两栖突击，又精通联合兵种作战，因此本次行动中你被排在海军军官之前优先任用。

src: The isthmus of Parpach bars our passage into eastern Crimea. It is very heavily deffended. You have to breakthrough before the enemy can concentrate more troops!
dst: 帕尔帕奇地峡阻断了我军进入克里米亚东部的通路，且防守极为严密。您必须在敌人集结更多兵力之前实现突破！

src: The job's done, I hope your men recover quickly.
dst: 任务完成了，希望你的部队尽快恢复。

src: The journey hasn't been easy. We've fought and bled together, and we've lost many good friends. But with God's help we've overcome all adversity. Every challenge has become a victory, and every victory has made us stronger. All who have tried to stop us have been crushed.
dst: 这段旅程并不轻松。我们一起战斗、一起流血，失去了许多好朋友。但在上帝的帮助下，我们克服了一切逆境。每一次挑战都化为胜利，而每一场胜利都使我们更加强大。所有试图阻挡我们的人都被粉碎了。

src: The journey to Mekele lasted seventeen months. You wouldn't believe how many perils my men and I had to overcome, how many difficulties we had to endure, or how many times I was about to die, but we finally arrived with the cargo. I was amazed when, just one day after my arrival, Emperor Yohannes IV ordered me to present myself before Him.
dst: 前往默克莱的旅程持续了十七个月。您不会相信我和我的手下克服了多少艰险，忍受了多少磨难，又有多少次我几乎丧命，但我们终于带着货物抵达了。让我惊讶的是，就在抵达的第二天，约翰内斯四世皇帝就下令让我前去觐见他。

src: The land north of the Alps is ours for a long time.
dst: 阿尔卑斯山以北的土地将在很长时间内归我们所有。

src: The landing was a catastrophe. The Germans were able to throw us back into the sea. Months of planing are wasted and the Germans now can concentrate on our soviet friends. You are not needed anymore for our future operations in Europe. You will become head of coastal defence in Alaska.
dst: 这次登陆是一场灾难。德军把我们赶回了海里。数月的筹划付诸东流，德军现在可以集中兵力对付我们的苏联盟友了。我们未来在欧洲的行动不再需要您。您将去阿拉斯加担任海岸防御负责人。

src: The landings at the Gallipoli peninsula, one of the first ever major amphibious operations in modern warfare, took place on the 25 April 1915. After some initial success, the British advance crucially lost momentum, and the Australian and New Zealand Army Corps (ANZAC) landing on the western coast met with stiff Turkish resistance lead  by Colonel Mustapha Kemal (Ataturk) and almost got thrown back into the sea.
dst: 加里波利半岛的登陆发生在1915年4月25日，这是现代战争史上最早的大规模两栖作战之一。在取得初步胜利之后，英军的推进却关键性地失去了势头，而在西海岸登陆的澳大利亚和新西兰军团（澳新军团）则遭遇了穆斯塔法·凯末尔（阿塔图尔克）上校率领的土耳其军顽强抵抗，几乎被赶回大海。

src: The landings will carried out without previous aerial bombardment in order to achieve surprise. This time your forces will start without an airport. You have to build or capture one. Two airborne regiments are held back as reserve and might arrive later if needed.
dst: 登陆将在没有事先空中轰炸的情况下进行，以达成突然性。这一次你的部队将在没有机场的情况下开局。你必须建造或夺取一座机场。两个空降团作为预备队被留下，如有需要可能稍后抵达。

src: The largest industrial area in the world is now safely in our hands. But the Americans seem to have inherited the obstinacy of the British. They still refuse to surrender!! Only one way to tell them who's who, I'm afraid.
dst: 世界上最大的工业区如今已安然在我手中。但美国人似乎继承了英国人的顽固，仍拒绝投降！！恐怕只有一种办法让他们认清谁说了算。

src: The last French troops left Hanoi in July. For the first time in centuries an Asian army had been able to win a war against an European country, and that had an outstanding effect on the rebirth of China's national pride.
dst: 最后一批法军于7月离开河内。几个世纪以来，一支亚洲军队第一次能够战胜一个欧洲国家，这对中国民族自豪感的重生产生了深远的影响。

src: The last Italian attacks at the Isonzo nearly broke the Austrian lines. They barely managed to hold the front, but nobody knows if they’ll be able to resist for much longer. The High Command decided that our allies needed German reinforcements, and we are the ones who were trained specifically for fighting in the Alps, so it was logical that they chose us.
dst: 意大利人最近在伊松佐河的进攻几乎冲垮了奥军防线。他们勉强守住了战线，但没人知道他们还能撑多久。最高统帅部认定我们的盟友需要德军增援，而我们正是受过专门山地作战训练的人，所以他们选择我们也就顺理成章了。

src: The last Russian reserves have succeeded in recapturing Moscow. Gather your forces once more and throw them out again.
dst: 俄国人最后的预备队成功夺回了莫斯科。再次集结你的部队，把他们再赶出去。

src: The last communist stronghold is the area around Barcelona. Your men, alongsid Spanish and German forces, are part of our war-winning offensive. Break through the enemy defensive systems and grind your way along the coast to the east.
dst: 最后一个共产主义据点就是巴塞罗那周边地区。你的部下将与西班牙和德国部队一道，参与我们这场决胜的攻势。突破敌军防御体系，沿着海岸一路向东推进。

src: The last conflict, in which the heart of Germany is at stake.
dst: 最后一场冲突，德国的心脏已悬于一线。

src: The last days of the war found Romanian forces (1st and 4th Armies) active in offensives in Czechoslovakia.
dst: 战争最后数日，罗马尼亚军队（第1、第4集团军）在捷克斯洛伐克境内活跃于攻势之中。

src: The last days, we have not encountered heavy resistance. Most of the Bulgarian Army is deployed in occupied territories in Greece and Yugoslavia. With the sign of our invasion, fascist leaders have ordered some loyal units to come back and defend the Bulgarian capital of Sofia against a Red invasion. The Red Army must help its comrades in Sofia who are supressed by fascists and take control of the city and its vicinity. Bulgarian proletarian partisans might help you during your advance. There are no signs of German fascists in the area, but watch our for some loyal crack Bulgarian fascists. Good luck, comrade.
dst: 最近几天，我们没有遇到激烈的抵抗。保加利亚军队的大部分部署在被占领的希腊和南斯拉夫。随着我们入侵，法西斯头目已命令一些忠诚的部队回防，保卫保加利亚首都索菲亚，抵御红军入侵。红军必须援助索菲亚那些受法西斯压迫的同志，夺取该城及其周边。保加利亚无产阶级游击队员可能会在你的推进中提供帮助。这一带没有德国法西斯的迹象，但要当心一些忠诚的保加利亚法西斯精锐。祝你好运，同志。

src: The last embers of society are still burning...
dst: 社会最后的余烬仍在燃烧……

src: The last few days, the seven division strong Belgian Army kept its positions around the Antwerp fortresses. We have 5.Reserve Division, the newly formed Marine Division, 37.Landwehr Brigade and 1.Reserve Ersatz Brigade keeping an eye on them.
dst: 过去几天，拥有七个师之众的比利时陆军一直驻守在安特卫普各要塞周围。我们派第5预备师、新组建的海军陆战师、第37国土防卫旅和第1预备补充旅盯着他们。

src: The last few weeks more and more supplies have been diverted to Egypt, allowing our XX Corps to launch an offensive to capture Port Said at one end of the Suez Canal and allowing DAK to attack Suez at the other end. X and XXI Corps are moving South into the Sudan to recapture our lost colonies Ethiopia, Somaliland and Eritrea.
dst: 近几周来，越来越多的补给被转运到埃及，使我们第20军得以发起攻势，夺取苏伊士运河一端的塞得港，并让非洲军攻击另一端的苏伊士。第10军和第21军正南下进入苏丹，夺回我们失去的殖民地埃塞俄比亚、索马里兰和厄立特里亚。

src: The last holdouts of the Philippines - Baler
dst: 菲律宾最后的据点 - 巴莱尔

src: The last months the front has been quiet at the Greek border, but just as we feared the political situation hasn't improved at all. We should have taken our opportunity to conquer Solun when we had it. Well, never mind. Our intelligenge reports confirm that here, at the Doiran Lake, three veteran French and British divisions are preparing an offensive to break our first line of defence and invade Macedonia. You will have to hold our positions, repel the enemy troops and, finally, make a counterattack.
dst: 最近几个月，希腊边境的战线一直平静，但正如我们所担心的，政治局势丝毫没有好转。我们本应在有机会时拿下索伦的。唉，算了。我们的情报报告证实，在这里、在多伊兰湖，三个久经沙场的法国师和英国师正准备发动进攻，以突破我们的第一道防线并入侵马其顿。您必须守住我们的阵地，击退敌军，最后发起反攻。

src: The last serious troops are defeated. Now the way to Antwerpen is free. A great performance from you.
dst: 最后一批有实力的部队已被击败。现在通往安特卫普的道路已经畅通。你表现得非常出色。

src: The last stand of the People's Army was one of the most impressive feats of the war. The civilians, our equipment and our soldiers retreated to Siberia, leaving behind a badly shattered Red Army. They would quickly recover, but for the moment we were safe.
dst: 人民军的最后一战是这场战争中最令人钦佩的壮举之一。平民、我们的装备和士兵撤退到西伯利亚，留下了一支遭受重创的红军。红军很快就会恢复元气，但眼下我们是安全的。

src: The last stand will be Beijing, this won't be easy, as you know, the best PLA units are deployed there.  The price maybe high, but it deserves a try.  You can become the new premier of the People's Republic of China!
dst: 最后的决战将是北京，这不会容易，如你所知，解放军最好的部队都部署在那里。代价也许很高，但值得一试。你可以成为中华人民共和国的新总理！

src: The lead echelon is accompanied by waves of mechanized infantry and heavy self-propelled howitzers, while Soviet bombers completely dominate the skies over the battlefield.
dst: 先头梯队伴随着一波波机械化步兵和重型自行榴弹炮，而苏军轰炸机则完全主宰了战场上空。

src: The left column's journey through the tangled ravines was doomed to failure and, having become lost and confused, it never got close to the objective of Hill 971. One battalion of Gurkhas took Hill Q on August 9th, but were then caught in friendly fire. Having suffered heavy casualties and with no reinforcements, the Gurkhas were pushed back off the hill shortly afterwards.
dst: 左纵队的行军穿过纠缠交错的沟壑，注定要失败，他们迷失了方向、陷入混乱，从未接近目标971高地。一个廓尔喀营于8月9日夺取了Q高地，但随后遭到己方火力误击。在伤亡惨重又无增援的情况下，廓尔喀人不久就被逼下了高地。

src: The left will be my 163rd Infantry Division, Your forces will take the right.
dst: 左翼将是我的第163步兵师，你的部队负责右翼。

src: The level of incompetence that ou achieved is unthinkable. You will be relieved of the battalion command immediately. Dismissed!
dst: 你所表现出的无能程度令人难以置信。你将立即被解除营指挥权。解职！

src: The liberation of Bialorus was the last Polish operation against the Reds in 1919. The second half of the year was all quiet. Meanwhile, the new Soviet Russians of Lenin fought against the White Russians of Denikin. But General Denikin not only refused to recognize the Polish state, but he also asked France (former Russian ally and current Polish ally) to stop supporting the Poles as well! Because of this, Polish authorities decided not to support Denikin’s forces and stopped all aggressive operations against the Red Army. This allowed the Bolsheviks to concentrate all available forces against the Whites and they were able to repel them.
dst: 解放白俄罗斯是1919年波兰对红军发动的最后一次行动。下半年一切平静。与此同时，列宁领导的新苏维埃俄国与邓尼金的白军作战。但邓尼金将军不仅拒绝承认波兰国家，还要求法国（前俄国的盟友、现波兰的盟友）也停止支持波兰人！正因如此，波兰当局决定不支持邓尼金的部队，并停止了对红军的一切进攻行动。这使得布尔什维克得以集中所有可用力量对付白军，并成功击退了他们。

src: The liberation of Tehran is an operation with foreign policy relevance for Germany - a success would strengthen the young alliance of our nations. And this alliance is important for Germany, because of the oil reserves and the strategic position of Iran. The operation is more or less thoroughly prepared despite the short time. An airborne operation east of Tehran should provide distraction and bind enemy forces, while your troops advance directly to Tehran and finding their way as liberators into the Iranian capital. The General Staff expect nothing more than a success!
dst: 解放德黑兰是一次对德国具有外交政策意义的行动——成功将巩固我们两国年轻而重要的同盟。由于伊朗的石油储量和战略地位，这个问题对德国至关重要。尽管时间仓促，这次行动仍准备得相当充分。德黑兰以东的一次空降行动应能分散并牵制敌军，而你的部队则直接向德黑兰推进，以解放者的姿态进入伊朗首都。总参谋部期望的只有成功！

src: The lightning advances of December and early January provide us with the opportunity to easily retake Seoul for the North Koreans.  However, the situation is becoming dangerous.  Our supply lines to China are long and are constantly being bombed and strafed by the UN air force.  Because of this they are preparing a counterattack to again liberate Seoul.  Our Korean spies have told us that a great number of troops are concentrating South of Suwon, including modern tanks and heavy artillery.
dst: 12月和1月初的闪电推进，为我们提供了轻松为朝鲜人夺回汉城的机会。然而，局势正变得危险。我们通往中国的补给线漫长，并不断遭到联合国空军的轰炸和扫射。因此，他们正准备发动一次反击，以再次解放汉城。我们的朝鲜间谍告诉我们，大量部队正在水原以南集结，包括现代化的坦克和重炮。

src: The local National Guard forces are holding northern Brooklyn, but they won't be able to maintain their positions for long.  Take your force, secure Staten Island, then cross the bay and push to liberate the city's defenders.
dst: 当地国民警卫队正坚守布鲁克林北部，但他们撑不了多久。率你的部队夺取斯塔滕岛，然后渡过海湾，推进去解救该城的守军。

src: The local militiamen hold their positions. There's also a regiment of Italian paratroopers undergoing the mountain training and they are surrounded in their garrison. Our combined airforce is on par with the enemy.
dst: 当地民兵坚守阵地。另有一个正在山地训练的意大利伞兵团，被困于其驻地之中。我们的联合空军与敌军旗鼓相当。

src: The location for our summer offensive is clear: the great salient around Kursk. Success here will shorten the front by 500km and create a reserve that can be used in the West. Model's 9th Army will strike from the North and Hoth's 4th Pz Army will attack from the South. The SS Corps is part of Hoth's Army.
dst: 我们夏季攻势的地点很明确：库尔斯克周围的大突出部。在此取胜将使战线缩短500公里，并腾出一支可用于西线的预备队。莫德尔的第9集团军将从北面出击，霍特的第4装甲集团军将从南面进攻。党卫军装甲军隶属霍特的集团军。

src: The longer you'll stay, the better for you and your men. Because - and listen carefully! - the evacuation goes in a snail's pace and there are not enough ships... Understand?
dst: 你待得越久，对你和你的士兵越有利。因为——仔细听着！——撤离慢得像蜗牛，而且没有足够的船只……明白吗？

src: The loss at Wake,then Pearl of the Pacific and West Coast Fleets.Now a chance to avenge all of that.The East Coast fleet and the new 'Wildcat Fighters on the carriers had the American Naval Brass buzzing.Finally the 'Zero would meet it's match.Midway was the Target.Lost to Japan shortly after Wake it had been a valuable asset in Japan's Pacific conquests.Take Midway and the Offensive's by the Japs will End,they are strung out all over the Pacific anyway with 'Aku's Fleet being the most Powerful stationed around Midway. Destroy His Fleet,take Midway and the Dominoes will fall one by one.Base B-17's and B-24's there and Japan would be Stupid to risk their Imperial Navy under the 'Heavies.Then an Island hopping campaign will take America all the way to Japan's Doorstep though it may take til '46.American Flyers now had the Fighter to dominate the Japs not just go toe-to-toe. Yes it was a Gamble sending the East Coast Fleet but in a few Months America would have 2O new Battleships put to sea.The attrition factor would kick in soon.So a Sub on recon.The Imperial Navy was were it was suppose to be.A few of the SS Frau's there,a surprise but what the Hell let them get a taste or Real Power,Amercan Air Power.The information back to Intelligence and then forwarded to Command.The attack would commence as planned and the Frau's were probably just Observers.This Victory would turn the 'Tide'.
dst: 威克岛的失利，之后是太平洋舰队和西海岸舰队的覆灭。如今有了雪耻的机会。东海岸舰队和航母上新装备的“野猫”战斗机让美国海军高层兴奋不已。“零”式终于要遇上对手了。目标是中途岛。它在威克岛之后不久落入日本手中，此后一直是日本太平洋征服中宝贵的一环。拿下中途岛，日本人的攻势就会终结——他们本来就在太平洋上拉得过长，而阿库的舰队是最强的一支，正驻于中途岛周边。摧毁他的舰队、拿下中途岛，多米诺骨牌就会一张张倒下。在那里部署 B-17 和 B-24 基地，日本就绝不敢拿他们的帝国海军去冒险对抗这些“重型机”。随后一场跳岛战役将把美国一路推进到日本的家门口，虽然也许要到46年。美国飞行员如今有了能在对日作战中占据优势、而不只是硬碰硬的战斗机。是的，把东海岸舰队派出去是一场赌博，但再过几个月，美国就会有20艘新战列舰下水。消耗的因素很快就会起作用。于是一艘潜艇前去侦察。帝国海军果然在预想的位置。那里有几名党卫军“女士”——有点意外，但管他呢，让她们尝尝真正力量的滋味：美国空中力量。情报传回，再转给司令部。进攻将按计划开始，那些“女士”大概只是观察员。这场胜利将扭转“局势”。

src: The loss of Hamasien would have been a terrible blow for Yohannes, whose capital was located just a few miles away from that territory, so he quickly mobilized an army in order to fight against the Egyptian invaders. Yohannes and the priests of the Orthodox Tewahedo Church convinced the hastily recruited levies of the importance of defeating the Muslim army that wanted to conquer Ethiopia, so although just one third of our warriors had rifles, the morale was extremely good. After all, it was a war between Christianity and the heathens. As long as our warriors had faith, God would help us.
dst: 失去哈马西恩对约翰内斯来说将是一个可怕的打击，因为他的首都距离那片领土只有几英里，所以他迅速动员了一支军队，准备迎击埃及入侵者。约翰内斯和特瓦赫多正教会的教士们让这些仓促征召的征募兵认识到击败企图征服埃塞俄比亚的穆斯林军队是何等重要，因此尽管我们的战士只有三分之一拥有步枪，士气却极为高昂。毕竟，这是一场基督教与异教徒之间的战争。只要我们的战士心怀信仰，上帝就会帮助我们。

src: The loss of Kazan had generated into enormous bolshevik activity to stop the Czech Legion from capturing more cities and advance across the Volga River towards Moscow. Leon Trotski himself would conduct the preparations.
dst: 喀山的失守引发了布尔什维克的大规模行动，以阻止捷克军团攻占更多城市并渡过伏尔加河向莫斯科推进。列昂·托洛茨基本人将亲自指挥准备工作。

src: The loss of Stalingrad will be a hugh blow to Soviet moral!
dst: 斯大林格勒的失守将是对苏联士气的沉重打击！

src: The loss of their Sixth Army has been too much for the Reds who, under British pressure, have offered us an armistice. They say that they'll retire from Crimea and Taman, where the United Kingdom will support the creation of a Free Crimean State under our control.
dst: 第6集团军的覆灭对红军打击太大，在英国压力下，他们向我们提出停战。他们说将从克里米亚和塔曼撤军，英国将支持在我们控制下建立一个自由克里米亚国。

src: The losses of the Hungarian 2nd Army were enormous. Of an initial force of 200,000 Hungarian soldiers about 140,000 were dead or taken prisoners of war. Only about 60,000 men (half of them wounded) returned to Hungary in May 1943. 80-100% of heavy equipment was lost.
dst: 匈牙利第2集团军的损失极为惨重。最初投入的20万名匈牙利士兵中，约14万人阵亡或被俘。1943年5月返回匈牙利的仅约6万人，其中半数为伤员。重型装备损失达八成至十成。

src: The losses on both sides were quite high. The Germans lost approximately 800 men (killed, missing, captured or seriously wounded), and between 100 and 160 AFVs (at least 50 of them tanks). The Polish brigade lost 200 killed and 300 wounded, as well as 300 horses and several guns. The 2nd Mounted Artillery Battalion lost almost 30% of men, the 21st Regiment - almost 25%; the 12th Uhlans Regiment that was used as a reserve lost 5 officers and 216 men, both killed and wounded. [wikipedia]
dst: 双方伤亡都相当惨重。德军损失约800人（阵亡、失踪、被俘或重伤），以及100至160辆装甲车辆（其中至少50辆坦克）。波兰旅损失200人阵亡、300人负伤，另有300匹马和若干门火炮。第2骑兵炮兵营损失了近30%的人员，第21团损失近25%；被用作预备队的第12枪骑兵团损失了5名军官和216名士兵，包括阵亡和负伤者。[维基百科]

src: The main French attack is taking place in Lothringen, where in fact they've managed to penetrate deep into our lines. If we don't stop them even Metz and Strassburg could be in danger. Gather your troops, counterattack and drive the French out of Germany!
dst: 法军的主攻正发生在洛林，事实上他们已深入突破我军防线。如果不挡住他们，连梅斯和斯特拉斯堡都可能陷入危险。集结您的部队，发起反攻，把法军赶出德国！

src: The main consequence of the battle was the improvement of the morale. The strategic gains on the Marne marked the end of a string of German victories and the beginning of a series of Allied victories that, in three months, would  bring the German Army to its knees.
dst: 这场战役的主要后果是士气的提升。马恩河上的战略收获标志着德军一连串胜利的终结和协约国一系列胜利的开端，这些胜利将在三个月内使德军屈膝。

src: The main difficulty for the Prussians would be the Danish ironclad Rolf Krake. She was at the Augustenborg Fjord and, if she spotted the Prussian boats, disembarking on the northern shore of the island could become an impossible task.
dst: 对普鲁士人而言，最大的难题将是丹麦铁甲舰「罗尔夫·克拉凯」号。她正停泊在奥古斯滕堡峡湾，倘若她发现了普鲁士的船只，那么在该岛北岸登陆就可能成为一项不可能完成的任务。

src: The main effort of the French Nivelle offensive is concentrated along the ridge known as Chemin de Dammes north of the Aisne - to be performed by the French 6th (Mangin) and 10th (Ouchene) Armies.  The Russian brigades, part of the French 5th (Mazel) Army, are tasked with a secondary objective of striking eastward from their positions at the heavily fortified Fort de Brimont.  The neighboring French 14th and 41st divisions are to strike at the towns of Berry-au-Bac and Beremicourt respectively.
dst: 法军尼韦勒攻势的主力集中在埃纳河以北名为贵妇小径的山脊沿线——由法军第6集团军（芒然）和第10集团军（乌谢纳）执行。作为法军第5集团军（马泽尔）一部分的俄军各旅，承担次要目标，即从他们在重兵设防的布里蒙堡的阵地向东突击。相邻的法军第14和第41师将分别攻击贝里奥巴克和贝雷米库尔两镇。

src: The main objective for the Finnish IV Corps was the city of Viipuri. On 24 August the Finnish 8th Division crossed Viipuri Bay, landed on the Lokhaniemi peninsula and cut the coastal route from Viipuri. The 12th Division cut the important railway line between Viipuri and Leningrad on 25 August and the main road connection between both cities on 27 August. The Finnish trapped the remaining Soviet forces in a pocket (Finnish: Motti) when the 8th and 12th Divisions met on 30 August in the Porlampi (Now: Sveklovichnoye) area south of Viipuri. The Battle of Porlampi was a Finnish victory and effectively ended the reconquest of Karelia.
dst: 芬兰第IV军的主要目标是维普里城。8月24日，芬兰第8师渡过维普里湾，在洛克哈涅米半岛登陆，切断了从维普里出发的沿海路线。8月25日，第12师切断了维普里与列宁格勒之间的重要铁路线，并于8月27日切断了两城之间的主要公路连接。8月30日，当第8师与第12师在维普里以南的波尔兰皮（今：斯韦克洛维奇诺耶）地区会合时，芬兰人将残余苏军围困在一个包围圈中（芬兰语：Motti）。波尔兰皮之战是芬兰人的一场胜利，实际上结束了卡累利阿的收复战。

src: The main objective is to take Barcelona.  It is the last important Republican city as their government is located there.  By taking Barcelona we may be able to put an end to this bloody war.  The Republicans are trying to build fortified lines in Catalonia so we are going to need to use the German tactics of troop concentration, close air and artillery support to quickly overwhelm them.
dst: 主要目标是夺取巴塞罗那。那是共和派最后一座重要城市，因为他们的政府就设在那里。夺取巴塞罗那，我们或许就能结束这场血腥的战争。共和派正试图在加泰罗尼亚修筑筑垒防线，因此我们需要运用德军的战术——集中兵力、近距空中和炮兵支援——迅速压垮他们。

src: The main part of the American 7 th army is destroyed, and already messages are coming in that they are evacuating their last bridgehead near Licata. In a few weeks the whole strategic situation in the Mediterrenean has changed beyond recognition. We will now change Sicily into an inassailabe fortress.
dst: 美军第七集团军主力已被歼灭，而且已有消息传来，他们正在撤离利卡塔附近的最后一个桥头堡。数周之内，地中海的整体战略态势将变得面目全非。我们现在要把西西里变成一座无法攻克的堡垒。

src: The main plan hasn't been accomplished, the rebel counterattack defeated our attack on Zaragoza. However, our propaganda services will try to exploit this minor victory at Belchite...
dst: 主要计划未能实现，叛军的反攻击败了我们对萨拉戈萨的进攻。不过，我们的宣传部门会设法利用贝尔奇特的这次小胜……

src: The majority of the war production for the west allied comes from the Ruhr area. If we will be able to capture the Ruhr area it will be more difficult for the allied to get supplies. Take the Ruhr area, Düsseldorf and build a bridgehead over the Rhine.
dst: 西方盟军的大部分军工生产都来自鲁尔区。如果我们能夺取鲁尔区，盟军获得补给就会更加困难。夺取鲁尔区、杜塞尔多夫，并在莱茵河上建立桥头堡。

src: The manoeuvres have been a relative success. You have proved the value of motorized forces but improvements are needed.
dst: 演习取得了相对成功。你证明了摩托化部队的价值，但仍有需要改进之处。

src: The manpower and ammunition shortage has become a problem of critical proportions:  none of the divisions on NW Front are at full strength of 12,000 rifles.  The 2nd Finnish counts a mere 6571, and the 104th 2582 - the size of just one pre-war regiment!
dst: 人力和弹药的短缺已成为事关全局的严重问题：西北方面军没有一个师达到12000支步枪的满编。芬兰第2师仅剩6571人，第104师仅2582人——仅相当于战前一个团的规模！

src: The map has been built according to the facts at that time and the trained strategist knows immediately: yes here it must have happened ... this place is perfect for an ambush...
dst: 地图是依照当时的实况构建的，训练有素的战略家一眼就能看出：没错，这里一定发生过什么 ... 这地方最适合设伏...

src: The map of Spain over the desk of your command post...
dst: 西班牙地图摆在您指挥所的桌上……

src: The message from Frau General Martha Frankopplan's HQ outside Moscow.Forces of the SS were ready to move. Recon had showed the Soviets had hardly no Armor and the Big Guns had been silenced. Soviet troops were still there in mass of course but all had been in former Divisions that had been rolled over by the SS before so it was thought they would most likely take off running East when the first Frau's rolled into town with the Panzers.The 'Boss' Joseph Stalin, his wherabouts by Double Agents in the Kremlin reported seemed He had vanished 2 weeks ago so the Soviets were being directed by No-one.A 'fitting End to a Country of Sub-humans' the War Cabinet had responded now that the End of the War in the East was near it's conclusion as far as organized resistance.So according to Ilse the Frauland was on the verge of winning the War leaving only Amerika to deal with and Japan had nearly been too much alone so with SS help it would fold like a deck of Cards.So Moscow first, then the Eradication could start in earnest of those deemed 'Sub-Human' in the Ukraine,Western Europe,London and Other Countries the SS had in their hand.Millions would soon cease to be and so would Mother Russia, it would be part of 'Germania'.
dst: 这条讯息发自莫斯科城外的玛莎·弗兰科普兰女将军司令部。党卫军部队已准备好行动。侦察显示苏联人几乎没有装甲，重炮也已被打哑。苏军当然还有大量部队驻守，但他们全都在此前已被党卫军碾过的旧建制里，因此人们认为，当第一批“女士”随装甲部队开进城时，他们多半会向东逃散。据克里姆林宫里的双面间谍报告，“老板”约瑟夫·斯大林约两周前似乎已经消失，苏军如今无人指挥。战时内阁回应说，这是“一个次等民族国家恰如其分的结局”——东线战争就组织性抵抗而言已接近落幕。于是按伊尔泽的说法，“女性之国”已濒临赢得战争，只剩下美国要处理；而日本单靠自己几乎已经撑不住，有党卫军相助，它会像纸牌搭的房子一样垮掉。所以先取莫斯科，随后便可对乌克兰、西欧、伦敦以及党卫军所掌握的其他国家中那些被认定为“次等人类”的人，正式展开清剿。数百万人即将不复存在，而“母亲俄罗斯”也将如此——它将成为“日耳曼尼亚”的一部分。

src: The message from the Boss.Zhukov knew what 'else' meant.It meant He would get to watch His family and kins tortured before being killed then He would be tortured,be crippled and get to waste away thinking of how He had failed the 'Boss' and Mother Russia in the Cold of a Siberian Guloug.So the Soviet Armor loaded up the area around Tosno on Zhukov's orders with Stalin's blessing.Back in Berlin and the HQ at Leningrad the reports from Air Recon units dashing behind the Lines showed finally the Soviet Armor north of Belegorod was not in Mass but pockets of small Groups.SS Tank crews,the Air Korps and the Heavy Kondor Gruppens had destroyed so much that it was no longer in the area in the Fantastic numbers before and New Soviet Armor was moved to other Fronts for the SS Leningrad Front was proving too much for the Ivan tankers.So one last major Soviet Armor Group to face and with Tosno captured the Leningrad Front would be on the move South towards Moscow.In Berlin the Fuhress and War Cabinet could finally breathe a little easier.The Frau's on the Front lines of course still had many a Day ahead to gasp for Air.
dst: 这是“老板”传来的讯息。朱可夫知道“否则”意味着什么。那意味着他将眼睁睁看着家人和亲属被折磨致死，然后他自己受尽折磨、落下残疾，在西伯利亚劳改营的严寒中慢慢枯萎，想着自己如何辜负了“老板”和“母亲俄罗斯”。于是在朱可夫的命令和斯大林的恩准下，苏军装甲在托斯诺一带集结。回到柏林和列宁格勒司令部，那些飞驰于敌后的空中侦察单位发来的报告终于显示：别尔哥罗德以北的苏军装甲已不是成建制的大编队，而是零散的小股。党卫军坦克车组、航空军和重型“秃鹰”机群摧毁实在太多，那里再没有从前那种惊人的数量了；新的苏军装甲被调往其他战线，因为对伊万的坦克手来说，党卫军的列宁格勒战线太棘手。于是只剩最后一个苏军装甲大编队；一旦拿下托斯诺，列宁格勒战线就将南下直取莫斯科。在柏林，女元首和战时内阁终于能稍稍松口气。当然，前线的“女士”们还有很多天要喘不上气。

src: The message sent to Berlin.A week of rain.A week of 'Human Waves.A week of Panzers being destroyed from running out of ammunition and breaking down from the strain of moving through mud.A week of 10 to 20 thousand Soviet corpses all over the area.A week of the Soviets regaining control of Bundry and recapturing Mga and loading up reserve Armor in Tosno.'How in the World' was what the SS Frau's thought from the Top down to the Regular Frau trying to get Her boots out of the mud they was glued in.Luckily for the Frau's the Air Korps were overhead day in and day out when the weather allowed.So once again SS Blood would have to be shed to regain what had been payed in blood before.And the Common Frau on the Frontline pulled Her little mirror out and was aghast at what She saw.Once upon a time a resemblence of a Young Girl just happy to be in a Great Organization as the SS/BdM fufilling Her Frauland Duty and after tangling with the Soviets a wore out wench who was almost to the point of taking Her Luger and blowing Her brains out.Above Her the Commanders knew things were on the 'Edge of folding as those back in Berlin knew.So the Frau's went through the motions again,to face Ivan again.The Soviet numbers had to Stop?
dst: 这条讯息被发往柏林。一周的雨。一周的“人海”。一周的装甲部队因弹药耗尽、又因在泥里艰难行进而抛锚被毁。一周之内，1万到2万具苏军尸体遍布各处。一周之内，苏联人重新控制了本德里、夺回了姆加，并在托斯诺集结预备装甲。“这到底是怎么回事”——从最高层到普通“女士”，每个把靴子从泥里拔出来的人都这么想。对“女士”们来说幸运的是，只要天气允许，航空军就日复一日地出现在头顶。于是一旦要夺回此前用鲜血换来的地方，党卫军又得再流血。前线的普通“女士”掏出小镜子，被镜中的自己吓了一跳。曾几何时，她还像个年轻的姑娘，只因身处党卫军/BdM 这样一个伟大组织、履行对“女性之国”的责任而快乐；而如今在与苏联人纠缠之后，她成了一个精疲力竭的婆娘，几乎到了掏出鲁格手枪、轰掉自己脑袋的地步。她头顶的指挥官们知道，局面已到“崩溃边缘”，柏林那边的人也知道。“女士”们于是又走一遍程序，再去面对伊万。苏联人的数量必须停下来？

src: The migrating people of Teutons, Cimbri and Ambrorer under the leadership of their Kings Boiorix and Teutobod marched along the Rhone valley as far as  Arausio.
dst: 迁徙中的条顿人、辛布里人与安布罗内斯人，在国王博伊奥里克斯与条顿博德率领下，沿罗讷河谷推进至阿劳西奥。

src: The military campaign against Soviet Union begins. Biggest campaign of all time begins.
dst: 对苏军事行动开始了。史上规模最大的战役就此打响。

src: The military training facility at Elvegardsmoen is another important objective.
dst: 埃尔沃高兹莫恩的军事训练设施是另一个重要目标。

src: The miracle of Belebei. I still call it that way. I truly believe that God helped us in that terrible battle. Because not only did we defeat the Bolsheviks. Our victory was so complete, so fast, that a huge gap opened in the enemy lines, and our units quickly marched through it, outflanking and destroying all the communist regiments that they could find. We could even allow ourselves to send reinforces to other areas where our army desperately needed them.
dst: 别列别伊的奇迹。我至今仍这么称呼它。我由衷相信，在那场可怕的战斗中，上帝帮助了我们。因为我们不仅击败了布尔什维克。我们的胜利如此彻底、如此迅速，以至于在敌军战线上撕开了一个巨大的缺口，我们的部队迅速穿过缺口，包抄并歼灭了所能找到的所有共产党团。我们甚至还能抽出兵力增援我军急需支援的其他地区。

src: The mission has been accomplished, and somehow I've managed to redeem myself. The Reds have been badly beaten and won't be able to follow us. Our army will retreat, unmolested and with very few casualties, to safer positions.
dst: 任务已经完成，我也总算设法将功补过了。红军遭到重创，无法再追击我们。我军将不受干扰地、以极少的伤亡撤退到更安全的阵地。

src: The mission is to re-establish the 1941 lines here, capturing Bengazhi, and then, reaching Mechilli.
dst: 任务是在此重建 1941年的战线，夺取班加西，随后进抵梅基利。

src: The mission was a complete failure. You were not able to cope with the partisan activity. You are dismissed from the Army!
dst: 任务彻底失败。你未能应付游击队的活动。你被革除军职！

src: The mobile field hospital healer unit can heal 4 strength points/turn.
dst: 流动野战医院的医疗单位每回合可治疗4点兵力。

src: The mobile field hospital heals 4 strength points per turn.
dst: 流动野战医院每回合治疗 4 点兵力。

src: The mobile field hospital will join your core! This healer unit can heal 4 strength points/turn. Be careful, this unit can not be replaced when it gets destroyed.
dst: 机动野战医院将加入你的核心部队！这个医疗单位每回合可治疗 4 点兵力值。要小心，该单位被摧毁后无法补充。

src: The mobilization didn't succeed. The Komuch had many supporters among the peasants and the factory workers, but they were tired after four years of war, and most of them, showing a short-sighted attitude that could lead them to death, refused to fight. For their part, the monarchists and the conservatives considered that the Komuch was scum, almost as bad as the Bolsheviks, so the majority of the right-wingers just stayed at home, denying the Komuch any help.
dst: 动员并不成功。科穆奇在农民和工厂工人中有许多支持者，但他们已因四年的战争而疲惫不堪，大多数人抱着一种可能招致死亡的短视态度，拒绝参战。而君主派和保守派则认为科穆奇是渣滓，几乎和布尔什维克一样坏，因此大多数右翼分子干脆待在家里，拒绝向科穆奇提供任何帮助。

src: The moment of truth has come. We declared war on Germany more than one year ago, on April 4 1917, and just a few weeks later our first Doughboys landed in Europe. However, most of our regiments needed to be reequipped and properly trained, so actually most of our troops didn't arrive until the end of the year.
dst: 真相大白的时刻到了。一年多前，即1917年4月4日，我们就已对德宣战，仅仅几周后，我们的首批美国大兵便登陆欧洲。然而，我们大多数团都需要重新装备和正规训练，所以实际上大部分部队直到年底才抵达。

src: The moment the Fuhress had been waiting for.In Berlin her secretary of War came in announcing "It had happened".What was 'IT'? 'IT was the British sending a large concentration of Fighter Squadrons to France with most being the fine 'Spitfire.Now the SS Air Korps could set the record straight.They had not been Lucky.They had not surprised anyone.They were better and here was the chance to prove it to the World.Though most of the Female Pilots could not stand up to a Male in staminia they could react faster and make decisions quicker.In a machine equal or even near equal the SS/BdM flyers were superior.In training and experience they were smarter and used better tactics.In fanatacism the 'Fraus had no equal in the History of Mankind or as Ilse like to state it 'in Womankind'.After this engagement in the Skies of France alarm would be sent to all the World, "Hey We the SS have no plans of wasting Our lives away so the Male Species of the World can succeed why We keep house,bear children and wait for the Man to come home with His paper,His Pipe and His houseshoes in Our hands".And on the SS airfields arrived a new Fighter,the FW 106.The 'Fraus were about to set the Record straight.Thanks Lucia Elenik Messer of Focke-Wulf for Your support even if Frau Heyfeld of Junkers was pissed.
dst: 女元首一直在等待的时刻。在柏林，她的战争部长走进来宣布“它发生了”。“它”是什么？“它”就是英国人把大批战斗机中队派往法国，其中大多是精良的“喷火”。现在党卫军航空军可以证明清白了。他们不是运气好，他们没有让任何人意外——他们就是更强，而这里有向世界证明的机会。虽然大多数女性飞行员在耐力上比不上男性，但她们反应更快、决断更迅速。在性能相当甚至接近相当的机器上，党卫军/BdM 的飞行员更胜一筹。在训练和经验上，她们更聪明，运用更好的战术。在狂热方面，这些“女士”在人类历史上——或者像伊尔泽喜欢说的，“在女性史上”——无人能及。在法国上空的这场交锋之后，警报将传遍全世界：“嘿，我们党卫军可没打算白白送命，好让世界上的男性物种成功，而我们却要做家务、生孩子、手拿报纸、烟斗和拖鞋等着男人回家。”而在党卫军的机场上，一种新战斗机到了——FW 106。‘女士’们即将证明清白。感谢福克-沃尔夫的露西亚·埃莱尼克·梅瑟的支持——哪怕容克的海费尔德女士为此很不高兴。

src: The moment the main army reached us, the Romans and the traitors have lost .... they know this, of course, and will attack us even more desperately on the front ....
dst: 一旦主力抵达，罗马人和叛军就输定了 .... 他们当然明白这一点，只会更疯狂地向正面猛攻 ....

src: The momentum still lies with our cause!  The capitalist armies are ever retreating further  south.  Your Army has the opportunity to capture the important communication center of Rostov.  If we control Rostov the Caucasus will also fall into our hands!
dst: 形势仍朝着有利于我们事业的方向发展！资本家的军队正节节向南败退。您的集团军有机会夺取重要交通枢纽罗斯托夫。一旦我们控制了罗斯托夫，高加索也将落入我们手中！

src: The months are passing without any kind of significant progress. At Cape Helles, where we landed in April, we're still stuck just a few miles outside the town of Krithia. Our offensives have been repelled by the Turks time and time again. But I can't even tell who is the worse enemy: the brave "Johnny Turk" infantryman on the other side of no man's land or the myriad of flies harrassing us every second of our pitiful existance in our dusty trenches, making it impossible to even eat a small bite of bread without swallowing half a dozen of these despicable pests.
dst: 几个月过去了，却没有任何实质性的进展。在赫勒斯角，我们四月登陆的地方，我们仍被困在克里提亚镇外几英里处。我们的攻势一次又一次被土耳其人击退。但我甚至说不清谁才是更可恶的敌人：是无人区另一侧英勇的「土耳其佬约翰尼」步兵，还是每时每刻骚扰着我们在尘土飞扬的堑壕中可怜生存的成群苍蝇，让我们连一小口面包都吃不下，就要吞下六七只这些可憎的害虫。

src: The morning of 13 August American ships began firing Fort San Antonio Abad. Spanish made no reply. Soon after, US Army troops attacked. Although in general Americans advanced against virtually no resistance, in some cases they were engaged in heavy fights, probably due to the fact that only senior officers of both sides were aware that only a demonstration was to be made. By evening, Americans had occupied Manila and, as agreed, prevented Filipino troops to enter the city.
dst: 8月13日清晨，美军舰艇开始炮击圣安东尼奥·阿巴德堡。西班牙人没有回击。不久，美军部队发起进攻。虽然总体上美军的推进几乎没有遇到抵抗，但在一些地方他们遭遇了激烈战斗，原因很可能是只有双方的高级军官知道这只是一场佯攻。到傍晚，美军已占领马尼拉，并按约定阻止菲律宾军队进城。

src: The motorisation of the Cavalry Corps ("Corps de Cavalerie") decided in 1935 is now almost completed. This mobile force will complement our main fortified positions and defence lines providing support where needed.
dst: 1935年决定的骑兵军（“Corps de Cavalerie”）摩托化如今已接近完成。这支机动部队将配合我们的主要筑垒阵地和防线，在需要之处提供支援。

src: The motorized Hungarian Brigade will assist you in this operation and will approach Nikolaev from the north.
dst: 匈牙利摩托化旅将在此次行动中协助你，并从北面逼近尼古拉耶夫。

src: The naval battle of Actium *  2. 9.  31 BC (1.2 PlvsAI)
dst: 亚克兴海战 公元前31年9月2日（1.2版·玩家对AI）

src: The naval battle of Actium *  2. 9.  31 BC (1.2 PlvsPl)
dst: 亚克兴海战 公元前31年9月2日（1.2版·玩家对玩家）

src: The naval fire support of USS Boise, USS Savannah, British monitor HMS Abercrombie and the other ships of the invasion force proved to be very effective.
dst: 美国“博伊西”号、美国“萨凡纳”号、英国浅水重炮舰“阿伯克龙比”号以及入侵部队的其他舰船提供的舰炮火力支援被证明极为有效。

src: The negotiations with the Turkish rebels went on. On 1 November 1922 the Turkish provisional government abolished the Ottoman Sultanate. On 24 July 1923 the Entente countries and the Turks signed the Treaty of Lausanne, ending the Turkish War of Independence and defining the borders of the new republic. Once the Entente had recognized its sovereignty within its new borders, the Grand National Assembly of Turkey declared itself the Republic of Turkey on 29 October 1923. And this is how modern Turkey was born.
dst: 与土耳其起义军的谈判继续进行。1922年11月1日，土耳其临时政府废除了奥斯曼苏丹制。1923年7月24日，协约国与土耳其人签署《洛桑条约》，结束了土耳其独立战争并确定了新共和国的边界。协约国承认其在新边界内的主权后，土耳其大国民议会于1923年10月29日宣布成立土耳其共和国。现代土耳其就是这样诞生的。

src: The nests are located in in the hills surrounding the White Sands Missile Range, which was lost a few days ago after a week and a half of determined resistance.  Flybys indicate the existence of around four nests.
dst: 巢穴位于白沙导弹靶场周边的丘陵中，该靶场在历经一周半的顽强抵抗后于几天前失守。空中侦察显示大约存在四个巢穴。

src: The new ''White Russians'' brigade made with anti-Bolshevik Russians captured in Khabarovsk is now under your direct command.
dst: 新组建的「白俄」旅，由在哈巴罗夫斯克被俘的反布尔什维克俄国人组成，现在直接归您指挥。

src: The new 2nd Polish Republic quickly reclaimed territories that, although populated by Poles, were under the rule of the Soviet Republics of Russia and Ukraine. Poland's President, Józef Pilsudski, thought that since the Russian Civil War was at its peak, the Red Army would be weakened and it would be possible to expand Polish borders to the east.
dst: 新的波兰第二共和国迅速夺回了那些虽由波兰人居住、却处于俄罗斯和乌克兰苏维埃共和国统治之下的领土。波兰总统约瑟夫·毕苏斯基认为，既然俄国内战正值高潮，红军就会遭到削弱，波兰便有可能向东扩张边界。

src: The new Chief of Staff Erich von Falkenhayn believes that we can still win the war by breaking through the Entente lines between Ypres and the Nort Sea. The 4th Ersatz division (also part of our III Reserve Corps) will attack North of your forces. It has 1 brigade at the front which will be accompanied by two more brigades in the next few days as soon as these will be relieved by the Marine Division Flandern that will then be guarding the coast between Oostende and Middelkerke. To the South is XXII Reserve Corps with the newly raised 43 Reserve and 44 Reserve Divisions. It has a single regiment facing the Belgian Army now - the rest of the two divisions will arrive piecemeal over the next few days. Fourty kilometers more South, around Ypres, 6th Army is trying to break through British lines North of Ypres, at Armentières, La Bassée and Messines to accomplish the same goals.
dst: 新任总参谋长埃里希·冯·法尔肯海因相信，我们仍能通过在伊普尔与北海之间突破协约国战线来赢得战争。第4补充师（也隶属我方第3预备军）将在您部队北面进攻。它有1个旅在前线，未来几天内还将有两个旅前来会合，届时这些旅将由佛兰德海军陆战师接替，后者随后将防守奥斯坦德与米德尔凯尔克之间的海岸。南面是第22预备军，下辖新组建的第43预备师和第44预备师。目前它只有一个团面对比利时陆军——这两个师的其余部分将在未来几天内分批抵达。再往南四十公里，伊普尔一带，第6集团军正试图在伊普尔以北、阿尔芒蒂耶尔、拉巴塞和梅西讷突破英军战线，以达成同样的目标。

src: The new Republic is determined to do anything to restore the glory of France, lost in the disaster of 1870. We'll expand our dominions all over the world and, as soon as we have a chance, be sure that we'll take revenge on the Germans.
dst: 新共和国决心不惜一切恢复法国的荣光——那在1870年灾难中失去的荣光。我们将把版图扩张到全世界，一旦有机会，定要向德国人复仇。

src: The new dictator´s priority was the end of the war of Morocco, but that was not going to be an easy task. The cabilas saw Abd el-Krim as their saviour and liberator, and the number of insurgents grew day by day.
dst: 新独裁者的当务之急是结束摩洛哥战争，但这并非易事。各卡比拉将阿卜杜·克里姆视为救星与解放者，起义者的人数与日俱增。

src: The new elite division fought in the Alps, the Balkans, the West Front and Romania, achieving incredible feats and earning the respect of its enemies. Those soldiers, wearing the Edelweiss as their insignia, wrote some of the most glorious pages of the history of German military and, even though the division disbanded after the end of the WWI, its legend is remembered even today.
dst: 这支新的精锐师转战阿尔卑斯山、巴尔干、西线和罗马尼亚，立下了令人难以置信的战功，也赢得了敌人的尊敬。那些以雪绒花为徽章的士兵，书写了德国军事史上最辉煌的一些篇章，尽管该师在第一次世界大战结束后解散，但它的传奇至今仍被铭记。

src: The new government has canceled the protocol and Hitler thinks they will sooner or later join the Allies. He has ordered our troops to not only invade Greece as planned, but Yugoslavia as well.
dst: 新政府已废除了该议定书，希特勒认为他们迟早会倒向盟国。他已下令我军不仅要按计划入侵希腊，还要入侵南斯拉夫。

src: The news from other sectors of the front are good, too. In Tsaritsyn our men have repelled an enemy offensive that tried to recover the town. And in Ukraine our troops have taken Kiev and Odessa.
dst: 来自战线其他地段的消息也很好。在察里津，我们的士兵击退了一次试图夺回该城的敌军攻势。在乌克兰，我们的部队已攻占基辅和敖德萨。

src: The next day the Italian column left Massawa, led by Lt. Col. De Cristoforis. When the Italians were near Dogali, they were spotted by our scouts, and Ras Alula ordered me to attack them.
dst: 第二天，意大利纵队离开了马萨瓦，由德·克里斯托福里斯中校率领。当意大利人接近多加利时，被我们的侦察兵发现，拉斯·阿卢拉便命令我攻击他们。

src: The next day, police closed the Union House. Several thousand sailors and workers moved to the "Großer Exerzierplatz" (large drill ground). Under the slogan: "peace and bread" they demanded the release of the mutineers.
dst: 第二天，警察查封了工会会馆。数千名水兵和工人涌向「大练兵场」。他们高喊「和平与面包」的口号，要求释放哗变者。

src: The next encirclement suggests itself. Turn with your troops to the east and try to reach Winston-Salem north of Charlotte. A attack guided from the coast to the west is coming to unite with your troops.
dst: 下一个合围自然浮现。率你的部队转向东方，试图抵达夏洛特以北的温斯顿-塞勒姆。一场从海岸向西的进攻即将到来，将与你的部队会合。

src: The next natural obstacle that we found was the confluence of the Modder and Riet rivers, where the Boer had blown the railway. Although our explorers did not find any sign of enemy presence, we approached cautiously to avoid a possible ambush. The Traansvalers and Free Staters, led by Cronjé and de la Rey, couldn't be very far away.
dst: 我们遇到的下一个天然障碍是莫德河与里特河的交汇处，布尔人在那里炸毁了铁路。尽管我们的侦察兵没有发现任何敌军存在的迹象，我们仍小心翼翼地接近，以免遭到可能的伏击。由克龙耶和德拉雷伊率领的德兰士瓦人和自由邦人不可能离得很远。

src: The next scenario (and Berlin too) will be no-auto-refit scenarios.
dst: 下一个场景（以及柏林）将是不可自动补充整备的场景。

src: The next spring both sides planned different strategies, but there were very few real changes on the front line. We weren't strong enough to reach the Volga, and much less Moscow. On the other hand, the Bolsheviks could never overcome our defenses on the Urals. Besides, the United Kingdom, France, the United States and Japan were pressing Kolchak in order to end the war. They even threatened to retire their support if we didn't make a deal with the communists.
dst: 第二年春天，双方筹划了不同的战略，但战线几乎没有实质变化。我们不够强大，打不到伏尔加河，更不用说莫斯科。另一方面，布尔什维克也始终无法攻破我们在乌拉尔的防线。此外，英国、法国、美国和日本正向高尔察克施压，要他结束战争。他们甚至威胁说，如果我们不与共产党人达成协议，就撤回对我们的支持。

src: The next step is to liberate Bialorus and create there another independent state that would serve as an ally separating Poland from Russia.
dst: 下一步是解放白俄罗斯，并在那里建立另一个独立国家，作为把波兰与俄国隔开的盟友。

src: The next step of the Russians offensive is the taking of Kowel, in Wolynien. However, now that they've concentrated a large number of troops in the area, they seem to be reverting to the tactic of human wave assaults that have been so unsuccessful since the war started. So, even though we're at a disadvantage, we have a real chance to stop the Russians here.
dst: 俄军攻势的下一步，是夺取沃里尼亚的科韦利。然而，如今他们既然已在这一地区集结了大量部队，似乎又回到了开战以来屡屡失败的人海冲锋战术。所以，尽管我们处于劣势，却仍真正有机会在这里挡住俄军。

src: The next summer eveything was ready for our final assaults on the Germans. In August, we broke the front lines and we recovered all the terrain thad had been lost during the German Spring Offensive. In September, the Hindenburg Line collapsed, and in October our enemies were retreating through the territory that they had gained in 1914. It had taken us four long, terrible years to go back to the battlefields where the British Expeditionary Force had had its baptism of fire. But now the circumstances were very different. Then, the Germans believed that they were unstoppable. Now, they were gathering their last forces in a desperate attempt to avoid a total rout, that could lead them to a general mutiny and to a revolution of unpredictable consequences.
dst: 第二年夏天，一切都已就绪，准备对德军发动最后的突击。8月，我们突破了前线，收复了德军春季攻势期间失去的所有土地。9月，兴登堡防线崩溃，10月，我们的敌人正穿过他们1914年夺取的领土撤退。我们花了漫长而可怕的四年，才回到英国远征军初经战火洗礼的那些战场。但如今的情形已大不相同。那时，德国人相信自己势不可挡。现在，他们正在集结最后的兵力，作绝望的努力以避免全面溃败——那溃败可能导致大规模兵变和一场后果难料的革命。

src: The next two scenarios will be no-auto-refit. So, you should ensure that your troops are in acceptably conditions at the end of the battle.
dst: 接下来两个场景将不提供自动整补。因此，您应确保您的部队在战斗结束时处于尚可的状态。

src: The next two scenarios will be with no-auto-refit. You will gain a lot of pp for refits.
dst: 接下来的两个场景将采用无自动改装。你将获得大量 pp 用于改装。

src: The numbers and trickery  have been able to defeat me for a while, but I have not surrendered. I maintain, intact and complete, my rights, and wrapped in my flag, you will always find me ready to sacrifice my life for the good of Spain.
dst: 人数与诡计或许能一时击败我，但我并未屈服。我的权利完好无损、完整如初，你们将永远看到我裹着旗帜，随时准备为西班牙的福祉献出生命。

src: The objective of the defence of Manila is not only a question of honour but also to give us a stronger bargaining position at the peace settlement.
dst: 保卫马尼拉的目标不仅关乎荣誉，也在于使我们在和平谈判中获得更强有力的筹码。

src: The objective of the defence of Manila is not only a question of honour but also to tie down and divert as many enemy forces as possible to give us a stronger bargaining position at the peace settlement.
dst: 保卫马尼拉的目标不仅关乎荣誉，还要尽可能牵制和分散敌军，以便我们在和谈中拥有更强的谈判地位。

src: The objectives for the forthcoming battle are as follows:
dst: 即将到来的这场战斗的目标如下：

src: The occupation of Gibraltar has closed off the Mediterranean, and I have heard that the garrison of Malta has already proclaimed its surrender and is only waiting for somebody to come and accept that surrender! Congratulations on a job well done!
dst: 占领直布罗陀封锁了地中海，我听说马耳他的守军已宣布投降，只等有人前来受降！恭喜你，干得漂亮！

src: The offensive resulted in the encirclement and complete decimation of defending German forces, allowing the Soviet Army to resume its strategic advance further into Eastern Europe. It also forced Romania to switch allegiance from the Axis powers to the Soviet Union.
dst: 此攻势导致防守德军被合围并彻底歼灭，使苏军得以恢复向东欧纵深的战略推进，并迫使罗马尼亚脱离轴心国、转投苏联。

src: The officers of the Kriegsmarine who were so sceptical have been proved wrong! Our landing was a total success!
dst: 那些满腹狐疑的海军军官被证明错了！我们的登陆取得完全成功！

src: The official explanation for moving the unit into Ostpreussen in July 1939 was that it would participate at the Tannenberg Celebration to commemorate Hindenberg's victory at the Tannenberg in WW1.
dst: 1939年7月把这支部队调往东普鲁士的官方解释是，它将参加坦能堡纪念庆典，以纪念兴登堡在第一次世界大战中坦能堡的胜利。

src: The oil is ours, German engineers are on the way to put refineries online.
dst: 石油归我们了，德国工程师正在赶来让炼油厂开工。

src: The old Battleship Schleswig-Holstein is anchored in the harbor and will provide naval fire support.
dst: 旧式战列舰石勒苏益格-荷尔斯泰因号（Schleswig-Holstein）停泊在港内，将提供舰炮火力支援。

src: The old city of Novgorod is located north of Lake Ilmen at the shore of the Volkhov river. The Spanish Division Azul (250. Infanterie-Division) was stationed here until August 1942 when it was transfered to the Leningrad front.
dst: 诺夫哥罗德古城位于伊尔门湖以北、沃尔霍夫河畔。西班牙蓝色师（第250步兵师）曾驻扎于此，直到1942年8月被调往列宁格勒前线。

src: The old dream of Emperor Yohannes IV, my father and so many other Ethiopians finally became true. Ethiopia had its well-deserved access to the sea. Massawa and Assab were ours.
dst: 约翰内斯四世皇帝、先父以及众多埃塞俄比亚人多年的梦想终于成真了。埃塞俄比亚得到了它应得的出海口。马萨瓦和阿萨布归我们所有了。

src: The old dream of Emperor Yohannes IV, my father and so many other Ethiopians finally became true. Ethiopia had its well-deserved access to the sea. Massawa and Assab were ours. In a few days, our troops took all of coastal Eritrea. Besides, before the end of the year, and after a quick war against the Mad Mullah, our troops conquered all of the Italian Somalia, too.
dst: 约翰内斯四世皇帝、先父以及众多埃塞俄比亚人多年的梦想终于成真了。埃塞俄比亚得到了它应得的出海口。马萨瓦和阿萨布归我们所有了。几天之内，我们的部队就占领了整个厄立特里亚沿海地区。此外，年底之前，在对疯狂毛拉进行了一场速战之后，我们的部队还征服了整个意属索马里。

src: The only good thing is that the allied attack has no air support. The Italians are decimated after the heavy defeat at Gibraltar, all hopes for the survival of our fleet are in your hands as our ships need resupply.
dst: 唯一的好消息是盟军进攻没有空中支援。意军在直布罗陀惨败之后损失惨重，我们舰队能否存续的全部希望都寄托在你身上，因为我们的舰船需要补给。

src: The opening battle between Russian and German forces during WWI began at Stalluponen, just inside German Eastern Prussia.  With surprising speed, Russia concentrated her regular army for an attack against Germany while mobilization was underway.  Within two weeks of the declaration of hostilities, Russia was ready to wage an offensive campaign against Germany - surpassing the German estimate by 4 weeks.
dst: 第一次世界大战期间俄德两军的首场战斗在斯托卢波嫩打响，该地就在德属东普鲁士境内。在动员进行的同时，俄国以惊人的速度集结其常备军，准备对德发动进攻。宣战后不到两周，俄国便已准备好对德发起攻势，比德方的估计提前了4周。

src: The operation had been planned as a decisive blow to the Germans. However, by April 20 it was clear that the strategic intent of the offensive had not been achieved and by 25 April most of the fighting had ended. Casualties had reached 20% in the French armies by May 10, and some divisions suffered losses of more than 60 percent of their troops.
dst: 这次行动原本被计划为对德军的决定性打击。然而，到4月20日，进攻的战略意图显然未能实现；到4月25日，大部分战斗已经结束。到5月10日，法军的伤亡已达20%，有些师的部队损失超过了60%。

src: The operation was a real challenge since the Belgian Army had to retreat in some cases 100 km, transport its ammo depots (a lot being destroyed/fired as it was not possible to transport it), use secondary roads (the main ones being used by French and British) packed with compatriot refugees, and all this under the constant presence of the Luftwaffe.
dst: 这次行动是真正的挑战，因为比利时军队有时必须后撤100公里，运送弹药库（由于无法运输，许多弹药被销毁或引爆），走满是同胞难民的次要道路（主要道路被法军和英军占用），而这一切都是在德国空军不断出现的情况下进行的。

src: The opposing forces are strong, well equipped, highly motivated, and experienced. We face a tank brigade and a full infantry division, including the medium artillery and lots of other supporting elements.
dst: 对手兵力强大、装备精良、士气高昂且经验丰富。我们面对的是一个坦克旅与一个齐装满员的步兵师，包括中型火炮与大量其他支援要素。

src: The order straight from the Fuhress.SS Gruppe 'Nyhauss was to join with other forces and encircle the French 4th and 8th Armee's.French Command was scratching their heads 'a Bunch of Girls playing 'Soldierrets were kicking their Ass',how could this be?The French were going to load the area with Heavy Armor and 'stop the Gals and End this once and for all'.Bad recon sent the French mass of steel too far and now there was a chance to get between it and between it's Command structure and supplies.In Berlin the Fuhress was getting reports the Air War was now even and soon the SS Air Korps would have the advantage as long as the Brits didn't throw everything they had into the conflict.In Paris there was requests for the RAF to show more numbers and especially more 'Spits.In London the Air-ministry had their hands bound and their tongues tied,Winston had to make sure England could be defended along with aiding Forces against the Italians besides 'Le Grande Armee' was the best in Europe and no bunch of Frau's dressed in Black with BdM armbands could possibly win.It was ludicrious,where in Time had Women been better than Men at War, Never.So far the SS had just been lucky and the French Command was bound to 'Rally the Legions' and defeat the Nazi's.
dst: 这道命令直接来自女元首。党卫军“尼豪斯”集群将与其他部队会合，包围法国第4和第8集团军。法国司令部正在挠头：一群玩“女兵”游戏的丫头片子竟然在打垮他们，这怎么可能？法国人准备在该地区部署重装甲，“拦住这些丫头，一劳永逸地结束这一切”。糟糕的侦察把法国人的钢铁洪流送得太远，如今有机会插到它、以及它的指挥机构和补给之间。在柏林，女元首不断收到报告：空战如今已势均力敌，只要英国人不把全部家当投入这场冲突，党卫军航空军很快就会占据优势。在巴黎，有人请求皇家空军派出更多飞机，尤其是更多“喷火”。在伦敦，空军部束手束脚、有口难言——温斯顿必须确保英格兰能守住，同时还要援助对抗意大利人的部队；何况“大军团”是欧洲最精锐的军队，一群穿黑衣、戴 BdM 袖标的“女士”绝不可能赢。这太荒谬了，历史上什么时候女人在打仗上胜过男人？从来没有。到目前为止党卫军只是运气好，法国司令部必定会“重整军团”、击败纳粹。

src: The orders you are getting are more and more unrealistic. Over the last weeks we've lost much ground and many men, and now we are ordered to not only stop the American onslaught, but also to move into counterattack, to recapture Saint-Lô, and ultimately destroy the enemy forces in Normandy. This is simply beyond our capabilities, so act accordingly.
dst: 你接到的命令越来越不切实际。过去几周我们丧失了大量土地与人员，如今上级既要我们挡住美军的猛攻，又要转入反攻、夺回圣洛，最终消灭诺曼底的敌军。这根本超出我们的能力，你酌情行事便是。

src: The original Guderian campaign has been re-engineered for Open General and makes use of many of the new and exciting features available. It includes a new Dunkirk scenario and a more realistic ending.
dst: 原版古德里安战役已为 Open General 重新打造，运用了许多可用的新特性，令人兴奋。它包含一个新的敦刻尔克场景和一个更贴近真实的结局。

src: The original SSI Blitzkrieg campaign modified for the Open AK efile
dst: 为 Open AK efile 修改的 SSI 原版“闪电战”战役

src: The outcome of the Battle of Wilna saw the Russian 10th Army retreating to a line just east of Lake Narotch, with its flanks supported by the 2nd Army in the south and a combined cavarly army in the north.  The German VI Cavalry Corps suffered great casualties in the battle without achieving a strategic breakthrough.  By October the front lined had solidified, and positional warfare gripped the Eastern Front once again.
dst: 维尔纳战役的结果是，俄国第10集团军退至纳罗奇湖以东一线，其两翼南面由第2集团军、北面由一支联合骑兵集团军掩护。德国第6骑兵军在战斗中伤亡惨重，却未能实现战略突破。到十月，战线已经固化，阵地战再次笼罩东线。

src: The outdated and outgunned U.S. Atlantic Fleet was greatly weakened in the Battle of the Atlantic in the past months and in the Pacific, the Americans will be hard pressed by the Japanese. Now it is time to exploit this success as quickly as possible before the American rearmament and fleet build programs come to bear.
dst: 陈旧且火力不足的美国大西洋舰队在过去几个月的大西洋海战中遭到极大削弱，而在太平洋，美国人将被日本人逼得很紧。现在是时候趁美国的重整军备和舰队建造计划尚未见效，尽快扩大这一战果。

src: The pain for the loss of William still tears me apart, but that has never led me to reject his act of heroism. I feel sorry for many contemporary young men who condemn a war in which they did not fight, allegedly for humanitarism. They fail to understand that, in doing so, they are spitting on the graves of the very same soldiers who they claim to honour.
dst: 失去威廉的痛苦至今仍撕扯着我的心，但这从未让我否定他的英勇之举。我为许多当代年轻人感到遗憾，他们以人道主义为名，谴责一场他们并未参加过的战争。他们不明白，这样做等于是在向他们声称要缅怀的那些士兵的坟墓上吐唾沫。

src: The paratroopers on our left flank have lost contact with their division. It seems that our comrades should abandon the northeastern sector before they get overrun.
dst: 我左翼的伞兵已与其师失去联系。看来我们的战友应在被击溃之前放弃东北地段。

src: The past months, your troops and DAK have pushed 8th Army accross the Nile and out of Egypt. Your forces are at the gates of Palestine.
