The Allies are gathering the last forces available in the Middle East to stop our advance. Most of the divisions they are fielding are inexperienced troops that haven't even finished their training.
dst: 过去几个月，你的部队和非洲军把第8集团军赶过尼罗河、逐出埃及。你的部队已兵临巴勒斯坦。盟军正集结中东尚存的最后兵力来阻止我们推进。他们派出的大多数师都是连训练都没完成的缺乏经验的部队。

src: The past year has been a dissaster for Japan, General. Our positions in the Solomons are really damaged by the continuous allied assaults. Our defeat in Guadalcanal has also given the enemies a good base to threaten our communications and launch other operations agaisnt us in Southern Asia.
dst: 将军，过去一年对日本而言是一场灾难。我们在所罗门群岛的阵地，已因盟军接连不断的进攻而严重受损。我们在瓜达尔卡纳尔岛的失败，还给了敌人一个绝佳基地，得以威胁我们的通讯，并对我们在南亚发起其他行动。

src: The peace treaty with the U.S. has put an end to four centuries of Spanish rule over the Philippines. Our troops are being repatriated and administration is being transferred to the "Yankees". However, your mission in the Philippines is not over yet.
dst: 与美国的和平条约终结了西班牙对菲律宾长达四个世纪的统治。我们的部队正在撤回国内，行政权正移交给「洋基人」。然而，您在菲律宾的使命尚未结束。

src: The peace treaty with the U.S. has put an end to four centuries of Spanish rule over the Philippines. Our troops are being repatriated and administration is being transferred to the Yankees. However, your mission in the Philippines is not over yet.
dst: 与美国的和平条约终结了西班牙对菲律宾长达四个世纪的统治。我们的部队正在撤回国内，行政权正移交给洋基人。然而，您在菲律宾的使命尚未结束。

src: The people celebrate your great rescue!
dst: 人民为你的伟大解救行动而欢庆！
人民为你的解救行动而欢庆！

src: The people in Alamogordo and Tularosa are sitting ducks, Commander.  We've got to evacuate them before more of these monsters show up and overrun the entire area.
dst: 阿拉莫戈多和图拉罗萨的居民就是活靶子，指挥官。我们必须在更多这种怪物出现、席卷整个地区之前疏散他们。

src: The people mourn the tragedy of our loss!
dst: 人民为我们的惨败而哀悼！

src: The phrase "el imperio en el que nunca se pone el sol" ("the empire on which the sun never sets") it was used mainly in the 16th - 18th centuries to describe the Spanish Empire. The Empire, which included many territories in Europe, the Americas, Africa, Asia and Oceania, was so extensive that there was always at least one part of their territory in daylight.
dst: 西班牙语「el imperio en el que nunca se pone el sol」（意为「日不落帝国」）这一说法主要用于16至18世纪，用以形容西班牙帝国。该帝国疆域辽阔，包括欧洲、美洲、非洲、亚洲和大洋洲的众多领土，以至于其版图上总有一部分处于白昼之中。

src: The plan consists in surrounding the Bolsheviks from east, west and north, and push them against the Caucasus. However, the enemy's numerical superiority is so great that our encirclement has been merely theoretical. If the Soviet hordes actually behaved like a true army they could break our lines at any place and march wherever they pleased. We're lucky that they've spent much time quarrelling and killing each other. Even their leader Sorokin has been shot.
dst: 该计划旨在从东、西、北三面包围布尔什维克，把他们逼向高加索。然而，敌人在数量上的优势如此之大，我们的包围圈只是纸面上的。如果苏维埃那群乌合之众真像一支正规军那样行动，他们本可在任何地方突破我方战线，随意进军。幸运的是，他们把大量时间花在了内讧和自相残杀上。就连他们的领袖索罗金都被枪毙了。

src: The plan consists of an attack from the North and the East on the Brunete sector, to surround the rebel forces there. The main part of the V and the XVIII Army Corps will attack from the North southwards to Brunete and Villafranca del Castillo, while the II Army Corp arrives from Madrid, taking the Villaviciosa de Odon. Also, the 14th Division will arrive as reinforcements, as well as a good number of FARE aircraft.
dst: 计划是从北面和东面对布鲁内特地段发起进攻，包围那里的叛军部队。第V军和第XVIII军的主力将从北面南下，进攻布鲁内特和卡斯蒂略的比利亚弗兰卡；而第II军则从马德里开来，夺取奥东的比利亚维西奥萨。第14师随后也将作为增援抵达，此外还有大量 FARE 飞机。

src: The plan for "Operation Fall Weiss" called for Guderian's XIX corps to strike due south to capture Brest from starting points on the eastern border of German East Prussia. The quickest way to get his force to the starting area was a fast dash across the Polish held "Danzig Corridor" then rapid uninterrupted movement through friendly territory. It took 4 days for the lead elements of the Corps to create and hold a safe corridor through which the rest of the battle group raced to East Prussia. The 5th and 6th Panzer Regiments of the 3rd Panzer Division were to do the lions share and were awarded some of the first Iron Crosses of the war.
dst: “白色方案”行动的计划要求古德里安的第19军从德属东普鲁士东部边境的出发阵地正南出击，夺取布列斯特。把这支部队调往出发地域的最快办法，是快速穿越波兰控制的“但泽走廊”，然后沿友好领土快速不间断地机动。军的先头部队用了4天时间开辟并守住一条安全走廊，战斗群的其余部队则沿此狂奔进入东普鲁士。第3装甲师的第5和第6装甲团承担了大部分任务，并获得了这场战争最初颁发的一批铁十字勋章。

src: The plan is this: First you must cross the Strait of Gibraltar, without going near the rock. We all know very well that it is impregnable. Its huge cannons can sink any ship, as well as the English battleships anchored in the bay. There are also several submarines and ships patrolling the strait, as well as aircraft. There is also a range 12 Radar. At the same time, our Italian allies are fighting the British fleet, the RAF, as well as units of free France.
dst: 计划是这样的：首先你必须穿越直布罗陀海峡，且不得靠近那块巨岩。我们都很清楚它固若金汤。其巨型火炮能击沉任何舰船，泊在湾内的英国战列舰同样如此。海峡中还有数艘潜艇和舰艇在巡逻，还有飞机。此外那里还部署了一部射程12的雷达。与此同时，我们的意大利盟友正与英国舰队、英国皇家空军以及自由法国部队交战。

src: The planned offensive consist of a concentrated attack on Teruel, in order to quickly finish the rebel garrison defending Teruel. The rebels are commanded by Colonel Rey D'Harcourt, a clever opponent. The High Command thinks the fascists will send a huge number of reinforcements as soon as our troops appear at Teruel, so drive your troops quickly to the objectives and be careful to secure your flanks... Reinforcements of the V Army Corps will arrive to help you.
dst: 计划中的攻势包括对特鲁埃尔发起集中进攻，以便迅速消灭守卫特鲁埃尔的叛军驻军。叛军由雷·德阿库尔上校指挥，他是个精明的对手。最高统帅部认为，我们的部队一出现在特鲁埃尔，法西斯分子就会派出大量援军，因此您要迅速率部抵达目标，并注意保护好侧翼……第V军的增援部队将赶来协助您。

src: The plot was betrayed but about 78 men seized kitchen implements, fought their way free from the school, and seized several wagons of gladiatorial weapons and armor.
dst: 密谋被告发，但约78人夺得厨房用具，杀出学校，并抢走数车角斗士的武器与盔甲。

src: The political opponents of Caesar intrigue together with the followers of the Pompey to destroy Caesar!
dst: 凯撒的政敌与庞培的党羽串通一气，要摧毁凯撒！

src: The political situation is increasingly unfavorable for us. In December General Martinez Campos proclaimed Alfonso, Infanta Isabel's son, King of Spain, and he is getting more and more supporters, including prominent traditionalists. The war in Cataluña is almost lost, and new recruits fill the ranks of the liberal army, more and more numerous.
dst: 政治局势对我们日益不利。12月，马丁内斯·坎波斯将军拥立伊莎贝尔公主之子阿方索为西班牙国王，他正获得越来越多的支持者，其中包括一些显赫的传统主义者。加泰罗尼亚的战事几乎已经落败，新兵源源不断地充实着自由派军队的行列，使其人数越来越多。

src: The populations of Alamogordo and Tularosa are being sent back to their homes.  Commander, it's a wonderful thing you've done here today.  I sure hope this is the most "anomalous" thing Anomalous Operations ever has to do, though.
dst: 阿拉莫戈多和图拉罗萨的居民正被送回他们的家园。指挥官，你今天在这里做了一件了不起的事。不过我真心希望，这是异常行动有史以来必须做的最「异常」的一件事。

src: The position of the Turkish army was strong, entrenched in hills behind the river. The Greek army should decide between entrench and defend the gains or advance towards Ankara to destroy the Turkish capital, thus extending its lines of communication and supply in hostile territory; after much deliberation they chose to attack.
dst: 土耳其军队的阵地十分坚固，在河后方的山丘上构筑了堑壕。希腊军队必须在固守并保卫既得战果、或向安卡拉推进以摧毁土耳其首都之间做出抉择，后者意味着在敌境内延长其交通线和补给线；经过反复权衡，他们选择了进攻。

src: The power sources you secured previously went not towards the time machine but towards the repair of several decommissioned weapons plants outside the city, which Pegasus used to construct its army.  The time machine is still fully functional.  It always has been.
dst: 你先前夺取的那些电源并没有用于时间机器，而是用于修复城外几座退役的兵工厂，珀伽索斯用它们打造了自己的军队。时间机器仍然完全可用。它一直都是可用的。

src: The preliminary bombardment for the attack on Scimitar Hill was very heavy for Gallipoli, but a mist on the Suvla plain favoured the enemy, interfering with the aim of the British gunners.
dst: 进攻弯刀山的炮火准备对加里波利而言非常猛烈，但苏夫拉平原上的雾气帮了敌人的忙，干扰了英军炮手的瞄准。

src: The production of armored trains has visibly increased since their introduction in the fall of 1914, with 15 operational detachments from Finland to Galicia.  With action around major railroad hubs, you may consider the deployment of armored trains a viable option for the remainder of the campaign in 1915.
dst: 装甲列车的生产自1914年秋投入使用以来明显增加，从芬兰到加利西亚已有15支可作战的分队。随着战斗围绕各大铁路枢纽展开，您可以考虑在1915年余下的战役中把部署装甲列车作为一个可行的选项。

src: The purpose of the Arras offensive was to draw in German reinforcements. It thereby assisted the French Nivelle Offensive that would start a few days later.
dst: 阿拉斯攻势的目的是吸引德军增援，从而配合几天后开始的法国尼韦勒攻势。

src: The quality of the French troops was too much for the Chinese soldiers. After some days of heavy fighting our troops fell back to Bac Le, and our enemies established important forward positions at Kep and Chu, threatening Lang Son.
dst: 法军的素质对中国士兵而言实在太过强大。经过数日的激战，我们的部队退到了北黎，而敌人则在盖普和朱建立了重要的前进阵地，威胁着谅山。

src: The question from the Fuhress back in the Frauland.So many Forces destroyed around Leningrad.So many attacks repelled and so many supplies spent the Reich Logistics minister had informed Ilse that action would have to be curtailed on the other Fronts if Leningrads defense had to be kept supplied at the rate it was.Of course the Fuhress blew a gasket and chased the Logistics head out of the building with Her Luger.Once calmed down of course the numbers could not lie,The 'Ivans had to break or Leningrad would have to be vacated.'How in the World can they,can We keep this up?It will make Us all Mad sustaining this'?The Fuhress looked over Her Map.Is this how the War with Stalin was going to be,and Lenningrad had a decent supply route through the Baltic States.The other Fronts did not.A War Cabinet meeting was called.Production quotas would be increased,more Slave Labor had to be drawn into the process,more transports had to be allocated to Supply.Eradication would have to be curtailled and the males in the 'Frauland would have to push the 'Slaves a little harder plus more Factories would have to be built.Could the SS/BdM beat the Numbers Stalin had?
dst: 这是“女性之国”那边女元首传来的问题。列宁格勒周边被歼灭的兵力如此之多，被击退的进攻如此之多，消耗的补给如此之巨，以至于帝国后勤部长告知伊尔泽：若要按现有速率维持列宁格勒的防御补给，其他战线的行动就必须缩减。女元首自然勃然大怒，掏着鲁格手枪把后勤部长赶出了大楼。等冷静下来，数字毕竟不会说谎：要么伊万们垮掉，要么列宁格勒就得放弃。“他们究竟怎么——我们又究竟怎么——撑得住这一切？这么硬撑下去会让我们全都发疯的。”女元首审视着她的地图。与斯大林的战争难道就要这样打下去？而列宁格勒至少还有经波罗的海国家的好补给线，其他战线可没有。战时内阁会议召开。生产配额要提高，更多奴工要被拉进流程，更多运输工具要划拨给补给，清剿行动必须缩减，而“女性之国”的男性得把“奴隶”们催得更紧，还要建更多工厂。党卫军/BdM 能拼过斯大林的数量吗？

src: The quick defeat of Australia will allow us to continue the conquest of the South Pacific. Now it's New Zealand's turn, where some Australian and American troops have escaped to.  They must not have another base here, New Zealand is like a big carrier, and it eventually could support an allied invasion of our new possessions in Australia.  From Tokyo, your orders are to assault the Auckland sector from two sides.  Special Naval Landing Forces (2nd and 3rd Yokosuka with paratrooper training) will support your mission.  Also seize the key island of Waiheke and its airstrip.   Like other battles we must capture all the enemy airbases because they have relative air superiority.   At the beginning of this battle I advice you to keep your air units in a defensive role.
dst: 澳大利亚的迅速溃败使我们得以继续征服南太平洋。现在轮到新西兰了，一些澳大利亚和美国部队逃到了那里。他们绝不能在那里再拥有基地，新西兰就像一艘巨大的航母，最终可能支撑盟军对我们新占领的澳大利亚领土发起反攻。来自东京的命令是：从两个方向进攻奥克兰地区。特别海军陆战队（接受伞兵训练的第2、第3横须贺部队）将支援您的行动。同时夺取关键的怀赫科岛及其简易机场。与以往其他战斗一样，我们必须夺取敌军所有空军基地，因为他们拥有相对的空中优势。战斗开始时，我建议您让航空部队采取防御姿态。

src: The race to the sea is over. Ostend has been lost, but the ports of Dunkirk and Calais are in our hands.
dst: 冲向大海的赛跑结束了。奥斯坦德已经失守，但敦刻尔克和加来的港口仍在我们手中。

src: The raids have left their toll on the border provinces.  They are seen as very serious threats to the security of Estonia in Tallinn:  they may be precursors to an invasion by the Soviet Union.
dst: 这些袭扰已给边境省份造成惨重损失。它们被视为对塔林的爱沙尼亚安全的严重威胁：它们可能是苏联入侵的前兆。

src: The rebel march on Madrid is completely stopped for the moment. In the past weeks, the movements of the fascist have shown us that the enemy's plans have changed. Now they will try to encircle the capital, cutting our communications with Valencia (new seat of the Republican goverment). The High Command thinks that stopping the rebel plans is possible, and the best sector to do it is the Jarama river area (SE of Madrid). Provisional divisions have been formed for this duty.
dst: 目前叛军向马德里的进军已完全被阻止。近几周来，法西斯分子的调动向我们表明敌军的计划已经改变。如今他们将试图包围首都，切断我们与巴伦西亚（共和政府新所在地）的联系。最高统帅部认为阻止叛军计划是可能的，而最合适的地段就是哈拉马河地区（马德里东南）。为此已编组了若干临时师。

src: The rebel offensive in and around Levante has been stopped after our victory in Teruel!. Excellent work!
dst: 我军在特鲁埃尔获胜后，莱万特及其周边的叛军攻势已被遏止！干得漂亮！

src: The rebels seem to be really desperate now: they refreshed Breckinridge´s troops even with cadets from the Virginia Military Institute...
dst: 叛军现在似乎真是走投无路了：他们甚至用弗吉尼亚军事学院的学员来补充布雷肯里奇的部队……

src: The recent death of our beloved Franz Joseph I can't make us forget that we're still fighting a war that will decide the future of the Empire. Karl I is the new Kaiser, and we must make sure that he won't be the last.
dst: 我们敬爱的弗朗茨·约瑟夫一世近日驾崩，但这不能让我们忘记，我们仍在打一场决定帝国前途的战争。卡尔一世是新任皇帝，我们必须确保他不会成为末代皇帝。

src: The recent events had proved that the modernisation of the Chinese Army was essential for the survival of China. It had been a difficult and expensive task, but obviously the results had been excellent. The Qing Empire had, for the first time in decades, a military power that could guarantee the country's independence.
dst: 近来的事件证明，中国军队的现代化对中国的存亡至关重要。这是一项艰巨而昂贵的任务，但成果显然是出色的。大清帝国几十年来第一次拥有了一支能够保障国家独立的军事力量。

src: The reform of the army was one of the changes that Yohannes had in mind. As soon as he learnt that I was a veteran soldier, he decided to offer me that task. I would become his personal military advisor, I would live in the court, and I would have wealth and servants.
dst: 军队改革是约翰内斯心中所想的变革之一。他一得知我是一名老兵，便决定把这项任务交给我。我将成为他的私人军事顾问，住在宫廷里，拥有财富和仆人。

src: The reinforcements that have arrived with the new Governor-General Camilo Polavieja have been formed into a division, "Lachambre Division.", named after its commander, Major General José de Lachambre, with the objective of recapturing Cavite and crushing the Katipunan insurrection.
dst: 随新任总督卡米洛·波拉维哈抵达的增援部队被编为一个师——「拉尚布尔师」，以师长何塞·德·拉尚布尔少将命名，目标是夺回甲米地并粉碎卡蒂普南起义。

src: The remaining Australians have surrendered and the supplies are ours. Congratulations!
dst: 残余的澳大利亚人已投降，补给归我们了。恭喜！

src: The remains of the third U.S. Army are trapped at the tip of Michigan's Lower Peninsula, nicknamed The Mitten, and refuse to capitulate. Set an example and show the American people that further resistance is pointless. Destroy the enemy forces!
dst: 美国第3集团军的残余被困在绰号“手套”的密歇根下半岛尖端，拒绝投降。杀一儆百，让美国人民明白继续抵抗毫无意义。歼灭敌军！

src: The remanants of the Soviet Black Sea Fleet have gathered in this area. Do not underestimate them!
dst: 苏联黑海舰队的残部已在此区域集结。不要低估他们！

src: The remnants of the 11th Army have escaped to the Terek, but their defeat has been so absolute that I doubt they'll recover from it. Surely they'll merge with the 12th Army, that is currently dealing with a cossack rebellion against the Reds. Soon they'll have to deal with us, too. The Terek is our next objective.
dst: 第11集团军的残部已逃往捷列克，但他们的失败如此彻底，我怀疑他们能否恢复元气。他们肯定将与目前正忙于镇压反红军哥萨克起义的第12集团军会合。很快，他们也将不得不应付我们。捷列克是我们的下一个目标。

src: The remnants of the Royal Navy in the Mediterranean Sea have gathered in this area, so we expect serious naval opposition, but also a strong enemy air force.
dst: 地中海的皇家海军残部已聚集在这一区域，因此我们预计会遭遇激烈的海上抵抗，同时还有一支强大的敌军空军。

src: The republican army is determined to destroy us and take Estella, our capital. The troops of General Moriones, more than 15,000 men, have assaulted our advanced positions and now they already control the villages at the foothills of Montejurra.
dst: 共和军决意消灭我们，夺取我们的首府埃斯特利亚。莫里奥内斯将军的部队，一万五千余人，已向我军前沿阵地发起进攻，如今已控制了蒙特胡拉山脚下的村庄。

src: The republican plan has failed. Their troops flee from our vanguard, and within hours Carlos VII will enter triumphantly  in Bilbao. We have been informed that Irún and Pamplona also capitulated, and soon we will take San Sebastián and Vitoria.
dst: 共和派的计划已经失败。他们的部队在我军前锋面前溃逃，数小时内卡洛斯七世将凯旋进入毕尔巴鄂。我们获悉伊伦和潘普洛纳也已投降，很快我们还将攻克圣塞瓦斯蒂安和维多利亚。

src: The rescue of the British troops at Dunkirk provided a psychological boost to British morale; to the country at large it was spun as a major victory. While the British Army had lost a great deal of its equipment and vehicles in France, it still had most of its soldiers and was able to assign them to the defence of Britain. Once the threat of invasion receded, they were transferred overseas to the Middle East and other theatres and also provided the nucleus of the army that returned to France in 1944.
dst: 敦刻尔克英军的获救为英国士气提供了心理提振；对全国而言，它被宣传为一场重大胜利。虽然英国陆军在法国损失了大量装备和车辆，但它仍保住了大部分士兵，得以把他们用于保卫英国。一旦入侵威胁消退，他们便被调往海外，开赴中东和其他战区，并构成了1944年重返法国的那支军队的骨干。

src: The research facility is ruined, but maybe it's better that this devil work was destroyed...
dst: 研究设施已被毁，但也许这件魔鬼的作品被毁掉反而更好……

src: The research team made of Major Nicolae Anghel and Captain Gheorghe Sambotin had to develop an unique vehicle having at its disposal components of local or captured material. With the help of engineer Constantin Ghiulai, they started by mounting the 122mm Putilov-Obuhov howitzer model 1904/30 and a coaxial 7.92mm ZB machine-gun on a modified T-60 chassis. The upper structure was made of four sloped armour plates 20-30mm thick that was giving vehicle a turtle shape. The resulting prototype was nicknamed Maresal (marshal).
dst: 由尼古拉·安格尔少校与格奥尔基·桑博廷上尉组成的研究团队，须以本地或缴获材料部件开发出一款独特车辆。在工程师康斯坦丁·基乌莱的协助下，他们先在改装的T-60底盘上安装122毫米普蒂洛夫-奥布霍夫1904/30型榴弹炮与一挺7.92毫米同轴ZB机枪。上部结构由四块20—30毫米厚的倾斜装甲板构成，使车辆呈龟形。由此诞生的原型车被昵称为“元帅”（Maresal）。

src: The response of the Romans was hampered by the absence of the Roman legions, which were already engaged in fighting a revolt in Hispania and the Third Mithridatic War. So the Senate sent propraetor C. Claudius Glaber with only 3000 recruits.
dst: 罗马方面的反应因军团的缺席而迟缓——那些军团已投入西班牙的叛乱与第三次米特拉达梯战争。于是元老院只派了前法官盖乌斯克劳狄乌斯格拉贝鲁斯，带着3000名新兵。

src: The result of the battle was a complete disaster for the Filipino revolutionaries and it signalled the advent of Spanish recapture of Cavite province. Aguinaldo had lost the best of its forces and the remaining ones had to retreat towards Imus. Although it took still some weeks and hard combats for the Spanish to reconquer the entire Cavite, the result of the offensive was clear.
dst: 这场战役的结果对菲律宾革命者来说是一场彻底的灾难，它标志着西班牙开始收复甲米地省。阿吉纳尔多失去了最精锐的部队，余部不得不向伊穆斯撤退。尽管西班牙人又花了数周时间和艰苦战斗才重新征服整个甲米地，但这次攻势的结果已经十分明确。

src: The results of the battle differ considerably depending on the protagonists. For the Spanish, it was a victory that "deserved a place in the best pages of Spanish history" since despite fighting superior forces they have dislodged Cubans from their positions and were able to beat the enemy again on their return.
dst: 这场战役的结果因立场不同而大相径庭。对西班牙人而言，这是一场「配得上写入西班牙历史最光辉篇章」的胜利，因为尽管面对优势兵力，他们还是把古巴人逐出了阵地，并能在回程中再次击败敌人。

src: The retirement of our troops from the city had caused widespread panic among the Armenian population of the city:  fearing retribution from Turkey's soldiers, they had attempted to flee the border regions of Alashkert, Van, and Tabriz, but with little success.  We now have reports that some Armenians have organized into Armenian Druzhiny-volunteer units willing to support our army.  On the other side, our retreat had given Turkey the ability to recruit the wavering local populations of Bedouin and Kurd tribesmen to their cause:  be aware of Kurd raiders on your flanks.
dst: 我军撤出该城已引起城内亚美尼亚居民的普遍恐慌：他们惧怕土耳其士兵的报复，试图逃离阿拉什凯尔特、凡城和大不里士边境地区，但收效甚微。我们现在有报告称，一些亚美尼亚人已组建亚美尼亚义勇队志愿部队，愿意支援我军。另一方面，我们的撤退让土耳其得以招募当地摇摆不定的贝都因人和库尔德部落民加入其事业：提防您侧翼的库尔德劫掠者。

src: The retreat from Narva has turned into a rout.  The 4th Narva regiment has all but ceased to exist as desertion and defeatism spread through the ranks.  The German forces have pulled out of Estonia completely, leaving us to our own fate.  With the capture of the regimental HQ, which you miraculously avoided, you have been given the opportunity to re-form the regiment in the rank of Kolonel.  You must make way toward Tallinn to prepare the final stand of the republic against Soviet agression.
dst: 从纳尔瓦的撤退已演变成一场溃败。随着开小差和失败主义情绪在部队中蔓延，第4纳尔瓦团已几乎不复存在。德军已完全撤出爱沙尼亚，留下我们自生自灭。由于您奇迹般地躲过了团部被占，您获得了以上校军衔重建该团的机会。您必须向塔林进发，准备共和国对抗苏联侵略的最后一战。

src: The retreat was successful, Senor General, although a few more of our units have been captured by the enemy.
dst: 撤退很成功，将军先生，不过又有几支我军部队被敌军俘获。

src: The revolt was crushed. Almost 500 rebels were executed. Some of the opponents eventually joined the Soviets. Koltsjak's regime, however, was secured.
dst: 叛乱被镇压了。近500名叛军被处决。一些反对者最终投向了苏维埃。然而，高尔察克的政权得到了巩固。

src: The revolution has begun. A wildfire can develop. Help the comrades with it ...
dst: 革命已经开始。星星之火可以燎原。帮助同志们去点燃它……

src: The revolution is fomented. The coastal towns are in our hands. Now freed Frankfurt on Main and  conquer by this the city of Finance, or can Großherzog Ernst Ludwig of Hessen put down the rebellion?
dst: 革命已被煽动起来。沿海城镇已在我们手中。现在解放美因河畔法兰克福，并借此攻占这座金融之城，抑或黑森的大公恩斯特·路德维希能否镇压这场叛乱？

src: The revolution is over ... Many comrades have fallen. You are captured ... It is not difficult to guess that you expect death ...
dst: 革命结束了……许多同志倒下了。您被俘了……不难猜到您正等着死亡……

src: The revolution is stopped bloodily by the prussian army. Being better trained and much more they force the revolutionists to flee. They go to Switzerland and from there most of them go to the just established USA where they hope to live in freedom.
dst: 革命被普鲁士军队血腥镇压。由于训练更有素、兵力更雄厚，他们迫使革命者逃亡。革命者前往瑞士，其中大多数人又从那里前往刚刚建立的美国，希望在那里自由地生活。

src: The right column, heading for Chunuk Bair, took this summit on August 8th. The Wellington battalion held off the Turks who were counter-attacking time and time again, but out of the 760 men of the battalion who had reached the summit, 711 became casualties. With Turkish reinforcements arriving quickly, a further advance became impossible.
dst: 右纵队向楚努克拜尔进发，于8月8日夺取了这座山顶。威灵顿营一次又一次击退了反击的土耳其军，但在抵达山顶的760名官兵中，有711人成了伤亡。随着土耳其援军迅速赶到，进一步推进已不可能。

src: The rocket base is split in two.  The Soviets will take the northern facility if you take the southern facility.
dst: 火箭基地一分为二。你夺取南半部，苏联人就负责北半部设施。

src: The rockets were not just ballistic missiles. They were space flight capable.
dst: 那些火箭不只是弹道导弹。它们具备太空飞行能力。

src: The ruse worked perfectly and Germans not noticing anything suspicious walked right into the trap. Their losses were immense and once their morale crumbled, they ran away in panic. Unfortunately, Czechoslovaks were unable to capitalize on this gain, and the only thing they could do was to hide in the mountains and ultimately cross the frontline and join the Soviets. Many of them didn't make it, though...
dst: 计谋完美奏效，德军毫无察觉地径直走进了陷阱。他们损失惨重，士气一崩，便仓皇逃窜。遗憾的是，捷克斯洛伐克人未能扩大这一战果，唯一能做的就是躲进山里，最终穿过前线与苏军会合。不过，其中许多人没能走到……

src: The sad thing is that our army isn't strong enough to take advantage from your victories and launch an offensive. And our German allies think that Macedonia is a secondary front, so they won't send enough reinforcements here. That means that, despite your success, we'll have to adopt a defensive strategy during the next months, maybe years. However, the French have been badly beaten, so while they recover I don't think we'll see much action.
dst: 可悲的是，我军还不够强大，无法利用您的胜利发动进攻。而我们的德国盟友认为马其顿是个次要战线，因此不会向这里派遣足够的增援。这意味着，尽管您取得了成功，我们在接下来的几个月、甚至几年里仍将采取防御策略。不过，法国人已被打得大败，所以趁他们休整之际，我想我们不会看到太多战事。

src: The salient around Kursk, created by the Soviet advances after the German loss at Stalingrad, drew the Germans' attention.  The German plans, code named "Zitadelle", were to cut the bulge by capturing Prokhorovka.  While the Germans waited to receive their new Tiger and Panther tanks before attacking, the Soviets, knowing of the German plan, took this time to deploy their forces in depth.
dst: 德军在斯大林格勒失利后，苏军推进形成的库尔斯克周边突出部吸引了德军的注意。德军的计划代号“堡垒”，意图通过夺取普罗霍罗夫卡来切掉这个突出部。当德军等待接收新的“虎”式和“豹”式坦克再发动进攻时，已得知德军计划的苏军利用这段时间把部队作了纵深配置。

src: The same evening, the officers who were at that time in Samara and had decided to join the Komuch Army discussed who could unite us and lead us. Nobody wanted to take that responsibility. People hesitated, and we were embarrased and silent. One captain even suggested drawing lots. Then, lieutenant colonel Vladimir Kappel, one of the youngest officers, stood up and said "if nobody wants to lead then, until you find somebody with higher rank, let me lead the military units against the Bolsheviks".
dst: 当天晚上，当时在萨马拉并已决定加入科穆奇军队的军官们商议，谁能团结并领导我们。没有人愿意承担这份责任。大家犹豫不决，我们既尴尬又沉默。一位上尉甚至建议抽签决定。这时，最年轻的军官之一、弗拉基米尔·卡佩尔中校站起身来说：「如果没人愿意领导，那么，在你们找到军衔更高的人之前，就让我来率领部队对抗布尔什维克吧」。

src: The same time Marines with a lot of enemy ships are attacking Vassvik.
dst: 与此同时，敌军海军陆战队正随大批敌舰进攻 Vassvik。

src: The same time you fight with the British ships, some of your units land again at the north island of Shetland. Your target is to destroy the canons at east coast of Shetland and another enemy Radar close to Gutcher where you can than deploy the rest of your Marines. Luftwaffe has cleared enemy airforce and air defence but also destroyed all airfields.Therefore your Branderburgers can't fly. Your Marinestosstrup should repair some ports. For a couple of hours a Recon Bomber will assist you scan the north and east coast to locate where the canons are. Also a hospital ship will be there soon. Make sure that they can approach the coast. Stay focussed on your target, west coast is not a problem for us now!!!
dst: 在您与英国舰艇交战的同时，您的部分部队再次在设得兰群岛北部岛屿登陆。您的目标是摧毁设得兰群岛东海岸的火炮，以及古切尔附近另一处敌军雷达，之后您便可部署其余的海军陆战队。德国空军已肃清敌军空军和防空力量，但也摧毁了所有机场。因此您的勃兰登堡部队无法飞行。您的海军突击队应修复部分港口。数小时内将有一架侦察轰炸机协助您扫描北部和东部海岸，以定位火炮的位置。此外，一艘医院船很快也会抵达。确保它们能够靠近海岸。专注于您的目标，西海岸现在对我们不成问题！！！

src: The scenarios are not 100% authentic and some unit names are fiction...
dst: 这些场景并非百分之百真实，某些部队名称是虚构的……

src: The scope of your command has increased along with your promotion to Kindralmajor and the transfer to the Southern Estonian Front.
dst: 随着您晋升为少将并调往南爱沙尼亚战线，您的指挥范围也扩大了。
贝德里亚库姆第二次会战

src: The siege of Kut al Amara, April 17th 1916
dst: 库特阿马拉之围，1916年4月17日

src: The siege of Leninrad continues for months without end. Your panzer battalion is one of many units that were moved to the front.
dst: 列宁格勒的围城已持续数月而未有尽头。你的装甲营是被调往前线的众多部队之一。

src: The siege started when Budapest, defended by Hungarian and German troops, was first encircled on 29 December 1944 by the Red Army and the Romanian Army. The Soviet forces besieging the city were part of Rodion Malinovsky's 2nd Ukrainian Front. Arrayed against the Soviets was a collection of German Army (Wehrmacht Heer), Waffen-SS, and Hungarian Army (Honvédség) forces.
dst: 1944年12月29日，由匈牙利与德国军队防守的布达佩斯首次被红军与罗马尼亚军队合围，围城由此开始。围攻该城的苏军隶罗季翁·马利诺夫斯基的乌克兰第2方面军。与苏军对阵的，是德国陆军（国防军）、武装党卫军与匈牙利陆军（Honvédség）的混合兵力。

src: The siege was primarily conducted by Romanian forces and elements of the German Army's (Wehrmacht Heer) 11th Army (11. Armee).
dst: 围城主要由罗马尼亚军队与德国陆军（国防军）第11集团军（11. Armee）一部实施。

src: The situation at the Brjansker front is very grave. The XXIV. Motorized Army Corps could brake through your lines south of Brjansk. It may be expected that they will turn northwards and try to encircle your troops. Try to evacuate your troops slowly but do not miss to defend Brjansk and your other targets.
dst: 布良斯克前线局势十分严峻。第XXIV摩托化军突破了你们在布良斯克以南的防线。可以预料他们会转向北面，试图包围你们的部队。设法缓慢撤离你的部队，但不要忘记防守布良斯克和你的其他目标。

src: The situation has changed a lot in Burma over the last 2 years. Our decisive victory was not achieved on China, and now, the Chinese, Indians and the British have reorganized and strengthened their forces. The imperial glory will be stoped for the moment... your mission is to stop the Allied onslaught we are awaiting. Reports show that the Indian units will strike on Akyab, your mission is to stop them at all costs!. I would like to suggest you inspect the area, and use the mountain road to surprise them with the rearguard...
dst: 过去两年间缅甸的局势变化很大。我们未能在中国的作战中取得决定性胜利，如今中国军队、印度人和英国人已重整并加强了他们的部队。帝国的荣光暂时要止步了……您的任务是阻止我们正等待着的盟军猛攻。报告显示印度部队将进攻阿恰布，您的任务是不惜一切代价挡住他们！我建议您勘察一下地形，利用山路从后方给他们一个奇袭……

src: The situation here was worsened since you went to Hong Kong. The Boxers are determined to exterminate the foreigners and everything that they perceive as non-Chinese. They're murdering all the local Christians that they can find, as well as any Westerner unfortunate enough to bump into them. Rape and pillaging have become routinary, the international legations in Peking are under siege, and now the Qing government is actively supporting those bandits.
dst: 自您去香港以来，这里的局势愈发恶化。义和团决心灭绝外国人和一切他们视为非中国的东西。他们残杀所有能找到的本地基督徒，以及任何不幸撞上他们的西方人。强奸与劫掠已成常态，北京的外国使馆区被围，如今清政府更是在积极支持这些暴徒。

src: The situation is as follows: As you know Hitler has died of a bomb blast in the Wolfsschanze and the army has performed a coup d'etat. General Beck, the old chief of staff has become head of state, marshall Von Witzleben commander in chief, and the parliament of 1933 including the communists has been called back. Becoming chancellor Herr Speer has played an admirable role in the whole affair winning over a lot of officials to the new order.
dst: 情况如下：如您所知，希特勒已在狼穴死于炸弹爆炸，陆军已发动政变。原总参谋长贝克将军已出任国家元首，冯·维茨莱本元帅任总司令，1933年的国会（包括共产党人在内）已被重新召集。出任总理的施佩尔先生在整个事件中表现令人钦佩，为新的秩序争取到了许多官员。

src: The situation is becoming really dangerous, we have an important lack of fuel and tanks, and the enemy has air superiority. Also the minefileds, are inflicting big losses on our units... We will launch a last hit to the British, hoping to surprise them like in the past - otherwise you must fight at any cost, until the last man!.
dst: 局势正变得极为危险，我们严重缺乏燃料和坦克，而敌人握有制空权。此外，雷场也让我们的部队损失惨重……我们将对英军发动最后一击，希望能像过去那样打他们一个措手不及——否则你就必须不惜一切代价战斗到底，直到最后一人！

src: The situation is critical! Mud and rain also take their toll. Maybe the germans are aware of our bad position and might launch a counterattack.
dst: 形势危急！泥泞与大雨也在消耗着他们。也许德国人察觉到了我方的糟糕处境，可能会发动一次反击。

src: The situation is dramatic. Several German breakthroughs have been reported. The front is about to break and there are no more reserves to restore the line. A new retreat to the Ijzer/Yser River as suggested by General Weygand is not possible: we would simply lose our ammunition depots since we no longer have the capacity to move them once more. In addition, in the current state of fatigue and demoralization a new retreat would mean the total disintegration of the Army (I guess you are aware of the recent mass surrender of several large units in Gand/Gent). Finally, our British allies have decided to evacuate their expeditionary force in Northern France. In view of the situation King Leopold III has requested, and the Germans have accepted, unconditional surrender. The cease-fire will start at 4.00 A.M of the 28th May.
dst: 局势十分严峻。已有多处德军突破的报告。战线即将崩溃，再没有预备队来恢复防线。魏刚将军建议再次撤退到艾泽尔河/伊瑟河已不可能：我们只会失去弹药库，因为我们已没有能力再把它们搬运一次。此外，在当前疲惫和士气低落的状态下，再次撤退将意味着军队的彻底瓦解（我想你已经知道最近在根特有几支大部队集体投降）。最后，我们的英国盟友已决定撤走他们在法国北部的远征军。鉴于这种局势，国王利奥波德三世已请求无条件投降，德军也已接受。停火将于5月28日凌晨4时开始。

src: The situation is extremely dangerous, we have stopped our offensive over Valencia because the red forces have succesfully crossed the big curve of the river Ebro near to Gandesa (Tarragona). This is a strong attack, the best enemy troops are carrying out this assault; our 50 Division is completely defeat and now it's resisting desperately agaisnt the Republican assaults to Gandesa and Villalva de los Arcos.
dst: 局势极其危险，我们已经停止了向巴伦西亚的进攻，因为共和军成功渡过了甘德萨（塔拉戈纳）附近埃布罗河的大转弯处。这是一次强有力的进攻，敌军最精锐的部队正在实施这场突击；我们的第50师已彻底被击溃，如今正拼死抵抗共和军对比利亚尔瓦德洛斯阿尔科斯和甘德萨的进攻。

src: The situation is not good.  The Americans have launched a counterattack defeating our Eastern positions and also our positions on the hills southwards to Tenaru.  Although the enemy forces are besieged, the initial landings are being supported by many additional navy and air units, plus some reinforcements. Also, they have fortified their positions, and the battle will be bloody...  Your main objective is to capture ''Henderson Field'', the airstrip from which the enemy has been receiving supplies to maintain the beach head. Your command is now attached to the 17th Army.  The Imperial Navy is here to engage the American Navy, let's see what our ships can achieve against the enemy vessels.
dst: 局势不妙。美国人发动了反攻，击溃了我们在东面的阵地，以及我们位于特纳鲁河以南山丘上的阵地。尽管敌军已被包围，但最初的登陆正得到大量海军与空中单位的支援，外加一些增援部队。而且他们已经加固了阵地，这场仗将会血流成河……您的主要目标是夺取「亨德森机场」，敌军正是通过这座机场获得补给以维持滩头阵地的。您所部现已配属第 17 军。帝国海军在此迎战美国海军，让我们看看我方舰只对付敌舰能有何作为。

src: The situation is not hopeless General. Some of Vimy Ridge is still in our hands and reinforcements are ready for a counterattack.
dst: 形势并非毫无希望，将军。维米岭的一部分仍在我方手中，增援部队也已准备好反攻。

src: The situation is so desperate that Denikin has had no choice but to employ all of his available officers, including myself. Three days ago he gave me the command of the area of Kharkov, in Ukraine. He's ordered me to stop the initial Soviet assault and hold the city as long as I can, thus giving the rest of our army the opportunity to regroup and retreat in order to the Donbass and the Kuban.
dst: 局势已绝望到邓尼金别无选择，只能起用所有可用的军官，包括我自己。三天前，他把乌克兰哈尔科夫地区的指挥权交给了我。他命令我挡住苏维埃的初次进攻，尽可能久地守住该城，从而为其余部队争取重新集结并向顿巴斯和库班撤退的机会。

src: The situation is worrisome. Our troops can hardly move on the conquered ground, and they won't be able to take all the relevant defensive points before the French reinforcements arrive. So when the enemy deploys its reserves, our own soldiers will be exposed to artillery fire, too. They won't be safe and we'll suffer many casualties.
dst: 局势令人担忧。我们的部队在占领的土地上几乎寸步难行，无法在法军增援到达之前夺取所有关键防御要点。因此，当敌人部署其预备队时，我们自己的士兵也将暴露在炮火之下。他们将不再安全，我们会遭受大量伤亡。

src: The situation is worse in the Western Front. The French have been relatively quiet since the failure of the Nivelle Offensive, but the British have taken us to the limit. In spring they defeated us at Messines, and after that we could hardly resist them at Passendale. If they try again this year I don't know what could happen.
dst: 西线的局势更糟。自尼韦勒攻势失败以来，法国人相对安静，但英国人已把我们逼到了极限。春天，他们在梅西讷击败了我们，此后在帕斯尚尔，我们几乎抵挡不住他们。如果他们今年再来一次，我不知道会发生什么。

src: The situation map shows the remnants of the Third Romanian Army in a pocket on 21 November 1942, while the Soviet offensive continues to the south and southeast.
dst: 态势图显示了1942年11月21日被围在口袋中的罗马尼亚第三集团军残部，此时苏军攻势正向南与东南方向继续推进。

src: The situation of the British troops at the Doiran Lake isn't good, either. But they are determined to break the Macedonian front during their spring offensive. Right now, three British divisions are preparing an offensive against us. This time all of our positions must hold, so don't forget it. Prepare your troops and good luck.
dst: 多伊兰湖英军的情况也不好。但他们决心在春季攻势中突破马其顿战线。眼下，三个英国师正在准备向我们发动进攻。这一次，我们所有阵地都必须守住，别忘了这一点。准备好您的部队，祝您好运。

src: The situation on the East front is not good after our abortive summer offensive.
dst: 在夏季攻势失利后，东线的局势并不乐观。

src: The situation was chaotic. The Red Army was approaching from three different sides and nothing seemed to be able to stop them. Rumours indicated that part of the Turkestan Army had crossed the river Belaya north of Ufa. If that was true, the Bolsheviks could cut our only retreat line in just a few days.
dst: 局势一片混乱。红军正从三个不同方向逼近，似乎什么都无法阻挡他们。传闻称，土耳其斯坦集团军的一部分已在乌法以北渡过别拉亚河。如果属实，布尔什维克几天之内就能切断我们唯一的退路。
斯滕斯特拉特的小规模冲突——1915年4月

src: The small amount of ground that has been captured during this battle hardly justifies our appaling casualties. Our losses make it difficult enough to hold the little ground we have, let alone continue to capture more. For the time being, all we can do is dig in and wait for further reinforcements.
dst: 这场战斗中夺取的少量土地几乎无法弥补我们惊人的伤亡。我们的损失使得连守住现有的一小块土地都很困难，更不用说继续夺取更多了。眼下，我们能做的只有掘壕固守，等待进一步增援。

src: The small kingdom of Belgium is about to suffer its worst ordeal since the independence. Situated between two of the world’s most powerful nations, two bitter enemies who wish to destroy each other, neutrality isn’t an option.
dst: 小小的比利时王国即将遭受自独立以来最严峻的考验。它夹在两个世界最强大的国家之间，这两个死敌都想置对方于死地，中立并非选项。

src: The so-called Great Western Offensive has quickly bogged down. Not counting the Estaires sector that you were defending the British have achieved a limited success, but in general the Franco-British attack is being a costly waste of time for them. They'll still keep on trying, just like they did at the Somme, Chemin des Dames or Passendale, and just like we did at Verdun. But eventually it will be useless. There won't be a second Cambrai. By the way, the Portuguese have suffered so many casualties that purportedly they've asked for the withdrawal of their troops from the battlefront. From now on they'll just perform auxiliary tasks in the rearguard.
dst: 所谓的西方大攻势很快陷入了僵局。不算您防守的埃斯泰尔地段，英军取得了有限的战果，但总体而言，法英联军的进攻对他们自己来说，是一场代价高昂的时间浪费。他们仍会继续尝试，就像他们在索姆河、贵妇小径或帕斯尚尔所做的那样，也像我们在凡尔登所做的那样。但最终这一切都将是徒劳。不会有第二次康布雷了。顺带一提，葡萄牙人伤亡如此惨重，据说他们已请求把自己的部队从前线撤下。从今往后，他们将只在后方承担辅助任务。

src: The so-called Great Western Offensive has quickly bogged down. The British have achieved a limited success, but in general the Franco-British attack is being a costly waste of time for them. They'll still keep on trying, just like they did at the Somme, Chemin des Dames or Passendale, and just like we did at Verdun. But eventually it will be useless. There won't be a second Cambrai.
dst: 所谓的西方大攻势很快陷入了僵局。英军取得了有限的战果，但总体而言，法英联军的进攻对他们自己来说，是一场代价高昂的时间浪费。他们仍会继续尝试，就像他们在索姆河、贵妇小径或帕斯尚尔所做的那样，也像我们在凡尔登所做的那样。但最终这一切都将是徒劳。不会有第二次康布雷了。

src: The soldiers of Czechoslovak army in the east fought many hard and bloody battles. Many of them had very bitter experiences with the communism and they despised it wholeheartedly.
dst: 东线捷克斯洛伐克军队的士兵们打了许多艰苦而血腥的仗。他们中许多人有着对共产主义的痛苦经历，发自内心地鄙视它。

src: The song was prohibited in France until 1974. Even though an award of 1 million francs and the immediate honorable release from the army were offered for revealing the original author of the song, he remained unknown.
dst: 这首歌在法国一直被禁到1974年。尽管悬赏100万法郎并立即光荣退役以征集这首歌原作者的身份，原作者始终无人知晓。

src: The southern wing of the front has been deployed on the Carpathian mountain passes and has the exceedingly difficult task of disengaging from the enemy and maintaining cohesion, while it catches up to the rest of the front's retreat.
dst: 方面军南翼已部署在喀尔巴阡山各山口，承担着与敌脱离接触并保持凝聚力的极其艰巨任务，同时还要赶上方面军其余部队的撤退步伐。

src: The soviet horde has been destroyed, and now our manchukoan allies can sleep well, without the red menace from the West. Emperor Pu-Yi sends you his congrats.
dst: 苏联大军已被消灭，如今我们的满洲国盟友可以安睡了，不必再担心来自西方的红色威胁。溥仪皇帝向您致以祝贺。

src: The soviets have defeated you!, well, for this time it's not important; the enemy had a larger amount of troops, but we hope your skills will improve in the near future. Now, let's go back to China.
dst: 苏军击败了您！不过，这一次无关紧要；敌军兵力更为庞大，但我们希望您的本领能在不久的将来有所长进。现在，我们回中国去吧。

src: The soviets sent a lot of troops; however you and your brave soldiers have reached all the operation goals with the desired final result.  Now the hills and other strategic locations are in our hands.  Maybe in the future Vladivostok could be the next target in this area. Congratulations for your promotion to General of the Imperial Army!
dst: 苏联人派来了大量部队；不过，您和您勇敢的士兵们还是以理想的最终结果达成了作战的全部目标。如今各高地及其他战略要点都在我们手中。也许今后这一地区的下一个目标就是符拉迪沃斯托克。祝贺您晋升为帝国陆军将军！

src: The spring wasn't over yet, and it seemed that we were about to repel the last counterattacks made by the Bolsheviks. Reaching the Volga wasn't a long term plan anymore. Victory was so close that I could almost grasp it.
dst: 春天尚未结束，而我们似乎即将击退布尔什维克发起的最后几次反攻。抵达伏尔加河已不再是一个长期计划。胜利如此之近，我几乎触手可及。

src: The start of Russian summer offensive seemed promising, but sadly it has lost momentum. I'm afraid that it could become a costly waste of time.
dst: 俄军夏季攻势的开始似乎很有希望，但遗憾的是它已经失去了势头。我担心这可能会变成一场代价高昂的徒劳。

src: The steppe cossacks were anxious to liberate their capital, which they had lost in January. Unfortunately, Hetman Dutov's Separate Orenburg Army did not have sufficient artillery, or even infantry troops, to assault a fortified city like Orenburg with any chances of success, so Kolchak decided that part of our Western Army would reinforce Dutov. He knew that the Soviets had two veteran divisions in the area, as well as several units of communist militias, and he didn't want to take any risks.
dst: 草原哥萨克急于解放他们在1月失去的首府。不幸的是，盖特曼杜托夫的独立奥伦堡集团军既没有足够的炮兵，也没有足够的步兵，无法对奥伦堡这样设防的城市发动任何有胜算的进攻，于是高尔察克决定，让我们西方面军的一部分去增援杜托夫。他知道苏维埃在该地区有两个久经沙场的师以及若干共产民兵部队，他不想冒任何风险。

src: The storming of the earthworks at Magruntein was immediately followed by the collapse of the whole enemy resistance. The Turkish reinforcements withdrew when they discovered the fall of the position. With victory at Rafa, we are now in a position to advance into Palestine, but to do so would require the capture of the Turkish fortress of Gaza...
dst: 对马格伦泰恩工事的突击随即带来了敌军整体抵抗的崩溃。土耳其增援部队在发现阵地陷落后便撤退了。凭借拉法的胜利，我们现在得以向巴勒斯坦推进，但要做到这一点就必须攻占土耳其的加沙要塞……

src: The story of 3 SS divisions attacking Prochorovka with hunderds of Tiger and Panther tanks is a myth and so is the SS divisions loosing +400 tanks in the engagement. The Panther battalions where in Germany and each division had only 1 Tiger company. At the start of  Zitadelle, the 3 divisions of IISS Panzer Corps, totalled no more than about 350 tanks. By the time the battle for Prochorovka started, the number of operational tanks had dropped to 211 - T: 94 / LSSAH: 56 / Reich: 61. Only 15 were Tigers. After the battle, II SS Panzer Corps reported 163 operational tanks. Russian tank losses were close to 650.
dst: 所谓3个党卫军师以数百辆“虎”式和“豹”式坦克进攻普罗霍罗夫卡的故事是个神话，说党卫军各师在此战中损失400多辆坦克同样如此。当时“豹”式营还在德国，每个师只有1个“虎”式连。在“堡垒”行动开始时，党卫军第2装甲军的3个师总计不过约350辆坦克。到普罗霍罗夫卡之战打响时，可用坦克数量已降到211辆——“骷髅”94辆／警卫旗队56辆／“帝国”61辆，其中只有15辆“虎”式。战斗结束后，党卫军第2装甲军报告有163辆可用坦克。俄军坦克损失接近650辆。

src: The strategic effect was nevertheless favourable, due to the fact that from then on, one third of the total German and Ottoman forces had to be stationed east of the Jordan. These two operations had convinced the German and Ottoman High Command that their left flank would be the main focus of British offensive activity, and that Allenby would not advance on the coastal plain until he had secured his right flank with the capture of Amman.
dst: 然而，战略效果仍然是有利的，因为从那以后，德军和奥斯曼军总兵力的三分之一不得不驻扎在约旦河以东。这两次行动使德奥最高统帅部相信，他们的左翼将是英军进攻活动的主要焦点，阿伦比在攻占安曼以巩固其右翼之前不会在沿海平原推进。

src: The strategic possibilities of this natural position before Keren, has been for many years appreciated by the Italians as a defence of Asmara and the highlands of Eritrea. On the Keren escarpment General Luigi Frusci, the sixty-two-year-old commander in the field, who had served in the Spanish Civil War, has decided to make his main stand, and to concentrate the bulk of his forces here.
dst: 克伦前方这一天然阵地的战略价值，多年来一直为意大利人所看重，视其为阿斯马拉和厄立特里亚高地的屏障。在克伦悬崖上，六十二岁、曾参加过西班牙内战的战场指挥官路易吉·弗鲁希将军决定在此作殊死一搏，并把他大部分兵力集中于此。

src: The strategic situation on the Kavkaz Front has become extremely favorable for us:  following the loss of an entire army at Sarykamysh, the remaining Turkish second-line troops have been unable to resist our spring offensive.  The key goal of the campaign remains the fortress of Erzerum, which guards the entrance to Anatolian plains in Turkey proper.  The IV Kavkaz Corps has been tasked by the Front Command with outflanking the Erzerum defenders from the south.  To accomplish this task, Sharpantier's cavalry and the Azerbaijansky Otriad are to march over 400 km to the NW to participate in the Meliazgert Operation, scheduled to begin in June.
dst: 高加索方面军的战略态势已对我极为有利：继在萨雷卡梅什损失整整一个集团军后，土耳其剩余的二线部队已无力抵挡我们的春季攻势。此次战役的关键目标仍是埃尔祖鲁姆要塞，它扼守着土耳其本土安纳托利亚平原的入口。方面军指挥部已责成第4高加索军从南面包抄埃尔祖鲁姆守军。为完成此任务，沙尔庞捷的骑兵和阿塞拜疆集群须向西北行军400多公里，参加定于六月开始的梅利亚兹盖尔特战役。

src: The strength of our allies in the DAK is down to 55 tanks, 54 guns and 500 infantry divided between 15Pz and 21Pz. 90Le has 53 guns and 1700 infantry left.
dst: 我们在非洲军的盟军兵力已降至55辆坦克、54门火炮和500名步兵，分属第15和第21装甲师。第90轻装师还剩53门火炮和1700名步兵。

src: The stringent need for modernising the Romanian armoured force made the specialists of the Ministry of Army Endowment and War Production to study the possibility of upgrading the R-2 tank in early 1943.
dst: 罗马尼亚装甲部队现代化的迫切需求，促使陆军装备与军工生产部的专家们于1943年初研究改进R-2坦克的可能。

src: The stubbornness and determination of the German assaults finally succeeded when they found a weak point in our lines and overran our positions. I tried to recover the lost ground, but when the battle was almost over, German artillery shelled the house where I was spending the night, shrapnel injured my chest, and I had to be taken to a campaign hospital. Haig sent reinforcements, and the gap in our lines was closed again.
dst: 德军进攻的顽强与坚决最终奏效了，他们发现了我们防线上的一个薄弱点，攻占了我军的阵地。我试图夺回失地，但战斗即将结束时，德军炮火轰击了我过夜的那栋房子，弹片击伤了我的胸口，我不得不被送往野战医院。黑格派来了增援，我们防线上的缺口再次被封闭。

src: The success of this mission was uncertain, and finally, the large number of reinforcements the allies sent to the battlefield have overwhelmed us. Now, it's time to retreat and reorganize our units.
dst: 这次任务本就胜负难料，最终盟军投向战场的大量增援压垮了我们。现在该撤退并重整我们的部队了。

src: The summer of 1914 changed the world. The Great War broke out. The Turkish government didn't want to fight, although it suspected that Russia would eventually attack Turkey. Besides, when the British government took over two newly built battleships that the Ottoman Empire had ordered to British shipyards: the Reshadiye (later known as HMS Erin) and the Sultan I Osman (later known as HMS Agincourt),  the Ottoman public opinion turned against Britain, too.
dst: 1914年的夏天改变了世界。世界大战爆发了。土耳其政府本不想参战，尽管它怀疑俄国最终会进攻土耳其。此外，当英国政府接管了奥斯曼帝国向英国造船厂订购的两艘新建战列舰——雷沙迪耶号（后称英国皇家海军埃琳号）和苏丹奥斯曼一世号（后称英国皇家海军阿金库尔号）时，奥斯曼的公众舆论也转而反对英国。

src: The sunset of the Spanish Empire - The Spanish American War 1898
dst: 西班牙帝国的落日 - 1898年美西战争

src: The sunset of the Spanish Empire - The Spanish-American War 1898
dst: 西班牙帝国的落日——美西战争 1898

src: The supply shortage has already considerably weakened the Romans .... and in this situation Caesar comes with an unexpected move:
dst: 补给短缺已大大削弱了罗马人 .... 就在此时，凯撒走出了一步出人意料的棋：

src: The swarm of Bolshevik soldiers was too much for my exhausted troops. Kharkov has fallen and we'll have to run to safer positions. Thank God that, due to the cold winter, the Reds won't chase us fast enough to encircle us.
dst: 蜂拥而至的布尔什维克士兵对我疲惫不堪的部队来说实在太多了。哈尔科夫陷落了，我们不得不逃往更安全的阵地。感谢上帝，由于寒冬，红军无法足够迅速地追击以包围我们。

src: The taking of Amiens improved the safety and the stability of the Prussian positions at the northern battlefront. However, the French units that could survive, with the help of new volunteers, kept on fighting against the Prussians until the last days of the war.
dst: 攻占亚眠改善了普鲁士人在北部战线阵地的安全与稳定。然而，那些幸存下来的法军部队，在新志愿兵的帮助下，仍继续与普鲁士人作战，直到战争的最后几天。

src: The terms of the treaty were devastating for the Chinese pride. Sorrow and resentment against foreigners, especially Westerners and Japanese, spread incredibly fast in all the country. Millions of voices cried for revenge, for the expulsion of the "white devils" and for the end of the foreign concessions. The Chinese government, which secretly supported those claims, did nothing to control the protesters, and as the century came to and end it was obvious that a new war would start soon. All that we could do was to go on with the modernization of the Chinese Army, and pray for being ready when the Empire needed us.
dst: 和约条款对中国人的自尊心是毁灭性的打击。对外国人，尤其是对西方人和日本人的悲愤与怨恨，以惊人的速度传遍全国。无数人呐喊要复仇，要驱逐「白鬼」，要终结外国租界。暗中支持这些诉求的清政府没有采取任何措施去控制抗议者，而随着世纪行将结束，一场新的战争显然很快就会爆发。我们所能做的，就是继续推进中国军队的现代化，并祈祷当帝国需要我们时我们已经准备就绪。

src: The terrain and the season reduce the chances of breaking through the Reinhard line - and the Gustav line behind it - that bars our advance to Rome. But by maintaining pressure, however, we can prevent the Germans from resting and refitting the tired and depleted divisions which they might hold as a mobile reserve for the close defense of Rome in the event of an Allied landing on the west coast or for use in a possible counteroffensive in the opening months of 1944.
dst: 地形与季节降低了突破莱因哈德防线——及其后方的古斯塔夫防线——的机会，这道防线挡在我军通向罗马的路上。但通过持续施压，我们可以让德军无法休整补充那些疲惫残缺的师——这些师本可被留作机动预备队，用于盟军西海岸登陆时近距离保卫罗马，或用于1944年头几个月的可能反攻。

src: The threat of our armies in Southern Russia being encircled has been countered although you did not recapture Kharkov as intended. We destroyed or severely damadged 4 Soviet Armies and regained most of the territory lost in January. Prepare your troops for a Summer offensive near Kursk.
dst: 我军在南俄被合围的威胁已被化解，尽管你未能如期夺回哈尔科夫。我们歼灭或重创了4个苏军集团军，并夺回了1月丢失的大部分领土。让你的部队为库尔斯克附近的夏季攻势做好准备。

src: The threat of our armies in Southern Russia being encircled has been countered. We destroyed or severely damadged 4 Soviet Armies and regained most of the territory lost in January. Prepare your troops for a Summer offensive near Kursk.
dst: 我军在南俄被合围的威胁已被化解。我们歼灭或重创了4个苏军集团军，并夺回了1月丢失的大部分领土。让你的部队为库尔斯克附近的夏季攻势做好准备。
战局逆转: 奇斯托波尔

src: The time for Operation Citadel has come. You are to attack and destroy the Soviet forces in the Kursk salient. The seizure of several key cities behind the front lines (including Kursk) is the key to this battle. You must capture all of your objectives by July 24th. We must warn you that we expect massive Russian counterattacks in your sector to begin within ten days. If you are unable to take all of your objectives, you must at a minimum hold two objectives.
dst: 堡垒行动的时刻已经到来。你要进攻并歼灭库尔斯克突出部的苏军。夺取前线后方的若干重要城市（包括库尔斯克），是此战的关键。你必须在7月24日前夺取所有目标。必须提醒你，我们预计你所在战区将在十天内遭到苏军的大规模反攻。如果你无法夺取全部目标，至少必须守住两个目标。

src: The time for the counteroffensive has arrived. After the first victories in the past year, the British have again recaptured Cyrenaica.  Now we are in a good position to attack Mersa el Brega, and maybe then, Agedabia. If we can retake these points we will be able to siege Benghazi again and maybe recapture Cyrenaica, restoring the front lines of the past year.
dst: 反攻的时刻到了。在去年取得最初的胜利之后，英军再次夺回了昔兰尼加。现在我们处于有利位置，可以进攻布赖加港，或许接着进攻阿杰达比亚。如果我们能夺回这些要点，就能再次围困班加西，或许还能收复昔兰尼加，恢复去年的战线。

src: The time goes by, and our comrades in Premissel are still trapped, besieged by the Russians. We can't leave them there. We must keep on trying, until we open a gap in the Russian lines. Our casualties are horrendous, and our men are exhausted, but we won't abandon our brethren while there is a spark of life in our souls.
dst: 时光流逝，我们在普热梅希尔的战友仍被围困，遭到俄国人围攻。我们不能丢下他们不管。我们必须继续尝试，直到在俄军防线上撕开一个口子。我们的伤亡惨重，士兵们疲惫不堪，但只要我们灵魂中还有一丝生命之火，就不会抛弃自己的同胞。

src: The time has come for retaking Port Elizabeth and Port Alfred. The British are still obsessed with the defence of Kaapstad, so they have sent just two divisions to this area. However, defeating them isn't going to be an easy task. While you were fighting in Natal Kitchener managed to build a strong line of blockhouses to protect the mountain passes. And at least three British battleships patrol the coast in order to give support to the defenders of the main towns.
dst: 重夺伊丽莎白港和阿尔弗雷德港的时刻到了。英军仍执着于开普敦的防御，所以他们只派了两个师到这一地区。然而，击败他们绝非易事。当您在纳塔尔作战时，基钦纳设法修建了一条坚固的碉堡线来保护各山口。而且至少有三艘英国战列舰在沿海巡逻，以支援各主要城镇的守军。

src: The time has come for the decisive battle of 1941. The Soviets have marshalled their troops to defend Moscow the economic and political key to Russia. It is time for you to hurl your forces at Moscow. You must break through their defenses and take Moscow before the combination of winter weather and Siberian reinforcements can steal the initiative. If Moscow can be taken and held this winter, the Soviets will undoubtedly surrender.
dst: 1941年决定性会战的时刻已经到来。苏军已集结兵力保卫莫斯科，此地是俄国经济与政治的关键所在。现在，该由你把部队投向莫斯科了。你必须突破他们的防御，在冬季天气与西伯利亚增援夺走先手之前拿下莫斯科。若能在这个冬季攻占并守住莫斯科，苏联无疑将会投降。

src: The time has come to break the stalemate of the last decade and open a new front against the Japanese mongrels.  You are to take your forces and cross the border here, at Teheran.
dst: 打破过去十年的僵局、对日本杂种开辟新战线的时刻到了。你须率部在此处——德黑兰——越过边境。

src: The time has come to destory the enemy on the Kuban steppes. They have been there for far too long. And finally, after months of preparations, we are in position for a full-scale attack on the fascist perimeter. Near Kursk, our units are rolling west again. We must follow and make the enemy see that the Red Army has arisen from its ashes!
dst: 时候到了，该消灭库班草原上的敌人了。他们在那里待得太久了。经过数月的准备，我们终于就位，可以对法西斯的外围发动全面进攻了。在库尔斯克附近，我们的部队又向西推进了。我们必须跟上，让敌人看到红军已从灰烬中重生！

src: The time has come, General. Your troops must establish the eastern beachheads at Alhucemas Bay and then they will have to take Axdir, the main focus of Abd el-Krim's rebellion. If all goes well, this operation will make us win this war. We trust in you, General. Go!
dst: 时候到了，将军。您的部队必须在阿尔胡塞马斯湾建立东侧滩头阵地，随后还必须攻占阿克斯迪尔——阿卜杜·克里姆叛乱的策源地。如果一切顺利，这场行动将让我们赢得这场战争。我们信任您，将军。去吧！

src: The time has come. During all of these months, after our victories in Eastern Europe and Italy, we've been preparing ourselves for this. Our Great Spring Offensive against France, the Kaiserschlacht. We've gathered everything we have: men, weapons, ammunition, everything. This time we have a large and mobile reserve ready to attack as soon as you open a gap in the enemy lines.
dst: 时候到了。这几个月来，在东欧和意大利取得胜利之后，我们一直在为此做准备。我们对法国的伟大春季攻势——皇帝会战。我们已集结了所能集结的一切：人员、武器、弹药，应有尽有。这一次，我们拥有一支庞大而机动灵活的预备队，只要您一在敌军战线上撕开缺口，他们就能立即投入进攻。

src: The time has come. It's been two long months, but in the end we're here, ready to take revenge on the Serbians. We've crossed the Drina and now we must head towards Belgrad, in the east. Russia will attack our frontiers soon, so it's important to overcome the Serbian army as quickly as possible. However, don't underestimate them. The Serbians may be poor, and badly equipped, but they've won two wars in the last two years, against the Ottomans and the Bulgarians, so their troops are more experienced than ours. They're a tough bunch and besides, they know the terrain very well. They'll use the mountains and hills to their advantage. So be careful, and good luck!
dst: 时候到了。已经过去漫长的两个月，但我们终于来到了这里，准备向塞尔维亚人复仇。我们已渡过德里纳河，现在必须向东部进发，直指贝尔格莱德。俄国很快会进攻我们的边境，因此尽快击败塞尔维亚军队至关重要。不过，别低估他们。塞尔维亚人也许贫穷、装备低劣，但他们在过去两年里打赢了两场战争，对手是奥斯曼人与保加利亚人，所以他们的部队比我们更有经验。他们是一群硬骨头，而且非常熟悉地形。他们会利用山地丘陵发挥优势。所以要小心，祝您好运！

src: The time has finally come to smash down the walls of "Fortress Europe". Welcome to Operation Overlord. Our part in this Magnum Opus is to estabilish a bridgehead on the beach code named "Juno". This is an 8km wide stretch of beach bordering Saint Aubin, Bernieres, Courselles-sur-Mer and Graye-sur-Mer in occupied France. After clearing the beach, drive as deeply into enemy held territory as possible, capturing all key points of enemy resistance. Good luck General...
dst: 终于到了砸碎“欧洲堡垒”城墙的时候了。欢迎参加霸王行动。我们在这部鸿篇巨制中承担的任务，是在代号“朱诺”的海滩上建立桥头堡。这是被占领的法国境内一段宽8公里的海滩，毗邻圣欧班、贝尼耶尔、滨海库尔瑟勒和滨海格赖。肃清海滩之后，尽可能深入地突入敌占区，夺取敌人所有抵抗要点。祝你好运，将军……

src: The time has finally come.  We are to advance across the Rhine and into Germany, where we will finally bring the war to an end!  As part of Operation Plunder, we will cross and secure the city of Rees.  After that, we will continue the advance deep into Germany, advancing along the roads to Bremen and Hannover.
dst: 时刻终于来临。我们要渡过莱茵河、挺进德国，在那里最终结束这场战争！作为掠夺行动的一部分，我们将渡河并夺取雷斯城。之后，我们将沿通往不来梅和汉诺威的道路继续向德国腹地推进。

src: The town itself had impressive defences, both natural and man-made, but the quality and the morale of the local garrison were very poor. Were it not for our presence, I'm sure that the Japanese would have taken Liushun with little effort, causing a massacre among the Chinese. Now, at the very least, the Japanese would have to pay a high price for their victory.
dst: 这座城镇本身拥有令人惊叹的天然和人造防御工事，但当地守军的素质和士气却非常低落。若非我们在此，我确信日本人会毫不费力地占领旅顺，并在中国人中制造一场大屠杀。如今，至少日本人将不得不为他们的胜利付出高昂的代价。

src: The trapped opponents still have several dangerous tank divisions and plenty infantry. The air force will made problems to you, especially because you will have no airfield at the beginning of the battle. The next airfield is too far away. Be sure that you have troops that can build an airport.
dst: 被围的对手仍拥有若干危险的坦克师和大量步兵。空军会给你制造麻烦，尤其是因为战斗开始时你没有任何机场。最近的机场也太远。务必确保你有能够修建机场的部队。

src: The troops advancing along the exposed southern part of the ridge suffered badly from MG fire and well plotted Turkish artillery support. On the northern slope the 7th Munsters made a desperate bayonet charge, and for a time it looked like they may have taken the initiative, but exhaustion, thirst and the reformed Turkish lines put an end to the advance. The Irish and English troops held their ground with a grim determination when the Turks counter-attacked the following day, but without fresh troops the battalions just could not realistically hold out much longer.
dst: 沿山脊暴露的南段推进的部队遭到机枪火力和周密部署的土耳其炮火的严重杀伤。在北坡，第7蒙斯特团发起了一次殊死的刺刀冲锋，一时看来他们似乎夺回了主动权，但疲惫、干渴以及重新整顿好的土耳其防线终结了这次进攻。次日土耳其军反击时，爱尔兰和英格兰部队以坚韧的决心守住了阵地，但若没有生力军，这些营根本无法再支撑多久。

src: The troops at the "Ligne KW" (Dyle position) river were not particularly hard pressed and two attempts to cross the Dijle/Dyle River around Leuven/Louvain were fairly easily beaten off.
dst: “KW 防线”（迪尔河阵地）的部队并未受到特别猛烈的压力，两次试图在鲁汶附近强渡迪尔河的行动都被相当轻松地击退。

src: The truth is that Lapedusa was taken without a single shot fired. White flags had been sighted in the port, and when Lieutenant Corbett of "HMS Lookout" approached the port in a motor launch, he was told that the island's garrison wished to surrender. Mussolini had given the permission to do so.
dst: 事实是，拉佩杜萨岛未发一枪便被占领。港口内已见白旗，当“HMS Lookout”号的科比特中尉乘汽艇驶近港口时，他被告知岛上守军希望投降。墨索里尼已批准其投降。

src: The two key fortresses on the mainland-Krasnaya Gorka and Seraya Loshad'-have denied us and the British fleet any access further into the gulf.  However, a mutiny at Krasnaya Gorka gives us a unique opportunity to crack the Soviet defense.  Although we cannot hope to capture the fortresses (they are too far behind the front line), we have decided to evacuate the mutineers and to do as much damage to the installations as possible.
dst: 陆地上的两座关键要塞——红戈尔卡与灰马——使我们和英国舰队无法进一步深入海湾。然而，红戈尔卡的一次哗变为我们提供了瓦解苏俄防御的绝佳机会。尽管我们无法指望夺取这些要塞（它们位于战线后方太远），我们还是决定撤离哗变士兵，并尽可能对设施造成破坏。

src: The union of the three duchies, which had a large German population, became increasingly difficult in the second half of the XIX century. Most of the Germans opposed the liberal and democratic reforms that the Danish government wished to apply. Besides, the Germans in Schleswig and Holstein supported the Salic law, so they wouldn't accept as a duke any descendant of the King of Denmark who belonged to female family lines.
dst: 这三个拥有大量德意志人口的公国的联合，在19世纪下半叶变得日益艰难。大多数德意志人反对丹麦政府想要推行的自由民主改革。此外，石勒苏益格和荷尔斯泰因的德意志人支持萨利克继承法，因此他们不会接受任何属于女性家族支系的丹麦国王后裔担任公爵。

src: The upcoming battle of the Kursk salient is meant to reverse the tide of the war with the Soviet Union. Once successfull, it will bring the strategic initiative back into our hands.
dst: 即将到来的库尔斯克突出部之战，旨在扭转对苏战局。一旦成功，战略主动权将重回我们手中。

src: The uprising against the Republic is completely smashed by our People's Army, the weakness of the rear rebel territories has been a key for our final victory, Northern places like Asturias, Santander or Euzkadi started a revolt against the rebel opressors, also, some rebel units joined the People's Army, and Burgos, the enemy capital has fallen. Many rebel troops have embarked to the Spanish Morocco, where they will try to resist with some Italian help.
dst: 反抗共和国的叛乱已被我们的人民军彻底粉碎，叛军后方领土的脆弱是我们最终胜利的关键，阿斯图里亚斯、桑坦德或巴斯克等北方地区奋起反抗叛军压迫者，此外一些叛军部队也加入人民军，敌方首府布尔戈斯已经陷落。许多叛军部队已登船前往西属摩洛哥，在那里他们将在意大利的某些援助下试图顽抗。

src: The uprising agaisnt the Front Popular goverment has begun!. You, an ''africanist'' general, are the leader of one ''column'' of Moroccan and Spanish troops heading to Madrid. It's believed that the march on the capital will end with the red goverment of the Front Popular... If this fails, we are sure our new German and Italian allies will support us with supplies and weapons to face the reds.
dst: 反抗人民阵线政府的起义已经开始！您，一位「非洲派」将领，是一支由摩洛哥人和西班牙部队组成、正开往马德里的「纵队」的指挥官。据信，向首都的进军将以终结人民阵线的红色政府而告终……如果失败，我们确信我们新的德国和意大利盟友会以补给和武器支持我们，以对抗共和军。

src: The uprising at Guangzhou against the local warlords was successful and access by sea for Soviet aid was secured.  Now, comrade Mao from Hunan is planning an assault on the city fortress of Changsha against the local warlords and KMT troops placed at that city. The central Chinese Communist Party director dislikes this operation, but we are going to dispatch your troops there to help our comrades in the offensive.  Personally, I don't want the prestige of Mao Zedong to overly influence the ChCP.  He seems to gain more power each day.
dst: 广州反抗地方军阀的起义取得了成功，苏联援助的海上通道已得到保障。现在，来自湖南的毛泽东同志正计划进攻长沙城防，打击当地军阀和驻守该城的国民党军队。中共中央的负责人不喜欢这次行动，但我们还是要把你的部队派去协助我们同志进攻。就我个人而言，我不愿毛泽东的声望过分影响中国共产党。他似乎一天比一天更有权势。

src: The uprising was successful and Nanchang is ours!  This has become the first major stronghold of Marxism in China.  Now it is time to create a Revolutionary Committee in this city to manage our goals.  We must get Soviet aid by sea with another uprising in Guangzhou.  Our comrades there will receive our support from Nanchang.
dst: 起义成功了，南昌是我们的了！这里已成为马克思主义在中国第一个主要据点。现在该在这座城市建立革命委员会来管理我们的目标。我们必须通过在广州的另一场起义来获得苏联的海上援助。那里的同志将得到我们自南昌的支援。

src: The use of combined naval, air, land and paratroop forces is very effective, is it not?
dst: 海、空、陆、伞兵的协同运用非常有效，不是吗？

src: The very precious help for the insurgents are the soldiers of the 1st division of ROA, a unit of 18 000 Russian volunteers in German service, who joined the Uprising. Without them, Prague will be surely lost, but their tanks, tank hunters and artillery (and of course their experiences and numbers) are one of the main reasons why the insurgents may and will hold against the enemy armoured attacks. But the soldiers of ROA don't want to fall into Soviet hands, and it is possible that they'll withdraw westwards once the Soviets get closer to the city.
dst: 对起义者来说，最宝贵的帮助来自 ROA 第1师的士兵——一支由18,000名在德军服役的俄国志愿者组成的部队——他们加入了起义。没有他们，布拉格必陷无疑，但他们的坦克、坦克歼击车和炮兵（当然还有他们的经验和人数）是起义者能够并必将顶住敌军装甲进攻的主要原因之一。但 ROA 的士兵不想落入苏军之手，一旦苏军逼近该城，他们很可能会向西撤离。

src: The victory is near. Your troops are standing in the near of Antwerpen. Your mission is to eliminate the last allied troops and occupy the harbor of Antwerpen to prevent further allied reinforcements.
dst: 胜利在望。你的部队已逼近安特卫普。你的任务是歼灭最后一批盟军部队，占领安特卫普港，以阻止盟军进一步的增援。

src: The victory is ours, mon Général! The enemy didn't expect our counter-attack and was demoralized by our overwhelming numbers of tanks. Their own A7V were too few and too cumbersome to make any significant impact on the battlefield. I wonder what a German army could do with a proper tank force. We hopefully will never find out...
dst: 胜利属于我们，将军！敌人没有料到我们的反击，被我们数量占绝对优势的坦克打得士气低落。他们自己的A7V坦克数量太少、又太笨重，未能在战场上产生任何重大影响。我很好奇一支德军如果拥有一支像样的坦克部队会怎样。希望我们永远不必知道……

src: The village of Silang is in our hands. The gate to reconquering Cavite is now open.
dst: 锡朗村已在我们手中。重新征服甲米地的大门现已打开。

src: The von Schlieffen plan had failed. The only option left to achieve a quick victory on the  Western Front was to outflank the enemy armies. Both sides tried to do this multiple times, leading to a 'Race to the Sea'.
dst: 施里芬计划已经失败。要在西线迅速取胜，剩下的唯一选择就是包抄敌军侧翼。双方多次尝试这样做，最终演变成一场「奔向大海」的竞赛。

src: The war against Serbia has started extremely well. In the north, German and Austro-Hungarian troops have crushed the Serbian defences. In the South, our Second Army has nearly liberated all of Macedonia, and here, in the center, we destroyed the first Serbian line at Pirot, some days ago.
dst: 对塞尔维亚的战争开局极好。在北方，德国和奥匈军队粉碎了塞尔维亚人的防御。在南方，我们的第2集团军几乎解放了整个马其顿，而在这里、在中路，我们几天前摧毁了皮罗特的第一道塞尔维亚防线。

src: The war in China is over, although it hasn't been thanks to your effort or your skills. Our allies have done most of the job. Well, a victory is a victory, I guess. You've been very lucky.
dst: 中国的战争结束了，尽管这并非靠您的努力或才能。我们的盟友完成了大部分工作。嗯，胜就是胜，我想。您运气不错。

src: The war in China is over. Empress Cixi and most of the court have fled Peking. Many Qing officers have died, and the people trapped in the legations have finally been liberated. There is still some fighting inside the city, but we'll soon crush all the remaining rebels.
dst: 中国的战争结束了。慈禧太后和朝廷大部分成员已逃离北京。许多清军军官战死，困在使馆区的人们终于获救。城内仍有零星战斗，但我们很快就能肃清所有残余的叛乱者。

src: The war in Europe is over. Now we had to keep our promise and built a second front against Japan in Asia. We could push forward and are now east of Changchun. Your troops should break through the lines of Japanese and Manchukuo troops in the east of the town and capture Changchun.
dst: 欧洲的战事已经结束。现在我们必须履行承诺，在亚洲对日本开辟第二战场。我们得以向前推进，目前正在长春以东。你的部队应突破该城以东的日军与满洲国军防线，夺取长春。

src: The war in Europe is won, but we still have the problem with Britain. Invading England is impossible, but the OHL thinks that there is an alternative solution. Prepare your troops, General, this time the journey will be really long.
dst: 欧洲的战争已经获胜，但我们与英国之间还有问题。入侵英格兰是不可能的，但最高陆军指挥部认为另有解决之道。做好准备，将军，这一次的征程将格外漫长。

src: The war in the east has not gone well. The Soviets have proven to be unstoppable, and are now advancing across German soil. You must stop them and push them back along the entire front by taking all objectives, however, if you can hold onto a minimum of six objectives, we may be able to obtain tolerable armistice terms. This is the final battle; you face either death or glory.
dst: 东线战事进展不利。苏军已被证明无法阻挡，如今正越过德国本土推进。你必须夺取全部目标，在全线阻止他们并将其击退；不过，你若能守住至少六个目标，我们或许还能争取到尚可接受的停战条件。这是最后一战；你面临的不是死亡就是荣耀。

src: The war is OVER!, this is our victory day in Asia, the Primuski Republic is now dealing his independence with Moscow while Stalin is begging for the armistice with Germany!. China, Burma and India are now also included in the Co-Prosperity Sphere. We have liberated Asia from the Europeans, but, who will free Asia from us? HAHAHA!. Your name is now included in the japanese history as one of the heroes of our sacred nation.
dst: 战争结束了！今天是我们在亚洲的胜利日，滨海共和国正与莫斯科谈判其独立，而斯大林正在乞求与德国停战！中国、缅甸和印度如今也纳入了共荣圈。我们把亚洲从欧洲人手中解放了出来，可是，谁又能把亚洲从我们手中解放出来？哈哈哈！您的名字如今已作为我们神圣民族的英雄之一载入日本史册。

src: The war is beginning! The uprising of July of 1936 is supported by a good number of army officers, capitalists, businessmen, the church, and other elements. Finally, the Republican government has decided to create a People's Army to try to stop the overconfident Nationalist march on Madrid... The newly formed People's Army needs officers like you.
dst: 战争开始了！1936年7月的起义得到了大量军官、资本家、商人、教会以及其他势力的支持。最终，共和政府决定组建一支共和军，以设法阻止国民军那不可一世的向马德里的进军……这支新组建的共和军需要像您这样的军官。

src: The war is going excellently!  The Revolution will soon liberate the rest of Europe and join with other communists all over the continent!  But first we must concentrate on capturing Warsaw in the north and Lwow here in the south!
dst: 战争进展得极为顺利！革命很快将解放欧洲其余部分，与整个大陆的其他共产主义者会合！但首先我们必须集中力量夺取北面的华沙和南面这里的利沃夫！

src: The war is not going as we had hoped for. North of the Pripjat Marshes the front has collapsed. However south of it, we have our front intact but are slowly being pushed back.
dst: 战事并不如我们所愿。普里皮亚季沼泽以北，战线已经崩溃。然而沼泽以南，我们的战线完好，但正被缓慢击退。

src: The war is over ! We have won !
The war is over! Tsar Ferdinand I is really pleased. He will be here tomorrow to visit the battlefield and will personally congratutlate you.
dst: 战争结束了！沙皇费迪南一世非常满意。他明天将到这里视察战场，并亲自向您祝贺。

src: The war is over. But some admirals of the marine want the endfight in the North Sea. So started the Novemberrevolution.
dst: 战争结束了。但海军的一些上将却想在北海打一场最后的决战。十一月革命就这样开始了。

src: The war that followed was a terrible test for Poland which was on the brink of disappearing due to the intense pressure from the Red Army. However, the Polish were able to recover and finally managed to conquer many Eastern territories that would become part of Poland until 1939.
dst: 随后的战争对波兰是一场严峻的考验，由于红军的巨大压力，波兰一度濒临灭亡。然而，波兰人得以恢复过来，最终征服了许多东部领土，这些领土直到1939年一直是波兰的一部分。

src: The war was a terrible burden for Britain, but it was still worse for Germany. It had taken away most of our enemies' reserves, and without any replacements for their lost men and equipment, their army would die out before the end of the year. Their only chance was a final, decisive blow with everything they had left, so that they could outflank our army and defeat us. After acheiving that, they thought that France would ask for an armistice, and I believe that they were right.
dst: 这场战争对英国来说是沉重的负担，但对德国来说更为糟糕。它耗尽了敌人大部分的预备队，而在其损失的人员和装备得不到任何补充的情况下，他们的军队将在年底前消耗殆尽。他们唯一的机会，就是用他们剩下的一切发动最后的、决定性的一击，以便包抄我军并将我们击败。在达成这一点之后，他们认为法国会请求停战，而我相信他们是对的。
通往符拉迪沃斯托克之路

src: The weather can change the ground condition!
The weather is awful, so enemy will be spoted at the very close range! Watch out!
dst: 天气糟透了，因此敌人将在极近的距离才被发现！当心！

src: The weather is extremely cold, around -20 degrees, this will make our rescue operation a harder; the airforce won't be able to help us. But, we count on your elite troops to defeat the enemy here.
dst: 天气极其寒冷，大约零下20度，这会让我们的救援行动更加艰难；空军无法帮助我们。但我们指望您的精锐部队在这里击败敌人。

src: The west allied have broken the agreements and have captured Berlin. This behaviour we have to punish. We have declared war to the west allied. Fortunately the German troops in the east are captured. We have negotiasted with their commanders that they will will help us if we will relinquinsh war imprisonment. You can order German troops if you need some.
dst: 西方盟军破坏了协议并占领了柏林。我们必须惩罚这种行为。我们已对西方盟军宣战。幸运的是，东线的德军部队被俘获了。我们已与其指挥官谈判，若我们放弃战争监禁，他们就会帮助我们。如果你需要，可以命令德军部队。

src: The west allied have broken the agreements and have captured Berlin. This behaviour we have to punish. We have declared war to the west allied. Unfortunately, the German troops in the east could flee to the west allied troops and will fight together against us.
dst: 西方盟军撕毁了协议并攻占了柏林。这种行为我们必须惩罚。我们已向西方盟军宣战。遗憾的是，东线的德军部队得以逃往西方盟军一方，并将联手对抗我们。

src: The whole Cyrenaica area is now under our control, however we know that the enemy have established a defensive line between the villages of Gazalla and Bir Hacheim. Aufklarung reports shows that the British are using anti-personnel, as well as anti-tank mine fields in that line to stop our advance on towards Egypt.
dst: 整个昔兰尼加地区现在都在我们控制之下，但我们知道敌人已在加扎拉和比尔哈凯姆两村之间建立了一道防线。侦察报告显示，英军在这道防线上布设了反步兵和反坦克雷场，以阻止我们向埃及推进。

src: The whole of Germany is depending on you. Don't disappoint us.
dst: 整个德国都指望着你。不要让我们失望。

src: The withdrawal has been a mess, and we have lost many men and tons of equipment...
dst: 这次撤退一片混乱，我们损失了许多人员和大量装备……

src: The world is in tatters.  The state exists to restore order, but how long can it hold on?
dst: 世界支离破碎。国家存在的目的是恢复秩序，但它还能撑多久？

src: The world must have gone crazy. How did we get to this? What a bloodbath, what horrid images, what a slaughter. I just cannot find the words to express my feelings. Hell cannot be much more dreadful. God have mercy of our souls, and forgive our sins!
dst: 这个世界一定是疯了。我们怎么会走到这一步？多么惨烈的大屠杀，多么可怕的景象，多么骇人的屠戮。我实在找不到语言来表达我的感受。地狱恐怕也不会比这更可怕。愿上帝怜悯我们的灵魂，宽恕我们的罪过！

src: The year 1915 ended for the South-Western Front with a stabilization of the line deep within our territory: from the Pripet Marshes to Tarnopol, the enemy has dug his entrenchment scar deep into our lands.  The massive Germano-Austrian offensive during the second half of the year has shattered morale but failed to rout us.  Your participation in the action at Galicia during our retreat has played a major role in delaying the German advance:  from the Carpathian Mountains to Przemysl you stood between German staff expectations and reality.
dst: 对西南方面军而言，1915年在战线深入我方领土之处以稳定而告终：从普里皮亚季沼泽到塔尔诺波尔，敌人已把其堑壕的伤疤深深挖进我们的土地。下半年德奥联军的大规模攻势虽然动摇了士气，却未能将我们击溃。您在我们撤退期间参与加利西亚作战，在迟滞德军推进方面发挥了重要作用：从喀尔巴阡山脉到普热梅希尔，您横亘在德军参谋部的期望与现实之间。

src: The year 1918 was great year for Germany and its allies. Greece and Italy surrendered, and in the Middle East the Ottomans managed to counterattack and recover much of Palestine, Mesopotamia and Arabia. But 1919 was still better. In March, the Germans finally pierced the French defences in the West Front. In May, France and Belgium had surrendered, too, and the survivors of British Expeditionary Force returned to their island. It was obvious that the Central Powers were going to win the war.
dst: 1918年对德国及其盟友来说是伟大的一年。希腊和意大利投降了，而在中东，奥斯曼人成功发动反攻，收复了巴勒斯坦、美索不达米亚和阿拉伯的大部分地区。但1919年更好。三月，德国人终于突破了西线的法军防线。五月，法国和比利时也投降了，英国远征军的幸存者回到了他们的岛上。同盟国即将赢得战争，这已显而易见。

src: The year was ending when we arrived in Korti. Wolseley had already decided that we would split into two groups: the River Column would ascend the Nile River by ship, and a smaller Camel Corps would march across the desert to Metemmeh and Khartoum. That second column would be composed of four regiments mounted in camels, as well as a cavalry detachment, and the volunteers from the Guards battalions would be a part of it.
dst: 我们抵达科尔蒂时，这一年已接近尾声。沃尔斯利已决定将我们分成两路：河上纵队乘船溯尼罗河而上，另有一支规模较小的骆驼军团横穿沙漠前往梅特马和喀土穆。那第二路纵队将由四个乘骆驼的团以及一个骑兵分遣队组成，近卫军各营的志愿兵也将是其一部分。

src: The young german nobleman Arminius, educated as hostage in Rome and serving in the roman army as commander of auxiliary units, has the complete trust of Varus..
dst: 年轻的日耳曼贵族阿米尼乌斯，自幼在罗马当人质受教，在罗马军中担任辅助部队的指挥官，深得瓦鲁斯信任..

src: Their forces consist of a robust defensive ring on a Velka Polom - Hlucin - Ostrava and several garrisons in the inland cities. They moved in everything they got, every reserve they have.
dst: 他们的兵力包括一道以大波洛姆—赫卢钦—俄斯特拉发为依托的坚固防御环，以及内陆城市中的若干守备部队。他们投入了所有能投入的一切、所有预备队。

src: Then a joint exercise with Soviet recruits will start. Soviet comrades play the role of a defender during the aternoon practise, so they'll use the morning hours to dig themselves. We don't know where they plan to hide, and thus cannot prepare ideally, but our instructors will help us.
dst: 随后将与苏联新兵展开联合演习。下午演习时，苏联同志们扮演防御方，因此他们会利用上午的时间挖工事。我们不知道他们打算藏在哪，所以无法理想地准备，但我们的教官会帮助我们。

src: Then even the way to Rome is open to us ....
dst: 到那时，通往罗马的路也向我们敞开了 ....

src: Then finally a day has come when grandpa returned. He came back in a train with a red star  on the front. There were many people on the railroad station, because other soldiers also returned. They came out of the train and the mayor talked with them for long. When he spoke with my grandpa he named him Herr Gelb Marschal which is strange, because my grandpa's name is Otto.
dst: 后来终于有一天，爷爷回来了。他坐着一列车头带红星的火车回来。火车站里人很多，因为其他士兵也回来了。他们下了火车，市长跟他们谈了很久。他跟我爷爷说话时，称呼他“盖尔布元帅先生”，这很奇怪，因为我爷爷叫奥托。

src: Then finally they released him. Grandma ran to him and she cried and they talked much.
dst: 后来他们终于放他走了。奶奶跑向他，哭着，他们聊了很多。

src: Then grandpa looked at me and he also started to cry. It was very embarrassing. I told him to not cry and I also told him that I don't like him, that he was much younger on a photo that grandma showed me and if he's really our grandpa and if the Russians didn't give us a false grandpa. He laughed much and then he hugged me and kissed me and it was so strange that now it was me who was crying. But it wasn't that embarassing, after all I'm just a girl, but my grandpa isn't.
dst: 后来爷爷看着我，也哭了起来。这让人很难为情。我让他别哭，我还告诉他我不喜欢他，说他比奶奶给我看的照片上年轻多了，问他到底是不是我们的爷爷，是不是俄国人给了我们一个假爷爷。他笑了很久，然后抱住我、亲了我，那种感觉如此陌生，以至于现在哭的人变成了我。不过也没那么难为情了，毕竟我只是个小女孩，而我爷爷可不是。

src: Then have your marines land ashore and assist in Malaga and then Mallorca the Spanish army against the rebels, without the help of your ships or planes.
dst: 随后让你的海军陆战队登陆上岸，在没有舰船和飞机支援的情况下，协助马拉加、然后是马略卡的西班牙军队对抗叛军。

src: Then our orders were to cross the river, take Kurgan and go to the north, completing the encirclement of the 2nd and the 3rd Red Armies. If we suceeded, Lenin's minions would be trapped, and nothing could stop us from liberating all of Siberia.
dst: 然后，我们的命令是渡河、夺取库尔干并向北推进，完成对第二、第三红军的合围。如果我们成功，列宁的爪牙就会被困住，就没有什么能阻止我们解放整个西伯利亚。
后来有些人回到了家乡。

src: Then the war started. We could handle the Austrians and the Ottomans, but the German Army was too powerful. Defeats led to desperation. Many people lost their hope in a brighter future. And once hope left, madness was all that was left behind. Revolutionary madness that spread like an infectious disease. And the Bolsheviks were the worst of all. Many people believed their lies. Men that once had been honest and hard working became no better that rabid dogs. Chaos swallowed everything that I believed sacred.
dst: 随后战争爆发了。我们能应付奥地利人和奥斯曼人，但德军实在太强大。失败带来了绝望。许多人丧失了对美好未来的希望。而希望一旦离去，剩下的便只有疯狂。革命的疯狂像传染病一样蔓延。而布尔什维克是其中最恶劣的。许多人听信了他们的谎言。曾经诚实勤劳的人变得与疯狗无异。混乱吞噬了我曾视为神圣的一切。

src: Then we've climbed on the wagon and went home. Grandma asked him what he wants for a dinner, that she may either cook a cony or a chicken. Grandpa said that he doesn't care, but that he wants a beer and yet something else, but this I didn't understood.
dst: 后来我们爬上马车回了家。奶奶问他晚饭想吃什么，她可以做兔子肉或者鸡肉。爷爷说他无所谓，但他想要啤酒，还有别的什么，这个我没听懂。

src: Then you must give the British a good lesson so they will not attack us again at Norway.
dst: 然后你必须给英国人一个狠狠的教训，让他们不敢再来进攻我们在挪威的部队。

src: Then, both sides prepared for battle.

dst: 特奥弗拉斯图斯邦巴斯图斯

src: There are 19 scenarios and someday I might finish the campaign but I doubt it.
dst: 共有19个场景，将来某天我也许会把这个战役做完，但恐怕够呛。

src: There are 3 defensive lines around the city. The first line is located around 25km from the city. The second line is located 6-8km outside of Odessa and the 3rd line located in the city itself.
dst: 城周围有三道防线。第一道防线距城约25公里。第二道防线位于敖德萨城外6至8公里处，第三道防线位于城内。

src: There are 8 deployment hex at sea, 5 in the west and 12 in southeast.
dst: 海上有8个部署格，西面有5个，东南面有12个。

src: There are also other versions of how the river crossing happened, it is said that it were the Germans themselves, who saved the bridge in exchange for a fair treatment. What really happened? Who knows? Bridge over Ostravice bears Sykora's name today and it is hard to argue about his and Olsak's bravery...
dst: 关于这次渡河还有其他版本，有人说正是德国人自己保住了桥梁，以换取公正待遇。真相究竟如何？谁知道呢？如今俄斯特拉维采河上的桥以西科拉命名，他和奥尔萨克的勇敢是无可争辩的……

src: There are clear signs that the capitalists from London will send the Royal Navy to Russia and attempt to evacuate Wrangel and his forces.  Comrade, this shows the lies told by the British and Wrangel.  How are they to evacuate a massive army?  Most likely they will only bring him and a few others to safety while the rest await the mercy of the glorious people's army!
dst: 有明显迹象表明，伦敦的资本家将派皇家海军前来俄国，试图撤离弗兰格尔及其部队。同志，这恰恰暴露了英国人和弗兰格尔的谎言。他们怎么可能撤离一支庞大的军队？十有八九，他们只会把他和少数几人送到安全之处，而其余的人则只能等待光荣的人民军队的发落！

src: There are enough planes already grounded, don't waste the air support needlessly.
dst: 已经有不少飞机停飞了，别白白浪费空中支援。

src: There are good news from India - the state of war between Germany, Italy and the Indian Empire is terminated! Since the fall of Britain the demand for independence grew rapidly. Last year there were numerous uprisings and the so-called Free-British not longer in control of the situation. Indian politicians have declared independence and the Indian Army is on the side of the new government.
dst: 印度传来好消息——德国、意大利与印度帝国之间的战争状态结束了！自不列颠陷落以来，独立的呼声迅速高涨。去年发生了无数次起义，所谓的自由不列颠已无法控制局面。印度政治家宣布独立，印度军队站在了新政府一边。

src: There are ground units from England, USA and Denmark and a lot of ships. Also there are many enemy aircrafts.
dst: 这里有来自英格兰、美国和丹麦的地面部队以及大量舰船。还有大批敌机。

src: There are no enemy forces between Alexandria and our troops anymore - the depots in Mersa Matruh are full! Supply you troops, refuel the vehicle and make your way to Alexandria!
dst: 亚历山大与我军之间已无敌军——梅尔萨马特鲁的仓库满满当当！补给你的部队，给车辆加满油，向亚历山大进发！

src: There are no more naval battles in this campaign and you should sell your ships now. Use the prestige to bolster your ground and air forces.
dst: 本战役中不再有海战，你现在应当卖掉你的舰船。利用这些威望来增强你的地面与空中力量。

src: There are no reserves or reinforcements.

There are rumors about our destination.... Is it Savannah or Wilmington? Charleston or Mobile? The officers dont't tell us no matter how often we ask. I hope next time when I write a letter I will stand on solid ground....
dst: 关于我们的目的地，众说纷纭……是萨凡纳还是威尔明顿？查尔斯顿还是莫比尔？无论我们问多少次，军官们都不肯透露。我希望下次写信时，我已经站在坚实的陆地上……

src: There are rumors that the Duke of Windsor should be reinstated as King Edward VIII. He was kidnapped in Portugal in July by agents of our Abwehr and he considered as German-friendly.
dst: 有传言说，温莎公爵将被重新扶上王位，成为爱德华八世。他今年7月在葡萄牙被我方阿勃维尔的特工绑架，且被认为亲德。

src: There are rumours that the Polish Army from France is on the way to Poland. They will help us to defend the country.
dst: 有传言说，驻扎在法国的波兰军队正在回国途中。他们将帮助我们保卫国家。

src: There are several medium and heavy tanks battalion rushing towards your area. They are supported by self-propelled artillery and mechanized infantry.
dst: 数个中型和重型坦克营正朝你所在区域冲来，并有自行火炮和机械化步兵支援。

src: There are some of our men who were assigned a guarding duty in the vicinity of southern river crossing. Don't let them alone, they need every possible backup, especially the mighty 88's, lest they fall prey to the enemy armour.
dst: 我们有些弟兄被派驻守在南面渡口附近。别丢下他们不管，他们需要一切可能的支援，尤其是威猛的 88 炮，免得成为敌军装甲部队的猎物。

src: There are some siege engineers on our ship - does that mean we have to attack fortifications? I hope to receive a letter from you soon, no matter were I will be!
dst: 我们船上有一些攻城工兵——这是否意味着我们必须攻打防御工事？无论我身在何处，都希望能尽快收到您的来信！

src: There are strong concentrations of enemy forces around our objectives and they are moving towards our positions. Seems like the Soviets started another counterattack.
