Reconnaissance reports around a hundred armoured vehicles including the heavy tanks, most of them in the southern sector around the highway.
dst: 我们的目标周围集结着大量敌军，他们正朝我方阵地移动。看来苏军又发动了一次反攻。侦察报告称有约一百辆装甲车辆，包括重型坦克，其中大部分在公路周围的南部地区。

src: There are two main routes towards the city that you may use, but the faster and more straight one is a bit jammed by the avantgarde of Soviet tank forces.
dst: 有两条通往该城的主要路线可用，但更快、更直的那条有点被苏军坦克先头部队堵住了。

src: There has been nothing that you could do. Let's hope that, with the help of the Germans, other divisions will be able to stop the Russians at Kowel. Their offensive will lose momentum and won't succeed.
dst: 您已无能为力。但愿在德国人的帮助下，其他师能在科韦尔挡住俄国人。他们的攻势将失去势头，无法得逞。

src: There is a experience trigger under a MG Bunker in the east.
dst: 东面一处机枪碉堡下方有一个经验触发点。

src: There is a leader trigger underneath a bunker in the center of the Westwall.
dst: 在齐格菲防线中央的一处碉堡下方有一个指挥官触发点。

src: There is also a ray of hope: since our cease-fire with the west the synthetic oil production has picked up surprisingly fast, and more and more new jet plains are batteling for the skies over Silesia.
dst: 还有一线希望：自从我们与西方停火以来，合成油产量回升得出奇地快，越来越多的新式喷气式飞机正在西里西亚上空争夺制空权。

src: There is also an objective in the city itself, the Polish Postal Office.
dst: 市区内还有一个目标，即波兰邮政局。

src: There is heavy activity in the Atlantic, so be careful.
dst: 大西洋上活动频繁，请当心。

src: There is more bad news.  The reason why you lost contact with the Don Cossacks Brigade was not your fault, comrade.  It seems that they have switched sides and have joined the capitalist criminals that we are fighting!  I urge you to make clear to your men the fate of such traitors!
dst: 还有更糟的消息。您与顿河哥萨克旅失去联系，这并非您的过错，同志。看来他们已倒戈投敌，加入了我们正在与之作战的资本家罪犯！我敦促您，务必让您的部下明白这类叛徒的下场！

src: There is much prestige in the three early Spain battles. Build a core of 30 odd units and gain experience for your long campaign to follow.
dst: 早期西班牙的三场战斗能带来大量声望。组建一支30来个单位的核心部队，为你随后的漫长战役积累经验。

src: There is no friendly SH at all, so the players can deploy a limited core in every scenario. Don't worry, you can buy a bunch of cheap and crappy units, to be honest, you cannot buy anything else. This story is about a Hungarian army which wasn't famous for the best equipment.
dst: 完全没有我方SH（部署格），因此玩家在每个剧本中都只能部署有限的核心部队。别担心，你可以买上一大堆廉价又低劣的单位——说实话，你也买不到别的。这个故事讲的是匈牙利军队，它可从来不以装备精良著称。

src: There is no further use in holding on to the four remaining camps. Take you surviving troops further West to Bardia to strengthen the city parameter defences for an attack that will certainly come.
dst: 继续守住这四处残余营地已无意义。带你幸存的部队继续西去巴迪亚，加强该城周边防御，以迎击必定会到来的进攻。

src: There is no further use in holding on to the three remaining camps. Take you surviving troops further West to Bardia to strengthen the city parameter defences against an attack that will certainly come.
dst: 继续守住这三处残余营地已无意义。带你幸存的部队继续西去巴迪亚，加强该城周边防御，以迎击必定会到来的进攻。

src: There is no further use in holding on to the two remaining camps. Take you surviving troops further West to Bardia to strengthen the city parameter defences against an attack that will certainly come.
dst: 继续守住这两处残余营地已无意义。带你幸存的部队继续西去巴迪亚，加强该城周边防御，以迎击必定会到来的进攻。

src: There is no hope of stopping the monarchists now but we will not fall into enemy hands. We will retreat, reorganize and make the Polish capitalists pay for this!  The Revolution will not be tamed!  Make your way east, comrade, the town of Rovno has fallen into the dirty hands of the enemy!  Retreat!
dst: 如今已无望阻止君主主义者，但我们不会落入敌手。我们将撤退、重整，让波兰资本家为此付出代价！革命是不可驯服的！向东开进吧，同志，罗夫诺镇已落入敌人的肮脏之手！撤退！

src: There is no prestige granted, except in round 1 with 200 pp for each roman player and 400 pp for each german player
dst: 除了第1回合：每位罗马玩家200 pp、每位日耳曼玩家400 pp 之外，不授予任何声望

src: There is one prestige trigger hidden in a city.
dst: 有一座城市中藏着一个威望触发点。

src: There is some bad news, though.  Italy will declare war on the Empire before the end of the month, so we'll have to deploy troops on three different fronts. Our army won't resist that, unless we have the support of our allies. Bulgaria might join our side in the future, but obviously Germany is our most powerful friend. The Emperor has decided to send you to our embassy in Berlin, as a military attaché, in order to improve the coordination between our two armies. It's an important mission, and don't worry, it will last just for a few months. Before you can notice, you'll be back on the front line.
dst: 不过也有个坏消息：意大利将在月底前向帝国宣战，因此我们将不得不在三条战线上部署部队。除非得到盟友的支持，否则我军将难以支撑。保加利亚将来也许能加入我方，但德国显然是我们最强大的朋友。皇帝已决定派您前往我们驻柏林的大使馆担任武官，以增进两国军队之间的协调。这是一项重要的使命，别担心，只需几个月。不知不觉，您就会重返前线。

src: There is some evidence to suggest that the Turks have established strong redoubts at the heights, so be prepared for a determined bayonet charge against their trenches. Our intelligence indicates that enemy reinforcements might come to help the Rafa outpost from Khan Yunis and from the east. Once again, speed is essential for our victory! Good luck!
dst: 有证据表明，土耳其人已在高地建立了坚固的多面堡，因此要准备好对他们的堑壕发起坚决的刺刀冲锋。我方情报显示，敌军增援可能从汗尤尼斯和东面前来支援拉法前哨。胜利再次取决于速度！祝您好运！

src: There might be a bug that makes it impossible to see the next scenario name in the after-action-report (AAR). If you want to check the campaign path and scenario list, you will find a detailed list in the README folder of the efile.
dst: 可能有一个bug会导致在战后报告（AAR）中无法看到下一场景名称。如果你想查看战役路线与场景清单，可在efile的README文件夹中找到详细列表。

src: There settled the Celtic tribe of the Iceni, who   later gained notoriety with their famous queen Boudicca
dst: 那里定居着凯尔特部族伊塞尼人，他们后来因著名的女王布狄卡而声名狼藉

src: There they formed Workers' and Soldiers' Councils and called for the abdication of Grand Duke Ernst Ludwig of Hesse. But he refuses ...
dst: 在那里，他们成立了工人和士兵委员会，并要求黑森大公恩斯特·路德维希退位。但他拒绝了……

src: There was a marsh of no great extent between our army and that of the enemy. The latter were waiting to see if our men would pass this; our men, also, were ready in arms to attack them while disordered, if the first attempt to pass should be made by them. In the mean time battle was commenced between the two armies by a cavalry action. When neither army began to pass the marsh, Caesar, upon the skirmishes of the horse [proving] favorable to our men, led back his forces into the camp. The enemy immediately hastened from that place to the river Aisne, which it has been; stated was behind our camp. Finding a ford there, they endeavored to lead a part of their forces over it; with the design, that, if they could, they might carry by storm the fort which Q. Titurius, Caesar's lieutenant, commanded, and might cut off the bridge....
dst: 我军与敌军之间有一片不大的沼泽。敌方在观望我军是否会渡过；我军也枕戈以待，若对方先试图趟过 ，便趁其队形散乱时进攻。在此期间，两军先以骑兵交锋展开了战斗。当两军都没有开始渡越沼泽时， 凯撒见骑兵小战对我方有利，便把部队带回营中。敌人立刻从那里赶往埃纳河——前面说过它在我营后方 。他们找到一处浅滩，便设法把一部分兵力渡过去；其用意是：若能得手，便强攻凯撒副将昆图斯提图里 乌斯所守的堡垒，并切断那座桥....

src: There was no time to lose. Although the Allied representatives in Siberia had told the Czechs to safely escort Kolchak to Vladivostok, when they ascertained that the Bolsheviks would oppose resistance, they quickly turned Kolchak over to the Political Centre. That's how the Socialist- Revolutionaries in Irkutsk called themselves. Of course, we all knew that the Czechs would do that.
dst: 没有时间可浪费了。尽管西伯利亚的协约国代表已告诉捷克人，要把高尔察克安全护送到符拉迪沃斯托克，但当他们确知布尔什维克会进行抵抗时，就立刻把高尔察克交给了「政治中心」——伊尔库茨克的社会革命党人就是这么自称的。当然，我们所有人都知道捷克人会那么做。

src: There were about 2,000 defenders on or below the summit of Chunuk Bair, and another 3,000 troops at the Farm. The Turks swept over the Lancashire battalion on the summit, wiping it out to the last man. The Wiltshires were killed or driven into the steep valleys. The Turks headed down Rhododendron Spur towards the Pinnacle, driving the New Army troops before them. New Zealand machine gunners positioned at the Apex shot down the Turks as they tried to continue down the spur. The gunners could not discriminate friend from foe so they also killed many New Army troops who were amongst the charging Turks. The Turks descended to the small plateau of the Farm and annihilated Baldwin's brigade. About 1,000 British were killed, the rest driven off into the surrounding gullies.
dst: 在楚努克拜尔山顶及山下约有2000名守军，农庄另有3000人。土耳其军冲过山顶的兰开夏营，将其屠杀至最后一人。威尔特郡团或被杀，或被赶进陡峭的山谷。土耳其军沿杜鹃花山脊向尖峰挺进，驱赶着前方的陆军新军部队。部署在阿佩克斯的新西兰机枪手在土耳其军试图继续沿山脊推进时将其击倒。机枪手无法分辨敌友，因此也打死了许多混在冲锋土军中的新军士兵。土耳其军下到农庄的小高地，歼灭了鲍德温的旅。约1000名英军阵亡，其余人被驱散到四周的沟壑中。

src: There were many battles in the Charleston area, but the Union was not able to take possession of the city before 18th February 1865.
dst: 查尔斯顿地区发生过许多战役，但联邦军直到1865年2月18日才得以占领这座城市。

src: There were two key advantages the German army possessed in order to execute this plan:  first, the rail network in Eastern Prussia was extensive and could allow for the rapid transfer of two army corps within days, and second, interceptions of the Russian wireless and unencrypted communications between Stavka and both field armies gave German intelligence information on the dispositions and intentions of the Russian units.
dst: 德军执行这一计划拥有两大关键优势：其一，东普鲁士的铁路网十分发达，可在数日内快速转运两个军；其二，对俄军无线电的截获，以及大本营与两个野战集团军之间未加密通信的破译，使德国情报部门掌握了俄军各部队的部署与意图。

src: There weren't enough new Panthers ready at the eve of the Kursk battle, but maybe you will be lucky enough to have at least one of your companies upgraded from the old PzKpfW IV. It's also rumoured that you may be promoted to a battalion commander...
dst: 库尔斯克战役前夕，就绪的新黑豹坦克还不多，但也许你运气够好，至少有一个连能从老式四号坦克换装。还有传闻说，你可能被提升为营长……

src: There will be no protos and if a player has no experience, the Victory or Tactical Victory will give him (her) more prestige points.
dst: 不会出现原型装备，如果玩家经验不足，胜利或战术胜利会给他（她）更多威望点。

src: There's a strong military base blocking our course towards Salla, and as such, it must be neutralized. The Soviets concentrated a strong infantry force with a substantial artillery, antitank, machine gun and flak support. The nearby airfield hosts an aviation regiment of long-range airplanes. A regiment of light and reconnaisance tanks is confirmed, too. Soviet peripheral defensive ring is weak and it's manned by token forces at the very best.
dst: 一座坚固的军基阻挡着我们通往萨拉的进路，必须将其铲除。苏军集结了一支强大的步兵，配有可观的炮兵、反坦克炮、机枪与高射炮支援。附近机场驻有一个远程航空团。另已确认有一个轻型与侦察坦克团。苏军外围防御圈薄弱，至多仅由象征性兵力驻守。

src: There's more work to be done, but first: I owe you a goddamned beer.
dst: 还有更多活儿要干，但首先：我欠你一杯该死的啤酒。

src: Thereupon the sailors on three ships of the Third Naval Battle Squadron refused to weigh anchor for the last naval battle of WW1.
dst: 于是，第三战列舰分舰队三艘舰上的水兵拒绝为一战最后一场海战起锚。

src: These Romanians are really brave. As soon as they declared war on Austria-Hungary they crossed the Carpathian passes, invading the Kingdom of Hungary and defeating the local garrisons. Some days ago they were in the outskirts of Hermannstadt, and only when they learnt that you were coming to help our allies did they retreat, stablishing a defence line and guarding the Rothenturm Pass.
dst: 这些罗马尼亚人真勇敢。他们一宣战，就翻越喀尔巴阡山脉的各隘口，入侵匈牙利王国并击败了当地守军。几天前他们还打到了赫尔曼施塔特城郊，直到得知您赶来援助我们的盟友，他们才撤退，构筑起一道防线并扼守罗滕图姆山口。

src: These are grave times indeed.  The Feuhrer has been assassinated.  Perhaps now this madness can end.  Your string of victories has given us a position to negotiate from, however weak it may be.  You have done all we could ask of you and more, and you may have saved the lives of many of your countrymen.  The forces arrayed against us cannot be stopped, but perhaps we will escape this slaughter with our nation intact.
dst: 这确实是艰难时刻。元首已被刺杀。也许现在这场疯狂可以结束了。你的一连串胜利给了我们谈判的筹码，尽管十分微弱。你完成了我们所要求的一切，甚至更多，你可能挽救了众多同胞的生命。与我们为敌的力量已无法阻挡，但或许我们能以国家完整的方式逃过这场屠杀。

src: These are hard times for being a farmer in the Transvaal Republic. If the British want something, they take it. And now they want your land. All right then. If they desire it so badly, they will have to pay with fire and blood.
dst: 在德兰士瓦共和国当农民，眼下正是艰难时世。英国人想要什么，就拿走什么。如今他们又看上了您的土地。那好。既然他们如此垂涎，那就让他们用火与血来偿还。

src: These fictional scenarios will take place in the same timeline that the "Weltkrieg" campaign, so if you're successful you'll eventually repel the invaders, conquer Eritrea and Somalia, and make Abyssinia become a staunch ally of Germany and the Ottoman Empire.
dst: 这些虚构场景将与「世界战争」战役处于同一时间线，因此只要您取得成功，最终就能击退入侵者，征服厄立特里亚和索马里，让阿比西尼亚成为德国和奥斯曼帝国的坚定盟友。

src: These infantry units were now also hard pressed by the enemy, and our encircle operation threatens to fail! Act quickly and save our units from destruction!
dst: 这些步兵部队如今也遭到敌人猛烈压迫，我们的合围行动有失败之虞！迅速行动，把我们的部队从覆灭中救出来！

src: These past five years have been terrible. The war has strained the economy of every country and proved the weaknesses of both Austria-Hungary and the Ottoman Empire, but in the end Germany has become the main military power in the world and, if we act wisely, soon we'll be the richest country, too.
dst: 过去这五年实在可怕。战争让每个国家的经济都不堪重负，也暴露了奥匈帝国和奥斯曼帝国的虚弱，但最终德国已成为世界头号军事强国，而如果我们行事明智，很快也将成为最富有的国家。

src: These traitorous Norici have always been friends of the Romans .... They have just waited until our vanguard is pre-marched to join the Romans again ... They have already enclosed us, and a Roman legion suddenly appears from the east...
dst: 这些背信弃义的诺里库姆人一向是罗马人的朋友 ...... 他们一直等着我们的前锋先行，好再次投靠罗马 ...... 他们已把我们包围，一支罗马军团突然从东面出现...

src: These were intercepted by the rebels, captured, or joined the uprising.
dst: 这些部队被起义者截击、俘虏，或加入起义。

src: These were the thoughts that occupied my mind when General Wolseley decided that, after securing the Suez Canal, we would finally march on Cairo. We knew that the main Egyptian force was heavily entrenched at Tel-el-Kebir, near the railway that linked Cairo to Ismailia. Apparently, the enemy didn't send any reconnaissance patrols out of their trenches at night, so Wolseley thought that we could approach their position by night, surprise them and stage a frontal assault at dawn.
dst: 当沃尔斯利将军决定，在确保苏伊士运河安全之后，我们将最终向开罗进军时，这些念头正萦绕在我的脑海中。我们知道埃及主力部队在泰尔-凯比尔深沟高垒，那里靠近连接开罗和伊斯梅利亚的铁路。显然，敌军在夜间没有派出任何侦察巡逻队走出堑壕，因此沃尔斯利认为我们可以趁夜接近他们的阵地，出其不意，并在黎明时分发动正面突击。

src: These, however, did not use their victory, but got pointless drunk in the conquered Roman camp.
dst: 然而凯尔特人没有利用这场胜利，反而在夺取的罗马营地里毫无意义地喝得酩酊大醉。

src: They already captured the port of Bakken and they put mines into fjord. You have to clear the mines and your marines must capture and repair the port.
dst: 他们已夺取巴肯港，并在峡湾中布下了水雷。你必须清除水雷，你的陆战队必须夺取并修复港口。

src: They also say that this machine is capable of healing injuries and mending metal; and that it even comes equipped with a micro-factory that can build for us any equipment we need near-instanteously.  All assuming of course, that we have the raw materials to fuel it.  Still, some of the equipment blueprints I have on me might come in handy now.
dst: 他们还说，这台机器能够治愈伤口、修复金属；它甚至配备了微型工厂，几乎可以瞬间为我们造出任何所需的装备。当然，前提是我们有足够的原材料为它供能。不过，我身上带着的一些装备蓝图，现在或许能派上用场。

src: They are rolling hemp bales up the hills and use them as a cover. We are loading our rifles and guns with red hot iron bullets but they soaked the hemp bales in missouri waters and our salvos won't light them up at all! We can only continue fighting for a short time, maybe only till the end of this day. We are going to die of thirst or will loose the battle and become prisoners of the Confederation!
dst: 他们把大麻捆滚上山坡当作掩护。我们给步枪和火炮装上了烧红的铁弹，可他们用密苏里河水浸湿了大麻捆，我们的齐射根本点不着它们！我们只能再坚持很短的时间，也许只撑到今日天黑。我们不是渴死，就是输掉战斗、沦为邦联的俘虏！

src: They have some thirty or so tanks and it's far too many for us. We just can't move any further.
dst: 他们大约有三十来辆坦克，对我们来说实在太多了。我们就是无法再推进。

src: They launched heavy offensives (Operation Uranus, Operation Saturn, Operation Little Saturn) and stopped the German counterattack (Operation Wintergewitter). The 3rd and 4th Romanian armies were wiped out of the front line, while the German 6th Army has been surrounded in Stalingrad. Our 2nd Army has been given the task of protecting the 8th Italian Army's northern flank between Novaya Pokrovka and Rossosh. You are to hold the lines behind the Don River. Now you must try to stop the Bolshevik hordes. Good luck!
dst: 他们发动了猛烈攻势（天王星行动、土星行动、小土星行动），并阻止了德军的反攻（冬季风暴行动）。罗马尼亚第3和第4集团军被彻底逐出前线，而德国第6集团军已被围困在斯大林格勒。我方第2集团军受命保护意大利第8集团军在诺瓦亚波克罗夫卡与罗索什之间的北翼。你要守住顿河后方的防线。现在你必须设法挡住布尔什维克的洪流。祝你好运！

src: They not only lived cultivated, they also used a harsh humor.
dst: 他们不仅活得讲究，还爱用刻薄的幽默。

src: They send these new units into battle once they arrive at the western shore of the Volga river!
dst: 这些新部队一到伏尔加河西岸就被投入战斗！

src: They were also indoctrined by communist propaganda and this led to many frictions and even open hostilities - like the one that happened when Klement Gottwald, head of Czechoslovak communists in Soviet exile was told to "shut up" while he held a speech during his visit of Buzuluk.
dst: 他们还受到共产党宣传的灌输，这引发了许多摩擦，甚至公开的敌意——比如有一次，流亡苏联的捷克斯洛伐克共产党领导人克莱门特·哥特瓦尔德在访问布祖鲁克发表讲话时，被人喝令“闭嘴”。

src: They were decommissioned by the Ministry of Defence in the late 1950s and became home for pirate radio stations and the micronation "Principality of Sealand".
dst: 这些堡垒在20世纪50年代末被国防部退役，成为海盗电台和“西兰公国”这个微国家的所在地。

src: They will not give up their land voluntarily. It is therefore necessary to conquer the land of the Boii.
dst: 他们不会自愿放弃土地。因此必须征服波伊人的土地。

src: They've also been able to spontaneously reproduce three or so of the Pegasus vehicle designs in the machine's vehicle factory.  If you're willing to take a chance with some unknown equipment, it might be helpful to acquire some of these for our force.
dst: 他们还设法在机器的载具工厂里当场复制出了三种左右的珀伽索斯载具设计。如果你愿意拿些未知装备冒险，为我们的部队弄到一些可能会有帮助。

src: Things have considerably worsened in these past months. Changing Serbia for Rheims was bad enough, but you and me knew that, sooner or later, an even darker day would come. That day is today. Here I am, at the front of Verdun, ready to enter combat in what is, possibly, the most terrible place on Earth. Many brave German soldiers have sacrificed themselves here since this year began. Now it's the turn of the Alpenkorps. We must keep on pressing the Fench once and again. Eventually, they won't be able to resist anymore and France will surrender. At least, that's the plan. Our country demands it, and we'll obey. That's what soldiers do.
dst: 这几个月来，局势急剧恶化。离开塞尔维亚转赴兰斯已经够糟了，但您我心里都清楚，迟早会有更黑暗的一天到来。那一天就是今天。此刻我身在凡尔登前线，即将投入到或许是地球上最可怕的地方的战斗中。自今年年初以来，许多勇敢的德国士兵已在这里献身。现在轮到阿尔卑斯军了。我们必须一次又一次地向法国人施压。最终，他们将再也无力抵抗，法国就会投降。至少，计划是这样。祖国要求如此，我们唯有服从。军人就是如此。

src: Things have not gone well in the west. The allies have proven to be unstoppable, and are now advancing across German soil. You must stop them and push them back along the entire front by taking all objectives. If you can hold onto a minimum of six objectives, we may be able to obtain tolerable armistice terms. This is the final battle; you face either death or glory.
dst: 西线形势不利。盟军已被证明无法阻挡，如今正越过德国本土推进。你必须夺取全部目标，在全线阻止他们并将其击退。你若能守住至少六个目标，我们或许还能争取到尚可接受的停战条件。这是最后一战；你面临的不是死亡就是荣耀。

src: Things were going quite well before they wounded you. Don't worry, with the help of the Germans we'll manage to break through the Russian lines. In the following weeks nobody will be able to stop our advance. Soon, we'll liberate Premissel, Lemberg and all of Galizien. Besides, if they want to rebuild their lines, the Russians will have to retreat from the Warschau salient, too. When the front line stabilizes, we'll be fighting inside the Russian Empire. There is some bad news, though.  Italy will declare war on the Empire before the end of the month, so we'll have to deploy troops on three different fronts.
dst: 在您负伤之前，局势进展得相当顺利。别担心，有了德国人的帮助，我们会突破俄军防线。接下来的几周，没人能阻挡我们的推进。很快，我们将解放普热梅希尔、伦贝格以及整个加利西亚。此外，俄国人若要重建防线，还不得不从华沙突出部撤退。当战线稳定下来时，我们将在俄国境内作战。不过也有个坏消息：意大利将在月底前向帝国宣战，因此我们将不得不在三条战线上部署部队。

src: Think twice! You're going to omit two interesting scenarios and You don't get a plane for free!!!
dst: 三思!你会错过两个有趣的场景,而且飞机不会白送!!!

src: Third battalion of the 6th US Armored Regiment / 1st US Armored Division. You control these forces. Most people agree that this battalion's mission to capture Oran harbour intact was suicidal. It is up to you to keep these guys alive.
dst: 美军第1装甲师第6装甲团第3营。这些部队由你指挥。多数人认为该营完好夺取奥兰港的任务形同自杀。能否让这些弟兄活下来，就靠你了。
“闪电战！”迷你战役的第三部分。

src: Third part of the "Defending The Reich" minicampaign.
dst: “保卫德意志”迷你战役的第三部分。

src: Third part of the "Defending the Reich" minicampaign.
dst: “保卫帝国”小型战役的第三部分。

src: Third part of the "Tiger I" minicampaign
dst: “虎式I型”迷你战役的第三部分

src: Third part of the "Tiger II" minicampaign
dst: “虎式II型”迷你战役的第三部分

src: This Version is optimised for playing as Caesar against the AI-Pompeius.
dst: 本版本针对扮演凯撒对抗AI庞培作了优化。

src: This a "torched earth" policy and everything must be destroyed before we leave the area.
dst: 这是“焦土”政策，我们离开这一地区之前，一切都必须摧毁。

src: This advance is pushing our organisational talents to the limit, but we advanced 60 miles into Egypt with only light casualties. Only 300 miles to go to Alexandria.
dst: 这次推进把我们后勤组织能力逼到了极限，但我们仅以轻微伤亡就深入埃及60英里。距亚历山大只剩300英里。

src: This advance is pushing our organisational talents to the limit. We told Mussolini this invasion is doomed to fail, and look what has happened. Our attack has stalled completely.
dst: 这次推进把我们后勤组织能力逼到了极限。我们早就告诉墨索里尼，这次入侵注定失败，看看结果如何？我们的进攻已彻底停滞。

src: This area will be secure for some time. But, sadly, I have bad news from Kimberley. Roberts has forced Cronjé to leave his positions at Magersfontein, and now he's at risk of being trapped at the Modder River. Are you willing to go back to Kimberley? Cronjé has been unfair to you in the past, but the future of our country could be at stake.
dst: 这一地区在一段时间内将是安全的。但遗憾的是，我从金伯利带来了坏消息。罗伯茨已迫使克罗涅放弃他在马赫斯方丹的阵地，现在克罗涅有在莫德河被围困的危险。您愿意回金伯利去吗？克罗涅过去对您不公，但事关国家的未来。

src: This battalion level scenario is loosely based on Hannes Gruber's regimental level Moscow scenario. The map on which it is played is created by Hannes Gruber.
dst: 这个营级场景大致依据 Hannes Gruber 的团级莫斯科场景改编。所用地图由 Hannes Gruber 制作。

src: This battle can be a difficult one. There are some six enemy divisions in the area, although some of them may be weakened after the previous battles, and they've had time to build trenches and machine gun nests. You'll have to employ your resources carefully, using your artillery to open holes on the enemy defence system before advancing.
dst: 这场战斗可能十分艰难。该地区大约有六个敌师，尽管其中一些在此前的战斗中可能已被削弱，而且他们有充足时间构筑战壕和机枪火力点。您必须审慎运用手中资源，在推进前先用炮兵在敌军防御体系上打开缺口。

src: This battle will be a difficult one. There are some six enemy divisions in the area, although some of them may be weakened after the previous battles, and the've had time to build trenches and machine gun nests. You'll have to employ your resources carefully, using your artillery to open holes on the enemy defence system before advancing.
dst: 这将是一场硬仗。该地区约有六个敌军师，尽管其中一些可能已在前几场战斗中被削弱，而且他们有时间修筑堑壕和机枪火力点。您必须谨慎运用您的兵力，在推进前用炮兵在敌军防御体系上撕开缺口。

src: This brilliant victory will ever be in the haerts of our soviet population. Due to your brave soldiers we could push forward in the south of Moskau and recapture a lot of land. If we could succeed a breakthrough in the north there will be a chance to encircle the whole Heeresgruppe Mitte in a big pocket.
dst: 这一辉煌胜利将永远留在我国苏维埃人民的心中。正因为您麾下勇敢的士兵，我们才得以在莫斯科以南推进，收复大片土地。如果我们能在北面实现突破，就有机会将整个中央集团军群合围于一个大包围圈中。

src: This campaign covers Russian participation in two conflicts of the 20th century:  the Russo-Japanese War of 1904-05 and WWI.  The former war presented many lessons about waging modern war:  many of them to be overlooked until blood began to spill.  At the outbreak of WWI, Russia's peasant army represented a bottomless well of manpower reserves, with only a slow mobilization schedule holding it from overrunning her enemies outright.  The opening year of the war saw massive armies of men engaged in a battle of maneuver with casualties running into hundreds of thousands by September.  As the Western Front froze into entrenched positions, the campaigns of maneuver continued in the East.  The front only settled briefly in the winter, to be shattered by a Central Powers' breakthrough offensive in 1915.  The year of 1916 saw the frontier stabilized into lines of trenches:  in places very porous along a vastly longer front.  Launching a truly successful offensive in the summer of 1916, Russia's tragic role in the war approached victory:  only to be snatched away by internal turmoil.  Suffering staggering losses in the war, pressured by civil unrest, and manipulated by the Bolsheviks, Russia signed a separate peace with Germany, Austria-Hungary, Bulgaria, and Turkey on March 3, 1918.
dst: 本战役涵盖俄国参与的20世纪两场冲突：1904-05年的日俄战争和第一次世界大战。前者提供了许多关于现代战争的教训，其中许多教训直到流血开始才被重视。一战爆发时，俄国的农民军队代表着取之不尽的兵员储备，只有缓慢的动员进度阻碍了它一举碾压敌人。战争的第一年，庞大的军队投入运动战，到9月伤亡已达数十万。当西线僵持为堑壕阵地时，运动战仍在东线继续。战线仅在冬季短暂稳定，随后便被同盟国1915年的突破性攻势所击碎。1916年，边境稳定成一条条堑壕防线——在漫长得多的战线上，许多地段漏洞百出。1916年夏发动了一场真正成功的攻势后，俄国在这场战争中的悲剧角色已接近胜利，却因内部动荡而功亏一篑。在遭受惨重损失、承受内乱压力、并受布尔什维克操纵之后，俄国于1918年3月3日与德国、奥匈帝国、保加利亚和土耳其单独媾和。

src: This campaign features two extensively modified versions of Craig Miller's original campaigns "Blitzkrieg!" and "Greater Europe". At the choice scenario following Dunkirk you can choose which campaign to play.  If you choose to do the "Greater Europe" campaign path please be aware that you will need a moderate air force (3-4 fighters) in order to win the scenario Invasion!.
dst: 本战役包含 Craig Miller 原版战役“闪击战！”和“大欧洲”的两个经大幅修改的版本。在敦刻尔克之后的抉择场景中，您可以选择游玩哪条战役线。如果您选择“大欧洲”战役路线，请注意您需要一支中等规模的空军（3-4架战斗机）才能赢下“入侵！”场景。

src: This campaign follows the fate of a fictional combined-arms Wehrmacht unit and its commander Otto Bistroff. Starting as a Spanish volunteer leading the armoured column, both his rank and the size of his unit progressively rises up until the Zitadelle operation, where his brigade was decimated and most of the men killed, wounded or captured.
dst: 本战役讲述一支虚构的国防军合成兵种部队及其指挥官奥托·比斯特罗夫的命运。他从率领装甲纵队的西班牙志愿兵起步，军衔与部队规模一路攀升，直到“堡垒”行动，他的旅遭到重创，大部分士兵或阵亡、或负伤、或被俘。

src: This campaign is 25 scenarios long and has very limited aux units. You fight with your core. Poland, France, Russia and more need to be comquered.
dst: 本战役共25个场景，辅助单位非常有限。你将依靠核心部队作战。波兰、法国、俄国等都需要被征服。

src: This campaign is a complete rework of Matti's Hungarian campaign for Waffenkammer. It strongly uses new features of Open General like minefields, built airfields, railways, train transports, new victory conditions, etc. Several new scenarios have been added and some maps have been replaced where better ones were available.
dst: 本战役是对Matti为Waffenkammer制作的匈牙利战役的彻底重制。它大量运用了Open General的新特性，如雷场、自建机场、铁路、列车运输、新的胜利条件等。新增了若干剧本，并在有更好地图可用时替换了部分地图。

src: This campaign is a further development of MillerBlitz+ and Blitz 2008 which both of them were modernized versions of H. Craig Miller's Blitzkrieg!. This version has been modernized even further and contains major changes to the scenario set-up. There are some new scenarios and in consequence some of the old ones have disappeared.
dst: 本战役是MillerBlitz+和Blitz 2008的进一步发展，这两者都是H. Craig Miller的《闪电战！》的现代化版本。本版本作了更进一步的现代化，并对剧本设置做了重大改动。新增了一些剧本，相应地，一些旧剧本也就此消失。

src: This campaign is a result of a long and tedious work. I wish that you will find it interesting, challenging and entertaining. I had fun while designing it, and it learnt me a few things about Open General, Open Suite, and about history of World War II. Enjoy playing the campaign at least the same as I enjoyed the designing.
dst: 本战役是长期艰苦工作的成果。我希望你能觉得它有趣、有挑战、也够好玩。我在设计过程中乐在其中，也借此了解了 Open General、Open Suite 与二战历史的一些门道。愿你游玩时的乐趣，至少不亚于我设计时的投入。

src: This campaign is a result of a long and tedious work. I wish that you will find it interesting, challenging and entertaining. I had fun while designing it, and it learnt me a few things about Open General, Open Suite, and about the history of World War II. Enjoy playing the campaign at least in the same way as I enjoyed the designing.
dst: 本战役是长期繁重劳动的成果。希望你能觉得它有趣、有挑战、有娱乐性。设计它时我乐在其中，也由此学到了不少关于 Open General、Open Suite 和二战历史的东西。愿你至少像我在设计中一样享受这款战役。

src: This campaign is dedicated to my (now deceased) Grandfather who was a sergeant in the British Army.
dst: 本战役献给我（现已故的）祖父——他生前是英军的一名军士。

src: This campaign is semi-historical: all scenarios refer to real battles, but there are no historical OOBs at all.
dst: 本战役为半史实：所有剧本均取材于真实战役，但完全没有史实的部队编制（OOB）。

src: This campaign recreates the main battles that Prussia fought during that historical period.
dst: 本战役重现了普鲁士在这一历史时期进行的主要战斗。

src: This campaign recreates the main battles that took place in German East Africa during WWI.
dst: 本战役再现了一战期间德属东非发生的主要战斗。

src: This campaign tries to combine the the good old "Blitzkrieg" campaigns by SSI and other designers with many new maps and scenarios and new features of modern Open General.
dst: 本战役试图把 SSI 与其他设计师的经典"闪击战"战役，同众多新地图、新场景以及现代 Open General 的新特性结合起来。

src: This campaign uses the "no prototype" settings. For the "Blitzkrieg!" minicampaign, you'd be awarded with an air support appropriate to your results; lets say that the High Command attached a Luftwaffe unit to your brigade for the purpose of testing the new Messerschmitt planes in combat. For the "Defending the Reich" minicampaign this flow of test planes will stop due to the Allied air offensive.
dst: 本战役采用“无原型机”设定。在“闪电战！”小型战役中，你会按战果获得相应的空中支援——不妨说，最高统帅部为你的旅配属了一支德国空军部队，以便在实战中测试新型梅塞施密特战机。而在“保卫帝国”小型战役中，由于盟军的空中攻势，这批试飞机将不再供给。

src: This campaign will take you from the cliffs of Scapa Flow to the White Cliffs of Dover. You'll invade Great Britain and experience adventures on the north american continent.
dst: 本战役将带你从斯卡帕湾的悬崖一路到多佛白崖。你将入侵大不列颠，并在北美大陆经历种种冒险。

src: This campaign will test your abilities as a leader in both Blitzkrieg scenarios and defensive scenarios.
dst: 本战役将在闪击战场景和防御场景中考验您的指挥才能。

src: This campaign, fictional though it is, will lead you through the main battles of the East Front from the siege of Leningrad to the fall of Pomerania. It is an accumulation of ideas and ideals, facts and fictions about the Tiger tanks; the scenarios may be resembling a story you've read about, but you can never be exactly sure if that particular history happened or not...
dst: 这部战役虽属虚构，却将带你走完东线的主要战役——从列宁格勒围城到波美拉尼亚陷落。它是关于虎式坦克的种种构想与理念、事实与虚构的汇集；这些场景可能酷似你读过的一段故事，但你永远无法确定那段历史是否真的发生过……

src: This can be tough, because you will have the option to fight against west allied troops. Otherwise this path will lead you to Berlin.
dst: 这条路线可能很艰难，因为你将有机会与西线盟军部队交战。否则这条路线将直通柏林。

src: This catastrophic defeat of the Soviets will speed up the liberation of Iran. Continue your advance towards Tabriz to Azerbaijan!
dst: 苏军的这场惨败将加速伊朗的解放。继续向阿塞拜疆方向推进，直指大不里士！

src: This cold winter will not quit!  Good attacks by you and your men, Bravo!
dst: 这个寒冬没完没了！你和你部下打得好，好样的！

src: This cold winter will not quit!  Your attacks by you and your men were done well, no one can blame our snail's pace amid this blasted weather!
dst: 这个寒冬没完没了！你和你部下的进攻打得很好，在这鬼天气里没人能怪我们蜗牛般的速度！

src: This cold winter will not quit......but this did not stop you!
dst: 这个寒冬没完没了……但这没能阻止你！

src: This could be the final battle of the war!
dst: 这可能是这场战争的最后一战！

src: This coup has ousted the government we signed a protocol with 2 days earlier - which is 2 weeks ago now - a protocol that brought Yugoslavia in the Tripartite Pact.
dst: 这场政变推翻了两天前——也就是两周前的今天——与我们签署议定书的政府，那份议定书曾把南斯拉夫拉入三国同盟条约。

src: This crushing defeat was too much for the American people, the pressure to demand a cease-fire too large. At least negotiations are in progress and the conditions, I think, will be fair. Until the signing of a peace treaty parts of the American east coast remain occupied, Army, Air Force and Fleet will be reduced to a minimum. The Pacific and Caribbean possessions will be resolved and the Panama Canal comes under international control. Also Canada, Australia, South Africa and New Zealand end her fight and be involved in the negotiations.
dst: 这场惨败对美国人民的打击太大了，要求停火的压力也太大。至少谈判正在进行，而且我认为条件将是公平的。在和平条约签署之前，美国东海岸的部分地区仍被占领，陆军、空军和舰队将被削减到最低限度。太平洋和加勒比的属地问题将得到解决，巴拿马运河将交由国际共管。加拿大、澳大利亚、南非和新西兰也将停止抵抗，参与谈判。

src: This declaration of war has already been given to the ambassadors of Great Britain and France. We are going to fight against the plutocratic democracy and reactionaries of the West that have always hindered the advance and endangered the existence of the Italian people...
dst: 这份宣战书已递交英国和法国大使。我们将与西方那些始终阻碍我们前进、危害意大利民族生存的财阀民主与反动派作战……

src: This defeat means the end of the Aragon front. Now the enemy can easily reach the Mediterranean sea without problems.
dst: 这次失败意味着阿拉贡战线的终结。如今敌人可以毫无阻碍地轻易抵达地中海。

src: This engagement had the potential to go down in the history of tank battles; instead, it will remain a stain on your record. Dismissed!
dst: 这场交战本有载入坦克战史册的潜质；结果却将成为你履历上的污点。解职！

src: This exercise seriously got out of control. Apparently these spaghetti eaters misinterpreted their orders and you were not able to cope with the situation. This does not look good on the track record of the Waffen-SS. I don't expect your troops will take part in any operation anytime soon.
dst: 这场演习严重失控。显然意大利人曲解了他们的命令，而你未能应付局面。这对武装党卫军的履历可不好看。我预计你的部队短期内不会参加任何行动。

src: This exercise seriously got out of control. Apparently these spaghetti eaters misinterpreted their orders. Congratulations for completing this exercise successfully.
dst: 这场演习严重失控。显然意大利人曲解了他们的命令。恭喜你顺利完成演习。

src: This exercise seriously got out of control. Apparently these spaghetti eaters misinterpreted their orders. Congratulations for completing this exercise with reasonable success.
dst: 这场演习严重失控。显然意大利人曲解了他们的命令。恭喜你相当成功地完成了演习。

src: This exercise seriously got out of control. Apparently these spaghetti eaters misinterpreted their orders. Congratulations for completing this exercise with some success anyway.
dst: 这场演习严重失控。显然意大利人曲解了他们的命令。恭喜你总算略有成效地完成了演习。

src: This far north, they won't expect us!
dst: 在这遥远的北方，他们不会料到我们！

src: This fictional scenario refers to the movie "The Eagle Has Landed". The villages in the movie are fictional too, but in one scene they point at a map and the area they point at is the Wighton, Warham, Holkham area.
dst: 这个虚构场景取材于电影《鹰已着陆》。电影中的村庄也是虚构的，但有一个场景中他们指着地图，所指之处正是怀顿、沃勒姆、霍尔克姆一带。

src: This first British attempt to overcome your defences has ended with an outstanding German victory. But don't be overconfident: there will be more attacks.
dst: 英军第一次试图突破您防御的尝试，以德军一场出色的胜利告终。但不要过于自信：还会有更多进攻。

src: This game (literally pi³ka rêczna) is also called "szczypiorniak" after the POW camp Sczypiorno, when the legionists played it.
dst: 这项运动（字面意为「手球」）又被称为「什奇皮奥尔尼亚克」，因军团士兵们曾在什奇皮奥尔诺战俘营里打它而得名。

src: This has been a disastrous, unexpected defeat. Our men are running for their lives, trying desperately to cross to the safe shore of the Drina, and many are dying there, drowned. The Serbians have rejected our first offensive in this war.
dst: 这是一场灾难性的、出人意料的失败。我们的士兵正拼命逃命，试图渡过德里纳河抵达安全的对岸，许多人溺死在那里。塞尔维亚人已挫败了我们在这场战争中的首次攻势。

src: This has been a great victory for Bulgaria, General. Most of Thrace is ours and, when the Serbians fullfill our informal pre-war agreement, we'll also take possession of Vardar Macedonia.
dst: 将军，这对保加利亚来说是一场伟大的胜利。色雷斯大部分已归我们所有，等塞尔维亚人履行我们战前的非正式约定，我们还将占有瓦尔达尔马其顿。

src: This has been the biggest defeat in the 1000 years of roman army: 3 Legions have been annilihated...according to tradition Augustus in despair has claimed "Oh Vare, Vare Legiones redde!" meaning " Oh Varus, Varus bring me back my legions!"......The numbers of the 18., 19. and 20. legion never have been attached again and the three legion eagles have never been found ( the biggest shame for a roman general and according to my knowledge the only legion eagles ever been lost).
dst: 这是罗马军队千年史上最大的一次惨败：3个军团被全歼...据传奥古斯都绝望地喊道「瓦鲁斯啊，瓦鲁斯，把我的军团还给我！」......第18、19、20军团的番号此后再未被授予，三面军团鹰旗也再未被寻获（对罗马统帅而言是最大的耻辱，据我所知，这也是罗马军团鹰旗唯一一次失落的记录）。

src: This has been the end of the Greek offensives. They have nothing else that they can throw into us. Ankara will resist, and now we can use our growing reserves to recover all the land that Greece took away from us.
dst: 这标志着希腊攻势的终结。他们再也拿不出什么来对付我们了。安卡拉将坚守下去，现在我们可以用不断壮大的预备队来收复希腊从我们手中夺去的所有土地。

src: This has been too much for the Germans. Their survivors are crossing the canal, back to their trenches. The front is safe again.
dst: 这对德军来说太过分了。他们的幸存者正渡过运河，撤回战壕。战线又安全了。

src: This has been your third successful campaign in just two years. I guess that you're looking forward to the day when you'll return to America. Well, I've got good news for you. Your request has been granted, and one of our ships will take you in Taku in less than a week. You'll be in San Francisco before the end of the summer, but I hope this won't be the last time that we hear from you.
dst: 这是您短短两年内的第三次成功战役。我猜您正盼着返回美国的那一天。那么，我有好消息告诉您。您的请求已获批准，一周之内，我们的一艘船会在大沽接您。夏天结束前您就会抵达旧金山，但我希望这不是我们最后一次听到您的消息。

src: This has certainly been a bittersweet ending. Your failure at the gates of Minsk will make it much harder for our diplomats to get concessions from the Russians. It's a pity that you couldn't finish what you had started.
dst: 这无疑是个苦乐参半的结局。您在明斯克城下的失败，将使我方外交官更难从俄国人那里争取到让步。可惜您没能完成自己开创的事业。

src: This hasn't been your best performance in a battle, has it? Thank God, the Ottomans could send enough reserves and the British decided to retire into the Sinai. So all's well that ends well, I suppose.
dst: 这不是您在战斗中最出色的表现，对吧？谢天谢地，奥斯曼人派出了足够的预备队，英国人也决定退入西奈半岛。所以我想，结局好就一切都好。
这是一个（「半」）虚构的场景！

src: This is a 50 scenario German campaign, divided in three independent paths, one each for Army Group Center, North and South.
dst: 这是一场包含50个剧本的德军战役，分为三条相互独立的路线，分别对应中央集团军群、北方集团军群和南方集团军群。

src: This is a British campaign covering the period of the war from 1940-45.  Beginning in East Africa you will face off against Italy and her colonial allies, before moving onto North Africa to face the Afrika Korps.  Following the successful operations in Africa the campaign then moves into the European theatre, starting with the struggle up through Italy, before shifting to the invasion and liberation of France.  In the final stages you will move through Belgium and Holland until you finally reach the Rhine and cross into Nazi Germany.
dst: 这是一部英国战役，涵盖1940至45年的战争。你将从东非开始，与意大利及其殖民盟友对阵，随后转战北非，面对非洲军团。非洲作战成功之后，战役转入欧洲战场，先是沿意大利一路苦战，随后转向入侵并解放法国。在最后阶段，你将穿过比利时和荷兰，直至抵达莱茵河并渡过进入纳粹德国。

src: This is a bitter defeat. Even now, enemy troops are advancing on our position.  Arm yourself with a rifle and seek redemption on the front lines.  I must leave you now, Herr General.
dst: 这是一场惨痛的失败。即便此刻，敌军正在向我阵地推进。拿起一支步枪，到前线去寻求救赎吧。我得走了，将军阁下。

src: This is a campaign created for a mid-sized core army, prestige settings will as a consequence reflect this.
dst: 本战役为中等规模的核心部队设计，声望设置也将相应体现这一点。

src: This is a choice scenario, after the fall of Egypt and the defeat of the Allied invaders of the Vichy France African territories, you should decide where the Deutsches Afrika Korps will go this time. We have made two different plans;
dst: 这是一个选择场景，在埃及陷落和盟军对维希法国非洲领地的入侵者被击败之后，您应当决定德意志非洲军这次将去向何方。我们制定了两套不同的方案；

src: This is a choice scenario. Depending on what you choose, different units will be added to your core.
dst: 这是一个抉择场景。根据您的选择，不同的单位将被加入您的核心单位。

src: This is a commando mission, you can deploy only ground units.
dst: 这是一次突击队任务，你只能部署地面部队。

src: This is a different campaign from Base AAW.
dst: 这是与 Base AAW 不同的一个战役。

src: This is a disaster! Herr General, German field commanders are not allowed to fail. Do you understand?  You are reliefed of your command and are ordered back to Berlin.  I have nothing more to say to you.
dst: 这是一场灾难！将军阁下，德国战地指挥官不允许失败。你明白吗？  你已被解除指挥权，并奉命返回柏林。  我没有什么要再对你说的了。

src: This is a disaster! Herr General, we have broken our teeth on the enemy defenses. The Bolsheviks are counterattacking all along our front. Army Group North has been shaken and must give ground. General Hoth will be assuming your duties. That is all. You are reliefed of your command and are ordered back to Berlin.
dst: 这是一场灾难！将军阁下，我们在敌军防线上碰得头破血流。布尔什维克正沿我们整个正面发起反攻。北方集团军群已受重创，必须后撤。霍特大将将接替你的职务。情况就是这样。你已被解除指挥职务，奉命返回柏林。

src: This is a disaster! We have to retreat to the east. You are reliefed of your command and are ordered back to Berlin. Unfortunately the Luftwaffe is busy and your transport plane won't have an escort...
dst: 这是一场灾难！我们必须向东撤退。你被解除指挥权，并被命令返回柏林。不幸的是，德国空军正忙，你的运输机不会有护航……

src: This is a disaster! You are reliefed of your command and are ordered back to Berlin.
dst: 这是一场灾难！你被解除指挥权，并被命令返回柏林。

src: This is a disaster! You are reliefed of your command and are ordered back to Berlin. You are lucky your escaped this fiasco with one of the last planes that made it out of the pocket.
dst: 这是一场灾难！你已被解除指挥权，并被命令返回柏林。你很幸运，搭乘最后几架飞出口袋的飞机之一逃离了这场惨败。

src: This is a disaster! You are reliefed of your command and are ordered back to Italy. You will join a minesweeper flotilla in the Adriatic Sea.
dst: 这是一场灾难！你被解除指挥权，并被命令返回意大利。你将加入亚得里亚海的一支扫雷舰艇分队。

src: This is a disaster! You are reliefed of your command and are ordered back to Pearl Harbor for cleaning-up operations after the Japanese attack. The head of the bomb disposal unit is waiting for you.
dst: 这是一场灾难！您被解除指挥权，奉命返回珍珠港，执行日军袭击后的清理任务。拆弹部队负责人正在等您。

src: This is a disaster! You are reliefed of your command and are ordered to join our mine clearing forces in the arctic sea.
dst: 这是一场灾难！你被解除指挥权，并被命令前往加入我们在北冰洋的扫雷部队。

src: This is a disaster! You are reliefed of your command and are ordered to join our secret weather station on Spitzbergen.
dst: 这真是一场灾难！你被解除指挥权，并被命令前往我们在斯匹次卑尔根的秘密气象站。

src: This is a disaster! You are reliefed of your command and are ordered to join the crew of an minesweeper off the east coast of Scotland.
dst: 这是一场灾难！你被解除指挥权，并被命令登上苏格兰东海岸外的一艘扫雷舰。

src: This is a disaster! You are reliefed of your command and ordered back to Military Academy for additional training.
dst: 这是一场灾难！你已被解除指挥职务，奉命返回军事学院接受进一步培训。

src: This is a disaster! You are reliefed of your command and ordered to join the crew of NMS Amiral Murgescu for mine laying duties in the Black Sea.
dst: 这是一场灾难！你被解除指挥权，并被命令登上 NMS Amiral Murgescu 号，前往黑海执行布雷任务。

src: This is a disaster! You are relieved of your command and are ordered back to London for further consultations.
dst: 这是一场灾难！你被解除指挥权，并被命令返回伦敦接受进一步磋商。

src: This is a disaster! You are stripped of your rank and insignia and are ordered to serve on a minesweeper in the arctic waters of Greenland. The war is over for you.
dst: 这是一场灾难！您被剥夺军衔和徽章，并被命令在格陵兰的北极水域一艘扫雷舰上服役。对您而言，战争已经结束。

src: This is a disaster! You are stripped of your rank and insignia and are ordered to serve on a minesweeper in the arctic waters of the Aleutian Islands. The war is over for you.
dst: 这是一场灾难！你被剥夺军衔和徽章，奉命到阿留申群岛的北极水域扫雷舰上服役。对你来说，战争已经结束。

src: This is a disaster! You were fortunate to have escaped capture after the this fiasco. You are reliefed of your command and are ordered back to Berlin.
dst: 这是一场灾难！这场惨败之后您侥幸未被俘。您被解除指挥权，奉命返回柏林。

src: This is a disaster! You will be stripped of your rank and insignia and are ordered to join the crew of a minesweeper in the Arctic Ocean.
dst: 这是一场灾难！您将被剥夺军衔和徽章，并被命令加入北冰洋上一艘扫雷舰的舰员队伍。

src: This is a disaster!, the British have recaptured Agedabia and Mersa el Brega, and are now driving to Tripoli!!!. Obviously, you are dimissed.
dst: 这是一场灾难！英军已夺回艾季达比耶和梅尔萨布赖加，如今正向的黎波里推进！！！显然，您被解职了。

src: This is a disaster, now we must make a retreat to Tunis to avoid the complete destruction of the Deutsches Afrikakorps...
dst: 这是一场灾难，现在我们只能撤往突尼斯，以免德意志非洲军全军覆没……

src: This is a disaster. Our ships has been sunk by the allies,the most of our troops are liying in the deep and cold sea, and now, we are prisoners of the allies.
dst: 这是一场灾难。我们的舰船被盟军击沉，我们的大部分部队正躺在冰冷幽深的海中，而现在，我们成了盟军的俘虏。

src: This is a disaster. The danish has defended itselfs good against our attack, and we can not achieve our objetives. You are dimissed.
dst: 这是一场灾难。丹麦人出色地抵御了我们的进攻，我们无法达成目标。您被解职了。

src: This is a disaster. The norvegians has defended itselfs good against our attack, and we can not achieve our objetives. You are dimissed.
dst: 这是一场灾难。挪威人对我们的进攻防守得很好，我们无法达成目标。您被解职了。

src: This is a disater, you have been defeated and the way to Baghdad is now open. Morale is so low that the consequences of your defeat can be much more far reaching.
dst: 这是一场灾难，您被击败了，通往巴格达的道路如今畅通无阻。士气如此低落，您战败的后果可能远比想象中深远。

src: This is a dissaster!!! the enemy have taken the Alcazar, and they are leaving to Madrid right now with the colonel Moscardo and they comrades as prisoners!. You are dimised!.
dst: 这是一场灾难！！！敌人已经攻占了托莱多城堡，此刻正带着作为俘虏的莫斯卡多上校及其战友前往马德里！您被撤职了！

src: This is a dissaster!, now Zaragoza is being besiged by the reds!!!. The generalisimo will be only happy receiveing your head as apology!!!!
dst: 这是一场灾难！如今萨拉戈萨正被共和军围困！！！最高统帅只有拿到您的项上人头作为交代才会满意！！！！

src: This is a dissaster!, the Republicans have defeated us, and Teruel is still in their hands!. Our march on to the Mediterranean sea is stopped!. We don't need you anymore.
dst: 这是一场灾难！共和军打败了我们，特鲁埃尔仍在他们手中！我们向地中海的进军已被遏止！我们不再需要您了。

src: This is a fictional scenario, because Crixos never came to this.
dst: 这是虚构场景，因为克里克索斯从未走到这一步。

src: This is a future that we can't abide, Commander.  It's time to head back and make it right.
dst: 这是一个我们无法接受的未来，指挥官。是该回去把它拨正的时候了。

src: This is a joint operation, so Habsburg's and Hohenzollern's equipment is available.
dst: 这是一次联合作战，因此哈布斯堡和霍亨索伦的装备都可以使用。

src: This is a joint operation,so Habsburg's and Hohenzollern's equipment is available.
dst: 这是一次联合作战，因此哈布斯堡和霍亨索伦的装备都可以使用。

src: This is a mini campaign about them.
dst: 这是一个关于他们的迷您战役。

src: This is a more difficult scenario . Taking a BV here really challenges the player.  Use of engineer type units to construct additional defenses is advisable.
dst: 这是一个较难的战役。在此取得辉煌胜利（BV）对玩家确是挑战。建议使用工程兵单位构筑额外防御。

src: This is a really important victory!, the British have been completely surprised by your Southern "hook". The Gazala Line is destroyed, and also Tobruk has fallen in our hands. Kongratulieren.
dst: 这是一场极其重要的胜利！英军被你从南面的“迂回”完全打了个措手不及。加扎拉防线已被摧毁，托布鲁克也落入我们手中。祝贺。

src: This is a sad day for the Empire. Our brave General has died while he was commanding his troops at the Predeal Pass. The battle still goes on and, without his guidance, our victory isn't clear. I hope that soon we'll replace him with another competent officer. However, the fallen hero will always be missed.
dst: 今天是帝国悲伤的一天。我们英勇的将军在普雷迪亚尔山口指挥部队时阵亡了。战斗仍在继续，失去了他的指挥，胜负尚难预料。我希望我们很快能以另一位称职的军官接替他。然而，这位阵亡的英雄将永远被我们怀念。

src: This is a short German World War II campaign. It is best suited for a lonely weekend, because the battles are small and they are not really hard. You command a single Tiger battalion comprised of a few units (the scale that I used is unit=company), with a dozen or two of auxiliaries.
dst: 这是一部短小的德国二战战役。战斗规模小、难度不高，最适合独处周末时游玩。你指挥一个由若干单位组成的虎式坦克营（我所用的比例尺是单位=连），另有一二十个辅助单位。

src: This is a short German World War II campaign. It is concentrated around the tank battalion with its accompanying support elements. It should be perfectly suited for a lonely weekend, because the scale of battles is small to medium and they are not really hard.
dst: 这是一部短小的德国二战战役。它围绕一个坦克营及其配属支援分队展开。战斗规模中小、难度不高，非常适合独处周末时游玩。

src: This is a short fictional World War II campaign. It is concentrated around the motorised brigade/division and its accompanying air support. It is perfectly suited for a lonely weekend. The scale of battles is small to medium and they are not really hard.
dst: 这是一场短小的虚构二战战役，围绕一支摩托化旅/师及其配属的空中支援展开。它非常适合一个人安静地度个周末。战斗规模小到中等，难度也不算高。

src: This is a total disaster. Despite important reinforcements you have been completely defeated. In addition, the situation in Cuba is dramatic. The Government has therefore requested to start peace talks. The fate of the Philippines is now in the hands of our politicians.
dst: 这真是一场彻头彻尾的灾难。尽管有大量增援，您仍被彻底击败。此外，古巴局势严峻。政府因此已要求开始和谈。菲律宾的命运如今掌握在我们的政治家手中。

src: This is a very dangerous move. Our army hasn't recovered from the losses of the war against Turkey, and the combined strength of Serbian, Greek and Montenegrin troops is greater than ours. We'll have to employ almost all our soldiers in this new war, leaving the rest of our borders undefended. The Ottomans could take the chance to recover some of the lands they lost some months ago, and Romania will have a golden opportunity for seizing our Dobrudzha region.
dst: 这是一步非常危险的棋。我军尚未从对土耳其战争的损失中恢复过来，而塞尔维亚、希腊和黑山军队的合力大于我们。我们几乎得把全部兵力投入这场新战争，导致其余边境无人防守。奥斯曼人可能趁机收复他们几个月前失去的一些土地，而罗马尼亚则将获得夺取我们多布罗加地区的绝佳机会。

src: This is a very important victory, though we lost further south, and your position has thus become untennable, we are giving the allies the impression that the road to Germany is still very long. The downside of things is that in the east we had to retreat to the Weichsel and the Prut.
dst: 这是一场非常重要的胜利。尽管我们在更南面失利，您的阵地也因此变得无法坚守，但我们正让盟国产生这样的印象：通往德国的道路依然十分漫长。不利的一面是，在东线我们不得不退往维斯瓦河和普鲁特河。

src: This is again a coordinated attack. The goal is Aragon's capital, Zaragoza. On your way to Zaragoza, you will encounter a lot of strongly-entreched falangist garrisons. These garrisons will try to resist, and delay you, until the arrival of rebel reinforcements, so a fast advance is needed. A guerrilla group has been deployed also to capture the Zaragoza bridges, but will not be able to hold them indefinitely.
dst: 这同样是一场协同进攻。目标是阿拉贡的首府萨拉戈萨。在您前往萨拉戈萨的途中，会遇到许多工事坚固的长枪党驻军。这些驻军会设法抵抗并拖延您，直到叛军援军抵达，因此需要快速推进。另外还部署了一支游击队去夺取萨拉戈萨的桥梁，但他们无法无限期地守住这些桥梁。

src: This is an Open General campaign with many new ideas and concepts utilised.
dst: 这是一个运用了许多新思路和新概念的 Open General 战役。

src: This is an absolute disaster, Herr Major. Defeat would be misfortune enough in itself, but fleeing in haste and leaving all your equipment behind as spoils for the Reds is a crime worthy of a court-martial!
dst: 这简直是彻头彻尾的灾难，少校阁下。失败本身已够不幸，但仓皇逃窜、把全部装备丢给红军当战利品，是足以送交军事法庭的罪行！

src: This is an easier scenario. Achieving a BV here should raise no special problems to the player.
dst: 这是一个较为简单的战役。玩家在此取得辉煌胜利（BV）应当不会有特殊困难。

src: This is an original scenario made by Dennis Felling for his 22 Infanterie Division campaign - Sevastopol 2, slightly modified by Jan Hedstrom
dst: 这是Dennis Felling为其第22步兵师战役——塞瓦斯托波尔2——制作的原创剧本，由Jan Hedstrom稍作修改

src: This is an original scenario made by Jorge Gabitto for his Barbarossa campaign, then converted by Guille to Open Gen The scenario has been set to another map, and has been substantially modified by myself to fit into this campaign.
dst: 这是Jorge Gabitto为其巴巴罗萨战役制作的原创剧本，后由Guille转换为Open Gen版本。该剧本被置于另一张地图上，并由本人作了大幅修改以适配本战役。

src: This is an original scenario made by Jorge Gabitto for his Barbarossa campaign, then converted by Guille to Open Gen The scenario has been slightly modified by myself to fit into this campaign.
dst: 本场景原为豪尔赫·加比托为其「巴巴罗萨」战役所作，后由吉列移植至 Open General；我本人为使其融入本战役做了少许改动。

src: This is an original scenario made by Jorge Gabitto for his Barbarossa campaign, then converted by Guille to Open Gen. The scenario has been slightly modified by myself to fit into this campaign.
dst: 这是Jorge Gabitto为其巴巴罗萨战役制作的原创剧本，后由Guille转换为Open Gen版本。该剧本由本人稍作修改以适配本战役。

src: This is an original scenario made by Jorge Gabitto for his Unternehmen Barbarossa called Rostov Counterattack, then converted by Guille to Open Gen The scenario has been slightly modified by myself to fit into this campaign.
dst: 本场景原为豪尔赫·加比托为其「巴巴罗萨行动」战役所作，名为《罗斯托夫反击》，后由吉列移植至 Open General；我本人为使其融入本战役做了少许改动。

src: This is an original scenario made by Traveller for his Barbarossa Campaign.The scenario has been converted and modified by Jan Hedstrom to fit into this campaign.
dst: 本场景原为 Traveller 为其「巴巴罗萨」战役所作，后经扬·赫德斯特罗姆移植改编以融入本战役。

src: This is an original scenario made by Traveller for his Barbarossa Campaign.The scenario has been converted and modified by myself to fit into this campaign.
dst: 这是Traveller为其巴巴罗萨战役制作的原创剧本。该剧本由本人转换并修改以适配本战役。

src: This is campaign is about him, and about his men who served in Legiony Polskie - Polish Legions in the KuK Army.
dst: 本战役讲述的就是他，以及那些在奥匈帝国军队的波兰军团中服役的他的手下们。

src: This is incredible!!!! the poorly equiped milita men have stopped your elite infantry units from Africa!!!, what kind of general are you??. You are dimised and a meeting with a military council has been arranged for you!.
dst: 真是难以置信！！！！装备简陋的民兵竟然挡住了您从非洲带来的精锐步兵部队！！！您算哪门子的将军？？您被撤职了，并且已为您安排了一场军事法庭的审判！

src: This is it - your final chance to break through 8th Army's lines before they get major reinforcements. We have completely lost air superiority and intelligence reports 100,000 tons of US material and supplies on route for Egypt. Enemy mine fields keep on being extended and their defences deepened - especially in the North.
dst: 机会来了——这是你在第8集团军获得大批增援之前突破其防线的最后机会。我们已完全丧失制空权，情报报告有10万吨美国物资和补给正运往埃及。敌方的雷区不断扩展，防御不断加深——尤其是在北面。

src: This is no time to rest. Correct your mistake: move your troops East and capture Tobruk.
dst: 现在不是休息的时候。纠正你的错误：把你的部队东调，夺取托布鲁克。

src: This is no time to rest. Move your troops East and capture Tobruk.
dst: 现在不是休息的时候。把你的部队东调，夺取托布鲁克。

src: This is not a "blitzkrieg" campaign. Battles are hard and long.
dst: 这不是一个“闪电战”战役。战斗既艰苦又漫长。

src: This is not a "blitzkrieg" campaign. Battles are hard fought and won.
dst: 这不是一个“闪电战”战役。每场战斗都艰苦卓绝、来之不易。

src: This is not a regular scenario but a so called 'player choice scenario'.
dst: 这不是一个常规场景，而是所谓的“玩家选择场景”。

src: This is one of the game's smallest maps, and provides a naval conflict as part of the action.  In order for the Axis to win the scenario the two Italian battleships must survive the scenario.
dst: 这是游戏中最小的地图之一，并且把一场海战作为行动的一部分。轴心国要赢得本场景，两艘意大利战列舰必须存活。

src: This is one too many failures Commander, take the next ship home and await further orders!!!
dst: 指挥官，您失败的次数已经太多了，乘下一班船回家待命吧！！！

src: This is our last opportunity. The Germans have advanced to the western periphery of Moscow. Hold Moscow at any costs!
dst: 这是我们最后的机会。德军已推进到莫斯科西郊。不惜一切代价守住莫斯科！

src: This is over. You have to tell the King. I do not dare, but you need to tell him because we must save as much as we can, both for the interests of the country, and for our personal gain assurance, recognition of ranks, etc.. The King must go to France and leave a general in Spain with the task of dealing with the enemy.
dst: 一切都结束了。您必须去告诉国王。我不敢去，但您必须告诉他，因为我们得尽可能多保存一些东西，既是为了国家的利益，也是为了我们个人的保障——军衔的确认等等。国王必须前往法国，留下一位将军在西班牙负责与敌人交涉。

src: This is probably also the background to the American offensive: The Americans are afraid the English might waver and hope to win before the English get serious about peace.
dst: 这大概也是美军攻势的背景：美国人担心英国人会动摇，希望在英国人认真对待和平之前取胜。

src: This is scenario inspired by the Arkhave-Vize scenario of Toliy's campaign "For God, Tsar and Motherland" .
dst: 本场景灵感来自托利「为了上帝、沙皇和祖国」战役中的阿尔哈维-维泽场景。

src: This is scenario inspired by the initial battle of Patrick Steinmann's "The Last Crusade" campaign.
dst: 本场景灵感来自帕特里克·施泰因曼「最后的十字军」战役的首场战斗。

src: This is terrible, General. We've lost our last opportunity to kick Italy out of the war. Now we must go on the defensive again. We'll probably stop them for some time, but if the Entente powers insist on attacking us, in the end we'll have to capitulate. The maritime blockade is hurting us too much, and sooner or later we won't have any resources left to keep on fighting. Your failure has doomed the Empire.
dst: 这太糟糕了，将军。我们失去了把意大利踢出战争的最后机会。现在我们必须再次转入防御。我们或许能阻挡他们一段时间，但如果协约国诸强执意进攻我们，最终我们将不得不投降。海上封锁对我们的伤害太大了，迟早我们都会耗尽继续作战的全部资源。您的失败已经把帝国推向了绝境。

src: This is the French's last bastion, the zone isn't the best for tanks, so beware.
dst: 这里是法国人最后的堡垒，这一带的地形不太适合坦克，请当心。

src: This is the easiest and shortest path. You will attack the Germans at Leningrad and will follow them to Courland.
dst: 这是最容易、最短的路线。你将在列宁格勒进攻德军，并一路追击至库尔兰。

src: This is the end of the campaign. The design started as an experiment if it's possible to make anything reasonable in 48 hours. But the project got out of hand pretty fast and it took me many months to finish, mainly due to the fact that I tinkered with lots of settings, ideas and details. I hope you liked the campaign!
dst: 战役到此结束。这一设计起初只是个实验——看是否能在 48 小时内做出像样的东西。但项目很快失控，我花了好几个月才完成，主要因为我在大量设定、构思与细节上反复打磨。希望你喜欢这场战役！

src: This is the first move for Allies in Europe. Try to push the American soldiers back to the sea. Their superiority in numbers is crushing and you must prevent the entire destruction of your forces, because American onset in Italy will go on.
dst: 这是盟军在欧洲的第一步。设法将美军赶回海上。他们数量上的优势压倒性的，你必须避免部队被全歼，因为美军在意大利的攻势还将继续。

src: This is the first significant withdrawal of the war for the German army. Now it's time to prepare for the winter...
dst: 这是德军在战争中第一次重大撤退。现在该为冬天做准备了……

src: This is the last battle to complete your campaign in Africa's West, the fortified City of Casablanca! The city is surrounded by mine fields and fortifications, at sea the Anglo-American Navy is imposing and the RAF have deployed all it's forces from the bases in Gibraltar. We trust you and we believe that you'll find a way to avoid all these obstacles in this struggle and kick-out the Allies from this sector of Africa.
dst: 这是完成您非洲西部战役的最后一战——设防的卡萨布兰卡城！该城四周布有雷场和工事，海上英美海军声势逼人，皇家空军也从直布罗陀的基地出动了其全部兵力。我们信任您，相信您能在这场斗争中设法避开所有这些障碍，把盟军赶出非洲的这一地区。

src: This is the last strategic point controlled by the British on the African coast, once we will take it, the allies will be unable to counterattack because we will have in our hands all the important ports. The configuration of Mombasa City makes the assault very tough plus the presence of the Royal Navy will push your command to the extreme, but we trust you.
dst: 这是英国人在非洲海岸控制的最后一个战略要点，一旦我们拿下它，盟军将无法反攻，因为所有重要港口都将落入我们手中。蒙巴萨城的布局使这次突击极为艰巨，加之皇家海军的存在将把您的指挥逼到极限，但我们信任您。

src: This is the plan we suggest; in the past month the units under your direct management have been deployed on the coast of the Sea of China in preparation for the Coup.   We are ready to support you by sea.  The Chinese navy will remain loyal to Mao, but it is not powerful enough to deal with a minor Soviet submarine unit.  After we secure the entire coast by taking Tanggu, you must launch the counterattack against the government loyalist units which surely will be sent to defeat our plans.  Take the Tanggu airfield as soon as possible as this will allow us to send you reinforcements by air.  Our planes will be painted with the PRC symbols.  You must avoid the Americans as we don't need any problems with them now.  The incident should be only between Chinese forces.
dst: 这是我们建议的计划；过去一个月里，你直接管辖的部队已部署在中国海沿岸，为政变做准备。我们准备从海上支援你。中国海军将继续效忠毛，但它不足以对付一支小规模的苏联潜艇部队。在我们通过夺取塘沽控制整条海岸线之后，你必须对政府忠诚派部队发起反击，他们必定会被派来挫败我们的计划。尽快夺取塘沽机场，这将使我们能通过空运给你送来增援。我们的飞机会涂上中华人民共和国的标志。你必须避开美国人，因为我们现在不需要与他们发生任何麻烦。这次事件应仅限于中国部队之间。

src: This is the story about him, and about his men who served in Legiony Polskie - Polish Legions in the KuK Army. The deeds accomplished by Józef Pi³sudski and his men created independent Poland.
dst: 这是关于他，以及那些在奥匈帝国军队的波兰军团中服役的他的手下们的故事。约瑟夫·毕苏斯基及其手下所建立的功业造就了独立的波兰。

src: This is the toughest of the Panzer General 2 campaigns, and is intended  for the General who is willing to risk everything to win...
dst: 这是《Panzer General 2》中最艰难的战役，专为那些愿意为胜利冒一切风险的将军而设……

src: This is very, very sad. You were pipped at the post. Thanks to your failure, all German troops could escape in the west. Other generals have to complete what you have started.
dst: 这非常、非常令人遗憾。你在终点线前功亏一篑。由于你的失败，所有德军部队都得以向西逃脱。其他将军不得不去完成你开创的事业。

src: This is your duty commander; the 5th Japanese division is driving south towards the Pingxingguan Pass. You must block their path, and then, annihilate all the Japanese, using your famous guerrilla tactics.
dst: 这是你的职责，指挥官；日军第5师团正向南直扑平型关。你必须挡住他们的去路，然后用你著名的游击战术歼灭全部日军。

src: This just gets better and better.
This lose is not your fault. Our reconnaissance has dismally failed. Fortunally your troops could escape and prevent an encirclement. The germans have caputed Charkow again.
dst: 这次失利不是你的错。我们的侦察惨败。幸运的是你的部队得以脱身，避免了被包围。德军再次攻占了哈尔科夫。

src: This means that you must not lose both eastern VHs before AI's BV limit. Since your ninth turn the normal victory conditions apply for the enemy and Soviets must capture all the VHs to win.
dst: 这意味着，在 AI 达到辉煌胜利限制之前，你绝不能丢掉东面两个胜利格。从你的第九回合起，敌军适用正常胜利条件，苏军必须夺取所有胜利格才能获胜。

src: This might well be one of the decisive battles of the war... if we loose here the Hinterland is wide open for Lee... if we win, we will break the neck of general Lee´s army and do away with a permanent threat !
dst: 这很可能是这场战争的决定性战役之一……如果我们在这里失败，腹地就会向李洞开……如果我们获胜，就能打断李将军大军的脊梁，一举消除这个长期的威胁！

src: This mission seems to be insane!
dst: 这个任务看起来太疯狂了！

src: This month of June is being very good to us. East of your current positions the British forces are trapped in Thessaloniki. To the west, our reserves have expelled our enemies from the Albanian border and have reached the Adriatic Sea. In Italy our Alpenkorps is launching an attack against the Italian lines in Trient, in the hope of breaking that front just like we have done here, in the Balkans. The taking of Ahen will be the perfect ending for this outstanding series of victories.
dst: 这个六月对我们极为有利。在您当前阵地的东面，英军被困在塞萨洛尼基。西面，我们的预备队已把敌人从阿尔巴尼亚边境逐出，并抵达了亚得里亚海。在意大利，我们的阿尔卑斯军正对特伦托的意军防线发起进攻，希望能像我们在巴尔干这里所做的那样突破那条战线。夺取雅典将成为这一系列出色胜利的完美收官。

src: This morning however, the Belgian Army is exiting its positions and has launched a full scale attack in support of the operations at the Marne. Your 6.Reserve Division is called back and troops from 39. Division  - also on route to the Marne - will detrain close to Leuven to help push back the Belgian Army attack.
dst: 然而今天早上，比利时陆军离开阵地，为支援马恩河的行动发起了全面进攻。您的第6预备师被召回，同样在开赴马恩河途中的第39师部队将在鲁汶附近下车，协助击退比利时陆军的进攻。

src: This morning, German forces have moved through the Faid pass under cover of a sandstorm and have encircled Djebel Lessouda, defended by CCA. CCA is reinforced by two battalions of the 168th infantry regiment. You are allowed to use units of the divisional reserve to counterattack.
dst: 今晨，德军借沙尘暴掩护穿过法伊德山口，包围了由CCA防守的莱苏达山。CCA得到第168步兵团两个营的加强。你可以动用师预备队发起反击。

src: This morning, the Soviets launched an offensive against Stettin. Our defenses are crumbling and the city's fall is inevitable. The only option left is to try to create an escape corridor.
dst: 今晨，苏军对斯德丁发起攻势。我军防线正在瓦解，该城陷落已无可避免。剩下的唯一选择，是设法打开一条逃生走廊。

src: This mountain is essential to the defense of Estella, so it is imperative to reject the enemy attack. Gather your battalions and defend Montejurra at all costs.
dst: 这座山对埃斯特利亚的防御至关重要，因此击退敌军进攻势在必行。集结您的各营，不惜一切代价守住蒙特胡拉。

src: This mutiny has given us a welcome pretext to take over the British naval units in Le Havre into our Kriegsmarine. The damaged ships can obviously be repaired and after some time be ready for use again. Your troops are now transferred to Spain to carry out the planned operation against Gibraltar.
dst: 这次哗变给了我们一个受欢迎的借口，把勒阿弗尔的英国海军舰艇收编进我们的德国海军。受损的军舰显然可以修复，一段时间后就能重新投入使用。你的部队现在调往西班牙，执行进攻直布罗陀的计划。

src: This needs to stop. We must defeat Serbia once and for all, before they receive reinforcements from France and Britain. But we can't do it alone. The Germans are willing to help, but if we could convince Bulgaria to join our side, too, things would be much easier. Let's hope our diplomats succeed in their negotiations with Czar Ferdinand I and His government.
dst: 这种局面必须结束。我们必须在塞尔维亚从法国和英国获得援军之前，一劳永逸地击败他们。但我们单靠自己做不成。德国人愿意帮忙，可如果我们能说服保加利亚也加入我方，事情就会容易得多。希望我们的外交官与费迪南一世沙皇及其政府的谈判能够成功。

src: This new Russian offensive took us by surprise. In fact, these past months had been really good. After our breakthrough in Görlitz, we had liberated all the lands that we had lost in 1914. The Germans took Warschau, and the Russians were forced to defend themselves into their own empire. The front had been quiet lately. The lines seemed stabilized.
dst: 俄国的这次新攻势让我们措手不及。事实上，过去这几个月一直很顺利。在格尔利茨取得突破后，我们收复了1914年失去的所有土地。德国人夺取了华沙，俄国人被迫退入本国境内防守。战线近来一直平静，看似已趋稳定。

src: This new enemy offensive was too much for you. I'm afraid that so many years of battles have finally afected your spirit. You should resign and think about your retirement.
dst: 敌人这次新的攻势对您而言过于沉重。恐怕多年的征战最终磨蚀了您的斗志。您应当辞职，考虑退休了。

src: This new retreat was a serious blow on the morale of the Belgian soldiers, who couldn’t understand why they had to retreat and leave not only the fortified position of the "KW line" but also Antwerpen/Anvers and the capital Bruxelles/Brussel.
dst: 这次新的撤退对比利时士兵的士气是一次沉重打击，他们无法理解为何必须撤退，不仅要放弃“KW 防线”的筑垒阵地，还要放弃安特卫普和首都布鲁塞尔。

src: This operation did, however, achieve the effect the French had hoped for:  the German OHL did not divert a single division from the Eastern Front, making use of their last reserves in repulsing our attacks.  Even knowing what this pyrrhic victory achieved for our allies at Verdun will not lay the perished souls to rest in the snows of Narotch.
dst: 然而，这次作战确实达到了法国人所希望的效果：德国陆军最高指挥部没有从东线抽调哪怕一个师，而是动用了其最后的预备队击退我方进攻。即便知道这场惨胜为我们凡尔登的盟友赢得了什么，也无法让纳罗奇雪地中逝去的英魂安息。

src: This operation has effectively reduced our Northern and Western Fronts to a passive role for the remainer of 1916.
dst: 这次作战实际上已使我们的北方和西方两个方面军在1916年余下时间沦为被动角色。

src: This operation has proven to the world that Italia is NOT a bunch of Mussilinni drones, but a nation of men.
dst: 这次行动向世界证明了，意大利不是一群墨索里尼的应声虫，而是一个有骨气的民族。

src: This path contains several scenarios. You will first attack the Kuban-Bridgehead and push the Germans through Romania and Hungary to Prague, where this path will end.
dst: 这条路线包含多个场景。你将首先进攻库班桥头堡，把德军一路从罗马尼亚、匈牙利推向布拉格，这条路线将在那里结束。

src: This province is extremely important.  Intelligence shows that the French have been supplying weapons to the Republicans here.  We must close the border with France and stop any kind of aid to the People's Front in the North.  One more thing: be aware that we must not shoot over the French border.  We don't want to supply the French an excuse to give their full support to the Republicans.
dst: 这个省极其重要。情报显示，法国人一直在向此地的共和派提供武器。我们必须封锁与法国的边境，制止对北方人民阵线的一切援助。还有一件事：注意我们不得越界射击法国境内。我们不想给法国人借口，让他们全力支持共和派。

src: This rugged country held many challenges no?
dst: 这片崎岖之地挑战重重，不是吗？

src: This rugged country held many challenges no?  Alas, the Fuhrer will not accept this explanation.
dst: 这片崎岖之地挑战重重，不是吗？唉，元首不会接受这个解释。

src: This scenario as modified is in no way historical.  It is a standalone version of the scenario as it would likely be played in the context of the Blitzkrieg campaign.  The forces deployed represent the kinds of forces that would likely be available to a player at this stage in the Blitzkrieg campaign.  The forces have also been balanced as much as possible to make the scenario balanced and hopefully, fun to play.
dst: 本场景经修改后完全不是历史性的。它是该场景的一个独立版本，大致按其可能在“闪电战”战役背景下进行的方式游玩。所部署的兵力代表玩家在“闪电战”战役该阶段可能拥有的兵力类型。这些兵力也尽可能作了平衡，使场景更均衡，也希望更好玩。

src: This scenario is fiction. Churchill stopped O'Connor's offensive after the battle at Beda Fomm so that he could send all available forces to Greece. Only a skeleton force remained in Lybia. It would take more than 2 years before the Allies would get another shot at Tripoli.
dst: 本场景是虚构的。丘吉尔在贝达富姆之战后叫停了奥康纳的攻势，以便把所有可用兵力调往希腊。利比亚只留下了一点骨干部队。盟军要再过两年多才有机会再次进军黎波里。

src: This scenario is originally part of the "Meine Ehre heisst Treue" campaign by Technique and has been used with his kind permission.
dst: 本场景原属 Technique 制作的“我的荣誉即忠诚”战役，经其慷慨许可后使用。

src: This scenario was designed by Urica (for his Polish-Soviet campaign) and it was he who also inspired me to design this small campaign.
dst: 本场景由Urica设计（为他的波苏战役而作），也正是他启发了我来设计这个小战役。

src: This scenario was originally designed as a standalone scenario by Dimitris GR. Many Thanks!
dst: 本场景最初由 Dimitris GR 设计为独立场景。非常感谢！

src: This seems to be the place of the Varusbattle indeed.
dst: 这里看来确实就是瓦鲁斯会战发生之地。

src: This short campaign (10 scenarios) tells the tale of those brave men who fought for their country more than 100 years ago. Will you lead them, not to victory, but to eternity?
dst: 这场简短的战役（共10个场景）讲述了那些一百多年前为祖国而战的勇士们的故事。您将率领他们，不是为了胜利，而是为了永恒吗？

src: This still doesn't excuse your blunders.
dst: 这仍不能为你的过失开脱。

src: This strike could have been an important success for our newly formed heavy tanks battalion. You need to be much more decisive in the future.
dst: 这次突击本可成为我们新组建重型坦克营的重要胜利。今后你须果断得多。

src: This strike could have been an important success for your newly formed heavy tanks battalion. Now we won't receive any Tigers because the High Command will surely prefer the more sucessful units.
dst: 这次突击本可成为我们新组建重型坦克营的重要胜利。如今我们一辆虎式也收不到了，因为最高统帅部肯定更青睐那些更成功的部队。

src: This strike was an important success for your newly formed heavy tanks battalion, and it also confirmed our trust in the new mighty tank. Our unit will receive many new Tigers in the upcoming weeks.
dst: 这次突击对你新组建的重型坦克营是一次重要的胜利，也印证了我们对这款新式强大坦克的信任。未来数周，我部将接收许多新虎式。

src: This time I could not stop the Germans. Although I did my best, I could not prevent Arras and Amiens from falling. However, thanks to the arrival of American reinforcements, Germany's victory was short-lived, and they were forced to leave both towns one week later.
dst: 这一次，我没能阻止德军。尽管我尽了全力，仍未能阻止阿拉斯和亚眠陷落。然而，由于美军增援的到来，德国的胜利昙花一现，一周后他们被迫撤离了这两座城镇。

src: This time I was appointed to the Guards Brigade, which was part of Lord Methuen's 1st Infantry Division. Our orders were to relieve the town of Kimberley, that was being besieged by the Boer. On November 21st we started our advance from Orange River Bridge and the following day we found a very strong Boer position at the hills near Belmont railway station. Lord Methuen ordered our brigade to advance on Gun Hill during the night, thus outflanking the Boer lines. But due to our defective maps, at next day's dawn we found ourselves short of the enemy lines instead.
dst: 这一次，我被派到近卫旅，该旅隶属于梅休因勋爵的第1步兵师。我们的命令是解金伯利城之围，那里正被布尔人围困。11月21日，我们从奥兰治河桥开始推进，次日我们在贝尔蒙特火车站附近的山丘上发现了布尔人非常坚固的阵地。梅休因勋爵命令我们旅趁夜向炮台山推进，从而包抄布尔人的战线。但由于我们的地图有缺陷，次日拂晓，我们反而发现自己尚未到达敌军战线。

src: This time Kappel suggested to attack Saratov and join with Denikin once and for all. Kolchak considered it, before finally postponing that operation. Other generals convinced him that taking Vyatka was prioritary. During the summer the Siberian Army had assaulted the city three times, and the Bolsheviks had always rejected them. The liberation of Vyatka had thus become a matter of honour, and it was decided that it would be our next objective. Since the Siberians were exhausted after their failed offensives, Kolchak ordered us to launch the final attack.
dst: 这一次，卡佩尔建议进攻萨拉托夫，与邓尼金一劳永逸地会合。高尔察克考虑过，但最终推迟了这次行动。其他将领说服他，攻取维亚特卡才是当务之急。夏天里，西伯利亚集团军曾三次攻打该城，都被布尔什维克击退。解放维亚特卡因此成了一个事关荣誉的问题，遂被确定为我们的下一个目标。由于西伯利亚军在进攻受挫后已筋疲力尽，高尔察克命令我们发起最后一击。

src: This time our elite Mountain Mortar units are ready to fight under your command. Also a Torpedoboot will help you to clear the mines at the west coast.
dst: 这一次我们的精锐山地迫击炮部队已准备好归你指挥。还有一艘鱼雷艇将帮你清除西海岸的水雷。

src: This time we will arrive from Sea, they will not calculate with this Move....
dst: 这一次我们将从海上到达，他们算不到这一步棋……

src: This time you were not been able to resist the British assaults. The German army has been completely defeated and Von Lettow must surrender. Your campaign is over.
dst: 这一次，您未能顶住英军的猛攻。德军已被彻底击败，冯·莱托必须投降。您的战役结束了。

src: This time you won't be able to use paratroopers. Our airfields are too far away.
dst: 这一次你将无法使用伞兵。我们的机场太远了。

src: This time you'll attack the German flank at Aarschot and Leuven. You'll face the German Marine Division and some Landwehr troops. I'm sure that you know how to handle them.
dst: 这一次，您将进攻阿尔斯霍特和勒芬的德军侧翼。您将面对德国海军陆战师和一些国土防卫部队。我相信您知道该如何对付他们。

src: This time you'll follow a young Russian officer that joins the anti-Bolshevik army in the spring of 1918. Sometimes attacking, sometimes retreating, but always fighting, your actions will determine if the Whites have a chance to win the war...or if you must settle for saving your life and spend the rest of your days in exile.
dst: 这一次，您将跟随一名1918年春天加入反布尔什维克军队的年轻俄国军官。时而进攻，时而撤退，但始终在战斗，您的行动将决定白军是否有机会赢得战争……还是说，您只能满足于保住性命，在流亡中度过余生。

src: This time you'll try to storm the Russian positions at the Duklapass, on the Karpaten. From there, we could send our divisions to liberate Premissel. Besides, it's a strategic position that the Russians will use, sooner or later, to invade the Hungarian Plains. If we control the area, we could be confident that our enemies will never attack the heart of the Empire.
dst: 这一次，您将尝试强攻喀尔巴阡山上杜克拉山口附近的俄军阵地。从那里，我们可以派师去解救普热梅希尔。此外，这是一个战略要地，俄国人迟早会利用它入侵匈牙利平原。只要我们控制该地区，就可确信敌人永远无法进攻帝国的心脏。

src: This time your orders have proved ineffective. Fortunately our reserves have been able to take care of the situation. From now on you should be more careful and study the enemy better.
dst: 这一次，您的命令被证明毫无成效。所幸我们的预备队已能控制住局面。从现在起，您应当更加谨慎，更仔细地研究敌人。

src: This tiny war will be over soon, and I'll be back home before your bithday. I miss you,
dst: 这场小战争很快就会结束，我会在您生日前回家。我想您，

src: This town will be a good place for our families. Katya has decided that she'll travel here in January, so the family will be together again. Those are great news.
dst: 这座城镇将是我们家人的好居所。卡佳已决定1月动身来这里，这样一家人就能再次团聚。这真是个好消息。

src: This town will be a good place for our families. Katya has decided that she'll travel here in January, so the family will be together again. Those news are almost better than my victory over the Reds.
dst: 这座城镇将是我们家人的好居所。卡佳已决定1月动身来这里，这样一家人就能再次团聚。这消息几乎比我对红军的胜利更让我高兴。

src: This victory has called the attention of the OHL, and it's been decided that you and your men will be transferred to the Belgian border, where your skills are badly needed. Good luck, General, you'll need it on your new destination.
dst: 这场胜利引起了最高陆军指挥部的注意，他们已决定把您和您的部下调往比利时边境，那里亟需您的才能。祝您好运，将军，您在新驻地会需要运气的。

src: This victory has given Italy its much deserved credibility and Germany overshadows us much less now.
dst: 这场胜利为意大利赢得了应得的信誉，德国如今也不再那么压我们一头了。

src: This victory will allow us to take a breath, but I must warn you that many army officers have joined the enemy! Others have abandoned the fight and crossed the Spanish - French border to escape.  Personally, I advise you to cross the border, too, and save yourself.   I think the rebel offensive is unbeatable now.
dst: 这场胜利能让我们喘口气，但我必须提醒您，许多军官已经投奔了敌人！另一些人则放弃了战斗，越过西班牙—法国边境逃走。我个人建议您也越过边境，保全自己。我认为叛军的攻势如今已不可阻挡。

src: This victory will be remembered forever among our followers. The republican forces launched their best troops against us, and yet they had to withdraw with heavy losses.
dst: 这场胜利将永远被我们的追随者铭记。共和军派出他们最精锐的部队来对付我们，却仍不得不带着惨重损失撤退。

src: This victory will not be forgotten in a thousand years!
dst: 这场胜利千年之后也不会被遗忘！

src: This victory will stop the British for a while. Congratulations!
dst: 这场胜利将使英军停顿一段时间。恭喜您！

src: This war may yet see an end in the West, but it has brewed a new war in the East.  May God be with you, Gospodin General.
dst: 这场战争或许将在西方看到结局，但它已在东方酿成一场新的战争。愿上帝与您同在，将军阁下。

src: This was a bumbling performance. We had good chances to stop the Germans some miles before Woronesch but you have not used them.
dst: 这次表现笨拙。我们本有很好的机会在沃罗涅日前数英里处阻止德军，但您没有利用这些机会。

src: This was a desaster. Leningrad is still in German hands. Dismiss!
dst: 这是一场惨败。列宁格勒仍在德军手中。撤职！

src: This was a disaster!  The arguments formerly proposed by General McArthur have finally been accepted by Washington.  A nuclear attack was carried out over the city of Nanjing, killing millions of Chinese people.  The soviets have declined to give us any nuclear help and now we must accept the peace imposed by the West.
dst: 这是一场灾难！麦克阿瑟将军先前提出的主张终于被华盛顿接受了。一次核打击落在南京城上空，杀死了数百万中国人民。苏联人拒绝给我们任何核援助，现在我们只能接受西方强加的和平。

src: This was a disaster... the arguments formerly proposed by General McArthur have finally been accepted by Washington.  A nuclear attack has been carried out over the city of Nanjing, killing millions of Chinese people... The soviets have declined to give us any nuclear help and now we must accept the imposed Western peace.
dst: 这是一场灾难...麦克阿瑟将军先前提出的主张终于被华盛顿接受了。一次核打击落在南京城上空，杀死了数百万中国人民...苏联人拒绝给我们任何核援助，现在我们只能接受西方强加的和平。

src: This was a great defensive victory. However, we won't win this war just defending ourselves. Sooner or later the enemy will find a breach in our lines, and we'll be in serious trouble. Should a chance for taking the initiative present itself, we'll have to make the best of it. It could be the last one.
dst: 这是一次伟大的防御性胜利。然而，光靠防守我们是赢不了这场战争的。敌人迟早会在我们的战线上找到缺口，那时我们就会陷入严重困境。一旦出现夺取主动权的机会，我们就必须充分利用。这可能是最后的机会了。

src: This was a great victory, mon Général! The enemy didn't expect our counter-attack and was demoralized by our overwhelming numbers of tanks. Their own A7V were too few and too cumbersome to make any significant impact on the battlefield. I wonder what a German army could do with a proper tank force. We hopefully will never find out...
dst: 这是一场伟大的胜利，我的将军！敌人没有料到我们的反攻，被我军数量占压倒优势的坦克打得士气低落。他们自己的A7V坦克数量太少又过于笨重，未能在战场上产生任何重大影响。我很好奇，一支拥有合适坦克部队的德军能做些什么。希望我们永远不必知道……

src: This was a narrow victory Herr General. While your success has opened the path into Russia, it was not what we had expected. This could be tougher then we planned!
dst: 这是一场险胜，将军阁下。虽然你的成功已打开通往俄国之路，却未达我们所期。这可能比我们计划的更艰难！

src: This was a nefirious performance. Your punishment will be no reinforcemnts in the near future.
dst: 这是一次糟糕透顶的表现。对你的惩罚将是：在近期得不到任何增援。

src: This was a poor performance. Dismiss!
This was a poor performance. There is no chance to get something out of your attack. However, it could be a good paragon, how a general not sould lead an attack.
dst: 这次表现很差。你的进攻不可能取得任何成果。不过，它可以作为一个很好的反面教材，说明一位将军不该怎样指挥进攻。

src: This was a premium performance. The advance of the German troops is stopped.
dst: 这是一场极为出色的表现。德军的推进被阻止了。

src: This was a semi-historic scenario which covered the allied advance, the german retreat across the Messina Strait as well as Operation Scylla, the breakthrough of Italian cruiser Scipione Africano and its fight with British MTBs of the 10th MTB flotilla. Scipione Africano's journey from its Base La Spezia in the Tyrrhenian Sea to Taranto, in the Ionian Sea, took place from 15th to 17th July. The naval engagement between the cruiser and the four MTBs took place in the eraly hours of 17th July.
dst: 这是一个半历史场景，涵盖了盟军推进、德军横渡墨西拿海峡撤退，以及"锡拉行动"——意大利巡洋舰 Scipione Africano 的突围及其与英国第10鱼雷艇支队交战的经过。Scipione Africano 从位于第勒尼安海的基地拉斯佩齐亚驶往爱奥尼亚海的塔兰托，航程自7月15日持续至17日。该巡洋舰与四艘鱼雷艇之间的海战发生于7月17日凌晨。

src: This was awful. We have decided that you will get no reinforcements for the moment.
dst: 这太糟糕了。我们已决定，眼下不会给您任何增援。

src: This was crucial to the battle.
dst: 这一点成了此战的胜负关键。

src: This was going to change the first of September, when our 1st Cavalry Brigade had to fight at Néry against a German division. That delayed the march of all the British forces, so the German III Corps had an opportunity to get close to our I Corps. For that reason I was ordered to take positions at the Retz Forest and cover the retreat of the other units
dst: 这种情况在9月1日将要改变，那一天我们的第1骑兵旅不得不在内里与一个德国师交战。这延误了所有英军的行军，使德国第三军有机会逼近我们的第一军。因此，我奉命在雷茨森林占据阵地，掩护其他部队撤退。

src: This was not a good performance. Too many German and Hungarian soldiers could flee because you failed in destroying enough axis divisions.
dst: 这次表现不佳。太多德国和匈牙利士兵得以逃脱，因为您未能歼灭足够多的轴心国师。

src: This was not good. You could only hold one target. Next time you should deal your job better.
dst: 这可不妙。你只守住了一个目标。下次你应该把活干得更好些。

src: This was one of the bloodiest battles I have ever seen... however the victory is ours, and the Americans have accepted our peace treaty, our ''Treaty of San Francisco''.  Now, the war in the Pacific has ended.  This is our V-Day in the Pacific!  Hahaha!  The Pacific is in our hands and your name will join our other heroes to become part of Imperial Japanese history!
dst: 这是我见过的最血腥的战役之一……然而胜利属于我们，美国人已经接受了我们的和平条约，也就是我们的《旧金山条约》。如今，太平洋战争已经结束。这是我们在太平洋的胜利日！哈哈哈！太平洋已落入我们手中，您的名字将与其他英雄一道载入大日本帝国的历史！

src: This was the only major Ottoman victory of the First Balkan War. Concentrating their artillery fire, the Turks could easily repel the Bulgarian frontal attacks, and they finally had to give up their offensive. Peace negotiations started soon and, although in March 1913 the war resumed for a few weeks, there were only small military actions until the Treaty of London ended the war on 30th May 1913.
dst: 这是第一次巴尔干战争中奥斯曼唯一的一次重大胜利。土军集中炮火，轻易击退了保加利亚人的正面进攻，保加利亚人最终不得不放弃攻势。和平谈判很快开始，尽管1913年3月战争又恢复了几个星期，但直到《伦敦条约》于1913年5月30日结束战争之前，只有一些小的军事行动。

src: This was tougher then expected. We hope you destroyed all the Russian supplies and reinforcements?
dst: 这比预想的更艰难。希望你已摧毁所有俄国补给和援军？

src: This was very different than in countries around Poland.
dst: 这与波兰周边国家的情况大不相同。

src: This will be a most grueling war like the last, God help us.
dst: 这将是一场像上次一样最惨烈的战争，愿上帝帮助我们。

src: This will be remembered as one of the largest cavalry battles in modern history and it has been a great victory for Poland! Although Budionny and part of his army were finally able to breakthrough our lines and retreat to the east, their losses were very high and I don't think they'll be a threat to us anymore.
dst: 这将被铭记为现代史上规模最大的骑兵会战之一，对波兰而言是一次伟大的胜利！尽管布琼尼和他的一部分部队最终突破了我军防线并撤往东面，但他们的损失非常惨重，我认为他们再也无法对我们构成威胁了。

src: This will be the final blow to the enemy and after this battle is over, we'll have won the war and the fight is over.
dst: 这将是给敌人的最后一击，此战结束后，我们就赢得了战争，战斗就此终结。
