src: This will be the hardest struggle we have ever had to make .... if we win here and destroy a large part of the Roman troops, we will win back all Gaul in one move!
dst: 这将是我们打过的最艰苦的一仗 .... 如果我们在此获胜、歼灭罗马部队的大部分，我们就能一举夺回整个高卢！

src: This year is not being a good one for us. In January, General Pavia dissolved the Parliament in Madrid, and the new provisional republican government has put the chaos within part of the liberal army to an end. We began the siege of Bilbao in February, and after more than two months we have not achieved any of our goals. The city still resists, our generals Rada and Ollo have died, and we have barely rejected the liberal attempts to lift the siege in the Somorrostro area.
dst: 这一年对我们来说并不顺遂。1月，帕维亚将军在马德里解散了议会，新的共和临时政府结束了自由派军队内部的部分混乱。我们于2月开始围攻毕尔巴鄂，两个多月过去却一无所获。该城仍在抵抗，我们的将领拉达和奥略先后阵亡，而我们勉强击退了自由派在索莫罗斯特罗一带解围的企图。

src: This year the manoeuvres of the Belgian army aim to prove that the motorisation of the "Corps de Cavalerie" is value for money. As Commander of the Regiment "2e Lanciers" of the 1st Cavalry Division ("1ère Division de Cavalerie") you must contribute to demonstrate its high mobility by making a spectacular move and quickly take the VH.
dst: 今年比利时军队的演习旨在证明“Corps de Cavalerie”的摩托化是物有所值的。作为第1骑兵师（“1ère Division de Cavalerie”）第2枪骑兵团（“2e Lanciers”）的指挥官，你必须通过一次引人注目的机动来展示其高度机动性，并迅速夺取胜利格。

src: This zone of Algiers is secure, Italian detachments will stay behind and we will continue our unstoppable advance
dst: 阿尔及尔地区已安全，意大利分遣队将留守，我们要继续势不可挡的推进

src: Those British have defended themselves with great courage. We have no other option but to retire.
dst: 那些英国人极其勇敢地进行了防御。我们别无选择，只能撤退。

src: Those days were very dangerous for the future of the Empire but, thank God, we reacted quickly. We liberated Transsilvanien with an army of imperial and German divisions, forcing the Romanians to retreat to the mountain passes.
dst: 那段日子对帝国的前途十分危险，但谢天谢地，我们迅速做出了反应。我们以一支由帝国与德国师组成的军队解放了特兰西瓦尼亚，迫使罗马尼亚人退往山口。

src: Those losses were a terrible blow for the Italians who, under British pressure, finally offered us a ceasefire, and the start of peace negotiations. We didn't trust Italy's intentions, but if we didn't accept, Britain would attack us, so we had to comply with their request. Peace negotiations started in Kasala on April 21.
dst: 这些损失对意大利人来说是沉重的一击，在英国的压力下，他们终于提出停火并开启和平谈判。我们并不信任意大利的意图，但若不接受，英国就会进攻我们，所以我们不得不照办。和平谈判于4月21日在卡萨拉开始。

src: Those were quite some days, comrade. Krasnodar and Novorossiysk have been liberated and the fascists cowards are fleeing towards the Taman peninsula where they should be evacuated to the Crimea. Our troops are close to exhausted but so is the enemy, and at least we are winning. The enemy will resist feriously but you should drive all the way west, until you have liberated the Kuban steppes totally!
dst: 这些天真是不同凡响，同志。克拉斯诺达尔和新罗西斯克已经解放，法西斯懦夫们正逃向塔曼半岛，准备从那里撤往克里米亚。我们的部队已近精疲力竭，但敌人也一样，而且至少我们在取胜。敌人会拼死抵抗，但你应该一路向西推进，直到彻底解放库班草原！

src: Those were terrible days, certainly among the worst that I lived, and in the end we were forced to retreat when the Germans nearly encircled our troops. We could not afford that risk, and on December 3rd Haig ordered a retirement from the Bourlon Hill-Marcoing salient.
dst: 那些是可怕的日子，无疑是我所经历过的最糟糕的日子之一，最终，当德军几乎包围我军时，我们被迫撤退。我们冒不起那个风险，12月3日，黑格下令从布尔隆山-马尔宽突出部撤退。

src: Those were terrible days, certainly among the worst that I lived, but in the end we were victorious, and our flank held on. Unfortunately news were not that good at Bourlon and Fontaine, where the Germans nearly encircled our troops. We could not afford that risk, and on December 3rd Haig ordered a retirement from the Bourlon Hill-Marcoing salient.
dst: 那些是可怕的日子，无疑是我所经历过的最糟糕的日子之一，但最终我们取得了胜利，我们的侧翼守住了。不幸的是，布尔隆和方丹的消息就不那么好了，德军几乎包围了那里的我军部队。我们冒不起那个风险，12月3日，黑格下令从布尔隆山-马尔宽突出部撤退。

src: Those were the last lines that my beloved uncle wrote before engaging in battle, one last time, with the Red Army. As you already know, he was killed in that action, so he didn't live to see the Bolshevik Revolution defeated and Russia freed.
dst: 那是我敬爱的叔父在与红军作最后一战之前写下的最后几行字。您已知道，他在那次行动中阵亡，因此没能活着看到布尔什维克革命被击败、俄国获得自由。

src: Though it cost us some of our last reserves, we have inflicted two considerable defeats on the Americans. Now political opponents of Rooseveld, sustained by the anti-communist movement, have forced the American government to receive our envoy!
dst: 尽管这消耗了我们最后一部分预备队，我们已让美国人遭受了两次相当重大的失败。如今罗斯福的政治对手在反共运动的支持下，已迫使美国政府接见我方的使者！

src: Though our attack was well timed and resulted in complete surprise of the enemy, your performance was not of the highest caliber, Herr General.  Although you were successful, we expected more from you.
dst: 尽管我们的进攻时机得当、达成了对敌的完全突然性，但你的表现并非上乘，将军阁下。你虽然成功了，我们对你的期望却更高。

src: Though, it is ironic Herr General, that you destroyed more factories then the British did!
dst: 不过说来讽刺，将军阁下，你摧毁的工厂竟比英国人还多！
三个「科洛诺」（西班牙平民）单位必须存活下来。

src: Three Air Transports are available in this scenario.
dst: 本场景中有 3 架空中运输机可用。

src: Three Air and four Naval Transports are available in this scenario.
dst: 本场景中可动用三艘空中运输船与四艘海上运输船。

src: Three Air and three Naval Transports are available in this scenario.
dst: 本场景中有三支空中运输队和三支海上运输队可供使用。

src: Three Red Armies were participating in the offensive. The Fifth Army, commanded by the Latvian Slavens, which had followed us from Kazan, was in the north, ready to cut the railroad at Melekess and encircle us. Tukhachevsky's First Army was in the west, controlled Simbirsk, and was going to attack Syzran and Samara from the north. Finally, Chwiesin's Fourth army was in the south, on both shores of the Volga, and would attack Syzran and Samara coordinated with the First Army.
dst: 参加这次攻势的有三支红军。第五集团军由拉脱维亚人斯拉文斯指挥，它从喀山一路尾随我们，位于北方，准备在梅列克斯切断铁路并包围我们。图哈切夫斯基的第一集团军位于西方，控制着辛比尔斯克，将从北面进攻塞兹兰和萨马拉。最后，赫维辛的第四集团军位于南方，在伏尔加河两岸，将与第一集团军协同进攻塞兹兰和萨马拉。

src: Three armies are converging on Przemysl:  the 5th from the north, the 3rd from the east, and the 8th from the south.  Our troops have exhausted themselves, and the supply lines have grown thin.  Our objectives are to first place a cavalry screen around the city and then to completely encircle the fortress, preparing it for a prolonged siege.
dst: 三个集团军正向普热梅希尔合围：第5集团军从北面，第3集团军从东面，第8集团军从南面。我军已疲惫不堪，补给线也日益薄弱。我们的目标首先是围绕该城建立一道骑兵警戒线，然后彻底合围要塞，为其做好长期围困的准备。

src: Three days ago, the Bolsheviks and the Germans signed the Brest-Litovsk Treaty. This frees up a lot of German troops that will undoubtably be used for a big offensive on the Western front. Even though the US joined the war 11 months ago, they don't heave many combat-ready divisions yet.
dst: 三天前，布尔什维克与德国人签订了《布列斯特-立托夫斯克条约》。这解放了大量德军部队，它们无疑将被用于西线的大规模攻势。尽管美国在11个月前已经参战，但他们还没有多少做好战斗准备的师。

src: Three months after the attack on Fort Sumter, the Union scouts discovered an important concentration of Confederated troops just 40 Km. to Washington. Scaried about the real danger, president Licoln sent a quickly created force under the general McDowell. Well informed by the infiltrated spies in Washington, the Confederacy could sent 10,000 troops under the general J.E. Johnston as reinforcements for the James Longstreet's men near the Manasas Junction. The first battle of the war was underway.
dst: 萨姆特堡遇袭三个月后，联邦侦察兵在距华盛顿仅40公里处发现了一支重要的邦联部队集结。林肯总统对真实危险深感惊恐，遂派出一支匆匆组建的部队，由麦克道尔将军指挥。由于潜伏在华盛顿的间谍提供了充分情报，邦联得以派出J·E·约翰斯顿将军麾下的10000名士兵，作为马纳萨斯交汇处附近詹姆斯·朗斯特里特部队的援军。战争的第一场战役就此展开。

src: Three of your battalions are holding a 2km front at Neuve Chapelle - 35km South of Ypres. In front of them are British forces of Sir Douglas Haigh's First British Army. Contrary to the French that keep on attacking in the Champagne area, the Brits have showed rather passive the last few months. They do not seem to share the French idea that the war can be won with 'grignotage and percee' - knibling at the front lines and breaking through.
dst: 您的三个营在新沙佩勒——伊普尔以南35公里处——据守一段两公里长的战线。他们对面是道格拉斯·黑格爵士第1英国集团军的英军部队。与不断在香槟地区发起进攻的法军不同，英国人过去几个月显得相当被动。他们似乎并不认同法国人「蚕食与突破」——即一点点啃食前线并实现突破——即可赢得战争的想法。

src: Three soviet armys attack on Dubno and Lutsk city and our fotces must bring to a stop all these soviet units.
dst: 三个苏军集团军进攻杜布诺与卢茨克城，我部必须遏止所有这些苏军部队。

src: Through an orderly retreat, you reached British forces and, undefeated, surrendered to captivity.
dst: 通过有序撤退，你抵达英军处，虽未战败，却投降当了俘虏。

src: Through our victory in Palestine, we are now able to support the pro-German nationalists in Iraq effectively. Despite our support in late May, the Commonwealth troops managed to defeat the Iraqi army and the government was forced to flee to Syria. The General Staff knows that the continuous struggle in the last months has led to tiredness of the troops and the equipment. However, it would be inexcusable not to take advantage of that prevailing chaos in Iraq and to wait until the Commonwealth's have established again. We could force Abdallah ibn al-Hussain, the Emir of Transjordan to agreed to a transit of our troops through its territory into Iraq. You have order to traverse the Nefud desert and attack the RAF base in Habbanyah east of Ramadi!
dst: 通过我们在巴勒斯坦的胜利，我们如今能够有效地支援伊拉克的亲德民族主义者。尽管我们5月底提供了支援，英联邦部队还是击败了伊拉克军队，伊拉克政府被迫逃往叙利亚。总参谋部知道，连续几个月的战斗已让部队疲惫不堪、装备损耗。然而，不利用伊拉克当前的混乱、坐等英联邦重新站稳脚跟，将是不可原谅的。我们已迫使外约旦埃米尔阿卜杜拉·伊本·侯赛因同意我军过境进入伊拉克。你奉命穿越内夫得沙漠，进攻拉马迪以东哈巴尼亚的皇家空军基地！

src: Through the course of the war in the first two years once at Verdun stationed french troops and a large number of heavy artillery have been removed and relocated to other sectors of the front. However by enlightenment and trenchcoats the attention of the french high army command was drawn on strong concentrations of troops near Verdun and the french high command began to bring back the removed troops and heavy guns to Verdun.
dst: 战争头两年的进程中，一度驻守凡尔登的法军部队和大量重炮曾被调走、部署到其他战线地段。然而，通过情报与间谍活动，法军最高统帅部注意到凡尔登附近有大量部队集结，于是开始将撤走的部队和重炮调回凡尔登。

src: Throughout June, there were continuing reports of Soviet and Mongolian activity on both sides of the river near Nomonhan, and small-scale attacks on isolated Manchukoan units. At the end of the month, the commander of the Japanese 23rd Infantry Division, Lt. Gen. Michitaro Komatsubara, was given permission to "expel the invaders". The Japanese plan was for a two-pronged assault. Three regiments plus part of a fourth, including three from the 23rd Division (the 71st and the 72nd Infantry Regiments, plus a battalion of the 64th Infantry Regiment) and the 26th Infantry Regiment under Colonel Shinichiro Sumi, borrowed from the 7th Infantry Division, would advance across the Khalkin Gol, destroy Soviet forces on Baintsagan Hill on the west bank, then make a left turn and advance south to the Kawatama Bridge. The second prong of the attack would be the task of the IJA 1st Tank Corps (1st TC) (Yasuoka Detachment), consisting of the 3rd and 4th Tank Regiments, plus a part of the 64th Infantry Regiment, a battalion from the 28th Infantry Regiment, detached from the 7th Infantry, 24th Engineer Regiment, and a battalion from the 13th Field Artillery Regiment, all under the overall command of Lieutenant General Yasuoka Masaomi. This force would attack Soviet troops on the east bank of the Khalkhyn Gol and north of the Holsten River. The two Japanese thrusts were intending to join together on the wings.
dst: 整个6月，不断有报告称苏蒙军队在诺门罕附近河流两岸活动，并对孤立的满洲国部队发动了小规模袭击。月底，日军第23步兵师团长小松原道太郎中将获准「驱逐入侵者」。日军的计划是两路夹击。三个联队外加第四个联队的一部——其中包括第23师团的两个联队（第71、第72步兵联队，以及第64步兵联队的一个大队）——以及从第7步兵师团借调、由角田新一郎大佐指挥的第26步兵联队，将越过哈拉哈河，消灭西岸拜恩查干山上的苏军，然后左转向南推进至川渡桥。第二路攻击由日本帝国陆军第1战车团（第1战车团，即安冈支队）承担，下辖第3、第4战车联队，第64步兵联队一部，从第7步兵师团抽调的第28步兵联队一个大队，第24工兵联队，以及第13野战炮兵联队一个大队，全部由安冈正臣中将统一指挥。这支部队将攻击哈拉哈河东岸、霍尔斯坦河以北的苏军。日军的两路攻势打算在两翼会合。

src: Throughout the whole campaign you can buy/upgrade to talian units only.
dst: 在整个战役中，您只能购买/升级为意大利单位。

src: Thus a pocket could soon be formed around your troops. You are to take your corps, brake out of Lodz and stop the Russians at the Warta river, which will be or next temporary line of defense before the Posen line. By the way: It would be wise to move along the railroad to Sieradz because the Russians from the northern pincer may soon swing around Lodz.
dst: 这样，一个包围圈很快就会在您部队周围形成。您须率您的军从罗兹突围，并在瓦尔塔河阻止俄军，那将是我们继波兹南防线之前的下一道临时防线。顺便说一句：沿着铁路向谢拉兹移动是明智之举，因为北面那支俄军钳形部队可能很快就会绕过罗兹。

src: Thus, in 1924 Primo de Rivera decided to retreat all of the Spanish garrisons on the western zone to strong defensive lines near the main towns: Ceuta, Larache and Tetuán. The last step of the operation, and the most dangerous one, would be  the retreat from Xauen to Tetuán.
dst: 于是，1924年，普里莫·德里维拉决定将西区的所有西班牙守备部队撤至主要城镇——休达、拉腊什和得土安——附近的坚固防线。这次行动的最后一步，也是最危险的一步，将是从舍夫沙万撤往得土安。

src: Thus, in april 1925, Abd el-Krim´s army invaded the Ouergha Valley, in the French protectorate.
dst: 于是，1925年4月，阿卜杜·克里姆的军队入侵了法属保护地内的瓦尔加河谷。

src: Thus, while the French attacked from the south, the Spanish army would disembark at the Alhucemas Bay, the very heart of the Berber lands. For the first time in History such an action would be taken with the combination of land troops and heavy air and naval support.
dst: 于是，在法军从南面进攻的同时，西班牙军队将在柏柏尔人腹地阿尔胡塞马斯湾登陆。历史上这还是第一次将地面部队与强大的空中及海上支援相结合来实施此类行动。
提比略·巴西尔·奥诺马古洛斯
提比略·克劳狄乌斯·马克西穆斯

src: Tiene usted 1000 puntos de prestigio para construir su columna.
dst: 您有 1000 点威望可以用来组建您的纵队。

src: Time for a live ammo landing exercise in preparation for the landing in England. The Italians have sent their 15th Army Corps over to the Amiens area to act as a training opponent. They will be supported by their symbolic Battle of Britain air force and the 1st squadron of their 1st fleet. Land your division, secure a beachhead so that the 2nd Pz division can be brought ashore and push inland to Amiens.
dst: 是时候为登陆英格兰做一次实弹登陆演习了。意大利人已把他们的第15军调到亚眠地区充当演习对手。他们将得到其象征性的“不列颠之战”空军和第1舰队第1中队的支援。让你的师登陆，建立滩头阵地，好让第2装甲师上岸，然后向内陆推进到亚眠。
时间跨度：1943年春季——1945年春季

src: Time to come home.  We need to track what those damn Reds have been doing in your absence.  The lunar corps can take care of covering up the battle and securing the site.
dst: 该回家了。我们需要追查那些该死的红军在你缺席期间干了些什么。月球军团可以负责掩盖战斗痕迹并控制现场。
Timocka 师/ 塞尔维亚第2集团军

dst: Timocki 炮兵团/ I Timocka 师/ 塞尔维亚第2集团军

dst: Timoshki 骑兵团/ I Moravska 师/ 第2集团军

src: Tip: Be really careful of the enemy planes!
dst: 提示：务必当心敌军飞机！

src: Tip: Deplete the enemy of ammunition and limit their supply routes.
dst: 提示：耗尽敌军弹药，并切断其补给线。

src: Tip: Infantry is best suited for street-to-street fights... and the local men know their streets.
dst: 提示：步兵最擅长街巷战斗……而本地守军熟悉这里的每一条街道。

src: Tip: On turn 5 you will receive reinforcements from the SW.
dst: 提示：第5回合，您将从西南方向得到援军。

src: Tip: The Norwegian defense is the strongest on the main west-east road and in the cities.
dst: 提示：挪威军的防御在主干的东西向公路与城市最为坚固。

src: Tip: Ther are enough planes already grounded, don't waste the air support needlessly.
dst: 提示：已经有不少飞机停飞了，别白白浪费空中支援。

src: Tip: There are several types of famous 88mm artillery available, each one being an amazing dual purpose gun.
dst: 提示：有多种著名的 88 毫米火炮可供选用，每一种都是出色的多用途火炮。

src: Tip: This is your only chance for a real prototype, don't miss it!
dst: 提示：这是你拿到真正原型机的唯一机会，千万别错过！

src: Tip: Upgrade your core tank into a faster and heavier model.
dst: 提示：将你的核心坦克升级为更快、更重型的型号。

src: Tip: Use as many 88mm artillery as possible; the longer the range, the better.
dst: 提示：尽可能多地使用 88 毫米火炮；射程越远越好。

src: Tip: blow the bridges before the Germans capture them.
dst: 提示：在德军夺取桥梁之前将其炸毁。

src: Tip: if you have been patient enough to keep or even smart enough to upgrade your core vessel this is the right moment to deploy it.
dst: 提示：如果您足够耐心地保留、甚至足够聪明地升级了您的核心舰船，那么现在正是部署它的好时机。

dst: 散兵 Sénégalais/ 第17步兵师/ 第5军/ 第3集团军

dst: 散兵 tonkinois/ 军远征 du Tonkin

src: To Chairman of the Council was appointed Bernhard Kuhnt. The "21er" Council
dst: 伯恩哈德·孔特被任命为委员会主席。「二十一人」委员会

src: To H. Craig Miller, Dennis Felling, Jorge Gabitto, Guille and Traveler who have all contributed with their scenario ideas to this campaign. Credits also to the playtesters 1T, Daerandir and Gixian. Thanks guys!
dst: 谨以此致H. Craig Miller、Dennis Felling、Jorge Gabitto、Guille和Traveler，他们都将自己的剧本创意贡献给了本战役。同样感谢测试人员1T、Daerandir和Gixian。谢谢各位！

src: To Hoza who corrected all my spelling mistakes in the intro's
dst: 感谢 Hoza，他纠正了我在简介中的所有拼写错误。

src: To anticipate the USPD, Ebert forced Chancellor Max von Baden to announce the abdication of Wilhelm II.
dst: 为抢在独立社会民主党之前，艾伯特迫使首相马克斯·冯·巴登宣布威廉二世退位。

src: To begin the conquest of the Dutch East Indies, your first mission is to seize the island of Tarakan and its supply of rich oil fields.  Do it quickly, we will soon need your services to clear other sectors.
dst: 作为征服荷属东印度的第一步，您的首要任务是夺取打拉根岛及其丰富的油田。要快，我们很快还需要您去肃清其他地区。

src: To continue onto the "Blitzkrieg" path, immediately occupy the city of Jamuga. To continue on with the "Defending the Reich" path, take the city of Woronino...
dst: 若要继续走“闪电战”路线，请立即占领亚穆加城。若要继续走“保卫帝国”路线，请夺取沃罗尼诺城……

src: To continue our assault on the Dutch positions, you should strike a decisive blow to the ''KNIL'', the Dutch colonial forces.  The main ports and air bases are in the Balikpapan sector, what we need is to capture that sector.  This will allow us to complete this campaign.  Select carefully where you are going to disembark.  The area has plenty of sea mines and some coastal defenses.  Use your navy and air units to eliminate this threat.
dst: 为继续对荷军阵地发起攻势，您应当对「荷印陆军」——荷兰殖民军——施以致命一击。主要港口与空军基地都在巴厘巴板地区，我们需要的就是夺取该地区。这将使我们得以完成本次战役。请谨慎选择登陆地点。该海域布有大量水雷，并有一些海岸防御工事。动用您的海军与航空部队消除这一威胁。

src: To finish the war, we must clear Morocco. The high command has designed a plan, disembarking our troops in the Ceuta area and establishing two beach heads to cut the communications between Ceuta and Tetuan.
dst: 为结束战争，我们必须肃清摩洛哥。最高指挥部制定了一项计划，在休达地区登陆我军，并建立两个滩头阵地以切断休达与得土安之间的交通。

src: To give no reason for diplomatic complications we have to leave the first step to the Americans. But once the enemy attack Martinique, you will react and occupy the three islands of Martinique, St. Lucia and St. Vincent and guard them from the grasp of the enemy!
dst: 为了不给外交纠纷留下口实，我们必须把第一步让给美国人。但一旦敌人进攻马提尼克，你就要果断出手，占领马提尼克、圣卢西亚和圣文森特这三座岛屿，并把它们守护得不让敌人染指！

src: To heal an damaged unit, place it in a adjacent hex to the mobile hospital. Then both units must stand still a turn (or longer) to repair the damaged unit.
dst: 要治疗受损单位，把它放在与流动医院相邻的六角格中。然后两个单位都必须静止一回合（或更久）以修复受损单位。
让所有普鲁士人都见鬼去吧！

src: To hell with all those Dukes and Earls !
dst: 让那些公爵和伯爵都见鬼去吧！

src: To live and to die is the way of the world. Things are now to be seen historical. You have written history...
dst: 生与死本是世间常道。如今事态已可作史观看待。你已写下了历史...

src: To make things even worse, our spies warned us of an imminent landing of the Japanese Second Army at Pitsewo, in Manchuria, inside the Empire and behind our own lines. So we had to go on forced marches towards the Chinese port of Liushun before the Japanese could take it. If our enemies succeeded, they could even threaten Peking.
dst: 更糟的是，我们的间谍警告说，日军第2军团即将在满洲的貔子窝登陆，那里位于帝国内部，而且在我们自己战线的后方。因此，我们不得不强行军赶往中国港口旅顺，赶在日军占领它之前到达。倘若敌人得逞，他们甚至可能威胁北京。

src: To make this day better, Katya has told me that Anatoly and Olga are expecting their first baby. Our first grandchild will be born in a free Russia.
dst: 让这一天更加美好的是，卡佳告诉我，阿纳托利和奥尔加正期待着他们的第一个孩子。我们的第一个孙辈将诞生在一个自由的俄国。

src: To make this day even better, Katya has told me that Anatoly and Olga are expecting their first baby. Our first grandchild will be born in a free Russia.
dst: 让这一天更加美好的是，卡佳告诉我，阿纳托利和奥尔加正期待着他们的第一个孩子。我们的第一个孙辈将诞生在一个自由的俄国。

src: To meet the threat to the canal and Egypt, we must prepare to halt the rolling Turkish juggernaut.  At the moment some Australian Light Horse regiments have occupied a position about seven miles west of Katia, and about eighteen miles east of Port Said. From the coast our entrenchments curve towards the oasis of Romani, and the new desert railway station near by. You and your men are ordered to reinforce our Australian comrades and repulse the expected Turkish attack. Good luck, General!
dst: 为应对运河和埃及面临的威胁，我们必须准备阻止滚滚而来的土耳其大军。眼下，澳大利亚轻骑兵的一些团已在卡提亚以西约七英里、塞得港以东约十八英里处占据阵地。我们的堑壕从海岸蜿蜒延伸向罗马尼绿洲和附近新建的沙漠铁路车站。您和您的部下奉命增援澳大利亚战友，击退预料中的土耳其进攻。祝您好运，将军！

src: To prevent a British naval blockade we will seize the Norwegian coast before the Allies can. The invasion of Denmark and Norway will consist of several task forces heading for specific ports. Your task force, Gruppe 1, will head for the northern Norwegian port of Narvik.
dst: 为阻止英国海军封锁，我们将在盟军之前夺取挪威海岸。对丹麦和挪威的入侵将由数支特遣舰队组成，分别驶向指定港口。您的特遣舰队——第1集群——将前往挪威北部的纳尔维克港。

src: To prevent a British naval blockade we will seize the Norwegian coast before the Allies. The invasion of Denmark and Norway will consist of several task forces heading for specific ports. Your task force, Gruppe 1, will assigned the northern Norwegian port of Narvik.
dst: 为防英国实施海上封锁，我们将在盟军之前夺取挪威海岸。入侵丹麦与挪威的行动将由数支特遣舰队组成，分头驶向特定港口。你的特遣舰队，即第1集群，将负责挪威北部的纳尔维克港。

src: To randowe, without him, I couldn't do anything.
dst: 感谢 randowe，没有他，我什么也做不成。

src: To reach its homeland, the Legion had still to cross Siberia, which was in control of White Russian power under Admiral Koltsjak. December 1918 saw a revolt against Koltsjak in Omsk, east of the Ural mountains, where Koltsjak held court. The Czech Legion supported Koltsjak as he did not object to the presence the Czech Legion - both sides had profit from one another.
dst: 为了回到祖国，军团仍须穿越西伯利亚，而西伯利亚正处于海军上将高尔察克领导的白俄势力控制之下。1918年12月，在高尔察克设府的乌拉尔山脉以东的鄂木斯克爆发了反高尔察克的叛乱。捷克军团支持高尔察克，因为他不反对捷克军团的存在——双方彼此互利。

src: To the Italian troops in Greece.
To the Philippines and the Pacific.

To the south, the Soviet 5th Army is pushing toward Kella.  In the center, the 7th is threatening Tallinn.  Along the coast, the Soviets are sending their own armored trains along with the ChK.  Soviet partisans have subverted some Estonians to fight for their cause.  Beware of Soviet marine parties landing on the outskirts of the capital.  You are to expect Scandianavian volunteers and the British Fleet any day now.  The Republic's eyes are upon you, Kolonel!
dst: 在南方，苏联第5集团军正向凯拉推进。在中路，第7集团军正威胁着塔林。沿海岸，苏军正调来他们自己的装甲列车以及契卡。苏联游击队已策反了一些爱沙尼亚人为他们的事业而战。要提防苏联海军陆战小队在首都近郊登陆。您随时都可能迎来斯堪的纳维亚志愿军和英国舰队。上校，整个共和国都在注视着您！

src: To the south, your forces are tasked with providing a mobile brigade.  We can only guess what forces will oppose you on the road to Slantsy.  Given the information from the Finns, you should expect elements of the 19th rifle division somewhere.  Also, most alarmingly, the Soviet 1st cavalry regiment has broken away from fighting to the south-west of us and is on their way to Narva as well.
dst: 在南面，您的部队奉命提供一个机动旅。我们只能猜测通往斯兰齐的道路上会有哪些敌军与您对抗。根据芬兰人提供的情报，您应该预期在某处会遇到第19步兵师的部队。此外，最令人警觉的是，苏俄第1骑兵团已脱离我们西南方向的战斗，同样正向纳尔瓦赶来。

src: To the third Caesar urgently had to reinforce his courageous Legions, which still followed him in large part from the beginning days of the Gallic war...
dst: 第三，凯撒亟须补充他那批骁勇的军团——高卢战争之初起就追随他的人，如今仍占大多数...

src: To win you must retreat 6 units, but if the British take the northern VH before turn 4 they win.
dst: 要获胜，您必须撤退6个单位，但如果英军在第4回合前占领北部胜利点，他们便获胜。

src: Tobruk has fallen! 30,000 Australians, Brits and Indians are marched off in captivity. We have captured enough supplies to start an attack into Egypt soon.
dst: 托布鲁克陷落了！3万名澳大利亚人、英国人和印度人被押走成为战俘。我们缴获了足够多的补给，很快就能发起向埃及的进攻。

src: Tobruk is ours!  Your destruction of the British here has set up for future operations in Egypt to be quickly possible.
dst: 托布鲁克是我们的了！你在这里歼灭英军，为日后快速展开埃及行动创造了条件。

src: Tobruk is ours!  Your destruction of the British here has set up for future operations in Egypt.
dst: 托布鲁克是我们的了！你在这里歼灭英军，为日后的埃及行动创造了条件。

src: Tobruk is ours!  Your destruction of the British here was costly for us to quickly set up future operations in Egypt.
dst: 托布鲁克是我们的了！你在这里歼灭英军代价不小，使得我们快速展开埃及行动变得不易。

src: Todas las cancillerias europeas estan absolutamente sorprendidas por el fulgurante cambio de rumbo que la guerra parece estar dando. Para completar la victoria se ha creado una operacion en el sector catalan al sur de Lerida, donde los rebeldes han tratado de avanzar para tratar de equilibrar la situacion. Su mision es salir al encuentro del avance fascista en el sector del rio Segre, encontrar la formacion de tropas atacantes y neutralizarla.
dst: 欧洲各国政府都对战争似乎正在发生的急剧转折深感震惊。为彻底取胜，我们已在莱里达以南的加泰罗尼亚地区策划了一次行动，叛军曾试图在那里推进以图平衡局势。您的任务是迎击塞格雷河地区的法西斯推进部队，找到发起进攻的部队并将其歼灭。

src: Today is a great victory for the German people.  Hiroshima and Nagasaki, obliterated in clouds of nuclear fire, force the Emperor to offer a full scale surrender of all Japanese forces across the globe.
dst: 今天是德国人民的伟大胜利。广岛和长崎在核火之云中被抹去，迫使天皇提出全面投降全球所有日军。

src: Today we will be pushing on towards Caen. It is imperative to the mission that we capture Carpiquet and its airfield. This will provide us with a forward base from which the attack on Caen can proceed. Bomber command is due to catch up with us in a few days, and will lend it's support in driving the Germans out of the occupied cities. Good luck General...
dst: 今天我们将向卡昂推进。夺取卡皮凯及其机场对本次任务至关重要。这将为我们提供一处前沿基地，从此处发起对卡昂的进攻。轰炸机司令部将于数日后赶上我们，并为把德军逐出所占城市提供支援。祝你好运，将军……

src: Today you will be commanding the largest formation a Canadian officer has ever commanded in combat so far. Your mission is to breakthrough the Seigfried Lines and clear the area west of the Rhine river, capturing all key cities and centres of enemy resistance. Good luck General...
dst: 今天你将指挥一名加拿大军官在战斗中所能指挥的最大规模编队。你的任务是突破齐格菲防线，肃清莱茵河以西地区，夺取所有关键城市与敌军抵抗中心。祝你好运，将军……

src: Today, after months of negotiations with representatives from both sides of the conflict, Bulgaria has declared war on Serbia, siding with Germany and the Austro-Hungarian Empire in the Great War that started in Europe last year.
dst: 今天，在与冲突双方的谈判代表进行了数月谈判之后，保加利亚向塞尔维亚宣战，加入了去年在欧洲爆发的大战，站在德国和奥匈帝国一边。

src: Today, history was made as German and Japanese forces successfully captured Pearl Harbor, marking the end in the global conflict. This bold strategic operation demonstrates the relentless strength and determination of our brave soldiers. With this victory, we have struck a decisive blow against our enemies in the Pacific, showcasing the might of the German-Japanese friendship!
dst: 今天，历史被改写，德国与日本部队成功攻占了珍珠港，标志着这场全球冲突的终结。这一大胆的战略行动彰显了我们勇敢士兵的不屈力量与决心。凭借这场胜利，我们对太平洋上的敌人给予了决定性打击，展现了德日友谊的威力！

src: Together with our Italian allies we've built a strong defensive line with minefields, bunkers and artillery positions. Once the British attack loses its power, we can easily rout them. But to accomplish this task, we must first get rid of their armoured units. Destroy their tanks and the attack will crumble."
dst: 我们与意大利盟友一起构筑了一条坚固的防线，布设了雷场、地堡和炮兵阵地。一旦英军的进攻失去锋芒，我们就能轻易击溃他们。但要完成这一任务，我们必须先解决他们的装甲部队。摧毁他们的坦克，攻势就会土崩瓦解。”

src: Together with our brothers the Teutons and Ambrones, you have to destroy the remaining troops of Consul Papirius Carbo!
dst: 与我们条顿人和安布罗内斯人兄弟一起，你必须消灭执政官帕皮里乌斯卡尔波的残部！

src: Together with two of our most powerful warships, the battleship Pelayo and the brand-new armoured cruiser Emperador Carlos V, several transports are carrying 5.000 men and other supplies to reinforce our forces already in the Philippines.
dst: 与我们的两艘最强大军舰——战列舰「佩拉约号」和崭新的装甲巡洋舰「卡洛斯五世皇帝号」——同行的还有数艘运输船，正运载着5000名士兵和其他补给，以加强我们已在菲律宾的部队。

src: Together, Germans and Austrians will resist the enemy. And, if we use everything that we’ve learnt in these three years of war (and I mean everything) it could even be possible to take the initiative for the first time since Italy betrayed our alliance. I can’t tell you more (spies are everywhere), so you’ll have to wait until my next permission, when we’ll be together and we’ll be able to speak freely. I already long for that moment. I want to see you again, hold you in my arms, and kiss you for hours. But we’ll have to wait a little. Now my attention must be in this horrible and endless war. God willing, it will end soon and we'll never be apart again.
dst: 德国人和奥地利人将并肩抵抗敌人。而且，如果我们用上这三年战争中学到的一切（我指的是一切），说不定还能在意大利背叛我们的联盟以来，第一次夺取主动权。我不能告诉您更多（到处都是间谍），所以您只能等到我下次休假——那时我们就能相聚，畅所欲言。我已经在渴望那一刻了。我想再见到您，把您拥在怀里，亲吻您几个小时。但我们还得再等一等。现在，我的心思必须放在这场可怕而又无休止的战争上。上帝保佑，它很快就会结束，我们将再也不会分离。
托尔纳内梅迪（通往考波什堡之路）
托马基夫卡 (托马科夫卡)

src: Tomorrow there will be a great parade at the Red Square. Our army will march along the main streets of Moscow, that has finally awaken from this nightmare that has lasted two years.
dst: 明天红场将举行盛大的阅兵式。我们的军队将行进在莫斯科的主要街道上，这座城终于从持续了两年的噩梦中苏醒。

src: Tong gan ku!  The dirty Japanese invaders got a lesson in good old ancient Chinese tactics.  The enemy division is completely scattered and our troops can continue to harass them.
dst: 同甘苦！肮脏的日本侵略者领教了中国古老的好战术。敌师已被彻底打散，我们的部队可以继续袭扰他们了。

src: Too bad Messines Ridge is in enemy hands. There was no way to retake the ground lost. Prepare for further enemy attacks.
dst: 很不幸，梅森岭已落入敌手。我们无法夺回失去的阵地。准备好应对敌军进一步的进攻吧。

src: Too bad that lack of fuel and ammo prevent us from launching further counter strikes. Let's wait and see what Monty's next move is.
dst: 可惜燃料和弹药短缺使我们无法发动进一步的反击。我们就等着看蒙蒂的下一步棋吧。

src: Too bad that the Axis forces failed to take posession of most of these important passes in the Eastern Dorsal. We need to arm these French troops with decent anti-tank weapons fast.
dst: 糟糕，轴心国军队未能夺取东部多塞勒的大多数重要山口。我们需要尽快给这些法军部队配备像样的反坦克武器。

src: Too bad that you failed to take Sborov. I am sure that Russian reinforcements will get the job done. You and your troops get time off in Tarnopol. A city with music and sidewalks, no noise of artillery fire and beautiful women.
dst: 很遗憾，您没能拿下斯博罗夫。我相信俄军援军会完成这项任务。您和您的部队可以在塔尔诺波尔休假。那是一座有音乐和人行道的城市，没有炮火的喧嚣，还有美丽的女人。

src: Too bloody commander, too bloody.  The high command thinks you are taking too many loses.  Anyway, the hills and the other strategic points are now in our hands.  By the way, Congratulations for your promotion as General of the Imperial Army.
dst: 太惨烈了，指挥官，太惨烈了。高层认为您的损失过大。不过，各高地及其他战略要点如今都在我们手中。顺便说一句，祝贺您晋升为帝国陆军将军。

src: Too many enemy troops were able to escape, but after all a immense pocket is closed - for the trapped enemy troops will remain only the surrender. But we leave the elimination of the pocket to our infantry. Advance west of the Appalachian Mountains further north on Knoxville!
dst: 太多敌军部队得以逃脱，但毕竟一个巨大的包围圈已经合拢——被困的敌军唯有投降一途。不过，清剿包围圈的任务我们交给步兵。从阿巴拉契亚山脉以西继续向北推进，直取诺克斯维尔！

src: Too many enemy troops were able to escape, but after the successful breakout you will advance with your troops to the southwest. Your goal is to reach the Gulf of Mexico east of Tallahasee and cut off the enemy troops standing in Florida.
dst: 太多敌军部队得以逃脱，但突围成功后，你将率部队向西南推进。你的目标是抵达塔拉哈西以东的墨西哥湾，切断驻扎在佛罗里达的敌军。

src: Too many enemy troops were able to escape, but the Caucasus lies ahead! Just 400 km to Baku, this important goal must be reached before the winter comes.
dst: 太多敌军部队得以逃脱，但高加索就在眼前！距巴库只有400公里，这个重要目标必须在入冬前拿下。

src: Too many enemy troops were able to escape, but the enemy defense in North Caucasus has collapsed. On the way to Astrakhan, your next goal, we expect only sporadic resistance.
dst: 太多敌军部队得以逃脱，但北高加索的敌军防线已经崩溃。在前往你的下一个目标阿斯特拉罕的路上，我们预计只会遇到零星抵抗。
托尔纳德,特拉蒙坦与提丰
托里霍斯 No.67/第7旅/第3师

src: Totally appalling work by your XIX corps Herr General, you are now ordered to cross East Prussia and form up for our attack south-east. Do not fail us again or the end of your command will come swiftly for you.
dst: 你的第19军干得糟糕透顶，将军阁下，现在你奉命穿过东普鲁士集结，准备向东南发起进攻。别再让我们失望，否则你的指挥生涯将很快结束。

src: Totenkopf's bridgehead is under heavy attack by the Russian 1st Tank Army and the 5th Guards Tank Army is counterattacking from the Prochorovka direction to our East.
dst: “骷髅”师的桥头堡正遭到俄军第1坦克集团军的猛攻，而近卫第5坦克集团军正从我们东面的普罗霍罗夫卡方向发起反击。
塔/ 第20师/ 第15集团军军/ 南方集团军
城镇近卫/ Ladysmith 卫戍部队
小队/第211/第64皇家中型炮兵/第4轻型/第2新西兰

src: Trabzon redif div./ XVII Army Corps/ 2nd Eastern Army
dst: Trabzon 预备役师/ 第17集团军军/ 第2东部集团军
Trans Baikal Kaz. 师/ 第11集团军

src: Transport for infantry will speed up their movements.
dst: 步兵的运输工具将加快他们的行进速度。

src: Transports delivering reinforcements will arrive from the east and our cavalry will be here soon coming from the south-east
dst: 运送援军的运输队将从东面抵达，我们的骑兵也很快会从东南方向赶来。

src: Tras el exito en el valle del Jarama nuestro objetivo ahora es asestar un duro golpe al enemigo, que tiene una confianza excesiva en sus propios medios, y hacer dudar a los rebeldes de la valia de la cooperacion que reciben de los italianos.
dst: 在哈拉马谷地取得胜利之后，我们现在的目标是给过分自信的敌人以沉重打击，并让叛军怀疑他们从意大利人那里得到的援助究竟有多大价值。

src: Tras la batalla del Ebro, el ejército nacional avanza por Cataluña con la intención de alcanzar Barcelona, la más importante ciudad republicana, a fin de infligir una derrota aplastante a la República Española. Escenario histórico.
dst: 埃布罗河战役后，国民军穿越加泰罗尼亚推进，意图攻占共和派最重要的城市巴塞罗那，以给西班牙共和国以毁灭性的打击。历史场景。

src: Tras la conquista de Bilbao, las tropas nacionales se preparan para acabar con otra de las provincias del norte republicano: Santander. El inicio se retrasa por la ofensiva republicana en Brunete pero, detenida ésta, ya nada impide el ataque, que se desencadena el 14 de agosto de 1937.
dst: 夺取毕尔巴鄂后，国民军部队准备消灭共和军北部的另一个省份：桑坦德。进攻因共和军在布鲁内特的攻势而推迟，但在其被遏止后，已再无任何阻碍，进攻于1937年8月14日发动。

src: Tras la destrucción de las fuerzas de los rojos en Santander, solo han logrado escapar hacia Asturias algunos elementos, que se han unido a las fuerzas allí presentes. El enemigo sabe como detenernos en las montañas, pero está completamente solo. El gobierno republicano de Valencia no puede enviarles ningún tipo de ayuda, por lo que es una pura cuestión de tiempo hasta que les llegue la hora de la derrota. Sin embargo, no podemos permitir bajo ningún concepto que el enemigo logre ejercer una especie de defensa heroica. Lo cierto, es que el invierno en las montañas asturianas es duro, y será el mejor aliado del enemigo. Su deber, mi general, es lograr una rápida y aplastante victoria. Después, podremos centrarnos en asuntos más importantes.
dst: 在桑坦德的共和军部队被消灭后，只有少数残部逃往阿斯图里亚斯，与当地部队会合。敌军知道如何在山区阻截我们，但它已彻底孤立。巴伦西亚共和政府无法向他们提供任何援助，因此他们的失败纯粹只是时间问题。然而，我们绝不能容许敌军进行某种英雄式的防御。事实上，阿斯图里亚斯山区的冬天很严酷，它将成为敌军最好的盟友。将军，您的职责是赢得一场迅速而压倒性的胜利。之后，我们便能专注于更重要的事务。

src: Tras las primeras pruebas de fuego mas o menos victoriosas para el Ejercito Popular, sumado eso a los ultimos envios de armas que han llegado desde la URSS, se puede decir que estamos en posicion de lanzar nuestra primera gran ofensiva de la guerra.
dst: 在共和军经历了几次大致成功的实战考验之后，再加上最近从苏联运抵的武器，可以说我们已经有能力发动这场战争中的第一次大规模攻势。

src: Tras nuestro fracaso en Madrid, hemos planeado un ataque a traves del rio Jarama. Su mision es romper la linea republicana para poder unirnos a otras fuerzas que vienen desde el este y completar el cerco a Madrid. Una ciudad rodeada no puede sobrevivir mucho tiempo, asi tal vez la capital caiga en nuestras manos en un par de semanas.
dst: 我们在马德里失利之后，计划了一次横渡哈拉马河的进攻。您的任务是突破共和军防线，以便与从东面赶来的其他部队会合，完成对马德里的包围。一座被围困的城市无法支撑太久，也许首都就会在一两周之内落入我们手中。
战壕/第73燧发枪兵/221/第111步兵师 [Ypern]
第67近卫步兵师战壕 [22G] 第6近卫集团军

src: Trento, Bologna and 164Le will hold the line in the North while DAK and your Ariete, Trieste and Littorio divisions will break through in the South and swing northwards round the rear of 8th Army's positions. The key to the battle will be the Alam Halfa Ridge.
dst: “特伦托”师、“博洛尼亚”师和第164轻装师将在北面守住战线，而非洲军和你的“公羊”、“的里雅斯特”、“利托里奥”各师将在南面突破，然后向北迂回，绕到第8集团军阵地后方。此战的关键将是阿拉姆哈勒法山脊。

src: Troops of [VIIR] Corps on your right flank will be put under your control once they have broken through the enemy first line of defense.
dst: 在您右翼的[VIIR]军部队一旦突破敌军第一道防线，就将划归您指挥。
D. Victoriano Pintos 上校部队

src: Trotsky coordinated the Soviet counterattack so well that, even before our evacuation of Kazan was complete, the Bolsheviks had taken Simbirsk, and Syzran and Samara were already in danger.
dst: 托洛茨基把苏维埃反攻协调得如此出色，以至于我们的喀山撤退尚未完成，布尔什维克就已拿下了辛比尔斯克，塞兹兰和萨马拉也已岌岌可危。

src: Trotsky has formed the Udarnaya (Shock) Group to counter-attack our positions at Vyritsa.  You must maintain cohesion of the front, Kindralleitnant!
dst: 托洛茨基已组建了突击集群，反攻我们在维里察的阵地。您必须保持战线的完整性，中将！
部队 de la défense nationale

src: Try to launch the first counterattack of the Republican People's Army for first time in the war.
dst: 尝试在这场战争中首次发起共和人民军的第一次反攻。

src: Try to lure the enemy armoured units into the forest where they are vulnerable to your supporting infantry.
dst: 设法把敌军装甲部队诱入森林，在那里他们将易于被你的支援步兵攻击。

src: Trying to undermine the confederate fortifications south-east of Petersburg, sappers already created a huge crater in the rebel position. But it has been of little use as the walls of the crater are too steep to climp up, our attack commando has been brutally killed in attempting to make it up...
dst: 为了破坏彼得斯堡东南方的南方军防御工事，工兵们已经在叛军阵地上炸出一个巨大的弹坑。但这几乎无济于事，因为弹坑的坑壁太陡，爬不上去，我们的突击队在试图冲上去时惨遭杀害……

src: Tsar Ferdinand I has decided that negotiations are useless. Only a quick, decissive attack will convince Serbia to give us what is rightfully ours. Tomorrow we'll start a war on Serbia and Greece.

src: Two French Armee's,the 3rd and 5th at Verdun and on the move.SS Frau General 'Nooks Lyanna Mullenmark had Her forces ready for the blows to come.Unfortunately for Nooks logistics had mis-read the supply orders so She was already scrapping the bottom of the barrel on munnitions and fuel which were meant to fight 1 force not the 2 coming at her.Back in Berlin the Fuhress was getting complaint after complaint with everyone in the Field crying for this and that so they could be sure to have enough,and of course most were hoarding more than they needed,that was eveyone but Nooks."This is War" Nooks had stated "Things go wrong,mistakes are made,People are maimed and killed.Matters not the Uniform.Civilians are uprooted,pawns in the game to suffer the same.Young/Old what's the difference.It's a Necessity to a Better End Result hopefully as the Fuhress has stated.Hell I'll deal with it as it comes and if I am killed,so It was in the Cards.I'm a smart Gal,not too bad on the Eye either so a few fellas have told Me.We'll win the War whether I see it or not.If My hands get too full,well that's just too bad for Me".So Nooks just played with the Hand She was dealt.The French of course hoped it was a losing hand but so far the SS/BdM had had the Deck stacked in their favor.
dst: 法国两个集团军——第3和第5集团军——在凡尔登，正在移动。党卫军努克斯·莱安娜·穆伦马克女将军已让她的部队准备好迎接即将到来的打击。对努克斯不幸的是，后勤部门误读了补给订单，所以她的弹药和燃料早就见底了——而那是用来对付一支敌军、不是两支的。在柏林，女元首接到一个接一个的抱怨，前线人人都在为这要那，好确保自己够用；当然大多数人囤的超过了所需——除了努克斯。“这就是战争。”努克斯曾说，“事情会出错，会犯错，人会伤残、会死。跟穿什么制服无关。平民流离失所，是这场游戏里的棋子，一样受苦。年轻年老有什么分别。按女元首的说法，这是通往更好结局的‘必需之举’。见鬼，来什么我应付什么，要是我被打死，那也是命里注定。我是个聪明的姑娘，长相也不差——有几个男的是这么跟我说的。不管我看不看得见，我们都会赢下这场战争。要是我忙不过来，那也只能怪我自己。”于是努克斯就按手里这手牌来打。法国人当然希望那是一手输牌，但到目前为止，党卫军/BdM 一直占着上风。

src: Two and a half months ago, British and French troops started their Somme Offensive to take the pressure off Verdun. At the same time, the Russians started the Brusilov Offensive.

src: Two days ago we released tons of chlorine gas against the French defences located north of Pilkem, and it worked extremely well. Two enemy divisions either died or had to run for their lives, opening a large gap in the Entente lines. It's a pity that we don't have enough reserves to break the enemy front completely, but with your help we can still take advantage from the use of the gas. Push through the gap, in Kitchener's Wood and St. Julien, and most of the Ypern salient will be gone. But be careful, there are two British divisions in the area, and the surviving French could regroup and counterattack, too.
dst: 两天前，我们向皮尔肯姆以北的法军防御阵地释放了成吨的氯气，效果极佳。两个敌军师非死即逃，在协约国战线上撕开了一个巨大的缺口。遗憾的是我们没有足够的预备队来彻底突破敌军战线，但在您的帮助下，我们仍能利用这次毒气袭击的战果。穿过缺口，突入基钦纳森林和圣朱利安，伊普尔突出部的大部分就将不复存在。但要当心，这一地区有两个英军师，幸存的法军也可能重新集结并发起反攻。

src: Two days later Emperor Yohannes crossed the Mareb with the remaining Ethiopian forces, blocking the advance of Sorendrup and his men. The fight started near the village of Gundet, and then Alula ordered us to charge against the Egyptians.

src: U.S. interest in Cuba had begun long before 1898. American strategic and increasing economic interests in Cuba, mostly in sugar and tobacco, led to several attempts to acquire Cuba from Spain since the beginning of the XIX century (U.S. had already acquired Louisiana and Florida from Spain in 1803 and 1819 respectively). However, the more the Americans tried to bully Spain into selling Cuba, the more Spanish resisted the idea: Americans had miscalculated the strong links between Spain and Cuba and the Spanish sense of national honour and pride.
dst: 美国对古巴的兴趣早在1898年之前就已开始。美国在古巴的战略利益和日益增长的经济利益（主要是蔗糖和烟草）使其自19世纪初起多次试图从西班牙手中取得古巴（美国已分别于1803年和1819年从西班牙获得路易斯安那和佛罗里达）。然而，美国人越是试图胁迫西班牙出卖古巴，西班牙人就越是抗拒这一念头：美国人误判了西班牙与古巴之间的紧密联系，以及西班牙人的民族荣誉感和自豪感。

src: Una cosa más, esta vez tendremos ganada la superioridad aérea numérica gracias a la ayuda de nuestros amigos alemanes. Sin embargo, como ya ha visto, y aunque los alemanes no lo quieran reconocer, los aviones rusos de que disponen los republicanos tienen toda la pinta de ser algo superiores, así que tenga cuidado.
dst: 还有一件事，这一次，多亏我们的德国朋友的帮助，我们将获得数量上的空中优势。然而，正如您已经看到的，尽管德国人不愿承认，共和军手中的俄国飞机看样子要更胜一筹，所以请您务必小心。

src: Una gran victoria aqui podra poner punto y final a las aspiraciones rebeldes sobre Madrid, al menos por el momento.
dst: 这里的一场大胜将终结叛军对马德里的野心，至少目前如此。

src: Unable to keep its positions, the French Army of the Rhine retreated to Metz the next morning, and the Germans besieged the city almost immediately. In a matter of weeks most of Bazaine's units had been destroyed or had been trapped in Metz where, unless they received some kind of help, would eventually have to surrender.
dst: 法军莱茵军团无力守住阵地，次日清晨便撤回梅斯，德军几乎立即包围了该城。数周之内，巴赞的大部分部队要么被歼灭，要么被困在梅斯，除非得到某种援助，否则最终都将不得不投降。

src: Unable to stop the Germans, the French army retreated to the west, towards Bitche and Saverne. The German Third Army did not pursue them and remained in Alsace, attacking and destroying the French garrisons that they could find.
dst: 无法阻挡德军的法军向西撤退，朝比奇和萨韦尔讷方向而去。德意志第3军团没有追击，而是留在阿尔萨斯，进攻并摧毁他们所能找到的法军守备部队。

src: Unable to stop the Prussian divisions, the Austrians and Saxons left the battlefield as soon as they received new orders from Benedek, telling them to join the Nord Armee in the east. Finally, all the Austrian forces in Bohemia gathered near Königgrätz, where the decisive battle would take place.
dst: 无法阻挡普鲁士各师的奥地利人和萨克森人，一接到贝内德克命令他们去东面与北方军团会合的新命令，便离开了战场。最终，波希米亚境内的所有奥地利军队都集结在柯尼希格雷茨附近，决定性的战役即将在那里打响。

src: Unbeknownst to GröFaZ, the local troops have been communicating with Heeresgruppe Kurland to open up a corridor to let the trapped troops into East Prussia. You, the commander, have enthusiastically adapted this plan.
dst: 那位“史上最伟大的统帅”并不知道，当地部队一直在与库尔兰集团军群联络，以打通一条走廊，让被困部队进入东普鲁士。而你，指挥官，已欣然采纳了这项计划。

src: Unbelievable! You've been defeated by the Romanian Army! The Bulgarians have showed more reliability than your own forces. Thanks to the Bulgarians we'll still be able to pacify this front before Christmas, but you...you are of no use to us right now. You'd better go back to the Western Front. And please, General, remain there.
dst: 难以置信！您竟被罗马尼亚军队击败了！保加利亚人表现出的可靠程度比您的部队还高。多亏保加利亚人，我们仍能在圣诞节前平定这条战线，可您……您现在对我们毫无用处。您最好回西线去。而且拜托了，将军，就留在那里吧。
Uncountable trophies: the Komuch 攻势 (II)

src: Under control of Consul Gnaeus Carbo Papirius who is there as Proconsul in exalted position, stands the  Legio I Germanica.
dst: 在作为前执政官身居显位的执政官格奈乌斯卡尔波帕皮里乌斯统辖之下，驻扎着第1军团「日耳曼尼卡」。

src: Under dubious circumstances he starts war against the Gallic tribes. The  following years go by with changing alliances and wars with various Gallic tribes. (If Gaul have had a centralistic government and army, Cäsar would only be a little footnote in history books)
dst: 他在可疑的情形下对高卢各部族开战。此后数年，便在不断变换的同盟与对各高卢部族的战争中过去。（倘若高卢拥有中央集权的政府与军队，凯撒只会是史书里的一个小小脚注。）

src: Under harsh conditions, and lacking proper equipment, you've done your best. Being a secondary, if not tertiary theatre of war, the Arctic Front is left to its fate - your brigade will be necessary elsewhere. Surprisingly, the attached air support will be expanded once more.
dst: 在严酷环境、装备匮乏之下，你已尽了全力。作为次要乃至边缘的战线，北极前线被弃之不顾——你的旅在别处更有用武之地。出人意料的是，配属的空中支援竟将再次扩编。

src: Under no circumstances would we ever have wanted to annoy the mighty British Empire, but the empress understood that it was the only option that we had. It was obvious that Italy didn't want peace. They had just retreated to Eritrea, but they didn't even have asked for a ceasefire, much less for the opening of peace negotiations. If we stopped now, we'd just give them the time that they needed to recover and reinforce themselves, and in a few months they'd invade us again.
dst: 我们无论如何都不愿去得罪强大的大英帝国，但皇后明白，这是我们唯一的选择。意大利显然不想要和平。他们刚刚撤入厄立特里亚，却连停火都没有请求，更不用说开启和平谈判了。如果我们现在停下，就等于给他们时间去恢复和增援，几个月后他们就会再次入侵我们。

src: Under the 1947 Treaty of Paris, the Allies did not acknowledge Romania as a co-belligerent nation. Northern Transylvania was, once again, recognised as an integral part of Romania, but the border with the USSR was fixed at its 1941 state, leaving the former Romanian-administered territories of Bessarabia and Northern Bukovina outside the country.
dst: 依1947年《巴黎和约》，同盟国未承认罗马尼亚为共同交战国。北特兰西瓦尼亚再次被确认为罗马尼亚不可分割的一部分，但与苏联的边界被固定在1941年状态，使原由罗马尼亚管辖的比萨拉比亚与北布科维纳置于国境之外。

src: Under the circumstances, General, the opening of the port of Antwerp remains absolutely necessary, since our main supply lines still run back to Normandy. As you know, Monty has ordered a re-grouping of all forces to concentrate upon the opening of the Scheldt estuary. Your mission is to neutralize the last great obstacles preventing us from using the strategically vital  port of Antwerp...
dst: 在这种情况下，将军，开放安特卫普港仍然绝对必要，因为我们的主要补给线仍要一路折返诺曼底。如你所知，蒙蒂已下令重新集结所有部队，集中力量打通斯海尔德河口。你的任务是清除阻碍我们使用具有重大战略意义的安特卫普港的最后几处巨大障碍……

src: Under the extreme cold weather, we couldn't accomplish our mission, and Ufa remained under the control of the Bolsheviks. Our troops in the south weren't lucky, either, and before the end of January we lost the town of Orenburg, too. But, at least, the Soviet attacks stopped. Our enemies were exhausted after so many months of combats.
dst: 在极端严寒的天气下，我们没能完成任务，乌法仍处于布尔什维克的控制之下。我们在南方的部队也不走运，一月底之前，我们又丢掉了奥伦堡。但至少，苏军的进攻停止了。经过这么多个月的战斗，我们的敌人也已精疲力竭。

src: Under the extreme cold weather, we prevailed, and Ufa finally fell in our hands. Our troops in the south weren't so lucky, and before the end of January we lost the town of Orenburg. But, at least, the Soviet attacks stopped, and with Perm and Ufa firmly under our control, we had two excellent bases to start a counteroffensive as soon as the spring came.
dst: 在严寒之中，我们占了上风，乌法最终落入我们手中。我们在南方的部队就没那么幸运了，1月底之前我们丢掉了奥伦堡。但至少，苏维埃的进攻停止了，随着彼尔姆和乌法牢牢掌握在我们手中，我们有了两个绝佳基地，春天一到便可发动反攻。

src: Under the impression of demonstrations and pressure from the large majority of Members of Parliament,Grand Duke Friedrich August of Oldenburg declared his abdication on 11 November 1918.
dst: 在示威活动以及绝大多数国会议员施压的影响下，奥尔登堡大公弗里德里希·奥古斯特于1918年11月11日宣布退位。

src: Under the reign of Etruscans Rome was booming.
dst: 在伊特鲁里亚人统治之下，罗马蒸蒸日上。

src: Under the terms of the treaty Britain will acknowledge the Austro-German gains from the war, whilst we'll respect the imperial possessions of Britain, Japan and Portugal. Specifically, Venedig will be again part of our Empire, and we'll share the possession of Malta with the Germans.
dst: 根据条约条款，英国将承认奥德两国在战争中所获得的利益，而我们则将尊重英国、日本和葡萄牙的帝国属地。具体而言，威尼斯将重新成为我们帝国的一部分，而我们则将与德国人共同拥有马耳他。

src: Under the terms of this treaty Britain will acknowledge our gains from the war, whilst we'll respect the imperial possessions of Britain, Japan and Portugal. Our former colonies will be returned, and our allies will obtain significative territorial gains, too.
dst: 根据这一条约的条款，英国将承认我们从战争中获得的成果，而我们则将尊重英国、日本和葡萄牙的帝国属地。我们昔日的殖民地将被归还，我们的盟友也将获得可观的领土收益。

src: Under these circumstances, Haig decided that it was necessary to relieve our allies and wear out the Germans, so he ordered an attack on the Ypres salient that, if successful, would secure the Belgian coast. The plan had been carefully made, and due to the coordinated use of planes, tanks, artillery and elite infantry our methods for gathering intelligence and assaulting fortified positions had improved remarkably. On the other hand, so had the German defensive tactics, and Haig's prestige had suffered after the Somme, so our offensive was controversial from the beginning.
dst: 在这种情况下，黑格认为有必要为我们的盟友解围并消耗德军，于是下令对伊普尔突出部发动进攻，若成功便可确保比利时海岸的安全。这一计划经过了周密制定，而且由于协同运用飞机、坦克、炮兵和精锐步兵，我们搜集情报和突击筑垒阵地的方法已显著改进。另一方面，德军的防御战术同样有所改进，而黑格的声望在索姆河之后已受损，因此我们的攻势从一开始就饱受争议。

src: Under your command is the Soomusrongide Kolon, which contains your 1st regiment and (still under formation) elements of Estonia's armored train fleet.  You are to requisition what armored train equipment is already available and report to the battlefield.  Once you recapture the initiative, expect more equipment to complement your Soomusrong.
dst: 您麾下指挥的是装甲列车纵队，其中包括您的第1团和（仍在组建中的）爱沙尼亚装甲列车舰队的部分力量。您要征用现有一切可用的装甲列车装备，并赶赴战场报到。一旦您重新夺回主动权，预计还会有更多装备来充实您的装甲列车纵队。

src: Underestimating the Italians after the battle of Karfreit would be a great mistake, though. They've put into practice a strategy of defence in depth, so moving on the mountain terrain may become difficult. If you're not careful, your casualties can be high.
dst: 不过，如果在卡波雷托战役之后低估意大利人，那将是一个巨大的错误。他们已经实行了纵深防御战略，因此在山地地形上行进可能会变得困难。如果您不谨慎行事，伤亡可能会很高。

src: Unfavorably the heavily fortified base Fort Bragg is located just between you and our distressed troops. Try to bypass Fort Bragg and attack the enemy in the back! Afterwards take care of the U.S. base and capture this main target!
dst: 不利的是，设防严密的布拉格堡基地恰好横在你与我们受困部队之间。设法绕过布拉格堡，从背后攻击敌人！之后再收拾这座美军基地，拿下这个主要目标！

src: Unfortunally most of the Brjansk region was occupied by the Germans. This was not a good performance.
dst: 不幸的是，布良斯克地区的大部分都被德国人占领了。这次表现不好。

src: Unfortunally you could not deliver. Therefore, comrade Stalin have decided that your troops will not reciieve any reinforcements at the moment.
dst: 遗憾的是你未能兑现成果。因此，斯大林同志已决定，你的部队目前不会得到任何增援。

src: Unfortunately our troops are not a challenge for the liberal army. At least not yet. Now we must learn from our mistakes and transform our volunteers into an army worthy of that name. The Liberal government is weak, and soon we will have a new opportunity to face it.
dst: 不幸的是，我们的部队还不足以挑战自由派军队。至少现在还不够。如今我们必须从错误中吸取教训，把我们的志愿者改造成一支名副其实的军队。自由派政府软弱无能，很快我们就会有新的机会与它一决高下。

src: Unfortunately the 2nd New Zealand Division proved that the Mareth line can be bypassed: just a week later they did so in Operation Supercharge II. There was nothing left for us but to hastily retreat to the Akarit line. The Akarit line formes a better defensive position than the Mareth line, but our troops arrived there in great disarray which meant that 24 hours after 8th Army's attack on the position it had to be evacuated. 8th Army has now made contact with the Allied forces in North and Central Tunisia and Mussolini's Afrika Korps faith is doomed.
dst: 遗憾的是，新西兰第2师证明了马雷斯防线可被绕开：仅仅一周后，他们就在“超载II”行动中这么做了。我们别无出路，只能仓促撤往阿卡里特防线。阿卡里特防线比马雷斯防线更宜防守，但我军抵达时已十分混乱，这意味着在第8集团军进攻该阵地24小时后，它就被迫放弃了。第8集团军如今已与突尼斯北部和中部的盟军会师，墨索里尼的非洲军命运已注定。

src: Unfortunately the Aussies pushed us back out of the perimeter in a swift counterattack. We will attack Tobruk again once the first units of the 15th Panzer Division have arrived.
dst: 遗憾的是，澳军以一次迅猛反击把我们逐出了外围防线。等第15装甲师的首批部队抵达，我们将再次进攻托布鲁克。

src: Unfortunately the Italian paratroopers and marines left to support the Italian attack on Malta from the east. The support unit has stayed to help you and is already part of your core.
dst: 遗憾的是，意大利伞兵和海军陆战队已离去，去支援意大利从东面对马耳他的进攻。那支支援单位留了下来帮助你，并已是你核心部队的一部分。

src: Unfortunately the allied troops could escape. The war will last longer as believed. But, for you, the war is over. Dismiss!
dst: 遗憾的是盟军部队逃走了。战争将比预想的持续更久。但是对你而言，战争已经结束了。解散！

src: Unfortunately there are no reinforces available.
dst: 遗憾的是没有增援可用。

src: Unfortunately we can not take advantage of this victory, because the republican army outnumbers us. We can only hope for a miracle and that the political situation in Spain changes favorably to our interests.
dst: 遗憾的是，我们无法利用这场胜利，因为共和军在人数上超过我们。我们只能指望奇迹，指望西班牙的政治局势朝有利于我们的方向转变。

src: Unfortunately we had to move troops to Yemen last summer to fight a local uprising. Now we have no more than 3,500 Ottoman troops at our disposal in the whole of Trablusgarp and the Italians have landed at Trablus (Tripoli), Tobruk, Bingazi, Derne and Al Khums. They say that they want to "bring the blessings of progress to Lybia". Needles to say, that the Sublime Porte cannot give in to these Italian demands.
dst: 不幸的是，去年夏天我们不得不把部队调往也门去镇压当地起义。如今，在整个的黎波里塔尼亚，我们可支配的奥斯曼军队不超过3500人，而意大利人已在的黎波里、图卜鲁格、班加西、德尔纳和胡姆斯登陆。他们说想要「把进步的福祉带给利比亚」。不用说，崇高的奥斯曼帝国政府决不能对这些意大利人的要求让步。

src: Unfortunately you were not fast enough. The germans blew the bridge up before you arrived. You will get a second chance to prove your abilities. Soon we will attack the Ruhr Area. Ensure that your attack then will be more succesful.
dst: 不幸的是，你不够快。德国人在你抵达之前炸毁了桥梁。你将获得第二次机会来证明你的能力。不久我们将进攻鲁尔区。届时务必确保你的进攻更为成功。

src: Unfortunately, I have to interrupt your vacation. While we have refitted your troops the situation near Zhitomir have changed in a serious way. The Germans have started a counterattack with five tank divisions after we have recaptured Kiev. Hold Zhitomir and stop every advance to Kiev.
dst: 很遗憾，我不得不打断你的休假。在我们为你的部队进行改装期间，日托米尔附近的局势严重恶化。在我们收复基辅之后，德军以五个装甲师发起了反击。守住日托米尔，阻止一切向基辅的推进。

src: Unfortunately, after receiving the news of the Allied invasion of Sicily, as well as reports of an impending Soviet attack on our positions on the Mius river, the Fuhrer has decided to cancel Operation Zitadelle...
dst: 遗憾的是，在收到盟军登陆西西里的消息以及苏军即将进攻我们在米乌斯河阵地的报告之后，元首已决定取消“堡垒行动”……

src: Unfortunately, if we want to make it there in time, this means we will need to work with the Soviets.
dst: 遗憾的是，若想及时赶到那里，就意味着我们必须与苏联人合作。

src: Unfortunately, some British and French units managed to escape from your encirclement at Duenkirchen and you will have to try to eliminate them at Calais and Boulogne before the British High Command manages to evacuate them.
dst: 遗憾的是，部分英法部队从你在敦刻尔克的包围圈中逃脱，你必须赶在英军统帅部把他们撤走之前，在加来和布洛涅设法歼灭他们。

src: Unfortunately, the Anglo-French offensives against the German defensive line on the Ardennes/Calais axis have failed and our Army, under pressure, has retreated further, leaving the Germans to capture Terneuzen and Gent/Gand on the 23 May.
dst: 遗憾的是，英法军队对阿登-加来轴线上德军防线的攻势失败了，我军在压力下继续后撤，德军得以在5月23日攻占泰尔讷曾和根特。

src: Unfortunately, the British know about this mission and have blockaded the island. They have forces from Free France with them. Also 2 French ships are equipped with the new RADAR sent by the Americans. Finally, don't forget that the British can send reinforcements from Malta, especially planes.
dst: 不幸的是，英国人知道这次任务，并已封锁了该岛。他们带着自由法国的部队。另外2艘法国军舰装备了美国送来的新型雷达。最后，别忘了英国人可以从马耳他派出增援，尤其是飞机。

src: Unfortunately, the Russians attacked earlier than expected, and Erzurum was lost on February 16. The Turkish 3rd Army fielded 140,000 men. Half of them were killed or wounded. Very few became the prisoners of war. The Russian Caucasus Army fielded 280,000 men, and its losses were much lighter.
dst: 不幸的是，俄军比预期更早发动进攻，埃尔祖鲁姆于2月16日失守。土耳其第3集团军有14万人，其中一半阵亡或受伤，只有极少数被俘。俄国高加索集团军有28万人，损失要轻得多。

src: Unfortunately, the fighting around the RAF base in Habbanyah is still in progress! The Commonwealth troops there, have built up a strong defensive position. But fortunately for us, in Fallujah in the rear of the enemy between Habbanyah and Baghdad a riot broke out and has cut off the enemy supply lines. With Samarra in our hands we are in a good position to exploit this situation and attack Baghdad from the west. Advance with your troops via Al Khalis and Bani Sad to Baghdad and attack the city! This way, we get Baghdad and could encircle and destroy the enemy forces between Habbanyah and Baghdad.
dst: 不幸的是，哈巴尼亚皇家空军基地周围的战斗仍在进行！那里的英联邦部队构筑了坚固的防御阵地。但让我们庆幸的是，在敌军后方、哈巴尼亚与巴格达之间的费卢杰爆发了一场暴动，切断了敌军的补给线。萨迈拉既已在我手中，我们就处于有利位置，可以西攻巴格达。率你的部队经哈利斯和巴尼萨德向巴格达推进，进攻该城！这样，我们就能拿下巴格达，并围歼哈巴尼亚与巴格达之间的敌军。

src: Unfortunately, the situation in Spain is not as we were told by Franco's staff. The revolutionaries have not only taken over much of Andalusia, but are preparing to take over Malaga as well. Few Spanish units are left in the area since the entire Spanish army is in Catalonia, which if the rebels prevail, it is certain that they will turn to the side of the allies. As you already know, you cannot have support either from our ships or from our aircraft.
dst: 遗憾的是，西班牙的局势并非佛朗哥的幕僚向我们描述的那样。革命派不仅占领了安达卢西亚的大部分地区，还正准备夺取马拉加。该地区的西班牙部队所剩无几，因为西班牙全军都在加泰罗尼亚，一旦叛军得势，他们必将倒向盟国一方。如你所知，你既得不到我方舰船的支持，也得不到我方飞机的支援。

src: Unfortunately, to the north of your forces, the Russians have broken through the lines and destroyed the Hungarian second army. We have no choice but to retreat to the Donetz.
dst: 不幸的是，在您部队以北，俄军已突破防线并歼灭了匈牙利第二集团军。我们别无选择，只能退往顿涅茨。

src: Unfortunately, we aren't allowed to pursue them. Germany doesn't want to do anything that can be interpreted as a provocation by the Greeks. What a foolish decision! No matter that King Konstantinos is pro-German, Greece is already invaded by Britain and France, and the Greek government will eventually declare war on us, no matter what we do. Stopping now will only benefit the Entente countries. But there is nothing we can do.
dst: 不幸的是，我们不被允许追击他们。德国不想做任何可能被希腊人解读为挑衅的事。多么愚蠢的决定！不管国王康斯坦丁诺斯是否亲德，希腊早已被英国和法国入侵，而且无论我们怎么做，希腊政府最终都会向我们宣战。现在停下来只会让协约国得利。但我们也无能为力。

src: Unfortunately, we have received orders to retire. It seems that the German Army has broken the French defences at Sedan and it is now free to drive for the English Channel. To avoid our southern flanks from being turned by the German forces we have to retire once more. Our new defensive line will be the Escaut/Scheldt River.
dst: 遗憾的是，我们已接到后撤的命令。看来德军已突破法军在色当的防御，现在可以自由地向英吉利海峡推进。为避免我军南翼被德军迂回，我们必须再次后撤。新的防线将是斯海尔德河。

src: Unfortunately, we have received orders to retire. It seems that the German Army has broken the French defences at Sedan and it is now free to drive for the English Channel. To avoid our southern flanks from being turned by the German forces we have to retire once more. Our new defensive line will be the Escaut/Scheldt river.
dst: 遗憾的是，我们已接到后撤的命令。看来德军已突破法军在色当的防御，现在可以自由地向英吉利海峡推进。为避免我军南翼被德军迂回，我们必须再次后撤。新的防线将是斯海尔德河。

src: Unfortunatley, the Swedes have ambushed our Finn allies and we must help them. We have intelligence reports that the Swedes are throwing all their reserves at us. Expect a flanking attack.
dst: 遗憾的是，瑞典人伏击了我们的芬兰盟友，我们必须去帮他们。情报显示，瑞典人正把所有预备队投向我们的方向。当心侧翼进攻。
联邦运河 at DeSoto 岬角

src: Units in Kholm still hold the pocket, but they are in a desperate situation. Airdropped supplies are running low, as many of the transport JU 52 planes were shot down by the enemy. You need to act quickly, and completely dismantle the enemy: destroy the Soviets east of the city, thus cutting their frontline units in Kholm and its vicinity severing their supply lines, and secure the eastern approaches so that a save evacuation is possible.
dst: 霍尔姆的部队仍守着包围圈，但处境绝望。空投补给日渐告罄，因为许多 Ju 52 运输机被敌击落。你必须火速行动，彻底瓦解敌军：消灭城东的苏军，切断霍尔姆及其周边敌军前线部队的补给线，并确保东部通道，以便安全撤离。

src: Units mounted in transport will not dismount automatically at the beginning of a new turn.
dst: 搭乘运输工具的部队不会在新回合开始时自动下车。

src: Units mounted in transport will not dismount if attacked.
dst: 搭乘运输工具的部队在被攻击时不会下车。

src: Units with [Z] special ability can build airfields in 2 turns and with the "fast builder" attachment in just 1 turn. Building an airport costs 20pp.
dst: 拥有[Z]特殊能力的单位可在2回合内建造机场，若配有“快速建造者”附件则仅需1回合。建造一座机场花费20pp。

src: Unlike Cuban mambises, Filipino rebels preferred open warfare to hit-and-run guerrilla warfare. They normally fortified themselves in villages and formidable trenches, forcing Spanish troops to storm the rebels' positions, with both sides suffering heavy casualties.
dst: 与古巴的曼比塞游击战士不同，菲律宾起义者更喜欢阵地战而非打了就跑的游击战。他们通常在村庄和坚固的战壕里设防，迫使西班牙军队强攻起义者的阵地，双方伤亡都很惨重。

src: Unlucky, Sir.  It was only a raid anyway, and the Italians were much too strong in the end.  We will get the better of them eventually, and you will get another chance to prove your worth.
dst: 运气不佳，长官。反正这只是一次突袭，意大利人最终还是太强了。我们迟早会占上风，你也会再有机会证明自己的价值。

src: Unternehmen Doppelkopf achieved some level of tactical success, but on a strategical level, no miracle happened, and the Soviets were shaken, yet undefeated. Their evergrowing numbers, their new powerful AFVs, and their recently gained air superiority, all these factors were hard to ignore.
dst: “双头”行动取得了一定程度的战术成功，但在战略层面并无奇迹发生，苏军虽受震动却未被打败。他们日益庞大的兵力、新式强大的装甲战车、以及新近获得的制空权，这些因素都难以忽视。

src: Unternehmen Taifun ultimately halted at the gates of Moscow, and the subsequent Soviet counter-offensive failed any hope for a fast German victory. Axis forces were thrown back, and the lines held only so-so; many units were trapped in cauldron and pockets.
dst: “台风”行动最终止步于莫斯科城下，随后的苏军反攻粉碎了德军速胜的希望。轴心国部队被击退，战线仅勉强维持；许多部队被困于合围圈和包围圈中。

src: Unternehmen Zitadelle didn't achieve a decisive victory, quite the contrary: the offensive was called off after it bogged down. Germans suffered heavy losses and Soviets gained a strategic initiative.
dst: “堡垒”行动未能取得决定性胜利，恰恰相反：攻势陷入僵局后被叫停。德军损失惨重，苏军掌握了战略主动权。

src: Until that happens, I'd like you to stay here, taking care of the guerrillas, but there are different orders for you. You must go with a small contingent of troops to China, where the anti-western movement has grown increasingly violent. We must send some soldiers to protect the Americans who live there, as well as their possessions.
dst: 在那之前，我本希望您留在这里对付游击队，但对您另有安排。您必须带领一支小分队前往中国，那里的排外运动日益暴力。我们必须派些士兵去保护那里的美国侨民及其财产。

src: Until we finally entered Kazan, I didn't fully understand the brilliance of Kappel's strategy. With just a handful of soldiers, we had inflicted the Bolsheviks thousands of casualties, mostly prisoners. But that was only a minimal part of the uncountable effects of our victory: To begin with, all the staff and the cadets od the Kazan Military Academy joined our side. The workers of the factories at Izhevsk and Votkinsk raised against the Reds, too, although they foolishly refused to join us, and were finally crushed. We also found huge warehouses full with weapons, ammunition and medicines, and the most incredible of all, we seized most of the Imperial gold reserves of Russia: 650 million rubles in gold coins and 100 million rubles in gold bars, platinum and other valuables. We could survive for many months thanks to all those resources.
dst: 直到我们终于进入喀山，我才完全领会卡佩尔战略的高明。仅凭一小撮士兵，我们就给布尔什维克造成了数千人的伤亡，其中大部分是俘虏。但这只是我们胜利无数影响中极小的一部分：首先，喀山军事学院的所有教职员工和学员都加入了我们。伊热夫斯克和沃特金斯克工厂的工人也起来反抗红军，尽管他们愚蠢地拒绝与我们合并，最终被镇压。我们还找到了堆满武器、弹药和药品的巨大仓库，而最令人难以置信的是，我们缴获了俄国帝国黄金储备的大部分：6.5亿卢布的金币和1亿卢布的金条、铂金及其他贵重物品。依靠这些资源，我们得以维持了好几个月。

src: VI.--There were in all two routes by which they could go forth from their country--one through the Sequani, narrow and difficult, between Mount Jura and the river Rhone (by which scarcely one waggon at a time could be led; there was, moreover, a very high mountain overhanging, so that a very few might easily intercept them); the other, through our Province, much easier and freer from obstacles, because the Rhone flows between the boundaries of the Helvetii and those of the Allobroges, who had lately been subdued, and is in some places crossed by a ford.
dst: VI.--他们从本土外出的路线共有两条——一条穿过塞夸尼人地界，狭窄难行，位于侏罗山与罗讷河之间（一次几乎只能通过一辆大车；而且还有一座极高的山悬临其上，极少数人便能轻易截住他们）；另一条穿过我们的行省，好走得多、障碍也少，因为罗讷河在赫尔维蒂人与阿洛布罗格斯人的地界之间流过——后者新近才被征服——且有些地方可以涉水而过。

src: Varian read the list "but Your Fuhress,this is hardly any of the names I gave You"."Watch Your tone there Amerikan" Ilse's adjuntant stated "Your speaking to the Fuhress". "That's the best I can do for You Amerikan,You and Your Jewish entourage.We got a War going on.I can send them all back to the Resettlement areas in the Ghetto's if You choose".Varian on a Mission sponsored by Miss Roosevelt to save the Culture of the Jews talked with His little group,there was nothing more that could be done.Varian didn't see it but the Jews by Him saw it.They were in the presence of someone who had orchestrated the Deaths of thousands of Jews if not Millions.The deal was made, 1.2 million for lives.The SS loaded the mass of People on the 4 Amerikan cruise liners.For these People the Horror of the SS was over,they would be taken back to Amerika.The ships loaded they began to pull out from the Docks.The Fuhress stood there.Varian and the American Jewish Council watched from aboard the ship the funds in the suitcases on the Dock that had just bought lives.A SS Frau doused the suitcases with Gas and threw a match.Ilse walked back to Her car."Your so Dam Cruel Ilse" Frau Lohr told Her.A smile came across the face of the Fuhress "Yes I know.I have to deal with stupid People as Amerikans. It is a Necessity.They think their saving the Scum of this World,their just postponing It's Eradication for a later date.It is inevitable some will cease to be when Germania arrives".
dst: 瓦里安看着名单："可是女元首，这几乎不是我给您的名单上的人。""注意你的口气，美国人。"伊尔泽的副官说，"你是在跟女元首说话。""美国人，我能为你做的就这么多，你和你那帮犹太人随从。我们正在打仗。要是你愿意，我可以把他们全都送回犹太隔离区的'安置点'去。"瓦里安受罗斯福小姐资助、前来抢救犹太文化，他和他的小团体商议后，已无能为力。瓦里安没看出来，但跟着他的犹太人看出来了：他们面对的这个人，曾策划了成千上万、甚至数以百万计犹太人的死亡。交易达成：120万买命。党卫军把大批人装上那4艘美国客轮。对这些人来说，党卫军的恐怖结束了——他们将被带回美国。船装满了人，开始驶离码头。女元首站在那里。瓦里安和美国犹太委员会从船上望着码头上那些刚买下人命的手提箱。一名党卫军"女士"把汽油浇在手提箱上，扔下一根火柴。伊尔泽走回她的车。"你真是太残忍了，伊尔泽。"洛尔女士对她说。女元首脸上浮现一丝微笑："是的，我知道。我得应付像美国人这样愚蠢的人。这是必需之举。他们以为自己在拯救这世上的渣滓，其实只是把对它的清除推迟到日后。当'日耳曼尼亚'到来时，其中一些人终将不复存在，这是不可避免的。"

src: Varinius is going to follow you to the back of the Moon. Bring this to an End. He stays together with his troops in Front of you at Picentia.
dst: 瓦里尼乌斯会一直追你到月亮背面。做个了结吧。他与他的部队就驻在你前方的皮琴蒂亚。

src: Varinius started persecution immediately after he had "conquered" Spartacus´ vacated camp. On Spartacus way lay several cities, including Nuceria that he captured and reinforced his army with the freed slaves. Varinius pursued him, but could not prevent the loss of Nuceria.
dst: 瓦里尼乌斯「攻下」斯巴达克斯弃守的营地后，立即开始追击。斯巴达克斯所经之路上有好几座城市，其中包括努凯里亚——他攻下该城，并用获释的奴隶充实了军队。瓦里尼乌斯紧追不舍，却无法阻止努凯里亚的失守。

src: Varinius was finally beaten by Spartacus and his Troops, his army was nearly exterminated. In this Scenario at Picentia, where exact I din`t know. Picentia was conquered by Spartacus without a doubt.
dst: 瓦里尼乌斯最终被斯巴达克斯及其部队击败，其军队几乎被全歼。本场景设在皮琴蒂亚，具体地点我不清楚。皮琴蒂亚无疑是被斯巴达克斯攻下的。

src: Varinius you have tricked excellent. Now Nuceria lies ahead of you, but i don´t think he will let you flee without further ado. So be on your guard !
dst: 瓦里尼乌斯，你把他骗得好惨。如今努凯里亚就在你前方，但我想他不会就这么放你逃走。所以务必提高警惕！

src: Vercingetorix could escape from us, and has withdrawn to Gergovia.... we must follow him fast....
dst: 维钦托利得以从我们手中逃脱，已退往热尔戈维亚...... 我们必须迅速追击......

src: Vercingetorix couldn`t manage to escape from Alesia .... He gave the supreme command over the entire Gallic relief army to you!
dst: 维钦托利没能从阿莱西亚脱身 .... 他把整支高卢解围大军的最高指挥权交给了你！

src: Vercingetorix has to remain in Gaul for strategic reasons, in order to bring some isolated fools, still loyal to Rome, to their senses, and to take care on all the small uprisings.
dst: 出于战略考虑，维钦托利必须留在高卢，去收拾那些仍忠于罗马的孤立蠢货，并照看各地的小股叛乱。

src: Vercingetorix is a brilliant commander-in-chief: instead of leading us into grueling open field battles, whose outcome would be rather uncertain, and which would weaken us substantially; We destroy the Roman supply routes and burn all the grain that we can not bring to safety ....
dst: 维钦托利是位杰出的统帅：他不把我们带进胜负难料、且会大伤元气的旷野会战，而是破坏罗马人的补给线，烧掉一切来不及运走的粮食 ....

src: Vercingetorix is king of the kings of all tribes!
dst: 维钦托利已是万族之王！

src: Vercingetorix orders an advance into the heart of the enemy: We will cross the Alps with all our men and advance straight to Rome ..... All the enemies foolish enough to stand in our way, will be destroyed ....
dst: 维钦托利下令向敌人心脏进军：我们将带全部人马翻越阿尔卑斯山，直取罗马 ..... 所有胆敢挡路的敌人，都将被消灭 ....

src: Vercingetorix takes care of central Gaul. He expects that we will recapture our tribal territory as soon as possible, and be ready for a revenge campaign into the heart of the enemy next summer ....
dst: 维钦托利负责高卢中部。他希望我们尽快夺回部族领地，并准备好明年夏天向敌人心脏地带发起复仇之战 ....

src: Very Good! We're still advancing with great determination, your strategy showed that you're unstoppable !
dst: 非常好！我们仍以极大的决心推进，您的策略表明您势不可挡！

src: Very Good! You've demonstrated clearly your superiority, now it's time to advance towards Algeria.
dst: 非常好！您已清楚地证明了自身的优势，现在是向阿尔及利亚推进的时候了。

src: Very good work, Herr General.  The Allies have been thrown out of Tunesia and are reeling in disarray.  This gives us the opportunity to force the Allies to evacuate Northwest Afrika.  This critical assigment is yours.
dst: 干得漂亮，将军阁下。盟军已被赶出突尼斯，正陷入一片混乱。这给了我们迫使盟军撤离北非的机会。这项关键任务属于你。

src: Very good work, Herr General. You have stopped the Bolsheviks and totally defeated them! We did not have any idea about those big tanks. Hopefully, they do not have many of them...
dst: 干得非常好，将军阁下。你挡住了布尔什维克，并将他们彻底击败！我们对那些巨型坦克毫无所知。但愿他们没有太多这种坦克……

src: Very good! After your success we could capture whole Germany in a few months.
dst: 非常好！在你的胜利之后，我们能在几个月内夺取整个德国。

src: Very good! After your success we could capture whole Germany in a few months. For the German troops the war is over. They have surrendered to our troops.
dst: 很好！在你的胜利之后，我们能在几个月内夺取整个德国。对德军来说，战争已经结束。他们已向我们的部队投降。

src: Very good! Despite the fact the Americans have managed to force their way inland at St. Laurent and St. Martin de Varreville, you have taught the Allies a harsh lesson.  But the war is far from over.  You should get some rest, we will have need of your talents again.
dst: 很好！尽管美军已在圣洛朗和圣马丹-德瓦尔维尔强行向内陆推进，你还是给盟军上了一课。但战争远未结束。你该休息一下，我们还会需要你的才能。

src: Very good! Despite the fact the enemy has managed to force their way inland at other points, you have swept all before you. And because of this blow you have dealt them, the Allies will not be able to take advantage of their successes elsewhere. You have done very well, Herr General.
dst: 非常好！尽管敌人在其他地点已强行突入内陆，你却将当面之敌横扫一空。由于你给予他们的这记重击，盟军将无法利用其在别处的战果。你干得非常出色，将军阁下。

src: Very good! The german offensive was a total failure. They could not gain territority and might have lost the possibility for huge counterattacks at all.
dst: 非常好！德军的进攻彻底失败。他们未能夺得任何领土，而且可能已完全失去了发动大规模反攻的可能。

src: Very good! You were able to capture the Ludendorff Bridge and established a bridgehead on the eastern shore of the Rhine. Our next target will be the Ruhr Area.
dst: 很好！你成功夺取了鲁登道夫桥，并在莱茵河东岸建立了桥头堡。我们的下一个目标将是鲁尔区。

src: Very good! You were able to save all airfields and the germans lost most of their fighters.
dst: 非常好！你成功保住了所有机场，而德国人损失了大部分战斗机。

src: Very good!!!. The British navy has been defeated and our objetives achieved without any problem.
dst: 非常好！！！英国海军已被击败，我们的目标毫无困难地达成了。

src: Very good, General. You managed to secure Crete and the action has been rated a total success. One consequence of Operation Marita - the invasion of Yugoslavia and Greece - has been that Romania, Hungary and Bulgaria are now our firm allies. They will be very useful when we embark upon our primary goal - the invasion of the Soviet Union.
dst: 很好，将军。你成功拿下了克里特，此役被评为完全成功。“马里塔”行动——入侵南斯拉夫和希腊——的成果之一，是罗马尼亚、匈牙利和保加利亚如今成了我们坚定的盟友。待我们着手首要目标——入侵苏联——时，他们将大有用处。

src: Very good, the Germans have suffered heavy losses. Now there is no danger for Moscow anyway. Also we have bind troops that the Germans could have needed for their offensive in the south.
dst: 非常好，德军遭受了惨重损失。现在莫斯科无论如何都没有危险了。我们还牵制住了德军本可用于南方攻势的部队。

src: Very good, the troops in the pocket was exterminated before the Kampfgruppe Seydlitz could save them.
dst: 非常好，口袋中的部队在塞德利茨战斗群能救出他们之前就被歼灭了。

src: Very good. After your victory, it seems that the finish government has to accept a peace dictate.
dst: 非常好。在你取得胜利之后，看来芬兰政府不得不接受一份和平通牒。

src: Very good. Now the distance between Stalingrad and the German front line is very high. The 6. Army in Stalingrad is doomed to extinction.
dst: 很好。如今斯大林格勒与德军前线的距离已经很大。斯大林格勒的第6集团军注定覆灭。

src: Very good. Now the distance between Stalingrad and the German front line is very high. The 6. Army in Stalingrad is doomed to extinction..
dst: 很好。如今斯大林格勒与德军前线之间的距离非常大。斯大林格勒的第6集团军注定要被消灭……

src: Very good. Now the first german big city is in our hands. Also the germans have lost several divisions and their fighting morale is lowered.
dst: 非常好。如今第一座德国大城市已在我们手中。此外德军已损失数个师，其战斗士气也已降低。

src: Very good. Now the way to Vienna is open. Moreover the germans had to stop their offensive at the Lake Balaton.
dst: 非常好。现在通往维也纳的道路已经打开。此外，德军不得不停止他们在巴拉顿湖的攻势。

src: Very good. The Axis have suffered heavy losses and your victory opened a way to Lwow. The next way will be an attack on Romania.
dst: 非常好。轴心国损失惨重，你的胜利打开了通往利沃夫的道路。下一步将是对罗马尼亚发起进攻。

src: Very good. The allied troops are destroyed and with Emden and Wilhelmshaven the allieds have lost two harbours in which they can land new troops.
dst: 很好。盟军部队已被歼灭，随着埃姆登和威廉港失守，盟军失去了两个可以登陆新部队的港口。

src: Very good. The axis have suffered heavy losses and no troops could be evacuated. While your offensive we could push forward in the Ukraine. Your men need a break. I am sure they will be needed in the near future.
dst: 很好。轴心国损失惨重，没有部队能够撤离。在你发动攻势期间，我们得以在乌克兰向前推进。你的部下需要休息。我相信不久的将来还会需要他们。

src: Very good. The axis in Stalingrad are now encircled and the Germans and their allied troops suffered heavy losses. Now a relief attack to break up the Stalingrad pocket is almost impossible.
dst: 很好。斯大林格勒的轴心国部队现在已被包围，德军及其盟军部队损失惨重。现在要发动解围进攻、打破斯大林格勒包围圈几乎已不可能。

src: Very good. The courland pocket is eliminated. You we can free troops for the Battle of Berlin. The end of the war is near. We will not sacrifice further men of you against the fanatic Nazis. But we have recognized with the west allied that we will attack Japan in the summer. Prepare your troops for this mission.
dst: 很好。库尔兰包围圈已被肃清。我们现在可以为柏林战役腾出部队了。战争即将结束。我们不会让你的人再去为狂热的纳粹分子作无谓牺牲。但我们已与西方盟国商定，将于夏季进攻日本。为这一任务准备好你的部队。

src: Very good. The great German offensive was stopped before it really could begin.
dst: 非常好。德军的这场大规模攻势在真正开始之前就被遏止了。

src: Very good. This is the end of the war! Hitler is dead and the surrender of the Nazis is near. Come back home and celebrate with us.
dst: 非常好。战争结束了！希特勒已死，纳粹的投降就在眼前。回家来和我们一起庆祝吧。

src: Very good. We did make a step over the Rhine. But the Germans are not beaten and we have to be careful and first eliminate the Germans on our flanks.
dst: 非常好。我们确实跨过了莱茵河。但德国人尚未被击败，我们必须谨慎，先肃清我们两翼的德军。

src: Very good. We freed Riga. The Germans have withdrawn to Courland and are trapped there.
dst: 很好。我们解放了里加。德军已撤退到库尔兰，并被围困在那里。

src: Very good. We have gained a lot of territory and destroyed several German troops. In the next month we planned offensives in the north and in the south. We will inform you, when your troops have to be ready.
dst: 很好。我们获得了大片领土并歼灭了若干德军部队。下个月我们计划在北部和南部发动攻势。当你的部队需要准备就绪时，我们会通知你。

src: Very good. You could break through the German lines and destroy the 8th Army. Now the way to Prague is open.
dst: 很好。你得以突破德军防线并歼灭第8集团军。如今通往布拉格的道路已经敞开。

src: Very good. You cut through the Russian troops so fast that it was almost unbelievable. We are now ready to assault the new Russian capital and make an end to this war once and for all!
dst: 很好。你如此神速地击穿俄军，简直令人难以置信。我们现在已准备好进攻俄国新首都，一劳永逸地结束这场战争！

src: Very good. You defeated the Nazis before they can withdraw their troops.
dst: 非常好。你在纳粹分子能够撤走部队之前就击败了他们。

src: Very good. Your troops could break through the allied lines and they must retreat because of their losses.
dst: 很好。你的部队得以突破盟军防线，他们因损失惨重不得不撤退。

src: Very impressive commander!  Despite the odds being stacked against you, you managed to hold the Italians off.  However, due to the very serious danger of encirclement posed by other Italian units on our flanks, the order to evacuate Somaliland has been given.  We'll regroup, drink some tea, and then come back later to give the fascists a bloody good licking!
dst: 太了不起了，指挥官！尽管形势对你不利，你还是设法挡住了意大利人。然而，由于两翼其他意军部队构成了严重的合围威胁，撤出索马里兰的命令已经下达。我们会重整旗鼓、喝点茶，然后再回来把法西斯分子狠狠教训一顿！

src: Very very Great Battle against the last soviet units, but the Red army will fight to the finish and she has very many forces, failing weather on it's side, with determined effort and well armed... a Heavy battle.
dst: 与苏军残部的一场空前血战，但红军将战斗到底，其兵力雄厚、占据天时（天气不利我方），装备精良、斗志昂扬……一场恶战。

src: Very well done!  You have exceeded the General Staff's hopes!  Your drive through the Herangsfjord has broken enemy resistance. And, because of your bold attack, the Norwegian government has sued for peace.  Congratulations!
dst: 干得漂亮！您超出了总参谋部的期望！您穿越海尔扬斯峡湾的推进已粉碎敌军抵抗。而且，由于您的果敢进攻，挪威政府已请求和平。祝贺您！

src: Very well done!  You have exceeded the General Staff's hopes!  Your drive through the Lillehammer Valley has broken enemy resistance. And, because of your bold attack, the Norwegian government has sued for peace.  Congratulations!
dst: 干得非常好！你超出了总参谋部的期望！你穿过利勒哈默尔山谷的推进粉碎了敌军抵抗。而且，由于你的果敢进攻，挪威政府已求和。恭喜！

src: Very well done!  You have have a date in Berlin.  The Fuehrer himself wishes to congratulate you.  Despite the fact the Americans have managed to force their way inland at St. Laurent and St. Martin de Varreville, you have bought our forces some valuable time to prepare for what will become a long and hard campaign.  We will make sure the Allies pay in blood for every inch of ground they move forward.
dst: 干得好！你在柏林有个约会。元首本人要亲自祝贺你。尽管美军已在圣洛朗和圣马丹-德瓦尔维尔强行向内陆推进，但你为我军争取到了宝贵的时间，为即将到来的漫长而艰苦的战役做准备。我们定会让盟军每前进一步都付出血的代价。

src: Very well done, Général. The units under your command have secured the British left flank. Now it's up to them to break through the German forces.

src: Victory conditions: Together with our Latvian allies liberate Dyneburg - take all VHs.
dst: 胜利条件：与我们的拉脱维亚盟友一同解放迪纳堡——夺取所有胜利点。

src: Victory conditions: Together with our Latvian allies liberate Dyneburg - take all VHs. Keep both units alive.
dst: 胜利条件：与我们的拉脱维亚盟友一同解放迪纳堡——夺取所有胜利点。让两个单位都存活。

src: Victory conditions: You are outnumbered.  Your units must cover the retreat since part of your units are auxiliary Ruga-Ruga tribesmen with little military valor in battles against a modern army.
dst: 胜利条件：您在兵力上处于劣势。您的部队必须掩护撤退，因为您的部分部队是辅助性的鲁加-鲁加部族战士，在与现代化军队作战时军事价值不大。

src: Victory conditions: You must exit 4 units from Kasama without losing the civilians.
dst: 胜利条件：您必须在不损失平民的情况下让4个单位从卡萨马撤出。

src: Victory conditions: You must retreat a total of 25 Spanish units.
dst: 胜利条件：您必须总共撤出25个西班牙单位。

src: Victory conditions: destroy the bridge over the river.
dst: 胜利条件：摧毁河上的桥梁。

dst: 胜利条件：守住3个胜利格为决定性胜利，2个为胜利，1个为战术胜利

src: Victory conditions: retreat 24 units, hold the two VH and ensure that the army depot survive.
