dst: 胜利条件：在第18回合前夺取所有胜利点获得大捷，第20回合为胜利，第22回合为小捷。

src: Victory conditions: to take all VHs by turn 10 for a BV, turn 12 for a V or turn 14 for a TV. Alternatively, to kill Maceo (MSU) by the same turns.
dst: 胜利条件：在第10回合前夺取所有胜利点获得大捷，第12回合为胜利，第14回合为小捷。或者，在相同回合数内消灭马塞奥（主力单位）。

src: Victory conditions: to take all VHs by turn 10 for a BV, turn 14 for a V and turn 16 for a TV.
dst: 胜利条件：在第10回合前夺取所有胜利点获得大捷，第14回合为胜利，第16回合为小捷。

src: Victory conditions: to take the VH before turn 8 for a BV, 10 for a V and 12 for a TV.
dst: 胜利条件：第8回合前夺取胜利格为决定性胜利，第10回合前为胜利，第12回合前为战术胜利。

src: Victory conditions: withdraw 50 units for TV (BV and V are not possible).
dst: 胜利条件：撤出50支部队为战术胜利（不可能取得决定性胜利和胜利）。

src: Victory objectives: Capture the enemy VH.
dst: 胜利目标：夺取敌军胜利格。

src: Victory shines brightly today, Herr Feldmarschall! Your forces demonstrated unmatched resilience and tactical brilliance in the colossal tank battle of Petersburg. Against overwhelming odds, you pushed forward and secured a decisive win. This triumph reflects the unwavering spirit of your troops. Onward to future victories!
dst: 今日胜利之光格外耀眼，元帅阁下！在彼得斯堡那场规模空前的坦克会战中，你的部队展现了无可比拟的韧性与战术才华。面对压倒性的劣势，你们奋勇推进，取得了决定性的胜利。这场胜利体现了你部队坚定不移的精神。向着未来的胜利前进！

src: Victory!   We have crossed that damned bridge and many comrades have died, but their lives were not lost, they have contributed to the success of our retreat to save the Revolution.  Congratulations for your actions.
dst: 胜利！我们已跨过那座该死的桥，许多同志牺牲了，但他们的生命没有白费，他们为我们撤退以挽救革命的胜利作出了贡献。祝贺你的行动。

src: Victory! Liberal troops are fleeing in disarray and the republican government, knowing that our troops march into Madrid from several directions, has capitulated. Within a few days Carlos VII will be proclaimed the legitimate King of Spain.
dst: 胜利！自由派军队正狼狈溃逃，共和政府得知我军从多个方向进军马德里后，已经投降。数日之内，卡洛斯七世将被拥立为西班牙合法国王。

src: Victory! Riga is ours, and the infiltration tactics have allowed us to achieve our goals with very few losses and without destroying most of the city. Apart from some units including the Latvian riflemen, who have fought valiantly, most of the Russian 12th Army has fled the battlefield. After so many years of war the Russian soldiers have lost their combative spirit and they refuse to fight against us. Soon Kerenski will have to accept our peace terms and, if he doesn't, he'll be ousted from power. In any case the war with Russia will soon be over.
dst: 胜利！里加归我们了，渗透战术使我们以极少的损失达成了目标，且未摧毁大部分城区。除了一些包括拉脱维亚步兵在内的英勇作战的部队，俄军第12集团军大部分已逃离战场。经过这么多年的战争，俄军士兵已丧失斗志，拒绝与我们作战。克伦斯基很快就得接受我们的和谈条件，否则就会被赶下台。无论如何，对俄战争很快就会结束。

src: Victory! The liberals have come up against our defenses and they are retreating southwards. They have also lost General Concha, who was killed by one of our shots. Although an  enemy, he was a capable and courageous man. We will pray for him.
dst: 胜利！自由派撞上了我们的防线，正向南撤退。他们也失去了孔查将军，他被我方一枪击毙。虽然是敌人，他却是一位能干而勇敢的人。我们会为他祈祷。

src: Victory! The surviving Greeks are leaving their positions, deserting and running for their lives, trying to get to Izmir and return to their country. Before this year ends, all the foreign invaders will be expelled from Turkey, and after four years we'll finally have, again, a nation of our own.
dst: 胜利了！幸存的希腊人正在撤离阵地，开小差、逃命，试图赶到伊兹密尔返回自己的国家。在今年结束之前，所有外国侵略者都将被赶出土耳其，而在四年之后，我们终将再次拥有一个属于我们自己的国家。

src: Victory! The war is over! Knowing that their Empire could be at risk, the British government has accepted our proposal for a Peace With Honour.
dst: 胜利！战争结束了！英国政府深知其帝国可能陷入险境，已接受了我们「光荣和平」的提议。

src: Victory! Zaragoza is our hands, and the path to Burgos is open! Good work.
dst: 胜利！萨拉戈萨已在我们手中，通往布尔戈斯的道路已经打开！干得好。

src: Victory!, the plan has worked, and the rebel positions around Catalunya have fallen!. Now we can attack Aragon and its capital, Zaragoza, again! The path to the victory is opened finally, thanks to the brave soldiers of the Republic and you!
dst: 胜利！计划奏效了，加泰罗尼亚周边的叛军阵地已经陷落！现在我们能再次进攻阿拉贡及其首府萨拉戈萨了！多亏共和国勇敢的士兵和您，通往胜利的道路终于打开了！

src: Victory: East Prussia.  You will take part in the battles of the 1st Army as you attempt to invade East Prussia with the aim of capturing Koenigsberg and opening the way into Germany.  The front-line troops have been mobilized more rapidly than anticipated by the enemy, and the Russian Steamroller can be unleashed to honor our alliance with France.
dst: 胜利：东普鲁士。您将参加第1集团军的各场战斗，试图入侵东普鲁士，目的是攻占柯尼斯堡、打开通往德国的道路。前线部队的动员速度超出了敌人的预料，俄罗斯压路机可以开动起来，履行我们对法国的盟约。
胜利条件：夺取所有胜利点。

src: Victory: Taking a Victory here will lead your corps into the South-Western Front for Galician operations.  The Winter Battle of the Carpathians has already begun, and your corps will join this action as soon as possible.
dst: 胜利：在此达成胜利，将带领您的军前往西南战线参加加利西亚作战。喀尔巴阡冬季战役已经开始，您的军将尽快投入这一行动。
维也纳 1945年4月 辉煌胜利
维也纳 1945年4月 战术胜利

src: Vienna fell to the Russians and your division ends it glorious history is Bolshevik captivity. I am sure your troops wished they escaped to the west to seek refuge with our former enemies - the Western Allies.
dst: 维也纳落入俄国人之手，你的师在布尔什维克的战俘营中结束其光荣历史。我相信你的部队宁愿当初西撤，投奔我们昔日的敌人——西方盟国——寻求庇护。

src: Vienna fell to the Russians and your division ends it glorious history is Bolshevik captivity. I am sure your troops wished they escaped to the west to surrender to the Americans.
dst: 维也纳落入俄国人之手，你的师在布尔什维克的战俘营中结束其光荣历史。我相信你的部队宁愿当初西撤，向美国人投降。

src: Vienna fell to the Russians. The Der Fuehrer regiment was sent to Prague for a (successful) rescue mission of the entrapped garrison forces, the Deutschland regiment clashed with American forces near St Poelten Austria and the rest of the division was sent to Dresden.
dst: 维也纳落入俄国人之手。“元首”团被派往布拉格执行解救被困守军（并获成功）的任务，“德意志”团在奥地利圣珀尔滕附近与美军交火，师里其余部队则被派往德累斯顿。

src: View from the turret of a Panther Ausf. D.
dst: 从一辆Panther Ausf. D的炮塔上望去的景象。

src: Villa and many of his men have escaped. Never mind. I don't know if we'll ever be so close to get him again, but at the very least we'll force him to run and hide. Carranza will consolidate his power knowing that Villa won't be an important threat anymore.
dst: 比利亚和他的许多手下逃脱了。没关系。我不知道我们是否还能如此接近地抓到他，但至少我们会逼得他东躲西藏。卡兰萨将巩固其权力，因为他知道比利亚不会再构成重大威胁。

src: Villa was crazy enough to attack Columbus, in New Mexico, three weeks ago. He was searching for weapons and ammunition. So, naturally, Wilson ordered a punitive expedition, and that's why we're here now. Pretty incredible, I tell you.
dst: 三周前，比利亚竟胆大包天地袭击了新墨西哥州的哥伦布。他是在搜寻武器和弹药。于是，威尔逊自然下令发动惩罚性远征，这就是我们如今在这里的原因。我跟您说，简直难以置信。

src: Vitebsk is secured by strong fortifications and the IX. Army Corps. Further south the VI. Army Corps hold the positions. The Germans have some good tanks and tank killers like Tiger II tanks and a division of Elefants. It could be a good idea to deploy your best troops in the south and push there forward and the rest can concentrate on Vitebsk.
dst: 维捷布斯克由坚固的防御工事和第IX军防守。再往南，第VI军据守阵地。德军有一些优秀的坦克和坦克杀手，如"虎王"坦克和一个"象式"歼击车师。把你的精锐部队部署到南面并向那里推进，其余部队则集中攻打维捷布斯克，这可能是个好主意。

src: Vitellius defeated Otho finally in the year 69 at the First Battle of Begriacum, near todays Cremona, but his claim to the throne was soon challenged by legions stationed in the eastern provinces, who proclaimed their commander Vespasian emperor instead. War ensued, leading to a crushing defeat for Vitellius at the Second Battle of Bedriacum.
dst: 维特里乌斯最终于公元69年在第一次贝德里亚库姆会战（地点在今克雷莫纳附近）击败奥托，但他的帝位主张很快受到驻扎东部诸行省军团的挑战，那些军团拥立其统帅韦斯帕芗为帝。战事随之而来，维特里乌斯在第二次贝德里亚库姆会战中惨败。

src: Vitellius' troops under commanders Fabius Fabullus (Legate of the Fifth Legion) and Cassius Longus (Camp Prefect) consist of seven legions, but mostly not at full strength, vexillations of the three Britannic Legions and auxilia from the Germanic and Britannic provinces.
dst: 维特里乌斯的部队由法比乌斯法布卢斯（第五军团副将）与卡西乌斯隆古斯（营地长官）指挥，辖七个军团（但大多不满编）、不列颠三个军团的抽调支队，以及日耳曼与不列颠诸行省的辅助部队。

src: Vizcaya, 1937. Finalmente, el general Mola se decide a atacar Bilbao, la última capital vasca que aún no ha caído en manos de los nacionales. Las milicias vascas y republicanas resistirán fuertemente el ataque rebelde tratando de rodear y tomar Bilbao.

src: Von Beseler's forces are again facing us and will without a doubt try to cross the Yzer and reach Dunkirk and Calais, cutting of the BEF's supply lines. It is your task to stop them.

src: Von Falkenhayn has decided that for Germany to win the war, France has to be bled dry. This has to be achieved by threatening to capture the city of Verdun - a national French symbol. The French will throw in all forces at their disposal to prevent the city from falling into our hands. Our artillery gets the task to destroy the masses of counterattacking French infantry.
dst: 冯·法尔肯海因断定，德国若要赢得这场战争，就必须让法国流尽鲜血。要做到这一点，就得威胁攻占凡尔登城——这座法国的国家象征。法国人将会投入他们所有的力量来阻止这座城市落入我们手中。我们的炮兵的任务就是摧毁成群反扑的法军步兵。

src: Von Gagen wants unconditional surrender which we never will accept.
dst: 冯·加根要求无条件投降，这我们永远不会接受。

src: Von Hötzendorf has ordered a counteroffensive of our 3rd and 4th armies all along the front line. This will be our last chance to defend Krakau. If we succeed, the city will be safe at last, and we could even have a chance to relieve the siege of Premissel.
dst: 冯·赫岑多夫已命令我们的第3、第4集团军沿整条战线发动反攻。这将是我们保卫克拉科夫的最后机会。倘若成功，这座城市终将安全，我们甚至有机会解普热梅希尔之围。

src: Von Kluck has sent the bulk of the First Armee SE in pursuit of the French Fifth Armee - ignoring the city of Paris and the new French Sixth Armee defending it.  Our 4th Kavallerie Division and IV Reserve Korps are now the sole units covering the flank of our offensive into France.
dst: 冯·克卢克已派第1集团军主力向东南追击法军第5集团军——而置巴黎城及防守巴黎的新编法军第6集团军于不顾。我第4骑兵师和第4预备军如今是掩护我军攻入法国之侧翼的唯一部队。

src: Von Kluck has sent the bulk of the First Armee SE in pursuit of the French Fifth Armee and the BEF - ignoring the city of Paris and the new French Sixth Armee defending it.  Our 4th Kavallerie Division and the IV Reserve Korps are now the sole units covering the flank of the offensive into France.
dst: 冯·克卢克已派遣第1集团军主力向东南追击法军第5集团军和英国远征军——无视巴黎城及其防守巴黎的新编法军第6集团军。我方第4骑兵师和第4预备军如今是掩护挺进法国攻势侧翼的唯一部队。

src: Von Lettow never suffered a decisive defeat, an didn't surrender until november 1918, when he learnt of the armistice that had been signed at Compiègne.
dst: 冯·莱托从未遭受过决定性失败，直到1918年11月得知贡比涅停战协定签署后才投降。

src: Von Lettow-Vorbeck returned to Germany in March 1919 and received a hero's welcome. He led some of his troops on a victory parade through the Brandenburg Gate which was decorated in their honor.
dst: 冯·莱托-福尔贝克于1919年3月返回德国，受到了英雄般的欢迎。他率领部分部队穿过为纪念他们而装饰一新的勃兰登堡门，举行了胜利游行。
Von Lieberman 支队机枪 Sec.

src: Wacht am Rhein is our best chance to seize the initiative and force the Western Allies to make peace with us. It is essential that you capture all of your objectives by December 31st, or the Allies will be able to move overwhelming forces into the Ardennes to stop our offensive. Brussels is your ultimate objective, but capturing and holding a minimum of four objectives by December 31st could also affect the war favorably.
dst: 莱茵守望行动是我们夺取先手、迫使西线盟军与我方媾和的最佳机会。你必须在 12月31日前夺取全部目标，否则盟军将能调集压倒性兵力进入阿登，阻止我们的攻势。布鲁塞尔是你的最终目标，但若能在 12月31日前夺取并守住至少四个目标，也可能使战局朝有利方向发展。

src: Wait Herr General, we just received radio transmissions, it seems the enemy is about to attack our positions west of El Alamain on a broad front in this moment. Leave now, act quick!
dst: 等等，将军阁下，我们刚收到无线电通讯，看来敌人此刻正要从阿拉曼以西向我军阵地发起宽正面进攻。立刻出发，行动要快！

src: Wait a minute Kapitan. A big comvoy with many ships will arrive soon from south with many merchant ships. Make sure they will not escape.
dst: 等一下，海军上校。一支由众多舰船组成的大型船团很快将从南方驶来，载有大量商船。务必别让它们跑掉。

src: Wait a minute, an old Carrier with a proto fighter will be under your command.
dst: 等一下，一艘配备原型战斗机的老旧航母将归你指挥。

src: Wait a minute, our intelligence reports that there is a 70 Km range Radar at Kirkwall. Keep your ships away!!!!
dst: 等一下，我们的情报报告说柯克沃尔有一部射程70公里的雷达。让你的舰船远离！！

src: Wait a moment, by decision of the Admiral it is an opportunity to test in battle the new equipment that the Kustenjaeger will have. A unit has been sent from Germany under your command.
dst: 等一下，经海军上将决定，这是一个在实战中检验海岸猎兵将装备的新装备的机会。一支部队已从德国派出，归您指挥。

src: Wait, we have a report that the British are helping the Belgians install a railgun to shell our troops, so be careful.
dst: 等等，有报告称英国人正帮比利时人架设一门列车炮来轰击我军，务必小心。

src: Wait, we just receive a message that British marines are also operating, the situation gets even more difficult.
dst: 等等，我们刚收到一条消息，英国海军陆战队也在行动，局势变得更加艰难了。

src: Wan Shan!  Did you see how the capitalists are escaping from us??   Pyongyang is again a communist stronghold, and we must continue to pursue and annihilate the UN forces.
dst: 万岁！你看到资本主义者是怎样从我们面前逃跑的吗？？平壤再次成为共产主义据点，我们必须继续追击并歼灭联合国军。

src: Wan Shan!  We have saved a lot of our men from the Kuomingtan onslaught.  We must hope to counterstrike the dirty nationalists as soon as we receive some Soviet aid through Manchuria.
dst: 万岁！我们已从国民党的猛攻中救出了许多人员。我们必须寄望于一旦通过满洲获得一些苏联援助，就立即反击那些肮脏的国民政府军。

src: Wan shan!  All the mission objectives were achieved before the Japanese could send reinforcements to this area.  Now your task is to hide your guerrillas and wait for new orders.
dst: 万岁！在日军能向这一地区派出增援之前，所有任务目标都已达成。现在你的任务是隐藏你的游击队，等待新的命令。

src: Wan shan!  The KMT have suffered a great defeat.  I'm sure we will be celebrating our victory over Chiang Kai Shek's troops during the coming year of 1948.
dst: 万岁！国民党遭到了一场大败。我相信在即将到来的1948年，我们将庆祝对蒋介石部队的胜利。

src: War Chief! The council of Elders of our tribe has decided to send you and your men to help our allies . . . . !
dst: 军阀！我们部族的长老议事会已决定，派你和你的人去援助盟友 . . . . ！

src: War Chief! What has never happened before, has to happen now: A tribal leader must now take over the leadership of all tribes, from all Gaul ...
dst: 军阀！从未发生过的事，如今必须发生：必须有一位部族首领接过全高卢所有部族的领导权 ...

src: We all hope that they will meet up with Model's forces that have resume the attack against the North of the Kursk salient.
dst: 我们都希望他们能与已恢复对库尔斯克突出部北面进攻的莫德尔部队会师。

src: We already warned our allies some months ago but the French strategists considered the region impracticable for motorized troops (sic).
dst: 我们几个月前就警告过盟友，但法国战略家们认为该地区不适合摩托化部队通行（原文如此）。

src: We also hope to find anti-soviet elements in the population of the conquered areas or even in the enemy army units.  Our plan is to set up of an anti-soviet ''independent'' republic there, the Primurski Republic, like in the 20s.
dst: 我们还希望在所征服地区的民众乃至敌军部队中找到反苏分子。我们的计划是在那里建立一个反苏的“独立”共和国——滨海共和国，就像20年代那样。

src: We also join the great Gallic revolt! High Vercingetorix!
dst: 我们也加入这场高卢大起义！维钦托利万岁！

src: We also need to capture the eastern shore of the Volga river to prevent the Soviets from launching further attacks.
dst: 我们还必须夺取伏尔加河东岸，以阻止苏军发起更多进攻。

src: We also received orders to attack in the next hours and retake the strategic important Harper's Ferry bridges, as well as the city.
dst: 我们还接到命令，要在接下来的几个小时内发起进攻，夺回具有战略意义的哈珀斯费里桥梁以及这座城市。

src: We are afraid that we'll finally have to accept the Curzon Line as the boundary between Poland and Red Russia. But after your poor performance at the battle of the Niemen River it's the best we can get.
dst: 我们担心最终不得不接受寇松线作为波兰与红色俄国的边界。但在您于尼曼河之战中的糟糕表现之后，这已经是我们能得到的最好结果了。

src: We are at a critical time in the Mediterranean.  We must destroy the British hold on Malta to halt their punishing attacks on our line of supply to North Africa!
dst: 我们正处于地中海的关键时刻。我们必须摧毁英军对马耳他的控制，以阻止他们对我通往北非补给线的惩罚性袭击！

src: We are at the doors of the Iraqi Capital City, the main obstacle is the Arab Legion and the 10th Indian Division brought as
dst: 我们已抵达伊拉克首都城下，主要障碍是阿拉伯军团和作为增援

src: We are at the gates of Tobruk.  We must destroy the British here to secure our hold in Tunesia, and set up for future operations in Egypt.
dst: 我们已兵临托布鲁克城下。我们必须消灭这里的英军，以巩固我们对突尼斯的控制，并为日后在埃及的行动做准备。

src: We are back with 1st Panzer Army and are advancing towards Rostov.  We must now push quickly to capture the city and reach the Don river before the full onset of winter.  Taking Rostov shouldnt be too difficult, our intelligence suggests that the Russian armies in front of us are in full retreat.
dst: 我们又回到了第1装甲集团军，正向罗斯托夫推进。我们必须迅速夺取该城，并在严冬全面来临前抵达顿河。夺取罗斯托夫应当不难，情报显示我们面前的俄军正在全面撤退。

src: We are both to report to Armygruppe HQ, it was good to serve with you.........
dst: 我们俩都要去集团军群司令部报到，与你并肩作战很愉快……

src: We are closing in on two Soviet armies defending Uman.  If the 17th Army and the 6th Army can link up the Soviets will be encircled and we will have achieved a great victory.  We are still advancing along with Von Kleists armoured group.  You should watch out for Soviet counter-attacks, as they try to break out of our encirclement.
dst: 我们正逼近防守乌曼的两个苏军集团军。若第17集团军与第6集团军能够会师，苏军将被合围，我们便取得一场大捷。我们仍随冯·克莱斯特装甲集群推进。你要提防苏军反攻，因为他们会试图突围。

src: We are disappointed with your failure to take your objectives in Norway. However, due to your previous success we are willing to overlook your mistakes in Norway and give you another chance to prove you are worthy of command.
dst: 我们对你在挪威未能夺取目标感到失望。不过，鉴于你此前的功绩，我们愿意不计较你在挪威的失误，再给你一次机会，以证明你无愧于指挥之职。

src: We are expecting Turkish resistance to be light, exept at "V" beach where our troops have the task to overwhelm the garrison of the Sedd-El-Bahr fortress. Once you have secured the beaches, we will land additional troops and artillery. The French 1st Division is on its way and will join your advance up the peninsula. It is essential that you seize your objectives as quickly as possible - before the Turks are able to send reinforcements.
dst: 我们预计土耳其人的抵抗会很轻微，除了「V」滩头——那里的部队要负责压垮塞德巴赫尔要塞的守军。一旦您确保各滩头的安全，我们就会登陆更多的部队和炮兵。法国第1师正在途中，将加入您向半岛深处推进的行列。您必须尽快夺取您的目标——趁土耳其人还来不及派出援军。

src: We are facing a terrible situation, the British 8th Army is going to attack our last bastion and our scout units say that Monty has sent the 2nd NZ division through the mountains, at the same time, he is going to launch a full frontal attack against our lines.
dst: 我们面临严峻的局势，英国第8集团军将要进攻我们最后的堡垒，而我们的侦察部队称蒙蒂已把第2新西兰师派过山地，同时他将对我们的防线发动全面正面进攻。

src: We are facing the last of the German major defence lines now, the Gotic Line, in the northern part of the Apennine Mountains. Your orders are to fight your way through the enemy lines and reach the pass roads which lead through the mountains to the Po valley.
dst: 我们现在面对的是德军最后一条主要防线——位于亚平宁山脉北部的哥特防线。你的命令是奋战突破敌军防线，抵达穿越山脉通往波河谷地的各处隘口公路。

src: We are giving you the use of our latest "terror" weapons, the V2 rockets. The British are desperate and will offer extremely defensive tactics.
dst: 我们把最新式的“恐怖”武器——V2 火箭——交给你使用。英国人已走投无路，将采取极端防御战术。

src: We are in an unstoppable advance along the African coasts. Now Oran is the next Allied fortified target, your mission is to clear it as fast as you can, before our enemies can reinforce and makes us an impossible duty to perform.
dst: 我们正沿着非洲海岸势不可挡地推进。现在奥兰是盟军下一个设防目标，您的任务是在敌人得以增援并使这项任务变得不可能完成之前，尽快肃清它。

src: We are involved at the Mongol-Manchu border into a fierce fight agaisnt Soviet and Mongol troops since March, as the Soviets continues refusing to recognise the true boundaries of Jap... err of our Manchukuoan allies. The Soviets have massed an enormous force at the West bank of the Khalkhin Gol river to retake the vicitinies of the Nomonhan village. What the Kwantung army wants from you, is to deploy your command there, and face the Soviets. Your skills, probably will be the solution for this new... incident.
dst: 自3月以来，我们与苏联和蒙古军队在满蒙边境陷入了激战，因为苏联人始终拒绝承认日……呃，承认我们满洲国盟友的真正边界。苏联人已在哈拉哈河（哈拉哈河）西岸集结了庞大兵力，企图夺回诺门罕村的失地。关东军希望您做的，就是把您的部队部署到那里，去面对苏联人。您的本领，或许正是解决这场新……事件的办法。

src: We are moving North to prevent the Boche from reaching the channel ports before we do. These ports are vital for the supply of the BEF. Only cavalry is now positioned even more to the North than we are. Cavalry and airplanes will decide if we can keep the British in the war.
dst: 我们正北上，抢在德国佬之前抵达海峡港口。这些港口对英国远征军的补给至关重要。目前只有骑兵部署在我们以北更远的地方。骑兵和飞机将决定我们能否把英国人留在战争之中。

src: We are nearing the land where the very first people loved by Hitler originated (kiddin'). High Command says that there are many Jewish Militia units across the whole territory, after the conquest we will send the SS in to "silence" the sector.
dst: 我们正接近那片希特勒所宠爱的民族最初发源的土地（开玩笑的）。最高统帅部称整片领土上散布着许多犹太民兵部队，征服之后我们将派党卫军进去“让”这一带“安静下来”。

src: We are not on schedule, but again 100,000s of Russians are trapped in pockets behind our lines. The Bolsheviks made the mistake of committing all their troops to the first line of defense. Once you broke through, they had no reserve forces to stop you. Now it's time to move East. Moscow is the target. Let's hope we have not lost too much time. Intelligence reports Siberian troops have arrived at the front already.
dst: 我们没按计划进度，但又有数十万俄国人被困在我们战线后方的各个包围圈中。布尔什维克犯了把全部兵力投入第一道防线的错误。你一旦突破，他们就没有预备队可以阻挡你了。现在是时候向东推进了。目标是莫斯科。但愿我们没有浪费太多时间。情报报告说西伯利亚部队已抵达前线。

src: We are not sure about the Italian defensive preperations. They are entrenchment well, but most of the Italian fleet is anchored at Leros island.
dst: 我们不确定意大利人的防御准备情况。他们工事构筑得不错，但意大利舰队大部分都停泊在莱罗斯岛。

src: We are now part of the SS-Panzer Corps commanded by Paul Hausser.  In spite of Hitlers orders to hold the city at all costs we have pulled back allowing ourselves a better tactical situation.  We are now going to launch our attack, with the Leibstandarte leading the way!
dst: 我们现在隶属于保罗·豪塞尔指挥的党卫军装甲军。尽管希特勒命令不惜一切代价守住该城，我们还是后撤了，从而获得了更有利的战术态势。现在我们将发起进攻，由警卫旗队打头阵！

src: We are now ready to launch the final ground attack against German forces in Tunisia, the last holdings of the Axis forces in Africa.  While the 2nd New Zealand Division takes the mountains to the south of Tunis and protects your left flank, your forces will smash through the German defences and capture Tunis and Cap Bon.  Be aware however that seeing as the enemy has no escape route left, he will fight mercilessly and can be expected to resist until the very end.
dst: 我们现在准备对突尼斯的德军——轴心国在非洲的最后据点——发起最后的地面进攻。趁第2新西兰师夺取突尼斯以南山区、掩护你左翼之际，你的部队将击穿德军防线，夺取突尼斯城和邦角。但要当心，既然敌军已无退路，他必将殊死搏杀，可望抵抗到最后一刻。

src: We are on our way along the White Sea coast en route to Archangelsk. Your orders are to proceed southwards, secure the Murmansk - Leningrad railway and overcome any Soviet resistance.
dst: 我们正沿海岸向阿尔汉格尔斯克前进。你的命令是向南推进，确保摩尔曼斯克—列宁格勒铁路安全，并击溃一切苏军抵抗。

src: We are planning to regain the intiative on the eastern front by launching an attack on the 'Kursk salient', codenamed: Operation Zitadelle.  The 1st SS-Panzer Division 'Leibstandarte Adolf Hitler' will be attached to the II SS-Panzer Corps.  We are to advance on Prokharovka and link up with the 9th Army in the north
dst: 我们计划对“库尔斯克突出部”发起进攻，代号“堡垒”行动，以重夺东线主动权。党卫军第1装甲师“阿道夫·希特勒警卫旗队”将配属党卫军第2装甲军。我们要向普罗霍罗夫卡推进，与北面的第9集团军会合。

src: We are pleased to tell you, that we have decided to add a new recon unit to your troops.
dst: 我们很高兴地告诉你，我们决定为你的部队增编一支新的侦察单位。

src: We are poised to strike the crushing blow!
dst: 我们蓄势待发，准备施以致命一击！

src: We are preparing for operations next year against the British in North Africa as well as against Yugoslavia and Greece. Your performance to date has been outstanding and we will be happy to allow you to choose your next operation for yourself and your army.
dst: 我们正在筹划明年对北非英军以及对南斯拉夫和希腊的作战。你迄今的表现十分出色，我们乐于让你为自己和你的部队选择下一个作战方向。

src: We are running low on fuel and ammo. And we have commited most of our reserve regiments. All we can do now is to wait and see what Monty's next move is.
dst: 我们的燃料和弹药即将耗尽，而且已投入了大部分预备团。现在能做的只有等着看蒙蒂的下一步棋。

src: We are sending reinforcements from other less important fronts... the first reinforcements which will arrive are your elite troops, we count on you to stop the Republican offensive. If they get a victory here, the course of the war will turn favorable for the reds, and we cannot allow that!. The Republicans must cross back over the river!.
dst: 我们正从其他较次要的战线调派增援……最先抵达的增援就是你的精锐部队，我们指望你来遏止共和军的攻势。若他们在此取胜，战局将变得对红军有利，我们绝不允许！必须把共和军赶回河对岸！

src: We are sending reinforcements from other less important fronts... the first reinforcements which will arrive are your elite troops, we count on you to stop the Republican offensive. If they get a victory here, the course of the war will turn favorable for the reds, and we cannot allow that!. The Republicans must cross back the river!.
dst: 我们正从其他不太重要的战线派遣增援……最先抵达的增援就是您的精锐部队，我们指望您阻止共和军的攻势。如果他们在此取胜，战局将变得对共和军有利，这是我们绝不容许的！共和军必须渡回河对岸！

src: We are sending three columns to intercept this Belgian attack:
dst: 我们正派出三支纵队截击比利时人的这次进攻：

src: We are taking measures to make the American public sick of this war. We started a big offensive towards Liege and get in the back of the American 1st and 9th armies near Aachen.
dst: 我们正在设法让美国公众对这场战争感到厌倦。我们已向列日方向发起一场大规模攻势，插到亚琛附近美国第1、第9集团军的后方。

src: We are to liberate the area round Kishinev called Basarabia for return to Romanian control.
dst: 我们要解放基希讷乌周边称为比萨拉比亚的地区，归还罗马尼亚控制。

src: We are very close to establish the land bridge to our eastern allies! The Japanese move with incredible speed - Kalachinsk, just 90 kilometers east of Omsk, has fallen into their hands. Start immediately your attack at Omsk before the Japanese arrive! In Omsk the Russians have pulled together their remaining eastern elite units for a last stand. Air force and armored units are as good as gone and their remaining tanks were entrenched because of fuel shortages. Expect strong resistance - the NKVD will ensure that no troops will surrender!
dst: 我们即将打通与东方盟友的陆上通道！日军以难以置信的速度推进——鄂木斯克以东仅90公里的卡拉钦斯克已落入他们手中。趁日本人尚未抵达，立即发起对鄂木斯克的进攻！在鄂木斯克，俄国人已把他们残余的东部精锐部队集结起来，准备做最后的顽抗。空军和装甲部队几乎消耗殆尽，他们剩下的坦克因燃料短缺而被埋入阵地当固定炮台。预料会遇到顽强抵抗——内务人民委员部会确保没有任何部队投降！

src: We are writing the Year 72 BC. The Celts are getting more and more aggressive and want to defeat Rome. For that Reason, Krixos seperates from Spartacus and takes his own way.
dst: 我们正处在公元前72年。凯尔特人日益激进，想要打败罗马。为此，克里克索斯与斯巴达克斯分道扬镳，走自己的路。

src: We broke through the enemy's lines and the Germans are in full retreat. We should try keep the momentum and encircle the german 10th army. It is unclear which units are ahead of us at the moment but the race for Rome is Open! Rome itself has been declared an open city and won't be defended.
dst: 我们突破了敌军防线，德军正在全面溃退。我们应当设法保持势头，包围德国第10集团军。目前尚不清楚我们前方有哪些单位，但罗马之争已经展开！罗马本身已被宣布为不设防城市，不会设防。

src: We can not allow Sweden to be a constant threat in our backyard! In order to bring peace and stability to all countries around the Baltic Sea, the High Command of the Army has ordered you to sent your troops to Sweden.
dst: 我们不能允许瑞典成为我们后方的持续威胁！为了给波罗的海周边所有国家带来和平与稳定，陆军最高统帥部已命令你派遣部队前往瑞典。

src: We can provide only a few troops for your mission, because most of the soviet armies are needed to hold the pocket closed.
dst: 我们只能为你的任务提供少量部队，因为大部分苏联集团军都需要用于维持包围圈的封闭。

src: We can soon end this war as we are sure to capture Moscow!
dst: 我们很快就能结束这场战争，因为我们必将攻占莫斯科！

src: We can soon end this war as we soon hope to take Moscow!
dst: 我们很快就能结束这场战争，因为我们即将有望攻占莫斯科！

src: We can't allow things like these to happen, General. We can't afford them. You're good at administrative tasks, but leading real troops on a real battlefield is something very different. You'll be assigned to the garrison of Prague, where you can contribute to the war effort being, at the same time, as far from the battlefield as possible. It will be the best for everybody, including you.
dst: 我们不能再让这类事情发生，将军。我们承受不起。您擅长行政事务，但带领真正的部队上真正的战场完全是另一回事。您将被派驻布拉格守备队，在那里为战事出力，同时尽可能远离战场。这对所有人，包括您自己，都是最好的安排。

src: We can't allow this situation; the capitalist unification of Korea must not be completed.  A capitalist state in Korea would be like a gun aimed at the People's Republic of China, and we know that the puny North American general McArthur has maintained some conversations with Chaing-Kai-Shek about a possible continuation of the war against us.
dst: 我们不能容许这种局面；资本主义统一朝鲜绝不能完成。朝鲜若出现一个资本主义国家，就像一支枪对准中华人民共和国，而且我们知道，那个微不足道的北美将军麦克阿瑟已与蒋介石就继续对我们作战的可能性进行过一些会谈。

src: We cannot continue the offensive, now you must prepare to fall back and defend yourself.
dst: 我们无法继续进攻，现在您必须准备后撤并转入防御。

src: We cannot leave Sevastopol on our flank while we advance on Stalingrad and the Caucaus, therefore it must be taken. Sevastopol is the most heavily fortified area in the world, stronger than the Maginot line or even Gibraltar!  This will not be an easy task, Herr General, but the General Staff has confidence in your leadership and resourcefulness.
dst: 在我们向斯大林格勒和高加索推进时，不能把塞瓦斯托波尔留在我们的侧翼，因此必须拿下它。塞瓦斯托波尔是世界上防御最坚固的地区，比马其诺防线甚至直布罗陀还要坚固！将军阁下，这不会是轻松的任务，但总参谋部对您的领导力和足智多谋充满信心。

src: We cannot let that happen. We must hit them now, before they have time to build new defences. But, of course, our first line units are exhausted, so we need your experience one more time. Pursue the Germans, harass them and force them to run for their lives. They're on the brink of defeat, and they just need a final push. Good luck!
dst: 我们不能让那发生。必须现在就打击他们，趁他们还没来得及构筑新防线。当然，我们的一线部队已经疲惫不堪，所以我们需要再次借助您的经验。追击德军，袭扰他们，逼他们拼命逃窜。他们已濒临失败，只需最后一击。祝您好运！

src: We captured the British column including Lord Methuen, who was badly wounded. You acted in a most chivalric way when you released the prisoners and allowed them to go to Klerksdorp.
dst: 我们俘虏了那支英军纵队，包括身负重伤的梅休因勋爵。您释放战俘并允许他们前往克莱克斯多普，此举尽显骑士风范。

src: We considered using a nuke to wipe these bastards out, but a few of our eggheads think it was atomic bomb testing that created these things in the first place.  We also can't afford to let the Soviets know something is going on here in the desert.
dst: 我们考虑过用核弹把这些混蛋抹平，但我们的几个书呆子认为，正是原子弹试验最初造出了这些东西。我们也承担不起让苏联人知道沙漠里出了事的代价。

src: We continue our advance into the Polish Corridor. We cut off and trapped parts of the Polish army at the coast and on the Hel Peninsula. You have to overcome the resistance and advance towards the coast!
dst: 我们继续向波兰走廊推进。我们在海岸和赫尔半岛切断并困住了部分波兰军队。你必须击溃抵抗，向海岸推进！

src: We control France but these small british islands in the waters off the normandie are a constant threat.
dst: 我们控制着法国，但诺曼底外海上的这些英国小岛是一个持续的威胁。

src: We could have run into serious trouble if General Linares, the Spanish commander, had decided to help General Rubín, but it seems that Linares is too prudent, and he's afraid of a Cuban attack against Santiago if he takes any troops out of the town.
dst: 如果西班牙指挥官利纳雷斯将军当初决定援助鲁宾将军，我们本可能陷入大麻烦。但看来利纳雷斯过于谨慎，他担心一旦从城内调出任何部队，古巴人就会进攻圣地亚哥。

src: We could trap several armies in East Friesland. We have reliable information that the west allied plans to evacuate the troops through the harbors of Emden and Wilhelmshaven. Take Emden and Wilhelmshaven before the ships arrive and destroy most of the enemy's troops to prevent the possibilities of a counterattack.
dst: 我们得以在东弗里斯兰围困数支集团军。我们掌握可靠情报，西方盟军计划通过埃姆登和威廉港的港口撤离部队。在舰船抵达之前夺取埃姆登和威廉港，并歼灭敌军大部，以杜绝其反攻的可能。

src: We decided to start a counteroffensive when the spring came, but we knew that it was going to be a difficult task. The Soviets had established solid defence lines at the foot of the Urals, and breaking them wouldn't be easy.
dst: 我们决定在春天到来时发起反攻，但我们知道这将是一项艰巨的任务。苏军已在乌拉尔山脚下建立起坚固的防线，突破它们绝非易事。

src: We did our best, and we actually defeated he Bolsheviks in Belebei. But it wasn't enough. North and south of our positions, the Reds kept on advancing, so if we stayed we'd eventually be outflanked and encircled. With tears in our eyes, we had to retreat to Ufa and build a new line of defence there.
dst: 我们尽了全力，实际上在别列别伊击败了布尔什维克。但这还不够。在我们阵地南北两翼，红军持续挺进，如果我们留下，最终会被包抄合围。我们眼含热泪，不得不退到乌法，并在那里构筑新的防线。

src: We didn't advance any further. In the coastal regions, the guns of the Royal Navy would be lethal for our troops, and we wanted to avoid those unnecessary losses. While we were fighting in Eritrea, the British had made a surprise attack against Gondar, and dealing with the new invaders was our priority. In order to fight against the British and, at the same time, defend the Eritrean Highlands and our other borders, we needed all the men that we could gather. I wasn't going to lose them by making foolish advances without any hope of victory. No, the ports of the Red Sea would have to wait.
dst: 我们没有再继续推进。在沿海地区，皇家海军的舰炮对我们的部队将是致命的，而我们想避免那些不必要的损失。当我们在厄立特里亚作战时，英国人已对贡德尔发动了突袭，对付这些新的入侵者才是我们的当务之急。为了在抗击英国人的同时保卫厄立特里亚高地和我们的其他边境，我们需要能集结到的所有人手。我不会让这些人白白葬送在没有获胜希望的愚蠢推进中。不，红海的港口只能再等等。

src: We didn't expect such a fierce resistance. Our casualties are huge, but in the end it won't matter. Vara del Rey is dead, and Linares has been wounded. When our reinforcements come, the Spanish defences will fall, and the siege of Santiago will begin. Nothing, and nobody, will be able to get out of the town, either by land or by sea. In a few days the Spaniards will realise that there is no hope for them, and they'll surrender.
dst: 我们没料到会遇到如此顽强的抵抗。我们伤亡惨重，但最终这都无关紧要。巴拉德尔雷已经阵亡，利纳雷斯也负了伤。等我们的援军一到，西班牙防线就会崩溃，圣地亚哥之围随之开始。届时无论从陆路还是海路，任何人和任何东西都无法离开这座城镇。不出数日，西班牙人就会意识到他们已毫无希望，并选择投降。

src: We didn't expect that the Italian lines would fall so easily. If we had known that the infiltration tactics would work so well our offensive would have been much larger, with the intention of kicking Italy out of the war. But now we lack the manpower and the supplies that we'd need to do that, so although we'll be able to advance many kilometers into Italian territory, sooner or later we'll have to stop and dig in.
dst: 我们没料到意军防线会如此轻易崩溃。早知渗透战术如此奏效，我们的攻势规模本会大得多，好一举把意大利踢出战争。但现在我们缺少那样做所需的人力和补给，所以尽管我们能向意大利领土纵深推进许多公里，终究还是得停下来构筑工事。

src: We didn't have much time to enjoy this new victory. We rested for less than one day, and then we had to board several trains that took us to the south. Denikin's staff had contacted Kolchak's, asking for a joint operation against Saratov. Kolchak had accepted, and had assigned that mission to us. We had to return to the Volga as soon as we could.
dst: 我们没有多少时间来享受这场新胜利。我们休整了不到一天，就不得不登上几列火车，前往南方。邓尼金的参谋部联系了高尔察克的参谋部，请求对萨拉托夫采取联合行动。高尔察克接受了，并把这项任务交给了我们。我们不得不尽快返回伏尔加河。

src: We didn't know what to expect in Irkutsk. There were Bolshevik troops and Socialist militias. Both of them would be hostile to us. As for the Czech units that were roaming along the railroads, I wasn't sure if they'd be willing to attack us, but we didn't trust them. Finally, the Siberian cossacks were opportunistic scum, but I doubted that they'd dare to fight against us.
dst: 我们不知道伊尔库茨克会有什么。那里有布尔什维克军队和社会党民兵。两者都会敌视我们。至于沿铁路游荡的捷克部队，我不确定他们是否愿意攻击我们，但我们不信任他们。最后，西伯利亚哥萨克是投机取巧的渣滓，但我怀疑他们是否敢与我们作战。

src: We didn't think that the enemy would recover so soon. At least our own defence lines have held, but the Ypern salient is still a threat to us. I bet that there will be more battles for this area.
dst: 我们没想到敌人会恢复得这么快。至少我们自己的防线守住了，但伊普尔突出部对我们仍是威胁。我敢打赌，这一地区还会有更多战斗。

src: We don't get tired of your splendid victories. In Bitola the Germans have succeeded, too. Now, while they attack Athen, our units will chase the remnants of the British army and besiege Thessaloniki. But don't worry, the Bulgarians and some of our second line divisions can do that task. Even without your expert guidance the war in the Balkans will be over soon, and now it's more important that you go back to the Italian front. We have great plans for our enemies there. You'll love them, that's for sure.
dst: 我们对您辉煌的胜利从不厌倦。德国人在比托拉也同样取得了成功。现在，趁他们进攻雅典之际，我们的部队将追击英军残部并围攻塞萨洛尼基。不过您别担心，保加利亚人和我们的一些二线师就能完成这项任务。即便没有您的专业指挥，巴尔干的战事也很快就会结束，而现在更重要的是您重返意大利战线。我们对那里的敌人有宏大的计划。您一定会喜欢这些计划的，这一点毫无疑问。

src: We don't have a choice, we have to surrender, the lack of supplies don't give us any other option.
dst: 我们别无选择，只能投降，补给匮乏没有给我们别的出路。

src: We don't have a choice, we have to surrender, the lack of supplies give us no other option.
dst: 我们别无选择，只能投降，补给匮乏使我们没有别的出路。

src: We don't have time to escape, Commander.  It's going to do whatever it was built to do.  Let's just hope it's not a massive bomb...
dst: 我们没时间逃了，指挥官。它要做它被造出来该做的事了。只希望它不是什么巨型炸弹……

src: We don't really have the resources to prevent the British from leaving France, but we must make sure that they won't have the means to come back, and that they'll suffer as many casualties as we can inflict on them. So take Dieppe and cut the enemy's evacuation route before the majority of the British soldiers are safe at home. Part of our Hochseeflotte will help you in this mission.
dst: 我们确实没有足够的资源去阻止英军离开法国，但我们必须确保他们不再有能力卷土重来，并让他们尽可能多地付出伤亡。所以在大多数英军士兵安然回到本土之前，夺取迪耶普，切断敌人的撤退路线。我们的公海舰队将派一部分力量协助您完成这项任务。

src: We don't really need you in China anymore, so you'll return to America. One of our ships will take you in Taku in less than a week. You'll be in San Francisco before the end of the summer, and if you remain in the Army maybe you'll have a second chance to prove your value in the future.
dst: 中国这边已经不太需要您了，所以您将返回美国。一周之内，我们的一艘船会在大沽接您。夏天结束前您就会抵达旧金山，而只要您留在军中，将来或许还会有第二次机会证明您的价值。

src: We enjoy complete air superiority and don't expect any german Luftwaffe planes.
dst: 我们握有完全的制空权，不必担心德军德国空军的飞机。

src: We enjoyed making this campaign and hope you enjoyed playing it.
dst: 我们很享受制作这个战役的过程，希望您玩得开心。

src: We expect the deployment of Yudenich's troops from day to day;  however, we cannot delay the start of this operation.
dst: 我们随时都在等待尤登尼奇部队的部署；不过，我们无法推迟这次行动的发动。

src: We expected more of you, General. A bunch of mountain shepherds has ridiculed you. Your performance was very disappointing.
dst: 我们对您的期望更高，将军。一群山里牧羊人就让您颜面尽失。您的表现令人大失所望。

src: We expected more of you, General. The British control the Hohenzollern Redoute, and we'll need many counterattacks, and the loss of many soldiers, to take it back.
dst: 我们对您的期望不止于此，将军。英军已控制霍亨索伦堡垒，我们得发动多次反攻、牺牲许多士兵才能把它夺回来。

src: We fight for the Tsar, Gospodin General!
dst: 我们为沙皇而战，中将阁下！

src: We finally had the opportunity that we had been waiting for so long. We could keep on moving, cross the Tobol, encircle the Red Armies of the East, and destroy them. All we needed was an order.
dst: 我们终于得到了盼望已久的机会。我们可以继续前进，渡过托博尔河，包围并消灭东部各支红军。我们需要的只是一道命令。

src: We finished the evacuation of Ekaterinburg with only minor incidents, retreating in order to the line Yalutorovsk - Tobolsk. From there, our troops were sent to Chelyabinsk, where they were badly needed.
dst: 我们以仅有几次小波折完成了叶卡捷琳堡的疏散，有秩序地撤到亚卢托罗夫斯克-托博尔斯克一线。从那里，我们的部队被派往车里雅宾斯克，那里急需兵力。

src: We fought KV tanks in the past days, and it seems like Soviets brought some more again.
dst: 过去几日我们与 KV 坦克交过手，看来苏军又调来了更多。

src: We fought the Russians with all our might, yet not even your greatfully received men could stem the red tide of Soviets as they pushed farther into my homeland.
dst: 我们竭尽全力与俄国人作战，然而即便是你们这些深受欢迎的将士，也无法阻挡苏联红色洪流向我国腹地纵深推进。

src: We fought very hard during the winter, to no avail. The Russian lines held, and besides, Premissel fell in March. Since the war started, half of our soldiers have died, been wounded, or taken prisoner.
dst: 整个冬天我们浴血奋战，却徒劳无功。俄军防线稳如磐石，而且普热梅希尔在三月陷落了。开战以来，我军一半士兵战死、负伤或被俘。

src: We go back to our accommodations for the wintertime and start next spring the invasion of Britain…
dst: 我们返回驻地过冬，明春发动入侵不列颠的战役……

src: We had expected you to move faster. Move your troops South. They are needed in the North of France where we have encircled a large number of enemy forces.
dst: 我们本以为你能推进得更快。把你的部队调往南面。法国北部需要我们围住的大批敌军，那里正需要他们。

src: We had failed. The Bolsheviks were in an excellent position to launch a massive counteroffensive once they gathered enough troops. I believed that it would happen in May. We'd have to do our best to prepare ourselves and defend Belebei and the other towns that we had taken at the start of the spring. Maybe there was still one last chance to stop our enemies.
dst: 我们失败了。布尔什维克处于极佳的位置，一旦集结了足够的兵力，就能发动大规模反攻。我相信这会发生在5月。我们必须尽一切努力做好准备，守住别列别伊以及春天开始时我们夺取的其他城镇。也许还有最后一次机会去阻止敌人。

src: We had finally taken our country back. Our losses had been huge, including our Tzar and His family, but Old Mother Russia wasn't lost. We'd do our best to heal her.
dst: 我们终于夺回了祖国。我们的损失十分惨重，包括我们的沙皇及其家人，但俄罗斯母亲并未沦亡。我们将竭尽全力治愈她的创伤。

src: We had hoped this operation would prove to the world that Italia is NOT a bunch of Mussilinni drones, but.....we have failed.
dst: 我们本希望这次行动能向世界证明，意大利不是一群墨索里尼的应声虫，但……我们失败了。

src: We had reacted much faster than the Italians had expected, and the colonial battalions had left Ethiopia, but the menace was far from over. The best enemy units, composed exclusively of European soldiers, were still heading south, towards Shire and Gondar. They knew that it was unlikely that we could outflank them, since we didn't have been able to mobilize large numbers of warriors.
dst: 我们的反应比意大利人预想的要快得多，殖民营已经撤离埃塞俄比亚，但威胁远未结束。敌军最精锐的部队——完全由欧洲士兵组成——仍在向南推进，目标直指希雷和贡德尔。他们知道我们不太可能包抄他们，因为我们没能动员起大批战士。

src: We had received excellent news from southern Russia, too. Denikin's forces had finally been able to advance into the lower Volga, and had taken Tsaritsyn. That meant that our two armies were separated by less than 150 Russian miles. If we managed to liberate Samara and Saratov, the two main clusters of anti-Bolshevik resistance would finally be united. Kolchak knew the importance of that goal, so he ordered us to plan a summer offensive against Samara.
dst: 我们也从俄国南部收到了极好的消息。邓尼金的部队终于得以推进到伏尔加河下游，并夺取了察里津。这意味着我们两支军队之间相隔已不到150俄里。如果我们能解放萨马拉和萨拉托夫，两大反布尔什维克抵抗力量的核心就终于能合为一体。高尔察克深知这一目标的重要性，于是他命令我们筹划一场针对萨马拉的夏季攻势。

src: We had to abandon our original plan 'Fall Gelb' after one of our Fallschirmguys lost the plans to the Belgians when his plane crashed. The new Sichelschnitt plan is much more daring, shifting the focus of the attack from The Netherlands and Belgium to the South of Belgium: the supposedly impassable Ardennes. This leaves the forces that need to capture the Netherlands much weaker than originally planned. Generalleutnant Student will land his FliegerKorps XI Fliegerdivision 7 and Luftlandedivision 22 near The Hague, Rotterdam and the bridges at Dordrecht and Moerdijk. Your task is to follow Generalleutnant Schmidt's 9th Panzerdivision through the South of the Netherlands. Once your forces arrive as West as Moerdijk, turn North to the Hague and follow the path cleared by Student's troops.
dst: 由于我们的一名伞兵在飞机坠毁时把计划落到了比利时人手里，我们不得不放弃原定的“黄色方案”。新的“镰刀切割”方案大胆得多，把进攻重心从荷兰和比利时转到比利时南部：据信无法通过的阿登地区。这使得负责攻占荷兰的兵力比原计划削弱了许多。施图登特中将将把他的飞行军——第7航空师和第22空降师——投送到海牙、鹿特丹附近，以及多德雷赫特和莫尔代克两座桥。你的任务是跟随施密特中将的第9装甲师穿越荷兰南部。你的部队一旦抵达最西面的莫尔代克，就转向北方前往海牙，沿着施图登特部队开辟的通道前进。

src: We had to break up our 11SS Regiment to bring the Deutschland and Der Fuerher regiments up to strength again. Some of our units have started to run out of ammo. But even though the  mud, rain and cold slowed us down, we have come close to the end goal of our offensive: the capture of Moscow. The 10th Pz Division will again be fighting at our left flank. Make us proud General.
dst: 我们不得不解散党卫军第11团，以把“德意志”团和“元首”团补足编制。我们有些单位已开始弹药告竭。但尽管泥泞、雨水和严寒拖慢了我们，我们已逼近此次攻势的终极目标：夺取莫斯科。第10装甲师将再次在我们的左翼作战。让我们为你骄傲，将军。

src: We had to make use of them before I had thought. For some time Japan had expanded its influence in Korea, which was a tributary state of China. Naturally, that caused tensions and incidents between both countries since even before I came to live in Asia.
dst: 我们不得不在我预想之前就动用它们。一段时间以来，日本一直在中国的藩属国朝鲜扩张势力。自然而然地，这在我来亚洲生活之前就已经在两国之间引发了紧张和冲突。

src: We have a chance for victory over Red army, but enemy resistence will be very strong. Soviet units from Siberia are hard.Bad weather,the severe frost,difficult trackless ground... It is Soviet battlefield.
dst: 我们有机会击败红军，但敌军抵抗将极为顽强。来自西伯利亚的苏军硬碰硬。恶劣的天气、酷寒、难行的无路荒原……这就是苏德战场。

src: We have a desk job waiting for you in Alice Springs!!
dst: 我们在艾丽斯斯普林斯给您留了一份坐办公室的文职！！

src: We have a disastrous situation on our hands and where it not for you, sixth army would be all but finished now. East of Serafimovitch two Russian corps have broken through the Romanian lines, destroyed three Roumanian divisions, and routed three divisions of Sixth Army. South of Stalingrad the Roumanian fourth army has been annihalated. Though it still holds Kalach, sixth army is surrounded in a perimeter west of Stalingrad, and in a disastrous position.
dst: 我们手上是一个灾难性的局面，要不是你，第6集团军现在几乎就完了。在谢拉菲莫维奇以东，两个俄国军突破了罗马尼亚人的防线，歼灭了三个罗马尼亚师，并击溃了第6集团军的三个师。在斯大林格勒以南，罗马尼亚第4集团军已被全歼。第6集团军虽然仍据守卡拉奇，却已被围在斯大林格勒以西的一个环形阵地中，处境极为不利。

src: We have a great opportunity for that here, at the Struma Valley. Recently, our 4th and 5th Armies managed to stop the Serbian counterattack at Kalimanci, so they have been able to send reinforcements to us. In the meantime, the Greek Army of Thessaly, commanded by the very King Konstantinos, is marching through the narrow Kresna Gorge, with little space for maneuvering. While you hold the bulk of the Greek army, our flanks will try to envelope the Greeks. If they fall into our trap, they will have to stop theit offensive and peace will be their best option.
dst: 我们在这里、在斯特鲁马河谷有一个绝佳机会。最近，我们的第4、第5集团军成功阻止了塞尔维亚人在卡利曼齐的反攻，因此得以向我们派出增援。与此同时，由国王康斯坦丁诺斯亲自指挥的色萨利希腊军队正穿过狭窄的克雷斯纳峡谷，几乎没有回旋余地。当您牵制住希腊军队主力时，我们的两翼将尝试包抄希腊人。如果他们落入我们的陷阱，就不得不停止进攻，而和平将成为他们最好的选择。

src: We have a last chance to turn the tide against our enemies here, in the Naraivka valley. The Russians will try a breakthrough in Halytch, sending a couple of Siberian divisions against the Germans that are defending the river.
dst: 我们还有最后一次机会，就在这里、在纳拉伊夫卡河谷扭转对敌的战局。俄国人将尝试在哈利奇实施突破，派出几个西伯利亚师去对付守卫河流的德军。

src: We have a most interesting opportunity to destroy two Soviet divisions and significantly cement my Finnish People to the crusade against communism.
dst: 我们有一个极有意思的机会，可歼灭两个苏军师，并大大巩固我芬兰人民投身反共圣战的决心。

src: We have a second chance of stopping Lord Methuen here, at the Modder River. We thought that our trenches, dug on the river shore, would be enough to repel the assault of the Kakies, but they have found a way to cross the Modder and outflank our positions near the town of Rosmead.
dst: 我们在这里，在莫德河，还有第二次阻止梅休因勋爵的机会。我们原以为挖在河岸上的战壕足以击退英国佬的进攻，但他们已找到办法渡过莫德河，并从罗斯米德镇附近包抄我们的阵地。

src: We have accepted peace through formal surrender of Italy, and we are now focused on keeping the Germans from turning Italy into a war zone.  If the Germans get a good foothold, we could fight among your mountains for years!
dst: 我们已通过意大利正式投降接受了和平，现在专注于阻止德国人把意大利变成战场。若德军站稳脚跟，我们可能在你的山区打上好几年！

src: We have achieved a minor victory, however the enemy has stopped our advance and in several other sectors.  The planned offensive won't reach all the main goals, and many enemy formations are still operational.  Intelligence has warned of a counterattack in your sector soon.  I advise you to order your troops to dig in.
dst: 我军取得了一场小胜，但敌人在此处以及另外几个地段阻止了我军推进。原定攻势无法达成全部主要目标，敌军许多建制仍在作战。情报部门已警告称，敌军不久将对您所在的地段发动反击。我建议您命令部队构筑工事坚守。

src: We have achieved a minor victory, however the enemy has stopped our advance here and in several other sectors. The planned offensive won't accomplish all of its main goals, and many enemy formations are still operational. Intelligence has warned of a counterattack in your sector soon. I advise you to order your troops to dig in.
dst: 我军取得了一场小胜，但敌人在此处以及另外几个地段阻止了我军推进。原定攻势无法达成其全部主要目标，敌军许多建制仍在作战。情报部门已警告称，敌军不久将对您所在的地段发动反击。我建议您命令部队构筑工事坚守。

src: We have achieved all the objetives as we planned. Kristiansand is in our hands now, good work.
dst: 我们按计划达成了所有目标。克里斯蒂安桑现已落入我们手中，干得好。

src: We have achieved some intial success but it will not last.  The Russians have begun a counter-attack and we are once again back on the defensive.  For our failure we have been ordered to hand in our armbands which signify us as elite soldiers.....Dietrich has refused to carry out the order saying he would sooner shoot himself.
dst: 我们取得了一些初步战果，但难以持久。俄军已开始反攻，我们再次转入防御。由于我们的失败，上级命令我们交还象征精英士兵身份的臂章……迪特里希拒绝执行这道命令，说他宁可开枪自尽。

src: We have achieved the objetives, the danish has showed us a good defence, but finally we did it. Good Work.
dst: 我们达成了目标，丹麦人向我们展示了出色的防御，但最终我们还是成功了。干得好。

src: We have achieved the objetives, the norvegians has showed us a good defence, but finally we did it. Good Work.
dst: 我们达成了目标。挪威人展示了良好的防御，但最终我们做到了。干得好。

src: We have advanced hundreds of kilometers and we once again stand at the gates of Rostov. It is vital that we capture this gate to the Caucasus as soon as possible, because still not all German units have retreated over the Don, back into the Ukraine. Although many Germans are forced back to the Taman/Kuban peninsula, enemy mobile forces are rushing towards Rostov. If you are quick enough than you can trap them before they have crossed the Don River. In any case, it is vital that we do not lose the momentum in this winter offensive. We must push the fascists invaders back, back and back. Good luck, comrade!
dst: 我们已推进了数百公里，再次站在了罗斯托夫门前。尽快夺取这座高加索门户至关重要，因为并非所有德军都已渡过顿河撤回乌克兰。尽管许多德军被逼回塔曼/库班半岛，敌军快速部队仍在向罗斯托夫冲来。如果你动作够快，就能在他们渡过顿河之前截住他们。无论如何，在这次冬季攻势中绝不能失去势头，这至关重要。我们必须把法西斯侵略者一退再退、一退再退。祝你好运，同志！

src: We have advanced some 25 miles deep into Soviet lines.  We are approaching Prokharovka.  However the three divisions of our Corps have became seperated, and our flanks are wide open owing to the failure of the Kempf detachment on our right flank and XXXXVIII Pz. Corps on our left, who have both fell behind.
dst: 我们已深入苏军战线约25英里，正逼近普罗霍罗夫卡。然而我军三个师已彼此脱节，两翼门户大开——右翼的肯普夫支队和左翼的第48装甲军都掉在了后面。

src: We have already partly overcome the Urals - the range of mountains once decreed to be the true border of Germany. The last large industrial area of Russia is here, stretching from Serow to Orsk. We can split it into two parts and castrate it if we take Sverdlovsk. This is your task.
dst: 我们已部分翻越乌拉尔山——这片山脉曾一度被钦定为德国的真正边界。俄国最后一个大工业区就在这里，从谢罗夫延伸到奥尔斯克。若能夺取斯维尔德洛夫斯克，我们就能把它一分为二、使其元气大伤。这是你的任务。

src: We have an excellent flank position at which to quickly punch through the Russian right flank and take the key bridge crossings.  Once this is done, the Romanian Infantry armies can finish off those Russians troops surrounded and without suppl
dst: 我们有一个极佳的侧翼位置，可迅速击穿俄军右翼并夺取关键桥梁渡口。一旦得手，罗马尼亚步兵集团军就能解决那些被围、断了补给的俄军。

src: We have an opportunity to break the communist forces, here at Guadalajara, and then march on Madrid before they can receive more outside aid.
dst: 我们有机会在瓜达拉哈拉击垮共产党军队，然后趁他们获得更多外援之前向马德里进军。

src: We have arrived at Metsovon Pass, the last available route of retreat for the Greek 1st Army out of Albania.  Reports show the Greeks are attempting to breakthrough here - so we will have to stop them.  Show the world how a LSSAH soldier fights!
dst: 我们已抵达迈措翁山口——这是希腊第1集团军撤出阿尔巴尼亚的最后一条可用退路。报告显示希腊人正试图在此突围，所以我们必须阻止他们。让世界看看警卫旗队士兵是如何战斗的！

src: We have been able to keep the Italians confined to the coastal cities for more than half a year now. But the enemy has received reinforcements and is trying to occupy more of Trablusgarp. Here near Trablus, they are about to attack the trench lines that we have been building at Janzour - 20 km to the West of the city.
dst: 我们已经能够把意大利人困在沿海城市半年多。但敌人已得到增援，正试图占领更多的的黎波里塔尼亚。在这里，的黎波里附近，他们即将进攻我们在詹祖尔——该城以西20公里处——构筑的战壕防线。

src: We have been able to secure Missouri for the Union but danger is coming from Arkansas ... you have to move your men there immidiately
dst: 我们已为联邦保住了密苏里，但危险正来自阿肯色……您必须立即把您的部队调到那里。

src: We have been given orders to drive the enemy out of the Caucasus steppes and the captured Black Sea ports. Attacks on the entire front in the Kuban will be made, but the biggest will take place near Novorossiysk. The Black Sea Fleet has offered a flotilla of cruisers and destroyers as well as thousands of trusty Marines. These, and a part of your force, will land near a large peninula south of Novorossiysk, in order to join up with the force coming from the coast, at Novorissiysk and defeat the enemy. It is a promising plan but it can be done. After all we are pushing the enemy back, west, west, all the the way west where they came from! Good luck, comrade.
dst: 我们奉命把敌人赶出高加索草原和被占领的黑海港口。将在库班全线发动进攻，但规模最大的将在新罗西斯克附近进行。黑海舰队提供了一支由巡洋舰和驱逐舰组成的舰队，以及数千名可靠的海军陆战队员。他们和你的一部分部队，将在新罗西斯克以南的一个大半岛附近登陆，以便与从海岸方向赶来的部队在新罗西斯克会合，击败敌人。这是一个很有希望的计划，而且可行。毕竟，我们正把敌人一路向西、向西、一直向西——赶回他们来的地方！祝你好运，同志。

src: We have been informed that a detachment of Spanish infantrymen is still besieged by Filipino rebels in a small outpost at Baler, a village on the eastern coast of Luzon. Now that the alliance between the U.S. and the Filipino revolutionary forces is broken and fighting has started between them, the Americans have allowed us to try to relieve the garrison if we wish so.
dst: 我们得到消息，一支西班牙步兵分遣队仍被菲律宾起义者围困在巴莱尔的一处小哨所里，那是吕宋岛东海岸的一个村庄。既然美国与菲律宾革命力量之间的联盟已经破裂，双方之间已经开战，美国人便允许我们（如果我们愿意的话）尝试去解围。

src: We have been informed that some German troops of the 208 Infantry Division have crossed the Escaut/Scheldt river through one of the tunnels in Antwerpen/Anvers that, due once more to the absence of coordination with our allies, has not been completely destroyed.
dst: 我们已获悉，德军第208步兵师的一些部队已通过安特卫普的一条隧道渡过斯海尔德河——这条隧道又一次因为与盟军缺乏协调而未被彻底炸毁。

src: We have been moved to the Ardennes region for a final offensive.  We are part of 6th SS Panzer Army, commanded by Sepp Dietrich.  We must break through the US XVIII Corps lines in the Ardennes, seize the high ground of Elsenborn Ridge and control of roads in the north, and then move to capture the vital bridges accross the Meuse between Liege and Huy.
dst: 我们被调到阿登地区，准备发动最后的攻势。我们隶属泽普·迪特里希指挥的党卫军第6装甲集团军。我们必须突破阿登地区美军第18军的防线，夺取埃尔森博恩山脊的高地并控制北部道路，然后夺取列日与于伊之间默兹河上的要害桥梁。

src: We have been on board of the ship for a week now. Most of us are sea-sick. We were sailing along the coast from New York City to the south.
dst: 我们已经在船上待了一个星期。大多数人晕船。我们正沿着海岸从纽约市向南航行。

src: We have been ordered back to the Eastern Front after our rest in Italy.  We are back with the 4th Panzer Army, and we are going to launch a counter-attack to destroy the Soviet bridgehead on the Dnieper.  First we are going to advance on Zhitomir.  We are supported by the 1st and 9th Panzer Divisions.
dst: 在意大利休整之后，我们奉命重返东线。我们又回到了第4装甲集团军，将发起反攻，摧毁苏军在第聂伯河上的桥头堡。首先我们要向日托米尔推进。第1、第9装甲师支援我们。

src: We have been ordered back to the Eastern Front for an offensive at Lake Balaton, Hungary.  The operation aims at destroying the Red Army between the Danube, the Plattensee and the Drava, and establishing a line east of the Balaton oil fields.  Our first objective is Sumontomya.
dst: 我们奉命重返东线，在匈牙利巴拉顿湖发起攻势。该行动旨在消灭多瑙河、普拉滕湖与德拉瓦河之间的红军，并在巴拉顿油田以东建立一条防线。我们的第一个目标是苏蒙托姆亚。

src: We have been pleased with your performance on the Italian front and it is now time for you to counter the upcoming Allied invasion of France.
dst: 我们对你在意大利战线的表现十分满意，现在该由你应对盟军即将发起的法国登陆了。

src: We have been relieved of command by Hitler himself.  He has replaced every commander involved in the relief attack down to division level!
dst: 我们被希特勒亲自解除了指挥权。他把参加解围进攻的所有指挥官一直换到了师一级！

src: We have been unable to stop the enemy in the mountains, but we will when they go down and try to reach the coast. Your units must secure the port of Suchumi, the coastal road which is our single supplyline to the front near Novorissiysk, and secure essential positions. Good luck, comrade.
dst: 我们没能在山区挡住敌人，但等他们下山、试图抵达海岸时，我们就能挡住。你的部队必须确保苏呼米港、通往新罗西斯克前线的唯一补给线滨海公路，以及各要点的安全。祝你好运，同志。

src: We have broken through across the whole frontier, and are racing to complete another encirclement that closes at Smolensk.
dst: 我们已突破整条边境，正疾驰完成另一次在斯摩棱斯克合拢的合围。

src: We have captured some of the Turkish trenches, but this ground could only be gained by ghastly sacrifice. It looks like we're getting into a stalemate position here at Cape Helles. I think there's no chance for us to break the Turkish lines at Krithia...
dst: 我们夺取了土耳其人的一些战壕，但这些土地只有靠惨重的牺牲才能换来。看来我们在海勒斯角陷入了僵局。我认为我们没有机会在克里希亚突破土耳其人的防线了……

src: We have chosen some troops for you. You will have six different troops, each of them is of another class. And you are able to order more units in a recent scale.  Keep in mind that your decision can be important in coming battles.
dst: 我们已为你挑选了一些部队。你将有六支不同的部队，每支属于不同兵种。你还能以较小的规模订购更多单位。请记住，你的决定在接下来的战斗中可能很重要。

src: We have committed the mightiest of our naval forces to this assault, forces that we cannot afford to lose.  If you win the battle on land, but lose our capital ships in the process, the battle will be lost.  You must preserve those ships.  They cannot be replaced.  We have also built up a substantial unterseeboot presence off the coast of Georgia.  You will have command of them as well for the duration of this battle.
dst: 我们为这次突击投入了最强大的海军力量，这些力量我们损失不起。若你在陆上取胜、却在过程中损失了主力舰，这场仗就输了。你必须保住那些舰船，它们无法替换。我们还在佐治亚海岸外部署了可观的潜艇部队。本次战斗期间，它们也归你指挥。

src: We have confirmed that the British have built strong fortifications in Port Alfred and Port Elizabeth.
dst: 我们已确认，英军在阿尔弗雷德港和伊丽莎白港构筑了坚固的工事。

src: We have conveyed our thanks to the Finnish government for their assistance in this struggle with the Russians.
dst: 我们已向芬兰政府转达了谢意，感谢他们在对俄斗争中的协助。

src: We have crossed Australia, without any significant resistance, just some kangaroos in the dirty roads of this country hahaha!  Well, now we think the Australians are planning to use the majority of their troops to protect their southeast corner where their major important cities and bases are located:  Adelaide, Sidney, Brisbane or Canberra for example.  Your mission is to get Adelaide.  This will completely cut Australia in two.  Meanwhile, disembark some troops from the sea against Brisbane and Sidney to keep the remainder of Australian troops busy.  Our brave navy will also be here in the Adelaide sector to help you deal with the enemy.
dst: 我们已横穿澳大利亚，没有遇到任何像样的抵抗，只有这国家泥泞道路上的几只袋鼠，哈哈哈！好，现在我们认为澳大利亚人正打算用其大部分兵力保卫他们东南角，那里有他们最重要的城市和基地：例如阿德莱德、悉尼、布里斯班或堪培拉。您的任务是攻取阿德莱德。这将把澳大利亚彻底切成两半。同时，从海上派兵登陆布里斯班和悉尼，以牵制澳大利亚其余部队。我们英勇的海军也将出现在阿德莱德方向，协助您对付敌人。

src: We have crossed the Alps and are here for the first time on Italian soil .....
dst: 我们已翻过阿尔卑斯山，第一次踏上意大利的土地 .....

src: We have determined the day of the summer solstice as the most favorable day of attack. Teutates, Selina and Esus are with us!
dst: 我们已把夏至之日定为最有利的进攻日。图塔蒂斯、塞利娜与埃苏斯与我们同在！

src: We have encircled two Soviet armies at Uman.  Although they tried to break out of the encirclement we managed to beat them back each and every time.  The Leibstandarte has earned considerable praise from corps commander Kempf for our part in defeating these relentless attacks.
dst: 我们已在乌曼合围了两个苏军集团军。尽管他们屡屡试图突围，我们每次都将他们击退。警卫旗队因挫败这些顽抗进攻而赢得了军长肯普夫的盛赞。

src: We have entered Kijów without any serious trouble. Very well done!
dst: 我们顺利进入了基辅，没遇到什么严重麻烦。干得非常漂亮！

src: We have excellent news! After hearing of our victory in the Battle of Manila Rear Admiral Camara's Reserve Squadron has been sent to the Philippines.
dst: 我们有个天大的好消息！听闻我们在马尼拉战役中获胜后，卡马拉少将的后备分舰队已被派往菲律宾。

src: We have failed to save the trapped men....but it was a lost cause.  The thick fog and heavily bogged roads made rapid advance impossible.  Now we, ourselves must try and escape before we are encircled.
dst: 我们没能救出被困的部队……但那本就是一桩注定失败的事。浓雾和严重泥泞的道路使快速推进成为不可能。如今我们自己也得在被合围之前设法突围。

src: We have finally been given the order to move to the Normandy region, Caen to be exact.  The Hitlerjugend division need our support in defending the important city against the British attacks.  They are taking heavy casualties holding on to the high ground to the west of the city - in the face of British armour and infantry assaults.  We will be taking over the defence of the Caen region, and hope to launch a counter-attack soon.
dst: 我们终于接到命令开赴诺曼底地区，确切地说是卡昂。“希特勒青年团”师需要我们支援，以防守这座要城、抵御英军进攻。他们据守城西高地，在英军装甲和步兵的猛攻下伤亡惨重。我们将接管卡昂地区的防御，并希望尽快发起反击。

src: We have finally established ourselves in the British Isles!
dst: 我们终于在不列颠群岛站稳了脚跟！

src: We have finally reached the northern chain of mountains that is our last obstacle on the way to Vladivostok and surely to wars end.  The Germans have re-taken the offensive on the European eastern front, and the USSR is in a bad position now.  They are isolated fighting against the Axis.  The Trans-Siberian Railroad is cut, and now it's time to drive to Vladivostok by passing thought the mountains.  The soviets have made some fortifications but they won't be strong enough to deter your forces.
dst: 我们终于抵达了北方山脉，那是我们通往符拉迪沃斯托克、乃至战争终结的最后一道障碍。德军已在欧洲东线重新发起攻势，苏联如今处境艰难。他们孤立无援，正与轴心国作战。西伯利亚大铁路已被切断，现在是穿过群山、向符拉迪沃斯托克挺进的时候了。苏军构筑了一些工事，但它们还不足以阻挡您的部队。

src: We have given you the key role in the invasion of France. You are to annihilate the French, British and Belgian armies located west and north of the Ardennes. In order to ensure their destruction, the early capture of Paris, and the opportunity to invade England this summer,  you must advance to the English Channel and capture all of the objectives no later than June 8th. A swift blow, delivered to the Allied armies as soon as possible, is essential to allow us time for an invasion of England this year.
dst: 我们已把入侵法国的关键任务交给你。你要歼灭驻于阿登以西和以北的法国、英国和比利时军队。为确保将其歼灭、早日夺取巴黎，并获得今夏入侵英国的机会，你必须在6月8日之前推进至英吉利海峡并夺取所有目标。尽快对盟军部队施以迅猛一击，对我们争取时间、在今年内入侵英国至关重要。

src: We have great plans for your troops in France.
dst: 我们对你的部队在法国有宏大的计划。

src: We have had victories these last months, comrade! We have trapped hundreds of thousands fascist near Stalingrad where our forces are still feriously resisting the enemy. And in the Caucasus the Germans are slowly retreating. We started our winter offensive to liberate the Caucasus region all the way up to Novorossiysk and Rostov, some weeks ago. Your forces have been held in reserve but will now be deployed in order to recapture Maikop and hopefully cut off enemy forces. The fascist can only retreat west, to Novorossiysk and the Taman/Kuban peninsula, or north-west to Rostov. With the capture of Maikop we can force the fascist forces to take the longer way, to Rostov, where they should be met by our own forces coming from the Don.
dst: 这几个月我们打了不少胜仗，同志！我们在斯大林格勒附近围困了数十万法西斯，我们的部队仍在与他们激烈交战。在高加索，德军正在缓慢撤退。几个星期前，我们发动冬季攻势，以解放高加索地区，一直推进到新罗西斯克和罗斯托夫。你的部队一直作为预备队，现在将被投入战斗，以夺回迈科普，并有望切断敌军。法西斯只能向西退往新罗西斯克和塔曼/库班半岛，或向西北退往罗斯托夫。夺取迈科普后，我们就能迫使法西斯走更远的路——去罗斯托夫，在那里迎接他们的将是从顿河方向赶来的我军。

src: We have however indications from General Richthofen that large formations, probably the Soviet first guard corps are on their way east to your sector. So, be on your guard against an attack from the east as well as a renewed attack from the north !
dst: 不过，我们从里希特霍芬将军那里得到迹象表明，庞大的编队——很可能是苏联近卫第1军——正向东开往你的战区。因此，你要警惕来自东面的进攻，也要警惕北面再次发起的进攻！

src: We have information that all of Sicily is surrounded by enemy submarines that are attempting to eliminate the last Italian ships.
dst: 我们得到情报，整座西西里岛已被敌方潜艇包围，它们正企图消灭意大利仅存的舰艇。

src: We have information that the British will mount a counter-offensive with some mad Scot troops and their "invincible" Matilda tanks.
dst: 我们有情报称，英军将用一些疯狂的苏格兰部队和他们“无敌”的玛蒂尔达坦克发起反攻。

src: We have just one step left to kick out the Americans from the east coast, start to move !
dst: 把美国人赶出东海岸只差最后一步，开始行动！

src: We have just secured the position for the assault. Easter arrives soon so try to liberate the city before the coming holidays. I think the citizens will help you and I hope there will not be  too many casualties. Our young army proved its worth and so did the Red Army. Take Wilno back.
dst: 我们刚刚确保了进攻的位置。复活节很快就要到了，所以请设法在节日前解放该城。我想市民们会帮助您，我也希望不会有太多伤亡。我们年轻的军队证明了自己的价值，红军也是如此。把维尔诺夺回来。

src: We have just secured the position for the assault. Easter is coming so try to liberate the city before the holiday. I think the citizens will help you and I hope there will not be too many casualties. Our young army proved its value as did the Red Army. Take Wilno back.
dst: 我们刚刚为进攻确保了阵地。复活节即将到来，所以请设法在节日之前解放这座城市。我认为市民们会帮助您的，我希望不会造成太多伤亡。我们年轻的军队和红军一样证明了自己的价值。夺回维尔诺。

src: We have lost contact to the enemy armies! It is unclear what will happen and your orders are to keep position.
dst: 我们已与敌军失去接触！接下来会发生什么不得而知，您的命令是坚守阵地。

src: We have lost the initiative on the eastern front.  Another year of senseless fighting in Russia has come and gone..
dst: 我们在东线失去了先手。俄国战场上又一年无谓的厮杀就此过去。

src: We have made breif contact with 6th Army, but, Hitler refused to allow a withdrawl!  4th Panzer Army and our forces struggle hold the corridor open and every day it gets smaller!
dst: 我们已与第6集团军短暂取得联系，但希特勒拒绝允许撤退！第4装甲集团军和我军苦苦撑着这条走廊，而它一天比一天窄！

src: We have made contact with 6th Army, but, Hitler refused to allow a withdrawl!  4th Panzer Army and our forces are to hold this corridor open for the entire winter if need be!
dst: 我们已与第6集团军取得联系，但希特勒拒绝允许撤退！第4装甲集团军和我军须在必要时整个冬季都守住这条走廊！

src: We have made contact with 6th Army, but, Hitler refused to allow a withdrawl!  4th Panzer Army and our forces are to hold this fragile corridor open for the entire winter if need be!
dst: 我们已与第6集团军取得联系，但希特勒拒绝允许撤退！第4装甲集团军和我军须在必要时整个冬季都守住这条脆弱的走廊！

src: We have managed to out maneuver the Allied naval fleets but we will have to defend our landing forces from naval assault from the north and southeast.  Be prepared for this eventuality.  I would wish you good luck, but I expect intelligence and careful planning will serve you better.
dst: 我们已设法在机动上胜过盟军舰队，但还得防备登陆部队遭受来自北面和东南面的海上突击。要为这种可能做好准备。我本想说祝你好运，但我期望情报和周密计划对你更有用。

src: We have missed a great opportunity to end this war.
dst: 我们错失了一个结束这场战争的大好机会。

src: We have moved through the hilly Eifel and are close to the Rhine at Remagen. Parts of the German 7th Army are defending this area. In the north a paratrooper division is blocking the road to Remagen, in the south the last remaining armoured units are defending the airfield near Sinzig. It seems that the Ludendorff Bridge is not yet blown up. If you are fast enough, it could be possible to capture the bridge before it will be destroyed.
dst: 我们已穿过丘陵起伏的艾费尔地区，逼近雷马根附近的莱茵河。德国第7集团军的部分部队正防守这一地区。北面有一个伞兵师封锁着通往雷马根的道路，南面德军最后残存的装甲部队正在防守辛齐希附近的机场。看来鲁登道夫大桥尚未被炸毁。如果你行动够快，有可能在大桥被毁之前夺取它。

src: We have moved your troops into Hungary and it is time for you to lead Operation Waldteufel, the attack to retake Budapest. You must take all of your objectives by March 25th at the latest. However, an earlier completion of your mission is necessary if we are to continue the counteroffensive and drive the Soviets back to Russia.
dst: 我们已将你的部队调入匈牙利，现在该由你指挥「森林魔鬼」行动（Operation Waldteufel），即夺回布达佩斯的进攻。你最迟必须在 3月25日前夺取全部目标。但若我们要继续反攻、把苏联人赶回俄国，就必须更早完成任务。

src: We have nothing to reinforce your men. We don’t have more guns, or planes, or rifles. There aren’t any fresh troops ready to relieve you. We have thrown everything we had against the Entente lines, and they resisted. Now we have nothing left to exploit your success in Kemmel.
dst: 我们已没有任何东西可以增援您的部队。我们没有更多的大炮、飞机或步枪了。也没有任何生力军可以轮换你们。我们已把拥有的一切都投向了协约国战线，而他们顶住了。如今，我们已无力扩大您在凯梅尔的战果。

src: We have orders to attack Leningrad immediately! However, we have too few troops - for reasons unknown to us, many units have already been transfers to Western Europe and the Finns in the north, continue refuse to participate in offensive operations against Leningrad. Thus, the brunt of the attack will be on your troops. Try to pound a breach in the Soviet defensive line and roll up the front from behind.
dst: 我们奉命立即进攻列宁格勒！然而兵力太少——不知何故，许多部队已被调往西欧，而北面的芬兰人仍拒绝参加对列宁格勒的进攻行动。因此，进攻的重担将落在你的部队肩上。设法在苏军防线上砸开一个缺口，然后从后方卷击整条战线。

src: We have perhaps the last possibility to finish our campaign in the east.
dst: 这或许是我们结束东方战役的最后机会。

src: We have pursued the remnants of the enemy all across the desert til the gates of Sollum. It is unlikely that the Senussi will put much effort in defending the city itself, but probably they will try to stop us at the Medean Pass and deny us entering their Libyan homeland. So be prepared to encounter stout resistance in the hills south of Sollum.
dst: 我们一路穿越沙漠追击敌军残部，直至塞卢姆城下。塞努西不大可能花大力气防守城市本身，但他们多半会试图在米迪安隘口阻止我们，不让我们进入他们的利比亚故土。因此，要做好在塞卢姆以南丘陵遭遇顽强抵抗的准备。

src: We have re-established our defenses on the Don, but 4th Panzer Army could not break through and Hitler refused to allow a withdrawl!  4th Panzer Army is withdrawling back across the Chir and has called a General Cousel to discuss Strategy.
dst: 我们已在顿河重建防御，但第4装甲集团军无法突破，希特勒又不允许撤退！第4装甲集团军正撤回奇尔河对岸，并召开军事会议讨论战略。

src: We have reached a critical juncture in our war in Russia. Many generals believe that we should divert your forces to assist Army Group South in its drive to capture Kiev. There does appear to be an opportunity to trap and destroy a large part of the Soviet Army in this area. Other generals believe we should ignore the south and instead send your forces driving directly toward Moscow as soon as supplies can be brought forward, in order to reach there before winter. They believe a move toward Kiev will delay the drive on Moscow and may cause us to fail at the city gates. It appears that high command is leaning toward a drive on Kiev. Your opinion on this matter could sway their decision toward Moscow, but it would surely cost you some of your prestige to voice your opinion regarding such a key decision.
dst: 我们在俄国的战争已到关键时刻。许多将领认为，我们应把你这支部队转用于协助南方集团军群攻取基辅。这一地区看来确实有机会围歼苏军的大部兵力。另一些将领则认为，我们应放弃南线，一俟补给前送就令你的部队直取莫斯科，以求在冬季到来前抵达该城。他们认为转向基辅会迟滞对莫斯科的进攻，可能使我军功败垂成于城下。目前看来，最高统帅部倾向于进攻基辅。你对这一问题的看法可能使他们的决定转向莫斯科，但就如此关键的决策发表意见，必定会使你损失一部分声望。

src: We have reached the last ''hot point'' in Norway. The allies have a good number of troops here, some of our troops are in the area yet, but they have been stopped by the allies. You must break out to Narvik and all the nearby areas. The Kriegsmarine is in the area to help us, but Im sure the Royal Navy will come for disturb our plains... Good luck.
dst: 我们已经抵达挪威最后一个「热点」。盟军在这里部署了大量兵力，我们的一些部队也还在该地区，但他们已被盟军挡住。您必须突围到纳尔维克及其周边所有地区。德国海军在该地区协助我们，但我确信皇家海军会来破坏我们的计划……祝您好运。

src: We have reasons to be optimistic at the Eastern front. Of course, that doesn't mean that we haven't suffered any setbacks lately. The worst of all was the death of our beloved Kaiser Franz Joseph in November. His successor, Karl I, wishes that we could make peace with our enemies. But, sadly, that's an impossible dream. France and the United Kingdom want to hear nothing of that. Our only chance is to keep on fighting, and to do our best.
dst: 在东线，我们有理由感到乐观。当然，这并不意味着我们近来没有遭受挫折。其中最沉痛的是我们敬爱的弗朗茨·约瑟夫皇帝于十一月驾崩。他的继任者卡尔一世希望我们能同敌人议和。但可悲的是，那是一个不可能实现的梦想。法国和英国根本不愿听这些。我们唯一的机会就是继续战斗，并尽力而为。

src: We have recruited an special division in Okinawa, (the ''boeitai'') plus some auxiliary units too. Also, the Yamato group is coming from Japan with fuel for just one way, to aid you with smashing the enemy fleet. Make good use of your brave kamikaze warriors, they can inflict severe casualities upon the enemy warships.
dst: 我们在冲绳征募了一个特别师团（「防卫队」），还有一些辅助部队。此外，大和部队正从日本驶来，所携燃料只够单程，前来协助您粉碎敌军舰队。好好使用您勇敢的神风特攻勇士，他们能对敌军战舰造成严重伤亡。

src: We have requested the alliance loyalty of our old allies, the Medomatrici, and our old friends will come to our aid ...
dst: 我们已向老盟友梅迪奥马特里克斯人请求履行盟约，我们的老朋友会来援助我们 ...

src: We have resources for 3 landings. There is no discussion about landings in Oran and Algiers. But where should the third landing take place?
dst: 我们的资源够发起3处登陆。奥兰与阿尔及尔的登陆无可争议，但第三处登陆该选哪里？

src: We have retaken Kharkov!  In a masterstroke we have corrected the tactical situation brought about by the Stalingrad disaster.  I doubt it could have been achieved without the tireless efforts of the Leibstandarte.  The red square in Kharkov has been renamed 'Leibstandarteplatz' in the divisions honour.
dst: 我们已夺回哈尔科夫！凭借一记神来之笔，我们扭转了斯大林格勒灾难造成的战术困境。我怀疑没有警卫旗队的不懈努力，这一切断难实现。哈尔科夫的红场已更名为“警卫旗队广场”，以表对该师的敬意。

src: We have returned to the Aisne. Our counterattack has broken Germany's neck.
dst: 我们已重返埃纳河。我们的反攻击垮了德国。

src: We have saved the trapped divisions!  We have also stabilised the Army Group South's frontline.  Once again the LSSAH have proven themselves to be the most elite troops of the Waffen SS.
dst: 我们救出了被困的各师！我们还稳定了南方集团军群的战线。警卫旗队再次证明自己是武装党卫军中最精锐的部队。

src: We have seized the Norwegian capital of Oslo, but still the Norwegians and their British allies resist us.  They are attempting to keep us out of the valley leading north from Oslo through Lillehammer.  Your forces are tasked with securing this important communications center.  Good luck, Herr General.
dst: 我们已夺取挪威首都奥斯陆，但挪威人及其英国盟友仍在抵抗。他们正试图阻止我们进入从奥斯陆经利勒哈默尔向北延伸的谷地。你的部队受命夺取这一重要的交通枢纽。祝你好运，将军阁下。

src: We have smashed the Australian forces in the Klidi Pass and we can now move towards Metsovon to cut off the retreat of the Greek 1st Army.
dst: 我们已在克利迪山口击溃澳军，现在可向迈措翁推进，以切断希腊第1集团军的退路。

src: We have started several trials to elimenate the trapped Germans in Courland, but all attempts were not successful. I think your men are more suitable for this mission. Attack on the front between Liepaja and Saldus, break through the German lines and take Pavilosta.
dst: 我们已数次尝试歼灭被困在库尔兰的德军，但所有努力都未成功。我认为你的部下更适合这项任务。在利耶帕亚与萨尔杜斯之间的正面发起进攻，突破德军防线，夺取帕维洛斯塔。

src: We have stopped the offensive, but our casualities have been too high.  You have permission to retreat your armies behind the Han river to avoid future losses.
dst: 我们挡住了这次进攻，但我们的伤亡太大了。允许你把部队后撤到汉江以北，以避免今后的损失。

src: We have succeeded in taking the city of Cherson.  Now we can continue the advance east, by moving with Von Kleists Panzer Group towards Rostov.  We need to take the city before winter sets in.
dst: 我们已成功夺取赫尔松城。现在可随冯·克莱斯特装甲集群继续东进，向罗斯托夫推进。我们必须在冬季来临前拿下该城。

src: We have taken positions on and around the Col di Lana - a mountain that dominates the area. I need to go now, but will write again soon. I expect to have plenty of time to do so because the Italians would be crazy to attack in this terrain.
dst: 我们已在拉纳山及其周边占领了阵地——这座山俯控着整个地区。我现在得走了，但很快会再写信。我想我会有大把时间来写，因为意大利人若在这种地形上进攻，那简直是疯了。

src: We have the unique opportunity to encircle 2 large Soviet Armies in the area west of Minsk. The original Barbarossa battleplan called for this to be done in one huge pincer movement, however the Fuhrer is worried about the risk of large scale breakouts of the trapped Russians. OKH has therefore decided this will be achieved by 2 pincers instead.
dst: 我们有一个独特的机会，可以在明斯克以西地区围歼两个苏联集团军。原“巴巴罗萨”作战计划要求以一次巨大的钳形攻势完成此举，但元首担心被困俄军大规模突围的风险。因此陆军总司令部决定改以两个钳形攻势来实现。

src: We have to move fast. Capture all small islands so we can clear the passage to Scapa Flow. Enemy has many subs and destroyers but you can't use your ships before you clear the area. Also there are many sea mines, so be carefull.
dst: 我们必须迅速行动。夺取所有小岛，这样我们才能打通通往斯卡帕湾的航道。敌人有许多潜艇与驱逐舰，但在肃清该区域之前你无法动用你的舰船。此外还有大量水雷，务必小心。

src: We have to speed up our operations, because on the west to us France and Britain threaten invasion.
dst: 我们必须加快行动，因为在西面，法国与英国正威胁入侵。

src: We have tranferred you to the quiet Italian part of the front. Your assignment is the same as you had with the Roumanians; providing them with the anti-tank capability they lack. We have sent the Italians lots of Bohler guns that are obsolete, but may be better than nothing.
dst: 我们已将您调往意军驻守的平静地段。您的任务与在罗马尼亚军那里时相同：为他们提供所缺乏的反坦克能力。我们已给意大利人送去大量过时的博勒火炮，但聊胜于无。

src: We hear rumors that the High Command of the Army once again fell in disfavor with Sigel and that he will be replaced soon.
dst: 我们听到传言，陆军最高统帅部又一次对西格尔不满，他很快将被撤换。

src: We heared these messages were received on the radio:
dst: 我们听说电台收到了这些消息：

src: We hope you gave Robin Hood and his Merry Men a good beating!
dst: 希望你痛揍了罗宾汉和他的绿林好汉们！

src: We just have taken city of Latron and are now entering the Judean Hills which block our approach to the Holy City. Given the importance of Jerusalem heavy Turkish resistance is to be expected.
dst: 我们刚刚攻占了拉特伦城，如今正进入阻挡我们逼近圣城的朱迪亚丘陵。鉴于耶路撒冷的重要性，预计土耳其人会进行顽强抵抗。

src: We knew that protecting Halen wouldn't be easy, but we really expected more competence and determination from you, Colonel. Well, we don't have time to discuss your poor performance right now. Move your surviving troops to the west and prepare yourself for even harder challenges. You'll have more chances to redeem yourself.
dst: 我们知道保卫哈伦并非易事，但上校，我们原本真的期望您能表现出更多的能力和决心。好了，眼下我们没有时间讨论您的糟糕表现。把您幸存的部队调往西面，准备好迎接更艰巨的挑战。您还会有更多挽回自己的机会。

src: We know that the Serbian defences in the area aren't particularly strong, but you will have to deal with them as soon as you can, before they receive any reinforcements.
dst: 我们知道该地区塞尔维亚人的防御并不是特别强，但您必须尽快解决他们，趁他们还未得到任何增援。

src: We know that the Serbians are well fortified in Kumanovo ans Stip, but the rest of the area is virtually undefended. Good luck!
dst: 我们知道塞尔维亚人在库马诺沃和什蒂普设防严密，但该地区其余地方几乎无人防守。祝您好运！

src: We know that two French divisions and a Russian brigade are ready to assault Kuckoveni and Banitsa from the south. Meanwhile, two recently rebuilt Serbian divisions are gathering near Gornicevo, in the south-east. Just like you did at the Doiran Lake, you will have to hold our positions, repel the enemy troops and, if possible, make a counterattack.
dst: 我们知道，两个法国师和一个俄国旅正准备从南面进攻库茨科韦尼和巴尼察。与此同时，两个刚刚重建的塞尔维亚师正在东南面的戈尔尼切沃附近集结。就像您在多伊兰湖所做的那样，您将必须守住我们的阵地，击退敌军，并在可能的情况下发起反攻。

src: We know that you've recently arrived from El Alamein but the severity of the situation right here demands your services.
dst: 我们知道您刚从阿拉曼赶来，但此地局势的严重性需要您效力。

src: We knowed that the Germans we lead this offensive and we could prepare strong positions. You will have command over the 51th Tank Army. This troops are not so experienced but all refreshed to over strenght. The positions before your deployment positions are secured with landmines.
dst: 我们早已得知德军将发动此次攻势，因而得以构筑坚固阵地。您将指挥第51坦克集团军。这支部队经验不算丰富，但已全部补充至超编兵力。你们部署阵地前方已用地雷加以封锁。

src: We left knowing that, without Vyatka, the Bolsheviks would not be able to defend Nizhni Novgorod and the roads that led to Arkhangelsk, which was occupied by our British allies. The distances that the Siberians would have to cover to get there were really long, so the marches would be very hard, especially in winter. However, I was sure that sooner or later they'd do it.
dst: 我们离开时知道，失去了维亚特卡，布尔什维克将无法守住下诺夫哥罗德以及通往阿尔汉格尔斯克的道路，而阿尔汉格尔斯克正由我们的英国盟友占领着。西伯利亚人要到达那里需要走的路程非常漫长，所以行军会异常艰苦，尤其是在冬天。然而，我确信他们迟早会做到。

src: We lost some of our seaborn recon planes to Bf 109s and Fw190s. Expect a strong axis air force!
dst: 我们损失了一些海上侦察机，被Bf 109和Fw190击落。要提防轴心国强大的空军！

src: We lost the battle for Caen and had to fall back to the beaches. Our whole operation is at threat. You are relieved of your command and are ordered back to London for further consultations.
dst: 我们输掉了卡昂战役，不得不退回海滩。我们的整个行动都受到威胁。你被解除指挥权，奉命返回伦敦等待进一步指示。

src: We managed to drive back both Soviet divisions and Finland is relieved from the crises.
dst: 我们设法击退了两个苏军师，芬兰由此摆脱了危机。

src: We managed to stop the Red Army at the Obi for five days. It doesn't seem much, but it gave us enough time to evacuate our wounded and many civilians in our last trains. Thanks to our resistance, they could travel safely to the east and leave Russia.
dst: 我们设法在鄂毕河挡住了红军五天。这看似微不足道，却为我们赢得了足够的时间，用最后的火车疏散伤员和许多平民。多亏了我们的抵抗，他们才能安全地前往东方，离开俄国。

src: We missed the chance to trap 600,000 Bolsjeviks in what would have been the Kiev pocket. Send your troops back North for the final assault on Moscow. And don't give me any excuses, I know the raspoetitsa - the dreaded Fall rains - have set in. This will disrupt mobility but we do need to reach Moscow before the winter.
dst: 我们错失了把60万布尔什维克困进本可形成的基辅包围圈的机会。把你的部队调回北方，准备对莫斯科的最后突击。别给我找任何借口，我知道“泥泞季”——那可怕的秋雨——已经来了。这会影响机动，但我们必须在入冬前抵达莫斯科。

src: We mobilised thousands of landing crafts and moterboats, figthers and bombers, dozens of cruisers and battleships and we'll carry out the largest landing operation in history.
dst: 我们动员了数千艘登陆艇和摩托艇、战斗机和轰炸机、数十艘巡洋舰和战列舰，将实施史上规模最大的登陆行动。

src: We must act quickly. Take your troops to Kraaipan station, defeat he British garrison and capture the armored train "Mosquito". It's full of rifles, ammunition and other supplies that will be extremely useful to our cause.
dst: 我们必须迅速行动。带您的部队前往克赖潘车站，击败英国守军并夺取装甲列车「蚊子」号。车上装满了步枪、弹药和其他补给，对我们的战事将极为有用。

src: We must admit that those Romanians are a skillful lot. Their 3rd Army has managed to cross the Dunav River at Ryahovo and has stablished a strong bridgehead behind the supply lines of our army in Dobrudzha. Now our entire Romanian offensive is at risk. Thank God that you and your veteran soldiers are in the area. Go for the Romanians and throw them back across the Dunav! There are some Austrian monitors at Ruse, near here, and they'll sail down the Dunav to help you as soon as possible.
dst: 我们必须承认，那些罗马尼亚人是难缠的对手。他们的第3集团军设法在里亚霍沃渡过了多瑙河，并在多布罗加我军补给线后方建立了坚固的桥头堡。如今我们整个罗马尼亚攻势都岌岌可危。感谢上帝，您和您的老兵们就在该地区。去进攻罗马尼亚人，把他们赶回多瑙河对岸！鲁塞附近有几艘奥地利的浅水重炮舰，它们会尽快顺多瑙河而下支援您。

src: We must continue our march. There will be time for celebrations when we win this war.
dst: 我们必须继续行军。等打赢这场战争，有的是时间庆祝。

src: We must delay the German advance at any cost, and give time to the bulk of our army to retreat to the west and the south, and make contact with our French and British allies.
dst: 我们必须不惜一切代价迟滞德军的推进，为我军主力争取时间撤往西面和南面，并与我们的法国和英国盟友取得联系。

src: We must discuss our plan now and then execute it even more quickly.
dst: 我们现在必须讨论计划，然后更加迅速地付诸实施。

src: We must do our best to capture Villa. It will be good for us and for our Mexican allies. We know that he was wounded some days ago in a skirmish against Carranza's troops, and now the Villistas have taken refuge in the village of Guerrero, near the mountains. Our camp isn't far from there, so if we send some fast units to Guerrero, we can have a great opportunity to arrest or kill the bandit Villa.
dst: 我们必须竭尽全力抓住比利亚。这既有利于我们，也有利于我们的墨西哥盟友。我们知道他几天前在与卡兰萨部队的一次交火中负了伤，如今比利亚派已退避到山边的格雷罗村。我们的营地离那里不远，所以只要派几支快速部队前往格雷罗，我们就有大好机会逮捕或击毙匪首比利亚。

src: We must get rid of the Romanians as soon as possible. Our Bulgarian friends, along with some German and Ottoman units, will attack the Romanian divisions in Dobrudscha and the lower Donau.
