In the meantime our main forces, including your elite corps, will attack at the mountains. If you conquer the Rothenturm Pass the way to Bukarest will be open and this battlefront will be pacified. Run, General, there is no time to lose!
dst: 我们必须尽快除掉罗马尼亚人。我们的保加利亚朋友，会同一些德军和奥斯曼部队，将进攻多布罗加和多瑙河下游的罗马尼亚各师。与此同时，我们的主力部队，包括您的精锐军，将在山区发起进攻。如果您攻下罗滕图姆山口，通往布加勒斯特的道路就会打开，这条战线也将就此平定。快行动，将军，刻不容缓！
我们必须守住我们的战线……

src: We must immediatelly, without any delay, renew our offensive actions. We must shatter the whole Soviet line once again for the final time, break through it, destroy the enemy groupings and rush towards Moscow. This is the last blow, after which the Soviets will fall apart, but it must be dealt fast.
dst: 我们必须立即、毫不拖延地恢复进攻行动。我们必须最后一次彻底粉碎整条苏军战线，突破它，消灭敌军集群，直扑莫斯科。这是最后一击，之后苏联人就会土崩瓦解，但必须速战速决。

src: We must keep on advancing before the winter comes. Your next objective will be the city of Minsk.
dst: 我们必须在冬天来临前继续推进。您的下一个目标将是明斯克城。

src: We must keep on advancing before winter comes. Your next objective will be the city of Minsk.
dst: 我们必须在冬天来临之前继续推进。您的下一个目标将是明斯克城。

src: We must not stop now!  We have forced our way over the Perekop isthmus.  Not only is Moscow happy with your results but also the glorious people's army.  Now Wrangel is not in the position to cause more bloodshed.  Blood of the Russian proletariat!  Go forward and hunt down the enemy criminals!
dst: 我们现在绝不能停下！我们已经强行越过了彼列科普地峡。不仅莫斯科对您的战果满意，光荣的人民军队也满意。如今弗兰格尔已无力再制造更多流血。俄国无产阶级的鲜血！继续前进，追猎敌方的罪犯！

src: We must now face the inevitable - the war is over.
dst: 我们现在必须面对不可避免的结局——战争结束了。

src: We must now move on to capture the city of Caen.  It has been an objective since day one of our landings in Normandy, and the Germans are still holding onto it.  Also, it is considered vital that we establish a foothold over the Orne River, and taking Caen would give us exactly that.  To assist in this operation, your advance will be preceded by a large aerial bombardment of the German defences.
dst: 我们现在必须继续夺取卡昂城。自诺曼底登陆第一天起它就是我们的目标，而德军至今仍据守不放。此外，在奥恩河上建立立足点被视为至关重要，夺取卡昂恰能给我们这一点。为协助此次行动，你的推进将先以对德军阵地的大规模空袭开路。

src: We must order the complete retreat !
dst: 我们必须下令全面撤退！
我们必须向前推进，少将！

src: We must push through to the Vistula River before the Polish forces can strengthen their defences.
dst: 我们必须赶在波兰军队加固防线前，推进至维斯瓦河。

src: We must re-establish contact with our right and left quickly!  Go quickly, tell your men their bravado is remarkable and my gratitude has no end, Italia has a picture of everyone of them in the Rome catherdral, praying for their safety amid this winter!
dst: 我们必须迅速恢复与左右两翼的联系！快去，告诉你的部下，他们的勇猛令人赞叹，我的感激无尽；意大利在罗马大教堂里挂着他们每个人的照片，为他们在寒冬中的平安祈祷！

src: We must smash the feeble Belgium army. A lightning victory is required to sweep thru the lower countries.
dst: 我们必须击垮孱弱的比利时军队。需要一场闪电般的胜利来席卷低地国家。

src: We must spend time to rebuild our troops health and morale, this small victory came at great cost.  Hopefully the Soviets are more weary of this winter war than we and are ready to talk peace.
dst: 我们必须花时间恢复部队的体力和士气，这场小胜代价沉重。但愿苏联人对这场冬季战争比我们更疲惫，愿意和谈。

src: We must stop the Allies from gaining a foothold on Italy in order to get them to talk a negotiated peace.  If we can take the landing areas thus trapping the Allied troops inland, they are sure to grant our terms for peace.  You and your men have fought valliangtly for the past 5 years, but never before were you defending the shores of Italia!
dst: 我们必须阻止盟军在意大利立足，好让他们愿意谈判议和。若能夺取登陆地区、从而把盟军困在内陆，他们必定会接受我们的和平条件。你和你的人过去五年英勇作战，但从未像现在这样保卫意大利的海岸！

src: We must stop. While you were crushing the Italian divisions in the mountains, the Russians launched a counterattack in the east. Our units were taken by surprise, and now all the Eastern Front could collapse. We must send all our reserves there as soon as we can, or all could be lost in a matter of days. We can't continue our offensive here.
dst: 我们必须停下。正当您在山中击溃意大利各师之际，俄国人在东线发动了反攻。我们的部队措手不及，如今整条东线都可能崩溃。我们必须尽快把所有预备队派往那里，否则数日之内一切尽失。我们无法在这里继续进攻。

src: We must surrender to the British....'Gentlemen, here my Saber...'
dst: 我们不得不向英国人投降……「先生们，这是我的军刀……」

src: We must take advantage of this situation, General! It is most important to advance quickly to the east and recover our lost territories before the Russians have time to recover or the League of Nations forces us to sign an armistice...
dst: 将军，我们必须抓住这个机会！最重要的是快速向东推进，收复失去的领土，赶在俄国人恢复过来、或国联迫使我们签署停战协定之前……

src: We must take advantage of this situation. Knowing that the Russians can barely defend themselves, we'll launch an offensive against Riga, the pearl of the Baltic. Maybe that will finally convince Kerenski to give in before it's too late for him.
dst: 我们必须利用这一局面。既然知道俄国人几乎无力自守，我们将对波罗的海的明珠里加发起进攻。也许这最终能说服克伦斯基在为时已晚之前屈服。

src: We need commanders like you urgently...confirm your appointment as general of your troops for the time being
dst: 我们急需像您这样的指挥官……暂时确认任命您为您所率部队的将军。

src: We need to investigate the nature of the situation.  Mobilize your men and secure the surrounding area.  In all likelihood, we're in safe hands, but there's no reason not to play it safe.
dst: 我们需要查明情况的性质。动员你的部下，控制周边区域。十有八九我们是安全的，但谨慎一些总没坏处。

src: We need to perform more investigative work and figure out what German soldiers are doing here.  I'll clue you in when we've got a plan.
dst: 我们需要做更多调查，弄清德国士兵在这里干什么。等我们有了计划，我会通知你。

src: We need to push eastwards and cross the Narva and Luga Rivers, so we can prepare our advance on Leningrad and Novgorod.
dst: 我们需要向东推进并渡过纳尔瓦河与卢加河，以便为进攻列宁格勒与诺夫哥罗德做准备。

src: We need to solve it quickly, otherwise the enemy will have a possible beach head  in our backyard.
dst: 我们必须迅速解决此事，否则敌人就可能在我们的后院获得一个登陆场。

src: We need to take part in a chase after the Russian Army and liberate the Polish soil.
dst: 我们需要参与追击俄军，解放波兰的土地。

src: We need you more than ever, General. If you fail, the Italians will annex Görz and Triest, and they won't stop there. Krain could fall, too, and then the gate to Österreich would be open. It could be easily the end of the Empire.
dst: 我们比以往任何时候都更需要您，将军。您若失败，意大利人就会吞并戈尔茨与的里雅斯特，而且他们不会就此止步。克赖因也可能陷落，届时通往奥地利的大门就会洞开。那很可能就是帝国的末日。

src: We need your skills more than ever, General. We were not ready to fight at two fronts at the same time, and the future of the Empire is at risk in any of them. The Emperor has granted you the honour of making an important decision. Where do you choose to fight next? Depending on your answer, you could find glory or disgrace.
dst: 我们比以往任何时候都更需要您的才干，将军。我们还没有准备好同时在两条战线作战，而帝国的前途在任何一条战线上都岌岌可危。皇帝赐予您做出一个重大决定的荣耀。您接下来选择在哪里作战？您的选择将决定您是赢得荣耀，还是蒙受耻辱。

src: We never did get the chance to discuss your Spanish experiences, let us talk of how this operation was successful also.
dst: 我们一直没机会聊你的西班牙经历，现在谈谈这次行动是如何同样成功的吧。

src: We no longer require your services. Goodbye general.
dst: 我们不再需要您的效劳了。再见，将军。

src: We now expect the Americans and British to launch an attack on Sicily and Southern Italy. At a minimum, you must put up a stubborn defense and hold at least three objectives until after September 8th. Ideally, you will hold at least ten objectives. Good luck, you will need it.
dst: 我们现在预计美英联军将对西西里和意大利南部发起进攻。你至少要顽强防守，将不少于三个目标坚守到9月8日之后。最理想的情况是守住至少十个目标。祝你好运，你会需要它的。

src: We now expect the Russians to poor in troops in order to march on the Chir, be ready for an attack from the east.
dst: 我们现在预计俄国人会大量投入兵力，以便向奇尔河推进，要做好从东面遭到进攻的准备。

src: We now have an airfield close to Alexandria. That will help our advance on the city. But be aware that the British army and their allies still have a large number of troops in this area.
dst: 我们如今在亚历山大港附近有了一座机场。这将有助于我们向该城推进。但要注意，英国军队及其盟友在该地区仍有大量部队。

src: We now have to advance further northeast trough the desert. The minarets of Alexandria will soon be in sight at the horizon. But be cautious, the British still have a considerable number of troops in this area.
dst: 我们现在必须继续穿越沙漠向东北推进。亚历山大的宣礼塔很快将出现在地平线上。但要谨慎，英国人仍在该地区驻扎着相当数量的部队。

src: We owe much of that to you, General. You've guided your troops with skill and determination, and you'll be remembered as one true American hero. I know that you're planning to retire, but may I suggest that you start a career in politics? Your country still needs you, and you could make a difference in Washington. At least, think about it.
dst: 这一切在很大程度上要归功于您，将军。您以才干和决心统率部队，将被铭记为一位真正的美国英雄。我知道您打算退役，但我能否建议您投身政坛？您的国家仍需要您，您在华盛顿定能有所作为。至少，考虑一下吧。

src: We picked up vague rumors of Mussolini having declared war on England and France. That is probably exaggerated, so make your stay in this sea of sand as comfortable as possible.
dst: 我们听到一些含糊的传言，说墨索里尼已对英法宣战。这大概言过其实，所以就请你在沙海里尽量过得舒坦些吧。

src: We proclaim you to be the Commander in Chief of our Expeditionary forces ...
dst: 我们宣布您为远征军总司令……

src: We reacted quickly. We arrested and executed all the leaders of the Yihetuan that we could find. The remaining members of the militias were forced to swear loyalty to our own units and were put under the control of some of our best army officers. Those who refused were massacred.
dst: 我们迅速做出反应。我们逮捕并处决了所能找到的所有义和团头目。剩下的团民被迫向我们的部队宣誓效忠，并被置于我们一些最优秀的军官的统辖之下。拒不从命者则遭到屠杀。

src: We really expected more of you. I'm afraid that you aren't prepared for a modern battle. You'll be transferred to an administrative position for the rest of the war.
dst: 我们原本对您期望更高。恐怕您还没有为现代战斗做好准备。战争余下的时间里，您将被调往行政岗位。

src: We received a message from our base at Jan Mayen that some British ships are moving close to the island. We believe that the enemy will try to attack to our submarine base. Our new Radar Cruiser is Southeast of the island and is now under your command.
dst: 我们收到扬马延岛基地的消息，称有一些英国舰船正接近该岛。我们认为敌人会试图攻击我们的潜艇基地。我们的新雷达巡洋舰位于该岛东南方，现归你指挥。

src: We regret that we must inform you that we will not be able to send you Support because at the moment all Connections are in the Hand of our Enemy.
dst: 我们遗憾地通知您，我们暂时无法向您提供支援，因为目前所有交通线都掌握在敌人手中。

src: We send your corps as reinforcement of our front.
dst: 我们派您的军作为前线的增援。

src: We shall claim most of northeastern Yugoslavia by right of conquest, we shall attack 1 day before the Germans do!  Take Ljubjana QUICKLY, there should be only light resistance, so we can beat the Germans to Zagreb!  Gods-speed!
dst: 我们将凭征服权占据南斯拉夫东北大部，我们要比德军早一天发起进攻！迅速夺取卢布尔雅那——那里应该只有轻微抵抗，这样我们就能抢在德军之前抵达萨格勒布！一路顺风！

src: We should be very careful, and protect our back through many scouts and a large reserve ....
dst: 我们必须非常小心，用大量斥候和一支强大的预备队护住背后 ....

src: We should concentrate on our goals in the west; our cavalry corps will be very useful later there..
dst: 我们应该把精力集中在西面的目标上；我们的骑兵军稍后在那里会大有用处……

src: We should encircle the city and prepare for a relief attack from the southeast; because our spies have reported the landing of enemy veteran forces from Greece .....
dst: 我们应当包围该城，并防备来自东南方向的解围进攻；因为我们的探子已报来敌军老兵部队自希腊登陆的消息 .....

src: We should have stormed the French artillery batteries located on the west bank of the Maas from the very beginning, but now it's too late to regret that mistake. You must correct it now, but be careful. It won't be an easy task. The French are heavily entrenched, and from the higher terrain they'll be able to spot all of your moves. But if your troops are fast, they`ll reach the objectives before the enemy sends its reserves.
dst: 我们本该从一开始就强攻马斯河西岸的法军炮兵阵地，但现在后悔这个错误已经太迟了。您必须现在去纠正它，但要小心。这不是件容易的事。法军已深沟高垒，而且他们能从较高的地形上观察到您的一举一动。但如果您的部队行动迅速，就能在敌人派出预备队之前抵达目标。

src: We should keep some pp in reserve, if we might be necessary to refresh our troops.... draw battered troops and those without ammunition from the first line and replace them immediately...
dst: 我们应该预留一些声望点数，以备必要时补充部队……把伤亡惨重的部队和没有弹药的部队从前线撤下，立即替换……

src: We should not try to occupy the settlements in the north-east, there we should retreat for the moment and try to build up a line of defense.
dst: 我们不该试图占据东北的定居点，那里应当先退一步，设法建立一道防线。

src: We spend weeks travelling down the Mississippi and once we arrived at New Orleans, we had to board ocean going transport ships.
dst: 我们花了几周时间沿密西西比河而下，一到新奥尔良，就必须登上远洋运输船。

src: We started our offensive some days ago, assaulting Nizza. However, the French defences at the Italian border have proved to be very strong. If we want to invade southern France, we must think about a different strategy.
dst: 几天前我们发起了攻势，攻打尼斯。然而，意大利边境上的法军防御证明十分坚固。如果我们想入侵法国南部，就必须另想一套战略。

src: We still don't know how they got here or what their purpose behind such a large military establishment is, but we do need you to take your troops and seize the ports here along the coast.  With their supplies disrupted, it should be easier to contain the German forces.
dst: 我们仍不知道他们是怎么来到这里的，也不知道他们建立如此庞大的军事据点目的何在，但我们确实需要你率部夺取沿海的这些港口。切断他们的补给后，遏制德军应当会更容易。

src: We still have a weak point at the Perekop Isthmus. Should it fall, all of Crimea would be in danger. Wrangel has ordered me to go there and command its defence, and I'll go there as soon as possible. It's more that just my duty: my family's safety depends on it. Katya, the children and Olga, Anatoly's wife, who is expecting her first child, have been evacuated to Simferopol, so I must do my best in order to prevent the Reds from taking Crimea.
dst: 我们在彼列科普地峡仍有一个薄弱点。一旦它失守，整个克里米亚都将陷入危险。弗兰格尔命令我去那里指挥防御，我会尽快动身。这不仅仅是我的职责：我家人的安危都系于此。卡佳、孩子们，以及阿纳托利那位正怀着第一个孩子的妻子奥莉加，都已被疏散到辛菲罗波尔，所以我必须竭尽全力阻止红军攻占克里米亚。

src: We successfully defended our homeland, and bloody avenged ourselves on the Romans ...!
dst: 我们成功守住了家园，并血腥地向罗马人报了仇 ...！

src: We suffered heavy losses. But our encircle operation could still be completed successfully...
dst: 我们损失惨重。但我们的合围行动仍有可能成功完成……

src: We thank you and your troops for there efforts during this campaign, the Allies can be quite stubborn, but at least we prevented the French from escaping, no?
dst: 我们感谢你和你部队在这场战役中的努力，盟军相当顽固，但至少我们阻止了法军逃脱，不是吗？

src: We think that a new Italian offensive is imminent, and that it can be the worst that we've endured so far. Thank God that you're here. Your men already know the terrain, and when the Italians attack you'll know how to stop them. If you don't, we'll be in serious trouble.
dst: 我们认为意大利的新攻势迫在眉睫，而且可能是迄今我们承受的最猛烈的一次。谢天谢地您在这里。您的部下已经熟悉地形，意大利人进攻时，您会知道如何挡住他们。否则，我们将陷入严重的麻烦。

src: We thought it sensible to let your battered troops stay put for a few days. After that you will have to move to the Italian sector of the front to stand in for the armoured division that participates in our counteroffensive
dst: 我们认为让您疲惫的部队原地休整数日是明智之举。此后您必须转移到意军防区，去接替那支参加我军反攻的装甲师

src: We thought that we could break through the Italian lines much faster than you actually did. Well, it doesn't matter. We've taken thousands of prisoners, and Austria-Hungary is safe for the moment. The Italians won't dare to attack them for some time.
dst: 我们原以为突破意军防线的速度会比您的实际表现快得多。不过也无所谓了。我们俘获了数千名战俘，奥匈帝国暂时安全了。意大利人一段时间内不敢再进攻他们。

src: We told you to put an end to this war, but you couldn't accomplish your mission. Maybe you aren't as prepared for modern warfare as we thought. We'll send you to an administrative position, where you'll still be useful. Good luck with your paperwork.
dst: 我们让您结束这场战争，但您没能完成任务。也许您对现代战争的准备并没有我们想的那么充分。我们会把您调到行政岗位上去，在那里您还能派上用场。祝您在文书工作中好运。

src: We took a few prisoners this time, and from the sounds of it, these scumbags fled here on two or three submarines to Mexico immediately after the end of the war, thinking they could rebuild an army and eventually retake their homeland from the joint Allied occupation.  Lunacy, if you ask me, Commander, but evidently they had enough weapons experts and scientists to make it happen.  And from the sounds of it, they might have been planning this little home away from home since the early 1930s.
dst: 这次我们抓了几个俘虏，从他们的说法看，这些混蛋在战争结束后立即乘两三艘潜艇逃到了墨西哥，以为能重建一支军队，最终从盟军联合占领下夺回他们的故土。要我看来，纯属痴心妄想，指挥官，但显然他们有足够的武器专家和科学家把它付诸实施。而且听起来，他们可能从 1930 年代初就开始筹划这个小小的「海外家园」了。

src: We took this goddamned iceberg from the Danes during the war and we're sure as hell not going to give it up now.  Construction on the airbase at Thule has been underway for at least a year and it might take another just to lay the finishing touches.  When it's done, this base is going to give us one of the straightest shots for a bomber run into mother Russia herself.
dst: 战时我们从丹麦人手里抢下了这座该死的冰山，现在我们绝不会再吐出去。图勒空军基地的施工至少已进行了一年，恐怕还得再花一年才能收尾。等它建成，这座基地将为我们提供一条直插俄罗斯本土的轰炸航线。

src: We tried again and again, but this time the Bolsheviks were too powerful. Many civilians and soldiers died or were captured by the Red Army, and the rest of us could barely escape to fight another day.
dst: 我们一次又一次地尝试，但这一次布尔什维克太强大了。许多平民和士兵死亡或被红军俘虏，我们剩下的人勉强逃脱，改日再战。

src: We tried really hard, but the Italian defences resisted. Your advance was minimal, and now that fresh enemy divisions are reinforcing their comrades, I’m afraid that we’ll have to retire to our starting positions.
dst: 我们非常努力地尝试了，但意大利人的防线挺住了。您的推进微乎其微，如今敌军生力师正在增援他们的战友，恐怕我们不得不撤回出发阵地。

src: We underestimated the Spanish army. They really know how to fight, and we're lucky that they finally decided to retreat in order once they learnt that they wouldn't receive any reinforcements from Santiago.
dst: 我们低估了西班牙军队。他们确实很会打仗，而我们也算幸运，他们得知不会从圣地亚哥获得任何援军后，最终决定有序撤退。

src: We understand now why the Anzacs found Gallipolli so hard to conquer!
dst: 我们现在明白澳新军团为何觉得加里波利如此难以攻占了！

src: We understand your garrison was no match for the hundreds of tanks that attacked your positions. We are glad you escaped captivity Capitano.
dst: 我们明白，你的守备队抵挡不住进攻你阵地的数百辆坦克。我们很高兴你逃脱了被俘，上尉。

src: We urgently need to regain the offensive on the Eastern front to deal the Red Army a blow that will weaken its offensive potential for a very long time to come. That will allow us to concentrate on the probable invasion by the Western Allies of either Southern Europe or France.
dst: 我们迫切需要在东线重新夺回主动权，给红军一记重击，使其进攻潜力在很长一段时间内难以恢复。这样我们才能集中精力应对西方盟国很可能对南欧或法国发动的入侵。

src: We want avoid large troop movements for our big offensives, so we have decided that an army stays in the region, whrere it is deployed. You have to come to a decision, where you want to fight. You have three options:
dst: 我们希望避免为大规模攻势进行大范围部队调动，因此决定让各集团军留在其部署地区。你必须做出决定：你想在哪里作战。你有三个选项：

src: We went most of the way to Omdurman by train, so on 1st September we were already in Egeiga, within six miles of our destination and close to the bank of the Nile, where a gunboat flotilla waited in support. I knew that the Dervish army had camped very close to our lines, on the neighbouring hills. In the morning they would try to use their numerical superiority to their advantage, forcing us to retreat to the river shore, where they could destroy us.
dst: 前往恩图曼的大部分路程我们都是乘火车走的，所以9月1日我们已抵达埃盖加，距目的地不到六英里，靠近尼罗河岸，那里有一支炮艇编队待命支援。我知道德尔维希军队就驻扎在离我们战线很近的邻近山丘上。早晨，他们将试图利用其数量优势，迫使我们退向河岸，好在那里歼灭我们。

src: We were able to capture New York, the US East Coast and the Gulf of Mexico while the Japanese captured San Diego, Los Angeles and San Francisco, as well as the Panama Canal. US Forces still control the Great Plains and Rocky Mountains area and the West Coast from San Francisco up to Seattle and Vancouver.
dst: 我们得以夺取纽约、美国东海岸和墨西哥湾，而日本人则占领了圣迭戈、洛杉矶和旧金山，以及巴拿马运河。美军仍控制着大平原和落基山脉地区，以及从旧金山到西雅图和温哥华的西海岸。

src: We were able to recruit cossacks and mobilise them against the Red Army. A free cossack unit will be added to your core!
dst: 我们得以招募哥萨克人，并动员他们对抗红军。一支免费的哥萨克单位将加入你的核心部队！

src: We were disappointed with your poor results in Normandy,  however, due to your previous successes, we have decided to allow you to honorably retire from service.
dst: 你在诺曼底战绩不佳，令我们失望；但鉴于你此前的战功，我们决定允许你体面地退出现役。

src: We were disappointed with your poor results in Normandy. Your performance must improve or the war will soon be lost.
dst: 你在诺曼底战绩不佳，令我们失望。你的表现必须有所改观，否则战争很快就要失败。

src: We were expecting those British and French reinforcements. You see we want to make a Kessel - like the ones in Poland - around the British and French armies here in northern France and Belgium. You've cut them off from the coast while the rest of our army has cut them off from France. Now it is up to you to close the ring!
dst: 我们早就料到会有英法援军。你看，我们想在此处法国北部和比利时，像在波兰那样，对英法军队形成一个合围圈。你已把他们与海岸隔绝，而其余部队已把他们与法国隔绝。现在就靠你来合拢这个包围圈了！

src: We were given improved panzers, so finally our Spanish friends could take our old ones. But few of them had mechanical problems with [blacked out] and hence just [blacked out] could join us. The enemy held the bridge across the [blacked out] river that crosses the path up to [blacked out]. With the help of [blacked out] that bombed their positions, we've forced the crossing, but there was so much smoke, noise, shooting and rumpus that I was really scared. But our commander lead us across the river and further to the village, where we've met the enemy again. They had several tanks, too. I don't remember much, it was like if I looked through the mist.
dst: 我们分到了改进型的装甲车，于是我们的西班牙朋友终于能接手我们淘汰的旧车了。但他们中有几辆因为［被涂黑］的机械故障，所以只有［被涂黑］跟上了我们。敌军据守着横跨［被涂黑］河的那座桥，而这条河正好挡在通往［被涂黑］的路上。在［被涂黑］轰炸了他们阵地的帮助下，我们强渡了这条河，但现场烟尘、噪音、枪声和喧嚣实在太多，我真的很害怕。不过我们的指挥官带着我们渡过了河，一路推进到村庄，在那里又遇到了敌人。他们也有几辆坦克。我记不太清了，就像隔着雾气在看一样。

src: We were lucky not to be pushed back into the sea!! We need to gain these objectives or our operations here in the Dardanelles will fail!
dst: 我们侥幸没有被赶回海里！！我们必须拿下这些目标，否则我们在达达尼尔海峡的作战就将失败！

src: We were not going to tolerate that. The final victory against the communists was too close for that. We travelled as fast as we could and we deployed our forces south of Klin. We were eager to win a last battle against the hateful Soviets.
dst: 我们决不容忍。对共产党人的最终胜利已近在咫尺，不能让他们得逞。我们以最快的速度行军，在克林以南展开兵力。我们渴望打赢对可恨苏维埃的最后一仗。

src: We were pleased with your initial success in driving deep into Russia.
dst: 你初期深入俄国的战果令我们满意。

src: We were so badly outnumbered that we knew that defeating the Bolsheviks was impossible. The only thing that we could do was to resist for a few weeks, avoiding to be trapped by the Soviet pincers, and giving the civilians enough time to be evacuated to Siberia, where we could continue the resistance.
dst: 我们在兵力上处于如此悬殊的劣势，深知击败布尔什维克是不可能的。我们唯一能做的就是再坚守几周，避免被苏维埃的钳形攻势合围，并给平民争取足够的时间疏散到西伯利亚，以便在那里继续抵抗。

src: We were so close this time...Now we'll have to go on the defensive again, waiting for the reaction of the Italians, and hoping that we'll be able to stop them just as we've done up to now. At least now we control some strategical positions, and they can be useful in the future, if we ever have another chance to strike our enemies.
dst: 这一次我们离胜利如此之近……如今我们只能再次转入防御，等待意大利人的反应，指望能像迄今所做的那样挡住他们。至少现在我们控制了一些战略要地，倘若将来还有机会打击敌人，这些阵地会派上用场。

src: We were so close... Our offensive ended on the right bank of the Tobol river, after having forced the Red Army to retreat more than 25 Russian miles. It was a great victory. However,  it wasn't good enough. Our enemies were beaten, but too many of them had survived. We had thrown everything that we had at them, and they were still capable of fighting back. They would recover themselves, and they would eventually crush us.
dst: 我们曾如此接近……我们的攻势在托博尔河右岸结束，此前已迫使红军后撤了25俄里以上。这是一场伟大的胜利。然而，这还不够好。敌人被击退了，但太多人幸存了下来。我们倾尽全力扑向他们，他们却仍能反击。他们会恢复过来，最终将我们击垮。

src: We were very disappointed by your inability to take Cairo. This has given the Americans the perfect opportunity to invade Northwest Africa. You are being re-assigned.
dst: 你未能夺取开罗，令我们极为失望。这给了美国人入侵西北非的绝佳机会。你将被调任他职。

src: We were very disappointed that you were unable to complete your mission on Crete successfully. You are to report back to Berlin for re-assignment.
dst: 你未能成功完成克里特岛上的任务，我们极为失望。着你回柏林报到，另行分配职务。

src: We were very disappointed with your inability to stop their forces, and unfortuately, they continue to push us back and threaten our very existence.  You have been relieved of duty.
dst: 你无力阻止敌军，令我们极为失望；不幸的是，他们继续把我们逼退，威胁到我们的生存。你已被解除职务。

src: We were very disappointed with your performance in Yugoslavia and Greece. It is time for you to prove that you are worthy to be a Panzer General.
dst: 你在南斯拉夫与希腊的表现令我们非常失望。现在该由你证明自己配得上装甲元帅这一称号。

src: We will attack Tobruk again once the first units of the 15th Panzer Division have arrived.
dst: 等第15装甲师的首批部队抵达，我们将再次进攻托布鲁克。

src: We will attack the Anyera from Ceuta in the north and from Tetuan in the south. You will command the northern attack. On the south we'll have the support of our old enemy, El Raisuli. The Anyera don't follow him, either, so he sees this campaign as an opportunity to gain more power and wealth. Besides, his past defeats have convinced him that he'd better see Spain as an ally, not as an enemy. At least for the moment, we can count on him.
dst: 我们将从北面的休达和南面的得土安同时向安耶拉发起进攻。您将指挥北路的进攻。在南路，我们将得到老对手赖苏利的支援。安耶拉人也不听命于他，所以他把这次战役看作获取更多权力和财富的机会。此外，过去的失败已经让他明白，最好把西班牙当作盟友而非敌人。至少眼下，我们可以指望他。

src: We will be working closely with our allies, the Spanish Nationalists and the Italians.  Our friends the Italians have brought to this battle one of their elite units, an infantry unit with mountain training.  Use this unit with caution.  It is with us to gain experience, not to sacrifice itself needlessly.  It will be needed in future battles and must survive.  If we do well here we may gain an important ally in Spain as well.
dst: 我们将与盟友西班牙民族主义者和意大利人紧密合作。我们的朋友意大利人为这场战斗带来了一支精锐部队——一支受过山地训练的步兵部队。谨慎使用这支部队。它是来积累经验的，不是来做无谓牺牲的。未来战斗还用得着它，它必须存活。若我们在这里表现出色，或许还能在西班牙赢得一个重要盟友。

src: We will now run this war in the only sensible way. This means we will retreat to the Seine, and concentrate all efforts on making an honourable peace.
dst: 我们现在将以唯一明智的方式打这场战争。这意味着我们将退往塞纳河，并把全部努力集中于缔结一项体面的和平。

src: We will see what the HQ plans for my corps....
dst: 我们且看司令部对我的军作何打算……

src: We will soon see one of the first mass paratroop drops in history! The paratroopers will help to occupy key areas and tactical points and will assist the advancing ground units in their attempt to quickly overrun the Dutch Army.
dst: 我们很快就将见证历史上最早的大规模伞降之一！伞兵将协助占领关键地区和战术要点，并支援推进中的地面部队，助其迅速击溃荷兰军队。

src: We won't be generous with those double-crossing traitors. Venedig will be incorporated, once again, into our Empire, and the Kingdom of Italy will be split into several, independent states. The days of Italian unity are over.
dst: 我们绝不会对这群背信弃义的叛徒心慈手软。威尼斯将再次并入我们的帝国，意大利王国将被肢解为若干个独立小国。意大利统一的日子一去不复返了。

src: We won, but Caesar admonishes us to get better in the next battle!
dst: 我们赢了，但凯撒告诫我们下一战要打得更好！

src: We'll attack Serbia from all sides. The Bulgarians will come from the east, taking Nis and Macedonia. The German 11th Army will invade northeastern Serbia, and finally we'll cross the Drina and the Danau from the west and the north. This time our enemies won't have a chance.
dst: 我们将从四面八方进攻塞尔维亚。保加利亚人将自东面进攻，夺取尼什与马其顿。德国第11集团军将入侵塞尔维亚东北部，而我们最后将从西面和北面渡过德里纳河与多瑙河。这次我们的敌人不会有任何机会。

src: We'll be glad to go with you to Wilno to offer our victory to Our Lady of Gate of Dawn. May our Lord give you a long and prosperous life.
dst: 我们很乐意与您一同前往维尔诺，将我们的胜利敬献给黎明之门圣母。愿上帝赐予您长寿而富足的一生。

src: We'll have time to talk about your incompetent leadership later. Thank God that the British and the Russians have won this battle for you. We must exploit this victory and advance into Peking as soon as possible. The foreign legations must be relieved, no matter the cost.
dst: 关于您无能的指挥，我们以后再谈。谢天谢地，英国人和俄国人替您打赢了这场仗。我们必须利用这次胜利，尽快向北京推进。不惜一切代价，也要解救各国外交使团。

src: We'll have to be careful, though. The Boxers are just scum, but there are some units of the Qing army, experienced and with decent equipment. We could pay a heavy price if we're overconfident.
dst: 不过我们得小心。义和团不过是一群乌合之众，但清军中有些部队经验丰富、装备也不错。倘若我们过于自负，可能会付出沉重代价。

src: We'll need skillful officers to complete that goal. Jean-Babtiste Bertaux-Levillain, we know your service record, and we think that you can be one of those men. Are you willing to serve your homeland whenever and wherever she needs you? Are you willing to make Germany pay for the humiliation that they inflicted on France? We know you are. You won't regret this chance. Fight for your country and bring it back to greatness. Ils ne passeront pas!
dst: 要达成这一目标，我们需要能干的军官。让-巴蒂斯特·贝尔托-勒维兰，我们知道您的服役记录，我们认为您能够成为那样的人。您愿意在任何时候、任何地方为祖国效力吗？您愿意让德国为强加给法国的屈辱付出代价吗？我们知道您愿意。您不会为这个机会后悔。为您的祖国而战，让它重现伟大。他们休想通过！

src: We'll never force the French to surrender if things keep on going like this. The Alpenkorps will need to do it better next time. I'd like to get rid of you, but we can't afford it. We need to use all the men that are available. So go back to the front and keep on fighting until the battle is over. After that, there will be a new mission waiting for you.
dst: 如果事情继续这样下去，我们永远也无法迫使法国投降。阿尔卑斯军下次必须做得更好。我很想撤换您，但我们承担不起。我们必须动用所有可用的人手。所以回到前线去，继续战斗，直到战役结束。之后，还会有新的任务等着您。
我们再也不会离开: 喀山

src: We're all ready when you are.  Carter out.
dst: 我们随时听候你的号令。卡特 完毕。

src: We're finally going to see action in Operation Barbarossa.  13th Panzer Division is advancing on Dubno and we are going to act in support incase of any Russian counter-attacks.  I wouldnt worry much about the Soviets though, they seem to be in complete disarray.  For them to counter-attack is utterly proposterous!
dst: 我们终于要在巴巴罗萨行动中见仗了。第13装甲师正朝杜布诺推进，我们将担任支援，以防俄军反攻。不过我并不怎么担心苏军，他们似乎已完全乱作一团。他们竟能反攻，实在荒谬！

src: We're just a couple of miles from Santiago, and it seems that Linares hasn't learnt from his mistakes. Yes, he has established strong defensive positions at San Juan and Kettle hills, and at El Caney, too, but he's sent just a few hundred men there.  Most of the Spanish soldiers are still in Santiago, waiting for a Cuban attack that will never come. Their presence there is completely useless, and that's great for our plans. When San Juan and El Caney fall, Santiago will be completely encircled and the Spaniards will be trapped there. Their only option will be surrender.
dst: 我们距离圣地亚哥只有几英里了，而利纳雷斯似乎并未从错误中吸取教训。是的，他确实在圣胡安山、凯特尔山以及埃尔卡内建立了坚固的防御阵地，但他只派了几百人去那里。大部分西班牙士兵仍待在圣地亚哥，等待着一场永远不会到来的古巴进攻。他们在那里毫无用处，这对我们的计划来说太棒了。一旦圣胡安与埃尔卡内陷落，圣地亚哥将被完全包围，西班牙人将困守其中。他们唯一的选择就是投降。

src: We're on the thresh-hold of conquering all that the Italians had lost, the last resistance point is founded here in Mogadishu. Be careful, don't under-estimate the Royal Navy
dst: 我们即将征服意大利人失去的一切，最后的抵抗点就设在摩加迪沙。请当心，不要低估皇家海军

src: We've already fought in these regions during the previous war. There are many Germans lying around. I fear that unless something happens, we'll once again fill those good ol' graveyards with bodies of our boys.
dst: 我们上一次战争时就在这些地区打过仗。这一带躺着许多德国人。我担心，除非出现转机，我们会再一次用我们小伙子的尸体填满那些老坟场。

src: We've also been able to use the intervening weeks to make a new model of tank combat-operational for the lunar mission.  This tank is equipped with a high powered energy weapon that will help break the front lines.  I even was able to secure one on permanent lease to the A.O.unit, providing it survives combat.
dst: 我们还利用这中间的几周，为登月任务打造出了一种新型坦克并投入战斗值班。这种坦克装备了一门高能能量武器，有助于撕开前线。我甚至设法以永久租借的方式给 A.O. 部队弄到了一辆，前提是它能在战斗中幸存下来。

src: We've been attached to the 11th Army and have been ordered to advance on the city of Cherson.  All over the front our armies continue to push the Soviets back - make sure it continues.  Expect heavy resistance within the city itself.
dst: 我们已配属第11集团军，奉命向赫尔松城推进。全线的我军都在继续击退苏军——务必保持这一势头。预计城内将遇到顽强抵抗。

src: We've been defeated and I'm afraid that the war will soon be over. Our commando could still fight for some time, but most of the other commandoes are exhausted and without any proper equipment. We've fought until the bitter end, but now we must stop, before we lose everything we have left.
dst: 我们被击败了，恐怕战争很快就要结束。我们的突击队或许还能再坚持一段时间，但其他大多数突击队已经精疲力竭，而且缺乏像样的装备。我们已经血战到了最后，但现在必须停下来，以免失去所剩的一切。

src: We've been defeated. The Turkish forces have enveloped our flank, and now our whole Third Army is in serious trouble. Our tsar Ferdinand I demands that you assume your responsability for this failure. General, you must ressign inmediately.
dst: 我们战败了。土耳其军队包抄了我们的侧翼，如今我整个第3集团军都陷入严重困境。我们的沙皇费迪南一世要求您为这次失败承担责任。将军，您必须立即辞职。

src: We've been planning the conquer of Riga for a long time. Naturally, our aim is to hasten the fall of Russia and, in the short term, to straighten or own lines so that we can send some divisions to the Western Front. But we wish to test some new combat tactics, too. Instead of a frontal assault against the city, most of our units will cross the Düna and take positions at the enemy's rear, isolating Riga and preventing its defenders from receiving any reinforcements. If these infiltration tactics are successful, we could use them against the French or the British.
dst: 我们谋划攻克里加已久。自然，我们的目标是加速俄国的崩溃，并在短期内拉直我们自己的战线，以便能抽出一些师派往西线。但我们也想检验一些新的战术。与其正面强攻这座城市，我们的大部分部队将横渡道加瓦河，在敌军后方占据阵地，孤立里加并阻止其守军获得任何增援。如果这些渗透战术奏效，我们就能把它们用在法军或英军身上。

src: We've captured Roberts and most of his staff. The Kakies have hundreds of casualties and we've taken lots of prisoners. Four British divisions have been virtually annihilated. Congratulations!
dst: 我们俘虏了罗伯茨及其大部分参谋。英国佬伤亡数百人，我们还抓获了大量战俘。四个英军师实际上已被全歼。恭喜！

src: We've chosen the area of Saint-Mihiel to launch our main attack. Although the French have had time to establish a strong defence in depth, when you overcome their positions it'll be hard for them to stop you before you reach the Marne, because their mobile reserve is quite weak. Once the Eastern bank of the Marne is secured we'll be able to encircle the defenders of Nancy and Verdun, and we could even threaten Paris.
dst: 我们选定圣米耶勒一带发动主攻。尽管法军有时间建立了坚固的纵深防御，但当您突破他们的阵地后，他们将很难在您抵达马恩河之前拦住您，因为他们的机动预备队相当薄弱。一旦马恩河东岸得到确保，我们就能包围南锡和凡尔登的守军，甚至能威胁巴黎。

src: We've crossed the Channel, and now we are going to the Mediterranean coast, but even now there are the remnants of the 8th British Army and a complete Egyptian division, so you have to destroy them. Our Intelligence report says that anti-British Palestinian groups will be
dst: 我们已渡过海峡，现在正向地中海沿岸前进，但即便现在那里仍有英国第8集团军的残部和一支完整的埃及师，所以您必须消灭他们。我们的情报报告称，反英的巴勒斯坦团体将

src: We've done it, Commander.  We've traced these six-legged freaks back to their hidey holes.
dst: 我们做到了，指挥官。我们把这些六条腿的怪物一路追回了它们的藏身窝。

src: We've driven out the Commonwealth troops from the western Mediterranean!
dst: 我们已经把英联邦部队赶出了西地中海！

src: We've driven out the Commonwealth troops of the western Mediterranean - it remains the eastern Mediterranean. Your troops are shipped via Italy to Libya, North Africa. The Italians need our support to reconquer Libya and to bring the strategically important Suez Canal in Egypt under our control.
dst: 我们已经把英联邦部队赶出了西地中海——剩下的是东地中海。你的部队经意大利海运到北非的利比亚。意大利人需要我们的支援来重新征服利比亚，并把埃及战略上重要的苏伊士运河纳入我们控制。

src: We've finally reached our destination in central Serbia. It's almost a relief, after travelling through most of Europe for nearly a month. When we left Italy they sent us to France, but just a few days later the High Command decided that we would be more useful in the Balkans, acting as a reinforcement unit.
dst: 我们终于到达了塞尔维亚中部的目的地。在横穿了大半个欧洲、奔波了近一个月之后，这简直是一种解脱。我们离开意大利时，他们把我们派往法国，但仅仅几天后，最高统帅部就认定我们作为一支增援部队在巴尔干会更有用。

src: We've gone ahead and loaded the majority of the residents here into truck convoys.  Your mission is to get these convoys and sufficient escort north to Holloman Air Force Base and the safety of our defense network there.  Unfortunately we do not currently know where the bugs have their nest, so you should keep an eye out in all directions.  We do know that a nearby town has gone dark, so you should assume that it has been compromised.
dst: 我们已把这里大部分居民装上卡车车队。你的任务是把这些车队和足够的护送兵力向北带到霍洛曼空军基地，进入我们防御网的安全地带。遗憾的是，我们目前不知道这些虫子的巢穴在哪里，所以你得朝各个方向留神。我们确实知道附近有一座小镇已陷入沉寂，因此你应当假定它已被攻陷。

src: We've had reports of Russian units fighting to the last man........and others that come wandering towards our lines on their own trying to surrender.
dst: 我们收到报告，有的俄军部队战至最后一人……有的则自行游荡到我军阵前试图投降。

src: We've left Algiers and we are in Morocco, your quick advance didn't give our enemies time to defend themselves. You have to advance faster and avoid the mistakes you made in the past.
dst: 我们已离开阿尔及尔，现在身处摩洛哥，您的快速推进没给敌人留下自卫的时间。您必须推进得更快，并避免过去犯下的错误。

src: We've lost too much time and Kitchener is coming with more than 10,000 men. We must retire inmediately and live to fight another day.
dst: 我们浪费了太多时间，基钦纳正带着一万多人赶来。我们必须立即撤退，以待来日再战。

src: We've prepared ourselves. In Sevastopol we have enough ships ready to embark our soldiers and our families, if necessary, and take them to a safe place. I just have to hold the Reds and the Blacks long enough, so that they won't be able to invade Crimea too fast. I've done it before, and I know that I can do it again. I haven't been able to save Russia, but at least I'll save the people who counted on us. I won't fail them this time.
dst: 我们已经做好了准备。在塞瓦斯托波尔，我们备有足够的船只，必要时可载上我们的士兵和家人，把他们送往安全的地方。我只需把红军和黑军拖住足够久，使他们无法过快地入侵克里米亚。我以前做到过，我知道自己还能再做一次。我没能拯救俄国，但至少我要救下那些信赖我们的人。这一次，我不会让他们失望。

src: We've restored all colonies of our ally and we control the whole Red Sea, but we have to gain another strong point controlled by the British:- Mombasa.
dst: 我们已恢复了盟友的全部殖民地，并控制了整个红海，但我们必须再夺取一个由英国人控制的据点：蒙巴萨。

src: We've started our advance toward the south. We are at Keren's gates, however this city won't give us any trouble the main resistence is in the mountains.
dst: 我们已开始向南推进。我们已抵近克伦城下，然而这座城市不会给我们带来麻烦，主要的抵抗在山地之中。

src: We've suffered so many losses that we've been forced to retire. Soon the British will launch new attacks, and I'm afraid that we won't have the strength to repel their invasion.
dst: 我们遭受了如此惨重的损失，以致不得不撤退。英军很快会发动新的进攻，我担心我们将无力击退他们的入侵。

src: We've taken on the Reds together. We've fought the Krauts long after they should have been taken care of.  We've fought everything from oversized bugs to a deranged robot to our own poor children in a wasted future.  We've even taken on men with muskets; definitely our "proudest" achievement.
dst: 我们一起对抗过红军。我们在那些德国佬早该被收拾掉很久之后还跟他们打仗。我们从过大的虫子、疯癫的机器人，一路打到荒废未来里我们自己的孩子。我们甚至还跟手持滑膛枪的人交过手；绝对是我们「最值得骄傲」的成就。

src: We've tried to convince the Germans to support us, but they've refused to help. They think that they're already fighting the decisive battle of the war in Verdun, and they don't want to waste their time in what they consider a secondary front. It's a mistake. With Italy out of the war, we could send more troops to the east, and then the Germans could retire some of the divisions that they have currently there, and send them to France. Sometimes, having modest goals is better.
dst: 我们曾试图说服德国人支援我们，但他们拒绝帮忙。他们自以为正在凡尔登打这场战争的决定性战役，不想把时间浪费在他们眼中的次要战线上。这是个错误。一旦意大利退出战争，我们就能向东线增派更多部队，德国人也能撤回他们目前在那边的一些师，调到法国去。有时候，目标小一点反而更好。

src: We, the Treveri, vote for Vercingetorix!
dst: 我们特雷维里人，投票支持维钦托利！
魏登巴赫 (维多姆巴克, 金巴夫)
韦伊海罗沃 (西普鲁士新城)

src: Welcome General, climb in, we will talk in my command-track as we march East.
dst: 欢迎，将军，上车吧，我们东进途中在我的指挥车里谈。

src: Welcome General, come in and look at our situation maps.
dst: 欢迎，将军，进来看看我们的态势图。

src: Welcome General, some water?  Its Hungarian you know, now that they and the Romanians are our comerades in arms we can aquire things a little more easily.
dst: 欢迎，将军，来点水？这是匈牙利货，你知道的，如今匈牙利人和罗马尼亚人成了我们的战友，我们弄东西也方便些了。

src: Welcome General, some wine? we have a lot to consider.
dst: 欢迎，将军，来点酒？我们有好多事要商议。

src: Welcome General, you are just in time to hear the operations briefing.
dst: 欢迎，将军，你来得正好，赶上听作战简报。

src: Welcome Herr General! Kiev is important both strategically as well as politically, since it is considered to be the key to the Ukraine!  The Soviets have several large armies gathered near the city. You cannot hope to beat them frontally so we will encircle them. However, our intelligence report that most of the bridges have been destroyed by the Soviets, so prepare for a difficult river crossing. You have been given the southern wing - cut them off as fast as you can!
dst: 欢迎您，将军阁下！基辅在战略与政治上同样重要——它被视为打开乌克兰的钥匙！苏军已在城郊集结数个大型集团军。正面强攻绝无胜算，因此我们将以合围取之。但我方情报显示，多数桥梁已被苏军炸毁，请做好强渡的准备。您受命指挥南翼——务必尽快切断其退路！

src: Welcome again commander.  We have escaped from Jingghanshan in our long march to the North.  Today the Dadu River lies in front of us, and your task is to cross that river.  The problem is, we have in front the city of Luding, which is in the hands of the local pro-KMT Warlord Liu Wenhui.  I see the chains bridge over the Dadu River is on fire, but our long march can't be stopped!  Go ahead soldier!
dst: 再次欢迎你，指挥官。我们已从井冈山突围，踏上北上的长征。今天大渡河横在我们面前，你的任务是渡过这条河。问题是，我们前方是泸定城，它掌握在亲国民党的当地军阀刘文辉手中。我看到大渡河上的铁索桥正在燃烧，但我们的长征不能停下！前进吧，士兵！

src: Welcome back home. Although the General Staff believes that our fleet should not be involved in the Mediterranean, Hitler has decided that your fleet should go there. There is an unpleasant situation in the south of Spain with the rebels besieging Malaga as well as the port of Mallorca. Although officially Spain is neutral, everyone knows that General Franco allows volunteers to fight with us on the Eastern Front. But be careful, it must not be seen that we are helping him.
dst: 欢迎回家。尽管总参谋部认为我们的舰队不应卷入地中海，但希特勒已决定你的舰队前往那里。西班牙南部局势不妙，叛军正围攻马拉加以及马略卡港。虽然西班牙名义上中立，但众所周知佛朗哥将军允许志愿者在东线与我们并肩作战。但要小心，绝不能让外界看出我们在帮助他。

src: Welcome back to Russia Herr General! Operation Citadel has been successful so far. Our spearheads are now past Prokhorovka and continue our speedy advance trough the endless Russian Steppe.
dst: 欢迎回到俄罗斯，将军阁下！迄今为止"堡垒行动"进展顺利。我们的先头部队现已越过普罗霍罗夫卡，继续在无边无际的俄罗斯草原上快速推进。

src: Welcome back to the Balkans, my friend. Turkey has for a long time been regarded as a country closer to us than to the enemy. They showed their will to cooperate during the Iraq crisis, but now they seem to be shying away from the obvious next step - signing an alliance with us and Tokyo. We'll have to persuade them. Your task is to push through the Turkish border fortifications and occupy Edime, Lueleburgaz and Corlu - that will give us a direct path to Istanbul and force the Turks to ally with us.
dst: 欢迎回到巴尔干，我的朋友。土耳其长期以来被视为一个更亲近我们而非敌方的国家。伊拉克危机期间他们表现出合作意愿，但如今他们似乎在回避显而易见的下一步——与我国和东京结盟。我们得说服他们。你的任务是突破土耳其边境工事，占领埃迪尔内、吕莱布尔加兹和乔尔卢——这将为我们打开直达伊斯坦布尔的通道，迫使土耳其人与我们结盟。

src: Welcome back to the Isonzo, General. Since you were here more than a year ago, the Italians have assaulted our positions four more times. We've managed to reject all of their attacks, but our casualties have been very high, and it seems that our enemies won't give up. They'll keep on trying as long as there is one single Italian soldier alive.
dst: 欢迎回到伊松佐，将军。自您一年多前离开这里以来，意大利人又四次进攻我们的阵地。我们成功击退了他们所有的进攻，但伤亡惨重，而且看样子敌人不会罢休。只要还有一个意大利士兵活着，他们就会一直尝试下去。

src: Welcome back to the Karelian Isthmus, Major. As you already know, the situation here is not going well for us. The Soviets are pressing hard to cut the road from Helsinki to Viipuri, and they have launched a massive offensive across the whole Karelian Isthmus. We need to buy some time. Stalin has reputedly abandoned his support for the puppet government in Terijoki, and we are now in direct peace negotiations with Moscow, yet the Soviet offensive continues. We must hold Viipuri until a negotiated settlement can be reached, or else Stalin will surely push on to Helsinki, meaning the end of Finland as we know it!
dst: 欢迎回到卡累利阿地峡，少校。如你所知，此地局势对我们不利。苏军正全力推进，企图切断赫尔辛基至维普里之间的公路，并已在整条卡累利阿地峡发起大规模攻势。我们需要争取一些时间。据称斯大林已放弃对泰里约基傀儡政府的支持，我们目前正与莫斯科直接进行和平谈判，但苏军攻势仍在继续。在达成谈判解决之前，我们必须守住维普里，否则斯大林必定会继续推进到赫尔辛基，那将意味着我们所熟知的芬兰的终结！

src: Welcome back to the South-Western Front, Gospodin General!  It appears that now the Army needs not only withstand the frontal assault of the enemy, but also the creeping malaise of pacifism and defeatism seeping from behind...
dst: 欢迎回到西南方面军，将军阁下！看来现在军队不仅要承受敌人的正面进攻，还要抵御从后方渗入的厌战和失败主义的慢性侵蚀……

src: Welcome back to the front, General. I wish we could have given you a warmer welcome, but as you see, we don't have time for that. If we don't react quickly, the Russians will destroy us.
dst: 欢迎回到前线，将军。但愿我们能给您一个更热烈的欢迎，但您也看到了，我们没有那个时间。如果我们不迅速行动，俄国人就会消灭我们。

src: Welcome honourable new commander. Your first task as an army officer will be the attack on Shanghai, one of the most important Chinese cities. This attack on Shanghai was not included in our original plans for China, however our nearby garrisoned troops have been bombed by Chinese troops from Shanghai, and, of course we can't allow that. The Chinese must pay!. The high command thinks you will be a great warrior in the future, and with this first lesson we want to test your skills on the art of the combined operations...
dst: 欢迎您，尊敬的新任指挥官。作为陆军军官，您的第一项任务将是进攻上海——中国最重要的城市之一。这次对上海的进攻并不在我们最初的对华计划之内，然而我们附近驻守的部队遭到了来自上海的中国军队轰炸，而我们当然不能容忍这种事。中国人必须付出代价！最高统帅部认为您将来必成良将，而这第一课，我们想考验您在多兵种联合作战方面的造诣……

src: Welcome to Africa! The front here is deadlocked and the Italians need our support to reach a victory. Your first task is to expel the Commonwealth troops from Libya. The Italian attack on Egypt last September failed miserably and our allies suffered a heavy defeat and the loss of Tobruk earlier this year. Now Australians have manned this fortress with his important deep-water port. For a long siege of the fortress we lack in time, try to take Tobruk by surprise without stopping motion and open the way to Egypt for us!
dst: 欢迎来到非洲！这里的战线陷入僵局，意大利人需要我们的支援才能取得胜利。你的第一个任务是把英联邦部队赶出利比亚。意大利去年9月对埃及的进攻惨遭失败，我们的盟友遭受了惨败，并于今年早些时候丢掉了托布鲁克。如今澳大利亚人据守着这座要塞及其重要的深水港。长期围困这座要塞我们耗不起时间，试着不停顿地奇袭夺取托布鲁克，为我们打开通往埃及的道路！

src: Welcome to Asia! Favourable conditions for us - the enemy is without adequate supplies, demoralized and Palestine is the last bastion of the Commonwealth troops on the Mediterranean. At Rafa a new defense line was built, but the defense position is weak and not deep and should not pose a problem for your troops. Break through the defense and advance at Khan Yunis our gateway to Jerusalem!
dst: 欢迎来到亚洲！形势对我们有利——敌军缺乏补给、士气低落，巴勒斯坦是英联邦部队在地中海的最后堡垒。在拉法修建了一条新防线，但这个防御阵地薄弱且纵深不足，不该给你的部队造成麻烦。突破防线，向汗尤尼斯——我们通往耶路撒冷的门户——推进！

src: Welcome to East Africa, commander.  I am Captain Jenkins and I shall be your assistant for the foreseeable future - unless I'm killed, captured or sent on a special mission to Fiji....
dst: 欢迎来到东非，指挥官。我是詹金斯上尉，在可预见的将来将担任你的助手——除非我阵亡、被俘，或被派往斐济执行特殊任务……

src: Welcome to France Commander. Your first mission here is to capture the village of Pozieres which lies in the center of a salient in our line. Success here is vital to boost our army's low morale!!!
dst: 欢迎来到法国，指挥官。您在这里的第一项任务是夺取波济耶尔村，它位于我军战线突出部的中央。此处的胜利对于提振我军低迷的士气至关重要！！！
欢迎来到德国，上尉阁下。

src: Welcome to Germany Kapitan. After Hitler's personal intervention, your orders are not to move towards Gibraltar but to attack Ireland, specifically Cork.
dst: 欢迎来到德国，海军上校。在希特勒亲自干预之后，你的命令不再是向直布罗陀进军，而是进攻爱尔兰，具体目标是科克。

src: Welcome to Manchukuo commander. The Kwantung army high command has requested to Tokyo your presence here, since you are the best officer to face the Soviets due to your past experience at Korea.
dst: 欢迎来到满洲国，指挥官。关东军高层已向东京请求调您来此，因为您过去在朝鲜的经历使您成为对付苏联人的最佳人选。

src: Welcome to Natal, General. The news of the war are excellent. Thanks to you a great portion of the coast is in our hands, Cronjé has finally conquered Mafikeng and De Wet has joined Botha's forces. Now it's time to deal with Buller's army.
dst: 欢迎来到纳塔尔，将军。战局消息好极了。多亏了您，海岸的很大一部分已在我们手中，克罗涅终于攻下了马菲肯，德韦特也已与博塔的部队会合。现在是时候收拾布勒的军队了。
欢迎来到波兰，旅队长阁下。

src: Welcome to Spain, General! You've already been briefed on the situation. Franco wants us to help him take Madrid. The Italians have been detained and his own troops have recently suffered a number of setbacks. Your goal is to cut the supply lines at Almadrones.
dst: 欢迎来到西班牙，将军！情况你已知晓。佛朗哥要我们助他夺取马德里。意军受阻，而他自己的部队近来屡遭挫败。你的目标是在阿尔马德罗内斯切断补给线。

src: Welcome to our new 4th Army, General. I guess that, after the Ottoman coup d'etat of January, the failure of the London peace conference was just a matter of time. So here we are again, ready for more fighting.
dst: 欢迎来到我们新组建的第4集团军，将军。我想，在1月奥斯曼政变之后，伦敦和会的失败只是时间问题。于是我们又来到了这里，准备迎接更多的战斗。

src: Welcome to the Aragon front, general. The operation of Brunete did not achieve everything that we wanted. However, the enemy has withdrawn some troops from the Northern Front. In order to try again to stop the rebel offensive in Asturias and Cantabria, the High Command has planned a new operation, here in Aragon. Its purposes are twofold. First, capture the objectives. Second, draw more troops away from our weakened northern front.
dst: 欢迎来到阿拉贡战线，将军。布鲁内特行动并未达成我们想要的一切。不过，敌人已从北方战线撤走了一些部队。为了设法再次阻止叛军在阿斯图里亚斯和坎塔布里亚的攻势，最高统帅部在阿拉贡这里策划了一次新行动。其目的有二：第一，夺取目标；第二，把更多兵力从我们已被削弱的北方战线引开。

src: Welcome to the Black Sea Komodore. While the main army is fighting in the North of the Kuban, your mission is simple, to attack from the south. From the straits of Kerch it is impossible but there are 2 places, west and east of Anapa where you can land the marines with great care of course. First of all you have to neutralize the Soviet air force and fleet. The good news is that the enemy has few tanks in the area but be careful, the coastal guns can do a lot of damage.
dst: 欢迎来到黑海，海军准将。当主力部队在库班北部作战时，您的任务很简单，就是从南面发起进攻。从刻赤海峡进攻是不可能的，但在阿纳帕以西和以东有两处地点，当然要极其谨慎地用海军陆战队登陆。首先您必须压制苏联空军和舰队。好消息是敌军在该地区坦克很少，但要小心，海岸炮能造成很大损失。

src: Welcome to the Eastern Front, General. It's frustrating after all of your efforts at Verdun, but it seems that the Russians and the British have finally come to the rescue of France. The Russian offensive, planned by Alexei Brussilow, has been the most surprising initiative that we've seen in years. It's pierced the seemingly strong Austro-Hungarian defences like a hot knife through butter, and now our allies desperately need our help. That's the reason why you're here.
dst: 欢迎来到东线，将军。您在凡尔登付出全部努力之后，这实在令人沮丧，但似乎俄国人和英国人终于赶来救援法国了。由阿列克谢·布鲁西洛夫策划的俄军攻势，是我们多年来见过的最出人意料的行动。它像热刀切黄油一样，洞穿了看似坚固的奥匈防线，如今我们的盟友亟需我们的帮助。这就是您来到这里的原因。

src: Welcome to the Gohoku region.  The big allied base on this country must be removed if we want to secure our Empire.  Although our reports inform us that the area of Darwin is fortified, the surrounding areas are a desert; it seems the Australians have evacuated the population and some facilities to the inner part of the country.  With your troops clear Darwin and establish a beach head to allow further penetrations into Australia.
dst: 欢迎来到濠北地区。若要确保帝国安全，就必须拔除盟军在这个国家的大型基地。尽管我方情报显示达尔文一带筑有工事，但周边地区都是荒漠；看来澳大利亚人已把居民和部分设施撤往内陆。请率部肃清达尔文，建立一个滩头阵地，以便进一步向澳大利亚内陆挺进。

src: Welcome to the North, Herr General! Although we were successful and captured Murmansk and the Kola peninsula in recent months, our offensive stalled in the arctic tundra. Terrain is swampy and rough and supplies are low. We welcome your experienced forces to the arctic theatre.
dst: 欢迎来到北方，将军阁下！尽管我们成功地在近几个月内夺取了摩尔曼斯克和科拉半岛，但我们的攻势在北极苔原上停滞了。地形沼泽密布、崎岖难行，补给不足。我们欢迎你的经验丰富部队来到北极战区。

src: Welcome, General. Sit down and let me explain you the situation. To be sincere, by now it's obvious that we overestimated the strength of our army before the war started. The Russians have defeated us in Galizien, and now they threaten the Hungarian plains. Were it not for the Germans who are fighting against them in Eastern Prussia and Poland, we could have already been forced to surrender.
dst: 欢迎，将军。请坐，让我向您说明局势。坦白说，如今很明显，我们在开战前高估了本国的军力。俄国人在加利西亚击败了我们，如今他们威胁着匈牙利平原。若不是德国人正在东普鲁士与波兰与他们作战，我们可能早已被迫投降。

src: Welcome, Herr General. You are facing the 6. Japanese army. The Japanese have passed the Chalchin Gol. Your mission is to put the enemy over the river.
dst: 欢迎，将军阁下。你面对的是日本第6军。日军已越过哈拉哈河。你的任务是把敌人赶回河对岸。

src: Well Colonel, excuse me, I mean Captain, since you failed on the battlefield, maybe the Field Kitchen detachment could use your help...
dst: 好吧，上校，抱歉，我是说上尉，既然你在战场上失利了，也许野战炊事分队能用得上你……

src: Well General, it was not a total waste. We learned some lessons that will
dst: 好吧，将军，这也不算全无收获。我们汲取了一些教训，它们将

src: Well Herr General,  we have suffered a defeat at the hands of the Red army. This must not happen again! We must show the world we are the master race! You must start using Blitzkrieg tactics or we will be slugging it out in the trenches again!
dst: 唉，将军阁下，我们败在了红军手下。绝不能再发生这样的事！我们必须向世界证明我们是优等民族！你必须开始运用闪电战战术，否则我们又要退回堑壕里苦战了！

src: Well Herr General, despite harsh conditions, you have done quite well!  Your victory has shown that already you have gained valuable experience in this new type of warfare.  In addition, the new pro-German government in Spain may prove to be a useful ally in the coming years.
dst: 好，将军阁下，尽管条件艰苦，你表现得相当不错！你的胜利表明，你已在这种新型战争中积累了宝贵经验。此外，西班牙新成立的亲德政府或许会在未来岁月中成为有用的盟友。

src: Well Herr General, our forecast was right and the Reds have decided we are weak enough to beat. Fail here General and we are finished. Smash the Red Army at Seelow and they will want peace.
dst: 好，将军阁下，我们的预测没错，红军认定我们已弱到可以击败。此处若败，将军，我们就完了。在泽洛击溃红军，他们就会求和。

src: Well Herr General, the time has finally arrived for you and your men!  You have been assigned to Feldmarschall von Rundstedt's Army Group South, and will take part in the thrust into the Ukraine, as part of Operation Barbarossa!
dst: 好吧，将军阁下，你和你的部下期盼已久的时刻终于到了！你已被分配到冯·伦德施泰特元帅的南方集团军群，将作为“巴巴罗萨行动”的一部分，参加向乌克兰的突击！

src: Well Herr General, what excuse do you have for letting a tribe of natives and a handful of British troops kick you out of Somalia?
dst: 唉，将军阁下，让一帮土著和一小撮英军把你赶出索马里，你有何借口？

src: Well Herr General, what was the problem? Where were your repair crews? They could have helped you be more mobile.
dst: 唉，将军阁下，问题出在哪？你的修理分队哪去了？他们本可助你更机动。

src: Well Herr General, you have earned a trip overseas.  We are going to the aid of our Italian allies in Somaliland. The Ethiopians, with UK aid are attacking. You must move swiftly before the UK can reinforce the natives.
dst: 好，将军阁下，你赢得了一次海外之旅。我们要去援助索马里兰的意大利盟友。埃塞俄比亚人在英国援助下正发起进攻。你必须在英国增援土著之前迅速行动。

src: Well Major, excuse me, I mean Captain, since you failed on the battlefield, maybe you can succeed in the Field Kitchen detachment! Dismissed...
dst: 好吧，少校，抱歉，我是说上尉，既然你在战场上失利了，也许你能在野战炊事分队里有所成就！解散……

src: Well Major, excuse me, I mean Captain, since you failed on the battlefield, maybe you can succeed in the Field Kitchen detachment...
dst: 好吧，少校，抱歉，我是说上尉，既然你在战场上失利了，也许你能在野战炊事分队里有所成就……

src: Well Major, it is done. We had no choice but to accept the Soviet offer. It is a hard peace, but a small price to pay for our continued independance. Your service in this war has not been in vain, the Soviets have paid a heavy toll in both men and materiel, and one day, we will retake what is rightfully ours....
dst: 好吧，少校，事情就这样定了。我们别无选择，只能接受苏联的条件。这是一个苛刻的和平，但为了我们继续保持独立，代价微不足道。你在这场战争中的服役并非徒劳，苏联人在人员和物资上都付出了沉重代价，总有一天，我们会夺回属于我们的一切……

src: Well commander, please listen to me, I will explain you the present situation. 4 months after the coup de'etat of July the situation is chaotic, some peninsular areas and the whole of Spanish Morocco are supporting the uprising. Rebel columns coming from the North, and from the South have reached Madrid. While the columns from the North under the command of the General Mola have been stopped in the mountains north of Madrid, the African Army under the command of the General Franco is now approaching the South and West neighborhoods of Madrid. They are a dangerous menace, and they must not cross the Manzanares river! Also, probably ''5th column'' elements will appear with the rebel approach to Madrid.
dst: 好的，指挥官，请听我说，我来向您说明当前形势。七月政变四个月后，局势一片混乱，半岛的一些地区和整个西属摩洛哥都支持叛乱。来自北部和南部的叛军纵队已经抵达马德里。莫拉将军指挥的北部纵队已在马德里以北的山脉中被挡住，而佛朗哥将军指挥的非洲军正逼近该城的南部和西部街区。他们构成了危险的威胁，绝不能渡过曼萨纳雷斯河！此外，随着叛军逼近马德里，可能会出现「第五纵队」分子。

src: Well done Capitano. You were able to drive the English back into Egypt. A good initiative of yours to call in the help of the 30th Group Frontier Guards from Bardia.
dst: 干得好，上尉。你成功把英军赶回了埃及。你叫来巴迪亚的第30边防警戒集群相助，是个好主意。

src: Well done Colonel. Despite suffering heavy casualties, you did succeed in stopping the Germans. It is however very unfortunate that you missed King Albert's early afternoon order to retreat in the face of a much bigger German force. Retreating would have saved a lot of our brave troops that now remain on the battlefield.
dst: 干得好，上校。尽管伤亡惨重，您确实成功阻止了德军。然而非常遗憾的是，您错过了阿尔贝国王当天下午早些时候下达的、面对规模大得多的德军时撤退的命令。撤退本可以拯救许多如今仍躺在战场上的英勇士兵。

src: Well done General! Now we are able to launch our counterattack.
dst: 干得漂亮，将军！现在我们能够发起反攻了。

src: Well done General! We have arrived at the Elbe river and met our Soviet comrades.
dst: 干得好，将军！我们已抵达易北河，并与我们的苏联同志会师。

src: Well done General! We will not attack the atlantic ports yet. You must drive as far as you can to the northeast. There is a chance to trap all German divisions near Falaise.
dst: 干得漂亮，将军！我们暂不进攻大西洋沿岸港口。你必须尽可能向东北推进。有机会把德军所有师团困在法莱斯附近。

src: Well done General! You captured your objectives quickly and our drive on Kishinev was a success. Our advance into southern Russia and the Ukraine is going as planned. Our Romanian allies will now deal with the Soviet occupation force in Odessa.
dst: 干得好，将军！你迅速夺取了目标，我们向基什尼奥夫的推进取得了成功。我们向俄罗斯南部和乌克兰的进军正按计划进行。我们的罗马尼亚盟友现在将对付敖德萨的苏联占领军。

src: Well done General! You captured your objectives quickly. Our advance into southern Russia and the Ukraine is going as planned. We can now help our Romanian allies deal with the Soviet occupation force in Moldavia.  The General staff has decided that you will lead the drive to capture Kishinev.
dst: 干得好，将军！您迅速夺取了目标。我们向南俄和乌克兰的推进正按计划进行。现在我们能够帮助罗马尼亚盟友对付苏联在摩尔达维亚的占领军了。总参谋部已决定由您率部夺取基什尼奥夫。

src: Well done General! You captured your objectives quickly. The General staff has decided that you will lead the drive to capture Smolensk.
dst: 干得好，将军！你迅速夺取了目标。总参谋部已决定由你率领部队攻取斯摩棱斯克。

src: Well done General. Most of Vimy Ridge is in our hands and the Canadian corps has suffered a bloody nose.
dst: 干得好，将军。维米岭的大部分已在我方手中，加拿大军被揍得鼻青脸肿。

src: Well done General. Rest your troops. You will be needed shortly in France.
dst: 干得好，将军。让部队休整。不久你将被需要于法国。

src: Well done General. The Faid and Maknassy passes are in our hands. Tripoli has fallen in the hands of Montgomery. Time to continue building up II Corps and wait for the arrival of 8th Army in Tunisia.
dst: 干得好，将军。法伊德山口与马克纳西山口已在我军手中。的黎波里已落入蒙哥马利之手。是时候继续扩充第2军，并等待第8集团军抵达突尼斯。

src: Well done General. The enemy attack towards Thala and Tebessa has been stopped and the enemy is on the retreat.
dst: 干得好，将军。敌军指向塔拉与泰贝萨的进攻已被阻止，敌军正在撤退。

src: Well done General. The enemy is pushed back 15km on a front multiple kilometers wide. Unfortunatley the enemy has brought in reserves from other sectors. The troops that have relieved your forces will have a hard time continuing the advance.
dst: 干得好，将军。敌人在数公里宽的战线上被击退了15公里。不幸的是，敌人已从其他地段调来了预备队。接替您部队的友军要继续推进将十分艰难。

src: Well done General. Vimy Ridge is in our hands and the Canadian corps has suffered a bloody nose.
dst: 干得好，将军。维米岭已在我方手中，加拿大军被揍得鼻青脸肿。

src: Well done General. You held on to this last corner of our country. Hendrik Geeraert - a skipper from Nieuwpoort - came up with a way to open the sluices of the Yzer at the right times to flood the complete area from Nieuwpoort to Diksmuide. That will prevent the Germans from ever mounting another big attack in our sector of the front.
dst: 干得好，将军。您守住了我们祖国的这最后一块角落。亨德里克·海拉尔特——一位来自尼乌波特的船长——想出了一个办法，在恰当的时机打开伊泽尔河的水闸，淹没从尼乌波特到迪克斯迈德的整个区域。这将使德军再也无法在我们这段战线发起大规模进攻。

src: Well done Herr Feldmarschall! A splendid victory - once again! But there is no time to rest. Your forces are immediately transfered to the north, where the Soviets build up forces along the Finnish border in this very moment!
dst: 干得好，元帅阁下！又一次辉煌的胜利！但没有时间休息。你的部队立即被调往北方，此刻苏联人正在芬兰边境沿线集结兵力！

src: Well done Herr Feldmarschall! Feldmarschall Manstein will now take command of our forces in the north.
dst: 干得好，元帅阁下！曼施坦因元帅现在将接管我方北方部队的指挥。

src: Well done Herr Feldmarschall! In a daring and unprecedented campaign, your forces successfully captured New York City, marking a decisive victory in this battle. Utilizing innovative tactics and overwhelming tactical coordination between Luftwaffe, Kriegsmarine and Heer, your forces overcame formidable defenses, establishing control over the bustling metropolis. Celebrations erupted across Germany as news of this remarkable victory spread.
dst: 干得好，元帅阁下！在一场大胆且史无前例的战役中，您的部队成功攻占了纽约市，标志着这场战斗的决定性胜利。凭借创新的战术以及德国空军、海军和陆军之间压倒性的战术协同，您的部队攻克了坚固的防御，确立了对这座繁华大都市的控制。这一非凡胜利的消息传遍德国，各地爆发庆祝。

src: Well done Herr Feldmarschall! Pearl Harbor is ours! The war is won! Hurra, Hurra, Hurra!
dst: 干得好，元帅阁下！珍珠港是我们的了！战争胜利了！呼啦，呼啦，呼啦！

src: Well done Herr Feldmarschall! Seoul is ours! The war is won! Hurra, Hurra, Hurra! You return home to a grateful nation.
dst: 干得好，元帅阁下！首尔是我们的了！战争胜利了！呼啦，呼啦，呼啦！你回到家乡，迎接你的是一个心怀感激的国家。

src: Well done Herr Feldmarschall! The Anglo-Soviet threat has been averted. The Allies have overestimated their powers, overstreched their supply lines and completely exhausted their offensive capabilities. We have to be fast now and make the best of the situation. Prepare your troops for a invasion of the United Kingdom.
dst: 干得好，元帅阁下！英苏的威胁已被化解。盟军高估了自己的实力，补给线拉得过长，进攻能力已完全枯竭。我们现在必须迅速行动，充分利用这一形势。让你的部队准备好入侵英国。

src: Well done Herr Feldmarschall! The landing operation was a grand success and we now have a foothold on the North American Continent! Long Island will serve as a marshalling area for our attack on New York City. The economic center of the USA will soon be ours, the skyscrapers - see them in the distance - will soon fly our flag! Prepare your troops for a fierce battle!
dst: 干得好，元帅阁下！登陆行动取得了巨大成功，我们如今在北美大陆上有了立足点！长岛将作为我们进攻纽约市的集结地。美国的经济中心很快将属于我们，那些摩天大楼——看看远处的它们——很快将升起我们的旗帜！让你的部队准备好迎接一场激战！

src: Well done Herr General you managed to mop up the mess caused by those "Bodyguards".
dst: 干得好，将军阁下，你成功收拾了那些“警卫”造成的乱局。

src: Well done Herr General! Brilliant work once again. You have fulfilled the General Staff's hopes! Your drive to Avranches has forced the last of the American and British forces from Europe. Now we can concentrate on building up our forces to invade England next year. You and your men will rest and refit for a key role in our invasion. I am happy to inform you that you are promoted to Feldmarschall!
dst: 干得好，将军阁下！又一次出色的表现。你没有辜负总参谋部的期望！你向阿夫朗什的推进已迫使最后的美军与英军部队撤离欧洲。现在我们可以集中精力扩充部队，以便明年入侵英格兰。你与你的部下将休整并改装，以便在我们的入侵行动中扮演关键角色。我很高兴地通知你，你已被晋升为元帅！

src: Well done Herr General! But despite your courageous fight we eventually had to withdrew from the city due to the continual Soviet attacks. We will pull back orderly and take up defensive positions behind the Mius river.
dst: 干得好，将军阁下！但尽管你英勇作战，面对苏军持续不断的进攻，我们最终不得不撤离该城。我们将有序后撤，在米乌斯河后方建立防御阵地。

src: Well done Herr General! General Rommel now takes over as a commander of the German and Italian forces in North Africa. He will keep up the pace and advances towards Cairo and the Suez Canal. Meanwhile your core troops will be sent back to th eastern front where your experience will be needed soon...
dst: 干得好，将军阁下！隆美尔将军现在接任北非德意联军指挥官。他将继续保持推进势头，向开罗和苏伊士运河进军。与此同时，你的核心部队将被送回东线，那里很快就会需要你的经验……

src: Well done Herr General! General Rommel now takes over as a commander of the German and Italian forces in North Africa. He will keep up the pace and advances towards Damascus and Baghdad. Meanwhile your core troops will be sent back to East Africa, where your experience will be needed soon....
dst: 干得好，将军阁下！隆美尔将军现在接任北非德军和意军指挥官。他将继续保持节奏，向大马士革和巴格达推进。与此同时，你的核心部队将被派回东非，那里很快会需要你的经验……

src: Well done Herr General! Herr General, you have exceeded our expectations! The enemy fought valiantly, but this did not stop you. Baku is in our hands and the railway from Persia to Astrachan is cut. With the oil fields of Baku captured, Germany will never run out of oil again!
dst: 干得好，将军阁下！将军阁下，您超出了我们的期望！敌军英勇作战，但这并未阻止您。巴库已在我们手中，从波斯通往阿斯特拉罕的铁路已被切断。夺取巴库油田之后，德国再也不会缺油了！

src: Well done Herr General! Herr General.
dst: 干得好，将军阁下！将军阁下。

src: Well done Herr General! Now that the Kerch Peninsula is in our hands we will turn all of our attention on Sevastopol. The city must fall!
dst: 干得好，将军阁下！刻赤半岛已在我们手中，现在我们将把全部注意力转向塞瓦斯托波尔。这座城市必须陷落！

src: Well done Herr General! Our drive along the Baltic coast was a complete success. The Soviets have been cut of from the sea, except for Leningrad. With your splendid victory at Narva, Estonia was liberated from Bolshevik oppression! Our advance on Leningrad can continue as planned.
dst: 干得好，将军阁下！我们沿波罗的海海岸的进军取得了圆满成功。苏军已被切断与海洋的联系，只有列宁格勒除外。由于你在纳尔瓦的辉煌胜利，爱沙尼亚从布尔什维克的压迫下解放了！我们向列宁格勒的推进可以按计划继续。

src: Well done Herr General! Our initial attacks on Stalingrad were successful but there are still enemy units present in the city and the Soviets are bringing in their strategic reserves from the eastern side of the Volga river!
dst: 干得好，将军阁下！我们对斯大林格勒的初期进攻取得了成功，但城内仍有敌军单位，而且苏联人正从伏尔加河东岸调来他们的战略预备队！

src: Well done Herr General! Sevastopol, the most powerful land and sea fortress in the world, is in our hands and the German and Romanian Flags flutter above the city. We now can direct out attention to the great tasks that lay ahead!
dst: 干得好，将军阁下！塞瓦斯托波尔，这座世界上最强大的陆海要塞，已落入我们手中，德国与罗马尼亚的旗帜飘扬在城市上空。现在我们可以把注意力转向摆在面前的伟大任务了！

src: Well done Herr General! The Allied attempt to seize the strategic important Dardanelles Strait failed. Turkey will stay neutral but granted your warships a save passage into the Black Sea.
dst: 干得好，将军阁下！盟军夺取具有重要战略意义的达达尼尔海峡的企图失败了。土耳其将保持中立，但准许你的军舰安全通过进入黑海。

src: Well done Herr General! The Fuhrer is very pleased with your performance! Our drive into the Caucasus continues!
dst: 干得好，将军阁下！元首对你的表现非常满意！我们向高加索的推进仍在继续！

src: Well done Herr General! The Polish fought heroically but eventually they had to surrender to the overwhelming power of our army. Westerplatte is ours! Schleswig-Holstein, while old, still proved to be useful when it took part in the bombardments. But there is no time to rest, Polish forces are still present along the coast.
dst: 干得好，将军阁下！波兰人英勇作战，但最终不得不向我军压倒性的力量投降。韦斯特普拉特是我们的了！石勒苏益格-荷尔斯泰因号虽已老旧，但在参与炮击时依然证明了自己的价值。但没有时间休息，波兰部队仍出现在沿海一带。

src: Well done Herr General! The crisis is over, and the Iraqi royalist forces as well as the British troops have collapsed! Your courageous and energetic tactics have allowed us a complete victory. And now the Iraqi people have been given the will to face the British with us in future campaigns. Additionally, the righteous government of Iraq agreed to lease the Habbaniya Air Base to Luftwaffe for 99 years. This will strengthen our position in this part of the world. Congratulations, Herr General.
dst: 干得好，将军阁下！危机已经过去，伊拉克保皇派部队以及英军都已崩溃！你英勇而果断的战术使我们取得了完全的胜利。如今伊拉克人民已获得了在未来战役中与我们一同对抗英国人的意愿。此外，伊拉克的合法政府已同意将哈巴尼亚（Habbaniya）空军基地租借给德国空军99年。这将加强我们在这片地区的地位。恭喜你，将军阁下。

src: Well done Herr General! The crisis is over, and the Polish Army has collapsed. Unfortunately, some of the enemy has retreated into Romania while parts of the Polish Navy were able to withdraw to Scotland. No doubt, we will encounter these tough and vengeful troops again. There are other repercussions as well. The Soviet Union invaded Poland from the east and the British and French have now declared war on Germany.
dst: 干得好，将军阁下！危机已经过去，波兰陆军已经崩溃。遗憾的是，部分敌军已退入罗马尼亚，而波兰海军的一部分则得以撤往苏格兰。毫无疑问，我们还会再次遇上这些顽强而复仇心切的部队。此事还有其他连带影响。苏联已从东面入侵波兰，而英国与法国现已对德国宣战。

src: Well done Herr General! The enemy attack on Siwa has been repelled and the Italians will establish a permanent presence in the Oasis. Our right flank is now secure and we can move our units back to the coast and march on Alexandria!
dst: 干得好，将军阁下！敌军对锡瓦的进攻已被击退，意大利人将在绿洲建立长期驻守。我们的右翼现在安全了，我们可以把部队调回海岸，向亚历山大港进军！

src: Well done Herr General! The fierce enemy resistance somewhat delayed our advance, but your breakthrough through the narrow Thermopylae passage opened the road to Athens.
dst: 干得好，将军阁下！敌人凶猛的抵抗在一定程度上延缓了我们的推进，但你突破狭窄的温泉关通道，打开了通往雅典的道路。

src: Well done Herr General! The northern supply route from Murmansk and Arkhangelsk has been cut. This is a serious blow to Soviet supplies, as they have to rely now solely on the Siberian route.
dst: 干得漂亮，将军阁下！来自摩尔曼斯克与阿尔汉格尔斯克的北方补给线已被切断。这对苏联的补给是一记重创，因为他们现在只能依赖西伯利亚路线。

src: Well done Herr General! The oil fields of Maykop and the western Caucasus will provide vital supplies for our army and industry. We now have to shift our focus on the eastern part of the Caucasus and the oil fields of Grozy and Baku.
dst: 干得好，将军阁下！迈科普的油田和高加索西部将为我们军队和工业提供重要补给。我们现在必须把重心转向高加索东部以及格罗兹尼和巴库的油田。

src: Well done Herr General! The rapid Danish capitulation cleared the path to Norway. We have to act quickly in order to counter the French-British plans to occupy Norway. Intercepted radio transmissions revealed such a plan with the code name 'Plan R4'. We have to get ahead of the Allies!
dst: 干得好，将军阁下！丹麦的迅速投降为通往挪威扫清了道路。我们必须迅速行动，以对抗法英占领挪威的计划。截获的无线电通讯泄露了一项代号为“R4计划”的此类计划。我们必须抢在盟军之前行动！

src: Well done Herr General! We took back from the British what once was ours!
dst: 干得好，将军阁下！我们从英国人手中夺回了曾经属于我们的东西！

src: Well done Herr General! You have dealt the Red Army a severe blow! With our lines shortened, we will be able to allocate some troops to the arctic theatre. So the General Staff has decided to transfer you and your men to the North after a short period for rest and refitting.
dst: 干得好，将军阁下！你已给红军以沉重打击！随着我方战线缩短，我们将能抽调部分部队前往北极战区。因此总参谋部决定，在你和你的部下经过短暂休整与补充整备之后，将你们调往北方。

src: Well done Herr General! You have exceeded the General Staff's hopes! Your drive through the Ofotfjorden has broken enemy resistance and Narvik was captured with intact ports and airfield. This will seccure iron ore supplies for our war industry! But wait, the situation is deteriorating as we speak...
dst: 干得好，将军阁下！你超出了总参谋部的期望！你穿越奥福特峡湾的推进打破了敌军抵抗，纳尔维克也被夺取，港口和机场完好无损。这将确保我们军工产业的铁矿石供应！但等等，就在我们说话的这会儿，局势正在恶化……

src: Well done Herr General! You repelled the Allied counterattack and the Norwegian government has sued for peace. Congratulations! With this victory and the capturing of the port of Narvik we have secured the rich Swedish sources of iron ore for the German industry.
dst: 干得好，将军阁下！你击退了盟军的反攻，挪威政府已求和。祝贺你！凭借这场胜利以及夺取纳尔维克港，我们为德国工业确保了瑞典丰富的铁矿资源。

src: Well done Herr General! You were able to deal with the threat and prevented the enemy from taking over Mallorca. The Spanish are reliefed and agreed to set up a Spanish Volunteer Division that will join the fight against Bolshevism on the Eastern Front.
dst: 干得好，将军阁下！您得以应对威胁，阻止了敌人夺取马略卡岛。西班牙人松了一口气，并同意组建一支西班牙志愿师，加入东线对抗布尔什维主义的战斗。

src: Well done Herr General! Your capture of Moscow once again showed your mastery of tactics. The Bolsheviks still refuse to surrender but have offered us an armistice. Our intelligence indicates that the Allies are planning an invasion of Europe early this summer. Therefore the High Command signed the armistice with the Bolsheviks so we can prepare for the pending invasion. You are to be transferred to the Western Front, where you will help defend Fortress Europe against an Allied invasion.
dst: 干得漂亮，将军阁下！你攻占莫斯科再次展现了你的战术造诣。布尔什维克仍拒绝投降，但已向我们提议停战。我们的情报显示盟军正计划于今夏初入侵欧洲。因此最高统帅部与布尔什维克签署了停战协定，以便我们为即将到来的入侵做好准备。你将被调往西线，在那里协助保卫"欧洲堡垒"，抵御盟军入侵。

src: Well done Herr General! Your capture of Moscow showed your mastery of tactics.The Bolsheviks have fled to Siberia and sued for peace. You have helped accomplish what Napoleon could not -  the conquest of Russia! Our panzers rumble through Red Square, and our troops sleep in the Kremlin!
dst: 干得好，将军阁下！你夺取莫斯科一战展现了你的战术造诣。布尔什维克已逃往西伯利亚并请求求和。你帮助完成了拿破仑未能做到的事——征服俄罗斯！我们的装甲部队隆隆驶过红场，我们的部队在克里姆林宫宿营！

src: Well done Herr General! Your success will be the foundation of an everlasting friendship between Italy and Germany! The Pact of Steel (Stahlpakt, Patto d'Acciaio) between our great nations is set to be signed next month and will be to the benefit of both, Germany and Italy, in the years to come!
dst: 干得好，将军阁下！你的成功将成为意大利与德国之间永恒友谊的基石！我们伟大国家之间的《钢铁条约》（Stahlpakt、Patto d'Acciaio）定于下月签署，在未来的岁月里将造福德国与意大利双方！

src: Well done Herr General! Your two-pronged attack on the Taman peninsula was a complete success and we gained a foothold at the northwestern tip of the Caucasian Mountains. Moreover, with Novorossiysk in our hands, the Soviets lost their last big Black Sea port. We now have to advance deeper into the Caucasus.
dst: 干得好，将军阁下！你对塔曼半岛的两路进攻取得了圆满成功，我们在高加索山脉西北端站稳了脚跟。而且，随着新罗西斯克落入我们手中，苏联人失去了他们最后一个大型黑海港口。现在我们得向高加索纵深推进了。

src: Well done Herr General, Taganrog is ours! The ports and airfields of the city will serve us well in the upcomming operations. Rostov will be your next objective!
dst: 干得好，将军阁下，塔甘罗格属于我们！该城的港口和机场将在接下来的行动中为我们提供极大的便利。罗斯托夫将是您的下一个目标！

src: Well done Herr General, after 73 days of siege Odessa is finaly ours! Our Romanian allies proved themselves in the battle and achieved a great success. Odessa was the last Soviet stronghold at the western shores of the Black Sea! We now can shift our attention further to the east.
dst: 干得好，将军阁下，围城73天后，敖德萨终于属于我们了！我们的罗马尼亚盟友在战斗中证明了自己，取得了巨大成功。敖德萨是苏联在黑海西岸的最后一个据点！我们现在可以把注意力转向更远的东方了。

src: Well done Herr General, the pocket of Kiev has been obliterated!!!!
dst: 干得好，将军阁下，基辅包围圈已被彻底抹掉！！！！

src: Well done Herr General, you have created a base for our troops land. Your losses must have been high?
dst: 干得好，将军阁下，你为我军登陆创建了基地。你的损失想必不小吧？

src: Well done Herr General. Who would have thought that the Swedish Navy would resort to using poison gas! I hope your troops are OK.
dst: 干得好，将军阁下。谁能想到瑞典海军竟会动用毒气！希望你的部队无恙。

src: Well done Herr Oberst. Thanks to the stuborn defence of you and your men, enough time has been gained to prepare the Hindenburg line. The Alpenkorps is taken out of the line and is sent to the Balkans where the skills of your men are urgently required. Our Bulgarian allies are under a lot of pressure from Serb, French and English attacks. We need to keep them in this war.
dst: 干得好，上校先生。多亏您和您的部下顽强防守，我们争取到了足够的时间来布置兴登堡防线。阿尔卑斯军被调离战线，派往巴尔干，那里急需您部下的本领。我们的保加利亚盟友正承受着来自塞尔维亚、法国和英国进攻的巨大压力。我们必须让他们继续留在战争中。

src: Well done Herr Oberst. Thanks to the stuborn defence of you and your men, enough time has been gained to prepare the Hindenburg line. The Alpenkorps is taken out of the line and is sent to the Balkans where the skills of your men are urgently required. Our Bulgarian allies are under a lot of pressure from Serb, French ands English attacks. We need to keep them in this war.
dst: 干得好，上校先生。多亏了您和您的士兵顽强防守，我们争取到了足够的时间来修筑兴登堡防线。阿尔卑斯军被撤出战线，派往巴尔干，那里急需你们士兵的本领。我们的保加利亚盟友正承受着塞尔维亚、法国和英国军队进攻的巨大压力。我们必须让他们继续留在战争之中。

src: Well done Kommodore!!! Malta is ours, but I fear it was a Pyrrhic victory. The Italians suffered heavy losses and probably won't be able to maintain our dominance in the Mediterranean for a long time. Our fleet after regrouping must start for the Black Sea.....
dst: 干得好，海军准将！！！马耳他是我们的了，但我担心这是一场惨胜。意大利人损失惨重，恐怕在很长一段时间内都无法维持我们在海上的霸主地位。我们重组后的舰队必须开往黑海……

src: Well done Kommodore!!! Move fast to Gibraltar, we have no time.
dst: 干得好，海军准将！！！快速向直布罗陀进发，我们没有时间。

src: Well done Kommodore!!! Next mission is to secure Krasnodar and then Black Sea is ours.
dst: 干得好，海军准将！！！下一个任务是确保克拉斯诺达尔安全，然后黑海就归我们了。

src: Well done Kommodore!!! Once again you have defeated the English.
dst: 干得好，海军准将！！！你再次击败了英国人。

src: Well done Kommodore!!! You stop the Americans.
dst: 干得好，海军准将！！！你挡住了美国人。

src: Well done Lieutenant. The Lado Enclave has been added to Leopold II's private possessions.
dst: 干得好，中尉。拉多飞地已被并入利奥波德二世的私人领地。

src: Well done Major Bauernschmitt! The Italians lost many men trying to capture the Col di Lana, but they captured no more than a few positions. Austro-Hungarian Kaiserjäger will relieve the Alpenkorps in the Dolomite mountains.
dst: 干得好，鲍恩施密特少校！意大利人为夺取拉纳山损失了许多人，但他们只占领了寥寥几处阵地。奥匈帝国皇家猎兵将接替阿尔卑斯军在多洛米蒂山区的防务。

src: Well done Major Bauernschmitt! The Italians lost many men trying to capture the Col di Lana, but they failed completely. Austro-Hungarian Kaiserjäger will relieve the Alpenkorps in the Dolomite mountains.
dst: 干得好，鲍恩施密特少校！意大利人为夺取拉纳山损失了许多人，却彻底失败了。奥匈帝国皇家猎兵将接替阿尔卑斯军在多洛米蒂山区的防务。

src: Well done Sir! Caen and its vicinity are ours. We should keep the momentum and push forward.
dst: 干得好，长官！卡昂及其周边已是我方所有。我们应保持势头，继续推进。

src: Well done Sir! Dunkerque and its vicinity are ours. We should keep the momentum and push forward.
dst: 干得好，长官！敦刻尔克及其周边地区已归我们所有。我们应保持势头继续推进。

src: Well done Sir! The whole Cotentin Peninsula is in our hands. Now we can concentrate our forces on Caen in the east and Avranches in the south.
dst: 干得漂亮，长官！整个科唐坦半岛已在我们的掌控之中。现在我们可以把兵力集中到东面的卡昂和南面的阿夫朗什。

src: Well done again Commander. Your ANZAC troops are proving their worth in this difficult battle.
dst: 再次做得好，指挥官。在这场艰难的战斗中，您的澳新军团部队证明了自己的价值。

src: Well done again Herr General! Rest now while OKW decides on your next course of action.
dst: 再次干得好，将军阁下！现在休息一下，让最高统帅部决定你的下一步行动。

src: Well done commander! Victory is ours!
dst: 干得好，指挥官！胜利属于我们！

src: Well done commander! Victory is ours! The war is won.
dst: 干得好，指挥官！胜利属于我们！战争结束了。

src: Well done comrade Zhukov.  Although the Germans still hold the Sinyavino heights, under your leadership and guidance, the fronts have met, and thus a land corridor has been opened into Leningrad! The city is still partially under siege, but emergency supply trucks are entering Leningrad as we speak, carrying much needed food and supplies. Once this second " Road of Life" is finished being constructed within the liberated corridor, Leningrad should be able to be supplied with all necessities until the Siege can be completely lifted. Congratulations, you have been promoted to Marshal of the Soviet Union!
dst: 干得好，朱可夫同志。尽管德军仍占据着锡尼亚维诺高地，但在你的领导与指挥下，各方面军已经会合，一条通往列宁格勒的陆上走廊就此打通！该城仍处于部分围困之中，但就在我们说话之际，紧急补给卡车正驶入列宁格勒，运去急需的粮食与物资。一旦这第二条“生命之路”在解放的走廊内建成，列宁格勒就能获得一切必需品的补给，直到围困被彻底解除。恭喜你，你已被晋升为苏联元帅！

src: Well done once more Commander we have the Turks on the run, now press your advantage.
dst: 再次干得好，指挥官，我们已让土耳其人落荒而逃，现在乘胜追击吧。

src: Well done!  You gave the Reds got a good licking at Guipuzcoa.  Now they will be unable to receive more supplies or weapons from France.  It's only a matter of time until the north is in our hands.  I'm sorry but you are not going to have time to enjoy the summer in San Sebastian.  I have another important task for you and it must be done quickly!
dst: 干得好！您在吉普斯夸狠狠教训了赤色分子。现在他们再也无法从法国获得补给或武器了。北方落入我们手中只是时间问题。很抱歉，您没时间在圣塞瓦斯蒂安享受夏天了。我另有一项重要任务交给您，必须尽快完成！

src: Well done! 104 members of the corps got the Russian Cross of St. George and we get time off in Tarnopol. A city with music and sidewalks, no noise of artillery fire and beautiful women.
dst: 干得好！军团有104名成员获得了俄国圣乔治十字勋章，我们可以在塔尔诺波尔休假。那是一座有音乐和人行道的城市，没有炮火的喧嚣，还有美丽的女人。

src: Well done! After all of your stunning victories against the Soviets, it's time for our diplomats to exploit your successes. I just hope they are as competent as you!
dst: 干得漂亮！在您取得所有这些对苏维埃的惊人胜利之后，是时候让我们的外交官们利用您的战果了。我只希望他们能像您一样能干！

src: Well done! After all of your stunning victories, it's time for our diplomats to exploit your successes. I just hope they are as competent as you!
dst: 干得漂亮！在您取得所有这些惊人的胜利之后，是时候让我们的外交官们利用您的战果了。我只希望他们能像您一样能干！

src: Well done! During the lat months our enemies have lost thousands of soldiers and tons of equipment, only to occupy a handful of villages without any real strategic value. Thanks to your efforts, the Macedonian front still holds on.
dst: 干得好！在最近几个月里，我们的敌人损失了成千上万的士兵和大量装备，却只占领了几个毫无真正战略价值的小村庄。多亏了您的努力，马其顿战线依然稳固。

src: Well done! The revolution continues. A wildfire is developed. Keep it up!
dst: 干得好！革命仍在继续。星星之火已成燎原之势。继续保持！

src: Well done! The revolution is successful! Long live the Republic!
dst: 干得好！革命成功了！共和国万岁！

src: Well done! You have succeeded in safely retreating our troops from the Ardennes to be redeployed in the "Ligne KW" (Dyle position).
dst: 干得好！你成功地把我们的部队从阿登安全撤出，以便在“Ligne KW”（戴尔河阵地）重新部署。

src: Well done!, The British have fought hard to kick us out from Fort Capuzzo, but it's still in our hands.
dst: 干得好！英军拼命想把我们赶出卡普佐堡，但堡垒仍在我们手中。

src: Well done!. The Republicans are on their feets!. However our spies are reporting that the enemy is assembling a powerful assault Westwards from Madrid... We should be careful.
dst: 干得好！共和军已重新站稳脚跟！不过我方间谍报告说，敌军正在从马德里向西集结，准备发动一场强大的攻势……我们得小心。

src: Well done, Comrade. You have shown that it is a mistake to think the Red Army is an easy prey! You are ordered to dig in, because the situation on other sections of the front causes us to send all reinforcements elsewhere.
dst: 干得好，同志。你已证明，认为红军是易于捕食的猎物是个错误！你奉命就地固守，因为前线其他地段的局势要求我们抽调所有增援前往别处。

src: Well done, General! Our enemies' losses have been staggering, and their hopes on a quick occupation of Elsass are gone. However, our casualties have been high, too, and due to the immediate arrival of a large contingent of French reinforcements, it'll be wiser to retreat behind the Rhein while we try to outflank them with a counterattack in Lothringen.
dst: 干得好，将军！敌人的损失大得惊人，他们迅速占领阿尔萨斯的希望已化为泡影。然而，我们的伤亡也很惨重，而且由于大批法军增援即将赶到，明智的做法是撤到莱茵河后方，同时我们设法在洛林发起反攻来包抄他们。

src: Well done, General, we expected you to accomplish this mission. Gather your men at Alborg, you're going across to Norway.
dst: 干得好，将军，我们料定你能完成此任务。在奥尔堡集结你的部队，你将渡海前往挪威。

src: Well done, General, well done indeed! You had one of the most important parts to play in this campaign, and you did it very well. It's a pity we cannot keep Lemberg, but we agreed a long time ago to give it to the Russians, so it will be renamed to "Lvov". Strange name isn't it? These barbaric eastern tongues...
dst: 干得好，将军，确实干得好！你在这场战役中扮演了最重要的角色之一，而且做得极好。可惜我们留不住伦贝格，我们早就同意把它让给俄国人，所以它将改名为“利沃夫”。这名字够怪吧？这些野蛮的东方语言……

src: Well done, General, you are faster than lightning! The Italians have arrived in Spain too late to fight and the Russians have returned to the Soviet Union where they were executed for not having enough faith in communism to win!
