Franco is head of the Spanish state and will help us whenever we need him. And the most important thing - all across the globe people are beginning to talk with respect of the Germans and the German army again! Truly well done!
dst: 干得好，将军，你比闪电还快！意军抵达西班牙为时已晚，未能参战；俄国人则回了苏联，因对共产主义必胜缺乏信心而遭处决！佛朗哥成了西班牙国家元首，将随时助我们一臂之力。最重要的是——全世界又开始满怀敬意地谈论德意志人与德军了！干得漂亮！

src: Well done, General. That was pretty close! Mussolini is back in power, most of the traitors have been shot. We have taken over the education of the new Italian officers. I hope this will be the end of that story. Italy should remain firmly at our side from now on. And now listen to Mussolini's way of saying thank you! [Mussolini speaking]
dst: 干得好，将军。真是险象环生！墨索里尼重掌大权，大部分叛徒已被枪决。新任意大利军官的培养由我们接手。希望这事就此了结。意大利从此将坚定站在我们一边。现在听听墨索里尼如何道谢！[墨索里尼讲话]

src: Well done, Herr General, well done indeed! You had one of the most important parts to play in this campaign, and you did it very well. It's a pity the Soviets changed the name to "Lvov". Strange name isn't it? These barbaric eastern tongues...
dst: 干得好，将军阁下，真是干得漂亮！在这场战役中，你承担了最重要的角色之一，而且完成得非常出色。可惜苏联人把名字改成了“利沃夫”。这名字真怪，不是吗？这些野蛮的东方语言……

src: Well done, Herr General.  The Allies have been forced to evacuate Northwest Afrika.  We can now provide additional men and material to Feldmarschall Rommel in his drive on Egypt and the Suez Kanel.  We have another important assignment for you on the Russian front.
dst: 干得好，将军阁下。盟军已被迫撤离北非。我们现在可以为隆美尔陆军元帅进攻埃及和苏伊士运河的行动提供更多兵力和物资。我们在俄国战线上还有一项重要任务要交给你。

src: Well done, Oberstleutnant. Fort Vaux is under our control and the French are rebuilding their defence lines near Fleury. With more divisions like the Alpenkorps, I'm sure that our enemies would have to surrender before the end of the summer. That is, if Britain and Russia don't lauch any offensives of their own in support of their French allies. That would be lethal for our plans.
dst: 干得好，中校。沃堡已在我们控制之下，法国人正在弗勒里附近重建防线。若有更多像阿尔卑斯军这样的师，我相信我们的敌人夏天结束之前就不得不投降。当然，前提是英国和俄国不发起各自的攻势来支援其法国盟友。那对我们的计划将是致命的。

src: Well done, commander.  Despite the odds being stacked against you, you managed to hold the Italians off.  However, due to the very serious danger of encirclement posed by other Italian units on our flanks, the order to evacuate Somaliland has been given.  We'll regroup, drink some tea, and then come back later to give the fascists a bloody good licking!
dst: 干得好，指挥官。尽管形势对你不利，你还是设法挡住了意大利人。然而，由于两翼其他意军部队构成了严重的合围威胁，撤出索马里兰的命令已经下达。我们会重整旗鼓、喝点茶，然后再回来把法西斯分子狠狠教训一顿！

src: Well done, comrade. The enemy was much stronger and more tenacious than expected. We were unable to take Novorossiysk itself but we have closed in, on two sides. Attacks on all of the fascist Kuban positions are continuing as we speak!
dst: 干得好，同志。敌人比预想的更强大、更顽强。我们未能拿下新罗西斯克本身，但已从两面包围了它。对法西斯库班各阵地的进攻此刻仍在继续！

src: Well done, comrade. You have stopped the Rumanian fascists! Furious fights have shown the tenacity of the Red Army in war! However the bridgehead cannot be held. As you have noticed the enemy is close to cutting us off from the rear. You have orders to pull back to our side of the Prut River and await new orders.
dst: 干得好，同志。你挡住了罗马尼亚法西斯！激烈的战斗展示了红军在战争中的坚韧！然而桥头堡守不住了。正如你所注意到的，敌人已逼近要切断我们的后路。你奉命撤回我方一侧的普鲁特河，等待新命令。

src: Well done, comrade. You have stopped the fascist advance on the coastal road. The front near Novorossiysk is changing into a stalemate so it seems, which is good from our perspective.
dst: 干得好，同志。你挡住了法西斯在滨海公路上的推进。新罗西斯克附近的战线看来正在转入僵持，从我们的角度看，这是好事。

src: Well done, sir.  Despite the desperate attempts by the Italians and their Colonial allies, the advance is going swimmingly.  Further challenges await however, as the vice tightens around the Italians and their East African forces.
dst: 干得好，长官。尽管意大利人和他们的殖民盟友拼命挣扎，推进依然顺风顺水。然而，随着包围圈在意大利人及其东非部队周围越收越紧，更多挑战还在前方。

src: Well done, sir.  You've pushed the Hun over to the other side of the Mass river and given vital flank protection to our Canadian brethren.  Montgomery has granted your unit some much needed rest as a show of appreciation.  Your men will have the chance to enjoy Christmas away from the front!
dst: 干得好，长官。你已把德国佬赶到了马斯河对岸，为我们加拿大兄弟提供了至关重要的侧翼掩护。蒙哥马利已准你的部队急需的休整，以表嘉许。你的部下将有机会在远离前线的地方过圣诞节！

src: Well done, the Dnepr lies behind us. We can now begin to tackle the large Soviet armies located just to the north-east of Smolensk.
dst: 干得好，第聂伯河已在我们身后。我们现在可以着手对付斯摩棱斯克东北方向庞大的苏军了。

src: Well done, we hold Minsk long enough to take new positions.
dst: 干得好，我们守住明斯克的时间足够构筑新阵地了。

src: Well done. After your superior win, Japan have sued for peace.
dst: 干得好。在你的辉煌胜利之后，日本已请求和平。

src: Well done. In the first phase of the Tobol offensive, you've achieved a brilliant victory. That gives you the chance to keep on advancing until you destroy the Red Army. You could change history, forcing Lenin and the Bolsheviks to sign a peace treaty with Kolchak, and to accept the partition of Russia.
dst: 干得好。在托博尔攻势的第一阶段，您取得了一场辉煌的胜利。这让您有机会继续推进，直到摧毁红军。您可以改变历史，迫使列宁和布尔什维克与高尔察克签署和平条约，并接受俄国的分治。

src: Well done. Palestine is secured. Due to a stunning coup de main by advanced detachments we have managed to secure a safe passage across the Suez Canal, which is now blocked for the British! We can now begin our invasion of Egypt from the east!
dst: 干得好。巴勒斯坦已确保。先遣支队发动了一场漂亮的奇袭，我们得以确保一条安全通道渡过苏伊士运河——如今这运河已对英国关闭！我们现在可以从东面入侵埃及了！

src: Well done. Singapore is isolated now and we should be able to take it pretty easily.
dst: 干得好。新加坡如今已孤立，我们应该能相当轻松地拿下它。

src: Well done. The Axis forces failed to take posession of most of these important passes in the Eastern Dorsal.
dst: 干得好。轴心国军队未能夺取东部多塞勒的大多数重要山口。

src: Well done. The Donbas lies in front of us. We can now begin to tackle the Soviet armies located just to the north and east in the area between the Donets and the Don rivers.
dst: 干得好。顿巴斯就在我们眼前。现在我们可以在顿涅茨河与顿河之间的地区，着手对付位于其北面和东面的苏军了。

src: Well done. The German attack was choked off by your troops. Also, the faschists have lost many troops. It would seem that they have lost the possibility to further counterattacks.
dst: 干得好。德军的进攻被你的部队扼杀了。而且，法西斯分子损失了大量部队。看来他们已失去了进一步反击的可能。

src: Well done. We have recaptured the important port of Benghazi, and now, onwards to Tobruk!.
dst: 干得好。我们夺回了重要的班加西港，现在，向托布鲁克前进！

src: Well done. You could hold most of your targets.
dst: 干得好。你守住了你的大部分目标。

src: Well done. You pushed back the Belgian 1st Cavalry Division.
dst: 干得好。您击退了比利时第1骑兵师。

src: Well done. You pushed back the Belgian 1st Cavalry Division. The Belgian Army is retreating to Antwerp and we can move South in the direction of Paris.
dst: 干得好。您击退了比利时第1骑兵师。比利时陆军正撤向安特卫普，我们可以向南朝巴黎方向推进。

src: Well done. You were able to resist until First Panzer Army encircled the two Soviet Armies attacking from the mainland. They have been encircled and destroyed in the Nogai Steppe.
dst: 干得好。你坚守到第1装甲集团军包围了从大陆发起进攻的两支苏军。他们已在诺盖草原被围歼。

src: Well fianlly OKH has agreed to your demands for an assault on Moscow before the end of the campaigning season. The plan is code-named Operation Typhoon and will involve 2 giant pincer arms encircling the Soviet capitol. Your II Panzergruppe along with II Army will form the southern pincer arm.
dst: 好了，陆军总司令部终于同意了你在战役季结束前进攻莫斯科的要求。该计划代号“台风”行动，将以两条巨大的钳臂合围苏联首都。你的第2装甲集群将连同第2集团军组成南面的钳臂。

src: Well,  Herr General, a bold stroke from the city of Klin to Fedoroloka will close the ring on Moscow. If we can drive through to this point, the enemy capital will surely be ours.
dst: 好，将军阁下，从克林城到费多罗洛卡的大胆一击，将合拢对莫斯科的包围圈。若我们能推进到此点，敌都必归我所有。

src: Well,  Herr General, a bold stroke from the city of Klin to Fedoroloka will close the ring on Moscow. If we can drive through to this point, the enemy capital will surely be ours.  Good luck!
dst: 将军阁下，由克林向费多罗夫卡发起一次大胆突击，即可合拢对莫斯科的包围。若能推进至此，敌国首都必归我有。祝您好运！

src: Well,  Herr General, you must quickly move on Cherbourgh and force the Allies from Europe, so that we may transfer your troops to the East. The Bolsheviks are driving across Poland and our most skilled leaders have been able only to slow them down a bit!
dst: 很好，将军阁下，你必须迅速向瑟堡推进，把盟军赶出欧洲，以便我们将你的部队调往东线。布尔什维克正横扫波兰，我们最精锐的将领也只能稍稍延缓他们的推进！

src: Well,  Herr General, you must quickly move on the key city of Avranches and force the Allies out of Europe. With Fortress Europe secure, and the Luftwaffe's success in dealing with Allied bombing raids, we will be able to build up our forces to invade England next year.
dst: 好，将军阁下，你必须迅速向要城阿夫朗什推进，把盟军赶出欧洲。欧洲堡垒既已稳固，加上德国空军成功应对了盟军的轰炸，我们将能集结部队，明年入侵英格兰。

src: Well,  Herr General; a bold stroke from the city of Klin to Fedoroloka will close the ring on Moscow. If we can drive through to this point, the enemy capital will surely be ours. Good luck!
dst: 那么，将军阁下；从克林城到费多罗洛卡的果断一击将合拢对莫斯科的包围圈。如果我们能推进到这一点，敌人的首都必定归我们所有。祝你好运！

src: Well,  mon Général, our counter-attack must be called a failure. But fortunately, the Germans are even more exhausted than we are and have called off their offensive. We must thank the Lord that the German A7V tanks were too few and too cumbersome to make any significant impact on the battlefield. I wonder what a German army could do with a proper tank force. We hopefully will never find out...
dst: 嗯，将军，我们的反击只能算是失败了。但幸运的是，德军比我们更加疲惫，已经取消了他们的攻势。我们得感谢上帝，德军的A7V坦克数量太少、又太笨重，未能在战场上产生任何重大影响。我很好奇一支德军如果拥有一支像样的坦克部队会怎样。希望我们永远不必知道……

src: Well, General, it's great to wave good-bye to this blood-stained stretch of land, isn't it? The heat, the flies, the smell of rotting corpses - I am sure the horrible images of Gallipoli will still haunt our dreams for some time. Fortunately, this campaign is over - but the war goes on...
dst: 嗯，将军，能向这片血迹斑斑的土地挥手告别，真是太好了，不是吗？酷热、苍蝇、腐尸的气味——我相信加里波利那些可怕的景象还会在一段时间里萦绕我们的梦境。所幸这场战役结束了——但战争仍在继续……

src: Well, General, when news arrived that a Turkish relief force was approaching from the east, it was decided to call off the attack and retreat back towards El Arish. Fortunately, the Turks didn't pursue us, but decided to evacuate Rafa and withdraw to their formidable fortress Gaza.
dst: 好吧，将军，当传来土耳其援军正从东面逼近的消息时，已决定取消进攻，撤回阿里什。所幸土耳其人没有追击我们，而是决定撤离拉法，退回他们坚固的要塞加沙。

src: Well, General, you have fought heroically over all these years, but this is over. Surrender and I guarantee that His Majesty Alfonso XII will grant you forgiveness for all your acts of war. We need men of your worth in the new Spain that will be forged from now on.
dst: 好吧，将军，这些年来您一直英勇作战，但一切都结束了。投降吧，我保证阿方索十二世陛下会赦免您的一切战争行为。在即将铸造的新西班牙里，我们需要您这样的人才。

src: Well, General... A sort of victory is better than a loss. But we will not win this war with mediocre performance. We are expecting the Yugoslavian government to surrender at any minute. We can extend our territory with another 11600 km2. Now we are sending you back to the mainland to reinforce your troops. We'll need you and your men for the big push on the Soviet Union. I hope you are up to the challenge.
dst: 那么，将军……勉强算得上的胜利总比失败好。但凭平庸的表现，我们赢不了这场战争。我们预计南斯拉夫政府随时都会投降。我们可以再扩张11600平方公里领土。现在我们把你送回本土去补充你的部队。对苏联的大举进攻需要你和你的部下。希望你能担得起这一挑战。

src: Well, General... You have secured the Polish-Hungarian border but the German pressure brought about a cease-fire before you could control the entire railway to Poland. Governor Horthy is expecting a better performance from you.
dst: 那么，将军……你已经确保了波兰-匈牙利边界的安全，但还没等你控制通往波兰的整条铁路，德国的压力就促成了一次停火。霍尔蒂摄政期待你有更好的表现。

src: Well, Herr General, you have managed to take Tobruk after a hard fight, but the English were still able to withdraw and strengthen their forces in Egypt.  Unfortunately, the war in North Africa will continue to drag on, since we lack the resources to sustain a major effort in the desert.
dst: 唉，将军阁下，你经过苦战拿下了托布鲁克，但英军仍得以撤退，并加强了在埃及的兵力。遗憾的是，北非战争将继续拖延，因为我们缺乏资源在沙漠维持大规模行动。

src: Well, Herr General. A bold stroke through the city of Schuss'elsburg will close the ring on Leningrad. If we can drive through to this point, the enemy city will surely be ours. Good luck!
dst: 那么，将军阁下。经施吕瑟尔堡城实施一次果敢的突击，便可合拢列宁格勒的包围圈。我们若能一路推进至此，敌城必为我所有。祝您好运！

src: Well, I guess it doesn’t matter. Russia is in the middle of a revolution, and seems determined to destroy herself. We’ll gladly help her to do that. Sooner or later the Russian revolutionaries will have to ask for peace, and Romania will follow. It will take longer than we desired, but finally, after so many sacrifices, the victory in the Eastern front will be a reality.
dst: 不过，我想这已经不重要了。俄国正处于一场革命之中，似乎一心要毁灭自己。我们很乐意助她一臂之力。俄国革命者迟早不得不求和，罗马尼亚也会步其后尘。这虽然会比我们期望的更久，但最终，在经历了这么多牺牲之后，东线的胜利终将成为现实。

src: Well, I guess it doesn’t matter. Russia is in the middle of a revolution, and seems determined to destroy herself. We’ll gladly help her to do that. Sooner or later the Russian revolutionaries will have to ask for peace, and Romania will follow. It will take longer than we desired, but finally, after so many sacrifices, the victory in the Eastern front will be a reality. However, we’ll find a new commander for the future operations of the Alpenkorps.
dst: 不过，我想这已经不重要了。俄国正处于一场革命之中，似乎一心要毁灭自己。我们很乐意助她一臂之力。俄国革命者迟早不得不求和，罗马尼亚也会步其后尘。这虽然会比我们期望的更久，但最终，在经历了这么多牺牲之后，东线的胜利终将成为现实。然而，我们将为阿尔卑斯军今后的行动另寻一位指挥官。

src: Well, I'll be damned.  It's never the fucking Reds, is it?
dst: 唉，真是活见鬼。从来都不是他妈的红军，对吧？

src: Well, Legat, are you ready for a short exercise fight against the Antique-General-Development-Crew .... to try out all functions  ....?
dst: 那么，Legat，准备好和 Antique-General 开发组打一场短小的演习战了吗 .... 试试所有功能 ....？
那么，条顿博德，时候到了。

src: Well, The General Staff is pleased by your performance.  Egypt and the Middle East lie at our feet.  Your ability on the battlefield continues to confound our enemies.
dst: 好，总参谋部对你的表现感到满意。埃及和中东已匍匐在我们脚下。你在战场上的能力持续令敌人困惑。

src: Well, actually the invasion was not quite so successful... the troops we sent across to Folkestone and Dover have been stopped by lots of fortifications and a lot of ground troops. Your first operation on English soil will be to relieve these troops by attacking from the rear.
dst: 呃，其实入侵没那么顺利……我们派往福克斯通和多佛的部队被大量工事和众多地面部队挡住了。你在英格兰土地上的首次行动，将是从后方进攻，解救这些部队。

src: Well, after our failure on Madrid we have planed an attack across the Jarama river. Your mission is to break the Republican line in order to join other Nationalist forces Westwards from here, and complete the encirclement of Madrid. A surrounded capital can't survive for long time, and Madrid will probably fall in our hands within a couple of weeks...
dst: 好，我们在马德里失利之后，计划了一次横渡哈拉马河的进攻。您的任务是突破共和军防线，以便与此地以西的其他国民军部队会合，完成对马德里的包围。一座被围困的首都无法支撑太久，马德里很可能会在一两周之内落入我们手中……

src: Well, after the liberation of El Alcazar your mission is basically clear the area of Toledo, and  open the way to Madrid. This will allow us to easily continue our advance on to Madrid. The enemy forces are mainly militia units which escaped from Toledo, as well as some reinforcements from Madrid.
dst: 好，在解放托莱多城堡之后，您的任务基本上是肃清托莱多地区，并打通通往马德里的道路。这将使我们能够轻易地向马德里继续推进。敌军主要是从托莱多逃出的民兵部队，以及马德里派出的一些增援。

src: Well, following your success at Sedan and Ostende, your brave men must now capture the port of Dunkirk on the Channel. Allied forces at the coast will be trapped if we can secure this harbor. With the British Army as prisoners, we can dictate peace on our terms. Of course, the English are aware of this possibility and will fight furiously to protect their lines of retreat. Good luck to you.
dst: 很好，继你在色当和奥斯坦德取得胜利之后，你勇敢的部下现在必须夺取英吉利海峡上的敦刻尔克港。如果我们能拿下这个港口，海岸上的盟军将被困住。只要俘获英国陆军，我们就能按我们的条件强加和平。当然，英国人清楚这种可能性，会拼死保卫他们的退路。祝你好运。

src: Well, following your success at Sedan, your brave men must now capture the port of Dunkirk on the Channel.  Allied forces in Belgium will be trapped if we can secure this harbor.  With the British Army as prisoners, we can dictate peace on our terms.  Of course, the English are aware of this possibility and will fight  furiously to protect their lines of retreat.  Good luck to you.
dst: 好，继色当的胜利之后，你的勇士们现在必须夺取英吉利海峡上的敦刻尔克港。如果我们能拿下这个港口，在比利时的盟军部队就将陷入包围。把英国军队变成俘虏，我们就能按我们的条件决定和平。当然，英国人明白这种可能，他们会拼死保卫自己的撤退路线。祝你好运。

src: Well, following your success at Sedan, your brave men must now capture the port of Dunkirk on the Channel.  Allied forces in Belgium will be trapped if we can secure this harbor.  With the British Army as prisoners, we can dictate peace on our terms.  Of course, the English are aware of this possibility and will fight furiously to protect their lines of retreat.  Good luck to you.
dst: 那么，继您在色当的战功之后，麾下勇士现在必须夺取英吉利海峡畔的敦刻尔克港。我们若能拿下这座港口，比利时境内的盟军便成瓮中之鳖。一旦英国陆军尽成战俘，我们便可按我方条件主导媾和。当然，英国人也清楚这一可能，必将为保住退路而拼死力战。祝您好运。

src: Well, following your success at Sedan, your brave men must now capture the port of Dunkirk on the Channel. Allied forces in Belgium will be trapped if we can secure this harbor. With the British Army as prisoners, we can dictate peace on our terms. Of course, the English are aware of this possibility and will fight furiously to protect their lines of retreat. Good luck to you.
dst: 很好，继你在色当取得的胜利之后，你的勇士们现在必须夺取英吉利海峡边的敦刻尔克港。如果我们能确保这个港口，比利时境内的盟军部队就将陷入重围。若能俘获英国军队，我们就能按我们的条件强制推行和平。当然，英国人清楚这种可能，他们会拼死保卫其撤退路线。祝你好运。

src: Well, if you like to see it that way.  The Poles were brave for defending that village to the bitter end but it turned into a Polish Thermopylae.  It only shows the superiority of the people's army!  The capitalists from London, Paris and Warsaw are sending their slaves to a certain death in order to stop us.  Yet they fail in stopping us!  They only slowed us down for a single day.  What is a single day in a war?  Go comrade, Lwow is ours!
dst: 好吧，如果您愿意这么看的话。波兰人勇敢地死守那座村庄至最后一刻，但那终究成了波兰的温泉关。这恰恰证明了人民军队的优越性！伦敦、巴黎和华沙的资本家们正把他们的奴隶送上必死之路，妄图阻止我们。然而他们无法阻止我们！他们只不过把我们拖慢了一天。一天在一场战争中又算得了什么？去吧，同志，利沃夫是我们的了！

src: Well, it appears we were correct and the Americans used one of their secret bombs against us.
dst: 唉，看来我们没料错，美国人果真对我们动用了一枚秘密炸弹。

src: Well, it is nice to finally know the Allies intentions for the invasion of Europe!
dst: 好，终于知晓盟军入侵欧洲的意图了，这倒不错！

src: Well, it's been a victory, indeed, although a pyrrhic one. The French counterattack is imminent, and since we haven't been able to dig in, I'm afraid that we'll lose much of the terrain that you've just gained. The fighting in Hartmannsweilerkopf isn't over. There will be many skirmishes in the following months until the front stabilizes again.
dst: 嗯，这确实是一场胜利，尽管是惨胜。法军的反攻迫在眉睫，而由于我们还未能挖好工事，恐怕您刚刚夺取的土地大半会丢掉。哈特曼斯维勒科普夫的战斗还没有结束。此后数月还会有许多小规模交火，直到战线重新稳定下来。

src: Well, it's time to assault Kijów and hopefully inflict a decisive blow against the Red Russians. You must break the enemy line near Zytomierz and advance as fast as you can towards the east. If we can occupy Kijów within a week, the Reds might be too shocked to recover. And the Ukainians would be likely to join the forces of the Ukrainian People's Republic commanded by our ally Symon Petliura.
dst: 好了，是时候进攻基辅了，希望能给红军俄国人一记决定性的打击。您必须在日托米尔附近突破敌军防线，并尽可能快速地向东推进。如果我们能在一周内占领基辅，红军可能会震惊得无法恢复。而乌克兰人很可能加入由我们的盟友西蒙·彼得留拉指挥的乌克兰人民共和国的部队。

src: Well, it's up to you to decide how the campaign will go on. If you click on the western flag, you'll play one fictional scenario that will end with a negotiated peace.
dst: 那么，战役如何继续，由您来决定。如果您点击西边旗帜，您将玩一个虚构场景，最终以谈判和平告终。

src: Well, it's up to you to decide how the campaign will go on. If you click on the western flag, you'll play six fictional scenarios that will end with a total victory for the Whites.
dst: 那么，战役如何继续，由您来决定。如果您点击西边旗帜，您将玩六个虚构场景，最终以白军的全面胜利告终。

src: Well, never mind. We can do this without their help. Get your troops and prepare yourself. The moment of punishment for those treacherous Italians has come.
dst: 算了，不要紧。没有他们的帮助我们也做得成。集结您的部队，做好准备。惩罚那些背信弃义的意大利人的时刻到了。

src: Well, our attack was maybe to optimistic. Otherwise, the finish troops were not superior. Therefore we have decided, that you are not needed anymore.
dst: 嗯，我们的进攻也许过于乐观了。但话说回来，芬兰部队并不占优。因此我们已决定，不再需要你了。

src: Well, our counteroffensive has been a failure after all. It doesn't matter. The Germans have just taken Riga, in the Baltic. I wouldn't be surprised if, in the following months, Russia fell into chaos and the Bolsheviks took power. In the short term that would be good for us. The war at the Eastern front would be over, and we could send more troops to the west, where we need them desperately.
dst: 唉，我们的反攻终究还是失败了。没关系。德国人刚刚夺取了波罗的海沿岸的里加。如果接下来几个月俄国陷入混乱、布尔什维克夺取政权，我也不会感到意外。短期内那对我们有利。东线的战争将结束，我们可以向西线增派部队，那里正亟需增援。

src: Well, our forces have stormed ashore on England's beaches only to meet ferocious resistance.  Our drive to capture London has been stalled.  Now, your services are needed to capture Windsor, a vital communications center.  With this rail junction in our hands, London will be cut off from their industrial centers and be forced to surrender.  Good luck, Herr Feldmarschall.
dst: 我们的部队已冲上英格兰海滩，却遭遇了凶猛抵抗。我们夺取伦敦的推进已经停滞。现在需要您出力夺取温莎——一处至关重要的通信中心。只要这个铁路枢纽落入我们手中，伦敦就将与其工业中心被切断联系，被迫投降。祝您好运，元帅阁下。

src: Well, our forces have stormed ashore on England's beaches only to meet ferocious resistance.  Our drive to capture London has been stalled.  Now, your services are needed to capture Windsor, a vital communications center.  With this rail junction in our hands, London will be cut off from their industrial centers and be forced to surrender.  Good luck, Herr General.
dst: 唉，我们的部队强攻英格兰海滩，却遭遇了凶猛抵抗。我们攻占伦敦的推进已陷入停滞。现在需要你夺取温莎——一个重要的交通枢纽。这个铁路交叉点一旦落入我手，伦敦将与其工业中心隔绝，被迫投降。祝你好运，将军阁下。

src: Well, our forces have stormed ashore on England's beaches only to meet ferocious resistance.  Our drive to capture London has been stalled.  Now, your services are needed to capture the bridges across the Thames river and the airfields. This should cripple the Londoners and their supply routes.  Good luck, Herr General.
dst: 唉，我们的部队强攻英格兰海滩，却遭遇了凶猛抵抗。我们攻占伦敦的推进已陷入停滞。现在需要你夺取泰晤士河上的桥梁和机场。这应能瘫痪伦敦人及其补给线。祝你好运，将军阁下。

src: Well, our forces have stormed ashore on England's beaches only to meet ferocious resistance. Now you have to drive on London. With the British capital in our hands, we will cut off their industrial centers in the north and west and the British will be forced to surrender. Abwehr reports a large American expeditionary force northeast of London! Prepare for enemy counterattacks. Surely the enemy will try to drive us back into the sea.
dst: 嗯，我军已在英格兰海滩上强行登陆，却遭遇了凶猛的抵抗。现在你必须向伦敦推进。一旦英国首都落入我们手中，我们将切断其在北部与西部的工业中心，英国人将被迫投降。阿勃维尔报告，伦敦东北面有一支庞大的美国远征军！做好应对敌军反击的准备。敌人必定会设法把我们赶回海里去。

src: Well, that wasn't so cunning a plan was it?  The German Army that was supposedly on its knees somehow managed to stop our advance to the Rhine, our airborne chaps have suffered tremendously at Arnhem, and the Germans are now threatening to cut across our single road of advance.  This is a crisis.  A large crisis. In fact, if you've got a moment, it's a twelve-story crisis with a magnificent entrance hall, carpeting throughout, 24-hour portage, and an enormous sign on the roof, saying 'This Is a Large Crisis'. A large crisis requires a large plan. Get me two pencils and a pair of underpants.
dst: 呃，那计划也没那么狡猾，不是吗？本该跪地求饶的德军竟设法挡住了我们向莱茵河的推进，我们的空降部队在阿纳姆伤亡惨重，德军如今还威胁要切断我们唯一的推进道路。这是一场危机。一场大危机。事实上，若你有空听，这是一座十二层楼高的大危机，门厅气派、满铺地毯、24小时行李服务，屋顶还竖着一块巨大的牌子，写着“这是一场大危机”。大危机需要大计划。给我拿两支铅笔和一条内裤来。

src: Well, that's about it, that's all I have. I hope it wasn't too disappointing. I will see you for sure, until then take it e-
dst: 好了，就到这里，我要说的就是这些。希望不至于太令人失望。我们一定会再见，在那之前，放轻松点，别太……

src: Well, that's the end of my short campaign.
dst: 好吧，我的短篇战役到此结束。

src: Well, that's the plan - and if I might speak frankly, Sir - I don't think much of it. The enemy has been alerted by our first attack on Gaza. The defences have apparently been strengthened since the first battle, and their forces around Gaza are growing day by day.
dst: 嗯，计划就是这样——恕我直言，长官——我并不看好它。我们第一次进攻加沙已经惊动了敌人。自第一次战役以来，其防御显然已经加强，加沙周围的敌军兵力与日俱增。

src: Well, the time for peaceful solutions is over. The Spaniards didn't want to negotiate, and what have they achieved? A war. Our ships have been bombarding the Cuban and the Philippine coasts for two months and now the land operations have started.
dst: 好了，和平解决的时代已经结束。西班牙人不想谈判，结果他们得到了什么？一场战争。两个月来，我们的舰船一直在炮击古巴和菲律宾海岸，如今地面行动已经展开。

src: Well, the time has come. Make your choice!
dst: 好了，时候到了。作出您的选择吧！

src: Well, there is nothing that I can do. Denikin is in my commander in chief and the decision is made. He's told me that he'll send me to the west in a couple of weeks, but first I must talk to the popes. Anatoly and Olga want to marry in Tsaritsyn in a few days, and I must make some arrangements.
dst: 唉，我无能为力。邓尼金是我的总司令，决定已经作出。他告诉我，几周后他会派我去西面，但首先我得和神父们谈谈。阿纳托利和奥莉加想在几天后在察里津结婚，我得做些安排。

src: Well, this is a minor disappoinment after all of your successes, but Bulgaria has surrendered anyway. You couldn't reconquer Edirne on the battlefield, but our diplomats will do it for you.
dst: 嗯，在您取得这么多成功之后，这只是小小的失望，不过保加利亚到底还是投降了。您未能在战场上夺回埃迪尔内，但我们的外交官会替您办到。

src: Well, we hope the Greeks will be no more trouble now!
dst: 好，但愿希腊人从此不再添乱了！

src: Well, we were wrong. While we were celebrating our victory in Belgrad, the Serbian army was regrouping and preparing a counterattack against our centre and our right flank. They knew that we had provisionally reinforced our left flank to secure Belgrad, and that our front was over-extended, so if they pressed hard enough our centre could fall.
dst: 唉，我们错了。就在我们于贝尔格莱德庆祝胜利之时，塞尔维亚军队正在重新集结，准备对我军中央与右翼发起反攻。他们知道我们曾暂时加强左翼以巩固贝尔格莱德，也知道我们的战线拉得过长，所以只要他们猛攻，我军的中央就可能崩溃。

src: Well, we'll deal with that problem later. Right now it's time for us to give the final blow to France.
dst: 好吧，这个问题以后再处理。眼下，是我们给法国最后一击的时候了。

src: Well, you barely accomplished your mission, but the conquest of England is the positive result.  Now, the English will have no choice but to sue for peace.  You have been lucky, Herr General, with this narrow victory.
dst: 唉，你只是勉强完成了任务，但征服英格兰是积极的成果。如今，英国人将别无选择，只能求和。这场险胜，你真是走运，将军阁下。

src: Well, you have certainly achieved a victory, but many Anyera rebels had enough time to hide. The rebellion still goes on, and it's a matter of time that the Anyera start to trouble us once more. Anyway, your victory will make easier for us to plan more ambitious operations in the future.
dst: 嗯，您确实取得了胜利，但许多安耶拉叛军有足够的时间躲藏了起来。叛乱仍在继续，安耶拉人再次给我们制造麻烦只是时间问题。不管怎样，您的胜利将使我们未来更易于筹划更具雄心的行动。

src: Well, your decisions haven’t been particularly brilliant, but in the end the Italian defences collapsed. We’ve captured thousands of prisoners, and our divisions are marching unopposed to Udine. This is our greatest victory in the west since the war started! Now we must continue our advance before the Italians can react. If we are fast enough, we could force Italy to surrender. However, I fear that we’ve wasted a precious time, and that our enemies will build new defences in a matter of days.
dst: 嗯，您的决策算不上特别出色，但最终意大利人的防线还是崩溃了。我们俘获了数千名战俘，我们的各师正畅通无阻地向乌迪内进军。这是战争开始以来我们在西线取得的最大胜利！现在，我们必须趁意大利人尚未反应过来继续推进。如果我们足够快，就能迫使意大利投降。然而，我担心我们已经浪费了宝贵的时间，敌人几天之内就会构筑起新的防线。

src: Well, your task here has finished. The Turks, and some of our second line divisions, will be able to secure the new front line. They could even occupy the Sinai and threaten the Sueskanal. It will depend on the result of the upcoming German offensive in France. And that's precisely the reason why you must go back to Europe. We count on you for the final attack against the French. Are you ready?
dst: 好了，您在这里的任务已经完成。土耳其人和我们的一些二线师将能够守住新的战线。他们甚至可能占领西奈半岛并威胁苏伊士运河。这要取决于即将到来的德国在法国攻势的结果。而这也正是您必须返回欧洲的原因。我们指望您对法国人发起最后一击。您准备好了吗？

src: Wellcome and congratulations as the new commander of this sector.  Please, let me explain the current situation.  We are pressing the chinese from the North and have a solid base at Canton.  Since our devastating attack on Pearl Harbour the United Kingdom has declared war on us.  The presence of their two european outposts - the portuguese Macao and british Hong Kong are a problem. Up to now, our main objective here is to crush the chinese resistance, just attack the european positions if you are able to do it, otherwise, focus your efforts on the chinese troops only.
dst: 欢迎您，并祝贺您出任本战区的新任指挥官。请允许我说明当前形势。我们正从北方压迫中国军队，并在广州拥有稳固的基地。自从我们对珍珠港发动毁灭性袭击以来，英国已向我们宣战。他们的两处欧洲前哨——葡属澳门和英属香港——的存在是个麻烦。到目前为止，我们在此的主要目标是粉碎中国的抵抗，只有在您有能力时才进攻欧洲人的阵地，否则就只把力量集中在中国军队身上。
Wellington 营/新西兰骑马/新西兰&AD
Wellington 团/新西兰 MR 旅
Wellington/新西兰乘马步枪兵/新西兰&AD
韦尔斯哈普机场（空运可用：3）
大比洛泽尔卡 (大别洛泽尔卡)

src: Werfen Sie die Invasoren zurück ins Meer!
West Australia Infantry Reg./ 3rd Brig./ Imperial Div
dst: West 澳大利亚步兵团/ 第3旅/ Imperial 师

src: West Yorkshire R/7 Br/I Burma Corps
dst: 缅甸军第7英约克郡西区团
俄罗斯斯维尔德洛夫斯克以西
西恩德海滨 (西恩德海滨)
韦斯特-萨特鲁普 (韦斯特索特鲁普)

src: Western Desert Air Force fighters and bombers continue to plague our forces, but your attack was a complete success. Prepare to send mobile forces towards the Suez.
dst: 西部沙漠空军的战斗机和轰炸机仍在不断袭扰我军，但你的进攻彻底成功。准备把机动部队派往苏伊士方向。

src: Western Desert Air Force fighters and bombers continue to plague our forces. Your offensive was no failure, but new enemy reinforcements stand between you and the Suez. There is nothing left but to dig in and await 8th Army's inevitable major offensive.
dst: 西部沙漠空军的战斗机和轰炸机仍在不断袭扰我军。你的攻势并非失败，但新的敌军增援挡在你与苏伊士之间。除了挖壕据守、等待第8集团军不可避免的大攻势，已别无他法。

src: Westf. K黵. Reg./ 11 Brig./ 5 Kav. Div. / II Armee
dst: Westf. 胸甲骑兵团/ 第11旅/ 第5骑兵师 / 第2集团军

src: We’ve done our best, and it hasn’t been enough. It doesn’t matter. Complaining is useless. Now it’s clear that the outcome of the war will be decided at the Western Front, and not in Italy. The Austrians will have to fend for themselves in the Alps. Your men will be transferred to France, where we’ll launch a final offensive next spring.
dst: 我们已经尽了最大努力，但还不够。这无关紧要，抱怨毫无用处。现在已经很清楚，战争的结局将在西线决定，而不是在意大利。奥地利人将不得不在阿尔卑斯山中独自应付。您的部队将被调往法国，明年春天我们将在那里发动最后的攻势。

src: What a beautiful day, comrade!  The smell of capitalists fleeing from the people's army is in the air.  Voronezh is liberated but the enemy is not yet fully defeated.  Start the pursuit immediately!
dst: 多么美好的一天，同志！空气中弥漫着资本家在人民军队面前仓皇逃窜的气息。沃罗涅日已经解放，但敌人尚未被彻底击败。立即展开追击！

src: What a disappointment! Thank God the French have managed to overcome the Germans, who have retired to the Hindenburg Line. But the performance of the American divisions has been so poor that now all our allies are mocking us. Even the Italians, General! The Italians are making fun of us, do you understand? You've disgraced the American Army and must take responsibility for it. I expect your resignation letter on my desk tomorrow at 7 am.
dst: 真是令人失望！谢天谢地，法国人总算战胜了德军，德军已退到兴登堡防线。但美国各师的表现实在太差，如今我们所有的盟友都在嘲笑我们。将军，连意大利人都在取笑我们，您明白吗？您让美国陆军蒙羞，必须为此负责。我期待明早7点前您的辞呈出现在我桌上。

src: What a disaster! After existing for more than six hundred years, the Ottoman Empire is about to be destroyed. You've tried, but you couldn't save it.
dst: 真是灾难啊！在存在了六百多年之后，奥斯曼帝国即将被摧毁。您努力过了，却没能挽救它。

src: What a disaster! Because of your failure we are behind the time schedule for our meeting with the soviets.
dst: 真是一场灾难！由于你的失败，我们与苏联人会师的进度已落后于时间表。

src: What a disaster! Our offensive came to an halt in all that mud and bad weather. Your units are ordered back to France for refreshments and won't take part in offensive operations for a while....
dst: 真是一场灾难！我们的攻势在那片泥泞与恶劣天气中陷入停顿。你的部队被命令返回法国休整，在一段时间内不会参与进攻行动……

src: What a disaster! Our offensive came to an halt. Your units are ordered back to France for further refreshments and won't take part in offensive operations for a while.... General, you are relieved off your command and are ordered back to Paris for further consultations.
dst: 真是一场灾难！我们的攻势停了下来。你的部队被命令撤回法国进一步休整，一段时间内不会参与进攻行动……将军，你被解除指挥权，并被命令返回巴黎接受进一步问询。

src: What a disaster! Thank God that the Russians have lost so many soldiers and equipment that I doubt they'll be able to keep the territories that they've taken for a long time. They've exhausted their last reserves, so from now on I think that they won't suppose a real threat to us.
dst: 真是场灾难！谢天谢地，俄军损失了如此多的士兵和装备，我怀疑他们很难长久守住已占领的领土。他们已经耗尽了最后的预备队，所以从今往后，我想他们不会再对我们构成真正的威胁了。

src: What a disaster! We lost large areas around Strasbourg to the Germans. Your units are ordered back to Paris for refreshments and additional training and won't take part in offensive operations for a while....
dst: 真是一场灾难！我们在斯特拉斯堡周边的大片地区失守于德军。您的部队被命令返回巴黎进行休整和补充训练，并将在一段时间内不参加进攻行动……

src: What a disaster! You failed to secure the eastern shore of the Rhine river. You will be reliefed of your command and are ordered back to London.
dst: 真是一场灾难！你未能确保莱茵河东岸。你将被解除指挥权，奉命返回伦敦。

src: What a disaster, General! Even though the Turks were not able to cross the Canal, they have established a strong position on the eastern shore and will be able to disrupt our supply lines for several weeks, until we have gathered enough troops for a counter-attack. But this may not concern you anymore.
dst: 真是一场灾难，将军！尽管土耳其人未能渡过运河，他们还是在东岸建立了坚固阵地，并将在数周内扰乱我们的补给线，直到我们集结起足够的部队发动反攻。但这或许已与您无关了。

src: What a disaster, General! Even though the Turks were not able to overcome our positions, your failure to defeat them has left them in a very strong position. Our casualites have been servere, and we are expecting another offensive by Johnny Turk in the near future.
dst: 真是一场灾难，将军！尽管土耳其人未能攻克我们的阵地，但您未能击败他们，反而让他们占据了非常有利的位置。我军伤亡惨重，我们预计土耳其佬不久就会再次发动攻势。

src: What a disgrace, General! Allenby's plan was brilliant, but you completely ruined it.
dst: 真是耻辱，将军！艾伦比的计划非常出色，但您把它彻底毁了。

src: What a disgrace, General! The whole operation failed miserably. The glorious British Army being defeated by a bunch of bedouins is surely not the news our government wanted to hear. At the moment, London is very much preoccupied with the Western Front. Otherwise, such a failure could have already meant you being relieved of your command.
dst: 真丢脸，将军！整个行动惨败。光荣的英国陆军竟被一群贝都因人打败，这绝不是我们政府想听到的消息。眼下伦敦正为西线焦头烂额。否则，这样的失败恐怕已经让您被解除指挥权了。

src: What a fight! Congratulations to this glorious victory, Herr General. Athens and Corinth are in our hands. But don't stop now, there are still enemy units southeast of Athens and on the islands.
dst: 真是一场恶战！祝贺你取得这场光荣的胜利，将军阁下。雅典与科林斯已在我们手中。但别就此止步，雅典东南方以及各岛屿上仍有敌军单位。

src: What a pitiful performance Herr General. This is the end of the French campaign for your troops. Luckily other generals performed much better and France will soon be in our hands. I don't understand why, but Hitler is giving you command over the complete SS-V division. The division will be renamed to SS Reich.
dst: 多么可悲的表现，将军阁下。对你和你的部队来说，法国战役到此为止了。好在其他将军表现好得多，法国很快就会落入我们手中。我不明白为什么，但希特勒把整个党卫军第5师交给你指挥。该师将改称党卫军“帝国”师。

src: What a pitiful performance Herr General. Von Kleist will have to divert more troops to the North to capture Belgrade now. This will delay the next phase of our invasion of Greece. The plan to capture Crete has been given up already in order not to further delay the invasion of Russia.
dst: 多么可悲的表现，将军阁下。冯·克莱斯特现在不得不抽调更多兵力北上夺取贝尔格莱德。这将延误我们入侵希腊的下一阶段。为不再延误入侵俄国，夺取克里特的计划已经被放弃。

src: What a pity, Oberstleutnant. Although you did accomplish the basic goals of your mission, you weren’t able to exploit your success, and our enemies retreated to safer positions, where they’ll establish a powerful defence line.
dst: 真可惜，中校。尽管您确实完成了任务的基本目标，却没能扩大战果，我们的敌人撤退到了更安全的阵地，并将在那里建立起一条强大的防线。

src: What a poor performance Herr general. You were lucky that the Leibstandarte on your left flank has performed much better than your troops. The Belgian king has capitulated and the British forces are retreating towards the port of Dunkirk. The Luftwaffe can take further care of destroying the encircled troops. Refit your troops and move your forces east to wrap up Maginot line garrisons.
dst: 表现真差，将军阁下。你运气不错，左翼的警卫旗队比你的部队表现好得多。比利时国王已投降，英军正朝敦刻尔克港撤退。德国空军可以接手继续消灭被围部队。让你的部队重新装备，然后东调，去收拾马奇诺防线的守军。

src: What a shame, General! You've lost. Not only did Nagyszeben remain in Romanian hands but they also pushed us back from Northern Transylvania. The Second Vienna Award has been nullified. The Governor has accepted your resignation.
dst: 真遗憾，将军！你输了。锡比乌不但仍在罗马尼亚人手中，他们还把我们从北特兰西瓦尼亚赶了回来。第二次维也纳裁决已被作废。摄政已接受你的辞呈。

src: What a tragedy! Our brave general has been shot by sniper fire, and we have lost his skilled leadership forever. At least he can rest in peace knowing that we acieved our objectives in Kosovo.
dst: 多么不幸！我们英勇的将军被狙击手的子弹击中，我们永远失去了他出色的指挥。至少他在安息时知道，我们已在科索沃达成了目标。

src: What a tragedy, General! Our troops were caught in the deadly fire of the Turkish guns and MGs. We were unable break into the enemy's heavily fortified positions. I think we have to come to terms with the fact that this campaign has failed completely.
dst: 多么悲惨啊，将军！我军陷入了土耳其火炮与机枪的致命火力之中。我们无法突入敌人重重设防的阵地。我想我们必须接受这场战役已彻底失败的事实。

src: What a tragedy, General! Our troops were simply overwhelmed by the thousands of Turkish troops that attacked our positions. Several battalions have been annihilated, and we were driven back to the sea. Evacuation of ANZAC was the only option left. You and your troops will return to Cape Helles.
dst: 多么悲惨啊，将军！我军被进攻阵地的成千上万土耳其军彻底压垮了。好几个营被歼灭，我们被赶回了海边。撤离澳新军团成了唯一的选择。您和您的部队将返回海勒斯角。

src: What an amazing victory! Italy has announced that it'll unconditionally surrender to us, in the hopes of avoiding Austria’s harsh terms.
dst: 多么了不起的胜利！意大利已宣布将无条件向我们投降，以期避开奥地利苛刻的条件。

src: What is true is that a second column under General Bernal coming from Aguacate should have joined Inclan's forces in his attack to Cacarajicara. Bernal's column failed to support General Inclan in the time specified. As a result, and also due to personal enmity, General Bernal was driven out of Cuba by Weyler.
dst: 真实的情况是，贝尔纳尔将军麾下从阿瓜卡特出发的第二纵队本应加入因克兰的部队进攻卡卡拉希卡拉。但贝尔纳尔的纵队未能在指定时间内支援因克兰将军。因此，再加上私人恩怨，贝尔纳尔将军被韦勒驱逐出了古巴。

src: What our troops need now is a short break to bring more men and material forward for the final dash to the Suez Canal.
dst: 我们的部队现在需要的是一次短暂休整，以便把更多人员和物资前送，为冲向苏伊士运河的最后一搏做准备。

src: What remained of Cavalry Army was sent south to fight with Wrangel's White forces in Ukraine and the Crimea.
dst: 骑兵集团军的残部被调往南方，与弗兰格尔的白军在乌克兰和克里米亚作战。

src: What that does mean, however, is that these aren't your men on the surface here, Commander.  Your A.O. unit has stayed planetside; they're too valuable to risk deploying on a mission like this one and we need a quick response team at home in case something ELSE goes awry while you're up there.
dst: 不过这也意味着，在地表上的这些人不是你的部下，指挥官。你的 A.O. 部队留在了行星表面；他们太宝贵，不能冒险派去执行这样的任务，而且我们需要一支快速反应部队留守本土，以防你在上面时还有别的什么鬼事出岔子。

src: What the fuck? This comprehensive and long time planed offensive was no success? Stalin is in rage. Maybe Stalingrad is lost too in a few days. You will be deported to Siberia. There you will learn what hard work means.
dst: 搞什么鬼？这场筹划已久、规模宏大的攻势竟然没有成功？斯大林勃然大怒。也许过不了几天连斯大林格勒也会失守。你将被流放到西伯利亚。在那里你会明白什么叫艰苦的劳动。

src: What use was the tempory airfield?
dst: 那座临时机场有什么用？

src: What we need to do here, Commander, is wipe out every trace of this time machine ever having existed.  The eggheads believe that our actions at Antietam created a weaker United States that succumbed to a nuclear war with the USSR, and that if we eliminate Pegasus and his machines, we can successfully avoid the future we just came from.
dst: 我们要在这里做的，指挥官，是抹除这台时间机器曾经存在过的一切痕迹。书呆子们相信，我们在安蒂特姆的行动造就了一个更弱的美国，它最终在与苏联的核战争中灭亡；而如果我们消灭珀伽索斯和他的机器，我们就能成功避开我们刚刚来自的那个未来。

src: What will we do now? Soon, the British will threaten again our hegemony in eastern Europe, and the German offensive in France will be less likely to succeed. Actually, the British could just wait until the effects of their naval blockade become unbearable, and force us to surrender. No matter how many battles you've won, General, a single failure may be enough to knock us down. I expect you to resign immediately, and for the good of our Empire let's hope that your successor is luckier than you.
dst: 我们现在该怎么办？不久之后，英国将再次威胁我们在东欧的霸权，而德国在法国的攻势获胜的可能性也会降低。实际上，英国只需等到他们海上封锁的后果变得无法忍受，就能迫使我们投降。将军，无论您赢过多少场战役，一次失败就足以把我们击倒。我期望您立即辞职，为了我们帝国的利益，让我们期盼您的继任者比您更幸运吧。

src: What you have done today is one of Bulgaria's greatest victories of all time. Not only did you stop the enemy offensive, you have routed its army! Now the Macedonian front is, at last, open for our final offensive. But before, you must secure our left flank at the Doiran Lake. There, the British are preparing a huge assault against our positions. Go and reinforce that sector. With you on our side, we have nothing to fear.
dst: 您今天的壮举，是保加利亚有史以来最伟大的胜利之一。您不仅阻止了敌人的攻势，还击溃了其军队！如今马其顿战线终于为我们的最后攻势敞开了大门。但在此之前，您必须巩固我们在多伊兰湖的左翼。那里，英军正准备对我军阵地发动大规模突击。去增援那个地段吧。有您在我们这边，我们无所畏惧。

src: What!??  Where are you going with those troops!!??  What kind of retreat are you making???  Your cowardice shows you are not the general which the People's Army needs! You are dismissed, as an officer, but not from the army, private!
dst: 什么！？？您带着那些部队要去哪里！！？？您这算是什么撤退？？？您的怯懦表明您不是人民军所需要的将军！您被解职了，不再担任军官，但仍留在军中，列兵！

src: Whatever happens, don't do any deed of evil. Revenge on an innocent Russian civilians or captured soldiers won't help her in any way, but it will hurt many people, including you yourself.
dst: 无论发生什么，不要做任何恶事。报复无辜的俄国平民或俘虏，对她不会有任何帮助，却会伤害许多人，包括你自己。

src: When Camara's Squadron arrived at Port Said on 26 June, the Egyptian and British authorities, influenced by the US consul, delayed the supply of coal to the squadron. By the time his ships were able to transit the Suez Canal on 5 July, more than a week later, the Battle of Santiago de Cuba had already destroyed Spanish Squadron under Vice Admiral Cervera, freeing large U.S Navy forces for action elsewhere. Faced with a threat that the Americans begin operations against Spain herself, Cámara was ordered to return home on July 7. Cámara departed Suez on 11 July 1898 for Spain, where the Squadron was dissolved on July 25.
dst: 当卡马拉的分舰队于6月26日抵达塞得港时，受美国领事影响的埃及和英国当局拖延了向分舰队供应煤。等到他的舰只能在7月5日通过苏伊士运河时，已是一个多星期之后，圣地亚哥-德古巴海战已经摧毁了塞韦拉海军中将指挥的西班牙分舰队，腾出了大批美国海军兵力用于他处。面对美国人可能对西班牙本土开战的威胁，卡马拉于7月7日奉命返航。卡马拉于1898年7月11日离开苏伊士驶向西班牙，该分舰队于7月25日解散。

src: When Emperor Yohannes decided to attack the Sudanese before dealing with Menelik's insolence, he had said: "if I come back I can fight Shewa later on when I return. And if I die at Metemma in the hands of the heathens, I shall go to heaven". We would soon learn that those were truly prophetic words.
dst: 当约翰内斯皇帝决定先攻打苏丹人、再回头处置孟尼利克的放肆无礼时，他曾说：「如果我回来，等我回来后再收拾绍阿也不迟。如果我死在梅特马、落入异教徒之手，那我将升入天堂」。我们很快就会明白，这番话真是预言。

src: When France finally surrendered in June, torn apart by foreign armies and an internal revolution, we believed that the war would finish. But we were wrong. Britain still refuses to sign a peace treaty. Its government knows that since Germany will never be able to invade the British Islands, the country is safe. So they intend to continue the naval blockade against continental Europe hoping that, in the long term, hunger will force us to give in.
dst: 当法国终于在六月投降、被外国军队和一场内部革命撕得四分五裂时，我们原本以为战争就要结束。但我们错了。英国仍然拒绝签订和平条约。它的政府知道，德国永远无法入侵不列颠诸岛，因此这个国家是安全的。所以他们打算继续对欧洲大陆进行海上封锁，指望从长远看，饥饿会迫使我们屈服。

src: When Guderian's and Hoth's troops closed the encirclement around Smolensk, the fate of 100,000 Russians was sealed. The Bolsheviks also lost 2000 tanks and 2000 guns in the Smolensk encirclement.
dst: 当古德里安和霍特的部队合拢对斯摩棱斯克的包围时，10万俄国人的命运已成定局。布尔什维克还在斯摩棱斯克包围圈中损失了2000辆坦克和2000门火炮。

src: When His Majesty the King Alfonso XIII authorized the suspension of the parliamentary system and my dictatorship, I decided thar my priority would be the end of the war of Morocco, but that is not going to be an easy task. After Annual the "kabilas" see Abd el-Krim as their saviour and liberator, and the number of insurgents grows day by day.
dst: 当国王阿方索十三世陛下批准中止议会制、实行我的独裁统治时，我就决定，我的当务之急是结束摩洛哥战争，但那绝非易事。安瓦勒一役之后，「卡比拉」把阿卜杜·克里姆视为他们的救星和解放者，叛乱者的人数与日俱增。

src: When I heard, in 1881, that a rebellion had started in Sudan against the Egyptian rule, I thought that it would be crushed in a few weeks. I was terribly wrong. The rebel leader was a Muslim cleric known as the Mahdi, who preached the most fanatical form of Islam that I've ever known. It was worse than anything that I had seen in Morocco, in Algeria, in Egypt, or anywhere. But, very soon, the Sudanese tribes, resentful after decades of Egyptian oppression, saw the Mahdi as a holy prophet who would liberate the land and renew the Islamic faith. They started to defeat the Egyptian garrisons in a series of battles and, two years later, they controlled most of Sudan and were powerful enough to annihilate am army of 10,000 Egyptian soldiers at El Obeid. It didn't matter that their commander was an English colonel.
dst: 1881年，当我听说苏丹爆发了反抗埃及统治的叛乱时，我原以为几周之内它就会被镇压下去。我错得太离谱了。叛军领袖是一位被称为马赫迪的穆斯林教士，他宣扬的是我平生所知最狂热的伊斯兰教义。那比我曾在摩洛哥、阿尔及利亚、埃及或任何地方见过的都更极端。但很快，在数十年埃及压迫下满怀怨恨的苏丹各部族，就把马赫迪视为一位将解放这片土地、复兴伊斯兰信仰的神圣先知。他们开始在一连串战斗中击败埃及驻军，两年之后，他们控制了苏丹大部分地区，并且强大到足以在欧拜伊德歼灭一支一万人的埃及军队。即便那支军队的指挥官是个英国上校也于事无补。

src: When I speak with the other Generals, they all say that we should stay mobile. We should attack and throw the Boches out of our holy homeland. But I'm really not sure if it's as easy as it sounds.
dst: 当我与其他将军交谈时，他们都说我们应该保持机动。我们应当进攻，把德国佬赶出我们神圣的国土。但我真的不确定这是否像听上去那么容易。

src: When Serbia was defeated, Montenegro should have stepped aside and declare his neutrality. Instead, this tiny, stubborn kingdom chose to stay with their old allies, the Serbs, and now they'll suffer the same fate.
dst: 塞尔维亚战败后，黑山本该退到一旁并宣布中立。然而，这个弹丸小国却执意与他们的老盟友塞尔维亚人站在一起，如今他们也将遭受同样的命运。

src: When Turkey joined the Central Powers in November 1914, the new enemy threatened the most vital supply line of the British Empire - the Suez Canal. The Egyptian Army was weak, and the Canal only defended by some battalions of the Indian Army. But soon troops from all over the Empire flooded into the Nile Delta.
dst: 1914年11月土耳其加入同盟国时，这个新敌人威胁到了大英帝国最至关重要的补给线——苏伊士运河。当时埃及陆军孱弱，运河仅由印度陆军的一些营防守。但很快，来自帝国各地的部队涌入尼罗河三角洲。

src: When Varus in summer 9 AD moves his 3 Legions into the west for the wintercamp into the safe left Rhine region Arminius realizes his chance...
dst: 公元9年夏，瓦鲁斯率3个军团西行，准备进入莱茵河左岸的安全地区过冬，阿米尼乌斯察觉到了机会...

src: When Vercingetorix surrendered after 6 years of war and the lost battle of Alesia in 52 BC, has Caesar  conquered an area that was as big as the Roman Republic before, so he doubled the Roman territory ...
dst: 当维钦托利在六年战争、以及公元前52年阿莱西亚之败后投降时，凯撒已征服了与先前的罗马共和国同样广大的地区，等于把罗马的疆域翻了一倍……

src: When Von Kluck realised his mistake he ordered his men to turn back and fight the advancing French Sixth Army, but in doing do he opened a 30 mile gap between his forces and Von Bülow's Second Army, just in front of our forces. After some hesitation, on September 6th we started our advance. We crossed the two Morins and the Marne River, but in the strict sense there was no battle during our march to the North. Only open roads were ahead of us. To our left and our right the Germans hardly managed to hold the French, and finally they were forced to retreat to safer positions. Their summer offensive had failed, and they would never take Paris.
dst: 当冯·克卢克意识到自己的错误时，他命令部队掉头，迎战推进中的法国第六集团军，但这样做却在己方部队与冯·比洛的第二集团军之间、恰在我军面前撕开了一道30英里宽的缺口。经过一番犹豫，9月6日我们开始推进。我们渡过了两条莫兰河和马恩河，但严格说来，我们向北行军途中并无战斗。前方只有畅通的道路。在我们左右两翼，德军几乎招架不住法军，最终被迫撤退到更安全的阵地。他们的夏季攻势失败了，他们永远也攻不下巴黎。

src: When WWI started nobody expected that the German colonial army in Africa could resist the enemy for a long time. Isolated and numerically inferior, the German soldiers and the native troops in the service of the Kaiser (the "askari") who were in Togo, Cameroon, South West Africa or German East Africa were supposedly no match for the colonial armies of powers such as the British Empire, Franced or Belgium.
dst: 一战爆发时，没有人料到驻非洲的德国殖民军队能长期抵抗敌人。孤立无援、数量上处于劣势，效力于德皇的德国士兵与本地部队（即「阿斯卡里」）分布在多哥、喀麦隆、西南非洲或德属东非，按理说根本不是大英帝国、法国或比利时等国殖民军队的对手。

src: When drawing water, the Romans light Ligurian auxiliaries encountered the Teutons rearguard, consisting mainly of Ambrones. The fighting soon spread to a battle from where the Romans gained the upper hand after a fierce battle. They pursued the retreating Teutons until they holed up in their laager.
dst: 罗马人在取水时，轻装的利古里亚辅助部队撞上了条顿人的后 卫——主要由安布罗内斯人组成。战斗很快升级为一场会战，罗马人在一番激战后占了上风。他们追击撤退的条顿人，直到对方躲进车阵。

src: When he had said this with a loud voice, he leaped from the ship and proceeded to bear the eagle toward the enemy. Then our men, exhorting one another that so great a disgrace should not be incurred, all leaped from the ship. When those in the nearest vessels saw them, they speedily followed and approached the enemy.....
dst: 他大声说完这番话，便从船上跃下，扛着鹰旗向敌人走去。于是我方士兵互相鼓劲，不让如此大的耻辱落到身上，全都从船上跃下。最近的那些船上的人看见他们，也迅速跟上，逼近敌人……..

src: When he, being in the middle of the sea, wasn´t in the mood for this, they gave him a "helping" hand to get out....
dst: 若他身处大海中央不愿动身，他们就「帮」他一把，送他下船....

src: When it became clear that the counter-attack was failing, instead of ending it, STAVKA poured in more forces from other sections of the line and in one area 10,000 men guarded 100 miles of the Dniepr against German forces which out numbered them 6 to 1. With Kleist's I Panzergruppe coming from the south-west the entire South-West Front was in danger of encirclement- but still Stalin refused to withdraw.
dst: 当反击显然失败时，最高统帅部不但没有停止，反而从战线其他地段投入更多兵力；在某一地区，1万人守卫着100英里宽的第聂伯河防线，面对的德军兵力是他们的6倍。随着克莱斯特的第1装甲集群从西南方向逼近，整个西南方面军都有被围的危险——但斯大林仍然拒绝撤退。

src: When it became clear that the counter-attack was failing, instead of ending it, STAVKA poured in more forces from other sections of the line and in one area 10,000 men guarded 100 miles of the Dniepr against German forces which out numbered them 6 to 1. With Kleist's I Panzergruppe coming from the south-west the entire South-West Front was in danger of encirclement- but still Stalin refused to withdraw.............
dst: 当反击显然失败时，最高统帅部不但没有停止，反而从战线其他地段投入更多兵力；在某一地区，1万人守卫着100英里宽的第聂伯河防线，面对的德军兵力是他们的6倍。随着克莱斯特的第1装甲集群从西南方向逼近，整个西南方面军都有被围的危险——但斯大林仍然拒绝撤退………………

src: When it seemed that the fourth assault against Vyatka would fail, too, the Siberians came to reinforce us. Together we overcame the last clusters of enemy resistance.
dst: 当对维亚特卡的第四次进攻似乎也将失败时，西伯利亚军赶来增援我们。我们合力攻克了敌人最后几个抵抗据点。

src: When on the 10th of January 1940 German military plans were captured after a German plane crashed, Belgian King Leopold III was prepared to accept allied troops in his country on some conditions (Belgian participation in the peace negotiations, guarantee of Belgium's integrity and of his colonies, and financial support to rebuild Belgium after the war). However, these conditions were unacceptable for Britain and France and their troops did not enter into Belgium until the German attack.
dst: 1940年1月10日，一架德国飞机坠毁后德军军事计划被缴获，比利时国王利奥波德三世准备在一定条件下接受盟军部队进入本国（比利时参与和平谈判、保证比利时及其殖民地的完整、以及战后重建比利时的财政支持）。然而，这些条件对英国和法国来说无法接受，他们的部队直到德国发动进攻才进入比利时。

src: When operation Barbarossa opened on the 22nd of June 1941, one of the most prominent axes, was the one from Bialystok to Minsk. The pattern of the border in this area formed a prominent bulge to the west of Bialystok, which offered German forces a tempting opportunity to attack the Russian flanks and encircle large concentrations of Russian forces. On the 27th of June, elements of the 23rd Infantry Division captured Bialystok and German forces began to squeeze the perimeter of the pocket from the north, south and west. The 2nd and 3rd Panzer Groups raced towards Minsk and Bobruisk, closing the pocket shut to the east. Remnants of some units slipped through the weak German cordon to rejoin the Russian front line further east and some joined the growing number of Partisan groups in the area. The Panzers had moved so quickly that bypassed and scattered Russian units often re-appeared out of the dense forests and swamps at the German rear creating havoc amongst the lines of supply and communication. The Red Army had lost 250,000 men killed or captured and vast amounts of vehicles and heavy equipment destroyed or captured.
dst: 1941年6月22日“巴巴罗萨”行动开始时，最突出的进攻轴线之一便是从比亚韦斯托克到明斯克这一路。这一带的边界走向在比亚韦斯托克以西形成一个明显突出部，为德军提供了诱人的机会：攻击俄军侧翼并围歼大股俄军。6月27日，第23步兵师的部分部队夺取比亚韦斯托克，德军开始从北、南、西三面压缩包围圈。第2和第3装甲集群向明斯克和博布鲁伊斯克疾进，从东面封死了口袋。一些部队的残部从薄弱的德军封锁线溜过，重新加入更东面的俄军战线，还有一些则加入了该地区日益壮大的游击队。装甲部队推进得太快，被绕过和打散的俄军部队常常从茂密的森林和沼泽中重新出现在德军后方，在补给和通信线上制造混乱。红军损失了25万人（阵亡或被俘），大量车辆和重型装备被毁或被缴获。

src: When our elite regiments arrived in Tientsin the Yihetuan offensive had already ended in chaos. All their attacks had failed and they were simply roaming the walled city of Tientsin. Certainly they were fierce and brave, like rabid dogs, but they were completely incapable of achieving any military objective, too. After nearly one month of victorious street battles the soldiers of the foreign coalition were confident enough to be planning a final assault on the Yihetuan positions.
dst: 当我们的精锐团抵达天津时，义和团的攻势已经在一片混乱中结束了。他们所有的进攻都失败了，只是在有城墙的天津城里游荡。诚然，他们像疯狗一样凶猛而勇敢，但他们也完全无法达成任何军事目标。经过近一个月节节胜利的巷战，外国联军士兵已经信心十足，正筹划对义和团阵地发起最后总攻。

src: When the "Race to the Sea" ended last year and the front stabilized, a salient was formed around Ypern, whose conquer has become a matter of great importance for us. Strategically speaking, there are some small heights there that would be extremely useful as observation points. But its symbolic importance may be even greater. In october thousands of good German soldiers, including young students and other volunteers, gave their lives in this very same area, trying to take Langemarck. It is our duty to avenge them and show the world that they didn't die in vain.
dst: 去年「奔向大海」结束、战线稳定下来之后，伊普尔周围形成了一个突出部，攻克它已成为我们的一件大事。从战略上讲，那里有几处小高地，用作观察点会极为有用。但它的象征意义也许更大。去年10月，成千上万优秀的德国士兵，包括年轻学生和其他志愿兵，正是在这片土地上，为夺取朗厄马克而献出了生命。为他们复仇，并向世人证明他们没有白白牺牲，是我们的责任。

src: When the Allies attacked in broad daylight on May 6th their advance was swiftly halted by strong Turkish resistance, mainly because the short artillery preparation had failed to destroy the Turkish MG posts. There was no point in the front line where the gains were more than 400 yards. The attack was resumed on the following days, without any significant success. 6,500 troops, about one third of the Allied soldiers who fought in the battle, became casualties. With the failure of the second battle, General Hamilton requested further divisions...
dst: 当协约国军队在5月6日大白天发起进攻时，他们的推进很快就被土耳其军顽强的抵抗所阻止，主要是因为短暂的炮火准备未能摧毁土耳其军的机枪阵地。前线没有任何一处进展超过400码。随后几天进攻继续，但毫无重大战果。6500名官兵——约占参战协约国士兵的三分之一——成了伤亡。随着第二次战斗的失败，汉密尔顿将军要求增派更多师……

src: When the Chinese liberated Mukden and Siping, a wave of panic spread among the Russians, who quickly fled from most of Manchuria. The Manchu Bannermen could retake Harbin and other important towns quite easily, and by the end of the year most of Manchuria was again under Chinese control. Finally, the Russians realized that being on good terms with China would be less costly and much more profitable than invading its neighbours. Russia and China signed a honourable peace and, finally, the last foreign army that remained in China left the country.
dst: 当中国人解放奉天和四平时，恐慌在俄国人中蔓延开来，他们迅速逃离了满洲的大部分地区。满洲八旗军相当轻松地夺回了哈尔滨和其他重要城镇，到年底，满洲的大部分地区又重新处于中国控制之下。最终，俄国人意识到，与中国保持良好关系，比入侵其邻国代价更低、利润更大得多。俄中两国签署了一份体面的和约，最后，留在中国的最后一支外国军队撤离了该国。

src: When the Dunkirk evacuation started on 27 May the Belgian Army was to the brink of collapse. The Belgians had practically exhausted all available means of resistance. They had no reserves, the Luftwaffe had air supremacy, rail networks were destroyed and roads were blocked by 3 million civilian refugees. Under these circumstances further retreat was not feasible and resistance useless. On the evening of 27 May King Leopold III requested an armistice. Despite the advice of his government, the King decided to stay in Belgium to share the fate of his army and people.
dst: 当5月27日敦刻尔克撤退开始时，比利时军队已濒临崩溃。比利时人几乎耗尽了所有抵抗手段。他们没有预备队，德国空军掌握着制空权，铁路网被摧毁，道路被300万平民难民堵塞。在这种情况下，进一步撤退已不可行，抵抗也毫无意义。5月27日傍晚，国王利奥波德三世请求停战。尽管政府提出建议，国王仍决定留在比利时，与他的军队和人民共命运。

src: When the Emperor heard of the revolts in Kiel, he orderd the 4th Jäger Regiment to Berlin. The city burns. The insurgents have the working-class neighborhoods under control.
dst: 当皇帝听说基尔的起义时，他命令第4猎兵团开赴柏林。城市在燃烧。起义者已经控制了工人阶级街区。

src: When the Germans invaded eastern France in 1914, one of their main goals was the taking of Verdun. They failed, but not before conquering the town of Saint Mihiel. Once the front stabilized the Krauts kept a salient around that town, with a high strategic importance. The French tried to expel the Germans from Saint Mihiel several times, to no avail.
dst: 1914年德军入侵法国东部时，其主要目标之一是夺取凡尔登。他们失败了，但在此之前却占领了圣米耶勒镇。战线稳定后，德国佬在该镇周围保住了一个具有重要战略意义的突出部。法国人曾数次试图将德军逐出圣米耶勒，均未成功。

src: When the Great War ended, we were counted among Germany's friends. The Ethiopian Empire is now bigger than ever. We have ambitious plans for modernizing our country, and I hope that we'll accomplish them. It won't be easy. Traditionally, Ethiopia had been the land of two rival tribes, the Amharas and the Tigrayans. Now, the majority of the empire's population are Oromos, Somalis, or people from different tribes. Besides, most of the Tigrayans would rather live in their own, independent country, and their loyalty to the empress is questionable. Overcoming this tribal strife will be indispensable if Ethiopia is to become a prosperous country. May God guide us during these years of peace, as he guided us during the years of war.
dst: 一战结束时，我们被算作德国的友邦。埃塞俄比亚帝国如今比以往任何时候都更辽阔。我们为国家的现代化制定了雄心勃勃的计划，我希望我们能实现它们。这不会容易。传统上，埃塞俄比亚一直是两个相互敌对的部族——阿姆哈拉人和提格雷人——的土地。如今，帝国人口的大多数是奥罗莫人、索马里人，或来自其他部族的人。此外，大多数提格雷人宁愿生活在自己的独立国家里，他们对女皇的忠诚也值得怀疑。如果埃塞俄比亚想成为一个繁荣的国家，克服这种部族纷争就必不可少。愿上帝在这些和平岁月里指引我们，正如他在战争岁月里指引我们一样。

src: When the Noricans called him for help, Consul Gnaeus Papirius Carbo left Pontafel and and approached the Germans.
dst: 当诺里库姆人向他求援时，执政官格奈乌斯帕皮里乌斯卡尔波离开蓬塔费尔，向 日耳曼人逼近。

src: When the Russian Civil War broke out in 1918, a popular Cossack leader named Budyonny organized a small cavalry force in the Don region out of local Cossacks and common-place criminals.  This force rapidly grew in numbers, sided with the Bolsheviks and eventually became the Cavalry Army.  It was transformed from a guerrilla force into a proper military unit.  This Army played an important role in winning the Civil War for the Bolsheviks, driving the White General Anton Denikin back from Moscow.
dst: 1918年俄国内战爆发时，一位名叫布琼尼的颇受爱戴的哥萨克领袖，在顿河地区从当地哥萨克和普通罪犯中组建了一支小规模骑兵部队。这支部队迅速壮大，加入布尔什维克一方，最终成为骑兵集团军。它从一支游击队转变为正规军。这支集团军在为布尔什维克赢得内战中发挥了重要作用，将白军将领安东·邓尼金从莫斯科城下击退。

src: When the Spanish army retreated from Xauen, Abd el-Krim believed that, sooner or later, Spain would be forced to accept the Berber´s peace terms. Since a Spanish counterattack seemed impossible, he felt free to attack France, the main colonial power in the region.
dst: 当西班牙军队从舍夫沙万撤退时，阿卜杜·克里姆相信，西班牙迟早会被迫接受柏柏尔人的和平条件。既然西班牙的反攻似乎不可能，他便放手去进攻该地区主要的殖民强国法国。

src: When the WWI started, the German Empire didn't have any unit which was specialized in mountain warfare. After suffering greatly at the hands of the French Chasseurs Alpins during the first moths of the conflict, and witnessing the effectiveness of the Austrian Kaiserschützen, the Germans decided to create a similar force.
dst: 第一次世界大战爆发时，德意志帝国还没有任何专门从事山地作战的部队。在战争头几个月里吃尽了法国阿尔卑斯猎兵的苦头，又目睹了奥地利帝国猎兵的高效之后，德国人决定组建一支类似的部队。

src: When the battle was over, the Dervish Army had ceased to exist. With our superior tactics, training and equipment, our victory was complete. Before the end of the day Omdurman was in our hands, and in just a few months we would control all of Sudan.
dst: 当战斗结束时，德尔维希军队已不复存在。凭借我们更优越的战术、训练和装备，我们取得了彻底的胜利。当天日落之前，恩图曼已落入我们手中，短短几个月内我们就将控制整个苏丹。

src: When the confederate army under Jubel A. Early was approaching us, General Sigel gave orders to evacuate the city. We took positions north of the Potomac river on the Maryland Heights.
dst: 当朱巴尔·A·厄尔利率领的南方军向我们逼近时，西格尔将军下令撤离城市。我们在波托马克河以北的马里兰高地占领了阵地。

src: When the independents rebellion started in Cuba in 1868, the U.S. was concerned with the effect of such conflict on American interests there. When in 1895 another conflict erupted between Cuban separatists and Spain, the U.S. doubted Spain could prevail and felt that it was no longer reasonable to follow a policy of inaction. Despite U.S. proclamation of neutrality, sentiment to enter the conflict was growing in the United States, notably fuelled by the alleged harsh methods used by Spain against Cuban population. Both the U.S. government and public opinion felt peace in Cuba could only come about through American intervention.
dst: 1868年古巴爆发独立起义时，美国关注的是这场冲突对其在当地利益的影响。1895年古巴分离主义者与西班牙之间再次爆发冲突时，美国怀疑西班牙能否取胜，并认为再奉行不干预政策已不合情理。尽管美国宣布中立，但参战情绪在美国日益高涨，尤其是受到所谓西班牙对古巴民众采取残酷手段的传闻煽动。美国政府和公众舆论都认为，古巴的和平只能通过美国干预来实现。

src: When the year 1921 started it was quite obvious that although, on paper, the United Kingdom, France and Italy still support the foreign occupation of Anadolu, if we resist long enough, they will end up looking for another kind of agreement.
dst: 1921年开始时，事情已经相当明显：尽管表面上英国、法国和意大利仍然支持外国对安纳托利亚的占领，但只要我们抵抗足够久，他们最终会寻求另一种安排。

src: When their rule ended, Czechoslovakia was economicaly devastated, its population demoralized, best of her sons and daughters killed, ruined or banished. A common state of Czechs and Slovaks disintegrated very fast and the decline of Czech society and state never stopped.
dst: 当他们的统治结束时，捷克斯洛伐克经济凋敝、民心涣散，最优秀的儿女被杀、被毁或被流放。捷克人与斯洛伐克人的共同国家迅速解体，捷克社会和国家的衰落再也没有停止。

src: When they had then had their fun, they let a ladder down to the water and asked their prisoners politely to leave the ship, and to go his way, he were free.
dst: 等他们玩够了，就放下梯子到水面，彬彬有礼地请俘虏离船自行离去，说他自由了。

src: When they knew of the immediate arrival of Prussian reinforcements, the French abandoned Amiens and retreated in order to Arras, in the north, in order to avoid the complete destruction of their army.
dst: 当得知普鲁士援军即将到来时，法军放弃了亚眠，向北撤退至阿拉斯，以免全军覆没。

src: When von Francois' Corps, reinforced by a motley of Landwehr units and batallions from other divisions, struck Samsonov's left (I), the flank collapsed.  On his right, the VI failed to engage the enemy, retreating in near panic.  The bulk of the 2nd thus became trapped in a cauldron in the forests east of the village of Tannenberg.  The arrival of the 1st Army's II Corps was too little and too late.  Refusing to leave his army, Samsonov remained in command while encircled.  Utterly defeated and having issued the order for scattered units to disengage and retreat, Samsonov committed suicide while retreating with his staff.
dst: 当冯·弗朗索瓦的军——得到了来自其他师的民兵部队和营的杂牌增援——猛击萨姆索诺夫的左翼（第1军）时，侧翼崩溃了。在其右翼，第6军未能接敌，近乎恐慌地撤退。于是第2集团军的主力被围困在坦能堡村以东森林中的一口大锅里。第1集团军第2军的到达既太少也太迟。萨姆索诺夫拒绝离开他的军队，在被围期间仍坚持指挥。在彻底战败、并下令散落的部队脱离接触撤退之后，萨姆索诺夫在随参谋人员撤退途中自杀身亡。

src: When von Francois' Corps, reinforced by a motley of Landwehr units and batallions from other divisions, struck the Russian I Corps on Samsonov's left, the flank collapsed.  On his right, the VI Corps failed to even engage the enemy, retreating in near panic - often mistaking its own cavalry for pursuing German Uhlanen. The bulk of the 2nd Army thus became trapped in a cauldron in the forests east of the village of Tannenberg.  The arrival of the 1st Army's II Corps was too little and too late to save Samsonov from tragedy.  Refusing to leave his army, Samsonov remained in command while encircled.  Utterly defeated and having issued the order for scattered units to disengage and retreat, Samsonov committed suicide while retreating with his staff.
dst: 冯·弗朗索瓦的军得到各色兰德韦尔部队和来自其他师的营的加强后，猛击萨姆索诺夫左翼的俄军第1军，该翼随即崩溃。在其右翼，第6军甚至未能与敌交战，便近乎惊慌地后撤——还常常把自己骑兵误认作追击而来的德军枪骑兵。第2集团军的主力就此被围困在坦能堡村以东森林里的一个包围圈中。第1集团军第2军的到来为时已晚，规模也太小，无法使萨姆索诺夫免于悲剧。萨姆索诺夫拒绝离开自己的部队，在被围期间仍坚持指挥。在彻底战败、下令溃散各部脱离接触并撤退之后，萨姆索诺夫在随参谋人员撤退途中自杀身亡。

src: When we finally convinced our German allies to launch an offensive south of Bitolya, it was too late. Our summer operations were stopped south of Lerin, and now it seems that an enemy counterattack is inminent.
dst: 当我们终于说服德国盟友在比托利亚以南发动攻势时，为时已晚。我们的夏季作战在莱林以南被阻止，如今看来敌人的反攻已迫在眉睫。

src: When we finally liberated Chistopol I felt a great relief. At last we had brought the war back to the Volga. If we kept a cool head, the Soviets would never retake the initiative and we would eventually win this terrible civil war. The nightmarish revolution would be over, and Russia would be saved.
dst: 当我们终于解放奇斯托波尔时，我如释重负。我们终于把战争打回了伏尔加河。只要保持冷静的头脑，苏维埃就再也无法夺回主动权，我们终将赢得这场可怕的内战。噩梦般的革命将告结束，俄国将获得拯救。

src: When we finally stopped to rest and regroup, the First and the Fith Soviet Armies had been virtually destroyed. In the north, the Siberians had met moderate success, too. However, we were exhausted, and the heavy rains had turned the roads into streams of mud. We couldn't  continue our race to the Volga.
dst: 当我们终于停下来休整和重组时，苏联第一、第五集团军实际上已被摧毁。在北面，西伯利亚人也取得了不错的战果。然而，我们已筋疲力尽，大雨把道路变成了泥泞的溪流。我们无法继续向伏尔加河冲刺。

src: When we finally stopped to rest and regroup, the First and the Fith Soviet Armies had been virtually destroyed. In the north, the Siberians had met moderate success, too. We had reasons to be optimistic.
dst: 当我们终于停下来休整和重新集结时，苏军第1集团军和第5集团军实际上已被歼灭。在北方，西伯利亚人也取得了适度的成功。我们有理由感到乐观。

src: When we go back, we're burning this thing and everything associated with it.  It's better that the world never know the potential for evil that control over time and space can provide.
dst: 等我们回去，我们要把这东西连同与之相关的一切都烧掉。让世界永远不知道，掌控时间和空间能提供何等邪恶的潜能，这样更好。

src: When you get to the next HQ screen please save your game and exit. Overwrite the WW1 Efile in your PG2 folder with those contained in the Zip "WW2 Efile". Reopen your saved game and your WW1 units will have been upgraded for you.
dst: 当您进入下一个指挥部画面时，请保存游戏并退出。用压缩包「WW2 Efile」中的文件覆盖您 PG2 文件夹里的 WW1 Efile。重新打开您的存档，您的一战单位将会为您自动升级。

src: When your army starts without an airfield, you have to capture or build one in order to deploy your planes.
dst: 当你的军队开局时没有机场，你必须夺取或建造一个机场才能部署飞机。

src: When your reinforcements have arrived you must retake Caen and push the Poles back and retake all the coastal  hexes, these are the important sites.
dst: 当你的援军抵达后，你必须夺回卡昂、击退波兰人，并夺回所有沿海格——这些都是重要据点。

src: Whenever we like, we could burn their houses and destroy their
dst: 只要我们愿意，就能烧掉他们的房屋、毁掉他们的

src: Where had it all gone wrong?A once and powerful force now just trying to escape anihilation.The only chance for survival was to fight it's way into open waters against the Italian fleet.Italian ground forces were closing on the port and the ships loaded all they could for the 'Run to America'.The few Squadrons of the RAF which had been decimated by the SS/BdM 'Frau-Z's aiding the Italians had done cut out for the most part leaving Italian Flyers to aid in the attacks on the ships of the Royal Navy and it's Allies.So for the Glory of Dear Ole England Admiral Sir Philip Vian of the flagship HMS King George shook hands with Major Bertrand Collins of the 'Kings Rifles Armor and boarded His ship, "Well Bert,this is It.As I You know Our Salvation and that of the Ilse's could have been if the 'Yanks had shown a little more interest in the Affairs of Western Europe.But it not being 'Their Problem' has doomed all Mankind to that Whore in Black ruling the World".The 'Sand' was lost and with It all the Oil.With what the 'Frau's were doing in Russia and the United States once again failing to defeat the Japanese in the Solomon islands the Axis was on the Brink of Total Victory across the Globe.Admiral Vian retired to His Quarters to rest His weary head.Moments later a message.The Italian Fleet was spotted.The 'Run' might not even get in a few Good Steps and the Admiral may soon get all the rest He would ever want.
dst: 一切是从哪里开始错的？一支曾经强大的力量，如今只想逃脱被歼灭的命运。唯一的生路，是冲破意大利舰队、杀入开阔水域。意大利地面部队正逼近港口，舰船载上了尽可能多的人和物，开始"向美国航进"。皇家空军仅剩的几个中队——已被协助意大利人的党卫军/BdM"Frau-Z"打得七零八落——大多已经撤走，留下意大利飞行员协助攻击皇家海军及其盟军的舰船。于是，为了亲爱的老英格兰的荣光，旗舰"英王乔治"号上的海军上将菲利普·维安爵士与"国王步枪队"装甲部队的伯特兰·柯林斯少校握手后登舰："好了，伯特，就是这一刻了。如你所知，如果我们当初的救星——'伊尔泽的救星也是——美国佬对西欧事务多几分兴趣就好了。可因为'那不是他们的问题'，全人类注定要由那个黑衣娼妇统治世界了。""沙地"（北非）丢了，石油也随之全失。加上"女士"们在俄国的作为，以及美国在所罗门群岛再度未能击败日本人，轴心国正处在全球全面胜利的边缘。维安上将回到舱室，让疲惫的头脑休息。片刻后传来一条讯息：发现意大利舰队。"向美国航进"也许走不了几步，而这位上将或许很快就会得到他此生想要的全部休息。
一切开始的地方: 萨马拉

src: Where the battle took place is not known to me, Acerrae is selected fictitious.
dst: 此战具体地点我不得而知，阿切拉是虚构选定的。

src: Whereas the landings at "S" and "X" Beach were accomplished with great success and only a few casualties, the troops at "V" and "W" beach had a much tougher time. Suffering severe casualties by Turkish MG and rifle fire, the troops wade ashore, struggled through the barbed wire obstacles and finally took the Turkish positions. At "Y" Beach the troops found their landing site undefended and spent precious hours waiting for further orders. Without official approval no attempt was made to occupy Krithia and the heights of Achi Baba, which were entirely deserted at this moment. If these vital positions had been taken that day, it might have decided the campaign and certainly avoided the slaughter in the succeeding months...
dst: 尽管「S」海滩和「X」海滩的登陆以巨大成功、仅有少数伤亡而告成，「V」海滩和「W」海滩的部队却遭遇了艰难得多的处境。在土耳其军机枪和步枪火力的重创下，部队涉水上岸，奋力穿过铁丝网障碍，最终夺取了土耳其军阵地。在「Y」海滩，部队发现登陆地点无人防守，却白白浪费了宝贵的数小时等待进一步命令。由于没有得到正式批准，没有人尝试占领克里希亚和阿奇巴巴高地，而当时这两处完全无人把守。如果这些关键阵地当天就被拿下，或许就能决定整个战役的胜负，也一定能避免随后数月的大屠杀……

src: While 60th and 74th Division will attack the Turkish defensive line along the Wadi Surar, your mounted troops will have to hold Turkish reinforcements at bay which are approaching the theatre from the north all along the Suffa-Foka-Tahta-Line. Furthermore, it is recommended that you use your infantry to secure our position at Nebi Samwil.
dst: 第60师和第74师将沿瓦迪苏拉尔进攻土耳其防线，同时您的骑乘部队必须阻击从北面沿苏法—福卡—塔赫塔一线逼近战区的土耳其援军。此外，建议您动用步兵巩固我们在内比萨姆维勒的阵地。

src: While 87th Brigade of the 29th Division stormed the crest of Scimitar Hill and chased the Turks back towards the high ground leading to Kuchuk Anafarta, the 11th Division failed to take the "W Hills". 29th Division came under heavy fire from the intact field guns of "W Hills" and from Tekke Tepe. A storm of lead swept them from the crest of the Scimitar. To make things worse, a great fire broke out in the undergrowth, so little headway could be made. Another attempt to take Scimitar Hill by the 2nd Mounted Brigade which was thrown into battle, failed a few hours later.There was not an atom of gain, for everywhere the troops fell back to the original line.
dst: 当第29师第87旅冲上弯刀山山脊并追击土军、朝通往库丘克阿纳法尔塔的高地推进时，第11师未能攻下「W高地」。第29师遭到来自「W高地」完好野战炮和泰克泰佩山的猛烈火力打击。一片弹雨将他们从弯刀山山脊扫落。更糟的是，灌木丛中燃起大火，几乎无法取得进展。投入战斗的第2骑马旅对弯刀山的又一次进攻也在几小时后失败。寸土未得，因为各处的部队都退回了原防线。

src: While ANZAC will be landing further north at Ari Burnu, and French troops at Kum Kale, your 29th Division will be the spearhead here at Cape Helles.
dst: 澳新军团将在更北面的阿里伯努登陆，法军将在库姆卡莱登陆，而您的第29师将在这里的海勒斯角担任前锋。

src: While Arrius newly arranged the battered legions of the two consuls, Spartacus moved further north, to the pre-Alpine province of Cisalpine Gaul.
dst: 当阿里乌斯重新整编两位执政官残破的军团时，斯巴达克斯继续北上，进入阿尔卑斯山前的高山南高卢行省。

src: While Colonel Urabi took control of Egypt, anarchy spread in Sudan. A Muslim cleric who called himself "the Mahdi" had started a revolt against the Egyptian administration, and he soon gathered an army of thousands of fanatics called Dervishes that crushed the Egyptian Army in several battles. The largest one was fought at El Obeid, in November 1883, where more than 10,000 Egyptians, including their British commander, Colonel Hicks, were massacred.
dst: 当奥拉比上校控制埃及之际，无政府状态在苏丹蔓延开来。一位自称「马赫迪」的穆斯林神职人员发动了反抗埃及当局的起义，他很快就聚集起一支由数千名狂热分子组成的军队，他们被称为「德尔维希」，并在多次战斗中击溃了埃及军队。规模最大的一仗于1883年11月在奥贝德进行，包括其英国指挥官希克斯上校在内的1万多名埃及人惨遭屠杀。

src: While General Wrangel fights in Vladikavkaz I must take Grozny and cut the Bolsheviks' escape route. The town is being defended by the 12th Red Army and some Chechen volunteers. It's surprising that these muslim warriors have allied themselves with an army of atheists, but I guess that their hatred against the Terek cossacks is stronger than their theological coherence.
dst: 在弗兰格尔将军于弗拉季高加索作战之际，我必须夺取格罗兹尼，切断布尔什维克的退路。该城由第12红军和一些车臣志愿者防守。令人惊讶的是，这些穆斯林战士竟与一支无神论者的军队结盟，但我猜想，他们对捷列克哥萨克的仇恨胜过了他们在信仰上的自洽。

src: While German panzer divisions are spearheading toward Warsaw, the German 8th Army has reached the river Warta. The Poles have set up a strong defensive Line and await the German assault.
dst: 正当德军装甲师向华沙突进之际，德国第8集团军已抵达瓦尔塔河。波军已构筑起坚固防线，严阵以待德军的进攻。

src: While Germany was on the strategic defensive after the fall of Stalingrad, there were several operational offensives before the Soviet conquest of Berlin. You take control of Axis forces trying to re-open the way to Stalingrad, and try to change history.  Can you stop the Allies before they reach Berlin?
dst: 斯大林格勒陷落后，德国虽在战略上处于守势，但在苏联攻占柏林之前仍发动过数次战役级攻势。你将指挥试图重新打通通往斯大林格勒之路的轴心国军队，尝试改变历史。你能在盟军抵达柏林之前挡住他们吗？

src: While Octavian was, amongst others, responsible for Hispana and the Italic mainland, his triumvirate colleague Antonius controlled the east of the empire where he met the ex-mistress of Caesar, Cleopatra VII, and begun his famous affair with her.
dst: 屋大维分掌西班牙与意大利本土等地，而他的同僚安东尼乌斯则控制帝国东部；他在那里遇到了凯撒的情妇克利奥帕特拉七世，并与她开始了他那段著名的恋情。

src: While Stopford, the commanding general at Suvla, went to sleep on HMS Jonquil, the landing in pitch darkness ended in great confusion with units becoming mixed and officers unable to locate their position or their objectives.
dst: 当苏夫拉湾的指挥官斯托普福德将军在「琼基尔」号上睡觉时，在漆黑中进行的登陆以极大的混乱告终——各单位混杂在一起，军官们无法确定自己的位置或目标。

src: While XXth Corps will attack between the Khalassa Road and the Wadi Saba south-west of the town, our mounted troops will make a wide flanking movement, secure the Hebron Road and attack Beersheba from the east and north-east. It is essential that Beersheba is in our hands before nightfall, since it posesses the only wells in the area.
dst: 第20军将在哈拉萨公路与镇西南的瓦迪萨巴之间进攻，同时我们的骑乘部队将进行大范围的侧翼迂回，控制希伯伦公路，并从东面和东北面进攻贝尔谢巴。务必在夜幕降临前拿下贝尔谢巴，因为那里拥有该地区唯一的水井。

src: While anarchy gripped our country, we have learned the lessons of Oroquieta. We have improved the preparation and equipping our soldiers, and finally the time has come to show the republican army that we can beat them in the open.
dst: 当无政府状态席卷我们国家之际，我们汲取了奥罗基耶塔的教训。我们改进了士兵的训练和装备，如今终于到了向共和军展示我们能在开阔地带击败他们的时候了。

src: While diversionary attacks will be delivered by the Australians at Lone Pine and at the Nek, your troops will take part in the main attack. Two columns will advance upon the Sari Bair range with the aim of capturing the high ground. The right-hand column will head for Chunuk Bair, the left-hand column for Hill 971 and neighbouring Hill Q. For our advance we will use the "deres" - dried gullies that offer the easiest paths through the difficult terrain.
dst: 当澳大利亚人在独松和内克发动牵制性进攻时，您的部队将参加主攻。两支纵队将向萨里拜尔山岭推进，目标是夺取高地。右纵队将指向楚努克拜尔，左纵队则指向971高地及邻近的Q高地。我们的推进将利用「德雷」——那些干涸的沟壑，它们提供了穿过崎岖地形最易行的路径。

src: While most of the british forces and fleet have been evacuated to Canada some units still are operating from Scapa Flow and cover the main force's withdrawl. You have to take Scapa Flow and the Orkney Islands. We will turn the islands into our new home base for the Kriegsmarine North Atlantic service.
dst: 尽管大部分英军部队和舰队已撤往加拿大，仍有部分单位以斯卡帕湾为基地作战，掩护主力撤退。你必须夺取斯卡帕湾和奥克尼群岛。我们将把这些岛屿变成海军北大西洋分舰队的新基地。

src: While other armies are mopping up enemy criminals that have been encircled, all of the remaining people's army not occupied with that task is being directed to the Perekop isthmus. They will be placed under your command as soon as they arrive in the region, comrade! In Moscow they regard you as a military genius!  The Revolution is driving the proletariat to great acts!
dst: 在其他集团军清剿被包围的敌方罪犯之际，所有未被这项任务占用的剩余人民军队都被调往彼列科普地峡。他们一到该地区，就将交由您指挥，同志！在莫斯科，他们视您为军事天才！革命正驱使无产阶级成就伟业！

src: While our 11th Army is tied up during its siege of Przemysl, only the 8th stands between the bulk of Austrian armies and the besieged garrison.  Without a doubt, the Austrians will attempt further offensives in this direction.
dst: 当我们的第11集团军围攻普热梅希尔而无法抽身时，只有第8集团军挡在奥地利集团军主力与被围守军之间。毫无疑问，奥地利人将在这个方向发动进一步的攻势。

src: While the Czechoslovak tanks were recalled for the Ostrava operation, most of the corps moved through Slovakia.
dst: 趁捷克斯洛伐克坦克被召回参加俄斯特拉发行动之际，军的大部分部队穿过了斯洛伐克。

src: While the Dutch government and Queen Wilhelmina managed to escape to England, General Winkelman declared the surrender of the Dutch Army. Congratulations Herr General!
dst: 尽管荷兰政府和威廉明娜女王设法逃到了英国，温克尔曼将军仍宣布荷兰军队投降。恭喜你，将军阁下！

src: While the French advance against Haricot Redoubt on the right, and the 42nd Division and Royal Naval Divison - supported by some armoured cars of the RNAS - attack in the centre, 29th Division has again the difficult task to push the frontline up Gully Ravine. This area has recently been heavily fortified by the Turks, so expect a hard and bloody fight. Your troops will be joined by the 29th Indian Brigade.
dst: 当法军在右翼进攻阿里科特多面堡、第42师和皇家海军师——在皇家海军航空兵一些装甲车的支援下——在中路进攻时，第29师再次承担起把前线沿沟壑谷向上推进的艰巨任务。这一地区最近已被土耳其人重重设防，所以要做好打一场艰苦而血腥战斗的准备。您的部队将得到第29印度旅的加强。

src: While the Germans try to break through our lines at the Lake Balaton in the west, your mission is to break through the German and Hungarian line at Szekesfehervar. With the capture of the town the way to Vienna will be open.
dst: 当德军试图在西部巴拉顿湖突破我们的防线时，您的任务是突破塞克什白堡的德军和匈牙利军防线。夺取该镇后，通往维也纳的道路将畅通无阻。

src: While the creation of the Anzio beachhead was successful, the 5th Army still is stuck at the German Gustav Line.
dst: 虽然安齐奥滩头阵地的建立取得了成功，但第5集团军仍被困在德军古斯塔夫防线上。

src: While the front against the fascists moves west, into Yugoslavia, Hungary, Czechoslovakia and Poland, your force will used in a special mission. Bulgaria and our Soviet Union have never been in war. However the Bulgarians sided with the German fascists. Three days ago we have declared war on Bulgaria. Bulgaria still had German troops on its soil. The Bulgarian Army has been given orders not to fire on our troops. However like in the Rumanian Army there are still fascists in their lines and they will fire back. It is also possible that some units have not received the order. It is a confusing situation again.
dst: 当对法西斯的战线向西推进，进入南斯拉夫、匈牙利、捷克斯洛伐克和波兰时，你的部队将被用于一项特殊任务。保加利亚和我们苏联从未交过战。然而保加利亚人站在了德国法西斯一边。三天前，我们向保加利亚宣战。保加利亚境内仍有德军。保加利亚军队已接到命令，不得向我军开火。然而如同罗马尼亚军队一样，他们队伍里仍有法西斯，这些人会还击。也有可能一些部队尚未接到命令。这又是一个混乱的局面。

src: While the infantry will make a frontal attack on the positions defending Gaza, your mounted troops are ordered to strike out east and north with the double object of holding up Turkish reinforcements from the east and southeast, and cutting off the retreat of the main body should the town be taken.
dst: 步兵将对防守加沙的阵地发起正面进攻，同时您的骑乘部队奉命向东面和北面出击，目标有二：一是阻挡来自东面和东南面的土耳其援军，二是在该城被攻克时切断其主力部队的退路。

src: While the majority of the Prussian troops headed against the Austrian army, some regiments stayed in Central Germany, invading and subduing other enemy states. The Army of the Kingdom of Hanover, knowing that they couldn't resist the Prussians if they fought alone, tried to flee to the south, where they could join the Bavarian forces. However, the Prussians were faster and, by the end of June, the Hanoverians were surrounded by enemy units on all sides. Defeating the small Prussian contingent in the town of Langensalza, in the west, was their last hope to break free and join the Bavarians.
dst: 在普鲁士军队主力扑向奥地利军队的同时，一些团留在德意志中部，入侵并征服其他敌对的邦国。汉诺威王国的军队深知，若孤军作战便无法抵挡普鲁士人，于是试图向南逃去，以便与巴伐利亚军队会合。然而，普鲁士人行动更快，到6月底，汉诺威人已被敌军从四面八方包围。在西面朗根萨尔察镇击败那支规模很小的普鲁士分遣队，是他们突围并与巴伐利亚人会合的最后希望。

src: While the numbers of experienced troops - formed before the war - diminishes daily at an alarming rate, the fresh 2nd and 3rd line divisions lack sufficient training to be as dependable in the field.  The ammunition shortage has compounded the problem.  Only your skillful leadership can hold the front together, Gospodin General!
dst: 随着战前组建的有经验部队以惊人的速度日渐减少，新编的二线、三线师缺乏足够的训练，无法在战场上同样可靠。弹药的短缺使问题雪上加霜。只有您高超的指挥才能把战线维系在一起，将军阁下！

src: While the rest of our Northern Army crosses the river at Haro, you must neutralize the republican resistance in Miranda de Ebro. It will not be easy. We know that liberals have mobilized much of their cavalry to defend the area, so you will have to exercise caution.
dst: 在我北方集团军其余部队于阿罗渡河之际，您必须拔除米兰达-德埃布罗的共和派抵抗。这并非易事。我们知道自由派已调集其大部分骑兵来防守该地区，所以您务必谨慎行事。

src: While two brigades are attacking Cavite from the north and east, Lachambre is leading the main force moving from the southeast portion of the province. It seems that the multi-pronged attack will converge on the town of Silang, where the revolutionaries are hunkered down in the impressive trench works built.
dst: 在两个旅从北部和东部进攻甲米地的同时，拉尚布尔正率领主力从该省东南部挺进。看来，这次多路进攻将在锡朗镇会合，革命者正依托所构筑的坚固战壕工事据守在那里。

src: While we are close to the Dardanelles Strait we got alarming radio transmitions from neutral Turkey. The British and their allies aim to close the passage for us. Blockships got sunk! In these minutes the enemy is about to land at the mouth of the Dardanelles, like they did back in the day in the Great War. Again they will fail. You must protect the neutrality of Turkey and a free Dardanelles passage for all peaceful nations!
dst: 当我们接近达达尼尔海峡时，我们收到了来自中立国土耳其的令人警觉的无线电讯息。英国及其盟国意图为我们封锁这条通道。阻塞船已经被凿沉！此时此刻，敌人正准备在达达尼尔海峡入口处登陆，就像他们当年在大战中的做法一样。他们同样会失败。你必须维护土耳其的中立，并为所有和平国家保障达达尼尔海峡的自由通航！

src: While we wait for the deployment of the Americans, our army is only engaging in small, but strategically important battles.
