Or, as in my case, we're giving support to our British allies, who are pretty sure that this time they will finally break through the German lines in Flanders. I've heard that before, so I'm not so confident, but I'll do my best to help them. I've become friends with some of their officers, like John Monash or Bruce Dickinson.
dst: 在我们等待美军部署期间，我们的军队只进行一些规模不大、但具有战略意义的战斗。或者，就我而言，我们正在支援我们的英国盟友，他们相当确信这一次终于能突破佛兰德斯的德军防线。这种话我以前听过，所以我不是那么有信心，但我会尽力帮助他们。我已经和他们中的一些军官成了朋友，比如约翰·莫纳什和布鲁斯·迪金森。

src: While we were fighting against Seymour and his relief force the Yihetuan and some units of the Qing Army had taken control of most of Tientsin. However, the Europeans, the Japanese and the Americans were defending themselves quite well  on the foreign concessions, south of the city. Athough the Chinese were attacking from three different sides the Westerners had been able to keep a supply line open, from where they received weapons, ammunition and reinforcements. So when the survivors of the Seymour column reached Tientsin, they weren't actually needed for the defence of the concessions, and most of them returned to their ships.
dst: 当我们与西摩及其救援部队作战时，义和团和部分清军部队已经控制了天津的大部分地区。然而，欧洲人、日本人和美国人在城南的外国租界里防守得相当出色。尽管中国人从三个不同方向发起进攻，西方人还是保住了一条畅通的补给线，从那里获得武器、弹药和增援。因此，当西摩纵队中的幸存者抵达天津时，其实并不需要他们来保卫租界，他们中的大多数人便回到了自己的船上。

src: While we were successfully evacuating Ekaterinburg, we received worrisome news from our left flank. The Soviet 5th Army was attacking our Chebarkul-Irtyash line. Our High Command believed that our men couldn't resist for a long time there, so very soon the city of Chelyabinsk would be in danger, too.
dst: 当我们正成功疏散叶卡捷琳堡时，从左翼传来了令人担忧的消息。苏维埃第五集团军正在进攻我们的切巴尔库尔-伊尔佳什防线。最高统帅部认为，我们的士兵在那里无法长久坚守，因此车里雅宾斯克城很快也将陷入危险。

src: While you  were fighting the Serbian Army at Ovche Pole, three French divisions advanced from Greece and have taken positions in Krivolak, south of Stip. They want to make contact with the renmants of the Serbian Army, thus avoiding its total encirclement. You must prevent them from doing that. You will attack the French Army and force it to retreat to Greece.
dst: 当您在奥夫切波莱与塞尔维亚军队交战时，三个法国师从希腊推进，已在什蒂普以南的克里沃拉克占据了阵地。他们想与塞尔维亚军队的残部取得联系，从而避免其被完全合围。您必须阻止他们这样做。您要进攻法国军队，迫使其退回希腊。

src: While you were fighting at Saint Mihiel the British launched a counteroffensive in north-western France, with the final goal of breaking the Hindenburg Line. They've been successful so far, but for the next phase of their operation they need our help. So, this time, your units will be attached to the Australian Corps of the 4th British Army.
dst: 您在圣米耶勒作战之际，英国人在法国西北部发动了反攻，最终目标是突破兴登堡防线。他们迄今进展顺利，但行动的下一阶段需要我们的帮助。所以，这一次您的部队将配属给英国第4集团军的澳大利亚军。

src: While you were fighting in Colesberg General Cronjé, knowing that Roberts was getting close with three divisions, retired most of his troops up the Modder River. He thought that he could outflank the Rooineks and counterattack from a better position, but Roberts was faster than expected, and some days ago he trapped Cronjé on the Paardeberg Drift on the banks of the Modder River. He won't be able to resist for much longer.
dst: 当您在科尔斯堡作战时，克罗涅将军得知罗伯茨正率三个师逼近，便把大部分部队沿莫德河向上游撤退。他以为能包抄英国佬，并从更有利的位置发起反攻，但罗伯茨来得比预期的更快，几天前他在莫德河岸边的帕尔德山渡口围困了克罗涅。他撑不了多久了。

src: While you were fighting in Greece the Alpenkorps, as well as some Austrian units, broke the Italian lines in Trient and quickly took Verona and Vicenza. But now, after weeks of fighting, they're exhausted and we need you to relieve them. You'll have to follow the offensive, advancing on the right bank of the Po Valley until you reach the Adriatic Sea.
dst: 当您在希腊作战时，阿尔卑斯军以及一些奥地利部队突破了特伦托的意军防线，并迅速攻占了维罗纳和维琴察。但经过数周激战，他们已精疲力竭，需要您去接替他们。您必须继续推进攻势，沿波河河谷右岸前进，直到抵达亚得里亚海。

src: While your defeat of the enemy division surrounding D.C. bought us some time, we're still on the edge of a precipice here.  The main Soviet fleet is due to arrive in force any time now, and when they do they'll bring the firepower their rebel lackeys so sorely need.   If the Soviets establish a beachhead here in New York, the war is lost.
dst: 虽然你击溃了包围华盛顿的敌军师为我们争取了一些时间，我们仍处在悬崖边缘。苏联主力舰队随时可能大规模抵达，一旦抵达，他们就会带来那些叛军走狗急需的火力。如果苏联人在纽约建立滩头阵地，这场战争就输了。

src: While your fleet fights in the Strait of Dover, your marines must capture the Channel Islands.
dst: 当你的舰队在多佛海峡作战时，你的海军陆战队必须夺取海峡群岛。

src: While your fleet is ready to leave Ireland, Hitler himself orders you another raid in England, this time at Liverpool. This strike will have a great effect on English morale, as the belief that English citizens are safe will be shaken.
dst: 趁你的舰队准备离开爱尔兰之际，希特勒亲自下令你在英格兰再发动一次袭击，这次目标是利物浦。这次打击将对英国人的士气产生重大影响，因为他们对英国民众安全无虞的信念将被动摇。

src: While your fleet prepares to attack Malta, you must undertake a dangerous mission. Prepare the ground for a landing of your marines in Gozo. You take command of elite Italian marines and must destroy the coastal defenses located in northwest Gozo. Italian paratroopers and marines will help, while the Luftwaffe will reconnoitre the area. For now you have nothing to fear from the remaining enemy ships.
dst: 当您的舰队准备进攻马耳他时，您必须执行一项危险的任务。为您海军陆战队在戈佐岛的登陆做好准备。您将指挥意大利精锐海军陆战队，摧毁戈佐岛西北部的海岸防御工事。意大利伞兵和海军陆战队将提供协助，德国空军将侦察该地区。目前，残余的敌舰不足为惧。

src: While your marines are moving to capture the channel islands, your fleet must cross the Strait of Dover. There are many enemy ships in the area, a lot of mines and at England's coast massive coastal canons. Enemy airforce is also big.
dst: 当你的海军陆战队去夺取海峡群岛时，你的舰队必须穿越多佛尔海峡。该海域有大量敌舰、众多水雷，英格兰海岸还有密集的海岸炮。敌方空军规模也很大。

src: While your marines are ready to land and take Gozo, your planes must create a distraction for the RAF and the same time to destroy the 3 Maltese airports.
dst: 你的海军陆战队准备登陆并夺取戈佐岛，与此同时你的飞机必须为皇家空军制造牵制，并同时摧毁马耳他的3座机场。

src: White Sands Missile Range, New Mexico
dst: 新墨西哥州，白沙导弹靶场

src: Who could have thought that Von Schlieffen's Plan would fail? It seems that the war will be much longer than we had expected.
dst: 谁会想到冯·施里芬的计划会失败呢？看来这场战争将比我们预想的漫长得多。

src: Why have you been so slow? Almost a week has passed and you haven't achieved anything. All right, it doesn't matter, I understand. Paradoxically, that problem has been caused by our own artillery. The bombardment has been so heavy that the terrain has become impracticable.
dst: 您为什么这么慢？将近一周过去了，您却一事无成。也罢，这不怪您，我理解。说来矛盾，这个问题恰恰是我们自己的炮兵造成的。炮击如此猛烈，以致地形变得无法通行。
维耶日胡奇诺 (维耶舒钦)

src: Wilenski Pulk/ III Bryg./ 1st Dyw. Litewsko-Bialoruska
dst: Wilenski 团/ 第3旅/ 第1师 Litewsko-Bialoruska
维尔科梅日(乌克梅尔格)

src: Will you assist to the big ceremony at the Yasukuni Temple in Tokyo?...
dst: 您会出席东京靖国神社的盛大典礼吗？……

src: Wilno is heavilly garrisoned and remnants of the previously beaten enemy can also be found outside of the town. There is not only the Western Division, allegedly Polish, but also a division from Pskow. There is the possibility that the Polish citizens of Wilno will stand against the Communists. Do not expect further reinforcements.
dst: 维尔诺守备森严，此前被击败的敌人残部也会在城外出现。那里不仅有据称是波兰人的西方师，还有一支来自普斯科夫的师。维尔诺的波兰公民有可能起来反抗共产党人。不要再指望进一步的增援。
威尔逊溪 * 战术胜利

src: Winning this war will take some time, but we'll prevail. I'm starting to think that the Spaniards had so many problems with the Filipinos because they were too soft with them, but that won't happen to us. Most of the American generals that have come to this archipelago are veterans of the Indian wars. They know how to deal with stubborn native rebels that refuse to accept defeat.
dst: 打赢这场战争需要一些时间，但我们终将获胜。我开始觉得，西班牙人之所以在菲律宾人身上遇到那么多麻烦，是因为他们对菲律宾人太软弱，但我们不会重蹈覆辙。来到这片群岛的大多数美国将领都是印第安战争的老兵。他们知道如何对付那些拒绝认输的顽固土著叛乱者。
香港旅温尼伯掷弹兵团

src: Winston Churchill's statement.The SS/KM's new Fuhress Class Battleships heading for open water.Their mission to patrol in the Atlantic to stop Convoys coming from Canada and those 'Ghost Convoys' coming from the U.S.A. that according to all information on the Allied side weren't.In Washington FDR sent out a memo for a few American Battleships to run exercises and a few Admirals to be very lient on rules of engagement should the SS/KM ships cross their path.So Frau GrandAdmiral Esebeck aboard the 'Frau Biss and Frau Admiral Hundsnerdorf on the 'Frau Tirptz were told by the Fuhress "In Your hands My Admirals are the finest fighting ships ever built to sail on the seas.They are far Superior, they are faster,better protected and their firepower is equal to anything by the Brits or as a matter of fact anyone else.Show the Enemies of the Fatherland their destructive power.Destroy the Dam Convoys and Britian will make Peace.If not then Britian will starve".So an engagement.The Royal Navy,France and Amerika against the SS/KM in the Atlantic.One that could bring Amerika into the War or a President down who had been saying to the People "No War in Europe".The Fuhress didn't care,the Convoys to support England had to be curtailed.
dst: 温斯顿·丘吉尔的声明。党卫军／海军的新型“女元首”级战列舰正驶向开阔水域。它们的任务是在大西洋巡逻，拦截从加拿大来的运输船队，以及那些据盟军方面一切情报显示并不存在的、来自美国的“幽灵船队”。在华盛顿，罗斯福发了一份备忘录，让几艘美国战列舰出海演习，并让几位海军上将一旦与党卫军／海军舰船相遇，在交战规则上“从宽处理”。于是，女海军上将埃塞贝克坐镇“女士俾斯麦”号、女海军上将洪德斯纳多夫坐镇“女士提尔皮茨”号，接女元首之命：“我这两位海军上将，你们手中是海上航行过的最优秀战舰。它们远为优越，更快、防护更好，火力不逊于英国人——事实上不逊于任何人。让祖国的敌人见识它们毁灭性的力量。摧毁那些该死的船队，不列颠就会求和。否则不列颠就会饿死。”于是一场交锋。皇家海军、法国和美国在大西洋对阵党卫军／海军。这一战可能把美国拖入战争，也可能打倒那位一直对人民说“欧洲无战事”的总统。女元首不在乎，支援英格兰的船队必须被掐断。
美国北卡罗来纳州温斯顿-塞勒姆
41年冬 不是“女士”待的地方！

src: Wisely, Emperor Yohannes thought that our enemies would attack again as soon as they could, so he ordered King Menelik to send his army to Gojjam and Gondar, in order to reinforce those areas. However, unbeknownst to Yohannes, Menelik and Tekle Haymanot saw this as an opportunity to forge an alliance.
dst: 约翰内斯皇帝明智地判断，敌人会尽快再度来犯，于是他命令孟尼利克国王派兵前往戈贾姆和贡德尔，以加强那些地区的防务。然而，约翰内斯并不知道，孟尼利克和特克莱·海马诺特却把这看作结盟的机会。
祝我好运。永远属于您的，

src: Wish me the best of luck.
Wish us luck, ma chère, because I know you want me to be home by Christmas!
dst: 祝我们好运，亲爱的，因为我知道您想让我在圣诞节前回家！
维斯瓦希米亚瓦 (屈内维斯瓦; 维斯瓦决口)

src: With 8th army crushed we now only have three American bridgeheads left on Sicily. Two of these have linked up. So far we have been able to contain these by retreating to hills out of range of the naval artillery barrage.
dst: 第八集团军既已被击溃，我们在西西里如今只剩三个美军桥头堡。其中两个已连成一片。迄今为止我们退守到海军舰炮射程之外的山地，得以将其遏制。

src: With Alashkert in Turkish posession, the front has shifted to the Araks River line.  Kurdish cavalry have begun raids in the Urmia region once again, and preparations have been made by the Kavkaz Front to abandon Tabriz:  nullifying all gains of the spring offensive.  Your failure in this battle has cost the Front an irreversible strategic loss, and you will be prosecuted by a military tribunal.
dst: 随着阿拉什凯尔特落入土耳其之手，战线已推移到阿拉克斯河一线。库尔德骑兵再次开始在乌尔米耶地区劫掠，高加索方面军也已准备放弃大不里士：春季攻势的全部战果化为乌有。您在此役的失败使方面军蒙受不可逆转的战略损失，您将被军事法庭起诉。

src: With Caen now taken you been have tasked with establishing a breakout south of the city, paving the way for a linkup with American forces attacking from the west.  The immediate goal is to secure the high ground north of Falaise.  It is hoped that with this offensive we can provoke a general collapse of the German front.
dst: 卡昂既已拿下，你受命在城南建立突破，为与从西面进攻的美军会合铺平道路。眼下目标是夺取法莱斯以北的高地。但愿凭借这次攻势，我们能引发德军战线的全面崩溃。

src: With Caen taken, and a large portion of German units destroyed at the Falaise Gap, we can now begin to breakout and liberate France.  You are tasked with carrying out 'Operation Paddle' - the offensive to clear the Germans from the land between the Orne and the Seine Rivers.
dst: 卡昂既已攻克，法莱斯缺口处又歼灭了大量德军，我们现在可以开始突破并解放法国了。你受命执行“划桨行动”——肃清奥恩河与塞纳河之间地带的德军。

src: With General Wahle's force at Nyangao separated from Von Lettow-Vorbeck's troops, the British sought to cut off the force and destroy it. Thus they planned to cut off and surround Wahle's column by flanking it with the veteran Nigerian Brigade. With the destruction of Wahle´s force and the taking of Myangao and Mahiwa, Von Lettow Vobeck´s way of escape would be closed and he would have to surrender.  Aware of the danger, Von Lettow Vorbeck rushed to reinforce Wahle´s men. He knew that  General Beves would throw his men into action regardless of loss of life and favored repeated frontal attacks.   Von Lettow-Vorbeck planned a defensive strategy of local counterattacks that would inflict  severe losses on the British.
dst: 由于瓦勒将军在尼扬加奥的部队与冯·莱托-福尔贝克的部队分隔开来，英军试图切断并歼灭这支部队。因此，他们计划用久经沙场的尼日利亚旅进行侧翼包抄，切断并包围瓦勒的纵队。一旦瓦勒的部队被歼灭、米扬加奥和马希瓦被占领，冯·莱托-福尔贝克的退路就会被封死，他将不得不投降。冯·莱托-福尔贝克意识到这一危险，急忙赶去增援瓦勒的部队。他知道比夫斯将军会不惜伤亡地投入他的部队，并且偏爱反复的正面进攻。冯·莱托-福尔贝克则计划采取局部反击的防御策略，以给英军造成惨重损失。

src: With General von Kleist at the head, the 11th Panzer Division has been rolling into the capital since 0632.
dst: 由冯·克莱斯特将军率领，第11装甲师自6时32分起就开进了首都。

src: With Jerusalem in our hands the British will have to retreat further, into southern Palestine. Don't give them any quarter, General. If they manage to rest and regroup, they could become dangerous again.
dst: 耶路撒冷既已落入我们手中，英国人就不得不进一步撤退到巴勒斯坦南部。将军，不要给他们任何喘息之机。如果他们得以休整并重新集结，可能会再度构成威胁。

src: With Jupiter! This is the first time we had to withdraw....
dst: 朱庇特在上！这是我们第一次被迫撤退......

src: With Liege in German hands, the German 1st and 2nd Armies are pouring into Belgium to defeat the Belgian army and to move onto Paris. The Belgian 4th infantry division is defending Namur while the other 5 infantry divisions - including the 3rd that got hit hard at Liege - have taken position behind the river Gete. Their northern flank is covered by the 1st Cavalry Division of General de Witte.
dst: 列日落入德军之手后，德军第1和第2集团军正涌入比利时，以击败比利时军队并继续向巴黎推进。比利时第4步兵师正在防守那慕尔，而其余5个步兵师——包括在列日遭到重创的第3师——已在赫特河后方占据阵地。他们的北翼由德维特将军的第1骑兵师掩护。

src: With Liege in our hands, our First, Second and Third Armee are pouring into Belgium. The Belgian 4th infantry division is defending Namur while the other 5 infantry divisions - including the 3rd that got hit hard at Liege - have taken position behind the river Gete. Their northern flank is covered by the 1st Cavalry Division of General de Witte. The division is positioned around Halen.
dst: 列日落入我们手中后，我第一、第二、第三集团军正源源涌入比利时。比利时第4步兵师防守那慕尔，而其余5个步兵师——包括在列日遭受重创的第3师——已在赫特河后方占据阵地。其北翼由德维特将军的第1骑兵师掩护。该师部署在哈伦一带。

src: With Liege in our hands, the First Armee has now caught up with our cavalry that had bypassed Liege.
dst: 列日落入我们手中后，第1集团军现已追赶上曾绕过列日的我方骑兵。

src: With Liege, Namur and Maubeuge in our hands, the 24th and 25th Pio Rgts and 120 pieces of siege artillery are freed up for the siege of Antwerp.
dst: 列日、那慕尔和莫伯日落入我们手中后，第24和第25工兵团以及120门攻城炮得以腾出来用于围攻安特卫普。

src: With Luga in our hands, the I Corps has approached Gatchina to the north, and the prize of Petrograd is just beyond!
dst: 卢加已在我们手中，第一军已逼近北面的加特契纳，彼得格勒这个战利品就在眼前！

src: With Malta operations at full capacity, the supply situation of our forces in North Africa is  horrible. It is virtually impossible to get supplies to the troops. Before the final drive to the Nile, air and sea basis Malta has to be taken out.
dst: 马耳他的作战能力全开，我们在北非的部队补给状况极其糟糕，几乎无法把补给送到部队手中。在最后冲向尼罗河之前，必须拔除马耳他这座海空基地。

src: With Portugal the use of naval- and airbases in the Azores and Cape Verde was negotiated and now the big jump from the Azores to Bermuda is imminent - 3500 km to be overcome. Under high pressure, a strategic bomber fleet has raised in the last year and from Bermuda their use against the American mainland be planed.
dst: 我们已与葡萄牙谈妥使用亚速尔群岛和佛得角的空军与海军基地，如今从亚速尔到百慕大的大跨跃已迫在眉睫——要跨越3500公里。在高强度投入下，去年已组建起一支战略轰炸机部队，并计划从百慕大对美洲大陆实施打击。

src: With Rommel in Germany since September 21st, General Stumme is in command of Panzer Armee Afrika. The front line is occupied by the four infantry divsions of our X and XXI Corps, reinforced by the Folgore and Ramcke paratroopers and the 164 Leichte Afrika division.
dst: 自9月21日起隆美尔在德国，非洲装甲集团军由施图姆将军指挥。前线由我们第10军和第21军的四个步兵师据守，并有“闪电”伞兵师、拉姆克伞兵旅和第164轻装非洲师加强。

src: With Russia, Romania, Serbia, Greece and Italy out of the war it's time to focus on our final offensive against France and Britain. You'll have the honour of leading the main attack, which wil take place as soon as we're ready.
dst: 俄国、罗马尼亚、塞尔维亚、希腊和意大利都已退出战争，现在是时候专注于我们对法英的最后攻势了。您将有幸领导主攻，只要我们就绪，它就会发动。

src: With Russia, Romania, Serbia, Greece and Italy out of the war it's time to focus on our final offensive against France and Britain. You'll have the honour of leading the main attack, which wil take place as soon as we're ready. But believe me, we won't tolerate more losses.
dst: 俄国、罗马尼亚、塞尔维亚、希腊和意大利都已退出战争，现在是时候专注于我们对法英的最后攻势了。您将有幸领导主攻，只要我们就绪，它就会发动。但相信我，我们不会再容忍更多损失了。

src: With Serbia defeated, Russia falling apart and Italy on the defensive, we don't have any real reason to remain in this war. It's a pity that France and the United Kingdom are so stubborn that they won't accept a negotiated peace. We'll have to keep on fighting until one side finds a winning strategy and the other collapses.
dst: 塞尔维亚已被击败，俄国正在分崩离析，意大利转入守势，我们其实没有任何理由继续留在这场战争中了。可惜法国和英国如此顽固，不肯接受经谈判达成的和平。我们只能继续打下去，直到一方找到制胜之策、另一方崩溃为止。

src: With Warsaw fully encircled, the very siege began. The intensity of the fighting became legendary and the casualties reached tens of thousands. The city was heavily damaged by aerial and artillery bombing. The garrison finally capitulated on the last day of September.
dst: 华沙被完全合围，围城战就此打响。战斗之惨烈成为传奇，伤亡达数万之众。空袭与炮击使这座城市满目疮痍。守军终在九月最后一天投降。

src: With Wehrmacht pushed ever westward, the fighting is spreading to the densely forested and marshy regions of Belarus. Soviet forces are advancing through seemingly impassable terrain and cutting off our defending units with surprise attacks.
dst: 随着国防军被一路向西挤压，战火蔓延到了白俄罗斯密林遍布的沼泽地区。苏军正穿过看似无法通行的地形推进，以奇袭切断我防守部队。

src: With Wilna in enemy hands, and German uhlans placing a tight screen around the last units under your command, you come to the painful realization that you have missed one too many chances in this battle.
dst: 随着维尔纳落入敌手，德国枪骑兵又对您指挥的最后几支部队布下严密封锁，您痛苦地意识到，您在这场战斗中错失了太多机会。

src: With Yugoslavia defeated, all that remains to challenge us in the region is Greece.  Unfortunately a British Expeditionary Force is in the country and has had enough time to entrench themselves in the mountains.  You are to take your brigade and advance through the Klidi Pass.
dst: 南斯拉夫既已败北，该地区能与我们抗衡的就只剩希腊了。遗憾的是，一支英国远征军正在该国，且有足够时间在山中掘壕固守。你要率你的旅穿过克利迪山口推进。

src: With a great effort, we reached the Tobol river. That's true. However, it didn't become our first step towards victory. It was just our swan song, and the Bolsheviks knew it. They simply waited on the western shore of the river until they were ready. And then, on October 14th, they advanced again. We could do nothing to stop them.
dst: 经过巨大的努力，我们抵达了托博尔河。确实如此。然而，这并没有成为我们迈向胜利的第一步。它只是我们的绝唱，布尔什维克心知肚明。他们只是在河西岸等待，直到准备就绪。然后，10月14日，他们再次推进。我们无力阻止他们。

src: With all gods! Now no more enemy stand between us and Rome!
dst: 众神在上！如今我们与罗马之间再无敌人阻挡！

src: With all the forces given to you, you still were unable to beat the Belgian Army. Luckily the Marine Division and 4th Ersatz Division performed better. The Belgian army has started to evacuate Antwerp. Their 2nd Division supported by the three British Brigades are covering the retreat.
dst: 尽管交给您这么多部队，您仍未能击败比利时陆军。所幸海军陆战师和第4补充师表现更佳。比利时陆军已开始撤离安特卫普。他们的第2师在三个英国旅的支援下掩护撤退。

src: With all the gods! We actually did it!
dst: 众神在上！我们真的做到了！

src: With each successful battle our allies respect us more and more, so now they count on us to strike the final blow to the Hindenburg Line. We won't let them down, will we?
dst: 随着每场战斗的胜利，我们的盟友越来越敬重我们，如今他们指望我们对兴登堡防线发起最后一击。我们不会让他们失望的，对吧？

src: With hopes of a quick capture of Paris gone and your 6.Reserve Division reunited with 5.Reserve Division, it is time to deal with Antwerp.
dst: 随着迅速攻占巴黎的希望破灭，您的第6预备师已与第5预备师会合，现在是时候对付安特卫普了。

src: With immediate effect you are dismissed from the army.

With incopetent generalship, you have allowed the Austrians to maintain a link with the fortress of Przemysl.  The delayed deployment of your cavalry screen has caused the strategic momentum to hang in balance, forcing valuable troops to be diverted to this sector from other lines of advance.  You have been dismissed of your command, Gospodin General-Major!
dst: 由于指挥无能，您让奥军得以保持与普热梅希尔要塞的联系。您骑兵警戒线的延迟部署，使战略态势悬而未决，迫使宝贵部队从其他进攻路线被抽调至该地段。您已被解除指挥权，少将先生！

src: With its base strength of 12 and a powerful dual-purpose gun it will help to defend the capital!
dst: 它拥有 12 点基础战力，加上威力强劲的双用途火炮，能协助保卫首都！

src: With low fuel and ammo stocks, all we can do now is to wait and see what Monty's next move is.
dst: 燃料和弹药库存见底，我们现在能做的只有等着看蒙蒂的下一步棋。

src: With luck, we can soon end this war as we hope to take Moscow.
dst: 走运的话，我们很快就能结束这场战争，因为我们有望攻占莫斯科。

src: With more of our troops arriving in Tunisia, it is time for a new attempt to take Mateur, Tebourba and Djedeïda - followed up by the capture of Bizerte and Tunis. The fall of those two ports would cut off the Axis lifeline to Italy and would force the Axis troops in North Africa to surrender.
dst: 随着更多部队抵达突尼斯，是时候再次尝试夺取马特尔、泰布尔拜与杰迪达——进而攻占比塞大与突尼斯城。这两座港口的陷落将切断轴心国通往意大利的生命线，迫使北非轴心国军队投降。

src: With most of the French on the run, our objectives were easily met. HQ must not know how far we have advanced already. Rather than have us continue the attack towards Ypres, they want us to wait for another gas attack.
dst: 由于大部分法军都在溃逃，我们轻而易举地达成了目标。司令部绝不能知道我们已经推进了多远。他们不让我们继续向伊普尔进攻，而是要我们等待下一次毒气攻击。

src: With much effort, our troops managed to break the Egyptian lines. The surviving Egyptians fled to the safety of their forts, and although in the following days we tried to assault them, it was in vain. Those positions were too strong. Finally, Yohannes agreed to a ceasefire. He allowed the remaining Egyptians to leave the forts and go back to their bases and, in return, we wouldn't pursue them. After some days, Hamasien, Akele and Guzay were again under Ethiopian control, but the Egyptians still held Bogos.
dst: 经过极大的努力，我们的部队终于突破了埃及人的战线。幸存的埃及人逃回了堡垒的庇护之中，尽管在随后的几天里我们试图强攻，但都徒劳无功。那些阵地实在太坚固了。最终，约翰内斯同意停火。他允许剩余的埃及人离开堡垒返回基地，作为交换，我们不再追击他们。几天之后，哈马西恩、阿克莱和古扎伊重新归埃塞俄比亚控制，但埃及人仍然占据着博戈斯。

src: With our bridgeheads on the eastern shore of the Dniepr river we are no able to push deep into the Soviet rear. Kiev and Dnipropetrovsk will be encircled soon! You will lead our push towards Dnipropetrovsk, together with our Italian and Hungarian allies! Good luck, Herr General!
dst: 凭借我们在第聂伯河东岸的桥头堡，我们已能向苏联后方纵深推进。基辅和第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克很快将被合围！你将与我们的意大利和匈牙利盟友一起，率领我们向第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克推进！祝你好运，将军阁下！

src: With our fleet crippled by an aerial torpedo attack at Taranto and vital reinforcements and supplies siphoned off to the Greek campaign, there is little more that we can do than sit and wait in our ring of fortresses near Sidi Barrani.
dst: 由于我们的舰队在塔兰托遭空投鱼雷袭击而瘫痪，重要的增援和补给又被抽去希腊战役，我们在西迪拜拉尼附近的环形要塞里除了坐等，也做不了什么了。

src: With our superior equipment we are able to repel the enemy, but take care of traps and anything unexpected!
dst: 凭借我们优越的装备，我们能够击退敌人，但要当心陷阱和任何意外！

src: With severe losses, your troops have entered Luga.  The stiffened resitance on the part of the Red Army does not bode well for the offensive:  it appears a change of leadership and policy (Lev Trotsky assumed command of the Red Army, re-instated officer ranks, and enforced conscription) has improved the Red Army's fighting abilities and organization.
dst: 您的部队以惨重损失攻入了卢加。红军方面日益顽强的抵抗对攻势来说并非吉兆：看来领导层与政策的变更（列夫·托洛茨基接掌红军指挥权，恢复了军官军衔，并强制征兵）已提高了红军的战斗力与组织度。

src: With strong Allied mobile forces on our tail, the first really defendable position is El Agheila - more than 1000km to the West.
dst: 强大的盟军机动部队咬在我们身后，第一处真正可守的阵地是阿格海拉——在西面1000多公里处。

src: With supply lines severely exteded, the Bolsheviks have been unable to secure their gains at Tallinn:  they have been driven back.  With the situation under control (and many officers dead), you miraculously retain your command!  You must attain a victory now!
dst: 由于补给线严重拉长，布尔什维克未能在塔林巩固他们的战果：他们已被击退。在局势得到控制（且许多军官阵亡）的情况下，您奇迹般地保住了指挥权！现在您必须取得一场胜利！

src: With that aim, an offensive was planned in the Cambrai before the end of 1917. We would attack with artillery and veteran infantry units, supported by a large number of tanks. It was a very dangerous move, since the German defences were formidable, but so was our determination. We knew that Germany was about to win the war in the East, so in a few weeks they could use new divisions against us. We had to force them to surrender before that could happen.
dst: 怀着这一目标，一场攻势于1917年结束前在康布雷筹划。我们将以炮兵和久经沙场的步兵部队发动进攻，并得到大量坦克的支援。这是一步非常危险的棋，因为德军的防御坚不可摧，但我们的决心同样坚定。我们知道德国即将赢得东线的战争，因此数周之内，他们就能调新的师来对付我们。我们必须在那之前迫使他们投降。

src: With that move however, Von Kluck left the flank of the Second Armee wide open, creating a gap in the German front between the First and Second Armee. The BEF and French Fifth Armee were slowly moving more and more troops N - in that gap. Only by withdrawing the First and Second Armee behind the Aisne, the German cavalry could close the gap and restore the frontline.
dst: 然而，冯·克卢克这一调动使第二集团军的侧翼完全暴露，在德军第一、第二集团军之间的战线上撕开了一个缺口。英国远征军和法军第五集团军正缓慢地把越来越多的部队调往那个缺口的北面。只有把第一、第二集团军撤到埃纳河之后，德国骑兵才能合上缺口、恢复战线。

src: With that move, Von Kluck has left the flank of the Second Armee wide open, creating a gap in the German front between the First and Second Armee. The BEF and French Fifth Armee are slowly moving more and more troops N - in that gap.
dst: 这一调动使冯·克卢克将第2集团军的侧翼完全暴露，在德军战线的第1与第2集团军之间撕开了一个缺口。英国远征军和法军第5集团军正缓慢地将越来越多的部队向北调入那个缺口。

src: With the 4-day artillery barrage coming to an end, a 20-minute pause preceeded the detonation of the mines.  The German troops rushed out of their dugouts to man the trenches -- only to be caught by the most massive man-made explosion in history.  The detonation of the mines - audible as far as Dublin - ensured early success.
dst: 随着持续四天的炮火准备结束，一次20分钟的停歇之后，地雷被引爆。德军部队冲出掩体进入战壕——却迎头撞上了人类历史上最猛烈的人为爆炸。地雷的爆炸声远至都柏林都能听见——这确保了初期的成功。

src: With the 5th Leichte Division in North Africa and trained for desert warfare, Rommel has decided to perform a reconnaissance in force. El Agheila has fallen without much fighting. Next stop is Mersa Brega. Your Ariete division will support the German forces in their reconnaisance.
dst: 第5轻装师已抵达北非并完成沙漠战训练，隆美尔决定进行一次武力侦察。阿格海拉未经多少战斗就陷落了。下一站是梅尔萨布雷加。你的“公羊”师将支援德军的这次侦察。

src: With the Antwerp fortresses reduced to rubble by German and Austrian siege guns, there was no other option left than retreat. Our six infantry divisions reached the coast four days ago - covered by cavalry, cyclists and motor machinegun sections. We have taken position in front of the river Yzer with the North Sea to our left and French and English troops to the right.
dst: 安特卫普的要塞被德奥攻城炮夷为瓦砾，除了撤退已别无选择。我们的六个步兵师四天前抵达了海岸——由骑兵、自行车兵和摩托机枪分队掩护。我们已在伊泽尔河前方就位，左翼是北海，右翼是法国和英国军队。

src: With the Belgian 1st Cavalry Division on the Belgian Northern flank shaken, it is now time to hit the 1st Infantry Division just South of it, defending Tienen. A quick and successful attack here will push back the Belgian army before the French can fill the gap between the 4th Infantry Division at Namur - to your South East - and the rest of the Belgian Army that is in front of your forces. Taking the Belgian Army out of the picture will allow us to turn the First Armee South towards Paris.
dst: 比利时北翼的第1骑兵师已动摇，现在是时候打击其正南面、防守蒂嫩的比利时第1步兵师。在这里迅速而成功地进攻，就能在法军填补位于您东南方那慕尔的第4步兵师与正对着您部队的比利时陆军其余部分之间的缺口之前，将比利时陆军击退。让比利时陆军退出战局，我们就能让第1集团军转而南下，直指巴黎。

src: With the Belgian 1st Cavalry Division on the Northern flank shaken, it is time to hit the 1st Infantry Division (*) just South of it. A quick and successful attack here will push back the Belgian army before the French can fill the gap between the 4th Infantry Division at Namur - to your South East - and the rest of the Belgian Army that is in front of your forces. Taking the Belgian Army out of the picture will allow us to turn the First Armee South towards Paris.
dst: 北翼的比利时第1骑兵师已动摇，现在是时候打击其正南面的第1步兵师（*）了。此处一次快速而成功的进攻，将赶在法军填补缺口之前击退比利时军队——缺口位于您东南方那慕尔的第4步兵师与当面其余比利时军队之间。让比利时军队退出战局，将使我第1集团军得以转向南方，直指巴黎。

src: With the Belgian army retreating to Antwerp, Von Kluck's 1st Armee is now able to turn South in the direction of Paris. IIReserve Korps is left behind to protect our supply lines from further Belgian interference.
dst: 比利时陆军撤向安特卫普后，冯·克卢克的第1集团军如今得以转向南，朝巴黎方向推进。第2预备军被留下，以保护我方补给线免遭比利时人的进一步袭扰。

src: With the Central and Northern Tunisian front stabalized, it is time to focus on 8th Army's imminent attack on the Mareth line. A mainly German spoiling attack against 8th Army positions failed misserably 2 weeks ago and nothing can stop Monty from launching a new offensive.
dst: 突尼斯中部和北部战线既已稳定，现在是时候关注第8集团军即将对马雷斯防线发动的进攻了。两周前一次主要由德军实施的破坏性进攻对第8集团军阵地惨遭失败，如今已无法阻止蒙蒂发起新的攻势。

src: With the Czech action at Tsjeljabinsk the imprisoned Legionairs were freed. Even more, the Soviet rule in the city was destroyed. The Legion would take care of their own way how to reach Wladiswostok and get out of Russia. No longer it would cooperate with the Soviet authorities. Still the Legion was scattered from Penza, west of the Volga River, to Tsjeljabinsk, east of the Urals...
dst: 随着捷克军团在车里雅宾斯克的行动，被囚禁的军团士兵获释。更有甚者，该城的苏维埃统治被摧毁。军团将自行决定如何抵达符拉迪沃斯托克并离开俄国，不再与苏维埃当局合作。此时军团仍分散在伏尔加河以西的奔萨到乌拉尔以东的车里雅宾斯克之间……

src: With the February revolution and the Tsar's abdication, a provisional government, headed by Kerensky, has assumed power of the Russian Empire.  Kerensky has promised our Entente allies to carry out a summer offensive to coincide with their efforts on the Western Front.  The French Neville offensive failed, and the British efforts at Arras have not paid off.  Kerensky has appointed Alexei Brusilov to command the Front and to muster the strength to break through.
dst: 随着二月革命和沙皇退位，以克伦斯基为首的临时政府掌握了俄罗斯帝国的权力。克伦斯基向我们的协约国盟友承诺，将发动一场夏季攻势，与他们在西线的努力相配合。法国尼韦勒攻势失败了，英国在阿拉斯的努力也没有奏效。克伦斯基已任命阿列克谢·布鲁西洛夫指挥方面军，并集结力量以求突破。

src: With the German attack against the Kursk Salient halted after an inconclusive tank battle at Prokhorovka and the Allies on the offensive at the Solomon Islands against the Japanese, the Axis have lost the initiative in the war. With more and more US forces being shipped into battle, victory seems further away than ever before.
dst: 德军对库尔斯克突出部的进攻在普罗霍罗夫卡一场胜负未分的坦克战后停滞，盟军又在所罗门群岛对日本发起攻势，轴心国已丧失战争主动权。随着越来越多的美军被投入战场，胜利看来比以往任何时候都更遥远。

src: With the North Atlantic now controlled by us, the Americans continue to send aid to the British using the island of Terceira for supplies. Also the island's airport functions like a huge aircraft carrier.
dst: 北太平洋如今已由我们控制，美国人继续利用特塞拉岛作为补给地，向英国人输送援助。该岛的机场也如同一艘巨大的航空母舰。

src: With the Polish problem solved, we are now looking at the West: The Netherlands, Belgium and France.
dst: 波兰问题既已解决，我们如今着眼于西面：荷兰、比利时和法国。

src: With the Soviet fleet out of action for the time being, one final objective remains and the Black Sea is ours. To destroy the 5 coastal cannons of the Krasnodar region. Then we can secure Krasnodar and we can capture the oil fields. Unfortunately, our aircraft carriers and ships in general cannot help you until you destroy the canons. Only some recon planes from Krasnodar might help you and that for a while as the Soviets are destroying the airfields one by one.
dst: 苏联舰队暂时失去战斗力，还剩最后一个目标，黑海就归我们了。摧毁克拉斯诺达尔地区的5门海岸炮。然后我们就能拿下克拉斯诺达尔，夺取油田。遗憾的是，在你摧毁这些火炮之前，我们的航空母舰和舰艇总体上都无法支援你。只有克拉斯诺达尔的一些侦察机或许能帮上忙，而且时间有限，因为苏联人正在一座座地摧毁机场。

src: With the Spaniards gone, Cuba will become an independent republic. Of course, we'll remind them that they owe their freedom to us. We'll make sure that they never take any decisions that could go against the interests of America.
dst: 西班牙人一走，古巴将成为独立的共和国。当然，我们会提醒他们，他们的自由归功于我们。我们会确保他们永远不会做出任何可能损害美国利益的决定。

src: With the XX Corps destroyed, you have held the front at the Bobr River, maintaining cohesion of our lines.  Your troops are to report to the rear for reorganization and preparation for their next assignment.
dst: 随着第20军被击溃，您守住了博布尔河一线，保持了我方战线的完整性。您的部队将到后方报到，进行整编并为下一次任务做准备。

src: With the aim of defeating the guerrillas Roberts and Kitchener created a system of blockhouses and ordered a scorched earth policy; Boer civilians had to be deported, farms and crops burnt, cattle shot, and wells poisoned, thus depriving the enemy of all kinds of support. I was naturally repulsed by these orders. For the first time in my life I believed that, by following them, I was not serving my country, but disgracing it. To make things even worse, the harsh South African environment was deteriorating my health alarmingly fast. Some days I was so weak that I could not even leave my private wagon and take charge of my troops.
dst: 为了击败游击队，罗伯茨和基钦纳建立了一套碉堡体系，并下令实行焦土政策；布尔平民必须被驱逐，农场和庄稼被烧毁，牲畜被枪杀，水井被投毒，从而断绝敌人一切形式的支援。这些命令自然令我感到厌恶。有生以来第一次，我认为遵从这些命令不是在为国效力，而是在给国家抹黑。更糟的是，南非严酷的环境正以惊人的速度摧残着我的健康。有些日子我虚弱得甚至无法离开我的私人车厢去接管部队。

src: With the bulk of our reserves sent to the Eastern front to save our Austro-Hungarian allies, there is not much we can do here on the Western front but to repulse Entente attacks like the one at Neuve Chapelle last month.
dst: 我方大部分预备队已派往东线去救援奥匈盟友，在西线这里我们能做的并不多，只能击退协约国的进攻，就像上个月新沙佩勒那样的进攻。

src: With the capture of Reims the new Entente lines near the Marne have been outflanked. Besides, our 6th Army has pushed through the gap that you've opened at Soissons and, overcoming all opposition, has captured Chateau-Thierry, west of your current position.
dst: 随着兰斯被攻克，协约国在马恩河附近的新防线已被包抄。此外，我军第6集团军已穿过您在苏瓦松打开的缺口，克服一切抵抗，攻占了蒂耶里堡——就在您当前阵地的西面。

src: With the defeat of the Afrika Korps and their Italian allies in Tunisia, we can now prepare for our return to Europe.  It has been concluded that an invasion of France is out of our reach at the present time, and thusly our focus is on Italy.  To begin with we will need to secure the island of Sicily, which will allow us to advance across the straits of Messinna into Italy itself.  The Italian defenders on the island have reportedly low morale and are considered inadequate to defend the coastline, however they have been reinforced by several German divisions.  Your main objective is the port of Syracuse.
dst: 随着非洲军团及其意大利盟友在突尼斯的覆灭，我们现在可以准备重返欧洲了。结论是，目前入侵法国还力所不及，因此我们把重点放在意大利。首先，我们需要夺取西西里岛，这将使我们得以横渡墨西拿海峡进入意大利本土。据说岛上意军守军士气低落，被认为无力防守海岸，不过他们已得到数个德国师的加强。你的主要目标是锡拉库萨港。

src: With the final war days approaching, and the definite loss inevitable, there's no strategy left. Germans are frantically holding the East Front to allow as many refugees to get into safety, and most of what can be achieved is simply a delay of few hours or days, before being overran by Soviets.
dst: 随着战争最后的日子临近，败局已无可避免，再无战略可言。德军拼命守住东线，好让尽可能多的难民逃往安全之地，而所能做到的，多半只是在被苏军击溃前拖延几个小时或几天。

src: With the invasion of Sicily, Allied forces got a footing on European threshold, soon to be followed with major landing in Italy proper.
dst: 随着西西里被入侵，盟军在欧洲门槛上站稳了脚跟，紧接着便是在意大利本土的大规模登陆。

src: With the last strength left in XX Corps, you were able to capture Alexandria. A similar scenario unfolded itself South of here with DAK standing at the captured Cairo Pyramids with no more than a dozen runners and a few 100 PzGrenadiere.
dst: 你以第20军仅存的兵力夺取了亚历山大。在此以南也上演了类似的一幕：非洲军站在被攻占的开罗金字塔前，身边只剩十来个传令兵和几百名装甲掷弹兵。

src: With the passing of February, the threat of an Austrian breakthrough waned, leaving Przemysl to its fate:  on March 30th the garrison capitulated.  This freed our 11th Army to redepoy to the mountains.  The fighting in April solidified along the established lines, with the Russians now failing in the face of firm Austro-German resistance.
dst: 随着二月过去，奥地利突破的威胁逐渐消退，普热梅希尔的命运已定：3月30日守军投降。这使我们的第11集团军得以重新部署到山区。四月的战斗沿既有战线固化，俄军此刻在奥德联军顽强的抵抗面前失利。

src: With the prestige you've gained, you can now equip your new units and make upgrades.
dst: 凭借您所获得的声望，现在可以装备新部队并进行升级了。

src: With the railway extended to Deir el Belah, they were able to bring in more artillery and tried again. Your task is nothing more than to prevent them taking Gaza.
dst: 随着铁路延伸至代尔拜莱赫，他们得以调来更多火炮并再次尝试。您的任务就是阻止他们攻占加沙。

src: With the recent advances South of here at Houthulst Forest we now have a chance to outfloank the German defenders. Cross the Handzamekanaal East of Diksmuide and attack towards Oostende, an important submarine and torpedoboat destroyer base.
dst: 凭借最近在豪特胡尔斯特森林以南取得的进展，我们现在有机会包抄德军守军。渡过迪克斯迈德以东的汉德扎梅运河，向奥斯坦德进攻，那里是一个重要的潜艇和鱼雷艇驱逐舰基地。

src: With the renewed allied offensive, the enemy and the front lines have finally reached the sector where your troops are deployed. As you know, most of our units here in Burma have been destroyed. This is our last stand to stop the allied advance, before to hurry up and go back into Thailand, and that is a plan which won't like to the Emperor.
dst: 随着盟军重新发起攻势，敌军与战线终于推进到了您部队驻守的地区。如您所知，我们在缅甸的大部分部队已被歼灭。这是我们阻止盟军推进的最后抵抗，否则我们就得赶紧退回泰国，而那个方案天皇是不会喜欢的。

src: With the success of Soviet winter counter-offensive, many Axis units were trapped in cauldrons.  In January 1942, German troops in Kholm were surrounded by Soviets in one such a pocket.
dst: 随着苏军冬季反攻得手，许多轴心国部队被困于合围圈中。1942年1月，驻霍尔姆的德军就被苏军围困在这样一个包围圈里。

src: With the taking of Keren, followed by the conquering of Asmara three days later, we finally controlled all the Eritrean Highlands and the mountain passes. Bogos, Hamasien and all the other regions that Menelik II had ceded to Italy were again in Ethiopian hands.
dst: 随着克伦的攻克、以及三天后阿斯马拉的征服，我们终于控制了整个厄立特里亚高地和所有山口。博戈斯、哈马西恩以及孟尼利克二世割让给意大利的所有其他地区，重新回到了埃塞俄比亚手中。

src: With the very last strength left in XX Corps, you were able to capture Alexandria. A similar scenario unfolded itself South of here with DAK standing at the captured Cairo Pyramids with no more than a dozen runners and a few 100 PzGrenadiere.
dst: 你以第20军仅存的最后一点兵力夺取了亚历山大。在此以南也上演了类似的一幕：非洲军站在被攻占的开罗金字塔前，身边只剩十来个传令兵和几百名装甲掷弹兵。

src: With these reinforcements we wil be able to attack Madrid from several fronts and victory will be certain. But before that happens you will have to defeat the liberal troops stationed in Guadalajara, that will surely try to prevent the Infante Alfonso's troops from intervening in our final offensive. Good Luck.
dst: 有了这些增援，我们就能从多个方向进攻马德里，胜利将成定局。但在此之前，您必须击败驻扎在瓜达拉哈拉的自由派部队，他们必定会试图阻止阿方索王子的部队参与我们的最后攻势。祝您好运。

src: With this victory you have completed the neutralization of the enemy's Northern Army. Nothing prevents us to direct our army to the Ebro valley.
dst: 凭借这场胜利，您已完成对敌军北方集团军的中和。没有什么能阻止我们把军队开向埃布罗河谷。

src: With victory at Agordat, all that lies in the way of victory in Eritrea is the town of Keren.  To approach the town of Keren, which lies 4,300 feet above sea level, from any direction but the east means an arduous passage through mountainous country. A formidable barrier of hills guards the town as you drive towards it up the road from Agordat. Only one gap exists through this barrier, the narrow and climbing Dongolaas Gorge that takes both road and railway up to the Keren plateau.
dst: 阿戈尔达特告捷之后，厄立特里亚的胜利之路就只剩克伦一城了。克伦城海拔4,300英尺，除东面外，从任何方向接近它都意味着要在山区艰难跋涉。当你沿阿戈尔达特方向的道路向克伦推进时，一道由群山构成的可怕屏障拱卫着该城。这道屏障只有一个缺口——狭窄而陡峭的东戈拉斯峡谷，公路和铁路都经此通往克伦高原。

src: With von Paulus's breakout from Stalingrad and your victory at Novgorod we have the opportunity to take Leningrad.  You are given this task, do not fail.
dst: 随着冯·保卢斯从斯大林格勒突围、以及你在诺夫哥罗德的胜利，我们有了攻取列宁格勒的机会。这项任务交给你，不要失败。

src: With von Paulus's breakout from Stalingrad and your victory at Novgorod we have the opportunity to take Leningrad.  You are given this task, do not fail. Ah ... Herr General, a late communication from the front lines! The Reds have launched a massive attack on our forces near Leningrad. You must hold them long enough for your troops to take Leningrad. Capture all the ports so the Reds cannot reinforce. I recommend 4 days holding the Red advance then rapid withdrawal before your troops are overrun. Remember General you must hold the Red advance until we are in the city. The Russkie troops will not reach your positions for 2 days.
dst: 随着冯·保卢斯从斯大林格勒突围、你在诺夫哥罗德的胜利，我们有了夺取列宁格勒的机会。此任务交给你，不得有失。啊……将军阁下，前线发来一封迟到的通讯！红军对我列宁格勒附近的部队发动了大规模进攻。你必须挡住他们足够久，好让你的部队夺取列宁格勒。夺取所有港口，使红军无法增援。我建议坚守红军攻势4天，然后趁部队尚未被击溃前迅速撤离。记住，将军，你必须挡住红军攻势，直到我们进入该城。俄军部队还需2天才能抵达你的阵地。

src: With von Paulus's breakout from Stalingrad in conjunction with the offensive of Manstein's Army Group Center the Bolshevik's are retreating in Central Russia.  Now with the Finn's recovery of their lost territory we have the opportunity to take Leningrad.  You are given this task, do not fail.
dst: 随着冯·保卢斯从斯大林格勒突围，加上曼施泰因中央集团军群的攻势，布尔什维克正在俄国中部撤退。现在，芬兰人收复了失去的领土，我们便有了攻取列宁格勒的机会。这项任务交给你，不要失败。

src: With von Paulus's breakout from Stalingrad in conjunction with the offensive of Manstein's Army Group Center the Bolsheviks are retreating in Central Russia.  At the same time the Finnish army has been recovering lost territory north of Leningrad, which has given us the opportunity to capture Leningrad.
dst: 随着冯·保卢斯自斯大林格勒突围，加之曼施泰因中央集团军群的攻势，布尔什维克正在俄罗斯中部溃退。与此同时，芬兰军队已收复列宁格勒以北的失地，这为我们夺取列宁格勒创造了契机。

src: With von Paulus's breakout from Stalingrad in conjunction with the offensive of Manstein's Army Group Center the Bolsheviks are retreating in Central Russia. At the same time the Finnish Army attempts to recover lost territory north of Leningrad, which has given us the opportunity to capture Leningrad. You are given this task, do not fail.
dst: 随着冯·保卢斯从斯大林格勒突围，加上曼施坦因中央集团军群的攻势，布尔什维克正在俄罗斯中部撤退。与此同时，芬兰军队试图收复列宁格勒以北的失地，这给了我们夺取列宁格勒的机会。这项任务交给你，不要失败。

src: With your advance the encirclement of six German and Hungarian divisions is complete. We know that the Germans will try to break out of the pocket. You have to prevent that troops of the axis can escape over the river into the west and you have to destroy most of the enemies troops.
dst: 随着您的推进，对6个德军和匈牙利师完成合围。我们知道德军会试图突围。您必须阻止轴心国部队渡河西逃，并歼灭敌军大部分兵力。

src: With your intervention, things can change soon. We have a great opportunity to win the war in the Balkans. We've finally signed two peace treaties with the Bolsheviks and with Romania, so the war in the east is over. Besides, it's obvious that the current Entente Spring Offensive in France will be a complete failure. That means that, at last, we can send fresh troops to Macedonia.
dst: 有了您的介入，局势很快就能改观。我们有一个在巴尔干赢得战争的绝佳机会。我们终于与布尔什维克和罗马尼亚签订了两份和平条约，东线的战事就此结束。此外，协约国目前在法国的春季攻势显然将以彻底失败告终。这意味着我们终于可以向马其顿派出生力军了。

src: With your last battalion surrounded and your hands raised above your head with a white flag of surrender, you could not help but admire the efficiency of the attack that has shattered your offensive and your career.
dst: 当您的最后一个营被包围，您举起双手、挥舞白旗投降时，您不禁钦佩这次进攻的高效——它击碎了您的攻势，也击碎了您的军旅生涯。

src: With your masterful guidance, everything has gone as planned. In a few hours our diplomats will meet in Solun with an Entente delegation in order to discuss an honorable peace for both sides.
dst: 在您的高超指挥下，一切都按计划进行。数小时后，我们的外交官将在萨洛尼卡与协约国代表团会晤，商讨对双方都体面的和平。

src: With your masterful performance against the Germans, you have ensured Latvia's political stability.  The Ministry has deemed fit to offer you a promotion to Kindralleitnant and to place under your command the army slated to attack Petrograd.
dst: 您以对抗德军时的精湛表现确保了拉脱维亚的政治稳定。部里认为应当提拔您为中将，并把预定进攻彼得格勒的军队交由您指挥。

src: With your support we should now be able to attack and crush the Americans. If you are victorious the threat of a new allied invasion of Italy will be gone for at least half a year, meaning we can redeploy your troops elsewhere.
dst: 有了您的支援，我们现在应当能够进攻并击溃美军。若您获胜，盟军再次入侵意大利的威胁将至少在半年内消失，这意味着我们可以把您的部队调往他处。

src: Withdraw all your forces to Rostov to hold Rostov and bridges across the river Don. When you can you must push through to Novocherkassk for victory.
dst: 将你所有部队撤至罗斯托夫，守住罗斯托夫与顿河上的桥梁。一旦可行，必须向新切尔卡斯克突破以夺取胜利。

src: Without any doubt, 1917 was the worst year of my life. The Tsar was dethroned and, some time later, taken prisoner. My beloved Russia lost the Great War against Germany. And, on top of all that, the Bolsheviks took power in most of the country. My motherland seemed to be withering, and so did my soul. Wishing to die, and being certain that my end was near, in the first weeks of 1918 I returned to my hometown near Samara, where at least I'd spend my last days with my parents and sisters.
dst: 毫无疑问，1917年是我一生中最糟糕的一年。沙皇被废黜，不久之后又沦为阶下囚。我心爱的俄国输掉了对德的大战。而雪上加霜的是，布尔什维克在全国大部分地区夺取了政权。我的祖国似乎在凋零，我的灵魂亦然。我一心求死，并且确信自己大限将至，于是在1918年的头几周，我回到了萨马拉附近的家乡，至少在那里能与父母和姐妹共度最后的日子。

src: Without the cossacks, I would have suffered an embarrasing defeat at Samara. Thank God that they came to our rescue. In the end, Simbirsk, Samara and Syzran were taken.
dst: 要是没有哥萨克，我本会在萨马拉蒙受一场难堪的失败。感谢上帝，他们赶来支援了我们。最终，辛比尔斯克、萨马拉和塞兹兰都被攻克。
魏特曼的第 101 装甲团
维齐希/巴伦廷/冯·曼陀菲尔
瓦迪斯瓦沃沃 (格罗森多夫)
沃拉-克日什托福尔斯卡

src: Wolseley's brilliant strategy granted us a fine victory in less that an hour and with minimal losses. The courage and the quality of the Egyptian soldiers were beyond all doubt, but they were completely surprised by our troops and were overwhelmed by our attack. Urabi surrendered to our cavalry, and the next day Wolseley arrived in Cairo. The Khedive was reinstated, and we established a permanent British military garrison in Egypt for the protection of our nation's interests.
dst: 沃尔斯利的高明战略使我们在不到一个小时、损失极小的情况下取得了一场漂亮的胜利。埃及士兵的勇气和素质毋庸置疑，但他们完全被我们的部队打了个措手不及，并被我们的进攻所压倒。奥拉比向我们的骑兵投降，次日沃尔斯利抵达开罗。赫迪夫得以复位，我们在埃及设立了永久性的英国驻军，以保护我国的利益。

src: Wonderful Commander we now have a good base for our attack on Gaza.
dst: 好极了，指挥官，我们现在有了进攻加沙的良好基地。

src: Wonderful Herr General! The Fuhrer is extremely pleased! You have captured the city of Stalingrad, and now we can again give full focus to the original goal of Case Blue, the Oilfields! You and your men are being ordered to link up with our forces advancing from Rostov into the Caucasus towards Maikop..
dst: 太棒了，将军阁下！元首极为满意！你已攻占斯大林格勒城，现在我们可以重新把全部注意力放到“蓝色方案”的初始目标——油田上！你和你的部下奉命与从罗斯托夫向高加索、向迈科普推进的我军会合……

src: Wonderful Herr General. Press on now toward Amiens.
dst: 太棒了，将军阁下。现在向亚眠推进。

src: Wonderful! The rebels are in disarray and retreating all their units in the sector. Our surprise attack across the Ebro has been totally accomplished thanks to your skills, and brave soldiers. Now, all of the Levante sector under rebel control is in chaos and will soon be recaptured by El Ejercito Popular. This victory will increase the morale of all the citizens of free Spain!
dst: 太棒了！叛军一片混乱，该地段的所有部队都在撤退。多亏您的才能和勇敢的士兵，我军强渡埃布罗河的突袭完全成功。如今叛军控制下的整个莱万特地区已陷入混乱，很快将被人民军重新夺回。这场胜利将提振自由西班牙全体民众的士气！

src: Wonderful!, we have conquested Narvik and all the nearby areas. This was the last big operation in Norway, the norvegians surrender us and we have now many naval bases to menace Great Britain and for secure the ''fidelity'' of the swedish.
dst: 太棒了！我们已征服纳尔维克及其周边所有地区。这是挪威境内最后一次大规模行动，挪威人向我们投降了，我们现在拥有许多海军基地，既能威胁大不列颠，又能确保瑞典人的「忠诚」。

src: Word on the wire is that a new development has occurred near Thule.  We may want to investigate that before launching an attack on the remnants of the German command, but ulltimately, the decision is your choice.
dst: 有线报称，图勒附近有了新动向。在攻打德军残余指挥机构之前，我们或许该先去调查一下，但最终决定由你来做。

src: Workers and Peasants Red Air Fleet

World News, July 19th London signs Non-Aggression treaty.SS/BdM Gestapa units are allowed on the Brit isles to shut-down armament factories,feed the starving and keep order.So the papers state.In Berlin the Fuhress is not happy though.The RAF and Royal Navy both have moved to Egypt to continue 'The Good Fight'.Both are just mere shadows of the strong forces they were and will have their hands full with the Italians.In Berlin A clerk walks into see the Fuhress"Ilse there's trouble at one of the Junker factories". "Send Frau Todthatcher, tell Her to do what She must".So arrives the FrauReichsfuhrer. The heads of Slave-laborers of the other 8 factories have been brought along to witness the FrauReichsfuhrers measures."What is the Problem here Frau Strauss"?"We've had some sabotage to damage the Frau-Z design and production.I have punished those I have caught but the damage continues to flare up".Frau Todthatcher looked out at the slave-laborer workers standing at attention."Does anyone want to come forward and admit this transgression against the Frauland.I see no-one wants to confess.Well whoever You are,how many of You there are I have only this to say.The Frau-Z Fighter is Our Ace Card that will win the War for the Reich against the Bolsheviks.The Fuhress will not allow disruption of any kind".And with that 1,700 workers were hauled away and disposed of in the Atlantic Ocean.Junkers once the news got around had no more problems.
dst: 世界新闻，7月19日 伦敦签署互不侵犯条约。党卫军/BdM 的盖世太保单位获准进入不列颠群岛，关闭兵工厂、给饥饿者供食并维持秩序——报纸是这么说的。不过在柏林，女元首并不高兴。皇家空军和皇家海军都已转移到埃及，继续“这场正义之战”。两者都只是昔日强盛兵力的一道影子，且将被意大利人缠住。柏林，一名文书走进来见女元首：“伊尔泽，容克公司的一家工厂出事了。”“派托德撒切尔女士去，告诉她该怎么办就怎么办。”于是这位女全国领袖到了。另外8家工厂的奴工头目被带来见证这位女全国领袖的手段。“这里出了什么问题，施特劳斯女士？”“有人搞破坏，损害了 Frau-Z 的设计与生产。我惩罚了抓到的人，但破坏还在不断冒出来。”托德撒切尔女士望向那些立正站着的奴工。“有谁愿意站出来承认这项背叛女性之国的行为。看来没人愿意认罪。好吧，不管你是谁、你们有多少人，我只说这一句：Frau-Z 战斗机是我们的王牌，它将为帝国赢得对布尔什维克的战争。女元首绝不允许任何形式的破坏。”说罢，1700名工人被拖走，丢弃在大西洋里。消息传开后，容克公司再没出过问题。

src: World War I is over, but now we face a new enemy! Herr Major, you are ordered to take command of the Baltische Landeswehr (Baltic Territorial Army) and the Eiserne Division (Iron Division) and liberate the capital of Latvia, the city of Riga, and its vicinity from the Bolsheviks.
dst: 第一次世界大战已经结束，但如今我们面对一个新的敌人！少校阁下，你奉命接管波罗的海地方防卫军（波罗的海领土军）和铁师（铁师），并从布尔什维克手中解放拉脱维亚首都里加城及其周边地区。

src: Worse news is that the Russians have decided to move us from the 11th Army to the 7th Army in the Carpathians. Those jealous Russian liaison officers must have something to do with this. Even during the battle, they gave us false information. They simply can't stand the fact that our maintenance facilities are so much better than theirs.
dst: 更糟的消息是，俄国人已决定把我们从第11集团军调到喀尔巴阡山脉的第7集团军。那些嫉妒的俄国联络官肯定与此事有关。甚至在战斗中，他们还给我们提供假情报。他们就是无法容忍我们的维修设施比他们好得多。

src: Worse, the front is in disarray, 8th Army has been decimated and Hitler is in willful ignornace of the state of his armies.........
dst: 更糟的是，战线一片混乱，第8集团军已被打得七零八落，而希特勒对自己军队的境况故意视而不见……

dst: 你是否愿意花费 300 点声望，说服最高统帅部允许你放弃进攻基辅，转而继续向莫斯科推进？

src: Would you prefer to fight next in North Africa or in the Balkans?
dst: 你愿意接下来在北非作战，还是在巴尔干作战？

src: Wow, it has been a little tougher that we had though, hasn't it? Those Spaniards do know how to fight, and they've been able to retreat in order when they saw a chance.
dst: 哇，这比我们预想的要艰难一些，不是吗？那些西班牙人确实很会打仗，而且他们一见有可乘之机，便能有序撤退。

src: Wrangel has broken out of the Crimea some time ago and captured land north of the Perekop isthmus.  We can only be grateful for a foolish act like that.  His forces are now strung out and have few reserves.  The idiots aligning themselves with Wrangel's fate must now even face the Cavalry Army!
dst: 弗兰格尔前些时候已突破克里米亚，夺取了彼列科普地峡以北的土地。对这样一个愚蠢之举，我们唯有感激。他的部队如今被拉成长线，几乎没有预备队。那些与弗兰格尔命运绑在一起的蠢货，现在还得面对骑兵集团军！

src: XII.--There is a river called the Saone, which flows through the territories of the Aedui and Sequani into the Rhone with such incredible slowness, that it cannot be determined by the eye in which direction it flows. This the Helvetii were crossing by rafts and boats joined together. When Caesar was informed by spies that the Helvetii had already conveyed three parts of their forces across that river, but that the fourth part was left behind on this side of the Saone, he set out from the camp with three legions during the third watch, and came up with that division which had not yet crossed the river.....
dst: XII.--有一条河叫索恩河，它穿过埃杜伊人与塞夸尼人的地界流入罗讷河，水势慢得令人难以置信，肉眼竟看不出它往哪个方向流。赫尔维蒂人正用木筏和拼在一起的船只渡这条河。凯撒由斥候得知，赫尔维蒂人已将三分之二的兵力送过河去，而第四部分还留在索恩河这一侧，便在第三更时分带三个军团从营地出发，追上了那支尚未渡河的队伍……

src: XLIV.--Ariovistus replied briefly to the demands of Caesar; but expatiated largely on his own virtues, "that he had crossed the Rhine not of his own accord, but on being invited and sent for by the Gauls; that he had not left home and kindred without great expectations and great rewards; that he had settlements in Gaul, granted by the Gauls themselves; that the hostages had been given by their own good-will; that he took by right of war the tribute which conquerors are accustomed to impose on the conquered.
dst: XLIV.--阿里奥维斯图斯简短回应了凯撒的要求；却大谈自己的美德：「他渡莱茵河并非出于自愿，而是应高卢人的邀请与召请而来；他离家别亲并非没有极大的指望与丰厚的报酬；他在高卢有高卢人自己给予的居地；人质是他们自愿交出的；他按战争之权收取征服者惯于向被征服者征收的贡赋。」
XLIX(榴弹炮) 皇家野战炮兵/14(轻型) [XV]

src: XLVII.--Two days after, Ariovistus sends ambassadors to Caesar, to state "that he wished to treat with him about those things which had been begun to be treated of between them, but had not been concluded"; [and to beg] that "he would either again appoint a day for a conference; or, if he were not willing to do that, that he would send one of his [officers] as an ambassador to him." There did not appear to Caesar any good reason for holding a conference; and the more so as the day before the Germans could not be restrained from casting weapons at our men.
dst: XLVII.--两天后，阿里奥维斯图斯派使者到凯撒处，说「他愿意就双方此前已开始商谈、却未得出结论之事与他商谈」；〔并请求〕「他要么再定一个会谈的日期；若不愿如此，就派他的一位〔军官〕为使到他那里去。」凯撒看不出有任何举行会谈的正当理由；何况前一天日耳曼人还按捺不住向我军投掷武器。

src: XVI.--Meanwhile, Caesar kept daily importuning the Aedui for the corn which they had promised in the name of their state; for, in consequence of the coldness (Gaul being, as before said, situated towards the north), not only was the corn in the fields not ripe, but there was not in store a sufficiently large quantity even of fodder: besides he was unable to use the corn which he had conveyed in ships up the river Saone, because the Helvetii, from whom he was unwilling to retire, had diverted their march from the Saone.
dst: XVI.--与此同时，凯撒天天催促埃杜伊人交出他们以全邦名义许诺的粮食；因为由于寒冷（如前所述，高卢地处北方），不仅田里的谷物尚未成熟，连饲料也没有足够的储备：此外他也无法使用他用船沿索恩河运上来的粮食，因为赫尔维蒂人——他不愿脱离他们——已把自己的行军路线从索恩河移开了。

src: XXIII.--The next day (as there remained in all only two days' space [to the time] when he must serve out the corn to his army, and as he was not more than eighteen miles from Bibracte, by far the largest and best-stored town of the Aedui) he thought that he ought to provide for a supply of corn; and diverted his march from the Helvetii, and advanced rapidly to Bibracte. The Helvetii, either because they thought that the Romans, struck with terror, were retreating from them, the more so, as the day before, though they had seized on the higher grounds, they had not joined battle; or because they flattered themselves that they might be cut off from the provisions, altering their plan and changing their route, began to pursue and to annoy our men in the rear....
dst: XXIII.--次日（因为距他必须给军队发放粮食的期限总共只剩两天，而据比布拉克特——埃杜伊人最大、储备最丰的城镇——不过十八里），他认为应当筹办粮食；于是改变行军方向、离开赫尔维蒂人，迅速向比布拉克特推进。赫尔维蒂人——或是因为他们以为罗马人已惊恐万状、正在退避，尤其因为前一天他们虽已占据高地却未交战；或是因他们自以为能截断我军的给养——于是改变计划与路线，开始追击并袭扰我军的后队……

src: XXV.--Caesar, having removed out of sight first his own horse, then those of all, that he might make the danger of all equal, and do away with the hope of flight, after encouraging his men, joined battle.......
dst: XXV.--凯撒先把自己的马藏到视线之外，再把所有人的马都藏起来，为的是让众人的危险均等、断了逃跑的念想，随后鼓励了士卒，便投入会战.......

dst: XXX.--与赫尔维蒂人的战争结束后，高卢几乎各地都派来使者，各邦首领聚集起来向凯撒道贺。

src: XXXI.--When that assembly was dismissed, the same chiefs of states, who had before been to Caesar, returned, and asked that they might be allowed to treat with him privately (in secret) concerning the safety of themselves and of all.
dst: XXXI.--那次聚会散后，先前见过凯撒的那些首领又回来，请求允许他们就自身以及所有人的安危与他私下（秘密）会谈。
