src: Yes, Russia and the Turkestan were safe at last, but what about the other possessions of the empire? Sadly, we had to accept the loss of many territories. In February, Kolchak signed the Treaty of Tiflis, acknowledging the independence of the republics of Georgia and Armenia, which became Russian allies. We quickly sent them arms, ammunition and advisors that they could use in their wars against Turkey and Azerbaijan.
dst: 是的，俄国和土耳其斯坦终于安全了，但帝国的其他领地又如何呢？遗憾的是，我们不得不接受丧失许多领土的现实。2月，高尔察克签署了《第比利斯条约》，承认格鲁吉亚共和国和亚美尼亚共和国独立，它们成为俄国的盟友。我们迅速向它们输送了武器、弹药和顾问，供它们在与土耳其和阿塞拜疆的战争中使用。

src: Yes, Your Excellency. We've lost Lerin and Bitolya. Tle leading general was fatally hit by artillery fire, and his troops could do nothing against the enemy's numerical superiority.
dst: 是的，阁下。我们丢掉了莱林和比托利亚。领兵的主将遭炮火击中而阵亡，他的部队面对敌人的数量优势无能为力。

src: Yes, comrade.  This is an impressive piece of mobile warfare!  You were even faster in Rostov than some of the capitalist's troops!  Roam the countryside and liberate the towns and villages of the provinces from the capitalists and monarchists.  They deserve to be free!  Hunt down every last traitor of the people!
dst: 是的，同志。这真是一场令人叹为观止的运动战！您在罗斯托夫的速度甚至快过某些资本家的部队！在乡间驰骋，从资本家和君主主义者手中解放各省的城镇和村庄。他们理应获得自由！追猎每一个人民的叛徒！

src: Yes, mister President. The attack on Kesiva was carefully planned, but unfortunately the General who led the troops was badly wounded by an enemy sniper at the beginning of the combat. Without his leadership, his troops couldn't achieve the planned objectives.
dst: 是的，总统先生。对凯西瓦的进攻是经过周密筹划的，但不幸的是，率领部队的将军在战斗一开始就被一名敌方狙击手打成重伤。失去了他的指挥，部队没能实现预定的目标。

src: Yes, that's right, Sir. The General is reported to be dead but in the midst of our retreat we couldn't recover his body. The Russian advance has been so quick that thousands of our soldiers are still missing and we fear the worst.
dst: 是的，长官，没错。据报将军已经阵亡，但在撤退途中我们没能找回他的遗体。俄军推进得太快，我们的数千名士兵至今下落不明，我们担心最坏的情况。

src: Yes, the Romanians have shown an amazing ability to resist our offensives. It’s incredible that they haven’t surrendered yet. But don’t forget that they have the continuous support of the Russians. Without their help, we would have already wiped all of Romania out. And we know that the Russian bear is dying. They are fighting against each other, they have dethroned their Czar, and the new republican government is an incompetent mess. It’s true that they were able to launch an offensive against our lines, but in a few weeks we had everything under control again. This new Russian attack will be a failure, and it’s just a matter of time until they surrender.
dst: 是的，罗马尼亚人表现出了惊人的抵抗我们攻势的能力。他们至今尚未投降，真令人难以置信。但别忘了，他们有俄国人持续不断的支持。没有俄国的帮助，我们早就把整个罗马尼亚扫平了。而我们知道，那头俄国熊正在垂死挣扎。他们在自相残杀，他们废黜了自己的沙皇，新成立的共和政府更是一团糟的无能之辈。诚然，他们曾对我军防线发起过一次进攻，但几周之内我们就把一切重新控制住了。俄国这次新的进攻必将失败，他们投降只是时间问题。

src: Yes, the girl is alright. She's very tiny, of course, because Sophie gave birth prematurely because of the shock. But the doctors told that the baby will be (hopefully!) alright. But now I see that they were silent about Sophie alone.
dst: 是的，女孩没事。她非常小，当然，因为索菲因受惊而早产了。但医生们说，婴儿（但愿！）会没事。但现在我明白了，他们对索菲本人的情况只字未提。

src: Yes, yes, I can't believe it either. After so many years of service, after surviving so many dangerous situations, after so many victories...just a few weeks away from retirement, the General was killed in one of the last engagements of the war. It seems that his car was shelled by some unspotted German mortars. It's a tragedy. The war is already won, but a man like him would have been very useful during the peace time. May his soul rest in peace.
dst: 是啊，是啊，我自己也不敢相信。服役这么多年，躲过了那么多险境，取得了那么多胜利……就在距退役仅几周之际，将军却在这场战争的最后几次交战中阵亡了。看来他的座车遭到了几门未被发现的德军迫击炮的轰击。这是一场悲剧。战争其实已经赢了，但像他这样的人在和平时代会非常有用。愿他的灵魂安息。

src: Yes, you're right, General. Our plan at Verdun isn't working as we had expected. Certainly, the French are fighting like lions and are forcing us to take a heavy toll for every centimetre of terrain that we conquer. But once we expell them from one position, their counterattacks are rare.
dst: 是的，您说得对，将军。我们在凡尔登的计划并不像预期的那样奏效。诚然，法军如雄狮般奋战，逼得我们每夺取一厘米土地都要付出沉重代价。但每当我们把他们逐出一处阵地后，他们的反攻却寥寥无几。

src: Yes, your Highness, the General died from his wounds yesterday. He did his best to stop the Italians and, if we act quickly, I think that we can still use his battle plan to halt the enemy offensive. Yes, the funeral will take place tomorrow. I understand, sir. Yes, I really think that he deserves that posthumous title. After all, he'll be remembered as one of the greatest generals of the Empire.
dst: 是的，殿下，将军昨天伤重不治。他已尽最大努力阻挡意大利人，若我们行动迅速，我想仍可利用他的作战计划阻止敌人的攻势。是的，葬礼将于明天举行。我明白，阁下。是的，我真心认为他配得上那个追授的称号。毕竟，他将作为帝国最伟大的将领之一被铭记。

src: Yesterday your forces captured the town of Brody.  Your pursuit of the Polish Army has left them shattered and desperately awaiting reserves.  Let them tremble under the hooves of your horses!
dst: 昨天您的部队攻占了布罗迪镇。您对波兰军队的追击已使其溃不成军，只能绝望地等待援军。让他们在您的铁蹄下颤抖吧！

src: Yesterday, I met with my old friend Emile Driant, who is commanding two battalions of Chasseurs here at Verdun. It was a joy to see him again after so many years, but very soon our conversation changed from indulging in reminiscences of our youth to a bleaker subject: Emile is very concerned about a possible German offensive in this sector of the front, a threat which Joffre simply denies. He has even taken the most unusual step of writing directly to the Ministry of Defence, complaining about the inadequate preparations of our defensive positions, especially the lack of workers and barbed wire. Joffre apparently was furious about Emile's letter, when he learned about it from General Gallieni.
dst: 昨天，我见到了我的老朋友埃米尔·德里昂，他在凡尔登指挥两个猎兵营。多年后重逢是件乐事，但我们的谈话很快从追忆青春转向了一个更灰暗的话题：埃米尔非常担心德军可能在前线这一地段发起攻势，而这一威胁霞飞矢口否认。他甚至采取了最不寻常的一步，直接写信给国防部，抱怨我方防御阵地准备不足，尤其是缺少劳工和铁丝网。当霞飞从加利埃尼将军那里得知埃米尔的信时，显然勃然大怒。

src: Yesterday, I spent the evening singing Christmas carols with some of my dearest comrades in an old, abandoned farmhouse in the snowy Carpathian mountains. In the warm, glimmering light of the fireside, I saw many eyes filled with tears, while our sore throats intonated "Stille Nacht, heilige Nacht". My heart felt heavy, too, when I thought of you and our loved ones and the many times we have sung this song together on Christmas Eve. How I wished I was with you, back in Germany, my love!
dst: 昨天，我和几个最亲密的战友在积雪的喀尔巴阡山中一座废弃的老农舍里，唱着圣诞颂歌度过了傍晚。在炉火温暖而闪烁的微光中，我看到许多双眼睛噙满泪水，而我们嘶哑的喉咙唱起「平安夜，圣善夜」。当我想到您、想到我们的亲人，想到我们曾在圣诞前夜一起唱过多少次这首歌时，我的心也沉甸甸的。亲爱的，我多么希望此刻能和您一起，回到德国啊！

src: Yesterday, on the 8th September 1943, the Armistice of Cassibile was made public and Italy surrendered. The Armistice was already signed on 3rd September between the Kingdom of Italy and the Allies in Cassibile on Sicily. German forces started to disamrm the itlaien and occupy all of Italy.
dst: 昨天，即1943年9月8日，卡西比莱停战协定公布，意大利投降。该停战协定早在9月3日就已由意大利王国与盟国在西西里的卡西比莱签署。德军开始解除意大利军队的武装并占领意大利全境。

src: Yet another brilliant victory of your tanksmen, Herr Major! Woderfully done! Enjoy your well deserved rest!
dst: 你的坦克兵又取得一场辉煌胜利，少校阁下！干得漂亮！好好享受你应得的休整吧！

src: Yet another victory of your tanksmen, Herr Major! Well done, indeed.
dst: 你的坦克兵又取得一场胜利，少校阁下！确实干得好。

src: Yet the surviving American ships still pose a serious threat and the Yankees will certainly send reinforcements soon. In view of the above, the need to scuttle most of our surviving ships due to the heavy damaged suffered during the battle, and the increasing pressure of Filipino insurgents, the High Command has ordered to abandon the naval station of Cavite.
dst: 然而，幸存的美国军舰仍构成严重威胁，而且洋基佬肯定很快就会派来增援。鉴于上述情况、战斗中遭受重创而需要凿沉大多数幸存军舰，以及菲律宾起义者日益增大的压力，最高统帅部已下令放弃甲米地海军基地。
叶韦茨科-米科拉伊夫卡 (叶韦茨卡亚-尼古拉耶夫卡)

src: Yohannes IV, the Great, His Imperial Majesty, Conquering Lion of the Tribe of Judah, King of Zion, King of Kings of Ethiopia and Elect of God, died in battle fighting against the Muslim hordes, just as he had wished. An honourable death for the greatest emperor that Ethiopia had had in centuries.
dst: 约翰尼斯四世，这位伟大的皇帝陛下、犹大支派的征服之狮、锡安之王、埃塞俄比亚万王之王、上帝选民，正如他所愿，在与穆斯林大军的战斗中阵亡。对于数百年来埃塞俄比亚最伟大的皇帝而言，这是光荣的死法。

src: Yohannes had been very patient for more than ten years. Following the advice of the Tewahedo Church, he had restrained himself for the sake of avoiding a civil war and fighting against the Muslim enemies of Ethiopia, but Tekle Haymanot's betrayal was the last straw for Yohannes. As soon as the Sudanese fled, we attacked the king's army and laid waste to much of Gojjam. Some said that our punishment was even worse than the Mahdists's pillages. We didn't stop until Tekle Haymanot submitted again to Yohannes.
dst: 十多年来，约翰尼斯一直非常克制。他听从特瓦赫多教会的劝告，为了避开内战、集中力量对抗埃塞俄比亚的穆斯林敌人而隐忍不发，但特克勒·海马诺特的背叛成了压垮约翰尼斯的最后一根稻草。苏丹人一逃走，我们就进攻了国王的军队，把戈贾姆大片地区夷为废墟。有人说，我们的惩罚甚至比马赫迪信徒的劫掠还要残酷。我们直到特克勒·海马诺特再次向约翰尼斯臣服才收手。

src: Yohannes had to settle with that. He would need all his troops to end the rebellion of Ras Wolde Mikael and to force King Menelik to swear allegiance to him. It would be an easier task now that Yohanes's warriors had captured nearly 13,000 Remington rifles, 20 cannons and lots of ammunition, but in spite of that it would still take two more years to subdue all the rebel nobles.
dst: 约翰尼斯只得接受这个结果。他需要动用全部军队来平定拉斯·沃尔德·米卡埃尔的叛乱，并迫使孟尼利克国王向他宣誓效忠。如今约翰尼斯的战士们已缴获近13000支雷明顿步枪、20门大炮和大量弹药，这项任务会容易一些，但尽管如此，要降服所有反叛的贵族仍需要再花两年时间。

src: You MUST establish the river as the screen line or the soviets are sure to infiltrate in great numbers.  The Soviets could start to move any moment, so you must move quickly!
dst: 你必须把这条河设为掩护线，否则苏军必将大量渗透。苏军随时可能开始行动，所以你必须迅速动作！

src: You Orders are to hold the beachhead and resist any german attack.
dst: 你的命令是守住登陆场，抵御德军的任何进攻。

src: You achieved a brilliant victory. Now it seems that the British have taken Jasin and you must go there and reconquer the town.
dst: 您取得了一场辉煌的胜利。现在看来英军已经占领了贾辛，您必须前往那里并重新夺回该镇。

src: You achieved a great victory, Herr General! The armies protecting Moscow are history! The General Staff is very pleased!
dst: 你取得了一场伟大的胜利，将军阁下！保卫莫斯科的各个集团军已成为历史！总参谋部非常满意！

src: You achieved a tactical victory. Now it seems that the British have taken Jasin and you must go there and reconquer the town.
dst: 您取得了一场战术上的胜利。现在看来英军已经占领了贾辛，您必须前往那里并重新夺回该镇。

src: You achieved a victory. Now it seems that the British have taken Jasin and you must go there and reconquer the town.
dst: 您取得了一场胜利。现在看来英军已经占领了贾辛，您必须前往那里并重新夺回该镇。

src: You achived a great victory! We could stabilize the whole front and destroy many German units. It seems the Germans spent their best units and completey lost their offensive capabilities on the western Front.
dst: 你取得了一场伟大的胜利！我们稳住了整条战线，消灭了许多德军部队。看来德国人耗尽了他们最好的部队，彻底丧失了在西线的进攻能力。

src: You achived a great victory! We crossed the Rhine on a broad front and with beachheads in the north and south we will be able to encircle the Ruhr area and trap most of the german forces in the west!
dst: 您取得了伟大的胜利！我们已在宽广的战线上渡过莱茵河，凭借北面和南面的桥头堡，我们将能够包围鲁尔区，并将德军在西线的大部分兵力围困其中！

src: You almost made it, but the British were too strong. A few days before the end of the war your army has finally been defeated and you were forced to surrender. Play this scenario again if you want a better result.
dst: 您差一点就成功了，但英军太强了。就在战争结束前几天，您的军队最终被击败，您被迫投降。如果您想获得更好的结果，请重新玩这个场景。

src: You already know me. And you're familiar to me, too. We've made a long journey together. Some of you were already under my command during the Ice March, when we earned the medals with the crown of thorns and saw Lavr Kornilov die before our eyes. Others joined in the campaigns of the Kuban and the Caucasus. There are those who, for a while, believed the Bolshevik lies and belonged to the barbaric Red Army, but were clever enough to change sides.
dst: 你们已经认识我了。而我也熟悉你们。我们一起走过了一段漫长的旅程。你们中的一些人在冰上行军时就已在我麾下，那时我们赢得了带荆棘王冠的勋章，亲眼看着拉夫尔·科尔尼洛夫在我们面前倒下。另一些人则在库班和高加索的战役中加入。还有一些人曾一度听信布尔什维克的谎言，隶属于野蛮的红军，但足够明智地改换了阵营。

src: You already know what happened: their summer offensive in Galizien was a complete disaster. Nevertheless, the Romanians saw it as an opportunity to retake the initiative. They launched a minor offensive in Marasti, and the truth is that defeated our first line troops.
dst: 您已经知道发生了什么：他们夏季在加利西亚的攻势彻底失败。然而，罗马尼亚人却视之为重夺主动权的良机。他们在马拉什蒂发动了一次小规模攻势，而且事实上击败了我们的第一线部队。

src: You also have the oportunity to add new units to your fleet.
dst: 你还有机会为你的舰队增添新单位。

src: You also have to destroy the Soviet bridgehead at Oranienbaum and you have to capture Kronstadt on Kotlin Island.
dst: 你还必须摧毁奥拉宁鲍姆的苏军桥头堡，并夺取科特林岛上的喀琅施塔得。

src: You also receive a core paratrooper brigade and a core cruiser.
dst: 你还将获得一个核心伞兵旅和一艘核心巡洋舰。

src: You and Vercingetorix have been sent by the gods!
dst: 你和维钦托利是众神派来的！

src: You and your Turk prisoners did well in beating off this Arab attack. Your Anzac Mounted Division is now needed to the north, make haste Commander!!!!
dst: 您和您的土耳其俘虏出色地击退了这次阿拉伯人的进攻。您的澳新骑兵师现在需要向北调动，指挥官，请火速行动！！！！

src: You and your boys will be making an amphibious landing on the northern end of the inhabited area, where you will rendezvous with some MP units maintaining control there.  Reinforcements are on standby to come in if the situation turns out to be FUBAR.
dst: 你和你的部下将在有人居住区域的北端实施两栖登陆，与驻守在那里的宪兵部队会合。若局势变得一团糟，增援部队随时待命。

src: You and your brave troops have achieved a great victory Herr General! The Soviets have been kept out of Rzhev and their penetrations in the Northwest have also been stopped! Now we can try to establish a solid frontline for the rest of winter.
dst: 你和你的英勇部队取得了一场伟大的胜利，将军阁下！苏军被挡在勒热夫之外，他们在西北方向的渗透也被阻止了！现在我们可以设法为这个冬季的余下时间建立一条稳固的战线。

src: You and your brave troops have barely achieved victory, Herr General! It was really a close call! The Soviets have been kept out of Rzhev and their penetrations in the Northwest have also been stopped! Now we can try to establish a solid frontline for the rest of winter.
dst: 你和你的英勇部队只是勉强取得了胜利，将军阁下！真是千钧一发！苏军被挡在勒热夫之外，他们在西北方向的渗透也被阻止了！现在我们可以设法为这个冬季的余下时间建立一条稳固的战线。

src: You and your corps get the honor to start our attack...
dst: 您和您的军获得了率先发起进攻的荣誉……

src: You and your elite troops are ordered to hold the line, no matter what! Push the enemy back into the sea! If we succeed, the Battle of the Mediterranean will be won!
dst: 你与你的精锐部队奉命守住防线，无论如何！把敌人赶回海里去！如果我们成功，地中海战役就将获胜！

src: You and your forces will be on trains to the Alps even as soon as the peace treaty is signed to keep Germany from invading.
dst: 你和你的部队甚至会在和约一签署就登上开往阿尔卑斯山的列车，以防德国入侵。

src: You and your forces will be on trains to the Alps even before the peace treaty is signed to keep Germany from invading.
dst: 你和你的部队甚至会在和约签署之前就登上开往阿尔卑斯山的列车，以防德国入侵。

src: You and your forces will formally surrender as soon as the peace treaty is signed, and tragically, Germany is already moving through the alps to occupy northern Italy.  We must now safe guard our resources for the Allies in a hope that they can move north quickly stop the Germans from moving farther south than they already have.   The Allies have been given safe passage while the negotiations continue.
dst: 你和你的部队将在和约签署后正式投降，而可悲的是，德国已穿越阿尔卑斯山，正占领意大利北部。我们现在必须为盟军保全资源，寄望他们能迅速北上，阻止德国人继续向南推进。谈判期间，盟军已获安全通行。

src: You and your men fought bravely Herr General and have succeeded in securing a temporary window of opportunity for the attempt to break the encirclement of the Sixth Armee! The code word "Thunderclap" is being transmitted to von Paulus as we speak!
dst: 你和你的部下战斗英勇，将军阁下，成功为打破第6集团军包围圈的尝试争取到了一个短暂的机会窗口！就在我们说话之际，“雷霆”这个代号正发给冯·保卢斯！

src: You and your men fought bravely Herr General!  Unfortunately, the Soviets could not be stopped. The two pincers of their attack have met East of Kalach. Sixth Armee is now surrounded! The situation is very serious for our troops...
dst: 你和你的部下打得十分英勇，将军阁下！遗憾的是，苏军终究未能被挡住。他们两路钳击已在卡拉奇以东会师。第六集团军现已被包围！我军的局势十分严峻……

src: You and your men fought bravely and are a great example of Axis cooperation, I would however like you to sign this after battle report that specifically mentions that our tanks are having increasing problems in dealing with the Russian heavy armor.....
dst: 你和你的部下英勇作战，是轴心国合作的典范，不过我仍想请你签署这份战后报告，其中特别提到我们的坦克在对付俄国重装甲时日益吃力……

src: You and your men fought bravely yet everywhere it seems the Russians stop our attacks, you must join me in signing this after battle report that specifically mentions that our tanks are having increasing problems in dealing with the Russian heavy armor.....
dst: 你和你的部下英勇作战，然而似乎处处都是俄军在阻止我们的进攻，你必须和我一起签署这份战后报告，其中特别提到我们的坦克在对付俄国重装甲时日益吃力……

src: You and your men have been mentioned by Mussilini as the pride example of Axis cooperation!
dst: 墨索里尼提到你和你的部下，称你们是轴心国合作的骄傲典范！

src: You and your men have been mentioned by both Hitler and Mussilini as the pride example of Axis cooperation!
dst: 希特勒和墨索里尼都提到你和你的部下，称你们是轴心国合作的骄傲典范！

src: You and your men have been selected to carry out commando operations against the islands of Guernsey, Alderney and Jersey. This will be a combined naval and airborne operation.
dst: 你和你的部下被选中对根西岛、奥尔德尼岛和泽西岛实施突击行动。这将是一次海空联合行动。

src: You and your men will be stationed in France to reform and get some much needed rest. The brigade will be expanded to a division, and there's an urgent need for a better, more powerful weaponry - the enemy air superiority is an undisputable fact.
dst: 你和部下将驻防法国，整编休整，稍作喘息。该旅将扩编为师，而更精良、更强大的武器已迫在眉睫——敌军的制空权是毋庸置疑的事实。

src: You are a great guy. You have managed capturing Antwerpen in only a half year. The next opportunity to land new units is far away. The allied have noticed their malposition and have quit the war. The whole German Reich is now under our control. You are invited to the Kremlin. Stalin personally wants to thank you.
dst: 你真是个了不起的家伙。你仅用半年就成功攻占了安特卫普。下一次补充新部队的机会还很遥远。盟军已意识到自己的失策并退出了战争。整个德意志帝国现在都在我们掌控之下。你受邀前往克里姆林宫。斯大林想亲自向你致谢。

src: You are a hero, General. Your inspiring leadership has been decisive to obtain this victory. Now Spain will have peace, and hopefully for many years. Congratulations, General!
dst: 您是个英雄，将军。您鼓舞人心的领导对取得这场胜利起了决定性作用。现在西班牙将迎来和平，但愿能维持许多年。祝贺您，将军！

src: You are again needed for and important mission; you are our best general here in China. The Burmese front remains quiet, and we need your leadership on this mission.  The morale of our men is really low in China, the constant retreats, and attacks have had a negative effect, and we need a decisive victory.  Your task is to seize the city of Changteh.  If we can get all our goals in this ambitious operation, we will be able to do further penetrations into the Chinese heartland, and possibly to end the war in China...
dst: 又有一项重要任务需要您出马；您是我们在中国最好的将军。缅甸战线依旧平静，我们需要您来领导这次任务。我们在中国的部队士气十分低落，不断的撤退与进攻带来了消极影响，我们需要一场决定性的胜利。您的任务是夺取常德城。如果这次雄心勃勃的作战能达成全部目标，我们就能进一步向中国腹地渗透，甚至可能结束在中国的战事……

src: You are aware that after we split the Republic into two territories the Reds launched a powerful strike across the Ebro River in August.  Although they took us by surprise and inflicted some losses; the brave National Army reacted quickly stopping the enemy at the gates of Gandesa.  Your orders are to deploy your troops and ruthlessly crush the Reds in the Ebro pocket.
dst: 您清楚，在我们把共和国切成两块领土之后，赤色分子于8月跨过埃布罗河发动了一次强大突击。尽管他们打了我们一个措手不及并造成了一些损失，但英勇的国民军迅速反应，在甘德萨城下挡住了敌人。您的命令是部署部队，在埃布罗河袋形阵地无情地粉碎赤色分子。

src: You are commanding an allied army of combined arms and will fight all the way from the beaches of the Normandy to the heart of Germany. You have to liberate France and the Low Countries, eliminate pockets and stop German counterattacks. Always on your side will be the great allied air force.
dst: 你指挥着一支诸兵种合成盟军部队，将从诺曼底海滩一路打到德国腹地。你必须解放法国与低地国家，肃清各孤立据点并阻止德军反扑。伟大的盟军空军将始终与你并肩作战。

src: You are completely responsible for the ground forces. This includes the upgrades and the expansion of your core. You are not only a field commander, but also a quartermaster and a politician who uses his prestige to gain any advantage possible.
dst: 你对地面部队负完全责任，包括核心部队的升级与扩充。你不只是战地指挥官，还是一位军需官和政治家，需善用声望谋取一切可能的好处。

src: You are completely responsible for the ground forces. This includes the upgrades and the expansion of your core. You are not only a field commander, but also a quartermaster and a politician who uses his prestige to gain any advantage possible. The air support is only partially in your hands, but it comes without any price. You can finish the campaign without any airplane purchased, just upgrade the airforce when necessary. I used the "air missions" setting, so the planes work much differently than in original Panzer General II.
dst: 地面部队完全由你负责，包括核心部队的升级与扩编。你不仅是战地指挥官，还是一名军需官兼政客，凭个人威望谋取一切可能的优势。空中支援只有部分归你调遣，但无需任何代价。你完全可以不买一架飞机就打完整个战役，只需在必要时升级空军。我采用了“空中任务”设定，因此飞机的运作方式与原版《装甲将军 II》大不相同。

src: You are facing a large part of the Heeresgruppe Mitte. The Germans have contracted a lot of tanks, infantry, artillery, 8.8 PAK and bombers west of Minsk. Hoths Panzergruppe 3 is attacking from the north, Panzergruppe 2 under Guderian is attacking from the south. You will have contact with these troops soon, too.
dst: 您面对的是中央集团军群的一大部分。德军已在明斯克以西集中了大量坦克、步兵、炮兵、88毫米反坦克炮和轰炸机。霍特的第3装甲集群正从北面进攻，古德里安麾下的第2装甲集群正从南面进攻。您很快也会与这些部队接触。

src: You are facing several finish troops. However, you should expect that the Germans will help Finland with some German reinforcements. Nonetheless, the enemy troops should be no problem for you.
dst: 你面对的是若干芬兰部队。不过，你也应预料到德国人会以一些德国增援帮助芬兰。尽管如此，敌军部队对你来说应该不成问题。

src: You are facing several tanks and infantry divisions. Moreover, you should calculate with heavy attacks from the German Luftwaffe.
dst: 你们面对的是若干坦克师和步兵师。此外，还必须做好应对德国空军猛烈空袭的准备。

src: You are facing the 11. German army in the north. Some parts of the Rumanian third and fourth army are attacking from southwest. The Rumanians are inexperienced. It could be a good idea, that you use your inexperienced troops against them.
dst: 你在北面面对德国第11集团军。罗马尼亚第3和第4集团军的部分部队正从西南方向进攻。罗马尼亚人缺乏经验。用你缺乏经验的部队对付他们可能是个好主意。

src: You are facing the 16th and 18th Army. These troops are worn out, but high experienced. They have only two serious tank troops. The way to the battlefield is blocked with Blockings, Bunkers and Mindfields.
dst: 你面对的是第16与第18集团军。这些部队已被消耗殆尽，但经验非常丰富。他们只有两支像样的坦克部队。通往战场的道路被路障、碉堡与雷场所封锁。

src: You are facing the 17th German Army. Also, there are several Romanian and Slovak troops. The Romanians and the Slovaks have only a low strength. The German troops has only a few tanks and only one fighter squadron. Maybe there will be no great fightback, but you have to be fast, too.
dst: 你面对的是德国第17集团军。此外还有一些罗马尼亚和斯洛伐克部队。罗马尼亚人和斯洛伐克人兵力薄弱。德军部队只有少量坦克，且仅有一个战斗机中队。也许不会有大规模反击，但你也必须行动迅速。

src: You are facing the 4. Panzerarmee and the 2. Army. Moreover, in the south the 2. Hungarian Army supports them. The Hungarians are not so experienced like the Germans. The Germans have also new assault guns with higher range than our tanks. Be aware of them! Oh, wait, we have just this moment obtained the information that the Germans have marched off more troops with good tanks and tank destroyers. They will arrive in the south of the battlefield in several days.
dst: 你面对的是第4装甲集团军与第2集团军。此外，南面还有匈牙利第2集团军支援他们。匈牙利人不像德国人那样有经验。德军还拥有射程比我军坦克更远的新型突击炮。务必当心它们！哦，等等，我们刚刚得到情报，德军又调走了更多配备优良坦克与坦克歼击车的部队。他们将在数日内抵达战场南部。

src: You are facing the 8th Army. These troops have lost much of their strength but they were supplied with some serious prototypes in the last days. The Germans have some new fighters in the area, but there is no airfield in the near, so, the fighters can support the German troops only a few days.
dst: 你面对的是第8集团军。这些部队已损失了大部分实力，但最近几天他们获得了一些相当厉害的原型装备补给。德军在该地区有一些新型战斗机，但附近没有机场，因此这些战斗机只能支援德军数日。

src: You are facing the 9. German Army. The troops in the salient are still very strong. They have built a coherent front line and break through it could be very difficult but they have no reserves after the first front line. The area is also full of landmines and fortifications. Rzhew`s defenders are very powerfull, you may need a lot of higher range artillery to break through the lines at Rzhew. Be aware, that the reserve troops are deployed in Sychewka. There you have to calculate with heavy resistance, too.
dst: 你面对的是德国第9集团军。突出部内的部队依然十分强大。他们已构筑了一条连贯的防线，突破这条防线可能非常困难，但他们在第一道防线之后并无预备队。该地区还布满了地雷与工事。勒热夫的守军非常强大，你可能需要大量远程火炮才能突破勒热夫一带的防线。请注意，其预备队部署在瑟乔夫卡。在那里你也必须预料到会遭遇顽强抵抗。

src: You are facing the II. SS-Panzer Corps. You have to calculate with heavy tank attacks. The German Luftwaffe will support the attack of the tanks. So you need a strong air defense and fighters.
dst: 你们面对的是党卫军第2装甲军。必须做好应对重型坦克进攻的准备。德国空军将为坦克的进攻提供支援。因此你们需要强大的防空力量和战斗机。

src: You are facing the XIII Army Corps. The enemy is under strenght and has only some seroius tanks. With a good front is should be easy to repel the breakout.
dst: 你们面对的是第13军。敌军兵力不足，只有少量堪用的坦克。只要战线稳固，击退突围应当不难。

src: You are facing two armies and some Manchukuo troops. These armies are bad equipped but they have entrenched themselves in the mountains east of Changchun. To break through the lines will take time.
dst: 你面对的是两个集团军以及一些满洲国军部队。这些集团军装备低劣，但他们已在长春以东的山区构筑了工事。突破其防线需要时间。

src: You are garrisoned in the small Sicilian town not far away from the seashore. Since the early morning you hear the cannonade of naval guns, and now your town, a former Greek colony of the Ancient times, is assaulted by daring Canadian and British onslaught.
dst: 你驻守在西西里一座临海不远处的小镇。从清晨起你便听到舰炮的轰鸣，如今这座小镇——古时的希腊殖民地——正遭到加拿大与英国军队悍勇的猛攻。

src: You are given complete freedom of action- continue your drive to the Channel!!!
dst: 你获得完全的自主行动权——继续向海峡推进！！！

src: You are in a vacuum between the retreating Germans and attacking Soviets. With no orders from above, with nothing to gain, and with little hope in sight, you follow the general retreat. Joined by some infantrymen, similarly forlorn, but similarly determined to not give up easily, your only chance is to escape westwards.
dst: 你处在后撤的德军与进攻的苏军之间的真空地带。没有上级命令，无利可图，希望渺茫，你只能随大部队撤退。身边聚拢了一些同样凄惶、却同样不甘轻易放弃的步兵，你唯一的机会是向西突围。

src: You are in command of Gruppe Vimy that is holding the Vimy Ridge North of Arras. It has a commanding view over the area. In case of an - almost certain - enemy attack on your position, hold on to this valuable position for at least 2 days (6 turns) after which reinforcements can push the enemy back.
dst: 您指挥着驻守阿拉斯以北维米岭的维米集群。这里可以居高临下俯瞰整个地区。如果敌军——几乎可以肯定——向您的阵地发起进攻，务必守住这一宝贵阵地至少2天（6回合），之后增援部队便能将敌人击退。

src: You are in command of the Czech Legion units near Ufa. You must hold any enemy from blocking the railroads going east, to the Ural mountains and safeguard the railroad. It might be needed to engage Soviet units because the White Russian army might not be able to stem the Soviet advance...
dst: 您负责指挥乌法附近的捷克军团各部。您必须阻止任何敌人封锁通往东方、通往乌拉尔山脉的铁路，并保卫这条铁路。可能需要与苏军部队交战，因为白俄军队或许无法挡住苏维埃的推进……

src: You are near Rovno.  As always you know what to do.  Capture all vital communication centers and push as far west as possible.  Most of all let nothing stop you!  Like a tornado you must use your mobility.  After all it is the symbol for cavalry!
dst: 您已逼近罗夫诺。一如既往，您知道该怎么做。夺取所有重要交通枢纽，尽可能向西推进。最重要的是，别让任何事阻挡您！您必须如旋风一般运用您的机动性。毕竟，这正是骑兵的象征！

src: You are not allowed to sell attachements from ships or airplanes.
dst: 不允许出售舰船或飞机的附件。

src: You are not allowed to sell attachments from airplanes or ships.
dst: 你不允许出售飞机或舰船的附件。

src: You are not allowed to sell infantry attachments or deploy inf units.
dst: 你不允许出售步兵附属装备或部署步兵单位。

src: You are not allowed to sell ship or aircraft attachments.
dst: 您不得出售舰船或飞机的附属装备。

src: You are not going to like this.
dst: 你不会喜欢这个消息的。

src: You are now in command of the complete 63rd Cyrene Division that is stationed in Camp Sofafi. Main units in the division are the 157 and 158 infantry regiments and the 45th artillery regiment.
dst: 你现在指挥驻于索法菲营地的第63昔兰尼师全师。该师主要单位是第157和第158步兵团以及第45炮兵团。

src: You are now to retreat from Alsace and go to the east.
dst: 您现在要从阿尔萨斯撤退，向东转移。

src: You are our last hope. Do your best and stop the enemy. If you succeed, who knows? Maybe we'll be able to retake the initiative in Macedonia after three years.
dst: 您是我们最后的希望。竭尽全力阻止敌人。如果您成功了，谁知道呢？也许三年之后我们还能在马其顿重夺主动权。

src: You are relieved of command, General Graziani has been chosen to take over the operations to salvage the situation.
dst: 你被解除指挥权，格拉齐亚尼将军被选中接管行动，以挽救局面。

src: You are relieved of your command and are ordered back to London for further consultations.
dst: 你被解除指挥权，奉命返回伦敦等待进一步指示。

src: You are spearheading an assault against Tukums, and you find yourself commanded by Der Panzergraf once again. Destroy the Soviet forces and clear the area so that a save corridor between Third Panzer Army and Sixteenth Army can be established and held.
dst: 你将担任对图库姆斯突击的先锋，并再次听命于“装甲伯爵”麾下。消灭苏军并肃清该地区，以便在第3装甲集团军与第16集团军之间建立并守住一条安全走廊。

src: You are still in command of XXI Corps: Ariete at close to full strength and Trieste and Littorio which have suffered heavily in last week's fighting.
dst: 你仍指挥第21军：“公羊”师接近满编，而“的里雅斯特”师和“利托里奥”师在上周的战斗中损失惨重。

src: You are stripped of all titles and property, the 4th CCNN awaits you, volunteer, now get out of my sight!
dst: 你被剥夺一切头衔和财产，第4黑衫营在等着你，志愿兵，现在从我眼前滚开！

src: You are the commander of the best units in the whole PLA, and your mission is to counter-strike the Soviet invaders.  If we want to continue with our own interpretation of the Marxism, we must defeat the Soviets.  Also Mao would be most pleased, if your men capture the important city of Khabarovsk.  He says that these territories are historically Chinese and no soviets must remain on Chinese lands!
dst: 你是整个解放军中最精锐部队的指挥员，你的任务是反击苏联入侵者。如果我们想继续走自己对马克思主义的解释，就必须击败苏联人。而且，如果你的部队夺取重镇哈巴罗夫斯克，毛泽东将会极为满意。他说这些领土历史上属于中国，中国土地上不得留下一名苏联人！

src: You are the most brilliant Blitzkrieg tactician in history Herr General! Your rapid defeat of the Red armies has opened the way into Russia!
dst: 你是史上最杰出的闪电战战术家，将军阁下！你迅速击败红军，已打开通往俄国之路！

src: You are to command the XIX Corps which is made up of the 3rd Panzer Division, the 2nd and 20th Infantry Divisions with the 23rd Infantry Divsion in Reserve.
dst: 你将指挥第19军，该军由第3装甲师、第2和第20步兵师编成，第23步兵师担任预备队。

src: You are to continue your drive West towards Amiens.
dst: 你将继续向西推进，直指亚眠。

src: You are to continue your drive south towards Brest.
dst: 你将继续向南推进，直取布列斯特。

src: You are to continue your drive south towards Chelm.
dst: 你将继续向南推进，直取海乌姆。

src: You are to join the invasion of Russia.
dst: 你将参加对俄国的入侵。

src: You are to land a small raiding party to finally destroy for good the Turkish guns.
dst: 您要派一支小规模突击队登陆，最终彻底摧毁土耳其人的火炮。

src: You are to retreat into Port Arthur and preprare for the siege.  Your command has been transferred to General Kuropatkin's newly forming Army Group in Siberia.  The aim is to relieve the siege of Port Arthur by a land campaign from the Russian Far East.
dst: 您须撤入旅顺口并准备坚守。您的指挥权已转交给库罗帕特金将军正在西伯利亚组建的新集团军群。目标是从俄国远东发动一场陆上战役，解除旅顺口之围。

src: You are to return home to a grateful nation!
dst: 您将回到家园，受到感恩的国民迎接！

src: You are to take command of Italian Legions transferred from Ethiopia to Spain as they join the Axis' crusade against the world's communists, 1937-1944.
dst: 你将指挥从埃塞俄比亚调往西班牙的意大利军团，加入轴心国讨伐世界共产主义的“圣战”，1937—1944年。

src: You became part of the conspiracy!
dst: 您成了密谋活动的一员！

src: You begin your campaign as a Kriegsmarine lieutenant. Naval battles await you, battles with only ground units, battles where your units simply have to survive, etc. In short, it is a campaign with all kinds of battles.
dst: 你以一名德国海军中尉的身份开始战役。等待你的是海战、只有地面部队参加的战斗、你的部队只须生存下来的战斗等等。简而言之，这是一场包含各种类型战斗的战役。

src: You better resign and open a "friterie/frituur".
dst: 你最好辞职，去开一家“薯条店”。

src: You better ressign and open a "gaufre" shop.
dst: 你最好辞职，去开一家“gaufre”店。

src: You broke through the Soviet defense, pushed the enemy far back, and overran the approaches to Leningrad. The bogged down Tigers were saved before the enemy could have destroyed or captured them.
dst: 你突破苏军防御，把敌人击退很远，席卷了通往列宁格勒的要道。陷入泥泞的虎式在敌军摧毁或缴获之前就被救了出来。

src: You can also become part of the conspiracy called Polska Organizacja Wojskowa.
dst: 您也可以加入名为「波兰军事组织」的密谋。

src: You can be proud of your men.  As your commanding general died on a snow bank - his deputy took command to salvage the situation as best he could.  We left many of our sons in the snow drifts so desperate was the battle.
dst: 你可以为你的部下感到骄傲。你们的指挥官阵亡在一处雪堆上——他的副手接过指挥，尽己所能挽回局面。这场战斗如此绝望，我们把许多子弟留在了雪堆里。

dst: 本场景中你可以购买 1 个新单位。

src: You can buy one unit in this scenario.
dst: 本场景中你可以购买一个单位。

dst: 本场景中你最多可以购买 2 个新单位。

dst: 本场景中你最多可以购买 3 个新单位。

src: You can buy up to 3 new units in this scenario. It is recommended to buy a fighter and do some upgrades.
dst: 本场景中您最多可购买3个新单位。建议购买一架战斗机并进行一些升级。

src: You can buy up to 4 new units in this scenario.
dst: 本场景中你最多可以购买 4 个新单位。

src: You can choose to be assigned either to defend our "provincias de ultramar" in the Caribbean (Spanish West Indies) or the ones in the Pacific (Spanish East Indies).
dst: 您可以选择被派往保卫我们在加勒比（西属西印度群岛）或太平洋（西属东印度群岛）的「海外省份」。

src: You can choose to command the forces at disposal of the Ist Army Corps ("I Corps d'Armée") to provide it support to defend the Canal Albert line and the Eben Emael fort.
dst: 你可以选择指挥第1军（“I Corps d'Armée”）麾下的部队，支援其防守阿尔贝运河一线和埃本-埃马尔要塞。

src: You can decide your next destination; the emperor has given you this golden opportunity.  By taking the Wake Island flag, your next destination will be the attack on the US base in the Philippines.  On the other hand, if you take the Hong Kong flag, your next destination will be the South of China, with Hong Kong and Macao as your main objectives. Taking the Dutch flag, you will go to fight in the Dutch East Indies.
dst: 您可以决定下一个目的地；天皇把这个千载难逢的机会交给了您。夺取威克岛的旗帜，您的下一个目标就是进攻美国在菲律宾的基地。另一方面，如果您夺取香港的旗帜，您的下一个目标就是华南，以香港和澳门为主要目标。夺取荷兰国旗，您将前往荷属东印度作战。

src: You can deploy 13 ground units in this scenario.
dst: 本场景中你可部署13支地面单位。

src: You can deploy 5 ground units and your air unit(s) to help out II.Btn/24.Res.Inf.Rgt. You will be given the opportunity to deploy the rest of your units later in the scenario.
dst: 您可以部署5个地面单位和您的空军单位，前去支援第24预备步兵团第2营。在场景后期，您将有机会部署其余单位。

src: You can deploy only ground units
You can deploy only ground units.
You can deploy only naval units.
You can deploy only your 2 Carriers. This is an air battle.
dst: 你只能部署你的2艘航母。这是一场空战。

src: You can deploy your carrier so your planes can support the attack and off course your Flagship, but they must stay away from the islands. There are many enemy submarines and some huge canons. General staff sends a special unit of Branderburgers under your command . You have to be fast before enemy Battleships approach. From our reports enemy airforce is weak.
dst: 你可以部署航空母舰让舰载机支援进攻，当然还有你的旗舰，但它们必须远离这些岛屿。那里有许多敌方潜艇和一些巨型火炮。总参谋部派了一支勃兰登堡部队特别单位归你指挥。敌方战列舰逼近前你必须速战速决。据我方报告，敌方空军很弱。

dst: 你可以对中部集团军群作战：

dst: 您可以回顾自己辉煌的军旅生涯了，将军。

dst: 您可以将它命名为「机枪分队」，或简称「重机枪分队」。

dst: 本场景内你无法购买或升级单位，而且敌军将先行动！

dst: 本场景中你不能购买单位。

dst: 本场景中你无法在海上部署伞兵。

dst: 你不能在海上部署伞兵！

dst: 你无法在海上部署伞兵。

dst: 您不能在海上部署伞兵！

dst: 本场景中你无法部署飞机。你无法建造或修复设施/格。

dst: 本场景中您无法部署您的舰船！

src: You can not depoly your paratroopers at sea.
dst: 你无法在海上部署伞兵。

src: You can not depoly your planes in this scenario. All airfields have been damaged in the fightes or have been blown up by the nationalists.
dst: 本场景中你无法部署飞机。所有机场都已在此前的战斗中受损，或被民族主义者炸毁。

dst: 本场景中你无法使用伞兵！

dst: 本场景中你只能购买意大利单位。

dst: 您只能从伊斯梅利亚港（六边形18,23）和塞拉皮乌姆港（六边形20,30）渡过苏伊士运河。

src: You can only deploy ground units in this scenario and the Exit Hex can only used by units in rail transport, so embark as much of your units as possible in rail transport at scenario start!
dst: 本场景你只能部署地面单位，且撤退格只能由处于铁路运输状态的单位使用，所以在场景开始时尽可能多地让你的部队进入铁路运输状态！

src: You can only deploy ground units.
You can play all 47 scenarios or a lot less as this is a modular campaign.
dst: 你可以玩全部47个场景，也可以少玩很多，因为这是一个模块化战役。

src: You can purchase only air units.
You can refuse and go to the POW camp together with your soldiers. There you will take care of them, and wait for the fall of both Empires.
dst: 您可以拒绝，并与您的士兵们一同前往战俘营。在那里您将照料他们，并等待两个帝国的垮台。

src: You can refuse, abandon the troops and become part of the conspiracy called Polska Organizacja Wojskowa.
dst: 您可以拒绝，抛弃部队，并加入名为「波兰军事组织」的密谋。

src: You can take command of all British and American forces in the area, but aslo this time, French troops will not take orders from you.
dst: 你可指挥该地区所有英美部队，但这一次法军部队仍不受你指挥。

src: You can take only a few days rest. We own information’s that the Commonwealth troops prepare a new line of defense at the Egyptian/Palestinian border at Rafa. Your troops are intended to cross the Sinai and drive the enemy out from Palestine.
dst: 你只能休息几天。我们得到情报，英联邦部队正在埃及/巴勒斯坦边境的拉法准备一条新防线。你的部队将穿越西奈，把敌人赶出巴勒斯坦。

src: You can win this scenario by either capturing the six fortresses on the map and the cities of Lier and Mechelen, or by exiting 6 units in the NW corner of the map. These six units enter the city of Antwerp, which is sufficient to make the Belgian Army give up the city.
dst: 您可以通过以下任一方式赢得本场景：夺取地图上的六座要塞以及利尔和梅赫伦两座城市，或者让6个单位从地图西北角离开地图。这六个单位进入安特卫普城，就足以迫使比利时陆军放弃该城。

src: You can't built at this scenario
You can't built at this scenario.
You can't built in this scenario.
You can't built or repair at this scenario.
dst: 本场景中你不能建造或修理。

dst: 你无法在海上部署伞兵。

dst: 你不能部署战列舰或大型航母。

src: You can't deploy your marines at this scenario. Only your Branderburgers and your Recon paras can take part at this battle and off course your ships and your airplanes.
dst: 本场景中你无法部署海军陆战队。只有你的勃兰登堡部队和你的侦察伞兵能参加这场战斗，当然还有你的舰艇和飞机。

src: You can't let that happen. Conquering the old capital of King David would have a huge impact on the morale of our army, and would allow us to control all the valley of the Jordan. The Turks have been able to reorganize their troops since their defeat at Megiddo, so this time they'll be able to give you some support. However, don't be overconfident. The British are still a formidable enemy. Get ready, General, and good luck!
dst: 您不能让他得逞。攻克大卫王的古都会对我军士气产生巨大影响，还能让我们控制整个约旦河谷。自米吉多之败以来，土耳其人已经能够重整部队，因此这一次他们能为您提供一些支援。不过，切勿过度自信。英国仍然是一个可怕的敌人。做好准备，将军，祝您好运！

src: You can't resuply or upgrade your units.
dst: 你不能补充给养或升级你的单位。

src: You can't swap attachements from marines to planes.
dst: 你无法将海军陆战队的挂载换到飞机上。

src: You can't swap attachements from planes to marines.
dst: 你无法将飞机的挂载换到海军陆战队上。

src: You cannot imagine what it meant to my comrades and me, when we finally received our orders to leave our positions at Verdun. Any place on God's Great Earth is better than this bone mill that has grinded many a brave man during the last months. Achim was the last of us to die at Verdun. You know, we went to Gymnasium together, long ago in happier times before the war. I still remember how we talked about our future plans in the school yard on our graduation day. Now, Achim's future has already become past. A sniper's bullet pierced his handsome face when he lit a cigarette. He died in my arms on an otherwise particularly quiet day at the front.
dst: 您无法想象，当我们终于接到离开凡尔登阵地的命令时，这对我和战友们意味着什么。上帝的大地上，任何地方都好过这座在过去几个月里碾碎了许多勇士的绞肉机。阿希姆是我们中最后一个死在凡尔登的人。您知道，我们曾一起上中学，那是很久以前、战争开始前的快乐时光。我至今还记得毕业那天，我们在校园里谈论各自未来计划的情景。如今，阿希姆的未来已经变成了过去。当他点燃一支香烟时，一颗狙击手的子弹洞穿了他英俊的面庞。他死在我的怀里，而那一天前线原本格外平静。

src: You command a motley horde of German paratroopers and mountain troops (soon to be joined by sailors from sunk ships), who have slight numerical advantage over the enemy. Our destroyer group is an intimidating force.
dst: 你指挥着一支杂牌大军——德国伞兵与山地兵（很快还会有沉舰幸存的水兵加入），对敌人略有数量优势。我们的驱逐舰群是一支令人忌惮的力量。

src: You command the Turkish forces and you must stop the Greek offensive; their forces are more organized and trained, but your position is strong.
dst: 您指挥土耳其军队，必须阻止希腊人的攻势；他们的部队组织更严密、训练更有素，但您的阵地十分坚固。

src: You command the mobile pincer ordered to capture and hold all the southeastern approaches to Warsaw. The inner city is not of your concern, just break through the peripheral defense. Isolate the defenders and leave them to your supporting infantry.
dst: 你指挥执行机动钳形攻势，奉命夺取并扼守华沙所有东南方向的接近地。内城不归你管，只需突破外围防御，将守军孤立，交给支援步兵去解决。

src: You control only your core units.
dst: 你只能控制你的核心单位。

src: You could not achieve your goals, the mission was a failure!
dst: 你未能达成目标，任务失败！

src: You could not achieve your goals, the mission was a failure! You had your chance, we need commander who successfully complete orders. This was your last combat mission!
dst: 你未能达成目标，任务失败了！你曾有过机会，我们需要能圆满完成命令的指挥官。这是你的最后一次战斗任务！

src: You could not inflict enough damage to the weak German units. They could retreat and create a new defensive line. It will be a huge challenge to break through their lines now. The war will last longer as it should.
dst: 你未能对虚弱的德军单位造成足够伤害。他们得以撤退并建立起一道新的防线。现在要突破他们的防线将是一项艰巨挑战。这场战争将比它本该持续的时间更长。

src: You could not manage a breakout. There was a chance to trap the Germans. But now this is impossible. The germans sent in reinforcements. We are still in difficult terrain.
dst: 你未能实现突围。本来有机会围困德国人。但现在这已不可能。德国人派来了增援。我们仍然身处艰难地形之中。

src: You could not prevent the scuttling of a large part of the Vichy French fleet. Mussolini will have to do with less ships than he had hoped for.
dst: 你没能阻止维希法国舰队的很大一部分被凿沉。墨索里尼拿到的舰船将比他期望的少。

src: You could not save all airfields, but this is not your fault. Our reconaissance has completely failed. Although we have lost several planes, we still enjoy air superiority, because we were able to destroy many Luftwaffe fighters.
dst: 你未能保住所有机场，但这不是你的错。我们的侦察完全失败了。尽管我们损失了数架飞机，我们仍然享有空中优势，因为我们得以摧毁许多德国空军战斗机。

src: You could not save the valuable French ships for our Kriegsmarine, but the other loot in the depots of Alexandria is plentiful. Next stop, the Suez Canal!
dst: 你没能为我们的德国海军保住那些宝贵的法国军舰，但亚历山大的仓库里其他战利品非常丰厚。下一站，苏伊士运河！

src: You could once again save valuable units for our Kriegsmarine and also the other loot in the depots of Alexandria is plentiful. Next stop, the Suez Canal!
dst: 你再一次为我们的德国海军保住了宝贵的舰艇，而且亚历山大仓库里的其他战利品也非常丰厚。下一站，苏伊士运河！

src: You could say that I was lucky, because I could return to our own lines. But that was the last time that I was engaged in battle. I was relieved from command due to my failure, and Kolchak sent me to maintain order in Chita, near the border with China and Mongolia. That meant that, when our army was finally defeated a few months later, it was easy to gather as many sympathizers as I could find and lead them safely to China, where the Bolsheviks couldn't harm them. After Ekaterinburg, I had a chance to redeem myself.
dst: 您可以说我算幸运，因为我回到了己方战线。但那是我最后一次参战。由于失败，我被解除了指挥权，高尔察克派我去靠近中蒙边境的赤塔维持秩序。这意味着，几个月后我军最终战败时，我可以轻易地尽可能多召集同情者，把他们安全地带到中国，在那里布尔什维克无法伤害他们。叶卡捷琳堡之后，我有了一个弥补自己的机会。

src: You couldn't force the Allies back into Tunisia, so it's impossible for us to attack with the few units we have.
dst: 您未能迫使盟军退回突尼斯，因此凭我们现有的少量部队不可能发起进攻。

src: You couldn't force the Allies back into Tunisia, so it's impossible to attack with the few units we have.
dst: 您未能迫使盟军退回突尼斯，因此凭我们现有的少量部队不可能发起进攻。

src: You couldn't force the Allies back into Tunisia, so it's impossible to defend Alexandria and Tunisia with the few units we have.
dst: 您未能迫使盟军退回突尼斯，因此凭我们现有的少量部队不可能守住亚历山大和突尼斯。

src: You couldn't stop the Bulgarian offensive. Now, even Istambul is in danger. Fortunately, you are among the many Ottoman casualties, so you won't live to see the fall of your empire.
dst: 您没能阻止保加利亚的进攻。如今，连伊斯坦布尔也岌岌可危。幸运的是，您是众多奥斯曼阵亡者之一，所以您无须活着看到帝国的覆灭。

src: You couldn´t conquer your objectives in time and after a British counterattack you suffered too many losses. The German army is now incapable of any further resistance. The campaign is over.
dst: 您未能及时攻克您的目标，而且在英军反击之后，您遭受了过多损失。德军如今已无力再作任何抵抗。战役结束了。

src: You deserve a promotion! You have managed to completely stop the German advance and eliminate the created bridgehead in a fast and brilliant counterattack. The German 56th Division has suffered heavy casualties.
dst: 您应该得到晋升！您以迅速而出色的反击彻底阻止了德军前进，并消除了其建立的桥头堡。德军第56师伤亡惨重。

src: You deserve a rest after so much action. But don't get used to it. We'll need you soon on the Macedonian front. Things aren't going that well there. We haven't suffered any important defeat yet but, on the other hand, the French and British forces have taken the initiative since January, and we have only been able to defend our positions, without making any important advance.
dst: 经历了这么多征战，您理应休整。但别就此习惯。我们很快又需要您到马其顿战线去。那里的局势不太妙。我们尚未遭受任何重大失败，但另一方面，法英军队自1月以来已掌握了主动权，我们只能守住阵地，未能取得任何重要进展。

src: You destroyed a dangerous attack by French panzers and now you must occupy Peronne and attack along the river Somme towards Abbeville.
dst: 你挫败了法军装甲部队的一次危险进攻，如今必须占领佩罗讷，并沿索姆河向阿布维尔进攻。

src: You did it !!! Arrius is defeated - now L. Gellius Poplicola is waiting ...
dst: 你做到了！！！阿里乌斯已被击败——现在等着我们的是卢基乌斯盖利乌斯波普利科拉 ...

src: You did it !!! Cossinius is beaten. Now praetor Publius Varinius number is up !!!!
dst: 你做到了！！！科西尼乌斯被打败了。接下来就轮到法官普布利乌斯瓦里尼乌斯了！！！！

src: You did it !!! Furius is beaten. Who is next?
dst: 你做到了！！！富里乌斯被打败了。下一个是谁？

src: You did it !!! Gellius is defeated - now it is time to move again with Spatacus ...
dst: 你做到了！！！盖利乌斯已被击败——现在是时候与斯巴达克斯再次行动了 ...

src: You did it !!! Gellius is defeated, now is the time for Crixus obsequies and then go further north to freedom ...
dst: 你做到了！！！盖利乌斯已被击败，现在是时候为克里克索斯举行葬礼，然后继续北上奔向自由 ...

src: You did it !!! Lentus is defeated - now we turn south heading to Poplicola and Arrius ...
dst: 你做到了！！！伦图卢斯已被击败——现在我们转向南方，直取波普利科拉与阿里乌斯 ...

src: You did it !!! Manlius and Longinus are defeated, now we can cross over the Alps !
dst: 你做到了！！！曼利乌斯与隆吉努斯已被击败，现在我们可以翻越阿尔卑斯山了！

src: You did it !!! Nola burns and ye escape in time ...
dst: 你做到了！！！诺拉燃起大火，你们及时脱身 ...

src: You did it !!! Nuceria is conquered and a part of Varinius Troops are destroyed.
dst: 你做到了！！！努凯里亚被攻下，瓦里尼乌斯的一部分部队被歼灭。

src: You did it !!! Picentia ist conquered and Varinius Troops have been nearly exterminated.
dst: 你做到了！！！皮琴蒂亚被攻下，瓦里尼乌斯的部队几乎被全歼。

src: You did it !!! The first battle is over. Now it's time for a counterstrike ...
dst: 你做到了！！！第一战结束了。现在该反击了 ...

src: You did it !!! The road to the south is now free. Let's go for The Boot of the world ...
dst: 你做到了！！！南下之路已经畅通。让我们去拿下那个世界的「靴子」 ...

src: You did it !!! The way into the interior of the country is open now. On to the farms with the fattened Pigs...
dst: 你做到了！！！通向内陆的道路已经打开。向那些养着肥猪的农庄进军...

src: You did it !!! You have rescued the Celts. But now there is staying a new strong opponent in front of you. Pompeius is back in the Country. Get armed !!!
dst: 你做到了！！！你救出了凯尔特人。但如今眼前还挡着一个强敌。庞培回到了国内。拿起武器吧！！！

src: You did it !!! Your flight was successful !!!
dst: 你做到了！！！你成功脱身了！！！

src: You did it well Herr Kapitanleutnant!!!
dst: 你干得很出色，海军上尉阁下！！！

src: You did it well Herr Korvettenkapitan!!!
dst: 您干得很棒，海军少校阁下！！！

src: You did it well Herr Leutnant!!!
You did it well Herr Oberleutnant!!!
You did it well Kapitan!!! You gave to British another good lesson.
dst: 你干得很好，海军上校！！！你给英国人又上了一堂好课。

src: You did it well Kommodore!!! Ireland will now stop (even secretly) supporting the British with volunteers.
dst: 您干得很棒，海军准将！！！爱尔兰如今将停止（甚至是暗中）以志愿者支持英国。

src: You did it well Kommodore!!! Our marines are safe.
dst: 你干得很好，海军准将！！！我们的海军陆战队安全了。

src: You did it well Kommodore!!! You have to return to Germany.
dst: 您干得很好，海军准将！！！您必须返回德国。

src: You did it well Kommodore!!!Our fleet can resupply.
dst: 你干得很好，海军准将！！！我们的舰队可以补给了。

src: You did not meet your objectives, but you were able to hold your ground against much heavier than expected enemy forces. Well done. More of our troops are reaching Tunisia every day. Time for a new attack.
dst: 你未能达成目标，但你顶住了远超预期的敌军兵力守住了阵地。干得好。我们的部队每天都在源源抵达突尼斯。是时候发起新的进攻了。

src: You did not prevent the scuttling of most of the Vichy French fleet. Hitler will be furious. What does he have to tell Mussolini?
dst: 你没能阻止维希法国舰队的大部分被凿沉。希特勒会暴怒。他拿什么去跟墨索里尼交代？

src: You did not prevent the scuttling of the Vichy French fleet. Hitler will be furious. What does he have to tell Mussolini?
dst: 你没能阻止维希法国舰队被凿沉。希特勒会暴怒。他拿什么去跟墨索里尼交代？

src: You did not succeed in eliminating the US beachhead. US forces have outflanked us by breaking through our lines near Coutance. Your mission is to push West to the shore in order to restore the front line and cut off the US divisions that have broken through. Do not fail us again!
dst: 你未能肃清美军滩头阵地。美军在库唐斯附近突破我军防线，迂回到我们侧后。你的任务是向西推进到海岸，以恢复战线并切断已突破的美军各师。别再让我们失望了！

src: You did well. One of the invincible fortresses is captured! The offensive will be continued by other troops.
dst: 您干得不错。那些所谓坚不可摧的要塞中已有一座被攻克！攻势将由其他部队继续推进。

src: You don't need to guard your starting VH.
dst: 你不需要守住你起始的胜利格。

src: You don't need to to deploy ground units.
You exceeded all expectations. You are now Kapitan zur See!!!
dst: 你超出了所有人的预期。你现在是海军上校了！！！

src: You failed in your mission. Dismiss!

You failed in your mission. We are far away from our goals. However the german tanks are a little excuse. You can be lucky that we will hold onto you. But you should know that a further failure will cost you your job.
dst: 你未能完成任务。我们距离目标还很远。不过德军的坦克算是小小的借口。你该庆幸我们还会继续留用你。但你应该知道，再一次失败就会让你丢掉职位。

src: You failed to achieve a breakthrough. And because of the flooding of the complete area around the Yzer, it is impossible to continue further offensive actions in this sector of the front. Also the attacks of 6th Army have failed to achieve a breakthrough.
dst: 您未能实现突破。而且由于伊泽尔河周边整个地区被淹没，这一前线地段已无法继续采取进一步的进攻行动。第6集团军的进攻也未能实现突破。

src: You failed to achieve your objectives. Luckily the Germans are short of reserve forces and have evacuated the Gustav line in order to avoid being cut-off. It is only a matter of days before Rome is in our hands.
dst: 你未能达成目标。所幸德军预备兵力匮乏，为避免被切断而放弃了古斯塔夫防线。罗马落入我军之手只是数日之内的事。

src: You failed to break through even the first Russian defensive lines. After receiving the news of the Allied invasion of Sicily, as well as reports of impeding Soviet attacks on the Mius River and at Izyum, Hitler has decided to cancel Operation Zitadelle.
dst: 你连俄军第一道防线都未能突破。接到盟军入侵西西里的消息，以及苏军即将在米乌斯河和伊久姆发起进攻的报告后，希特勒决定取消“堡垒”行动。

src: You failed to close the encirclement around Smolensk. The Russian 16th, 19th and 20th Armies escaped and are now blocking the roads to Moscow. Reaching Moscow before winter sets in will be a tough job that is better left to more competent generals than you.
dst: 你未能合拢对斯摩棱斯克的包围。俄军第16、第19和第20集团军逃脱，如今正堵着通往莫斯科的道路。要在入冬前抵达莫斯科将是一项艰巨任务，最好交给比你更能干的将军。

src: You failed to hold the perimeter of the Falciu bridgehead. Report in Moskva!
dst: 你没能守住法尔丘桥头堡的外围。到莫斯科报到！

src: You failed to take your objectives. Your Kavallerie Division is taken out of the line and is sent to the Eastern Front. The 2nd Bavarian Corps of the new Armee Groupe Fabeck will take over your sector of the front.
dst: 您未能达成目标。您的骑兵师被撤出战线，派往东线。新组建的法贝克集团军群的巴伐利亚第2军将接管您所在的前线地段。

src: You failed too in breaking up the pocket? Are you serious? You decieve all our hopes.
dst: 你也没能打破包围圈？你是认真的吗？你辜负了我们所有的期望。

src: You feel remorse for the death of these thousands?  Sorry, I don't understand what you mean...
dst: 您为这数千人的死亡感到悔恨？抱歉，我不明白您的意思……

src: You fiercely broke through the Soviet defense, pushed the enemy far back, and overran the approaches to Leningrad. Most notably, the bogged down Tigers were saved before the enemy could have even seen them.
dst: 你凶猛突破苏军防御，把敌人击退很远，并席卷了通往列宁格勒的要道。最值得一提的是，那些陷入泥泞的虎式坦克在敌人发现之前就被救了出来。

src: You fought bravely and with honour but the battle is lost. This is not only the end of the Spanish rule over the Philippines but also the sunset of the Spanish empire.
dst: 您作战英勇而光荣，但战斗还是输了。这不仅是西班牙对菲律宾统治的终结，也是西班牙帝国的落日。

src: You fought valiantly, but the Bulgarian Army finally overcame your troops. We'll have to retreat to our defences at the Çatalca line. I hope you'll do it better there.
dst: 您英勇作战，但保加利亚军队最终还是击败了您的部队。我们将不得不退到恰塔尔贾防线的防御工事。希望您在那里能打得更好。

src: You get 2500pp and should upgrade your units to the most modern equipment available.
dst: 你获得2500pp，应把部队升级到现有最现代化的装备。
您需要在以下两者之间作出选择：

src: You go with Krixos and the Celts. On to glorius Battles...
dst: 你随克里克索斯与凯尔特人同行。走向荣耀的战斗吧...

src: You go with Spartacus. On to the North...
dst: 你随斯巴达克斯同行。向北进军...

src: You have 1000 prestige available to build up your army.
dst: 您有 1000 点威望可用于组建您的军队。

src: You have a company of Luftlande-Sturm available. Use them wisely, be wary of enemy fighter planes and AA units. (No other paratroopers can fly the plane. This is a mistake in efile, but I kinda like it, because it simulates the usage of FJ units after Crete.)
dst: 你有一个空降突击连可用。善加运用，并提防敌方战斗机和防空单位。（没有其他伞兵能驾驶这架飞机。这是 efile 里的一个错误，但我还挺喜欢它，因为它模拟了克里特岛之后空降猎兵部队的使用方式。）

src: You have accomplished your mission admirably and we can now start pushing Maceo's troops out of Western Cuba.
dst: 您出色地完成了任务，我们现在可以开始将马塞奥的部队逐出古巴西部。

src: You have accomplished your mission brilliantly and we can now start pushing Maceo's troops out of Western Cuba.
dst: 您出色地完成了任务，我们现在可以开始将马塞奥的部队逐出古巴西部。

src: You have accomplished your mission, but your lack of speed has allowed the enemy armies to escape.  It is possible that the campaign against the British and French could go on as long as the last war.  Herr General, we will, no doubt, call on you again for your services.
dst: 你完成了任务，但你的行动迟缓让敌军得以逃脱。对英法的战事有可能像上次大战那样长期拖延下去。将军阁下，毫无疑问，我们还会再次请你效力。

src: You have achieved a Great Victory, Herr General. You have crippled the British Expeditionary Force, and the French have surrendered. Very good.
dst: 你取得了一场大捷，将军阁下。你重创了英国远征军，法国也已投降。很好。

src: You have achieved all objectives, the mission was a complete success. Good work!
dst: 你已完成所有目标，任务大获成功。干得好！

src: You have achieved all the goals of the assault, however the enemy is showing a extremely hard resistance into the city... We must change our initial plans, now we will try to surround Madrid, by cutting their communications with the remain Republican areas.
dst: 您已达成此次进攻的全部目标，然而敌军正在城内表现出极其顽强的抵抗……我们必须改变最初的计划，现在我们将设法包围马德里，切断它与其余共和区之间的交通联络。

src: You have achieved all the goals of the assault, however the enemy is showing us a extremely hard resistance. Now, we are going to change the plans. Let's go to surround Madrid...
dst: 您已达成此次进攻的全部目标，然而敌军正表现出极其顽强的抵抗。现在，我们要改变计划。让我们去包围马德里……

src: You have again dealt a blow to the Americans, but they still refuse to receive our envoy. We have however been able to influence the American press to write about our peace offer, and a debate has started in America.
dst: 您再次给美国人以重击，但他们仍拒绝接见我方的使者。不过我们已能影响美国报界刊登我方的和平提议，美国国内也掀起了一场辩论。

src: You have again stopped very powerfull forces attempting to conquer your positions ! Meanwhile, Manstein has moved up troops and armoured divisions to launch a counterattack that will decide the fait of sixth army and with it the future of our empire.
dst: 您再次挡住了试图攻占您阵地的强大敌军！与此同时，曼施坦因已调上部队与装甲师，即将发动一场反攻，此战将决定第六集团军的命运，也决定我们帝国的未来。

src: You have ashamed the Red Army, comrade. The fascists are pouring into the Crimea as we speak. Report in Moskva!
dst: 你让红军蒙羞了，同志。法西斯此刻正涌入克里米亚。到莫斯科报到！

src: You have astounded the High Command with your capture of the high ground!!! We are now in a fantastic position to push the Hun back into Germany!!!
dst: 您夺取高地之举令最高统帅部大为震惊！！！现在我们正处于绝佳的态势，可以把德国佬赶回德国去！！！

src: You have beaten back a ferocious German attack and withstood their Mustard Gas, this may well be the turning point in this war!! Well done Commander!!
dst: 您击退了一次凶猛的德军进攻，并顶住了他们的芥子气，这很可能就是这场战争的转折点！！干得好，指挥官！！

src: You have become a national hero in Estonia, but the war does not end here...
dst: 您已成为爱沙尼亚的民族英雄，但战争并未就此结束……

src: You have been awarded with the Order of the Rising Sun 3rd Class.
dst: 您已被授予三等旭日章。

src: You have been cheating! Sorry, no prototype! Choose again!
dst: 您作弊了！抱歉，没有原型机！请重新选择！

src: You have been defeated by the Portuguese.  They will now be able to conquer Masasi and to make contact with the British forces of the Lindi area.  Surrounded on all sides by enemy troops the Germans will have to surrender. The campaign is over.
dst: 您已被葡萄牙人击败。他们现在将能够征服马萨西，并与林迪地区的英军取得联系。德军被敌军四面包围，将不得不投降。战役结束了。

src: You have been defeated. The bridge is intact, allowing the british to supply normally.
dst: 您被打败了。桥梁完好无损，使英军得以正常补给。

src: You have been given the privelage to lead the mighty offensive to enable Germany to reclaim all the territory that rightfully belongs to the Fatherland.
dst: 你获此殊荣，领导这场浩大的攻势，使德国收复一切本属祖国的领土。

src: You have been incapable of stopping the French. Now most of Elsass is in danger. It'll be wiser to retreat behind the Rhein while we try to outflank our enemies with a counterattack in Lothringen.
dst: 您没能挡住法军。如今阿尔萨斯大部分地区已岌岌可危。明智的做法是撤到莱茵河后方，同时我们设法在洛林发起反攻来包抄敌人。

src: You have been ordered to become president of our most famous military academy and teach our future officers. The war is over for you!
dst: 你已被任命为我们最著名的军校的校长，教导我们未来的军官。对你来说，战争已经结束了！

src: You have been promoted to the rank of Major.  You still remain in command of the 1st regiment.  However, HQ is prepared to allocate more resources to your command.
dst: 您已被晋升为少校军衔。您仍然指挥着第1团。不过，司令部已准备向您的指挥部分配更多资源。

src: You have been provided the best equipment and men from the German army but the SS have provided you with uniforms for your march across Europe.
dst: 你获得了德国陆军最精良的装备与士兵，而党卫军则为你横穿欧洲的进军提供了制服。

src: You have been relieved of command, the front is broken!
dst: 你已被解除指挥权，前线已经崩溃！

src: You have been too slow! Now when winter comes to our defensive positions, it will be very weak and we won't be able to resist the Soviet counterattack. We'll be forced to peace negotiations and surely we'll have to cede much of the territory we had taken from the Soviets.
dst: 您行动太慢了！如今当冬天来临时，我们的防御阵地将十分薄弱，我们将无法抵挡苏军的反攻。我们将被迫进行和平谈判，而且必定要割让我们从苏俄手中夺来的大片领土。

src: You have been too slow! We couldn't conquer our objectives in time and now the Berber counterattacks are about to expel us from the beachheads. The whole operation has been a failure! We'll be forced into pact with Abd el-Krim and give up our interests in northern Morocco.
dst: 您的动作太慢了！我们没能及时攻下目标，如今柏柏尔人的反攻眼看就要把我们赶出滩头阵地。整场行动已经失败了！我们将被迫与阿卜杜·克里姆媾和，放弃我们在北摩洛哥的利益。

src: You have been unable to beat the enemy, and the British still threaten our lines. We'll retreat to Magersfontein, where hopefully we'll be able to stop them once and for all.
dst: 您未能击败敌人，英军仍在威胁我们的防线。我们将撤往马赫斯方丹，希望能在那里一劳永逸地挡住他们。

src: You have been unable to defeat the Greek Army. The consequences for Turkey will be terrible. The campaign can't go on.
dst: 您没能击败希腊军队。这对土耳其的后果将十分惨重。战役无法继续下去了。

src: You have brilliantly executed a controlled retreat from Narva, and HQ is pleased to promote you to the rank of Kolonel.  However, there is no time for celebration.  Pskov has fallen to the Bolsheviks.  Intelligence reports that the elite Latvian Riflemen division is moving toward Tartu and the Latvian border.  While the defense of Tallinn is organized, you must stop the Soviet froces from advancing along the south-eastern axis.
dst: 您出色地执行了从纳尔瓦的有序撤退，司令部欣然将您晋升为上校军衔。然而，没有时间庆祝了。普斯科夫已落入布尔什维克之手。情报报告称，精锐的拉脱维亚步枪兵师正朝塔尔图和拉脱维亚边境移动。在组织塔林防御的同时，您必须阻止苏军沿东南轴线推进。

src: You have captured Ziza and a great number of Turkish prisoners. However we have become aware of an offensive by marauding Arabs hellbent on revenge against the Turks. We could get caught up in this and have our push to Damascus halted. Your orders are to rearm your prisoners and defend Ziza!! It is imperitive that you hold all your positions!! Good Luck. (There is only 2 possible outcomes:- Brilliant Victory for holding your 3 Vic Hexs OR Loss for not holding them).
dst: 您已夺取济扎并俘获大批土耳其战俘。但我们得知，一群四处劫掠、一心要向土耳其人复仇的阿拉伯人正在发动进攻。我们可能被卷入其中，向大马士革的推进也会因此受阻。您的命令是重新武装您的战俘并守住济扎！！您必须守住所有阵地！！祝您好运。（只有两种可能的结果：守住3个胜利点获大捷，或者守不住而失败）。

src: You have captured the "kitchen", but are still fighting for the "living-room". The Soviets still hold some blocks on the eastern banks of the Volga...
dst: 你们已经攻占了"厨房"，但仍在为"客厅"而战。苏军依然控制着伏尔加河东岸的一些街区……

src: You have captured the British Expeditionary Force, and the French have surrendered.  You have achieved a great victory, Herr General.
dst: 你俘虏了英国远征军，法国也已投降。你取得了一场大捷，将军阁下。

src: You have captured the British Expeditionary Force, and the French have surrendered. You have achieved a great victory, Herr General. We accomplished in 6 weeks what could not be done in 4 years 25 years earlier. German troops will parade on the Champs Elysees!
dst: 你已俘虏英国远征军，法国也已投降。你取得了伟大的胜利，将军阁下。我们用了6周时间完成了25年前4年都无法完成的事。德军将在香榭丽舍大街阅兵！

src: You have chosen to Win and end game.
dst: 你选择了胜利并结束游戏。

src: You have chosen to continue playing on the Blitzkrieg path...
dst: 你选择继续以闪击战路线进行游戏……

src: You have chosen to continue playing on the Defending the Reich path...
dst: 你选择继续以保卫帝国路线进行游戏……

src: You have chosen to exit the campaign
You have chosen to go exit the campaign.
You have chosen to go the Greek Isles in Feb 1942.
dst: 您已选择于1942年2月前往希腊群岛。

src: You have chosen to go the Kanev in Russia. November 1943.
dst: 您已选择于1943年11月前往俄国的卡涅夫。

src: You have chosen to go to Caen in June 1944.
dst: 您已选择于1944年6月前往卡昂。

src: You have chosen to go to Zhirkovski in Russia. Dec 1942.
dst: 您已选择于1942年12月前往俄国的日尔科夫斯基。

src: You have chosen to go to the Crete in August 1943.
dst: 您已选择于1943年8月前往克里特岛。

src: You have chosen to go to the English Channel in September 1945.
dst: 您已选择于1945年9月前往英吉利海峡。

src: You have chosen to play Feodosiya. So be it!
dst: 你选择了费奥多西亚。那就这样吧！

src: You have chosen to play Kerch. So be it!
dst: 你选择了刻赤。那就这样吧！

src: You have chosen to play the Greater Europe campaign path!
dst: 您已选择游玩大欧洲战役路线！

src: You have chosen to play the classical Blitzkrieg! campaign path!
dst: 你选择了经典闪电战！战役路线。

src: You have chosen to play the traditional Blitzkrieg! campaign path!
dst: 您已选择游玩传统闪电战战役路线！

src: You have chosen to stay in command of 4th Kavalerie Division. The division's units are:
dst: 您选择继续指挥第4骑兵师。该师的单位如下：

src: You have command over the 40. and 13. Army. These troops are equipped with very new prototypes of SU tank destroyers. They could be useful for you.
dst: 你指挥着第40集团军与第13集团军。这些部队装备了非常新式的 SU 坦克歼击车原型车。它们对你或许有用。

src: You have conquered all of your objectives and now your troops menace Lindi. The British advance into the mainland has been temporarily stopped. Now the Germans are open to move south and escape from their enemies.
dst: 您已攻占了所有目标，现在您的部队威胁着林迪。英军向内陆的推进已暂时停止。现在德军可以向南转移，摆脱敌人。

src: You have crushed the UN forces with a smashing victory!  Now, we can continue with our advance towards Seoul.
dst: 你以一场猛烈的胜利粉碎了联合国军！现在，我们可以继续向汉城推进了。

src: You have dealt the Red Army a severe blow. Good work, Herr General.  It's time to close in on the Soviet capital. You're to lead an offensive at Novgorod on the Northern front where the General Staff wants to sever the communications between Moscow and Leningrad. Proceed with haste to your new assingment.
dst: 你们给了红军沉重的打击。干得好，将军阁下。是时候向苏联首都逼近了。你将指挥北线诺夫哥罗德的一场攻势，总参谋部希望在那里切断莫斯科与列宁格勒之间的交通线。请立即前往你的新岗位。

src: You have dealt the Red Army a severe blow. With our line shortened, we will be able to transfer some troops to Feldmarschall von Paulus at Stalingrad. Good work, Herr General.
dst: 你给了红军沉重一击。随着我方战线缩短，我们将能抽调部分部队支援斯大林格勒的冯·保卢斯陆军元帅。干得好，将军阁下。

src: You have dealt the Red Army a severe blow. With our line shortened, we will be able to transfer some troops to Feldmarschall von Paulus at Stalingrad. Good work, Herr General.  Meanwhile the Finns are opening a drive to recover the land they lost to the Bolsheviks in 1940.  Remembering your help in 1939 the Finns have specifically asked for you to lead their drive.  The General Staff has agreed to their request, so you and your men are to transfer North after a short period for rest and refitting.
dst: 您给了红军沉重一击。随着我们的战线缩短，我们将能把部分部队转交给斯大林格勒的冯·保卢斯元帅。干得好，将军阁下。与此同时，芬兰人正发起攻势，要夺回他们1940年失去给布尔什维克的土地。鉴于您1939年的援助，芬兰人特意请求由您来指挥他们的攻势。总参谋部已同意他们的请求，因此您和您的部下将在短暂休整和补充装备后调往北方。

src: You have decided to continue the war in China, and onto the Asian mainland.
dst: 您已决定在中国、进而在亚洲大陆继续战争。

src: You have decided to continue the war with our assault on the Philippines.  Get ready for the planned invasion on that US colony.
dst: 您已决定以进攻菲律宾来继续战争。请为这场针对美国殖民地的既定入侵做好准备。

src: You have decided to continue with the war in the Dutch East Indies.
dst: 您已决定在荷属东印度继续战争。

src: You have decided to fight in New Guinea.
dst: 您已决定在新几内亚作战。

src: You have decided to fight in the Battle of Brunete.
dst: 您已决定参加布鲁内特战役。

src: You have decided to go to the North Front.
dst: 您已决定前往北部战线。

src: You have decided to go to the POW camp and spend the rest of the war playing handball - a game that was recently invented.
dst: 您决定前往战俘营，在战争剩余的时间里打手球——一种新近发明的运动。

src: You have decided to take part in the Burma campaign.
dst: 您已决定参加缅甸战役。

src: You have defeated subleader Arrius. But his general "Gellius' comes to avenge him.
dst: 你已击败其副将阿里乌斯。但他的主帅「盖利乌斯」前来为他复仇。

src: You have defeated the British Army and saved de Wet, but Cronjé has surrendered anyway and you haven't been able to rout the Kakies. Soon they will launch a new attack, and I'm afraid that we won't have the strength to repel their invasion.
dst: 您击败了英军并救下了德韦特，但克罗涅还是投降了，而您也未能击溃英国佬。他们很快就会发动新的进攻，我担心我们将无力击退他们的入侵。

src: You have demonstrated great valor in the battle, leading the sorrounded corps out of the cauldron and stopping the German attack.
dst: 您在战斗中展现了极大的英勇，带领被包围的军冲出包围圈，并阻止了德军的进攻。

src: You have disappointed us. If you are not able to retreat fresh troops, less will you able to command troops in the offensive.
dst: 您让我们失望了。如果连未受重创的部队都撤不出来，您就更无法在进攻中指挥部队了。

src: You have disappointed us. If you are not able to stop the Germans in well prepared positions, less will you able to command troops in the offensive.
dst: 您让我们失望了。如果在准备充分的阵地上都无法挡住德军，您就更无法在进攻中指挥部队了。

src: You have disappointed us. If you are not able to successfully retreat some elite troops from the Ardennes, less will you able to command troops in a real battle.
dst: 你让我们失望了。如果你连从阿登成功撤出一些精锐部队都做不到，就更不可能在真正的战斗中指挥部队了。

src: You have disappointed us. If you are not able to temporally stop the German infantry, less will you able to fight the panzers.
dst: 您让我们失望了。如果您连暂时挡住德军步兵都做不到，就更不用说与装甲部队交手了。

src: You have disappointed us. You were not able to protect the retreat of the "17 Division d'Infanterie" and now not only the unit has been overran and does not longer exit but the German army is just behind us.
dst: 您让我们失望了。您未能掩护“第17步兵师”的撤退，如今该师不仅已被击溃、不复存在，德军还紧追在我们身后。

src: You have disgraced the People's Republic!  You are not worthy of commanding our comrades!  You will face a tribunal!
dst: 您使人民共和国蒙羞！您不配指挥我们的同志们！您将面临军事法庭的审判！

src: You have disgraced the People's Republic! You are not worthly of commanding our comrades! You will face a tribunal!
dst: 您玷污了人民共和国！您不配指挥我们的同志们！您将面对军事法庭！

src: You have disgraced the people's republic! You are not worthly of commanding our comrades! You will face a tribunal!
dst: 您玷污了人民共和国！您不配指挥我们的同志们！您将面对军事法庭！

src: You have done a good job!!!.

You have done a good job, comrade. The Bulgarians resisted more than we expected. However they are no match for our experienced veterans. You have been given orders to keep advancing towards their capitol of Sofia!
dst: 你干得不错，同志。保加利亚人的抵抗超出了我们的预期。但他们不是我们经验丰富的老兵的对手。你已接到命令，继续向他们的首都索菲亚推进！

src: You have done a good job, comrade. The fascists had more reserves than expected, including an entire tank division. Although you have shifted the frontline to the west, no breakthrough has taken place. On the other hand, the enemy was not able to destroy the Novorossiysk bridgehead either. We are locked in a stalemate. We will stop offensive actions and assemble forces for a new offensive that should commence after some months.

src: You have done a great job leading Mussolini's Afrika Korps in its conquest of the Middle East. Congratulations. This war can still be won!
dst: 你出色地率领墨索里尼的非洲军完成了对中东的征服。恭喜。这场战争我们仍能打赢！

src: You have done more than well, comrade. You have stopped the Rumanian advance towards Odessa. They have suffered tremendous losses already however they will be attacking soon again. Conditions on the fronts elsewhere, force us to pull your experienced division back from Odessa and to the Crimea. The garrison of Odessa will continue to resist!
dst: 你做得远不止是干得好，同志。你挡住了罗马尼亚人向敖德萨的推进。他们已经遭受了惨重损失，但很快会再次进攻。其他战线的局势，迫使我们把你经验丰富的师从敖德萨调回克里米亚。敖德萨守军将继续抵抗！

src: You have done very well on the Italian front.
dst: 你在意大利战线的表现非常出色。

src: You have done well Herr General. These factories will be available for our use now.
dst: 你干得好，将军阁下。这些工厂如今可归我们使用了。

src: You have executed quite well a controlled retreat from Narva, and HQ is pleased to promote you to the rank of Kolonel..  However, there is no time for celebration.  Pskov has fallen to the Bolsheviks.  Intelligence reports that the elite Latvian Riflemen division is moving toward Tartu and the Latvian border.  While the defense of Tallinn is organized, you must stop the Soviet froces from advancing along the south-eastern axis.
dst: 您相当出色地执行了从纳尔瓦的有序撤退，司令部欣然将您晋升为上校军衔。然而，没有时间庆祝了。普斯科夫已落入布尔什维克之手。情报报告称，精锐的拉脱维亚步枪兵师正朝塔尔图和拉脱维亚边境移动。在组织塔林防御的同时，您必须阻止苏军沿东南轴线推进。

src: You have failed and the British have had time to destroy the supplies that we were after. Now you must redeem yourself helping the other commandoes that are besieging the town of Kimberley.
dst: 您失败了，英军已有时间毁掉我们想夺取的那些补给。现在您必须戴罪立功，去支援正围攻金伯利城的其他突击队。

src: You have failed miserably.  With the loss of our surface fleet, England remains dominant on the high seas. Report for reassignment immediately!
dst: 你惨败了。随着我们水面舰队的损失，英格兰仍在公海上占据主导。立即报到接受重新安排！

src: You have failed to accomplish your task. Wehrmacht saved the situation and the Yugoslavian government may surrender at any minute, but everybody is laughing at the Hungarian army. Governor Horthy is very disappointed. You are relieved of your duties, General.
dst: 你未能完成任务。国防军挽救了局势，南斯拉夫政府随时可能投降，但所有人都在嘲笑匈牙利军队。霍尔蒂摄政王非常失望。将军，你被解职了。

src: You have failed to beat off the Russian relieve attempt and now hundreds of thousands Bolsheviks have escaped. Send your troops back North for the final assault on Moscow. And don't give me any excuses, I know the rasputitsa - the dreaded Fall rains - have set in. This will disrupt mobility but we do need to reach Moscow before the winter.
dst: 你未能击退俄国人的解围企图，如今数十万布尔什维克逃脱了。把你的部队调回北方，准备对莫斯科的最后突击。别给我找任何借口，我知道“泥泞季”——那可怕的秋雨——已经来了。这会影响机动，但我们必须在入冬前抵达莫斯科。

src: You have failed to capture your objective.  The Kavkaz Front command has ordered for your resignation.
dst: 您未能夺取目标。高加索方面军指挥部已下令您辞职。

src: You have failed to defend Egypt!! Now return home while we attempt to tidy up this mess!!
dst: 您未能守住埃及！！现在回家吧，让我们来收拾这个烂摊子！！

src: You have failed to do your duty, General. You penetrated the first Russian lines of defense, but the offensive stuck in the mud and the counterattack of the Red Army smashed our last reserves. We are losing this war. Bolsheviks will take over the whole country. Hungary will be under Communist rule for decades.
dst: 将军，你未能尽到职责。你突破了俄军第一道防线，但攻势陷于泥泞，红军的反攻粉碎了我们最后的预备队。我们正在输掉这场战争。布尔什维克将占领整个国家。匈牙利将处于共产党统治之下数十年。

src: You have failed to do your duty.....but we will give you another chance.
dst: 你未能尽到职责……但我们会再给你一次机会。

src: You have failed to drive the fascist enemy out of the Rostov region. Despite all our advantages you have failed...
dst: 你没能把法西斯敌军赶出罗斯托夫地区。尽管我们占尽优势，你还是失败了……

src: You have failed to make Allies to retreat in Tunisia, so it's impossible to defend Alexandria and Tunisia with the few units we have.
dst: 你未能迫使盟军在突尼斯撤退，因此仅凭我们手中这点部队，既守不住亚历山大，也守不住突尼斯。

src: You have failed to stop the French. Thank God that we could send our reserves, so the enemy invasion has been finally repelled. Now our borders are safe and we just have to wait until the Schlieffen Plan ends with our total victory. The war will be over before Christmas.
dst: 您未能挡住法军。感谢上帝，我们得以派出预备队，敌人的入侵终于被击退了。如今我们的边境安然无恙，只需等待冯·施里芬计划以我们的全胜收场。战争将在圣诞节前结束。

src: You have failed to surprise the liberals, who have retired in good order. Soon they will regroup, and our situation will become desperate.
dst: 您未能奇袭自由派，他们已井然有序地撤退。很快他们就会重新集结，我们的处境将变得令人绝望。

src: You have failed to to convince the Boii of our strength. Boiorix, now vanish into oblivion forever.
dst: 你未能让波伊人相信我们的实力。博伊奥里克斯，如今你就此湮没无闻吧。

src: You have failed to to convince the Boii of our strength. Teutobod, now vanish into oblivion forever.
dst: 你未能让波伊人相信我们的实力。条顿博德，如今你就此湮没无闻吧。

src: You have failed to to convince the Romans of our strength. Boiorix, now vanish into oblivion forever.
dst: 你未能让罗马人相信我们的实力。博伊奥里克斯，如今你就此湮没无闻吧。

src: You have failed to to convince the Romans of our strength. Teutobod, now vanish into oblivion forever.
dst: 你未能让罗马人相信我们的实力。条顿博德，如今你就此湮没无闻吧。

src: You have failed! We are lucky as the German pressure brought about a cease-fire before you could lose completely the entire Subcarpathia. The Governor needs your services no longer. Dismissed!
dst: 你失败了！我们很幸运，德军的压力促成了一次停火，使你不至于彻底丢掉整个下喀尔巴阡地区。摄政王不再需要你的效力。免职！

src: You have failed. Thousands of Marines are perishing because of your blunders...
dst: 你失败了。数千名海军陆战队员因为你的失误而牺牲……

src: You have fended off disaster, comrade.  The Poles conducted a flanking attack on Brody while our eyes were pointed only on getting to Lwow.  You stabilized the situation!
dst: 同志，您化解了一场灾难。当我们一心只盯着利沃夫时，波兰人对布罗迪发动了侧翼进攻。您稳住了局势！

src: You have finished the hypothetical path. Try now to discover other scenarios in the game...
dst: 您已完成这条假设路线。现在不妨去探索游戏中的其他场景……

src: You have gained satisfactory marks in this exercise.  Your superior officers believe you must employ more daring in cavalry maneuver, while maintaining infantry in strong defensive positions.  Nevertheless, you have been given a promotion to the rank of Major.
dst: 您在这次演习中取得了令人满意的成绩。您的上级军官认为，您必须在骑兵机动中更加大胆，同时让步兵坚守坚固的防御阵地。尽管如此，您已被晋升为少校军衔。

src: You have get to Wladiswostok by passing American and Japanese zones of occupation. No more fighting is needed! You are going home!!!
dst: 您必须穿过美国和日本的占领区抵达符拉迪沃斯托克。不再需要战斗了！您要回家了！！！

src: You have inflicted a heavy defeat on the rebels. You have earned you promotion to the rank of General.
dst: 您使叛军遭受沉重打击。您赢得了晋升为将军的资格。

src: You have inflicted a serious defeat on the rebels. You have earned you promotion to the rank of General.
dst: 您使叛军遭受惨败。您赢得了晋升为将军的资格。

src: You have inflicted a severe defeat on the rebels. You have earned you promotion to the rank of General.
dst: 您使叛军遭受惨败。您赢得了晋升为将军的资格。

src: You have inflicted great tank losses on the 5GTA and you held on to Kharkov. However, Russian advances North and South of the city force us to retreat to the Dnepr. Most of your forces are sent to France for rest and refit. Only a Kampfgruppe will remain on the Eastern front until the spring of 1944.
dst: 你给近卫第5坦克集团军造成了巨大的坦克损失，并守住了哈尔科夫。然而，俄军在该城南北两侧的推进迫使我们退往第聂伯河。你的大部分部队被派往法国休整和重新装备。只有一个战斗群会留在东线直到1944年春天。

src: You have inflicted great tank losses on the 5GTA. However, Russian advances to the North and South of us, force us to retreat to the Dnepr. Most of your forces are sent to France for rest and refit. Only a Kampfgruppe will remain on the Eastern front until the spring of 1944.
dst: 你给近卫第5坦克集团军造成了巨大的坦克损失。然而，俄国人在我们南北两侧的推进迫使我们退往第聂伯河。你的大部分部队被派往法国休整和重新装备。只有一个战斗群会留在东线直到1944年春天。

src: You have lost the battle! You hesitated too long and let the chance of a life-time slip away. Uman is now a spring-board for the Soviet assault. We have to withdraw... Your career is over. Even the favor you have in Budapest could not save your position.
dst: 你输掉了这场战役！你犹豫得太久，让一生难逢的机会白白溜走。乌曼如今成了苏军进攻的跳板。我们不得不撤退……你的军旅生涯结束了。就连你在布达佩斯的人脉也保不住你的职位。

src: You have lost the battle, but the Germans are able to win the war. While you were fighting, German troops have passed Tula and are heading towards Moskau now. We will need your help for the defense of Moskau.
dst: 你输掉了这场战斗，但德国人有可能赢得这场战争。在你作战期间，德军已越过图拉，如今正朝莫斯科进发。我们需要你的帮助来保卫莫斯科。
您已经输掉了这场战斗！

src: You have made an outstanding job stopping this fierce enemy attack. Unfortunately, at Kajmakchalan, east of your positions, the Serbians managed to break our lines, although with heavy losses. In order to avoid the risk of being encircled, you will have to retreat to the Crna Bend, north of Lerin, for regrouping.
dst: 您在阻止这场敌军凶猛进攻方面做得非常出色。不幸的是，在您阵地以东的卡伊马克恰兰，塞尔维亚人虽然损失惨重，还是突破了我们的防线。为了避免被合围的风险，您将不得不撤退到莱林以北的茨尔纳河湾进行整编。

src: You have managed to accomplish your mission and we can now start pushing Maceo's troops out of Western Cuba.
dst: 您成功完成了任务，我们现在可以开始将马塞奥的部队逐出古巴西部。

src: You have managed to contain the Germans and repeal most of their attacks. In spite of several attempts German infantrymen could not take Vinkt.
dst: 你成功遏制了德军，击退了他们的大部分进攻。尽管多次尝试，德军步兵仍无法攻下芬克特。

src: You have missed our best chance to crush Budionny's troops. He has managed to retreat to the east with minor losses and his army will still be a challenge for us in the future. We'll still be able to continue with our counteroffensive but I think that you should resign your command. You performed well in the past, but now you seem exhausted and for the good of our nation you must take a rest.
dst: 您错过了粉碎布琼尼部队的最佳时机。他以很小的损失成功向东撤退，他的部队将来仍会是我们的一大麻烦。我们的反攻仍可继续，但我认为您应当辞去指挥职务。您过去表现得很出色，但现在您似乎已精疲力竭，为了国家的利益，您必须休整一下。

src: You have not achieved your goals in this exercise.  Your superior officers believe you must employ more daring in cavalry maneuver, while maintaining infantry in strong defensive positions.  Luckily for you, this has merely been a training exercise!
dst: 您在这次演习中没有达成您的目标。您的上级军官认为，您必须在骑兵机动中更加大胆，同时让步兵坚守坚固的防御阵地。对您来说幸运的是，这仅仅是一次训练演习！

src: You have one mission; destroy the remnants of the capitalist forces.  Otherwise, they will receive more reinforcements and support from their stronghold at Pusan.  Quick drive them into the sea and Korea will become the unified Korean People's Republic.
dst: 你只有一个任务；消灭资本主义势力的残余。否则，他们将从其釜山据点获得更多增援和支持。迅速把他们赶下海，朝鲜将成为统一的朝鲜人民共和国。

src: You have only your core troops. We cannot provide more troops, because they are all needed on other frontlines.
dst: 你只有自己的核心部队。我们无法提供更多部队，因为其他战线都需要它们。

src: You have orders to immediately travel to Moskva and report to the great leader himself. No further details have been given.
dst: 你奉命立即前往莫斯科，向伟大领袖本人报到。没有透露更多细节。

src: You have orders to pull back to Odessa at once. First make it to Kishenev which contains the only road leading out of Bessarabia still in our hands. Be quick because the Rumanian and German fascists are on our heals! Good luck, comrade!
dst: 你奉命立即撤回敖德萨。先赶到基希讷乌，那里有比萨拉比亚唯一还在我们手中的出城公路。动作要快，因为罗马尼亚和德国法西斯正紧追不舍！祝你好运，同志！

src: You have our fate in your hands..
dst: 我们的命运掌握在你手中。

src: You have passed this first trial, now we are going to Massawa's Port to cut off any supply entry from the Indian Ocean.
dst: 您已通过了第一次考验，现在我们前往马萨瓦港，以切断来自印度洋的一切补给输入。

src: You have performed far below our expectations. The Romanians still resist from Rasova to Kobadin. Besides, our attack at the Eastern sector has beed repelled.
dst: 您的表现远远低于我们的期望。罗马尼亚人仍在拉索瓦至科巴丁一线抵抗。此外，我军在东段的进攻也被击退了。

src: You have performed superbly in this exercise.  Estonian authorities are impressed with the results and have placed your regiment as an example to other units forming in Estonia.
dst: 您在这次演习中表现出色。爱沙尼亚当局对结果印象深刻，并将您的团树立为爱沙尼亚正在组建的其他部队的榜样。

src: You have performed superbly in this exercise.  Estonian authorities are impressed with the results and have placed your regiment as an example to other units forming in Estonia.  You have achieved a promotion to the rank of Major.
dst: 您在这次演习中表现出色。爱沙尼亚当局对结果印象深刻，并将您的团树立为爱沙尼亚正在组建的其他部队的榜样。您已被晋升为少校军衔。

src: You have proven once and again that you are one of our most skilled commanders, so I want you to lead the first troops that will land on the coast of Alhucemas. Good luck!
dst: 您一次又一次地证明了自己是我们最出色的指挥官之一，所以我想让您率领首批在胡塞马海岸登陆的部队。祝您好运！

src: You have punished the 2nd Soviet Latvian Division and forced all Soviet troops to withdraw.  Your attack is the final nail in the coffin containing the Bolsheviks' ambitions for Latvia and southern Estonia.
dst: 您已重创苏俄拉脱维亚第2师，并迫使所有苏俄军队撤退。您的进攻是钉入布尔什维克对拉脱维亚和爱沙尼亚南部野心棺材的最后一颗钉子。

src: You have pushed the British back, but they have managed to withdraw into their Tobruk fortress.  Unfortunately, we do not have the resources to capture Tobruk at this time.  The war in the desert will continue.  Herr General, you are to return to Germany immediately.
dst: 你击退了英军，但他们已设法撤入托布鲁克要塞。遗憾的是，我们眼下没有资源攻取托布鲁克。沙漠之战将继续。将军阁下，你必须立即返回德国。

src: You have reached the Normandy St-Lo area ahead of schedule. Your troops are put in LXXXIV Corps reserve for now.
dst: 你提前抵达诺曼底圣洛地区。你的部队暂时编入第84军预备队。

src: You have reached the Normandy St-Lo area on schedule. Your troops are put in LXXXIV Corps reserve for now.
dst: 你按计划抵达诺曼底圣洛地区。你的部队暂时编入第84军预备队。

src: You have reached the Normandy St-Lo area slightly behind schedule. Your troops are put in LXXXIV Corps reserve for now.
dst: 你略微落后于计划抵达诺曼底圣洛地区。你的部队暂时编入第84军预备队。

src: You have reached the Normandy St-Lo area way behind schedule. Your troops will be thrown in action without much preparation.
dst: 你远远落后于计划才抵达诺曼底圣洛地区。你的部队将在几乎没有准备的情况下被投入战斗。

src: You have repelled the Portuguese invasion. Your victory will give the rest of the German army enough time to concentrate at the Lindi region north of Nevala.
dst: 您击退了葡萄牙人的入侵。您的胜利将给其余德军足够的时间，在纳瓦拉以北的林迪地区集结。

src: You have satisfied our expectations. I am gladly to tell you that Finland have sued for peace and now will support our troops.
dst: 你满足了我们的期望。我很高兴地告诉你，芬兰已经求和，现在将支援我们的部队。
