src: You have saved us from a big threat !
dst: 您使我们摆脱了一个巨大的威胁！

src: You have scattered the 2nd Soviet Latvian Division and captured their ammunition and food supply - complete with the rail stock.  Your attack is the final nail in the coffin containing the Bolsheviks' ambitions for Latvia and southern Estonia.
dst: 您已击溃苏俄拉脱维亚第2师，并缴获了他们的弹药与粮食补给——连同全部铁路车辆。您的进攻是钉入布尔什维克对拉脱维亚和爱沙尼亚南部野心棺材的最后一颗钉子。

src: You have selected the Alternative German reaction to the Soviet breakthrough in Operation Uranus. This plan involved a direct attack by elements of the Sixth and Fourth Panzer armees on the Soviet armored spearheads moving towards Kalach from the Chir river...
dst: 你选择了德军对苏军"天王星行动"突破的替代反应方案。该方案是由第6装甲集团军和第4装甲集团军的部队，对从奇尔河向卡拉奇推进的苏军装甲矛头实施直接攻击……

src: You have selected the Historic German reaction to the Soviet breakthrough in Operation Uranus. This involved the mounting of a Relief effort in order to free the now encircled 6th Armee in Stalingrad...
dst: 你选择了德军对苏军"天王星行动"突破的历史性反应。这包括发起一次解围行动，以解救如今在斯大林格勒被合围的第6集团军……

src: You have selected the path to ensure the oil routes going through Syria, Iraq and Persia.
dst: 您已选择了确保经由叙利亚、伊拉克和波斯的石油路线这条路线。

src: You have served the Fatherland well, and given us a chance for peace before the final blows fall, and if there is any wisdom left in the world we will avoid another Versailles.
dst: 你为祖国尽忠职守，给了我们在最后打击降临前谋求和平的机会；倘若世上还有半点智慧，我们将避免又一个凡尔赛。

src: You have showed a worrying lack of skill in your advance on the Ukrainian plains. Although you did manage to destroy some Soviet divisions, it took you too long to do so and now the Reds have gathered an incredible amount of reinforcement troops. We'll have to retreat from Ukraine and build a safer defence line towards the west. Anyway, we'll choose another commander for that mission. Consider yourself relieved from duty, General.
dst: 您在乌克兰平原上的推进表现出了令人担忧的能力不足。虽然您确实歼灭了几个苏军师，但耗时太长，如今红军已集结了数量惊人的援军。我们不得不从乌克兰撤退，并在更靠西的地方建立更安全的防线。无论如何，我们会另选一名指挥官来执行这项任务。将军，您被解除职务了。

src: You have succeed in stopping the Germans after repealing all their attacks. In spite of several attempts German infantrymen could not take Vinkt.
dst: 你成功阻止了德军，击退了他们所有的进攻。尽管多次尝试，德军步兵仍无法攻下芬克特。

src: You have succeeded at stopping the enemy. That will give us enough time to improve our defences at the Doiran Lake area. In the meantime, you will be transferred to the west, near Bitolya. It seems that the French are preparing a huge counteroffensive there.
dst: 您成功阻止了敌人。这将给我们足够的时间来加强多伊兰湖地区的防御。与此同时，您将被调往西面、比托利亚附近。看来法国人正在那里准备一场大规模反攻。

src: You have succeeded in clearing Narva of the Soviet presence, but the war does not end here...
dst: 您已成功清除了纳尔瓦的苏俄势力，但战争并未就此结束……

src: You have succeeded in your mission where many others would have failed.  However, the Western Allies have been able to evacuate a majority of their troops and sink most of our surface fleet.
dst: 你在许多人都做不到的地方完成了任务。然而，西线盟军得以撤走了大部分部队，还击沉了我们大部分水面舰艇。

src: You have successfully beaten off the Russian relieve attempt. Send your troops back North for the final assault on Moscow. And don't give me any excuses, I know the rasputitsa - the dreaded Fall rains - have set in. This will disrupt mobility but we do need to reach Moscow before the winter.
dst: 你成功击退了俄国人的解围企图。把你的部队调回北方，准备对莫斯科的最后突击。别给我找任何借口，我知道“泥泞季”——那可怕的秋雨——已经来了。这会影响机动，但我们必须在入冬前抵达莫斯科。

src: You have successfully crossed the Dnepr, but you have lost valuable time. All chances of encircling the Russian forces are gone.
dst: 你成功渡过了第聂伯河，但浪费了宝贵的时间。合围俄军的时机已全部丧失。

src: You have taken Richmond and the enemy had to surrender !
dst: 您攻下了里士满，敌人不得不投降！

src: You have taken the Belgian flag and will go to the west of the colony.
dst: 您已取得比利时旗帜，将前往殖民地西部。

src: You have taken the British flag and will go to the center of the colony.
dst: 您已取得英国旗帜，将前往殖民地的中心地带。

src: You have taken the Portuguese flag and will go to the south of the colony.
dst: 您已取得葡萄牙旗帜，将前往殖民地南部。

src: You have the Italian First Army to stop the upcoming attack: Giovani Fascisti, Trieste, 90 Leichte, La Spezia, Pistoia and 164 Leichte. 15Pz is in reserve behind the front. 21Pz is in reserve at Gabes. 10Pz and Centauro are commited against the US II Corps.
dst: 你有意大利第1集团军来阻止即将到来的进攻：“青年法西斯”师、“的里雅斯特”师、第90轻装师、“拉斯佩齐亚”师、“皮斯托亚”师和第164轻装师。第15装甲师在战线后方作预备队。第21装甲师在加贝斯作预备队。第10装甲师和“半人马”师被投入对付美军第2军。

src: You have the command about the 49. and 50. Army. The troops are still inexperienced, but they were reinforced only just.
dst: 你指挥着第49集团军和第50集团军。部队仍然缺乏经验，但刚刚得到了补充。

src: You have to annihilate the pocket!

You have to attack the prisonhouse in Tsjeljabinsk and free your fellow legionairs. You might have to defend yourself against possible attacking local Soviet troops and the Hungarian POWs which are still in the vicinity. Parts of the Legion is still at railroads west of Tsjejabinsk but some of them might arrive on time to help you.
dst: 您必须攻打车里雅宾斯克的监狱，救出您的军团战友。您可能不得不自卫，抵御可能来攻的当地苏军以及仍在附近的匈牙利战俘。军团的一部分仍在车里雅宾斯克以西的铁路沿线，但其中一些可能及时赶到助您一臂之力。

src: You have to build two bridges on the RIVER terrain hexes in order to cross the river with your ground units.
dst: 你必须在地形为河流的格子上建造两座桥梁，才能让地面部队渡河。

src: You have to ensure that Santolán pumping station remains in our hands.
dst: 您必须确保桑托兰泵站始终在我们手中。

src: You have to hold your positions at all costs, until the wounded have embarked and equipment and ammunition that we have to leave behind have been destroyed.
dst: 您必须不惜一切代价守住阵地，直到伤员登船完毕，并且我们必须丢弃的装备和弹药被销毁。

src: You have to move fast and be careful. After that, you will not have time to resupply or upgrade your units.
dst: 你必须行动迅速并小心谨慎。此后，你将没有时间为你的单位补给或升级。

src: You have to solve this mission only with little help from auxiliary troops.
dst: 您只能依靠辅助部队的少量支援来完成这项任务。

src: You have tought those arrogant Bulgarians a lesson that they won't forget. Peace negotiations will start soon. It's a pity that we don't have more commanders like you, beacause the outcome of this war might have been very different.
dst: 您给那些傲慢的保加利亚人上了一课，让他们永生难忘。和平谈判很快就会开始。遗憾的是我们没有更多像您这样的指挥官，因为这场战争的结局本可能截然不同。

src: You have we command over a tank division, the Moscow garrison and several bunkers and pillboxes. We have tried to mine the way for the German divisions but we could not finish this.
dst: 您将指挥一个坦克师、莫斯科卫戍部队以及若干掩体和碉堡。我们曾试图在德军各师必经之路上布雷，但未能完成。

src: You have won the battle, but the Germans are able to win the war. While you were fighting, German troops have passed Tula and are heading towards Moskau now. We will need your help for the defense of Moskau.
dst: 您赢得了这场战役，但德国人却有可能赢得这场战争。当您作战之时，德军已越过图拉，如今正朝莫斯科进发。我们将需要您协助保卫莫斯科。

src: You have won the campaign, and practised the basic tactics of Open General.
dst: 你赢得了本战役，也演练了 Open General 的基本战术。

src: You have won, Herr General. You have crippled the British Expeditionary Force, and the French have surrendered. Unfortunately, the English continue to resist us even after the loss of their contemptible, little army. Good work.
dst: 你赢了，将军阁下。你重创了英国远征军，法国也已投降。遗憾的是，即便失去了那支可怜的小军队，英国人仍继续抵抗。干得好。

src: You haven't been able to conquer the hills on the west bank, and our task at Verdun will be much harder. However, although it will take longer than we had thought and the cost will be very high, we could still achieve our goals. The French Army will eventually collapse. Unless, of course, Britain or Russia launch relief offensives...
dst: 您未能攻克西岸的那些高地，我们在凡尔登的任务将艰难得多。不过，尽管会比预想耗时更长、代价高昂，我们仍有可能实现目标。法军终将崩溃。当然，除非英国或俄国发动救援性攻势……

src: You haven't been able to defeat the Kakies. Cronjé has surrendered with most of his army, and de Wet and you barely managed to escape. Soon the British will launch a new attack, and I'm afraid that we won't have the strength to repel their invasion.
dst: 您未能击败英国佬。克罗涅已率其大部分军队投降，德韦特和您则勉强脱身。英军很快会发动新的进攻，我担心我们将无力击退他们的入侵。

src: You haven't been able to defeat the Red Army and now the Soviet counterattacks will force us to retreat. We'll have to agree to peace negotiations and we'll lose a great portion of the territory that was once part of Poland. You should accept your responsibility and resign inmediately.
dst: 您没能击败红军，现在苏军的反击将迫使我们撤退。我们将不得不接受和平谈判，并失去曾属于波兰的大片领土。您应当承担起责任并立即辞职。

src: You haven't been able to surprise the Germans, and now all our army is vulnerable. If our enemies regroup and counterattack, we'll be in great trouble. It's time to disengage and to go back behind the ring of fortifications surrounding Antwerp.
dst: 您没能奇袭德国人，如今我们全军都暴露在危险之中。如果敌人重新集结并发起反攻，我们将陷入极大的困境。是时候脱离接触，撤回安特卫普周围的堡垒环后方了。

src: You haven't chosen a path, please try it again.
dst: 您尚未选择一条路线，请重试。

src: You haven't defeated the British, and French has been able to send reinforcements to Roberts. And, sadly, I have even worse news from Kimberley. Roberts has forced Cronjé to leave his positions at Magersfontein, and has trapped him at Paardeberg. In a matter of days Cronjé will be forced to surrender. You must go back to the Transvaal inmediately and try to save our country from the foreign invasion.
dst: 您没能击败英军，弗伦奇得以向罗伯茨派出增援。而且遗憾的是，我从金伯利带来了更糟的消息。罗伯茨已迫使克罗涅放弃马赫斯方丹的阵地，并将他围困在帕尔德山。不出几天克罗涅就将被迫投降。您必须立即返回德兰士瓦，尽力把我们的国家从外国入侵中拯救出来。

src: You haven't made any proper choice, please repeat the scenario.
dst: 您没有做出正确的选择，请重新进行该场景。

src: You haven't selected any destination. Please, select where your army will go.
dst: 您尚未选择目的地。请选择您的部队将前往何处。

src: You haven`t rescued the Celts. Now try to rescue yourself! There is staying a new strong opponent in front of you. Pompeius is back in the Country. Get armed !!!
dst: 你没能救出凯尔特人。现在想办法自救吧！眼前还挡着一个强敌。庞培回到了国内。拿起武器吧！！！

src: You hold the important junction. The railway line, tarmac road and a nearby airfield are critical for our local defense and supply. As such, they must not be lost.
dst: 你扼守着重要的枢纽。铁路线、柏油公路与附近机场对我方本地防御与补给至关重要，绝不可失。

src: You kept the German divisions engaged. But unfortunately you were not able to take the Reinhard line and push the Germans back to the Gustav line.
dst: 你牵制住了德军各师。但遗憾的是，你未能夺取莱因哈德防线并将德军逐回古斯塔夫防线。

src: You know I have been fighting in many a battle during my career in this brave and proud army, but never before have I experienced such an excitement at the eve of an engagement with the enemy. It is a strange mix of determination and eagerness, with some uncertainty and anxiousness. Our great retreat has finally come to an end, here at the Marne, close to the gates of Paris. I just learned that the enemy's right flank has turned away from our capital and the 1st German Army is marching south. They are presenting us their flank, and we cannot let this chance pass by. The great counter-attack everyone is talking about for days, will finally materialize. Wish me luck, we will need it. La France will need it.
dst: 您知道，在这支英勇自豪的军队中，我戎马生涯里身经百战，但从未在临敌交战前夕体验过如此的兴奋。那是一种坚定与渴望的奇特混合，夹杂着些许不确定和焦虑。我们的大撤退终于在马恩河畔、巴黎城门前走到了尽头。我刚得知，敌人的右翼已掉头离开我们的首都，德国第1集团军正南进。他们把侧翼暴露给了我们，我们绝不能让这个机会溜走。大家谈论了数日的那场大反攻，终于要成为现实了。祝我好运吧，我们需要运气。法兰西需要运气。

src: You know that we can't hold Shetland, so we have to stay focussed on our target. We have to move to Mediterranean. You must destroy enemy facilities at Scapa Flow and destroy as many ships is possible.
dst: 你知道我们守不住设得兰群岛，所以必须专注于我们的目标。我们必须转移到地中海。你必须摧毁斯卡帕湾的敌方设施，并尽可能多地击沉舰船。

src: You know the rest. Against all odds, the Italians defeated us. In less than ten months, they conquered all of Ethiopia. Emperor Menelik went to exile in Russia, where he died in 1900, a broken shell of a man.
dst: 后面的情况您都知道了。出乎所有人意料，意大利人打败了我们。不到十个月，他们就征服了整个埃塞俄比亚。孟尼利克皇帝流亡俄国，1900年在那里死去，成了一个身心俱碎的人。

src: You know what he's talking about of course - the Sudetendeutschen. About three million Germans live in Czechoslovakia and Hitler thinks now is the time to invade. He's a lunatic - the Wehrmacht is not ready. We can only hope to win if we achieve total surprise and smother resistance before it erupts. Thus your orders are to proceed to your victory objectives as quickly as possibe before the enemy has time to mobilise his army. The only organised resistance will probably come from one of the border fortresses.
dst: 你当然明白他说的是什么——苏台德德意志人。约三百万德意志人生活在捷克斯洛伐克，希特勒认为现在是入侵的时机。他是个疯子——国防军尚未做好准备。我们唯有达成完全突然性、在抵抗爆发前将其扼杀，才有胜算。因此你的命令是：在敌军来得及动员之前，尽快向胜利目标推进。唯一有组织的抵抗，大概会来自某座边境要塞。

src: You look sick, général. I'm not surprised, after four months in this hell. You must take a permission. A long one, I dare to say. Spending the summer at home, with your family, will be good to you. We need you, but only if you're healthy and strong. Go back when you have recovered!
dst: 将军，您看起来病了。在这个地狱里待了四个月，我并不感到意外。您必须休假，而且我敢说，要休一个长假。在家与家人共度夏天，对您有好处。我们需要您，但前提是您健康而强壮。等康复了再回来吧！

src: You made it! The British were not able to defeat you. Your army is still strong and you know that you could resist the British for a long time. However, Germany has signed an armistice in Compiegne, so it's time for an honorable surrender. Anyway, you have done an excellent job.
dst: 您做到了！英军未能击败您。您的军队依然强大，您知道自己还能长时间抵抗英军。然而，德国已在贡比涅签署了停战协定，所以现在是光荣投降的时候了。无论如何，您干得非常出色。

src: You made it! Very well done, comrade. The front has completely fallen apart. We are falling back on Odessa.
dst: 你做到了！干得很好，同志。战线已彻底崩溃。我们正向敖德萨撤退。

src: You made it! Well done, comrade. The front has completely fallen apart. We are falling back on Odessa.
dst: 你做到了！干得好，同志。战线已彻底崩溃。我们正向敖德萨撤退。

src: You may buy some strength points or attachments for your two core units now.
dst: 你现在可以为你的两个核心单位购买一些兵力值或附属装备。

src: You may deploy 1 ground unit and your aircraft...
dst: 你可以部署1个地面单位以及你的飞机……

src: You may deploy your core paratroopers at sea.
dst: 你可以把你的核心伞兵部署在海上。

src: You may deploy your paratroopers at sea in the east.
dst: 你可以在东面的海上部署伞兵。

src: You may even check the maps of some battlefields to make your plans accordingly.
dst: 你甚至可以查看一些战场的的地图，以便据此制定计划。

src: You may have saved the Empire today, General. The Russians are still advancing, but we've saved thousands of men and tons of equipment. Obviously, we had underestimated our enemies. Or, maybe, we had overestimated our own strength.
dst: 今天您也许拯救了帝国，将军。俄国人仍在推进，但我们保全了数千士兵与成吨装备。显然，我们低估了敌人。或者，也许是我们高估了自己的实力。

src: You may leave the camp now and start your real campaign FROM BUZULUK TO PRAGUE!
dst: 你现在可以离开营地，开始你真正的战役——从布祖鲁克到布拉格！

src: You must accept your responsability in this disaster, General. You will soon be judged at a general court martial. Now get out of my sight!
dst: 将军，您必须为这场灾难承担起您的责任。您很快就要接受军事法庭的审判。现在，从我眼前消失！

src: You must allocate sufficient rapid forces for a second wing of your attack group to maneuver behind the Pskov garrison and to capture vital communication centers in the area.  To the south, the Bolsheviks have hastened to assemble a front out of regiments of the 4th Rifle Division.  Your break-through forces must exploit this weakness and capture all objectives quickly.  Speed is of essence!
dst: 您必须拨出足够的快速部队组成攻击集群的第二个侧翼，机动到普斯科夫守军后方，并夺取该地区重要的通讯中心。在南面，布尔什维克已仓促以第4步兵师的各团拼凑出一条战线。您的突破部队必须利用这一弱点，迅速夺取所有目标。速度至关重要！

src: You must also expect some attacks fron the Ottoman Navy. Unfortunately, we have no means of defence against them, so be careful.
dst: 您还必须提防奥斯曼海军的一些进攻。不幸的是，我们对他们没有任何防御手段，所以要小心。

src: You must be careful. The French Army is experienced and well positioned, specially near Dolno Chichevo and Krivolak. They have blown all the existing bridges, so crossing the rivers  may prove difficult. Try to weaken the enemy with your artillery before crossing.
dst: 您必须小心。法国军队经验丰富且占据有利位置，尤其是在多尔诺奇切沃和克里沃拉克附近。他们炸毁了所有现存的桥梁，因此渡河可能会很困难。渡河前先设法用炮兵削弱敌人。

src: You must break the Polish defence and move towards Warsaw.
dst: 你必须突破波兰人的防线，向华沙推进。

src: You must come to this meeting, and pray, pray that we come up with a plan that Hitler will accept!
dst: 你必须来参加这次会议，并祈祷，祈祷我们能拿出一个希特勒会接受的计划！

src: You must complete the upcoming campaign by November 26th at the latest. The fate of the war in the east is in your hands.
dst: 你必须在11月26日之前完成即将展开的战役。东线战事的命运掌握在你手中。

src: You must control 6 VH for a BV, 5 for a V or 4 for a TV at the end of the scenario.
dst: 在场景结束时，您必须控制6个胜利点以获得大捷，5个为胜利，4个为小捷。

src: You must defend the bridge near Osera city - medium strong republicans units -  and occupy Villanueva city and bridge on rio Gallego.
dst: 将军阁下，您必须防守奥塞拉城附近的桥梁（共和军部队中等强度），并攻占比利亚努埃瓦城及加列戈河上的桥梁。

src: You must dismantle Turkeys last line of fortifications at the base of the Kavkaz Mountains.
dst: 您必须拆除土耳其在高加索山脉山麓的最后一道要塞工事。

src: You must feel proud of yourself, General! You will be remembered as one of our best military commanders. Poland will be forever in debt to you.
dst: 将军，您应当为自己感到骄傲！您将作为我们最优秀的军事指挥官之一被铭记。波兰将永远亏欠您。

src: You must form a marine detachment (3 units) out of specially trained infantry and MG units.  Our Finnish allies have promised to send a detachment of their 1st regiment, so expect their help shortly.  Intelligence reports that the Russians have unloaded siege guns-most likely en route to Tallinn earlier-at the port of Letipea.  Don't let these catch your transports in the water!
dst: 您必须从经过专门训练的步兵和机枪单位中组建一支海军陆战分遣队（3个单位）。我们的芬兰盟友已承诺派遣他们第1团的一个分遣队，所以很快就能期待他们的帮助。情报报告称，俄国人已在莱蒂佩亚港卸下攻城炮——很可能早先是要运往塔林的。别让这些火炮趁您的运输船还在水上时打到您！

src: You must gain the German Army a foothold on English soil!
dst: 你必须为德军在英格兰土地取得立足点！

src: You must get used to these amphibious invasions Herr General because there will be some more required in the future!
dst: 你得习惯这些两栖登陆，将军阁下，因为将来还会需要更多！

src: You must go further east towards Chita. Our goal remains leaving Russia and get home. Semenov's Transbaikal Cossacks might try to stop you and you have orders not to be stopped by anyone.
dst: 您必须继续东进，前往赤塔。我们的目标始终是离开俄国、回到家乡。谢苗诺夫的外贝加尔哥萨克可能会试图阻止您，而您接到的命令是：不得被任何人挡住。

src: You must help defend Tunisia so that we can maintain a position in North West Africa. If you can hold Tunis and at least two other objectives until well into March, will almost certainly cause a delay in future Allied operations.
dst: 你必须协助防守突尼斯，以便我们在西北非保持一个立足点。如果你能守住突尼斯城以及至少另外两个目标直到3月过半，几乎肯定会使盟军日后的行动受到拖延。

src: You must hold Kazan and hold the enemy at bay. We have no intentions of advancing towards Moscow but we will not be defeated. Also hold open the railroads to the Ural mountains.
dst: 您必须守住喀山，并遏制住敌人。我们无意向莫斯科推进，但我们绝不会被打败。同时要保持通往乌拉尔山脉的铁路畅通。

src: You must hold Riga until you can launch a couter-attack to take the pressure of our forces.
dst: 你必须坚守里加，直至发起反攻，为我军减压。

src: You must hold our position on the Gnila Lipa River and prevent an Austrian advance here long enough for the bulk of the 8th Army to disengage from the Carpathians.
dst: 您必须守住我们在格尼拉利帕河的阵地，在此阻止奥军推进足够长的时间，好让第8集团军主力从喀尔巴阡山脉脱离接触。

src: You must hold the initial airfield... Hurry up, before the paratroopers are defeated.
dst: 你必须守住初始机场……动作快点，赶在伞兵被击败之前。

src: You must keep the momentum and advance on Kherson as well. Doing so we will be able to trap a large enemy force in the area of Nikolaev.
dst: 你必须保持势头，同时向赫尔松推进。这样一来，我们就能把一支庞大的敌军困在尼古拉耶夫地区。

src: You must know by now that the Stalingrad problem has become even more precarious.  Manstein is forming an attack group that will re-establish contact with 6th Army, however we also know of another Red Army offensive in the vicinity of our own Italian 8th Army.
dst: 你如今想必已知，斯大林格勒的问题变得更加岌岌可危。曼施泰因正在组建一支突击集群，将重新与第6集团军建立联系，然而我们还得知，红军在我意大利第8集团军附近另有攻势。

src: You must mobilize whatever mobile forces you can and perform a mission of utmost importance:  large quantities of supplies for the Baltic Fleet and our ground armies have been left at Libau and must be destroyed before they fall into German hands.  A small group of your forces can be deployed, and they must destroy any ONE of the supply stocks and temporarily recapture its location.
dst: 您必须动员一切能够机动的兵力，执行一项极其重要的任务：为波罗的海舰队和我方地面集团军准备的大量补给物资被留在了利包，必须在其落入德军之手前将其摧毁。您可以部署一小队兵力，他们必须摧毁任何一处补给仓库，并暂时夺回其所在地。

src: You must neutralize all German cavalry rear-guards and drive toward Lake Narotch.  German engineers have begun building a trench system to hold onto their gains.  You must capture these trenches in an effort to enable a counter-stroke against the German 10th Army.  Time is of essense here:  as the front solidifies along lines of entrenchment, our chances of a rapid counter-attack diminish.
dst: 您必须消灭所有德国骑兵后卫并向纳罗奇湖推进。德国工兵已开始构筑堑壕体系以守住其战果。您必须夺取这些堑壕，以便对德国第10集团军实施反突击。这里时间至关重要：随着战线沿堑壕线固化，我们快速反击的机会正在减少。

src: You must occupy the oil field and ready yourself before hard counter attack, because enemy will try obtain these fields at any cost.
dst: 你必须占领油田，并在敌军不惜代价反扑前做好准备。

src: You must preserve the Italian capital ships.  We went to a great deal of trouble convincing them to join us in this assault on the British at sea, we will need them again in the future and we must not let the heart be cut out of their navy.
dst: 你必须保住意大利的主力舰。我们费了很大力气才说服他们参加这次对英国的海上突击，将来还用得着他们，绝不能让他们的海军心腹被挖掉。

src: You must provide support to the "Chasseurs Ardennais" defending Vinkt.
dst: 你必须为防守芬克特的“Chasseurs Ardennais”提供支援。

src: You must repel ground attacks and occupy two bridges on river, to secure our units attack on Voronez and Stalingrad city.
dst: 您必须击退地面进攻，并占领河上两座桥梁，为我部进攻沃罗涅日与斯大林格勒创造条件。

src: You must retain control of Szekesfehervar long enough to allow 5 ground units to be moved into the Berhida Corridor when it opens up.
dst: 你必须在贝希达走廊打开时，守住塞克什白堡足够长的时间，以便把5个地面单位调入该走廊。

src: You must stop the Greek offensive; their forces are more organized and trained, but remember that your position is strong.
dst: 您必须阻止希腊军队的攻势；他们的部队组织更严密、训练更精良，但记住您的阵地很坚固。

src: You must strike through the Ardennes towards Sedan as quickly as your panzers can go!
dst: 你必须以装甲部队能达到的最快速度穿过阿登、直扑色当！

src: You must take these bridges, so that we can move on the cities of Tichvin and Volchov.
dst: 你必须夺取这些桥梁，以便我军向提赫温与沃尔霍夫两市推进。

src: You must take your objectives by no later than November 16th, but in order for us to ensure that we can hold Moscow in the face of a determined counterattack, you should strive to take Moscow several weeks earlier. This will no doubt be our best chance to win the War in the East.
dst: 你必须在11月16日之前夺取全部目标，但为确保我军能在敌军坚决反攻之下守住莫斯科，你应争取提前数周拿下莫斯科。这无疑将是我们赢得东线战争的最佳机会。

src: You must withstand the gigantic onslaugth of the Soviet army on Berlin.
dst: 你必须抵挡苏军对柏林的磅礴攻势。

src: You need more training in Blitzkrieg lightning warfare Herr General. We are not in the trenches of WW1!!!
dst: 你需要更多闪电战训练，将军阁下。我们可不是在一战的堑壕里！！！

src: You need to capture the city of Johvi and its Supply Hex, which will serve as marshalling area, to deploy additional ground units.
dst: 你需要夺取约赫维城及其补给格，它将作为集结区，用以部署额外的地面部队。

src: You need to capture the ports of Zanzibar before you can deploy additional ground units!
dst: 您需要先夺取桑给巴尔的港口，才能部署更多地面单位！

src: You need to defeat the offensive of the 39th and 5th Armies and crush through the 43rd Army. Heeresgruppe Kurland forces will arrive from the north, and together, you must stop the Soviet offensive.
dst: 你需要击败第39和第5集团军的进攻，并突破第43集团军。库尔兰集团军群的部队将从北方抵达，你们须合力遏止苏军的攻势。

src: You need to launch an counterattack and capture the 5th VH at Serafimov for a BV.
dst: 你需要发起一次反攻，夺取谢拉菲莫维奇的第 5 个胜利点以获得 BV。

src: You need to launch an counterattack, clear the Soviet bridgehead and capture the VHs near Serafimovich and Veshenskaya for a BV.
dst: 您需要发动一次反击，肃清苏联桥头堡并占领谢拉菲莫维奇和维申斯卡亚附近的胜利点，以获得 BV。

src: You next goal is Stalingrad - advance with your forces along the eastern Volga river bank immediately to this city!
dst: 你的下一个目标是斯大林格勒——立即率你的部队沿伏尔加河东岸向这座城市推进！

src: You only have the command about your tank army.
dst: 你只拥有对你坦克集团军的指挥权。

src: You orders are to capture the city of Braunschweig and the Harz Mountains and proceed further to the east to the Elbe river. We hear rumors that the Soviets are also advancing towards the Elbe from the east...
dst: 你的命令是夺取不伦瑞克市与哈茨山脉，并继续向东推进至易北河。我们听到传言，苏联人也正从东面向易北河推进……

src: You penetrated the first Russian lines of defense, but the offensive is getting stuck in the mud. We need to retreat towards Vienna and regroup North of the NeusiedlerSee.
dst: 你突破了俄军第一道防线，但攻势陷入泥泞、寸步难行。我们需要向维也纳方向撤退，并在新锡德尔湖以北重整。

src: You performed magnificantly and struck a serious blow to the US forces in the Ardennes. Lead elements of our Fifth Panzer Armee have even reached Antwerp, making its vital port unusable to the Allies.
dst: 你表现出色，给了阿登地区的美军沉重一击。我们第5装甲集团军的先头部队甚至抵达了安特卫普，使这一重要港口无法再为盟军所用。

src: You performed very well, but US divisions moving in from the south have relieved the
dst: 你表现出色，但从南面开来的美军各师已给

src: You performed well, but US divisions moving in from the south have relieved the surrounded
dst: 你表现出色，但从南面开来的美军各师已给被围的

src: You pledged and were enlisted into the ranks of Polska Si³a Zbrojna - Army of the Kingdom of Poland.
dst: 您立下誓言，并被征入波兰武装力量——波兰王国军队的行列。

src: You put up a good fight in Normandy.
dst: 你在诺曼底打得很顽强。

src: You reached your objectives and the Germans have signed an armistice! The war is over!
dst: 您达成了目标，德国人签署了停战协定！战争结束了！

src: You reached your objectives, but the BEF was able to continue their orderly retreat.
dst: 您达成了目标，但英国远征军得以继续有秩序地撤退。

src: You really need to address the growing Soviet dominance in the air.
dst: 你确实需要应对苏军日益增长的空中优势。

src: You receive 1750 prestige points and should acquire your starting core.
dst: 你将获得1750点威望，并应购置你的初始核心部队。

src: You receive a free 12 SP recon!
dst: 你获得一架免费的12点兵力侦察机！

src: You receive a squadron leader fighter plane with combat support [C] ability
dst: 你获得一架拥有战斗支援［C］能力的王牌飞行员战斗机

src: You reluctantly attacked the Soviet defense without even a chance to reach the approaches to Leningrad. More unfortunately, the bogged down Tigers couldn't be saved before the enemy captured them. This is a serious blow, as now the Soviets will acquire all the necessary knowledge of our new panzer.
dst: 你勉强进攻苏军防线，连通往列宁格勒的要道都未能接近。更糟的是，陷入泥泞的虎式没等被救出就被敌军缴获了。这是沉重打击——如今苏军将掌握我方新式坦克的全部关键情报。

src: You reluctantly attacked the Soviet defense, pushed the enemy back, and reached the approaches to Leningrad. Unfortunately, the bogged down Tigers couldn't be saved before the enemy destroyed them.
dst: 你勉强进攻苏军防线，击退敌军，抵达了通往列宁格勒的要道。遗憾的是，陷入泥泞的虎式没等被救出就被敌军摧毁了。

src: You restored some semblance of order, but still further south the situation is disastrous, you will now withdraw along the Warta to Frankfurt a/d Oder as soon as possible. Maybe we can still stop the Soviets with our troops arriving from the west.
dst: 您恢复了一些秩序，但更南面的局势仍是灾难性的，您现在要沿瓦尔塔河尽快撤往奥得河畔法兰克福。也许我们还能靠从西面赶来的部队挡住苏军。

src: You rushed west and took Odessa without too much trouble, an admirable achievement. After months of advancing, our troops in the Ukraine will stop large offensive actions as almost the entire Ukraine has been liberated now. But our great nation is larger than just the Ukraine and those areas are waiting for our troops to liberate them from the fascist oppression. Your forces will be send to the Crimea. Other forces will start attacks in Byelorussia and the Baltics.
dst: 你快速西进，没费多大力气就拿下了敖德萨，这是令人钦佩的成就。经过数月的推进，我们在乌克兰的部队将停止大规模攻势，因为几乎整个乌克兰现已解放。但我们伟大的祖国远不止乌克兰，那些地区正等着我们的部队去把她们从法西斯的压迫下解放出来。你的部队将被派往克里米亚。其他部队将在白俄罗斯和波罗的海发起进攻。

src: You seem to be very talented in working with our allies. You will go to Bucharest and Rome to pick up some medals, your troops will go to Italy to assure us of Italian loyalty, and to prepare its defence.
dst: 您似乎很擅长与我们的盟友打交道。您将前往布加勒斯特和罗马领取几枚勋章，您的部队将开赴意大利，以确保意大利的忠诚并筹备其防务。

src: You should be aware that the allies will be sending in reinforcements from the west throughout the battle.  We expect them to arrive in the vicinity of the villages Rehrbaon, Puberg and La-Petite-Pierre, as well as the city of Saverne.  Be prepared for this eventuality.  Good luck.
dst: 你要知道，盟军会在整场战斗中从西面调来增援。我们预计他们会抵达雷尔博、普贝尔和拉佩蒂特皮埃尔等村庄一带，以及萨韦尔讷城。对此要有准备。祝你好运。

src: You should deploy light units only (infantry, mortars, light artillery and MGs).
dst: 你只应部署轻型单位（步兵、迫击炮、轻型火炮和机枪）。

src: You should depoly your ships and infantry or other light units like mortars and MGs only.
dst: 你应当只部署你的舰船与步兵，或其他轻型单位，如迫击炮与机枪。

src: You should run back to the Phillipines where a new mission is waiting for you.
dst: 您应该赶回菲律宾，那里有一项新任务在等着您。

src: You should take a rest, General. In the future you will have to fight still better, in order to stop El Raisuli once and for all.
dst: 您应当休息一下了，将军。将来您还必须打得更出色，才能一劳永逸地制止赖苏利。

src: You should think that this defeat would have broken Rome's neck ... but there is one thing we have to appreciate about these crazy Romans: They are incredibly tough ...
dst: 你或许以为这次惨败足够折断罗马的脖子 ... 但这些疯狂的罗马人有一点不得不让我们佩服：他们顽强得难以置信 ...

src: You should try to overcome any resistance and liberate Rome as fast as possible!
dst: 你应当设法克服一切抵抗，尽快解放罗马！

src: You start during the Spanish Civil War with a tiny core, and you'll move all over the Europe with an ever-increasing forces under your command. You will fight the rapid skirmishes of the early years of "Blitzkrieg!", and you will encounter the attrition battles of the desperate resistance while "Defending the Reich".
dst: 你从西班牙内战起家，仅带一支小小的核心部队，随后将指挥不断壮大的兵力转战整个欧洲。你将在“闪电战！”的初年经历迅疾的遭遇战，并在“保卫帝国”中直面困兽犹斗的消耗战。

src: You start in the autumn 1941 during the second stage of an attack on Moscow. Leading a mere light tanks company, you'll later become a commander of the whole tank battalion. Trapped in the mud, blood, and tears of the East Front, you'll fight the last frantic skirmishes of "Blitzkrieg!", and later encounter the attrition battles of the desperate resistance while "Defending the Reich".
dst: 你始于1941年秋进攻莫斯科的第二阶段。起初只指挥一个轻型坦克连，日后将成为整个坦克营的营长。陷于东线的泥泞、血与泪之中，你将经历“闪电战！”最后几场疯狂的厮杀，随后在“保卫德意志”时遭遇殊死抵抗的消耗战。

src: You start the campaign as a war chief of the Treveri with battles at the frontiers against the Teutons. These old enemies again and again try to invade our fertile country.
dst: 你以特雷维里人军阀的身份开始战役，在边境与条顿人交战。这些宿敌一次又一次地试图入侵我们肥沃的家园。

src: You start without an own airfield and have to build one once your sappers have landed.
dst: 你开局没有自己的机场，必须在你的工兵登陆后修建一座。

src: You start without an own airfield and have to build one once your sappers have landed. A fast builder attachment will be useful.
dst: 开局时您没有自己的机场，工兵登陆后必须修建一座。加装快速建造附件会很有用。

src: You start without an own airfield and have to build one once your sappers or paratrooper engineers have landed. A fast builder attachment will be useful.
dst: 你开局没有自己的机场，必须在你的工兵或伞兵工程部队登陆后修建一座。一个快速建造附属件会很有用。

src: You stopped the Belgian Army and pushed them back towards Antwerp, but our advance on Paris has been halted. The Allies won the battle of the Marne and our army had to retreat to the Aisne.
dst: 您挡住了比利时军队并将他们逼向安特卫普，但我军对巴黎的推进已被阻止。协约国赢得了马恩河会战，我军不得不撤退到埃纳河。

src: You stopped the British advance. The enemy seems to be shiping a lot of forces to Greece which makes further attacks on our positions unlikely. You can move back to the offensive when the German Afrika Corps arrival is completed.
dst: 你阻止了英军的推进。敌人似乎正把大量兵力运往希腊，这使得他们进一步攻击我阵地的可能性不大。等德国非洲军全部抵达，你就可以重新转入攻势。

src: You stopped the Soviet armoured forces and slowly pushed them towards Kharkov. You were able to safeguard our positions at the very last minute, and our situation is still shaky.
dst: 你挡住苏军装甲部队，并缓缓把他们压向哈尔科夫。你在最后一刻守住了我方阵地，但局势仍不稳。

src: You stopped the Soviet armoured forces, pushed them back, and then continued until you reached the outskirts of Kharkov. This decisive action safeguarded the city and our positions are unbreakable now.
dst: 你挡住苏军装甲部队、将其击退，随后继续推进，直抵哈尔科夫郊外。这一果断行动保住了该城，如今我们的阵地已牢不可破。

src: You stopped the Soviet armoured forces, routed them, and then continued your push until you reached the outskirts of Kharkov. This decisive action safeguarded the city and our positions are unbreakable now.
dst: 你挡住苏军装甲部队、将其击溃，随后继续推进，直抵哈尔科夫郊外。这一果断行动保住了该城，如今我们的阵地已牢不可破。

src: You surely know, that we are at war with Finland at the moment. Your mission is to break through the finish lines at Suomussalmi.
dst: 您想必知道，我们目前正与芬兰交战。您的任务是突破芬军在苏奥穆斯萨尔米的防线。

src: You take command from the civil war in Spain, to the "lightning" victories of early World War II - and beyond!
dst: 您将从西班牙内战一路指挥到二战初期那些“闪电”胜利——并走向更远！

src: You take command from the civil war in Spain, to the "lightning" victories of early World War II and beyond.
dst: 你将从西班牙内战开始执掌指挥权，经历二战初期那些“闪电”式的胜利，直至更远。

src: You take command from the civil war in Spain, to the "lightning" victories of early World War II and beyond....
dst: 你将执掌指挥权，从西班牙内战，到第二次世界大战初期那些"闪电"般的胜利，乃至更远……

src: You take command from the invasion of Czechoslovakia, to the "lightning" victories of early World War II - and beyond!
dst: 你将从入侵捷克斯洛伐克开始执掌指挥，历经二战初期的“闪电”胜利——直至更远！

src: You take command of Axis troops from the civil war in Spain, to the end of the WW2 conflict.
dst: 你将从西班牙内战开始执掌轴心国部队，直到二战冲突结束。

src: You take command of Axis troops from the civil war in Spain, to the victories of early World War II and beyond.
dst: 你将从西班牙内战开始执掌轴心国部队，经历二战初期的胜利，直至更远。

src: You take part in Von Manstein's counterattack. Our battalion is the most powerful unit in the area, and we are expected to lead the assault, knock out the enemy tanks and destroy all heavily guarded positions.
dst: 你参加冯·曼施泰因的反击。我军营是该地区最强大的单位，上级期望我们率队突击，击毁敌军坦克，摧毁所有重兵把守的阵地。

src: You took part in the first Spanish Civil War, so you might be able to make sense of this one! Everything here is mixed up. The Spanish army is divided into factions that can't be seperated, some are pro-German and some are idiots who still can't see that we'll win in the end. Just clean the mess up here. If troops fight on your side, treat them well. If they don't, beat them.
dst: 你参加过第一次西班牙内战，或许能理清这场混战！这里一切都乱成一团。西班牙军队分裂成无法区分的派系，有些亲德，有些是至今还看不出我们最终会赢的蠢货。把这里的烂摊子收拾干净就行。若有部队为你而战，善待他们；若不，就揍他们。

src: You useless buffoon! Look what you've done! The Germans have crossed the Marne, outflanked the French, and are marching on Paris. Mark my words, I'll make sure that, one day, you'll be held accountable for this disaster. You'll spend the rest of your life in a military prison, I swear!
dst: 您这个没用的蠢货！看看您干的好事！德国人已经渡过马恩河，迂回包抄了法军，正向巴黎挺进。记住我的话，我保证总有一天会让您为这场灾难负责。我发誓，您将在军事监狱里度过余生！

src: You valliantly kept your positions, but on the Weichsel and the Prut we were beaten, Soviet troops are streaming into Romania, and have attacked Bulgaria.
dst: 您英勇地守住了阵地，但在维斯瓦河和普鲁特河一线我们被打败了，苏军正涌入罗马尼亚，并已进攻保加利亚。

src: You were defeated. The british have cut your route of escape and you must surrender.
dst: 您被打败了。英军切断了您的退路，您必须投降。

src: You were defeated. The enemy has surrounded us and we must surrender.
dst: 您被打败了。敌人已将我部包围，我们必须投降。

src: You were defeated. The portuguese camp hasn't been taken in time and we are critically short of all kind of supplies. We must surrender, as we don't have the resources to continue the war.
dst: 您被打败了。葡萄牙人的营地未能及时占领，我们各种补给都严重短缺。我们必须投降，因为我们没有资源继续作战了。

src: You were far too late. This failure is unacceptable and your chances for the promotion are vanishing. It's true that the Pz II tanks are starting to show their weakness, so for the upcoming operations you will receive a mix of Pz IIIs; command them better than this time.
dst: 你来得太迟了。这样的失败不可接受，你的晋升希望正变得渺茫。确实，二号坦克已开始显露疲态，所以为接下来的行动你将接收一批三号坦克；下次可要指挥得更好些。

src: You were fortunate to have escaped capture after the fiasco you perpetrated in Finland.  However, your previous performance merits another opportunity.  Do not fail us again.
dst: 你在芬兰酿成惨败后还能逃脱被俘，算你走运。不过，你以往的表现值得再给一次机会。别再让我们失望了。

src: You were fortunate to have escaped capture after the this fiasco.  However, your previous performance merits another opportunity.  Do not fail us again.
dst: 在这次惨败之后，你能逃脱被俘实属幸运。不过，你先前的表现值得再给你一次机会。不要再让我们失望了。

src: You were lucky 2nd Pz and 10th Pz divisions captured your targets. Vayzma and Gzhatsk are in our hands now. Again 100,000s of Russians are trapped in pockets behind our lines. Now it's time to move East. Moscow is the target. Let's hope we have not lost too much time. Intelligence reports Siberian troops have arrived at the front already.
dst: 你运气不错，第2装甲师和第10装甲师夺取了你的目标。维亚济马和格扎茨克如今在我们手中。又有数十万俄国人被困在我们战线后方的各个包围圈中。现在是时候向东推进了。目标是莫斯科。但愿我们没有浪费太多时间。情报报告说西伯利亚部队已抵达前线。

src: You were not able to penetrate the Russian lines of defense. Retreat towards Vienna and regroup North of the NeusiedlerSee.
dst: 你未能突破俄军防线。向维也纳方向撤退，并在新锡德尔湖以北重整。

src: You were not been able to mantain your positions. The British stormed the German lines and Von Lettow's army is routed and forced to surrender. Your campaign is over.
dst: 您未能守住您的阵地。英军猛攻德军防线，冯·莱托的军队溃败，被迫投降。您的战役结束了。

src: You were not fast enough. You failed!

You were unable to break the back of the BEF. Thanks to the advances of Second Armee on our left, the BEF has to retreat to restore Entente lines. II Kavallerie Korps is ordered to keep on hitting the enemy during their retreat.
dst: 您未能打断英国远征军的脊梁。多亏我左翼第2集团军的推进，英国远征军不得不撤退以恢复协约国战线。第2骑兵军奉命在敌军撤退期间持续攻击。

src: You were unable to take all of your objectives and the casualties sustained doesn't allow us to continue the war.  You must surrender.
dst: 您未能达成您的所有目标，而且所承受的伤亡使我们无法继续战争。您必须投降。

src: You weren't bold enough, and the local enemy forces held. This failure is unacceptable and your chances for the promotion are vanishing. At least your services will still be required in the spring when the offensive actions will be renewed. Panzer I tanks will be replaced with new Panzer IIs, highly increasing the mobility of your unit.
dst: 你不够果敢，当地敌军守住了。这样的失败不可接受，你的晋升希望正变得渺茫。好在春季攻势重启时你的效劳仍将被需要。一号坦克将换成新的二号坦克，大大提升你部队的机动性。

src: You will assist our Romanian Allies in their attempt to reclaim their lost province of Moldavia. The key city in this province is Kishinev, and it is also your primary objective.  Not only is this assignment strategically important, it is politically critical.
dst: 你将协助我们的罗马尼亚盟友，助其收复失去的摩尔达维亚省。该省的要城是基希讷乌，也是你的首要目标。这项任务不仅战略重要，而且政治攸关。

src: You will be able to deploy 3 units for an amphibious assault. Only specially trained infantry (Morskaya Pekhota) will be deployable with the fleet. The rest of your forces will assume command of the II Turkestansky Corps outside of Arkhave.
dst: 您将能部署3支部队实施两栖突击。只有受过专门训练的步兵（海军步兵）才能随舰队部署。您其余部队将接管阿尔哈韦城外的第2突厥斯坦军。

src: You will be assigned missions that the best of the best can't handle.  You will face enemies mankind has never dreamed of.  You will never be allowed to disclose the nature of your assignments.
dst: 你将受领连最精锐者都无法应对的任务。你将面对人类做梦也想不到的敌人。你永远不被允许透露任务的真实性质。

src: You will be assigned missions that the best of the best can't handle.  You will face enemies mankind has never dreamed of.  You will never be allowed to disclose the true nature of your assignments.
dst: 你将受领连最精锐者都无法应对的任务。你将面对人类做梦也想不到的敌人。你永远不被允许透露任务的真实性质。

src: You will be awarded an artillery unit and 144 pps (at least).
dst: 您将获得一个炮兵部队和144点声望（至少）。

src: You will be awarded with 144 pps (at least).  It's enough to upgrade infantry.
dst: 您将获得144点声望（至少）。这足以升级步兵。

src: You will be awarded with 228 pps (at least).
You will be awarded with 300pps (at least).
You will be awarded with 300pps (at least). Buy a recon unit.
dst: 您将获得至少300点威望。购买一支侦察单位。

src: You will be awarded with 324 pps (at least).
You will be awarded with 420 pps (at least).
You will be awarded with 420 pps (at least). Buy cheap recon bomber.
dst: 您将获得至少420点威望。购买廉价的侦察轰炸机。

src: You will be awarded with 492 pps (at least). Buy transport for infantry.
dst: 您将获得至少492点威望。为步兵购买运输工具。

src: You will be awarded with 72pps (at least). Buy transport for infantry.
dst: 您将获得至少72点声望值。请为步兵购买运输工具。

src: You will be awarded with 792 pps (at least). Buy transport for infantry, recon and something else.
dst: 您将获得至少792点威望。为步兵、侦察兵购买运输工具，以及其他一些东西。

src: You will be drawn back from the front for rest and possible refitting.
dst: 你将被调离前线休整，并可能进行重新装备。

src: You will be remembered by both your friends and enemies as a great leader however this all ends.  You are dismissed.  Go see to your family.
dst: 无论这一切如何收场，你的朋友和敌人都将铭记你是一位伟大的统帅。你被解职了。回去照顾你的家人吧。

src: You will command a small allied special force in order to capture Elba and fight down the german garrison.
dst: 你将指挥一支小型盟军特种部队，以夺取厄尔巴岛并击溃德军守备部队。

src: You will command the Hungarian 11. Királyi (Honvéd) Huszár Hadosztály fighting in Galicia, Bukovina, Transylvania, Romania and Italy.
dst: 您将指挥匈牙利第11王家（洪韦德）骠骑兵师，转战加利西亚、布科维纳、特兰西瓦尼亚、罗马尼亚和意大利。

src: You will embark on this campaign in the rank of Kapten and in the position of Executive Officer of the 1st Estonian regiment.  As you gain experience and progress in rank, the number of troops under your command will increase.  You will be instructed to requisition more equipment in such cases, but you will not be restricted to specific types.  This campaign is built at battalion level.
dst: 您将以「上尉」军衔、第1爱沙尼亚团副官的身份开始本战役。随着您积累经验、军衔晋升，您麾下的部队数量将会增加。届时您将奉命征用更多装备，但不会局限于特定类型。本战役按营级规模构建。

src: You will engineer some of the most famous victories of all time- Brest, Sedan, Smolensk, Kiev before finally tasting defeat at the gates of Moscow.
dst: 你将亲手缔造一些史上最著名的胜利——布列斯特、色当、斯摩棱斯克、基辅——最后在莫斯科城下初尝败绩。

src: You will find a prestige trigger at a important landmark!
dst: 你会在一个重要地标处发现一个威望触发器！

src: You will gain 100 pp per turn.This money is for refits and you will be over the cap if you do not use it, so feel free to use it.
dst: 你每回合将获得100 pp。这笔资金用于补充整备，若不动用就会超出上限，所以请随意使用。

src: You will get help from the soviet Westfront. These troops have only few tank divisions but many artilleries and especially infantry divisions.
dst: 您将得到苏联西方方面军的援助。这些部队只有少量坦克师，但拥有大量炮兵，尤其是步兵师。

src: You will get the plane - for free. And this plane doesn't count against the cap, so won't sell it. Keep it! Use it! Upgrade it! Win with it!
dst: 您将获得一架飞机——免费的。而且这架飞机不占用上限，所以不要卖掉它。留着它！使用它！升级它！用它取胜！

src: You will have command over the 65. Army. This troops will attack the Romanian front in the northeast and will support your attack against the Italian und Hungarian troops in the southeast.
dst: 你将指挥第65集团军。该部队将攻击东北面的罗马尼亚军战线，并支援你对东南面意大利与匈牙利部队的进攻。

src: You will have the command over the 30. Army. The Germans hold the only airfield in this area, but the 30. Army has a very experienced engineer troop, which has many experience in buliding airfields.
dst: 你将指挥第30集团军。德军掌握着该地区唯一的机场，但第30集团军拥有一支经验非常丰富的工兵部队，他们在修建机场方面经验颇多。

src: You will have to do it better next time. The Kakies have barely been disturbed by your troops, and they continue their march on Kimberley virtually without opposition. That must change at the Modder River.
dst: 您下次得做得更好才行。英国佬几乎没有被您的部队惊扰到，他们几乎毫无阻拦地继续向金伯利推进。这种情况必须在莫德河改变。

src: You will have to exit 10 units at the retreat hex at the Eastern map edge
dst: 你必须在地图东侧的撤退格撤出10个单位

src: You will have to face indigenous armies, Boer guerrillas and the frightening divisions of the Kaiser. But with faith, skill and courage you will make all of them kneel before the British Empire!
dst: 您将不得不面对土著军队、布尔游击队以及皇帝那令人胆寒的各个师。但凭借信念、技艺和勇气，您将使他们在不列颠帝国面前统统跪下！

src: You will help the Italians by deploying some of your best units.
dst: 您将调出一些最精锐的部队进行部署，以配合意大利人。

src: You will invade the islands of Pantelleria, Lampedusa and Sicily and mainland Italy. Fight at Salerno and Anzio, free the city of Rome and fight all the way to the north and destroy the german defence lines at Monte Cassino. You will take command of troops from many countries in landing operations and battles of combined arms.
dst: 你将入侵潘泰莱里亚岛、兰佩杜萨岛、西西里岛以及意大利本土。在萨莱诺和安齐奥作战，解放罗马城，一路向北推进，摧毁德军在蒙特卡西诺的防线。你将在登陆作战与诸兵种合成战斗中指挥来自多个国家的部队。

src: You will join Lachambre Division in his offensive to recapture Cavite.
dst: 您将加入拉尚布尔师，参与夺回甲米地的攻势。

src: You will join my German forces here, in Prussia, to breakthrough the Polish defenses at Mlawa!  We must act quickly to enable a rapid march to encircle Warsaw.
dst: 你将在普鲁士加入我的德军，突破姆瓦瓦的波军防线！我们必须迅速行动，以便快速推进合围华沙。

src: You will join the Center of our PanzerGruppe as we strike at Sedan and secure a large bridghead.
dst: 你将在我们装甲集群的中路，随我们突击色当并夺取一个大桥头堡。

src: You will lead Bayazetsky (Nikolaev) and Makinsky (Trukhin) Otriady.  Your mission is to swiftly break through the Turkish line toward Van.  May God speed your horses, Gospodin General-Leitenant!
dst: 您将统率巴亚泽特（尼古拉耶夫）和马金（特鲁欣）两个集群。您的任务是迅速突破土军战线向凡城推进。愿上帝让您的战马疾驰，中将阁下！

src: You will lead our forces at the Feodosiya operation. From the Taman peninsula you will land at various places around the town of Feodosiya, which lies on the connection of the Kerch peninsula with the larger Crimean peninsula. The German forces are stretched to defend the coasts but they should be ready to counterattack once you have landed. So be quick, land your forces and attack!
dst: 你将指挥我们的部队执行费奥多西亚行动。从塔曼半岛出发，你将在费奥多西亚镇周围多处登陆，那里位于刻赤半岛与更大的克里米亚半岛的连接处。德军为防守海岸而兵力分散，但一旦你登陆，他们应该会准备反击。所以动作要快，登陆后立即进攻！

src: You will lead our forces at the Kerch operation. From the Taman peninsula you will land at various places around the town of Kerch, on the far east end of the Kerch peninsula, part of the Crimean peninsula. The German forces are stretched to defend the coasts but they should be ready to counterattack once you have landed. So be quick, land your forces and attack!
dst: 你将指挥我们的部队执行刻赤行动。从塔曼半岛出发，你将在刻赤镇周围多处登陆，那里位于刻赤半岛最东端，是克里米亚半岛的一部分。德军为防守海岸而兵力分散，但一旦你登陆，他们应该会准备反击。所以动作要快，登陆后立即进攻！

src: You will lead the LIBERATION of Greece!  The Germans have kept all of our Italian brothers in the Balkans as POW slave labor, many have escaped to join the Greek partisans group - ELAS.
dst: 你将领导希腊的解放！德国人把我们在巴尔干的意大利兄弟全部扣作战俘苦力，许多人已逃脱并加入了希腊游击队——ELAS。

src: You will move to a more familiar ground, quite literally. Army Group Center has been pushed back to the pre-war border; the fighting has shifted to home territory.
dst: 你将移师到更熟悉的土地，字面意义上的。中央集团军群已被压回战前边界；战火转移到了本土。

src: You will not be able to deploy your core ground troops (6.Reserve Division) until later in the scenario.
dst: 在场景后期之前，您将无法部署您的核心地面部队（第6预备师）。

src: You will not be able to upgrade or purchase during this scenario..
dst: 在本场景中你将无法升级或购买单位……

src: You will now hurry to Berlin to prepare the final battle
dst: 您现在要赶往柏林，准备最后一场战斗

src: You will only have your tank army for this job.
dst: 这项任务中你只会拥有你的坦克集团军。

src: You will only have your tank army for this mission, but we have allocated two divisions with bridging engineers to your troops, because the Germans have destroyed the bridges.
dst: 本次任务你只会拥有你的坦克集团军，但我们已为你的部队配属了两个配架桥工兵的师，因为德国人摧毁了桥梁。

src: You will only have your tank army for this mission.
dst: 本次任务你只拥有你的坦克集团军。

src: You will only have your tank army for this mission. The Germans control all two airfields in this area. We have provided an engineer troop to your army. It should be able to build a little airfield in a few days.
dst: 此次任务你只会拥有你的坦克集团军。德军控制着该地区的全部两座机场。我们已为你的集团军提供了一支工兵部队。它应该能在几天内建成一座小型机场。

src: You will only have your tank army for this task.
dst: 这项任务中你只会拥有你的坦克集团军。

src: You will participate in the counterattack with the objective of forcing the Gnila Lipa river and opening the way to capture the Austrian fortress of Lemberg.  The Kiev military district is designated as the primary mobilization district, and you can plan on receiving ample reinforcements for this battle.  You should also be aware that the Austrians have begun redeploying one of their Balkan armies (2nd) to assist in their offensive.
dst: 您将参加反攻，目标是强渡格尼拉利帕河，打开攻取奥地利伦贝格要塞的道路。基辅军区被指定为主要动员区，您可以指望这场战斗获得充足的增援。您还应注意，奥军已开始重新部署其巴尔干集团军之一（第2集团军）来支援其攻势。

src: You will receive a free core jet fighter for field testing and evaluation. HQ awaits your detailed reports within a week!
dst: 你将获得一架免费的核心喷气式战斗机，用于实战测试与评估。总部期待你在一周内提交详细报告！

src: You will receive reinforcements from the Rakvere 5th regiment, supported by Estonia's first armored train.
dst: 您将收到来自拉克韦雷第5团的增援，并得到爱沙尼亚第一列装甲列车的支援。

src: You will reinforce the garrison with some troops under your command and avoid the island to be taken by the Yankees. Given that their final destination is Manila I do not expect a major effort in this mission.
dst: 您将率麾下一些部队增援守军，防止该岛被洋基人占领。鉴于他们的最终目的地是马尼拉，我预计这次任务不会遭遇大规模进攻。

src: You will see, a Legion has everything it needed to operate complete  independent - a genius level of organization, that was not seen for centuries and not reached until modern times...
dst: 你会看到，一个军团自身就具备独立作战所需的一切——一种组织上的天才水准，数百年间未曾再见，直到近代才被超越...

src: You will start this scenario without an airfield, so you may want to build one.
dst: 本场景开局时您没有机场，因此您可能需要修建一座。

src: You will support the main effort with your troops departing from Aguacate, southeast of Cacarajicara.
dst: 您将率部队从卡卡拉希卡拉东南的阿瓜卡特出发，支援主攻方向。

src: You will take command of Hitler's elite bodyguard from the early days as an elite motorised brigade to the epic battles as a fully fledged panzer division.  You will fight through Poland, Holland, France, the Balkans and the Soviet Union, pushing your men to the edge as you prove their skill in battle.
dst: 你将指挥希特勒的精锐卫队，从早期作为精锐摩托化旅，一路成长为完整装甲师，经历一场场史诗战役。你将转战波兰、荷兰、法国、巴尔干和苏联，在证明你部战斗技能的过程中，把你的士兵推向极限。

src: You will take command of the German and Italian units in the second battle of El Alamein. Will you be able to repell the allied attack and launch a counterattack to capture El Alamein and Alexandria? Please note: This is a NO-CORE campaign. Your core will consist of your mobile HQ unit and one heavy tank detachment only.
dst: 你将指挥第二次阿拉曼战役中的德军与意军部队。你能否击退盟军的进攻，并发起反攻夺取阿拉曼与亚历山大？请注意：这是一场无核心部队的战役。你的核心仅由一支机动司令部单位和一支重型坦克分队构成。

src: You'll push northwards towards Ostende on your right flank and Nieuport on your left flank and destroy the Army of Belgium.
dst: 你将向北推进，右翼直指奥斯坦德，左翼直指尼乌波特，并消灭比利时 Army of Belgium。

src: You'll receive a free core H-39-Class battleship prototype. It will be useful in this and the upcomming scenarios.
dst: 你将免费获得一艘 H-39 级战列舰核心原型舰。它在本场景及后续场景中都会很有用。

src: You'll reside in the Far North for quite some time to accomodate yourself with the arctic conditions. You are ordered to train hard and to keep the spirit and endurance of your men high. This doesn't look like a mere occupational duty, especially considering that your air support will be once again strengthened with new machines...
dst: 你将在极北之地驻扎相当长一段时间，以适应北极环境。你受命刻苦训练，并保持部下的斗志与耐力。这看起来已不像是单纯的驻防任务，尤其考虑到你的空中支援将再次以新机种得到加强……

src: You'll take command of our right flank and make a quick counterattack in the villages near Kirk Kilisse. If you manage to defeat and outflank the best units of Bulgarian 3rd Army, they'll have to stop their advance or, at the very least, slow their march. That will give us enough time to prepare a solid defence line.
dst: 您将指挥我们的右翼，在基尔克利塞附近的村庄发动快速反击。如果您能击败并包抄保加利亚第三集团军最精锐的部队，他们就将不得不停止推进，至少也得放慢行军速度。这将给我们足够的时间构筑一条坚固的防线。

src: You're far behind the Polish defense! Coil back to the lines of contact and attack the rear of the enemy!  Air recon says that the Poles are holding the bridge! You must capture it intact, understand?! Once you secure the bridge, follow further south, still further south! Poles are retreating towards you! You must clear the whole area!
dst: 你们已经远远深入波兰防线后方！掉头回到交战线，攻击敌人的后方！空中侦察说波兰人正守着那座桥！你必须完整地把它夺下来，明白吗？！一旦夺取了桥，就继续南下，一直往南！波兰人正朝你们的方向退过来！你必须肃清整片区域！

src: You're far too deep in the mountains! You must reach the rest of brigade! Do you understand?! Move down from the mountains and reach the coast!
dst: 你们深入山区太远了！必须与旅主力会合！明白吗？！从山上下来，抵达海岸！

src: You're not expected to tame the onslaught, just try to hold as much ground as possible. Don't let your supply depots fall into enemy hands, it would be a miserable prerequisite for an inevitable evacuation.
dst: 不指望你压制住这股洪流，只需尽力多守些地盘。切莫让你的补给仓库落入敌手，那将成为随后必然撤离的糟糕前奏。

src: You've been able to stop the Russians. Let's hope that they cease their attacks, for we won't resist much longer.
dst: 您已经能够阻止俄国人。但愿他们停止进攻，因为我们坚持不了多久了。

src: You've defeated the French so quickly that we'll have time to consolidate our positions before they can counterattack. Thanks to you this part of the front will be safe for many months, maybe for years.
dst: 您如此迅速地击败了法军，使我们能在他们反攻之前有时间巩固阵地。多亏了您，这段战线将安全上好几个月，也许好几年。

src: You've done it again, General. Your mission was extremely difficult, but with your heroic march you managed to save most of our Army. Our men are behind safe positions now and the losses have been minimal.
dst: 您又做到了，将军。您的任务极为艰巨，但凭着英勇的进军，您成功拯救了我军大部分兵力。我们的士兵现在已撤至安全阵地后方，损失微乎其微。

src: You've done it! Malta is ours and the war is over! At last, those stubborn British have accepted the offer of a Peace With Honour.
dst: 您做到了！马耳他已是我们的囊中之物，战争结束了！最终，那些顽固的英国人接受了「光荣和平」的提议。

src: You've done it! The French government has chosen to surrender before a second Marxist revolution arises in Europe. I'm not sure if France will be abe to stop the mutinies in time. If they had given up some months ago things would be different for them, but now it's probably too late. Besides, they can't expect any help or mercy from us. We'll make them pay for all these years of suffering.
dst: 您做到了！法国政府选择了投降，以免欧洲爆发第二次马克思主义革命。我不确定法国是否来得及平息那些兵变。要是他们几个月前就放弃，情形对他们会大不一样，但现在恐怕为时已晚。而且，他们也别指望从我们这里得到任何帮助或怜悯。我们要让他们为这些年的苦难付出代价。

src: You've done what best you could have done, but now it is time to retreat. Evacuate the airdrome, then strip the bunkers and depots of everything useful and rush westwards.
dst: 你已尽了最大努力，但现在是撤退的时候了。撤离机场，再搜刮地堡与仓库中一切有用之物，向西疾进。

src: You've done your best, but the enemy defences were too strong. Never mind. Now take a well-deserved rest with your troops. We'll send fresh units to the battle as soon as possible. In a few weeks Kobadin will be taken, and after that the port of Köstence and the railway between that city and Bogazköy will fall easily. Romania will be defeated before the end of this year.
dst: 您已尽了全力，但敌军防线太过坚固。没关系。现在带着您的部队好好休息一下吧，这是您应得的。我们将尽快向战场派遣生力军。几周之内科巴丁就会被攻克，之后康斯坦察港以及该城与博阿兹柯伊之间的铁路都将轻易陷落。罗马尼亚将在今年年底之前被击败。

src: You've done your best. Our enemies are retreating again. Sadly, the price that we've paid is too high. We can't keep on defending the ruins of Görz and the shore of the river, we just don't have enough men for that any more. We must retreat to the mountains, and defend ourselves from higher ground. That means that the Italians will have a solid bridgehead, but there's nothing that we can do about it.
dst: 您已经尽力了。我们的敌人再次撤退。可悲的是，我们付出的代价太高了。我们再也无法守卫戈尔茨的废墟与河岸，我们已没有足够的人手了。我们必须撤往山中，依托高地自守。这意味着意大利人将获得一个稳固的桥头堡，但对此我们无能为力。

src: You've failed and your casualities have been huge, the Americans have triumphed in El Guettar.
dst: 您失败了，伤亡惨重，美国人在盖塔尔取胜。

src: You've failed, but at least our other counterattacks at Bourlon and Fontaine have forced the British to retreat in order to avoid encirclement.
dst: 您失败了，但至少我们在布尔隆和方丹发起的其他反攻已迫使英军为免被围而撤退。

src: You've forced the British to retreat in order to avoid encirclement. Your  audacity has caused the enemy plans to fail again.
dst: 您已迫使英军为免被围而撤退。您的大胆使敌人的计划再度落空。

src: You've fought valiantly, but our flank couldn't hold. Our offensive simply can't continue. We'll have to retreat in order to avoid being encircled and destroyed.
dst: 你们作战英勇，但我们的侧翼没能守住。我们的攻势实在无法继续。我们必须撤退，以免被包围歼灭。

src: You've fought valiantly, but the defences at Orel were too strong. Besides, the Reds have sent reinforcements from the Baltic, and they're about to attack our flank. Our offensive simply can't continue. We'll have to defend ourselves in order to avoid being encircled and destroyed.
dst: 你们作战英勇，但奥廖尔的防御太强了。此外，红军已从波罗的海调来增援，即将进攻我们的侧翼。我们的攻势实在无法继续。我们必须转入防御，以免被包围歼灭。

src: You've got to know when to walk away: farewell to Ufa
dst: 你得知道何时该离开: 告别乌法

src: You've missed the best opportunity that we had to defeat the Italians. Maybe there won't be another one. Now we'll have to go on the defensive again, waiting for the reaction of the Italians, and hoping that we'll be able to stop them just as we've done up to now.
dst: 您错失了击败意大利人的最佳机会。也许不会再有下一次了。如今我们只能再次转入防御，等待意大利人的反应，指望能像迄今所做的那样挡住他们。

src: You've selected the path towards South Afrika, now you have to recapture the Italian Colonies.
dst: 您已选择了通往南非的路线，现在必须夺回意大利殖民地。

src: You've succeeded, but our scouts inform that the Russians reserves will arrive in just a few hours. You must stop your advance, and your troops will have to go back to their starting positions. It's so frustrating... no matter how hard we try; it seems that the defenders of Premissel are doomed.
dst: 您成功了，但我们的侦察兵报告，俄军预备队再过几个小时就会赶到。您必须停止推进，您的部队将不得不返回出发阵地。真是令人沮丧……无论我们多么努力，看来普热梅希尔的守军都在劫难逃。

src: You, the player, can determine which campaign you want to play by moving your unit either south to Gibraltar or southeast towards Tobruk. If you want to play the classical Blitzkrieg! scenario path you should choose Tobruk. If you want to play the campaign called Greater Europe (also originally by H. Craig Miller) you should capture Gibraltar.
dst: 您——玩家——可以通过将部队向南移动至直布罗陀或向东南移动至托布鲁克来决定游玩哪场战役。如果您想游玩经典的闪电战场景路线，应选择托布鲁克。如果您想游玩名为"大欧洲"的战役（同样原由 H. Craig Miller 设计），则应夺取直布罗陀。

src: Young Prince ...! This is a great honor!
dst: 年轻的王子 ...！这是极大的荣誉！

src: Young Prince: For this task you should have enough men at your disposal, and you should have enough prestige to raise a lot of new ones or improve the equipment of your veterans ....
dst: 年轻的王子：为这项任务，你手下应当有足够的人马，也应当有足够的声望来征募大量新兵，或改善老兵的装备 ....

src: Your 22nd Pz has suceeded, but the 21st Pz has failed, the allies now have an uninterrupted bridgehead from Isigny to the Orne. It is quite clear they had hoped to have Cherbourg as a harbour, but your bold actions have prevented that. However, there is no chance whatsoever that we can drive hem back into the sea now.
dst: 您的第22装甲师成功了，但第21装甲师失败了，盟军如今拥有从伊西尼到奥恩河一线连绵不断的桥头堡。很明显他们本希望把瑟堡作为港口，但您的果敢行动使其未能得逞。然而，我们现在已毫无可能把他们赶下海去。

src: Your 29th Division will advance along the ridge, with the 162nd Brigade of the 54th Division moving in protective support along the right flank of the attack. Our main objective is Kidney Hill, the centre of the Turkish defence positions at Kiretch Tepe.
dst: 您的第29师将沿山脊推进，第54师第162旅则沿进攻的右翼跟进提供掩护。我们的主要目标是肾形山，即基雷奇泰佩土耳其军防御阵地的中心。

src: Your 4th Kavallerie Division is part of HKK I on the South flank of the cavalry sweep that is to break through the enemy lines at La Bassee. [XVIII] from 4A, [XXI] from 6A and [XV] from 7A have given up their cavalry units to beef up the strength of your division.
dst: 您的第4骑兵师隶属HKK I，位于骑兵大扫荡的南翼，任务是在拉巴塞突破敌军战线。来自4A的[XVIII]、来自6A的[XXI]和来自7A的[XV]都交出了各自的骑兵部队，以加强您师的实力。

src: Your 4th Kavallerie Division's troops must once again cover the flank.
dst: 您的第4骑兵师部队必须再次掩护侧翼。

src: Your Australian troops have been given the task of taking Lone Pine while the New Zealanders will attack Chanik Bair following a feint attack by the Australian Light Horse Brigade. Capturing these objectives is of the highest priority!!
dst: 您的澳大利亚部队受命夺取独松，而新西兰人将在澳大利亚轻骑兵旅的一次佯攻之后进攻查尼克拜尔。夺取这些目标是当务之急！！

src: Your Branderburgers have the important mission to land in England and destroy the British HQ at Canterbury. Then they must capture Ramsgate airfield in the north, destroy the Radar and escape before enemy reinfocements arrive. It will be not easy. The same time your ships must stop enemy attack at Calais. Luftwaffe will support you at this hard mission.
dst: 你的勃兰登堡部队有一项重要任务：在英格兰登陆并摧毁坎特伯雷的英军司令部。随后他们必须夺取北面的拉姆斯盖特机场，摧毁雷达，并在敌军增援抵达前撤离。这并不容易。与此同时，你的舰艇必须在加来阻止敌军进攻。德国空军将在这场艰难的任务中支援你。

src: Your Brazilian units have been ordered to move along the river Serchio and clear the valley before they can link up with the rest of your army.
dst: 你的巴西部队已奉命沿塞尔基奥河推进，肃清河谷，之后才能与你的其余部队会合。

src: Your Cavalry Army has taken part of the push south of Kiev and is now in excellent position to cut off the capitalist's troops still in Kiev.  The Twelfth Army is approaching Kiev from the east.  The Polish criminals have no respect for the property of the Kiev people and are likely to demolish the bridges and perhaps even more!  You are ordered to liberate Kiev, and join up with Twelfth Army and advance as far as you can to the west!
dst: 您的骑兵集团军参与了基辅以南的推进，现在正处于切断仍盘踞基辅的资本家部队退路的绝佳位置。第十二集团军正从东面逼近基辅。波兰罪犯毫不尊重基辅人民的财产，很可能炸毁桥梁，甚至更多！您奉命解放基辅，与第十二集团军会合，并尽可能向西推进！

src: Your Core was just augumented by an artillery unit. Infantry units should trade old Werndl rifles for modern Mannlichers. Another infantry should be purchased.
dst: 您的核心部队刚刚补充了一个炮兵单位。步兵单位应将旧的韦恩德尔步枪换成现代化的曼利夏步枪。还应再购买一支步兵。

src: Your Corps is ordered to swing north and capture the vital Channel Ports.
dst: 你的军奉命转向北方，夺取至关重要的海峡港口。

src: Your Das Reich division is part of Guderian's 2nd Panzer Gruppe. Your troops have covered more than 700km in a bit over 2 weeks since Operation Barbarossa started but have not seen much action yet.
dst: 你的“帝国”师隶属古德里安的第2装甲集群。自“巴巴罗萨”行动开始以来，你的部队在两周多一点的时间里已推进700多公里，但尚未经历多少战斗。

src: Your First Army will attack northwards, assisted by the V Cavalry Corps by infiltrating through less guarded Greek positions in Kirka valley, and coming behind the Greek front lines. At the same time, our Second Army will attack westwards.
dst: 您的第一集团军将向北进攻，第五骑兵军则通过克尔卡谷地守备较弱的希腊阵地渗透，绕到希腊军前线后方予以配合。同时，我们的第二集团军将向西进攻。

src: Your HQ at: Salas, Asturias, October 1936
dst: 您的司令部设于：阿斯图里亚斯，萨拉斯，1936年10月

src: Your Highness, I regret to inform you that the disembark at Toulon has failed. Most of our elite troops have died or have been taken, including their leader. Undr these circumstances, I believe that we should cease all our current military operations. The outcome of the war will depend entirely on wether the Germans can defeat the French in the Marne and in Flandern.
dst: 殿下，我很遗憾地告知您，土伦登陆已经失败。我们的大部分精锐部队不是阵亡就是被俘，包括他们的指挥官在内。在这种情况下，我认为我们应当停止当前所有的军事行动。战争的结局将完全取决于德国人能否在马恩河和佛兰德击败法国人。

src: Your II Panzergruppe has been redesignated II Panzer Army.
dst: 你的第2装甲集群已改称第2装甲集团军。

src: Your Orders are to repell all attacks and launch your counterattack. Your final objective will be the city of Sigulda in the southwest.
dst: 你的命令是击退所有进攻并发起反击。最终目标是西南部的锡古尔达城。

src: Your XIX Corps has been redesignated II Panzergruppe and is to take part in the opening thrusts of the invasion of the Soviet Union as part of Army Group Centre. We expect that Pioneers will be able to build a temporary airfield for the Luftwaffe so they can keep up with your advance and Bridging Pioneers have been tasked with building Pontoon bridges so your troops can skirt to the south and east of Brest to avoid delays.
dst: 你的第19军已改称第2装甲集群，将作为中央集团军群的一部分，参加入侵苏联的开局突击。我们预计工兵能为德国空军修建一座临时机场，好让他们跟得上你的推进；架桥工兵已受命架设浮桥，让你的部队可以绕到布列斯特以南和以东，以免延误。

src: Your XX Corps has broken through Allied lines. Trieste and Littorio are on route for Beirut and Ariete is moving on Damascus. DAK has taken Amman and is routing Russian forces on its way to Baghdad. Meanwhile X and XXI Corps continue their drive South along the Nile, have taken Khartoum without much resistance and have started the attack on Adis Abeba.
dst: 你的第20军已突破盟军防线。“的里雅斯特”师和“利托里奥”师正开赴贝鲁特，“公羊”师正向大马士革推进。非洲军已夺取安曼，并在向巴格达途中击溃俄军。与此同时，第10军和第21军继续沿尼罗河南下，未遇多少抵抗就夺取了喀土穆，并已开始进攻亚的斯亚贝巴。

src: Your achievements were noticed. Once back in Reich, you will be promoted and you'll take a command of a newly formed motorised brigade. The attached air support will double in size, and the pilots will be honoured to fly a prototype machines.
dst: 你的战绩已被注意。一旦回到帝国，你将获晋升，并执掌一支新组建的摩托化旅。配属的空中支援将扩编一倍，飞行员们也将有幸驾驶原型机。

src: Your achievements were noticed. Once back in Reich, you will be promoted and you'll take a command of a newly formed motorised brigade. The attached air support will double in size.
dst: 你的战绩已被注意。一旦回到帝国，你将获晋升，并执掌一支新组建的摩托化旅。配属的空中支援将扩编一倍。

src: Your action during this battle of maneuver showed the German command that taking large tactical risks may not be wise.
dst: 您在这次机动会战中的行动向德军指挥部表明，冒太大的战术风险或许并不明智。

src: Your actions during these weeks of war have been impressive. You've showed great competence commanding large ammounts of troops and you've definitely earned your promotion to General.
dst: 这几周战争期间您的行动令人印象深刻。您在指挥大量部队时表现出了卓越的能力，毫无疑问赢得了晋升将军的资格。

src: Your actions lead to a complete failure of our plans. Von Kluck had to more and more divisions of the First Armee back to the NW to repulse the attack of the French Sixth Army.
dst: 您的行动导致我方计划彻底失败。冯·克卢克不得不将第1集团军越来越多的师调回西北方向，以击退法军第6集团军的进攻。

src: Your advance was slower than we expected, but at least you could force El Raisuli to retreat. Maybe his defeat will finally convince him that he'd better see Spain as an ally not an enemy. At least, I hope that. El Raisuli's cooperation would make our tasks in Morocco much easier.
dst: 您的推进比我们预期的要慢，但至少您迫使赖苏利撤退了。也许这次失败终于能让他明白，最好把西班牙当作盟友而非敌人。至少我希望如此。赖苏利的合作将使我们在摩洛哥的任务轻松得多。

src: Your and your men will continue with my panzergruppe as we drive to the channel and victory!
dst: 你和你的人将随我的装甲集群继续前进，直扑海峡、夺取胜利！

src: Your are ordered to take command of your old regiment that is located south of us: SS Regiment Der Fuehrer. Your task is to assist 9th Pz Div in its drive towards The Hague accross the bridges captured by Student's troops.
dst: 你奉命接管位于我们以南的你原来的团：党卫军“元首”团。你的任务是协助第9装甲师经施图登特部队夺取的桥梁向海牙推进。

src: Your are ordered to use the railroads to reach Samara on the Volga River. No doubt the Soviets will attempt to slow you down on the way to buy time to prepare defenses of Samara. You veterans must overcome all difficulties and clear Samara from Bolsheviks.
dst: 您奉命利用铁路抵达伏尔加河畔的萨马拉。毫无疑问，苏维埃会设法在路上拖延您，以争取时间准备萨马拉的防御。你们这些老兵必须克服一切困难，把布尔什维克从萨马拉清除掉。

src: Your army arrived at the Harz Mountain Range. The last defenders between us and the Elbe river have entrenched in the mountains. Additionaly, the Germans have formed a new Panzer Division which is equiped with prototypes. They will try to stop our army's advance. The division is experienced but they lack the strength. Intel reports that they are stationed east of Braunschweig.
dst: 你的军队已抵达哈茨山脉（Harz Mountain Range）。我们与易北河之间最后的守军已在山中构筑了工事。此外，德军还组建了一个装备原型车的新装甲师。他们会设法阻止我军推进。该师经验丰富，但兵力不足。情报显示他们驻扎在不伦瑞克（Braunschweig）以东。

src: Your army fields two supply/healer units in this scenario as well as a staionary hospital tent. Use them to heal and supply your adjacent units.
dst: 你的军队在本场景中拥有两个补给/医疗单位，以及一顶固定医院帐篷。用它们来治疗和补给相邻单位。

src: Your army fields two supply/healer units in this scenario as well as a stationary hospital tent. Use them to heal and supply your adjacent units.
dst: 你的军队在本场景中拥有两个补给/医疗单位以及一顶固定医院帐篷。用它们来治疗并补给相邻的部队。

src: Your arrival has been kept a secret, so you'll be able to surprise the Australian divisions that guard the area. Yesterday our sturmtruppen took strategical positions on the eastern shore of the kanal, paving the way for your final attack. Go,  Feldmarschall, and good luck. This could be the last battle of this war.
dst: 您的到来一直秘而不宣，所以您能够出其不意地打击守卫该地区的澳大利亚各师。昨天，我们的突击部队已在运河东岸占据了战略位置，为您的最后进攻铺平了道路。去吧，陆军元帅，祝您好运。这或许是这场战争的最后一战。

src: Your arrival has been providential, General. This new British offensive has caught us by surprise and now all the front is in danger. Even the Siegfriedstellung could fall if we don't find a way to counterattack.
dst: 您的到来真是天意，将军。英军的这场新攻势打了我们一个措手不及，如今整条战线都岌岌可危。如果我们找不到反攻的办法，连齐格飞防线都可能失守。

src: Your assault on Yugoslavia and Greece was blitzkrieg in its most powerful sense. Due to your spectacular success, we have decided to appoint you to command a very special operation.
dst: 你对南斯拉夫与希腊的进攻是闪击战最有力的体现。鉴于你取得的辉煌战果，我们决定委任你指挥一次极为特殊的行动。

src: Your assault on the city will be staged from three directions.  To the north, your immediate task is to capture the rail depot of Peltes and to deploy your Soomusrong.  The city of Riga bristles with fortifications built over centuries and modernized during WWI by the Russians.  Carefully choose your axis of advance!  To the south and east you must use cunning maneuver to support your armored assault.  The Freikorps have reorganized outside of Cesis, and their retreating units can be a severe danger on the flanks of our troops.
dst: 您对这座城市的进攻将从三个方向展开。在北面，您的当务之急是夺取佩尔特斯的铁路枢纽并部署您的装甲列车。里加城遍布历经数百年修建、又在第一次世界大战期间由俄国人加以现代化的防御工事。请慎重选择您的进攻轴线！在南面和东面，您必须运用灵活的机动来支援您的装甲突击。自由军团已在采西斯外围重新集结，其撤退中的部队可能对我军两翼构成严重威胁。

src: Your attack broke the communists and as we speak our forces assemble to march on Madrid!
dst: 你的进攻击垮了共产党人，就在我们说话之际，我们的部队正在集结，准备向马德里进军！

src: Your attack broke the communists just in time and as we speak our forces assemble to march on Madrid!
dst: 你的进攻及时击垮了共产党人，就在我们说话之际，我们的部队正在集结，准备向马德里进军！

src: Your attack failed to reach its goals. Your services are no longer required.
dst: 您的进攻未能达成目标。您已不再被需要。

src: Your attack has been a disaster, but we can't afford retreating. If we do, the war will be lost. We'll keep pushing forward until we reach Damietta, but that'll be a task for a new, more gifted commander. Consider yourself relieved of all your duties. Go back home and try to enjoy your retirement.
dst: 您的进攻是一场灾难，但我们不能撤退。一旦撤退，战争就输定了。我们将继续向前推进，直到抵达达米埃塔，但那将交给一位新的、更有天赋的指挥官去完成。您已被解除全部职务。回家去吧，好好享受您的退役生活。

src: Your attack has been a disaster, but we can't afford retreating. If we do, the war will be lost. We'll keep pushing forward until we reach Dieppe, but that'll be a task for a new, more gifted commander. Consider yourself relieved of all your duties. Go back home and try to enjoy your retirement.
dst: 您的进攻是一场灾难，但我们不能撤退。一旦撤退，战争就输定了。我们将继续向前推进，直到抵达迪耶普，但那将交给一位新的、更有天赋的指挥官去完成。您已被解除全部职务。回家去吧，好好享受您的退役生活。

src: Your attack has been a disaster, but we can't afford retreating. If we do, the war will be lost. We'll keep pushing forward until we reach Orléans, but that'll be a task for a new, more gifted commander. Consider yourself relieved of all your duties. Go back home and try to enjoy your retirement.
dst: 您的进攻是一场灾难，但我们不能撤退。一旦撤退，战争就输定了。我们将继续向前推进，直到抵达奥尔良，但那将交给一位新的、更有天赋的指挥官去完成。您已被解除全部职务。回家去吧，好好享受您的退役生活。

src: Your attack has been a disaster, but we can't afford retreating. If we do, the war will be lost. We'll keep pushing forward until we reach the Aisne, but that'll be a task for a new, more gifted commander. Consider yourself relieved of all your duties. Go back home and try to enjoy your retirement.
dst: 您的进攻是一场灾难，但我们不能撤退。一旦撤退，战争就输定了。我们将继续向前推进，直到抵达埃纳河，但那将交给一位新的、更有天赋的指挥官去完成。您已被解除全部职务。回家去吧，好好享受您的退役生活。

src: Your attack has been a disaster. At least the Germans have taken the Sueskanal and soon the British will sign a peace treaty. However, your mishap at Malta shows that it's time for you to go back home and enjoy your retirement. You've been one of our best commanders, but now we need new, younger leaders.
dst: 您的进攻是一场灾难。至少德国人夺取了苏伊士运河，英国不久也将签订和平条约。然而，您在马耳他的失利表明，现在是您回家安享退休生活的时候了。您曾是我们最优秀的指挥官之一，但现在我们需要新的、更年轻的将领。

src: Your attack impaled itself on the communists, as we speak our forces retire to regroup and survive the winter.
dst: 你的进攻在共产党人面前撞得头破血流，就在我们说话之际，我们的部队正后撤重整，以熬过这个冬天。

src: Your attack left the Belgian army in disarray. Their troops are pulling back towards Antwerp, leaving the road to Paris wide open.
dst: 您的进攻使比利时军队陷入混乱。他们的部队正撤往安特卫普，从而把通往巴黎的道路完全敞开。

src: Your attack on Constantinople has failed!! You are hereby relieved of your command!!
dst: 您对君士坦丁堡的进攻失败了！！您特此被解除指挥权！！

src: Your attack on Tienen has failed, but to the North of, II Corps has more success with its attacks and now the Belgian Army is pulling back towards Antwerp, leaving the road to Paris wide open.
dst: 您对蒂嫩的进攻失败了，但其北面，第2军的进攻更为成功，如今比利时陆军正向安特卫普撤退，通向巴黎的道路完全敞开。

src: Your attack on the Ardennes was a dismal failure. Not only did it fall far short of its ultimate goal of forcing the Allies to sue for peace, but the resources we wasted will no longer be available for the defense of the homeland.
dst: 你对阿登的进攻是一次惨败。它不仅远未达成迫使盟军求和这一最终目标，而且我们为此浪费的资源再也无法用于本土防御。

src: Your attack on the coastal guns was extraordinary!! The way is clear for us now.
dst: 您对海岸炮台的攻击非常出色！！现在道路对我们畅通了。

src: Your attack was a dismal failure!!! Your are relieved of your command!!
dst: 您的进攻是场惨败！！！您已被解除指挥权！！

src: Your attack was botched. Fortunately, your fail has no role. The war is over despite your performance. I think you are war-weary. For operations in the future we will give unspent generals a chance.
dst: 你的进攻搞砸了。所幸，你的失败无关紧要。尽管你表现如此，战争还是结束了。我想你是厌战了。为了未来的作战，我们会给那些尚未被起用的将军们一个机会。

src: Your attack was quite an achievement considering the odds against you; unfortunately, it fell short of its ultimate aim of forcing the Allies to sue for peace.
dst: 考虑到敌我力量悬殊，你的进攻已是相当可观的战果；遗憾的是，它未能达成迫使盟军求和的最终目标。

src: Your attack was so successful that not only the 5th Pz.Rgt. and 8th Mg.Btn. were saved. You also captured Generals Lavarack and Morshead at Fort Pilastrino.
dst: 你的进攻如此成功，不仅救出了第5装甲团和第8机枪营，还在皮拉斯特里诺堡俘获了拉瓦拉克将军和莫斯黑德将军。

src: Your attack was swift and decisive, worthy of being written into the history in the true samurai tradition.
dst: 您的进攻迅速而果断，堪称武士道传统，足以载入史册。

src: Your battalion received its first three Tigers, but they immediatelly ran into the problems in the muddy terrain and now are bogged down. You need to disrupt the Soviet line of defense, attack into the enemy rear, capture the local HQ, and most importantly - recover the lost Tigers!
dst: 你的营接收了首批三辆虎式，但它们立即在泥泞地形中出了状况，如今陷入泥沼动弹不得。你需要撕开苏军防线、突入敌后、夺取当地指挥部，而最重要的是——救回那些丢失的虎式！

src: Your battalion was crucial in this mission, but the Pz II tanks are starting to show their weakness. For the upcoming operations you will receive a mix of Pz IIIs, some of them repaired, some of them brand new.
dst: 你的营在此役中举足轻重，但二号坦克已开始显露疲态。为接下来的行动，你将接收一批三号坦克，有些是修复的，有些是全新的。

src: Your battalion, recently refitted with many new Panthers, was chosen for the upcoming attack against Narva bridgeheads. Commanded by Hyacinth Graf Strachwitz, our group must break through the firmly held lines of the Soviet 109th Rifle Corps, capture the enemy HQ, and hold it long enough for the main forces of the 170th, 11th, and 227th Infantry Divisions to follow in your tracks and entrench themselves.
dst: 你的营近来换装了许多新黑豹，被选中参加对纳尔瓦桥头堡的进攻。在海因里希·格拉夫·施特拉赫维茨指挥下，我军集群必须突破苏军第109步兵军据守的坚固防线，夺取敌指挥部，并坚守足够久，好让第170、第11和第227步兵师的主力循你开辟的道路跟进并掘壕固守。

src: Your battle group will land at dawn along with the 26th Infantry Division at Portsmouth. This area form the westernmost section of the invasion front and your goal is to take the Port of Portsmouth and to reach Southampton in the west. The landing of the second wave, in your section the 4th Panzer-Division, is scheduled 24 hours after the start of the invasion.
dst: 你的战斗群将于黎明时分与第26步兵师一同在朴次茅斯登陆。这一区域构成入侵战线的最西段，你的目标是夺取朴次茅斯港，并向西抵达南安普敦。第二波登陆——你这一段的第4装甲师——定于入侵开始24小时后进行。

src: Your blitzkrieg through Belgium was most impressive and has given us a great opportunity to conquer France in time for an assault on England this year.
dst: 你在比利时的闪击战极为出色，为我们及时征服法国、以便在今年进攻英国提供了绝佳机会。

src: Your bold attack crushed the communists and as we speak our forces march on Madrid!
dst: 你果敢的进攻击垮了共产党人，就在我们说话之际，我们的部队正向马德里挺进！

src: Your bravery in combat has allowed us to evacuate His Majesty and a fair number of troops to safety. Now we must learn from our mistakes and transform our volunteers into an army worthy of that name. The Liberal government is weak, and soon we will have a new opportunity to face it.
dst: 您在战斗中的英勇使我们得以把国王陛下和相当数量的部队撤到安全地带。如今我们必须从错误中吸取教训，把我们的志愿者改造成一支名副其实的军队。自由派政府软弱无能，很快我们就会有新的机会与它一决高下。

src: Your brigade has been assigned to the 'Northern Front', and as such will begin the march into Eritrea.  The Italians have abandoned their border defences for better defensive positions in the mountains around Agordat.  Agordat is a vital junction of Eritrea: here pass the roads to Keren, Asmara, and the sea. The strategic importance of this town is confirmed by the two important battles that took place here in that dry and inaccessible zone in 1890 and 1893.
dst: 你的旅已被编入“北路”，将开始向厄立特里亚进军。意大利人已放弃边境防御，转而占据阿戈尔达特周边山区更有利的防御阵地。阿戈尔达特是厄立特里亚的交通枢纽：通往克伦、阿斯马拉和大海的道路都经过此地。1890年和1893年在这片干旱难达之地发生的两场重要战役，印证了此城的战略地位。

src: Your brilliance on the battlefield is exceeding even the most optimistic predictions at the Ministry.
dst: 您在战场上的出色表现，甚至超出了陆军部最乐观的预期。

src: Your brilliant defence of the island has made fail the yankee attempt to conquer a part of the Spanish Empire.
dst: 您对这座岛屿的出色防御，挫败了洋基人征服西班牙帝国一部分的企图。

src: Your brilliant defence of the island has made fail the yankee attempt to gain control over a part of the Spanish Empire.
dst: 您对这座岛屿的出色防御，挫败了洋基人控制西班牙帝国一部分的企图。

src: Your brilliant defence of the island has made fail the yankee attempt to gain full control over a part of the Spanish Empire.
dst: 您对这座岛屿的出色防御，挫败了洋基人完全控制西班牙帝国一部分的企图。

src: Your brilliant defence strategy has saved our army from an inminent disaster. If it weren't by you, most of our forces would have been annihilated, and even Melilla would be in great danger. Even though we have to mourn the death of brave General Silvestre, shot at Annual by an enemy sniper, this is a day of glory for the Spanish army.
dst: 您出色的防御策略使我军免于一场迫在眉睫的灾难。如果没有您，我们的大部分部队早就被歼灭，连梅利利亚都会陷入极大的危险。尽管我们不得不哀悼在安瓦勒被敌方狙击手射杀的英勇的西尔维斯特雷将军，但这仍是西班牙军队光荣的一天。

src: Your capture of Sevastopol on schedule deserves praise for a job well done.
dst: 你按期攻克塞瓦斯托波尔，任务完成出色，值得嘉奖。

src: Your capture of Washington has allowed us to negotiate a favorable peace treaty with the Americans. But, their ability to create and test an atomic bomb has kept us from uniting North America and Europe. Your brilliant leadership throughout this war will long be remembered in the coming years of peace.
dst: 你攻占华盛顿，使我们得以与美国人谈判达成一项有利的和约。但是，他们制造并试爆原子弹的能力，使我们未能把北美与欧洲统一起来。你在这场战争全程中展现的卓越指挥，将在未来的和平岁月里长久为人们所铭记。

src: Your cavalry is needed north!  If you sweep northwards and cut into the right flank of the Polish offensive we might again turn the tide and Poland will be liberated from their reactionary capitalists!
dst: 北方需要您的骑兵！如果您挥师北上，切入波兰攻势的右翼，我们或许能再次扭转战局，把波兰从他们的反动资本家手中解放出来！

src: Your command has switched from SS Regiment Deutschland to SS Regiment Der Fuehrer which is attached to the 207th ID. This division will cross the border with the help of two armoured trains, break through the Grebbe Defensive Line and capture the city of Utrecht in the heart of the Netherlands.
dst: 你的指挥权已从党卫军“德意志”团转到配属第207步兵师的党卫军“元首”团。该师将在两列装甲列车的协助下越过边境，突破格勒贝防线，并夺取荷兰腹地的乌得勒支城。

src: Your command was brilliant, and it was decided that you'll get another Panthers to equip a second company with them. Rest of the Pz IV tanks are thought to be quite formidable... for the moment.
dst: 你的指挥堪称出色，遂决定再给你一批黑豹，装备第二个连。其余四号坦克，眼下也被认为相当强悍……不过只是眼下而已。

src: Your command was mediocre at the very best, and it was only reluctantly allowed to equip another company with Panthers. Rest of your tanks will remain the Pz IVs.
dst: 你的指挥充其量算平庸，只是勉强获准再用黑豹装备一个连。其余坦克仍将是四号。

src: Your command was successfull, and it was decided that you'll get another Panthers to equip a second company with them. Rest of the Pz IV tanks are thought to be quite formidable... for the moment.
dst: 你的指挥很成功，遂决定再给你一批黑豹，装备第二个连。其余四号坦克，眼下也被认为相当强悍……不过只是眼下而已。

src: Your comrades need help. Karl Artelt and Lothar Popp, leader of the revolt and USPD members, stand by your side. Go in and win!!
dst: 你们的同志们需要帮助。起义领袖、独立社会民主党成员卡尔·阿特尔特和洛塔尔·波普站在你们这一边。冲进去，取得胜利！！

src: Your conduct of this operation has been admirable, General! You brought your troops ashore, overrun the surprised enemy and reached the high ground of Tekke Tepe. Unfortunately, the Turks have responded quickly and we had to retreat from the heights when two new Turkish divisions appeared on the scene.
dst: 将军，您指挥这次行动的表现令人钦佩！您率部队上岸，击溃了猝不及防的敌人，抵达了泰克泰佩高地。不幸的是，土耳其人反应迅速，当土耳其两个新师出现在战场上时，我们不得不从高地撤退。

src: Your core consists of the air assets of Armee Gruppe Meuse and troops from Kavallerie Division 4 that are leading the advance into Belgium.
dst: 您的核心由默兹集团军群的空中力量以及率先挺进比利时的第4骑兵师部队组成。

src: Your core forces are part of the offensive right wing moving into Belgium. Can you make von Moltke's plan work?
dst: 您的核心部队是正挺进比利时的进攻性右翼的一部分。您能让冯·毛奇的计划成功吗？

src: Your core units from XX Corps: Ariete, Littorio and Trieste. Your task is to contain and repulse the enemy attacks.
dst: 你来自第20军的核心单位：“公羊”、“利托里奥”和“的里雅斯特”。你的任务是牵制并击退敌军进攻。

src: Your core was just augmented by an artillery unit. Infantry units should trade old Werndl rifles for modern Mannlichers. Another infantry should be purchased.
dst: 您的核心部队刚刚补充了一个炮兵单位。步兵单位应将旧的韦恩德尔步枪换成现代化的曼利夏步枪。还应再购买一支步兵。

src: Your core will consist of two units only throughout the whole campaign. A heavy tank detachment and a HQ (Must-Survice-Unit).
dst: 你的核心部队在整个战役中仅由两个单位组成。一个重型坦克支队与一个司令部（必须存活单位）。

src: Your corps did excellent!  You completed the victory of the destruction of two Soviet armies!  The lines of POW's marching west seem endless.
dst: 你的军表现卓越！你完成了歼灭两个苏军集团军的胜利！向西行进的一队队战俘望不到头。

src: Your corps did it!  You completed the victory of the destruction of two Soviet armies!  The lines of POW's marching west will bring satifaction to your many wounded.
dst: 你的军做到了！你完成了歼灭两个苏军集团军的胜利！向西行进的一队队战俘，将给你众多伤员带来慰藉。

src: Your corps did well!  You completed the victory of the destruction of two Soviet armies!  The lines of POW's marching west seem endless, they hearten your wounded that move back to our rest areas.
dst: 你的军干得好！你完成了歼灭两个苏军集团军的胜利！向西行进的一队队战俘望不到头，鼓舞着撤回休整区的伤员们。

src: Your corps was key in our success, your cooperation with General Guderian was amazing, never have I seen two country's forces work so closely together!
dst: 你的军是我们成功的关键，你与古德里安将军的配合令人惊叹，我从未见过两国的军队如此紧密地协同！

src: Your corps was key in our success, your cooperation with General Guderian was impressive, you have shown how two country's forces can work closely together!
dst: 你的军是我们成功的关键，你与古德里安将军的配合令人印象深刻，你展示了两个国家的军队能如何紧密协同！

src: Your counterattacks did not achieve much, but at least the British attacks got contained and thus their offensive was a failure.
dst: 您的反攻收效甚微，但至少遏制住了英军的进攻，因此他们的攻势以失败告终。
