src: Your counterattacks were a complete failure. Luckily the British did not succeed in penetrating our second defensive line and a breakthrough was avoided.
dst: 您的反攻彻底失败了。幸运的是英军未能突破我们的第二道防线，避免了一次突破。

src: Your country has been too ambitious, or too imprudent, in this fateful summer of 1914. Nobody thinks that Germany will be able to win a long war fighting on two separate fronts at the same time. Defeat seems inevitable. And that's what will happen, if one unexpected factor doesn't enter the scene: you.
dst: 在这个决定命运的1914年之夏，您的国家过于野心勃勃，或者说过于轻率了。没有人认为德国能在两条互不相连的战线上同时作战并赢得一场长期战争。失败似乎不可避免。而这确实会发生——除非有一个意想不到的因素登场：您。

src: Your critical assessment of the lack of a winter support plan at the staff meeting got you thrown out!
dst: 你在参谋会议上对冬季支援计划缺失的尖锐批评，让你被赶了出去！

src: Your critical assessment that two simultaneous campaigns are beyond Italy's capabilities at the meeting got you thrown out!
dst: 你在会议上尖锐指出同时进行两场战役超出意大利的能力，这让你被赶了出去！

src: Your daring attack failed and has severly reduced your forces. You are relieved of your command!!
dst: 您大胆的进攻失败了，您的部队损失惨重。您已被解除指挥权！！

src: Your defeat at Pskov is a disappointment.  Your troops were saved from disaster by the arrival of Yudenich's further reinforcements.  Despite this serious setback, General Yudenich has announced his goals for a most ambitious operation:  the capture of Petrograd.
dst: 您在普斯科夫的失败令人失望。您的部队幸得尤登尼奇后续援军赶到，才免于灭顶之灾。尽管遭受了这一严重挫折，尤登尼奇将军仍宣布了他一个极富雄心的作战目标：夺取彼得格勒。

src: Your defeat at the hands of the British could have cost us dearly. We're lucky that they haven't been able to exploit their initial success, so we could mobilize our reserves in time. You must learn to be careful, and don't be overconfident: there will be more attacks.
dst: 您败在英军手中，这险些让我们付出沉重代价。幸运的是他们未能利用初期的战果，所以我们得以及时调动预备队。您必须学会谨慎，不要过于自信：还会有更多进攻。

src: Your defeat has allowed the Russians to continue their advance threatening our very existence.  Your services are no longer needed.
dst: 你的失败使苏军得以继续推进，威胁到我们的生存。你的职务已不再需要。

src: Your defeat is explicable yet most unwelcome. Don't expect much favour in close future...
dst: 你的失败情有可原，却最不受欢迎。近期别指望有什么优待了……

src: Your defence strategy has saved a great portion of our army from an imminent disaster. If it weren't for you, most of our forces would have been annihilated, and even Melilla would be in great danger. Even though we have to mourn the death of brave General Silvestre, shot at Annual by an enemy sniper, and the loss of thousands of soldiers, this is a day for hope and relief.
dst: 您的防御策略使我军的大部分部队免于一场迫在眉睫的灾难。如果没有您，我们的大部分部队早就被歼灭，连梅利利亚都会陷入极大的危险。尽管我们不得不哀悼在安瓦勒被敌方狙击手射杀的英勇的西尔维斯特雷将军，以及成千上万名士兵的阵亡，但这仍是充满希望与宽慰的一天。

src: Your defense of France was adequate; unfortunately, the Allies have broken out of Normandy and are advancing across France.
dst: 你对法国的防御尚属合格；遗憾的是，盟军已突穿诺曼底，正横越法国推进。

src: Your defense of France was disappointing and has allowed the Allies to race across the countryside. Your leadership must soon improve.
dst: 你在法国的防御令人失望，使盟军得以在乡野间长驱直入。你的指挥很快必须有所改观。

src: Your defense of France was disappointing, however, due to your previous successes, we have decided to allow you to honorably retire from service.
dst: 你在法国的防御令人失望，但鉴于你此前的战功，我们决定允许你体面地退出现役。

src: Your defense of Normandy was outstanding.
dst: 你对诺曼底的防御表现出色。

src: Your defense of the Italian mainland was satisfactory. To date, you have done a reasonable job defending Southern Italy, but unfortunately, the Allies have been able to fight their way onto the Italian mainland.
dst: 你对意大利本土的防御尚称合格。迄今为止，你对意大利南部的防守还算可以，但遗憾的是，盟军还是杀上了意大利本土。

src: Your defense was impressive, but the British are too strong and you have no chance of a prologued resistance. You must retreat to safer positions at Latema Nek.
dst: 您的防御令人印象深刻，但英军过于强大，您没有进行持久抵抗的机会。您必须撤退到拉特马内克的更安全阵地。

src: Your delay at Bitola means that our victory in the Balkans will take longer and will be harder. At least the Bulgarians have won the day near the Doiran Lake and are ready to attack Thessaloniki. We still have a chance to take Athen, but we'd better choose an officer with more determination. Von Hutier will replace you, and you'll be sent to the Italian front, where I hope you'll show that you've learnt from your mistakes.
dst: 您在比托拉的延误意味着我们在巴尔干的胜利将耗时更长、更加艰难。至少保加利亚人已在多伊兰湖附近获胜，并准备进攻塞萨洛尼基。我们仍有机会拿下雅典，但最好换一位意志更坚定的军官。冯·胡蒂尔将接替您，而您将被派往意大利战线，希望您在那里能证明自己已从错误中吸取教训。

src: Your delay leaves us in a difficult diplomatic situation with Ukraine. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs wants you removed from your command . Fortunately the Army is able to coverup this scandal.
dst: 您的拖延使我们在与乌克兰的外交上陷入困境。外交部希望解除您的指挥权。幸运的是，军方能够掩盖这一丑闻。

src: Your delay leaves us in a difficult diplomatic situation with Ukraine. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs wants you removed from your command and I'm afraid that the Army won't be able to coverup this scandal. For the sake of us all, you'd better resign.
dst: 您的拖延使我们在与乌克兰的外交上陷入困境。外交部希望解除您的指挥权，而我担心军方将无法掩盖这一丑闻。为了我们大家，您最好辞职。

src: Your destruction of our army here was so costly we have withdrawn from Tunisia!
dst: 你在这里对我军的歼灭代价如此沉重，我们已经撤出了突尼斯！

src: Your destrustion of the British hold on Malta will ensure to Marshall Graziani's success in North Africa!
dst: 你摧毁英军对马耳他的控制，必将确保格拉齐亚尼元帅在北非的成功！

src: Your division and the other divisions of HKK I and II will be relieved by the 13th and 14th ID of the 6th Armee. Move your troops North to support HKK IV near Messines - just South of Ypres.
dst: 您的师以及HKK第一、第二军的其他师将由第六集团军的第十三、十四步兵师接防。将您的部队向北调动，支援梅森附近——伊普尔正南方的HKK第四军。

src: Your division avoided a captivity only so so, and now you retreat towards the Reich proper. Where will be your last stand?
dst: 你的师勉强逃过被俘的命运，如今正撤向帝国本土。你的最后一战将在何处？

src: Your division has been transferred from Guderian's 2nd Pz Gruppe - South of us - to Hoepner's 4 Pz Gruppe for the final drive on Moscow. Our first task is to break through the Russian lines, following the 10Pz Div and move North to Vyazma to make contact with Hoth's 3rd Pz Gruppe North of us and encirle the Russian 16th, 19th and 20th Soviet Armies of the Western Front and the 24th and 32th Armies of the Reserve Front. The Russians made the mistake of putting their Reserve front in the first line of battle. Once we break through their lines we should be able to move on Vyazma and Gzatsk without too much resistance. Gzatsk is a city vital for or further drive on Moscow and also vital for the Russian defense of Moscow.
dst: 你的师已从我们以南古德里安的第2装甲集群转隶霍普纳的第4装甲集群，参加向莫斯科的最后推进。我们的首要任务是突破俄军防线，跟随第10装甲师北上维亚济马，与我们以北霍特的第3装甲集群建立联系，并合围西方面军的俄军第16、第19、第20集团军以及预备方面军的第24、第32集团军。俄国人犯了把预备方面军摆在第一线的错误。一旦我们突破其防线，就应能在阻力不大的情况下向维亚济马和格扎茨克推进。格扎茨克是继续向莫斯科推进的关键城市，对俄军防守莫斯科也同样关键。

src: Your division is now ordered to move to the Eastern front to stop the new Russian winter offensive.
dst: 你的师现已奉命调往东线，以遏止俄国人新的冬季攻势。

src: Your division is now part of the 11th German Army, which is chasing the disarrayed Russian troops. The Russians are retreating out of Galicia, so we are presented with a good chance to exploit the situation and deal them a severe blow.
dst: 您的师如今隶属于德国第11集团军，正在追击溃散的俄军。俄国人正撤出加利西亚，因此我们获得了一个良机，可趁势给他们沉重一击。

src: Your division is one of the few Panzer divisions facing the Americans in Normandy. Send a KG to La-Haye-du-Puits in support of the 353th Division that is under heavy American attack. Send another KG to support 17SS Panzergrenadier Division "Goetz von Berlichingen" in its counterattack NW of St-Lo. The rest of your forces will be kept in reserve for now.
dst: 你的师是诺曼底为数不多面对美军的装甲师之一。派一个战斗群前往拉艾迪皮，支援正遭美军猛攻的第353师。再派一个战斗群，支援党卫军第17装甲掷弹兵师“格茨·冯·贝利欣根”在圣洛西北的反击。你其余的部队暂作预备队。

src: Your division played no more than a very minor role in the past half year's attempts to break through the Gothic line and into the Po river Valley. That is about to change. If your attack succeeds, we can push the Germans into the Alps and open the doors to the Balkans.
dst: 在过去的半年里，你师在突破哥特防线、进入波河河谷的努力中只扮演了极其次要的角色。这一切即将改变。若你进攻得手，我们就能把德军赶进阿尔卑斯山，并打开通往巴尔干的大门。

src: Your dozing off at the staff meeting got you thrown out!
dst: 你在参谋会议上打瞌睡，让你被赶了出去！

src: Your dozing off at the staff meeting has gotten you relieved!
dst: 你在参谋会议上打瞌睡，让你被解职了！

src: Your early capture of Washington has forced the surrender of the United States before they could successfully test an atomic bomb. North America and Europe have been successfully united under common leadership and all the other nations of the world are courting German favor. The world is at peace.Your brilliant leadership throughout this war ranks you among the greatest generals that have ever lived, and you will be remembered as the greatest Panzer General in history.
dst: 你提前攻占华盛顿，迫使美国在其成功试爆原子弹之前投降。北美与欧洲已在共同领导之下成功统一，世界其余各国纷纷向德国示好。世界恢复了和平。你在这场战争全程中展现的卓越指挥，使你跻身有史以来最伟大的将领之列，人们将铭记你是历史上最伟大的装甲元帅。

src: Your efforts have been very meritorious, but the Americans have broken the line in El Guettar, so we don't have another choice:- Retreat!
dst: 您的努力非常值得称道，但美国人在盖塔尔突破了防线，我们别无选择：撤退！

src: Your efforts thus far are being rewarded with a divisional command and the rank of General-Major!
dst: 您迄今的努力得到了回报：您获得了师级指挥权，并晋升为少将！

src: Your escape from Capua was succesfull !!! Now go get food and weapons from the transport and freed the slaves of the surrounding area. Along with these new followers you perhaps have a chance to see your homeland !!!
dst: 你从卡普阿成功逃脱！！！现在去从运输队那里夺取食物与武器，并解放周边地区的奴隶。有了这些新加入者，你或许有机会见到自己的故乡！！！

src: Your experience with the Soomusrong has been a valuable one.  The armored trains add explosive power to your offensive, but they can be extremely vulnerable in maneuver.  Use them wisely in your upcoming campaign:  without adequate supporting units and a clear retreat path, an armored train can become an expensive loss.
dst: 您在装甲列车（苏穆斯龙）方面的经验十分宝贵。装甲列车为您的进攻增添了强大火力，但它们在机动中可能极易受损。在即将到来的战役中要善用它们：没有足够的支援部队和明确的撤退路线，一列装甲列车就可能成为代价高昂的损失。

src: Your experiences against the Serbian army will be useful here, in Galizien. The war against the Russians hasn't started well for us in this border of the Empire. After some initial successes, those damned Russians crushed us at the Gnila Lipa River, an all our troops had to retire with heavy losses. We tried to resist in Lemberg, to no avail. That seemingly invincible fortress fell, too, less than a week ago.
dst: 您在对抗塞尔维亚军队时积累的经验，在这里——加利西亚——会派上用场。在帝国的这条边境上，对俄战争开局不利。经过最初的几次胜利后，那些该死的俄国人在格尼拉利帕河击溃了我们，我们所有部队都不得不带着惨重损失撤退。我们试图在伦贝格抵抗，但无济于事。那座看似坚不可摧的要塞也在不到一周前陷落了。

src: Your failure at Malta has alowed the British to severely hampered Marshall Graziani's efforts in North Africa!
dst: 你在马耳他的失败，让英军得以严重阻碍格拉齐亚尼元帅在北非的行动！

src: Your failure at Voronezh will severely hamper Fall Blau! Governor Horthy has decided your next assignment is to lead a mine cleaner squad of a penal company.
dst: 你在沃罗涅日的失利将严重妨碍蓝色方案！霍尔蒂总督已决定，你下一个职务是去惩戒连当扫雷班班长。

src: Your failure could have costed us the loss of Krakau. Thank God that the other commanders have succeeded in other sectors, forcing the Russians to retreat.
dst: 您的失败本可能让我们丢掉克拉科夫。谢天谢地，其他指挥官在别的防区取得了成功，迫使俄国人撤退了。

src: Your failure here has enabled the Turks to hold Palistine and force us back into Egypt. British troops will try to finish the job here. The High Command is very dissappointed and have ordered your troops to the bloodbath on the Western Front. I hope you are more sucessful there!!!
dst: 您在这里的失败使土耳其人得以守住巴勒斯坦，并把我们逼回埃及。英军将在此地完成这项任务。最高统帅部非常失望，已把您的部队调往西线的大屠杀。希望您在那里能更成功！！！

src: Your failure here has enabled the Turks to hold Palistine and force us back into Egypt. What remains of your troops will spend the rest of the war in the desert protecting the Suez Canal!!!
dst: 您在这里的失败使土耳其人得以守住巴勒斯坦，并把我们逼回埃及。您残存的部队将在沙漠中度过余下的战争岁月，保卫苏伊士运河！！！

src: Your failure in the Caucasus has put us in an extremely difficult position. The Soviet winter offensives have forced us back all along the front. You are being re-assigned.
dst: 你在高加索的失败使我们陷入极其困难的处境。苏军的冬季攻势已迫使我们在全线后退。你将被调任他职。

src: Your failure in the Middle East has cost us dearly. British counterattacks have forced us to abandon Egypt, therefore we have no choice but to dismiss you.
dst: 你在中东的失败让我们付出了惨重代价。英军反攻迫使我们放弃埃及，因此我们别无选择，只能解除你的职务。

src: Your failure in the invasion on Malta will drive you to a most historic path in the Alamein sector, where prestige will be lacking.
dst: 您在马耳他登陆的失败将把您引向阿拉曼地区最具历史意义的一条道路，在那里声望将会匮乏。

src: Your failure is beyond comprehension.  The enemy armies have escaped encirclement and already have begun to counterattack.  The General Staff has no need for incompetent commanders.
dst: 你的失败令人无法理解。敌军已逃出合围，并已开始反攻。总参谋部不需要无能的指挥官。
你的失败令人无法容忍。

src: Your failure is most unfortunate. You will move to East Prussia to prepare for the upcoming grand offensive scheduled for the next year's spring.
dst: 你的失败令人极为遗憾。你将前往东普鲁士，为定于明年春季的大规模攻势做准备。
你的失败令人难以承受。

src: Your failure leaves us in a very delicate position, General. The best you can do right now is resign. Good luck on your civilian life.
dst: 将军，您的失败使我们陷入非常微妙的境地。您现在能做的最好的事就是辞职。祝您的平民生活好运。

src: Your failure on the battlefield has allowed a numerically inferior German force to scatter the attack of two fresh corps and to hold on to their objective.  General Litvinov has personally demoted you, demanding that you be removed from his army.  Your career as a military leader has ended.
dst: 您在战场上的失败，让一支数量处于劣势的德军部队击溃了两个新锐军的进攻，并守住了他们的目标。利特维诺夫将军已亲自将您降职，要求把您从他的集团军中除名。您的军事生涯就此终结。

src: Your failure to capture Alexandria means that we lose the initiative in North Africa. No help can be expected from the Germans. They are preparing for a major Russian Summer offensive at Kursk. You are dismissed.
dst: 你未能夺取亚历山大，意味着我们在北非丧失了主动权。不能指望德国人帮忙，他们正为俄国在库尔斯克的大规模夏季攻势做准备。你被解职了。

src: Your failure to secure this vital objective has left us in a perilous situation!!! We have a desk job waiting for you.
dst: 您未能确保这一关键目标，使我们陷入险境！！！我们给您留了一份坐办公室的文职。

src: Your failure to secure this vital objective in time has left us in a perilous situation!!! We have a desk job waiting for you.
dst: 您未能及时确保这一关键目标，使我们陷入险境！！！我们给您留了一份坐办公室的文职。

src: Your failure to take Damascus has forced us into an embarrassing ceasefire with the Turks!! Enjoy your retirement as your command is no longer needed!!!
dst: 您未能夺取大马士革，迫使我们与土耳其人签订了难堪的停战协定！！去享受您的退休生活吧，因为您的指挥已不再需要！！！

src: Your first assignment as PLA's commander will be in the Jilin province, our base there is placed at Linjiang. The situation in Manchuria is complex. We need Manchuria for some reasons, first, it's border is close with the USSR and the support we are receiving from the Soviets, and second, Manchuria is the most industrialised area in the whole China, we need the resources from here, and we need to avoid the profits the Kuomingtang can get from here.
dst: 你作为解放军指挥员的第一项任务将在吉林省，我们在那里的基地设在临江。满洲的局势很复杂。我们需要满洲有几个原因：第一，它的边界靠近苏联，也靠近我们正从苏联获得的支援；第二，满洲是全中国工业化程度最高的地区，我们需要这里的资源，也需要防止国民党从中获利。

src: Your first assignment will be with the relief troops.
dst: 您的首个任务将是随援军行动。

src: Your first contact with a western army has been a failure. I'm afraid that you aren't prepared for a modern battle. You'll be transferred to an administrative position for the rest of the war.
dst: 您与一支西方军队的首次交锋失败了。恐怕您还没有为现代战斗做好准备。战争余下的时间里，您将被调往行政岗位。

src: Your first contact with a western army has been successful. Sarrail's army is heading back to Greece.
dst: 您与一支西方军队的首次交锋取得了成功。萨拉伊的军队正撤回希腊。

src: Your first mission in Operation Fall Weiss, the conquest of Poland, is to capture the key cities of Kutno and Lodz by September 10th. This keeps open the possibility of conquering Poland before the French and British can launch an attack on Germany. If these objectives are taken before September 10th, additional forces may be available to you for the assault on Warsaw.
dst: 你在征服波兰的白色方案行动中的首个任务，是在9月10日前夺取库特诺与罗兹这两座重要城市。这使我们在法国与英国对德国发动进攻之前征服波兰的可能性依然存在。若能在9月10日前夺取这些目标，可能会有更多部队可供你用于进攻华沙。

src: Your first objective is the port of Diego Suarez.  The Vichy defenders are expected to be a mix of French colonial troops along with local volunteers.  You will have naval support provided by several battleships, cruisers and destroyers, and you will also receive air support from aircraft flying out from our aircraft carriers.
dst: 你的第一个目标是迭戈苏亚雷斯港。预计维希守军是法国殖民军与当地志愿者的混合。你将得到数艘战列舰、巡洋舰和驱逐舰的海上支援，还将得到从我方航母起飞飞机的空中支援。

src: Your first task is an attack in this sector. Commonwealth forces consist of two tank battalions with appropriate support. Every time the Italians tried to enter the region, the Brits counterattacked and routed them with little effort. I pity the Italians, they are courageous and skilled, but their vintage tanks are museum pieces and can't do much against phenomenal British armour. Especially when Brits have air dominance over the battlefield.
dst: 你的第一个任务是在这个防区发起进攻。英联邦部队由两个坦克营及其相应支援组成。每当意大利人试图进入该地区，英国人就会反扑，不费吹灰之力就把他们击溃。我同情意大利人，他们勇敢而娴熟，但他们那些老掉牙的坦克都是博物馆展品，对付不了英国人非凡的装甲，尤其是当英国人还掌握着战场制空权的时候。

src: Your first task is to hold a defensive position at Rapta.  Two German groups, the KaiserGrupe and the BismarckGrupe, will assault.  Form an assault group and, with the help of Russian reinforcements, strike the German flank and to capture Kella.  Also be aware of any German cavalry activity on your own flanks as you move toward your final objective SW of Rapta.
dst: 您的首要任务是在拉普塔守住一处防御阵地。两支德军战斗群——皇帝战斗群和俾斯麦战斗群——将发起突击。组建一个突击群，并借助俄军增援，打击德军侧翼并占领凯拉。此外，当您向拉普塔西南方的最终目标推进时，要留意己方两翼的任何德军骑兵活动。

src: Your force is coming from Rumanian soil, on the west side of the Prut River, down south to Falciu. Other forces will try to cross the Prut River from the area south of Kishenev. Be quick and make sure those fascists get caught. I believe you are familiar with this region, comrade. Good luck.
dst: 你的部队正从罗马尼亚境内、普鲁特河西侧南下，直指法尔丘。其他部队将尝试从基希讷乌以南地区渡过普鲁特河。动作要快，确保那些法西斯被截住。我想你对这一带很熟悉，同志。祝你好运。

src: Your force will assemble south of Kiev and attack the Polish positions well south of Kiev.  Your goal will be to force a way through the Polish line and open up a gap so we can pour in infantry and cut off the enemy at Kiev.  Your operation will be supported by the 3rd Don Cossack Brigade which is few days march behind you.
dst: 您的部队将在基辅以南集结，进攻基辅以南远处的波兰阵地。您的目标是强行突破波兰防线并打开一个缺口，好让我们投入步兵、切断基辅之敌的退路。您的行动将得到第3顿河哥萨克旅的支援，他们就在您身后数日行程处。

src: Your force will attack towards Novorossiysk and beyond. Attacks will come from the bridgehead south of Novorossiysk, as well as along the coastal front. The Black Sea Fleet has once again committed Marines who are waiting to get revenge for their fallen comrades, months earlier. So attack, and let nothing stop you! The enemy is still strong and willing to resist so prepare for a ferious battle. We accept not anything less than the complete destruction of the enemy in the Novorossiysk area! Good luck, comrade.
dst: 你的部队将向新罗西斯克及其纵深进攻。进攻将来自新罗西斯克以南的桥头堡，以及滨海战线。黑海舰队再次投入了海军陆战队员，他们正等着为几个月前牺牲的战友报仇。所以，进攻吧，别让任何东西阻挡你！敌人依然强大，且愿意抵抗，所以准备迎接一场恶战吧。除了彻底消灭新罗西斯克地区的敌人，我们不接受任何其他结果！祝你好运，同志。

src: Your force will be divided into two. One group will rush to Ordzhonikidze and garrison the city against the Germans. A second group will take part in a smart counterstrike on the German flank in order to destroy the attacking Germans from behind, or at least make them retreat. Good luck, comrade.
dst: 你的部队将一分为二。一队火速赶往奥尔忠尼启则，进驻城市抵御德军。另一队将在德军侧翼实施一次巧妙的反击，从背后消灭进攻的德军，或至少迫使他们撤退。祝你好运，同志。

src: Your force, located near Bucharest, must cross the Danube River at two of its crossings. Near Ruse and near Turlukai. After the crossing you must drive deep into Bulgaria and take control of all important positions. Be aware of fascist, resisting troops, comrade.
dst: 你的部队位于布加勒斯特附近，必须在两处渡口渡过多瑙河：鲁塞附近和图尔图卡亚附近。渡河后，你必须深入保加利亚，控制所有重要据点。当心法西斯的抵抗部队，同志。

src: Your forces are transfered to XX Corps - the remains of 10th Army. General Tellera is in charge of the withdrawal of troops from the Gebel into Sirte. General Babini's armored forces retreated from the El-Mechili area to your area near the coast after they clashed with elements of the 7th Armored Division. They report English columns moving through the desert towards the coast. If we don't move fast, they could cut-off our route of escape.
dst: 你的部队被转隶第20军——第10集团军的残部。泰莱拉将军负责把部队从杰贝勒撤入苏尔特。巴比尼将军的装甲部队在与第7装甲师的部分兵力交火后，从埃尔梅基利地区撤到你这处靠海的区域。他们报告有英军纵队穿沙漠向海岸移动。如果我们不快速行动，他们可能会切断我们的退路。

src: Your forces are well under way to Budapest. The Bolsheviks are astounded by the success of your offensive against their over-extended forces. Stalin has indicated he wants to negotiate a peace settlement. This will bring peace to Europe and will save our country. You performed wonderfully General.
dst: 你的部队正顺利向布达佩斯推进。布尔什维克对你进攻他们战线过长的部队所取得的成功感到震惊。斯大林已表示愿意谈判和平解决。这将为欧洲带来和平，也将拯救我们的国家。你干得非常出色，将军。

src: Your forces arrived at The Hague too late to capture the Dutch government and Queen Wilhelmina - they managed to escape to England. Fortunately the Dutch have capitulated after the center of Rotterdam was bombed into oblivion by the He-111s of Kampfgeschwader 4.
dst: 你的部队抵达海牙太晚，没能俘获荷兰政府和威廉明娜女王——他们成功逃往英格兰。所幸在第4轰炸航空团的 He-111 把鹿特丹市中心炸成废墟后，荷兰人投降了。

src: Your forces captured several Allied divisions trapped inland.  Peace talks are expected to bring a cease fire and we expect to sign peace within days.
dst: 你的部队俘获了困在内陆的数个盟军师。和谈预计将带来停火，我们预计数日内签署和约。

src: Your forces gave the Germans a rough handling as they withdrew.  Thankfully we captured enough Germans to make a large trade of POWs - bringing many of our men home.
dst: 你的部队在德军撤退时狠狠地教训了他们。所幸我们俘获了足够多的德国人，得以进行大规模的战俘交换——把许多同胞带回了家。

src: Your forces gave the Germans a taste of their own Blitzkrieg!  Brilliant, absolutley brilliant!
dst: 你的部队让德国人尝到了他们自己的闪电战！精彩，精彩绝伦！

src: Your forces gave the Germans a taste of their own tactics!  Well Done!
dst: 你的部队让德国人尝到了他们自己的战术！干得好！

src: Your forces have repelled the attack on Vienna and have struck a severe blow to the enemy. The Russians - tired of the war and unable to cope with long supply lines - have gotten in comparable difficulties on other fronts. This situation is forcing Stalin to negotiate a peace settlement. This will allow us to direct forces to the west to fight the Western Allies.
dst: 你的部队击退了敌人对维也纳的进攻，并给了敌人沉重打击。俄国人——厌倦战争、又无法应付漫长的补给线——在其他战线也陷入了类似的困境。这一局面正迫使斯大林谈判和平解决。这将使我们能把兵力调往西线，与西方盟国作战。

src: Your forces have repelled the attack on Vienna and have struck a severe blow to the enemy. The Russians - tired of the war and unable to cope with long supply lines - have gotten in comparable difficulties on other fronts. This situation is forcing Stalin to negotiate a peace settlement. This will bring peace to Europe and will save our country. You performed wonderfully General.
dst: 你的部队击退了敌人对维也纳的进攻，并给了敌人沉重打击。俄国人——厌倦战争、又无法应付漫长的补给线——在其他战线也陷入了类似的困境。这一局面正迫使斯大林谈判和平解决。这将为欧洲带来和平，也将拯救我们的国家。你干得非常出色，将军。

src: Your forces managed, although barely, to push the Allied forces back to the beaches at Salerno, however they're second effort again pushed our forces from the beaches.  Peace talks have turned into surrender negotiations, but should still bring a cease fire and we hope to sign peace within days.
dst: 你的部队虽然勉强，还是把盟军赶回了萨莱诺的海滩，然而他们的第二次进攻又把我们的部队从海滩上赶了出来。和谈已变为投降谈判，但应仍能带来停火，我们希望数日内签署和约。

src: Your forces must occupy and keep bridges over Wilhelminakanaal, river Mark and Maas, so we are can cut off enemy troops in the surrounding Dordrecht.
dst: 你的部队必须占领并守住威廉明娜运河、马克河与马斯河上的桥梁，如此我们便能切断多德雷赫特周边之敌。

src: Your forces must stop the enemy advance down south on the coastal road. Although the recapture of Novorriysk is beyond our limits, you are ordered to contain the German attack and retake several positions in the hills. Good luck, comrade.
dst: 你的部队必须阻止敌军沿滨海公路南下。尽管夺回新罗西斯克超出了我们的能力，你受命遏制德军的进攻，并夺回山区的几处阵地。祝你好运，同志。

src: Your forces reached Mersah Matruh, but not without suffering heavy losses. Our army has come to a virtual standstill with most trucks broken down or without fuel. Alexandria is out of range and the only option is to walk back to Sidi Barrani where the Libyan Corps is preparing defensive positions.
dst: 你的部队抵达了梅尔萨马特鲁，但也付出了惨重代价。我军几乎完全停滞，大部分卡车损坏或没有燃料。亚历山大已超出范围，唯一的选择是步行撤回西迪拜拉尼——利比亚军正在那里构筑防御阵地。

src: Your forces took the Allies by surprise from which they did not recover!  Peace talks have already brought a cease fire and we expect to sign peace within hours.
dst: 你的部队让盟军措手不及、一蹶不振！和谈已带来停火，我们预计几小时内签署和约。

src: Your forces were unable to stop the Belgian army. You are lucky that the Belgian attack was called off when they got news from the fronts they were supporting by this exit from Antwerp.
dst: 您的部队未能阻止比利时陆军。幸运的是，比利时人从他们这次出击所支援的各前线得到消息后，便取消了进攻。

src: Your forces will be key since Rommel's panzerkorps has been engaged in defending the Arras area and will not be able to join the final drive.  Your corps will race up the coast taking the ports while mine will cut off the Allied forces from moving west.
dst: 你的部队将是关键，因为隆美尔的装甲军正忙于防守阿拉斯地区，无法参加最后的推进。你的军将沿海岸疾驰夺取港口，我的部队则切断盟军西撤之路。

src: Your forces will be supported by one of the first deployments of Austin armored cars in battle.
dst: 您的部队将得到奥斯汀装甲车首次投入战斗之一的支援。

src: Your gambol has paid dividents!  You have scattered the 2nd Soviet Latvian Division and captured their ammunition and food supply - complete with the rail stock.  Your attack is the final nail in the coffin containing the Bolsheviks' ambitions for Latvia and southern Estonia.
dst: 您的豪赌获得了丰厚回报！您已击溃苏俄拉脱维亚第2师，并缴获了他们的弹药与粮食补给——连同全部铁路车辆。您的进攻是钉入布尔什维克对拉脱维亚和爱沙尼亚南部野心棺材的最后一颗钉子。

src: Your goal is simple, destroy all the island's infrastructure.There are 2 radars at the island,, must destroy them too.
dst: 你的目标很简单，摧毁岛上所有基础设施。岛上有2座雷达，也必须一并摧毁。

src: Your goal is to judge which part of the frontline is threatened, and send the reinforcements there.
dst: 您的目标是判断战线的哪一部分受到威胁，并把增援派往那里。

src: Your goal is to recapture Maikop and the oilfields, as well as an advance to the Kuban River. The Germans are retreating but do this skillful. And the more west you will arrive, the more tenacious the fascist defenses will become. So be careful. Good luck, comrade!
dst: 你的目标是夺回迈科普和油田，并向库班河推进。德军正在撤退，但撤退得很有章法。而你越往西，法西斯的防御就越顽强。所以要小心。祝你好运，同志！

src: Your goal, the Gulf of Mexico is only 100 km away. Proceed with maximum speed to the southwest and interrupt immediately the railway line Jacksonville-Tallahassee. Let the troops following in your back occupy the western bank of the Suwannee River and stop the enemy forces flowing from Florida to the west. We also expect weak enemy counterattacks from the west. Defend the corridor and let no enemy forces break through to the west!
dst: 你的目标——墨西哥湾——只剩100公里了。以最高速度向西南推进，立即切断杰克逊维尔-塔拉哈西铁路线。让你身后的后续部队占领苏万尼河西岸，阻止敌军从佛罗里达向西涌出。我们预计西面也会有敌军发起的小规模反击。守住这条走廊，绝不让敌军向西突破！

src: Your great success in Africa has not gone unnoticed by the high command, but unfortunately,we must now move some of our assets in order to strengthen our hold on Northwest Africa.
dst: 你在非洲的重大胜利已引起最高统帅部的注意，但遗憾的是，我们现在必须抽调部分兵力，以加强我们对西北非的控制。

src: Your great triumph in the Middle East has been acclaimed by all Germany.  We are planning a major offensive against Russia in the Caucasus early this summer. Our control of the Middle East will allow us to attack the Caucasus from both west and south.
dst: 你在中东的重大胜利赢得了全德国的赞誉。我们计划今年初夏在高加索方向对俄国发动一场大规模攻势。控制中东将使我们可以从西面和南面两个方向进攻高加索。

src: Your great victory is reminiscent of your early blitzkriegs through Europe. We have forced the Soviets to make a separate peace with favorable terms. We must now focus our resources on fighting off the American and British armies.
dst: 你的伟大胜利令人想起你早年的欧洲闪击战。我们已迫使苏联以有利条件单独媾和。现在我们必须集中资源抗击美英军队。

src: Your hard won victory over the British was costly but yet finally complete.  Your General did not survive the RAF attacks, thankfully Marshall Graziani quickly turned the battle in our favor.
dst: 你对英军的这场苦战胜利代价高昂，但终究圆满完成。你的将军没能挺过皇家空军的空袭，所幸格拉齐亚尼元帅迅速扭转了战局。

src: Your heavy tanks battalion broke through the Soviet defense, but the enemy sent a whole armoured corps to plug the hole. Destroy the opposition and capture your objectives as fast as possible.
dst: 你的重型坦克营突破了苏军防御，但敌人派出一整个装甲军来堵缺口。尽快消灭敌军并夺取你的目标。

src: Your horses are the most mobile force that we have, comrade.  Dash to the isthmus and force your way into the Crimea!!!
dst: 同志，您的骑兵是我们最机动的力量。冲向地峡，强行杀入克里米亚！！！

src: Your hospital tent heals 5 and your medical truck heals 3 strength points/turn. (Units have to stand still in a turn to heal strength points.)
dst: 你的医疗帐篷每回合治疗 5 点兵力值，医疗卡车每回合治疗 3 点兵力值。（单位必须在一个回合内保持静止才能恢复兵力值。）

src: Your immediate task is to hold on to the outposts in the flooded area between the river Yzer and the Nieuwpoort-Diksmuide railroad. If the Germans would penetrate your lines, they will be able to reach the channel ports and cut off the BEF's supply lines.
dst: 您的当务之急是守住伊泽尔河与尼乌波特-迪克斯迈德铁路之间被淹没地区的各前哨阵地。如果德军突破您的防线，他们就能抵达海峡各港口，切断英国远征军的补给线。

src: Your inability to capture your objectives in and around Moscow has led to disaster. The Soviet armies, reinforced by troops from Siberia have wreaked havoc on our overextended and once invincible armies. Fierce Soviet counterattacks this winter have put back our weary troops all along the front. The remaining forces of SS Reich are sent to France to be reequipped. You'll be lucky if they allow you to remain in command of the division.
dst: 你未能夺取莫斯科城内外的目标，酿成了灾难。得到西伯利亚部队增援的苏军，把我们战线过长、曾不可战胜的军队打得大败。今冬苏军的凶猛反击把疲惫的我军全线击退。党卫军“帝国”师的残余部队被派往法国重新装备。若他们允许你继续指挥该师，你就该谢天谢地了。

src: Your inability to capture your objectives in and around Moscow has led to disaster. The Soviet armies, reinforced by troops from Siberia, have wreaked havoc on our overextended and once-invincible armies. Fierce Soviet counterattacks this winter have pushed back our weary troops all along the front, you are dismissed.
dst: 你未能夺取莫斯科及其周边的目标，已导致灾难性后果。得到西伯利亚部队增援的苏军，对我军战线过长、曾号称无敌的军团造成了毁灭性打击。今冬苏军的猛烈反攻，已将我疲惫的部队全线击退。你被解职了。

src: Your inability to defend Germany has led to our total destruction. Although you fought well in many battles, we have, in the end, lost everything.
dst: 你无力保卫德国，导致我们彻底毁灭。尽管你在许多战斗中打得很好，我们最终还是失去了一切。

src: Your inability to hold back the Turk army has led to our invasion force being forced off the peninsula. You are relieved of your command.
dst: 您无力挡住土耳其军队，致使我们的入侵部队被赶出了半岛。您已被解除指挥权。

src: Your incompetence is shocking, Herr Major! We've lost so many men and so much ground due to your blunders, that it's a wonder that you don't face court martial! Your time as a battalion commander is over!
dst: 你的无能令人震惊，少校阁下！由于你的过失，我们折损了如此多的人、丢掉了如此多的地盘，你没被送上军事法庭已是奇迹！你担任营长的日子到头了！

src: Your indecisiveness on the battlefield has cost our 5th Army dearly:  the Austrians have guessed correctly not to anticipate an attack from your sector and have pulled troops back to isolate and surround our XIX Corps.  With the 5th Army's objectives in jeopardy, General Pleve has personally relieved you of your command, demanding a able officer lead in your stead.
dst: 您在战场上的优柔寡断使我第5集团军付出了惨重代价：奥军正确地判断出您所在的地段不会发动进攻，于是抽调部队孤立并包围了我们的第19军。由于第5集团军的目标岌岌可危，普列韦将军亲自解除了您的指挥权，要求由一名得力的军官接替您的职务。

src: Your leadership has been magnificient, General! But the small amount of ground that has been captured during this battle hardly justifies our appaling casualties. Our losses make it difficult enough to hold the little ground we have, let alone continue to capture more. For the time being, all we can do is dig in and wait for further reinforcements.
dst: 将军，您的指挥堪称卓越！但这场战斗中夺取的区区一点地盘，实在不足以抵偿我们骇人的伤亡。我们的损失使我们连守住现有的弹丸之地都很难，更不用说继续夺取更多了。眼下，我们能做的只有挖壕据守，等待进一步增援。

src: Your leadership has shattered the British forces.  Congratulations, Herr General.  Now, we must capture the port of Tobruk before the English can prepare an effective defense.
dst: 你的领导击垮了英军。恭喜，将军阁下。现在，我们必须在英国人组织起有效防御之前攻占托布鲁克港。

src: Your leadership has shattered the British forces.  Now, we must capture the port of Tobruk before the English can prepare an effective defense.
dst: 你的领导击垮了英军。现在，我们必须在英国人组织起有效防御之前攻占托布鲁克港。

src: Your leadership proved weak and uninspiring at Kharkov, and we were unable to regain the initiative. Another year of senseless fighting in Russia has come and gone.
dst: 你的指挥在哈尔科夫表现得软弱乏力、毫无锐气，我们未能重夺先手。俄国战场上又一年无谓的厮杀就此过去。

src: Your legion's small air force is already stationed at Susa airfield.
dst: 你军团的小型空军已驻扎在苏萨机场。

src: Your less than spectacular performance has motivated a reevaluation of your usefulness.   Some of the enemy has retreated into Romania.  The British and French have now declared war on Germany.  If we did not need every man to fight, your career would be over!
dst: 你并不出彩的表现让人不得不重新评估你的价值。部分敌人已撤入罗马尼亚。英法现已对德宣战。若不是我们还需要每一个人去打仗，你的军旅生涯就该到此为止了！

src: Your liberation of Basarabia was brilliantly done and Romania has declared a national holiday!
dst: 你解放比萨拉比亚的行动干得漂亮，罗马尼亚已宣布全国放假庆祝！

src: Your liberation of Basarabia was no small task, the Russians fought hard no?
dst: 你解放比萨拉比亚可不是小事，俄国人拼得很凶，不是吗？

src: Your liberation of Basarabia was well done and Romania is celebrating.
dst: 你解放比萨拉比亚干得很好，罗马尼亚正在庆祝。

src: Your liberation of Washington D.C. is a goddamned inspiration to the masses who have lived under Nazi occupation for the past two years.  I highly doubt those Kraut bastards ever saw US coming.
dst: 你解放华盛顿特区，对那些在纳粹占领下生活了两年的民众是极大鼓舞。我极其怀疑那些德国佬料到过美国的反击。

src: Your light tanks company is a part of a battalion tasked with breaking through the Soviet defense west of Vyazma. A river crossing is held by enemy artillery, but your motorcyclists found a ford north of your starting positions. Infantry support must outflank the artillery, clear the village, and secure the bridgehead. Rush towards your main objective and rendezvous with forward elements of Waffen-SS division approaching from the south. Destroy the Soviet barrier troops in the nearby city.
dst: 你的轻型坦克连隶属于一个营，任务是突破维亚济马以西的苏军防线。一处渡口被敌军炮兵把守，但你的摩托车手在你出发阵地以北找到了一处浅滩。步兵支援必须包抄该炮兵、肃清村庄并确保桥头堡。向主目标疾进，与从南面逼近的武装党卫军师先头部队会合。消灭附近城市里的苏军阻截部队。

src: Your main force should continue on to assault Chelm.
dst: 你的主力应继续前进，进攻海乌姆。

src: Your main objective is the town of Beersheba with it's airstrip which is vital to the Royal Flying Corp. Also capturing the road junction to the north will stop any Turk reinforcements retaking Beersheba. I can't stress how important this mission is to our continued campiagn here in the Middle East!!!!
dst: 您的主要目标是贝尔谢巴镇及其简易机场，这对皇家飞行队至关重要。此外，夺取北面的公路枢纽将阻止任何土耳其援军重新夺回贝尔谢巴。我无法强调这项任务对我们继续在中东作战有多么重要！！！！

src: Your main task is to advance your troops to the center of Asturian and to give further assistance to Gijon and Oviedo.  You may recruit troops for a column under your command.
dst: 您的主要任务是率部推进到阿斯图里亚斯中部，向希洪和奥维耶多提供进一步支援。您可以招募部队，组成一支由您指挥的纵队。

src: Your maneuver around the Polish right did not keep to our timetable as planned and Panzer Division Kempf was forced to complete the breakthrough, however they are finally enroute to Warsaw.
dst: 你绕过波军右翼的机动没有按我们的时间表进行，肯普夫装甲师被迫替你完成突破，不过他们终于上路向华沙进发了。

src: Your maneuver around the Polish right kept to the timetable as planned and Panzer Division Kempf reports that your breakthrough was complete and they are enroute to Warsaw!
dst: 你绕过波军右翼的机动按计划的时间表进行，肯普夫装甲师报告说你的突破已告完成，他们正向华沙进发！

src: Your maneuver around the Polish right was a disaster!  Panzer Division Kempf was forced to produce your breakthrough, and they must halt to prepare to march on Warsaw.  OKW has shifted our Luftwaffe priority to other more successful sectors.
dst: 你绕过波军右翼的机动是一场灾难！肯普夫装甲师被迫替你完成突破，他们还得停下来准备向华沙进军。最高统帅部已把我方空军的优先支援转向其他更成功的地段。

src: Your maneuver around the Polish right was true Blitzkrieg!  Already I have reports of the Panzer Division Kempf that followed your breakthrough has reached the outskirts of Warsaw!
dst: 你绕过波军右翼的机动是真正的闪电战！我已经收到报告，随你突破而进的肯普夫装甲师已抵达华沙郊外！

src: Your maneuver was very impressive, General! El Raisuli tried to resist your attack, but he finally had to flee from the battlefield to avoid being captured. He even left one of his best horses behind! Maybe his defeat will finally convince him that he'd better see Spain as an ally not an enemy. At least, I hope that. El Raisuli's cooperation would make our tasks in Morocco much easier.
dst: 您的机动非常出色，将军！赖苏利试图抵抗您的进攻，但最终为了免遭被俘，他不得不逃离战场。他甚至丢下了一匹最好的马！也许这次失败终于能让他明白，最好把西班牙当作盟友而非敌人。至少我希望如此。赖苏利的合作将使我们在摩洛哥的任务轻松得多。

src: Your marines don't need to take part in the battle, we don't want to conquer the island.
dst: 你的海军陆战队无需参战，我们并不想占领该岛。

src: Your marines landed at west and must kill 40 enemy units. Lufwaffe supports you with 1 recon bomber.
dst: 你的陆战队已在西面登陆，必须消灭40个敌军单位。德国空军以1架侦察轰炸机支援你。

src: Your marines must move to Corsica immediately. No time to re-fit or re-suply. But first of all, the navy will have to ensure their smooth passage against enemy ships and planes.
dst: 你的海军陆战队必须立即开赴科西嘉岛。没有时间重新装备或补充给养。但首先，海军必须确保他们在面对敌舰和敌机时能顺利通行。

src: Your men are to cross the Prosna River and assualt the anti-tank guns across the bridge.  You should then move quickly to seize the heights, and move into the village of Boleslavecz.  A link up with the 17th Infantry Division is expected by the time you are advanicng on Opatev and Wieuroszov.
dst: 你的部队要渡过普罗斯纳河，进攻桥对岸的反坦克炮。然后迅速夺取高地，进入博莱斯瓦维茨村。待你向奥帕特夫和维乌罗舒夫推进时，预计将与第17步兵师会合。

src: Your men desire you a quick recovery, but they won’t be able to visit you. They will be transferred to France, where we’ll launch a final offensive next spring. The operation in the Alps has been cancelled. The Austrians will have to fend for themselves there.
dst: 您的部下都盼着您早日康复，但他们无法来探望您。他们将被调往法国，明年春天我们将在那里发动最后的攻势。阿尔卑斯山的行动已经取消。奥地利人只能在那里自行应付了。

src: Your men, along with elements of the 8th British army , have been ordered to join the Fifth U.S. Army in the drive for Rome. You must break the German defenses from Cassino to the Tyrrhenian Sea and advance up the Liri valley. Reconnaisnace of the area reports that the rivers are still swollen and raging from the spring rains, so capturing and using the existing bridges will be imperative to your success in this mission. Good luck General....
dst: 你的部队与英国第8集团军的部分兵力一起，奉命加入美国第5集团军，共同向罗马进击。你必须突破从卡西诺到第勒尼安海的德军防线，并沿利里河谷北上。对该地区的侦察报告称，春季降雨使河水依然暴涨湍急，因此夺取并利用现有的桥梁将是你此次任务成败的关键。祝你好运，将军……

src: Your mission has been a complete success, but the British still threaten our lines. We'll retreat to Magersfontein, where hopefully we'll be able to stop them once and for all.
dst: 您的任务已取得完全成功，但英军仍在威胁我们的防线。我们将撤往马赫斯方丹，希望能在那里一劳永逸地挡住他们。

src: Your mission is as simple as it is dangerous: you must pierce the German defence lines at the Saint Quentin Canal. Once you've opened a gap, your units will be relieved and the Australians will pursue the retreating Germans. Just like it happened in Saint Mihiel, the key to victory will be the coordinated use of combined arms.
dst: 您的任务既简单又危险：您必须在圣康坦运河撕开德军的防线。一旦打开缺口，您的部队就会被接替，澳大利亚人将追击撤退的德军。就像圣米耶勒之战那样，胜利的关键在于诸兵种的协同运用。

src: Your mission is clear general, crush the bolshevik resistance here and end with the Russian power in the Pacific and with this war, for once and forever. After this battle, we are sure the Soviets will sign the armistice, the war will end, and Japan will be the main power in the world...
dst: 将军，您的任务很明确：粉碎这里布尔什维克的抵抗，一劳永逸地终结俄国在太平洋的势力、终结这场战争。此战之后，我们确信苏联将会签署停战协定，战争将会结束，日本将成为世界头号强国……

src: Your mission is i) to stop the Germans in the river in order to permit the redeployment of the allied armies and ii) to safely retreat your troops, so do not engage them unnecessarily.
dst: 您的任务是：其一，把德军阻止在河中，以便盟军重新部署；其二，安全撤出您的部队，因此不要不必要地与敌交战。

src: Your mission is not easy general.  You should deploy a detachment to the East of Guadalcanal, where the Ichiki Detachment is already deployed and attack the enemy beach head as soon as possible.  They should be kicked out from the Solomon's!  Wakarimasu-ka?  To support your mission, there is already a detachment from the Special Navy Landing Forces in the West, while the Imperial Navy will send an entire fleet plus some air units to strike the enemy warships...
dst: 将军，您的任务并不轻松。您应该向瓜达尔卡纳尔岛东部部署一支分队，一木支队已经部署在那里，并尽快进攻敌人的滩头阵地。应该把他们从所罗门群岛赶出去！明白了吗？为支援您的任务，西边已有一支来自海军特别陆战队的分队，而帝国海军将派出整支舰队外加一些空中单位去打击敌方战舰……

src: Your mission is to break the siege of Oviedo, clear the South miner area (where the most radical milita defenders are placed) and also capture Gijon, the last Republican capital in the North. The Cervera destroyer and some bous will support you from the coast and also the Legion Condor and the CTV forces from the air. Our supporters into the city, as you already know, will be out of their holes when you get closer to them.
dst: 您的任务是打破奥维耶多的包围，肃清南部矿区（那里部署着最顽固的民兵守军），并夺取希洪——共和军在北方的最后一座首府。塞韦拉号驱逐舰和一些拖网渔船将从海上支援您，秃鹰军团和意大利志愿军团则从空中支援。正如您所知，城中的支持者会在我们靠近时从藏身处现身。

src: Your mission is to break the siege of Oviedo, clear the Southern area (where the most radical milita defenders are placed) and also capture Gijon, the last Republican capital in the North. Some parts of the navy will support you from the coast and also the Legion Condor and the CTV forces from the air.
dst: 你的任务是解除奥维耶多之围，肃清南部地区（那里驻守着最激进的民兵），并攻占希洪——北方共和派的最后一座首府。部分海军将从海岸支援你，秃鹰军团和CTV部队也将从空中支援。

src: Your mission is to capture Oran, it's harbour, la Senia Naval airfield and Tafaraoui Air Force airfield. The French are expected to resist the landings.
dst: 你的任务是夺取奥兰、奥兰港、拉塞尼亚海军机场和塔法拉维空军机场。预计法军会抵抗登陆。

src: Your mission is to cross the river, and take the town of Fraga, where intelligence reports the enemy command center is deployed.
dst: 您的任务是渡过该河，攻取弗拉加镇，情报显示敌军指挥中心就部署在那里。

src: Your mission is to defend Madrid at any cost, if Madrid falls, the whole Spain will fall! Remember the Madrid people's slogan; No pasaran! ("They shall not pass!").
dst: 您的任务是不惜一切代价保卫马德里，如果马德里陷落，整个西班牙都将陷落！请记住马德里人民的口号；不许通过！（「他们休想通过！」）

src: Your mission is to evacuate the greatest possible number of troops.
dst: 你的任务是撤出尽可能多的部队。

src: Your mission is to make an organized retreat to the east bank of the Ebro river, trying to take as few losses as possible. Plus ultra, Senor General"
dst: 您的任务是向埃布罗河东岸有组织地撤退，尽量把损失降到最低。Plus ultra，将军先生

src: Your mission is to open up the supply route to the north through Arnhem, and  clear the northeast, and part of the western Netherlands. We have been in contact with the Dutch resistance, and have arranged a rendezvous with our Special forces operatives. The specific objective location will be made known when they arrive.  One last thing General, the latest intelligence has confirmed the existence of a POW camp for prisoners taken on the Eastern front. Liberate the prisoners and ensure their survival. Good luck General....
dst: 你的任务是打通经阿纳姆向北的补给线，并肃清荷兰东北部以及西部荷兰的一部分。我们已与荷兰抵抗组织取得联系，并安排了与盟军特种部队特工的会合。具体目标地点将在他们抵达后告知。还有最后一件事，将军：最新情报已证实，存在一处关押东线战俘的战俘营。解放这些战俘并确保他们存活。祝你好运，将军……

src: Your mission is to prepare 8 battalions for a purely amphibious operation.  You are to capture the two roads that lead to the fortresses.  This is necessary for demolition and evacuation operations to succeed.  The Soviets have had plenty of time to repair their fleet, so expect a desperate fight by the Red Navy.
dst: 您的任务是准备8个营，执行一次纯粹的两栖作战。您要夺取通往那两座要塞的两条道路。这是爆破与撤离行动得以成功的必要条件。苏俄有充足的时间修理他们的舰队，所以请准备迎接红海军拼死的抵抗。

src: Your mission is to reach the port of Hungnam while destroying all enemy forces along your way.  You must stop any UN evacuation as soon as possible.  A successful evacuation will be a victory for them.  The 2nd, 6th and 10th North Korean divisions (the 2nd Korean People's Army) will be under your direct command and the 20th PLA will arrive from the South as reinforcements.
dst: 你的任务是推进到兴南港，同时消灭沿途所有敌军。你必须尽快阻止联合国军任何撤离行动。撤离成功对他们来说就是一场胜利。朝鲜人民军第2、第6和第10师（朝鲜人民军第2军）将归你直接指挥，解放军第20军将从南面赶来作为增援。

src: Your mission is to seize Monterey and the surrounding area to use as a port.  Tomorrow morning our reinforcements will arrive as we expecting a heavy counterattack from San Jose and other minor villages near San Francisco.  Be aware; San Francisco is not our objective today as we are not ready for its heavy fortifications.
dst: 您的任务是夺取蒙特雷及周边地区，将其作为港口使用。明天早晨我们的援军将会抵达，因为我们预计会遭到来自圣何塞及旧金山附近其他小镇的猛烈反击。请注意：旧金山不是我们今天的目标，因为我们尚未准备好对付其坚固的防御工事。

src: Your mission is to stop the enemy offensive as soon as possible to allow a fast advance to Barcelona, ending with the Republican resistance in Catalunya.
dst: 您的任务是尽快阻止敌军攻势，以便迅速向巴塞罗那推进，终结共和军在加泰罗尼亚的抵抗。

src: Your mission is to stop the rebels here, by counterattacking, and keeping open communications with Madrid.
dst: 您的任务是就地阻止叛军，通过反击并保持与马德里的联络畅通。

src: Your mission will be to defend the mountain passes near Limanowa, stop the Russians, counterattack and retake the villages that our enemies currently hold. Good luck, General, we count on you!
dst: 您的任务是防守利马诺瓦附近的山口，挡住俄国人，发动反攻并夺回敌人目前占据的村庄。祝您好运，将军，我们指望您了！

src: Your mission will be to ensure that this does not happen. This time you will be without the support of other units, since all of them are occupying strategic positions in Álava to prepare our progress towards Burgos. Also the enemy will employ veteran units stationed in Santander and Santoña. But we have full confidence in your talent in combat.Good Luck!
dst: 您的使命就是确保此事不会发生。这一次您将得不到其他部队的支援，因为他们全都占领着阿拉瓦的战略要地，为向布尔戈斯挺进做准备。此外，敌人还将动用驻扎在桑坦德和桑托尼亚的老兵部队。但我们对您作战的天赋充满信心。祝您好运！

src: Your mission: Break through the British lines and force the B.E.F. to surrender. Beware of British counterattacks. Their armoured brigade has already brought Rommel's 7thPz division and the Totenkopf into problems a few days ago near Arras.
dst: 你的任务：突破英军防线，迫使英国远征军投降。提防英军反击。几天前在阿拉斯附近，他们的装甲旅已让隆美尔的第7装甲师和“骷髅”师陷入麻烦。

src: Your mission: Landing in northern shore and southern extremity of Hainan Island and occupy all key positions.  Naval support is provide for South China Naval Force.
dst: 您的任务：在海南岛北岸及南端登陆，并占领所有关键阵地。华南海军部队将提供海军支援。

src: Your mission: Show the enemy that we are not defeated, advance quickly towards the interior of Tunisia to create chaos within their armies.
dst: 您的任务：向敌人表明我们并未失败，迅速向突尼斯内陆推进，在他们的军队中制造混乱。

src: Your mission:- Advance at full speed and take Tebessa.
dst: 你的任务：——全速推进并夺取泰贝萨。

src: Your mobile XX Corps assisted by the few mobile elements of X and XXI Corps are tasked to follow the coastal road to Alexandria. Whatever forces 15Pz, 21Pz and 90Le can muster will go for Cairo - 150km SE of Alexandria (off map).
dst: 你的机动第20军在第10军和第21军少量机动部队的协助下，奉命沿公路向亚历山大推进。第15装甲师、第21装甲师和第90轻装师能凑出的兵力都将进攻开罗——亚历山大东南150公里处（图外）。

src: Your mobile forces were not big enough to encircle and destroy 8th Army. However, the arrival of our non-motorized infantry and artillery units at the front made Gen. Auchinleck give up Mersa Matruh. He is now taking position at El Alamein.
dst: 你的机动部队不足以合围并歼灭第8集团军。不过，我方非摩托化步兵和炮兵部队抵达前线，使奥金莱克将军放弃了梅尔萨马特鲁。他如今正在阿拉曼占领阵地。

src: Your must repair the damaged port at Bogen Bay, so you can deploy your units. Our elite Marinestosstrupp with fast built abilty are close to port. They are now under your command.
dst: 您必须修复 Bogen Bay 受损的港口，以便部署您的单位。我方具有快速建造能力的精锐海军突击队已接近港口。他们现在归您指挥。

src: Your next assignment is to take Warsaw and several nearby Polish cities by no later than September 30th. Intelligence warns us that the French and British are preparing for an attack towards the Rhine within 2-3 weeks, so it is important to take all of your objectives as soon as possible.
dst: 你的下一个任务是夺取华沙以及附近数座波兰城市，期限不得晚于9月30日。情报部门警告我们，法国和英国正准备在2至3周内向莱茵河方向发动进攻，因此尽快夺取全部目标至关重要。

src: Your next assignment will be enclose the Anglo-American armies that are in Bone.
dst: 您的下一项任务将是围歼位于博讷的英美军队。

src: Your next destination is Korea and Commander we need officers there.
dst: 您的下一个目的地是朝鲜，指挥官，我们那里需要军官。

src: Your next destination is Korea and Commander your services are needed there.
dst: 您的下一个目的地是朝鲜，指挥官，那里需要您效力。

src: Your next goal is city of Sverdlovsk, a transport and industrial center on the European-Asian border. We own no information about the strength of the defenders of the city, maybe it is possible you manage to capture the city in a surprise attack by the current chaos among the enemy ranks.
dst: 你的下一个目标是斯维尔德洛夫斯克城，欧亚交界处的一座交通与工业中心。我们没有关于该城守军兵力的情报，也许趁敌军当前一片混乱，你能以突袭拿下这座城市。

src: Your next goal is to advance along the west coast to the north towards Galway and Sligo and give flank protection for our main forces which have the order to attack Dublin and Belfast on the east coast.
dst: 你的下一个目标是沿西海岸向北推进到戈尔韦和斯莱戈，为我主力部队提供侧翼掩护——主力部队奉命进攻东海岸的都柏林和贝尔法斯特。

src: Your next mission is to defeat the Yugoslav and Greek armies and force the British forever from the European mainland. You should capture your objectives by April 30th so that our upcoming invasion of Russia is not delayed. If you are able to complete your mission earlier, we may honor you with the command of our planned airborne assault on Crete.
dst: 你的下一项任务是击败南斯拉夫与希腊军队，把英国人永远逐出欧洲大陆。你应在 4月30日前夺取各项目标，以免我们即将发动的对俄进攻被拖延。若能提前完成任务，我们或将委你指挥计划中的克里特空降突击，以为嘉奖。

src: Your next mission is to invade England. You must seize London and all other objectives in England before our limited shipping and the storms in the English Channel force us to withdraw our invasion forces. High command has given you until September 30th to complete your mission, but we fear that you must succeed sooner or we will see the invasion falter before the British surrender. Operation Sealion is about to begin. Good Luck!
dst: 你的下一个任务是入侵英国。你必须在我们的有限海运能力与英吉利海峡的风暴迫使我们撤回入侵部队之前，夺取伦敦以及英格兰境内的所有其他目标。最高统帅部给了你到9月30日的时间完成任务，但我们担心你必须更早取胜，否则入侵行动会在英国投降之前便难以为继。海狮行动即将开始。祝你好运！

src: Your next operation will be to try and enclose the Anglo-American Armies in Bone.
dst: 你的下一次作战将是设法把英美军队合围于博讷。

src: Your next task is the occupation of Cork, the most important port on the south coast of Ireland.
dst: 你的下一个任务是占领科克，爱尔兰南海岸最重要的港口。

src: Your objective is the fort of El Magdhaba. We are told it is defended by about 4000 troops with maybe some artillery. You will be assisted by a detachment of The Imperial Camel Corp and The Royal Flying Corp. Success is vital as the water at El Magdhaba will be needed for you and your horses. If you fail you will surely perish in the desert on your return trip!! You must upgrade all "Regular Infantry" units to "Light Horse" units. Only "Sappers" should remain as foot soliders.
dst: 您的目标是马格达巴要塞。据我们了解，它由约4000名守军防守，可能还有一些炮兵。帝国骆驼队和皇家飞行队的一支分遣队将协助您。此战的胜利至关重要，因为您和您战马需要的饮水就在马格达巴。如果失败，您回程时必定会葬身沙漠！！您必须把所有「正规步兵」单位升级为「轻骑兵」单位。只有「工兵」应当继续作为徒步步兵保留。

src: Your objectives are the resulting craters from the mines' explosions and the cities of Messines, Wytschaete, and Garaard.
dst: 您的目标是地雷爆炸形成的弹坑，以及梅西讷、维茨哈特和加拉德等城镇。

src: Your offensive do not deserve the word offensive. Romania still supports the Germans. We are at the end of patience with you and will not support you any longer.
dst: 你这次攻势配不上「攻势」二字。罗马尼亚仍在支持德国人。我们对你的耐心已经耗尽，不会再支持你了。

src: Your offensive was a complete disaster. We will have to wait for the infantry divisions to catch up before we can try another Dnepr crossing.
dst: 你的进攻彻底失败。我们必须等步兵师赶上来，才能再尝试一次渡第聂伯河。

src: Your operation was a failure. You are needed no longer.
dst: 你的行动失败了。不再需要你了。

src: Your opponent is the Army Group Balck. The troops are battle-wearied, but they have some serious tanks and fighters.
dst: 您的对手是巴尔克集团军群。这些部队久战疲惫，但他们有一些厉害的坦克和战斗机。

src: Your orders are to break through the Soviet defense and pierce deep into their lines, concentrating on enemy strongpoints and tanks.
dst: 你的命令是突破苏军防御、深入其战线，重点打击敌军支撑点和坦克。

src: Your orders are to capture Monte Cassion, overcome the Gustav Line and push westwards in order to connect with the Anzio beachhead and march for Rome later on. For the upcomming operation you will take command of Polish, Canadian, British and Free French Forces, which will fight alongside your core troops. Good Luck, Commander!
dst: 你的命令是夺取蒙特卡西诺，突破古斯塔夫防线，并向西推进，以便与安齐奥滩头阵地会合，随后向罗马进军。在即将到来的行动中，你将指挥波兰、加拿大、英国和自由法国部队，他们将与你的核心部队并肩作战。祝你好运，指挥官！

src: Your orders are to capture the cities of Mateur and Tebourba. Intelligence expects resistance from lightly armed enemy infantry. Expect no reinforcements.
dst: 你的命令是夺取马特尔与泰布尔拜两城。情报预计敌军步兵装备轻弱，抵抗有限。预计无增援。

src: Your orders are to capture the objectives around the city.  A Brilliant Victory here will allow you to replace your troops for second-line siege troops and to participate in the winter campaign.  Should you choose to conquer Przemysl outright, substantial prestige will be awarded to you from captured stock, but your forces will be given rest during winter.
dst: 您的命令是夺取城市周围的目标。在此达成大捷，将使您得以把部队替换为二线围城部队，并参加冬季战役。若您选择一举攻克普热梅希尔，缴获的物资将为您带来可观的威望，但您的部队将在冬季获得休整。

src: Your orders are to destroy Dewey's squadron, to retake Cavite Arsenal and to force the Americans to surrender or to re-embark.
dst: 您的命令是摧毁杜威的分舰队，夺回甲米地兵工厂，并迫使美国人投降或重新登船撤离。

src: Your orders are to join the Spanish column under Brigadier General Santocildes that will escort a supply convoy from Veguitas to Bayamo, a city in the middle of the insurgent stronghold. The Governor General of Cuban, Arsenio Martinez Campos, will also join the column to get an estimate of the situation.
dst: 您的命令是加入桑托西尔德斯准将率领的西班牙纵队，护送一支补给车队从贝吉塔斯前往巴亚莫——一座位于起义者腹地的城市。古巴总督阿塞尼奥·马丁内斯·坎波斯也将随纵队同行，以评估局势。

src: Your orders are to organize your army and launch another attack on the city. Do not fail!
dst: 你的命令是整顿你的军队，对这座城市发动另一次进攻。不许失败！

src: Your orders are to stop the Red Army so that our civilians can flee to the West and Berlin will end up in American hands, not in the hands of the Soviet barbarians.
dst: 你的命令是挡住红军，好让我们的平民西逃，让柏林最终落入美国人手中，而不是落进苏联人手里。

src: Your orders are to swiftly capture your objective and clear the way for the army's advance toward Koenigsberg.
dst: 您的命令是迅速夺取目标，为部队向柯尼斯堡的推进扫清道路。

src: Your orders are to take command of U-47 and to infiltrate Scapa Flow, the home of the Royal Navy. If you manage to stay undetected, you should be able to find and destroy a large target. Good luck, commander!
dst: 你的命令是接管 U-47，潜入皇家海军的老巢斯卡帕湾。若能保持不被发现，你应能找到一个大型目标并将其摧毁。祝你好运，指挥官！

src: Your orders are to throw the landings on the southern Pelloponese back into the sea. However, a massive airlanding near Corinth threatens to cut of your supply lines. I secretly but urgently advise you to give up your positions in the South and to throw everything you have against these paratroopers. An escape to Attica is your best option.
dst: 您的命令是把伯罗奔尼撒半岛南部的登陆部队赶下海去。然而，一场在科林斯附近的大规模机降正威胁切断您的补给线。我私下但紧急地建议您放弃南部阵地，把您手头的一切都投向这些伞兵。撤往阿提卡是您最好的选择。

src: Your orders are: Proceed northwards and take the Fortifications at Drewry's and Chaffin's Bluff and secure the Richmond & Petersburg Railroad. We captured a lot of locomotives and river steamboats at Petersburg, so transport of your heavy units should not be a problem.
dst: 您的命令是：向北推进，夺取德鲁里崖和查芬崖的防御工事，并确保里士满-彼得斯堡铁路的安全。我们在彼得斯堡缴获了大量机车和河上汽船，所以重型部队的运输应该不成问题。

src: Your orders commander: Cross the Strait of Dover and make landfall at the coast of Kent. Establish a beachhead and make your way to your objectives. Since our operations against Portsmouth and Southampton we don't expect naval attacks in the south-west.
dst: 你的命令，指挥官：横渡多佛海峡，在肯特海岸登陆。建立滩头，然后向你的目标推进。由于我们对朴次茅斯和南安普敦的行动，我们不预计西南方向会有海上进攻。

src: Your outstanding victory near Warsaw defending against the Soviet juggernaut has helped us keep the Soviets at bay for another year.
dst: 你在华沙附近抗击苏联庞然大物的卓越胜利，帮助我们又把苏联人挡住了一年。

src: Your performance at Komarov-Tomashov has given the opportunity for a flanking attack against the 4th Army.  You must speedily execute this task!
dst: 您在科马罗夫-托马绍夫的表现，为对第4集团军发起侧翼进攻创造了机会。您必须迅速执行这项任务！

src: Your performance has been splendid. I think that you deserve a rest. You will be transferred to our border with Romania. That country is still neutral, so right now the sector is quiet, but don't be overconfident. Things might change in the future.
dst: 您的表现极为出色。我认为您理应得到休整。您将被调往我们与罗马尼亚的边境。该国目前仍保持中立，所以眼下这一地段十分平静，但切莫掉以轻心。未来局势或许会发生变化。

src: Your performance in Holland was quite disappointing and because of it, we have lost any ability to counterattack before the enemy's final assault on Germany.
dst: 你在荷兰的表现相当令人失望，正因如此，在敌军对德国发动最后攻势之前，我们已丧失了任何反攻能力。

src: Your performance in Holland was very good, but unfortunately,  we have still lost any ability to counterattack before the enemy's final assault on Germany.
dst: 你在荷兰的表现非常出色，但遗憾的是，在敌军对德国发动最后攻势之前，我们仍然丧失了任何反攻能力。

src: Your performance is similar to the historical result of the battle.
dst: 您的表现与这场战役的历史结果相近。

src: Your performance was Excellent!, Herr General. The Soviet 3rd Tank Corps, and the 8th Guards Tank Corps have been severely mauled. Even if the Soviets were waiting for us to crush the Warsaw uprising before resuming their offensive, now they will have a much harder time doing so...
dst: 你的表现极为出色！将军阁下。苏联第3坦克军和第8近卫坦克军已遭重创。即便苏联人原本是在等我们镇压华沙起义之后才恢复攻势，现在他们要这么做也难得多了……

src: Your performance was Excellent, Herr General, and with Kharkov once again ours, your men are being moved south for refitting as a Panzergrenadier division! Also the Estonian SS-Freiwilligen-Panzergrenadier-Battalion Narwa is being attached to your division to replace the departing Nordland Regiment and Finnisches Freiwilligen-Battalion...
dst: 你的表现极为出色，将军阁下，随着哈尔科夫重归我方，你的部队正南调改编为装甲掷弹兵师！此外，党卫军爱沙尼亚志愿装甲掷弹兵营「纳尔瓦」将编入你的师，以接替即将调离的「诺德兰」团和芬兰志愿营……

src: Your performance was Good, Herr General, and with Kharkov once again ours, your men are being moved south for refitting as a Panzergrenadier division! Also the Estonian SS-Freiwilligen-Panzergrenadier-Battalion Narwa is being attached to your division to replace the departing Nordland Regiment and Finnisches Freiwilligen-Battalion...
dst: 你的表现良好，将军阁下，随着哈尔科夫重归我方，你的部队正南调改编为装甲掷弹兵师！此外，党卫军爱沙尼亚志愿装甲掷弹兵营「纳尔瓦」将编入你的师，以接替即将调离的「诺德兰」团和芬兰志愿营……

src: Your performance was Good, Herr General. The Soviet 3rd Tank Corps, and the 8th Guards Tank Corps have been severely mauled. Even if the Soviets were waiting for us to crush the Warsaw uprising before resuming their offensive, now they will have a much harder time doing so...
dst: 你的表现良好，将军阁下。苏联第3坦克军和第8近卫坦克军已遭重创。即便苏联人原本是在等我们镇压华沙起义之后才恢复攻势，现在他们要这么做也难得多了……

src: Your performance was a shame for the sovietunion. The Germans could break up the pocket and save the 6. Army. The death squad is already on the way to you.
dst: 您的表现是苏联的耻辱。德军得以打破包围圈，救出了第6集团军。行刑队已经在去找您的路上了。

src: Your performance was ok. You cold hold most of your targets.
dst: 你的表现还算可以。你守住了大部分目标。

src: Your performance was only a partitial success. Next time you should accomplish your mission in a better way.
dst: 您的表现只能算部分成功。下次您应当更好地完成任务。

src: Your performance was outstanding! The fortresses of Douaumont, Vaux and Souville - or what is left of them - are all captured. The offensive will be continued by other troops.
dst: 您的表现极为出色！杜奥蒙、沃克斯和苏维尔要塞——或者说它们的残骸——已全部被攻克。攻势将由其他部队继续推进。

src: Your performance was outstanding! Two of the fortresses are captured. The offensive will be continued by other troops.
dst: 您的表现极为出色！已有两座要塞被攻克。攻势将由其他部队继续推进。

src: Your performance was satisfactory, Herr General, and with Kharkov once again ours, your men are being moved south for refitting as a Panzergrenadier division! Also the Estonian SS-Freiwilligen-Panzergrenadier-Battalion Narwa is being attached to your division to replace the departing Nordland Regiment and Finnisches Freiwilligen-Battalion...
dst: 你的表现令人满意，将军阁下，随着哈尔科夫重归我方，你的部队正南调改编为装甲掷弹兵师！此外，党卫军爱沙尼亚志愿装甲掷弹兵营「纳尔瓦」将编入你的师，以接替即将调离的「诺德兰」团和芬兰志愿营……

src: Your performance was satisfactory, Herr General, considering the situation. You managed to break out of the Soviet encirclement relatively intact! I must now inform you that the Sturmbrigade Wallonien and the Panzergrenadier-Battalion Narwa are now being withdrawn from your division. Wallonien will be sent back to Wildflecken to be reformed, and Narwa will be integrated into
dst: 考虑到当时的局势，你的表现令人满意，将军阁下。你成功相对完整地突出了苏军的合围！我现在必须通知你，「瓦隆尼亚」突击旅和「纳尔瓦」装甲掷弹兵营正从你的师中撤出。「瓦隆尼亚」将返回维尔弗莱肯重建，「纳尔瓦」则将编入

src: Your performance was satisfactory, Herr General, the Uman pocket has been sealed...
dst: 你的表现令人满意，将军阁下，乌曼口袋已被封死……

src: Your performance was satisfactory, Herr General, the bridgeheads have been secured...
dst: 你的表现令人满意，将军阁下，桥头堡已经巩固……

src: Your performance was satisfactory, Herr General, we are now driving deep into the Caucasus!
dst: 你的表现令人满意，将军阁下，我们如今正深入高加索！

src: Your performance was satisfactory, Herr General. The Soviet 3rd Tank Corps, and the 8th Guards Tank Corps have been severely mauled. Even if the Soviets were waiting for us to crush the Warsaw uprising before resuming their offensive, now they will have a much harder time doing so...
dst: 你的表现令人满意，将军阁下。苏联第3坦克军和第8近卫坦克军已遭重创。即便苏联人原本是在等我们镇压华沙起义之后才恢复攻势，现在他们要这么做也难得多了……

src: Your performance was satisfactory, Herr General...
dst: 您的表现尚可，将军阁下……

src: Your performance was very disappointing. The offensive will be continued by other troops.
dst: 您的表现令人非常失望。攻势将由其他部队继续推进。

src: Your plans to move to the countryside, where life will be cheaper, seem like a great idea. It tears my heart to be unable to help you in the present situation, but you know that there is very little money that I can send you these days. Your cousins have been the most generous and I will have an eternal debt to them, but it wouldn't be fair to ask for their help once again. When this nightmare is over I hope that Russia will reward all our efforts. But right now we'll have to live in poverty. Just like when we married. Do you remember? Those were very happy days, even though dreams were the only thing we had plenty of (...)
dst: 您打算搬到乡下，那里生活开销更低，这主意似乎很棒。在目前处境下无法帮您，让我心如刀割，但您知道这些日子我能寄给您的钱少得可怜。您的堂兄弟们一直最为慷慨，我将永远感激他们，但再向他们求助就不合适了。等这场噩梦结束，我希望俄国会回报我们所有的付出。但眼下我们只能过清贫日子。就像我们刚结婚时那样。您还记得吗？那时我们唯一富余的就是梦想，可那些日子多么快乐（……）
你的骄傲的特雷维里人军队

src: Your punch through the Russian right flank showed your troop's understanding of blitzkrieg, despite your countries rather light equipment, we must urge Italy & Germany to share Tank designs.
dst: 你击穿俄军右翼的突击，展现了你部队对闪电战的理解；尽管贵国装备较轻，我们必须敦促意大利和德国共享坦克设计。

src: Your punch through the Russian right flank showed your troop's understanding of blitzkrieg.  The Romanian Troops lost all doubts by your example and finished off the Russians soon after.
dst: 你击穿俄军右翼的突击，展现了你部队对闪电战的理解。罗马尼亚部队在你的榜样下打消了所有疑虑，很快解决了残敌。

src: Your punch through the Russian right flank was another fine example of true blitzkrieg.  The Romanian Troops followed your example and finished off the Russians quickly.
dst: 你击穿俄军右翼的突击，是真正闪电战的又一典范。罗马尼亚部队以你为榜样，迅速解决了残敌。

src: Your quick advance has created a salient in the enemy lines, like the one at the Chosin Reservoir.  This sector is protected by a North American division.  Your task is to make a surprise attack from two different directions and destroy the entire enemy division.  Be careful, our spies report that it's a crack division and they have air support from an improvised airstrip near the reservoir.  Air reinforcements are on the way.
dst: 你的快速推进在敌军战线上形成了一个突出部，就像长津湖这里的这个。这一地段由一个北美师掩护。你的任务是从两个不同方向发起奇袭，全歼该敌师。小心，我们的间谍报告说那是一个精锐师，而且他们从水库附近的一座临时机场获得空中支援。空中增援正在赶来。

src: Your raid on Krasnaya Gorka has met limited success.  The few rescued mutineers have provided valuable information to our fleet command regarding Soviet anti-shipping installations.  Furthermore, the presence of hastily conscripted units (Polk Bednoty was a regiment raised from homeless Petrograd men) is a clear indicator of the strain our offensive has caused the Red Army command.
dst: 您对红戈尔卡的突袭取得了有限成功。获救的少数哗变士兵向我舰队指挥部提供了有关苏俄反舰设施的宝贵情报。此外，仓促征召部队（贫民团就是由彼得格勒无家可归者组成的一个团）的出现，清楚地表明我们的攻势给红军指挥带来了巨大压力。

src: Your raid on Krasnaya Gorka has met success.  The rescued mutineers have provided valuable information to our fleet command regarding Soviet anti-shipping installations.  Furthermore, the presence of hastily conscripted units (Polk Bednoty was a regiment raised from homeless Petrograd men) is a clear indicator of the strain our offensive has caused the Red Army command.
dst: 您对红戈尔卡的突袭取得了成功。获救的哗变士兵向我舰队指挥部提供了有关苏俄反舰设施的宝贵情报。此外，仓促征召部队（贫民团就是由彼得格勒无家可归者组成的一个团）的出现，清楚地表明我们的攻势给红军指挥带来了巨大压力。

src: Your raid on Krasnaya Gorka has succeeded brilliantly!  The rescued mutineers have provided valuable information to our fleet command regarding Soviet anti-shipping installations.  Furthermore, the presence of hastily conscripted units (Polk Bednoty was a regiment raised from homeless Petrograd men) is a clear indicator of the strain our offensive has caused the Red Army command.
dst: 您对红戈尔卡的突袭大获成功！被解救的哗变士兵向我舰队指挥部提供了有关苏俄反舰设施的宝贵情报。此外，仓促征召部队（贫民团就是由彼得格勒无家可归者组成的一个团）的出现，清楚地表明我们的攻势给红军指挥带来了巨大压力。

src: Your raid on Krasnaya Gorka has turned out to be a resounding failure.  No mutineers have been rescued, and your troops suffered heavy casualties.  Nonetheless, the Red Army has received a tactical shock, and we must carry this momentum forward into the upcoming offensive, Kindralmajor.
dst: 您对红戈尔卡的突袭结果是一场彻头彻尾的失败。没有哗变士兵获救，您的部队伤亡惨重。尽管如此，红军还是受到了战术上的震动，我们必须把这一势头带入即将到来的攻势，少将。

src: Your readers should know that my name is Andrés Martínez Regos. I was born in Northern Spain in 1840, to a very large family. Although my parents did their best, it was impossible to raise so many children, so I joined the army when I was very young. I turned out to be a good soldier, and when the war with Morocco started, I was already a sergeant. I fought at the Castillejos and Tetouan, but I was badly wounded there. The doctors could save my leg but, as you see, I became lame for the rest of my life.
dst: 您的读者应当知道，我的名字叫安德烈斯·马丁内斯·雷戈斯。1840年我出生于西班牙北部一个非常大的家庭。尽管父母尽了最大努力，但要养活这么多孩子是不可能的，所以我年纪很小就参了军。我证明了自己是名好士兵，与摩洛哥的战争爆发时，我已经是一名中士。我参加了卡斯蒂列霍斯和得土安的战斗，但在那里身负重伤。医生们保住了我的腿，但如您所见，我余生都成了瘸子。

src: Your recent performance has been superb; unfortunately, the Western Allies' overwhelming quantitative superiority has allowed them to force us back to our borders. Your most recent victory in Southern France combined with your earlier victory in Normandy have proven to us that you have the ability to lead our upcoming counterattack in the Ardennes.
dst: 你近期的表现极为出色；遗憾的是，西线盟军压倒性的数量优势已将我们逼回本土边界。你最近在法国南部的胜利，加上此前在诺曼底的胜利，已向我们证明你有能力指挥我们即将在阿登地区发起的反攻。

src: Your removal of the British hold on Malta will be key to Marshall Graziani's success in North Africa!
dst: 你拔除英军对马耳他的控制，将是格拉齐亚尼元帅在北非取胜的关键！

src: Your retreat was almost perfect. You can join the rest of the German troops at the eastern part of the colony.  Here you will take command of the garrisons of the Lindi area.
dst: 您的撤退近乎完美。您可以到殖民地的东部与其余德军会合。在那里，您将接管林迪地区的守备部队。

src: Your secondary objective is the small island of Gozo, just north of Malta.
dst: 你的次要目标是马耳他正北方的小岛戈佐。

src: Your services will be required in the spring when the offensive actions will be renewed. The old Panzer I tanks will be replaced with new Panzer IIs, highly increasing the mobility of your unit.
dst: 春季攻势重启时，你的效劳仍将被需要。旧的一号坦克将换成新的二号坦克，大大提升你部队的机动性。

src: Your shameful defeat has forced us to lift the siege of Kimberley. I would shoot you right here, but the British will invade our country in a matter of days, and we'll need all the available soldiers against them. You'll have a chance to redeem yourself.
dst: 您耻辱的失败迫使我们解除了金伯利之围。我真想就地枪毙您，但英军几天之内就会入侵我们的国家，我们需要所有能用的士兵去对付他们。您会得到一次戴罪立功的机会。

src: Your ships are on the way from northwest, Luftwaffe recon bomber is back again to assist you scan the area, but now RAF can use the airfields. The hospital ship will be from now on part of your army.
dst: 你的舰船正从西北方向驶来，德国空军侦察轰炸机再次回归以协助你侦察该区域，但现在皇家空军可以使用这些机场了。这艘医院船从今往后将隶属于你的军队。

src: Your smashing success in overrunning the Russian frontier armies and taking Smolensk proves that yet again that you are the premier Panzer General in the world.
dst: 你碾压俄国边境各集团军并夺取斯摩棱斯克的辉煌胜利，再次证明你是世界上最杰出的装甲元帅。

src: Your solid performance near Warsaw against the Soviet juggernaut has helped us keep the Russians at bay for another year.
dst: 你在华沙附近抗击苏联庞然大物的稳健表现，帮助我们又把苏军挡住了一年。

src: Your son, as a brave warrior of the Imperial Army, and following the ancient learnings from the Bushido Code, died undertaking a banzai charge agaisnt the despicable enemy troops. His soul is resting now at the sacred Yasukuni temple in Tokyo.
dst: 您的儿子，作为帝国陆军的一名英勇战士，秉承武士道古训，在对卑鄙敌军发起万岁冲锋时阵亡。他的英灵如今安息在东京神圣的靖国神社。

src: Your storming of Sevastopol will be recognized as one of history's greatest assaults against a fortress.
dst: 你对塞瓦斯托波尔的强攻，将被公认为历史上最伟大的要塞攻坚作战之一。

src: Your success holding back the Allied invasion force was an inspiration to the Wehrmacht. Unfortunately, we were unable to stop their final reoccupation of Africa.
dst: 你成功遏止盟军入侵部队，令国防军深受鼓舞。遗憾的是，我们未能阻止他们最终重新占领非洲。

src: Your success in Poland has impressed the General Staff.
dst: 你在波兰的胜利给总参谋部留下了深刻印象。

src: Your success in phase one of the attack on Poland was outstanding. Due to your rapid advance, their defenses have been thrown into disarray, leaving the road to Warsaw wide open.
dst: 你在进攻波兰第一阶段的表现极为出色。由于你推进迅速，敌军防御已陷入混乱，通往华沙的道路已完全敞开。

src: Your success last summer in slowing the Allied breakout from Normandy has convinced us that you are the most qualified general to lead our upcoming counterattack in the Ardennes.
dst: 你去年夏天成功迟滞了盟军自诺曼底的突破，这使我们确信，你是率领我们即将在阿登发起反攻的最合适将领。

src: Your success to date has been noteworthy. Our control of the Middle East will allow us to attack the Caucasus from both west and south.
dst: 你迄今取得的成功值得称道。控制中东将使我们可以从西面和南面两个方向进攻高加索。

src: Your successful assault on Yugoslavia and Greece will allow us to begin an invasion of Russia without fearing an attack on our flank from the Balkans.
dst: 你对南斯拉夫与希腊的成功进攻，使我们得以在不必担心巴尔干方向侧翼受攻击的情况下发动对俄进攻。

src: Your successful capture of Malta has secured our position in the Mediterranean basin and our supply lines from Europe to Africa are much safer now. The English will trouble us no longer, and the entire area is under our control. You are to be congratulated. Excellent work!
dst: 你成功夺取马耳他，巩固了我们在地中海盆地中的地位，我们从欧洲到非洲的补给线如今安全得多。英国人再也不会来骚扰我们，整个地区都在我们控制之下。你值得祝贺。干得漂亮！

src: Your successful capture of Malta has secured our position in the Mediterranean basin.  The English will trouble us no longer, and the entire area is under our control.  Good day, Herr General.
dst: 你成功夺取马耳他，巩固了我们在地中海盆地的地位。英国人再也不会给我们添麻烦了，整个地区都在我们掌控之下。日安，将军阁下。

src: Your successful capture of Malta has secured our position in the Mediterranean basin.  The English will trouble us no longer, and the entire area is under our control.  You are to be congratulated.
dst: 你成功夺取马耳他，巩固了我们在地中海盆地的地位。英国人再也不会给我们添麻烦了，整个地区都在我们掌控之下。应当祝贺你。

src: Your successful capture of Malta has secured our position in the Mediterranean basin.  The English will trouble us no longer, and the entire area is under our control.  You are to be congratulated.  Excellent work!
dst: 你成功夺取马耳他，巩固了我们在地中海盆地的地位。英国人再也不会给我们添麻烦了，整个地区都在我们掌控之下。应当祝贺你。干得漂亮！

src: Your successful capture of Moscow turned out to be short-lived. Soviet reinforcements from Siberia were able to push back our weary troops. Fierce Soviet counterattacks have weakened our once invincible-armies.
dst: 你成功攻占莫斯科的战果未能持久。来自西伯利亚的苏军增援击退了我军疲惫的部队。苏军的猛烈反攻削弱了我军昔日无敌的军团。

src: Your successful conclusion of the battle for Kiev has been noted.
dst: 你成功结束基辅战役一事已记录在案。

src: Your successful delaying action in Africa was helpful in slowing the Allies. Unfortunately, we were unable to stop their final reoccupation.
dst: 你在非洲卓有成效的迟滞作战有助于延缓盟军的推进。遗憾的是，我们未能阻止他们最终的重新占领。

src: Your superb tactical skills are needed in Hungary where the situation is critical. The Bolsheviks have besieged Budapest, and we believe that if it falls our Hungarian allies will sue for peace. You must relieve Budapest.
dst: 你的卓越战术才能是匈牙利所急需的，那里的局势十分危急。布尔什维克已围困布达佩斯，我们认为一旦该城陷落，我方匈牙利盟友就会求和。你必须解救布达佩斯。

src: Your supremacy has rendered the Boii ineffective.
dst: 你的威势已使波伊人失去战力。

src: Your supremacy has rendered the Boii ineffective. They have appointed you as their new King and will be by your side in all your future battles.
dst: 你的威势已使波伊人失去战力。他们已拥立你为新的国王，并将在你未来所有的战役中站在你这边。

src: Your swift and decisive attack completely destroyed both Soviet divisions; all of Finland is celebrating the great victory!
dst: 你迅猛而果断的进攻彻底歼灭了两个苏军师；全芬兰都在庆祝这场大胜！

src: Your swift and well executed reaction chased the Belgian Army back into their ring of Antwerp fortresses.
dst: 您迅速而漂亮的反应将比利时陆军赶回了他们的安特卫普要塞环。

src: Your tantrum at the staff meeting has gotten you relieved!
dst: 你在参谋会议上大发脾气，让你被解职了！

src: Your task is ''easy'', stop the americans, and kick them out from the Tokyo sector. Our special air attack units (tokko), and our land attack units recruited from the population will attack in first wave... they are deployed in the beaches, and we are sure they will act like true samurais, then, use your units to counterattack... This is the last battle of the war, we must get the victory to save the Japanese Empire, or die.
dst: 您的任务很「轻松」：挡住美国人，把他们赶出东京地区。我们的特别航空攻击队（特攻）以及从民众中征募的陆上攻击队将作为第一波发起攻击……他们部署在海滩上，我们相信他们会像真正的武士那样作战，随后，用您的部队发起反击……这是战争的最后一战，我们必须取胜以拯救日本帝国，否则就只有死。

src: Your task is clear; defeat the Republican advance and restore our lines at any costs!!!.
dst: 您的任务很明确：击退共和军的推进，不惜一切代价恢复我们的防线！！！

src: Your task is clear; defeat the Republican advance and restore our lines at any costs!!!. Be careful, the best red units are in front of us!, specially the 11th enemy division, commanded by Lister.
dst: 您的任务很明确：不惜一切代价击退共和军的进攻，恢复我们的防线！！！小心，我们正面对的是共和军最精锐的部队！尤其是由利斯特尔指挥的敌军第11师。

src: Your task is to accomplish the codenamed ,,Operation Theseus''. This operation means to break the enemy lines in the Bir Hacheim area using the best of the DAK armored forces, and make a fast advance behind the front lines, surrounding the enemy. Finally, you should assault the Tobruk fortress, and take all the other mission objetives.
dst: 你的任务是执行代号“忒修斯行动”的作战。此行动意在动用非洲军最精锐的装甲部队突破比尔哈凯姆地区的敌军防线，迅速向敌后推进，包围敌人。最后，你应当突击托布鲁克要塞，并夺取所有其他任务目标。

src: Your task is to aid the Persian "rebels" in clearing Tehran. With a success here, Persia surely will be an important ally in the coming years.
dst: 您的任务是协助波斯“叛军”肃清德黑兰。若在此成功，波斯在未来数年必将成为重要的盟友。

src: Your task is to end with the enemy resistance in Vizcaya and to capture the city of Bilbao. Our supporters into the city will appeared as soon as you get closer to Bilbao to aid your troops clearing the buildings.
dst: 您的任务是肃清比斯开境内的敌军抵抗，并夺取毕尔巴鄂城。当我们靠近毕尔巴鄂时，城中的支持者便会现身，协助您的部队肃清楼房。

src: Your task is to take as many of the positions of the Reinhard line as possible.
dst: 你的任务是尽可能多地夺取莱因哈德防线的阵地。

src: Your task is to wipe out the paratroopers and to stop more troops from crossing the Rhein.
dst: 你的任务是消灭空降兵，并阻止更多部队渡过莱茵河。

src: Your tour of duty in the region has come to an end:  your assignment takes you back to the Motherland for strategic planning along the European frontier of the Empire.
dst: 您在该地区的服役期已经结束：新的任务将您召回祖国，去参与帝国欧洲边境一线的战略规划。

src: Your troop's attack on the left managed to support the conduct of this encirclement, however I am concerned over your losses.
dst: 你的部队在左翼的进攻得以支援这次合围的实施，不过我担心你的损失。

src: Your troop's attack on the left seem to run into a brick wall, I am concerned over your losses, can you even hold your lines?
dst: 你的部队在左翼的进攻似乎撞上了铜墙铁壁，我担心你的损失，你还能守住你的战线吗？

src: Your troop's attack on the left successfully supported of the conduct of this encirclement!
dst: 你的部队在左翼的进攻成功支援了这次合围的实施！

src: Your troop's attack on the left was completely successful in support of the speedy conduct of this encirclement!
dst: 你的部队在左翼的进攻完全成功，有力支援了这次合围的快速实施！

src: Your troop's inability to screen the flanks of my Panzerkorps forced the main thrust to halt and support your flank guard efforts. True that our reconnaisance underestimated the hordes that charged against us, but your troops could have performed better!
dst: 你的部队未能掩护好我装甲军的两翼，迫使主攻停下来支援你的侧翼掩护。诚然，我们的侦察低估了冲向我们的人海，但你的部队本可以做得更好！

src: Your troops and the hotchpotch of German troops that arrived in 1st Division's (Superga) sector were not able to take the assigned targets from the French Maroccan and French Algerian Divisions. The planned Allied offensive will continue. This will undoubtably result in the Axis troops being split. Panzer Armee Afrika cannot keep up the fight without supplies. This is the end of Mussolini's Afrika Corps!
dst: 你的部队连同抵达第1师（苏佩尔加）地段的杂牌德军，未能从法国摩洛哥师和法国阿尔及利亚师手中夺取预定目标。盟军计划中的攻势将继续进行。这无疑将导致轴心国部队被分割。没有补给，非洲装甲集团军无法继续作战。墨索里尼的非洲军到此为止了！

src: Your troops are at the gates of the capital of the enemy! The seizure of Washington will be a psychological blow to the American people and the enemy will do anything to stop you and prevent this shame. In addition to Washington exists another center of the opponent's resistance. South of the capital is the U.S. Marine Corps Base Quantico. Also there, the enemy will probably fight a stubborn battle. Proceed with caution and focus your attack on these two main target. Enemy counterattacks in your flanks are not expected.
dst: 你的部队已兵临敌方首都城下！夺取华盛顿将对美国民众造成心理打击，敌人会不惜一切阻止你、洗刷这一耻辱。除了华盛顿，敌人还有另一处抵抗中心。首都以南是美国海军陆战队匡蒂科基地。那里敌人多半也会顽强作战。谨慎推进，把你的进攻集中在这两个主要目标上。预计你的两翼不会遭到敌军反击。

src: Your troops are exhausted, so you'll be relieved from the front line for some weeks. But don't get used to it, we'll need you again in a few weeks, either here in the Balkans or in the Galitzian borderlands.
dst: 您的部队已疲惫不堪，因此将从前线撤下来休整数周。但别习惯了，几周后我们还会需要您，不是在巴尔干，就是在加利西亚边境。

src: Your troops are receiving much-needed training under your guidance.  The local population in the Lake Peipus region is indebted to your actions.  The Red Army raids are seen as very serious threats to the security of Estonia in Tallinn:  they may be precursors to an invasion by the Soviet Union.
dst: 在您的指导下，您的部队正在接受亟需的训练。佩普西湖地区的当地民众对您的行动感激不尽。红军的袭扰被视为对塔林的爱沙尼亚安全的严重威胁：它们可能是苏联入侵的前兆。

src: Your troops are routed back to the West via railroad in the Leningrad area. There still exists organized resistance.
dst: 你的部队正乘火车调回西面的列宁格勒地区。那里仍存在有组织的抵抗。

src: Your troops are setting combat example for the whole Estonian army!  The local population in the Lake Peipus region is indebted to your actions.  The Red Army raids are seen as very serious threats to the security of Estonia in Tallinn:  they may be precursors to an invasion by the Soviet Union.
dst: 您的部队正在为整个爱沙尼亚军队树立战斗榜样！佩普西湖地区的当地民众对您的行动感激不尽。红军的袭扰被视为对塔林的爱沙尼亚安全的严重威胁：它们可能是苏联入侵的前兆。

src: Your troops are waiting you in the Ardennes.
dst: 你的部队正在阿登等待你。

src: Your troops are waiting you in the Canal Albert.
dst: 你的部队正在阿尔贝运河等待你。

src: Your troops can choose to join the main effort in the centre or help in the flanks.
dst: 您的部队可以选择加入中央的主攻，或协助两翼。

src: Your troops caught the Russians as they were vulnerable and your men and pushed them back to their start lines!
dst: 你的部队趁俄军薄弱之际出击，你和你的人把他们赶回了出发线！

src: Your troops caught the Russians completely off guard, and that is the word of several Russian Officer prisoners that we have taken!
dst: 你的部队让俄军完全措手不及——这是我们俘获的数名俄军军官亲口所说！

src: Your troops deserve my sincerest congratulations!
dst: 您的部队值得我致以最诚挚的祝贺！

src: Your troops fought like demons, and that is the word of several Russian prisoners that we have taken!
dst: 你的部队作战如恶魔一般——这是我们俘获的数名俄军俘虏亲口所说！

src: Your troops fought well, but this offensive seemed doomed before it began.
dst: 你的部队打得好，但这次攻势似乎一开始就注定失败。

src: Your troops have arrived the Oder at Küstrin. Take Küstrin, take positions along the river and build a bridgehead over the river at Küstrin.
dst: 你的部队已抵达屈斯特林附近的奥得河。夺取屈斯特林，沿河占领阵地，并在屈斯特林的奥得河上建立一处桥头堡。

src: Your troops have been transferred from 6SSPz Armee to the 5PzArmee and have swung south around LSSAH. Your task is to capture the crossroads at Baraque Fraiture, push through the US lines of defense and capture Liege.
dst: 你的部队已从党卫军第6装甲集团军转隶第5装甲集团军，并绕过警卫旗队向南迂回。你的任务是夺取巴拉屈弗拉蒂尔的路口，突破美军防线，攻取列日。

src: Your troops have dug in in shallow trenches. The ground here is flat and cut by many small drainage ditches. Behind our lines is the Bois de Biez, with even further back, Aubers Ridge - barely 20 feet higher than the surrounding area but giving an observation advantage.
dst: 您的部队已挖好浅壕据守。这里地势平坦，被许多排水小沟切割。我方战线后方是比耶树林，再往后是欧贝尔山脊——它仅比周围地区高出20英尺，却拥有观测优势。

src: Your troops have fought fiercely and have enabled our army to safely take positions on the "Ligne KW" (Dyle line).
dst: 您的部队作战英勇，使我军得以安全进入“KW 防线”（迪尔河防线）阵地。

src: Your troops have traveled from Oslo to the important city of Kristiansand, where they will help the dissembark of gruppe 4, commanded by the Captain Friedrich Rieve. Kriegsmarine important ships will aid your drive on Kristiansand. There are some norvegian ships in the area too, we think they won't be a serious problem. Your troops will take some points in the mountains, in order to avoid the arrive of allied reinforments to the norvegians.
dst: 您的部队已从奥斯陆开拔至重要城市克里斯蒂安桑，他们将在那里协助由弗里德里希·里弗上校指挥的第4战斗群登陆。德国海军的重要舰船将支援您对克里斯蒂安桑的推进。该地区也有一些挪威舰船，我们认为它们不会构成严重问题。您的部队将夺取山中的一些据点，以阻止盟军援军抵达挪威人手中。

src: Your troops met the Russians as they came racing through the gaps in 8th Army's front and your men and stubbornly forced them back to their start lines!
dst: 你的部队迎上从第8集团军正面缺口冲来的俄军，你和你的人顽强地把他们赶回了出发线！

src: Your troops really deserve to be considered as the elite of the Belgian army!
dst: 您的部队确实无愧于比利时军队精锐之称！

src: Your troops reported seeing multiple winged ants within each nest; queens, ready to fly off and repopulate elsewhere.  Thank God we nipped that in the bud.
dst: 你的部队报告，每个巢穴里都有多只带翅的蚂蚁；那是蚁后，随时准备飞出去到别处繁衍。谢天谢地，我们把它扼杀在了萌芽阶段。
