src: Your troops screened the flanks of my Panzerkorps good enough that few Russians got through to hamper the main thrust.  Our reconnaisance underestimated the hordes that charged against us, who could have guessed the Russians could attack in such strength!
dst: 你的部队把我装甲军两翼掩护得够好，只有少数俄军得以突入干扰主攻。我们的侦察低估了冲向我们的人海——谁能料到俄军能以如此规模进攻！

src: Your troops screened the flanks of my Panzerkorps good enough that the main thrust surged forward at good speed! Your forces on the right fought valiantly against the hordes that pressed in to stop us and stopped them.
dst: 你的部队把我装甲军两翼掩护得够好，主攻得以高速猛进！你右翼的部队英勇抗击蜂拥而来阻止我们的敌军，并挡住了他们。

src: Your troops screened the flanks of my Panzerkorps so well that the main thrust surged forward at great speed! Your forces on the right fought valiantly against the hordes that pressed in to stop us and stopped them cold!
dst: 你的部队把掩护我装甲军两翼的任务完成得如此出色，主攻得以高速猛进！你右翼的部队英勇抗击蜂拥而来阻止我们的敌军，并把他们死死挡住！

src: Your troops should be ashore and in control of the high ground by this evening!! Our sources tell us that this area is weakly defended. Good Luck.
dst: 到今晚，您的部队应当已经上岸并控制高地了！！我们的情报显示，这一地区防守薄弱。祝您好运。

src: Your troops will also be honored, and good friends of mine have word that you are favored to lead the assault on Malta.  Congratulations to you General, and good luck in your next mission!
dst: 你的部队也将受到表彰，我的一些好友得到消息，说你有望领导对马耳他的突击。恭喜你，将军，祝你的下一个任务好运！

src: Your troops will embark for Libia within the month.
dst: 你的部队将在一个月内登船前往利比亚。

src: Your troops will embark for Suvla Bay!
dst: 您的部队将登船前往苏夫拉湾！

src: Your troops will go to Kongsvinger.
dst: 您的部队将前往孔斯温厄尔。

src: Your troops will go to Kristiansand.
dst: 您的部队将前往克里斯蒂安桑。

src: Your troops will have to stop the Moroccans at the gates of Melilla and save Spain's honor and its men.  You can expect reinforcements from Spain.  First save Melilla and the unarmed colonists, then counterattack and crush the rebel Riffians.
dst: 您的部队必须在梅利利亚城门口挡住摩洛哥人，保住西班牙的荣誉和她的士兵。您可以期待来自西班牙本土的援军。先解救梅利利亚和手无寸铁的移民，然后发起反击，粉碎叛乱的里夫人。

src: Your troops will join the 1st brigade in a counter-offensive aimed at recapturing Tartu and at stopping the Red Latvians at this frontier.  Beware of roadblocks that Soviet partisans have set up on the approaches to Tartu!  You will receive as reinforcement what little reserves the brigade posesses within days.
dst: 您的部队将加入第1旅，参加旨在夺回塔尔图、并在这条边境线上阻止红色拉脱维亚人的反攻。当心苏联游击队在通往塔尔图的要道上设置的路障！数日之内，您将收到该旅所拥有的那一点微薄预备队作为增援。

src: Your troops will now screen our left flank as Guderian's troops race for the channel!
dst: 你的部队现在将掩护我方左翼，而古德里安的部队则向海峡疾驰！

src: Your troops, now located in the Arnhem sector of Holland,  are fighting off a massive Allied attack aimed at securing a path across the many rivers and canals leading to the vital crossing of the Rhine at Arnhem. It is essential that you prevent the Allies from completing their plans. If the Allies secure Arnhem, they will be able to force their way into Germany this year before we can mount a strong counterattack.
dst: 你的部队目前位于荷兰阿纳姆地区，正在抗击盟军的大规模进攻。盟军此举意在打通一条穿越众多河流与运河的通路，以夺取阿纳姆的莱茵河关键渡口。你务必阻止盟军完成其计划。一旦盟军拿下阿纳姆，他们就能在我们组织起强大反攻之前，于今年突入德国境内。

src: Your unflinching defense of Sarykamysh, compounded with the severe cold of the Kavkaz Mountains cost the enemy severe casualties:  the Turks left 7,000 frost-bitten prisoners and nearly 90,000 dead on the frozen slopes of the Araks valley.  The triumph of Sarykamysh will enable offensive operations for our forces during the spring of 1915.
dst: 您对萨雷卡梅什的坚定防御，加上高加索山脉的严寒，令敌人付出了惨重伤亡：土耳其人在阿拉克斯河谷冰封的坡地上留下了7000名冻伤俘虏和近9万具尸体。萨雷卡梅什的胜利将使我们的部队能够在1915年春展开进攻作战。

src: Your unit is garrisoned near the edge of a vast swamp, which was supposed to serve as a natural defense for our flank. During the night, however, Soviet scouts penetrated the swamp, followed by engineers and the main force. Our defenses consist only of a few light infantry units with unsubstantial artillery support. The only armoured unit in the area is an incomplete SS-Panzerjäger-Abteilung... and then there's your own battalion of heavy tanks, which are absolutely unsuitable for fighting in the swamp.
dst: 你的部队驻守在一片辽阔沼泽边缘，这片沼泽本应作为我军侧翼的天然屏障。然而夜间，苏军侦察兵穿过了沼泽，工兵和主力紧随其后。我们的防御仅由少数轻步兵和微弱的炮兵支援组成。该地区唯一的装甲单位是一个不完整的党卫军坦克歼击营……再就是你自己的重型坦克营——它们绝对不适合在沼泽中作战。

src: Your unit is part of the 150th Rifle Division located in Bessarabia, former part of Rumania. It is likely that the Rumanians will start an offensive here soon. To prevent this and conquer suitable defensive positions to start our own offensive from, you must cross the Prut River at Falciu, capture the bridge and form a bridgehead. Reinforcements will be brought in whenever possible. Beware of the Rumanians who will fight feriously because it is their own soil they will be fighting on. You must succeed. Good luck, Comrade!
dst: 你的部队隶属于驻扎在比萨拉比亚（原罗马尼亚领土）的第150步兵师。罗马尼亚人很可能很快在此发动攻势。为阻止其进攻并夺取合适的防御阵地以发起我军自己的攻势，你必须从法尔丘渡过普鲁特河、夺取桥梁并建立桥头堡。增援将尽可能及时抵达。当心罗马尼亚人——他们是在自己的土地上作战，必将殊死抵抗。你必须成功。祝你好运，同志！

src: Your unit will receive just a few more Tigers in the upcoming weeks. And while you will take the command of the battalion, it's only because your predecessor was wounded in combat.
dst: 未来数周，你的部队只会再接收寥寥几辆虎式。而你虽将接掌营指挥权，却只是因为前任营长在战斗中负了伤。

src: Your upcoming offensive against Palestine and TransJordan comes a week after our German allies started a major offensive on the Eastern Front. This offensive - code named Operation Zitadelle - might turn the tide of the war. Combined with a succesfull offensive against Palestine and TransJordan, it might convince Turkey to join the Axis and turn the tide of the war.
dst: 你即将对巴勒斯坦和外约旦发起的攻势，比我们德国盟友在东线发起的大攻势晚一周。这次攻势——代号“堡垒”行动——可能扭转战局。若能与对巴勒斯坦和外约旦的成功攻势相结合，或许能说服土耳其加入轴心国，扭转战争局势。

src: Your use of poison gas has achieved results, but we think the Allies will seek retribution by using their secret weapons they have been developing.
dst: 你使用毒气取得了战果，但我们认为盟军会动用他们一直在研制的秘密武器来报复。

src: Your utter lack of initiative has cost the lives of countless marines.  Your inability to coordinate the fire of the fleet with troop movements on the ground has resulted in numerous casualties to firendly fire.  Perhaps wanton waste of men is the status quo on other fronts in this war, but the Kavkaz Front cannot afford a commander such as you among its ranks.  You have been relieved, Gospodin General.
dst: 您严重缺乏主动，葬送了无数陆战队员的生命。您无法协调舰队火力与地面部队行动，导致大量人员死于友军误伤。也许白白浪费人命是这场战争其他战线上的常态，但高加索方面军的行列中容不下您这样的指挥官。您已被解职，中将阁下。

src: Your utter lack of initiative has cost the lives of countless soldiers. Your inability to coordinate the fire of the fleet with troop movements on the ground has resulted in numerous casualties.
dst: 您完全缺乏主动性，致使无数士兵丧命。您未能协调舰队炮火与地面部队的机动，导致了大量伤亡。

src: Your victory as Luga was a hard-won but essential success.  The stiffened resitance on the part of the Red Army does not bode well for the offensive:  it appears a change of leadership and policy (Lev Trotsky assumed command of the Red Army, re-instated officer ranks, and enforced conscription) has improved the Red Army's fighting abilities and organization.
dst: 您在卢加取得的胜利来之不易，却至关重要。红军日益顽强的抵抗对进攻并非好兆头：看来领导层与政策的改变（列夫·托洛茨基接管红军指挥权、恢复军官军衔并强制征兵）已提高了红军的战斗力和组织度。

src: Your victory at Cesis has become a symbol of national pride!  This day will be remembered for generations.
dst: 您在采西斯的胜利已成为民族自豪的象征！这一天将被世世代代铭记。

src: Your victory at Debrecen made it possible for the 8th German and 2nd Hungarian Armies to escape from Transylvania. Unfortunately, the 2nd Ukrainian Front is only 90 km away from Budapest. We are expecting them to attack any minute. You must hold the Attila-line until all Axis troops arrive and prevent a Bolshevik lightning victory.
dst: 你在德布勒森的胜利使德国第8集团军和匈牙利第2集团军得以从特兰西瓦尼亚脱身。遗憾的是，乌克兰第2方面军距布达佩斯仅90公里。我们预计他们随时会发起进攻。你必须守住阿提拉防线，直到所有轴心国部队抵达，阻止布尔什维克式的闪电胜利。

src: Your victory at Kharkov has allowed us to regain the initiative. We must continue to press our attacks against the Soviets.
dst: 你在哈尔科夫的胜利使我们重夺先手。我们必须继续对苏军施加攻势。

src: Your victory at Kharkov was so quick and decisive that the Soviet forces became hopelessly disorganized. We have been able to keep them on the run ever since.
dst: 你在哈尔科夫的胜利如此迅速而果断，致使苏军陷入无可挽回的混乱。此后我们一直让他们疲于奔命。

src: Your victory at Klin opens the way to a Northern encirclement of Moscow. Victory is at hand! The Fuhrer is very pleased!
dst: 你在克林取得的胜利打开了从北面包围莫斯科的道路。胜利就在眼前！元首非常满意！

src: Your victory at Pskov will be very useful in future Russo-Estonian negotiations.
dst: 您在普斯科夫的胜利将对未来的俄爱谈判十分有利。

src: Your victory has been complete. Kitchener has died in battle and when news of this new British defeat arrived in Kaapstad a rebellion started among the Afrikaner population of the city. Governor Milner panicked and he has left the country.
dst: 您取得了完胜。基钦纳已战死沙场，而当这场新的英军惨败的消息传到开普敦时，该城的阿非利卡人居民中爆发了起义。米尔纳总督惊慌失措，已经逃离了该国。

src: Your victory has been, without any doubt, crucial for the future of our Empire. Romania has sued for peace, and the Russian revolutionaries have suffered a blow from which they won't recover, especially since the Germans have also taken Riga, in the Baltic. I wouldn't be surprised if, in the following months, Russia fell into chaos and the Bolsheviks took power. In the short term that would be good for us. The war at the Eastern front would be over, and we could send more troops to the west, where we need them desperately.
dst: 毫无疑问，您的胜利对我们帝国的未来至关重要。罗马尼亚已经求和，俄国革命者也遭到了一记再也无法恢复的重创，尤其是德国人还夺取了波罗的海沿岸的里加。如果在接下来的几个月里，俄国陷入混乱、布尔什维克夺取政权，我一点也不会感到意外。短期内那对我们有利。东线的战事将会结束，我们就能向西线派遣更多的部队，那里正迫切需要援兵。

src: Your victory has helped delay the Russian advance, but it was insufficient to keep them from continuing their attacks.
dst: 你的胜利有助于迟滞苏军的推进，但不足以阻止他们继续进攻。

src: Your victory on Crete adds yet another successful campaign to your resume. Your next assignment will be critical to your career and to the cause of the war.
dst: 你在克里特的胜利为你的履历再添一次成功的战役。你的下一项任务对你的前程和战争大局都至关重要。

src: Your victory on Crete will go down in history as a military masterpiece. Your reputation within the army is unequaled. It is for this reason that we have given the key role in the invasion of Russia and the extra resources merited by your prestige.
dst: 你在克里特的胜利将作为军事杰作载入史册。你在军中的声望无人能及。正因如此，我们把入侵俄国的关键任务以及与你声望相称的额外资源交给了你。

src: Your victory over the British was complete, yet I think disappointing.
dst: 你对英军的胜利是彻底的，但我想还是令人失望。

src: Your worn-down forces were unable to dislodge the Canadian troops and the British units that came to their help. Our losses are mounting fast and the novelty of gas warfare is wearing off. Other divisions will have to continue the attack towards Ypres.
dst: 您疲惫不堪的部队未能逐退加拿大军队以及赶来支援他们的英军部队。我方损失正迅速攀升，而毒气战的新奇感也在消退。只能由其他师继续向伊普尔发起进攻了。
您诚挚的 富克斯上尉”

src: Yozgat redif div./ II Provisional Reserve Corps/ 莂talca Army
dst: Yozgat 预备役师/ 第2暂编预备役军/ Catalca 集团军

src: Yozgat redif div./ XVIII Army Corps/ 2nd Eastern Army
dst: Yozgat 预备役师/ 第18集团军军/ 第2东部集团军
伊普尔-伊瑟尔运河 (伊珀尔莱)

src: Yugoslav government has betrayed us. Occupy Belgrade and then head southwards.
dst: 南斯拉夫政府背叛了我们。占领贝尔格莱德，然后向南进发。

src: Yugoslavia has been defeated and we can now move to support Italy against the Greek and British armies.  Your men are to continue the advance as soon as possible.  The Klidi pass is defended by the British and is our next objective.
dst: 南斯拉夫已被击败，我们现在可移师支援意大利对抗希腊和英国军队。你的部队要尽快继续推进。克利迪山口由英军防守，是我们的下一个目标。

Zealand troops who were training in nearby
dst: 埃及训练中的澳大利亚和新西兰

泽列尼卢格 (泽列内卢格)

src: Zhukov decided it was time to break the stalemate.  At 05:45 on 20 August 1939, Soviet artillery and 557 fighters and bombers attacked Japanese positions, the first fighter-bomber offensive in Soviet Air Force history.  Approximately 50,000 Soviet and Mongolian soldiers of the 57th Special Corps defended the east bank of the Khalkhyn Gol. Three infantry divisions and a tank brigade crossed the river, supported by massed artillery and the Soviet Air Force. Once the Japanese were pinned down by the attack of Soviet center units, Soviet armored units swept around the flanks and attacked the Japanese in the rear, achieving a classic double envelopment. When the Soviet wings linked up at Nomonhan village on 25 August, the Japanese 23rd Infantry Division was trapped. On 26 August, a Japanese counterattack to relieve the 23rd Division failed. On 27 August, the 23rd Division attempted to break out of the encirclement, but also failed. When the surrounded forces refused to surrender, they were again hit with artillery and air attacks. By 31 August, Japanese forces on the Mongolian side of the border were destroyed, leaving remnants of the 23rd Division on the Manchurian side. The Soviets had achieved their objective.
dst: 朱可夫认定，打破僵局的时机到了。1939年8月20日5时45分，苏军炮兵与557架战斗机和轰炸机袭击了日军阵地，这是苏联空军史上第一次战斗轰炸机攻势。约5万名苏蒙士兵——隶属第57特别军——防守着哈拉哈河东岸。三个步兵师和一个坦克旅在密集炮火与苏联空军的支援下渡河。日军被苏军中央部队的进攻钉住之后，苏军装甲部队横扫两翼，从后方攻击日军，完成了一次经典的双重包围。8月25日，苏军两翼在诺门罕村会合，日军第23步兵师团陷入重围。8月26日，日军为解救第23师团发起的反击失败。8月27日，第23师团试图突围，同样失败。被围部队拒绝投降后，再次遭到炮击与空袭。到8月31日，蒙古一侧边境上的日军已被消灭，只剩下满洲一侧第23师团的残部。苏军达成了自己的目标。

Malaria, typhoid fever and any other dreadful disease you can imagine have taken its toll on my brave men during the last months, since we have landed on the shores of this godforsaken island that is called Madagascar. We were sent out to destroy the Merina Kingdom of Queen Ranavalona III, who has refused to turn her country into a French protectorate. But until now, our real enemy has been this devilish jungle, and we had to bury many a good man during our march on the Malagasi capital Antananarivo. there is one thing that I will teach them for sure: Their are times where freedom must be defended....

src: we have conquered the last important confederate Navybase !
dst: 我们已攻占了最后一个重要的邦联海军基地！

dst: 我们已获得现代物资，现按命令向西挺进——如果我们把叛军赶出布恩维尔，我们的补给线就能保证一段时间的畅通

src: we have to hurry up, General !
we have to move fast, General !

src: we have to reconquer the important railway junction Harpers Ferry at all cost....
dst: 我们必须不惜一切代价夺回重要的铁路枢纽哈珀斯费里……

src: we have to srtike quickly into the heart of the beast !
dst: 我们必须迅速打击这头野兽的心脏！

src: we have won, I fullfilled my duty: I resign as general, return to my school and teach young people again.....
dst: 我们赢了，我尽到了职责：我辞去将军职务，回到我的学校，重新教导年轻人……

src: we were able to secure this area.... but we have to retreat....General Lee is moving with a large army towards Washington....
dst: 我们得以守住了这一地区……但我们必须撤退……李将军正率领一支大军向华盛顿开来……

src: we've fought very brave, but the Prussians sent more and more troops against us... at last our front collapsed....
dst: 我们打得很英勇，但普鲁士人派来越来越多的部队进攻我们……最终我们的战线崩溃了……

src: well done ! now we must try to move further into Virginia...!

src: well done but we cannot take profit out of our victory: our troops are tied everywhere...

src: well done. You have secured this part of the coast !
dst: 干得好。您已经守住了海岸的这段！

src: well, meanwhile we gathered enough troops aruond Petersburg: time to take the next step...move forward with caution and take Petersburg and all the area south of Appomattox !
dst: 好，与此同时我们已在彼得斯堡周围集结了足够的兵力：是时候迈出下一步了……谨慎推进，拿下彼得斯堡和阿波马托克斯以南的全部地区！

src: who carried the message of armistice in Europe. He was suspicious of the message because it couldn´t be confirmed by the German High Command as they lost their last radio set 1917. On 13 November 1918, two days after the armistice, he took the town of Kasama which the British had evacuated, and continued heading south-west towards Katanga. When he reached the Chambeshi River  on the morning of 14 November, the British magistrate Hector Croad appeared under a white flag and delivered a message from the allied General van Deventer informing him of the armistice.
dst: 那名摩托车手携带的是欧洲停战的消息。他对此消息心生怀疑，因为德军最高统帅部早在1917年就丢掉了最后一部电台，无法证实这一消息。1918年11月13日，即停战两天之后，他攻占了已被英军撤离的卡萨马镇，并继续向西南方向的加丹加挺进。11月14日清晨，当他抵达钱贝西河时，英国治安官赫克托·克罗德打着白旗出现，转交了协约国范·德文特将军的一封信，告知他停战的消息。

src: wir haben uns mit modernem material ausgerüstet, und ziehen laut befehl nach westen- wenn wir die rebellen aus boonville vertreiben sind unsere versorgungswege bis auf weiteres sicher....
dst: 我们已用现代物资装备起来，并按命令向西挺进——如果我们把叛军赶出布恩维尔，我们的补给线暂时就可保无虞……

src: with Excitement we hear that our german Friends have formed four volunteer Regiments.
dst: 我们兴奋地得知，我们的德国朋友们组建了四个志愿兵团。

src: yes, because right now the earth is starting to shake beneath my feet and a terrible symphony of thunder is roaring in the distance. The gates of hell are opening. The Germans attack...
dst: 是的，因为此刻我脚下的大地开始颤抖，远处传来可怕的雷霆交响。地狱之门正在打开。德国人进攻了……

src: you must cross over the Liska and Don rivers and occupy the bridges near Kalach city.

dst: 你必须摧毁 11 区内的 3 座机场，并击落多佛地区所有敌方战斗机。

src: you should deploy most of your men in the west, to take the desoto peninsula.... and your cavalry should help in the east....
dst: 您应该把大部分兵力部署在西面，去夺取德索托半岛……您的骑兵则应在东面策应……

src: you should purchase some additional artillery and/or cavalry.
dst: 您应该增购一些炮兵和/或骑兵。

src: ¡Buenos dias Sr.General! Nuestro glorioso movimiento patriótico para salvar España sigue por buen camino. Sin embargo... aun debemos llevar a cabo algunas operaciones importantes en las provincias del Norte. ¡Nuestro levantamiento en Asturias, Santander, Vizcaya y Guipuzcoa (donde nuestra guarnición se ha rendido), ha fallado miserablemente!, y que esa ridícula franja de territorio permanezca leal al gobiero de Madrid, es algo, ¡que no podemos tolerar!. Mientras nuestros valientes soldados están combatiendo al enemigo en la capital de la República, usted deberá ponerse al mando de algunas unidades y atacar Guipuzcoa de inmediato. Le llegaran algunos refuerzos del Suroeste, que deberán atacar siguiendo el eje Urnieta - Hernani - San Sebastián. Además, contará con algunas unidades navales, que ya navegan desde la base de El Ferrol para apoyar la ofensiva con fuego pesado desde el mar.
dst: 早上好，将军！我们为拯救西班牙而进行的这场光荣的爱国运动进展顺利。然而……我们在北部各省仍需执行一些重要作战。我们在阿斯图里亚斯、桑坦德、比斯开和吉普斯夸（我方的守备部队已在那里投降）发动的起义惨遭失败！而那条可笑的狭长地带竟仍效忠于马德里政府，这是我们绝不能容忍的！当我们英勇的士兵正在共和国的首都与敌人作战时，您须统率若干部队立即进攻吉普斯夸。西南方向会有一些增援部队抵达，他们应沿乌尔涅塔-埃尔纳尼-圣塞瓦斯蒂安轴线发起进攻。此外，您还可动用若干海军部队，它们已从埃尔费罗尔基地出航，将从海上以重炮火力支援此次攻势。

src: ¡Esta usted citado para un consejo de guerra!
dst: 您被传唤出席军事法庭审判！

src: ¡Esto es un desastre!, su ataque ha sido desbaratado, y muchas de nuestras unidades puestas fuera de combate. El enemigo ha consolidado sus posiciones en Teruel, y ahora no podremos continuar con el ataque en el Mediterraneo.
dst: 这是一场灾难！您的进攻被击溃，我方许多部队丧失战斗力。敌军已巩固其在特鲁埃尔的阵地，如今我们无法继续向地中海进攻。

src: ¡Esto es un desastre!. Nuestro ataque ha sido desbaratado, y la  mayoría de nuestras unidades puestas a la desbandada... Las milicias del Frente Popular han consolidado sus posiciones en torno a San Sebastián ... y ahora el Frente Norte es un peligroso cuchillo apuntando a Navarra y a Castilla, la espina dorsal de nuestro avance hacia Madrid.
dst: 这是一场灾难！我们的进攻已被打乱，我们的大部分部队陷入溃散……人民阵线的民兵已在圣塞瓦斯蒂安周边巩固了阵地……如今北方战线就像一把危险的尖刀，直指纳瓦拉和卡斯蒂利亚——我们向马德里推进的脊梁。

src: ¡Esto es urgente general!, los rojos han derrotado a nuestra 4º Brigada desplegada en Teruel. Han tomado muchos prisioneros, entre los que se incluye el comandante de la guarnición, el coronel Rey D'Harcourt. Las temperaturas extremadamente frías nos impiden desplegar la superioridad aérea de que disponemos para colaborar en la derrota del avance enemigo. Esto supondrá un problema, pero el C.G. del Generalísimo cree que las tropas que se encuentran bajo su mando pueden retomar Teruel, lo que nos permitiría continuar con la marcha hacia el Mediterraneo.
dst: 这情况紧急，将军！共和军击败了我方部署在特鲁埃尔的第4旅。他们俘虏了大批人员，其中包括守军指挥官雷伊·德·阿尔库尔上校。极寒的天气使我们无法投入可用的空中优势来协助挫败敌军推进。这会是个问题，但最高统帅司令部认为，您麾下的部队能够夺回特鲁埃尔，这将使我们得以继续向地中海进军。

src: ¡Excelente! ¡Excelente!  Todo el Norte de España está ahora en nuestras manos. Ahora podremos volver la atención al frente del centro, aunque su próximo destino será el frente de Aragón, donde estamos planeando una operación especial para alcanzar el Mediterraneo y tomar Valencia, donde se encuentra la capital republicana.
dst: 太棒了！太棒了！西班牙整个北部如今已落入我方之手。现在我们可以把注意力转回中部战线，不过您的下一个目的地将是阿拉贡战线，我们正在那里筹划一次特别行动，以抵达地中海并攻占巴伦西亚——共和军的首都就在那里。

src: ¡Excelente!, los rojos se han llevado lo suyo en Guipuzcoa. Ahora se les ha cerrado el grifo de armas y municiones desde Francia. Es solo una cuestión de tiempo la caida de todo el Norte en nuestras manos... Lo siento por usted, pero creo que no tendrá tiempo de disfrutar la temporada de verano en San Sebastián: tengo otro importante cometido para usted, ¡y debe ser llevado a cabo con prontitud!
dst: 太好了！共和军在吉普斯夸吃了大亏。如今他们从法国获取武器和弹药的渠道已被切断。整个北方落入我们手中只是时间问题……我为您感到遗憾，但我想您不会再有时间享受圣塞瓦斯蒂安的夏季时光了：我还有一项重要任务交给您，而且必须尽快执行！

src: ¡Excelente, excelente! Al final resultó que la ofensiva enemiga era una auténtica chapuza, así que los republicanos han sido frenados en seco pronto por sus tropas y sus determinadas acciones. General, debo decirle que a no mucho tardar seremos nosotros los que pasemos a la ofensiva.
dst: 太棒了，太棒了！到头来，敌人的攻势不过是一场十足的拙劣之举，所以共和军很快就被您的部队和您果断的行动遏制住了。将军，我得告诉您，用不了多久，就该轮到我们转入进攻了。

src: ¡Felicidades!, la cabeza de puente de los republicanos ha sido destruida, con lo que Barcelona ya está al alcance de la mano y nadie podrá detenernos ya en nuestro avance por terreno catalán.
dst: 恭喜！共和军的桥头堡已被摧毁，巴塞罗那已近在咫尺，再也没有人能阻挡我们在加泰罗尼亚地区推进了。

src: ¡Mi General!  Hemos recibido un telegrama urgente de Burgos:
dst: 我的将军！我们收到了一封来自布尔戈斯的紧急电报：

src: ¡Oh gracias a Dios!, nos ha salvado general. Nos estabamos quedando sin comida ni municiones... ya estabamos temiendo lo peor, viendo a los rojos correr por las calles. Ahora deberíamos continuar consolidando la defensa de Oviedo...
dst: 哦，感谢上帝！将军，您救了我们。我们已经快没有食物和弹药了……看着共和军在街上四处乱窜，我们一直担心最坏的情况。现在我们应该继续巩固奥维耶多的防御……

src: ¡Su incompetencia ha resultado funesta para la causa nacional!  Bilbao es un nuevo Madrid, y además lo que es peor, se rumorea que los franceses están planeando reabrir la frontera para permitir el paso de suministros a los republicanos.
dst: 您的无能对国民事业造成了灾难性的后果！毕尔巴鄂成了新的马德里，更糟糕的是，有传言说法国人正计划重新开放边境，以便让补给运给共和军。

src: ¡Su incompetencia ha resultado funesta para la causa nacional!, ya sabrá que los cuarteles de Gijón han caido junto con Oviedo. Hemos recibido informes que hablan sobre la ejecución del coronel Aranda, programada para mañana. La suya seguro que le seguirá pronto.
dst: 您的无能给国民事业带来了灾难性的后果！您想必已经知道，希洪的兵营已随奥维耶多一同陷落。我们收到报告称，对阿兰达上校的处决定于明日执行。您的处决想必很快也会接踵而至。
……但首先你应该好好休息一下。
“Corps de Cavalerie”的部分部队必须协助第1军，尤其是其第7师，防守埃本-埃马尔地区，并阻止德军夺取马斯特里赫特地区阿尔贝运河上的桥梁。
“KW 防线”（迪尔河防线）果然如我们所料顶住了。德军损失惨重，未能突破我军防线。
“KW 防线”（迪尔河防线）很好地顶住了德军的压力。德军损失重大，费了很大力气才夺得几处小桥头堡。这些桥头堡很快就会被肃清。
“KW 防线”（迪尔河防线）在若干地段被突破，但我相信它能阻止德军前进。您只需收拢部队，夺回德军建立的桥头堡。
“KW 防线”（迪尔河阵地）的部队并未受到特别猛烈的压力，两次试图在鲁汶附近强渡迪尔河的行动都被相当轻松地击退。
“本场景是一场漫长、复杂、架空、需精细微操、带自订房规、声望丰厚的庞然大物，但但愿人人都能从其无尽的可能、幽默、史诗级玩法以及它所蕴含的严峻挑战中获得乐趣。这是一场游戏中的游戏，我的主要目标，是让它成为那套默认的场景测试，以找出天下第一的 Open General 玩家，哈哈。”
“第1阿登猎兵师”已奉命前往芬克特镇增援前线。
“钢”突击队 / 科赫突击支队 / 第7航空师
“花岗岩”突击队 / 科赫突击支队 / 第7航空师
“混凝土”突击队 / 科赫突击支队 / 第7航空师
“骑兵军”必须掩护部署的北翼，接替正撤回法国的法军部队。
“骑兵军”正在前线后方整编，但如形势需要，可能会要求您提供支援。我们已获悉德军将试探鲁汶城周边的我军阵地。
